We were sat at a table against the window where the sun was blaring into everyone's eyes and I asked if the shades could be closed and was told no so I asked to be moved to a booth since there was a bunch of them available. We were moved. As we sat we were looking at the decor and it looked nice in there until I looked at the iron scrolling that lined the tables. It was filled with dust. Gross. I did like the bar portion in the center with fire going. It's a nice touch. Two people in our party got fajitas and they were totally underwealming! The chicken one had less than a breast of meat and was burned in spots. The steak one had only about 4 strips of meat. I was going to share with my son but there wasn't enough to share between two people and yet they aren't cheap! My son loves chimichangas and they had none on their menu. The service was just OK. More than once we felt like we had been forgotten. Needless to say, we will not return for many reasons. The only pro I can think of is the chips and salsa. They do have a couple TVs so I might go if I wanted to drink, eat chips, and watch the game.. but I could do that anywhere.
The food was excellent, we ate outside which was much quitter than inside and not as crowded.  The beer selection was great 43 micro brews I believe.

Hands down the best bread pudding in the northwest. Seriously, I've had waitresses at different restaurants suggest we go here just for it!  So that's saying something. I've never had a bad meal here or experience ever, in fact the best steak I've had in this valley has been from Kahootz too, It's one of the best kept secrets in the treasure valley. 
They are usually pretty good about getting you in a timely manner, but unfortunately with good food comes the people who know where to find it and eat it.. and that's a good thing!

Nice old fashioned looking restaurant. We first walk in and it's quiet but the guys greet you real fast and help you. Super cool to see good customer service from a small burger joint. The orders of food are pretty big, my onion rings were delicious. My bacon cheeseburger reminded me of a Big Juds burger but the hamburger patty was seasoned and made for a nice juicy burger. The lettuce, onions, tomatoes was crisp, fresh and had a good combination of meat to bun. Give this place a try and I think you won't regret it! "Give it a try and feel the hunger!"

I've been several times with my wife; they often run a BOGO coupon which makes it a compelling lunch option. Although the lines might look long, they go very quickly, and you can be sitting down to eat within 10 minutes of arrival, even during a lunch rush.

They offer pre-designed pizzas (they have selected toppings) or you can build your own. I tried building my own on my last visit (bacon, blue cheese, banana peppers, garlic) and it was good...and the pre-designed choices are excellent too. I believe they are also offering salads. They have typical beverages, as well as some higher-end sodas on the fountain. 

 The pizzas are big enough to feed at least 1 person. My wife always takes a couple of pieces home. I'd say it's about the same amount of food as a Chipotle burrito. 

 I'll definitely be back; it's convenient to my house and serves a tasty and quick lunch!
We enjoy this restaurant every time we are in town. Food is authentic which is hard to find in Idaho. Awesome happy hour from 4-6.

Awesome Food!!! Lobster bisque, Lobster Alfredo...TO DIE FOR!!! I went there Saturday night, I made reservations and passed the 1 hour wait line (BIG THUMBS UP TO RESERVATIONS!!!) I had a glass of the "Menage a Trois " red wine, I could not believe the great taste of that wine! It floored me! Anyway, we hat the Lobster bisque soup, I could not believe it was just part of the meal, tasty like no other, with giant chunks of lobster! My wife had the Lobster Alfredo, same as the soup, more lobster than you can shake a stick at. I had the prime rib, I have to admin, it was not the best. I love my prime rib with the horseradish sauce on it, not au jus. This came swimming in au jus, literally swimming. That might be great for some people, just not my taste. All in all, we will go back again and again, just not for the prime rib.
Like the amazing selection I enjoy sitting at the bar n chatting with bartenders friendly team good food.

Terrible service. Waited 40 minutes for good on Sunday night. $7.50 for a shot of fireball. Simply overpriced everything exspecially the drinks. They play the same extreme sports video EVERY night. Avoid this place unless you feel like having some bad good and pay twice as much as anywhere else for it.

A friend highly recommended this restaurant and we enjoyed a delicious dinner. The cornbread cooked in a little cast iron skillet started it off on a good note. We had the smothered pork chops that were tender and meaty with a potato cake with a crispy outer layer topped with gravy and a sweet corn. My husband ordered the catfish which they substituted red snapper that was lightly breaded with a bit of a kick in the seasoning. It was served with the potatoes and corn. For dessert the peach cobbler and ice cream was just like Grandma used to make. Looking forward to returning to try some of the breakfast, lunch and sushi items.
Good selection of sandwiches and entrees on menu. The service was excellent and they had quite a selection of microbrews on tap. The pork sandwich was excellent. Prices were fair.
I love this place. The gluten free rice dough isn't only for people with an allergy, it's a must try!
Great food and taste, but have had food poisoning multiple times unfortunately. Also it would be nice if the cups for soda were bigger.

Normally this KK is outstanding but today I was extremely disappointed!!! I ordered a small blended Carmel vanilla latte and received a small iced something not vanilla or Carmel. When I brought it to the woman's attention she, with a snirky attitude, said "we'll we can add more Carmel if that'll make you happy. Oh and we can't do blended because we don't have the proper items to do so". On top of that my order was completely wrong. I ordered 6 chocolate with sprinkles and 6 additional variety and received 5 chocolate with sprinkles, a strawberry with sprinkles, 1 original with sprinkles and 5 random ones with nuts. Nothing close to what I ordered. Extremely disappointed - and so are the people who didn't get their donuts!!!!
I'm a big boy, this place doesn't do it for me.  I think the salesman was ok, but after he saw my size and what little selection there was, he moved on

Meh bad service... I think the manager needs to revamp everyone's training here. 

First of all there was about 5 waiters total 4 of which I watched stand in a little huttle chit chatting while the ONE other guy ran around doing everything. Our waters didn't get refilled our chips were left empty and no wonder because he was the only one doing everything he couldn't do it all well. 

The food was not great (nor was the margarita I didn't drink either) and when I asked to take just the food back he grilled me on why I wanted to return the meal. Asking once for knowledge purposes is one thing but I told him I'm not too sure I just didn't like it and he asked 3 more times telling me he doesn't have authority to take it off the bill and the manager needs a reason. I told him you know what if the manager has a problem they can come out and speak directly to me. Like Jesus Christ!!!!! 

Then after knowing we were unsatisfied with the meal they made us wait for the check and then once we were ready to pay made us wait again before they picked it up and not once did we get an apology.

Loved this place! I had Lindsey color and cut my hair, seems they all were all good in there. I am very happy with both the cut and color. I won't choose to go anyplace else. I am happy I found a nice place to
Go as I am new to the area!

This place is the best. Great food, great atmosphere, and friendly staff. 
Steaks are big and good. 
Free peanuts and the rolls with the cinna butter are the best thing that man has ever made. Full bar too.
Amazing......I give them 100+'s!! Very friendly, clean, great location.   My Guacamole bacon cheese  burger was the best burger I've had in years. Organic meat. The best. A must try.
Burgers are super good! I'd say a tad expensive but worth it if you want a good burger that is better than any fast food joint!
Awesome place! Wings and steak are amazing! Came from NJ and had a great time here tonight!

Was excited to try this place but left totally disappointed. We didn't even take home our leftovers. The pizza is like a cracker with canned tomato sauce on it. No flavor whatsoever. To be blunt, it was disgusting, hard to even swallow. We will never go back here. Great concept, TERRIBLE pizza.
Great service great food loved the Alfredo ! They always have awesome beer choices and know a lot about each one! Love this place!

I love Yard House! The food is always fabulous! The service, however, is always lacking. Expect to wait for a drink refill, regardless of how busy they are, and expect to have a server that does not know the menu. Training is definitely lacking at this location.

It's 11 o'clock on a Sunday im sitting here for 20 minutes waiting for a normal cheeseburger and chicken nuggets I'm wondering if they had to go kill the chicken or something this is ridiculous to have to wait this long.....
Great good, family friendly and fast service! My family and I frequently visit Wok Fusion. The owner is really nice!

Alway a fun environment. Lots of tvs and music. Wide variety of sauces for wings and other options as well. Daily specials. Food quality is good. I've had days of speedy service and seen it lag at other times. Overall it is on my short list for lunch.

It is WalMart... Do I really need to review here? They all kinda suck. This one is open 24 hours though and it is currently after midnight.... How convenient. Considering that Boise is one of those towns where nothing is open super late, this is s probably the most fun a girl can have on a Thursday night. It is cleaner than most other Walmart's too... so that is something.

i dont usually review chain restaurants but since it's the only one in idaho i figured why not? it's definitely worth reviewing too.

we came in on a saturday for lunch. no wait. the inside is so hip with unique art along the wall and the most gigantic bar in town. it was nice and cold and dark in there- i just love the atmosphere that yard house creates. it just makes you want to come in and never leave.

our server kind of sucked, i'm not going to lie. he had the personality of a raisin. boring. never engaged with us, gave me a blank stare any time i asked him anything at all. if you aren't personable, why choose serving? the best part about the job is getting to interact with people. we barely saw him. he sucked.

drink order taken- wine for mom- club soda for me- never got the club soda. literally mom got her wine and 15 minutes later we never saw the server so i finally asked someone passing by for my drink. when he came back and we told him what happened he didn't apologize, just made an excuse. *rolls eyes* whatever bro, cool story.

now on to the good stuff: YUM! we got the 'lumpia' to split as an appetizer and it was so damn good. perfection. the sauces they came with were TO. DIE. FOR. the truffle sauce sounds weird but it was so addicting i couldn't stop eating it! i even dipped my pizza in it- which was amazing btw. highly recommend. they should make a pizza with that as the sauce. i would buy it.

cobb salad mom got was delicious and very fresh looking- my pizza and ranch salad was really tasty and such a great deal for $9.95. i love that they have lunch menu even on weekends, that's awesome.

i will definitely be coming back- hopefully i don't get stuck with mr. raisin again...

Where's the corporate structure. Apparently Walmart has the 3 stooges working at the tire and oil side. I'm use to pulling up to get my oil changed and having guys run out to get it done right away. Here there is a wait of about four people. One guy just standing out in the garage looking no where with a blank stare and the other two guys teaming up on the computer flirting with the girls in front of me. 45 minute wait for an oil change? I'll pass

So the new name is Soda Stop, but this place is no good. The cookies are disgusting, precooked, frozen, and served cold/frozen. The kids who work there are super unimpressed with their jobs and not remotely courteous.

Went for a weekday lunch, staff was very friendly. It was a little confusing because you are not really sure if you need to sit yourself or wait to be seated. A sign would help with that. Food was great. I got a the cali sandwich and my husband got fish tacos. Mine was hot and flavorful, the fish in the fish tacos was a really good portion size comped to other local restaurants. Fries and fry sauce was worth it too. Love the neighborhood feel, can't wait to visit again.

The Yardhouse is my new favorite place to eat.  We have been her a number of times and I have tried something new every time.  There isn't a bad meal in this place.  The service has always been impecable and their beer selection is out of this world.

Went to this place yesterday. Had the sushi and sashimi combination for two. Looked beautiful tasted amazing. Jump forward two hours later, my wife and I are both sick. Now over 24 hours later we are still sick. We both felt great before then. There isn't really any other explanation or the way we feel.

Great looking from the outside. However, having the first face being a crabby teenager named Katie will ruin your business. Dear Manager, don't let kids run the show on a Friday night, I never even made it to order, rude, rude, rude. Will never go back.

Great food and bar selections, comfortable and in a great location. The Village at Meridian is a nice place to shop or just hang out. The only down side at the restaurant is the crazy high noise level, that's bad.
Fun environment, loud, great prices for really tasty food! LOVE THEIR ROLLS! 9 times out of 10 great service.

The "manager" I assume it was, visited our table while dining at there new location. Made small talk about the chairs and there opening. By far the nicest Flat Bread location and very personable management and customer service. Great food and great company. We are never disappointed.

Went here with a friend for some drinks and great wings and got exactly that! Had a wonderful server named Kimberly who was extremely quick with orders and making sure we had everything we needed. Great and friendly staff, with above standard service, would highly recommend to anyone!

We stumbled upon this place when we were running errands in Meridian. It was  a pleasant surprise. They had a great beer list, great service, and a great overall feel to the place. The food though was just average. I would be back for sure if I am in the area but I would come for the people, the service,  and the beer and not necessarily  for the food.

Blaze Pizza is one of my favorite places in Boise. It's incredibly challenging to find delicious pizza that is Gluten Free- and Blaze is very careful. They change their gloves, use a different slicer, and you get to build it yourself which is fun. Definitely a favorite place of mine.

So disappointed! Walked into the restaurant at 6 p.m. on a Tuesday. There was one employee at the register with one customer. Was not greeted or acknowledged for several minutes. Finally there was a weak "dine in or take out"? I requested a booth for two. We were seated and asked if we wanted to order any drinks. When I asked for water with lemon, I was told , "I will let your server know." Really? You can't bring us our water? Waited several minutes and the mystery second employee and water never appeared. Walked out. First clue should have been that there were only two tables occupied at peak dinner hour. This location has zero ambiance and absolutely failed on customer service. First impression was horrible. There are too many choices in Meridian to settle for substandard service. I cannot recommend wasting your time on this one. Sorry.
Closest to Bay Area I've found in the Valley. Salt & Pepper prawns were excellent as was the Mu Shu. I WILL be back!

Came in to have dinner and was seated and waited 15 minutes and no one even came by to ask us for a drink order. Decided to be fair and set a timer for 2 minutes to see if anyone would even acknowledge us. Nope! They seemed properly staffed but obviously totally disorganized. We left without ordering and they even thanked us on our way out! What a waste of time!

First time at the Yardhouse! Fabulous. Had the lamb burger with jalapeño relish YUMMY! Our waiter was very knowledgeable about all the beers and the history of the establishment, worth the money. We will be back.

I was wrong, I judged Blaze pizza before trying it. I thought it would be overpriced average pizza. What I got was a great value and pizza made just the way I like it. Nice crisp crust, plenty of sauce and quality toppings. Then I went to get a drink and was blown away with the wide and quality assortment of beverages. If the pizza was average I would still come just for the drink selection. However, you get the best of both worlds.

One of the worse experiences I have ever had. Went with friends to have a nice dinner. Three little girls a mother of two of them. Everything started out find until the food and drinks came. The kids would not eat the food because it was cold. The drinks were watered down and we could not drink them. They the bill came we explained the problem and thought something could be done, so the overly large manger started out explaining to is that we were drunk and that we were as he put it ( deceiving the inn his own words ) and that we needed to pay for the food. We said no and he then said if we don't pay he was going to call the police. We told him please do. And then he left us. He then back I then asked then to please redo the food order for the kids and replace the drinks we did not drink since we only tasted them. He said no! You are both drunk! Mind you we had only tasted the drinks. I then asked for the bill and he would not give it me to pay. I then said if you are not going to give as the bill to pay then we are leaving. He then said if you do then I will have you arrested. At this point I'm now trapped and can not pay the bill or leave. So this started an argument. Now I'm confronted with a over 300 pound manager and words were said which lead to the manger getting so mad that he grabbed my neck an strangled me and I fell to the floor from lack of oxygen and injured my neck from the mangers strangle hold. My friend tried to stop him and she was pushed and hit  in her chest by the manger also,all the while this is being  recorded  by the restaurant cameras. 

I feel sorry for the staff that works there. You can tell by their faces that this manger must have a temper and they can nothing about it as to fear losing their jobs.

I just moved here from Southern California and ive been to another place and it was horrible!!  I went here today with a friend who recommended it and it was good!!  I will have to try the tempen side for dinner one night but im so use to the crab being different in the California roll but my salmon roll was good, i will go back with the hubby and try other rolls but more impressed then the last place.

This place is great! They have great food, a wonderful staff, and a wide (43) selection of beers on tap. Their Friday and Saturday prime rib specials are fantastic. Hand cut steaks starting at 5pm, and they are seasoned and cooked to perfection. Don't show up late these nights or else they may run out. The only downside to this place is the size. It can get crowded and busy, but I guess I would rather wait a bit for great food and service rather than no wait for mediocrity.

Ehh...?
That's kind of what I end up thinking as I leave Buffalo Wild Wings. I've been here about 3 times and every time it's been JUST ok.

The first visit, it took me (and I timed it) 45 minutes to get a beer and our server told me 3 times it was "On it's way." Ok, it takes 1 minute to pour a beer...what's with the other 44? By the time I got it, I didn't even feel like paying the 5 or so bucks for it. Got a salad and the chicken seemed undercooked and lukewarm, not a good start for a wings place.

Second and third visit, our food has just been ok. Absolutely nothing to write home about, or even crave on a later date. My boyfriend hates it here and I end up just getting a side salad every time we meet friends here, because I know it won't get messed up or be mis-cooked. NEver a good experience and we don't go here by choice.

This is what can best be described as a "90's style yuppie inspired upscale Mexican eatery" when it comes to ambiance.

The salsa served with the fresh corn tortilla is a bit spicy, enough to wake up your tongue. 

I tried the Mahi Mahi tacos.  2 tacos with grilled fish and a nice pico worked wonderfully.  Sadly, the rice has little flavor, and the beans were lacking something, but didn't distract from the dish.  

Definitely a go back spot.

The initial experience was not a good one but the owner is very proactive and does stand by his customer satisfaction guarantee. He made contact with me personally to communicate about our differences. He offered to refund the disputed charges and cares about his company's reputation.

Went for lunch with our kiddo. We stood at door for a while before being seated. Once finally seated we were never acknowledged. We were walked by several times by different employees. We waited patiently for 20 minutes, made eye contact with the gals working but we were never approached. We left, unnoticed. Disappointed! We love chilis.

Went for first time was very excited to eat their. My wife order tacos which came cold not even warm. Told manager which he took back and put the plate in the microwave that only warm the rest of the food on the plate that was the rice and beans but tacos was still cold. The food needed more taste very plain. Very expensive and will not go again.

My first and only complaint is that they do not have alcohol....no beers no wines. Im not a big fan of mongolian bbq but this was good considering they had way more choices. They had salmon, mahi mahi, lots of vegetables, and you can get it with tortillas to make small mongolian tacos? 

pros
-clean
-friendly and helpful staff
-cool atmosphere
-lots of choices

cons
-no alcohol......
-unicorn farts
Wouldn't know it by looking from the outside but this place is the BOMB!  Get there early or there will be a wait.

As I sauntered into my nearest Texas Bro-house, I was welcomed by an empty server stand, thank Cthulhu. Usually I have to fight my way thru the robust patrons just to get my name on a list, and I had prepared myself for it by stuffing my pockets full of peanuts. 

I don't think I've ever been the Bro-house without ordering the deep fried onion treat. I've even ordered one as dessert after having one as an appetizer. Fresh onions battered and deep fried are as American as heart disease & morbid obesity, and you're goddamn right I'm okay with that. 

This trip's meal also included a plate of grilled shrimp over a bed of seasoned rice(always great) while my table mate decided to get a half slab of ribs and an order of chicken critters(side note: if I'm spending my good boy points for some chicky tendies, I'm coming for Texas Roadhouse, and quickly) Those critters are scrumptious! 

It's reliably great, even with a wait, solid place for a date. 

This review has been quite the rollercoaster of emotion. I'll be back, and I might even stop myself from eating all of the honey butter.

Thank you once again for another great experience at Yard House. Tonight my husband and I enjoyed a beautiful evening on the patio and shared the chicken pot pie. Delicious and huge-the two of us had more than we could eat! You have never failed to please! ***A word of advice to diners-you MUST try the s'more desert and share with friends. It's a warm, gooey, fun to share experience!

This is a newish place (September 2018) that's great for breakfast and lunch. We came in for lunch, but they serve breakfast all day, so we had one plate of each. I ordered a mexican omelette with red potatoes and rye toast. Every bit if it was excellent! I don't usually finish the toast and hashbrowns with a typical breakfast, but these were so good I had to. My wife had a toasted cheese sandwich with guacamole and red potatoes, which was also very good. The service was great, nice/attentive wait staff, plus the price was right. I will totally be back.

Highly disappointing experience based on the food as well as value for price. Poor quality on the Carne Asada Tacos and Top Shelf Margarita for over 30 dollars (including tip). Missing California but I could get 5x better tacos and a margarita for a third the price.

Won't return.
By far my favorite craft store! I know I can always find what I want, and usually it's on sale! My personal favorite part about hobby lobby is that Christmas goes up like in August!

Overpriced with extremely slow service. It took about 20 minutes to get a high chair for my son, and even longer to order my first drink. The food was good (shrimp pasta in vodka sauce) and the martini was good, but $30 for one person to have a drink and a half-sized entree is pretty steep for Meridian. At those prices, I would expect a nicer (quieter) atmosphere with more attentive service and fewer big screen TVs.

Class act service!  Why would anyone get their oil changed anywhere else. Free newspaper, Wi Fi and drink while you wait in your car. Staff is amazingly friendly and cordial. Staff Is just real where your car stands and they recommend things with no sales pressure. Between oil changes stop by for tire pressure checks and fluid top offs. I am disappointed I have driven by this place and never tried them out. Thanks to the reviews I would have never tried this place out. I will recommend this place to friends and family. Nice to see the owner Michael working on cars with his staff. Keep this business going by bringing all your cars here for their oil changes and maintenance checks.

We had 40 people here for dinner and just showed up. They were able to seat us within 20 minutes. The food was fantastic, service was impeccable! They got all of our orders correct and knew who ordered what! The gave us separate checks and didn't blink an eye! Wow! Hands down great place. Not to mention the playground and shops right there!
Great food. Great atmosphere. Friendly waitstaff. If they were open more hours that would be even better. But still definitely worth the trip.

Overall the food is not bad but I would have to say I have had much better steaks in many places but have paid a lot more as well.  This particular location is very busy on weekends but we did not have a long wait.  The thing I dislike the most is the feeling of "burn them and turn them" I get when going to a Roadhouse.  The staff is trained to try to up sell you before you even sit down, plus it's clear they want you to eat fast so they can turn the table as quick as possible.  Maybe this is less present during the week but on weekends it is annoying!  All of that being said, the "baby" blooming onion is just the right size for two people and was perfectly cooked.  The garden salad was nothing special, the same can be said for the Caesar salad.  The fillet was tender and cooked as ordered but had a slightly spongy texture, I wonder if it gets some artificial help in the tenderness department?  The pulled pork was very good as were the ribs although not as good as a true BBQ joint, but not bad.  So in summary if you can overlook the hustle aspect, the food is a good value for the price.
Food was ok. Beans and rice were cold and way too much meet on their Posada and meat was dry. And not favorable,

Ralph and crew had a big job taking out 3 large redwoods and also trimmed some other trees at our Clovis home.  I was really impressed with their work and they do a super job cleaning up. These are true professionals and I am so happy to have found them.  I highly recommend them.

Kevin is awesome! He helped me so much by educating me on the best humidifier to purchase. Then he made ordering it online from the store for me, easy. He's great!! Basically I entered the store, stood there looking at all the humidifiers, thinking to myself "gee, which one!" When Kevin appeared and said "how may I help you, any questions" and I was like yeah, which one" so point is, he was like a humidifier angel that showed up and saved my day! All the sales associates that I came into contact with today at Bed Bath and Beyond were all exceptional. There was also another very nice gentleman stocking the kitchen area, he was really friendly to me while my 16 month old threw an embarrassing tantrum in the middle of the store. And there were several nice young woman at the cashier registers also. Everyone that works in this store is really cool! Very helpful people, really nice shopping experience. I highly recommend this store!!!!

Server was very friendly, but service was not fabulous. We ordered beers nachos and salad. The beer was cool but not ice cold like it should be. Food was alright until the flies decided to take over and then nothing looked appealing anymore. Probably will not go back again.

Service is great. Atmosphere is like no other. This place is beautiful. Food....meh. Cold tacos, boring tastes, tortilla chips and salsa are lackluster. No discounts on alcohol for happy hour? Unheard of. You'd think the food would be out of this world in a setting like this. Kitchen and menu need a serious overhaul.

Food a little pricey for the value.  I absolutely HATED the nachos. Overly salty, otherwise flavorless chips with sparse toppings.  Charged me for much-needed salsa, which was also poor.  Wings OK, better at Hooters.

I eat in steak houses all over the country.  Kahootz measures up with all of them.

Steaks are cooked spot on.  Many places don't know how to serve a steak medium rare.  These guys do.  When you read other reviews complaining about their undercooked steaks, it is because they are accustomed to cooking the flavor out of everything.

The dining room is small but worth the wait.

We like to order off the fresh sheet and get a bread pudding for dessert.

The wine list has a wide variety while being very economical.  The beer list is one of the strongest around.  

The service is attentive and family friendly.
Just love eating here the steaks are so tender the melt in your mouth great I'll always come back ! And say Hi to Billie she is great all the staff is wonderful

This place is great! They have a very large menu but execute everything very well. I've had the enchilada stack, jambalaya, and angel hair pasta with shrimp. I clean my plate every time because it's so good. If you go at night on the weekend, there will probably be a wait. Lots of beers on tap and a nice ambience with dimmed lights makes it feel very cozy. I highly recommend it!

Surprisingly, a very, very, very tasty steak joint right in the middle of Meridian.

Prices are great for the quality of food, which is above average to excellent (depending on taste and item).

Ask for extra scoop of vanilla ice cream on the caramel bread pudding dish.

Don't listen to the praying mantis review from 2011 - a real kung-fu warrior would have wing chun'd the mantis and gently set him/her on a plant outside. Some people's kids.

Ate here on a business trip. I feel bad that my employer is actually picking up the tab on this one the yum yum sauce was yuck yuck. Tasted like Cole slaw dressing. Ordered chicken and shrimp hibachi at a regular table. The food was not hot and as expected and was extremely bland. Not at all impressed.
This is my favorite meat market. They make authentic European sausages and you can get all cuts of beef, pork, and lamb.
They move all my furniture to a second floor apartment building. No scuffs on any of my furniture!! They were very diligent and they also assembled all the beds!Great guys, will recommend to anyone!!

I usually sit at the bar and drink beer/eat. I love the huge selection of beer and the bartenders seem very knowledgeable, but it's hit or miss whether I get a pleasant bartender. I also feel that the beer and food is overpriced. Overhyped.

This is a special place, reserved for that perfect evening!  Took the Lil Woman out here for our 32nd Anniversary , Great restaurant, our Waitress was Mikayla, she does an excellent job, if you've read my posts before you know I line to drink plenty or water, and she kept my glass full all evening which is not an easy thing too do.  Probably had 5-6 glasses full anyway back to our meal. We started with the stuffed mushrooms, they are delicious!  The scones with their butter are delicious also.  For our entrees ; my wife had the Planked Salmon and I'm not a big Salmon fan but theirs is mouth watering delicious!  I had the 8 oz Prime Rib it was a perfect size and excellent I had a Russet baked potato along sized.  Excellent meal, definitely be back here again when I'm in the Boise area, hats off to Jake the owner he has an excellent restaurant!!!

Made an appt mid May for my carpets to be cleaned July 3rd for our rental before we moved out. We were scheduled for arrival time between 8:30-9:30am. My husband went to our empty rental, since we moved out, at 8am to wait...when they didn't show up at 9:30am he called and was told the tech was in Napa finishing up the first job and he'll be on his way...an hour later after no one showed up he called again and was told yet again that he was finishing up and would be there in an hour. This hourly call and phone tag went on to 5:30pm when we gave up and cancelled the appointment. My husband sat in an empty house for 10hrs waiting!! It was absolutely ridiculous! I would not recommend them at all.

I normally love this place, but have had several people tell me about bad experiences. Well, yesterday I encountered a bad experience myself! After being seated and sitting for a bit without any server, I asked a bus boy if he could bring us some waters. He did. Another 5-8 minutes went by and we still hadn't seen our server. I had to go ask someone if we could be waited on. She came and apologized. All was well. We ordered. I ordered my burger WELL done. It came out pink. I was polite, but told my server It wasn't well and I couldn't eat pink. She took it back. They replaced it with a well done burger that I got after everyone I was with had eaten there meal. I was still charged full price.  Wasn't impressed to say the least.
Online ordering is simple and easy. Pickup is completely painless. When dining in, always great staff and food.

We walked in and we were greeted by a very nice lady. She explained the menu to us, answered all of our questions. 
We received our food within 10 minutes of sitting down. My order was wrong. They brought the right order out after another 2. My food was cold... (BBQ pulled pork Mac) & it wasn't very good. I basically helped my husband eat his. 
I can't say we would go back here.
Had a great breakfast here yesterday. I had the special, BBQ Bacon Scramble. Delicious.  Loved their red potatoes and the banana bread was a real treat. This is a great addition to the neighborhood.
Love this place!  Great staff, food, and drinks.  It's great during football season!

This was ok food. The service was fast, and good. The food was mediocre. The steak was bland, and not very good quality. The burger was bland as well. The apple bread pudding was not nearly as good as I felt the hype was. Overall it feels like it should be a lot better for the price. Maybe it was an off night, but my steak had a giant nugget piece of fat right on it, the dense kind you don't really want to eat. Nobody trims the meat?  Let's just say it wasn't "marbled". The server was lovely, which is what redeems an otherwise disappointing dining experience.

We LOVE BWW and now that we have an infant, it's a rare occasion that we get to be social.  Having some free time (thanks mom and da), we thought we'd check out BWW because of our past amazing experiences.

Our server could have cared less that we were there.  She seemed to be going through the motions to bring us beverages and food in order to get a tip.  We were at BWW between 2:40 and 3:35 and the bar was rather empty.  We didn't demand this and that, we just wanted polite timely service.

Needless to say, Amanda was not there and did not serve us and that was 99% of our problem.  

We'll give this BWW another chance in the future but currently, this BWW is on our skip list.

Amatureishly prepared food. High prices. Inattentive service from poorly prepared servers. Undercooked wings over cooked burgers and warm beer. Other than that it's great. I stay away. Gave it 4 chances and went from bad  to worse. You can do better , almost anywhere.!!
Very rude lead manager Tanor!! So disrespectful! The food was great the waiter was great however the so called manager was a joke!!

I've been happy with my pizza for 99% of my visits.  I'm always impressed with the employees and their positive attitudes. A.J. has made each experience more enjoyable, she always has a smile.  One of our favorite employees here!

Wow! You will not believe the food coming out of this place! We had the artichoke dip to start and it was piping hot, creamy, cheesy, and the bread was perfectly toasted but chewy in the middle (yummm). My husband had the steak salad and I had the pork loin. Holy smokes! Two super thick cuts of pork that were tender, juicy, and easy to cut. The wild rice was delicious and the asparagus was fired perfectly on the grill. Plus, the prices were amazing. We weren't drinking, but the beers were in huge handled glasses. I saw two tables order the bread pudding (I think that's what is was) and the server delivered it and then poured an entire cup of caramel over the top! I'm absolutely coming back to try it- we were too full to even entertain dessert. Our server, Cameron, was attentive, quick, and friendly. I can't believe the quality of food for the deal of the price. Definitely recommend.

With the creation of yelp and everything else I've become a big fan of local franchises and what not but Yard House is one of the exceptions. I just really like it here. It's loud and they get you in and out to make their money but there are TV's to watch sports all around and the food is always good.

This place rocks. It's like a subway but for pizza. You can select a signature pizza or for $7.55 you can build a pizza with what ever toppings your little heart desires. The pizza is cooked at a very hot temperature so it doesn't take long and the pizza comes out with a crunchy yummy crust

I think this place is a bit expensive for what you get and they just raised all thier prices again    BUT!!!!  they do have great chips and salsa consistently, they also are the ONLY place I know of around here that Makes REAL chili Rellenos, 

    I am a Huge fan of these things.   Not the funky omelet type the lazy places make, not he oily gross , literally disgusting type that the disrespectful people that operate where Shakey's used to be on overland.    No No NO. 

  The real deal, a Fat Pablano stuffed with as much cheese as humanly possible and covered with a super crunchy breading and cooked to perfection every time RELLENO.     No Kidding.   they are awesome    the only reason I gave them three stars is i think they are too proud of their menu as far as prices.    makes it not so easy to stop in when I would like.      

   even the Mexican place that proclaims they are the home of the chilli relleno does not make the real deal.  what they make is a soggy omelet with a hatch / anehiem

 those kind are a joke

I read reviews and was hesitant to go there as there were people saying that the service was slow and the menu was overpriced. My thoughts after taking my grandson and his girlfriend there is that the food is good. There are some items on the menu that are a bit over priced in my view but there are items that are not, so there is some choices on price. They have a large selection on their menu. We went on a Sun early evening fairly busy but there was no wait to be seated, the food order was reasonable as far as arriving at our table. The waitress was friendly and helpful, willing to answer questions and offer suggestions. I will go there again.

My husband and I love dining at Kahootz. Most recently we visited in October for our 14th Anniversary. As always the food was amazing and did not disappoint.

The Bread Pudding is to die for....we really wanted the full order but the waiter talked us down to the half....still think we could have done the full =)
Awesome place love the atmosphere and the service! Everyone is friendly and the food is amazing! The bar makes great drinks also
Took my puppy Gunner for the first time.  He and I made some new friends! We had a blast. Loved all the obstacles and space. We will definitely be going back to play again soon.

After a 20 minute wait and 3 waitresses that helped literally every table around us, i had to go to the hostess station to ask for a waitress... To which a waitress not so happily came over another 5 minutes later, and blamed it on the hostess, instead of a hello or good evening. It wasn't even busy... I've been really excited to try this place, but was not impressed. Felt like a burden to the staff, had to ask for the lemons 4 times for my salmon, by the time i got t, my salmon was cold... And that was only the beginning. Didn't offer to compensate for anything, not hospitable... Won't go again. Very disappointed.

These guys seem to be trying too hard to create a theme restaurant. We sat close to the grill and were completely annoyed with the constant yelling. They yell every time a meal is added to the grill. It makes no sense.

I'm sure you all know that restaurant that comes out and claps and bangs a drum for birthdays while the crew sings a lifeless tune. (Tucanos, I'm looking at you.) This restaurant seems to be the inspiration for these guys.

The most annoying part of the evening was when the waiter gave us some unsolicited info. She was listing off the marvelous features of the place like fresh vegetables daily, A wide variety of meats and sauces, and then she shocks me. She says,  "Our owner won't serve alcohol because it's against his religion", as if it's some kind of feature.

What?? How is this beneficial? Am I supposed to be inspired by the owner's self righteousness? 

How does not serving beer or wine improve the atmosphere in a sit down restaurant. Even Chuck E. Cheese serves beer. I guess this is a family restaurant for those that are  just fed up with the moral decay of Chuck E. Cheese. 


After listening to the cooks yelling for about 20 minutes, I was needing a something to dull the absurd atmosphere.

The vegetables were fresh.

They provide a few more options for protein than your standard Mongolian grill.

The cost is almost 2X any other Mongolian grill and you have to endure the constant yelling. I hope your restaurants in Canada and Minnesota are doing well because I predict a complete flop here.

Great food (including vegetarian options), great drinks, mostly good staff, however, on the spendier side. 

If you are looking for a great date night, this is a fantastic place especially for people with dietary restrictions, if you're just looking for a place to have a chill drink and hang out - probably better to look elsewhere to save yourself a pretty penny!

I love going to this place for dinner.  The atmosphere is fun and the staff is always friendly.  They have a huge menu of delicious food also. Last night I ordered the parmesan crusted pork and it was amazing!  The bourbon sage and cherry sauce was one of the best things I have ever tasted.

* Looking at the chalkboard special, it looked okay. A personal one topping pizza, a small make-your-own salad, and a beverage. Ten dollars plus change plus tax plus tip. Seemed a little pricey, but I had a look at the salad bar first and decided it was better than the average salad. It offered all the fixins I like: broccoli, mushrooms, garbanzo beans, onion, tomatoes, sunflower nuts, croutons, and pickled beets. Only problem, it was hard to fit it all onto the small plate provided.
* The salad dressings are not all made in-house, but there were five to choose from. Six, if you include the plain oil and vinegar option.
* The server actually steered me to a lower priced deal, when I told her water was my drink. Lunch special number 1: You get three toppings instead of just one, and choice of soup or salad. Why pay for a fizzy sugar drink, if I was drinking water? This is where many restaurants make a tidy profit... selling a cheap fountain drink for a couple dollars extra.
* The salad was very tasty, of course; I made it my way. I licked the plate when finished. Bad manners? Pizza was pretty good also, but I didn't lick the plate. Crust was the thick and fluffy, reminding me of what Italians might call "Sicilian Style". One complaint here, the three toppings were not all captured by the cheese. Yet they were not skimpy with the cheese.
* I would have liked a napkin dispenser at my table, because one napkin wrapped around a knife and fork is not enough to wipe my fingers and face.
* The mens room floor was covered with classy textured tiles, making me feel like I was standing on solid ground, no risk of slipping, even if some sloppy person dribbled on it where I had to step ;-)
Excellent job they do. A wonderful new library director making great changes.
A real Chicago dog! The hotdog itself was great and the toppings were spot on. I used to serve these and loved them. I have to go back for the beef sandwich and other Chicago specialties.

I, myself, not a big fan of giving five stars to chains, but I have seriously never had a bad donut here.  In fact, one time I pulled up in the drive through to pay and collect my donuts, and the cashier handed me my donuts, through in an extra one and didn't make me pay for any of it.  I tried again and again to hand her the money, but she insisted.  I was very skeptical when eating it, thinking it was day old or something, but it was still warm from the production line.

Needless to say, it is a shame we don't have more local mom n' pop donut shops -- I just can't seem to pay five bucks for an effin' cupcake.

My husband decided he wanted to give this place a try today in the middle of our boys' nap.  The staff was friendly and accommodating, and our server Kendra was great.  Very patient.  She even had the foresight to bring extra straws without being asked so we were prepared when the boys accidentally pulled theirs out of their chocolate milk and dropped them.  

As for the food, my husband noted that while the wings were made correctly, their medium would be the equivalent of mild wings in Buffalo.  My step-daughter had the sweet barbeque.  I, of course, ordered something unrelated.  The pulled pork slammers looked so good, I just had to try them.  I had them with the honey BBQ sauce, which was tasty with an unexpected kick.  Our boys had chicken tenders, which were okay.  The fries are great.  Crispy, flavorful and not particularly greasy.  

I also had a couple of Captain 'n Cokes.  Not only were the servings more generous than similar establishments, but the bartender was also fairly generous with the rum.  

Definitely not a place for the health-conscious, but pretty nice for a sports bar and grill, and the service sets it above the average chain.

NEVER AGAIN! Went here one time and that will also be my last. I observed the cook coughing and sneezing in the kitchen area while preparing my order. Worst part was when I noticed he was NOT wearing gloves while preparing food. Then I  watched him as he grabbed tomatoes and lettuce with no gloves after he had been sneezing into his forearm. DISGUSTING and absolutely UNSANITARY! And he saw me watching him the entire time this was happening...unbelievable!
The Shrimp & Calamari Diablo is Excellent. Staff is always courteous and on task each time I have been there. I was disappointed that the  Womens restroom did not have a changing table.
Great food and drink list. Quick and courteous staff, overall happy with the experience.
Beer selection is great, food not so much. 100% prefer the local breweries over this chain.

We have tried Yardhouse on several occasions with friends. The atmosphere is inviting and the service is great. The food quality however has been somewhat inconsistent and just not hitting the mark yet. I have high hopes for this restaurant and of course will be back since it is conveniently located in the village at Meridian.
Quality of food is amazing, the garlic fries are fantastic. You can't go wrong if you are looking for a great burger in Meridian. Highly recommended!

I've been by this place several times finally stopped in  I had a great meal food was prepared to order. Although it is fast food, it is far from low quality food. The meal was excellent,  service was stellar and friendly. I will be eating here again!

If I am looking for a place to chill with some friends and have some great food this is the place! Staff is super friendly, the atmosphere is pleasant, the food so far has been fantastic. I absolutely love the happy hour menu at this place. Lets not forget about the truffle fries! This place stays packed and for good reason.  Great patio seating next to the Village fountain. 

Beer drinkers will appreciate the huge selection of beers they have.. Beers, beers and more beers. Ladies who are wanting to keep it light, you will love the Fresh and Skinny drink menu. Stop in, sit at the bar and enjoy something inexpensive off the snack menu. You wont regret it!

I have had my carpets cleaned a few times and it has always been average.  I have older carpets and  they never get the stains out 100%.  It has been 2 weeks and the stains have not reappeared!  Jonathan was professional, prompt, called & texted to confirm and thorough.  I already called again to have my couch cleaned after seeing the great results!  Call them you won't be disappointed

I pass this place every day and have never stopped by. Now my wife and I have made Main Street Burgers our new regular restaurant. Here's why: I am not sure why they do not advertise organic beef on all burgers, but that is what they use. The cost is also very low for how much you get and the high quality food. 

You can taste the difference compared to your run of the mill burger place. 5 stars all the way.

Food isn't bad and the service was pretty good too... I just hated how loud it was in the restaurant. I know you come here to watch games but if its to loud were you can't even think or talk to the person next to you than I'd rather do a to go order. But it is a fun place to have a good time with friends and watch a game or two and have some drinks and good food!

For the price, this is an excellent steakhouse. It's comparable to The Outback in terms of food quality, though it is a full price-point lower. The Filet was excellent, and prepared exactly as ordered. The 10 ounce NY strip, ordered medium-rare, was ever so slightly over-done, but it's flavor and price were too good to justify returning it. The ribs were also beautifully flavored, and as advertised, were indeed "fall-off-the-bone", though again, just so slightly over cooked. Had I ordered a whole rack, I would have returned them, but as I only ordered a small side-rack, I didn't bother. The hot rolls and honey butter were delicious. The sides were great; the house salad was excellent, with a variety of greens, tomatoes, home-made croutons, hard boiled egg, and shredded cheese. If you are looking for whole grains, locally-sourced, organic, sustainable blah blah, this is not the place for you.

The waitstaff appeared to be made up almost entirely of college students. Bling-jeans, short-shorts etc. Still, the service was good, though not as attentive as it could have been. I was actually surprised at how quickly we were seated and fed, considering how busy it was. Our wait, without reservations, was only about 5 minutes, and our appetizers and food came out in a timely manner. All in all, a fine place to go for a really good, not-too-expensive steak and indulgent sides. Not for those on a diet! 

This is a loud, casual joint. If you are looking for that romantic dinner for two, forgetaboutit. A business dinner? Not so much. Birthday patrons  get the "Howdy-Howdy HO!" schtick from the well-practiced staff. It is what it is. The steaks are darn nice for the price!

I was hesitant to go. .. .but OMGosh! It was amazing! Best steak I've ever had. ..no joke! I can never finish a whole steak and I didn't want to stop eating even when stuffed. Must try...I guarantee won't be disappointed.
I highly recommend Dunn Right Carpet Cleaning. They always do a great job. Very knowledgeable, thorough, easy to book with, and have reasonable pricing. I will definitely use their service again.

Worst Carl's Jr. location ever. If I could give this location negative stars I gladly would, they are lucky they even get one. They have the worst customer service (rude, slow), they rarely get the order right and if they do it's either very badly made or cold/old. Almost every time I have been to this location it has been a bad experience which is sad because I love Carl's Jr. and would really enjoy frequenting a location that is close to my house. Unfortunately I have read many many bad reviews about this location and it seems Hardee's/Carl's Jr. Corporate will not look into these issues and restaff this location, it has been this way since construction. Hopefully with my tirade of reviews that are about to be posted it will catch someone's attention and they can get this store up to par with the rest of the stores in the area. My experience tonight was sitting in the drive thru for 20+ minutes and finally having to back out of the line of cars who then followed us out of the drive thru as well. Upon leaving the area I was very excited to notice that a car that had pulled out of the drive thru line previously before I had pulled away was able to go inside and receive their order within just a couple of minutes.

This review is based on a Food Truck visit at the church near Maple Grove and Amity.  I grew up on Chicago Italian Beef sandwiches.   The sandwich I had from the food truck was NOT an Italian Beef.  The meat was sweet, like sloppy joes, with big chunks of uncooked onion and peppers. Not very good, but I could've managed.  However, the excessive amount of fake parmesan cheese completely overpowered any other flavor.  Two bites and I had to stop.  I'll try another dish next time.

(in Idaho) Had Josh and team come out to take care of some very mature 60+ ft Siberian Elms..Without a doubt the best job that I have ever had done.  Went through two other providers a 'tree hippy'  and "the butcher" setups as I call them..Near $4k later I wish I would have found Chavco first...Professionalism, experience and quality of job are ALL 5 stars.  Call these good folks first or regret it later!

Had Yard House for the first time! They have this back from where I'm from but I never tried it. Went in during the late happy hour (9pm-close). Ordered the California Roll, Four cheese pizza and the boneless wings (Korean style). All three were amazing! My favorite out of these three will definitely be the Cali roll. I highly recommend it! The waiter was super nice, great music, and friendly. They also have about 140 draft beers so there's that! I will try this place again (:

if i could give this place a 3.5 i would.

I used to have a b-dubs when i was attending university in Virginia.  Although i thoroughly enjoy their buffalo wings, this place doesnt stand up in comparison to other b-dubs i have frequented:

-the wings come in a huge range of sizes, some are very tiny, some are normal.  its definitely a buzzkill for how expensive this place is (beer and 18 wings is about 25 dollars, im a fatty)
-the range sauces vary, some days its super saucey and hence super spicy, other days its so under-sauced that the spicest sauce barely affects the mouth.
-server staff is very inexperienced, i know its a little nitpickky, but everytime i have been there, there has been some kind of screw up, or watched some waiter drop a tray.  that being said, i dont mind, i just feel bad for the waiters sometimes, they may be understaffed.

all this being said, i still go back because the wings here are better than the rest of anythign in the boise/eagle.  if you can handle the problems associated with a new restaurant, you should definitely hit this place up.

after their processes get streamlined, its a winner.
If you are looking for quick, good sushi, Sakana is great! They have good rolls and delicious flavored sake.

Did not use:  tv wall mount mfg. instructions, stud finder ( knock, knock on drywall method), common sense.
Got the job done.  Left hand prints, finger prints and smears all over two tv's, one costing in excess of 2k.  No cleaning cloths, no knowledge of today's yv functionality.  Choose:  save a hundred bucks, clean up after them, re-locate the hdmi cables, touch up paint the scratches on the wall, live with the scratches on the tv, get really mad or spend the money on a well trained installation service like the G--k squad.  One star because they showed up.  I will contact them and update my review.

Just came in again on Friday.  I took a taste of the water and said.. I think they got my review and laughed.. I then pulled out my phone and sure enough.. Response was that water would be filtered and in fact it was.. WAY TO GO!
Food was again, amazing and well worth the wait.  Love this place, keep up the great work, food and service.  Also big kudos to your girls running the front desk.. super curious and concerned with our seating arrangements.  5 Stars.
Service was horrible and food was mediocre, I make better wings at home and can get my own drinks too.

Evergreen roll - It's a special roll not on the menu. I always order it because everyone secretly wants to be "in" and this roll is my ticket. Did I mention it's delishx10. I'm usually a Sashimi girl but I'll carb load just for this guy. 

Sit at the sushi bar- I always feel like a baby bird awaiting it's next meal but the chef's are extremely nice and "treat' their regulars ;)
My first Chicago-style hot dog and I'm a fan. Much obliged Steve!

This was our first time in and all I can say is WOW! They offer a very nice variety of beers on tap that my boyfriend really enjoyed. They offer weekly appetizers and entrees,so we took advantage of it! We started with the stuffed meatballs which were simply amazing, then we ordered the lobster linguine and bacon vinaigrette salmon. Both were so delicious! And of course we just had to share their homemade bread pudding! We definitely left there full and extremely happy! And our server Serena definitely made our experience that much more enjoyable! We will definitely be back!

One of the only few places in town that are opened late with decent food. Been here many times and have had really good service even with big tables but not tonight. Waitress made about six mistakes.  That is not typical but one thing I have come to realize is it's always loud in there. It's hard to carry on a conversation. Other than that the service is typically good with good discounts on food and open late. They have discounted bone in wings on Tuesday's for $.40 each and $.60 for boneless wings on Thursdays. During the week after 9 pm you get buy one appetizer and get one free. With all that said BWW is a fun place to hang out. They have tons of TV's for all your favorite sporting events. Garlic Parmesan wings and Asian Zing wings are really good. Try them out.

Stopped in for a late lunch on a recommendation of a friend and it turned out to be well worth the trip. Jan had the grinder steak sandwich and I had the club. Both were prepared very well and had a lot of flavor. Portions were more than sufficient. Jan also had a side salad which she said was very fresh and the dressing seemed to be homemade. Would definitely stop here again.

Dining room is relatively small, and a little dark which added to the atmosphere. Music was audible but not so loud that you could not hold a quiet conversation at your table. Service was friendly and prompt. I will return in a few weeks and try them again this time will have one of the burgers.

Lucky for me I received a free chair massage and received for the free coupon visits over here. The day prior to my first appointment I ended up hurting my back. I came in and after my first week (three adjustments visits) my back felt much better. I was moving around without pain and had more mobility than prior to my injury.

Both me and my girlfriend ordered the ribeye. Mind you, the ribeye costs $34. So let me ask you a question, why is a ribeye, that is cooked on a flat top, not cooked over fire, and cooked unevenly, $34? That ridiculous. My salad was good. My potato was good. My appetizer I got potato skins and they were burnt. You guys should be ashamed to charge that much for such crap.

Great food, great atmosphere. Pizza in about 5 minutes it was awesome. If you want a sit down restaurant atmosphere and a long wait for your food this is not the place for you. If you want a fabulous pizza for a great price and don't mind an open atmosphere then definitely try them out!

I typically don't review chains if for no other reason than people pretty much know what to expect: hit and miss food, hit and miss service, etc.  However, I have been so consistently impressed with the Chili's at this location, I feel compelled to let others know.  

Tonight was the second time we were served by Josh, this time with a large group.  Both times he was prompt, courtious and really went above and beyond the call of duty.  And that's saying something since we've always received good service here.

As for the food, just about everyone had a burger - some rare, some medium rare, some medium - and everyone was pleased.  I had the chicken crispers, and while I regret not getting a burger, those were cooked perfectly as well - not overdone or underdone as is often the case.

If it's Chili's you're craving, and good, family friendly service you want, this is the location.  They clearly strive to stand out in the crowd.

New place in the neighborhood so we tried it for lunch on Sunday. They were busy but seated us right away on the patio. Staff friendly and accommodating as we swapped tables with another party. I was happy to see gluten free options so I ordered burger and fries. Gluten free bread isn't amazing and choices limiting but Homestead serves good quality. So gold star for GLUTEN FREE options. 

I'll be back for beer as this looks to be the speciality. I didn't count the TV's but there more than I had fingers for. 

All in all, it's basic but the neighborhood needs this place.

Decided to give them another chance. Ordered the pizza this time and others with me ordered pizza, pastrami and steak sandwiches. All food was well prepared and delivered in a reasonable time. Glad to say the music was not as loud so we could carry on a conversation at the table. The only complaint I have was that I remarked to the waitress three times that I wanted my beer to come with the meal, it came 10 minutes before so it was no longer cold and a little flat by the time the meal came. A minor point and I will try to be more clear next time.

This place is delicious! My hubby and I just went today for the first time and we thought it was great. Friendly staff and yummy sandwiches! They do not skimp on their meat on their sandwiches. Usually I get a medium sandwich at port of subs or which wich but I could have gotten a small because it was packed with meat. Same for my husband he usually gets a larger but he could have gotten a medium. The only sad thing was that they gave us a different brand of jalapeño chips then they had listed on their menu. They were 40% fat free, and they were not good. The chip thing wouldn't defer me from going again because it was amazing!

We thought we could get in and out quickly, but it was made panfully clear that this would not be the case.  The waitress was just not very good.

Food tasted OK, but the portions were small.  My husband was hungry again an hour later, and he had not even eaten any Chinese food.

Overpriced for the quantity & quality of food served.

Casual, family friendly atmostphere.  My wife and I have eaten here 8-10 times.  Homestead offers a tremendous beer selection, but inconsistent food and service.  It often seems as though employees are more interested in talking to one another than making sure their customers are happy.  The majority of the food we've had has been very good, but we were served very subpar, cold breakfast once.  Avoid the biscuits and gravy!  This is the reason my wife won't eat there again.  Lunch and dinner menus, on the other hand, have been very reliable and delicious.  The last thing I always notice about Homestead is the outrageous number of flies buzzing around during the warm months.  It's really annoying.  But you'd be hard pressed for find a better beer selection!

Not very happy with the customer service at this place? Called for two days to let them know that we were going to have 15-20 ppl at 6:30. No they do not take reservations,  but to try and stick 17 ppl at a table big enough for 10 is absolutely uncalled for! The waitress and hostess both had terrible attitudes when I kept asking for another table! I will never come back!

We had the Shrimp Chow mein, Egg Foo Yung and Salt and Pepper Squid. All were just excellent.  For those of us who love Egg Foo, the gravy must be done right and Wok Fusion accomplishes it. Service is spot on..

This establishment has passable food, nothing to rave about, and a festive atmosphere, however, the last time we were there, whoever cashed us out added a $10 tip on to a $9 order, even after I had left over 20% in cash as a tip at the table. In short, I am never going back and encourage others to seek better quality service and food elsewhere in the valley.

A quick lunch at the Yard House in the Meridian Village. Ordered from the lunch menu - 8" margarita pizza -very good except overloaded with garlic cloves (easy to remove). Others ordered butter noodles, al pastor street taco  and turkey sandwich. By the looks of the plates the server picked up, they too were very good.

Ashley, our server, was excellent!!!!!


Sorry so short, I'm be rushed.
Wonderful food and amazing service. We will definitely be back and for sure spread the word. Thank you

Had lunch with a friend there the other day, was fast service and they were semi busy. Server had the orders in and food on the table in about 10-12 minutes. I got the BBQ burger plate and it was quite good.

I ordered just a large Dr Pepper and the car in front of me order a lot of food. Instead of having that order pull around and wait for their large order, so they can just give me a large drink. They kept that car there and had me wait for 4-5 mins because they didn't want to do what the policy states. You should always park the car if you can get the next order out quicker. Drive thru 101

Visited again last night. The outdoor setting, service and cocktail were excellent. I ordered the shrimp pasta again and the presentation was a C- at best. It looked sloshed all over the plate, the shrimp were overcooked and all on one side, partially under the pasta. There was also a stray kernel of corn, even though none of us ordered a dish with corn. Might just try an appetizer next time.

I was the only one in the drive thru.  Through the window I could see several employees just standing around which leads me to believe that they weren't busy inside. All I ordered was a kids hot cocoa and it still took well over 5 minutes for me to get my drink. When it came out it wasn't even warm it was cold. Don't think I'll be visiting this Starbucks again.
Great Prime Rib!!! Very reasonably priced. It had a mild smokey flavor with a great rub.
Stopped by for a quick meal while waiting for a friend. Its nothing fancy, but it's good as fast food goes, a cut above the chain restaurants nearby

We had such a nice dinner in the Bar Top last Sunday! The bar area was intimate and quiet, no blaring TV's - which is a rarity in most restaurants. 

I had the fish and chips. They were impressive with four large fillets on top of what appeared to be fresh cut fries. The fillets were lightly beer-battered and nicely moist inside. I would definitely order them again. The salad bar had a nice variety of fresh salads and shrimp. The amazing lobster bisque alone makes it worth a trip to Jaker's! So rich and delicious! 

The staff was friendly and accommodating and the restaurant is spotlessly clean. The atmosphere was relaxed and easy - perfect for a lazy Sunday evening!

Really Good food, all salad dressings are house made. The French dips and fries were fantastic. We also had the bread pudding which was delicious. The half order is very generous 
 Easily enough for 3 to share.  My only complaint was the soup, I had the beef and vegetable soup. The only vegetable was potatoes and it was very over powered by bay leaves. Id stay away from that but everything else including service was great.

We have been to the Eagle/Meridian location twice and both times our food was cold. Kids portion of mac n cheese was not the usual either. The other night the pizza was soggy! Who does that?! The servers are friendly and they have some local brews.

So overpriced. I ordered the lobster Mac n cheese and it was $25 it was very bland and I was not impressed at all my husband got the jambalaya and it was not very good at all. We probably won't ever eat there again.

My garage was not insulated when my house was built. I called Marv's for help. I was quoted a price and I agreed. They made the appointment and showed up right on time. The installers were very competent and professional. They cleaned every scrap from their work. My garage was always very hot in summer. It would be 10-15 degrees hotter than outside temp on days of 85-100. Now it stays around 10 degrees cooler than outside temp. I am very satisfied. I most highly recommend Marv's Insulation.
It's about time there were options for good, quality beer in Eagle. Taps rotate often so always something new. Friendly staff and plenty of tv's to catch a game.

Avoid at all costs. Ordered Mac N' Cheese with chicken and mushrooms. It was the driest mess I have ever tasted. Dried out pasta, chicken and mushroom with about a tablespoon of sauce. Inedible. So I thought I would complain when the waitress returned to ask how our meal was. It was a full 20 minutes after everyone else at our table had finished eating that she finally returned to check on us. No excuse for the delay- it was a Tuesday night and not crowded. I simply told how bad it was and asked to have it taken off the bill.  The next thing I know the manager returns with another order of Mac n' Cheese. But it is not another order. She announces that she has taken the now very cold and now extremely dry bits from the original order and added some sauce that was missing the first time around. Amazing. The other three people at our table found their food to be edible, but not good enough to want to return. So unless you want amateur chefs, waiters and a foolish manager, avoid this place.

While the food is fresh, and of good quality. I had to deduct a star for the unfortunate lack in our order. Being vegan, we ordered extra veggies-no meat-no tofu. The bowl literally had 4 pieces of spinach on top, and the noodles were virtually dry. Would have liked more sauce, and veggies, and a healthier portion for the amount we paid. Otherwise, the girl at the front was very sweet and courteous. The girl in the back however was not as friendly.

I've been getting Wire Guys since we all had to get those converter boxes. I love them! They are experts. They are extremely reasonable and they get the job done right. They just did a bunch of work hooking up my new TVs. You won't be disappointed.

I stopped in to The Vault during a recent business trip and was impressed right away. The lounge is nice, clean and while there were about 10 guys smoking cigars their air system was doing its job. The smell of tobacco, was clearly in the air while it wasn't smokey. They've got a great location and I'm happy to hear they can now have beer in with their recent approval for their license.  I'll be visiting again soon!

Very poor service. In the past we have really enjoyed the food and service here. This time however we received awful service. We arrived at 6:30 with a party of 7 and were waited on by Alissa. After ordering two appetizers and our food quickly;We waited until 7:15 before asking a manager where our appetizers and food were.( people who arrived after us had already been served) Instead of apologizing or saying she would check on it, the managers response was "yea well we're gonna serve your appetizers and meals all at the same time, it will all be out in a bit". Most of the food was served a few minutes later but a pizza order was wrong. After starting on our meals, and salads the final appetizer arrived (just in time for dessert). We understand that waiting on a big group can be difficult and we always tip well. However serving all the food and appetizers at the same time, 45 minutes after ordering and offering no apology isn't excusable. We've enjoyed the food here and hope to get much better service if we return at all.
Hibachi is marginal, and their sushi is alright. The staff is friendly and the restaurant itself is clean.

Five stars all the way. The only criticism I have is that we waited ~ 1 hour to be seated vs a 30 minute projection, but that was completely out of the control of the hostess staff (they had some tables lingering a REALLY long time after eating). 

We ordered the artichoke dip for an appetizer and I can honestly say it was the best artichoke dip I have ever tried, fresh out of the oven. Their drink selection is awesome, especially the their beers on tap. I ordered the prime rib for dinner which was served with a delicious baked potato and perfectly grilled asparagus. Dinner was amazing from start to finish. 

And let's not forget the service. We were well attended to, and our server seemed to show up at precisely the time we needed her. 

Lastly, the pricing was extremely fair. All around great experience. I love seeing a local business succeed like this and after having visited I know exactly why they are doing so well. We will definitely be back.

It is what it is, have not found a good Mexican restaurant on Boise yet

you always know what you get when you come here, ok food and ok service, nothing to write home about, but ehhh.

I love the concept of fast-casual pizza at Blaze Fast-Fire'd Pizza. They have a wide range of sauces and toppings to choose from at a reasonable price. I also love that they try to offer a gluten free crust for those who want or need it. For those who *need* a gluten free option however, this place may not be the safest option (and don't get me wrong, the restaurant doesn't tout a gluten-free safe environment, it simply offers a gluten free crust). Beyond changing gloves and putting your crust on a non-gluten baking tray, all toppings are cross-contaminated with the gluten crusts -- sauce spoons are spread across gluten crusts and toppings are pulled from containers that just touched glutened gloves. For those in my group that did eat the gluten free crust, they felt it may have been better if it was cooked longer as the middle was still very doughy (maybe fewer toppings next time). The other people in my group who had regular, gluten-full crust said it was cooked through perfectly with a little char on the edges.
Sit in the bar during happy hr for the half price appetizers! And on Mondays it's buy 1 get 1 for $1 fajitas; YUM. A basket of chips salsa and the guacamole are aLso a meal for one.
Great service! The food was amazing! Will be back for sure with friends and family! The atmosphere was a lot of fun!

Service was five stars at this place but my kale caesar salad hardly had kale and was mostly romaine. There was also supposed to be brussel sprout shavings and there were none. The shrimp was cooked perfectly but was overly salty. Not to mention, they brought me the wrong salad to begin with. $16 for a romaine caesar? No thanks, I can get that at Panera! My husband had the Nashville chicken, which he liked. However, it was two pieces of chicken with a few pickles and sweet potato pancakes for $17. Overpriced all together.

This is our second time and they delivered. We were 20 mins before happy hour ended and Shay took really good care of us. She was awesome at referring drinks, food and dessert. She has the most pleasant and relax personality on top of the great service she provided us. 

I definitely recommend this place for lunch, dinner or just happy hour. 

BTW, on Sundays, they have 50% off Bacon Bloody Mary or Mimosa so definitely will be back on a Sunday.

Horrible food and horrible service. I will not be back.
We were seated on the patio and it seemed the staff completely forgot about us. Our very simple queso appetizer took over 40 minutes, we had to continually ask for refills of chips and then remind them that we had asked for them. Menus weren't offered so someone in our party had to get up and track them down. We had to ask for water and once that was brought to the table it wasn't refilled once. 
Apparently Sunday is all-day happy hour and the quality of food and drinks is exactly what you pay for. I'd be surprised if the margarita I ordered had any alcohol in it at all. It tasted like a watered down lemon-lime Gatorade.
I ordered a mango chicken salad, which was so awful I had to send it back. The lettuce, which was very obvious from a bagged "salad mix" tasted like it'd been sitting in their fridge for weeks. The texture was soggy and there was nothing but a horrible flavor to it. The manager did come out to let me know he was sorry and that when he looked at the salad he could tell there was too much dressing on it. I informed him it had absolutely nothing to do with the very tasteless dressing, but the very old product they were trying to pass off as a "fresh" salad.
My husband's meal was a little better - chicken fajitas and a draft beer. The beer took 15 minutes and we were right outside the bar area. The fajitas were just okay. 
Happy hour specials are great, but I'd much rather pay full price somewhere else that has good food AND good service. There is nothing worse than feeling like an afterthought while dining in a restaurant.

YUMMY!!!  I was so excited to find this place in Meridian because it seems sushi is not very popular here!  I am from the Bay Area in California and since I moved here I've been missing it SOO much!!  This place has satisfied my cravings!!  I ordered Spicy Tuna rolls and California rolls and they did not disappoint!  Their soup and salad were really good too!!
