My husband and I had a great time watching others enjoying the grill chef doing his tricks for the crowd!  Maybe we'll try that sometime too!!

Big Boy Movers was a third party mover tasked by Pack N Load to do the job. Pack N Load had written up a proposal to unload a piano and unpack two large PODS including re-assembling bedroom furniture and a dining room table. 

I was disappointed with the service that they performed. They were on a very tight schedule to do a Herculean task. At the request of the leader, I was told to start unwrapping the beds and frames (king including a vanity, queen, and twin), including the mattresses and dining room table, if I wanted them to be re-assembled after they unpack the PODS. I did complete the portion of the work that were supposed to be tasked to do.  It took me many days to recover from the unwrapping of the shrinkwrap. While this was going on, the leader was always on the phone with his supervisor. 

Since they had only two people, it took them longer than expected. That day they were triple-booked. I was the first job of the day. To me, that creates unsafe decisions to be made by the mover and movee. It was supposed to take them 3 1/2 hours and ended up being 4 1/2 hours to do the job.  I think if they had one more person, the move would have been better experience.

I blame the either supervisor or dispatcher that did not understand the scope of unloading the  two large PODS, not the two twenty-somethings tasked to do the job.  They were not empathetic and I was double their age doing their job (unwrapping to keep up with them), a recent widow. I was very upset through this whole unloading process and they knew it.  I would NOT recommend them for unpacking and packing because their management does not understand scope of their work to be done, and the amount of manpower to do the job safely and properly.

I really wanted to like this place but they have some work to do here on the food and the service. We came on a Friday eve and told there would be a 30 min wait. We waited about 20 min and then we were told our table was ready -but when we were seated we waited another 10 to be greeted by our server and then several more minutes before we saw her again.
Once we ordered our food it came out quickly. I found the chips cold and nothing special. We had to request utensils and napkins after the appetizers were brought to our table. Tiny paper napkins- what- at an upscale place like this?
Loved the jalapeños poppers with bacon - super flavor and nice and hot. 
Our Machada burrito was just ok- the filling was great but the topping was cold. Did it sit too long in the kitchen? We still prefer our local Mexican restaurant "Jalapeños"- better food with less expense and wonderful service.

I enjoyed Blaze Pizza when I lived in Arizona - I was happy when they opened up their restaurants here. No place else can you go get a great, affordable, and personal pizza with such great quality. Every time we so I get what I want, my wife gets hers, and we have always had awesome service. Ignore the long lines, it moves fast and everyone is working hard to make it a great experience.

An Absolute Wonderful meal and friendly staff. We were visiting from Cali and did some groupons to try different places and this concept was so unique to us we had to try. I am sure glad we did!..They have the BEST cheesy vegetable soup, fresh produce, quality meats and breads I can't believe they do not put a value on their meals. We were happy to donate more money than our silly groupons to this amazing endeavor. A complete breath of fresh air is what we experienced in this little caring sandwich shop! You dont have money? Work an hour and we will feed you!..Awesome concept! California has alot to learn. Thank You, for showing us true American love.

Waste of $$$

I decided to finally try this place, only to deeply regret doing so.  The overpriced food is fair at best.  Then the server, Dan, was horrible! First of all, he addressed me as "Boss" in a sarcastic tone.  At these prices, I believe "sir" and "madam" are appropriate. He was too busy talking to a couple at the bar about golf to come check to see how my meal was until my last bite. Then, eager to leave, I asked for my check. Waiting, I hear him engaged (loud enough for me to hear him across the restaurant) with the same couple. Frustrated, I got up and walked where I could see him, in hopes it might expedite the process.  After sharing my disgust with the hostess, an assistant manager appeared. That's when he finally appeared with my check. 

You only have one chance to make a good first impression!
Generally when shopping it takes some time for an associate to ask if you need help, but when they do they are courteous and helpful.

Nic: Hey, guess what!? I really like this place!

Han: That's about time you liked something. Lately it's been nothing but moan, moan, moan.....

Nic: Pfff...well I moaned a bit today too, but in a good way. Their steak salad is great! Good portion of tender, flavorful and well seasoned meat, lovely greens, tomatoes, red peppers, mushrooms, a slice of crispy French bread and their raspberry vinaigrette...yum!

Han: I'm surprised you even remembered what was on the salad, you practically inhaled that thing. I was going to tell you that they also have a sweet onion dressing, in case you were thinking about ordering another one .

Nic: Well, I can't say I didn't contemplate it for a second or two......How was your Reuben sandwich? I noticed you left the fries on the plate. 

Han: Sandwich was good. Good bread, great corned beef and a really good homemade 1000 Island. Fries were meh. I really like all the different types of beers. Good food, good beer, good service, what more do you want?

Nic: Good point. What more do I want? A second stomach so I can try their amazing desserts sometime! I keep wanting to try that hot caramel apple almond bread pudding! One of these days.....
Well done, as usual!  Great location, very friendly staff and great food!  Hopefully outdoor seating next spring?

Beer selection is decent. Food wasn't bad, but we found it rather bland. The mac&cheese was on the favorites tab and it wasn't worth the 16.99. My wife had the vodka shrimp pasta and it was bland as well. The shrimp really had no taste and it tasted like the use a tomato paste as the base for the sauce.
NO BEER! And not informed of no alcohol before being seated waited 15 minutes for a table and there were plenty open. And the food is slow to come.
It was just okay.  I love Mexican, food arrived in about 2 minutes, Margaritas..Okay  Found a hair in my food which just about to gross anyone out.
Fast, friendly affordable dental care for the Treasure Valley....its a Dentist, what else do you want to know?

Customer service sucked from the get go. It's run by a bunch of rude teenagers who clearly have no customer service experience. They got our order wrong and didn't even apologize for it. The girl with the purple colored hair brought our food out with a sassy attitude. Food was dry, as if it was sitting there a while. Would not recommend this place to anyone. Worst burger joint ever!

Ten stars if I could! I moved to California two years ago (I use to eat here all the time before I moved because I worked at the salon down the street ) and I can't tell you how many burgers I tried and none (not even in n out) came anywhere close to this spot Main Street burger is the BOMB even my dad who always has something to complain about Loveeed it / we just had the happy meals and we were most definitely happy after lol! - great daddy daughter date at the greatest burger joint ! Thanks !!!!
Always a big fan of texas road house. This particular locations has always had amazing customer service. Free rolls right when you sit down. Great beer. Two sides on almost every meal. Hard to beat.
Really good food and drinks, service has Been hit and miss. Twice good servers, twice bad servers. But I always enjoy the food.
Love the atmosphere here and the steak salad with creamy garlic dressing is a must, oh and dont for get the bread pudding!! Friendly staff !!

You have to understand it is beer first, food second at a Yardhouse. With that being said the Yardhouse provides pretty good food. I tried the Mac and cheese with French onion soup and a Belgian style beer. I was satisfied with the food, nothing more. I expected more out of the Mac and cheese from a beer joint like this. The beer selection is well above average and is worth going to just for the beer. 

The environment is good for catching a game, also. Overall I would go here again, the food is above average, the beer is excellent, and the service is good. The negative is the wait time to get in can be long since it just opened.

Went for lunch for my first time, wife told me they had a party there a few weeks ago and they all loved it.  For one, I love beer (big surprise) so the 141 beers on tap was a great change from the other restaurants, mainly because I could care less about wine.  One thing I think that sets this place apart from the obvious is the waitstaff was not only friendly but........when they screw up they hook you up!  Sounds weird but I have been to many restaurants that screwed up a drink order and took the old one back and gave you the right one.....or argued the fact.  This place let us keep the wrong beer (141 beers on tap I asked for one that sounded exactly like another one so of course I don't care) and gave me the right one.  The food was absolutely amazing. The Cuban was out of this world delicious.  Between the waitstaff and the food and beer I will be back again in a heartbeat.  Also, those complaining about the prices, you get what you pay for and it's still not that expensive!

Chain resturants normally have the impact on me that garlic does on a vampire. I retreat with haste at the very idea.  Yet I have eaten in more chains in the six months since moving to this  area than in the sixteen years combined before.  I'm not kidding. 

Most of those experiences were woeful so I walked into Noodles & Company with low expectations.  Imagine my surprise to find myself a fan!  I found  friendly people, efficient order and service model, good food using fresh ingredients and served at the table in real dishes, not plastic, along with fair prices.  

THE GREETING:
My husband and I paused at the menu board.  An employee welcomed us warmly to ask if this was our first visit.  When we said yes, he went on, "I hope you'll let me take about 30 seconds and I'd like to explain how this works at Noodles and Company..."

My knee jerk thought was "I do not need a tutorial on ordering fast food" but then I realized I was being jerk.  Because this man was so engaging and as it turns out I really did find the overview useful!

HOW IT WORKS IN A NUTSHELL FOR "NOODLE-NEWBIES".

1.  Look at the menu board to choose your entree.  The focus is noodle bowls, but there are also three or four salads, and equal number of soups and also a few sandwiches plus a flatbread.  

There are dozen-ish items in noodle bowl options listed with photos in rows.  They are logically arranged so narrowing down  to answer, "What sounds good  today?" is pretty easy.

Each of the vertical rows is a regional / ethnic specialty.  First Row - Mediterranean / Italian.  Second Row - Asia / Chinese, Thai, Japanese.  Third Row - American / although with specialties on that list like Stroganoff or Spaghetti with meatballs.

The top item in each row is the best seller in that specialty.

Worth mentioning that all of the noodle dishes start out as vegetarian.   Not to get ahead of myself because in everything is connected to everything else mode, this will lead us to steps three through five.

2. Choose large or small bowl size.  The large is nearly twice as much food for only about a buck and a quarter more money.  Being lighter eaters, we thought the small was swell.  Being types to support the underdog, we chose from lower rows of options.  Being in the mood for SE Asian flavors, we chose rice noodle dishes, one with a bit of kick from a peanut sauce and the other with a slightly sweet coconut curry.

3. Mosey to the counter to place your order with a friendly staff person.  This is when you can order protein to add to your dish if you want to, from tofu to chicken, pork, beef, meatballs or shrimp to top it off.  You can also decide if you want soup or side salad added to your order of noodles for a pittance extra charge.  

4.  Pay for your meal and notice at how little it costs.  All the noodle dishes start out at the same price for small and then another for large.  It is the addition of proteins that makes the price go up.  A couple of the noodle bowls most typically ordered with a protein, like spaghetti and meatballs or beef stroganoff, are priced with the meat included.  But you can subtract that (mushroom stroganoff anyone) with cost deducted too.

5.  The friendly counter person will give you a number.  Take it a table in the clean, brightly lit space (or on the patio in nice weather) and wait on one of the nice service staff to bring you your meal on real dishes with real cutlery.  While you wait you can read the sign about the company's commitment to holding down waste by using dishes that can be rewashed and not end up in landfills.  (Read fast, the food is quick to arrive.)   I despise plastic containers and utensils in fast food places.  The real deal here was a lovely surprise. 

6.  Tuck into those noodles and enjoy fresh flavors and veggies cooked just so for pretty-darned-good food while you think about hatl you'll order next time, since you know there will be one.  And just when you thought it couldn't get better for a fast casual food model it does when you find you don't need to 'bus your own'.  Ta dum!

DIETS:
All items have calorie counts posted and that sure does give one pause about how super diet friendly some of these dishes are while others can bust the diet bank.  Also, gluten free items on menu.

FUN:
For entertainment, stand by the soda machine, which is also the water dispensary, and see how long it takes first timers to figure out how it works.  Which won't be long as it seems the been there before timers are eager to help others learn how the cool contraption functions.  Social bonding experience.

SERVICE:
It is worth saying that every employee here conveyed a sense they were glad we were there and they hoped we'd come back. Delightful.

THIS N THAT:

1) PARKING:  The lot is shared by a couple of other businesses, including Blaze pizza.  

2) ACCESSIBILITY:  Accessible parking:  Level in.  Standard height seating.  Ample aisleway

Rude staff.  Wrong sandwich. Then they agrued with me when I brought it back. I waited in the drive through for near ten minutes when I was the only car....
Great food usually, it's just too bad the staff doesn't care.

Went in on Sunday - and it wasn't packed yet! This was our first visit to this location; we've been to the YH in San Diego and had a nice time. This visit was wonderful! We were seated in the patio - which was enclosed - and no screaming children! Thank you hostess! My husband is a beer snob and loved the variety! I loved the variety of the menu. I am hesitant about places that have too much variety: those who have too much on their menus tend not to be expert at any of them. But what we had was wonderful! We had the devilled eggs as an appetizer - very good, different! We each had soup: Tomato Bisque with basil (wonderful!) and French Onion soup that didn't taste canned or too salty. My hubby's grilled cheese was the best he's ever had (including mom's!) and my turkey sandwich was very good! We cannot wait to return - this will be our new favorite restaurant - but not at peak times or days. By the time we left, it was PACKED...and the Village at Meridian is beautiful. It certainly doesn't look like a typical Idaho venue...so I think on Friday nights/Saturdays/and Sundays after church: be prepared to wait. If you're flexible on time, I don't think you'll be disappointed!
verry friendly staff and great food was realy impressed how great the staff was and food was great but portions could have been a lil bigger
Very dirty and disorganized store. Was pretty disgusted and didn't purchase anything due to that and the prohibitively high prices.

I came here for the first time, had the tomato basil bisque which was excellent, full of flavors just the way I like it. My second dish was the Bangkok Curry which had nice flavors but wasn't a curry but still good. If it was a curry I would have given 5 stars.

*word to others* 
Do not just call the front and ask to pay your balance : be specific ask to pay "my entire anything I might ever owe you balance" 
Because being told that $28 went to collections is hard to get corrected  after being incorrectly SENT.

I usually try a restaurant a couple of times, just in case they are having an off night.  This place is 0-3!   Just when I thought it couldn't get any worse, they out did themselves.  We went on Father's day for the over priced under flavored buffet.  The salad bar looked like they had either washed the salad or the bowls were just that dirty, my father's steak was sent back three times so they could get it right, we were close enough to the kitchen to hear the chef (if that's what they are) complain.   My mother gave up on the buffet because it was either under cooked (salmon) or over cooked (prime rib).
At some prodding of friends I went back with them to see if the experience would be different.  I ordered a drink, it came with a fly in it, I sent it back, instead of a new drink, you could see where they must have tried to scoop it out but broke it up instead.   I got up and left.

I like this store a lot. The employees are so friendly and helpful. The store is always clean which I love. The only problem I have is that every time I go in there are about 6-7 people in every line and 3 checkers working. It drives me crazy!

What a disappointment!  The service was awful, the wings were mediocre, the atmosphere was fab though if you are looking for a casual sports bar setting.  We started with a beer and everything was going fine until our food came.  It is served in paper baskets, no silverware, no plates and no server to be found.  By the time we did get ONLY silverware our wings were hard, gross and cold.  Ordered another round of beers and it took two trips and a new server each time.  Really don't think I will be going back.

I messaged on Facebook and got an instant response and a quick appt. They were running late but called to let me know. They took a lot of time and it shows. Carpets and rug look brand new. Great deal and very nice! Can't beat that.

I've always loved the atmosphere of BDubs. Ever since my first football game here. It's just a fun environment, full of sports-lovers who want to have a good time. The service has always been amazing (as long as you know it's not super fast. Due to each server having up to 10 tables) although, I'm used to fast service. Buffalo Wild Wings is based on quality. It takes a little while to get what you want, but when you get it. It's totally worth it. Servers are friendly, and the beer is always cold. 

Best way to watch football in my opinion.

Had pork chop mein. Not the best I've had, but def not bad.  No subs on menu.  Had to order side of fried rice (not a side menu)  I'll try it again when have more people and can order more than one item. Not quite a restaurant, but not Panda. Would love to see an actual Chinese restaurant... Hot tea, crunchy noodles and a sorta clean bottle or soy sauce on the table... Ya know
I called this store because I broke a light when putting up my glass solar bulbs they kindly sent me three replacements at no charge!!  Thank you for excellent customer service

I've been a customer of Einstein's for many years. All four of my family's automobiles have been serviced there and will continue to be. The service is always good but not so much so that I've been compelled to write a review...until today. I did visit a different location on Fairview in Meridian, ID today and I was blown away by the service. 

William greeted me with the standard - paper, iPad, service menu and complimentary beverage offer and then helped navigate me inside where he passed me off to Saul. WHO WAS INCREDIBLE. He was polite, informative, respectful to the rest of his crew, and knowledgeable in making suggestions. I did opt to include the transmission and radiator service which made my visit longer than usual. He engaged in polite conversation.

As I was leaving I asked Saul who I could share a compliment about his service with and he said "Well, Ma'am, that would be me!" Which is what led me here! I was even more impressed when I learned he was the team lead because it showed in how he treated his team and how they treated him! Well done, Meridian Einstein's!!

Food was luke warm and pretty much flavorless, vegies we're hard and chewy...for a steakhouse you would think the filet mignon (special) would be melt in your mouth awesomeness...sadly no it was lacking.
Had their medallions steak with the mushroom sauce.  the sauce was so salty like they dumped the bag of salt in so would not recommend getting the mushroom sauce.

We just ate here for lunch and enjoyed a delicious hamburger.  I did not see any of the items listed in the lower ratings of this hamburger place.  The staff was respectful and helpful.  The photos of hot rods made the wait pleasant.  I will drop of an 8x10 of my old hot rod.  

The hamburger was great on the homemade buns.  I also enjoyed the fries and milkshake.  If you are comparing the hamburger price to McD's, Wendy's, etc...  You are missing the point of the good ole fashion American small business owner.  Go ahead and make the CEO's for those large food chains rich.  I for one will stand by and support my local business owner every time.

Great burger joint...

Only in town for one night, and a couple guys in the group wanted a steak.  Tried this based on positive yelp reviews.  

Arrived a couple min after 5:00 and there was already a 30 min wait.  Found couple seats at the bar for the wait.  Bar tender was friendly and helpful.  Beer was cold, and tender was spot on with recommendation.  

Waiter had solid recommendations.  Clam chowder was really good and perfectly spicy.  I went against sound judgment and had the cioppino at a steakhouse.  One of the best tasting meals I've had in a long time.  Everyone at the table left fat and happy...without dessert.

This is a great place for sushi and hibachi, have been here many times it was always very fresh and tasty. Now they offer 1$ sushi on Mo and Tue, what a deal ! Very tasty not that mayonnaise and sauce lathered sushi rolls you get somewhere else.
Only a couple of visits but each time the food was fantastic! The service was wonderful! Thanx for the grand experience!

Had a lovely early dinner on Tuesday night. We were able to eat from early dinner menu and it was awesome! Our server Carly, attended us very well and charged my phone as a courtesy while we ate dinner. Food & service very good.  I'm giving a 4 out of 5 stars only because I thought the music was very loud in the restaurant thus, making it difficult to fellowship with my friend. thumbs up.!

So here I am way inland, in the small city of Meridian, thinking I'm crazy for ordering Cioppino.
But, you know what, it's great!  Very fresh seafood!  Steaks and specialty mac and cheese dish were also very good.  And truly cooked to order.  Fish cake appetizer, another winner!  Large selection of beers on tap.  Keep in mind this is a fairly small place that does not take reservations, so be prepared to wait.

Ordered take out, it was fantastic!  Order done right on time, packed well for travel and delicious to eat.  We're really looking forward to going back and eating there... the folks are really nice and the establishment looks clean and fun.

I just stopped in after work for a quick bite and a beer. The bar area was fun and full. I was greeted by no less than seven smiling hostesses. I was sitting for no more fifteen seconds before the manager approached me to see what I wanted. He took my beer order and left. Fifteen seconds later my server stopped by with a hello and a warm smile. Great service and friendly people here.

Sakana has become as comfortable for my wife and I as our favorite pair of slippers.
We go for lunch at least once, and usually twice a month. The Bento box lunch meals are wonderful, especially the salmon. The fish is fresh and smells clean and inviting. Sakana has the best tuna, fatty salmon, and shrimp in the Treasure Valley. The staff is friendly and knowledgeable. The menu can be a bit confusing to those new to sushi, but the staff is happy to explain and give suggestions. The miso soup is heavenly. My wife has commented that is better than any tranquilizer made.

Nice restaurant/pub! Over 100+ draft beers. Great sounding music. Great service and very good food. Prices seem reasonable too. My wife and I shared the mushu egg roll and surf-n-turf burger. Great sauce came with the burger. The. "Surf" was lobster claw meat.  Lots of good stuff on the menu. We will re-visit many more times.

Service was really slow, but I am thinking that our server may have been new. The manager had to come by and bring our drinks (He was very nice) and the cocktails were really good; (Watermelon margarita). We tried the coconut shrimp and eggroll appetizers and they were really tasty. The Shrimp came with only three giant shrimp and they were not included in the 1/2 price apps for happy hour so I'm not sure I would order those again. We had the swordfish tacos and I have to agree with another reviewer that they were pretty salty so I personally would not order those again. The rice and beans that the tacos came with were really good t and a little spicy. We shared a piece of the macadamia nut cheesecake and that was truly the best cheesecake we have EVER had! It was so creamy and nutty and came with the most delicious caramel sauce ......

Food is always consistent and delicious. Service is usually pretty good, but be prepared to drop some money (depending on what you get). For my family of 3 we usually spend like $50, which is why we don't go here all that often.

Are those other 4 reviews on crack?!? WTF?! The only bad thing about this place is their coffee (ok, also the stupid singing/yelling... But I don't care what the cooks do as long as they keep cookin' up the grub!)... Great choices, super clean, and (unlike every other Mongolian bbq place) SUPER fresh! I'm a Mongolian fan and I've returned here twice already. It's good stuff.

The food was good but, how do you NOT serve tortilla's with Carne Asada dinner. Every place I've eaten this you get your choice of Corn or Flour and they don't charge you an extra $1. For what I paid for the meal I definitely should have come with. 
Oh and if you go there late like we did (11:30pm) don't expect to be able to get everything on the menu, I was going to try their chicken wings but was told later that they were out of them for the evening even though they're on the happy hour menu.
We had 12 people and the waitress was really good, kept all of our fluids full. 
This must be a bar first with a restaurant tagged on because the music was loud which would of be ok if it wasn't Techno Disco.
Overall not really impressed

I'll start off with a positive and that would be the service. Hostess and Server seemed to be very polite, organized, and attentive. Now the bad or I'd even go a step further and say really bad...the food. Ordered the crab cakes, which is apparently a new addition to the menu. Came with Russet Potatoes that were blanched and fried. Also came with grilled asparagus. Bottom line, everything was swimming in oil...Literally a thin film of oil all across the base of the plate. Crab cake was saturated in oil. What you'd expect from an amateur cook who either puts something in oil at too low of a temperature or someone who leaves it in the oil too long. Asapargus was hammered on the grill. Leaving it thin and flimsy. I'll just leave it there. Don't go. Keep walking. Nothing to see here. This is the second time I've been here and the second time the food was bad.

Overpriced and horrible service. We stopped by during Happy Hour and were less than impressed. The beers were over priced and the bartender was rude. When she short poured our beer for a second time I asked if she could top it up.  She said that she could add more foam to it, but it was over poured already. There was over 3 inches of head on the glass! We then saw her leave the tap wide open on another pour and waste almost a whole beer! If you're going to be rude, at least pour a beer correctly. We have never been back. Tonight we tried Kona Grill across from the Yardhouse and the service was outstanding! The manager thanked us for coming in, the beer was poured correctly and my wife's drink was made perfect. Happy Hour was a nice value and has some great appetizers. We will go back there from now on when we visit for shopping or going to the magnificent new theatre. If you go here, for over $7 a beer, watch your pour! The few ounces they short change every customer is losing them a ton of business in the future. Money is too valuable to waste on poor service, no value and better options within 50 yards.

Jakers always has great food. Having to wait 5 or 10 mins on a Tuesday night thar wasn't busy was questionable, but after we wait the 10 mins being told to wait even longer because of other reservations who hadn't shown up yet was too much. Empty booths all over and you can't seat us and get drinks going? Come on management, Shame on you.

Pretty busy place and really it's like subway. In a way you kind of feel rushed on what you want for toppings. I would rather check all the items I want versus telling them because it is loud in there. The pizza comes out really fast, within minutes of your toppings being put on. My pizza was really good and my wife and kids loved their pizzas also. Great place to try out if you want something fast and good.
Great lively environment and delicious entrees with generous portions. We had a lobster and shrimp scampi topped ribeye steak and everything was prepared as ordered and delivered with a smile.

This is one of those places that you drive by all the time, and never really notice.  Well, since I am always on the look out for a great burger place, we finally took a chance (after diving by for years), and tried this place out.  Well...  This place makes a Great Burger! Wonderful price! friendly staff!  And the tater tots were cooked to perfection! Since we first tried it, we have gone back several time.  I definitely recommend this place!

I'm a huge fan of the appetizers here. last year they ran a Monday night appetizer deal all football season long. I was there almost there every week. Give this place a shot, they got a million different beers and fair pricing.

Walked in sat right at the bar. The place was pretty full of mostly families with young kids. No one there at the bar. I Waited several minutes for anyone to say hi. A nice gal came to a register at the end of the bar, worked on it for a couple minutes then finally said hi, asked about my day, I asked for an IPA on tap, she exclaimed there were none. What? Really? A pizza restaurant that spent hundreds of thousands on their build out didn't carry a single IPA?

Pulled out two cans and set them on the counter just out of reach and walked away. After watching her greet 2 regulars, cash out another, make drinks for another order -- she didn't come back. So I left. When I was leaving, she looked at me and I just said maybe another time. 

So much opportunity , under staffed and under stocked. 

Maybe next time guys.

Kahootz is a good little hang out.  They have a nice selection of beers and the servers are super friendly.  The food is typically very good.  

The atmosphere is more suited towards conversation rather than loud music and partying.  If you are a d-bag who wears his hat backwards and thinks the sun sets his pants you won't like Kahootz.

The jalapeño poppers are huge! What a great selection in beers for a place out in Meridian. The people here are friendly and can help you decide on the type of beer you want. I recommend smaller portions of beer so then you can try even more. My burger was juicy and smokey. Great flavors and it came with seasoned fries!
Most disgusting place I've ever ate at in my life (no joke). Not ONE thing tasted good on anyone's plate. I can't believe we had to pay for that garbage of a meal.

Oh, KK, why do you torture me so?  You had me at "Wait a second.  Now what can I get you?"  As much as I love, love, love, love your bready donuts, I do have one minor complaint.  "Minor," because your d-nuts are still as cheap as most mom & pop shops and more doughy than any d-nut I have experienced anywhere else, hence, the only reason I spend time reviewing your chain out of all the other crap chains out there.

I need consistency.  It is 1:30 p.m. and I have not eaten a thing this Sunday morning/afternoon waiting for my d-nuts and coffee.  When I finally unveiled my d-nuts, I was shocked to see that you keep screwing with my head by giving me tiny apple fritters.  Last time you made it up to me by throwing a free one in the box.  The time before I had three gargantuan fritters that were fit for a king.  But today, I struggle to keep it together with my three premature looking fritters.  You don't seem to do this with any other donut, as they are perfect little shapes and fritters have a mind of their own, but I ate my fritter in about four bites.  FOUR BITES.  I have waited all morning for this.

Went with my daughter. Had great service. Wonderful scone rolls with dinner. We had delicious clam chowder. My daughter had a great garden salad. My ahi tuna was fabulous. I ordered from the appetite menu. It also came with a meal option which was perfect. Also it was quick to get a seat, even on a Friday night.

Sushi presentation was good, but the fish meat was SMOOSHY and gross. (Not sure how else to describe it... the steaks of fish meat on the sushi were mushy instead of firm. Almost as if they were frozen too much, and then got handled wrong?) The teriyaki salmon, however, is fantastic! I recommend it!
You know what would of been perfect? If Janice didn't spill the water! Food was great, service was great, Dodgers lost.
Excellent food & service.   The food is so fresh also a very clean establishment.  My new favorite restaurant ;)
I didn't really understand the hype. My wife could make steaks better then there's and beyond that they don't have anything special to offer. Coming back next week - maybe I'll change my mind.

We opened the doors and were presented with a filthy floor covered in peanut shells.  I felt like we were at the zoo rather than an upscale restaurant.  We were told the wait would be 15 min. it was 30 min.  Luckily there were plenty of places to sit while waiting.

We didn't really realize how noisy the restaurant was while waiting.  It wasn't until we got past the main counter that the noise hit us.  It wasn't so much the loud country music, but all of the people trying to talk over the loud country music.  Our waitress was shouting to us and we had to shout back.

One particularly loud song came to and end and the restaurant broke out in to applause.  I think they hated the noise as much as we did.

As mentioned in other reviews the butter is mixed with cinnamon.  Not bad, but it would have been nice to have a choice of regular as well.

Waitress was very friendly and quick to replace drinks.  Salad came quick, food came quick.  Salad was awesome, especially croutons.  Baked potato was cooked perfect.  Sweet rolls were average.

I was unable to talk to the other people at our table without shouting, so we just ate in silence.

I can't really tell if the food tasted good or not... between the peanut shells, the noise and the obnoxious music, we knew we would never come back no matter how well the steak was cooked...
The Homestead is a sports bar done right. The best place to watch the game. Good pub food, incredible beer selection, and great drinks.

I know what you're thinking.... 'sushi?!?!?  In Idaho?!?'

Yes, my friends.  This was quite a surprise to me.  Fresh, fresh, fresh.  Melt in your mouth fresh.  

Service was impressive and the place is clean.

We had a sashimi platter and shared a couple of rolls between 4 of us.  I always leave room for dessert and we ordered the deep fried ice cream.  It was pretty good, but I'll pass on it next time.

Veggie omelet was fresh, pumpkin pancakes tasted like holiday pumpkin, coffee was good and service was friendly and attentive! Right down the street from our house and it will now be our regular breakfast spot.

While I did not have any direct interaction with these folks, my fiancee did. She seemed pleased with their communication, though I thought it took longer than necessary to get our appointment scheduled. Since I didn't interact with them directly, I am not considering scheduling difficulty in my review, but wanted to mention it in case anybody needs tree service immediately that this might not be the best option.

That aside, the actual work they did was phenomenal. I went to work with my backyard looking like a pine forest from hell. When I returned, the sun was visible and my backyard looked about 5x as big as it did in the morning. All the low-hanging branches were cleared, some higher branches were also taken down, and the trees were cleaned of dead pine debris. 

Also, if the trees weren't evidence of it, I wouldn't have known that they were at my house at all aside from the back yard having fewer pine needles. They cleaned up after their work very thoroughly and even left us some decent sized pieces of wood for our fireplace. 

These guys do a great job! If you're in need of getting your trees maintained/cleaned up and have a few weeks to wait, go with these guys. You won't be disappointed.

I give them 3 stars not because of the food but more for the delivery. They said at most i would have my food in 1 1/2 hours, i waited 2 hours and a half almost for my food and by the time i got it the food was cold, the fruit was soggy and they also forgot to give me silverware to actually eat my food. They definitely need to be a little more accurate about delivery times because for the price i paid i expected a little more. Other than that the food was really good, I'm just upset about the timing, price & temperature.
WE like Texas Roadhouse before 6 p/m. for their special.  I think it's a 6 oz steak, salad and baked potato for $7.95.  We've never had a long wait at that time.  Good service and good food!

This is by far the BEST steak house EVER! The steaks are cooked to perfection and so tender they don't need a steak knife. The price is good for the amount of food you get. The waitstaff is friendly and knowledgeable. Love the fresh rolls and cinnamon butter. Jennifer was awesome and took good care of us.

This place is your typical diner. Burgers are large but average. The drive threw took WAY too long, 20 min for 3 cars!? Not cool. The best thing about this place were their onion rings! So good and perfectly fried! Great with Fry Sauce, which is a given.

Jonathan did a great job, had my two bedroom living room area and dinning room area done and it came out like brand new. and he said that it would be dry within six hours it got dry fast... i love it and will be calling again for future business thank you much!

I love this place! Great casual place to have a steak dinner on a patio. The pork chop is amazing and a must with the bread pudding of course. The only thing is it is very tight quarters inside the building and not easy to get through. That is why we prefer the summer and patio dining!

Tried to make a reservation 2 hours before. We were told that they don't take reservations but we could sign up on line 30 minutes prior. Checked the site and it said there was no wait list. We walked in and there were a huge number of people waiting. It showed no wait list even after we left.We were told that the site does not update like it should. What a mess . They should tell the truth.

Yard house is OK but honestly it's too overpriced for what you get. The beer selection is amazing and I did have a fantastic glass of pinot noir but as far as the good went it was just ok. I would go back to the Yard house but it would not be in my top choices.

Perfect date night with the wife spot! 
Laid back, decent beer selection, outdoor seating, killer steaks. We did have to wait but, it was well worth it. Just took a couple beers to the outside area.

Indigo, Mom and I had a lovely lunch here today. We split Nachos and sat inside where it was nice and cool. The waitstaff were prompt and friendly. Our nachos were delicious, as were the chips and salsa. The real delight was the horchata! A very refreshing and sweet treat. I'd make a trip back just for horchata! 

Indigo gives this place 15 stars!

Note: Plenty if room for a stroller to fit through the door and to our table. Always a plus.

Mildly pricey, but very good quality. Imagine a Subway version of pizza. It is freshly made right in front of you and you get to pick out the toppings. The atmosphere is casual/hipster and it would be really good for a decent first date that isn't too fancy but isn't too cheap either. Really great staff.

Loved our experience there tonight. Food cooked excellently, great service. The only thing keeping me from a 5 star was the volume of the music!! I had to shout for the person next to me to hear me practically, let alone talking to people at the opposite end of the table. Good music, just way too loud.

Love Kahootz.  We go there 3-4 times a year as a special evening or lunch.  Food is always prepared to our request.  Service is always good.  Yes it's a bit noisy, but that's what you get when you go here.  Not a drinker (any more!), but the beer selection looks great.  Great steaks and sandwiches, Garage Grinder is my favorite sandwich.  Desserts are good also if you have room!

They did an absolutely amazing job cleaning my living room, family room, and two hallways. They also worked with me on my last minute schedule change. I needed an earlier appointment and they squeezed me right in. I love my fresh smeeling carpet. I will definitely be doing business with them again!
The Chianti caramelized onion burger with Fontana is so amazing!!! The beef ragu gnocchi is so good. Great food consistently and good service
Overrated food. Very family friendly therefore tons of screaming kids. No thanks. I would rather spend my money at goodwood and get a great meal

Came by myself,  sat at the bar and asked the fellow to make me anything he felt inspired to make.  I wasn't disappointed.  He made me an interesting roll with multiple fish species and a delicious 3 part sauce.  Spicy and good.   The surprise was the salmon skin which was cooked and actually very tasty.  Hard to believe but it was good.  Good experience over all and worth the 4 stars.

Tuesday evening for the $14.50 rib eye which my wife and I both had, though only 8 oz it was great, mine rare and hers medium,  the waitress forgot our steak knives but it didn't matter, the steaks were tender enough to cut with the butter knives. My plate was clean when we were done. A bloody mary and a bourbon and soda were both well made with a good pour. Looks like date night will be Tuesday's at Kahoots!

This library is a great one! I have little kids (ages 6, 8 & 10), so the large children's area is very nice for me to bring my kids to! They have a play room with toys, quite a few tables to sit and read, 3 tables with iPads and computers to play, another room for story time, several other computers to look at the library catalog, little shopping carts, a coloring table, and they are always doing a fun "find the hidden picture" game. There's always a librarian nearby for any needed help.
Best pizza ever, love this place!!!   It's like a subway for pizza.     You pick the sauce, the cheese and toppings!  Don't split it, cause it's so good you will eat the whole thing.
Meh.. it's ok if your're at Fred Meyers and really want spaghetti. Other than that I wouldn't recommend it.

This place is great place with good portions and friendly service . I got the sweet and sour pork in the Chinese special with hot and spicy soup and it was amazing. Although the hot and spicy soup was not the best it was ok. My friend got the mandarin chicken ( not spicy) and it tasted spectacular and almost resembles orange chicken. My other friend got the won ton war soup and it was sooo big. This was perfect for just a meal. This was an amazing experience and I rate this place 9.5 out of 10

We took a risk and came to the Yard House with 4 adults, 4 kids under the age of 3, and an infant. I was worried that a nice place like this would not appreciate children, but we received fantastic service. Our waiter was friendly, and made sure the kids were always well taken care of. Food came out in a fair amount of time and was delicious! We loved the ambiance and the music helped our neighboring tables less able to hear the chatter of our large group. 

Thank you to the staff for helping us "adults" get a nice dinner outing with the fam!

Another bad experience here. We used to love this BWW. But seems like every time we come here now is super disappointing. We swore last time we were done with this BWW because the food quality is much worse and the service wasn't good. We decided to give it another try and still- the service was slow, the dry rub was just crazy salty, the wings were not flavorful, and my husband had to wait forever to get his drink refilled. We enjoy the atmosphere and games on TV but we swore off of this place for a long time.

Excellent service (thanks, Lyss!). We enjoyed the food and the ambience. They were out of a few things when we came, but they were really great about helping us find alternatives. They were out of my husband's 7 oz NY strip, but gave him a 14 oz for the price of the 7 oz because he had already ordered it by the time they discovered it was sold out. We really appreciated the awesome customer service. The food was delicious: con queso, filet mignon, red potatoes, asparagus, NY strip ... delicious! We will be back next time we're in town!
Such a great office, so cute and so friendly! I was more afraid of the dentist than my toddler! This was her first trip to the dentist and she had a great experience, now if only they would treat me!

I kind of don't really like The Village. I mean, if you were to cut the price of everything in half or even knock off one-third, I'd probably be more inclined to visit. The real issue for me is that price, at least in this instance, does not dictate quality. Establishments like Big Al's, Kona Grill and Yard House are fairly quality, but so overpriced as to keep me away for good. However, these business owners know that The Village IS the draw, so people will eat at their restaurants just because they're already walking around, shopping at overpriced stores, paying way too much for appetizers at an overpriced theater (let's be honest, movie theaters EVERYWHERE are overpriced), working up a thirst and an appetite.

I don't think Yard House is necessarily a bad place. On the contrary, I enjoyed my food and especially thought that the fish sliders were a million times better than expected. I love the fact that they offer something insane like 473 different beers on tap. However, price is going to kill it for me every time. That and the fact that they're usually so unbelievably busy that you wind up waiting 30-60 minutes for a table.

I'd rather take the $100 I'd wind up spending for two people to have an appetizer, dinner and drinks to, say, a sushi restaurant and eat my brains out, or even Fork for some quality cocktails and locally sourced deliciousness.

This is definitely someone's bag. Not mine.

Food selection and service was good. The food took too long to arrive at the table after we ordered it. My meal was warm not hot as was the other 2 people I was with.The flavor was great but it was rather unfortunate the food was luke warm. I have a feeling it sat awhile as it got busier. Might try again, might not.

One of our favorites! When all else fails this is one of our go tos. Always on our list when visitors ask for good restaurant suggestions. 

My favorites are their burger and steak. Their specials are usually excellent as well. 

If you like bread pudding, this is some of the best I've had.
The location of this Walgreens is easy to access.  The shelves are well stocked and it's pretty clean for the most part.
We love coming here for good appetizers and good beer. It is family friendly and the kids enjoy it here as well. You can't go wrong ordering nachos!

Good choice of beers and great food. The service is exceptional. I don't know how you go wrong eating here. Had the pterodactyl wings for the first time and they were delicious. Funny they put them on the appetizer menu when they are a full meal. Also partook in the con queso dip which was delicious. Don't go expecting a cheap meal but very much worth it.
Incredible selection! Awesome people! A bit pricey, but worth the delicious food! This is my new favorite place right now. I will definitely be back very soon!

My diets are very clean. I constantly get a wired taste in my mouse after eating at the chain-like restaurants. It's my honest feeling. And I wish I can know better details in terms of the ingredients in the food & sauce they serve.
I have gone here twice with my daughter. Both times the women who did our pedicure and wax were rude. I will not return these people need a lesson in customer service.....

Been to several BWWs across the country, and this was one of the best!  Apparently it was recently remodeled. The food was great and the portions were great as well!  This was a refreshing visit after several mad meals at other BWW locations.

If you don't think there enough Applebees and TGI Fridays in this town this might be your place. There's really nothing special about Jakers Bar and Grill. The old Jakers on Park Center Pond seemed to be more of a steak and prime rib restaurant. 

I had a hard time deciphering the theme of the new Jakers. Is it Asian fusion with mid-western comfort food? Whatever it is there is one thing for certain.. Old people love Jakers!  When you walk in you can't help but notice the number of blue and grey haired people. (I have quite a bit of gray. Hence the 3 stars)

I had the chicken lettuce wraps. It wasn't terrible or memorable. 

I followed up my wraps with their prime rib. It was decent but somewhere between integrating the Asian fling, the fiesta enchilads, and the Maui mahi surf tacos,  Jakers lost it's edge. They used to be a top notch steak house. Now, I lament to say it, they've become like Fridays. Fufu drinks, jack of all cuisines and master of none.

This town deserves a dedicated steak house. I don't want to have to drive down to Chandlers and plop down 60 bucks every time I have a craving for a decent steak.
A very solid independant burger place. Fresh food and good service. Good ambiance with numerous car photos on the wall. While not particularly remarkable it has no failings or missteps.

I really like Yard House and have been going there.for years for their Happy Hour apps; the poke stack and spinach cheese dip are my favorites . My favorite  entree is their ginger crusted salmon. In the summer it's great.to sit on the patio and listen to the live music at the Village

We had to get five stars here because the service was excellent and I have to say when the best hamburgers I've ever had. Nice crowd I can see it becoming a really popular hang out in the near future. Definitely regulars hang out great for newcomers to
My BF took me here and I never knew it existed it's such an a quaint awesome place with a great vibe and even better food and drinks!

Was in town for work and saw this place. Got the chicken alfredo and it was pretty good. Big portion and the sauce was very fresh and home made. Service was friendly as well. Overall a pretty solid spot.

Third time to the Yard House and the food is just not good. There was a group of six of us this time and we could not finish our dinners, everything was very salty. The drinks on the other hand were great. If I just wanted a beer I might stop in but there are so many great places 5 feet away with great food as well.

Krispy Kreme is not your fancy go to donut fixation but watching the donuts go through the cooking process is always mesmerizing. The sweet smells of maple, and glazed fills the air and always makes me buy a dozen or two.  You simply can't go wrong with the original glazed and catching them while they are still hot or warm is a delight that one must experience while on this beautiful planet. Sure, I know carbs and fats etc... I get it. Its not like I am eating a dozen by myself everyday but once in awhile the sweet tooth calls. The service is friendly and professional.  There are plenty of specials ranging to BOGO dozen or BOGO on assorted flavors.   As a note, though, while KK's donuts are featured in any number of gas stations, I will always get them at the Meridian store.

One of my favorite lunch destinations in Meridian. Always plenty of seating and absolutely delicious wings. Service is spotty but I come for the environment and food quality. Get the mango habanero and Asian zing - so tasty!!
Some yummy steaks . loved the food here and really good service too. The bread they serve is soft and yummy. We are definitely coming back here

I've been to the Yard House several times and am very impressed with the food and the service. We've had our glasses filled without having to ask and had amazing servers every time but one occasion. Today I had a young woman who served us. I told her I needed a minute to decide and didn't see her again for almost 10 minutes. I got my food and finished my drink she walked by several times looking at my empty cup and still didn't refill it. She apparently didn't feel the need to check up on us either. She talked to us a total of 2 times,  once to take our order and once to give us our check. All in all it's been good food and good service for the most part. Just don't count on consistant service.
We have had such great experiences at the dentist! The staff is amazing my kids love going!

I've been going to Angela at Rain for about two years now for a cut and highlight.  I have long curly hair that usually costs an arm and a leg to get highlighted and cut.  Angela does a really good job for less than I have paid at any other salon I have ever gone to.  The salon itself is clean and well-appointed and the people who work the front desk are always polite and attentive.  I highly recommend Angela and Rain.
The best burger!  Not expensive at all!  Friendly and helpful staff with a clean and inviting atmosphere.  I will only get burgers from Main Street Burger!

The beer does not change much and not many local flavors.  The food is good but way expensive. The only time I go here is happy hour otherwise its all over priced. I have been to 4 of their locations now.

Went in on opening day.... Service was actually good for the first day.. ordered the chicken nachos They weren't bad, but the chicken should to be shredded instead of in little cubes.. It made them hard to eat and gave the chicken a weird texture, almost like it was canned. I thought $6 for a pint was steep for the area. The food seemed to be priced well. I will give them some more chances to see how they progress. One note, I saw several of the staff walking around checking their phones, even the owners wife. Probably not the best thing for patrons to see... After all, isn't that what breaks are for now?!

The weekend starts early!! Late night hours Thurs-Sat!!

Also, happy hour specials change daily!!!!

Love this park, there's a small dog area which is great for our 20lb ball of joy. I would give this place five stars if it weren't for the people that came in without a dog and tossed a ball around and got mad at my pup for wanting to play with them. They proceeded to get upset at him and so we ended up having to leave due to their selfishness, even though we were using the park as it was meant to be used. Gladly will be returning, but hopefully they won't!

Saul, Joey and John were super fast and helpful. They caught engine problems that I wouldn't have noticed if they didn't let me know. I love going to Einstein because the staff is knowledgeable and friendly. I will be a long time customer and recommend going to see the guys on Fairview all of the time.

I just recently visited this establishment. The waitress was nice but I found it awkward that my table had 4 different people serve us. With that being said the communication amongst them must of been off because they tried dropping off vampire tacos which none of us ordered. We kindly declined. When our steak arrived it was well done when we ordered medium rare. To top it all off we ordered 2 pints of beer and 4 mixed drinks, our table consisted of 5 guys, and when we tried to order 2 more mixed beverages the manager Brian came over and said he couldn't serve us anymore drinks. Now I could totally understand if someone was tipsy, but that was not the case. He said corporate limits the amount of drinks. Ok, so your saying the limit is about 1 1/4 drinks per person? I've been to yard house in Portland, Seattle, and San Jose. By far this is the worst experience I've had at a yard house. They say your only as strong as the weakest link. Judging by the village yard house this chain is in trouble!

We walked in here during a Friday happy hour and sat ourselves down at the bar stools. We JUST got in after driving 7 hours and were thirsty and hungry.  Our bartender was wonderful from the start. They were really swamped but she took the time to tell us what the happy hour was all about. She was patient with our special needs when it came time to place our drink and food order. She followed all special instructions and even told us to order an item that was less expensive and we would not be sorry. On top of that she brought us over some of their honey rolls right out of the oven.  

Our salads were amazing, huge, fresh, and tasty.  We ordered the crab and avocado salads. They've got tons of dressings that they make and she suggested miso vinaigrette and so glad she did as it was perfect on the salads.

It was Jake and you know I mean it when I say that!

My husband and I came here for a dinner date maybe last year. At the time, I heard this place had the best sushi, although that's not what we came for. I didn't like the miso (I think?) soup, which unfortunately reminded me of the unpleasant flavors associated with nausea. I ordered chicken, he ordered steak. Our portions looked fairly large, but the flavor was bland. Normally when we go out to eat, I can't finish my meal and end up taking the leftovers home in a box. However, neither of us felt satisfied after eating here. My husband was hungry enough that we went and got him a sandwich from Jack in the Box.
The doughnuts are good when they are hot, other wise they leave this weird film feeling in your mouth. They are also very sweet.

Jonathan and Brian, GREAT JOB!!!!  You guys came in, took care of business with great care and excellent customer service. Your knowledge of your field and practice is well defined in your work. Thank you!!!

Great food and service. I ordered the steak fajitas and my mom ordered chicken fajitas. I paid a $4 up-charge for steak which I thought was a tad high. The chips and salsa were great... and my family loved the table-side guacamole -- which again had an up-charge but this one seemed reasonable. My brother ordered a Corona in his margarita... since they discontinued it, they charge him for two drinks for it but my brother said he still wanted it. Service was quick and accurate. Wait time was less than 5 minutes.

Visiting my brother July 4th from California. Was told it was pretty good, but I really thought it was gonna be just another Rodehouse. I was surprised and wrong. The sirloin was excellent, melt in your mouth, prepared exactly like I ordered steak done right. The staff were right on. Friendly, efficient and very funny with my nephew celebrating his birthday. Great job. Any time I'm in Idaho, I'll definately be coming back.

Complete garbage. Service was awful. Went there based on yelp and Google. Seriously, do not go here.  The steak was barely edible and I have never left a review before. Just want to give folks the honest truth.

Yummy, their margarita pizza was a huge hit! Perfect after a very long day. The one in Meridian downtown was nice enough to be honest and let us know that they don't serve the calamari (my favorite food), but that the one on Linder does. They gave up a sale with us and had us go there instead out of the goodness of their heart so that deserves five stars right there. Calamari was delicious. Will definitely be returning. Thank you for your awesome service.

Working in the service industry and getting off at 11pm-1am makes it tough to go out and grab a bit to eat or a quick drink after work unless you are going to a dive bar.
Luckily Matador is open until 2am every night and is mine and my friends new go to spot after a long day of work or on our days off for Top Shelf Tequilla Tuesday.
The food is great and the drinks are even better.
Best variety of Tequilla in the Treasure Valley by far.
Drew is the bartender who usually takes care of us and the service is 10/10 every time I come in. 
I will always be a returning customer.

My brother loves to get finger steaks every time he's in town. We drove by this little place and decided to check it out. I have to say, I was impressed. You get a nice portion of finger steaks and fries, and they throw in fry sauce and barbecue sauce without you having to ask (a good amount of those, too.). The finger steaks were tender, with a tasty batter and just the right amount of crispness. The barbecue sauce was amazing (was it barbecue sauce?) and complimented the finger steaks nicely. It was tangy and sweet, with a nice amount of pepper. My brother claims they were the best finger steaks he's ever had. I have to agree. The fries were also good, well seasoned. My dad was also pleased with his burger, so I'm sure we'll be back.

This past Saturday my boyfriend and me decided to try the new Sakana on Vista. The inside is MUCH nicer than the outside and I was really excited about that. Our server was super sweet and even gave us complimentary edamame. I ordered the Mamasan. It was good, but nothing outstanding. I also ordered wine, which came in the tiniest glass ever. My boyfriend liked his Cali and tuna rolls, but again, it's wasn't anything out of the ordinary. The servers are great and the food is okay. I would definitely go back if i was craving sushi and didn't want to travel downtown.

Awesome place to eat. Was craving A good salad yesterday and drove right to noodles and company. My first visit was a wonderful experience. The salad was fresh with lots of chicken, apples, slice Red peppers, Blue cheese over a wonderful selection of greens. It was served with a delectable pomegranate vinaigrette. I had to try the tomato bisque on the side and was not disappointed. The soup was hot and delicious with just appropriate amount of seasoning. My companion had the macaroni and cheese which I got a bite or two of and it was amazing. I will definitely be visiting this establishment very often and can't wait to try all the other choices.

I do not know what these people that work here are thinking about but it certainly is not about making the customer happy or have decent food, We stopped in because we wanted to try the Fish Sandwiches. I had ordered Burgers from carl's in the past but Only from the one On entertainment and Overland down by Costco and across from Chuck O rama, They were always good and the people there were nice, zero complaints.   This place though OMG!   wtf.   
   1st we were dining in, we ordered two meals with the fish sandwiches , supposedly beer battered Cod, what we got after having just walked from the counter to the table with this mess was unbelievable. it looked like someone had sat on them, the fries were short, hard and cold. when I went back up to he counter casually as to not make a scene, and described what was up I was looked at for a second and then told hmm, well sorry .. thats how they are.   and that was that. the counter person just went in back with no resolution.    If I was alone i would have raised some hell but I was not and I didn't want to ruin the great date we were having so I left. but i will be reporting this BULL CRAP everywhere I can.   seriously.   these sandwich buns were thinner than the super thin supposed fish, the lettuce was wilted and old looking, mine actually had a big brown spot in the middle, and the tarter sauce was translucent like mayo that was left too close to the stove for a few hours.   imagine that now and you will get it.
Good beer but $7 a beer? That's a little on the steep side!! Food is mediocre at best!

This review is in regards to our takeout order. So i ordered 5 meals and 2 appetizers. Every item said fresh bread included, great because we love the rolls...well.we only got 4 rolls...really 5 meals and not even 1 roll for everyone. Ok so 2 appetizers each should come with a dipping sauce, no we got 1 sauce for both so how do you eat an onion blossom and fried pickles without enough dip? What a waste. 3 of our meals came with side salads, i ordered extra ranch just in case, we only got 2 ranches... ordered 2 ribeyes, one medium and one medium well. The one supposed to be medium was very rare, not fun for a pregnant lady to bite into, i had to microwave it 2 minutes to not be mooing still, because ya know microwaving a $20 steak brought me joy...NOT!!  Had a baked potato on the side, ok its fine but was still hard and not cooked all the way, had to microwave that too..  considering how much i love texas roadhouse i am very disappointed in this order. Please do not have take out ordering available if you can make sure quality will be just as great as eating there.
This is in my opinion the best sushi in Boise. The only downside is that there's no All You Can Eat sushi. They do have $1 plates on Monday and Tuesday's. Highly recommend it

Always a great time! Trivia. Poker . Great drafts! And tons of different BBQ choices for any pallet. Anything from fried pickles to classic wings to delish nachos! I always have good memories and great service! I'm also quite addicted to the wild berry lemonades
Love their food and frequently order it to go.  The last two times I was told 20-30 minutes.... actually waited 45-65.

Just ordered a chicken salad and I would bet money, this chicken is processed-has that overly smooth (tofu like) appearance with very little chicken texture. With so MANY places to eat in the Meridian area, I will be spending my money where I know without a doubt, the meat is REAL.

I am conservative about giving out 5 stars to chains, but this Texas Roadhouse definitely deserves a 5-er. Our meal was cooked perfectly. ..broccoli was perfect balance of tender and crisp as were fries. There was a seasoning on the fries that was a little extra special. ..maybe garlic...and parsley?? Some might complain of them being too salty, but we're at Texas Roadhouse where everything is bigger and better and your eating sweet dinner rolls with cinnamon and sugar butter!! Point being,  I LOVE the frues. Steaks were perfectly cooked, and Uber tender. ..I could have cut mine with a butter knife...exceptional flavor and texture. Chelsea was our server, and she was a rock star; attentive without being intrusive,  on top of everything including my special needs dietary requests. Traveling the country as, well, non-mainstream person,  it's easy to feel a bit on edge...but Chelsea put us at total ease and we had a fabulous dining experience!  Will definitely stop here the next time I'm through Boise!

The food here is decent.  Though limited the breakfast items are very good.  Homestead's Bloody Mary's are among the best in the greater Boise Meridian area..  They offer a dizzying amount of micro brews that are rotated frequently.  Found a brew I really liked only to find it gone a few days latter.  

The good food a drink at the Homestead are offset by the flies.  Do something about the flies and this review changes from two to four stars.

Loved our dinner at Texas Roadhouse.  Easy call ahead, welcoming atmosphere, great service (thank you Dylan), excellent food, generous portions with both child and adult menu and reasonable prices. Only suggestion would be to turn down the volume on the music.  Very difficult to have a conversation.  Fun family atmosphere.  We look forward to coming back next trip to Meridian.
Best happy hour around. Drinks are a little pricey but competitive with in the village. Good food, Great atmosphere, and nice staff. Outside seating always has nice views of the water feature.

When I feel like a big, spicy chicken sandwich I go to Buffalo Wild Wings. I don't normally go to places like this because it has a sports bar feel to it, but I still like it. The atmosphere is fun. I like watching for the quiz questions, but I don't participate. I find this place interesting, the food is great, and the staff is friendly. They have a good variety of beer.

Food was ok, but pricing was not appropriate for the food. Seems like everything on the menu is about 20-30% over priced. Beer menu is huge and seemed reasonable in pricing. Cocktails were way over priced. They must make a massive profit on their liquor sales.

Let me start by saying that I downloaded "Yelp" just right now so I can comment on how much I love this place! Not only do they have a huge variety, literally there is something for anyone.  Not a fan of noodles? That's ok because they have Amazing sandwiches, soups, salads, flat breads, pot stickers and the list goes on. On a diet or have pesky allergies? The calorie count is on every dish and they have delicious Gluten free items (the gluten free pesto pasta is to die for) 
I don't know about you but I have very picky eaters in my house and they totally helped me create the perfect dishes for everyone.  No rolling the eyes when you are staring at the menu with a blank look on your face. They helped me create the perfect dish for my 2 year old that is lactose and tolerant, but is also allergic to gluten. 
My first time dining at noodles and company I was lost and confused on where to start.  A very nice employee came over and helped me. (I was also holding a screaming baby and had a grumpy 5 year old with me) he first started by greeting me and then he turned to my oldest and started talking to her (she was not nice to him at all) I was frustrated and embarrassed and thinking about leaving,  but soon the employee was asking if she could have a free cookie. Her face lit up she now had a new best friend.  The rest was a breeze while he helped me create my dishes (with the staff in the kitchen giving suggestions for my picky eaters) 

I will never forget the way they made me feel that night, I felt important, I felt like they truly cared about my child's allergies. Absolutely Amazing!

I loved the atmosphere, the staff were all laughing and having a great time, while staying quite enough so the customers could enjoy their meals with their family. You could tell that they loved their jobs. 

My only complaint is that they would not allow me to tip them. Way to go management, you have an amazing crew!

Sakanas is one of my most favorite sushi restaraunts, there have been times I have gone twice a week!! I have tried many rolls and hibachi I have never been disappointed with the flavors or the service! Sometimes the rolls don't stick together however it still tastes great!

I have been really loving their Buff Bowls. I usually lot for the Japanese Steak bowl. Deliciously seasoned steak with spinach, sprouts, carrots, broccoli and sesame seeds (I think that's what those were). The only downside is that it takes 10 or so minutes for them to make your food. This is an indicator that all their ingredients are fresh and things are cooked to order. They also have one of those fancy new soda machines with the thousands of flavors. Pretty cool! Highly recommend their buff bowls if you're looking for a healthy and delicious alternative.

This is my favorite Walmart in the area always clean and has friendly staff. The old thing I hate is when they are cleaning the floors its like the customer is in the way!! They are so loud too. Got my tires there and do a lot of bulk items as well as the basics I like some of their pjs and panties but not the clothing, I did get a cute turquoise hoodie on clearance for $5 so you can't beat that!

I use to be a huge fan of Buffalo Wild Wings but then after eating here so much its become just an a-ok place to eat at.  I always end up eating here if I can't decide on where to eat.

The environment is good and the workers are really friendly.  However, there was one waiter who said I looked like his friend whom is a guy.  Hmmm...thanks for saying I look like a guy?  Rude much?  Yeah, I don't see him working there anymore so I'm glad.  He even forgot to give us back our card after he charged it.

The only thing I really like about this place is their boneless wings.  The sauces are alright.  I would recommend everyone to try it out at least once.

I like the atmosphere because it's brighter than kyotos. I'd like this place to be more of a hibachi vibe. The service can be a little on the slower side but just don't come to this place if you're in a hurry. It's a great place to have dinner with friends because the wine is so cheap! The parking lot is spacious which is great. I had dinner in one of the private rooms one time and it was pretty sweet. The table is lowered so when you sit your feet dangle under ground. I'd give this place a try more for the sushi. I also thought the potstickers might be from a bag or maybe they're just that good at making them all look the same ??

Funny small dive kind of a place with DELICIOUS food. I got the $12 steak and it tasted like a $25 steak. Great potatoes and veggies, really great quality food. I wouldn't bring kids here probably just because it's a little cramped and small, but a great date night place.

Mongo's grill is Mongolian BBQ on steroids!  If you like Mongolian type restaurants you will love this place!  And if your not... It's still worth trying this place.  

Service,  Been here several times and everyone is very freindly and you can tell they like working here.  Alway a plus!  This last time we came in and had a expired coupon and asked the hostess if we'd be able to use it. And with out hesitation she said.. Of course you can.  They help answer questions as your wondering and the freindly guys cooking your food are always  courteous.   And in between getting your food and coming back your drinks get refilled.  Love that.... 

Food,   Five star is given because I believe that this is the best you can get as a Mongolian style restaurant.  The choices are endless and the quality of meat and produce are the freshest I've seen.  For example the meat at other places are frozen like a rock and not very appetizing.  But here looks fresh and marinated.   And I didn't find ANY vegetables brown or discolored. Even the Salas bar looks great.  Soup a bit crusty from being in the crock pots.  The choices are truly endless you could eat here for a year and never have the same thing twice.  Even when you get to the cooking station they ask you questions like egg, tortillas, white rice, or Fried rice?  OMG so many choices!  Then when you get your hot bowl of food now you have all these sauces you can add to the top.. Like I said so many  chooses. Maybe to many for those of you like me that have trouble deciding what to make and end up making something over the top! And we'll not always the best idea.  My recommendation is to start slow and easy and not go nuts. Good luck. 

Groups,   I brought my team here for a Christmas luncheon and they loved it. This is a very diverse group that can tend to be hard to please at times. (Don't tell them I said that) but they all loved the whole  experience of it all.  But it could be the 3 hours out of work and I sprung for mongo's great deserts.  I'm pretty sure they all loved it.  And the private room was fun to have everyone sit together.   

Give this place a try. Even if this isn't your thing. I think you will be pleasantly surprised.

Was traveling for business and stayed the night in Meridian.  Found Kahootz on Yelp and thought I would give it a try.  So glad I did.  Had a great meal (ribeye special) along with their vegetable beef soup.  Excellent quality.  Could tell everything was made from scratch.  Also had an excellent wheat style draft beer from Montana.  The ambiance was very comfortable and laid back.  The service was excellent.  I had a server by the name of Christina who was super nice and very helpful with recommendations.  Thanks so much for making my first evening out in Idaho really nice.  Will certainly come back when I return for my next meeting.

This place has an awesome beer selection but it doesn't stop there. A lot of places similar to YH rely on their beer selection and food takes a back seat. I've eaten her on multiple occasions and everything is great with one exception, the fish and chips are very bland including the jalapeño tarter sauce. I've had their ribeye, cheese butger, turkey club (minus swiss cheese), street tacos, Mac and cheese and jambalaya. Everything has been flavorful and fresh. This is a great place to go before catching a movie next door.

My boyfriend loves Chicago style pizza so when we drove by this place while in town we had to stop. Service was pretty good, greeted quickly and our server checked in with us just the right amount. On a pizza scale this place is about a 7, lots of cheese which we love. However, the sauce and the pepperoni were scarce in the double pepperoni we ordered. They also lacked in quality, the same pepperoni on the pizza as the salad bar. Id give it a 3 on a scale for Chicago style. Overall, it was a decent dinner but nothing compared to some of the great deep dish pies we've had in the Northwest.
Great prices and strong vacuums! Cleaned my Dodge Grand Caravan after my family destroyed it! Haha

This Sunday my family and I decided grab lunch before a movie at the village. As we sat by the fountain considering where to eat, the youngest in our group suggested Yard House....I was hesitant as just two months ago we had dinner there and the food was mediocre. Not because Yard house has mediocre food,  as we have dined at the Seattle location, but because this location in Meridian appears to have challenges with food quality. Our previous visit, my fiancé ordered a salad and got limp old lettuce. It was so badly presented that we had no words. My fiancé is not big on complaining so we let it slide. And decided to try other places in the village.
