On this recent Sunday, I ordered the chicken sandwich which is presented on a flatbread. Our food took about 25 minutes which I thought was a long time when the restaurant was basically empty (Sunday at 11:15 am). 

When I moved the chicken to add some lettuce , I found that  the flat bread was burnt. They had the nerve to serve me significantly burnt bread. The chicken was covering the burnt bread and I would have never seen it had I not moved it aside.  What bothers me about this is that the kitchen served it. They were too lazy or did not think I would see the  burnt bread under the chicken and sauce etc. 

I was visibly upset and the waiter handled it well. Sunday was my cheat day and I really wanted a good meal.  They ended up not charging me for my meal and even offered to re make it. However we had to get to a movie and with the 25 minutes for our food to arrive, we didn't have another 25 minutes for a new meal....so that was not an option.

The chicken was also significantly burnt and I had to cut off the edges as it was charred bitter.  

I think the yard house has a good menu but they need to step up the food quality and kitchen organization. With three other big restaurants around, not sure we will be back. 

It's too bad really because the restaurant has great ambiance and decent service. To me bad food is a deal breaker for a restaurant. And hence the 2 stars.

Service and food very good. I actually take home most of the main meal just so I can have some of that luscious bread pudding...believe you me, the half order is big enough for both to share, but it is a must.  My steak was done right. I went for lunch but will be back many times.

My husband and I love mongolian bbq and eat it quite often. This place doesn't even deserve a star, I would only give it half a star just for the seafood selection. Where do I begin?

1. The cooks have no clue how to really cook mongolian bbq because the noodles and meat got stuck on the grill. They stayed in one spot and did not go around the grill. They don't know how to put it in the bowl so it just sat on the grill until they figured out how to do it, so I ended up with some burnt noodles and meat.

2. They over cooked our noodles and chopped it up

3. They put too much water to the point where all the sauce I put into it was pretty much gone, so I ended up having a bland food. I season and put a lot of sauce in my mongolian bbq so it has flavor (I have been doing this method for 4years), the way they cooked it made it tasteless.

4. Service is horrible, our server did not refill our drinks until it was completely gone so we basically waited about 10 minutes to get refills; the place was not even busy because it was about to close and there were only 2 tables that the server was waiting on.

5. TERRIBLY OVER PRICED AND NOT WORTH IT!!!!!!

I WOULD NEVER RECOMMEND THIS PLACE TO ANYONE. I WOULD NEVER COME BACK.

I had lunch on Sunday, May 20th.  Was there with family.  I ordered a Quesedilla Explosion salad.  I found the salad to not be eatable due to the drenching of dressing.   The food preparation was severely lacking.  Food prep was also slow.  I will not go back.  Good luck with soaked salads.

Service was good- very friendly. Food for most part was good- crispy red potatoes and hash browns but would not recommend the chicken fried steak. It was mostly breading very little meat and not a lot of flavor. Definitely a no. Now their specialty breads delicious we had the banana nut bread.

I really love the attention to detail this company offers. Very responsive. He remodeled my bathroom, built an outdoor bbq island and removed existing windows and installed slider and French doors. Work was completed without a flaw and the work looks great. We are setting up for phase 4 which includes remodeling my kitchen/dining room. I am so excited it's gone so well so far and looking forward to doing more projects with Rendon Construction

Used to be satisfied with Krispy Kreme I would support my local kids and girl scouts by buying the fundraiser discount cards. Now that Krispy Kreme has discontinued this service I no longer have any urge to get donuts here. This was a very bold mistake Krispy Kreme well done. Side note their donuts don't really fill the entire box any more. 10/10 would not recommend this store to anyone.

Too pricey and too tight.
There is no space to get around the food tables and their food is no better than other Mongolian grills in the area. We realize they are new, but we won't be back. You can't take your leftovers because it is all you can eat, but for a lower price at the "per bowl" grill, I can take home more than half of the food I chose. Best of luck to them but they will need to make changes......

When it comes to hardware stores I like lowes over all the rest. There usually very clean and I can find my way around then better the  others.. always seem to have alot of employees working and there usually very helpfull. Prices are always online with other places sometimes more sometimes less.. find the clearence item is where the best deals can be had. Only thing I hate is they never seem to have enough cashiers and this location doesn't have self check out
oH SO yummy. Can't go wrong with any of the signature pizza's! Always add roasted garlic whoLe not chopped ! And the owners ---they're AWESOME.

Great atmosphere and large selection of import and micro beers.  They can be a bit spendy if not using their happy hour or specials but it's still very good.  Only reason for 4/5 instead of 5/5 is the value for everything if paying full retail on each item.

We went in and waited at the reception desk only to be completely ignored. The bar was busy but the restaurant was not very busy. We got tired of waiting to be acknowledged and finally left and went to the restaurant next door.

I love Yard House! Especially for their late night happy hour and the Lunch menu. Every time I come to this place which is pretty often the service is either outstanding or awful. No in between. However with that being said the food is always uniformly good. I absolutely love the side salad that comes with the corn. I also have had the pizza during lunch with a ceaser and I'm more than satisfied. I had to dock a few stars for the service sometimes not being the greatest and the times that I have had some food items that were just uninspiring.

Went in for Sunday brunch buffet and at $15 a person will not be returning. The French Toast was burned the cooks came and looked at it about 4 times, hmmm wonder why no ones eating it? The omelet was ok bit greasy though. Much rather go to C barrel way better food for way less. Servers seemed to be playing around over heard the hostess say to our waiter he was disgusting.
We've been going here since they opened. Only once were we disappointed. Great rolls, fresh fish and excellent service.
The Countryman's Benedict is amazing!  It's a Benedict, country fried steak and biscuits and gravy in one dish!  Now...time to go workout and work off the calories!

Who doesn't like Texas Roadhouse? I'm not sure if we even come here & we got a table that instant, we usually wait because this place is just jampacked with meat lovers lol. Thankfully there's peanuts you can munch & did I mention their rolls? My son, he will just eat those with their butter. Steak is always the way to go for the hubs & I usually do the seafood. We like to share so we can eat each other's food. We always have a great time here!

we ate at the Fairview ave in Boise location on Friday night April 30th. Lacey our waiter was fantastic. My Rib and Rib steak combo was terrible. The ribs were overcooked and dry. The steak had great flavor but it had so much grissle I could not saw it into pieces with the sharp knife. It was pretty bad. My wife had the country fried chicken and it was pretty average at best. We were with a couple of friends from Montana so I did not raise a fuss, just paid the bill unhappily and went away. My friends had a rack of ribs, same deal, dry. She had salmon and it was equally as bad. I have been going to the Roadhouse for years but am not thinking I will go back

This is a very welcoming, family friendly restaurant. We were greeted right away and sat quickly. Our server came over promptly and brought with him waters and warm chips & salsa. We asked for some recommendations and his suggestions were helpful. Al Pastor tacos were good. I loved that they were served with lime wedges and some different sauces. Meat was flavorful. Beans and rice were good. My husband had a seafood combo platter. He liked that too. 

Only complaint would be that the floor where we sat was a little dirty. Maybe like a smaller child had sat there and crumbled chips that fell on the floor. When we left I did mention it to someone and they apologized. 

I would eat here again for sure.
Went for dinner. Host gave away our seat. Then waited extra 15 min for a table. Waited 10 min to get greeted. Food quality not the same as the opening week. Service just average.

Full bar, great service & delicious pizza. We tried the capricciosa, that was our favorite & the blanco magnifico, ok too but not as tasty in our opinions.

Generous wine pours

I have been to the Boise location many times and love it. I live in Nampa and was excited to learn they were opening up another location closer to home in Meridian. I have only been there a few times but the food quality is lacking. The hostesses are not very friendly but the wait staff has been great. The last time we ate there my menu was filthy and sticky. Food stuck to the outside and inside. The floors were pretty dirty. I don't think they had been swept all day. From now on I will drive the extra distance and go the Boise location which has always been great.

Overall excellent selection of beers on tap which rivals any big city such as LA, Seattle or NY; and easily surpasses nearly all bars in Idaho. 

I prefer the ambiance and service on the inside of the restaurant as opposed to the patio, YMMV.

I went on a Monday evening and was pleasantly greeted right away by a hostess.  Both the bar and the restaurant area were very busy, yet the overall service was friendly and efficient. 

To start with to drink I had a virgin Bloody Mary-- expertly prepared.

The food is fresh and they use top quality ingredients.  What stood out for me was the sauce on my shrimp scampi-- so delicious that I poured some on my rice and dipped my bread in it.

The asparagus was fresh and perfectly cooked.  The creme brul'ee for desert was simply divine.

With my meal I had a Widmer hefe Weizen which is my favorite Seattle brewed beer which reminds me of the authentic German hefe Weizens I had while stationed in Germany. 

The atmosphere and vibe inside of the restaurant is really great.  Nice quality music being pumped in via XM satellite.  

I would recommend this restaurant for a casual to more important, to families and to business people as well.

My rating is based on quality of ingredients, friendly efficient service and price.

BTW the wine bottle selection is great and priced quite a bit less then at most restaurants in larger cities.
Very good breakfast!  Place was packed but not too slow on service. Will definitely go back. The banana bread was fabulous!'
Had the small poke bowl today. It was fabulous. The man who made it was very nice and the restaurant is very clean. Will definitely be back!

Amazing food and the best customer service I've had in a really long time! The owner went above and beyond any expectation to fix a minor problem. We were visiting from out of state, but if we lived here this would be my breakfast place of choice!!

We loved this place! Great vibe. Love the patio. Service was great. The food was amazing. Had to order a flight because the beer selection was too good to pick just one. Too bad we live across town. I'll be back.

Eat there often and the prices are great.   Friendly staff and good food for the price.  I'm sure it is the busiest restaurant in Boise.  The only gripe I have with Texas Road House is the cleanliness of the restaurant is atrocious!  Just because you have peanut shells on the floor, I does not mean that the place can be dirty and have a layer of grease on everything. When was the last time they dusted or cleaned the kitchen?

Casa Del Matador is a great addition to The Village, bringing a tex-mex flair with an upscale environment that a date or a family could enjoy. Don't go expecting traditional Mexican or to be seated right away, but DO go for great food and an awesome environment. With a daily food happy hour, it's hard to beat (except, of course, if they also had a drink happy hour!)

Food: The food has always been good at Matador. Whether at this location or the downtown spot, you'll hit it right if you're looking for tex-mex. My husband and I shared the queso fundido (seasonal) and it was very, very cheesy but needed salt. We also shared the beef burrito with verde sauce, which was big and very good. We hear the chicken burrito is a popular choice and will try that next time. It seemed similar to a Chipotle or Q'doba style burrito. Both items, plus chips and salsa, were more than enough for the two of us to share. Also, the nachos are great! The Green Chile, a soup with a side of tortillas, comes in a very big portion (perfect!) with grilled flour tortillas. While it needed salt, the flavor and chunks of pork were very good! FYI - the chips and salsa at this location are saltier & spicier than the downtown spot... SO GOOD! 

Drinks: n/a

Atmosphere: Very nice and seemingly upscale, compared to most other Mexican or tex-mex spots in the area. Think like an upgraded On The Border. It gets VERY dark in there at night, so don't try to take photos of your food (lesson learned from this photo-taking foodie!). We loved the dim ambiance and dressy vibe. 

Service: Unlike busy nights, we didn't have to wait for a table. We were seated right away, were greeted by our server about 7-minutes later (longer than we'd usually like to wait), but once we ordered we had our food in less than 10-minutes. Overall, it was fast, friendly and easy service. Our drinks were always refilled and server always had a smile!

Happy Hour Offerings: Daily food happy hour from 4-6. No drink specials, sorry!

Healthy Hack: n/a

Tips: FYI - the chips and salsa at this location are saltier & spicier than the downtown spot... SO GOOD!

Place is very busy for a pub that I would take for a dive bar. I like the outdoor dining area, and the inside is more like a dive bar. Our wait was actually less than what we were told, we ordered the chicken wings for an appetizer. They were flavorful and delicious, I would of liked for it to be more crispy than having it boiled and then grilled. I got my NY strip and it's looked smaller compared to my daughter's steak and we both got the same thing. The steak was cooked medium just right and the roasted red potatoes were super delicious with asparagus. I would say that the sides were small in portion because I finished it all before I could eat all my steak and was left with nothing to eat it with. I also got the clam chowder there and that was superb, nice and creamy with a good amount of clams and potatoes not too chunky. We arrived around 7:30 and I was hoping for the prime rib and they ran out! So you have to get here around 5 because they go fast! The service here is good, the waitress we had was super nice and knowledgeable on what the menu had and could tell us about the dishes on the menu and I really enjoyed her service. Very polite kept our drinks and water full. The one thing I did not enjoy was the noise but I understand it's more of a pub atmosphere. If you are around this area, you might wanna check it out and have a blast at a place with lots of choices for beer.

It's your basic sports bar, food wise. The bone in wings had a really good flavor. The wait staff was so so. The place wasn't packed but it was normal dinner time. Wait staff were walking around. Our waitress came for our order and we weren't ready and it took. Her about 15 min to come back for the order. Wait time was about 25-30 min and 5 people in our party. Waitress checked on us once or twice during the meal. 

I have never been to a Buffalo Wild Wings and doubt I will go back.

I'm here from out of town and felt like having Chinese food. I want a bit out of my way for this based on the reviews that I read here. Here's my take:

Really good egg rolls. Tasty, crispy, hot. Really good. The fried rice was also really good. I got combination fried rice which made it even better.

I was not a fan of the hot and sour soup. It was far too spicy food what I'm used to. Too much heat, too little flavor. 

Other than that, not a bad place.

Bad experience....first time at this location; also our last time. I have a serious dairy allergy and Katie, who was making my pizza questioned why I needed the ingredients from underneath when there was blatant cheese in the bacon, olives and pizza sauce. I tried to be patient, but she was rude about it. When I asked about the dairy free cheese, she said "oh, that would've been nice to know before doing the toppings, I guess it will be Chicago style". Then, when I told AJ, the manager on duty about the rudeness, she said "sorry, we need to keep the line moving". I said "there was nobody in line" (we literally were the last group in line, but because of my allergy all the workers stopped and made a huge deal about it which caused everything to stop). I get it, it's a business, but telling me I'm just a number is down right rude. Then after I was talking to AJ telling her how hard it is to eat out she responded with, "yeah if I had that allergy, I wouldn't eat out". We also told her that this is the first time our family that lives locally has gone to Blaze and the won't be coming back and her response was, "they look happy to me". Wow! I left telling her I would Yelp our experience. Shortly after that she went ahead and called her district manager and then brought us over the DM's card asking us to call her.  She also apologized and backtracked in everything that had previously happened. I think she ate a little humble pie or her DM told her to go "make it right". As soon as we arrived back home to our visiting location I called the DM (Kara). She was very nice and very very apologetic about the situation. She offered to take care of us if we would go to one of her three locations and I kindly declined. We were only visiting this town for a short time and honestly I'm not sure my family wants to go back. I appreciate Kara's kind gestures and I expressed that all I wanted was this to be a learning experience for them and how to treat those who have allergies. An allergy is something someone is born with or develops over time and we can not change that part of us (trust me If I could I would). People that are ignorant about allergies really need to evaluate how they treat those with said allergies. Meridian Blaze, I hope this was a lesson that you learned to be sensitive to all people regardless if they have an allergy or not!

This place gets worse and worse everytime I go there.  I go out to Meridian for business and have frequented this place numerous times.

First time was amazing.  Second time (next day) was OK.  Then the rest was just blah.  Not worth the money they charge for sure.

One memorable time, I waited over an hour for my salad.  And my party's steak was unseasoned and well done (asked for medium rare).

Never going back.  Too many other places to go.

Great Texas Roadhouse experience. As always GREAT food at an amazing price, especially the steak, chicken and ribs! That and great service, and it's made. I'm not too much of a fan for the extremely loud music to the point that you have to yell at the person sitting right next to you, but maybe that makes it feel like you're not crammed into the eating pin with a few hundred other people all at the same time. I would always suggest getting some red meat, it's always great here, and if it's not, they'll redo it until it is!

Delicious food!!! My wife and I went for a special occasion. We don't drink but heard the food was good. Space was limited so we sat at the bar. A guy came in drunk and was obnoxious toward us and other guests but the bar tender expertly handled him. The food was so good!

Just had dinner at the wok Fusion food was absolutely excellent.I was very impressed price was fair service was also very good I highly recommend this establishment. Give it a try.
Glen B.

Usually come here on Tuesdays when the wings are 65 cents so your able to stock up pretty good! Overall this place has a really fun environment when you come in with a lot of friends because there are TV's all over the place playing the best sports games that are on. Really relaxed environment so you are able to enjoy yourself and company to the fullest.

Went for the first time for my brother's birthday. I had the vampire tacos. They were delicious but I felt like I needed two more of them for the price. Pretty cool style restaurant but definitely caters to those who enjoying drinking.

I went here to get breakfast. I wasn't really sure of it at first because I could see their silverware was the cheapest stuff you can get at Walmart. I was very surprised how good the food was though. I could not complain about how anything tasted. I got the chicken fried steak and it was delicious, the hash browns were cooked perfectly, eggs were scrambled with cheese. Overall very satisfied with the food. The interior decor was very blah but I'm assuming they're fairly new and still acquiring new decorations. Would give a 5 but it's extremely difficult to get a 5.

I have never had an easier oil change! All of the employees were knowledgeable and didn't pressure me to buy any extras. They even offered refreshments while I waited in my car. This is my go to oil change location from now on.

It's so nice to have a local bar and grill in North Meridian. I had lunch there today and everything was excellent. I had a mushroom Swiss burger with fries. The burger and fries were both great. The service was excellent. Rafael was super friendly. The place is great!  Keep it up!

Have a mixed review....  In a nut shell  food was great .... Service was not so great...  However... in the end it all worked out and I will definately give them another chance.    .   Started with the Clam chowered which was  a little thin for my tastes but the overall flavor was great.. For the main menu I ate the Spicey Thai Shrimp dish which was flavorful and fresh..  My date had ordered a medium rare prime rib which came out not so medium rare.. or even medium...The center of the meat was more grayish with maybe an imagination of pink...  We sent back the meal wanting a more rare piece.. Waitress came back and said that was the last piece of prime rib...hmmm.. Were they sending out something they knew was not correct?? In any case we exchanged the meal with a top sirloin which was corrrectly cooked.  Bad part about it was by the time my date recieved her meal,  everyone at the table had finished their meal..

The check came out and they had changed for the more expensive top sirloin cut... Not big deal as it was only 1-2 bucks more...  I dont mind paying for what I get.. it was a little disapointing that they didnt think to  give some kind of break for sending out the over cooked meat and having the the last person basically eat by themselves..... Some people at dinner had already finshed their meal by the time the replacemnt steak had been sent to the table.   Also drinks often when empty... but somewhat understandable as the resturant was packed.

The positive.... A person(owner??) was walking around and asking were we satisfied with our meal and we noted that we had the over cooked problem...  he was understanding and said he would try and make it right.. Ended up giving us a gift certificate to comp half the cost of the compromised plate..  Like I said in the end it all evened out... the low points were... The  thought process by the waitnress  to "make it right" was perfunctory..  Had to let someone other than our waitress know before they initated any type of comp....

If we didnt recieve the partial comp  this would have been our last visit..  The food was good.. the last person we delt with made it right..  I hope my service experience was a fluke andon my next visit I can focus on the food rather the bad service.. Update to follow

I had the 4 item special- egg soup, fried rice, spring roll and sweet and sour pork. I liked it and would order it again. The Mrs. had the same thing except she had kung pao chicken. She also said she would order it again, although it had a lot of vegetables. The service was good, although there were not a lot of patrons at the time. Prices were reasonable.
Consistent service and quality of food. My daughter and I shared a veggie pizza and beet salad. Tasty! The bartender/server was great and made a yummy gin and tonic to boot!

Celebrated National Margarita day here.  The service was extremely slow.  If you like long and I mean long lunches this is the place for you.  2 1/2 hours to eat a meal is a little long.  The Drinks took forever to come as well.  Probably will not visit this On the Border again.

Shameful experience tonight.  Considering we frequent the establishment a few times a month, if not once a week..tonight was more than disappointing (the last three times have been sub-par, but the staff has always been great.. so we keep coming back).  Tonight though.. Food was cold.  Our waiter, Ty,  was less than attentive. When we let him know it was cold, he could have cared less.  Overall experience - disappointing.  We have always considered Matador our 'go to place' and it's definitely gone down hill.  Stinks.  We've loved this place for the last few years. It will be hard to find a new 'go to'.

We needed four menus because the first three had food stuck to them, the table was not properly cleaned and we ordered food without guacamole because of anaphylaxis allergies and the food came with guacamole and had to be sent back.  Skip this pace
Love their prime rib dinner's on Fridays. Kids cheesy noodles are the best too! Small quaint atmosphere with great servers!

This was a very enjoyable Sushi experience! I have eaten at many different sushi houses all over the U.S. and this one is definitely in the top 5 I have tried! The chef's creations were both very tasty AND very artistically created! I had the Red Bell and my wife had the Candy Cane! Both were great! The Candy Cane was spicy, to say the least! I am not a fan of spicy foods, though. The Red Bell was great! The wait staff was very attentive to our needs. The best thing, for us, was that it was within walking distance from our hotel room at Candlewood Suites! If we ever pass this way again, we will definitely stop in!
For a little mom & pop place, and it really is, the food is great. While we were eating, quite a few people came for pickup.

Enjoyed a nice dinner with friends @ Jakers.  It must have been ennoyable because we forgot to get pictures of the entrees 

What i really like about Jakers is the layout, the tables are arranged in such a way to provide a feeling of privacy which lends to a quieter dining  experiance.

The service was fine, if anything maybe a little too attentive as the server came back three times to ask if we had made a decision about dessert.  

Next time we will do a better job at rating the food, for now... simply a placeholder to reflect our satisfaction.

Why all the negative reviews? This place is awesome. Great staff, tasty fresh food, calories listed out on the wall clearly, lots of options, and the coolest soda machine in the Treasure Valley ;) Love it here.

We used to eat here all the time. My family is vegetarian and vegan, and this was our go-to. We loved the Bangkok Curry and Thai Curry soup. I used to get the big supersized bowl of Bangkok curry with tofu and extra veggies on a bed of spinach. It was so delicious and healthy. We were regulars and came often. Welp, they don't have ANY of those items on their menu anymore. We could probably ask for "no meat" on the rest of their dishes, but we don't like the majority of the rest of their dishes. They have also removed any references to "vegetarian" options on their online menu and added the word "chicken" to almost everything. So we no longer eat here and haven't for a while now. We have been sad because there is not very many other places where we can find a good healthy option like that.

Everything was good. The only thing I don't understand is why call it fresh pasta when what I was served was cooked sometime before and set in a steam table to get all sticky and glued together. I know the pasta was made in the store but step up your game. No advantage to fresh pasta if it is not cooked to order.

A tiny steakhouse and pub with high top tables and over a few dozen different beer options. For those who are into local and specialty beers brewed from micro brews and local breweries - there's an option for everyone. If beer isn't your thing - there is also a cocktail menu and wine list. I had the Estrella (house) cabernet and my fiancé had a pint of Louie Lager.

For dinner we ordered each a junior new york strip which is a 7 oz served alongside a vegetable of the day and your choice of wild rice or rosemary roasted potatoes. I had the rice which was cooked well and seasoned with a flavorful broth. The rosemary potatoes were blistered and cooked throughout and also seasoned well. 

We both had our steaks cooked medium rare and I felt though it was a tad over cooked. Beside the actual quality of the cut of steak, the service was good (Travis served us) and it was a nice place to stop for dinner. There is limited parking in the lot and due to the popularity of the joint it was packed even on a Wednesday evening for dinner (around a 35 minute wait).

ohhhhh my goshhhhhhh i LOVE Hobby Lobby.
Shopping will never be the same once you experience this place. 
It has everything. I can't even describe it, and everything is always 50% off.
From decor to furniture to art, to flowers, to frames, to holiday items, to scrap book supplies, art supplies, and EVERYTHING in between. Plus this place is HUGE, and their decor/art items are always changing. 

seriously. experience it once, and your life will be forever changed.

Food here is great!! If you have never been or are not sure what to try their loaded mashed potatoes are a must! Also have great potato skins and rolls with cinnamon butter. One of my favorite places to come out and eat. Great prices and they have steak specials on Wednesdays

Let's be honest here; you do not come here strictly for the food. You come here to watch the game with your friends on a plethora of tv's and share in the fan comradery. 
Their happy hour deals are good. Their sliders and nachos are always tasty. Although they come up with new sauces I always stick with my favorites: asian zing and honey bbq (yes, I'm a baby with heat). 
THE BEST server you can ever have is Troy. Ask for him if you can and you will not be sorry. Just be sure to tip him for the service he will give you that is far superior to what you would get from the young kids there.

Food is ok. 3rd time here and still not impressed. Always make it down this way because kona grill has a wait and we are trying to catch a movie. Beer is very expensive and service is ok..... I would avoid this place if you could or use as last resort.

Great local restaurant with an extensive list of beers on tap, which is important when you have a beer connoisseur in the family.  Definitely one of the best in the area. They also have a decent wine list though limited..  The food is excellent and the staff friendly. Seating is limited so you better arrive early on the weekends.
Ruth makes this Walgreens! We all just love her including the kids. She always has a right smile, positive attitude, coupons, and friendly conversation. Wonderful customer service!

Located between a tanning salon and Cost Plus World Market, I'm not sure this shop will be long lived.  Kudos to the folks who have invested themselves in setting this up, I think it arrived a few weeks before Christmas, and they were friendly when I popped in to look for a couple of greeting cards there.  But the space is oddly set up, with "kitchee-witchee-giftee" knick-knack stuff in the front like tote bags and coffee mugs and little signs (in the mode of "dogs leave paw prints on our hearts" and "grandma is my favorite") so at first one might do a double take to ascertain one really is in a franchise best known for greeting cards and gift wrap.

But look straight ahead, at the back of the store and there are the racks of cards.  Although, among the many, I only found two of the half dozen or so I was needing.  Once upon a time Hallmark cards were the apex of greeting cards but now many of them seemed 'tired' or dated or cheap quality paperstock but with a $3.50 price tag for same.  On the flip side, if you are looking for gentle cards with religious theme, Hallmark provides a number of nice options for those which other retailers don't seem to stock.

I'd really like to spend my dollars with a local owner for a franchise like this, it is not unusual for the franchise owner's name to be on the marquis at a Hallmark Shop, but this isn't a store I'd go back to.  And I fear World Market as next door neighbor might gobble up this store's customers who are looking for cards or wrap.  Alas.

THIS N THAT:

1) PARKING:  Big, strip mall lot.

2) ACCESSIBILITY:  Accessible parking in lot.  Level in the door and all on one floor.  Ample space in aisles.

Came here after seeing that it had a pretty good following. Went on a Thursday at 630 because figured it wouldn't be busy, and not a single parking spot was available. Always a great sign. Parked across the street and walked over. Had a ten minute wait which was worth it. Had the sparkling pomegranate punch and it was amazing. We had a variety of food from the ribeye special to the fish tacos, there was something for everyone. Not only would I go here again but I would recommend it to anyone. Our sever was attentive, but not overwhelming. He was nice and made good recommendations. Next time will sit on patio area just because inside gets loud.
Friday, September 21, 2018: they like to close up shop 20 minutes early. Just a heads up to whomever is managing this location.
Had a great experience here.  Great pub food menu with great salads as well.  I'll be back for sure.

Great spot! Awesome beer and wine list with lots of local options. The food is great and the weekly Ribeye and Prime Rib specials are a bonus. The service has been spot on and I love to watch the communication between the kitchen and the wait staff. It's a well run place! We'll make this a regular stop!
Comfortable atmosphere to hang out. Similar to a Starbucks vibe.  Mocha was fine.

Dad & I finally tried Mongo's Grill today and we were pleasantly surprised by most aspects of our meals.  We thought the servers and cooks were great.   Our food was delicious.   

My biggest surprise was the variety of ingredients and food styles one can choose here.   When our server was taking us on our first-timer tour, I noticed a burrito sitting on the grill.   Burrito?  Yes, you can use the ingredients offered to make Italian dishes, tacos & burritos, wraps, etc.  We made mostly seafood/veggie combos with Thai noodles, but we'll definitely try something more inventive next time.

A few disappointments:  
- We're seafood lovers and we were excited to try the scallops, shrimp and mahi mahi.   None of these are available during lunch, and this is not explained on the Web site menu.
- The "fried" rice didn't seem fried at all.  It was just brown from lots of soy sauce, along with some frozen peas and cubes of frozen carrots.
- We were greeted quickly and served efficiently, but when we ordered dessert it seemed to take forever.
- Two gals were at a table near us and after their meal they ended up behind the serving station getting drinks.  Are they owners or something?  It was pretty unprofessional.
In my opinion: the best wings! Great service too . Sometimes it can be crowded. Just avoid major sporting events . Unless you enjoy the crowds.
What a great experience. I get nervous at dentist and they made me feel so comfortable!

When the original owner opened this restaurant, I went quite a few times.  The food was a little above the regular bar/restaurant food in Meridian.  I moved out of the area and haven't been back  for about 7 years.  Last Friday I was having my dog groomed and since this establishment was right around the corner I decided to try it again.  The place was packed and there was only one table left.  Since I was by myself, I decided to sit at the bar.  I ordered the lunch seafood special (this is the same every Friday).  Cod lightly breaded and fried with a panko crust.  It was excellent and the fries were my favorite - square cut with the skins on the ends.  They were also cooked so that they weren't mushy and limp which so many places tend to do.  The sauce served with the fish was a little bland.  I wasn't quite sure if it was for the fish or the fries.  So, I asked for a serving of cocktail sauce.  It was excellent!  Next to me was the owner and he asked if I liked the fish.  I said that it was some of the best seafood I have had in a long time.  He told me that they have all of their seafood flown in fresh every day.  I was impressed and want to go back and try other items on their menu.  Great place, excellent atmosphere, and attentive staff.
Love this place... Great food & ambiance.  Servers are delightful.

Great happy hour. Family friendly. Had 6 adults with a toddler and new born. 11 happy hour appetizers , 6 beers and 2 desserts later...... Our bill was less than 120.00!!!  We left with full tummies and money left in our wallet. We will be back.

We have been here a few times.  We don't visit often, because it is a bit pricey for us.  The food has been fine.  Most of the time, the service is good.  There have been a few times when the place wasn't busy and service was slow.  We've had a couple times our food was wrong; though they have been good about fixing things and even removing the item from the bill without us asking.

On a late Saturday morning we were looking for breakfast and tried a couple of local favorites but didn't want to wait an hour.  Found this on Yelp and it was perfect!  Great menu, food came quickly, everything was tasty.  Eggs came exactly as ordered which can be difficult during a busy time.
Oishii desu!  Good food, nice Nihonshu selection and great service.

While I think Dr. Price is amazing, their front desk staff not so much. The whole staff turns over every 6 months or so so no one has a clue. I over paid them several times just to not deal with the hassle when they told me I owed them money, although I paid at every visit. Today when I was there, they told me that again, offered horrible customer service and the billing person was exceptionally snippy (maybe thinking I couldn't hear her?). While I'm extraordinarily happy with Dr. Price and have recommended him to many people, I just can't deal with the incompetence of the front office. I double checked my HSA records and of course I had paid those charges.

Not bad for just starting up
Waitress didn't know much about the menu 
Only second day on job
Eggs were a little underdone 
My hamburger steak was underdone 
We will definitely go back and try it again

Worst customer service ever! A few weeks ago we went in for breakfast. It was busy and with there table set up you have parties of two sitting at tables that seat 4-6 people. We asked the party in front of us if they wanted to share a table. They agreed. We let them order first and we ordered 5 min apart from them. They received there drinks and food. The waitress then disappears. The other party finished there food and yet we still didn't have our food!! Stay away!! They will not be around long!

I have been here at least four times since it opened.   Every time I have been pleased.  Their food is very good--try the truffle fries!  Absolutely to die for.  Their happy hour appetizers are half priced and delicious.

Although it is pretty loud, the atmosphere is nice and open and I think it's good for groups of up to eight.  They have huge booths that can seat eight people which are really nice.  The service is always excellent and food is served quickly, quite the feat for such a large and typically busy establishment.  I've also never had to wait too long for a table (never more than around 10 minutes). 

And of course, THE BEER.  They have 100 (or more?) taps, so many varieties on their vast and easy to read menu.  Samplers are available, you can build your own or go with a pre-determined array of choices, and are reasonably priced.  Both servers and bartenders always seem to know their beer and are able to offer some good recommendations.

Overall I have never had a bad experience here and highly recommend.

This place is a town favorite. We go every few weeks when we get the chance. From the burgers to the steaks to the apps, they deliver every time. The staff is awesome and they stick around which tells you they enjoy what they do and the owners must be doing something right. It's small so the best times to go are during lunch or before or after the dinner rush.  Not a place I would say is kid friendly since it's a bar and grill, unless it's in the summer and you can eat outside. Worth a try if you're in the Meridian area and looking for a great bite to eat in a chill atmosphere.

Excellent service, excellent atmosphere and food was awesome. 
Very busy but no one waited.

My steak was cooked just the way I wanted it!! Texas Roadhouse is great and love the free peanuts!! Great place for ohana and friends!! We will definitely visit many more times. I always recommend this place to the people I meet.. This place is the only place that makes my steak just the way I like it!! Plus awesome prices

Dined at Chili's with a total party of 4 adults, a 9 year old, and a 2 year old on a weekend evening. As expected, the place was busy, but the host was unfriendly and abrasively told us there would be a 30 minute wait because they only had 4-person booths available. We said we would be willing to squeeze the 9 year old on one side of the booth with 2 of the adults and put the baby in a high chair at the end of the table if that left enough room for staff and customers to move around. The host, appearing irritated, said, "Ok, if that's what you want," then informed another host to grab a high chair. As we were being seated, the two hosts were whispering to each other and looking at us as if we've grievously inconvenienced and offended them. As it turned out, the booth worked fine and even with the high chair, there was plenty of room for servers to maneuver. 

The service was incredibly slow, which I partly forgive because i understood they were busy. What I won't forgive is my $15 steak sitting for so long in the pass window under the heat lamps that it turned gray and had the texture of shoe leather. In addition, the accompanying mashed potatoes were cafeteria slop and the vegetable medley had been cooked to mush, which I imagine had less to do with how long the plate had been sitting before service and more to do with how they were poorly cooked in the first place. I informed the server of my concerns and that i wished for a freshly cooked plate. She was very apologetic and sent a manager to the table, who gave a bevy of excuses and no actual apology. The fired me a new steak, which was fresher than the first one I received but still lacking in flavor and quality. My dining partners were underwhelmed with their entrees as well. 

The only thing remotely redeeming about Chili's is their chips and salsa, but with a boat load of other restaurants (and grocery stores!) which have chips and salsa just as good or better, this isn't enough to keep my business. I feel Chili's is unimpressive and overpriced with low quality pre-made food. If you want a quality steak dinner with a fair price and friendly attentive service, go to Texas Roadhouse a mile up the road!

They were great!!!! My 20 year old truck feels new again. I was very impressed they offered a drink and a newspaper. I'm not one to keep up on my truck but they  checked everything and showed me what me fluids looked like and what they should be. RECOMMEND go to Eisteins

One of my favorite restaurants. I eat the Pterodactyl wings a lot. Love them!  Their steaks are fantastic. The mile high mud pie is an indulgence that shouldn't be missed. A great beer selection and the staff are all fantastic.  The owner often comes out to say hi. Great place to eat!

Updated review
We took my father in law to Kahootz last weekend. The wait was about 30 minutes. We grabbed a couple of beers and waited for a table. A table was ready in about 15 minutes. They gave us the beers on the house. Nice!  The service is always awesome. 

I had the steak salad and it was excellent. You can't go wrong with this place.

The food was vial, but the service was good. Everything was frozen, terrible quality, and insanely overpriced. I am devastated we paid money for frozen "cheesy bites" that were actually tater tots with gas station cheese drizzled on top. I think the lobster bisque will make my husband puke later. And the "scalloped" potatoes were actually a mushy bowl of hash browns with broiled string cheese on top. PLEASE save your money and your tastebuds on this. SO sad we spent so much money here.

Finally tried the Yard House and really enjoyed it! The service was great and so was the food. We inadvertently arrived minutes after Happy Hour which our server honored (nice touch). We tried three items from the app menu. The pizza was great, I didn't care for the sushi, but only was because I don't like roe, it was plated very uniquely. Last we tried the egg rolls,  those were good too. We had a great meal tried a new ale and all for a great price.
Great place! Get there early. Prime rib was good. Sirloin was excellent. Good service.

Yum! The food here is amazing, and the prices aren't too bad either. I really enjoy that they season their food :). 

We have ate here a few times now, and each time didn't disappoint! They give you large portions of fries and tots. 

We'll be going back for sure.

Been here several times over the last month or so... The beer selection is REALLY great!! The Clam Chowder on Fridays is Awesome.... Today I had a Bacon Cheese burger and Fries... Ummmm not so good.. Burger was small and fairly dry..the fries were small and overdone. Lesson learned.. DO NOT order a burger .. Just not a burger place.. I can deal with that!! But so far all else is really good.  Service is good .. nice friendly vibe .. Of course I will go back.
The Gorgonzola fries are fantastic! Would order then again in a heartbeat. Nice atmosphere and the staff was great!
It was ok. Service was slow and had to ask for silverware and straws.  Big prices. Short stack of pancakes was $8.99 and the cakes were small. I had high hopes, but was disappointed.

Excellent poke, very fresh,  may be a little pricey, but well worth it.
More idahoians should eat this kind of food, healthier than biscuits and gravy.
Great place for build your own pizza that is fast fired in two minutes at 800 degrees. Kids can put what they want on it. Reasonably priced. Friendly service.

Wonderful service from the first phone call, until the movers left. They finished before the allotted/estimated timeframe and even asked if they could sweep out the truck. They helped move the furniture around to multiple rooms, upstairs and down... Gave advice on our new town too. Clean and professional. I would highly recommend them. Thank you guys!!

i had hopes. i wanted so much to find a good mexican restaurant in the eagle/meridian area. oh well.

the service was good, and prompt. i can say that for it...otherwise, yeah. not so much.

The Nashville hot chicken sandwich must have lost some steam coming all the way from Tennessee. I didn't think you could have a negative heat value, but that's about what this sandwich had. 

I imagine the folks at Prince's in Nashville would just shake their heads. There, your mouth is on fire and you're sweating buckets of water. Yard House doesn't dish up any of that excitement.

And for a $13 sandwich, I expected more than just a throwaway bun. Nothing special there. It didn't even have much rise to it. 

The truffle fries, on the other hand, were pretty good.

I felt like the menu offered way too many choices. When it takes you 20 minutes to go through the menu, it's too long. Which typically means a place doesn't excel at much.

The lighting reminded me of a 1960s steakhouse. Turn on the lights. Save money somewhere else.

I guess most people come here for the beer. For the rest of us, it's kind of so-so.
Can't beat their happy hr deals! Wings, lettuce wraps and the tuna roLL, yum. The iced grn teas are DeLiSH also.
I loved the food and the interior design is phenomenal! Our waitress Devyn was absolutely amazing and the entire experience was absolutely outstanding. 20/10 would come again.

Just moved to Boise area went here a few times for drinks which were decent if not overpriced 8-13$ service sitting at the bar was mediocre really wanted to try the food so went for dinner food was ok but I got one drink before food and with a habanero steak burrito could not get the attention of the bartender to bring me another drink gave up boxed my food and left the manager even bussed our plates while I was in the restroom and didn't ask   My wife how it was I would have given him an earful recently retired to Boise they have lost out on many years of income as we eat out often

Today I ordered a single cheeseburger and tots and rings for my hubby and I. 
Burger comes slooow...but the food was hot, fresh, and looked seriously good! Got it home, and took a bite of my burger. Dry. Maybe that was why they include a large tub of fry sauce? Added sauce amd tried again. Omg, so good! 
This is not a cheap burger, but it is fresh, loaded with veggies, and the bun is hearty. 
Tots were not tasty. Onion rings had a very thick breading. 
Over all, I'd order the burger again, hands down delicious value, but I'd skip the sides. Life is too short to eat bad potatoes in Idaho.

My husband used to be a huge fan.  A special treat for us was going to Chicago Connection for a pitcher of beer and pizza.  [Let not the Meridian location at Cherry Lane incur this bad review.  Pizza and service was always great there.]  This is the third and last time we'll be accepting delivery from the El Dorado location however.  Simply requests such as side of marinara- which they charged for BTW- completely ignored.  After the third time, it isn't an oversight, it's a total lack of caring.  Furthermore- the pizza was mediocre at best.  Not worth the premium price tag- I'd rather do Dominoes at half the price and a correct order.

Been waiting for this neighborhood bar to open. Drove by and said to myself, we gotta try that place out. Today was the day! Came in and was immediately greeted and invited to take a seat anywhere. The server was waiting on a few tables so it took a bit of time, but the order was taken and food was served in turn around time. Food was delicious and the size was great.  Top it off, happy hour is 2-5 with $2 off wells and crafts. Plus the play the local music radio station to boot!
Yum.  Cheese curds.  Sweet bacon boody mary, qeuso with carnitas.  Wham bam.?..we'll be back real soon man !!!!  Delish!
Great happy hour and great service. Can't wait to eat on the patio, maybe when it's cooler weather
Delicious pizza.... totally appalled when we see our waiter outside the window smoking then he smelt like it when he came back in and served our food... gross!

Took the waiter 30 min before we got our orders taken. The Nacho platter is very small. Complaints aside, the waiter did well despite being short handed. He was polite & no too intrusive. The food was good.

It's nice that this place is open late but for the price of the items they just don't deliver.  My food came out barely warm and over salted.  Also my margarita on the rocks was 90% ice.  Not worth the price tag.  Daytime plates seem to be slightly better but not by much.  
Staff and ambiance are pleasant but unfortunately it's all a front for an overpriced low quality food and drink experience.

I've been here several times and always had a great experience.  I usually go through the drive through and at times it may take a little longer but well worth it since everything is cooked to order.  I really enjoy the fries.  They have salt and pepper on them and always fresh.  Great place in downtown Meridian.

oh my gosh what a great park.  We went to use the dog park.  They have one for large dogs and or for small.  We were the only ones in the small park, 

It has a mixture of artificial Turf, compacted sand, and real grass, path to walk all around with benches to sit along the path. There are benches on the artificial turf and a covered area with tables and benches.  There are restrooms.  

For the dogs there is water and different training pieces in the compacted sand
Food, it's about average. Large menu, prices are a bit high when compared to restaurants of similar quality. I would recommend to a high school boy who wants to impresses for a first date.
Yum! Food is awesome, decent prices and they always do military discount for me and my family! Drinks are super yummy too

We had a late dinner here tonight and I was skeptical at first because I thought maybe the restaurant wouldn't be up to the task since they were due to close in an hour.  I was wrong.  We were seated right away and the server was there to get our drink order.  We ordered the food and it was out and piping hot in about twenty minutes.  My husband and I chose the combo special where you select two or three items.  I had Chile Rellenos and a chicken enchilada---both were delicious!  I sampled some of my husband's cheese enchilada with red sauce and it was really good.  In the past the menu did not have flan for dessert which to me is a must for any Mexican restaurant.  It is now featured so we ordered some and it was excellent--served with a few strawberries and blueberries.  Good job, On The Border!  We'll be back!

We've visited Jaker's many times and are always pleased with the quality of both the staff and the food. The building and food is nice enough to feel like fine dining, but it's perfectly acceptable to dress casually which we really like.

On my most recent visit, we sat at the bar for happy hour and ended up ordering a full dinner as well. Our bartender, Jenny, is one of our favorites--she's quite friendly but not intrusively so. She had a good feel for when to check in with us and when to let us chat. 

Their happy hour is really good: There's a small-plate appetizer menu (We tried the crab-stuffed mushrooms and the calamari. Both were good.) and drink specials. Their wine pours are a generous 9 ounces and they have a nice selection. Happy hour gets you $1 off beers and house wine and $2 off margaritas and martinis.

My husband ordered the soup and salad bar with his meal. He liked the salad bar, but the lobster bisque he got from the kitchen? A-maz-ing! It was fresh and not like sometimes you feel like you're getting a few days old soup when it's really thick; and it was so delicious!

For dinner I ordered the chicken tenders with fries and my husband ordered fish and chips. The portions were really generous and the food tasted great. I'm really happy to see that Jaker's has moved to hand-cut fries and Jenny told me that they've started hand-dipping their chicken strips instead of using the frozen ones. This is a step up from what we've had before and I appreciate that they're constantly looking for ways to improve.

Jaker's is a great place to visit whether you're stopping in for happy hour drinks after work or you want a full dinner for date night. It's definitely one of our favorite spots in Meridian. They even do a half-price lunch or dinner on your birthday which we're going to take advantage of this week for my husband's 35th!

BEST SUSHI IN IDAHO. By far. This is the best sushi place I've actually tried in the world. My fiancé and I have gone here for years and never get tired of it. There's so many good things to say about it. Amazing staff. Amazing sushi. (We love the Tiger roll, dynamite, and Hana rolls probably the most) So much flavor. We have tried probably 10 different sushi places in the valley and Sakana has always been what we come back to. (Sometimes multiple times a week!) We love it here. Highly recommend!

Have I mentioned I love this place? There used to be one at the mall where I lived in Northridge and I had missed it so much after it closed. So when I moved here it was one of the first places I went to, to have dinner. It's by far one of my favorite Mexican places.

Drinks: you cant go wrong with just a house margarita. If your in the mood for something different you can get a Sangria Swirl Margarita or MY personal favorite the Pefect Patron Margarita.

Starters: Do yourself a favor and get the Steak Nachos or the Gac Live those are my favorites. If you want leftovers, get the Sampler.

Lunch: They have a wonderful lunch menu with everything from smaller burritos to a lunch sized fajita. AMAZING!!

Entrees: I highly suggest the Ranchladas. I love them. Always have. I recently tired the Queso Chicken for the first time. You cant go wrong with that either.

Just go. Get some margaritas and get some food. Be happy and come back.

Took my beautiful wife on a date night to the Yard House, was not overly impressed.

Started off with a 25 minute wait and there is   only 3 chairs to wait, so the entrance of Restraunt was full of people, shoulder to shoulder.

After the wait we were takin to our table. All tables are extremely close to each other and the noise level is insane, that was with the TV's muted. 

Service was subpar, long wait.

Dinner was good but overall not worth the hassle.

Not my best experience. We chose Jaker's because some out-of-town friends were staying nearby.
Upon our arrival  (I did have a reservation and had requested a booth), we were immediately seated right next to the restrooms although there seemed to be plenty of other booths available. When I asked if we could be seated elsewhere, we were taken to the extreme other side and seated next to the servers station.
Then our waiter presented "memorized" speil, hardly taking a breath. We had to ask him to repeat, so could understand the options he was offering. He seemed not at all interested in helping to make our dining experience pleasurable.
I ordered an avacado/crab salad. The avacado was so Not ripe it was hard to cut even with a knife.
None of our party of four were impressed with the food. Our waiter seemed to be rushing us unnecessarily, then plopped the bill on the table before we were through eating. 
Won't be going back there anytime soon.
Clean place, good service & great taco.  Fresh chips, salsa was not too hot just right.  See you next Tuesday!
The pizza is not bad, It might be new in idaho but if you has lived in California it's every where. I honestly had better pizza in local restaurants. Plus it's really expensive.

I expected an amazing burger because of all the reviews. The ingredients are very fresh, but the burger was not seasoned and it was really dry.  I had to add condiments when I got home.  It had a small smear of mayo in the middle of the burger and that was all.  Fries were the normal frozen fry variety with a lot of seasoning/ salt. Fry sauce was good, and they give you a good amount.  To add fries and a 21oz drink is $3.99, which seems a little high for frozen fries.  Not super impressed with the food.  Service was good, though. Yogurtz has better burgers and fresh homemade fries for less money, so I definitely don't understand the rave reviews here.

I don't understand why some of the people are reviewing this place so venomously. It's kinda sad actually, especially to waste your time complaining about the size of the bowl? Seriously, are you fat, lazy, or both? Get up, get some more food, try some thing new. I love this fresh healthy look on Mongolian and that I can mix and match and several trips. I like having several small bowls because there are so many sauces and meats and veggies to try. Loved the option to get it wrapped or with an egg! We will be returning for sure.
Very affordable and good food.  Plus they are vegan/vegetarian friendly.

I ordered the small plate seafood linguine and potato skins. The skins were good, but for $18.00 the seafood linguine was a total rip off. With the exception of a couple of shrimp, I needed a microscope to see any other seafood. I moved here from San Diego which is FAR more expensive than Meridian and I would have had ample seafood on the linguine in San Diego. There are 1,000 new people moving to Meridian alone each month. Fastest growing state in the U.S. With that will bring many new restaurants/businesses. Jakers needs to step up their game and not be so cheap or they will not survive the influx of new people and restaurants. It was shameful. The pieces of salmon which were few, were about a half of an inch square. This was delivery food. Won't be ordering again.

Great goat cheese / tomato chutney app. I had the Ruben, which was awesome. My wife had the fish tacos, she said they were a little dry and only ate one of the two.  
Overall nice atmosphere, we would eat there again.
I loved the burger here. I got a double western burger and it was so good! Fresh ingredients and super filing! One of the best burgers I've tasted! So glad we tried this out!
Great Customer service here. Love how the employees call out all the details. Seemed fair and honest. Plus you get $10 off for checking in on Yelp.

Had some time to kill while visiting and found this place.  Excellent selection, and a great place to relax and have a smoke.  Always nice to find a nice comfortable place that's clearly popular with the locals
Really friendly service and efficient. Nice clean location and open later on Sundays which I found to be a problem while visiting. Grear franchise location.

Jakers is probably one of my favorite places in town. The service is phenomenal. Our server, Skyla, was so friendly and attentive. The GM personally checked on us. And our food came out in a timely fashion even tho the place was PACKED! Seriously, if you haven't been there, you need to change that.

YUM!!! The food was absolutely delicious! We dined in and loved it. Our waiter was nice, the place was very quiet and pretty clean, but the best part was definitely the food. I would for sure go back! We ordered one large double deluxe pepperoni and one individual pizza with olives & Italian sausage, and also an order of cheese bread. I got an insane cheese pull with my personal pizza, I lifted the first piece as high as my arm would go and was STILL pulling cheese! It tasted super delicious too, and was a great price. The cheese bread comes with marinara sauce and was super yummy, it's garlic bread with melted cheese on top which was very good. We brought home the pepperoni pizza and have been having leftovers all week. I'd definitely recommend them for the food, and we will be going back soon!

Everything here was incredible. From the food to the service to the drinks! We came here as part of a company outing of about 6 people and were all taken care of throughout the night. Our server was polite and attentive without being too overwhelming which we appreciated. I've heard of kahootz from so many locals (as I am new to the area) and I am definitely happy I had dinner here and will certainly be returning with my husband next time.

High prices (they want to lock you into a packet and if you don't want to purchase it, then it's more expensive), less than average quality. We will have to find a better place. Too bad, because it's literally blocks from our house

One of the best Starbucks in the area. 

Pros:
Consistently good drinks.
Friendly, helpful staff.
Clean store.
Drive thru is partially shaded most of the day.
Starbucks Coffee Master (black apron) on staff.

Only partial con:
Weird parking lot at this complex. Watch out for Wendy's drive-thru exiting by Starbucks' drive-thru entrance.

Save yourself the disappointment. Over priced and disorganized.  The chefs cooked my mongo for what seemed like 10 minutes.  Roughly until it was completely dry and over cooked.  I took it back up and filled it with sauce and asked the guy to just quickly redo it since it was super dry.  They proceeded to cook it again until bone dry.  Bad food. Bad concept.

Absolutely rude nail tech here !!!
The young girl working here was so mean to my mom because she didn't want or need cuticle manicure with her polish change.

When I chose my polish she told me that it was light and I said that was fine, but she didn't say that it was completely transparent. When I asked for a new color that wasn't transparent she got all annoyed with me and said "I told you it was light".

When we asked if they take card she rudely told us that they "prefer cash", making us feel obligated to use cash even though it wasn't what was most convenient. 

The lady who actually did my nails was slow and messed up twice, had to redo two different nails two different times. 

There are plenty of nail salons in the area, so they really need to be more diligent on their customer service. Won't be coming back here.

Delicious and worth the money! I had a burger and tots and the hubby had cheese burger and fries. So good. Hubby thanked the staff and the replied "it was made with love!" We will be back and the cost was perfect under$20 for 2 burger fries and a drink.
The best food and the best service I love chili's food service and prices I have never been let down

Loved the atmosphere of this place.  Very, very cool and modern.  The host was a bit clueless & had no idea who was in front of who to be seated.  Our waiter, which was a young guy whom I cannot remember his name (although I wish I could because he was literally freaking awesome and deserves some recognition) was prompt, courteous, professional and perfect.  Our food was great!  My drink was very, very strong & I walked out pretty buzzed although I am not a frequent drinker.  

I docked one star due to the portion of my meal.  I ordered the street tacos, and while they were great, I don't feel that I received enough on each taco for the price.  They were pretty much one-biters with only a teaspoon of meat & cilantro/salsa.  My husband's meal was a good-sized portion, though.  

Nonetheless, we will be back to this location at The Village.

Went here on a date with my husband. We were excited to try something new out and had read decent reviews. Sadly it was not good. The sides were small and the steak had some odd glaze on it. The drinks were good but not enough to bring us back.

This place is always a win! Burgers are fresh and tasty... We have tried several and they are all excellent. Their fries and tots are good as well. The onion rings weren't as crispy as I like them, but they still had good flavor. No complaints. Workers are always friendly and helpful. Highly recommended!

This place is either way understaffed or poorly managed. Wether you food is good or not, your experience will be bad.  The waitress was rude when my friend asked for a drink, "said it will be coming" and walked off. Would not come back

I went to redeem my birthday month Pizza and was so pleasantly surprised! I got the art lovers and added extra sauce and olives and pepperoni with pesto on the bottom and dollops of red sauce on the top. It was truly to die for! I also love how they have some selections of Blue Sky sodas. I will definitely return in the future to enjoy this place! The staff was so friendly and welcoming as the sun was setting and I enjoyed a Monday night with great pizza and reading... It doesn't get any better than this!

Did not use:  tv wall mount mfg. instructions, stud finder ( knock, knock on drywall method), common sense.
Got the job done.  Left hand prints, finger prints and smears all over two tv's, one costing in excess of 2k.  No cleaning cloths, no knowledge of today's yv functionality.  Choose:  save a hundred bucks, clean up after them, re-locate the hdmi cables, touch up paint the scratches on the wall, live with the scratches on the tv, get really mad or spend the money on a well trained installation service like the G--k squad.  One star because they showed up.  I will contact them and update my review.  
  I figured out   these guys need structure, protocol....a standard to uphold.  The installers need a checklist insuring ALL work is done to a high standard throughout their customer base.  Proper equipment is a must:  cleaning supplies, fully charged power tools and how about reading those customer supplied instructions.  A dress code would be nice.  Two well groomed techs with matching t-shirts says "professional" louder than a couple of dudes in old jeans needing a shave.  As it stands I was sent one installer and his untrained helper.  Zero knowledge of today's 4K TV and calibrations.  Homework, training, image....then you earn your stars.

Love this place! The fact that you get to sit in your car is extremely convenient. As an added bonus they'll give you a newspaper and they offer drinks. The staff is SUPER friendly (and attractive ). I'll definitely be back and I'll recommend them to everyone in the area.
Love this place. Worked with my sensitive dog and charged a reasonable price.  Groomer was nationally certified.  My dog too loves it!
I've only been once and don't plan on going back anytime soon; due to location.  The sandwich I purchased was good and the service was very friendly.
great casual pub atmosphere with a fantastic tap selection of beers.  Food is excellent and I've never had a bad meal there.   Keep it up!

We have gone to the Hot Spot Cafe about five times now. The food is ok but it's close to our house so we always say why not go. Today is our last time. Our order was wrong, service was terrible and the restaurant was freezing. My husband and I both decided to just eat the wrong omelet. It was undercooked and gross. We won't ever go back. It's too bad because we were both excited to have another breakfast option.
The felafel pita is delicious, but vegetarians beware - the same tools that are used to cook meat are used to cook the felafel, gross!

I like the small booth options for two people, it gets you in faster. 

It's always loud but this last visit the music wasn't deafening which was refreshing!

My husband was a little miffed they didn't ask how he wanted his burger cooked, he likes it a little on the rare side and they did not ask.

The mashed potatoes and rolls are outstanding. The catfish was okay, not stunning, the dipping sauce was actually what made it good.

Parking can be a bit troublesome so I highly suggest getting their early or you're parking at the back of the lot. I don't mind walking but it fills up fast! 

Husbands tip: get the wings, they are his favorite.

Pssst.....Chili's fajitas suck in Boise too.

Gross chicken, napkin-like tortillas. And something that was supposed to be "beans and rice".

Our server was nice though.
Good food. .poor table service. .dirty tables.  No steak on noodles as ordered. .  No urgency to fix f up.

I had been to this restaurant many times in the past and thought that it was delicious. The last time sadly was not the case. We went for my birthday dinner a bunch of us gals...it seemed as though the waitress was annoyed she had to serve us. Drinks too a long time... orders incorrect... food was not what we expected, the sushi tasted as if the oil needed to be switched out (tempura. My seared tuna was great it was just the sushi that was not the best. Friend of mine had a chicken dish that Was not what Was expected or good  upon leaving the restroom was a complete disaster dirty and there were fish eggs on the door.. I had to exit sick.... needless to say not my best experience

Stopped by for the first half of the steelers game....Alexis C was our server....probably the nicest person we have ever met...she was attentive, and didn't Care that we were there for the entire game ..  Place is legit. Food was awesome ...you gotta stop by ..

UPDATED REVIEW: 
Ordered through their drive thru and got a club on a sub and it's supposed to have bacon AND cheese. It came with neither of those things. The sub was so sloppy once I got home, the bun on the bottom was so soggy it was hard to eat. If I ever want firehouse, I'll probably be eating in the restaurant rather than drive thru just to make sure they get it eight

Love firehouse subs! I've been going to firehouse since 2012 in Virginia and it's always been a fave! My ultimate favorite sandwich is the Beef and Cheddar Brisket!! It is the best. Not to mention they use the BEST mayo (DUKES!). My husband got the Firehouse Hero and it was seriously delicious. When I want a sub this is the place I go!

This place is top notch! The food was amazing, the service was excellent, and the ambiance welcoming. We will absolutely be back to try more items from the menu; making up our minds today took forever as there were so many things that looked delicious. We were a group of four,everyone was satisfied with their food, and none of us offered to share! Fabulous gem of a restaurant, we can't wait to go back.

If you need or want Chinese food in your life, then look no further. Wok Fusion is the best Chinese restaurant in the Treasure Valley. They are a little pricey, but overall, totally worth it! I don't think I have been place to eat. The staff is kind, friendly, and a joy to talk with. They are prompt with their services and show a genuine caring about the customers that visit their establishment. If you haven't been there, and you like Chinese food, you have one objective: GO!

My wife and I get: Chicken Chow Mein, General Tso's chicken, and egg rolls. Just in case you wanted a recommendation. You can't go wrong with these items.

99% of the time, I would say this place gets the food and service right. But this time, I have to say no and try to bring down this rating based on the way I was treated like I did something wrong by using your online app. Here's a hint madam manager: don't argue with your customer when they say that they didn't request anchovies on a cheese only pizza. 

"Ok, I guess we'll just have to throw it away then!"

REALLY?! You're gonna say that out loud and embarrass me?! 

The foods great but get some new staff....PLEASE!!!

While not exclusive to this location, Krispy Kreme knows how to do donuts. They are all fresh and delicious and I am yet to be let down.  Pro tip, getting an odd number of donuts can be more expensive then just getting a dozen of your selection. They have a lot of specialty flavors although I am still a big fan of the original glazed. They also offer coffee and drinks selections.

I have always had an exceptional experience...and I completely understand that getting stuck behind three cars in their drive-thru can be overwhelming for the staff (obviously an owner problem)...but when I have already placed my order and then waiting, I should at least get verification from the drive up window that my order is pending, which after about 3-5 minutes of being at the drive-up window I did not (which I witnessed the employee sweeping, which is a good thing, but not acknowledging me...I drove off). Sorry, I left you with 2 burger and 2 side orders.

Last night, Hannah took care of us, and I do mean "took care of us"!  No sooner than any of our beverages were half full, a new full one would be dropped off.

Been to a lot of restaurants in my time, but this is the first time that I was able to drink 5 glasses of diet coke during my meal.  Usually I'm stuck with 2, maybe 3 and then supplementing with a glass of water (that's refilled a couple of times).

Finally, someone got it that I enjoy drinking a cold beverage before, during and after my meal.  Thank you Hannah!  The five stars is a result of your sterling service, your great smile and your graciousness---even though the place was packed and everyone seemed slammed.  Excellent job y'all!
Excellent food and service.  Spicy Edamame and Nashville hot chicken are on point!   Their hot chicken is on par with hot chicken in TN. So good.

Dont Go On Sundays Theres The Cashier Omg So Rasict She told me to me to speak my english properly and Didnt want to sell me 5 detergents she said there was only a Limit of 4 and I asjed where does it say that she looked all over the paper and never found anything man I didnt say anything i just said well no thank you and left The other girl are nice but she was the worst!

We ate here yesterday 2 adults, 3 children for lunch. It was great. The service was really great, restaurant was clean and food was outstanding. The steak sandwich was delicious and the kids loved the cheesy noodles. They have plenty of beer on tap as well. We will come back any time we are in the area!
My husband I eat here or order take out at least twice a month. Everything we've ever tried has been delicious, and the service is fast and friendly.

This place is legit!!!
Jalisco cooking...
Cheese is the bomb and at least
Someone knows how to make tamales
Sushi was just fine. Don't get the Shumai starter, it was slimey and I am pretty sure has crab in it which was not listed.

This was my second time to Main Street.
The first time we waited for quite a long time in the drive thru lane. The reason for the wait was they cook to order and use fresh ingredients....good reason!!!
The second time we called our order in and was ready when we got there.
They use organic beef and the fresh ingredients.
The hamburger was excellent, fries, and onion rings also!  
We got a couple double cheeseburgers and some sides.
This place beats many fancy sit down gourmet type burger places.
It may cost a couple more dollars than your run of the mill drive thru places...but once again....it is worth it for the quality ingredients.
We will become regulars!!
Food was ok service was really poor, second time this has happened, waitress forgot one of our orders, and the food service was really slow.
The food is usually pretty good here.  We had dinner last night and the restaurant was FREEZING and we were not even close to the door!  Need to find a way to keep guests warm.

I always get great service in here except for one time when the girl working in the bar was too busy talking to her friends.. But the drinks are great and food quality is okay..4 star for customer care!
Love this place. Made from scratch food, fun atmosphere and affordable dining experience. The wait almost always sucks but if you call ahead it's a little easier.
Atmosphere is pub style, but family oriented.  Staff is friendly,  service is great and food is fantastic.  Little place with big menu. Love it, love it, love it!

Why even have an appointment. I have to take off work early and Not get Paid  because he won't see people after 4:30 know but yet again I am waiting till 4:45 the time that I wanted to have my appointment but wouldn't let me. I haven't even been seen yet. Waist of time and $$$
