The staff is friendly and the treatment is fast as long as you brush your teeth often. Has TVs so you're not bored. Also very decorative.
Extremely poor service today, one of my worst experiences. Wasn't offered a glass of water the entire time I was there and the servers was extremely rude.

We there two weeks ago to meet some very old friend . We had a wonderful dinner and the food and atmosphere was great . We went to the one on Main St in Meridian . They didn't even seem to mind that we where there for so many hours .

Went after church for the first time. Had lunch and everything was so good. I had the blta with fries. Hot crisp fries and crisp bacon on my sandwich. Husband had the turkey w/ mash potatoes and gravy and that was really good too. Will definitely be back

Me and my wife came here for dinner one Monday evening. This little unassuming restaurant is actually quite robust with a large selection of raw vegetables, meats and pastas ready for stir frying right before your eyes. You gather all of the ingredients yourself so there is no chance of a screw-up. Staff was friendly and courteous. Highly recommended...
It is good, especially for Asian people if you don't used to western food, very good chi ice.

Not a huge fan of chain restaurants but I must say, Yard House, Yay! Their food is good, the drinks are good, the service is good. Can't complain right? They can accommodate larger groups since their booths are huge, the environment is nice and it's right next to the theater. They can sit you quickly and the beer is good! For a chain restaurant which I am not a huge fan, I must say just like Yelp, Yay! I am a fan

These guys are great. Took my car in for oil change and had them check the breaks, thinking I needed new break pads. They called me an hour later to have me come pick up my car. Said the breaks were in great condition and the car itself is in good condition. I loved their honesty and their prices. Will definitely go again in the future.
Prawn scampi was excellent! The mile high mud pie was awesome!! A great place and we will be returning soon!!!

I was very impressed with the customer service at this location. I've always been a fan of Chicago Connection so I decided to call them when we were at Roaring Springs and needed dinner. I called this location and told them where I was and that I wanted the pizza delivered to my van in the parking lot. Not only did they bring the pizza right to my car they brought with them paper plates, plastic utensils and cups even though I never asked for those items. They just knew we would need those things and brought them. This is customer service. I was very impressed and the pizza was very good as usual.

Yummmmm.... Went there last night and I keep asking myself if it's too soon to go back. Noodles are delicious, sauce is so flavorful and the bread is soft and buttery. Price is very affordable so definitely somewhere to go when you're in a pinch, or even when you're not!! Delicious meal all around.

They just opened one of these in Oceanside where we live. We had been curious about it. We were visiting family in Boise and decided to check it out. All I have to say is yum!...lol we got there kind of early so we were able to take advantage of their early bird specials. My BF had the 6oz sirloin and I had the roadkill. They were cocked to perfection. We will be back to eat here again in our own home town.

I took my best friend here for her graduation present, had a wonderful experience but the next day her gel manicure was already chipping. We called in and went in the next day to get it fixed. Few days later mine began chipping well and so did hers, even the ones that were recently fixed. We called in again, expressing our unhappiness and the lady offered us a free gel manicure. At this point since we had already been in there to get it fixed we didn't want another one so we asked for a refund. The lady on the phone told us she would call back and she never did. So we called again and said we could come in for the refund. When we arrived and I went in, the lady, knowing who I was, barely acknowledged me and the when the guy handed me my money back was extremely rude to me. UM, we will not be going back or recommending this place.

A friend recommended this restaurant so we went to try it out. The food was good for the most part even though it was cold and we wait a long time to get our food. The service was slow and the gals that worked there seem like they have no waitress experience or customer service experience either. They never checked on us while we were waiting for our food. They brought our food and had no idea who's food was who's and when we would try to talk to them they would jst smile and walk away. Frankly it was the worst service ever. The food was ok but not worth the wait either. Prices are on the higher ended.
Awesome food and drinks Tom is a great server. I will be back and will dring my friends and family.

I have eaten here many times since they opened and have tried different dishes.  All were good. This is the BEST Mexican restaurant around. Plus they sell their salsa as well.  I recommend this place to everyone.

Horrible!!!!! First time Katie forgot to put us on the schedule so they were a no show. I called to see what time they were coming said she hadn't put us on the schedule so offered a discount and rescheduled for a 3:30 appt. On a Friday.  6pm and still noone showed up !! So Unprofessional don't waist your time !

This is by far the best sushi restuarant in the Boise Area. I live in the North East end of Boise and make the trip out to Sakana on a regular basis (at least a few times a month). 

They have an amazing lunch special, similar to what you may find at sushi restaurants in larger cities...2 roll combos, sushi/sashimi combos and bento boxes. The prices are great and the fish is the best quality in town.

As for the full menu, they have a large selection on specialty rolls which are not deep fried. The deep fried sushi roll is something I despise and generally lose respect for a sushi joint when the majority of their offereing are of the deep fried variety.  One of my favorite offerings on the menu is the Brooklyn Bridge. It's a sushi boat for 2 which includes sushi, sashimi, your choice of specialty roll and a soup or salad. It's a great deal and again, the fish is the best I've had in town. 

In addition to the high quality sushi, everytime I visit Sakana, the staff are extremely polite and attentive. It is one of the few places I've visited in Boise and had superb service on a consistent. Everything about Sakana is 5 stars for me.

We feel like we walked into Mexico! 

Colorful. Fresh. Friendly staff. 
Fresh authentic Mexican dishes. 
Live music. 
Nice selection of beer and fresh Marquitas!

Our new favorite Mexican restaurant in the area! 

You need to at least visit!
Took my daughter her for her birthday dinner. The seared tuna was fantastic and the service was great.

Great spot! Awesome beer and wine list with lots of local options. The food is great and the weekly Ribeye and Prime Rib specials are a bonus. The service has been spot on and I love to watch the communication between the kitchen and the wait staff. It's a well run place! We'll make this a regular stop!

Absolutely the best steaks ever! We are frequent flyers at the Texas Roadhouse and my main reason for going is to get a great steak. No, of course, they are not The Taste of Texas or a Ruth's Chris Steakhouse but they come very close. For the price, the food is always excellent and the staff is on the ball. They have hospitality figured out!

I'm surprised the reviews aren't better, we really enjoyed this place. Service was good, atmosphere is normal sports bar and food was tasty! 

I got some special Japanese pork burger with candied bacon that was really good, it came with some pretty basic fries though. My husband got the Nashville hot chicken, that was so delicious! It comes with a hot honey that I wanted to put on everything including my fries, the chicken and the sweet potato pancakes. That whole plate was delicious. My aunt got the enchilada stack and my uncle got the Southern Fried Chicken plate, they both really liked it and it looked good.

Overall it was really good, my husband definitely got the best food out of all of us, and I think a huge problem is that their menu is so extensive. Can you really have 100 delicious items on your menu? Probably not. But overall it was good and I would go again

I have had dinner at Kahootz about eight times in the last year and find it to be a very good locally owned restaurant.  The food is simple but good.  The owner is always there and I hope that he makes money as he seems to work very hard at ensuring that the food is good.  They have an excellent beer selection and I find this place to be a nice neighborhood pub.

I would give this place a 100% night after night. With over 100 beers on draft (quite tasteful beers, I might add!) and food cooked to perfection, I am terribly impressed! The staff is incredibly professional, friendly, and had spot on suggestions. Don't miss out on an awesome night! Not packed on a Friday night. They'll have you covered and leave you feeling quite pleased with the whole experience!

Fast and friendly service!  I usually dread going to the mechanic due to the lack of friendliness and the speed of service. I was in and out of Einstein's within 20 minutes on a Saturday. At prior mechanics, a Saturday oil change would take two hours or more out of my morning. It was also awesome to be in the car the whole time, and get to watch the work performed underneath via TV. I'll definitely be visiting again!

We didn't have to wait long at all for our pizza....they mean it when they say it is fast fired pizza!! It was pretty good pizza (sauce tasted fresh, perfect amount of cheese) but we didn't love the crust. If you plan on having a salad, they are pre-made in a cooler which was disappointing.

Good food. However, after being seated we sat for about 15 minutes waiting for a server. However the server that ended up helping us to cover for the lazy one was very nice and quick. She is why this has 3 stars.

I think the Matador is one of my favorite things about Idaho since I moved here. Their braised carnitas entree are to die for and I'm not a big meat eater usually, but I get them every time. Pretty every time now toomy fiance orders their carne asada nachos I wind up having to steal a few of his because they are just so good, plus the serving is huge!

If I could any food everyday for the rest of my life it would be their goat cheese stuffed jalapenos wrapped in bacon dipped in ranch mmm. Also i love their fresh sheet and that items change seasonally and so many of the seasonal drinks and entrees have been some of my other favorites too. And also have to say best salsa I've ever had.

Seriously if the Matador had a cookbook there would be no limit to how much money I would pay to have their recipes in my hands. I don't think I've gone to dinner with anyone there who did not love it. They really have something for everyone kids, picky eaters, gluten free, vegan, vegetarian, foodie, etc.

It can be busy getting in, but I'm not complaining because they are worth every minute and will send your phone a text when your table is ready so depending how much time you have you can walk around and look at stores while you wait for your table, which I always enjoy.

It's probably a sign of have problem, but we've had a few staff member recognize us we go in so much I guess. The staff and service is always amazing though and I think it's a good sign they are able to acknowledge customers in that sense because I know how busy they must get and how many faces they must see each day.

I LOVE this place!  The front desk staff is incredibly friendly, always greeting me with a smile and offering drinks.  The hair service is THE best around.  The quality of the color, cut and product is unbeatable.   Go see them!

We've never had a bad experience at this Chilis but I also don't expect total perfection from Chilis, within reason of course.

We have been to this location a handful of times in the last year or so and it's pretty solid every time. The servers are friendly, the food comes out appropriately and looks/is tasty.

We've had app plates forgotten or a sauce forgotten but no major infractions of any sort.

This location is in our area and one of the better ones in the area according to us so we will continue to return when the Chilis craving hits.

Stopped in for a quick lunch. They had their buffet up and running, but decided against it.  Was just looking for something light.  Really nothing light on the menu, at least light in Senior citizen terms.  Ended up having the finger steak and my wife had a salad.  Both were okay, but not what we were looking for.  Can't  fault them, rating comes from our needs not their service.  Did have their Bloody Mary bar - neat idea!
Holy YUM! Best burger I've had in ages! You have to try this place! The staff is friendly and food is quick! Big Judds has nothing on these guys. The tater tots are great too! Keep up the good work!

My dinner at Chili's was perhaps the worst dining experience ever. We ordered 2 dinner salads, they came out 10 minutes apart. One entree (chili) was delivered 25 minutes before the second entree. We had to grab our Utensils from the service station. Finally caught up with a waiter because the chili arrived without a spoon.  The waiter said the kitchen was "slammed" but there were many empty tables in the restaurant.  One of the salad's arrived with the wrong dressing, but gave up and ate it anyway. The atmosphere was chaotic. Never again.

I went in to order take out. I was in a hurry. The person I gave my order to mumbled really bad. Additionally, she spoke exceedingly fast. I couldn't understand her hardly at all. That combined with being told I could have my wings to go in 15 minutes or less, and they took over 25 minutes makes me not want to come here again. I was at bww because I love the the wings especially the rubbed original. Maybe I'll forget this lousy experience and go back but with so many places to get wings this will be low on the list.

My family and I were extremely pleased with the customer support we received from this Verizon store during our experience. Allen, Salvador, and Derrick were tremendous help and they were even more patient through our complex situation we were through. Great store with great leadership. Highly recommend for anyone's Verizon needs.

Good service and good food. 

No reservations. They get crowded but have an outside area.

If you are handicapped or vertically challenged and unable to hop up on high seats then you are limited to where you can sit. They have booths but i have trouble with them because its a step up.  Think there are only two tables in the whole place that work for me

I was so excited to try a new breakfast place. Service was good, very attentive, but it's all about the food for me. Super small portions served on cheap plastic small plates. I am always mostly excited to try the hollandaise sauce (see pic). It was separated and flavorless. The omelette was super dry with ingredients on top instead of inside, shredded hash browns were good, but super small portion. One piece of toast. Overall disappointed and won't be back.

Stopped in for lunch. Just got here from the Oregon coast (my husband and I are travel nurses) and the ahi was super fresh. Everything tasted awesome and the staff was super friendly. We live close to here and will definitely be back!

The hibachi wasn't as good as I was hoping, especially for the price. Their weekday lunch prices would make it worth it. Aside of hibachi, their food portions are excellent, taste is average. Service was slightly subpar, I asked for plain noodles with nothing in them and they were loaded with vegetables; I also asked for soft tofu, not fried, and got fried tofu. On the other hand, some of my friends ordered sushi and it looked great; lots of fresh looking fish-not skimpy at all.

Very disappointed that they charged my credit card for the tip when we left cash. This is fraud. My wife and I split a great sushi assortment dish and paid $14.31. We left $2 (14%) cash tip. The service was fast, but the guy really didn't seem like he liked us being there (even when we walked in, he was not friendly at all). Then I get an email from Capital One that our tip amount was a little high being 50%. $7.00! We paid the tip cash so that should have been $0.00 for tip! We did not put in anything on the line, but a lot of people don't. Capital One is fixing the situation, because Sakana would not fix it over the phone, and it is a drive to get there. $7.00 is not much and maybe we're a bit cheap for 2 people, but it was fraudulent and I do not think this was just a mistake.

Menu has large pictures on avacados on burgers and salads. Wife and I order a salad that listed avacados on it. It's only after we get the food they inform us that "there is a strike in Mexico and now avacados are not available." Offering to get me a different meal. I came there to eat with my family not wait while my food was redone or to get a new meal. They should not have the avacado options on their menu if not available

Good quality food with nice portions. The hospitality will keep me coming back as will the food. 

I had the medium rare prime rib...it was medium rare!  Adding sautéed mushrooms means that there will be half a pound of mushrooms on top of your steak. 

If you get Carly, you will be taken care of...but chances are great service no matter who you get.

Blue Cheese dressing for the salad is served in packets!, packets! Server said they are looking for a vendor since they opened for business.  They've been open for 7 months!! according to her. Our server was very non existent.  Coming from the food industry, a customers glass should never be empty, especially for an extended amount of time.  Would not return.

The place looks good. The food, however, not so much. I ordered the three fish tacos and they were pretty much flavorless. I was only able to taste the tortilla and the veggies. My plate had side servings of rice and beans, a staple of Mexican restaurants everywhere. It's not to difficult to mess these up, but this place manages to excel at it. The beans taste like the bean dip out of those little Frito Lay cans. The rice, in my opinion, tastes like instant rice that comes in a box you buy at grocery stores... the generic brand, not the good stuff. I won't be returning for the food at this place.
I went there right after they opened. Food was excellent. Went back some time later and it was just Chinese food, nothing special. :(
The food is always okay but the service this last visit was just completely unprofessional and horrible. Will not be returning to this establishment.

WOW! Small town, small bar, small restaurant but BIG on taste! We waited about 20 minutes which was reasonable for a Saturday night. The server was prompt and attentive throughout our meal. Dinner for 4 = Scampi, my husband (who is picky about his seafood) loved it. Best ever. Daughter had the sirloin, it was cooked perfectly, was as tender as that cut can be. Steak sandwich, delicious, nice presentation. I had the pork chop which was moist (!), and delicious. The gravy/sauce was a little strong but very flavorful. Great beer selection too. If you're claustrophobic, this might not be the place for you because it is tight. But service and food quality were outstanding. Plus it's not a chain.
I love the vampire tacos.  It's sometimes a bit crowded on evenings, so make sure you time it just right.  Tons of different beers to try if that your thing!

I'm an out of towner, visiting ID for the second time.  Friends knows I'm a picky eater and like variations so they recommended this place....Love the pizza here and many different kind of dishes this place offers.  Good food, friendly and fast service as well !
Our server had attitude all night, they forgot over half our order and then the server continued to be rude and tell my girlfriend she didn't need any shitty attitude. Her name is Chelsea

I have driven by this place so many times and finally had the opportunity to have dinner here.  As we pulled up there were only a couple parking spots left and the outdoor seating was busy.  We decided to eat inside and told to seat ourselves.  There was an assortment of booths and high tables with high chairs and one normal height table and chairs.  We choose a comfy booth and we were greeted by a friendly waitress within a matter of seconds to take our drink order.  We ordered the wings for an appetizer and my wife ordered the Reuben and I ordered the steak salad.

The wings came out first and they were huge!  I have been so used to getting small wings at other places, I forgot how big full grown chicken wings are.  They had a terrific sauce on them which was not to spicy and very flavorful.  If I were to  order them again, I would ask them to be cooked more (I believe they are baked wings) as I enjoy wings with crispy skin verses "elasticky" fat, you know what I mean if you like wings.  They were really good.  I took a couple home and baked them in the oven and they were really good.

My salad was a salad and I asked for a side of ranch verses the raspberry vinaigrette it comes with.  It was nice having pieces of steak on my salad.

My wife ordered the Reuben.  I have never ordered a Reuben so I didn't know what to compare it to so when I took a bite, I thought it was good but my wife thought it was average.

We both decided we want to come back and try other menu items.  I really wanted to try their steak and if I would have known that on Monday and Tuesdays they have a Rib Eye steak for $13.50, I would have ordered that instead of my salad since I was there on a Monday night.  Their special board also mentioned that they have prime rib on Friday and Saturday.  All in all, I really like the small bar/restaurant feel of Kahootz and we plan on coming back real soon and trying other items that looked terrific on the menu.  Until next time.
The place to go to satisfy a steak craving. It can get really busy on the weekends. Go during the week to beat the crowd, if you can make it in.

The food may be fine, but I have never been treated this badly.  A good friend gave us a $50 gift card here.  We used it recently for my birthday - only to be told that it only had $7 remaining on it.  After verification from my friend that she immediately gave me the card, and knowing that the gift card has NOT been used, they steadfastly refused to acknowledge that the fault might possible be theirs.  So take your $43  that you ripped off Sakana's.  We will not be coming back and will take every opportunity to let others know not to frequent your establishment.

Have done business with the shop in Meridian a few times. VERY honest people, clean shop, even enjoyed the experiences. Quoted price for repairs on husbands vehicle - it came back at half of what the originally quote... HOW often does that happen?? They could have cheated us easily ... instead they were honest and the building of a relationship was more important to them.

We will continue to take our business to them. Could not be more impressed with their business practices and ethics.

Unsuspecting diners walking into Texas Roadhouse might think they've entered a barbecue joint. That's the image that comes to me when I hear that name.

Although the roadhouse has a small selection of ribs and pulled pork, this is mostly a steakhouse with chicken and even catfish.

You'd think the roadhouse might be a buffet restaurant with all the free rolls and buckets of peanuts. Instead, it means they hand out a lot of styrofoam (can't you join the 21st century and offer a more environmentally friendly container? They're out there) to-go shells for people to take leftovers home. 

I typically choose the ribeye steak: lots of flavor and a little bit of fat on the side. There's three sizes, 10 to 16 ounces. Choose the small after reading the paragraph above about leftovers.

Everyone knows that chile with an "e" doesn't have stinking beans in in and the roadhouse understands that. Otherwise, it isn't chile. It's one of the better restaurant chiles I've found. 

Service is always friendly and efficient.
One of the best in Meridian- great food and even better service. Price is reasonable and great atmosphere for an excellent night out

We've only been once, just after it opened, and it was very busy.  The food was good and the service was nice.  We will visit a few more times and see what we think.  We'll wait until it is open a bit longer to see if we can find some slower times to visit, or make reservations.

We've been a few more times and the host station is very unfriendly and usually ignores us for long periods of time.  Maybe it is because we have kids.  All I know is you should acknowledge your customer.

I've been to many places like this one partially decent food but large beer selection. There is lots of space for people to sit and stand when it is busy it takes a long time to get your food it seems like there's not enough waitstaff causing them to rushing through your meals by asking if you want anything else every 5 minutes.

These guys are great. Josh was a really nice guy, easy to work with, and got the job done - regardless of it being a bigger job than they originally thought. Super efficient, reasonable price, came out within a couple days notice. Dont bother calling anyone else - seriously. I will be calling them for everything tree related going forward.

Love how this location caters to children with lollipops aka Dumdums, stickers, bubbles, cartoons, play area in the waiting room, super cool visual plasma fish tank, etc. The staff has always been kind to my son and me on each and every visit, and since he first started pre K 4 the very 1st time, it has been quite often, esp in March and April, so thank you. Thank you so much 4 making it easier 4 a prego mama to deal with a sick toddler. Much appreciated!

This is kind of like your Chik-Fil-A of the oil changing world. They are very upbeat and friendly (maybe a little overly so as it comes off a bit forced but it is certainly better than the alternative) and they have a couple of nice additives like your daily paper is handed to you, they offer you a drink, etc. They are fairly quick and cover all bases. They do try to sell you a of bunch of different things while you wait but are fairly gracious if you decline.

Prices are comparable to most other places that are similar.


8/18 - Updating my review a little. This same day, maybe 3 hours later, I found out my exhaust pipe completely broke in half because it was rusted through. On my paperwork it notes that they did a chassis inspection and that seems like something that would stand out. I clearly don't fault them in any way but I do take into consideration that things maybe aren't done are thoroughly here as hoped or as should be. 

The overall service and experience was good but this does concern me a bit.
Highly recommend! Had the spring roll and Cashew chicken plates. It is a very friendly family run business, great service but extremely quiet- just take an entertaining companion!
Super fast pizza made on the spot , and also the best tasting . Love the thin crust style and they have plenty of ingredients to choose from . Great prices too !!

Went for the 4-6 pm happy hour. Drinks are half price and smaller (six inch) pizzas are available at a reduced price. This is a great way to try different types of pizza. 
Staff is friendly and helpful. The manager came by our table to check on our satisfaction with the food.

I understand it is Valentine's Day weekend, but I called and was told by staff at the restaurant I could call ahead, while on the way, to be placed on the waiting list, and then when we arrived to go to front desk and get a pager device so they could notify when name came up. Arrived at restaurant and gentleman at front desk said we would have to be placed at bottom of list saying it was past the 15 minute time allowed. We were not notified of this and it took well over 15 minutes to drive through rush hour traffic and finding a parking spot. Basically, you have to call right as you pull into a parking spot to make their 15 minute limit to be placed on waiting list. So, long story short my wife and I would've had to wait another hour and a half for a table, thus missing our movie that we already purchased tickets for. Ridiculous customer service and had to find another place to eat at the last minute. Please notify customers of your waiting list policy before they get screwed when arrive at the front desk at your restaurant. Thanks for ruining a nice time out with my wife for an early Valentine's Day outing. I'll make sure to inform many other people , friends, family, and co-workers of your shoddy service.

Been there a few times and food was good today only two tables with customers and they got both orders wrong. The fires were so salty I could not eat them. Also we waited for 1/2 hour for our food and the order incorrect. Won't go back.

This was our 5th visit within a year.  I can't speak loud enough about the quality of the sauces and the care of the plated dishes (bistecca pappardelle, for example) that are coming out of that kitchen.  The wine list is a step up from sufficient, the bar is ample, haven't even tried the pizza, and yes, it's in a strip mall, but you can watch the sun go down while you drink signature cocktails and wait with anticipation for your peroni clams to arrive - which by the way, are the bomb.

Service is always on key - hard to find these days.  They dimmed the piped rock when we asked them to, and I'm hoping they replace those sportsbar screens that NO ONE was watching (due to the great food) with loops of the Godfather or Big Night food scenes.  Well done, little Flatbread in Eagle.  Well done.
I've been here several times and James (Chef/Owner) continues to create the "Wow Factor".  A definite place to go....great staff Amanda and everyone else are Great and friendly.
Quality food & reasonable prices.  Bleu chop salad w/entree is fantastic if you love bleu cheese
Great spot for a steak or ?  They care about your whole experience for small town fair.  Good food with chef touch!  Meridian favorite before the sprint car races........ Good times!

This location was clean and the staff very friendly.  My wife and i tried this place for the first and last time. The food looks great but lacks any flavor. With so many options for pizza, i won't eat here again.

Marshalls is great and having one closer to home, even better! Or possibly not because I'm there more often!

This location is fairly new and has good options.  I've noticed the shoe collection changes fairly frequently.  I go in for kid shoes and usually find what I'm looking for, if not, the next week, I will.

Marshalls is already discounted so their sale items are even better!  It's in a great shopping center that is part of The Village at Meridian but not in the mall so you can easily miss the crowds!
Amazing!!!!!  That's all I need to say. Great selection of toppings. Great taste. Super awesome staff!!

You cannot just order a pizza, you wait in line with your pizza and they will ask you how it is at every ingredient. Great idea for some maybe. Even asking them to just make it according to their specs, they won't. They will ask after each ingredient. I found this to be annoying.
The product is adequate as a pizza. It's busy, so they have a following, but I won't be one of them .

Michelle Somers is amazing! She's very nice and wants to make a connection with her clients. 

I haven't had much interaction with any of the other stylists that have stations here. The salon is always clean and has a great atmosphere. 

I wish there was a reception type area. It would make it feel a little less awkward when you walk in, than just walking in a seeing a bunch of stations not knowing where to go.

Decent food for the price, room for improvement. It is Smashburger™ meets Subway ™ as far as the layout and order process. There are signature pizzas and build your own but basically it's all custom made to your taste. We had four people and four different orders. They have a good variety of toppings to choose from. I had a white top pizza which is white sauce and garlic, bacon, and some other things. They put arugula on top after. I added some chicken and Italian sausage. Another person had spicy sauce and some meat, another had regular sauce and some meats. 
Mine didn't have a lot of flavor but the spicy sauce was spicy and the regular red sauce just tasted like tomatoes.  The sausage was the most flavorful thing on the pizza.

The Matador is probably my favorite Mexican restaurant in Boise. The service at this location is great-- I think my family has made friends with all of the waitresses and bartenders at this point (we've been visiting regularly for years now). Wait times are usually reasonable-- we've been quoted waits up to 1.5 hours on a Saturday night, but I don't think we've ever waited longer than 45 minutes.

The food and drinks are awesome. The Brussels sprouts is hands down the best app on the menu. A few months ago they added a new dinner to the menu-- cornmeal crusted mahi-mahi, which comes with the Brussels sprouts on the side. It was fantastic, and I'd recommend it to everyone!
Really really enjoyed my meal. Best Mac and cheese I've had in a long time. Loved the option of the cute side salad.
LOVE Jarvis Dental and Dr. Crowley!  The staff are amazing My entire family goes to there and are extremely happy.  If you're looking for a great dentist, look no further Jarvis Dental is the best.
YES, this is gross and  it's unsanitary restaurant.  The sushi chef, who exits the bathroom and doesn't wash his hands. I was so disgusted I decided to never come back again to this place...!
Absolutely the best Mexican food! So grateful they opened up in meridian. We hit the McCall location as often as were there. This was fresh crunchy tacos, not soggy, great service and HOT food!

We love Pueblo Lindo. So happy they opened a place in the Boise area as we've visited them for years in McCall. Great food. Authentic. Good vegetarian options (including rice and beans). Super friendly staff

Best Chinese around. Great tasting food hands down. The owners are so friendly and accommodating. I always just get takeout but food is prompt and fresh. A little pricey but the taste makes up for it.

I am incredibly underwhelmed by this place. 

After waiting an entire year to try it because I was always headed somewhere else when we passed, I finally went in tonight. I should have just kept the dream alive and gone home. The atmosphere was loud - not *quite* annoyingly so, but getting there. Since it was Saturday night and I'd spent a portion of the evening watching a Pixar movie I didn't really want to see I realize I maybe wasn't in the best of moods. I was greeted by an unenthusiastic hostess who seated us fairly quickly. She put our menus on the table unceremoniously and didn't even do the usual "so and so is your waiter tonight and he'll be here in a minute." 

Speaking of so and so, his name was Andrew. He was singularly uninteresting. He showed nothing beyond rote "interest" - meaning no idle banter, no building rapport with his diners, barely even a smile. As a result he got kind of a crappy tip (sorry, dude, you aren't entitled). He didn't bus our table at all after our chips and salsa which wouldn't normally be a problem except we were at a 2-seater booth and had 2 plates of food coming. 

My daughter ordered nachos from the kid's menu. It came as promised, with black beans, cheese, sour cream and guac. However, our buddy Andrew failed to mention THE PLATE WAS HOT. My kid is FIVE. My daughter went to reach for it but I stopped her because 1) I noticed Andrew had been using a freaking potholder to handle it and 2) It was double-plated which typically means hot. Even still, some people aren't really observers and a child could have been burned on those plates. That's really annoying, and my biggest gripe of the night. Not the lackluster customer service or the mediocre food - the SAFETY ISSUE of presenting a child with an item from the child's menu and NOT MENTIONING it's hot. Now, my kid is pretty smart (I'm not biased, honest) and would have immediately figured out it was piping but seriously, why should she have to burn herself to know? 

I ordered chicken enchiladas rojas and it was ok. The food was nothing to write home about. It did it's job - gave me energy and made me no-longer-hungry. That's pretty much the extent of the good things I can say about it. 

I had to ask for the check because aforementioned waiter seemed to be interested in sweeping miniscule chip crumbs off the floor with a broom and dustpan. It was a dustpan on a stick but nonetheless, he seemed pretty intent on his mission. Perhaps the other option was cleaning the bathroom so he was prolonging that as long as he could. I don't know. All I know is he didn't bus, he barely smiled, he didn't check on us, and I had to ask for the check. Lame tip for you, bud. 

As we left, the hostess watched us idly. No "thank you for coming in" or "have a good night!" Sorry to inconvenience you by patronizing your establishment, hostess. 

Overall, this place is a Monet painting. It's gorgeous from afar but when you get a close-up it's a big ol' mess. Based on food quality and customer service, this place is overpriced and/or understaffed. I briefly considered writing a letter to their corporate office and realized it wouldn't matter because I'd probably be offered food vouchers or a gift card or something and I certainly don't want to go back. Although, now that I think about it that would make a good Christmas gift. Ho, ho, ho! I give you the gift of mediocrity. 

I really, really try hard not to leave yucky ratings. One star because the hostess's boots were cute, one because their soda was good. These are the two things that saved them from a zero-star review.

The dining experience was every thing you could want for a special night out.  We ordered the 2 for $25.00 meal deal  appetizer, two entre's, plus dessert to share.  Food came cooked as ordered and the cheese cake was just the perfect touch to cap the dinner. I know your experience will be just as good!

Great pizza most of the time! Service, well it's kind of like they have bunch of puppies working there- super sweet but don't know what they're doing most of the time  hot mess. Especially if you're there during a rush hour. But good thing the food tastes good! I would definitely do some more training on organization/uniform washing, whatever

I love Sakana!  It has great sushi and wonderful ambience!  The service is wonderful, and their soup and salad is good too.  My favorite roll is the Godzilla, which is eel and avocado.  They are kinda pricey, but it's worth it!

Came in and there was a 45 minute wait which was expected. We left and received a text to say our table was ready which was much quicker than expected! We arrived and told her we had a table of six for Greg. She told us she had a table of three for Craig. I showed her my text message and she got very sassy and told me to calm down and that she would seat us, even though I was very calm and tried to explain to her where the miscommunication may had been. This truly started the evening off poorly.

Following this experience it was very very good. The waitress was an absolute rockstar and the food was out of this world. Highly recommend this restaurant but try to avoid the hostess at all costs because she is a complete bitch.

A great dining experience, you won't be disappointed!

My wife and I were at Jaker's just a few days ago and I must say, it was probably one of the better dinners we've ever had in the Boise area!  Our server's name was Matt, and he did a great job in being very attentive to our needs all evening.  And he made sure that our drinks were filled and that we had plenty of delicious scones with honey butter!

I ordered the finger steaks, and they were very tender, juicy with a tasty coating.  Quite possibly the best I've ever had in this area!  And Jaker's uses a unique process to cook their French fries as they don't taste starchy. And the lobster bisque soup was just out of this world!  And my wife said that her broiled trout was excellent and fresh.  And she said that her dinner salad was very good as well.  Next time we go we'll have to try one of their desserts as there are quite a few to chose from.  

Years ago I did know the owner of Jaker's, Jake Jones, when he lived in Pocatello and ran the old Jake's restaurants.  And I must say, he definitely knows his stuff when it comes to running a fine dining establishment as he's been at it for quite some time.  And the price for meals here are very reasonable!

Dad & I tried this Noodles location for the first time.   (I would have tried it a few months ago, but when hubby & I attempted to eat here about ten to ten, the doors were locked.)

Dad tried the Pasta Fresca with Shrimp.   This was after I asked if the Japanese Pan Noodles could be made without the "spicy" part, and they said no.   He really liked his dish, and I liked it, too.

I had my usual, the Pesto Cavatappi with pulled pork.  It tasted great and was just the right temperature.   The only trouble I encountered with it was three big pieces of the pulled pork were just fat.   I'm glad I was watching as I ate.

We went later than the usual lunch crowd, so the restaurant was pretty empty.   Service was friendly, especially the young man who brought our food to the table.   

I wish I could do 3-1/2 stars, but I'll give them the benefit of the doubt.   Speaking of wishes, I wish the menu listed all the veggies that can be added to a dish just as the proteins are listed.

Absolutely amazing!! The wedding "pig" (whole smoked pig) was delicious and staff went above and beyond.  Hundreds commented on how wonderful the pig was.  We will be using Meridian Meat & Sausage for many future events, without a doubt!
Great food great service I have such a great time every time I go their chicken and waffles are  misty is awsome

I was hesitant to try this place as it was first described to me as being "a Subway of pizza places". It's like Subway only during the preparation they slide the dough down the counter and add toppings as you request that's where the comparison ends. The sauce is flavorful with a little bit of a bite the toppings are fresh and the cooking process is quick and leaves the crust crispy with a little bit of a char. To top it all off they have S'MORES! Go in the first Tuesday of the month and you can buy one and get one free.

I've have been to Yard House several times and it does not live up to the hype.
Not terrible...but not great.   They are expensive and the value is just not there for a town like Meridian.   However, it is nice to have an additional dinning choice at the Village in Meridian.
Pretty good for the price and very good customer service along with very speedy made pizza.

I still love the wing sauce choices but every single time we go there something is more expensive. No more Tuesday tradition wing night? That's a bummer. Guess we will just buy the sauce and make our own at home.
You really can't go wrong going here for a hotdog. Bring cash or there is an ATM in the parking lot. Support a local vetran and the dogs are delicious.

This place has been hit or miss for me. I've been here several times and the food is usually very good but I leave here hungry every time due to small portions. I have only been here for lunch so this review is based on some lunch items I've had. I had the finger steaks and there were only 4 pieces. What? Tried the salmon wrap and it was 95% lettuce, no salmon.  Had the philly dips and it was very good but once again, small. The crispy chicken sandwich is good in size and taste. I'd have that again. The service is good but they can get overwhelmed and forgetful when it's full. I will have to try the breakfast menu and see what's going on there. I really hope this place succeeds. It has a lot of potential if some small changes are made.

Just got off the phone with Harold, he was more than helpful, trying to find a certain item, he checked his store and the one in Nampa and Boise and all of them are out, but said for me to check back in a few weeks.  Appreciated him taking the time with me.

The modern meets artistic decor, music choice and all around vibe was top notch!! Food was next level with flavor and plating. If that didn't sell you on the place, the staff were both knowledgeable and kind! 
All around, would definitely highly recommend.

Service was fair. Typical Tuesday night. We waited a long time for the beer and martini. It was not busy, yet our server seemed rushed, although she was perfectly polite and smiled. Beer was served warm and the food was ok.  Too much competition to come back any time soon.
Place is good. Pad thai is great

I have gone to this location quite often whether it is take out or dine in. I ordered a lunch take out and drove a 10 minute to pick it up and 10 minutes to take it back to work. I called and let them know the forgot my California roll and they pretty much called me a liar and they packed it. So what did they offer to make it right for the time I would waste to go pick it up and wasted fuel? The California roll they never packed and that was it. To make it even better the manager refused to get on the phone. Won't be going back here.
The "manager" kicked us out and told us to never come back because we didn't think our steaks were cooked properly.

This place was scary. while hubby stood in line to order, I went to the restroom. The door lock was broken and replaced with a small 'Mickey mouse' aluminum slide lock. Ok. Not a big deal. 
Used the toilet - no toilet paper in the large dispenser. Found it later sitting on the toilet tank. 
Went to wash my hands NO SOAP
NONE. HOW DO THE EMPLOYEES WASH THEIR HANDS?
Washed with just water went to use the towel dispenser- no towels! DONE. I AM OUT OF HERE!
Walked back to the waiting area and the floor boards had large gaps between each one. 
My logic is if the bathroom is a disaster so is the food. I didn't wait to see. We went next door to eat. I feel like I dodged a bullet here.

I had a fantastic experience at Inspired Living. I had multiple projects I needed help with on a new home in Arizona. I worked with Tammy and she was AMAZING! She was so patient with me (bless her...not an easy task!) and her ideas and guidance through the projects were knowledgeable and considerate of my budget! The store is gorgeous and I felt compelled to look around every time I was there! Janet (owner) has really done a wonderful job with this establishment and the designers she has working with her!

I was really happy when I first found this place. The first time they cut both of my dogs' hair I was very pleased with the results. But the last couple of times, their work has gotten so sloppy. The cuts have been uneven, and the way the normally cut their hair (which is suited to my preferences) doesn't happen anymore. It's so sad to me because I was excited to find a shop that only costs $35 to get bath, grooming, nails, etc. I wish they were consistent. I've had two good experiences and two bad experiences... Another annoying thing was that I had referred a couple of people to them and they have a referral discount, but took them three visits before they applied the discount to my account. They also used to call the next day to check on how they did, but that sadly has also stopped.   It's a shame because they seem to really treat the dogs well while there. They always would tell me how one of my dogs kissed them the whole time while getting groomed.  Unfortunately, I can't really recommend them.  The price is right, but I need more consistency.

These guys were fantastic. They called to let me know when they were on their way and did an incredible job. Professional, friendly, hard-working. I had a couch that had some difficulty getting through the door of my new apartment and they remained patient and took their time so they didn't damage my couch or the door frame. They also had the best prices i found in the valley. Next time i move i'm definitely calling Big Boy!
Pretty shitty that this is the only location in the entire state of Idaho and it's closed.... Way to run a fucking business....
Very good food! Hot and sour soup was awesome. Big portions on my scallop and shrimp entree. It was spicy, just like they said!
We were told this location has new owners, and even if the hot sign is on, it no longer means free original glazed donuts. So that happened. How greedy.

These guys are amazing! Charles,the owner is involved. They offered different options and gave advice. The end product (a double vanity for my bathroom) was flawless. They were very fast, too! Their rates are fair for the level of excellence.

As a fan of the McCall location, I was happy to see that they had ventured to the valley. I was not disappointed. 
The dinning area was large, and well laid out. The seating area felt very spacious, Bright colors, and good lighting made it feel very comfortable.
We were greeted and seated right away. Very pleasant staff. Looked like they enjoyed their jobs. 
Waters were brought out , with a pitcher on the table. We ordered drinks. I had a Margarita (descent, a little sweet fore my taste, but fine), and my girlfriend had a beer.
we munched on chips and salsa (the salsa is very good by the way).
We looked over the menu (same as McCall), so I went with the enchiladas Jalisco. 3 enchiladas (beef, cheese, chicken). Each came with their own sauce. The sauces were again a little sweet, but I enjoyed the meal (rice and beans came with it of course).
Nothing fancy, but good food, and reasonable prices. New "go-to" spot for us.

We went for family lunch, food and service were outstanding! We all loved what we got. 
We loved the atmosphere, the food, the service, everything!
We definitely will be going back.
Great flavors and service. Prices were fair- good portions! Next time I'm visiting, I'll come back here

Organic beef, tasty fries, great frie sauce, oh and for the reviews that say bad service... wrong. The lady with the hoarse voice served us and she was great. We sat outside on a beautiful day and she brought our HOT food to us.  Amazing.

Recently, I hired Big Boy Movers for a large move.  Mostly, everything went well.  First, what went well...the guys were very polite and moved things without damaging anything.  They arrived on time.  They worked the entire time and were efficient.  There was no standing around or wasting time as I have had with other moving companies.  Next, what didn't go well.  When I scheduled, I told them I had a very large move and what I needed.  In the end, they didn't move everything that I needed moved.  They said some stuff that I had in my garage wouldn't fit in the truck and I could take it in my SUV.  I told them that I needed it moved because I couldn't do it myself (There were a few large items).  I was told that they had another job they had to get to and refused to finish my job.  Now I get to hire someone else to finish the job that they refused to finish.

I was able to book my appointment on the Facebook page. I had to reschedule due to my work schedule and Katie was very accommodating. I booked a car detail, interior only. Jonathan and his partner came toward the end of the arrival window, which was ok.  He actually asked me if there were any problems areas in particular that he needed to focus on. I was not expecting that question but i was impressed with him asking me that. I told him the back seat because I have kids and my car was definitely dirtier back there. They spent about an hour doing the floors, seats, doors, and trunk. I am very impressed! My car is a 2008 and have never been that clean since 2008!! It's almost like new again!! Their prices are very reasonable plus I did not have to go anywhere. They came right to my house!! I would recommend to anyone who needs first class service for their car detailing needs!
Rendon Construction did a great job.  Professional, efficient, and honest. Very happy
The best dining experience we've had in a very long time. The food was excellent. Very fresh and delicious. Management was friendly and our waitress was great. We will dine here again soon.
The best burger in Meridian. Pricey but good.

I expected a lot more from a hibachi restaurant that you have reservations at. First, it took about 15 minutes to just take drink orders, then another 5 to get a water, another 10 to get food our food order in. We were entertained while the chef made out food which is why I gave 2 stars. But my biggest problems with this place are 1.) Their exhaust fans are no where in the ballpark that they need to be (I was in the right corner while facing the front door) and noticed the table next to us had the same problem. Plums of smoke engulfed me, so much so that I couldn't see half that was going on. The shirt and coat I was wearing that night would tell you how bad it was. 2.) Over cooked my rare steak, soup was no were near as good as other hibachi grill restaurants, fried rice is flavorless and Burnt in spots. Also, the appetizer we ordered didn't arrive until we had damn near everything of our main course on our plate. Then when everything was being cleared out, the waitress cleaning plates blatantly ignored someone at our table asked for the check. They got so pissed that they left the table to look for someone that would help them. I think his wife might have been sick. Regardless, he wasn't rude but he repeated multiple time "MISS!". She never looked up. He went to the front and my husband, another couple and I sat there to wait for the check. Another 15 minutes later, we finally got it. Then another 10 to pick it up. For how much we spent, I expected better service and food.

Food was great and our service was great. I wanted to leave our waitress, Brooke, $16 on a $39 bill but she only gave me tens and a one for my change from $100 so I could only tip $11. I think she probably didn't leave us any fives in order to get a ten dollar tip- kind of a passive aggressive way to get a larger tip and the funny part is she could have had an even larger tip. It was a little annoying because I hate how servers assume that younger people are not going to tip well when I almost always tip 30-35%. 

There was this guy who worked there named Dillon whom my girlfriend said kept giving her creepy looks and staring at her.l and we were there with our son, which is ever creepier on his part, which is why I can only leave a 4/5 hahaha

Great place for lunch.  We came on Tuesday @1:30   Will return to try dinner.  We were greeted at the door by Chloe who was friendly and bubbly.  

Autumn was our server who was friendly and very accommodating who gave us the password for wi-fi.  
She checked with us often to see if we needed anything.

I had the crab avocado salad and chose 1000 Island dressing.  It was Hugh and sooo good. Took some home for dinner. Hubby had fish and chips which he liked. The Creme broule wad wonderful.

We will be back  

We returned during the week for a light lunch.  The greeter and waitress one in the same was great. Friendly and checked back with us often.

I had the ultimate grilled cheese with bacon and tomatoes which were left off. Waitress noticed it when she brought it to us so bought some tomatoes on an extra plate.  the sandwich was tasty and FF were great.

Hubby had fish and chip which he enjoyed.

A group of my girlfriends went to Flatbread for their Thursday Night-ladies night. We ordered a bottle of wine, an app and our meals. The waiter, a total meathead, had to be reminded 3 times about our app, which on the third attempt we ended up canceling. Normally I would understand if they were busy or he had a lot of people in his section, but that was not the case. When we cancelled the app he didn't apologize, offer to still being it at no charge or to pay for something else. Instead, he took it among himself to add a $10 tip to my bill!! Buyer beware! If you get meathead pay with cash only or you might get a surprise on your tab!
Library is very nice with many resources. Staff is very friendly and accommodating. The only downside is that quiet study can be difficult due to the noise levels of excited children.

Fun place with yummy food. I love the whole concept of going through a line choosing what you want on your pizza as they prepare it for you. It's kind of like the subway of pizzas. Tons of choices and I mean tons! Thin crust so you don't have to worry about all those extra calories, you can just focus on the yummy toppings.

The prices here are very good and the restaurant's nice and clean well-lit and in a really great location! The first time I went I had a hard time finding it though. I really like the attitudes of the people working there, they seem like they really enjoy their job. I love to go to a restaurant that has friendly happy employees.

Burgers are delicious every time. Onion rings are awesome! Came here about 10 times in 2 months. Love it. Friendly staff, only thing is certain employees charge you for ranch. Avoid those suckers and get your free ranch.

This place is off the hook! Amazing donuts with flavors and types changing throughout the day, always fresh. Try there Mexican white chocolate latte-amazing. If your a little experimental try a beer they serve on tap with one of their donuts, you won't be sorry
Great meat and potatoes type place.  Everything I have tried has been excellent.  Open late.  Friendly staff.
Great food great service I have such a great time every time I go their chicken and waffles are amazing

Really delicious tacos on taco Tuesday, also a great atmosphere and kind service. No complaints here if you're looking for a great bar and grill  to catch a game with your friends and enjoy some food then you'll definitely get that here.

Siera was extremely rude to our group while ordering along with being rude to her co-workers. No customer service from behind the counter. Pizza was ok, not sure about the pressed dough method? Will not be going back
Great subs and salads! Customer service is great too. Convenient drive thru. Prices are reasonable.
I love Hobby Lobby but the lines are terrible. If they would implement a barcode system for scanning your items at the checkout then the lines would move so much faster.
Fabulous burger but on stale roll!  They forgot my French onion soup...server was too busy but nice.

Holy Hot Sauce, their Bloody Mary is THE thing to have for a hangover. Very good food and service. Their salsa is tasty and zesty. We went for lunch about 2 months ago and they were busy, but gave us plenty of attention. Definitely a 'must try' place.
Great diner. One of Meridian's secrets for now. Great lunch, great dinner. Never had a bad meal. The Rueben soup and meals around St Paddy's day are legendary. Never had a bad meal

Food was extremely slow to come out. After being there about 15 minutes. They came out to tell me the only had one banana bread & asked to substitute zucchini bread. I said fine but it came without the French toast toppings. The bacon & eggs were good. The read potatoes were nothing unique. Bacon was good. Everything was fine but it was no different than a Denny's. The coffee & water was not readily kept filled.

5 star for Mexico food in ID, if you're a transplant from CA keep in mind this is Idaho and that authenticity were used to is few and far between. As for good Mexican conveniently located in Meridian this will do the trick

If you want scratches in your brand new wheels...this is the place to get your truck washed. Oh and Victor (Mgr) will be sure to tell you how that's impossible even though it magically appeared right after going through the wash.  But it's your word against there's...so what do you do...

Steve makes these exactly the way I remember Fat Jonnie's making them in Chicago- The food is delicious and authentic. He's using all the right ingredients, and he's a great guy. Anyone in the area should stop in and support this great local business.

Always great service, always great food, always great ambiance. Texas Roadhouse is a staple for my family. When you consider the price for the amount of food you get, in combination with the downright tastiness-c'mon, no one makes a better steak than Texas Roadhouse-it's the best restaurant in town. They keep those rolls coming and so do we!

Absolutely delicious. The quality of the ingredients and the delicious options have turned me into a loyal lover of this place. Can't wait for the next time I'm back so I can grab drinks and  some delicious food. Oh and the staff is amazingly friendly

Great breakfast great place. I ordered the "Idahoan" and my guest ordered the Rib Eye and Eggs 
Both were perfectly prepared and tasted wonderful. 
The service was very attentive, pleasant and we enjoyed our meal very much. Brook was our server, it's no wonder she was also training a new server.
Got some donuts for my sisters bridal shower ! There was none left ! lol surprised ?! Of coarse not so I'd say five stars !

We give this one a 10 plus star!  Wow what great pizza!   Waitress, Paisley waited on us.  She was very pleasant and friendly.   She greeted us with a big smile.  The manager Ryan came out to greet us to make sure everything was just as we liked it.  He was professional and kind!  We were sooo impressed with this Chicago Connection!  Never had such great service at any other one in the area.   And it's spotless clean!  We will always come back here from now on when in town!

They have a few vegan options. We went with the vegan burger. Not the best...and it was a little burnt. But the vegan "wings" were good. Extremely spicy but good. If you are with a group there will be something for everyone. But I'm not in a rush to go back for the vegan food.
Love this place . Very good food . Very prompt service . Extremely good drinks . Nice vibe , nice staff . Greatest place to get food in the village.

This place offers an experience. From bath bombs to growlers to specialty coffee and milkshakes--there's something for everyone at this epic stop on Eagle Road.

I'm hoping they turn the upstairs into a co-working space for business owners who work from home, but want to get out (and need snacks and coffee throughout the day).  :) :) :) 




#hiJaci

The food is always great and the staff is even better! My wife and I are weekly "regulars" and every time we arrive we are greeted with a friendly smile AND by more than one of the Servers. They often bring our usual drinks without asking including the Chips & Salsa.

Update for this 1 star review. Management made the situation right. On a return visit the donuts were as fresh as could be. Krispy Kreme has always been my favorite donut and will continue to be. This location has excellent customer service and is exceptionally managed. Thank you.

Love this place, even though I don't drink beer (my loss, they have 150 of them on tap), they do offer a decent wine list, which I am discovering with each  visit.

We returned  there yesterday for lunch & opted for the speedier seating option: the bar.

Place was hopping in the middle of the lunch rush. Bartender was friendly & efficient. 

I ordered the quinoa salad & hubby had the salmon. Both delish, I am pretty sure that all the colors of the rainbow were present in my salad, it was SOOO tasty!

We'll be back!

The Pterodactyl wings were really good.  Because I wanted to pace myself I ordered the 8 oz sirloin special w/ rosemary potatoes and grilled asparagus for $13.95.  The cut of meat was mediocre, but still worth the price.  I'll come back next time I'm in town and order a better cut of meat.  Staff is very friendly and attentive.  Nice relaxed atmosphere.  If I lived close, I would visit often.

Had the prawns as an appetizer--not very good. They were seasoned well but over cooked. The steak tip sandwich was ok but seemed over priced. Pizza crust was good but the the first one came out burnt and had to send it back. The replacement wasn't burnt but the oven must have been dirty cause there was lots of burnt flour on the bottom so it still tasted pretty bad. I've been to other flatbread locations and they are great. Probably won't be coming to this one again though.

In town for a couple days and went to Pueblo Lindo tonight after reading the reviews here and were glad we did. As said by others; fast, friendly service, our food came out quick, and was excellent. Great local spot. Great value too!
Love this restaurant Food is FRESH & EXCELLENT!  My favorite is the Chicken Arugula Salad.  I crave it.
Authentic Mexican food, good service, casual ambience, tasty Margaritas. Pollo Mole & Chile Verde A+, warm & fresh tortilla chips, homemade salsa. In front of Kohl's and open Sundays.

I'm a BIG fan of the Yard House and while you may think it's because of all the TVs, Happy Hour Special, Queso Dip, all their beer and spirit offerings or the hip cool environment, it's not any of those things. 

I'm a BIG fan because there's a dedicated menu section for those of us who choose not to eat meat, vegetarians, or no animal by products, vegan. 

If you are omnivore, Steak lover, or someone who only eats seafood, may not have even noticed that there's a section called " Gardein " Gardein products are Vegan meaning that they are made without animal and animal by products.  So, just for a review that means, no pork, chicken, beef, lamb, seafood, plus no by products, which means no eggs, milk, butter, and honey 


I know I know. What's left???? Actually quite a bit but that's a topic for another time. 

First let's talk about what is Gardein

It is a meat substitute made from Soy, Wheat, Pea Proteins, Vegetables, and Ancient Grains 

So let's do a deep dive into the Gardein submenu at The Yard House 

There's Mac N Cheese. - clearly Vegetarian but not Vegan. Due to the use of Cheddar and Parmesan    - The truffle Oil and Wild Mushrooms makes this a tasty treat and dish 


Gardein Orange Chicken. - very similar to the Mandarin Gardein Chicken that can be purchased at most retailers like Winco, Meijers, Publix and even Walmart.   Here The Yard House changes the sauce to more of Orange glaze and adds baby corn, bok choy  and jasmine rice.  Definitely Vegetarian and most likely not Vegan due to the Orange glaze but double check with the staff  This is a good meal but I think it needs more veggies and less sauce 

There's a BBQ Chicken Pizza.  Again it's not real Chicken but the chicken substitute is really good. ( Seriously ). The Mozzarella is the real deal so this is not a vegan dish but vegetarian  

The Gardein Buffalo Wings come in three different varieties.  Buffalo, Firecracker, Korean and Jerk.  For a vegetarian, these are freaking amazing. So damn good. If you catch these during dine in happy hour. Order them the buffalo is the best but the Korean is a close second.  Remember if you are vegan check about the sauce and skip all the dipping sauces. 

The Fried Chicken tenders are the worst item on the sub menu. It's due to the outer crisp that is heavy on the grain. This is the same as the ones you can find in the grocery stores. So skip these ones. 

The BBQ Chicken salad is similar to the pizza listed above but has a lot of no no's if you are vegan so be careful 

The Gardein Grilled Chicken Avocado Sandwich is amazing. Definitely a fav. Here's a hack to make it vegan.  Ditch the Swiss and mayo. Make sure the bun is vegan and otherwise if you are vegan DONE.  ( try to sneak in some Hampton Creek Chipotle Mayo - Vegan ) and some Violife cheese like the Hot Pepper ( vegan ) and add that to your sandwich.  Achievement Unlocked 


The Torta is also Delish for vegetarians but there's a lot to take away to make it vegan like the pepper jack cheddar, crema, and the mayo. 

The Vegan Burger is phenomenal except for one small detail.  The vegan cheese used is Daiya.   Not a big fan of theirs since they sold out to a pharma company in Japan but worse is that the taste and texture of their vegan cheese is poor.  Ask the staff to make it w/o Diaya and bring your own Vegan cheese 

There's the Gardein breakdown from
The Yard House.  Of course the drinks spirits and good times are important and all of that exists at TYH but for me and my friends and family, I'm thankful that there's a little submenu that can easily fit into my needs.

Two thumbs down. I didn't think it was possible to make chicken fajitas dull and unappealing. The staleness of the corn tortillas rivaled hard taco shells. The seasoning on the chicken fajitas was overpowering, unpleasant and it ruined the flavor. Most of the veggies were sliced way too thick and weren't cooked.

I wish them luck but we won't be returning. The search for good (Mexican) restaurants in the Boise area continues.

After being forgotten at Le Peep, we went looking for soemwhere to get a quick breakfast. Friday was busy, but it was "date morning"! No kids!!! Everywhere we tried had a long wait or no low carb options. We decided to skip breakfast and just get coffee and found Hot Spot Cafe! We did even know they were here!

From the moment we walked in, the waitress was smiling and helping us. The coffee came fast and was great. The menu was amazing with so many different items that all looked incredible! I loved that gluten free options were available for toast, crepes, French toast, pancakes, and more! The kitchen was happy to swap out fruit with tomatoes and make all of the little changes that I asked for. They were great. 

When the food arrived, it was incredible. Honestly, I haven't had steak that tasted that amazing in a long time! We will be back!!! I am excited to try new things from the menu! 

I highly recommend trying this hidden gem.

I only write reviews when I am blown away for the good. The best should always rise to the top and I put Pueblo Lindo in that category. What I was most impressed by is the variety of flavors and the fact that they don't all blend into a flavor mush. The meats also stick out us uniquely delicious from many of the Mexican restaurants in the area. Friendly service and great food!
Best steaks and ribs. Great service. Delicious rolls! We've never had a disappointing meal at Texas Roadhouse.

Where do I begin.... from the start.  Staying at the Candlewood Suites and saw this restaurant next door.  I am an absolute sushi fanatic, so what the heck!  Appetizer menu has a 5 piece sushi for $7.99.  That's perfect for me to test the waters before I drop $80 on Uni, Hotate, and fatty tuna.  

As soon as I saw the plate,  I knew what I was getting.  You know,  one of those 'all you can eat' looking sushi platters..... with tiny, warm, sweating fish on rice that's falling apart on the plate.... I should have known,  the refrigerator door was left open for the entirety of my meal.  Now,  at this point I am fricking hungry!  I just flew in and only had a bag of pretzels on the plane.  What's the back up plan??  Teryaki!  How can you mess up teriyaki????  

Round 2... Momma always told me to be a positive person,  so, the broccoli was perfectly done.  Probably the best broccoli that I have ever tasted.  The MSG kept it fresh while sitting in the heat warmer in the kitchen.  Damn fine broccoli.  Now the chicken,  just look at that chicken.....it was fricking cooked in the microwave.  Steamed, rubbery, never touched a grill or frying pan chicken.   The steak was cooked just like I want it,  pink in the middle, how do you do that in a microwave? They figured it out!   Rice was fine,  left the chicken, downed the steak with a bottle of Asahi.  I won't get started on the gravy excuse for teriyaki sauce.  Note to self, if you have to go to one of these fake Benihana restaurants,  get the Hibachi.    

Btw,  server was great, they were quick to refill your drink and very friendly.

This restaurant is the gourmet of all pizza places. Subway meets papa Murphy's and bam!! My first ever time going I got the extra spicy build your own pizza. Each bite brought a sting to my mouth and a new flavor each bite! This pizza place will leave your stomach craving for more each time you go.
So so - good service, great beer selection.  The food was so so, not sure I'd return.  No major issues just average.

This is a great local steakhouse in Meridian. Been here a few times and have had great service and consistently good food. I am a little surprised that they don't have a ribeye selection on their menu. Although, they do offer a ribeye special on Monday and Tuesday evening. But get there early. They run out within an hour or so. Overall, great little spot with good service and good food.

Joshua was great to work with.  Showed up with crew on time and did an outstanding job with our tree.  In and out and were very thorough and clean.  Got many bids and decided to go with Chavco due to great reviews and responsiveness from the owner.  Will call them again for future services.  Thank you Chavco.

Crowded, loud, and confusing. It was our first time in and we didn't know if we were supposed to seat ourselves or wait. We had eye contact with at least 10 employees but none were helpful. We took our group elsewhere.
Best burgers is boise if you are looking for a old time feel burger place with fry sauce and great French Fry's this is the place not to spwndy and you get what you pay for
Our wings came out cold. The veggies were water laden making them bruised. The server was good, however. I won't be returning to this place. Hot food should be served hot!

This is my 3rd trip to the Yard House. We come here because my wife likes it, not because I do. read on to learn why Im not a fan.

The Yard House is in "The Village." The Village reminds me of that old TV series "The Prisoner".

http://www.imdb.com/title/tt0061287

For those out there that are older, like me, you might remember "The Prisoner". But then again, it did not get a huge amount of play time here in the US. 

The TV series was set in a place called "The Village", which was a very secretive and isolated community for people that the government needed disappeared. 

The entire show was about this one ex-MI6 agent that the leaders of The Village were trying to get secrets out of. It was a really cool, but also very bizarre British TV series.

I will give 1 example of it bizarreness. When the Prisoner tried to escape, a huge ball (about 6 feet around) named Rover would come rolling down the street. It would roll over the Prisoner and envelop his face. When it did, he screamed in pain.

I am not exactly sure why our Village reminds me of this old show. Perhaps its the layout and design that is reminiscent of The Village.

Perhaps its the way that The Village in Meridian is a little on the secretive and exclusive side of things. 

Maybe its because The Village is just too upscale of me. I am more of a plane Tee shirt sort of guy that likes his plain old meat and potatoes. 

I am not exactly sure, but for whatever reason, this place gives me the Willies.

Well, on with the review. 

This place in Noisy. The music is loud. The main theme here is Alcohol. The bar is huge and take center stage right smack in the middle of the place.

Now that I think on this, this probably one of the reasons Im not comfortable here. I am not a drinker, though I do have a mixed drink on occasion.

When I was here, most every table had Alcohol in one form or another on it. The smell of Alcohol permeates the entire place.

The Yard House is a huge bar. Perhaps the yard House is the waive of the future. No longer does the hostess have to ask if you want to sit at the bar or in the dining area. 

Places like the Yard House no longer give you that choice. Either you sit where there is liquor being served, or you find another place to eat.

The Yard House is not a family friendly place. Alcohol is everywhere you look. But this does not seem to stop families from coming here. 

I noticed more than a few examples of this. A family with 2 or 3 kids at the table with mom and dad. The kids were eating burgers and fries while mom and dad were guzzling beer and wine.

A picture that you would never see in my family growing up, and will never see in my family now.

I would call this place a Basteraunt or a Restaubar. 

Like most every other place in The Village, the prices here are on the high side. This is another reason why The Yard House is not Family Friendly. My small family of 3 paid $42, which is on the lower end of an average ticket price here.

The last 2 times I was at the Yard House, I had a burger. The burgers here are pretty good, when they are good. Like so many places though, its hit or miss depending on who cooks it and perhaps what mood they were in that day.

This time, i had Street Tacos. 


I did like these, but 3 of them came no where close to filling me up. In fact, I told my wife that the 3 tacos were a cute Amuse-bouche (Appetizer). Now I was ready for my main meal.

After we ate here, we went to Fast Freddie's for a hamburger. 

I am not a fan of the yard House. If you are a drinker, you might well like it here. There is lots and lots of booze here. 

If like me, you dont like being around alcohol and dont want your kids exposed to alcohol, you will want to find yourself another place to eat.

I love marshals. Just like tj Maxx, has great variety of things that are hard to find and very unique. Prices are lovely and it's clean and organized. Same brands cost so much less than in other stores and they get new stock about weekly so keep popping into the store once in a while cause the items available will be pretty different each time

I've visited at least half a dozen times and it has become my favorite happy hour spot.  They have great food and a very good deal.  As important, though, are the solid service and comfortable surroundings.

The bar is huge and very deep.  I had enough room to hold my arm out straight in front of me.  This gives plenty of space to be eating, drinking, and socializing at the bar.  The bar stools are very comfortable, too.  If you're so inclined, there are big TVs to watch.

The food has always been the star for me, as I'm not much into beer or cocktails.   Most of the restaurant's appetizers are half price during happy hour and drinks are discounted too, so this makes for an excellent value.   My favorite app at most places is the calamari.   I only ordered it once here, though.  Not that it wasn't good, but I liked some of the other items much better.  One item that doesn't seem like an appetizer is the Chicken Garlic Noodles.  They are amazing!  I would eat them every day.  Hubby's favorite was the buffalo boneless chicken wings, but they were way too spicy for me.

Restroom is spacious and very nicely-appointed.

Breakfast is served all day, woohoo!!! First time here and the service was great. Everything is made from scratch so the wait is a little longer versus precooked food. Worth the little longer wait. I was so happy to see the kids meal came with freshly made chicken strips and mashed potatoes! It's hard to find a kids meal made with fresh food nowadays.
