I received 3 refills of my coffee and was offered a to go cup of coffee as well. My country man scramble was delicious and I found the portions to be perfect and we had some leftovers. I don't agree with the other reviewers that the portions are small but I'm a smaller person so that could be why. I look forward to going back and trying the lunch menu.

The staff was excellent, and the food is Affordable and delicious. I ordered the French toast combo, and a side of biscuits and gravy. My wife ordered some amazing waffles, the banana nut waffle. My daughter ordered the chicken alfredo pasta which was a lunch special and she loved it.

Showed up measured, emailed once, he  recommended carpet an vinyl on rental home,  home was empty (easy install), we went to pick out flooring (lament/vinyl plank) at another store location that he has access  Emailed multiple times, called may times, to get flooring installed on rental home, he should have said he was to busy, instead of leading us on, Voice mail always full, he probably should work for someone who can keep a schedule.

Went today for the first time to have lunch. It smelled delicious as you walk up to the door. We were greeted promptly and seated right away. The service is excellent they are very attentive and seemed genuinely happy. The food is delicious we will definitely be going back, o recommend anyone who wants Mexican food that has great flavor give them a try.

Was not impressed. To me, you go to a salon to relax, not sit and get your nails done only to see two big screen TV's playing football. Honestly?? That's not really the part that bothered me. I paid to get a manicure, and all I got was my nails cut, filed (crookedly), and painted. They didn't trim my cuticles or do a hand massage or anything. All said and done, my nails look ok from a distance. Up close you can see smudges. Not what I would expect out of a professional place.

I have been a client of Dr Strickland's since 2006. He has always helped me with all my aches and pains. Most recently I was in so much pain I could not sleep lying down and had to use crutches to walk. I am off my crutches and sleeping well at night. I would recommend them to anyone.

Horrible hostess service. We called ahead (as the hostess said to call 20 minutes ahead of time to put our name down) and we arrived roughly 25 minutes later. When we arrive she gives us a buzzer -- which okay we understand we must wait our turn. 30 minutes pass - mind you plenty of people have cleared out and passed us! Then it starts to near 30 more minutes so we go up to ask and they say it should be "any minute now" but then it's past the 45 minute waiting mark and we ask again and they say the rain outside is causing them to give up all the free tables inside to those outside first. Which yes we understand, but it would have been nice to be notified instead of having us wait for phantom tables that were being given to about ten or so parties before we can even sit. Had we known that fact earlier we would have understood. But nearly 50 minutes later and still not a word on why we were waiting for so long. Very irritating.

Missing food in order. Extremely bad customer service. Two employees actually avoided me when seeing I needed assistance. Very rude when confronted about the mistake as well, and didn't want to fix it. Won't be coming back.
Food was great but slow coming out. Kat was our server. Happy hour was very good choice wise. But wish we would have gotten more time to enjoy. Almost late for our movie

I don't understand the recent negativity. The Homestead embraced our large group recently. Service was terrific. Enjoyed the food. Had the gyro which I would have again. Enjoyed the side salad and two Bloody Mary's.

Will definitely be back.

I just walked out of Chili's. Hands-down some of the worst service I've ever had. Middle age 40 something waitress with a angry scowl. Waited forever to be sit and also waited forever to get my check(the place was hardly busy). In my honest opinion this waitress hated her job with a passion and it showed. Simple common courtesy or politeness would suffice. Say hello at least. Maybe say welcome or have a nice day. It was horrible! Just all angry! Not even a smile!??Geez! Now let's get to the food. The burger was burnt around the edges and a whitish color of gray in the center. My Caesar salad was just drowned in dressing. 100 bucks say these employees drive this place into the ground within a year. Note to owners ACT NOW!! Send a family member or friend in on a Tuesday and see for yourself. I was waiting for Chef Ramsey to pop out somewhere to help you.

This facility is disgusting. The food was alright, but the eating area is atrocious. This place has not been cleaned in months from the looks of it. Every single table had food crumbs on and under the tables, the floors period have gunk built up along the walls, the chairs have never been wiped (again from the looks of it), along with the trash receptacle...and don't get me started on the disgusting build up on & in the soda machine. There was dust on top of the napkin dispenser on the table I ate at. I can't believe a DAILY cleaning protocol isn't put into place. I get some places are not up to date but at least keep it clean. People eat here.
On top of it all as I contemplated getting a hold of some ownership to inform of my experience, I asked if this location was corporate or franchised owned. The gal responded with "I don't know I just work here".
You tell me if that is acceptable anywhere.

Simple menu with tons of flavor!  I yelped looking for a family joint within price range.  Not an inch of disappointment here! Organic beef, fresh ingredients, buttered buns, and more.  I would say these burgers are better then a red robin burger.  Their barbecue sauce is AMAZING! I chose the ALARM burger, and I would do it again.  Flavor flavor flavor!!! Their buns weren't the commercial crap sesame buns either, this place is amazing from A to Z.

Poor service, bartender was a D*** when my husband went to ask him about their Bloody Mary mix to see if it had gluten in it - he, aside from our waitress had no clue, both of them said there was wheat in the vodka, "food wasn't that good" according to my son who ordered the French toast and got what was more like French cardboard. My food was cold. Very poor attention to detail/unsanitary staff!! There was a bowl of chips and salsa sitting behind me for about a half an hour(according to my husband-I had no clue), having long hair I know that I flipped my hair behind my shoulder a few times. I asked the waitress for a straw, when she came back she pulled an unpackaged straw from her pen pocket. DISGUSTING!! Speaking of unsanitary- watching the bartender make out bloody Mary's three staff member grabbed the lemons,limes etc and stuck them on the toothpicks with their hands that have been touching everything else in the restaurant and what other people have touched- instead of using the toothpick to poke and pick up everything. Train the staff on contamination. It's pretty gross.
Manager, Walter took excellent care of us. He went above and beyond for our office to-go order. The food was excellent! Can't wait to go back. Thank you!
Just moved to the area and discovered Hot Spot Cafe and I'm so glad I did! Delicious and great service with a smile! Try it, you won't be disappointed! I promise!
The marinara sauce reminds me of Spaghetti-Os and the bruschetta bread was thick and getting soggy on the bottom. I was excited to try this place, but I don't think we'll be back.
We really enjoyed eating at our "go to" restaurant when visiting boise.  The manager was amazing, taking time to come and say hi and we enjoy the service every time!

I like the food here but the service is really slow. They definitely need more employees. I ordered 2 items. One of them came to our table after about 15 minutes. The second order came after another 15 minutes. It wasn't really crowded. About half the seating was full. Would probably be 3-4 stars if it hadn't taken so long.

Ordered food for delivery and it tasted fine.  Next two days we had the shits!
Had fried rice along with other items.  Won't be back.    They need to review their food handling procedures.  I looked up their health inspections and that contained some scary information.  Last health inspection had 7 infractions with two critical violations and one prior to that one had 7 infractions and 4 critical violations!   I spent my entire adult life in the restaurant industry and I can tell you that those inspection scores are very bad!  Please save yourself and DO NOT eat here!

.I was hungry, and needed a quickie. I didn't see anything wrong with the dining area, yet I would not want come here to sit down and eat.
.Had a BLT in a whole wheat pita, to go. They build it to your order, similar to Subway. No cheese, just thousand island dressing. The 'artist' ripped off the top paper wrap for me so I could immediately start eating.
.Flour tortillas don't appeal to me, and things that looklike a soft shell burrito might scare me off.  This pita thing was yummy, without any pasty gluey aftertaste. it was a bit dry, but I will experiment with some other dressings.
Excellent food and great beer selection.   Best Reuben in the Treasure Valley and service has always been outstanding.  Highly recommended.
Sandra and Ben did another stellar job in getting my direct TV set-up! Easy to work with and are always quick to fix any issues we may have had!

The food is fantastic. Service is great too.  However, I often enjoy Mexican restaurants with booths and a little privacy.  Here and mi casa both have that cafeteria feel since it's so open.  But that's just my aesthetic preference.
Open late! Nice setting outside. Service was good. Parking is kind of a hassle though.

The best service.  Our meal was taking a bit longer than they felt it should so they brought us out an extra appetizer for free.  My daughter wanted a juice halfway through our meal and she just gave it to us.  The service was top notch!

I've had a great experience with Carollen at this mattress firm store. She took time with me, and asked great questions to make sure I got the mattress I needed. I recommend visiting this store and working with her.

Was really excited to try this place.  Looked up the menu on-line before we went and had my plan of what I was going to order.  Unfortunately, even though the menu board says "We have Sushi!" They do not have sushi at this location.  They also don't have the Crab Rangoon appetizer that I was going to try.  They only have the bowls at this location.  So, rethought my order and got a bowl, which I thought was unimpressive.  My husband, who was also very excited to get some sushi rolls, ordered a bowl.  Two of the proteins he tried to order (that are also listed on their menu board) they don't carry anymore at this location.  Maybe someday we will give the Boise location a try and hopefully they actually have what is on their menu, but was mostly just disappointed in the Overland location.  

Also, the other reviews about the bathroom situation (no toilet paper in the dispenser, paper towel dispenser doesn't work, make-shift lock for the door) were the same when we were there as well.
i love the gluten free items. the food is delicious and the waitresses are so nice!
I've eaten at other Jakers restaurants (Missoula, Idaho Falls) etc and always had good experiences.   At the Boise one, not so  much. Disappointing service.

Wow. Just wow. The food here was absolutely AMAZING. 10/10 , Caila needs to be promoted for creating such an incredible & optimistic, comfortable environment . Texas has great servers AND hostesses, especially the one in Meridian . They made me and my 2 other pals feel like home when we came to eat. Also the appetizers are PERFECTION. Along with their salmon, woohoo! Will definitely come back .

My wife, an Intensive Care Nurse, wanted to have a quick Christmas Eve dinner with her family (myself and two small children) before going in for her 12 hour shift. We called ahead to hold a spot. They quoted us a 30 minute wait time, which seemed reasonable so we decided to go. It took us about 15 minutes to get there, so we were expecting a 15-20 minute wait.

We wound up waiting almost an hour after arriving. My wife was upset. 1.) There wasn't time to eat a meal with her family on Christmas Eve, and 2.) She was going to have to start her 12 hour shift starving.

Anyone in that situation would be upset. She requested to talk to the manager. She asked if there was any way a rush could be put on her order so she could at least take it to go. The manager, clearly overwhelmed by the busy night, refused to accommodate the request. My wife asked what the wait time was for orders coming out of the kitchen. He had no idea.

My wife asked him to leave her alone so she could decide what to do. He continued to stay at the table, demanding she "calm down", further agitating her. He wasn't able to assert control over her, so he said we had to leave.

So, Christmas Eve, after waiting more than double the quoted wait time. An inept, power-tripping manager, kicked out a Nurse on her way to work and her small children. She went to work without dinner and the rest of us scratched something together at home.

In all the decades I've been dining out, from New Port to New York City, this was one of the worst customer management experiences I've ever witnessed.

Texas Roadhouse cares about one thing: your money. They're never getting a penny of ours again.

So, I love pizza... and I was kinda hesitant on going to this place, but so glad I did. They are set up like really cool. It's like subway but with pizza! 
Love how fast and easy it wAs. And it was freaking delicious! Been back there a few times and haven't had a bad experience. So definitely a place to try

Sat at the bar by myself and ordered a half yard full of the local Sockeye Catch Series brew, which was light and toasty and perfect for a sunny hot day. The Cuban pork sandwich was delicious with actual roast pork. The bartender was friendly and had good recommendations.

The salsas were good; Chips fresh and tasty. The service was excellent. The verde sauce requested for enchiladas had a good depth of flavor. The chipotle sauce was not as good. They ran out flan before 6pm on a Saturday evening.

Best pizza I've ever had! The salad was also excellent. I was in Meridian for the weekend and was so impressed I ate there twice. We had the 2 for lunch special and the portion sizes were perfect. We also ate dinner there and split a pizza and a salad, perfect portion size again. The pizza crust is amazing, none better. I want to try every different kind of pizza on the menu! The ambiance is great.  I'll definitely go back, I'm craving it now!
Great food, I'm not a sushi eater and usually leave sushi restaurants hungry still, but not here. Plenty of food with leftovers. I love that the teriyaki chicken is not dark meat!

Rate a 0 if I could. Asked customer service to switch out money for a bigger bill. Didn't even bother to open up her til to look, went back over to self check out Conner was a big help and reassured me he might have it but he looked anyways!
How hard was that to do for the CUSTOMER SERVICE area to do that?! 
You're fucking horrible Walmart!

The steak was a little tough but the flavor was so good it was a healthy offset.  The bread pudding was amazing! Ive lived in Meridian for 22 years and i cant believe i never knew this was right up the street. Ill be back for steak and bread pudding for sure!!

Very good lunch. Limited parking. They suggest parking across main in a parking lot. Not me traffic is terrible on main, I want to live. If I was in meridian I would stop for lunch if I could park safely.

Food was well prepared and the vegetables arrived fresh even though we ordered delivery.  However, I was really looking forward to Yellow Chicken Curry, the item I ordered. What I got was something with a brown sauce and pea pods along with other vegetables.  Moo Goo Chicken maybe? Definitely not curry. 
My husband's Cashew Chicken was good and the Egg Drop Soup was very nice. 
Be advised- if you re ordering the Calamari it comes stir fried with onions and a mixture of spicy peppers. I believe maybe Serrano's and definitely some jalapeños. This was not specified on the menu. My husband couldn't eat it, although it was well prepared. 
Deal Dash did a great job on the delivery. Very speedy and food arrived hot.
Food, service and atmosphere are fantastic. The littles found everything they liked. Colby, our server, was the best we have had in a very long time. Will be back over and over again.

I'm lingering between 3 and 4 stars, but I'll go with 4 since I'm a nice guy. 

This place is like the Subway of pizza joints. All the toppings (if you pick the make-your-own) are laid out before you and you can have whatever you want and as much as you want. I wouldn't  recommend loading up, though, as the Neapolitan style crust is thin and doesn't hold up to a lot of toppings. I'm fine with that as I usually get 3 or 4 and load up the cheese. Fresh arugula after it comes out of the oven is awesome. 

They have some of their own creations to pick from if you'd like, but I've never tried them. They also have some unremarkable salads, too. The make-your-own only comes in one size, but it's enough to fill me up.  I really like the blood orange lemonade.

My only complaint here, which has been said in other reviews, is the acoustics. Concrete floors, metal surfaces and a metal roof make things echo and coupled with the loud music bouncing off of everything, you can't hear anything. This was the reasoning for the three strikes on my last trip:  misspelled my name, sent my pizza thru when I said I wanted one more topping, and didn't give me drinks when I asked for two. The employees here are very nice and I know this was because they couldn't hear what I was saying.

All in all, I like the pizza and the fact I can put whatever I want on it for $7 and change. Just turn down the music a little, please.

I'm so glad I searched yelp for a steakhouse in the area! It's no wonder there are many good reviews! This place is great! Our server was very good and had a fun personality. We started off with a craft beer...perfect beverage after a Boise State football loss. I had the New York Jr steak...cooked to perfection. The cup of clam chowder was yummy. The other 3 people in my party were equally impressed with the food, casual ambience and service. This place will definitely be on our revisit list when we are back in town!

From the food, to the tequila, to the decor--Casa Del Matador exudes Tex-Mex.

Surrounded by iron work, with the obligatory sculpted longhorn looming above, our party of four was immediately escorted to our seats upon arrival (on a Tuesday night around 7pm), which was nice given they don't accept reservations and Tuesdays at The Village can be busy (due to Village wide discounts on Tuesdays). 

We enjoyed complimentary chips and salsa to munch on while we decided on drinks (always a nice touch). I ordered a Hornitos & Patron Citronge margarita, which was delish. My dining companion ordered a Herradura margarita which I tasted--also delish (one of the better margaritas I've had the pleasure of tasting in the Treasure Valley). The Hornitos Blanco that my margarita was mixed with is tequila stored in stainless steel casks (like all blancos). Whereas, my companion's margarita was made with Herradura's reposado, which is aged in oak barrels. It was interesting to taste the two side by side. The side by side comparison made the oakiness of Herradura's reposado very apparent. 

We were also able to taste a couple of their tequilas for half price (Tuesday deal: 1/2 price top shelf tequila). A decent deal on quality tequila. 

It's worth a mention, that some of their tequila tasting flights are inordinately priced. For example, the Extra Anejo 2, which features a half ounce each of, Herradura Seleccion Suprema, Don Julio Real, and Gran Patron Burdeos is shown in the menu for $120 for what is, in reality, roughly $20 of tequila. Not that it's not excellent tequila--it most certainly is. And, I understand that many people may not want to spend the $300 that a bottle of Don Julio Real will set you back. You're paying to be afforded the opportunity to taste these lavish liquors without having to commit to the full bottle. I get it. And still...the price tag makes me cringe a little. 

For dinner, I ordered the shredded chicken burrito with poblano sauce. It was tasty and incredibly filling. I could have easily split it with my dining companion and been satisfied. The service was fast, our meals came out quickly and were piping hot. I also learned while we were there that they serve brunch from 9-11am on Saturdays and Sundays (just the Meridian location--not Boise)!  I cannot wait to try this!  Breakfast burritos!  Hurray!  

All in all, a great experience. And, though the food was indeed tasty--in a metro that has few options when it comes to finding finely mixed margaritas--I am glad to have found Casa Del Matador! 

Get to it!

We decided to go here since the restaurant we wanted to go to was booked until late. We called ahead and were told that they had a table for us. When we arrived, they had no clue about any table. They ended up giving us a private room for no extra charge  which was cool. The service was pretty good. I ordered the steak and shrimp hibachi for 20 + $ and fried rice. Didn't realize that fried rice was extra $. The hibachi was not very impressive. Fairly bland. The rice was good after a little extra soy sauce. I would expect a little better food for spending over $30.

The food was delicious, only to be outmatched by how great the service from Adam was. Time and time again he went above and beyond to meet our needs, managing to keep other guests happy at the same time. An examplary employee, that should be promoted immediately. Will return just because of him !
My favorite pizza stop.  Glad to have them in Meridian.  Love their home made rach dressing.  Miss the live music.
Amazing food!!! Great ambience. Great service!!! We will probably go here every time we are in the Boise area from now on. The wonderful waitress recommended our meal choices & they were fabulous.

Had a very nice meal here with relatives during an overnight visit. Unique Neapolitan style pizza stands above many pizza places I've been. Interesting combinations of ingredients and a good selection of beer on tap. It has that studied upscale feel. The service hustled & was friendly & helpful with suggestions for pizza and beer. If I lived nearby I'd certainly stop by when I wanted a quick, satisfying, tasty meal.

Quality of food has gone downhill bad. There was a "Pine-sol" taste in our food and the waitress claimed it came from chili peppers being overcooked in the sauce which made zero sense. Tasted more like the food was contaminated with floor cleaner.

Excellent food, great flavors and reasonably priced.  Would like to see home made tortillas to match the rest of the home made flavors.  Margarita a bit  questionable, wine margarita perhaps.  Otherwise spectacular.

Great burgers for a fast food joint.  There's no need to go to a McDonalds or any other fast food place in town when this is right around the corner.  They are pretty quick and you can also call your order in.  The prices are right also.

OMG I never want to come here again! The location is AWFUL!!! This review is RE: the location only. It's THE WORST! Why, oh why did they move from downtown to this terrible suite on the wrong side of Eagle Rd and in a weird little strip mall?!

Had a very frustrating experience ordering pizza from here. Sent the kids to pick up our order and tried to pay with a $100 bill. The manager would not accept the money and told the kids that was her policy and sent them packing with no food. 

There is nothing posted as such in their store or online. This forced my kids to go to another business unnecessarily to break the bill and cost us over a half hour more of our time with the traffic. Once we were informed of the delay, with family and friends waiting, I POLITELY called to ask the manager (Laura) why that was her policy as it was very inconvenient, affected our family activities we had going on, and their website (we ordered online) did not specify that limitation.  Her attitude was uncaring and stated she does not accept $100 bills. I asked if she had a drop box like every restaurant has had for several decades and she said yes. But that's not how she does it. She was very rude and stated  "I am a franchisee, not corporate, and I can make my own policies." I told her I managed a pizza restaurant for most of my time in college and never had  an issue with $100 bills. There also is not any crime to speak of in the area that would dictate such a policy (I can't think of any other businesses in the area that have this policy anywhere in town, even gas stations). Again she was dismissive and rude, and uncaring or sympathetic. I told her I would keep that in mind next time, and let others know of this experience, but that we would never be back.

I am writing this review not because of the policy per se', which is not consistent with what the other Papa Murphy stores are doing by the way, but because of how rude and dismissive the owner was. Laura was disrespectful, not sincerely apologetic for the inconvenience and dismissive. I could tell she is not used to someone questioning her practices. I would hate to work for someone like that.

People should know who they are dealing with as an owner of the establishment. Having an inconvenient, unnecessary policy that hinders her customers is certainly her prerogative as the business owner. Fair enough. It was a black eye for "corporate," however, and she has lost business from more than one patron already. And customers have the right to inform others about their experiences too.

I will not be buying from her business anymore and have already told others to avoid. As someone else stated in their review, I will just take my business where I don't have to deal with rude people. And where they will take legal U.S. Tender.

Use with caution. I hate rude business owners. It's a small world. It never pays to be rude to customers.

This Pharmacy is absolutely amazing. Josh is so friendly and the other pharmacists/technicians are beyond helpful. I love that they remember my family and I every time. Not only that but the store itself is huge and there is always great discounts, as well as huge sale item baskets at the front of the store. Great people & great prices!

Love us some Flatbread Pizza!  The staff is great and the food is good to.  Kid's love to build their own pizza and all of this is followed by Warm Cookies and Ice Cold Milk!  

Great lunch specials and just a good place to go.

coming from Fresno Calif. where you can find many Poke Restaurants and being more and more popular,  this Poke in Idaho is as good if not better than others we have visited.  Even if it is a little overpriced ,it is worth the freshness and amount served,  VERY tasty, large assortment.
Problem is, Idahoans will not visit the Poke restaurants, all they will eat is beef, chicken ,biscuits and gravy.  If only they will try FISH POKE BAR, they will enjoy a change in diet and maybe even feel better about themselves.

I have been here twice. I don't live in ID but go when I visit a friend. The local beer sampler was great and fun to try so many beers. The last time I had the fried chicken. The batter was crispy and fantastic. My only complaint was the batter really needed salt and seasoning. They seem to rely too much on the gravy for flavor. Before that I had a lobster pasta which was great. I've tried bites of other dishes and several apps. Overall the food is great. Staff is friendly and helpful. The beer list is epic!  I will continue to go back when I visit.

I have now eaten here three times and hope to never eat here again. The place is filthy. Under tables, floor and seats just aweful. The food is less than acceptable, mostly tastes like frozen dinners in the microwave. Staff is friendly and nice but it can't make up for poor food and sitting at a dirty table.
Yummy food! Loved all their appetizers. Service was great and they had a good selection.

Selfishly don't want to rate 5 stars... because this local place keeps growing in popularity!  We love it and have enjoyed many amazing meals, beers, and wines here! 
Expect small, busy, and a wait.  It's okay! Anything good is worth the wait!   Trust the fresh sheet! It's always amazing!

From the moment I walked in I felt so welcomed, they informed me where all products are and offered a drink. Olivia did my hair and she was so great, I left loving my hair and feeling great about myself. She truly cared about me. It was the best experience I've had at any salon or spa. Thank you ladies for all you do!

This was our first time here the food was cold homemade chili cold french fries cold. We had the clubhouse sandwich the bacon was straight out of the refrigerator,  I asked for no Italian dressing on the sandwich they must've thought I said extra. Not worth the 20 minute drive to get here. The service was great though the food not so much.

The food was cold, who likes cold Mac and Cheese? They service wasn't anything to write home about. The meatballs and spaghetti was great oh wait they ran out of meatballs. But it wouldn't have mattered it was cold too! Too many restaurants to choose from will not be back.
Was taken here for a celebration.  Staff was great and the food was tasty.  Felt is was competitive for the price.  Atmosphere was right on for lunch.

Oh -my -gosh I might have just found my new favorite pizza place !!!!! The pizza itself was sooo bomb I made a create your own , the drinks they have are also amazing !!! They have this hot pink fruit drink mix it with the lemonade and it will blow your mind!! I'll be back a lot (p.s my man and i both agree they are incredibly filling I'm trying to tell him it's because the ingredients here are so much better quality ! We are still full hours and hours later ! ) and all the staff was super super nice ! All things that are important while eating out they hit ! I highly recommend !!!

My husband and I are first time home buyers and needed to replace some flooring in our home.  When we first contacted FDF, they were prompt to come over and give us an estimate.  Their estimate was about $100 less than the next estimate that we got.  It seemed like a great deal, so we went with them.  We paid a non-refundable deposit and got the carpet ordered.   The contractor was supposed to come on 8/9 at 9 am, so my husband and I got to work tearing up tile.  We checked with FDF to see if we needed to tear up the underlayment.  We explained what kind it was and that it was under tile.  They told us that it did need to come up.  So we got to work.  The evening before the 9th, they let us know that the contractor wouldn't be able to come until 1 pm the next day.  Things happen, so we rolled with it.  We told FDF that we were having trouble pulling up the underlayment, and they quoted us $2/foot to remove it.  We got about half the room done, and told them we would pay them to do the rest.  Around noon, on 8/9, we called FDF to make sure we were still on for 1.  Nope.  Now the contractor wouldn't be coming until 3.  He gave us the contractor's number, and the contractor said that he probably couldn't make it that day at all.  We were able to agree that the contractor would come and tear out the underlayment and start on the flooring the next day.  He came by around 4 pm on 8/9.  He said that they didn't have the equipment to tear up the underlayment and that it hadn't needed to be torn up at all.  Awesome.  We also had a small tile entry that needed to be cut.  The contractor had not been made aware of that and didn't have the equipment to do that job either.  FDF let us know that we would get to foot the bill for the rental equipment needed to tear up the underlayment, because they wasn't aware that their contractor didn't have that equipment.  Really?!? I assumed, when I hired them, that they would have contacted the contractors to make sure they had the necessary equipment.  Isn't that what I was paying them for?  I also was not happy that we would have $590 in additional costs because of FDF's recommendation that the underlayment needed to come up. Again, I was hiring them for their expertise.  I was also being charged for 180 feet of underlayment removal, when there was only 140 feet.  My floor was torn up, I needed them to get started because I have 3 small children, and I would have been out my deposit.  I was kind of in a bind.  The contractors got started the next day.  They accidentally broke the tile in the entryway.  Fine, accidents happen.  But it wasn't my accident, so I shouldn't be responsible, yes.  Nope.  Apparently I was also going to be responsible to pay fix that too, because I'm paying for everything else, why not a new entryway.  The contractors did agree to carpet a small hallway to offset the broken tile, which was nice.  But the contractors were overbooked, so they weren't able to finish the entryway for 5 more days.  Finally, the day after the job was finished, I got a call from FDF about payment.  They told me that someone would be in the office all day.  I went with my payment, and no one was there. So I slid it under the door.  I'm busy and have 3 kids.  I can't drive back and forth trying to catch you.  If someone isn't going to be there, and you know I'm bringing a payment, please let me know.  The breakdown: whatever their estimate is, add $400-500, whether because of miscommunication or mistake you are probably going to pay more.  Don't count on them clearly communicating the job to the contractor or making sure they have the right equipment.  It seems like they didn't clearly explain the job to our contractor, which made things more complicated for me.  So my final verdict is: 2 stars because my floor looks amazing!  The contractors really did a great job.  Would I work with them again?  Probably not, I'd just work out a deal with a contractor myself, it would be much less of a hassle, and then I think I would get a better idea of what the job would actually cost.  Would I recommend them to a friend?  No.

Delicious! Such a relaxed and fun place to have lunch with friends. I loved that there was no pressure to leave, as we and our friends stayed talking for quite some type me. The food was delicious and I was happy to see more than just pizza on the menu! The server was kind & attentive without being obtrusive and was also quick to check in with us. I'll definitely be returning!

The front register girl working today (only 3 days on job) has zero happiness in her. Work on greetings! Everything in lobby is dirty. I would schedule a deep cleaning once a week. We own businesses and I know that cleanliness and customer service is the only way to survive as a business. Smile girls!!

I guess I am just not a fan of Buffalo Wild Wings no matter where it is located. I feel like the food is just average, nothing spectacular. Especially now knowing they get their chicken from Tyson. I felt the server lacked social skills. My boyfriend got the boneless wings which were not that good. I felt like I was eating in a school room cafeteria to be honest. I would rather eat at a different restaurant and from now on I will.

I am on the fence between 3 stars and 4 stars for Kahootz, we had awesome service and the location is exactly what I imagine for a local Idaho Ale House, which I loved. They had a great beer selection and the outdoor seating looks lovely. Food wise I wasn't blown away I had the chicken sandwich on special and my husband had the steak sandwich. He found his sandwich heavy on the horse radish and my sandwich was just a sandwich. The fries seemed a little cold/not as fresh as I would have liked. I think I would try here again for maybe drinks and appetizers.

Visited this restaurant.  Service was fast and the staff friendly.  

Found the spaghetti very good and in strips like traditional spaghetti.  Judging from other reviews I found the product flavorful and good.

Please try this place.
We love wok fusion. The food is the best Chinese food we have found since we've moved here. The people are friendly and the place is clean and we are repeat customers

Great food and a lot of fun!

Make sure to use A lot of sauce can be a little flavorless.

So just learned this place was a chain (which to me is a good sign that I couldn't tell) but it explains why the menu is so extensive. That being said, We've been about 3 times now and it continues to be so awesome, I'm changing my review to a 5. I mean there's only 1 in Idaho so who will know the difference? Service has always been good, love eating outside if the weather is nice, and the food is great! 

We've tried a bunch and this is everything that's delicious: 
Hummus app, poke nachos, Cuban pork dip sandwich, short rib ravioli, Nashville hot chicken, and kids pizza.

Stuff that's good but not great: ahi tuna salad, kids spaghetti, and kurobuta burger.

Highly recommend!

Pros: great food, great atmosphere, great service!

Cons: none as of yet
Chorizo dog was amazing!!! The donuts are light and airy and the flavors are really unique!
Please pizza is it interesting concept will you lay out your pizza and they build and cook it while you wait in line and get exactly what you want.
Walking in and the staff was nice and welcoming! Started off with the Crab Pops and it was delicious! The chicken dishes and beef dishes were very yummy! I wish it was closer to my house!

We love to try new Mexican food restaurants so we decided to try Pueblo Lindo. What a waste of time and money. They were overpriced and the beans were watered down. You can usually tell how authentic a Mexican restaurant is by how the beans and rice taste. The chille relleno sauce tasted like tomato paste. The rice was tasteless. They serve small portions in a huge plate and the flour tortillas were stale. I left there feeling unsatisfied and $30.00 poorer.

Worst customer experience of my life I only give it one star because yelp won't allow me to give it no stars. I refuse to ever take my business to another walgreens, as well as switching my pharmacy. I went with my family to get some medicine for my 8 year old autistic cousin because he was sick and I decided to let him pick out a toy from the toy aisle as we were looking through the toys the closing manager (Jim Hensley) decided to approach us and inform us to put the toys back in the spot we found them (confusing to me seeing as we were looking and hadn't picked up a single toy) I replied saying that we would, and continued to look, Jim decided to start to walk away but then turn around and proceed to stare at me for a few minutes, when I looked back he decided to ask me if I had a problem?!? I was shocked and replied asking why he was staring at us and he replied with an increasingly confrontational voice that he was staring at specifically me! I'm sorry but who do you think you are Jim?? I've worked in retail and customer service most of my life and I find this unacceptable to approach a customer and speak so rudely is utterly ridiculous and I'm baffled how he ever got promoted to a manger? Was it because of what I was wearing or maybe my sexual orientation, maybe you thought i would steal the toy, not sure what it was that offended you? I'm still trying to figure out what was so wrong that I did, but I'll tell you this much I am well respected in my career and can afford a toy from walgreens (don't need to steal it) and do not appreciate being judged by the way that I look. Maybe Jim talks to all customers in this manner? Not quite sure but I recommend to stay away from walgreens in general seeing the disrespectful "mangers" that they hire, but if you must go to walgreens I strongly recommend any other one.
Fresh fish! Great flavor and comfy atmosphere. Very friendly. Think zen bento, but poke and more customization. Super stoked to find this place

I have eaten sushi all over the world and for the most part not never eaten at a place where I literally thought that the sushi was bad and by bad I mean literally in the case of the hamachi, gone bad.  The Saba was sub par and the only saving grace was the Ikura with quail egg and simply because you really can't screw that up....plop the eggs on top of each other.  Did I mention the hotate?  Normally a nice piece of fresh scallop.... Here some minced version of I am not sure what...also don't get lured in by the $1 sushi sign...a pathetic display of 1-2 slices off a sushi roll....all that said the service was great.

This was literally the worst dining experience ever! I came in with my family at noon sunday 11/4 and IVY ...our server took 5 min to even acknowledge us and tell us she would be back for our drink order. Finally she grabbed a drink for my daughter and a stella for my husband. When asking what the local drafts were she had no idea what they were and had to go write them down and come back. After 40 min on our food ticket our food finally arrived. My husband ordered the fajitas which looked great. My daughter order the Mac n Cheese which literally looked and tasted like Kraft... Her side was mashed potatoes that had obviously died in the window from sitting under the heat lamp for too long...I ordered the lunch special to start, chicken enchilada soup and boneless wing (sos)  sauce on side and 2 sides or ranch so she didnt have to run back and forth. My wings came out with some fries and the SOS....no soup and no ranch. I finally got my soup and ranch and tried the soup it was amazing! (Hence the one star) and my fries and wings were cold...I asked her to please just take it back...as I continued to get more and more frustrated Ivy explained that we could check out on their computer at the table. With out table full of dishes because we did not have our table pre-bussed all I wanted to do was just swipe my card and leave... After entering the tip the computer loaded and said sorry your total has changed...I went back into my bill and it had added a game that we did not play. We had to flag our server down and finally she came over we gave her our card and asked her to take the game off...she came back with the card and the ticket and still after all that we never had a manager come and appologize. I myself am a server...all servers should know beers exspecially when there is only 5 locals, Check tickets before they are ran to ensure the full order is delivered, pre-buss the table and make sure that when there is an issue a manager is notified and then after all that you should definatly NOT tell a guest having so many issues they can check out on a computer. I don't know if it was pure laziness or lack of training but ill never return to this place.

This place is terrific! We flew in today from So Cal and thought we would just bit the bullet and test the mexican food in Boise on our first night! Pueblo Lindo did not disappoint!! 
The Chili Relleno and Carne Asada taco were terrific, as was the Carne Asada Burrito my hubby had. We will definitely come back on our next visit to town!!

This place is so low key and hole in the wall, which is what makes it perfect.  Have not been there in a long time, but decided the other night it would be perfect for a date night.  We were immediately greeted by a very friendly staff member who had us sit wherever we wanted, except the big table in the corner.  They were kinda busy so when the waiter approached us after we sat down almost immediately it was a shock.  He was a very soft spoken person made us feel very welcome.  He took our drink orders and was back with those drinks in the blink of an eye.  Since we don't do date nights very often, we decided to splurge.  We ordered the wings, and at the time thought they were very pricey, but when they came out it was obvious why they were a little more expensive.  The wings were the whole wing!!  Not just flats, not just drum sticks, THE WHOLE WING!!!  In one piece!!!  They were amazing, nothing more can describe these things.
     My Fiancé ordered a Shrimp Scampi and I ordered the Pork Chop.  The food came out and it was stellar! The pork chop was huge.  It had to be 1.25" thick and still on the bone.  The sauce they put on it was buttery super flavorful, but it did not mask the taste of the actual meat.  I am allergic to shrimp, so I did not try her dish.  The look on her face though was one of pure enjoyment with every bite she took.  I highly recommend this place to anyone who loves good food, great service, with a laid back chill demeanor.

Wow, late on a Saturday afternoon there were more wait staff than customers. My husband and I walked in an no one who worked there acknowledged us so we walked over and sat at the bar at the far left corner. The wait staff never even looked our direction let alone say hello. Some did walk behind us several times, others were just standing around or on their phones. Even the owner (The Wife) was setting about 3 stools down from us with her back turned to the customers in the restaurant and she too was glued to her phone. We saw a couple other people walk in and they looked confused and to find a table and sit or to just stand there and wait. We like to support local and new businesses but after sitting there for quite some time and being ignored, we left. Still nobody noticed. I guess they don't need our business nor will they get it. Where did Customer Service go????

I love that this breakfast uses fresh ingredients.

Hidden away in the Kohls shopping center, it may be a little hard to find. It was worth seeking out.

The corned beef is huge, tender chunks or fresh corned beef. The seafood bennie or seafood omlert is especially good as well. It looks like EVERYTHING is fresh and well presented.

I took off one star for the hash browns and hours of operation.

The hash browns should be a golden brown, not a pasty white with a little burn on top. I know you want fresh, but a little more oil would ho a long way.

I found this place at a meeting with friends. Went back for breakfast before only to find they open until 8 am. C'mon -you are a breakfast establishment! Open for breakfast.

I understsnd this is their 3rd time change for ooerating hours in the very short time they hsve been open.

I fear this will be their demise. How can customers ever get to know you?

We've been bowled over by the very friendly service and unbeatable value with the dollar sushi deal on Mondays (and today the sign says Tuesdays, too).   We've been so often since my May 2011 review that the servers know us and know exactly what we typically order.  This special is available ALL DAY Monday and Tuesday.

Our two favorite items on the dollar sushi deal are the Hana and the Tiger.   They are like $12 and $13 on the regular menu... but a whole 10-piece roll  costs only five bucks on dollar sushi days.   Total bargain!

If you don't know what you want off the bat, or if you want some variety, ask to see "the cart".    It has all the dollar deal items on it, and you can get as many or as few as you like.

The restaurant also has three large teppanyaki tables and three special Japanese-style rooms where you sit on a cushion.   Very cool!

I'm a big soda drinker, and my soda is always kept full.   Restrooms are very clean and generously-sized.

I have ordered takeout from this place 3 times now . I tried to like it by trying new items each time . 
Im sorry but this place has the bland food . Even when I asked to have it Spicy it's still missing something . 
Won't be ordering from them again

I worked with dan. He was very nice, but used old nail polish, and so now my nails are bubbly. And the polish was not painted on cleanly. I could have done a better job if I had the color at home:/ his station was also very dirty and made me a little hesitant about him using the tools on me. Especially not seeing him even take the time to brush off his station for the girl after me. I will not be here again.
Kahootz is awesome- one of my very favorite places to get well thought out food with great flavor. You can't go wrong with their specials- always exceeds my expectation

Well it was eventually going to happen. In 41 years I have never refused to pay for meal. That ended tonight! After an excruciating hour and a half wait in what had to be a fire code violation waiting area we finally got seated only to be confronted by a rude server. Fine, we can deal with that. Ordered, got our drink refills (after literally having to yell to get our servers attention) aaaannnddd the food arrives. My father in laws ribeye was very thin and cooked well done (ordered medium rare) and was missing the ribs, my prime was not only well done (yup med rare again) but the meat was grey as though it had been microwaved. My wife's ribeye was cooked right but was one of the toughest and rubberiest pieces of meat I have ever seen and my kids fries were so over salted they refused to eat! I complained and was told that they would get me a to go box so I could take new steaks home! ARE YOU KIDDING ME! So ya, no stars are deserved here but are required to post. Avoid at all costs on Friday or Saturday nights!

It's a shame because this used to be my favorite spot when they first opened, but they have dropped several notches across the board from quality of food to service to management seeming to care. The only thing that remains second to none is their beer selection, but that doesn't even earn them much credit because when I was in yesterday they couldn't even seem to pour the right beers we ordered! Ordered a strong IPA, and was brought a Bud Light. The server proceeded to argue that he had "punched it in" correctly and no effort was made to rectify what was clearly the wrong beer.

The food here used to be amazing and spot on, especially their pizzas. Not only have they gotten rid of the best pizza on their menu (the Thai pizza), when you order a different kind they don't even finish cooking them (are they in a hurry?).

Management used to stop by every time we visited to check how things were going and it's now been 4-5 consecutive visits with no one stopping by.

Sorry guys, but I'm done giving you chances to fix this. Stop acting like a half-rate chain and fix your issues and I might come back. Until then I will be perfectly happy to spend my money at one of the other myriad options at The Village.

I thought this breakfast restaurant was awful. Chicken fried steak had a large gristle/vein that was totally unappetizing. Hash browns had an odd taste. Food was lukewarm. Could not finish meal. Husband liked his omelet. French toast and pancakes were cold with cold butter that would not melt and cold syrup. There is no microwave so no way to heat up. Only 3 other tables occupied. The music combined with the tv news was too much.  Other reviewers like this restaurant. Probably should try something different on the menu but not sure I would return.

They have great customized pizza for $7.25 a pizza.  It reminds me of a sandwich shop because they have all of the toppings at the front. You can choose as many toppings you want and they will build your pizza in front of you. 

They have a huge variety of toppings ranging from your normal pizza toppings to artichokes, ricotta (which adds and extra flare), pesto sauce and a lot of other choices. 

They have a lot of drinks including various sweet teas as well as an unsweetened ice tea.

Now for the downside; it's incredibly noisy. This will have a huge impact on your experience. My recommendation is to take it to go or eat outside. If you plan on this, then you'll enjoy the pizza and not be annoyed by the atmosphere. Although if you just plan on a lot of noise it won't bug you.

All in all it's a great place for good tasting reasonably priced pizza.

Out of all chain restaurants, this is by far my favorite. First of all, the rolls. Oh my goodness the rolls. They are probably the best thing I have ever tasted and add in their delicious cinnamon butter, it just melts in your mouth. I try to restrain myself to only one or else I'm not hungry for my dinner but it never works... I usually eat three (don't tell anyone). Secondly, their steak is so good. This is probably some of the best steak I've had that costs $10-$20. It is always so tender and melts in your mouth. I always get the 11 oz. sirloin cooked medium, covered in mushrooms, with a side salad and loaded sweet potato, also delicious. I am usually so full after rolls and my salad, I can only get a couple bites of my steak in. This is perfect though, because Texas makes for the best leftovers! It's probably a little sad how excited I am for the leftovers, but I don't care! 

The ambiance is definitely southern Texas/Mexico style with some really cool decor. It is, however, super loud. It never bothers me much, but I can see how it could bother some other parties. 

There isn't a ton of vegetarian options, but my mom always loves going here for their "country veg plate". You get to choose four sides as your entree. There are plenty of vegetarian sides to choose from.
So glad this restaurant came to the neighborhood. Service is great. Food is delicious. Ambiance takes us to traditional Mexico. Great for families, groups or a date!
This is honestly a super authentic steakhouse with an awesome bar. Would definitely return!
Absolutely the best Mexican restaurant in town. The habanero salsa is the best salsa I've ever had and the "pico" cabbage salsa is a really good twist.
REALLY good service, great look, DELICIOUS scones, great food, not expensive! No bad side going here! I'd recommend anyone to come here. Especially during the late evening like we did.

Food is good, especially if you are a connoisseur of true Italian pizza, but overpriced for the portions. Flavors are unique - at least for the Treasure Valley, so it can be a fun place to experiment with new things. Service is satisfactory, but I've never encountered anything extraordinary. Atmosphere is great for date night or business meeting and there is a decent patio that opens onto the Generations Plaza.

this location is fairly consistent for food quality/portions along with service.  We usually stop here a least one or twice when visiting family in Meridian/Nampa area.   Parking is ample and location is easy to get to.

Who puts cilantro in Cole slaw?!?! I made a Door Dash order and when my delivery arrived half my order was missing, I phoned the restaurant & my Dasher had to make another trip (she got an extra tip) my fish & chips were good, but I really couldn't eat the "Cole slaw" one because of the cilantro & second, I'm pretty sure they forgot the dressing. Neither me or my coworker got the condiments we requested (ranch dressing & tartar sauce) but we both got ketchup instead...good food, but attention to detail is everything
Chris and Tyler provided great service at the eagle rd, ID location. Thanks boys!

I have been to the one in Meridian a couple of times now. The food is awesome, the service is spot on and the atmosphere is great!  I absolutely love this place and will go as often as I can.  I had the Portobello, Sausage and Fontina Flatbread.  It is so good I could eat it every day....

This place is a local hot spot! When I was here, people of many ages and lifestyles stormed the building of knowledge and entertainment...also known as the Meridian Library. Wow. Who would have known?

The entrance is welcoming and warm and definitely laid out to allow teens and adults alike to be a little more loud as they enter. The entrance is closed off, if you will, so the sound will not carry into the quieter areas.  I see this as a great place for people to hangout, chat, snack if they wish, prior to actually entering where the books area.
For a Thursday night, the place was bustling. I just walked around looking through books, checking out their monthly librarian picks, goat books, and relaxing next to the outdoor waterfall on the patio. If you need to escape your day for a few, think about the Meridian Library Patio. What a gem and I am serious!

Once I found the book I wanted to take home, the librarians were wonderful! They listened to my library stories of when I was a kid and proceeded to tell me about the SUMMER ADULT Reading program, like when we were little. They have prizes, drawings,  and check off all your lego looking blocks, and get a free book for completing your nightly 40-minute reading. What a great idea. I have such fond memories of my experiences at my local library and Meridian is such a special place to keep those library memories going, especially for children. (Or adult like me that still act like a child.)

So the moral of my rave is, this place is great! I also love that when you check out books, your receipt tells you how much money you save by checking out your book! What a wonderful idea!

This place is clean, welcoming, and you are sure to find a quiet nook to escape to the world of reading.

Now just go!
(The reason for my 4 is because I want to frequent this spot to see if my experience is consistent. I will update after a few more stop-ins.)

This review is based on a Take Out order made this afternoon, June 15, 2017. We only live about 1.5 miles from the restaurant and the plan was to take advantage of Boneless Thursday to share with some family members a dinner from BWW, as they'd never had them.

First, the wings were "ok", they could have used more sauce. We ordered several different flavors, so our family members could find one that they liked. After this experience, in my opinion, if I'm going to get myself in a situation where I need wings via take out/delivery, I can have a better tasting wing from Pizza Hut.

We also ordered four of their side Caesar salads. After our experience, I would highly recommend NEVER ORDERING TAKE OUT SALADS FROM BWW. For 4.49 per salad, they were very undersized, and the lettuce was wilted and brown. I think each person might have received the equivalent of two and a half romaine stalks on their salad. I uploaded a picture to share what 4.49 gets you.

I don't understand the  high ratings at all. When I got out of my car I witnessed an employee emptying the garbage while on FaceTime. When I walked in I saw him put the garbage can touchIng a prep table which had hundreds of piece of cheese on it. He then put the can back in the dining room and went right to the register  without washing his hands. He then expedited food (put the food into bags) for the drive in. The dining room was filthy and the burger I had was cold. I threw my food away and left    Someone is going to get sick here for sure.

Stopped in to try the sushi rolls and were pleased with the service and the quality of the food. We had the Crown roll, Tempura roll, and a third roll which I don't recall the name of and they were very filling. Extremely pleased and will definitely come back with the kids next time.

This venerable chain is consistently good and the Meridian location is no exception. We had an unruly party of 8 extended family members. James was terrific and handled the various personalities, and the different levels of alcohol consumption, with professional aplomb. Thoroughly enjoyed the experience.
20/10. Get the B.A.T + chai. You wont regret it. The food? Bomb. The drinks? Bomb. The donuts?? Oh SO bomb

I haven't been to the dentist in a few years, okay more like 3 or 4. Jarvis dental was very accommodating and friendly considering all the work they had to do just to get these chompers of mine clean again. I had an appointment in May and they sent me a text that a spot came open. I called right away and they got me in the same day. Sara who did the cleaning had her work cutout but was awesome the whole time. She was concerned about my comfort and doing the best job. She always told me what to expect during each step of the cleaning. Kudos to a job well done. I very happy to have a dentist I am comfortable with and trust. 

8/9/18 update- Still a fan and even more happy after the last visits. Keep up the good work!

I'm shocked to see low ratings on here for Integrity pest control. I've been using them for several years with great outcomes every time. After yet another positive outcome with Wayne I was compelled to leave him a positive review.
I prefer working with owner/operator companies instead of big brands.
Wayne takes the time to address my initial problems and after inspection of the house usually finds one or more things which require attention. Then he takes the time to show me what he found, educates me on the insects/problems as well as the treatment. He's very thorough and never seems rushed.
Overall, I have been pleased and impressed with every interaction I have had with him.

$7.25 for a personal pizza with all the toppings you want. It is a little bigger than your typical personal pizza so the price seems about right. The crust is average-ish as are the toppings. The sauce is...sauce. Overall, you get an average tasting pizza that's ready in about 3 minutes from the time they toss it in the (gas)oven and it's delivered by very friendly staff.

Wow!! This was our first time at Jakers. Good happy hour beer prices and discounted appetizers, can't beat that. The reason I gave this 5 stars is for the delicious French dip - soooo delicious. We had good service as well. We will definitely be back.

Came here for lunch on a Saturday and was surprised it wasn't packed.  There was plenty of seating open and as I waited for my friend to arrive the place slowly filled up.  Our server was very pleasant and checked in on us a couple times and said good bye before she headed off shift. 

They have a great selection of food items to satisfy your taste buds. You have the option of fine pies (pizza), sandwiches, soups, and salads.  I love their pick two option during lunch as it give you an opportunity to try a couple items on the menu. I settled on the Margherita and the Chicken Apple Walnut salad. I was happy with my choice as they both were tasty. 

The Meridian location offers a full bar so if you have a favorite drink you can request one or settle on one their several cocktail options, beer or wine. 

Great experience and I will be back.

Large portions! Food came quickly. Nice service. Water tastes like it's from a hose. Other than that we loved it and will be back!! If you get the queso try mixing in the complimentary salsa it's very good!! We can't wait to go back and the decor is darling!

I went and got a pedicure today. I left at 2:00 and by 3:30 part of the nail polish had gotten smuggled.  When I do my nails at home it doesn't get smuggled. Waist of $$. Know I will have to go to to store and pay more $ to try and get it fixed.

For the price? I do t think there is a better steak in Boise. If you want a better steak you're looking at $50-100/plate and you're an idiot. Sorry. This $20 rib eye is at least pretty good and at least $30 cheaper. I've stopped going to Chandlers, Ruth's Chris and the likes. It's just not worth it in comparison.

I feel like people are rating this place lower because they expect a fine dining experience?  The fact is, it very much a "middle class" eatery.  I personally loved their selection in both food and drink.  There is something on their menu for everybody.  I was also very impressed by the staff.  Our waitress was extremely pleasant and accommodating.  Expect what they are: a fun, often crowed upscale bar and restaurant.

Really great visit to this Chili's!  Food was tasty and service excellent.  Small things like the hostess noticed the table she was going to sit us at was a little dirty, so she stopped and got a CLEAN washrag and wiped down the whole table and the chairs and dried them so it was nice an clean when we sat down.  Our waiter knew the menu and the taps, our orders were done correctly.  Basically everything was just as it should be with manger and team working hard to provide a nice dining experience.  We'll be back!

My husband and I use TPD Property Management to manage our 18 rental units. This company runs an excellent ship and Courtney and Carly are a cohesive and complementary team. We have full confidence in their professionalism, their abilities, and their reliability. We have full assurance that our business and rental well-being are being cared for at the highest level. They are on the ball and always on top of their game! They get things done in a timely manner and operate with fairness and integrity at every level. We are exceedingly happy with this team and the way they conduct their business. Under their professional business care, we have profited significantly more than we did with the previous Property Management Company. We highly recommend TPD Property Management.

Where to start? Great atmosphere, great food great service, all at one place?! Yes!! I had a delicious filet mignon: melt in your mouth, and cooked to medium perfectly! Salad was mixed greens (delicious), steak sandwich wasn't full of griddle and fat, and the prawn appetizer.. I wonder if anyone has larger prawns! Scrumptious.
Yes best meal I've had since we moved to Idaho We will be back The chain could and wings were the best I've tasted not to dry very messy to eat thoroughly enjoyed it

I've only been here a few times since they moved from Park Center but I really enjoy this restaurant.  I love the ambiance of this place and usually you pay for the decor in your meals but not here.  Prices seem to be consistent with other places in town.  They had built an additional sunroom in the last couple years and I love sitting in there.  They have nice big windows, the chairs are comfy and there is a nice water feature in the sun room.  Last time we sat at the table next to the water feature and it was a little loud during conversation so if you can, don't sit next to it.

We came here Sunday (Sunday Brunch from 10am-2pm) after church and my friend and I both ordered the Brunch Burger which included an egg, hash browns and bacon and it was excellent.  The fries were really seasoned well and it came with some of the best fry sauce I have had.  My other friend ordered the soup and salad (all you can eat) and it included a variety of soups such as Clam Chowder, Chicken Noodle, Chicken Tortilla, Lobster Bisque and a Vegetable soup (I am not sure if these are the same soups every Sunday but it was for this day).  She also enjoyed her lunch and said the soup and salad were excellent.

We went around 1:30pm on Sunday so the restaurant was quiet but we had a great waiter who took really good care of us and kept our drinks full.  He had a great personalty and we really enjoyed our lunch.  

They have Happy Hour every day from 4pm to 6pm and after 9pm to close Monday through Saturday.  Looking forward to trying it out.

The staff are all great people and really friendly the layout of the store is open and spread out so you don't feel crowded in small isles like some of the older stores and it a great to finally have a Maverik in the area also the store and parking lot are very clean I will differently be there on a daily basis

Is the Yard House king when it comes to the village? The answer sadly is NO.  Where it's prime location, robust menu, lively ambience give it points. It quickly is lost in food quality and service.  

  Where most people will enjoy this place and rave about it, I simply can not.  Remember MEDIOCRE is not good enough for your money!  My friend and I were quickly greeted and seated with NO wait...ok wait, It was a Sunday night close to 7pm to be fair.  Our orders were quickly in as he ordered the bacon cheeseburger and I felt a bit more fancy and wanted the French dip (I've had it many times)  

  Our experience started off well and I was impressed to say the most part, the food arrived and then it shifted.  I tasted my fries and they were barely warm, I also asked my friend and he agreed his were the same.  I began to eat my french dip and it was lukewarm, as well as the aujus was just cold  (the best part!) We figured we would just make do with the fries and entrees but have her replace the aujus.  It had been quite a wait for the food and we weren't willing to wait for remakes. 

  Where we recieved great service before we were now not being checked on, our drinks were empty and we were not asked how the food was.  She finally came and I was able to get my new aujus, it was lukewarm but I guess that's better than cold.  This was a very dissapointing visit for me and not what I'm used to, and shame bc I brought a visitor to whom I bragged about this place.  Surely we can cook 2 HOT sandwiches with fries that are HOT, when u go to place and pay to be fed it should not feel like you are getting luke warm left overs.  

  Overall- the wait and the ambience is not worth the food quality and the lack of service.
Great food & wonderful staff! Went here for our anniversary and was not disappointed. They were busy but the wait was not long and the experience was worth it
he filed my teeth too short without asking me!! I simply wanted my teeth to be straight and that's it. now my teeth are RUINED

I eat at noodle and company often. This location in particular seems extra nice and clean. The girl that took our order was more than accommodating to our requests. That is something I appreciate very much. 

It's Valentine's Day and they are very busy, however our food arrived quickly, it was prepared correctly and tasted great, the restaurant was clean and nice.
Great food, we came in for lunch.  The soup was very good.  All 3 dishes were great! Prime Rib and Frisco sandwiches were A+, will be back so happy this place opened!
Went with two friends for lunch. I had the veggie burrito and absolutely loved it. Can't wait to go again and again and again!

An absolute great place!  From the steak to the cake this was all good food.  The service was prompt and happy to be there as well.   
I would go back next time I am in town.

It's nice that this place is open late but for the price of the items they just don't deliver.  My food came out barely warm and over salted.  Also my margarita on the rocks was 90% ice.  Not worth the price tag.  Daytime plates seem to be slightly better but not by much.  
Staff and ambiance are pleasant but unfortunately it's all a front for an overpriced low quality food and drink experience.

Good food, service and ambience! They've got a few new dishes on their menu. $6-$8 beers, but a pretty impressive range to chose from. Pretty crowded over the weekends.
Must Try: Deviled Eggs, Blueberry and Banana Crumble.
The food is all made from scratch and tastes wonderful, the service is fantastic, and the interior makes you feel like you just stepped into Mexico.
I LOVE Jakers!  So does my entire family! It is a great treat every time we go!  The service is awesome and the food outstanding!  I highly recommend this restaurant!

My family and I recently moved to Boise and our new home has a stacked stone fireplace centered in the living room. Mounting the TV there (Samsung, 48" LED) definitely requires professional assistance so I called Ben and we spoke for almost 10 minutes. Ben said it's a tricky job but he's hung mounts like this before. Prior to scheduling a visit, Ben requested that I take a few pics and text them over so that he could better evaluate the project. So, I promptly took 3 and sent them right over, BUT, never heard from him again. I called back the next day, leaving a voicemail, and tried again the following week; also sent another text to make sure the # was correct. Nothing, just radio silence, which I thought was odd. If the project was more difficult than he anticipated, that's ok, I just wish he would have given me a simple response, you know, a common courtesy reply, via text or phone. Blowing me off like that is unprofessional, to say the least.
Great food with great portions. 40 tap beers and full bar. Love that they take orders on ipads. Fun friendly staff with a ton of big tvs. This is the taphouse of north meridian!!!

Joe and I had been wanting to try this place out since moving to Meridian. We finally hit it in time for happy hour! Joe and I appreciate a nice, descent size happy hour menu with some variety since we tend to go during these times of the day to save some cash money! :) With plenty of flatbread, oils to dip, beer and yummy cocktails to try we had a great experience. The atmosphere was awesome and you kinda wanna just hang out. Our table was tucked a little in the back but the employees were attentive. The manager even stopped by and asked if we'd been in before. He informed us a little about the restaurant  and their popular lunch special they have. The flavors and the deals are bringing us back for sure.
     P.S.
       I cant  wait for it to warm up so I can sit out on their super cute patio. I love me some outdoor seating!

This place has become our favorite Mexican food restaurant. They've got great service and great food and a friendly atmosphere. We've had quite a variety of their dishes and have to say that they outshine practically everyone here right now for authentic Mexican food. Their Arroz con Pollo is yummy!

As a vegan, I really appreciate Yard House! They have a whole menu dedicated to meatless FULL meals. Our waiters have always been wonderful, and their Sangria is amazing. My boyfriend and I love to watch the Seahawks games there. So fun!

I will not be going back !!! I have been going there practically every week for a year and never had a problem . But yesterday I went and the mixed up my tots for friends so I just called to inform them that if there was another hotdog basket order they might have the tots . Just for a heads up . Then the girl ask do you want me to fix it and puts some tors for you ? I told her no that's ok I could not come right back I was back at work . She so nicely said what if I put your name down and we will just comp a whole new basket . So when I called to them them know I was coming so it would be ready the girl told me well I don't have your name down she then asked me if I had my ticket from the last one I said she told me she would put my name down so I threw it out. She rudely said will then the only thing I could do on a mess up was replace the tots I wasn't the one who asked for the whole basket to be replaced it was the employee . So I was upset and I said ok can you put them down  and she hung up on me . So I called back and said I think I was disconnected she said oh I thought you said you weren't coming back so I hung up . I t would of been nice to say ok we'll put those down  bye!

My guess is Casa Del Matador is going for the fine dinning/upscale Mexican restaurant vibe. It is a beautiful restaurant and I bet in the spring/summer the patio would be a great place to people watch and enjoy a drink and maybe some chips and salsa. They do have a wood burning fire place in the middle of the restaurant that was wonderful on a cold winter night. I left with my hair smelling like campfire though. Not a bad thing, just something to be aware of. 
We missed Happy Hour, but from the menu it looks like they have some very good deals on select appetizers. 
Nothing bad to say about the service, except a little on the slow side. But our waitress was very friendly, offered suggestions and handled our large group very well.
The food - just okay. Some good and some not good. And on the pricey side, at least for Mexican food. But it's in The Village, so this isn't surprising. The chips and salsa are very good. For another appetizer we ordered the Queso Fundito. It's melted cheese with pablano peppers and caramelized onions and comes with your choice of warmed corn or flour tortillas. We choose the flour based on our waitresses suggestion. The queso had no flavor at all, especially for all the peppers and onions that we could see in the dip. The tortillas were good and nice and warm, but even dipping the chips in the dip didn't help much, except to add some much needed salt.
For dinner I ordered the carnitas tacos and my husband ordered the braised beef tacos. Both plates came with two tacos, Spanish rice and black beans. Both of our tacos were very good. The pico that comes on them was spicier than most places, but it was delicious. Sadly the tacos were the only thing on the plate that had any flavor. The rice was undercooked (crunchy) and flavorless and the black beans tasted like they'd just been scooped out of a pan of boiled beans. There was a little cheese on them, but not enough to add any flavor. So we each had a plate of two tacos for $12 each, because neither one of us ate more than a bite of the rice and beans. Good thing we filled up on chips and salsa.
Everyone at the table who ordered the Cadillac margaritas enjoyed them. Not overly sweet. The menu shows a lot of specialty margaritas that sound interesting. So I might try it again for Happy Hour and a drink. I'm a little more open minded than my husband. He said never again - unless we have a gift card or someone else is paying.
Great place! Mgr. Ken Kennedy and his team are fantastic! Especially Kayla and Will and Sabrina and Kevin and Misti AND Justin! The Foster's

First - walking in outside smelled like sewage
Second - flies bombarded us continually as we ate 
Third - we were in little before 5 and after being sat no one came by for 10 minutes 
Fourth - the wait to order was like forever 
Fifth - 1/2 my wings were almost cool and 1/2 okay hot
Sixth - after being served no one even asked us about empty glasses 
Seventh - after taking my cc to waiter and chasing him down he brought cc back and apologized cause he lost track of a table outside his area but explained "it happens all the time"

Upside - the wings that weren't cool (temp wise) were among best ever outside of upstate NY 

Still the service was terrible and waits unacceptable.  Sorry I went there.   Won't again if I can avoid it.

Lied to us about health of our kitty.  Refused to spay! Caused us to go to another vet for exam and she was fine. They said their vet confirmed illness. Once our vet said she was healthy we went back for spay. SNIP had no record of this drama. Well it happened and cost me money for lies and BS.  Avoid them. Go to a real Vet office.

I went online to see if there was a store near me, wallah 3 miles away. Called store to see if there were discounts or sales and yes, the sales were starting the next day. Went in the next day and was met with a salesman that spoke so fast, slurred words, and continued to say "like I said" and having never said once prior the things he had said were said before. Haha. Crazy. I asked him the difference between the low range, mid range, and high range suit and his answer was quality and fit. Haha. It was getting worse. He had me try on a jacket that was huge and when I said this is so roomy. He said some fit a bit looser but we can tailor it. I said but this one is huge. He looked at the tag and said oh, this is not the right size. Haha. I still don't know why this stores brands suits are worth buying over others and just don't know if I'll go back, ever. I need a salesman that loves what they do, knows their stuff, and can help me part with my hard earned moolah willingly because I've been made to look and feel good. Bad all around experience.
