We had her come it to groom our 9 month old English cream golden retriever. She did an incredible job and went above and beyond in my opinion.  We will continue to use her, we were super pleased with the end result!

Kahootz is a fun place that lives up to its reputation as a tavern that serves real food.  But more than that, they get customer service.  The staff greats everyone who enters and wishes all who leave a good night with a genuine attitude of hospitality.  I was fortunate to stop in on a night of their Ribeye Special.  Not typically a ribeye guy, this steak was tender, juicy and full of flavor.  Served over grilled asparagus and red potatoes you cannot go wrong.  And the beer selection was pretty impressive as well.  But again, it is the people that make the Kahootz Steak and Alehouse so special.  Do yourself a favor and stop in for food and fun.  And do it on a Monday or Tuesday so you can enjoy the ribeye!

My family went on New Year's Day and it was the worst service ever. Since we had two children we were singled out and treated terribly. FYI--they were well behaved!! Everyone was seated before us even though we arrived first. I will not ever go back and wouldn't ever recommend this place to anyone.

We gave this place a few more tries- what I've learned is that before they were telling me Becky was doing the haircuts but she wasn't every time, and it showed.  I was very unhappy w the cuts.  When Becky grooms my dogs, they are great.  I would emphasize letting only Becky groom your dogs and you should have a great experience.  I make a point to ask on the phone and when I arrive in-person, and the last couple of times, both dogs were groomed professionally and exactly as I requested.

I know now why they sell out of donuts!!
We tried the farmers market with bing cherry and goat cheese, dirty churro, 99 problems and they were all amazing. They have very interesting flavors, all well thought out and made with love. I love that they source local ingredients. I also had a hot dog which I wasn't sure about the brioche bun but it was delicious and their fries are the best! I can't wait to come back and try more flavors of donuts and savory items.

We got 4 donuts; dirty churro, south beach, California dreamin, and parrot head, and 2 coffees; salted caramel latte & Nutella nitro. The tops of the donuts (where the flavor was) were ok but their donuts are so big that the flavor doesn't carry through out the entire donut. We probably wouldn't go back just for donuts. Our coffees were less desirable. The salted caramel didn't have much flavor and the Nutella was EVERYWHERE! It was a mess. The idea of this sounds good but I think it would be better in a hot coffee where the Nutella can melt. We also got the Elote Loco Dog and the 208. Those were better than the donuts. Their hot dog buns are amazing!! Beware though that if your expecting a chorizo like the normal Basque chorizos we have around here, you will be disappointed. These ones taste more like the breakfast chorizo you get at the store. Still good, just different. Be prepared to spend over $30 for donuts and coffee, more if you choose to try the hot dogs.

I always try to visit here when in town.  Food is good and service is fast.  Portion sizes are large...I always have a doggie bag to bring home.  Try the rolls/butter...they are warm, delicious and a great way to start your meal.
I had the filet mignon and ribs...steak was cooked to perfection,,,ribs were fall off the bone.  Sauce is spicy..so be prepared.  
Only complaint was my food was heavily salted...I would have preferred to add in my own salt...but the next time I go back...I will ask for all sauces and seasoning on the side.

Not only is the food tasty...but the wait help is outstanding.  Everyone is friendly...attentive and just basically nice!  They make having dinner here a pleasant experience.
Delicious burgers and they have a fry sauce that can be addictive.   Customer service was wonderful too. It's definitely a great place to go for an inexpensive bite to eat.

I love this store. Always super helpful and friendly. I bought a bunch of stuff about 8 months ago. Phone cases, screen protector s and such. 
Decided to buy the unlimited phone screen protector program. Well, in the past 7-8 months they have replaced it 6-7 times at NO cost. 
Im actually walking out now with a new screen. Im in the building industry so my phone takes a beating. 

Definitely earned my business. Going back today to get my wife's and kids phones protected.

These guys know their donuts.  We tried regular donuts which are standard brioche with a light glaze and they were great.  The brioche was light with a mild flavor.  The raspberry glaze actually tasted like real raspberries.  Also tried the Nashville hot chicken sandwich.  The flavor was great, a bit of sweet and spicy.  Brioche is a bit more expensive as it's labor intensive to make correctly.  Honestly, I can't wait to go try more items from their menu.
We have been coming to this restaurant for over 12 years. The food quality, presentation and service is always great. The owner John is hands-on and it shows in his business. This is a must try.

Friendly staff. Slow for the food. You have to pay2$ for a basket of chips after the first one. I got a soda and found out it was 2.99$ for 1 drink. There are no refills included. The fajitas were ok but for the prices and no refills rule we will not be going back.

My wife and I stopped in this unassuming little cafe for lunch, wow were we amazed.  The food was extremely tasty and the service was beyond exceptional.  Can't wait to try this place for breakfast.  I don't think you can go wrong in this wonderfully run little cafe.

Excellent prime rib on Friday nights and the service is great (Thanks, Tyler!).  Great salads at lunch!  And did I mention the bread pudding???  Oh my - it's delicious - I've even picked up some to go for a dinner party!

I usually come here on Tuesdays where it has a special deal of 'BoGo' (Buy One Size, Get Another of the Same Size Free) Boneless Wings. It is usually a hit or miss with the dry rubs with the boneless wings so I would pass up on those. My absolute favorite sauces for my boneless wings are Honey BBQ and Parmesan Garlic. They give plenty of sauce and a ton of wings on BoGo Tuesdays. The servers I have been with were very friendly and laid back for such a busy night. I respect them for that.

These guys are truly amazing! I called in the morning and I was watching DirecTV by 5 PM. Professional install. He helped me install my remotes with all my televisions and gave me a personal business card  just in case if I had any questions. He explained everything to me. I've had DirecTV now for about eight months and have not had one problem. Couldn't be happier!

We have used Integrity Pest Control for over 4+ years.  Wayne has always been very thorough and very professional..  We have only had a great experience with Wayne.  His home service is reasonable and we have had no issues.  I would highly recommend this company if you need any pest control.

Great place to hang out with friends and have a drink. It can get a little spendy but its a great atmosphere.  Love sitting on the patio and people watching on a summer evening.  I love that they have vegetarian options and that actually means options not just salad. My favorite is there non meat chicken wings...delicious!

So good  steak is amazing 
Best salsa in town !!  Found original place in McCall
Was so so happy to hear they were also in Meridian 
Love this place and staff was very friendly

This is a fun family restaurant. Typical chain-type steakhouse. Most of the time the food is good, but not 100% of the time. The best thing about Texas Roadhouse are their buttered rolls and cinnamon butter they bring as you sit down.
From many visits to this restaurant we've learned to not go for the ribs. There are better places in town. Other steaks are very good. Their prime rib is pretty good too. Big portions are all over the menu. Sometimes I'm not in the mood for a big cut of meat, so I go with my favorite salad - the chicken critter salad. This is a HUGE salad with crispy pieces of fried chicken tenders.
One thing that has always been consistent is the service. Always very friendly and willing to fulfill any request. The decor is typical Texas-themed, a little on the stereotypical side, but fun - especially for kids. The country music is sometimes blaring and sometimes not. This is not a place to go for an intimate dinner full of conversation.
They have a full bar and while their signature margaritas are pretty good, as with most chain restaurants, you pay a lot for a minimal amount of alcohol. But their willing to add on a "kicker", a small extra of liquor for an additional charge. I stick with a draft beer. Definitely a better value in my mind.
This last visit the hubby got the Country Fried Sirloin. OMG! It was delicious and I will be getting it the next time. Their white gravy is so good! He got it on his smashed potatoes and I even dipped some of my chicken in it. Yummm

We met family for a quick catch up lunch. We were attended to immediately and the waitress, Zoe gave us a thorough run down of the menu. My husband loves to engage waitresses and we found Zoe more than up for the challenge. She was engaging, fun and efficient. We ordered boneless chicken with sauce. What we ordered was exactly as she described. We had additional requests that she promptly took care of. One of our family members had a question on the bill. Zoe took the time to thoroughly review the bill with him. She was amazingly patient!  The wings and sauce were good and met our hunger needs.
Very busy, nice little place. Pizza is good. Around $7-8 for a one person Pizza, you can choose your toppings.  Friendly staff.

What is funny is that I live in Nampa, but I am never there. I am always in Ada County. I get all my chores done in either Boise or Caldwell and then I come to my house in Nampa to eat, shower, and sleep. 
Meridian Library District is at least five minutes away from my job. So, when I order books and movies I send them to the location on Cherry Lane. Since the self publishing services are not available in Canyon County, I go to the events on Cherry Lane. 
This library is the go to place because it is easy to find and it is in the middle of everything. This is where the events are happening. If they are not here they are at the Boise library in downtown Boise. 
I like their system. Their electronics work way better than the ones at the NEW LIBRARY in Nampa. You can easily use the place where you return the books without any issues. It is easy to check out material. There is no waiting in line. You just swipe the material across the scanner and swipe your card and you are out of there within minutes.
My main complaint about this library is the fact that they really don't have it together when you are trying to renew your membership. It was a struggle to get the answer that I have to go to Nampa to renew my library card. I really wish I could renew it anywhere in Idaho. It makes sense since you can send books from all over Idaho there. Right?
My other complaint is the fact that they are constantly changing their website. I have found some fun and interesting things online that I wanted to revisit and play with. At one point they had that typing test on there. I also have a issue with digging around for the self published stories by Idahoans. They say that you have to be a member, but they make it impossible to locate it and utilize it. They also make it impossible for you to advertise your work that is on their site. Perhaps put that at the front to let the community know that you care about them?

Came in to order a pretzel...they didn't have it  anymore. Disappointed because that was my favorite...Order a Burger WELL done. I took two bites. It was ok...I only took two bites because We had ordered the new cheese curds. (Basically mozzarella sticks but in curds, not impressed) but I was full after having a few (tiny, but fried). Asked for a cup of potato soup to go so I could have lunch the next day and they were out! Out of soup. Come on. Hours later I heat up my burger and I bite into it and it's basically raw!!!!! I have a pic, but not sure if and how to upload it! Will never go back to chilis again. Don't send me coupons. Don't have the manager contact me. Gross and disappointed. Yuck!!!! Never, ever. Chilis and I are never getting back together!
Great Prime rib here! In fact everything good! Come early for dinner tho, cause there's always a line. Great service too.

Out of all the Texi-Mexican restaurants I've been to, this one is my favorite.
I regularly take my girlfriend here for dinner and we've never had any issues.
The staff is always kind, on point and accurate with our order.
Food is always fresh and drinks always cold.
Thanks Matador!

Small portions, bland food, and WAY over priced!!!! I would not come back even it was free! They only carry one salsa that is not very good might I add. Please save your money and time. Just a disappointment all around. Chips were thin and greasy. Taco was small and 90% pice de gallo. Soup lacked flavor despite being told it was "spicy". 

****WARNING****

What pissed me off the most was being charged for "spicy sauce" due to the fact they do not carry alternatives. Robbery and foolery. 

I will never return! And I will be sure to spread the word not to waste your time or money here. It should have been a clue that no one was eating here while I dined. I would give this place a 0/5 if it were possible based on the food and prices. Service was average.

I also did not appreciate listening to the servers complain about how horrible their lives are having to work all day. It's a choice and most people do it. It's called being an adult.
Happy hour food is pretty good and drink prices are right. Relaxing atmosphere at the village food for a quick bite or a date night with the movie theater next door. Definitely worth checking out
Don't let the outside fool you! Omgosh I love their steak salad! Full of fresh greens, veggies and cheese! The meat is tender and juicy too! The wait staff is friendly and make you feel welcome!
Food is okay. Service is very good and friendly. Pricey wine men for the quality of food. My steak was good, but not great. Best part was the baked potato. Husband had the burger which he liked.

First time eating at a Texas Roadhouse restaurant and I must say i was really impressed.  The atmosphere was quite lively with country music in the background, decor etc.  the food was really impressive.  I had the ribeye and half rack of rib combo.  The ribs I felt made the meal.  Pull off the bone and just the right glaze on the meat.  Would definitely go back there for the ribs.   The rolls and the butter were great as well.  Love the butter!!!!  Service was good, only issue I had was the seating for us was a little off and cramped.  The line dancing was cool, some were more into it than others.

My pizza was good, but I ordered a salad and they had to get it when I paid because they're assembly line didn't take it into consideration... Disorganized. My husband's pizza was raw. Seems like it didn't get blazed. They need some help, or a timer! Not going back.
Great service. Staff is very friendly and Dr Crowley is amazing.  So grateful we found this dentist.

Unfortunately the food wasn't good at all. 
The server only came to take out order and give us a check. Flies everywhere and even my wife got bit by a spider definitely not recommended 

Plus side drinks were good

I absolutely love the food here.  The last few times we had an inattentive waitress and were really leaning towards not coming back. Tonight we were provided excellent service from Hannah and our faith in the restaurant has made a change for the better. We hope they continue to provide service as excellent as tonight.

Ordered a few subs to go and got home and the whole order was wrong. 1 out of six subs was right. There were subs in there that we didn't even order. Not sure why it's so hard to get things right. This has happened a couple of times now at this location.

Traditional Neapolitan pizza that you can't find anywhere else. Everything is fresh and the service is amazing! Chicken arugula basil salad is the best and their pick two lunch combo is a screamin deal.  I love live music on Wednesdays and a wonderful happy hour every day of the week! 

Oh and the cookies!  Hot our of the oven chocolate chip cookies!  Ok ok I am done now.
Great happy hour. All drinks on discount. Stiff drinks on a budget. Food is a step above what you would expect from this type of chain.  Decent flatbread and steak bites.

A clean, inviting atmosphere, with an extremely friendly staff make this restaurant one that you will want to bring your family back to over and over again! Our experience here at Mongo's was GREAT! They really know how to have a good time while maintaining a professional feel. You could easily have a business meeting for lunch and then a family fun outing for dinner and you wouldn't even need to eat the same thing over again because there is such a huge selection of veggies and meats and sauces and spices and even extras like cheese or eggs or tortillas! So much more than your average Mongo grill!

Highly recommended if you want to have a great night out!
Came in for breakfast on a Saturday morning. Staff was friendly and the food was great!

Don't know if you were unexpectedly busy (for a Saturday) because service was terrible!! 
People lined up, empty dirty tables, no one acknowledges you standing there  at the door. People seating themselves once a table gets cleaned but not rhyme or reason as to how many sits at one table (1 man sitting at a table for 6, and 2 at a table for 4, rather than cleaning an empty table for more efficient and considerate accommodations). 

Once we sat down, waitress passes out menus to people standing in line rather than us who just sat down. Had to get up and get our own menus and ask for coffee 2 times. Once eating, had to continually ask for refills (cups are very small!) 

Food was decent but overpriced for small portions and comparison to other restaurants where portions are larger. Potatoes were tasteless. Had overcooked prime rib special (why did they ask us how we wanted it cooked) Idaho omelette substituted with ham rather than steak which barely had any in it, Only 2 long bell peppers slices and mostly ALL potatoes. Which I didn't need cuz It was served with hash browns. cinnamon roll was big but dry. Pancakes were just ok, and not very sweet. 

Lastly, bathroom had no toilet paper or towels and had to inform busy waitress who was hustling tables.  Noticed after tables were being cleaned, they didn't clean the floor from derby for next guest after children made a mess. 

This could be a good little Hotspot if you had some good management, a cashier, and more help in there For bussing (There was one dishwasher that occasionally got a break to come out and wipe tables.)  I felt sorry for the 3 young, inexperienced waitresses in there trying to do it al!! 

I may try again another time. Eggs Benedict and country fried steak looked good, and the lunches also looked worth trying.

I love this place! My husband and I have been to this location twice recently and had great service both times. We always get the fondue appetizer to start off with and get a large Caesar salad and a pizza to share. This restaurant is our favorite date spot. My only word of advise is if you go when it is cold outside don't sit by the window, it gets a bit chilly.

Very pleasantly surprised on our first visit! Had to give them 5 stars because I couldn't find a reason not to..... First off very friendly staff that provided top notch customer service. The food was fantastic, everything tasted fresh and was cooked perfectly. For the quality of their breakfast it was very reasonably priced, we look forward to coming back!

I really wanted this to be good. From the moment I called to place the carry out order it was bad. The young male that I spoke to was so rude. I really thought I could deal with that if the food was good but that wasn't the case. Pork and seeds tasted dry and old, mandarin chicken was fatty, pork fried rice was hard, potstickers tasted raw and watery, and low mein had a weird taste to it. The lady I spoke with when I called back and asked for a manager was very apologetic and nice but we won't be back. This was such a waste of time and a bummer experience.

They still have a decent grilled cheese. They still have that stupid delicious Manhattan (I know beer's there thing...I like beer, I do! But, their Manhattan?  My people. Liquid poetry.). And, speaking of poetry...their Brussels Sprouts. For heaven's sake. I just can't even...the only thing to be done in times like this is to call upon Shakespeare for help:

To Yard House's Crispy Brussels Sprouts (with ripped potatoes)

Shall I compare thee to a summer's day?
Thou art more lovely and as piping hot:
What is a "ripped potato," they all say
Who cares? They go with you and aren't a tot
Sometime too hot the spice of others burn
And too often over or under-cooked
And for those lesser sprouts I never yearn
By chance, or chef's choice, to them I'm not hooked
But thy extreme tastiness *is* for me
With your savory sauce of malt vinegar
And your ace combo of tender/crispy
Love for you--sure--no need be insecure
So long as buds can taste or people crave,
So long as you're on menu, you're my fave

Little green bombs of flavor, my people. Little leafy, roasted flavor bombs.

Get to it!

The service we had here this past weekend was great! The food was also pretty good, and better than what I would typically expect from a chain (for example, chilis, Outback, etc.). I love the Caesar salad, rolls (duh!), and steak fries. Everything else is just okay. Have had better elsewhere but it's a fun restaurant and very affordable!

I love Carl's Jr. and this location is close to my house but this was the worst experience I had at a fast food place ever and I want the whole world to know a about it. First of all I had to repeat my 2 item order 3 times to the the person working the register. 30 minutes later I'm being handed items that aren't even mine but the guy is sorry because he "haven't slept in a few days". Another 10 minutes pass by and I have my order. All is well. 

I get home and my hand breaded chicken still has raw uncooked batter on it. Isn't cooked and it's absolutely horrific. Part of me wants to go back and and leave this trash back at the store but I won't be bothered for 8 dollars. Instead I will never return to this location again. Stay away!

Great atmosphere, everyone there was super friendly and engaged in conversations. I write this review a few months after visiting only to say I can't wait to be back in Boise so I can stop by The Vault again!

Decided to give the curbside pick up another shot. Besides it's been about 4 years so surely things have changed. Pick up time was 5:56 and we gave them a couple extra minutes and arrived at 5:58. I responded to their text as directed and responded with "here." About 13 minutes went by so we decided to walk in to the pick up counter. I wasn't really presentable to go inside and that was the whole reason we went with the curbside pick up. We mentioned to the girl at the counter that we had passed the 10 minute mark, as per there curbside sign our car would melt if we were there for more than 10 minutes. Apparently the girl at the counter was not liking our joke and threw major attitude. Keep in mind I had tipped 15% on-line (I usually tip more but I felt this was fair for a To Go order) so the fact she was acting that way instead of apologizing was disturbing. A large bag was finally brought out and of course my salad was buried in all the hot food. I pulled the salad from the bag in hopes of keeping it cool. Luckily we live right around the corner. We get home and of course I have a nasty wilted hot salad. A $13 salad. I feel ripped off, again. What happened to common sense and courtesy?

Very disappointing. We had party of 6 for lunch. It took forever to get served and when we finally were the wings were lukewarm, not fresh. Three of us ordered wings and all were lukewarm. When we said something to the server he went and talked to the manager. After awhile he came back and said the manager basically said there wasn't anything they could do about the wings. They didn't even offer to get us a fresh order! And we said something right at the beginning, it's not like we ate the wings and THEN complained. The manager didn't even bother to come over and assess the situation personally. They did comp our fries though. Whoop-de-do. Probably won't be going back.

The atmosphere is really trendy.   I really like the over all feel of YH.  The beer selection is way over the top! I had a raspberry beer that was so fricking good.  So good that I'm going back to have more on my next day off. ( Tomorrow).  We had a few appetizers that were pretty darn good.  The fries were awesome and the firecracker wings were ok.   I know I know I know...  Next time I be more adventurous and not just order wings.   Other than the wait the service was good.  I will make a reservation next time.   Can't wait to try some more beers!!!

This was my first time here and they did not disappoint. The wait for a table was exactly what they estimated and we were able to snack on some roasted peanuts while we waited.
The hot buns they serve with spiced cinnamon butter while to look over the menu is to die for. Probably the best part of the meal but I love me some buttered bread!
Everything was excellent and wonderfully flavored. My Forth Worth Ribeye with mushrooms was cooked perfectly and the green beans were seasoned well. I could have made a meal just out of the loaded baked potato, it was so good. My only disappointment was the cheese on the potato was not melted. I think that's standard, but I would have enjoyed it even more if my cheese was heated through. 
Overall it was a great meal. We will definitely be coming again when we're in the mood for a juicy steak.

PASS on Hobby Lobby and go to Quality Art.

The staff at Hobby Lobby are rude and unknowledgeable.

Also, apparently the Hobby Lobby executives have decided to try to deny their female employees full healthcare coverage.

Overall, a terrible place and once that isn't going to get any of my dollars.
Great ambiance and their appetizers are my usual go to. Happy Hour Nachos. Do it. You wont regret it.

Love their salads, pizzas and pastas! The only thing keeping me from giving them 5 stars is their wine list.  For the red wine lover with a sophisticated, full bodied, earthy palette, their red wine offering falls short. My friends and I agree, we would love to see them fill this void with at least one bottle that meets the above criteria (there are plenty of Paso Robles wines that would fit the bill; Justin, Eberle, Vina Robles.......to name just a few).

They Didn't have the food me and my husband ordered...  came back and said they were out??? asked for chips and salsa and I believe they forgot about it (took awhile to get) and charged us for guacamole that I said NO to because it gives me heart burn. Husbands food came out 10 min before mine and it was cold... then bun was cold and so were the fries... not impressed at all!!!
Way too loud.  The staffs comes out and sings to guests and at 5:00pm the volume of the music was turned up.  Not a very enjoyable experience.
I ordered their burrito. It tasted good. They served chips and salsa, while I waited. I ordered a house Margarita. It was big an good. Nice new place!

Fast Eddy's is the only car wash in town that actually got the bugs off the front bumper of my car. I commute most days to Ontario and back and I've never seen the front of my car this clean!! Why? They enlist 3 people who spray the front bumper with special stuff then scrub it right before you enter the car wash. I have a magnet on the side of my car and one of the gentlemen handed it to me before I went into car wash. Oh and colored soap to make the experience fun. I am impressed!
Flatbread has some of the best Pizza! Their Chicken Apple Walnut salad is also amazing! Great atmosphere and great service.
Mateo V was awesome! He has been out twice to our place in Boise, and is super helpful, knowledgeable and polite. Late night setup visits, too. Cheers man, you are the best of the best.

We found our go-to Chinese restaurant! Such nice, friendly service. Interior had a cozy environment w good, soft lighting unlike most places. We got 3 items to go: Szechwan Chicken, Chow Fun and pork fried rice. All very fresh and delicious.

Such a unique place! Love the donuts- if you like fluffy brioche dough then this is your spot! The flavors are super unique and i love them ALL!!  
The drink selection is also amazing, interesting flavors and fun to enjoy! Their cold brew is one of the best I've tried and I'm not even a fan of cold brew. 
The dogs - so far I've tried the Elote and the Flying Hawaiian and omg!!! So good. Will be back to try others and besides it's nice supporting a local, family owned business that is like nothing else out there.
Also forgot to mention- all the employees are super nice and helpful.

we were on our way back home when our maintenance light went on. we knew we needed an oil change so we thought we'd stop on our way through. they got us right in and were extremely pleasant. we were impressed with our service and we didn't feel like we were getting sold each step of the process. we were out the door in less than twenty minutes and back on our 5 hour drive. we wish there was one where we live! it's almost worth considering making the trip back up here to get the service again

You guys are absolutely THE BEST service!Trustworthy, helpful and always looking to save us $$ 
Thank you for your business. You make small businesses look good

Let's start off with when you order a salad usually the dressing comes with it, I had to sit and wait for the waitress to bring dressing after my salad was brought to my table she was just chatting it up with another waitress so  to that. Also as pricey as the drinks are if actually like to taste alcohol in my beverage instead of just juice. When the waitress brought my appetizer we had a table of 13, so we were sharing everything well I had to get up again and search for the waitress (chatting it up) to ask for plates, when she brought them over majority of them were dirty with old food stuck on the dang plate

Can't say enough good about the service there. I took my car in for an oil change and tire rotation before a road trip. I had my two little kids with me while we waited. The kind men there acknowledge I had my kids, had coloring books and crayons, Netflix for my toddler, and even brought out a new Hotwheels car for him while we waited. The specific mechanic who was working on my car also knew I was waiting with kids and made sure to work quickly but still efficiently. The waiting are was super clean, well-decorated, and professional. They definitely earned my business in the future.

It says a lot about a business in how they handle customers who come in after closing hours.  After a long day hiking we arrived here about 15 minutes before closing time. We received amazing service as usual, and the food was fresh and well made. About 10 minutes after closing time, another couple walked in and they were greeted with a welcoming smile, great service and invited to stay and dine in. 

Great service, great food, great value. Hard to beat that.

Most of the menu is impressive, but my NEW favorite is the CaliClub!  Had it today and almost ordered another one in case they got discontinued for some ungodly reason.  Holy cow, was that delicious!  The side of beer-battered freedom fries was the perfect compliment!  Thanks again, guys!  We'll be back!

Been coming here for a few years now and the food is always consistently very good, and never greasy. My all time favorite is their mandarin chicken and fried rice combo plate. So good! They are also locally owned and operated, so I love knowing when I eat here it supports small business.

Boise location.  Great addition to Boise in experiencing some new types of cuisine.  Fish is fresh, no odor when you walk in.  The staff here is as new as the location.  Good food, good selection.  The scoops of protein are a little small compared to what I have had at other poke locations.  
Step out of your comfort zone and try something new!

Honestly this rating was more of a 3.5, so I decided to round up. 
So let's start with the greeting. She was really nice and we got seated right away. The atmosphere is that of what you would expect at a Mexican restaurant, it's a huge place with lots of seating. The decor was fun to look at. 
Afterwards were served hot tortilla chips with salsa, the salsa needed more kick to it for sure. Was missing some spice but it was good! But maybe it also has the fact to do that I'm Hispanic and love me some spice, especially to my salsas. :) 
For our meals we ordered the steak ranchero and the carne asada tacos, which both come with rice and beans. The carne asada tacos are really good, I liked the fact that the meat wasn't gristle-y which can sometimes happen in carne asada tacos. The salsas that came with the tacos needed some spice too though. My husband said his steak ranchero overall was good. The steak was good, but he also mentioned everything just needed more heat as well. We also agreed the rice needed some flavor. The waiters were all really nice and attentive. We will probably come here again to try out other entrees and then really see what we think of it before we decide to knock it off the list.

First stop on my trip to Boise! It happened to be happy hour when I went so why not snag a frozen mango margarita for $5. Sister got a regular margarita on the rocks. They were pretty strong; not what I expected for happy hour. Food was mediocre. Ordered a mushroom and cheese quesadilla and it had a little cheese. But the guacamole and sour cream it came with was good, provided some dipping for the otherwise dry quesadilla. Also ordered a chicken tortilla soup. That was pretty tasty, spicy though. All their food was spicy. 
Service was great though! We were from out of town and she was super sweet and let us know some good places to check out and treated us very well! Food is okay - it's serves as a spot for late night munchies but don't expect delicious Mexican food.
thee BEST biscuits and gravy i have ever had hands down! the best little cafe with the best food!

This place really confounded my prejudices about Meridian (I recognize that the restaurant is part of a chain, but still).  A great melding of a great tradition of pizza with the need to be accessible and fast in the American restaurant marketplace.  Nice outdoor almost sidewalk experience, great service, great (four cheese) pizza.  Would definitely go back and hope Idahoans support this place until the next time I'm back in town.

We recently moved to the area and I decided to give Dunn Right a go.  I read most of the yelp reviews and gathered quotes.  I was a little hesitant at first.  However, Dunn Right came in at the mid price point I desired.  Initially, I scheduled the appointment on Wednesday, but the timing of getting my keys was a bit complicated.  So, I had to change the date a couple of times.  Katie was very understanding and flexible.  By the time Jonathan came on Monday he was ready.  He walked through our house and gave me the price, which was roughly what I figured I would pay after my conversation with Katie.  The carpet and tile cleaning (along with the seal) was done promptly and without issue.  The carpet and tile in our home looks awesome.  Katie came by towards the end to thank me for my business. I'm glad I went with Dunn Right.

okay this was a first at this.location to try out there pizza. the atmosphere of the restaurant is cozy. with the wood bring pizza oven in the back. we started the order with a appetizer of smoke goat cheese and red peppers with fresh bread. It was amazing  the waiter was amazing we then went to the wedge salade. this too was absolutely great. last was the sausage pepperoni mozerilla pizza. well let's just let you know if your thinking thin crust pizza is crisp thin crust. then this is not going to meet your expectations the topping was good but dough seemed to be soggy and not cooked all the way through now the bottom was cooked because there was burn marks on the bottom. so to be open minded it could have been soggy because of the ingredients on in sweated as it cooked thus making soggy. Which ever it was I talked to the waiter who promptly went to the Manger who immediately came over to so see how to resolve our issue. I discussed the soggy Ness of the pizza and my thoughts that it was not thoughly cooked but just on outside from cold vegetables and meat being place on dough into a hot stone fireplace. thus making outside cook but not inside. also possibly that because of ingredients might be what gave it the appearance. however she earns try listened to me and made no excuses or explanations but asked if we would like to try something else's or a new one. this is great customer service! we chose a Flatbread pizza after her suggestion that it may be closer to the crisp thin crust type of pizza we was looking for. the one we chose was a sausage arugula flat bread it is cooked crisper and more like you would think a thin crust should be. for two people with each having a glass of wine and a order of appetizers you can expect to spend close to 30 -40 dollars. end conclusion is it is a very nice atmosphere to go to serves a nice selection of wine and food and had great customer service.  just know what your might be thinking is thin crust crispy pizza is not what you think it is here. it's good just have a proper expectations of what it is.

Tonight's dining experience was superb. I was extremely hungry, and the food didn't disappoint, but maybe that's because I was so hungry?  Anyway, I tried the Housemade Sausage Lasagna. The waitress, Leslie, who was very attentive and fun, said that she has never seen anyone NOT finish the lasagna. It had to be good, right? RIGHT! I'm still eating it, in fact, as I write this review. It's EXCELLENT.  Beware though. When they say it's hot, they aren't joking. It burned my tongue like the dickens for the first ten bites. I had to take it slow, but I was so hungry, so I powered through. 
Enjoy the lasagna!

Thanks to Yelp while at a conference in Boise we found this wonderful restaurant. It is often difficult to know what to expect when trying a new Mexican Restaurant - for each has their own recipes - but we found the items we ordered were great.

I ordered Enchiladas Jalisco and the waitress gladly substituted a ground beef for the cheese. I enjoyed the strong flavors of the mole. I especially appreciated the waitresses willingness to answer my questions and her suggestion to go with this dish as "You can ge Carne Asada anywhere." 

One friend ordered the chicken chimichanga said it was just as he expected. Another ordered Arroz Con Pollo which was not what he expected - possibly misunderstanding descriptions. He said it was flavorful, but...

All in all, if I was traveling through the area I wouldn't hesitate to stop in again. As other reviewers have mentioned it is tastefully decorated and seems to be a popular place for families to visit.

For great steaks, excellent service and an all around awesome meal, this is the place. The stuffed mushrooms were amazing and came with the tastiest toasted bread and cheese sauce ever.  Our dinners were served with fresh asparagus and every bite was excellent.  Most of all, the service was impeccable.  The place was packed on a Friday night but we never had to wait for a drink refill or just a quick check in on how our meal was tasting.  It wasn't perfunctory duty-driven service, but was professional while maintaining the smaller town vibe of caring and concern.  We will stop here whenever we are in town.

Hang out with friends on chili's today, we got seat right away. We ordered salmon, chicken with rice and vegetables , the rice wasn't cook well too hard to chewing, told the waitress and changed fresh one to us . Besides the rice , other food and services are good & friendly.
Been three times in a month now ... So delicious !!!!! Totally worth it great place to take literally anyone! Come hungry and ready to try a bunch of stuff !

We have switched to Dowdy's.  People at the front are super nice and helpful.   Oil changes are the best price in town!  We brought in an old car which they could have easily found something wrong but said nothing needed done at this time.  Seems pretty honest to me!  Thanks Dowdy for coming to our area.

Oh. my. gosh... If I could give this 6 stars I would. Everything was delicious from the fluffy bread rolls with cinnamon sugar butter to the medium well ribeye steak with corn and baked potato! So delicous!! Totally tops. Definitely a place to take your family to and have a quality meal. Great service and poppin' atmostphere!

I feel especially lucky that they chose to expand business here in Meridian Idaho. I'm a foodie. This place is delicious.

I want to take a moment and recognize their bathroom. They have SOFT toilet paper. Nice quality, probably hand picked for greatness.

Most businesses give us the sand paper, cheapy one ply toilet paper. But not here. Only GREATNESS  here.

The bread they use is crispy, and golden idk what butter they use but i think it's from heaven. 
When you bite into the hot dog, it's full of flavor. Like it's actually seasoned unlike an Oscar Meyer dog.

I'm sorry I should've even compare an Oscar Meyer weenie to these glorious hot dogs.
Anyways, order what ever you want because it's going to be delicious, and you'll want to order again and again and again.

Service is quick, friendly, and helpful. I'm definitely coming back here again.

Sushi was delicious and the atmosphere was great. Took my wife on a date night and we really liked it  the hibachi areas look fun if you have a larger group. Prices were on the higher side for our sushi but not outlandish. Quality and service was admirable. Definitely worth a try if you are looking for a sushi date night.

The movers were prompt, friendly and worked hard. Just as important, they took great care of our belongings. The company was flexible to work with my schedule and fit me in on the day I requested even though they were already booked out.   I really appreciated this because we were eager to move into our new house and not stay another night in a hotel. 
I don't plan on moving anytime soon, but I will certainly use them again when I do!

While visiting Idaho with my girlfriend in September we had the pleasure of dining at Yard House on a Saturday night. We had a party of five and the place was busy and clean and not too noisy. The seating was very comfortable as well.

Our drinks were tasty, my girlfriend had the Pomegranate Margarita and I had the Grand Patron Margarita and the food was awesome! We had the Onion Ring Tower, one person had the Lobster Garlic Noodles and I decided to try the Lobster & Shrimp Agnolotti, it tasted so good! Our waiter was great, the service was outstanding and we all got the chance to enjoy ourselves. We'll definitely be back for the Great Food and Drinks.

Making it a point to leave an honest review,  hopefully as constructive criticism.  I ate here with 6 other people,  and we all absolutely hated our food. It was flavorless, over salted, bland, and disappointing. Service was extremely slow, and it wasn't very busy. Definitely won't be coming back.

Hope you guys can figure things out so you can stay in business.
This place has the best hot and sour soup in town!!! Great food and very quick with pickup orders.

We decided to try out Jakers not worth the cost of the food!  So much went wrong!  First. I ordered soup and salad bar. Fruit on the salad bar was very tangy. Obviously going bad. The shrimp salad was half frozen. It had not been refreshed at all. The soup bar had a nice variety but was lukewarm. I am not eating lobster bisque that has not been kept at the proper temp. The soup bar had not been refreshed either and I was scraping the bottom of the soup pan. Now for the French dip sandwiches very little meat on the sandwiches!  And 23$ for a French dip!  Ridiculous price. 
Our waitress did not clear dishes. When I let her know about the fruit she did not send the manager over or anything. The kitchen also " lost" our order. Another waitress brought food to our table that was not ours. Yet again no manager came to see what the issue was. Poor service and just ok food. Our bill was 85$ totally not worth it. We will not be back again

Not that great of service.  Dirty table that i cleaned myself but the wings were good. The beer was good, a little spendy.  Not sure that i expected 5 star but they definitely have room for improvement. However, i will probably be back to another wild wings

I was hoping for another favorite Mexican restaurant in the area. A bit more on the not so satisfied side of things though. 
I start my initial judgment on a Mexican restaurant on two things; chips and salsa (which happens to be my favorite part of the meal) and Pollo La Crema as a base line at any place. It seems every one offers Pollo La Crema and we generally like it. Pollo La Crema is a white sour creme based sauce, yet it was creamy  red here. It had something mixed in with it and changed the taste dramatically. It didn't tasty anything like it should. In general the flavor was ok, however my wife wasn't as thrilled. 
On a positive note I really like the chips and salsa. On the menu at says you'll be charged after your first dose of chips and salsa which I always find rather irritating however on my two trips I was never charged extra for more I assume that will change once they're more established. The first visit they gave as a another kind of salsa basically a green chili salsa which wasn't necessarily something I wanted to dip a chip in the second visit was good but I don't know what it was, kinda of like finely chopped cabbage with some type of liquid flavoring on it and Cilantro. It was good but odd. A customary offering is salsa and beans with your chips however neither time they offered any beans it was these others things. Both times we asked for beans and was charged for a side item to dip our chips in. First time it was a dollar the next time it was a dollar fifty.

Trip  number 2 we ordered something different and it tasted like a mix between Asian/Mexican and Indian food. Really odd taste never had anything like it in Mexican and it honestly wasn't like eating Mexican food.  In the end we didn't like it and my wife would not eat it so it was fairly disappointing. 

In the and at this point we've decided not to go back maybe in a year after they work out some of the kinks and maybe have things up and running a little bit smoother I might convince her to give it another try. So far the only saving grace was great salsa with chips.

My wife and I do like the Texas Road House. Though I think for me, its more about the name since I am from Texas. They do have sweat tea!!!

The chili is good, but I don't care for chucks of tomatoes. if you like a more chunky chili, you will probably really like it here.

Since their name has Texas in it, I expected a really good authentic Chicken fried Steak. I was dead wrong. It  has been northenized. It is made from Sirlon, which is there 1st mistake. It does not have the flavor of a chicken fried steak at all. The gravy was so-so. 

It is very very busy here. On a friday, if you try to go after 5pm, be prepared for a very long wait. 

As for me, I like it here, but I don't think the food warrants its being this busy

Good atmosphere and friendly staff. The food wasn't extravagant but was good. The chicken burrito had a sweet flavor to it that I didn't love but was still good. My husband had a beef burrito and really liked it. We will be back.
Great new cafe in Meridian ! Had the open faced Prime Rib sandwich . Great flavors hand cut skin on mashed potatoes ! Defiantly coming back

I didn't go inside... I was a couch potato while my husband went to pick it up. So I can't speak to the ambience. However, I can say this was first pizza that I have enjoyed since moving to Idaho. It had a delicious thin crust that was light and airy. The sauce was good not sweet tasting- as I've found with a good portion of places around these neck of the woods.  They also have a variety of sauces available- one even has a kick to it.  If you are a picky eater or as I like to title myself "particular", then this place is for you. You can tell them how much sauce or cheese you want. You can pick whatever and however many toppings you want for no additional charge. It's actually crazy how delicious it is for the price! The pizzas are one size (the size of a small) but it's seriously $5.95 for a one topping pizza and $7.55 for create your own pizza with unlimited toppings! You can't even buy ingredients to make your own pizza for that price.  These are Domino's prices with way better taste. They even have gluten free dough. My stepdaughter said its the best gluten free dough she has tried. Give this place a try. It's conveniently located near the village. Go there with your family when you don't have the typical village restaurant money to spend. Enjoy!
Great atmosphere service and food! Recommend the margaritas. They're all phenomenal. Service was great. Especially at the bar.
Way too loud.  Not good for groups.  Went to dinner with a group of 4 people and could barely hear each other.  By the time we were done with dinner our throats were sore from talking so loud.

I live close to this Walgreens.  I make frequent and sporadic purchased headed to my home and from.  Every single employee is personable and chatty.  They all do their jobs and I don't believe I've ever just seen them standing around.  The lady from London is my favorite.  She's way friendly and one day when I was having a bad day she said "sadness doesn't stay around forever".  Kindness will get her far in life.  I've never experienced the pharmacy staff.

Waited 25 minutes for a table. 15 minutes to order. Food arrived one hour and five minutes after we arrived and one order was wrong. Server did his best but this place was a disaster. Kitchen appears to be out of control. Not a good experience.

Will not stand behind their warranty! Had 10 year warranty on mattress, it was sagging after two years, waited 8 plus weeks for their warranty claim process, only to be declined and they claim it was from our $2500 log bed frame, and it was just an excuse so they didn't have to warranty the mattress, do not buy from them, you spend top dollar for the product only to get zero warranty resolution!!!
The long line I was in was taken care of in less than 1 minute. If u want a quick bite, this place has great food. The staff there was also very friendly. This is a great Wendy's!

I hired these guys because they were cheaper than the rest. Never again will I go for cheap over professional.

My first warning sign was that they showed up in a U-Haul. Then I caught each mover checking messages on their phone when they were supposedly out of sight.

I purchased a large sofa that wouldn't fit through our front door, so two guys from a thrift shop figured out a way to get the sofa in through sliding glass doors. But these movers could not get it back out! I had to call a couple of neighbors who were able to figure it out in about 5 minutes. That was a waste of 30 minutes and at $60 an hour, plus what I had to pay the neighbors, They caused me to lose money.

When they were moving furniture in, one item was a large desk and they told me it just wouldn't fit. I had to teach them how to get a piece of furniture like this, snaked around the door sideways.

I am an artist and I had a set of drawers containing a couple of hundred die cuts. The set of drawers clearly had a top and a bottom, yet these movers placed it upside down in my living room. Now I have a big mess to clean up.

I'm noticing dings in my furniture that weren't there before. I'd be willing to bet that they didn't use blankets to cover my furniture.
They did a great Very friendly and great customer service. They even give you a news paper. Even offered us coffee, hot chocolate and soda for free. We will definitely be back.
We could not have been happier with everything tonight. Food, drinks, DESSERT, and our waitress (Christina) rocked!  For sure coming again!!!

The food was so delicious here! We started with the Artichoke Dip and it's the best I've had in a long time! Food was cooked perfectly and my hubby said his Steak is one of the best he's had here in Idaho so far! Loved the atmosphere too! Will be back soon and we will be bringing our friends!
The place is beautiful and the staff is super nice. Food was average. Nothing special about their menu. Prices are higher than average.

Honestly I love Roadhouse. The food is exceptional and the service is over the top. You feel like family when you go in and dine. The rolls are my favorite but I have to deny them every time cause I'll eat 2 or 3 baskets to myself! I've had pretty much everything on the menu... which tells you how much I eat at roadhouse! My favorite is a 6-8oz sirloin sweet potato and chili or veggies! Load sweet potato is my go to for a dessert without ordering a dessert... yes the wait is long but call ahead is awesome and keeps the wait to a 10-15min wait which is super doable.

296th reviewer of Yard House located in the Village, Meridian, Idaho. 
This is my 376th Yelp review. 

296 reviews and it's only been open a few years. Today I was the 30th reviewer of Sizzler, which has been in business at that location for decades-- it really shows you how popular of a place this is. 

Here I will share with you my experience:

Where is the door?!? I had a hard time finding the door, but then I noticed that it was near the movie theatre. I wasn't the only one for myself and a stranger chuckled and agreed that since there was more than one of us with the same issue we weren't dorks at all... were we??? One of my besties met me and she texts me asking where the entrance was-- HAHAHA life is cute! 

Yard House is located in the Village of Meridian. It's right next to the Village Cinema and around many other eateries. 

When you walk in there is a small narrow area where you walk to the counter for seating. There wasn't much room here and I needed to get by to get to my dining companion as I was the second out of three to arrive. This didn't make too much sense to me because this is the exit, too. When exiting you have to wait for people that are checking in, which is surrounded by the bar (the bar is basically in the middle of the whole place). I chose to walk out the door leading to the outdoor seating and cut through the small fence they had. 

I sat right by the kitchen which is an open kitchen viewing concept, which I really like. It's interesting to see how they make your food, how hard they work, and how clean or unclean the area is (this was VERY clean). All of the seating appears to be super close to all others, almost as if you're eating with everyone else-- no privacy, which makes private or inappropriate conversations difficult. 

The staff was friendly and helpful. We laughed together and I asked her to join us, which she said she would if she could lol. 

Happy hour! M-F 3pm-6pm and late night 9 pm-close S-Th
We went for happy hour and they have many appetizers that are half off during happy hour. Here are the happy hour choices: 

Poke Nachos, Ahi Sashimi, Poke Stack, Spinach Cheese Dip, Queso Dip, Chicken Nachos, Chicken Lettuce Wraps, Fried Chicken Tenders, 
Classic Sliders, Onion Ring Tower, Wisconsin Fried Cheese Curds, Fried Calamari, Moo Shu Egg Rolls, Pork Lumpia, Boneless Buffalo Wings, Boneless Firecracker Wings, Boneless Jerk Wings, Boneless Korean Wings, Garden Wings, Fried Mac + Cheese, Pepperoni & Mushroom Pizza, Four Cheese Pizza, Margherita Pizza, BBQ Chicken Pizza, and
The Carnivore Pizza. WHEW!  That's a lot. I had chicken lettuce wraps which I made with tofu and chicken served with yummy sauces. One dining companion had the sliders which came with fries and the other got the nachos which he was very impressed with. They weren't overkilled on the size either but were still pretty significant. 

I had bariatric surgery last year and can't eat much. After about four bites I pushed the plate to the other side of the table. The waitress saw this and came and asked me if I wanted to try something different. I explained that everything was fine and she was bent on making me sure that I was satisfied. I was! Please don't take my leftovers, I want to eat them for lunch for the next two days! 

Drinks have a special, too: $2 OFF ALL BEER, WINE, SPIRITS & COCKTAILS, $3 OFF 9OZ WINE, $4 OFF HALF YARDS

Thanks for reading my review! SYOY and I hope you have a great day!

My wife and I had dinner here last week and we were thoroughly unimpressed. Outside of the beer selection, we decided that the adjective 'unremarkable' could be used for all the food selections.  The peperoni pizza was a 'black hole of flavor', and adding loads of chili flakes + parmesan did absolutely nothing.  I felt as if I had noise cancelling headphones on my taste buds.

Just moved to the area and discovered Hot Spot Cafe and I'm so glad I did! Delicious and great service with a smile! Try it, you won't be disappointed! We have become regulars! The wait staff are all do friendly and the service is great!

In 2012 Darden Brands, the food conglomerate that owns Olive Garden and Red Lobster, bought the Yard House brand of restaurants.  This one in Meridian is part of the Yard House chain.  Imagine how poor food might be at rubber-stamp-over-long menu and kitchen with Sysco quality pre-packaged food at one of these type of mass market chain restaurants and you would be right for the food here.  Not to mention the plastic flash-n-dazzle interior with multiple TVs and pack'em-in tables.  It is unfathomable that people would choose to eat here more than once.   Marginal quality and the prices are high to cover all the marketing costs of the restaurant.  Then again, different strokes for different folks.  Maybe way back at the time the Sly song* with that refrain was popular I might have even thought this was a good place. (I did love that song.)  But now I've enjoyed enough good food, which does not mean expensive food, it means good food, and service to know better.  If you're OK with Darden Brands mass market food, this could be the place for you.  We won't return under our own steam.  If someone else suggested meeting there, we'd decline.  

*What do you mean you don't know the song?  Put on your dancin' shoes!  https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4DQAQd-uy-0

THIS N THAT:

1) Location is near the movie theater in The Village at Meridian, which is a sort of "Bellagio-fountain-wannabe-theme park" outdoor shopping mall.  Parking is a bear.

2) Accessibility is level in the door, all on one level, tables are tight spaced, accessible loo.

My boyfriend and I stopped in for the first time on a Friday night around 7:30. The wait was 15 minutes so we sat at the bar for a drink while waiting for a table. We were given food menus to look over while waiting and we were seated within the quoted 15 minutes. Our server was awesome. He knew the menu very well and recommended additional toppings (mushrooms, Gorgonzola, etc) on our filet mignon and prime rib dinners. We also ordered dessert and were shocked at how affordable the dinner was for the quality of the food and service! The only negative thing about the restaurant is the noise level. It was very loud when we arrived but by the time we finished our meal, the restaurant was almost cleared out and the noise level was much better. This did not negate from giving 5 stars! Next time we will come at a later time to enjoy a quieter dinner.

Twice I have eaten here. With gluten sensitivities and a weak stomach. I find my tummy is happy after eating here. So I can recommend it. Yummy choices also. Prices OK. Its nice to be able to have a few very inexpensive selections.

Went here for a date once, they had live music that was actually good, the pizza was amazing!!! And the prices were decent as well! Great spot for a date and great food. Yum. I am super picky about pizza because I'm from New Jersey where we have a plethora of authentic italian food but this was great.

This is one of our favorite places in the Valley. We have eaten several sandwiches, salads and pizza here and have never been disappointed. 
If you make a reservation you don't wait for a table as it is busy on the weekend. 
Service has always been great.

I was craving a burger, heard about Main Street Burger.  Drove a long way to get it and....  I was sorely disappointed.  It was almost cold, thin, no flavor and overall yucky.  Before you spend your time and money at Main Street Burger, use your gas to go somewhere else.

Went there for the first time a few months ago and have been back at least six or seven times, the food is some of the best mexican food in the valley.  The service is over the top.  i would recommend this place to everybody, we have told many people we know of this place, those who have gone have all texted me on how great their experience was.

We visited the Village location recently for dinner and found the food to be WAY less quality than when before, borderline gross.  Cheap tasting meat and toppings.  I'm not sure if they changed food suppliers but don't waste your money on food here.  The only positive is they have a good beer selection.
Excellent customer service! They were happy to answer my many questions. The prices are amazing. Great store!
Delicious food, and fast service. Server,  Shannon, was attentive and had everything we needed before we asked. Thank you!
Food and service was great. Food came out fast and was fresh. The best War Won Ton soup I've had in Idaho. Definitely coming here again.

I have lived in Italy so I cannot say this is the best Pizza I have ever had, but it is the best pizza I have ever had in America. The wood burning oven is as authentic as it gets and the 800 degree temperatures create a thin yet crispy crust.

The authentic pizza, like the quattro formaggi and margherita, are simple and delicious. The dough is extremely thin and the sauce is very light, with little seasoning. The extreme oven temperature leaves some wonderful burnt spots on the bottom (which taste delicious) while the higher water content sauce melds with the top to create a chewy, slipery top. Insanely good.

The more americanized pizzas are good. Too heavy on the toppings to be authentic but still good. The pepperoni (which doesn't exist in Italy by that name) tastes great, as does the sausage.

Those of you who live close to this place should feel lucky. There are only a handfull of pizzerias like this in america and you have one in Idaho!

Always great food and ambience! 
One of my favorite places to eat in Meridian. 
Cozy, warm and casual.  I recommend coming early to get a seat, It fills up quickly with limited seating capacity.

Love, love, love the food here. Very tasty. This a MUST visit if you love this type of food. And you get free sopapillas samples at the end of your meal. Like complimentary mints only better. It's just perfect. And the staff seemed pretty friendly too.
Great vegan options. Crispy Brussels sprouts are da bomb - make sure to ask for no cheese. Most menu items are easily adjusted to be vegan. Don't forget about the delicious frozen margaritas!

This was our first time here. We live a mile away so thought we needed to check it out. We were very happy with the beer selection! So many choices. Our server was super friendly and nice. The steaks were perfectly cooked and delicious. We will be back for sure!!

I always wonder why the Buffalo wild wings locations are just average and still am trying to figure this out.  Nothing wow about this place...when the wings are good they are good, but it is not always like this.  Each location I have visited should focus on consistency with all of the food products.  Some times the the wings are good, sometimes not.  Sometimes the potato products are good, sometimes not.  Look at all the locations and they all with few exceptions are just average rated when they could be 4-5 stars.  As a local at the very first BW3 location on Woodruff Avenue at The Ohio State University years ago I can tell you that way back when the focus was not on liquor sales and big screen TV's and the product was better all of the time.  Perhaps Buffalo Wild Wings has lost sight of what made it great so many years ago.

Great Poke Bowl spot! We were visiting from out of town and I was a bit uncertain since this place didn't have many Yelp reviews. NOT TO WORRY! This place is totally legit: clean, new, bright, the service is excellent (friendly and helpful), the options are MANY, and everything was very fresh! 
I wish we were local, I'd be a regular!

It's my first time here but had to wait with my group for about 10 min, I order a burger but it wasn't that good nor bad, it was okay, it was greasy but I'll probably give it another try. Cajun chicken pasta was actually pretty good for try price!

I could be wrong but when your hours say you close at 10pm on a Saturday night that means that someone can call or try to order food at 9pm. I guess not. 

I tried to order on line and over the phone at this location at 9:08pm and was very rudely told that they were closed. I work in a restaurant so I get it if someone wanted to order a lot of food 15 or 10 minutes before close. Not impressed with the customer service at this location.

I was house sitting in Kuna for about a month and stopped in at this location a few times.  Definitely still has the shine of a new store.  Unlike others who have reviewed, I had no issue with the food or the staff.  Granted they aren't always the fastest either, but in my experience Carl's (like Jack In The Box) cooks most food to order, so if you go when it's not terribly busy you may have to wait a bit longer for your food.  Love their big chicken filet sandwich and fried zucchini!  If you're in a rush you might want to consider going in (so you don't get backed up in the drive thru lane) or going elsewhere.  Otherwise, sit back, relax, catch up on your Candy Crush and wait for the goodness.

Always five stars every time we go. Sometimes the service is a bit slower but they are always friendly and helpful. On our last visit, our server went above and beyond to recommend items and was sure to check in on our opinions. We tried two delicious sandwiches... One with meatballs and the other a portobello mushroom. They were both presented beautifully and were very flavorful. The kids LOVE to make their own pizzas... So fun. Dessert was 3 amazingly gooey chocolate chip cookies for the kids and a delicious budino for the adults to share.  We usually order pizzas and have loved every one we have tried.... Especially the bianco magnifico! Delicious! Can't wait to go back during the warmer months and enjoy the great patio.
Thought I was going to receive something extraordinary for the price. Was disappointed. Service was good.

Love Krispy Kreme and so do my kiddos. We've visited this location many times and come away satisfied. 

They're often out of maple bars which can be a disappointment.

I didn't fall for the all the hype at the beginning and it wasn't until a friend took me one time while I was on a business trip.  That visit was the first of many. 

Here's what I love 

I can make my own Pizza the way I want. 
The ingredients are flavorful and the selection is great

Here's what I love even more

There's some sauces in squeeze bottles that are available for additional flavors like Buffalo after your pizza comes out of the Pizza.  Definitely peep them out 

Here's what I don't love

The noise is insane all the time. While we don't mind waiting the acoustics of the crowd plus the raised voices of everyone inside make Blaze feel like a sports pub & bar versus a Pizza place 

Their vegan cheese is awful. Before I get a slew of comments of vegan cheeses in general, the advancement and flavorful ness has increased 100x fold so much so that the vegan cheese industry is slated for 30 billion dollars by 2024. If they all tasted like ----, the projection would considerably less than 30 billion dollars. 

I would strongly suggest that Blaze ditch the rice a roni looking sticks of vegan cheese to another brand like Violife or Follow Your Heart. Hen train their staff about the different cheeses and how they interact with ingredients. 

The ending counter 

While the end counter or pick up counter is suppose to be hand-off for the pizza cutter and customer is ends up be a cluster ---- since customers hover over the area like zombies anticipating a twisted ankle of a human. Seriously. People go sit down and wait for them to call your name 

What I haven't tried yet

The app I have been told is user friendly and worth skipping the antics and drama of being inside with the Pizza zombies. 

I'll let everyone know in an update.  

So in the end, if you're looking for a vegetarian or vegan option, Blaze is a great option right here in Meridian.

5 stars just for putting salt and pepper on your burger patties!! In my humble opinion as a person who loves burgers, this is such a simple thing and people miss the mark on it!  Ordered the bacon cheeseburger. 1/3 lb patty. Thick bacon. Lettuce. Tomato. Burger spread. Buttery toasted bun. Side of crispy tots. TA DAH! Husband had the guacamole bacon burger. He also liked his burger. 

I'll be honest...we had every intention of eating at Kahootz next door. Too many people. This place is right next door. Took a chance without even checking Yelp reviews. I'm slightly disappointed I didn't eat where we had originally planned on going BUT this burger place is great. It's one of those places you might drive past thinking it wouldn't be worth the money. You'd be wrong thinking that. 

I would totally eat there again!!

Went in to buy a dozen of their dinner rolls and a house salad to go. Andrew, who took my order, first typed my phone number wrong even if I told him twice to correct it. Also after waiting for more than 20 minutes to get my order, he called me by a wrong name, and then when I  checked my order,  we found out that he only picked up half a dozen instead of the whole dozen. I really like this restaurant, but the past two visits here have been a disappointment with their customer service.

I actually liked this place even though all I had was Nachos. The drinks were definitely good, must try the jalapeno margarita. I liked the atmosphere and our server was absolutely adorable. He made sure we had drinks and food at all times. They also have good desserts. I have visited their location Downtown Boise and was not extremely crazy for the food, didn't think the price was worth to be honest. It was not fair to rate them lower since I didn't really have food. My reviews are based on the appetizers, dessert, drinks and service.
O. M. G!  GREAT Margaritas, best ceviche I've had in the states. Our tacos were fabulous & the service was wonderful. What more can I say? We'll definitely be back next time we're in town!

Excellent service. I've eaten there only twice, both were very enjoyable. Ate there last week with my daughter for lunch special. We both had the French Onion soup and French Dip half sandwich. The sandwich was huge, and very tasty! More than enough food and two meals were less than $20. Sit outdoor if you can. I will return, just a great place!
Had a wonderful time last Friday. Had driven by many times and never went in. The mac and cheese was amazing and perfect for sharing. The onion soup was so good I will for sure be back.

We visited BWW on Eagle Rd today. The service left a lot to be desired. We were here for 1-1/2 hours for simple lunch items. In addition to that we were informed that they charge for ranch, which would be fine if they were at least filled up. When I complained about it the waitress said "you get one squirt and that's it."  They weren't even half full. If it weren't for previous experiences we would never come back.

I made appointment was told the new exam was 120. Ended up being 180. For absolutely no help on back pain. Dr Race asked a few questions and explain how muscle works. I told him I was a personal trainer. Basically knowing how body works. He proceeded to lay me down and put his thumb in my back. Yes it hurt like crazy I have knots in my shoulder. I got little relief. For my pain. Then takes me out and his assistant had me do 3 strength on wall. Had me do a foam roller. A couple exercise for back and legs. My legs are not the issue it's my back. Not sure why that cost 80 dollars for 5 mins max. I called to dispute cost. Basically was transfer to billing. Not sure why that was. No help to back and out 180 dollars. They had not ask how they can help just cancelled my next appt.

I went here the other night to get a fresh salad! When I asked for the salad bar the server said that he took it down 30 mins ago and to order something else !  So he came to take out order, I asked what the soup of the day was, he said " oh we don't have any soup, I unplugged it at 4pm. Who the heck shits down food 5 hours before closing and does not accommodate their customers. The  place was empty and now I know why. 1) no food to eat beside just pizza (some people are choosing things besides that)
2) crappy service 
3) no one in the restaurant tells me to run

Friday Night and foggy conditions made our decision to visit our local Chilis an easy one.  This place was packed.  I must confess I have not been to a Chilis state side for several years.  Matter of fact the last time I was at a Chilis was in Tuxtla Guttierez, Mexico. There are tablets on each table.  Some kids were playing games as well as bad husbands and boyfriends who find it more interesting than their wife/ girlfriend. The menu is more grown up and complex as well as more expensive.  My wife wanted a margarita and we ordered the Mango Margarita with the Patron shaker.  The server and the bartender did an awesome job of making her drink perfect.  ( Not an easy task ). I ordered the Buffalo Chicken Salad and my wife ordered a three item Mexican Combo.  Enchilada, soft taco and tostada.  Typically ordering Mexican food is a disappointment where ever we go, so my expectations were low.  My salad was of a very nice heaping portion and well presented.  They same could not be true for my wife's dish.  The picture in the menu neatly displayed all three items on one plate.  This did not happen.  The tostada was on one plate while everything else was another.  The other plate was double played and was extremely hot, like it was parked under a salamander waiting for the tostada.  The tostada had fresh beans and the tortilla itself had a nice crunch to it. It was not greasy.  Good.  The plate with the enchilada, rice, and beans was killed by the heat. It was ok for the melted sauce on the enchilada but the rice became little missiles and the beans were now baked.  The suggestion would have been to plate the enchilada, then the tostada and then the rice and beans. Our service was efficient and friendly and the table tablet was not used.  Our server did indicate to us that we could pay that way.  Being old fashioned, I was content to hand over my credit card and keep the table tablet playing for the kids.

Amazing service, amazing food, great place to be. We had a question about food that wasn't even on their menu and they gladly helped us remember the name of it. Best Mexican food around if you ask me. 12/10 would recommend.

I have just sat down and will give a three star for now. Haven't ordered yet. 
Cleanliness: meh. Tables are sticky dirty. 
Ambiance: echoey, sparsely decorated. Institutional. 
Service: fast and friendly so far. Pleasant. 
More to come...

Order half portion of chicken walnut salad and a full side of their new pizza with the broccolini. Tasted very good. Fresh ingredients. Service was friendly, suggest I try their garlic ranch for dipping the crust, tasty. Only improvement is the pizza crust was quite soggy in the center, could be crisper. Maybe the plate absorbs moisture?
Good nonetheless!

Vegans & people who like decent customer service: go somewhere else. I was so excited to visit this restaurant with my non-vegan friends because I saw (first on their website and then on their menu) that they serve vegan options. Long story short, I ordered the southwest veg enchilada dish made vegan (as listed as an option under the item on the menu). I was told the refried beans were vegan but the general manager delivered my plate to me with black beans saying that their refried beans are never vegan because they contain lard. I really appreciated her customer service until I found a big chunk of ground beef in my rice and then beef crumbles throughout it. My other friends were horrified and informed the server who was so genuinely apologetic. Unfortunately, the dish came back a second time with beef crumbles throughout again. The assistant manager, Anna, came to the table, offered no apology, and said "there's an explanation" which was that "it happens" when the food is "being plated." Mind you, all three of our plates had beef crumbles thoroughly integrated in our Spanish rice. She then resisted comping the meal. 

The general manager, Jen, was worse. She said that this is the reason why they don't list anything as vegan on the menu. Obviously, Jen hasn't looked at the menu because 1) ground beef isn't vegetarian and 2) the menu clearly states that the vegetarian enchiladas can be made vegan. Additionally, the general manager is aware that lard is not vegan but is not aware that ground beef is not vegetarian. I am really shocked at the management at this place and their complete lack of customer service on a factual issue. Moreover, we were there for over an hour and left hungry.

Want a really good steak at an affordable price?  Want more food and sides than you can carry in a take out box?   Well, Texas Roadhouse in your place.  Good service, great beers on tap, good food and you just cant go wrong.   You should call in to check the wait times especially on the weekends because they always seem to be packed. (Good Sign).  Try to stay away from the sweet rolls and honey butter.  You will definitely ruin your appetite and any low carb diet you might be on.  The restaurant can get a little loud at times so if you are planning any meaningful conversation with the hot babe sitting across from you it will have to wait till later.  Still I don't mind increasing the volume when needed to talk about how good the food is and to order another beer.  The BONE-IN ribeye is a favorite among the carnivores  connoisseurs and it is my all time favorite here as well.

Authentic! Traditional ambiance, love the restaurant decor. Staff is EXTREMELY friendly and attentive, to the point where you think they are family workers.
