The Chili Verde is delicious, chips warm and salsa tasty. Go for lunch specials, and have a Modelo Negra. I think there is a Happy Hour... 

Only thing I would like to see offered are Beer Cocktails like a Super Chavela (ice cold salt rimmed margaritas glass with Mexican beer and a shot of tequila in it).   I added a picture of it. I'm telling you- if you put these on the menu, they will become the talk of the Treasure Valley!

One of my favorite places in Meridian. They have a great atmosphere for enjoying a few drinks and a pretty decent Flatbread pizza. They have an outdoor patio which is nice, and a decent size bar. I would give  5 stars if they put more toppings on the pizza.

Back in the area on bs this year, we returned to Flatbread where, last year, we enjoyed 3 dinners in just 5 days. Wow! What the heck happened? In a year, this place went from 1 of our 2 area favs to somewhere we will never return.  The pizza sauce was watery thin resulting in a soggy pizza middle. Dried herbs; why?        The bloody mary, advertised as "bacon delicious" or something of that nature, in one of our hotel bar-books, was "watery blandness". The wine flights have always been hit/miss but more miss this time. Tab: $40 for a watery pizza, a bland cocktail & three wine tastes. Ouch. The two stars are for positive past experiences and friendly, albeit heavily tattooed, waitresses.

It was our first time dining here, so we asked server Jake to briefly give us the run-down.   He recommended the 2 for $10ish lunch specials, so we chose two items each.

Hubby chose a meat pizzetta and the tomato basil soup.   He eats a lot of tomato soup and he really liked this one.  He said the pepperonis on his pizzetta were too small, almost burnt in the oven.

I got two different pizzettas.  One had Roma tomatoes on top, and Jake said that they had heirloom tomatoes today so I could switch them if I wished.   I did have them switched, and my pizzettas were awesome.   I LOVED the crust.

On our second visit exactly one week later, Hubby's pepperoni was perfect!   They also still had the heirloom tomatoes, so he and I each had a margherita pizzetta with those.  YUM!   I tried the half chicken w/ portobello sandwich.  I think I may have just found a new favorite sandwich.   Also, this visit, we were in a hurry... didn't have a lot of time to get to another appointment.   Our server was great about getting our check processed quickly and getting us a box so we could be on our way.  We enjoyed the leftovers, too.

Wish we had tried it sooner!   (Better late than never, right!?)

Food excellent. Drinks are good, pizza was awesome and the kids make it yourself pizza was so adorable for  my daughter.  The calamari was great and the meatballs were very very good.  This is s nice little go to spot here in the  area.  Will definitely be back.

Now I'm picky when it comes to Italian-style pizza. I've eaten it all over Europe and the US. There were some spectacular places I used to frequent when I lived in England. In Los Angeles alone, there are so many options for Italian pizza it's not even funny, with a particularly excellent place not 5 minutes from my home.

All that being said to frame my opinion: this is truly spectacular pizza! I couldn't believe how perfectly-cooked my Pizza Margherita was. I bucked authenticity for protein and got prosciutto added on it, and it was flavorful without being salty. I asked our server for crushed red pepper and was told I had the option of spicy oil. Spicy oil! I missed that so much!! I used to drizzle that on my pizzas in Europe and had forgotten about it!  It was sooo good! And with a great pilsner on draft, I was in heaven.

For dessert, I had to get the chocolate melting cake. It was over-the-top awesome and gooey chocolatey awesomeness poured forth once cut open. It was glorious.

I'm pretty sure my friends in SLC mentioned this place before, so it was great to finally try them, and in this location since they had such great beer on draft! Will absolutely be back when in the area!

I have actually been here to eat at Noodles several times, but just never wrote a review until now. When I 1st tried Noodles, I was not sure what to make of it. After all, a place called Noodles does not exactly bring up images of beef and chicken and other things that would appeal to a meat and potatoes eater like myself and most guys. 

Noodles sounds like a place that people would go to to catch a light lunch and talk. Well, I am happy to admit that I was wrong.

Here, many of the menu items are smaller, and lighter, but I think this is a good thing. Most restaurants give you, on a single plate, way more food than any 4 people can eat and that food is mostly greasy, and unhealthy.

I have tried many of the items on the menu. Here are the ones that I really liked. Wisconsin Mac and Cheese. Who does not like Mac and Cheese? I mean really, whats not to like?

Their Mac and Cheese is a bit dry, but it is good. Every time my wife and I go here, we have this. The noodles are a nice Al Dente (Just this side of done) but as I pointed out above, they can be a little dry. 

Noodles, if you are listening, a nice cheesy, ooyee gooyee, creamy sauce would go a long way to make this dish stellar.

My favorite here is the Wisconsin Cheesesteak. The meat is tender and there are lots of red bell peppers to give the sandwich a little crunch and extra flavor. The red onions are nice as well. The only thing I wish Noodles would do for this sandwich is make it a bit bigger for bigger appetites like mine. 

I also like the BBQ pork and the Pad Thai. There are still a few dishes I have not tried yet, that I look forward to tasting.

Everything I have tried so far as been very tasty with lots of flavor and spice. Though the menu is not bad, I would like to see them expand into even more. How about spaghetti? Thats made with.....what for it....Noodles.

Another thing that is missing here are good drinks. They have fountain drinks like Pepsi, Coke and such as this. But what about healthier options like hot tea, cold tea, and other beverages like this that contain more than just sugar?

This is a pet peeve of mine. I have seen so many restaurants that have food that is healthier, but then they nullify this by offering unhealthy sugary soft drinks. To me, this is an oxy moron that just does not make any sense at all. I have an idea Noodles and company. How about those yummy teas from TeaVana?

Also missing here are good deserts. If there were good deserts here, it would not only help me by appeasing my sweet tooth, but also drive up the restaurants check average.

Why they dont offer deserts is a mystery, but one that I am ok with as long as they keep serving good noodle dishes. 

Keep up the good work Noodles!

The worst customer service in their auto department. We ordered 4 tires on a Wednesday, was told they would be in on Thursday. I get turn around time, sometimes deliveries take long than expected. I called on Saturday, still no tires. Finally Sunday morning, I get the call that the tires on in. Take my car in at 12pm. The department team member said it would take about an hour and half and they would call. Ok great. FOUR HOURS later, still no call that my car was finished. I go back down, and low and behold be car was done. I asked when the car was finished and it was finished TWO HOURS after dropping it off. Mind you, there was only ONE car there when I dropped off my car. I received no phone call letting me know my car was done. On top of that, they are ringing up people with full blown groceries and only have ONE person helping customers. The manager walked in, saw the line of people, stopped behind the desk, looked at us, then walked back outside to the shop. I will never bring my car back here again. I would rather pay more money and get better customer service than save a few hundred dollars. To think I thought the Walmart in California were bad...

Since this place is new, I have been waiting to write a review until I have tried it multiple times. Every new restaurant takes a while to get going and to work out all the kinks. I have now been 3 times, and each time has been a little better. The first it was very new, and the waitress did not know the menu at all, which I was surprised, because as a server the first thing you always do is memorize the menu. SO I thought this would get better. Unfortunately not, each time I have been, all at least a month apart, the service was the same. I had to ask the waitress for so many items that did not come out with our food. The only reason that I gave it 3 stars is because the food was mostly good. The banana bread is fantastic! However, it doesn't matter how good the food is if the service stinks.
I've been to several Texas Roadhouses across the country and they are all consistently great!  Reasonable prices for a delicious meal, fast and friendly service. You can't beat it!

This place is great ! 1 st time here / Calab the waiter recommended the Bloody Mary , Be prepared it comes with a meal loaded on top . Great food , great service , great prices. It can get kinda packed , but Calob was on top of the orders he was a great sever.

We bought a gift card through a local school event and thought it would be a nice, easy date. We didn't have high expectations since it's just a basic chain restaurant, but we were beyond disappointed with our food. The hot rolls and peanuts were basically the only thing worth eating. (Please note, the rolls are really only good when hot). I ordered a fillet with a side of shrimp and mixed veggies. My husband ordered the fried catfish. Based on the menu description of how they cook their meat, I ordered mine medium well (menu description defined this as "some pink".) Nope. No pink. Overcooked (way beyond pink). The shrimp had a nice flavor but they were cold (not room temp. But partially cold -like when you heat something in the microwave and portions get warm and other portions don't.) my veggies were raw. Not even cooked. Raw baby carrots and raw broccoli with a glob of unmelted butter in the middle. I honestly think they forgot to cook/steam them. My husbands fish was the texture of mashed potatoes. He could only eat half. If it had just been one or two things we may have said something. But it was just so over the top BAD it wasn't even worth it. We will never visit another Texas Roadhouse. So sad that these restaurants have become nothing more than an over priced TV dinner that's not even cooked correctly. 





said something. But it was honestly the whole meal
8 people (kids) working and total chaos!  Too worried about talking about how drunk they got at a party and how dead their cell phone is.  Hadn't even started on called-in order!! Really?

We used to go to Carl's Jr. just for fries or the zucchini coins, but NOW with the Beyond Burger, my husband can eat here regularly. Every time we go to Carl's Jr. now, we both get the Beyond Burger and it is delicious every time. (The customer service has improved at this location as well).I can't tell you how much this means to us as vegetarians, you don't even understand how long it has been since I've been able to go to a fast food place and order a burger without having to say "without X, with X." I literally go up to the window and order the Beyond Burger and I'm like "That's the plant based burger right?" And they're like "yeah!" We aren't treated like we are weird for wanting it. Also it tastes fantastic! MEAT EATERS you must try this burger! I can't even tell it's not meat, I sometimes have to check just to make sure. It is fantastic. Please don't ever stop selling this.
It's very just a beautiful place to be, even with long lines it's so worth it once you sit down and enjoy an amazing meal. Once you finish you can go shopping conveniently in the village!

If you like pepperoni so hot and spicy that it erodes the lining of your stomach;  if you like cheese that tastes and smells like throw-up and old socks; if you like soup just loaded with large chunks of raw garlic . . . . then this restaurant is for you.  My wife and I won't be back.  We gave it two stars because the bathrooms were clean.

PS:  I had to physically restrain my wife from throwing a full water glass across the room at our waitress, after waiting 20 minutes for her to take our order!
Dr. Wagnon has been treating my chronic pain long term. Him and his crew are amazing. You can't go wrong with this amazing team.
Delicious food, great service. Servers were kind to the kiddos, which is a huge win in my book. I got the 3 enchilada plate and was blown away.

I was just in and ordered a pizza with bbq sauce which I normally do here and they're normally very nice about it and ask if I'd like to spread it around because it comes in kind of a squirt bottle. They normally spread it with their hands which is kind of gross so they should probably incorporate some sort of spoon if people want bbq sauce? Today I asked the girl to do it for me and she rolled her eyes at me and she was not friendly at all. It's super disappointing when I come here and it's consistently the same girl that is rude.

This use to be my go to place for prime rib. I've been coming here every Thursday for the last 3 years..  the last 5 months has been really disappointing. I order the same thing every week and every week I always ask first if they have medium rare. Today I ordered a 16oz prime rib medium rare and more on the rare side. Every time I get my steak it's a medium. It's almost like eating a pot roast. I don't like to complain cause you can only do it so much until you get sick of it.  Today 1/17/19 will be my last visit here. Time to give another restaurant a shot.

This place was crowded when we got in. The Bloody Mary is pretty impressive, but a little too dark..tasted more like worcestershire and less like tomato. Gyro and tacos were ok, nothing special, but the macaroni and cheese is a big win here. Next time I'm also going for the onion rings...
Blaze pizza has the best gluten free crust in town! I highly recommend Blaze to anyone with allergies. They change their gloves and are cautious when preparing your food! Thanks Blaze!

I really enjoyed working with Rocky and Charles. They are a first class act. Rocky even met me at the granite places on a Saturday morning to educate me on picking out the material for my counter. This is my second project with Artistic. They are top notch from start to finish! I also got a discount on my sinks through them at Fergusen. The workmanship and installation was shear perfection as well. I highly recommend them.

After readings all the bad reviews we almost didn't eat here. We decided to make our own decisions and dined here. What a wonderful dinner we had. Great service( thank you Briana), and good food! Don't always take the reviews as the absolute truth...

Main Street Burgers has hands-downthe most absolutely, decadent taco salad in the town of Meridian!! It starts on a bed of fresh Spring greens, red onion, olives, tomatoes, cheese mix, and the most fabulously spiced taco meat you will ever put into your mouth! You can have Ranch dressing, Italian dressing, or no dressing. It comes with a side of chips and salsa which you can eat separately or throw them in your salad. Fantasmahorical!!

I usually really like this place but....the salads leave little to be desired. We ordered several salads for a,work meeting. The meat was bland and there were very little fixings in the salads other than greens. For the price you would expect a gourmet salad with plenty in it to satisfy you till dinner. I suggest spending your money on different items than the salads. The atmosphere is nice and service is slow but friendly.
Just look at the picture. Melt in your mouth filet with real crab and hearty asparagus.

I came here on a Friday night with my husband and daughter. We were greeted quickly and seated right after.  A little after 7pm on a Friday they were busy but there was no wait.  

The atmosphere was boisterous and bubbly; clearly there were people there blowing of steam from the work week.  I saw a couple families but mostly groups of adults. 

They have a pretty standard kid menu - mine ordered mac and cheese, then complained because it wasn't that toxic orange Kraft color. Sorry, kid. I did the obligatory mom-taste and it was pretty good, if a little bland. But what mac & cheese isn't?

I got the pesto chicken sandwich and it was AH-mazing. Thinly sliced chicken, pesto sauce, sun dried tomatoes and marinated artichoke hearts on ciabatta...holy crap. Mouthgasmic. Crisp parmesan rosemary French fries rounded out the plate and I ate them all!! Nom nom nom! The portions are generous enough that I took half my sandwich home and had it for (second) breakfast the next morning. 

The service was quick and friendly. Not overly solicitous or annoying, just the right amount of attention.  

The bill for 3 of us, including a chocolate lava cake dessert, came to $47. Not bad at all!

We'll definitely go back. Maybe tomorrow.  Maybe right now.

This place is so great. The lady who helped me (Andi) was fantastic. I was in town for business and my wife orders from Plant Therapy regularly. Since the only stores are in Idaho, this was my first time being in the store. Andi helped me get the items my wife was looking for and hooked me up with some other amazing items as well. When it comes to essential oils, Plant Therapy's quality and oil education is rivaled by no one. They are honest and open about their products. 

If you use essential oils, do yourself a solid and become a Plant Therapy friend. Follow them in Facebook and the other social media outlets for their educational videos and product news. 

So glad I took the time to stop in store and meet the wonderful staff and smell some of their new oils. 

And yes, I bought several.
We love the food here. It is amazing. But the service is awful. We waited an hour for our food today. It came out cold.
The prime rib was great and the staff was very friendly and attentive. I liked the beer list too
One of the best burgers I have had. Funny that this comes from a restaurant with pizza in the name. Salads are great too. I haven't had the pizza yet.

So sad... we come here often, and it declines more  every.single.time. What is going on? Suuuuuper lengthy time to receive any meals, then comes out cold. Previous time here, the corn on the cob was so over cooked that the kernels had all popped haha! I think we are done coming in :/ Bummer.

Your mission, should you choose to accept it, is to challenge yourself how you think about burgers. At least that's what the folks over at The Counter want you to do. They are about creative construction and feel they make things delicious with what I am convinced must be Monsanto inspired ingredients. Life is about experiences, and if you want to try stuff, learn something or be creative, try your local college dorm. There, you will not only have more fun picking off the scabs you got from your last sexual escapade, but will so intensify your senses from the endless consumption of gourmet frozen-burrito-ramen-noodle-doo, that you will actually enjoy paying high prices for the food at The Counter.

It is without a doubt in my mind that the vast number of toppings available for your creation can only be made possible through the efforts of Nicolas Appert and the magic of butylated hydrocyanisole and hydroxytoluene. How else can they afford to keep that many ingredients in one place? I hope I'm wrong and that their Market Selections are in fact sourced daily and not preserved.

My particular creation started with the hormone and antibiotic free beef, then it was topped with Gouda cheese (a personal favorite), sun-dried tomatoes, roasted green chilies, and the roasted garlic aioli all on a standard brioche bun to preserve the flavor of the ingredients. Along with the Parmesan fries, it all sounded like a delightful and flavorful combination to me!

Now, don't let the looks fool you! The burger was in desperate need of salt and was simply not impressive; the bun was dry, the tomatoes had little flavor, the garlic aioli was okay but still lacked garlic and the green chilies tasted like, well, what you might imagine a Leprechaun penis would taste like . . . green with a just a hint of Guinness! The Parmesan fries were dissolving in their own grease and became more limp than the aforementioned Leprechaun.

The only redeeming quality of The Counter was the service! Our server and the rest of the staff were fantastic. Friendly, welcoming and efficient, almost to a fault. A wonderful crew, indeed and I would go back and try a shake just to be served by them one more time.

My personal burger combination at The Counter was not at all what I had built up in my mind and the cost made the whole meal even harder to swallow. With over 312,120 ways to to build your burgers, you could spend a lifetime creating and devouring different combinations! Unfortunately, only one combination was enough to convince me that there were perhaps 312,119 too many. Consider me disappointed.

Today was my first time at firehouse subs. My experience was 10/10 definitely! The sub was juicy and delicious! And the fresh taste oh my goodness! My taste buds were at home with the taste! The gentleman suggested the hero which was a great choice. I'll definetly be back with friends I have to share this amazing restaurant.

Heard through the grapevine that this was the best Mexican food in town......I do not agree.
Wasn't very busy so we were seated right away. The service was good but the food wasn't. I ordered what I call the enchiladas sunrise. (2 ground beef enchiladas with 2 eggs over medium on top) this is what I order at every Mexican joint so I can compare meal for meal. The ground beef wasn't seasoned very well, a store bought packet of Mc.Cormicks taco seasoning would have tasted better than their proprietary seasoning. The rice and beans were good and the chips were warm and crunchy. The salsa was lacking flavor and a base sauce, water and some onions and tomatoes does not qualify as salsa. My boys ordered the kids quesadilla and kids chicken nuggets and French fries. The chicken nuggets were store bought Dino nuggets that were fried well beyond the normal cook time and came out dark brown borderline black. The fries were bought at the same store and had the same super old fresh from frozen flavor that great value brand fries from Walmart have.

Keep moving, there's nothing to see here. 
The quest for quality Mexican food in the treasure valley continues.

Went with a colleague last night early about 6:30. Place was half full but we were told it would be 15 minutes (Bar hustle I guess). No, we weren't dressed business but clearly our millenial server ( started with an S), could probably tell we are old enough to be her father, yet she asked us our names-first names. I would agree with review below (Trish)- place like this (and all others) should err on the side of Sir or Ma'am. She was trying to be cordial but was failing and ended up telling us of her life story...blah blah. Anyway, the food; I ordered a drink. She came back and took our order without the drink(?) after a wisecrack and about 5 minutes later she put it on the table- not fresh ice at all- no swizel stick...first impressions. Couldn't remember which of us 2 had ranch or bleu cheese (it's that tough? Place was empty by now). 
Good salad. Then came to explain that the 'printer' messed up our order and it would take a while longer (you lost an order for 2- $32 Entree specials?)
Brought our dinners and again placed the wrong orders in front of us (consistently wrong, at least..) then discovered this after we each cut in to our steaks and wanted me to just switch with him (huh?).
Salmon must not have been misplaced because it was dry as the plank it was on and over seasoned. Waste of a Wild caught salmon steak...Kobe steak was good but definitely over seasoned-nice intent though.
Best part was the potato- excellent Simplot!
And I asked for Hollandaise- NOT Bernaise
Food ok maybe, service- usual for these days- un-knowledgeable about the menu and manners ( interrupted us when she wanted to...)
Jakers real name is Phil, but dont call him that? Who cares?

If this is the only place in town with Simplots- I'll be back. Only for that.

The Italian Wedge salad was amazing and the classic cheese pizza was good authentic thin crust Napolitano pizza that I have had, outside of NYC and San Francisco. Great location with outdoor seating. Also have gluten free and goat cheese pizza available, however, my only negative was that the Gluten free crust was subpar, and contained corn (which was a problem for half of my family).

HITS the spot! My husband and I were so excited to see a ramen restaurant pop up in the area as they are few and far between. 

I ordered their TONKOTSU CHASU ramen (pork belly) and the broth was full of flavor with the right amount of toppings (mushrooms, seaweed and a delicious pickled egg). If you are looking to warm your belly with a delicious broth/soup. This is it! We are definitely going to become regulars. Also great service.

Very good food, good service, good prices equals a good find in Meridian. Eagle Road close to Kohl's. I particularly enjoy the Pueblo Lindo enchilada, just the perfect combination of flavors.  My husband had the el pastor street tacos and enjoyed them very much, three small tacos left him wishing he had another three! Enjoyed the chips & salsa, also can ask for extra spicy  salsa!

The good: sauce, fish and toppings were delicious - Great Poké! Had spicy salmon, spicy tuna, and Yellowtail with assorted toppings.  
The bad: I asked for sauce #1 and both employees tried to talk me into trying something different. 
Also they wore gloves but also handled register, credit card and pen with same gloves they just served with.  Men's restroom had no soap.  They charge extra for over 5 toppings and also avocado and squid salad. For the price of the bowls all toppings should be included.

The newest addition to North Meridian, Homestead is sure to surpass your expectations for a "local" joint you can go after work with the guys or take the family to for a nice meal. It feels as if our whole neighborhoods stops in after the workday to catch up, watch sports and enjoy a few brewskis. It is the kind of place you want to be a "regular" at. 

Food: For a basic menu, the food is very good. We tried the Cod Sriracha Bites, which came to our table SUPER fast. They had just the right amount of kick and were perfectly bite size. My husband and I shared them... the portion was just right. We also shared a hamburger. While the burger was cooked well, it seemed as thought it was under-seasoned and not too flavorful. We also had a side salad with their house-made Italian dressing, which was also rather bland and flavorless. We'll have to go back to sample more food, because as far as the nosh goes, we weren't thoroughly impressed. HOWEVER, we watched several dishes of their mac & cheese go by, and it was a HUGE portion that looked super creamy and delicious. Their nachos also looked really good, too. We are looking forward to going back.

Drinks: Over 40 beers on tap, with printed menus that are always changing. They also have a full bar. They have brewery nights on Thursdays, so be sure to stop in for samples if you're into that!

Atmosphere: I think the atmosphere is what seals the Homestead deal for me. There's no bad seat in the house, as there are TV's pretty much at every single angle they could think to put them. There are low tables, high tables, big high group tables, and wrap-around bar-top seating. The tables feel a little snug, but it's homey! It was rather loud and very lively when we stopped by Friday afternoon. We loved it! 

Service: Super fast and genuine. Our server was patient with us as we looked over the menu and offered great recommendations! Very happy with the service.

Happy Hour Offerings: Daily drink happy hour from 2-5, with beer, wine and well drink specials. No food happy hour, bummer. 

Healthy Hack: Their salads are pretty healthy! 

Tips: n/a

I've been here now about 5 times. They've got pretty delicious food. I enjoy their poke salad and their garlic lobster noodles (pictured). I think the atmosphere is nice, but loud. All in all, I'll definitely go back for several items on their menu.
Best prime rib and bread pudding in Idaho!  Our server, Tyler, was excellent and catered to our needs so efficiently!
Great service and food!!!we got hunan chicken and broccoli shrimp!  It was amazing!  We will be back!

The challenge is their process of greeting people and getting them through to being served. Usually no one at front desk to check you in. HOWEVER, once you do finally get to a customer service person, they are attentive, knowledgeable, and caring. It take a while to get with someone for help, but once you do, they give you their undivided attention. People who typically use NORCO are either caretakers or someone needing specialized service or items. Not the most robust healthy people so it is more stressful or physically difficult for them to wait. All I would suggest is for them to review their customer service process to make it easier to get to the good people who help you.

We are regular customers at this store and a year ago we bought all new downstairs levolour blinds from this store. This was a 2,300 dollar purchase. Not cheap by any amount. Over the last year we have had to replace 8 of the 10 blinds multiple times. The string will malfunction and then they will not go up or down. We finally got a manager to speak with us and were told we never should have been sold these type of blinds due to our long windows and that The blind expert should have known this or the professional window measurer should have known this  and told us this information. But the store  will not make any adjustments for us.  We are not bling experts so we went with what was recommended to us. The manager over there has made no attempt to replace these or even sit down to make this right for a permanent solution. This is not right at all. We spent our hard earned money on a product that was inferior and they sold those to us. So now I have to re do all of my down stairs blinds. This is horrible customer service and not acceptable.  We are out a substantial amount of money now. I will never support or shop at this store again. So much for their customer service statements and treatment of customers. Highly disappointed with this store. This is taking advantage of your customers for sure.  Just disgusted with this process.

Excellent, and highly recommended.

This was our family's second visit. The first time, we had one of the Certified Neopolitan pizzas, and it was excellent. Having doe that, we decided to have some of the more "modern" toppings tonight.

To manage expectations, diners should understand they're getting a very very thin crust pizza, baked for only a minute or so, at very high heat. So you want to eat it while it's hot, or it might get a little floppy. Probably best to use a knife & fork. Sauce and cheese quality are excellent, and the crust is excellent as well. 

The drinks are great; lots of local stuff (Payette & Highland Hollow, plus plenty of Idaho wine). Kid's meals are a neat idea...they give them uncooked skins, and ramekins of cheese and sauce, and let them make their own, which then get fired in the oven.

We also had a roasted tomato and goat cheese app that was superb. Nice to get the happy hour pricing on it.

Definitely worth having dinner here if you visit, and should be in the rotation if you live here. We are fans.

What was good:
-Food and beverage quality.

What needs work:
-Pretty much nothing. If things are busy, your pizza might not go from the oven to your table in minutes, which is not good. Servers should be super-attentive to getting the pizzas out *immediately*. On our second visit, it appeared they had a dedicated server who just ran pizzas out...great idea.

I absolutely recommend the place. Go.

I was in with my mom a couple days ago, I order the Wisconsin mac and cheese. I asked the lady at the cash register up front to make sure to coat each noodle with cheese! 
The gentleman standing behind her (manager/supervisor of some sort or maybe employee ) Replied No problem! Same Gentleman also brought our food out and made sure it was up to par and cheesy! Haha and it was amazing! 
Absolutely friendly, funny great service and staff! 
Went above and beyond
If I can give a billion stars I would!
Great job noodles on eagle!

Wow. Wow. Wow. Ruff Ruff Ruff. We couldn't believe our own eyes. A dog park in Meridian?  It can't be true right?  After trudging along to Morris Hill dog park for several years and dealing with the bark ( not the speaking type ) and the lack of concern of the doggies caretakers we don't have to go there any more. What's even better we don't have to sneak into the baseball diamonds at Settler's Park to let our Siberian Husky run. Not any more. We came across the Storey Bark Park by a fluke accident. We were looking for information in regards to the dog splash day where doggies can go and use the pools in Boise and Meridian when I had to see a web link to the Storey Bark Park. Even though I clicked on it, I still didn't believe it existed. We put our Siberian Husky in the back of our CRV and went over to the Bark Park. There's plenty of parking and there are two parks. One for little dogs and one for big dogs. The space is beautiful with shelters for people and there is even a concrete walk way where you can walk with your dogs without a leash. There is real grass and fake grass and gravel for the playground. There are ramps and obstacle sticks if you and your pup are into that sort of thing. There's a water pump and kiddie pool as well. Kody, our husky was so excited. He checked everyone's Facebook status with a quick sniff to the butts and started to gallop in the open spaces.  To see our husky run in the wide open space is simply majestic. There's really no other word for it. There's plenty of pooper scooper bags and trash cans to take care of those need to go moments. So if you've got a pup who needs to run or simply needs to get out of the house go visit the Storey Bark Park in Meridian

Took a friend here last week for lunch. He was visiting from out of state. We were kinda of embarrassed bringing him here. The ambience was the usual ale house look. I will say our server was sweet. The food however was terrible. Cold fries. Undercooked burger. The garlic on the fries could have warded off a dozen vampires. Very noisy too. Will I be back? Nope.

This is a hard one to write since I don't eat meat other than fish. My boyfriend loves the place though! It is a little loud for me so if you're looking for a place to talk this isn't it. The food is always good (I get salad or the fish options) and the service has always been great. 

I do love the random line dancing and the decor is fun to look at! 

I've been with several large groups and they have always done a great job working us in. Sometimes there can be a wait but its never been too long.

I was moving across town (Idaho Falls) with not that much stuff. The people on the phone were really nice. 

Big Boy movers showed up almost a half hour late and only called a few minutes before scheduled to tell me. That wouldn't have been a big problem on it's own but they took two hours to just load 3/4 of my tiny 800 sqft apartment. In less time, my friends much more professional movers loaded their entire house included two couches and a piano. 

I called about 1.5 hours in to explain what was going on and Big Boys told me I had to pay them anyway for the two hours no matter what. The rest of their solution was for me to keep my movers there until finished, pay extra for the uhaul time (even though I paid for 4 hours instead of just the 2 I scheduled just in case..and that still wasn't going to be enough because they were late and slow), take a few more hours off of work and then they would MAYBE adjust the price at the end. 
Instead of two movers, I got a mover, someone "in training" , and his supervisor who mostly watched them and talked on the phone. Most of the time it looked like they were just hanging out or asking me what to load (uhm, the boxes?). I felt like I hired the neighborhood kids to move my stuff. 
I still was charged the same for a guy "in training" as I would have been for actual movers.

So the 2-2.5 hour job lasted 4 hours and only because I fired Big Boy and had my friends' movers finish the job. In 45 minutes the other movers had changed out the old washer and dryer in my basement (it took 35 for BB to even get the other ones out of the house after a discussion on which one is the dryer), put the new ones in, and moved all my stuff to exactly where I wanted it in the new house. 45 minutes. It would have easily taken the BB movers another two or three hours at my expense. 

So I had to take a full day off of work and hire a second moving company after dealing with Big Boy for a whole morning. The Idaho Falls movers they contract are nice guys but completely incompetent movers. I'm filing a charge dispute with my bank as soon as the Big Boy charge clears.

They've responded to my review elsewhere that I didn't disclose the washer/dryer pick-up location which isn't true. I asked about that the day I arranged for the movers. And the "extended location"  they had to move the washer and dryer to my truck was across the street because they told me not to move the uhaul. By "plumbing issues" they mean my friends dealt with the small leak from the washer hook-up, not the movers. 
They also called the "supervisor" while I was standing there to tell him I was unhappy and then wondered why I didn't want them to continue the move and risk them breaking my stuff or not taking care with things because they were mad.

What they still couldn't explain was why their movers took over twice as long for a job as other movers.
My favorite is the Hook & Ladder it's a great place for sandwiches, also it helps all of our Firemen. There fast a good!
This place never disappoints.  I live almost everything on their menu!  And their wait staff is always so pleasant!

My party of 4 came here for appetizers and dinner at 5:30 on a Monday night and we had excellent service and excellent food. I have never been to a Yard House so this was my first experience.

Our server Andrew got our drink order and let us know we could order off the happy hour menu until 6- half off appetizers and $$ off drinks. We quickly ordered fried Mac and cheese, chicken strips, pepperoni pizza, and cheese curds to share. All for half off. Nothing like a nice discount to make it a little easier on the pocket book.

We were happy with everything. The chicken tenders were nice and crunchy and came with Dijon mustard and ranch. Not spectacular ranch but I forgive that. The pepperoni pizza was thin and crunchy, slightly spicy sauce and a good amount of cheese- surprisingly yummy. The breading on the cheese curds were not as dark as I've seen other places but they were still crunchy, salty and delicious. Oddly, the came with honey and some sort of horseradish dip which was odd. The star of the show: macaroni and cheese bites with tomato bisque for dipping. Just trust me on this- please order these if you like delicious food!

We enjoyed our meal and service was great- thanks again Andrew!
Always quick and easy professional service! If you don't have time to wait or do it yourself, drop by and they'll get in and out.
We came in late last night and they didn't rush us. The pizza was very thin and good. The service was also good and the people were all friendly.

Great service from Brooklyn, our server. She was very attentive and helpful when we asked questions about the menu items. Had the BYO burger and fries. I am a fry snob and the fries here are exactly the way a prefer them. Everyone has differing opinions on how they like their fries but for me these are perfect. The burger was really generous on the beef and tasted great. I have found  a new preferred burger  and fries place. I will be back to try other items off the menu as I was so impressed with this first visit. This locally owned and operated spot beats chain outlets hands down.

Nice spot for a dinner date. Great salads and pizza. One of the best places in Meridian, with open dining and a not too noisy atmosphere it fit the bill for a night out with my wife. We had the monday night flight and got a pizza, salad and 6 3 ounce glasses of local wine. A nice way to try out some flavors for us not so informed lightweights.
Excellent service and exceptional food!! Definitely recommend this restaurant. Very chill environment! Lots of tvs for sports enthusiasts!

One star for the guy with the long hair and good at his job and 1 star for the guy that hired the guy with the long hair and good pizza for the price salad bar looks like a two rabbits made baby rabbit's in it. UNDERSTANDING its a mom in pop shop if you like hard A you are in luck because the youngster makes a stiff drink and my we got a buzz actually impressed. DOUBLE STARS ONLY 1 SERVER

While visiting friends in Idaho we had the good fortune to dine at Kahootz.. I ordered the Bloody Mary drink special and was delighted to get a tall glass rimmed in spiced salt and garnished not only with the usual celery stalk, but a skewered banana pepper, olive and lime wedge topped with a crispy bacon slice that was still warm! No other Bloody Mary will ever measure up after that!
We all ordered steak and it did not disappoint. The wine was outstanding and upon my return home I discovered that it was a limited release of about 600 bottles and was sold out. Too bad but it made the evening even better.
We had heard about the wonderful bread pudding so we ordered one for the four of us to share. It was delicious and more than enough for all of us to have a taste,
Kahootz is a gem! We'll go again next time we visit and it can't be soon enough for us.
Excellent food and good atmosphere. I'm from Arizona and I know good Mexican food lol. These guys are better then most in the valley so try it and enjoy...

While I haven't received my 15 year resident of Meridian badge, I feel like it's been about 10  years or more that I've been anxiously waiting for Fast Eddy's at the Centrepoint development at Ustick and Eagle Road.  I remember seeing the sign, "Coming Soon" and I was finally thrilled to have a gas station in near proximity of our subdivision.  No more trips to Stinker or Fred Meyers or even Walmart.  Ha!  Then the development and construction came to crashing halt and my dreams were gassed. In the meantime I drove down Ustick to the Fast Eddy's just pass Settler's Park.  I may even have written a review of that location but alas they changed their location and sold out to Jacksons or Mavericks.  My enthusiasm was renewed when I saw construction start again on the massive lot for Fast Eddy's. First was the Car Wash and Oil Lube then the gas station.  This review is for the Car Wash and Gas Station. 

PRO 1

The car wash is really good for $7.00 you get a complimentary dashboard wipe and the team inside the car wash queue slather your vehicle with suds and care.  Once out, find a spot and take advantage of the vacuums.  Why?  They really suck. I mean that in a good way. They do really suck.  If you're inclined to use the mat washer, I am, it's great and works well with my Honda mats. Lastly, they provide towels to get to those hard to reach spaces. I've been through about 20 times since they opened and each time has been perfect. 

TIP 1- If possible, get your gas first and let the pump know that you'll add on a Car Wash, and the pump will reduce your gasoline price.  SCORE!!

PRO 2 

Inside Fast Eddy, the clerks and just about everyone in a neat and tidy blue shirt is super helpful and they play the best jams. The restrooms are phenomenal. The selection is gigantic.  They even sell flower arrangements and have a full sandwich place inside.  ~ Earl of Sandwich. 


TIP 2 There are a number of specials found throughout the Fast Eddys Sometimes it's gum and other times its Perrier, So get your Oui Oui on.


PRO 3 The gas station pumps are super cool. Why?  They have an option to pay via Apple Pay or Samsung Pay where it is contact-less. With the recent rash of ATM Skimmers, this is an awesome feature.  If you're not sure how to use, you can still insert of swipe your card just make sure to protect your PIN.The gas station lanes are wide. I love that there's plenty of space for all sorts of vehicles. 

CON 1  There are some overpriced items but hey it's gas station not a dollar store. 

CON 2  I wish the hours were expanded. I believe the car wash closes at 8pm during the Summer months. I'll check the hours for Winter and update this review. 

Overall - Fast Eddys is my go to for Gas, Gum, and a wash.

Have been to the Yard house a couple of times and always enjoyed the food and selections of beer.  

For lunch today I kept it light with a salad and spicey tuna.  Was very happy with the salad and the spicey tuna was a unique twist on the classic sushi roll,(see pic).  

Service has always been friendly and accomodating.  Overall. I really enjoy the Yard House for a quick bite and beer.
Always a good atmosphere, great customer service, very reasonable prices - BUT - OH MY GOODNESS - do they salt their food.
Came here on a friday night and this place is busy! It only took a little while to find out why though. The pizza here is the best you can find in the Treasure Valley!

Um, let's keep this short and sweet.  Great atmosphere, great food and great service.  Oh, and the prices are pretty right on.  One weird side note:  what is with the schpeal about the " registered Italian pizza" stuff?... Really? just strange and who cares.  Tony and Gino are from Italy and their pizzas are the real deal without being registered in Italy.  But that's another review.

Good service, nice clean restaurant and good food. I had a hard time finding it because the sign is not legible when there are shadows on it. Drove all around the parking lot a while looking for it and finally called them. It is across the parking lot from Walgreens . I think it's probably the best Mexican food in meridian

I have been to to this chain multi times before- but never at this location.  I must say I will totally be back!  Plenty of parking, flat entrance, big spacious bathrooms- (ie accessible!) & fantastic options for vegetarian & gluten free peeps like me.  This location is cosy yet well lit, open & spacious... including  a full vibrant bar area! I would recommend for groups or individuals.  Service was great, food was excellent & prices very reasonable for the quality.  As I'm still in my birthday month- I chose delectable Panna Cotta after my unique artichoke salad.  I heartily recommend both for any reason!

This is the two visits in one week review. 

My wife goes out to the village on her lunch breaks and told me that a new restaurant had recently opened up. Cool, new place to try. We checked their yelp reviews, which were surprisingly low for their opening week, but It wasn't anything that would stop me from trying them out. 

We arrive to quite the line during the end of a typical lunch hour. A girl greets us and introduces us to their process in making brioche, which is completely transparent to patrons. It takes a while for these donuts, and they intend for them to turn out good enough to sell out. 

When we finally get to the check out, the girl asked if it was our first time and what brought us in. "Your negative reviews on yelp brought us in." She looked shocked and said we were brave. My reply was, "Not really, I paid attention to what they were complaining about, and it seems to me that you sell out early in the day and most of them were mad they missed out. If you're selling out that quickly, it must be good."

Their menu had plenty of options, but I immediately saw their version of a Luther, so I ordered the Hangover. My wife, not intending to have cardiac arrest, played it safe with the 208 and their seasoned fries. We also ordered an O.G. Donut to get a baseline. 

This place is about the brioche. The donuts are made with it, and the buns are made of it. If the foundation is off, the house crumbles. Their foundation is built on something they do incredibly well, and is absolutely worth the time they put into the prep work. 

The 208 is a fantastic hot dog, at least the one bite that I had. I was too busy trying to not die happy after having the first proper Luther of my life. I cannot begin to describe the amount of indulgence that wonderful plate of wonder begins to bring my slowly beating heart. It was a quick realization that this was an "all-in" kind of situation when it comes to consumption. I can not describe it adequately enough, there is no clean way to eat this burger. And before you add your opinion, you are dead wrong if you think you can use a fork and knife. Every moment that screams for a napkin is worth what you are shoving in and on your face. 

I had an appointment to make so I had to depart lunch with my wife, but as soon as I left, the owner came up to her and introduced himself and asked how everything was. She told him about us coming in about the negative reviews, and she couldn't stop telling me about how nice of a person he was. 

I couldn't stop talking about it at the barbershop. Everyone that came through our doors was shown a picture of the most beautiful thing I have ever survived. 

But that was Wednesday, I needed more. 

We went again for dinner on Sunday. 

I asked the cashier if I should go for the chili + beer dog, or the Nashville Hot Chicken. Without hesitation I was told to go for the Hot Chicken because their home location is from Nashville. I couldn't argue, so I went that route, and my wife went with the B.A.T.  

Once again, the single bite my wife gave me was fantastic. It's a bacon wrapped dog that doesn't feel heavy because of how light the toppings were. But I couldn't stay focused on that, I had round two of "all or nothing."

While it was significantly less messy, forks and knives are for quitters. The Nashville hot chicken was the perfect punch of heat on a juicy piece of friend chicken, while balanced perfectly with a tangy slaw and pickle. 

We finished the meal off with a farmer's market donut that had a honey glaze, a raspberry filling, and goat cheese on top, as well as a parrot head with lemon curd and buttercream frosting. Both were entirely different. The farmers market was a great balance of savory with a welcome bite of funk that worked, much to my wife's surprise. The parrot head is for the person with a sweet tooth. The lemon curd mixes well with the buttercream, but it's definitely high up there on my personal sugar preference

-----------------

The environment is entirely quirky. There is donut art everywhere that isn't tacky, and it makes you take a second look at all of the decor. Their music selection made me feel right at home, and on our second visit there was a huge birthday party happening in the middle of the restaurant. This is a place that I have no problem coming back to, and I am confident that I would love everything on their menu. It is a little on the pricier side, around $35 for both of us, but at no point did I feel it wasn't paying the value. 

For those shying away from negative reviews, do yourself a favor and realize it's worth coming in early to not miss out.

This is crazy I never give 5 starts but my son, husband and I just went to Yard House for an early dinner and it was AMAZING! We haven't been in quite a while and the place has really taken things up a notch... a few notches!!! The service was great, so was the food, all of our food was delicious and not just good ....it was awesome and we ordered dessert and appetizers as well. I will definitely be back soon!

Very clean facility.  Courteous and attentive staff. Large selection of local, domestic and imported beers.  Menu items to please all tastes as well as multiple vegetarian options.  Reasonably priced.  My visit was during the afternoon happy hour (3-5pm) great specials on drinks and appetizers.

We vetted quite a few contractors before we started a new project at our home. Let me tell you, we are SO happy we went with Shaun and Rendon Construction. Not only were they on time every day, but thorough, quick, and the work was nothing less than exceptional. The job started and ended on time and the quote came in well under all the rest of the bids. Shaun was quick answering questions and updating at all times of the day if needed. The company definitely puts their customers first. We have more jobs that need to be done and thanks to Rendon Construction, we have no doubt that we will use them on every single one. Highly, highly recommend them!

Portions were generous. Customer service was flirty. Flavor was spectacular. Fresh. Left me feeling good. 

4 Stars only because the place was empty and I prefer a little more "ambiance of people."

Will definitely wants back.

Pretty good service food and drinks! The only thing that sucks is waiting to be seated and there is peanut shells everywhere which is insane I didn't know so many humans ate like chickens and just drop the shells all over the place. Best fried pickles I've ever had too!

Best donuts! I love that they still make the donuts fresh all day. If you go in during the right times you can get a box of fresh donuts that literally melt in your mouth. I crave their donuts and find myself going at weird times of day to get some. The best part is that they're open till late.

Best service and food EVER! Derek and his staff were extremely attentive, truly wanted us to have a great experience. Now, can we talk about the food??? A M A Z I N G! Ribs falling off the bone as you start to cut them ( yum) and those shrimp in butter and garlic sauce...so good! The restaurant was also super clean, social distancing was enforced and all of the staff wore masks for our protection. Thank you all at Texas Roadhouse in Meridian!!!
didn't stay inside the lines of my nails, super consistent about me getting gel instead of polish, even though I said many times I only wanted polish.

After moving here from Texas, we've been really disappointed in the local Mexican restaurants...that is until Pueblo Lindo. We decided to try it out last night and were pleasantly surprised! The restaurant is clean, nicely decorated, and even had live music on a Thursday evening. Our server was helpful and attentive and never let our chips and salsa run low (which were super yummy btw). All of us were more than impressed with our food! The meats were all so flavorful and even the beans and rice were delicious and not at all bland. 
To say we are excited to find a new go-to family Mexican restaurant in Meridian is an understatement!

Visiting Boise this weekend and looked to Yelp for dinner recommendations. This place completely deserves it's rave reviews!  I had a meatball sandwich that had fresh ricotta, peppers, pesto and arugula on it. It was a total mess to eat but a happy mess!  My daughter got an alfredo pasta kids meal, it was huge for a kids meal which she was psyched about. One of her friends got the 'make your own pizza' kids meal, which was literally making your own pizza!  They brought her out the dough with some containers of sauce, mozzarella cheese, and the additional toppings she chose (pepperoni and sausage). Then they grabbed it and put it in the oven. Such a darling idea!!  We were excited to find out they have a location close to us in Sugarhouse, I will definitely be taking my husband there soon.

Wow! Yelp works!! 
We read the reviews and decided to stop in for dinner. We ordered the Enchiladas Jalisco. It came out fast and hot. Wait staff was friendly, helpful, and quick. The atmosphere is great, colorful interior, clean bathrooms, simple and tasteful decor. 
The food was delicious! My hubby and I shared a plate and it was plenty. We would give it a solid 8 out of 10 for flavor and amount. 
Try this place, I think you'll be happy !!
Great food and even better service! everybody there is super friendly. The atmosphere is great! Overall enjoyed my experience and can't wait to go back!

Casually strolled in for lunch, the aroma of pizza in the air drew me into this restaurant.
I was extremely pleased with the pizza; I had the build your own; I took advantage of the lunch special, it was a choose two so I indulged in a mini pizza and half sandwich. The food was superior however for being fairly "slow" the food took an unusual amount of time to come out. The wine selection is divine. Cheers!

Maybe we just hit here on a bad day? The only thing that was really good was the service. Unless you like super salty, garlicky, greasy hash browns or raw in the middle pancakes. I'll give them another shot at one more star.

My wife and I went here and decided to eat on the patio. When our food arrived we were swarmed by wasps. I managed to get in one bite and my wife couldn't even touch her food so I can't speak to the meal's quality. In the end our meal was reluctantly comped which alone bumped this review up from one star. I strongly recommend eating inside or not patronizing at all.
Very poor mexican food.  We will ever eat here again! Whoever the chef is needs to learn what Mexican food is!

I recently took my son in to get a prom tux and honestly I had the most awful experience ever! 
The employees were absolutely rude especially this blonde older lady. She was very condescending when helping us and a complete jerk when we asked questions. She also was very difficult when I asked to look at discounted items or a sales section. I am very disappointed at this branch and I am shocked because this is usually a very reliable store. I am not taking my service here again! I would give zero stars if I had the chance. Forgot to get this ladies name but I wish I had so I could inform her supervisor of her disgusting behavior.

We went there at 7:00 pm on a Tuesday night.  It took 10 minutes for someone to bring us water.  After she brought the water she left for another 5 minutes before returning to take our order which included an appetizer, 3 salads and 2 pizzas plus drinks.   It took approx 30mins for food to show up and included the appetizer, which should have been out first.  The salads were pretty good but the pizzas were not hot and were very flimsy and not topped with many ingredients.  There was no cutlery on the table and we had to ask for it after the food was delivered, further delaying the meal.  We finished our meal and waited another 15 minutes for the waitress to clear and bring the bill.  She never actually cleared the table, except for 2 plates, leaving the remaining 4 plates on the table and we had to work around them to sign our respective checks.  In summary there was a lot of waiting, very little service and so-so food for an ok price.  Not sure I have any motivation to go back!

This is the worst pedicure I've EVER had.  The staff was unfriendly and did a terrible job, and I'm not picky.  My daughter took me there for my birthday and we ended up paying an extra $5.00 each for the sugar scrub.  The whole thing lasted about 15 minutes and the nail cutting was crooked, the nail polish was awful and the foot massage was practically non-existent.  He took the emery board and about sent me through the roof, my feet have never been that sensitive.  They didn't put on the manicure flip flops that the other salons use, but I did see them in the drawer.  The man I had didn't look very professional with a wrinkled white t-shirt on. They never spoke a word.  We checked out and he said we don't take cards and had to use the ATM with an additional $1.00 charge and then he stood an waited for his tip, the most attention shown all day.  I would not recommend or EVER go back.  The only positive about this place was the decor was nice.  Both the girl that did my daughter and the man that did mine were equally unfriendly and both did a horrible job.
Great place, fresh tastes and classic breakfast.  Friendly staff and locally owned and run by the chef and his sister

I've seen a lot of "concern" about voting fast food chains and gas stations with 5 stars. Well, I see it differently than those people. I am not ranking the "chain", I am ranking the particular location and the people that work there. I've visited this Carl's Jr 4 times. Each time has been very quick, very very friendly (yes two very's), with quick hot food and it is for that reason that I feel that this particular Carl's Jr. and the people on the inside, get a 5 star. 

I once worked at a Carl's Jr when I was 16-- it was my first job, and it was in a mall. Hard work and customers can be so mean. Hard to keep a smile on your face. 

Carl's Jr. has a breakfast menu, which is small but good. They even have sausage/country gravy, which isn't found in many fast foods. They have a killer breakfast burrito with the gravy on the inside-- pretty good people. They have fresh biscuits, too! 

This location has a green burrito inside it as well. I am not a fan of the Green Burrito side of Carl's Jr., but that's a personal preference because I am a foodie-- nothing to do with CJ! 

I personally thank those working in the morning, for being so kind and cheerful in the morning when I just wanna go back home to bed! The store manager often works the drive-thru which really says a lot for her employees. She isn't setting in an office, but rather in the front line, doing her share. Good job, all!

The staff was so welcoming and friendly.  They were particular about the details in the car pre-wash and drying afterward.  The actual carwash is like an amusement park ride and kids will love it. Everything was sparkling and the vacuums were strong and convenient. The family who owns Fast Eddy's is wonderful and we love supporting their business.
Nice addition to our neighborhood!   Family owned and operated with friendly and sincerely good service.  Food was very good can't wait to come back again and try other items
Yummy sushi. Friendly service. My kidos weren't fans of the steak on the kids menu but other than that it was great! Will revisit.

I did not expect the generous portions of food or the friendly service that we received from Kiley.  Being new to the area, we were looking for a "go to" place and we found it.  Tried the beer sampler which is a great way of sampling the various micro beers without committing to a full size glass.  Hubby's filet was very tender and cooked perfectly.  The one item that puts this over the top is that all dressings are made in house.  I love a good salad and the blu cheese was fantastic.  Got quite crowded but there is an outside patio area which we saw several people enjoying.  Will definitely be going back.
Justin, did you actually read my review?  If you did, do you really think I'm going to come back again, especially soon (!!), and, why would I email you? I've got nothing more to say.

Every single time I come to Chili's there is a problem. Today I was served an uncooked chicken sandwich, I couldn't even bite on one side because the meat was raw. Manager said it looked good to him. Well, I should have offered him to bite it. Was a little shocked by his response. Never again! So done with this place.

Pueblo Lindo just opened in Meridian off Eagle Roads and Ustick.  We went in on a Saturday night before the Grand Opening.  They are still working out the kinks, but doing a great job.

When we arrived we found the restaurant clean, open, and bright.  There was live music being played in the corner and we found he would take requests.  The friendly host got someone to seat us quickly.  Our waitress brought us water quickly and asked if we were interested in drinks.  The Margaritas are the standard bowl-shaped glass and you get them blended or on the rocks.  There are a few draft beers and the regular soda options.

They served up a basket of chips, salsa, and pico de gallo.  My husband, who likes HOT salsa asked for the habanero.  He said it had good flavor but still wasn't hot enough for him.  He's weird that way.

We each ordered different things and one of friends is very particular about her Mexican food.  From southwest Texas, very few places live up to her own good cooking.  She got an entree with the mole sauce and declared it amazing.  She said she could tell it was home made and so much better than most places.  The rest of her dinner was great and she said this would be a great place to return.

The dinners for the rest of us were, also, quite good.  The seafood was fresh, beans tasty, meat done well, and the sauces delicious.  The men both said they enjoyed the flavor notes in their entrees. 

We've already decided to return again.

Fuck this establishment I get the corona virus epidemic but how is a Togo order any different than a full seating area and bar this was the worst service I've ever had no skills by management at all oh I'm sorry and a cold shoulder don't come here unless you want to wait forever for you food checked in been 45 minutes already and still waiting........................went inside again and was told I'd need to wait longer apparently grub hub and other services get priority on Togo at most restaurants that's some fucking bull shit!!!!!!!!! Two and 1/2 hours after ordering food is finally ready cold and all half assed straight bullshit!!!!

My husband & I were looking forward to trying Jakers.  I had an e-mail from them for soup & salad bar for lunch.  Lunch is advertised as being 11-3.  We got there at 3 & by the time the hostess came out it was 3:01.  We asked her if was still lunch and she said it was dinner time.  We pointed out that we were just a minute off.  She actually smirked as she said "yeah, it's after 3". Just rude.
This is my 3rd home. Never had it go this smooth. I thought something was wrong. Maybe they wasn't doing their job or something, but they were on top of things.

Let's be honest here, who doesn't like doughnuts? They make the world a happier place!:)) I come here often since it's close to my house. This is my "go to" place to pick up sweets for my friends, family & coworkers. Asked my 6 year old daughter, she will definitely tell you this is her favorite place to go!:))
I count seven standing around and yet no one taking my order at the bar.  Very odd the lack of service here.  Won't be back for happy hour.

Love this neighborhood pub/restaurant. Perfect for any get together. Great shrimp cocktail. Prime rib is some of the best in the area if you get there in time but you can't go wrong with their burgers or specials. Great portions and value for your money.
Wonderful service and the food is amazing! I was impressed, such an unexpected gem of a restaurant.

You guys show up to our apartments and just start cutting the trees above the cars without any warning or consideration of all the branches your dropping on people's car and dragging them around and in between the cars you could easily warn everyone to move . Then you think leaf blowing the car as I'm leaving helps the situation what the hell is wrong with your crew???

UPDATE: 3/20/19
Only came here because one of our kids requested for his birthday. 2 Handicap accessible parking spaces and 10 To-Go parking spaces

UPDATE 11/21/2018
14 To Go spaces and 2 handicap spaces! Why?

Ok, here we go.... 

I have complained about this multiple times to managemand I really shouldn't return but their handicap accessible parking is a joke! Why on earth do you need so many spaces for pick up and you have one or two accessible 

The only reason for a dirty restaurant is laziness! I love your patio but have you ever heard of a pressure washer??

Nice restaurant. Good customer service (there was an elderly couple making things a little complicated regarding their seating during a very busy time, and the staff was very accommodating and kind). Food was good. I had fajitas and my husband had carne asada with spicy shrimp. Both had good flavor and nice portions, (although the shrimp wasn't spicy at all).  Would go again.

Way better Mexican options in the valley. The queso is velveeta and I'm pretty sure chips are out of a bag. Hit one of the many local places and have better selection and higher quality food.  Another Eagle Rd restaurant destined to fail. :-/

Stopped in for an oil change, WOW what a great experience!! I pulled up and a knowledgeable friendly technician came out to greet me. He explained my options, wasn't pushy and escorted me to their high end waiting area. They not only changed my oil and a dirty air filter without a long wait they also cleaned my truck, great touch. It's nice to find a place that is all about the customer service experience who is also very good at what they do.

We have always loved going to jakers for Happy Hour. We have a couple glasses of wine and an appetizer. Been doing this a couple times a week for almost 3 years. Last two times we have gone we waited 10 minutes for a server. Tonight we walked out. At least 2 servers looked at us, even chit chatted amongst themselves. Two bartenders there and 2 people at the bar. No one came over to take our order. We always tip 20%. I know we aren't largest tab of the night but at 3:00 in the afternoon  Happy Hour we are still patrons. I am bummed cause I don't think my husband will go back. I love their food, wine is great but we needed service. We drove across the parking lot to the Ram and they were happy to see us and waited on is immediately.
The food is great but the service is reliable terrible!  Have been there 3 times and two out of the 3 times the server just walked away.  I just gave up and won't be returning!

Lovely place for unique salads and deliciously pizzas. The wine selection was impressive and we enjoyed lunch with a large group. The artichoke salad was delicious and refreshing. The salad and pizza combo was a generous plate. We enjoyed our time and would visit again. Our only disappointment was that they served our group of twelve at different times, leaving some of waiting for our food while others had finished.

Went here the first time over the weekend and was very happy. This is a tiny little place so not much seating. It seems to be a family run business, our waitress was so nice and very helpful. The food is good very good and you get a good portion for the price. I suggest the Chinese special where you get rice, soup and and an entree for under 10 dollars. My only real complaint was that the the main meal wasn't as hot as the soup when it came out. Also I should mention that if you dont like spicy things the menu is a little sparse for options. But overall very good food and friendly staff.

Reviewer # 6. 

My friend Jon M saw that I checked in here and asked if I found the beyond... and no, I haven't. 
I stopped in here because I was awaiting my better half to meet me at Baja Fresh for lunch. Since it was over 100 degrees outside, I didn't want to wait in my car and I didn't want to go into the food joint and wait around. I looked behind me and there was the BB&B and thought, you know, Lori from Shark Tank sells lots of things in this store so LETS GO... 

I was in the store for about 20 minutes and never got out of the first area. I was stuck in the "bed" part of the store. There was lots of interesting things in here. A lot of creative ideas. The staff was friendly asking me twice if I had any questions or needed any assistance. 

Once I got the call that my honey had arrived, I left the store empty handed; however, I do plan on going to to store again soon and checking out the bath and looking for the beyond!

We've always loved the Yard house, its tasty food, good service and ambience.
We decided to have an early New Years Eve dinner for two there tonight but was quite disappointed.  We went for happy hour and had drinks and appetizers.  The chicken tenders were overcooked and flavorless, the fried cheese curds were terribly salty too.  The Korean Chicken bites were only fair as were the egg rolls, but everything fell short of what we have always loved this place for (layers of flavor and food cooked to perfection)
Our server "Tiana" was friendly enough but our service fell short too.
It took nearly 10 min to get our drinks , the bartender finally brought them himself. (no offer of waters either ) We asked for extra sauce during the meal too, but was completely forgotten, and no offer of ketchup for the fries.
At the end of the meal our server asked how things were and we told her honestly about everything we were unhappy about.  She didn't seem to care less and just pointed to the ticket and said if we wanted to complain we could do it online.
The restaurant wasn't even busy yet.  Which I would have allowed for as I have been a server for years and know what a tough job it can be.
Long story short we won't be back at the Yard house for a while.  The manager needs to work with both his/her cooks and wait staff to improve things a bit.
We are breakfast here this morning. The food tasted great. They gave us good portions and the service was very friendly and consistent. We will be back.
Pretty unhappy with the device I received earlier this week. Management did nothing after a complaint I left!

These burgers are amazing!! Oh my goodness we finally made it here today, and we all loved it. They have kids meals with chicken, burger or corn dogs. For sides you can have fries, onion rings or tater tots. Our family of 5 was $33. Well worth every penny. The people that work here are really friendly too. Just a great place to be!

I am not a big cigar person, but I indulge occasionally especially with a college friend. The Vault is a repurposed cigar and liquor bar in downtown Meridian with a large humidor and small, but impressive selection of drinks. Free street parking is available in the area. 

The interior is exposed brick with high ceilings and lots of leather furniture. Cigar smoke lingers in the air with a handful of gentlemen escaping the outside world for sports, tobacco, and alcohol. This is a man cave in the purest sense. 

The owner pointed me towards a nice cigar for my taste and complimented with a smooth DIPA. They have all the cutters and lighters you need for a long smoke. My friend and I chatted about politics, work, and life over a great smoke and beer. Not bad for a hot Saturday in the Idaho suburbs. 

This is a fun combination of a great owner, amazing cigars, and a perfect atmosphere. Anyone wanting a smoke break would be happy to linger like smoke in the air.

Wowzah! Never lived in an area that had an actual Krispy Kreme location. These doughnuts are what all doughnuts aspire to be! Fluffy and sweet and theres a drive thru as well. Iced and hot coffees, oj, choco milk, or hot chocolates. 

This breakfast will ensure you favorable status anywhere you show up with it!

Eating some today after visiting for the first time yesterday

This is a great little hidden breakfast spot!  In fact....maybe I shouldn't be writing this and sharing the secret! I guess I did discover it through Yelp so it's only fair...

Well to be honest I ended up here twice because I was hoping to try out Joe Momma's across the street and left angry because of the hour long wait. So lucky for me, I found the Hot Spot Cafe with empty tables and kind waitresses! Honestly this place has a great breakfast menu and great service. 

I love a place with a good variety of unique breakfast items and you'll find that here. From many delicious options for French toast including banana bread French toast, to lots of omelettes to choose from. My favorite so far was the biscuits & gravy, so good! My grandma would approve of the gravy so that says a lot. Coffee is also good and they have a variety of flavored creamer which is a plus. They let you have your own personal pot at your table for refills too, sweet! 

Can't wait to come back to try the lunch!

This location is a bit of Russian Roulette.  I've had fantastic pitas and brutal pitas here.  The last few were pretty good but a few weeks ago, my pita was balled up into a ticking time bomb just waiting for me to bite into it so it could explode everywhere.  When I took that first bit, BOOM!  Pita everywhere.  We laugh now and then about it but at the time, I could have spit nails.  Overall, this place is worth taking a chance at.

Stopped in for Boise Supper Club here and they did an AMAZING job taking care of us.  Customer service was excellent!!!  We had a large party and our drinks never went dry, we had our food quickly, a knowledgeable server who was both funny, and attentive to everyone's needs.  Food was hot and tasted delicious.  They really did an excellent job taking care of our group. 

For dinner i had the nachos as an appetizer, fish and chips for dinner, and the beignets for dessert.  

Food was excellent, service was excellent, and we all had a really great experience.  

Support local and come to Homestead for your next meal!
Delicious food and half price appetizers for happy hour.  They have great big booths and windows to see the outside and people watch.  Fun place!!

Not our best weekend lunch visit, service was the biggest miss.  Our server was either annoyed with life or simply didn't want to be there.  Items were forgot, attention was scarce, and smiles were few and far between.  Food was good, beer was cold, and I like that you can pay with the kiosk now, especially when the server doesn't want to interact.
It was nice to see a good crowd there on Saturday, love the food and service is usually good.  I chalk it up to a bad day for one person.

Food was good but barley lukewarm by the time we got it home. There was no hostess and as I waited for my to go order- for which I was never greeted but ignored and had to ask for help- I saw at least one group leave because there was no one to take their name or bring them to a table. Very poorly run restaurant....

This is seriously my favorite restraunt. No seriously.
I'm talking an amazing price for high quality fish and food.
I'm talking amazing service whenever I come in.
I'm talking fun atomosphere with a quaint little restraunt run by great people!
Guys if you haven't tried fish pokè bar you are missing out. The food here is like a build your own pokè bowl where you pick you meat, veggies, rice, and toppings. They have a ton of sauces you can choose from or premixes that are DELICIOUS. I cannot rave enough about the constant fresh fish and food. The amazing bobba is sweet and yummy.

TLDR: try fish pokè bar. You will love it. It is not expensive it is amazing average about 10 dollars.
This place is my new favorite Mexican restaurant. Been here a half dozen times now and everything from service to quality and price have been spot on.

First time @ Blaze Pizza and I really enjoyed their thin crust pizza.  I started with the meat eater and added loads of garlic, tomatoes, and olives.   They had several salads to choose from and I got the Greek Salad which was actually very good.  Will be back to try some different pizza combinations.

Its a bit pricey for the size of the steaks. My other half ordered a burger said it wasn't as good as Red Robins steak. I had a cup of loaded baked potato soup and a side salad for $14 bucks a bit pricey. The soup was good and the salad was a bagged salad.
