Am not a food critic but I know what I know and it wasn't knock down drag out place that you would think reading all the review. Can get the same size steak at Texas Roadhouse a lot cheaper. Some what disappointed we were tucked in the only booth by the door and the waitress seemed really busy so we werent take care of that well. Had to wait for about 10 minutes after asking for the check. We aren't huge spenders on our meals out but to be treated like didn't matter was rather disappointing. Who knows we could have been big spenders we just choose to spend our money on great food and excellent service.

Not bad. I had chili rellano with a hard shell taco / shredded beef.  It was a bit disappointing in that the taco shell was from a box. The chili sauce was a bit sweet and spicy. My friend had enchiladas which had the same red sauce. What was awesome were the retried beans. Highly recommended. I guess another try may be in order and not order combo plates.

Ben and Sandra are amazing to work with. Their communication and customer service are top notch. It only took a few hours to get a quote via email. When we realized the tv wasn't going to be able to be mounted where I wanted it on the day of installation (due to electrical issues), Ben was patient with me while I took a few days to think about what would work for my family and lifestyle. The installation itself took less than an hour and Ben was chatty and friendly the whole time. We did have a small hiccup getting an outlet cover put on after installation, but Ben and Sandra resolved this is issue in a hassle-free and timely manner. I highly recommend them!

Love the atmosphere and (usually) the food, but service last night was really lousy. After waiting 20 minutes for a table on the patio, we were seated and then ignored. I had to go ask for a server. After our food arrived, she disappeared and I had to go hunting for Parmesan cheese, ultimately taking it off another table. We finished eating and sat around ignored again until I went to find someone who could bring us our check and a box. A diner shouldn't have to get up once to help themselves during a meal, let alone 3 times. 

I had a Moscow Mule and the roasted tomato flatbread. The flatbread was excellent and the mule pretty good, but it definitely lacked the ginger flavor I get elsewhere. My kids had the mac and cheese and it was really oily without a lot of flavor. No side dishes with the kids' meals and they charge extra for milk instead of soda. Next time I'll probably order off the regular menu for the kids so they can get something besides carbs and oil.

The Yard House has become one of our favorite places to take friends and we never see a reason to not return!

The indoor/outdoor seating options are great, depending on the weather of course. The wait time to get seated can sometime be awhile on the weekends, but overall not bad. They don't make reservations but do have call ahead options. This is where you can call about 5-10 minutes before arriving and have your name put on the list... it just helps decrease the time you are waiting. But if the wait it going to be awhile just grab the pager and walk around the Village while you wait!

The restaurant is always clean and the staff is quick and very friendly. They personalize your experience with a smile and laughter. They also have a great knowledge of their menus and their many drinks available from the bar. 

Our most favorite reason we take friends though is because they have a HUGE variety of menu options. We all have those picky friends (some WAY pickier than others) and there is something on the menu for everyone.  And the customization of menu items is also excellent!  They do a great job accommodating your requests.  

Favorite menu items I like to order (where to I start?)... The Lamb Burger, the Street and Vampire Tacos, the Artichoke Dip and Lobster Dip, and the Short Rib Ravioli. 

Stop in and grab a bite, you won't be disappointed!
They had a promotion that they didn't honor. Pizza sort of mushy.

Got the elote dog and it was yummy! Went in around 7p and they were sold out of donuts which we kind of expected due to how popular it's been so we weren't too bummed definitely makes it so we come back to try! Our food was great and staff was friendly.

Yummy sushi. Friendly service. My kidos weren't fans of the steak on the kids menu but other than that it was great!

Awesome Cali rolls and soup! More than enough food! Great server.
Food is good but the service is horrible. Almost 25 min just for a cheeseburger through the drive through. This isn't the first time either. Only go if you have a long lunch hour.

On a whim, my daughter and I were driving to an event, and needed dinner. Having a hankering for Mexican, I decided to yelp for help. We were near Pueblo Lindo, and the reviews were good, so we decided to go. 

To start, the staff was incredibly accommodating. 

The food was delicious. My 5 year old got a quesadilla, and not a bite was left. I had the pollo a la crema, and it was terrific. The sauce was rich and creamy(hence the name) but the chicken was also tender, and very well cooked. 

The experience was top notch. I can guarantee a return trip.

The service is amazing, and the pizza is better. Try the blanco and you will not be disappointed. We came the second night they were open and we weren't disappointed. The waitstaff is attentive but not bothersome. The gave me a list of possible allergens (one of our children has a horrible nut allergy) and were able to discuss the menu in detail. The beer selection is small but with a healthy variety. I was especially impressed at how well they welcome and served children. I will definitely be returning, either for a casual beer and pizza or full family meal.

The service, food and drink continue to slide here unfortunately in our opinion. We used to enjoy hanging out and after work get togethers.  We decided to give it one more try this past Friday. We were served in the bar. Took longer than you would think for less than crowded Friday night. The food we ordered the large app trey as others have noted, just ok and not something we would want to repeat. And zero presentation. It looked nothing like the menu photo. The drinks were not made well! The strawberry daq my wife had was mostly syrup, in a beer tumbler, half ice and watery,  with hardly any spirits, no presentation. Completely uninspiring. Marginally drinkable so she stopped half way through. My drink was a simple mixed highball, pretty hard to mess up right? ...and yet...It too was less than par. I tried another. First was super strong, second was super weak. No consistency. The worst part was the 20-30 something waiter who seemed to think he was as part comic, part Vegas entertainer until I asked him how come no drink prices were on their menu...then he goes into lecture mood about how no real restaurant does that and right on the line of suggesting I was foolish for asking. Insult to injury. Check the box. We don't go to restaurants to get lectured by the waiter 30 years our junior. He tried to come back later to smooth it all over but once more comedic timing ...not this lad's forte. Something to the effect "I was not trying to suggest you all were cheap for inquiring about the drink prices." Duly noted. Curiously, that interaction happened just as we were paying with the portable table kiosk, (hint to manager, have your staff wipe them down now and then ours was tacky and sticky) and just as we were finishing the requested review on our experience,  which in truth was far more charitable than the one we are leaving now, It suddenly completed the transaction without allowing us to finish the review. Odd we thought. So then we thought, 'where can we go to to leave a review.? Wife: 'How bout yelp!' Me: 'Smashing idea.' Despite it all we left  our real waitress who tried to overcome and took over 16-17%, which on a 100 point scale is how we would rate the dining experience at the Chili's on Eagle Road on this night.
One of the best burgers I've come across in Boise. Haven't had something I don't like yet.

First time visiting this place.  No previous info or expectations.   We did hear about the Bloody Mary's from a friend.  But we had no idea how INSANE they are.   You have to see it to believe it.   WOW!  What a fun place for a date.   Free Beer samples were flowing.  Place was packed, yet we received excellent, top notch attention and service.  I ordered the Bacon Bleu Cheeseburger.  My wife ordered a Reuben.   Absolutely fabulous and cooked perfectly.  So much food.  The fries are crispy and perfect.  Oh, we are definitely returning to Homestead B&G.....and bringing our friends!

This place is amazing! First time in, and I was very impressed! It is a little pricey, but totally worth it. I love that there's different size selection based on your appetite. They have several different types of fish, toppings, and sauces to choose from. It was fresh, wonderful, and healthy. This is a Poké bowl dream come true. I have never been to a place where I can build my own bowl with such a large amount of ingredients. I will definitely be back! This is perfect for any type of diet or lifestyle.

Ate there for lunch today with three others. Got right in.  It was about 1130. Seemed to get busy about the time we ordered but our food came out fast and very hot. Chips and salsa were great. We had four different things and everyone said theirs was great. Been trying to find a good Mexican restaurant in my area and have found it. Tried all the rest and this is the best. Prices were good and staff was very attentive. Will be back. Highly recommend.

I love this place! Took my mom here for a small dinner and we loved it. We shared the entree mac and cheese and the appetizer meatballs - both to die for! They are not large portions but they're rich and full of flavor - perfect to share. I had a glass of wine and our waiter, Colby, was great. He was accomadating and very friendly. I am excited to come back and try different items off the menu!

I love the wood fired pizza.  I've been to NYC a few times on business lately and I can honestly say that this is a good secondary pizza to me for when I am away from business.  

Get the mac and cheese and any other pie.  I think the place is solid, but its hard for me to give ANY pizza place outside of NYC five stars.

Service was amazing, as well as the atmosphere. Food arrived in good time, drinks were delicious and they have a huge selection of different beers. My favorite drink here is the mango mojito. It is spendy, and the quality of food we ordered didn't seem to reflect how much it cost, which is why I'm only rating 4/5 stars. But that's not to say the food is not good, and the portion sizes will leave you satisfied. I would return here again!

Horrible customer service. Friend and I ordered a pizza online they delivered hers and didn't deliver mine when the delivery person called the store they said that my pizza was set to be picked up and not the liberty even though that is not the way I ordered it. Instead of offering to deliver it once they found out I thought it was going to be delivered they just kept saying it is set to be picked up so I had to get in the car and drive down there and pick it up then they couldn't find it.   Nice touch!

Funky atmosphere and donuts were very pretty to look at. We were happy with the hot dog we tried on their signature bun. Not a huge fan of the street corn-surprisingly oily-and our $4 donut was unfortunately super dry for the most part. Service was great though. Would come back and try something different on the menu.
Had a great dinner. Enchiladas and burritos were good. The customer service was excellent. Very friendly all around.

Me and my family dropped in late tonight right before closing and had the most amazing enthusiastic customer service from the two employees working. Jeremy has the most amazing energy and they were both so amazing at their job. I would love to come back just to see them again :)

My experience with Casa Del Matador in the Village has been hit and miss.  This time I thought I would give a review and whatever my experience was, it will now be emblazoned in the internet to share.

The Food:  My companion and I started with a order of guacamole after the server suggested we have some with our chips.  Nice up-sell!  The avocados were perfectly ripe and flavorful. The dish also came with a salsa verde and pickled vegetables that had jalapenos and onion.  Very spicy and delicious!
My companion ordered the cheese quesadilla and I ordered the 5 street tacos.  My companion had no complaints about her meal.  My tacos were just okay.  They were fairly bland and soaked with grease. Despite there being a different meat in each taco, they all tasted the same. I needed some of the jalapenos and onion to give it some kick.  

The Drink:  No complaints here.  I ordered a Blue Sapphire martini, dirty.  I arrived just how I love it...icy cold with a nice briny kick to the gin. I have always loved the drinks at the Matador!

Ambiance:  The restaurant is dark and lavishly furnished with black iron, crosses and dia de los meurtos figurines. They have a lovely circular fireplace for people to sit around and the vibe is sexy and bit naughty.  

The Service:  Our waitress was polite, friendly and prompt.  Our food arrived in an ample amount of time.  We did mention to her when first arriving that the restaurant seemed very cold (the fireplace was not on).  She said, "Hmmmm...I feel hot."  So with that response, we left our sweaters/coats on.

Price:  A bit on the spendy side.

Once again, my experience with Casa Del Matador was hit and miss.  Some things they do very well (drinks, ambiance).  Some things need improvement (main dishes).  I think from now on I will attend the Matador when I'm in the mood for an appetizer and drink with friends.  Try the Bacon Wrapped Jalapenos stuffed with Goat Cheese.  Heavenly!

Always great service. Have loved everything I've tried. The kids love to make their own pizzas and once they let them watch their creations be cooked in the pizza stove thingy. Great atmosphere. Wonderful patio to sit on downtown meridian.

Received a message the groomer would be 20 late, which is okay. But she ended up showing up 50 minutes late. 
The hair cut was okay, there are places on my dog that are really choppy and abrupt as well as parts that look like the groomer just didn't get to or double check. 
I told the groomer that one part that needed attention was between his toes/paws and she didn't even touch them! 
It's been awhile since my dog's anal glands were cleared and he sometimes drags his butt on the carpet which is a sign he needs them done, she said his were fine and didn't need them cleared. 
There were no prices posted anywhere so even though she was an hour late and didn't seem to do all the parts of the service that it says is included, I still got charged $90. Definitely won't be using this service again.

Really great place! I didn't have any expectations when I stopped by but I ended up really loving it. The prices were reasonable and my bowl was super tasty. The house sauce was particularly good with the fish.  The owner was super polite and friendly. I'll definitely be back again.

Oops! I did it again. Why? Hunger. With a friend who was going to have a drink. I figured I'd give it one LAST shot. Seriously... Last visit there. Poor service is reason enough to not go back to a restaurant. EVER. Having my friends wait for me, at a table, for 25 minutes, when I was sitting in front of the hostess, is another reason to not go back. Three strikes, they're out!

I arrived before my friend. Thankfully, she is striking, and they figured out that she is who I was talking about when they asked who I was waiting for. 

Make nice with the waitress. Blah, blah. Order drinks... blah... We order. I order the Korean BBQ Beef Ribs appetizer. It comes with spinach. I think I'm starving so I dig in and my spinach is the same temperature as the refrigerator. Yes, seriously. I had my friend and the waitress feel it. Needless to say, the waitress took the plate back to the kitchen. She brings it back out, holding it with a mitt. It's HOT!!! I'm happy and still hungry. I take a bit of the ribs and rice. Yep, it's hot. I take a bite of the spinach.... Hot on the outside, refrigerator cold on the inside. WHAT THE #$^%^??!!! How is this possible?

They took it off of the bill. I'm done. Peace out. Not going back. No way. Won't do it. Can't make me. 

#Howhardisittoheatspinach

I'm going to start out with a 4 Star. First time here. Sushi was fresh. House salad was good and ginger dressing was tasty. I Need to try their tempura, teriyaki and other things before I rate up or down. Coming soon....

I was not able to find an address to your corporate office anywhere. If I would have been able to locate this, I would have written a letter to them. I did get a call from the manager at the store on Fairview, which was nice. What was not nice at all was how the guy handled the complaint.

He wanted me to come in to look at surveillance to prove that they did in fact change the oil on my wifes car. This is the oddest thing I have ever (In my 30 + years) been asked to do. Then he proceeded to tell me that according to the car fax, It has been a while since I have had the oil changed. 

#1 that should make no difference at all if they had drained the old oil completely. #2 This is false. I change the oil very regularly on our car. #3 I dont think every oil change place is linked up and notifies Car Fax of changes, so I doubt their reports are accurate. #4 I should not be made to feel like its my fault. 

Any good manager should not do this and should be willing to, at the very minimum, offer a discount on the next oil change. If I were the manager, I would have asked me to come in, checked my oil and offered either a discount, or a free change. This would have been excellent customer service and not the very disappointing CS that I received. It sounded like the manager just wanted to prove that he was right and I was wrong. I posted my experience on Yelp and will not be returning to Einsteins to get any of my vehicles oil changed. Because of the manger here, you have lost a customer for life. I strongly recommend that corporate looks at this and retrains the manager at the Fairview store on how to provide better customer Service

First time at Jakers was a Friday evening with the girlfriend. The food was pretty dang good. Prime rib was cooked exactly how we asked (rare-Med rare) and the prime rib sandwich was great as well. The au jus was probably among the saltiest I've ever had. For what you're paying I could see getting a little more soup or side. Service wasn't bad. Overall pretty good experience.

We have been here about 5 times. My review is more about the service than the food. The steak Benny was absolutely heavenly. Eggs cooked perfectly. To be honest, the food is delicious. This restaurant will fail because of the service. Don't get me wrong, I think they are trying so I'm not sure what the disconnect is. The excuse when we ask what the problem is is always the same. Someone called in. Understaffed. Whatever. They are friendly, but somehow for such a small space overwhelmed. We continue to go back because the food is so good. I will be sad if this place doesn't make it, but tell me where the chef goes and we will follow him there.
Ever get that feeling of tasting something sooo good, your eyes close with a sweet exhale and a smile?  That's how my lunch today made me feel.  Excellent!!
This place is the best. Carne Asada is char grilled to perfection. And try a blended Pina Colada. Also service is the best. Polite, friendly and great food.

Loud not just from people noise but also the game commercials and all blaring at high volume. Ordered a hamburger on a gluten free bun and waitress doesn't have the sense to mention fries are breaded in flour. Burger was mediocre, my husbands rueben was not good, fries fair. Will not be returning. It was crowded when we got there so some must like that whole atmosphere where you can't hear the waitress or the person at your table.
Give yourself time for the food to cool, but when you do, it's SO yummy. Definitely worth it for the insanely low prices during happy hour!

Great food and great atmosphere!!! My husband had a steak that was cooked perfectly and I had the fish tacos which I highly recommend. We are visiting the area for a few days and will definitely be going back here to eat before we go.

We have been going to Flatbread for several years now and I thought it was high time I wrote a review as I think they are very deserving of a great one.  We have ALWAYS had wonderful service, and the food is exceptional.  The happy hour prices are amazing, and a family of 3 can get out of there under $30 with alcohol included.  They always have great local brews on tap, and what can I say about the pizza other than it must have crack in it, as it is highly addictive.  The plucked and peppered is unusual and exceptional as well as the Maple fennel pizza.  I could go on, but really, just try it for yourself, you will not be disappointed.  Oh, I must also comment on the fondue, outrageous!  You will want to lick the bowl. YUM!  
It must be a great place to work, as we always see the same folks working there, and they are always happy and efficient.  Taylor, the GM, always checks on you to make sure you are completely happy too, hats off!
Thanks Flatbread for getting me out of my kitchen and I promise we will never leave a crumb on our plates!

Such a cool place! I got the Rueben and it was honestly the most phenomenal hot dog I had ever tasted. Their homemade chips and fries are also delicious. I'm not a huge fan of their donuts. The chocolate glaze was just messy and not very tasty. But their donuts are creative and huge! I would give them another try for sure.

Fine store. Fine service. Great selection for gaudy holiday stuff. I really only have two complaints. One, they do not stock the Hallmark channel movies on DVD, and two, GEEZUS GAWD THAT IS A LOT OF GLITTER.

I wish I could judge the food and the experience separately but since I can't I'm giving an average of 3 stars with an explanation. 

FOOD - 4 stars
I had the Red Vine concoction from the menu of suggestions. Basically a margherita pizza. My husband did a build-your-own pizza at the same time. He'd been in before and had the spicy sauce which was a little too spicy for his taste (surprising since he doesn't mind sweating). The end result of both pizzas were very good. I ate half of mine in the car on the way back home (Vista area of Boise) but my husband waited until we were home and both were very good even with travelling. My husband was also a fan of the Blood Orange Lemonade served there. As a quick takeout place I would go again if I was in the area.

EXPERIENCE - 2 stars
This was my first time eating here so I'd never tried any of the sauces before. I asked (more like yelled) what I thought was a simple question of, would you recommend the traditional sauce or the white cream sauce with the Red Vine? The lady making my pizza told me she had no idea personally and didn't ask anyone else for a recommendation, just stared at me to make a decision. So, you offer only three sauces in total and you don't have your employees at least try them? That's seriously one of the only opinion questions they will ever be asked but this lady hadn't tried them? It struck me as really odd that she didn't know and really unprofessional that she didn't even bother to attempt to find out for me. The rest of the experience was very typical of a trendy but cheap restaurant. Mostly teenagers and early 20 somethings working behind the counter so you get the teasing and flirting of the employees to keep you entertained. My other big problem with this place was the overall atmosphere. It's got warehouse style ceilings, industrial looking fixtures, and because of this it was extremely loud with a ton of echo. With the music and talking it was super hard to hear to order and would have been unpleasant to sit there with our food. We must have come just after a rush also because the trash cans were being wheeled back and forth adding even more noise to the cacophony. 

All in all, the food was decent, the price was decent, but the atmosphere sucked. We'll be back eventually but wouldn't go out of our way to eat here.
Came through at 10:10pm - cashier could not remember which drink was which and had to wait 20 mins for chicken strips.

Have to just keep shouting out - this Flatbread never disappoints.  Our server Shay was welcoming and kept the food and drinks flowing.  Love the wine list, the musak was just right for three generations, and the food, as ever, crisp, fresh, comforting.  Just wish owners would bring back the peroni clams!

WHY does this place have such a high rating? Sure, the portions are huge, but what about the quality and service?

The menu clearly stated "ask your server about our new cocktail menu". Always up for trying something new and delicious, I inquired. The response from the unsure waitress "ummm, we don't really HAVE a menu for it. We just rolled it out in January (umm, its JULY). We have a bloody mary mix and a margarita mix." Are you kidding me? Just throw SOMETHING together. Anything, really. I ended up ordering my old standby: Ketel and tonic. It arrived after little delay.

The food was "meh". Ok, but nothing to write home about. The purple potato mash, which the waitress had no clue about, was inventive and tasty. The beef, not so much. Bland, tough and obscenely greasy.

The restaurant certainly has a look going on. Lots of bits and bobs as decoration. I can see the Idaho appeal. The patio - no thanks. 

Will I go back? Nope.

Great park. Great location. There are multiple benches to sit on while you sit back and watch your fur babies having a blast. There's even a covered spot to sit away from the sun. They have real grass and artificial turf. The real grass is important for us. Dogs don't have much fun in wood chips. They like real grass to run and play on. The turf seems to keep things clean and not smelly. They have water bowls, a pool, and sections for small and big dogs. They also have outdoor restrooms that always seem to be in great shape. My small dogs love going here where the dogs are similar in size. They start whining and crying in excitement as soon as we are down the street because they know where they are going.  We are thankful this place exists and come often.

First impression, filthy. More after I order and eat. Floors and tables are disgusting. 

It amazes me to see five star ratings for this place. It really begs the question "are these the business team for this location?" Friends perhaps?
The people that rated this a five-star have obviously never been to a real five-star restaurant. Come on guys, paid reviewers? 

First time here in the Idaho Blaze. I have to say, not impressed at all. There's a girl at the oven and she's picking her ear with her finger.
There are at least five people behind the line, more in the back, and they are slower than molasses.
There are at least eight tables open and every one of them are dirty. There are napkins and straw wrappers and crumbs and cheese and dirt all over the floor. The glass for the hot table where they slice the pizza has been splashed with who knows what. It's disgusting.
The pizza will probably be ok but I won't be bringing my family of 5 here again. Blaze isn't THAT good. 
In the hour we were here no one swept the floors, more tables are dirty, and the line is still long. 
The pizza was good, build your own, but the dough split because they didn't press it well enough. It kinda broke apart while eating. 
Just ok.

Went to take my family to Texas Roadhouse in Meridian Idaho, and we were treated extremely poorly.  We came in with 4 adults one child and two infants and we were told it would be a 10 minute wait, after 20 minutes walked to front staff and the young lady with the long eyelashes was extremely rude to me when I inquired about the wait time saying that because we had two infants they had to be careful as to where they sat us.  There were 5 girls standing around at the front counter talking about us and not doing anything to help clear tables.  Went down the road to Goodwood and were seated upon entering the restaurant and treated kindly and offered a special place to sit with the babies.  Will not ever eat at Texas Roadhouse again and especially this one.
We had a very fast closing date, I believe eighteen days, and Academy Mortgage came through with flying colors.

Terrible food and service! I will not be returning to this place. Soup tasted like it had soap in it from not cleaning the cooking pot or something. Chicken was dry, and the shrimp appetizer breading wasn't fully cooked.

The pizza here is probably some of the best. If you think Dominos and Pizza Hut serve 5 star pizza...this isn't your place. If you're looking for something more authentic and wood fired...you gotta go here. The pizza is worthy of 5 stars (especially on $10 Tuesday's). Try the downtown and Bown location. Awesome food and atmosphere. Stay away from the Flatbread in Meridian though...it's dirty. The restaurant is dirty. Floors dirty. Tables dirty. Patio...even dirtier. The staff seems to favor a lackadaisical approach to food service. Oh, and as for atmosphere...none. Go for the pizza it's completely worthy of your hard earned dough....but maybe order take out from this particular location. 

Rating Breakdown:
Pizza: 5 stars
Cleanliness: 1 star
Atmosphere: 2 stars
Staff: 3 stars 
Average: 3 stars (rounded up because the pizza really is that good)

Great wings!! Great beer selection!! Fun pub like atmosphere!! Definitely recommend this place to anyone who enjoys trying different beers. My Husband and I love getting the pterodactyl wings and a sampler. You won't be disappointed!!

Better Life Chiropractic is one of the best chiro clinics that I have ever had as a healthcare provider. Dr. Christian Price is a very talented chiropractor that specializes in treating injured athletes and is extremely strong. The ladies that handle the front desk and appointment scheduling are all awesome. Thank you to everyone at Better Life for your extraordinary care and concern for all of your patients.

Everyone around here knows that texas roadhouse is a fun place to get a yummy steak,  the honey butter is fabulous! Also, the blended margaritas are somehow creamy? This is some sort of voodoo magic that i don't understand but i seriously love! The hosts always ask how my last experience was, and that's nice, but these poor kids are expected to ask you about yourself while trying to navigate this restaurant and talking in the opposite direction, meanwhile it's super loud. I don't know how they don't crash into each other all night! Shannon was my server. She was wonderful! The food was great! The prime rib was fatty, but a good fatty. I can't even explain it. It's another roadhouse mystery! I love this place! I will be back! Thanks again!
Fabulous food, service and ambiance!! Highly recommended!! We will be back! Thanks sooo much

I enjoyed this pizza very much! I'm from Boston and am somewhat unaccustomed to Chicago style pizza. After a very long day of traveling, I ordered a pizza and salad and it truly hit the spot! I called the wrong location and the fellow I spoke to took the time to find out the correct location that would deliver to my hotel. After calling the location that could deliver to me, they were efficient and the food arrived quickly and was hot and very tasty! A great end to a stressful day. Thank you!!!

Easy review, the security team treats loyal customers as though they are thieves, with a "sic em" attitude, especially when the customer is disabled and doesn't follow the cookie cutter image this Walmart seems to have of the ideal customer. Hey, my $$ spends just like everyone else's, and easily spends at other stores unrelated to this unappreciative branch. Won't be back.

Cashiers and most other staff would be the only reason this store gets any more stars, they are really good most of the time, but since I can't separate the stars, one shall remain. Cya.

When I moved here for a new position my car quit working. It was a 2005 Hyundai Elentra with 200,000 miles on it. They didn't make me feel like a loser for driving old car, in fact they found things that didn't have to be replaced while redoing electrical wiring that rodents had chewed through saving me money.

My experience had made me a loyal customer and now I have 2019 Buick Enclave that I take to them for oil changes and will have them do service work as needed. 

I have found everyone that I come in contact with to be very friendly and smiling when being greeted.

Keep up the good work.
Great spot and friendly dogs.  It is a little short on shade.  They have water for dogs and two sections for small and large dogs.

I was returning a favor for a neighbor who'd helped me at our home. So I offered to take him out for dinner at the place he chose. It was Kahootz in Meridian, ID. Re raved about it but to me it's just another "Bar & Grille". Nothing special.
The food leaves a lot to be desired and they've messed my order up both times I've been there...the one upside is the atmosphere, it can be great on warm summer nights.

Sadly disappointed with our meal tonight.  Both ribeye steaks were tough.  One more so than the other.  Both steaks were overlooked. Had the green beans as a side and it was more like green bean mush.  The entire serving was little tiny bits and green bean baby food consistency. There were only about 5 small beans that were not broken up. I must have gotten the bottom of the supply, that had been over-stirred for hours. Service was good, as usual, but the meal fell significantly short of prior experiences at TR.   We are hoping this was just an off night!  We frequent this TR and is consistently great.  We would hate to see the quality decline to this level as the norm.

My food never came. Steak dinner ended up in s box to go. I should have just left hungry. Food was cold. Yes I paid for my food but we were going to a function so I did not eat it. Probably won't eat it either. Three of us that ordered the same dish ended up taking to go.... no explanation just... others at our table got their food but cold. They brought more fries but we had to get going. We allowed 1.5 hour for dinner but not enough. Very poor management

Fredo is awesome! He definitely made our first experience here at Casa Del Matador one that we enjoyed. The food was delicious, the service was amazing and quick, and we look forward to our next meal here. We got the mushroom fajitas, Veg burger, and the Veg burrito! Plenty of vegetarian and vegan options :)

I had heard my family members rave about this place, so I went here last night. The menu sounded enticing, but when the food came out it was not mimicking the description. Fried Crispy brussel sprouts, were burned and soggy, crispy not.
When I received my steak tacos, I looked for the meat, it was one ounce of steak total in two tacos, instead they buried them in lettuce and pico de gallo. The flour tortillas were cold, and with that said the steak taco was cold. Smdh. 75% of my plate was holding dry rice, and refried beans, I ordered a vegetarian plate not steak tacos. 
The meal was highway robbery, I will not give this place a second chance because reading other reviews this is not an exception but the rule. The only part that was very good was the chips and salsa. 
This is as corporate food empire where the overhead is huge, and to save money they cut into the quality of the food. The menu is a bait and switch. It has good intentions and sounds goo, but the execution is where it goes downhill. 

If you want customers to come back. Saying you are sorry, and continue to let food through the pass the same way, means you are not sorry.

33.39 dollars for a meal with a glass of wine, bottled water, soggy brussel sprouts and steak tacos that had 5% meat and 95% lettuce with pico de gallo is highway robbery. 

Thanks but no thanks.
Their chicken wings are amazing. I was introduced to this place by a friend and hands amazing

I would give this place ZERO stars if I could. We ordered from Doordash the other day... First, we received the completely wrong order and they were nasty to the driver. Then, they sent kind of what we ordered, except that the "regular wing" order was actually boneless. The conclusion was that the food quality was bad, the lazy people working there don't give a crap, and nobody should get food there EVER.

Killer addition to The Village! Stopped in this evening for a quick bite before a movie and was blown away with the fun concept, polite and exited staff, attentive owner, and super solid food. 

Had the Elote and Flying Hawaiian dogs with the house fries. Their take on Mexican street corn on a hot dog was really fun and the hot dog and bun itself would be standouts on their own. Fries were seasoned and hot. You can tell they have a chef working the grill. Also, big props for having a veggie dog as an option for any of the hot dog offerings. 

I was glad to hear the continue to sell out of their donuts by midday so I will have to come back one morning. Handmade brioche donuts are worth the effort to make a separate trip.
Usually love this place - but not this time. Played never cleared and my food so-so. Definitely wasn't worth the wait. One more chance ? Not anytime soon

Have been here a couple few times and have never been disappointed.  Is sushi expensive in Idaho?  Yes.  Does Eagle Road in Meridian suck nuts at all times?  Yes.  Does Sakana on Eagle Road deliver great sushi during every visit?  Yes!

We've made multiple visits to Sakana since we discovered it in 2010.  It is certainly a gem off the beaten path unless you know it's there.  I pass it on a semi-regular basis and every time I see it I have a fond memory of both the grub and the facility

On our first visit, we were fortunate enough to experience the "fancy rooms" (where you take off your shoes and sit at a low table.  Service it A, grub is A, over all experience is A.

The grub Sakana is on par with the authenticity of the experience.  If you don't like Sakana then you don't like sushi!!!!

This is Probably my favorite steak house! We drove up on a whim and parked. Entered the place and it was packed. We took a seat at the bar... where we had a sampler beer platter! Amazing, because the I actually got to pick the beer I wanted. 
The bread was awesome, the steak was cooked to perfection! Medium rare, perfectly. The asparagus and potatoes were to die for! We will absolutely be back and would recommend this place to everyone!!

It's a shame that the same restaurant I rated best let me down. I hated the attitude of the waiter, looking hasty and ignored our table. 

We had a pobalano carnitas with half chicken. I'm billed for habenero steak. When asked the waiter she told me $13 burrito with the meat substitute is going to work the same to $19. Ridiculous!

Also for the kids meal, there was choice side of fries but she gave us beans & rice as an option. Not even strawberry lemonade for kids beverage. Again since there was chicken, we opted for grilled chicken (not knowing it's for extra $$).

Remember folks: Chicken in menu option is the shredded one. Grilled chicken extra fare* not mentioned in menu nor a word updated by the waiter. Left disappointed, WILL NEVER BE BACK.

Pretty large restaurant with a louder atmosphere. Good place to grab a bite if you're shopping or seeing a movie. Our server Chris had great energy - he was very hardworking and friendly. I took off a star because most of their options are heavier/ not many healthy or veggie options so it might be hard for a large group with varying tastes.

Ate here awhile back when my parents were in town. Good food. Small inside and loud. Too loud for me had hard time hearing conversations. Food is of good quality. Seems always busy even busier Friday's and into weekend. If you want high end food - this is the place to go.

Very cool place. We had the chili dog, rueben, and bahn mi. They were all delicious. We also had a churro donut, and a raspberry mojito donut. They were very good. Everything had balanced flavors. The staff was friendly, and took time to give us the story of there restaurant, even though they were busy. We highly recommend checking this place out.

The crab stuffed mushrooms really were not that good. The mushrooms were thick and under cooked. Lacked flavor. The salad my husband got had way too many carrots on it. I upgraded to the strawberry salad and that was excellent. My husbands filet was outstanding, my sirloin was ok. Overall not terrible but the filet and the strawberry salad is what saved the meal.

Nice Marshall's. Clean and well organized. Lots of choices. Not too far drive from Ole Miss campus sister store Ross Dress for Less right next door. Looks like down the strip mall planning on opening a Home Store

Rude people. Just stopped in while in the area to ask a couple questions before bringing our fur baby in. Won't be going back after dealing with the people. Those employees would be better suited in a California DMV.

My dear friends who live next door have been telling me about Main Street Burgers for years. I don't know why it took so long for me to get here. MS burgers is a homemade local burger place. It is sandwiched next to Chicago Connection, Kahootz Bar and a soon to be Blimpies. There's a small patio outside but we decided to eat inside. The counter area is tight but the staff is very friendly and helped us with the ordering process.  The menu is pretty simple. I ordered the Bacon Guacamole Burger and my wife ordered the Bacon Cheeseburger. You can make each burger a combo of you want. There are onion rings, tots, and fries. I had heard that the tots were really good. The sinning space is small as well. The walls were filled with framed pictures of hot rods, cars, and classics. Our order arrived and it was a lot of food since we made each burger into a combo. My burger say on top of a generous bed of tater tots. The wife's burger came in its own boat because the onion rings was overflowing in their own boat. If there are two people, my suggestion would be for one person to order a combo and the other not. So that both people can share the fried goodness.  My Bacon Guacamole was simply delicious. The Bacon was thick filled with a smoky flavor and pepper. The Guacamole was spread evenly on the bottom bun. The meat and cheese worked well together. Overall it was a great burger  and quite frankly the best among non-chains. I would totally recommend MSB for a classic burger with a homemade fresh taste.

So incredibly disappointed to order a pizza at 8:30ish and wait forever for it. Only to find out they thought it was for pick up when the conversation stated clearly we were at our hotel. My husband went to pick it up and because it was so close to closing time, they left and we have no pizza ... 11p local time here and hubby is returning with McDonald's ..  ugh just awful. But hubby would like to stay a little longer than planned in the morning to thank you personally.

What an amazing job they did from design advice to install.  Very professional, with attention to detail.  We couldn't be happier with our new countertop!!  Highly recommend their services.  Thanks guys!

I have to admit, R&R BBQ was really great. It's comfy, clean and attractive. his menu has every thing I like and I'm very excited to try it all. The staff is very friendly as well. Definitely will come back to this place always.
Wouldn't bring any animal I cared for here again. We had our dog done here and they tried to throw in extra fees at the end and then our dog developed a hematoma from his surgery.

Love this place! Was waiting for their opening and so happy to finally check them out! We were lucky enough to meet the owners and hear their story! The shop has a fun vibe, so clean, and definitely a place you'd love to hang out - not just treating your taste buds. The donuts (tried 3 in store and took 4 home) and thought highly of all of them. Their coffee is delicious, staff is wonderful, and truly a gem came to The Village with their arrival. 5+ stars all the way!

Went to this location last night walked up to check in my party of 5, hostess asked if everyone was here I said no we're waiting on 1 person, so she handed me a pager and said to let her know when everyone had arrived. So confused, I asked if I was checked in for 25-35 minute wait since she handed me the pager to which she replied no you will go to the bottom of the list when you check back in. This is a terrible policy, I will never eat at another Texas Roadhouse the food is not tasty enough to put up this policy and the obnoxious noise level of the music.

We've been going to this restaurant for a few years now but it seems that there are big CUT BACKS going at this particular Flatbread location.  First, we ALWAYS order the fondue appetizer because the cheese is to die for but last night, we didn't get anymore than 1/4 cup of the cheese and after a few bites each, it was gone.  We also ordered the apple walnut chicken salad and that portion was reduced too.  Sadly, we won't be back to the Meridian location.  We've never had a problem with tiny portions at Bown or downtown Boise locations.
Always good. Mushroom Kale soup and warm spinach salad seasonal special was great. None of the deserts are very good. But all the Flatbreads and most pizzas great.

Eryka is doing a beautiful cover up on my back, she custom made the perfect Sailor Moon piece for me! I recommend her to everyone! She's a great artist and has an awesome personality! Love my sessions with her.

Came here on a Friday evening. Called in beforehand to get on wait list. Was told 15 to 20 minutes and give code when arriving. Arrived 15 minutes later and was told it would be a couple minutes. 20 minutes later and multiple people who came in after us being seated we turned in our pager and left hungry and frustrated. We had eaten here before and the food was mediocre, came back on youngest kids request, but will never return. Famous Daves around the corner blows this place away in food and service. Would not recommend anyone go here based on not so great food, extreme wait times, and poor customer service.

I prefer shopping at Lowe's over the orange box store. The service is always good and I usually find everything I am looking for.
However, this location is exceptional. I've had two recent buying experiences that signal to me that the management is selecting top notch staff who have strong customer service skills.
We were searching for window blinds for our home and had limited success finding the kind we wanted. We finally called Lowes and had the good fortune of speaking with Lori in the blinds department. Over the phone, she collected my information, quoted me an excellent price, and scheduled our measurement appointment. Later that week Lori called to let us know that one of the brands we were considering was having a sale...which saved us even more $$s. Lori is very organized, communicative, fun and friendly. It was such a stress-free experience which we certainly appreciated. Lucy, the dept. manager, was also very helpful and has a "can-do" spirit.  The installers they selected were great and the blinds were a perfect fit. 
Mike, in kitchen appliances, helped me select a refrigerator and made all the delivery arrangements over the phone. He set up delivery and followed up with a phone call. Even the delivery guys were professional making sure not to scratch walls or dent our new floor.
This Lowe's will be our permanent "go-to" store from now on.

This is not a place I would recommend to anyone. Not because of the food, but because of the service and their lack of attention on the details. My wife, kid and I went to this place for dinner. We ordered the western bacon, the guacamole burger and a chicken strip basket for my son. Now first and foremost, this establishment doesn't have anything a burger joint doesn't. They all have decent food generally for the most part like any other burger joint I've been too(assuming they don't burn the food). But where they have a massive downfall is in customer service and the details of the order. The lady who took the order got it right as it was on the receipt. But was extremely snippy when taking it. But to begin with after sitting at the drive up sign to order for five minutes(literally) I only here someone come on to say "has someone taken your order?" To which I replied "No" and they responded with. "Give us a moment and we will take it".(Clearly this sets a tone of "your time isn't important to me"). After another five minutes someone comes on. I begin my order, after everything I say she asks me to repeat it, at least three times. After being in the drive up for 30 minutes we get to the window to pay. Only to sit, don't get greeted or anything. Finally the girl opens the window. Now I have a 20 in my hand and two penny's to hand her; My total was $18.02. I try to hand her the pennies and she just snatches the $20 out of my hand and turns away. No greeting, we try and get her attention to give the pennies as I really don't want 0.98 back. Another girl with purple hair comes to the window. I explain to her we are simply trying to get her attention she didn't take my pennies and I really don't want all the change back. To only here her say "I can't hear you". She gives me a look, and I can immediately tell it's the same girl who took the order as she displays the same attitude she gave me when I was trying to place it. She grabs the pennies out of my hand and tells the other girl to give me two dollars in a very rude way. The lack of team work displayed between the employees explains the wait times. As the business clearly was not operating appropriately. To whom ever owns the establishment, I would highly recommend spending some time setting standards for your employees. If you don't this business is bound to fail, I've seen it time and time again. If you don't have time I'd recommend hiring a manger to work the place to do the same thing. If you have one(hate to say it but they need to go, or need a coaching session themselves)... Now to finish the story, the girl turns hands me my change and says "I'm so sorry, today is my first day and I'm really lost in here. I'm really frazzled because no one is helping me either so I don't know what to do. I apologize. It's really f**king bad in here." Now if that doesn't say something coming from the employee, excusing her poor choice of words from a professional stand point. Or good manners when representing the business. She is telling the customer what is being perceived is true. Well we sit and sit and then the food comes. Now immediately I think I better check the food. Well I have two burgers with NO sauce on either one(we didn't order it that way) and chicken strips with fries and not tots like we did order. I sit trying to get the girls attention she finally opens the window and I explain to her we asked for tots it's on the receipt but you gave us fries mistakenly. I assume they want it back so I try and hand it to her. The new girl doesn't know what to do so she turns to the girl with purple hair. She comes to the window rolls her eyes and says keep the chicken and fries we will make you your tots and slams the window. A minute maybe goes by and someone comes to the window and says can you please pull up by the flowers while we make your order correctly. So I do, I sit and sit and sit and now we have spent almost forty five minutes in the drive up here only to get the girl with purple hair to bring the tots. I roll down the window and she sticks the bag out and says with an attitude "Here's your tots!" In a very smart aleck tone. No apology, no sorry for the wait, no I apologize for the in-convenience. Then rolls her eyes again, turns and walks off. So long story short, if you want meh burgers that you can get at McDonald's for a fraction of the time, less money and same quality. Then you'll enjoy this place. If you want to save yourself the experience and time don't go here. Only up side compared to "fast food" was fresh cooked patties. Everything else about this establishment: it's atmosphere, customer service, attention to detail and a general understanding of how to operate a business from a customer service stand point doesn't apply. Happy eating folks!... We have given up trying to eat here. To many consistent stories like this with this establishment

The food is Great. Different Mac n Cheese plates with generous portions. Beer variety changes weekly. Not sure how many handle but there's always a Stout to try. I'm a regular for Thursday night's when they have different breweries bring in samples and swag. Take home a pint glass when you enjoy one of breweries beers that night. Staff is always friendly.

I don't live in Meridian but found myself trekking to this location to retrieve a library book for book club.  It was hopping on a Saturday - book fair at the entrance, singing for youngsters with a guitarist, and a teen room.  Busy, large parking lot.  Yet I was able to get in and out quickly.  Librarian was very helpful and very nice environment.  Probably needs to be bigger but they use all of their space well.

2nd reviewer of Rite Aid in Meridian, Idaho. 
My 381st Yelp Review. 
A-OK-- works in a pinch!

I am a big Rite Aid fan. Really only their sale items, and their plenty point reward club. Rite Aid in general, I give 5 Stars; however, this particular Rite Aid lacks in a few areas. 

The customer service is extremely lacking. When you walk in the door you really never see anyone. It's like a ghost town and many of times, I've had to stand around and wait for someone to come check me out. The store seems to not get much business; therefore, the cashiers do double duty and are working on special projects in the very large store. The cashiers, don't make small talk, rarely talk to you, are often super slow, and the scanner rarely works. 

Additionally, their stock runs low. Sale items are gone rather quickly (most of the time) as well.

I'm going to start out with a 4 Star. First time here. Sushi was fresh. House salad was good and ginger dressing was tasty. I Need to try their tempura, teriyaki and other things before I rate up or down. 

UPDATE 4/2019 - Downgrade from 4 stars to 3 stars. We ate lunch on a Friday afternoon. Had the shrimp tempura combo plate and I could tell the oil they were using was VERY OLD. I may not come back if I find a better Japanese restaurant.
Great place for lunch or dinner in the summer, food was good and we liked sitting outside while our 2 year old ran in the grassy area next to the patio.  I had a pizza and it was very tasty.

The Yard House is one of our restaurant staple because we have never had even a remotely bad experience and the food and atmosphere is great. My wife and I have been going since the restaurant opened. We've seen some items deleted and some changed for the better.  We often take friends and family to enjoy the food and atmosphere (best music genre list in the Valley!). We were there last night and have to give a big high five (hope I'm not dating myself) to Spring the manager. She has always been friendly and courteous, she was very polite and accommodating and helpful last night. 
Always a good time at Yard House!

Service was slow despite arriving before the dinner rush. Sushi roll was underwhelming. With a limited trip window to try restaurants, I wish I had spent my meal elsewhere - however I had certainly had worse.

Josh has made my home away from home. Great cigar venue. It rivals all the cigar bars and private clubs I have been to over the years. Josh had a great cigar selection. His employee was very friendly and very knowledgeable. I smoked the 1502 Blue Sapphire that she recommended. It was a Nicaraguan smoke. Medium body. It was a hour smoke and it had great flavor. It burned evenly and cleanly. I will defiantly buy this cigar again. The venue was very comfortable and had a very friendly vibe. The leather chairs were very comfortable and inviting. Josh was very knowledgeable and I found the history of the building to be very interesting. Again the clientele was very friendly. I only got to talk to Laurie on the phone. She was very friendly and answered all my questions. I am looking forward to my next visit.

we have been going to Sakana restaurant for many many years. It has always been our favorite restaurant in Boise. What has happened to our favorite restaurant? We are so disappointed! The salad looked like it was made yesterday and stored with the dressing in the refrigerator.
The fried tofu was pale and undercooked. The beef negimaki was horrendous. The beef used to be a nice slice the beef with a few scallions now the beef is like saran wrap with hundreds of scallions and, the meat was fatty. I asked to get in touch with the owners and they said that was impossible. Someone will have to drag me to go back to that restaurant! Too bad

Every time I come to this buffalo wild wings they never pay attention to the person up at the front waiting. The servers will walk back and forth not paying any attention to the people up front. By the time the togo person walks up to the front they are either unfriendly or eating something. I work in the restaurant industry and this restaurant lacks professionalism. It is so sad because this is one of my favorite places to eat at. Things need to change.

I've taken my 2000 Toyota Tundra into Dowdy's multiple times and had a good experience each time. Recently the battery went dead, I replaced it and within 1 day the new battery went dead. I took it back to an auto parts store and they told me the alternator was bad. I then took the truck over to Dowdy's and talked to Stu. He advised me to go back over to the auto parts store and replace the battery connectors and splicer cables myself before I spent $100's of dollars on replacing the alternator. I did that, it cost me less than $30 and 30 minutes of my time. I then had the auto parts store check the alternator again and it was in great shape. 
Basically Stu saved me $500-$800 and did the "right thing" and cost himself a little business in the short term. It is hard to find a mechanic who will give you your best options rather than dig in and start charging you for services that may not be needed. 
Dowdy's has definitely got my business moving forward. Thank you to Stu and to Dowdy's!
One of my favorite restaurants in the area.  Close to work and home.  I love the food and atmosphere!  The service is always great.  Always do the Pick 2 menu.
Excellent Neapolitan pizza! I ordered the diavola and it had nice bold flavors and was very enjoyable! I will be coming back.

Excellent service and superior dinner. We had dinner on a Sunday evening and there were plenty of open tables. We did call ahead to make a reservation just in case. My hubby ordered the October special which was the schnitzel and it was amazing.  I had the tempura shrimp and it was perfect. David was our server and he was awesome. Very professional and attentive. We highly recommended Jakers in Meridian. We have also ate at the one in Twin Falls and we have had Thanksgiving dinner at the one in Great Falls Montana. All of them are exceptional.

Very Disappointed. I ordered food to go on Christmas Eve and my husband and I decided to dine in for Valentines Day today. Let me say first, Yes it is always expected for businesses to be busier than normal on certain occasions. Both experiences on Christmas Eve and today were horrible. One person waiting and bussing tables. Same person also working on to go orders. Food took forever and there was a young girl who was also helping with to go orders and a little girl, maybe 2; both coughing like crazy. Perhaps have extra help when business will be a lot busier than normal.

My wife and I stopped by here for lunch today. We have been to the Meridian location but not this one Boise downtown and decided to try it. It's on the 2nd floor of the 8th and Main building, and has a classy, upscale yet casual look inside. We were greeted warmly and shown to one of the tables located next to the best feature: floor to ceilings windows overlooking 8th Street. I believe they open them in nice weather as well. They have a bar that has a couple tv's (extra points for having hockey on!) that looked like a nice place for a casual drink.

We each got the Pick Two lunch combo, intending to share so we could taste 4 dishes. My wife got the lemonade which she said was delicious, and I ordered iced tea which more water than tea. 

The first combo was the Tomato Bisque Soup and Chicken Portobello Sandwich. I am not a tomato soup fan really, but my wife loves it. In the interest of my fellow Yelpers I took one for the team to taste it. It is creamy but not too heavy, and tastes of tomatoes and herbs. It's not bad and the texture is fine- just not my favorite. She did finish it all however! The sandwich was not my top fave, mainly because it was a good 85% thick bread. Awkward to eat, very little filling (I would not have been able to identify a single ingredient if I hadn't read the menu description) and to me very dry. Again, my wife seemed to find it better than I do, but she also generally enjoys bread products more than I do. 

The second combo was the Tuscan Chicken Pizza (it comes as a "pizzette" or individual little one in the combo) and the Chicken Arugula Salad. The pizza was delicious. The crust has the signature wood fired taste, the toppings were in good relation to the pizza. It was a touch dry and had I had a sauce to dip it into I just might have. The salad was fresh and well balanced and the dressing was delicious. My only annoyance is one I have with many restaurants- cut your ingredients to at least somewhat fit on a fork! When you are trying to eat salad and every piece is so big you can't fit it in your mouth and it's a mess, it drives me crazy. It doesn't have to be a chopped salad but just some simple cuts to make it more manageable, especially at a place where business lunches are common (end lettuce rant).

The service was good. Our server knew the menu, was very polite and helpful when asked to place an ingredient on the side, and seemed friendly and sincere. Lunch didn't take a long time to get to us, but we lost our server after the food came and he focused elsewhere. It was quite a while before he got back to us and we had to request the check and a box (I couldn't finish my combo). All told, lunch took 55 minutes, which isn't horrible but is cutting it close as I was on a work lunch break. Bill was $28 for the two combos and two beverages, so a bit pricey for an everyday lunch spot but a good "once in a while" or "special" option. 

Overall it's a nice little lunch spot and the service was good, the place was clean and inviting, and the food was solid. I would love to see a few more options on the pick two menu geared towards a stronger protein base- like some of the meatball or prawn appetizers maybe, or just a grilled chicken breast with the toppings maybe. I suppose I could try ordering a sandwich without the bread but it isn't the same thing usually as an option that is actually meant to stand alone. I'd happily pay a bit of a "up charge" for a solid, lunch protein option in the Pick Two line up.

.Throw the word "famous" onto a menu item, and someone will try it, for the thrill of testing. That's kind of why I came into this place, to try one of the world famous macs. The common theme here is mac & cheese.
.Ordered the BBQ pork mac. It's pulled pork, jalapeno, and cheese over elbow macaroni. As you can see from the photo, they only fill the bowl about halfway. The macaroni was not bad, but undercooked. Maybe others like it this way - firm and chewy. The stuff tastes okay while warm, but quickly loses my interest as it cools. It also made me thirsty, but having already parted with 9 dollars on this, I decided to get my drink elsewhere.
.The interior reminds me of a Zupa's. Clean, casual, noisy. Pasta is generally a cheap food. The higher prices here are probably paying for bussing tables and washing bowls, and perhaps the fact this is a high traffic and high rent district.

I've had two meals at Flatbread in the last two weeks since first trying it and I'm pretty sure that's only going to be more often. I haven't had a bad experience yet. Last time we went to the Meridian location and Austin was our server and he was great. The little patio was great and I especially enjoyed the little water fountain view. I really want to go back for their happy hour soon. I love going to happy hour with my girlfriends! Very impressed with how the sandwiches taste and I can't wait to go and actually try the flatbread. Soon! Very soon!

Food is very tasty...the restaurant is LOUD!  But...we were seated next to a birthday party.  Portion sizes are fairly large so we brought home a doggy bag... Food servers are very attentive and pleasant.  I would return back to to casual dress restaurant.  I had the prime rib...which is very filling and was cooked to perfection.

My husband took me out for lunch and my expectations were high. 
Food was average, nothing special. 
Our server was overwhelmed with the amount of tables he was taking care of. 
I'm not planning to go back in the future.
We eat here all of the time. We love it! Food is amazing, service is great! We recommend the goat cheese appetizer! Mmmmmm

I ordered my pizza online and was given the estimated pickup time of 35-45 minutes. I showed up after 30 minutes and picked up my pizza. I got home and opened the box and was greeted with what is seen in the picture. Toppings that look like they were thrown everywhere and it looks like some of them somehow held on when they landed (and just on a few slices). Next to zero sauce was on the pizza as well as it being completely folded over on one side. Also, it was COLD and not by just a few minutes either. It had to have been sitting in the box on the counter for 20+ minutes by the time of pickup. With this being my first experience with Blaze, I doubt I'll ever back. The staff were running around like crazy and there was little to no care placed into how they were assembling pizzas.  As someone that has worked in the food industry, I'd be embarrassed to send out anything that looked like this!

Tortured ear drums and aversion to sardine can seating trump tickled tastebuds which means it is unlikely I'll be back to Blaze.  The good news at this Meridian outpost of the chain is the thin crust, quick fired (cooks in 180 seconds) pizza is far better than my hubby and I expected it to be.  More good news is the young staff, all of whom seem relatively new to retail food service, are friendly and eager.  Both of those good news things keep this rating from sinking to two stars because in a simple measure of different strokes for different folks, we both said "you must be kidding" about what we think is pretty awful space planning and the gawdawful loud, that is LOUD, music on the sound system.

It is one thing to get a good buy on decent pizza but it is another thing to enjoy eating it in the restaurant's surroundings.  At Blaze I get the first thing and not the second thing.

Still, they gave us "buy one get one" coupons for future visits.  Never one to set aside any free offer ("free is best" he says), my hubby may venture back on his own for a BOGO take out pair.  But he'll do that without me and keeping in mind my Yelp friend Mick L's good counsel that Blaze pizza is best when eaten at the point of creation. 

CATTLE CHUTE MEET SARDINE CAN
Space planning here made me stop right at the door and wonder, "What's up with this".  Tightly spaced tables straight ahead, sardines might have more room in some cans than you can at some of the tables, you are obliquely and intuitively directed by that "barricade" to the left to a cattle chute arrangement that will take you up to the counter to place your order.

ORDER PROCESS
Although they have little menus right at the start of the chute, some do not know to take them or perhaps have time to review them so there can be a bit of a wait while the delightful staff folks behind the counter explain the schtick then take the order and assemble the pizza before greeting the next in line to explain the schitck then....

SCHTICK
The schtick is that one can order an 11" (?), personal size pizza (note we found it amply fed two lighter eaters so another good news thing here) with a choice or red sauce, spicy red sauce or white sauce and an unlimited number of toppings of one's choosing for only $7.25.  Plain cheese pizza and pizza with one topping are both under six bucks, but otherwise one may order from a handful of house specials or create one's own pizza with literally as much of anytthing as one wants and pay the flat $7.25 fee.  Which means a good amount of hmming and yahooing from folks in line as they have the toppings piled on.

THE DRILL
After you've walked down the cafeteria style line (think Subway or Chipotle) to have your pizza made and after you pay for it, you are instructed to stay near as they will call your name 180 seconds after they put it in the oven. You take your own pizza to your table and you bus your own when finished eating.

PIZZA
We are less is more types in terms of pizza toppings, different strokes, and selected a house speciality called Red Vine (a Margherite of sorts) which is red sauce, fresh ovalini mozzarella and fresh basil added before oven and out of oven is topped with quartered cherry tomatoes.  We asked for and received a sprinkling of fresh arugula as finishing too.  The thin pizza crust was good and so were the toppings.  The time in oven was just right to get it cooked just so.   Too bad the vibe was so uncomfortable.

VIBE
Hard surfaces mean noise to start with and with ear splitting music cranked up high, well...you know the outcome.  Add in being cheek to jowl with the people dining next too you and well...my friend says she is too old and too rich for that kind of discomfort.  I am just too old. I'd rather pay the eleven bucks or so for a good Margherite pizza elsewhere that feeds three and comes with table service and relaxing ambiance.   Yes.  I know this makes me a crumudgeon.  So it is.

THIS N THAT:

1) PARKING:  In the lot right outside which is shared by Noodle and Company and a couple of other businesses.  

2) ACCESSIBILITY:  Level in and throughout but tight tables may make path of travel tough for a wheelchair user or someone pushing a stroller. That said, a man using a wheelchair was able to maneuver on the day of my visit.  Mostly standard height seating at tables.

3) SALADS TOO:  Prepackaged salads are between the end point of ordering pizza and the cash register for check out.  There were three options as I recall, Caesar, Arugula with beets and goat cheese and one other.  The arugula salad contained fresh ingredients but the house vinaigrette tucked in a little pastic containter was too oily and the too small for the contents container in which the salad is presented made it nearly impossible to eat it without it spilling all over the table.  Serveware is plastic.  

4) CLEAN UP:  Hats off ot the staff who were working diligently to wipe up messy tables and keep things tidy in the turnover.

Dunn carpet cleaners did a great job of our home making our 10 year old carpets look new again. The team was prompt, professional, hard working and very friendly. The quote I was given over the phone matched what was said in person. I would definitely recommend this cleaning company to anyone and will have them back for my future cleaning needs.

Arrived at the restaurant at 11:05 pm on a Saturday, only to find that the drive thru was open and not the dining area, which was ok. We pulled into the drive thru and waited behind another car for at least 5 minutes before we heard them help the people in front of us. This took another 5 minutes. At long last we got up to the terminal, and we waited and were not greeted until my sister said, "Hello?" To which the response was "yeah, order when you're ready." Ive worked fast food before so I thought, yeah, that's okay, the girl in the drive thru must be annoyed that we're here an hour before close. Placed our two separate orders and were given clipped, curt answers in response. You know how you can hear someone smiling when they speak? I could hear her frown like a megaphone.
We pulled up and waited behind the first customer. And waited. And waited. We saw no one at the window. After 10 minutes I asked my sister to back out and go to McDonalds or any other place, but she was insistent on her cheap below-average-but-still-okay-ish food. Despite my growing annoyance, we stayed behind the other car for another ten minutes. It was now 11:26, and I was understandably irritated. There were at least two people in the store. Unless they shut off their grills an hour before closing (a big no-no in my food experience) I still can't think of an excuse.
At 11:30, the car in front of us rolled out and we pulled up. We were greeted coldly and with no semblance of kindness, she merely stated the prices and returned our change. Then she closed the window and disappeared again.
11:33. Our food comes out the window in two brown bags without so much as a "good night." Upon opening, no receipts to be found. Every time I have stopped by a Carl's Jr, they have asked me if I want my receipt. This time, no questions, no pleasantries, nothing.
We ordered 3 spicy chicken sandwiches and a double cheeseburger. All four had a tiny amount of sauce (mayo and ketchup respectively). We ended up driving home to apply our own condiments. By the time we ate, it was 11:40.
35 minutes in a drive thru, with only 2 cars? Ridiculous. Poor customer service. We felt like an annoyance to the employees. You're still open, you still have to deliver on your service and sense of urgency.
TL;DR disappointed but not surprised. Go to McDonalds, right down the road, or there's a Wendy's, a Taco Bell, a KFC all just across the freeway. Dont waste your time here.

My wife and I have been here several times. They are more expensive, so the assumption is that they are better. Well, not really.

The best thing that is not even on the menu is the Scones. The scones are very good and the honey butter is wonderful. But Im not sure that these are worth the trip and expense of a meal here.

I have tried several things on the menu and have been very disappointed with them. I like to try things that are different. I tried the enchiladas. I can't recall the exact name of them. It was a very small portion. They tasted like they were straight out of a box. I have bought them before in the frozen section at Wal-Mart. They are no good and neither were these.

I had the fish and chips before as well. They were good, but every greasy. I also tried the chicken parmesan. It was the oddest Chicken Parm I have ever had and it was nasty.

My wife likes it here though, so I will keep trying to find something good on their menu. But my advice is pass this place up.

This was my first time going to this nail place. Paid $25 for a pedicure that was rushed and incomplete. It was over in about 10 minutes. He didn't even trim my nails or clean them. I would not recommend this establishment, not will I return. Disappointing!
Ran into some issues but Nick did an awesome job taking care of them. Thanks! :)
My favorite place to eat in town. Great selection and super friendly staff. Fast paced, busy and never disappoints.

I remember Chili's in the mid 80s.  They had these amazing tacos.  Over the years they fell off the menu.  Imagine my delight when I found them on the menu again called "chili's 1975 soft tacos ".  They're as good as I remember!

Came for lunch with two other girls and two babies. Our waitress was very friendly, and I was very impressed with the food. 

We all got the lunch combo with a salad and pizza. I got the wedge- and it was huge even though it was half the size of a normal wedge since it was part of the lunch combo. If you order their regular sized wedge I recommend splitting it, or make that the only thing you order. It's very filling and big!

I got the alfredo the great pizza. It was very flavorful, though it wasn't what I was expecting- when I think alfredo on pizza I'm thinking a white pizza, which this was not, but it was still delicious! The garlicky sauce and whatever they season the chicken with went great with the bacon & tomato. 

The girls got dessert- one got cookies and ice cold milk, the other got a molten lava cake or something, and they both looked really good!

Pueblo Linda has the beat carnitas I've had in a LONG time. Everyone else seems to take shortcuts it's mushy or overlooked. Not my taco tonight. Yum!!!  Plus a huge plate of nachos. Gets 5 stars in my book. Next time I'm bringing my family.

The Yard House has become one of our favorite places to take friends and we never see a reason to not return!

The indoor/outdoor seating options are great, depending on the weather of course. The wait time to get seated can sometime be awhile on the weekends, but overall not bad. They don't make reservations but do have call ahead options. This is where you can call about 5-10 minutes before arriving and have your name put on the list... it just helps decrease the time you are waiting. But if the wait it going to be awhile just grab the pager and walk around the Village while you wait!

The restaurant is always clean and the staff is quick and very friendly. They personalize your experience with a smile and laughter. They also have a great knowledge of their menus and their many drinks available from the bar. 

Our most favorite reason we take friends though is because they have a HUGE variety of menu options. We all have those picky friends (some WAY pickier than others) and there is something on the menu for everyone.  And the customization of menu items is also excellent!  They do a great job accommodating your requests.  

Favorite menu items I like to order (where to I start?)... The Lamb Burger, the Street and Vampire Tacos, the Artichoke Dip and Lobster Dip, and the Short Rib Ravioli. 

Stop in and grab a bite, you won't be di
Great service and staff. Food was very good, exceeded my expectations for a chain steakhouse. I will go back.

We have our company party at the Yard house meridian every holiday season! This year it was about 45 plus people. We love this place bc of the vegan options and bc they are competent to host our parties! The gardien wings, edamame and the veggie lettuce rolls are amazing. They could use a better veggie burger. The staff is great, they're really a super warm and jovial group and although the service was a little slow getting the food out at this last experience, management handled it well and the staff was very poised while facing pressure from a fairly large group.

Such a cute little place! Nice and clean. The staff was super friendly and helpful, and best of all the food was amazingly tasty. I ordered the bianco magnifico,  and kale salad, both were delicious.
