They have options for kids to make their own pizza, so it makes it fun for the kids, along with getting to choose their own options. It's so hard to get my son to it his food since he is so picky, he ate all of his food,  and finished off some of mine! 

I definitely will be returning,  and would recommend this place to others,  especially if you love pizza.

Big boys movers were just what I needed. They did an excellent job of packing my belongings into two pods. They moved quickly and efficiently as I needed. 

I used another local company to move from Nampa to Meridian.  That company was not efficient or timely. They made excuses for not being able to fit my furniture into the truck, but they did not pack the truck properly.  My realtor 
offered to assist me in moving, though it was not his job. Kind man!! 

However, Big Boy Movers packed quickly, professionally,  courteously helping me in every way possible. Thank you Big Boy Movers!!  

Definitely would use again.

Best burger in Treasure Valley! I had the single cheeseburger with everything. My hubby had the mushroom Swiss special with mushroom aioli. Both burgers were exquisite! Onion rings, tots and fry sauce were perfect. Friendly service. Can't wait to go back!
Best breakfast joint I'm here at least once a week you may have a little wait but it's so worth it

I have been working with Norco for 19 years.  I have noticed a continual lack of overall customer service in the last 5 years.  There are too many to list out here. Phones are rarely answered by a person and on 3 separate occassions I never recieved a call back.
Great service and the food was wonderful. The drinks were expensive and no alcohol it seemed. 10 bucks for a drink that just tasted like sugar water.

Ordered a big Carl, and fry's. Kinda sketchy due to everyone's current situation. They made everyone who order go around to the front and wait while they bring it out to you. Got home, to realize there was a long hair in my burger. And also a smaller one in my frys. 

I used to love Carl's jr and could depend on a decent burger. This changes everything, especially in a pandemic'. Disgusting, and I can no longer trust in this company.

Thanks for reading

I don't come down to Idaho this often, but I want to point out one flaw about this Chili's.

The building looks as if it has not been remodeled since opening in the mid 2000's. It is 2019 and while I never been inside the Eagle Road location, it definitely needs a remodel, just like the one near Boise State University.

Chili's, if the Meridian, ID location on Eagle Road is one of the restaurants to be remodeled, please do so.

Great place to grab 100% all natural burger everything they make is amazing there onion rings are the bomb their tater tot's are always fried  perfectly crispy. They have kids meals that are large for the price

This is the best Chinese in Idaho!! Always consistent always fresh! Light flavors never overly salty! Everyone we take loves it! We have never been disappointed! The family that owns/runs it is very sweet and helpful.  I have nothing bad to say truly!
Great food and stellar service in a relaxed atmosphere. Reasonable prices. But don't go too late if you don't want them to be out of their best.

Service is terrible at this one.  Feels like you are an inconvenience. Tried 5-6 times thinking they were just working out the kinks on the food and service. Not the case. Food is not good, downtown Boise and Downtown Meridian are much better.  They also nickel and dime you when you order kids pizza, charged us extra for another cheese topping. $.75 for a spoonful!

Think of this as a deconstructed sushi roll in a bowl. It's kinda like going to Subway, in that you go down a line and pick your "bed" from several rice options, or salad greens, then your protein, then your sauce, then your toppings. If you have a healthy appetite, go ahead and get a large bowl. It's $15.99 but it's probably equivalent to 3 sushi rolls, so if you think of it like that, it's a good deal. The medium would be perfect for lunch at $11.99.

A couple of tips: Ask for extra rice, they don't put enough in the bowl. Also, don't order from just the menu boards above. There's tons of options listed on the bar itself, and you don't want to miss out on things like the spicy tuna and fish roe. Pretty much everything is raw (except lobster, crab, and shrimp), but they will cook it if you insist. But that would be horrible, so don't do that! You can make any combination you want or try one of their combos.

I had a medium bowl with Spicy Tuna, Scallops, and Shrimp. I added sauce mix #3, and asked her to drizzle Spicy Mayo over the finished bowl. For toppings I had cucumber, crab meat, green onions, fish roe, cilantro, black and white sesame seeds, shredded seaweed.

My boyfriend had a totally different combo and he really liked it as well.

This was really delightful to eat. The fish was fresh and flavorful, and the sauce was delicious. I do wish they gave you more sushi rice. You really need that to feel full. But I do think it's a good value. If you love sushi or poké, you'll like this. There's been several restaurants in this space and they never seem to do well. I hope this one does, because it's nice to have a healthy food option in this area.

Conclusion: Highly recommend!

Fantastic location.  Located right in The Village at Meridian.  Good amount of outdoor tables along the sidewalk with optional canopy shade.  My wife and I have gone to Matador many times in our old home state of Washington.  When we arrived here in Boise we were excited to a family name.  I was afraid it wouldn't be as good as our experiences at the other chain locations.  However that was quickly put to rest when the crispy calamari app arrived at the table.  We also tried the Baja mahi-mahi tacos and carne asada burrito.  Both were amazing!  Finished with the fried ice cream which was also well done.  Short story, great place, great food, will be back again and again!
Absolutely amazing best service amazing food!! We ordered poke nachos, fish tacos, shiitake noodles and the rib eye everything was perfection

Of my last 2 trips, they messed up my order 2 times.  The first time they offered me a free replacement meal, which was understandable.  When I went in to claim it a few weeks alter, they said someone else already claimed it and there was nothing they would do about it.  The manager was rude, so I complained to corporate.  All they did is send me back to the manager who only offered me a replacement burger (not the meal that they owed).  Very poor customer service.  I will not go back to this location.

If at all possible, find some place else to buy. Have had absolutely the worst customer service. Went in on Saturday to get some cabinets. Was looking for some odd sizes and asked the "designer" who helped us lay out what we needed. She said call her to get them pulled for us. Tried calling on Sunday. Could not get anyone to answer the line in the department. Sent her an email. Little did we know that she was not scheduled to work for the next 4 days. I have tried calling for two days and was never able to get anyone to answer. We had a deadline so we just went in and picked them up ourselves. Loaded 2 flatbed carts by ourselves while an associate in cabinets watched us. Only when we were done did she ask if we needed help. They did not have all the items we needed. Checked out. They failed to give us the 20% discount. Had to go back the next day for a refund. 

Finally heard from the original "designer" and she had absolutely no idea who we were and what she had helped us with even though I put her file name in the subject line if my email. This is Wednesday. Four days later. 

Went in to get the 2 cabinets that they didn't have at the first store. Had to load on our own because the 3 associates were too busy to even say hello. Made sure to remind them if the discount. Except it was only for purchases over $400. But we had already spent $1200. Treated us like criminals for attempting to take advantage of their discount. 

Done with crappy/non-existent customer service. Buying online from now on. I can find better products and as a builder, it's unfortunate that there is nowhere better locally.

My husband and I have driven the whole way from Portland with our 2-year-old daughter to Boise for the new job. The late lunch/early dinner at Kahootz was such a treat after our long road trip. Our server, Travis, we ended up to know he was actually the manager, was nothing but caring and kind. The food came so promptly and absolutely delicious. I was very much in the seafood mood, so I passed the steak this time and had their scampi with asparagus and wild rice. I loved their cream sauce!! Just a right taste:) 
Travis kindly brought the extra baguette and crackers for our picky eater. 
When we got back to our car,the buttery was dead. But the kind employees and Travis found a regular customer and had him give us a jump! It was such a heartwarming experience. We'll definitely come back. Great service, great food, generous portion for a reasonable price, kids-friendly, (and clean bathroom) !!

This place is the worst, I went in a while back and my server Mandi or amanda... I can't remember but my good was cold and she was rude. I could understand if they were busy but they weren't. I won't be back.
Coincidence? Went here for food and had not used my card in awhile and in less than a week my card had been compromised and almost $300.00 charged at online clothing store.

The food and service are usually great, but one beef I have with BWW is the fact that the menus are constantly changing- the layout, prices, the specials, everything. That's fine if that's intentional, but I personally come to love certain dishes or specials and come on a specific day only to hear "oh we discontinued that" or "sorry we don't do that anymore".

Terrible service. Getting washed hands before they made my food. Took them 30 minutes to make two pitas. I highly doubt the temps of their veggies are within the allowed range. They were all wilted and gross looking.

Let me start with the decor.  It is very intimate and modern with a great feel that is becoming of the other store in Boise I have visited on many occasions.  There are two large doors that open to the south and face Generations Plaza and really open the place up.  It feels great!  The food is AMAZING!  We started with a sea salt and parmesan flatbread that simply got us going and was great.  My wife and I split the chicken apple walnut salad.  Just as fresh and tasty as ever and is my favorite!  The main dish was the quattro formaggio.  I'm a fan of all the pies and have had most of them, this is my second favorite for no other reason than it just happens to not be the maple-fennel sausage.  They are both out of this world!  When you go, don't forget the cookies!  If you order a half dozen, and it is worth doing even if you are full, you get a bottle of arctic cold milk.  These are the best cookies I have ever run across.  The mac and cheese is as good as any pasta I have had and you just won't miss going there to eat, and eat well!  The service was off the charts and this place is a nice addition to the great group of places to eat in Meridian!  TTTRRRUSSSTTT MEEEE!

First time here and NOT my last!

Located at The Village in Meridian. You walk into  a half bakery and half graffiti garage setting. I LOVE IT! The vibe was easy going and laidback.
You seat yourself in or outside. We ordered the Reuben dog and 208 dog. First of all, their bun was TOOOO DIE FOR. I need that in my life daily 
The flavor of both dogs were delicious in their own ways. I loved the Rueben. I was not disappointed... I could eat that everyday...
The donut was light and fluffy, not too sweet. It was creative and satisfying. The little shot of rum was a bonus too! 
The price is not bad for the quality of food you receive. The experience is also worth paying for. 
Definitely a fun date night idea or a quick delicious meal on your own and people watch! Lol 

Can't wait to try the rest of the menu!

I've been here with my wife for dinner and with friends from work for lunch.  I think the restaurant is a renovated auto shop.  It's a really nice venue that I was surprised to find in the middle of Meridian.

The lunch special with a half-salad and half-pizza was fantastic.  I haven't had anything here that wasn't great.  I'll be back for sure.

Best in the Valley hands down. Happy they have made their way back after selling precious locations to Jackson's. Great customer service, top of the line facility and the standard is one of a kind compared to the usual "gas station."

First time at this establishment for a full set of nails. They are the best! I usually have a problem with the shape of my nails and the tech shaped my nails just as I requested!  Would highly recommend Modern Nails!

The food was fantastic and the service impeccable! 

We had the Coconut Shrimp, Spinach Dip, and a Bacon Burger. Everything was cooked and seasoned wonderfully. The dip was so delicious it was had not to over fill. The shrimps were HUGE and full of flavor (I would suggest a jelly sauce as an option for dip), and the burger was cooked to order. 

The waitress was one of the best we had and with the staffs help, our table was cared for perfectly. 

It was a great choice for our 14th anniversary!
Updating to say everything still applies from my original review 3 years ago  This location is still totally rocking it! Count me as a loyal customer

Great place for gas, plus rewards for your purchase  want more, no need it is what it is.......... 

Vcnvcvv hvvggjyfhnb hungvnjg. Jgvnhc jdb hfvhhc bhvbbgjvfj hunching. Hbnnnj

Had the grinder sandwich and prime rib. Both items were cooked flawlessly. The rotating beer menu is gigantic. They recently expanded outside seating here and it is awesome. The waitress we had was amazing. Would eat here again! 5/5.
Came here on a Sunday for brunch. Service was great. Definitely recommend the chipotle club omelette. And the French toast was delicious.
This place has really good service and happy hour!! The nachos are amazing you need then in your life if you haven't had them!!!!

Amazing beer selection and the food is waaaay better than you would expect from the size of the establishment. The steaks are bomb, I've literally had 20+ and the temps and flavor are always incredibly spot on. Seriously always impressed. The GM's name is Cameron and he's a really nice guy.

I had them clean me sectional and 10x12 area rug. They did a fantastic job. In the late evening on the same day, I noticed a smell that was making me nauseated so removed the area rug and sat down and smell was gone. It was the rug. I notified Dunn Right and they were more than happy to mediate the problem and come back. We scheduled the first revisit and had to reschedule due to traffic. Fine not a problem. We were more than ok with that. Reschedule number 3 for Monday august 21 between 1-2pm. They were a no show. No calls or communication. I facebooked them several times on Monday night and Tuesday regarding the missed appointment. No response. Totally silent. Customer service suck. Will not recommend or use.
Love this place.  Finally good food and beer in Meridian/Boise. The burgers are outstanding and plenty of artisan beer on tap. You must have one of the Bloody Marys

First off, this is just a really fun place to be. The design of this restaurant and all the cool little details from the light fixtures to the hanging bar make it a really great place. Fun music and good company!

I stopped for lunch and got the pick two, which is a really great deal.  My selection was the pepperoni, sausage and portobello pizza with a Caesar salad. They wedge cut the romaine leaves which makes for a really interesting salad but the flavor nonetheless is really good. I also really enjoyed the flavor of the pizza and it had just the right amount of spice to go with it.

Now here is why I did not give them five stars. Several times I've come here and ordered a pizza that has sausage on it. When I do this and after they fired it in their wood oven, it always comes to my plate soggy and greasy. Don't get me wrong because the crust is really good.  It's just the crust never really solidifies and it becomes a mess when you go to pick up your slice of pizza. Every time my toppings want to slide right off because the grease and soggy interior enables this. 

I will be back again though I'm sure because I just love the flavor and vibe of this whole place.

Yes yes yes.  I'm not a jalepeno popper girl, but they looked really good so I thought I'd be brave.  So worth the mouth pain because they're the bomb!  Great beer selection, bartender was cool, even the patrons were all happy and chill.  We will be back since we are building a house in the neighborhood!

WONDERFUL! I was so poorly treated at Joann fabrics, I had embroidery questions and Joanns was so rude and dismissive I almost gave up.but I called hobby lobby with my same questions, they didn't have what I was looking for but gave me the name of several places that would and even helped explain what I would need. Thank you so much for making me feel like a human and being kind to me. I appreciate you! I wish I would've gotten her name, but she was working the sewing section around 2 today! She deserves kudos!!

We went to Jakers last night (it's been about a year since the last time) around 630pm and it was really busy. We were told 15 min wait for a table and waited about 35 min. After our salads we waited about 20 mins for dinner, server was great. I was in the mood for seafood and ordered the lobster bisque and the crab stuffed avocado salad. The bisque was pretty good but the crab salad wasn't the best. I was expecting 'lump crab' as described but it was shredded crab with too much onion for my taste. He had the most amazing (his exact words) chicken fried steak, the best he's ever had. Said it literally melted in his mouth and he talked about how delicious it was all evening. We weren't drinking but I would like to go back for cocktails- their Martini menu looked amazing.

I am so sorry to hear Angela P's story. I had a similar experience with Dr. Bradly of the Spine Institute. He operated and I got way worse I mean way worse. He told me when he was in my back he could see the right side was herniated but had to sew me up because his brilliant staff had authorized the left side only to be done. I had a mylagram and a MRI. You'd think with 2 very good images he could have gotten it right. Then this clown did a stimulator trial. The stimulator trial worked great but alas hear I sit 2 months later with no implant. I got a bit nasty with him about it and his solution was to dump me as a patient. Guess it was hard to own up to such a screw up. These idiots should try to remember part of there oath. First do no harm but it's all about the money and the patient be dammed.

Donuts are pure heaven. The service is amazing. The mimosas were a little too sweet for my liking, but enjoyed them nonetheless. The food was greAt. Any place that will go out of their way to make my kid a fruity pebbles donut when the person in front bought the last one is a hero in my book.

Went for lunch. Small leather book would have been more tender than there small steak. Not sure what was tougher to eat , that steak or that week old bread they served with the meal. Will never go back.  BARF.

Food is okay but I'm not sure if it makes up for slow service (takes 25 minutes for one meal, than another 25 minutes after the first one comes for the other persons meal), loud atmosphere (can't hear the person next to you) and absolutely no phone service (wasn't even getting LTE).

Very good locally owned and operated Mexican restaurant.   Up there with Mi Casa and Jalapeño's on food quality and the service was very good.   They did a nice job with ambiance and decor package.
Can't wait to come back and try other menu items.

Food- Stay away from basically everything that isn't deep fried or a burger. The BBQ burger was passable as we're the chicken strips, but they were nothing special. My wife's French dip was dried up and the beef tasted old. Chips and salsa we're stale. I think the theme here is to consume enough beer that you don't care about the shortcomings of the food. 

Service- The kitchen and the poor restaurant layout slow service to a crawl. Again; consume beer in quantity and you won't notice. 

Layout- Horrid. Staff has to basically squeeze through narrow gaps between tables. Other than that, it's typical sports bar layout with TVs in every corner. Be prepared to scoot your chair in as staff try their best to slide by you. 

Overall- It's a sports bar trying to be some sort of upscale pub and it comes up short in both categories.   Also, take care of the flies please. I know it's hard during cluster fly season but we we're constantly attacked by dozens and dozens of agressive flies.

I absolutely love this place, not just for their food, but because of the atmosphere they have created. There's graffiti art work on the walls, interesting light fixtures, and seating all throughout. The decor definitely resembles the amazing food. You can tell that quality is their most important priority when it comes to their food. The doughnuts are sweet but fluffy, leaving you to want to take more bites. I had the lemon, dirty churro, and more than maple all which were tasty. The first time I went I was greeted by a girl named Parker. She was incredibly sweet and was willing to walk me through all of there selections. She also got to know me and shared some things about herself too. I find this important in small companies because it builds those relationships within the community. The smoked caramel latte is so much fun! Not only do they smoke it right in front of you, but you get to be apart of the magic as well. The place is kept really clean, and every time I've gone there is always someone sweeping and wiping down tables. I encourage everyone to go and try this place! I've noticed that some people have complained about them running out of donuts, but you can always call ahead and they will put them aside for you! I hope they stay for a long time because they are my favorite part of going to The Village.
Loved it! First time there because we happened to be in the area and we will definitely be back. Staff was super friendly. Salads were fresh and delicious. Pizza was superb!

YUM!!!  The pizza here is out of this world and if that's not enough the atmosphere just makes it that much better!  It's trendy yet casual and family friendly at the same time!  I love the roll up doors that open up to the park!  The booths are really fun to sit in as well and the tables for two near the pizza oven are just wonderful!  I wish their appetizer menu was a little more than just more bread and cheese but that's ok.  I love that it's family style because I like being able to try a little bit of everything!  The ingredients are totally fresh and flavorful, right down to the grated parmesan on your table!!

We had decided never to go to casa del matador again. Then we received a gift card for Christmas!!  So we  decided to hit happy hour. Our previous to visits were lunch.  First, our server, Kelse, was top notch!  She was smart quick and attentive but not overly.  We decided to try happy hour. Good choice. Previously, we found the meals a little overpriced and bland. We had previously signed up for their loyalty program so we received free grilled jalapeños. Yum!  We had the mango margaritas, tried salt and sugar rims, sugar better.  Tortilla soup was a little watery. Nachos with ground beef were perfect. Huge  and loaded.  Guacamole was great. Again, Kelse made our meal!

I crave this place! The manager Austin is so personable and accommodating. The staff as well has always made such a great impression on me anytime I go in. I keep trying new things when I go And every time I do I am never disappointed. Love this place
I was a little skeptical, but glad I was wrong. This place is excellent all around. Definitely indulge in both donut and dog. Enough reading - 100% go try this place!

Great soup and salad bar, best lobster bisque ever.  The chicken tortilla soup and baked potato soup is also very good. !!  Love the holiday buffets.  Make reservations way in advance for holiday dining. The severs are terrific.  Make sure you get to try the freshly made scones that come with your meal

Sad day at Texas Roadhouse for me, been coming here for a long time. This was the last time. I only have one night a week to go out and enjoy an evening with the wife. After an hour plus wait we got in just to hear that they were out of Prime Rib again! Thats twice this has occured. Time to head down the trail and find anouther steakhouse.

Called Marv's about a problem with my insulation.  They are very knowledgable, and knew exactly what was wrong.  There man showed up when promised, fixed the problem and explained everything to my satisfaction.  They were polite and courteous and very reasonable.  Highly recommended
Seriously great Mexican food. Great family style restaurant with easy parking.
Wait staff is always friendly and on point. My son loves the build your own pizza for kids, and the tomato soup is awesome!

Service was excellent, Kara had a great sense of humor and very friendly.

The pizza is fantastic, very authentic.
Great tomato bisque soup.

Will definitely be coming back.

We ordered a Togo custom order of beef and fried rice and the Hauhan beef. We got delayed getting into the restaurant. When we finally arrived, our food was still hot and we were greeted with hugs. 

The food was all excellent, fresh and so much flavor!

The portions, price, and food quality is amazing!!! We eat at this restaurant more than any other in the valley. The kids meals are huge and filling which is great for our older boys. My husband and I love the blended margarita and Spanish coffee. The happy hour is seriously one of the best in Meridian!! Highly recommend to anyone looking for great food, great prices, and a fun atmosphere!

If you are looking for professionals, these are not the guys for you. They could not manage to get the sofa out the same door in which it came, though I Googled the information for them and they spent 30 minutes dawdling about trying to figure it out. The head guy said he would bring a pry bar the next time he came out, but did not. Just moved the sofa to a different room and left it. I called two guys from our neighborhood that were able to remove the sliding glass door and get it out in about 15 minutes.

I had to explain to them how to get a desk into my new home. They were just going to give up, saying it wouldn't fit.

And now I'm looking at a set of drawers that they placed upside down. It is full of little die cuts and I'm going to have to take an hour at least to sort them back to where they go. It is clearly the bottom, not the top.

I also caught both of the first two movers checking messages on their cell phones. The head guy probably needed to check in with the office, but it was an inordinate number of times.

I should have known when they called me from the U-Haul office. They didn't even have their own truck. The prices were lower than everyone else, but if I had to do it over again, I would just pay more and get it done right.

I tried to call the office to discuss this with them, but they never called me back.

Yes, this store is in an old building but it is very clean. I like that it is not crowded, the staff are all very friendly and helpful.

What I LOVE the most is the pharmacy. In all my years going to pharmacies, I have never had a pharmacist actually come over and talk to me and be woohoo friendly....until now. He actually overheard my questions I was asking the very friendly lady at the counter, and came right over and answered my questions and went above and beyond to help me.

Every time I go in, he is always friendly and he is the first that actually cares about his customers. I will only come here from now on.

The food is great and the price is right. My family
Loves ordering personal preferences for the pizzas so it is ideal. During this last visit, they burned my pizza. Although they fixed it, I had to reorder by jumping into the line that was 40 people deep. I got a few rude comments and snarky looks -- so it was awkward. When I finally got my pizza, my family was already finished eating. I'm happy Blaze remade my pizza but they did t even offer something for the inconvenience... like a cookie or something. I know that sounds lame, but it really messed up our dinner.

Came here for the first time and decided to sit out on the patio.  It was a gorgeous day to be outside.  The location and decor of this place was spot on as It had a great feel to it.  Tables in the patio were really nice, I can see myself sitting out there for a long time and enjoying good food, drinks and friendships.  We were greeted immediately by a kind waitress.  Service was excellent the entire time.  I was there for a quick lunch and their lunch menu was very limited to a two or three item entree.  Since this was my first visit, I decided to order off the menu and wanting to keep my lunch price somewhat reasonable, I ordered 5 street tacos for $12.  You have your choice of 5 different meats so I decided to try a few.  When they got to my table, they looked more like Alley Tacos than Street Tacos.  They were extremely small and I get it.  They are located in the Village.  The tacos had decent flavor but nothing to rave about.  I would definitely go back for their chips and salsa and try other menu items.

Can I add a star? I love this place! Consistent, tasty food and, if you go during happy hour, the options are huge for half the price! 

We love the onion ring tower, boneless wings, pizza, nachos and Mushu egg rolls. Definitely worth the trip!!
Loved it. Nice comfortable place. Small humidor but stocked with good sticks. Great beer selections
Always our choice for gluten free pizza! They offer a great lunch special and the chicken apple walnut salad is the best!

Sunday 12/15/19 4:00pm
What a shit show!!! We arrive there are two groups ahead of us (two top and a four top) we're told 15-20 minute wait as we stare at four (4) opens tables and two (2) empty booths!??? What????

Then a manager comes up "to help!?" There are empty seats in the bar? Upon return from the "packed no seats available bar"  We contemplate leaving when two guys from the bar offer us their seats, because they're leaving.

"DONT TELL PEOPLE THERES A WAIT WHEN THERES EMPTY TABLES IN PLAIN VIEW!!"

Best salas in town. Get the street taco flight, it's delicious! It can be a bit of a long wait (not surprising for the Village) but they text you when your table is ready so you can go walk around and enjoy the Village. 

We have two little kids and they both ask to go to the Matador at least once a week. 

They also have a new loyalty program which is great.

Been to Jakers before and liked it, but today we did a pick up order and it was cold.  We couldn't even eat a quarter of it.  They barely gave us any fries and on top of it, the fish and chips were greasy and the burger was so well done.  When we went to pick it up, we saw our order on the counter and no one knew what was going on.  It took around six+ minutes before they gave us our food.  They told us what time to pick it up and we were there 10 mins before it was suppose to be ready, we got there early so it wouldn't be cold.  It basically was sitting there before we got there and we still had to wait.  The portion and the the cook on the food, is why I would not go back and of course of the staff who had no clue what is going on.

Just tried this restaurant. We weren't disappointed!  Food was fantastic and the service by Tyler was great!  Had filet mignon and husband had rib eye. Their deserts are also outstanding. Creme Brûlée was so yummy but the best was the bread pudding. Will definitely visit here again.
Bought $2,000 in blinds 10 months ago. We've had to replace 8 of them (3) still on order. To fix this I'll spend another 2,500+ on blinds from a blind company.

I've always had good service here and they generally get my food out quick but what is with the smell!!? I usually go through the drive thru so I never really noticed but I went in recently and it just smells awful! I looked up reviews to see if it was just me who thought so... it's not! Definitely a concern. It doesn't even get better as you hang out inside. It's bad enough to not get used to!
Great, great store...from books, to clothing, to bedspreads & duvets, they it all!!! And the quality is top notch!!!

I moved from Sacramento in 2018 and used a highly recommended moving company who lost the top to one of my tables, splintered the leg of one of my dining room chairs, and lost one of my shelves.  Their "so what?" attitude really appalled me.  They did pay for the repair of my chair, and they did find the top to my table; I had to pay nearly $200 to have it shipped to me.  This was after I paid over $6,000 for the move. After arriving here,  I had to have a major remodel done to my part of the house, and that same part was full of furniture and unpacked boxes.  I needed to have them all moved to a storage unit, but did most assuredly NOT want to call the movers I had used before.  Someone recommended Big Boy and I called them.  They were amazing.  The young men that showed up were friendly and courteous.  They had to carry boxes through the snow to get them to the truck, but they never complained.  They were very careful about not tracking snow and mud into the house and they treated my belongings carefully and respectfully.  They finished the job in the time and for the amount that had been agreed upon when I received the estimate.  If I ever have to move again, I will definitely call them first.  I am pleased to recommend them most highly.

Took nephew today. He got Pasta Bolognese. It was a great portion. Came with meatball and big noodles. He loved it and they brought it out first which was awesome.

Rumor is they are keeping the Mushroom Kale Soup because it has been so popular...i hope so!

Great food and service as usual!
Customer service was horrible they treat you like crap and blow you off! Super rude and don't know we're there stuff is, would definitely not recommend going there

I ordered ramen bowls to go and the staff were super friendly and attentive. They packaged the ramen in a way to make it stay as fresh as possible until I was home. The flavors were delicious and authentic. Definitely will return!

The hostesses are rude and consider guests an intrusion on their time. I called about an issue and was basically told that if the app wasn't working I could go somewhere else. When I had my daughter run in to get the order the hostess was rude, curt, and let it be known we weren't welcome.

Okay, I was a bit skeptical with it being in an upscale mall area that it would either be too frufru or too expensive or both - I was pleasantly surprised...  It still seems to fit in with the "hip" clientele - there's vegan and kambucha.  I came in expecting to try one of the hotdogs and we all got donut sandwiches (they are donuts - complete with glaze) and split a side of fries.  All were very good tasting and came out in a fairly short time.  Staff were cheery, pleasant and helpful.  Tip - if you get one of the 'sandwiches' it will be messy, unless you're one of those who uses a knife & fork.

Went here for the first time and an torn on whether it was a 3 stars or a 4. If I could I would give it a 3.5. Coming in I was honestly surprised how small it was. They do have a outdoor covered seating area which is pretty good size but inside is pretty small. The atmosphere is were bar like, it is very casual and can get pretty loud. Luckily there wasn't a ton of people when we went otherwise I don't think we could have heard ourselves think. It is low key but very clean including the restrooms.  Service is good, the lady that waited on us was very friendly, stayed on top of drink refills and didn't bother us to much. The food is where I am torn. I got the pork chop which was HUGE, it had good flavor but it was pretty fatty and not a lot of meat, parts of it were under cooked. The sides it came with of red potatoes and asparagus were very tasty but the asparagus had a little to much pepper. My husband got a 10 oz sirloin, he again liked the flavor of his steak but his wasn't evenly cooked , he also had the issue with the excessive pepper but on his fries. Prices are reasonable and portion sizes are good. It's just there was some execution issues with the meals. I would try it again to see if this was a fluke because there was potential.

If I could give 0 stars I would. I can't recommend that you FIND SOMEONE ELSE to look after your property enough. If you choose to use TDP, plan on spending more money than planned. I would bet, they never did a walk through, like our contract stated, and I can guess this by the three inches of dust that was hanging off the light fixtures in every room. That would have been the first clue that the tenants were not properly maintaining our property. After the tenants ruined our floor and we found out they didn't have the proper insurance, we asked that TDP check their Insureance to ensure our investment was protected. TDP failed to check the tenants insurance like they said they would, and we ended up having to pay for many damages out of our own pocket after the tenants broke contract. Give yourself peace of mind and do not hire TDP Property Management.

I normally don't write reviews but feel the need for this one. If I could, I'd give 0 star. My teenage boys wanted Panda Express but I convinced them to try this place because of some of the reviews. We came in a Saturday afternoon when nobody was there except for the owner's family, so it seems, while they were eating. Right away I felt unwelcome as no one greeted us. Told the lady I'd like to order for to go. She didn't even bother to give us the menu but pointed to the counter. At this time I wanted to walk out but my kids thought that would be rude. We proceeded to ordering and waiting for the food was the the most awkward 20 minutes of my life because again, we felt like we were bothering and interrupting their family lunch. Finally the lady came out with our food and handed it to my son, who said "thank you" and she replied with "uh huh"?!?!?! To sum it up, the service SUCKS!!! The food was mediocre and definitely not better than panda but way OVERPRICED!!! Definitely won't be coming back. EVER!!!
This place is great! The food is delicious and the workers were very helpful and friendly! I definitely recommend going here!

Great experience (and low cost) with having our cat spayed and microchipped! Scheduling was simple. Soon after scheduling, I received emails confirming the appt. and instructions for pre-op care. Their process is well designed to accommodate the volume of pets they treat. I appreciate the service(s) you provide to the community...nice work!
About the best place in Meridian to take a client or meet some for lunch.  Nothing is bad on their menu, nothing.  I return at least once every other week.
Amazing!  Had the meatlovers and Veg out signature pizzas. They were so good. Never been here before. I'll be back for sure 100x
One of my favorite sandwich shops in the treasure valley. I always order the turkey bacon ranch and it is fantastic! The food and service is always great.
Reasonably priced, great location for us, and delicious Mexican-American food. We keep coming back... only thing is to keep the chips and delicious salsa coming!

A single doughnut costs $1.58 now?! But they aren't even full sized! And no, I can't have ice water but I can BUY a bottled water.
And they don't seem to want me to stay here while eating my donuts: It is absolutely freezing in here; I seriously think the AC is on despite the outside barely above freezing temps (cashiers are wearing jackets too).
The final blow: A communal table. No one wants to eat at a communal table. 
Thanks for making me feel wanted and welcome, KK. Not.

Randomly tried this place during lunch hour. Ordered a donut and hot dog. The order took a few minutes and they brought a second donut for my wait. Juicy dog, crispy fries. Donuts were decadent and definitely should be reserved for a treat.

I'm giving you a 1 Star because you got rid of your amazing Salted Butterscotch Pudding and replaced it with a doughy Mixed Berry Crumble of which I did not even eat a third of. It would be a waste of calories. Even though your food is good, we won't be back till the Salted Butterscotch Pudding is back.

I went there yesterday with my wife for lunch.  We ordered lemon chicken, mushu chicken, and almond chicken.  The meal was excellent, the service was excellent, and the restaurant was clean.  The server was so nice and efficient, and our meal was hot.  

I will definitely be back.  Thank you for the wonderful experience.

Food is great but the way they crank up the music full blast every 45 minutes so that the wait staff can do their hoedown dance is ridiculous. Way too loud and distracts from what is otherwise a really great meal. Unfortunately, it's a big enough deal that I won't be back until they either do away with it or turn it down.

Many many many beers. Although I did it eat at the yard house. The menu was tempting. And I'd like to try it. 
Beers were expensive 6-7.5 for a pint 

It is a good first stop in a dinner and a movie. Given its proximity the theaters.
I felt the pizza was under cook taste like ash from the fire my plate was black with ash. The cook was using the same cooking utensil to stir the fire to remove pizza with.

Soo good!! We ordered the Hot Tokyo Chicken special. Sides are not large so order extra but the chicken and sides were delicious. Delivery was fast (we live in Star) and it was hot. It was fun to get to try food from a CA restaurant we've never had even when we lived in CA. I'm excited to try the sushi and the Chinese; all of it really!!
Hot dog wrapped in bacon was delicious. The bun is like a thick slice of delicious toast bread. And the doughnuts are fun unique flavors that are served warm! So delicious!

AMAZING! about as close to mom and grandma's cooking as you are going to get and here in Meridian. Food is so authentic and so flavorful! 

Tonight I had the "tacos al pastor" and they were great. We've had the pozole, mole and enchiladas and non of the dishes have disappointed! I've been driving to Nampa and Caldwell for years to get real/authentic Mexican dishes, now I don't have to.
Bulletproof coffee and healthy, fluffy, delicious donuts! I walked in at 9 am feeling a little tired and the vibe that I had walking out was refreshed, and excited to tackle the day ;)

Picked this place to watch the BSU/Oregon bowl game. I had heard about the bloody marys being good, and it was located near us. 
It is set up in a small, but new strip mall. Ok parking. The place is set up like most bar & grills. Open beam ceilings, stained concrete floors, a few tables (some hi, some low), and a full bar.
I ordered a bloody mary. It was fine. Not great, but not bad either. Kind of lackluster on the garnishings. They do offer a deluxe version with a slider, pretzel, and some other sides hung on it, but it think that the actual drink would be the same.
We all ordered food. I have the jalapeno burger. It was good. Nice size, cooked the way I asked (Med Rare), and descent fries. Everyone else enjoyed their food and drinks as well.
All in all a good place for a quick drink, and bite. Lots of TV's for sports. We will stop by again.

I'm not sure who the female employee  is that drives a beat up red mustang and smokes- but she should be a little more cautious of how she acts while wearing a "Noodles & Company" polo shirt in public. She littered her cigarette on the ground out her car window and when she was  called out on it she called my friend a  "fu@king twat" Super Classy

Service was fantastic, food was awesome, and the atmosphere was excellent as I sat outside in October to enjoy one of the last warm days of the season.  The wine menu could use some work, but there are two bottle on the wine menu that are great.  Our server was wonderful and my water glass never went empty.  Highly recommended to everyone who loves pizza and wine.
Cold chili and tacos without the cheese or tomatoes. Why? We have been going here regularly with positive results. Today did not do it for me.

So it was my birthday and I wanted to try a new place for dinner. I originally wanted to go to Spice for some delicious Indian food, but decided on an alternative.

My wife's parents had been to Homestead a couple times and raved about it several times. Located at Linder and Chinden in Meridian, when we showed up and the place was packed. We went on a Friday night, and finding a parking spot was a little tough. Was a little bit overwhelming at first, but as soon as I did some quick people watching, and looked at their amazing beer menu, I felt like it would be a great night.

First and foremost, their beer selection is awesome! One of the best around. I enjoyed the Founders Dirty Bastard Scotch Ale, but the highlight for me was Boise Brewing's Witch's Tit Winter Ale. A delicious beer! Boise Brewing is sneakily becoming one of my favorites. We then ordered some food, and started with some bacon wrapped poppers, described as "made in house, fresh, crisp jalapeños stuffed with cream cheese, and wrapped in rich, thick bacon". I neglected to get a photo of these. They were pretty tasty. I mean you can't go wrong with jalapeños, cream cheese, and bacon. The jalepeños were not very hot though.

I got to finish the meal with their bacon bleu burger and a side of onion rings. Pretty damn good. Not the best I have ever had, but certainly not the worst. A solid bacon and Bleu Cheese burger. My favorite combo. The onion rings were some of the tastiest I have ever had.

If you are in the mood for a great beer selection at a bar and grill with a variety of food choices, this is the place to go!

The food was great, our server was wonderful, but the atmosphere was disgusting.  The music was sooooo loud we couldn't talk.There were seven of us at the table and not everyone could talk.  We told a server as she walked by and all she said was it was awfully loud, but didn't do anything about it.  I will not be back. I can go someplace else for the same quality food was a lot better experience.

Don't ask for anything other than a beer, if you ask for a cocktail they will talk down to you, apparently the bartenders forgot the term customer service,"they are a Ale house" well excuse me!!! the food was mediocre  at best, over priced for what you get.

Regan, the cashier working at the register just now was one of the rudest people I have ever come across. Not one word to me. I have to go and check my receipt to make sure I wasn't overcharged. She saw I had my phone out for a coupon and was disturbed by me asking her to scan it. Also, something fell on a ornament  and it broke accidentally and she gave a look of disgust because it broke. I'm almost 100% positive that happens all day long. It was a $1.32 and I offered to pay for it. While I'm here complaining there was another male working near the back that was rude, he was wearing his pants high and glasses. That's the best I could describe him. I just spent $367 and really don't appreciate all the rudeness. I know Christians aren't perfect but at least at In and Out everyone is happy and nice. It's 6:05 pm on 12/17/2020. Let's hope my receipt adds up.

First time here and was looking for some tasty mexican dinner. Was blown away at the quality of food and speed of service. We were greeted by our waiter Alfredo, who got us chips with salsa and guacamole right away. Not only did he change my order when I messed up, but his service was incredibly polite and fast. He noticed every time my water was low and would refill it, and got us a box before I even had to ask! These are the kind of experiences that are gonna make this restaurant grow. Loved the food, fantastic service, definetly gonna recommend this place!

Wow! I was really disappointed in yard house this visit. We usually have a good experience with food here. Portions are large enough for two meals and the quality and taste are good usually fine as well. We brought our family that was visiting from out of state to the village and they wanted to try Yard House so we headed in for lunch. Our waitress was excellent ... Thus the reason for the two stars. We had a large group and she was very upbeat and attentive.The food... well... it was really bad! Poor quality meat that was filled with chunks of fat on my Bahn mi sandwich. The sandwich wasn't even close to the ones that I have received from here in the past. It was just really gross, to be honest. The kids pizzas were good, the macaroni and cheese, both the kids and the adult version was very bland. Apparently the deviled eggs were good, I didn't try those, but others in my party said they were tasty. My nephew ordered the seared ahi sandwich and after a few bites was so disgusted by it he couldn't finish it. 

All in all, not our best trip. With all of the options in the village... this may be my last visit to the Yard House. Unless its just for happy hour!  Can't really mess up a beer!

This is a favorite place for me and the hubby. We usually split a salad and a pizza and sometimes an appetizer too. We have tried almost all the pizzas and they are all delicious. Picking one just depends on what you are in the mood for. The atmosphere is warm and cozy in the winter or you can sit on the patio in the summer. Love that they have a happy hour now! The cookies and milk are a great way to end the meal.
Always great food and great service at the Yard house. Best is, dining outside in the spring. Definitely a place to try if you have not.
Love the bar at homestead..zac on Sunday's is our favorite bartender. .should have him work bar more often, we would go more.
Like your place but you need to fix the misters on the patio. You're losing money because it's too hot to sit out there without them. Especially since you allow dogs. BIG DRAW!  Get er done!

Yummy. Went here based on good reviews. Definitely not a fancy environment but the food was good and the service was friendly and efficient.
My lemon chicken was cooked crispy on the outside, moist inside with a yummy tart lemon sauce which they did not skimp on. My husband's spicy beef with vegetables dish was good too.

If I lived in Meridian, I'd be a regular here.
Service is great every time food is amazing best fried pickles I've ever had by far and delicious steaks too!!!

Pshhhhhh for a $8 pizza you seriously can't go wrong. It's not the best pizza in the whole entire world but it is yummy and you're allowed to be creative. Plus, they have goat cheese. I fucking love goat cheese.

My fiancé is Mexican and he is very picky about his Mexican food. He loves this place! He loves the food, music, decor, and the wait staff are excellent! Very authentic. The Molé is delicious and next time I am trying the posolé. Can't wait to go back or order some to go! They also have a restaurant in McCall!

Service was great. This coming from a server myself. Brooklin was on the spot. Very attentive.  Checked back often. She has a sweet personality and smiles lot. Clean restaurant. Large burgers. Great tasting food. Fries are worth coming back for.  We'll be back for sure. Nice place to just sit and.....
Great food and service. Lovely staff. We will definitely return. Atmosphere is a bit crazy & packed together but hey, that's a sign of happy diners.

I love the Idahoan Omelette, wished they put more hashbrowns on the plate after all we are in Idaho. My wife had a Spinach skillet both tasted great and we were happy with the price. The service was fantastic everyone was very busy helping everyone. The quality was as good as Joe Mommas but the price was better. The only turn off was they had CNN on TV... Fox News would've been a grand slam. This state is 70 percent Republican how could they get that wrong?
Great Food and Great Service!

Atmosphere, location, parking= 4 1/2 stars

Food & house margaritas= 2 stars

I've only been to this location, once for drinks and appetizers months ago, and tonight with a party of 12. 

Ordering and time of food to table went great. Food arrived lukewarm... Rice cold. Guacamole was tasty as well as table salsa.

House margarita tasted pre made with minute-made lemonade as a base... I would not order again.

The forks are HUGE! My 6 y.o. Could barely eat with them, and uncomfortable for me as well. His spaghetti was overlooked. The turkey Cobb salad had the dressing mixed in already, which was surprising. I guess they assume they know better than you how much dressing you want. Overpriced. A lemonade costs nearly as much as a beer. Calamari is mainly tentacles. Pretty sloppy and definitely not worth the money.
Amazing service, unique food and beverages. Very friendly owner. Definitely a fun place to go and eat. Employees are very attentive!
Not sure what happened to this exact  location but they've only gone down. Cold food. The food seems like it's been prepared a long time ago. This was our final. Not coming back.

This is solid Mexican food, and great service. We recently moved from CA where we were surrounded by top-notch Mexican food, and with that said, Pueblo Lindo would easily hold its own there. We also have eaten at the Pueblo Lindo in McCall and it's also awesome. Highly recommended!

Execellent Huckleberry Mahi with risotto in cream sauce.
Cooked perfectly.  Service was also excellent.

I love Carl's Jr. There food is great but the customer service at this particular joint is horrible. The wait is twice as long as any other cj's or fast food restaurant. The staff is always rude no matter what. I am always as nice as can be (sincere pleases and thank yous)because that would suck to work there and I feel for them but they continue to be rude every time. I just went in there and they messed up my order and when I told them they acted angry and made my sandwich really fast and shitty because they were mad. Absolutely ridiculous. The only reason there is one star is because I enjoy their food. Everything else? Shit.

The employees were rude. The girl cooking wasn't wearing a face mask and would throw the orders after she got done. We had to wait 45mins to get our order. 

This store is a complete disaster. Would never recommend anyone ever goes here.

Y'all. This place was a GEM. I am super picky about food and I have no shame sending things back if I dont like them. I mean you are paying for it, so you should like what you order! And I was asked to find a place to eat so of course, I brought it to the Lord and asked Jesus where we should go and He told me here. Y'all, it is amazing. I mean of course if JESUS tells you to go somewhere, it's GUNNA be fire. And He saves us from the fire so, pun. Anyways, the food was fresh the menu price was totally worth the food. It's about 10-11 per person just like any other place. Really fresh. Really good. I deff will be coming back.

I had an awesome experience at Texas Roadhouse besides some dirty looks from workers that weren't even at our table! I had never eaten at one before, and due to our waiter, I had a great time. If you ever eat at this location, I recommend Luis. He was fast, he always made sure we had what we needed, and he was very kind. Thank you texas roadhouse for a great experience. Please watch for rude waiters giving tables dirty looks. That was the only thing that threw off the night.

Excellent pizza!  Perfect crust, generous toppings.  Note to waiters: Do NOT pat customers on the shoulder every time you come by!  Drink refills are slow.  Space is comfortable, restrooms are nice, parking is free, prices are good.  Service could be better.

Matador is a bit tricky. I never break down my reviews based on different details, but I had to actually do math to figure out my review score (lol, yikes I know!) so I thought I'd share my hard work with the Yelp fam. Some things are great. Some are awful. 

Food - 4 stars. I absolutely love their steak nachos. Like, they're my favorite nachos of all time. I love the guacamole sauce, the ratio of ingredients, the generous portions and the crunchy chips. I've also had pounds of chips and salsa, which is pretty good. Chimichanga is pretty good, not spectacular.  I've had a few different salads and really enjoyed each one. I had this one with roasted grapes once and it was delicious. 

Drinks - 4 stars. Great selection of tequila. I'm not a margarita connoisseur, but the few I've had have been yummy. Not too sweet and do not taste like they come from a mix. Pretty hefty price tag though if you buy outside of happy hour. 

Service - 1 star. Oy, the service is brutal here. I've been to multiple Matador locations and it's been the same everywhere. They're slow, inattentive, mix up orders, and the servers usually seem a bit put out to take our order. They must not put an emphasis on service. They've also been weird about splitting checks. 

Location- 4 stars. It's nice to have Matador at the village. I enjoy their happy hour, especially before going to a movie. I dislike their GIANT booths that they like to squeeze way too many people into. It's also pretty dark so bring your Yelp ring light to get good pictures. :) There is a decent amount of patio seating for the summer, though none can accommodate a large group. 

Overall this case out to a 3.25 so I'm sticking to 3 stars.
This place was mediocre probably wouldn't go back the service was poor as well they could improve there friendliness

Food here recently has be over-salted. Thankfully their fried rice is on the bland side so you'll be able to mitigate the entree's saltiness. Their seafood options are better than average, but again, a tad on the salty side. 

Service is still quick and the owner recognizes familiar faces well, but we were given a short and snappy, "you know the menu" when we requested a recommendation to try something new. We only know what we've tried, that's why I asked. ;) 

There are some horrible Chinese options in Boise and while this isn't one of them, if you have something decent closer, there's nothing worth going out of your way to come here.

Nice little spot. Typical burger joint but this place is by far the cleanest joint around. The owners do a wonderful job at keeping this place clean. The burgers we ordered were good however the temperature was not as warm as it should have been. Nice staff.

My wife and I were doing a relatively extensive home remodel (which was shown on HGTV), and we had been through several of the bigger flooring showrooms in the Treasure Valley -- we got product and installation bids from all of them.  Fortunately, we were finally introduced to Michael at Factory Direct Flooring.  

None of those other stores compared to the customer service, knowledge, honesty, attention, competence, and savings we received from Michael.  He guided us through every step of the process:  helped us decide which product would make the most sense for our needs, helped us choose the design that worked with our aesthetic, was flexible with the installation schedule, and his team performed a FLAWLESS installation.  The best part is that Factory Direct did all this at a 5-figure savings over the installer that we were going to use prior to meeting Michael.  After the installation, when another vendor came in and damaged the flooring, Factory Direct came back to our house, repaired the damage at no cost to us.  

Every member of Michael's installation team were professionals -- they showed up on time, they worked hard, they finished on time, and the results were perfect.  I appreciated Factory Direct's work so much that I have referred several friends and business contacts to Michael -- and they all have seen equally great results and savings.  

I cannot be happier with my experience with Factory Direct Flooring.  In industry filled with vendors who put quantity over quality, it is refreshing to work with someone who values craftsmanship and relationships.  Michael, you have a client for life in me.

I'm not one to typically leave reviews, but these donuts were too good to not say something about... 

The one with peaches in the middle and some sort of browned butter frosting was amazing.

Out of all the mediocre donut places in the valley, there is absolutely nothing special about most of them... BUT the moist texture, amazing flavors, and awesome store hours open for a night snack... this place gets a full 5 stars from me.

Haven't had any hotdogs... but the donuts are a game changer here.

My reception was better before they came and put in their antenna! Horrible customer service and crappy attitudes toward me when I told them there was a problem a month later. They assume you screwed around with their antenna (which we didn't touch) and said it would cost us $75 for a service call a month after installation. Worker told me when he arrived that he was going to disconnect our stuff from the tv and then if it got good reception he would collect $75 from me. In the end he couldn't fix it and back peddled about it being our fault....now we have horrible reception and are out $250 for the original installation.

UPDATED: I am giving them 3 
Stars (originally 1) because I am happy with the end result. Took 3 visits to my house and talking with owner to get the situation fixed but now my reception is great.

I've been here multiple times already, and I've enjoyed each and every visit. Right off the bat, the value is real good here, but can get a little "spendy" for some of the premium options/ alcoholic beverages. I always order the 16OZ USDA Choice Sirloin steak with mashed potatoes and fresh vegetables, and unless I'm REAL hungry, I always bring some of the steak back home for dinner.

You come here for the steaks, and the steaks here are real good. I've had some steaks from other "chain" restaurants in the area, and I always come back here because these really do taste the best. Seasoned well, no need for any A1 sauce. I'd highly recommend adding mushrooms & Jack Cheese on top of your steak, IMO it's totally worth it. 

You get unlimited rolls, which are very tasty, and you can always take some home with your leftovers. They always have some sort of IPA beer on deck, which I always order.

I've visited this location multiple times, always had great service. I had a real good time last time, Greg was my waiter and I enjoyed him serving us so much that I had to come on here and place a review. If you're lucky enough to get him, you'll have a real good time here. Very attentive and just good & positive vibe from him.

If this is your first time here, this is what you order: 16OZ USDA Choice Sirloin (medium well) topped off with Jack Cheese & Mushrooms, mashed potatoes, and fresh vegetables. This is the REAL DEAL, trust me. I included the picture to this review, it was a biblical meal. Order a large beer and just kick back and chill. Lots of TVs, mainly around the bar area, to watch sports.

Overall, 5 stars EASY. Great value, great tasting food. If I HAD to mention a negative, I'd just point out that the serving size for the mashed potatoes / vegetables is just a tad undersized. If they had just a little bigger servings for the potatoes & vegetables this place would be unreal. Also, could get a little loud at times, and some tables have minimal lighting, but still a good environment.

I'm stuck between 3.5 and 4 stars with this place. Okay, I'll start with the good stuff. The menu. I love it's it's great for large groups, it's great if you have no idea what you wanna chow down on & there are great vegetarian options. 

The atmosphere! I'm a fan. Dim lighting (everyone looks way better in dim lighting, lol) it's "poppin" I dunno I just love the vibes. 

Cons, the service just doesn't blow me away when I'm there! I always feel like I'm waiting a long time for everything that I order. And I have done my fair share of wining and dining, so I know a wait when I see one.
Jeremy Wagnon was very informative and I felt comfortable with him.  I'm excited to get my report and Care Plan back next week so I can move forward with treatment and hopefully feeling better soon!
Great environment with good service and amazing Mexican food.  I especially like the habanero steak burrito.  Also, I love the location being next to the Village.  I would highly recommend it.

Dr. Jarvis is a wonderful family dentist. They have been great with the whole family especially my kids. 
Our youngest had been very terrified of the dentist and their tools. Until we went here and she finally let them use tools in her mouth and now had let them do everything they need to in there. It has been a very great experience.

We ate in once last year and while it wasn't bad, wasn't good enough to bring us back. Still, it's close to home so encouraged by the good reviews online, I decided to give take-out a try and placed an order for Beef Chow Fun and potstickers. The order was ready within 10 minutes as promised which is why I gave them 3 stars, but the food itself was probably closer to a 2. Potstickers were huge, with a thick coating of gloppy, soggy dough. The styrofoam container should have had a corner open for venting, but even that wouldn't have been enough to save them. One bite and the remaining huge chunk of filling just plopped right out into the overly salty dipping sauce. No way I could eat them, so moved on to the Chow Fun. Unfortunately that wasn't much better. The snow peas were crisp, but that was the only positive thing. The beef was tough and the noodles gummy, overall bland and tasteless -- most of it went into the trash. It didn't seem possible that others would have given 4 and even 5 star ratings for this food so I even double-checked to make sure I hadn't gone to the wrong place. So disappointing...

All I can say is YUM! My mom and I dropped by today to check this new place out, and while we didn't get any meals (ex. hot dog, fries...) we did get some donuts to go! My mom got the Southern Belle and I got the donut of the day, which was an apple cinnamon pull apart with crushed pecans (think "monkey bread"). It was DELICIOUS! One of the best donuts I have had, not too sweet and just the right size. My mom said she absolutely LOVED the Southern Belle. I can't wait to return to try the hot dogs, and I will definitely be getting more donuts from here in the future!
One of my favorite places for brunch! Staff is always friendly and knowledgeable. The beer selection is excellent and they make the best Breakfast Shot in town!
The Pad Thai was awful! The noodles were dry with no sauce. For the price, not worth eating.

Love this place!! You have to try there mochi it's one and only!! They have everything for everyone. They have teppanyaki, sushi, sushiyama, tempura!! YUMMY!! Really good tea as well. And I'm not a fan of saki but they do have it warm. I think that it is very cheap because we can eat and only spend less than 40 for the two of us. We usually spend 70 elsewhere seeing we order alot of food!! Great for groups and usually no wait!! They even have paper rooms for big groups you can reserve!!

Very Satisfied!! 

I just recently moved to Idaho and didn't know any local hair salons! I had purple hair and needed it removed and lightened so I would be ready for an interview the next day. I showed up without an appointment, was greeted politely and I explained to them my situation on why I was coming in so last minute! 

Kelsey and Alana agreed to fit me into their tight schedule and stay late to tag team my hair so I would be professionally ready for my interview! 

*I colored my hair purple on my own, I highly do not recommend doing that, as I found out theres was many other options I could have done at the salon. If you're wanting a funky color in your hair I highly recommend talking to Kelsey or Alana about your options (trust me you'll be shocked on what you can do instead of dying it)!!!*

Kelsey and Alana were trying their absolute best to pull the color out and then it turned pink..   BUT WAIT ! They got it out!! Yay!! I showed them my inspiration picture and they start tag teaming on dying my hair, which was really fun! They both have amazing personalities and super bubbly people to be around and as they were going through the process of lightening my hair they were explaining what they were doing and why! Which I absolutely LOVED because I get anxious dying my hair because if you don't like it.. well you're kinda stuck with it. 

I couldn't have been happier with my experience here. Absolutely amazing people and gorgeous Salon! I got EXACTLY what I wanted from my inspiration picture! 

Thank you guys so much!

If you would like to see more of their amazing work, I'll be posting their Instagrams below!!
Ordered the Chicago Combo.  Real mozzarella cheese, fresh tomatoe sauce, and traditional Chicago-style crust.  Fresh tasting and cooked just right.  Good food and clean restaurant.

Probably the worst fast food experience I've had. A few weeks ago my family and I hit Carl's Junior after busy day of moving. We used to love Carls Junior but had been living in an area where there wasn't one. We waited in the drive thru for over 20 minutes. We ordered 4 western bacon cheeseburger meals. When we got home...not one had cheese. I phone the restaurant and the young lady who answered said she would put out names on a meal replacement list. So, 8/11/17 my husband and I decided to cash in on our replacement to feed our teenage boys. A young man named Jesse helped my husband and I. Went went inside because the drive through was packed. The young man struggled to find our names on "the list" and then struggled to comp the food in the system. The general manager was present the entire time. He stood back in the kitchen/ grill area and not once offered his support. Heck he could have saved everyone some pain and suffering if he had just come out and helped. All the while this young man Jesse muscled through the awkward situation, answered phone calls, dealt with other customers and tried to be as graceful as possible. I have this place a one-star because the management is awful. The guy is lazy and has no business being in charge. Jesse however deserves a raise and a promotion. We won't be back to this location.

Kahootz is one of the places you thought only existed in sitcoms. Where the side character says to the main character, "you wanna have your life changed?" Laugh track, then the main character looks nervous or uncomfortable. Then they go and it ends up the crazy side character was right. 

Don't judge the exterior of this Alehouse, inside... amazing food and ambience awaits you. Now I'm just a humble guy who happens to travel for work, but on my travels I've had wings from some of the best places in the country. Kahootz honestly have the best buffalo wings I've ever had in my life. 

Once I started eating, the idea of doing anything else... other than eating the wings, really annoyed me. My dad was with me, the very man who took me to uncover these golden delicious wings, and even his voice was an unnecessary distraction. 

I haven't tried anything else from this place. But let's just assume it's good, yeah? The important take away from this review is you should go here for the wings. 

The service was also great, the waitress was really nice, there was lots of seating, and outside seating... see I'm already f#%#ing annoyed you're making me talk about something other than the wings.

Don't  hesitate to eat here.  Great Mexican  food.  Lunch specials, or order off menu.  Either way food is fresh and hot.  Two enchiladas witn rice and beans tips this old guy into the comfort zone.  Salud

We've been here a few times now for lunch (both during the week, and weekends), and have always had great food (have tried burgers, sandwiches, and finger steaks). 

Service can be spotty - our server today seemed more interested in rolling silverware than bringing us our drinks, so someone else brought them. 

Great beer selection - they have it posted on their website, so you can check it out on your phone instead of looking at the tv.

First timer and the food was out of this world . Our server was warm and engaging will definitely be back ,my wife had the Cobb salad and it was over flowing on the plate both my daughters had burgers and fries and I had the fish tacos & fries .I would highly recommend the Homestead to anyone  who wants great food at a reasonable price .

We should have heeded the warning on the door... Help Wanted. They were quick with the drinks, but took forever to get the food. They brought my husband's food out first and asked me what I had ordered. By the time my husband was about finished eating they told me mine would be right out. About 15 minutes later my food was served, long after my husband had finished eating and our drinks were empty. What they brought me didn't even match what the menu said. Won't be going back.

Flatbread is my go-to place in Meridian for gluten free pizza. You can get pretty much any of their pizzas with a gf option. They also offer flatbreads which basically consist of the gluten free crust with the flatbread toppings. It can get pretty expensive with the additional $1.50 per pizza to make them gluten free, even the small ones but its worth it for a good pizza with quality toppings. I'm also a big fan of the Italian salad. As far as cross-contamination goes, I think they are pretty careful because I've never been sick eating at this location. *fingers crossed*

Great service! Both employees we're very friendly. My tai chicken pizza looked awesome and tasted great. Second pizza was custom order and the did it perfectly. One of the employees helped me to my car. You guys rock.

Kahootz has a great beer selection and the bartenders and waitstaff know their stuff when it comes to beer. The service has never not been super friendly and they seem to know the regulars well. There is a family atmosphere every time I come here. Love and attention are in the food. 

I have a close friend who eats here EVERY time he is in Boise and he has a near-crack-level addiction to their bread pudding. 

I, on the other hand have a serious bent for Manny's pale ale and MacN Jacks amber ale. -locals laugh at me, but you can't get that stuff outside of the PNW... and they are top 5 beers for me. They always have at least one of the two on tap. 

Come for the beer and the atmosphere, stay for a good steak and way too much dessert.

Ordered the Reuben and Steak Sandwich for takeout - they were SUPER on-point (asking if I needed sauces, offering suggestions that were not up-sells but merely pro-tips, timing the order with my arrival, etc.). 

The steak sandwich was pretty good, though a little clunky. I'm not gonna say anything else about it because holy hell the Reuben is what you should order right now good god go eat it stop reading this already
The employees at this Walgreens are very friendly and helpful. One if the  great things about Walgreens is, if you  buy the products and don't care for it then you can always take it back:)
Our favorite place to go for Happy Hour . The Poke Nachos are amazing.  Huge beer selection and overall great food.
Great new Mexican restaurant with authentic Mexican food. The carnitas tacos were delicious, made with fried pork, not the stringy stuff!  Service was great. We will definitely be back.
Great food, able to change things up to match with wife diet. Amazing flights of beer. To hard to make a choice there are so many on tap.

After visiting the place across the street, this place was amazing. The food was fresh, delicious, arrived quickly, and they allowed substitutions. If they keep this up and don't change then they will have a customer for life. My daughter had the french toast kids meal and it came standard with berries and cream, not just boring maple syrup. My omelet had sprouts and avocado, such a nice addition. I'm a bit of a pancake connnoisseur and the pancakes (just original, plain, nothing fancy) I ordered with my omelet were the best ever, no joke. I'm craving them right now and was thinking of placing a huge order to bring for an Easter brunch. If I could say one negative it would be that given all the other things they do to go "above and beyond" that they should have housemade jelly to go on the toast. Friendly staff too.

Finally!!!!! A legitimately awesome Mexican Food Restaurant in Meridian! Moving here from San Diego, it has been tough driving all the way to Nampa or Caldwell for authentic and quality food. This place is amazing. Service, food, decor, music all perfect. The service is top notch. The Pastor and fajitas are perfect. This is the best Mexican food in the valley hands down and it is about time!!!

EXCELLENT pizza, salad, and dessert!  Ordered for pickup, really fast service. Easy on and off I84. Whenever I am on this stretch of road, I will stop and pick up a Margherita pizza! I also appreciate their "give-back" philosophy.

Really disappointed in Chili's. They appear to be struggling financially or something because they've started cutting corners with handing out silverware in little brown paper baggies and not having napkins readily available: we had to ask for them. The waitress was polite, suggested the special, and checked on us regularly to make sure we were happy. The portion size was great. The food itself was a bit disappointing. The freshness of the fries was questionable and my burger was subpar. Although the quality of dining has gone down, the prices have not. The experience wasn't profoundly bad, but it wasn't great either.

Very good, authentic Italian pizza. Very impressed. They say the ingredients are flown in from Italy daily. I don't know if I believe it... but my pizza was good I can't really question it. 

The only thing is the waiter didn't know how to pronounce some of the Italian words. Hahaha but it's all good he was cool and gave us good service. Definitely recommend.
Yuck! Queso tasted like hormel chili out of the can. Waitress gave dirty napkins and not very attentive. Fajitas tastes like pre packaged pre made frozen meal. Will not go back

Normally I like this place, but not today. I get it, Feb 14 will be crazy, I expect that. But two things were handled very poorly. First, our projected wait was 85-95 minutes. We are at 120 now. They should be a little better at projecting by now.  Worse, multiple people who arrived after us have now been seated ahead of us and we are only 2 people. At one point they told us 20 minutes left, that was an hour ago. Then they told us 10 minutes. That was twenty minutes ago. We are still waiting.
But that is not what provided the worst experience. They let EVERYONE stand in the walkway while waiting. Not just the entry but entire walkway. Entering and leaving you almost feel violated pushing through the crowd.  Seriously!? Just tell people that is a walkway and to wait in the waiting room or outside. Gauranteed that is a fire code violation, any fire and everyone inside dies. And I bring this up because that is not just a today problem. It is a piss poor process they have and they just let it get completely out of hand.
