Also, they advertised to call ahead today. After thirty minutes on hold we arrived and hung up anyway since we were here.

This place has a great menu, now they just need some half decent management. Or it is just not worth coming any more.

I will never go back to this Chili's.  The bartender is beyond rude. He literally flipped our table off because we ask the server to split our checks. The bartender is condescending, rude and makes you feel like a burden. He needs to find another profession. We called the GM and he didn't seem to care. To bad we love the food.
Restaurant was clean and the food was great. Customer sevice....well, not the friendliest but he did refill our drinks in a timely manner.
Much better than one would expect from the outside. The specials are great, but could be more imaginative. Great beer selection. Waitstaff is top notch.

Wow! My favorite donuts in Boise! The special donut of today, Stairway to Heaven, was amazing! My husband and I bought 4 other donuts and all were soooo good. My husband loves to look up and taste test multiple donuts as we travel to different cities. This is our 3rd place to try here in Boise....now my favorite! I also got the grilled cheese and tomato soup meal...a grilled cheese on donut bread was yummy! The Donut Dog is only in Boise and Nashville....everyone must try this place in my opinion!

First off we had no idea this was an allergy nightmare since they put peanut butter in their enchilada sauce which yes can be traditional but our daughter is severely allergic! So we would have never gone had we known this. Luckily we didn't have her with us this time but the taco salad we got with steak was all lettuce and very little Steak. My taco was soggy and flavorless. We won't be back.

I wish I could say this is based on one experience, but after 4+ visits, I doubt we'll go back. First, the music is way too loud. It's not a night club and when we have more than two people in our party, we can't make conversation with anyone besides the person next to us and we still have to yell. It's also so dark it's hard to read the menu, let alone check the quality of the food. Second, the service is unpredictable. One visit we had our entree before we were halfway done with our salads and felt we had to rush to eat. The next time, we had finished our appetizers for a while and started wondering what the hold up was. Our server didn't check on us for several minutes even though she passed by our table to serve other tables multiple times. We were there for over an hour and ended up late to our movie due to the delay in service. For a Tuesday this seemed off to me. Maybe it's a turn over thing, but customers shouldn't be treated differently depending on the time of day. We still pay the same amount for our food and tip well regardless.

This place is amazing. Went for the first time today. I had the brunch dog and my wife had the grilled cheese. We also bought an assortment of donuts. Wasn't disappointed with any of it. Service was also great. Highly recommend.

We go to fb every Tuesday and sit at the bar so we can have nate the bartender. .the best!!  Food is great, nate makes the best cocktails in meridian!!  Also best service at the bar.. try vodka Collins  (only nates) amazing .  love chopped vegi pizza too!
WooHoo! As good as it gets! All family members all ages love this place! That's a win-Win! Friendly and Fun!

We went here for dinner and I was pleasantly surprised to have the option of a gluten free bun for my jalapeño burger. They even toasted the bun with garlic butter so it was excellent. The fries were battered so I ordered a garden salad. The waitress was very attentive and offered anything she could think of as a gluten free option without my asking, and considering it's a loud bar & grill, her extra concern for me was very much appreciated. My husband had the 50:50 burger which had smoked pork and huckleberry BBQ sauce which gave an outdoorsy flavor. There was a talented guitarist singing and playing music live. The atmosphere had good energy. We don't drink and still felt content dining there.

My wife and I both got the rib eye steak and it was pretty good, the portion of the steak and the taste, we were definitely impressed. The sides were pretty disappointing, got barely any red potatoes and the asparagus were very soggy and bland. The price it was for what the sides ended up being was pretty eh. But if you want a good ribeye you'll definitely get that!

Hein does a great job! She is fast and friendly, but also takes the time to make sure that you are happy with the color and design. I can tell it is important to her that customers are happy with the finished service. Prices are very reasonable too!

They get it right every time! My steak always comes out just how I ask for it, and the ribs sidekick tasted freshly done. Points for the crazy dance number the servers busted into about halfway through the meal. They all started line dancing. I was fascinated by this. Will def go back!

Homestead is one of our favorite burger places. The burgers are large and taste great. You can't go wrong with the mushroom Swiss or BBQ bacon burger. The fries are amazing. Thin and crispy, served with awesome fry sauce. The only reason I didn't give it 5 stars is because it is always incredibly loud and crowded. You can't hear the people at your own table talking because of the noise. We usually order food to go so we don't have to deal with the crowded tables and noise.

Stopped by here today to check out the new business. The location is a bit small but finding a place to sit wasn't a problem. The menu is easy and not a lot of choices which make things easier. Unfortunately they don't have a donut menu not sure if they change there selection everyday or what. We stopped by in the afternoon after lunch and they were all but out of donuts which was sad. I know this business is new and they are going to go through some hiccups so not really dinging them for that. They have a lunch special which includes a dog fries and drink for 10 bucks which is a little on the high side but for the village is on par. They offer several different sides with your special but don't tell u they up charge for some of them. I got the chili and cheese dog a truffle fries. The dog it self was good the bun is like a super thick piece of toast cut in half half way down so the bottom half is pretty much just extra so I found myself just taking bits of toast. The truffle fries were good a little on salty side. We also got the bacon wrapped dog and regular seasoned fries both good. We were able to get 1 donut which was very flavorful and not bad on price about 3 bucks a donut. But when u add it all up it was over 30 bucks for 2 hot dogs and fries and a donut.. bit on the high side. My biggest complaint was the music that was so loud it was almost unbariable. Will have to give them a couple weeks and see how they are doing.

The ladies of this business are fantastic. They are sweet and have not once ever made us feel bad for having three insane dogs. We take our pack here every few weeks to get nail trims and they do the best job. Our dogs are difficult, extremely loud, and just down right annoying sometimes, but they have never once made us to feel that way. 

Their nails are always nice and short afterwards!

Ate here about a month ago, it was good but the one thing my husband and I can't forget is how curt and borderline rude the blond teenage gal taking the orders at the very front of the line was.  Seemed as if she was done with people that geeeee, I don't know, actually order their pizzas with her!?  It was our first time there so we had a couple of questions but she didn't seem to be able to want to deal with that.  Even though there was no one behind us, her whole vibe was, "Keep it moving."  Sheesh!  You can do better, Blaze, I believe.  I hope you're reading these reviews, looks like I'm not the one one that has encountered somewhat "eh" service here.  Too bad, because the pizza's delicious.

We went in for a good bye celebration. We waited an hour for a table we had a big group it was 14 of us. So the wait was understandable. Once we finally sat down  it started off ok our server got water right away took drink orders. She forgot my childs drink. She was very forgetful any time we asked for something she said yes but then she forgets it. Food... my child order enchiladas with no cheese she got cheese. It took forever for her to get her food fixed we where all done eating by the time she got her food. My taco salad was not what I expected. I wanted grilled chicken I got shredded chicken. Overall the experience was not good. We weren't impressed by the service or some of the food. This was my 3rd time here and I gotta say it was not the best.

I've come to this salon 3 times, and each time a different lady has done my hair. They all do a great job with my color & cut! 
I love the vibe here: they have Christian music playing, everyone at the salon is talking to each other, you can grab a coffee or soda, and they have information all over on how to help fight sex trafficking. All of their profits go towards this fight, and they are all serving in different areas towards ending human trafficking. It's a great place to be!

The service is good as well as the ambiance of the restaurant. Chips and salsa are average. Portions are good size..The downfall is they put red sauce all over their fajitas! I don't know why restaurants do that. I will go back and try something different. Our family scored Pueblo Lindo a 6.75/10 average.

I really want to like this place because it is close to my house and I love Chineses food. But I can't even like this place. This is our second try a year apart and it's a fail x2. This time I places a $52 to go order. They said 10-15 minutes and it took 30. The guy who took my order was not friendly and somewhat impatient. The chow main was dry, the fried rice was like instant rice fried, weird texture and not much flavor. The three entrees were mediocre at best. I won't be going back for a third try.

Add another $ to that. I used to buy there when the clothes had a more vintage style in the 90's. The clothes held up to everyday wear and washing; NO MORE. The sweaters and jackets 'pill' and the clothes don't hold up more than a year. It has been disappointing to see it change.

I was really impressed with the service and atmosphere at Einstein's Oilery. The servicemen were upbeat, friendly, and efficient. They seemed to actually enjoy their jobs and make you feel important. They politely offered additional services without being pushy or trying to scare me. The free wifi, drink and "sucker" for my son were nice added benefits.
Mongolian beef was middle of the road. Dinner portions are huge!  Service was quick, friendly, and attentive.
I love Wok Fusion. That is like real Chinese food. Their egg rolls are super good! I loved their noodles and there fried shrimp was amazing! I so encourage you to come here!

If you are going in a small group of 2-4 people and just want to try out be of their signature Bloody Marys, this may still be a fun stop. 

 Every time I've been to Homestead has been a total let down. Confused orders (being offered another table's order), low quality ingredients (old wilted lettuce etc), and unfriendly, disorganized staff in general makes this place low on my list to visit again.

Called in an order for takeout at 430pm we asked if  it could be ready by 6:15, they said no problem. Arrived into the restaurant at 6:00 15 minutes early, waited in a huge lime for 15 minutes to finally make it to the receptionist, we asked about our order, she told us it would be ready in a few more minutes. By 7:00 we finally got our order. 

We watched this huge line where people were waiting patiently, also watched impatient people cutting in line and being served first.. Clearly a more organised system could be used.

It was was a busy day for the year.

The food was moderate, not worth the wait. Had a few members of the family feel sick the next day.
Friendly servers, fast service, good food. The cashew chicken was delicious. Saw a regular come in and he was greeted by name and asked for the usual. I can see why they come here.

Stopped in here on our way to and from Utah. Great off leash park. All the humans were nice and our pup had a great time running off all his energy. Place was super clean and restrooms made for a great recharge before hitting the road. There's a spot for Big pups and a separate one for littles, our babe ran in both!

Absolutely amazing! We had 3 different donuts and they were all amazing! We also had the grilled cheese and tomato soup (soup was a little to sweet for me), truffle fries, and pretzel bites. Our Kids loved all of it, to! The truffle fries were huge! Could easily be shared with 4 Adults. Great service! We'll be back!

Blaze pizza is my all time favorite pizza place! I mean what's not to like about it? They have amazing customer service and their pizza is amazing!  I love there thin crust and I love how we get to choose what we put on our own pizza. I recommend blaze pizza to everyone!

This place smells bad. Not really appeasing for a restaurant! Kind of like a sewer. We waited over 20 minutes for our order, too. The employees were nice, I think they were just short staffed. The play area is cool, but the smell....yeah.

We took our year old pup to Snip to get spayed. They were charging over half the price that our local vet wanted. They got us in for an appointment quickly and were very informative about what we needed to do to prep. Surgery went great and our dog was healed and back to her normal self within 2 weeks. I highly recommend them!

Came here on a weekday right after they opened for the day to try their burger and fries.  Burger was cooked to order, so be patient. Everything on the burger was fresh and the burger had a great flavor.  The price was more than fair.  If you're not a huge french fry eater but want to have some with your burger, be sure to split an order. They kind of give you a lot. The restaurant is small inside but looked very clean and the employees working were nice. The only negative thing we noticed was the really tight exit driveway with parked cars from the next business.  There was snow on the ground and we were in a truck and didn't want to risk sliding into them, so we went out thru the entrance driveway. Overall, great local place with a good burger.
Food here is consistently great and the family that owns it is always very friendly and welcoming!!

We had a great time here last night. We walked into a sport bar like feel with music playing. We arrived before happy hour ended at 6 and were greeted with a smiling waitress, Mimi. She was so friendly! We had never been at the Yard House since we moved here. It felt like a gem hidden with a big attitude! If I recall they have 130 beers on tap. We looked at the menu and everything looked so good. I ordered the roast beef au jus with french fries. My husband had a hamburger and onion rings "he said it was like having a juicy burger without the juice". The steaks and fish and other hamburgers and oh my the appetizers looked so good. 
Mimi was so kind to show us how to order the many different beers on tap and how to check out. Such a wonderful waitress. We will be back.

What this Chili's or was it Applebee's. 
What a waste of time. Slow service in an empty restaurant at 4:30.
Overcooked steak. Cold broccoli, mash potatoes that sat under the warming light that dries the few shred of cheese. 
Warm, not hot chili appetizer. 
Only the chips and salsa were any good. 
What happened to the Chili's of the past?

I've been to the matador quite a few times. The ambiance and wait staff are fantastic, the food is decent but really has been hit or miss for me.  ****Happy hour needs to be better...only two drink options and they are frozen margaritas for 5 bucks ..  not on the rocks those start at 8.00. All in all they need more drink specials!
We were excited to have this place close by but the acoustics are terrible so you can't really have a conversation when they are busy.  Food is hit and miss.

Having gone there many times, I took a date for her first homestead experience. Disappointing!! No longer a hidden secret, numerous loud drunks at the end of the bar, dropping "F" bombs within ear shot of families. I'm all for summer patio music, but when it leads to so many flies, I can't enjoy my dinner!??

Staff was buried, but friendly as always.

Came back for the usual.
-Cuts back a lot of sauce
*asks for little bit more sauce*
*gets order back with still minimal sauce, barely enough to cover the whole wing.
Mmk. If I can't enjoy wings with speciality sauces I can barely taste to complement my bone/boneless orders, what's even the point then? Sad, this place used to be greater than what it is now. Until next time, I guess.

Had a lovely lunch with friends this afternoon. Server, Devon, was so sweet. The food was fresh and delicious! We took up a table for a couple of hours visiting. They took good care of us. Will go again when I'm in town.
All of our food was delicious. Excellent service, great meal for the whole family. Kids loved it and so did we!
Very delicious food here and loved the flat iron steak salad. I would recommend this place if you want to try something new. The wait time was a little long but I was with a big group.

So disappointed! We placed an order online and picked it up. I made the dreaded mistake of not checking the order before leaving, and of course we were missing our salads.  I called and let them know if the mistake, and sent my husband to pick up the salad. An hour and a half later, we got our salads and we were eating our now cold meal. 
Nothing was offered as compensation for the inconvenience AND even though I had called and let them know of the mistake, they took care of all the other pick up orders before bringing out our salads.
Also the sides on the family meal are VERY small! Not family size! Not worth the 50.00, not even close!

Industrial decor.  Some unique menu options that aren't at the other Flatbread locations.  One reason I'm a fan of this small chain is each Flatbread location (six total) has its' own personality yet all are related for the good parts of their DNA in creative menu, consistency in good food, quality libations and all at moderate price point.  As downside, service varies from pretty good to barely OK at some of them.

GRAND OPENING GOOD MANAGEMENT:  We heard "Welcome" and "Thanks for coming" from the moment we entered and the door was held for us, through seating at our table, from our server, from the manager who stopped by and also from the owner who came by tables to talk with guests.  Today's opening coincided with area grade schools being out and at lunch there were lots of families of multiple generations with children in tow.   They were 'slammed' with customers but there was ample staff on site to be certain all tables were cared for. 

VIBE:  Located In the Eagle Island Marketplace, same strip mall as Fred Meyer in a space remodeled space from a previous occupant, this now  features an industrial meets rustic vibe with high ceilings, exposed duct work and some raw wood elements.  Seating is mostly standard height (yahoo!) wood tables and metal chairs and upholstered booths. There are high tables with bar height seating at bar and just inside door.  Interesting light fixtures above and a wall of windows in front make the space light and bright.  

MENU & FOOD:  The same pizza / pasta / sandwiches / salads / soups as on the other Flatbread location menus but also a few items unique to this location. The same "2 for $10" lunch specials and also the "make your own" pizza available to children at all Flatbreads.  Options aplenty for vegetarians and omnivores. We shared steamed clams off the small plates menu and a grilled artichoke salad.  Both were delicious and here's tip if you order the clams - ask for extra bread and spoons as the Pernod broth is too good to leave behind.

LIBATIONS: My husband had a glass of Petite Sirah which was an ample sized pour in good quality Spiegelau stemware for $8.  Coffee is good and served hot in a nice mug.  Full bar. 

SERVICE:  The server was friendly, well informed on the menu, attentive and efficient.  Since service can be a problem at some locations, hope the good service here holds.

SPACE DRAWBACKS: Tables and chairs too tightly spaced making it difficult for servers and customers to get through them.  Also high ceilings and a big open space like this with a lot of hard surfaces is a very, very high noise level, in particular as the place fills up.  In particular when the always too loud music gets cranked up to "HUH?  WHAT DID YOU SAY?" levels.  Easily fixable by rearranging tables, or even removing one and turning down the music.  


THIS N THAT:

1) PARKING:  Good sized lot.

2) ACCESSIBILITY: Accessible parking in lot.  Level in the door.  All on one floor.   Mostly standard height tables, including in bar area which is also an equal access requirement few get right.  But tables throughout are tightly spaced and it looks as if path of travel to the bathroom would be impossible for wheelchair users.  They need to fix that for ADA reasons - it is a requirement of equal access.

3) THE LOO:  Only 1 loo for gents and 1 loo for ladies.  No kidding.  Both are right outside the kitchen.  When the place is busy be prepared to line up in the hall and wait.  Awkward layout.

These guys are awesome, I  first started using them back in the early 90s when he was the tree doctor. I had an emergency with a tree,won't go into detail about it. I called every tree service in the phone book and he was the only one that would help. 
Fast forward to today, I had him come out and clean up the big trees in my front yard. And they did an excellent job.
People complain about pricing too much, but I believe that you get what you pay for.

First visit to this restaurant that is new to Meridian. The entire experience was extremely good. From the greeting to the service (Saray) and food was fantastic. Seafood Burrito and Chimichanga Burrito between Sharmini and I. Highly recommend this restaurant.

I went to Walmart for grocery shopping this morning.  As usual, the battery I needed was out-of-stock at the front of the store, so I went to the automotive section.  I could see the battery needed in the locked display, but there was only one cashier helping another customer.  I waited 5 minutes before asking if there was someone else who could help me, as it was apparent the other customer would be there much longer.  I was told "no" there was no one else who could help me.  I explained that I only needed a battery, but the cashier just walked off, ignoring me.  At this point, I left my groceries and went elsewhere.  I have found that my money spends just as well elsewhere.
UPDATE:  Received a phone call from Walmart apologizing for the lack of service.  Will give them another chance.

I don't know what all the fuss is about. This place was not amazing, and the service left much to be desired. MUCH. The fish tacos were overly greasy, and the prices really high. I don't see any redeeming points in this place except at least I didn't get food poisoning.

The food was decent, the beer selection great, but the music was so loud, it took yelling to talk to other people at the table. Of course, since no one could hear each other. Everyone was yelling. According to the manager, the corporate HQ thinks loud music is the shit. Well, that it is. I won't be back in the evening.

My husband and I were to go on a date tonight for Mother's Day and we had picked this spot to try..we hadn't eaten here before so I was pretty excited to go check it out! Unfortunately, my morning sickness got the best of me which prevented us from dining in, but not from grabbing some take out! I am SO glad we did. Of course food is always best served immediately, but it was still so so good when we got home! (Luckily we live super close) 
Looking forward to when we can dine in and I can enjoy a couple beers!

What in the hell is wrong with you!? who stands at the front of a restaurant looking like this? We walked in, you looked pissed off, irritated and not happy to be there. Guess what, get over it. It's your job! That's just the start of it. This is our second time coming to this bdubs, and NO ONE looks happy, there's no smiles no nothing. The only person I've ever seen smile with our server today. Next thing...the kitchen needs to wake up and do their job as well I use to work at bdubs and this is such a simple menu.....our wings were cold. I don't understand that. You drop the wings, you dress them in the sauce you put the ticket up, expo gets it ready with ranch and veggies and then you get someone to run it. Not that damn hard. I have told multiple people since our first visit to not come here to this location because it's terrible customer service

Awesome first experience here! I just came through for a routine oil change wanting to try the place out. These guys were very fast and efficient. They replaced a faulty light, windshield wiper, and air filter for me. He even showed me my air filter next to a new one to show me the difference because I wasn't sure. They informed me of many different options that I had without trying to push a sale. He also told me about how I was due for new power steering but showed me that it still looked pretty good so it wasn't necessary. Loved the honesty and how they weren't trying to make a quick buck on me. Freshened my car up for a pretty good price and loved watching these guys work. I'll definitely be back and always recommend Einstein's.

This restaurant is a "must try"! The food is outstanding and the service is hard to beat. Shea was the server who instantly made my wife and I feel so comfortable and appreciated, we were so impressed with her attentiveness and care. Last night was the first time we actually dined in the restaurant, we generally ordered out. W will go back again and again. The pasta was delicious, the  Caesar salad was the best restaurant salad I have had. Everything, to include the martini, was top shelf. The manager, 
Austin , stopped by for a nice chat and he was an excellent representative of the ownership and we could fell his professionalism. As one old commercial would tout " Try it you'll like(love) it.

The Gas station is extremely over priced. We got juul pods here and we're told they upped the price. we went to the other location and we're told that wasn't true! i don't understand but why would you go to this one when the others are all less expensive??

I only had the bloody mary and it gets 4 stars, I went for brunch and although I wish they had more options I was pleased with my drink. My husband tried the giant mimosa and it was delicious. My son had their breakfast and it was not earth shattering but we didn't go for the food, we went for the drinks.

Eryka is an incredible artist, love that she and her husband Dane both run the shop. Both as well have a great eye for creativity and more than willing to help build upon whichever idea you have. Great lines, shading and color, wish I could share an image on here but it's fantastic work.

We recently completed a remodel with Rendon Construction. We decided to do a major home improvement in one shot. The work consisted of all new windows (upstairs and downstairs), with multiple windows changing frame sizes, and adding two new windows. Gutting the kitchen and moving it to the opposite side, removing walls -to expand living area, new roof, guest bathroom and paining exterior of house, as well as many, many, electrical upgrades throughout the house. Since we had our 
work cut out for us, we did our research and narrowed it down to interviewing six contractors. We highly recommend for any home improvements, you need to shop around and be meticulous.... this includes interviewing contractors. From the six contractors, we narrowed it down to three. It is interesting to review the differences each brought to the table, along with pricing. Rendon Construction was not the 
least expensive, but Shawn listened during the two walk-thrus we did (during interview and collecting info to generate the bid), made suggestions and was not pushy. The other two had good backgrounds, 
but were late during interviews; no courtesy call, one too pushy and the other appeared very laid back and did not take any notes during the walk thru. Since the beginning, we were very pleased with Shawn. Very likable person, polite, and always communicated with us. We did go through rough patches, but all those were delays brought by the city, which had no reflection on Shawn or his work. His employees picked up after themselves, were on time and were courteous. If we were dissatisfied with the work, Shawn would take care of it immediately. There were occasions we thought things looked great, but when Shawn would do a walk-thru, he would catch something and have his employees correct it. It felt good knowing that he cared that much to correct finished work. Shawn visited frequently, called daily, and was open to receive calls at any time of the hour. When Shawn was not available to answer, he would return calls within the hour. With the many meticulous requests, Shawn never made us feel like we were a bother.  We are very satisfied with Rendon's work and highly recommend him to anyone. For sure we already have the next project in mind, and we know who we will be calling, Rendon Construction.

I'm not quite sure what to say. My daughter and I walked in and no one helped seat us so we took our own seat. A tall woman came to the computer kiosk at the bar to enter an order and she looked right at us and asked the bartender who we were. Both said have no clue. It took us 10 minutes to even have someone ask if we've been helped. I told the bartender, who finally came over that now all we'd like is a soda. Explained what happened and he apologized but whispered under his breath to the woman and they all looked at my daughter and I. So at this point the only positive thing I can say about this restaurant is that the Pinot Grigio was cold just like the service.

Homestead is a great place to go if you're looking for a good time. They serve bar-type food in extremely large portions and it is certainly not bad but not excellent either. It is near my house, so we go mostly out of convenience. The food is good, the energy is always good, the employees are always friendly and it's an all around fun place to eat. I would definitely recommend the Homestead.

They had delicious food. They had fast service, ran it right out to the car faster than we were told (25 minutes) for curbside pickup. The whiskey glazed salmon is the BEST. I highly recommend this! Plus, they gave us a free roll of TP in our bag, so that automatically deserves a 5 star recommendation!

SHERRI! 
Hands down the best experience I have  ever had eating out .  Extremely grateful for her presence on this earth . Not only was she spot on regarding her service , yet she was very kind and just very grateful. I have been a waitress for 6+ years and have never had a better time then tonight on a busy sunday evening the weekend before Valentine's Day   . We will  be seeing you often because of Sherri , and the amazingly prepared food from the cooks . Much love .

I went here for lunch with some coworkers and I will say that the food is pretty good. I ordered the 208 dog and really enjoyed it. The downside to this place is that it's pretty pricey. Most donuts are a minimum $3.50 each, with most running about $4-4.50 each. My coworker asked how much a dozen would cost, thinking there must be a discount for a dozen, and the girl working there stated a dozen donuts run about $40-$50. I don't know who would ever drop that kind of cash for some instagram looking brioche donuts, but I feel that if they're going to survive in Meridian, their prices will need to decrease. 

The decor in the restaurant is certainly also in line with instagram-worthy art, hip neon signs and graffiti, etc., but I will say the seating isn't super comfy. 

By the time I had decided to order a donut, the line was about 20 people long and I had resorted to just getting one another time. However, my coworkers had ordered some prior to eating and when we went to pick up, we figured we could just order one extra to pop into the box. We were prepared to pay in exact cash and everything, but the girl working there wouldn't make an exception and stated we would have to wait in the 20+ people line to get another donut. Poor customer service in my opinion, especially as we already had clearly dined and ordered donuts there. I understand there was a line, but it was only 1 donut. Luckily, I was able to have one of my coworkers' donuts, but still, the exchange had us leaving on a not so great note. 

Advice to diners: wait until the hype dies down. Perhaps their demand and prices will go down.

A gluten-free haven that is close to where I live....woohoo. I went here for lunch and have no idea why I waited so long. First off, the place is adorable. It's in the Fred Meyer strip mall so I had low expectations but the decor and atmosphere are really cute...like downtown cute.

I had the gluten free pizza and kale salad. The pizza was amazing. In fact, so good, I verified that it was actually gluten-free. Normally, when you order gluten free pizza it is pre-packaged and not great. This one was clearly made in house and amazing. The kale salad was also great with grilled stone fruit and soft kale (trust me you don't want your kale too crunchy). Can't wait to go back
Want a quality, well made meal to knock tour socks off? Well this is the place. They take the time to make your delicious. Thoughtful and delicious. Plus the outside dining patio is great!

Went on Friday night, busy but got a seat at the bar right away. Good selection of beers on tap, ordered a local IPA (recommendation from the bartender Tom) Excellent choice, so went on and took his recommendation for the prime rib special! Also an excellent choice! Homemade blue cheese dressing on the salad was the best ever! Fun place, everyone seemed to be having a fun time! I'll be back!
Food was good, service was great, but portions weren't enough. The location is very convenient for us.

The servers here are really great. Manager is a bit of a soiboi, but overall the front-of-house staff is very solid, still, as far as food goes, I have to ask; What is the appeal of this place? I've been a few times and am struck by how busy they consistently are. I thought I would check Yelp to see if there was some out-of-this-world menu item I didn't know about. Nope, apparently there is a class of people (broad in USA, very broad in more than one sense of the word, in fact) who actuly LIKE grease-covered tables, noise so loud your waitress can't even hear you to take your order, and food that is cooked so poorly, one wonders why it was even brought to its completion. I mean, we have all botched a dish in our lives, but at the Roadhouse, it's like, I have to ask, why did you bring this to its fruition even though it was botched so many times along the way? And I mean simple things, like french fries or grilled chicken breast. Everything is either raw or burnt, or both. Someday when an advanced civilization is gazing at the ruins of America, they will see the ramshackle marquee for Texas Roadhouse, sticking out of the ashes, and they will know that grim image embodies every single aspect of what poisoned our national character. For the love of God, people, it's worth paying an extra $2 to get MUCH better food across the street at GoodWoodBBQ. Honestly I don't like IHOP, but even they are much better than the Roadhouse, at least they can grill a damn chicken breast. What is the sense in saving $2 if you have to get dialyses and intestinal surgery later? Lastly, those rolls everyone talks about? They're garbage. Little tip about cold domestic beer that is also true about crap bread full of sugar, if it tastes like garbage at room temp, it is garbage. Go somewhere else. For the sake of our great nation, eat better food than this dreck.
Great service.....great food! Nice place to come and relax after a long day. A bit pricey but worth it!

I love Flatbread! You can always count on them for great good - I've never had a bad experience there. Be sure and take advantage of their happy hour specials, especially the pomegranate martini. It actually tasted like pomegranate rather than just straight vodka, like most. I always order the roasted chicken portobello sandwich     (Fontina, Caramelized Onion, Pesto Aioli, Fresh Basil, Fig Glaze)....the combination is amazing! Every now and again I will order a side of the macaroni and cheese (or opt for the lunch option (half sandwich and macaroni. It will probably end up killing you (cheese, carbs, grease), but you'll die happy! :) It's seriously so good! Try it out, you won't be let down! 

Their Ricotta-Stuffed Mushrooms also make a tasty appetizer!
Service was very good and the food was great! Ribs were tender, moist and flavorful. Melissa was very sweet and and helpful. Everybody was friendly and attentive! We will definitely be back!!!

I'll keep this one short and sweet. 

We waited 45 minutes for our food and when we got it it was cold. We never saw our waiter between when we got our sodas and when the food came 40 minutes later. When I asked to talk to a manager our waiter spent 90 seconds saying how busy he has been and trying to talk us out of talking to his manager. We got tired of it and gave up and asked for our check, then waited another 5 minutes to get it. It was the first time in my adult life that I did not leave a tip.

It was almost certainly a reflection on this particular server and not on the establishment because the food was pretty good for being cold and the portions were generous.
We come her frequently. Nate at the bar is the BEST ever. Great place for drinks. The music is perfect for the vibe.

My wife doesn't do many YELP reviews but she wanted to write to say how much she appreciates the owner's integrity, honesty, and professionalism as well as her great eye for style! She went above and beyond to find a solution with a piece of furniture even though it was not her responsibility to do so. We would recommend Inspired Living to anyone looking for great furniture and accessories with a kind, knowledgeable staff! My wife is a customer for life!
ニューアメリカンで、少し店内がうるさいですが、メリディアン・ビレッジ内でロケーションから良く接待で使います。予約した方が良いです。サンノゼ(サンタナロウ)にもあるチェーン店で、人気の店です。

These guys moved us into our new house in Boise during the worst of the January '17 snow! They figured out how to get an enormous Chesterfield leather sofa into the house when it wouldn't fit thru the front door (this entailed lifting it over a side gate and maneuvering it through a sliding glass door). They did an amazing job, I would definitely use them next time and I wholeheartedly recommend them to you if you need a mover!

Fantastic Orthodontics office. The staff and Dr. Kelson are so nice. My kids love going here. My kids want to keep their braces on, I think just so they can keep going to this office-strange right? 
Nice people! Nice cool office!
Makes beautiful smiles.

Great customer service and delicious donuts. Note, they're not cheap ($3-4/donut). But they are fancy and fun and definitely worth the splurge every once in a while. The owner obviously loves what he does and wants to ensure you experience is great. Can't wait to try some of the other things they have to offer. Their grilled cheese and truffle fries look amazing.
Great fast service at an affordable price. I will definitely be a returning customer.
Great place for lunch, or a casual dinner. Flatbreads are awesome, salads are really good as well. My favorite is the chicken arugula. Highly recommend.

One of my favorite go to places for lunch.  Their specials are always good as well as their steak salad!
For those of you that like beer...they have a huge tap selection that you don't always find at a smaller restaurant like this.

I'd say the food is good but for the price tag my younger brother shouldn't have gotten food poisoning and throwing up all night long; he ordered the Lobster Garlic Noodles). We had a great server but it took an hour from the time we ordered to get our food. Had my brother not gotten sick and our food didn't take forever to come out I would've gladly given five stars, but points definitely get docked for food poisoning and having to wait forever to get our food. Maybe we just came on and off night but for being out of town visitors I was not impressed.

Driving through Boise, I had to find a steak and one of their awsome potatoes. Luckily it was Wednesday, and I had the best $12 sirloin that I have ever had. The green beans were killer! Emma the bar server was excellent.

One of the best burgers places in the area. I highly recommend. They have a small menu, which is a huge plus. Easy to pick something and not too much that they suffer in quality. I typically get a cheeseburger or when I'm feeling extra a bacon cheeseburger. Just visited today and decided on a bacon cheeseburger. It was so good. The bun is always fresh, the toppings are always generous and fresh. The party is always tasty and cooked perfectly. The staff is always friendly. If you are in a hurry, this place is not for you, they put effort into their food, so it takes some time. I'm always happy to wait because it's so good.

Reviewer # 9. 

This Wendy's is consistent on their customer service and their food quality. 

Wendy's has good deals and value menu. I like the chili and baked potatoes. You can't find a good baked potato at other fast food chains, or chili for that matter.

Inside this location is one of the new Coke machines where you can make hundreds of combinations. This location is fast and friendly and I've never had a concern or complaint here.

This location makes you feel like you're at a fancier restaurant, and they have awesome happy hour promotions for drinks and food I love going to this place I frequent it all the time oh, the jambalaya is awesome and I always end up ordering the nachos because it's a large portion at a very good price especially what it's on happy hour price. I probably come here about once a month with my wife it's one of her favorite locations to eat and drink.

Ruined family and birthday dinner! Party of 13 and we called ahead an hour before our planned dinner time. When we arrived they gave us pager and told us approximately 15-25 minute wait time to be seated. Finally checked back in with them after 40 minutes of waiting. After an additional 5 minutes of waiting we were brought back to our location. I mentioned to the hostess that it was ridiculous that, with call ahead seating, we still had to wait an additional 45 minutes. She snapped back that she had no control over the floor. As we come to the location of our table I realize we are seated at two tables pushed together and a third table off to the side....wait....did we just wait that long to not even be able to sit together? At that point I felt like they had completely forgotten about us and threw us in whatever space they had available.

On Friday, I called Dowdy's kinda of last minute as I had to get a cooling system flush on my daughters car, before the weather changed.  I had a few recommendation's, but none of them were open on Saturday.  I explained my situation to Brandon on the phone, and he fit me in.  He said it would be done before closing.  They had to flush the system 5 times, to get the junk out.  It was bad.  This was above and beyond what I expected.  They gave me an thorough explanation of what to keep an eye on, and didn't try to upsell me anything  Not only that, with a full schedule, it was done 3 hours early, the cost came to what they quoted me on the phone, $100.00 + tax,  and I had found a $25.00 coupon.  A super clean shop too. Definitely an honest, upstanding shop, that I will return to, and highly recommend.
Great food, but noisy bar atmosphere....there is outside seating if you can tolerate the heat

Some friends recommended this place to us who live up here and it certainly didn't disappoint. Such creative coffee's and the dogs were outstanding. We split the B.A.T and the  Smoking Joe which both were outstanding. We also split the truffle fries that were enough for our family of four. I got a coconut cold brew which was delivered in a cool little drink bag. (Never seen anything like it), my wife got a brown butter latte and it passed her coffee snob taste test 100%.  We were blessed to top all that off with two monstrous donuts that were off the charts. Some of that had to come home with us, which just means added pleasure later tonight. I'd fully recommend this place to anyone. It won't disappoint.
WE LOVE KAHOOTZ! You can order anything on the menu and NEVER be disappointed. Giving 4 stars only because service can be hot and miss.
they were very rude to us and have very bad customer service. would give 0/5 if possible‍. i was pushing my mentally handicapped sister and they yelled at her, and BEN was racist and homophobic:(

Nickle n dime is what this place is about and should consider changing names to. My kids ordered chicken nuggets and asked for ranch. $2.50 for ranch for chicken nuggets. We've taken them out to eat hundreds of times and never been charged for dipping sauce for chicken nuggets/strips. Pathetic. Food is decent but this place takes the cake on up-charges. We won't be back.
Last Friday night there were six of dining in having fun our server's name was Lisa she was absolutely awesome she's the one that made it really fun we will be back

Terrible food.  My husband ordered a cheeseburger, medium but it came out medium well. He said it was over spiced and the tomatoes were not even ripe, green.  His meal was supposed to come with a pickle spear.  Nope. Oh, and the so called cheese was like Velveeta.  Gross.  Also,  everything was very salty.  I ordered the prime rib and was not impressed.  Full of fat and very bland.  The only thing we liked was the dinner rolls and the atmosphere.

Man oh man does this place SLAP!! I had the best waitress Maria. She straight took my order within a few seconds of my butt having a meeting with the booth seat. The wings was poppin that night too! She brought me extra napkins cause you know imma need them if the wings slappin. Long story short y'all need to give her a raise and a trip to Disney World. B-dubs y'all always hooking me up.

The negative reviews are unwarranted, or maybe it was an off day when they came. This place is OUTSTANDING! We were greeted by super friendly staff, and the menu was awesome. I had the handmade truffle pappardelle special and hubby had the crab topped ribeye. Everything was DELICIOUS! Everyone come and eat here!!

Gave Crave another shot...  Tried Elliot's.

We got the fish and chips and the shrimp tacos.  

Food arrived right on time as scheduled.

Both entrees were very good.   However, we both liked the fish and chips over the shrimp tacos.  --I absolutely loved the cole slaw that came with the fish and chips :-)  It was my favorite part of lunch.

This was a way better experience than we had with the Mexican Restaurant...

Dr. Whitt and his staff are the best! I have two children with major medical complications. Dr. Whitt has been so gentle and kind with my son who was adopted internationally and had a background of trauma. My sweet son was terrified at first, and now is so excited about going to the dentist. My other son is autistic and nonverbal. Dr. Whitt just spent 20 minutes gently playing with him to see his mouth. His office staff scheduled us first thing in the morning because he has an immune disorder (limiting his exposure) and did everything possible to accommodate us. My son's aide was with us to help and on the way out she said, "WOW. He is so nice." We couldn't ask for a kinder, more accommodating dentist.

I love this place.  Great deal and pizza is really good.  I did realize something, when it is busy, pizzas tend to be under cooked as I am sure there is limited oven space.  If busy, make sure to ask for your pizza to be well done.  I've been in there when it is slow and my pizza comes out crispy.  I've also been in there when it was busy and my pizza was soggy.  I have had more good experiences than bad but just something I have picked up on in the last 6 times I went.  Tip.  They will try and rush you through but if/when ordering a pizza with unlimited toppings, don't feel bad to ask them to put more cheese around the edges and more toppings, fyi.  Great place.

Tonight was my second time coming here and we walked in and were seated immediately. Adam the server was great! I ordered the Taco Salad with Carne Asada and it didn't disappoint!! It was loaded with cheese, sour cream, black beans, guacamole, and the Mexican cheese. I would highly recommend!! I also ordered the Chile mango margarita and it was delicious! Definitely will come back.

Krispy Kreme has always been my favorite, especially the glazed Kreme filled that they discontinued. Went to this location and ordered 1 chocolate glazed kreme filled. It was like eating a 5 day old donut from a truck stop in the middle of nowhere. I know what a fresh donut is like or even one that's a day old but this was ridiculously stale.
I was not impressed... the selection was very minimal when we went. The donut we did get tasted like yesterday's leftovers. Wouldn't go back.

The first time we ate at Pueblo Lindo I wasn't impressed.  Not that the experience was rotten or anything, just so-so.  Maybe because we were in a hurry.  However, we had opportunity to go trice this past holiday week and wow, what a difference.  Excellent menu, great service, and good food, be properly seasoned and served at proper temp.  Highly recommend you visit.

I've had the gluten free flatbread pizza here a couple times now and tried 3 different types. All were very very good. Not only is the taste great but you can tell the ingredients are of high quality. Staff is great as well. Highly recommended!

The menus and carpet aren't very appetizing but we gave it a try. 

The $9 yellowtail sashimi appetizer had bones/cartilage in it. The rolls tasted like cat food. The Katsu was soggy. We finished the tempura and went somewhere else to get dinner. 

The photo is what we left behind because it wasn't edible. I don't know what the pink stuff is - but it was supposed to be tuna. Definitely not tuna. It was gross, wont be back.

Amazing service, integrity, above and beyond. Prompt, attentive, highly knowledgeable. Josh even has donated many truck loads of wood chips for our outreach garden. Would not use anyone else! My dad was an arborist and although I do not know much, I can tell Josh and his crew know what they are doing. Highly credentialed also and 50+ positive reviews on Google.
Great service, great pizza. Reminded me of when I visited Italy, a true Italian pizza. Will eat here again & again when visiting family in Boise. Visiting from Tacoma, WA
Best French fries around. Chicken tenders are very good. Very, very good. Will be back. Great service.

I know it's a chain but I really like their food. Always consistent and delicious plus, though expensive, they have the best drinks and beer selection.  Plus, the night manager, Spring, is the nicest, most helpful person. Great staff and fun atmosphere. Can't go wrong with the Yard House at the Village

The food was yummy!! Lots of options!! Really fun and relaxed atmosphere!! The service was amazing!! Parker helped my friend and me out, and she was so nice and very knowledgeable about the menu!! We were first time customers and she welcomed us, explained the menu, and offered recommendations. She made genuine conversation and DID NOT treat us like another transaction. Definitely recommend!!

I had spoken to a man who didn't inform me they closed at 5pm. So when I went to get my sons very important medical device, I was I upset and worried we would just have to go to the E.R. for the night. I called the after hours and they could not have been more nice. They called me right away and sent someone to the store so I could meet them to pick it up. That was a huge relief and I won't forget how quick and understanding they were. Thank you Norco!

I know many people like this place.
Service was very good prices were a little high,
I had the jr NY.
Very small for $14 my wife had the pork chop ,it was very good,
My wife had tongue cancer and can NOT eat any thing spicy.
My rice was very spicy and the pork chop sauce and potatoes  were both spicy.
It did not mention any of that on the menu
We did enjoy the bread pudding that was very good.
We will probably not be back

One of my favorite sandwich places! The employees are really friendly every time I'm there. Their sandwich's are super good! I always get the Italian sub with some things taken off and they get it right every time. Overall a really nice place to get lunch or dinner and it quenches your hunger no problem. Highly recommend!

I write a lot of reviews of restaurants. Many of them are not very positive. Unfortunately, there are a lot of sub-standard restaurants, food and service around. 

This place is a definite exception to that. Mongo's is among the best restaurants that you will find here in the Treasure Valley. 

The staff is very friendly. I have been to a lot of places that were much more high priced and refined that were far less friendly and helpful than Mongo's.

I have yet to encounter any of their staff that was rude or even in not so great a mood. 

The food is...well what can I say. Its what you make it. If you have not been to a Mongolian grill before, you will find this to be a good experience. 

You take a bowl, go through several bars filled with meats, veggies, noodles, herbs, and of course sauces. You take as much, or as little, as you want. 

You are in complete control of what you want your meal to taste like. There are recipes that Mongo's gives you, but I have yet to try them. I always create my own. It might take you a few tries to get your own recipe just right. Mine includes Chicken, Pineapple, Fresh Cilantro, hot peppers, red onions, bell peppers, noodles, and a few other items.

You can make it hot or mild, spicy or more bland, meaty, or with nothing but veggies.

To my taste, the sauces are a little weak, so I use a lot of them. I probably add around 10 to 15 ladles of sauces. 

Mongo's grill is a stir fry like all Mongolian Grills. There is oil that you can use, if you want. But I like to keep mine healthy. 

I highly recommend Mongo's grill. Its fast, clean, healthy, and the staff is very friendly.

Went to buy doughnuts before work at 5:40AM and they were basically out of everything. Why are you even open wasting my time then? Then after going through half the menu to find a doughnut they actually have made I buy some... to get to work to see the smallest worst looking doughnuts I've ever seen in my life. Won't be going back.

We are from Portland and visit Flatbreads for lunch almost every time we are in Meridian.  Food is always great, but the service is exceptional!  We always have our grandson with us - lunching with kid in his "terrible" two's is truly a experience no waiter or waitress should ever have to go through, and for that I apologize.  But the staff was wonderful - replacing dropped silverware, supplying more (and more) napkins, plus bringing additional lemon wedges ( not sure how the kid ets the, or why)'and they did it with a mailer.  Thank you.Flatbreads!

This was the second time that the servers and bartenders had such a negative attitude, that we will not be returning.  The food isn't good enough to overcome the treatment we received last evening.  The bartender would not wait on my husband.  Gave them some water, and then proceeded to chit chat with some patrons at the end of the bar. He acted like it was an inconvenience to bring us some tap beers.  We were shown to our table and we asked to sit at a nearby table and the hostess got very huffy and threw the menus on the table.  We figured we were doomed and ended up leaving before ordering.  There are not too many employees that seem very happy with their jobs. Poor management? There are too many other restaurants nearby that have friendly staff and good customer service and good food.

The Nampa location is probably the worst as far as customer service goes. My friend was literally yelled at regarding their 'kickers' they put in their drinks - We had no idea what a kicker was. I called twice to complain and warn corporate about the behavior and haven't heard anything back. Don't go here, you'll be treated like garbage and then at the end of the dinner the server will have a completely different attitude.

Tried it out for the first time since I've been craving Chinese so much and I can't believe I've never been before it's so close and convenient from my house & the food was yummy! I ordered the spicy mandarin chicken with fried rice not spicy really but so delicious  I ate it so fast I forgot the picture! Prices are decent too not spendy at all and it's very good portions!!  I went with my dad,brother, hubby & 3 yr old and they all enjoyed their dinners also! There's only one gal and we went right at the rush but she handled everyone so well. Be prepared to wait a little bit but we'll worth it! It will be my go to now!
I know Texas Roadhouse has been around for years at this point but I'm still impressed each time I walk in. They have a unique atmosphere that makes me want to come back again and again and again.

It's such a hot day here and Boise, and I was looking for a nice ice cold beer, so my friends and decided to stop in here and try few of the 40 beers on tap. Upon arrival we looked past the disaster of a mess in the back of the grill  that would leave any health inspector cringing, and pushed forward to get a refreshing drink.  We were all three highly disappointed when all three received warm drinks. Still we held out hope for the rest of our food, but we were quickly let down yet again with a warm salad. To round out the trip it seemed as if the restaurant as a whole did not run cohesively. The service was slow despite being over staffed for the amount of people that were actually even dining in the establishment. I will say the To-go order of poppers we ordered were thoroughly enjoyed when we got home...too bad the rest of our experience was not as well received.
Great drinks but REALLY bad food service. Oh...and fyi- if you ask them where the food is after an hour and the bartenders girlfriend is at the bar she may threaten you...NOT A GOOD LOOK

Chilis holds fond family memories. However, must admit miss the complimentary chips and Salsa. We ordered two for only $25. 2 salads, 2 entrees included chicken-fajitas and BBQ Ribs with FF and coleslaw. And a dessert. Food was tasty and plentiful.

Wife and I came here last night and ate outside. Very nice atmosphere. Definitely a great place to chill. They seemed to have a nice drink selection but neither of us got anything. Though we will definitely be coming back to try. 
I was expecting more pasta but they had a very small selection. By small I mean 2 options. I even tried the kids menu but apparently I'm too old for that. :). I asked for the lasagna, the wife ordered an Alfredo the Grate. For the appetizers my wife ordered a cup of tomato basil soup and I got the prawns. I was later told that the lasagna was out... My pasta option down to 1. I settled with a meatball panini. 
Again just a chill night and great atmosphere made things easy. We got our appetizers relatively fast and they were amazing. The prawns were delicious but I was very impressed with the tomato basil. Wet my appetite for sure and I was more than ready for our food. The food took a little while though but I guess that should be expected with pizza. 
The food arrived and was presented very well. I was surprised at the size of the pizza since I've ordered a large pizza from here before. That pizza was amazingly delicious but the size was more than disappointing. This pizza was large enough for both my wife and I and equally delicious. My sandwich was great and I definitely recommend it but I wasn't feeling it.
Overall a great experience and will be coming back.

I am so happy that Fast Eddy's has finally opened up on Eagle & Ustick!!!   I've purchased a monthly pass for my car washes!  They are the best!   There was a small incident with the car behind me the first day going through.  One of the managers (I'm assuming) came out to me immediately after I parked at the vacuum area to apologize for the inconvenience as I was trapped inside for a few moments!  It was all good.  I could see there was an issue so I just waited until it cycled up again!  These guys really are the best!!!

If you want a really great hot dog, make sure you come here! They have so many different options for toppings, and you can do a plain hot dog kids meal. There are a few old picnic tables to eat there. You have to walk to one of the nearby stores to use a bathroom or throw your trash away, but I guess that's to be expected at a hot dog stand.

Donut shop fast same thing everey time all the normal and normal shit show buy doz and feel better i did maple bars and a fat doobie before you hit the drive through is a Oregon tradition if you been through Portland Oregon

My husband and I live locally and we were so excited when a place like this opened - great beer selection and pub food. We used to go frequently on Thursdays for tap takeover. A nice event - but otherwise our service and food would be inconsistent from visit to visit. Now, they are so busy you can't seem to get in the door on Thursdays after 4:30. We have gone back a few other visits - different days, different times and now I don't know that we will ever return after our most recent bad visit Friday afternoon. Service is very hit and miss - depending on who you get. The food is just as inconsistent and disappointing. It's loud, busy, and crowded. If you're looking for just beer and apps and a place to watch "the game", it's fine. Otherwise, for a great meal and great service - stick to other similar joints.

Looking for more/new Sushi options in the Meridian area and landed on this spot of course through Yelp reviews. The inside was nice, and the lady serving us was absolutely awesome, great service. We tried three rolls and three kinds of nigiri.  All were awesome, the best was the "Chef's special" roll. Their fatty tuna and fatty salmon were also delicious on the nigiri.

We will be back!

We really enjoyed our time at this place. Service was great in helping me decide and customize a pizza. Thing was, I forgot to get the Gluten Free version with all of my customization. I remembered about 10 min after I placed the order and asked if it was too late to change.... Nope! They gave me what I wanted. I love when you can ask for what you want and a restaurant does it!

Service was very good, even on a busy Saturday night!. Quaint, small town vibe, like a neighborhood business. Loved the open air design. 

Everyone seemed to like their order.  I have to agree with a few other reviews and say that the gluten free flat bread pizzas tasted amazing! It's got me looking online for recipes to make my own at home.

We ordered Cabernet to go with our meal. A bit more chilled than we like to have our reds, but we dealt with it. Just seemed odd.

I think we'll be visiting this place again. I hope soon!

I used to go to a chiropractor every 3 months. After visiting Dr Nathan Lane I haven't been back since he quoted me relief within 4-6 visits and I was done in five. Most chiropractors address your symptoms. Alliance focuses on soft tissue repair to correct the problem.
Pizza was excellent but really $8.00 for a very small glass of house wine and $5.00 for a kids root beer...rip off on beverage.

Came here a couple times to try out what the "rage" was about and the first time my family of 6 and I found multiple hairs in ALL of our dishes. Not only that but my family was served 15 minutes before me where I had to sit and watch them eat. The manager didn't seem to care at all and was just tendering to the people who were only buying drinks. NEVER RETURNING!! Worst service ever- don't bother take your service elsewhere.

First time Blaze Fast-Fire'd Pizza.customers...and this will be our last time.  We ordered four pizzas online.  A third party company delivered our pizzas.  Each of our pizzas were cold and our order was wrong.  I contacted the store manager "Jake" and explained the situation.  I could not have been more disappointed from his response.  The MGR attempted to redirect responsibility to the delivery driver.  When I asked for a refund he told me he had never performed a refund using a third party delivery company and it would take five to ten business days for processing.  Dissatisfied, do not recommend, and poor customer service.

My reception was better before they came and put in their antenna! Horrible customer service and crappy attitudes toward me when I told them there was a problem a month later. They assume you screwed around with their antenna (which we didn't touch) and said it would cost us $75 for a service call a month after installation. Worker told me when he arrived that he was going to disconnect our stuff from the tv and then if it got good reception he would collect $75 from me. In the end he couldn't fix it and back peddled about it being our fault....now we have horrible reception and are out $250 for the original installation!

They have the most terrible customer service I have EVER seen! I was in the drive-thru for 30 minutes for a chicken sandwich that only had 2 small chicken strips in it. I sat at their ordering sign for 6 minutes to begin with and nobody said anything or replied to me so I drove to the window. They are terrible and slow....I'm sure they are only in business because the food is fabulous....need new epmloyees!

I came to the salon the 8th of February with red/brown coloring in my hair. I was assured that a blonde highlights over brunette low lights would be easy to do. I was looking for 70% blonde and I wanted a trim on the ends. I ended up with maybe 15% blondish and the worst trim/cut. I went to another salon this week to see if I could get the layers she cut evened out so they didn't look stringy and I was informed that my hair had been thinned out and that the thinning had put shorter layers under the long stringy layers right in the middle of my hair and that I'd have to cut 6" off my hair to even it out. It was already cut about that much at Oliver's so it would put my hair above shoulder length. Although the gal was super fun and nice I am super unhappy with my hair.
This place has really good thin pizza. The only reason I knocked a star off was because the crust had a lot of charcoal. Like a lot..

Very good. Love brick oven style pizza. Not mine & my husbands was cooked perfectly. Love the various pizza options & the drink choices Only complain I have is this one & the one back I need South Bend, IN - not enough seating.

I normally don't write reviews but I had to on this one. One word to describe this place; DISGUSTING! It was honestly gross. 

Trust me, skip it. It won't be there much longer anyway.

Food wasn't bad. I had the Thai Noodles. They came in a spicy peanut sauce that was pretty tasty. The good was average, the price was excellent. Unfortunately I couldn't quite get the restaurant's style. Half their menu items are Italian, the other half is Asian...
It's hard to be good at either of these styles and when u try to serve both in the same restaurant, the result is often poor. To the restaurants credit, the food wasn't bad, it just wasn't that good. It's probably worth a trip to make up your own mind.

I love Flatbread and frequently bring out of town guests here. Unfortunately, service at this location is lackluster. I'd recommend going to another Flatbread location if you don't want your drink sitting empty for your entire meal while the waitstaff sits at the bar and chit chats.

My husband and I had an early (5:15) dinner there last night. We were given dirty glasses, pointed this out to first sever. Then I had to ask for a clean plate for the pizza, brown stuff was on the plate :( There's a lack of continuity in service. One person took our order, brought our drinks/salads. Another brought the pizza. If they had one server they could have offered a discount, comped something, having seen this twice. Food was good, but dirty dishes pretty well KILLED the experience. There's ZERO reason why servers shouldn't check this first and kitchen staff/plumbing should be addresssed. It was slow there. I talked to the very young-looking Manager on the way out and he offered no comp, gift certificates, etc. We won't be back. This has happened there before and we gave it another shot. Not again.

It's to hot to cook in the house, so off to try a new place, Homestead Bar and Grill.  Short review, service was very friendly, food was ok, but details and cleanliness were what was lacking.

We were greeted upon entering and told to find a seat anywhere.  As others have pointed out, the tables are very close together.  They have a small space and are making the most of it.  It was not terribly busy, but it took some searching to find a clean table.  Perhaps we'd just missed a rush, but most of the tables hadn't been wiped down and the floor was scattered with stuff from hastily wiped tables from earlier in the day.

We sat down and our server came up to the table and presented menus.  They were smeared from dirty fingers and mine had dried ketchup or some type of sauce on it.  The waiter was very polite and friendly but seemed a little distracted and when we asked about some of the beer selections, he wasn't certain what they were.  He did bring samples of a couple of things, which was good, because the descriptions on the pad presented (dirty pad) didn't really help to figure out which of the 40 beers on tap to try.  We figured out what we'd like and gave our dinner order.

The service was slow.  It took a while to get both beers and the food took even longer.  The food was mixed.  The burger was a large patty cooked to a medium-well.  There was just a very small squirt of mayonnaise on it.   Ketchup was on the table.  There was a generous portion of fries included and my husband was not able to finish everything.  My salad was okay.  Chopped greens with a generous amount of cheese, but the dressing was oily and not pleasant.  I'm glad it was on the side because I only had a couple of bites with it.

When I went to the restroom, there were no towels in the dispenser, so I had to wipe my hands on toilet paper.  

We may try it again.  I would hope to see it cleaner than it was.  Given there were 5 people on the floor and only about 10 tables filled, you would think they could attend to cleaning menus and items that customers handle, checking the floor, doing a better job of wiping tables (and not just hurriedly swiping stuff on the floor with a damp cloth), attending to the bathroom, and just giving the place a once over.

My family and I do pizza night every Friday and have enjoyed trying out the different pizza places in and around Meridian. I just discovered that I am allergic to dairy so I was on the hunt for a pizza place that had vegan options for cheese and found Blaze Pizza. It was pretty good the first two times, not spectacular but not bad. My kids loved the fact that they each had their own pizza. The toppings are pretty minimal though so that was a con. The reason for my three star review is our latest experience with them tonight. I ordered curbside online and had my husband pick it up. He tried calling for almost 20 minutes and their phone was busy the whole time (he was trying to avoid dragging our son in with him since he couldn't leave him in the car). By the time he went in and then waited for the pizzas inside they were cold. 

It's frustrating because this is one of the only pizza places I can eat at. At this point I'm thinking I'm better off snagging a dairy free pizza at the store and letting my husband and kids go to one of other amazing places we have found.

I am a HUGE bbq fan - I moved to Boise 13yrs ago from the suburbs of Atlanta, so I am always looking for new BBQ restaurants to try. Some have been really good and some not so good. I have heard good things about R&R (when they were in SLC) so I was excited that we were getting our own location.  

I visited today (12/3/20) at exactly noon. The main dining room was quite full but the room by the hand washing station was empty and I was extremely grateful! My mom and I both had the sliced brisket sandwich with coleslaw on top (an extra charge!) I opted for hush puppies as a side (a delicacy I haven't had since moving here) and my mom got the mac and cheese. The cashier was successful in upselling a banana pudding that we shared. (It was ok but nothing special at all) I redeemed my "welcome reward" of 6 wings that you get for downloading the app. (A $7+ value) I had a choice of sauce and I asked for Buffalo.

Our food came out quickly ... almost too quickly. The person dropped it off and then went to get us utensils. But I also asked for the bbq sauce that was supposed to come on the side.  How can they forget the bbq sauce? Maybe that was a sign. While she was gone I took a bite of the hush puppy. I just couldn't wait! My excitement turned to disappointment! It was cold and extremely dense. It definitely was not made to order ... instead it tasted like it was sitting under a heat lamp for HOURS and it was only 12pm! When the lady came back with our sauce I explained that my hush puppies were cold and she brought me new ones. She claimed these seemed "much better" but I really did not notice a difference at all!! It was a LITTLE warmer but it was so HEAVY!  I felt defeated and didn't see the point in having to get up and ask for another new order, so I let it slide. But seriously, why are hush puppies even on the menu if they are going to be so blatantly disrespected like that?

The wings were terrible. Really bad!  I was expecting Buffalo but  it was like no Buffalo I have ever tasted. - My guess was I got the wrong order.  Buffalo sauce is orange. It is a mixture of hot sauce and butter. These wings tasted like pepper and vinegar and ... It DEFINITELY was not Buffalo. It was just terrible (and so salty! The kind of salty you only taste on bad quality food.). If I had actually paid $7 for them I would have been LIVID (especially after the hush puppy fiasco)

Now to the sandwich. The brisket was pretty good. Nice and meaty - a little too much fat for a sandwich (and maybe a tad too salty - again with the salt!),  but it is brisket. It is almost impossible to ruin brisket. The coleslaw was worth the extra charge (even though it should just come with it! That is how you are supposed to eat a brisket sandwich.)  The bun was too soft though! It was not holding up to the meat, coleslaw  and sauce and it really should have been at least lightly toasted.  The whole idea of a sandwich is to make it easier to eat ... it defeats the purpose if your bread doesn't hold up. Who wants a sandwich that is falling apart?

Here is where I am really not happy. My mom and I were eating and we both had food in our mouths and  the manager (?) pops up completely out of nowhere and asks how our food is.  Now I was trying to indicate that I had food in my mouth and couldn't talk right at that second (and I was rushing to swallow so I could talk to him) but I guess we made some grunting noises or something that he interpreted as "good" so he said "glad to hear it" and started walking away.  He was only there for like a second!! As he was walking away I was finally able to swallow, so I said in a voice that I KNOW was laud enough for him to hear me, "I never got a chance to answer!"  He just kept walking.
I HATE when customer service is just for show. If he wasn't on auto pilot and he actually cared how my lunch was 1. He would have realized I was trying not to talk with my mouth full 2. Given me more than 1 second and 3. Heard me when I said that I didn't get a chance to answer him.  

It is now 7:30 and I still have that lingering taste of disappointment ... and salt! (LOTS OF SALT! I have been drinking water by the gallon.)  - I usually like to give restaurants a second chance but I just don't know about this one.  Money is really tight these days and When I spend money it should be a treat. I just don't think it is a good gamble.

If you looking for some great Mexican food and a cold beer in Meridian..look no further!
I will first mention that I have been a fan of Pueblo Lindo since 2011 when we would visit their McCall location. Back then it was a great little secret. Now.....it is a very popular place and for good reason. I mention this because I am going to guess that Meridian area locals will learn about the great food and great service at this location and turn this spot into a hot spot for great food!
Let's talk food. You always get a big basket of chips, salsa, and a bowl of cabbage goodness when you are seated. The salsa is very tasty and the chips are always warm. 
I ordered 3 tacos (El Carbon, Carnitas, Pastor) with rice and beans. All three tacos arrived in tender corn tortillas with plenty of flavorful meat.The wife ordered the fajitas veggie burrito. A warning...the burrito is huge. The veggies were cooked with lots of flavor and still had a bite to them.
Here is a tip....ask for the salsas. They have 4 ridiculously tasty salsas that you must request. Salsa roja, verde, jalapeno,  and habanero. All 4 salsas are crazy good. You must put these salsas on everything to take the food to the next level.
I highly recommend this place!
Cheers Always!

We were here in Meridian visiting family.  Ordered over the phone and picked it up. Slight problem with the order.  Props to Malcolm for his solution.  Details not needed, but next time in town, we will be visiting Jakers for sure.  Not just the service, but food was great.  Thanks Malcolm and staff!
Hot spot trio and garden veggie benny were delicious!  Service was fast and attentive. Food came out quickly and was fresh and hot. I will be back and I highly recommend.

Right when we walked in the door, the first thing we noticed was the smell, which was like a rest stop bathroom. The store was filthy, garbage on the beverage station, ketchup smeared on the floor that looked like it had been there for a while. The boy who took my order made little to no eye contact with me, he seemed like he would rather have been anywhere but there. It's not like they were terribly busy; the drive thru girl's cell phone ringtone was loud enough to make out the PG-13 R&B lyrics blaring from it while waiting for my food, so she proceeds to lean against the counter and stand there texting as I get my food to go sit down. My son and I walked into the play area, and the stench about bowled me over - like a mixture of sweat and feces mixed with French fries. I almost feel like I need a tetanus shot after leaving there. I can assure you I have no reason to come back.
I love this place! It's not expensive and the workers are super friendly. He's always looked great every time I pick him up from there.
