More staff than customers and yet their sercive sucks our waitress talked about fishing when we have not even ordered our meal...and there are 5 "waiters" standing at the bar... not sure why they have any stars

We were anxious to visit this new bar/grill. There's not much out in this part of town so we were hoping it was good. It is OK. Not great.

Big selection of beer that scrolls down a flatscreen TV. Nothing in writing, so you have to sit there and wait for her to scroll through several times to make your selection.

We came on a Tuesday evening and the place was half full and they had lots of staff, but poor service.

The ambience is good with over a dozen big flatscreen TVs. Not sure will be back anytime soon.

As first time home buyers, we had a lot of questions and weren't super educated about the process. Mike was so patient and gracious through the whole process. We never felt dumb or intimidated, he clearly explained everything to us and was always quick to answer our questions and help us understand new developments. Can not express our gratitude enough!

*1st time (month or two ago) I had a couple standard spicy bloody Mary's. My husband has the Breakfast Beer Cocktail which was so good! It had huckleberry vodka, colors light, and OJ. You have to try it!! There must not be a standard recipe for a Bloody Mary since the second bartender was far better!  
*2nd visit on 03/17/17 - Celebrated St. Patrick's day with their special of fresh corned beef and cabbage (husband devoured), I had a Reuben from the usual menu, and Irish beer specials. OMG! 
*the beef and cabbage was so good, perfectly cooked and totally could be a regular in their menu! Wasn't sure of the chips, assuming the most of them were to soak up those delicious juices. 
*The Reuben from the regular menu was by far the BEST I have had in the Boise area. Nothing could beat Jason's Deli (chain) Reuben, but this certainly tied or is in 1st! There was a lot of meat, portioned sauce and sauerkraut, and bread was crispy and had great flavor. The fries were equally as amazing! Crispy and not greasy...magic perhaps?? I would totally grab a plate of fries and a beer or two when in the mood. 
*We will be returning, and not just for drinks!!!

Love this place. Great food, great service and atmosphere.  Highly recommend you try the bacon wrapped shrimp. The pizza was delicious. And what ever you do, save room for dessert. I had the Tiramisu and the pudding, I recommend both.

Wow, where do I start with Blaze Pizza?

What I will say is that the price is reasonable and the pizza comes out fast. Turbo microwave - speed of light, superhero "Flash" fast. Except there is nothing superheroesk about this pizza.

The old saying is that you get what you pay for. If you want food that comes out super duper fast, and is marginal at best, this is your place.

You can either go into the restaurant or order on line. But wait a minute. They dont deliver, (At least not yet) so whats up with ordering online, you might be asking.

I had the same question and I still do. The only point that I can see to ordering on line is you get to skip the line at the restaurant.

After placing the order online, the web site tells you when to get to the restaurant. Once you get to Blaze, they start cooking your pizza.

Seems to me though, after going into Blaze, is that the problem is that if the restaurant is crowded, you might still have to wait in line at the register which could well cause a bottleneck.

It took them 3 minutes to cook my pizza. 3 Minutes!!!!

When my pizza was ready, I saw why it cooked so quickly. The dough is almost paper thin. I have never, in my life of eating pizzas, encountered such a thin crust. The thinner the crust, the faster the pizza cooks. 

I ordered the "White Top" pizza. It comes with white cream sauce with mozzarella, applewood bacon, chopped garlic, oregano, and when its done, they put some arugula on the top.

If you are a meat lover, do yourself a favor and put more ingredients on this pizza, if you order it. When I got mine, there was just a few groups of bacon here and there on my pizza. The bacon seemed to be huddling together like they were keeping out of the cold.

The problem I see here with extra toppings is that the crust is very thin. I dont think this thin crust will hold up to very many toppings. Especially if the toppings are greasy like Pepperoni and sausage. 

What I think you will wind up with, if you add these ingredients, is a soggy mess that you will have to eat with a fork. The crust is not going to be able to support the weight of very many toppings, not to speak of the grease.

With other normal pizzas, the dough acts like a sponge that soaks up the grease from greasy ingredients like Pepperoni and sausage. This crust here is so thin, it is barely is able to support its own weight.

I tipped a pizza slice on its side and grease dripped from it like orange goo from Star Wars. 

"Icky Icky Goo"
Jar Jar Binks 

The other odd thing about Blaze is that its one size fits all. If you want a personal sized pizza, small, medium or large, you wont find these here, They have only one size, which Im sure is done to speed things up and insure higher profits. Only offering 1 size, means less labor, less time making dough, and fewer errors.

My wife had a salad, which is no where near fresh. The salads are pre-packaged. The one my wife got looked like it had been sitting around for a good while. I have seen better pre-packaged salads at McDonalds.

Everything here looks like it was done with one thing in mind. Cost savings to promote higher profit margins. Right down to the odd looking little plastic stools, with no padding at all, that you have to sit on. 

My butt hurt just looking at them!

The next thing I found weird was the Men's room. Now Im guessing that you will find the same thing in the Women's room, but I cant go in there since..well Im a guy. 

I needed some toilet paper in the restroom. I expected, like every other restroom I have been to, to simply roll out how much Toilet Paper I needed from the roll. 

Guess what? 

Here at Blaze, its not that simple. They have installed some sort of stopping mechanism on their Toilet Paper holder that prevents you taking more than just a few squares of Toilet Paper. 

(My guess is that this is another cost savings thing the owners of Blaze have put in place to save money. But Come On Blaze, its Toilet paper. Its not that expensive)

Now, maybe its just me, but 2 squares of Toilet Paper is just not enough for...well you know. I spent a lot of time in the bathroom just trying to get enough Toilet Paper off the roll to do the job. I was not amused. 

If you like good pizza, my suggestion would be to go to Grimaldis in the Village. Its 2000% better than what you will find here. Grimaldis is more expensive, and no where near as fast, but as I mentioned at the beginning, you get what you pay for.

Since when did our lives speed up so much that we have come to love substandard food that comes out super duper fast? 

Do yourself a favor. Slow down, eat some better food with less grease and live to see another day.

My fiancé and I love finding new breakfast and brunch places; we love finding places open on a Sunday morning. 

This place is honestly what we expected. Fast, generous and their food was delicious. They definitely made us feel welcomed. My fiancé ordered the special of the day which was absolutely amazing. It was a Bacon Cinnamon Roll but it literally tastes like a funnel cake (for those funnel cake lovers.... YOU NEED TO TRY THIS!) We will definitely come back soon. 

Also, our server was such a sweet heart and would check on us and would refill our drinks once she noticed. Very attentive.

Their pizza is surprisingly amazing. They went the extra mile to deliver me deliciousness, and I appreciate it wholeheartedly. Desserts are OK, too, some of there stuff is alright, but the PIZZA!!! YUM!!!!

Yum. That's all. Had the junior New York strip. It was perfectly seasoned, perfectly cooked, the perfect size. Got a free mud pie dessert for my birthday. Child number two loved her grilled cheese. Child number one was ecstatic about the big cheeseburger. Everything was perfect.

Stopped in for Boise Supper Club here and they did an AMAZING job taking care of us.  Customer service was excellent!!!  We had a large party and our drinks never went dry, we had our food quickly, a knowledgeable server who was both funny, and attentive to everyone's needs.  Food was hot and tasted delicious.  They really did an excellent job taking care of our group. 

For dinner i had the nachos as an appetizer, fish and chips for dinner, and the beignets for dessert.  

Food was excellent, service was excellent, and we all had a really great experience.  

Support local and come to Homestead for your next meal!

I've eaten here several times since it opened. The food is flavorless and overpriced. At first I thought it might be because they were new but it has stayed consistently bad. 

On my last trip my 10 year old daughter ordered fish and chips. She ate two bites and said "this is disgusting, it tastes like rubber covered in undercooked dough." I tried a bite and her description couldn't have been more accurate.

My other trips have involved sending my food back to get the order right and dishes that are devoid of any real flavor.

I might go back for a beer but I'd never order food there again.

Go next door to twigs or even the movie theatre restaurant if you want to eat.

Good old fashion burger 
Love the service right at car window 
Very friendly and fast

This restaurant is short on ambience but definitely serves up delicious food in generous portions.  
My friend and I went after church on Sunday and didn't have any trouble getting in, though it did get busier by the time we left around 2pm.
We ordered an appetizer each, Spring Rolls and Crab Pops. Then my friend stayed on the appetizer menu for Chicken Lettuce Wraps and I  ordered Sweet and Sour Pork plate.
With our sodas the bill came to  $40, kind of pricey for lunch, but we both have brought home leftovers, and I'm sure I will have at least 2 more meals of the S&S Pork.
We will definitely go back, as well as recommend it to other neighbors in our Adult Living complex.

We recently ordered chilis to be delivered for a meeting and I was pleasantly surprised that the food was hot, fresh, and delicious!  I had the Cajun chicken pasta with chicken enchilada soup. The portions were generous and it was well packaged for transport. Of course they have my favorite ever chips and salsa!  This is a wonderful option for takeout or delivery and I ordered from the Broadway store.

So disappointed! Used to love Noodles and Company's potstickers.... ordered some today and they don't resemble potstickers at all! Tasted bad and looked like burnt pancakes. Not sure if they changed where they got them or if we got some really bad cooks. Bummer!

I've been to this location a few times.. it seems like it's lacking something. I had takeout, last experience, came back home, and within 5 minutes - my food was cold and the boneless wings were chewy. First bad experience was during the Super Bowl and literally the same thing happened. I had to reheat them in my microwave(same day/hour). I've eaten inside the restaurant and the wings were tough. Something should change with quality, at this location, because this is one of the BDub's that I'll continually say 'ehhhh, (I love wings BUT) it's been 'below average' the last few times.. the 2 stars is for the service; it never seems to be lacking.

Had to ask for water 3 times,  and ranch dressing twice. The fried chicken sandwich  tasted and looked like it had been preprepared ahead of time  and microwaved. Could not eat undisturbed due to the flies that consistently pestered us at the table ( we were inside). Wont return.

Went to this place and ordered

When the order was received the meat was raw.  Took it back to the window and explained the situation.  The person that was probably the manager simply turned and walked away

The manager should have handled this and left the sales employee hung out to dry.  The manager should have also delivered the replacement product out to me

Bad management displayed

Hard to dine-in with an hour long wait if you have children. Won't honor specials for carry out either because people then have to wait longer for food...? For a chain as big as BWW and being one of the very few who make wings in the area they seem ill prepared to service anyone. Buy more fryers for this location, just throwing away money.

I have no words to describe how amazing our dinner was tonight. It was our first time trying this restaurant to celebrate my son's birthday. 

We were greeted and seated immediately and our servers were incredibly attentive for the duration of our meal. 

The complimentary chips and salsa were delicious as was the Pueblo Lindo Enchilada and the Chicken a la Crema. The margaritas are massive and very flavorful. Can't wait to come back with my husband for date night!
Outside patio seating is very nice and beautiful! The prime rib was cold though. Service was good too! Staff was nice!

This place is my favorite go to for salad. The deconstructed salad is the bomb. Honey loves anyone of there pizza's. Wow just writing this review and made up my mind I am going here for dinner tonight.

In the past when I have dealt with mortgage providers it seemed they were keeping costs a secret till the day of closing and I was just expected to come up with a couple thousand dollars on the day of closing. Also, it was hard to get them to nail down a time for approvals, closing, etc. I am impressed how upfront Jason and Tara were regarding disclosing costs and sticking to the schedule they provided. They set realistic expectations for us throughout the process.

Great beer, great food and great people! Highly reccomend if you're here in Meridian. We watched the 49er game here and TVs everywhere. Their duck carbonara special was sooo creamy and delicious. Steak perfectly cooked and great service.
Very disappointed.  Finger Steaks, Fish Tacos and Chicken Tenders were all heavily fried and just not good.  One sone ordered the Turkey Club and said it was great.  J

Where do I begin. Our order was pretty easy. A large Maui Pizza, cheese bread and some chicken dippers. It took over an hour for delivery and then the food is cold. The dough was like eating play doh. Wow. You want your business to go under in a time like this you are doing a great job. Won't order from here again.

Food is good, nice selection of drinks and tequila but the snarky and condescending waitresses make this place somewhere to avoid when they make you feel like a inconvenience to them with eye rolls and condescending statements...manager included.

If I could give more than 5 stars, I WOULD!! This is my first time at this restaurant as I wanted to try out their gluten-free bread. Not many places offer that option. I ordered a sandwich and walked out to my car. After finding a place to park and eat, I opened the box. The wonderful aroma was driving me into a ravenous frenzy. I picked up the sandwich and quickly noticed that this was not like other gluten-free breads that often chew like shoe leather.With my first bite I could tell that this bread was different! So soft, so tasty, it was like an actual homemade roll! I had to force myself to eat slowly so that I could enjoy every mouthful, even though my stomach wanted me to gobble it all down!! I was in gluten-free sub heaven! This is now my favorite sub sandwich place! 

AND....I want to say thank you to them for not forcing the "MASK" issue. I am unable to wear one, but they made me feel like a valued customer, and for that I am now a repeat customer FOR LIFE!! I will recommend them to everyone I meet. If you're looking for an EPIC sub sandwich, then look no further than the Firehouse Sub shop on N. Eagle Rd in Meridian. 

P.S. Did I mention that they will round your purchase up (with your permission, of course) to the next full amount and donate that amount to First Responders? Well, they DO! And they have a rewards program for their customers, too!

This was hands down the best delivery and/or takeout we have had this whole pandemic! Food arrived hot, never happens!! The food quality made it actually feel like we were at a really nice restaurant but I didn't even have to shower! I feel like this place is going to settle a lot of "I don't know what sounds good to you for dinner?" conversations because he can get his BBQ or Asian food and I can get my sliders, salad, or sandwich! 

Our family ordered the Hot Chicken Sliders from RHS, Little Dragon Dumplings and Panang Rice Noodles from Betelnut, Rings of Fire from Wing Dome and cookies from Merite. The dumplings and sliders were a favorite. 

Did I mention this was the best tasting takeout we have had in 10 months!! So many hugs!
Signed up for yelp to share my distain for the customer service of this store. I would advise anyone to go elsewhere.

We love, love, love Inspired Living Collection!!!
We have known and worked with Inspired Living Collection for on projects for over 30 years. Everyone there is always so friendly, knowledgeable, talented and always a delight to work with. If you have never heard of or been to an Inspired Living Collection store you have been missing out. I would recommend everyone to stop by and say hello you'll be glad you did!!!
This is my dog's favorite spot! She has so much fun and she loves the water buckets (she loves to get messy!)

Went in again today to celebrate my sons birthday and again received great service. Parker remembered me and asked about my family and even remembered what I'd ordered the last time I was in (mimosa flight - of which my favorite is the hibiscus mimosa). She was super sweet even when I was frazzled and we were served great food once again. 

This time we had the truffle fries, the grilled cheese & soup, and the hangover. All of which were delicious, but our favorite was the grilled cheese & fries!

Wonderful food and service.   My new favorite fir good Mexican food.  We had a party of 6 and food was fast hot and great.  Everyone loved the food and each had something different.  Great experience.
This was so loud that I turned off my hearing aids.  The wait staff was very helpful.   I had the cheeseburger, which was awesome.   Parking is very difficult to find.

I've been going to Meridian Meats and Sausage for a few years now. Their pepperoni is the best in the valley and, quite frankly, the best I've ever had.

I usually buy a few pounds and then vacuum seal it at home to maintain the freshness. Otherwise, it'll dry out after a few days.

The owners are very friendly and the place is always kept clean. Just be aware that they don't accept credit cards. So, come prepared.

Definitely give them a try!

Went here today. Did not have a good experience. Extremely slow service stressed me out due to my baby being very hungry and having to wait for soup which we asked to be brought out early. Then it ends up being way too spicy for a 1 year old...just slow slow service and zero attention to details.

This place is just amazing! The staff is on top of everything and the nicest and most attentive I've seen! They were very quick with the food and it was just delicious. I 100% recommend this place. Their soups are fantastic and the appetizers are filling and so good. Probably my new favorite Chinese restaurant.

Me and my fiancé ate there Saturday night. I ordered a steak south of the border burrito . The burrito was 99 percent filled with rice and beans. Very little meat. I was definitely disappointed ! I basically had a overpriced rice and bean burrito .  ! My fiancé meal wasn't very good either. When I spend $40 plus on food and drinks I expect everything  to be good . Total waste of money !  Never going back !

Excellent sushi and sake was hit and delicious! The service was fast and there was no waiting to get a seat. Great place to grab sushi or have some hibachi. Presentation of the sushi rolls was professional and top notch!
Love this place!  Worth the wait.  The food was amazing, the server was awesome and the place is warm and fun!  My favorite place in the Boise area!!

We love this spot!  It's got all of the great things that the other Flatbread restaurants do, but because they moved into this location that had a bigger kitchen thanks to the previous occupant, they've got an even bigger menu!  My favorite addition is their fried calamari & cauliflower appetizer.  It's absolutely delicious -- and the three dipping sauces are terrific.  We like mixing them on our plates and experimenting.

They pride themselves on having a certification from Italy, and they serve thin Neapolitan pizzas. They are so good!  All of the ingredients are fresh.  Probably my favorite pizzas in the valley. I like the (Heirloom) Tomato Margherita, dad likes Alfredo the Grate, and hubby prefers the Pepperoni, Sausage & Portobello (although on our last visit, they were out of sausage).  I look forward to summertime when they add heirloom tomatoes as an option. Speaking of summertime, they've just added a fun patio for those who like to eat outdoors.  

At lunchtime, we enjoy their Pick Two. You get to choose a pizzetta and a soup, or two pizzettas, salad and half sandwich, etc. Great value.  Tuesdays, all pizzas are $10.  Bargain!  And Happy Hour specials are great, too.  Sign up for their Frequent Fire card, because it makes eating here an even better deal.

My family and I will make lots more visits to this location.  And one of the future visits will include the Bisteca Pappardelle, which sounds amazing, but I haven't tried it yet.

Fresh food, naturally rich flavors, great service.
While this food is not what I'm typically accustomed to it's terrific in its own way.
My favorite dish now are the lettuce wraps with a wonderfully glazed chicken with diced bell peppers, onions, and carrots. So delicious. It's got a sweet salty savory balance on fresh crisp lettuce. Also, the fried rice is fabulous. It's got just a hint of smoky grilled flavor that I love. Everything is diced to the right proportion's. The hot and sour soup is probably the best I've had yet. It's just spicy enough to balance the salty and smidge of sweetness.
The owners are wonderful people that always come out to greet you.
The only downside I would say, because there has to be at least one, is that the decor at the moment while they're building their business is a bit plain. But, it's simple and probably very easy to clean which is great for a restaurant owner.
It's worth the extra five minute drive from my house to pass up all of the other Chinese restaurants.
I have an endless amount of positive things to say about Hannah Ivens but I'll let the photo of my beautiful cut + color speak for itself! She's amazing and you need her in your life
Love the burgers but the fries are even better! When I need a burger this is the place to go.
Delicious. Unpretentious simple burger. Bacon cheeseburger and fries. Classic burger bar. Go get one then go back and get another.

What a wonderful find!  I love this place.

We have been to this restaurant two times now, and both times have really enjoyed the food.  The first time we came here was to just get something (anything) to eat after helping my son move into his new house not far from here.  That evening we were welcomed by one of the most friendly hostess/waitresses I have ever met, and things only got better from there.  That night I enjoyed the Kung Pau Chicken, which is my "stand-by" thing to order when I try a Chinese restaurant for the first time.

Last night my wife and I returned to Wok Fusion for our traditional "Mid-Week-I-Don't-Feel-Like-Cooking-Night-Out", and I enjoyed the food even more.  Again, the greetings and service of the same hostess/waitress were friendly and happy, and she provided wonderful service for us.  We started off with an order of Pot Stickers.  Well, I'm kind of like the Will Rogers for Pot Stickers, in that I never met one that I didn't like.  Truth be told, however, is that not all Pot Stickers are created equally, and some are better than others.  I have to tell you that the Pot Stickers we had at Wok Fusion were among the best I have encountered.  They were crispy on the outside, and the dough was thin and cooked perfectly (not thick and doughy).  But the magic part was the meat inside.  It was seasoned wonderfully, and I really enjoyed them.

Dinner for us was Curry Chicken (for me) and Szechwan Chicken (for my wife), both with fried rice.  The veggies for these dishes were fresh and crispy, and both entries were cooked and seasoned nicely.  The servings were enough to fill us both and give me enough for a left-over lunch today.  How can you not love this place!

We will return!

--------------------

I tried to dry the dishes before they were washed.
Everything was out of sink.

Unfortunately my husband and I decided to come the evening of National Donut Day so, quite understandably, they were completely sold out of donuts. I'm still giving a four star rating because of the circumstances surrounding the day and the popularity of the restaurant.

Even though we couldn't try a donut, we went ahead and ordered a dog. The flying hawaiian, with pineapple chunks, applewood smoked bacon pieces on a brioche bun, was delicious with every bite. The hot dog itself was very high quality, which I appreciate considering it was nearly $8 for one dog. It was great, but was it worth it? Maybe, but next time I return it will probably be for just a donut unless I'm craving a hot dog.

We were skeptical of the restaurant because of the reviews. The one stars were detailed and the five stars were vague and short. But we gave it a try.
As you an see we were impressed. Wife and I arrived at 4:15 on a Friday (left work early) here's what we found.
Super clean restaurant and tables,
Fast attention by servers, our main server was Jake (great guy, lots of tattoos, but classy)
We ordered the caso and two "pick three for $10" meals, along with ice teas. All items were fast, hot and delicious.
Summary, it was a good time with good food and service for not much money. We really needed it, and chili's delivered.

Great management and a great place to hang out.  Went here during the fake "epidemic" and it was open and hosting like every restaurant should be.  Grabbed 2 specials and WOW, excellent food, excellent portions, I was overfilled and unable to eat anymore.  Decently priced drinks and so many beers on tap I lost count.  Will be back for sure!

Looking for a great Mexican restaurant and tired of the same options? Pueblo Lindo is so amazing! The combination of authentic food, great service and complete bar is the perfect way to celebrate with big groups, families or for date night. Check it out before you can't get a table!

Food was just below average. I ordered the salmon with a miso citrus topping.-NOT GOOD! The hand cut fries were yummy and so was the salad and bread. Mashed potatoes were good too. We also ordered the hot crab spinach artichoke dip as an appetizer. We didn't see nor taste crab and it was watery. Beer sampler was not good either.

This was our first time eating at flatbread.  I give it 4 stars because they got our order wrong and the pizza was really soggy.  I wish I could give it 3.5 stars because it wasn't quite 4 stars.  We didn't get a chance to correct the waitress because she didn't check back that often & we had to leave soon so my boyfriend could make it to work on time.  We had to wait quite awhile for our food to come as well, and our pizza came before our appetizer.  Despite that, the roasted goat cheese appetizer was delicious.  I will give them another shot in the future.  The waitress was friendly also.

Average Starbucks with incredibly nice staff. Good amount of seating, free WiFi, we like to study here. 

Just a hint about coffee shop etiquette for patrons: if you don't plan on using the electrical outlets, pick a seat without them.
A pleasant, family-operated business serving tasty food at reasonable prices.  Service is good, but don't expect an amazing décor or a lot of formality.
Always excellent food and amazing service never had a bad experience going here and chicken mole is amazing!!!

Glad to see family-run Chinese food to try in Meridian instead of the big chains like Panda Express.  Some of the reviews we saw made us a bit apprehensive to try this place, but we thoroughly enjoyed it.  We had kung pao chicken, cashew chicken, and the hot sour soup.   All were tasty.  The service was friendly and prompt.   We will be back!

I didn't have high expectations as this is a chain, but this place is not good. The food is all extremely salty. You can't have a conversation with the person sitting across from you. We went as a family and our kids are extremely well behaved. They're older and still content to just color. They must've judged us as we walked in, thinking since we have kids we wouldn't mind being stuck in the small room with all the other kids on the restaurant. It was obnoxious. Unlike our kids, the table behind us did not have well behaved children. They were climbing over and under the tables. Not the restaurants fault at all...but what I WILL fault them for is the fact that they cram as many groups with kids into one room in an attempt to keep them away from other guests. 
The food was sh*t. None of us finished, so I guess I don't need to worry about it anymore. Skip it.

If I could give no stars I would. We waited 30 minutes and nobody bothered to even get us drinks. They served people that got there after us. We left after no service and couldn't flag anyone down because they wouldn't come near our corner we were seated in. They wasted no time clearing our menus off the table after we left.

Dr. Baxter has really improved my life. I went in for shoulder pain and came to found I had a lot more issues I didn't even realize existed. Problems I lived with most of my life that I had just learned to accept and deal with; I had no idea they could even get fixed. Not only has my shoulder pain been fixed but lower back issues I had learned to just live with my whole life have now been corrected and I didn't even know it could be. The whole staff is great and pleasant! The front desk staff greets you by name when you come.in and has a great attitude. Zack and Roxy up front are wonderful. Highly recommend!

We contracted Lowes to do the construction deck, pergola, balcony and the contractor Alex Dawson and his crew, they did a fantastic job in our Boise area vacation home! Very professional, attention to details, quality workmanship and at a very compatible price. Would recommend Lowe's and Alex Dawson any time and will use over and over again. Mike Ballard, Lowe's Meridian store coordinated the work and stayed on top of the project from beginning to end.
I love your food. I'm always impressed when waitstaff doesn't have to write your down your order and they get it right when it comes to the table. Props to great servers!!

Wow!  This is THE amazing design store that we needed in Boise.  The merchandise is high quality and reasonably priced.  They have a wonderful assortment of accessories, art, and furniture.

Janet did the interior design for our new home and she was amazing to work with.  We are extremely pleased with the results.

My brother, who has Down syndrome, was staying with me and we realized he forgot a piece from his C-pap machine. It was a Saturday so we were panicked we wouldn't be able to find a place open to get the part. His house, where the part was, was two hours away. He's terrified to sleep without it since he has severe sleep apnea. We called Norco and the after hours person directed us to Dave Williams. He met me at the Meridian location and got us the part quickly. I can't tell you how much we appreciated that. Thank you Dave and Norco!!!

I love the donut that has peach in it...think it's called Southern Bell. The donuts are a bit spendy but are not made out of regular donut dough so I guess it's a fair trade. If you enjoy donuts and want flavored ones that you can't get from Krispie Creme then this is the place for you!!

Met a friend for lunch. Flatbread is the perfect place. We both ordered the 'pick two'. I love that there are so many good options and not just some standard. Their options are one of the pizzettas, half salad, half sandwich, macaroni and cheese, or tomato basil soup. There are a few things on the menu you can't choose but there are more things you can. 

I had their mac & cheese and tomato margherita pizzetta. My friend ordered the Chicken Apple Walnut Salad and the tomato basil soup. I love the wood fired pizza here. The crust is chewy and has a fabulous char from the hot oven. The salad was good and had a delicious tangy dressing. 

I love the vibe here. It never feels rushed when you are catching up with a friend.

We tried this place because it was on the right part of town and we were looking for something comforting on a rainey cold day.  We ordered to go Tonkatsu bowls with adder 1/2 app harumaki.  The meal for two came in high quality to-go boxes with all the necessities including chop sticks and sweet chili sauce for our harumaki.  The egg included in the Tonkatsu was delish.  No onion so we added some sliced scallions at home.  Fun new treat.  We had a good time and experience.  Will be back.

Second time coming here. Last time was amazing this time not as good. Today we had the Countryman breakfast which had chicken fried steak that was mostly breading and quite bland. The other meal we had was the Idahoan which was extremely salty and had some egg whites that were completely uncooked. I give 5 stars because the service was great, friendly staff and because I can't judge negatively over one meal.

I was a fan of Jakers at its old Parkcenter location and have wanted to try the new location since a friend told me about their $9.99 all-you-can-eat soup and salad bar lunch special.  Today I had the opportunity to come here with a group of friends most of whom had never been here.  All of us are glad we came.

The large 40 seat meeting space is perfect for groups because it is separate from the main restaurant, quiet (the house music can be turned on or off), and private.

The soup bar was amazing, with five house-made soups including a lobster bisque reminiscent of that served at Zuppas, but with even more lobster.  The salad bar featured a large selection of fresh ingredients and house made salads, fresh fruit, and deli-sliced meats for making an awesome chef salad.  And our friendly waitress kept us well supplied with unlimited scone-like rolls and clean plates.

We will definitely be back.

My tattoo faded and looked funny once it healed. I have many tattoos (the oldest being 15yrs old) and none faded like this or had light spots. They do not include touch ups.... For what I paid, at least one touch up should be included... Its disapointing. Luckily my regular artist is going to touch it up for free.

First time here at this gorgeous restaurant! I had a Sangria and a Smoky Margarita for drinks and lunch I chose shrimp tacos with garlic crema, black beans, and rice. The service was above and beyond and I couldn't ask for a better meal and experience. Our server during this visit was Kelse and she was remarkable! This place is a must! Beautiful location, fabulous food and drinks and service top notch!

I had this place for the first time yesterday! Lemme tell ya, the place was PACKED! Which, usually is a good sign. Anyway, I just had a pick up order so went up the bar and everyone's bloody Mary's looked BOMB! I was working so no booze for meeee! 

So, I got the chicken BBQ chicken salad and the regular Mac n cheese! I LOVED everything. Only thing I didn't like was the chicken...

It had a funky texture which was rubbery almost like it was under cooked or something. Soooo deff won't be getting the chicken again!

This started as a one star review but due to a server jumped up. We got seated for a late lunch. Our waitress came and dropped off water and chips & salsa. She asked if we wanted anything else to drink and we asked for a few minutes to look over the drink menu. She never returned. She had three tables after us seated and took and delivered orders. One of which was right next to us. She turned her back to us and wouldn't look at me when I tried to get her attention. This was over 15-20 minutes of waiting. We got the attention of another server and asked him to take our order. Without hesitation, and quite apologetically, he took our order and topped off our waters. The manager delivered our food and apologized as well. We didn't ask nor did we expect his kindness in comping our meal. He said this isn't tolerated in his restaurant and will be addressed. Our new server kept checking in on us while running his butt off to make sure we were taken care of. What started awful turned fantastic. Thank you to Ty our server who, if you go, must be asked for! A wonderful young man. Also, the food was amazing. Had the chicken tacos and habanero steak burrito. That burrito was heavenly.

Getting right to it: fantastic heartwarming service, awesome people; delicious food, great drinks, fun menu items, a cozy bar, sweet deals, plentiful seating... I'm running out of adjectives!!! 

I went here with my mom to try the epic Bloody Mary and it didn't disappoint. What we weren't expecting... phenomenal wings!!!! I love wings and these wings were so friggen well cooked!! I need to come back and try all the flavors. The mango was so tasty, and the whiskey BBQ was quite savory and sweet. 

My favorite aspect... as always, was the service. Genuinely kind and thoughtful people made this a 10 out of 10 experience; I highly recommend a visit. 

I'll be back for more wings... please don't change the way you're making them!!

At 6:30 on a weeknight I was just leaving the grocery store and had nothing prepared for dinner.  The family at home was hungry, so takeout seemed like a good idea.  Next door I noticed Fresh Betty Spaghetti, which offers spaghetti, sauce, meatballs, salad, and bread for takeout only.  I decided to get one of the family dinners plus some extra meatballs to take home.  I walked in and saw there were several people sitting and waiting for their orders to be completed, plus two others ahead of me in line.  Still, I figured it shouldn't be too long of a wait due to the limited menu...wrong!  

There was just one employee at the register placing orders and collecting payment, and it looked like she was operating in slow motion. No sense of urgency, even though several more people walked in behind me. There was one other employee nearby, but he didn't seem to be doing anything other than answering her questions.  I waited several minutes while she finished taking the order for the first person in line.  The next customer had several questions, and I waited while they described to her all the different meatballs offered.  She chose Traditional meatballs, and they informed her they were out of those.  She then chose Beef meatballs, and the response was that they only had a couple of those left.  Why describe all the different types of meatballs for her if they're out of them?  And why would a place that only sells spaghetti and meatballs be out of most types of meatballs right at dinner time?  I realized I would be ordering my spaghetti dinner without any meatballs since I didn't want chicken, and that seemed to be all they had.

After an agonizingly long wait, they finally finished up this woman's order and it was my turn.  As I stepped up to the register, the man behind me piped up and said "since I have a telephone order, why don't you go ahead and ring me up and get me out of here?"  Without even acknowledging my presence, the employee at the register agreed that would be a good idea.  I can see why this man spoke up since it was taking up to 10 minutes per customer in line.  However, that didn't really work for me!  I stood there a few more minutes while the employee rang him up, working just as slowly as ever.  A few minutes later she still wasn't done -- how can it take that long to ring up an order that was previously called in?  

As I continued to wait, I noted that in the 15-20 minutes I had been there none of the waiting customers had received their order and departed.  They were now joined by the two previously ahead of me in line.  I had heard  they were out of both Traditional and Beef meatballs.  I came to the realization that it would be faster to go next door to Fred Meyer and buy the ingredients to make my own spaghetti dinner -- which is exactly what I did.

I don't know if the food at Fresh Betty Spaghetti was any good or not since I never got a chance to order it.  Customers buying take-out are generally in a hurry, and don't want to stand there for over 20 minutes before even placing an order.  If it's quicker to make it yourself, that kind of defeats the purpose...  Also, if Betty Spaghetti sells only spaghetti and meatballs, they need to make enough meatballs to not be out of everything during peak hours.  Additional staff and training for existing employees is definitely needed.  I doubt they'll stay in business if changes aren't made.
Worst service ever! Don't waste your time on supporting this business. We were treated like dog crap, so shocking.

Visited this past Friday.  The place was very busy which is a great sign. Even though it was busy, we were seated very quickly. The menu is small which is another great sign. The drinks are served in a little mason jars.  If you are a thirsty non beer person, you'll need several refills. The selection of microbrews from the local area is one of the best.  I ordered the steak sandwich. I was concerning about the horseradish sauce, but was told that it wouldn't knock my socks off but is what makes the sandwich.  I was some what skeptical but when the sandwich arrived, the server was spot on.  Note: I am not a fan of store bought horseradish. Matter of fact I hate it, but there version was flavorful and had a spice to it.  If they bottled it, I would buy it.  The girls each had a Hawaiian salad.  Nothing specular but it comes with a homemade sweet onion dressing which is the star.  great flavor.  The desert menu may seem small but cannot be missed. Definitely save room for the bread pudding. You'll thank me later.

Worst experience a BWW I've ever had!!  We came here specifically to watch the #1 NCAAF team play in the Big 10 Championship game. That's why you go to BWW, right??  I've asked FIVE TIMES for them to change the channel and they keep changing it to anything else!! Jeopardy?!  SHOPPING NETWORK?!?!!!  This BWW SUCKS!!!

I am reluctant to give this place a glowing review due to several soured experiences here. It's VERY inconsistent in both service and food quality and order accuracy.

Menu: Its actually pretty good. They have a wide variety of awesome food to choose from and an extensive list of beer. The half yard beers are a great deal if you're planning on more than one pint. 

Food: There's their major downfall; the food. I don't know what's happening in that kitchen but I've seen every kitchen no-no come out of there. I've had stone cold burgers make it to my table, charred and rubbery fillet mignon, overcooked queso dip that was clearly black on top, tacos that have hardened under a heat lamp and one time, a burger that was charred black on one side and hidden under extra sauce. What the actual fuck guys??? When it's cooked right, it's awesome, I'll give them that. But there seems to be an effort back in that kitchen to push poorly cooked food out. 

Service: Kinda hit and miss. It runs the range from non-existent to invasive. Management is usually good about making sure customers are satisfied when there's an issue with the food, which sadly happens often. The staff doesn't seem to be very tight knit, I suspect there is a lot of turnover here leading to a lack of team cohesion. 

Resturant: clean and modern. 


Overall: when it's good it's 5 stars, when it's not it's one star. There's no in between. Management needs to look into what in the hell is going on in the kitchen and make sure that there is some quality control. I've heard the phrase "I checked it myself" way too often AFTER a dish has been returned. I thought that was the job of a manager, quality control. They, at the very least, do take responsibility and make sure that problems are corrected. If they can catch them before they make it to the table, they'd see a huge improvement.

Oh, Yardhouse! How you disappointed me. To be ignored is not good. Your bartender looked at me sitting there, with nothing in front of me, as he was giving people, who were in the process of sitting, menus. Then, to tell me that you look left to right" as your excuse. Uh, here's some news... I was on your left. Wow! Sadly, you may have lost me. Here's the upshot... Kona Grill was happy to have me and provide me with some great bar service!! Thank you, Becca!
This is the spot. The filet is the best in town. A local spot, we just love. A few cocktails and a filet is so damn good.

I ordered a chocolate iced Creme filled donut... and I received one with custard filling. Boo. I am super bummed. But the donuts were still fresh and tasty. I just wish my order would've been correct.

George D was very helpful and was very eager to tell me what was the best application for my needs. He new exactly what to do without thinking about what he was going to do next. I have great reception and all is working well. I would definitely recommend this company. I don't understand the bad reviews. I had a great experience. 
Thank You George D.

Ordered crab ragoons, gyoza, and tonkatsu chasu to go. Everything was still warm when we got home and well packaged. Crab ragoons were crispy on the outside with creamy cream cheese crabbiness on the inside, gyoza was nice and soft. The ramen was so good, with chewy yet full-bodied noodles and a rich pork broth. The meat isn't too fatty and thinly sliced which was nice. Staff was very nice, and the restaurant was clean. Will definitely return for more!
Not cheap but great quality. The red  quinoa kale salad was  amazing and delicious if you like healthy food

My family has been here twice. Both times, we all came away with the same feeling. The food is just meh here.

The service was very friendly, but a little sub-par as well. We were one of only two families in the restaurant, but the waitress failed to stay on simple tasks such as making sure we had enough plates or silverware. 

I don't usually dock stars for service though unless I've been multiple times and have seen a pattern of problems, as I know that sometimes you just get a bad waiter at a good restaurant and even good waiters can just have an off day. So this rating is unfortunately purely for the food.

The food is always somewhere between sub-par and good, but never great. I know good Mexican too - I lived in an area filled with Mexican influence and culture and had many friends there that didn't even speak English and was privileged to regularly share meals with them.

In this case, the shredded beef is a little tough and dry. The portions are a little small, especially for beans. The sauces are decent, but in every case I felt like "I've had better". I had the Enchiladas Jalisco this last time and a Chili Relleno. The mole was decent (though I'm not a huge fan of mole so not a good judge). The green sauce was probably the best, but again, I felt like I've had a lot better. The Chili Relleno was probably the best thing I had and was made very well, but the problem is I've been to El Tenampa here in town and they have one of the best Chili Relleno's I've ever had, so it was hard to compare.

In short, if you're the type of person that likes their Mexican food a little sweet and not quite loaded on the spice, and maybe a nice location and dining experience, this place might be pretty good for you. If you're looking for Mexican food that is juicy, authentic, and above average, and are a bit picky with your Mexican, this place will probably leave you a little underwhelmed.

Worst place for groups. We always have to wait hours. Not hour, hours. By the time we get seated we are starving and get full off just the delicious bread! Other than that one of my top places to eat just wouldn't ever choose to go there in groups they really need to improve the tables for 6 or more because there is usually only one and we have to wait for it. But everyone always wants to wait to eat there and go there for special occasions.
Great menu. I am slowly eating my way through the menu and never had a bad meal. It's a must try.

Excellent service. I've eaten there only twice, both were very enjoyable. Ate there last week with my daughter for lunch special. More than enough food and two meals were less than $20. Sit outdoor if you can. I will return, just a great place!

My friend and I have come many times but the last two times our server Ivory has treated us horribly!! This last time we got there an hour before they closed prepared to order drinks and dinner so we didn't keep them past their closing time. We had to ask for everything from straws for our drinks to plates so we could share our food. At 11:50 (before restaurant closing time) she turned up the lights, turned the music off, and stacked the chairs around us BEFORE the restaurant even closed! When we asked if we were keeping her she said we were. I should mention that it was a dinner my friend and I were having because she was moving across the country in a couple of days. I have been in the restaurant industry for 16 years and I would NEVER treat a guest so horribly!

So yeah, the big differentiator here is the... the shredded chicken.  No really.  It's remarkable.  So typically "shredded chicken" means "boiled with little or no seasoning, then shredded."  Not here!  This is a heavily seasoned and yummy shredded chicken!  I'm pretty sure I tasted some adobo sauce in there, which is a first for shredded chicken I've had in a restaurant, and is more similar to carnitas de pollo that I make at home.  Definitely next-level shredded chicken!

The enchiladas chipotles are kind of unique, since the sauce used is kind of a salsa-like enchilada sauce.  Definitely worth a try!

I think the only thing I was a little let down on is the regular enchilada sauce.  It's... it's kind of bland, and I'm pretty sure it was canned.

Service is on point, quick and really nice, and I'm always surprised when they bring out the little fritter dessert thingy at the end!

Had the Valentines dinner special for two consisting of of bacon wrapped shrimp, filet or prime rib (choice of one per person), snow crab leg, chocolate cake. Food was absolutely amazing. Prepared perfectly to order. Jakers is amongst the best food in the area. Cocktails were really good as well. Ask for a scone!

It was okay it wasn't the best Mexican food I've had had some flavor - chips and salsa guacamole on the side not bad. Service is okay it's not over the top but it is okay so if you're into 'okay" then this would be perfect for you. Looks nice inside, just saying the staff is not enthusiastic but they are there¿

Went to this establishment for my birthday this past Monday. I no longer order sirloin steak because it's always tough, so we ordered the ribeye. The outside of the steak was fine, but both my husband's and my steaks were really tough in the middle.You're a steak and BBQ restaurant, how could you serve such crappy steaks? This used to be my husband's and my "place". It's clear from the incredibly loud music, this company doesn't want the senior clientele. Bye, bye, TR, we won't be back.

Excellent therapeutic massage provided by Sarah Arnold.  She dispenses with the new age fluff and gets to work.  Sarah has helped immensely with my chronic back pain and intermittent exercise injuries.  It's difficult to find a therapist of this caliber -  now my entire family are regular customers.  Go Sarah!
Just discovered this place in the old Souper Salad location.  AWESOME food, decor and staff.  We were all impressed and will definitely be back!

Apparently they must have lots of that PPP money that they don't need to notice four people standing there for almost ten minutes waiting to be seated while multiple waitresses just stare and walk on by with a mostly empty restaurant in mid afternoon. So sad.
Nice staff, but often has a problem with flies. Not cool.
Never fails to hit the mark! Always fast and food fantastic.  Ethan was amazing and on top of his job.

Rendon Construction just replaced the countertops and backsplash in our kitchen.  Shawn is extremely professional and provides a high quality product.  He get back to you immediately when you have questions.  His standards for the work product were higher than mine.  Everything provided by his subcontractors was fixed if there were any problems.  I recommend him highly for any remodeling project

Best car wash i have seen in a long time. High end facility. Clean and professional staff. Vacuum area had all working vacuum stations and ample drying micro fibers clothes. Most car washes leave bug residue...but not this car wash. 15 dollars well spent. I pay more in California for half this quality of service.

I didn't want to come here because of the reviews I read. I drove to two different burger places which were closed when on Yelp said they were open. I decided to give it a try. I went through the drive thru. The girl working the window was very sweet and polite. They got my order right and everything tasted  good, as I would expect it to. 
I never give reviews but I felt with all the negative ones on here I had to share my experience. Maybe they got new Management or replaced some employees. I don't know but I will definitely go back.

This is a great downtown Meridian restaurant.  It is casual, but really nice.  The people who work there really make the atmosphere inviting! 

The menu has many things to offer along with Gluten free choices.  The food is not your typical pizza joint food.  The unique combinations of types of pizzas and flatbreads to their salads is pleasing to any palate.  There's definitely something that anyone will like.

They have a fun kids menu too!  Kids can make their own pizza or have a choice of smaller kid friendly food.

And their Mac n Cheese is, in my opinion, the best!...if you like Mac n Cheese you might like to try it with different add-ins for a different dish each time you visit.

It's a nice place to dine alone, meet up for a lunch or dinner date, or even have a large group gathering!  The staff here know and practice hospitality!  A big shout out to our waitress from tonight: Mitzy, thanks for the great service!

*** Responding to the businesses comment at the bottom of the original review

I very rarely leave negative reviews, but I'm so angry about the performance of this company that I felt in this case it was necessary.

I prepped my house, moved everything off the carpet, only to have the cancel on me hours before citing "mechanical issues".  Obviously I was not happy, but I know things can happen so I gave them the benefit of the doubt and re-scheduled for the following week.

Fast forward a week and one day.  I sent an email confirming in the morning to make sure they were coming.  They responded back to me saying that they were coming.  The delivery window was 5-6pm.  I thought great and once again got my entire house prepped for their arrival.  At 5:30 p.m., I received a call once again canceling my appointment.

What was most surprising was the lack of empathy, and customer service that was demonstrated on the phone.  The girl was talking to someone else while I was on the phone with her, then raised her voice at me and accused me of being unreasonable.

Umm.  I don't think it is unreasonable to expect companies to follow-through on their commitments.

It was a huge waste of time

This company is very unreliable

***Response to Comment:

While I know you say you work hard to make sure customers are happy, this statement could not be further from the truth.   Not only did you have ample opportunity to address the situation much earlier in the day when I was speaking with you, but your tone, demeanor, and dismissive attitude on the phone after wasting my afternoon was not just unprofessional, but highly disrespectful.

Simply the best spaghetti, sauce, and meatballs I have ever had. Everything is made from scratch; fresh spaghetti pasta, homemade sauce, and the meatballs. The spaghetti finds that perfect balance of being hearty without being doughy. The sauce is simply to die for. Layer upon layer of flavor in both the plain ("unleaded") and the meat ("leaded") versions that can only be obtained by slow cooking without letting it burn. The sauce was neither too thick nor too watery - just right, and it sticks to the pasta like it should. The meatballs come in four varieties - Chicken, Beef, Traditional (Beef & Pork mix), and Spicy. I had both the Traditional and the Chicken and they were both among the best I've ever had. Next time I'll try the Spicy!  The best part was that I was able to get a Family Dinner for 4 with 8 meatballs and extra bread for less than we'd spend at a fast food restaurant - and we have enough leftovers for several lunches or dinners!  Great food, incredible value, and convenient location (right next to the front entrance to Fred Meyer). Cannot ask for anything more!

This is a hard review for me...
I searched for a solid year, if not longer to find someone to do a cover up for me. I stumbled upon their Facebook page and instantly knew Eryka was the artist I had been searching for. 
I messaged about scheduling and was told to wait until they do their one day where everyone stands in line for hours just to schedule. I was literally the first person in that line 2 hours before they even opened. I was committed to Eryka being my artist. 
So got my tattoo 2 months later and it was EXACTLY what I always dreamed! 2 weeks later I messaged asking to schedule for a touch up assuming I wouldn't have to stand in that line again. I was told to wait until it healed all the way. 
I got another tattoo from Eryka during their flash sale and agin asked about an appointment for touch up and Dane said to message the page again and I did... 
Then COVID hit and understandably they shut down. Once they opened again I messaged and it has been absolute ridiculousness from then on...
I tried once again to get scheduled and was told to message them back in a week if I didn't hear from them, so one week later I messaged again. I was told the simple imperfections that I see aren't bad enough to get on the schedule. 
Dane was condescending repeating things saying "like I said..." I felt belittled and talked down to. I still haven't received a time to schedule and frankly am disappointed at the lack of and overall communication on their part. I now have to spend time searching for another artist to touch up my tattoo. I have my before and after pictures which are the exact pictures I sent to them hoping they would see what I see when I look at this every single day.

Quite possibly my new favorite . They cook your pizza in three minutes. The white top was so good I want to try every other pizza they make. It was savory and salty and the flavor were amazing.
Second visit just as impressive as the first. The bbq chicken pizza  . I go with their recommended  toppings. Their crust is chewy and crunchy at the same time. Their sauce isn't too sweet and just right.
My husband tried their beet salad and it was very good too.

My family and I were craving good Chinese food tonight and my son heard of this place, so we thought we would give it a try.  So glad we did.  We ate on site and were immediately greeted by the nicest lady who told us to grab any table.  Granted we were the only ones seated, but we still grabbed a nice table with lots of room to put our order on.  (There we're actually multiple take out orders being picked up at the time we were there).  We had previously looked at the menu on line ahead of time so we ordered what we had decided on.  We ordered the Chicken Chowmein (to die for!), Mongolian Beef, pork fried rice, Szchewan chicken, and lemon chicken.  I must say, we loved everything they brought out to us.  It was hot, fresh, and super tasty.  I will definitely be coming back and now that I know something this good is close to home.  It was all SO yummy.

Really good! 
We loved everything we tried - dogs, donuts and hot chicken sandwich! 
I see a lot of poor reviews on the price and yes, it's a little more than this area is used to for this type of food, but I thought it was fine due to the fact that they really care about their flavor and service. I've had lots of cheap and expensive food that was so lackluster that I'm always looking for somewhere that goes the extra mile and really tries to make their food taste good! If you want a cheap hot dog and donut you're looking in the wrong place - try your local grocery store!

Great service. Synthetic for my diesel. Checked all fluids. Drive thru. My tank is ready for the road.
They are my new oil tank when in Boise.

I went in on a Monday night with some friends for happy hour amazing menu so much food we ordered 3 appetizers and drinks very delicious! The only down fall was the waiter his name was Andrew he didn't seem very helpful and maybe not wanting to be there I asked for recommendations and replied after I had taken a few minutes of looking at the menu I asked between two and he replied with well after all that time deciding I would say both are good on the menu and after I ordered my appetizer and after thirty minutes of waiting I went to ask what had happened because it never arrived  at the bar because he never even came to check our table throughout that whole time I let them know I felt like he didn't like us at all and that I just wanted to cancel my order because everyone else was done eating at my table and he finally came to our table and first thing he said was I don't hate you and  said he didn't realize he gave my food to the table behind mine. The fact I went and told someone about how Unwelcomed I felt and then he comes to our table saying I don't hate you as the first thing he says to me with a very sarcastic tone and face was very unprofessionally handled as well which made everything even more uncomfortable than it already was this was the worst service and he made me feel very unwelcome through out the whole time I'll def be coming back because my friends appetizers were amazing and my drink I ordered was the only thing I actually got to my table was amazing as well but def will be asking to sit anywhere other than Andrews section and yes after all that I still tipped him
Bomb bomb donuts!! Not a huge selection, but enough to give your taste buds a yummy ride! We will definitely be back !

This is by far the worst Carl's Jr. ever! The Only reason they are still open is the location. Been to other Carl's,and the food is what you expect. This one has sucked from the beginning. Fire the management.

I would highly recommend Dowdy for all your auto needs. Scheduling an appointment was quick and easy. My 2014 Toyota Corolla needed an oil change and some maintenance check ups. Spoke with Tyler at the shop who patiently and kindly explained everything to me and even suggested me other places/ways/tips/tricks to save money on my vehicle. Turns out they have couple of Toyota specialists there who worked on my car. The turn around time for everything was about 1.5 hrs, which is what they had estimated to me. Cost was very reasonably priced. Dowdy's is definitely one of the most honest auto shops in town and I would highly recommend to family and friends! I'm definitely returning again for all my auto needs. Thank you so much Tyler and Dowdy's for a pleasant experience!!

The Donut + Dog is WORTH trying!!! Some of the best, unique donuts, hot dogs, and coffee I've ever had! I came here while I was visiting Boise from Houston, TX. This was exactly the unique breakfast that we were looking for.

The interior is very well lit with lots of natural lighting coming in from their big front windows. They have a cool Simpsons mural on their wall and donuts neon sign which makes for cool pictures. They also have this open area they call the "Donut Vault" where you can watch them make all their delicious donuts from scratch in front of you. It was around Halloween when I came here so they had many pumpkin and fall themed donuts/drinks available.

I forget the names of the exact donuts we tried, but you can SEE how delicious they are in the pictures. I believe 1 was a guava cream cheese donut, cherry filled vanilla glazed donut with sugar shards, raspberry lemon poppy seed donut, and a bourbon maple bacon donut. Then we washed it all down with their SMOKED caramel latte, and coconut cold brew. The smoked caramel latte was probably the coolest coffee I've ever ordered as it's literally smoked in a box in front of you before they serve it and the latte art was a multicolored christmas tree. The coconut cold brew was solid as well, and cool because its served in an adult sized "Caprisun" type pouch.

I will definitely visit this place again next time I'm in Boise, and I highly recommend them to others!

I have been to quite a few meridian salons for pedicure. I showed up yesterday evening at 6:30, they close at 7, I politely asked the woman at the desk if she had time for a pedi/gel polish, I told her I knew it was close to closing so if not it wasn't a problem. She smiled warmly and said plenty of time. She let me take my time to pick my color- didn't rush me through their many options. The water was perfect temp, she was very precise & attentive, even made conversation with me. She didn't rush me through and gave a great massage. It was a wonderful pedicure. She took her time with my polish and very polite. Very reasonable price and I didn't feel like a burden or rushed. 

The pedicure station was clean and my feet & toes look and feel great! 

I didn't catch her name but I think it was Linda! I will be scheduling with her!

I want to write a great review because let's be honest this is a great hobby store with a great selection of items. But today they wasted 25min of my time! After I paid for my items and got to my car I reviewed my receipt because I felt like it was a little high for all the things I bought and that's when I realized I was overcharged by almost $60?! Two items at 29.69 which I did not buy!!! Everything I Bought was a bunch of little things, and I get it based on their old school charging system where they have to manually enter each item I understand mistakes can happen, so I go back and nicely explain there was a mistake and expect them to simply refund that mistake... instead they went through all my bags and items twice and try to figure out the problem, which btw they never did... finally decide to just refund me after I stood there with my toddler for over 20min while they went through my things over and over!! My time is important, like everyone, I feel this issue could have been resolved much more effectively and respectfully!! Will I go back?? Of course I Love Hobby Lobby, but from now on I will be watching the check out process a lot more carefully!!

This place is amazing.

We stopped in today to get a quick oil change but this quickly became an experience for my kids and I. 

The staff is super friends and organized. He explained the process of the oil change and that they would be vacuuming out my vehicle and also taking it through the car wash.

Once inside their lobby area which has free coffee and some sodas and snacks for purchase, my kids quickly found these "soap shooters" that you can shoot vehicles with soap suds as they pass through the car wash.

The staff offered my kids suckers, coloring books and free hot wheel cars!

A+ can not wait to come back!

Happy Hour place with friends, only happy hour food, not alcoholic beverage. The interior is nice, cheery, colorful lantern lights, busy mozaic porcelain walls. There is an upper section with some small tables and chairs that caught my attention. I wondered the whole time how to get up there and why no one was up there. Maybe it was just part of the decoration. However, I would love to sit up there if it's ever available. The food was ok. I am npt much of a Mexican food lover. Ordered the wings, I am not a fan of the sauce. The cumin flavor was not welcomed on my pallette. Plus the only gave the drummettes; I like the 2-bone-part of wings. The calamari was not wow at all. I like the nearby restaurant's calamari better. It wasn't crunchy and the sliced bellpeppers were too greasy/soggy. The chicken quesadilla was good. It has pretty good flavors and fillings. We also ordered the $1.50 tacos. They were very small, if you're hungry, you should eat at least 5 of them. But they were all good. The salsa that they gave with chips when you first came in could use more salt, lemon/lime, and a kick of heat to it. It was good experience, loud which was great for chatty group like us. Oh for women, if you need to wait for whomever is in the restroom, do not stand in front of the restroom doors, you would see the guys standing in front of the urinal. Hahaha...I had to excuse myself rigth away when the men's restroom door was opened. Just a warning :-)
I didn't think one place could perfect coffee, hotdogs and donuts, but they did it. So good. Don't leave without getting the nitro cold brew. Epic

Just tried this place and really enjoyed it! The Won Ton War soup was amazing!! The best I've ever had. The veggies are so fresh. The wok dishes were great. We weren't fans of the sweet and sour chicken, too dry and chewy. The service was great, but the ambiance is just so so. This restaurant could really become amazing with a more authentic ambiance. Overall, we'll definitely be going back!

I'd give a zero if I could! A group of us went there and the staff and food were horrible. Brittany the bartender had a major attitude problem and no care for customers. My "chili renello" was basically a stuffed pepper and was cold. Many people in our party complained about the food being cold, tough meat, etc. Definitely never going there and never suggesting it to anyone. The staff really doesn't seen to care at all about customer service.

Danielle is absolutely the best! Incredibly fast service every single time we go here. The food order is dead on and if there is an issue, she resolves it with no questions asked. 

Now, 

Becca is the exact opposite! She is terrible! Took almost 3 hours to eat and she barely came to check on us. 

Recap!
Danielle is amazing and you will have the best experience! If you get Becca, ask for another server! She will ruin your meal!

Found this newly open ramen place from the cashier at the Asian market.  I had Tonkotsu chasu and spring rolls.  I like the soup, not too salty and noodle was good as well.  Only 4 stars for now till i tried other ramen places.
Food was awesome!!! Only complaint was it's a little to loud inside for dinner conversation.... but we will definitely go back.
First time here but we love it. Sat outside and it was beautiful! Good service and great food.

First time here for 5 of us, which included 2 locals. Tavern ambience with good food. Although I was bummed that I couldn't get a martini, it is, after all, called an "alehouse".  Wine selection limited but good. My filet mignon was cooked perfectly medium rare, as ordered. Other diners had steak salad, fish tacos, soup & salad and new york strip; all said their dishes were good. Our waiter, Brandon, was anxious to please and even brought out gorgonzola, as requested, to accompany my steak. We arrived early in the evening, around 5:30, and had no trouble parking or getting seated. But even on a weeknight, I noticed that it was filling quickly an hour or so later when we left.

Delighted with our lunch choice. The lunch special was a great way to go to try multiple things. Both the Zucca and Bianca Magnifico pizzas were our FAVORITES. The chicken arugula basil salad and lemon chicken flatbread were good. I really loved the pizza dough and overall flavors. I look forward to going back again.

Arrived for my appointment this morning (which has been scheduled for over a month) to be told that the Chiropractor I see wasn't available because he was at a "marketing event...he's the face of our company". Never mind that I received two reminders that my appointment was with him and no mention that I would be expected to see a different doctor who I have never met. I chose not to be seen and will be taking my business elsewhere. A simple phone call would have saved you a client. Do not appreciate the implication that my time is not valuable and I should be happy to see anyone who the practice sees fit.

Wow!  Such a great find!  We've always struggled to find authentic Mexican food in this area since moving from San Diego 27 years ago.  Now I think we've found our new favorite!  We were seated and immediately given warm chips and salsa.  The margaritas were the best I've had in a while: served in a BIG glass and only $8.  I had Carne Asada and it was delicious.  Husband had enchiladas and loved them. Great service as well.  Highly Recommend!

We've dined in and ordered curbside several times here. I'm not a big fan of their food. I only like their chicken salad and rolls. But they always get the order right and it's as it should be. Since COVID, the wait times are pretty long. We usually expect to wait in our car at least an extra 30 minutes waiting curbside when we ordered hours in advance. In normal circumstances, I would recommend.
Family of four for $40 bucks and we all left full.  Can't beat it and the service is outstanding.

I was craving chips and salsa at night and this place is conveniently open until 10pm. We were the only ones in the restaurant who were there to eat. The red salsa is a bit spicy and the green garnish that was brought out tasted so good with the tortilla chips.  Our food didn't take too long to come out and my husband was excited to get a chimichanga. He said it was really good. My street tacos hit the spot. The rice was really good along with the beans. Our waiter was attentive and kind. Didnt make us feel in a rush. I'd come here again to try other things.
Really good poke. I really liked it here. Also the staff was very friendly. I liked the salmon and ahi bowl with #2 sauce style.

I travel all over the US and if I had a million dollars to build my dream cigar lounge full of cigars I love this would be it. Seriously, their humidor is top notch! No yard gars here, plus they have beer, wine and port. Within 2 minutes the owner Josh was giving me a tour which lead to a smoke and a beer and some great conversation. Big city selection with small town friendliness, this is my new home. I was introduced to several 9-15$ cigars and smoked a $6 that blew my mind. These guys nailed it!

We have always enjoyed Main Street Burger, but the last two times we have ordered the burgers are below their usual quality.  Burgers are undercooked, rare, and the last time I had a dark brown hair in my cheeseburger.  Main Street Burger needs to " up their game" in the quality department.  Sorry, we will find another favorite burger place.

I was in there just the other day. The food was great! But the way the employees talk to each other is crazy! Clearly no respect for one another. While I was in line to order my food, a short haired girl was talking to someone in the drive thru trying to get an order right. An older lady yelled at her and was using extremely vulgar language. She got pretty upset and went into the back but shortly came back up to the counter to take orders. The older lady then yelled at her once again to leave. Like I said, can't complain about the food, but the team work and customer service sucks. Waited super long for my food, but it was worth it!

Flatbread will always be a favorite. I never tire of their fresh tomato soup, amazing variety of salads or their awesome pizzas ans flat breads! It is impossible to make a bad choice when ordering here.

This is one of my favorite places to have a good steak. I don't give them 5 stars because the music is too loud and it's a little bit dark, so this isn't a good place to talk while you enjoy your meal. 
Service is outstanding and I I said before, food is delicious! Just turn the music volume down and we'll come more often.
Hostess was rude the moment I walked through the door. Loud. Cluttered. Food was just OK.

I'm new to Meridian and i walked into Flatbread for lunch. If you haven't been you have to go. The caesar salad is to dye for, the lasagna and the mac and cheese are fabulous!.  Great service and good food, that's what they are all about.
Locally owned and excellent!  The food is wonderful and the prices are reasonable.  Please support this sister and brother venture!!

Went on lunch hour and was seated right away. Had a great burger. They also have a greatly priced soup and salad bar. I'm picky and like my burger a certain way- they accommodated me and let me choose the ingredients I wanted on my burger: which made a happy customer. I will come here again.

Third time here in two weeks since opening. First time came in the morning and had an amazing maple donut with bacon, to die for! Came back to try their hot dog and it did not disappoint! We had the Rueben Dog, well we are hooked! Been back twice since! Such friendly staff! Owners definitely brought their Tennessee hospitality. Our new fav!

Chips and salsa were good , that's it! I had the green chicken enchilada, I'm not sure what to make of the chicken that was inside the enchilada, I didn't even eat it it was so bad, I ate the tortilla only.  The ground beef enchilada was just ok.
I've had better Mexican food from Taco Bell! The only thing authentic about this place is the decor.  Will never go back and would never recommend.
Best bloody Mary's in town and their chicken wings are better than anywhere I've ever been.

I love Texas Roadhouse and have eaten at various restaurants from East to West. This is by far our least favorite location.
I ordered a steak which was cooked a little overdone and had no flavor.  Hub ordered the pulled pork which was not pulled and marginally pork. It was if they took a chunk of dried meat, cleaved into big chunks, and slathered it with BBQ sauce.
The waitress kept addressing us in odd terms such as "sweetie" or "honey" and kept winking at us...bizarro. 
The Nampa location is much better.

I returned to this place today for a late lunch with my wife and daughter. I always try to review restaurants more than once so I can get a good average of their food and service.

Casa Del Matador is upscale Mexican with more of a nod toward Spanish. According to the web site, it's Mexican Reimagined. The main thing Case Del Matador has going for it is that it's clean, and pretty well maintained. Though my wife did notice that their return air vents were "furry".

The last time I was here, it was so busy that we had to sit around the fireplace, which has tall stools that you sit on. This time, we asked for a booth. It was slow, so we got one!!!
