When we got to our booth though, I was not so thrilled. I have a sensitive butt. It does not like hard surfaces and demands padding. The seating at all of their booths are bare hardwood. Now most folks have heard of the old saying "happy Wife happy life." For me, I had to modify this to "Happy Butt, Happy life."

Also of note was that even though there were few people here when I came with my family, service was very slow.

I had something called the ENCHILADA ROJAS. On my 1 to 10 scale, I would give it a 4. It did not have much flavor, was on the dry side and just did not have that great Mexican flavor that I would expect. In fact, Ive had much better enchiladas at other Mexican places in the Meridian/Boise area.

My enchilada plate came with rice, which is a common thing for Mexican restaurants. Like most every others I have been too, the rice was dry and very nondescript. 

My wife had the fajitas and loved them, but this was primarily because they are loaded with veggies. My wife loves, loves, loves, her veggies. I fully expect her to turn into a Carrot one of these days.

If you like meat like I do, you will be disappointed in the fajitas because there is very little meat to be found.

My daughter ordered the Street Tacos. They are very small. Even for a teenager of 15, 3 of these were now-where near enough. 

She must have liked them though because I had told her I wanted a bite so I could add this to my review but before I could say "Wheres mine", she had gobbled them down.

We also had the Queso Dip. I have had a lot of Queso at a lot of different Mexican places over the years. Usually, Quesso is creamy and has a mild to not so mild heat to it. The Queso here was not creamy at all and the taste was off.

It is a bit hard to describe, but it tasted more like they had taken a block of cheddar and melted it down with little else to add any flavor at all. After it set a while, it began to harden up a bit. None of us were a fan, so it set there mostly uneaten.

For me, the only winner here was the salsa which did not have a strong taste of garlic like before. This time, it had a lot of Cilantro in it, which I love.

I think the main draw of this place is the atmosphere, the drinks, and the crowd. If you are going to come here expecting these things, you will be happy. If you come here expecting traditional Mexican dishes, you will not.

For me, I imagine better Mexican food that I found here.
Best prime rib ever. Best home made ranch ever. Best everything ever. Love this place.

My wife loves the fajitas here, and she asked specifically for them, so like any good husband, I wanted to please my wife. And besides, even though I have had several bad experienced at this place, I thought..."Why not give them one last try.

After all, I have messed up a lot over the course of my life but have received a lot of chances to get it right. Thankfully, I was not given up on and did eventually get my life right. 

I came to the Matador one last time to get them another chance, and please my wife. I ordered the Steak Fajitas. When they came out, they looked good. I excitedly took out a tortilla, added guac, onions, and bell peppers, beans and then the steak. I rolled up tortilla into a nice size and took a bite. 

The flavor was good, but something in my mouth just was not working. I spit out the food and explored it to discover that the steak was mostly un-cheawed. I decided to try build another one just in case I had gotten a bad piece of steak.

I had the exact same experience. I even picked a piece of steak and tried it al-a-cart just to make sure. The steak was indeed the issue. It was like trying to eat shoe leather. It was completely inedible.

Just as soon as we could get the attention of the server, we told him of the problem. The server took it back and told us that he would replace it, I told him this time, Id better go with the Chicken. 

About 15 or 20 minutes later, my replacement Fajitas came out. The server came back a little later to check on the replacement and told me that he was going to talk to him manager.

When we had finished, the server came over and told us that we could either have a free desert, or 10% off our meal. I did not say anything to this because I did not want to make my wife uncomfortable, plus we had spent way too much time in here already.

We opted for the 10%, but I thought this was very poor customer service. I had been given really bad food that I could not even chew, then I was forced to wait while they replace my food. During that time, my wife finished her meal and I was left to just sit there and watch her eat. And for all this inconvenience, I was being offered a free desert or 10%!!!

I love given additional chances to places, but this is the straw that broke the camels back. In the words of the sharks from Shark Tank, 

"With that, I am out!"

Cod was simply amazing, who would have thought Oliver in pasta were great!
Waited quickly, quick drinks, great meal!

Oh my God!  Do not ever use this Company.  So many reasons and not enough space.  They never show up and when they do once a week they show up without calling around 3 in the afternoon and do about an hour of work. Promise to show up next day, but guess what, no show.  We have been working on closet for 4 months as part of a bathroom remodel.  All other subs have long been gone, but you guessed it, not them.  One excuse after another, will not return phone calls, and when they do show up for an hour a week they do not have the right material.  ABSOLUTELY THE WORST EXPERIENCE!  NEVER! NEVER USE THIS COMPANY.

I was in the unique position of wedding planning and wedding dress shopping during the COVID pandemic.  Kate was extremely helpful throughout the entire process, starting with communication around having to reschedule my appointment, the expectations about what the appointment would look like, and also reassuring that we would find the perfect dress.  From the moment I arrived, I felt special.  There was a sign out front welcoming me to the store, and Kate and McKenzie were waiting inside with great big smiles (even though they had to wear masks, they socially distanced and showed us their faces so we knew who we were interacting with!).  Kate asked what I was looking for, and we immediately started trying dresses, putting me in 20+ gowns to make sure I fully evaluated everything to pick the perfect dress.  The appointment ran quickly, smoothly, and was so fun!  The cottage was set up comfortably for my two guests to sit and watch me try on gowns, with mirrors and lighting to make sure I was able to see every angle of the gowns.  Not only did they make me feel special, but they were also so sweet and caring to my guests who were there to help.  I would hands-down recommend Kate and her team to every bride searching for her perfect gown.  Kate has a passion for helping brides find their perfect gown, and that passion shines during the appointments.  Even with a limited timeline, Kate was still able to show me more than enough dresses, and I left feeling excited, confident and totally in love with my gown!  Thank you, Kate!
This is a great local steakhouse with amazing food! Go early or wait to people watch! Salmon, steak & specials are great!
Cane in tonight and sat for 20 minutes and finally left. Never greeted, several servers walked by.

These are pictures of just some of the $1 sushi you can get on Monday's or Tuesday's.  I personally don't eat sushi so I can only go off what my family has said the last 2 times we've eaten here.  The $1 sushi seems to be served warm.  The first time they ate here, both my kids and husband enjoyed it.  Second time, my son couldn't bring himself to eat his because it was served warm and not well rolled.  The 3rd time, my son wouldn't go back and my daughter wasn't able to eat hers as it was also served warm and the sushi was not rolled well.  The first 2x we had the same great waitress, 3rd time we had a different waitress and she was not so great.  Acted like she was annoyed to even be there! I really don't think this place is worth going to for $1 sushi so IF we were to go back, it would be for something else on the regular menu.
Amazing!!! Certified Italian original piZZA.  Way awesome worth deviating off course to visit. The best healthy brick oven pizza ever. Rivals Roberta's in New York and safer environment.

I love this place so much.  I hesitate to say it's one of my favorite pizza places just because it's a chain, but I'd be lying if I tried to say otherwise.  Like other Blaze pizzas I've been to, this location executes a nice crispy crust, and a topping-laden pizza for an extremely fair price.  I love how you can load up your pizza with as much as you want for the same price across the board!  The employees are also very friendly, yet not overly so like some of the other Blaze Pizza locations I've been to.  The line moves fast because they are so efficient here & you only wait about 2 minutes from when you pay until when you get your pizza.  Highly recommend!

Awesome job! When the put in our counter and island tops the sealant hadn't set and we were worried. The OWNERS came and sealed the counter and island tops that day, again! We have been very happy ever since. We will use them again (if the will have us).

I feel like when restaurants get popular, they slowly start slacking on the quality of food. Relying on regulars to return. Well, I returned and I could attest that the quality is slacking.. which is upsetting. I've always said, 'quality over quantity'. Little tip from a Latina: When cooking rice don't cook it in large quantities.-it leads to sticky/mushy rice. Rice may not seem like the main dish, but it matters. I would have rather waited another 10 min and be served quality rice instead of the sticky sitch. I received. If that weren't enough my mushroom tacos were cold and the sauce was terrible. I probably won't be returning for the food again. I should have just waited the hour to be seated at Yard House.  Was not a good experience.

I was dying of hunger and all I craved was a burger I looked up places close to home and this came up! So glad we called in our order it was so delicious! I ate the bacon cheeseburger with fries and my son had their kids hamburger. Definitely will order or dine here again! I didn't even get a picture I ate so fast lol

I've tried this location three times now. My family gets the deep dish and I get the gluten free pizza. Two of the three times we've had pizza from this location, mine had been raw. Not undercooked, but absolutely raw to the point that I could not even pull a slice off the pizza without it disintegrating. I've had to put the pizza back in the oven to bake it more. One time out of the three my family's pizza was raw as well. When the pizza from here is cooked it is delicious. Their sauce is one of my favorites, but if I wanted to cook my own pizza I'd buy from a take and bake place. Not giving this pizza place a 4th try.

5 stars could not describe how amazing my visit was. 
I decided to take my best friend to my favorite pizzeria that reminded me of home (I'm from Italy). We were greeted by a really nice girl who sat us outside. And let me tell you. The patio area was so lovely. The weather was also nice so sitting on the patio was the best option. Our server Kara was so helpful! She rocked!! 
Our food was so good. The quattro stagioni was a little slice of home. And my best friends food was also perfect! 
Thank you for you excellent service and giving me the opportunity to show my best friend a taste of Italy!!

Food was pretty bland, I would say this place is about the same as Panda Express. Clean place, friendly staff, my only issue was the waitress had her kids there taking up two tables. The smallest one maybe 2 years old followed her around, she would have to push her away while taking orders and or bringing food to the tables a bit unprofessional but I understand if someone doesn't have child care.

So many places to eat and get above and beyond service!  I can't recommend this restaurant. After our fourth chance... awful service. I walked out for the last time.

Can't say if the food is good or not..we never got any.

The donuts are tasting very chemically flavored. We couldn't even finish them but felt bad throwing them. I would recommend regular store donuts over these. The hot dogs were good but also tasted chemically flavored. The atmosphere is nice but I wouldn't recommend this place even if it was cheaper. I have to add that the food looked good visually but that made the let down even worse. This place is acting like some kind of gourmet spot but it's very far from that.

I'm so sad because I'm not sure if this is still open.

But, the staff is amazing! Always so kind. Ok, I'll be honest I've never tried the food. However, their coconut cold brew coffee is probably the best I've ever had!!! And I've been to LA, Australia, Italy and all the hot coffee shops. I don't live in Idaho but I got it every time I was at the village. It's that good. Hope this place stays open!

The food is fantastic, got chili and beer cheese hot dog and a hangover burger. The quality exceed my expectations. Everything tasted fresh and made to order. The burger was juicy, the beer cheese souse has the perfect hint of quality beer.

The music and atmosphere are a great match for Boise. Great vibe.

1 suggestion, everything is sticky, yummy sticky. Come Summer there's gonna be a line to wash your hands and the whole social distancing thing too.  I'd suggest 1 one or 2 open access foot operated sinks for washing hands.

Food perfect!

I have just sat down and will give a three star for now. Haven't ordered yet. 
Cleanliness: meh. Tables are sticky dirty. 
Ambiance: echoey, sparsely decorated. Institutional. 
Service: fast and friendly so far. Pleasant. 

UPDATE: next day
Okay, I ordered egg rolls and Kung Pau chicken with fried rice. 
Eggrolls were fabulous. Fairly big. Lots of tasty meat and a balance of veggies. Crispy and piping hot. Not greasy. 
Kung Pau had good flavor. The pieces were cut too big for my taste. Each piece was about 1". I'm used to much smaller bits. Just a preference I guess. 
The fried rice was ok. Dark with soy but not a lot of other ingredients. 
I will return to try out other meals but for now it'll be a 4 star due to the egg rolls and the flavor of the Kung Pau.

Went in for a date night last night around 10pm. Left being super disappointed I ordered the buffalo ranch chicken sandwich with fries. My chicken tasted burnt and it looked like it was a piece that had been sitting around for hours... to top it off my fries were cold and stiff. Not once had our waiter asked for a refill or if she could bring us anything. She returned to our table with our check about 10 minutes after our food had been served and we haven't had even started to eat because we had no eating utensils or ketchup. To top it off I asked for a side of mild sauce and they had the nerve to bring me a COLD straight out of the fridge cup of mild sauce. Wow! They also need a new manager since the current one they have always looks upset and like she hates her job. Must be why this place is a dump.

Hostess was rude. Finally got seated and got drinks promptly enough, but waited over an hour for food. Then it came out cold. I felt bad for waitress, she was clearly trying her best but kitchen, hostess, and busers made her job difficult and our experience HORRIBLE.

We enjoyed our meal. Mandarin Chicken and Kung Pho beef both very good. We will be back 

Great service. They have wifi but the sign in password is l o n g.

Customer service.  10 people in line, one worker.  Others just walking by ignoring the situation.  Don't waste time at this place, Ace hardware is much better and very helpful.  Will not go back to Lowe's.

This is a great place. Great food, service, prices and ambiance. The waitress was checking on us a lot, making sure we were taken care of.  Very cool place. The best place we have been to yet in the Boise area.

We love Mexican food and this is one of our top spots in area. Excellent service, warm chips to table and great salsa. I told my husband they seem to cook their food with love. Delicious! We've been back several times.

I found this auto shop on Yelp, and I called 2 make an appointment. I showed up on time, and they had plenty of kid toys, activities 4 my toddler, etc. They even had coffee 4 me. They took a look at my SUV as I needed a diagnostic. Then just simply referred me 2 their colleague since they couldn't solve my problem. Great customer service all around! I highly recommend this place.
Great job,  might be best oil change experience I have ever had.   Usually hate getting it done.  Definitely found my only oil change place I'll ever use.   Thanks guy's.

Had high hopes for this place. 

Wanted some donuts and came in around 7pm and they were sold out. 

Got a Mexican white chocolate latte iced and it was okay. Not the best. 

Got the 208 hot dog it was ehh. 

My sister got the vanilla sky and definitely was different then we thought. It's a cotton candy over a coffee. Nothing even dripped from the cotton candy.. Wanted a refund or exchange and they wouldn't do it, said the cotton candy was special made for the coffee. So she brought my sister a hot chocolate on the house which was nice of her. 

Also there's a huge glass window where you can see them making the dough and the guy was on his phone and making the dough the same time. Talk about germs. Also there were crumbs on the floor around the tables and underneath. 

Not many tables and chairs.

Pretty pricey place. Honestly not great coffee or food so just instagramable pics.

Great food right off the bat. Our new favorite. Clean, friendly, warm atmosphere. Completely reminds me of Guadalajara. And then I just found out that the owner is from Guadalajara. 
Rookie move on my part, I neglected to take pictures before we touched the food.
I wanted to taste their carnitas and they were happy to provide me a side as well as their verde. 

Chips: outstanding
Salsa: great
Enchiladas: perfect. Red sauce was rich and just spicy enough. 
More soon.

I wasn't impressed by all means at this noodles. I waited for ever for a to go order. I was only 2 items. It was pretty dirty there dirty finger prints all over and they didn't take care of dinning area. Dishes were over flowing. And it didn't seem that they were short staffed. Lady was pretty rude after I got my food.

Brother team came exactly on time, worked VERY hard (no rushing), explained what they were doing, and did a great job cleaning my carpets. They even got rid of some stains that had stayed through several cleanings with my Bissell shampooer. Will definitely call these guys again.
Authentic Mexican food at a great price.  A place I have to eat at every time I visit Idaho.  Just the right amount of spice to keep us happy.

Went here today gave 3 stars for the nice man BUT even tho the hot dogs look so good and tasted so BAD where was the snap when you bite them? Costco $1.50 dog/soda deal is so great the $19.00 we spent for 2 dogs fries and cans of soda won't ever happen again

This place is an almost sinful delight.  I think we've ordered something from each restaurant and have NEVER been disappointed.  The pizza is amazing and the clam chowder from Elliot's is the best you'll ever have.  They've recently added breakfast menus...now we're stuck!  The delivery drivers are always on time and very professional.  Granted; it's not the cheapest venue, but the quality and presentation of the food will easily illustrate the concept of value vs. price.

I finally got to check out the "hot" New Mexican place in town via McCall; checked it out with a few friends on a Sunday afternoon. For a Sunday afternoon, it was busy and with all the positive yelp reviews I thought we were in for some great Mexican food. I was sadly disappointed. They serve fresh chips and salsa along with a Mexican "coleslaw" haha I'd say pico yet with the lettuce it resembles more of a "Mexican coleslaw". I like they keep the chips and salsa coming (no extra charge after the 1st basket). The customer at first was attentive and friendly. I ordered the enchiladas Jalisco which is three different types of their enchiladas. The food came out pretty fast; I just felt the food fell flat to me (the rice was bland very little flavor, the enchilada sauce had an off-putting sweet flavor, the mole was okay (more like a canned mole flavor); the positives the beans had great flavor and the portion size was big. Lastly, everyone at my table paid at the same time (waitress took everyone's credit cards but forget to run his; he noticed she didn't run the credit card we waited 10-15 minutes to flag her down so he could pay). She had an attitude about it; it was annoying because he had to wait around to pay while everyone had left. Another thing, they have two sizes of margaritas they automatically without asking you upgrade you to the $8/grande size (you don't realize it til you get the ticket). I was little disappointed in my visit; customer service and the food fell flat I just feel there are better Mexican food options such as MiCasa down the road or the gold standard Enrique's in Kuna.

I was in town here for business one night and many hundreds of miles away the next day... when I realized that I left my credit card there the night before doh!  I called and spoke to Steve the manager and while he was ruthless in verifying my identify (definitely a good thing), he agreed to mail it back to me to my home address in Texas.  He had no obligation to do this but he went above and beyond the call of duty to help me, the customer.  And this saved me a lot of hassle having to cancel the card and get a new one, change all my autopay accounts, etc etc.  

The food at Texas Roadhouse is always great, and this place was no exception to that.  But the customer service rendered here by Steve was truly exceptional.  Thanks Steve, you have earned a customer for life!

I went here with 5 girlfriends to kick off a girls trip and we all really enjoyed it. 
We ordered one of each donut in the case and enjoyed them all! We actually were shorted one, but didn't notice until we had already began eating and didn't mention it. 
Noteworthy donuts were the lemon, OG, and s'mores. The brioche dough is so delicious, they could put anything on it and it would be good! 
We didn't try any of the other menu items, as it was breakfast time, but I look forward to testing out the grilled cheese. And, I hear the fries are delicious.
The prices for donuts are what I expect from a gourmet donut place. But the coffee drinks seemed overpriced, so we all opted out this time. 
The owner or manager, not sure, greeted everyone and explained the flavors. That was a nice touch. Very friendly staff. They even took pics for us, a sweet gesture! 

I took my kids back on a second visit and they both had the maple bacon. It was delicious as well! I'll continue coming and bringing friends, this place has a fun atmosphere and good food!

Back again for the truffle mac! I've been to other locations and made an attempt to at least try everything once, almost there! Definitely a great twist on pasta dishes, very scrumptious. I find their portions generous when you get the Regular size, and the customer service has been friendly at this location.

Wow. Should have heeded prior reviews! Food was horrible. Seriously, worst seasoning and cooking Ive had in a long time. Servers were unresponsive and under staffed. Will never come back here and highly recommend no one eat here. Its that bad.
Checked this place out on a whim...great selection of different hot dogs and amazing donuts! We have already been back and I am sure we will keep going back!

super amazing food was great my whole family had a Great good time steaks cooked to perfection prime rib tasted great baked potatoes were amazing Burger super big cooked just right  excellent service outstanding nice job- very busy even at 4:30 on a Saturday super busy all through the night-  if anything half of us got our food while the other ones had to wait a little bit longer but other than that considering how busy it was - yes it's loud inside but you're with your family so just enjoy it the fresh bread is very tasty buns with the butter,

Went to Einstein's for the first time yesterday and had the greatest experience there. Ramon, William, and Dakota really helped me out a lot the job they did was outstanding. They got the service done really fast and ramon replaced my cabin air filter,which I didn't even know I had. Overall great experience thanks to these guys and I will always get my oil changed here from now on.

The Matador is a perfect place to grab drinks or happy hour snacks before your movie night. The happy hour menu is robust enough to fill you up. Service is always top knotch and drinks are tasty. 
Check it out!

Love the beer selection! Food is really inconsistent. I had finger steaks and fries a month ago and it was pretty good. Tonight I ordered a BBQ bacon burger medium rare with crisp fries. It came out well done with cold fries...... I'm done

Came here for the first time on a Saturday afternoon. My husband and I wanted something to snack on, so we decided to just order a hotdog and a donut to share. 

The staff was extremely helpful and gave us a little history of their restaurant, which originated in Nashville. We weren't totally sure what to order, so the cashier gave us his recommendations. We ended up ordering the 208 and the maple bacon pecan donut (forgot the name of it).

We got to have our dessert first. The donut was extremely soft and very light. It was even warm when we got it. The brioche dough definitely makes it unlike any other donut I've had, in a good way. The icing was a little too sweet for my liking, but hey that's what donuts are about right? The bacon helped balance the sweetness and the pecans added a nice crunch.

Soon after, we got our 208 hotdog. Well not really a hotdog, but a kielbasa dog! The 208 is a kielbasa in between brioche toast with a bacon onion jam and ground mustard drizzle. The first bite was extremely hot, but juicy and delicious. I wish I waited a couple minutes for it to cool down a bit, so I could've fully enjoyed it without fighting through the burn. The brioche bun is a game changer. I don't know why everyone isn't using brioche instead of plain old hotdog buns! It was perfectly toasted on the outside while still being soft in the middle. The bacon onion jam was a great salty & sweet addition and the stone ground mustard on top was perfect to cut through all the fat.

A lot of people consider the prices to be high, but everything is expensive at The Village. I'd gladly spend a little more money here for the unique donuts and dogs and we will definitely be back to try more of their food!

Great place!  Lots of brews.  Dinner starts at 4--best be there a little before as the crowd becomes very large very quickly.  Not a bad meal or brew to be had.  Wait staff is outstanding.  My buddy looked like he was on drugs when he tied into the bread pudding.

New to town & went in for a Friday the 13th Special to try out the shop, my friend highly recommended this shop. Picked out a flash tattoo and once I got tatted my artist Kingsley was very nice, professional, and had a very light touch with his tattoo gun! Tattoo turned out great, clean lines, and is healing great. I went with 5 people and we all got tattooed by different artists and all loved the outcome. Will be going back for future tattoos!

Had a coupon I wanted to use. All was well until I asked the simple question " do you offer military discounts?" The cashier was polite when she said "sorry we do not". But a manager overheard and approached rather closely and affirmed that they do not, never had, and to do so is an abomination. Why would someone do that? I wish I would have called the district manager but I just wanted to let it go. A simple no would be fine. I'm sorry to say because of this persons harsh attitude toward a military person, I will never return.
Special thanks to Jay in the pharmacy. Both my fiancé and I got our covid shots today and he really knows how to work with people who are afraid of needles.

Reviewer #19 

I am a fan of Pita Pit and this location is pretty consistent. It's an international healthier lifestyle living. 

If you don't want the pita bread, you can get anything fork style (salad) and is very good. You can pay a little more and get double the meat. My kids usually go for the breakfast pitas (awaken with Bacon) and I get the chicken souvlaki which is super low in calories. You then add your veggies, fruits (pineapple mostly) and sauces. Many different sauces to chose from. 

This location can be somewhat hidden if you don't know it's there. It's on the corner of Overland and Eagle behind Qdoba next to Big Juds No. 2

OMG the food is delicious! We had the Brussels sprouts, the burger, and chicken fried steak. I love ranch. And they had the best ranch dressing ever. I won't go to a restaurant that has bad ranch!! Then took home an order of cheddar tots and mud pie. Damn I can't say anything bad about this place. Our waitress,Marina, was perfect too. Great service and great food. We will be back! Can't wait to try the salmon and the rib eye!

I walked in unsure of what to get or how to order and they were so helpful walked me through the menu and helped me narrow it down. Kind genuine and clean. I really enjoyed the food and it was ready right as I sat down. I'll be coming here more often.
Ben was extremely helpful and accommodating. He listened to what we wanted and got it done quick and clean. If you have TV's you want installed and wires hidden Ben is the guy to do it!!

Very funky and hip donut / hot dog place. Seems like a strange combo, but they make it work. One of the only places open early and for brunch in The Village. 
Fun selection of donut flavors and they looked delicious. I wasn't crazy about their "brunch" menu. Not much of a selection if you aren't a fried egg fan. I went with the avocado toast and a side of bacon. While there was a whole avocado on the very delicious bread, the cost was not worth it. My bill for the avocado toast, a side of bacon (3 slices), and the mimosa flight was close to $35 - before the tip.
I did love their mimosa flight with different options of flavors. The raspberry and mango were delicious!
I'd like to try it out for lunch and maybe go back for donuts if I'm over that way.
Service was beyond friendly and helpful! Interior of the place was very clean and had some fun decor. With a garage-like door to semi sit outside, it's great for people watching.

Wife and I just had dinner here for the first time.  Our overall experience was excellent.   I made reservations and was promptly seated upon arrival.  Very nice greeting from our hostess and our server Beks was very nice and helpful throughout our meal.  We ordered a calamari appetizer and scones (bread) the calamari was good, not the best we've had as we order this whenever a restaurant has it.  But I would say (and did say to my wife) a 8 on the 10 scale.  We prefer a crispier preparation.  These were more like calamari  finger sticks.  
The wife had the 8oz Prime Rib with a side of Lobster Bisque and Onion Rings.   First of all the scones were so yummy!  Cue ball sized bread balls that melt in your mouth like a fresh donut hole.  My wife said her Prime Rib was equally as good.  The onion rings were large, nice and crispy.  My wife said the Lobster Bisque was next level satisfaction!!  I had a bite and agree!  
I had the Prime Rib French Dip and it was an 11 on the 10 scale.  So flipping flavorful and the bread it was served on tasted just like the awesome scones we just had.  What a combination of wonderfulness.   Our meal was a little slow to get to us but Beks kept us informed and that just gave us a little more time to converse.  We happened to follow a big group's meal and understood the situation.  
Keep up the good work Jakers.  We'll be back!!!!
Great place to go and get your nails, manicure or pedicure. They have a professional staff and ensure that you are happy.

Dinner before movie quick service order the appetizer first which was the RV. Priced it I think $13, it was tasty but definitely not worth it, the portion size is ridiculously small. The wife and I split the fish and chips which was actually quite good, a bit oily but good. Somewhat loud atmosphere and you have to like a bar environment no matter Where are you sit because the entire restaurant is basically designed to circle around a giant center bar, not the best place to go if you were a non-drinker.

The "Manager", an older gal, named T.K. was extremely rude to me today and quite frankly, embarrassed the Maverik name. I went to the location at 57 East Franklin road in Meridian. Two days ago I bough a half gallon of milk around 2am. The gentleman that rang up my transaction did not offer me a receipt and to be honest, I trusted that I didn't need it and was not going to have items to return. I got home and poured a glass of milk only to find out that it had expired. Needless to say I had a date with a porcelain bowl the rest of the morning. I called later that afternoon and asked if I could exchange the milk, as it was bad, but did not have a receipt. He told me he would exchange it without a problem because we, AKA Maverick, stand behind our products and of course he would exchange it. I took it in today and explained the situation to Virginia, who was EXTREMELY, INCREDIBLY NICE!!! She had me get another 1/2 gallon.  After looking at the dates, the sell by date was 9/22/19. I explained that I didn't want to have this issue again, even though the milk didn't expire until October 1, 2019. The 1/2 gallon I brought in had the same sell by, and expiration dates as the item I bought. I asked if I could exchange it for a different brand of milk, or something of equal or less value. She offered to get the manager, T.K. The manager told me, very rudely, that none of the milk was expired, the sell date is the last day that company can sell/deliver the products to Maverik. I explained that I would feel bad if I went home and had the same issue; could I exchange for a different brand, or get a full refund. She turned into a "fake nice", very drawn out voice/attitude of sarcasm and said, "Ohhhh suuurrreeee! I guessss we can dooo that! Even though none of the milk is expired!" At that point I asked for a full refund. She continued to be fake nice sarcastic and to tell me the milk was fine. I cut her off, and asked for my money again. She started to process the return, again, trying to tell me the date was a sell by date. I asked her, "Why would I buy a product that your store cannot accept after a certain date? What makes you think it's an issue for me to not want it if your company can't even accept it past the sell by date?"  She opened her moth to argue again and I abruptly asked for her name, who was the manager, that Virginia was amazing, and could I please have the number for the company's corporate office. She provided me with the number, my refund, then as I was walking out, she let out another sarcastic drawl..."Have a nice daaaaayyyyy pretty girl!!!"  I will continue to buy from Maverik, but if T.K. is working when I buy there, I will not make a purchase that day. Maverik, I'm sorry that this employee has embarrassed what otherwise is a really great store, with your sarcastic, rude choice in management.

This is not a place I would recommend to anyone. Not because of the food, but because of the service and their lack of attention on the details. My wife, kid and I went to this place for dinner. We ordered the western bacon, the guacamole burger and a chicken strip basket for my son. Now first and foremost, this establishment doesn't have anything a burger joint doesn't. They all have decent food generally for the most part like any other burger joint I've been too(assuming they don't burn the food). But where they have a massive downfall is in customer service and the details of the order. The lady who took the order got it right as it was on the receipt. But was extremely snippy when taking it. But to begin with after sitting at the drive up sign to order for five minutes(literally) I only here someone come on to say "has someone taken your order?" To which I replied "No" and they responded with. "Give us a moment and we will take it".(Clearly this sets a tone of "your time isn't important to me"). After another five minutes someone comes on. I begin my order, after everything I say she asks me to repeat it, at least three times. After being in the drive up for 30 minutes we get to the window to pay. Only to sit, don't get greeted or anything. Finally the girl opens the window. Now I have a 20 in my hand and two penny's to hand her; My total was $18.02. I try to hand her the pennies and she just snatches the $20 out of my hand and turns away. No greeting, we try and get her attention to give the pennies as I really don't want 0.98 back. Another girl with purple hair comes to the window. I explain to her we are simply trying to get her attention she didn't take my pennies and I really don't want all the change back. To only here her say "I can't hear you". She gives me a look, and I can immediately tell it's the same girl who took the order as she displays the same attitude she gave me when I was trying to place it. She grabs the pennies out of my hand and tells the other girl to give me two dollars in a very rude way. The lack of team work displayed between the employees explains the wait times. As the business clearly was not operating appropriately. To whom ever owns the establishment, I would highly recommend spending some time setting standards for your employees. If you don't this business is bound to fail, I've seen it time and time again. If you don't have time I'd recommend hiring a manger to work the place to do the same then if you have one(hate to say it but they need to go, or need a coaching session themselves)... Now to finish the story, the girl turns hands me my change and says "I'm so sorry, today is my first day and I'm really lost in here. I'm really frazzled because no one is helping me either so I don't know what to do. I apologize. It's really f**king bad in here." Now if that doesn't say something coming from the employee, excusing her poor choice of words from a professional stand point. Or good manners when representing the business. She is telling the customer what is being perceived is true. Well we sit and sit and then the food comes. Now immediately I think I better check the food. Welp I have a two burgers with NO sauce on either one(we didn't order it that way) and chicken strips with fries and not tots like I did order. I sit trying to get the girls attention she finally opens the window and I explain to her we asked for tots it's on the receipt but you gave us fries mistakenly. I assume they want it back so I try and hand it to her. The new girl doesn't know what to do so she turns to the girl with purple hair. She comes to the window rolls her eyes and says keep the chicken and fries we will make you your tots and slams the window. A minute maybe goes by and someone comes to the window and says can you please pull up by the flowers while we make your order correctly. So I do, I sit and sit and sit and now we have spent almost forty five minutes in the drive up here only to get the girl with purple hair to bring the tots. I roll down the window and she sticks the bag out and says with an attitude "Hers your tots!" In a very smart aleck tone. No apology, no sorry for the wait, no I apologize for the in connivence. Then rolls her eyes again and turns and walks off. So long story short, if you want meh burgers that you can get at McDonald's for a fraction of the time, less money and same quality. Then you'll enjoy this place. If you want to save yourself the experience and time don't go here. Only up side compared to "fast food" was fresh cooked patties. Everything else about this establishment: it's atmosphere, customer service, attention to detail and a general understanding of how to operate a business from a customer service stand point doesn't apply. Happy eating folks!... We have given up trying to eat here. To many consistent stories like this with this establishment!

Not bad if you like that club atmosphere. But if you're wanting to have any sort of conversation during your dinner I suggest you go somewhere else. Good beer selection, bad food. They need a whole new kitchen staff to be honest. Been here few times now and each time the food has gotten worse. Dryyyy buns/tortillas/bread. Keep the bags sealed, it's common sense!!!!! Oil in the fryer hasn't been changed out since November I'm sure, you can taste it in every bite of your French fries. New kitchen staff, that's what I'd change. Oh and a little less enthusiastic DJ #deaf

AMAZING BLOODY MARYS!! I'm from CA and came out to surprise my friend for her birthday. We stopped by this place. The food was delish and the drinks are to die for. I'm picky on how bloody Mary's are made but this one takes the cake!!! Try the Mac b cheese yummy!! Staff was super nice and quick! Thanks Homestead!! I'll see you in 3 mos!

This has been one of my husbands favorite spots when he travels with me to Boise but this past Thursday evening not so much!  Granted we got there at 8:00 PM and they close at 9 but I still expect a hot meal.  Their salad bar wasn't bad, the soup bar - all the soups were so thick I could have used a fork.  My baked potatoe wasn't even warm enough to melt the butter.  My husband ordered the chicken fettuccini which you would expect to be hot but sadly it wasn't. They also added sliced zuchinni to this dish - really? It was so over cooked it turned to mush! 
Not impressed at all, but I will give them another shot at an earlier hour.

Good food and good service. We live less than five minutes from Enriques, but make the trip here instead,  and it's definitely worth it every time. We've never had a bad experience here. 

Veggies in fajitas should be crisp and flavorful, and they totally nail it here, no soggy, overcooked, oily veggies here. 

There is a diverse array of good flavors to be found here.  Try the camarones tamarindo for a truly unique and tasty dish.  

My wife loves their carne asada tacos, and she is very picky.  They are really excellent, though I do agree with other reviewers that their tortillas have room for improvement. 

Today, I ordered a standard chicken enchilada and was pleasantly surprised. It wasn't a giant gooey sloppy mess of cheese and sauce like you might find elsewhere. The sauce was delicious, with a hint of smokiness and spice from the adobo flavoring. The chicken was cooked perfectly and there was a lot of it in there for it being an enchilada.  Actually, it probably could've just used a bit more cheese and onions. 

We've been here about 10 times and it's always consistently good. Nothing mind blowing--we're not in Southern California after all--but give it a chance. The draft beers are available in 25 oz, and when you ask for a "couple of limes", the servers take note and bring at least two!  I love it!

Wow these kids were impressive. I'll admit when I rolled up a few minutes late and saw 4 teenagers in my driveway I wasn't sure what to think but they got right to work, so professional, and did everything I needed them to do in under the 2 hours mark they were given. I was extremely impressed and highly recommend their services!
Fish tacos were a 2 out if 5. My wife didn't like her fish and chips at all. Probably won't be back.

I just landed in Boise after being awake and traveling for 8 hours from LA. We stopped here for lunch right after. Having two little babes in our group is always a fun and interesting experience and our waitress who is also a mom of a little babe was so amazing and accommodating! They quickly brought out the kids meal (sooner the lil babes meal is ready the better) and started us off with some warm bread. I got the chicken portobellos sandwich with a side salad. The side salad had a bit of cheese and a tangy balsamic dressing. The sandwich was on thick cut focaccia and the chicken and mushroom melted with cheese and pesto was phenomenal! Flavor was great! I would for sure order again.

Two of us arrived here with no reservations. It was either. 45 min. wait or eat at the bar. We chose the bar. I ordered meatloaf and Mac n cheese. It was excellent! My wife had prime rib. It too was great. Great selection of beers and great food. We have absolutely no complaints. The staff was fantastic. Can't wait to get back to Meridian to have dinner.

Be very careful if you have an allergy. I love salmon and tuna and have eaten sushi my whole life while being allergic to shellfish. I specifically told the waitress and chefs that I was allergic to shellfish, crab, shrimp and lobster. I ordered a roll that didn't mention any of those items and had an entire conversation with the waitress about my allergy in front of the chefs. They then served me a roll (called crispy which at the time mentioned nothing about crab). I asked why there was crab all over my sushi when I said i was allergic and her reply was"that is why we were so confused with what you ordered, it says it right on the menu that it's topped with crab"
I told her no it doesn't otherwise I wouldn't have ordered it.
She then argued and told me she would show me the menu herself so she tried, and like I said, it doesn't and didn't mention crab. 
They then told me it's imitation crab and i refused to eat it.
They made me a new one and she then reminded me that next time when i order to make sure there isn't crab on the roll HAHAHAHA wow. Also, this was Sunday October 18th 2020 on my birthday....

I hope no one from Italy makes a visit to Blaze Pizza while visiting the United States. They'd keel over watching an industrial stamping machine pressing out pizza dough. 

That was my first impression walking up to the counter at Blaze Pizza. Good dough doesn't have to be twirled in the air: That's mostly for show.  But hand-stretching yields a much better crust and is why you don't see quality pizzarias using a rolling pin. 

The crust makes or breaks a pizza in my book. For others, it's a mountain of toppings. At Blaze, it seemed simply a vessel for containing the other ingredients. There was nothing remarkable about the flavor, although I give them props for the charred bits on the bottom, the signature of high-temperature ovens.

The dough hardly lived up to the company slogan: Dough Done Right. If you want a lesson, go to Portland and check out Apizza Scholls or Ken's Artisan Pizza. Now, they know how to do it right. 

Blaze offered a large selection of toppings, from the standard pizza meats (remember, Pepperoni is an American invention not found in Italy) to a wide variety of vegetables. It's rare to find artichokes, roaster garlic cloves and sautéed onions at a pizza joint, so I praise them for that. However, basil should be added after the pizza has been cooked not before.

They're also generous with the amount of toppings they add, although I would avoid the temptation to load it up with everything. The more toppings you have, the soggier the finished pizza gets. Not a good thing.

The pizza I got was good. It just left me wanting a better, more flavorful crust. 

Despite the place becoming very busy soon after they opened at 11 a.m. on a Saturday, the staff was very friendly and with pizzas taking three to four minutes each, customers didn't have to wait long.

I was shopping for a specific item. An employee had a very large cart in the aisle.  I waited as she finished working in the section I was looking for.  She knew I was trying to find items in this area yet moved herself over but left large cart right where I was trying to look.  I asked if I could move her cart.  Not rude or demanding, just a request.  She looked at me, rolled her eyes and flipped her hair.  This is not the first time I've had employees act s as if I'm in their way, but definitely the most obnoxious!
FAST EDDY'S IS THE BEST GAS STATION EVER! It has everything thing you could ever imagine and it never runs out of anything I love it so much. I go there once a week at least
Today I came in with my family and 6 kids and Zach our server was amazing with the kids and very attentive. He make sure that we had everything we need and we never had an empty glass.

The food was large and fresh.My boyfriend had the burger was a huge stesk burger cooked exactly how he asked for it. The fries were crispy and warm but a lot of them stuck together. Still good however. I had the soup of the day. It was a tad on the spicy side. Still excellent fresh steak in soup was super tender. Had a side salad wow was so good. All fresh and truly chopped which I love i dont have to spend my dinner cutting up my salad. Our waitress was on it tonight and tipped good to show for it.
Tasty kale salad! Will be back to try the flat bread and tomato bisque. The staff is friendly and is a nice atmosphere.

We usually like this place but our last visit was a very bad experience.  The food was fine, however a trip to the restroom was a disaster.   Two employees were in the restroom... one of them was vomiting his guts out while the other was asking if he was going back to work.   Needless to say my dinner experience was ruined!

I don't know if he went back to work but mgmt should he sent him home.  Restaurant employees coming to work sick is not cool, not cool indeed.

Is there anything better than steaming hot buttered rolls smothered in cinnamon butter? Yup...unlimited steaming hot buttered rolls smothered in cinnamon butter!

Yes, this is a chain, but it doesn't feel like it. The staff are so kind and accommodating and the food is delicious, affordable, and are portioned high. 

Every Monday night is kids night with free sundaes or root beer floats! They even have a magician move from table to table impressing kids with magic tricks and free balloon animals. 

This is our families favorite spot to eat. It's delicious, we don't break the bank, and we always come home with leftovers!

Krispy Kreme is always coming up with something new.  Mini donuts.  Valentine donuts.  Summer donuts decorated like strawberries and pineapples.  Chocolate glazed chocolate donuts.  There's almost always something new and different every time I stop in (maybe 6 times a year).

The downer is that when I do stop in, it's in the evening Sunday after work and they are often out of certain donuts.  One time they were out of a donut in the case, but I spied some on a rack behind the counter and had to ask if I could have one of those (they obliged).  

The lobby is not always super clean - it's not gross, just doesn't look like it's been swept, or tables wiped down recently.

Delicious donuts - better when they are fresh though, but that is probably the case with all donuts really - window to the assembly line where the kids can watch the production of donuts, bathroom for patron use, and decent prices (if you are getting 7 donuts, it's a better value to get the dozen).

While Hobby Lobby has great products, and I enjoy looking at their home décor items, I'm writing specifically about my experience with the Meridian, Idaho framing department. 

I went in to have a montage of pictures matted and framed.  At the top of the picture was my surname.  I was asking the framing department to cut that part off and include in within the matting at the bottom of the frame.  My sister had just had the same thing done at the same store within the last month, and it looked great.  However, when I made the request (in her presence) I was treated poorly by the employee working the counter.

First of all, he seemed annoyed when we approached the counter and asked to look at their stack of in-house mats (we waited for a few minutes before ringing the bell to get his attention).  After providing them, he complained that he still had stuff to do in the back.  We told him we were fine; we still needed to select our mats.  Once we did, we called him back and made our request.  When we described what we wanted, he corrected our terminology and said, "That's not what you call that."  He was condescending in tone and attitude.  Then he told us that their store policy didn't allow them to fulfill our request.  When we explained that my sister had had the same thing done less than a month earlier, he just repeated the store policy and told us the picture ourselves and then bring it back.  As we walked away, he passed another employee and said (loudly enough for us to hear), "There's another one asking us to cut art."

We called the manager to complain, and he asked us to return after the employee was off work; they would fulfill our request.  Apparently the store policy had changed, but the employee's attitude was the bigger problem.

In the end, I was happy with their work.  And perhaps this was just an isolated instance, but it was very off-putting and I would think twice before having Hobby Lobby frame my pictures and/or artwork again.

Went in to buy a dozen of their dinner rolls and a house salad to go. Andrew, who took my order, first typed my phone number wrong even when I told him twice to correct it. Also after waiting for more than 20 minutes to get my order, he called me by a wrong name, and then when I  checked my order,  we found out that he only picked up half a dozen instead of the whole dozen. I really like this restaurant, but the past two visits here have been a disappointment with their customer service.

Food is pretty good. Everything was tasty, but nothing left a huge impression. The cocktail menu and drinks were fantastic though. Very creative and well balanced. It is nice to be able to sit outside on the patio and enjoy a meal with friends.

I really wanted pizza. We had just moved here and were unsure where to go. This was a bad choice. Family visiting. Thought we'd make an order to check it out. 
I am a chef as is my daughter. Two chefs that love pizza and grew up in the bay area. Really not good odds for a restaurant but we had to try. Ordered two pizzas thinking that they would at least represent. The meal was inedible. The pizza had nothing whatsodver to do with the representation online. Docked dough. Really? The best part of a good pizza besides sauce is the crust. It should have a crown. Have bubbles. Cooked until crusty, bubbly, cheesy, wonderfulness 
So sad and so sorry. We made the wrong choice. From what I see, many people like the food. For that, I am happy for them. All I can really say thank you and I wish you well.

Pretty good service food and drinks! The only thing that sucks is waiting to be seated and there is peanut shells everywhere which is insane I didn't know so many humans ate like chickens and just drop the shells all over the place. Best fried pickles I've ever had too!

This is a follow up to my previous reviews. If you have a family of small kids, you might want to think about if you want to go here or not. Its loud everywhere.

The last time I was here, I sat in the bar area. The lights in the bar area are red. I asked one of the wait staff why the lights are red and she did not know.

She guessed that it was for atmosphere, but I am not sure that I get that. Why would red lights make for a better atmosphere? 

The steaks here are good, but they seem t often have issues with getting them cooked to the correct temp.

So if you have a steak here, cut into it when they bring it to make sure its correct.

I had the hamburger the last time I was here. Dont bother with the hamburger here. One would think that a steak house could cook a better hamburger. 

But Id guess that maybe they do not get many orders for hamburgers. They are just cooked on a flat top. They are pretty boring with no real flavor at all.

Dont waste your time with their hamburger!!

The steaks are good. The steak sauce is good. The Pina Cololada is good.

They USE to be good. Now more often then not my order is wrong, late or didn't get ordered at all.They dont even have the courtesy of letting someone know when a order is running late or a tracking number so I can know where it's at. I have had to buy extra supplies on Amazon more then once when they have dropped the ball. After the went to the call center it has gotten very sloppy.

Finally!!!! A real, genuine, authentic place in Meridian for craft donuts, craft dogs and brew! Coffee and Alcohol. I hope they have memberships. The staff is amazing and obviously passionate about their product. The people that can't understand why they can't roll in at 5pm and not get a donut, go across the street to get a factory donut. This place is all about quality, not quantity and is famous for that reason. The Elote Loco and BAT dogs were Epic- simply E.P.I.C. All of the donuts we have had were the best we have ever had.

Crazy combo, huh? Donuts? Hot dogs? Well, we like both of those and were hungry so we decided to give this place a try.
They had just re-opened after the govt. mandated shutdown so we were especially happy to be purchasing food from them.
The dog was outstanding!  Check the menu out because these aren't the typical hot dog combos you might be expecting. My dog was a sausage from a house recipe, served on a yummy buttered and toasted bun, with delicious toppings.  
Of course I had to buy my husband a giant chocolate-filled donut, topped with a homemade seared marshmallow. He ate the entire thing immediately upon receipt!
Looks like they have great coffee too so do give this place a try for whatever you might be hankering for!

I go here multiple times a month on dates, with my family or with friends. Everything here is too notch authentic Mexican cousine. My recommendation is the carne asada tacos add cheese. Literally the best carne asada tacos I've ever had and I'm from California.

I'm not a big fan of Mexican food, but it's one of my husband's favorites, so from time to time I get to indulge him by going out for Mexican food.  Much to my surprise this was an excellent experience! 
Pueblo Lindo is a new Mexican restaurant in a very convenient location of Eagle and Ustick. The interior is clean and nicely decorated. The chairs are very comfortable and the ambience is all around inviting. 
It was not quite 5pm and the restaurant was filling up quickly. They were able to seat us without delay and despite being a new restaurant and busy, they did great with the service!  
You are welcome with bottomless chips and salsa but even better, ask for a spicier salsa and you have two options (jalapeño and habanero). These were excellent!!! 
The menu is quite long with many choices but we ordered the 3 Enchiladas Combo (shredded chicken)and the Carne Asada Tacos... and WOW!  The perfect sized servings of beans and rice that come with the entrees, and the flavors were spot on. 
The reason for four stars and not five is because the prices for drinks are a little steep and come with just one refill at that price and the bathroom facilities were just not very clean. 
Overall this was a great experience, great food, and friendly and quick service. For me... this restaurant made Mexican something I could do more often with my husband.

In the middle of the village, with the colored water fountains right next by, the yard house is a really nice place to be.
The patio is really enjoyable during summer.
Get ready to have some wait (averaging 25 minutes) as the place gets packed easily. Especially during their Tuesday specials and  happy hours. The service is pretty slow at that too.
The food is good and the choices on the menu is large. We tried various salads and burgers and nobody was disappointed of the quality. But we all noticed that they are using really big and large plates that are not filled all the way. It makes your meal look small, even if the portion is there.
The downside of this place is also the price of the drinks. It's way overpriced and same for some of the entrees.

We've used Dowdy's since 2017. Both my wife and I are extremely pleased with their service and pricing. We had both regular service and repairs done and have always felt we were treated well. We trust the team at Dowdy's in Meridian!

Best Mexican restaurant in Meridian. The food is very tasty and the price is very reasonable. The staff is away friendly, if you love Mexican food you have to give these guys a try. You will not be disappointed.

So their bbq pizza definitely sucks! Tried it one time before, but decided to give it another chance and will not be ordering again. No flavor at all, hardly any cheese, chicken and bbq sauce. Not worth the price at all!!

Absolutely Fantastic! Our new go to Mexican Restaurant. The best carne asada tacos I have ever had and we are big time taco truck lovers. My kids usually order the enchiladas and never have any  leftoverers. As a matter of  fact when we come here  we never have any left overs to take home because it all gets eaten.

The service is absolutely  wonderful.

Placed my order online for curbside pick up two hours before my chosen time of 6:30, arrived on time and received a text just as I was pulling in that my order was ready.  You would think everything was going as scheduled, right?  I go to pull in to a slot and see there is a long line of cars all helter skelter waiting for their orders as well, I call the number for curbside to let them know I had arrived for my curbside pick up. 30 minutes later all the car in front of me are still waiting and I have an employee approach my car and tells me that what I had ordered over two hours earlier was no longer available and would I like to order something else.  Are you kidding ME!  This place is a joke, save your time and money and go ANYWHERE else.
Best Mexican restaurant in the valley! The food is fresh, delicious, authentic, and huge portions. The staff is so friendly and courteous, every single time. Affordable too!

Talk about poor service.
Called twice today requesting to speak to a provider and got a receptionist on the phone saying they could not call in my medication. When I asked who I was speaking to she says a staff member and that the doctor can't call me back.

In what world is it about making the process as inconvenient as possible for the patient and forcing them to pay for a second visit, Without even a call back from a doctor.
Quality food ! The steak is always juicy and cooked exactly how I like and the sides are fresh and tasty, I would recommend everyone give them a try.
Best sushi in the Treasure Valley!

Kate is SO wonderful!! She is so passionate and bubbly, my experience was amazing. I loved that it was such a personal appointment and a friendly, fun atmosphere. Kate is so attentive to details and which features I liked or disliked in each dress I tried on. Every dress I tried on was absolutely gorgeous! I'd highly recommended Kate's Bridal Cottage to anyone looking for their perfect wedding dress.

This rating has nothing to do with food or  others working there, blonde bartender needs to get a job she likes, went to use restroom and she took my drink and tossed it when my husband wasn't looking. I let her know and she wasn't sorry about it or nice at all. Another over worked unhappy person and so let down at the attitude as obviously my husband was still there so she knew we were not done yet. As a matter of fact she wasn't nice last time either.

This place is amazing! The salad with the house dressing is so good! The steak sandwich was so good. Macaroni and cheese was awesome! Different flavors of cheese. Have you ever seen an old lady lick her fingers?? I did!
Love how they really take care of their restaurant and are very friendly. They seem to take great care in their business cause it shows it.  Very happy costumers

Since we ordered out, I will just review the food. 

My family of 5 all had some sort of negative reaction from the food. Today is day two of my gastric excorcisim, my youngest threw up last night after consuming some fried rice and the rest of my family suffered a night of upset stomachs. 

Overall the food was terrible. The fried rice was bland, sweet and sour pork was overdone, sause was tasteless, the General Tsos chicken was a sweet soggy mess. Avoid the cashew shrimp at all costs as they are not de-veined (they still have their intestines and poop in them). 

We won't be ordering from there again.

If I could give Matador a 0 star, I would. I never have issues at the Boise Matador, and go there often and love every experience. I had a horrible experience with the hostess Cami on Cino de Mayo. I was sat at the busiest table in the restaurant and asked to be moved. She was incredibly rude about it and said I had to be put back on the waiting list. Once I talked to the manager, she sat me in a new spot immediately. Then I come back tonight and they bring me a salad with completely unseasoned shrimp on it. I asked for the salad to go back to the kitchen and they brought me a new one. Meanwhile, it's 105 degrees outside so I politely ask the same hostess if I can sit inside at the table that had been empty since I walked in and she said I would have to be on a 45 minute wait list even though I had my food already. Then they brought me my full bill, and when I asked for my salad to be comped, they could only give me $10 off which is ridiculous. I finally just accepted the situation, walked out and the table I requested inside was still empty. When I asked the hostess Cami why I couldn't have been been seated there, she told me that she had already seated and cleared the table in the 10 minutes I had still been sitting outside. Then from the entrance I see her pointing at the table and yelling/complaining to her coworkers about me. I WILL NEVER GO BACK TO THIS LOCATION. SUCH HORRIBLE CUSTOMER SERVICE.
I love coming in! The vibe is perfect, food is delicious, and coffee is definitely worth it!

Visited the Vault Saturday 11/23. Great selection and service. In a 100+year old building on Old Town Meridian great seating tv's to watch the game. I'd recommend the place to anyone looking for a relaxing place to enjoy a smoke and a little company.

Went in for lunch today... beautiful overcast day. We sat on the patio and immediately noticed just how filthy the ground was. It literally looks like no one has ever washed it down with a hose. There was small pieces of food stuck all over, stains, the lines in the cement were filled with unsightly grime and... well it was just nasty. Also, the tables were really dusty. Food was good but seriously take a minute each morning and clean it up!

Typically I come for happy hour and I'm always amazed at the quality of the food. Being Mother's Day we thought it would be a great idea to take my teen son with me. It was again just as nice as always. The food quality is top notch, the salad bar is fresh and well maintained and the server comes around just enough but is not invasive. 
This place is one I would highly recommend for either lunch or dinner.

If you're drunk and inebriated... you can certainly eat here. Cuz your upchuck will blend nicely with the crappy food they bring you, after they mess up your order. I can't believe how far yard house has fallen from quality. Not good AT ALL....
I love this place. A must go to when in from out of town. The BEST desserts. A must visit! Always 5 stars

Fast Eddy's new Car wash bent my front license plate out
I had this car since it was new; it's a 2007 never happened before at any car wash
Called and talked to Justin
He said yes this is happening to some cars
They will put a license plate holder on it for me so it never happens again
I asked about a free car wash for my trouble
He ignored the question and repeated the license plate holder offer
Here's photo after I bent it back myself but I'll need to unscrew it and do a better job at home sometime 
Not looking for a holder per se
If I wanted a holder I would get one that I like

This was DELICIOUS. I think it's now called panda garden, or at least that is what is on the menu. I got the garlic shrimp lunch special and it is a decent amount of food for $7.50. Will definitely be back to try the sushi.

We were so happy with the total carpet renovation! Michael was professional and his installers were friendly and informative. They let me ask my questions and even helped me move a heavy dresser because my husband has tendinitis in both arms. Fast, friendly and a pleasure to work with!

Having lived in Texas for 2 years before coming back to Idaho, I've got to say - best salsa we've had since being back in Idaho! Everything was fresh and flavorful. Every dish we had was great. Great service. Very clean facilities. All around, great place.

I have been going here for a few months now and I couldn't be more grateful for Better Life! I heard about this place through a few friends and they had a deal for a decently cheap first exam.
I expected nothing to be wrong with me because I wasn't in consistent pain, but after a thorough exam (including E-rays, nervous system scans, etc.) discovered I have more wrong with me than I thought! 
After talking through payment and getting on the same page about everything, I decided to go through with the treatment. After a few months, I feel like a new person! Not only has my body stopped hurting when doing some activities, I have noticed a change in my emotional and mental health as well! 
The staff here is so wonderful, kind, and insightful. Dr. Price is very intelligent and explains everything in full depth while also using research to back his word (with citations!). 
Overall, I have been extremely satisfied with my decision to come to Better Life Chiropractic.
Been here a couple of times with a prime rib craving and they don't disappoint. Food has been great, drinks are good, prices are decent, and the atmosphere is fun and lively. I like it!

Rancid oil! Very prominent in the Mongolian beef. 
The moo shu pork was just OK. Not a lot of Asian flavor. Kung pao chicken and the Mongolian beef (and due to the bad oil in the Mongolian beef we didn't eat much) were not spicy at all. Will not go back here.

Delicious. The broth was super creamy and tasty.  The pork wasn't too fatty and thinly sliced. So good. Super clean place. Staff is a family and super nice.  They just opened on Tuesday.  Can't wait to come back.

Today I went to the Walmart bought some electronics, needed a guy to bring the key to open it, waited for 45min, nobody showed up, an other assistant he helped me to called that guy couple times, then I went to the front desk for customer service, they called him again, then I saw him came over, and nothing to say, how come? That was so terrible, the worst service attitude !If they don't want to sell something, should be not displayed.So awful...

An excellent place to meet friends. I have had many dishes at Jakers a big surprise for lunch Meatloaf... Yes meatloaf and garlic mash potatoes... Excellent... Everything I've had has always been fresh and Good.  They also "overpour" drinks... The whole place is friendly!

Their mission is amazing.  www.insideoutcares.org 

They are absolutely delightful.  
INside our was established to brings awareness and understanding of human trafficking to our communities instilling a commitment for action to benefit those impacted. 

They came to Donnelly and served the Valley County community.  Such an incredible outreach and so informative.

This place gets a 10 out of 10 for the service. Everyone was very sweet to me, even when I messed up my own salad order; they were willing to fix it for me. Yeah that's right, I used a semicolon... hold on to your butts. 

I came in with a coupon allowing me to get an entire pizza and a drink and a free side salad or dessert. I got the salad that's dressed like buffalo chicken: blue cheese, buffalo sauce, and an assortment of peppers. I was impressed how they dressed the salad. Making my pizza was fun, this is really the Chipotle of the pizza world. Or if you haven't been to Chipotle, this is a 'create your own pizza place' but you get to watch them do it. That's right, you watch them do it right in front of you. Pretty punk rock right? Twisted, bro. Twisted. Bird up. 

I was totally pumped that they had a coconut fresca, but it was fairly bland and surprisingly tart. Then I thought I'd mix the passion fruit and the coconut because I live on the edge, you know, I'm a straight up rebel... steal your dog and leave it back on your front porch three weeks later after teaching it inane tricks like how to leap onto your head and stay there like a furry helmet...... I'm that kinda crazy. Anyways it didn't taste good, the passion fruit was super tart. Needs more sugar maybe? I mean this isn't a health food store, it's okay to splurge a little on the sweet drinks. 

The pizza was good, I got the meat lovers. I love the thin tasty crust. I thought the red sauce was solid, and you know... cheese is s'good.

Okay that's all. It's pizza. It's good. You're good. I love you. I miss you. Be with me.

We ordered our lunch online. When we got there it was not ready and we were told that they had not received our online order even though we had the confirmation. We were told it did not go through and online orders go to the owners phone who was not there. We ended up waiting 20 minutes for our orders to be made and we were also asked to show our bank accounts to verify the payments went through. Later that day I was asked to give them my information again and ended up going bavk out the following day to pay because they could not retrieve my payment from their online ordering. The food is good but they only have one employee working during the lunch rush and they need to remove or come up with a better online ordering process.

Decided to go to Jakers for Valentine's Day, they were offering their prime rib seafood buffet and that sounded good. We've been here before and I remember it being quite expensive and not very impressive but this sounded like a great opportunity since we are prime rib and crab lovers. We were able to get a decent seat and took off for the buffet. They have a great salad bar with good soup options including clam chowder, which I recommend. Unfortunately if we were to base the quality of food served this night we would never be back.  The snow crab was terrible, so full of water and hardly any meat in them, and even still partially frozen. No need for a crab cracker as they are all soggy, bad idea for them as you have to eat 10 times more crab just to get the same amount. Prime rib was OK and sliced fresh in front of you, we could not believe the mediocrity of everything served this night, and for almost $50 a person it should've been much better. The staff is very friendly and waitresses are very attentive, will never be back for this special ever again, may come in for the soup salad lunch but that would be about it. Again terrible representation of the restaurants food quality, just cause it's a buffet doesn't mean you have to lower your standards.

I won't be able to say enough about my favorite place to dine in Meridian...but the place is too busy without you showing up too, so maybe I'll just hit a couple of highlights. 

The Happy Hour menu is the bomb. Great prices and portions. Try the stuffed jalapeños. And the margaritas are downright legit. No skimping on the tequila!

I've never met a staff member that wasn't friendly...but the bartenders do have a mystery about them. You'll just have to see what I mean. 

It's a noisy place. Shame on me for thinking I could hold a dinner seminar in the balcony. 

That's probably saying enough...after all, I really don't hope to see any more of you show up.

Horrible Mexican food! Nothing is authentic. 
I need to accept the reality that the only really tasty Mexican food is when I cook it. Even if I don't feel like cooking, it beats wasting money

I have always loved going to a Bed Bath and Beyond to shop for odd things or even shopping for a bedding. I just moved near this one and went to get window coverings and bathroom essentials. Spent over 1k and was happy with what I bought. I used a coupon for 20% off one item. When we got back home I decided to go with a window treatment store because of the shapes of my windows. So I returned my coverings in an unopened box. The lady at the return desk ask me if I wanted to use my 20% off that I used earlier for one item and I had told her "no" it's ok not sure if I plan to get anything. However, I planned to buy few small items but nothing big.
In the meantime another employee walked behind her and they both mocked me as if I was being a snob!!! I'm sorry but don't judge me unless you know me. So many nice people here, why hire 2 that can't work with the public!!!!!!!!

I came to blaze pizza because I had a coupon for a free pizza for downloading the app and being a first time customer. I showed the coupon to the people at the front and they said the girl at the register would take care of it for me. The boy that helped me was very nice. The girl with dark brown hair and braids was very rude. She threw my pizza together and didn't even put toppings on half the pizza. I had to ask for the toppings to be on both sides. Then at the checkout when I gave her my coupon she was very rude and just said they didn't accept those (even though the people at the front told me it would be taken care of) then she just stood there and stared at me, I told her I was sorry but didn't have money to pay for the pizza and she just said sarcastically "you don't have money?" Then shook her head and had them throw away the pizza. As a first time customer this made me never want to come back to this location ever. Oh also I was with other people that got pizzas and I asked for a water cup which she never gave me either.

Although food is good not sure if it's worth the wait and the loud environment. Been to several of these restaurants and they're all the same atmosphere, can't hear the person across from you due to the loudness of the music and people.  If you're looking for a fun environment that you have to yell to be heard then I guess it's OK.

I posted another photo last night and realized that I hadn't written a review yet.  

Dad, hubby and I love the pizza here.  That's the most important thing about a pizza place, no?   And at $7.95 apiece, we can each order a pizza exactly how we like it, eat half and take the rest home for another meal.  The $7.95 price, by the way, includes as many toppings as you like.  It's Subway-style, so you can see the various toppings behind the glass partition.  So far, all of the toppings I have tried tasted great and were fresh.  I like that they include things like fresh mozzarella (ovalini), fresh basil, and other fun stuff like caramelized onions and roasted garlic.  Don't forget the saucy drizzles like Balsamic vinegar or pesto!   The crust is very thin, but that's how they can get it to cook in only 3 minutes.

They don't serve beer, but they have a very nice selection of sodas and other drinks.  They have taps of lemonade and blood orange lemonade, too.

The atmosphere is purposefully loud.   There are hardwood tables and hardwood chairs... so I take it that they want us to chow down and move right along.  That's fine with me.
