Take-out boxes are pre-assembled and ready to grab at the beverage station.  There's a nicely-sized patio area for when weather permits, but it sits right up against busy Eagle Road.

Throughout my many visits, I have found the staff to be friendly and the restaurant to be clean.

Food is awesome. I recommend this place. You can't beat the atmosphere, service and food. I cannot say enough. Other than open one in California.
Ask for Anel or Orlando guarantee you'll be taken care of.
If you want an excellent breakfast ELMERS RESTAURANT is the place. Great service and delicious coffee too. They dont only do breakfast you can have lunch and dinner and it's all good at ELMERS!

Horrible food! You know it's bad when you are the only one in there during happy hour. The food was really bland! The eel sauce is definitely not eel sauce. The fried food is as good as a piece of rubber. I would never recommend this place. Please if you can go somewhere else and save your money. If you do like this place then I'm sorry for you and hope you do try other options out there.

Ordered the corn dog meal which came with fries and a drink. 

Corn dog tasted awful. Couldn't finish it. Never got my drink. 

Wait was awful long. Staff were rude. Definitely do not recommend. Waste of money.
I am obsessed with their food!!! It is sooo good!!! I love the rolls you can get as a appetizer!!! I definatly recommend this for dinner!

Wonderful pizza...creative recipes and delicious dough. We love the Capricciosa with the super thin prosciutto slices on top, cut with a cool slicer that sits near the counter. The salads are excellent, especially the Chicken Arugula Basil. Great service and friendly employees.

Me & 3 of my kiddos all got braces at the same time. 
Staff is absolutely wonderful!! 
Kids teeth are looking great.

Tonight my husband and I came in to celebrate our buying our very first house. We were beyond luck to have such an attentive server to tend to our special night. Kade made our little celebration one of a kind that I will never forget. Kade's service was spectacular. He gave some amazing recommendations, not to mention his outgoing and very friendly personality. We didn't have to ask for anything during our entire dinning experience because he was so on top of it. So, thank you Kade for your wonderful service! We will be back soon just to request you!!

Casa Del Matador just opened up recently in the village. I was very excited to see this open and try it. There just arent any newer clean upscale Mexican places in or around Boise. If this place turned out to be good, I knew it would be a hit.

Like most of the other restaurants in the Village, this place is mostly a huge bar. The only restaurant I can think of that does not fit this mold is the Counter. I did notice that they seem to have an upstairs. It did not look like it was open, so I could not tell if this was really a diniing area, or just for show.

Casa Del Matador is basically a huge bar with a few booths and tables thrown in. Its noisy and busy!

We went here on a Thursday night around 7 and it was packed. There was mostly 20 somethings and 30 somethings when we went.

The menu is small and does not have the traditional Mexican items on it. They have the normal tacos, enchiladas and burritos, but they all have some sort of twist to them. Most items, according to our waitress and spicy. I saw a couple things that said they had habanero. 

It was so busy, that we were not able to get a table. We had to sit around an elevated fire pit, that thankfully was not going.

The 1st thing I noticed was the very interesting decorations. There are huge things hanging fro the ceiling that look like over sized Christmas decorations. It was very unusual, but I liked it.

Our waitress was very friendly and had a great personality. She took our order promptly and we got our food in good time, especially considering how busy it was.

I had the fajitas. I ordered half steak and half chicken. They dont have a price for half steak and half chicken, so they charged me the price of the steak fajitas, which is $18. Very expensive compared to other Mexican restaurants.

When it came out, the 1st thing that came to my mind was that old commercial; "Where's the beef?"

I got 2 pieces of steak and 4 pieces of chicken to make my fajitas with. The rest were veggies and there was not a lot of those either. The steak that I got was in chunks instead of cut up nicely like other places that serve fajitas. They were not bid chunks my any stretch of the imagination, but too big to be just a bite.

This made eating the steak hard. The steak had a good flavor, but was chewy and tough. Cutting it into smaller portions would have made it easier to eat.

One thing that I did like about the Fajartis was that they roasted their bell peppers. Most every Mexican place that I know just sautes them. This adds a nice texture and smokiness to the bell pepper, which I loved.

The chicken was just ok. It did not have much flavor to it. I was happy to see that I was not charged extra for guac, like some other places do.

I was very dissapointed in the fajitas and especially the lack of meat. Next I will tackle my wifes meal. She had a chicken burrito. The burrito was big, but we soon discovered why.

It was so large because it was filled with black beans and rice. We had to do a burittoectomy and like an exploratory surgeon, look for the chicken. I counted 4 or so pieces of chicken in the "Chickenless" Burrito.

If you like garlic, you will love the salsa. One word of cation on this is that if you are on a sodium restricted diet like me, be careful with the salsa. its loaded with salt as well.

I thought I was going to OD on salt right there in the restaurant!

We noticed a young man in black walking through the restaurant. He came to where we were, picked up my empty water glass and filled it. 

This young man had no expression on his face, and never said a word the entire time we were there. He was not taking orders, so I am guessing he was a manger, or something like this. Whatever he was, he needs customer service skills and a personality.

The bottom line here is that If you are younger, make good money, love the bar scene, want some ok Mexican food that is non-traditional, and like to socialize, this is the place for you.

If you are older, prefer a more quite atmosphere, like meat, are on a budget, and prefer more traditional Mexican food, you will NOT like it here.

This ramen house has to be the BEST RAMEN HOUSE IN IDAHO! The server girl was so sweet and nice. The ramen was so good and drink were different but GOOD! I would have to say this whole experience was a 10/10 and me and my bf will definitely be coming back here!
The staff is super friendly and I really enjoyed the food. I got the elote loco and it was great. The fries are AMAZING. They recommend the chips, but don't get chips get the fries.

We've eaten at Flatbread numerous times and have always enjoyed it.

Our standard appetizer is the prosciutto wrapped prawns. Four plump prawns wrapped in just the right amount of prosciutto and cooked in the pizza oven. Baby arugula and a fig glaze finishes off the dish. Always a winner. 

I've had a number of the pizzas. Most are quite good but there are a couple that don't float my boat. The maple fennel sausage pizza is too sweet, as is any of the pizzas with balsamic cippolini onions. Just not my cup of tea. The others are consistently good. The only downside is that occasionally it seems that the oven just isn't hot enough and the pizzas can come out a little on the soggy side. 

My wife typically orders the half and half for lunch. The chicken/apple/walnut and the iceberg wedge salads are her favorites. The sandwiches are all quite good. 

A decent wine by the glass list rounds out the menu nicely.
This place is Rad! Love it. Great location in The Village. Awesome variety of cool food that you can't find anywhere.

Great service. Very attentive. Loved sitting at the "pizza bar" and watching the oven. Also loved the local beer selections. Pizza and mac and cheese both great!! Kids get to make their own pizza at their table...very cool touch.

YUCK!!!  The food was horrible!!!  The chicken teriyaki was defrosted frozen rubbery chicken that bounced in your mouth while attempting to chew it!!   The rice was dry and not Japanese.  This was all after my order ticket was lost by the kitchen whilst I sat waiting for 20 minutes.....  

Don't even bother going here if you care for sushi or Japanese steak house and sushi cuisine!!

This place was elbows to asses on a Friday night.  Not surprised but not pleasant either.  Just wanted another beer to facilitate by friend's alcoholism.  May visit this place on an off hour but not on my immediate to do list.

My alcoholic friend just reminded me they have 100+ beers on tap.

My first and last visit!

I read snout the long lines on Yelp buy went anyway.  Tellers were right!

It was difficult to just get in the store through the oriole standing in line at checkout.  My ability to walk and stand us limited so as soon as I realized check out was going TK take forever, I walked out.
Some of the worst poke I've had in the area. The fish seemed tough and the poke bowl itself lacked any sauce or flavor. Good prices, but not worth a second visit.
amazing food&service!!! holes in the wall are still the best!!!!   ;o)

I want to like this place. They have a great selection of beer and a lot of TVs! I've eaten there 4 or 5 times and have been disappointed each time. Their fries are great and that's what keeps bringing us back....trying something different and maybe it will be good. I've had a burger...burnt. The chicken wrap was pretty good. The Philly cheesesteak was awful. Terrible cut of meat. The meatloaf has a smoky (in a bad way) flavor. The nachos weren't good...they'd obviously been sitting and the chicken was refrigerator cold!

If I want to watch a game, grab a beer and pig out on fries...this is the place to do it.

I was expecting so much more from my flying Hawaiian dog, my experience was, bread soaked in grease shriveled pineapple and a few crumbs of bacon.  
I can say the staff is friendly and helpful. 
I also ordered the special of the day. A donut with blackberry sauce on top.  
Not bad! I can say this is a pricy place for what you get.

I'm hoping by the time you read this, this restaurant's stars will be up to the appropriate amount. I'll get to my personal experiences with this awesome eatery in a moment, firstly I'd like to list off everything that makes this place shine:

1. It literally shines. It's an absolutely gorgeous location, and at night it's a beautiful restful sight to behold; also it's quite romantic. 

2. The goat cheese quesadilla. Wow is this good. I ordered it my second time in, and now I regret every moment I'm not eating it. 

3. Happy hour, two happy hours actually. I prefer the late night specials and drinks. They have some fantastic tequilas and the bartenders know what they're doing. 

4. A wonderful staff. They've yet to miss a moment of fantastic service for me. Great job everyone working there, keep it up! 

5. Plentiful seating! Even on one of the most crowded nights of year I felt comfortable bringing a date without a reservation. That being said... I worry this means the business is running slow. Come on guys! Tell your friends!!! 

I read the negative reviews written by some Yelp elites, and I couldn't help but notice the manager has responded to every single one. I've never experienced overly loud music or unsatisfactory service. I also think the food here is great and everyone I've brought here has agreed. I'm sad some people have experienced some bad service but from the looks of the attention the higher ups are giving the negative feedback I'd say I've been experiencing the restaurant's improvements; and congrats to the manager for keeping an eye on some important responses. 

That all being said... I've had such a wonderful time eating here I actually have a ridiculously picky critique! It's actually not that picky I just really love eating here; I normally just like to spread warm happy feelings and cupcakes and butterflies when a restaurant treats me well. But I digress... The seating on the opposite side of the booths on the first floor are fairly uncomfortable. It's a really stiff wood without much padding. If they fix that, I'm guessing their next improvement will be solving world hunger.

My advice to you (person reading this review wondering if you want to go eat here) is absolutely check out this place. If the music is too loud, or the service is poor, or the food is off... say something as soon as you can. If you're not treated with respect, then that's a great sign they don't deserve your time or money. 

This is also great relationship advice.

Crave is our new family favorite because we all like different foods. I always want fish or sushi, no one else does. My husband wants wings, but they're too spicy for my daughter. My other daughter wants Thai, while a bean burrito is requested by my other kid! Crave gives us the variety and flexibility to individually order what each of us want and it's quality food that tastes good! Too many times we've gone to an overpriced restaurant where the food was crappy and regret immediately sets in at the thought of wasting $70. But Crave isn't like that at all, plus they deliver! Their customer service is super nice too, I accidentally ordered our dinner twice, called to cancel one and it was seamless.

Carl's Jr. is pretty good in general. But this particular location I had the pleasure of getting not so great service. Most of the time if I get a wrong order I just go back in and it gets taken care of and it's no big deal. My issue lies when the person serving me makes up excuses and acts like it was MY fault they couldn't get my order right. And it don't help they walked away and just started chatting away while my food was waiting sitting in the window and I already was wasting my time. And it didn't even taste that great either. I know it's stressful work but don't blame other people for not being able to do your job right.

Used to kind of Love this place  for the following:
Very good food . 
Very prompt service . 
Extremely good drinks . 
Nice vibe , nice staff . 
As for my most recent and last trip this last weekend  we received :
No food ( because they were suspiciously out of everything we had asked for : beet salad , cauliflower bites , quinoa ,etc. ) 
Weird / totally bizarre service ( our male server asked me to take off my glasses in order to check my ID like I was being questioned by the goddamn FBI also I'm practically 40 so it was completely uncalled for in the first place  especially since he didn't ID my husband )
Drinks were still God's but they were out of two of the beers my husband wanted 
And the server wasn't nice . He was just off .
I wouldn't recommend this place unless you enjoy mediocre shit .
Thanks you for coming to my TED talk .

I bought two dozen doughnuts today. The girl informed there would be an extra 49 cents each for the 3 apple fritters. No problem. When I got home. I had two regular size fritters and half of another one. Also the 3 custerd filled ones were filled with some white sickening sweet icing

I love the Homestead! Good food, good service and a fun atmosphere. I eat there all the time, and recommend it to friends. However, as a lover of spicy food, one of my favorite things about the Homestead was their Inferno Sauce, which has grown increasingly less spicy since the first time I ate there. I even determined that despite asking for Inferno Sauce today, we got regular old Buffalo Sauce. We'll forgive the issue because the Homestead's food is great, but it's definitely disappointing because I used to really look forward to ordering their Inferno Sauce; it was special and I can't get it anywhere else. (If someone who works at the Homestead sees this and decided to bring the Inferno Sauce back, go as spicy as possible. Thanks!)

The family and I definitely enjoyed our time. The service was very friendly, the environment was nice and clean. The drinks are great and better priced than the average bar and grill. We shared an assortment of food, the sliders, jalapeño poppers, etc which was all fantastic. I ordered the club/chef salad and it was freaking huge and delicious. I'll definitely be going back.
The food was great and the staff was fun, energetic, helpful and very friendly. Chips and salsa were a nice touch with our to go order. Can't wait to dine in!
Wonderful  brother team and so efficient. Thank you so much!
Love this place!!! The owners are amazing and the food is perfection every time. The Boston Cream is my fav donut and the Rueben hot dog is ridiculously good. :)

Got the larger NY strip. It was so amazingly flavorful that I had to close my eyes with each bite just to fully savor what I was experiencing. So glad I drove outside the trendy city center to find this place. Service is quick and accurate and friendly. Atmosphere is laid back and casual, surprising for a steak house this good. I've literally paid twice as much at "finer" formal restaurants for steak that wasn't even half as impressive as this.
Friendly service, great food! Ordered the Japanese Steak Noodles and absolutely loved it! Great flavor and good quality meat.

My boyfriend and I have been to this location a few different times now and I have to say I've not really had or seen bad customer service. I love taking advantage of the .70c boneless wing Thursday. Savannah in particular is a great server and accommodating.

Meridian Meat and Sausage has by far, the best quality meat. I won a prize from 6 on your side that included a gift certificate here. I came in and chose the Prime Rib...This is the BEST quality Prime Rib I've ever had. I met the owner he's a great guy, friendly employees, the shop is completely clean. And of course great meat and a good price. I've found the spot to get all the best meat around.
Great food and friendly stuff! I am taking one star off because it is a little pricey and the place is somewhat small so there is always waiting time. Love the garden area

Flatbread is the one place where I know, for 100% fact, that I'm going to get a good meal and fabulous service each time I go, no matter when I go and no matter what I order. It's just that good, all the time. 

Food: You can't go wrong with their Pick 2 (Craft 2) lunch specials, from 11-4 daily. Whether it's a pizzetta, salad, half mac and cheese, sandwich or a soup, it's ALL GOOD. Our favorites are the quattro formaggi pizzetta, mac and cheese and chicken apple walnut salad. The new kale salad is also really good, and the nuts and seeds on top are delicious. My husband's favorite appetizer is the sea salt flatbread, and I love the bruchetta. Literally, it's ALL GOOD! If you're a mac and cheese lover, try the mac and cheese! One of the best parts is the cookies and milk for $1 after a meal. The perfect light topper to a great meal!

Drinks: Daily drink specials, great hot tea and coffee!

Atmosphere: The atmosphere is great. It's not a huge dining room so it gets very cozy and romantic when it's busy. You can also sit outside during the warmer months, and the patio is wonderful. Good people watching in the little park they have there! My favorite spot in the whole place is at the tables by the fire place. It's the warmest, coziest spot!

Service: Always fast and super friendly. Flatbread servers always seem like they really enjoy their jobs.

Happy Hour Offerings: Daily happy hours, with the best lunch pick 2 special around daily from 11-4

Healthy Hack: Very healthy salad options. I always order the half salads and they're plenty for one!

Tips: Ask for their ranch with pizza... it's a chipotle ranch and so tasty!
Descent, but not the best and overpriced. Restaurant was clean. The girl who made my order was not friendly and seemed annoyed.

Have been to this new Cafe one time too many. Stopped in after church to have brunch, the wife ordered the Steak Platter special, and I ordered the Strawberry French Toast. Service has been very good every time we have been here, and the food normally is pretty good too, but on this visit, both of our meals didn't meet expectations. First, my wife expected to get a piece of steak, with onions, peppers with chipotle', and eggs over easy. What she received was scrambled eggs with hollandaise, on top of soggy  hash browns, with lots of green peppers, onions & a few slivers of steak.
The kitchen replaced the eggs that she ordered, but the rest of the meal was left behind. When she asked to either have the description on the board changed to better reflect what they were serving, or compenstate us for the less than stellar meal, the manager offered a 10% discount. Second my french toast looked nice, 4.5 stars for presentation, however the bread was tough and chewy. Not sure why, maybe over cooked or the  bread may not have been fresh. The eggs, bacon and water were good.
Again, the service was excellent, but only one star for the food. Not sure we'll be back, which is unfortunate, as we live close by. Sorry, not so hot!
First timer, tried 5 donuts and they were all pretty dry. Way overpriced for how tiny they are too. Nothing special!

We arrived here as Pilgrims to the Treasure Valley looking rode hard and put away wet.  I imagine we appeared one step away from homelessness we were so bedraggled after a grueling 20 hour day of moving.  I know we were hungry given we hadn't eaten in 18 of those hours.

We arrived just at start of the happy hour specials menu.  We took a table in the bar and as the female server approached to greet us the male bar tender said, firmly, "I'll help them".  Perhaps being protective of her given our appearance?  Or taking pity on us for the same reason?  Or protecting his tip turf?  Regardless, it made us feel 'wanted'.

Whether because we were so hungry or in need of some human care after the long move day or both I do not know, but in all the meals we've eaten in another Flatbread location (in Bend Oregon, our 'move from' location) this was the tastiest for food and cocktails.   The baked goat cheese with fire roasted tomatoes we ordered from the happy hour app menu was delicious. 

Normally I write reviews that describe food and ambiance and service in some detail.  All I remember to say about this experience is we entered hungry and forlorn and we left feeling nourished in tummy and spirit.

To show our appreciation for being able to "come as you are and be welcome here" we left a really big tip.    

THIS N THAT:

1) ACCESSIBILITY: Accessible parking is in lot in back.  So that you don't have to travel all the way around to the front if  you have mobility limits, you need to enter via 'employees only' door right off that accessible parking lot.  Some seating is standard height.  Sadly all bar booths are step up and not accessible to those who can't stand.

2) LUNCH TWO FOR...is it $10?  Offering the same special here as Bend it can't be beat as a great deal at lunch time.

If you like the taste of a dense dry dinner roll sprinkled with sugar, then this is the place for you. I couldn't even finish eating a single donut. I have never in my life been so disappointed in a donut. Winco bakery does a better job.

We made a reservation for 6:30 on a Saturday, and it's a good thing we did. We walked in at 6:15, and were seated close to 6:30. We ordered drinks, then our server returned and told us that their CO2 wasn't working, so we could have nothing with carbonation. Our scones and Caesar salads were delicious, but that is where the good part of the meal stopped. We ordered seafood linguine and the almond crusted halibut. The pasta and seafood in the linguine were both vastly over cooked. The almonds on the halibut were too coarsely ground, and the coating slightly burnt, the fish over cooked, and the sauce was minimal. The bacon wrapped brussel sprouts were also overcooked. The food wasn't terrible, but it wasn't good either. For the price point, I expected far more. We likely won't be back. 

Our server, Talan, was great though.

Never had a bad meal here! Did take out tonight. My husband and I had the Road Kill with buttered corn and veggies. Ordered it medium and it got home and was perfect. Pink in the middle. Got the fried pickles... OMG so good.

Went there with some family from out of town. Our waitress was awesome I wish I had remembered her name. She apologized for our food taking to long which we didn't even notice and when it came out it was slightly cold but we were ok with it cause we didn't want to continue to wait. Next thing you know the manager came over and paid for our whole tab!  Never in my life did that ever happen. Both her and the manager had awesome personalities and great people skills!

I appreciate that The Matador has vegetarian options, even if they all use the same Beyond Meat. I was a little frustrated because the menu said to ask the server to make it vegan. I asked the server what veganizing it would mean, but he said he didn't know and seemed unwilling to ask the kitchen for details. The Beyond Picadillo Enchiladas were fine. I can't say I was displeased, but wouldn't return based on the food. 

The service was also fairly lacking. I recognize this may be in large part because of Covid restrictions, but it was still pretty subpar. We weren't given silverware the server left immediately after delivering our entrees before we even had a chance to ask for some. When we got up to go ask for it, they brought us forks (no knives) and we had to go ask again for napkins. Our waters were never refilled until my friend asked for more, and then his was refilled but none of the rest of ours were. 

I'd be willing to try it again, but don't feel especially inclined to go back any time soon.

With my boyfriend and I Coming from the Bay Area, we are fans of Japanese food. This place will not disappoint you with authentic food that is made with love and care:) we got the tonkotsu ramen and teriyaki chicken which are both to die for. We can't wait to return so we can enjoy the amazing food and stellar service!!

The worst Texas Roadhouse experience ever. We went there for an early Saturday family dinner. All four of our orders came out very salty! The sautéed mushrooms were greasy n super salty. My in laws grill shrimp came out very salty too. I ordered a medium rare 10oz Fort Worth ribeye with sautéed mushrooms n loaded mesh potato on the side. Steak was thin n fat, it came out to be more like medium instead of medium rare. The food quality was average. We were very disappointed at our food. Will not return for awhile.

We love the doctors, PA's, nurses & staff at this Primary Health. Every time we've been in they've been great! We've gone in for Shingles, kids Staph infection, ear infections, sprained ankles, possible broken bones (3 athletic sons), last minute physical so we cd adopt our beautiful daughter (thanks Dr. Hudson!!), & even a barbed fish hook stuck completely into my hysterical teen son's thumb last night! (Big thanks to PA John Subaitani!) 
Thank you for saving us from countless ER visits & for taking such great care of our family!
One of my favorite places for fragrance!  Lilac candles are my new favorite. Go find this for yourself. And hand sanitizers 5/$7. How can you beat that. Always love their sales.

Fail- its 1:30  orders been in since just after noon.  Was supposed to be here by 12:30.  App doesnt even show its being prepared yet.

Just about 2 pm now hard to understand the app and whether the check marks are after something is done or thats when that thing is being done.  Very confusing communication.

But maybe its on the way 

Arrival 2:07   2 hours and 1 minute after the order was placed

At least the hot food is cold.  

Fail

Disappointed overall, this was our first visit to the Linder Rd location. We've had great experiences at the other Flatbread locations and this time did not live up to what we've come to expect. Our server spoke with us three times; to take our order, to bring the meal & drop the check. Flavors were good but my sandwich was lukewarm. Overall, felt like a fast food experience at a sit-down price unfortunately.

Went into the store to upgrade two devices.  The first associate assured me he would transfer all of my data, pictures, etc. even though I had shared I hadn't backed up my phone in a while.  After getting home I realized I was missing three months worth of family photos.  Vacations, birthday parties, and my daughters graduation were all lost.  I called the Sales Associate immediately and left him a voicemail (he provided me his cell and said to call anytime if I had questions or concerns.)  He never called me back.  I went into the store to get assistance, and the Store Manager was extremely rude first making another sales associate try to resolve things for me even though he could hear what was going on.  When I finally requested that he come speak with me he made excuses why his sales associate had not returned my call, and literally said "Those pictures are gone.  I don't know what you want me to do for you."  I left in tears and have not been able to retrieve these pictures.  Save yourself the heartache and go to another location or provider.  WORST EXPERIENCE EVER!

These guys have awesome quality sandwiches. I've gotten the Hook N Ladder quite a few times - and it's always been very good! The only reason I'm not giving it 5 stars is because I asked for 'no onions' on the sandwich and I had to take them off... the girl was brand new - so it's not her fault, she still made a superb sandwich. Try the hot sauces when you walk in, but beware of the ratings on the bottle... 9 & 10 ratings mean that's extremely hot!!!!!

Our first time in and we had a great experience.  It was very crowded and pretty loud as well.  We sat at the bar and received great service!  Pastrami burger and fish-n-chips were both delicious.  We did have to ask for anything, the guys tending the bar were on it despite how busy it was.

The food looks and smells amazing. The sides were above average, but the meats we tried (spicy sausage, chicken, pulled pork, and ribs) were all pretty dry and tough, the worst being the ribs by a long shot. The various bbq sauces are tasty and help, but it took a significant amount of sauce to re-hydrate the meat. The heavy lifting savior of the meal came at the end - the peach cobbler. Amazing dessert.

This is the ultimate drink and snack stop. Oh and they have gas too . Their selection is too notch and I always walk away feeling really good about myself. The employees have always treated my nicely.

We have not been to Jakers since the location moved from ParkCenter.  We decided to go for our Anniversary. Mistake. 
We were disappointed in the food and the service we received. 
I dropped $60 on a Rib Eye steak and chicken dinner and I could've made the same cut of meat on my grill with much more flavor for $15. Our server sounded like she was half asleep and offered no suggestions of what to eat after informing us that you were out of our first choices of meals to eat. It was exhausting trying to figure out what to order.

4.5, if I could do that  Everything was very tasty  and service was so polite and quick! Restaurant went from 1/4 full to 3/4 full while we were there, but it didn't get too noisy despite the the strip mall environment. The Hunan Pork was deliciously spicy, fried rice great, and the egg drop soup dependable. The only thing I didn't particularly love was the spring roll, but the sweet and sour sauce we used for dipping was delightful! Family-owned and run. Try it! You'll like it

I have loved Matador for years now. The food is absolutely delicious and the atmosphere is so fun. We went again this week and I was so pleased with the measures that were being taken to prevent the spread of COVID-19: masks and gloves being worn, keeping patrons 6 feet apart, paper menus, etc. I can tell Matador cares and that means a lot. It made me feel safe. I will definitely be returning soon.

This is a signiture steak house we visited Kahootz today and had the Tuesday special a 8oz. Rib Eye Steak that is the best Rib Eye I have had in the last 10 years in any resturant in Idaho. The service and whole experience was 5 plus stars. My wife and I will be back soon. Congradulations on hitting your mark we love it when the experience is 200% positive keep up the great work Kahootz. I can only imagine the prime rib we coming for that next!

A small neighborhood place in Northwest Meridian, Wok Fusion is a small place that serves very good Chinese food. The selection is small, but there are some interesting things on the menu including Red-Braised Tilapia. The Sweet and Sour Pork was good and the Hunan Pork definitely had a red pepper kick and plenty of fresh veggies. The only thing they could do to improve now would be to have an actual lunch menu-----only dinner specials for lunch and the prices are a bit steep. Hopefully that will change because they're on target with the quality of their food.

It was our last night in Boise and we wanted to go somewhere outside of the downtown Boise area for dinner. I came across Kahootz on the Tripadvisor website and I was sold when I saw that one of their weekly fresh specials was  etouffee. Kahootz was about 20 minutes from where we were staying so we hopped in the car and headed to Meridian. We arrived around 5pm and were given the choice of sitting inside or outside. It was pretty hot outside so we chose to sit inside. Shortly after we sat down we were greeted by our server (Lorena?). Kahootz has over 40 beers on tap and we couldn't decide so Lorena brought us 2 small samples that she thought we might like. 

I ordered the aforementioned etouffee and my wife ordered shrimp scampi. We were advised to save room for dessert. Our meals arrived and we dug in. My wife loved her shrimp scampi and marveled at how many shrimp were in her meal. My etouffee was wonderful. I love spicy food and this was right at the top end of my heat tolerance. For dessert we split a 1/2 order of bread pudding that was nothing short of amazing.
Excellent all around. First time at this Village restaurant and was extremely pleased. Great food, service at very reasonable prices. We will return.

This is the dirtiest place ever.  I went because my kids like to take their kids here to play.  Yuck!  The last time I went with them, I said "Never again."  Well, against my better judgement, I took the grand kids today.  I thought I would be sick from the smell in the play area - B.O?  I don't know and don't want to know.  The whole place is FILTHY.  I am not the type to write terrible reviews, but this place needs the health department to take a look.  Ewe.  If you happen to look up at the pod with a steering wheel in it - look how dirty the wheel is.  I just hope we don't get sick from the filth of this place.

This was so bad it inspired me to create a Yelp account. A favorite lunch spot had a wait, so I decided to try Buffalo Wild Wings in Meridian as it was just a couple of doors down. I have enjoyed their wings at other locations, but was horribly disappointed with this restaurant. My lunch consisted of five greasy wings, a pitiful side order of fries, and a drink - for the utterly insane price of $17!!! If you like slimy wings, I guess this might be your spot. As an added bonus, you get to be ignored by the bartender while she is busy text messaging. I will never set foot in this restaurant again.
If you can't beat the flavor of a Costco dog, you've got a problem. Really disgusting hot dogs for way too much money.  It's a shame because the guy running the place is cool. Cash only.

Our group decided to hit up this newer business to the Village featuring artisan donuts, hotdogs, burgers, and even Nashville chicken (sandwich). It's a beautiful decorated spot and they have several spots you could consider outdoors if that is something you are looking for right now. They have a large selection of fresh big donuts which all looked fabulous (it'd a great place to grab coffee and donut as well; we had the lemon meringue and the seasonal both were delicious). Most of the group went with hotdogs including me (all had rave reviews). I ordered the chili cheese with beer cheese sauce; I loved it!! The beer cheese sauce was spot on even used it for the fries (their fries were so good; crispy/well seasoned). I did the lunch special was $10 (hotdog, fries, and drink). 
So what's with the 2 stars then? Unfortunately my friend who had two service animals was subjected to harassment by the owner. Per ADA: "In situations where it is not obvious that the dog is a service animal, staff may ask only two specific questions: (1) is the dog a service animal required because of a disability? and (2) what work or task has the dog been trained to perform? Staff are not allowed to request any documentation for the dog, require that the dog demonstrate its task, or inquire about the nature of the person's disability.
The owner and the initial staff who walked up to her violated both of those questions and documentation was demanded by the owner. She was watched constantly and one of her dogs was "too close" to the inside even though she was trying to be outside of their business. One of our folks ended up spilling her drink totally an accident I get it maybe not their favorite customers yet to make it obvious with glaring/uncomfortable looks/comments. I haven't felt that uncomfortable and not wanted in a restaurant in a long time. We ended up leaving and enjoying the beautiful weather on the Village patio. They have a great restaurant, great food yet poor customer service not to mention violating the ADA to me that's not okay (you should be a welcome place to all). I was disappointed I know businesses especially restaurants are hurting right now I brought you business and to not get treated right is a bummer. Hopefully the owner and staff become better trained/compliant with ADA and be a little more patient/friendly with folks. I'd go back for the hotdog or donut in coffee I just have a bad taste in my mouth hopefully you will have a better experience be treated with great customer service.

I really don't like giving a 1 star to this establishment but the bad out weighed the good. Had lunch their on 1/29/20 at 11am opening, the first thing I noticed when I walked in was that all of the tables had not been wiped off from the previous evening. The girls who worked the line were helpful and very pleasant. As we got to the end where we paid and where the pizza went into the oven the Man was extremely rushed and rude. We ordered drinks and did not get cups and I felt afraid to ask him for them and I could certainly tell he brought stress to the girls working. I did ask and he did get them. I headed to the restroom room before sitting down for lunch and there was no TP and the place was filthy. I'm not sure what shift does what but I do know from working in restaurant's before everything should be clean, stocked and ready for the next day and double checked that morning.. Now the food  was delicious  the best I have had in a really long time. So I've decided  I will order To Go for now on and recommend others to do the same. Such a Shame.
The food is wonderful, restaurant is clean, staff very friendly. We have dined in and taken out and have never disappointed!

I've lived in Boise for 5 years now.  I came from Southern California where good Chinese food was everywhere but it has been a struggle for me to find Chinese food that tastes like my grandfather cooked it. 

Although I've only ordered one dish from here I strongly recommend it.  The Ma Po Tofu is very good.

We wanted to like this place because we love the other Flatbread locations, especially downtown. We've been several times and have been satisfied just once. After last evening, though, we won't be back. After waiting for almost 40 minutes for a simple Parmesan flatbread and a lasagne, our food arrived with a weak apology. In all the time we sat there, no one ever came to explain the delay. Evidently the kitchen was backed up due to online orders. It feels like our dining experience was if no importance. Next time we will drive into Eagle or to the Village where many places cater to their customers and value those choosing to drive out to eat.

We were looking at a house and have been emailing back and forth about applying and the whole process there was going to be three of us on the lease and a consigner. we all have great credit and make the money to pay rent, after emailing I sent in my application and then back and forth a few emails they pretty much knew how much we all made I was prompted to have the other tenants send in thier application and the consigner as well, I was never told anything was wrong with my application and in the clear but the very next morning almost to quickly we were all declined I feel like this was really scammy to have all of us apply and then decline us even though you had already seen some of our pay stubs and had a fourth income for a rent of only 849 it seemed very unfair and we are just in need of a house and our on a budget and can't be applying everywhere at 30-40 a application fee, now we are out over 100 in application fees on a. House we were excited to have a chance on getting because it seemed hopeful but once I emailed them back about being declined not knowing why exactly we were I got no response asking them to work with us or see if they could help us get into something else. We were just really hopeful of this company this industry just isnt a nice one when it comes to trying to get a younger generation into a house just wish there was more of a offer to help us after paying you over 100 dollars to get told no

My husband and I stopped in tonight at about 8:40 to grab a quick dinner. The open sign was on and the door was unlocked with hours clearly starting they are open until 10. When we walked in the girl behind the front counter informed us they were closing early today and everything was already shut down so they couldn't serve us. There was nothing posted with changed hours and as I stated above the open sign was on so nothing would have indicated they were closing early. We both love pita pit and I come to this location quite often but this has changed my mind. We will be finding our pita fix somewhere else from now on.

Carl's Jr is pretty much my go to fast food when I want a quick and cheap burger. I never expect excellence when I hit up a fast food place. This location is on my way home and never super busy. The drive thru isn't the fastest but not the slowest. Food is always the quality I expect and I. Never disappointed at all. If there service was a bit faster I would give them 5 stars. Maybe next time I swing in it will be a bit quicker..

This is the best place to get your wedding dress! I called looking for a specific dress. She didn't have that one but had one from the same designer. I went in to try it on and ended up loving it even more than the dress I had originally picked out. Kate is so adorable, accommodating, and so helpful. Her cottage is the cutest thing in the world! It's so beautiful! And so fun to see the Alpacas out front  
Just do not rule out this place because it is not a big store. I promise you may find exactly what your looking for. It's the perfect mix of beautiful, intimate, whimsical, and romantic! I can't wait to go back for the fitting once my dress comes in

Took my wife and daughter out for my wife's birthday Sunday. Her choice. We waited our hour in the car,which was the wait time. Our table was next to the busing station where there was constant traffic by the table making it unenjoyable. Everyone in the restaurant passed by except for our waitress. When she came by we ordered an appetizer and 2 drinks. My beer was 3/4 full and was slapped on the table,then she walked away without even acknowledging us. Another waitress brought our appetizer out after walking around the room to find our table? After another 30 minutes the waitress came back and took our order.  Although my wife and daughter's food was okay,my ribs were really over cooked and were extremely salty, theirs was too. But the ribs were awful. Being her birthday,I didn't say a lot, but was pretty pissed off.   Needless to say, I wouldn't go back again on a bet.  Which is sad because years ago, it used to be pretty good.

My family was happy to be part of this practice, but when we lost our primary care doctor, Dr. Hamblin, things have gone horribly wrong. 

My husband was suffering (and still is) from severe back pain, so he went in to see Dr. Hudon. Without going into specifics, two appointments, an x-ray and an MRI later, my husband is worse off than he was. Just now he has medication that makes him dizzy and doesn't work (they refuse to try a different prescription) and we've got thousands of dollars worth of tests we now have to pay out of pocket for. In the end the said they could not help him and recommended he go somewhere else, that isn't even covered by our insurance. 

I had a similar back pain issue about a year ago... I was treated like a human being by Dr. Hamblin at this same office... I was cared for. My husband was shunned and treated like his pain wasn't real. He is almost 40, has worked physical labor his whole life, and rarely complains of pain. What he is feeling is real and he should not be treated like a common criminal because he is in pain and looking for help. If you go into a doctor and you have a problem they should try and help, not leave you worse off than you were before. The level of compassion is so incredibly sub par, I can't even begin to recommend this place to anyone... even for urgent care.

I have been eating this take out for over 2 years and those experiences were pretty darn good.  Tonight, the food was just awful. Ordered Sesame Beef (but received Hunan Beef and it wasn't that good) and pork chow mien.  The chowmein was so greasy, there was a puddle of oil in the bottom of the container.  I've been here and ordered this chowmein mana times before and it was the most spectacular side dish they offered.  Not any more.  When I phoned the restaurant to check on what was actually received from Door Dash to Wok Fusion, the gal who answered the phone was so snotty and basically told me to call Door Dash and complain.  She was not going to even hear me out.  Well it will be a very long time before I order from there again and I'm bummed out.

While in town for a week visiting my parents, we enjoyed dinner out on the nice patio tables.  Sam was our waitress, very attentive and friendly, dinner was delicious (Bianco Magnifico pizza, a flatbread, and salad) and saved room for Tiramisu.  We went back a few nights later because we enjoyed the outdoor ambiance so much out on the patio, with the courtyard and fountain right next to it.  Very peaceful, delicious food, tried the lasagna and another flatbread this time. Alex was our server and he ROCKED. Super nice, attentive, very personable. Highly recommend this place, haven't eaten inside, but I'd assume its just the same service and quality.

We have been to Kahootz a few times recently (just starting to eat out again).  On every visit the competent staff is really glad to see you and seats you immediately inside or outside depending on your preference.  We sat at a tall table outside where all COVID protocols are responsibly in place.  Ice water comes immediately as does the opportunity to order a beverage of your choice with lots of options.  Their tap list is extensive and fun to pick whatever your pleasure.  They also offer wines and a full bar.  We had the fish and chips for lunch today which is available on Fridays along with clam chowder.  Our server was extremely helpful, friendly, and enthusiastic about the establishment she represents!  The food quality is excellent with large pieces of cod breaded and cooked to perfection.  Comes with fresh lemon, nicely seasoned fries, and a freshly made tartar sauce.  Other sauces are available upon request including a thousand island version of fry sauce and a creamy garlic sauce.  Just a very nice experience, excellent value, and it is no surprise that these folks have a lot of "regulars".  We are glad to have Kahootz as a great option for an excellent casual dining experience.
Love the patio remodel they did to help increase seating! As always our meal was excellent!

Finding a good hair stylist in the area has been a challenge and after my favorite hairdresser at another salon moved away, I needed to go somewhere else.   Having just moved to Eagle I discovered this hidden treasure in a small strip mall on  State Street close to downtown.  Very convenient and very close to my house!  Not only that but the prices are about half of what I'd been paying at another nearby salon!

Tarah has been cutting and styling my hair for the past three months now and I've been very pleased.  She understands my concerns about my particular hair issues and has been able to provide me with a serviceable stylish haircut that's easy to maintain.  I've been impressed that she's not only precise, but works quickly and with a shampoo, cut, style and blow-dry I'm usually done in less than a half hour!   

Another note about this shop:  They have a mission and it's a good one in that they help to fight human trafficking and provide much input and education about this problem as well as a lot of outreach.  And that is a good thing!
The dog park is huge!  My dog loves the space and I love the amount of shade.  They have pools and fresh water.  We love going here.

Food was good and the service was excellent but I will not be going back. I took my daughter to Sunday breakfast with a coupon for a free kids meal (with adult entree and drink) but when the check came I was told that I couldn't use it for breakfast. The coupon made no mention of specific meals so not only did I need to pay for her meal I also had to pay for my beverage which I hardly ever order. I was also offered sour cream after ordering the breakfast burrito and was surprised to find a charge for that on my bill as well as none was mentioned when it was offered. I don't care for establishments that do not honor their coupons or use tatics to sneak charges onto the bill.
Consistent quality of freshness. Very delightful atmosphere. And the friendliest manager!
Amazing food for a reasonable price and definitely authentic. I've had great Mexican food, so I know what's good and this place definitely is!
Loved the one back home but this one not so much. The salsa is good but last time we got the chips they weren't the same. They were thick and burnt.

Got the chicken soulvakis today. Great pita  if you like slimy chicken fat. .After a couple of bites had to tear open the pita, throw out the chicken and eat  the remaining.  Very disappointed from my past visits to Pita Pit.
Ordered a sausage and egg biscuit this morning,  and still got cheese. My egg was paper thin. No wonder the drive thru at McDonalds was 6 cars deep in two lanes!

So Yelp is the reason we came in. And boy are we glad. My bf has the locos dog and I had the west coast burger. It definitely is different having a donut as a bun but it was good! The girl suggested I keep the toasted side on the outside to help keep my hands from getting sticky. Very good advice (still had to wash my hands tho!)

We did get a side of fries. They were seasoned perfectly. 

The atmosphere is quirky and the decor is industrial. Probably not the best place for an intimate date night night - but good for a fun one!

We'll be back for sure.

My husband got sick from their steak and rib combination tonight, he took a few bites of the steak and as he swallowed it he tasted something was rotten. He barfed a few times at the restaurant and barfed more after he came home, and he is having an upset stomach. The manager kept saying their steak is cut freshly and blamed my husband for, I quote "having one of those days with upset stomach." They offered a replacement of the meal which we were no more interested and still charged us $22.99 for his rotten steak plus other things we had. This was one of my steak-and-potato husband's favorite restaurant, unfortunately due to the quality of the meal and the way they handle matters like this we will no longer going there or recommend any friends going there either.
I have eaten at Flatbread a lot...and I mean a lot. I've never had a bad experience here and the atmosphere is always fun. My favorite restaurant ever

Great place to eat. The Yard House has wonderful happy hour meals outside seating fresh ingredients food is always served hot with a smile and a menu list that continues for pages pages and pages the yard house is definitely the place to go if you want to have a great meal a great experience and sit outside and enjoy a little sunshine

Over the last two years I've used the guys at Legacy to purchase two homes and refinance two rental properties.  They've been extremely easy to work with, have set great expectations, and met or exceeded them all.  The staff is friendly and helpful.  I've recommended them to my family and friends...that's all you need to know.  Highly recommend!!

A cute looking store with decent food. I ordered a small with brown rice which I could tell was old, hard and dry.  The ahi tuna was cut into oddly sized pieces and not nearly sauced enough (though the sauce that was there was delicious-spicy mayo!) I asked for cucumber as a topping and I got so many cucumber spirals I couldn't even see my bowl underneath it.  I am used to high quality bay area poke places and this is not one of them. I kept an open mind but not even having fresh rice available is a concern to me

You could spend hours in this store and still not see everything. The staff are very helpful and the amount of unique decor is impressive! Inspired Living is a treasure that everyone should check out.

On September 13, 2020, we went to the Wendy's located at 3140 E Florence St, Meridian, ID 83642.  We ordered a maple bacon chicken croissant, a sausage egg and cheese croissant, and a sausage cheese biscuit with no egg.  Only, 1 out of 3 sandwiches were correct.

We went back through and asked them to fix the sausage egg and cheese croissant and the sausage cheese biscuit no egg.  The girl retook the order and kept asking us multiple times to clarify the order (also she kept playing with her mask).  She told us that there would be a five-minute wait on the biscuit and to pull around to the front.  About 7 minutes later the manager (who never wore a mask during all our interactions with him) brought out our order.  We checked our order and the sausage and cheese biscuit was correct, but the sausage, egg, and cheese croissant was still incorrect.

We went back through the drive thru a third time.  By the time we got to the second window, they were no longer serving breakfast.  We told the same girl working the drive thru that one of our sandwiches was still incorrect.  She tried to tell us that we ordered both sandwiches without egg. We said we ordered the croissant sandwich with egg and that she verified it with us 3 times when we came through the drive thru the second time.  We asked to have it fixed.  The manager came to the window, wearing NO mask.  He told us that they were no longer serving breakfast.  He offered a lunch sandwich instead.  We said we would like a gift card instead.  He said he could not give us "free money" on a gift card.  We informed him that it was not free money.  It was our money that was used to pay for the sandwich.  He argued with us and then said he could do a refund for the sandwich.  My wife felt that we should have been comped for our order since we had to drive thru three times to have it corrected.  He gave us a refund for the one sandwich.

When my wife asked for the general manager's phone number, he told her to look it up herself.  As I tried to respond, he closed the window on me and walked away.  I honked the horn a couple of times and he did not come back to the window.  When I honked some more, he finally came to the window and mouthed for me to move.         

If this is the type of service you provide, you should close your doors and no longer be part of the customer service industry.

This place is our new favorite sports bar. Came here on a college football Saturday and while completely packed, service was surprisingly fast. And by surprisingly I mean about 10 seconds after they put your order in the iPad, someone is there with your drink/food.. it's almost weird. Speaking of food, for bar food this is surprisingly creative and tasty. 4 Greek inspired dishes on the menu? Ok- I'll buy in. Bloody Mary's come spicy, which is always worth a star in my book. Overall we were super impressed and will be making this our staple football spot.
Dude... came here on Wed the 8th @ 1212. Shuttered and closed. No sign. What's up with that?

Was at this location last night with friends for drinks. NEVER again my friends! Don't waste your money. Drink at another establishment or at home. My husband ordered the Tequila sampler and all 3 glasses were practically empty when it was served. The Tequila was also served in brandy snifters. We mentioned it to the server and he seemed annoyed. Seriously....We have been to their Boise Location and had a wonderful experience. The bartender in Boise was friendly, informative and served adequate pours.

Sat down and immediately ordered wine, which we didn't get until after we got main course. Server came up with some lame excuse. Bad, bad, bad! Had bacon wrapped meat loaf which was very good, as were the fries.

Here in town on a business trip for the past two weeks. A co-worker and I were looking for a great steak place in town. I found this place earlier in the week. We both had the rib eye and lobster bisque soup. Here is my review.

Pros:

- Lobster Bisque soup was VERY good! 

- Good seating arrangements and lighting. 

- The steak was good. Very good bread with honey butter.

Cons:

- Kind of expensive for what it was in my opinion, but it was good food. 

If your looking for a higher end place to eat in the area, this is the place. Be prepared to pay for it. I would eat here again.

I am from Texas, so I love a good Chicken Fried Steak. Problem is that so far, I have yet to find one in the Boise area.

When I brought my family here. I saw a Chicken Fried Steak (CFS) on the menu, so I thought, why not try it. 

You never know, right?

The steak came out and I could tell right away, that it was not a real Texas style CFS, but I tried to keep an open mind. I did not take long for my open mind to close up.

I could see the grease swimming on the top of the steak. Still, I wanted to believe that it was possible to northerners to cook a CFS. I was not going to give up just yet.

A good CFS should have a very crispy coating on it just like Fried Chicken, and it should not be greasy. I have talked to a lot of places on this and so many of them say that its not possible to fry without being greasy.

I tell each that this is because they dont know what they are doing. It is certainly possible to fry without the food being greasy. You just have to know what you are doing.

The coating on this CFS was was soggy and it looked awful. The gravy was not a good flour gravy, but it off color of white like they used way too much grease to make it. 

Some of the CFS meat was tender, as it should be. But about 1/4 of the meat was so tough, I had to spit it out. 

The flavor of the CFS was pretty non-existant. The bottom line here is that Jakers has no clue how to fry. I had the same bad experience with their Steak Fingers. 

On a scale of 1 -10, I give it a -2. If I were to judge it based on a real Texas Chicken Fried Steak, I would give is a -5.

On the upside, I tried some of my daughters Sirlion steak and it was good. I would say it was as good or better than the one had Texas Roadhouse. 

Of course here, the sirloin steak is quite a bit more expensive that Roadhouse. So, If you have been searching all over Boise for a good CFS like me, dont waste your time with this one.

So, my last visit was so good I had to come back.  Once again, great!! Serving size is perfect,  ingredients are fresh and veggies crisp.  So flavorful.  The best hot and sour soup I've ever had.  This time I had the kung pao chicken, fried rice, spring roll and the hot and sour soup. Consistently delicious!

Are they even still in business? Sent a detailed message about a month ago with all of my contact information and have not had a response from them.

Guess they're so busy that the money is just flowing in and they don't have to follow up with prospective clients??

This place is horrible.

Extremely loud to start.

Food is terrible.

Started with chips & salsa, the chips were stale and greasy; sent them back and they brought back more stale & greasy chips.

I had the skirt steak, steak was good, baked potato was ok, side veggies inedible.

Wife had fish tacos greasy fried to death fish on a stale tortillas are not fish tacos.

1 daughter had pizza, tasted frozen

1 daughter had mac n cheese was ok

1 daughter had chili sent it back it was edible 

Was charged for chips and chili we did not eat nor wan, the server could not understand why I would not want to be charged and would not reverse, so I would not tip. And that is to bad because he gave pretty ok service.

This was the worst meal I have ever had.

DO NOT GO HERE

We went out for a birthday....the food was mediocre overall for the price, however appetizers and birthday dessert were great!  I had the shrimp jambalaya which was pretty tasty overall .  We had one dish that was not good and they did credit this which was much appreciated.

I accidentally ordered Tokyo Hot Chicken from California. When i came inside to pick up my order, the manager was super nice and understanding. She navigated us through the app and made sure my chicken was made right away at their location. My food was very delicious and fast. highly recommend

Let me start this conversation by saying this was the worst service we have had here. First Janian was our server. She seemed to have an attitude from the moment she asked us what we wanted to drink. She brought the drinks over and asked if we were ready to order. I replied that we would take an order of potato skins. She proceeded to ask us if we were ready. I replied no not yet. Janian asked us if we would like some more rolls. We said yes please. From here it goes down hill. 
 Janian took our order. My wife asked me if I wanted onions on my steak. I replied yes to Janian. We got our food and received no onions on my steak. It was 2.00 and didn't want to send it back because who knows what would happen. We never got refills for my wife's water. Part of my steak was burnt like no other. Very poor customer service. Her tip showed it. My wife asked a manager I believe for the check as our waiter was nowhere to be seen. About 10 minutes later our waiter showed up and gave me a check. She replied" Oh you already got a check." I replied yes. Again very poor customer service. 
 I am a retail manager for twenty five plus years. Customer service is everything. Especially the time we are in right now. We will be thinking twice about going back as we were going at least once a week.
I like to shop here. So many ideas that make my mind really think! Great store! I've bought fabric, floral pieces, home decor, jars to make body butter with, beads, etc. I love to be creative.

Dave Perry and the team at Academy Mortage are without a doubt the best in the industry. They were flawless in their communication and details. Professionalism is unmatched! I would absolutely recommend Academy Mortage

Forgot to review this spot. Was a few months ago that we ate here. As I recall service was good and the food okay. Place is quite large and I believe it affects the ambiance.

I was not  impressed enough to return, there are other places that I like better. Once again, the service and food was good, just not good enough.

I had been seeing Dr Brady for a few years but he retired.  Recently I needed some work done because I was experiencing nerve pain whenever I brushed a back tooth where the crown met the gums - periodontal surgery had left a gap between the two. So I scheduled an appointment with DDS Nathan Williams at New Leaf Dental. He suggested I have the crown removed and cavity fixed which may or may not have been under the crown causing the pain.  The crown was removed and he determined there was no cavity below it so he shaped the tooth and applied a temporary. No filling needed so I saved $200. I was very pleasantly surprised that there was no pain AT ALL. I have never been so fortunate as to have crown work that was painless. I have found my dentist for life! He even called me the day after to see if I was doing alright. The new crown was eventually put in and the sensitive nerve issue was resolved. I have to give a shout out to Alicia too - she's the best.

It's been a fat minute since I enjoyed a fast-fired customized pizza from Blaze. I used to be even more addicted to pizza (I swear I have it under control now) and used to force my mother to take my here once a week after class. I've been only been disappointed in a few creations which ultimately were due to my own visions of grandeur. Years later and I can still say, Blaze slaps. 

After a long day at work my brain didn't have the juices to build a pizza of a lifetime so I chose from their Signature Pizzas menu. Cool thing about these is they are complete creations which you can then modify to your liking. I started with the Hot Link (spicy red sauce, jalapeño, black olives, sausage, red onion, banana pepper and mozzarella, $8.95) and added pepperoni (at no extra cost!) with a side caesar salad ($3.95). Huge shout out to whoever made my salad because there was just the right amount of creamy caesar and croutons. Just as I polished it off, my pizza was hot and ready to be devoured! The pizza's aren't huge, 11-inches, but half filled my husband and I up. Fresh ingredients, check. Generous toppings, check. Cheesy goodness and yummy dough, check. The damn thing was so spicy, I didn't even need extra hot peppers. 10/10 would eat again.

Blaze Pizza is such a fun spot for all occasions. Date night, family night, need to feed the kids, whatever it is. Everyone of any age can find enjoyment here. I mean, it's PIZZA. When will that ever go wrong?!

How absolutely disappointing. [6/21]--1 

We're in the middle of a Military move across 1600 miles and stop in a hotel right across from B-Dubs. We've been to this one before, sit down. 

This was Carry Out. My kids are hungry. Make me wait--that's fine. Make my kids wait--cranky, hungry, exhausted... thanks a lot. 

Ordered: 8:40
Ready: 9:00
I showed up at 9:00 and there were several people in there. I understand busy. I get it. 

9:05 - she asks for my name "Jeff" she goes back and comes back out, "they're bagging it." 9:10...9:15...9:20 "how long does bagging it take?" Another gal asks for my name, "Jeff..."

"We don't have an order for that name. Well, I paid. So ... and that gal just said it was being bagged 15 minutes ago.
She goes back and comes back and says "Jeffrey?" I have a blank stare now, thinking she can't be this dumb as to not know Jeff is short for Jeffrey...

I get my bag 20 minutes late. 
--Let's begin:
* My food is cold... 
* I paid for queso for the buffalo chips. It's spilled all inside the container and there's an 1/8" in the cup. 
* The buffalo chips are under cooked. Soggy. 
* I PAID for fries that my kids never got--so that's awesome. 
* No napkins.
* No utensils. 

You literally have one job. And it's the easiest thing on the planet, and you do it constantly. Why is this a struggle? I've worked food and drink service before, and this is embarrassing.

Our favorite Mexican place. You're given chips and salsa right away. Have always received, fast and friendly service. Love their chicken mole and carne asada plater. Even though we live much closer to Enriques the taste and service is well worth the drive. 

Can never go wrong ordering the carne asada platter, oh and add the shrimp. A la Diabla is delicious and not too spicy love the mushroom in that sauce.

Went her on the recommendation of our neighbor. Honestly, this was probably the worst meal I've had in the Treasure Valley. I had the French dip with the "adult" root beer. I took one sip of the drink and couldn't stomach it. It was full of syrup and well rum. The French dip was 3 small slices of beef on a huge French roll. The roll wasn't toasted and the au jus was like dipping the sandwich in salty ocean water. Can't say I'll go back, unfortunately.
Love this place! Foods always phenomenal! Service is spectacular! Love the blackened pizza crust and the smoky flavor! Favorite appetizer Fontina Fonduta! Yummy!
Awesome customer service from Keagon!  My first time at the store and I got my wife a Chicken Cesar pita wrap... the thing looks ginormous.  Definitely, coming back soon!
Great food and really good service. Has a chill vibe and a fun place to hang out and just have drinks.

Mackenzi and Kate were so lovely! They showed me dresses from what I thought I'd like to things I didn't think I'd like just to show me the range. They didn't pressure me to buy anything but provided me the designer info and pricing. Overall the experience was great and I'd recommend this cute, intimate shop to all soon to be brides.

Went to this location for lunch today.  Set us in the bar area in a booth.  Service started out pretty good but because we weren't drinking beer or liquor our waitress which was the bartender as well forgot about us.  I went without a  drink refill.  She was  re-filling the beers at the bar meantime and over in the corner talking to another waitress and checking her text messages on her phone I could see.  
I had to give them 1 star but she deserved ZERO....


. We had to as the greeter for a to go box and paid the bill on the table kiosk and left without a thank you or anything.

very disappointed to say the least. to start we were told it would be a 45 min wait and that turned into an hour and 15 min wait. we finally got a seat and had to wait another 20 min to be served. once we were served we waited about 15 min then my food was brought out and no one else in my party received their food. another 15 min and my boy andy got his food. fast forward another 10 min and the rest of my party was served. however it was very questionable because my black friend donny was served last??? not to mention they got his order wrong. thought it was over...no, there were flies everywhere, people walking around unmasked, and we didn't get fast refills. despite all of this the entertainment level was there and i enjoyed the bangers being played. i've been a loyal customer for the past 4 years but this experience is making me question my loyalty.
A real gem. Excellent service non-stop. The ribeye was cooked perfectly and was delicious. Long list of good brews. Can't go wrong here.

My mom and I went and had lunch here today. The staff were all very kind & patient. I got their Nashville Hot Chicken (I assumed it was going to be spicy, it wasn't). I think their prices are a little high but that's just me...  
The fact that they serve beer and mimosas was AWESOME! Who doesn't enjoy a beer?

I've been here 3 times trying 3 different hot dogs. All delicious! 
Plus the staff is super nice!

I've been here a couple times and I was more impressed during my most recent visit! I ordered the pulled pork sandwich and it was very very good. Service was slow but we weren't too annoyed since it was brunch hour on a Sunday. My little sister came with us and we were all a bit disappointed because they took their chicken strips off the menu (even for kids!) and it's one of the few things she will order while we're out. They were really good last time we were there too, which was a bummer. Drinks were HUGE and I definitely want to come back with my girlfriends for the mimosas!

I recently moved to Meridian and have been on the search for good Chinese takeout. I have tried Wok Fusion two times now and both times everything was delicious. The food is so fresh and the portions are perfect. I got the special with the Mongolian chicken, fried rice a spring roll and hot and sour soup. I must say the hot and sour soup is the best I've ever had!

Have been waiting 1 hour and 45 minutes for delivery.. called twice and they cannot tell me where the driver is as he had 6 orders on his truck.. $62 worth of pizza and I live a mile from the store.. I am done with them!
Should be 0 stars

We gave Yard House a try tonight and wasn't disappointed at all. We sat at the bar to avoid a wait and had good craft beer and burgers. The bartenders were attentive and knowledgeable about the vast variety of beer on tap so, we couldn't ask for any better than that! Well worth the time and money.
Best hot dog I've had since New York! Come git ya some!

It was one of those days where I didn't feel like cooking, when I thought of Crave! Perfect excuse to give it a try. 

I ordered in the late afternoon and selected a delivery window. Nice and easy. Delivery was prompt, on the early side of the delivery window I selected which was awesome. The food arrived piping hot- I had to let it sit for a bit. But when it comes to delivery, this is a rare experience so it was nice to know the meal was as fresh as it could be. With the way their business model is- every meal is delivered DIRECTLY to your door the minute it's ready to leave the kitchen. That's a major plus and all for a small delivery fee of $4.99. Considering most food delivery apps have a delivery fee of some sort but never guarantee a direct delivery- it's luck of the draw on if you're meal if delivered first or last.

We ordered a large spaghetti & meatballs and a side of focaccia. The portions are perfect, enough for one if you are really hungry or enough to split if you are moderately hungry. I'm a sucker for bread and we both thought the focaccia was dangerously good. We didn't mind the spaghetti but we weren't as crazy about the meatballs, a tad on the salty side and they weren't fork tender- this is more of a personal preference. Overall we were both impressed with the experience, the direct delivery and meal options, will definitely ensure that we will try it again. I can't wait until they add more dishes and expand the variety.

Yikes. Once upon a time, an innocent mother drove to Main Street Burger to get her family of 5 some dinner. When she came back, this is what we, the waiting family, received:
- 2 of the 5 orders were completely wrong
- 1 of those errors included a double burger that was supposed to have no cheese due to a severe cheese allergy... there was cheese.
- cold onion rings. Yep. Cold.
- and getting this food literally took more than a half hour AT the establishment. 

So. My husband (remember the no cheese order? That was his.) wanted to actually eat dinner so he drove the 15min back to Main St Burger and requested the CORRECT burger with no cheese and one that actually had the guacamole he requested and paid for and didn't receive the first go around. The girl at the drive through speaker was so kind and apologetic and respectful. The girl at the WINDOW, however... practically rolled her eyes at him and slammed the window in his face. So that's pretty rad.

So, in summary: slow, incorrect orders, rude employees, lack of attention to detail, cold food. 

And that's all she wrote. 

WAIT! That is NOT all she wrote! Did I mention the tomatoes on each of our burgers were a disgustingly pale pink/white color? No? Oh, well the tomatoes on each of our burgers were a disgustingly pale pink/white color.

Been meaning to go here for some time because this place has great Yelp reviews.  Saturday eve and only a 20 min wait, we called ahead and were told we had to be present to put our name in.  Small place w a bar as the focal point.... basically 6 booths and 6 open tables but worth the wait.  I had the French Dip w/fries and we split a side salad. Excellent blue cheese dressing!  Sandwich was very good, great tasting roast beef and excellent ajus, although a bit plain as cheese and/or onions are extra. Wife had the pasta primavera.  Good flavor but the sauce was thin and not very rich while is what you want when you splurge on a pasta entree.  The clam chowder we had to sample was not great, had a weird flavor and neither of us love it.  Wanted to give this great place with an obvious chef inspired menus a 5 star rating but it just wasn't there.  Our waiter was very friendly and new a lot about the entries.  We will be back because we appreciate a smaller well thought out menus based on quality as this place obviously is.

My least favorite location. Their door "greeters" are the most racist old women I've ever personally encountered. My husband is Hispanic. Our two kids are darker skinned and they constantly "perform checks" on us. Every. Single. Time. It's to the point where I have to record us before we get to the door to protect ourselves from this woman. I've actually tested this theory by walking out by myself and she doesn't stop me when I'm alone. Things bagged or not. We only get stopped when we're together! This behavior is disgusting! I don't care if this is Trumps America or not. We will not be harassed by some racist woman with nothing better to do than stand there and pass judgment. I also caught her stopping 2 separate Hispanic families on their way out and one black woman on her way out. None had done anything, nor was there anything not on the receipt.
We ordered variety of Sushi but they were all tasteless. Service was good but would not recommend for a authentic Japanese sushi if you are looking for one.
One of our favorites!  We have been eating at the restaurant in McCall and was thrilled when the Meridian location opened up!!  Great service and food!!  You won't be disappointed!  Go try it!
This place is amazing. Great food and great serves. Always willing to  My allergies are my needs

I would seriously do businesses elsewhere! These guys double charged me for a saw and won't give my money back! Also I bought gift cards they all of a sudden don't work! Bought a lawnmower there died within 3 weeks they would not let me return it!! This place is absolutely terrible i'd run for your lives!

What a wonderful concept and execution. I went on opening day so of course the donuts were sold out. We were sad but totally understand and are so excited for this new business!

So instead I had the Nitro Cold Brew and truffle Parmesan fries. Both were excellent. My coffee was so smooth and creamy. I could have ordered 3 more! My daughters and I shared the fries and were so happy. The truffle is very subtle and just adds a slightly unique flavor. Our Parmesan did get a bit clumpy but eating a chunky bit of melty cheese never bothers me! 

The location is so cute. Cool graffiti art, fun seating options and an open viewing area to the donut making magic. We will be back and come early so we can try one of those donuts!
