An excellent place to meet friends. I have had many dishes at Jakers a big surprise for lunch Meatloaf... Yes meatloaf and garlic mash potatoes... Excellent... Everything I've had has always been fresh and Good.  They also "overpour" drinks... The whole place is friendly!
UPDATE: TAKING 3 STARS AWAY.... something was missing from this visit... I ordered Brisket, sliced... Horrible... I don't send things back... I just don't come back... I guess if they can't serve something that's Ladened with fat... don't serve It!

Always a pleasant dining experience!  Good food and great service!  The prices seem a little high for some things ($18 for a burger), but the place is exceptionally clean and the atmosphere is warm and friendly.

I usually love going to eat here, but today I wanted to do take out, because I just want to social distance.  I waited for my food outside for about 15-20 mins, thinking it would be hot when I got home, since I didn't live that far.  To my disappointment it was stone cold, not warm at all. And the amount of fries are laughable (barley none), not also with our orders of burgers, we ordered chili, so we could make a chili burger, we got all the fixin, but no chili.  And I have had burgers there several times and never had it, to where the buns were so buttery, we could not finish the burgers. I don't know if i'll do take out again.  I would of eaten at the restaurant but there is no social distancing.  Just very not impressed on there take out, at least at mc donalds the food was hot.

This company was the contractor on my home when it was built 4 years ago. Right after closing, while going through the punch list, I found some minor issues and emailed the company.  Repeatedly.  After about 2 months of not hearing back, I called them and asked why they weren't being responsive.

Apparently the sales person handling my account had quit, but they never bothered to notify me, nor delete her email address.

Recently I required some cabinetry to be redone, and dropped off the pieces for work. 4 months later, I've not been able to pick up the completed shelving: their voicemail is frequently full, they rarely return phone calls when you do manage to leave one, and they return calls late in the day... despite their workshop and showroom only being open a few short hours every morning.

I would recommend them only if all other closet companies closed down... and even then I'd be inclined to suggest DIY instead.

Not your average quick oil change service.

They run out to greet you and offer you great stuff: news paper, amazon fire tablet, coffee or soda. 

You don't have to get out of your car.

You can watch TV or your car's service via the set of monitors by the driver's seat while they are working on your vehicle.

They explain every product/service before offering it and don't push it if you say no thank you on specialty items.

They call everything out so you know what's getting done.

Friendly and fantastic! I'll be taking our vehicles here again :)

Absolutely ridiculous how i went in and ordered food and waited an hour and half to get it but a couple that came in 20 minutes after I did got their food within 10 minutes of walking into the place!! Food was really good but not worth waiting an hour and a half to get.
Love the atmosphere here...it can get loud but fun and great food

Ok first off they have not cleaned my carpets yet. Because they are 5 1/2 hours late. I got a call from them over 7 hours ago saying that the customer before me was taking a little longer so they were running running late. Then it appears that there was actually more than one customer before me for them to be 6 hours late. . I've had to call every few hours to see where they were - no contact initiated by them. 

 No straight answers from Katie every time I talk to her it's " he's just finishing and will be coming shortly". They were supposed to be here between 1 and 2 - it's now 7:30. Jonathan is supposedly in transit ( allegedly he was not far from me but now it's been almost an hour). 

If we had not gone through the effort to move all of our furniture I would tell them just forget it.. What a way to run a business.....

Update : Jonathan showed up a little before 8. A full 6 hours late. Then proceeded to try charge me $115 over the price I was given by Katie when I booked the appt. He said the price I was given was an estimate but she had quoted me the price itemized  by cost per room. At no point did she say anything about pricing being an estimate...Seemed shady to me....made me extremely angry.

But after a few minutes of arguing back and forth a price was agreed upon and he went to work. After completing the upstairs he decided that he was done for the day and told us he was leaving with the job half done. He wanted to come back today but we had plans made and no way were we going to allow him to be in our house when we were not there. Basically we paid him for what he had completed and said our goodbyes and good riddance. We are done with a Dunn for us it was Dunn Wrong. Well get someone else to finish the job

I will say that the work that was completed was done properly and the carpet looks good. They just have no clue about customer service. Horrible communication and deceptive price quotes. Good luck if you choose them.

This place NEVER has the advertised specialty donuts. Ever. Because I'm a glutton for punishment, I've tried to patronize them several times. They "were out of" the strawberry filling for their last specialty donut. If it's a promotional item, you may want to anticipate and manage your delivery orders.

When they were running the blueberry glazed original, we were told after driving from Nampa, that the "machine was broken" and would be working in an hour. Again, we went home with nothing but disappointment. We called a few hours later and the machine was still inoperable. Glad we didn't waste time and gas going back.

There are a few other times this has happened and this place is managed and run very poorly. They take paying customers for granted and I hope corporate reads these reviews because that store really needs a change in attitude, ordering, inventory, and most of all, LEADERSHIP! Glad this happened because I'd rather patronize the local Mom and Pops businesses who actually want my business!
The girl at the drive thru had no clue what was going on, was rude and then messed up our order 3 times. Not impressed lol

Customer service incredibly rude and left very nonprofessional impression. Try charge you for thing what was never done. Technician was knowledgeable but horrible customer service ruin everything. Highly not recommended.

The park looks amazing. It has it all: big area, water fountains, benches, bag stations, etc. The nicest dog park i've ever been to. Indeed, I really don't like this place. It gets super busy. I am talking about 30-40 dogs in the evenings. People bring small dogs to the big dogs area, female dogs in heat, food, small kids are being unsupervised. People don't watch their dogs as they get into the fights, and most don't pick up after their dogs. Don't like this place. City, please build more dog parks in Meridian so it won't be that crowded, and make people follow "dog park" rules. Thanks.

I bought the wrong Feminine hi-jean product for my wife. I went back to the store within 15min and was told they will not refund/return any personal products.. they said that I can bring it back after the Covid issue and they will refund it then... I know $7 does not seem like a lot of money. I have been unemployed for 3 weeks still not unemployment check and can not find a job that will pay the bills..... Walmart does not care how you are doing they only care about what they want.
The box was not opened and like I said it had been 15 min. thanks for making me go spend another 7 dollars to fix a mistake..... 
Go shop at Fred Myers, at least they care about the community....

This Meridian location is always very clean and often the best premium fuel prices in the area. The store is clean and the bathrooms are also clean. 
Save extra money by signing up for their Adventure Card, save 6 cents on every gallon

This is a super dog park. Every encounter with every person and dog there was so natural and friendly. I had just dropped my husband off at work around the corner wondering where to take my dog for her morning walk; happened upon this park and now it's a regular. I come all the way from Nyssa so this must be a good park!!

Been here 2 two times and both times I've been treated poorly. The staff seems to be either disinterested in its guests or thinks they are too good to be serving them. I can't remember who my server was the first time but the second time I went in and the bartender Daniel was a beam of light in the darkness (please excuse the sarcasm). When we first arrived he seemed less than happy to be taking orders from us. Not a smile or hello. He seemed more interested in talking to the other bartender than serving us. Yardhouse has happy hour at 9 and I was hoping to get some food before our movie. It was 8:59 and rather than waiting till 9 I flagged down Daniel and asked him if he could put my order in. In exactly one minute trying to be funny. He didn't even look at me and said, "then I'll be back in a minute." Not exactly the worst thing to say but it was rude. I only wanted to get it in soon and without interrupting him while he was busy. I hope in the future the staff will treat guests like they are welcome rather than making me feel like I need to eat/drink and leave

I had my first appointment with Dr. Wagnon today. He is very knowledgeable, professional and kind. I am very excited to go back, and I'm confident that he will help me with my back pain and nutrition goals as well! The gentleman at the front desk was very friendly, and worked with me on finding a good time for my next appointment!
Wow what a gem. My husband and I came in for lunch. The server was sweet and friendly. The pizza was good, but the Mac and cheese was amazing! We will definitely be back soon!!

I have seen this place ever since they first opened up. They are right in the Fred Myer complex. its a small hole in the wall.

They dont have any seating. They are delivery and carry out only. i think the idea of a fast food Spaghetti place is brilliant. Whoever thought of this place had their thinking hat on.

I think it was smart to not make it into a restaurant, but have it as just delivery and carry out. 

However, I think only time will tell for sure if this will really work.

As far as I know, there are no fast food Spaghetti places anywhere in the Boise area. I will watch this place very carefully to see if they last. 

I just heard the other day that Mongos is no more. My daughter commented that the building that Mongos was in is cursed. This is certainly not the case, but it does seem that restaurants in this building have had a hard time making it.

The reality is that very few restaurants make it past their 1st year. Owning a restaurant is a very very competitive business that I think many that start one just are not prepared for.

Anyway, back to Spaghetti Betty's. 

The meatballs are separate. You can order as many as you like. They are big. I had a traditional, a special (Which on the day I was in was a spicy pork/beef combo, and chicken).

The traditional meatball was...well traditional. It had a good flavor, it was tender and flavorful . Not sure I can describe the flavor it had. I would say that it was not one of the worst, but neither was it one of the best meatballs I have had.

On a scale of 1 to 10, I would give it a 7. The chicken meatball had no chicken taste to it at all. If I did now know it was chicken, i would have not known it was chicken. It had no real flavor at all. I would give it a 2 on my scale.

The spicy special meatball was spicy, but I would not say it was anything special. I preferred the traditional.

The noodles are made right there in the store. I could see a young woman making them as I waited for my meal. The thing that struck me as odd though was what she used to make the noodles. 

it looked like a device that is used to make sausage and grind meat, not noodles. the machine has a screen with several holes on it. The meat goes in, its ground up, and then comes out this screen with the holes. Except in this case, noodle ingredients go in and something resembling noodles comes out.

I have used a similar machine to grind up beef to my own hamburger meat. I have never seen this sort of device used to make noodles.

When I got home with the meal, the noodles were the very 1st thing that my wife noticed. They tasted ok, but they look weird. They look like ground meat that has been pushed through a metal screen with holes in it. 

They are way to thick and just dont look very appetizing.. Not a normal, traditional spaghetti noodle or even anything close to it. 

My guess would be that the owner wanted his restaurant to make noodles from scratch, but did not want to pay someone enough to make a real from-scratch noodle. So this is what he, or she, came up with.

On my 1 to 10 scale, the noodles get a 2. Mostly due to this very odd non-traditional look, the size and consistency.

The meals are given to you in those carry out containers that you get when you get Chinese take out. I was impressed that they stapled the bag to keep all the boxes from falling out or falling over.

The sauce is poured on top of the noodles. The sauce is a bit hard to describe. It is a marinara sauce that you can get with or without meat. They call it Leaded and Unleaded.

The sauce has an odd oily texture to it. Not sure what kind of oil it is, but it coated everything it touched. The sauce was a little watery for my taste, which diluted the flavor. 

When I poured out the meal onto my plate, the sauce was in the middle with a ring of water around the outside. I had to mop up the water with a napkin so it did not mix with the sauce.

The sauce....well, it did not taste home made. My guess, though I could be wrong, is that it comes from a jar.

On a scale of 1 to 10, I would give the sauce a 4 or 5. The bread they give you with your meal was good. They say it is home made, but Im not so sure it is. The bread had cheese on it and is made to order with every meal.

I love the concept of a fast food Spaghetti restaurant. I really want this place to succeed. My fear though is that unless they make some changes to their food, they might have a tuff go of it

I think if this place can make some adjustments to its food, it could do well.

I almost forgot, You get a lot of food here for cheap. I pair $10 for 2 meals. But then again, spaghetti is very cheap to make. Probably right up with there pizza in costs and maybe even cheaper.

 As Spaghetti Betty's is now,  I was not impressed and would not have it again.

People who have left positive reviews of sushi here have obviously never had GOOD sushi. Yes this is Idaho and coming by good, fresh, properly prepared sushi can be a challenge - there is at least one place in downtown Boise that sets the bar high. Nevertheless, don't lower your standards just for an "experience" - I promise you'll be disappointed by this one. This is one of the worst restaurants in Boise/Meridian in my humble opinion. It would get less than one star if that was an available choice. The only thing remotely redeeming about this place was the miso soup! The decor is drab and dirty, the staff.. young, bored and inattentive. The food sits dying on counter while the staff rolls silverware and talks amongst themselves. The chefs at the sushi bar refused to make eye contact let alone engage us in a conversation about what was fresh or on special. The first roll we ordered was about as mainstream and easy as they come: spicy tuna roll. The roll arrived auspiciously on a large plate that had clearly been refrigerated for a period, obviously prepared in advance. The fish in the roll had been tortured and beaten within an inch of its life.. run through a meat grinder resulting in a consistency closer to cat food than chopped fish. The taste of day-old mayonnaise and Chili sauce overwhelmed me as it was everything I could do to get this garbage down. We questioned the chef about its preparation and was met with a glare that could melt ice. His response was to simply say that's how they make it. Sent the dish back, and they could care less that we were displeased. There was zero effort to correct it or even consider the criticism.. and it wasn't comped. My spouse and fellow critic, more experienced in worldly cuisine ordered nigiri - fatty yellowtale, salmon and tuna. The only discernible taste was that of the rice. It was largely a bite of mush. $80 later I can tell you I/we won't be returning.. and I would suggest you take your hard earned $ elsewhere as well!

First of all, I haven't found anything I'd consider a good Mexican restaurant in Idaho!  

Casa Del Matador is Idaho's version of several styles and fusions. it's part Smokey Tex.Mex, part New Orleans Heat, with a touch of NY. Yuppie style. 

The lunch menu offered some odd choices, including an American dinner complete with meat and potatoes, an an array of fusionist styled finger foods, and appetizers, No traditional Mexican styled  combos or bowls of pinto beans. They only serve black beans. I ordered a version of steak tacos, they were served up in flour tortillas and the steak strips were four plus inches long, and  coated in a green sauce, (and impossible to eat politely from a flour tortilla and no knife to cut them with) they need to be cut in smaller bite sizes. My steak strips were covered with breaded fried onion salad toppers, and a Mexican cheese.  I spiced it up with my friends pico. The salsa served was a smokey garlic infused Texmex style, rather than a traditional tomato, peppers, onions, garlic and cilantro salsa. 

The location was nice, plenty of parking,  and outdoor seating on a beautiful day was the best!

Yummy food and great service!  Went here with our dog on the patio and had the 2-for lunch special...both salads and pizzettas were tasty and fresh!  Nice ambiance...wish I had gotten the server's name because she was attentive and personable

I frequent dog parks 4-5 times a week.  This one is closer to my house.  Pros-it is in a good location and easy to get to.  However when i take CG to the parks part is for me to get my steps in as well.  This park is smaller and very urban city.  If your dog loves to social with others it was extremely busy.  However i will be opting to drive 10 more minutes to the Nampa dog park
Aida. Works in the fitting rooms. What a grumpy lady. Just do your job. Stop bitching
First time I've been here and not been pleased. Hopefully it was a fluke thing. Food was great but service was not the usual, and out of MUD PIE, that's a sin in its own
Genius "buns" stay put when set down and condiments don't fall out. Creative & scrumptious flavor blends. Artistic donuts and beer flights!

I love my visits, people are kind and very helpful. They  help you feel right at home and comfortable. Professional and helpful in helping you choose the best for you. Would recommend Rain Spa and Salon to all my Family and Friends. Thank you all for being you.

Food was good however we had a few problems. First, we waited over an hour for a table even though they said no more then 30 minutes. When we got our checks one person from the party got their check and when the waitress came back with their card and charged them more then what was originally on the check. Spoke to the manager and told us that this was a good coaching thing for the waitress. Well. ...it should have  never had happened to begin with. It was a rough night.

I'm not sure if people from Boise just don't understand good BBQ or what. While there wasn't anything particularly bad about the food, it certainly wasn't great BBQ. No smoke ring or flavor in the brisket or pulled pork, lackluster ribs, dry hush puppies. I guess some of their sandwiches are pretty good, but this is definitely not the place for good BBQ.

They steal your deposit! Seems like I'm not the only one either. I booked an appointment in June for August 19tb, put it on the calendar (I made it for a Thursday specifically because my husband is off on Fridays) and got an email on Monday the 16th stating that I had missed my appointment. I reached out to them to explain what had happened, I also had received no communication or confirmation emails with the date until the night of the 13th, the Friday night before the supposed appointment. They rescheduled my appointment for Oct. 19th but kept my deposit *as a donation* I only authorized them to charge my card for $118 the day of the procedure but the charged $138 stating they had no record of the deposit. When confronted they said that I no showed in August and they did me a courtesy by not making me reschedule through the website. Also, my baby looks like she got gutted with a serrated knife.

Went for lunch with a buddy yesterday (sat outside of course) and I thought it was really good...got the 3 meat platter with pulled pork, sliced brisket and the spicy sausage (2 ribs on the side cause I told my teenage son I'd bring a bunch home for him) with fries. Everything was hot and the spicy bbq sauce was really good. It's a fast casual place, so it doesn't have the menu options and such that some of the sit down places have but everything was really good. More telling was the teenager who pretty much inhaled all the leftovers and was impressed  with the quality. Nice addition to the Village and we'll be back I'm sure!

I know why I'm the first to add & review Inside Out Salon - it's an insider secret place that's absolutely incredible! 

First, yes, you'll get a great haircut. I started with Dawn, the owner, but as her schedule shrunk due to other activities (I'll talk about them below), I have used a couple of the other ladies. All professional & do a great job. 

Second, their prices. No, your not at the beauty school but those are your prices! For real. I am always getting complements on my hair!  Some of the ladies are newer out of school & it takes a little bit longer, but it's so worth it, because ...

Third. OH. MY. What drives this place is salon is the fight against human trafficking. Not in Africa or Mexico. Not just the US, but right here in our own Treasure Valley. Ask them. Your life will be changed by the true stories you'll hear about this growing epidemic in our own backyard. These beautiful ladies are dedicating part of their lives to fight. And you & I get to help by getting our hair done. How easy was that?  You'll seriously leave there debating on whether to tell your girlfriends or keep the secret to yourself. 

Come as you are. This is a simple salon without any pretension. You can make yourself a cup of coffee in their Keurig or grab a soda from the mini fridge.

I had an absolutely horrible experience at this place tonight. First of all we checked in with the hostess and she informed us that it would be a 20-30 minute wait and asked for my fiancé's number and that we would receive a text message when our table was ready. After 30 minutes of waiting we noticed that people were coming in giving their name/number and getting seated before us.   We went back up to the hostess counter (we were sitting right in front of them and they saw us waiting there the whole time) and I asked to see where we were on the list and that we hadn't  received a text message she said "oh we definitely already texted you" and said that she would put us back on the list.  The hostess never said I'm sorry that I took your number down wrong, sorry that maybe our system cliched out and didn't push your message through, or even sorry that you didn't receive our text message for whatever reason!! For a place that is suppose to provide service to the public this is unacceptable.  We should of received a free beverage, appetizer, or dessert at a MINIMUM! Secondly, I ordered a margarita with no ice and my fiancée ordered a margarita with ice and they brought my margarita in a small cocktail glass that was half full and she received a tall glass with ice and margarita that was full to the top.  There is no way that my "non-ice" margarita would be comparable so I was shorted about half of what I should of received. I will never step foot into this horribly ran restaurant again I am absolutely disgusted with the Madator and if I didn't have a gift card I would of just left.

This place is amazing. I have never been to a car wash like this.  We are new to Idaho and this was the highlight of my weekend.  The young men who greet you were so friendly!  Next time I will have to bring someone with me, not only to experience the awesomeness but I am very claustrophobic and freaked out a little while inside the tunnel. It did a fantastic job of cleaning the car and appreciate the clean towels and air station provided. The vacuums were extremely powerful.  I'll be there often even if I don't necessarily need my car washed just to show my guests who come into town!

Just had the best waiter I've ever had the pleasure of serviving us. Name was Matt G. Only 2 beers in so not a yard house drunk liking ;) most attentive, right there when you need him customer service I've ever experienced. Not to mention knowledgeable and very helpful. The service industry needs more like him.

I personally did not get the salt at my table. But I understand that he might have brought it to a different table. 

I would also like to touch on how amazingly expensive it is to eat there. 
If you get a burger for $13 but you want fries also you have to pay $5 more.

I like famous Daves better in terms of food and beer selection. The restaurant itself is fun, with line dancing servers and a lively atmosphere. Their prices were good and server was very nice. But, food was just ok. Kids had ribs and chicken strips, wife had sirloin, and I had salmon. Sirloin was the best out of all the meals. 
You get a free app if you dl their app while your there earing.
Thier 22oz beer is only $1 more than their 16oz so thats a no brainer. 
Overall it was good, but not great.

Our new favorite brunch spot!  We took our crew to recover from a long day at the Boise Music Festival... You can't go wrong with Brunch, Bloody Marys & Bottomless mimosas right?

They have several buffets... Breakfast, dessert, Bloody Mary, salad.  Sooo many things to choose from.  The breakfast buffet offered delicious mac and cheese, scrambled eggs, hash browns, omelets, French toast, waffles, biscuits and gravy, bacon, sausage, fresh sliced ham.  

The desserts were probably my favorite part right up there with bottomless mimosas for $4.  So many choices from chocolate silk pie, cheesecake, creme brûlée, etc.  

I'm also a fan of salad so I loved the salad bar.  They have four different salad choices as well as loaded baked potato salad, fresh fruit, yogurt, etc and of course homemade croutons.

For being a warm day (already sweating by 11am) it was the perfect place to cool off and unwind.  Our server Kayla was a rockstar and kept the mimosas flowing!  It is quiet and cool so our group of friends were the loudest bunch in there.

You know it's good when you have to wait on a Monday for a seat.  All of the food ordered was great.   My new York was a perfect medium, pink all the way thru.  The shrimp appetizer was fresh and tasty.   The hamburger tasted like they ground the meat themselves.   
Great friendly service, quick and efficent.
Bartender was amazing!! Food was great if you're in Boise hit this place up. Won't be disappointed.

Matador is one of my favorite Mexi-fusion restaurants in the Boise area. There is a great 8th street local in downtown Boise and a lovely spot in the Village area in Meridian.
Always friendly staff, delicious food, quality drinks, and wonderful atmosphere. 
The margaritas are great if you're looking for something other than pre-mixed drinks. 
Chips and salsa are delicious too, bueno bueno.

I made an appointment, and while doing so let the staff know I would be moving in a month but had an emergency situation with two teeth. I was assured they would be able to help. After paying for an exam and xrays, I was told it would be a month for an appointment to fix what the dentist advised needed to be taken care of immediately. In addition, they charged more than they should have, and mor ethan they said they would (they had said I would pay only what my insurance did not). When I called to complain politely the office manager told me she "wouldn't argue" and not to call again when I inquired as to the overcharge and what to do with my emergency. The exam was a waste of money if they won't fix it. Clear patient abandonment as I was told by other dental offices. Be warned...

We were greeted nicely by the waitress and she was helpful in allowing my Wife a couple of tasters of craft beer before settling on one. We ordered the Cubano sliders, meatball appetizers and a side salad. The meatball appetizers arrived on the cool side and were sent back to be re-heated. I asked my Wife how the sliders were, she replied, "so-so." The side salad was comprised of wilted lettuce, cheese, chopped olives. The meatball appetizer arrived and was adequately heated. Unfortunately, it was bland. A notch above cafeteria standard. Craft beer tap list is expansive and well chosen. I would have enjoyed ordering a second beer however, the food server that had assisted our waitress, brought us the bill. No asking if we wanted anything else? Ok... i guess we're done here. Pretty much summed up our experience. We'll gladly drive a few more miles and go to the Yardhouse or Sockeye for our taphouse restaurant experience from now on. This was our second time here...essentially to give it a second chance. Fail.
Love the vegan options and their ability and willingness to change menu items. Always good food and good servers.

3 stars because the donuts are always great! It's short two stars due to the messy restrooms and staff. We have had issues with our orders time after time when using the drive thru...so I don't recommend that. When ordering inside your not going to get a happy friendly employee but you'll see your order and can correct any problems before checking out. Good luck yelpers.

Had a friend in town from Vegas and took him to check out the Village.. decided on The Yardhouse for dinner. I had a blackberry mojito and porcini crusted halibut. This is probably the best meal I've had at the Village, halibut was perfectly cooked and sitting on top of Parmesan mashed potatoes, so good. I'd order this again and again.

Reviewer # 14 
Walmart is Walmart... in the lyrics from Britney Spears "....baby what you see is what you get". It's a hit or miss. Will you get friendly people? Short (manageable) lines? Shelves stocked? 
For the most part this Walmart, and many in our area, do a really good job at all of the above--imo. 

They have a Burger King inside, which is not the normal go-to place to eat while you're at Walmart, but hey-- nothing better than shopping with a Fruit Loop or Lucky Charm Shake, right??? 

Good prices at Walmart-- albeit lower at Winco, but you can get just about anything you need while you're shopping here. I've found the Automotive Service department to be friendly and hard working, but don't expect to have updated auto material on new cars. I bought a 2017 car 6 months ago and the tail light went out. What bulb do I need I asked, but they didn't have updated manuals not did the machine have 2017 in the system... 7 months into the year. In their defense-- why the heck am I needing a bulb already?!?

Not impressed. Yes it's cheap but you'd expect more when you're paying $1 per piece. Some of the pieces were cut so small that I wouldn't count them as actual pieces. We ordered almost all the selections on the menu and I'd say they were very bland. Albertsons sushi tops this place. Best thing on the menu is the spicy tuna, and that's a basic roll. Best advise. EAT AT YOUR OWN RISK. I'm just crossing my fingers I don't get food poisoning.
Great place, friendly staff great food.  The Pozole is fantastic and served with all the extras.  Make sure you ask for the cabbage pico

I try not to give a one star rating but after multiple negative shopping experiences I decided it was time.

Honestly there's are no ruder employees ( well, possibly the DMV) than the checkers in this store in Meridian. 
I don't know if it's training or low work morale but it's as if they have a chip on their shoulder. Kilene waited on me today and rolled her eyes at me when the computer reset itself on their cash register. She refused to give me the coupon. Unless I got their app. The kicker was that she whispered to the manager about me. I am  done shopping  here. It's over rated unless you're looking for holy roller decorating stuff.

Beer selection is fabulous!  Don't have the "sushi". A staked spicy tuna roll and the cake of cold rice with a little crab on top for the other option is terrible. All rice, little fish. Don't recommend those options

Visited yard house for happy hour menu! Their happy hour is a great bargain! We had chicken strips with sweet potato fries sliders with truffle fries wine and dirty vodka martinis. Fries were cold. Sliders and chicken fresh hot and very delicious! The service was awesome!! I believe our servers name was Matt he was personable friendly knowledgeable and attentive! He was training a new server. When I return I want to be in Matt's section.

I love Kahootz!! The food is always excellent and the service is always great. I even think that the pricing is really well done considering how much food they give you and the variety. We have been many times and enjoy the venue very much
This was our first time eating here.  The food was great and service was fantastic!  I would highly recommend.

Ordered the half pizza and salad. Ceaser salad was good, pizza was delish
 I ordered the art lover, replaced the red sauce with white sauce. It was a great switch however I wasn't a fan of the dollops of ricotta- my fault tho as it was in the description.

I come here a lot with my parents and their dog during warmer weather. They are super nice and attentive and very sweet to the dog and the food is always great! I really appreciate that all the workers wear masks. I am only comfortable dining outside right now so I will be back when the weather warms up!

This shop is so cute. The service was amazing. Kate hand picked a bunch of dresses that suited me great. There is a beautiful dress selection. Kate accommodated myself and my best friend who is also a bride so that we had an evening to try on dresses and take our time. The girls were so fun and helpful!

I walked in to be immediately greeted by the very friendly host (I think her name was Kylie), who was in the middle of seating another party while simultaneously dealing with a ringing phone. She politely let me know that she would be with me as soon as possible. I waited no more than just a few minutes, and was impressed with how quickly she was able to get to me! She made me feel instantly welcome. 

My server Taylor was incredible sweet and very attentive. She was always right nearby if I needed something, and was very quick to bring my drink and Calamari order. She was also very knowledgable about all of the specials, which I was definitely tempted by! I let her know that I may need to leave abruptly, so she made sure to bring my check so that I could cash out quickly whenever I needed to leave. I always appreciate it when servers are respectful of my time like this! 

I only enjoyed a drink and calamari during this visit, but I can attest to how incredible the steaks are here! I'm also a very big fan of of their pork schnitzel - the mushroom sauce that comes on it is incredible. 

I have to say - I've stopped in a few times now, and the GM is ALWAYS a delight. He is so friendly and kind, and really goes above and beyond to make all his guests feel welcome and provide an extra-special experience. 

Long story short - Jakers is known for great food, but its the stellar staff that keeps me coming back each time.

We've been there three times, and each time just weren't really impressed.
The first time was their grand opening so I expected some hiccups, bur when we sat at the only high table (4 chairs) one of the wait staff first asked if we could move to a low table along the outside wall for two. I asked is there anything else? ...he said "Well OK" and we sat at the high table. Their beer selections seemed great, if they weren't out of what I wanted. I can't recall what we ate, but it wasn't memorable. This day all TV's had one show showing, which I overlooked as a hiccup. I don't come to a place like this to watch a game I really want to see.
Another couple next to use had about the same experience as we did, 2 Stars!

The next time we went a few weeks later we had the same experience with beers I wanted they were out of. Again the food we had wasn't memorable. We saw a couple order a pitcher of beer, when it was delivered it was more than 1/2 head! The lady looked at the server with a puzzled look, asked if he knew how to pour beer? They sent that back.  2 stars!

The third time we were there we went with a group and it was picked by one of the guys. We didn't eat only had beers once I found one they had. Everyone else ate and found the food to be decent, and beers were good. 3 Stars!

Service: 4 Stars (except that first experience)
Food: 2 Stars.
Beer: 1 Star. (mainly because of the 3 times they never had my first choice, and I think the beer prices are higher than average, $1 more for the beers I like)

We may try them again and see how it goes, only problem is there are too many other option!
So happy with the quality, taste and zucchini noodle options always a winner for our family.  Best pricing for pasta meals too.

Great dog park!
This park is divided into two sections, one for smaller/shy dogs and one for all the rest of the puppers. Both sections are large and well equipped.
There is grass, sand and pea gravel here aling with some cement pathways.  The three kiddie pools always had a beastie or two splashing around, and the expanse of grass was long enough for a good run.
The people for the most part were friendly and engaged with all of the dogs. There are always  a handful of humans who don't pay attention to their dogs; there were only one or two of these that I noticed here, which was a nice change.
I look forward to bringing my pup here every chance we get.

Reviewer #98

Super fans! Good price, good experience, fast service, and good prices. 

Let's break it down start to yummy finish-- shall we? You walk in, nice and cool atmosphere, and you head to the left to a line that moves rather quickly. There are paper menu's to look at while you're waiting, or you can look at the large menu behind the counter, but the paper one explains things a little more. 

Once you get to the counter the person will ask you what you're having. When you make your decision, they will circle it on a sheet of wax paper so that the people in the line will know what they're making. It's just like Subway and Pita Pit, where you create your own, just pizza. You can get as many toppings as you want for the same price. If you want thicker crust, or gluten free crust, you will pay $2 more. They put which sauce you want (from 4 selections), then to the cheeses (many choices), then to meats, and finally veggies. AS MANY AS YOU WANT! We ended our pizza with three toppings and my brother in law had one filled with meats and cheeses. 

Once your pizza is hand crafted, it goes into the oven for only 3 minutes or 4 if you get the thick crust. WOW. Not much time at all. Seriously the same amount of time it would take you at the other chains that I mentioned. 

The taste is good, too. It's customization-- so remember you chose these flavors. Because of the atmosphere, the affordability and customization, this place is a very family oriented place and I will be sure to visit again. On 6/1/2015 Jon M wrote, "'m going to start off by saying I freakin love this place. I'm not going to sit here and tell you its the best pizza in town,but it is really good and its cool to stand there while they make it with all the toppings you choose" and I am going to agree with him full circle! After all, it was his review that led me here. Thanks JON M!

Service is spectacular, great beer and the food was nothing short of excellent! High quality everything here.! I had the clam chowder and salad with grilled chicken. The soup was amazing! Will be back again soon

This is quite possibly my favorite place on earth and I cannot believe I didn't discover it sooner. The beef is particularly juicy and they have some interesting combos that I would like to try in the future. I want to make sure that I try everything on the menu and maybe even do my business meetings here from now on. Whatever kind of drug you're putting in the food, keep doing it! Love you guys, keep it up. Shawn.

A bit pricey, but overall very good food. I had the Asada tacos. Great flavor. But the best item on the table tonight was the Angry Fireball...Angry Orchard Cider with a shot of Fireball Cinnamon Whiskey. Wow...a new favorite. Thanks Nick for the recommendation.

You don't think it's going to be much, but you can get a very large quantity of fries for less than 2$ with a big tub of fry sauce to go with it! Their burgers are great as well a little pricey for what you get same with the shakes they're pretty small and expensive but myself I'm a fry person and this is the best place for fries in the valley!!!
Always good most of the time great, today really good lol, wish the bar top would open back up live setting at the bar and eattin

Simply delicious! Great food, calming/relaxing atmosphere and great service. Our waitress was nice and attentive. The food was fresh and full of flavor. I have a feeling we will be frequenting this establishment a lot.

Horrible Mexican food! Nothing is authentic. 
I need to accept the reality that the only really tasty Mexican food is when I cook it. Even if I don't feel like cooking, it beats wasting money

Disappointed they no longer offer complimentary chips & salsa.  Ordered the Grilled Chicken Salad.  It's a pile of iceberg lettuce with 2 Tablespoons of salsa, maybe 3 ounces of chicken breast, dressing and a pile of mediocre shredded cheese which contributes much to the calories.  I think you could get a better grilled chicken salad at their neighbors with the golden arches.  Won't be back.

All I can say is that they have really good burgers here and the tots aren't bad either. It's one of our go to places when we are hungry for a burger.  You won't be disappointed.  Also, my husband and I always get the combo, which is a cheese burger, fries or tots, and a drink.  Both meals for less than 20 bucks. I think it was like 18 bucks!  A great burger and a great deal!

First time dining at the Matador. My wife has been many times and loves it. The food was good, I had the tres carnes mega quesadilla. Not as big as I expected given the $14 price.  

Caution: the chips and salsa are legit. You'll likely keep eating them and have little interest in the meal you're paying for.

Ok. This place was ok. I was seriously disappointed. I got the elote hot dog. I didn't know the hot dog itself was chorizo. Tasted so weird. Should have just been a normal hot dog. I did get the truffle Parmesan fries. They were good. Super crunchy. Not much flavor. I  also got a donut. The one with bacon. It was ok. Maybe if I had gotten another one it would have been better. I was just disappointed. It wasn't as tasty as it should have been. I will probably go again just to give it a  second chance.
Fast sertvice, Food was great, drinks amazing, and Forrest is the best server in the area by far.
Fantastic, professional well run spa. I go there for many services and I'm never disappointed.

If I could move this salon to my hometown I would do so in a heartbeat.  I had to make an appointment since I had to travel there last minute missing my own.  I was very lucky someone cancelled so I could squeeze in.  Kinzie was my stylist and she was amazing.  I got a color and highlights.  I love it.  There is no mystery to what the cost will be they are very upfront and I love the atmosphere.  If I ever have to go through there again, I WILL be stopping in.....

Got in and out of the store. All questions were answered regarding my account and promo deals. Highly recommend going here for any needs on your account. Great Customer service by accommodating clients after closing time as well.

I thought I'd give this place a try with my wife tonight, so we stopped in. We both got drinks and ordered the bacon wrapped shrimp as an appetizer. I really enjoyed the shrimp. As a steak lover, I was super excited to try the most expensive steak they had on their menu (28 oz bone in rib eye). Now I usually order a rib eye medium, because medium rare can sometimes be too chewy depending on the fat ratio of the cut. I played it safe and ordered it medium, as it was a $50 cut of beef. The steak came out 30 minutes later and it looked amazing. Unfortunately, it was very over cooked and tough to cut through. Normally I would just suck it up and not complain, but this is a $50 steak we are talking about. They offered to make me a new one, but it would have taken another 30 minutes, so I just ate the side of mashed potatoes and left. I was pretty disappointed because I was hungry. Why offer a high end steak if your chef doesn't know how to cook it properly? I will say that the server was nice and she was quick with our drinks. Other than that, the experience was mediocre. I probably will not be coming back.
Always fantastic!  love this place they do an amazing job. My hair looks great. Ive been going here for about 5 years

This place was AMAZING! Thankfully it's close to my new home because I will definitely frequent it. There appetizers were delicious. I believe we got one that was a fondue with also some steak and it was to die for. There wedge salad was great. The pesto flatbread was amazing I could eat it everyday for the rest of my life. My bf got their pizza he got a half of two different kinds because he couldn't make his mind up and both were delicious. Service was amazing our waiter was very kind and extremely informative. If you are wondering if you should eat at this place...do it. You won't be dissapointed.

We usually prefer going to Home Depot because the workers there are more helpful. However, on Sunday we went to purchase an upright freezer at Lowe's and Juan at Store #2573 was amazing! Juan looked around to locate an upright freezer but didn't see any and asked if I knew the item # which I did so he hunted in the back and found the only one left! He definitely went the extra mile to find the freezer since they computer said there was one in-stock. Juan was so happy to help us you can tell he truly enjoys going to work!!!

We recently purchased a home that was in dire need of a master bathroom renovation.  After entertaining bids from several contractors, we signed with Shawn and he had his guys working on the project within a week.  There were some minor issues with one of the subcontractors, but Shawn was quick to correct the problems and even threw in some trim work to compensate for the inconvenience.  Overall, Rendon Construction did a solid job on the bathroom and treated us fairly throughout the process; we'll definitely consider Shawn and Co. again in our future projects.

Took my visiting mother in law here last night for dinner. We were promptly greeted by a couple of hostesses and immediately taken to a nice booth in the corner. She brought us rolls and silverware right away. Those rolls are so delicious! Shannon, our server, quickly stopped by the table to introduce herself and take a drink order. My MIL ordered coffee and Shannon kept her topped off thru the whole meal, which my MIL really appreciated. She described a few of the menu items and what came with our meals. She was sure to mention what comes on their side salad in case you didn't want something (no egg for me). We were there somewhat early for dinner and they have "Early Dine" meals that are value priced.  My MIL and I both ordered the 6 oz sirloin steak that came with 2 sides for only $9.99. It was plenty of food for us and we even had leftovers. My husband ordered a 10oz ribeye and said it was cooked perfectly and tasted great. Our steaks were also cooked to our liking which is sometimes a fail when people ordered multiple doneness at the same table. What a delicious $10 steak. Shannon is sure great at her job, quickly checking on us or getting us what we needed, right down to the ToGo containers. This was a very pleasant surprise to have such great food, great service at a fair price.  Everyone thanked us as we headed out.  We will definitely be back here soon!

Highly recommend this place. Great food, service & ambience. Went for happy hour. Good time to go because you get to try flatbreads out for $5 each (personal size). We had the Tomato Margherita, the Lasagna & Roasted Red Pepper & Goat Cheese. They were all melt in your mouth FANTASTICO! The chicken apple walnut salad is mmm mmm good. Also beer & wine choices were great! PLUS they have tables outside by a park area. So it"s relaxing. If you have kids they can run around and play a bit.  The staff looked after us completely. They were bright & conversant.

The lady who did my nails did a great job, I love them. The salon was very clean and modern. However, I don't think I will go here again because the entire time I was getting my nails done the 3 nails techs that were working gossiped off and on about their clients. 
So great nails, clean salon, bad vibes.

Three days calling during business hours, left messages, 12+ calls, no response. ALWAYS on the other line?

Maybe COVID and the shop is empty.

Guess I need to find another RV service.

Phil

My biggest contention is that the music was too loud.  We could not have a conversation.  I like to be able to talk to those with me when I dine out.  The food was tasty, although, my plate was barely warm.  They certainly give a lot of food and, unless you have a huge appetite, there should be enough to have take out for another meal.  This place has potential, but feel short when we visited.  The loud music was what annoyed me the most and I could not leave fast enough.

My husband and I got to the restaurant 30 minutes before close just wanting a quick bite to eat. We got there and all of the lights were off and two employees were cleaning up, I knocked on the window, Because the door was locked the guy working looked up and acted as if he didn't see me then he walked into the back laughing. We sat in our truck waiting for a just a second as another customer showed up and asked why they were closed so early. Then both employees were in the back room peaking through the kitchen window laughing at all of us. They were VERY VERY VERY IMMATURE for closing early and laughing at us as we stood outside.

This is one of the best BBQ places we have tried! We did it delivery thru DoorDash to have delivered to a friends house and it was so good we were still thinking about it days later! Pulled pork and chicken were big winners and the coleslaw was soooo good. Five stars!!

A five star experience from the time I booked my appointment online with Brianna. Being greeted and offered a drink for my short wait, discussing what I wanted and exactly what the cost would be to achieve it, the hand massage while my color processed... the salon is lovely, Brianna has a heart of pure gold. She made me so comfortable and her color and cut skills are top notch.

We've ordered twice this week and we have mixed reviews.

On Monday, Tokyo Hot Chicken debuted. Chef Michael Mina, who operates a Michelin-starred restaurant in San Francisco, obviously excels at fine dining. Fast casual? Not so much.

"It's spicy chicken, but it's obviously not Nashville hot chicken," Mina told the Los Angeles Times. "It's a play on it, with some fun Japanese flavor profiles."

He described the heat for his chicken as 6 or 7 out of 10. The people running his Crave kitchen must not have gotten the memo. Saying my order had a heat rating of 1 would be a stretch. 

And I could have tolerated the lack of heat if it was well seasoned. That was a fail, as well. It left me with very bland chicken. 

The accompanying Tokyo secret hot sauce, had no heat, either. But the crunchy potatoes were quite good. 

I was really looking forward to this chicken. Maybe Mina's Idaho crew should eat lunch at Von's Chicken on Vista to get a taste of what spicy Asian chicken really tastes like.

The ultimate irony was that my girlfriend, who doesn't crave heat like I do, ordered garlic wings from Seattle's Wing Dome, another Crave Delivery tenant. They didn't say they were spicy, but they had far more heat than mine. They were quite good.

Tonight, I ordered a Wiseguy NY pizza from Tony G's. Owner Tony Gemignani runs several pizza joints in San Francisco, employing gas, electric and coal-fired ovens, with separate menus for each. I'm guessing the Meridian oven is gas or electric. I've never seen a coal pizza oven in these parts.

The pizza was excellent. Good pizza starts with a superior crust and this was all that, not like the crusts without a soul that Keystone used to slog with their $5 large pizzas in the Boise Valley in the 1980s. Bad pizza at its finest, yet I have friends who still swear they were good.

The pizza came with pepperoni, Calabrese sausage, a bold sausage developed in italy's Calabria region, a fennel Sicilian sausage, Peppadew peppers and even several dollops of ricotta cheese. Every ingredient shined.

Kristy ordered three sliders from Rock House Sliders. She reported they were good, but said because they were packaged in thin, individual boxes they were cold by the time they were delivered to us in Boise.

Deliveries were both on time and the drivers were friendly.
An unexpected surprise.  Food was wonderful and tasty.  Service was right on.  We will be back for more since it was so hard to decide what to order. Thank you for a great meal.

Best Mexican food ever, and the absolutely friendliest staff! We LOVE this place! We don't live in Meridian yet, but visit a few times a year. We dine at Pueblo Lindo several times each visit and definitely more than any other restaurant. The food is consistently outstanding, the cocktails are delicious, the chips are always fresh, and the atmosphere is great. Highly recommend!

I've only been to Texas Roadhouse twice in my life, both experiences were solid! I tend to go as a treat, especially when I've clocked close to 100 hours at work that week. More importantly, I'm a creature of habit, I will order the same thing each time, frozen sangria margarita(s) and steak salad... both times were grand! My experience has been consistent, and that's important, I will be a repeat customer! Tina, she was my wonderful waitress my last time in and I really appreciated her eye contact

I love eclectic restaurants like Donut+Dog! The most delicious hotdogs. I had the B.A.T.- bacon wrapped with avocado, tomato and sriracha aoli. The bun was my favorite it's basically a large thick buttery brioche bread wrapped around the dog. 

If you would like a variety of donuts I suggest you order in the morning as they sell out quickly. We went in the evening and they only had the original glazed. Luckily, I called in the morning and ordered a yummy variety- I love the southern belle (with peach filling). They are all thick layered brioche donuts. The service was excellent- they were very helpful on the phone ordering donuts and I had them waiting for me when I arrived. They even asked if they could warm them up for us.

The only reason I am not giving 5 stars is because of the price. I totally understand that the brioche is handmade but it's quite expensive for donuts and hot dogs. I took my three kids there- for 4 hot dogs and 4 donuts it was $48!!

Oh yeah!
You'll really love the food. It's really really good.
Beer is a little on the pricey side but the food is dynamite.
Good food but overpriced. Great place to watch football games with their large menu and beer/drink list.
Awesome establishment great food and service can't wait to return try the dogs not just the donuts!

My first 2 Crave Delivery experiences were beyond exceptional, however, today's did not meet my expectations so I had to drop a star.

Today, I ordered the Idaho trout almondine from Elliott's. I assume they were out of trout, as we received a nice sized salmon filet. It was moist and tasty and though surprised by the swap, my wife was quite happy with it.

I, on the other hand, was mostly disappointed with what I was provided. I ordered a half Jerk Chicken sandwich with tomato basil soup from the Grove menu. What I received was a Massaman Curry Bahn Mi sandwich along with a Jerk Chicken salad. Portion sizes were terrific and the quality/taste of the food they sent was easily a B+.
I would have preferred to let them know about this glitch via their app, but it only lets you provide star ratings. 
Overall, I'm still a big fan, and am excited to keep trying all the wonderful foods and drinks they have on the menu!
Just had an oil change on 4/23/19.  William D. helped with the service and was awesome!  5 out of 5 stars!

My car takes synthetic which is relatively expensive for a full oil change. After reading a few of the reviews I decided to go ahead and give it a go with Fast Eddy's. I called beforehand and got the scoop of what it all entails. Staff were very friendly and helpful. Inside the waiting room is pretty relaxing with plenty of choices in magazines, tv's, pac man arcade, and the squirt guns . I received a $15 complementary full car wash and a $10 rebate off my next oil change. Therefore with the discounts I feel I got the best bang for my dollar

Good Mexican food in the heart of the Treasure Valley. We were pleased to eat here to say satisfy our Mexican food cravings. They come in good portions and the flavor was almost up to par as to what we've had in  southern CA. You can't beat the Mexican food in So Cal but honestly this was good Mexican good for us. We'll definitely come back again and it's such a comfort that to know we can eat good Mexican food in the area!
Such a great kids program. This library is helpful and beautiful and I love it so much!!

A nice and very busy downtown restaurant.  The place features flatbreads with different toppings, pizza (including certified Italian style pizzas), and a full bar. They have a wine taster package, which is nice item for a date night. The service is fawning, but sometimes harried and forgetful when the place is packed. On busy weeknights, its not an easy place to hold a conversation.

I've seen Noodles & Company throughout the valley and even gave it a chance when I was an omnivore but couldn't remember what I ate and how it was.  

We were really the mood for noodles and my instinct was to go to any number of the rated locations from Yelp but for one reason or another they were simply too far or too expensive or perhaps not vegetarian / vegan friendly.  

I checked online to ensure that several of their dishes were vegetarian and vegan friendly and they stated as much. 

Here's a tip.  Go to their website and then click on NUTRITION, ALLERGEN & DIETARY LIFESTYLE CALCULATOR.  

You'll have to click again for the T&C but then you can put in the allergens and Noodles & Company will provide you with not only what you can order but how to say it at the counter.  I thought that was really cool.  

It was prime dinner time and it wasn't busy. Usually that spells doom but I kept an open mind.  Aubrey was our cashier and she was casually friendly but nothing that made it memorable.  

I ordered the Spicy Peanut Sauce with tofu and my wife ordered the Pad Thai without meat or tofu.  There wasn't any other special instructions that I needed to make so  was feeling fairly confident.  

We waited for our order and I didn't think about it but Noodles makes each order as they go, which is good but it really depends on how you like your noodles. 

The expeditor brought out our orders and I was very impressed with the presentation. I mean really impressed. So impressed I took a several pics. 

Then it went all downhill from there.  While the presentation is perfection my veggies were undercooked and my noodles as well as my wife's noodles were hard.  The worse part was there was some severe lack of seasoning. I was looking for some more flavors. The peanut sauce and the chopped peanuts were lackluster in taste.  It was very disappointing. I had to constantly drizzle Sriracha on top of my beautiful dish  to give it some spice and additional flavor. 

My wife had hard noodles too and she forgot to tell Aubrey no peanuts. Her dish was gorgeously played as well but lacked flavors.  We were really looking for a fireworks or flavor but it just wasn't there.  We talked about it and soon discovered that the chain locations are just that way so they cater to more people and as fas the noodles go, since they are made to order, they probably have a standard time of less than what they need to be so that the dishes are prepared in a timely manner.  

While Noodles & Company maybe a fit for most, it's not going to work for us. I applaud the kitchen team on their plating. For a chain, it's a A+ presentation but everything else is just average.
I have visited twice. They make good food, I had their prime rib, and it was good, tasty, cooked just right. This place is small and always busy, so plan to wait for a table.

I was referred  to Micheal at factory direct outlet by another one of his customers. I had laminate flooring and wanted to match it for my living room but after having two other flooring companies tell me it couldn't be done, I was at my wits end and had decided that I would just replace the carpet. Micheal searched and found the exact match. My flooring was installed by two  very capable installers yesterday and looks amazing thank you for going the extra mile to find the laminate to match. I am very happy with how my floor looks. I would recommend Micheal to anyone who is looking to install flooring, and will be calling him soon to replace carpet in bedrooms.

"You can't just eat good food. You've got to talk about it too. And you've got to talk about it to somebody who understands that kind of food." 
― Kurt Vonnegut

92nd person to review Main Street Burger in Meridian, Idaho on Main Street and Franklin across from the Rite Aid Center. This is my 427th review on Yelp. 

If you live in Meridian you've probably driven by this place several hundred times like myself. I've had this place bookmarked both mentally and on Yelp for quite a while and today was the day! I'm glad I went and I will go def go again when I need a good cheapish meal. 

A bright sunny day, the perfect weather for outdoor seating, not too hot, not too cold; however, the sun was uber bright but with the Main Streets outdoor covered seating we were kept quite comfortable. 

The important stuff that you really want to know, right? The FOOD! Well, it's certainly not 5-star food, but it is a good overall 4 I'm a fan kind-of- place. 

The menu: Burgers, fries (sold separately), other sides, taco salads, finger steaks, tots (which I hear are super good), hot dogs, and milkshakes. All average pricing. 

I ordered the Taco Salad-- a generous portion of lettuce, tomato, well-seasoned meat, and cheese. Served with either ranch or Italian as opposed to sour cream and guacamole (either would have been fine) and salsa and made in-house tortilla chips, which were seasoned well, but were hard and stale. I ended up throwing the chips away. 

Ranch is ranch some say-- well, not this guy! NOPE.  However, don't like paying for ranch or other condiments, especially at chain restaurants, but I understand that this is a small business and they do provide a good serving size, so $.50 is fine. 

My son ordered a crispy chicken burger. He thought it was good and that's all that matters, but it's three crispy chicken strips placed on a bun. The chicken strips are nice in size, crispy and thick. 

My other child got a kids meal and her chicken was super hard that she cut the roof of her mouth on-- the inside was "mushy" but it was replaced without question. Perhaps it was a one-off-- just beware if you have a toddler. 

There is a limited amount of seating inside. The tables are small and won't accommodate all body sizes, beware of that. 

The parking lot has ample parking. 

All-in-all, I liked Main Street Burger. I like the locally owned and operated aspect and would be happy to spend both my time and money there again.

5 stars for service tonight! We were originally going to have a "date night" in Boise but our plans changed and we decided to stay closer to home. We decided on yard house to catch happy hour. We arrived around 5pm and were seated in the outside (heated and covered) patio area. Our server (I forgot her name) was top notch! Super friendly, fast service and checked in the perfect amount of times. We had a great experience and the food was hot and fresh. I like the added tablet things on the table so whenever you're ready, you can just pay. We'll be back! The happy hour was great!
Just ordered for pick up. They give so much food. They separated the sauce so the chicken would be mushy. So good.

We love Yard House & visit often. This location has been really good to us for the most part. 

HUGE beer selection & food menu/can get pricey however they have a fabulous happy hour. 
Lots of TVs. 

We enjoy their pizzas but LOVE their Gardine wings & get them almost every time we visit. 
Their sushi roll is not really a roll but a stack- we have had it many times however the last time we ordered it the fish really lacked freshness; however that won't stop us from going back- probably just won't order it again at this location. 

Always great service at Yard House!

I had high hopes for this place but I was disappointed. Ordered something a specific way because of a food allergy, they repeated it back to me multiple times, listed it on the receipt, and still screwed up the order. Everything that we asked to exclude was on the order. It's like they didn't listen at all.

First time here.  Interior is nice and inviting.  We asked for a booth and got one of those 2 person small booths...cozy yes but next time we won't be doing that...too small for their large plates especially for 2 people.  Food... EXCELLENT...at least the food I ordered.  Lots of food too.  Had to get a take home box.

I ordered lunch online from this place, and I was very happy with my food! They had it ready when I went to pick it up a little late. I ordered a pizza I created myself and a side salad. They were both excellent. The lady attendant was very polite and helpful. I think I'll eat here again!

The concept for this food delivery/take out is brilliant.  You can order a variety of types of foods from a great selection of restaurants all to be delivered together.  We've ordered from Crave a couple of times and I highly recommend the spicy chicken sliders from Rock House Sliders.  This is the best chicken sandwich I have ever had.  The buns are made fresh with a little brand on the top.  The chicken is breaded perfectly with fantastic flavor that is not over the top spicy.  The secret sauce is an appropriate amount and compliments the chicken well.  Add a little lettuce, pickle, cheese and you've got the best chicken slider EVER.  Tried the pizza from Tony G's and it was average.... I prefer Idaho pizza.  The spicy tenders from Wing Dome were delish.  We got them w Buffalo Sauce.  The sushi from Omakasa was extremely fresh...... how you would want your raw fish.  Bonus points for the fancy take out boxes.  The reason I only gave four stars was Crave needs to enhance their app and web site to include better descriptions of the food or maybe some pictures.  It takes awhile to figure out what you want as it's a bit of a guessing game.

Amazing service and the best Mexican food in the Treasure Valley! Hands down!!! I had the Camarones a la diabla (not to spicy just right) my wife had the street tacos and raves about them. Great margaritas and wonderful atmosphere.
Overpriced. Noisy, so noisy it's impossible to talk across the table. The food is not that great. Too california. When can we have Idaho back.
I love it here so much.  The owner is amazing and the food is delicious.  The hot dogs and burgers are great quality and the donuts are works of art.

We were shook by crashing shelves in our pantry 3 nights ago to find a big pile of fallen pantry goods and appliances. Once we cleared the immediate mess that night and the rest of the pantry the next day, I saw that golden sticker with these guys' name on it. I also looked at the beam holding up shelf that came down. Interesting, I thought, that the location where it gave was a beam installed by TVC which was CUT less than an inch from where it was screwed into the wall! I was beside myself how such incompetence could be brought to bear on my own home, but there was, staring me back in the face. It seems that the installer was too lazy to get cut and install another beam in one piece, properly, so they just screwed in a cut piece and not a solid beam instead. I also noticed 1 supporting beam running the length of the pantry, where I expected more since the height of the shelves is 7 feet from the floor. My house was built in 2001 and I am its only owner. I expected many other items in the house to go before my pantry shelves. Now I have hundreds in repairs or replacements of my shelves to look at. This installation was so poor and so incompetent I am having a hard time believing my builder, who I trust, to contract with people who do such awful work. I wish I could submit pictures so I could show you all exactly what I am talking about. 1 Star is too high a review but I can't submit a lower rating.

STAY AWAY FROM THESE PEOPLE.

Happy New Year, TVC.

I went to Kahootz this past Saturday with my family for a birthday. When a  couple of my family members arrived before the rest of our group they refused to seat them because we were not all there yet. As more of us arrived they still refused to seat us until the last two of our party arrived, even though we are at the bar taking up space anyway. We were paying customers but were made to feel as if we were intruding. Once we all arrived our waiter was a nice man who made sure to take care of us the best he could. We received our soup and salads and when my Uncle made a joke about the crackers on my mother's soup the waitress got offended and became very rude to us even though the joke was not said to her or even about her. It then took forever before we got our main order and it was barely warm. My husbands potato was barely warm enough to melt the butter they had put on top of it. However the flavor of the food was amazing. We ordered a last round of drinks before we left for the evening. While waiting for our last drinks from the bar we got our bills. We were done paying before my last drink was even served to me. While enjoying our drinks another guest approached our table and rudely demanded to know when we are leaving because they were waiting on our table. We were not even finished with our drinks. I was amazed that the folks working at Kahootz first off allowed this man to approach our table and secondly told that guest they were waiting on us when there are plenty of other tables that also held six guests. We were looking for a fun evening to celebrate a birthday and instead left frustrated and angry. I will not return.

I have driven by this place quite a few times but had never been to a Texas Roadhouse, so we decided to stop in for a late lunch. 

The atmosphere is pretty cool. Lots of stuff on the walls, meat case showing off their steaks and the staff was super nice. 

When you get to the table they give you some delicious hot rolls with a cinnamon butter that is amazing. They also have peanuts on the table for you to snack on.

We ordered the Cactus Blossom as an appetizer and man was it greasy! It is served with a horseradish type sauce. Overall it was pretty good but the insane amount of grease made it touch to eat. 

We got a chicken salad and a burger and the salad was definitely better than the burger. The burger was massive but the meat was dry and over cooked and it was so salty! I am assuming this was just a fluke and someone got a little heavy handed on the salt by accident but I couldn't even it the burger. 

Overall this place is okay but definitely not in a big rush to return.

Took the family out, because we had to get out and found our friends at Homestead were there with great food and beer to pass the time!  Hope you guys hang in there, we're walking distance away and love our local places!!

If a no star review, would suffice I'd do it. I read the bad and great reviews but was so in pain- I risked it.

There are great reviews for this place, but I stand by the latter- I agree, they charged me 190 and didn't do a thing for me or my pain just tried to set me up w a "payment plan" for my issues

Went to an orthopedic doctor next day who totally contradicted everything they said with the same X-rays. 

Scam. They want to keep you there. The laser is bs, don't buy a word

Horrible. Guacamole was brown. Everything must be pre made and thawed.  Truly the worst mexican food I've ever eaten.

Went last night to celebrate my husband's book. Nice time. Great staff. A bit of a wait for a Friday night. Daughter had avocado toast, husband had BBQ hamburger with fries, I had yummy Mac & Cheese. It had shiitake & oyster mushrooms, gooey cheese and a crispy crumble on top. Absolutely delicious. Also had their cheese curds - yum. 
We sat outside on patio - a bit chilly for March still but we got warm with a hot chocolate! Food, staff & price = awesomeness!!
Really yummy! Loved the food - great service. Ordered the Tonkotsu Ramen and a hot boba tea with a crab Rangoon appetizer. I was pleased with all three and would recommend eating at Ramen House.

First time in and the person who greeted me was friendly and helpful. Restroom was clean and tables were clean and neat. The hot and sour soup had a great flavor and texture. The Kung Pao Chicken was very good as well.  Going to try Cow Fun next time!

Unfortunately the gal who I had been going to for 7 years decided to move shops, which I totally respect.  The part that upsets me is that I had an appointment the day after her last day, I showed up and she wasn't there.  No one bothered to call me, they just assumed that I wanted to have someone else do my hair.  We all no that we women get attached to our hair stylists.  I would have really appreciated a phone call.

This is one of our offices regular lunch favorites. Service is always good, friendly and fast. The pick 2 lunch special is awesome. You can try a salad, sand, mini pizza or soup combo and it's all so good! The chicken apple walnut salad is yummy and I always try a different flat bread or sandwich and have never been disappointed. Love this place!
