If you're wondering why I haven't said a word about the coffee... there must be something wrong with you. I'm really not trying to be rude, but why are you looking for a yelp review to tell you whether or not you should go to a Starbucks? If you live in a city with some sketch areas, I can see you checking in to see if there's any shenanigans going on with the establishment. But, this is Meridian. It's all fine. It's just a Starbucks. They have decent coffee and the comfort of knowing mass quantities of people frequent Starbucks. 

I can't even tell you (to be honest) whether or not the coffee here gives you a good caffeine buzz. I only do the hard stuff... you know... Bang, Yerba Mate... even a Red Bull if my life is RELLY going downhill. 

I can tell you that there's tons of seating inside, and a nice outside seating section parallel to the building. There's also a Pokéstop and a gym not too far off.

I was CRAVING a hot dog. I remembered that this place had opened in the village recently and decided to check it out. If you are expecting a "plain Jane" hot dog you are thinking wrong. I was feeling a little adventurous as I usually do the plain "what kind of meat is this?" hot dog. All of their hot dogs are unique in their own ways. 

I got the 208 hot dog and it was very very good. The dog was cooked well and very hearty. My husband got the grilled cheese and tomato basil soup. He was a little thrown off by the fact that it was a cheese sandwich made with "donuts.". I tried it and was absolutely blown away by it! Sweet and savory indeed!!! I think I will get it next time. However, the one downside was the tomato basil. It tasted more like marinara sauce than tomato basil. 

We also got the pretzel bites with cheese sauce and they were OH SO GOOD!!! Husband scarfed those down without hesitation. 

Now, let's talk about the staff. Super super super nice and welcoming. I never got his name but the guy that took our orders was so helpful in our choosing and gave us a little rundown about the place. The guys that were running the food to the tables, and everyone else, were all so nice and treated us very well. 

They are also Law Enforcement friendly. I say this cause when we were sitting down, I took off my coat and I was still wearing my uniform and the guy noticed and told me that if he had known he would have given us 10% off because many of their families have someone working in law enforcement. That is a very nice thing to hear and I appreciate their support. He set us up with a little to go box with a couple of donuts and that was super nice of him. 

I know I will be returning for the cheese sandwich and, of course, to try out more of their donuts!! Thanks again guys!
The staff was awesome. They were really busy on a Saturday night but got our delivery to us within 15 minutes of us placing our order.

Do you taste that? Yep, like pure sugar. 

It was my first time at a Krispy Kreme and I was very disappointed. The doughnuts are super sweet and sugary, and not very fluffy. Sadly, Walmart's are better and 1/2 the price. 

I do have to say, they are cute. 

Won't ever go back though. Definitely not my kind of doughnut.
They were an hour late, did not respond to texts, walked into the backyard without knocking and self righteous to boot as if they were doing me a favor.
Went there for lunch and the server was so friendly, the food was awesome and my drinks were also good! Highly recommend this place; they have tv's for watching sports and  great food!
What an amazing burger with the best bacon around. good customer service. some the best tater tot's in the valley I highly recommend this place to anyone. I eat there about once a week.

Ribeye was delicious! Pizza is also good and cheese curds! I haven't had anything I didn't like here. Love the patio seating! Perfect location and very friendly service! One of my favorite places for a good meal and time! (:
Excellent food and service! Everyone is very nice. The food comes out quick and they give you a nice little dessert. They have the best micheladas ever. Highly recommend!!

It's an ok place.
Most of the tables are tall, which can be weird and hard to capture your napkin when it falls off your lap.

The staff is super friendly and helpful..

The beer options are ok, but you need to like ales, and heavy porters... meh.
The wine options aren't bad.

The food...  sigh.
We started with the pterodactyl wings - 5 come on the plate and they are huge. Not really super shareable.
We all went with the steak sandwich - and i was very unimpressed. It was cooked to the point of no return and the result was meh. The description made it sound amazing... I was lucky to finish the meal.

I can't say i'd go back, i can't say i'd suggest anyone else go there.

It might be the place for you, but it won't be the place for me.

We just had our first Crave delivery. After reading Michael Deeds column about Mac n Cue we had to. We ordered the ribs and brisket with cold slaw. Delicious! The sauces complimented the meats perfectly. We also had the BBQ pork n Mac. Wow! Over the top fabulous.

A surprise was thrown in, a long stemmed rose Nice touch Crave Delivery.

See you again soon!

I love new places! 

I'm guessing most, if not all of us, do. R&R BBQ is the new place in the Village so I was just waiting for a good opportunity to give them a try. To add to the excitement, I am from Texas. As any good worthwhile Texan does, I live, eat, and breath good BBQ.

I smoke my own brisket in my backyard on a semiprofessional smoker so I consider myself an expert at it.  It's been pretty hard to find good BBQ in Idaho. The best I have found so far has been GoodWood. Mine is way better, but GoodWood does pretty good at it. 

My wife and I wanted to go out to eat a bite for lunch, so we decided to give R&R a good college try. Which is a bit weird since I did not even go to college.

I ordered the Brisket plate. I wanted the sandwich mainly because it was cheaper, but the guy at the counter talked me into the plate. My wife wanted the chicken sandwich, but she was on her game and asked the guy at the counter if their chicken was white meat. 

He asked the cook because he did not know. He was told "NO, THE CHICKEN IS NOT WHITE MEAT". This was a HUGE red flag, but we decided to order anyway. Every place in town, with a few small exceptions, use All White Meat Chicken. If you go here, and like white meat chicken, you will want to order something else.

They have fried okra on the menu, so being from Texas, I had no choice but to order this as well as the hush puppies. My wife had onion rings. 

The Food
I wanted very badly to be able to write you a good review and say this is the best BBQ I have had since leaving Texas. Sadly, I cant say that.

The Chopped Brisket Sandwich & Plate
On the video that plays on the restaurant TV, they show traditional chopped brisket which is pulled so it's in small thin strips. The brisket in the video also looks lean and very good. 

This was a completely different than what we got!

I would be ok with chunks if the chunks were good. What we got though were very large chunks of fat with almost no meat. Their version of Chopped Brisket made me think of that old commercial "Wheres the beef?"

To add insult to injury, most of the chucks of fat were cold and not even cooked. Both my wife and I had to inspect the chunks to be sure what we we seeing was really what this place was passing off as brisket. Touching them verified they were in fact cold, mushy fat.

After getting over the initial shock of what we received, my wife and I both inspected the chunks of fat. 

The Chopped Brisket Sandwich and plate gets a negative 10

Sliced Brisket
We sent the supposedly chopped brisket back. They gave us Sliced Brisket with was way better, but it was still not lean, which is what we specifically asked for when we ordered. The sliced brisket had a decent smoky flavor, was tender and much closer to lean. 

On my 1 to 10 scale, I give their sliced brisket a 6, but please please please dont confuse this with with their Chopped Brisket which was a HUGE FAIL!

The BBQ Sauce
The sauce was ok. It tasted like Ketchup with some spices and maybe some molasses thrown in. Not smoky and no heat. The sauce gets a 2.

The Okra
The fried okra looked good and crispy, but I'm afraid this is where the positive ended. The inside was very slimy and mushy. My guess would be that its cooked from frozen, so the outside got done, while the inside did not get a chance to get fully cooked. 

Their fried okra gets a 2

The Onion Rings
They were crispy, but lacked flavor and were very greasy. These get a 3

The Hush Puppies
They were just ok. They were really dry and had little flavor. I would give them a 4 out of 10.

The search goes on for good BBQ. If you know of a good one, I would love to hear about it.

I wouldn't feed this food to my dog because I love him. My potato skins were served burnt with dirty plates and my main dish had hair in it plus it was over cooked. Our main dish came out before our appetizer and the manager justified it by saying they can't not stop making food once its ordered. Sorry your cooks don't know how to not burn food but how about making your customers happy and making their food right the first time.

I was in visiting family from San Francisco. I wanted to take my 2 sisters to a nice meal before I drove back home. Asked who had heard of great place to go for a steak, regardless of price. Apparently one of their new found friends raved about this place....so we tried it out. Would never have known or picked it out because of the very unassuming building. Decor was fine but nothing too fancy. 

     But boy was I delightfully surprised when I got my perfectly cooked, beautiful cut of new York steak. We each had a different cut and they were all fantastic. Perfect amount of food for a very honest price. Even the rice and asparagus were up to par. No lack of anything coming out of here. Try it and you'll see.

Amazing service. Seated right away. Excellent food. I didn't even notice the salad had taken a bit long to be delivered and the server apologized and offered us a free dessert. Blown away by the service. Face friendly too.

My wife and I had seen this place many times before. We love to go into this area and eat at ling and Louie's. 

So today, we decided to head in to see what they had. After all, it looked nice enough form the outside. 

Well, you cant judge a book by its cover. This saying works just as well for things  not looking good, that actually are good on the inside, as it does for things that look appealing on the outside, but on the inside are nasty.

When we entered, we found that this is a sports bar. This should have been our first clue to just walk away. I have yet to find a sports bar in Boise that is any good.

This place in no exception.

Walking in, every space on every wall is filled with TVs. Small TVs, large TVs, and mid sized TV's.

This made for a weird deco. Most every TV was turned to a different sports channel. So it was impossible to watch one and not be distracted by the two next to the one you were trying to watch.

We were sat in a booth right by the greeter station. Since this was a sports bar, we expected noise and people being rambunctious. 

What we did not expect was that the noise and rambunctious would come from the staff that worked there.

The staff all stood around the greeter station and yapped. They yapped and yapped and yapped the entire time we were there.

It was like being in a room with a bunch of teenagers having a slumber party. It was that annoying.

Then came the food. My wife had a hamburger. The hamburger was bland and tasteless. It was a flattop burger and not even a good one. I have had better burgers from McDonalds.

I had the boneless wings. I chose 2 sauces. The 1st one was the Asian. The second one was habanero/mango. 

The Asian was supposed to be infused with Ginger and Garlic. The flavor of the sauce was bad. I could not taste any ginger or garlic. It was just plain not good.

The Habanero/Mango was hot. But thats it. It was just hot. No flavor at all and certainly not mango. 

The last thing was the fries. Flat, overly salty and flavorless. 

When we got our Check, we noticed one more issue, which made us flaming mad. My wife had asked for Mayo, Mustard, and ketchup on her hamburger. 

On our Check, we noticed that this joke of a place actually charged us for Mayo. Really! Are you kidding me? I have never been charged extra for mayo before. 

This place will never see my business again.

We wont be back and I would not recommend this place to anyone.

Convenient location for those of us that live in the neighborhood.  
Excellent.  Excellent beer selection.  
Staff has always been friendly.  

Food quality - average food with big portions.  However, there are a few standouts:

Sriracha cod bites - f****** awesome.  Tequilla lime chicken mac.  Same.  And anything in a pita.   

This place is always busy.

Dr Baxter has great knowledge of how the immune system is associated with our spine alignment. During these times of uncertainty it is great to have additional insight on how to remain well and be able to fight off anything I may come into contact with. The staff there is all very helpful and the office is a very clean environment. I really recommend them!

I wanted to do something special for my parents 50th Wedding Anniversary, unfortunately COVID limited my options.  I saw Jakers offered Schnitzel and decided to treat them to a special dinner, I could pick up and they could enjoy at home.  
The hostess was polite and friendly, the food was hot and fresh.  My parents said it was delicious and they enjoyed it greatly.

Thank you for helping me make their 50th Wedding Anniversary as special as possible.

Used to love coming here but just feel liKe it's gone down hill they have changed so many things on the menu as  far as ingredients go. I still go and order fries but not my go to anymore which is a bummer since I used to love it here.

I've had several things here - over the years and am always particularly impressed by the meat dishes. 

Their lunch soup and salad is a great deal also and the salad bar is comprehensive. 

Most recently a friend and I shared the sautéed steak bites and mushrooms with baguette and they were awesome. 

I was told to get a French dip (prime rib dip  here, they call it) and it was mediocre. Great fries!  

Nice steakhouse atmosphere, clean and good service has been the experience here.   Plus they give you the "scones" with honey butter.  Yum!

Nice, friendly, and clean location. But beware of online ordering. 5 of 8 things were missing in my order tonight :( Once we realized it, we returned to the business and everything was rectified. In the future I'll just go in and order or in the drive through!

Customer service Is always curtious & friendly. They have a great beer menu but don't get used to a beer you like menu rotates quickly. I recommend the bacon blue cheese burger & the tequila Mac & cheese. It is the best restaurant in the area. P.S it is a very loud restaurant so be prepared.

I was so excited to go check this spot out after watching posts from the grand opening and seeing their delicious photos on Insta. Tonight I had the chance to go with one of my GFs and she was just as excited as I was. We already had an idea of what we were going to order. When we walked in, we weren't greeted, so we're a little confused as to what to do next. But we found the menus and the order window. The girls working were very friendly.  I was bummed they were out of donuts (as this is a donut restaurant) and i had my heart set on trying a few and bringing some home as well. We ordered our food and went to get drinks. The soda machine was out of ice. Not a big deal, they came and filled it as soon as we told them. Our food arrived and looked scrumptious. The burger my friend ordered was a little small for the price of $13... but she said it was good. We were in need of napkins but they were out so we had to ask them to refill those as well.  I ordered the elote loco and it was good. I liked the bun the most. The loco fries were tasty, good amount of seasoning. 
My gf went to wash her hands because her burger was a little on the messy side. They were out of paper towels in the restroom. 
I was a little underwhelmed. It seems as though the owners set up shop, everyone hyped it up, it opened and they left it for some young adults to run. I write this review,  not to rag on the place, but to shed some light and make the owners aware of situations that are completely avoidable when running a restaurant.
Took my family there for a Sunday birthday brunch and we were treated so well. Super service, wonderful food: Frankly, it's one of the best restaurants in Meridian.

When it comes to choosing a brunch spot on a busy Sunday this is the place to be! We were greeted right away by our server who was absolutely spectacular, during our whole visit she made sure we were taken care of. She even gave me a great food recommendation! I also love the fact that the coffee pot is left on the table you never have to wait for a refill! We will definitely be coming back!!

Exceptional Italian style pizza. Hands down my favorite pizza place in the Northwest. Appetizers are always amazing especially the calamari.  Cocktails are spot on every time. But it is the pizza. Just the right amount of exceptionally tasty fresh ingredients. I've never tried their flatbread and the name of the place is a little confusing because their Neapolitan pizza is the best.
It's fast and very crispy pizza. My one kid likes crispy so she was happy. My other kid hates crispy, so she was not happy at all.

Went to dinner tonight at this location and I will probably not go back. Worst service that I have had in a LONG time. The only thing she got right was our drink order...we even had to wait for our bill and then wait again to get my credit card back. Food was good but my daughters meal was served 10 minutes after everyone else. Not even an offer to remove from the bill. Horrible experience!
This was a really yummy and fun find! We ordered the dragon dumplings, panang rice noodles and lobster mac n cheese. All were really delicious and arrived HOT.
Food and service was great! Our waitress, Jasmine, was great and we loved everything we ordered. Definitely worth stopping in.

We love Kelson Orthodontics! We were quoted 18 months and that is exactly what it ended up being. I think their prices are competitive as well. My daughter LOVES the staff and Dr. Kelson. They always made her feel special. Very happy with our results. Thank you KO!!

Not nearly as friendly or quick as when it was Einstein's.  Valvoline is more expensive and they unfortunately lost all of my vehicle info and maintenance history with the buy out.  Not sure I'll go back.  Truly bummed it's not an Einstein's anymore!  No major complaints about the service, just not as nice of an experience as when it was under previous ownership.

Super delicious food!  We had the lobster mac and cheese.  Made me feel like I was on the wharf in Seattle!  Delivery was right on time and friendly.  We also enjoyed the sushi and an oh so yummy dessert torte!  Really nice that they have made it so easy to get delivery during Covid.

I am always very frustrated when I come in here, which I why I very rarely do. It was the same situation tonight but at the end my cashier Kiera was fantastic. She had great customer service and even convinced me to download the app. 

The one complaint I always have is that I get bbq sauce in my pizza and they spread it with their fingers because they don't incorporate a spoon. That is why I prefer Mod

I ordered ahead of time and checked online and saw they delivered food curbside. Turns out, this location isn't doing that and handled everything through the drive through. The line was 20 cars long. If I hadn't already paid for my order, I'd have just Country Donuts on Overland and Five Mile.

Never had a bad meal here. With the pandemic going on I've ordered out twice and it's been hot and delicious both times. 

The reason for the one less Star is because one time I got a steak and it was rare, but I ordered medium well, they took the cut up steak (in multiple pieces because I couldn't decide if I could eat any of it) and threw it back on the grill. I just thought that was odd (It would've been fine if I hadn't already put my used fork in and on all over the steak).

Food was amazing! I had a French Dip and hubby had the lobster fettuccine, amazing!! Our server name was Law, he was also AMAZING. It's great when you have someone who is personable and enjoys (or makes you feel like he enjoys) your company.

Absolutely Fantastic! Our new go to Mexican Restaurant. The best carne asada tacos I have ever had and we are big time taco truck lovers. My kids usually order the enchiladas and never have any  leftoverers. As a matter of  fact when we come here  we never have any left overs to take home because it all gets eaten.

The service is absolutely  wonderful.
Very professional and helpful and definitely going back. Got a lifetime customer here

Always wanted to try this place hoping I would find some good authentic Mexican food. Definitely Americanized Mexican entrees. Best thing was the Salsa and Drinks. Other than that services was mediocre, food was cold when it arrived and we asked for A couple different things that we never got. My husband got 5 asada tacos for 17 dollars that's roughly 3.40 each without rice and beans on side.  Definitely won't be back for a meal. Maybe just drinks and chips/salsa.

Horrible experience with this company!  The owner seems nice enough, but unfortunately disorganized and/or incompetent.  Like other reviewers, we got the "we're so busy" excuse from them time and again.  Geez, you weren't too busy to take my check and cash it right away and then not show up for 4 weeks!  After I began hounding the owner daily did they finally show up, then it took 3 guys 6 hours to install what was a very simple design and a completely open and clean working space.  They spent most of their time standing around talking about sports - no wonder you can't get your jobs done. They delivered the wrong drawers, then took 15 days to deliver new ones, which I had to install myself!  Horrible service, horrible company all around, do not use.

Came to grab a bite to eat before the movies and wasn't sure what I was in the mood for  but definitely not the loud echoing atmosphere.  
Place is clean with-a somewhat friendly younger staff 
I got the ahi appetizer which tasted very good served   with nice crIsp veggies. Then got the fish and chips meal which was large portion and tasted alright. 
I love good fish and chips so I critique them hard- these were light flakey cod a decent batter that was crunchy but bland and oily.   Food came out pretty quick and was hot I think they are a bit pricey for the atmosphere 

May come again to try other items but not if I want to have a conversation with the person I bring.

Visit was 11/07/2019

Great first impression, a very clean and colorful atmosphere. We were immediately greeted and seated in a both. 

A waitress brought waters, chips, salsa, and a slaw within a minute of us sitting down. They leave the pitcher for you to refill as needed, which I LOVE that idea. The salsa was not hot (I will ask next time if they have a spicier version) but it was flavorful. Chips were warm and what you'd expect. The slaw had a great taste, can't describe it.

Our server was very friendly and seemed to be on top of his game. We ordered a large margarita on the rocks and a large Dos Equis Amber. Drinks arrived quickly. Beer was ice cold, margarita was good and you could taste the tequila. Thumbs up! 

We ordered the carne asada and enchiladas Jalisco. The carne asada was a bit tough, but the flavor was there. The enchiladas stole the show and we can't wait to get them again! The shredded beef had a green sauce, shredded chicken had mole sauce, and cheese had a red sauce. The shredded beef stuffing was hands down the best...very moist and tasty. Our favorite sauce was the mole. Cheese & red sauce was good, but the other two threw a huge shadow over it. Beans tasted good and rice was ok. We liked that they don't drown your plate in the beans and rice like most Mexican restaurants do. At the end of the meal, we were given two fried doughs with whipped cream, chocolate syrup and strawberry syrup. Mine was a bit too fried, but my husband enjoyed both. 

Next time, we will make sure to get plates with the shredded beef and mole sauce. So excited to visit this place again!

Pretty...mediocre. I got a burger and my husband got the 3 meat platter. His platter was pulled pork, brisket and ribs. My burger was very small and very dry. The meats from the platter were all very dry too and not much flavor. The mac and cheese was ok. Again, not much flavor and the noodles tasted a little overdone. The onion rings were extremely soggy but the batter was tasty (would have been great if they weren't so soggy).  

Not very impressed. I might try again in the future in hopes that it improves over time.

Never disappointed in this place. Service is always on point and the food is delectable. Music can be a tad loud at times but overall this is a great spot to get a bit of the Mexican cravings tickled.

I like anthropologie in general. Way pricey but their sale room is pretty nice and they carry voluspa candles, which rock

I'm no hipster but I grew up in the Bay Area and the Napa valley where amazing shopping and foodie tastes were rampant even before they were hip.  

I've been in Boise 15 years now and my biggest pet peeve is a staff that thinks they are trendy  and cool, so they talk down to patrons (me) like a plebeian stay at home mom who doesn't know her butt from a jug of cider and doesn't belong there. 

Don't get me wrong , I AM a 42 year mom and I am
 Now on a budget -- but I've dined next to madonna, I shopped at the VERY FIRST urban outfitters ever to exist. .  . And I purchased body shop products in Berkeley directly from Anita when I was cutting my senior English class. 

So to be treated as an idiot by some 20 year old is really irritating and if I were more prone to getting my feelers hurt, I'd say insulting. 

All this to say...Anthropologie in the village.   Nope

I spoke with THREE EMPLOYEES and all of them demonstrated the sentiment that I didn't belong there.  (I had $300 cash from my birthday but whatev). 

More importantly, the reason I spoke to 3 employees instead of 1 - they didn't know their products, they didn't know how their sales applied, they weren't able to answer my questions, and they didn't really care. 

I'll try the one downtown with higher hopes because there was some 20% off glassware that i really wanted but decided not to buy because of their lack of knowledge or help.

Crave has delicious food! My family has been ordering every week and trying something different each time. My favorite is the Dan Dan Noodles from The Peached Tortilla. Very excited for the new kitchens to be added!

I am telling you guys this is absolute the best burger joint in the city, state and maybe the world.  Omg, I know it is crazy me saying this but the freshness and taste and detail is amazing.  They take something so simple and they perfect it.   They make everything from fresh, made to order.   Definitely Idaho's best burgers.  If I could only go out with the chef to see what ingredients they purchase and sneak behind the counter to see what they do to these burgers I wouldn't have to come back so much........nah.   they make burgers like no other.

Went here the other night for the first time ever...well, first time in Boise/Meridian. 
We went after looking at Christmas lights at Scentsy. 

I don't need to make this long like I usually do lol. 
This place was terrible. The place was a mess to begin with, food and crap all over the floors. I'm surprised the tables were wiped down to be honest. 
The vibe was depressing as hell too. The food was dry af and way too much salt on "naked chicken strips" I think they were called. 
Saige, our waiter I'm convinced hated us and for no reason. I just think he was having a bad night because he couldn't sell raffle tickets. He tried selling us those things, actually it was "buy gift cards and get raffle tickets for the 55 inch tv"
I didn't want gift cards. I wouldn't want to give a gift card to a place like that hahaha! I did want that tv and the raffle tickets to try for it but that would only happen if I bought the gift cards. 
ANYWAY...Saige was upset because he said his friend was selling tons and he hadn't sold any. He was trying to guilt us into buying them and it made the entire situation/experience really weird. The one here was just kinda cringe.

If you're in the area and you need a place to eat? Look at the sign for this place and then look at the sign next door ANNNND...go there instead! Save yourself some money and save yourself from a really odd, kinda cringe experience. 

Thanks all! 
Cheers!

Both my children see Dr. Kelson. We moved here mid orthodontic treatment from Texas and We have never been disappointed. We can't say enough about the staff in this office. From the moment you walk in you're greeted by the friendliest office staff.  The girls in the back are amazing. My son has special needs and Dr. Kelson and his team go above and beyond to meet his needs and make his visits comfortable. My son also has a complex mouth, Dr Kelson always takes the time to go over details, talk us through the next steps and never makes us feel rushed. My daughter was hesitant about getting braces but now she looks forward to her appointments. We can't say enough about this team and what they do for our kids.

This place was very surprising, in a very good way. In a strip mall in Meridian. Looks like a fast food, take out restaurant. Instead, a no frills, sit down restaraunt. Not fancy, but pleasant and clean.

We had Spring Rolls and Pot Stickers for appetizers; a beef dish, a shrimp dish and fried rice for entrees.

Spring rolls were deep fried, more like egg rolls. Vegetables inside were fresh and crunchy.  Pot stickers were best we ever had.

Both entrees were delicious. Beef dish served with vegetables and a sauce. Beef was tender, vegetables crispy, and sauce favorable. Ginger and garlic in sauce. Yum!

Shrimp was deep fried and served with onions and peppers. Shrimp was batter cooked to perfection. Sautéed onions and peppers cooked in a lightly spiced sauce, but the sauce did not make the shrimp soggy. Fried rice cooked with pork and made great a great side dish.

All food was fresh. Seemed to be cooked to order. Service pleasant and efficient.

We do not make it to Meridian often. But when we do, this will be a destination for us.  

Given a four for atmosphere. Food a five.
We literally have been sitting outside w empty drinks for a half hour. We have seen our waiter two times. He took our order and delivered it.

Hot sweaty sub on a hot day yuck!  This was my first and last visit.  The meat was so thin that it looked like it had already been chewed and oozed off of my sandwich which was neither hot nor cold but lukewarm warm and runny.  I had the Firehouse Hero not so good 3 hours later I am still burping it up.

Great lunch spot to sit on patio.  They have a combo where you get small pizza or flatbread or sandwich, plus small salad for $8.95.  The arugula, basil salad is great, and the BAT pizza is my favorite.  Pretty good wine list too.  Kinda noisy on Main St., but a great place to try.

Very disappointed in the lack of customer service in this store. To be more specific, the new owners younger staff, 2 women and young man (25-40)age group. I don't know the age of the owners. I was told they moved here from Washington to open the business which I could care less about, I just asked if this was a corporate store or franchise and one of the rude women piped up with that. I was looking for my annual Keepsake ornament that I started collecting in 95. They had 2 other customers in the store besides me. When I asked for assistance finding my ornament I was obviously pulling one of them away from making a display change. I didn't want to bother the gal behind the register. I'm 48 and I can honestly say with the negative attitude and lack of " thank you" after my $25.00 purchase, I have no intention of going back!

Wow! What an extraordinary experience watching this restaurant outstandingly serving their customers. First, the food was wonderful. My wife and I wanted a light meal and ordered two 
Italian Wedge salads and they were  the best ever. Our server Kyle was so exceptional, you would have to go there to see what I mean. The entire staff is so friendly and the Manager, Austin, came by and discussed how they were able to satisfy customers take out needs during the shut down. This guy has some personality and should be promoted up the chain. But the most impressive thing I saw, except for the martini I had, was the way a young lady by the name of Amiah went about her chores sanitizing tables and chairs. She cleaned everything, table tops , bases and pedestals as well as the floors around the tables.  Very impressive. I complimented her on the way out and she said the management just wants to keep the customer safe. So go there have an epic meal, relax and enjoy the food and staff.

I was very disappointed. We were told it was 1/2 price boneless wing Thursday. We were told this several times as we ordered. We pointed to large order of wings 19.95 and repeated several times saying this makes them $10 correct?  She confirmed and we ordered. Bill came with a price of $16. And change. Hardly 1/2 off. Card had already been ran. We were told a corrected amount would show later. Three days and waiting on correct ticket. I'm thinking it will not be forthcoming. I feel we were misled and treated poorly. They continued to deny that they had not told us 1/2 price. Never going back.

Downsized the container for tortilla chicken soup by 1/2 between April 13 and April 21.  Both were DoorDash orders.  Same price but half as much soup.   The manager was too busy to discuss it with me when I called and the front desk person denied that they changed the container size.

Wanted to like this place but after today, that won't be happening. I went in to get a gel manicure and left happy with how they looked. Three days later, ALL of my nails started peeling off, one completely fell off on its own. Called the salon and asked if I could go in the next day and get them fixed, the gal on the phone was nice about it, told me to come in and get them fixed. I go in the next day and she took off only the bottom half. Then she told me to pick the color I had on and I told her, she tried to disagree with me and told me that wasn't the color numerous times. She grabbed the color, swatched it and what do you know! It was the right color. She started painting my nails with the top half of the old polish still intact. After completing my nails, all of them minus one have bumps (see picture.) Not only did I leave with bumpy nails, but I also left with out one apology for having to come back. Safe to say I will not be going back, a waste of $30!!

LOVE THIS PLACE!!!! I grew up in meridian with my mom taking me and my brother to the librairy for story time and other activities. And now I can start taking my nephews and such and they love it here. Its a very kid friendly environment with all the books you could ever need lots of movie rentals and time on the computer with a printer connected which is very helpful. The staff here is wonderful always love to stop by and say hello. Wish I could give more stars.

Had new years eve dinner at Jakers last night. Was so much fun and the food was exceptionally delicious. We had the buffet with prime rib, crab legs, shrimp, salmon with lot of sides and of course the yummy salad bar. The place was packed but it was like a big family celebration. Couldn't have asked for better staff either. Mike was our waiter who was on top of everything.  I was truly a "well oil machine". Beautiful decorations for the holidays and I can't wait to spend my gift cards. Who could miss on getting $120 for $100...much better than you can get in the stocks (usually). Happy New Year everyone at Jakers and thank you for everything.

Boise Krispy Kreme is the worst in the franchises chain. They never have Maple bars and they always recommend the glazed maple donuts which do not taste the same. This location really does suck and the coffee has declined over time as well. We have purchased our last donut from this location until they make a big change. BRING BACK THE MAPLE BARS!  I would have rated a half star if available but one should get the point across.
Always liked their pizza. But the new spicy chicken with ghost peppers is disappointing. Not hot at all.
Loved this grooming service!! Melissa did an amazing job with our Yorker. Would highly recommend them.

I was so excited to try a new breakfast place. Pretty disappointed. Service was good, very attentive, but it's all about the food for me. Super small portions served on cheap plastic small plates. I am always mostly excited to try the hollandaise sauce (see pic). It was separated and flavorless. Overall disappointed and won't be back.

Do not go here unless you want your heart to stop from the amount of salt/sodium they put in their food. The "marinated meat" doesn't taste like anything but cardboard from being over marinated and over seasoned. Their salsa, chips and just about every menu item is extremely over seasoned. It's hard to notice when you are eating it but you will find yourself quickly parched for water after you visit the matador. That is not a coincidence and sign of the poor quality.

We haven't been back to the matador in over 3 years because of this and poor service. today we made the mistake of "giving it another chance", while the menu had changed the quality and service hadn't. This put an official nail in coffin for us and quite frankly I would love to see another business fill this location.

Terrible service!  After 15+ years with AT&T I decided to give Verizon a try (heard service was better around Boise).  Went in and it was clueless city.  First they said  I could keep number...followed by you can't.  Second, they said if you don't use iCloud to  transfer phone data to new phone they're not sure how to do it...seriously, the phone store doesn't know about the app or that corporate technical can do it?  Then they ordered 2 iPhone 11 Pro's for us and never called to say they were in, so I called...the store won't answer their phone.  Always goes to call center.  Call center explains  the order is "stuck" and they'll re-order and send direct to my house...pricks!  If I would've said yes I would have lost a $700 promo because it ended the day after my order was placed.  Terrible, untrained customer service!
So far so good. Clean. Friendly staff. Ramen ok so far. Not the best but good.   Be right back with more

Anything that comes out of the wood fire is amazing! Also they have Lagunitas IPA & Ace Cider. My two fave drinks with a pizza. Service was great too. Very friendly staff. A great place for either a sweet one on one dinner or a place to take a group of friends.

Oh my gosh this food is so good. So many choices! Tony G's is my favorite for pizza in Idaho and the percolate coffee and teas are refreshing and smooth. YOU CAN GET ANYTHING HERE. Chinese, mexican (elote is so good), thai, vegan, wings, pizza, southern comfort, ANYTHING. I love it. Im so grateful for the people who made this place a reality.

Excellent Mexican food! The best I have had in Meridian. Quick service.  Food arrived piping hot. Only trick was finding it since it is not visible from Eagle Road.  It is in a strip of stores behind the Panera Bread that faces Ustick.  It is just north of Ustick on the southbound side of Eagle.

My favorite spot to get my car washed! I am awful and I only get my car washed once per quarter... if not longer. Fast Eddy's is always my "go-to" spot. 

I feel that the car wash in general is of good quality. What I really appreciate is the self severe area after to dry your vehicle and vacuum anything out as well. I have yet to try this, but a different customer shared with me that there is a spot to clean your floor mats as well. I will absolutely be trying this feature next time l, my floor mats are a hot mess! I know some other reviewers talked about chipping paint and what not. I have not had that experience, however, my car is always filthy every time I have been... so I need the high pressure washed.

So, we were looking for a good burger/sandwich shop and found this gem. Walked right in and was greeted by a super fun staff that made us feel like welcome friends. The tables/menus/chairs were cleaned and fresh for us as we sat down. The four of us ended up ordering a rueben, a pastrami burger and a couple of the bacon blue burgers to be shared with the table. All of them were Absolutely amazing!!  You have to be pretty fast to get pictures of the food here because it won't be on the table long! 
I can't wait to go back and explore some more items on the menu!

I ordered door dash today because it was 99 cents delivery. I ordered their honey crispy chipotle chicken crisper with side of fries and ranch. When they delivered my order. All I got was a soggy nasty chicken with no fries and ranch. I don't think I'll order from this place again. So nasty.  And can't get the orders right.
I was waiting for the order outside more than 50 minutes, the service is very, very poor
They have the best bloody marys! Really good service here. Everything was hot and fresh. Definitely coming again.
SERIOUSLY the best Chinese food my wife and I have had. They are 6 miles away and the food was too hot to eat. The chowmein  noodles were fantastic. Definitely will order again.
Such a yummy place. Food was great, atmosphere was perfect. Highly recommend if you are looking for a steak place.
So noisy could hardly hear a thing. Could not even hear the server. .Music is way to loud and food is average.

Horribly loud, they were looking down and shouting questions(I didn't know it was at us) then she finally looked up at us. She was annoyed that I didn't answer, I explained that I didn't know she was talking to us ,thought maybe she was shouting directions at a coworker

She looked around all sarcastic like "who else would I be talking to?" The attitude all the way around was impersonable and rude. The pizza was barely edible , some barbeque chicken pizza. It had about 5 tiny pieces of chicken barely any cheese , about 4 peppercinis and hardly had flavor. Keep your crappy California resteraunts in California .I will never go back again.

We recently moved from out of state and ordered a refrigerator, washer and dryer online.  We chose the delivery date that worked best for us.  Throughout the process we were kept informed by email and then received a phone call the day prior to delivery to confirm the delivery window.  The two guys that brought our appliances out were so friendly, professional and careful with our appliances and our home.  They gave us some helpful tips about protecting the stainless steel finish on our new refrigerator.  The trash company delivered our trash cans while our appliances were being delivered, and the guys kindly brought the cans in for us without us asking.   We're very happy with our appliances and the service we received.

My wife and I ate here couple nights ago and the food was good as always excellent service very friendly people my concern is that nobody said a word to the couple that walked in and they brought a dog and carried the dog in in a blanket and then proceeded to set the dog on her lap with the dog basically sitting right there at the plate I find this very unsanitary and not necessary I don't know why people can't go anywhere without taking a dog especially into a restaurant. Definitely will have to consider one of the other Mexican places if that is what is going to be happening there.

Motherhood: A Warning

When you wake up to a crying child, make sure all your feet are ready to leap out of bed with you. Apparently, you can sprain an ankle STEPPING OUT OF BED. Humpf. 

That's the embarrassing story of how I sprained my ankle. Here is the nice story of the nice people at nice Primary Health who took care of me. 

It was 8:00 am on a Saturday when we decided I'd better get checked out, so we needed an urgent care that was open on the weekend. Luckily this big, new PH is now opened near our house and they open at 6:00 am. I hobbled into the car and my husband drove me. I hobbled inside and sat in the waiting room, while he checked me in. This part was a breeze. They had all my records from a flu shot the previous year, and all we had to do was pay a $20 co-pay. 

We waited for about 5 minutes and the nice medical assistant took me back. He got all my vitals, then we waited for the doc. We waited in the room for about another 5 minutes and then saw the doctor. He listened to my embarrassing story and assured me that I wasn't the first one he'd heard. Then he examined my ankle and sent me back for x-rays. This was the only part of my experience that was a bit annoying. Instead of getting me a wheelchair, I had to hobble down the long hallway on crutches. By that point, I'm really not feeling great so I felt pretty sorry for myself. :)

We waited another 5 minutes, and then looked over the scans. He gave us instructions, answered all our questions and sent us on our way. I'm grateful for these urgent care locations that make these type of non-emergency situations, if not less embarrassing, at least a little more convenient.

Yard house is the absolute best place in the valley to sample a huge selection of local and Northwest crafted brew. 

With a menu as long as your arm, you'll likely never have to try the same thing twice. I highly recommend the truffle fries if you are looking for a new addiction.

We took my mother in law to dinner for her birthday! She chose to go to Chili's and this location is our favorite and the closest to our house. I ordered the steak and made it a 10 ounce. I received the first one and it was well done and I ordered it medium rare the waiter was super nice and came right over and said he would have the manager order another one it came out and it literally was mooing he came back and I had it cut open and he said I'll get my manager we'll this is where I was absolutely  shocked with how rude the manager was she came over and immediately became defensive and said it's cooked to temp so that is medium rare so I said that's medium rare she said yes! I said no it's not and she again said yes it is and walked off! Never have I been treated so poorly at a restaurant! My mother's food and wife food was also cold when we received it and we ordered more beans because they were so cold and they came out again cold! Never again will any of us be going back to Chili's on eagle again! There manager is extremely rude and unprofessional!!!!!

Unhygienic. Humiliating. Inconsistent. Bad quality. Go elsewhere!! 
I wish I could give ZERO stars!! 

Went here based off of a review from a close friend who had amazing pedi experience. Sadly mine was not the same. 
I showed up on time to my appointment, and was BARELY given the time of day. I was in an out in under 29 min for a pedicure! Shortest pedicure of my life! 
Massage was non existent, they rushed everything, and at the very end they messed up my toe polish when they put my shoe on. 
Then they over charged me for the service. 
I called to complain when I got home because I didn't want to make a scene in public. They suggested I return so they could fix the messed up polish. 

The owner did my touch up, and told me that I should have come on a slower day, because they were busy on Saturdays.  (Also that She has a life and wants to watch sports too apparently!) Also that I shouldn't have called to complain later and that I should have said something right away.
So it was MY FAULT. Umm? Hello? I had an appointment!? 

Let me tell ya, it felt wonderful having the owner rip me a new one in front of everyone for no reason. 

Yeah, I will never return. The unprofessional attitude, public humiliation, terrible service. 
I don't know where they get off thinking they can treat paying customers this way. 
Too bad I paid cash or I would have called my bank to refund me every dime I gave them.

Save yourself the trouble and go somewhere else that isn't "so busy" so they can "enjoy watching sports" on weekends!!

Come for the donuts, not the coffee (or to chill x)!! Tried the coffee last night and it was like some hot butt, and not the good kind! Donuts were good, but the place was dirty. Floors were nasty..
Also, it sucks how expensive singles are... and you don't get a break in the price unless you get a dozen..! Cheap/lame marketing tricks.

This was my first experience ever at Texas Roadhouse. I always drive by the parking lot and it is ALWAYS PACKED!  We randomly decided to get dinner here on a Wednesday night. Waited maybe 5 minutes for a table. It was packed inside! They seat you with fresh rolls and butter - husband said they were delish. Our server was on top of it! She was great! And it really did seem like everyone working (there were a lot of workers) was cranking out food and touching tables. We had a free app promo so we tried the cactus blossom but I have to say we weren't big fans. Outback's bloomin onion is far superior. I ordered the bbq chicken with fries and veggies and my husband had the salmon with fries and chili. He loved the chili. The chicken dish was great. Overall we enjoyed our meal and the experience so we will definitely be returning!
I love this place! I eat here a lot and have never had an issue. The food is bomb. Recommend the spicy mandarin chicken.
I did a combo order of wings and fries and every single fry is over burnt and cold and hard as rocks not en edible fry out of the lot.

Y'all are awesome! I've eaten lunch here today and dinner last night and the food was FANTASTIC! As busy as they were, my meal still came out fresh in a timely manner both times. The gal taking the order was swamped but super polite and very friendly. The guy also had a rap battle with me in the drive through and nailed it! Thanks Trey!!!

Dr. Strickland is the Chiropractor in the valley.
He's treated my family for different issues and all of us have had great outcomes. He's knowledgeable and cares to really get to the root of your issue. He sets it up so you're treated according to your true needs...no unnecessary treatment. The team there works well and they're all so friendly. Highly recommended!

Terrible!!  I ordered a $22 steak meal and received 6 very thinly sliced steak pieces with overcooked potatoes.  It plated very prettily, but not much food and the steak was way undercooked.  It took a very long time to come out of the kitchen!  So disappointing!!

It was not a good experience for me. I ordered the carnitas and they were so fatty and soupy.  I actually gagged. I did send them back and reordered regular ground beef tacos.  Those were fine-nothing to write home about. Kinda blah.  
They were very understanding and did not charge me for the carnitas. I appreciated that. I've also tried the carne asada tacos and they were too grisly.  My husband had enchiladas and tamales and he liked them.  If I go back I would stick to the traditional enchiladas and tacos.
The restaurant was nice, clean and well laid out.

New to the area and State... dropped in for a good margarita.  Had two bartenders the first one (blonde colored hair) was extremely rude.  In summary after asking if she could change TV channel to a NBA game, she simply placed remote control directly in front of me and stated; "I don't have time for this" she never bothered to even try to look for the game.  I should note the bar was not full...in the next few mins I could not help but note she went on to have very obvious causal conversations with her co-workers.  She clearly was not overly burdened with work.  Now I should note after this she discontinued being my bartender and a brunette stepped in.  The brunette was what anyone would expect in terms of being customer oriented.    We  all have bad days at work, most are mindful to keep those comments to ourselves vs stating them out loud.
Best donuts ever! We came through and tried this place with my daughter. The donuts are fantastic and great customer service. Highly recommend.

I have been coming to Firehouse subs every since they opened up here in Meridian. Their subs are very good. My mainstay is the brisket, so I will focus on this one.

If you like Brisket, you have to try it here. Forget about those other fast food places that claim they make the best Brisket sandwich. They don't. Trust me, Ive tried them. 

Arbys, for example, says "We have the meats". Well, they do have the meats, but in my opinion, they are not very good meats and their brisket is..well, lets just say based on the taste, its questionable if it actually is Brisket, and I will leave it at that. 

The brisket here is very smoky, but its not a strong smoke flavor like you get from Hickory. I am going to email them and try to find out a bit more about how they smoke their meet and where. 

There is only 1 issue, which is not big , but big enough to costs Firehouse 1 star.

Like I said, I have been going to Firehouse for a long time now. I have probably been here 50 times or maybe more. This has been a pattern that I dont understand. But it happens often enough as to cost them a star and raise concerns.

It would be like spending a dollar to save a nickel. In this case they do great with The Meats, but they skimp on other things, which I really dont get.

On 4 out of 5 carry out visits, they put little to no sauce on the sandwich and they give me few or no pickles, which are supposed to come with the Brisket. So I get lots of meat, which is great, but on a Brisket sub, sauce plays a huge role in the overall goodness of it.

If a Brisket sandwich is short sauce, its like taking a Ferrari, which is 12 cylinder, and making it so it only fires on 6 cylinders. Sure the Ferrari will still run and do a decent job, but its not going to perform near as well as it could if it was running on all 12.

Same goes for their brisket sub. Sure its still good, but its nowhere near as good is it could be because its either missing the sauce or has very little of it.

Its the weirdest thing in my mind. They give me lots of meat most times, but then they short me on the sauce and the pickle. 

I woke up at 3am this morning thinking on this. Weird right? To wake up at the crack of dawn and think about a review you have written and a restaurant you have visited, but as I tell my wife, Welcome to My Mind.

The problem is that on their Brisket sub, they put both Mayo and BBQ sauce. Why Mayo I have no idea. Being from Texas, I hate Mayo with a passion and the combo of the 2 is, in my opinion, even weirder. Even my wife hates it and she was born and raised here in Idaho.

When I order the Brisket sub, I always ask them to leave off the Mayo. When they do, they do not add more BBQ sauce to make up for this. They use what must be the very same ratio of BBQ sauce to Mayo, which is light on the sauce and heavy on the Mayo.

What I end up with is a very dry sub because they stuck to their formula of very light BBQ sauce. So mystery solved. If you like me, do not like Mayo, and order this sub without it, do yourself a favor and ask them to go heavier on the BBQ sauce.

Before I forget, speaking of the meat, they do sometimes have a nasty habit of shorting this as well. I usually order double meat just for that reason. When they do double meat, they usually do give you a ton of meat, but you pay for it. 

The foot-long Brisket is $10 then another $5 for the double meat so this is a bit of an expensive sandwich. But trust me, it is worth it if you are a carnivore like me.

Sometimes their bread is stale as well and a weird texture. Have you ever put bread in the microwave? When you do this, there is a weird reaction that happens at the molecular level of the bread. It becomes chewy, so I am wondering if they are putting their bread in a microwave to warm it up.

So when you go here, which I suggest everyone does, especially if you love Brisket, make sure you get your  sauce and a pickle.

Brought my food home and when I went to eat the burger, it was completely pink inside! Called the manager. I wasn't looking for replacement food - I just wanted to make them aware of it for health and safety reasons - and was told that pink inside was their medium.

No thanks!

Booked 8am appointment for my 17 year old son. Got to the office at 7:45 with all new patient paperwork filled out and ready to go because my son had to work at 9am. Told the receptionist he would need to leave by 8:40 to get to work down the street. Was informed he was booked for an hour appointment and they wouldn't be able to reschedule him until September!  That's 3.5 months out and he is back in school by then!  If they just informed people ahead of time before booking the appointment that it would be for a whole hour, this could have been avoided. Now, my whole family will be finding a new dentist. It's unfortunate because my husband liked this office. I guess having too many patients is a good thing so they aren't worried when people leave.

It is handy and convenient to have a Lowe's so close to my house. BUT......... you will find a ton of sales people standing around talking to each other and you can never get them to help you. if there's a girl in the store with yoga pants good luck getting help at all!!!
I was in there today and had questions and nobody would help me I finally found some sales people but they didn't know anything at all on what I needed help with so the associate they pointed out to me was helping a girl with yoga pants pick out shades for her ceiling fan I waited for almost a half hour before I just left

Come on Lowe's

Avoid! There has been only one cashier in the entire building the las few times I've shopped here.  Every single time there is a line of five people waiting and others in self checkout.  I contacted corporate only to be told they would contact the store manager.  I went to do groceries yesterday and again there was only one cashier and I asked her why because there was a line of people.  The cashier told me that it was store policy to have only one cashier and Walmart was trying to get customers to use 'self-checkout' in particular people shopping a bunch of stuff.  Do yourself a favor and go to WinCo or elsewhere.

I've been doing business with them for the last year-and-a-half I normally buy a box of sin compromiso per week during outdoor season after taxes $272 little more expensive than downtown Boise and from my house I'm in between both today after purchasing a box of sin compromiso I asked for the humidifier pack and was told it was a dollar six really a dollar six he can't throw it in well for a dollar six you just lost my business
Great job! We were moving and needed the carpets cleaned on short notice. Not only did they do a great job they were able to meet our short deadline. Will be using them again in the future.

Hidden gem in historic downtown Meridian.
Steak (filet mignon) was some of the best I've had. Went back the next day for the Rueben, which was also one of best. Homemade everything. Great beer selection and has a cool vibe.
The wait was 2 hours long but the food made up for the long wait. I guess Texas Roadhouse will have to build another location to accommodate every who loves their food!

I just spent 2 hours in this store picking out wood for an outdoor playset, it was going to be around 300$. When I got to the register l told the Lowe's employee that I had a military ID on file. She pulled it up using my phone number, but said the address did not match my ID, sure enough it didn't. I've used it before with no problem and I had updated it online like was requested (before April 1st). I pulled up my account online and showed her that my online account matches my ID and includes my military verification..plus I had my military ID. She had to call someone and after their conversation, I asked her if she was going to put in my veteran discount...she said she couldn't and then she told me to purchase my items, then call costumer service and figure out why it's not the same as in their system, then come back and return and repurchase with my updated info... Umm I don't think thats how that should work. All in all a huge waste of my time. Home depot is closer to my house and I've always chose to go to Lowe's... No more. I can see why Lowe's are going out of business around the country

I started dealing with Norco about 45 years ago in down town Boise on River St. and always had good service. Recently we watched their new building going up in Meridian and could hardly wait for it to open,  "Wow" convenient and good service coming our way. WELL BOY WAS I WRONG; in 45 years of dealing with Norco I have NEVER had such POOR SERVICE. Yesterday was the second time in the new facility for CPAP supplies. The first time I had to wait about 30 minutes for service because there were several name before me. Yesterday 2/14 about 3 pm I signed their wait list and the entire names above me were crossed off and only one person in with the service rep, great, I'm next. They finished and the customer left, however; so did the service rep. I keep waiting and he never returned. Another 45 minutes go, still no service rep available. I've got another appointment I need to keep. I finally had to go and ask one of the employees at the front for assistance. She got a gentleman from the back and I was out of there in less than 10 minutes after waiting over an hour for assistance.

Shame on Norco the first time; shame on me the second time. I will be going to a different supplier in the future. This had to be the worst customer service I've ever had. I guess Norco has just gotten to big to manage properly. Norco is NOT the only supplier of medical or welding supplies in the area.

First time here. I went with a co-worker and we had a good time. Great prices on wings and they were pretty good. Very friendly service and cute waitress. Parking is ok but not the best. All we had was apps so I cant saying anything on the main food. I would deffently go back.

Caught Kahootz at the end of the lunch rush - had a 10 minute wait for seating (strangely, in 20 minutes almost every table was empty). Wait staff were very friendly and attentive and made sure our wait was pleasant.

Kahootz has a great lunch menu (dinner looks even better), especially if you're into red meat. Special for the day was clam chowder and fish and chips,  after all, it was Friday (when will the Friday "fish" thing ever end?).

Chose not to go with the specials - wife decided on the Hawaiian Chicken Salad (they were nice enough to bring her a sample of the dressing before she ordered - always a 5 star move). She said it was very good, but way more than she could eat (don't you just hate people who say that as you're licking your plate clean?).  I went with the Rueben Sandwich, which was excellent!!!!! Well, almost. It is served on marble rye bread (a Rueben staple), Swiss cheese (another go to item), Stienfelds kraut, "tons" of House Roasted Corned Beef (maybe not tons, but a huge amount), and homemade 1000 island dressing. It is the last item that poses the problem with perfection - the amount of 1000 island dressing, mixed with the kraut, made it impossible to pick up the sandwich in a normal manner (the dressing basically soaked through the bottom half of the sandwich) - i had to eat it with my fork and knife. But that little inconvenience did not in any way take away the taste of the sandwich - excellent!!!!!!

O, i did order a craft beer with the meal - Pako's Eye-P-A (cute, huh?) from Snake River Brewing. Wait person ask if I wanted a glass or mug - I like handles, so went with the mug - sometimes it pays to read the menu and actually listen to the wait staff - a glass is 16 oz and a mug is 25!!!! Made for a long afternoon nap - lol.

All in all, Kahootz was a good experience, one that I hope to repeat in the near future.
Great juicy burgers and their onions rings are beer battered. Fries are also good. It's become one of favorite burger places.

The service at the bar is consistently bad. Wait to order a beer and get a menu. Wait for the beer. Wait to order food. Wait to order a second beer. Wait to pay your tab. Yah, the service is just not very good. Three bartenders waiting on maybe a dozen people around the bar should not be overwhelming for them. And yet... it is. Also, $7 for a run of the mill beer is a couple dollars too much in Boise, ID.
Needed somewhere to eat while getting new tires. They are polite, quick and it was quiet while I enjoyed the great General Tso chicken. Will come back. Glad I found this place.

Saw Randi for a massage package and it she was absolutely wonderful. Although we got a late start (they only have one dressing room and it was occupied while I was waiting to go in) she tacked on an extra fifteen minutes to the treatment to make up for lost time. Everything from the oil journey and scalp massage to her attention to detail in my tense shoulders was amazing. She was very sweet and made sure I was comfortable the entire. I loved sitting in the steam room after my treatment as well. 

The spa was clean, the customer service was great, and I left feeling like a new person. I can't wait to go back and see Randi again!

The Donut + Dog 
Located at The Village in Meridian, this business may be best known for their donuts, but it would be a mistake to underestimate their dogs, which are extraordinary. All of the hotdogs are nitrate free and based on recipes created in house, with the exception of the smoked kielbasa. Like the donuts, each dog is built on the concept of layering sweet and savory flavors. For my first dog, I chose the Chili and Beer Cheese dog, which is bacon wrapped and topped with beanless chili. In the first bite, you taste creamy (cheese sauce), sweet (chili), savory (dog), saltiness (bacon -which also add crunch), finished with some heat (chili). You also get the  texture and flavor of the buttered and toasted brioche bun. I added a side of Elote "Mexican" Street Corn and Loco Fries, both of which had layers  flavors and were  outstanding. Highly Recommended!!!

.Ordered the wing bundle package with 20 boneless and 20 traditional wings ... comes with sauces, carrots, and fries. Fries were cold and soggy, they left out our carrots, blue cheese and ranch in the bundle and also left out the two side orders of carrots, ranch and blue cheese we payed extra for. How are you gunna order wings and they forget the sauces??? super effing retarded. You guys SUCK!!!!

Service was wonderful.

Food was uninspiring and not worth a repeat or the money $$'s spent.

Noise level is deafening and you just want to get your check and leave.  I am convinced places do that to drive you out and get more "turns" on their tables.

One and only time for us, Sorry.

0 for 2 To Go. My wife ordered the chick Chipotle Fresh Mex Bowl the last two visits, each order to go. The first time they forgot the dressing and the second time they forgot the avocado. Maybe if the manager wasn't playing putt putt behind the bar with the servers, he could make sure the orders going out of the kitchen were correct.
Food is OK, not great. Fries were cold. And service at lunch at the bar was terrible!

The food was bad the service sucked and was really slow and they wouldn't put my game on the tv...she only checked on us 2 times in an hour and a half...if she was faster we would have spent more money and drank more beer, don't know her name but she was a red head with freckles and curly hair, made me not want to go back

This was our first time ordering from Crave...  I pre-ordered our lunch the day before and it arrived right on time. 

We ordered from the Mi Almita restaurant.  My wife and I were excited to try it because coming from San Diego, we are natural Mexican food junkies, and love to try new Mexican food options in the Treasure Valley as they become available...  (one of our concerns when we first moved to Idaho 22 years ago was that we were doomed to have to settle with bland sub-par Mexican food in our new home.   On our first dine in experience, the square of American cheese on my Chile Relleno did nothing to quell my trepidation, and frankly made me die a little inside.  --thankfully, since then we have found better options in Boise :P)

From Mi Almita, we ordered the Enchiladas de Pollo (red sauce) for my wife, the Tacos (Carne Brava) for me, and chips and guac to split.

The chips and guac were good; both were freshly made.  A few chips were slightly under done with a slightly chewy consistency, but most were fine.

My wife liked her enchiladas but wasn't wow'ed by them.  She felt they were a bit bland and wouldn't order them again.

The tacos:  The meat was plentiful, but I felt it and the onions/peppers were also pretty bland.  Salt was the standout spice in the meat.  --not that it was overly salty, just that in the absence of other flavors, that's the spice that stood out.  The included sauces and cilantro/onion (provided on the side) helped.  --the habanero sauce had a nice bite.  The corn tortillas though were a train wreck:  you can have soft tortillas; you can have crunchy tortillas, and you can have a soft tortillas that are slightly fried to help give the shell some texture and physical integrity.  However, if you do the latter, you CANNOT overcook them...  The tortillas were like shoe leather.  I couldn't bite trough the tacos; I had to chew through them, which made the taco filling want to squirt out the sides of the taco.  When I was done eating, my jaw muscles were literally sore from chewing tortilla, as though I had been eating jerky.  Serious.

I hear that others have had better experiences than ours ordering from Mi Almita.  Hopefully, our experience was due to the restaurant being new and cooking inconsistencies haven't been ironed out yet.  (some charring of the meat and vegies I think would have really enhanced the flavor of my taco innards).  Next week we will try the Crave fish restaurant... the shrimp tacos there look amazing!
Great beer section!! I had the prime rib dinner special and it was perfect, the food is amazing and the wait staff is prompt and friendly.
The pitas are great. I had the chicken with pesto. Seasoned perfectly. My wife and I split one and was plenty.

Me: Do you have hot tea?
Waitress: Yes
Me: Do you have english breakfast or Earl Grey? 
waitress: blank stare
me: what kind of tea do you have?
waitress: Regular tea
me: that's like saying you have regular soda
waitress: confused look.
me: no worries, bring me vodka & we will both be happier.

The food was classic chili's - which is tasty & fun.
The server was pleasant, and punctual.

there was a question if there was MSG in the fajita seasoning (if you are sensitive), and i'm not quite convinced that the top shelf alcohols i ordered were used (Cointreau vs triple sec - although there was a $2 up charge for the cointreau on the bill) the taste difference to me is like pure cane sugar vs artificial sweetener in soft drinks (yes, i'm a snob !!)

This is our go to Chinese spot. We've been coming here for a couple years and the sweet waitress/owner remembers my order at this point. The entire family is truly so nice. The food is also delicious! Everything I've tried has been so good and well worth the price. The portions are perfect and the food is always fresh. Everyone I've introduced to this place has loved it as well! Highly recommend trying it out!

What time does the billing office close at? I get home from work about 4:25, I call Norco and I get disconnected after I push 5. It will ring once or twice and that's it. I don't write reviews, especially bad ones. Hate to say it, but this sucks that people can't call in to pay a bill.

Donuts are really really expensive here for Albertsons quality donuts. Nice locations and the whole shop is neat but the prices just get to me every time. Donuts aren't that bad, just could be better.

Found this place through door dash. Let's me say I've never actually been inside. The food was amazing! I had the French dip sandwich and it was to die for. It was cooked perfectly. The steak was high quality, it tasted like it has been smoker for hours. It was tender and juicy. My wife had the brisket sandwich and it was just as good! Will definitely order from here again!
Nope... this isn't authentic and definitely not worth the price! Similar to Panda Express! Very disappointed!

I am super grateful to be able to have the opportunity to still order take out during this pandemic. However, I am extremely disappointed with my order. I picked up the food within the order time and and ate it within 5 minutes of ordering it. The boneless chicken quality has gone down over the years. My chicken and fries were cold and not to mention my fries were soggy, the portions were lacking as well. I felt very ripped off. We will not be coming back to Buffalo Wild Wings, it's too bad because it used to be my favorite. Oh, and you forgot my carrots and celery, my fault for not checking the bag but I shouldn't have to do that it should already be done correctly the first time.

Extremely poor customer service tonight. The waitress had bad attitude once we came in at 11:00 pm. She took our order and never once checked on us. The manager Jeff then came to our table apologizing but at this point it was too late. I am extremely disappointed with the staff and management tonight. I would not recommend this restaurant to anyone past 10:30 pm because they shut down at 11:00 pm on Thursday's.
yardhouse has good service but they need a better menu. i got orange chicken and my rice was undercooked, i haven't liked any food there, but my friends do so maybe it's just me

Manager refers to mixed race Portuguese black as porch nigger As a person of color. I cannot stand by, and allow This Racist attitude manager to continue to be in public. He needs to find a job where he's not around people of mixed races. I would never again eat at this restaurant and encourage all people with good conscience to boycott. It's hard enough to survive in this town without having to deal with people like him. Ownership get your act together!!

The service is exceptional. Fantastic waiters and waitresses. The atmosphere was really nice as well. The three stars are for those two elements.

The food? 0 stars
It was comparable to my very European mother using the first Pinterest recipe she found with ingredients found at the Jacksons gas station.

Just moving here from Las Vegas, so far this is the best ramen place my wife and I have found. Really friendly and tentative staff. The menu is great, never had spicy shrimp wontons, and they didn't disappoint

I was a bit apprehensive at first. The old "you get what you pay for" etc. I was first impressed with the check in. There were about 20 people at the door and the process was seamless. Upon pickup there again was great organization and I was given clear instructions in handling our post op pet care.

I would recommend SNIP to anyone. They also offer other services; shots, nail trim, microchipping etc. along with a spay or neuter. What a great service for the valley animal population!

I am unsure why this place has gotten such challenging reviews. My son and I came here after camping. We were both impressed with the food and the freshness of the fish was superior to many coastal places. At the same time, the value of the meal was off the charts. A 14 piece so she made dinner, which included miso soup and came on a bed of nice greens, was $16. A medium poke bowl with three scoops of fish was $12. Lots of food and quality fish in landlocked Boise. Impressive
Norco is busy place but delivery was professional and prompt. Billing is well managed.

I thought I knew what to expect when I came here. That's why I ordered the potstickers. Finally something new and unique!

Never in my life did I ever think I would ever be served a hard, fried, greasy sack of meat comparable to the dehydrated meat found in cup noodles. On top of that it seemed they were run over with a steamroller. New? Yes. Unique? Sure. Would I recommend this to my worst enemy? Likely.




I also don't recommend the noodles.

This is by far my favorite Sushi go to! especially on $ days...great way to grab a quick bite if you can't stay awhile. I really like the variety offered and the ease of ordering. The staff are the best and work hard to provide great tasting, quality food.

One of my favorite local restaurants, have eaten here numerous times,  Their steaks, pterodactyl wings, and bread pudding are all winners. On the weekends it can take a while to get in, because of the popularity and small size,  The staff are friendly and efficient.  If you order the bread pudding it's is enough for 2 to 4,  an out of this world delicacy. Everything I have ordered here has been very good with large portions.

I'm so happy to have this restaurant close to us. Pretty kid friendly so I can see it being a place that we'll visit a lot in the future. We came in early on a Friday evening with a party of 4 plus child. They seemed a little short handed (probably due to covid so not holding it against them). Our server was very friendly and attentive. Everyone liked the drinks they ordered. I ordered a virgin mojito since I'm pregnant and it was super fresh tasting. Our pizzas were all good. The risotto balls were okay. Tasted room temp rather than hot and fresh. My daughter enjoyed her mac and cheese and the server packed up her cookie to go. We all had a good time. I will definitely come back.

Great spot for lunch or dinner. Their soup and salad bar deal for lunch is great. Our personal favorites are the fish and chips and the prime rib dip sandwich. Their "scones" are AMAZING! Little on the pricey side but the portions are good and the food is always tasty.

Took an hour to get my online order ready. 4 people ahead of me who waited about the same. 
Takes way too long.

I was having mechanical problems with my clutch 800 miles from home.  These guys were a lifesaver!!! They fixed it in a few minutes and my bike is running perfectly!  It's so scary breaking down far from home.  If all businesses were like this we would be living in a better world.  Kudos to Triumph Boise!!! They really care about their customers.
One of our favorite burger spots! Only downside is their dinner staff always seem to mess up our orders so we only go for lunch. Classic home style burgers and their onion rings are amazing!

We had an awesome server and the busboy took care of us as well. My gyro totally hit the spot, beer selection was awesome for my husband and it really seemed like everyone in the busy place was happy with their food, drink, and service. We will definitely be back!
