This is literally the best dog park. It's so clean and big enough for there to be different dog groups to play with.  Path to walk laps if you want to. Very clean and even has pools you can fill with water for your dog.  We were just visiting but wish we had a dog park like this near us.
As a Texan, this is the only place I have found Tex-mex style queso since moving to Boise area! Must go, enjoy!
My favorite ramen house in the Treasure Valley

If you have an alternate place to get wings, I suggest giving it a try.  We have been customers of BWW for a while now.  We have dined in, used take out, and delivery.  No matter what, whether during COVID-19 or before, we have found this place to be inconsistent, sloppy, and careless.  The quality just isn't there.  The price isn't good enough to draw business away from other places offering wings.  The food is haphazardly prepared and presented.  The only consistent thing we've found is that BWW always forgets an item.  Like many people, we've been utilizing take out and delivery for the past seven months and our orders always have missing items.  We tried to present feedback to BWW through their website using the contact us form and have not heard anything from them, except the automated form letter response telling us they received our feedback.  Unfortunately, this type of mediocre quality/experience is common when a business becomes popular.

This was my second visit to R&R BBQ. Everything on the first visit was great, except for the Ribs. After reading my first review, the Manager of the Restaurant contacted me and persuaded me to come back and give him another try. I reluctantly agreed to do so. I have to tell you that I'm sooooo glad I did! This time everything was Excellent! The jalapeño hush puppies were just as good as the first time. Not to dense, deep fried to a golden brown. Not greasy at all and full of flavor! This time I had Mac 'n Cheese, which was outstanding! Full of cheesey flavor, noodles cooked perfectly as was the cheese sauce. Just the right thickness, and not to much to overpower the dish. I could eat that again and again! The sliced brisket was just as good as the first time, smoked to perfection with a great bark and smoke layer. Very moist and seasoned just right. And last but not least, the baby back ribs. These ate like "Award Winning Ribs" as advertised! Awesome smoke ring and outstanding bark, seasoned to perfection. Tremendous bite, and outstanding taste! The Manager checked in on me several times, genuinely caring about my experience. He felt that the first time I had the ribs, though they had been fully cooked to temperature, they had not received final seasoning and the final cook to produce tender ribs with a great bark. The first time they probably had been inadvertently pulled and served. Hey, stuff happens! As I said, I'm really glad I went back, and without a doubt, I'll be going back - several times! The food is fantastic and for BBQ (lots of time and work) it's very reasonably priced. If you like BBQ, I highly recommend you visit R&R BBQ!

I'm always hesitant to stop in for a late lunch anywhere, however, the parking lot was half full at Pueblo Lindo and many guests could be seen seated near the windows. This was a welcoming site at 2:00!  

Standard chips and salsa hit the table as soon as we did. Nothing remarkable, just good. Ordered the Chile Colorado which was tender and flavored as expected. Huge kids portion of the shredded beef casadilla. 

Overall it was a good experience. Didn't find anything particularly extraordinary, however, nothing wrong with decent consistency.

I should have looked at the recent reviews before ordering. Obviously this place didn't have any time during quarantine to work on customer service. The manager hung up on me when I called to ask why I got 1 cup of ranch for 25 wings and only 1 celery stick...not like 1 chopped up into smaller pieces...1 stick of celery. He said you didn't click the right buttons and I said well why wouldn't an error message pop up and say you had 4 choices and only took 2?? He just said you did it wrong and hung up. Don't worry I won't get it wrong again because that's the last order you will get from us.

ABSOLUTELY GARBAGE! I am a very huge fan of Texas Roadhouse and I have never ever received any service this low at any of the others in the country. First issue salads came out not a single one was correct for a table of five. Maybe they got confused got it. Then we had no silverware for said salads, ok maybe she forgot. Got the silverware and food was still on the batch. Moving on to the entrees.... not a single steak came out the way instructed to cook. Medium rare was apparently jerky in their eyes. Instead of taking the plates back the waitress returns with an empty plate and only takes steaks so the table is left with sides..... for 30... freaking.... minutes.... no steaks... Don't even begin to wait for a beer.... just forget it. The one plate that came out on time and complete was a burger... Salty as the sea! At this point being understanding is out the window. Once the manager came out to ask if everything was ok we spoke up and all of a sudden the steaks came out. I have never written a remotely bad review on A Texas Roadhouse and it pains me to submit this one but this place was one word..... TRASH. Eat at Popeyes next door before you waste your time at this place.

Had a date here and the steaks are amazing and the customer service is great. I love the environment, the perfect atmosphere while eating in this restaurant, the lighting is not bright, very comfortable. Love to come back again!
Food and service was excellent. I had the club and my husband had the Ruben. Would recommend both!

I have been taking my family to Dr. Jarvis since we moved to Idaho 3 years ago.

All services were okay, not blown away with amazing customer service, not bad service just okay.

The reason I will be finding a new dentist is due to the service I received last, very poor.

A job change meant I had no dental coverage, my wife took my kids and herself for cleaning and check up. My wife informed them we no longer had dental insurance and we would be paying ourselves. The office still sent to insurance company, and guess what, it was denied. Dr. Jarvis' office then began calling for payment, ok, it happens. I talked to office staff and was told bill was past due, and that insurance was denied. I told the office send the bill to me and I would pay ASAP, they said ok, will do.
They continued to call my home like I was trying to skip out on the bill, that they never sent me!!!

I know have bill, will send payment, and find a new dentist.

I hope that Dr. Jarvis reads and reviews her companies policies on how the engage customers.

And 1 more thing.........
THEY ARE NOT OPEN ON FRIDAY'S....
This has driven me crazy for 3 years because that is the best day for me to do appointments.

We do love the food at homestead but a recent visit left us feeling very disappointed. I called ahead to ask what measures were being taken to help stop the spread of COVID-19. Whoever I talked to told me they were keeping tables 6 feet apart, not keeping condiments on the table, and that's about it. We decided to give it a try even though their efforts seemed less than stellar. We were very disappointed to arrive and find the restaurant totally packed. We were sat almost shoulder to shoulder with the table next to us. None of the staff were wearing masks. They were refilling water glasses from table to table, picking up each glass to fill, spreading germs. We won't be back until they take this pandemic seriously and prove to their customers that they care about their health. I want to feel safe when I go out to eat and I did not.
Just a quick note to say thanks for all of your help and support through this process. You certainly met all of our expectations and we're extremely grateful for your service!

We went the other day. Service was good.  Excellent Beer selection. Full bar. Clean bathrooms. Excellent easy going vibe. My husbands homemade pastrami sandwich was very good. I had a a chicken salad with cranberries, pecans and blue cheese. Our friends had fish and chips which was very very good. 
We will definitely go back to explore the menu. 
The girl next to us had a Mega Mary which looked fun and she said was great. Was a Bloody Mary with a soft pretzel, a slider, bacon, a fried chicken drumstick and some other stuff that made it a cocktail and a meal!

This place has the best Ramen in the area in my opinion and dam good Asian food all together. The broth can be a little more on the salty side, but I just tell them "less salt" and the order comes out delicious. I recently ordered other dishes like the fried rice, beef broccoli and general chicken. Each dish was delicious and the staff is friendly and courteous. This is my go to spot in the TV.

Best ramen bowls in town! The spicy pork and roast beef bowls are delish and HUGE!!! Our kids loved the orange chickens and even liked our ramen bowls. Amazing service and very clean. This will for sure be a weekly stop for us.
Customer service Is always curious & friendly. They have a great beer menu that rotates everyday. I also recommend the bacon blue cheese burger.

For us, the remodel experience was completely different than the 7 previous reviews. Shawn appeared to be knowledgeable and smart however we received the brunt of all of his learning mistakes. It was hell for us from January to June 2018.  Many promises were made but just to get us to pay him some money.  We were left to deal with one of the unlicensed contractors he brought on the job, one who ultimately caused us endless headaches and who walked off the job with our money. By filing a complaint to CSLB against that contractor it was discovered that Shawn was in violation as well to have hired an unlicensed contractor so CSLB filed a complaint against him and we were included for "abandonment" since he has yet to finish our punch list and close out our contract. He was found guilty, fined with a mark on his license. This guy is slick and sadly his needs and desires were far more important than ours.
Have eaten here couple of times. Great food! Bit loud but it's a sports bar. Their Mac & Cheese is yummy! My personal favorite is their Reuben sandwich-my mouth is watering while thinking about it!
Pharmacy consistently makes mistakes.  If you have multiple prescriptions, they always seem to forget one and you have to make 2 trips...
Always have a great meal when we go here! The poke nachos, jambalaya with noodles, and the drinks are so yummy!!

Oh my word my son bought me a 4- pack of donuts here  for Mother's Day and they were so fluffy and delicious  I'm going to try there bacon wrapped hot dog my kids did they loved it great place but you have to order a day earlier on the donuts or two days but it's worth it every bite I'm going back 
Mary W

Nice orderly and clean dining area.  Good lighting and furniture.  The standard tonkatsu chashu pork item was as expected.  A good blending of fish broth, pork, egg, seasoning and noodles.  

I was looking for a place that matched the strong, somewhat greasy broth that I could get in many places in Gardena, CA.  Also, I was looking for a place where they serve it hot & spicy.  

I spoke to the server about spicier items and she said more are on the way in the next few weeks.  Good for them.

Meanwhile, it is back to my "go-to" haunt of Ramapong where I can get a ramen that might possibly be used as paint stripper.  Now that is the real deal.

Kona had the pleasure of meeting Madison today! She did a wonderful job grooming him!! She took time to listen to how I wanted his hair cut- I'm very picky- She was very friendly and professional and arrived on time.  I'm very pleased with the service and highly recommend her!!

Let me start by saying this review could apply to every kitchen we've tried at Crave.  So far, we've ordered from about 3/4 of the businesses.  Tonight we tried their newest tenant....Crawford Cookshop.  This restaurant advertises their food as "comfort food" and I'd have to say that's an accurate description.  It is, however, comfortable with a little twist.   The meatloaf was was served with a savory mushroom sauce and the brisket loaf was just a tiny bit spicy with cumin flavors.  A nice side of slightly chunky mashed potatoes accompanied.   The other entree we tried was their chicken pot pie.  A generous amount of white meat chicken mixed with the requisite veggies is prepared with a rich, but not overpowering gravy and topped with a large, crisp and delicious homemade biscuit.  It's a nice presentation that looks as good as it tastes.  As always, the Crave order arrived piping hot.

We have never really ordered delivered food because it never seemed worth the price once you paid delivery charge and tip.  And the food was simply never as hot as it should be.  Crave has solved much of that issue.  The standard delivery fee is reasonable and the containers used by several of the restaurants allow the food to both stay hot and finish that last bit of cooking that occurs after the food is removed from the oven.

If you haven't tried this business, I recommend you give it  a try.  It's a good opportunity to experience some excellent food from some well-known chefs in the comfort of your own home.

Well R&R took what was a fail to satisfy a customer order to an EPIC fail to do the right thing.

A few weeks back, I ordered a burger thru a delivery service.  Here is the actual order as shown on-line.

Cheeseburger  Choice of Cheese: Cheddar. Addition: Onion Ring & Bacon  Side Choice: French Fries $12.06

The web ordering system is straightforward.  It lists the various burgers and how you can modify them.  I added an Onion ring and Bacon to the basic Cheeseburger.  They won't let you complete the order until you choose a side.  French fries was what I chose.

What did I get?  A burger as ordered, but no fries.  I contacted the business to report the shortage on the order.  The female representative mentioned that they would not ask the driver to return, but I could pick up the fries.  Hahaha, funny.  She realized that wasn't an option and offered to send out a gift card to me the next day.  

Well, it has been weeks, now and no card.  This is how to convert a fail into an epic fail.

Not recommended.

This place is amazing! It's a must go. We had the crab ragoons and the pork ramen. The food was delicious and the service above par. Great atmosphere as well. We will definitely be going back and soon.

Waited 45 minutes for my teenager to get a COVID-19 vaccine. Five kids, who arrived after us, were taken back and we were left waiting. I inquired when it would be our turn and was given a response that offered no guarantee or actual answer. We left. Very disappointing because this is our regular clinic.

If your looking for alcoholic drinks this is your place. Lots of beer on tap and giant margaritas and Bloody Mary's. The food was decent. I had a burger and it was kinda bland but the fries were amazing. My husband had the Mac and cheese and it was very good. Wish I would have gotten that instead. Great atmosphere definitely a great hang out spot.

I used this service for almost a year I paid  with tip $110. I was happy with Melissa (who always cut his hair) I received a message Melissa was no longer with the company. I wasn't home when the new girl came my husband said it took her about 90 mins when I came home his hair was hanging in the left side of his face (Yorkie) over an inch longer and didn't seem to have done much cutting. Unfortunately I won't be using this service. I did call and spoke to the owner who was very apologetic and said she would have fixed it but I already made the decision to not use this service.

Got the tonkotsu ramen and the gyoza. I'm pretty sure the gyoza are the same potstickers i used to buy frozen from the grocery store. The ramen didn't have a home cooked flavor to it either. It all felt very pre-made. Even the mushrooms tasted like they came out of a package. I liked the spicy pork I added, but I would not consider it "spicy" at all. 
Thanks to ramen house for the meal, but it's not a place I'll be coming back to any time soon.
Very delicious, I will definitely come back and try different dish. Very friendly waiters.
Peached Tortilla is one of our favorite restaurants from Austin! Freaked out when we saw it in Boise. Personally we love the Southern Fun, but you can't go wrong with any of their food!

Our group was craving Ramen. Found this gem while driving from Boise. We ordered Tonkatsu, Miso and the house special ramen all three were excellent. Their fried rice was cooked perfectly. I wish we had ordered an extra rice to take home. The service could not have been better- so friendly great recommendations. I didn't get pictures. Everyone ate so fast. Definitely will come back when in Idaho.

Rough day at Kahootz!! 
The server was great, but the food and length of time were dreadful!! There were 7 of us, we ordered drinks and after we received them we were informed of how long dinner would take-not enough help in the kitchen. 
Our steaks were all over cooked. The asparagus was good, so were the fries. 
I'd wait until the staffing shortage gets resolved. 
They did take 3 of the steaks off the bill. The server tried hard to do a Good job! Not her fault that the kitchen couldn't deliver!
Not even open? Their sign says they are closed Sunday and Monday...fine, but it's Saturday afternoon. Disappointing.

Just like all the other reviews, this place is legit. Coming from southern Cal specifically San Diego area. They are up there with the best we've had. Please come and check it out. Don't be disappointed.
All time fav restaurant. Service is always great! Food & drinks are amazing! The Spanish sangria & nachos are a must try .

So delicious! Tried the Tonkatsu ramen, broth is on point...nothing but good things to say about appetizers and entrees. Matcha also perfect, not too sweet. Services was also excellent. We will definitely be supporting this ramen house.

I moved back to the area and it's always tough finding a new artist. I had friends who recommended their artists but the style I was looking for wasn't there. Even after doing the leg work and checking out their past jobs it's still nerve wracking. But I am so happy I found Erykane Ink! The shop is clean. The artists are very talented and friendly. They don't try to talk you out of your ideas but work with you. Highly recommend them!!

I went to Lowe's to buy the blinds for home. I regret getting the blinds from them because it's been an ordeal for 7 months. Some parts were missing, wrong color and other the wrong size. We have been waiting for the right-sized wand for one of our windows for about 6 months. We have been told 4 times that the wand is already ordered and all we have to do is wait for it. After 6 months we're still waiting. My son got his blinds for his home from Home Depot and he had a better experience than mine.

Good was amazing and our server was very attentive. The only reason I didn't rate this place 5 stars was that the entrees came out immediately after the salads and the restaurant was in need of a cleaning. There was a lot of dust in the ledges and blinds which I wouldn't expect to find in a place of this caliber.

This is a must try if you are looking for a fun place to grab a bite in the Village @ Meridian, ID. Don't be fooled by the fact that they sell hot dogs. These aren't anything like the regular hot dogs you get at home...these are artisan with great flavor profiles and attention to detail. I ordered the Flying Hawaiian with grilled pineapple, bacon crumbles and teriyaki sauce. It was a great mix of sweet and salty. I LOVED it! I upgraded my fries to Parmesan Truffle fries and it was well worth it. They were delicious too! We were too full to eat any donuts but saw they also offer a Sunday brunch. I can't wait to try this place again. It has a very cool vibe to it with vibrant artwork and great music. It's hard not to leave the Donut + Dog with a full belly and a smile on your face!

We did takeout. Every thing was well packed, separated. The chicken with mushrooms was delicious. Curbside parking and just in front of the window was awesome! They sent us a text when our food was ready to pick up!

First time visit and went for the Caveman Burger with a side of Mac n cheese. This burger is quite filling - hamburger Patty, 1/2 sausage link cut sideways, and a decent portion of pulled pork. The burger was average but very filling.

I also ordered a side of fried pickles and these were a huge disappointment. They were not crispy - basically eating hot pickle chips that were lightly bartered. Not sure if they need more batter/more cooking time or both.

Wife & I ate dinner there Friday afternoon 3-4.
I ordered the filet steak & wife ordered the bone in pork chop. Everything came out good will definitely go back. Good ambiance with good food & beer.
We sat at the bar.

This deli is one of a kind, at least for the area. We saw it highlighted on the news, and have been interested to try it ever since. There are no prices on their menu board. It is a 'pay what you want' / 'pay what you can' community deli. We split a turkey avocado. For a sandwich that could have been free, I was quite impressed (almost like eating at a Hugo's type deli). The bread was soft, the turkey was piled on, the veggies were very fresh (including the fresh avocado), and the portion was generous size. The lady behind the counter was very sweet, and friendly. She came by with a platter of tasty cookies when she cleared our dishes for us. We happily paid 'extra' and like knowing that it would be paid forward for someone less fortunate to have an opportunity to enjoy something there.

We've been there twice this month!  First visit was to celebrate our 27th anniversary, and today's visit was to celebrate my 51st Birthday.  Both times were highly enjoyable, super-tasty, fulfilling (naps afterwards), and had great service.  Service and interactions with waiters Giovanni and Colt were wonderful.  And both visits warranted me requesting their GM, Derek to visit our table.  I told him that I've lived/been to 9 different states and lived/been to 6 different countries, and that their Ft. Worth Ribeye was the best in my life!

If you haven't been there yet, and you're reading this review, saddle up and mosey on over there!
I was a little disappointed that they were out of the wings that I wanted but the food and beer selection was still great. I'll come back again to get the wings.
Fast delivery and accurate order. Detroit Pizza was delicious! My wife had crab Mac n Cheese, sooo good.

If I could give zero stars, I would! My husband and I went in to give it another go because in our past experiences we have not had good service and our food has come out cold. Went in on Sunday, sat down at a table next to the door and sat there for 10 to 15 minutes before somebody flew by and threw menus on our table and said that they would find us a server. Sat there for an additional 10 minutes and never once did anyone come to ask us what we would like to drink or if we were ready to order our food. We walked out! Tables uncomfortably close to one another. People next to us couldn't get up without me having to stand up and push in my chair. Over it. Will not be back.

Super happy to add a star to this review. During social distancing, we are trying take out from as many local joints as we can. My husband wanted a steak, so Kahootz it was! Ordering was easy. I called in and the very awesome and friendly manager took my order. 20 minutes later I was leaving with my food. My husband got the Junior New York and said it was cooked really nicely. I got the romaine wedge salad and it was awesome! The in-house bleu cheese dressing is absolutely incredible. I wonder if they bottle it...? Also, love their in-house croutons! They are crunchy, but not so stale that you can't stab it with a fork. 

A great take out option for an elevated meal!

Ventured out to dinner last night not realizing we'd find ourselves with an hour+ wait everywhere at the Village, so we considered other options. Chili's had a 30 min wait, so we decided to try it after over 10 years of not going. While the service was really great, the food was not. It was a slight up from Taco Bell, and I'd even prefer Taco Bell's tortillas and beans over Chilis. The chips and salsa were good, but everything else was just gross. The chicken is so processed and slimy. They make it look so good on the menu pictures, but don't be fooled, it's bad. Really bad. 0 stars for food quality, an extra star for good service. We will never return.

Kate's Bridal Cottage is such a cute bridal cottage! It was such an intimate experience when i went dress shopping in early January. Upon arrival, I was greeted by a cute personalized welcome sign. I was the only one dress shopping so i had Mackenzie's undivided attention. She listened to my every wants, likes, and dislikes. I probably tried on around 10-15 dresses and Mackenzie was just super patient the whole time. It was definitely an amazing bridal experience. & i said yes to the dress that same day! Its been 4 months since i committed to the dress and i haven't had any dress regrets at all.

We ate at flat bread pizza tonight and what a great experience! We had a fantastic pizza and the grandkids got to make their own pizza they bring you the kids meal pizza not cooked and the grandkids put the sauce and the goodies on it and then they cook it for you ! Our waitress Jessica was super nice and the place was so busy I was trying to get a glass of wine and Walter the manager came by and went and poured it himself and brought it back to me what great service unbelievable! Best pizza we've had in a long time and great service thank you so much!

I did not know that it was possible to get such bizarrely different customer service in the same visit, and for it to be so weirdly gender specific. Chris and the other male employee I interacted with were fantastic. Great customer service, treated me like they were happy to have me there, and were helpful in trying to find what I was looking for. The female employees... well, they either looked at me like I was a sex offender for even being in there, (I'm gay af and looking for Xmas gifts for my mom, who has Alzheimer's dementia, not looking for an employee to be my girlfriend, ok?) avoided me, or could barely be bothered with even the most basic customer service. 

One big point of contention was that a previous customer had apparently left a meth lab in the men's room. (They said that it was "not safe for people to be in the men's room"; the only explanation for that which makes any kind of sense is a meth lab. I don't think a structural issue would be confined to just the men's room. There could have been a magical being shrinking people down and then flushing them down the toilet in the men's room, I guess... but the meth lab explanation seems strangely more plausible than a magical being. The manager on duty stressed that a customer was the one who had made the men's bathroom dangerous to occupy as if all customers were on the same team and we had all been in on it. Any way, I should not have to have a long debate about customer service with an overfull bladder just to get to use a bathroom, but that was exactly what happened. If something goes wrong with one gender's restroom, you either close both or make one unisex-you don't just tell one gender "who cares if you need to use the bathroom?". The M.O.D. suggested going to the store next door on either side, but if I am going to do that, then I am going to spend the money I would have spent in Marshall's in the stores next door. 

Also for what it is worth, "not safe for people to be in the men's room" is a group of words that I never thought I would have to use together in a sentence in a Yelp review, but here we are. 

One other odd moment was when Chris was trying to help me find my mom some yoga pants and over the ear pieces all of the employees had, he asked someone to come help me because that was not his department. A couple of minutes later a female employee came over with a customer. I made eye contact with her to see if she was the employee Chris had called for me, and she stared back at me like "what are you looking at, creep?!" ‍‍‍

Lowe's customer service is piss poor. My order was delayed months due to COVID-19. I would have understood if Lowe's took the time to investigate and provide a updated delivery date, but after many calls and run-around misinformation Manager Paul Shragg was incredibly rude and dismissive. The man has no business dealing with customers. Lowe's quality has declined considerably. I recommend you find an alternative, otherwise don't expect common courtesy .

Had a dinner date with the wife on a Friday night. (12/04/20). Unfortunately they said the wait was 45 minutes to get inside. We were hungry so decided to brace the cold outdoor seating. Big mistake. It was right at 30 degrees and they sat us on steel lattice chairs away from the free standing heaters.  The wife was looking frosty in about 10 minutes. Luckily a couple left and we were able to move closer inside the outdoor lean-to three sided structure.  I reminded the Arctic staff that we weren't from California, but no no dice, stuck outside. We had cocktails that almost iced over before the food arrived.  The food was great and we endured the conditions without frost bite. Funny, in less than the 45 minutes, several groups showed up and the wait was less than 15 minutes. Be advised, hold off until spring unless you dress for cold and not a dinner date. 
I'm not giving access to my photo library, so no photos will be posted.
Very tasty spot!!! However, the service was extremely slow, and the pizzas were way overpriced. I'd rather drive 4 hours to Salt Lake City for Settebello than pay the costs here again.
The quality of the food has been consistently great, both in the restaurant and to-go through out restrictions. The steaks are cooked perfectly every time.

Very large lounge 20-30 seats. Excellent cigar selection. Beverages available. Beer and wine available and full liquor license soon. 2 large flat screen TVs. Great vib and friendly crowds. Roll-up windows for the nice weather. WiFi available. Check www.Facebook.com/TheVault1905 for events and daily video posts.

While the donuts were delicious, I wasn't thrilled at all with the service. The food and drinks were pretty overpriced but it's a fun place to sit and eat. However, the workers were very slow and it took a little over an hour to get one cup of coffee (not exaggerating here). I was very frustrated by the time I left. While it was busy at the time, I could clearly see that no one was working on drinks. Another customer was also frustrated with the wait as well. When I finally received my coffee it didn't taste like what I thought I had ordered! If you have time and money to spare you may want to give this place a visit, but unless someone else is paying I don't think I'll be visiting again.

Great job cleaning the carpets! They had a wonderful special on Facebook and I used to clean the apartment for move out. Made it look brand new!!! Took longer than expected but they didn't charge me a penny over the estimate. Wonderful job!

https://m.facebook.com/dunnrightrestoration

I have dined at the Matador (Village) a few times now. It seems we go here when we have company, and we are visiting the Village. 
The good:
The atmosphere is outstanding. Decorated very nicely. Mixed with new and old. It gives it a very upscale feel.
The staff are very friendly, and attentive. Lots of smiles.
The drinks are surprisingly good. A nice amount of alcohol, and very creative selections. Try to smoky margarita. 
The not so good:
The food.....blah. I know going in I am going to get Americanized Mexican, but lack of flavor, and execution make this a no go in the future.
Ordered  off the special list last night. Flank Steak (citrus marinated) with Mexican potato salad (weird right?). The meal arrived and a very small portion of bland flank steak (cooked well though) and some yellow potatoes in a tangy sauce of some kind. No hints of citrus, and no seasoning. The meal came with a couple of green onions, which typically would have been char roasted (I asked for a couple of jalapenos as well).
The (both) had been thrown on a grill for maybe 20 seconds, and both were still raw.
This is about the same story with each visit, so as beautiful a place as it is, we will probably not be back unless it is for drinks and an appetizer.

Ugh. I don't even know where to start. First off I guess we have been struggling to find good Chinese food since moving to Idaho. This place had great reviews and the pictures of the food looked so good but man were we fooled.  Our waitress was so un kind. It took forever to really be helped and all she did was rush us and didn't listen to anything we said or were asking. 

We ended up getting 3 of the dinner combos - 4 pick. So an entree, soup, rice and egg roll. We got the egg flower soup and it had zero salt or flavor. Actually, it tasted like soap. My other 2 guest didn't want anything new but I had 2 bites and wanted a warm soup. So I stopped her and asked to try the hot and sour soup and her answer was "umm..." so my dad chimed I'm and said the answer is "yes.. you can get her a new soup.." after some debating she finally said ok. Once she brought me the soup she had a nasty comment to go along with it. 

All the other interactions with her were equally unpleasant. The hot and sour soup was better than the egg flour for sure! We then got the shrimp appetizer and not only was the batter so thick but it was not even close to being cooked all the way. I saw a picture on Yelp with the shrimp having a white sauce drizzled over them. So I asked her for that and she looked at me like I was crazy and said she had no idea what I was talking about. So, I showed her the pic and she finally realized it was the honey sauce. 

The food looked good when it came out. And I was so frustrated by this point but I was really trying to think she was just having an off night and that the food would make up for it. Well... I was wrong. The Mongolian beef had 5 pieces of chicken; the rest was onion. The fried rice was ok. And the egg roll was good on the first bite but when I got down to the meat it was so disgusting. Like, legit disgusting. 

My husband got the mandarin chicken so we shared. I ate most of his. Until I got towards the last few bites and something was horribly wrong with my piece of chicken, I had to spit it out. By that point I was over it and walked out to let the rest of my party to pay the bill. (Not happy about that either... and of course because of her horrible service her tip was a big fat $0.00) 

I don't understand how they could have so many to go orders or people eating there. The meat was horrible and none of the food (except maybe the rice) was good. I am so mad I waisted so much money. And I still cannot get over how bad our server was.

I had heard in the past that this was a good little restaurant.  I have driven by it many times and have always been curious about it.

Since this terrible pandemic hit we have been primarily eating in.  Today for Easter I told my wife and daughter we should order takeout.  She read reviews about this restaurant and they were positive.  

She ordered and I drive here to get our meal.  We ordered a pasta salad, two salads, a chicken rosemarie sandwich, a chicken mushroom sandwich, a hamburger, and a small flat bread pizza. 

The person working there was so nice and professional.  He talked with me for a while and I really liked the look inside the restaurant.  When this pandemic is over and businesses start to reopen we will come here.  He showed me their happy hour menu, and it is on our list of places to go.

I wished the staff a Happy Easter and returned home to eat.  The food was incredible.  The bread was light and fresh.  The meat was juicy, the salads were fresh, and the pizza was delicious.  

We have left overs for another meal.  If you are in the area of Fred Meyer at Linder and Chinden stop by this restaurant.  Great staff and delicious food.  You won't be disappointed.
The staff, atmosphere, and the food are all amazing. Worth the drive and the wait. This is a must if you are in the Meridian areaRib Eye Steak

This was the worst BWW we have attended. Our waitress, Trina, said they serve food once it's done and don't wait to serve all the food at once. Seemed like a good idea at first, until we received an order of fries, then 5 minutes later 1 kids meal. Then 5 minutes later another kids meal. Then my wife received her wings 5 minutes later. And then I received mine 5 minutes later. So now our fries were cold since we wanted to eat them with our meal. Trina was friendly and seemed overworked for Amy he amount of people in the restaurant. 

I ordered a Moscow mule and it was not balance, and had too much alcohol. The wings were decent but the overall operation was not good. I don't know that we'll be coming back to this location.

We love this dog park! We moved here in November and are anxiously waiting for the grass side to open but we frequent Storey about 3x a week or so. I will say there are occasionally a few fiesty dogs but luckily with the huge baseball fields next to this park if things start to get rowdy I'll take my dog over to the grass fields and walk him around there. Great spot to get your steps in while your dog socializes too!

Always tasty, consistent and great service! Regardless where you try TR, it's always the same... great! Do yourself a favor and give them a try or a return visit because the steaks and ribs are excellent! Oh by the way, the draft beers are awesome and they rotate craft beers through which have been great additions to the overall experience.

I'm honestly surprised no one has gotten sick from this place. I decided to stop by tonight to try this place for the first time and boy was it unsightly. The kitchen was absolutely filthy. All of the produce in the pita prep area was rotting. Cheese was turning brown. Lettuce was black and gooey. Hummus looked so old, the top layer was a different color than the bottom. There were tons of different things mushed into the cutting boards, turning them a mix of brown and black instead of the white color they should be. All of the sauce bottles were filthy and had a crust on the top of them. The grill looked like it hadn't been cleaned in years. Spatulas and grill utensils were slimy. Grease covered walls. Trash all over the floor. The kids behind the counter would handle money, touch the register, touch the the fridge, touch the pita, then all the condiments that go in your pita, without changing their gloves once. It was gross and screamed of cross contamination. 

I think the health department needs to pay a visit to this place before someone becomes seriously ill.

The Hot Spot is rapidly becoming my favorite fast breakfast place in West Boise. The service is exceptional and the food is plentiful and tasty.

I like that everything is made from scratch so it takes just a bit longer but it really isn't noticeable​. Hot Spot hasn't really be discovered yet so you can always get a place to sit during the week which is very nice.

For me,​ good coffee is a must at breakfast and theirs is very good. They are great at keeping your cup topped off.

The breakfasts are large and cooked exactly the way you want them. The lunchtime meals are also very good. The finger steaks are my second favorite in town, they could be seasoned a little better but you won't be sad you ordered them.

Give the Hot Spot a shot, you'll be very happy ... and full!

This location is consistently chaotic. If you order to go expect your food to be wrong. If you sit in expect to get COVID, there's no space between seating, full capacity for their tuesday deals. Super confusing when we ordered on phone. I waited 30 mins after their estimated time for my original food. the entire order was wrong. They messed up, offered to pay the difference, then charged my card for the difference of their mess up? The three teenagers tried to argue with me and tried to tell me i ordered it wrong. Manager Caroline even didn't acknowledge me until she brought out the new wings.

Today was our 1st time here my husband & I stopped in here today for lunch after hearing a bunch of great things and the rumors are true! This place is fan-freakin'-tastic! I had Pollo a La Crema & the hubs had Chicken Mole'  both were so yummy & flavorful! The rice had great flavor! The salsa wasn't the hottest but still a decent spice & great flavor! Servers were friendly. We loved everything so much we came back in the same day for dinner & brought family! And got to try 2 more dishes which were also amazing! We asked if they had a spicier salsa to have with the chips & they did, they brought out a jalapeno salsa & a habanero salsa, I didn't try the habanero one but my husband & mother in law loved it. I thought it was a really good combination mixing their jalapeno salsa with the original salsa they bring out. So the dishes that were ordered for our dinners was the Carne Asada, the garlic shrimp (don't remember the exact name of the dish) & a chicken enchilada which was huge! Everything else was soooo good! My sis in law finished her entire meal & she never does that! I also got a mango margarita with their happy hour prices. We would highly recommend this place & we will definitely be back, you won't be disappointed!

We can't recommend the Meridian Jos. A. Bank highly enough! Ken and his team were absolutely wonderful to work with. Planning a wedding during COVID is hard but the team at Jos. A. Bank in Meridian made our lives so much easier. They went above and beyond to be sure all our groomsmen had their suits in time for the wedding despite closures etc.. They even worked with us to accommodate several guys who lived in states where there were no Jos. A. Bank stores open by taking their measurements over the phone and getting their suits ordered for them! Any couples planning a wedding NEED to go see Ken and his team! Thank you Jos. A. Bank Meridian Team!!

If I could give zero stars I would. Probably the most traumatic salon experience I've had in years, and I've gone to A LOT of salons in past years. I have dry, long, thick hair. It's extremely difficult to deal with on my own so I'm forced to go to salons very often for help just properly straightening it. I came in to Rain Salon asking for a botanical conditioning a blowout and a straightening, (of course). The conditioning and wash went well and the straightening was alright. The stylist worked quickly and I thought it was because of skill but I realized before long that she was in a hurry. My hair takes a bit longer, naturally. She probably had a client waiting, which she did. She didn't blow dry the hair all the way through because of her rush. Then the worst happened, I'd been needing a trim, so I said if we had the time to go ahead. She cut too much. It devastated me. The type of hair that I have, if you cut just. too. much. It gets puffy. All. The. Time. 

I asked for a refund at the end of service. I hadn't had a good look in a mirror at my hair until I'd gone to the bathroom. But a woman not working that day but happening to be there refused me immediately. She was quickly defensive and talked over me. I'm a meek person, I never argue. I felt like I was bullied. I left the salon that day in tears wishing I was a stronger person who could stand up for myself. I was unhappy with the cut they should have refunded period. But instead they turned aggressive. 

Do not go expecting a refund for a service you disliked. They will most likely refuse you with the retort, "it was not done incorrectly." It doesn't matter if the service was unacceptable to you. Your opinion doesn't matter. 

I won't come to this salon again. To say the least.

It was my Mom's 91st birthday. She lives at a senior retirement home and I wanted to buy donuts for everyone to celebrate her birthday. I live out of town, I called the store to buy some donuts and the store manager donated the donuts! Such a nice thing to do!  They were all so excited! They loved them! It is always a treat for them to get Krispy Kreme! Thank you so much to everyone at the Meridian Krispy Kreme!
Dollar sushi Monday and Tuesday! Yum
Friendly hospitality and great atmosphere. Food came hot, generous portions for the price.
Place is honestly mids. Harry Potter vibes on the inside. Hella expensive. Food is nothing special.
Wow so so yummy! So happy we came across this place. Ordered twice now and both times our meals were better than expected! Hoping the quality continues to stay the same!

Horrible customer service. Awful. Rude and it's just the drive up open. Very disappointed. I have family from out of town and they wanted to go there but instead we went to Albertsons. Donuts not as good but I don't want to feel like I'm bothering someone for doing their job!  Manager needs to fire some people.

The tuna seemed like it had been frozen and had a very chewy texture. The rice was crunchy like it had been sitting too long. My order ended up having seaweed when I didn't order seaweed. The spicy mayo was good and I ended up eating the salmon and avocado.

My family and I love to go to Mongos.  The food is great.  You can have all you can eat or just one serving.  The food and place is always fresh and clean.  It can be as healthy or non healthy as you desire.  Depends what you put in your bowl and the sauce you put on top.  I love the veggies and Tilapia which is lean and low fat.  There are so many ways you can make your dish and if you don't like it you can always go back and try something else.  The staff has always been very nice.  Good is great.  We have made it our family birthday destination.  You have to try it out if you like the Mongolian BBQ style food.  All You can or want to eat.

After years of back pain, multiple chiropractor, massage, and medical treatments and advise, I finally feeL like we might have a solution at Alliance with their more whole-body approach with therapy, medical, chiropractic and massage all working in harmony.

Tonight, we had the 2 Meat plate (sausage and brisket) with hush puppies and Mac and cheese, and the 6 piece BBQ wings with original sauce. The brisket was tender and tasty, sausage (kielbasa I think) I prefer with more color on the outside (there were grill marks but they needed to be cooked for a few minutes on a high flame in my cast iron), the sides were delicious (Mac was al dente and covered in a yummy, white, cheesy sauce) and the wings were tossed in a BBQ sauce that had a little kick to it--there was a side of good ranch to compliment. 

I would order again but pass on the sausage. I had food delivered so I wasn't able to order the ribs which is what I really wanted to try (app said it wasn't available) same for the garlic smash with gravy. I'll try ribs next time.

Great food, excellent service! Castle was our bar tender and server, we have been in a number of times and always set at the bar so he can serve us, always does a great job. The food here is outstanding as well, we have had a number of different items from the menu, and all have been very good! BTW, they have great deals for happy hour.

Very bad service. First we sat at the bar, and I asked the female bartender if she could put our name in for a table. She said,"Well you can walk over there and do it." It was not close and I asked her if she didn't have a way of communicating with the front. Well then she huffed and puffed and went around the bar to give the hostess our name which is what she should have done in the first place. Poor service. Then we sit down to eat, and they brought ALL food at once. Appetizers, soups, and entrees. I complained to the waiter and he brought his manager over. She said we had  to specify we wanted things brought out separately. Now I don't know who taught her or where she has been eating, but soups, salads, and ESPECIALLY the appetizer are always brought out first. ALWAYS. Because while you are eating your soup or appetizer your entree is getting cold. All she did was make excuses. I would have had much more respect if she apologized and said something like the kitchen got backed up.......anything admitting their mistake. The food was pretty good, but I will never go back there, and I will tell everyone I know not to go there. They should have also comped a glass of wine or done something. Nothing but lame excuses and no understanding of the restaurant business. Hey manager. When your menu says starter it means starter!

I was recently prescribed a CPAP machine through Norco. When I went to the appointment at Norco I was provided two options that were both fairly similar. During the meeting I asked several times how much it was going to cost. Each time I was told that there wasn't any way to give me a total up front. In hindsight this should have been a red flag. Now almost 3 months down the road and I owe $725 to Norco. I called 3 times and no one picked up the phone so I went in person. Turns out the machine is leased at $100 per month. I can break this lease and return the machine to avoid more charges, but I still have to pay the $725 including the lease and supplies they gave me. So in essence, I pay another $700 to finish the lease and keep the machine or I return the machine and lose $725 anyway. This seems incredibly wrong since I was never told how much I would end up paying. I simply trusted the representative when she said it "won't be that much". The kicker is that this companies motto is "Serving you better".

Update: the manager of this location, Brent, called me today. He acknowledged that this process for billing is problematic and shared that Norco is working on a permanent solution. He agreed to help by crediting a portion of the money I owed. His response felt sincere and I appreciate the gesture. I'm updating my rating from 1 to 4 stars given the prompt response.

My daughter was here visiting and I suggested this place for her to get her roots and undergrowth re-done.  My daughter went in to see Lyndsay and when she came home she was bawling because none of the top or undergrowth was done and then after being qouted $140 for long hair and $40 for a haircut and minus $10 for having a yelp coupon, it was supposed to be $170 but when it was done it was $200!!!!!!  ( She planned on tipping Lyndsay $20). I called the salon at which nobody wanted to say who ran the shop, they said they are all their own boss but after being persistant, I was told Stephanie owns the salon.  I spoke with Stephanie who assured me she would look at it and get to the bottom of the problem. She explained that the girls were all trying a new way of doing hair color these days and it takes a bit to get the top to show up. So I sent my daughter who was embarressed to go back, back to the salon where Stephanie greeted her outside. ( I assume so the other customers couldn't hear).  Stephanie tried to tell my daughter that it was normal for the roots and undergrowth to still be brown, not BLONDE ( I was on the phone the whole time) and that it would all be blonde after a few washes or something, well its been over a week and still no BLONDE on top.  She never did offer to fix it and so then when my daughter asked her about the over charging, Stephanie said "no one qoutes prices over the phone" ( so basically called my daughter a liar) she finally went in to the salon and came back and pushed $40 in to my daughter's hand and then stormed back inside.  No apology, no offer to fix it, and just no customer service whatsoever!!!! even after assuring me that if I sent my daughter back over there, that she would be professional about it.  My daughter wasn't a teenager, she is a grown adult who knows how color should look when you walk out of a salon.  I am not want to complain or write reviews but her hair on the top and underneath was exactly the same as before she went in!!!!!!

Another after golf lunch! For some reason was desirous of a hot dog and remembered seeing a sign at the corner of Meridian and Fairview - one of these strip malls with a Rue Aide, a Subway and a pizza place. I was surprised to discover that Taste of Chicago wasn't a store front restaurant but more of a food truck type of place - nothing wrong with that, it just surprised me.

Never having eaten a "Chicago dog" I wasn't sure what to expect so went with the "original". My friends, I must say it was a most pleasant experience - probably the best dog I have ever eaten!!!!!

The only advice I would is to eat it there rather than "to go" - the bun does not hold up to travel well.

Was looking for some unique cards / birthday themed items and was woefully disappointed at what this store had to offer.  For a store affiliated with the Hallmark brand I expected much more.  The store is sparsely stocked, very small selection of wrapping paper and ribbons that one would be looking for with a card.  Also the gift items are seriously lacking in comparison to every other Hallmark store i have been in. For example figurines, ornaments, chimes, window decor, soaps, lotions, pretty much everything you would expect in a gift shop is missing the mark here.  They have a nice candy counter, with chocolates sourced from Portland (if I recall correctly), and the staff is very nice but other than that, I'll pass.

Slow service (server had a table of 20 besides our table of two, really??), half order of nachos was below standard (crappy chuncks of chicken, very little cheese). Margaritas were terrific tho! Overall, this place is really noisy; music is way too loud.

Homestead used to be our favorite burger place. We would never go in and sit down to eat though because the noise level is unbearable. You can't hear the people at your own table talking. We were fine getting our food to go. 

The last 4 times we have ordered online they have messed something up. Our order is not hard and we have no customizations to our burgers. They always forget to include the ranch and fry sauce. There shouldn't be a spot in the online ordering section that asks what condiments you want if they aren't going to include them. On multiple occasions my husband's mushroom Swiss burger had uncooked mushrooms instead of sautéed or there will literally be 2 mushroom slices on it. 

Last night was the breaking point. I am 35 weeks pregnant and all I wanted was the BBQ burger. We ordered online as usual and my husband picked it up. Upon opening my to go box I was instantly disappointed. I instantly noticed there was no fry sauce and my burger was wrong as well. There was maybe 4 drops of BBQ sauce on the burger and it had clumps of seasoning all over. The most irritating part was there was no onion ring on it, which is of course my favorite part.  

If you like a super loud restaurant with less than friendly staff or having your order messed up then this place is for you. Otherwise I would look elsewhere.
Been here 4 times, BBQ is excellent.  Reminds me of Texas BBQ joint.  Big portions, great flavor employees always friendly.

TPD is the worst property management co I've ever used.
Courtney will promise you the moon, but not return phone calls.  I'm an owner and had to leave a note on their office door to have them call me back.  

She only wants to communicate through email. 

I never felt like a priority.  I felt like I was on the back burner.  I felt like my property was not being taken care of and that my wishes as an owners where not considered.....Simply the worst communicators ever.

I've been to this Matador at least 20-30 times since it opened years ago. Literally went last week at the same time and had a great experience. But tonight at 3:50 pm my girl and I came in, requested a booth, got sat at the first booth closest to the front door, and then sat there, watched three tables and a big tip directly next to us get sat and immediately get waters and chips. We sat until 4:15pm before we made the decision to get up and leave. At least 6 members of staff walked past us several times before I finally came to this decision. Every time we visit we spend 100$ or more. I don't know what happened to the management but I'm over this place.

We found them looking for cash options. We haven't gone anywhere else since and would recommend them to anyone. Their prices are fair, the dental work is well done, and everyone is welcoming and personable.

This is white people Mexican food. I ordered the chicken, thinking it was found to be a full breast, it's basically a sliver of a chicken breast. Horrible. Tortilla is Missions. Recently moved here from Houston, TX and I'm just trying to save y'all from paying for non authentic Mexican cuisine. Go to Chipotle, you'll get more food for your money!

It is a corporate beer-drinking spot, so you go into it with a pretty good idea of what you are going to get. I live walking distance to The Village so I have frequented each of the dining locations there, a number of times.  And without a doubt the two that I return to the most are The Yard House (if I am in the mood for a low key, beer-drinking evening), or Backstage Bistro (if wine is the drink of choice for that given outing).  

Yard House has a large selection of beer from all over the world.  It is a big space that can accommodate large or small groups.  And overall it has a pretty good menu.  Overall it is surpassed my expectations.  There is nothing super esoteric, or creative with their food offerings. But everything is good. And it is always a good time.

Love them!  Easy to work with, reliable, and professional.  We've used them twice now and it's been great.  Once when we moved to Boise, then to move our stuff from one storage unit to another when it flooded.  That time was last minute and at the end of winter and they were able to get a team together quickly and help us out; it was the highlight of a bad situation! I've  recommended them to a few friends and they've had nothing but good things to say also.  They are fairly priced, helpful, and trustworthy.  The movers aren't the type to hunt at or make you feel like tips are expected but we always do because we're always so pleased with the service

Instagram SOLD me on wanting to try this place. So my husband, kiddo and I  took an adventure today. 

We arrived right when the store opened and were able to place our order. Everything on the menu sounded incredible.. but we stuck to just ordering what we knew we would eat. 

I had the lumberjack with a campfire cappuccino. The lumberjack is a waffle with their Nashville hot chicken. It's served on top of their maple brioche Donut with a piece of bacon. I am typically not a bacon/maple combo fan.. but let me tell ya, the savory from the chicken made this eeriest brunch item amazing! 

The campfire cappuccino was also very good. It wasn't very sweet (which I appreciated). It was also served with a locally made toasted huckleberry marshmallow. Personally, I would have preferred a plain toasted marshmallow... but that's  just me. 

We had full intensions to bring some of their amazing donuts home for later.. however, we were just WAY too full. Aside from their brunch and lunch menu, I look forward to returning to try their delicious donuts

Was on a business trip from Seattle when a friend of mine suggested we go to the Matador.  I love the Matadors in Washington and didn't know they had one in Meridian.  Wow, this is the coolest Matador i've been to by far.  I was shocked to find out they only had been open a few days because our server Shae was great, the food was great as always and I love the new frozen mango margarita's.  Way to go Matador!  Love your restaurant and will be back.  From the looks of the crowd there on a Thursday it looks like others do as well.

We are in the midst of the Covid 19 pandemic, people being asked to socially distance while still supporting local restaurants. (Takeout and delivery are much safer than dining in) We decided to pick up a phone order from Texas Roadhouse in Meridian Idaho.  Much to our surprise and dismay, the restaurant was packed with diners and the waiting area was full. How can this be safe social distancing? The mayor of Meridian announced that there would be a fine for anyone not adhering to CDC guidelines during this time. Shame on Texas Roadhouse for allowing people to dine in and shame on the people of Meridian who don't get it. How many people have to die before we take this seriously???!!!

I highly recommend that you boycott Krispy Kreme. They are scammers. They have an app that you are supposed to be able to use to buy donuts after loading the app with money. I Downloaded the app, loaded up $25 onto it, and then was told at our local store they do not accept the app.  I spoke to the manager as well. She stated for me to get my money back I needed to speak with corporate. I have sent now over a two-week period three emails and have called KK three times to get my money. They have accused me of lying because they say that the store here is supposed to take the app and accept the money on my app. I have explained to them the local store is saying they do not. Who's right? I know that they owe me $25 and I cannot get it back. FRAUD, THIEVES. Don't go there

The only reason I'm giving them 4 stars is because they DO NOT have their liquor license yet and that's kind of a bummer.  I love a good Patron margarita with my Mexican food but the only margarita they offer is a pre-mixed Jose Cuervo.  However, if you like micheladas (my husband does) theirs are delicious and the presentation is cool too!
We've been twice in the past week and it's definitely our new fave.  We love the ambiance and the comfortable seating as well as the delicious food that's reasonably priced.

For starters their salsa is some of the best I've had at a local Mexican restaurant.  We also ordered the chile con queso and guacamole dip.  If you're not a fan of Velveeta cheese I wouldn't recommend the cheese dip but I'd order double of the guacamole.

We have dined here twice with two different groups and the food is exceptional.  Everyone loved their meal.  My husband though his seafood alambre was just "okay" and opted for a carne asada torta the next time that he absolutely loved.  I can't stayaway from the hard shell tacos... I got both ground beef and chicken and the second visit I also added a verde beef enchilada.  We will be regulars from now on... especially once they get their liquor license.

I want to start off by saying you're going to want to join their online waitlist. I dined in on a Saturday and the wait list was about 90 minutes. Once it was our turn to be seated we were sent a text and were allowed to come inside the restaurant. They don't allow people to wait in the entrance area. 

Our table had just been sanitized and they have small plastic dividers between booths. However, this placed was packed! They were not limiting capacity compared to other restaurants in the Valley and masks are not required when entering or exiting. I saw one table with 8 people but most had about 5-6/ table. For those reasons my family and will not be back to dine in. 

The food was good I would give it a 4/5. Our waitress was very polite and attentive. I don't recommend the piña colada. It lacked flavor instead I recommend you get a margarita.

Went today for the first time. Ordered pulled pork, brisket and the chicken thighs. Excellent!!! The brisket was tender and not dry. The pulled pork ... delicious , moist and flavorful.  My husband doesn't care for chicken thighs... ate these ... no problem.  They were full of flavor and so tender and not dry. Will be back.
Not a fan of the spicy tuna roll but they have a great beer selection and vegetarian menu.

We stopped in for a special reason - we have a celiac member of our household, and that makes eating from restaurants a special challenge. In particular, pasta/ramen/asian restaurants have been tough to find good options. So we came in and asked the front desk a few questions. They said they could do rice noodles and check on the broth, so we gave it a trial run. Always a bit of a gamble, but we very much wanted to have a nearby ramen option!

The chef himself came out twice to clarify things, and a third time after realizing one of the ingredients in the broth he custom-made for her might have been a problem. The food itself was delicious, and seems to have been completely safe.

We -really- appreciated the staff going the extra mile for us - if it had been a busy time we would have felt bad for taking so much time and extra effort on our behalf. We'll definitely try to return during slow hours so as not to disrupt things. If they ever end up adding pre-made gluten-free options to the menu to simplify things (possibly by finding a good GF soy sauce to keep on hand), it will probably become one of our most-visited restaurants!

The food is good, the staff is helpful and we highly recommend trying this place for anyone looking for a nice warm bowl of ramen, GF or otherwise!

Hadn't been here yet, and were always looking for something new.  I had tried to get delivery the day before, but it turns out I'm just a shade out of the coverage area, so we decided to get take-out the next night.  It was terrific!  

The bang for your buck is certainly there.  For $25, we got enough spaghetti for 3 people, with lots of leftovers, plus extra bread and 2 amazing meatballs.  We got the "leaded" sauce (with meat) and it was great.  We also go the spicy sauce on the meatballs, and that was amazing!  Everything about the food was delicious, and we'll be back for more.  The food was ready in 10 minutes, and everyone in the place was super friendly.  It's not an eat-in establishment, but closer to a Papa Murphy's feel, pick up and delivery.  Still, it was fast and very, very good.  

In closing, it's worth every penny.  For a privately owned business, it holds it's own and I highly recommend us locals continue to support it.  Thanks!

Third time's a charm!  Our first visit ended up with us leaving because the wait was so long, and we were really hungry. The second visit, the bar top was closed and there was a wait for restaurant seating so we went elsewhere.  

Last night, we made sure to get there early and had no problem getting seated. The bar top was busy but we found two spots.  It was happy hour and appetizers, flatbread pizzas and drinks were all three dollars off.  Great deal! Where else can you get 2 Grey Goose vodka and sodas for 11 bucks plus the fantastic menu they offer?!  Since it was our first time here, we started looking around to see what other people were eating and the couple next to us had a rather scrumptious-looking plate of food in front of her.  She was nice enough to tell us it was the Tender Steak Bites and Mushrooms but she opted to order the appetizer as a meal and had a baked potato to boot! Of course we ordered that as an appetizer and it did not disappoint. They weren't kidding when they said tender, the pieces and the overall taste was superb. My husband who's usually more picky than I am fell in love and pretty much ate the whole dish himself!  Hence, the order of calamari that followed. Those were very tender and not gummy or chewy and the batter was crispy.  

I had been craving prime rib for months now and finally decided to order it after asking Justin, who brought out the calamari, told me the prime rib is always good. Yes, indeed it was delicious.  I was very satisfied.  We look forward to returning to Jakers soon!

There was no one at the door when we arrived. We waited about 5 minutes before someone helped us; which was not the hostess. No idea where he/she was??? After we were seated we wanted 15 minutes when we left because the waitress had still not bothered to show up at our table!!! I will not be going back!!!

If I could give them 0 stars I would. We ordered take out in when we got home we served up the Chow Mein and we all put one bite in our mouths and spit it out immediately. Nauseating! The only description I can think of is rancid. The kind of smell and taste you would have with food that you've left in your refrigerator for 2 weeks or more on accident.  If we would have eaten even a few bites of that food we would have been all violently sick.  We have young children and it is very dangerous for a restaurant to be sending this kind of old food out. They would not give us our money back when we brought the food back and that is why I have decided to write this review....they don't care! Very disappointed that they don't understand that they need to be held to a standard of serving edible food as they are a restaurant serving the trusting public.

We enjoyed this place very much! We were in Tokyo and Korea last year and this place is very authentic. My daughter and I rate this as number 1 in Boise, but we still haven't visited all the ramen joints yet. If you want a great atmosphere and authentic ramen, this is the place!

OMG! This fine establishment has created a menu item that will sweep the nation. In the little known town of Meridian ID the Yard House combined chicken sliced into one inch strips, breaded, and deep fried. It's like fish and chips but chicken instead of fish. Combine this with a tomato based dipping sauce equals pure magic. Thank you to Lisa for recommendation and compliments to the chef!
Fish and seaweed were obviously dyed. So fishy I spit it out and hoped not to get sick.

Atmosphere A+, Lobster-A+, Dan-A++, Jessica-A++, sitting in the bar watching the gal clean the blinds on the front windows with her duster while eating our tasty Shrimp cocktail-F, watching and smelling the window spray cleaner as the gal cleaned the front doors as we ate our yummy Lobster dinner-F.  Has management changed?  Dinner was great, cocktails were great, and our servers were superb, as always ... but whoever watched as the cleaning occurred during holiday dinner service made a poor decision. Peace out.
Great food and staff is always upbeat and seem to enjoy their jobs.  Love the drive thru, I have kids!

Dinner rolls and peanuts that meet you at the table are pretty good. Ordered a margarita that was too tart to even get halfway through. The food was bland. Large serving sizes. Friendly ambience. Server was nice. Food just didn't measure up.
Amazing artists!!! Eryka does work like I've never seen before. The shop is super clean and friendly! They even have a new amazing nail artist!! Highly recommend!!!

It was my first time going to the donut + dog. The gentleman working was very kind and knowledgeable on each doughnut and he even explained their brioche dough and what makes it so great.  The doughnuts were delicious! My favorite was the brown butter! But they all were very good. You can definitely taste the quality, plus they weren't greasy.
Ramen House is authentic Japanese food it reminds me of my moms cooking when I was growing up. Simple ingredients and freshly made.
Love me some BarBQue!!! Great ribs, I just moved to the area and this is now my official BBQ place.
I can not wait to come back here at the end of the month. Pizza was so good. Just had the margarita but they all looked so good.

A delightful young lady greeted me for my visit. I believe her name is Abbey. Little did I know, she would create such a delicious pizza that I my mouth would water the next day for more.  I was impressed at first bite.  To her credit, I did come back the next day... not only for the pizza but for her smiling  service!

We found this company through Living Social. I should have passed on them from the get go because the owner said that I could just pay him directly the discounted rate rather than purchase the service through Living Social. That in itself speaks to "lack of" integrity. He committed to us that if we saw bugs in-between scheduled quarterly visits, he would come and do re-sprays at no charge. Well.... sure enough we continued to have bug issues after about a week after he came and sprayed. We called and left message after message, no response. We sent e-mail after e-mail, again no response. So we then asked to have our money refunded, again no response, no refund. This again speaks to the "lack of" integrity. His website clearly says that "Customer satisfaction is our top priority Or it's Free". We even had our attorney send a letter advising that they honor their "money back guarantee", still no response. I have now filed a complaint with the Better Business Bureau. If you are looking for a bug company, I would caution you to AVOID THIS COMPANY!

Rarely do I give a single star. It's due to food and service. Mom and me, we ordered the cactus (bloomin') onion as appetizer, she ordered 6oz sirloin, I ordered 20oz bone in ribeye (AKA Tomahawk). Mom ordered medium, I ordered medium rare, both with baked potatoes, both with salad. Salad came out before appetizer.  Onion app was raw, sent back. Steaks delivered to table, mom's was medium well, mine was medium. Mom ate hers, I sent mine back. 2nd try came out RAW, manager delivered (I'm assuming, she didn't introduce herself or explain where the waitress was). She stood while I cut into it, when I showed her the raw interior, she said, "what was it supposed to be?"  REALLY? I pushed it to the end of the table, she took it, I said, "That's it, I'm done". While waiting for mom to finish, she brought me ANOTHER one. I refused. Ticket came, mom said "wait a minute, I want to see that" but the manager took my card anyway. Kara was manager's name. She came back with receipt, and mom held up the ticket and said, 'you didn't take the onion off, we returned that, too, it was raw." THEN KARA SNATCHED THE TICKET OUT OF MY MOM'S HAND. Nuh uh, you did not! NOBODY treats my mamma like that. Kara came back with the credit and new receipt, which I signed. Gave waitress a $25 tip. Didn't return steak to get free food asshat, returned it because y'all can't cook a damn steak.

TPD makes securing a rental extremely complicated, nearly impossible.

I was searching for a rental in the Boise/Meridian area for my retired father who isn't very tech savvy. We came across a rental he really liked on Zillow, so I requested a tour. An automated system from TPD got in contact with me to help schedule the tour. First, my dad had to qualify to even view the rental. The system took about 24 hours to approve him, then I scheduled the viewing for the following day. 

He knew that he really liked the property, so he applied for it online, paid the $40 application fee plus the $20 fee for his cat, using this weird pet-approval website where we had to upload medical history for my dad's 12-year-old cat. It's ridiculous! Is the pet paying the rent?! 

The next day, were able to view the property using their lockbox system, which is rather complicated. My dad would not have been able to figure it out. You have to call a number that tells you to enter the serial code on the lockbox, then it gives you a code to enter into the lockbox for it to open. 

When we finally got in the house, my dad fell in love with it. I remember him saying, "I'll take it!" So, I immediately called TPD to tell them that he would like to make the deposit as soon as possible. Nobody answered. Left a voicemail. Then this automated system kept emailing me telling me to apply for the home. We already did that! That's the problem with using this automated system! It's redundant and impersonal.

Since TPD doesn't do business on the weekends, I called them shortly after they opened on Monday at 10 a.m. No answer. Left a voicemail saying my dad was ready to pay a deposit. Heard nothing.

It was three days from our initial inquiry when we finally heard back from them, only for them to ask for 90 days worth of bank statements, as if proof of my dad's substantial investments were not enough to pay the $1,275 per month to rent the home. They want to know exactly what you spent money on in the past three months, despite how much money you have in your bank account. Very intrusive and unnecessary. Shouldn't a credit report be enough to approve someone?  

By the time they contacted him to request that info, we had already had a fantastic experience with another landlord who quickly approved my dad's application and allowed him to submit a deposit. 

TPD, you should simplify your process. It's discriminatory to have such a complicated process that not everyone can figure out. Extend your business hours, not everyone can do business during the timeframes you're open. Step up your game.

First time here and was pleasantly surprised with the food and service.  The decor is sort of old school, but while being a large place, we did not find the noise to be excessive. Conversation was easy with the other couple who joined us.

Our waiter, Blake, was first rate and very professional for such a young man. He listened and had a sense of humor. 

The food was much better than I expected. First, this is one place I now know I can find fried oysters, a dish not easy to find here. The oysters were fresh and done just right. The other dishes we had were Kobe Beef fillet, excellent. Fish and Chips were also great. Fresh cod and fried to a just right crisp without being oily. The french fries were not as good as other places, so improvement could be used here. The chicken fried steak was an excellent pounded round steak with gravy on the side. 

Three of us had the baked potatoes here as we had heard that Jakers' bakers were first rate. The baked potatoes are rubbed in bacon drippings and sprinkled with sea salt and course ground pepper. They're baked every 30 minutes so a fresh one is a sure thing. We all liked them as the skins were baked, not steamed; hate bakers done in tin foil. Butter, sour cream, chives and bacon bits made these as much a treat as the entrees. Beer, iced tea and wine were drinks of choice. Water glasses were kept filled.

No desserts as there was no room left.

So all in all, we would go back, especially for a beer and appetizers at happy hours.

This is the best of the best. The steak cooked to perfection, probably the best steak in town. The breads were also very good and all you can eat for free! The services are just amazing! Everyone were so friendly and we just had a Great Time over all. Thanks for an amazing experiences! No wonder why this place is always pack!
Renee and his team do a marvelous job!  All varieties of meats that are so delicious.
Their gourmet flatbread pizzas are great. Our favorite pizza in the Boise area. They also pour a good size drink. I love their lasagna. Also good salads.

Delicious burgers! I was trying to find our go to burger place in the valley and I think this is it. So far I've tried their burgers, tater tots, and shakes and all are worth coming back for. They have indoor and outdoor seating and a drive though so you can choose how you want to order and eat. The place looks like an unassuming diner from the outside and the food quality will blow you away! The burgers are juicy and flavorful, the buns are buttered and  toasted, the tots are made just right and paired with a generous amount of delicious fry sauce, and their shakes are really creamy and tasty. If you're craving a burger and your in the area, stop by here. It will be worth your time.
