Really nice great cocktails and they even have vegan options. However, the food is very standard and expensive for what you get
The Yard House, like the nearby Kona Grill, is one of those places that you can visit and know that your food will be good no matter what you order.

We had Courtney manage our rental after our old PM retired. Big mistake. She knows every trick in the book to legally take money from both owners and tenants - she definitely plays both sides!! She will promise the moon, but does not even come close to following through.

Just one example - she literally stole my tenant's deposit while the tenant was still in the house. Yikes!

1st time tonight.  Incredibly clean, well trained and very professional staff / servers / bartenders.   Food was just OK, nothing really stood out.  Portions on some dishes are on the small to very small  end of things... For example, a side of asparagus should be more than 2 sprigs... 2 sprigs is a garnish.     I would probably give 3.5 stars here if I could because of the just average food.  5 stars for service.    Will try again -

In the Asian food dessert that is the Treasure Valley-  this is a great find.  Best Ramen in The Boise Meridian area- and has good appetizers to match.  Authentic ingredients and presentation (including the wood ear mushrooms) and flavors are exactly what they should be.  

Pork Chasu was done correctly, husbands beef wasn't bad either.   The Gyoza and Spicy Shrimp dumplings were eaten to fast to be photographed (they were that good).  

If you find your self looking for Ramen in the treasure valley- this is the spot.

We've been bringing shelter dogs to groomers all over the Treasure Valley for the last 13 years. We settled here in Meridian and have been using this groomer's establishment for about three years due to the price and location. Compared to other dogs we've adopted, our current two absolutely hate being groomed. When we've brought them home, they've had nicks, uneven cuts, missed nail trimmings and seemed completely out of sorts after being picked up. We've let it go based on their finicky temperaments but now we're second guessing our decision to disregard these signs. Here are pics of our Havanese from his last appointment. His whole side and front are burned... badly. My husband picked them up and was too shocked to say anything or ask questions. When I called for more details, the owner answered the phone and at first blamed my dog for leaning against the dryer. This particular dog is the most timid animal we've ever owned and if anything he would be huddled in a corner away from the dryer. When I pointed this out, she blamed the new bather and how she scolded her afterwards for not paying attention. When I said I'm not blaming anyone I just want to understand what happened to my dog, she blamed me for being a customer, not a groomer and therefore not understanding how things worked. Granted, I concluded by saying I shouldn't be charged for the appointment and she said if I needed to take my dog to the vet for treatment she would pay for that but not refund the service, if I didn't take him to the vet she would refund me the grooming fee. I completely understand mistakes happen but her belligerent attitude made a bad situation that much worse. 

First, I've dealt with many dogs and many groomers. I've never had this issue, so yes, I've never had to deal with a defensive groomer who turned her business error on me. Second, this adopted dog was a gift from my brother one month before he died from cancer. I'm sure everyone knows that our pets become our family in many different ways. This shy animal trusts me to take care of him and I betrayed that trust by continuously taking him to a woman who clearly lacks rational communication skills and empathy. A simple I'm sorry this happened would have gone a long way but her attitude indicated she rates profit more importantly than our pets. I'm kicking myself. Other dog owners have rated this business well, but the truth is 90% of people will walk away from bad business practices without complaining. These pics are evidence that you may not be getting what you entrust this establishment for.

First visit today.  My experience was excellent.  The stylist listened to what I wanted and performed it perfectly.  My hair has never looked as good as it does now.
The people were friendly, polite, and so welcoming.  And..... the price was quite reasonable.

For the most part the servers are pretty good. But I don't understand why it feels like, to me, that every time I place an order they somehow lose my ticket and my food doesn't get made. So then I'm waiting there for over an hour assuming that it's coming and it never does. Trying to talk to the manager tonight, 10/20/2021 around 10:00 PM, it's like pulling teeth. He did not in any which way shape or form make me feel like he cared about our issue. At all! We continuously feel like we're nothing. We do not feel like they care. I absolutely do not recommend this place.

We had brunch there this morning, with our niece, her husband and sister-in-law, our server Daniel was awesome! The eggs Benedict is amazing and they have bottomless mimosas, great experience we will definitely be back and will request Daniel to be our server, he did an outstanding job!

I was super excited to get my hair done for my birthday and it ended up being a terrible experience. In all the times I've gotten my hair done, this was the worst. My stylist did not listen to what I was asking for in terms of color and cut. She was very nice but failed miserably on execution. I stressed what color I was going for and my hair was essentially the same color as it was before she "colored" it. The cut was the worst cut I have ever had. She butchered my hair. Bad. I asked for a straight cut, and she gave me layers near the end...but only on one side. The entire cut was uneven. I had several long strands all over my head and some extremely short ones as well. She was supposedly a master stylist, having worked there for 12 years. I expected better, especially for the price. I told her several times throughout the process that it wasn't what I asked for. She assured me that I could come back and she could do more to my hair. The cut couldn't really be fixed without going shorter and it is already as short as I was willing to go. I left very upset and cheated. I told them I wanted a refund and they stressed that they do not offer refunds but that I could come back and have the same lady fix it. I didn't feel comfortable doing that at all! They wanted someone else to do it and I still didn't feel comfortable. I just wanted my money back. I sent them pictures on fb of how awful my hair was but they still insisted I go in..which again I did NOT feel comfortable doing. I did not receive the service I paid for. There is absolutely NO excuse for this. It was an expensive lesson. I do not recommend Rain Salon & Spa at all!
Very nice people,  very relaxed atmosphere however my steak was really gristle. I was very disappointed,  but enjoyed my company

Over priced mediocre food, they got booze though, but that's over priced as well. Buy a bottle and drink it in the parking lot, then go inside and order a beer and nurse it. Then look for the ladies....

Sadly, tonight will be my last time eating at Homestead. Even though I only show 7 check ins here, I have been here more times than I can count.  Here's why I won't be back:

My husband works hard to support his family, so I am always aware of coupons and advertisements that can save us money.  Homestead has an advertisement in a local publication with 4 coupons.  Tonight my hubs and I decided to have dinner here and take advantage of a coupon that was a free appetizer with the purchase of 2 entree's and 2 drinks.  As our server is clearing our table, we hand her the coupon.  She comes back with the bill and the coupon and tells us that she apologizes but in order to use the coupon we would have needed to purchase 2 alcoholic beverages.  Before I can say a word she states that she knows that it doesn't say that anywhere on the coupon, but that's what her manager told her.  Ummmm.....wow....ok.  The only reason I even ordered a 2nd soda was so we got the free appetizer.  I actually didn't even drink any of my $2.99 soda. So, beware of the shady practices of this restaurant.  I'm kinda sad, I liked it here.  Oh well.

Always a safe and delicious choice when traveling from out of town with limited time and jet lag. 
The service is lack luster but I think that's par for the course. The food is where it's at though! The burgers are huge and delicious, the pizzas are enough for two and perfect.  Obviously this place has the best beer selection in town... I just wish there was a bartender to refill my beverage...

Staff is friendly but you have to repeat yourself when you order. At least they do repeat your order back after to make sure it's correct. They ask you to drive around front after you pay so someone can bring your order to you. There's no signs that tell you where to park, so front and center it is. Fries are hot and crispy and the burgers are good.

I have two daughters who both have greatly benefited from Dr. Strickland's knowledge and expertise.  A  back fracture left my oldest daughter in tears from pain each day.  After seeing other chiropractic offices, physical therapists, and orthopedic surgeons, we became frustrated with lack of results to help her relieve her pain.  Dr. Strickland thoroughly assessed her and created a plan of action including chiropractic adjustments and laser therapy.  Within weeks she was pain free.  My second daughter's soccer life was taking a major toll on her body.  She suffered from weekly migraines, neck pain and throbbing knees.  Again, doctors orders of icing and increased stretching wasn't working.  With adjustments, constant attention to her physical needs and laser therapy, she is migraine free and fully participating in her soccer life.  I'm grateful to a very competent chiropractor, Roy Strickland, who attentively listened and worked to provide solutions to bring health and happiness to my girls.  Thank you Dr. Strickland!

Was craving some french fries so I stopped here this afternoon. I saw that they sell sides of ranch and since I like my fries dunked in ranch, I asked the worker if their ranch was a housemade dairy ranch. She said yes. Lies! This stuff is straight from the bottle and packaged in a little cutesy plastic cup. Tastes like every other gross soybean oil-based ranch. I want my 50 cents back.

Located in the heart of The Village at Meridian. This is a sit down restaurant with waiter/waitress service. Both indoor and patio seating. No reservations allowed for patio seating (it's that popular). The wait time for the patio on a Friday summer evening is 1.5-2 hours for a group of 4 or more people. We had a large group so we opted to wait 45 minutes for indoor seating. The restaurant inside is large, the lights are low, and the noise level is high. No need to worry if you have loud kids, the other diners will hardly notice. My husband likes yard house because of the expansive list of beers. I like yard house because they have a dedicated section of the menu to Garden vegan meals. My kids like yard house because their are kids meals and they can be loud without mom and Dad shushing them. There is something for everyone here, just make sure you get reservations if it's a Friday or Saturday, or get there early if you want to sit on the patio.

When did Jakers get so expensive? They were understaffed so service was slow, but our server made up for it by being very attentive and helpful. The food, specifically the Seafood Linguine, was good, but in our opinion not worth the price of $26.00. Chicken Parmesan came on a bed of dry linguine noodles, no sauce. Ribeye steak runs $41.00??? Used to be a favorite go to, "used to" being the key words here!

A group of us ate at Land Ocean last night.  Upon entering the ambiance took us by surprise, it had great lighting and warm atmosphere, busy but not crazy.  We all ordered something different.  I ordered the chicken served with mashed potatoes and asparagus, the chicken was very moist and the vegetable still had a crunch, Perfect for my tastes.  My husband ordered the surf and turf, he substituted the top sirloin with a filet.  The filet was cooked perfectly.  When leaving everyone in our group commented that this was definitely a restaurant they would like to return too.  Service was perfect with suggestions to enhance our meals plus he had an explanation of the nightly specials.  Plus their wine list was good.

I placed my order ahead of time and came in at 6:30 pm on May 12th after they told me there is a 45 min wait for order picked up my order I asked them if it had dipping sauces it didn't so she went inside and got my sauces, everything so far so good get home and open up the bag and the boxes are wet and soggy like my order had been sitting there for a long time already, I arrived right at 45 min as I was told when I started eating I had buffalo bbq lemon pepper and mango habanero in total 64 wings and paid over 40 dollars for old and dry wings ? I didn't find the order very pleasing we have over half the wings left over I doubt I will be coming back to order again until the restaurant is open back up for business, because driving from Fairview and Milwaukee to meridian by st Luke's to pick up old dry wings isn't very pleasing.

Inexpensive sushi when you consider the $1 sushi every Mon and Tues. If you order off the menu then they're about the same as everywhere else. Happy hour specials however are very nice. I tried the Harumaki which was delicious and the spicy tuna roll which I was not impressed with at all. Then I moved to the dollar menu where I tried the Pink Lady roll which I adore. Then came the Evergreen which was very good, Iso Maki, also good, Hanna roll tasty and pretty, California roll and the the Tiger roll which was fresh and tasty. Also got the miso soup and was not happy with that at all. It was very plain and not much flavor. 

I had a fantastic server who was not only very knowledgeable but warm and friendly. There are also other staff members that came by and were very nice and friendly. I felt very welcomed when I walked in and during my entire stay. They leave you alone while you're trying to eat and they come and help you with anything you need anytime you need it when you're not. They seem to have an innate knowledge of when to approach. For me this is perfection in service.
I sent this company a text describing my problem and asking for a response. They never communicated back to me.

Needed gas and wanted to try out the car wash since it got me a $0.15 discount per gallon for the $12 wash. Free vacuums, air, dash wipe, and shammies to finish drying the car... the kids working the car wash come out with brushes before the wash started and soap up the windshield, tires and running board area. Cleanest my car has been in an automatic wash in a long time!

This was AMAZING! We had a torta carne asada and the pastor alambre (recommended by the hostess). Both were so good!! The portions were huge, the flavors authentic and delicious. It also came with a large portion of chips and salsa with a little dessert treat of fried cinnamon sugar chips (white girl name for them, haha). I will definitely be back!

I come to this Walmart from time to time and usually have trouble with people in the electronics department. I shopped at this location last week to pick up an online order. I was unfamiliar with the orange tower pick up thing and when I needed the help employee Deanna was there to guide me through. She was the most helpful person and knew customer service. She is an example of how every Walmart employee should be at this location. Thank you to her, and it gives me faith in Walmart.

So far so good.  This is a BRAND NEW location so they don't even have a phone number to call and order ahead unless they write it down for you.  It just happens to be a little too convenient (right down the street from my house) so I have stopped in twice.  The employees were very friendly and provided fast service.  My order was done by the time I finished paying :)

I highly recommend the chicken, bacon, artichoke pizza!  I could eat it several times a week.  Last weekend we had company so I also ordered a "stuffed" pizza and we all felt that it had waaaaay too much breading and not enough filling (personal preference).

Horrible customer service on several occasions.  Not to mention poor work.  I am done giving them chances.  Do they not understand consumers have options!  You should be nice to your customers and educated about what you do.

Tired of the National chains?  Need a local place with good service and good food?  This is your restaurant.  I wish I could say something bad because I want it to myself.  My only complaint - it's too popular and fills up quickly.

Great service and food! Carnitas was cooked In a braised fashion and was very tasty! We had a large group and it is first come, first served...worked out with 2 tables by each other. Adam W was the perfect server. He was attentive and kept us with chip,salsa & drinks.  You can't go wrong with anything on the menu.

Not really a review today -- just a complaint that they never have items IN the store.  I look online, they carry it, but NEVER find it in a local store within 50 miles of me.  Really?  To someone that works at BB&B - you might want to re-evaluate the buyers.  You don't need isles and isles and isles of china and bedding.  Let's start buying the items your patrons want to use...or better yet...REPLACE.  Sometimes I want to buy in the store and not online.  In short:  I love the store, hate the lack of inventory.  Start catering to the patrons and not the internet.

I brought my bike in on a scheduled appointment to have the rear tire changed. I was told by the service manager to bring it in early and it would be done right away. It took all day to change out a tire, and they charged more to change the tire than I paid for it. I will not use Boise Triumph for any future service needs. There are other options available- I am very disappointed in their customer service, particularly since they are a new dealer in town

Matador has always done a great job for us, either at The Village or downtown. From the delicious chips and homemade salsa with lots of garlic, to the house made cocktails including some amazing margaritas. Never understood any of the negative review.

I normally order either the habanero burrito, carne asada surf and turf, or enchiladas. You can not go wrong with any of those. This most recent visit I asked our waiter for his favorite item on the menu, to which he responded enthusiastically the "Braised Carnitas!". I love pork carnitas so no idea why I had not noticed and tried this before. Well let me just say I've been day dreaming about this plate every since this visit. The portion was HUGE and I ended up taking it home and eating two meals on it.

The steaks here never fail to wow me.  This was the special of the night, steak covered in mozzarella cheese, and grilled vegetables.  Wow, just amazing, and bursting with flavor.  One of my favorite diners.

Great Car Wash! They offer clean towels to dry your car off after going through the wash, in case you forget to bring your own.  Additionally, at the start of the wash, an actual person hand wipes your windshield for those extra tough bug smears on your glass. There's a tip jar right at the entrance for the employees, that I hope gets relocated to be more prominent.

I was very impressed with this place. The check in process was easy, and I loved that people bring their animals up one at a time (especially since my Shepherd is NOT a fan of other dogs). My boy has healed up nicely and I'd definitely recommend.

We come here at least once a week. We usually have great service, but tonight it was outstanding! Our server, Sage, was seriously the best server I've ever had! We've both worked in the industry for years and agreed that he is an amazing server! Thank you, Sage!

This service was a great find during COVID. It is not a store front delivery service. It is a professional kitchen that makes gourmet food to be delivered directly to your home at a time you select. 

We have ordered from them at least once a week for six weeks. Date day! Everything has been fresh and the perfect temperature.

Today we ordered the Spicy Chicken sliders. One of the best things I have ever ate. Bread was fresh. Flavors complex and layered. We hope they add this slider to their service permanently. 3 to an order. Two would have been adequate, but now we have breakfast tomorrow.

Everything on Crave Delivery menu is exceptional. Prices make menu a great value. Wine by the bottle good and reasonable.

I have had back trouble most of my adult life and I am talking about over 40 yrs of back issues and two surgeries prior to meeting up with Dr. Richard Manos.  Dr. Manos took the time to go over my MRI and show me the issues that had to be addressed.  I ended up with spinal fusion from T-10 to my pelivs.  The surgery was a 9 hour day for Dr. Manos at West Valley Hospital in Caldwell.  For the first time in decades I no longer suffer from intense back pain.  For sure, I am not as flexible as i once was  but the pain is pretty much gone.  I thank Dr. Manos for this result.  He saved my quality of life.

Update: I've gone back about 3 times already to order the prime rib and each time I was told that they're sold out. Even called to make sure it's available. Unfortunately I wasn't very satisfied with the other foods I ordered. Their prime rib was awesome but it's very frustrating to return multiple times and be told that the food I want is not available. You gotta do something about that.

Not only is the food great (have some smoked wings) management is awesome. My wife has celiac and knows to tell anyone we order food through that she does. Long story short there were croutons on the salad and they remade it for free even though I insisted we pay . Thanks!!

Fries are tasty with a sprinkling of seasoned salt.  5 Stars
Beer battered onion rings cooked perfectly and hold up nicely when eating them, not greasy.  5 Stars
Western Bacon Cheeseburger was loaded with stuff and the bun held up nicely. 5 stars
Double cheeseburger was equally well done. 5 stars

Indoor dining and outdoor tables were not wiped down between customers.  In this environment, that means a lower rating. 

They have enough staff to take better care of their dining area, if instructed to do it.

I have eaten at the Jakers in Idaho Falls and had a great experience, decided to try the meridian location for a late Valentines Dinner, to my surprise the parking lot was nearly empty on a Saturday night at 7:30, was greeted and seated immediately by the hostess and waitress was very prompt in bringing drinks and salads. That is where the great evening turned horribly south, the waitress recommended the 28 oz ribeye for 2, I nodded as ribeye steak is one of my favorites. When the waitress brought out our charcoaled steak, she sat it in front of us and quickly left. I cut into it to see it was very rare in the inside and blackened to a crisp on the outside. I ordered medium. I shaved away most of the char and attempted to salvage the dinner as my Wife kept insisting to me to send it back, I felt bad for the waitress as she was great up until she served us a horribly burnt ribeye. We covered the steak up with the cloth napkin and paid our check, Went straight to another restaurant for an appetizer as we were both hungry after picking at a 28oz burnt steak.( I highly doubt it was 28 oz) now I know why this place was so dead on a Saturday night, I spoke with some of my friends and family and they had similar reviews for this Location. It really is too bad as we have eaten at a lot of local restaurants and this by far was the worst steak I have ever had, at 59.95 it wasn't  a bargain either.

I was refered to Norco by my neurologist for CPAP supplies. My initial visit was positive and professional. I was told I would recieve a follow up appointment and I did. I was contacted by Christie. When I answered the phone, I asked if it would be possible for her to call back in a couple of minutes for I was in a project that was time sensitive. She said she would. I went on with my day, and an hour or so later not hearing back from her, I called Norco. I found when you call Norco, you are put on hold immediately. While on hold you listen to a man then a woman sharing all the wonderful services Norco offers. The first time I called, I was on hold for almost 7 minutes, the second time over 9 minutes. When I finally got through to Christie, it seemed she forgot to return the call, but went on like nothing had happened. The second time I left a message, as of yet, I have not received a return call. My point in all this is while Norco is a very impresive place with what looks to be a huge selection of product, for me they are too time consuming to do business with.

These people were absolutely amazing. I don't think I've ever had that much consistent, good care. They made what seemed to be a scary simple, easy, and fun. I felt like I was part of their family. They took very good care of my surgical needs. Amazing group of people, all the staff.
Went here to have them wash and vacuum my car as I just got out of surgery and couldn't do it myself. They charged me $32 and it was a mediocre job at best.

I had an appointment set up for the first time and when I walked in the woman inside was screaming at the dog behind the gate. I turned around and walked out because I was not going to put my dog in that kind of environment. I felt very sorry for the dog she was screaming at.

Talk about value for the dollar. We initially met with Positive Pets in our consultation for puppy training but when a family vacation coincided we ended up doing the immersion training with boarding. While we were gone we got some beautiful photos and even a couple of videos of our pup learning some great basic commands that we hadn't mastered in our self instruction at home. After returning home there was an in depth meeting to cover the training our fur baby had while we were away. Included in the package we get ongoing training. We had private classes where I learned to be consistent and understand how dogs learn. After completing the private classes we went to a group beginners class where we covered things like heal, sit, stay and place (where you can ask your dog to be when, for example, someone comes to the door so your dog isn't vying for the door as someone comes in). We are now in the advanced distraction training where we are learning how to heal off leash, she can obey commands when I'm not right next to her, return to me when I call her, lay under my legs when I'm at an outside dining experience and not be distracted by other dogs or surroundings. We have had some wonderful and patient trainers. My favorites have been Britta and Taz. We are still in a group class and when we are done with this class we might do the tricks class. Our other classmates are wonderful and off the bat we have something in common, we love our dogs. You do need to practice at home, there is no "miracle" that is going to have your dog obeying like Lassie (if you're old enough to know who that is) without practicing. The trainers are genuinely caring and help with on the spot corrections. They ask for and answer questions during every session. I even texted Taz after our darling pup chewed the banisters and baseboards in our home after being unattended at home for a couple of hours. She went above and beyond by texting me back, letting me know we had done the right thing by not punishing our sassy pup (because she wouldn't have understood the reason for the punishment), gave us some ideas to implement at home and has even followed up with me about our battle of the wills at home. 

Yes, it feels expensive up front but I cannot stress what a value you get from that investment. I cannot believe how much we have gotten from our weekly trainings and the payoff it has had in our family and our home. If you were to pay for each class anywhere separately, I shutter to think how much it would be. There is even the option of going to the Saturday class in Boise if you're schedule allows for formal training twice a week. And you can tell how much the people care from the people at the desk to the trainers and their hard work in all their classes. This place is amazing.

How should I start? Well, our waiter was probably the worst you could get. I never got his name. But I went there with my parents my boyfriend my cousin his wife and our kids. We all ordered our drinks and appetizers. He brought them out and we ordered our food. And my cousin asked for a refill on his Arnold Palmer and it took 4 times of asking the guy before he finally brought it with out an apology I might add. But no big deal. Then everyone's food came out except my boyfriends so we waited and waited and my dad being a really funny goofy loud guy goes "hey!" And the server flipped
Around and my dad started laughing and I called him over and he looks at my boyfriend and goes did you just yell at me? And I said no it was the big guy down there and I laughed and said don't take him serious he likes to Tease and the server just glared at me. I go but anyway my boyfriend still hasn't Received his food and the server goes I don't know. Walked to the back came back and looked at everyone's food. And he totally forgot
To write it down.  Like okay....so another 30 mins
Goes by and we haven't seen the waiter once but finally got his food. And my dad does hey I was just teasing you I wasn't yelling. And the server says I don't know why they would say you did if you didn't. I was like are you serious!? And walked off and didn't come back
For another 20 mins. When he came back he made some snide remarks. I go are you having a bad day? And he says no I just don't like being yelled at. I lost my cool finally I said you know what you are the reason people don't like to have fun anymore. It was a joke get over it. I said I wouldn't expect someone to
Come into my barber shop and
Me treat someone terrible and on
Top of that do w terrible service and expect a tip. And he just shrugged his shoulders. I can't even imagine employing a person like that. A different server walked by and said she was sorry to me. So obviously I'm not the only one who thinks he is a terrible server and terrible with customers. I would really like to talk to the manager and get something situated with
This. I was too heated at the moment with the disrespect. But it was astonishing. Hopefully if you go there
You don't get this horrible server!!!! I really wish I would have caught his name to save you all!! Disrespect at its finest!
Nice place. Clean and good service. Large tap list with good choices. The bad---NO HAPPY HOUR! It was on the Yelp Happy Hour list. Didn't eat just drank.

I ordered from Mi Almita for my bday dinner at home with the fam. The delivery guy was nice. For the price, the food was scant and so-so. I expected greatness from a Michael Mina restaurant. Also, the margarita mix was so super sweet and gave both my husband and I major headaches. For $150, it was disappointing. Bummer.

Noisy to the point that we had to use our phones and text to each other.   I had the fish and chips.   Fish had a funky after taste and the chips are just fried frozen with a slight breading.   

Wife had finger steaks.   The bite she gave me was 75% breading and 25% steak.  From what I saw while she she ate that was pretty standard.   

Son in law had chicken and waffles.   Waffles had been murdered.  Cooked so hard they were inedible.   

Daughter had Idaho Mac and cheese.   Same fries that I had with the fish and chips mixed with Mac and cheese.   


Not worth the drive out.

I was beginning to despair that there wasn't decent ramen in the Treasure Valley, but I have found it!!!! Pork ramen flavorful, tender, and tasty. Bonus is there is no worry about a health department shutdown here! Clean, properly sanitized and wearing masks! Bravo!!!!!
Delicious and a fun place to eat. Everyone seemed very energetic and happy. One of my favorite spots so far since moving here.

Really REALLY bad service. Only reason I put two stars is because *some* of the food was decent (soup was cold).  Get there and they say 5-10 min wait to be seated, no biggie! Except we ended up waiting 25 minutes. And the snarky comment from the manager definitely was not appreciated. Don't tell me the wait is 5-10 minutes if there are 12 parties ahead of me? Server took forever to get our order. And the icing on the cake, they sat us in the very back, freezing cold, no lights, with the heaters off. Absolutely horrible dining experience. For a weekday too?  Excepted way more for the price.

Outstanding 
Great customer service 
Louis was professional and ensured I had everything I needed. The quality of the food was great!

Thank you, I'll Be BACK!

We LOVE Kahootz. It is our favorite weekend outing. We probably go... once a month or more if we're after some prime rib. The ONLY reason for the four stars is that the last two times we've been, we've had the prime rib. Both times mine has been over cooked, and one of the times we were pretty sure the table next to us got our food. My boyfriend ordered the larger prime rib, and I ordered the smaller. The table next to us ordered long before us, and we got our meal first. Mine was not medium rare or even close. My boyfriend's was no different than mine as far as size, either. When the couple next to us got theirs, the man exclaimed how big his seemed compared to hers since they'd ordered the same size, and the woman mentioned that hers wasn't quite cooked enough. It was pretty clear our meals were switched. It wouldn't have been a big deal, but the larger prime rib is more expensive, and our orders weren't great the next time, either. We'll go back, for sure. We'll probably take a little break before our next visit and hope that some quality control is implemented. Expect to wait.... but it is worth the wait. Go early if you want the prime rib. If you're the kind of person who voices when you notice something (we really aren't since we generally still enjoyed our meal) then speak up, and make sure you get what you want. I'm sure they'd oblige any concern.

This is the perfect place for any bride looking for an incredible experience and their dream dress! From the moment I arrived, I felt so special. Mackenzi picked out amazing dresses for me to try on and really listened to what I was looking for! The dresses are amazing and beautiful and I felt so happy trying them on. I seriously can not say enough about how perfect this experience was to find my wedding dress. Everyone should go to Kate's!

So it's a pretty simple concept and if you are familiar with one of the chains, your familiar with all of them.  

I only took off a star because I dislike one of their investors, but that's a matter of principle.  It's really good pizza as long as you make it a point to choose the toppings you want to eat and don't create some whackadoo pizza just cause.  It's a good bargain, and the best way to get two pizzas when you want something different than your "all meat all the time" husband.  

I'd be back.  I'd even suggest it to people (even a friend with a Vegan husband) because the variety makes it easy to please even the pickiest/most difficult diets.
Food was delicious and the staff courteous and hard working. We will definitely be back soon.

I've been seeing Dr Wagnon and I can't begin to tell you how much better I am. My pain has subsided.  I'm so glad I am going as I was in pain off and on for a year. I wish I would have gone sooner.   They have an easy process for checking in.  The girls at the front desk are very nice and friendly.

Emma was a fantastic waitress who took great care of us. Had great conversation without making us feel awkward or invaded. The food was fanominal, the drinks were flowing beautifully and all in all it was a wonderful experience and I will be coming back and recommending her and this place to others.
So disappointed I ordered fried rice with vegetables and as you can see I'm pretty sure they just added a sprinkle of rice...
Came here for the white woman. Was not disappointed. However it was not chilly quite warm in fact.

Well, to start off I wanted Brynn McCurry to do my Hair because I knew Her from a previous Salon, but She was booked solid so She recommended Me to another "Stylist"  term to be used lightly. When I called Her she was a little uncertain about a style I wanted so I sent Her a picture, She said it was a little  technical???  You are a professional? Really?? praised Herself by stating Her 25 years as a Professional ? Isn't that why you charge $150 because you are supposed to be the best?  Mmmm not so I found out. She didn't quite understand about a short a line stacked Bob , She didn;t grasp hair coloring in chunks, made a mess of everything, Then in the end of my appointment she told Me she was a bit Hard of Hearing, OMG. Called Stephanie the next day, Hostile and arrogant , tried to get me to go back to the incompetent  hearing challenged one and conversation went from bad to worse. Funny how very nice they are when they take your money and really bad they are when you have any issues . So NO I would not recommend this Salon and I am peeved that I spent $150 for a disaster

Last Saturday we tried to go eat here, at the recommendation of a good friend! There was 4 of us, we got there at 8:40 PM. There were at least three 4 tops available on the patio and seating available inside. When my husband tried to get us seated, they told us they were no longer accepting "big parties" for the night! That's super disappointing, especially with there being more than hour before closing on a Saturday night. That was going to be our first experience and it quickly became our last. So Yardhouse in the village ended up getting our $200 tab, your loss.

We drove all the way out here on a weeknight to support Boys and Girls Club, which was doing a fundraiser. Despite the patio being all set up with TVs on, the hostess would not us sit outside because they didn't want to send a server out. It was a nice day in August during the pandemic - the patio absolutely should have been open. We left and ate somewhere else.

AMAZING! One of the best bbq places in 
meridian/boise. I'll definitely be back soon. Reasonably priced and has a great atmosphere, as well as very nice staff members.

Yummy food in a fun environment! I got the Buffalo Chicken sandwich and it was great! If you stop by, definitely try the Queso as an app. They were prompt with greeting us and with getting our food out. We went on a busy weekend, and it was very loud. Nothing wrong with the noise, just wanted to warn you if you thought it was a quiet space, it can get loud when it's busy!
I love coming to this place. It is my husband and I favorite place to eat, and their takeout is just as amazing!

We love eating at their original location in McCall. First time eating at this one. Superb food just like the other one. My favorite was today's special. The Pueblo Lindó burrito with chili verde and instead of the red sauce on top change it to the tomatillo salsa verde. Amazing flavors.

I love this place. You can find me here at least once (usually twice) a week, sometimes 3 times to be perfectly honest. The unlimited toppings makes it so I never get tired of coming here. I can have completely different pizzas every time I go and it is excited. The staff are great, I do get really excited with certain people are working the line because they will automatically put more on pizzas but you can always ask for more.

If you enjoy cheese pizza it is less expensive and still delicious. Also their blood orange drink is scrumptious. 

I love pizza and I love this place
Can I give 0 stars? This place is disgusting and the owners really should be ashamed of themselves. If you support puppy mills this place is for you.

I had found this place on Yelp a while ago. It's a bit out of the way for us but we happened to be driving home from Nampa and we were hungry. I opened up my saved businesses and we were going to drive right past it. 

It's a friendly place and was really busy for an early dinner. There was a constant flow of people picking up orders and the phone was ringing. That's definitely a good sign. Our food came out and it was flavorful and really hot. I am not a big fan of fried rice. We usually get noodles if it's an option instead, however theirs honestly was one of the best I've had. It wasn't over cooked and it had flavor. My husband felt the same about it. Happy we made the stop!

I had the cinnamon churro donut and it was simply OK tasting.  The visual was gorgeous and the staff was friendly.  It was fun seeing people make donuts in the back with care and artistic flair.  They are truly artists.   I'm more of a traditionalist when it comes to donuts, but I'll stop by for dog and fries since they look incredible.   I hope others love these donuts because places like this need to survive in Boise/Meridian.  Don't let this review keep you from trying new things, especially this establishment.  Great people are working here!
How do you forget the topping...on a one topping pizza?   Disappointed to the say the least but good lord.

Long wait for a Thursday evening dinner but the food was definitely worth it!

I signed up for their wait list online and it said the wait time was 35-45 minutes. My parents and I arrived about 25 minutes later and verified through text we were here and got a generic message saying to keep our phone nearby and wait for a confirmation text. Well the wait time was almost exactly an hour. But we finally got seated. Mom and I ordered two starters, the fried pickles and the bone buffalo wings. A short while later a nice young woman took our order. After about 20 minutes, we were informed our starters got lost in the shuffle and weren't made so they would still make them and bring them out but would take both off our bill which was very considerate!

Now onto the food! Those soft buns and cinnamon butter was heavenly. So hard to not stuff your face on just them!! I ordered the BBQ chicken and ribs with a side of veggies and steak fries. Mom got the ribeye steak and shrimp with a side of mashed potatoes and veggies. I LOVED my food. The grilled chicken was cooked just how I like it with a good amount of moisture, not dry! The ribs were incredible. When I say they fell off the bone, they really did, I would grab the bone and move it just a little and it was barely connected to the meat and easily slide off. Very juicy, very tender, very good. I added lots of their signature steak sauce to my chicken and ribs and that made the meat even better! Extremely filling though, I ate all the chicken and ribs, and barely had enough space to eat all my boneless buffalo wings!

Mom loved her steak and mashed potatoes. The shrimp was room temperature to slightly cold which threw us both off as we were expecting them to be hot like everything else. But overall, we left extremely stuffed but extremely satisfied. This was my first time ever eating at a Texas Roadhouse and I had such a great experience! If I'm ever in the area again I'll definitely be back for more meaty goodness! Our waiter was a young woman who must still be learning since she had an older woman helping her with everything. But they were both friendly and made sure our waters stayed full and checked in a few times to make sure we were doing ok. Good people and great food. Can't ask for much more than that.

This place is pretty damn cool inside and out.  The ambiance is nice, the layout is cool.  Hostess was dressed well too.  The servers were super friendly.

First negative.  The glasses and plates were not clean.  Things were flaking off the outside of the glass and plates.

The food:
Beef wellingtons;. These were kind of just meh.  Pretty bland, but not horrible.  Save your money on this one

Jalapeno bacon Mac and cheese:. This was pretty OK.  However it was not very hot (temp wise).  The top was cold and the underneath was just warm.  Honestly, Applebee's has better mac and cheese.

Blackened salmon:. This was actually pretty good.  The rice was weird.  The sauce was decent.  I would order this again.

The wagyu beef:. I give this a solid "ok".  I have had much mich better steak, the sauce was tasty as were the mushrooms.

All in all, this place acts and looks like it should be an upscale restaurant, the interior is cool, the waitress was super nice, the food looks and sounds good but doesn't deliver overall.

The restaurant is a 5, bit the food is a 3.

This place is delicious first time here today and Zach at the bar is amazing full of recommendations def very awesome in suggesting and making sure we had a great experience. The drinks to the food was amazing and ughhhh champagne shots say what!?!?!!!!!!! I will definitely be returning again asking for Zach he is on his stuff very helpful amazing customer experience. Anyone who is a foodie this is a definite go to! I can't believe I've been missing out for far too long.
Great services we love our mattress I would recommend 100% happy happy customer great prices go check it out
I came in for brunch, and I definitely plan to be back. The server (Chelsea), paced everything well, and my friends and I enjoyed the mimosas. Glad that someone took that old Pinnacle spot!

Always great food and one of the best happy hour menus around. The braised carnitas is one of the best Mexican dishes around. But prices went up recently, like everywhere so we typically only go for happy hour now. Salsa is amazing. Vibe is cool.

From a small sample size of only three dishes, this is definitely a place for some quality Chinese food.  This was a "takeout order only" for us as we were headed home.

So glad to see that they are operating again after the vandalism to their business took place.  The cowards who did the damage should be dragged behind a truck on Ten Mile.  I hope they get caught and I have a chance to be in the jury.

The fried rice was not greasy, light and fluffy with good flavor.  The Mongolian Beef was very nice with lots of dried Japanese chilies (the way I like it).  A non-spice eater in the family ate it and did not worry about the spiciness as long as you steer clear of the actual chilies.  Both dishes are candidates for reorder.

The lettuce wraps could have used more frying.  The meat was cooked, but not crispy.  It also lacked some flavor.  

This is a place that demands more exploration.  We will be back.

Wow! Great tasting food and appealing presentation, they take takeout to another level! We ordered the Dan Dan Noodles, Southern Fun and #60 Fried Rice and everything looked and tasted fantastic, really tasty, flavorful and authentic Asian flavors something we've been missing since leaving Hawaii. A real must try!

We have been ordering from Crave for a few months now.  We are very impressed with all food ordered, delivery and customer support.  We ordered 4 different types (48 total) of sliders and 6 kids meals from Rock house sliders a couple of days ago.  As always the order was 100% correct, delicious, warm and on time.  Our delivery driver, Steve, was very  professional, helpful and friendly.  Every guest commented on how good the sliders were.  The spicy chicken and original rocker were the favorite.  Thank you again Crave and RHS in particular this time for another wonderful meal!
Food is unbelievably good. One of the best I've had in the treasure valley. Will definitely be back

This is hands down the best Ramen place in the treasure valley. As a ramen lover, I used to travel miles for a good ramen meal, no longer need to search all over Yelp. My personal favorite is the Tantanmen, if you like the thick and mild taste broth topped with some minced ground pork. I like mine made spicy, very flavorful and fulfilling.

I would give ZERO STARS if I could! I am so mad that I can't even be bothered to write all the details, but their office is a joke! They canceled on me three times and once they left me in a room for 5 minutes thinking 
Dr Jorgeson was coming to talk to me (Dr Varley told me there was nothing he could do for me.) only for someone to come in and say we have to set up an apt. (He wasn't even there that day.)
I WILL NEVER (ATTEMPT TO) GO THERE AGAIN! I know Idaho is lacking in the medical field and there aren't many options ... see if your insurance will accept out of state referrals.  I'm going to Los Angelas, Ceder Sinai. I am done playing games over here.
Great food, lots of options, and of course hundreds of beers on tap. Would be five stars but waiter mixed up my drink order twice in a row.

We decided to to try out Kahootz after reading some other Yelp reviews. We are SO happy we did. We went on a Friday night so there was about a 30min wait but it was totally worth it. We ended up grabbing a drink from the bar and waiting on their patio under the heater until a table was ready.

My husband got the Reuben sandwich and I got the salmon over risotto. They were both amazing. The servers and every staff member we encountered were wonderful, even though it was super busy. We are so glad we found this little gem and will definitely be going back. It's a perfect date night location.

Well planned and designed, Storey Bark Park offers a great, fenced space for canine fun. 

The park is separated into two areas. There is the larger area that welcomes dogs of all sizes and then a smaller area that is specifically for smaller breeds. In the large area, there's a covered area with picnic tables where you can hang out while your pup has fun running and playing with other dogs. There's an agility course for those whose dog needs a working challenge, fresh water, and plenty of plastic bags for picking up doggie messes. 

While I'm a fan of facility and the fact that the Meridian Parks & Rec conspired to create such a space--I was a little disappointed in the lack of canine supervision by dog owners. Many sat or stood in the covered area, chatting while their dogs ran around virtually unsupervised. 

I get it--it's a fenced area. It's easy to disregard the need to keep watch. But, while I was there I witnessed a couple of aggressive dogs go unchecked by their humans and three other dogs leave messes that were left un-scooped by their human companions.

Of course, this isn't the fault of Meridian Parks & Rec--the rules are clearly stated upon entrance (clean up after your dog, no aggressive dogs). It was none-the-less disappointing. Wonderful spaces like this are made great by those that utilize them--a little responsibility and good citizenship goes a long way. 

Hopefully, I just caught it on an off day and such behavior is the exception, rather than the rule.

My wife and I stopped in yesterday afternoon to get some prices on window coverings. Once my wife informed the salesperson that we would install the shades and blinds ourselves that salesperson told my wife that he didn't have the time to price out all of our measurements/ needs.

I found that a quite pathetic response from someone hired to HELP sell products for Lowe's and have positive customer interactions as a company representative. 

The decision was easy for us to take our business elsewhere - including appliance shopping.

I first started going to Blaze Pizza in Charlotte, North Carolina. The pizza and staff are just as good here in Meridian. 
Fresh and hot pizza. Friendly staff. The store is consistently clean. They keep the line moving. I'll keep coming back again and again.

Jakers had always been my favorite for prime rib.we hadn't been for almost two years due. To Covid. Was outraged at their prices. An 8 oz prime rib with no sides was $27. That is equal to Chandler's prices and at least they have ambiance and live music. We walked out without eating.
Amazing food and service every time we've been. We take out family/friends whenever they come into town.

I'm giving a generous 4 star review because I know they will get there, but aren't quite there yet. 
The restaurant is beautiful, loved the ambiance! 
I brought my employees here for a Christmas dinner on Friday night. We were seated with our reservation right away. There were maybe 4 young hostesses standing around and not the most friendly, and sat us at a table for 8 in a dark corner, there are 3 of us. 
Our waitress was sweet, chatty and gave good recommendations. She brought water and a tiny bit of bread and butter. It was great, but enough for one of us.
We ordered from their cocktail section. Skip this until they get a full bar!!! Cocktails ONE star. To be fair our waitress couldn't try them and couldn't recommend or not because she is pregnant. Tastes like they open the can of already made cocktails and dilute it with soda water and juice. Flavorless and not worth $10. We tried 3 different selections, wouldn't recommend. Stick to the wine list. We enjoyed the wine. 
Calamari and cocktail prawns were our appetizer selection, both excellent. They were served quickly and tasted super fresh. I'd order both again. 
After our appetizer we ordered a bottle of wine, our server even brought us a sample of two were deciding between. We really appreciated that. 
Then we were asked to move tables. No problem at all, we were happy to be out of the corner and accomodate the mix up. The manager was charming and even offered us a freebie for our trouble.  We were checked on multiple times prior to our dinner arriving. Excellent service here.
Our dinners were all delicious. We had the salmon, sea bass and filet selections. We were all very happy with our food. Cooked perfectly! 
After our dinner was cleared we tried dessert.
Lava cake, creme brûlée, and the apple alamode. All delicious! Wish there were more berries on my creme brûlée but it was creamy and delicious!
After desert was cleared our service died. She brought our check and never came back. 
We chatted for about an hour, the restaurant was quiet by now and didn't need our table.  We never were asked for an after dinner drink, coffee, or had our water glasses refilled in that time. We probably would have ordered another bottle of wine. It's unfortunate our service dropped at the end. Like completely vanished. That's why I think they deserve 3 stars. But, hate to knock a good restaurant for service. Service was good to start but after the check was brought, we never saw her, or anyone again.

Since it was only three stars I was actually really surprised with how my nails came out. Are usually don't like getting my nails done by a boy but they surprisingly look really good. He was really friendly and he was constantly asking me if I like them. my gel manicure definitely deserves five stars. I cannot remember his name but he was a middle-aged man with tattoos on his arms.

First of all, I have to respectfully take exception with some of the other items mentioned in the other Elite's reviews here: 1) Random assaults by frightening insects are not a usual part of the dining experience. 2) The tables are not so tall that only the Bronco's basketball team will be comfortable. 3) The kitchen is not on a campaign of terror against, vegetarians, gluten free diners, and people with food allergies. However, if you are a fan of those other Elites, please take their word for it, because it might make it easier for me to get a table here, because any given night this place is packed, and it's been that way for years.

What these unfortunate diners think they are coming to this ale pub for is what the restaurant was built on, doing a few things well. The aged. succulent beef, like the New York strip I get, is their primary weapon in their war against vegetarians. The fact that some of that beef is grass fed, however, should not make you think its gluten free. Remember, it's impossible to order food that's gluten free in a steakhouse, there's got to be some grains in that aged, grass-fed beef somewhere.

Vegetarians should ignore the delicious pasta primavera, The fact its delicious is a diversionary tactic used to lull vegetarians into a false sense of security. You just don't want to eat here. The fact they've also added a larger selection of on-tap beers also just steers me away from this place every time! I can't fathom why I've been coming here off and on for five years now to eat.

So, while there is no explanation why this place seems packed every time I eat here, believe me when I say the other elites are right you are risking your fate by eating here as BIG SCARY BUGS WILL ATTACK YOU, and maybe I'll be able to finally get a table. Again, please don't eat here, especially if you don't like good food.

Great food at the Yardhouse, however don't go there if you want to have conversation with friends at your table. The 80's music the manager/corporate plays is WAY TOO LOUD.  We were almost shouting to each other to hear anything over the music. I asked our waitress if she could turn it down just a little. She gave me the canned answer that the volume is set by "corporate" as if nobody in the restaurant has any control over it. She must have asked someone because she came back to our table and said "Yes", they could turn it down. Well............they didn't turn it down and may actually have turned it up!  Again, good food, but way too loud of an atmosphere.  Came away feeling it was not the best dining experience.
Warm old school vibe, good bar selections and delicious food!  Don't miss the wings or dessert!
One of the best car washes I've been to. Staff is always so friendly and welcoming . Clean towels are always available and the store it's self is amazing with so much options . Definitely recommend .

Last night was my first experience at this location and I have to say I'm underwhelmed. The only reason I made the special trip to this store instead of JoAnn's or Michael's was because of a specific hobby kit I wanted to buy for a Christmas gift so I called and had them set one aside for me. They did, but when I went to pick it up I asked someone if I could just grab it since I saw it immediately and she looked at me like I'd just grown another head or was suddenly speaking Klingon. My husband and I perused the aisles and I found their selection to be exactly as described by other commenters. They have a ridiculously large selection of some things (if you ever need a decorative crucifix or 27 different kinds of puffy paint this is your store), and a shockingly sad selection for other items including a minimal fabric section. I'm also not a fan of how sales and items are listed there. I grabbed a multipack of Scotch tape because of a giant sign right in front of the display saying that Christmas decor and wrapping supplies were half off, I apparently missed the microscopic text that said Scotch tape wasn't included but Monika was kind enough to let me know. 

My biggest problem was the crowded layout of the aisles making it difficult to maneuver and the less than friendly staff, particularly the girl who checked us out, Monika. Now I get it's the holidays and I'm sure the staff at retail stores are ready to sock the next Santa they see in the face but being there to assist customers in a friendly way is kind of what they are paying you for so stop grimacing at me when one of the items I picked up doesn't have a price tag. This, on top of the archaic system of typing in codes for each item instead of having a scanner makes the experience one you'd wish you could forget. Stood in line for 10 minutes yesterday because an item didn't have a price tag and without a scanner they couldn't ring it up (would have helped if Monika wasn't already annoyed with life and willing to go look but she would rather wait twice as long and have two other people help find the code). Then she also insinuated that we were lying about certain items being on sale and instead of looking for herself she waited for another worker to finish with their customer so she could ask them and verify the info. I'll be ordering online or just avoiding Hobby Lobby altogether in the future.

Love this place! Went in and had a great time meeting all the cute puppies! The staff was super knowledgeable and helpful! The super tall employee was the best, he helped me the whole time and was fun to talk to! Would recommend to anyone looking to get a forever furry friend!! :)
Good appetizers. Good beer and cider. Good service. Well definitely be back to try more of the menu.

Delicious. The thin crust and fresh ingredients make this pizza so delicious. The mac n cheese is also amazing. I love this place and will continue to crave all their food, I've tried so many menu items it's crazy.

The open sign is back up as of December 26!  This family run business was temporarily closed from late November through late December after vandals broke in and destroyed their kitchen.  .  As posted by owner Maggie Situ to Wok Fusion FB page on or about December 13, 2021, after someone posted a complaint that Wok Fusion's phone wasn't being answered:    "Hello, so our restaurant was broke into three weeks ago, and our kitchen equipments were destroyed, it will need some time to get fixed. We are temporary closed until further notice, sorry for the inconvenience and thank you for your support."

This family works so hard,  I hope their business can recover from this.

I went there with my teen age boys the second night they were open. The service was terrific.

They have a nice selection of beers and a nice environment to hang out with friends and drink/watch a game.

I liked the menu a lot, it has a lot of promise. The quality of the food was above average for a bar, but not by much. The Idaho nachos were good, but the cheese wasn't melted through (which is a deadly sin for nachos). Also the chips were tasty but a bit too fragile for nachos. They should switch to kettle cooked potato chips so they can hold the toppings better.

Otherwise the food was pretty good. I will go back again, but probably more for drinks/appetizers than for dinner with my kids.

Recently moved to the area and needed to find a dentist- saw some recommendations in neighborhood facebook page and decided to give them a call. I scheduled an appt for a few weeks out but they called when they had a cancellation and were able to fit me and my kids in sooner. Dr. Jarvis and her staff are excellent!! They were great with the kids and super friendly! So glad I called! Would definitely recommend Dr. Jarvis!
Always a solid choice! Great friendly service and you literally can't make a bad choice on this menu.

I recently went into Rain Salon and Spa after winning a gift certificate from ThisisBoise.com. I probably would have never gone in if it wasn't for that, because I live in downtown Boise and this location isn't the most convenient for me. 

The gift certificate was for a women's cut and botanical treatment with Kayla. It came perfectly timed, because my locks were in major need of a trim!

I scheduled ahead of time for my day off, because I knew I would be running around a lot that day. I got there 5 minutes before my appointment, and the receptionist kindly checked me in. I sat and waited, for 25 minutes. Someone (who had noticed I was sitting for a long time) stopped by and asked who I was seeing. She went and checked with the receptionist and let me know that Kayla's appointment before me had arrived late, but that she was just about done. I was a little irked by this, because I like to stay on schedule. (Also, tardiness is very rude in my eyes.) I know it wasn't Kayla's fault her appointment came late, but you think someone would have told me sooner! I was nearly ready to leave when Kayla finally came and got me. 

Kayla was nice enough, but very timid. I hate to say it, but I always expect hair dressers to be chatty people! If I have to sit for an hour+ while a stranger touches my head, I want someone who can keep a conversation growing. 

She started with a scalp/shoulder massage with some minty product. Then she shampooed me and did the botanical treatment in the sink, and gave me a hand massage while it sat in my hair. Nice touch. 

I'm in the midst of growing my hair out, so I didn't want her to take too much off -- just the dead/split ends. She suggested adding just a little bit of layers (to the ends) to add some volume, as my hair is pretty flat. I happily agreed. The cut turned out fine, although I could still pick out some split ends when she was done. Oh well.

Before I left, she styled me just a little (I was heading to a massage, so I urged her not to do too much as I would just be throwing it into a pony). Kayla, true to the Aveda salon procedure, explained which products she was using and how they would help me style my flat hair. On my way out, she made a point to show me all the products she used on the store shelves, "just in case." I work in sales, and have for some time, so this move irritated me. I understand half her job is to sell me Aveda products, but I'm a big believer in "earning the sell." In other words, I don't believe you have the right to try and sell someone something if you haven't first built good rapport and have earned your client's trust -- which she unfortunately did not. 

I don't think this is a salon I'll be returning to. Besides the high prices and lackluster service, it's too far from home for me.
don't order the rolls to go unless you like burnt bottoms! Very disappointe because that's all we got. typically love this location but don't know how to feel about it now.. Hot Rolls.

I love Mexican food so was very happy to see an new restaurant pop up close to home! I find most Mexican food enjoyable, so for me, the defining factor is the chips and salsa and a margarita on the rocks, both were excellent. The service was also fast and friendly! I'll be a regular!

We ordered our mattress and adjustable bases July 11th. We were told the original delivery would be July 13th. While professing the order, the salesman said "Oh never mind, it will be delivered July 24th." We were a bit bothered by that, but it wasn't the end of the world. July 23rd I get a call saying the mattress didn't come in, but the bases did. He said there should be no reason why the mattress shouldn't arrive next week and we scheduled delivery for July 31st. July 30th I got a text to confirm delivery. I accepted delivery and then realized the mattresses weren't on the list for delivery, it was only the bases. I called the store immediately and asked about it. They said the mattresses still hadn't come in, but they are delivering the bases. What good is it to have two bases and no mattresses? So I asked when the mattresses would come in and he said they are available for pickup on August 3rd. Pick up?! Oh no, I paid for the red carpet, top of the line delivery and set up. It's not my fault the bases are being delivered separately. Sean, the salesperson I was talking to on July 30th said there was nothing he could do about changing the mattresses to delivery instead of pick up. I asked what other options I have as far as ordering different mattresses. His response was "There's nothing I can do." The only thing he offered to do was cancel the delivery for the bases. At this point, I'd rather have the bases delivered and I can cancel my mattresses and look for mattresses elsewhere. The fact that Sean said there was nothing he could do to help me was beyond me. He said I would need to talk to the original salesperson the following afternoon. Why wouldn't any of their salespeople be able to help customers? Let me add, had I not noticed the mattresses weren't on the delivery confirmation, I would not have known they weren't being delivered. I didn't get any phone call or notification that my mattresses weren't going to be delivered. I had to call them to clarify. So later today I will have two bases and no mattresses. This place lacks communication and customer service. I will not be doing business with them again. If you would like your items in a timely manner, shop elsewhere!
This place does not disappoint. Why haven't I found this place sooner on my trip to Boise. The customer service is great . The food is amazing and I will definitely be coming back

First time, pretty busy at lunch. Wife had chicken noodle soup. It was pretty good, lots of noodles and pieces of chicken, and tasty. I had Japanese pan noodles with an added chicken breast grilled. Tasty too, veggies were crunchy and fresh. Shittake mushrooms were present, could use a few more slices though. Chicken breast was nice addition, grilled. For the price though, could be a bit bigger. 

Quick service. We would return.

Bad service, cold wings, manager is useless. If you want better food and service just go to the Chevron across the street and get a hotdog off the heating rack. Been to this location about 4 times over the past few years and it is always the same shitty service and food.

I ordered ahead of time and checked online and saw they delivered food curbside. Turns out, this location isn't doing that and handled everything through the drive through. The line was 20 cars long. If I hadn't already paid for my order, I'd have just Country Donuts on Overland and Five mile

I'm not a huge fan of takeout food but Crave Delivery has changed the game.  We've ordered a few times now and they are always on time with delivery and the food is still fresh and hot.  We hope they add more restaurant offerings soon for a little more variety.

*FYI* ALL of the Mai Thai pad that is served with tofu.  It doesn't state that on the menu (yet) but there is no option to remove it unfortunately.  For that reason I took pics and complained on 2 occasions.  I felt the other meats were lacking in qty and we don't like tofu.  Each time I complained I was compensated and on the second time it was explained to me.

Mai Thai is our favorite to date but you have to be very careful with the spice.  The first time I selected level 1 for my drunken noodles and my husband got level 3 on his pad Thai.  I could barely eat either of the dishes because my mouth was on fire (I'm a wimp).  DEFINITELY order the Thai Appetizer!  I highly recommend adding pork to the fried rice and this is probably the best dish I've ordered.  There's definitely a kick somewhere (maybe the dipping sauce?) but nothing I couldn't handle.

Crave delivery is also easy when entertaining guests.  It's easy for everyone to order what they like or get a diverse variety to share family style.  This past weekend we had our guests place their own orders on my phone  ( so easy)
First time to this salon. My hair stylist was Savannah. I love my cut. I normally get my hair cut when it gets too long, but I really like how my hair looks now and will be back!
Great Ramen with great service,  we stumbled upon this place while traveling through the area. We are always looking for a good ramen spot. This place is going on our list as a place to come back to.

Hoping the "hit or miss" experience is resolved soon.  Used to be our local favorite until things like uninformed server brought a drink from the bar that was not what I ordered and then wanted to argue that an "old fashioned" and a "Kentucky Mule" were basically the same thing.  The meal did not make up for it so we're taking a break for awhile to try other places with consistency and quality to match their prices.

Love their food! But it is really  noisy so if you have a large group  probably isn't the best place to go for a visit. We met for book club and really hard to talk. Everyone had good fOod and  liked the place

Terrible fish and chips! Looked terrible when the server brought them to us... like Van Da Camps but bigger. Fries were great but for 11.00 a piece we could go another place for much better service and atmosphere! Thank a lot ‍

Do not come here for the car wash. They close at 7 which is earlier than most and for poor quality, over priced washes. Gas is gas. Seriously the worst fast eddys so far, I would rather drive a block down for my wash. I did actually.

My wife and I found this place by accident and we absolutely loved it. The portions were enormous and priced to sell. I had the cheesesteak and my wife had the calzone and both were out of this world. We didn't go to drink but I wish we had. They had different bar specials every 30 minutes. It was a beautiful thing for a younger couple however I would recommend going on a night .

I would leave a 0 star review if I could. Ordered online through their website and had set my pick up time to ASAP. I went to the store at my pick up time. Only to find out that they are 40+minutes behind and there is a group of 20+ people waiting in the pick up line (some had been waiting for over 45 minutes ). This is a ridiculous way of doing business. First of all don't let me order and choose my pick up time if you can't make that time frame (or somewhat near it). Second of all there were literally 2 people working the counter /checkin area. Clearly they need to hire more people if they are going to be taking in so many online /door dash orders. They have lost my business because they lack of efficiency and hospitality.

I went here with my sister and my two boys. We went for lunch during the lunch rush hour, and it was awesome. There service was great. I ordered the enchiladas, and my boys enjoyed a taquito and quesadilla. As always when dining in a Mexican restaurant, the tortilla chips and salsa are free of charge, but I have to tell you that their salsas are super tasty. Thank you for a delicious, fun and quick dining experience since we were all on a time budget.

This place is my go to when choosing mexican food in town and always bring friends and family when they visit. This place never disappoints. Food is always amazing along with the service. Cant come here enough the whole family loves it.
Lost me as a customer forevermore what they are doing to my pillow  . I encourage everyone to not buy from this company again . See you after your bankrupt.

We recently adopted our sweet Golden Retriever, Bella, who was very much in need of a *thorough* bath. We tried to get her in with multiple grooming salons but most of them were booked out 2-6 weeks already! 

I found CleanPup Saturday evening and was able to easily book an appointment on their website for today (Monday) at 8am! The process was so easy that I wasn't sure if I had actually correctly booked her appointment. Not to mention I felt extra lucky for having to get her in so soon!

Tim showed up exactly on time and was super professional and kind to Bella. He made sure he was fulfilling everything I wanted for Bella and gave a thorough explanation of what would go down. I was super impressed with how quickly he finished with her and Bella seemed happy and very relaxed. Best of all, she looks, feels, and SMELLS great!!! 

What an easy breezy experience for Bella and I! Thanks, Tim!

This store is being run by mental midgets. We went in to buy an outdoor patio furniture piece and a BBQ unit. It took over an hour for them to try and book out the delivery and charges.

As it got later and later, I finally had to leave before I went postal in there. I don't suffer idiots very well. They put probably their newest employee at the cashier/service desk and he could not figure out how to do a charge for the items+a delivery charge+ an assembly charge. A second woman clerk came by and knew as little as the poor new guy  and she was totally comatose too.  My wife stayed and suffered thru this fiasco. Now we were talking about a $600 purchase and I was so steamed at their incompetence I told her that we should have gone the Amazon or Wayfare route. (BTW, this outfit charges $60 for delivery and it isn't worth it.)

The next day I was still so PO'd I did go back and canceled the whole order and told the manager why. He didn't even try to keep the sale, just shrugged his shoulders and rang up the cancelation and refund.

Lowes is not my favorite store.

I went to r&r earlier today (yesterday technically... it was Thursday the 11th) I have had some bad experiences here before such as none of the tables were sanitized, the staff would have no energy stuff like that but today was completely different. I went in to R&R and was greeted with a loud "welcome to r&r!" and the guy that takes the food out sanitized all of the tables almost immediately after people left them and when he brought my food he was very polite and friendly. I saw some kid spill their drink all over the floor but he cleaned it up without saying anything bad about it. The parents were very apologetic and he said and I quote "its no big deal, accidents happen all the time" he cleaned up the drink with a smile on his face and when he was done HE apologized that it took so long to clean up even tho it only took MAYBE a minute? (Yes he was wearing a mask. Over the nose and stuff but you can tell he's smiling) he was pretty much the only one of the people up front with their mask over their nose I noticed. Anyway the food was great the tables were clean and the service was amazing. Definitely a better experience than last time. (I highly recommend the pork sandwich or the cheese burger if your going there for your first time. The 2 meat plate is also good, the pork and brisket are my favorite)

Not so much a restaurant review, more of a staff review I guess? His name tag said was Austin or Andrew or somthing? I don't really remember but he did a good job and had a lot of energy. The ONLY complaint I could have is the employees were using profanity frequently while talking to each other rather loudly.  Usually this wouldn't bother me but as I previously mentioned there were kids there so that was kinda concerning. However once again their food runner guy did great and didn't swear a single time. He accidentally hit his hed on the table while cleaning up the spill and all he said was ouch. I overheard someone ask why he was working that position instead of doing dishes so I assume he doesn't do that job normally but he definitely should. He's a good fit for the position in my opinion 

The cashier also did a good job, she was friendly and answered all of our questions in a polite manner but her name tag was on the side of her hat so idk what her name was, but her mask was under her nose. Not a bad thing, not here to complain about somthing i think shouldn't be required anyway but oh well, what can you do about it :/

I paid 109.98 for 5 meals that were nothing like downtown Matador food. Sent two meals back for redo. Also, steak nachos had virtually no meat on it. Water was served with no ice.street tacos about an inch high of white onions, awful.  My meal was only palatable...chili relanno...one filled with rice only, no cheese.  Date 5/6/2017 ticket 10020. Was enbarrassed because I told my family they were in for a treat. I will not recommend this restaurant.

First time at this location. Been to the Pocatello one before which was a great experience! Went for happy hour. Slow service slow food to table. Staff looks all scattered and confused and they weren't that busy. Ordered Shrimp and flatbread appetizer which was a 4 out of 10.
