Big turn off was our table inside the bar being swarmed by 6 or 7 huge FLIES!  Landing on our food, rim of our drinks and our faces. You could see dozens circling the room. Yuk! Said something to waiter and his reply was well we can't control the flies lol. No thanks not going back. There are a lot of other high end restaurants around that can control their flies and have better service. My wife said shouldn't there be a manager on the floor? I looked around and there was a very old gentleman with a cowboy hat on and a name tag who was standing in the server area with his back to the customers who was unaware what was going on. Wish I could be writing a good review.

We should have believed the 3-star average reviews.  The waitress, Ashley, was great, but the margaritas were not good...avoid the Jovan tequila -- was absolutely terrible.  The food was marginal at best.  Will definitely not return.

What a great intimate steak house. No reservations, so calling ahead helps to see how long the line is if there is one. But there is ample parking and some close handicapped spaces for those who need such an amenity. As for the food...Yummy! On my second visit I enjoyed the 8 oz rib eye steak. It was their special. Served with asparagus and potato, I opted for the french fries. My husband and I shared their beer flights. They have quite the selection to choose from and anyone who likes beer will find something they can enjoy. The wait staff is attentative and quick. They know their stuff. I plan to return as it's a fun little place to enjoy a good meal.

We were so excited to try this new restaurant that opened near our house and it did not disappoint! Both of the appetizers that we had were fantastic. When we saw how busy it was, we worried that the service may be slow, but our server Kyle was prompt and attentive. He offered great suggestions and didn't make feel rushed. We sat at the bar while we waited for our table and drank a wine that was recommended by the bartender, Kat. She was so knowledgeable and friendly that we didn't even mind the wait.

Can't wait to return for Valentine's Day.

Great chips and salsa! Service was good and the food was great. I definitely recommend the bacon wrapped jalapeño poppers! They were seriously amazing. We got seated very quickly but we did show up right as they opened. I do recommend coming in a lot earlier if you're wanting to come for a dinner they usually always have a 1 hour minimum wait.

We've had Kahootz to go twice during this quarantine/stay at home order. Both times it's been phenomenal! 

Last night we ordered prime rib for the family and the queso appetizer. Everything was packaged really nicely and the food was SO GOOD when we sat down to eat. The baked potatoes are huge and an entire meal themselves. Piled on top of a delicious cut of prime rib and asparagus? To die for! 

Definitely a place we're missing visiting, but glad they're open for take out right now.

Placed an order online at 11am to be picked up at 2pm. Got the email that order was received. Ordered a gluten free and a custom medium pizza. 
Went in to pick up my order. Was informed they did not have gluten free so they couldn't fulfill my order. No prior notification was sent to inform me that my order couldn't be fulfilled. Extremely frustrated. Cancelled my order.

Been back 5 times and have enjoyed more dishes. Always the same great service by Maggie. We always ask her to have the chefs cook it like they would for themselves with less sauce, less salt/soy sauce, and less oil. They always do it like we want. 

Since our first review we have had (in no particular order here):
1) won ton soup- very good, lots of home made pork won tons, cha siu pork, and fresh bean sprouts and pea pods. Broth excellent. Bowl will serve 2-3 people. 
2) hot and sour soup- one of the best I have tasted. Clear and clean taste with good heat. 
3) chow fun noodles- excellent rendition, noodles are not over cooked or sticking together. We had chicken in it, but you can have any meat or tofu in it. Again, good crisp veggies and fresh. 
4) cashew chicken- crisp cashews, fresh and crisp veggies, especially pea pods. A good dish for those not wanting a spicy dish. 
5) Hunan pork- great spicy dish. Have it as hot as you like. 
6) Pot stickers- home made, fried just right, not too doughy, 6 to an order with a good dunking sauce. 

Obviously, we love their food. High praise from a Chinese guy who cooks the cuisine.

We ordered a to go order on Friday February 7, 2020. My husband ordered the Mac and cheese and I ordered the chicken caesar salad. While my salad was average, his mac and cheese hardly had any cheese, the noodles were dried out and not well cooked. Not to mention the mac and cheese was over $10 and hardly had anything there. I emailed the company with my concerns and a picture. I received a standard response saying I would hear from them in 2-4 business days. They never contacted me so I figured a Yelp review might get someone's attention. Please see the attached pic. Also, if you are a mac and cheese fanatic DO NOT buy it here!

I have driven 15 minutes away three different times to get hot original glazed donuts and I have yet to get what I asked for. Every time I go I specifically ask for "HOT" donuts. The first time, I got cold and crusty donuts. The second time, they actually told me they weren't fresh, so I asked when they made fresh ones through out the week and left. And the third time, I went during a time I was told by an employee they would be fresh, asked three times if they were hot, and then still got half a dozen cold donuts. I'm done giving my service to Krispy Kreme. Three times of error in a row is more than enough for me to not want their donuts anymore

I have had nothing but amazing experiences at kahootz. It is my go-to restaurant for my birthday meal with my spouse. The prime rib is always delicious, the sides are great, and the mud pie is off the charts. Everything I have tried has been cooked perfectly and delicious. If you haven't been here yet, do yourself a favor and stop in next chance you get
Don't even bother, food that's cold and not what it says it is when u order. And you can get better sushi at the supermarket! Nasty. And way to over priced for the trash thay are putting out.

I've took in my dog around three times. She has always came out shaking and scared. I just thought it was because she's still new to grooming since she's a puppy, now I'm not sure if they have done other things I'm unaware. 

This last time she came out with a large and deep cut on her leg. They tried pinning it on me and said she was fussy and too matted. Any professional would know to stop and have the pup calm down before even continuing. If you aren't able to finish the cut that's understandable but to continue and have the pup suffer is unexplainable. They were extremely rude about the whole situation as well. Sadly she has 2 stitches now.  

This place might be the cheapest but do yourself & your pup a favor spend the extra money and go somewhere else. 

I am extremely disappointed and I do not recommend!!

Placed an online order while waiting outside and when I realized it was going to take over an hour I went inside and cancelled the order IN PERSON. A week later I still did not have a refund on my card. Called 3 more times over the span of a week and kept being told it was processed. Never got my money back. I gave up. This is not some difficult task or circumstance and chalk it up to management not following through or properly training staff.

We we had the hibachi dinner. The server was excellent chef was incredible. The show was even better. We had a fun time. Is a great place to celebrate an anniversary. The food was incredible shrimp was cooked perfectly salmon amazing steak was awesome. Recommend highly.

I cannot recommend this place enough to my friends here in the Treasure Valley area. The combination of unique, well thought out ambience, and delicious food really takes you to a new level. On top of that, add premium VIP style service, you have an entire experience unmatched in the Treasure Valley area.

We ordered a multitude of dishes and I don't remember the last time I being that full especially in a higher tier restaurant.
I definitely recommend this place for a nice meal out! Although pretty boujee, the food is super good. The atmosphere is really good too! Worth the larger price tag.
Went to Kahootz when my folks came I to town from Chicago. Mom got a steak and that was good, the rest of us were underwhelmed by the food.

So I went and ordered two spicy chickens through the drive-thru. When I got home I took a bite to find the patties were burnt and inedible, when they're usually a golden brown. It seems like the workers have just given up and don't care. For sure will not be going back to this location.

My husband and I were recommended R&R by a friend. We tried it out this past weekend and we loved it! The ribs had a little too much smoke taste for my liking, but my husband enjoyed them. The pulled pork and sliced brisket were amazing! We ordered fries, baked beans and got a side of fried pickles... we were really impressed by everything, especially the fried pickles! We had asked an employee about the nachos after we were eating our meal (planning our next visit) and he brought us a sample of the nachos, no charge. They were delicious as well! We're looking forward to our next visit!

It's a 5 star that gets 3.  Service.... is nice.  It makes a 5 star.

The food is bullet proof.  The only thing I've had that wasn't fantastic was the taquitos.  Other than that, the menu and the things on it are amazing.  My faves are the street tacos and the chili... and the brussel sprouts... and almost everything I've tried.

The service... ugh.  Ugh is the way they seem to regard you.  I've been there a number of times, and there legit one guy... yeh, he's a guy... a bartender... who seems into his job.  Everyone else is pretty much phoning it in.  I'd give one star, but the food is just too good.  Replace the entire wait staff and this will be an easy 5.

I've got to upgrade from 3S to 5S.

1- I don't know if it's just me, but I feel like the service has improved.  Maybe I've just been getting lucky, maybe I had been just getting unlucky when I wrote my review, or maybe they've had turnover and hired better.  Whatever it is, I won't knock the service anymore.

2- I feel like they're one of the better restaurants in terms of handling themselves during COVID (for those of us whose judgement, like mine, is questionable enough to eat out.)  If I remember right, they had a table up front with some hand sanitizer, and required masks if you're not seated.  THEY ARE ON DOOR DASH, so if you want to really minimize risk, there is that option.  They appear to value the health/safety of their staff and customers.  It also helps that they've got enough square footage in the place to where they can keep us good and spread out.

They've also added an enchilada plate using a mild habanero sauce- and when you can get habanero flavor without the punch-you-in-the-face heat, do eet!  Currently my favorite thing on the menu.
Love Flatbread - typically go there with friends for lunch, and get the you pick two option. Delicious pizzas, and you can't go wrong with their salads. Highly recommend.
Kahootz is the best. All of their menu items are delicious. We used to go there about once a week prior to Co-Vid. Staff always super friendly and helpful. Awesome service

Ordered the Caveman burger and the 2 meat plate special for dinner. The food was excellent. The pulled pork was to die for. Used the Less Sweet More Heat combined with the original sauce which was a nice combination. The garlic mashed potatoes and gravy were great too. Some of the best BBQ in the valley.

The highlight of the evening was the fact that the restaurant was packed with people lined out the door and since this is next to the Village it is a hopping place. I had placed the order online for pick up and when we arrived there were not any cars in the pick up spots and the signs marking the spots were a large QR code. I scanned the code from the car, entered a few items of info and it only took a couple of minutes to have our food and we were on our way.

We will definitely be back.

Well... i recently moved from Texas... so I know I have high standards. But this wasn't even close to reaching them. Dry briscuit that came out to my table lukewarm. The sausage honestly tastes like refried beans. The fried okra was fine, but that's it, just fine. They're bbq sauce is pretty great though in my opinion. Friendly customer service and very fast... just not very good food.

Bravo, you guys. In my 30 years of life, I've never been on the receiving end of a more perfectly executed practical joke. That was a masterclass in how to defecate all over an unsuspecting victim. Hand-clap emoji.

I love how my chicken tender salad was one piece of uncut lettuce topped with a single 2-inch chicken tender that can only be accurately described as a "turdlette." Bonus points for not including any of the toppings that I requested whatsoever, and extra credit for whoever decided to send the dressing containers without any dressing in them. (Including the ones I paid extra for - that really gave me a chuckle.) All of that would've been enough for most pranksters, but not you guys. Nope. You went the extra mile and made sure that 4 of the 10 boneless wings i added to the order were made out of undercooked cartilage. That was as tasty on the way up as it was going down.

Maybe I should take a moment to speak a bit more seriously. Listen, guys and gals responsible for this order: I know you didn't dream of being Buffalo Wild Wings employées when you were children. But as long as that's what you're doing, perhaps you should consider not doing it like absolute imbeciles. I just got off of a 10 hour shift, working on my feet all day and taking abuse, and all I wanted was a decent meal for my hard-earned pay. I've eaten at b-dubs for over a decade - in 4 different states - and I've never had an experience that came close to being as awful as this one. Shame on all of you. For god's sake. What an absolute travesty.

I had the pork ramen amd it eas amazing!!!   Great portion sizes!  Customer service was top-notch.  Frirndly staff, nice & clean, and delicious food!

Can't wait to go back!
Laura did my nails today and I couldn't love them more. She helped me decide what I wanted after ten years out of the nail game. I'll be back next time I visit the Treasure Valley  #matteblackforever

I've been here about 5 times in recent months & I can say they do an amazing job on fills.  However this last visit wasn't good.  They spent the entire time arguing with a carpenter trying to hang up shelves (in front of customers).  Yelling over us.  Then I go to pay & I go to finish the transaction on a new card POS system and the lady literally swats my hand away from touching the screen, says "no, you don't sign there"!  I was speechless, verbal and physical inappropriate conduct without any acknowledgement that maybe you shouldn't show this behavior in front of customers!!
Best Chinese takeout that we have found! The staff are always so friendly and professional!

Another great meal at Kahootz. This time we went for beer flights and sandwiches. 

I found a new beer to love. Made by Left Hand brewing company, it's their Chai spiced dark beer. Oh My it is delightful. 

Kahootz's Ruben is tasty. Rye bread filled with tender corned beef, thousand island dressing, sauerkraut and swiss cheese. Then grilled to make it nice and toasty. Their French dip was good as well. We ordered both and split them. 

I look forward to my next taste of their bread pudding - half serving to share. It is the best ever!

Vibe, eats, service all add up to we're glad we tried it.  But my husband and I wouldn't make it a destination left to our own devices.  The vibe here leans heavily the sports bar direction.  I knew that going in but expected, based on reviews, good food would be the hook.   But the food wasn't quite the quality expected.  Service was unerringly friendly but not quite on point for details.  Still, worth a try to see how it works for you.  Especially if you live in the neighborhood.

VIBE:
Eleven TVs.  Count 'em!  OK...maybe even twelve.  Each tuned to sporting events.

It was LOUD at lunchtime, maybe not so much the TVS but from the fact that at 1:45 on a weekday it was nearly a full house.  Including fifteen or so of the maybe twenty four-ish seats at the bar taken by folks drinking beer...who were all still there doing the same when we left an hour later...and having the congenial back and forth between themselves and the bartender that made it seem like this might be a regular thing. ("NORM!"  You know what I mean.  :-))

The tempo was 'neighborhood place' with people ranging from a few grade school kids to seniors to all ages in between and included a bunch of (cute) guys who seemed off the construction crews for the residential building boom in the area.

Industrial look with exposed duct work above and what seems like a garage door on one side that likely gets rolled up onto a sidewalk / patio for seating in nice weather.
 
SEATS:
We were invited to seat ourselves.  The only open options were a handful of stools at the bar or standard height tables along the wall with chairs on the outside and a hard wood bench on the wall side.  We chose the wall tables. Besides the hard bench, there is a downside to these seats worth noting that is this:  every time the door opens the cold breeze blows straight down that line of tables, even if you're sitting down the line as far as the bar.  Which we were.  Now you know.

There are also high stools at high tables ringing the dining area and some more low tables that seem trapped in the middle of the ring with a tight squeeze to get to them. If I could wave a magic wand, I'd rearrange those low tables to the outside so they don't sit in that "canyon" of high tables.  Good design for "people traffic" flow is low to high.

Thumbs up that the stools have backs!

EATS: 
Better than mass market chain fare.  And here's a tip:  sharing is a great idea because portions are generous.

We split a Cali Club sandwich, chose garden salad as our "comes with" and were enticed to an order of onion rings on "best ever"  recommendation of the server.  

Half of the order of onion rings were disappointingly 'doughy' as if undercooked and remained uneaten.  The rest were crispy on the outside but flavorless.  Tip:  There is great Sirachia Ketchup on the table.  Highly recommended.  

The sandwich was good enough and easily shareable.

The romaine in the salad was crispy but it came with sliced black olives of the canned variety and bland cheese as if packaged pre-shredded.  Tip: Avoid the House Italian which was devoid of flavor but for oil.  Fortunately it was served on the side and happily replaced with the Yogurt Green Goddess (a winner) when requested. 

SERVICE:
Friendly, "thanks for coming" server who knew the extensive menu well. Nice job.  He demonstrated Saintly restraint with the table next to us, folks who like us were new to the restaurant but who seemed unable to navigate the menu.  He answered every question patiently although he was swamped and the answers were printed on the menu.  A couple of service misses were in a small saucer delivered for 'share plate', no question why half the onion rings were left in a doughy pile uneaten and the check delivered shortly after the food without asking if we wanted  dessert. 

PRICES:
Fair across a range of options, in particular for the size of servings.  Then again quality was not high so it balances out.  Our lunch which amply fed two lighter eaters was $13.00.

LIBATIONS:
Looked like more than a couple of dozen beers on tap.  They also have a full bar and a specialty cocktail card was on the table. Soft beverages.   I noted a Root Beer Float was only $3.75.  Would have ordered one for dessert had I been asked if I wanted dessert.

THIS N THAT:

1) PARKING:  Private lot front and more in back of this newish mini-strip-mall location.

2) ACCESSIBILITY:  Accessible parking in lot, but shy of the number to meet ADA rules. Mall owner's issue. Level in the door.  All on one floor.  Some standard height seating accessible at wall but overall most standard height seating here would be impossible to get to given the place doesn't follow ADA rules for clear aisle spaces. 

3) HAPPY HOURS:  Two times a day.  From 2-5 and then after 9p.

4) BREAKFAST on WEEKENDS:  Saturday and Sundays.  See the website.

Open dining order at the counter and then find a seat and they bring the dood to you   We ordered the 3 meat  with the 2 sides of ribs so 4 bones, and the pulled pork.  BBQ sauce offered was sweet , Spicy& original we got one of each.  Also each meal comes with hush puppies too.  When the food came out it looked great and they were cooking fresh hush puppies and would bring them out when done. 
Salad was a salad nothing special but was good, ribs were cool and pretty

Heard about this newly opened restaurant and decided to reserve a table for me and a couple of my dearest friends. The restaurant is decorated with simple elegance and the ambiance is nice. The music was good and not too loud. Our waiter, Weston offered great wine pairings with our food order and he was spot on! 
The service was prompt, friendly, and helpful. The food was delicious and perfectly portioned. I will definitely be back.
By far the best flatbread pizza I've ever had unbelievable French onion soup the salads are unbelievable great service great food highly recommend

I was a little worried about eating here after reading some of the reviews, but it was by my hotel and I love Japanese food, so I went. My server was very polite and helped me pick out exactly what I wanted to eat. The roll was delicious and flavorful. It was called Naked Girl, and I got it without the cream cheese.

Everyone else seemed to enjoy their food as well.

Really good place. Quality steak, great ribs, and good sides. Felt a bit rushed to get out of there though. Check came when I was about half through with my meal. Was going to get dessert but paid, then finished meal, then left.

Again, we go to Jaker's quite often, and have for years, so obviously enjoy it for numerous reasons.  Our food last Saturday night was great, as always ... horrid service in bar.  The consistency of professionalism and enthusiasm needs to be worked on as it truly is hit or miss.  It was a miss Saturday night.

We visited the Ramen house last night and we're impressed with the service and the Ramen. Being from Southern California we were surrounded by top-notch Ramen places and the Ramen House would hold its own with those. I ordered the Tantanmen (screenshot below) and very much enjoyed the touch of spicy. 

Also, the service was very accommodating, and the minimalistic decor was nice.

SoCal expat here, (dare I admit).  The wife and I have been looking for a decent Mexican restaurant with little luck until we found the one up in McCall.  Both restaurants are fantastic and the Meriden location has become our go-to choice for good Mexican food.  Love the chips and salsa!

It's all the way in the corner of the Eagle Island shopping center, sort of hiding behind the Fred Meyer and all the other things in this giant strip mall.  You'd almost never know it was there, and certainly wouldn't know it was that big inside.  

It's wood fired pizza, and is pretty much exactly what it's supposed to be.  Charred but not burnt, thin crust, fresh real toppings and if you know what Neapolitan pizza is supposed to be- you know that's correct. 

Decent selection outside of the pizza- but be real- that's what everyone wants.  

We got the flash fried calamari and it was a little  greasy, maybe a little over fried, but still tender, well seasoned and better than you'd expect at a landlocked eatery.  

Pizza was the real deal, and on par with most pizza places like this.  It's not going to replace our other favorite spot in Eagle for pizza- But- it's a good choice.  Husband got their version of all meat, and I went with the Quattro Formaggio (added prosciutto).  No complaints from either of us.  Service was great, and on the ball drink refill wise.  

We'll be back- for lunch- husband wants to try the pizza margarita- .

This is a classy yet casual dining experience. The food is wonderful and the atmosphere very inviting. Our server (Kelly) was awesome. She checked with us a few times to make sure we had everything we needed, but not so much as to be annoying. Very friendly and knowledgeable about the menu. Excellent service! We'll definitely be back!

Horrible place. After being there for almost 11 years im done. We had an issue today with my daughter and they didn't seem to think it was that big of a deal. I told them I need to have her in today if there was an opening or after school this week. They said if it was so important I would take her out of class to get her tooth fixed. I'm sorry but my daughters EDUCATION is important and to miss one day or even an hour is not good. They got her in and fixed her tooth after we paid them 60.00 for it and then after words told me to find a new dentist. Well don't worry I was already finding a new one. The STAFF sucks. I hope Dr Whitt will see this and the letter I wrote to him today about this issue and call me back. But I am doubt that will happen. I'm sure when I left my letter was thrown away. But take your kids to them and good luck. Wish they had better office staff that actually listened to you and didn't seem pissed off every time you call in with problems or needing an appointment. They claim they give good service but they really don't. My kids never got anything for NO CAVITIES like others have. I think they singled out my family for a long time

Love this spot for a quick bite. Great pizza, salads and sandwiches. They have a wood oven that they cook the flatbreads and pizzas with and it adds so much flavor!  Great spot for a after work drink or a weekend meal with the family. The prices are more than appropriate for great food and drinks.

I will never come here again. I ordered FOUR HOURS IN ADVANCE and even paid for my order ahead of time, under the assumption I would get the ribs I paid for. Nope, they told me they ran out. How about you guys save ribs for the customers who already paid for their food. Then the manager (I'm assuming)  said she gave us double brisket. What a joke!! If I knew this was how they operate, I never would have ordered from them in the first place. 

Also- they have the parking spots for curbside, well I followed the link and let them know I was there, TWICE! I waited and waited and waited. I finally went inside and asked about my order and asked about the curbside outside. "Oh, we've just been really busy" yet I see a bunch of employees cleaning tables. I will make sure I tell everyone I know to take their business somewhere else. So disappointed in how you run your company.

Been so hungry for a big juicy meatball sandwich. You know the one that drips pasta sauce down your  hands??? I found it.... here. Reasonable price, great tasty sauce on a sub roll with a pickle. Yum yum yum!!! Of course this place also has salads, sides like Mac n cheese and chili... oh never ending selection of warm and cold subs. I will be back.

Have tried out this place in Austin and had a fantastic experience. Tried out this location and enjoyed as well, but not quite as good as my hometown. Prices fair for quality and experience. I'd recommend giving it a try!

It's decent, but if you consider yourself a 'ramen head' to any degree it is pretty disappointing. The inside has a god atmosphere and the staff is pleasant, but the ramen was just not that good. The broth was very salty and lacking depth for me. Overcooked eggs. The crab rangoons were tasty though.

Last night we had the most wonderful experience at Yard House. I am pregnant and because of Covid we didn't want to do a big gender reveal, just something simple and special for my husband and I. Our waitress Holly B. Was amazing. We showed her the gender results and she and the kitchen staff came up with a creative and incredibly sweet way to reveal to us our babies gender through our dessert. Yard house is always one of our favorite restaurants. You can always count on quality food and amazing staff! Thank you Holly and the kitchen staff for making it such a memorable night for us!

I have absolutely no complaints about the doughnuts themselves. They're obviously amazing. What I do have a complaint about, however, is the fact that pretty much every time I go to this location, no matter what I order, they seem to be out of it, no matter what time of day it is. Usually I end up having to cycle through two or three different options before I land on one that they actually have in store. I understand that places like this run out of things, it happens. But, it's beginning to border on a little ridiculous at this point. It's almost like I have to specifically ask what they do have instead of ordering what I want.

I am still searching for a descent (if not the best) Chinese restaurant in the Metro Boise, and I think this one can be considered descent (or good) here.  It is probably the best I have had so far since moving to Idaho.

The restaurant is casual and clean.  Very clean.  I was offered a menu but now realized that there might be a lunch menu (I would prefer to try the lunch menu first).  It is very American Chinese restaurant but the dishes I ordered are pretty good and authentic.  I did have a hard time to order because it seems a very typical American Chinese so the items on the menu were not what I was really looking for.  I ordered Hunan pork and hot and sour soup to dine in; Chow Mein with pork and Beef Chow Fun to go.

The hot and sour soup was really good.  Hot and Sour evenly.  It had everything I think the basic Hot & Sour soup should have (although I do preferred to have some pork in the soup, too.)  Hunan Pork was very spicy.  Not sure if I would rate it 100% authentic, but close enough to my taste.  First, it has to be spicy, and it was....  Very.  However, it seems lots of the Chinese restaurants here like to add a lot of vegetables in every dish.  I don't think Hunan pork should have so many veggies in one dish (celery, mushrooms, zucchini, carrots, and cabbage).  Personally, I think if you have too many vegetables in a dish, that's pretty much called "chop suy," which in Chinese pretty much means "stir fry every thing (and mostly left-overs)"  - the original meaning of chop suy.    Anyways, so when I was looking for a "vegetable" dish, the selections are limited.  There are also lots of spicy dishes on the menu.  But like I said, it is very American Chinese to me.  They are most common dishes people like to order here, so I guess you can't really go wrong with it (or you can in some restaurants).

The Chicken chow main to go was very good.  I was pretty happy with it and my boys ate a lot of it.  The beef chow fun is fine.  I think the flavor is not there (Well, let me put this way, the chow main and chow fun taste the same but different type of "pasta."  But "fun" is made out of mung beans (I think)  I supposed they should taste a little bit different.  It is hard to explain but they are different.  The beef chow fun was a bit dry, but not too bad.

So over all, it is not a bad place to go try some descent Chinese food in town.  I have more on my list to explore, this is definitely the best one so far!

This is your basic sports bar with exelent food . I had the sawtooth burger witch is  a 1/2 pond 1/2 beef 1/2 elk burger topped with pulled pork lettuce tomatoes pickle  and huckleberry BBQ  sauce and swiss cheese... With a healthy portion of french fries ... My companion had a steak salad witch was perfectly cooked to medium rare.

Homestead presents a bit of a love/hate for me. I've now been twice and had similar experiences. 

Love: food is very good, beer selection is top notch, atmosphere is fun

Hate: service is terrible

On both occasions service was very slow. Last Thursday night it took 90 minutes to have 2 beers and then our bill was wrong. I hope the service improves because I really enjoy going to Homestead.

OK, this is our first time coming to R&R barbecue. Needless to say I am less than satisfied. The brisket is extremely fatty and, we had to pay two dollars extra to get brisket on the three meal plate. In addition to the pork is dry and taste like it may have been sitting out all morning. The ribs were pretty good. The mac & cheese is very dry with very little cheese it's mostly just macaroni with a little bit of butter. I wouldn't recommend coming here. The food price is fairly high and the quality of the food itself is less than ideal

Our favorite restaurant at The Village.  The beer selection is outstanding.  If you are a fan of IPAs try their 9.5%'er, its a doozy.  Food has always been prompt and tasty.  Never had a complaint with the service.  A must try if you are at The Village.

This place is awful. Save your time and money. Most, not all of them are rude and incompetent. Maybe I'm just spoiled with having a fantastic stylist in Vegas, but either way the lady who claimed she was in charge was nasty. Time to get a job out of customer service. Tbh I could see if I was being an ass , or causing problems, but disagreeing with someone's beliefs doesn't mean you treat people like shit, especially when you have a job where you deal with the public, and also receive tips. Hmmm.....

Not impressed by Lowe's Installation Services.  Used them for a flooring job in two bathrooms which also included installation of one new toilet.

(1) Contractor used for initial measurement, cost and materials needed was wrong.  This lead to paying upfront for sub-floor rip-out and disposal labor (No sub-floor.  We're on slab concrete, which the contractor should have seen) and purchase of several sheets of plywood and other supplies that weren't needed.
(2) Also paid for linoleum rip-out and disposal that wasn't needed.
(3) I had to go back to Lowe's while the installers were at my house to pick-up a part that was needed but not included.
(4) Installers didn't stop at Lowe's to pick up what was identified for them to bring (fortunately it was the plywood that wasn't needed).
(5) Lowe's does not provide a customer liaison to coordinate the timing of multiple contractors, so we had to reschedule the plumber to reinstall the toilet after the flooring installation took longer than we were assured.
(6) One of the flooring contractors talked to himself loudly, played music and sang to it while he worked.
(7) The plumber (who came back, thankfully after doing other jobs) had never seen a toilet that connected in the way our new one needed to be installed.  Fortunately, it came with directions.

We had to revisit Lowe's again to get refunds for the materials and labor that were assessed but not needed/used.  So far, that was about $500 worth of refunds.  One refund required a certain Lowe's employee to re-calculate, but he wasn't available.  Lowe's was supposed to call yesterday to tell us about the amount of that refund after they figured it out, but they didn't.

We should have learned our lesson last time we used Lowe's when did a new front door and back door installation that took six months for them to complete successfully.  That one required Lowe's to call out additional contractors to fix what the first one did.  Lesson is now learned.

I shop the Meridian location because its conveniently located to me, I like their sales typically but it's the majority of their staff especially the management. There is one manager with brown hair that stands around chomping on her gum waiting for the moment to use her special code or key so she can finally feel important. 
I had purchased some paper and had bought to many so I went to return the extras with my receipt and boy was I given the treatment of a thief. First they had to call someone from that department to "verify" it was actually their paper the when the girl did Ms big shot gum smacker told her "no you need to go look". Not sure the girl actually did they did refunded me my less then $5 refund. On a separate encounter with her I was returning something damaged and she refused saying because she couldn't resell it she couldn't return it. Awesome policy. Look what happens when you give a bitter lady a pack of gum and a special code.  
And if the troubled customer service was isolated to her I wouldn't be so annoyed but I noticed the guy manager was kind of the same way. This lady at Christmas brought in a specialty pack glue or epoxy, not even asking for a refund just telling the guy she has bought several of these and they all were the same when she went to use them. They were dried up at the tip and when she did get the glue to come out it just bursted through the tip. She said I don't want a refund I just wanted to tell you so you can pull them because it seems to be a safety thing. He was kind to her but as soon as she walked out the door he along with several other cashiers began mocking the lady and blew it off laughing. 
I continue to go there because I like the ribbon selection and sale. I try not to go to often but I like a few of their things so I go for those things and ignore the bitterness.
I'd complain but since it's the management...

Awesome spot for happy hour. All appetizers are half price including the 3 items plate. I had the buffalo wings, chicken strips, and Spinach & Artichoke dip. All three were excellent for the price of $5 per plate. I even left with a leftover. 

They have happy hour everyday including Sunday. I just wished the service was a bit better. Our server was MIA for a while. Besides that, this Chili's is pretty solid for happy hour. Y'all will be happy :).
Came here to apply to be a US Marshall. They neither have applications for this position nor do they sell firearms. Was bummed to find out they are indeed a retail store.

We ordered to go at the restaurant. The lady up front was very kind and repeated my entire order back to me to verify she entered it right. Unfortunately whoever made the meal though seemed to completely disregard what was ordered or the meal specifications. I could not eat the majority of my meal due to the lack of attention in creating the order. Additionally we ordered sides of veggies and sauces that we did not receive either.

First of all, none of the servers were masked. Upsetting. The pandemic is far from over.
Now about my sandwich: It didn't taste bad, because it taste at all. Pastrami should be spicy, salty. This was flavorless, dry and hard to swallow. And at over 9 dollars for a medium, way over priced. Won't be back.

YardHouse is your standard drink & eat spot. Other than the massive list of draft beers, food is standard and nothing over the top exciting. I prefer coming for Happy Hour and having few beers (or Silly Stupid Sours since it's the only spot with it on draft) and couple appetizers to call it a night. I've been to this location several times, and I expect to wait on tables and food as the service is extremely slow. Food always comes out hot and good, but don't come here to eat if you're looking to sit, eat, and go. Plan on a minimum hour dining experience. 
If you come in with our kids, highly recommend finding spots at the bar to avoid table waiting. Soon as you sit get the bar tenders attention, or you'll be sitting to grab their attention for some time.

I'm glad they are wearing masks. However, I spent an hour and 15 minute to have my pictures framed. When it was finally my turn, the man who was helping me stopped and had to answer someone else's question and then he forgot his tape measure had to get it, next another person came to pick up an order and again I was left waiting while he helped her and took the picture to the front of the store, he also helped a man asking about art supplies. My pictures were not hard. I wanted a small simple black frame with no mat. When we finally got it all rung up he told me for Both pictures it would be over $300. Ridiculous. I know not all of it was his fault as he was the only one in that area, but I saw over 10 other employees walking around the area, he also was extremely slow. It would be nice to have more helpers in framing. Next time I'll go to Michaels.

Extremely mediocre food and restaurant.  You order at the counter, expensive entree's and small portions.  Reviews are true and nothing to be excited about.  Dry ribs, fatty brisket, cold fries, and 30 min later the forgotten hush puppies balls show up, burnt.  Wasn't terrible experience but not going back, just not good bbq, too bad, great location by the Village.
Average food for average place. Server was kind and helpful but pizza wasn't anything unique. But the view from the patio area was nice. Definitely fun date spot in meridian.

This evening we were in the drive thru at Main Street Burger in Meridian. We sat waiting to place our order and after waiting 10 to 15 minutes with no reponse, I called them to see if maybe their speaker wasn't working; where I was then put on hold. So we finally pulled up to the pick up window. There, the person working the pick up window turned his back to us, and didn't opened the window. We finally drove off. How disappointed we were to find their customer service  to be so terrible!! We wouldn't recommend this place to anyone. This was at 7:10pm on 7-24-19

My husband and I had a great pedicure, first timers at Rain. The products they used far surpass others we've tried in the Valley. It was a great, relaxing experience. Makayla was great and I just rebooked with her for our next pedis!
I love the service and treatments at BLC! My chiropractor really cares about my well-being and the laser therapy really helps my condition. I appreciate them working with my schedule. Great service!

I would love to hang out here. I just went in to grab a stick and go back to my hotel, but they had a decent selection, good prices, and a cool decor with lots of leather chairs. 

The woman who helped me was very friendly and invited me to stay.

Good service but was disappointed. My husband and I went just before 3pm and ordered off of the lunch menu. I ordered a cheeseburger. When I got it I looked under the bun and no kidding I thought they forgot to put the patty on it.  I looked again and then I saw it. I thought that it looked like a kids burger. If I would have brought my 13 year old grandson he would have thought it was a kids burger. I haven't been to jakers since covid and was so looking forward to a burger and fries. I was so disappointed. That's what I usually get there. For lunch or dinner. I can't imagine they serve that for dinner. That would be worse.

This is not the best BBQ I have ever eaten. There are 2 others that I can think of that are better than this place! This place must buy black pepper by the ton and put it in EVERYTHING!! Their "Sweet Sauce" was so spicy I couldn't even eat it.  Loaded with black and red pepper. 

I ordered Brisket, chicken thigh, and garlic mashed potatoes (no gravy, or bread, as I need to be gluten free.) Brisket was dry and loaded with black pepper rub and smoke flavor so strong that it didn't allow the flavor of the meat to shine through. The chicken thigh was only slightly better, but still lots of pepper! And the portions were average to small, but maybe average in price to other places in town.

I will NOT be rushing back to this place anytime soon. I would much rather spend my hard earned money with the BEST BBQ place in the Valley. Even the second best place is preferable to this place!

Save your time and money and go to Habit or 5 Guys.  We were in line for over 50 minutes while they were working on their outside sign.  The server took our order and of course by the time we got to the window the order was cold.  Burger was nothing to write home about, very bland, bun was 1/2 rate and overall just very basic.  I won't go back again as I can't see it getting that much better to beat out Habit Burger.

5 stars just isn't enough! This place was absolutely amazing and was so perfect. McKenzie, the consultant was so personable and fun. She truly made our group feel so pampered and welcome. The first dress she pulled was the one my best friend said Yes To The Dress to! BRIDES GO HERE
Sat outside and had dinner.  Food was really great and service was good.  Had a Reuben and a French dip- the meat on both was especially yummy!

Pretty incompetent. It was my first visit to a pita pit, because we just moved into the area. Every time I asked a question, the girl behind the counter answered like I was stupid and wasting her time. I ordered three vegan falafel pitas. We cannot have milk and do not eat meat. I made it very clear they needed to be vegan. I didn't think I needed to bay sit her while she made my food, but I must have been wrong. After I got home I found all three of the pitas were wraps instead of pitas and every single one had some sort of sour cream or dairy sauce in them. We couldn't even eat them. What an incompetent putz.

All this company had to do was simply admit they screwed up and failed to prep enough product. All ingredients are readily available at most any grocery store. In fact one is in their parking lot. There is no shortage of sugar, flour, eggs, etc. These items are not part of the supply chain issues. It is not about informing servers of the number of items 86'd. It should be management's focus on actually not running out of menu items. Simply poorly managed and now after excuses were given from a spokesperson from this company we will never be back and I suggest others avoid it. Plenty of well run restaurants in the area.

Scam Alert!  Don't pay for mixed breeds at pedigree prices!

We bought what we thought was a papered Alaskan Klee Kai, she had ACA pedigree papers, which we later found out the ACA registers anything you send them.  You could register your rabbit as a Malamute.

We were sold a pure breed dog, but when we got her to the vet for a regular checkup, our vet said shes was a mix.  I just did a bunch of searching and found that my $3500 dog was really a $150 dog and pedigree was a complete phony.

The name of the breeder on the pedigree paperwork turned out to be a known puppy-mill breeder.  I went to a few Alaskan Klee Kai organizations and they also confirmed that this breeder is a known fraudster.

They do not confirm the sources of thier puppies.  if they did, they would have known about this guy.

To be fair, she's a cute dog, but she's not an expensive pure breed dog.

We've called the store, and they admitted to being scammed and we are now awaiting the results of that.   If we find that their response is a good one, I will adjust this accordingly.

Came in for a recommendation for a friend as a novice, came away impressed by the selection, service, atmosphere and in particular how many patrons seemed to be enjoying having a good time in the well appointed leather chairs.

Classic Starbucks experience, ordered my typical iced vanilla latte, and drink was on point. Took them less than four minutes to have my order ready. 

The store is a bit small but there were plenty of two person tables and the staff made sure the keep the place clean while I was there. 

On a random note, I noticed that almost everyone around me was simply drinking water. Not sure if this is a trend but I can see how staff may be a bit displeased when people come in, order water, and stick around for their free wifi.
Even thought the send you coupons when you go to check out they tell you that you can't use them. The only reason I went in the first place was because my sister had a coupon. Never, NEVER again

Really disappointed this morning. Got up early to get fresh donuts and not only were the monster donuts not ready but they wanted to charge 12.75 for one dozen glazed when their own local website menu showed $8.75 per dozen. When I asked she said prices were world wide - I showed her the site and she just said "well those are our prices do you still want them?" No offer to match their OWN posted prices and further did not offer the Saturday sweet or treat deal as even possible compromise. Wow. Super poor service. Don't see myself coming back.

If I could give a 1/2 star, I would. I run food delivery and I am always picking up there, so I thought I would see what the fuss was all about? I saw that they had gluten-free options and was excited to try them out. My step-father ordered spaghetti and meatballs (it was cold!) and I ordered Zoodles Shrimp Scampi. It tasted alright in every way except the zoodles were hard to chew! I wear dentures and it would have been great if the Zoodles had been blanched for a few minutes, or something, to soften them a little bit more. The soda machine was on the fritz and our drinks tasted like seltzer water. Gross!! You did, however, knock it out of the park with your Tomato Basil Bisque! I could have eaten a gallon of that stuff!! This was the Eagle Rd. store in Meridian, Idaho!! Hopefully, with proper management they can aspire to be the store they SHOULD be?

And the search continues....
Some things just don't flourish in some places. Idaho has amazing food! And in many ways, I'd put the overall quality of things like Mexican Food, burgers, even Pizza above places in Portland, Seattle, Salt Lake etc. But unfortunately, the pursuit of truly delicious BBQ has once again come up short. 
We were so excited! The menu at R & R looked good, and the fact they're about to open a second location implied that it was likely doing well. We ordered several things, trying the Wings, an order of their Ribs, a plate with bbq chicken and brisket and a plate with Sausage and more ribs. We also got cole slaw, Mac n Cheese, Hush Puppies and Fried Pickles. The overarching theme was DRY. Not just a little dry, but BRUTALLY overcooked. And everything! The wings were cooked to a crisp, the ribs as well. Sausage was fine, probably the best item but the Hush Puppies (although tasty flavor wise) were like sawdust. Even dipping the meats into additional BBQ sauce couldn't keep them from tasting dry, stale and truly unsatisfying. And then the sides, the Mac n Cheese and Cole Slaw were drastically under seasoned and very bland. Not one person in our group wanted to try again, and so the search continues! Let it be known throughout the land...Boise Idaho, my hometown and still where my parents live, is DESPERATE for good BBQ! There must be someone out there who can help us.
$14 junior top sirloin steak, delicious.  My husband's steak sandwich was great too! Baked fries were tasty. Seating inside and out.

My wife and I really like the food here.  The service is really good but does get a little slow on Fridays when they get a bunch of take out orders.  I love supporting a local business instead of a chain and these guys are great!
always liked their pizza, problem is with the ones making the pizza, they don't like putting on anything extra, also they can be rude when we ask for more toppings.  Customer service is very poor.

Do not use this office! Nothing good to say. Over charged. Billed for a missed appointment even though it wasn't correct on their end. All they want it extra money and they will get you where they can. They fixed my front tooth and a week later it chipped again then charged me full price even though they didn't do it right the first time.

First time carry-ing out at this location - paid in advance with a phone order and only had to wait a few minutes; great 'white top' pizza!  The 'head guy' does quality control; checks inside box to be sure all is done right! (they missed the arugula on ours and he fixed that) And for the price, their pizza beats Idaho Pizza hands down! And their crust is divine!

I hadn't been to a chilis in yeeeeeeears and forgot what it was, as I had only been there once. 

I was pleasantly surprised! We had quesadillas, pulled pork hamburgers, chicken, french fries, and a couple of different desserts, and everything was so good! We had no complaints about any of the food. The chips and salsa were very tasty and so was the enchilada soup ..Yum! 

The food was good, but what made the experience GREAT was our server Justin! Very kind, upbeat, and attentive and fun. 

We will definitely be going back.
5+++ stars!  Our favorite go to afternoon/evening pizza place.  Superb service.  Outstanding thin crust pizza.  Simple, elegant all made with fresh ingredients.

Oh how I really try to like this store. Their selection of home decor options are always far superior to other competitors, which is why as much as I cringe just a little every time I go in; I can't help but go back.

If you know exactly what you want, do not need advice from an associate, and the item is in stock you are golden. Anything outside the above and you need to either shop elsewhere or prepare yourself for a hit and miss experience.

Do not get me wrong, the employees here are friendly and would love to be helpful; if they were knowledgeable enough to be. I find more often than not, someone will ask me if I need help, I ask a question and get the immediate panicked deer in the head light look.

I also find their inventory of actual supplies for a home improvement project are poor. Want a cool ceiling fan or a new bathroom fixture? They've got it! Looking for all the necessities to build a deck, probably not going to happen. If you do find what you need, it was most likely one option that will work but not really what you were looking for, and then you feel like you compromised and I hate that!

Special orders are really what gives me anxiety. If I see that the item I want is not in stock, I really comtemplate how bad I want it before proceeding. The first issue, is now you really do need help and no one is around to help. Nor do they come when you push the ridiculous call button in the department.  Then is the item actually available? Followed by how long will it take to come? Answers to both these questions are never consistent.

On my last special order purchase, I was told the item was on back order and their normal one week order time would be more like three. Well... it arrived, took the guy 45mins to unbury it from the back and then found out that it wasn't even all there. Fast forward another three weeks, and the rest finally arrives. Pick it up, employee pushes cart to my car and then asks if I got it ok? The nice me says, Yup! While the other side of me is thinking inside, " Really?!? You just pushed this flooring out to my car in a shopping cart, and are going to let me load the 30lb boxes in my vehicle by myself? " Just not OK......

And so, my love hate relationship continues.....

Me And my family love to eat at chilis however this location is not ideal. We normally go to the Franklin location because we get the best service there. However the Eagle one is closer. Every time we go there we end up waiting forever for the server to even bring us menus (we sit in the bar area for happy hour!) then once the server finally come we have to wait another 15mins for them to bring back our drinks then take our order. My husband ordered the spicy shrimp tacos without the spice. You see our daughter loves shrimp so he did that for her. The server didn't even write down our order. So when he brought the food, naturally my daughter takes one of the shrimps and plops it into her mouth. The spice was clearly still on there. She spit the bite out and started to cry. She had to chug water for the spice to get out. When we told the server he asked "are you sure it's spicy" keep in mind me and my husband both tried it and it was even spicy to us, he didn't Ben offer to take the food back. My husband ate it but my child had no other food other then the app. That we ordered. We will not be returning.
Never thought I'd be a savory/sweet type of girl. But, this place is to DIE for! Super kind friendly staff!

We visited the Yard House early during a weeknight, it was slow. After the hostess completed two separate phone calls, one sounding like a personal call, she was finally able to acknowledge and seat us. Our server came straight over and filled our drink orders quickly. Then we didn't see him again for over 20 minutes AFTER closing our menus. The restaurant was on the colder side, so our food was cold pretty much right after getting it. And my favorite part of this entire experience was receiving my steak rice bowl without any rice. Yup. Our server did manage to bring me a bowl of gooey brown rice halfway through my meal. This place must be relying on their popular location, it was a disappointing experience.

I moved to Meridian 7 years ago.  I had the great fortune to go to dinner here for the first time within my first couple of weeks.  This is my favorite place to eat in Meridian.  The beer selection is always awesome and the food is always delicious.  
When the weather is nice, they have one of the best outdoor dining areas in the valley.  The service has always been outstanding.  It is also an excellent choice for business lunches or dinners, especially the ones that include beer.
Make sure you take advantage of the Monday or Tuesday special on Ribeye steaks.  The ribeye here is worth the extra night out for dinner.

Wings are okay but the service is terrible. The many times I've gone the wait time is always off by half an hour to an hour. Probably last time I am going, I called ahead asking if they were busy she says not really takeout would probably be 30 mins. I get there and they make me wait an hours on top of my thirty mins. It's ridiculous, I get being busy but they should of told me they were busy ahead of time. Apparently it was a 2 hour wait for dine in before I called. It's always something that goes wrong when you go, whether it be them forgetting something, unreliable wait time, to inconsistent food.

My main complaint is that the noise is too loud to have a conversation.  There were 3 of us we found it difficult to hear each other.  The food was good but arrived at the table a bit on the cold side.  Even the coffee was not very hot.  Service was a bit slow.  So, next time we will pass on the Yard House.  Just not a pleasant place to converse. Also, if you request any changes or substitutions to your menu selection there are up-charges.  So the bill can be larger than you anticipated.  Already a bit pricey anyway.

Pueblo Lindo is delicious! There mole cannot be beat and their service is over the top awesome, every server is such a delight. The food comes out so fast and fresh! We look forward to eating here every time.

Tried this place out for an oil change on a Saturday morning.   No line, wait was minimal.   Full synthetic cost $69 and included a car wash.  Plus free coffee, soda, water, video games, sports on the tv all in their clean spacious waiting room.  Definitely a fan of the perks and super nice waiting room all for competitive pricing.

The staff was amazing and very professional! They make every effort to make it a fun experience for kids, from ceiling TVs playing movies under exam chairs, fish tanks throughout the office and toys EVERYWHERE. Everyone was was knowledgeable and friendly.

Great little spot for Ramen, it reminds me of some of the little corner Ramen places in the Bay Area, except this place is newer, cleaner, and modern. The food is great and authentic. My only gripe would be that service is slow, as they have a tiny wait staff and the front of the house seems to get in the weeds pretty easily.

They seem to be handling current health and safety concerns responsibly with masking, cleaning procedures, social distancing, and appropriate ventilation.

i got my boyfriend and i a purebred golden retriever from here at the beginning of February. the customer service was pretty good, everyone was attentive and did their best to make things go smoothly for me. as far as my dog goes, he's doing great! healthy and all things great. he's growing fast that's the only sad part lol. attached are some pictures.

Great quality end results! My critique is for the owner of this place. There needs to be more professionalism coming from your staff. These are screenshots of an interaction I had with Laura in the nail department. Disgusting. Unprofessional. Extremely embarrassing look on Oliver's salon. I feel there is no accountability for unprofessional behavior. I was a client of hers for 2 years. And this is how she treats me

Stopped here for lunch and received prompt, friendly service on a Friday. I ordered the spicy shrimp with poblano crema sauce and a wedge salad. The salad was fantastic - I'd definitely order it again. The shrimp weren't spicy, but instead were almost inedible due to the amount of salt in the dish.

I know I shouldn't have high hopes for fast food, but this location doesn't even try. Ordered food and was told to pull around to the front to wait because "it was being made fresh". Waited 10 minutes, got my food, got home, and found out that all the buns were hard as a rock. Fries were stone cold and hard. Lettuce was brown and soggy. Onion rings were so hard I couldn't even bite into them. Again, I know it's fast food but come on guys. Get it together.

We really, really wanted to love this "place".  The menu has some interesting variety, though it desperately needs detailed descriptions for each dish.  The idea of recipes from fine U.S. restaurants is great, but it doesn't work if they're not well executed.  For examples, the dumplings may have been good, but not so much when they're swimming in sauce and oversaturated by the time they reach their destination.  The steak Oscar would have been good, had someone dialed back the seasoning, specifically salt.  It was inedible.  All issues appear to be either the cooks aren't tasting the food, or they lack the finesse to execute the dishes properly.

The packaging and delivery are superior to anyone in the valley.

I'm not a negative review leaver but guys. The food is just not worth the money. It's not crazy expensive, but if I'm going to spend $17ish on a meal, I anticipate it's going to taste good. Got the Mac n cheese and orange chicken. Both were described to the nines on the menu and tasted like microwave food. Not worth your money. Service was fine, liked the atmosphere. Otherwise, no.

Holy Kahootz batman. It's been on my list of to do's for some time to check this place out, like way too long in fact, and with things finally starting to get back to some sort of normalcy we got a sitter and headed over. 

Much like other reviews have stated there is going to be a wait so just embrace it. It was right where they told us it would be for a Saturday night (45-50 min) but the people in meridian are great so it wasn't bad at all and keep reading...ITS WORTH THE WAIT

Now on to the goods....the food is great folks. My steak was delish, about just what I was expecting...not knock your socks off but very satisfying. My wife got a pomegranate halibut special and was great too.

We started with the wings...and let me tell you they are definitely something you want to try. I know wings and this wing sauce is very unique,  special, and house made. It's distinct, savory, and down right.....well...right. 

Now, on to the two items of greatness that will keep you coming back and craving more...that second round of pure mouth watering bliss....the blue cheese dressing and bread pudding. 

First the blue cheese. I'm just going to tell you now that there is no judgment in this place when it comes to guzzling this dressing down like a flippin Gatorade after a 10k. You are going to want to do it...look around and fingers will be being used as squeegees to get every last drop down the hatch. It's amazing. If penicillin had a smoking hot sister this would be it. Hitler would have traded world domination for it, it's that good. Cummins guys would take those huge stickers off their back windows just for a freaking taste. It's capable of subduing Karen's into malable easy going neighbors you hope to see when walking in your neighborhood.

Second and pretty much last to nothing is the bread pudding. I'm a huge bread pudding fan, it's my favorite and I am a connoisseur of sorts. Vegas has long been known for having some of the best and I have had my fair share from one coast to the other and Kahootz has one of the best...and dare I say it the best I have had to date. This is Meers cafe level deserts lady's and gentlemen...and if you don't know what that is just know it's next level sh!#. Get it...and DONT GET IT TO GO...enjoy it there while the Carmel works its magic on an oven hot sizzling cast iron pan.

I'm stuffed to the gills and still wanting more right now. Get out there, order local, and eat up Boise.

Stopped in for a quick bite.  They are short staffed and I was very patient. You know who wasn't?  The salty crazy old Bertha of a manager.  Soooo rude to her employees.  I thought she was short due to Covid related work issues.  Nope. It's because she treats her employee like absolute garbage and no one wants to work there.  This restaurant needs to be short staffed of management, not employees working the register.  It's not their fault that you didn't save up for retirement and have to work a crappy job make ends meet at the age of 75!
I come every so often and every time it's great! The cook on point every time. So I bought them A bucket of beer.  Love that they have that option on the menu.  Service was great as well. Thanks

Wife and I tried Jaker's for the first time Saturday night.  As you can see by the two stars, we weren't exactly impressed.

The GOOD:  Wife had prime rib and we both agree it was very good.

The BAD:  Both of our salads were very mediocre.  Small in size and average quality ingredients.  Both of our bake potatoes were dry as if they had been cooked earlier in the day.  We asked for "everything" on them and received a skimpy amount of butter, sour cream, and a few bacon bits.  After about four bites, we were left with a dry baked potato and did not finish the rest.

The WORST:  Up to this point we probably would not have taken the time to give a poor review but my $28 rib steak put us over the line.  Quality of the meat was fine as well as it being cooked just how I ordered it.  It's what Jaker's used to cook my steak that is a huge problem for us.  The steak tasted like it had been cooked in a microwave.  But it was browned and crispy on the outside and still pink on the inside.  When the waiter brought it to me, it was on a smaller plate (on the main plate) and this small plate was really hot.  So hot it was spitting grease all over the rest of the plate.  The waiter even told me (as he was sitting it down in front of me) that I may want to shield myself with my napkin while it cools.  It appeared to me that my steak was cooked right on the smaller plate.  When we were finished with our meal, I asked our waiter if my steak was cooked in a microwave.  He was quick to say no, that it had been fried on a "flat grill".  

My cousin sells restaurant equipment and told me that they probably used what is called a convection microwave oven.  It cooks fast like a microwave but gives the brown color like an oven.  Whatever it was cooked in, it tasted like a piece of microwaved meat.  This was very disappointing especially after paying nearly $30 for what would have been a good steak had it been cooked over a flame.  Even if what the waiter said was true (which I don't believe), who fries a choice rib steak?  This is not what I would expect from a higher end restaurant.

I have been here multiple times and it... Has never really impressed me. It is extremely loud, the ribs are dry and very little meat, staff is usually decent but I have had unfriendly staff a couple of times. The only thing I ever really liked was the cocktails. This place just makes me think of a cheaper knockoff is Outback Steakhouse. The only times I really go is when a friend or co worker really wants to meet up and they suggest this place.

I am on Vacation and visiting my father and I for got to pack part of my cpap face mask.. I was so panicked and freak out I started calling all medical supply companies.. I talked to Amanda and she was amazing, supportive and was able to help me out... 
Thank you
Frustrated. We gave them a nice tip at pickup and they didn't give us all the items we ordered. Lame. Going elsewhere next time.

I made reservations for a pedicure weeks ago. When I showed up for my 1pm appointment at 1:05 they said they gave my spot away to a walk in. I explained that I'd skip the pedicure if I could just get my toenails painted for the wedding rehearsal I needed to go to that night. They said sorry we are too understaffed and would not accommodate me at all. I am so disappointed and will never return here again and would never recommend this place to anyone. I just had a baby and had to get someone to watch my baby just for this appointment and they wouldn't even paint my toes.

This place is great!! I've been here several times and never had a bad experience. We are always in and out in about 5 minutes with two dogs. Never had to wait and the service is great. Beth and Kayla always take care of us!

I love The Peached Tortilla! Insanely good recipes with a unique fusion of Asian style cuisine and southern flair. The brisket is absolutely fantastic and the Dan Dan Noodles have the deliciously painful spice level that you can't stop eating. 

I can't say enough good things about The Peached Tortilla and am excited to try everything on the menu!

Drove by and decided to give it a try and I'm so glad that we did!!! The industrial feel inside is awesome, the pizza we ordered should have had left overs but it was so good we ate the whole thing. To tip it off our waiter Craig was so nice and informative! When we told him it was our first time he explained the whole menu (quite passionately I might add) and even told us what some of the Italian ment. We signed up for the rewards card on the spot. Definitely recommend giving this place a try!

Despite coming during lunch traffic on a Saturday with my two small humans, we were treated like honored guests. I rarely eat at a sit down restaurant with my brood and I especially avoid it when my partner is missing. But we needed a pick me up and Pueblo Lindo delivered. 

First of all, this place is beautiful. It is bright and welcoming and the decorations are so fun to look at. My oldest was particularly enthralled with the corn husk "flowers" at our table. The staff was so kind and attentive. They brought my girls tiny, lidded glasses of water (smart) and plenty of chips and salsa (again, smart) and kindly assured me that the rice all over the floor was no big deal. 

Their chips and salsa are awesome. It comes with a regular red salsa and then a super yummy slaw one. Both were flavorful with a touch of spice. "Hungry", the oldest, devoured both. We ordered the Combo #15, taco (with chicken), enchilada and tamale (with shredded beef). I also ordered an extra side of beans, because who doesn't need a little extra refried beans in their life? We loved all of it. "Hungry" devoured the tamale and asked for more. She loved the chicken, but thought it was a tad too spicy inside the taco (I don't know...kids are weird). We probably liked the enchilada the least, though it was still very good. The beans did have a little extra heat to them, but my adventurous eater was determined to eat them and quickly got used to the spice. :) To top off the meal, they brought us sugared and spiced tortillas with cream. That was definitely a hit. 

"Hurricane", the 1 year old, was only at a Level 2 so we were able to finish our meal at a leisurely pace and avoid angry side eye from fellow customers. Overall, it was a successful Saturday outing.
This place is a place where u can get a good mattress sometimes but it is a good place to go to buy some more money and buy it for a free gift card to buy it for a free gift card to buy it for a

We had to take our dog into the vet because this place cut our dogs tail and our dog couldn't walk without being in pain. This place does a horrible job. Pay more money to go elsewhere! We are extremely disappointed and we do not recommend.

We love this place! The pork fried rice is great and we usually get the crap pops, lo mein, red braised tofu among their other dishes. My only complaint it that Yelp says they deliver ... they sure don't.

We've been coming here for about a year now.  Every time we visit the staff is extremely friendly and helpful.  The grounds are always a clean, towels stocked and vacuums/air in good condition.  I like the option of buying the booklet of 7 washes at a discount instead of being locked into an unlimited monthly membership, much better bang for your buck.

Hello, my name is Carmen and i recently had back surgery..i have been going through intense sciatic nerve pain for approximately 6 months when i was referred to The Spine Institute...Thank God..i met the most awesome Dr ever..Dr. Daniel Bradley and his associate. .omg they saved me i am now able to do the things i love pain free and sooo happy ..i would recommend him to any one who is suffering and think that they have to deal with the pain..there is light at the end of the tunnel..SHOUT OUT TO DR. BRADLEY. .keep doing what you do..I Thank God for you..

I got a chicken cesear wrap and almost all of the chicken in the wrap was bad. It was grisly and barely cooked enough. It also came with bacon which I was excited about but that was also undercooked. I literally pulled almost all of the chicken out of the wrap and didn't finish it because my appetite was ruined after continually biting into fatty gross chicken.

Do not buy any doors from Lowe's. I have paid 4500 for two doors 2 years ago, before COVID. It took almost a year to get them installed and the back door was installed incorrectly. It sags on the hinges and cannot be open or closed. I have been trying Lowe's to come and repair my door for 7 months now and all I get is the run around. Everyone points a finger at someone else and nothing gets done. As off right now I cannot use my back door. The customer service is the worse, I have ever experienced anywhere.
Mike the sales person is nice and promises you moon and stars but once you sign the check he is gone and everyone else could care less.
Lowe's also has 1 door installer for the entire treasure valley.

Land Ocean was a decent dining experience and they do take reservations through their website. The atmosphere is nice and well laid out, low lighting and modern decor. Overall, there is something missing to make this a top notch place- maybe just needs more time. There is no staff masking or distancing in sight. The service was a bit slow at first (took over 10 min to get water when we were sat) but from then on the meal was coursed well and drinks were timely. Our waters were filled regularly, which was great! Our server was very friendly and attentive once we had her. We had issues with our glassware being dirty (food/grit on the outside of the glasses) and our server was prompt to replace and let the kitchen know. The wine list is great, with a range of prices, but do know that the only cocktails they serve are canned. They do have beer as well.

The food portions were large! Appetizers were plenty to share and our table was satisfied with what we ordered! The side salads were also huge, but lacked a bit of flare and flavor. My friends were fans of the mussels, artichokes, and blue cheese dip. I ordered the spicy filet mignon stir fry - it was not spicy and had very little meat- tons of veggies and sauce if that's your style. 

Overall, I would probably rate a 3.5 but yelp doesn't allow that and I don't think it is quite 4 star. I will likely return to try a few more dishes and see if they improve in execution a bit. Will update my review if so!

Oh how I love Jakers! Always, always good food and service! They're usually pretty crowded when we go so not a place we go if we're in a hurry, but worth the wait when we have time. Staff is always helpful and friendly. So much so that you need to allow a bit more time as they are very sociable. Not complaining but again, allow bit more time. 

As far as space and accessibility, they are very limited on space and the way it is set up, not the best for wheelchair or scooter users. There is basically little to no moving around room. Mostly booths and the bar is pretty much for the upright only.

Their salad bar is one of my favorites in town and they have the largest pour of wine you'll find. The prime ribs sliders are to die for and the lobster bisque is heavenly!

Decent park but the dog owners don't watch their pets.  The dogs there today were aggressive and the owners did nothing, just sat on their bums and got mad when I said they should watch/control their dogs.  Inept dog owners and aggressive dogs are not a good combination for a dog park.  Too bad because the park is nice.  Just wish people that go there weren't such jerks.

Excellent restaurant!  I highly recommend Land Ocean restaurant!  We had a top notch dinner December 26th as a mini family reunion. Family members from Minneapolis, Atlanta and Boise. I was very impressed with the professional staff and management!  Every item was prepared and served with care and detail. The food was prepared as requested and all family members were totally satisfied with their choices. I selected the Land Ocean entree. The steak was top notch and butter knife tender. The Macadamia Nut Crusted Chilean Sea Bass was amazing. Our superb starters were: Cheesy Garlic Bread, Spicy Garlic Mussels and Tempura Prawns all excellent and mouth watering!  Special kudos and recognition to our server Nicolle who went above and beyond to ensure our meal and individual requests were met!  The restaurant is well staffed, friendly and professional!  I recommend Land Ocean for anyone looking for a memorable and satisfying dining experience!
Love this place!!  Great staff and tasty salsa!!  The only thing is it can't be a notated as a vegetarian meal if the rice has chicken broth.. but I appreciate the staff knowing this!

Yummy dinner, as always  .... we missed our wonderful waitress Jessica and bartender Dan!  Hope they're both there next time we go as they are one reason our evening is so delightful.  She's a real professional!
This store prohibits overnight parking. I brought my RV here and then saw the signs, so I had to go out of my way to go to a campground.
Literally the best food I've had since moving to Idaho a year and a half ago. If your questioning going... GO!! I have never been so happy with a meal before!!!
Ugh. Just got takeout. Of course order is totally screwed up. I don't know why it is so common that people can't take a simple order.

Can't believe how much cool stuff is in this 'store'. I went for medical supplies but they have all kinds of items from welding supplies to reclining chairs. Was met by a very nice girl the other day who was friendly and helpful. They worked with my insurance and I was in and out pretty quickly. Great place!

The only TRULY "Fall Off the Rib" meal! Flavorful, great sides including loaded sweet potatoes and my mother's favorite restaurant! Call ahead to be on the wait list, and to find out how long to wait. Great prime rib, filet and sirloin too.
