Ok, here we go.... 

I have complained about this multiple times to managemand I really shouldn't return but their handicap accessible parking is a joke! Why on earth do you need so many spaces for pick up and you have one or two accessible 

The only reason for a dirty restaurant is laziness! I love your patio but have you ever heard of a pressure washer??

This place is awesome. I sat at the bar and observed the chefs and servers communicating and working with each other to ensure everything was correct. I got the Filet and it was cooked perfectly at medium rare. The dinner roll was excellent as well and had a hint of honey. Will definitely be back if I make it to the Boise, ID area again.

We had takeout and I'm so impressed with their food! We tried the traditional tonkotsu ramen, tantan men, teriyaki chicken, and gyoza.

Ramen - broth was really good (not bland and not too salty), noodles were chewy and the portions had just a right amount of toppings. The sliced pork was more lean than normal pork belly, no visible fat, but tasted great. 
Tantan- had a little kick to the broth, my husband loved this one. 
Teriyaki chicken- I think it is pan fried because it was slightly crispy (in a good way!) and sauce was very good too. 
Gyoza- very traditional and liked the dipping sauce with chili oil. 

Packaged up really well so that it was perfect when we got home - just had to put broth into bowl with all the noodles. 

Super sweet host and great customer service. Absolutely worth a try. We will definitely be back soon!!

We are SO GLAD The Matador came to The Village! My wife & I eat here often! This venue is more open and bright than the downtown location. Food is still top notch and you can't beat the bar! 

My only complaint? 'Sure wish they had cloth napkins! Somehow with such great food, paper napkins seems, well, sooo... wrong! ;)

We freaking LOVE Crave Delivery. GREAT, high quality food. Your party can order from any of the restaurant options.. We just ordered a mixture of Asian food and Mexican. You can even get dessert delivered!!!! Like what in 2021 heaven is this??? Highly, highly recommend!!

We've eaten here quite a few times. Food has always been very good. Tonight we had the wedge salad with cilantro lime ranch dressing. Very good. Lettuce was fresh and the dressing had a lot of flavor. We shared the Habanero shrimp which were delicious. Melted in your mouth. Not terribly spicy. Also shared the chicken fajitas. Again, very tasty and plenty of chicken for both of us. This was an order for one. We will again, be back.

Sat at the bar great service. Ordered some chicken wings,  well sized wings good amount of sauce on Korean sauce, and a little salty on lemon pepper dry rub, both were good tasting.
Good beer selection.....duh!
Tried Nashville hot sandwich, had a very juicy crunchy well portioned peice of chicken with a well toasted peice of bread.
Had a classic hamburger with bacon cooked medium well, meat cooked exactly at that temperature, very pleased.
Fries not hot as hell but it is a night with every table filled.
They did bring out another side of hit fries for my whining ass, hey they tasted good but weren't hot the first time, better the second time.
So I guess overall if all you have to b**** about is french fries weren't drug out of the back of the kitchen fast enough the rest of it should be the least of your worries everything tasted great service was great great beer selection definitely would recommend.

I don't typically write bad reviews, but this one takes the cake. I stood there for about 10 minutes, with nobody else in the store, waiting for an employee to take my order. When I finally looked over the counter, I saw 3 post-high school employees, just gossiping near the drive-thru window. I asked for service, and they actually bickered about who to take my order. Eventually, I got someone to take my order which I had very much time to decide on, and when I got it they forgot my receipt, gave me the wrong frosty flavor and I ended up walking away 20
Minutes later regretting my decision to not go to Carl Jr.'s. Customer service, save the drama for your break.

We have been disappointed in this location again and again.  Tonight was the last straw.  We routinely order the Maui chicken and order jalapeños with it.  The last year and half has been a struggle to get what we pay for.  The jalapeños are left off about 90% of the time.  I have called and talked to previous managers and have received free pizzas and refunds to accommodate the lousy initial service.  Tonight was no different until Ryan got on the phone.  I explained our issue and how it has been ongoing for over a year.  I also explained that we would no longer be patronizing Chicago connection due to their apparent lack of concern over quality control.  At this point Ryan asked to look up our account and upon doing so informed me that the reasons we didn't receive jalapeños, is because we didn't order them.  He said this with a very accusatory tone and quite condescending.  Unfortunately for Ryan I have a copy of the receipt that clearly shows we requested jalapeños.  If one of my employees treated my customers like that they would either never be allowed to talk to customers again or not employed at our business.  

I run a local family business and it pains me to see local companies putting out a subpar product.  We only frequent local businesses and will no longer support Chicago Connection.  This isn't something we take lightly, I've been eating CC since they opened their doors.

Kahootz has to be one of my favorite places i've eaten at in Meridian. The food was cooked to perfection and everything tasted amazing. What really made our experience awesome though, was our AMAZING waiter Tyler. He was on top of everything, so sweet and charismatic, and you could just tell he loved his job. I have never written a review for a restaurant, let alone a waiter, but after having him as our waiter, I just had to write one for him.  Tyler, you were awesome!
One of my favorite dinner places. Great good. Nice wine and beer selections. Friendly staff, and fun atmosphere. The bread pudding is a must at the end of you meal.

Went here to grab some appetizers and a drink for my friends 21st birthday. It was pretty busy so we figured we'd just go somewhere else. We love this restaurant! They give you little muffins when you sit down and the service is great. Our server was super friendly and helpful. Are food was also very good! I 100% recommend this. Help this new buisness

Love firehouse subs! I've been going to firehouse since 2012 in Virginia and it's always been a fave! My ultimate favorite sandwich is the Beef and Cheddar Brisket!! It is the best. Not to mention they use the BEST mayo (DUKES!). My husband got the Firehouse Hero and it was seriously delicious. When I want a sub this is the place I go! The employees are friendly and the food is usually pretty quick to come to the table.

Oh how I wish I could post negative stars.. and as a former service industry server that is hard for me to say.. however.... I am not really sure how its possible in the 2020/2021 economy to FAIL so hard at delivery food service. Over a week ago (during Super Bowl Sunday) we decided to order wings .... 1) we were aware this was going to take some time so we ordered it over 2 hours before we were expecting to eat.... 2) we had confirmation texts from the uber driver that she was in the location and waiting on our food with frequent updates.... 3) AFTER she was told the order was going to be ready in 30 minutes .. she waited an hour and then asked again and was told that we "DIDN'T EVEN HAVE AN ORDER"... wait WHAT? Clearly we were in the wrong here.... how could we have had an order in the queue that they didn't know about that they CLEARY acknowledged previously in the night? After seeing multiple reviews about how bad the service was and the line was for delivery drivers at this location, I wasn't shocked that my poor uber-driver was stuck asking for instructions... Buffalo Wild Wings.. you need SERIOUS reform in management.... READ YOUR REVIEWS. Also.. call me back. P.S. We never received our food that night. The driver waited for 2 hours, T-W-O hours!. And guess what.. BW never acknowledged the error. They passed the buck, and blamed others. BW management (especially on the corporate level), figure it out! Please... You only have yourselves to blame. Act as though you are an established restaurant, act as though you proved something once, act as though you know what you are doing, act...

Excellent food that hit the spot.
Service is exceptional. Friendly family with the cutest little girl to greet you at the door

This was my first experience here in Idaho! I'm from DC, and after traveling 15 hours I needed some pampering. I'm a hair stylist back home, 10+ years experience, and let me tell you these girls made me feel like a million bucks. I have never had an experience like this before. I had just landed and checked into my hotel, and the first thing I did was book a blow out. The whole staff at Rain did not disappoint from the moment I walked through the door. Brianna did fantastic blow out, had great conversation, and made me feel incredible even though I had the simplest of services. Kindra's scalp massage and hand/arm massage were just what I needed after a crappy day. Thank you all so much.

Absolutely gross. I checked in online and waited and waited. I went in to find out what was going on. The gal at the front said oh, we dont do that I dont k ow why it's on our website. Ok 30 min wasted. Got seated. We ordered and food was brought out by 4 different people at all different times.i ordered slaw, dont. It looks bad, not slaw. I sent it back, as well as my daughters. My bone in wings were hard, overcooked and dry. Couldn't get a waitress. My tea glass sat empty. I will not be back, nor will anyone in our party of 5.

My husband my son and I all went to yard house during its opening weekend. Very busy and it was expensive but we enjoyed ourselves! When our family was in town this weekend we decided we would go and have a few drinks and some food at Yard House. The lady at the front  let us know there would be an hour wait. Fine. I asked her how far the buzzer would reach and she said only about 50 yards and not to go past Kona grill. Okay great we will stay far away from Kona grill and hang close. We sat at the Fountain closest to Yard house and waited for the show. After about 30 minutes we decided to walk towards the movie theater so the family could look around inside. After waiting a while longer I decided I would see how much longer the wait would be. I went in and asked and she looked at me and said well we paged you 20 minutes ago and you didn't show up so we marked you off.  I let her know that we did NOT get a page and the buzzer was in my husbands hand the entire time. She told me that I went out of range then. Well we didn't as we stayed very close to the restaurant and was also told if we went out of range that the buzzer would go off and we'd have to get it reset. It never did any of these things. She gave me a different buzzer and told me well it'll be about 10 minutes.  I tell our family and we wait around for about 15 and head back in to check on things again. We ask about the wait and our lady who has become VERY snotty with us tells us it'll be another 10 minutes. (her name starts with S. I will not post the full name to chalk it up to maybe she was having a bad night). My husband tells her hes a little disappointed as we were originally told an hour and we were paged after 25 minutes yet the pager DID not go off. She looks at him and very rudely says YOU WERE OUT OF RANGE basically saying -hey not my problem. My husband nicely informed her that we did NOT go anywhere near where we were told not to go. We purposely stayed close and also that we were told if we went to far that our buzzer would go crazy and let us know to come back and get reset. We let it go and then asked again how much longer only to be informed that it would be 10 minutes.  Funny it was 10 minutes the first time she told us that 25 minutes ago. We gave back our buzzer and left. Its hard to convey and explain her attitude on here but it was very terrible. I was embarrassed that we raved about yard house to our family only to have their experience be terrible and not even get a chance to sit down to try any food. The wait wouldn't have been such a big deal if we werent treated so rudely and been accused that it was our fault when there was CLEARLY something wrong with the buzzer. I don't think we will come back.  Please let your hostesses know that customer service goes a long way. Being friendly makes up for small things 98% of the time.

Update: Yard house Contacted me and sent us a very nice gift card. We haven't been able to get out and use it but we will give the Yard House another shot. I Will post how things go when we finally get back over there.  Regardless It was very appreciated and unnecessary for the Owner to do that. It shows that they do care how things are going and want to improve on what needs improved on.

I ended up stopping by the shop just to check it out.  My husband and I were totally ignored by the stylists and then the owner, Stephanie came in  and made an appointment for both of us.  He just needed a cut & style, so his hair turned out o.k.

I needed to have the gray at my roots colored and have my highlights redone, of which in 35 years, the two color treatments have never been done at the same time.  As a result, the highlights literally ran into the brown part of my hair, which made all of my hair look "brassy".  I explained to Stephanie what the result was over the phone.  Like I have heard from other clients, she did not offer to redo it at no cost, nor did she apoligize.

Then, call me crazy, I tried another hair stylist at Oliver's, Alana.  I needed my roots touched up and just the bottom of my hair trimmed, since I have long, straight hair.  She did the roots, which needed to be done again in three days, due to her wiping off the color around my forehead and face.  She stated, "boy, that color didn't last long.  I said, well, you wiped it off!"

Then she proceeded to trim the bottom of my hair.  She stated that for awhile, the cut would look "really blunt".  I have never been told that before.  Also, she told me I was done, so I started to get up, and she must of seen it wasn't even at the bottom, so she was cutting my hair as I went out the door.

After that, I decided that was enough!  Then Stephanie called me, I told her what happen, and stated that I was still not happy.  Again, no resolve or apology.  I told her she just needed to see to it that I was no longer in Alana's schedule book, and that at the time I was there, I spoke with Kelsey who said she would be glad to do my hair.  Stephanie then proceeded to tell me that Kelsey was NOT taking new clients.

After that, I decided that no matter how patient or nice I was, that I was just doomed to have my hair screwed up there.  Going somewhere else.  You don't have to kick me in the head three times!

Not very impressed. I wanted to find a place close to my house to fix my car. Went to Meridian location. I felt it was very expensive, they had my car for 2 days, didn't update me on the progress. I didn't feel they were honest with me. Not going back.

Came in, after I was seated the seating hostess sighed and stated "I forgot again", only to walk away and return with their special menu, afterwards, my brother, fiancé and I sat down, quietly, for 10min without even the glimpse of an associate. Needless to say this is unacceptable, we are at the RAM now, much better service right off the bat. 
Also, On the border tonight was very slow, one family finishing their meal, a couple behind us, and an employee eating to our left. Not busy at all, 0 excuse for this behavior.

This is the most amazing salon with such a great cause!
Making women beautiful at an affordable price.
Stephanie Semancik is the best color expert and stylist I have ever had.
She makes my day every time I'm blessed with her treatments.
I would refer her to anyone, with total confidence! She has been doing my hair 5 years and never a disappointment!
Love her work! Love her spirit!

Shoutout to our server who was actually happy to be at work , engaging with us and gave good service . The manager also swang by to check in and the kind balloon artist was there for the kids . Over all good experience, you guys are doing something right .

Horrible experience. Dishonest and unethical. I would not use them to manage your property or rent from. They will take advantage of you like they did us. The property maintenance is also very bad. They don't manage. Our property was falling apart....

I had a very poor experience with this clinic. The office staff is disorganized, sound aggravated, are impatient and don't do as they say.  It seems to be a clinic for pain management and not for new patients or patients who had a slip and fall injury seeking imaging to find out what the exact injury is, for example. Even the manager on the phone said before any imaging, their protocol is to have the patient go into physical therapy immediately without knowing the injury and an appointment could take 2 months to schedule! And in fact, for patients that have a new injury the other woman on the phone says the next available could be 2 months from now or next week, but can't give the appointment without a person named "Siri" authorizing it, which could take weeks. Even for Medicare beneficiaries, Spine Institute of Idaho does not care about you.

We love Flatbread Neapolitan Pizzeria in Boise so we thought we would try the one in Meridian since it's so close to home and we loved this one just as much.

The staff here are all incredibly nice and on their A-game.  The outdoor seating area is really nice and the food is incredible.  You have to try the baked goat cheese appetizer...amazing!

Their pizzas are incredible and their drinks are done to perfection too.  So glad to have one close to home and can't wait to go back.

I tried Blaze for the first time about a month ago. I heard pretty positive reviews from many of my friends about it, but I just never tried it until my good friend suggested it for a couples date night. My life changed that night!
We arrived on a Friday night around 7:45.  It was very busy but it allowed me enough time to figure out my surroundings and learn the ropes!

The process is similar to Subway. You are greeted by an employee who asks if you have ever been to Blaze before. If you haven't, they explain the process. Anyway, you have the choice of several different dough types (thin crust, thick crust, gluten free) & sauces. They offer like 6 different types of sauce, I opted for the classic red. At that point your pizza is handed off to another employee who takes over from there. You then get to pick as many toppings as you would like.  They definitely do not skimp on the number of options they have. There are tons of toppings!!

Cheese: mozzarella, ovalini mozzarella, parmesan, goat, feta, ricotta, Gorgonzola, & vegan cheese

Meats: pepperoni, Italian sausage, ham, salami, bacon, crumbled meatballs, grilled chicken, & turkey meatballs

Veggies: artichoke, banana peppers, black olives, cherry tomatoes, fresh basil, roasted garlic, green bell peppers, jalapeños, kalamata olives, mushrooms, pineapple, red onion, roasted red peppers, sautéed onion, spinach, squash, zucchini, sea salt, & oregano 

Finishes: arugula, BBQ drizzle, buffalo sauce, olive oil drizzle, pesto drizzle, balsamic glaze, & ranch

After selecting your toppings the pizza goes into a fire oven to be cooked.  Once it's done they call your name & then you get to enjoy the deliciousness. 

I LOVE the pizza here.  The crust is the perfect mix of chewy & crunch.  The little charred parts on the bottom of the crust are delicious. The quality of the toppings are good. 

The negatives: the salads always look wilted. Each time I have come in I have noticed that the salads all look as though they have been sitting all day. I have tried the Caesar salad and the dressing was delicious but the lettuce was not crisp at all.  

Overall:
I love this place.  Period. It's pizza perfection IMO. The price is great ($7.85 for a build your own). They offer a great selection of fountain sodas as well as specialty lemonades and the lemonade is the same price as the soda. I recommend eating your food there to get maximum flavor and enjoyment. If you have leftovers they even have half boxes to take your pizza home in! 
Now I'm hungry & craving Blaze again.  Lol

The best steak will always be cooked in my own backyard, but for the price you'll find it hard to beat Texas Roadhouse. This particular location is always busy.  The steaks in particular are very good here, especially the sirloin. 

With plentiful hot rolls and their signature butter, Texas Roadhouse is always a good place to stop in and have some good eats.  

One pro tip I would offer is to take advantage of their free call ahead seating if you're coming on a weekend evening, you'll thank me later for that trust me! 

For an appetizer try cactus blossom and try to grab a steak for dinner.

Went there for lunch a few days ago with some friends, I will never go back again. Horrible service, Got Con Cayso and did charge extra for chips. Had a awful French Dip they charged for cheese, horseradish was extra, if you wanted side salad instead of the extra small portion of cold French Fries ( maybe 7 of them) it cost extra. I had one beer, All mind you for lunch at a ridiculous cost of $29.50 for one person....what a rip off!!!!

This place is consistent and tasty. Service is fast and friendly. Ambience is refreshing and enjoyable. It's really all I'm looking for in a restaurant. 

They have a small wait, but it's really not bad. When you're seated, they have plenty of fun drinks and foods to choose from. 

I'm a big fan of Yard house and it's our go to for a nice dinner out.

First, really great service! Second, great simple boba! I tried it hot for the first time and it was delicious. They also have combo options to try an appetizer and a dessert along with your entree and all 3 were very delicious! My friend got the Yakisoba noddles and they were amazing! We'll definitely be coming back:)

Dear owner of Meridian Idaho location:
Your store has one job- Make donuts. 
Unfortunately, every time we go there, no matter what time of day we get the same tired story- "We're almost out of donuts, and have hardly any to choose from". 

Now, I'm not sure if you're so danged rich you don't care about maximizing your sales, or you're so disconnected from what's going on, you aren't aware of the problem, OR you are content in making a certain amount of donuts/money everyday and are scared of tossing a few in the trash at closing time. 

I've been to several other locations and they always have ALL THE VARIETIES all the time. They also have fast friendly service. 
Your location never has A VARIETY nor fast friendly service. 

YOU OWN A DONUT FACTORY! How hard can it be to make more donuts? We were there midday on Mother's Day 2021. Your staff said "we don't have much to choose from because we're out of donuts as we were busy today". Wow, you mean to tell me you can't look at your sales history and not know what holidays will bring your store more business? Or better yet, fire up your donut making machine and make MORE?!?!?! Recommendations:

As it is now, we won't be back. Going to find some other bakery that actually makes donuts.

Being from the SF Bay Area, I'd been spoiled growing up with authentic Mexican restaurants and have yet to find a true match in the Treasure Valley. Until now. Pueblo Lindo is amazing!!!! I got a crispy chicken taco and cheese enchilada with mole sauce and both were delicious. The chicken was juicy and full of flavor and the taco shell was crispy, but didn't fall apart when bitten. The mole was perfection! My cousin got a veggie chimichanga with red enchilada sauce and we shared the cheese dip for the chips. My family and I have always gone to {name redacted}  in Star, and Pueblo Lindo FAR surpasses them!! Try them, you won't be disappointed.

The food here was really good. I had the sea bass, and it was phenomenal. My husband and kids loved their filets. It also feels more ups ale inside than it appears from the outside. Seems like a great date night option. They don't have their full liquor license yet, but have a decent beer and wine selection. (Our server said they're expecting to have a full bar soon.)

Gotta hand it to em .... $7 for a wash and dry on your car?  Pretty impressed.  And the vacuums really suck!  Got my inside and outside nice and clean.  They also have microfiber towels to use for free and you can wet them to clean the inside of your windows.  Now that's a bargain!  Oh and they'll give you a free towelette to wipe down your dash and steering wheel!  I'll be back for sure!
PS:  tips are appreciated, but you need to give them at the start of the wash because once through there isn't anywhere to drop one off.
Ordered the family pack. We did the 3 lbs pulled pork and have to say that it was amazing.  Will order again. Thank you!

Once upon a time, Texas Roadhouse was one of my most favorite places. It's quick, dependable and feeds you the most delicious rolls on earth. Bread is very important to me. Buuuuut.... as time has gone on, many of the things that I loved about this place have become its downfall.

Because this place is affordable and quick, it attracts large crowds of people at every time of day, every day of the week. I have never been here on a slow day. And I have probably dined in at TRH 40 times. This means that is very loud, very crowded and it feels like a restaurant factory. The very kind and attentive servers will check on you about 15 times in one dining experience. Which means that you always have a full glass of water, but you also feel pretty rushed. If you come on a weekend with a larger group of people, you can expect to wait an hour or more for a table. Then once you're in, you'll feel rushed to get out. I just prefer to enjoy my whole dining experience these days. 

Some of the food is stellar, and some of it tastes exactly like you'd expect from a chain. The aforementioned rolls are puffy pockets of golden heaven. The caesar salad is delicious and I love their mashed potatoes with white gravy. But the rest of the food can be disappointing. I've given up trying to eat steak there. It is usually overcooked and often comes with a side of gristle. The vegetables swim in butter and are REALLY over-seasoned. Like...I ask them not to season them because they're kind of inedible. I used to love the chicken critters (chicken fingers) but the pieces have become less chicken and more breading. 

There are a lot of good things about TRH. But it is definitely not my first choice anymore. Forgiving Michelle of the past gave it 5 stars. Tired, "I like to hear dinner conversation" Michelle of the present gives it 3 stars.

I actually really liked this place! I called ahead a did the drive thru to pick up here in Boise.  I ordered cheese stiffed tortellini with chicken and white sauce.  I also tried the shrimp scampi with zucchini noodles.  Both were delicious and the amounts are big so I had leftovers.  I like how there is the option of eating healthier with using zucchini instead of pasta. They also have many other choices including cauliflower.  Price  was reasonable for the amount you get ! I'll go again :)

I'm a die hard dollar store shopper for crafts because, well, they are cheap. But after a recent visit to the dollar store they did not have what I was looking for. I asked the cashier if there were any other craft supply stores nearby and she mentioned Michael's and Hobby Lobby. I went to both stores and Hobby Lobby is definitely my favorite of the two, as well as the only one that had what I was looking for. 

I love how organized it is and how expansive and huge it is. If you are looking for a craft supply or home decor item, chances are they will have it here. 

Coming from the dollar store to here was a bit of sticker shock in regards to prices. But they do have sales from time to time. For example all fake floral is half off every other week. And one time I saw home decor on sale. They have an app so perhaps you can find out more about sales on the app.
This place has really good service and happy hour!! The nachos are amazing you need then in your life if you haven't had them!!!!

BUYER BEWARE READ THIS BEFORE PURCHASING A PUUPY AT PUPPYLAND IDAHO OR ANY PUPPYLAND LOCATION!!!
We bought a Shorkie Puppy on September 29,2020. We were told she was healthy and was a good eater. The first day she did not eat or drink water. That same night we had her she was up with a cough. We took to her our Vet the next day and she had an Upper Respiratory Infection and required antibiotics. Our VET said she had the infection for at least 7 days. We had her fecal done and it came back positive for Giardia and Parasites. She required more medication. Now after only a few days of owning her she is on 3 medications and is throwing up. It is sad how Puppyland advertises Vet checked Healthy puppies. I have spoken with the Regional Manager Sabrina and she refuses to acknowledge that they sell sick puppies and did not even have any concern that other puppies may be sick. All she wanted to do was protect their image and had no concern at all for our puppy. Everything my puppy has is CONTAGIOUS. Since these illnesses are contagious, I can only assume other puppies at the Idaho location are passing these illnesses around to each other. The puppies share the same water dispensers and eat, pee, poop where they live in glass kennels. This is how these illnesses are passed around to each other. I also purchased AKC Puppy Resource Kit which comes with mypettrainer.com and the company has no idea what or who this is when I call the number on the information Puppyland gave me. Do your research before spending a dime with this company. Extremely unhappy customer and will never again buy a puppy from Puppyland at any location or recommend anyone else to.
My dog was here for the 3 week residential training.  It was a complete waste of money.  He wouldn't even sit after the training.  No follow up from the business.
The campfire burger is good, not great. The onion rings are good. The bread (scones) with butter is yummy! Enjoy!

UPDATE in response to Steve.

You're right, I left out the part where Steve told me they could "fight it out" with insurance, implying that he wasn't going to take ownership of their mistake.

It's been almost 2 weeks after waiting for a response from Fast Eddy's. My car is still damaged and the lack of communication still stands.

Another perfect night!  Once again we went for Happy Hour and stayed for the rest of the evening, and a wonderful gal named Jessica waited on us ... she is just a DOLL and took perfect care of us!  She knew what we needed even before we did and was on-top of anything we needed ... the whole night.  What a joy of a human being.  She made our night delightful.  It so nice to feel wanted and that an establishment wants your business and wants to take care of you ... like you're an old friend even tho you just met.  The food was delicious, as always, and cocktails are very very good!  It was so busy tonight ... every seat was full in the bar and the dining room was bustling.  So glad to see it busy .. they deserve to do well.  The owner, once again was taking care of his patrons and staff. I went to Krispy Kreme on Friday 12/17/2021 to grab some donuts as a treat but also for the next morning for our family. We live in Nampa and it's easily a 20 minute drive. It was about 9:15pm upon arriving and there were two people in the drive thru in front of me and two more cars pulled up behind me. The first car was taking quite a long time to order, but then I realized he wasn't talking, he was just stalling there silently. He pulled up and the next car after that pulled up and did the same. I was confused because I called the store and it said their store hours were 6am-10pm as did their Yelp and Google page. I pulled up to the window to see if anyone was inside there were 3 young people working. One wrote on the window with the steam inside that they were closed. As they were doing this they were looking at me and laughing. I came here to write this in anger, but I'm also reading that this seems to be a regular occurrence at this location. Whoever is managing this store either needs to change the hours or take control of their employees and ensure that they are working their entire shifts and not goofing around. Just in the few minutes I was there they lost 5 potential customers, who knows how many people pulled into this drive thru during that 45 minutes they were supposed to be open.

Today was my son's first trip, ever to a dentist. He is a very strong willed 3 year old, so I will admit I was nervous about how this trip would go.

The waiting room was right up his alley, as it is centered around pirates which is currently one of his favorite things. He is all about his imagination, and the giant ship was so amazing to him. Such a great way to break the ice. I arrived 10mins before our scheduled appointment to ensure he would have plenty of time to play and get used to the new environment.

Our hygienist was so sweet and patient with him. We tried x rays, and when he got nervous she just said, it's okay it's normal for kids his age to be too timid for this step and moved on. I thought it was great that she tried, but didn't push the issue. She was so good at explaining all these new things to him in vocabulary he could understand.

Our exam room was a jungle theme, also up my son's alley. The best was when I discovered curious George was in the room. This made his day! They had this stuffed monkey with real teeth, which was used to show how to brush correctly. So clever!

When the dentist came in for a quick exam, I was blown away at how well my son sat there and opened his mouth . I sat there, quietly and let them talk to him. This is a kid I struggle with daily on brushing and he sat there like a champ!

 The only difficulty came with the fluoride treatment, which I wasn't shocked about. He quickly forgot the trama when he was given a gold coin to use on their prize vending machine. 

My only complaint, was the wait for the dentist. The hygienist said he was a little behind, and she did great at checking on us and trying to keep my son entertained. But a 3 year old has only so much patience and I could tell he was getting antsy towards the end. Probably would have been better to let him keep playing in the waiting room, until they were caught up.

All in all, a positive first dentist experience! And no cavities, so no return visit for 6 months! :)
Food and drinks were good. Our server was kind, but the hostess was the most rude person I have encountered. We will not be returning due to her lack of compassion and kindness for the customers!

A fantastic meal for our family of 7. We were visiting Boise and have not been in a restaurant in 6 months so this was a great breakout.   3 of us had prime rib--cooked perfectly, and the rest of us had steaks.  Service was wonderful.

Awesome atmosphere, terrific staff & amazing food & drinks. Had originally intended to go to Sid's Garage ( heard amazing reviews about their food), but yikes packed so we went to Matador & glad we did. While they were busy they enforced masks & social distancing seating... first plus. The staff was very friendly & on top of their game. Went during happy hour & they do have the best one in Meridian I have to say.. cheap yummy frozen margaritas . I had the mango which was delicious. They also have pretty amazing food during happy hour . I had the carnitas quesadilla & delicious. Would I go back? Absolutely! Wonderful restaurant
Kahootz is such a fun steak house! Great food with an extensive menu. Eating outside is perfect in all seasons.

I was having a beer and a meal with a couple friends and the waitress (who was horrible by the way) was very slow and disrespectful. After ordering food that took over an hour to receive, we asked to speak to the manager, to which she replied, "we don't have a manager." Instead of sending a manger, the waitress sent a co-worker by the name of Ernie. He was no better then the waitress! Myself, nor anyone I know will EVER patronize this establishment again.
Jakera just opened a drive thru.  Super fast and convenient.  Food is from an abreviared menu and was delicious

Once again here at  lowes and there is no one willing to help or even acknowledge me employees are taking off there stupid vests and going on break. for this big of a company it surprises me they can't figure it out
My wife came in earlier today and bought $2200 worth of supplies I KMan after work with my truck to pick them up I waited for a half hour before someone could figure out where they put all of the stuff that my wife purchased and then they pointed at them in the back of the store and said it's that and walked away!
REALLY LOWE'S? What the hell?
These people have got to be Saints. They deal with people that don't read instructions and just want to do things their way. I have used SNIP about 3 times and will continue to do so.

I gave my longest and best-rated review on Yelp earlier for the Noodles & Company on Milwaukee in Boise. 

And I meant every word. 

I visited this store as a call-in customer, using the Noodles & Company app I dowloaded from my smartphone before I even left the Milwaukee location to order dinner for my family. 

I will NEVER visit this location again. 

I only gave it three stars instead of one because of my experience the day before at the Milwaukee location, and the 2 men who were working weren't unfriendly, and made sure to let me know about a problem with my order, which is a strange glitch in the system that allows you to 'substitute' certain ingredients instead of just removing them from your order and made it look like I was substituting sprouts for deleting sprouts. 

The restaurant was unkempt and I could see, even walking in with sweats and slippers because we were slumming it that day, the .. I guess you can call it mud, caked on the runners.

My friends have been raving about this place since they opened and I finally decided to give it a go. Their food spoke to my soul! When I was looking at their menu online, I saw you can order family size chips and queso. I thought that was weird... who would order family size chips and queso??? Well, I ordered their nachos that came with their queso and I get it. I could eat just their chips and queso for an entire meal. It is cheesy in the best way possible. We ordered a baked potato, a two meat plate, nachos and banana pudding. The plates were loaded (and I mean LOADED) with meat! They do not skimp on the meat here! The potato skin was a little salty, but honestly, who actually eats the skin??? The meat was juicy and tender and flavorful. But truth be told, the real star of the meal was the banana pudding!!!! They put wafers in it and real slices of banana. I shared my pudding, but after the first bite, I regretted the decision to share it. Do not miss out on the banana pudding! Your heart will thank you! It is surely a warm hug for your soul! I will come back just for their banana pudding, and queso of course!!!!

This review is for Lisa the waiter and their terrible cook. First experience: I decided to dine in and waited an hour in my booth - I was the only person in the dining area finally I went looking for Lisa to find out she couldn't find me.... no...what she was really doing was chain smoking cigarettes out back with the cook. Not to mention the pizza was undercooked but I ate it anyway and woke up throwing up pepperoni and whatever else was in that doughy mess. Second experience today I was served uncooked pizza AGAIN and I refused to eat it. I went to Lisa and said this is uncooked again I will not eat this, all Lisa said was "Okay". Didn't even offer to make another pizza or apologize. I will never eat here again. Eat here if you want food poisoning and horrible service.

First time picking up a pizza - should have listened to the poor reviews ! Ordered the Quattro Staggioni  - sad to say this establishment should be embarrassed to charge $17 for what they sell as an 11 inch pizza, of which a good part of it is crust, thus your pizza is actually about  9 inches.  The reviews are correct that the toppings they list are spread thin, with each toppings placed on one of two slices only - just a sad offering for a pizza. Not sure why people even bother going here for pizza - perhaps their 'actual Italian food' is better but trying this once was enough for us to know they are overpriced and so not worth returning. Blaze Pizza beats this place hands down - go there for awesome pizza!

We typically come here in group because of the awesome soup and salad bar ($11.95) & has good selection of not only crisp/fresh salad/veggies but chicken, seasoned shrimp, lobster bisque soup and several others! 
 
Today ordered the calamari appetizer which was delicious! It was the most tender, meaty strips (no rings) have had anywhere local.  Very good sized portion and I love that they offer their appetizers with a meal option. 

I ordered the Avocado and crab salad, was a little surprised how much spice it had (bits of jalapeno maybe?) avocado was perfectly ripe. Plenty of crisp salad & cabbage..huge portion!

Great service + good food = great evening!
Always a pleasure to eat here. love to keep business local. Good food friendly staff.

Let. Me. Tell. You.
This is our new favorite place and will be for a long time. The care that goes into making your food AND they have their own fleet of delivery vehicles (I won't use Uber Eats after some things I've seen). Highly recommend Tokyo Hot Chicken- my husband is obsessed and we've had it twice in one week. The FLAVOR of fried chicken without it being dry or too salty is AN ART trust me- you must order some! The wasabi mash, the different Mac n Cheeses, the fried green beans and spare rib from Betelnut, the mango smoothie is amazing amazing too- just try them out. You want pizza but husband wants sushi? Done. One delivery fee, acclaimed chefs in one location. I wish I had more pictures

Great food! Great service and perfect lunch restaurant 

My husband and I went here for lunch mid week and we were seated right away. The restaurant is clean with friendly service. We loved the ramen. Highly recommended.

I loveeeee that the Treasure Valley is filled to the brim with charming little burger joints like this! I came here for dinner and kept my order very simple, a cheeseburger with french fries. I enjoyed every last bite! The bun of the burger was soft on the outside but perfectly toasted on the inside. The veggies that came on the burger were crisp and fresh, the cheese had the right amount of meltiness, and the burger patty was slightly thicker than most fast food joints, but not overwhelming. The best way I can describe eating this burger is that it gives you that "sinking your teeth into something tasty" satisfaction.

In between bites of my burger I enjoyed some french fries! Crispy, hot, well seasoned, and exactly what you envision when you think of french fries from a local burger joint.

Service is friendly and fairly fast. The food takes a tiny bit longer than a typical fast food joint, but their burgers are worth the wait!

Other things: they have inside seating, a drive thru, and a few tables out on their patio!

Let's start with the basics. I'm not a crafty person. Well I'm crafty but not in the artsy sort of way. As a guy who accompanies my wife or daughter to one of these, I find myself being the only male in the store. While the benefits may outweigh the negatives, I notice time ticks slowly while I'm in any craft store. This is even true for Hobby Lobby but it's tolerable. Why? It's their amazing selection and great deals. They actually have manly stuff here too. So guys, if you have to be dragged to a craft store, try to steer them to HL.  Here's some tips. (1) There's all sorts of specials and deals so look for them. (2) In the middle of store there's all sorts of Automotive collectibles and art. Fan of MOPAR or Chrysler? There's all sorts of Stuff N Thangs for the man-cave or for the office. Maybe Mustang or Corvette is not your thing but Marvel and DC are? No sweat HL has that Stuff N Thangs too. Sure, I know, you're asking like what do they have? Framed Art, lamp shades, and stuff. Go check it out. Okay so you're not into comic book characters or Automotive stuff but you like science stuff and toys like rockets. No problem HL has that too. It's in the way back of the store but it's there. Not into that but into collecting coins. They have Stuff N Thangs for that too. I think you get the point. They have guy stuff there. So don't go to those other places, be a good guy and offer to drive your significant other to Hobby Lobby and then don't wait in the car like a tool, go inside and check out what I pointed out in this review. Time will fly  by and best of all you'll be the hero. You'll see. By the way, thank me later.

Ok so I ordered deliver. It sayed it would take 30-36 minutes to get here. It instead took 2 hours and when it got here it was stale and cold. If you microwave it, it taste disgusting. The pizzas are very overpriced and not worth the money.
Excellent service and attitude even at the end of the day still bringing a quality A+ service to customers.  Great quality, & value try this place if you haven't ! The cookies are delicious too

Really a 3.5 stars, but not an option. The restaurant was clean, service was good, chips and salsa were the favorite. Seems some places rock the salsa and then skimp on store bought chips. No bueno! Pueblo Lindo has both good chips AND salsa. Husband ordered Al Pastor taco plate and said they were excellent, maybe his favorite so far. I ordered a shredded beef taco, got a (maybe) grilled store bought shell? Definitely not authentic. Would not order again. Rice was good. I think I just need to try something else to make me like this place as much as the hubs.

Just go there, you won't be disapppointed. I tried the standard tonkotsu chashu ramen and it was a pleasant reminder of Tokyo. Broth was rich, milky and full of flavor. The noodles had good chew & consistency, and the sliced chashu pork topping was tender and delicious. I encouraged my boys to pick up the bowl and drink down the broth towards the end, as is customary in Japan - they gladly slurped up every last drop of the bowl they split. We will be back.

First off front staff is GREAT! Secondly my chiropractor has been treating me and my 15 yr old son AND hosts educational classes for free. Dr. Baxter is an awesome chiropractor and I highly recommend him and/or the entire office!

ALSO Theresa the massage therapist is AMAZING! Deep massage that was very 'therapeutic' (painful) but I left her feeling incredible and I look forward to seeing her again. For the first time in my life I look forward to getting a massage by the same person again soon.

Great place, great food, great service! All around absolutely fantastic!! Everyone that works here is responsive, friendly and fantastic. The food is amazing, especially the sticky shrimp!!!!
Highly recommend if you're in the area!!

What a hidden gem!  This location is set back from the street, next to Lucky Perk Coffee behind the Walgreens.  We've had exceptional service and consistent food, every time we've stopped by.  It's really tasty and the quality of their carne asada is superb.  As other Yelpers have said, you can easily grab a quick, hearty meal for the price of a fast food combo.  The wait staff are all friendly and attentive and you feel immediately welcomed when you arrive. This is a family business and that's one reason why I like this place because supporting small, local businesses is essential.  

 My husband LOVES Chile Colorado and is usually disappointed whenever he orders it because most restaurants use poor quality meat that ends up being hard, stringy and too fatty for his taste.  He has ordered this almost every visit now with only one time where he had their Pozole (and he loved that too!) and swears it's the best he's had!  My photos prove it too!  I typically order their carne asada but also love their tacos, enchiladas and machaca.  They have daily food and drink specials, that vary from enchiladas or chicken fajitas and these are all well-priced.  

One tip, I have is to ask for their habanero salsa, if you dare!  It's much spicier than the one that normally comes with their chips.  They also have a medium salsa that I prefer and it's tasty too!

So, if you're craving a quick, hot meal or just want to partake in their Happy Hour, you won't be disappointed at Pueblo Lindo's!

One star for this place is one too many. The staff gave the impression they were more interested in separating me from my money than in helping resolve my back pain. In addition to putting me through several pointless tests that didn't appear to be connected to my health issues, I later learned they charge much more than the industry norm for the Boise area. 
During one visit, the doctor mentioned how certain she was I had carpal tunnel. (Note, above, I was there for Back Pain.) She wanted me to return on a later date to run a test for carpal tunnel syndrome. I was unfamiliar with this syndrome, but I knew my wrists weren't bothering me. She told me that was unimportant; I could still have it. First, she ordered an electromyogram and a nerve conduction study. Not only are these expensive, they're painful, and she skipped over some simple, inexpensive preliminary tests that could have possibly ruled out CTS-- especially since I was there for back pain! Second, the billing department insisted I pay for the test in full before they were performed, even though they'd always received my payments on time and in full.  I did as they asked, but they were reluctant to give me a receipt, which I requested since they were acting so weird about this payment. Despite being told I'd paid for the entire test, the billing dept sent me an additional bill for 30% more at a later date. We went back and forth over this bill. They had quoted me a final cost prior to my paying for the test, and that is what they were paid. I didn't appreciate their attempt to bait-'n-switch their price.
 When they sent late notices and threatened to send my additional charges to collections, I went into their office, in person, and spoke with the office manager. She rolled her eyes at my attempt to be reasonable. Bottom line: she finally took notice when I told her I was ready to report them to the Board of Medicine. She scurried into the back office, then came out and said there was a sticky note on my file saying I was getting a discount rate. So she would "forgive" the latest charge because they'd "made a mistake".  Yeah, and I have a bridge to sell you too, lady.

Just tried this place and WOW, if you dig donuts and food that expands your waste line, try this place. The donuts are perfection and they actually have a grilled cheese made out of a donut. Might sound odd, but it was a party in my mouth. They also have awesome looking hotdogs. This place rocks. 

I would have given five stars, but it's a bit pricey; $13 for a SMALL grilled cheese and small cup of soup. (It was enough to fill me up though.) They also have the payment kiosk that makes you decline a tip option in order to force customers to tip, which I HATE. If a business charges $13 for grilled cheese, why am I expected to enhance their employees' wages, especially when I order my food at the counter = they don't wait on me. I'm an avid tipper at sit down restaurants, but it's ridiculous that we are expected to tip everywhere we go, especially just to buy a freakin' donut.

The counter employee who waited on me was great; friendly and all, but there was a long line behind me and she took the time to introduce the entire staff to me, which didn't make sense given the long line. I'm sure the owner makes her do it, but it made me uncomfortable since people were waiting behind me.

Overall, I'll come back to Donut +Dog for the unique fare and mouthwatering calories. If I'm going to chow-down-wide-load, it may as well be on something this good!

Oh, I wanted to like them, but too many problems. Ordered a pizza to share, half pepperoni and sausage and half wild mushroom with truffle oil.  Also ordered their French onion soup. Didn't notice their were no utensils at the table or napkins like at the other tables. Server said we could do the pizza as special with adding the soup for $2 each. 
She asked about drinks and I wanted a beer. I asked her to suggest something and she said she knew nothing about what they had, but she would name some. I picked one, to her credit she did bring me a sampler. Didn't care for it so I ordered one I was familiar with. 
After a wait, pizza came. Had to ask for napkins from another server. half minute later, the soup came. It was hot and bubbly, delicious bowl of soup. Unfortunately, by the time we had finished the soup, pizza was cold. Of course, in any restaurant that knows what they're doing, the soup should have come before the pizza went in the oven. I could tell the pizza MIGHT have been good, the mushrooms and truffle oil tasted yummy. Unfortunately, in the time the pizza sat, while we ate the soup, it had turned cold and the crust soggy. It was not very pleasant to eat. Certainly nowhere what Grimaldi's or Smoky Mtn. Pizza's crusts are. I have a feeling if it was right out of the oven it might have been very good. 
We finished the pizza, talking about how it might have been. The bill came and they had charged full price ($8 each) for the soup. To their credit, the server admitted she messed up and it was taken off the bill. 
The bottom line is, I think the chance of good food there. But with all the mistakes, especially bringing soup right after pizza, it would be really hard to tell.

I scheduled an appointment to hopefully find a dress. When I arrived, I was greeted with a personalized sign congratulating me on getting married and Mackenzi was there to help me find a dress. She was absolutely the best and so helpful. She was the sweetest and made it a lot of fun. The cottage itself is so charming and had a beautiful room to try on the dresses. I will be returning to narrow down my favorites. Thank you again Mackenzi for making me feel so comfortable and also making it fun!

Very disappointed I. Customer service attitudes and a long delay between doctor appointments and medical equipment getting "approved" to order! The delays are very long and unnecessary especially after being a customer for 4 years and expediting an appointment just so I can get my life sustaining equipment ordered. Very disappointed and looking for a new supply company now.

I am Hawaiian-Asian, and extremely particular about my ramen and noodles. The noodles here are spot on. They are the perfect alkaline noodle, tender and chewy. Broth is divine. Presentation and the variety of offerings in the ramen are generous. If you love ramen- give this place a try!

It was pretty great eating here!!! Awesome food. I had the grilled cheese with a side of cheese and it was the best cheese I've ever had. My server brad was very handsome and very polite. What a nice young man he was. I was swooning when he brought me my Margarita

Tonight my husband and I celebrated a very special anniversary! We always think about branching out to a new spot BUT....  We always find our selves back at Yard House! With a reliable menu and a super sweet staff- it's really a no brainer! Poki nachos, regular nachos and kale Cesar  is my fave! They have the best happy hour! 
Highly recommend! 

Also- I have to give the staff a huge shout out! Jordan just started there a week ago and she made that bar light up even brighter! Everyone working bar is always so sweet! Can't wait for our next date night!

My husband and I were celebrating our anniversary eariler this week and discovered a new restaurant that opened for business about three weeks ago. We were impressed with everything about the Land Ocean. First, the location it is close to home and we did not have to fight the traffic on Eagle Road. It is an upscale restaurant with atmosphere that is truly warm and inviting. Lighting was soft, the volume of the music did not interfer with having a conversation, and the booths were classic with a touch of elegance and comfortable.
The service was like the ambience of the restaurant warm, inviting and not to be stated professional. The wait staff provided great service - being very aware when to check if we needed something or remove an empty place. They were helpful to recommend and share information about items on the menu when asked. Our waitress, Nicole, was charming and endearing. We never felt rushed to order or leave. Brandon Handly, the general manager, came to our table to check if we needed anything. Also, all of the staff appeared to enjoyed their jobs and the people they worked with.
The food was delicious, plating was beautiful,and just the right portions. My husband had the double lobster tails and I had the filet mingon and lobster tail. The lobster melted in your mouth and filet was cooked to perfection. We shared a very simple appetizer. It was a cheesy bleu cheese dip with home made potato chips. It was fabulous. Desserts  were excellent.

I ordered the prime rib and it seemed like i got  22 oz of pot roast.    The meat was dry and it had no characteristics of prime rib.    I wouldn't recommend any one to order the prime rib and also they forgot my rolls and put the creamy horseradish sauce i had ordered for my prime rib and put it as the dressing for my caesers salad.    Such a waste of 30 bucks for a national chain.    Im going local next time.
Great find. The gal was helpful on helping me pick out a mellow cigar. I will be enjoying that cigar this weekend once I move into my new home. Thanks!

What a cool spot! Great drinks, good food, and super laid back atmosphere. Our group loved dining at Yard House! We went for cocktails and appetizers and ended up staying for Linner.

We had a group of 8 (plus a toddler) and our waitress handled our group like a champ. She was very friendly, very quick, and took great care of us. 

Pro tip: Order the kids pizza! It's roughly the same size and quality of the adult-sized pizza for a fraction of the cost. We ordered both and noticed that the pepperoni & mushroom was almost the same size as the kids pepperoni. 

Our sweet potato fries didn't come with maple syrup, so that was a bummer. And then we asked for fry sauce and ketchup and got fry sauce and ranch...which was still delicious but not what we asked for. 

But everything else was pretty damn good! I'll definitely be stopping by Yard House again.

I have purchased several bikes from this shop. Hunter has always been straight forward with me. The employees are personable and always make you feel welcomed. Ashley gets your paperwork handled quickly and accurately. All three of my bikes are routinely serviced here with great results. The showroom is clean and inviting  and loaded with amazing bikes!

So far the best Mexican restaurant we have eaten at in Idaho.  Service was prompt, wait staff was friendly and attentive and food was good and our family of 6 each enjoyed the different things we ate.  Definitely recommend giving this place a try.  We certainly will be back!
I love the food here and the staff is always on point very friendly enjoy my second time around here
Always a great experience with the friendly helpful staff. Never to busy and easy access to needed items. Pharmacy staff is amazing and very knowledgeable.

Disappointed!!! My family and I were looking forward to dinner. We patiently waited for over an hour to be seated. When we were next to be seated, a family who was on the list after us complained for the long wait, so the hostess sat them.  My husband went up to the hostess to let her know we were before them and she said "oh your table is almost ready." A few minutes later she sat us at the high top table at the very front of the restaurant. We sat there for over 15 minutes and no one came to serve us. Meanwhile the family that was sat before us in the booth had water, chips, and their order taken.

We got up to leave and on the way out I kindly let the four hostesses standing at the front know that we waited for over an hour to be seated, a family got sat before us that was on the list after us and we sat at the table for over 15 minutes and no one had come to serve us. The response was "okay."
Subs are great!  This location has a drive thru which is amazing!!! And they have the best cookies ever. Need I say more?
I love going to chilies my favorite is there southwestern eggrolles they are so delicious.

The vault is a fantastic place to go in meridian, Idaho.  They have an amazing selection of boutique cigars, that you don't generally find in a normal cigar store.  The lounge has abundant comfortable seating with a very diverse clientele.  They have sodas beer and wine and TVs.  Hi there every time I'm in Idaho.

The restaurant ambiance was very nice and the wait staff were friendly, however the food wasn't as good as we hoped.  The food presentation was very nice, but The Avocado toast was cold, the bacon was undercooked and sausage skillet was cold and being in the cast iron skillet gave it a bad metal taste
I didn't know you had a drive thru!!! Amazing, quick & fast, not to mention, delicious experience overall today - TYSM!!!

I do not treat myself to a pedicure, as often as I would love to get one. Nor do I ever splurge and get a manicure too. I was feeling in a pampering kind of mood however, and thought why not?  Of the few nail salons I've visited, none have stood out as outstanding. Until now!!!  The overall look and feel of the salon was inviting, clean and well decorated. Cute little waiting area, very comfy massage chairs, and fun art deco bowls to soak your feet.  I did go all out and get a mani and a pedi. Two very nice ladies waited on me. One did my toes, while the other did my fingers. I was blown away at how meticulous they both were. Taking their time, inspecting their work, redoing areas they considered unacceptable. Not once did they try to up sell me! No do you want a flower, do you want sugar scrub, do you want your eyebrows waxed? They both gave awesome foot and hand massages, spending much more time than I expected. So nice!!! Honestly, a place like this really makes me reconsider my frequency to returning. This might just be my new monthly treat to myself!

Pricing:  I felt the price was reasonable.  And I think comparable to other salons.  $50 for mani with gel polish and pedi with regular polish

My wife and I just stumbled onto this place last night and really enjoyed it.  Her meal was great.  Everything cooked perfectly. My meal was great. Everything fresh and generous.  They have a great selection of local brews so I ordered a flight.  Pretty tasty.  Dessert was awesome too.  Walked away uncomfortably stuffed.

Best thing about this dining experience?  THE SERVICE!

Our server was on the ball.  She was really hustling...and I noticed.  

Bottom line?  Service was outstanding.  Food was great.  Patio dining was really nice.  Yes, we'll be coming back.

I would have given 5 stars because the servers are good and I really love the bread pudding, but I had to knock it down to 3 stars because I ordered a top sirloin and wanted it seared on top (I like things well done on the outside and juicy inside) but the chef would not do it.  It is unfortunate when chefs have a fixed mindset and only want to prepare a steak "medium rare" for everyone-- because that is the "proper" way to cook a steak. Yes, that is fine, but I still like my crispiness on the outside. And I am the one who is going to be eating it and not the chef-- so next time I will go to Corona Village for a good steak. They do it the way I like it, "right" or not!

The service was great. The food we ordered only about half our items were good. I ordered a roast beef dip that was completely inedible. The manager did remove it for our ticket which I was grateful for. Ordered a chicken sandwich at our table that was also not edible. The young one ordered the kids pizza. She said it tasted weird as well. This kid eats everything when it comes to pizza. Ahi nachos were good.

The most amazing people to work with! Absolutely friendly and most attentive to their renters. We moved from the mid west, Carly and Courtney were just so very helpful and understanding. They made a long and stressful move pleasant and we couldn't wait to be in our new home. Any concerns or questions we had they were quick to get us answers. I would absolutely recommend them to anyone looking to rent in the treasure valley. We can't say enough great things about this team.
Friendly service, Great food and drinks... wish there were some closer to where I live but worth the wait to visit when I'm in town

I went to Einstien's Oilery and thought they had changed my headlight for me.  During the following week I noticed it was still out.  I went back and they explained to me that they didn't carry that lightbulb so they didn't change it (a miscommunication on my part).  They told me that I would have to probably go to a dealership because it was a difficult thing to change.  I was a bit disappointed but understood.  While I was trying to figure out if I could get it done in the little amount of time I had that day, plus 2 little kids, he came back to my car.  John said "See that guy Cody over there?  He will change the headlight if you can go get the bulb".  I was so happy.  I went over got the bulb and came back.  They had it done in 5 minutes all with smiles and happiness.  This is why I will keep coming back.  Customer service that went way beyond my expectations.  Thank you John, Cody and the rest of the staff!

Our first time eating this pizza and it was from the new location at Eagle and Chinden Rd.  The crust was great and the flavor was good, but there were NO toppings. The "meat" pizza had a few meatballs and hardly any peperoni.  Little to no nutritional value unless you like bread.  The BBQ chicken pizza had barely a piece of chicken per slice and only ONE piece of the cheese.

Sadly, we will not go back.

A place that has 43 beers has got to have good food.  Reading other reviews I really wanted to like the Reuben sandwich.  The rainy afternoon started with a Stella and a Guinness.  Turkey sandwich and salad for the Mrs.   Thumbs up on the sandwich.  Thumbs down on the attractive salad because the fluffy greens they use are too hard to manage in the small bowl.  When the dressing is used, it just gets to be a mess.

The staff was helpful. energetic and engaging.  They knew a lot of the regulars.  We were treated to some samples of different styles of beer and really enjoyed the banter with the staff.  If we lived closer, this would be a good local hangout along with maybe Pauly's Bar Room.

The food came out really fast.  Perhaps too fast as would be seen as the meal progressed.

Sad to report that the huge Reuben was a disappointment.  The seasoned fries were great on flavor, but because they were thick cut, they got limp over the time it took to finish the sandwich.  Not good.  Thinner fries would hold up longer and the seasoning would work just as well with them.  Kudos for not pushing fry sauce on us.  The large slices of marbled rye bread were really toasted, perhaps too much.  It was definitely much stronger rye flavored bread than was necessary because it overpowered the other more delicate ingredients.  The corned beef was way too salty because the brine had not been completely cooked out of it.  The beef was extra chewy as well and slipped from the sandwich with every bite.  Further evidence of undercooking.  Perhaps this is normal, or maybe not, but it was unwelcomed in my sandwich.    The sauerkraut and swiss cheese (unmelted) were sparse making the entire affair an un-happy meal.

Try something other than the dinner salad, Rueben and the fries on the menu, if you go.  We would revisit for the beer and the very cool staff.

The food was unbelievable both times I ordered. First, the fried chicken from the Tokyo restaurant was the best chicken I have ever had. The meat fell perfectly off the bone. It's great food and you can try something different every time, which is great. Worth the try!

I have tried the Yardhouse twice now. Once during happy hour and once during lunch. Happy hour wasn't all that great if you ask me. The wine tasted old and the food was mediocre. For lunch I tried the mushroom pasta from the appetizer menu and it did have a good flavor, but my service was awful. I sat at the bar since I was alone and there were 3 servers/bartenders back there but they just couldn't seem to keep up or didn't care about service (which is strange when someone else brings you food). I honestly wouldn't waste my time going again when there are plenty of places for a good drink and better food.

The only thing decent about this place is the interior decorating. The lamps are cool, that's about it. The service is abysmal. The food is.. well I don't know where the owners of this place come from.. Oregon? Seattle? It's definitely not Spain and it shows. Despite the Spanish name I guess the food is more Mexican inspired? But it's trash. The salsa verde tasted rancid. My "carnitas" enchiladas  had a random piece of carne asada in it. Which leads me to believe there's a fair share of cross contamination going on in their kitchen too. Food was fast, but again, tasted bad. I would rather wait a little while and enjoy a well prepared meal, then end up regretting spending money on something I could do better myself at home.

I was not pleased with the front desk staff or with the chiropractor (Dr. Baxter). However, I really liked the massage therapist, Amanda. She was very professional and knowledgeable. Without the massage, I would have rated this 1 star. The receptionist told me she had checked with my insurance and there would be no charge for chiropractic visits because I had met my out of pocket limit (due to surgery this year). My insurance didn't cover the visit or the X-ray so I was left with the bill. At the initial evaluation I was presented with a "monthly plan" where I would pay over $200 per month. I tried not to laugh . . . I just wanted a spinal adjustment. I declined. There was no adjustment at the first appointment; I had to come back another day for that (probably so I could be charged for 2 visits). Then at the adjustment appointment, the chiropractor only used a tool on me rather than manual manipulation. I didn't feel like it did a thing. This was a big waste of time and money.

"Yay! I'm a fan," is right! I have been here on numerous occasions over the past few years, but was reminded of this place last month. A sweet lady at my gym and I got into a conversation about how I was avoiding gluten and dairy and how it made eating out a little bit less fun than it once was. A few days after this conversation, she showed up to class with a gift card to Blaze in hand (so kind)! She gave me the gift card and joyously shared with me, "They have a delicious gluten free crust AND vegan cheese that actually melts and tastes so good!".

After being on the receiving end of this random act of kindness, I decided to go put my gift card to good use. I came in here on a Friday night to grab a pizza to go. The line was super long and the place was packed to the brim with families. As I waited in line I noticed a sign that said you could pre-order online and then pop in to pick your order up (I know for next time!). After waiting in line just shy of ten minutes, I was able to walk alongside the glass barrier between myself and the employees who put the pizzas together, and customize my pizza!

I got a GF crust with GF sauce (yes, you need to specifically ask for GF sauce - gluten in pizza sauce? Who'da thunk it!), and vegan cheese. For toppings I got peppers of all sorts, pepperoni, sausage, jalapeños, oregano, s&p and a few other things that I can't quite recall right now. 

After paying for my pizza (right around $10), I waited for 5ish minutes and was on my way. Service was friendly and straight to the point. As far as atmosphere is concerned, I don't know that I'd be too keen on dining in here during a busy hour. There's just a lot going on. But given the chance to come here during a less packed hour, I think I'd stick around.

Went over for lunch today and I was excited to try it. Nice staff and a clean restaurant were both a nice greeting. I went with a smoked burger and some sweet potato fries. The food was good but nothing that blew me away. Meat was juicy, bun was okay (I would have preferred a thicker and bigger bun) and sweet potato fries seemed to be the typical frozen sweet potato fries. Some hand cut fries and a better bun would have made for a 5 star experience for me. All in all, good restaurant that I would recommend for bbq and will likely visit again

Well, we are veterans of using Artistic Tile and Granite.   Our family has used them three times now and we have had two homes with granite countertops in the kitchen from them.   The level of service from Artistic is unmatched!!  Both of our homes we have had kitchen countertops done turned out amazing!!   We just received new countertops at our new home today and I can't stress enough how impeccable the measurements were and how nice the end product is.   For instance, the spacing by the stove and the match of the grain in the one area we had a  seam was perfect.   Working with Charles and Mark has always been easy peasy and they respond to your questions in a timely manner which I can't say for other businesses.  We will have future work done by them  in our master bath next.   Wouldn't work with anyone else.  I wish I knew the names of the two gentleman that installed the counters today.  I can't remember, however, they were both excellent at their job and very professional as well.   Class act all around!!!!   Thank you again Artistic!!!

We moved here from the Seattle area, so we were so excited to see a familiar favorite here in Boise, The Matador!! The food is SO good, our favorites are the chips and salsa, brussel sprouts, fajitas, mahi, and enchiladas! Food quality is always great and so fresh, never greasy. Happy hour offerings are hard to beat! Best Mexican food option in the area, IMHO, and always our go-to for Mexican food! Hope you enjoy it as much as we do!

Seeing Karen W's review posted yesterday for Treasure Valley Closets reporting experiences that mirror ours with this company, if misery loves company she and I are going to be fast friends.  Because having TVC work on the bedroom and storage closets in our new home has been a litany of incorrect drawings, sloppy work, missed appointments, late show ups without the right materials, promises to return without meeting those promises and damage done to other parts of the house by one their installers.

This closet work should have been completed by August 1.  It wasn't and since then it has been the same litany of lousy follow up by TVC management as Karen W reports for her project too.  We are still waiting on some of the work to be completed.  And these guys were not our choice.  New to the area we knew nothing about them and they were part of the custom home build contract as the closet sub contractor used by the general contractor.  

 The owner of TVC seems a nice enough guy, actually, and has himself been on site a couple of times always with the excuse that things went south on this project because "we are just so busy".  Which makes me scratch my head that anyone would use them now that I know better.   But since Karen W and I both know better, the question is why didn't the builder of this home. And as P.S. here I'll offer up that our experience with the General Contractor, Tradewinds, was chock full of lousy management examples...maybe water seeks its' own level in Tradewinds choosing sub-contractors like Treasure Valley Closets.

We've been coming here for about a year now and the staff is always friendly and the food and drinks are great. Be sure to say hi to Megan, one of our favorite server's. Clean and safe during these COVID-19 times!

So delicious! Friendly service and amazing food! Perfect for a cold night!  yum! We ordered the butterfly shrimp, crab rangoon, mandarin chicken, orange chicken, creamy chicken ramen and miso shrimp ramen! Amazing! We will definitely be back!
Excellent aund good restaurants  good service Very a good price I  recommended this place for every one

Me and my best friend went here for lunch and their chicken Caesar Salad is great and really filling. Good price for it too, it's a little dark and the tables aren't really 6 feet apart but the servers wear their masks correctly which I appreciated. The hostess was very nice but when we left they did not say a single thing to us, they were talking.

Came in for a second time with my wife, to give R&R another try, after speaking with their extremely professional and friendly management team. We wanted to dine in, so that we could enjoy the food while piping hot, however our infant wanted us to eat at home, see we took our order to go. The staff was very friendly, and helpful, We ordered BBQ wings (bbq sauce) for appetizer, Brisket nachos for my wife, and I had the Rib tips with Garlic mashers. The bbq was served up quickly, and i was asked what bbq sauces i wanted and quantity. And, off we went home to drive in. 

The wings: I had these on my first visit, and they were absolutely delicious both times. I put on a little extra of their spicy bbq sauce, and had to stop myself from eating all of them so i would have room for the Rib Tips

The Rib Tips: similar to burnt ends for Brisket is what i was told, and after opening up my very healthy portion, was delighted that i took the suggestion. Great smoked flavor throughout, and lots of meat! I love the spicy BBQ sauce with these. The garlic mashers side were tasty as well, definitely smashed in the restaurant, and the flavor was great... do yourself a favor and have the gravy on them!

The Brisket Nachos: Holy moly were these freakin amazing!! Loaded up with lots of chopped brisket, tomatoes, sour cream, and queso cheese (which is thick and delicious) The chips were also fresh, which isn't easy to accomplish with nachos. My poor wife was slapping my hand after it kept making repeated trips into her nachos. Im definitely going to have these on my next visit.

I couldn't be happier that we came back tonight, my belly is full of delicious food, and theres still some leftovers for lunch! A special thanks to their General manager, Carlos, and the evening manager, Gina who made sure our visit was perfect. If you're looking for some great BBQ, do your mouth a favor, and stop by R&R!

I ordered my dinner online and it was a very easy process. I worried about ordering it online because I was afraid the food would be cold by the time I got it home.
