However, it was packaged perfectly so that my steak was still warm, the rolls were warm, and the salad was nice and crisp. I was very impressed with the ability to pull right up front and have somebody bring my food out to my car. If you want a great steak dinner at home, I highly recommend ordering it to go from Texas roadhouse.
A really solid vegan burger. My favourite out of the common fast food restaurants for a vegan burger. Also the crisscuts are nice albeit greasy.

Came in on a Friday night at about 7. There seemed to be a wait because there were a lot of people standing outside and sitting inside the waiting area but we got seated almost immediately.

Our waitress was great, she was really on top of it and checked in with us often. She was probably the best part of this restaurant, sadly.

Prepare yourself for an OILY oily oily meal. EVERYTHING we had was just dripping in oil and I had a raging stomach ache afterwards because of it. That alone takes it down a star because everything we ordered was consistently incredibly oily. 

The next reason why it's down another star is because the food is very "fine." It's maybe a hair better than average but at the PRICE, uh NO. Incredibly not worth it. I had the grilled cheese that was super oily, and the plating was SO unappetizing... I paid $11.95 for the sandwich plus $2 extra for Avocado... For $14 I expect that to be the best grilled cheese I've ever had and I was disappointed. 

Truffle fries were good, but again covered in an insane amount of oil. Price on these was actually fair, around $5.

Calamari was average. Dipping sauces were pretty mild, but not bad. My one complaint is that it could have been way crispier. Way too expensive for what you got, $11 for an appetizer?! And an average one at that?! 

Overall the price really just kills it because the food is fine, but you basically need to sell your soul to eat here. I will not be returning.

Great place, with good food and good service. Servers are super friendly We had the top sirloin and NY strip steak for lunch. Steaks were good. Service super friendly, the only reason for 4 stars and not 5 was the bar drinks were a bit pricey.

So tried it again tonight. Was super stoked they had added Omakase. Everything I read was ++ about the restaurant but was super sad to receive my order missing an entire 6 piece roll and cucumber salad. I was hoping to share it but there was only enough for me. I will say, I called and spoke to a wonderfully pleasant representative that provided me a $10 discount code. Sushi quality was good. I also understand that we are in Idaho and so, access to fresh fish is a little more challenging but not getting what I paid to get was pretty sad. Fortunately I'm full, it was good and they're making  it right but feel like they should adhere to what is being offered and if, given limitations of being in the PNW or whatever, make up for it some other way and advise the customer of the sub. I will try again. I'm a foodie from So. Cal so may be more critical than most but regardless, important points to call out. Their customer service is amazing and share a building with my office.

The place is new, and with Covid going on, I had to pick up the food and drive 20 minutes before I could eat it. That's going to take a little away from the moisture and flavor, but I took that into consideration for the review.  I'm a certified BBQ judge and have smoked a lot of meat on different pits, and eaten BBQ all over the world - even Texas. 
There was no smell of smoke outside the building, and no significant smoke flavor on the brisket or ribs, and just a little on the sausage.  There was a nice smoke ring on the sliced brisket, but it tasted like pot roast with a light beef flavor, a little dry (probably the delay), and the tenderness was ok.  The ribs were a little over cooked, and a little dry also.  The rub was good.  The sausage was pale, and looked more like boiled than smoked.  The flavor was ok, but had one spice that I couldn't identify that was too strong. The texture was a fine grain and the casing had a good snap.  The banana pudding was a little small for the money, and the flavor of the pudding was bland.  All of the portion sizes were reasonable, except the pudding.  I tried all 4 sauces.  The original was the best of the four, but not great. The Carolina was gritty and thin, and was the worst. 
At the pickup spot, the QR code sign is too low and the front of the car covers the sign when you park!  Need to raise  it up a couple of feet, and also put an R&R phone number on the sign, in case the QR reader on your customer's phone doesn't work. 
I'll give it another try. Maybe I hit a bad day.

Had a e-chat today with Betsy at the Meridian library ( Cherry Lane location) and she was very helpful with my issue. This was my first time chatting with a library person on e-chat; she was very professional and was able to find a solution to my issue. All 5 stars for this location!

Where to start with this one?
1. On the expensive side
2. The food just is not good 
3. Not a fan of the counter service (not a fan of counter service anywhere, I prefer sit down)

Just come down to the food and it's not good bbq.

My wife and I have been very cautious about restaurant dining during the pandemic.  We won't seat unless all staff member y are masked and seating enables six feet or greater separation.  We were pleased to see that this restaurant satisfied those, and more efforts (including staff friendliness, professionalism, and respect for social distancing.

Congratulations to the management and thanks for taking our community and your staff health seriously.

BTW... The flatbread and salad were fantastic

The front of the menu says WELCOME and they mean it. Owned by the same nice family as much loved Pueblo Lindo 'mothership' in McCall, this eatery is in remodeled space previously home to the defunct Souper Salad in a Meridian strip mall.  A little off the beaten path to see it from Eagle Road, you'll need to drive into the mall parking lot to find it.  (My husband and I have been driving by weekly since late September like raptors after prey waiting for it to open.) The same extensive menu as Pueblo Lindo McCall, good food and friendly service.  Setting expectations up front being important, I'll share they are in 'soft opening' mode now so expect some kinks in service and food timing and you'll be happier...or wait until they have the new place wrinkles ironed out. 

VIBE:  Bright interior colors, fun sculptural décor above and things like sombreros as wall decor.  Big windows at the front let in light but also lots of sun and they have thoughtfully provided sun shades to help with glare for those who choose a window table.  There are booths against walls and standard height tables with "woven barrel base" bottoms and chairs of similar design throughout.  The hitch-in-the-giddeup for this seating is one cannot put their feet under the table, feet are blocked by the barrel base, which means one is sitting a good way back from the table - even those of us with short legs like me (5'4") and hubby (5'7").  I imagine this might be even more awkward for taller people with longer legs. 

SERVICE:  Today (12/4/18) is the first full day of operation (they opened with dinner on 12/3) and there clearly are opportunities for service staff training for a couple of folks on diner care (as in following up after food is delivered and when there are long waits between order and food to table) and process delays to work out for food coming out of the kitchen.  No worries as this is expected in what is their 'soft opening' window.  That's what this period is for - to work things out.

And I say 'gracias' to whomever hired the skilled and adorable (those dimples!) Orlando, who worked at one of the nearby competitors before being hired to train at PL in McCall and come back to Meridian.  He has a natural instinct for diner care and he was also helping his teammates.  As diners we appreciated the work of all of them.

MENU & FOOD:  Another Yelper posted very good menu photos so you'll find options and price points there.  We ordered our favorites from the McCall location from Pueblo Lindo's lunch menu (fresh spinach enchiladas for him and pollo en mole for me) to compare apples to apples for the two kitchens.  We thought the food at this new location was equally as good and maybe even better than the McCall location as this kitchen seemed more expert in restraint for salt.  And the whole beans (as option to the also good refried) were particularly good here.

All is house made. (Except maybe the tortillas.)  And the salsa is delicious for our taste-buds for being spicy and chunky with white onion, scallions and tomatoes incorporated.  I regret I didn't ask for a spoon to eat it without the need for chips calories included!  (Although the chips are very good too.)

LIBATIONS: As with McCall, options are soft drinks, a small selection of wine or beer and pre-bottled Margaritas.  We chose water here, served in tall glasses with ice and a pitcher for refills set on the table.

VALUE:  Two diners well fed with just-big-enough-but-not-too-much sized lunch entrees + one flan = $23

ACCESSIBLITY:  ADA parking in associated lot.  Level in the door and all on one level.  Standard height seating but at barrel bottom tables that would not allow a wheelchair user to get up to them.  Didn't check Loo.

NEIGHBORS:  For location notes - Pho 779 is on the right and Hot Spot Café on the left.

I just happen to find this sweet little spot in Meridian Idaho which is just right outside of Boise Idaho. There is ample parking in front of the restaurant. The staff was very friendly and attentive to the customer. The menu is filled with delicious food options. I had the  tonkotsu ramen, which had a rich and creamy broth firm noodles delicious pork, and one soft boiled egg. The entire dish was filling and flavorful. To my surprise they have only been open for 4 months,  but the quality of their food indicates that they've been making this type of food for many years. So if you're in Boise for the surrounding area and you're looking for some good traditional Ramen this is your place
This place is ALWAYS out of something. I'd call ahead and make sure they have the specific bbq item you're wanting. "The ribs will Be done in about 3 hours" lol really?
Do not order pulled pork on your salad. It ruined our salad. I'd love to come back and try something else. The pork was very mushy under cooked .

We went here because it was #1 on yelp but was super below average, not to mention the bowls were 1/3 of the way full and the boba tasted like water and you couldn't even chew through the tapioca so we didn't even drink it, we both got super sick after eating the poke bowls, 10/10 do NOT recommend :((

I really like the food here.  The folks that work here are really nice too.  The only thing I would change ( which is why it's 4 stars instead of 5) is the noise level.  The music can be turned down a bit so we can hear each other talk without yelling.

I've ordered takeout here 6 or 7 times in the last year or so.
Food has been mediocre , the woman up front NEVER says THANK YOU or YOUR WELCOME....answers the phone with a simple "hello" 
I just feel that there should be some appreciation shown. 
I've never post a review about this place before because it's family owned .
Today I ordered and the chicken was spoiled.  I think they know it's going bad and try to get away with it.  Didn't want to deal with her so I just threw it away.
I will not order from here again.
If she was more appreciated of my business I would deal with an occasional spoilage or mess up.

It's been a long hard day. It's one of those days where you aren't in the mood to cook so ordering food online is your guilty pleasure for the day. So I call noodles and co to place an order for a Buffalo chicken Mac. Simple order. No special requests or anything. And what ends up happening? No chicken. How do you forget the chicken? And of course this order is to go so I don't see this mistake until my long drive home. It's a lesson learned today. Just avoid this establishment.
Stopped off with some BFF's for brunch and Bloody Mary's so yummy! It was almost to loud to visit but it's the right atmosphere for that. I would deff recommend this stop

Crave in Meridian is absolutely delicious. My family had a selection of a few of the concepts, our favorites being MacnQue and BuddhaBowl by Mina, big flavors and fantastic ribs and mac. The food showed up fast, hot and came in beautiful packaging. Top quality. Tony G's pizza was incredible. The Chicago style pizza was one of the best I've ever had delivered. I have a big family and everyone was raving about dinner tonight. Cheers Crave!!

If I could do a 0 I would. We pulled up to get lunch. The open sign wasn't even on and it should have been. The two young boys were standing in the lobby eating chips and VAPING. VAPING IN THE MIDDLE OF THE STORE. We couldn't believe it, we will not return.

12/20/21 - there are only 2 employees working the store tonight. My order was delivered 30 minutes early and incomplete. Not to mention the fact that my pizzas were delivered uncut, when I specifically ordered them to be cut.

I called the store, and the gentleman that answered apologized profusely. He then took charge of the situation, got my 3rd pizza sent out to me and even sent a pizza cutter for free.

Shame on the corporate people at Chicago Connection for letting your store get like this. But a huge round of applause for the few guys working tonight. They went above and beyond when the odds were against them. I sincerely hope someone reads this and rewards the employees working tonight. Bravo.

One of our favorite places to dine with kids. I wouldn't say the atmosphere is overwhelming as far as sound but it's nice with kids not worrying about them being loud or interupting the surrounding tables because the atmosphere is already loud. The food is great especially for the pay. I love that they give you bread the instant you sit down. 

We love this location you can tell the msnagement at this establishment has invested in giving outstanding service. We saw the difference when we stepped into another Texas Roadhouse and the same inviting atmosphere was lacking. 

Also with my husband and I slowly aiming toward a keto diet this seems to be one place we frequent to stay on track. Even though the bread is tempting, we munch on the peanuts and order steaks.

Love the variety of drink options and their Happy Hour menu is top notch. 

At my last visit, I ordered a Lost Coast (northwest pale ale) and their Chicken Nachos during Happy Hour and got this enormous platter! Couldn't quite finish the whole thing but left extremely satisfied and with a happy belly. 

In my experience, this place has been a hit or miss which makes it hard for me to give it an objective overall review. Some of my visits have been amazing: the customer service has been on point, food comes out by the time I'm done laughing at the first joke at the table, and the meal is a solid ten. But then I've also had mediocre service to go along with semi undesirable food. 

Their dim lighting builds great ambience which is perhaps why this is a popular spot to meet up with friends and family. Meal hours are super busy and a wait can be as long as an hour long. Watch out for the post-movie rush particularly during the premiere of popular movies (Made this mistake once and learned from it). 

Recommend folks visit during their Happy Hour and enjoy a cold brew.

We went here on a Saturday evening to celebrate my friend's birthday. Line was fairly long; we had to wait for 30 minutes to get a seat. But the wait was worth it.

As appetizer, we ordered fried calamari with spicy tomato sauce and roasted jalapeño tartar. I thought it tasted bland. I ordered one of their House favorites, Southern fried chicken breast with creamed corn, bbq beans, spinach mashed potatoes, and bourbon gravy. It was bomb! The boneless chicken was tasty, and I loved the creamed corn in particular. My friend ordered seared ahi steak sandwich with arugula, tomatoes, caramelized onions, peppercorn aïoli, grilled rye, and fries. I took a small slice and I thought it was delectable.

And because it was my friend's birthday, we got a free creme brûlée! We also got 2 free cocktails. Servers were attentive. Overall, a great dining experience! Will be back for sure.

Very extensive selection of options to create your customized bowl. All ingredients seemed to be very fresh. They also offer tortillas to make a wrap. There was a suggestion menu to help those that lack creativity. Atmosphere was comfortable and clean. Our server was friendly and helpful. Also very kid friendly.

Downfalls:
Pricey and no option to get just the bowl and no salad bar.
Bowl so small, hard to get all toppings in, unless you put a very small amount of each topping.  It's unlimited trips, so you can go back multiple times.
No hand sanitizer before entering food area. That's a lot of people all touching the same tongs, kinda gross if you ask me.

We've been going to Homestead for 2 years now, minus the COVID lockdown. Staff is friendly, food is fresh, hot, huge portions, and great! Josh will fix your purr fect drink! This is a neighborhood place, so expect hometown vibes.
The broth is awesome and the service was fantastic, but you need to know the noodles are just packaged noodles.

Food was great. Very fair prices.  Had a combo plate of enchilada and tamale. Both excellent. The beans were very creamy and excellent. Salsa was spot on. Food came out quick. Server was terrific. Had cute decor inside too. I will definitely eat here again.

Can I give a restaurant 0 stars? If I could, this would be the one. We were at Village at Meridian for the afternoon and wanted to get some appetizers to eat outside. We looked at reviews for places around and decided to go to yard house to get 2 ceaser salads, 1 order of chicken strips, fries and 4 sliders...  We ordered the food and were told about 20-30 minutes... which was ok even though there was almost nobody in the restaurant. They told us they will call when it's ready. After 45 minutes and no phone call we went back inside to check on the order and the waiter at the front only had the chicken strips ready. Since we had a hungry toddler we said she can give us the strips and we will wait for the other items... about 15 min later...still no food so I ask her to go check on our order. She came back with out food so I took it went outside... when we check, there's only one ceaser salad so I went back and told her we ordered two salads. At that point she tells us the salad was in the bag with the chicken strips... no it wasn't. I even told her that earlier she told me that the only thing that was ready was the strips... so she says "oh ya ur right" and then goes in the back for another 10 min and comes back with the salad.  In total we waited almost 1.5 hrs for our food. By the end, I wasn't even hungry, just annoyed at the service.  The food wasn't even that good. Decent but nothing special. Don't go here if u wanna wait 2 hrs for a ceaser salad.
Can be hard to hear because it's very loud & busy but I did like environment & decor. Nice servers & great menu

Heard rave reviews and I was left very disappointed with an expensive meal. 
Ordered thru doordash and was missing one bowl of Mac n cheese which doordash gave me credit for. The bowl was the size of a cup at any other restaurant so not sure if this was also a mixup or if this was truly their bowl size.
The taste was nothing to be excited about. I've had better from a box as sad as that is.
I got the steak and cheese so like a philly. Tasted and looked like mayo on it, no flavor at all from the meat or veggies. VERY bland ate 6 bites and saving the rest. Will only eat because of the price which was double the price of subway.

Reason this gets 2 stars is because my husband also got a sandwich and he said it was good. His was the Italian and he liked it more than the Wendy's Italian.

Sad this wasn't a great experience as I've heard about and their rating seems to give them on doordash.

Puppyland should be shutdown not only for public scamming but for the neglect of its puppies. 4-5 puppies are kept in small cages, of which there are about 6 in a small room. They also keep large breed dogs in pens too small for the animals to turn around in. They do not allow cameras in the store for a reason. The puppies are kept in these cages 24/7 with feces and food scattered around. They are scamming the public by charging $4,000+ for mixed breed animals they pass off as fullbred ( none are registered with a reputable agency) and offer payments for people who can't afford this? I called Animal Control and they said they have been contacted many times over this place. Puppyland claims to not be a puppy mill, but in an ongoing lawsuit against them, it was proven that they receive their puppies from JAX puppy mill in IA. I witnessed a new batch of puppies come in from an unmarked van and the whole store had to shutdown (suspicious) and the workers had syringes of appetite stimulant waiting for these poor animals. Not only that but many puppies have had serious health problems from that store and the workers are very pushy and rude to boot. I can't believe puppy mills are still allowed to operate this way.
Just not going to restaurants lately.  Poor service and food sub standard at most places
Came hungry, left stuffed....always a fun place with good food and awesome service!!!!  5 stars!!

Wow, did I just get a lousy attitude. Some days I can walk into this store and give them 5 stars. Today I dealt with Isaac in returns. Today was a 1 star day. I bought a crappy product I now have to spend my time returning and I have to deal with your attitude. Grow up. If you don't like your job get another one.

My husband and I have ordered from Crave Delivery a few times. We love that we can mix and match different types of cuisines and try new restaurant easily. We've always liked our food, but especially love everything we've had from Rock House Sliders. The buffalo maple chicken strips are to die for if you love SPICY food. But, what really sets Crave apart is their customer experience. We placed an order yesterday only to have them quickly call and say they were out of one of the main items we had ordered and were very sorry for the inconvenience. We completely understood, but ended up canceling the order because that was the main thing we wanted. Within 20 minutes, they had called back and said they felt so bad, they were going to send out our exact order today free of charge. We were blown away. They didn't have to do that, but they turned what could have been seen to some as a bad experience it something fantastic. We can't say enough how much we appreciate when a businesses goes above and beyond and that's exactly what Crave did.

Headed out for a night of shopping and a quick dinner first.  I 'Yelped' hamburgers and this place came up.  We were not disappointed!  The burgers are large with great toppings and a good bun.  The only thing that wasn't perfect was that the burger was a little too overdone and dry.  A juicier burger would have been better.  The fries were awesome!  I am not used to fry sauce so had to ask for ketchup.   
I was expecting this restaurant to smell greasy as most small fried food places do.  Nice surprise,  no fried greasy smell!  Big plus in my book.
We will be back!

Dearth of diners at weekday high-noon and spare space momentarily led us to think we had arrived at take-out place not the full service Chinese food restaurant we were looking for.  We u-turned to leave just as a friendly young woman emerged from behind kitchen doors to invite us in.  Aroma of garlic hitting hot wok and the cadence of happy male voices speaking Chinese in the kitchen along with her warm greeting were like magnets to draw us to a table.  We stayed to enjoy really good food and delightful service. My benchmark for Chinese food in the Treasure Valley for the complete package of food-service-ambiance is Red Pavilion in South Meridian.  But food dishes at this North Meridian located family run eatery puts them in competition for 'best in area" based on our first visit and service here can't be beat. If you read only this far, here's the bottom line: try Wok Fusion.  We are eager to go again.  Details follow.

BIG MENU / REASONABLE PRICES:  Multi page and mostly options expected on an Americanized Chinese food menu, there are also more authentic dishes too.  Divided into appetizers - soup - noodles - vegetables - pork - beef - chicken - seafood dishes.  Prices for entrees range from roughly $10 to $13.50  with soup and appetizers ranging from about $4 to $8.  If you like combination plates, there are about ten options for those listed on the back of the menu in the "your choice with soup and rice" and then option for egg roll added for as little as $8 - $10 total.  Since the same menu is used for lunch and dinner, you can order the low priced combos either meal if that's your thing. 

GREAT FOOD:  We chose Spicy Five Spice Tofu with Pork stir fry with Chinese black beans and veggies and also a stand-by for us when trying a new place, mu-shu vegetable.  The flavors for both dishes were delicious even if the tofu dish was not spicy by our standards.  The young man who is lead cook in the kitchen hails from Canton region of China and Cantonese style is not the hot and spicy of Hunan or Sichuan regions.  So in a kitchen with a cook from Canton, set expectations for even spicy options to still be more tame.

We were impressed with the knife skills of the cooks, there were two in the kitchen on the day we visited,  given the vegetables in both dishes and tofu and pork were expertly cut. The charming server told us that as young as the lead cook is, he has twenty years experience a professional kitchen. It shows because we also appreciated that the vegetables in the stir fry were cooked "just so" for the perfect still toothsome bite and that the dish used limited oil and sauce.  So many Americanized Chinese food restaurants drown the food in sauce or in oil.  (Even Red Pavilion sometimes does the latter.)  My husband remarked, as high praise, that the flavor of every single component in the stir fry dish and mu-shu was evident.  The tofu in the stir-fry was some of the best we've had.

Portions are more than ample and we had take away for another meal at home.  To illustrate how good was the food, we transferred every remaining morsel into the take away Styrofoam containers we were given.  

STELLAR SERVICE:  Delightfully perfect!

WELCOMING VIBE:  Minimalist interior is welcoming if spare.  Plain tables and dark chairs with vinyl upholstered seats, light and bright from surrounding windows that look out on the parking lots of the strip mall where this is located, it is sparking clean (including the loo) with pride of ownership evident.  Opposing walls are sort of mango and lime colors.  Festive Chinese style red lanterns and cute pendant lights both hang from the ceiling.  And here for us was a big "yahoo"...no music!  Just the cadence of the cooks talking in Chinese.  That is music to our ears!

GOOD ACCESSIBILITY:  ADA parking in lot.  Level in the door. All on one floor.  Ample space to get to tables and all seating is standard height.  Loo is accessible too.

LOCATION / PARKING:  In one of Meridian's many small, new-ish, awkward non-descript strip malls.  This a newer one has a small parking lot.  Neighbors are a nail salon and State liquor store.

This is my go to place when I'm town which is quite frequent lately.  Starting with the beer menu, which is linked to the Untappd app.  Always a top of the line highly rated IPA on draft and that is very important to me. And the food is about average bar food but I come for the beer and atmosphere and chill vibe
Great atmosphere and delicious food!  Started with the queso dip and went on to my delicious NY strip. Service was friendly and fast. Everyone was so nice and the meal was amazing!

UPDATE:
Malcom the GM reached out to me and made it right. He invited me back to try the steak for a second time and everything was great. Thank you for showing my wife and I a good time!

I love this Hallmark Store! It's everything "Hallmark!" Cute nick-nacks, gifts, candles, all kinds of goodies and, of course, cards! I've never had a problem here. I have always found what I went in there for. I'm so glad they're here!
These places still exist? Disgusting. Animals deserve MUCH better. Close down already.

By far the best car wash in Meridian.  The equipment works well, the prices are reasonable and the self serve area is the best.  Clean towels, working vacuums and mat cleaners, window cleaning spray bottles.
These guys were great! Prompt and awesome! I will definitely use them again. They were super nice and thoughtful with all of our stuff

I walked into this store on a Wednesday afternoon with the intention of buying $5000 worth of equipment and opening a new account. There were no other customers in the store. Two employees were at the computers and barely acknowledged my presence. After asking a couple of questions of the employee from across the store and receiving short, uninterested responses it was apparent they weren't interested in my business.

I see walmart as a necessary evil... their prices are so low that my budget cries a little if I go somewhere else for some things. Like childrens' clothing and shoes- they outgrow things so quickly that it makes sense to get the basics cheaply at walmart. Some basic food stuffs are crazy cheap, and some things are better to get at Winco or Freddies. 

This one, and the Nampa location, always seem to be much cleaner and well organized- as opposed to the Overland location, which is typically trashed. 

They have surprisingly good produce, but I have been unimpressed with the meat and the bakery departments. 

Still, I don't care for the way I've seen the employees treated- I've seen them berated publicly by managers, which is just rude and uncalled for. 

Necessary evil...

ordered a 10 ounce sirloin, wanted the temperature to be medium but got a super bloody and raw steak. Called and was told the manager would be calling us back but never did super disappointed because this is one of our favorite places. Don't order to go

Stopped by pueblo lindo on my way home, hoping to grab some decent chile verde. Upon arriving home and opening my meal, i saw chile con shite and nothing remotely resembling a verde sauce. Their hot sauce was good, but the meal registers as a major negative. Never again, i suggest you steer clear a well
Thank you 4 great service, food, drinks & making it easy 2 entertain my boys B4 a feast! I forgot how awesome the dinner rolls are. Yum!!!

Been here several times, not sure how missed writing a review! 

We've never been here for $1 sushi.

ACCESSIBILITY: Not very good for wheelchair or scooter users once it starts filling up. Everyone needs to get out of their chairs for you to get by. 

Came in on a Tuesday for Happy Hour just after 5:00. Sat on the patio despite the heat! It was a warm one but they have good shade and misters. 

So we check out the happy hour menu (I'm the Queen of Happy Hour!) and much to our surprise, happy hour ends at 5:00! Really??? Who in Boise has a happy hour that ends at 5:00??? Ummm...  no one! It's always 6:00 or even 7:00.

Fortunately our server Kristin was awesome!  She was very attentive! The drinks were good and we ordered the nachos which were ok. The chips were under the broiler or whatever a little too long and the salsa is more like water with tomatoes and cilantro. $8.99 regular price or $4.99 if you make it in time for happy hour. 

When the misters came  on it was more of a shower than a mist so if you don't mind being very wet, then they're nice in the heat. 

Other than the early happy hour it was fine but we most likely won't be back because of that.

FYI Homestead: https://gooutlocal.com/listing-category/happy-hour/

Nowhere to be found just a bunch of kids working 
The owner or corporate should be ashamed !!!!!!!!!!!
I called to complain and heard kids laughing 
Because I was making a complaint 
Krispy Kreme I'm done wasting my time with you it's unfortunate because we do love the donuts!!!!!!!!

I LOVE hobby lobby and today I literally don't want to shop there ever again. The carts are not that big (not their fault) so if your wanting to get a bunch of stuff you have to make a couple trips. I went to the back of the store where the lamps were and decided I wanted about 3 lamps and 2 vases much more than the cart could carry. So I decided to try and push the cart and carry two lamps. Store on Eagle Road in Meridian.

OVERRATED! This was my first time at Jakers. I made reservations and arrived 10 minutes before. When we walked in there were several guests just standing around near the host stand with no host in sight. It was 5 minutes later 1 of 3 hosts decided to stop wiping down menus while another was running around the entire restaurant like she was trying out for a marathon - no joke. After finally getting sat 20 minutes later we were approached by the waiter who couldn't have been more rude. Maybe it was because we did not order alcohol? The waiter was so unfriendly and rude. The food was bland, dry and very over priced. I can go on and on but I am not going to waste any more of my time talking about how terrible things were. We will never go back!

I always stop in here for happy hour in to meet friends when I'm in town, try to make a reservation as there was going to be 12 to 14 people, we said we couldn't so we should arrive early for happy hour which was 4 to 6. Got there at 3:45 PM but then they took my name and number and said they would page me when a table was ready but they had open tables? I refused to leave and waited and said nope I want a table now you just told me to come in early. So finally we got seated after quite a wait. We couldn't have more than 6 people to a table even though we were all together so we were separated at a booth or table and around the fire pit by the bar and still manage to at least visit and connect with each other. The service was pretty crappy it took a really long time for the drinks and the food to come. I ordered chicken tortilla soup which was cold and the mini tacos were so covered in sauce that you could not even pick them up and eat them with your fingers. Even though we had three separate parties they still got the checks mixed up and I ended up paying for other peoples food. We had one extra guest  come and they said they could not sit with us! they even went to the manager and asked and they said absolutely not no more than six people., Then a group came in for prom and they had seven people and they let them sit at a table? Why do you some customers get to break the rules and others do not. Some customers came in not even wearing masks at all nobody said anything, most of the staff was wearing masks however.The food really didn't taste that good the mango margarita was probably the highlight of the evening

I love this place their chips and salsa are not good at all but I order their chicken enchiladas with the salsa verde with corn tortillas black beans and a delicious strawberry margarita and I die happy every time best food coma of your life!

We understand that it's a struggle to get people to work, but when it's the busiest day of the week (bogo) you would expect there would be more then two servers on. we were told the wait would be an hour, so we waited an hour. there was seven of us and asked us if we wanted a booth. extremely uncomfortable just for six people, very unprofessional. we went in to talk to talk to the host and we asked very politely for a table, they then explained that we had to wait another hour for a table because they only had TWO TABLES OPEN. there are seven bigger people and you asked if a booth would work? like use your brain a little bit.

This Pizzeria is not your typical pizza parlor. It is a self serving "sandwich shop" style which helps the customer pick the perfect pizza. If you're looking for a filling pizza place and in the mood for some Italian cuisine this is your place! Line may get long so arrive early. The only down side was the name calling for the pizza. They aren't very loud so listen closely.

Food is delicious. We have had different  several ramen that were excellent. Hubby had yakisoba and it was excellent. 
Very clean. The wait staff is so nice and accommodating. We will be back!

I have mixed emotions about this place to be honest....all the hype was surrounding the "famous  bloody mary's"....and although it was fun to have a slider, chilli, chicken wings, a pretzel and a beer back all perched a top the glass....unfortunately the pretzel was the best part. The bloody mary mix fell SUPER SHORT. I was with a table of 4 and everyone felt the exact same. Honestly,  I was pretty bummed. 
Now in a good note...the atmosphere was great, neighborhood sports bar vibe and a good place to watch the game. The food was good, with generous portions (pub food), but it didn't disappoint. There is a full bar, so maybe skip the bloody mary and get another cocktail instead. I would say a solid 3 stars, and I would come back again.

I came into plant therapy a few weeks ago just wanting to check everything out... I recently listened to a podcast about the company and learned a lot about their business model. I normally use doTERRA oils and figured that there was nothing better out on the market. I wasn't really planning on buying anything.

When I looked in the plant therapy I automatically thought their quality wasn't as good as doTERRA until I did research... The company is very transparent with their GCMS testing which basically gives the customer an inside look into the quality of the oil's. Everything matches up and it is great quality. They are lower cost than doTERRA and Young living because they don't have to pay anyone inside of their multi level marketing pyramid. Let me add their quality is just as good if not better than both doTERRA and Young living. What's even better is it's local so I can drive right in and get the oils when I run out and I don't have to order or wait for shipment to come to my door... And I don't have to sign up and pay a monthly cost just Get a lower cost... Because the oil are already a lower cost.

I don't work for the company so just throwing that out there! If you are interested in the podcast I listen - see my screen shot.

Lunch before the Tuesday El Cheapo movie. Pretty expensive for a lunch, Cocoanut shrimp was $13 for three butterflied shrimp. Soup and salad for the wife was almost $11. Final bill w/o tip was short of $49. Food was tasty,but I think we'll pass the next time we do the movies there.
Great service and amazing food! Will definitely be back! Thanks, daniel for the great experience!

Wow. This place has great ribs. Lots of meat that's nice and juicy.   Very casual dinning. You Walk in, place your order and sit dow and wait, but not long. The rib seasoning it really good even without adding any sauce, but three different sauces are available, Original, Carolina and Spicy. The Original is a little on the spicy side as it is. The Spicy starts out sweet, then the heat hits your tongue. Carolina is watery, but that's the way it's supposed to be. Had both their regular and sweet potato fries, both are very good. If you have a hankering for some rib, this is the place to go.

Really bad experience with this company. They came out 3 times for the same refrigerator. First 2 visits for the same heater (had to pay both times even though the second visit was from bad workmanship from the first) and 3rd for something they aren't even sure about and didnt provide photos for. Never use these guys.

The hostess was pleasant, food was good, but, service was less than desirable. Menu is focused around meat, no silverware and we had to wait, for the server to come back. Her reaction? Wow really? Place could serve up the best steaks, ribs etc. but it won't matter if one leaves the restaurant thinking about crappy service instead of the meal.

All the puppies seem to be drugged out of their minds. Even shaking most of them they don't wake up. Really suspicious. It's devastating. They keep the big dogs in the tiny cages and they are begging to come out. Unbelievable should be shut down immediately.

Very nice people. Tasty food. Clean restaurant and prompt service. Everybody is so nice and they really make you feel at home. I really enjoyed my dinner and the service!!! I had a chile relleno snd tamale.

SERIOUSLY....were did this come from? And i mean that in a good way. : )
This by far is one of the valley's best kept secrets. My girlfriend and I were in Meridian today and hungry, so i was lookin on yelp for places to eat and found Kahootz....Thank You Yelpers. Wonderful little steak n ale house!!!.....we started off w/ the queso cheese dip.....holy crap!!! I thought my mom had come back from the dead to make their cheese sauce with jalepeno, onion n tomatoes in it, it was that good!!! I had the chicken marsala ( i was lil hesitant at first to try it because every place that i have tried chicken marsala around Boise.....straght up SUCKED!) The pic of the bread pudding n the mile high mud pie.....if you can't tell the sheer magnitude of these by the pics. Just kidding, we won't be shopping there again. 0 stars. Learn to treat your customers better. They are the reason your store exists.

judge called their contract deceptive, and the State AG is now demanding changes due to at least one illegal provision where they try to prevent you from posting anything negative about their company.

3 stars because the service was great. Food was okay, I will say best Chinese food I've had in Idaho but that's not saying much. Super expensive though. I won't go back. Rather just eat Chinese food when visiting family in California

She told me to "let the color grow on me" and said after a wash or two the hair will feel healthier and sent me on my way. I reached out a few times in the next couple days trying to at least get the color corrected and never heard back. I now know I could've been refunded the $600+ I spent just on the hair extensions alone within 7 days after they were put in had the stylist told me the refunding process when I voiced multiple times how unhappy I was. I reached out to the stylist who started the hair extension brand (Rose and B) they used and she pretty much said sorry but no refund even though you were and still are unhappy and the other stylist didn't tell you what our refunding process when you had them put in. So I spent $600+ on hair that I absolutely hate

This place is great. I have been for happy hour, dinner and lunch, yes I am a fan.  The appetizers are always delicious, portions are plenty and they have a fabulous side salad and garlic dressing, oh yes, bring me the dressing. Service is always awesome and they definitely keep an eye on your table so if you need another beer or cocktail the servers are on it, I appreciate that.
Crème Brûlée !!! I can't get enough! Definitely a MUST try dessert! Dinner was and always is amazing. Nice quiet environment

We've always loved this place, especially the patio in the warm months. The food and service was great yesterday. Love the Mac and cheese!!! My bf was happy that they had local ciders as he's not a beer or wine person. But..... the patio, deck, tables and chairs were filthy! Not like a wind storm with leaves and some dirt but months if not years of neglect. Sticky & greasy. A good hot, soapy pressure wash would go a long way!! And.... If it's filthy in the outside, the inside is probably similar. I'll go back but will only stay if it's been cleaned. Ick!!

Went for dinner on Tuesday night. Service slow. Had their 8 oz ribeye special. Food was excellent! Cooked perfectly with fresh asparagus and potatoes.
$13.95. Brought friends the next week.  Friend loved her salmon special. Steak not as good but tried the baked artichoke app and it was awesome!! Service was very good.
We got a half order of bread pudding and 4 spoons. Served with vanilla ice cream and bubbling caramel sauce! AWESOME!
Donuts are well known, but I've learned a valuable lesson about this location....open the box and check it before leaving.  It's a bummer to get home with a dozen of the wrong item.
Great place to eat when you don't want to cook, love everything about this place, waitstaff is very friendly

Oh man this place is nice!! I have followed these folks online for over a year before I found my self at their door step. Walked in to a nice lounge of guys watching the game and chatting. Was shown to the humidor and got a few tips from the nice guy as it has been a while since I have been in a real deal cigar shop. Sadly I could not spend time with them that day, but I was able to pick up some great sticks. The guy was nice enough to throw me a empty box to trans port my good back home. And being that it is a 9 hour drive I was grateful for his kindness. If you lien cigar, and drinks, you should be here.

Having just moved to Boise we didnthave much in the fridge and looking thru endless boxes for pits and pans seemed tedious so we decided to try a take out place that fit both my husband and myselfs cravings. I wanted a delicious salad and he of course a burger and fries. So I sent him here to grab a taco salad for myself and he got himself a double cheeseburger and tots. My salad was really good especially for a takeout joint. There was a good amount of beef and the lettuce was fresh. My husband was pleased with his selection as well and said that the burger was awesome. My one year old seemed to really enjoy the tots as well. Will definitely come back!

Only one cashier was open.  The line stretched all the way down the isle.
11 cash registers were closed.
Seriously?
I won't be back to this worn out store.

Don't waste your time. Service is mediocre at best. Our food lacked flavor, as in we wouldn't feed it to our dogs, and came out luke warm. When we mentioned this to the waitress the only response we got was, "okay." We paid $87 of our hard earned money for our food to get thrown away. No thanks, never again. Do yourself a favor and find a REAL sushi or Japanese steakhouse because this ain't it.

My wife and I had The team at Positive Pets dog training train my personal mobility assistance dog Jade. I love how they provided us with weekly video updates and pictures. In addition to the videos and really appreciated the private one on one follow up lessons. I soon learned how important they were. When Jade came home she started to fall back into her old habits, as soon as I called Devin he walked me step by step through what to do. The client aftercare they provide is nothing short of amazing. I highly recommend Devin, Britta and their team. Thank you again from an old Marine.

I am so happy to have found this place! I had given up hope of finding good Mexican food in Idaho.. and this place is a breath of fresh air compared to the other restaurants around here. Every thing tastes really fresh (I liked the salsa verde the best) and the chicken they use tastes as though its been roasted which is awesome. My whole family enjoyed it, we will definitely return!

Pueblo Lindo serves up Mexican recipes from the very awesome state of Jalisco. 

When you arrive you are greeted by friendly staff that bring out water, chips and salsa. The chips were warm and crispy and the salsa was delicious. 

I had Pozole. It was yummy. Extra kudos because they had no problem with my dietary request. 

They have cute Jalisco decor and play Mexican tunes.
Prices are reasonable. Overall a great dining experience. I highly recommend.
Great experience as always. I am 16 and have been going to Dental Care for Kids for 5 years. I have never had a complaint. They are friendly, caring, and thorough.

Came in for late lunch so it was pretty empty and they were able to sit us down quickly. The waitress was nice but the service was slowwwww.
I ordered the BBQ bacon cheeseburger and my associate ordered the Hawaiian pizza. It took about 40min to receive our meal in a near empty restaurant. We ended up with empty glasses for 5-10min waiting for drink refills. When the food finally came out my burger was good but cooked more well than I asked for.
I have ate at other yard houses through your the country and this one had the slowest service by far.

I was called to pick up jewelry findings that I had ordered through the Oklahoma home office. I had called to complain about the manager, Richard, and his really horrible attitude. Tamara, the customer service representative, apologized for his bad behavior and took my order over the phone. I was called to say it was ready. I arrived, 2 managers, including Richard, had no idea what I was talking about and I left the store empty handed after travelling 120 miles round trip. I never heard from them again. Period. Now I read their CEO is collecting artifacts that do not belong to him. Hey kids, thats called stealing and according to some religious beliefs, thats a sin. They owe me the gas I spent in vain. So Richard, Tamara, and Mr. CEO, I would consider all your behaviors in business to be nowhere near the standards of a self-endorsed evangical platform for business in the USA.

The regular entrees seemed a little pricey for lunch until I saw a lunch menu that seemed more reasonable. I got the sweet and sour pork with a cup of soup, egg roll, rice, and drink. Everything was REALLY GOOD!

Wow!  These guys are the real deal.  On time, did what they said they would do for the price they quoted, and they cleaned up after themselves!
My wife and I would highly recommend All Valley for appliance installation.

Just ate here for the first time and this is some of the best BBQ I have had in a long time. The ribs were flavorful without the sauce and when I added a little sauce, made them even better. Sweet tea was amazing and the salad was crisp and fresh not soft a wilted. Most definitely coming back here!

Don't know why someone hasn't thought of this sooner. 

Whenever my partner and I are busy We opt-in for delivery from one of the big food delivery companies. Which typically results in an overpriced soggy bag of slop from Kyle--who just ripped a bong before walking around my apartment complex for fifteen minutes trying to find the right unit.

I decided to try Crave and got some pretty damn good pad Thai. The guy who dropped it off was fast and friendly...  that was refreshing. My partner is a vegetarian and she was able to order from a different restaurant. 

It seems like they have a bunch of chefs under the Crave service that collaborate on orders. Some of the options on there were local. There's every type of food imaginable. 

This will be our go-to from now on.

HORRIBLE DEALERSHIP!  Arrogant, dishonest & disrespectful salesmen. I was ready to buy a motorcycle from them, but when they wanted to raise the price over $3000 from the advertised price I walked. When I pointed out the error to the salesman he was arrogant, condescending and unapologetic. This dealership is owned by the same owner as High Desert Harley Davidson.........AVOID BOTH AT ALL COSTS.
The manager is so kind and genuine. The food is delicious but the best part is seeing such an incredible manager in action. Thank you and we will be back

Our server Ashley was amazing! We came in for a birthday and she made it so much fun. The food was sooo 10/10. We highly recommend this place and if you get Ashley as your server you hit the jackpot. We will come back because of her and the fantasti

This place is extremely popular and always crowded. All service staff are quite friendly and helpful and knowledgeable on the menu. We could tell that our waiter was busy but he never gave us that impression as he took our order. We never felt rushed and he was glad to answer all of our questions.  Ordering a steak here is never a disappointment and their temperatures are spot on. We were surprised and delighted by the size and taste of the baked sweet potato, highly recommended and very healthy for you.  The only let down which other people may enjoy, were the sweet dinner rolls that preceded the meal. The rolls seem to be baked with sugar and the only side given is a sweet cinnamon butter. These taste more like a dessert than an appetizer.  Again, these may be great for kids, but not to our liking.
Great food and great service EVERY TIME!  I've been to a lot of different Texas Roadhouse restaurants all over the country and this is definitely the best.  We love coming here!

Terrible horrible manager. Not helpful at all!! Never going to this Lowe's again! He was not interested in changing his incorrect price tag or understanding my point of view. I had another item that rang up more than the non-sale regular price. I feel like they are just trying to rip off everybody at this location. I haven't been to any other local Lowe's but I am 100% certain it's better than this location. Ugh. Livid.

I've tried mister car wash, epic shine, and rocket and fast eddys is the best! I mean they all wash your car of course but I had noticed even after one wash sometimes my car would have a speck of something dirty left on it and honestly who wants to turn their car around and tell them that it's still dirty... not I. I love how it really cleans the car with their brushes and dries! Another cool thing that I love is they have a mat cleaner! You just stick your dirty mats in their little machine and they come out the back super clean. They also have a vending machine with air fresheners and other wipes if you need for purchase. Not only that the gas station convenience store is massive! They probably have every drink on the planet in there (just kidding but maybe!?) and their sandwiches are pretty yummy.

Hobby Lobby is a great store and provides customers a wide selection of craft merchandise and prides itself on being a Christian-owned company. I used to go to a store in Albany, OR, all the time and fell in love with all parts of the store. There is just so much! If you like perusing through aisles and aisles of never-ending interesting finds, this is the place for you!

On my last couple visits I've found some adorable pots to propagate my houseplants into. I also had some beach themed lamps from our old beach house that I was able to redesign using cheap material found at Hobby Lobby. Everything in the picture with the succulents cost me less than $20! IMO that's a damn steal.

The reason behind this subpar rating today boils down straight to the customer service. Whether you're asking for a bathroom, at the check out stand, or asking where a certain item is located, you get the same, uppity attitude from associates every time. Like their too good for you. Our last cashier clerk didn't even bother saying hi to us. Like yo, y'all shove it in everyone's faces that you are "family friendly," so start incorporating it. You claim that kindness is a fundamental part of your customer experience but it's clear you don't encourage employees to practice what is being preached to the public. 

In the end, Hobby Lobby has the best selection of crafting products out of any big box craft store in the city. However, the lack of customer service speaks loud and clear that they are only focused on one thing - money. Not that that is going to stop me from coming here but just a heads up, don't expect anyone to do anything remotely out of the way for you here. Get in, get your shit, get out and call it a day. End rant.

We have never had a bad meal here. Service is quick and very friendly. We especially enjoy the little daughter who helps (maybe 4 or 5 years old)! Tonight we had the spicy mandarin chicken ( not very spicy) and twice mushroom beef and chow mein. The beef was so tender and very flavorful. Good to see this business doing well!
Called to find out if they carried bed frames. Sat on hold for 15 minutes and finally hung up.  Went elsewhere and got someone eagar to help.

These guys are HONEST AND INTELLIGENT!  They take the time to explain and make sure the customer understands the workings of the appliance. Brandon & Brik were quick, efficient & highly personable!  I highly recommend this company to anyone needing a repair!  Additionally, I rarely leave reviews, however they impressed me so much I wanted to applaud this company.

this place is so  great it's worth the wait. it's all made fresh and you can tell takes a minute. small little place on main street in meridian. Has a drive thru but me andy kids ate inside.
they have kids meals available they come with the works tomato pickle lettuce onions but you can get the pickles taken off my daughter hates pickles. But she loves the burgers here. The employees were friendly and seemed to actually care that they got my order right I love coming here it's the best. Also the owner showed up while we were there just seemed like a nice regular guy wouldn't have known if the nice young man hadn't said something. Cool burger place cool owner that's why it works.

I'd first like to start off by saying that I understand these are unprecedented times, and business is unusual during this health pandemic. I am a patient and understanding person, and during this pandemic I have ordered from different restaurants, will tip higher than normal in order to support our local businesses and the essential people working for us. 

That being said I was super unimpressed with the lack of care and service. I placed an online order at 7:43 PM, received and email confirmation that the order would be ready at 8:12 PM. 

Once my husband got there, he let them know he was there, apparently you wait outside and they will bring you your food once it is ready. 8:25 PM, still waiting, no big deal, business is unusual and it's Mother's Day, 8:46 PM, still waiting. I call to see if they can give me an estimated time frame of when they are able to get the food out, the guy said 2 minutes. 8:58 PM, still waiting, I call again and the guy says, "yea yea, sorry, going now". It's now 9:05 PM and we still didn't have our food, nor any communication, no one came out and said "hey sorry, we know you're here, it's on it's way" nothing. 

Very dissatisfied. Will not be going here again even when things can go back to normal again.

Our family regularly visits the downtown Meridian and downtown Boise locations. Just recently we were in the area one Sunday midday and noticed for the first time the one beside the Fred Myer in Eagle off Chinden and Linder.  Decided why not give this location a try.

They have been open little over a year but it's still very nice and looks brand new inside. We like the decor of old reclaimed wood. I must say the service at this location was stellar. We have always got really good service but it felt a tad better here.

We learned they have some menu items now found at the other locations under the sandwiches and burgers. We tried some of our favorites on the menu and as always treated to a wonderful meal.

I know people come here for the steak, but can we have an honest moment here and say that if you come here for the rolls, that's okay too. You are not alone. Yes, the steak is delicious...but this carb queen's main motivation for coming here is the rolls and honey butter. There, I've said it.

Second to the rolls, however, is their steak. I ordered an 8 oz sirloin with mashed potatoes and a caesar salad on the side. I ordered my steak medium and that's exactly how it came out - a pretty pink center and perfectly cooked outside. I loved the mashed potatoes and will definitely order these again (like I mentioned earlier, CARBS). The caesar salad was good, but I would probably opt for a mixed greens salad instead next time. Overall, I was stuffed at the end of this meal AND still had a good amount to take home with me for the next day.

I really like the atmosphere in here. It's exactly what you would expect that vibe of somewhere called "Texas Roadhouse" to be--loud country music, western decor, and just an overall friendly and relaxed vibe. A wonderful dining out experience with good food in an atmosphere that doesn't make you feel ashamed for accidentally putting your elbows on the table or reclining in your booth after stuffing your face with rolls. Service was also friendly and timely (we did come here at like 9:30 at night, so it was probably past their diner rush). Overall, awesome experience! This might become a frequent stop for me...just not too frequent because you know, those rolls.

New neighbors in our new neighborhood have done many favors for us. So, when they asked where the best Mexican food was in the area, we said Pueblo Lindo. Better yet we said, let us take you for a Thank You. 

On a Friday night, the place was hopping. But the food and service was great. They even had a "hombre cantare" and pretty good too. More Tejano style ballads than musica classica. 

Don't think we ever saw so many beef fajitas orders come out. The smoke and flavors permeated the air and was so tantalizing. Got to have those next time. The tacos, enchiladas and other dishes we had were great, as usual. Cold beers made for the best libation with this meal. 

The servers are always the best, both the men and women. The food came out at a nice pace considering the crowd. We'll be back again.

Well shut my mouth!  Steve, owner, wanted to make things right and boy did he ever!  I went back and they detailed my car and I got an oil change. He introduced me to the managers and sat and talked with me for a while as they were doing the oil change. The car was so beautiful afterwards that even my girlfriends noticed and now they want to take their vehicles to Fast Eddies. Amazing experience!  Thanks Steve. I hope to see you again soon.

Busy Friday night but the still managed to get our pastry of 12 seated realistically fast. The menu is amazing with a great assortment of food and lots of appetizers to choose from. Many local beers as well as a good assortment of popular beers. It was crowded but we were still able to hold a conversation without yelling and Bon our server was amazing. It's nice to find good service in a post pandemic world where lack of staffing has caused customer service to be a low priority.

Just tried this place tonight! Had the pulled pork tacos, fried pickles, cucumber salad! Everything was so delicious and the service was great! The Mac and cheese is great as well! Definitely will be going back!!

I purchased a dog from Puppyland and they give you the "Certified Pedigree" papers, they show purebred dog but my dogs was not.  They state they do not purchase from puppy mills but they source from JAK (61 adult breeding dogs / August 20 had 254 puppies) - Iowa and Mike Decker (105 Adult breeding dogs), both who are on the national puppy mill list.  How do you claim not to purchase from puppy mills?  Justin Kerr, owner of Puppyland states he sells mixed breed dogs all day long for $4,000 plus, I wonder how many people know they are spending that on a cross / mixed breed dog.  If you purchased an Alaskan Klee Kai, DNA test the dog.  Don't do it yourself, buy the kit and have a vet do the test so you are not accused of altering the kit, which we were.  If you want to talk to me or ask any questions, do not hesitate to contact me.

I'll be honest, it's not my favorite place to shop but when you artsy, crafty, or seasonal decor, Hobby Lobby as it. The store at CentrePointe is  huge with all sorts of seasonal decor or maybe you're just in the mood to make everything in your bathroom resemble Pismo Beach.  Looking for sand dollars dishes, yeah they have it.  

Here's a PRO-TIP.   Their website has coupons and or coupon codes.  Make sure to have them on your phone or use the mobile app son you can get a discount on top of the already discounted specials. 

The staff is friendly and very polite.   On one occasion, I was looking for white Christmas bulbs and didn't see any stocked on the shelves. I did see them stocked on the very top shelf.  An employee Roberto was looking at my perplexed face and said, " I can get those down for you.  How many do you want?"  Kudos to Roberto for recognizing an issue and acting on it before me or anyone else pestering him to go get the ladder.  Young man, Roberto, that intuitive customer service will take you places. 

As for the moss, paint by numbers Gnomes, picture frames and thr assorted comic book decor for any Marvel or DC man cave, Hobby Lobby has it  If you're lucky enough to have the cash on hand to take advantage of the discounts, do it and have no regrets because it won't be there long.  Well, maybe the Christmas Chihuahua dressed in a purple robe may still be there in February.

Even in Boise, there's a Starbucks open on Christmas day! Who'dathunk?

For being a major holiday, the staff was super cool, and the drinks tasted just like any other Starbucks location (which is to be expected) and the line moved pretty quick despite a holiday rush. Ho ho ho!

Sherry and I orderd happy hour nachos, happy hour salad, a Philly cheesesteak, and Virgin Mary.

The happy hour nachos were fantastic, the salad was fresh and tasty, and the Virgin Mary was awesome (we want to return for the iconic Mega Mary (see http://www.idahostatesman.com/entertainment/ent-columns-blogs/words-deeds/article180389501.html).

The only disappointment was the Philly Cheesesteak: the meat was cut too thick and had lots of grizzle, there were not enough onions, and little flavor.  I recommend the kitchen staff take cheesesteak tour of Philly (Jim's is a must visit, Pat's second) to see how it's done - with a little effort you could become the premier purveyor of Philly Cheesesteaks in Idaho.

We celebrated my daughter's 18th birthday and she decided this was the place! We got a reservation for our family and they were great with our party size of 12-16. First impression was wow! What a beautiful restaurant! I loved the glass room for our party and being able to view the restaurant entirely! Love the picture of the bull walking on the beach is what it looked like to me. Reminded me of Yellowstone for some reason. Our waitress was super awesome, she took great care of us. I would say the food is a little pricey but overall they had really good dishes. I ordered a burger since I had prime rib for the last 3 days and didn't want a steak. The bbq burger was ok for me and I it was probably my fault since I asked for medium well. Was a little dry for me but overall flavors were good. My wife's spicy steak was delicious and had a great kick to it. My sister in laws Chilean sea bass was phenomenal! The coconut rice was exquisite and worked well with the fish. Our calamari appetizers were delicious and we even had another order because it was so good! My daughter's steak was a little too well when she asked for medium rare, but she said the flavors were there. The seafood from here is really good and well cooked. Our deserts were really good, the vanilla bean creme brûlée was fantastic! Really the best out of the bunch but the apple pie and chocolate cake were just as good! I would definitely come back and try something again! I really want to come back to their brunch as the menu items all sounds delicious! Again the service was great and I can't wait for you all to give it a try!

Just picked up dinner tonight and it was great:) They got our order correct and ordering was easy. All employees were wearing masks and most guests were too. I'm glad BWW is taking COVID-19 precautions:)
Our server Derek was great! He was fast and informative  about the different beers and food items, plus he put up with our crazy group! Thanks Derek!

I really enjoy ramen, and I thought this place was pretty cute. however, most of the things just weren't up to par. when you take shortcuts, or you buy lower quality items, it's noticeable to people that enjoy this type of food.

the egg rolls tasted like the frozen kind. the veggies inside were congealed and odd. the sauce tasted bottled. it was sticky and thick, and not sweet. the thai tea tasted like milk, not rich and creamy like i'm used to.  I didn't even finish it. my mom was flabbergasted- she's never seen me not finish a thai tea in my life. 
even the soy sauce is not kikkoman and I know that seems like a small thing, but the cheap kind they bought to cut costs just doesn't taste as good. 

the ramen was delicious, which is why they are getting the stars i'm giving. the broth was rich and creamy (I got creamy chicken) and the chicken was delicious and well cooked inside. I also enjoyed the soy sauce eggs- they were salty with lots of flavor. it was an all around winner in my book. 

my mom got the orange chicken. again, very little flavor. it was cheap chicken and tasted gamey. the sauce was bottled and had no flavor. the portion was HUGE though, ridiculously huge. i'd rather they have less but used better chicken like the kind in the ramen and got better sauce. 

I plan on coming back, but for ramen only. I will not be trying anything else on the menu unfortunately, everything we had was disappointing.

Prepare to wait for around 45 minutes for a table here. For appetizers we had the wings and artichoke dip. Both were excellent. Our main entrees were ribeye and the garage grinder sandwich with chicken. Main dishes were excellent (ribeye and sandwich) but side dishes were a huge disappointment. Fries were hard and lacked flavor and the roasted potatoes were sub-par. We wanted to try the baked potatoes (they looked delicious) but they ran out of them (how do you run out in the potato state?!?!). Food took awhile to come out but overall service was excellent. We are out of towners that had high expectations based off of the reviews and were a little disappointed.

They certainly do NOT require masks. 
Two different groups were waiting and then seated who never in the building had masks on.

There's literally not enough places in the treasure valley that serve a good pork belly bun! So I am super excited to see this place pop up! I love Asian food and this place offers a southern twist!! Can't wait to try all the delicious items!

UPDATE 11/21/2018
14 To Go spaces and 2 handicap spaces! Why?

Ok, here we go.... 

I have complained about this multiple times to managemand I really shouldn't return but their handicap accessible parking is a joke! Why on earth do you need so many spaces for pick up and you have one or two accessible 

The only reason for a dirty restaurant is laziness! I love your patio but have you ever heard of a pressure washer??

We hired them to come out and move the cable behind our tv so the wires would not show.  The installer was a joke.  He would not even move the tv or console back when finished.  To top it off we had perfect reception of all the ota channels BEFORE he arrived... after leaving we get Chanel 6 and 4... they did not perform the original work that was ordered due to time constraints and I was charged 300 bucks to still have wires showing from my tv down the wall, and all of my reception messed up.  F'ing joke of a company.

This was our first time here and we enjoyed it.  We ordered the shrimp and steak baskets and they were very good. The draft beer was served cold.  Our bartender, Ernie, was awesome and answered all my questions.  We will return soon, for sure!

A chain but really very good.

a unique experience with lots of fun.

killa steaks and ribs.

I wish this place was near us.

everyday is a party here.

always very busy.

gotta call to get on 30-60 minute wait list

Worst restaurant experience I've ever had in Boise. They were so rude and dismissive that we didn't even get a table. Put our name on the list and the next 6 groups were seated before us. Wait staff was extremely rude and didn't care when I asked after waiting 30 minutes if we were going to ever get a table.
 1st time in, never going back

Indifferent service, salt lick meets greasy-soggy food, "WHAT DID YOU SAY?" levels for music and noise.  Two strikes visits.  We don't need a third to know "they're out" on our list.  If it isn't evident Matador in Boise is part of a restaurant chain, the chain roots sure show with Casa del Matador. (They are links in the same chain.)  I write few one star reviews.  This one is fitting. 

If it wasn't oddly amusing on its' own that the food is so bad in such an overwrought interior design space, the fact that they seem to mistake themselves for French Laundry for no menu modifications is really laughable. Here are examples. Comical in hindsight.  Irritating at the time.  

1. One dish came with a grilled flour tortilla.  We asked if we could substitute a corn tortilla.  The server hmmm...ed and hawwww...ed.   Probably not, she said, the kitchen does not like to substitute.  Give it a shot we asked.  Pretty simple thing.  Well, she said, I'll try.   Good thing she was successful because the corn tortilla (it was served with just one) was the only edible thing for a mushroom dish that was literally too salty to eat.  Yet our server did not ask why we left it uneaten when she returned at the end of the meal.  

2.  A taco sampler contained pork, chicken and beef tacos.  We don't eat beef so asked if we could substitute another pork taco in its' place.  Probably not, said our server.  The kitchen really didn't want to do things like that.  They had 'rules' from...and here she didn't say corporate but that's my memory translation of the message.  Give it a try, we said.  If not, just leave the beef one off.  I'll have to charge you the same price even if it is left off, she warned us.  Yes, we said, yes, that's no problem.  No sense bringing us something we won't eat just because it is included in the price.  OK, she said.  The kitchen apparently did have dispensation to substitute pork for that beef taco.  Not that it mattered much in the end given the tacos were so soggy sitting in greasy liquid when delivered that eating them was not so good a thing.

We don't eat at the Burger King chain but we do know the jingle and wondered if we should wander into Matador chain corporate offices singing a few bars.  "...special orders don't upset us...have it your way." 

Not that any of this is the problem of the folks serving the tables or manning the cooktops.  I imagine it has to do with policy.  But there you go.

There are places to get good Mexican - American themed food in the Boise area.  A couple for authentic Mexican food too.  Casa Del Matador is among neither group.

THIS N THAT:

ACCESSIBILITY:  Level in the door.  Some standard height seating in the perimeter areas of the restaurant and outside.  But the 'happenin' stuff' is in the bar area and that's where most will want to sit.  Yet if the Governor of the State of Texas, a man who uses a wheelchair due to being paralyzed in an accident, or actor Michael J. Fox whose walking is limited due to Parkinson's disease, or U.S. Congresswoman Tammy Duckworth whose legs were severed in Iraq, wanted to sit in the bar they would likely find not one single standard height seating table that they could use. The ADA requires they have seating available to them for equal access.  It is a Civil Rights law for inclusion passed in 1990.  Casa del Matador was built in 2015.  Beyond belief that they didn't know better.  The law has been in place for 25 years.
Great Mexican food and pleasant wait staff!  We were excited to try as we really liked the sister restating McCall. We were not disappointed!
I had them manage my house, they were terrible.I would not recommend them to anyone. They didnt take care of my property.  They are now called Rentwise.

Super quiet and quaint place! Our server was super nice and quick with her service. We got our food probably 5 minutes after ordering! Huge serving sizes for an affordable price! Their Thai tea is also super yummy! Definitely will be coming back again!

It had been a long time since had been here...like visiting a long lost friend. ..awhhhh!  Staff was very friendly and down right gushing with apologies that the "inside" was full and we could eat in the covered outside dining if we'd like.  So we ventured out. 

Cody our waiter was attentive and quick to give suggestions/opinions so the Pteradactyl wings,  Rueben sandwich & Steak salad were ordered and VERY quickly brought out.  

Food was hot & pretty darn good!  My husband exclaimed the corned beef wasn't "screwed up" (which is his way of saying it's good).  Wings (not so spicy, kinda sweet, savory) were served with a wash cloth (any clue here?!) and were impressive to see.  Speaking of impressive, the bread pudding wasn't the best I've had but was pretty good with enough to share and a cup of caramel sauce!  

We'll be back!

The Donut + Dog 

The setup
Eclectic. 2 chartreuse bistro sets, an open garage door, a sea of industrial tables, graffiti on the walls, neon pink signs, hanging basket seats and Homer Simpson. You can watch the donuts being created as you listen to 90's music while you wait in line to order. And there will be a line. 

Menu 
Also Eclectic. Donut Hamburgers, mimosas, fancy brioche donuts, nitrate free hot dogs, unique organic coffee drinks, and beer. Oh my!

Service
The people who work here are helpful and polite. Even though this place is new, and they are insanely busy at times, the servers are kind. I have no complaints about service whatsoever. 

Food 
It's ordinary food served extra. Very whimsical. 
The South Beach Donut is served with a tiny pipette of rum. The kids dog is served plain on a brioche bun. See the picture, it's like Texas Toast who had big dreams. The food was excellent and did not disappoint. The fries were the first to disappear. 

Ambiance
This place is bright, loud, energetic, upbeat, and bold. Relaxing? No. Aesthetically soothing? No. But that's kind of the point. It's supposed to be interesting, like the food. 

4 stars

We don't eat out at Mexican restaurants very often, they all seem to taste the same. So it has taken us a while to try out Pueblo Lindo and boy have we been missing out! We were both very surprised at how much flavor was in every bite! Everything was absolutely at a higher level than your typical Mexican restaurant. We can't wait to go back and try something else, or maybe just get what we had before! They also have a full bar with a great selection of unique cocktails and beers,

This used to be my go to for decent (never great) food because the service being  good, the restaurant was clean and the staff was cheerful and friendly. They also gave you a little treat at the end of the meal...whipped cream and some cinnamon sprinkled tortilla chips with some strawberry sauce. Nothing exceptional except the thought. None of the above applied when we went a couple of Sundays ago. There were 12-13 of us and the water took forever, the beverages came out 1-2 at a time and the sodas were $3.95 with tons of ice in them. as did the food and the flavor was not there. It was bland as was the salsa and the portions of the side of guacamole ($3.95 I think was about 2 Tablespoons. Lo siento pero la comida no era autentica ne sabroso y el servicio malo. Unicamente les doy dos estrellas  si un dia vuelvo,

This review is for the pharmacy only

My step daughter is here for the summer and she has prescriptions through Rite Aid.
