I was a bit nervous about how the refill process was going to play out because her insurance carrier is only in California and they have a tendency of not immediately covering anything in another state. Usually it's a long, drawn out reimbursement process.  So, I called Rite Aid & prayed for the best! Initially they were not able to give me an answer because they needed to actually attempt to charge the insurance company for the prescription and we were a few days too early to get a refill.  The pharmacist told me to call back in 2 days. He also reassured me that if the insurance company denied the medication he would find coupons & discounts to get me the best out of pocket price possible.  I appreciated that he was willing to go the extra mile.  
Fast forward two days! I called Rite Aid again to ask them to attempt to run the prescription.  When I gave my daughters information to the technician she happily told me that the medication was ready for pickup! Wow! That was nice' I didn't think that the pharmacist was going to remember to run it.  
Dealing with pharmacy's can be a total pain in the A, but Rite Aid really came through for me! Thanks Joshua!

I really enjoy Texas Roadhouse they have the best rolls anywhere. The meat us always cooked perfectly and just delicious food quality meat, as well as wonderful drinks and desserts. The only complaint I would have is its really loud in there so don't go there expecting to be able to have conversation with anyone but the person sitting next to you, but other than that it's great.

Ok so Mongos is good food with lots of variety.  Way more options than your standard Mongolian BBQ, food is great, service is good.  Pricing is steep, the value is not there.  Maybe include beverage or desert for that price and you would be getting there.
Store is super old and gross looking from the outside. Inside is slightly better. The isles are scattered and unorganized making it difficult to find what your looking for.

Best bridal gown shopping experience I've had! There was a wide variety of dresses which made finding my dream dress so easy. Kate really listened to what I envisioned and picked the best gowns that were exactly what I was looking for. The whole experience was so fun and memorable!

A perfectly filled Krispy Kreme doughnut has the filling in the very center, not off to one side. Just wanted to get that message to the workers here. I came in to get my favorite, custard filled with chocolate on top. I got half way through the doughnut before finding any custard. The chocolate glaze on top was also only found on one side, the edge really. This is the description of failure. 

Never know I was such a doughnut critic! I just like em to look like they do online... If I'm going to pay $1+ each...

I judge ramen by the broth and this place hit it spot on! The broth was flavorful and hearty. It warmed my soul on this cold winter day! Their portions are huge and they don't skimp on deliciousness! Our server was friendly and attentive. I will be telling everyone I know about this place!

The Grill is very close to my place, so we go there on a regular basis.  They have a familiar pub grill menu, and had a few really good items on there that were my go-tos.  I came in for lunch today to a new updated menu.  Frankly I was glad to see nice clean new menus, but wasn't really sure what was new and did notice my favorite items were gone.  Pesto chicken for one.  I was sitting at the bar, of which they sell mixed drinks and plethora of beers on tap.  Tons of beers!   A few chairs over from me was another guy staring  at the menu befuddled like me as his favorite stuff was gone as well.  Overheard him say what I was thinking.  I wasn't super hungry so I thought I would do the chicken Caesar.  A staple everywhere.  It does seem that they changed it to smoked Chicken vs grilled chicken.  I couldn't remember what the menu was like before, so I ordered it.  Meh, wasn't my favorite.  I think it is best to offer the salad without protein, and then let people add they type of protein they want, steak, chicken, smoked chicken, etc.  No a real smoked chicken guy I guess.  Anyway, I'm not a big fan of the menu changes, but what can ya do.  I'll have to find something else there, I'll keep searching.   

In other news of the Grill, the staff is nice.  They seem to know many people that come in.  I see lots of hugs and hellos to familiar people.  If they don't know you when you come in, a yell comes out, "Sit wherever you like! We'll be right there!"   And that works for me as well.  It's a bar/grill.  Not a large place, but they do have overflow seating outside and seating at the bar, also bar high tables, and standard stables along the walls.  It does get a little loud.  They serve very large drinks, and have a good sized bunch crowd on weekends.   

Fun events like karaoke and corn hole can be had on late evenings.  Give it a try.

Our daughter is 17 and desperately needs a puppy. She has had a very rough last few years and suffers from depression. She needs an animal to be an emotional support for her.

This place is in the same parking lot as Red Robin. We saw a guy walking around carrying signs about puppies, so we figured why not look.

This place looks pretty nice from the outside, but they dont have any prices showing anywhere. This was the 1st red flag.

They have signs up that say "We finance". This was the 2nd red flag,  but we decided to take a chance anyway. 

There was a line outside, so we had to wait a while before getting in. Once inside, there were a number of puppies that seemed healthy and happy. My daughter found one that she liked pretty quickly.

We asked the lady that walked around with a clip board if she would see it. They sat her up in a small close in area so she could spend some 1 on 1 time with the puppy.

We were suspicious due to the above issues, so we asked how much the puppy was.

The lady said the puppy was 3495. I quickly said, we will take it. You cant beat $34.95 anywhere.

She corrected me said. No, the price is 34 hundred and 95 dollars. I looked at my wife in astonishment. 

We quickly told our daughter that we were leaving, gave the puppy back to the lady and left shaking our heads.

I have never in my life even guessed that anyone would charge such a price for a puppy. 

If you are looking for a puppy, unless you have very very deep pockets, I would say to look elsewhere. There are lots and lots of places out there that charge more reasonable prices.

Great atmosphere and great cigars. The service was knowledgeable and friendly. Again, I have to applaud the atmosphere. Definitely a cool place to enjoy a cigar and get lost in the experience of the smoke. I offer it four stars () and my recommendation.

This WalMart SUCKS!   I went to the garden center on a Sunday afternoon and purchased 6 bags of bark.  They had at least 4 people standing around "directing traffic" and one poor checker who was new to her job.  

I waited for at least a half hour to have someone come and load the mulch into the back of my car, which was parked directly outside the garden center.   However, I got tired of waiting and told them I would have someone come back, (with the receipt) and pick up the bags of mulch.  

On Monday, I had my neighbor go to this WalMart location to pick up the bags of mulch.  They gave my neighbor nothing but a hard time.  Said, "she should have picked this up on the day she purchased it".  EXCUSE ME!!  Everyone was either busy or standing there with their finger in their left ear.  My neighbor decided he'll go to the Nampa, ID WalMart because the people at that store, don't act like the "world owes them a living".  

Today, Monday, when I was able to contact the Asst Manager, the "real manager" had gone home for the day, she said she would be happy to help, but that she needed to know "which WalMart associate gave me bad service.  As if she thinks this is really a code for "which WalMart associate should I fire??   I HATE the WalMart stores, all of them in the Treasure Valley, with the exception of the Nampa store.  WELCOME TO WALMART!!!

Sincerely, 
Steven & Carolyn Riedl 
Star, ID
Glad to have this new Flat Bread in our neighborhood as they are a very good local chain.   Great food, good service and nice atmosphere.
Some of the best brisket, shredded pork, and bbq sauce in the northwest. This is one of the few bbq joints I'm willing to frequently pay for in the age of Traegers.

I'm giving this two stars because the service was fantastic! The food was cursed tho.... This is a rundown of what we ordered:

Chari Siu Pork (we knew better)
Bloody mary drink
Heat wave drink
Sirloin Dip
Pork Belly Burnt Tips

The taste of the char siu was smoke. Just smoke. So much smoke. Like drinking a bottle of liquid smoke. No amount of mediocre hot mustard will ever make that okay. It was also like pork nuggets they were not sliced thin in any way whatsoever. 

Both drinks were watered down and close to zero flavor. The heat wave tasted like water with some lime and tajin.

The sirloin dip could have been made at home if you had a camping pot, some stale bread, no seasonings, and depression. 

The burnt pork belly tips would have been great if they were a little crispier. It was kinda like eating chunks of pork fat with barbecue sauce. I think I saw this on Fear Factor once. I recommend putting coconut oil in the coleslaw because it makes it easier to scrape in the trash.

Service was on point tho. Super sweet and super fast. Our waitress was lovely and wonderful (unlike the food). She made conversation and connection and we couldn't have asked for better. Her eyeliner was so sharp it could kill a man and I loved it. Service is carrying this restaurant on their backs though because the food is just kinda.....oof.
Emma gave us exceptional service. She was an absolute joy and very attentive to our bottomless Mimosa brunch.

Being of the Chinese persuasion, we are always looking out for good cooking of that cuisine. We won't go into the typical rant about "Americanized Asian Food" only found in the Boise area, but the acceptable Chinese restaurants are few. After our visit to Wok Fusion, we think we can add one more that we like, making a total of two.

Most of what we report here is just building on Michele R.'s excellent review, but we did note some similar and additional observations. First this is a family run business and Maggie runs the front. Ask her anything and they will cook it to your directions. The cooks in the kitchen are Chinese and appear to be family relatives also. 

The decor is simple, but very clean. The menu seems extensive. In our Labor day dining, it appeared that take out was about 10:1 to dining in. Glad to see that they had a lot of takeout  business while we ate there. But, the seemingly lack of dining in patrons shouldn't scare off those who want to eat in. You will be pleased and service is quick.

We had two dishes and white rice. At our request, Maggie had the cooks make our dishes spicy, spicier than normal. The addition of some jalapeños to the bell peppers helped a lot. The 5 spice Tofu and stir fried pork was clean, not overly sauced, and each vegetable was cooked so that the taste was still clean on each one. The chopping showed good technique and avoided the often committed foul of too big pieces.The Szechuan Spicy Chicken was a bit over salted and if we have it again, we would ask for no deep fried coating on the chicken pieces, but merely seasoned chicken stir fried with less salt or soy sauce. As Michelle R. noted rice comes on a flat plate. But we asked for rice bowls and Chopsticks and they were happy to accommodate us. We would like to see them add brown rice to their menu. Also, they brought serving spoons to aid our dining.

We will return and try other dishes that have a good chance of being cooked authentically, rather than "Americanized". They must have also heard my thoughts as they left out the zucchini often described in the menu. (Personally, I didn't know Chinese even knew about zucchinis when I was a kid in the Bay Area.) The use of shredded cabbage though is a good technique to give body and taste to the sauce, sort of like the French mirepoix or Italian soffritto. The kitchen shows good technique and flavor development.

We are looking forward to returning. Future dishes might be Cashew chicken, Garlic pork, beef and broccoli and something with bok choi. Without zucchinis, of course, and more dry stir fried than heavily sauced or oiled. One thing that would be out is probably egg fu yung which is akin to chop suey as being Chinese.
One of my faves. You can always count on Yard House for a cold cocktail, good food and service. Nice patio area with ample space and very accessible for those in wheelchairs or scooters.

I was surprised at how good our meal was. Perhaps I'm used to something not being cooked well or season properly or getting less than stellar service but that was not the case at Land Ocean. My husband ordered the surf and turf, I ordered the filet. We always order apps and dessert, crab cakes, the wedge and garlic bread then the molten chocolate cake for dessert. Everything was season well and delicious. It was a Saturday that I purposely booked at 430 to miss the rush and the restaurant quickly filled up after we arrived yet our food came out temped well and service was stellar. Why not five stars? Because they currently only have a limited liquor license.. my mojito came out tasting not great- sent it back and got a martini that was pretty good but still not what I'm used to. We plan to go back and try other menu items and taste the crème brûlée that was unavailable that evening.

I'd come here for happy hour.  We had lunch here one afternoon, it was ok, my burger was a little charred on the ends and my fries were lack luster.  Kind of a mess when eating the burger, it slid off the bun, I think the large pickles and onions on it might be the issue along with the "secret" sauce. Our service was very good and the atmosphere was positive but for the process I'd stick to a happy hour night.

I got the chicken chow fun & chicken curry. My first time here due to a quick stop eat while waiting on my daughter at the dentist. I love their portion! Everything was delicious. Although the server kinda made me uncomfortable because she kept staring at me the whole time I was there. She gave me the vibe that I was going to do a dine&dash. Because I do look very young with a little baby. Lol but that's never my intention. Anyways, I tipped her anyways because she was very attentive .

Hubby and I tried last night for the first time and LOVED it!  He is a big burger and fries fan-absolutely loved the burger and fries, said it was the best burger he had in a long time.  I tried the Thai Chop salad with tofu and it was DELICIOUS!!  So nice to have new options in town- we have been so tired of the same old things.  Highly recommend, we will definitely be repeat customers!

In the pantheon of car wash / gas station / convenience store set ups, I know not how one could shine brighter than this.  Quality car wash today as well as the simply stellar service received in the car wash and inside the sparkling and huge convenience store from all the friendly people involved.  Including an unexpectedly delicious sandwich at the (franchise chain) installment of Earl of Sandwich inside Fast Eddy's store.  Good enough that we who avoid chains at nearly all costs - including choosing to go hungry rather than eat them - would not only go in again if in the area but might actually make EOS a destination. 

Be not afraid of the behemoth looking size for all of this.  We didn't gas up the car at the Chevron dispensing here, but the kind of service we received at the other services we tried was the small business quality of "we're glad you're here" that seems so rare these days.  Well done by all.

BACK STORY: Newish transplants to the area that we are, about 5 years in from Oregon, we were unfamiliar with the history of Fast Eddy's as business owned by locals, Steve and Tracie Eddy, and their path of building and running successful gas station / convenience store locations of which they have sold well over a dozen to Jacksons Food Stores since 2004.  But for the last year-ish we've watched this Fast Eddy's go up on a roughly 5 acre parcel on Eagle Road in Meridian.  The owners said in press stories that this would out do anything they had built before.  Seeing is believing that this does.

CAR WASH:  Three levels of wash offered.  $10 / $12 / $15.  Having just come off a road trip that included several days in Bend with "yellow dust pollen" all over our SUV and a plethora of pesky road-bugs plastered on our front, we chose the $15 "bug blaster" wash as recommended by the friendly young guy checking us in.  A wise recommendation it was and the other young man doing the grill and car prep before it went "through the ringer" did a great job too.  Clean as a whistle coming out when we pulled into one of the UMPTEEN vacuum stations and also borrowed their clean towels to wipe off outside and wipe down inside. (PS - a free air freshener and / or dash wipe comes with the $15 wash - we declined with thanks for the offer - but so you know there it is if you want it.)

CONVENIENCE STORE:  Being just inside the timeframe for breakfast eats at Earl of Sandwich (they make the turn at 11a) we drove across the lot and hurried  in to the huge, sparkling clean store that was well stocked with almost anything you can imagine...
...from bottles of soda to bottles of Opus One and Silver Oak wines - no kidding 
...from fresh bananas to hot dogs with fixin's bar
...from grab-n-go fresh salads to Ling & Louie's sushi rolls to take-n-bake at home pizza
...from shelves and freezers of convenience foods to gelato in a case to buy by the scoop
...from four kinds of piping hot coffee in serve yourself stations - French Roast was darned good as the venue goes - to a (beer) growler refill station. 

I ignored the freshly delivered Krispy Kreme donuts (willpower won out) but there the sweet things were.  But sweetest of all things was the friendly greeting and service from the women at the counters.  THIS is how it should be done.  "Come back and see us again!" one exclaimed as we left.  You bet customers are inclined to do that with service like this. 

EARL OF SANDWICH:  Details included in a separate review, but this franchised sandwich business (on a corporate level actually launched by a descendent of the Earl of Sandwich) exceed our expectations by a lot for the quality of the eats - we chose a tasty Breakfast BLT - and the delightful service.  Brava to all the friendly young women working there and bravo to the owners who took the time to hire and train.  You think fast food service can't be done right?  It can.  And this is how.

ACCESSIBILITY:  Once in the store all is ADA compliant, just as one should expect in 2019, 29 years after the law was passed.  Unfortunately, accessible parking misses the mark of ADA law in that the accessible (aka ADA) parking spots have been put at the far ends of the convenience store and not near the front door where they should be.  The require ADA spots be proximate to the entrance so that a disabled customer does not have a longer route to the door than an able bodied customer.  The far end placement of the parking makes the trek to the front entrance longer for sure for disabled customers.  It would have been easy and it is still possible for the owner to locate these spaces at the front near the entrance.

Service is always GREAT!  Food is great also,  my husband and I love the hamburgers, but have to split one as it is too much food for us.  

This place feels like CHEERS to us!  We have lived in cities throughout the United States, so much so that we call ourselves the "geriatric gypsies".  

If it has a downside it would be in the price of drinks.   Again, great staff, but then we always sit at the bar!!

As the old saying goes, "Try it, you'll like it"!!
The owner reached out about our experience we had and was more than willing to make it right. Really appreciate the owners response, very kind. As for the restaurant- we love their food!
This place needs to be revisited if you haven't tried it recently! Lynn gives a fantastic pedicure and really shows pride in her work is very sweet! Friendly staff and very clean place.

Not a fan. My grandma is looking for a puppy. Tried the humane society first and then browsed Puppyland's website. Called to inquire about some of their puppies and was told they can't give out prices over the phone. Based on other reviews we dodged a bullet dealing with this place.
My wife loves this place. I will be getting gift cards for her for future birthdays and celebrations. My daughter too!

I absolutely love this place.  

The bloody Mary's alone are worth the trip, however, the tap list is incredible.  The food is usually on point (but my burger was hella dry last time) and the service is always great.  Sit at the bar if you can.
Excellent! I'd like to give more than five stars. We ordered the spicy shrimp wontons (not fried), tantinum ramen and curried noodles. All were delicious. I highly recommend Ramen House.

I could list the groomers I've taken Samson to but that would take too long. Being totally frustrated with trying to get a groomer to call back, I called CleanPup mobile. WOW, what a difference!!!  Samson loves Melissa and Melissa loves us.  It's a perfect match between groomer and client. You won't be sorry.

Jordan Boone is flawless with my hair. She knows exactly how to make you feel comfortable and takes the time to educate you on what your hair is capable of and ensues complete confidence in her ability to make you feel beautiful. 

I have been going to Jordan at Oliver's for 3+ years and trust her completely with my hair 

The team at Oliver's are always very friendly and inviting.

My friend and I came here for lunch on a Friday afternoon, around 1:00 pm. Although Meridian was its typical busy traffic, Ramen House was not busy, so our overall wait (table, ordering, food delivered to table) was very fast. I admitted to the waitress that this was my first time in a ramen restaurant, and had a couple questions for her. She was helpful and gracious. I ordered the Tonkotsu Chasu ramen and my friend had the Creamy Chicken ramen. I was very pleasantly surprised at the flavor! The broth was rich and seasoned well, the pork belly was so flavorful, and the egg and mushrooms were both tasty and a great texture added. My friend really enjoyed her ramen as well. I am so glad we came, and I will be bringing my husband here with me next time! SO GOOD!

This is mine and my husbands favorite restaurant! We come here as often as we can and it is where we host birthday parties and special events because the food is incredible and we have YET to have a bad experience.
Both of us are servers and know what it's like to be busy and yet whenever our server stops by, they're genuine and fun. 
Confession: my husband totally faked his "first time" so he could get free peanuts ;) haha
We love you guys! Keep doing what you're doing.

Awesome Artisan Pizza for the wanna be foodie.
Excellent atmosphere, very friendly employees, and super flavorful ingredients.  How does one find all of these things in one restaurant?  Well, they go to Blaze Pizza of course!  No, I don't work there  - nor do I know anyone who owns the place!  I ordered the Veg Out signature pizza, and trust me, even if you're not much of a veggie fan - you should try this anyway!  The flavor combinations I found were top notch, making it hard to remember that I was actually eating a VEGETABLE pizza.  Nothing like any other veg pizza I've had .. and I will be ordering it again.  They offer a thin crust artisan style true to the wanna be foodie, clean eating, self discriminating in what is put in her mouth, oven fired pizza.  Handy caloric and nutrient calculator right there on the restaurants website.  Easy to use, no digging through the entire menu to find what you ate!

I usually struggle finding something that sounds good on the menu, and the food is usually just okay. But the beer selection is usually fantastic and is the main reason I go here, lots of styles to choose from.

The technician was great.  He as fast, efficient, and did a great job with the installation.  The price was more than fair.  The problem with the company is not the services offered, but the office support staff.  I have been waiting for a call back for over a week.  The technician did not have an amplifier on his truck, so I needed one delivered and installed. The woman answering the phone did not have a clue what i was talking about and needed to consult with a technician.  She could not be bothered to return my call.

I have debated over a week whether to post this review given they don't have any, but every time I think of my experience and look at my horribly done nails, I have to write about it.

The good things?  The Dad was great and attentive, but doesn't know how to do nails.  Only Pedicure, so he did mine.

The bad things?  I got handed over to the daughter who has one of the biggest attitudes I have ever seen.  She acts like you are disturbing her.  She won't talk to you and if you try to make conversation, she won't answer. I ended up not daring to ask for a flower on my toes because it would have pissed her off.

My Pedicure took 45 minutes and then had to watch her take another client in front of me. I was waiting forever to get a full set.  I knew it would be another hour at least before I got out of there.  After she painted my toes (Dad doesn't paint), she made me walk barefooted over to her nail station.  As I looked down, all I could see were ants and hair on the floor.  I wanted to barf.  I explained to her what I wanted and not 10 minutes in, she handed me off to her Mom because she had an appointment.

Now, the Mom doesn't speak English. I couldn't get pricing or the difference between gel and acrylic out of her.  Her daughter speaks perfect English and wouldn't even look up to help.  I asked the daughter to explain to her Mom what I wanted and she said "Oh just tell her".  Gee, thanks.  I tried...I didn't get what I wanted.  Instead I got long-fat square nails that make Dolly Parton's look short. (For you millennials, look her up)

I was there for 2 hours and 20 minutes for a basic pedicure and a full set of tips and acrylic.  $75 and I have to have them redone in  1/2 a week!

All in all....I will never go back just because of the daughter and the fact that the bottom of my feet had dead ants on them after paying $30 for a pedicure!

I don't know where to start.   I wanted to transfer my service from Sprint to Verizon and was told that I could keep my phones.  I had new phones and didn't want to buy more.  After three credit report runs and almost two hours later,  I was told that Verizon can't accept my Sprint phones.   So, after the new S8 came out,  I went back to Verizon,  they ran my credit again and I got my new phone.   They told me that I would get $360.00 for my old S7, but when I went to trade it in, I could only get $200.00.  They claim this their system is down.  I won't even go into the Dish network mess.  They won't return your calls,  they claim that I have  90 days to turn my phone in, now I am told I only have 14 days.

I went here for the first time a couple weeks ago. My family and I were meeting a old friend for dinner.  Probably not the best place for conversations but the food was good. I got the fried chicken and I never had gravy on it before but it sure was good. When I first looked it up I was a bit nervous about wait times but we got in right away and plus the waitress was very good about making sure we had everything we needed. We will go again for sure because it was so good!

Walmart's going down really fast and it's no wonder. They're doing a lot of bait and switch BS and it's getting harder and harder to find anybody out on the floor to help you. Several times recently I've tried to get help and they refused to help me at all. It's no wonder they have to close their stores at midnight nowadays and don't have much staff. Their prices are going up though I've noticed. I can shop at WinCo for less than Walmart and it used to be the other way around. Everything is out of China it seems. Don't have a lot of positive things to say about Walmart anymore. And I used to work at this location and loved it.

Today's experience I went in to get some cupcakes for a barbecue I was going to and saw the display table covered with cupcakes. There were small packages marked at $1.84 and big packages with no prices but a big sign right over them that said $3.98. So a normal person would figure that the big package with no price would be the item that is $3.98 right? Grab them go to check out, nope. Almost $6. Apparently there's a little tag attached to the bottom part of the table that's pricing them at this higher price. There was nothing on that table to match that $3.98 that I could find so I left 'em. Wally World can keep their crappy lying bait and switch. Me I'll find a different store to shop at when I don't go to WinCo. 

Posting picture of cupcake table.

Being the "Ramen Head" that I am, I'm always on the lookout for new ramen places to try.

Being new to the area, I've desperately sought out a ramen place I can keep going back to: And I've found it!

Having been to Japan, and regularly making homemade ramen, its been difficult to find ramen i consider "delicious" within the treasure valley.

My partner in crime and myself ordered the Tantanmen ramen (9/10 by authentic standards)
Chaschu ramen (8/10 the chasu was delicious, but very thinly sliced, and the broth tasted quite chickeny as apposed to porky, but still pretty rich and flavorful.

The crabrangoons were the best I've had in Idaho, and the Gyoza were packed with flavor, lightly crisped and juicy.

By far the best ramen I've had in idaho, amazing and attentive service, (yes they were quite busy, and yes we had to wait a bit for table service, but that should go without saying for this delicious ramen and a small staff that was extremely polite).

I will be coming back here as often as possible to try other items on the menu.

But if you like creamy, sesame, cumin, flavored ramen, the Tantanmen is amazing!

$16.95 for a cheese pizza that at any other place would be considered a "small" or "personal" size.

Like other reviews, pizza was around 11 inches with a large crust. 

Blue cheese was put on a pizza that was requested to not have it.

Online ordering is complex and not straight forward, lead to another pizza being screwed up.

2 out of 3 pizzas being wrong, only one correct was just cheese...

$56 for 3 small pizzas that didn't feed a family of 4.

Won't be going back.

Poki nachos chicken nachos chicken lettuce wraps for the win! 

Strawberry Mojito's are off the chain

Martin and Alex are awesome along with so much of the staff! The front hostess are ALWAYS DOLLS!

We were so excited to try this new restaurant based on a friend's recommendation.  I should have known to look at reviews prior to getting my hopes up.  We went on a Friday night and the place was pretty busy.  First impressions are this place used to be a Peppermill and someone reupholstered the banquets and added some cool lights over the bar.  We arrived a few minutes before our reservation and were seating about 20 mins later.  We were all excited looking over the menu as there are a variety of choices for about everyone in your group.  We ordered from their 'craft cocktail' choices and received our drinks.  The mules were served with wilted garnish.  The drinks themselves were nothing exciting and not on par with what one would expect from a 'craft cocktail' menu.  We ordered our food and received our salads/soup within 10 minutes.  The salad was fine but the soup arrived cold.  When we flagged down our waitress to let her know, she immediately shared this with the manager (who was standing at a terminal right behind our table).  He just shrugged his shoulders as if to say 'so what'.  The steaming soup came back out about 10 minutes later..... carried by the manager but passed off to someone else about ten feet from our table as he didn't want to deal with it.  Bread was served and it was one of the highlight s of the experience. Entrees were served.  All four entrees were some variation of steak and we all agreed it was fabulous.  Cooked and seasoned perfectly.  One entree was missing the vegetable side so this was pointed out to the server.  She got a menu and verified it should have been there.  A quick trip to the kitchen and out came a plate with literally three strands of asparagus.  We finished our meals and noted the entree with lobster was overcooked and way to chewy for lobster.  Next up, desserts were ordered.  Desserts were served and we pointed out they were not what we had ordered (after they were sitting on the table in front of us).  She picked them up and literally served them to the table next to us.  Pretty sure this is not standard restaurant protocol (especially with a somewhat contagious variant out there).   Chocolate cake desert was warm and decadent; banana desert was not exciting at all.  For the prices this place charges, i would expect consistently good food and drinks.  The service definitely needs work and the manager needs to decide if he is really in the right role (especially when there are so many mistakes made and he can't come to the table that is five feet away to at least apologize.... maybe comp the soup or something???)  Don't think we'll be rushing back anytime soon.

this is the worst establishment i've ever had the unfortunate privilege of having to order from several time cause of co-workers and family wanting to eat there stay away if at all possible if you order togo the dont make your food till you show up in store even if the app says its ready and if you complain or ask questions you just get a cold shoulder from management or told how its your fault for ordering online!!!!! had better luck ordering from downtown location they seem to have a better grasp on how to rum a business unlike the meridian location absolutely appalling how management treats customers and continue to get away with it without any accountability from a corporate level!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!! 


go to wing stop better wings and sauces!!!!

These guys came out to check out a washing machine and were able to the machine functioning correctly very quickly. Brandon and his apprentice were professional and top notch at every level. Great company to help you solve appliance issues. 
I will use them every time something comes up.

I would not recommend trying to shop for window coverings with them. My wife went in for a consultation, but they have too many cooks trying to stir the pot, so to speak.

First they send a guy out to do measurements, but he doesn't do the colors or style recommendations. Then she has to go in to the store and consult with a saleslady there who has never been to the site, seen the wall colors, or the setting and visibilities. The lady shows some sample styles, motor or manual, and colors. Then she sends my wife with some sample color swatches to see what she likes. Every try to see what colors and materials look like from a 2"x2" swatch? Doesn't work well to say the least.

In the meantime, we  got another store's advice and color choices in the new house. It was easy to see what looked better and was going to work with motorization. One person who visits on site, does the measurements, advises on brands, materials, styles and colors and gives the estimate. naturally, we found this a much more satisfying process and connection.

Anyway, back to Inspired Living, when they found out they tried to charge us $106 for the visit out for measurements. They said he was an independent contractor and had to be paid. They never told my wife that he was going to charge for that service.  My wife, if she had been told that would have said, NO! Free estimates are the SOP for window coverings. 

Now you can see why the one star review. Want to know what company we liked more, PM me on Yelp.

Have been here for two years have not found a place to do the French pink powder gel that look good.   
Been to about six salons and always they're OK or not really that good.  So happy that I found this place even though I had to drive an hour to get here it was well worth it for the holidays she did an awesome job!!   I don't mind paying if the work looks really good.   
Would recommend to anyone who is looking for something, other than an OK job on your nails.

So we arrive and sit down with in a timely manner, but tonight I was told "we serve our food when it's ready so you all will not get your food at the same time" 

this is ridiculous, what kitchen manager can't handle a 5 Top, since when did BWW decide they can't serve 5 people at the same table at the same time, any decent restaurant in town can handle a 5 top... 

by the way I'm not talking about a 5 minute difference, 3 of use got food and 25 minutes later the other two in my party got there food, we were told "sorry the fries took so long" the fries were freakin cold when we got them. 

this is the 2nd shitty experience we have had in the last 45 days. never again BWW.

Our first time here and definitely not our last time here! The only photo I got was our artichoke dip which was amazing!!!!!! I had the prime rib which to die for and my husband had the shrimp Alfredo which he said was delish, their apple
Bread pudding was amazing and ginormous!

What an amazing experience! I have shopped online with Plant Therapy (PT) for several years and so I know and trust their quality and corporate integrity. Being able to ask questions of their knowledgeable staff added a whole new level of happy to my experience. The oils are reasonably priced, sourced correctly, and even oils that aren't specifically labeled "organic" are sourced from places where they test out as pure. Unlike big multi-level companies, these oils are bottled from single batches and not mixed together, and report data can be easily acquired on their website. What a great place to smell many different oils and learn more about how they can help my family!

went to the Matador on a Saturday night, put our name on the list and was told the wait was around 90 minutes. There was a total of 8 and we were seated at a table just outside the kitchen/dish area. Our view for the entire dinner was of a dirty kitchen floor and food. Food was ok but had good flavor but my fajitas had about half a small chicken breast and was beyond grilled. Having been in food service for close to 15 years, I was disappointed in  how we were treated by hostess staff. She seemed to think she was something special. Just not impressed for the money we spent to have a special 20 year anniversary.

Going downhill. South of the border carnitas burrito was most rice, but worse bland and small. Charging extra for salsa when the gratuitous cups of salsa are very tiny is a Mexican restaurant travesty. They raised their prices without reflecting the new prices on the menu, small increase but it's a pretty shady business practice we heard other customers complain about. Lots of good reviews, and hardly any negative reviews... seems sketchy considering our table's experience was all around poor. Will not be returning.

Horrible service by a very rude person. Told us the wait wasn't very long and then refused to seat our party. Two adults and three little kids. But they took in the party that got there about 15min after us that had two adults and two little kids. Like our one extra kid was so much more for them to handle? It didn't make any sense. We waited for over 30 min while they kept seating others that got there after us. I will never ever go back to this place considering how rude the man at the counter seating people was. At least it saved our family from eating expensive and gross food from what the other reviews state.

Food poisoning!!

Service was great and our server was really nice, but.....


This isn't the first time this has happened at a Buffalo Wild Wings. This will be the last time I ever eat at one. Have absolutely horrific diarrhea from their food.

Buffalo's Wings are sub par quality compared to Wing Stop. I should have saved myself the sickness and gone there.

The first thought after I finished my workout today: I want pizza! Not the best after workout food, BUT definitely the most delicious! Blaze is perfect for someone who craves pizza but doesn't want to wait a long time for their food to be done. 

The fast food style pizza concept is so convenient. Walk down the aisle and choose from their plethora of toppings. I'm a huge fan of their pesto drizzled on my crust before baking. I also love that their pizzas are made in a wood fired oven. They have great indoor seating and are a quick hop off of eagle road!

The manager was amazing! I was having trouble with getting my app to work and he was so cooperative. He gave me a free drink for the trouble! The food is fast and delicious!

I was happy to see an R&R come to town. Do we need another BBQ place?? Probably not, but the nice thing is I feel like their service is faster than some of the other places. It's also a great place to go with a group! Everyone can order at the counter and pay for themselves. No bill to figure out at the table!! That's a bonus for sure!

I had the pork tacos with a side of sweet potato fries. I love their fries. They aren't quite a steak fry cut but they are bigger than your traditional fry. Perfect shape for dipping. They were cooked perfectly. Tacos had a good portion of BBQ sauced pork. Topped with a coleslaw and feta cheese. They tasted as you would expect. They were served with a green tomatillo sauce on the side. They didn't need the extra sauce but it added more flavor.

Stopped in here on a Saturday with a buddy after some time on the driving range. There was a family of 3 there and us. Other than that, fairly empty.

I ordered the 3-item lunch special with Sweet & Sour chicken, fried rice and egg flower soup. The soup came out immediately, piping hot. I had to throw a couple of ice cubes in it to cool it off. It was good, though.
The chicken and the rice came out about 4 minutes right after that. I guess it pays to visit when the place isn't busy.

My buddy had egg flower soup, fried rice and Mongolian beef with mild spice. It was made perfectly to order. The vegetables (onions and scallions) way outnumbered the beef in the dish, but it was still good.

The 3- or 4-item lunch special always includes an order of soup and rice that each counts as one of the items.

Two 3-item lunch specials came out to $19 before tip.
I'll visit this place again.

I just happened to notice on a trip to the nearby Kohl's. we have now been three times and loved it each time. Their carne asada is excellent! We are  recent transplants from San Diego, with its legendary Mexican food, so finding this absolutely thrilled us! 

The staff is friendly and efficient, too.

We've taken our dog to Classi K-9 Clips around 5 times. They charge $50 to groom my goldendoodle which is by far the cheapest in the valley. I'm not particular at all when it comes to grooming - as long as she smells decent and doesn't have mats after she comes out, I'm happy. But for the past few times, she's come out with cuts and burns and they never mention it to me or my husband when we pick her up. This last time, she has had a hard time sitting down and I couldn't figure out why until I saw her tail. There are huge burn marks ALL OVER the underside of it. Any professional would know that they need to cool down the razor every once and a while. Spend the extra money and go elsewhere.

The food here is excellent. We have eaten here several times and it is consistently good. The only reason for deducting a star is, I have found in recent months that the servers are not particularly friendly (not all, just some of the newer ones) - not bad service, just not stellar.

Oof. I ordered the $15.99 teriyaki combo, the bill came and it was listed for $21.99. We asked them about it and the waitress got the manager. We explained and she said "I'll fix it"... came back and it was marked down to $19.99..... we said no that's still wrong.. the manager got pissy and grabbed the check "I'll fix it". No I'm not lying... it came back at $16.50...... for real. We said "it's only .50 but you need to fix it or we're not paying". She yelled at me "16.50 cheaper then $15.99". It was embarrassing and not even worth the $15.99! Don't even waste your time.

Stopped in for the first time here at Blaze Pizza. I loved it!  I chose to build my own pizza which is why next time I'll chose one of the menu ones.  I wasn't able to get the right taste together. Liked the stove that fires the pizza and the crust was delicious.

Ask literally anybody I know -- Crave Delivery has changed my life. It's healthy (besides the cake and pizza maybe!). It's fast. It's euphorically delicious. I'm pretty sure it's less expensive than going to a sit-down restaurant with the same quality of food. 

Let me tell you how bad my obsession is: I ALWAYS have an order ready, or I tweak it during the week before I finally treat myself. It's that good, with SO many options. 

Also, how are these guys killing it with every new restaurants they add?! The boba, the mexican food, the sushi, the bbq, the pastries and desserts... it's all phenomenal. I'm in love. 

The downsides are minor, but may limit certain types of eaters, especially with food allergies. You can't make any requests, no matter how small it is. For example, I can't order an item without cucumbers (where they're toppings and non-essential for the dish) for my boyfriend because he's allergic. 

Also, the app is rather glitchy. When you scroll, you'll accidentally click on a dish all the time. It also frequently asks me to log in even though I'm clearly logged in when I click on my profile.

The only dishes I've ever had issues with were the Basque Burrito (which was amazing the first time we tried it, but has been inconsistent in quality), and the Lox Bagel sandwich (very plain and bland). But if you try their Southern Fun, Boy-See-Boy NY Pizza, Queso Flameado, Jezebel Roll (note: extreme heat fans only, I can barely handle it and I've had restaurants challenge my heat tolerance before), Tokyo Hot Chicken meals or Iced Lavender Vert, I guarantee it's a good time. 

I love you, Crave. Don't worry about alerting my boyfriend -- he knows.

I waited for around 8 minutes or so before my server came and offered me a beverage.  The food was very good, I had a cobb salad and my guest had the nacho's, he really liked them.  I'd come back again but I think I'd sit at the bar, the service was a little slow at the beginning of our visit but overall not a bad experience.

It's almost as if they try to mess up your order. You order a double, you get a single. You order a medium, you get a small.  And then when you ask about it, all you get is deer in the headlights stares.

I shall name this place SNOBBY LOBBY....
My sister-in-law and I went in the other day looking for wedding items. A "clerk" showed up...didn't bother even asking if we needed help. And as she watched us out of the corner of her eye...we finally requested to know where the colored sand was. She looked at us and "motioned"  with her pointing finger that what we were looking for was over there....what the heck does over there mean ?  Really!!  Oh ok....  We went "over there" which was a couple of isles over and on the very bottom...thanks for your assistance there "clerk lady"...  Got all that we thought we needed.  Went to the check out line and encountered the most "non-friendly non-curteous" check out lady ever !!  She had the look of drinking butter milk on her fact the whole time....
We purchased a cake topper that was fragile....it got shoved into the bottom of the bag. And when I requested that it be removed and placed into a separate bag to keep from the chance of breakage...I got a definate roll of the eyes.......and it was taken out and "roughly" placed on the counter and shoved into another bag ...and was handed the bag with a snide "here".........  I am thinking "oh wow" !! 
If that wasn't bad enough.....
We made a quick trip to Walmart to check out "wedding albums"....and of course they didn't have the one that my sister--in-law had in her "brides mind"......and remembered that Hobby Lobby had them.........as I hung my head in a.......ok....we went back to Hobby Lobby.
As we just got to the isle with the wedding items...the lights were being turned out...ok..we KNOW it's time to hurry.  As my sister-in-law picked up an album (already opened out of the box)  a clerk showed up...asked in a very hurried voice that they were closing.,,,and just about that time the "finger pointer clerk" showed up....grabbed the album out of my sister-in-laws hand and said "you are NOT to open any boxes" !!!!! My sister-in-law calmly said "I didn't it was already open".  And the "finger pointer clerk' said "well whatever...we are closing and we don't want to have to call security".  Oh what the what ?!?!?!?   Oh hell to the no !!!    And as my sister-in-law and I walked off " "the finger pointer clerk said: "wel-l-i-i-i...I hope you have a great night". 
Will I be back ?  NO NO NO !!!   I will do without before I EVER EVER go back into that place.  
My advice: if you hate your job so much........step aside and let someone who really would like to have a paycheck and would show some curteous customer service have it.

This is our go-to date restaurant. For a chain place, as opposed to a cozy local joint, it is surprisingly fabulous. The food is always stellar, and the service is great. We typically get the "early bird" special, and spend just under $30, and leave stuffed to the gills with leftovers. The bread is indulgent, and the salads are lovely. The steak itself is always high quality, tasty and cooked perfectly. I love that they offer a baked sweet potato as one of their sides. 

We have never once had a bad experience there.

My husband and I went on a date here and we were pleasantly surprised! We ordered one of the meals for to, it was a bit pricey, but for how much food came with it!! Wow!!! Full full plates!! And it tasted amazing! We almost got some sushi, the dynamite roll was soooooo sooo excellent! Best one I had ever had! We will be returning very soon for another date!! It was soo good! The waitress was very tentative and kept our drinks full, she was happy and smiley.

haven't been out for Mexican food in awhile, but moving usually means not cooking as much as before. So the other night after a hard day of moving, we thought-It is time for Mexican cooking.

Having seen the good reviews for Pueblo Lindo, we thought that we would give it a try. Glad we did. Friendly service staff with smiles on their face and with plenty of advice on what we might like. They asked what brought us in and if we were new? We said, yes, and told them we heard that they had good food.

Well, we were not led astray. The carne asada street tacos were some of the best we have had. They let you add your own salsa-just like i appreciate. Nothing worse than soggy tacos. The salsa and chips were especially addicting. We did in two bowls of it and the Mexican style cole slaw; even this green adverse diner. Washed it all down with a good and cold Mexican beer and what more can one ask for.

My wife tried the chili rellano and spinach enchilada. I thought they were very good, but she prefers chili rellano with jack cheese instead of yellow/cheddar(?) cheese. But probably difference in tastes. She loved one of my carne asada tacos and she though that was what the next visit will call to her. I could go for the tongue tacos next time.

Great to have a good place so close by and we will be back.

I went to R & R BBQ for the first time on 4/26/21 in Meridian ID. I had the three meat plate with sliced brisket, spicy andouille sausage and the Highly Rated "Championship" ribs. Sides were hush puppies and potato salad. The hush puppies were delicious. Fried to a golden brown, not to dense, great flavor with a hint of jalapeño. Potato salad was very good. The brisket was very moist and tender with a good smoke on it. Flavor was outstanding! The Andouille sausage was smoked just right. It was spicy, but not to spicy. And then there was the "Championship" ribs. A tougher Rib I don't believe I've ever had! It was a fight to get a bite off the bone. Another fight ensued trying to chew it! Flavor was lost in the struggle. Very Very disappointed. I was excited to hopefully have another good BBQ Restaurant to frequent, but I think I'll pass on R & R BBQ. In my opinion, as the ribs go, so goes the BBQ Restaurant.

BEST customer service
BEST staff
BEST car wash
BEST convenience store
Love this business, I recommend it to everyone. Keep up the good work

Horrible customer service. The lobby was unlocked, and they wouldn't let us order because they "accidentally forgot to lock it." Then we attempted to walk through the drive through and they declined our service there as well. Absolutely ridiculous

We have now been here a few times and every time has been a great experience. Even tonight being severely short staffed these lady servers worked their butts off. The wait tonight was a little longer and despite this the servers got us everything and hustled to ensure we got everything we needed. 

Tonight we had a great meal...my wife had the carne asada and camarones (shrimp) platter and I had the carnitas plate. Everything was super delicious and my plate was cooked perfectly with the right amount of crisp on the carnitas. I ended up sneaking a bite of the carnitas and cooked perfectly medium rare. Also to wash everything down were 2 top shelf margaritas. This is such a great local Boise spot and will add everyone needs to be patient with restaurants based on staffing problems. These folks that are showing up to work their shifts deserve our grace and patience.

I love my visits, people are kind and very helpful. They  help you feel right at home and comfortable. Professional helping you choose the best for you. Would recommend Rain Spa and Salon to all my Family and Friends. Thank you all for being

This place does not take reservations and you takes your chances to get in. But, I wouldn't bother since when we go there on a Tuesday night at 6 pm, it was a 25 minute wait. But in a sardine crowded dining area, it was all high chairs and dated booths. And noisy is an understatement. You would have needed a megaphone to converse.

I did look at the menu and didn't see my favorite a ribeye steak. Putting this all together, we decided to eject and leave.

I absolutely love this groomer! The owner, Angela, is so sweet, and is super responsive for appointments and special requests! I recently adopted a border collie who is afraid of pretty much everyone, but is especially cautious around men. So for this reason, I have asked for female groomers only, and they have accommodated my request with no question! I have already booked our second grooming appointment because Reno seemed to have enjoyed it so much  
Not only is the customer service on point, but you can't beat the convenience of the mobile service!

This was my first time trying any ramen restaurant, and they have set the bar incredibly high! I had the Spicy Miso, and it was absolutely delicious. Every bite was a taste of heaven! My server was also the host, runner, and busser, yet the service was still great! Definitely will be back soon!
Quality of wood and prices are the main factor of my review. I must admit the service is not that far off either.

This place is pretty rough. My husband and I used to love KK but I don't think we'll be coming back to this one. The last two times we've come has been because the hot, fresh donuts light was on and each time we were told that they "forgot to turn it off." Also, both times, we ordered a dozen only to get home to find out that they were the wrong ones. Check the box before you drive away, noted. By looking at other reviews it seems that this isn't an uncommon occurrence.

Worst experience at a Krispy Kreme ever! First of all the lady taking our order was very rude. They didn't have ANY doughnuts so she got upset when we would order something they didn't have "at that location". I love Krispy Kreme and have been going to them for years so I'm extremely disappointed.

Not safe for individuals with food allergies. I have Celiac Disease, and I called ahead to confirm there were gluten free options. The gentleman I spoke to said the staff was knowledgeable and they would be very accommodating for me. Unfortunately, the waitress was not as understanding. She looked at me like I was stupid when I asked what was in certain rolls and I explained I can't eat gluten. I love Philadelphia rolls, and she kept saying "It's just fish and cream cheese." Thank goodness I inspected the rolls before consuming them. What first tipped me off that it may not be safe is there was a piece of chopped tomato on one of the rolls, which should not be in Philadelphia rolls at all. When I looked closer, I found two of the rolls had roe (fish eggs) on them, which shouldn't be in the Philadelphia rolls either and I know for a fact they are not gluten free. I could've become violently ill if I had eaten those rolls. I was very disappointed in the service and the food quality. I will not be dining here again.

Went to dinner here. Due to so many people being here, we had an hour wait. When we finally got seated, the selection of beers was incredible. The dinner we ordered was excellent. The filet was perfect. While I have the Yard House 5 stars, I did have an issue with the choice of beers. When I travel, I like to drink local. Their local selection was non existent. If I wanted the large selection of beers, I can get those at home. Aside from that, dinner and beers were excellent.

I love mom 'n pop (local) hamburger joints. You can tell they pull out all the stops when it comes to their food. Don't live too far from this place and I knew I'd hit them up sooner or later. My mouth was watering waiting in the drive-thru, especially when I find out it may be a bit of a wait as they make everything to order. 

Got a burger (this Asian can't do cheese), onion rings and corn dogs. Couldn't wait to get home and dig into this stuff. Alas, the burger was okay. My friend had the corn dogs and she really liked them. The stand out was the onion rings. They aren't hidden or swimming in dough or super greasy. Well, they did leave some big-o grease stains on the bag, but they didn't appear to be greasy when eating them. They taste best with fry sauce as ketchup kills the onion flavor - you just taste ketchup. Yes, local Idahoians, this transplant is learning to appreciate fry sauce. 

To date, the BEST burger I've had out here was at a grill in the Hyde Park neighborhood. Not fair to name the place here. So, as far as I'm concerned, this place is Main Street Onion Rings to me. Watch out arteries, I see possible onion ring binges in my future.

This is my go to spot when I visit SLC. I flipped when I saw that we got a location up here. I love bbq and this is the spot to get it.  5 stars in Orem only 4 here. I think they are still getting it going here.  Still good. Pulled pork and slaw are guaranteed winners.

This is a great restaurant. Best Mexican food  in the Boise area! See my 8 yo. review below:

"Hi guys, this food is amazing & deliciously yummy. This is best Mexican restaurant we've ever been  to!"

Worst service I've ever experienced. I went inside to place an order, after being passed by twice by the same employee, observed by three others, the drive thru employee asked me, "do you need something?" I had been inside at the counter for 7 minutes at that point. I told her I would to place an order, she told me that I needed to go through the drive thru to do so. I went through thr drive thru, and by the time I'd reached the window I'd been at Carl's Jr for 25 minutes. I had my payment collected by the same employee that walked past me twice without acknowledging me while I was inside. I was then told to pull into a parking space to wait for my order. I politely declined citing I had already waited inside then was instructed to wait outside. Another employee demanded I pull forward. I again politely declined. My order was simple, consisted of 3 items commonly ordered, and I had already waited 25 minutes, so I felt I may be forgotten if I pulled I to a parking spot. My window was pounded on, and I was told to move into a parking spot. I again politely declined. She refused to serve me, canceled my order and said, "now you can leave!" I don't think I deserved that considering I had already done what she asked, and had waited 25 minutes for a cheeseburger, fries, and fry sauce. She refused to provide my order, and then glared at me while I counted my refund. I went to a Wendy's after being refused service from
Carl's Jr teenaged staff member, and as I drove past on my way home from Wendy's, the car that was in front of me was STILL waiting in the parking lot.

My family and I met our friends here for dinner. They were able to accommodate for our party of 11 with no problems. Server was so friendly and warm. She checked on us regularly, refilled our drinks and the kids drinks and the food came out in a timely manner. We did not have to wait long for our food. Overall it was a pleasant experience. We would definitely come back again.
Austin rocks!! Thank you so much! There's not a lot of customer service that is so positive anymore!! We are here from Sacramento and we are very impressed with dinner!!!

For the menu price point our dinner fell way short of expectations. Buffalo Wings appetizer came out with cool inner temp. Sent them back, which server cheerfully did, and they came back out have clearly been nuked and dunked in more sauce. They were now a hot and soggy mess. I ordered the 8 oz Prime rib, medium rare. It arrived with at least 2 oz of fat and gristle running through the center, overcooked on one side, raw on the other - how does that even happen?? Garlic fries were half soggy from something - it this point I was over this meal. My husband's halibut was over grilled to the point of being of stringy texture. At this point HE was done with this restaurant. Server was inattentive and forgetful. Just writing this place off and won't be back.

Latest update:  We are proof that there is justice to be had with Puppyland

Puppyland withdrew their final appeal of a judgment in an Idaho case where Puppyland was caused of selling to us a mixed breed dog sourced from JAKs, who was found by the Iowa AG to have been involved in a puppy laundering scheme in that state; and misrepresenting those mixed breed dogs as high-end pure breed dogs with phony documentation.

Their customer contract was also found by the Judge to be extremely misleading & the Idaho AG's office to have at least one illegal provision penalizing customers from publicly providing honest feedback about Puppyland.

Puppyland withdrew and accepted the Judgement within an hour of discovery requests being submitted to the court demanding evidence of puppy sourcing and other documentation attempting to validate their source of puppies and other evidence of misconduct.

If you are heading into a legal battle with Puppyland, we can help you learn the lessons we learned and leverage our success.

The food here is really good!  But if you have less than optimal vision... bring a magnifying glass.  The print on their menus is super tiny!  It's nearly impossible for my dad to read and I'm having a hard time too.  

Dang... forgot my magnifying glass again... Good thing we already know what we want!  If you haven't tried it yet, the roadkill is very tasty!
Best steak I've had in town so far! going to take my wife again on our anniversary.
this place is beyond crap nothing tasted like what it was supposed to be pita nahhhh burrito this place like a ghetto mexican place the server gave us free cookies like what pita shit
One of my favorite places to eat. Build your own pita, subway style. Portions are big, very filling and satisfying.

Kate and Mackenzi are wonderful! They were so supportive and so friendly! I found the dress of my dreams thanks to them (a dress that Kate and Mackenzi picked for me!). I am taking my mom back to see it later this month. 

Kate's Bridal Cottage is a small, intimate experience that every bride should have!

First time visit today, 12-27-21, when visiting some cousins. Would LOVE a place like this in the Nampa/Caldwell area. What a great spot for some food, drinks and a good time. 

Menu has many choices for food, which I have to say the Mac n Cheese was darn good, and the full bar and extensive beer list offer many choices to compliment the meal. 

They offer both high table and low table seating options with soMe seating available at the bar as well. A couple of long tables can serve well for a large party or to be shared amongst others. 

Quite a few TV's to view if your favorite sports team happens to be playing. All of this makes for a great place to meet friends and enjoy some down time!

Dont know what happened, as this used to be my favorite burger spot, but tonite was terrible. The service was bad, the food wrong twice and then cold. The workers being loud and obnoxious behind the counter. The girl that brought our food out was very rude. I have never had issues here and am still in shock. Very disappointed.

I've seen the sign for this place out on Overland for the past week or 2, so I grabbed the kids and came in for a treat Tuesday afternoon.  Entreat is located in the same little strip as Dickies, but in the back where it's hard to see from Overland.  The first thing I noticed upon walking in is that this place is BORING!  2 walls painted a purplish color, 3 pics on the right side wall, the menu on the left.  3 or 4 small round tables with clear acrylic chairs, and nothing else!  I was expecting more of a sweet shoppe, along the lines of Powell's at Bown Crossing, but this is really just a soda and cookie shop.  That's fine.  There are plenty of options for sodas, but only 4 cookies to choose from, sugar, chocolate chip, snickerdoodle, and I forget the 4th.  The cookies are good, but nothing special.  I ordered a Green River, which is soda water, double watermelon flavoring, basil, and fresh lime.  It was very tasty, and the kids enjoyed their drinks as well.  The prices are a little misleading, b/c they charge you for each ingredient in the sodas, even their concoctions.  So my 24 oz Green River was $1.25 for the base, and ended up costing $2.70.  This is never explained, and there aren't prices by the individual drinks, so you just have to count how many ingredients the drink you choose has, and do the math yourself.  

Anyway, I can't imagine this place will be here long, and I doubt the kids will be clamoring to come back.  They seemed rather bored here as well, and I'm sure next time they'd rather just go to one of the many Fro-yo shops in the area.
The food quality and taste are good. The BBQ nachos can use more meat ingredients. The prices are a bit steep for their options. The restaurant is spacious and clean.

We are looking for a corgi and when we called them and asked the price they said they don't give prices out over the phone.   It was a 2 hour drive from our plaice to their location  and so i told them that.  they were not at all understanding.   Then when we did arrive we were required to give a Picture ID just to talk to someone...1 red flag.  When we did talk to the staff I said I wanted to know the cost of a Corgi puppy.  She tried to get us to look at them first and interact with them before telling us the price.  We refused and asked again.  She told us it was $4,450.00 for a puppy.  Which is double what all my research on cost of them had shown. Not good.  we turned around and left without looking at a puppy.

As a Texas native I was pretty excited to try out this tex mex spot. I had been craving enchiladas all week so I ordered the enchiladas poblanos with shredded chicken and certainly was pleased. The queso fundido wasn't my favorite but I'm super picky about queso and finished it all anyways. My mom ordered the enchiladas Verdes and between both of our leftovers I'll be eating enchiladas happily all weekend!

Obviously we are regulars at Jaker's.  Our waitress in the bar last Saturday night, Emma, was the BEST we've ever had!  She was a doll and was attentive without bugging us, and was so sweet.  It was obvious she knew her profession and was very comfortable with people, and knew how to do her job.  What a nice young woman ... I can see her a Manger in the future!  Thanks sweet Emma .. we'll make sure to be in your section next time.

I really love this place, I've eaten both inside and takeout and they do amazing both ways. It's consistent and yummy every time with friendly staff and the food is ready pretty quick! I go here often and it has become my favorite place to eat!
I have tried multiple dog grooming services in the area and this is by far my favorite. Great price and even better service

Do not go!!!! Read before thinking of going. Every. Single. Time. I go. there's an issue. From forgetting a drink to never making the food properly to empty jalapeño poppers. It's ridiculous and I've had enough. There's other places to go to to spend out money. We the people control if they stay in business or not. No more will I go there for their crap attitudes to the crap food they continue to make.

Ok matador. I know you have your hands full right now but it is thankful Thursday!  I'm sure I'm not the only one to be thankful for this meridian location but just know that I appreciate the break I get when I come in!

I have had the chance to visit many times to enjoy the food but it is your front of house personnel (every one of them) that keep me coming back!

I can't wait to see you all,,

Double cheeseburger, extra cheese. Order it. Order it right now. This is what burger dreams are made of. Pure love and perfection. Toasted buttery bun, gooey cheese, charbroiled meat, paired with juicy crunchy vegetables.... I need another bite of my husband's burger! Haha! 

The night crew tore it up! Officially our go to burger place

Looking for for an upscale, delicious new place to feel like a movie star that won't require taking a 2nd mortgage? Definitely come try Land and Ocean. The menu is so diverse and everything we ordered was fresh and flavorful. Grilled artichoke had a fantastic dipping aioli, the fresh chips with blue cheese dip were perfectly crunchy and golden brown (I'm not a huge fan of blue cheese, but if you are you'll love it) and the spicy tuna on black rice and spinach was absolutely incredible. I honestly can't wait to get hungry again so we can come back and try the mussels and fish and chips. And everything else. The hostess, server and food runner were all perfectly attentive without being intrusive. AND... almost every table is a big, cozy, private feeling booth! I Love this place!

Back for a second dinner in a week. 5PMish and the tables started to fill. This time we had a Shrimp Ramen and an order of broccoli and beef.The shrimp ramen was good, but my favorite is still the Tantanmen ramen as it is the spiciest. The server said we will make any ramen spicy as you like it. So next time.....

The broccoli and beef was actually quite good. Broccoli was fresh and still crunchy and the beef was also tasty and of good quality. I like my B&B with a hint of oyster sauce, but that is just my personal cooking style. Served with a bowl of white rice, there was enough B&B for two; just order another rice and you are good. I would not be afraid to try other dishes, such as the Yakisoba and/or chicken dishes. By the cooking style, I am betting they are Chinese cooks rather than Japanese or Korean. Surprisingly, their food is not overly salty or oily.

This is a great place. Hope they will vary the menu occasionally.

Reviewer no. 2

This Maverik is located on the corner of Meridian Rd and Franklin Blvd in Meridian. It has a very large corner lot with several fuel pumps, a picnic table, air dispenser (takes credit/debit) and is located directly next door, and shares a parking lot, with Mountain America Credit Union. It opened late Summer 2017.

Inside is an updated Maverik with a bakery inside. At this bakery, you can view the menu and order fresh food to be made, almost like fast food, including whole pizzas, which is unlike many of the old Maverik's where they just make food and place it in the hot case. This one does not have a Cinnabon inside. There are tables and chairs for you and your crew to eat at, which again, is unlink many Maverik's and leans toward a fast food atmosphere. 

They have a large selection of drinks from coffee, tea, soda to Icee's, iced coffee, and flavor shots (cherry, vanilla, lime, lemon). For your coffee is fresh liquid creamer and flavored creamer ( you don't have to open those little annoying plastic containers), and other fun needless calories like dried marshmallows. 

Maverik is a fun place to shop. You earn rewards on your purchases, have virtual punch cards to redeem free items (10th soda and food item is free), they have an app where you can review your points. I generally trade my points in monthly for a $10 Maverik card which I then give to the kids for gum or snack before school. With this app (Maverik card) you earn 2 cents off per gallon of fuel as well. You can also get the Maverik card linked to your checking account and you earn 6 cents off per gallon and the card works as a check and will clear the bank a few days later. 

Something I hadn't seen before is the one stop shop sinks they have in the bathroom (see my video). The bathroom sink has an automated soap dispenser on the far left, followed by the automatic water dispenser in the middle, followed by a blow dryer on the far right. You never leave the sink to dry your hands. Perhaps this is new technology elsewhere, but this is the first time I've seen this and I think it's pretty cool. 

The staff-- they are ALL super friendly. Everyone I've come in contact with-- from the General Manager to all the crew, I've not had a bad experience and of this writing, I've been in over 20 times, and each one has been a great experience.

I have been going to Dr Summers for about 3 years now and with my hectic work schedule (I travel for work) I have had amazing results. He listens to my symptoms and always has a solution followed up with stretching and exercises to help maintain my  symptoms while I'm on the road.
The Pozole was so good! The right amount of flavor, not watery, and not too oily. Highly recommend. Will be coming back. 10/10

Do you enjoy dry bbq? Flavorless sides? Come here! Brisket was terrible for the price, pulled pork was actually decent compared to our flavorless mac... dry tough bbq is here to stay I guess.
No different than dickies bbq for a lot less money. 
You'd never catch me dead paying these prices for this horrid cheap dry bbq... when your grasping for a nearest drink to get the bbq down.. its terrible.

YOUR MEAY SHOULD NOT NEED SAUCE TO BE EDIBLE.

Sorry to say Jake, that we were somewhat disappointed this evening... and, we normally are 5+ consistant fans!  We normally have Dan as our waiter, but he was working the bar ... so we had a new guy who had his rehearsed speal down, which after hearing twice was too rehearsed, and seemed non personal.  Your bar is known for casual, and tonight the vibe changed.  You need to tell the guys in the back to change their oil in the fryers ... my finger steaks were so greasy, I didn't eat them all, which is unusual.  The guy next to me at the bar didn't eat his onion rings, which is crazy as normally they are killer. One of the peep at our table had the fresh salmon on a plank, but it wasn't exciting, and the plate looked sooooooo bland and uninviting, and it was on your special card this evening.  Your restaurant was BUSY tonight, which is great, but the food suffered and needs to be up to snuff, and the waitstaff needs to be on their toes.  Of course, we'll come back as it is our neighborhood spot ... even tho we have to drive for 20 miles to get there!!  We love your place, and I am writing this with respect to you.
Love their happy hour. Good price and even better food. My favorites are the chicken nachos, boneless Buffalo wings, margarita pizza, and spinach dip.

I went to see Michelle for a cut and balayage. I was a blonde looking to go back to brunette. I arrived 10 mins before my appointment time and Michelle arrived 3 minute late.
I showed her pictures of how I wanted my hair to look and told her about my concerns. She was quick to say "uh huh, ok!" and get to work. She told me halfway through that she never uses permanent color and only uses a semi or demi colors. I started researching to find out these colors wash out in 10-24 washes. As someone who is willing to pay hundreds of dollars for color, I want it to last. After asking her questions she seemed to become annoyed with me and starting rushing. She was absolutely rough when washing my hair and didn't even wait for the water to warm up before rinsing. After the torture of the wash came the blow dry.... she had a nozzle on the dryer and had it so close to my head that she kept burning me and I would yank away. After all was said and done my color came out a lot darker than any of the pictures I showed her and does not blend well. I am devastated. And Michelle knew it too. She didn't even ask what I thought of it as she was rushing me out because he next client arrived. I had color on my forehead and cheeks from her rush job which I had to remind her again to take it off.
To end the humiliation she wanted to take pictures of her "work" by having me stand facing a wall and fluff my hair up. 
I am incredibly disappointed about my service here. The salon itself was very posh and nice, but I will not be going back.

The food and atmosphere is great but the server Anthony is absolutely THE BEST!  He should win best server award in the Treasure Valley!  Great personality, great service, very attentive, and great menu suggestions!  You have a gem!
Sakana Eagle Rd. Meridian is my go-to sushi restaurant even though I live in Southwest Nampa.

CLOSED !!!!!
Well there is some justice in the world, these two crummy Mexican Food place went belly up in the last week or so.

God they were awful. No local cooking and salty as all get out. No bread or small loss. Ate a t both and that was a big mistake.
I left the honest review below and they responded with their email address to make it right. I sent two emails with zero response. I guess it's just lip service. Won't be returning.

The ramen was very good! We had the Tonkatsu and the broth was delicious the chasu pork was thinly sliced and super flavorful.  I got their "meal deal" and got half an appetizer for $3 more and got the spicy shrimp wonton, which was honestly amazing.  Highly recommend!  The service was quick and attentive, and she gave great recommendations.  Enjoy!
