They are usually pretty good. But tonight's take home meal was really really bad.  The pizzas were burnt and really thin and their bolognese was not the same. No more wide noodles and different sauce.  So sad.

You would have never known by simply driving as we did for over a year.  Kahootz fits the definition of a hidden gem here in Meridian. Finally a local suggested we try it and boy are we happy we did!

Everything on the menu is made in-house, and they do an excellent job.  Some things to watch for, Friday and Sat are Prime Rib special nights and it's delicious!  Also keep an eye out for the chef's special/seasonal menu, usually it has some really tasty items on there.

One simple dish that will really catch you off guard is their Reuben, it's crazy good.  Again everything from the meat, bread, and Russian sauce all made in house and you can tell.

The only negative I could possibly muster is don't expect a full bar.  They specialize in draft taps and have an excellent selection.  There are a couple alcoholic beverages they can make but not many.

Pricy but has to be the best gas station in all of Boise. Well worth it in my opinion. I go here very often just for the sheer variety with everything. There's even some non traditional stuff like bath bombs.

When you think of the quintessential Cigar Lounge exactly what you find at The Vault comes to mind.  Warm exposed brick walls and wood rafters, inviting and comfortable leather chairs and decent sized walk-in humidor with a fantastic selection.  Couple TVs if you need some entertainment. However more times than not a good friendly conversation will be more entertaining.  Need a drink to enjoy with your favorite stick, they have a small selection of local 22oz bottled beer and assorted Japanese Sake.  Really a hidden gem in downtown Meridian.

I think even my age-old Chili's nostalgia is not enough to keep me coming back. I have so many memories at Chili's and I feel like I am writing an obituary but the last time we went, everything was just bad. The service was attentive but what they said about the appetizers and food that we ordered was off. We wanted specific things so we asked if menu items would fulfill those things and were horribly mislead. It really was not a "bad" experience, but it was frustrating. If I am going out to eat, which I do more than I should, I want to be sure that my food is what I am expecting. Don't get me wrong, I do not have super high expectations for a food chain restaurant, but I do expect to have honest service and decent food and neither of those things happened today. Also, the margarita was really heavy in the mix and light on the tequila but that is expected.

I'm a steak guy  Texas Roadhouse gotta be the best steakhouse in Idaho and come here all the time Elena,K8tlyn and Demi great attitudes wonderful service.
GUARANTEED TO COME BACK.
Good food. Decent service. My mom and I went here the other day. The fish tacos were good. The queso was good. My mom enjoyed her margarita. I wish they would've refilled my water more.

This was our first visit and I wasn't real impressed. Husband had the honey BBQ bacon burger and the patty tasted frozen. I had the grilled chicken wrap which was not bad but it wasn't the best quality either. It was just a step above fast food. The patio is nice but the music was blaring with bad 80's music right over our heads. There wasn't anywhere you could sit on the patio to get away from it.  We won't be going back.

Okay so this place has a bar feel for sure and is always jam packed with people BUT the food is super super good. It was cramped but like I said good. Only reason I took a star was that I felt claustrophobic.

Normally love Matador but haven't been to this location. We got the fajitas for two - to go... almost $50 after all was said and done and the steak part of it was great... but they forgot to give us tortillas, and the rest of it was basically a giant pile of onions.  Not sure how to eat fajitas without tortillas especially with the ratio here. Super disappointed :(

The food was delicious, there was so many meals and drinks to choose from and the waiters where do nice.
I would 100% recommend trying it

We had an excellent experience at Texas Roadhouse. My sister was in town and my husband and I wanted to show her a fun time and dining experience. We had issues at another restaurant and started out the evening rocky. We decided to ditch the other spot and try Texas Roadhouse. Best thing we could have done because of Sarah (Anne) who served us at the bar. She made our evening and added such a personal bubbly touch to our evening. We felt like she was our bestie by the end of the meal. Highly recommend requesting her next time you are in!

Just tried to go to Buffalo Wild Wings to watch the Nascar Chamionship. Out of all the TVs they have they would not switch one of them off of football to watch the race. I thought this was a sports bar and not a football bar.

First time here, and we were all happy with our meals. My husband and I agreed his vegetarian burrito is the best we had. I liked the Pueblo Lindo Salad better than other taco salads. My daughter finally found a pazole close to what a Spanish Class classmate had brought (his dad's recipe) that wasn't too spicy for her, because they bring extra herbs to spice to your liking. One star removed for the bone fragment my daughter found in one of the pieces of meat in her pazole. Excellent service.
Prime rib is melt in your mouth and the sirloin is fabulous.  The best beef at the best prices in the area.  We try to go early because it's always crowded and for good reason.  We love it.

The Donut + Dog is AMAZING!!! They have amazing customer service and the most delicious brioche donuts and flavors ever! Make sure you go early because you can't rush a 20 hour rise on dough, so when they're gone, they're gone. 
The coffee and the donuts are absolutely worth the wait in line or the early morning wake up! The brown butter latte was heavenly. We will be back soon for their lunch special!
Love the atmosphere, their gourmet menu items, their CREME BRULEE! The waitstaff is so kind, I've never felt rushed and they always answer my questions. One of my favorite restaurants.

Best Mexican restaurant I've been to in years.  Highly recommend!  Excellent taste and quality fresh ingredients.  We ordered steak fajitas and a poblano carnitas burrito.  The vegetables were fresh.  The meats were well seasoned and tender not chewy.  The carnitas burrito had a flavorful traditional Mexican seasoning taste.  The fajitas steak was well seasoned, juicy, thick, and tender.  The chips and salsa were amazing.  The salsa was fresh and had a nice blended texture, and just the right amount of heat - very mild, but lots of flavor.  The salsa is not tomato paste or watered down or has so much heat that your mouth goes numb - it is just right.  Service was excellent.  Atmosphere I would say is targeted more towards young adults not so much for kids.  Prices are reasonable for the quality.  I look forward to going again and trying different dishes.

Its always been the best great prime rib, so we went,  we thought alittle early. It was our 31st Anniversary and at 7:00pm. No PrimeRib. Not even 1. So he got aTbone and i got a blooming Onion. Disappointed we took it and went home. It was a Thursday

We went through the drive through at 9:15pm and their signs say they close at 10pm. There were 8 employees in the window that we could see and some even looked at us in our car and pretended they didn't see us!!!! What? We waited and then just went somewhere else. They were all just sitting around talking. Are you open or not??

The service is mixed. Some of the staff are competent, professional, and friendly. Others do not answer their phones or are consistently unavailable when you call back, a minute later. Then they wait 24+ hours to return your call. When you call back, they are once again unavailable for another 24 hours. I was told that some people are working from home and that may be part of the problem.

Ordering online seems great until you hit a snag. I now have spoken to 6 different people over 10 days and no one can figure out what happened to my order. It is not nuclear fission, or deciphering genetic code.  It's just an order for three small items.And no one seems to know what to do, although several seem concerned and tried to help. And instead of music while you wait on hold, enjoy the overwrought two people touting the company's sincere commitment to help you through this terrible pandemic. Over and over and over. I never thought I would hunger for elevator hold music, but it would be an improvement.
This was the first time we ate at the Boise Texas Road House. We wasn't disappointed.  We love Teaxas Road House. We was on vacation will eat there again next ti.e we are in town

I'll warn you in advance: this review will be long.
I came in here for a wash on a Sunday with my kids since they love the car wash! We got the highest package they offered. 
When we first entered the wash, two young men used a pressure washer to blow off the front of the car to get off any bugs. During this process, he yelled out something about "pressure". We finished through the car wash and when I pulled over to vacuum the car, I had 4 areas on my hood where the paint was blown off. 
I was shocked as I've never had this happen in all the times I've gone through a car wash. I spoke the the gentleman on duty who was the supervisor. He took my information and told me the manager would call me the next day. 
The next day came and went and no one called. I called the day after that and left a message for the car wash manager to call me back. He never did. So I went into the car wash and spoke with the manager (Victor) who told me my info was sent to corporate and he would call me back possibly the next day but no later than a week after it happened. Victor never returned my call. I called on Friday to check in and was told Victor was out until Tuesday for a medical reason but they took my info down again and told me he would call me back. Tuesday came and went with no communication from anyone. I called again and spoke with Victor who said he had sent everything over to corporate but what did I want? "some free car washes?" I explained to him I just wanted the car repaired and he gave me the owners number and told me he would call the owner (Steve) but I was welcome to call him as well. I called Steve but he didn't answer and, his voicemail was full so I sent a follow up text as well explaining what happened and that I would like a phone call to discuss it. He didn't call me that day. I sent another follow up message the next day asking for a call, he still didn't call. I called Victor again who said he would have Steve call me. I did finally receive a phone call from Steve saying because my car had rock chips on the hood and because my hood had been improperly repainted, he wasn't going to repair it. I have owned my car for 6 years and I purchased it certified pre-owned from Honda and it has never had the hood repainted. It was a lease from Honda before I purchased it and I received all the maintenance and vehicle history when I bought the car and, again, it has NEVER had the hood repainted or repaired. 
I explained this to Steve, the owner, who continued to say it was repainted and he wasn't going to repair it since it had rock chips and was "improperly painted".  I'll say it again, it's never been repainted. It has the factory paint on it from when I purchased it from the dealer. I explained to Steve that he was insinuating I was lying about the paint. He even had the nerve to say it wasn't right that I was expecting him to repair my car. I'll add, Steve even admitted that he went back and watched the video and saw the exact moment when the gentleman blew the paint off. 
I have been through MANY car washes all over the country and I have never had the paint blown off my car. I accepted immediately that the gentleman using the pressure washer must have made a mistake and got too close to the car. I wasn't angry, nor was I impatient through this whole process. I didn't call my insurance because I knew it would probably be easier for the owner if he was given the opportunity to fix it though his own means. Boy was I wrong. 
I've never dealt with such a insensitive business owner before. I was patient and understanding each time I spoke with this company, even when it was a huge inconvenience for me due to their mistake. Even when my calls were never returned. I continually gave them the benefit of the doubt and showed grace during these frustrating Covid times. But it isn't an excuse for a business to dodge taking ownership for a mistake and making it right. My husband is currently serving out of state in the US Navy and I have had to attempt to handle this, what turned into a very stressful situation, on my own while having to take care of four young kids. And on top of that I'm forced to pay my deductible and lose out on money my family really needs to in order to fix Fast Eddy's mistake.
I would urge you to look elsewhere for a car wash if your car has any rock chips in the paint at all, which is extremely common in any vehicle that isn't brand new. It's at risk of damage without any remediation from this business. I'm so thankful I have insurance that is great and is going to repair my vehicle but I'm concerned for those that may utilize this car wash and don't have insurance as great as mine and aren't able to afford the repairs needed due to their mistake. 
I am VERY disappointed with the car wash service and even more disappointed in how I was treated by Steve and his manager.

The food was decent, the beer selection great, but the music was so loud, it took yelling to talk to other people at the table. Of course, since no one could hear each other. Everyone was yelling. According to the manager, the corporate HQ thinks loud music is the shit. Well, that it is. I won't be back in the evening. I will say that I complained to the HQs and they sent a gift certificate for the trouble. We will be back for early happy hour.

Being my first time, my first impression was good for the atmosphere. They were currently starting to get a 35 minute wait so my friend and I decided to sit at the bar until our table became available. It took a couple of times before someone asked if we wanted a drink and more than enough people passed us by! Well, bartender Rudi stepped up to tge plate and my friend and him hit it off talking about President Reagan. Thereafter Rudi was our man, he got us our drinks a coke and a cherry limeade (my drink). He brought us our drinks and I was so embarrassed because it apparently the cherry limeade made there is an alcoholic beverage which I did not want. So I bashfully explained what I meant for a cherry limeade...7-Up, grenadine with a couple times squeezed and Rudi's reply oh so basically a Shirley temple...lol...ok, ok tomato toemahtoe! So he fixed that right up. After our drinks Rudi asked if we would like to sit and eat dinner at the bar, we said ABSOLUTELY! Therefore, Rudi was on top of his game with my friend and I having a good time! Rudi even had a magic trick, which actually just turned out to be a napkin being laid out as placemats with a plate being held down by my silverware...as you can imagine I was not impressed but I told him better keep practicing! My friend ordered the pork burger, with clam chowder and I ordered the bacon, chicken mac-n-cheese with tomato bisque soup. Honestly, the soup was good but NOTHING to gloat about...I believe I have had tomato bisque before and it seemed to have more significance of taste. It basically tasted like Campbell's tomato soup with heavy cream whipped into it with some seasoning. When my entree finally arrived...took longer than expected...I grabbed my fork, stabbed into the macaroni and than began to blow, thinking it was steaming hot...NOPE! I wasn't sure what to think, I tried again and again and it was cold. The presentation looked great! The manager ended up coming over to see if I wanted mine heated up or another one...I started mixing the food around digging further into the dish and that helped spread the heat around. Therefore with the managers offer, the thought crossed my mind, however I declined his offer because I honestly wasn't sure how long it would take again. So I told him I was good with what I had and as I ate more I decided the pasta was not al dente enough and there was certainly not enough sauce within the cheese. It was too dry, maybe add a Bechamel sauce to the dish to make it more creamy! I will definitely not order that again but I will try the restaurant again! Rudi was great entertainment!

Been to many cigar lounges across several states, The Vault is one of the best I've been to.  Party of 6 was promptly seated, with excellent service from Jody.  Comfy, clean leather seats,  a nice selection of beers, and good ventilation.  Friendly patrons to boot.  Looking forward to future visits here- they will be opening the outdoor patio area May 2021 with additional spirits as well.  Highly recommend this spot to relax and pass an hour or two.
I love this salon! I moved here from Washington and am always so scared to find a new hair stylist but I know Aveda always delivers. Thank you!!!
Good food, tons of beer on tap, friendly staff. Come here all the time. Always something good on one of the flat screens.

We may have a new office fave after trying Firehouse Subs.  I placed an online order today around 12:10 pm and it was ready for pickup when I arrived at 12:25.  I found it very easy to place an order on their website.  They have a large variety of sandwiches that can be customized, you can save your orders, save payment method, etc.  They also have 3 different size options which I found to be rather helpful since a couple of us are light eaters but don't always like to order something to share.  FYI... you can pick up online orders through their drive thru.

I ordered a small white smoked turkey and found it to be the perfect size with a bag of chips a drink and a pickle spear.  It reminded me of the turkey I used to get at Schlotzkys back in the day.  Their meat is very thinly sliced just how I like it.  I ordered my husband a medium Italian fully loaded and he as only able to finish half of it but on a normal day it would be the perfect size. We also found it to be very affordable as we only paid $23.53 for 3 different sandwiches, chips and drinks.  This will definitely be a regular in our lunch rotation!

Really under impressed with our food and service. We thought we were taking our son to a nicer dinner. It felt more like a dive bar. Nothing was gross but nothing was good. Servers were fine but not happy. It took forever for my husband to get salsa, he finally went up and got one himself. Felt like the Denny's of Mexican restaurants. Food was bad quality and chicken was terrible. Also it took forever to pay.

Long history has taught me to not like Chili's. Typically over-priced, bland food with sketchy service. To appease the family I went grudgingly and this time, I had a game-changing experience.

Although the hostess was a little curt, everything else was really good. Prices are still a little high but all 5 dishes were made well and I got 2 thumbs up from everyone. I had the chicken tacos and they were tasty.

I'd be willing to go back to this Chili's again, which is saying something from a long-time avoider of the brand.

After fighting for a parking spot in this weird little strip mall, I made my way inside. The woman who helped us let us sit wherever we wanted. The menu is straight to the point, which I love. Being from hawaii, and missing the chow fun the manapua man would sell, I was ecstatic to finally find somewhere in Idaho that sold it! I ordered chicken chow fun, my partner ordered general tso's chicken. The food came out fast. The general tso's chicken batter was light and crispy and not overly saucey. The chicken chow fun was flavorful and perfectly cooked! The short time we were there for dinner, there were 5 take out orders. I think more people do take out than eat inside. I think it's safe to say I found my new favorite Chinese restaurant! My advice is: do brave the craziness in the parking lot, the food is well worth it!

We used their services and it has cost us severely.  The tenants were horrible, destroying the property, not paying for the damages, as well as stealing personal property.  All of which could have been avoided if the tenants were thoroughly reviewed and investigated as well as confirming their renters insurance not to mention performing scheduled walk throughs to ensure compliance and care.

Some of the repairs made by the P.M. we're cheap and incomplete.  

We had to spend several days and hundreds of dollars repairing and cleaning the property after tenants vacated the property prior to their contract terms.  We also had to haul off quite a bit of furniture and trash they left behind.

Not sure what we were paying for having a property manager like this?

I really do like Blaze and Similar restaurants like this, Blaze does a pretty good job, Some of the employees are pretty friendly and the ingredients are always good. I can't say I have ever gotten a pizza there and not enjoyed it. I think Blaze pizza in general is usually 4 or 5 star for me. I'm a fan.


My main problem with this Location in particular, is that they are incredibly stingy with the cheese. Every time I go in to this spot I have to ask a guy named Jake five times to add more mozzarella. 

Maybe the cheese costs are subtracted from the tip jar at the end of the day? I get the "build your own" pizza Which is supposed to grant you unlimited toppings, and I'm sure guys go crazy and load on 5 pounds of meat, all I like is a cheese pizza, with extra cheese. Therefore I have to order the build Your own (most expensive pizza they sell) and Hold up the line is my pizza craftsman adds slowly adds cheese pinch by loose pinch.

This place is amazing. 
A hole in the wall atmosphere with Levi drinks that will not disappoint. A groups of five we had mega bloody Mary's , mega mimosas and an iced coffee. Everyone loved their drinks. 
We shared some nachos, sliders, and potato skins and they were big hits. We only did not finish the potatoes because there was way too much food and they are more like loaded potato wedges
Justin was really great even when he thought he was such  a comedian 
Great service. Great atmosphere. Would highly recommend

I ordered the small sirloin for dinner as I wasn't overly hungry.  It is the best steak I have ever had!  My whole meal was wonderful and the service was friendly and pleasant.  Simply put - excellent.

Went to TRH tonight for dinner. We have only eaten at a TRH one other time when we lived in California, but our memory of it was a positive one, so we decided to give it a try! Our group consisted of me, my hubby, my 14 year old daughter, & my 12 year old son. This was the kids 1st time at TRH. 
We arrived right around 8 & were warmly greeted by a hostess opening the door for us & promptly taking us to our table. On the way to the table, she made sure to grab a basket of the coveted hot rolls & cinnamon whipped butter for us. 
Shortly after being seated, we were greeted by our server, Jenny. Jenny took our drink order & asked if we wanted an appetizer. We didn't, so she ran off to get the drinks.  When she returned, we were ready to order:
Me: 10oz rib eye, loaded baked potato minus chives & corn
Hubby: full rack of ribs, loaded baked potato minus chives & salad with ranch 
Daughter: All American cheeseburger medium with fries
Son: Bacon cheeseburger with loaded baked potato minus chives  (notice a pattern with the chives!?! Lol )
I have a pretty severe shellfish allergy. So, I mentioned it to Jenny while ordering & asked her to be sure that the kitchen staff was aware of it. She didn't seem to understand what i was talking about. My husband tried to explain it, but she still didn't seem to get it. No biggie, we just quietly asked another server to be sure that the kitchen staff was aware of it. 
Our food arrived within a decent amount of time. Both kids enjoyed their burgers, although my son did say that it was a bit too charred in some spots. My husband enjoyed his meal. He had no complaints. I was happy with my food as well, but the rib eye steak had to have been the thinnest rib eye I have ever seen before. It was less than 1/8 of an inch thick. It was rather odd. 
My biggest issue I had was how cluttered our table got. By the time the food arrived our table space was really limited, but our server never took dirty plates away once they served no purpose. It was comical to watch us attempting to stack dirty dishes without breaking something. 
I will be going back again to see if I have a better experience. It wasn't awful, but it wasn't amazing either.
My wife really enjoys their food and is unable to come to the restaurant at the moment. Thursday was her birthday and it was what she wanted more than any other restaurant.
Absolutely best Mexican food I have had in my life. Who would have thought it is in Meridian Idaho of all places? Service, food and atmosphere. My new favorite restaurant and affordable.

We took friends from England to Yard House today for lunch.  They both enjoy different beers, so we thought it would be one of the best places in Boise to visit.  We had 2 small children with us, so we were hoping to relax for a drink, but also get our food and eat before the kids became restless.  It was not an enjoyable experience.  We asked to be seated outside, in the shade. The table they put us at was in the shade at first, but quickly was hot with sun, while there were other tables available in the shade.  We had to ask for menus, then waited 45 minutes sitting in the sun with no food, so we finally asked to be moved over to a shaded table.  We asked about our food, and the manager came out and said our food wasn't fit to serve because we had moved tables - it was a total of 5 minutes to move!  By this time, the kids were tired and ready to go, so we said we needed our food in 5 minutes or we needed to leave.  What do you know... our food suddenly showed up!  We think they lost our order and were trying to get some extra time. Yard House did do the right thing and pay for our meals, but we were terribly embarrassed because of the experience with our company from out of town.  There are lots of breweries around town now - not going back to Yard House!

Nice atmosphere to watch the game.  But the beers are extremely inconsistent and the new menu is horrible.   Food  is not great but it can be a fun place to hang out if your not hungry or looking for the same beer you had the last time you went.

My family and I went here for a afternoon snack and a beer. You order at the counter and they will bring the food out to you. The restaurant is super clean, and the staff was friendly and helpful. We ordered the pork nachos which were good and a good portion.  We also ordered the Buffalo chicken wings which we thought were just okay and on the pricey side ($16.99 for 12). My son liked his Mac n cheese.  If you sign up for the app you receive the pork Nachos for free. This was a very nice perk. Overall a good very casual restaurant.
Consistently delicious! That's huge, to find a place that isn't a hit and a miss.  We love their Chile Relleno. We also had a tasty flight of margarita's, with a blueberry one that was great.
Great selection of cigars, great facility, great staff, go there and relax.  Had a great relaxing time.  Friendly environment provided so you can strike up a nice conversation with your fellow man.

My husband and I are so happy our friend recommended Basic Dental Care. We absolutely love Dr. Williams. We are new to this area so having to part from our previous dentist after so long was nerve wracking but, again, we are so happy. We feel like we have always known Dr. Williams and his staff. You won't be sorry if you move to this wonderful dentist!

When we moved to the area, it was really important that we found good sushi. There were a few places that we had tried, but Sakana has been the best thus far. It also helps that it is a hop skip and a jump from our house.

Monday and Tuesday's are great for first timers. They offer $1 sushi, so you can try a variety of their rolls without having to commit. If sushi isn't up your ally, they have many boxes available of tempuras and what not. There is also a Japanese grill that puts on a fun show. 

My husband and I can't get past their great sushi and variety. If your around the area, this is a great place for a night date night out or for a fun party/gathering.
What a find while shopping in Meridian! Great food to an excellent selection of craft beers! The steak sandwich was a fantastic choice and the wife enjoyed the club sandwich.

The food options are great as is the food quality but both times I've come for pick up, they have multiple people running around without masks. One was even opening several bags looking for something. Idaho is among the worst in the US for covid 19 and to be in a centralized food distribution center like this with several maskless people is troubling. So unless this is figured out, I'll just go pick up from other Meridian restaurants directly.

3rd person to review SNIP (Low Cost Spay Neuter Clinic) in Meridian (Cherry and Linder). Snip is a lower cost ($35 neuter cats, $50 spay for cats), which is a steal! My vet was close to $300 and I had three kittens to spay! This is my 467th Yelp review. All prices are listed on their easy to access website. 
Open to the public anyone and everyone. The appointments are about a month out. They do accept donations, too, and I think that's really important as they do a great service to the community. In fact, they have a $5 plan for people that have the need for low income. There is additional directions on their website (http://www.snipidaho.org/) if you're interested. A great community resource! 
The process is super easy. You have to check their website daily for appointments. It's not uncommon for you to enter your information, go to the calendar, and there are no appointments available. I was able to get appointments for three kittens about 4 weeks out. You have to pay a small deposit for each animal. You fill out 5 or so questions about your pet and that's it! 
Instructions are simple: 
A) Drop off your pet in a pet carrier (if you don't have one you have to buy a box for $6) at 7 am. Don't be late... You will intake the pets and off you go. 
B) You pick up your pet at either 3 or 4 PM, depending on dog or cat. When you go inside you sign in and pay. Mine was cheaper because one kitten was a boy and I had no idea! Fun conversation...  The nurse comes out and talks to everyone together. You get your medications and your pet one by one. You can buy a cone for $6. My kittens didn't do well with it and so that was that--

My husband went to see Dr. Michael Speckman at the Caldwell location. We just moved here and my husband needs a pain doctor. The doctor told my husband that he was a big as a house. The office staff when he walked in didn't even talk to him for 15 minutes and he could hear them talking about patients while he waited. Needless to say he won't be going there again. Just because someone is over weight doesn't mean they should not be treated for there pain.

This place is a joke. Upon welcoming us into the store, they required pictures of our ID's!! Are you kidding me!?! You wanted 3 pieces of my personal identifying information just so we can look at puppies!?! We asked why they needed that and they claimed they had a puppy stolen so they need pictures of ID's to mitigate theft. What about theft of my personal information?? Why would I allow them to store our personal information in a random database? There are other options to secure their assets.... What about security cameras? Seriously, the store is tiny, with staff sitting right by the door, maybe have staff that's more attentive to their surroundings if you are that concerned with theft. After we denied them access to our ID's they told us we had to leave the store. Ridiculous. Poor customer service, rude and unlawful storing of personal information.

My husband and I just left this place after sitting at a table for 20 mins being ignored with servers and management walking by us. Not a single person said anything to us. No waters were brought.. nothing. But the table across from us that got seated after got service within minutes. Their server didn't even acknowledge us. There were multiple staff standing around so they weren't short handed and the place was fairly empty. I like to give people the benefit of the doubt but that was ridiculous and plain insulting. There is no excuse to sit at a table for 20 minutes and be completely ignored.

As a person who was employed briefly for this company and has worked at other retail stores, I couldn't believe my eyes. I know this is not how BBB operates but I have been to this location several times now and I'm not going back.
If I were the owner of Purple (mattress brand) I would've removed my product. There was no one around to answer our questions and the floor set felt gross. I didn't want to lay on their $100 pillow. It wasn't the first time this has happened.
There are serious signage issues. I can't find a price for anything. Clearly I'm looking for a price and an employee with a ladder comes towards my way. Instead of letting me know that they can send another employee-they just carry on with "sorry." I guess I should be grateful for that sorry but I didn't even bother looking for the price of that robe any longer. 
It's kinda hard to admit this but the Nampa location is way better!

So happy to have this place so close to home! Came in on a Wednesday night and was happy to see it was fairly crowded. That's always a good sign! Nice and clean. Very organized and easy to maneuver around for us on wheels. Service was prompt and friendly. Good food at fair prices.

My wife loves this place therefore so do I! I've learned that in only 2 years of marriage. :)  How can you not like Texas Roadhouse food?  Well worth the price, everything I have had is excellent.  I love their ribs and steaks. It comes with a couple sides and I always choose their sweet potato and salad.  Their salad is packed with yummy stuff and not just salad and dressing.  My wife loves their baked potatoes.  Only flaw, super loud and super packed.  The tables are so close together you are literally inches away from the table next to you.  I get it, when you have a popping restaurant you want to get as many people in as you can since you are always slammed.  When we go here, we go close to closing time but then you have to deal with everyone cleaning around you and sweeping the tons of peanut shells that have accumulated throughout the day.  If this place were quieter and had more space, it would definitely earn 5 stars and I would come here more often but who really cares when all of Treasure Valley eats here regularly.

My hubby and I went for dinner on a Monday and it was loud but, we liked the music and the festivities around us.  We were greeted at the door and seated immediately with fresh rolls, honey butter and peanuts. Yum! Our server Becky was fast, competent  and delightful. The menu is vast and the food was hot and delicious. We ordered a blossom onion to start and the sirloin steak with a salad and potato for our entree. I brought home lots of leftovers for the next day. We will definitely be going back.
This place sucks, they never deliver and 8/10 times they get the order wrong or deliver to the wrong address. The girls that work there have attitudes as well.

crave is awesome their food for the most part is 5 stars customer service is awesome and i love to try new things and so far i have loved the taste and portions of everything i've tried !  btw for breakfast the cowboy bowl and biscuits and gravy are so yummy!!! luch the cheese calzone is the best i have ever had and dinner i have yet to try but i am pretty confident that i will find a favorite!!!

First time I went all was good, I have been back two more times rs and the service has been terrible.  Last time I went my dork had dried food all over it, had to ask for another one.  I asked for water with lemon, he brought me a glass of water, I asked again for lemon, I had to ask twice for salt and pepper.  I ordered ranch dressing for my son, I had to ask again for the ranch.  I had to ask for refills of water, my sons meal came with dessert...I had to ask for it.  I had to ask for the check, I had to ask for him to pick up the credit card.  I sound like a complainer, I am usually a patient person but come on!!!  It was busy but not that busy.

Food is amazing, staff doesn't seem overly appreciative of your patronage.  This could be due to the issue of being short staffed and a very small seating area. I'd still recommend trying it and making your own decision!!

It was sister day and so we decided we'd go give Homestead a try. Not good. Shrimp was fried so hard that you couldn't find the shrimp, my sisters got finger steaks, the steak was deep fried too long and it was so tough it took my sister about 15 minutes to chew it. She secretly spit it out. Definitely will not go back, it was just awful!!! Besides that we had to wait 30 minutes to get over cooked dry food. Actually the order of fries we ordered were okay. 
It will not be a place we will have sister day again.

I am a Joann's and Michaels shopper but just recently decided to try Hobby Lobby.  Ok, now I know what all the fuss is about.  Lots of selections other than craft supplies.  A very fun place to go to to decorate your home for everyday as well as every holiday.   An excellent selection of fabrics for sewers too.  I noticed the cheaply made furniture items at the entrance that are grossly overpriced.  Cute but not well made.  Other than that, a great place for so many things to make your house a home and get creative.
literally change your online hours, and if you're not open at 10am anymore on saturdays then why are your employees there running the clock up?

Clean and new.   Customer service needs work.  Not the most friendly place.  Pizza and other options are what you would expect from a Papa Murphy's.   Wonder why they didn't put in a drive through.. Big miss if you ask me.  But for a local Carry out pizza place you can go wrong.  Glad it is here and we will continue to use this location in the hopes the service improves.

Disappointed in this last visit. Which is unfortunate because we brought family from out of town. I know that this restaurant can do better. 

Few issues:
Bland ceviche... really tasted like nothing. Waste of money and I wish we would have sent it back. 

Greasy and bland tacos... the street tacos today were almost inedible due to the amount to grease pouring out of the beef and chorizo tacos. The pork and chicken tacos had zero flavor... all I got was the cilantro and onion. 

Hot plate for kids nachos.. bringing out a scalding hot plate to put in front of a child is about as dumb as you get. You need to make the nachos on a separate platter and slide them on to a plate. Seriously need to use better judgement here guys. 

Over dressed salad... the Romaine salad was disgusting. Lettuce was super soft and soggy almost like it was put under a heat lamp. 

High points-
Great blood orange margarita...always a favorite with us. 

Adam- great server... this is our second or third time with Adam and he consistently does a fantastic job. 

Overall- as stated above we are very disappointed but understand that bad days happen. Today was really a 2 star visit but Adams service and the margarita saved the day.

Fix the Hot plate issue.

BEST GLUTEN FREE PIZZA OUT THERE! 

And my husband loves the other food too, especially the mac and cheese and sandwiches. Cheaper at lunch time and happy hour! Love the food, and we return frequently

Originally from New England we have been looking for a GO To for good Chinese restaurant.. This place did I not disappoint.. fresh tasting and Delicious food! My fav is the shrimp chow mein! yumm! Highly recommend.

My family and I went for a birthday dinner, a party of 7, and we got seating quick but it took a half hour to get our appetizers and another 2 hours on top of that to get our meals. They were all freezing cold. The pasta had globs of cheese that wasn't melted and the steaks were cooked well done  when asked for medium rare. They said that it was due to us having a large party, but there were multiple parties of 4, 5 and 6 that arrived after us and left way before us. Maybe just wrong place wrong time but it was brutal.

Back againnnnnnnnnnnn tonight!  Congratulations on so many awards for 2017 The Best of Boise!  I am reading in the Statesman... Steakhouse, Restaurant Service (DUH), Happy Hour (Best Double Talls in the Boise Valley), Burgers, Fine Dining, Night Food, Local Sandwiches and Best Local Restaurant ... Oh, I'm sure I missed something!  Dan and Jessica were first-rate, as always.  They always make us feel at home and comfortable.  They know their business and do it seamlessly.  Jake should be proud to have such great employees.  Food was tasty, as always.  The restaurant and bar were busy, which was great to see, as I know the community is finding our hidden treasure.  Thanks, Jake for such a terrific restaurant!  See you again soon!

Wow...Can't say enough nice things about Dowdy's. From start to finish I was treated like a long time friend. 
I needed to get the brakes done on my truck. I set up the appointment over the phone, was quoted a price, and the work was done timely, and at the price quoted.
Very clean waiting room, plus the is a starbucks very close. Really nice to find a friendly, professional mechanic close to me. We will be bringing our vechicles here from now on.
Customer service is excellent. There was a little bit of a mix up with our takeout order and they were more than willing to do whatever needed to correct the issue.
They have really delicious food. The menu has a large variety to choose from. They have awesome Tepan tables. Their chefs' tricks at the Tepan table are very cool.
Elena was absolutely the most wonderful server I've ever met. Kudos to your customer service and laughing with us at the stupidity that was brought to the table. Thanks for a great first visit!

I don't know where all these good reviews are coming from. My husband made an order for pick up and brought it home. Two person dinner with soup, rice, I ordered salt and pepper pork and him honey chicken. Absolutely no flavor. Both dishes sound delicious, right? My dish was supposed to be hot. Nope. Even with sliced jalapeños. The hubs could eat it, and he's very heat sensitive. I added ho sauce to it. The honey sauce on his dish? Weird white thick sauce. Not sweet, not really anything. How do you make a sauce that doesn't taste like anything? Not being picky, but it's pretty hard to screw up Chinese food.

We were there for lunch a while back... Our second visit. It's one of those places that you really want to like. After a so-so experience the first time I wanted to give them another chance but after the second visit I liked it even less than the first time. 

The service was fine but the food, not so much. I ordered street tacos that were beyond too greasy! My guest ordered enchiladas that were extremely greasy as well. No, we didn't order the healthiest but the dripping grease was just too much. And overall, not very flavorful. 

I agree with the person that wrote about accessibility in the bar. It's non- existent. You might as well say "Disabled Not Welcome"!

Was in my old stomping grounds so decided to stop in at The Homestead for lunch. Foods fine but man the culture is disappointing. Bartenders and servers that act like you are the least of their concerns. Seems like a locals only place. Also, as this was during COVID the employees were wearing their masks....pulled down onto their chins, lol. What's the point of even putting it on, can't blame anyone but the management though I guess. Won't be back.

I don't eat fast food but this food might as well have been from a fast food joint. Ordered two kids burritos and two super burritos and... well... we were disappointed. I didn't even eat my burrito since it was soggy and open ended. Kids burritos were the size of a frozen burrito. My wife said the salsa was good but... cook the tortilla! Soggy anything is gross. Don't assume that everyone wants a wet burrito! We got the burritos dry (normal) and the were still soggy. Weak. We won't be back. We'll continue our search for the best burrito in Treasure Valley though.

The place is clean and I love the cleaning station they have to wash your hands. The staff is super friendly and helpful. They got a good mix of meats and their well priced. I got the three meat for my visit, I paid the extra 2.50 for the brisket, ribs, and spicy andouille sausage. The brisket is very tender but I used all three of their bbq sauces to try it as it wasn't smoky enough for me. The sausage was very good and I liked the smoke that was on there. The ribs were amazing and they had great seasoning on it and the meat came right off with every bite. The side I got was mashed potatoes and gravy and that was good. The hush puppies were dry to me. My favorite was the ribs and I think the next time I'm there I'll try the chicken thighs or chicken wings that they have. Give them a try if your in the area. I know I will.
Visited the Meridian location and Chris was AWESOME! He was super helpful and nice!! He hooked us up!

I love this place! We come quite frequently and it never disappoints. Their pepperoni and chive pizza is so good and their ranch is amazing!  We also really like the Chicken Arugula Basil salad. The staff is always on top of it and we've only had great service.

I had a fairly negative experience here. 

Decided to stop by to grab some dinner before I went home. I was trying to decide between here and the Flqme Broiler. I should've chosen the Flame Broiler. 

Walked in, sat at the bar, and waited just under 10 minutes (not exaggerating) for the bartender to ask me what I'd like to drink. When he brought it to me, I asked for and received a menu. I decided pretty quickly what I wanted, but waited an ADDITIONAL 10 MINUTES for him to come back to ask me what I'd like to eat. To give him the benefit of the doubt, he did explain they were understaffed for the night, and he was alone working behind the bar. 

Ordered the Philly Cheesesteak with the House "MacDaddy" sauce. I couldn't be more disappointed if I tried. The meat was dried out, the sauce was completely tasteless, and the bread was so soft that it was crumbling whenever I took a bite. I ate all of it because I was hungry, but asked for ranch dressing to give it at least some taste. 

Also, the guy sitting to my left was drunk and should've been cut off 4 drinks earlier. 

I give this place two stars because it gets 1 star regardless, plus 1 for the ambiance being decent. 

I'm going to have to strongly consider whether or not I'm going back.

We haven't been to Jaker's in about 5 years but thought we'd give it another shot. I ordered Chicken a la Jaker's and wife order Chicken parm. All the food was really good. Nice portions, quality food, flavorful. We had great service as well. But it was just all majorly overpriced. We walked out after two normal entrees that came with 1 side and soup or salad, plus two cokes, and 20% tip (we'll deserved) at $70! Yikes. Nothing about Jaker's screams a normal $70 dinner so we were left in a bit of sticker shock. Still, an enjoyable evening, but we can get that in a lot of other places with quality food for a lot less. The prices will keep us from returning.

I'm only giving a 2 because the fries and drink were good. The sandwich on the other hand was disgusting!!! I don't even know what this is, it is hard it came out the sandwich in the first bit. I will never eat hear again
beer and food god, service very good. We go there every two weeks

10 minutes from the time we sat at the table in the bar area until we were finally acknowledged. Ordered a couple beers, chips and salsa and soup. After receiving our drinks and food, it was another 13 minutes before our server came by to check on us. 
The server indicated that they were slammed busy; however, this couldn't be further from the truth, unless management severely understaffed the restaurant for the evening. 
My wife and I are visiting from Phoenix and I must say this is the most disappointing part of our trip so far, not that the bar is set high for Chili's anyway.

This is our absolute favorite "happy hour" restaurant in Idaho. We come here every time we visit. The staff is always so helpful with food and beer recommendations, and they are very attentive with each table. The food is amazing, and the 1/2 yard beers are SO great. I definitely recommend trying this place the next time you're in Idaho.
Beautiful and clean library with any boom your heart can dream of. It's a fun place that truly does foster a love of reading. Lots of community classes are also offered here which is Great!

First timer!  The Restaurant business is still climbing here in the Boise Area.  I am a "home grown"and this place reminds me of what it used to be like...in the day.  Christine was our "HOSTESS" for the evening.  I don't like to say server as I am not from ROYALTY descent! So I don't have servants, she was probably one of the best I have encountered in a very long time.  Prompt, effecient, knowledgeable, and...wait for it...fun!  In this atmosphere, SHE made the whole evening. I ordered the Prawn Cocktail - so fresh, served perfectly chilled and the cocktail sauce had a kick that I love. My friends had the french dip and the Sauteed Prawns...all were prepared as they should be hot, tasteful and presentation.  I look forward to going again. The menu has a wide variety.  I gave up Meat about a year ago...but watching some of the BEEF choices come out... made me think...I just might have to try the Prime Rib!!! Check it out...and if it's not too busy ask for Christine.  You will walk out satiated with a smile on your face.

Got the nachos here and it was super good!! Portion was decent and they give you a good amount of meat!! The chips on the nachos are different than normal chips. You gotta have them pearls to bite into them! The crunchiness sells it!

Flatbread has been a favorite go to in Downtown Boise. Since they moved to their new location, they've become more central to the restaurant scene. They have an awesome view of the city from their second floor location. If you need a quick lunch, you can hit them up for their pick two. I love their BBQ chicken pizza and tomato basil soup. The flavor combinations leave you wanting more and getting that comfort food feeling when you're starving. The service is always friendly, fast and they make sure you enjoy your experience.
They got our order wrong and they were super slow! I highly do not recommend coming to this Wendy's

Completely frustrating experience a few times over! I kept thinking that since they're a fairly new store that things would get better...not the case. Every single experience just continues to be a source of confusion and crappie attitudes for them, in turn leaving me irritated over the whole process. I've tried walking in, calling in, and even ordering online and nothing seems to work right. Ordering ready-to-bake pizza just shouldn't be this tough! Extremely disappointing consider how convenient the location is but I will drive a bit farther for good customer service and a stress free pizza.

I see my previous review has been deleted but this place needs to be shut down by the health department. The cook has been observed leaving the bathroom numerous times without washing his hands. #2 and all. Gross! My kid even commented on that and he's 3.
Clean restaurant good service but honestly not anything exceptional especially for the price not my cup of tea but my date took me there so I guess free food and good conversion made it OK.

Not great. We have moved 7 times in the last three years and have worked with numerous moving companies. The guys were nice, but it took them forever to unpack a 12 foot truck which we have seen moved rather quickly in the past. There was damage to the hardwood floors and a lot of disorganization. When I spoke with the company to book, they assessed the amount of furniture and boxes and quoted us a 2 hour move, which included assembly of one bed. The unload alone took two hours (as I've previously seen done in an hour or less) and they could not figure out how to assemble the simple IKEA bed frame. After showing them how to do it, they were still confused and said they hadn't seen anything like it before. I finally told them that me and my fiancé would do it because we were about to go over the time we were estimating and they still charged me for the amount of time it took them to try to figure out the bed that they couldn't even build even after I walked them through it. Definitely disappointing. We have moved a ton for work and have worked with a lot of companies and I would not recommend these guys.

Their fries are delicious! Beer battered and amazing! The sauce on the fish tacos makes it! Workers  were wearing their masks on their chins while walking through the dining area. They do not limit capacity. Social distancing was not enforced. Customers were 50/50 wearing masks.

Ordered the family meal with pulled pork for take out tonight. The pork was amazing and the portion size enough to last us for a couple more meals. Mashed potatoes, gravy, and coleslaw were all good too. Will definitely come back to try other menu options, those nachos look tempting.

This place is delicious first time here today and Zach at the bar is amazing full of recommendations def very awesome in suggesting and making sure we had a great experience. The drinks to the food was amazing and ughhhh champagne shots say what!?!?!!!!!!! I will definitely be returning again asking for Zach he is on his stuff very helpful amazing customer experience. Anyone who is a foodie this is a definite go to! I can't believe I've been missing out for far too long.

Had a grand dinner at lunchtime today. We love bringing leftovers home for dinner. I had the bacon wrapped filet mignon and my wife had rib eye. They were both cooked to perfection and were so yummy. The service was great. I had a Bloody Mary. Also made to perfection and it came with a hot slice of bacon. Oh my goodness. Needless to say, I think we found a gold mine and will return.
I continue to go back again and again.  It has a very reliable and excellent menu.  Neither you nor your guests will be disappointed.

First Idaho appearance of a small (4) chain of steakhouse meets seafood restaurants started by a Sacramento couple, their marketing collateral uses the adjective "swanky" as introduction: "...a modern steakhouse with a swanky vibe".   Based on our introductory meal we'd choose uncomfortable as adjective to describe the entire dining experience.  

VIBE: Decor seems as if imagined what would be "swanky" for a Reno Casino restaurant circa 2000 with interior (revamped in the awkward old Pinnacles Bar and Grill location) of elevated upholstered horseshoe shaped banquettes.  It makes service and dining difficult and trying to hear the server across the banquette with the LOUD pop music on sound system is a challenge.  (The tune titled "Impossible" being played at HIGH volume struck me as perfect fit for the service layout here as we were trying to order.)   The big banquettes also create impossible reach ranges for servers delivering food or picking up empty plates.  The lighting seems to cast a sort of odd orangey glow and it makes menus (printed on darker paper and laminated) difficult to see.

SERVICE: The young service staff (mostly college student age) were all as as nice as can be.  Good for the manager for hiring people with helpful personas.  But clearly more training is needed for coordination with kitchen if they owners want to pass this off as "swanky" fine dining.  We said we'd start with the cocktails and we had to ask about them 3 times until finally receiving them after the food arrived when we asked that third time.  This was with maybe 15 total people in the place and each nice server saying the bartender was 'on it'.  As we could see the bartender wandering about behind the bar.  Our salad and main arrived together although we had asked for salad course first.  The main was tepid in temperature. Something is amiss for coordination with kitchen.  And then, this is the best part, as we were waiting on the dessert course the bartender happened by our table and said, "I'll have your cocktails in a minute."  Ummm...no...we're on coffee and dessert.  

LIBATIONS:  Cocktails ($10 each) are currently from a can and "mixologist enhanced" as they describe it on menu.  (See photo posted.) There are about a dozen options and the two we selected were not half bad considering the can origin!   About 60+ options on wine list by bottle ($30 ex: Kung Fu Girl Reisling to $140 Corliss Estates Cab - bottle only) and glasses ($8 to $18).  Riedel glassware.  About a dozen craft beer choices around $6.  Good coffee.

MENU & EATS:  The salad was unremarkable for a classic format (wedge) for the "modern steakhouse" they tout themselves to be.  The shellfish dish we chose for main which would have been good had it not been served barely tepid.  Extra lemon requested for main arrived as bar slices not wedges. No bowl for shells so  we improvised to pile on bread plate.  Pumpkin cheesecake and steaming mug of coffee at end of meal were the best part. 

Brunch served on weekends.  We didn't look at that menu.  Using the same menu for lunch and dinner with:

*A dozen'ish starters ranging rom $9 to 17, examples: bacon mac n cheese $9, blue cheese dip w/chips $12, prawn cocktail $17

*Three main course sized salads from $17 to $19  

*Nine burgers and sandwiches from $14 (BLTA) to $19 (Prime rib dip)

*Ten entrees ranging from $14 (Fish n Chips) to $32 (Filet Mignon - 6 oz)  

*Soup of day ($8 bowl) and 3 side salads @ $10 each (Caesar, wedge, tossed)  

*Desserts numbered half a dozen and all $9.50is in classics like creme brulee and apple crisp and cheesecake

BOTTOM LINE IMHO:  One and done here for us which seemed as if Longhorn Steakhouse meets Ruth Chris wannabe with Anthony's and Reno Casino touching in.  Yet, they will have an audience in this general Meridian area because there is a demographic that will find this "awesome".  Different strokes for different diners. They have been in soft opening and that is a smart tactic to get service protocols and kitchen systems up to speed with limited crowds.   But they plan advertising "big time" come Monday 12/6/21 and they really are not ready for prime time crowds that might follow.

ACCESSIBILITY:  Major ADA violation that is hard to believe from a CA company given awareness in that state is high for rules of the 32 year old Civil Rights law.  That is no accessible seating, not a single seat, in the bar area where it is all raised booths thereby segregating mobility disabled people from being in the bar. Even though a ramp was installed to get there.  A few standard tables on the restaurant level.  Accessible parking outside in lot.  Loo are accessible.

PARKING:  A plus for this highly visible right on Eagle Road location is that it has a parking lot.

EXTRAS:  Small outdoor seating area parallels parking lot.  Private glass enclosed dining area looks as if it would seat 20'ish.
Good food good beer good service and a bit overpriced. The margarita flatbread pizza was tasty. Would return

The food has always been amazing but the service has gotten real lousy and gone down hill. Starting with the disappointing hosts. My husband and I ask to sit in a booth and the host says no and I ask why not and he said the section is closed. So my husband says well how long is the wait for a booth he says 25 minutes ! Are you serious?! How it should be is the guest should feel comfortable and be told yes of course then you get a server to cover it. It's not the guests problem and the guest should never feel like an inconvenience. So we decided to wait and then the manager sat us right a way in a booth. How strange? The host was just either a big idiot or lazy but he's the first impression to your business. How about you train your hosts a little better to figure it out it's not rocket science I've been a server and host for 5 years! 

His name the host is Bryce. Let's see how the rest of the evening goes.

Tasty steaks, a good selection of beer and wine, heavenly bread pudding and 5 star service.  The only negative is that even when their 8 oz ribeye is on special (as it is on Mondays and Tuesdays), their prices are a bit high compared to my standby favorite Texas Roadhouse.

So excited we can eat Pueblo Lindo closer to home! We love the restaurant in McCall and are not disappointed with the new location in Meridian. Friendly servers, bright and happy interior, excellent food-we are so happy! The mole is fantastic and the fish tacos had such an excellent flavor-we can't wait to try everything they offer :)

We did a catering order with R&R over a week in advance. We were sent a confirmation email an hour before the order was to be delivered stating everything was on time.  Needless to say... the order arrived over an hour late in the middle of our Christmas party.  The food was cold... we ordered the burners to keep food warm, however they didnt give us the stands making the burners useless.  They never advised that the meat we ordered wasnt available they just took it upon themselves to give us random meats.  The garlic mashed potatoes were horrible and bland and not even mashed they were super lumpy and tastless.  The mashed potatoes spilled in the box all over everything.  Their lack of planning and communication made for a very horrible dinner as well as taking up an hour of our time where we had other stuff to do and were unable to do so.  Never will I ever do another take out catering event with this place.

The husband approved! **guess he needs to listen to my food choices more often haha!** 

I've been to this Poké place a few times now and it never disappoints. I have also never ventured off of their "build your own" Poké bowl. I usually get the same thing with small exceptions here and there. 

Most of the time I get a small bowl with sushi rice. It's 2 scoops of protein and then you add your sauce as well as 5 toppings. My husband will get a large (5scoops of protein). This place usually does not have a line, but they are also still new. 

If you're in the area and are looking for a "deconstructed sushi roll" check this place out! Everything is fresh and made right in front of you too.
This is one of my favorite places to get prime rib! Great service, great food, great vibe. Definitely order the bread pudding dessert and have your camera ready!

Always a long wait, but it's usually worth it for us. We love the huge beer selection! Big menu, which they just re-designed and it's very helpful. All the food I've had here is pretty good. Not the best, but not bad. I love the atmosphere and it's one of our favorites. Great location and ambiance, and outdoor seating is fun in summer and winter.

New year day my husband and I decided that Chinese food sounded good for dinner. We ordered chow main, honey shrimp, chow fun, and Mongolian beef... the order took an hour... we took into consideration that there aren't very many places open due to it being a holiday... anyway.... we got our food.... the Mongolian beef was primarily veggies and no beef my husband called them back to ask why that was and the lady very rudely stated that's just how it comes and then proceeded to tell him they wouldn't give any kind of refund for it.... he took the beef back to the restaurant and the lady asked him well how do I know you haven't eaten any of it.... he left the beef with them because it seemed as if they only care about the money and not customers..... Now the quality of the food as well was just not very great either... we had to add all of our own sauces to our noodles and the honey shrimp was just fried shrimp no kind of sauce at all.... we had a horrible experience with them very disappointed!!!

This place is sooo good. I love the convenience of delivery and all the options that you can mix and match (works out nicely when not everyone wants the same cuisine).

The quality of food is excellent and always comes hot or cold, whichever it's supposed to be. 

They accidentally delivered a wrong item and I got a hold of them without issue and their customer service was amazing. They were very apologetic and delivered the correct item within 30 minutes.

I'm thrilled this place is in Idaho!
Always fast always excellent customer service. All the employees are super friendly and very attentive. From the car wash to the detail center I highly recommend this place.

I've only been here once so far but definitely plan to come back. The style of service that involves making your way along the counter and choosing your toppings (similar to Subway or Pita Pit) is fun and exciting, with lots of toppings to choose from which are all fresh and delicious. The prices are super reasonable, especially since most pizza places charge by the topping and Blaze has one flat rate. I'm definitely the kind of guy who likes 5 or more toppings on my pizza, so this system is ideal for me.

Be aware that the seating can be a bit crowded and is large and open like a cafeteria. I don't think there's anything wrong with that, but it's good to know what you're walking into and this isn't a pizza place with big booths for families of five or anything.

Finally, there are some isolated incidents of poor customer service in the other reviews, but during my visit everyone was polite and helpful, and patient with me which was important since I hadn't been there before and didn't know about all of the available toppings. 

Ultimately I paid $8.00 for a pizza all my own, with as many toppings as I wanted, that I got to  eat with good friends and I had a wonderful time. I think that's the best thing I could hope for in a pizza place and I'll be coming back for weekend lunch with my room mates again and again.

Really great service, and good Mexican food for Idaho. (Great chips and an awesome selection of salsas. They also have great guacamole.) We usually get right in or have a short wait. That seems to be rare these days. My only complaint is that their "en Diablo" sauce for spicier dishes has a sweetness to it that kind of ruins it for me.

For the amount of times I visit this place I was surprised to see I hadn't yet reviewed them. 

Texas Road House does exactly what it says it will do perfectly and will leave you satisfied and wanting more. 

Outstanding customer service from hostesses on up, great food prices for value (11oz sirloin with 2 sides for $12.00?!), and the freedom to bring your family and enjoy your company. 

I recommend this place every chance I can and hope everyone gets to try it atleast once. 

Beware: can be pretty busy on weekend nights. Come early or call ahead.

Love this concept and the fact that it has one of our favorite SF spots - Betelnut. The wok-fired green beans, papaya and grapefruit salad, and firecracker chicken brought us right back to being in the restaurant! 

We also got a small veggie and small pepperoni pizzas from Tony G's menu and they are very solid pizzas with lots of top notch toppings, crisp and chewy crust (regular pizza not the Detroit style), and we must have been a first delivery because it was piping hot. 

Looking forward to exploring the menu more and really hoping this concept does well.

Bland. Bland bland bland bland bland bland. The waiter made a big deal about how spicy the habanero was and i have tasted spicier shampoo. The smoked margarita is worth one star, it was pretty good. The house margarita was like a glass of green Koolaid with zero alcohol in it. Makes other mall food look like Michelin star cuisine. Do not visit.

So far this is the best chinese food I have tried in Meridian. Called in a takeout order on Friday and it was ready in about 20 min. We tried the following:
Beef chow fun: a little on the dry side but beef was tender and overall flavor was good. Good portion size.
General Tso Chicken: great portion size and great flavor. Chicken had a good crunch but wasnt overly breaded.
Mongolian Beef: portion size was just ok. Flavor was good but way to much onion and not enough beef. We will probably try a different beef dish next time.
Crab pops: great flavor and portion size. I think they were a little over fried so I will probably order again to see if that's the norm.

Overall good portion size and flavor for the price spent about $42 and there was enough food for me and my husband for dinner and then lunch the next day. We will probably order for take out again.

This place is the best the food is phenomenal everything on the menu looks so good the hardest decision is picking one thing. The  dining room is extremely comfortable and it has first class service. Our server Elizabeth went above and beyond to help us enjoy our dining experience we will definitely be returning for another visit

Brought in a picture of a bad lighting ballast and their lighting guy pulled a ballast off the shelf telling me it was the proper replacement. Got home and it was physically longer with 3 less wires for installation. Brought it back and their 'electrical specialist' said "I can't help you, I've never installed one of these before." 
I'm going back to the orange store. No more blue for me.

This was our first visit and both the food and service were off the chart outstanding. My wife had the scampi and I had the New York Steak and everything on both plates was outstanding. 
The bread pudding topped the evening off in scrumptious fashion. A half order fed two of us. 
Travis, our server, rates a 10 out of 10.

This is the 3rd time going to The Matador and the visits have been years apart. While I like the waitstaff and the ambiance the food just isn't good. The beans are soo salty, enchilada flavor was missing key spices and the rice, dry and heavy on spice but not in a good way. Their ceviche is really good, mojito was average. I'm not a fan of tequila so maybe this just isn't the restaurant for me.
PS the flies on the patio are aggressive and out of control, pretty miserable.

We highly recommend Rendon Costruction.  Shawn and his crew remodeled a bathroom in our 1957 home that was in dire need of help.  From start to finish the experience was a pleasure...say that about a 5 week construction zone in your home and you realize you're dealing with pros.  Daily updates and rapid response to questions were the norm as was their willingness to make changes on the fly.  Every member of Shawn's crew was polite and respectful and will always be welcome in our home.  Stop looking....you've found a good one in Rendon Construction.   
ps....He's even more obsessed with detail than me and that's saying something!

I've tried this place multiple times and continue to be disappointed.  I tried to tell the server today and couldn't because she didn't even ask how things were.  Two times ago, I ordered a chicken sandwich minus the bun.  It came out and was about 2 in. round.  I asked the server if he thought that was acceptable and he told me because there was no bun it made it appear smaller.  I then asked if the bun was the same size as my wife's hamburger she had ordered, and he said yes.  The bun was about 4 in.  I said that would make for a pretty bad sandwich.  He did agree and said he would talk to the kitchen manager.  He then came back and said the kitchen manager said that's how its served and thats what you get.  He said he would comp the meal and did.  Other than the initial arguing that the chicken was big enough, the server was good.  But was clearly scared to question the kitchen or management.  

I let it go and brought my dad over for beers and lunch on his birthday a couple weeks later.  The food took about 40 minutes to get.  They were not very busy, but understaffed.  My food was actually pretty good, but my dad's chili was cold (refrigerator cold).  He tried to send it back, but it took about 10 minutes for the server to come back.  The server was nice and advised that someone forgot to turn on the warmer that day.  This was at 2pm.  Must have been a big oversight since they made it through their lunch rush.  The server just laughed and shrugged it off.  Fair enough, it was only chili I guess...

Decided to go in today for breakfast and mimosas.  We got there at noon, knowing they serve breakfast until 1pm (at least that's what the menu says).  It took awhile to get our order taken and when they did, we were advised that the kitchen decided to stop serving breakfast at 11:30 because of a menu change.  I've worked in this industry my whole life and the kitchen doesn't dictate the hours of operation.  Complete BS.  However, we stayed and ordered lunch.  My club sandwich was dry and the meat tasted old. In all honesty, it would have had to be pretty good to not taste bad because of the previous experiences and the start to this trip.  My mom asked for a bloody mary and requested it to not be too spicy.  It came out 3 shades darker than tomato juice, which means its nothing but spice and weird stuff.  She is not picky and said it was almost undrinkable.  We asked for a little more tomato juice and the server scoffed at us and then brought out and entire pint glass of tomato juice.  Then charged us for it. All of our food was cold.  Like it had been sitting in the unwarmed window for 10 minutes.  The onion rings had uncooked batter throughout them.  Not one of us finished more than a quarter of their plate and the server didn't even ask how it was.  She did ask after the first couple of bites and I said it was tolerable. She didn't ask why or try to remedy anything.

This place is consistently busy due to it's location and the fact its one of the only places you can drink in the area.  My hard earned money will no longer be spent here.  See you at Rudy's.

I loathe this place.... loathe! No way is the food here worth waiting over an hour in pre-covid times, let alone now. Sure the buns are good, but the rest is just slightly fancier apple bees fare. There's better out there for a similar price without the overly long wait.

First time visiting this Restaurant tonight and eating in was a pleasure. Nice atmosphere and a very friendly and attentive staff. Clean, small, hometown authentic feel.  The food we ordered was orange chicken, spring rolls, and vegetable lover ramen. All three dishes were superb and brought to us in a timely manner. Great place, friendly service, good food, will definitely be returning. Thank you.

I really want to love this place. It is convenient, and has good food about half of the time. Today, however... I arrived and gave the host & hostess my name to pick up the to go order I had phoned in about 20 minutes before.  They told me that it wasn't ready, so I sat down to wait.  20 minutes later they asked my name again, checked their systems and announced that they did not have an order for me in their system. It was too late to change my plans, so I ordered again and they took my credit card right away. 
I have now been waiting for almost an hour and still do not have my to-go order. No information, no check-in, no estimation, no contact at all.  
I would leave, but I have already paid.  
I wonder how long it will take?

Absolutely fantastic. Service and customer experience sets this place apart. Went for an oil change and ended up having lunch at Earl of Sandwich and a drink at the Growler inside. Sandwich was perfect, beer was ice cold and the service at the oil change was the same price as their competitors but they cleaned our car and vacuumed the interior including an air freshener! I will only come here for my service forever! I'm in love. Mark Honesto is the man.

I'm 9 and am on my mom's phone (with her permission lol) Anyways, I LOVE Sakana!!! Their sushi is sooo amazing and the miso soup I always get is the best!!!! My mom gets the udon soup and she LLLOOOVVVEEESSS it

If you are in Meridian, COME EAT HERE!!! The food is excellent, fresh and great specials daily. The steaks and prime rib won't disappoint! Also they have a ton of beer on tap!!!  Give this place a try...I dont think you will regret it...plus you get to support locally owned, which is never a bad thing!!

4 stars not because of food, drink, or the staff those are all 5 star worthy. I gave it 4 stars because its very small, loud and sometimes very hard to get in. Also the decor is dated and dark.

One of my best friends raved about this place, she & husband love it. I was super excited to try it. It was good, I had bowl of tantanem ramen soup, with Thai iced tea & gyoza; my husband had General Tso chicken with fried rice. It was good but neither of us got too excited about anything we ate.  Maybe my expectations were too high, no major complaints but we just didn't find anything exceptional. My friend orders the house special yakisoba with vegetables, to be fair I should give a try  if I eat there again.

This was the BEST marketplace I have ever been to. They offer so many goodies. We stopped in to get sandwiches for lunch and easily spent 30 mins walking around mesmerized by everything this store offered. They had so many choices for candies and sweets and many flavors I had never see before at any other store. They had local gelato, local ice cream sandwiches, and other local products. This store has everything you could ever think of and then some! It was also very clean and organized. We're talking about going later to explore more

Fresh ingredients, great pizza, but holy cow someone needs to teach the staff customer service. I have been going here regularly since they opened and every time every employee acts like they hate there job and are usually rude, not just to me, but other people in line around me as well. I understand customer service is tough, but at least fake a smile to the majority of your customers.

I get that this place just opened a couple of weeks ago.  But being sold out of donuts at a place where DONUT is the first word in the name is really unfortunate.  We were there at 6:30 on a Friday night.  You've had 2 weeks to figure out how many donuts you need to have on-hand.  And you'd probably want to do even more on a Friday night.  Blah blah blah we are so popular and that's why we sell out.  OK, yes.  BUT you could have handled it better.  You have the sandwich board out front, put a big SOLD OUT OF DONUTS on that so that people don't waste their time coming in.  We watched A LOT of people with kids coming in and turning around and leaving after finding out that there are no donuts.  Telling people to come back tomorrow at 8am is just silly.  Maybe give out a BOGO coupon or something to incentivize people to come back at 8am tomorrow.  If you are running out of donuts every day, make extra.  And if you make too many, put them half price at the end of the day or the next morning.

Elote Loco
