chorizo dog, "mexican street corn", cotija (roasted sweet corn, chipotle powder, lime, cilantro).
- Good, but very spicy if you just bite the dog (just a warning, nothing wrong with it).

B.A.T.
bacon wrapped dog, avocado, tomato, basil-sriracha aioli
- Got this without the aioli and with mayo instead; it was good too.

The bread for buns was soft and delicious.  A little big for the size of the hot dog.  But tasty just the same.

The real winner here however were the fries.
Fries - black truffle oil, melted parmesan cheese.
However the parmesan wasn't melted.  They should have torched them or put them under the broiler for a bit.  It would have made these really good fries really great fries.

The place wasn't packed - again, there was a lot of in and out from people finding out there were no donuts - it was maybe 75% full and the place was not clean.  The floors were super dirty - needed mopped or at least swept.  I didn't see anyone out there attending to the dining area while we were there though a guy did come to take our plates before we left. 

I'm on the fence about this place.  And again, I do realize they are new to the Village.  The dogs were good.  The fries were almost great.  But no donuts.  And a dining area that needs attending to.

I'm going with a 2 for "meh, I've experienced better" because I have from new restaurants.  We will however probably return and give it another go and update this review and star rating accordingly.

We are doing a studs out renovation on a smaller home, and got a couple bids from around the valley. After accepting the bid, their crew came out and had things wrapped up within hours. Crazy fast. Clancey was who helped me out, and he exceeded expectations! Professional, concise, and extremely well at communicated with me and getting things done right.  100% recommend Marv's insulation, ask for Clancey.

Good food and lots of options! They even have a section for vegetarians but their rice does have Chicken broth in it so opt for beans if anyone is a true vegetarian :) love the chips and salsa that comes before each meal! The atmosphere is so friendly and authentic. Like you are part of the family here ! I am glad to have found this place.

Looking for a great dentist?  no further! Dr. Williams is fabulous as well as his entire staff. We are new to the area and were nervous about finding a new dentist but thank God our friend recommended Basic Dental Care! We love Dr. Williams. He is competent, gentle, thorough and funny! His hygienists, dental assistants and office staff are great too!

Great sirloin steak sandwich and the french dip sandwich as well.  Really, everything was good!  The fries were cooked just right and the beer was great!  We sat at the bar because we got immediate seating and our server was efficient and welcoming.  Good experience, we will be back!

We had high hopes for the homestead and had been really looking forward to trying the buffet. It was mostly cold and just ok I am not a person who writes bad reviews or even says anything and would not be writing this if not for the service. After waiting 30 minutes for the check our waitress told us "sorry to leave you unattended for so long, I'll get your check right now" we waited another 10-15 minutes with no sign of her. We had 2 coffee's and two buffets I gave the bartender $40 and told her we had waited long enough and would not be back to which the response I got back was "we have enough customers thanks!" really?

Norco in Boise meridian is the worst outhouse for medical supplies available in the treasure valley. I have been with them for a year and a half boarding things like glucerna shakes that I have to have for my diabetes and for the last few months have been approved to order some shower bar handles so I don't fall. Of course Norco is always out of stock and has them on backorder. For an employee owned company you'd think they take some concern when it comes to their supply chain. They need to carry a few safety items in stock. The proper medical supplies can keep you out of the hospital and Norco seems intent on helping get you there. Today I offered to go to Walmart and pick them up for Norco as they were on sale for 8 bucks a piece of course they declined and will contact me again when they become available they would better serve the treasure valley in Halloween supplies rather than medical. Beware if you ever get their candy you may not want it. Happy Halloween Norco.

I recently visited Star, Idaho and my suitcase broke.  I went to Marshall's during the Christmas rush and found a suitcase , but, no price tag on it.  An employee named Cliff very quickly took charge, found the correct price, ticketed the suitcase and put it by the cash registers with my name on it so I wouldn't have to lug it through the long line.  What an excellent example of customer service! He was fast, efficient and a breath of fresh air during a busy time for retail stores. Excellent job Cliff

This review is for the pharmacy only

My step daughter is here for the summer and she has prescriptions through Rite Aid.  I was a bit nervous about how the refill process was going to play out because her insurance carrier is only in California and they have a tendency of not immediately covering anything in another state. Usually it's a long, drawn out reimbursement process.  So, I called Rite Aid & prayed for the best! Initially they were not able to give me an answer because they needed to actually attempt to charge the insurance company for the prescription and we were a few days too early to get a refill.  The pharmacist told me to call back in 2 days. He also reassured me that if the insurance company denied the medication he would find coupons & discounts to get me the best out of pocket price possible.  I appreciated that he was willing to go the extra mile.  
Fast forward two days! I called Rite Aid again to ask them to attempt to run the prescription.  When I gave my daughters information to the technician she happily told me that the medication was ready for pickup! Wow! That was nice' I didn't think that the pharmacist was going to remember to run it.  
Dealing with pharmacy's can be a total pain in the A, but Rite Aid really came through for me! Thanks Joshua!

First time customer. Got a "large" bowl of Japanese noodles to go. What I got was a HALF filled large container which was I suppose was the equivalent of a small. Noodles where very chewy, not even cooked al dente! Very disappointed in the quality and quantity for what I paid for. Will never go back there.
Not 5 star ramen, but having eaten ramen nationwide....this is hands down the best we've found in Idaho. Friendly and well staffed adds to the experience. We will only eat ramen here when in Boise.

Usually I would post a 4 or 5 star review for these folks but not this time.  I was amazed to observe that in the midst of the very worst time so far during the 18 months of worldwide pandemic status I could not see what I considered as sufficient safety measures, i.e. gloves, masks, table cleaning/sanitizing, during this visit.  Months ago they did much better.  Why not now?

Very disappointed in our experience. The bartender got visibly angry when asked if they served hot chocolate (for Bailey's).  He said "I am running a bar here".  The host forgot to seat us, so we had to ask what happened to our place in line after 4-5 groups behind us were seated ahead of us.  The food was good, but when it was delivered to the table I had to get up and request some plates to put the Fajitas on.  Finally, they messed up our second drink (same as the first).  Not likely to return.

We were greeted by Emily with a welcoming smile and conscientious efforts to make sure we were seated quickly. Our server was cheerful and helpful. My husband raved about the tastiness of the steak entree and the flavors in his meats are very important to him. We actually hadn't been to a Chili's for years because he didn't think the food would be good but he is won over. We  will return soon.

I brought my bike in on a scheduled appointment to have the rear tire changed. I was told by the service manager to bring it in early and it would be done right away. It took all day to change out a tire, and they charged more to change the tire than I paid for it. I will not use Boise Triumph for any future service needs. There are other options available- I am very disappointed in their customer service, particularly since they are a new dealer in town.

What a cute shop! I haven't been in a hallmark in years, but I loved it as soon as I walked in. The lady let me in a little early because I didn't know they didn't open til 10:00. I was looking for a little Idaho gift, and I found a cute mug. They have chocolates, tons of cute gifts, and Christmas ornaments out already. I read on another review there were no hallmark movie DVDs, but there was today. Lots of unique items to check out! I think I'm going to go back for the chocolate advent calendars for $17.

This is one of our good ol' standby spots in Meridian if we want pizza and/or salad.  Both the flatbreads and pizzas are all delicious. One thing I'm really picky about is the dough, and this place delivers a fantastic dough which cooks up well in the wood fire brick oven.

If you enjoy a good wedge salad make sure you try their's. It has sweet and spicy bacon with blue cheese crumbles and nice dressings all on fresh crispy lettuce wedge. One of our favorite salads in town!

The Caldwell office is a circus.  I've never been seen within 45 minutes of my scheduled appointment, including one today at 8:40am.  The waiting room was empty both when I arrived and when I walked out after sitting in a room while in pain.  To add insult to injury, the staff is loud and unprofessional outside the procedure rooms.  If you must go, request to be seen in Meridian...the wait is also long but each day doesn't feel like casual Friday at a gymnasium.  

Bottom line, request a different referral from your doctor and save yourself a lot of grief.

Their lobster bisque was extremely good! I would go back for that. They had some fun drinks too but didn't end up getting anything. Got the schnitzel. It didn't taste BAD, but it was extremely small and the sides were worse than fast food. I was setup with such high hopes just to be knocked down so hard lol the prices were absolutely astronomical. We probably won't go back...only went since we had a gift card.

I wanted to give a shout-out to the team that worked the evening of 10-29.21. I placed an order online for pick up and when I got there it looked like there was some event in town (tons of young adults in matching sweaters filling every one of the eating establishments in the area). Essentially, the place was packed to the brim- a line around the store. I got in about 5 min earlier than my pickup time and left with my pizzas exactly the way I ordered them and cooked perfectly in about 12min. The assembly-line team were absolutely rocking it. They all deserve some kudos!

Had to go to court, but won a settlement against the owner today.  Read every line of your contract, they don't guarantee anything other than the health guarantee for limited time.  If they tell you it's a purebred, don't believe it; their contract states they do not guarantee breed at all.

Glad this is finally over.

I love this spot! I came here while my aunt and cousin were visiting and I have to say this place is awesome it has a nice bar and TV screen so if you're into sports or that kind of thing you can definitely watch a game or two and the menu is awesome. I ordered a salad and chicken wings and shared it with my aunt and we loved it it was delicious! my cousin ordered the mac & cheese baked potato dish and she loved it as well. I would love to come back and bring a couple friends with me good vibes.

Moved from out of state to the Boise area. Had an appointment to have Big Boy Movers meet us at the home to help unload the truck. Even though we were running two hours late, BBM met us at the house to help us unload. They were unable to extend the time helping due to other jobs so I can't blame them for that.

This review and five stars is more about the two young men who helped us; Gage and Trent. Both of them were polite and professional and KICKED @SS. These two guys hustled and unloaded a 26 foot truck packed to the gills in under 2 hours (with the help of my son-in-law) with my directing what furniture and boxes went where. Their work ethic is outstanding and they never rested or paused. Hats off to these fine guys!
Terrible hostes, seated multiple people in front of us that got here after us. Waited 2 hours and lied about where we were on the list. Would not come here again.

I haven't been to this restaurant in a few years but decided to come here for a date night.  It could be such a great restaurant but there were just a bit too many flaws for me to want to come back here. 

We got there at about 500pm, it was dollar sushi plate night so thought this was good to try some different small plates. I ordered hot tea, it was really just above room temperature. I had to ask to have it reheated. We ordered our combos, but never received our salad and soup we ordered. 

I enjoyed the shumai and the tempura we ordered, and the combo roll plated we got. You do get a lot of food for the price. 

The food was so-so, the service was lacking.

I said I would revisit this place a little later to see if I could give it a better review.  And I did, and I can.  I'm teetering between 3 and 4, but I'm going to give it 4 stars.

We went early Saturday morning, a couple of ladies were working on donuts with gigantic mounds of mouthwatering delicious yeasty dough, the stands by the register were loaded with donuts, as were the cases behind where they would pull them from to serve.  We were pleased to see this as there were no donuts on our first visit (over a month ago).

The young girl that was working was super cute and super chatty.  The only issue there was that she was the only one working the front for a while -- someone showed up a little bit later.  So, while she was working on hot drinks for someone, we had to wait a fair amount of time to order and get our donuts.  This happened to other folks too.  But she came around when she could and checked on people, asked what donuts they liked, talked about the donuts and their ingredients.  She was super knowledgeable.

The donuts.  
We tried 4 different ones while we were there, and then took 2 home with us.  We divided them all and did a tasting of sorts.  I'll start with least favorite.  There were a couple of seasonal ones - one was topped with dark chocolate and dark chocolate chunks and it was too strong for me.  My husband liked it and finished mine.  If you like dark chocolate, you would like this one.  There was nothing wrong with it - just not for me.  There was another seasonal one that had dark chocolate on top as well and then a big mound of peanut butter cream on it.  Neither of us cared for the peanut butter piece of it.  It had an alcohol taste to it, but the girl said there wasn't any alcohol in it.  I'm not sure, but it just didn't work for us.

My husband had the More Than Maple - topped with bacon and chocolate drizzle and he liked it really well.  I could smell it and it was sooo mapley smelling - it smelled really good.  He said he wished the bacon would have been pieces all over instead of just the one big piece so that you get some in every bite.  He loved it regardless though.

The California Dreamin' was pretty good - the caramel was delicious on this one.

A favorite of mine, I can't recall the name, but it was glazed, cherry-filled, and topped with a little mound of goat cheese.  A lot of filling.  Reeeeeeeeeeally delicious.  And this was having it 10 hours later - less fresh, but still delicious and loaded with cherry filling.

The showstopper for us was the Southern Belle:  peach jam filled from 4 sides, brown butter glaze, local pecan brittle topped.  That brown butter glaze is more of a frosting and it was IN CRED I BLE.  Like, WOW.

I'm not sure if we would go back, because they are a little spendy - but you get what you pay for.  Maybe we wouldn't go back for 6 though and that would cut down on the cost - ha ha.  I would recommend this place though because you WILL find something to tickle your fancy.

We've been here twice and both visits were marvelous. We do our best to avoid crowded evenings, so either arrive early or on a non-crowded night (we went one Saturday evening before lines started and on a Monday evening).

We got a perfectly prepared prime rib one evening and a nice ribeye the other. Both were wonderful paired with asparagus and baked fries. They have a great beer flight from their extensive local beer list (eight 5 ounce beers - easy to split between two people so as not to have too much - at an amazing price).

We don't normally do dessert, but were told the bread pudding was not to be missed by another Yelper... so we split a half order that was still way too big for us - but it was absolutely superb.

The service was not quick, but it was extremely friendly. We plan to bring our nephew here with us when he visits next week.

If there was a No star rating I would give it here.

At first this outfit seemed a good one. They were quick to come out and give a bid. The bid seemed a fair value. They set a date within a week to do the work and said what time they would be there.

Well, now the proof is in the performance and this is where they crashed and burned. They couldn't meet the time set, did not phone and notify us, and then could not even meet the reset time that day. If they can't organize their business to meet their appointment, that tells me a lot.

As a consequence, we canceled them and will find a better company.

This dinner was amazing. 40 min wait was totally worth it, for a nice, casual date night. I had the scampi and rice, with asparagus, cooked to perfection. Nic had sirloin and reds. Divine! Manufic!! Muah!!

This place is Disgusting.  It should be shut down.  
I just left.. sick to my stomach.  
puppies covered in feces.. Horrible

Average sushi
Food - 3
Facility -4
Service- 4
Price - 3

We have been here a few times and it's a good quick fix for those sushi cravings. It beats the grocery store sushi but not by much. They always have customers but they also always have seats, we we have never had to wait to be seated. 
Not a place a would bring a customer for lunch or dinner but I do bring the family when we have to sooth the itch, they know what to expect so I think that makes it ok. 
If you like a lot of mayo in your spicy rolls this is the place for you. I'm personally not a fan, I want to taste the star of the show not the supporting cast.

I am giving this a 2 star because on Saturday when we came in, we had a terrific waiter, a bit of a wait on service but he was very kind.  Ordered the Steak & Shrimp Fajitas which were awesome.  I ordered it rare and what do you know, I got my steak done rare.

Went back on Sunday and discovered that the same order of Fajitas is very different at the same exact location.  This time when I ordered my fajitas rare, the waiter (who started out GREAT...but wait, there's more about him later) informed me that you can't request it done any way, as it only comes out medium.  When I asked why he said because it's just a cheap cut of flank steak which is really thin.  Hmmmm, the day before I got a thick cut of actual steak done rare as I requested.

Food was not great, but the appetizer of Texas Cheese fries were very good; however, we could not finish all our food and asked our waiter for a couple of To-Go boxes.  He brought us back 3 tiny ones and when my husband kindly asked him if he could go get a large one the waiter then got really snarky and said, "Why, you're not going to take those fries are you, they won't be any good."  My husband then said  that it was not up to him (the waiter) to decide how he would eat his leftovers and then asked a bit more firmly once more for a To-Go box.  Then the waiter got really beligerent at my husband and stormed off.  

My husband gave him our credit card and waited and waited and waited...finally, he had to ask a manager to get him his receipt so he could leave.

After this horrible experience we will NEVER step foot in there again, and here's why....2 days later it just so happens that someone got a hold of our credit card number (not the card, just the number) and racked up $1,000 of charges....hmmmm....not sure how that could have happened since the only place we used our card where it actually left our eyesight, and for quite some time. was here....just sayin' BE AWARE!!!

An amazing dining experience from start to finish. Great ambiance, attentive wait staff, fair prices, large portions and food that will keep you coming back. No complaints; recommend this place to anyone looking for a good restaurant in the area.

My wife and I have been very impressed with Kelson Orthodontics. They are always kind and courteous, professional and genuinely take an interest in our kids. I remember walking in with my daughter once and Dr Kelson calls me by name and says hi across the office. I think I had only met him once. I was very impressed. Would highly recommend!

Management:  don't be shy with the toppings, especially the mozzarella cheese.  I've been to many Blaze pizza in California, Arizona and others and I can say this location really makes sure to limit amount of toppings.  And I knew this location was like this from my first experience and sure enough, they barely sprinkle the cheese.  I get it... mozzarella is the single highest cost but man, can you not sprinkle it?  I asked for more and again, sprinkle where you still see more red sauce than cheese.  Even the customer behind me asked for MORE cheese.  Chicken... just a few dropped in.  Was going to ask for more but just gave up. Check it out for yourself.   Do better and be better.
Took over 30 minutes to receive our wings. Everyone around us got their wings. Server was extremely rude. Floors with dirty and wings were extremely dry.

Moved to the area from Texas two years ago and have tried several area Mexican food restaurants with degrees of disappointment.  So happy I found my go to place for excellent Mexican food.  Even my bro who doesn't like Mexican food all that much thought the fajitas were the best he ever had. I had the shredded beef enchiladas and they were excellent!  Very nice decor and all the staff was super friendly.  We want to try the McCall location next.
These guys will take you for a ride don't bother applying. They lead you on to get more money.

We went here for a MMA fight night while visiting in ID. It was an alternative to BWW (who were completely booked full)  the food was pretty good the wings excellent the service a little disorganized but friendly (to be expected for a new joint) this place serves something like 40 beers on tap but had run out of several long before the fights started. Still the beer drinkers in my party were happy about trying new things. some of the patrons were over served which we all got to listen to in rants etc at the end of the main event (I also watched a drug deal go down between totally normal looking people)  it's a bar set up with tables but people brought in young children. It was a totally new experience indeed

It is always super busy here! There are a lot of tables and outdoor seating when it's nice out. My wife and I have never had to wait more than a few minutes to get a seat. The food is good to fair. The beer selection is amazing. The can make cocktails and you have to see their Bloody Mary to believe it. I won't give you the satisfaction of knowing what it's all about, you got to see it to appreciate it!

Of I could leave nothing on this I would. Two weeks post surgery and we had to take our dog to another vet where they told us his genital swelling was the worst they'd ever seen. They had to drain his scrotum and after looking said that they would need to remove them all together. They also said that while they couldn't verify what exactly happened during the SNIP surgery to cause this due to so much blood and swelling but they said it was most definitely from the previous surgery. $512 later, our pup is finally feeling better. I cannot urge people enough to go somewhere else. This place should be sued for the damage they cause!

I have never given a bad review, and I don't even mind if service is slow, but this was beyond awful. Sodas were never brought out, ever - even after asking a few times. Appetizers brought out after the food (& an hour and a half of waiting) and it just goes on & on from there. The manager was the worst part of the experience & not helpful at all. As a business owner, I would reconsider who my manager was.
Great beer selection and fantastic environment. We could spend a good amount of time at the Yard House. Anthony the bartender is amazing and very nice
Looking for a place to eat found this on Yelp. Burgers and tots amazing!!! A lot of food for the price. Will come back when In Meridian.

9:45, Stopped to get some doughnuts to take home. Store was closed. Why? I don't know.  Probably because it's a  Friday night and teens want to leave and get their party on. In the meantime, KK lost money, as I observed quite a few customers were stopping in for doughnuts as well.

Absolutely loved this place when my girlfriend and I checked it out for our first time! Friendly service and very unique and delicious food! We recommend getting the gooey grilled cheese with tomato soup and getting the BLA Hot dog! The donuts are also unique and delicious and a perfect way to end your meal

Wonderful young man that helped me today! I went in to purchase their famous pepperoni sticks that we had tried up in Garden Valley! So delicious...let me tell you...even BETTER fresh!! Also bought some sausage and salami, and we're excited to try it. My first time going in their store and I'm looking forward to buying quality meat from there in the future! Thanks guys!

We were very disappointed.  The size of our meals were small and not satisfying.  My husband ordered rib eye tacos.  zero cilantro on them, which is why he chose them.  They were 2 small tacos with no salsa .  I ordered carne asada meal well done.  It arrived rare and I did not eat it.  So I basically paid $20 for rice, beans and corn.

I really want to love Kahootz. It's local, they have tons of beers on draft, the bread pudding is worth leaving my husband for. But twice now my steak has been overcooked! I thought maybe the first time was a fluke, but it happened again. I did say something the second time and they comped my steak. That was great. I just find overcooked steak an unforgivable sin in a steak house. I guess I'll stick with their brews and bread.
Amazing food went back already for 2nd time! Great portions and the ramen is great! Highly recommend and excellent staff!

READ THE LOW REVIEWS! 
Customer service is the absolute worst with this company. It is family owned. The apple truly does not fall far from the tree with these guys. Everyone from the "owner" to the bottom, "customer service" is downright terrible. It is clear that there has never been training within the company. They cant figure out how to diagnose a simple ice maker, making more work for everyone involved. My ice machine worked TEMPORARILY but never properly after one "technician" came out. They company called to set up another appointment (kudos),  I let them know that the ice machine was running and appeared to be making ice (yet the ice never completely froze). I called them again to let them know that my ice machine was in fact, not working properly and OH MY GOSH! Let the fireworks begin. Brandon (apparently the owner... ???) was downright nasty. He had already spoke with Dureen (customer service ???). Man. What a headache these people are. Avoid at all costs!! 
Thankfully my warranty company on my appliance will be able to set me up with an actual professional. Ill make sure to add the company to this review for any other poor individuals who fall into this family's web. 
I should also mention that a co-worker was sitting in my office when I first called Doreen. She was on speaker and my co-worker was mortified by the way Doreen even spoke to me. I also talked to Danielle (apparently a manager). I let her know that I would be leaving a review. She responded with, "If you leave a bad review, we will contact our attorney and sue you for defamation." She was also on speaker when that was said, allowing three other individuals to hear her threat. AVOID AT ALL COSTS. :)

Nice-ish inside, but with an "I'm on display" sort of vibe because of the circular arrangement of the tables. This is particularly strange, since the low light seems to be trying for cozy/romantic. It's just kind of an awkward vibe.

The service was good, but the food spotty. The bleu cheese dip is 100% worth the money, but our entrees were pretty uneven and disappointing. My fish was overcooked, my rice underseasoned, but the shrimp was good. My husband only ate half of his fish and chips, a favorite, because they were so lackluster. We will not go back.

Great experience on a quiet Sunday morning (6/12/2021).  Grabbed some baskets of flowers in the garden center and Angie went above and beyond the service expected.  She had such a 'chill' demeanor, and made check-out really enjoyable.  Thanks, local Lowes Team!

We visited the showroom seriously looking to purchase a motorcycle a couple of months ago. There were probably 3 sales persons in the shop talking together. Not one of them gave us the time of day. We purchased a lightly used bike from a private seller. Took the bike in last week to run a diagnostic on it. No mechanic on duty. They asked us to bring it back this week and would cost $35. Brought it in today and they charged us $67. Not impressed.

Stopped by to pick up a couple dozen donuts tonight. I got to watch some of the first pumpkin donuts going down through the fryer & glazer. They looked delicious!
The employees were super nice.  Patience helped us & she was awesome! Her name fit her well!  She answered all of my questions about the donuts & the cooking & glazing process. 
The donuts we brought home to eat were yummy!! Super fresh & perfect.

I was visiting my parents in Boise and my Mom suggested Pueblo Lindo. We both had the camarones diablo. It was very delicious and the staff are just outstanding. So kind and welcoming. 

Everyone is so warm and welcoming to my elderly parents when they come in and remember their favorite dishes. Since I was flying out today, my Mom and I returned for lunch. Her shrimp fajitas were fantastic and I really enjoyed my nopales con juevo. There were a few dried chilies hidden in there with great heat and two extra salsas came to the table to enjoy. Preferred the red but the verde was delightful, too.
Such a wonderful dentist and staff!  Everyone here is really friendly and answers any questions thoroughly!

I am giving this 3 stars because the employees were all really nice. Honestly I would say this burger was just mediocre, if that. There was just really nothing special about it. The actual hamburger tasted bland, needed salt. The bun was not your typical bun which I knew that when ordering. They did have tasty tater tots and fry sauce. Pricing wise it was a little pricey which I wasn't expecting for this type of burger joint. I probably wouldn't go here again just because I can get better burgers somewhere else for what I paid at this place.

So, my daughter fell in love with a sweet little pup but then we discovered the asking price would buy a teen a decent first car. After some reflecting we called and spoke with Joe, the manager. He agreed to come down on the cost and we greed on a price. We took our daughter in to make arrangements for the purchase but while she was playing with the pup we were presented with the used car salesman add-on list of expenses. What had a day previous been referred to as "included", micro-chipping, donation to fight puppy-mills, taxes had all been added onto the agreed upon price. Basically, all we had negotiated toward a more affordable price had been halved. So, they intentionally exposed the lie at the last minute knowing it left us choosing one of two bad choices;  either reward the deception or crush our daughter with the news that now we were not buying the puppy.   We chose to teach her to not allow unscrupulous people to cheat her.

I've been here several times and I'm never wowed by the food. The chips and salsa are decent. Sometimes the chips come out warm but most of the time they are cold and sometimes just a bowl of crumbled chips it depends on the day. The green enchiladas are good but small. Green chicken burrito is good. Chicken chimichanga is also good. The cilantro lime sour cream saves a lot of the meals I've had it is really good. The rice is ok but could have more flavor. The refried beans always hard and look like they have been out awhile and lack in flavor as well. The gringo tacos are not good. I'm not exaggerating when I say I prefer Taco Bell tacos! They don't even fry their own shells! And again lack in flavor. I could go on but overall I gave this three stars because the food is just ok. Location and decor is great, service is usually good.

Excellent service and food
Our waitress had a great attitude 
We think her name was Ashley
She told us but lol we may have forgot
Amazing experience
Thank you

I wish I could give 5 stars and may change my review next time.  We had a group of 10 for late night happy hour and birthday celebration. Our waitress Lisa ended up taking a turn for the worse. She went from nice to rude and bossy very quick. She was scolding us for asking another waitress for something, arguing about how easy/hard the computer is to use and even rudely asked one of our friends how old she was to prove a point. It was very awkward and unacceptable. We ended up complaining to the manager who handled it very well and that's why I'm giving 3 stars, other wise I'd give one. I've never in my life been treated that way and hope she doesn't work there any longer.

UPDATED REVIEW: 
Ordered through their drive thru and got a club on a sub to try and it's supposed to have bacon AND cheese. It came with neither of those things. The sub was so sloppy once I got home, the bun on the bottom was so soggy it was hard to eat. If I ever want firehouse, I'll probably be eating in the restaurant rather than drive thru just to make sure they get it right.

We just tried to go through the drive through and several employees working there. Instead of taking our order they did not answer. Drove up to window and they just ignored us. 30 min to closing. The owner should know about the crew there!  There is more to your job than cleaning to go home.

We've gone twice in the last two weeks. We like the warm ambience, music wasn't too loud and we were able to have a good conversation. Def a good spot for a date night, not too fancy or over the top - just right. Today during brunch we were seated more toward the middle near a group of loud women so that changed the experience. Probably will ask for a back table when possible. Love the style of the lights, booths and the bar in the middle. For dinner we both were raving over our meals... surf & turf and the sea bass. Everything was made to perfection and delish, we scraped our plates and got apple cobbler for dessert, very good. For brunch we had the crème brûlée French toast and crab cake dish, the crab cakes were super fresh (just wish they were warmer) and flavorful, French toast was good but we weren't sure what made them "crème brûlée" French toast.

Loves:
- Ambiance & date night vibes
- Great service
- Steak & fish cooked to perfection
- Muffins served before our meal at brunch
- Seated quickly without a reservation
- Prices are equal to the value of the meal
- Portions are perfect- not too much, not too little
- Didn't wait too long for food (if you get your salad same time as your food, it's because the food was ready quickly )

Would like to see:
- Better beer selection (more winter stouts would be nice)
- Food to come out hot, both times it came room temp (Thankfully still so tasty)

This is ALWAYS the best place to stop for gas, bathroom break, and a quick snack. They keep this place so nice and inviting. Bathrooms are immaculate. Very clean. The wall art covers the whole inside and makes for a great atmosphere. Workers are always nice and friendly. 

Great snack, drink, and food options. They even have a little eating area that is spotless. Pumps are quick and easy to use.

My partner had lunch with his work crew on Friday. He said we must go! Saturday at noon We did and it was delicious! We had the mega Bloody Mary which was lunch and a cocktail in 1. Affordable 15 bucks for a MEGA Bloody Mary with slider, bacon, shot glass with delicious chili, chicken wing, pretzel, shot of PBR, add queso for pretzel for a buck. We will be back! The bartender Josh was a pro! Watching the team behind the bar was super entertaining. Our server was fantastic as well didn't catch her name and it wasn't on our receipt. Check this place out! 
I have a new rating scale for 2022. 5 stars means go out of your way to check the place out. 4 means good food/ good service it would be worth your while to check them out. 3 means go there if you're in the area. 1 or 2 is rare for me. I don't use Yelp to complain.

I tried the California burger meal they were advertising in their window. What I received looked nothing like the picture but I thought it tasted good.  We also got a bacon avocado burger and it tasted good.  I would put them above a few of their competitors.  However,  the location was a mess.  Spilled items and sauces all over the floor and the garbage was over flowing with garbage.  The employees were are but just seemed to make sure they didn't step in it but never cleaned it up.
Love that there are a lot of options, I was happy to see that they had vegan options. Delivery was fast. Food was pretty good, but found a hair in my food :/

I've been coming here for about year, once a week for happy hour more or less. Tyler behind the bar whips us up traditional whiskey sours whenever we come in..  honestly, one of the best I've had in the Treasure Valley! Lexey is also super attentive and has great recommendations. Always a great experience and playlist going!

Stopped in for brew and a take out burger.  Good beer prices during happy hour.  Too many IPA's and too few Lager/Pilsner.  Ordered their basic Homestead Burger to go.  The preparation time was long because the place was pretty busy, but I had my brew, so all was good.  Very good bartender - service-oriented and no-frills interaction with the customers.  

I got the burger and fries.  Nice packaging, but no napkins.  Only discovered that when I started rummaging thru the bag once I left the restaurant.  Not cool.

I normally don't like battered fires, but these were lightly done, so they were OK.  

The burger was a whole different matter.  They proudly advertise 1/2 pound patties.  Inside the burger was a stiff, overcooked, dry, tasteless hunk of something and there was a lot of it.  I started to feel bad that a cow actually gave up a life to have this done to it.  They would benefit from having a different mix of fat and red meat in their burgers and not cooking it until it is a hockey puck.  There is a lot of meat, but bordering on unedible.  

Not recommended.

Second time ive been to a Yard House. First time was in Commiefornia near the bay, and it was decent.  You can read that review on your own. This one seemed better. The server was terrific and the food was good, i think. I ordered a burger and a ton of beers. I can tell you this though, Yard House in Boise makes the one in  the bay look like an over priced dennys. Dennys is good, dont get me wrong. Id come back, and id try and sneak a water in here and there....who am i kidding, no I wouldnt, id order another growler and id get at it.
Best bloody Mary's in town! Always great service and friendly staff! Happy Hour is the best

There were dirty tables (food on them from previous guests) surrounding ours when we arrived. Thinking they would soon get cleaned up, we said nothing. It took a while before our server showed up and then it took at least 20 minutes to receive our food. Tables surrounding us are still not clean. About half of our food items arrived cold and not fresh, not to mention overpriced. I asked the host if someone could get the tables cleaned up around us and she said she would get on it. She cleaned 1/3 tables and left the other 2 dirty. Those tables remained unclean when we left (total stay was about an hour). What kind of a restaurant leaves dirty tables that long, especially after receiving a complaint? This place stinks of the "I don't care mentality". This was the last time that I will patronize Chilis.

Don't let them into your home or give them money. Wayne is the owner operator, a short ,blue eyed guy. He does incomplete work that won't get ride of your pests, then promises and second treatment if needed. That is a lie he will tell you. He lies about his warranty and will tell you he is coming to do another treatment but won't/lies. When you call him out he acts like a 13 year old who isn't getting their way. I used a more popular pest control company after unfortunately using Integrity, the new company took care of my pest problems, Wayne @ Intrgrity wasted my money and time.

We were so disappointed this morning, one of the girls working the conveyor belt with the fresh donuts had her mask on their chin (below her mouth) and the other girl had her mask below her nose.  We wanted a donut, but not if they aren't wearing their masks correctly.  Hey Krispie Kreme get your act together!

Several issues getting ONE prescription filled. Knowing that it is a monthly prescription we call 2-3 days in advance to ensure it will be in stock when our insurance company will allow refill(unfortunately stuck with allotment of 30days). We will often get the run around of either we don't have, it didn't arrive, etc. today after calling on Sunday (it's Thursday) we're told the prescription itself expired yesterday therefore could not be filled. After several calls to dr they confirmed that the prescription doesn't actually expire until the 23rd!  I truly believe that the staff at the pharmacy simply don't care as one minute you can talk to one and get an answer but talk to another person and get a completely different bullshit excuse. Whats worse is we live in a different town 30-40 minutes away from this pharmacy so when told prescription is ready and to get all the way over there to hear "oh sorry it didn't arrive" not just once but several times it makes you question if they really know what they are doing.

This is ridiculous. You guys had difficulty keeping up with filling prescriptions before Covid. Now, with the drive up testing, the "vaccine" appointments, you can't even get through on your phones. Sitting waiting, as I write this, waiting on someone to answer the phone. Been waiting 26 minutes so far. I guess if you just need you r/x you're just out of luck chuck.

Great price, great ramen, great service! I had their ramen+app deal, with spicy miso ramen and the spicy shrimp wontons. Both were very delicious. I've been here several times and the flavors of their food is consistent and the service has always been pleasant.

Really great atmosphere, food, and drinks hidden at the end of a shopping center! Stopped in at Flatbread for a quick dinner and was immediately impressed with the attention to decor and how quiet it was for a packed restaurant with lots of kids. The flatbread and pizzas were as good as advertised - we did the margherita and plain marinara. The drinks were well done and lots of options - blackberry basil mule was the top.  Great find for pizza and a nice setup at the bar if you just want to pop in.

I ordered through DoorDash, which I knew my order wouldn't be perfect, I mean come one it's DoorDash they always mess something up. However I was rather surprised to find what appeared to be half eaten French fries, that I hadn't ordered, in my ranch container..... I ordered the Southwest Egg Rolls, they were warm and quite delicious, the French fries just left me very uneasy, but I used the ranch from my refrigerator instead. Kinda gross if you ask me. 

Points for warm food, major point deduction for the half eaten French fries.

Well my wife and I stopped in after a movie tonight and we were seated pretty quick.   That's where the good report ends.   The rest of our time was short-lived because a table with 6-8 was seated next to us and it became rapidly apparent that the potentially larger tip table was to be the priority.   We never even got water and after a period of time we simply left.  McDonald's left us more satisfied.

Being new to Idaho, I had to research a good doctor to treat my back.  Dr. Manos (who I still have never met) was highly recommended and/or reviewed.  Due to his scheduling, and my pain, I was able to get in the office to see his PA.  

In my initial appointment we addressed my reason for the visit, which was excruciating pain in my coccyx when I sit and/or lay down.  I had a previous surgery for my low back, but was not in the office for this reason.  They started with x-rays which were not centered around the point of my pain.  The x-rays were done of my low back.  I asked why we didn't get x-rays of my coccyx, and the PA explained that it's very hard for them to x-ray the coccyx because of the angle of the spine.  The PA then ordered an injection straight away without any attempt at a diagnosis.  She also ordered an MRI.  I asked to have the MRI prior to the injection because I wanted to know what could potentially be wrong with my tailbone before having an injection that may or may not help and would ultimately cost a bit of money.

Let me begin by saying I had been very clear about the area of my pain, and why I was in the doctor's office.  I had to ask a friend to accompany me to the injection appointment, and I also had to take time off work.  When I got there, I was told that they needed to refer me to the hospital because the location of the injection would be too painful.  This would require me to come back another day.  Also, receiving the injection at the hospital would increase my co-pay from $98.00 to $400.00.  So, at this point, I had wasted my time, my friend's time, and would be required to pay 3 times the amount for a procedure to be done when I didn't even have a diagnosis.  I canceled the injection because I wanted a diagnosis before spending that amount of money.  I had already paid a significant co-pay for the MRI (which I expected) and just wanted to make sure the injection was the next best step.

The appointment for my MRI came, and I was asked to fill out paperwork for the appointment, once again indicating that I was there for my tailbone.  The MRI was completed.

I met with the PA for the results of my MRI.  This procedure, that I paid a pretty decent co-pay for, was not even done for the area of my back that I was in the office for.  Even my MRI entrance paperwork listed my reason for the procedure, which was my coccyx.  I was told that the MRI only scanned my low back, but did not go all the way down to my coccyx.  Ultimately, I did start to become irritated because I paid for my initial appointment (and an x-ray that did not go to the area of concern), and then wasted a day for an injection I couldn't get, and THEN found out that the MRI was not even for the area of incident!  The PA tried to tell me that she had explained the MRI would be for my low back, and I told her that nothing that I had indicated since I'd been in their office (other than my low back problems from 10 years ago) implied that my main issue was the low back.  She then said she could re-refer me for a pelvic MRI and I was appalled at the thought of having to pay for an additional MRI when the first one should have been for that area.  At this time, she said she could send me in for a new x-ray (nowhere near as accurate as an MRI) at their cost (nothing remotely near the cost of an MRI) that would check my tailbone.  Mind you, at my first appointment I was told they couldn't do that.  So, I went in for the x-ray to my tailbone which she said ended up showing inflammation to the area.  Again, she suggested the injection as the only means to diagnose the issue with my tailbone.

I feel that the office should have sent me for another MRI at their cost, since all of my appointment paperwork and discussions were for one area of my back, while the PA took it upon herself to attempt to diagnose another area.  Also, after reading about possible injuries to the coccyx, every article has made very clear that you should not proceed to an injection without some sort of diagnosis indicating that this would be the most helpful path to recovery.  

It's unfortunate that Dr. Manos was unavailable for any of my appointments at the Spine Institute because they have definitely not only lost a patient, but given a former patient very good reason to tell people to stay away.  Their office staff is very friendly, but that is ultimately meaningless if they don't listen to their patients.  I have to make my flexible spending account last throughout the year, and most of the balance has been consumed by procedures that weren't even centered around the area of concern.  

I am still in terrible pain.  And, I have spent nearly $400.00 out-of-pocket to be no closer to addressing and/or solving the problem.  I would never recommend this office.

Went there last night for the first time. Always saw lots of cars and heard good things, so we gave it a shot. The atmosphere was great and we found a seat in the bar right away. The server recommended the steak bites as an appetizer and boy, those were great. 

Once we sat down in the main restaurant, I ordered the special which as a salmon dish with bacon wrapped brussel sprouts. When my meal arrived, the salmon was on a wood plank and was very dry. There was no sauce offered to put on top of that, so I used the dipping sauce for the brussels sprouts to put over it. The salmon also was way too strong with smoke flavoring. Three of us at the table ordered the bacon wrapped brussels sprouts, and when we tried them they were not cooked properly and were hard as a rock. That was very disappointing and we ended up sending all three orders back. They were unable to correct the mistake and we had to choose a different side order.  My wife ordered a chicken dish which was very bland and lacking of any seasoning.

Maybe this was just bad luck, but after paying $80, I doubt we'll go back.
Easily some of the best food I've had. The pho broth is magical! I haven't found anything that I didn't like.

Indigo, Mom and I had a lovely lunch here today. We split Nachos and sat inside where it was nice and cool. The waitstaff were prompt and friendly. Our nachos were delicious, as were the chips and salsa. The real delight was the horchata! A very refreshing and sweet treat. I'd make a trip back just for horchata! 

Indigo gives this place 15 stars!

To say it plainly, Blaze has one of the best tasting pizzas and best prices you'll find in Meridian. 

As the village shopping area grows and new business pop up I'm always excited to try new things. Blaze has a completely fun and unique take on pizza building. Is very similar to Chipotle or Subway. You can choose your own toppings and unlike chipotle you aren't charged more for asking for more stuff. 

You can load up three or four cheeses and all the meats. It's completely up to you. Having a fixed price for this was the best part. Even at most pizza parlors they will charge for each additional topping. At 7.25 it's a steal. 

The best part though is that flavor wise it blows away most pizza joints. I'm not usually a thin crust eater, but this one is amazing. I eat every bite. It's similar to Casanova, another thin crust fire oven pizza parlor, but I like blaze more. 

I hope you get a chance to try this new joint.

I WANT to like the idea of Buffalo Wild Wings, but unfortunately the main aspect of this establishment is lacking, the food. 

Inside you'll find plenty of TVs and seating. Do know that on hyped game days seating will be hard to find so come early or stay home. 

The beer is over priced, but has a good variety. The wings aren't the best and the non wing items seem like they are lacking in quality. I have a hard time ordering a non wing item as it is when going here. The temptation is too real. 

Probably best enjoyed with a larger sports viewing group to watch your team.
My favorite restaurant in Meridian! Order the off-menu caprese salad and BBQ chicken pizza with pineapple and jalapeño (I got it as a surprise). Amazing! Shout out to our favorite server, Austin :)

We have been going here a couple times of year since they opened.  The service is ok.  The Sushi - meh - certainly not the best or the freshest - not even a great value.  We have had much better homemade sushi so that is not saying much.  The hibachi is fun, but you wait a long to before they come out to cook.  They have great miso soup, the house salad is nice.    The Udon noodle soup is a great value. But - be warned, you had better eat the entire bowl.  You will be disappointed in asking to take the leftovers home as they will dump most the broth out and send you home with a tiny container of the remaining noodles.   Will I go back?  Probably after the lingering memory of disappointment wears off in about 8 months.
Best rib Rub I have found so far in Idaho. Meaty Ribs very juicy . Service was fast and Friendly staff .

Our family of four experienced very bad service.  Our reservation was at 5:30, the "kind of hostess" or should I say one of the watress' ask us to wait 5 more minutes, well.....15 minutes later we were sat for hibachi. I told the watress that we wanted a kids chicken hibachi, a kids steak hibachi and we ordered sushi for ourselves.  Once the bill came we were charged for an adult steak hibachi, which was $9.00 more than the kids.  The waitress never smiled and came across very rude.  Since they had others waiting for the hibachi tables the watress started picking up our plates right in front of us.  We were charged incorrectly and haven't been to a place where we felt more unwelcome.  I would highly recommend choosing another sushi and hibachi place.  Oh, one more thing, the womens restroom needed the toilet paper restocked.  The only reason I gave them a 2 and not a 1 star is because Tommy the hibachi chef was fun and entertaining for us and our children.
Great service (Lana), good food, good atmosphere and reasonable prices. Lunch special is the way to go.  Wedge salad and pizzetta.  Tasty and good portions.

Omg!  I was so excited to see a Land Ocean coming to Meridian! We moved the the area from Roseville, Ca a little over a year ago and would frequent their location in the Roseville Galleria for brunch.  Stopped by this location yesterday for brunch as was so thrilled to find  the same quality of service, food, and restaurant atmosphere that I could count on back in Ca.  Way to go Land Ocean... we are very excited to welcome you to Idaho!
My dogs give this place two paws up.  It is big, has water, and obstacles for the pups. It's also close to the freeway.

This Mexican restaurant has excellent service and very good food.  The warm chips and salsa are great...the tacos very good...and they end your meal with a small sweet.  Great value.  They have beer and wine as well as pre-made margaritas.  Probably the best we have had in the Boise/Meridian area.

This one is a keeper. It was a 20 min drive to pick up the takeout but I think that it was worth the drive. The young ladies that work there are very sweet and polite. The food was super. I have been looking for a good fish taco for a long time. I really enjoyed the way they prepare their tacos. I like that the fish is not one huge chunk and the taco was sturdy and easy to handle without it falling apart. The Idaho nachos were an interesting item and having only been in Idaho for about 9 months and this was a different take on nachos. Pretty good. My Hunny enjoyed his enchiladas. I think this will be our go-to place for Mexican take-out.

They are horrible with customer service. No return emails or voice mail messages. I would not consider hiring them for any of the services they advertise.   Since they would not talk to me after several attempts. I cannot recommend them to anyone else.

Good burger! 
Well seasoned and tasty they use American cheese and the beef tastes fresh.
Today I was on a mission to taste test burgers and we made it to 7 burger joints. I think the only mistake we made was not having all the burgers outfitted the same. Small differences like house sauce vs mustard and ketchup and whole onions vs  grilled onions or no onions can adversely affect the taste. The thought was to order a cheeseburger from each place with nothing added or taken away. For that reason I am reviewing each burger as a stand alone and not head to head. Next time I think I will put them head to head with the same fixins.

Lacey is a wonderful server. An absolute breath of fresh air. Her attention to detail and awesome personality really made our night.
We came in to celebrate my daughter Karli's 27th birthday.  I ended up trying to steal Lacey over to Starbucks.  She knows how to create and set a wonderful atmosphere. 
Brad the Magic Man was pretty cool as well. Grandkids loved his balloon sculptures.

Where have all the adults gone? This is the second business I've been today with a very young person at the register, under-trained and without a clue. And here it was causing all kinds of trouble for the 10 people waiting for food in the lobby. The two people making food kept calling people up asking what they had ordered and how they wanted it prepared. How are you losing orders in the 10 feet between the register and the grill? Took 20 minutes to get our order. Pitas were good but not worth all the hassle. Order ahead and online if you want to skip all this I guess.

Great local family owned Chinese place. The hot and sour  is super flavorful. Ordered the Szechuan scallops & Shrimp, iron deluxe sizzler, hunan pork & chow fun and each dish is very good.  Lots of flavor, great texture, and friendly atmosphere make this one of my favorite places to eat

You pay no less then 3k for a puppy that they get from puppy mills, I have had friends work this this location and they have all quit because of the bad conditions of this place and how much of a scam it is. They don't know the breeders of the dog and most of them are mixes, not pure Breeds. Also the worst thing I found out about this place is that they put down the momma dogs after they can have anymore babies. How CRUEL!!!

oh jakers...you really aren't awesome.
anytime I asked people about jakers they would say, "oh it's nice...but expensive" so I kind of expected it to be an upscale restaurant when I went with my family, because that's the reputation it has.

the whole reason we decided on this place is because my parents went a few weeks ago and had a crappy experience so they gave them a $15 gift card to make up for it.

right from when we walked in...they have young people running the place. the servers, cooks, hostesses, managers...all of them looked under the age of 22. there were no "adults" present.

walked by the "famed" salad bar...a light film sat over all of the pasta salads...it looked like the deli counter at a bad grocery store. yikes! guess I won't be ordering that. can't believe it was $17!

our server was nice enough. she got us everything we needed. we took our orders and soon after she brought out our salads. the salads were good and so were the scones with honey butter. that is basically where our experience ended.

it took literally 45 minutes for our food to come out. the salads had long come and gone and we sat...and sat...and sat. I kind of felt bad for our server, because she just kept apologizing. the "chefs" were backed up...it was ridiculous. we were about to just leave when the food came out. my dads fries were cold. my food was not piping hot, it was luke warm. my mom just got her trout on the plate with no sauce, no potato...we had to remind them about the sauce which they brought out 8 minutes later in a ramekin after she'd nearly finished her fish. the whole thing was just a disaster.

they all felt super bad for yet another bad experience for my parents, so they gave them a $45 gift card! you've got to be kidding! how do they make any money when they are constantly giving away money? we are NOT complainers. like, it is not our MO. they are just really that bad. I don't expect this place to be around for much longer, honestly. the prices DO NOT justify the decor and the service. 

lastly- there was a french fry sitting on the floor in the middle of the room the entire time we were sitting there. it's dark carpet- you can't miss it. the manager, all the servers, the hostesses....everyone walked by it so many times and no one picked it up. it was so irritating to me. is that the kind of restaurant they run? a nice place with a squished french fry left on the floor? it seems small but it just shows how little they care about the ambiance and experience for the customers.

I will definitely not be coming back- way too many better places around with better prices and better food. and no, I do NOT want a gift card!

They deserve negative stars. Crappy management. Crappy service. Second year we ordered wings and paid ahead of time for 40 wings on super bowl Sunday. Showed up at my allotted time. Told me they are behind over an hour!! Been here now for 1 hour and 30 mins waiting. Again!! I don't get it. Did they not know they were going to sell wings today??? Now I just want a refund and get the ef outta here....nope...can't even get that. They suck at an amazing level.

Fooled me twice...done with this crappy place!

Just drive the extra few miles to go somewhere nice in Boise. This place is dirty and specializes in nothing. One of the few "bar and grills" open in the meridian suburbs currently, but will be a place of the past as meridian continues to grow. AVOID homestead

Lots of different kinds of beer on tap...if you are a beer person you must stop here at least once. The food is good as well, but the beer steals the show in my opinion. The villiage is also just a great place to hang out in general.

I got the medium which comes with 3 scoops with salad or rice. It was more like a small. Barely put salad in it and really skimpy on the toppings compared to other poke places I've eaten at in the valley. I put edamame, green onions and seaweed salad. I did like the sauce combos which was helpful. Clean place and the fish was fresh. If you eat here Sunday around 11:30 there's no parking because the breakfast place a few buildings down hog up all the parking. I would come back here again but maybe ask for extra salad.

This place is like if your southern friend's momma with the mumu and the massive hair invited you over to the family cookout and then slathered your plate in every family recipe she knew. This is what gator-wrestling catfish kanoodling boys eat before their wrestling meets-and I'm here for it. I lived in Texas for two years and in that time, I ate all kinds of BBQ delicacies! This compares to a large portion of them hands down. You can bet I'm coming back. Period.

I made a simple online order for Homestead Nachos. It was supposed to take 20 minutes.
When I came for the pickup, I was supposed to walk through the packed restaurant where nobody was wearing a mask during the pandemic.
I wasn't going to do that, so I called and said I would wait outside. When I told them the reason, I was told the town now has a 'no mask mandate'. I know she meant it no longer has a mask mandate, but looking inside, it almost looked like masks were banned. It took an additional twenty minutes to get the food.
This was my first, and most likely last, experience with this place, mostly because of an unreasonable wait time, and no accommodation for safety concerns during a pandemic.
I love this gas station and car wash, they literally have everything you could ever need at a gas station and more. Plus the store is really nice and clean. My favorite place in town to fill up!

So So so disappointing! Over priced everything for the quality. Starting with cocktail, 10.00$ for a bottle or canned cocktail. The fries are nothing special,  small portion for 9.00$. Both of our dinners came to us cold. One wasn't prepared as ordered. We sent both dinners back for correction. When they were returned to us, one dinner had hot fish, cold goowy rice and cold soggy broccoli. The second dinner came back with over cooked fish that was old fishy tasting. Both dinners were small portions for the price. My husband was hungry when we got home. I did ask to speak to management. A gentleman came to the table. He seemed uninterested. He offered no resolution.  I asked him to pay for our second cocktail since we had to wait so long. When we go to an upscale restaurant  we are able to have one cocktail with dinner and be done. It seems that we are not alone in BAD, SAD experience at Land Ocean!!!

We tried Crave three times, tasting from more than half the menus.  Others here have provided detailed takes on the food items. So I'll just underscore that the quality varies greatly across the menus, and on top of that, for the cost, we'd much  rather order directly from more consistent restaurants in our area.
Love this restaurant.  Great happy hour, wonderful variety with steak, chicken and seafood.  Also THE BEST WEDGE SALAD!!!!!
The Matador is one of my favorite go-to places in Meridian. The staff is always helpful, the food is great, and the tequila is awesome.

Sat at the bar last night and enjoyed an infrequent date night with the wife. We shared a handful of appetizers and were both blown away by how good they were. I had a spicy poblano shrimp dish and it was about as good as any I've ever had back in southern CA. The margaritas were cold, delicious and totally refreshing. I highly recommend the spicy cucumber jalapeño margarita. The bartenders were really friendly and knowledgeable too! Thanks for a fantastic evening!

Everything is fantastic! It is so hot and fresh. It tastes the way you hope every fast food place would, but clearly they take their quality of food much more seriously. I'm happy to support this local business whenever I can.

I ordered a chicken strip basket, but was very disappointed.  I expected whole muscle chicken meat, but the strips were chopped, processed & formed into a "chicken strip" shape.  The fries were pretty good, but not worth the overall cost of the meal.  Not a place I'd visit again.

We are very impressed with the training our dog has received at Positive Pets. The trainers love our dog and she loves seeing them. Our dog stayed at Positive Pets for 8 weeks and we feel like we got a new dog after the training. She is well behaved, listens, and knows many commands.  We are continuing training her with Positive Pets for her to become a service dog.  We highly recommend Positive Pets.
It's Mother's Day, they were slammed! The service was AMAZING. You could tell they were working hard.  Waitress was great! Hostesses were on it! Thanks for a great meal! Thank you!

The food was amazing and the people were so nice at the restaurant.  We ordered the fillet  mignon and pork chops.  They were both really delicious.  If I ever come back Boise, ID, I will defiantly come to this restaurant.
Fantastic food.  Very good service despite the fact that they were swamped and short staffed!! I wish I remembered our waiters name, but he was great!!

Tried for the first time last night, we had a party of 9 and they were able to make a same day reservation! Everyone was so nice and accommodating! The food was delicious we will definitely be back! Thanks for great service!
Such a wonderful place to get a dog! The employees definitely know what they are talking about! Clean and smells great such plus.

This is my absolute favorite place to eat! When I began eating here I was very new to sushi, raw fish scared me. I found and fell in LOVE with their sweet potato roll! It is a fantastic roll to introduce newbies to. The staff is amazing and the sushi chefs are phenomenal. I've tried sushi other places and nothing measures up! Raving FAN!

Checked in and was told the wait would be ten minutes. Once we got the text that our table was ready we promptly went back inside and waited ten more minutes to be seated. We were seated with no rolls. Three parties were seated (with rolls) within ten minutes after us. We still were not provided rolls and when a waiter finally came around they helped the table the was seated last, first. Let me note, there were probably six different waiter/waitresses walking around. We will never return to Texas Roadhouse.

I've been patiently waiting for the perfect opportunity to give this service a go and arriving home from a full day of traveling, to no food in the fridge, seemed like the pretty perfect scenario.

Overall consensus from my party of 5: A solid 2 thumbs up!

I selected all of the menu items and opted to choose them all from one restaurant. I was in the mood for Asian cuisine, so I went with Betelnut.

I ordered the dragon dumplings, chicken lettuce wraps, pork spareribs, chicken satay and the rice noodles. I served it up family style, so everyone had the chance to sample all the dishes.

Everything had great presentation, was still warm, had fresh ingredients and was very flavorful.  Each menu item was roughly $15 (give or take a few) which was a tad spendy,  but I felt pricing was fair.

Using the app was very easy. I liked that PayPal was a payment option, because I didn't have to go find my wallet to complete the order. I also liked that I could select a specific delivery window (30mins) and it arrived right on time! Driver was very friendly.

I have tried other delivery services (like Door Dash) and overall I felt like this was a better experience. 

I think there is something to a business that is sticking strictly to one thing they are good at and not trying to caterer to everyone.  Meaning a dedicated facility that only does takeout with drivers only coming and going from one location. Just allows for better quality and less chance of room for error.

My only critique is that I would like to be able to reference what exactly I ordered after the fact. Unless I'm missing something, my email confirmation and my order summary on the app didn't show me an itemized list. 

More restaurants are getting added to the menu selections,  including sushi (which I'm excited about) so I have no doubt I'll give them a go again.  

Next time your gonna splurge on the luxury of delivery service takeout, give Crave a whirl!

Great waitress,attentive.Nice atmosphere.All the food wasn't very good. Cheese dip tastes like velveeta, fish tacos were NASTY!  Tasted like the cooking oil and mushy that's about it.  The chicken sandwich and steak sandwich were dry.  Wouldn't go again, it's not cheap and isn't very good. I appreciate the manager contacting me, it does show he cares.  Unfortunately, it doesn't change our opinion of the food (four of us).
Thank you Ben & Sandra!! This is our second install on our second house, professionalism to the maximum!! Honest, perfection, punctual. Thank you guys!

WAY TOO LOUD.  Came here for a family and it was so loud we were not able to visit with each other and by the time I left my throat was sore from yelling.  The bar menu could be better with a better selection of whiskeys, and vodkas.

I have frequented Noodles & Company on two occasions.

The Food:  Something for everyone.  I ordered the Penne Rosa and my companion ordered the  Alfredo MontAmore.  Both were tasty with the Penne Rosa having quite the kick of spice.  Yay!
What I like about this establishment, despite being a chain...is that you can customize your food to your liking.  Vegetarians, Vegans and Meat Eaters can totally order what they like and calorie counts are included on the menu.  The second time around, I noticed that one of the dishes you can get humanely raised pork as an extra.  I asked the employee about the pork and she in turn asked a supervisor.  Apparently the pigs were raised happy before slaughter...rooting and roaming around being happy pigs.  That's a PLUS in my opinion.

Oh...I also attended a YELP event that evening where Noodles & Company was one of the vendors handing out free food.  The guy that was at Noodles & Company earlier that day was there and recognized us from attending his restaurant earlier that day.  The portions that they gave out at the event were VERY generous...much more so than the other vendors.

Ambiance:  Typical chain type seating.  Nothing to write home about.

Service:  Very friendly.  When you enter there is a employee greeting you and asking you if you have any questions about their menu before ordering.

Price:  Reasonable

I will frequent here again, especially if there are several of us.  In addition to noodles, they also carry salads and sandwiches.  With an extensive menu, there seems to be something for everyone!
Food is fantastic as are wait staff. The manager regularly checks on customers to make sure they are having a good experience as well which I really appreciate.

Went through the wash on opening day!  Absolutely amazing!!  You need to go check this out!!  Head and shoulders above anybody else in the  Valley!!!  Super friendly customer service and fantastic facilities!!!  Can't wait for the C-store to open!!!  Fasst Eddy's you were missed!!!  WELCOME BACK!!!

Sakana is one of my favorite sushi restaurants in Boise/Meridian area.  The restaurant is clean, friendly staffs (Mr Agam is the best), the food is delicious and good portion.  Age tofu is my favorite appetizers besides squid salad.  The sushi rolls are big and yummy. We tried the hibachi twice and it was OK.  I prefer sushi than hibachi in general anyway.  The bento box for kids is really big.  It is more than enough even for me.  I am a petite around 130lbs.  The bento box has rice, your choice of chicken/beef, then edamame, california rolls, and some tempura!  Now I am hungry just by picturing it.  To top it off, mochi ice cream with different flavors; taro, strawberry, orange....all yummy!

We live on a farm and have several dogs. Earlier this summer, we had our Great Pyrenees spayed and just recently had our Pug spayed. Both times were positive experiences. The staff is wonderful, the cost is affordable and they did a great job taking care of our dogs.  I was hesitant to try SNIP because of some of the reviews but after our friends had a positive experience, we decided to try them. Yes, it can be a longer wait depending on your breed but the savings are well worth it. So far, we have saved over $500 between the two dogs. I don't understand some of the reviews that complain about hidden costs because they have been forthcoming with us and we know exactly what our cost will be from the moment we drop the dogs off. Overall, SNIP deserves 5 stars.

Gross! I ordered delivery, fool that I am, and paid $33 for an appetizer and a dessert from Yard House. The lobster and artichoke dip came in a little container with a scoop of dip. In another container were a handful of tortilla and pita chips. The dip was like eating a mouthful of salt. No real recognition or flavor of any ingredients...just salt. The dessert was the mini sampler...a mini chocolate souffle, a mini creme brulee, and a mini apple crumble, all served with tiny shots of melted ice cream. They were out of the creme brulee, so I got 2 chocolate souffles instead...figured I couldn't go wrong with that. Wrong. They were so dense (souffles are supposed to be light, yes?) and overpowering of chocolate, they were inedible. They tasted exactly like those Domino's Pizza chocolate lava cakes...seriously. Actually, Domino's might be better. Ugh! Extremely disappointing and way overpriced "meal". I might as well have taken $33 out of my pocket and thrown it directly into the trash. Never, never again.

It's not easy finding a Mexican restaurant with good carne asada but this one has the best.  I can't even count how many Mexican places here that I have been so disappointed with since moving from California.  I sure hope this new restaurant survives or I'll end up having to cook my own Mexican food.
My husband and I lived in Italy for 3 years and we know pizza!! That pizza was fantastic and very authentic. And the wait staff was amazing! Thanks for a great experience!

We called with a big group reservation on a Saturday afternoon, and they were able to accommodate us for dinner that evening. The food was good, and it is in a great little area in old town, near a nice plaza with a little water fountain. Enjoy!
update: they still suck don't come here please. please just save yourself. the staff is only nice if you complain to them.

Very disappointed . This was our first visit to the restaurant. We read so many great reviews so were looking forward to our visit. First of all  they were sold out of several items. When the cashier was asked to explain brisket he didn't seem to know what to say. He said it's chopped up beef that's smoked. So we order our food. We ordered brisket tacos, pulled pork sandwich that came with a side, chose Mac and cheese and added coleslaw for.75. We were charged 2.79 for the coleslaw, which they refunded. The mac and cheese was cold. The coleslaw dry.  The tacos were small and only two of them. 9.99 for two small tacos. The best part was the music and the soda. We won't be back. There are better restaurants in which to spend $30.00!

Shout out to Demi@ the E Fairview location! She helped me with a delivery problem  and made me feel valued. Also, Cathy, the delivery person was so sweet and navigated the icy driveway like a champ!!!

Just like the McCall location it's a great place to eat.  Service was quick and the food was yummy.  The key is their red and green salsas you have to ask for.  So good.  We will be regulars at this location and will always eat at their McCall location when we head up there.

Ordered online 2 days ahead of time to be sure I could get the 4 dozen donut varieties I wanted. Showed up for my order and they were out of the donuts I wanted so I had to choose something else. A waste of time and money. Next time I'll hit up the mom & pop shop instead.

After reading the menu I was ready for a extraordinary pizza experience. Unfortunately the menu is the best part. The food has a lot of potential if it can just be realized. The dough is worked too much to the outside so you get a too-thin pizza with a doughy crust. With the addition of the sauce and toppings the pizza is impossible to eat except with a knife and fork and even then the bottom has become soggy making it harder to cut. We had four different pizzas and the situation was the same for all of them. After biting in to a slice the problem is solved. The pizzas weren't hot.
