The question was how long had they sat before they got to us or rather did the crust char so quickly that they thought they were done and served them up. The cooks need guidance.

I saw them open late one evening recently so I stopped in. Maggie the owner welcomed me very sweetly. She's the best thing about the entire restaurant. She really is very very nice and friendly. I guess the restaurant only opened a few months ago and she's working hard at making a go of it. I wish her the best of luck, but I would advise looking at her sources, food preparation and delivery system for the following reasons:

I ordered broccoli beef and pork and seeds with egg drop soup. The egg drop soup had nothing in it but the egg and it was more cold than warm and congealed. Yuck. The pork and seeds were obviously full of MSG they were the bright pink ones not the good when's cut from pork loin. I've got half of a very small container of the Chinese mustard and seeds to go with and everything was ice cold, like they pulled it out of the fridge. The broccoli beef was okay, but the food is obviously pre-made. I asked for spicy, three star hot. What I got was 1/2 star maybe. At least the broccoli still had some crunch left to it so it wasn't overcooked too badly. 

I'm sorry I wish I had better things to say about the restaurant. I won't be returning.
Chicken mole and / or guacamole gave us food poisoning.  We both had the same severe gastrointestinal reaction ~7 to 8 hours after eating dinner.

This is literally the third time we've been here where they were out of their mainstay: glazed doughnuts. When we mentioned this oversight to apathetic clerk and asked why they were always out of their most popular doughnut, I kid you not, she said, "because they are so popular."  
Too bad they don't have one of those big machine thingies that fry massive quantities of glazed doughnuts and send them out on a conveyor belt. That would be so cool.

We had the hangar tacos, bbq pork belly tacos, Dan Dan and brisket dish. Pork belly buns were good a little dry. Tacos were cold and not good, Dan Dan was very tasty and hot, brisket was okay. I find the crave menu difficult to figure out, mediocre food and terribly expensive. This meal was $124! Should have been $45. Great concept but as it usually is fancy containers and tuxedoed delivery drivers don't mean great food.

This is the worse restaurant we have been to in a long time.  We have been there many other times.  1. We ordered calamari,  we got something that looked like frozen fish cut into strips and deep fried.  Waitress told me they make their own.  Basically frozen fish cut, deep fried, then called calamari.  
2. My husband ordered lobster pasta. It looked cold, he tried it and said it is ice cold.  I stuck my finger in it and it was no warmth too it. 
The owner didn't seem to care l, just kept telling us he was the owner and he taught the cooks himself.  We didn't have to pay for this stuff.
We will never be back.

Very delicious food! The Dan Dan noodles are seriously hot! The Thai salad was super fresh tasting. We loved the fried rice. Everything was great. We had it delivered via crave. My only complaint is that our pork belly bowl was missing from our order! I would definitely order from here again despite the mess up.

Our family decided to head to downtown Meridian and enjoy some artisan flatbread...two elderly diners  (86 & 89) slightly overwhelmed with choices but settled on Tomato & Basil Soup & Apple Walnut Salad, a half order (which isn't on their menu to do half but you can!). We enjoyed the Bianco Magnifico pizza (the absolute fave at the table) & the Quattro Fromagio with added chicken.  One in our party also had the Tuscan Pot Pie...the filling should have been a little thicker but had great flavor.  Pretty quiet on a Sunday evening,  GREAT service from waiter Zach & bartender kept his couple visiting/talking etc. .We will be back!

My son has mentioned a few times that I needed to try this place and today, we did! 
We used Uber Eats so this review is for the food only.
We both ordered the "build your own" pizzas and I needed a gluten free crust. The build your own is an 11" crust, which cuts into 6 decent sized pieces. I was very happy to see they have 2 gluten free crust options, one of them is keto. I chose the cauliflower crust option. 
I chose the spicy red sauce with goat cheese and the following toppings:
Banana peppers
Red onion 
Green peppers 
Applewood bacon
Mushrooms 
Grilled chicken 
Man it was delicious!!
My son chose the classic dough crust with the spicy red sauce, ovalini mozzarella & Parmesan cheese as well as these toppings:
Grilled chicken
Italian sausage
Pepperoni 
Artichokes 
Banana peppers
Cherry tomatoes 
Red onion 
You can choose to have a sauce drizzled on top. I chose olive oil and my son chose ranch dressing.
The pizza is "made with 100% pure fire" and is very yummy!! 
I will definitely try them again!

This is by far one of my favorite pizza places in town. One of the only drags is it can get kind of busy so long lines and the place can get kind of loud but other then that the pies are always on point there selections of ingredients are always good and nice and fresh and pies are cooked fast and fresh and for the price it can't be beat. Don't hesitate to stop and and check this place out

Great service 
Rib steaks was good 
Prime Rib very good 
Great specials certain hours and days

This is gonna be my first review ever on yelp.  I normally just suck it up if I had a bad experience or disliked something.  I really tried to love this place.  It's a major hit or miss.  Staff is always really slow and confused.  Today they were out of 4 items that I asked for and the one thing they did have they wanted to charge me more for.  So I didn't get the fish I wanted or the toppings I wanted and the rice was old.  I'm from Hawaii and eat lots of rice.  I can tell when rice has been in a warmer for longer then a day.   I don't think I'll be going there again.  That kinda makes me sad since they could be a great place If they got it together and took better care of their business.

I wanted to put a good word in for Big Boy Movers.   We sold our home and reserved a Saturday with Big Boy Movers.  Our escrow didn't close so we had to reschedule with very short notice.   
Big Boy Movers rescheduled us for the following week on the day that we needed them.  They were so nice and understanding, even though they lost a day of moving.   
Then the same thing happened again the next week and once again Big Boy Movers kept their composure and were very empathetic and tried to fit us on another day with an already full schedule.   
In the end, we weren't able to use Big Boy Movers but I wanted to applaud them on their fantastic customer service.

Cannot be more grateful for their services, true professionals and knowledgeable in the field.  Always representing proudly as a local veteran owned and operated establishment, would recommend their services and insight to anyone in need of floors.

I remember this place being really good and haven't gone in a while so I thought, why not try it again. The rolls and potatoes were fantastic but my steak was not that good. I figured if you are a "steak place" your sides shouldn't be your best item to come out. It wasn't awful but it wasn't the best. 

The employees were friendly even though they were swamped. The experience was good and the food was alright.

The only place I've found in town that understands how delicious a guava and cream cheese donut is! Coffee and donuts are both delish! A little pricier than my other local fave, but in my opinion you're paying for the atmosphere, amazing customer service... and food that lives up to the hype!

I am so thrilled to have a Hallmark shop back in the Treasure Valley. The people that run this are very kind and helpful. Sometimes you just want a Hallmark card with a great selection! They also have a wonderful array of gifts. I will continue to support this store! Do yourself a favor and stop in.

After seeing all these one and two star reviews for the Eagle outlet, I think I'll repeat what I said awhile ago in reviewing the Spectrum outlet. These places are crummy Mex food because they do not cook at these places, they get most of their food from a central kitchen and it is heated and served. The Manager at the Spectrum outlet told me to my face that this was the case. 

Avoid On the Border like the plague.

Tonight was our first time at Flatbread and we LOVED it. My husband got a chili glazed shrimp and chorizo flatbread he didn't speak for 10 minutes because it was delicious. I got a four cheese pizza with fresh garlic, also delicious. Topped it off with no other than cookies and milk! Cookies were hot and fresh! The service was incredible and we went on a busy Friday night. Definitely recommend.

Can I add a star? I live this place! Consistent, tasty food and, if you go during happy hour, the options are huge for half the price! 

We live the onion ring tower, boneless wings, pizza, nachos and Mushu egg rolls. Definitely worth the trip!!

I LOVE love this place! I love the appetizers, the flatbread, and the drinks. The patio is awesome in the summer! But tonight we had the very BEST server, Lexi.  She was so sweet and helpful. I had some special dietary request and she made it happen. It was the best. I got to eat my favorite food and enjoy every bit.  She had a great smile and a kind soul.  Thank you for a great experience.

I don't do fast food very often- but I like that thry do a lettuce wrap on any of their sandwiches (to avoid the gluten in their buns.)  Every time I've been here thru the yrs the people hsve siesta been very friendly, very efficient & very helpful. This time I was having communication challenges due to my health kinks- & they handled it graciously  Also the bathrooms are clean & easily accessible near the entrance of the store.

I ordered tonkatsu ramen to go tonight and ate it promptly about 15 min later. What followed is the worst night of my life. I write this after having spent a majority of my night in the bathroom with the worst cramping ever. And then I threw up so much that my mouth hurts but I immediately feel so much better. I am usually not one to have these kinds of issues but this really was the worst way to spend the last night of vacation. I will never ever go back to this place ever again. I believe it was the ramen as my husband and daughter ate another dish and no issues at all.

My overall opinion of this place is that the food is very mediocre and over priced for what you're getting. I think the only thing on this menu that is tolerable is the Prime Rib Philly but you can expect to pay extra for that. Their rolls (or scones as they call them) are freaking delicious. You can eat your money's worth in those alone. If they're nice enough they might bring you soft butter so you can actually spread it on the rolls. Some people really enjoy places like this and many have had a great experience here. I think my in-laws and grandparents would absolutely love this place. I, however, won't be back and I won't be taking any guests here ever.

Some good things to say: I thought the service was excellent. My waitress was very kind and friendly and it was obvious that she knew how to do her job and did it well. Actually, every staff member I encountered was friendly and helpful. That's always nice. The place was also very clean, had a nice layout, was not overly crowded, lighting was nice and low but not too low, and overall had a very nice ambiance. I nice place to be, really.

The hubby & I just finished some shopping at Ashley Furniture and we needed some food. Although there were a lot of other great restaurants nearby, we chose Wendy's because we have always had great luck at Wendy's. They don't skimp on bacon or the delicious cheese sauce! Yummmm.  Couple that with .50 cent Frosty's to dip our fries in! We happily walked into the doors. Since we left our kids at home, we were in no rush. 
Our order was taken by Daniel. He greeted us as we got to the register and asked how our night was.  Our response was, "great! How about yours?"  He said that he "had better days". My hubby said that he was sorry that he was having a bad night & we hoped it got better. Daniel wasn't rude or snarky. I think he was being brutally honest with his answer.  Gotta respect that.  We placed our order:

#2 Double cheeseburger meal with 3 slices of bacon, large with a coke
#5 Son of a baconator meal with no ketchup or mayo, medium fries and a coke
3 sides of cheese sauce
2 small OG Frosty's 

Daniel struggled a little to find a couple of items on the register & needed to ask for help from another team member, Casey. This is where things just went wrong. 

After we paid for our order & sat in the dining room, Casey was really loud. She kept saying that she swears to God she is about to quit this job. Prior to getting our food, we heard her say this no less than 3 times. 

Before long, our meal was brought to our table. My husband & I combined our fries and took the burgers & cheese sauce off the tray. We started to eat our fries & we had Casey shout out to us and said, "those aren't your burgers! They belong to those guys" and pointed to the only other people in the restaurant. So, we handed the burgers to the other guys. They were 2 younger guys (about 17-19ish). Casey came out to talk to them and told them several times that she swears she is going to quit. She then starts offering them jobs!?! It was nuts.  She kept saying that she was serious about them getting hired. The 2 of them were even given applications. It was rather odd.  While all of this is going on, we still don't have our cheeseburgers. The fries were lukewarm at best & the cheese sauce was room temperature. Since it was taking so long to get our burgers, we were at least hopeful that they would be hot & fresh. Almost 10 minutes after being given our fries, the burgers were ready. I walked up to the counter to get them. When we opened them up to eat them, they were cold. The meat was overcooked, bacon was limp, it was awful. I literally took one bite out of my burger. 

Under normal circumstances, I would mention something to the manager while I was there. But unfortunately, there was nobody at the front register or in any line of sight at all. So, we just left.  It was a rather unfortunate end to a really great night.

Great food; wonderful ambiance and friendly helpful service.  The sea bass was out of this world!  ('Have had it twice.)  Generous tasty appetizers too (have had the calamari and the wellingtons).  We'll continue to visit and try several other inviting menu items.

We went here on a spur of the moment on December 17th, 2021. The place was packed but we were able to get a couple of seats at the bar. The staff were awesome and we had about 4 different bartenders and waiters ask us if we had been taken care of and that we had everything we needed. 

The food was delicious and the drinks were fun. I had the Land Ocean (aka surf and turf) and the steak that I got was the most delicious steak I have EVER had. The meat just melts in your mouth and the flavor was spot on. The cheesy break was good and...well...cheesy. my husband got the rotisserie chicken and that sucker was huge!! 

We will be back... you better believe it!
Friendly service, but mediocre food. From a bar perspective, it's pretty cool. Bloody Mary's are good and they have a good beer selection.

Jaker's is my go to place when I want a great steak dinner with great sides. Drinks, entrees, sides and desserts are all terrific. Their to-go during restrictions had been fast and consistent in quality. One of my favorite places.

Damn check engine light was on. New to the area, I used Yelp to locate this place and I was not disappointed. I got the car serviced quickly and the guys even changed an interior light for me that I couldn't figure out. Such easy to talk to true professional mechanics. Definitely would recommend this place to anyone needing service on thier car.

This is an amazing service. I have 2 dogs and it has been a long time since they were groomed. She took all the time she needed to  make my boys so handsome.  She seemed to genuinely care for each dog.  An absolute sweetheart and a wonderful job.  Thanks so much.
Great place to come grab a drink with family or friends. Soda and cookie shop. All sorts of great combinations of Aidan's flavoring.

I have eaten at Kahootz twice now within the last three months. My first time was with my friend who said she loved eating there so I wanted to try it with her! I'll share  my experience from both visits. 
1st visit - we were seated outdoors next to a heater. It was so nice! I loved the atmosphere, the service was great! I loooved the beer selection. I chose the beer flight and was so excited to try the filet mignon. It has been a while since I've treated myself to such a nice piece of steak. I ordered my steak medium temp because I am not a psycho who eats expensive steak well done. Anyways, about 45 minutes to an hour later (I don't mind waiting longer for good food), our food finally came. Well, my friend's food came first. Mine about 15 minutes after. Not exactly the best timing but also not a deal breaker. When my steak finally came out, it was well done. Like, not even a little bit of pink in there. The thing was cooked solid. I should preface this with - I rarely ever send food back - but I felt like I deserved to get my steak cooked the way I had asked for considering how much I was in paying for it. I apologized to the server and told her it absolutely wasn't her fault but was hoping the kitchen would make me a new steak cooked medium. She was very kind and didn't make me feel guilty about it at all. However, I had to wait another 45 minutes to an hour for the second steak. She ended up taking the steak off my tab completely which she didn't have to do but it did mean I was definitely going to come back and give this place a second shot! 

The second time I came, it was to celebrate with my husband. We decided to order the New York steak and split it (it's a 14oz steak). We ordered it medium and, while the wait was much more reasonable this time, the steak was still mooing. I mean, we could barely cut into the steak because the meat was so raw. I always feel bad for the servers in these situations because they have no control over what the kitchen puts out. Anyways, we didn't ask for a new steak, we simply asked if it was possible for them to throw our current steak back on the grill. We had cut the steak in half and then eaten a couple of bites from the outside, but the majority was still there. The server apologized and was incredibly nice about it. When he came back, however, he came back with only 1/2 of our steak. There was a huge chunk missing. We thought maybe the other part was still on the grill but the server said that that was all the kitchen gave back to him. He, again, apologized and felt embarrassed for what had happened. He also ended up taking the steak off our tab without us even asking which was very kind of him. What happened to the other half? Did it end up in the trash?

In both visits, I made sure to tip the servers for the total amount and extra and I absolutely adored their kindness and hospitality. The atmosphere is amazing, the beer selection is great. But it seems the kitchen staff needs to figure out how to put out a more consistent steak. I'm still not sure if I'll be back after my first two experiences. Maybe if someone else invited me to go but it probably will not be my first choice.

The day before our moving truck was to arrive, my driver had to move it one day later. I panicked because we had Big Boy Movers all scheduled. I called immediately to see if I could reschedule. They had no one available when my truck was to arrive. To make matter worse, my driver had a short window to unload and go to his next job. Well, after calling around I found no one. I called Big Boys back to see if they had anyone to recommend. Not only did they have someone else, they did the scheduling and it worked out perfectly. They went above and beyond and we are very grateful! Thank you Big Boy Movers!

My 18 month old Boston Terrier needed her nails clipped badly but I had not made it to the groomer. Yesterday I was at home and noticed the Clean Pup mobile pull up to my neighbors house.  I went over and asked If there was any way she would be willing to trim Kona's nails. She told me that she was more than happy to do it as soon as she was done with my neighbors dog.  I was beyond ecstatic. 
Once she was done, she came over to pick up Kona.  The main thing I noticed at this point was that Kona was very comfortable with her. This was a very pleasant surprise. She carried Kona to her trailer and returned a short while later.  Kona's nails looked great!!! They were no longer sharp talons that could rip our eyes out.  She explained that she cuts the nails as close to the quick as possible without hurting her or making her bleed and then she grinds them down. Impressed doesn't even describe how well she did them. 
After she dropped Kona back off at out house, I went back to the trailer with her to pay.   When I went inside the trailer, I noticed that her equipment was very clean and organized. She only charged $ 7 for her nails!!! I chatted with the owner, Angela, for a bit & then headed home.  
I highly recommend Angela to groom your pets, she is really patient with the animals and takes pride in what she does. 
Thank you so much, Angela! I can't wait to see you again for my pet grooming needs. You rock!

This is one of the best, if not THE BEST, Mexican food that I've had. Twice. Service was perfect - as well & is clearly well-ran... But seriously - Authentic real Mexican food. I went to the location in McCall (as there's 2) and it was fantastic, as well. Again, if you're looking for great, AUTHENTIC Mexican food - this is the place. Had '3 enchiladas plate' - one was chicken with REAL mole sauce on it...absurdly good! Another at the table had the sampler plate... couldn't get them to stop raving how authentic and good everything was.! The tortillas, the chicken, the beef..all the way down to the 'chips and salsa' - So so good! Most things that aren't made from scratch at a Mexican restaurant are made from scratch here. Awesome restaurants you guys have! I was tentative about it being in a strip mall- then you get inside and it's like "whoa, this is sicckkkk!" Awesome decor, what a great place. I will be back!!

A classic burger joint. Simple menu, worth every penny!
My workplace orders from Main Street Burger often and my wife love it!
Customer service is excellent, with quality of ingredients and flavors to match! You MUST get the onion rings! Would recommend to friends, family, corporate events, and more!

So, I have gone back to TRH several more times & I have decided that it's finally time to update my review. 

The food quality has gotten better.  The last few times we have been our order has been:

Me: 10oz ribeye steak, baked potato with butter & sour cream, & side salad with blue cheese, extra croutons, & shredded cheese on the side. 

Hubby: full rack of pork ribs, French fries, & side salad with blue cheese.  

I am obsessed with the blue cheese dressing! It's seriously delicious & I find myself craving it.   I have even gone online and looked for a copycat recipe! Lol. The ribeye has been pretty tasty, but it's still uber thin. My husband really loves the ribs and at only $18.99, you can't beat the price.  

TRH has now become a regular spot for date night dinners.  The food has been good & consistent and my hubby and I can eat for under $40 pre tip. TRH does get very busy, so I highly recommend using their call ahead seating to avoid a lengthy wait time. The last time we went it was an almost 2 hour wait (but we called agreed).

Super busy but still went through line very quickly.  Create your own or pick a predesigned pizza for one price. White sauce or varied tomato types.  Several cheeses (included whole mozzarella, shaved mozz, goat cheese etc) chicken, bacon, pepperoni & more!  TONS of veggies (grilled onions, sun dried tomatoes, cherry tomatoes, fresh basil, cubed grilled zucchini (so didn't make pizza too soggy), artichoke hearts, sea salt (yum), oregano plus all the regular stuff!). We'd been to similar (in Arizona) build your own pizza & the only suggestion is to offer olive oil (in place of sauce) one with garlic too!  They will "finish" your pizza off with pesto & bbq sauce (pesto delish-not too strong), olive oil or arugula but they didn't ask so kinda need to know this! We enjoyed the blood orange lemonade.  So the BEST thing was the service!  A napkin fell between the tables, it was maybe a minute & young fellow was there picking it up & asking if we needed anything else (including napkins!) He came by several times & checked in!  This was by far the best service we'd seen for awhile anywhere!  We will be back. .several times I'm sure!

Daughter's turkey bacon  was good.i had the Buffalo chicken.... Very disappointing experience, buffalo chicken should be served with blue cheese with blue cheese dressing yet neither were available the way they build the pitas you can have either all the veggies in your bite or all meat in  you your bite. I do have to say they were very polite and accommodating

Brand new dog park for Meridian. Opened 8/12/15. Been there twice and the dogs loved it. Sectioned into two areas, one for bigger dogs and one for smaller and older dogs. Areas have gravel, artificial turf, and real grass for the furries. Plenty of room in either section to throw a ball and for them to run. There are even real fire hydrants for the males to mark on.

Water fountains for human and dogs are provided.

Plenty of dog bag dispensers with widely spaced garbage cans to place the filled bags into. Please watch your dog and police up after them. They have made it easy to do this.

Each area has a covered picnic table area and benches along the walkways. Walkways and parking lots are paved and wheelchairs can use them easily. Restrooms are easily accessible and meet handicapped standards.

This weekend, the weather was cooler and the attendance was huge. Many dogs and kids and adults. No aggressive dogs were noted and play and running was the order of the day. Great way to socialize a dog who has not had much chance to be with other dogs and people. Just watch your dog if it is new to this experience and be prepared to leash and remove it it gets too defensive or offensive. (It is highly advised to not bring un-neutered males into the dog park , but not forbidden. Use extra caution.)

Congratulations to Meridian Parks for this fine addition to their parks. One of the best in the Boise area and beats any of the Boise Dog parks. No bark chips means no splinters in the dogs' paws. And real dog pickup bags means no "holy" recycled grocery bags.

Can't believe this was voted the best mexican restaurant in Idaho.  Not even close and they use peanuts in most of there sauces but guaranteed there would be no cross contamination. Wonder if they want to pay the hospital bill.  Food is the most white Mexican food I have eaten.
The car wash itself is pretty much like every other car wash.  The one thing that stands out is they always seem to have clean towels available.  I cannot say the same thing about the other places.

I use them because they are the best equipped and supplied vendor. Before their service generally sucked for the wait time and the method they use to sequence customers. However since they have moved to this new facility, things have improved immensely when there in person or by phone.

I have compared experiences with other suppliers in other cities and Norco is the best I have dealt with.

Techs know what they are advising on and getting replacement supplies has been good.

I found Phoebe on Facebook and on a whim decided to book an appointment with her. She was super responsive and professional. When I came to the salon everyone greeted me and I got to know the awesome people that work there. This business is under new ownership and you can definitely tell. It was a totally different experience then the reviews from prior owner. Phoebe was so so sweet and now my go to. I'd definitely give it another shot if you had apprehension! I gave her full creative freedom to do whatever she wanted and she did not disappoint!! I also got a pedi by a gentleman that works there. Totally sweet and it was great! Highly recommend.

Unfortunately YardHouse has become a hard no for me from now on. On occasion I'll find myself there for happy hour for the cheap drinks, but I won't ever recommend the food.

In terms of an actual review of I've always found myself wanting more from YardHouse. Originally I felt their poor food was from a to large of a menu. Then they revamped their menu and I was excited to see a more simple menu. Even with their revamped options, the food tastes like it's pre-prepared and microwaved. It's unfortunate because they are open late and serve a good purpose for late night Village outings.

Great place to grab a good old-fashioned burger. Quality and taste was amazing. Burgers are generous in size! Price is super reasonable and the place is clean. Staff is friendly! On my list to stop at again!

Outstanding food and service with a great drink selection. Tons of beer on tap. Either indoor or outdoor dining make this place a great venue! Right next door to an amazing movie theater and a beautiful fountain if you choose outdoor seating. Check it out, it's a great place to take a date before a movie.

First visit after seeing it in downtown Boise. We found they had other locations and stopped in instead of going to downtown Boise. I don't mind the prices although certainly higher than most in this area. If the pizza is good it is worth it. We had a nice server who did a good job overall. We reviewed the menu and took suggestions and ordered. At one point, we looked at the dessert menu and commented on the cast iron cookie. The server told us it was great and to "save room." Good upselling techniques and we were indeed planning for that. Our drinks and pizzas arrived and were all good. We commented on finding a good place to come more often. Then we get to the end and order the cast iron cookie dessert. She takes our order and walks away. She comes back a couple of minutes later and tells us they are out of that dessert. We were not happy with that. Why would she be suggesting something to us that they didn't have?? I really hate when restaurants cannot manage properly to have all menu items. It is simply poor management and leads one to wonder what else is managed poorly. The excuse of supply issues is absurd. The description claims it is "our cookie dough" which means they make the cookie dough. I am pretty sure eggs, sugar, flour, etc. is readily available. And if they really cannot make the dessert, remove it from the menu. The excuses for not having menu items is unacceptable. We did not order anything else reducing their sales by $8. The loss of sales add up in any business. But most importantly, our first visit with the idea of finding a good local place to enjoy often has completely faded. So, poor management has lost business. Eventually it will cause a problem. Further poor management in not even approaching us with any kind of apology (and not the ridiculous excuse from the server). Bunker management at its best - hide out and not be seen or found when there is a problem. Good luck!

Obviously by my previous high reviews, we've been fans of Jaker's for quite a few years, the food and employees.  We've always had a grand time and felt it was our neighborhood spot and the employees made us feel valued. It was worth the drive. Unsure what is happening, as I know Jake and his wife were there last night buzzing around, as always, but things have changed. Our waiter was completely uninterested, and it was pretty obvious he didn't really care if he waited on us or not, which was normally highly unusual.  He did his job, but with no happiness or enthusiasm. He didn't really check back with us, or care our order wasn't taken with any detail as to what cheese, what extras, etc ... just get the order in, and go home. Dinner took a long time to come, which was also unusual. We're not high maintenance customers, and pretty easy going, so it should be somewhat easy to wait our table if you have a smile and kind.  Unsure if someone new is hiring, or if management has changed, but something seems very different, and it's not in a good way.  We are very sorry as this was a terrific regular spot for us to know we were valued, and needed as customers. Sorta sad ... but I understand things change.

This place has bomb food although i heard one of the managers yelling at one of the employees and it kinda turned me off. I know how hard it is to work in a restaurant and I'm betting they don't get paid that much to begin with so ya that's why the 3 stars. Other than that they had awesome food a chill set up and i like the idea of it.
Great car wash!  Got the bugs from 5 states off the front!  Highly recommend this as the place to go.

The Spine Institute of Idaho is the most awful place I've ever encountered! All of there staff is terrible but especially Sheryl as far as dealing with work Comp and she lies about everything and they cant even get the clinical summaries right and then when you let them know they get an attitude with you and then try to attempt to correct the errors only to insult you by putting in bold letters over weight and still can't get the summaries right and the funny part is they didn't even weight me! I gave them a star just because you have too they aren't deserving of one star !
Fantastic service delicious food and drinks! Super cute and fun environment! Definitely will be back!

Best spa in Boise. They offer tea and water when you walk in and the tea is delicious and rejuvenating. I've gottan my hair done by multiple people there and they never disappoint. They are always positive and happy! This place is professional and relaxing. I highly recommend it.

If you're the type who doesn't bat an eye at someone drinking Mimosas for breakfast, then boy have I got the spot for you! 

This place serves what's called a Mega Mimosa, served in a glass that's about as big as your head, with close to half a fruit basket on the rim of the glass. 

A Mega Bloody Mary with enough food on top to count as an appetizer, to include, a cheeseburger slider, chicken wing, cup of chili, a pretzel, and bacon, etc. Seriously, it's an appetizer on top. 

And a Mega Mule. My favorite. Literally served in a copper cup so big you could wear it as a helmet. Bring friends, you'll need them!

Now on to the food, we tried the Potato Skins as an app, and I ordered the Reuben sandwich with fries and fry sauce. Yummm! The reuben did not disappoint. I was already starting to get full but had a hard time putting this sandwich down. 

As far as the restaurant itself, the service was okay, but it gets a little loud in here (as it is a bar). As long as you go in with that expectation or that doesn't bother you, then I definitely recommend stopping in here for a bit of day drinking!
Their website is garbage and has no holiday updates which is inconvenient for people who do last minute shopping. Fix that issue and maybe I'll fix this review.

I have a handful of shops that I could spend hours in just looking at everything they have, dreaming about what my closet, kitchen, or living room would look like if I had an endless supply of money. Anthropologie is one of those places. Everything in here is beautiful. The tiny little tea light candles? Gorgeous. Window displays? Perfect. Coffee mugs? Darling. Coats that cost as much as my rent? Oh my gaaaash, I'm drooling.

Aside from the endless amount of day dreams that this shop supplies me with, I love them for their sale rack. I like to think that one day their swanky coats will fill my closet, but until then, their glorious little sale room is where I live. You wanna talk about hidden gems? You'll find 'em in here! Purses, hats, accessories, you name it, they've got it. Thank you anthro for jumpstarting my Christmas shopping. Because of my most recent to their sale room, I have almost all of the shopping for the ladies in my family done. Huzzah!

So go wander around the store, appreciate all its gorgeous furnishings, buy a swanky coat, or score a sweet deal in the sale room - you might just find me here doing the same. :)

We're regulars, here three to four times a month. Food is reliable, service always good--until yesterday. Our server was inattentive, spent her time chatting behind the bar. One in our party waited 20 minutes for a second beer, and it was only when another staff member went to clear our table and I told her we were still waiting for a beer and our food that our server resurfaced. Our food came out after nearly an hour. It was hot, so I'm assuming she forgot to place our order. Asked for a box when she took our credit card. She came back with the bill for signature, said she'd be right back with a box. She was again chatting behind the bar. We had to ask someone else for a box after nearly 10 minutes. We've had great service from all other servers. Blonde server, Bailey Joe was the name on the ticket. What made it worse, was that we'd brought another couple with us and it was their first visit.

Great cocktails! The food is awesome. Never had a bad meal. We usually go there at least twice a month. The halibut is very good. 
I recommend this place always to friends.

My son has previously visited for a routine cleaning. Yesterday, he was running, tripped & hit his head on a desk, where he knocked in a tooth and another was missing. He was bleeding and crying historically. I came in as a walk in to see if they could examine him and they immediately assisted with him. During the process, they were caring and compassionate under the circumstances. We are super thankful.

Met a friend here for lunch. It's a little hard to find--ok, maybe 'hard to find' isn't exactly right--it's just easy to pass by as their sign is not very visible. Service was prompt and very attentive. I know Flatbread is their thing (I mean, it's in their name, after all), but they have mac & cheese on the menu! So, of course, I couldn't resist. Had half order of their mac 'n cheese (which was ahhh-plenty--I still had some to box up and take home). It's made with four cheeses and is very rich.

Delicious...but as rich as Daddy Warbucks, my friends.

And, then...on the way home with my darling (aka, the takeout box) riding shotgun, I listened to a little Simon & Garfunkel.

And, theeeen...

Well, my friends, this is what happens when you pair Flatbread's amazing pasta selections with an overzealous love of cheesy mac, a little geekiness (on my part...not Flatbread's), and the best American Folk Rock duo of the 60's:

Coo, coo, ca-choo, my love, Mac 'n Cheese
This girl loves you more than you will know 
(wo, wo, wo)
Oh bless me please, my love mac 'n cheese
Takeout box is filled with you--oh yay--
(Hey, hey, hey...hey, hey, hey)

Sitting on a sofa on a Sunday afternoon
Going to locate a pasta plate
Laugh about it, shout about it
When you've got to fuel
Ev'ry time you look at it, you drool

Where have you gone, my Formaggio
My craving turns its hungry eyes to you
(woo, woo, woo)
What that you say, my love mac 'n cheese
Flatbread's kickin' mac is here to stay...
(Hey, hey, hey...yay, yay, yay)

I mean...if a dish meets the "I want to sing about it" level of lovely...then, I think it's safe to say it's pretty awesome. Right?!?!

Right.

Get to it!

First time having a fish poke bowl. It was really good. I got the largest one with tuna, seaweed, mango and the house sauce. It was almost too much meat and not enough of the "sides". Next time I'll probably get a medium and add an extra side.

But still very good, very friendly service, and very helpful.

Well after years of coming here I have to change my review. I have came here for years but recently in the last year the service has gotten worse and worse. You walk in the girls are all very snooty and bothered making me feel like a burden by even walking through the door. This last time really was the last straw I came in for my birthday and we got seated but no one came to greet us at our table for 25 minutes & that's only because I had to stop someone who works there finally letting them know we had been waiting for 20 minutes or so and no one had helped us.  For clarification on how many were seated at the table it was 2. Sad part was this time the place was pretty much empty. I got pictures this time of the faculty just standing & talking which is okay but don't forget about your customers I mean I'm willing to pay extra if that would make my service better.  As you can see our drinks are just sitting there we waited 15 minutes to receive those after sitting up there I almost wanted to go grab them myself to not interrupt their very important conversation after our 25 minute wait to even get greeted at our table. Usually this place is packed and sometimes there is a wait time which is understandable. These last couple of times all the workers there seem bothered, and unhappy making me feel like I'm a burden to come eat at your restaurant. I loved this place so I am sad and disappointed to be leaving this review. Their chips and salsa have never been very good chips always have tasted stale & the dip tastes very watered down def not authentic. I always came here for their salsa verde chicken enchiladas they are truly one of my favorites! Also the best margarita place ive been to! I always get their strawberry margarita its my favorite. For that ive even tried doing door dash to avoid the terrible service but unfortunately the kitchen in the meridian location lacks on following instructions through the app but the downtown location follows instructions and shows they pack the food with care as well. Im beginning to wonder if they are owned by the same person since the menu is the same but the name of the restaurants look alike but are different. One is called  The Matador and the other is Casa del Matador. Anyways if you order online downtown location is recommended! After my last terrible experience I went over to SIDS garage also located at the  village and they made my day so much better. It's crazy what the atmosphere can do in a place. I would recommend walking over to sids garage for a refresh on customer service. I couldn't believe the difference in being greeted with a smile before you even set foot in the door there. The matador downtown also has way better service almost makes the longer drive worth it. Sad this place was definitely me of my top 5.

my wife and i had the burgers here eh could have been better. the moment we said we werent drinking service went down. non attentive to us. sad because the waitress was super nice. 
definitely a place for drinking and not for the food. 
im sure on a friday night super fun. but still the food wasnt the best even for bar food burgers. the fries were good.

Stopped in for lunch with the family and had a great experience! Our sever was Emma and she was fantastic! Made great recommendations and sold us on the wine special.  Enjoyed our silver oak over prime rib this Christmas. Will definitely be returning! Thanks!

Neat vibe here.  Great subs and choices.  Always busy when we are at their Meridian location.  Love that they give the kids a plastic fire helmet but so sad when it cracks and breaks minutes after we leave leaving my kid crying.   Always a reason to go back.  Yum!!!

New Management!!! 

A few years ago, I met Emily at a different nail salon and I loved how she did my nails but we lost touch after she left and I was left sad and ended up bouncing around to different nail salons. 

I ran into Emily a few weeks ago at the Village and she told me that she had just taken over Modern Nails. She suggested I come by and I am so happy that I did. I have my nail person back! Yay! Not only is she incredibly talented with a soft touch, but she is so kind and sweet. I love talking to her! 

The prices are on the pricey side but I am more than happy to pay extra for the perfect shape and someone who does an even better job than the picture I showed them! If you need a color or certain style that they don't have,she will get it for you! 

This is officially my new go to nail salon. I am so happy!

Gawd, what passes for riff on Dan Dan Noodles was a bad dish.  Not in the "I'm Bad" way of the Michael Jackson tune.  In the way of lousy.  Overcooked, greasy, barely room temperature at arrival and oddly flavorless but for taste bud incinerating heat.  (Dan Dan should be very spicy.  And my hubby and I are no fainting flowers for heat.  But, come on...)  Had I ordered this in the Peached Tortilla mothership storefront restaurant in Austin I would have asked the server to please return it to the kitchen. 

A GHOST:  But this Boise area location is not a bricks and mortar Peached Tortilla eatery extended from the Austin based Southern-Meets-Asian-Fusion food truck turned caterer and bricks and mortar eatery there by the same name.  This Meridian located source for Peached Tortilla is a virtual appearance in that the food is prepped - and I imagine with perhaps some of  it shipped in premade, a la Oliver Garden or Applebees model - I'm assuming this is not a scratch effort based on result - in one of the roughly 17 ghost kitchens on the Crave delivery campus and delivered by a Crave driver to the address you provide when you place your order with the Crave app which is the only way to order with this Peached Tortilla.   From my perch it is automated order of home delivered fast-formula-food.  

LOW CRAVE CUSTOMER SERVICE: If you have a lousy dish, well, too bad for you.  There is a number one can call for Crave customer service.  It goes to voicemail.  Through no fault of whom I believe is a single guy covering the calls.  That there is not enough service personpower for phone calls about order problems is a management issue.  

HIGH CRAVE FEES: lf ordering from PT or any of the other ghost kitchen fronted food businesses under the Crave umbrella, be aware of Crave fees and service charges which can add to the 'pain' of having an inedible dish delivered.  As example, on a recent roughly $35'ish food order the service charge (over $9) plus delivery fee ($5) plus tip we added for driver of $10 meant another $24 added over food cost.  Yes, we know better about the fees because we've tried Crave every time someone says "Try this new place through Crave that I read about in The Statesman, I think it might be better than the other options there." Alas.  Not so far.

ORIGINAL R-E-S-P-E-C-T: Which is no knock on the original Peached Tortilla in Austin that was started by an attorney (in the lexicon of different law practices, his specialty was as litigator) who was born in Japan and moved to the Georgia as a child so had influence of both Asian and Southern US foods and who decided to take a different path away from courtroom and to food  with Southern-Asian Fusion Inspired eats so popular it quickly grew from one food truck in Austin to several to storefront eatery.  They are doing something right based on that popularity there.   And now through Crave is the first appearance of virtual ghost kitchen Peached Tortilla food delivery.  I'm thinking certainly the original in Austin, where he has some local control over the kitchen(s) have to be be better than this. 

KUDOS TO CRAVE DRIVERS:  All is not lost, though, when ordering from Crave because the delivery drivers are always friendly.  I never mind tipping them, for sure.

Had the bacon cheeseburger and tots. Very good burger, the bun, bacon and pickles really stood out in a very good way! Tots were good, will try fries next time to diversify. Cool burger spot, good fry sauce, and friendly staff. Will gladly check out again.

Love this place!  It's our favorite Mexican restaurant in the Treasure Valley.  The service is amazing, the employees are friendly and attentive.  The salsa is the best!  I usually order the Chile verde burrito, I request to put the rice on the side and no lettuce.  I jokingly have said they should call it the Shannon special!

Had a very nice birthday lunch with 3 other ladies. Everyone was happy with their food: truffle burgers, quinoa salad and Baja fish tacos. Our server Lacey was very attentive and took very good care of of us birthday girls! Going back for sure!!

Given past experiences with mechanics, I was ecstatic to have found a professional and honest place to service my mother and I's cars, given that they are older cars that constantly need maintenance and repairs. 

 Whenever I brought in my car, I was always blown away with the great customer service I was treated by Dowdy's (specifically Harrison). I'm not very knowledgable when it comes to cars so I always asked lots of questions. Harrison always explained in ways I could understand: the breakdown of costs, the parts involved and how they work together, etc. Because of this, my mother started to bring her car in as well. We were always treated with a great level of patience and friendliness.

But this didn't last long. 

On January 4th, we brought in my mother's car because the engine light turned on due to a misfire on cylinder 1. They had it checked and Harrison said that they verified the light and asked us when was the last time we replaced the spark plugs because they looked worn. The technician recommended replacing them. My mother agreed to proceed and paid $447.73  for all 8 spark plugs to be replaced. As my mother was paying, she had a bad feeling about the service not being completed but chose to ignore it because all of the experiences prior were great.

On January 8th, the engine light turned back on. We wondered why the engine light would turn back on so quickly. Since my mother had a bad hunch about the service not being done, she took it to a friend who is a mechanic to look at it.  Our friend, who took the images I included in this review, confirmed that the spark plugs were not replaced. 

On January 21, we went in to ask questions regarding the matter. The minute we walked in and before saying anything we noticed the drastic change in Harrison's attitude. I made it clear from the beginning that I just wanted to ask a few questions about the service done; I didn't want to argue. When I showed him the images attached and asked him how they weren't any fingerprints or signs of the ignition coils being touched, he explained that the technicians wear gloves. I then said that I still believed it would leave marks with gloves. He became extremely defensive and slightly raised his voice and said that we were accusing them of being liars etc. I clarified that we weren't accusing them but simply wanted to ask questions. He said that their services have no guarantee and the only thing he offered was a free diagnostic since the light was on. They gave us an appointment but we chose not to attend. 

I am incredibly let down in Harrison's change of attitude before we even had a chance to discuss and his using an angry tone with me. We suggest that people who know as little of cars as we do check the work before leaving the facility.

We met some friends for dinner and the entire experience was amazing! Tyler was our server and he was great! I had the shrimp scampi and loved it! The sauce was delicious and the asparagus and potatoes were cooked perfectly! My friend also got the scampi. We told Tyler that we loved our dinner and he suggested ordering the rice as a side next time. A few minutes later he brought out a plate of rice for us to share! Not only was the food amazing but the service was perfect which makes for a great experience. We were seated on the patio and it was a cold night but we were near a heater and they had blankets for anyone who wanted them. We will definitely return!

I've have been here before was just okay.  Tried them again was not impressed with the service or the food.  If you want cold food for a high price this place is for you.  We went on a Sunday at a little after 4 pm was seated right away.  We were given chips and water and said our server we be right there.  Waited about 10 minutes we ordered right away.  It took 45 minutes for the food I got the nachos with carnitas the server said the plate was hot she was right but the food was not.  My wife got the shrimp tacos said hers tacos were good but the rice and black beans were tasteless. I said something about the cold food nothing was taken care of.  No manager came by or anything.  I could go on and on but I will not be coming here again.  I come from a big family and word will passing to many people.  Warning to people don't waste your time or money.

Okay so we ordered on Super Bowl sunday and we thought they were going to be somewhat busy but they weren't. They were able to get our to go phone order pretty quickly so by the time we arrived it was ready. When we got home everything was still nice and warm. 

My husband and I each tried a little of each other's plates to get the full experience and taste everything. My husband ordered the 2 meat plate (sliced brisket + spicy sausage) with the side fried pickles. So we both agreed that the sliced brisket is NOT the way to go, it was a little on the dry side unfortunately. He was also sad he didn't just get the pulled pork like mine instead of sausage. The fried pickles were probably my favorite out of everything! They had a nice bite, crunch and saltiness to them that I love in a fried pickle. 

My plate consisted of the 2 meat as well with chopped brisket and pulled pork with the side of creamed corn. My plate was really good, we both agreed the chopped brisket was more tender and juicy. Pulled pork was good and the creamed corn was yummmy! Hush puppies for both our plates were good, corn bread-y if you're into that sort of thing. I thought I would be but I think they were a little dry so I will try a roll next time. 

We also ordered the full rack of ribs and a side of Mac and cheese. My daughter liked her Mac and cheese, it was good but I felt lacked the cheese sauce. Okay now on to the ribs, we were VERY disappointed in the ribs! Ugh we wanted to so badly like them but you had to tug to get the meat, we are looking for tender, fall off the bone ribs and these just didn't hit that mark. When we decide to go, if we do we will get the other meats vs getting any ribs at all.
The prices on the menu did not match what they charged us. Each food item we ordered cost more than what was advertised on the menu.

Pretty average noodles. I can tell they're not from Italy's best cows. I got the shrimp scampi and let's just say I'm far from impressed. My girly girlfriend got some Mac and cheese and I would say that it was better than what I got. They need to stick with what they're good at and they wouldn't even let us sit inside. Disappointing I won't be eating here again

Although I have had one or two mediocre experiences (OK, one very bad one) overall my lunch experiences are great with dinner not so much.  The more crowded the place is the slower the service but the food is just great.  I had the Turkey Swiss sandwich today and it was awesome.  The service was great today as well.

Over all it is a place worth going to.  If you ever have a bad experience ask for the owner/manager and she will make sure you're taken care of.

Ordered the wor won ton soup and it absolutely had no flavor.  It contained bell peppers green and red which it should not be in there.  There was no shrimp that makes the broth of the soup.  My partner had broccoli and beef and it came with cabbage which again it shouldn't.  The sauce it came with was really think. The only thing that was palatable was the Kung pao chicken.
Good steaks, meh sides, yummy drinks, friendly service, decent prices, always an incredibly LONG wait which has kept us from going very often.
Great customer service, flexibility, and price!! I had my whole house redone in under a week and I love it!!! You won't be sorry!!

This place is phenomenal. The owner, staff and patrons all create a familiar feeling atmosphere that isn't all up in your business, but inviting in every way. The humidor is excellent, a true aficionado's paradise. Don't miss out, this place is nothing short of a gem!

One of the first places we randomly stumbled upon when we first started our move to Idaho. 

This is one place that we have tried multiple items on the menu and they never disappoint. The beer selection is also constantly changing. 

This last visit the patio was open. If you have the opportunity to sit on the patio and a nice summer breeze is around, DO IT! They also have desserts, but we are always so full, we have never made it to that point. 

It is still some pretty typical "pub food" with a fancier twist.

Saw a ton of cars there a few afternoons ago and decided to give this long time Meridian burger place a try. Glad I did. They have great burgers. Freshly made, well cooked, and very tasty. Buns are substantial, corn meal dusted, and hold up under the juice of the meat and the tomatoes. More fresh lettuce than I normally like, but with the onions and juicy tomatoes a real burger. They also have grilled chicken and fried chicken sandwiches with the same great veggies. I see hot dogs too. Maybe next time. For those not mayo fans, ask them to hold it out. 

I had my burger with tater tots. With the fry sauce, back to the hot rod days. But they also have fries and onion rings that also will have a rendezvous with my taste buds in the future. Also killer milkshakes, I hear. BTW, speaking of hot rods, spend some time looking at the car pix on the walls. Test your memory, if you are of that age. Is that a 54 or a 55 Chevie?

Price wise I think they are very fair for the quality. My burger was $4.75 and it was a well made, substantial burger. Want cheap go to McD. Want tasty and fresh go here. 

The place looks dated outside, but inside is clean. All booth seating and somewhat small inside. Outside seating at tables, WX permitting. But when WX permits, I am getting a to go order and down to Settlers or the Storey Dog Park for al fresco dining in comfort. 

This is fresh made food, so don't expect McD speed at the drive up window. I'll be back.

Yard House is a fun place to go for date night, and super conveniently placed for a night out being right next to the movie theater. 

I had the spicy chicken sandwich which was the best chicken sandwich I think I've ever eaten! It was very spicy though so don't order it if you're on the wimpier side haha. My husband ordered a burger that was pretty average, but good enough for the price. 

Our waitress was so kind & very quick especially considering how busy of a night they were having!

Horrible experience each time. The wait times are never correct and it's always so chaotic. We have been waiting for 45 mins and used the app to get on the waitlist. Our table was supposed to be ready in 30 mins. We called after the 45 mins and they said to come right in. We came in and were rudely greeted by Jordan and told to get out. We tried to explain that we just called and were told to come in, and she said "I don't care, you need to leave until you get a text". We explained that we were supposed to receive a text, never did, and called. I asked to speak to whom ever answered the phone and she once again asked us to leave. We have 3 children under the age of 10 and they were so excited.

This review hurts me to write as I love me some greasy, unhealthy, fast Chinese food. I'll start with the only positive of my entire experience ordering from here...the people that own and/or work there are very nice and polite. Aaaaaaaaaaand that's where any of the good ends. 

By phone, we ordered the dinner for two, which comes with 2 entrees (we got General Tsao's Chicken and Honey Chicken, choice of rice (got fried), and 2 little soups (egg flower for us). We also got a separate order of beef chow mein and 2 egg rolls. The total cost was 45 bucks, which I felt was a little high for hole in the wall Chinese, but I at least figured they'd give you a TON of food for that much and/or the food is so amazing, it would be worth it. None of those possibilities came true. I left with a box of food, but immediately noticed it wasn't heavy in any way. I thought maybe I was just still buff, but then thought that's not possible cause I haven't been to the gym since March...thanks pandemic. Got back and we plated the food. The General Tsao's, or orange chicken as its commonly know , was...ok. It was the best of all the food we received, but that truly doesn't say much at all. It was SLATHERED in sauce. It wasn't a terrible sauce, wasn't great, but there was so much that it was overpowering and made the "chicken" a little soggy once you got past the small, overfried crunch. Then there was the honey chicken...I wish I would have taken a picture of it as it looked absolutely disgusting. I decided to try this as I absolutely love honey shrimp, and thought that this might be similar. It was NOT in any way. The deep fried "chicken" pieces were just absolutely slathered in a gooey, fake-tasting, sweet glaze sauce that I thought was ok at first, but after a few bites started making me feel sick. I only tried two bites of the chow mein...bland. The egg rolls were a nice size but boring and tasteless. But the biggest disappointment might have been the fried rice...I LOVE fried rice and feel like it's relatively hard to mess it up. Don't know what they did, but they messed it up. Absolutely tasteless. 

I hate giving bad reviews but in this case, I can't even explain what happened. NOTHING was good, it was too expensive for how bad it was, and it wasn't even a quantity over quality situation as we didn't even receive that much food! Super disappointed!!!

Time to review a HARDWARE STORE! EXCITING! This is my new go-to Lowe's and so far I'm pretty happy with it. It seems a little more organized than the one on Overland in Meridian that I used to go to, and the staff are generally pretty helpful. To expand on that, big shout out to Howard, the older gentleman who works returns. Not sure if he always or exclusively works returns, but he's just a super nice and helpful dude. I told him I needed to exchange some NUTS AND BOLTS and he made the process easy and...fun? I know that sounds weird, but he somehow did as he cracked a few jokes and was generally just a pleasant person. Howard should be the king of Lowe's. Maybe Howard's last name is Lowe and this was some kind of Undercover Boss thing? Nah...he was too nice. 

Anyway, hard to get too descriptive about a big box hardware store, but this location usually has a stocked inventory and a good selection of things I had no idea I needed, and everyone has been pretty helpful. I was going to take some pictures but actually that's a lie because why would I go into a hardware store to take pictures? Who am I, Al Borland? Thanks, Meridian Lowe's on Eagle...the never ending war between you and Home Depot for my business shall continue!

The service of the workers is terrible. Most of the time they don't know what there doing and just standing there. They forgot most of our food. The people who place you don't know what time you will get seated. We also had to wait a hour for our food and they put six people in a little booth. Twice. I wouldn't even think about going here again until they hire smarter people.

I love Rain Salon. They have the most amazing customer service! There team is knowledgeable and passionate about their craft. The owner is hands on and kind. They have great Covid Protocol and I feel safe when I go there.

What a waste of money. We ordered a sampling of the following "restaurants": wing dome, tony g's, Tokyo hot chicken, and Mac and cue. The fries from wing dome were Luke warm and undercooked. I don't know how a person could possibly mess up frying fries but whoever is running wing dome managed it. The Mac and cheese from Mac and cue was dry (where was the sauce?) and the noodles undercooked as well. The fried chicken from Tokyo hot chicken arrived barely warm but was decently flavorful. The only thing somewhat enjoyable was the pizza. But it's enjoyment was undermined by the massive waste of money on the other items. I heard about this service through social media and thought it was a cool idea. But unfortunately they don't seem to have people who know how to cook. We won't be trying this again.

I have competed in several BBQ competitions and I have eaten at almost all the BBQ restaurants in Treasure Valley.  In my opinion, R&R has the best BBQ.  Their BBQ doesn't need any sauce to be delicious.  Some other BBQ restaurants need to drown their meats in BBQ sauce for flavor but not here.  The only improvement I would recommend is to double fry the french fries and less seasoning.  My son's french fries were undercooked and over seasoned.  Overall great BBQ!

Well now, finally..a Mexican restaurant that rivals the food I grew up eating from my grandmas, aunt's, and mom!

I've searched the treasure valley for good beans, rice, carne asada and chili Verde and wow. I had the chili Verde tonight and had learned that they will spice it up when asked so I asked. It was great. The rice was tasting and fluffy and not too much tomato. The beans were very good but could be better if they are fried in lard but everyone's trying to be health conciense, so it is what it is.

The chips they serve are warm and seem very fresh and the habenero salsa is spectacular. The jalapeno salsa as well as the regular salsa are very good as well.

I will be making this my go to Mexican food spot, and it being 10 minutes away makes it all the more convenient.

Next time I'll try the pozole since most restaurants don't even serve that. My wife had abondigas and said it was very good.

Ok, that's it. I would definitely give this place a try.

This has been really hit and miss for me. Sometimes it's great as in the finger steaks and sometimes it's mediocre as in the burgers.
Last time we were there a received a cold well done burger after requesting medium rare. The fries were cold too.
The service is always good but you never can be sure about the food.

You guys have got to do something about these flies. You can't eat in peace. So if you want to have a beer, good. But the second you have food- be ready for constant attack of flies. Makes me wonder how many flies are in the kitchen where food is prepared. But the Food is pretty good. Too bad about the flies. Now I remember why we don't come here often. Ultimately grossed me out.

Excellent happy hour! The environment is cozy and clean, the food is tasty, and the service is excellent. My husband loved the Mac and cheese. The pizza is cooked in a brick oven with a real fire. Easy access from pine street and the freeway. Easy parking. We will definitely be returning.

I will give Dowdy's Automotive my business for the rest of my car owning life in South Meridian, Idaho! I moved here about 2 weeks ago and within the first 5 days of me living here my car started having MAJOR issues. I had the car towed to Dowdys where Dan met me at the counter and spent his time listening to me do my "woman explaining" of what I think is wrong with my car. He was so patient. They did a diagnostic and found out that the major problem with the car (transmission) needed some repair work, I needed new brakes, and a power steering pump. Before doing the brakes and pump they sent me to a recommended transmission repair shop. After getting the car back from the transmission place, I went straight back to Dowdys to get the rest of the repairs done. I was so pleased with their work. Between their service & the service from the transmission shop... my car drives like new! I want to say thank you to Dan for being so patient, friendly, and explaining everything to me. I felt like I was genuinely being taken care of by a auto shop that actually cares. They are my new car shop for everything. I highly recommend them to anyone looking for a good car shop. THANK YOU DOWDYS!

Wow! The donuts are amazing! Expensive but certainly worth eating one of them, which will likely fill you anyway. I tried 3! Flavors are incredible and the unique options will make you want 3, or more, too. I didn't try the dogs but they look fantastic as well.  Very fun

We had Carlie as our server !
She was amazing. Best service we have had 
at Texas Roadhouse and we come here all the time .
Thanks Carlie

Texas Roadhouse has really gone down hill. Used to be our favorite place to eat. Now, meh. No rolls when we first arrived. Took server forever to take our drink order. Still no rolls. Finally brought rolls and took our order.  We both had dinner salads, which used to be amazing. Not so much anymore. Quality was good, but the lettuce used to be nicely chopped into bite-sized pieces and now it's just a ragged mess.  Server finally brought some rolls, seconds before another server brought the salads.  When our meal finally arrived, my husband did not get what he ordered, but the server left before he could tell her it was incorrect. When we finally got her attention, the Server offered no apology, checked her ticket and said something about him ordering a baked potato instead of fries. She said she'd bring him a potato. He is ordered his steak medium rare, but it was well done. The potato finally arrived and was "soupy".  At least my meal was good, since we were there to celebrate my birthday.  I could maybe understand the mediocre service and general apathy had we been there in a busy weekend evening, but this was a Tuesday night, for goodness sake!!   Overall, a very disappointing experience. It will be quite a while before we waste our money on a return visit.

Cleanest, friendliest, best selection of drinks, gas, food, snacks and the best car wash in town. All this with a twist of unique options. Things you won't normally find at any other store, period. A friend said they don't sell Truly Raspberry Lime in sigler anywhere. Fast Eddy's does.  I just found out they have this cool scan as you go and pay on your phone. You don't even need an app. So smooth, so easy. So cool.
Love then s place and thanks to Mark Miller for the referral!!!  Fantastic product and staff!!!

First time here. I've been to Mod in California and understand they're affiliates. Not 100% sure but  I knew what to expect - it's the Qdoba version of pizza and you have choices down the line. They have several salads to choose from but the only fresh looking one was completely arugula and that's not my thing so I passed. The lettuce on the others looked questionable and the croutons on Caesar looked soggy 

They have 3 beers on tap, more by the bottle and a few unique soda flavors, black cherry being one. Mmm

Bathroom Was clean-ish. 

My son loved his pizza (mozzarella, parm , pepperoni and sausage). It was fired well and we loved the crust blackened on the edges. Light on the toppings. They have a one topping pizza that I assume is less expensive - but for the littles, I think it's overpriced when they only want 2 toppings. Next time we'll ask for more of the only 2 toppings he wants. 

I tried to get a little creative. Maybe my bad. I had spicy red sauce (not very spicy) mozzarella, Parmesan ,ricotta, bacon, sausage, spinach, artichoke hearts and let them sprinkle the oregano and sea salt on 

Crust was again cooked well but I have 2 complaints. Big ones. 

1. The "applewood bacon" - I understand is supposed to be smoky but it tasted like the bacon bits from my jr. high salad bar. Way overpowering, in an overly processed way. Yuk

2. The ricotta.  There were giant globs of it all over  the pizza. It ruined it. 

I asked for the manager because I just couldn't eat my pizza and Dave was helpful and responsive. 

They made me a new pizza to take home. This time I just got spicy red sauce, parm and mozzarella, pepperoni sausage and mushrooms. Kept it simple. 

I saw a pizza with ricotta come out as I left and they were wayyy more moderate on the amount. Maybe it was just a new employee that did mine. 

I ate leftover pizza today. It was Good. Not amazing. I was happy with the way the staff reacted when I asked for a new pizza. We'll be back. For the crust and Because it's super fun for kiddos- We will keep it simple though.

Our experience tonight did not justify the price we paid. First off, the fact that your happy hour drink special is for a blended margarita only is just stupid. When I asked about the wine list, our server said they don't really have one but that they offered a cab, a Malbec and a Tempranillo. This is like telling a beer drinker that you have a dark beer, a medium beer and a light beer. The manager here needs to educate the servers on wine. I would expect this lack of knowledge at a restaurant with a much lower entree cost, but our bill was $120 for 3 people. My two companions had the wedge salad off the happy hour menu. Not sure why but the romaine lettuce was bitter on both servings. They also had the happy hour tacos which they said were good. We ordered the queso with the chips expecting a creamy cheese dip but this queso was more like a cheese hummus, the texture very odd. I ordered the carne asada medium, it arrived rare with a canned corn attempt at street corn (there is literally a corn field across the street and they are serving canned corn).Our waitress never came to check on our food nor did she fill waters. Our drink order took 10-15 minutes even though the restaurant was only 1/3 full w/plenty of servers and two bartenders. The whole experience was super underwhelming and waaaaaay over priced.

I have never been to Texas Roadhouse that I didn't get the best service and the best tasting steak ever!  Love their newer policy that you can call to be put on the waitlist so you don't have to wait so long once you get to the restaurant.  That was the only complaint I have ever had is that the wait time was so long and now they have fixed that.  I have ordered "to go" several times and I must say it was efficient and accurate.  The food tasted great even in this situation.

Friendly and fast service. The pizzas cook in less than five minutes. So, if you're in a hurry, this is the place, so as long as there isn't a line to place an order. They do their best though.

They have good options for ordering... pick one if theirs, modify it, if you so choose, or, build your own. The crust isn't  so heavy that you feel like you're eating a loaf of bread. 

I brought  half of my pizza home and reheated it in the oven and the texture was still as good as if it were fresh from their oven.

Good value for the price.

Went for lunch on a weekday, had happy hour salad, philly cheesesteak, and happy hour nachos.  Nachos were fabulous, salad fresh and better than the average salad.  Philly Cheesesteak was less than desirable though.  Will return.

I was SO excited for this place to open and go try it only to be UTTERLY disappointed. So you can barely hear the people working behind the counter cause of how loud it is in the building. We ordered a dirty OG the parrot donut the brown butter latter nitro cold brew the Reuben dog and the left coast burger. The donuts were cake like and not really coated... my fiancé loved the Reuben dog but the left coast left me wishing I ordered something else... the patties need seasoning they had zero flavor the only thing I enjoyed on the burger was the avocado. Our drinks were the only highlight which actually made us come back a second time... we ordered the same drinks and we attempted to try the food again. We got the ultimate frito pie and the elote "Mexican" street corn... the pie was good but the corn had so much cheese that I couldn't taste the special blend. Our drinks were not like the last.. sad to report brown butter latte was just a latte nothing special and the nitro cold brew turned out to be a cold brew instead.. I didn't care to mention it to our server even though it's a .75 difference because the server was busy explaining why they always run out of donuts and owner seemed to be chatting it up and more preoccupied. Sorry donut and dog the brown butter latte was what brought us back but I don't know. Nothing enticing.

As a long time loyal patient, I have seen a lot of stuff go down here in the past but stuck around because the work done here was so much better and yet still 1/2 the price of our last dentist. It overjoys my wife and I to see that the source of problems in the past has been removed in the last year or so and new friendly smiling people are now flawlessly greeting, scheduling, and billing without issue. Congratulations on the personnel upgrades. I think you now have the winning team you and I both deserve.
Food was horrible. Frozen, Lean cuisine microwaveable  pizza is better then the one I ordered.

Hubby and I just love this place! Josh is our regular bartender,  but we also love Taylor and Zack! Food is amazing, especially when Trevor is cooking. When he is cooking, our food is always hot and perfect! Trevor makes amazing soups and stews that I always take home. Check out this family locals place!

My favorite dog park in the area. 

Plenty of space to run and fetch, walk laps, or socialize. Some great agility equipment in the center, small pools in the warmer months, plenty of trash cans, and well-stocked  bag stations. The park is fully fenced in and has double gated entrances. There's a smaller, separately fenced area for small dogs as well.

I am not writing this as a review, although it may sound like one, but it's meant to be more like this is what to expect.

The project started out as a kitchen remodel, then two new double French doors one with a new opening the other fit in place where a slider was and a new opening for an interior door were added to the project. Most the companies I received estimates from estimated about a three week timeline for the kitchen project and about three to four days for each of the door additions projects, let's just call an extra week for each or two additional weeks.

Once the kitchen was prepped for cabinets the work came to a halt as did the additional projects added. Cabinets took three days to install, then removed and another week to paint, no other work was done the other two days of that week. Now I know Shawn, which by the way is a nice guy, is going to dispute this and add that the tile and granite had last minute changes which I did so, let's be generous and add another week to the project, I believe that makes it a total of six weeks now. 

There would be days a tradesman would not show, at one point I questioned if they were sending a tradesman to finish the work and I was told the painter was there. Well yes he was but he's painting outside, why is there not any work going on inside?  He didn't want the two butting heads, how does that happen when one is inside and the other outside? You can expect one tradesman at a time through most your project. But Shawn is a nice guy.

Expect your home to be treated as a construction site, this includes your garage and yard as well.  You'll have piles of debris forming in your home only to be moved to, in my case, the side yard and garage.
