Along with the debris the garage was also used for the storage of new materials which was never discussed. You'll have water shut offs without prior communication. If you have pets or kids be careful, the last few weeks of the project we were constantly picking up razor blades from the floor. Smoke detectors were removed and not replaced, I eventually replaced it. And let's not forget the dust abatement, this is only done during demo, the rest of the time nothing and your house becomes a dust bowl. But Shawn is a nice guy.

The project from start around May 1 to finish September 2019 took about four months. To put this into perspective an entire home renovation takes three to four months. 

Now a year later all the shoddy work it starting to show. Yesterday noticed a gas smell under the stove, SDG&E came out and found the gas valve leaking. She says it happens to older valves, but wait, I paid to have the gas line moved a year ago it's all new. She tells me the brand of the valve is so old you cannot buy them anymore. She shut off the gas to the entire home on a Sunday afternoon. Really!

Now it's going to cost me $375.00 to repair something I supposedly already paid for.

I was really excited when I learned there was finally a Ramen restaurant opening in Boise! And not just a Ramen restaurant, but a really good one. The broth is dialed in perfectly, and every Ramen bowl I've tried the dozen or so times I've been there so far has been really delicious. The eggrolls are also great, and so are the Matcha tea lattes! Staff is always friendly and attentive. 5 stars all the way!

Best grooming shop in town! The staff is super friendly and patient with my Saint Bernard who hates getting groomed. Classic K-9 clips is the only place I will take her! We have never had issues and we have been going there for years.

I love this place - the food is great. The crab Rangoon are the best I have had and always fried to perfection. I love the tonkatsu ramen and it is the only thing I have ordered, but my husband had the shrimp yakisoba on our last visit and cleaned the plate. The staff are all really lovely, it's always clean, and they serve Coke products which is a win for me. Now that it's getting cold, do yourself a favor and get a bowl of ramen - it is good for the soul.

Absolutely awful. We call literally 3 minutes before we parked to confirm they had prime rib. Was told they had plenty. We sat at the open bar and ordered right away only to find out they couldn't blend a margarita and we're out of prime rib. Done going here. Over rated. Indian Creek is way better.

I fell that I am being somewhat generous with this review, however, I do feel bad for the 3 stars. This was my first time at a Texas Roadhouse and possible my last. Mainly because of how loud and busy the place was (which kuddos to the business for that!) 

We went to this establishment on a Tuesday for a friend birthday. Reservations were phoned in advance for a table of 7. (So to begin my review and to be fair, it was a larger party)

Just about everyone ordered some sort of steak with two sides, I ordered a steak salad (medium) and my husband ordered a pulled pork sandwich. 

When the food arrived, everything was looking good, minus my meal. The salad itself was fine, but the meat was totally well done on one side and the other was purple and RAW! I did express this to the waitress and she did comp me on the meal which was incredibly kind of her. 

The rest of the party who ordered potatoes did not receive them in a timely manner. They had already finished their meals by the time the potatoes arrived. That was also frustrating. 

Our waitress really did a wonderful job considering how busy that place was. If you've been to a Texas Roadhouse before, then you probably know what to expect. This particular establishment just isn't quite for me personally.

this place sucks 
don't come here
i have had brackets fall of and they have been extremely extremely rude to me and don't care. they also have given me expired bands and are only open on Wednesday's

Came in around 4:30 on a Friday, wasn't busy at all, plenty of open tables inside. Wasn't warm enough to sit outside, but they do have very nice seating outdoors, which we'll make sure to eat at next time. This was my second time eating at this location. Last time I missed out on Happy Hour (4PM-6PM), so I wanted to come here during HH, just to see how the specials are and if they're worth the money. I've included pictures of all food we ordered, just so you guys can see a picture of what some of the food & drink options look like. Just some quick pros right off the bat: great atmosphere & decorations, great lighting (if you get a window seat), small candle at tables (nice lil touch), CLEAN BATHROOMS ;)

During Happy Hour, the Frozen Lime Margarita is $5, and the Frozen Mango Margarita is $6.Honestly, the drinks were tasty, but for a Happy Hour, I think they drinks should cost $4. If I had to choose between the two, I'd recommend the Mango one, for $1 it's worth it over the Lime one (better taste). We also ordered a glass of Ruta 22 Malbec wine, which was $7.50 a glass. PRICEY (I can get a Ste. Chappelle big boy bottle at Winco for $11 and have a GREAT NIGHT ;)), but this is what I'd recommend over the margaritas if you're planning on having a serious entree here, especially if you're ordering something spicy, just because the wine is dry and matches up perfectly with a spicy dish.

Now, on to the food. We ordered the Happy Hour Steak Tacos, Happy Hour Mushroom Quesadilla, and Happy Hour Tortilla Chicken Soup. I really enjoyed the Steak Tacos, the burnt flavor on the outside of the steak pieces was very tasty, but for $6, it felt pricey (again, this will be the main theme here). The Mushroom Quesadilla comes in at $5, and was really good as well, I'd say it's a fair price, if anything, maybe should be a dollar less, but not a big deal. The Tortilla Chicken Soup was just alright, I'd say skip that, unless you're craving a bowl of soup. I believe the soup had avocado in it, which actually was a good surprise. Out of the 3 Happy Hour options we got, I'd recommend the Steak Tacos, just because of how tasty the steak was.

For entrees, we ordered Verde Chicken Burrito, Carne Asada, and Carnitas. All 3 tasted GREAT. I'm not sure if it's because we were all hungry, or if the alcohol was kicking in, but I literally can't think of any complaints in regards to how the food tasted and was presented. Even though our entrees took a while to get (same goes for the appetizers in the beginning AND the drinks), the food was HOT and tasted great. I saw others complained about getting cold food, that wasn't the case with us, I was really satisfied. 

The Carne Asada had that same burnt steak taste as those steak tacos earlier, which ya'll already know how much I liked that flavor. You get Garlic Mashed Potatos with the Carne Adada, but I really didn't taste much garlic in there. But still, the whole package of meat, potato, and corn was G.A.F. The amount of meat you get with the Carnitas is really a good value, and if I remember correctly, it had a little sweet taste to it. The Verde Chicken Burrito was VERY good as well. I'm just looking at the pictures I took and it's making me hungry again. If you had to make me choose 1 entree out of the 3, I'd say go for Carne Asada.

There are 2 reasons why I'm NOT giving this 5 stars, and that's because of the slow service & the overall pricing. Our waitress was very nice to us, the issue I had was just waiting around for our drinks, appetizers, and food. They weren't even that busy, so I'm not sure why it took so long. And the pricing, well I just feel like the prices are higher than they should be. The food was GREAT, but if the price was perhaps ~20% cheaper (ex Carne Asada for $17-$18, Carnitas around $15), I'd be all over this place. 

Overall, I'd say this is a SOLID 4, will be back. If prices were a tad lower, I honestly would say I'd go out of my way to come here at least once a week. I really had a good time here.

It's open late, and that's really the only thing good to say.  Service is hit or miss, food isn't always consistent but it is open late. 

Its a chain, like many of the late night options we have in Meridian with you standard bar & grill fair.  

After two visits- nothing has wowed me.

We stopped at this Firehouse Subs at 1:08 as we were traveling. I bought 2 turkey bacon subs. We were eating them & I was picking some turkey off to give to our dog. At one point I took the bread off to get more turkey for our dog only to find a dead fly in my sandwich. Thank God we had my dog with us otherwise I would have eaten that dead fly. What really irritated me was when I went in to give them the other half of the sandwich along with the part with the dead fly on it they actually said "oh we are sorry. We are having a problem with flies." Never ever again. We only eat fast food when we travel with our dog but you can believe we will never go to another Firehouse Subs. I own a business & I would hope my employers would never be that inconsiderate or dumb. I can not believe they did not see the fly because it was not buried in meat or lettuce but rather right on the edge.

Absolute awful service. Less than 20 customers in the building. Waitress, after avoiding us for 15 minutes brought us waters. On her 2nd trip around we say we're ready to order, she states she cannot take our orders but we watch both tables next to us order and also watch the bartender pour 8 drinks. Her computer was down but couldn't write our order. We're here often and their food takes over 45 minutes. So if your system is still down after the 1.5 hours we're here, I think the small order of wings is okay to Comp. awful, take your business elsewhere.
Went in to have lunch and sat in the bar. Friendly and fast service. Food was excellent. Very nice afternoon. We will return.

Location: it's in a good location, but parking can be hard to find.  There is no parking that is close to this restaurant as it's in the middle of the village by the theater.

Ambiance:. Lights are dim, plenty of sports on TV, and plenty of indoor and outdoor seating.  If you choose to dine outside when it's colder, no problem, there are heaters.

Service: It was a Tuesday night, and we got right in as a party for 2. We had plenty of time to decide on our drinks and Apps.  I'm not sure how they are on water refills, as we didn't get water until after our first round of drinks.

Food: the pretzel was good with the horseradish mustard. The ribeye looked better than it was. It was a little over cooked and tough.  The meat could've been seasoned more too, there was little flavor for a ribeye.  Of course, you don't think of the Yard House as a place for really great steaks, so I shouldn't have been surprised. My wife had the filet and she said it was good.  Hers looked more like medium well vs medium.

Bathrooms: they were clean and orderly. 

Drinks: there a lot of beer choices so take your time and look through them. The beers were ice cold and flavorful.

To sum it up I won't go out of my way to come back, but if there's a group of that want to go I won't request something different.

Love, love their donuts. We have also tried their dogs. Great. Had the Nashville chicken San which is good but spicy. My only complaint is we live far away so by the time we get it home, it's cold. So it's best to eat in. Of course then you have to find a place to park. I use a cane so that's not good for me

My wife and I have eaten at Kahootz several times and have never been disappointed. Their steaks are exceptional as are all of the other dishes that I've tried. If you decide to eat here make sure that you get the bread pudding! I am not a fan of bread pudding but I was astounded at how good theirs is. Make sure that you get there with plenty of time to spend socializing with friends and having a beer possibly. The facility is rather small but well worth the wait and they go out of their way to get you seated quickly.

Blaze Fast-Fire'd Pizza (Meridian, Idaho)

There are so many options at Blaze that deciding on what to order can be overwhelming.  Opting for one for their signature pizzas is a safe move. I basically order the same pizza every time...Keto crust, white sauce, mozzarella cheese, 4-5 servings of chicken, some bacon, and crushed garlic.  I'll have them cut my pizza into 8 slices instead of the typical 6 just so I can trick myself that I'm eating more.  I also have my pizza this way because it's easier to eat.  I order this pizza so often that the Manager here knows that I'm in town when he sees this pizza in the oven.  I travel to Idaho at least once a month just so I can dine at this Blaze Pizza. Just joking. I travel to Idaho for work and my job pays for my daily meals up to $75.  I can basically dine anywhere for dinner, but I choose to come here. Why?  Well, it's because this is one of the best Blaze Fast-Fire'd Pizza establishments that I have ever been to.  Even with the long lines, the ordering process and getting my pizza with the quickness has never been an issue.  My pies have always cooked to perfection, never under or overcooked.  I live close to two Blaze Pizza's in Vegas.  They're good, but not as good as this location.  Keep it up, Blaze Pizza of Meridian!!

I would highly suggest NOT signing a contract with this business. First, I brought my little dog in for training for some resource guarding behavior. He is a puppy, and she recommended the use of e-collars. I said absolutely NOT. And did some further research. ANY training center that does not use positive reinforcement only, especially on an 11 month old Havanese, is not what I want for my pet. She pushed and pushed quite hard. Never looked at my dog during the consultation. Shoved an iPad in my face with hard sales tactics. I signed and spoke with my Havanese club who gave me advice based on new opinions on behavioral modifications on dogs. I spoke with another trainer and decided she was a better choice. Positive Pets refused to refund my money! Had to go through the run around for a week, wouldn't refund on my card, insisted I come in to pick up a CHECK. All to try and sell me again. I don't recommend.

I'd give 0 stars if I could. Absolutely horrible place.
I don't know what was worse, the way the employees/ owner acted , or the color/ cut they did for my wife. Didn't even offer to fix it . Just pretty much belittled her and told her she was dumb.
Long wait and the floor was filthy. Lots of staff standing around. Food all over the floor

The noodles I ordered were overcooked and had no flavor. The house salad was the only good part of the night and it was tiny and finished in a few bites. The sushi was sad. The sushi was the worst I have ever had. The California had huge chunks of avocado, the yellow tail was warm and fishy and overall I would not come back. .
Since I had a credit from the Mi Almita order, I ordered from the Peached Tortilla, blackened fish and it was delicious! My boys had sliders and fries and this order really made up for the last one.

We had driven past Land Ocean a few times and finally went in to try it. We were not disappointed! Overall we had a wonderful experience with an equally wonderful meal. Despite the other reviews stating food was slow, we actually found it quite timely. We never felt rushed between our courses. Patrick, the floor manager, came over and helped us decide on a wine to pair with our meal. He was both very knowledgeable about the menu as well as the various wines. He even introduced us to a new wine! Land Ocean will be added to our list of date night locations and we will definitely be returning!

Overall a great experience. We went here for dinner after the Village Christmas Tree lighting with a group of 11. We were pleasantly surprised the wait wasn't very long.  The service was great, and the food came out in a timely manner. All our food was really tasty. I had the Chicken avocado sandwich, my husband had the Korean cheesesteak sandwich and my son had the Nashville hot chicken sandwich and we all loved our food. The yard house is a little loud but a fun restaurant. They have a great selection of beers. I would go back again.

Well well well!!  National margarita day:) 

It is always a pleasure to have a meal at the Matador.  I am lucky enough to come here a lot. 

The menu may appear to be "basic Mexican". But if you look closer you'll find a few hidden gems.  (Menu online). The food is not hard core Mexican and neither is the vibe. Maybe a little Tex mex, so that is refreshing. 

I enjoy the food here.  The enchiladas are often a "go to" for me but I think I've tried it all. 

Just like most all restaurants this location can have a bit of a dinner rush especially on weekends.  Do you really want to eat where no one else wants to eat?? ha ha. I don't!   The staff usually handles the rush fine.  Not always but if a server gets shook it's probably the "new guy". They'll get it together. Give'm a break:)

I was here for the rush last night on national margarita day and the place was bumpin! Did they get everything right?  Maybe not? Will I take a star off of this review?  Definitely not!!

Luckily I get to go to the matador meridian again tonight with one of my other daughters.
Went to this store 30 minutes to closing and the man closing on 28 July was very nice. Only took about 5 minutes for them to make our food. Good service & good food

Be sure you read the fine print on your menu! Went to this location on 7/6/17 for happy hour as I had only ever been to chili's a handful of times and never during happy hour. Ordered margaritas and food/appetizer type items off the happy hour menu, which range from $3-5. We get the bill and everything but our drinks is either double the price or more than it's supposed to be. I asked the server why our food was the wrong price and she proceeded to tell me in order to get happy hour pricing on food you have to sit in the bar regardless if you're there during happy hour. However your drinks are happy hour specials regardless where you sit. Needless to say this was the stupidest thing I've ever heard in my life and I don't know any other restaurant with this policy as it's completely absurd. When I go somewhere for happy hour I check the menu for the timeframe (ex. 2-6PM) and dates and I'm not searching for some microscopic text that says "bar only". The server and her manager chose to not rectify the issue and still charged me double for my food. I will not be eating here again at a restaurant that scams it's unknowing customers. Our server didn't even have the decency to mention said policy when I pointed to the happy hour menu and specifically said "I would like to order the $5 happy hour special boneless wings." They have the worst customer service I've ever dealt with and the food was sub par. Take your money literally anywhere else.

Brilliant! We decided to try the Omasake Sushi part of Crave Delivery and it was great! I actually picked it up at their location as it was on my way back home and everything was on time as order and so fresh! Great fish quality and great rolls all together! For sure will order again!

We came for happy hour and the food was better than expected. The grande nachos with steak blew us away. The 5 tacos for $8 cannot be beat. $5 lime margaritas were tasty and refreshing. Our service was efficient and friendly from Elina. My only complaint/suggestion would be to double wrap the tacos since the tasty juice from the taco meat did soften the corn tortilla too much. Definitely recommend their happy hour, but expect a wait because this place is popular! Best way to spend my 23rd birthday

For balance to all the great reviews: my experience was a mixed bag.  The food was very good.  The service was not.  Arrived early on a Saturday night during a quick visit to Boise.  The menu and reviews looked great.  Too hot to sit outside in their very nice seating area.  We ordered food including baked potatoes and about five minutes later the server came and told us baked potatoes are unavailable until 5.  This is not noted anywhere and the server did not tell us though apparently that is always the case.  She seemed very distracted .  We decided to order desserts in advance only to be told that one of the four options had run out and one had only one serving left (at 4:30 pm) We ordered steaks with Gorgonzola one medium one medium rare.  After about 20 minutes the steaks came out with no toppings.  Our server then told us the kitchen was out of Gorgonzola.  We asked for mushrooms instead and started to eat our steaks while waiting. A few bites in we realized our orders had been switched and we  got each other's steaks.  More than halfway through the steak, I went to the kitchen to ask for the mushrooms which finally came out a few minutes later.  The server never came to check on us during the entire meal and when we were finished we sat and waited for our desserts for about 15 minutes. My friends dessert which was an ice cream pie to go came out first and we then waited about 10 minutes for my dessert while hers melted; mine was also cold and no explanation.  The food was really excellent; delicious steaks, yummy house made blue cheese dressing on the salad, all very good but the meal was overshadowed by the many service blunders and the odd running out of items so early on a Saturday night with empty tables.  I may try again on my next visit and hope the service issues will be addressed.

I had not had a pedicure in SIX MONTHS.  I am not ashamed to admit this since it's Covid-19 shutdown in California.  But I came to see my brother and his wife and kids in Boise over Labor Day weekend.  And I needed a pedicure.   BADLY.  

I was fortunate to get an appointment at Rain Salon & Spa, which also has a salon, doing haircuts and other spa services. My sister in law Tracy drove me here since her friend who is quite picky recommenced them.  

We entered and was treated to a socially distanced steam towel and hand sanitizer (which was great because no matter what I needed, I don't need Covid) and was graciously offered a beverage. 

We were seated and met the wonderful Natalie, my nail technician who was FABULOUS.  The pedicure was amazing and she didn't even make me feel like it's been 6 months.  

The service was efficient and very professionally done.  I love the work and the atmosphere.  

The smell of Rosemary-Mint was wonderful and reminded me of Quail Lodge in Carmel, Ca Monterey Peninsula (home of Pebble Beach Golf Course).   Relaxing and a true spa experience for such a convenience and without the $$$$ prices.  

I was so pleased with the service and their kindness, I had to write a review and encourage everyone (since I'm sure they're guy friendly too) to give them a try.   They are an excellent group of folks and I can't wait to come back. 

If I could give more than 5 stars I would.  Thank you Natalie; you're amazing.

We went here for breakfast because Joe Momma's was way too crowded. I was pleasantly surprised! The portion sizes were generous and the food was very good. Service was a little spotty and the atmosphere could use a little spiffing up although it was clean.  I had an omelet with pancakes and wasn't disappointed.
Ordered the Italian sub. It was sweet. No, I mean it was literally sugary sweet with the dressing they put on it.  Sickening sweet.  Ate half. Threw the rest in the garbage.

I have been taking my kids here for 5 years and Dr Whitt has been awesome. I do have a few complaints from a few years ago when they would call to reschedule the dentist appts. because the dentist was going out of town. But, they wouldn't have any openings immediately so it would be a month or two later that they would be seen. This happened twice, which didn't make me very happy. BUT, the kids love the office, the play area in the waiting room and mostly the coin for the prize machine that they get regardless of cavities or not. Both  my 8 and 6 year old get excited to go to the dentist which makes it worth any hassle. The last 2 years (he has since gotten another dentist in the office) we have not had any problems with scheduling.  My friend did call in to try and get her daughter in and it takes awhile for an appt. and we have never had an emergency so I don't know how quick they are to see patients. For just our normal check ups and a few cavities, Dr Whitt has been great

So I have attempted to use this company twice now and actually given them three shots. First time maybe a year ago they were late to their appointment time and I had to cancel. It happens so I thought I would try to give them another shot since they have such a good priced special. This time around I had an appointment on a Friday I believe and I got a call around the time of my appointment that day saying their driver was having trouble with his GPS and they were way behind so they asked to reschedule. Okay fine strike two. So they reschedule me again for the following Wednesday between 3 and 4 pm. That day I got a call from their driver saying it would still be between 3 and 4 but closer to 4pm. Well surprise surprise 4pm rolls around and no call and no driver. I waited till 4:27 pm till I finally got fed up and sent them a message to cancel my appointment and that their driver had not called to explain what was going on or if he would even be there. I left my house at that time to go grocery shopping and when I arrived back home about an hour later there was a card in my front door saying they had missed me at 4:15 so on top of missing all three of the scheduled appointments their employee is obviously a liar as well since I was sitting in my living room with the front door open just my security screen closed till just before 4:30pm. Needless to say they will not be getting any business from me. They got three shots.

Well seasoned, well cooked, clean restaurant, and solid lunch spot.  The finger steak basket was fresh and hot, salt and peppered fries, with really solid fry sauce and homemade barbeque sauce.  The staff was friendly and attentive.  There are a handful of mom and pop burger locations in the area and I'll be back to Main Street Burger!

Expensive, thorough, somewhat fast.  You can sit inside your car for the whole time.  Car goes off so if it's hot or extremely cold, you may want out.  The service was great.  They checked everything.  They also try to upsell so know what you need or you may pay more for something you are not quite sure about.  I always get synthetic oil and here they charge a flat $71 for this.  I checked into Yelp for a discount but even so, this was a pricey oil change.  I'm used to better pricing for the same convenience.  Definitely will shop around before returning.
Growler Guys is a great place to have your favorite beer or cider. Over 48 different flavors to sample.  The prices are fair and the service is good. I would recommend if you like beer.
Great food, good quantities, friendly staff, nice to choose all the additions to the bowl from the rice, up. We like the Miso soup also.  We love us some Poke!

Super cute little candy store that is locally owned and operated.. The guys are always so friendly and welcoming!  They have something for everyone! Hundreds of sodas and 1 million different candy choices!     I recommend this place for everybody!  This is the type of Business I love to support!  And I hope you do to.  Great place!

I've got to hand it to the Dutch Bros guys at the Linder location. As a precious self-proclaimed "non-fan" of Dutch Bros, today's experience turned my view around. 

There was a line of about 4-5 cars in each side, but I pulled in, anxious to try their white coffee. The super-friendly guy who walked out to take my order, after telling me about the white coffee, actually recommended I did NOT order it as it's pretty strong and tastes different than black espresso. But I insisted! When I pulled up to the window (despite the line, which didn't take long), I tried it and loved it! Yum! 

And then, in addition to the friendly service, they comped my drink. Why? Just because. Now that's service! They may not have my coveted drip coffee, but I'm sure I'll be returning in the future order more white coffee. 

Thanks for the excellent service, Dutch Bros. You guys pulled a game-changer on me just might make a fan out of me yet!

uummm I should probably have called the health department, we have been to this Meridian restaurant twice and BOTH times my son got deathly ill with a gastrointestinal illness. My guess is undercooked meat, or someone there is not washing hands. GROSS. We will never go back.
If you want a burger with no patty and some cold ass fries then look no further!   How do you forget the most important part of a hamburger?

We wanted to like this place. When we got there the place was full so we were optimistic. We planned to eat and catch a movie. 
Our appetizer took 40 minutes and was delivered with no plates for our tablemates to share. It was a hummus platter. Although most of the plate was tasty it was sparse and the pita bread was covered in a sandy flavorless substance making it unpleasant to eat. Sadly our main course came just five minutes later and was mediocre at best. When expressed to our waitress she exclaimed- " oh no" , placed our ticket on the table and quickly disappeared.
Sad to give the place a low rating and feel like it's unlikely we will return.

Since On the Border is gone we are looking for a good Mexican restaurant, so we came to Mi Casa for our daughter's birthday and we're glad we did. The food was excellent. What can I say, we all liked it a lot! The portions are large very large we had the mi Casa platter it came with carne as ads steak chile rellano large chicken requiring rice and beans with quacamole 3 homemade flour tortillas very good they sang a beautiful Spanish birthday song and put a sambrero on her head and gave her a free dessert more than we expected you will not be disappointed.
Love this location!!  Great parking, great customer service and excellent gas prices!!  The grocery prices are a bit high inside but the store is clean and smells fresh.

Finding a good Mexican restaurant in town that compares to Dallas or SoCal is next to impossible so after reading the yelp reviews and a review in the local newspaper we gave this new mexican spot a try and it disn't dissapoint.
Arrived around 1:00 PM on a Saturday and it was busy.
Service-  very friendly and attentive.
Atmosphere - Not sure what they are trying to accomplish. Although there were a few Mexican paintings on the wall it could use a little more detail.  They also had a few large TVs on the wall showing sports so not sure if it fits.   Maybe they should be playing videos of Mexico scenery?
Food-  Based off our first visit we think this may be some of the best Mexican food in the treasure valley.  
1. Chili Relleno was a fresh chili (not canned like so many other spots in town).
2.  Carne Asada -  Good flavor and not overcooked
3.  Chicken in the taquito was all white meat and plentiful
4.  Guacamole - prepared table side.  Another step up from most Mexican restaraunts
5.  Tortillas - Nothing special here -  wish they were made fresh and in house
6. Salsa-  good
Four stars ( Not five) due to the atmosphere but not a big problem especially for lunch.
What happened to this place? Stale buns, over cooked fries, mealy tomatoes... No longer worth my time and you aren't getting any more of my money.

Second time in and I'm still in love!  The crust is the best in town.  Fast, hot, gooey, and good.

I can't believe a reviewer would leave a bad review after not eating and leaving because there are no bathrooms!  Seriously?!

I was reminded again this morning why I don't go to Lucky Perk. The coffee is great but the service is EXTREMELY SLOW! My heck, 8 minutes from ordering to leaving is WAY to long.

When I got to the drive up window, three people inside just wandering around, no organization. Nobody looked like they had a system of what to do, where to be, "deer in the headlights" look. 

When you go to Dutch, Moxie, Starbucks, etc, you're in and out. Everyone at these places know their jobs and what they are to be doing.....this place is extremely slow. When it was Moxie java it wasn't this slow. I won't be back.

I really enjoy this place. I have been in twice for lunch, both times I got the Molcajete because it's delicious and so much fun. There are enough pictures of it on here I didn't post one. I went with a group of six this time and I got to see a variety of dishes that looked great. Nobody finished their whole meal. I got to try some of their dishes and I thought everyone was worth ordering again. I think they use high quality meats and ingredients at this place and it's noticeable. Can't say that about a lot of places. I definitely recommend this place to anyone craving Mexican food near Eagle Rd. and Franklin Rd.

Just attempted to get a coffee from this Dutch Bros, there were six or so kids inside and outside. One was riding on the hood of a girls car. We were behind her, and waited while she got her drink and then waited some more while the young people talked, laughed and ignored us. We backed out and left. If the owner is going to leave a group of kids in charge, he should make sure they are responsible. We won't be back.

Seriously good food. Had the Kobe meatloaf and it was delicious my Husband thoroughly enjoyed his prime rib French dip sandwhich as well. Only down side was we never once we offered more drinks which we love our drinks so it was disappointing, but for a rainy Tuesday the two waitresses working seemed a little overwhelmed.
Pretty pricey for so-so food. Fries tasted old, tables were dirty, and service was not very friendly. Not a $10 dollar burger.

First time going here and we loved it!! The different options are great. The people are very nice. They make suggestions if you ask and the food was fresh and delicious! Definitely going to be a regular place we eat out at. Give it a try! You won't regret it

Placed an order in the morning for a cake to be picked up around 6pm, but around noon we found ourselves near the store so we dropped in to see if there was a chance we could just cancel the order and buy a cake. The staff was super friendly and helpful, she whipped our order up for us in under ten minutes and we were on our way! The cake was a huge hit at the event that night.

Great location, plenty of parking, the place is presentable and clean. Prices are basic my hourly, half day, full day, etc. and are reasonable. However, the customer service is poor, stinks, not up to par. The employees watch sports in the computer monitor while customers are in store. I needed help and asked the man to help and he was so caught up in his sports that he ignored me until I asked for the second time. I won't go back.

Save your money and don't use diamond lawns.  The office is a mess.  Very disorganized.  They purchased the scott lawn accounts this past year.  I was a happy Scott's customer.  Diamond lawns is horrible.  They don't come out when scheduled.  I called and cancelled the aeration I scheduled because they didn't show up for three weeks.  Then after I cancelled with the "manager," they sent a tech to do the service the very next day when I was not home.  I called back to the same manager and he insisted that they didn't do the work?  But then they sent me an invoice anyway.  You are better off using a reputable company.  I still stuck with them for the fertilizer program but my lawn now looks worse than when I didn't even have a service.

Oh my!  First place I have found molcajete outside of Mexico!  Best molcajete I have ever eaten. This was so very good!  The place doesn't have a whole lot of atmosphere; clean, sombreros and pan his on the wall, kind of an industrial feel.  Small bar with a pretty nice selection of tequila!  Very nice Mexican beer selection including several on tap. 
Chips salsa and bean dip were all delicious. Kids meals only 3.99 (doesn't include beverage) but generous portions. 
In addition to my molcajete, my husband had the most amazing pork carnitas burrito. The meat was amazing, tender and flavorful- and large enough that after having spent several hours at Roaring Springs he still only ate half!  He said my black beans were delicious. 
My daughters had carne asada tacos that they said were delicious. Their guacamole was good added to mine!  
Don't know about dessert...it's a first but I was too full to even care about what was for dessert!
Great car wash!!  I travel the west coast and this is one of the best I've used. Got all the bugs off. Car is clean now at a $10 cost. Thanks guys!

I really like this place. Every time I come here I get great food and great service. I've really enjoyed everything I've had so far. To this point my favorite is the Green Pig burrito, it's a perfect blend of meat, rice, beans and bunch of other wonderful stuff that makes it a cornucopia of flavors.  They really have something going here. I encourage anyone to give it a try, you'll keep coming back, I know I will.

I would say this is one of the better Mexican restaurants in the treasure valley... The chips were served with salsa and beans (didn't care for the orange cheese on the beans, that's not authentic) BUT the chips were fresh so that was good. I was a little sad that the fajitas didn't come out sizzling since that's what fajitas at a Mexican restaurant are known for! But the food was pretty good, I'd say 7.5/10 because the steak wasn't that good and pretty salty. However, My boyfriend had the El Molcajete and loved it! He said the sauce it was in was delicious and he will get it every time.

I've been very disappointed with my local restaurants choices lately. I must say last nights dining experience has been one of the best we've had in some time. The Mood was relaxed and casual yet classy... Our waiter Josh Wow!! Not only good lookin but excellent at his job.. Made us feel comfortable and catered too...excellent service and the food... Must try the Mac m cheese sammwich...
Excellent place for lunch! They have the best bean dip and salsa and the food was delicious.

First impression was Welcoming Friendly and Clean. Heater for the pool / jacuzzi is broken (6  days that ive been here and no fix yet and the out of order sign appears to be pretty old), you can also hear right through the walls and anybody walking on the floor above you sounds like an elephant stomping. My wife and three kids were really looking forward to relaxing in the pool. Dont get to go on a lot of vacations so im dissapointed with our stay. Great Location. Staff has been extremely Friendly but should care more about these issues.

This is the worst food/service I've had in a while. Wow! Where to start? We get there and sat ourselves like the sign says, wait five minutes with no service, then we finally decide to move tables. We aren't given any silverware or napkins and the table is dirty. Next, we order and it takes 45 minutes to get our food out. The server still didn't give us silverware and forgets my side so I have to ask again and finally get it. The food was cold, WAY to salty, and looked Ike it was just thrown together. Then when we're paying our server forgot to give us a pen. Definitely stay clear of this place!

I've been to many car different washes in different states but have never experienced a car wash service like this before!  

I initially came there for a full detail service and an attendant came running out to greet me and looked at my car for an estimate.  He recommended that I first get the "Ultimate Full Service Package" for $39.95 (rather than a detail) which includes the Supreme Car Wash (their best one.)  After going through the car wash tunnel, they had me drive into their Full Service shop while I watched 3 guys basically detail my car inside and out for about 20 minutes!  The job was amazing and I saved over $100 for a typical detail.  They do offer full details (takes all day) and I did eventually do that because I was so impressed with what the quality work they do.

By the way, if you have kids or you just are a kid like me, you will love their spray guns inside the luxurious waiting area (with snacks and drinks too!)  There are two spray guns mounted to the floor that extend through the viewing glass of the car wash tunnel.  As the cars go by, you can direct and spray them with colored car wash soap!  Oh it is a blast!!

Also, restrooms are nicer than some of the restaurants I've been to!  (Can you believe this is a car wash review? ha!)
Great service every time ask for  Delandra very friendly and helpful!  Came from another state and this place was very professional and easy to book appointment!
Yummy coffee, great service! Love the rustic atmosphere and convenient location/drive thru.

Wow. This place is great! I recently moved to Meridian from Los Angeles. And the biggest challenge for me has been to find a good local restaurant. You see, LA has some if the best restaurants at your fingertips. We decided to try this place out on Saturday. I had the burger. Not expecting much. Was I blown away. The pretzel bun was soft. I loved it and im not a pretzel fan. The sauce had a perfect balance of flavors. I would best describe it as an aioli. My fiancé had a pizza and his mom had the green giant pizza. I tried a bite and yummy! She's a vegetarian and said it was one of the most unique and delish pizzas she's had. I can't wait to go back and try out the rest of the menu. Oh and the service and ambience are great. We had previously gone there when it was public house. But somehow the energy is different. Highly recommend.

I've always liked Baja Fresh because I feel like for fast, casual food it's fresh and high quality. I tried this location for the first time today and was pleased. The dining area was neat and clean and the service was friendly and fast. The food tasted fresh and the salsa bar was super clean and well-stocked. This will be one of my go-to cheap/fast eats.
Wow, what a disappointment :( the fries and cheese sauce saved this from being a one star. Food was blah had a strange flavor. This location changed my image of my childhood burger place to go

While visiting Boise we were craving Mexican food. We heard this place is the closes to So Cal Mexican food you can get. I definitely agree this place was spot on. I got the carnitas burrito. I love how the burrito was cut in have a good mix of onions, bell peppers and carnitas.

If there is one thing I know about, it's cheeseburgers.  And this place does not have good ones.  The "lacey" patties lacked flavor, there was nothing great setting it apart.  The French fries were harden soaked by grease.  Definitely go to five guys, or even wendys, before this place.  Did not try the custard.

~Pleasant servers~  
~Great chips~
~Good beer~
~Nice menu variety~
 **Cold food**

We keep giving this restaurant more chances, but it doesn't look like things are going to change.  Three times now, the hot food has been served luke-warm, and on cold plates.  The result is by the time it gets to your table and you take a few bites... you're eating less than pleasant cold food.  

Cold meatloaf in a sandwich = good
Cold meatloaf served as a main course w/cold mashed potatoes = BAD

They do have some small heatlamps, but have been told food is delivered so quickly, they don't have to sit under the heatlamps (I agree that food is served fast).  This leaves it to two other possibilities.  One - they're serving food on cold plates, or Two - they serving food on cold plates AND they're not holding food at proper temps....

Eeeek!  Let's hope it's not the latter of the two.

First time in and this place is an instant favorite!!! Coming from Southern California, I missed Poké and hadn't found an adequate replacement spot.

Poké Bowl gives you the option of white or brown rice, or salad as the base, proteins and sauces you can mix and match, and an array if additions, including Tobiko! The tuna was probably some of the best I've had since coming to Boise, the sauces were delicious, and I inhaled it like no other.

It's a little on the pricey side, starting at $10 for a small bowl, but it's an understandable and worthwhile price for the quality and taste you're getting!

Perfect 5/7, will definitely be back! ;)
Delicious donuts.If you Ike cake donuts your in luck. They are made for you after you order. Very fresh. I freeze a dozen.
First time visiting Idaho and came here for lunch. The tacos were sooo delicious and the service was amazing. Friendly staff!! Will definitely be back next time I come visit.
Poke in the Treasure Valley!! Yay!! Selection was excellent, food was delicious, and the customization is perfect. We will definitely return. Maybe again tomorrow. And the next day. And the next.

I happened to stop here for a quick coffee this morning and I was pleasantly surprised at the lovely place they have here! The girl who helped me was so wonderful.. the best part of the service was the promptness and the courteous nature... it's very rare now a days and the reason why I felt the need to post this review!
Thanks much and hope to visit soon!

Just had my first and last meal from wingstop. My mother and I just ordered take out. Preorder for 8pm. Got to wingstop 15 mins early and the food was already to go. Got it only took 10 mins to get home. We spent almost $25 for 10 bone in wings each 2 large fries and 2 drinks. Would not have minded the price if the food had been good. The fries were ice cold and mushy not crispy at all. The wings also cold and dry. I did get half garlic parmesan dry rub but the mild sauce wings should have been juicy not like an old leather shoe. I would not recommend them to anyone.

Tried to order wingstop online at 10:30pm on a Friday night. Was not able too. Stopped by there at 10:40pm and they were closed but a bunch of kids were in there. Sign on the door says they close at 11. I took a pic. If I was the general manager I would fire all the employees. I'm going to start passing the pic along if no action is taken.

Fantastic service, great price and perfect location.  Newer property rooms were well appointed for the price. 

Very high value for the money.

Well to start off, it's was  100 degrees outside and it felt  like the AC was broken. The waitress told us to sit wherever we wanted. Well it took awhile to find a clean table to sit at. Actually the dining room was filthy. Several pieces of silverware on the floor. Also pizza crust and food on the floor. Took awhile to get our order. The pizza tasted fine when we finally got it. Several tables were waiting for a long time for their orders. They ended up taking the orders to go. Salad bar was a mess and needed restocked. Won't be going back here!

The entire restaurant was empty with only three booths filled and about 5 family's waiting to be seated. They looked extremely unorganized as i stood there for 20 minutes just waiting to have someone put my name on the list. Also smelt like stinky shrimp and was hot inside. I ended up just walking out after no one would even acknowledge me.
Pretty bland Mexican food The waiter brought in Buffalo Wild Wings from next door which should have been my first clue.

Holy brisket this was good...I tried the street tacos for lunch. Chicken teriyaki was fairly standard, pork was pretty good, but the Korean brisket is where it's at! Love the slaw also. Service was great, and for street tacos they piled it on for sure. I couldn't even finish 3 of them.

I am so bummed that I didn't visit this place before now! I was on the hunt for my favorite seasonal beer, and couldn't find it anywhere in town. I work near The Growler Guys, and figured I would see if they had it, and they did! I was elated. 

I stopped by on a Sunday afternoon, bought a growler and had it filled. I wish I knew the name of the woman that helped me, because she was amazing! She was super polite, helpful, and explained their reward program to me, which I was happy to join, because I will 100% return. 

Their selection is super extensive, and their price point is comparable to other bars and stores in the area, if not a little better.
Oh my goodness, the gringos tortas rocked my world and the breakfast tortilla was so warm and amazing!

After loving the new Paddles up Poké place downtown, we were anxious to try out Poké Bowl. I really enjoyed choosing my own protein, and knowing exactly how much I was paying for. The employees were very friendly, although when paying with credit card it seemed tip was required instead of optional. Overall it was a great experience, the quality of food was great and we really enjoyed it. We'll definitely be back!

We started to get these cakes for birthdays when we lived in Salt Lake City. Their voiced their delicious. If you haven't had him before definitely put them on your list I'm sure you won't be disappointed.
This place was disgusting, and we literally got kicked out right after we ate because somebody "had a reservation". Avoid this place at all costs.

I really should give Calle 75 five stars, but I hate eating with plastic forks and knives! Evidently Calle has two locations, one in downtown Boise and the other in The Village in Meridian. We ate at the latter location which is a shared space with two other businesses.

Located in the plaza of the Village, it opens up to outdoor "dining" and great views of the fountains and the active life of very nice shopping mall.

It is fast food with a flair - nice atmosphere considering the casual element to chooses to display - a somewhat food truck brick and mortar vibe. Service was somewhat fast considering every order is handmade and the staff was polite and friendly.

My wife had two tacos that were made to order - her verdict was "very good." I had the Green Pig which was to die for!!!!! I really can't say enough for it, in fact, just writing about it is making me hungry.

Once again, I feel bad about the 4 stars and its my fault not theirs. So, two words of "warning" - know that your not dining out, but eating "street food" and secondly, study the menu before hand (we felt we were kind of holding up the line because we weren't sure of what to order.

Get the Green Pig!!!!!!

Pinnacle was a great place until the new owner took over. Since then half the staff has left, the only beer I come here for will be taken off tap soon when it's been the only place to find it for ages, and NFL Sunday ticket will no longer be shown. How do you pull sports out of a sports bar and expect it to succeed? It makes me sad that lack of experience and no willingness to put money into the place will turn me away forever, along with most regulars.

This yelp is for the wine department.
If you need help finding the right wine Jamie P. is your gal! She is phenomenal with aligning her wine selections to the person and taste! She has always listened to what my husband and I want and has steered us to many a great bottle of wine. 
Jamie makes herself available to all in the wine department - very personable. I appreciate how down-to-earth she is and she always has a smile.
If Jamie is not there I go by her personal recommendations. She personalizes wine by wine ratings, her favorites and why, and by price point. You cannot go wrong going by her recommendations. She really knows her wine! 
We go to this location for the wide selection of wines and Jamie's expertise!!

Awesome food! For being a sports bar they do a great job with Sunday brunch.. They need some work with their service though. The lady we had may of been having a bad day, but it took way to long for food and service.

Best pizza ever! 

Handmade old-style crust oven-baked,  flavorful sauce,  pizza is unique. 

We stopped after school one day.  A slice is a quarter of a pie and filling.  $3! 

I had a salad that was really good.  

We've been back several times now. Relic is next to Harrys Bar and Grill  by the Majestic Theater.  

This little pizza restaurant is excellent!

The manager told us No when we asked for fresh fries. Cold mushy fries, missing food drove back outta our way to get our food. When we got there and asked for fresh fries he said NO. So we handed him the cold fries.  Being told no after a customer order was wrong is not what a company should be doing. yea I'm not happy.
Staff was not very friendly, seemed like they didn't really care if they got my business or not.  They cleaned my stuff okay, but I won't be going back.  I felt like a burden.
Not quite In &Out, but if u get the California style and add some mustard it's,  dare I say, JUST as good. The custard is worth the trip alone. I gotta give the chilli fries a try next time.

Trash days are Monday Wednesday and Friday. The first day I came I was not able to get into the drive-thru, I was determined to find another morning routine so I waited and found out their trash days. You want to come for their customer service and stay for their food!

This is one of our favorite restaurants! As of this posting they just added new items to their menu and everything looks delicious. I had the SOHO salad. I loved it! If you like PF Chang lettuce chicken wraps then you will like this Asian influenced chicken salad. Fresh lettuce and cabbage mixed with crisp carrots and sesame chicken. The dressing was a soy sauce based vinaigrette. I will definitely be having it again.
Insanely good gelato. I have been throughout Italy, Greece, New York and San Francisco and this is top notch.

I walked into the one in the Old Navy parking lot across from the Meridian Villiage---It was FILTHY! It was literally SO built up grime all over walls and everything I had to walk out. It also smelled so bad! I notice a girl has a similar comment from 3 months ago so it's obviously a problem. Hopefully they get this taken care of!!

Convenient location next to the highway and right across from WinCo and a few other food joints. I am so appreciative that the front desk associate allowed us an early check in after driving for 12 hours! Our room was clean, no complaints there. 

Downsides: Thin walls, we have a toddler and our downstairs neighbor banged on our floor (it was still day time, sorry guy...can't stop my kid from being a kid!). 

Be sure to ask that your room comes equipped with a fridge and microwave if these things matter to you. 

Our room had no mini fridge or microwave, had to get ice from WinCo to keep our food from spoiling and kept it in a cooler. Thankfully, there is a microwave in the lobby. 

Overall, a good to stay considering price and in comparison to other motels.

We were devastated when Wok King burned down in 2014, wasn't sure if we would see the family re-enter the restaurant scene. When I heard about Poke Bowl, of course I had to give it a try! It's a far cry from the old menu, but i have my fingers crossed that some of that menu will come back eventually.

The concept is simple, and you have full control of what's in your bowl. For the base, you can choose white or brown rice, or salad greens. From there, choose your generous scoops of protein, sauces, and toppings. Easy breezy! They will let you taste the sauce options before you make your choice, too.

I've noticed a few other reviews complaining about warm rice, but honestly, this is normally how it's done! 

And as far as the price goes, this is very affordable, considering what you get. The amount of fish is easily as much as 2 sushi rolls, for half the price!

After tracking my spending over the past few months I found I have been spending a couple hundred dollars a month here. The coffee is great. And I often pair it with a bagel or a breakfast wrap. However it wasn't it until recently when I had an interaction with their Saturday barista that I realize their weekday barista's lack in their customer interactions. During the week the barista greets me by confirming my order, telling me my total, and taking my form of payment. It's been months and I am still telling the same faces that I have an employee discount that needs to be applied. While I wait for my order the window will remain closed. Today I watched while my barista just had her back against the register while she waited for my order to be ready. A few Saturday's ago the barista was so warm and welcoming. When she approached me at the window, she asked how my morning was, if I was ready for Christmas and so on. I could tell the poor girl was so cold but her face was so warm and inviting! I couldn't help but tip her more than more order. It is so sad but I just don't think I will ever return.

We loved this restaurant! We will be back. We started our meal with the stuffed jalapenos. YUM! Cheesy, bacony and so good! He had the chicken pot pie, which really wasn't a pot pie, but was so delicious I thought my husband was going to lick his plate clean. I had the Sunday dinner which was a very flavorful pot roast with vegetables. We both really enjoyed our dinner. This used to be the R&R public house. They added more booths to make this a more comfortable atmosphere. Service was also great. Thank you Renee. They have a nice selection of beer on tap and many other beers to choose from. The wine list wasn't great, but it was okay.  The music in the restaurant was even good. We like our whole experience here. Go and try it.
One of the best sports bars in town, awesome happy hour! Denise rocks! Great food! Great service!
A very friendly staff greeted me and kept me engaged.  This little gem is somewhat hard to get to, but well worth the little effort it takes.  A wide range of food and drink!  Five stars!

I walked in this evening and there was a sizable line but it was moving along. Didn't actually buy anything. The entire store reeked of spoiled milk. I worked at an ice cream shop for over four years and that's a good indication that they're not properly cleaning the store. The only thing that should ever smell like that is the dumpster on a hot summer day. Probably will not revisit.

Not the biggest selection but they have what you want and are friendly. They have an abundance of extra parts plus they match the brands in store. Great quality service. If you care about remote control cars and plans I HIGHLY suggest this place it is designed just for that.

Dining out does not get much better than at Gramercy Park Pizza.

The food is exceptional and full of flavor. We got the Thai tacos, salmon blt and spicy peach burger. All of these items were expertly crafted and just what we were craving.

The service is so great, genuinely friendly staff that caters to your every need while being in t-shirts and covered in tattoos. It's fine dining service without the snark. 

This is one of those places I am confident that you could order anything on the menu within your personal set of likings and ultimately be very pleased.

Can not wait to return.

On Valentine's Day evening my wife and I went to another restaurant, Jakers.....received absolutely HORRIBLE service so left and found this great spot.  We will definitely be back.  The service and food were both GREAT!

Unfortunately you will be deluged with texts if you give them your cell number in hopes of getting a discount down the road.  You may well receive half a dozen texts a DAY and find it impossible to get off their junk texting list.

Too bad, an otherwise good restaurant tortures you with it's marketing later on.

Ate here earlier today.

Had the regular bowl with salmon, ahi (tuna), and hamachi (yellowtail) and the chili shoyu dressing on rice.

It wasn't bad. I'd go back.

Service wasn't particularly fast though; of 3 wait staff one was behind the counter and the other two were sitting at a table talking.

The crab sticks aren't actually crab, they're krab/surimi.

The ginger is sushi ginger (pickled), not fresh grated ginger. And nori, furikake, and gochujaru (chili flakes), sweet white onion, limu (dried seaweed) aren't available as toppings.

The cucumber was your regular thick skinned supermarket variety, not the thin-skinned mild Japanese cucumber.

Some add-ons (like ginger, scallions, sesame seeds, tobiko, etc) are better stirred in with the sauce than served on the side.

I was in Hawaii a couple of weeks ago and saw clams, razor clams, cockles, white crabs, and swordfish all at Tamura's Market as various types of poké but that was definitely not oriented to the haole.

A few more toppings, some more sauces, another type of fish or two, and better service would all be welcome improvements.
The Green Pig was amazing! Also had 3 different tacos that were ok but for the price would not buy them again.
Just another dry cleaner store in the neighborhood. They offer alteration, $10-15 for a hamming job. They can get it done in a week!

Great fries as long if the fries are not cooked to long. Small burger is great deal with most the fix ins on it. Clean and friendly staff. Yes wish they had in and out here in Idaho but we don't this is the next best thing.
What a big, beautiful store! Everyone I came in contact with was super friendly!! Great place to drool at kickin' bikes!
Fantastic cooking class in Spanish Tapas. Great instruction. Easy environment. Fun and good food.

This is by far the best juice bar. On top of it Amber and Courtny are so so sweet. This is for sure the only place in Boise i will be juicing!!!! 100% worth the juice and the experience. JUICE AT REVITALIZE

This place is more "up-scale" than Motel 6 usually is (I usually will never stay in a Motel 6). The rooms open into the hallways, it's 3 stories, and has an indoor pool. 

It was clean (on the second floor). The floors are laminate so everything echos, and the neighbors above me could be heard dropping things and moving chairs. I could hear doors slamming when people exited/entered their rooms. So bring ear plugs if you plan to sleep past 6am. 

I requested non-smoking and they sent me to the 3rd floor which was horribly filled with smoke! I told the front desk lady I wanted a different room. She gave me the "only non-smoking left" which had 2 queens, but didn't charge me for the difference. 

If you are staying more than one night, note that they only clean the rooms every other night you stay there, so I had to request more towels. But, for the price its definitely worth the stay and I'd stay there again if I need a hotel there.
This place has excellent food and even better service. We all got the personal size pizzas and shared them so we could try each. They have a great menu, very creative pizza creations.

We tried Gramercy Park based off of the reviews on Yelp and we were extremely disappointed. When we ordered, the waiter said the oven was not working well and that pizza would take 35 minutes, so we changed our order. House Salad with chicken, jalapeño popper appetizer, and burger (not a pizza to make things go faster than 35 minutes). So, 45 minutes later... our food came out. Our food came out after the table of six next to us... who ordered after us. While we were waiting... a child at the table next to us threw up which has nothing to do with the restaurant but how it was handled was completely the restaurant's responsibility. The hostess pulled the high chair out with vomit hanging off of it. She went back and forth not handling the vomit. Then pulled the napkin up with vomit hanging off... and then the smell continued to increase. Another employee came up and took the high chair. The hostess continued to clean the table by putting the crayons back in the drawer of crayons to hand out to other children... this is how sickness is spread. We will not be going back to this restaurant. It was an hour and a half to eat dinner. Way more time than we wanted to spend.

Tried Relic for the first time tonight. Great service over the phone, fast, friendly service at pick up and the pizza was so good! We had the Eric - just the right amount of sauce and the crust was excellent. Can't wait to go back and try another one!
Based on nothing other than the volume of the music playing in here and how long it took to get the pizza, I'm giving this place a 2. Hopefully the food is really good...

This was our first visit to this location of Fuddruckers.   In the past I've enjoyed eating at Fuddruckers restaurants.  I don't know if it's because I've gotten older, or because the novelty has worn off, but though the food was tasty, the overall experience left me feeling kind of, well, meh.   The cattle call method of ordering, having to fetch and carry toppings and condiments and  the uber time consuming '100 kinds of drink' soda machines just left me feeling like we stood around, trotted from service area to table and generally participated in a dog and pony show until our food was ready.   The dining room felt cavernous, and for what you pay, not having an option for a refill on fries seems a bit much.  Our burgers (2/3 lb models) however, were EXCELLENT.  The fresh made buns and the seasoning of the meat (which was cooked to perfection for both my husband and myself) swept away some of the 'meh' of the visit.   We were lucky that they weren't busy. I hate to imagine the line ups at the 2 (TWO!)  SINGLE spout soda machines meant to service the entire dining room.  I also feel that offering a dessert menu at the table would help Fuddruckers to generate more sales.

Went in for lunch with a friend. I had the personal manhattan pizza, and he had the Boise cheesesteak sandwich. My pizza was very good, and he liked the sandwich . We shared the crab stuffed tater tots, and they were really good also. Only complaint was the service. It was busy, so we sat at the bar. Bartender too busy to really service anyone sitting there. All in all, good food, nice atmosphere.  I will go back again.

Jim and Lance were very helpful and a pleasure to work with. Lance made the sales process a breeze and laid out our plan details in a simple format that made it easy to understand and see where we could save money and get more for our dollar. We are getting 15 GB of data now for the price of what we were paying for 2 GB.

A good burger with lots of fries. A regular burger has two patties while a little hamburger only has one. Otherwise they are the same. They do had a great veggie option. It does not have a veggie party but rather lots of fresh veggies. 

This is a chain so the food should be the same no matter where you go.
Wings were okay, some of the sauces were over powering. We waited over 20 minutes to get our food and multiple people who came in after us got their food first.

The food here is phenomenal. I ordered the fish taco's and every bite filled me with so much happiness and made me realize I have been lied to when it comes to authentic Mexican cuisine. This place is a must try.

Since On the Border is gone we are looking for a good Mexican restaurant, so we came to Mi Casa for our daughter's birthday and we're glad we did. The food was excellent. What can I say, we all liked it a lot! The portions are large very large we had the mi Casa platter it came with carne as ads steak chile rellano large chicken requiring rice and beans with quacamole 3 homemade flour tortillas very good they sang a beautiful Spanish birthday song and put a sambrero on her head and gave her a free dessert more than we expected you will not be disappointed.
Its ok... sub-par taste compared to Buffalo Wild Wings and Wingers. Not a place I will probably visit.. especially for the cost.

The barista's attitude could use improvement but the coffee was AMAZING. I travel the country and I always order the same drink at different local and chain locations, and I was SUPER impressed with the sink I received here. The best I've had hands down. Would definitely recommend going!

The "chronic" in Chronic Tacos stands for chronically bad service, chronically overpriced and chronically slow. I had a breakfast burrito at Chronic Tacos this morning with a co-worker. We both ordered burritos. After a huge wait, 1 finished. They forgot about the other burrito.. 
(Note: There were two customers total in the entire place)

Finishing the second burrito was no major rush to these guys. I guess they had better things to do. In the end, I had a luke warm below average breakfast burrito. This place sucks.
What a beautiful place!! This dealership is huge and the folks were all really nice. They had lots of bikes and accessories. If you're a Harley fan and rider you won't want to miss this place!!

In Meridian on business and I had a craving for pizza. So Tuesday I ordered the Peach & Chong for carryout and brought it back to my hotel to devour in private and it was phenomenal. I'm a creature of habit so once I find one thing that I like I'm likely to be a repeat offender. Wednesday I went back and ate at the bar while watching the Indians lose to the Yankees and had a simple pepperoni pizza which was also delicious. Problem is I saw 3 tables order the veggie wings and I didn't soooooo, Thursday night I ordered another takeout order again. Veggie wings and a pizza with veggies. Delicious

If you're craving pizza, do yourself a favor and check this place out. You won't regret it

You had me at 55 different craft brews on tap. 

No seriously they have 55 different craft brews on tap that are rotated often. It seems that growler stations are becoming a dime a dozen in the Treasure Valley with gas stations, grocery stores, and even outdoor power equipment shops peddling growlers of beers. Growlers for those not in the know are large glass bottles that hold the yummy deliciousness known as beer. 

It's really refreshing to have a place like The Growler Guys where you can try anything they have on tap before you buy. That's right, you're not relegated to sampling beers on certain days of the week when a brewery rep happens to be visiting. 

Their people are certified by the Master Brewers Association, so they can speak to the beer and dole out a modest education. I love asking them questions about what beers to pair with food. Try asking them about beers that go with ice cream. No seriously, do it. Did you know that some beers taste better in special glasses? I didn't either.

Another really cool thing they do is they use a CO2 purge system to remove the air from the bottles before they fill with the beer. If you want to enjoy fresh beer three weeks after you buy it, their system allows this as long as you don't open the beer - otherwise it's like opening a bottle of soda, eventually it'll go flat. You should ask for a demonstration - they showed me how it works and it's really awesome. And any demonstration that involves fire and beer is always a fun thing, well, as long as it's done safely. 

In addition to the brews, they sell a wide variety of beer-related swag. As you can imagine, they have growlers a plenty, wearables, glassware, mini kegs and more. 

Another nice service they have is a loyalty program that rewards you for every dollar you spend. You earn rewards as you patronize them. Since I'm in there weekly, it makes sense to take advantage of getting free goodies and discounts. 

They also have a few tables and chairs to allow people to have a glass or two before leaving with their growler. And while they don't serve food, if you do get the munchies, Boise Fry Company is just a few doors down from them. 

If you love craft beer as much as I do, and like being able to taste the beer before you buy it, I recommend paying the Growler Guys a visit. You won't be disappointed.

Great Steakburgers!! Gotta try the Original Double Steakburger with cheese the burger is cooked to order so it's hot off the grill when you get it. The fries are a shoestring fry that are always hot and fresh.  Also don't pass on the custard, so much creamier than regular ice cream. My favorite is the PBC&B concrete!!  Don't pass this place up!!
My bowl was so bland. The only thing with flavor was my crabstick. The salmon had no flavor. The spicy mayo and wasabi mayo didn't help at all. I'm not impressed. Won't be returning

David the manager is a dick, filled my bowl with rice and had 5 pieces of meat on top. I said it's suppose to be half entree and half side but he would fix it and said that's how they do it. Menu doesn't say anything like that. His customer service is trash.

Pizza was great, I loved the thin crust pizza - it was cooked perfectly, crispy on the outside, but still soft on the Inside.  Yes there is a lot of fine grain corn meal on the bottom, but it adds to the taste/texture of the pizza.  Salad with the vanilla basil vinaigrette was also unique and tasted great.  Service was really good, a very friendly waiter.  Bonus points for giving our kids little white boards and markers to keep them entertained while we waited for our food. Also love that gluten-free pizza dough is an option as our daughter needs to eat GF. We sat right in front of the open kitchen and I was impressed by how polite and friendly the kitchen staff was amongst themselves.  We'll definitely be returning.

First time trying poke here. Overall the fish and ingredients were really good. Only down side was that I didn't have any idea of what types of sauces to mix or how much. The rice towards the end was therefore bland. Would definitely recommend having recommendations for sauce mixtures on the board. All of the ingredients were really fresh and a small was very filling. Staff was incredibly friendly and overall good experience.

Visiting from California and looking for a good place to buy a cake. Came here ate a sample of their confetti bundt cake and it taste awesome. I like the service too! 
I bought a 10" bundt cake happy and satisfied

Maybe we ordered the wrong thing (carne asada and el pastor) but the tacos were nothing special.  Also I ordered two chicken tacos and was given carne asada instead.  Not bad food but I'm not hustling back for more.

Really like this place and would award 5 stars as everything is consistent.  It gets 3 , newish policy 4 or more per booth during games.  Offered table, and offered to wait greeter said no.

Problem is 6 booths open game 1/2 way done.   Nobody waiting, kinda like crickets in there.  Hmmmm.  Host greeter rather matter of fact.

Went elsewhere and am now turned off by this policy.   Had a great time elsewhere and will re-think Pinnacle, sorry.

I was craving a shrimp or lobster burrito. I made the mistake of going to Baja Fresh.  Three people, 29 dollars later and a goopy black cup of salsa later was enough for me.  The burrito was ok. No flavor.  The part that gets me is that is there sooooo much potential for a little garlic, salt and pepper, but you won't find any one brave enough to cook with those seasonings.  The goopy salsa was the worst.   My wife thought that it was black beans.  Nope.  Gross, nasty and not spicy.  Place was packed with middle to upper class folks who don't know any better.  They need to change the name to Bland Fresh.

I'm gonna try and make this short and sweet. 

Is it a bit pricey? Yes
Are the fries fantastic? No, they are not
However...
Are the concretes good? Very
Is the burger worth it? I certainly think so

I really don't understand past reviews talking about the burgers being bland. I can't speak to the chicken, but the burgers are great. Maybe they all had colds or something. 

The two things that bring down my rating are: price for how little you get, and staff attitude. The manager seems like a very understanding/reasonable guy, but on two separate occasions the cashier has seemed like he hated life. Also, others aren't wrong when they say the patties are skinny. It's still plenty of food though

Since buying my first vehicle from Meridian Ford, when it was located between Main St & Meridian Rd. I've alway had a great sales and service experience. I've bought 3 vehicles from Rick Looney (95 Bronco, 05 Escape & now 2015 Fusion, all happened to be a shade of RED) and have been treated very well. Rick was sick when I came to pick up my Fusion, but he had Bill Gray help me out since I had talked with him a week earlier. Overall a very pleasant experience.
Other than have the brakes serviced on the 95 Bronco, I've never had other issues with the vehicles. That service was done in a timely manner under warranty!
Clean gas station.  Good car wash.  The last time I went through, the dryer didn't dry my car at all.  I mean it didn't even work.  Only once though.  Been good since.
Ate here while in town for a few days. Didn't seem that it would be great. The food was amazing. Loved the Poutine, the salads and the kids loved the pizza.

Stopped in on our way to Boise for a late dinner. Lots of choices and even the kids Mac and cheese was good. Yummy beer cheese fries and the greatest vanilla basil vinaigrette!! Very interesting for dressing but it totally works. We'd totally be back to try other options on the menu.

We've been here a few times prior to this visit and have had some good experiences. The food is always good and normally piping hot. The food that had been sitting there was warm but not at the right temperature. Usually the waiter/waitress is very nice and not rushing but today was not the case. The waitress was not very welcoming, we almost had to go get our drinks ourselves,  and she rushed us to pay...which made us want to leave even sooner. Not a good experience which sucks because we love their food.

Great burgers and great fries.  I want to give this place a five star.  However, management needs to clean things up.  Doors are all filthy in bathrooms. There is grime leading into the kitchen on the door. Bathrooms usually smell like vomit and the outside patio tables are covered in grime and left over food.  Outside needs a pressure washing weekly and someone needs to get a jug of 409 and clean the doors and bathroom and kitchen.  Love the food, love the fries, staff is great.

Let me just start by saying BEST SOPAPILLAS WE HAVE EVER HAD! I'd read good reviews about Mi Casa on Yelp, and I'm so glad we ventured over to check it out. I have no complaints about Mi Casa and know we will be returning. It might be our new favorite local Mexican spot!  

Food: I was VERY impressed with the food. The chips, salsa and bean dip were delicious. We added a bit of salt to the salsa and it totally hit the spot. And free bean dip is always appreciated! I ordered the spinach enchiladas and was so pleasantly surprised when they came out with a Verde sauce and pinto beans. The enchiladas were loaded with spinach. It felt like a decently healthy meal! My husband ordered the a la carte carnitas tacos and they had great flavor... Don't be fooled that they may look small! We also ordered the nachos and, while someone may argue that they had TOO much cheese, that's not a phrase I use in my vocabulary so I thought it was a delicious mound of cheese, chicken and toppings with a few chips underneath... Similar to a Mexican pizza. Definitely eat them with a fork! Yum! To finish, we ordered the sopapillas. They were so good. They were not crispy and sugar-coated like most... They were soft, doughy and even a little underdone. They were PERFECT. 

Drinks: n/a

Atmosphere: It's very simple, as it should be, considering that it's a big, open room in a strip mall. It's set up with traditional Mexican decor, has a couple TV's, and limited tables, considering the small space. The music was fun! I think the atmosphere, while nice but very simple, is the only thing that diminishes from the rating. 

Service: So prompt and friendly!! They were quick to seat, greet and serve us. Everything came out so fast and our server was so nice.
