Happy Hour Offerings: n/a

Healthy Hack: They've got great healthy options! Their soups, seafood and ceviche are really reasonable! Can't wait to try more of the menu. 

Tips: Add a pinch of salt to the salsa! The hot side sauce is more HOT than spicy, so take caution if you start liberally adding it to your meal!

Wow, these guys have the best Mexican food in Idaho, I am not kidding at all. Not just the staples either like tacos and enchiladas, they have some really unique items to choose from too. My current favorite is the Jalisco Plate; bacon wrapped shrimp, awesome spinach chicken thing, and an enchilada. The restaurant is just a little place, but man do they produce good food!

This was a nice little place, good service, and food was your standard fare for Ameri-Mexican.  Felt the meat was a little bland and sauces, both enchilada and burrito, were not terribly robust flavor wise.

Good salsa with chips and bean dip, nice starter.

Portions are good size, even the lunch options.

Probably a bit spoiled living in Colorado with numerous choices, I'd say average and would go back to try another item.

Bought a $50 piece of artwork that I wasn't able to finish in one session. I was told I was allowed to come back whenever I wanted to finish it. The piece had taken me 3 sessions and I still wasn't finished. I had grown busy due to being a full-time college student while holding down a full-time job, so i was unable to come in. They told me that after a 30 day waiting period of not coming in, that I would have to pay for an additional 'studio fee' which was a total of $6. (No biggie) when the time came and I received a phone call that my piece of artwork was over the 30 day month trial period, I was still unable to come and finish my piece. I didn't think it was a big deal to have them hold my piece until I was ready to finish it, so I didn't come back in for a while. When I came in yesterday, I was told that my piece had been "thrown out" due to the new year. I think that was completely unacceptable and I should've gotten my money back. I had finished a previous piece that was $45, and for them to give me absolutely no warning about my piece being thrown out, I thought that was extremely unprofessional and I won't be back. They basically stole from me.

My new favorite Mexican restaurant in the area! Can't beat the food or the exceptional service...the arroz con pollo and pollo a la crema are my faves here! They also serve Coke and not Pepsi...a huge plus in my book:-)

Just had lunch here and ordered #1. I would compare this close to an In-n-Out but the difference is it has more to offer. I like the burger. The fries were a bit salty for me but they were crispy thin cut and it was good. Great drink selection.

Too much mayo on the wrongly marked sandwiches that took awhile to make.

The french dip came with heavy mayo and salty  roast beef. I didn't even need the dipping sauce. The urban cowboy sounds healthy with chicken breast, turkey, and avocado, but also comes with cream cheese, heavy mayo, and pepper jack cheese. The bread was fresh and fluffy but started falling apart from all the mayo. 

I guess if you call for pick-up AND emphasize light mayo, you might be ok. They also deliver with $25+ purchases.
Just moved from LA to Boise just like home great food awesome service! Great kids menu also!
A bit pricey , just the burger was almost 5 bucks. But It was  delish !! Way to go Boise . In the land of mediocre , I found something really good !

We have been enjoying Mike & Rosie's street tacos served fresh every Tuesday (summertime) at The Ketchum Farmer's Market for at least 3-4 years now. 
We live in Los Angeles where we get the best mexican food & street tacos.  Calle 75 Street Tacos menu & product is excellent & as good as any fresh, well prepared taco back home.

My kids ages 10, 8 & 7 also love their food.  There is something for everyone & the owners are accommodating & helpful if we need to alter our order.  My kids love the chicken, the steak & the carnitas & can easily eat three "street size" & often crave more.  :) 

The shrimp tacos are amazing! Fresh, packed with flavor & topped with cabbage & an amazing sauce.  The chan torta, the farmers market veggie taco  & my husband's favorite the El Pastor are all winners.   I even ordered the lettuce wrap tacos with chicken & Mike put all the same ingredients from the shrimp taco onto the chicken.  It was packed with flavor.  I will honestly share that Calle 75 has the best shrimp taco in all of Sun Valley Ketchum as well.  I've sampled every shrimp taco this summer from Desperados, La Cabanita, KB's Burrito to Mama Inez. 
The quality & flavors do NOT compare.   Hope to visit the Boise location one day to enjoy the full menu as I'm sure it's amazing & my kids agree! 
Thanks Mike & Rosie for another wonderful summer experience with you. 

Mary Perkins & Family 
Los Angeles

Revitalize is my new favorite spot. They offer fresh cold pressed juice, bowls, protein shakes, coffee/espresso and a few selections of avocado toast. They use local and organic ingredients in their offerings. Everything I have had so far is delicious and it's healthy which is a plus. You can sample the juices and the staff always have helpful recommendations. One things I love about Revitalize is they offer free community classes from time to time. I loved the yoga and essential oils class they hosted recently. If you are looking for a fun, healthy and delicious juice bar-look no further!

I LOVE their donuts! If you have a sweet tooth like me, but still want to work toward that summer bod, you definitely need to try these!! They taste incredible and they're low in calories and sugars/carbs. I'd highly recommend the flavors Mint Hopper and Coconut Cluster! Check out their Instagram page for daily deals!

Love this place! Brings back memories of times spent with my mom. I now take my girls a couple times a week. It's our new hobby and are making Christmas gifts here. Nice family owned spot with great peeps.
My daughter took me here for a Father's Day dinner. The food was very good and the service even better. Our server was very helpful and friendly. He helped us chose a wonderful meal.

Update 2/2/18: Not very impressed this visit. You know when you order a meal and everything tastes the same??  There are no individual flavors?  Like everything is kind of old? Not bad ... just not fresh. Fries were horrible! Like the burnt ends of potatoes. 

I think it will be a while before we come back if ever.

Pinnacle has always been a good stand-by for us. I love the patio in the warmer weather. We've always had good luck with our servers. Polite and efficient. Good happy hour prices. The happy hour BBQ chicken quesadilla was yummy.

Diverse selection of beers on tap, including a neat display of taps on tv screens. You can even request your favorite beer - with enough interest they'll supply it! Wonderful service. Clean tables. Great music/atmosphere. And most importantly THE spot to get your growler filled. Highly recommend!!
Staff was friendly and helpful. Prices are comparable to every other Harley Davidson store.  Their inventory was large and diverse.
This was my first time trying this place. It was great tasting, great service and loved the large portion size. Definitely recommend this place for a Mexican food fix(:
I received a tower of small cakes as a thank you gift. They were so fresh, delicious & beautifully wrapped that I will keep these in mind the next time I need a nice gift for someone.

FREAKING DELICIOUS! We went to gramercy last night for dinner and had such a great experience. We walked in at 6 on a Saturday night and we were lucky enough to not even have a wait time. When we got to our table the waiter was quick to come over and take our drink order and had some great beer recommendations. My mom and I both ordered one of the specials, the pulled pork special and the ahi tuna special while my husband ordered the gramercy. All of them were AMAZING. The service was quick, the atmosphere was nice and the staff was awesome. We will definitely be back many times

Our food was so good, we like this Panda the best, looks like a new girl was being trained today and she was so sweet and so happy, the others were happy too, just made me feel happy, we all need a little of that.
Happy Saturday!!

This place is shit!  My wife's car broke down and we had it towed here. The car would start fine and then instantly shut off. The dealership tried to tell me it was the battery and I had argued it wasn't. They replaced the battery, charged me $120 and said the car is fine. Two weeks later the exact same thing happened. Had the car towed back and now they say it's the throttle body. They called to tell me the car is ready and I complained about the bogus battery charge. When I picked up the car they waived my deductible for the warranty to offset the battery. Didn't even realize I had a deductible. We picked up the car and my wife followed me home. We almost made it home and the car started doing the exact same thing!  What's wrong with these people?!?!  I will update after I talk with them tomorrow, but for now I am extremely dissatisfied with Kendall Ford. Anyone want to buy a 2013 Explorer Limited?

Maybe my opinion is skewed from living in Los Angeles, but this was the most awesome example of everything-under-one-roof store I've seen since Fedco. And that was 20+ years ago. Fred Meyer has *everything* and it was an amazing experience to get everything we needed with one stop. They even have a Chase branch inside!

Mi Casa is awesome! My wife and I are from California so we know good Mexican food. This restaurant is spot on and the food is authentic. Don't mind the haters on here because they don't know great food. The chili verde enchiladas and the carnitas tacos were amazing. The owners are a husband and wife and their very nice and sweet. I highly recommend this restaurant!
Mi Casa is our go-to Mexican restaurant.  You can tell that the food is higher quality compared to other Mexican restaurants.  They have amazing fajitas and the place is always clean.

Our go to place for a fresh, quick burrito!  Sometimes it can take a while to get your food - so if you are in a hurry for a To Go order, I would call ahead.  The Nacho Burrito and Veggie Burrito are favorites for us!
Great experience, would buy from again and make the 575 mile drive back to California, even enjoyed my free ride from the airport! Carter was a class act!

Was a little skeptical when I sat down and saw the "C" rating on the wall, as a nail tech myself it worried me a little. But the lady that ended up doing my nails did an awesome job! I'm assuming she was the owner of the salon. I will definitely be back for a gel manicure again. Only reason for the 4 star and not 5 is the rating. Makes me wonder what gave them that rating.

Great experience. We had a wonderful server who was more than helpful on our first visit. Great happy hour selection and prices. The food was very good. Started with the crab stuffed tater tots. A different, but wonderful take on tater tots. Husband had the chicken fettuccine alfredo and I had the buffalo chicken salad. His was delicious, mine was good. The salad had so many items in it that it was a little too much and something in it tasted just a bit off. But not enough for me not to go back and try something different.
Kind of an odd set up for a restaurant and on a Friday night it go busy very fast. Wouldn't recommend this place for kids at all. As we were walking out I noticed the bar had very loud techno music playing, which I think would have been very off-putting if we had decided to eat at the bar.
All in all a good addition to Meridian/Boise. Looking forward to trying other items on their menu - both food and draft beers.

My husband and I really enjoy going to Mi Casa!  Every time we have dined in, the waitstaff has been extremely attentive, always paying attention to our drink refills and making sure we have what we want or need.  The food itself is delicious - we have tried various items from the appetizer selections, soups, entrees, and desserts and leave with our tastebuds happy and stomachs full.  

I have also ordered take-out a few times, and even with my (ahem) not so slow takes on corners on my drive home, when I open up the food at home, the presentation of their food is as wonderful as dining in!

The only reason I am not giving 5 stars is that there is no changing table in either bathroom.  We have taken our baby there a few times, and often other families have infants with them as well, so the lack of changing table is my only complaint.  

Overall, if anyone wants my recommendation on where to go for delicious Mexican food, Mi Casa it is!
The self serve car wash is awesome amd efficient.  I will be back to use the self serve car wash over and over again.   Especially for the price

There service was unbelievable! How does that girl still have a job? She is horrible. As our first time in she did not smile or even speak one time as I tried to figure out the menu she did not offer to explain or anything! FIRE THE UNGRATEFUL TEENAGER!!!! Traditional wings were great though and their fries were wonderful! Get that teenager out and I promise to change my rating to 5 stars!!

So surprised! Booked through priceline's Express Deals, so you don't always know what you're going to get. This was a winner.

Full size fridge, stovetop, etc. Very nice bathroom and comfortable bed. Staff was friendly and polite. Definitely got my moneys worth!

The surrounding area is a nice suburb of Boise.

I was sent here by my regular barber who was too busy to get me in. I showed up without an appointment, but John gave me a fantastic haircut and treated me like a king. I get a cut every two weeks, and liked that he didn't shear me off like some shops. I will stay with my normal barber since it is closer to my home, but I would recommend this place any time. Gave me the full old-fahion barber treatment that I like.

OVER Priced Store type Sushi.  I've eaten at this place in the past and they made amazing Sushi. You don't see the Japanese man making the sushi in the back which is why it was always surprising but the last time we went to this place it was pretty bad.  I ordered 2 sushi rolls and Edamami to go and it was pretty bad.  Taste like something you would get from a grocery store where the sushi had been sitting for hours.  We ate it within 10 minutes of it being made and it tasted cheap and poor amount of actual sushi in the rolls.  Sure the Gelato is good but for Sushi - PASS!

So impressive. Virginia at the front and I think Amy was the intake nurse, super great people. Came in for urgent care visit as I'm new to Boise. Saw Dr. Eric, very friendly, patient and thorough. The wait was not long and they even helped entertain my kiddos (5 of them) I'm convinced this is where I will be having my healthcare team while in Meridian.

So yummy. Fish is so fresh! Lots of toppings and choices. Also have very tasty and good size rice bowls. Staff is super friendly and helpful! We will be back soon!! All my Boise/Meridian/Eagle friends need to try!
Very Pricey! Nothing great about it! it's actually just down the street, but I'll drive elsewhere to get my nails done. Kind of a Rip off!

I only wish I could give a negative rating but am forced to give one star.  I cannot comment on the food because we were harassed in the parking lot by the owner before we ever got a chance to give his restaurant a try.  His behavior was so appalling that we would never consider spending a cent on any business where the owner runs out into the parking lot to yell and scream at customers.  On this day, we parked in a lot across (yes across) the street from his restaurant, that could accommodate our large vehicle, towing a trailer.  Those of you who know the area will see a vacant lot across the street and between his restaurant and On The Border.  That is where we parked.  We were walking to another restaurant in order to grab a quick lunch.  The owner from Pinnacle came out of his restaurant, yelling at us saying that we are not allowed to park there if we were going to go to Five Guys (which apparently is his competition, as his main advertisement is "gourmet burgers").  We informed him that we weren't going to Five Guys but to the pizza buffet next to Five Guys.  He very rudely and aggressively told us that we can't park in "his parking lot" and go to any other restaurant except his! We told him that no other area could accommodate our vehicle length, that we weren't in his lot and aren't interfering with any of his customers (again, we were in a vacant lot nowhere near his restaurant or his customers). He became more and more irate and adamant, saying that he has to pay the parking lot property fees of which other owners don't have to pay (really, he pays parking lot fees on a vacant lot not associated with his business???).  We ended up walking away from this completely insanely acting owner.  Never, have I had anyone go so far out of their way to harass others for not dining at his restaurant.   I don't know about owning and operating a restaurant but I do know how to own and operate a business.  Offending innocent people is certainly NOT the way to gain customers....FAIL!

Since visiting my family in Boise I've been to a few great places to get craft beer. This is by far my favorite. Really knowledgable, super friendly, cool vibe. Love getting a pint and chatting while I decide what to fill the growler(s) with. Will make this a regular stop every time I'm in Boise!
Worst chicken wings ever. Like eating rubber. We had the original wings. Won't go back!!!!

We recently just moved from Southern California so we were excited to hear of this place- since we can find these places everywhere back home. After having ate there, it was pretty unfulfilling. The fish wasn't as fresh as I would have liked, they skimp on the sauce, portions seem small & it's a little overpriced for what it is. The fish was cut into such small pieces I didn't really feel it was adequate for the charge. Not impressed. Would rather just go to a nicer sushi restaurant.

If you are like me, I'd never heard of Pizza Studio until a co-worker told me about it.  This place is a well kept secret.  Choose your crust, 6 different styles to choose from; traditional to Firecracker.  Fresh toppings and premium meats.  They have a wide selection of additional toppers like truffle salt and old Bay seasoning.  It wasn't very busy, I hope that is only because I haven't seen much in the way of advertising.  Give this place a shot, you won't be disappointed.  Next to Five Guys and Firehouse Sub's on Eagle Rd.

Dr. White is the man!! Office is clean and staff is friendly. Highly recommended! Came here sight unseen and was not let down. Doc fixed up me up and I was on my way. Great results! My go to when mah stuff is all jacked up

We were pleasantly surprised since this is a fairly new restaurant.
Everything was good! We had a chile relleno, chicken enchilada, rice, beans, pollo a la crema, corn tortillas, and horchata. 

Their menu is fairly extensive but unfortunately not online anywhere yet.
It appears to be a family operation and very friendly. They moved here from Twin Falls where the husband was a cook in a Mexican restaurant.

His experience shows!

The service was outstanding with two girls and then a guy all asking if we needed anything else and how the food was.

We highly recommend this place!

John & Sue

Nampa, ID

First time diner, I happened upon this deli for lunch while in Boise.  Sandwich menu offerings from roast beef, pastrami, corned beef, etc. Just what I would expect from a 'New Yorker' deli. 
The New Yorker hot roast beef sandwich was delicious!  The unique ingredients that made this sandwich 'pop' were feta cheese, pepperoncini, butter and oil and vinegar. 
Not only was the sandwich delicious they created a lunch 'experience'. How?  When they called me to let me know my order was ready, I was not called by just a name or a number.  She simply called out, "Barbara, lunch time!" 

I'll be back.

Been all over, to many dealers. It's a large, clean outfit with lots of bikes and clothes to browse.  Like any sales environment, their sales staff works hard to make a sale.  It's the nature of the beast, so I don't think to much of it.  But they also have an excellent parts group, too.  Jason and Scott are stellar.

Where High Desert shines is their retail clothing staff.  Nearly all the gals that work on that side bust their tail to help.  Some are overly pushy, but the majority, such as Jenesis, Makenzie, Tina, Ashlyn, and Paige, are outstanding.  Sure, everything is over priced, but if you're going into any dealership looking to save money, save yourself the trip.  But these folks make the experience better than anywhere else.

Thanks!

Great prices on furniture and it isn't all the crappy kind you would find at Costco or Walmart. I went to many many local furniture stores and bought my new sofa here, with everything I wanted, AND a few extra hundred bucks. Really, great place to get comfortable furniture. It definitely isn't right if you're looking for trendy furniture. The only reason I didn't give 5 stars is because they didn't offer a cover for my new couch when we loaded it on our trailer. Other than that, great place to get the best price on furniture.

My daughter had the mint-Oreo concrete and loved it. I tried the chocolate custard in a waffle cone. Yum! The custard is a winner. The burgers, not so much. I've heard them compared to In-n-Out, but I just don't see it.  The fries are all right, but the burger I tried was all grease and very little flavor.

So delicious and the perfect light desert! I have read the comments about customer service.  Now looking back at my experience it wasn't the best, but hopefully the owner will give these young employees a lesson in being polite and friendly.

If you ever hear a chef or serious home cook say something like, "I'm going to the playground," chances are that they're headed to Sur La Table (or a similar store). But instead of coming home with a scraped knee or bump on the noggin, it's a scraped credit card or bump in the check book. Either way, the damage is nominal.

You'll survive to play another day.

The unique attraction here is the cooking classes. And while I haven't yet (keyword: yet) participated in any of them, word on the street is that they're lots of fun.

My personal experience is that of "needing" (and I put that in annoying air quotes, because my definition might be different than yours) a set of bowls and dessert plates.

Simply put, this was a case of buy now and apologize later. As a former chef, who was having dinner guests over THAT night, I had a vision for presentation. And to be caught without the proper canvas for my art constituted an extreme emergency!

So while I didn't require any assistance in finding what I came for, there was sufficient staff on hand helping other patrons. 

Anyway, over a hundred bucks later... aside from my "needed" merchandise, I also got a free measuring conversions refrigerator magnet and free knife sharpening for a year.

Justification enough for me.

Good thing I kept my virtual blinders on, because had I explored the rest of the store, I'd be still sleeping on the couch.

Since Sur La Table is still quite the novelty in The Village, I anticipate that you'll find it to be quite crowded through the holidays. So come, but come with a mission, and account for the extra time it'll take at checkout.

In fact, checkout is the only downfall that I could find here. The island is situated in a way that impedes the flow of traffic in that portion of the store. Also, its limited registers (only 2, if memory serves me) will cause you to wait a while longer as the cashier wraps up my fragile purchases.

Not very good. Not impressed. Wings were dry and the fries were undercooked. I'm almost sure that they double fried my wings. Wingers across the street is way better, and the wait time is shorter. I shouldn't have to wait 45 minutes for wings at a place with a drive through.


Edit - I sent the wings back and got another order that was even worse. They didn't even give me the right amount of wings either. I'll never be back.

This Motel 6 is definitely one of the better ones out there. All of the doors to the rooms are inside hallways and the rooms are very spacious. I also liked the updated rooms with the 32' flat screen and hardwood floors. Their wifi is free and they also offer free coffee in the lobby. Keep in mind this is a budget motel so don't be surprised if you find a strand of hair here and there. The motel faculty was also very friendly and I even received a call from the manager thanking me for staying at the motel.
Best baristas around! All are super friendly and want to get to know you. They also make the best drinks!
Drove by today and noticed the vacant building, did these guys close up shop?

I stopped by here for the first time tonight with my friends before watching a movie. I have tried the food truck several times and it was delicious. The cashier was super friendly and helpful in me selecting my beans and my type of meat. I ordered one burrito and a water my total was $10.03; no chips and salsa nothing just a burrito. The food was amazing; great flavor with a touch of heat. I chose the al pastor for the meat; great choice lots of flavor. For the style I chose Gringa style which comes with habanero sauce. The sauce was flavorful with a touch of heat not as much heat as I was expecting for a habanero sauce but still good. My chief complaint was the price; $10 for one burrito no beans/rice, no chips or drink. If I had ordered those it'd be close to $15-20 that's a little pricey for this type of restaurant. I get it your in the village now the rent is pricey but at that price I can go to a lot of other restaurants in the village(the Matador for instance) and have a sit down meal with a waiter/waitress and get a lot more food for around the same amount of money. Maybe include a generous portion of chips then your customers can use your great salsa bar. I don't think I will be back anytime soon myself; please don't let the description of $ on yelp fool you it's definitely not a $ restaurant but if your looking for tacos/burritos/salsa/tortas with great flavor and don't mind paying a little more this is the place to grab a bite to eat if your at the village.
You call this food? McFood with a slightly nicer atmosphere, is how I would describe this place. The service wasn't bad, but that isn't enough for me to ever return.

I had a room next to the stairs. With lots of kids running up and down the stairs, it was very loud and irritating, especially on the nights when there were kids sports team staying there. Breakfast selection good but food (eggs) were often still cold, oatmeal was often empty, making choices somewhat disappointing. Staff pleasant and helpful, beds comfortable, rooms clean.

Thank you so much to Lupe!

He helped me look over several models, explained the pros and cons of each, and offered advice on which I would most likely be comfortable with because I'm not a big, burly man.

I really liked the Sportster and even took a used on out on a test drive.  Man, it was fun - so very different than my little Ninja.  Much, much more comfortable for sure.

Although I am not going to buy another bike till my Ninja is paid off (this Spring), I appreciated the help I got at High Desert and will definitely be back when the time comes!

We've been going to Ye Olde Sweet Shoppe in Eagle, but the store is going out of business this week, so we came here and I noticed something right away; their salt water Taffy.  It was way smoother than I'm used to and it reminded me of a place I visited a few years ago while in Salt Lake.  Sure enough, the clerk confirmed their taffy is from Taffy Town; the awesome taffy place I took a tour of many years ago.  By far the best taffy I've ever tasted.

Their selection of sodas and candy sent my daughter's head spinning, but not before she filled a bag of taffy and assorted candies for the road.  And yes, they are much cheaper than The soon-to-be closed shoppe in Eagle too.

I'll be coming back again soon.
Came in... sat down and no one ever helped us.. such a shame.. 3 employees looked right at us..
Food was excellent I had the El Mocatje and was very happy. Very friendly wait staff. Don't be surprised that it is small place the food and drink was great.

I have been in countless times for various occasions and have ordered every size in just about every flavor... All delicious. I like the bundtinis the best though. A perfect little treat and SO yummy. I have always had fabulous customer service, the ladies in there are so sweet and helpful. Love it here!
I am highly disappointed in the new menu or lack there of.  This place was at the "pinnacle" and now it is at the bottom of the barrel .. bring back the menu...if i wanted 5 guys I would go next door
This place is awful got a double patty burger that was possibly the smallest single patty burger I've ever had in my life....$8. Dirty as heck.

Came for lunch and was pleasantly surprised. Fast, friendly service. Good food, good prices. The food wasn't too greasy, as I had anticipated, and the ingredients were better quality than any other Mexican place I've been to in Boise so far.

Finally got my car washed today at Fast Eddy's.  I bought the car wash about two weeks ago, but didn't want to actually do the wash until it seemed like it was going to stop raining for at least a day.  Well, today was beautiful, and many of us here in Meridian thought today was the day to wash the car.  I love their automatic car wash.  It doesn't seem to rough on the car, and it does a really good job.  I usually get the $10 wash, since paying more doesn't seem to do any better of a job, and I don't like the smelly little air freshener that they give you for the more expensive washes.  My car is much happier today, now that it is clean, and I have Fast Eddy's to that for that.

[ Cute Story:  While I was drying off my car, and vacuuming it out, the guy near me was doing the same.  While he was busy cleaning his car, his 5-year-old-ish daughter was busy vacuuming up all the dirt and leaves on the ground in the parking space next to his car.  Very cute. ]

Thanks for saving our night! Without fail Gramercy has been a great go to for drinks and food! Tonight was no different. After a lame visit to a mediocre restaurant in Meridian we took ourselves for a couple of good beers and a great salmon Blt! The bartender was funny and helpful, the food was delicious and the beer was delightful. We will be back, often :)
Good variety of fresh fish and sides. Slightly overpriced but I will happily go back again.

Clean establishment.  Food was mediocre. The Mahi Mahi fish tacos were over spiced with a peculiar flavor. The Kobi meat loaf was nothing special.   Service was poor, especially for a slow Sunday night.  Can't imagine service on a Friday/Saturday night.  It's a new place, so hopefully things get worked out. There is potential, just not now.

I will never go to the Meridian DQ again.  I ordered a Royal Oreo Blizzard and it had hardly any Oreo in it....only ice cream.  I took it back and asked for them to remake it and it still had no Oreo and now now chocolate fudge center.  The employees that were working were rude and obviously didn't care about the customers.

Went to this store looking for replacement screen protector for LG V20 phone and an issue with google directions. The sales assistant was condensing and rude. Felt like we got the bums rush. The person then opened the door with a get out all the while giving us a sarcastic smile. WE WON'T GO THERE AGAIN!

I do lots of catering from here. Why? Always on time for pick up and items are already fresh and clean. I am very happy with portion size as well. 
Fajita is great because you can get the meat and vege separated, giving the vegetarian a option as well.
Manager, BEN is awesome and his team of great staff makes my life easier. 
Thank you!

In Meridian on business and I had a craving for pizza. So Tuesday I ordered the Peach & Chong for carryout and brought it back to my hotel to devour in private and it was phenomenal. I'm a creature of habit so once I find one thing that I like I'm likely to be a repeat offender. Wednesday I went back and ate at the bar while watching the Indians lose to the Yankees and had a simple pepperoni pizza which was also delicious. Problem is I saw 3 tables order the veggie wings and I didn't soooooo, Thursday night I ordered another takeout order again. Veggie wings and a pizza with veggies. Delicious

If you're craving pizza, do yourself a favor and check this place out. You won't regret it

I thought I'd go to a little better place, figured $10 for a couple tacos would be a little better.  I was wrong, I ordered the steak tacos again paid a lillte more.  Very disappointed, started out waiting too long to be served.  Then cashier was very rushed like she was way behind or something.  I took my tray to get salsa and there is not enough room to set my tray, very awkward my tray is about to fall off the small counter and my tall meal number was hitting the plastic shield.  Almost dropped my tray, then the napkin dispenser was almost empty,had hard time finding napkins and to top it off my Steak was very tough and burnt.  Not a pleasant experience.

Absolutely the worst customer experience I've ever had. Food took more than twenty minutes to arrive, drinks came in incorrect and the waitress repeatedly kept telling me the computer didn't take my order and the printer wasn't working. Tables and bar nearby were not bussed. Never returning

This Dutch bros is by far my favorite for customer service. I go here daily but have stopped at your Dutch bros in the Boise area if I'm running errands etc. and on multiple occasions the other places have not been as friendly and messed up my order. The people at this location always talk to me and ask how my day has gone. Has given me a free drink if the wait has been to long, always ask me to try my drink first to make sure I like it if it's something new etc. this location, people, and management are top notch. Thank you
They truly have great burgers! And fries! We went through the drive through and they were very thorough. Polite and got our order right. Freddy's has it figured out!

I had my hair colored, cut and styled by Karen yesterday and she did a Fantastic job!! She definitely is a Five Star Service!! Way to Go Karen, I recommend anyone looking for a Great hair color and stylist you need to try Karen shes the Best!!!

Came here with a couple friends. Place was not very clean. Ordered combo meal with a coupon for a free yogurt. Cashier didn't know how to do coupon-food wasn't great, frozen yogurt was pretty good. Would probably come back to try shake or some kind of ice cream dish again, but wasn't impressed enough with food to eat there again.

Our first visit to gelato cafe.  Not impressed initially.  Tables dirty, fighting flies, service was very slow (two tables with people, so not busy at the time). Food was not our favorite and maybe a little over priced for the amount.  We ordered what they said is one of their best items the gryos.  Lettuce was a little wilted, the taste was so-so not great.
Also ordered the Ruben sandwich, it was full of sauerkraut and which seemed to over power the meat making it tart tasting.  I did out 1,000 island dressing on later which did improve it.
Appears from the overall good rating we either hit on a bad night or something.
They were nice to us as they asked how things were and we shared it was not our favorite.
From all the good yelp reviews, maybe we just hit them on a bad night.

Just had the Baja style Asada burrito (something I find hard to break away from) it was delicious and filling as always - BOY food! Salsa is from scratch with a wonderful spice. Tortillas are the real deal. Great spot!
$50 of beer for $30! what a deal! This place is great, always busy with a huge range of diffrent beers, my favorite place atm.

Blaze pizza is .4 miles away. Let's compare.

Price: exactly the same unless you want cheese only in which case blaze knocks off a buck.

Crust: Pizza Studio offers more options like delicious rosemary herb or firecracker 

Toppings: blaze has considerably more cheese and other toppings. Also, Blaze's toppings appear more fresh and appealing. Studio has more sauces. 

Atmosphere: blaze is more fun and exciting, but studio has nice art decor. At Studio we were the only people eating the whole time and there were dirty tables.

Drinks: blaze has better selection and their blood orange lemonade is superb. Studio, so so.

Oven: blaze is a wood oven, while studio is a fast food looking conveyor belt toaster thing - no comparison.

I expect Studio Pizza to close their doors soon if Blaze continues to dominate.

If they were in a different location, maybe, but with a clearly superior competitor,  they will lose.
Tried it for the first time a couple of weeks ago. Clean and delicious fish tacos and the root beer on tap was wonderful! Samples of brownies was icing on the cake - good stuff! :)

Honestly I love how cute and tasty it is. The juices are the best. Like I just love it. It's be hard to find at first but you'll find it. The customer service is 'amazing. Great staffvery clean and organized in here and smells amazing as soon as you walk in. They bring the order to you if it's a walk-in. Just love it here
Wonderful and friendly service. Highly recommended going durning happy hour. All the sandwiches are too die for.

My husband, son (15) and I recently visited Chronic Taco for the first time.  We were all excited because we all love Mexican food and expected at least  something out of the ordinary.  I had a large chicken burrito and it was big, but wrapped so that you could only eat 1 ingredient at a time.  The chicken was so salty, I couldn't even finish it.  My teenage son (who eats any and everything) took a few bites and ended up throwing it out because of the salt.  My husband had some fish tacos and some soft tacos which looked incredibly greasy.  What bothered me more than the food was the dirtiness of the place.  Food everywhere, dirty rags being used to clean off food trays and the floor was filthy both behind the counter and in the eating area.  There were also 2 employees supposedly standing outside smoking that the guy working inside was complaining about.  Very unprofessional.  I don't think we'll be back.

There isn't much to recommend this hotel. Even by Motel 6 standards it is poor at best. Staff has a lazy attitude, cleanliness leaves a lot to be desired and whoever decorated the place must have died before getting to the job. The door track on the elevator is filthy.  Our room was dingy and our bedspread had stains. The front desk replaced it and promised to talk to housekeeping. The bedspread was the least of the conversations they should be having.

Hadn't heard of Calle 75 Tacos before. I just barely moved to Boise. Saw their vendor station at the Boise Farmers Market. Decided to give it a try. I got the Tacos which are 2 for $6. I got a carne Asada taco and pollo Asada taco. They have their own house made salsas you can put on your tacos. A salsa verde and a salsa roja. 

Salsa roja is supposed to be spicy but I'd say it's a medium and the salsa verde is mild. 

The tacos are really good. Tasty. Well marinated. And the service is really friendly. The pico tastes fresh and nothing beats a corn tortilla taco from a good street vendor. I'd recommend them if you're at the market. Only thing I wish I could have had was some queso fresco on it but that's being picky. Really good tacos.

We wanted pizza and found this little pizza shop. The folks running the place were personable and friendly. They helped us pick the perfect.pies. The pizza crust was light and not greasy. Our group ended our meal by arguing which pie was better - the Jimmy or the Ted. No matter they were both satisfying.  We will be back to settle the argument

What a surprise neighborhood pub. Driven by this place hundreds of times. Glad we finally stopped in. 
Nice outside patio away from the street. Full bar inside worth some great sounding cocktails and plenty of craft brews on tap. 
House salad was great with bacon and hardboiled egg. Kid's cheese pizza was good and my son loved it. Most remarkable was the great Low Rider pizza my wife and I shared. Included bacon,  Alfredo sauce, and the most awesome CRISPY spinach. 
Waitress Callie was friendly and professional. 
Close to our home,  we will be back.
Great surprise, was going in for desert and loved this place. The pizza is excellent and the Gelato martini's were great as well.

I picked up a salad for lunch then brought it back to the office.  It was kind of pricey for what it was and I hate to say it I found a small piece of blue paper or plastic in my salad, looked like a wrapper from what the lettuce might have been held together with.  Kind of a disappointment when you spend over $12 dollars for a salad. Service was very good and pleasant.
Hands down amazing. The food and service is wonderful. Don't forget the chorizo for dessert!

I love their pizza, but I was extremely disappointed on tonight's visit. The service was slow and uncaring and the kitchen was making many mistakes. While waiting for our dinner we observed a person picking up his take out order, it took 3 tries for the staff to get the order correct while he waited an extra 20 minutes. We ordered 2 pizzas and only one came out to the table with an apology that the kitchen forgot to make the 2nd pizza. We were given our pizza for free, but it wasn't enough to salvage our experience. I doubt if we will return to this location.

No bad, but not what I ordered.
I told the kid what I wanted and he looked lost and that exactly what I got.
I won't go back

Very professional. Clean. Staff is kind. The wax they use is so gentle on my skin, but gets up just about everything. Prices are competitive. I keep going back because all they do is wax. So I'm in and out no hassle. Their waiting room vs client rooms are separated by frosted glass so i dont worry about anyone seeing me go to or from my room. Love this place

I've always enjoyed this place. Best place in town for good beer, good food, and plenty of TV's tuned to a host of sports.  The Reuben and the pork chop sandwich were top notch.
The new owners evidently didn't like the clientele.  They discontinued the pub chips, screwed up the best sandwich on the menu- the Reuben, and changed the music.  Now modern folk instead of classic rock.

Message received, you don't want my business and I will burden you no more.

Love this Growler station! They have a great variety of beers. The staff answers questions and let you sample beers. The variety of the growlers is nice too. You can get any size. The prices are great too!
Enjoyed a Hawaiian pizza and a sweet IPA on a rainy evening.  The pizza had numerous toppings and good flavor.  The service was fast and friendly.

Longest wait ever for food, bathrooms so filthy I couldn't let my toddler sit on them (feces all over the seat), chips stale and chewy, and two confused servers bumping into each other trying to wait on us.  When we asked for box and check it was another long wait even though place was pretty quiet.  Won't be coming back..

As a man with hobbies like four wheeling, motorcycles, major home remodels and other masculine activities, you wouldn't think I would find this store of any interest.  On the contrary I find the Craft Warehouse to be an awesome place to find cool ways to customize my stuff without blowing my pocket book on some fancy custom website. I especially appreciate that the employ's are very helpful no mater how bad I am at explaining what I want to do, I always find what I am looking for or at least something close enough to work.

I've been hearing about this place for awhile so I decided to meander over to Eagle/Meridian to give it a try. Boy I'm glad I did, this place exceeded all my expectations and that is truly hard to do in Boise. Sorry Boiseans. My girlfriend and I started with the clams which had chorizo added to it. Not fishy and pretty tasty. For our entree we shared a large pizza and had the Jolly Green Giant with added Chili Bacon. This place killed it! All the freshest toppings, chili bacon was amazing and the dough was to die for. Saving the best for last was the dessert, it was a homemade cookie baked on the spot, but be ready to wait 15 mins or so for this bad boy to come out of the oven. It was truly a remarkable explosion of goodness in my mouth. 

Definitely a place to try! I can't wait to check it out again. Keep up the good work. Gramercy folks.

I've experienced strange massages before but this one was pretty high on the list. I got a Groupon for a massage plus relaxation treatments - whatever that means. I booked online and got my appointment for an evening after work. When I arrived there was no one around. I sat down in the lobby and noticed the "new client" clipboard sitting there so I just grabbed it and filled in my info so I was ready to go. The masseuse was running behind obviously so I was hoping I'd speed things along. I waited probably 15 minutes past my appointment. The lobby was small but looked nicely put together.

The masseuse came out of the room he'd been working in and greeted me. He seemed nice enough but he was extremely chatty while getting my info put in the computer. After the last client dressed and left he went back to change the sheets. He asked me to come back so he could talk to me while changing sheets. I'm not a chatty person so I didn't like awkwardly standing in the hall answering questions about myself while he cleaned. He took the old sheets off and wadded them up and stuck them under the table. He put a new sheet on and told me to get undressed to my comfort level and he'd be back. I didn't see him wash his hands after coming out from his last client so I really hope he did after he left me to undress. 

The room itself was pretty decent looking and the table was comfortable. I got undressed like normal and got under the sheet. When he came back he made awkward remarks about how it was a judgement free zone, etc which was odd to me. He asked if I was comfortable before doing anything saying he tries to be careful not to make women who may have been sexually assaulted uncomfortable. I guess gold star for trying but that's not a thought I like while trying to relax. 

During the massage he kept sighing loudly and saying "beautiful". He tried telling me he thinks it's "beautiful" to see a muscle knot worked out but that's a super weird reaction for a masseuse IMO. When I was face up and he was working on my shoulders I could feel his breathing on my skin and face. He bent over way far and his stomach was almost on my face. I could feel his shirt grazing my nose. And he got a bit too close to my rear for comfort while working on my legs and back. No idea which of those was the "relaxation treatment".

A few times he worked muscles way too hard and it really hurt. His cell phone went off at one point. He talked a lot during the massage too which irritates me to no end. Read the room, dude. I'm not there to tell my life's story nor am I enthusiastically elaborating in my responses. I'm there to relax. In silence. After the massage I got dressed and went out. There was another poor soul waiting in the lobby. I paid and he asked me for a hug before I left. I've never been so weirded out by a massage experience.

Cafeteria style food. I ordered the rib eye sandwich and it was just ok. I think I get better out of the microwave. My wife ordered a regular hamburger and it looked good but it was like 10$. Would have rather gone to carls jr for cheaper.

We popped in here after catching a movie at the Village Cinema on a busy Sunday afternoon.
Love, love, love the open-air concept/feel to the building, and that there is plenty of seating. (Absolutely necessary with two other restaurants so close by!) You order at the counter and wait for your number to be called, a laid-back style of food service I quite enjoy. 
The gentleman at the counter that took my order was extremely friendly. I opted for the "Green Pig," a green-sauce burrito. 
It took about 10 minutes for them to call my number, which actually surprised me with how busy they were. 
The burrito was good and fully-loaded. Not quite as big as a Qdoba burrito, but big enough to deserve the (roughly) $8 price tag. At times it seemed to be more heat than flavor, but overall it was pretty good. 
I'll definitely be back to sample the tacos!
Just what I was looking for.   Also seems like all the people are nice around here.  Strong shots. Nice clean retro place.

Best burger in Boise.  I've tried smash burger and Boise fry company and 5 guys smokes them!  The burger tastes like a in and out burger - only better!  The try's are better other places but the meat on the burgers here is the best.  Their buns suck though..  Or rather nothing special about them.  Again, best burger in Idaho.

Went in with a girlfriend for a drink and a bite to eat. Odd little place but kind of quaint at the same time. We ordered a glass of wine and a gelato margarita and a veggie flatbread pizza. All were yummy. Reasonably priced. Our first waiter was great. The owner I think. The second could have used a bath, some clean clothes and a hair cut but all in all it was pretty good. We'll probably go back.

Good Mexican restaurant. Very excellent selection of beers. Had my favorite Mexican beer that's hard to find. The carnitas was cooked perfectly. Very generous portions of free chips salsa and refried beans.
We really enjoyed the enchiladas and salsa. They sat us down and made us feel welcome even though it was late evening.

Showed up at 8:51pm after rushing to get there by 9pm.  As I pulled in The store looked closed. Lights looked dimmed and there was no open sign. An employee was taking out the trash. I pulled up to him to see if it was closed and he said I had 5 minutes. I didn't know places closed at 8:56pm?  I didn't feel welcomed and didn't want a spitball in my drink so I bailed. Another establishment run by teenagers who need to be somewhere by 9:01pm while the owner is at home thinking their business is in good hands. Seems like the common theme in town is to begin breaking down and cleaning an hour before close time. If you happen to go into the establishment during that hour you will feel unwelcome vibe in the atmosphere. Too bad excellent smoothies.

I haven't been impressed with two of the local main pizza chains in the Boise area. The pizza at gramercy was awesome. Crust had flavor,  pizza toppings were high quality. You will pay more here than a pizza takeout chain, but this is well worth a few extra $. The inside is nice and they have a chill bar area, both are suitable for a date. Overall impressed.  My only con would be there was a hefty amount of bacon on my pizza, which came with bacon. I usually prefer a smaller amount, but that may be a pro for you and not a con

They have excellent Gelato martinis. The environment is calm and relaxed. They have live music some evenings. It's a place to go for the night. They don't try to hurry you along plus the fresh, delicious food is worth savoring.
Really good food and I was surprised with how fresh the fish tasted. I will definitely go here again. The seaweed was delicious. Poke' Bowl is a for sure place for me to eat again and soon.
Friendly and fun staff, clean and well organized, spacious area to enjoy, good music. We stayed for a game of Skip-Bo with the kids.

This place is always amazing! The food is great. My favorite is the Italian Grinder, and I have a hard time not ordering this every time I come. They always have a good selection of local craft beers on tap, and also have a full bar. The staff and service are excellent. I may have only checked in once or twice here, but I have been here over 20 times and I am never disappointed.

I'm happy to join in on the enthusiastic welcome by other reviewers to this new family-run restaurant that promises to solve a frustrating dining problem -- namely, where to find good Mexican food in the Boise area. After only one visit, this has become our go-to place for weeknight Mexican.

There are several very thorough, thoughtful reviews on this site and I'll try to avoid repeating the comments here, which generally seem right on the mark (I urge you to heed Michele R's recommendation about the spoons and napkins). 

We loved the tableside-prepared guacamole, which allows for customization (no raw onions for us, please, a little less cilantro, a little more lime). The tortilla chips were perfect, as was the bean dip. My wife is a fan of chicken mole and she was very happy. The rice wasn't overcooked into a gloppy, greasy mush but was light, with a welcome al dente texture. I like tamales, and these are house-made: okay, the chicken tamale was a little dry, easily resolved with salsa and/or guac, but I'll try a different one next time, or maybe the recommended chile relleno. Then again, the sizzling fajitas on the next table looked, smelled, and sounded pretty good too. The chef doesn't automatically assume that everybody likes to swallow fire, so the seasonings were generally gringo-friendly, but with charred jalapeno on the side so you can add as much heat as you like. 

The service could not have been better.

I was tempted to award 5 stars, but 5 stars is perfection, as good as it gets within a given category. Yelp doesn't allow half-stars and I just wasn't willing to round up. There are a few nits to pick, none of which will make us the least bit hesitant to return. But here they are:

Margaritas are okay, no better. They're served in glasses that could comfortably provide habitat for a pair of tropical fish, so if sheer volume is your bag, go for it. But they tasted pre-mixed, even if they aren't (and I don't know, though the lack of tequila options is suspicious), and a little thin. Corona Village remains our gold standard here. I'll stick with the beer next time.

Carne Asada is a personal favorite, and if I find a really good one, I'll never order anything else. At Mi Casa, the flavor is very good indeed, but the steak is sliced thin, then marinated and grilled. That inevitably results in tough, well-done meat. Every Mexican restaurant I've been to in this area does it the same way, so maybe that's just the regional style. But the better places elsewhere marinate an entire piece of skirt steak, then grill to a nice char and serve it whole -- that way you can have it medium rare or however you like, so it may still be chewy but not dry. 

And I still have this thing about TVs in restaurant dining rooms. As in, "WHY???" Sports bars, sure. Okay, any bar. But Mi Casa is a really small place and there are two of them. At best they're distracting and at worst, they are tuned to stations that many people find offensive. In this case, it was two bloody guys pummeling each other in something called Ultimate Fighting. Whatever you want to watch in your own home, help yourselves, but this is utterly inappropriate for a family restaurant, or in fact any restaurant with me in it. Now the sound was off and maybe they weren't even aware what was onscreen and, my bad, I should have said something and didn't.

Rant over. We will be back and will tell others about it in the hope that these earnest, hard-working people can be successful and raise the bar a notch higher for Mexican food in the Treasure Valley.

.I just now did the Arby's survey as requested by my server, and prompted on the back of my receipt. I didn't say anything mean, or give any "unsatisfactory" replies. There was a time they rewarded me for doing such a survey with a free basic roast beef sandwich. Not now. And there was a time (2009 perhaps) I applied to work at Arby's, but did not get any call back or "also ran" email. So its not easy for me to give feedback with enthusiasm. Sour grapes?
.I think the best sandwich I ever had at Arby's was the chicken salad on whole grain bread - with red grapes. No joke. That's a limited time deal, and it's not available now.
.Arby's deserves credit for some great coupon deals. Last night I got three different coupon deals on one ticket - including two loaded Italian sandwiches. Hurray! 
.Some restaurant employees have anal-retentive behavior when it comes to their discount coupons. In other words, you can often only redeem one coupon per visit. So to get around this, I might buy a sandwich deal with one coupon, walk outside to eat it in my car, then walk back into the same restaurant with another coupon to get something different.
.Today I had the Smokehouse Brisket. Not a bad sandwich... but with the salty BBQ sauce and cheese, the brisket flavor was drowned out. And it proved to me that not all beef belongs in a sandwich
.A word about the curly fries. Yeah, they are craveable, and probably coated with MSG. Ask the average teenaged server, and they don't know what's on the fries. My point is, how about offering some healthy fries with simple sea salt?

This hotel is rapidly heading downhill.  We stayed a couple of years ago and it was fantastic.  We came back this year and it is terrible.  The window doors are filthy.  The towels are worse than the rags I use to wash my car.  You get caught in the strings hanging from them when you shower.  The computer is soooooo slow it takes 3 minutes for a screen to come up.  The computer screen is filthy.  The mouse barely works.  No towels or water cups in the excerise room.  No wipes to wipe down the equipment.  There is a crack in our shower wall.  I spoke directly to the manager, Mr. Casey, I think and he said he would look at my complaints and over 24 hours later nothing has changed.  I guess we will have to go back to staying at the Holiday Inn Express.  Also when I reserved, I click on some pics and when I went back the price had gone up.  What is the deal with this hotel?  I am extremely disappointed.  We are staying 6 nights but won't be back.  The staff is friendly but the manager doesn't have a clue.  Keep on going to another hotel.  Maybe the Courtyard is better.

Rooms are nice, new and clean, customer service is great. Everything was good except it was very loud, dont stay next to a door exit (on the first floor) all nite long door was opening and closing and i could hear everything clear.
Ask for Jennie!!! Best. Pedicure.  Ever! She's patient, sweet and she takes her time and does an amazing job! So relaxing!!

This is my favorite smoothie place! 
Always greet you as you enter and the service is quick (Meridian Location)... My favorites are between Triple Berry, the All Star Acai and Higher Grounds (excellent alternative for coffee lovers).
 I love how they offer shots of wheat-grass, acai, ginger too. Decently priced. I Highly recommend. 
They offer 10% off for military members/dependents. And a loyalty punch card that fills up fast.
  
The only draw back is wish they would display or offer the calorie and sugar count for the smoothies.

.This place is situated against two outside window "walls". Nice view of the autumn leaves. Overland Road traffic. Groovy old rock & roll tunes. Old railstation style electric filament light bulbs. Televisions? I am never that interested in watching muted TV at a restaurant. Smooth beautiful wooden table tops in the dining room. And high barstools (so you can dangle your legs?) and high tables in the bar area. I didn't come here to order alcohol, I came to investigate why Gramercy Park Pizza and Grill was on a list of the best places to eat in the Treasure Valley.
.No, I don't seriously believe every written review. As my waiter said, or quoted (a cliche) - Different strokes for different folks.
.I did tip the waiter, not because of the food, but because he was pleasant, patient, he gesticulated to the rhythm of the music, I had my food on the table in less than 10 minutes after I ordered, and he offered some extras to try to enhance the flavor.
.Having lived in New York about 4 years, I always compare pizza I eat in Idaho to the pizza I remember at Italian pizzerias of New York. This Gramercy is more of a pricey eclectic restaurant. You can't watch the chef prepare your pizza, or sandwich. Most of the menu space is for foods other than pizza: appetizers, salads, sandwiches, pasta. I ordered the popular GPPG pizza.
.The first way I judge a pizza is by the appearance of the toppings. Captured by cheese is my preference. This GPPG was free range, meaning that the toppings sat on top of the cheese, and easily fell off my slice as I lifted it.
.Next thing is the consistency of the crust. The GPPG crust was not stiff enough to hold up to the weight of the other ingredients. 
.Most important to me is flavor. There was a peppery-looking dust on the bottom of the crust, but it hardly added any flavor. The sauce was average, the meat was larger chunks than I would expect on pizza, the gobs of cheese in my mouth kind of reminded me of a grilled cheese sandwich. Not too good, not too bad.
.Only distasteful thing I would say is the parking lot, designed to make people wonder where they should park.
Very good food. Taste like moms and grandmas. I'm Mexican heritage and this restaurant is special. No affiliation
Best burger in Boise! We are from Cali and loved in and out burger..this tops it. What a delightful burger!! Little bacon cheeseburger is delicious topped the way you want it. Fun atmosphere.

Awesome atmosphere, very relaxing and laid back. The best part is the coffee is good too. Great service. We took a board game and just hung out for a date one night. They were very cool about it and we had a great time. We keep meaning to go back and we will soon, I really like this place.

I had a service tech named Will come out and fix my door and he was amazing! He has 15 years of experience behind him and really knew what he was talking about! He was very kind and helpful. I would definitely recommend Action Garage Door to anyone who is looking for great service on their garage door. Thank you Will!

I love the flavors and quality of their ice cream.  The staff is friendly and the portions are fantastic.  The price is a bit more expensive, but you get what you pay for.  When I have a few extra dollars I like to splurge here.  I will get their largest size and save it for left overs.  It will last me about 3-4 more nights of delicious treats.

After an absolute trainwreck of an appointment with Sunrise Garage Doors I called Action Garage Door and their service tech Will showed up and saved my day. After 15 years in the industry Will knows his stuff and saved me over $400  from the Sunrise quote. Action Garage Door, you guys have a rock star in Will and because of him I will recommend your business to anyone who is having problems with their garage door. Once again thank you very much.

My sales rep Kayleen (gosh I hope I spelled that right) was truly amazing. This is the second time coming in to troubleshoot something on my new iPhone. The 1st time the rep and I worked out the issue together, as we both had no clue. He was super helpful with that. We got he problem fixed
My second time in Kayleen literally called the ATT line for me as one issue could not be resolved in store. She fixed everything I had trouble with. After switching from Sprint, my OS did not want to connect properly. So glad she could help find and correct the issues. She even entertained my 15month old while I had to talk with the ATT customer service. My rep got me set up with new item, my choice, for my new phone. She did not push product on me until I asked. She also gave me the correct apps to download to streamline my new AT&T mobile service. Such excellent customer service. I have had the door held for me going in and out every time as well.

Horrible pizza. I ordered a simple cheese pizza and the crust wasn't even close to being fully cooked, there was only 1 real cheese option, and the sauce tasted like tomato flavored water. The staff was nice, but unfortunately the food was not. Will not be returning

Fast Eddy's is an amazing one stop shop.  I get my oil change, emissions, tires and car washes done here.  I subscribe for the monthly car wash and really like that you get to use a towel to dry your car and windows.  The set of tires I helped my neighbor lady with were almost $300 cheaper than the main tire competitor in this area.The emissions and oil change services are by far and away a better experience than Jiffy Lube or similar.  I cannot recommend Fast eddy's enough.

Possibly the friendliest of all the friendly Arby's that i patronize.  The food is always prepared quickly, I am always greeted and, after years of going there I just realized that the manager even knows my name (It goes on each receipt so they can call it when my order is ready)  Always hot and fresh, I come here more often than any other place I buy roast beef....period.

We absolutely love this place. It is extremely difficult to find a restaurant that not only has amazing food, but is kind and patient with our (sometimes loud) little boys. We love the menu, and the staff  is always so kind and accommodating. Our date-night go-to!!!!

The food was excellent, but check to make sure everything they offer you is part of your meal. I was under the impression that the side salad was apart of mine and was a little surprised to find out it wasn't.

Great food and dessert. We got a single steak burger and California combo for $11.53. They even gave us a free sundae!  They have great service and great employees. 
You should definitely come here.

Note* this review is based on the restaurant being open for three days. 
The menu is huge just to warn you.  Service was very friendly.   Staff members were working together during the lunch rush to keep everyone happy it seemed.  Lunch was served with chips,  rice and beans.   The chips and bean dip were warm which is great.   The salsa was very mild and had a hint of sweetness that I could not define.   I prefer more heat and sharpness in my salsas but for a restaurant,  the salsa will meet their guests needs. The bean dip was simple with nothing to write about. 
I ordered the tacos al carbon.  Chicken,  steak and carnitas. The tacos were served with rice and beans.
General overview of the plate in terms of flavor.... bland.   I found zero cilantro,  jalapenos or unique spices in any of the items.   I am a huge fan of cilantro and jalapeno and I was a bit disappointed that my Mexican fare did not have either.   The tacos were served on tortillas that were dipped in their homeade sauce (very tasy sauce) which prevents the ability to eat a taco with one's hands.   More like an enchiladas without the cheese.   The carnitas were not slow cooked and shredded.   More like deep fried pork.   The chicken was grilled with very little seasoning.   The streak again was grilled with little seasonIng and sliced very poorly.   The rice has potential with a little more spices added I feel.    The beans were the same beans they served with the chips.   
I will give the family restaurant another chance in a month or so after they tweak a few things and give a follow up. 
For now I would say the restaurant has the potential,  they just need to fine tune the menu. 
Enjoy and cheers always!

Mi Casa never disappoints. You can always count on a good authentic Mexican meal delivered by a friendly server, sometimes by the friendly owners themselves. That's what keeps my wife and I coming back!
This is my second review of gelato cafe and I had to take it down a star. The sushi was decent, but overpriced for the quality. The gelato is excellent though.

We have had Action Garage Door come and take care of maintenance on the garage doors at our home and we have always been impressed.  They show up on time and do great work at a fair price.  I highly recommend them to anyone that needs garage door help.  The best in the business!
A great sandwich placee in Meridian. I love Quiznos and jimmy johns. But nothing compares to the amount of meat you get in your sandwich at gandolfo's. The knuckle sandwich is second to none.

Lunch was just so so.  It was quick.  The rice was very good.  The orange chicken and black pepper chicken was so so.  I would not cal this gourmet, but that's what their sign said.  Another negative point is that it was dirty.  Floors were dirty.  Trays you put your food on were dirty.  Mine felt greasy on the sides.  It appears they just take the trays and place them back out for customers without washing them.

$5.00 lunch special! 5 wings... fries and a drink!
You're killing me!
What a great deal!
Love the Atomic Sauce. 
After all the sweat and tears from the spicy ... I cannot wait to have them again!
Ohhhhh so bad for me yet so good!
Excellent food, choices, and service. I loved how there were more options than just poke. This is the superior place for poke for sure.

My daughter and I have been getting our eyebrows waxed at European Wax Center for about 8 months now. Love this place!!! Tara M. Is who helps us and she is fantastic!!! She has shared a lot of knowledge with us and is just super fun and personable!

Best bike store in Meridian. I had them tune up my wife's bike and they did a great job. They also didn't charge me an arm and a leg. Nice staff. Their prices are a little high, but I have found deals on helmets.

Ordered a pizza. Extremely greasy! I soiled a large thick paper napkin from three pieces of pizza. Sopped up so much grease it wasn't even funny. Disgusting. And no it wasn't the toppings. It was low quality cheese. 

Too much cornmeal on the dough. That's all I had all over my bottom lip and hand nothing but cornmeal at different stages of burnt.

Top to bottom the best place to stop for gas and a car wash. A full selection of beverages both alcohol and non alcohol. Food accessories you name it, and it's there. The car wash staff are very friendly and accommodating, I had to run my car through twice to get some hard water stains off(I haven't washed my car in months) and they gave me the second one for free even though I was more than willing to pay so fantastic customer service! If a location ever opens in my town I'll go there religiously.
We love it.  Just diet before and after.   The music inside stinks however we know going in what to expect.  Good quality and taste

This is THE best poke bowl I have had in several years. The choice of veggies and protein is so great and I loved all the options. Not to mention it was ABSOLUTELY DELICIOUS!!!!! Definitely going back.

First time here, me and my wife tried the Freddie's Single combo, they offer French fry seasoning next to the fry sauce pump and it was awesome! The burgers were like nothing we have tried before. Two pickles sliced lengthwise and we were surprised by the shoestring fries! The house fry sauce was awesome. A must try! Friendly fast service, clean tables. Got a frozen vanilla custard to go. 5/5
The food here is very good and every bit as good as any other Baja Fresh. However the service wasn't great. Not terrible but definitely sub par for my experiences at any other Baja Fresh.

When I came to Boise to interview I was able to snag a breakfast taco from Calle 75 at the Saturday market and found it very good - no small feat since I was living in Austin, TX at the time which lives and dies by their tacos. Fast forward almost 2 years and was able to visit the brick and mortar location last night. Tacos were great. Love that corn tortillas are the default...as they should be. They need to sell beer though. Tacos without beer are like peas without carrots.

Check this place out, tons and tons on tap and all types and stles! The growlers they have are also awesome, a ton of varieties. If you're in the area and look for a cool place that has a ton to offer with stellar prices I would check this abode out. The service was quick, nice, and helpful. Great little spot!

I like custard. That is where this restaurant starts with its name.  I like their desserts, but they are rich.  A good treat.  I'd rate the dessert menu 5 stars, easily.  

Next, comes the "steakburgers" side.  I was not impressed.  Over cooked, thin, just not that good.  I would never come here just for burgers.  There are too many other great burger places around.  I'd put the burgers in the 2 star category.  

Finally, comes the fries.  I love their fries.  They are good, and the seasoned salt for them works quite well. They definitely raise things up, in the main course category.  I'd rate them 4 stars.  

Over-all, I'll give it 4 stars.  Want some ice cream/custard?  Worth a 5 star.  Want a fast food burger?  I'd recommend going elsewhere.

I've driven by this place every day for the last 6 months and have finally just tried it. I usually stick to Dutch bros down the steet or Starbucks across the freeway but figured today I would mix it up. I for a mocha freeze and love it.

This place is phenomenal. I wish we had one of these in California. I had a ton of bugs on my truck after driving from Cali and the guy hosed them off. Best vacuums ever. Took the dog hair out of the carpet! Sweet. 

The people inside were just really friendly and helpful. I even picked up good wine and a beer growler there! Can you believe it? Clean as heck too. Fantastic operation. Highly recommend.

The food here is nothing memorable. It is like every other mediocre Mexican restaurant I've ever been to. The service was pretty good and the prices a bit more spendy than average. I wouldn't recommend this restaurant for a favorite but more if a convenient no other Mexican restaurant around so I'll eat here to feed my Mexican craving.

Great place, great atmosphere...my food was great. 
However, my roommate ordered the salmon and he absolutely HATED it! He said he the taste of it was not of salmon, but instead of freezer burn. He was 100% disgusted with it. He complained to the girl in a nice way at the end of supper and honestly, she was sweet, but she really didn't seem to care that he was very dissatisfied. I had a pizza and some garlic toast and it wasn't the best in the world, but it was great...if that makes any sense lol.
Ive had their burgers there before and they are AMAZING! 
Just don't get the salmon and expect something amazing! its not! and it hardly came with any veggies.

Nice, quiet, clean hotel with good amenities and helpful staff.  I'll stay here again when I'm in Boise.

I came from Oregon for a President's Day weekend visit, rolling in around 12:30 a.m. on a Friday night.  The hotel is very easy to find, right off the freeway.  I'd used hotel points to make a 3-night reservation, but I wanted to add a fourth night at my own cost.  No problem.

The room was more than adequate, with a king bed, easy chair, sofa, and small kitchen.  The TV was nice too.  I wasn't too thrilled about competing with everyone and their 4 kids for the complimentary breakfast, but that was no big deal, as there are plenty of restaurants nearby and a Shopko and Walmart where I bought groceries and just made breakfast in my room.  It's nice to have a stovetop, microwave and full fridge to avoid eating out for every meal.

I didn't take advantage of the fitness room or pool/hot tub area as I was snowboarding much of the time, but they looked nice.

These dudes know how to make good tacos!! It is too bad that Taco Del Mar was voted Meridians best Mexican food. In comparison, there is no comparison. Calle 75 has great tacos and burritos. Even a good selection of local sodas. This place is THE best Mexican restaurant in Meridian. At least in my book.

WAY better than BWW! Of course, they are different in that BWW is a sports bar, sit down type of place with lots of alcoholic options. But for take out, Wing Stop is the way to go! They are definitely not stingy on the sauce or seasoning and the boneless wings are actually chicken! Not deep fried breading like BWW's boneless wings sometimes ends up as.

Waiting 10 mins 3 waiters total of 5 tables with people at them and couldn't get one person to stop at the table to take our order or say they they will be with us in a few. Won't waste my time going there again

My husband and I tried this place last week when we had no kids and we had such amazing service. I was a little surprised there weren't more people in the place but loved that it was vrey open and spacious. 

My hubby and I got some stuff off the happy hour menu, and he also got a huge calzone! We liked the food a lot, although the calzone could have been in the brick oven just a little more. 

The server was amazing. She was funny and polite and had a very professional but laid back approach. We gave her a huge tip. 

We will be back with our whole family and also bring guests here from now on.

This place is alright.  I agree with one of the other reviews on here that the service is totally lacking and they are definitely over priced.  They forgot that I ordered a combo and instead just gave me my tacos and chips.  The tacos were great!!  But for two tacos, a burrito, two drinks and some chips I think $17 is a bit much.  As for the atmosphere, it's lacking as well.  The idea is there but it's not finished in my opinion.  They need music instead of just the tv noise.  It's a skater/snow border theme so they need punk music or something to go along with it.

My family loves this place. The chef, Jeremy is a sweetheart who took plenty of time to make a personal visit and answer any and all questions we had. Probably the best finger steaks around, and out here there's a lot of competition. They also have a sidecar on the cocktail menu, as a transport from Portland I can't remember the last time I had one of these. We loved our server, Lauren who had the best personality and sense of humor. Don't listen to the other reviewers, changes have been made since then.

The customer service was lacking.  I ordered a cake for delivery and was told I'd have it at a specific time then later was told that there's no guarantee. The lady I spoke to was not pleasant but the cake was delicious.

I love the Higher Grounds. It has protein AND coffee!  If I need an extra jolt, I'll order extra coffee. I have liked all of the smoothies they serve but Higher Grounds and Peanut Butter Power are my favorites. The staff are always friendly too.

I've been here twice already and love it! So fresh and delicious. There are many sauces and toppings to choose from and the raw fish tastes great, fresh, not "fishy." Also, tofu is one of the protein options so vegetarians and vegans can also eat here. Service is friendly. Restaurant and bathrooms are very clean. I would really give it 4 1/2 stars if I could. The only reason I'm not giving it 5 stars is I think the small bowl at $10 is a little spendy for 1 person. But the medium bowl can easily be split between 2 people, which at $12 is very reasonable for lunch. I just wish there was a little cheaper option for a single person. That said, this place is great. It is a much needed option for Boise. 

PS. If raw fish isn't your thing, there is also a small menu of cooked items like noodles, War Wonton Soup, potstickers, etc. I haven't tried those yet so can't comment on them. The poke bowls are where it's at! ;-)
