Tacos were average, but authentic. Chips were a little hard but guacamole was pretty good. Take-out didn't take too long. Husband enjoyed his burrito, but it didn't blow him away either.

They got me in last min and over the holiday week. I got Liquid Gel nails done (Hard gel with tips) and she did a great job. It took about an hour or so and priced fairly. I will say, I was going to get regular polish but didn't realize I picked a gel overlay until it was too late. But overall, great experience.

What the hell did I just eat? No wonder they sent a mass mailer for a free pizza to the surrounding area, I can say I'm glad i did not have to pay for that. The crust was paper, I have had communion wafers thicker and with more taste. This was a major let down because the concept is really cool but I'm going to stick to my Papa Murphy's take n bake.

For the most part we do most of our grocery shopping at this Fred Meyers mainly because it's 1.5 miles away! For regular staples their prices are OK, but it helps to look for their deal (like any store), and I do like many of the store brand products. Overall their produce department if OK but many times some items are pretty average in quality. The meat department has gotten better since they remodeled it a while back.
The rest of the department  (Electronics, Hardware, etc) are OK, but I've found better prices elsewhere. 
I'll give it 4 stars because it's close, clean, service has been pretty good for me.

I take my boys there to get a hair cut.  They do a good job on the hair cuts plus they have a convenient location for us.  The only thing that I kinda did not like is the chairs where you have to sit and wait they are not that comfortable.

I was quite surprised how good the wings were. This was my first visit to Wingstop and simply put, I really liked the wings! We stopped in for 60 cent wings on Tuesday (Monday too) sampled a couple of types of the boneless wings and they were hot and crispy and very moist on the inside.
always love this place and everyone that works here! super friendly people and great drinks! i never run out of something new to try. i will always keep coming back here for sure!!
I don't know why I was so excited about trying this place when I saw the photos on this site. 10$ and I got this dingy lil shite burrito. I got Baja shrimp with chan chan style.
As advertised .... It's a good burger, but fries just soso.  Think I'll stay with Smash burger.
We have been here before for the fingersteaks. In the past it has been hit or miss on service and food. Today both food and service were exceptionally good. We will definitely be back again.
The lady who was bartending was rude and served other guest who arrived after we did first!  Moreover, she was slow and unresponsive to our request.  Won't be going back there again!

Came in fairly late on a Friday night to grab dinner with my husband. Restaurant looked clean and the layout is great. We got ourselves a booth that has its own tv that you can change the channel yourself and the volume. That is defiantly great. A few minutes late our waitress showed up and got us a couple of 25 oz beers and dropped off the menus. Pretty basic sports bar food burgers, sandwiches ect. We ordered the finger steaks for a appetizer and didn't have to wait to long. They where fresh and good also a decent amount. My husband ordered the Ghost Burger and had them add Bacon and I ordered the mushroom burger. We got the food in the average amount of time and it was super hot and fresh. The Garlic Frys are amazing and my husband said the Ghost burger was great if you like spicy. My burger however was very over cooked, there where very few mushrooms on it and they are not kidding when they say charbroil as all I could taste was burnt meat. Needless to say I did not finish it. My husband gave me his Bacon to cheer me up and it was by far the best part of my meal. Service was great and our  waitress was very friendly and accommodating. May stop in for a appetizer and drink to watch a game but didn't feel the food was worth the money.

I go every Fri. morning and meet up with a few ladies from my church.  We usually sit outside in the summer on their beautiful patio surrounded by lavender, pretty tables with flowers and cute decor, but inside is very cozy and lovely in the colder months, as well (including the fire place). The staff is always wonderful, the coffee and treats DELICIOUS and the ambiance, superb!  I truly look forward to every Fri. morning so I can have my coffee and a treat.  I also like that I always get a chocoloate covered coffee bean with every coffee order -- it makes for an extra special treat each time...like an unexpected sweet kiss. :)  I almost didn't want to write this review simply because I don't want too many people knowing about my little secret spot -- however, not too many others will want to join me at 5:45 am (is what I USED to think, but the place is usually hopping by 6:00 am)!

I can not believe that I am leaving a review on McDonald's. Everyone already know what you are getting. The service was poor and they really messed up our order. It is kind of an expectation for fast food places.

Seems like this McDonald's cares more about they're customers in the drive thru then dining in. It took me 18 minutes to get a mcdouble. My order number was skipped for others with more items. When I went up it seems like it was just sitting there, so if I didn't say anything it would have been forgotten .. I was not the only person complaining or having problems in the dining room. Oh well, go through the drive thru instead, you'll save 20 minutes.

First time here after driving by a handful of times and being a pizza fiend, it was on my radar. The inside was nice and clean, and I appreciate the fact that you can see everything going on in the kitchen. Breadsticks are made to order (they cut the dough in front of you) which is pretty great, although I did not eat any so I can't comment on whether or not that makes them taste better. The pizza was average. The crust is not too thick, not too thin...not really sure what style they are going for. My slice of cheese was heated perfectly but it just lacked depth of flavor... For the price (approximately $3.28 for a cheese slice) I would consider eating here again if I was on the go and looking for a quick pizza fix, especially since the slice was quite large. The employees/(what appeared to be) the owner were also friendly which is a plus. As for ordering a whole pizza or going out of my way, I would have to pass, as there is not a lack of pizza places in the area and I was not wow'ed.
Loved this place 48 beta and counting!  Great to taste and drink your favorite craft beer!

Fantastic place.  The service is very fast and friendly.  Prices are highly competitive with most national chains with a quality substantially higher.  They're also very invested in the local community.

The current website listed is incorrect.  They are, however, on facebook.
Today was my first and only visit to Freddys, I won't be back. The hamburgers are terrible, the meat is about as thick as two ply toilet paper and bland.

Don't let the 3-star rating fool ya...

I like Tree City, but there's simply no wow-factor here. And while the service is friendly and courteous, I come here for one reason and one reason only -- Higher Grounds. It's my standing order and should be yours, too. Otherwise, the other smoothies are average fare.

Prices are reasonable. And they have a 10% military discount, if you're in that circle. Plus, a loyalty punch card, to boot.

The Meridian location is just a few doors down from Sports Clips, where I'm also a regular. This is a pleasant place to go when there's a long wait for my haircut.
Wow! What a fancy motel 6. It looked like a little lodge. The room was huge, 2 beds, a little table & chairs. Too cute! Will definitely come back to Idaho and stay here.
"A" for staff enthusiasm. "D-" for carne asada tacos. The meat was tasteless. It had no preparada marination or spice added. They gave us a 25% discount, though. I gave an extra star for that.

Love me some Arby's! I gotta hand it to this location when it comes to customer service, speed & quality of their food, for a fast food place. One thing I would like to mention when not going though the drive-thru and eating in, is some smiles and less cold shoulders from the cashiers up front. It can go a long way in making the customer experience that much better. Most times I've been in you can see on their face how much they don't want to be there. A little more friendliness in that department and I would give it 5 stars!

This use to be one of my favorite places and I would always recommend to my friends but the last few times I have been there the service has been below average and the food disappointing if anyone from there reads this the cooking staff should be fired and train the wait staff to care about the people they are waiting on checking back is nice. So if anyone looking to have fun and a good food find another place that has great food,beer and service because it's not pinnacle..

Wings sometimes are great and sometimes pretty sad. The food can't make up for the terrible customer service we received when they didn't make our order for up to 30 minutes on a slow Sunday evening. No apology no response from the manager, not an establishment I will support when  the owner doesn't even care about service. Food isn't worth it.

This is our go-to restaurant. I have yet to have a bad meal. The steamers are wonderful, The pot roast literally melts in your mouth. The Mac & Cheese Sammich (yep, Sammich!-love it!) is indescribably amazing. Veggie buffalo wings are to die for. My hubby loves the pizzas. Mango moscato? Yes please! Staff is great. Love this place!
Legit....  if you're gonna eat a donut, eat one from here.  Less sugar, more protein, better for you than a hot KK.  And tastes just as good!
Spectacular! Well worth any wait. Great service and even better food. Our two and four year olds found plenty of food they liked.

Had the gyros which there version is lunch meat style which I don't really care for. The tzatziki sauce was flavorless and lazy, they cover costs by using feta cheese and lettuce instead of piling on the meat. Ice tea was grainy and poorly done. I would go back to try the wide assortment of gelato that looked tasty and the service was pretty nice.
Visiting from California. This is really great pizza!  Fresh and crispy crust on the bottom.  You won't be disappointed.
Everyone that worked here was so nice. Easy check-in, free wifi that works pretty well. VERY welcoming to pets of all shapes and sizes. The beds weren't the best, but I wasn't expecting luxury.

Today I went here. My dad was there before us and told us that they wouldn't sit us until all of the 5 of us were there. The man at the stand in front heard my dad and said that he wouldn't seat us, even though all 5 of us were there. He also told us to get out of his restaurant. If I could give it no stars I would.

There's hardly a week that goes by where I don't drop in for three of Calle 75's Baja-styled fish or shrimp street tacos. They are consistently bold in flavor, fresh in ingredients, reasonably priced, and are served up in a timely fashion by a friendly crew. I can't say I've had better seafood tacos in the Treasure Valley, and these easily rival the best I've had in California and elsewhere. If you're not a taco person, Calle 75's burritos are also excellent--especially the surf n turf with tender carne asada and seasoned shrimp. My one criticism would be their size, which is slightly smaller than what you'd get at Qdoba, Taco del Mar, and similar for around the same price.

For fast, flavorful food in the Village, Calle 75 is first-rate. A must-try for taco lovers and hungry shoppers alike!

I had a good experience buying my bike a month ago...  however, the website leaves a lot to be desired.  I tried 3 times over a week to try and schedule a service appointment online because the exhaust is backfiring excessively on my Fat Bob and even did the live chat function and was assured someone would call me for an appointment, but it never happened.  I finally had to call the service department and when I asked them what was up, I got the feeling no one gave one single crap or didn't know why I never got called back.  I made an appointment over the phone.... for NEXT THURSDAY.  What was the point of the online scheduling request function or the live chat?  I don't know, maybe I'm expecting too much, but it left a bad taste in my mouth.  You spend that much on something and you want stuff to work.

This is the second time coming to this place and everything was great. The California style double burger is recommended. They give you a generous portion of fries and also custard at the end. The inside is very 50s but it seems clean and the staff was nice. For 2 adult meals and a kids meal it was around $20.

I love the Lemon Bundt Cake! I plan on trying all of them. This is a great place to come if you need a sweet treat fix or unique gift item.  I have always had pleasant customer service at this shop, they normally will offer you a sample which is always nice and appreciated.

Just went here again for a Brazilian. AMAZING. Pain-free wax. The first wax they do is FREE too, did I mention that? Just let them know that Danielle's yelp reviews persuaded you to come here. The staff is friendly, knowledgeable, and most importantly, comfortable. It is super nerve racking to rip off your knickers and froggie in front of someone you don't know. However, I feel so comfortable here and there are no windows. They have a 5-day touch-up policy so if they miss a spot, you can call them within five days and they'll clean it up for you. You won't regret and you can thank me later.
We're from Los Angeles so we definitely know authentic Mexican food.  This place is just like in LA.  Very authentic old school type food like mama used to make.

We have been here multiple times for lunch and dinner and never have we been disappointed. The food is on point. The staff is great. The chips and salsa. The chips and salsa!! So good we got some to go this time. Just good food. Come. Try. You won't regret it. Or go to Taco Bell and have diarrhea.

For a quick eyebrow wax, this is not the place. Needed an appointment (I like to just walk in when I have a free ten minutes). They try to push you into buying a package as soon as you walk in the door. The wax itself was drawn out and unnecessarily long. I felt like I was stuck in a training video. The waxed was perfectly nice, but was explaining each and every move as well as trying to push product. It's just an eyebrow wax!!! It should take 10 minutes, including paying! To top it off, she didn't take enough off, and within less then 2 weeks I needed to have them redone. Waste. Of. Time.

Carter did a great job in finding what I was looking for as opposed to just putting me in a vehicle to make a paycheck. He took the time to actually listen to what I wanted and then found it. The entire process was one of the easiest and fastest that I have ever had in buying a new vehicle. His follow up was on point and hot harassing, letting me know that I could use him as a resource. I will be looking to Kendall Ford in the near future for other vehicle purchases.

My definite replacement sweet treat spot! Everything is healthy. Organic never tasted so good! I  the Cali bowl. I also recommend the juices. I have not tried the teas yet, however plenty of visits left for me here. Great date spot for a casual meet-up. Easy area to walk off calories after.

Delicious!!! Great beer variety. Yummm appetizers, fantastic dishes (holy menu!), and wonderful service. 

Definitely returning :)

GP has always been a good, go to place for us. The menu is creative and different and the food quality is good. They've got a good draft beer selection, not too much but a good cross section. We've never been disappointed although the pork belly sliders are a bit over the top. My fav is the Buffalo Soldier. Eat one!

The poke here is super delicious and fulfilling ! I'm from San Diego, Ca and there are a variety of poke places I have tried. I was surprised Boise had a poke place , but I was excited to try it. This place is definitely on my top five. I got the small bowl with white rice , salmon and tuna , sesame sauce , spicy mayo and you get to pick five toppings. I was a little bummed you only got to pick five , because other poke places I've been to  I got to pick unlimited toppings. Overall, this place is delicious and definitely worth it :)

Let me preface this update by saying I moved out to the Boise area from Boston in late 2014. I got pretty spoiled by the abundance and quality of seafood when I was there, not to mention proper preparation thereof.

I have had fish and chips twice since moving out here before last night. Both times I have received a glorified fish-stick, complete with heavy-handed breading and over-frying. Both times I have been thoroughly disappointed. As such, it was with some trepidation that I ordered the fish and chips from Pinnacle. 

The fish and chips here were terrific. The fish was covered in a light and fluffy batter that was reminiscent of what I had become accustomed to eating in Boston. it was golden and crispy without being overly oily and dense. The lemon wedge was nice and perky, and the tartar sauce was spot-on. The chips (fries) were good. 

The food came out quickly, was piping hot, and our server was pleasant. I am very happy I stopped here, as usual. 

Please note that the four-star rating is only because there is not a 4.5 option. You will not regret coming here.

Windows, windows, and more windows. Great natural light during the day but unfortunately what they look out to is not that exciting. That should not hold anyone back from a great experience.
I'm usually turned off whenever refers to me as "my brother" but somehow these Billy Bob dressed guys pull it off. 
This has become my favorite go to place in Meridian when I'm in the Boise area. Which I am a lot. 
The staff is super nice, kind of laid back while somehow pulling off professional servicing. Really pretty eclectic blend. 
Parking, always a sore spot for me can be a little tight as all the other businesses compete in the same, kind if small lot. 
I really have no issues with the place and plan on coming mist times I am in town.

Really nice place.  Gyro and Grilled Chicken Pita are awesome.  I ordered a California Roll as I felt like some sushi and it was a meal in itself.  I had the Gelato as well and it was excellent.  Brian (owner) is a class act and works hard to put out quality.  I really like Gelato Cafe and continue to go back once every couple weeks.  I heard the pizza was excellent and will try that next time I go back.  Love local restaurants!

Finally had the opportunity to try this place out. Everything was great. I tried a chocolate peanut butter donut and it was awesome. I wasn't sure what to expect and I wasn't disappointed. Only 103 calories too. Went perfect with my hot coffee.

I have been to the Coffee Studio 4 times. I have ordered iced coffee twice and hot coffee twice. In those 4 times, only 1 (of the hot) coffees tasted the way it was advertised. The other 3 tasted like milk, with a hint of coffee flavor. I assume, for flavored coffees there is a recipe to follow (how much syrup,  milk and coffee to use) but all 4 times I have been,  the coffee has never tasted the same. The flavor of your coffee is dependent on who your barista is. The staff has always been very friendly though! And the establishment is very cute and convenient for my drive to work. Just wish I could depend on my coffee to taste the same each time.

How can you not give Dutch Bros and good rating.  Coffee drinks are great, it's fast and they are fair priced.  Super friendly staff in line to take your order.  

Again, cheers to the management company that runs this chain.  You would never know it's a chain.

Great selection of brews, wonderful people with smiles abound!  Where else can you test as many as 55 different flavors in one place?  My only (2) wishes are that they had some snack to serve other than pretzels, and that the prices of my favorites were about 20% lower so I could go more often. (patio seating would be nice too) Otherwise it's an innovative concept and a fun place to be!

Every time I come into this place, the staff is always ready to take my order and always greets me. If you ever want to customize your juice or smoothie, they will! That's one of the best perks about this place. They have never told me "no" when I want to have almond milk instead of skim milk or add blueberries or ginger to a smoothie or juice. A free boost also comes with any smoothie. The staff is always kind and reasonable. If I could change anything about this place it would be to offer more juice options and green smoothie options. Otherwise, they are a great place to come.

Had lunch and a couple beers... Service was great..place had a good vibe..Food was pretty good.... I had the grinder sandwich. Other food I saw being served look good as well... To bad it's so far out of the way... Will go back tho.

Yelp is right.  This place is legit as hell.  Huge portion sizes, low prices, and great salsa.  I travel for work so I always try to explore the non-chain restaurants in any area I'm in.  I'll definitely be coming back here when I'm in Boise!

Tried a regular poke bowl with shrimp, tuna and salmon. I was worried about the freshness of the fish, but was pleasantly surprised. The bowl was delicious and all the the ingredients were very fresh. There was just the right amount of sauce. Will definitely be returning for another bowl!

No queso fundido, the salsas were empty, really long wait for food. I liked my tacos, but my friends were not impressed with their burritos. We were looking for a quick good lunch, this did not meet our expectations.
I'm Mexican, so I know authentic Mexican food, and this wasn't it. It wasn't bad, but the portions are tiny and it's too expensive for what you get.

Food was good, but you can tell they have poor management. The place is filthy and the floors are full of grease and slippery.  I even saw 2 toddlers behind the counter and in the kitchen. Looking forward to Boise getting one because this place was awesome when it first opened.  We won't go back to the Meridian location.

Stopped in last night to try this place out. Some of the best Mexican food I've had their beans are rated in the top one or two in my book. They are phenomenal. Great service and the staff is very friendly

Horrible place. 11:02am this Saturday morning we went threw the the drive threw to order breakfast since they  advertise all day breakfast. The breakfast menus were still up and said all day. Nope, we were told they weren't serving breakfast. What a joke.
Was an awesome place! There was plenty of staff around for questions that I had. Loved the motorcycle atmosphere in this place. If I was ever in the market for one I would definitely buy it here.

I got a gel manicure by Kristen. She was so kind and professional. She offers a QUICK service and is no fuss! Perfect for busy moms on the go! Great colors to choose from, offers online scheduling, and you can pay/tip with card. Definitely going back to her again! She is available thurs-sat!
Delicious food. Excellent service!! I have an onion allergy and the waitress was amazing about making sure she worked with the chef on what I could eat! Love this place!

I scheduled a massage and received an email the day before, to arrive 5 min. early. Well I arrived early, and no one was there.  I waited 15 minutes and still no one. So I called to leave a message. No call back. When I got home, I saw that after I left for my appt. they EMAILED that the therapist, Karmen had to cancel at the last minute. But no one called me to let me know!  And no one returned my phone call after I left one, and they still haven't.  Very unprofessional not to call clients when you are cancelling last minute, so that the client doesn't leave the house in time to make a non-existent appointment. Not everyone is glued to email 24/7. I am not rescheduling or going back, they have left me with a bad impression.
I just received one of the best customer service from your manager Emily! Thank for making sure we left happy customers and we will be returning!
You can't go wrong here. I purchased the bundtlet sample box. All were good, but I should have purchased the pumpkin mini Bundts. They were fabulous!
I had an issue with Coffee Studio, the owner contacted me immediately to resolve the problem. I will return as usual.

I've always been a huge fan but lately not so much. Went in for lunch today and holy sodium intake! Everything was way over-salted (and we asked for less salt). Hey guys, we can salt our own food if it's needed. No wonder the dining room was empty.
Had a tuna and lobster bowl. Sauces were awesome and the fish was so fresh. My only regret is that I didn't get the large bowl! Might come back for dinner tonight...

Pretty much your basic Marriott. They are close to   shopping and some different  places to eat. There is an indoor pool and hot tub which my husband and I tried to use in the evening but it was packed full of kids and was way over chlorinated. The person who greeted us at the front desk was polite. The room was fairly clean if you didn't look to closely but there were a couple of disturbing stains on a few things. I will post a photo. Overall I think I prefer the downtown Boise location better.

Just moved to the area so I'm looking for a permanent nail place. This one is really close to my house so thought I'd start here. 
My appointment was at 5:30 and at 5:55 they finally got to me with no mention about being behind. 
Quickest pedicure I've ever gotten and the lady doing my toes stopped multiple times to FaceTime. That threw me off. 
The guy who did my nails was nice enough and did a good job after explaining to me it would be $5 to take off my polish and $3 for a nail repair. He said because I'm a new client I have to pay for all that. Welp needless to say I won't be going back. 
The place was clean although the news depresses me and it was loudly on in the "background" which is actually what all the customers stare at. I prefer peaceful music. Better luck at the next place

Went in to order a cake.  It was 5:45 pm and posted store hours are till 6.   

Was initially ignored by 2 young employees

Another person, presumably the manager cam up from the back and I asked if I could order. Bid was rudely told for another few minutes.  

Really bad customer service which guaranteed that I won't return.  

Manager please keep in mind the spending money in your store is not a privilege.     You should appreciate customers
Mi Casa is 2 months old and off to a hot start. Great authentic food. Attentive friendly service and more than decent prices for huge portions. I hope to see them expand soon!
My family and I have been coming here for years and we are always taken excellent care of.  I would highly recommend any of the providers that work a this location.

Great local spot for breakfast, afternoon snack or for anyone looking for a casual and relaxing break from your day. They have a great selection of drinks for both coffeeholics and non coffee drinkers. With free WiFi what else do you need? They even have a convenient drive through window if you don't have time to stay. Support this locally owned business.

Five Guys is the best hamburger shop in Meridian as far as I'm concerned the manager is GREAT food is frest hot and portions are Hugh it a fare price for the quality of food very clean inside and out the patio was very nice I had the cheese burger which is a double toped all the way and med Cajun fries every think was just cooked very hot and very good

The absolute best pizza in Meridian! The most cheese and the best garlic bread ever. There is no other place to even consider getting pizza in town. It's a little more than other pizza places but it's worth every penny.

Nice place - My first visit was only a couple days ago. The people behind the counter were very attentive and did a great job. 

This place is very similar to Rubios or La Salsa, minus the salsa bar. Lots of meat choices,  Everything fresh and prices was delicious. The only downfall was very limited kids drink selection - Water, soda and a couple mexican mixes were all... No Juice or Milk for the little ones.  

But in all -we'll be back! :)
Really a big fan of their cakes but the last two times I've tried to go they've been closed 10 minutes before their advertised closing times so who ever is closing can skate out early.

Ok normally I wouldn't take the time to review a fast food joint. But after having had lunch there today all I can say is wow. First off my general rule of thumb is don't walk through the doors of any place until it's been opened for a while. But having read reviews of other locations I felt i had to give it a try. Well lets just say this I wasn't disappointed. I started off with a Pattie Melt combo. The Pattie Melt was on crispy toasted rye bread with swiss and grilled onions, and the fries were out of this world. Slightly thinner than a fry at other places but not a shoestring. Perfectly seasoned and just darn delicious. So I go about running errands and being a big guy I decide that I'm still a little hungry about an hour later, so I go back in for a chilli cheese dog, They use Vienna franks which are all beef with a natural case so there's a good snap. The chilli was good but the main reason I went back was to try the custard. So they serve custard instead of soft serve or ice cream. It's richer and has more body. You can get cones or sundaes or what they call a "concrete" think Blizzard but on steroids. All I can say is so wrong so so wrong. Thick creamy decadent are there enough words to describe the goodness I don't think so. Go, eat, enjoy I know I did.

My wife and I had a great dining experience at this restaurant. It's awesome that you can choose your fish as well as your ingredients and sauce and build a bowl to your liking.  It's also great that you have a vegetarian choice as well as can manage the size of the protein if you choose to add fish.

I have been using Molly Maid for six months, and I absolutely love them.  The staff that clean my house are quick, professional and polite. I have had the opportunity of using other cleaning services and Molly Maids process is much more consistent and well thought out.  The perform the same cleaning routine in my home every time.  Best of all they are quiet and they do not bring outside drama into my home.

I have never been so ripped off in my life. I had a move in cleaning where the seller had left most of the house very dirty, two women, didn't have to do any vacuuming, 5 hours and they charged me $423. This is not only shameful, it's highway robbery. Now my realtor who recommended them to me in the first place will be using someone else in the future. She is on of the most successful realtors in the area having sold 35 houses last year. Guess what folks? That business is  gone! That was $85 an hour. The cleaning was good but in trying to put it into perspective for the gal on the phone who didn't get it, I said, " You charged me almost 1/2 $1,000! Nurses who save lives, or police or firefighters make far less. " I'm a nurse and make far less than that. For any of the good reviews on here you must be getting regular cleaning so the price is much less. DON'T EVER DO A MOVE IN OR MOVE OUT with this company. I have since found another company that would have charged me $200. My house is 2,150 sq ft so not gigantic. RIP OFF RIP OFF RIP OFF. I cannot believe the nerve to charge $423 for 5 hours of work. Shameful.
Pas mal pour un restaurant de fastfood mexicain. C'est mieux que Taco Bell. Ça c'est sûr !

My 3 star rating for Gramercy is based solely on the pizza. Firstly, I was very impressed by the interesting and creative combinations. My dining partner and I ordered two pizzas to share--the Manhattan which includes traditional red sauce, pepperoni, sausage, artichoke hearts, red onions (and perhaps something else I forgot), and a pie with a garlic oil base, bacon, sausage, and fried spinach. All the toppings were fresh and plentiful and the woodfire oven adds a nice crispiness and char to the outside of the crust. However, the crust was too thin to support the multitude of greasy toppings and sadly became soggy in the middle. In addition, the sausage was crumbled too finely (almost reminiscent of the burnt bits leftover in the pan after frying), not the hearty chunks I would prefer, and the fried spinach on top of the pie that already had bacon and oil just added another layer of heavy greasiness which didn't help with the sog factor of the crust. 

We also ordered two house salads to accompany our pizzas, which were fresh and delicious. Sadly, I was unable to try the other menu items which include a variety of appetizers, sandwiches, and burgers with innovative toppings. There is a small but thoughtful craft beer selection and a creative cocktail menu. The service was friendly and efficient and the ambiance welcoming and comfortable. Although I wasn't fully satisfied with the overall execution of the pizza, I would absolutely return to Gramercy to sample other dishes and down a few drinks.

Came here with the whole family today! The staff members here are knowledgable, very professional, and great at listening to what areas hurt or need extra attention. I left feeling relaxed and that my massage therapist had paid close attention to exactly where I wanted him to. I'll definitely be back :)
Great authentic food and the drinks were amazing. Service was exceptional! Many families were eating and enjoying the atmosphere.

The bowls were tasty , but the portions were small for the price . It was really fresh and they had a lot of topping  selections. If your hungry you need to order 3 or more sides of protein. On the run I would eat there again . Next time I would purchase my poke from Fred Meyers and make my own poke bowl for a third of the price. That's just my opinion!!!
Yuck! Food was terrible, service was awful, atmosphere was cheap and overdone, and the prices are ridiculous! Most definitely will not return.
Took family to lunch there. Had great Mexican food.  Was looking for a spot after moving from San Diego, Ca where there are a lot of Mexican restaurants to choose from.

I ordered a meatball sandwich to eat in and a Ham & Cheese for my wife to go ( she works next door at Harley Davidson)  My Meatball sandwich would have been the best I have ever had if it were hot. It was luke warm in the middle. Her Ham & Cheese was the same way. I will go back only because the meatball sandwich had great flavor and I would like to have one prepared properly. ( It was 11:30 am and they were not busy?) I have heard great things about the pizza so another trip back is the plan but it will have to be better or it will be the last

Sandy and crew are top notch. It's clear they are passionate about having a good time at work and providing stellar customer service. No high pressure sales. Straight up honest advice and a genuine attempt at building a relationship and not just closing the next sale.

Pinnacle has always been a good stand-by for us. I love the patio in the warmer weather. We've always had good luck with our servers. Polite and efficient. Good happy hour prices. The happy hour BBQ chicken quesadilla was yummy.
Quick service and place wasn't too busy so there were a lot of seats. Lots of parking. But the west bound traffic on I-84 is killers from Boise!

Great people great bikes what more could you ask for..?  The salesman are not pushy by any means and they are there to put the right person with the right bike.  I have shopped at other places and they just want the deal, not High Desert they want you to feel right and ride right.  So swing by and check them out they have some great choices and hey you never know you might just find your dream ride!

Wow,  we showed up and got seated right away.  Very prompt and what seemed like what might be good service.  After we sat down it took 8 min just to see if we wanted anything to drink.  My husband and daughter both ordered water I ordered a margarita.  After we ordered drinks then they brought out the chips and salsa.  The margarita arrived quickly minus the salted rim I had asked for. The woman sitting behind me found a hair in her food right after I sat down.  That made me a little Leary.  After a long day driving I was hungry and didn't want to have the conversation of I don't know what do you want. 

The drink was very good.  Tasted like Mexico.  They had 6 large screen TV's Broadcasting the football game which was a nice feature.  They never once came by to see if I wanted a refill on my cocktail so that was a bummer.  Right when the food was served they asked if I wanted another.  Well no thank you the food has arrived.

It was good good nothing to write home about.  Nothing that made
Me say oh my goodness that was amazing. Getting the bill was slow.  But from start to finish was under and hour so not too bad.

Lucky Perk is my absolute favorite of all our local coffee shops, and consistent across the board, no matter which location I'm going to. Why are they different? They feature a rotating "dessert" brew each day. No cals, lots of flavor, great aroma. I love love LOVE their dessert drips! Plus, customer service is ON POINT across the board. They are MY spot!

Food: The oatmeal is very good! It comes in a coffee cup with your choice of mix-ins (almonds, brown sugar & cranberries--you pick 2). It's not fancy but I really like that it's house-made, not a HUGE portion and not pre-packaged. I love that they also offer a wide variety of meals (oatmeal, burritos, salads) and pastries. The breakfast burritos are very good... they're heavy and very filling. They offer different flavors (the bacon, egg & cheese is yummy!) and serve with hot sauce if requested. The cinnamon rolls are homemade by a local gal and are SO GOOD! She does a really nice job! The frosted sugar cookies are the icing on the cake. You won't be disappointed.

Drinks: The dessert brew! They do a good job with their lattes, hot chocolates and tea variety as well, but I love the dessert brew. It's a new flavor each day. They also serve a decaf gingerbread tea that is so great... make it a "London Fog" by adding a splash of milk!

Atmosphere: They are always very nice and cozy for a casual catch-up date or just a solo study session. I like the tables (high and low options) and the comfy bed couches. There's always a variety and the fireside seating is also a bonus.

Service: The service (and dessert brew, of course!) is what keeps me coming back. The staff is always friendly, upbeat and smiling. 

Happy Hour Offerings: n/a though they do have punch cards & text club

Healthy Hack: The dessert brew is a flavored coffee with no cals. Bonus! If you're looking for a light but satisfying meal, ask for the oatmeal. It's an appropriate serving and won't tip you over the edge on calories, sugar or cost!

Tips: Ask for the dessert drip! It's a rotating flavor ranging from vanilla to almond, etc. No cals, lots of flavor, amazing aroma. Join the text club for deals and discount alerts!

Once in a blue moon I love to indulge in wings. We found out about Wing Stop last month and so happy we did.

In addition to the wings being delicious and as true to what the original chicken wing concept, the extra option of choosing to get your fries extra crispy makes this place my go to spot when I have a cheat day. The french fries are delicious and fresh and as close to perfection as you can get.

I am not a big fan of oversized wings (makes me feel like the chickens were fed hormones to inflate them). The normal size of the wings are exactly as they should be. The flavor makes it way to the core and I have to say they are the best wings in Idaho.

The only reason I did not award this place 5 stars is the dine in restaurant itself. Its sparse and cold. You really don't feel like eating there.

For take out its near perfection.

The only place I will get wings.

We had the green pizza and the beet salad. It was delicious. The wood fired pizza is amazing. The bartender had just made cardamom syrup so of course I had to have an old fashioned with the cardamom. Actually I had two. Love coming here when I'm in town.

Do we really need another burger place in Meridian??  How many is there?   McDonalds,  five guys, Smashburger, Carl's jr, Sonic, jack in the box,  Arctic Circle, Wendy's,main street burger, Boise fry co,  and I'm sure I missed a few!  So how could this place bring anything different and unique to an already  saturated burger town like Meridian?   

Well I'm telling you that they have done just that!  It's different and unique!  And I will tell you that we really enjoyed our lunch!  Loved the double steak burger!  It was delicious and  much different than any other burger place in town!   The frys and seasoning were very good as well.  

The menu and restaurant has a wide variety of options that makes it super family friendly!  The place has a colorful and fun decor!   

Custard?    What is custard?   All I can tell you is its like ice cream but only better and creamer!   A must try if your like me and have never had it!  So good!  

Only down side to Freddy's is the location and parking is a bit off.  But don't let that keep you away from a truly great and taste burger!  :)
The employees are super friendly. The hamburgers were thin and the fries were also thin, not what we were expecting with being steak burgers, cheese curds were yum!

I've been here once,  and ordered 20 wings, Hawaiian, barbecue, and garlic parmesan.  I enjoyed the garlic parmasan.  They seemed to be well cooked  and instead of having the flavoring just sort of slathered over the top, the flavoring was cooked as part of the wing. They were a little crispy and very tasty. If I ever go back, which is unlikely, I would order the garlic parmesan wings.  The other two flavors  appeared to be undercooked, as the skin of most of the wings was white instead of browned.  Over the top of these white-skinned  chicken wings, they slathered the flavoring.  The result was a pasty looking, chicken wing with sauce smeared over the top.  I learned a lesson!  If I Want a really good chicken wing, don't go to a place that mass-produces them, it just didn't work.

Service was efficient, quick and friendly.  The restaurant was clean and well maintained.  

The food is good - consistent with other Panda Express locations.  It satisfies cravings for Chinese food, but it's by no means the best Chinese food I've tasted.  (Maybe an unfair assessment since I've eaten at a lot of Chinese food!)

I took off 1 star because the portion size is small for what they charge.
Stopped by to get an oreo custard. It tasted good, but I was disappointed at how terribly it was mixed.

Coming from San Diego, we had Wal-Mart but not  the Supercenter and we had grocery stores. When we arrived in Idaho we discovered the Wal-Mart Supercenters and all the different hybrid grocery stores like Fred Meyers, Shopko and the rest. Fred Meyers is my moms's favorite grocery store. She's comfortable there as it reminds her of her upscale Safeway from her time in California. It took me a lot of time to come around. ( 10 years ) I was initially turned off by the pricing and lack of selection. Over time, I have come to rely on Freddie for a lot more as I have abandoned all hope for Albertsons. Freddie services includes great service, self check out, all sorts of stuff ranging from groceries to guns and ammo. The best advice is look for the deals and check their ad. Their Natural section is fairly decent. The Sushi is good and check the end caps towards the back of the grocery aisles. You find all sorts of specials and discounted items. When I am in pinch and I just need a thing or two, Freddie's is my destination. By the way, their gun case at the Meridian store  is one of the best in the valley.

Their website says they're open till 9. It appears that they close at 8 so they haven't updated their website, so that is very frustrating. Not that hard to do. I got there at 7:50 I know it's close to 8 but not 8 o'clock yet but they were completely closed down locked doors. Not a very good way to try to run a business. The food is also often hit and miss anyways not sure why I go back. Could be so much better but its not.

Quite possible the best Mexican restaurant in Boise. We've been to a few Chapala restaurants and Enrique's in Kuna and Mi Casa rises above them. I had the chicken enchiladas with the white cream sauce and we tasted the chile relleno. Excellent, excellent, excellent. The restaurant is small so get cozy with your neighbors. We went in for a late lunch on a Saturday. Prices were on par with other area Mexican places.

Disappointing experience all around. My family likes to go to Pinnacle often because they have a really cool building - high ceilings, nice big booths, and televisions which are great to watch the various sports games that are on. They also have decent beer offerings on tap and the complimentary housemade chips are tasty. In general, I would give Pinnacle a 3 star rating, as they are pretty average all around in regards to service and food. However, when we went in on a Saturday before the holidays, we decided it would be our last visit.

To start off, the restaurant was completely empty. This is important to keep in mind, because in theory, a restaurant that serves breakfast should probably have a fair amount of people at 10-10:30 in the morning on a Saturday. Many places have waits to get in and once we encountered the hostess, I could see many people opting to just leave. The hostess greeted us and we asked if we could seat ourselves in a booth since it was empty but she insisted on seating us. We wanted to sit in a booth by the bar and generally like to sit in the center one facing the tvs (as mentioned, we have previously been regulars here). She tried to seat us one over from the center booth. Literally right next to it. I don't know why it was so important for us to sit in the other booth when there was no one else there...I get that sometimes servers have different areas they cover but it seemed like a moot point in a space so dead. Needless to say, we got a lot of attitude, but she ended up dropping it and we sat in our preferred booth. As a sidenote, our booth did have the perfect view of two employees (one being the hostess) sitting in a booth of their own, drinking coffee and chit chatting. Maybe she felt uncomfortable with the idea of us watching them slack off? In general, hardly any of the five or so servers were doing much of anything. I would think that would mean stellar service awaited but read on!

Our server...while he was nice enough, he was forgetful in bringing out certain things (ie. plates for our appetizers...guess we were expected to all huddle over the main plates and dig in?) and had to be asked regarding refills. When we asked for a lunch menu, he said they didn't serve lunch on the weekends. Cue confusion, as we have had lunch there many times, and generally do a combination of breakfast and lunch foods. We went on to clarify that we wanted the regular menu, and finally he realized we did not mean the lunch specials menu...Maybe that was our bad, but one would assume if there were no lunch specials on the weekend, you would offer up the regular menu for other offerings instead of acting like breakfast is all that is served? We got some attitude here as well when ordering from the main menu. It was 10:45 am by this point and some people in our party ordered breakfast items, some ordered lunch items. The server came back a little bit later to tell us that 'the chef was very unhappy with him' for presenting an order with regular menu items before 11 am, because apparently that is when the regular menu ordering can officially commence. Let me reiterate...we were the ONLY ones there! Most of the items we ordered were also most definitely frozen food that just needed to be thrown in the fryer. So sorry to the chef if you did not feel like making a little extra effort for the only customers in the place. It was also unfortunate that the waiter told us to 'just come in later next time' if we wanted to order breakfast and regular menu items, like he was helping us see the light with that bit of advice...next time, I'm going somewhere that actually values my business. If this is the general attitude that has been floating around this place, I can see why no other customers were there.

That being said, the food was just ok. Nothing wrong with that, but also nothing worth going back for when the service is lacking (and that's putting it kindly). I like to support local businesses but I can't support an establishment that has employees who feel inconvenienced by having customers. Fun fact: 'Pinnacle' is defined as a high, pointed piece of rock. This experience was so unpleasant, it felt like a piece was broken off and jabbed in to my spine the entire visit, so at least the place is true to its namesake!

Open 4 months now.  Still stocking up on lots of interesting ceramic pieces to paint.  Halloween stuff, Xmas stuff, kitchen stuff, kids stuff, Christian stuff, wall pieces.  $6.00 fee includes all paint, glaze and firing.  You can come back if you don't finish painting on your first visit.  Very friendly family owned business.  Every time I paint something, when I come back to pick it up I want to paint again.  Very addictive!
Have pretty good menu.  The Idaho Steak Sandwich is excellent.  Good soups.
Ordered a pepperoni and mushroom pizza, and an amber beer. Both were teriffic. Service was good, even though the place was packed. Great experience.

Well I have given this bar three stars for right now because I have not been in when it was busy on a major sports night. I am going today however to watch the NBA finals so we will see how that goes. 
My first visit came by surprise because the last time I went it was Iggy's and even though Iggy's had a younger atmosphere the food and service sucked so avoided that place until my husband told me they had became Pinnacle. So we ordered the beer tower and for all you beer drinkers here is the breakdown. 
We bought the tower for $17.50 and it held 100ozs of beer. That equals about 8.33 12 oz beers which makes each beer in the tower $2.10 give or take some cents. That is not bad for a bar beer but for you "economically frugal people" such as myself you are better off going during happy hour which is 3-6pm and get the 25oz beer which is half of for $2.50 and just drink 4 to make 100oz and only pay $10 a $7.50 savings for the same amount of beer just not the cool tower with that metal thing that keeps everything really cold. 
We ordered the original boneless hot wings, nachos and finger steaks. The wings were OK. they reminded me of the no lawyers bar boneless ( I did not do the bone in because I am picky about my bone in and most places screw it up). The pork nachos were o.k. the pork a little dry but still o.k. Last is the FINGER STEAKS which in Idaho is a big thing. The finger steaks were above average I enjoyed them and I have eaten alot in Idaho so I was happy with the taste and the amount served. 
We ended up drinking two towers and betting on a hockey game that was playing since there was no basketball on that day. The TVs are great and some of the booths have there own flat screens ( very nice) My only complaint is yes if you are in the bar area there should not be kids. While reading this keep in mind the place was not busy at all.... I am trying to watch a game and have adult conversation when two families with young kids sit beside each side of us ( for all you sports fan we know we can be rowdy with the language when supporting our teams). Naturally I watched my language and topic of conversation but that turned the bar feeling to like pojos with a bar in it. I hope today we don't have to worry about that and they will mind where they sit people. To be continued....

So second time at the Pinnacle and I went during a busy sports night ( the NBA Finals). I am happy to say that the seating was alot better and the owner offered us a better table when the previous people left. I did not have the same waitress this time since we moved tables but when I saw her she seemed to be as cheerful as ever. The waiter we did have was the bartender and made sure we had what we needed and then left us alone which I prefer I do not like being pestered while I eat and watch the game. 
Yes again I had the beer tower but this time was with a few friends so went through a few. I also ordered the same appetizers as last time because my husband and I both liked the finger steaks. Unfortunately my friends did not but I think it might be a acquired taste to like finger steaks for some people. My friends ordered the huddle but I will not rate their food because I did not try it ( was to busy munching on my own food). I did order the original wings (bone-in) which to my surprise were fairly good and not dry. 
The neg was that I guess before I got there the hostess was a little rude to my friends right before the owner walked up. Later that night she was cleaning a table and looked miserable not sure why probably had a bad day. 
So the pos is that my husband and I at least had a great time and liked that we had our own sound box for the flat screen we were watching. Another plus is that there were no kids sitting next to us this time in the bar area which was great. The seating was large enough to sit all five of us even though we ran out of food space with all our munchies. I may have started to become biased on this place but it has comfortable sitting and huge flat screens and is five minutes from my house so the second trip definitely made me want to stop by again.

First time in really liked it. Everything cooked perfect. Last time medium rare was wellllll done. Should taken it ack but very hungry.

Fries are big potatoes, not that great. Seems to be always packed. Think I'll stay with Smashburger.
Jakey made my new purchase so easy! I knew what I wanted and he explained and helped me through every process. I am loving my new iPhone 7 plus! Great service!

Once again slammed it out of the park! Very yummy dinner salad with mixed greens and delicious blue cheese dressing. I had the Cluckin Carbonara for dinner. It is creamy, tasty and interesting. It is a very large serving that I usually split for the next days lunch. My husband had the Tater and Tate's. The gravy is what it is all about.
Good flavor and different variety of choices...but it was not worth how much it cost and food amount. My husband still walked out saying he was still hungry.
Went there with my parents on Sunday night and we all got sick yesterday and were up throwing up all night. Disgusting! Will NEVER go back.
My favorite burger joint!   Don't worry about the In-n-Out comparison because we don't have so it doesn't matter.
Smallest kids taco ever for $2.50, no drink or chips included. Should be about $0.50 for this meal!
Always quick service and consistently good food.  I come here periodically. No complaints.

Yummy! Considering it was gluten free and healthy it was pretty good. Cake consistency wasn't dense. But also wasn't fluffy like a yeast donut. It had a spongie texture. Flavor overall was good, I'm visiting from CA and this would be the perfect treat! And we got a steal for 3 donuts for $5. I had the chocolate coconut one, my friend had chocolate sprinkles and the little one had the funfetti! The frosting was a bit sticky, definitely not the best idea for the children (mess city)!

Honestly the best Panda I've been to, and I'm a Panda fanatic :) This one is close to my heart because it's where I first had lunch with my wife and now my awesome daughter works there! Good people, clean restaurant, the best orange chicken in town, and raspberry tea. Love it!

I was greeted by the owner, I had a few questions, and I had my young grandchildren with me. I sat the kids at the table while I talked with the man.  The kids were really excited about doing something there, paint plates maybe.  Another man, a customer, came in a minute later and interrupted us, and the owner went off to help this other person, and just left us hanging, and never got back to us.  This other customer was asking the same kind of questions I was.  After several minutes of ignore, I gathered the kids and we left, we won't be back!

No way this place is worth what the prices are. is it good, it is ok nothing spectacular. $9.95 for the Tater tats is rediculous. The Pizza was ok but the chicken on it was the frozen concept you can get anywhere. The only thing we realy liked was the basil they put on the pizza, it was fresh. My beer was not even close to cold. Would I go back and pay $40 for two beers and a pizza and a substandard appetizer? NO ( forgot to mention the waitress forgot our jalapenos and the appetizer came with the pizza and not before like it should have.

Food--consistently excellent! Best salsa in town!
Service--prompt, attentive, friendly!
Atmosphere--A nice family feeling to the place, festive music but not so loud you can't hear what the people with you are saying. 
Muy Delicioso!

Was great when first opened but now it's hit and miss. Sometimes my burger is killer and other times it's soggy and slopped together. Quality is all about training and standardized processes. Something is lacking over there in the ability to deliver a consistent quality burger, like In-N-Out.

About a month ago, I was riding through Idaho and stopped by High Desert HD to replace a wiring harness for my heated jacket. I was very impressed by the size of this dealership, and noted that in addition to Sales, Parts and Service, they also offered HD rentals, which I thought was pretty cool.

Regarding the wiring harness, the young lady at the parts and apparel counter was very friendly and helpful, and found the two parts I needed (wiring harness for bike, and thermostat for the jacket). 

The people at the dealership --from the lady who was greeting people at the front desk, to the young lady at the parts and apparel counter, and everyone else were all very friendly.  I don't even ride a HD (the heated jacket I have is made by Gebrings, which also makes them for HD), but I went ahead and bought myself a High Desert Harley Davidson shirt, just because it was such a cool place!

Ew! Poor service and eh food. The salad was the best thing there. I had the Peach and Chong pizza which is supposed to be one of their more popular pizzas. There was so little flavor, other than spicy. The toppings overpowered the crust by a mile. The poor crust didn't stand a chance. They had a very limited beer selection. The service was barely there. The girl who waited  on us was clearly "somewhere else" other than the job. She just seemed checked out. Nope. We won't be back.
Great place with amazing service and awesome staff. For the creative in you, an awesome place. Wish we had something like this where I live in Las Vegas.
Great service, great food, great prices!!!!  The portions were suprisingly large.  They were great with our kids and stayed on top of salsa, bean and drink refills.

Yelp recommended the Poke Bowl and we loved it.  Great food, clean dining area, and super friendly and helpful staff.  They helped explain the options and let us taste the sauces to help choose what we liked.  It is a nice healthier alternative to the usual fast food options.

This salon does a great job. Every time I have gotten my nails done they were beautiful. They have so many options for colors and designs and basically can do whatever you can think of. They are quite pricey so I don't go often but when I want to splurge this is where I go.

I have had Kanak Attack's food for many years now on several different occasions and decided to use them to cater for my business for a Christmas party.  The food was excellent, savory, and creative.  My employees were impressed as well.  We especially liked the Mini pork Egg Rolls and sweet pork tacos!  The main reason I'm writing this review is their customer service.  We had a dish that we ordered that wasn't quite what we expected and told the management and they were very apologetic and made it right.  You don't run into many businesses with this kind of customer service these days with quality good, value food... We will definitely be using them again!

Manager, you need to know your staff is abysmal, especially your surly hostess, who blatantly sneered us and then within earshot challenged the servers to get a tip out of us. When we asked about vegetarian options, the server was clueless, but she did say we could skip meat on any salad "but it wouldn't be any cheaper." I have rarely encountered such rude people. What is going on with your staff there? This is a beautiful restaurant, but, Boise people, avoid it at all costs.

Food was great, portions great, nice beers but the music is so loud and terrible, rap, funk, fusion.... it can only get 3 stars.  This is not a night club and from what I see it is a family establishment.  If we come back it will be for takeout.

My friend and I were roaming around Sunday and were craving something fresh and healthy. We stumbled on Revitalize while walking around the Village. The vibe was a nice big open area with a clean atmosphere. It took us awhile to decide what we wanted and ended up getting the bora bora pitaya bowl and the Boise State blue drink. The smoothie bowl was very delicious! We didn't even have to wait a long time to get it! The blue drink was very refreshing and not too sweet. We left very happy with the intentions to return sometime!
I don't know about their pizza but I know you don't don't want a Phillly Cheese steak .  terribly DRY and flavorless.  Maybe Subway can hook one up?

We are from Jordan Valley, Oregon and stopped by on our way home one evening. 
Fantastic pizza, salad and exceptional service from all staff members.
We cannot wait to go again!

We have always had great wait staff at Pinnacle, but the last two or three times we have been there we have been disappointed in the food.  This weekend I ordered sweet potato fries.  They came out completely burned crispy and black!  Not only did the kitchen staff think that was acceptable (or thought they could slip it by) but the waiter apparently didn't notice either.  The finger steaks, which are usually excellent, were also overcooked.  On our previous visit we had coleslaw which was just a cup of cabbage - someone had forgotten to put the dressing on.  We usually enjoy this restaurant, but recently there have been some issues with the food preparation which I hope will be corrected so we can continue to enjoy eating out at Pinnacle.

From the greetings at the door to the exit, you felt that they wanted you to have a good time and great food. We showed up after the lunch rush and Colby was there with a smile and determination to place us where we felt comfortable. We had 2 adults and a 1.5 year old, so positioning is key! You may assume that they were focused on the lunch transition, and maybe they were but it was transparent to us. We had some top notch food with very prompt service. Jim who was serving us gave great recommendations.  We had some of the best customer service and food recommendations that I can recall. Honestly the best customer service mixed with a a fresh  and flavorful products.
This is my favorite new spot on Eagle! Fresh fish,l and a great variety of toppings. The staff was helpful and pleasant. I hate to admit it but sushi move over.

This place is so much better than hanging out in that "Little California" area called "The Village" the food here is priced much lower than the places down the road! Heck here they may even know your name!  Great service, owner is fantastic and is willing to fix your food or drink the way you want it. Will be back often.
Love this place!! Great service and coffee! We stopped by today and the girls were exceptionally busy and they handled it perfectly! Great job gang!! I'll be back!

Old fashioned style burger...these day business trips are killers. Sit around in a plane, sit around in a meeting, sit around stuffing my face with good -ol burger and good -ol Idaho-based fries...my daily workout will have to waift, whifle, i stuffff, my face...convenniently located on the way to my client.  Viola!

First, the place is filthy. The floors are sticky, and the tables, chairs and even the entry way need attention. The bathroom was gross, and for some reason there was a very sour smell. The entire staff was teenagers, which is fine, but they don't really know how to interact with customers other than taking an order. It was a surprisingly negative impression, especially for being in such a prime location on Eagle road.

I'm not quiet sure what the bad reviews are talking about. This place was so good! I loved that I had a good amount of options for crust and toppings! By making my own pizza I was also able to make it a little healthier! Which was awesome for me. The staff was also extremely helpful. They could tell it was our first time and helped us find our best combination of sauces, crust, and toppings. Might I also just add unlimited toppings!!!! 

The pizza I got was a wheat & flax seed crust with mozzarella cheese. Half of the pizza I put the tomato sauce with pineapple and spicy pork sausage. The other half I put the basil pesto sauce with mushroom, caramelized onions, and chicken. Then topped that half off with a balsamic glaze! Both were soooo good!! The crust had the perfect crunch. 

My fiancé got a traditional crust with the buffalo sauce, mozzarella cheese, pepperoni, bacon, and the spicy pork sausage. He loved his pizza as well! 

We will definitely be returning because you can't beat $8 and all the options you get!!

I love Fast Eddys!!! The employees are consistently kind and helpful . The stores are clean and nicely done. I always find something unique to purchase. I love the
greeting cards

Food tasted gross today. This is our second time. First time was good. Chicken inside burritos tasted raw and fish smell. Our order was made by putting all raw ingredients and then micro wave for about 5 minutes. We were shocked to see our order came out so fast. We hated the food and will never go back for food we can microwave and not do anything.  Our both plates were so hot that our server did not bother telling us that " It is hot and be careful". This is ridiculous.

Stayed at the Hampton Inn and Suites in Meridian and wanted to pick up a quick delicious meal to go so I checked out Yelp to find out what's recommended.  This came up first and had good stars so my bf and I decided to give it a try.  So glad we did - absolutely delicious.  We are from Cali so we weren't sure how "authentic" the food would be but we were very impressed! It was so delicious - even better than some of the Mexican food we have back at home! 4 thumbs up!

I'm not sure what happened here. I am a pretty regular customer and about two months ago the place seem to have a huge overhaul. All the regular girls were gone - I mean it seemed like every single one doesn't' work there anymore. The new staff is great but the coffee is just terrible now. I've gone there a bunch of times and every single time it's been pretty bad. I think they need to teach the new staff how to make a latte! I can't even step in there anymore. It's too bad because I love to support local places and it's so convenient for me, but I'll have to start driving to a new coffee spot.

I just had a massage with Tanya and I have to say that it was the best massage that I've ever had!  The whole business was professional and welcoming.  I'm from out of town and visiting family on vacation, but I had such a positive experience that I'm planning on booking again whenever I'm out this way!  :-)
No flavor, Tina tacos. Very expensive. Disappointment! Came in on the promotional Saturday to try the food. Not coming back!!!!

In 2015, we purchased a Hayden Home in South Nampa.  Action Garage Door was the sub-contractor for the home's garage door.   During our warranty period we had four positive interactions.   
The first was a "user error".  The technician just needed to provide Genie opener training to a prior Lift-Master user. 
The second was a binding door.  The Technician adjusted the opener and lubricated the door.
The third was when the door suddenly stopped working.  I cancelled the service call when the opener started working normally twenty-four hours later. .  
The fourth was when the Genie opener apparently shorted out.  There were no lights or signal codes.  The Action Technician installed a new opener.  

I think that Action does a very good job with Garage Door repairs.  Going forward, we will use them again for maintenance and repairs.

Excellent little chain restaurant, on par with a handful of other good chains and serves solid, dependably edible food.

We generally get the tacos, of which I recommend steak.  They have a salsa bar that has some very good choices, I recommend the pineapple one.  Very fresh and a pretty good variety.  

The kitchen is clean and you have an expanded drink selection.  The bowls are fine but I don't think the shrimp is worth the extra cost.

Sadly was not impressed. 

Pizza was good, Mac n cheese sandwich was awful.   

Pizza- zesty red sauce, flavorful, fulfilling. Mushroom and cheese topping was good.

Sandwich - awful.  Cheese was not nice and Melty, but burnt on one side.  Sandwich was incredibly greasy. I ended up eating the Mac n cheese noodles with a fork off the sandwich, but the sandwich was horrible. 

I appreciate the staff. My drink was never empty.  Staff was friendly. 

Restaurant had a nice atmosphere. Staff was customer service oriented, friendly. 

Food was just ok.
Staff is super helpful and store looks amazing if your interested in a bike this is the place for you they also have classes if you wanna learn

The most disgusting sandwiches I have ever seen/tasted. I would be ashamed to serve these! 

If I had opened the boxes the food was in--at the drive thru-- I would have asked for a refund! 

We got home, opened the boxes. I couldn't believe they were something we paid for. They stayed in the boxes and I will be returning them today and talking with the manager!  We will NEVER return. No second chances with Freddy's... @freddysusa.com
Brian (owner) is awesome. Gelato martinis! What more do you need?! Coffee, sushi, pizza, sandwiches. He has it all. You will love this place.
Always so good, wish they were open later on the weekend but that dosent stop me from coming in all the time. I live very close and enjoy the food and the staff!

These donuts are great for more healthy treat! They are very dense cake like unlike normal donuts. You can taste the protein in some of the flavors, but they are still really good for a healthy option. I recommend the strawberry cheesecake and the Lemonade!

Sports Bar & Grill doesn't capture the true elegance of this establishment.  Yes there are big screen tv's, but skillfully placed and not obtrusive if your not a sports fan.  The atmosphere is anything but "sports bar."  More Great Gatsby/Key West feel in my view with plush, large comfortable booths and Tiffany style lighting.   The service is excellent.  The menu is very extensive, reasonable and the food quite good.  Full bar and good tap selection. I ordered the Cobb Salad which was excellent.  My date order the Fish & Chips which looked delicious. Large and lightly battered Cod filet.  I hadn't been here in a few years and forgot what a hidden treasure this place is.  I won't wait so long to go back.

Wow... great quality, fast friendly service. I went to the Nampa, ID one and I'm a fan now. I just a great burger by whether you have to commit to it or not. Meaning, if you can put it down and take a bite later... it might now be the best. This burger... oh my. Love it, love it, love it... did I mention I love it? I'm thinking it's better than 5 guys and Smashburger now.

This review is specifically to give a shout out to the manager.  Yesterday I ran into grab a couple of burritos to go.  Apparently I set my purse down while I went to the salsa bar and forgot to grab it on my way out the door with my burritos.  By the time I realized my purse was missing and searched high and low for it the restaurant had closed.  I called this morning at 9am (they don't open until 10:30am) and spoke with the manager who confirmed that I did leave the described bag in the restaurant.  I was told that he had it held safely in the office and he had not gone through it yesterday because he was waiting for me to come back.  When I went to pick up my purse today he also verified that I was in fact the proper owner (picture ID in purse) before allowing me to take it.  I am grateful that they take these steps for security purposes and I am even more grateful to have my purse bag with nothing missing.  Thank you thank you!

BTW... The burritos were delicious (as always)!  I even got one free with my stamp card :)

Atmosphere is excellent, you can sit at your table and watch the chefs prepare the food in the kitchen or watch a game on one of the many tv's. They have pizza and many other items on the menu. I enjoyed their take on the chicken pot pie although it was very rich and did not do well as a take home andreheat item. My husband and a friend ordered a pizza and really enjoyed it. We will be back!

Updating my review as I really used to like this place but having a hard time lately due to inconsistent service and quality. Not sure if management/owner change or what. Last week purchased two lattes that were ridiculously sweet. Went two nights ago had awesome lattes made perfectly. So thought hey I'm busy let me grab a latte and a breakfast burrito. Latte tastes horrible and potatoes are hard and black. No bueno!

03/19/17 - second time here and this place did not disappoint! The one downfall, the free side of refrained bean dip (w/salsa and chips) were not as warm as they were the visit visit. Other than that, it was great again. It was much busier inside which is good to see. Clean place and the staff was friendly again. 
*Husband has the carne asada super burrito (so much meat...very tasty). 
*I had a combo which consisted of a cheese enchilada and a pulled beef enchilada, both with red sauce, and black beans and Mexican rice. 
Both of us would order the same dish again, but we like trying new things. 
*You gotta try this place! For the amount, quality, and cost of what you get - this place is way better than Chappalla who has raised their prices.

WOW!! This place was fantastic! I ordered the regular bowl with 2 scoops of tuna and a scoop of shrimp. Had a variety of fresh vegetables with rice, and it was incredible. My wife and I shared the bowl, and we were both content, but I could have devoured the entire bowl myself. I will definitely go back.
This was a very pleasant visit.  I arrives as they were opening so it wasn't busy.  I enjoyed the food and the staff was great with helping me to decide what to eat.
Delish!! They have something for everyone. Carby options, low-carb, raw fish, cooked animal protein.

Hidden Gem. Gelato Cafe is yummmmmy. The Gelato is on point. Tastes like it did when I was stationed in Italy. The food is very good. Oh and one of the best parts are the martinis!!  They come with a drop of Gelato and are absolutely delicious.  This is a great compromise for the kids who want ice cream and the patents who want an equally delicious martini. Prices are great with the second Martini discounted. Very laid back atmosphere and on Monday nights they provide an open mic night for our local talents. Oh and they are open Sundays.  Great place that I would encourage all to experience.

Tiny, dinky little room set into a strip mall. Walked in not expecting much, got an underwhelming menu and then was promptly blown away once the food came. Very authentic food and their carne asada is top notch. Rice was junk, beans ok, but the seasoned and fried jalapeno that came with was spectacular, borderline awe-inspiring. Also had the shrimp diabla, which was not a high point, but passable...kinda...but that carne asada and seasoned jalapeno...more than made up for a not very comfortable atmosphere inside...I would definitely come here again and this is one of the better places I've eaten Mexican food in the last few years. Impressive flavors and when they come correct, executed to damn near perfection. This is definitely on my list of return spots.
Great food and service, today was the best, a couple new Girls doing a great job, the only thing disappointing was the cost has gone up a little, it's still a good value and love the food.

Best Tacos in Idaho. Seriously.  They are perfectly cooked and the sauces are amazing. My wife and I had them for the first time on a Friday night and drove back for Saturday lunch. Addicted. 

Also met the local owners on Saturday. Very kind people. We will keep coming back to support this local business and satisfy our taco cravings.
My favorite coffee place! I will go out of my way to stop in here for my daily coffee. The burritos and various breads they sell are also top notch. This is the way espresso was meant to be.

My husband & I have always like the food here. But tonight, we had a terrible time getting our order straight. We ordered the 3 shrimp taco dinner. We were asked how we wanted our fish cooked multiple times in spite of repeating that we wanted 3 tacos - all shrimp. She asked at least 2 other times how crispy we wanted the fish cooked. (The shrimp is grilled). She got my fajitas ok but asked several times which beans I wanted & then didn't add the drink to the bill so we ended by drinking water. But the worst part was when we were only 1/2 way through eating, they started washing the floor near us with very strong ammonia. I asked if they could just wait until we finished. Several other people nearby also expressed a problem with smell. They then started washing another area nearby leaving us with very strong odors from two sides. We had to get up & leave before finishing. Two other groups of people also left with 1/2 finished plates. When I went to the counter to tell them that was really not good to do this before people are finished eating, the manager said this is how they do it & keep the floors cleaned for us. She was very arrogant about it while they kept on cleaning.

I have been going to High Desert Harley for some time now for Service work, Parts and clothing. Always had a great experience. Recently I decided to look into trading up from my 07 FXDL. I was greeted by Steve Keitges and he showed me some great bikes. Even though I desired to not pull the trigger yet, he has been a great help and very respectful. My wife was in Christmas shopping for me and he greeted he with a smile and remembered her and helped her out. Great guy and great company.

I was very disappointed when I opened my box to see such small wings.  I ordered 10 and I got 9! They didn't offer any ranch sauce or anything. I've been to some great Wing places, and this place sucks! The wings were good though.
