Love this place! Perfect place to come for a little gift or just dessert. There isn't one I've tried that I don't like. Despite other reviews re service, we've always been pleasantly greeted and have never had any complaints.

I have eaten here three times since they opened and find this to be an excellent Mexican restaurant!  Family owned and operated the service is personal and the food has deep flavors.  Their prices are lower than what the quality demands. They seem to be building their business one customer at a time and seems to be working.   Located next to Buffalo Wild Wings this is a great place to get some great local mexican food.

First and foremost, this was probably the most pleasant experience I've ever had at any coffee place.  I'm in town visiting some family and drove all the way from San Diego.  Kensey was more then great, it was such a pleasure getting to meet her.  And Michael, who is also from SoCal, was a pleasure to talk to as well.  Delicious coffee, even better service and conversations, and you have yourself a 5 star review.  I'll be seeing you soon!

One of my favorite places to eat in Meridian. Though you do have to face the typical Village parking situation, it's worth the walk in to get some tasty Mexican fare.

I've tried quite a few different things on the menu and can say pretty confidently that you can't go wrong. I like getting 2 or 3 street tacos and usually decide to upgrade to an extra flavorings like gringa, chan chan, baja, etc. I've also had the chan chan torta and while it wasn't my favorite, I can see why people love it, as it's loaded with flavor and the portion size is plentiful. The Basque burrito is an unsung hero of the menu; one of my friends had it the last time we went and I had MAJOR food envy. That's on the top of my list for the next time we go to Calle 75 (and I'll make sure I haven't eaten for a few days, because that thing is enormous).

The ambience isn't anything spectacular; since Calle 75 is located in the middle of the Village, the eating space is shared with Rice Works and the coffee shop. Seating can be a little dicey depending on the time of day and size of your group, but it's generally not a problem. Definitely a louder environment than a normal fast casual or sit-down place because of how open the room is, and they also can make the whole place open-air when the weather gets warm enough.

You can eat for under $10 if you don't get a beverage or chips on the side. Otherwise, it'll run you just over that. I wouldn't necessarily recommend Calle 75 to an out-of-towner since it can be a little tricky to find within the Village, but to anyone who lives around here that's looking for a fast lunch spot with a lot of flavor, it's a definite win in my book!

Growing up in Caldwell my boyfriend and I were always around amazing Mexican food, my boyfriend being Mexican grew up with it. Now that we are in Boise we struggle finding a place that will cater to our taste buds and has great service! After going to the village a few times to eat here we have decided it is our go to place when we are craving some good Mexican food! The service is always really great, and they offer a fun menu.

See my last review disappeared!  I will now make sure I come back weekly to make sure everyone knows of the complete amount of disrespect we encounter here! 

If you don't like your job don't stand there with pissed off look on your face when people come in for food. We were greeted with heavy sighs and mean looks because because we came in semi close to closing. I assured the girl that we would be fast, but she didn't care, she decided to be pissed no matter what. We tried to engage in small talk and instead were met with with insults. 

I love wingstop but please do away with terrible service! Your wings are great but this makes the whole experience sour and not sweet !

Went on for lunch for the second time. While first visit was ok, this time was very good. Sat at the bar again, as it was very busy at lunchtime. Bartender seved us quickly. Had the salmon BLT with Caesar salad. Very good! Nice size portion. Will definitely be back for that sandwhich again.
Fun place! Great service! Sample to find your favorite. Grab a flight while they fill your Growler. They also do quart cans too- Many beers on tap, ciders, and kombucha choices

I took a risk and ordered a birthday cake based solely on the pun on the name. But it was phenomenal! The staff was always extremely polite and friendly when I called and always answered the phone within 4 rings. The website is very easy to use, though I don't think it does the cakes justice. I purchased a two tiered red velvet/carrot cake, and a small gluten free cake. All of the cakes were delicious! Very moist but not under baked, the perfect amount of icing that the cake as a whole wasn't over poweringly sweet. Please keep in mind this statement is true for both the regular and GF cakes. I was extremely satisfied by the entire experience. I would recommend this to any one for any occasion and I will definitely be going back!

Wife & I went there with a Groupon coupon last week. Happy hour was 4-6PM I believe. Very good prices on drinks--50% off. 

She had a Sirloin steak & I had a pulled pork sandwich. Both were very good. The free homemade potato chips were warm & delicious. Very good "sports bar" food. We will return. The total bill less than $28 + drinks + tips.
Just in town for one night - and found Gramercy Pizza&Grill.   Gotta say, the Salmon Salad was stellar!   Next visit to Boise/Meridian, I'll be back!

Nice place for a Motel 6. The location is right off the freeway so it's easy to get almost anywhere. The motel itself outside is very clean, inside though the lobby and hallways are a bit run down looking. The actual rooms though are very clean and updated (again for a motel). The maids always made sure we had fresh towels and soaps everyday, which was nice. Overall, good place to stay for cheap or if you need to stay somewhere that allows dogs.
This place is a bit difficult to find and get into the parking lot but the hipster pizza was amazing!!!

Service was great and even though it was 6:30 p.m. on a Friday night we were able to get in right away. The chips and salsa were complimentary and tasty. I ordered the three item combo plate (don't judge!) with two tacos and a tamale. The tamale was tasty and made for yummy leftovers. The taco shells got soft super fast but they brought me another. Overall I'd say the food was average and I'd probably explore other places before settling on this place as my go-to when craving Mexican.

Eeewww. Smells weird and there are hairs all over the tub, in the sink, on the toilet... My shoes are sticking to the floor. 
It has an overall modern look, but cleanliness clearly isn't priority here. 
And oh joy! EVERY FOOTSTEP! I can hear every single footstep in the room above us. Not only the footsteps, I can hear them opening the drawers like they're in the same room with me! I'm just oh so glad they're early risers! What would I do with a peaceful AM? That would just be too much on a holiday weekend. I hate this place. Also the beds had their own special smell that took about an hour to accustom myself to before I could fall asleep. That was comforting and delightful. Gross. Gross. Gross. I just keep telling myself it's cleaner than camping.

Was able to visit with the owner while I was there, super friendly! I'm not a huge coffee lover, so the awesome barista fixed the best huckleberry Italian iced soda I've ever had. My travel buddy raved about her chai tea! Will absolutely make it a point to visit again next time I am in the area!

Pretty consistent yummy food. Although the service can at times be not at 100% it's generally pretty good. It can get crowded at peak times, both the line to order and sitting area. Food is good, they give you samples if you'd like to try something new. Items with shrimp are usually a buck extra (worth it).
Greasy food, not very good taste for burgers and fries. I wouldn't recommend going there. Didn't try the dessert. Atmosphere was kinda loud and crammed. Maybe better for drive through snacks.

I had heard a lot of great things about this restaurant from friends and finally decided to try it with my son and daughter for a late lunch.  The gal waiting on us was less than friendly.  I ordered the Gyro without onions and feta and of course both were added, wouldn't usually mind if they are super busy but there was only one other table and they were finishing up so they only had to worry about the three of us.  It took 30 minutes to get our order which was basically a sandwich, gyro and pizza not a difficult order.   Although the food was good, I will give them that but I don't know if it's worth dealing with the service.

This place is AMAZING! Tianna is the best! It is super clean and professional. All the ladies are so nice and I love just being here! Also they use awesome wax! My sis in law moved here from CA and told me about this place and now I will be a forever customer!

I came here with my mom and sister one evening to see what it was all about. It was like a Wednesday evening or something so it wasn't packed with people. Maybe only up to 10 others at most. We were greeted and told to head back and wash our hands to make sure we didn't have any oils on our hands before touching the pottery. Then we were allowed to take our time and select pottery from several shelves. There are all different types including vases, boxes, dishes, statues, art to hang, etc. Some are very detailed while others are fun and simple. They're all labeled with prices so it's easy to select something in your range. I picked out a realistic looking owl sculpture. 

Once your pottery is selected you can take it back to one of the many work tables and go get your glazes. The glazes are organized in bottles and there is a nice color key so you can get a feel for what it'll turn out as after it's fired. There isn't much space so it's hard for more than maybe 2 people to be at the station at a time. In fact my mom accidentally knocked her pottery on the ground while picking out glazes because it was a tight squeeze but the staff were great about it and she just picked another piece. They could benefit from another glaze station if they can make the space for it. Once you fill your palette and get your brushes you're free to work at your own pace.

We worked for probably a few hours on our pieces. Being artsy as we are it was nice to take our time with the detailed pieces we worked on. When we were done we paid and the pieces were brought to the back so they could be fired later that week. When I went back to get the finished pieces my sister and moms pottery looked great but mine had an issue. The glaze came off in several spots which is probably from someone touching it with oily hands. They gave me a gift certificate for the price we paid for my pottery so I can go back and paint it again or paint something else instead which was really cool of them. I love this concept and I'll definitely be back!

Delicious food! The fajitas are right on! Great customer service!! Sonja was our server, and we couldn't have asked for a better server! We stopped by while on a long trip and will probably be stopping back in for lunch or dinner if we are in the area again in the future!

When I went I got a a bacon cheese burger and it was so good I had to come back and the place was almost empty. They have the coolest soda machine I have ever seen it is a touch screen machine and it has so many flavors like they had raspberry flavored coke. You have to try it.

Food is great! Had a large pizza split- low rider and peach half and half. Amazing! The gramercy bites (fried pizza dough with homemade sauces and garlic/Parmesan)... Just wow! Awesome happy hour drinks with Ben as the bartender. This place is a must-go!!!

gluten free friendly place (the only thing gluten is the buns so steer clear of those and you are good). kind of messy eating one of their burgers wrapped in lettuce. Fries are good but can be a bit greasy. Go for the cajun fries, nice little kick.

My favorite place to stop by for a coffee on the way to work or when I'm running errands. The drinks is always good and they are priced fair. I like the fact that if you order an iced drink they put the amount of liquid you paid for in a bigger cup with the ice, so you aren't paying for ice! I've never seen another coffee place do this and I always feel cheated, or if you ask for less ice they try to charge you more. The people who work here are always super nice and make small talk while you are waiting for your drink. The only think I don't like is that in the afternoon it's flooded with annoying kids from the close by high school and junior high and they get in the way thinking they are all cool and what not, ugh!
Really good food. The free entree with comment coupon is a rip off. Egg roll is not an entree; it is an appetizer. Otherwise, a good value for your money.

Really pretty good basic Mexican food from a hole in the wall. I got the veggie burrito, which was not on the menu, but was very tasty and basic. It had broccoli carrots until beans rice etc. Well flavored and I ate it all. When I'm in the Boise area again, this will be on my shortlist when wanting Mexican.
The core needs a little bit to be desired, but that is why it's called a hole in the wall

We are wingstop junkies from Arizona. We always look up wingstop when we travel.... we were so excited when they opened one up here since we live down the road.  I hate to say it but we have given them quite a few chances and every single time we have been disappointed. We were the only people in here and we waited 30 minutes for our food, and when we finally got them the fries were dry and over cooked.  From the looks of it there is only 1 employee here. How awful for her and this place that could have done amazing things.

Wife found this place on the old innerweb.  The waitress (Nicollet) was super friendly and did a great job. The food was excellent and for a reasonable price.  Happy hour specials were good.  I would give this place a better score than five stars.

Bought my token shirt!  Bought my token token! It doesn't matter how many of these stores I go into, I love them all! Harley 'stuff.' Usually buy my leather at leather up.com, my road bells at rude dog.com; but I must have some Harley paraphernalia or my fix need won't be fixed. Some woman who lives with me and won't ride, hates the shirts with women on them. If I don't have a woman behind me on the bike, I NEED one on my shirt. Oh well. She bought--no woman on my shirt. I imagine riding each of the bikes. I imagine wearing the leather; new leather with leather smell; new helmet; new wom...well, not that! If you are motivated by a walk-thru in a Harley franchise, you are not an American, and are heartless. And should Not Be allowed on a Harley. Well, unless you are soundly and righteously converted. When I bought my Harley (Buddy Stubbs-Phoenix) my wife said she wouldn't ride. She said, "There are plenty of Navajo women where you're working; find one of them." I found a couple and they are fast friends. We rode a lot. On my Harley. Awesome! I have made three stops here at High Desert in two days. Addictive. I think I need a new bike and another for my daughter who loves riding. Stop here! Buy here! Support High Desert!

I am always looking for ways to trim expenses without compromising quality and Fudds does that for our family of seven. We can get great burgers or salads (or grilled cheese for the kids), top everything off the way we want and we don't have to spend the 20% surcharge to tip a server. For great service, I don't mind paying that additional expense but more often than not, we end up waiting for someone to come and fill our drinks or get us more Ketsup. Some people may not like self-serve but I prefer that to waiting for sure. And the .99 hand-scooped ice cream cone as we leave is always a hit.
Got a lot of arts n crafts, cute stuff for the house. I've always been a fan of Michael's very similar!

We loved this place!  We're from California, so we have pretty high standards for good, authentic Mexican food.  Mi Casa exceeded our expectations!  Food is fresh, drinks are always full, and the made-to-order guacamole is the best we've ever had!  Everyone here provided an excellent experience from the moment we walked in.  Definitely worth the time and a little drive from Boise if you want good Mexican food!

Katelyn M saves the day!   Oh my goodness she was amazing! I literally cannot say enough good things about her and that store!   Century Link was a horrible experience but AT&T was great!  I recommend anyone to go see Katelyn and team.  Katelyn quickly addressed my needs and found the perfect hotspot solution for my family!   Thank you Katelyn!

The special tonight was lobster Mac and Cheese with Brie which was decedent!! We also had the Chicken Pot Pie which was great and the sammich was good as usual. Is highly recommend checkin this place out. Service is always good as well. Oh, they have great drinks (beers and cocktails) as well!

I love Cold Stone!  We used to go all the time when we lived in Los Angeles and I was excited to get my Mud Pie Mojo during our visit to Boise.  The ice cream was as good as usual but I have to say we COULD NOT eat inside the store.  My 4yr old had never been to a Cold Stone and he was excited to go.  The first thing he said when we entered was "this place smells disgusting".  I had to agree.  It literally smelled like a mix of sweaty hockey pads, vomit and a public bathroom on a hot day.  WOW!  I was getting sick while waiting in line.  Somehow I persevered, got my ice cream and found a table outside to sit at.  When my son needed to use the restroom my husband and I had to Roshambo to see who would take him.  My husband lost so I can't give you details on the bathroom but my husband looked a little pale when he came back!!

Update: My husband said the bathroom was a bit of a sanctuary from the stench in the store...

This is a new drive-thru Starbucks. So far, while a "cozy" location, it does have a good amount of seating for its size. There's outdoor, patio seating as well as bar, table and chair, comfy chairs, and a long rectangular table with seating. The staff is friendly and they made my drink well. I'm always glad to see the opening of a new Starbucks and I bet it'll be a well-used location in no time.

The staff is friendly and efficient.  Short wait.  Basic equipment is outdated.  Chairs in the examination room filthy.  Can't tell what color filthy.  Not good.  Doctor was good.  Good thing I'm from out of state.  4 stars.  A medical facility should be clean.
Amazing food and service. The burgers were juicy and flavorful. The fries and thin and delicious. Great customer service and a fun family place to eat.

Not impressed, overpriced, salty and burnt partty...not sure the beef should be deemed "steak" quality.  There are much better burger choices out there and I don't see this place lasting too long...pumpkin concrete was the only thing that was any good.

I visited Calle 75 Street Taco during a trip to Boise. As a native Texan, I am quite familiar with "gourmet tacos" and burritos (á la Torchy's Tacos, Freebirds Burritos).

I had the Green Pig and was quite impressed with it. There was a nice balance of pulled pork, verde sauce, avocado cream, rice, and beans: overall, flavorful without being incendiary, not too dry or too drippy and of a nice consistency. 

The ingredients were of high quality and fresh. 

If I am back in this neck of the woods, I will visit again!

I enjoyed this place because i didnt want something heavy for lunch and this fit the bill. The fish tasted fresh and i felt like I was eating a sushi bowl. The price is a tad much but i felt like i got a good amount of fish. Will go again for a lunch spot
Great food and atmosphere. Loved both the Italian grinder and Reuben. Can't wait to come back.

I grew up in Houston eating tacos and Mexican and Tex-Mex was just life. Does it make me an expert, by no means, but I do know good Mexican.  When I moved to Meridian the first thing I did as far as eating out, was look for a good Mexican place.  Mi Casa was it!  They aren't the best I've ever had but how can you be when its almost impossible to find fajita in any of the stores. They where good though, some of the other mexican places boiled their fajitas....disgusting, not Mi Casa fresh off the grill mmmm. My only complaint is that  Mi Casa is kinda pricey too, about 60 bucks for a family of 5. They do bring out an enormous platter of food ...I mean it was basically a hubcap with food on it... so you could probably have a kid share with another one and still have leftovers.  We always do.  Really if you want good mexican this is on of the few places id suggest.

My husband works right next door to GPPG, so he's been eagerly anticipating the opening. I love how they opened up the interior with the rows of booths in the middle. No liquor license yet (I don't drink beer or wine), but one word to the manager and he had hard cider ordered from then on! This is right around the corner from my house, so we go often when we can afford. I have yet to have a bad meal. The pot roast literally melts in your mouth. The Mac & Cheese Sammich (yep, Sammich!-love it!) is indescribably amazing. Oh, the dessert dough-balls are a MUST have. I'll go for those alone. Why 4-stars? A bit hard to get a seat on a weekend (good for them!), a bit loud and the service is a bit slow, and the parking can be a bear. But SO worth it!

The atmosphere is good to relax and have a good quick bite to eat. Wanting a quick treat the breakfast taco caught our eye. With your choice of meat, type of egg on a taco it was a very well done taco. If you're expecting authentic Mexican tacos this isn't quite your place but for a "Mexican Fusion" restaurant it's tasty! I'd come here again!

By far the best street tacos in the Boise area!  I go there regularly and if you like grilled fish tacos (or any other types) this place rocks.  Can take a while to get your food but it is always warm and tasty.  Only negative thing I can say is that not all of your cooks are as good as some of them but I always leave happy.   Burritos are good too!
Good service and great food. Carnitas burrito is our absolute favorite!! Definitely family friendly so take your kids!!
Best smoothies in town.  They also sell healthy wraps and other snacks...I like the variety better than Jamba Juice.

I probably would've given a 3 1/2 stars but my husband really liked it so will get it 4!!
There jalapeño was awesome though Crne  Asada it was real good --we had the mi Casa plate it's so big to people could eat it!!
I really think they're very special hot sauce is yummy taste like chocolate and cherries and then it kicks your ass with heat!

Costs more than it should but very delicious. Also, the customers are dumb messy animals who should be left in cages. Place was absolutely filthy when I visited but I blame the masses. And management for being greedy and not hiring more help.

Wow! What a great place! Refried beans and two kinds of salsa with your chips is a fabulous idea! The chicken avacado soup is very tasty! We had chile relleno and crab enchiladas! You hit it out of the park! Friendly staff! Tvs! great music too!
I seriously crave Relic Pizza once a week. If you love TRUE NYC pizza... This is your place. Don't know what to get? Order a JR with ricotta. It will blow your mind.

The best place in Meridian to get your beer. I love how the owners put on events and allow people who don't live near Downtown Boise to have something this cool to call their own. Staff is friendly and lets you try before you buy. Definitely a great business!

We love coming in to Gramercy. My husband and I can enjoy a nice drink while the kids can get a fancy drink as well. The pizza is the best. My daughter loves the clams. No complaints and the food is always great and we never have leftovers.
The level of incompetence at this store if off the charts. Missing ingredients, stale bread, missing food all together. It's a mess. You're better off saving your money and skipping a meal.
Fresh burger, awesome drink selection, fun arcade for kids. And you can't beat the  $.99 ice cream cone!  Prices are a bit high but acceptable.

I am a new patient of Shauna Lacow.  I left her office feeling like a weight had been lifted off my shoulder.  I finally met someone who treats their patients with kindness and understanding and was very thorough.  She listened to my questions and concerns and took her time discussing the causes and treatment.  I didn't feel rushed and wasn't dismissed easily.  I highly recommend her.   
The front office and nurses in the lab are fantastic.  Very kind and quick to assist.  I also didn't feel like I waited long to be seen which is a huge plus. 
I am extremely grateful that I found Meridian Family Medicine.
Amazing place! Had the salmon &fried spinach. Loved the salmon, but the spinach, wow! Absolutely delicious. The food, menu, crew & ambience spot on. Can't wait to go back & try the pouring.

Waitress was nice although only checked on us once. Food came out cold. My husband had eggs Benedict and I had turkey melt. Nothing like cold hash browns. Turkey melt was lukewarm and had too much mayo and very little turkey! Curly fries were not hot, tasting or temperature wise.

This place is fantastic! The food was delicious (I would give it an 8 out of 10 for Tex-Mex) and the servings sizes were enormous. The staff was incredibly friendly and helpful - they were so friendly, I would go back there for the service alone. I had sopés (something I rarely find on menus outside of Mexico) and my husband had a combination plate (the chile relleno was fabulous). 

They bring salsa and refried beans with the chips, YUM. The salsa is mild but you can ask for the spicy stuff as well. If you choose to do this, BEWARE! The spicy salsa is SUPER spicy. The whole dining experience was excellent. Highly recommend!

Best Mexican food in the area, hands down! The portions are more than generous, and the prices were average. The Chile rellenos are the best I've had in years. The Carne asada tacos were amazing. All of our kids were happy, too. There are many Mexican restaurants closer to us, but we will drive past them every time now to come to Mi Casa! Service was fast and friendly as well. We are going to be telling all our friends and family about this place.

Great drinks and decent service  but unfortunately the food was a poor excuse for Mexican food. My pacifico burrito was comparible to cat food paste don't order it unless you like dissapointments... and cat food. My wife's chimichanga was like a wet sock. Chimichanga's  are supposed to be crispy/crunchy not floppy/soggy. Anyone who likes the food here doesn't know  Mexican food.
Due to great customer service this place is a Walmart killer. Prices are higher here but the service wins out in my book.

Had my first pizza from Relic yesterday, wasn't all that impressed. Seems like any ordinary pizza, nothing really special. Had a $2 off coupon so we gave it a try. $15 for a 1 topping large pizza is a little much. Won't make a special trip for Relic pizza without a coupon.
I just moved to the area and the transfer of my yearly pkg was so easy. And Trianna is the best! Very Very Pleased!

Great staff!! On POINT customer service!! Great coffee!! You can't go wrong!  I love the iced caramelizer, if you like sweet coffee try it! My kids love their hot chocolate. I really appreciate how their coffee doesn't have a harsh bitter taste. The experience of Dutch Bros from start to finish it definitely 5 stars.

This place is amazing!  Great burgers and fries. They have fry sauce to dip your fries in. I'm addicted already!  If you want a great dessert try their custard. The texture is out of this world and it taste unbelievable!  The people were very friendly. I will definitely be coming back.

I like this place a lot! They offer a lot of dairy free options which is great for me because my daughter is lactose intolerant. Their smoothies are definitely refreshing and not overly sweet, if you don't want them to be. I like that because sometimes I just want a healthy smoothie instead of something packed with sugar!

3.5 stars

Prices could be lower.

Sweet coke machine!

Polite service. All their silverware was empty and I had to wait about 5 minutes for a fork!?!? Someone dropped the ball on that because they weren't busy at all.

Warm cheddar dipping sauce & jalepeno cheddar sauce dispensers for dipping fries! Cool!

Fries luke warm when handed out :/
Husband liked the fries they are soft and more potato like. Aka (Jo-Jo style)
I like mine crispy and was not a fan.

The topping bar is great for being able to customize your burger exactly how you like.

Samurai burger- red robin is better ... But the pineapple was fresh ... Teriyaki sauce was good not great but overall tasty and enjoyable. 

Kobe burger- fantastic beef especially for having them cook it well done (I'm pregnant) very filling! 

Side salad- not bad or good

Music on the louder side! Cute eclectic decor throughout, clean, and casual. Tons of tables and good for large groups! Also, they have some arcade games for the kiddos!

Well, you pay for quality, I will say that. I've gotta some baking dishes, towels, and some kind of noodle making contraption here and it has all worked out great. The stuff here is quality, but dang if it isn't expensive. But quality and buy once as they say. They have everything your kitchen needs and also some bar stuff.

Buns that leave your hands stinking until you Gojo them. The seasoned fries were ridiculously seasoned & the flavor just wasn't good. ambiance... well... It is like eating at a plaid walled Costco, less the people.

Bike had a flat, so I rolled into Meridian Cycles right after opening time on a Saturday morning.  They had my tube replaced and me back on the road in less than fifteen minutes.  Sometimes a review is just straight to the point.  Meridian Cycles got the job done right, got it done quick, and everyone in the shop was friendly while I waited.  Not much else to say except if you need a quick bike repair in Meridian, these guys will do you right.

Just moved to Meridian from San Diego and had to find out where to get my craft beers.  I passed by this place a number of times and finally got a chance to stop in today.  This is what you want if you just love beer.  They had everything I wanted to see and many others I will be back to try.  I believe it was Josh at the helm today and he provided excellent, knowledgeable service!  

Thank you The Growler Guys, I will be back many many more times!

I think this will be our last visit. They've committed the ultimate food error. Unseasoned bland food and letting food sit under the heat lamps for approximately 10 min. We sat at the bar and timed how long the food sat there. Apparently 1 cook was fast and the other absent.  It's a shame because we used to like coming here.

Yes, I've had the pleasure of visiting In n Out, 5 Guys regular, Boise Fry Company fan. So what do I think of Freddy's? Their steak burgers beat In n Out's tiny dry bun burgers, animal style or not, hands down. Get the California burger with all the fixings, trust me (-;
Always a Home Run....And we love the sides.  Service is aways on point!  Kids love the garlic parm and we like BBQ and original hot.

I do not understand the low rating for this pizza place!?!

This is my go to for ordering pizza when my wife or I are to lazy to cook.

Pizza is good and delivery is fast and efficient.
They also have online ordering which I love!!
Lovin' this place! Great beer list, reasonable prices, friendly service, and a super cool digital tap system. Get here!
Great food and service. Beer selection is wide if average. Less micro brews than I thought for idaho but there it is. Cool place. Check it out.

This apt feels luxurious, fresh, new and truly like a small home. I have owned homes and rented apts in my last 18 years and this place is my favorite rental! We moved to ID and didn't know where to buy, so we rented the 2 bdrm, 2 bath apt. It has been great and with WiFi and TV included in the price, its a steal! Close to the Village shopping and food and coffee galore, FG is a place to call home and convieniant living! Plus if you are new to the area, Boise is 10 minutes away to the heart of downtown.. Take a look and see if you feel as happy as I do:)

This morning I came to five guys for the first time and my experience was more then satisfactory. The blonde girl with the black glasses took my order and was very helpful with the menu and never stopped smiling even though I asked too many questions. My food came out quickly and the burger was juicy and fantastic. I will defiantly be coming back to this restaurant again. Way better then any in - n - out I've ever had.

Ordered a Ruben sandwich. There was only meat on half the sandwich. I ate the good side and left the empty side. When the waitress (with all the tats up and down her arms) ask about it I told her she shrugged and did nothing. Basically I got half a sandwich and paid for a whole one. Kind of lame.

I recently purchased a motorcycle there. The sales staff is great. Customer service was on point. Upon leaving the dealership, I was run into and my bike was damaged. I brought it back to the dealership, the people that ran into me paid for the repairs and everything was good. High Desert called me after the people who hit me had paid for the repairs. They told me it would be a 5 week wait for the parts. The bike is still rideable, so I went to pick it up until the parts came in. I stopped in at the service department, told them who I was and they said they would have my bike washed and out to me. I waited for an hour and a half. At that time, the service writer who was handling my repair came back and I asked what the status of my bike was. It was still upstairs and hadn't been washed. After two hours of waiting, I finally got my bike. Fast forward to 7 weeks after I left and the parts still haven't come in and no one knows where they are at.

Quite possibly the best Mexican food I've had in the states!!  My boyfriend and I shared the Mi Casa Plate and the El Molcajete and were blown away by the portions and the quality of the dishes. We dine out quite a bit and this is one of the best meals we've had since moving to Boise. Definitely a new staple in our repertoire! The service was absolutely on point as well!! Even though it was late on a Tuesday night, the server was kind and appropriately attentive. Just beware the grilled jalapeños! I love heat, but one bite nearly ruined my experience. Thankfully, there were plenty of beans to heal me up. If that's your thing, dig in; otherwise, just put those beauties off to the side, take a sip off your margarita and prepare for a delectable feast.

I was not impressed. I've definitely had better. The meat was sweet and a very mushy consistency. Wasn't feeling all that great after eating only half my meal. My elderly mother was not warned about the extremely hot plate and left without finger prints! Her plate was dangerously hot when I tried to help her.

First time at Fudruckers, it was actually very good. I had the chipotle burger and sweet potatoes fries, my mom had the dogzilla. I like the huge section of toppings and sauces to fix it up just to your liking. Great service. Bathroom was very clean as well.

Just stopped here for dinner tried to order a pizza with ham and mushroom. Was told they don't do ham on pizza here but I could have spam instead. Very odd!!

Did enjoy the gramercy bites. Recommended


Alternative pizza should be the name

Great service.
I have been in the market for new patio furniture and went to Big Lots in Meridian to see what the had. The display was nicely arranged and staff helped me shuffle pieces around and measure lengths. I decided to purchase the Sonoma collection and the cashier,  Brittany, was on the ball making sure the storeroom had all the components of the collection prior to ringing up the items. The gentleman working the storeroom, Omar, really went above and beyond helping me load and secure the heavy boxes in my truck. Terry the manager also reviewed my receipt to ensure the discounts on the collection and the friend/family discounts were applied.  I will defiantly be shopping here again soon.

I hesitated to rank this pizza but as Pizza is what they do....how can ANY pizza establishment NOT be able to make a good taco pizza???  It is so easy with taco sauce, some good meat, some cheese, lettuce and some chips on top after cooking....and include a little jalapeño???  We got one yesterday.....IT was terrible!!!!   Chicago Connection needs an over-haul!!!
Tacos were delicious and ready quick. Cashier and cooks were friendly and talked to us the entire time, suggesting different sauces, toppings, etc to try out. Love this place.

Ambiance: industrial meets victorian meets modern meets Idaho! Relaxed yet nice :)

Service: Friendly greeting and we were seated immediately. Waitress was pleasant and did a good job. I do wish drink refills would have been more on point. Food came out fast and so did our ticket :) overall nice experience! 

Food: 
Idaho Cheesesteak Melt was filling, had good flavor but I felt something was missing. I wouldn't order again. 

House salad very fresh! Tried the vanilla basil dressing and the ranch dressing! Was surprised how much I enjoyed the flavor of the vanilla basil dressing! Ranch was okay.

Fries were better than average according to my husband and fry sauce was good but not the best he has had. 

Mac and Cheese Sammy had good flavor nice and cheesy just too much carbs lol we wouldn't order again.

Our ticket was only $21 before tip not too bad! Will be back to try more of their enticing menu! I got so full I was sad I didn't get to try the Apple dessert! 

Ps... We sat next to the kitchen and they were all wearing gloves which was nice to see! Also they were upbeat!

So good. Came on a whim and left a believer. I've gone for lunch and dinner and both times had the grilled Mac and Cheese Sammy. I'm still thinking about it- it was so delish. Fries are great and side salad is better than anywhere out there; complete with egg and bacon. The comment about the pricing below is insane; my dinner was $8.95. You can barely get out of a fast good joint at that price. Service both times for me was above par as well.

Made my first trip to Mi Casa a couple of days ago, the food was good and the portions are large which is in line with the price. Had the carna asada tacos with rice and beans. Their salsa has a little bit to be desired, not all that good, tasted like watered down tomato sauce with a few pieces of onion and chiles. The staff was friendly and the service was prompt. I will go back again.

I have eaten at many poke places before and I am giving only two stars for a few reasons. Firstly I find it hard to believe that the owners here cannot provide a bowl that is not "to go" even when you dine in.  The bowl is much too small and even trying to eat out of it becomes messy because everything from the top falls out.  They need a bigger bowl that they wash and put back out into circulation.  Not to mention that every time you dine in you end up putting a plastic bowl, lid, and fork into the trash.  I guess they don't care about the environment.  Also the wasabi can be diluted into a sauce instead do you don't have to hide a glob of glob the bowl to find half way through your meal.  I also think they can be more generous with the fish.  I think this place needs improve their fish portion and change their bowls out before I visit again.

SUPER DELICIOUS! The staff is very friendly too. Maybe they will have different fresh toppings to choose from? We also had the wonton soup it was so Yummy. We left feeling very full. We are definitely coming back!

I would give Calle Street Tacos TEN stars if that was an option!  My husband and I have fallen in complete LOVE with these street tacos and I think we had at least four date nights in a row where we would go to the Village and sit outside during the warm summer nights and order like twelve street tacos and just sit for hours talking and munching on the most incredible tacos, and then we'd finish the night with a sweet cinnamon roll right next store at Cinnaholic. The meats in these tacos are amazing with so much flavor and we love ordering a good variety of creating our own and also trying to more popular options on the menu. If you are a fan of street tacos, want your life changed for the better and live in the Boise or Meridian areas, this place is worth checking out. Like I said; we are in love! If there has ever been a restaurant that has totally stolen my heart and run with it, it is this! I can't get enough

We have eaten here twice since my last review and I wish I could give 10 stars. This place is awesome. The people and the food is outstanding. Everything ordered by myself and the rest of my party every trip here has been so good. 

Current favorite restaurant in all the valley for the options and the consistency!!
Nice big grocery store. Like the wide aisle, pleasant lighting and freshness of produce. Nice selection of products too. My go to supermarket

I hesitated to rank this pizza but as Pizza is what they do....how can ANY pizza establishment NOT be able to make a good taco pizza???  It is so easy with taco sauce, some good meat, some cheese, lettuce and some chips on top after cooking....and include a little jalapeño???  We got one yesterday.....IT was terrible!!!!   Chicago Connection needs an over-haul!!!

I thank u for response BUT we had no lettuce....almost NO meat or cheese and no chips of any kind....  I asked for jalapeños and did not get any....truly this pizza was almost just crust with a few tomatoes...
BuT I appreciate yr response...

Ordered a #8 and which had a single steak burger (order 117) and found a small hard sharp piece of white  plastic in one of the bites. I approached the cook staff, asked them what it could possibly be to which I was told "it looks like a piece of plastic had chipped off of one of their cutting boards". He said "sorry about that".  After that, my kids wanted custard, and although I was a little deterred by the plastic in my food I went ahead and ordered 2 concretes. I asked for the turtle to have no pecans as I have an intolerance. I know that they have posted everywhere in the restaurant that some orders may be contaminated by nuts but I was surprised to find a large quantity of pecans in my concrete.  When I approached the register to explain I was met with an annoyed glare and a "sorry about that, do you want me to remake it?" "Yes. Sure. Please do". I thought I will give it to my kids seeing that now I've had plastic and pecans in my food and I'm no longer hungry. When it was remade it was made as a hurried sundae with caramel spilling down the side, not a concrete as originally ordered. I didn't say anything this time and left with my mess of a sundae. While the food is good minus the plastic and pecans I don't think this restaurant runs very cleanly.
Very very good...The only reason why I gave it 4 stars is because of the price. 2 tacos for $6 is a bit expensive. Other than that it was very tasty. I would recommend. sodas are overpriced

Not just another pizza joint!! I had a super good experience from the moment I walked in.  The local owner and his team went above and beyond.  The pizza was great and the store was clean and new.  Well done Relic!!

My favorite burger joint in town. Cajon fries are a must. You get so much, get one for two ppl and if you have leftovers, heat up the next day. Only fries you can reheat and still tastes wonderful. 
Wish they had a whole wheat bun. White bun gets soggy a bit but keeps with low key burger theme. 
Can order ahead for pickup. Wonderful and. Convenient

Sheer serendipity to be shopping in this strip mall for window shades and spy Gelato Cafe.  Feeling parched given the heat of the day and peckish given it was late afternoon, we popped in to peruse the potables.  The Italian Lemonade on the big menu behind the counter caught our eye.  Better still, the very friendly owner manning the same asked if we'd like to sample the gelato.  Delicioso!   

DON'T MISS IT...ITALIAN LEMONADE WITH GELATO
Noting one could get a 16oz Italian lemonade with a scoop of gelato of one's choice, we opted for a scoop of the perfectly tart-sweet lime gelato.  Served in tall to go cup with ice and a straw it was about as perfect a summer beverage as either my hubby or I could imagine.  At $2.85 it seemed a really good price to us too.  Big enough to share, and we did, we both agreed it was so good that next time we stop for one of these it will be for one each.  

GELATO MARTINIS...NO KIDDING
We may also stop in some evening to try the shop's Gelato Martini's.  I kid you not. They make them in a host of creative combinations.

THE MENU
While I'm disinclined to restaurants that don't "pick a lane and drive in it" and this menu was all over the road with Pizza, Sushi, Sandwiches and even Gyro's included, our beverage was so good and the owner so friendly that we'll give it a try for lunch or dinner eats sometime too.

THE DRILL
Order at the counter.  I assume it is subsequently delivered to your table as a nice woman inside working on her laptop ordered a Martini and it was delivered to her.  Our lemonade was to go.

THE VIBE
The ambiance with spartan tables and chairs and two TVs on the wall is not going to win design awards.  But there are standard height tables in the main for seating (woo hoo...my days of wanting to perch on high stool to eat  or dirnk are in the rear view mirror) and the tables are arranged with room between them so no sense of being a sardine in a can here.  I also think there may be outdoor seating.  Overall this reads "all are welcome", neighborhood casual and that's a good thing.

THIS N THAT:

1) PARKING:  The strip mall lot has about 75 parking spaces.

2) ACCESSIBILITY:  Accessible parking at each end of the mall sidewalk.  Cafe is level in and throughout. Several tables with standard height seating.

3) GELATO TIPS: Aside from the luscious lime, the salted caramel is a fantabulous flavor and they have huckleberry gelato too.  Were I to read a crystal ball I'd see many calories contributed to my future.

4) FOOD SENSITIVITIES:  For my friends who are lactose intolerant, some of these gelato (many fruit flavors) are dairy free.
The service is always friendly, the food is good, and they let usnwatch Battlebots on the big screen on Sunday night's!!! I love this place!!!!!

Simple burgers and fries. Pricier than In and Out.(Sorry, I'm an Arizona transplant) It is what it is and the review is based off of "fast food burgers" I like "Big Judds" as the better, local option.

Came in close to closing but was met with exceptional service. I thought it would be your standard pizza bar but to my surprise it was phenomenal. The service topped it off. Every team member had a smile and seemed genuinely happy to be there.
Excellent food and service! I had the Philly cheese steak sandwich 8.5 out 10.  The beer selection has everything you need.  This is my go to place.

I was a maid of honor for my best friends wedding. I was so excited to have the food she raved about. 

They were punctual which is critical in such occasion. The display was professional and easy to access for a party of over 100 people buffet style. I had to talk to the guy (I wish I remembered his name!) to discuss when he would be set. He was super friendly! He always ensured when a dish platter was done a new one was set. Honestly, not having to worry about the food was such a relief!

We had a salad, 2 dressing choices, grilled veggies, fried rice, pulled pork and chicken teriaky. Each item was sooo tasty. Everyone seemed to have enjoyed it. From the bridal party perspective it was great. 

I wish we had their food truck and catering services back in Las Vegas! Highly recommend!

I had a mini chocolate cake with white icing. It was insanely sweet and no different than something you'd get in a grocery store bakery. Just sugar, sugar and more sugar with no real chocolate or cocoa flavor.

This place is bomb! I'd say it's the most underrated place in Meridian. The service is awesome, the food is great and it has an awesome atmosphere. Pizza, salad, sandwiches are all awesome. Josh Hardy, our bartender/waiter is hilarious, always remembers your favorites, and really makes the whole experience. Would definitely recommend this place!

This is a nice, unpretentious environment to relax and enjoy a well deserved massage.  Kimberly spent just the right amount of focus on my sore areas and I always felt comfortable.  I've scheduled my third massage and would highly recommend her services.

If your allergic to seafood don't go here. They fry everything (even the chips) in the same oil. They cross contaminated-we told them after we ordered shrimp(not knowing) and refused the plate and let them know he would have to go to the hospital if he had any kind of shrimp-very allergic. Even though we didn't eat any seafood within an hour my boyfriend had a severe--almost fatal reaction!!! Mi Casa wouldn't even replace his EPI pen ($130) they said we should have told them the allergy before we ate the chips. Whatever....pretty lame for almost killing a person.

Driving from Dallas TX to Central Oregon, we stopped for an early bite to eat and decompress for half an hour after an all-night drive from western Wyoming on Sunday, September 4th, 2016. We visited just after 6am, and the store was clean, and the staff was friendly and alert, and the food was made correctly and tasted like it would from any McDonald's store across the country. 

No major complaints other than the hand soap in the restrooms does not clean hands well. 

The location has an updated exterior and well lit interior. 

I would consider revisiting this location should the planets align and I find myself in Meridian again whilst requiring a recharge.

Dear denizens of the Treasure Valley,

I am happy to say that authentic Mexican cuisine is here.  As a long time resident of the desert Southwest, I can safely say I have a lot of experience with Mexican food.  At its best, it is far more than tacos and burritos.  Of course those are good too, but if you have yet to experience a good mole or crema... oh my goodness are you missing out.  Our area may not be known for great Mexican food, and I'm sure there are other hidden gems I've yet to experience, but I can say without hesitation that if you want an amazing and authentic Mexican experience... look no further than Mi Casa in Meridian.

Let's get the downsides out of the way first so I can gush about all the great stuff.  It is a small restaurant in a strip mall near a big medical complex.  This presents a few problems.  The first is parking.  Finding a spot relatively close to the restaurant itself can be difficult, especially if you go for lunch.  The second problem is that it IS a pretty small place and not very suitable for large parties.  We have three small children and need two high chairs to seat us all.  There was really only one table in the restaurant that was suitable for us.  That said, they were very accommodating and did everything they could to seat us comfortably, but just note that if you have a large party or many children, things may be a bit tough.

Ok, so on to the awesome!  First, this place is authentic.  What do I mean by that?  The atmosphere, the food, the staff... they all make you feel like you are in a little Mexican kitchen in the Sonoran desert.  And I know, because I lived there!  This isn't the "Tex-Mex" vibe you get at On The Border or some place like that.  You know this place is the real deal.  

Second, the staff is awesome.  Now the staff is small... so when the place gets hopping, the service does slow down, but I don't hold that against them because they are certainly not "slacking off" and homemade food just takes time to prepare.  So if you go at a peak time, like say lunch hour, things may be a bit slow.  But if you accept that going in, and enjoy free chips and salsa... it isn't really an issue.  The staff is also very friendly, and very knowledgeable about the menu and items.  I was torn between two items and mentioned this to our server.  She without hesitation recommended one of the dishes I mentioned and so I picked that one.  Needless to say she was absolutely right and the food was fantastic.

Which brings us to the food.  In a word........ awesome.  Everything we ate was fantastic.  The complementary chips and salsa also come with some refried bean dip, which is a great touch and also outstanding.  The salsa itself is a little too mild for my personal taste, but your opinion may vary.  We also got some queso dip that had chorizo sausage and it was great.  The sausage was flavorful without being too spicy.   My wife ordered a soup with chicken and avocado and liked it very much.  She loves avocado but appreciates it "plain," not mashed into guacamole.  I ordered chicken in a crema sauce and it was amazing.  As I noted, our server recommended this dish as a specialty of the house and it did not disappoint.  I practically licked my plate getting every drop of the sauce.  We got a hamburger for our son, and yeah you don't go to a Mexican place for burgers... but he devoured the whole thing.  So the food is "toddler endorsed" also.

Bottom line folks, there is great Mexican food in the Treasure Valley.  Next time you're in the mood for something a bit more than Tex-Mex, head to Mi Casa in Meridian.  You will not be disappointed.
Eh Fred Meyer isn't so bad,but they could use more deals?

So pleased with my visit here! We just moved here from California and I needed to find a new place center for eyebrows and Brazillian waxing. I called and spoke with Alyssa, she was able to get me an appointment in less than an hour for the same day! She was super friendly and informative on the phone and when I met her upon arrival. The facility looks very clean and professional with a nice display of products they sell. Tara was the person who took me back and did the waxing Magic! She cleaned up my eyebrows and made them amazing again! Normally I would get them threaded in Ca since waxing used to be painful for me, but with the hard wax they use and their special formula wax it didn't hurt AT ALL. She took the time to try two different color brow powders on my eyebrows afterwards to give me the best choice of products. I thought that was wonderful customer service to really go the extra mile to make sure whatever color I chose for my eyebrows was what I liked. She did a wonderful job with my Brazillian wax, she's very easy to talk to and made it a very comfortable experience. Like I mentioned, the wax is GREAT, and didn't hardly hurt at all (I've had some horrible experiences in California!!) she had the wax done in less than 10 minutes which is perfect if you're in a hurry. She took the time to tell me every single product used on my eyebrows and my lady parts and gave recommendations and informed me of the benefits of all their products. Couldn't pass up the buy two body polishes get one free promotion!! I will definitely be returning to Tara! Let her know Ashley sent you! Alyssa took her time to inform and explain the different promotions and offers that they offer to help save you money in the long run. I will definitely be joining their member plans as I can see myself returning regularly! Thank you again ladies for such a pleasant visit!

I am a small business owner and send a lot of thank you gifts to my vendors.  My husband and I came into the store on 03/31/16 at 4:30 to buy 3 bundt cakes for delivery and some bundtletts for our family as a treat which would have been a $200.00 order.  I was requesting 2 bundt cakes be delivered to a few banks that were located within 3 miles of this business.  I was told that they could deliver each cake for $13.00 delivery charge (which is pretty steep).  I asked if they could deliver by tomorrow (Friday) and the girl in the front had to check with the owner.  She came back and said it was going to be a $30.00 charge for each because it was short notice.  The bundt cakes I was purchasing were $39.50.  How can a business justify a $30.00 delivery charge for going no more than 3 miles for a delivery?  I have been buying these cakes for years in another city and when I heard one was opening in Boise I was really excited, now I am so disappointed.
Couldn't believe there was pizza this good in Boise. Total surprise. Can't speak highly enough about it seriously.

Had to come back here on our last day in Boise due to the Al Pastor tacos tasting so damn good. I also missed out on the potato taco the day before, so that had to be rectified. The Idaho Potato Taco comes standard with white and yellow cheese and topped with sour cream. Y'all know how I feel about cheese on a taco but potato tacos do not count. It was like eating a baked potato. I noticed, but not in time, that you could also add bacon or chorizo. I drowned the two al pastor tacos with the extra spicy sauce. They were epic. 

I will have to try the brisket taco next time I'm there.

Had lunch here on Wednesday about 1pm. The snow had kept a lot of people off the roads, and the girl at the counter said the place would normally have been packed. Since it was my first visit and I wanted to assess East-Coast style sandwich quality, I had the "Little Italy"- basically a mixed Italian. Half-sized (~6") set me back about $6. That's a bit much, but you can go to 12" for like $2 more, which would be a good deal to split with someone.

Overall, I like it; so far it's my favorite sub in the Treasure Valley (beating out Hugo's, Quizno's, Port 'o' Subs, and Fred Meyer).

What was good:
-Plenty of meat and filling; proportions were good.
-Quality meats: Pretty good; the cheese was good. Meat was average.
-Greenery: Lettuce/tomatoes etc were fair, but it is January.

What needed work:
-Really, just the price...I thought $6 was a bit much,

I'll be back, I'll take the family, I recommend it. Good stuff!

Today was my first time visiting​ the store. I was greeted upon entering and the girl was very sweet. However, I did not feel there were many options when it came to juice. I ended up ordering a juice that was spinach, parsley, celery, and carrot....hoping for a healthy green juice. Instead I get a little handful of spinach, a reasonable amount of parsley, reasonable amount of celery, and five huge carrots! I believe carrots were listed as the last item and my juice was full of them. While waiting for my juice I looked around and began to notice how dirty the store was... enough to almost make me scared to drink my juice. Overall the juice was not anything great and because of the lack of cleanliness I won't be returning. Super sad because I love to support local businesses and this is close to my house. I ended up going to Jamba juice for lunch and it was a clean and fresh experience...my green juice was exactly what I wanted.

i cant even tell you how much i love this place. every time i walk in, i get so happy. the employees are all so nice and helpful, they have literally everything- and it's better priced than target and better quality than walmart. it's a one stop shop!

we had a really (really) bad experience at ashley furniture and we were on the hunt for a new sectional sofa that would work in our basement. i was grocery shopping one morning and found a great sectional- at a fair price! what a concept! no sales people hounding me, and i was even allowed to use their 10% off coupon in their sunday ad. how great is that?

we got the most gigantic sectional, which is some of the highest quality i think i have ever sat on- for less than the dinky sagging crap we got at ashley's. and they had really cute pillows too in their pillow section i could accessorize with! i felt like i was dreaming....i got this from a grocery store?? how is this possible? 

we could not be happier. the employees were so helpful, and got it loaded in the trucks for us. easy breezy. they told us if we had any issues we could return it...what a concept! that's how furniture buying should be- not a life sentence!

thank you again fred meyer, you have life long customers in us!
I ordered a double bacon burger no sauce and the hatch green chili on it. It was one of the best burgers I've had in a long time. It had great flavor and the order was spot on.

We always order for delivery.  Food usually arrives earlier than promised and is piping hot. The delivery driver is VERY friendly and it's always the same person. I would highly recommend getting crab rangoons and pot stickers for appetizers. For the main courses my wife and I like the generals chicken, orange chicken, and szechwan beef. This is by far the best Chinese food we've found in the meridian area.
Really good food and atmosphere. The service has always been extremely good as well. This is a great place for people who live on the south side of the freeway.

I arrived on time for my appointment, but didn't get called back to get my hair cut until 30 minutes after my scheduled time. I just needed my sides buzzed, which is hard to mess up. 
My only complaint about the cut is the stylist gave me a collar cut on my neckline when I asked for her to just make sure my hairline was clean. Maybe this is my fault and I just don't know how to correctly ask for what I want.

This place is our new go to for Mexican food! Amazing proportions of delicious food at a decent and justified cost. My husband had the carne asada combo which he really enjoyed. I enjoyed the Mi Casa combo. The carne asada was the best we've had in a long time. His chimichanga was very flavorful. My chicken taquito was not fried, it was softer than I expected but it was super good! The child rellano had an egg like substance coating, but the cheese inside was the selling point. Rice and beans were well seasoned. Everything was cooked great! We saw three separate tables order the shrimp dish in the black stone bowl....must be a favorite. Place is very clean, staff friendly, and food is amazing! I very much recommend this place.

Stopped in today after finding reviews on yelp. My husband and I were immediately greeted and seated. We got our drinks and chips, refried beans and salsa. The salsa was mild but had good flavor. I enjoyed the beans they had good flavor and texture.  We ordered of the lunch menu. I got the pollo creama burrito and my husband got the super burrito. The portions were huge. Especially for lunch.  You could share! My only complaint was the queso fresco on my burrito. However that was my fault as its included in the description on the menu. The service was good. I could have had another refill on my drink. The place was clean and comfortable.  We will go back.

Best Mexican food I've found this far north of the border (and I'm from LA)! Awesome food complimented with even "awesomer" service! Yeah, maybe the decor could use a lil makeover, but the service & comida WAAAY out shadowed that aspect of our experience. Btw, the reviews don't lie. Portions are GINORMOUS! Next time we're in town, definitely coming back here!

If you are looking for a knowledgeable, friendly and gentle chiropractor this is the place. Dr. Hanson, aka Jared, is very thorough yet easy to talk to. He focuses on your problems and provides professional opinions/feedback without being pushy on the services he offers. I always feel like the center of attention when I am there and the staff is very accommodating. There is a play area for my kids to keep them busy wail I am getting my adjustments and I am never worried about leaving them there to play wail I am in the other room. Jared is also very good with kids and provides chiropractic services to them as well. 360 Chiropractic has a wonderful massage service with a dedicated room that is more like a day spa than a doctors office.
Great wings for a pretty good price. I would put it at a similar level to BWW but slightly not as great.

Don't let the fact that they share space with an Asian restaurant and a coffee shop turn you away from Calle 75 street tacos. I've visited this place twice (within a week) because the food is outstanding. I've tried the Al pastor burrito and the chicken burrito. Both were outstanding. I loved their take on al pastor. They add pineapple which really plays well on the sweet and salty thing. Their salsa was very good as well and seemed to be home made. If you enjoy hot sauces they make two different kinds and both were equally good. This place blows all the chain burrito joints out of the water. I'll keep coming back here again and again.

Veggies were perfect al dente & chicken was perfect, not greasy or oversauced. The food server smiled and gave me a great serving of vegetables and chicken, she did not skimp on my mixed vegetable side as was done by a past server, so I was very happy and so was my stomach.
Loved this place! I've been a couple of times. Their steak sandwich is so good. I also liked their vanilla basil salad dressing.

This place has solid food options, and all are presented well. Some specialties are the vanilla basil salad dressing and the vegetarian hot wings, which are cauliflower pieces in buffalo sauce that burns with the heat of a thousand suns. Truly a trip to flavortown. 

I was disappointed with the lack of draft options (7 or so taps, none of them are cider). Also, the server wasn't my favorite. He was ok, just awkward and slow. Also, he wasn't knowledgable about beer, and struggled to say anything meaningful about the beer options. 

The vegetable that came with my dinner was an olive tapenade. Bizarre. Not sure when olive tapenade became a vegetable, but whatever.

My steak was awesome. The rest of the dishes at my table looked great. The presentation is awesome, and this place will only continue to be good and get better.

Just had a delicious vegan breakfast here! Although the buffet is not vegan, I asked if the cook could prepare me hashbrowns with sauteed vegetables; basically the veggie omelette with hashbrowns instead of eggs and no cheese. Spot on and delicious! I'm learning to ask for specific things. Thank you, Pinnacle Bar & Grill!

If I could give this place zero stars I would.  This place STINKS!  As in Smells.  Really bad.  Like rotten milky dishcloths.  The employees don't seem to care if the tables are sticky, the trash is overflowing, and the floors are filthy!  There was one cute girl trying to clean the place by herself after the line calmed down- but the other employees disappeared in the back room.  I also over heard another employee talking trash about people coming into the store. This place needs a complete overhaul!
High quality ingredients and great service. They make everything fresh from scratch and you can taste the difference. Awesome lunch specials and slice deals.

1st time at Five Guys (Dtr Rachel brought me some fries once) - great AND friendly service, didn't know that standard burger comes with two patties...  Ordered Large fries and they were more than I could eat and I LOVE fries!  Excellent tasting burger - may have to switch my allegiance from Carl's

This place is always amazing! The food is great. My favorite is the Italian Grinder, and I have a hard time not ordering this every time I come. They always have a good selection of local craft beers on tap, and also have a full bar. The staff and service are excellent. I may have only checked in once or twice here, but I have been here over 20 times and it is a regular go to spot.

We planned to go to an adjacent eatery, but it was closed.  So we took a chance, cold turkey, on  Gramercy Park Pizza and Grill.  Wow, were we pleasantly surprised at this little gem tucked away in South Meridian.  We were surprised at just how crowded this place was yet we were lucky enough to be seated immediately.  Our server was prompt and we ordered.  My GF spotted the Gramercy Sandwich and encouraged me to order that, she ordered a personal pizza.  The sandwich reminded me of a famous sandwich I've seen on TV from Pittsburgh I believe.  Holy Cow!  What a treat!  Amazing flavor: pot roast, corned beef, french fries, cole slaw, black pepper mayo, Swiss cheese, tomato & pickle.  All this plus a side to-boot!  My G.F's specialty pizza was excellent and perfectly to her liking and they even allowed a substitution at no-charge for one pizza topping.  We both were impressed that the food was served on nice white china plates instead of a plastic basket or tray.  The price was very acceptable and a good value for the amount, quality and service.  We had been wine tasting and ordered only water to drink, but instead of a less than enthusiastic attitude in water refills, our servers were coming by every 5 minutes to refill our glasses.  They quickly wrapped our leftovers in foil with expediency.  The servers here have a real "team effort" mentality which is very refreshing.  We were extremely pleased with our dining experience and recommended  this restaurant before we even left the parking lot.  Bravo!

This review is strictly for the gelato.

I went in and got 5 flavors (the owner split pints and we got one medium sized flavor). I LOVED the mango flavor, it was rich and creamy, and had perfect mango flavor! The plain chocolate was anything but! Soft at a hard freeze, a bit on the darker chocolate side. Cookies and cream was slutty, it was so good (I don't even love this flavor, but this gelato was stupendous!). Huckleberry was nice, though a little too grainy from the fruit. Pineapple,  lemon, straciatella, oh my!
I don't eat tons of sweets, but look forward to trying all the flavors he makes (pear, pretty please?)

And, food looks tasty too - looking forward to the muffaletta....
The food was just "ok". Meat was a bit bland but not terrible. Overall--just very ordinary.

Had the best experience for my daughters 5th birthday party. We had a small group of kids who were taken care of every step of the painting process. Their creations were fired quickly,within 2 days, and they were thrilled with the outcome!! We will definitely return to have more painting fun!!

Love their "Daily Specials!" Never have been disappointed there! Great service and just a laid back and local atmosphere! This is my go to restaurant here in Boise/Meridian! Their sandos are a must or a good yummy salad if you want to go more heathy!

I think I may be the only Idahoan I know who isn't a huge Dutch Bros fan. I think I'd like them a lot more if they offered drip coffee, because I'm not a huge espresso lover. What I do like about Dutch Bros is there's always a huge line, so if I want quick coffee, I'll just go down the street! :) 

Food: n/a

Drinks: Their Americano is good, but I get it black and that's that! The green and flavored teas are also good.

Atmosphere: The music is usually always very loud and there's always a huge line of cars. 

Service: While the staff is always super happy and upbeat, there's a hipster vibe there that I'm just not vibin'. If I want to wait in a huge line for coffee in the mornings (or any time of day for that matter), I'll go to Dutch Bros. It's just not fast and not excellent service.

Happy Hour Offerings: n/a

This place never seizes to amaze me! I just had the Lowrider pizza and I have to admit the crispy spinach was intemendating at first. But man.... The best pizza I've ever had! No lie! 
Staff is great, beer is great, good is better!
10 stars

If you've never had Poké before, you will love it if you are a fan of sushi. I had a regular bowl with comes with 3 scoops of the protein of your choice. I picked salmon, tuna and white tuna with brown rice. If you like a little kick to it, I recommend the chili shoyu, sesame shoyu and spicy mayo. It tastes just like a sushi roll! All of the toppings are really awesome, from avocado to jalapeno. I love being able to mix and match, and all of the ingredients and fish are so fresh and delicious. No fishy smell, super clean and easy to order.
Great selection of beer on tap and knowledgeable staff that can help you find a new favorite. Great price on growler fills and I don't have to get a gas station attendant to fill it for me.

Fantastic customer service without the high pressure sales. Seth was very informative about the products and set clear expectations on the ordering of a Traxxas TRX4. Ordered it on a Saturday with a next Saturday delivery, but got a call on Wednesday that it was in. Sandy was great during pick up and gave me some great no pressure advice about what to watch for as far as replacement, which was exactly what all the online forums stated. Pricing is fantastic and any savings you may get online is more then made up for with the knowledge and relationship you will build with the team at Action Hobbies. Thank you everyone at Action Hobbies!!!!

This place is awesome! I just had the standard burger, but it was pretty good. I love pretzel buns and that's what they had. The people I was with all had the buffalo solider and loved it. It was huge and they said it was the perfect amount of spiciness. 

It was a little on the pricey side, but for a site down place, I don't think it was any more unusual than another other restaurant around. 

And to the dude that complained about the tater tots...they are stuffed with crab - That's why they are $10 and you spelled tater tots wrong.
I worked with the office out of Boise. They were professional, prompt, helpful and friendly. Also, compared to others in the area, they have decent prices. I would recommend.
Love this Starbucks!! Great staff with great personalities. They remember your name and drink. They make me feel like they are my friends!
My first time having street tacos. They were amazing!!!! How did I live life without them? Definitely try the garlic aioli sauce. Yum! I will definitely be back!

I had to do an update. I had previously given them two stars, but this morning when I called the front desk to get some more towels brought up, I was told to go find the housekeeping lady. Seriously? I had to just search through the halls. 
Last night when we called the front desk for more pillows (they're about the thickness of a folded towel) we were simply told they were out and then promptly hung up on.
Service and cleanliness. That's not their motto.
Great as always!  Fell in love with Freddy's a yearcago while in Florida.  Wish they had them in Oregon.

Went to Gramery Park to days in a row and both days the food was fantastic.

Do not let the name fool you they have way more than pizza!!!

Great service excellent food; this is my new go to place in Boise

i wanted to try gramercy park for a while, and was glad we finally did. best way to classify it would be as artistic pizza and pub, which was not as i had expected.  i enjoyed their lunch special: a flavorful burger topped with crisp, fried jalapeño pepper rings, pineapple slaw, bleu cheese crumbles, avocado spread, and hot sauce served on a ciabatta bun.  i really liked the flavor combinations so my only complaint would be that they don't cook the burger to order,so no rare burgers here, but otherwise  a yummy burger.  don't overlook the french fries either, rustic style fries with skin still on, twice fried, and sprinkled with coarse salt- it was hard to not eat every fry then and there.  it cost about $13 for the meal, so a little pricy for a burger but worth it.  service was friendly, but a little slow, but a good experience overall.

Dr. Howard is by far the best dentist I have ever dealt with. I feel their prices are very good. The office staff is always nice and so helpful. They take care of my whole family. They all try very hard to make sure they build a good rapport. I give them 5 stars.

Not going to lie, it's nice knowing that there is a place that does donuts that doesn't give me a complete sugar crash and it's gluten free so my partner can have some too :) definitely not what I would have expected texturally speaking when it comes to gluten free, this is more of a sponge/soft texture and it doesn't have that grain feel afterwards. Some of the flavors are a little sweet for me but I'm willing to pay the price for something that my partner and I can enjoy together.

I stopped here for lunch before my shift at work. I walked in and said to the nice young man taking my order that I had a random request. I wanted a Market Fresh Roast Beef and Swiss and I knew it wasnt on the menu anymore but could they possibly make it for me. Where the other Arby's in Nampa told me no, this one got the shift leader right away and he asked me what I wanted on it and nicely had it made for me :) I was the happiest customer in the world. Next time I want Arbys, I will for sure come to this one. That is how you keep your customers happy and coming back.
I got a very lovely phone call today from the owner trying to make things right. We shall see what happens, but I am optimistic as she seemed like she really wants to make things right with me.
Pricey little round cakes of happiness .   My favorite is lemon.  So fresh . I grab a fork and call it my afternoon snack.   Yummy.

Freddys is the worse burger ever and the sad part is that it's better then the fries. Why do you smash the burger and then burn it?????? talking about Smash burgers please don't be mad at me for not going to Smash burger because they have awesome burgers. I rate Freddy a negative -10 and she tried to refer to her burger to a In-N-Out burger. GROSS GROSS GROSS.

Great customer service both here and at the Caldwell location. Highly recommend.
Many convenient locations and a huge selection of equipment.

Great service & great selection of items. My only complaint (had nothing to do with them) is the high school girls sitting behind us were having inappropriate conversations, not suited for my young children's ears.
Got the number one combo. It was great to have burger that wasn't full of grease or dry. It was too salty and sorry coke fans, they only serve Pepsi.

We were hesitate to try the Pinnacle because of horrible experience in other places but WOW we WILL be BACK! Excellent , absolutely excellent! The spinach dip and chips were the best we have had ever had. The restaurant was clean and relaxing and background music was NOT blasting ( thank you) ! The food came out exactly as ordered and flavor was fresh, hot and packed with great flavor. Thank you Dan for the excellent food and presentation. Our server ( Haley) was very sweet and thoughtful, providing outstanding service and keeping our beverages going. This might have been our first visit but it won't be our last; A must try!!

Tried this place a month or so ago and was not impressed.  I tried the steak and papas burrito first of for $10 I expect a delicious huge burrito but received neither. The size was so so and the flavor was nonexistent the only flavor I tasted was cheddar cheese and every once in awhile potato. Nothing about the food inspires me to return.

So happy there is a store in Boise area, practically lived off of nothing bundt cakes in SoCal!!! Customer service is amazing, so helpful and accommodating. Since I don't bake this is ALWAYS my go to when I am responsible for dessert. You haven't lived until you have had one these cakes!!
