Pleasantly surprised! After my husband swore I'd like it, I went. We ordered separate pizza's and ended up with leftovers. Here are the pizza's we built: regular crust, pesto sauce, mozzarella, artichoke hearts, kalamata olives, and chicken. Second pie started the same regular crust, pesto sauce, mozzarella, mushrooms, chicken, bacon, and both types of sausage. We were impressed with both pies (pics will be uploaded). The service was great. They were helpful and quick and he restaurant was clean. All in all, worth going and I'll be back!

Love the atmosphere, staff is friendly and knowledgeable, and the bowls are better than amazing. I crave them! Also, the juices are in fun bottles, taste like juice I have never had and the color and names are so unique.

its a bit over rated and a little expensive for a fast food burger can't wait till in and out burgers comes to idaho know that is what a burger is all about plus for $6.00 dollars you get a combo with fries and coke unlike this guys that you come out paying almost $10.00 for the same thing. just wait idaho till you get in and out the double double the 4 by 4 or animal style fries any of you who have been to in and out know exactly what i'm talking about.

I'm pissed!!! I sent my fiancé (at the time girlfriend) here to get her nails done since I knew I was going to be popping the question the next day.  Amore totally jacked her nails up and caused us both a lot of stress the day before getting engaged.  She came home totally devastated and embarrassed about how bad her nails looked and because of how bad her overall experience was at Amore.  We will never come here again and I will make sure to warn anyone who asks for a recommendation to steer clear from this place.  #DONTBEPIMPED

Had lunch with the family on Saturday.I was impressed; these are good burritos and nice to have competition with Qdoba. Also an impressive beer selection, which is cool. I suspect the breakfast burritos would be excellent.

I has a steak and refried bean burrito, and a shrimp and black bean burrito. (Split 4 ways with my wife & two kids). The tortillas were grilled, not steamed, which gives them a very different texture and makes for a different burrito than Chipotle or Qdoba. Not better or worse, just different. Also, they include guacamole in the burrito, which is great. It makes them a bit drippy, but that's fine. I think the burritos are a bit smaller than Qdoba or Chipotle, but they're still a decent meal.

What's good:
-Unique menu; fish, shrimp, more items.
-Including guac in the burrito.
-Beer selection.
-Hot sauce selection in squeeze bottles in the ice tub...nice touch!

What's not so good:
-Burritos left open on top (not folded)...could get messy. Maybe they only do this if you eat in.
-Size...they could be a bit bigger.
-Table service...is there table service? You order at the counter, they bring it out, or maybe you pick it up. I always wonder if I should tip in this situation. They should just have you pick up your food at the counter.

I like it, I'd recommend it.

Great front end service, nice pool and exercise room, clean new attractive rooms, but breakfast is only mediocre.  The in-room kitchen and other amenities are exceptional.  It is easily accessible and surrounded by restaurants and other services.  They have a laundry room on-site if needed.

Tried the "frozen custard" which came highly recommended by others, and a shake. Nothing special. Tasted like cheap ice cream to me. I get it's supposed to be "custard" and not ice cream, but it tasted more like a marketing gimmick than reality.

Can't speak for anything else.

My husband and I, plus two of our friends, had dinner at Mi Casa tonight and we will definitely be back. Bob and I both had the carnitas burrito and we both agree, it was the best carnitas we have ever had. Absolutely delicious! Our friends had siete mares (Mexican soup chock full of shrimp, crab legs, scallops, clams, potatoes, etc.), and campechana, another shrimp, scallops, etc. soup. They were thrilled with their choices! The service was impeccable. What a wonderful new restaurant in Meridian--right off of Eagle. We will return often!!!

We go to pinnacle almost weekly it is one of mine and my husband's favorite restaurants! The food is always good and the service is usually decent. Our most recent visit however was not as enjoyable the food was still fantastic but our server was annoying inattentive and rude. Every request we made he would try to joke and tell us no this was only funny once! We were annoyed because he would say no to getting us more water and then would not bring it out without us reminding him again to which he would say no again. Not funny we were annoyed and thirsty most of our meal! Let's hope you don't get this server but if you do think about the good food not the service!
4 stars for food!
0 for that server!

I've found this location to be relatively easy to use and the service to be quick and courteous. Their burgers are much juicier and have a better flavor than national competitors like Freddy's (awful) or Smashburger (overpriced) though not quite as good as local burgers from Boise Fry Co or Big Juds. That said, Five Guys consistently produces a good burger and great fries at a decent price.

If you like a long piece of hair in your burger, this is the place for you. With so many Burger places to choose from this one fell short in the taste dept. Their concrete (shakes) are very good though
Worst carne asada I've had in a long time. Won't be coming back. I've had better so i won't be paying for a disappointment

"I feel like pizza tonight."  That was the first thing I heard when I came home from work today.  Ok, that's really not true, but in the conversation with DW this evening, the topic of pizza did come up.  A quick Yelp search showed that Gramercy Park was close to the top.  Since this place is only a couple of blocks from our home, it was a natural choice.

The place was pretty busy when we got there, but there were some tables available so there was no wait.  Our server warned us that they were running a bit slow on cooking the pizza tonight, but that didn't stop us.  We were pizza focused!!!  We both ordered personal pizzas; Pepperoni for my wife, and Maui Wowwie for me.  

We also ordered a salad, which ended up being excellent.  It was big, and there was bacon, cheese, and fresh greens in the salad.  I loved my bleu cheese dressing too.  Awesome salad.

Our pizza's were great too.  We didn't have long to wait, despite the warning from our server.  My pizza was super hot when they served it. The crust was thin, and cooked nicely.  The sauce tasted great, and the ham, bacon, and pineapple were wonderful.  There was a distinct salty-and-slightly-spicy vibe happening with each bite, which made my tongue tingle a bit.  The personal size was perfect for me, as I ate half, and I'll have the other half for dinner tomorrow.  

So the food was great, the service nice, so how can we not come back here again?  I'd certainly recommend it.


--------------------

Did you know that most people want at least three covers on their bed?
That's just a blanket statement.

The food is delicious.  It seems as might be served at an abuela's kitchen table.  The splendid service makes it taste even better.   The young women waiting on the booths and tables inside the strip mall located modest space were warm and friendly from greeting at the door through the meal.  You sense the hearts of everyone involved here, from cook to servers, are vested in making the guest experience a good one. Our expectations were exceeded.  We look forward to returning in spite of the awkward location with an awful parking lot.  

TIP:  If you read no further than this, here's a tip.  Flatware in the form of knife and fork are delivered to the table wrapped in a single, small paper napkin.   Ask for a spoon and extra napkins.  You'll thank me.  Reasons why follow.

VIBE:  The glass door of the strip mall store front opens into a modest sized interior with a handful of booths lining each side wall.  There are three additional four-top tables down the center of the room.  Bright colored sombreros and art with Mexican themes adorn the walls.  My husband commented on how much he enjoyed the fit of the decor.  

SERVICE:   Welcoming greeting at the door followed by smiles throughout the meal from the charming young women waiting the tables.  They knew the menu, could answer questions and conveyed genuine delight that we had decided to eat at Mi Casa.  The stellar service is a reason we will go back.

But a note to set expectations here regarding pace.  There seemed to be one or maybe two cooks in the little kitchen.  When tables are full and  roughly 40 diners arrive at roughly the same time, as at lunch hour, there can be delays in food arriving at the table.  You will be well cared for by the friendly staff as you wait, but if you're in a hurry this may not be the best fit. 

MENU & FOOD:  Chips with little bowls of salsa and refried beans for dipping are delivered to your table along with multi page, laminated menus.  I appreciate that each diner got their own little salsa bowl.  I love salsa and prefer not to share.

And here is the first reason you may use that spoon I recommended you ask for.  The salsa is yummy  with fresh minced onion, tomatoes and jalpaneo but it is thin in texture and I wanted a spoon to eat it.  No kidding.  That extra napkin will also come in handy to wipe up "oops" salsa spots on the table when using vehicle of the chips.

Dinner options are on the inside pages of the menu.  The lunch menu on the back offers smaller sized and lower priced versions of some dinner options.  You can also order from the dinner menu for lunch.  When my husband did that, for sopas, they provided him with a lunch sized portion at a lower price without him even asking if that was possible. 

The menu runs the gamut from standard fare on Mexican-American menus, like burritos, to specialties like mole and carnitas and tamales and sopas.  There were several seafood options and three or four soups.  Everything is made in house, including tamales and sopas.  And here I'd offer that the potato soup that has a vegetarian broth with roasted pasilla peppers and cojita cheese is delicious.

You'll find that  spoon handy again when you ask for a take away box in which to put your leftovers of any entree you order.  Portions are so generously sized, even at lunch, that neither my husband nor I could finish ours but the food was so good we wanted to take every morsel to eat as leftovers. 

If I could wave a magic wand, I might step down the salt in the dishes just a bit.  But that has more to do with my personal preference and no fault of the kitchen.

PRICES:  So reasonable that I wonder how their metrics work to be profitable.  Two people sharing a large bowl of soup plus two entrees, plus delicious chips and salsa was under $20.00 before tax and we had leftovers to boot. 

THIS N THAT:

1) LOCATION:  I am not a fan of strip malls in Meridian housing cheesey chain restaurants (as in the Buffalo Wild Wings which is Mi Casa's neighbor).  I conclude I am of minority opinion given the poorly designed parking lots at strip malls like this with too tightly spaced and small sized spaces to pack in as many cars as possible seldom seem to have an open space to park.  I avoid these lots as there is typically nothing to make me want to be there.  I will brave this location though, to visit Mi Casa.  But if I could wave a magic wand, I'll move the restaurant out of this strip mall.

2) ACCESSIBILITY:  Whomever built this strip mall, which is clearly less than ten years old, completely ignored ADA parking standards, which have been the law for twenty five years, given there are but two in a parking lot that has over two hundred spaces. Shameful.  And illegal.  The restaurant itself is level in and throughout, all standard height seating.  In spite of close quarters, it seemed as if wheelchair access could be possible.

Best fast burger in town.  The lettuce wrap is a favorite of mine and I love the fresh custard.  The staff is always smiling and helpful and they work hard to keep things clean and nice. Great place to get a fast yummy burger.
Clean, fast service, excellent food.  Got the uncooked poke bowl.  Was excellent.  Sauces are tasty.  Price is extremely fair.  I will be coming back here.  So much better then the dirty Zen Bentos

First time here. The food was very good. Not busy at all. The person helping us made some great sauce recommendations. Much appreciated. I would suggest that they get some set bowls for newbies. Also maybe expand the options for the base. You recommend this place! Thanks!
IT was decent Nice wings and the girl was Nice and if I had to choose i whould do it agian
The food was fair. The service was horrible and there was only one other table of 4 there. She never came to check on us. Every time we needed a refill or more chips we had to chase her down.
Heading back home to California we had to make a quick stop. The crew working tonight were amazing!!! Megan was very helpful even when she was given a confusing order. Will be back in July.

I had a lunch meeting here and I was more than pleased by the experience! The service was fantastic and food was above average for Sports bar type food. The homemade chips that were served as a free munchie was a nice touch. I will definitely come back again!

This is my favorite Mexican restaurant in the Treasure Valley. The Pollo La Crema is amazing and we have always had excellent service (even with our wild kids). The server remembers us, even if it's been a few months. They are very accommodating and it's always a great experience.

I visited this location for the first time for a brazilian wax and was very disappointed in my experience. I found it to be uncomfortable and atypical that I was supposed to undress while the technician was in the room with me. The wax was uncomfortably hot, when I expressed this, I was reassured I was fine, but it most certainly did not feel fine. The special "technique" used for a brazilian wax was to wax in a few large sections then go over again in smaller sections. I have not experienced this technique anywhere else. In fact, I have always been told to never wax over the same area twice because of the irritation it can cause. Despite having a high pain tolerance, I was in agonizing pain (to which I expressed to the technician, who assured me it was normal-it is not normal). As I was about to end the session due to pain, the technician told me that there were a few more hairs but she would rather leave them alone because my skin was looking a bit "angry". My skin was swollen and red due to the HOT wax and the multiple waxing over the same areas. I was bruised, red, and sore even 3 days after. I had so many ingrown hairs afterwards, even after buying their serum. I would not recommend this place to anyone who is looking to have a professionally done bikini or brazilian wax. It was uncomfortable (emotionally and physically), painful, and well not done.
I went there on the 1st of may at 3:25 and Jacob served me, he is the best got an excellent customer service from him with a great attitude  he made my experience great. Thanks

A little pricey for "street tacos" but consistent with Village pricing. I had some so-so tacos and some pretty good ones. My Hispanic wife loves the place so I will adjust the review if I continue time find things I like.

You definitly pay for what you get. Cheap Hotel. First thing when we get into our room, its completly  trashed. There was pizza boxes, trash on the floor and the sheets were not even done. That is just unacceptable. We requested a clean room. When we told the guy working that night he was not surprised at all. I guess its common for maids to forget to clean the rooms. The positive is the he upgraded us to a suite room. At least this one was clean.  It was also weird that their was a random guy walking around the hallways like he owned the place. He had no shoes on and seemed like he was doing drugs or something. Just seemed sketchy. The postives of the suite room were there was a tv, a dinning table, and it was a decent size. Another downside was that the housekeepers wake everyone. We were to check out by 11:00am. Its 10am and housekeepers are already kicking people out. We still have about 45 min til we check out. I thought that was weird. Would not come back. Beware!

Went there today after setting up an appointment online for 2:30.  I understand it is possible for a short wait.  Upon arrival, I was asked if I had put myself on the list online.  I said yes and waited. They have a TV screen displaying the order you are in for waiting.  I was the first.  They called back 3 different people as I was waiting even though I was first on the list.  I thought maybe those people were already waiting before I placed my name on the list online, so no big deal.  Then 2 more get called back.  30 minutes after I arrived, a lady came in with her two kids.  She was asked if she was on the list.  They looked her up and immediately called one of her kids back.  At this point, I'm not thinking it's simply others waiting from before I put my name on the list.  For whatever reason, I was being skipped.  Needless to say, I left and won't be returning.  Pretty sad for a brand new location that I would assume is trying to earn new and repeat business.

So I like to come here every once in a while when I'm looking for something a bit better than the supermarket ice cream or if I want to treat my little girl.  I really like the way they do ice cream. It's not too stiff (overly-frozen) and they have a bunch of toppings including fruit which I like. The only thing is that the service isn't great. It's adequate and they aren't rude, but they're not particularly upbeat either. I suppose an ice cream parlor isn't the ideal place to work, but if you work someplace that children frequent, it's important to at least feign a decent attitude.

Definitely a budget motel. Rooms feel more like updated dorm rooms. 
Front desk staff tonight was less than pleasant. 
Is it really hard to put on a smile and a pleasant demeanor when your in the hospitality business?
Right now there is TONS of road construction in the area. If you can keep driving into Boise or Nampa depending on which way your headed, I definitely would.

Normal Mexican food.  Wait staff friendly.  Food good but not extraordinary 

Rice al dente

Quick service.  Good for lunch

Nice kitchenettes with fridge, microwave and small stove.  Friendly, efficient desk staff.  Small but serviceable pool and whirlpool.  Small gym with decent, new equipment. Right off the freeway.  I requested two queen beds so I could sneak in my family of six.  They upgraded me to two rooms for free and apologized.

One of the online maps accidentally put them at 1415 e pine ave.  the desk patiently guided us to their actual location right off the freeway.

Each room has a sofa bed as well, and there is a grill out front for guests too.  

Staying here lightened our mental travel load.  The place feels new and cheery.

We decided to stop in for lunch today after hearing good reviews.  We ordered the Astoria and Manhattan pizzas along with just a regular side salad.  Both pizzas were good.  The crust was delicous however it was a tad oily.  You can tell a lot about a restaurant by just a simple side salad.  A variety of mixed greens with a variety of toppings including bacon!  Can't go wrong with bacon!

The service was fantastic!  The kitchen is semi open to the restaurant and even the chefs made sure to thank us on the way out.  We will be back.

I am a chubby man and that is partially due to my love of all things sugar. When I learned that a candy/soda shop was opening up within a stone's throw of my house, I had to investigate and I am glad I did. 

My wife told me a new shop opened very near our house and she suggested I stopped by to see if they have my favorite soda, Puma Kola. I figured I would give Poptops a shot but didn't get my hopes up because I have only found my beloved Puma Kola at Powell's across town. Low and behold, not only did Poptops have Puma Kola, but it was also cheaper than Powell's. I should note, that being cheaper than Powell's is a trend that continues throughout the store. 

I also talked to the two guys running the shop and they were very friendly and seemed knowledgeable about various sodas and candies.  They were also quick to let me know that they were in the process of stocking the store with dozens more sodas and candies. These are my people. 

The only downside and one that they promised to rectify was the selection. Right now, Powell's does have more candy to choose from but I have a feeling that lead isn't going to last long. This store is fresh from Candy Land and is still in the process of getting merchandise in. Poptops is probably already beating Powell's soda selection based on the varieties I eyeballed and so I think the candy will soon catch up. I am excited to see what is in store for this little shop. If all goes well, Meridian's dentists are going to be getting a lot more business as Poptops grows. 

Sweet tooths rejoice! There is a new candy/soda shop in town and it is awesome!
"This is the real deal! Straight up authentic and as good as it gets. Being in Mexico and trying the real stuff, this is just as good! Recommend to all Mexican food lovers!!
Good pizza. The crust could have been a little more cooked. Kind of soft. I would definitely try it again. I got it to go and the young woman that helped me was extremely nice!

I've cut my own hair for most of my life, but I decided to try the new Supercuts that just opened near my house.  Glad I did.  A nice gal named Kim cut my hair and did a great job.  No more DIY haircuts for me.  Thanks Kim!

Brooke, maybe you should speak to Megan and Alyssa before doing an update on your reply. 
Your voicemail  must be full or not set up because it wouldn't allow me to leave a message. And yes, I was charged twice. I sent my bank statement to Megan via email. I am waiting for a refund. Luckily Megan is very kind, patient and willing to help!


They advertise $5 credits for referrals but after I referred a friend and she went twice they still would not honor the credit. I paid the full amount and they charged my card twice! This is a little gem. The owner is extremely friendly and makes very tasty cocktails.The meatball sandwich is very good and they also have a pretty good sushi. They have a few gluten free items wich my wife enjoys and my kids enjoy the food and gelato as well.Its not a bad place to come in the evening with just my wife and have a few ccktails.
I love this place; however trying to get out back onto eagle road actually sucks ! Other than that this is the best place for nice smoothie way better than Jamba Juice in my opinion and fresher!

Whittney was amazing and always gave us advise on what would be best for us as the buyers. Never had any problems reaching her and she would always reply with as many details as she could and then make sure we completely understood the process. Definitely recommend Academy Mortgage and Whitney Curran.

My Mom and I visited Angel Nails this past weekend to get a pedicure. The place is very cute and nice and clean. Van did my pedicure and Maria did my Moms. They did a very good job and took their time. I didn't feel like I was being rushed out of there. My Mom also go her eye brows waxed by Maria. She did a fantastic job! This will definitely be my new go to spot.

SECURITY FLAW
First let me saw that this particular Motel 6 is unlike others I have stayed in. The buidling itself stands apart from other typical Motel 6's. You will be suprised how nice it is. Check in was super easy and quick. The indoor pool was inviting but unfortunately due to schedule I didn't get a chance to try it out. The room was clean and neat and the tv and air work flawlessly. 
Here is where my only complaint is. During my stay the room key all of a sudden de programmed itself. I took the room key to the front desk. There was a gentleman behind the counter that didn't seem to belong. He was dirty and smelled of BO. I told him my situation and he got the desk agent. I told the agent my key didn't work and was expecting to show my  I.D. after I gave the room number. She didn't ask for I.D. and just programmed the card. 
I literally could of found that card on the ground and she would of programmed it to any room I wanted. I find this to be a major security FLAW in my opinion. 
I would of gave 5 stars but I'm giving 3.

I went to see Josie after a referral from a friend.  I had just gotten a terrible cut from another salon and she said she could fix it.  She took her time and evened it out and we discussed what I could do to get it to the cut I had wanted in the first place.  I will definitely be back.  I brought my daughter in for a cut later in the day and she did a beautiful job for her as well.

I'm so happy I found Josie!

Freddy's didn't strike a chord with me, but it may with you.

The atmosphere is all fun 50's diner fabulousness.  They play fun 50's tunes, the tables are all retro red and chrome cool.  It's also sparkling clean (something I very much appreciate).   

I ordered a single cheeseburger meal, which you have to kind of search for on the menu as all the featured, pictured combos are doubles.  Here's the thing you need to know, their patties are paper thin (really and truly very thin, my people).  The cashier explained this to me as I was ordering a single and he wanted to make sure I wouldn't be disappointed.  I'm not overly carnivorous (can one be "overly" carnivorous?) and so a thin patty was fine by me.  But, you should note, that if you're ordering a double?  It's going to be much closer to the amount of meat on a typical burger joint's single.  If you like something a little meatier, I'd go for the triple.  

The burger was fine.  It didn't rock my socks but it was by no means bad.  The fries are shoestring, which is my least favorite style of fry.  So, overall the meal was little ho-hum for me.  

The service is lightening quick and the cashier was friendly and informative.  Definitely, a good place to hit if you're pressed on time.  They'll get you in, out, amply fed in no time.  And, they'll be friendly to boot.

For dessert, I ordered their a chocolate and peanut butter concrete (frozen custard concoction akin to a thick milkshake--so thick, you definitely must use a spoon), which was ok.  It was chocolatey but there were only a couple of bites that I could even taste the peanut butter (sad!).  My dining companion ordered signature Chocolate Brownie Delight Concrete and found it so overly sweet, he couldn't eat it. 

Overall for me?  

A swing and a miss.

Meh ...  Expensive, small wings. You get to pay extra for ranch or blue cheese because you didn't pay enough for the wings.  Oh, and not only do you get to pay far too much for your meal, they will make you wait twice as long as they quoted to get it. 

Let's see, no, no and h$ll no.

Decided I'd stop in to pick up dinner here as Five Guys slipped my mind and I hadn't eaten there in years. First time I visited the chain I was impressed by the way they put the fries in cups and overloaded the cup causing the bag to have lots of fries at the bottom. Simple menu so you don't have to choose between tons of options. I got the small cheeseburger with ketchup, mustard, extra grilled mushrooms, grilled onions, lettuce jalapeños and a medium cup of fries. Best burger I've ever eaten. So juicy. Messy wrapper with a lot of juice leaking on the foil so you get your hands dirty. My tongue was overjoyed at first bite. Fries were good but a tad too salty and greasy, getting cold fast and then getting soggy. I told my mom she's gotta try the burger though, she'll love it.

.The double steakburger was darn good. I like the pickle slices cut lengthwise, so they didn't fall out while I was eating. The thin cut fries were better than expected. I thought the seasoning shakers might add some value to the sandwich and fries, as it resembled something I make up at home. Nah, I can't endorse it; might be better without the sugar.
.The design of this place reminds me of a diner from the 50s. Next time I will try the custard.

Purchased a TV and the wife didn't like the boarder, silly I know but no big deal just return it and get the one your wife likes... Not at Fred Myers, unlike all other retailers you have to jump through hoops and come back when the proper manager is on duty even tho it's been 2 days since I purchased it. What a hassle and disappointment I have to drive all the way back into town just to return something that should have been a hassle free return, steer clear of electronics at Fred Myers unless you are 100% sure, just stick with Best Buy easy hassle free 30 days I knew better but I decided to give them a shot and the hassle was not worth it.

Roger the MOD on duty was extreamly unhelpful and not nice in explaining why he couldn't help us.

We then proceeded to customer service where we met Cassy SHE HERSELF GETS A 6 star and when we explained our situation she tried to help by calling roger to clarify and rather than getting an answer she got reprimanded for even asking... SHE WAS AMAZING for the sympathy, a no can be said in so many ways and Roger gets a 1 star and I give Cassy a 6 even tho she said no it was in the most respectful and explanatory way possible, she deserves a raise.

Whatever you do, don't order the Cashew Chicken pizza.  This pizza needs to be removed from the menu.  Absolutely the worst pizza I have ever had in my life.  The chicken tasted like it was cooked last month and the broccoli was probably removed from somebody's grandparents freezer that had recently passed, but hey what to do with this old broccoli?  I bet CC wants it for the worst pizza you can buy!

Please CC, this pizza is a disaster.

Meridian was in need of a place with great street tacos and these are the best. I also love the glass building and it's location in center of the village. Tasty casual dining, that I can't get enough of!
Pizza is ok. Better selection of toppings at Blaze Pizza down the street. No white sauce kind of a deal killer for me.  Taste was good though. Friendly staff.

A pretty solid wingery (yup, just made a new word) that knows how to cook chicken! 

My wife and I recently ordered take out from Wing Stop and were pleasantly surprised by their offering. My wife had the parmesan garlic wings and I had the parmesan garlic chicken tenders. I am not a fan of actual wings, too much work, not enough reward but I love chicken tenders.

Upon biting into my chicken tender, I quickly realized it was one of the juiciest and tenderest chicken pieces I have eaten in a long time. The tender lived up to its name!  These guys really know how to cook chicken, it was perfectly done. My wife encountered the same goodness in her wings as well. 

The only part of Wing Stop that I'm not sold on is the powdered flavoring they put on the chicken. When you order wings from Buffalo Wild Wings you get bites of meat slathered in various tasty sauces. While Wing Stop's variety of flavors was good, I am not sold on the powder coating. It tasted good but I think I like my chicken with sauces rather than powders. 

Overall, Wing Stop was a surprisingly good experience and a wingery (the more I say it, the faster it catches on) that really knows how to cook chicken to perfection.

I have been wanting to try this place for a while now. We decided to go with the pizza. It tasted good, but nothing I couldn't make myself at home. To me it was just ok. Great atmosphere and decor though, and a nice selection of craft beer.

This place is Awesome! I had the Astoria Pizza and it was so good. The crust is the best, it's crispy it's just perfect. Also, try the Jalapeño appetizer it's has wonderful flavor with a real spicy kick.

Had a Double Bacon Cheese Combo. It was above average for fast food. There menu was simple and to the point. Burgers and Dogs! Yeah... We like trying new places and we're not disappointed with this one. They had great service and food. Looking forward to trying their ice cream in the future.
They're so thorough I had a pile of random change on my nightstand and when I came home they were individually sorted based on coin type.
A lot of beers to decide from. A little expensive compared yo a few of the other places we hit up.

These donuts were yum-mee. There were satisfying and indulgent but I felt good eating them. Plus they didn't leave the nasty guy feeling from regular donuts. If you are looking for traditional tasting donuts these are not for you but if you want something new and tasty this is the place to go.

I have only ordered online and picked their food up to bring home/elsewhere, so I can't really speak for the service when you eat in the restaurant.

However, whenever I order from here, I am always pleased. When I pick up my food, the cashier repeats my order back to me to ensure that they made it correctly and are always pleasant. 

I love good hotwings. I was a bit disappointed in the lack of good, traditional buffalo style wings when I moved here from the east coast. Their buffalo sauce is spot on. Nice and vinegary, not too thick, not too thin, and not JUST Frank's red hot. They do it right here.

I prefer this over buffalo wild wings because the product is better (no intense gastric distress) and it's nice to pick up an order and eat it at home. Come here for good wings!

I hired them to do a move out cleaning expecting kitchen cabinets, shelves, baseboards to be wiped down. The only thing I could tell they did is wipe down the kitchen counter and the bathrooms were cleaned.  I had to redo my floors, completely wipe down the kitchen cabinets and the shelves in closet.  They also told me they would call me before they charged my credit card and I would receive a detailed list of what was done.  I did not receive a call nor the list.  I am very unhappy and will not use them again.

My brother and his wife are making a cross country trip with their Harley in tow. Had an electrical issue and the good folks here helped them out.  Left a lasting impression about the great service available to Harley owners when visiting Boise area. They could have charged them for the time and effort but the staff chose to charge the battery got free. This is a business that knows how to treat people. You and your staff should be proud of your work ethic. Thanks for all you do!

I have been a fan of Chicago Connection for as long as I can remember! It is our go-to pizza place. This location is super convenient for my husband and I to stop by after work and pick up a pizza. The parking lot is easy to get in and out of, even during 5 o'clock traffic. 

I LOVE the bread sticks!!! I am pretty sure I could eat them everyday for the rest of my life and never tire of them! The pizza is also great. I am a super picky eater so I don't order anything super exciting or adventurous. I can tell you that their black olives do not taste funky. This is a big deal to me, and I have had black olives from other places that were awful. Trust me.
All the people in my group who ordered burgers had terrible stomach aches for the evening, including me. Makes me wonder if they use beef with pink slime. I will not go there again.

FINALLY really good Mexican food in our area!!!  They make a killer chili verde burrito with super lean pork and you have the option to order pinto beans instead of refried beans if you would like to keep it a little healthier.  I don't know if they use lard in their pinto bean recipe, if they do, it's not much, because you can't taste it.  The broth feels light and clean.  So many mexican places here are some strange version of TexMex, but Mi Casa is nothing like that!!!  The staff is really friendly and nice, regardless of how busy it is.  Just wish they had a second location in Eagle but totally worth the drive!!

Fun experience in fresh fish, interesting sides.  Helpful staff for choosing combinations.  Seaweed salad delicious.  Rice or salad.  Choice of fish or tofu and five sides.  One regular easily serves two though easy leftovers

I called in a to go order, 20 wings 4 flavors and fries. 3 out of the 4 flavors were wrong and the 4th was under cooked. I live in Boise so it's a drive to get wings. However I was so upset by how messed up my order was I drove back. The manager refused to refund me my full amount because I didn't bring back the drinks. Piss poor costumer service. The manager on duty said her name was Casia. I won't be going back.

Quality service and food. Decor is plane-jane, but what the establishment lacks with decor they certainly make up for it with delicious Tex-mex food. We've searched high and low for good tex-mex in the treasure valley and I think we've found it.
It was good,  but not amazing.  I would try more places before going back,  was ok though

You can never go wrong with Starbucks no matter where you go or where you're from. My go to mock macchiato is an iced coffee with vanilla, milk, and caramel drizzle. Yum! I always try to order something new at least once a week to check pot the menu! Drive thru makes it easy when we got the kiddos in the car.

i used to eat baja fresh in high school a lot until they closed the one in my area and i hadn't been back since.

was craving fish tacos so i thought i would give it a try for old times sake. sorry i did, to be honest. 

came in at lunch and it was pretty busy in there. i ordered 2 "baja fried fish" tacos, which come with cabbage, tomatoes, and sauce on ONE corn tortilla. my mom ordered a "chicken taco plate" with rice and black beans.

her food was almost inedible. the chicken was burnt, the "tortillas" they came in were so thick and kind of hard and chewy like they had been microwaved and then left to sit out- didn't like the rice and beans either as they were cold.

my tacos were little and sad. are they really too cheap to use 2 tortillas for a taco?? one bite and the thing split open and i had to eat it with a fork. if i'm paying over $3 for one taco it should come with 2 tortillas. just stupid. 

2 tacos, 1 drink, and 2 "chicken taco plates" (she took one home to my dad) and it was $27.50 for lunch. seriously incredible. i have ZERO desire to come back. the prices suck and the quality is bad....lesson learned. BYE, felicia!

Subpar food at best.  If you go there you are going for the beer selection and bar. Had the salmon which was absolutely covered in sauce and overly salted deep fried spinach. Why do you need to deep fry spinach !  Other dish ordered was pizza and yes it too came with deep fried spinach. Tried the poutine as an appetizer and tolerable but the gravy overly salted.  I'd give it a pass

The Pulse is a great shop for runners with a staff that really knows running. I was having knee problems running and they did a free gait analysis which clearly showed I over-pronate and they helped get me into a shoe that may help reduce the pronation and thus my knee pain.  The owner is really friendly, and a great supporter of the local community. I'll be coming back here next time I need a pair of running shoes or accessories.

.First poke bowl for me. Really well organized menu boards, guiding me through the process of building a bowl. Several fish available to choose from. I ordered salmon and white rice, with a handful of mild ingredients, in a small bowl. Am I really gonna eat raw salmon? I like sushi, and this was kind of like a sushi salad, so I went for it. Quite tasty. 
.Server was a little hard to understand, but very friendly. Avocado costs extra. Wish the credit card machine didn't ask me for a tip up front, but that's the economics of fast-food, seat-yourself service.
Delicious ice cream with a great selection of add-ins and pretty good customer service.  :) Definitely recommend. My favorite is the sweet cream.

The golden gloves lunch is awesome. You get to choose 3, not 2 items; a salad, half sandwich, and a side. Good portion. Lots of large screen tvs to keep an eye on sports while eating. Good service. Waffle fries were perfect, crispy and hot!  Go there regularly.

I admit that I'm a regular here, have been for years and will continue to be since I'm a McDonalds fry lover and am leaving this review on behalf of my spouse whom I have to listen to complain time after time after time about their pies. He loves McD's pies with the exception of the ones here. They're either raw, undercooked or cold and after tasting the last 2, I agreed to write this review. It's not rocket science, just a cheap Pumpkin Cream Pie! But cold. Not cool, not room temp but cold. Ick!

Growler Guys lives up to their name. They have lots of good beer on tap, and do a good job filling your growlers. They are happy to give samples of any beer you want to try so you make sure you come home with something you like.  If you want to grab a pint while visiting they will happily stick your growler in their fridge to keep it cold. Only con I have is the very limited seating inside if you want to grab a pint in the store. I know this isn't their business model but a few more tables would be nice.  I'll continue to come back here for their friendly customer service and great beer selection.

So. Good. I'm usually a somewhat picky eater, but here even the things I don't like, I like. I've not yet tried the pizzas, but the sandwiches are absolutely delicious. The meats are well cooked and food is out in a timely manner. I highly recommend this place!!

Stopped in today for their hot 'n sour soup, and left with a quart of won ton hot 'n sour...unbelievably fresh and delicious wontons in the same soup the owners were known well for, as previous owners of Wok King in Boise.  This stuff is great!
The owners were working hard as usual on a Saturday, and cheerful as always
Awesome. Good price. Tasty. This a great place for a quick burger. Can't go wrong. Tip: only order one large fry for 4 people. It is huge.

Great rotating selection of beers locally brewed and from other states. Friendly and knowledgeable staff. With so many selections, it's hard to choose but they offer samples to help you make up your mind.

Stopped to get ice cream for my kiddos, there was one person ahead at the window in the drive through. I ordered and pulled up. Person in front of me drive off. I waited for 14 minutes at the window and no one ever came to it (this was after I had ordered). I left without their ice cream, ridiculous. I should add the parking lot was empty so I have no idea what they were doing in there. Will not go back.

Cindy at the front desk is awesome. Lots of fun to talk to. Graham Hill the dentist is outstanding. All the hygienists are great. Highly recommended. Our whole family goes here and we've never had a bad experience (which is saying a lot for a dental office haha).

Waiting for store to open in the morning .
Store owner opens door. No hello or welcome to our store. I purchased a small bundt cake only because was a Birthday gift. Otherwise would have walked.

Pretty good street tacos that you can add different sauces to if you want to make things more interesting. Some are pretty spicy though so watch out. We tried a little of all the street taco meat choices. I thought they were all good. The fish is grilled not fried, which I was very happy about.

Fresh poke with lots of choices and plenty to eat! Staff is super helpful in assisting with ordering and lets you sample sauces before you pick. Great flavors and generous portions! Will definitely be back for more!!

Outstanding Pizza!
We're in Meridian on vacation and checked YELP for a good pizza.
Thanks to local YELPERS for comments about Gramercy Park Pizza!
This was by far one of the best thin crust pizzas I've ever had!

Are you curious about how a business drops from a four-star status to a one star status?  Well, it depends upon the business...

If you know me, you know that I am an easy going guy and very easy to please.  For a convenience store, my expectations are pretty low. I mean really, most of the stuff that happens at a convenience store is pretty much self-service.  Pump your own gas, get your own ice, get your own soft-drink, dry off your own car after the automatic wash.  I don't expect great customer service.  My expectation is that the services that a convenience store provide be "convenient", and I expect that I will get the product that I pay for.  Convenience stores are all over the place. For most commodity-like businesses, the best way to make sure I don't patronize your business is to give me a reason to NOT choose your business.  Well, Fast Eddy's provided me with that reason yesterday.

This Fast Eddy's station has been my neighborhood go-to spot for a few years for gas, propane, car-washes, and even a bottle of wine now and then.  I purchased a car wash a while back, and went to redeem it yesterday.  I have been extremely busy for the last few months, so I haven't been as disciplined as I normally am in many things (like getting my car washed), and when the car wash attendant typed in the wash code, it came up as EXPIRED.  I said that seemed weird, but sure enough, when we looked at the receipt, it showed that I bought the car wash on June 3rd, and it was now July 5th.  Fast Eddy's now sets the expiration date for car washes at 30 days.  I seem to recall that when I bought car washes back in the winter, the expiration time was much longer, as I got several washes using old car wash receipts.  I'm thinking it was at least 60 or 90 days.  But now I'm sitting in line at the car wash with a wash code that expired less than 48 hours ago, and the attendant says he can't let me through.  I ask why does the car wash expire anyway?  He doesn't know.  Why 30 days, and not longer?  He doesn't know.  All he knows is that he can't let me in.  The result here is that I purchased a service from a business, and now that business is refusing to perform the service.  Yes, they have their reasons, but the bottom line is that I did not get what I paid for.

Ok, I guess some of this is on me, since I was unaware of their car wash expiration policy, and did not attempt to redeem the service within their prescribed window of availability.  I'll own that.  I'm not the kind of person to storm into the office and demand to see a manager over something like this.  But at the same time, I do not have to give any more of my business to Fast Eddy's, and I think it would be dishonest of me to give a positive recommendation for this business in light of this situation.

After the attendant firmly reinforced that I can't be allowed into the car wash, he noticed that there is no way for me to pull forward out of the car wash lane.  I am sitting in my car at the entry gate, and he says I have to back out.  The funny part is that now multiple cars had gotten in line behind me, and the guy now has to direct traffic to clear the path, so I can back all the way out of the car wash area.  

This experience was quite a change from events at Fast Eddy's in the past.  Fortunately, there are plenty of places to buy gas and propane.  More and more high quality car washes are popping up all over the place, and I can get wine elsewhere as well.

They do a fantastic job here! The food is fresh, homemade and local and service is spectacular. I had the Idaho Cheesesteak sandwich and my co- diners had the Salmon BLT and the Flat Iron Veggie- we couldn't quit talking about how good everything was!

Since moving from Northern Virginia I've been looking for a taco joint that can come close to comparing to my local favorite. Calle 75 comes pretty darn close. They were out of a ton of stuff when I visited, which is disappointing. No brisket, no al pastor, no queso. However, the two tacos I tried were really quite great. Calle stuffed as much as possible into that little taco, including a ton of great flavor. My only gripe is the price. They should really be at least $.50 less per taco. $7 for two tacos? Not really street tacos price.

Great Mexican food! Service is excellent! Huge portions and tasty all around. I had their pollo a la crema; it was creamy, the chicken moist, and super cheesy! Done so well I will be back to eat it again and again and again. This place is well worth the visit!

I ordered the mole enchiladas, the plate was extremely hot which is expected but what was unexpected was that my mole enchilada wasn't even warmer than room temperature. The waitress never checked back on us. I never leave reviews but the service wasn't great and the food was mediocre tasting at best. I will not be coming back ever.

I don't think the people working here could be any slower. I'm standing here like I have been for 30 minutes and that line was that long really. The girls are literally walking a quarter speed and staring at each scoop of ice cream as they put it in the blender for an extra 3 seconds. I'd consider actually hiring people that can move faster than a snail if you want to get this place thriving.

If you know what steak burgers and frozen custard are...and you like that kind of thing...you will love Freddy's! We had one in Phoenix and I've been before- so of course I was excited to see one pop up on Eagle road. Very attentive service, the manager stopped by and played with the kid a few times and of course the food was good :) I have always been a big fan of food concepts that do something simple as long as they do it well (in and out comes to mind) and Freddy's does just that. It's a change from the ordinary, it's reasonably priced and it's quick service. If you've never had it, go and give it a try!
Great coffee house, looking for local spot. Will return when in town !  Easy to get to and the staff was polite and had great customer service skills!

Blackened Salmon was bomb-dot-com. Well, let's be real, you can't really ruin something like that. 

Oh and Fun fact of the day: Finger steaks are purported to have been first served in a restaurant setting at Boise, Idaho's "Milo's Torch Lounge" (aka The Torch) in 1957. Milo Bybee claimed to have invented finger steaks while wondering what to do with leftover tenderloin scraps when he was working as a butcher for the U.S. Forest Service in McCall. 

Only a true Idahoan could really appreciate these little "fingers", which Pinnacle does a great job with. Try the Honey Mustard- It has fresh herbs.
Delicious! I got the Gwen and holly roll and it was one of the best rolls I've had in the valley. The gyro was also divine. I'll definitely be back.
I love this place, Lisa is the best. My eyebrows are amazing!! I go every three weeks.  You have a customer for life!!

If I could give zero stars I would. Bought a Groupon for this company. When I called the message said to book online. The specific service that the Groupon was for, massage and relaxation something or other had absolutely zero available appointments for as far ahead as I was able to view.  So it was just bait to get you to book something else and then have to pay for it apart from Groupon. 
Groupon even contacted them but I got no response from them.  This place is a joke. An inconvenient joke

I've been back multiple times and still the same great, delicious food experience. I have a favorire Salmon BLT that has never been topped, so I'm hesitant to try them at other places. I have to say, Grammercy's is my 2nd favorite by far. It was great being able to sit on the patio with our dogs as well. Just made the experience that much better!

I love Calle 75! 

I have eaten here several times both on their cart and out at The Village. Dang it, I always order the same thing but I think that is a sign of a happy tummy. My mother's favorite is the Outlaw Torta. She loves the combo of the brisket and the bbq sauce. The Chan Chan Torta is my go-to bite here. The carnitas, spinach, pico, aiola, and the avocado chimichurri on that amazing bun!! Gets me every time.

I have slipped away from my normal a few times to try their street tacos. The gringa and the chan chan are worth the extra dollar and will melt in your mouth! Put a little dabble of the red salsa on top and you will be good to go for some extra spice.

My dad gets the shrimp burrito every time and I would love to tell you how wonderful it is but my father never offers up a bite. Which means it is amazing! 

Facilities out at The Village in Calle 75 are always clean, staff are usually friendly with smiles.

I don't travel out to Meridian often but when I do it is to fill my tastebuds up with Calle 75.

Very 1950s feel to decor, and music. But the menu is cool screen. Food was great price, and we left filled UP to burst! Kids loved it, they ate every bite and that's saying something. Custards after were excellent, portions super generous. Would absolutely go back.

Stopped by Mi Casa again with the family last night. After our first great experience, we decided we needed another go. 

The service was just as overly friendly and very attentive. They do not let you want for anything here.

We tried the Queso Fundido - very good, the chorizo was a touch on the dry side but nothing to really complain about, we had no problems polishing it off.

My husband had the same as he did last time, crab enchilada - he reported it was just as good. I tried another new (to me) item, the sopes w/ chile colorado. They were good but I felt missed the mark on flavor - the chile colorado is like stewed beef chunks in a red sauce. The sauce definitely could've used some tweaking in terms of flavor. The beef was very tender.

The sope itself was also a bit boring. I realize it is just the vehicle but I feel it could have benefited from some additional flavor. The texture is a bit strange, it's kind of like a really dense biscuit that has been flattened out.

Left me wishing I had ordered the mole! Oh well. Next time.

Even though my slight disappointment in what I believe is more personal preference than anything, we will most definitely be returning!

I'm Mexican and can tell you this place is the real deal! Authentic, fresh, and delicious. The portions are large and the service is fast and friendly. The chile relleno and carne asada tacos were fantastic! Definitely my favorite Mexican restaurant in the Boise area.
Upscale FreshMex that always maintains a very clean restaurant. Burritos are very good, and i will come back for sure.

Just moved into the area and was looking for some great deep dish pizza. I should have come to Yelp to look up reviews before coming here. Seriously the worse Chicago style pizza we have ever had. Nothing special at all about this pizza. They get 1 star only because facility was super clean. Unfortunately they didn't even get our order correct and we were the only ones in the facility. Not going back. Salad bar is a rip off as well.

We eat out often and for some reason have never tried Gramercy Park, we visited for the first time last week and will definitely be back! The staff & service was great and the food was amazing!! Highly recommend the Italian grinder but everything we got was good!

Great addition to the Eagle road corridor, and overall a solid rendition of a trendy favorite. The portions were a good value, the fish--while not amazing--met expectations, the accouterments were varied and fresh (except the avocado, which they should prep a la minute instead of far in advance to avoid browning), and the service was fast and friendly. I will definitely be back!

I wasn't expecting anything luxurious....it is Motel 6 afterall....but I wasn't expecting this. 

Housekeeping woke us us every morning starting at 8:30 by knocking on each door and loudly yelling for housekeeping. We could hear them several doors down. Not everyone gets up at 7 am during a vacation weekend. 

Shower had very little water pressure. A normally 10 minute shower took twice as long. Bathroom area was clean and well stocked but had terrible pressure. 

No fridge. I was hoping to have a fridge but apparently we didn't get one. Not the end of the world but would have been nice to have cold drinks in the room.

Found gross hairs in our ice bucket. Thank goodness for plastic bags. 

Bed was not comfortable. Super hard. It was difficult to sleep because of it. Would work well for those who prefer firm beds. Bonus, loved the 4 super fluffy pillows. 

Room door did not close properly unless you let it slam or pulled/pushed against it, depending on if you were coming or going. Found it rather odd that the door didn't close properly. 

Tv turned off after about 2 hours of being on the same channel. So while watching a movie it would suddenly turn off unless you messed with the channel or volume. Energy saving measure? 

Air conditioner worked great. 

Definitely would not recommend.

Was one of the nicest motel 6 stays I've had! I always stay motel 6 because of their awesome pet policy! This one was clean, very spacious, front desk personnel were personable and welcoming and booking was seamless through motel6.com. I'd definitely recommend staying here for a quick nights rest. Only thing is that we heard the toilet running and some other water/pipe noises in the morning which woke us up.

Finally!!!!!! Someone in Boise understands what authentic fajitas taste like! We ordered fajitas to go,  and honestly,  I wasn't expecting much because NO ONE in Boise gets it.  This place gets it! The meat is actually marinated and has flavor.  The onions and peppers are cooked to caramelized perfection.  They know that mushrooms have NO place in a fajita.  What a concept.  The tortillas taste hand made and are very fresh.  The salsa is not just tomato juice with an onion floating around in it.  It has a wonderful flavor.  After trying literally every Mexican restaurant in Boise,  this is the only place that will have my business from now on.  Very impressed with Mi Casa!

Slowest AT&T store ever. Don't go here. Go to Apple to buy your phones. It's the same price with better customer service. I literally watched 3 reps sit around and chat about the weather, cars and and a whole lotta nothing for over 45 mins without even being greeted. And then when I was 45 mins later I was asked if I wanted to make an appointment?! Really?! #1 ask me that when I walk through the door so I don't waste my time. #2 if you do bother to talk to me, at least ask me what I need. Especially when your store closes in 3 minutes and I still haven't been helped. I really hope someone reads this, hopefully someone at the management level. Lance, Frank and the other guy are HORRIBLE and need some basic skills in customer service.

Fresh food cooked perfectly! Burgers, fries, cheese curds... Yummm!
NEVER forget the desserts either. Look at the kids faces when they see them!

Took a friend here for a birthday lunch.  Service was very good, prompt and competent.  We ordered a large pizza and a red barn salad to share.  My guest thought the salad was excellent.  It had apples, candied nuts, and very nice salad dressing.  The pizza had pepperoni, artichokes and Italian sausage.  It was also good and more than enough for two.  My only disappointment was that they charged an additional $2 for a "split plate".  I am not sure if that is because we shared the salad or the pizza or both.  I could understand if we ordered one item and split it but we ordered a full size pizza and a $10 salad.

I think I found my favorite place to eat in Idaho. On a Saturday night we were able to be seated immediately due to plenty of open seats in the bar area. We didn't get carded which was impressive! My husband always gets carded over and over bc he looks so young, which can get annoying, especially since neither of us drink. The decor was gorgeous. Had a fancy look too it but also had the feel of a sports grill with TVs. The food was unique and delicious! The best combo for me. I had a spicy peach burger. That is right, PEACH! One of my 2 fav fruits made into a compote on a burger. It was probably the best burger I have tasted! Loved every bite! My husband had the Hawaiian type pizza which had my other favorite fruit, pineapple, and it was also huge and yummy! Waitress did an amazing job attending to all our needs and the price was not bad either for us poor college students. Perfect date night out!

Most everything that mattered about this meal was on the poor to average side. The carne asada burrito was below average, meat was a little tough and had other "pieces" in it, not sure what they were. The rice and beans were below average, not much flavor. I really liked that they give you beans with cheese to go with the chips. Chips themselves were just ok. Salsa for the chips was watery. The presentation over all was really nice as was the couple that was there that served me. The service itself was on the better side but not great. No one checked back after they served the food till after I was done, there was one other person eating there. I had high hopes for this place due to the other reviews, not sure if this was just a bad day but I doubt I'll be back.

I have been working on growing my hair out for 5 years and have worked on getting it to the length it Was.  I went in for a clean up of my ends (3 inches).  I left with a nasty mullet cut.  How does a trim turn into chopping off all of someone's hair.  So disappointed with the services I received and would never recommend this place to anyone.

Calle 75 tacos is a wonderful place where you will  find authentic Mexican food with layers of flavor because they do everything from scratch. an amazing and satisfying dining experience. If you're looking for the real deal this is the place! The atmosphere is exceptional as well kind of like dinner and a show with the water features just outside the window. The Baja tacos and burritos are my favorite

Very surprised at how nice this place is.  I expected a sports bar but this is actually a pretty great little restaurant.  The service is AWESOME.  I met a friend here for dinner on a Saturday night - had a drink at the bar (sunken in the middle of the restaurant, very cool) while I was waiting. Tried the italian lemon drop - not my favorite, but that's just me, it was too sweet.  Moved to a table for dinner and had a salad and the mahi mahi fish tacos, both of which I loved.  I am definitely looking forward to going back here, my husband will love it.

We asked some pretty straightforward questions about the menu and it took going through 3 baristas to get an answer. The coffee taste is absolutely awful, I don't know if they just don't know how to make shots or if their Machine is dirty. Needless to say I will not go back for the coffee, but it has a great lounge.
Just moved in the area and wanted to try this place out. I ordered the LowRider pizza. It was amazing!! I look forward to being a frequent customer and trying other items on the menu.
Our favorite Mexican restaurant, just moved from Phoenix, my Wife is from Mexico - all we can say is - Yumm

I love this place and always have.  Been getting pizza there since the 1980's.  Deep dish, ton's of cheese and the pizza there is just excellent!  If you are new to town, I would definitely try them out!

Really good. Not something I could personally eat everyday because it's very rich but the quality was very high and flats were great. Staff was very helpful. Nice and clean which is what you want with raw fish. Highly recommend.

I eat here too much. Very addicting. Maybe they add crack to their burgers? Who knows. Either way you just can't get anything better than a Bacon Cheeseburger, "all they way", no pickles (because no one actually likes those vile things!), with BBQ sauce.

First off, I will just say, by reading the other reviews, it's a little hit and miss here. Unfortunately, it was a total miss for us. 

New to the area, were more than willing to try new places. We love neighborhood bar and grills, pubs, and places where the environment looks fun.  We came in at noon or a few mins before, on a Friday. The server was a little too blunt, too rude for our comfort. For instance, my wife asked if there was a substitute for Cole slaw.  The servers response.  "Haha nooo!  It's a take it or leave it kind of thing. Manager found out we were subbing it, and he was pissed. So no!"  Went ahead and ordered the steak fingers. These were barely edible. I feed my dog better looking meat than this stuff. The burger wasn't bad. My wife and I shared the burger instead. Kids meal was over priced. And informed as we are more than ready to leave, that the kids meal comes with fruit or something else. We say fruit.  The waiter returns to the table again. And says, "they are preparing that fruit, and it will be out in a few mins". We wait. A few mins later a fruit cup that is pre packaged Dole or something slides across our table. It was literally something you put in your kids lunch, cause it was sealed and all. 

Come on. I felt like I was being served lunch from a used car sales man, and needed a shower when we left.

The staff had an attitude that they were something special.  This was not at all proven.  The place reminded me of a high end Chili's or Applebee's.  The food was OK, but definitely overpriced for its quality.  It took forever to get refills from the bar.  Another 1 and done establishment.

Stopped in here after some shooting practice at the nearby gun range. Loved the atmosphere, lots of TV's to watch the game on. Service was quick and attentive. Pizza was excellent, soup also delish! We will be back when out in Meridian.

Love coming here to see Tianna for my face wax. She is always so nice and energetic! Because I am always on the run, I really like how quick yet detail oriented she is and we always make sure we get me ready in no time. I have a full face package but I never know exactly what I want to get done before the day of my appointment so it's pretty awesome that I can decide when I get there without rescheduling or calling ahead.

Right off the bat, I'll say I really do enjoy the food that Calle 75 puts out there. It's delicious! Calle 75 has been around for a while now with their food truck/trailer that makes its rounds around the Valley, and it's delicious. I'm glad CenterCal gave this local biz a chance to live among the national chains at the Village (it's right next to Yard House and Kona Grill). Unfortunately, I can't justify eating at Calle 75 as much as I'd like because it's such a poor value. There's not a lot of food for the very high prices. I know the Village is geared towards the affluent Meridian burbs, but at least the Yard House has cheap happy hour specials late at night. As for Calle 75, my belly screams yes, but my wallet mutters no. For the sake of loving local business, I hope Calle 75 survives the Village, but for me it'll have to stay as a rare splurging treat.

The best Mexican food in Idaho! The food is fresh, flavorful, and authentic. The service is great, and their new location (2 doors down) is three times the size, so there is less of a wait time. You must go and try the El Molcajete, it is so good! All of the enchiladas and carne asada tacos are also delish
Love this place, the waitresses were very friendly and the food was yummy. Great service and the best mexican food I've had in the treasure valley. Eating it to-go for dinner again tonight :-D
This is my favorite restaurant!! We have probably tried 5-6 different items on the menu and have loved every single one!!

First time here good was ok nothing great. Had the finger steaks which were extra greasy and had very small pieces of meat in them.

The table chips were ok but cold. My wife liked the prime .

Bottom line is you can get better food else where for cheaper.
Clean, spacious rooms, comfortable beds.  Free breakfast could use some improvement.  Friendly staff.

Front desk is not attentive.  They seem to ignore status.  Rooms are horribly designed unless you are traveling by yourself.  Shower curtains hang too low so you are stepping on curtain while showering.  Thin walls, so traffic sounds all night.  Breakfast buffet is stocked with variety, but actual food is poorly cooked and layout of buffet makes it a circus to prepare your plate.  

Overall, don't waste your time here.  Just go to the Courtyard down the road a block or two.

When dining solo there is really nothing more disappointing then walking into a restaurant/bar and there are no open seats at the bar -OR- you have to take that single open seat uncomfortably close to strangers which nobody wants to do. 

Never have had this problem here. Big bar, lots of seats and each one is covered by multiple TVs.

Anyways out of 5, the food is about a 3 (it's a sports bar, not a steakhouse), atmosphere is a 4 (once again it's a sports bar, not a steakhouse. It's a sports bar atmosphere) and staff/service is also a 5. Not sure of the bartenders name that seems to always be working but he is top-notch. 

To sum it up... awesome wings, cold beer, lots of TVs and some cute waitresses. What else can you ask for in a sports bar?

It's a very fast food chain.  Most deserve a single star but I am giving it two stars in honor of my wife who enjoys coming here, and the curly fries, which are craveable and  memorable.  The sandwiches are sort-of diet approved if you take off the top bun.

Honestly, though, nothing at this restaurant is very good except the curly fries, and none of it is healthy.  Big national fast food chain, 'nuff said.

Wow! Lexi is awesome! My hair is obnoxious. Part frizzy, part straight, super puffy, but fine, or thin. Grays. Lexi made me look smooth and sleek. She managed my hair, and deserves the title PROFESSIONAL!

The tacos were great!  We are visiting from California and this place was recommended by some of the local workers at the outdoor mall here.  Decent sized portions and fresh food made to order.  My only complaint is limited selection of fountain sodas.  We have some of the best Mexican food available to us in SoCal and this place holds up well!

Called first thing this morning and got right in. Everyone was extremely friendly and helpful. As a former salon owner and current licensed hair and makeup artist, I have very high standards on cleanliness and proper sanitation and disinfection habits. The salon was very clean, everything was packaged and labeled appropriately. Jenny did a fabulous job on my nails, she's very gentle and she's so very sweet! I had a set of acrylics removed (from a different salon) and a gel manicure. I will call ahead of time to request her when I go back in a couple of weeks.
Great chill sports bar. Plenty of games on, and speakers at the table. The reuben was great.

Been here twice. Excellent beer and, just as important, excellent service. Beers from breweries in many states, ranging from pale ales to triple IPA's to unusual ciders. 

Staff is knowledgeable and happy to give as many tastes as you need, also just generally cool people. 

Lots of fun merchandise, sweatshirts, a variety of beer receptacles, great stuff!! Overall  highly recommended for a great growler fill or for a pint. Also, check in on Yelp for money off growler refills or other great coupons!

The staff was So friendly we loved our one night stay here. The rooms were huge and we had a full kitchen with all the fixins. The price couldn't be beat either for a two bedroom with a kitchen. The beds were on the firmer side but most hotel beds seem to be.The decor was updated and beautiful and for being pet friendly you'd never know because the room was so clean.

Just had a pizza and sushi, and it was absolutely delicious! !! Can't quite explain how good this place is. The service was amazing and quick! Do yourself a favor and try this place out, you won't regret it and it will more than likely become a favorite!
Very small. not good at all we all feel like we got ripped off. Like a paper plate with toppings on it won't be go back.

I have been to this Lucky Perk at least a dozen times.  I use it for big orders to take back to an office.  I fax over the order the day before so it is ready for pick up when I get there.  They help you to the car with the coolers filled with yummy drinks.  I am rarely there when there aren't a lot of people.  It has a rather large sitting area.  I would say at least 25 tables.  They are very quick with drink orders and there is also a drive through.  I would say the worst part is the parking.  yes they have a parking lot but if there are 10 people sitting inside, and a line of people there are zero spaces.  The nearby lots all have if you park here you will be towed or for our customers only.  The drink options are endless really: cold or hot coffee's, smoothies, sodas, etc.  They have food as well (bagels, sandwiches, yogurt etc).  I wouldn't continually to give them weekly business of at least $50 if they were not a friendly and EFFICIENT place.  Let's face it you want your dang caffeine and get out.

The employees were super helpful in showing me how Poké works. I had never had it before and they showed me the best things to get. For $10 I was completely full with the small bowl. The miso soup was delicious as well. Great little shop and I'm glad I found it
Great Mexican food!!  Order the El Molcaje - delicious, unusual and enough for two!  Servers were very efficient and the chips and salsa come with beans.

Calle 75 has some of the finest tacos I've ever had, and I've had my fair share of tacos. They have a blend of traditional flavors and innovative combinations that you won't find at your standard taco shop. Everything there is great, but the al pastor tacos are truly amazing. The staff is friendly and the service is top notch. Don't miss the chance to eat there; you won't regret it!

Amazing place...service is top-notch. Food is absolutely awesome, especially the gluten-free crust option! The staff is more than accommodating, if not compensating for something! ;). Definite recommend if you're dining in Boise (Meridian) and DIG pizza and customer service...

I absolutely love 360 wellness! Brittany is amazing! She works around my schedule and helps with my two year old while I'm getting treatment! They have lots of toys and a little playhouse for the kiddos as well!
Their "4 step treatment" has really helped with my headaches, neck and back pain! (Vs just an adjustment)

My son and I have both been treated by Dr. Payne in the past two years.  I am in my forties and needed some ortho work.   Dr. Payne helped me decide the perfect treatment for the problem I wanted to take care of.  And my teeth look great!  My son also needed treatment and just got his braces off recently.   His teeth also look great!  Dr. Payne and his staff love to have fun and make everyone feel welcome!  I would highly recommend giving Dr. Payne a try.   You won't be sorry!
We ordered a dozen donuts and they are very tasty. They were ready very fast. Pick up service was great!
Love this place! So excited to have this store in Meridian!

Great food and service!   We split fajitas and there was so much food we didn't finish it.  Had leftovers to take home!  That never happens!!   Everything tasted amazing.   Thank you for such a great meal.  First visit we went to celebrate my birthday and I was made to feel extra special!  I really enjoyed the extra touch!

This place is really good for a Mexican restaurant. The food is different from other Mexican restaurants I have been too. Really stands out from others. Definitely one of my favorite Mexican restaurants to go to!
We connected with some special $3 Black Friday vodka salads.  Yummy and a great buy! Food choices include giros, pizzas, sushi, and gelato.
Now this is as good as it gets! Icing is unlike anyone else's and they cake is so moist. Only complaint is sometimes they take a long time to get your order.

First let me say our family has patronized this restaurant since it opened and have been there many times. All of them good if not great.  However , this time
we had a not so great meal with poor service and then it became worse . We attempted to pay with a $100 gift certificate that we purchased at a school auction we were treated like we were running a scam. The manager questioned us multiple times on where we got the certificate and who gave it to us and was unprofessional in his behavior . I.E. He barked this across the restaurant " I don't even know these people" " anyone could've made this". Completely embarrassing. I told him exactly were we purchased it and when( he asked for the date, why?) .I just said we will just pay it. He then continued to lecture us on why he couldn't take it . How the restaurant needs to make money , etc..We told him "we get it " and actually had to hand him our credit card to get him to leave. We received a new bill which for some inexplicable reason had now been divided into two separate tickets. Why? A bizarre dining experience. The owner contacted us after our negative review and again explained why they couldn't take what we had  and then stated that we shouldn't have "badgered " his employee which did upset me as we didn't . The owner did contact BK (my daughter , wife and I are all  graduates as well as current parents )and asked them to refund us which was a nice gesture( thanks for that ) but we're happy to make a donation to BK.  I think we all had wished it had never had happened .

Kind of an unusual experience, I'm assuming. I'll start by saying that the service was really outstanding. The two young ladies waiting on the whole restaurant were insanely polite and on top of it, in terms of refills and our gastronomic needs. I ordered the fajitas mar, tierra y cielo (beef, chicken and shrimp). They were great and flavorful, if a little greasy, but the shrimp were easily the best part. They came in a nice, rich, red sauce. The beef and chicken weren't extraordinarily flavorful and the beef was pretty tough.

My poor vegetarian wife, who had been dreaming about a vegetarian burrito, couldn't really get what she wanted. She asked for a burrito with whole pinto beans, rice (which she couldn't have, as we found they are cooked with lard), fajita veggies (bell pepper and onion), cheese, sour cream and guacamole. What she got was a tortilla filled with steamed broccoli, zucchini, mushrooms and baby corn... odd to say the least. She also got the whole beans, but the cheese, sour cream and guac came on the side. To make matters worse, the burrito was seriously floating in soup. Presumably, it was mi casa sauce, but it was watery and soaked the tortilla.

Well, after my wife finally fessed up to thinking it was gross (and it seriously was... I had a bite), one of the waitresses said they wanted to have the chef remake it. They did and it still wasn't much better, but we really, really appreciated the thought and consideration.

So great service, interesting food. Not sure if I'm raving about the authentic qualities of this fare, like others are, but I'm probably still spoiled from living in Los Angeles. You could do worse, in terms of Mexican food in the area, but it won't be worth the drive for us to come back here.

Having moved here from Vegas I was ecstatic when they opened Freddy's here! We used to go to the one in Vegas all the time...that being said I didn't think they could improve on what we thought were the best burgers in the west. I was wrong! The Meridian Freddy's is definitely fresher, hotter and better than the Vegas store. I was floored.
