We went the first day and I wasn't expecting to be blown away (being the first day and all I was going in skeptical but was pleasantly surprised) 

Their burgers and fries are great. If you have ever been to a Steak N' Shake, it's the same concept. Super thin cut fries and hot off the grill steakburgers. The double w/cheese is the best. Also a nod to their Vienna Beef Chicago dog, although it is not on a poppy seed bun as it should be, it's a valiant attempt. (and the best we can get here in Boise) 

Frozen custard is much richer and creamier than ice cream, give it a try! 

So happy Freddy's is here!!!!!

Frozen Custard? Try "melted molasses".
Stopped by last night with my wife for a frozen treat. Ironically, the soupy cream was thin, while the overly rich flavor was unbearably thick. I'm guessing they added tons of the flavor and not enough ice cream. Regardless, I couldn't possibly eat it.

I don't usually rate gas stations but I saw the lonely one-star rating and had to stick up for this awesome place. 

Their gas prices are usually already 2 or 3 cents lower than the nearest Chevron stations, and they give you an additional 5 cents off per gallon if you use your Chevron/Texaco credit card to fill up (so that means I save usually 7 or 8 cents per gallon). They have a full service car wash on site that cleans my car perfectly. I've had no problems with a pump malfunctioning - I always get my gas. 

The convenience store is absolutely awesome. It's super clean, it's got a great atmosphere and a great selection of food and drink - including beer and wine. It is one fancy c-store. And the bathroom is one of the cleanest I've ever been in. This bathroom would seriously put 5-star restaurant bathrooms to shame. But enough about that.

Awesome staff. Super friendly, always enough people running the registers. These guys take pride in a clean store. I always get gasoline here and will continue to do so, since it's super close to where I work.

This McDonald's is pretty good with service...  my order is always correct and the team there is friendly. My only issue was with this last visit, the morning team allowed a car to stay in the drive though despite how long it took to complete the order. There were several cars backed up -- and people were mad. Since this was 7:30am on a Workday, it just wasn't an ideal situation.

This place is pretty new (a couple of months) and the staff was great.   The kitchen however needs some help.
The kitchen was SLOW and the food was just OK bording on bad.
I had a steak - it was close to the worst rib-eye I have ever had.  It came with a free piece of pie.  After one bite I knew why it was free.
The interior of the place is really cool - lots of TVs and a nice bar.   

I would give them another few months before you check them out - the kitchen needs a lot of work.

Laid back but also relaxing atmosphere
Good service just amount great food
I got the cheese steak it was a really amazing sandwich and fries the waiter checked often and made it easy to get service
  Very pleased
Quick, fresh and delicious. Ordered 3 street tacos carnitas baja style.  Wish I had tried more!

I really love this Fred Meyer. Always so clean and inviting. I always notice something new and interesting when I stop by whether I'm in the grocery side or home and garden side. I always check out their manager specials and have been blown away at times what great deals they have. I'm so happy Fred Meyer is so close to my house and have been a happy rewards member for years.

This place is hot off the presses. I went there with my family the day before opening night and was definitely excited the moment I walked through the door. The general atmosphere is very cozy and modern yet there's still a feeling of being right at home once the food starts coming to the table. They have a great selection of Northwest beers on tap as well as wine. Our lovely waitress brought us some homemade potato chips for us to munch on as soon as we sat down. They were the BEST chips I've ever had. Excellent seasoning. I could go there, have a couple beers and eat those chips and be perfectly content. But to make matters even better, I ordered the cheesesteak. I'm from the east coast so I take my cheesesteaks very seriously. 

I've never quite had a cheesesteak like this. It's like they marinated a huge pot roast and let it cook all day, then served it on some delicious buttery artisan bread. Swiss cheese and sauteed onions on top. MMMMM!!!! So delicious. My Dad had the Pork Belly Mac & Cheese and that nearly blew my mind with flavor. Either of those dishes I could eat any day of the week. The fries were also fresh cut. None of that frozen crap. Again, topped with their own excellent seasoning.

I will be making many trips back to this place. I haven't even tried the pizza yet, but if it's anything like the food I've already had, I'm sure I will be in heaven. Definitely one of those places you want to return to just so you can see what other delicious discoveries you will find. Highly recommended!

The ice cream at Coldstone is always amazing and the portions are normally generous. But this review deserves only a 3 star because of their waffle bowls. The past several visits have resulted in a stale and almost inedible waffle bowl, and today they were bland and tasted like cardboard! I know from experience of working at a Coldstone way back in the day as one of my first jobs, that the waffle cones should be made with a generous portion of cinnamon and stored properly to avoid them becoming stale. If I could do it at 17, so can your employees. I splurge at Coldstone and pay the extra money for my waffle bowls, please make it worth the money and not just a reason to grit my teeth while enjoying my creamy and delicious ice cream.
Great service and an amazing selection! Fun environment and great information if you have questions or are looking for a new recommendation! Check them out!
Went there with the family today for lunch, we had a pizza, Thai tacos, and Idaho cheesesteak. Good service and the lemon basil salad dressing is amazing.

Usually really good food and service. Today, place only 1/3 full, took 15 minutes to get my salad, and shrimp way undercooked. Used to love this place.  Took shrimp back, no one seemed to care. Too many other restaurants in the area to return.

This is close to a 5 star review for Poke Bowl.  I have been in probably 6-8 times in the short time they have been open. That's how much I love poke.  

Here is the mostly good, and a couple odd, tending toward negative impressions I have:  the choice of white rice, brown rice, or salad is great.  I get the 'regular' bowl which is 3 scoops of protein.  Portion control is a smallish ladle in each protein.  Just in the last few days they have added a scale, so I asked how many ounces come with the regular bowl and was told 6.  That seems adequate and fair on their part to control their expensive proteins.  It makes a big meal and I often put part it the fridge and finish it later.  But tonight the server put a metal tablespoon in the bowl on the scale before she added in the fish.  I asked about that and she just gave me a sheepish look.  I don't know what a metal tablespoon weighs, but I would guess it's an ounce or so.  This seems weird to me. 
The sauces are very good, but honestly I have only had the regular sesame and the chile soy, so there are many I have yet to try. They put a generous amount in the bowl and mix in the proteins.  (Seems to me this would be the time to add the metal tablespoon to the bowl.)
Next, on to the toppings, 5 of which are included.  (Avocado costs extra.) There are great options and each time I have watched them prep my food, they add 2 of their spoonfuls to my bowl.  Not tonight.  I hardly was given any seaweed salad, and a much less amount of the other toppings than usual.  I had to ask for more seaweed salad as one of my 5 selections. 

So in summary, the food is great - fresh and good for you.  But I am concerned they are getting carried away with the portion control, especially the part where they take away from the protein by substituting a metal spoon as part of the weight.
Killer food and the most awesome people you'll meet... Oh, and the location is great!

Great people who are always willing to answer your questions and point you to the right beers.  They have over 50 choices and will give you a sample before you make a choice. The Growler Guys also have great prices.
Service is extremely slow and they really are a limited  sports bar. Food is good but signs for ever to get your food or your drink so you can

If you want a higher price, higher service grocery store, this is a good one. I'm too cheap to shop here for everything, but I do buy lettuce here regularly ($.99, much less than Winco) and I like the deli for mortadella and capicolla. 

I'll be a consistent shopper as  long as the produce stays cheap. 

If you don't like Winco, this is a great place to shop. Better selection than Albertson's, friendly staff, and they take credit cards. 

Add a star to my review if you are not price-sensitive.

Love this place.  Owners are amazing and the service is just fantastic.  Staff is well trained and always super nice and friendly.  Anyone who would not give this place a good rating needs to go back as it truly is well run and managed and the quality of food and drink is great.

I was in Boise for a soccer tournament and was looking for a quick bite and I refuse to do the Big 3 hamburger places.  We found KB's on Yelp and it was around the corner and I'm a fan of tacos and burritos.  I first noticed the simple menu!! It's wonderful and all you need.  The staff (or manager) was excellent and helpful and answered any question we had.  We enjoyed looking at the photos on the wall of the people wearing KB's gear around the world.  Very cool.  I wish we had KB's in Utah.
It's a thin crust pizza with super fresh ingredients and emulates any other pizza out there.  It's a hometown local business and not a chain. They definitely deserve all our support!
Amazing service!  Chimichangas were the best I've had in meridian. Locally owned and operated. Will be back for sure.
Priced high, don't price match competitors, bad customer service... I'll go with competitors every time

This is one of our very favorite places in the valley. The Gramercy Bites will change your life. The flat iron veggie sandwich is possibly the best thing on the menu and I'm not even a vegetarian! TRUST ME, order it!
Very clean, nice, and large with awesome huge TV's. One star downgrade because service is very slow

I had a great experience here! Helen did my gel manicure and was very sweet. The place is very clean and I LOVED that all the tools were opened individually in sterile packaging for each person. She did a super cute design on my nails and they turned out great! Gel mani was $29 plus $5 for the design so a little pricey for me, but I really enjoyed it and will be back for sure!
In town for a business trip and stopped by KB's for lunch.  Great FRESH and heathy fish tacos for everyone!  Clean crisp flavors!  Fresh homemade salsa!  We will be back

Went today for lunch with the fam...overall, am a fan. A few points...

- To be clear, this is NOT New York pizza...I don't think they bill themselves as such and it doesn't mean it isn't good, but it's not classic NY pizza.

- We arrived right when they opened and I'm not sure the ovens were as fired up as maybe they always are. The only complaint I had was that the bottom of the crust was not really as crisp as I generally like.

- Good tasting crust, good toppings and a good sauce. We had 3 different varieties and all were good...no other food other than the pizza but the menu or sandwiches and salads looked good.

- They do take and bake which I think is a great idea and a good option to the big national chain.

Overall, a good local pizza option...we'll be back!

I was overjoyed when I heard that Sur La Table was coming to the Meridian Village.  I've shopped in this store in several different cities and I'm always amazed at the variety of cookware, utensils, appliances, and just about everything one needs in the kitchen.  The other plus about this store is that it accommodates every price range.  It's not a specialty store, it really caters to people who enjoy cooking but don't want to spend a fortune.  That's not to say that there aren't pricey items to buy there-----take for instance the coffeemakers.  When you enter the Meridian store often times a salesperson will offer you a cup of coffee.  More than likely it's from the top model barista style espresso machine which will run over $1,000!  But never mind there are other models that are less expensive.  At any rate, I'm glad this store is here and I've already made several purchases.  I'm also considering a cooking class here and there are many from which to choose.  It's also just fun to browse and see the latest offering in cooking gadgets!

Dr. White is fantastic! We started chiropractic care for our four-month old son about 6-8 weeks ago. I was desperate, when he was super fussy one Saturday afternoon. I searched for someone open on Saturdays and Dr. White was one of two in the area. I called his office because he was closer. He was able to fit us in, last-minute, just before he was supposed to close.  My son did a complete 180°. 

After our first visit, my skeptical husband was not only convinced that we needed to switch providers, but that chiropractors actually knew a thing or two. ;)

My son had some symptoms, like irregular breathing, and his physical therapist and pediatrician wanted to order a swallow evaluation, to check for aspiration. Dr. White reached out to some friends, did some research, and informed us of the amount of x-ray exposure that would've required. I feel that he's the ultimate, when it comes to informed consent. This wasn't even a procedure that he would be performing, but he went out of his way to assess the risks and benefits for us.

My husband now goes to see him, without prompting. We'll continue seeing him for adjustments, as needed and he of course comes with our highest recommendation!

Yum yum yum. Get the double California burger with pickles and some of their fries. Husband loved the double bacon burger. Custard was also fantastic. Great place when your craving a nice cheesy burger and fries.
I love Mexican food! It's a hit or miss with Mexican and this place was a hit' I had the seafood enchiladas and it was exceptional!!!

I have been at this Freddy's 2 times. I hoped that my 2nd experience would be better. The floor where very dirty and every sandwich I have had, has been dry and tasteless. The only good thing I have had is their custard, but I think that is a hard thing to mess up.

Kanak Attack catered food for my wedding and it was delicious and the service was excellent!  I received so many compliments and the guests seemed very pleased. They were also decently priced so I was able to provide an entree for my guests rather than appetizers.  I would definitely recommend them!

Favorite place in town.

Every time we have family visit from out of town, we bring them here. We tell them they have to try the amazing food. At first they don't believe us, until they try the first bite. Then, instant hit and they call and talk to us about the great restaurant we took them to.
If you try a pizza, try the Manhattan, it has wonderful flavors. The other favorite of ours is the Vanilla Basil vinaigrette on the house salad.
Although, in all fairness, everything we have tried here is wonderful.
Atmosphere is nice, and the prices are reasonable. If you go to their website they have the menu and prices you can view before hand.

It's always packed and you might have to wait a short while, but well worth the wait!
I highly recommend this gem of a restaurant.

Best pizza. Love thick crust with a lot of cheese. Annoyed everyone I call and ask what the dining room specials are they say none. But when I go in, I always see a dine in special written on the black board.
They really took their time getting all the bugs off my grill. But the brushes totally missed my roof.

They've gone steadily downhill since opening. My visit last week was awful - it took them 25 minutes to make my tacos (there were 3 other orders). When I got them they were covered in pepper seeds and were so hot they weren't really edible (I had my friends try them and they agreed they were way hotter than usual and too hot to eat).
Super yum. Carne Asada tacos are the best. Great variety and great service. Guys there are really nice. Favorite thing to do is grab some tacos and sit by the fountain.
Always great food and great service. Camarones Mojo De Ajo is amazing. The hot seafood soup is great as well. Havent had anything I didnt like. Stick to there specialties as they are all awesome.
I love this place! I'm so glad to see them in ID finally! The service & food was great! This will be a regular stop for us!
Awesome staff and delishas coffee. You have to try the 911! Lines are long, but service is quick.

AMAZING food! I had the fajitas and they were the best I've ever had! The chicken was moist and the veggies didn't end up getting burned like at most places. My husband had the street tacos and said they were great. Great beans and rice, too. Fast and friendly service. Highly recommend!

Food: 10/10 (great for fast-food style food)
Value: 9/10 (perhaps slightly overpriced, but for fresh fish in Meridian, very worth it)
Atmosphere: 7/10 (casual environment, very clean, nothing special. But great staff)

Fish was fresh and delicious. They give you a good amount of fish and toppings.

My family loves this place! The employees are always so nice. We happened to come in on a day that the owner was in and she spent 30 minutes with us picking out cakes and flavors. My kids loved the samples. The best cake around!

Pretty good burger joint! My band and I went to Boise, Idaho, and decided to try out Freddy's because it was recommended to us. We were pleasantly surprised! They had friendly service and were patient with us as we fumbled over the menues. I had the vanilla custard with mixed strawberries. I ordered a small but it was still a pretty large sized portion. Their shoe string fries are good too, filling. Fry sauce was tasty, too! If you have ever tried In N' Out before, this is sort of like that, but better and with a larger menu. :)

We decided to stop at Freddies and give it a try today.  I had the bacon cheddar burger with fries and a chocolate shake. Everything was very tasty.  The burger was juicy and had good flavor. The shoestring fries were seasoned and were served hot. The shake was very thick. We will be back again. Go ahead give it a try.

Dr. White is the man!! Office is clean and staff is friendly. Highly recommended! Came here aight unseen and was let down. Doc fixed up me up and I was on my way. Great results! My go to when mah stuff is all jacked up!

They have a large selection for those who are gluten free. Their donuts are vanilla or chocolate base with toppings put on to order, so not a typical glaze. The donut base itself is more like a muffin which was a tad disappointing for an advertised "gluten free donut". I think the base is primarily protein powder. 
After reading a few reviews, I was less skeptical about there being an after taste, but it very definitely tastes like stevia- almost overwhelmingly so. If you don't mind that taste, they would be pretty good. Unfortunately, I don't enjoy that taste so I really struggled to finish a whole donut. 
The price was understandable for what it is- a borderline muffin made of protein powder and stevia- but a bit steep for my liking since I didn't really enjoy the taste. The strawberry cheesecake donut was the most palatable. We purchased 4 for $10.
I love Five Guys!  The best burger and fries around!!  I have yet to have anything that wasn't good!  The service is always great!!  Super friendly!!
LOVE this place! Cozy atmosphere with plenty of seating. Amazing breakfast burritos and plenty of options for coffee, drinks, and pastries. Very nice staff. Plus a drive thru.

This used to be our favorite sports bar for some apps and a drink.  This is our first visit after the ownership change several months ago.  Service was fair to poor.  The nachos were lousy,  and the wings fair if u like barbecue sauce just poured over.  My wife's margarita was served in a beer glass and watered down.  We had to ask for napkins for our fingers, and no finger towelettes -  go figure.  We won't be back-

We loved this place when we lived here.  Today was really disappointing!  It was dirty (and not busy at all), service was poor, and the salad bar was unappetizing.  The waitress asked if we wanted cheese and pepper for pizza and then never brought it and disappeared.   They only get a 3 because pizza tasted pretty good.
Best wings in town. Get the wings cooked with the extra time. Love the Korean flavor when they have it. The seasoning on the fry's is sooo good.

This is our second time here. Still floored at how great the food is. The kids both have gotten pizza which is completely legit and have given us leftovers to take home (yes....the kids pizza). Last time, I had the Salmon BLT and I was beyond amazing. My husband had a spicy peach burger. Surprisingly full of flavor and in my top three burgers of ALL time. Today, we split the Vanilla Panzanella Salad (with salmon) and the pork belly. The salad was so good. The salmon that came on top was a FULL filet, perfectly cooked. The whole thing made me fall in love with salads again. The pork belly was on top of cheesy grits and had crispy spinach which I was so intrigued and impressed with. My kids even asked to eat the spinach because it was cool and delicious. The entire meal was awesome. Oh we also had the vegetarian wings (cauliflower) and it was worth buying again. Great flavor. Great texture. The service is on point. Not too distant. Not too clingy and extremely friendly. I think we have found our new favorite place in town! (Oh... I'll post pictures NEXT time we are here. The food looks so good that I forget the pictures as I'm grabbing my fork!)

The menu is large, and most of the dishes are TexMex.  The food came on large, screaming hot  platters, but the retried beans were thin and spread out about 1/8" deep. The rice and corn tortillas were ok, but not special. You can taste the guajillo chiles in the Chile Colorado sauce, but the small beef chunks were very tough and did not taste like they were marinated and slow braised in the sauce, more like the beef was cooked separately and the sauce was poured over them. 
There are many other dishes to try, but the lackluster performance on the Chile Colorado makes me unwilling to go back.

My garage door was in need of repair so I started calling around. I was getting quotes to replace the whole garage door operator, upwards of $375 plus the keypad and remotes that come with it.

I called AGD and explained the problem. Within a minute, I was quoted a price for a fix--without having to completely replace the unit. I scheduled an appointment for the next day but had some time restrictions. They were willing to work with my time restraints and almost exactly one day after calling (roughly 24 hours from first call to finished job) the door was fixed, and working flawlessly.

Highly recommended!

Just ate lunch at Mi Casa and it was great! My wife had the al carbon tacos which were delicious! The meat was tender and the tortillas were fresh. I had a lunch special (1of  more 2 dozen specials) of Carnitas burrito with rice and beans. The burrito had a delicious sauce over it with mexican crumbled cheese. The carnitas was tender and perfectly fried. It was only $7.25! My wife and I had 2 meals and one beer for under $20!!! Chips and salsa are great and come with refried beans to dip in. My wife's family is mexican and this food is just as good as her families recipes! Great place and will be our place for great mexican food.

This place is one of my favorite fresh eateries. It's easy to navigate the menu and plenty and raw and cooked options. It's a simple experience as far as dining goes. My favorite item to order has been the "bowl" and the serving size is great! I expected to be skimped with the raw fish but they are generous portions with more than enough tasty toppings to polish the dish. 
They also offer GLUTEN FREE sauces!!
Get creative! It's hard to go wrong!

ok people we have all had the general poor experience at a drive through window, we all have had someone forget to put something in the bag and driven off only to realize it when we sit down at our kitchen table. but when that disappointment is compounded by the fact that the staff are rude and look like the just rolled into work after going on a binder and sleeping it off in their work clothing for two days solid, that is where I draw the line. I wont say I'll never go there again "because I am weak willed when it comes to a bacon ultimate cheeseburger" but I will say that I am not happy with their choice in employees!
Love the staff and food. You can count on good quality handmade soups, pizzas and sandwiches. In This area, you'll find no better consistent quality and service.

Far from home, on a road trip that had already racked up 12 days of power travelling, we looked like we had been dipped in pink mud after which a squadron of bugs had attempted a kamikaze attack on our car hood, grill and windshield.  They needed a proper burial, and our victimized car needed a proper bath and vacuum.

Not too far from our motel, we discovered there was a Fast Eddy's.  It had a convincing number of great compliments from the Yelp community.  Unfamiliar with this particular chain, but familiar with the drive-thru, do-it-yourself concept, we lept into action.  

There were several guys standing at the entry holding strong pressure hoses and long handled, soft brushes soaked in soapy water.  We asked for a little extra attention in the form of more time with the pressure spray and some serious scrub action so those dead bugs would soften and be ready for the next step, the e-ride through the whirling dervish drive through.  They were ready for the challenge and that is exactly what we got, a great preliminary scrub down. What a refreshing attitude compared to a similar business we frequent in California. The car came out the other end with very little bug residue and a nice blow dry.

Then, off to the free, self-vacuum, an extremely powerful suction that made a mockery of the dirt inside. This again was far better than our similar California business.

And last but not least, clean, soft rags were made available for wiping down those remaining drops and most stubborn of bug carcasses. The car looked pretty darn good.

$10 well spent, which included an undercarriage wash and protective seal.  Such a deal.  We were very happy!  And yes, we still smooch as we are guided through that watery tunnel. Tradition.

I wish Fast Eddy would open up in my home town.
Amazing place! Fresh fish, delicious choices of sauces and toppings, fast service, just plain fantastic.
Couldn't ask for a better place to watch sports or just hang out. The staff is awesome and treats you like family, food is flavorful and delicious, and a great selection of beers on tap.
We have been here numerous times.  Every time its great.  If you are looking for some good eats give this place a shot.

We love Baja Fresh and went out of our way to eat at this location. So we were especially disappointed with the experience. We are used to the extra time for food preparation at Baja Fresh in comparison to other fast food places, but this was the slowest one we have ever been to. Ordered a burrito with sour cream, but didn't get any. Syrup was weak in all of their pop flavors. The women's bathroom was out of order so there was some waiting to share the men's. Compared to all other fast food places it was OK. Compared to other Baja Fresh restaurants, this was the worst one we have been to so far.

I'd never felt like I'd had a bad hair cut before but after going to cut loose I feel like this is the worst hair cut I've ever had. I'll be honest it's not terrible it's fine but I don't feel like a got what I wanted. I thought I could trust the opinion of the girl cutting my hair and she cut it how she thought would look good but I really don't like it. Not to mention I asked her to cut it fairly short and it was still a mid length. It was the end of the day and I was the last customer (I can't go anything other time because I work full time) I felt like she had checked out and was uninterested and in a hurry to get off work. Probably won't be returning for their services.

Finally got to take the family some were new and wound up spending way more than intended on burgers and fries. The food was not bad but in my honest opinion it was nothing special.  So we went try the frozen custard and not only was it just as pricey but I have made better at home. Was very disappointed the only thing I liked was the decor.

It would be a GREAT sports bar if they had sound! I can go and listen to any bar and listen to music.  Nothing worse than listening to music at a sports bar.  Yes, they have the sound for the BSU games, but otherwise it's music.  Real lame!  I will give them credit for having speaker boxes, you must request them.  But the ambiance is not the same without having actual sound of sports, put something on for god sake.

I've been to this location multiple times over the past few weeks & my experience tonight finally prompted this review. 

The ice cream is good for a chain. Having had truly hand-churned, hand-packed ice cream from a little tiny Mom & Pop place when I was a kid, I'll never attain that level of flavor ever again from a chain store but it's certainly better than in a grocery store. 

The store is neither a shambles nor super clean. I don't use public restrooms so can't speak to that.

I recognize several of the employees as being there from the previous times I've been there. Not a single one of them ever greet a customer with a pleasant affect: no smile, no pleasant "how are you today", absolutely nothing other than a curt "what can I get for you" & then grim mixing of the order. It used to be that if you tipped them - and i DO still tip them although they do absolutely nothing to deserve the tip - the employees would sing all together & it was just a fun experience, especially for kids. I don't know when/why they stopped doing this. Every employee looks like indentured servants who are only a few months into their 7 years. 

My complaint that prompted this review may seem petty but was one of those small things you just can't believe an employee would take so much time to provide the opposite of customer service: My daughter asked for the medium size, Love It, with a waffle bowl for her order. She received a generous amount of ice cream in her bowl. So much so that she couldn't take more than a few bites. 

We wanted to take the remainder of it home. They design their packaging in such a way that the waffle bowls cannot be taken home intact in a cup with a lid. Hers was still so full that it just made more sense to fully transfer the whole thing to a larger container altogether - like a container for the takeout ice cream, in fact. I suggested this to the employee when asking her for a take home container, and she responded by handing me a teeny plastic lid made for the Love It cup. I explained that even breaking the waffle bowl down it was going to cause the ice cream to gush over the sides given how melted it was at that stage (and also make the waffle bowl totally a mushy mess by the time we got it home). She continued to insist and describe to me exactly HOW I needed to break the waffle bowl down in order to fit it. I then brought it to her to show her, thinking she would see the sense of just putting it in a bigger container or maybe even just breaking it down into two smaller ones?

MY MISTAKE. I wish so much now that I had paid attention to her name, but I actually am not sure they were wearing name tags. If so, I didn't catch her name. She had to ask someone in the back how to go about fitting this ice cream under & into the lid she wanted it to. She then chastised the girl who had *made* the order for overfilling the waffle bowl & making it too difficult for her to fit it under the lid & break up the waffle bowl. She went to a LOT of effort to not give me anything but that small plastic lid, in other words. She gets a very high mark for conserving company funds in not handing out any extra packaging to make a customer happier. I was so shocked at her determination to make me UNhappy that I admit to loosing a choice word on her regarding her efforts to not allow me a 25 cent container and then walked out. 

The other poor reviews on Yelp should be discouraging to those considering getting a treat here as well. Until the owner considers some employee training on customer service I just don't consider it a viable option for ice cream any longer. I will go to another ice cream vendor in town before I'll give another cent to Coldstone.

So sad...we thought it would be great food...the management was really great...however, do not order the Ruben if you're looking for the stacked corned beef...and hubby ordered Italian sandwich with so little meat he was shocked. Too bad...nice place.
Good burger, willing to grill all your veggies, and damn good fries! Love it in spite of the health risk.
Don't wait your money. No flavor in the sauces, the fish was soggy. The spring rolls were passable.
Amazing service with a unique concept. Loved the Moroccan crust and balsamic glaze option. Will definitely return. Possible to pick up before a night at the Shakespeare festival.

I would give 0 stars if I could. They do not honor the sales they promote when they have signs hanging in the store announcing the sale. Furthermore, VS credit card holders should be treated better considering we pay outrageous monthly service fees for using our cards. I will shop online before I ever return to this location.

I had the pork carnitas burrito at the suggestion of the server.  The meat was cooked to my satisfaction, the sauce was good and the peppers fresh.  There was quite a bit of burrito to eat here.  We also started with the queso dip, which was good, but not good enough for the $6.95 price.  I'd definitely go back.

These guys made my filthy, dog hair, covered, food and drink spilled mini van look brand new again. I have 3 kids and a German shepherd that trashed my car, I couldnt believe how clean they got it. They are amazing I will be going back

I've been to HD shops all over the world and this one is by far the most active, helpful, professional, and personal. Tons of rides throughout the year, lots of activities, always have food and beer, and support local schools and organizations.

Scotty, Logan and the other guys at the parts counter are outstanding. Always willing to dig into each order and be sure to get just the right parts.

Levi, Misty, Shane and the others in service are awesome. They explain everything they're doing, are flexible with the schedule, and recommend the right steps every single time.

Ryan Bayne, DJ and the others in sales are excellent. Not pushy at all. Willing to start up any bike on the floor. 

Jenesis, Tara and the other gals in the gear dept are always helpful, happy, and fun to talk to. And they don't get upset when you try on 5 different shirts and don't buy any of them! ;)

TWO THUMBS UP FOR HD-HD.

We had the lettuce bowl tacos and they were very flavorful. Very friendly staff walked us through the menu and how to build your own dish.  They were good to change things like switching sauses to less spicy choices.  I will come again and recommend this spot to others.  Movie theater near by is a bonus

The food is okay at best. The service however leaves something to be desired. I have been there a few times and almost every time I have to stop else to get my server so I can get my check after waiting for about 20 minutes after my meal. During the meal the server is hardly seen as well. The only good thing are the $3 mimosas and bloody Mary's on the weekends.

Total and utter garbage. Quite possibly the worst and most pitiful hamburger I've ever eaten. All you get is too nasty looking patties with a couple onions and two pickles on it. Some lettuce and tomato that would be nice. Have you ever eaten anything and then wish you hadn't eaten it just so you could go eat something else. That's how I feel right now.

This used to be one of fav places, but has gone down hill as per the few customers we encountered during the dinner hour.  The tables and booths were pretty much dirty - even the one's that appeared to be cleaned. Onion rings and kids chix tenders cold, nasty lettuce garnish on rings.  And, what happened to the bake potatoes?  Cashiers used to be super friendly - not tonight.  Just a blah experience - not returning anytime soon.

These Donuts are soooo tasty! I was surprised that they tasted so good for how low calorie they are. I had a cookies and cream donut and it was so filling. The shop is so cute and inviting, will definitely be going back and telling all my friends! Thanks for making such a yummy treat more nutritious!

My only real critique of this place is that some providers, who I won't name (because, you know, retaliation is a real thing) don't have the most kid-friendly bedside manner. That said, these folks are all business, which means they are all about taking care of your child. That's worst case scenario, which is pretty darn good for a "worst."

Best case: my kid is so damn in love with Frisbee that he will point to his most recent area of discomfort and say, "Doctor?" We finally figured out he wasn't ill; he was using his last illness as an EXCUSE to come and see Dr. Frisbee (who, apparently, talks in some awesome voice that little kids just love).

Apologies for not remembering her name (I want to say it was Meredith) is the one I always seem to get along with very well. She is very professional and comports herself in the way you'd expect a doctor to, but breaks character around my kid, joking around, playing and chatting with him.

Again, my "worst case" was supposed to make you say: "Really, sounds pretty good to me."

Because it is. This place is great and is populated almost entirely with people who, more or less, want to get down on the ground and play with your child as if they were their own children. We love taking our little boy here and, soon, our next little one.

P.S. They have an awesome, ocean-theme (a la Finding Nemo) play room for kids with toys and video games and great ocean-related art. Kidtopia!
Been coming here for a year and love it.  While they have a high turn over rate for staff it appears they still have great staff! Definitely would recommend them!

The drive thru window was overcrowded, but the service I got was more than I had expected. The woman who handed me my food was cute and told me "be careful, the fries are very hot" I know this isn't much by any means, but coming from a McDonald's. I thought it was very sweet of her. My food was ready in a short while as well.

I love, love, LOVE the crust! Family run and really cares about the quality of the product they serve. Try the east coast style calzone! Is not just a pizza folded in half. 

If you're in a hurry they have pizza by the slice or take and bake. The home baked isn't quite as good as when they cook it in their oven but it still beats Papa Murphy's hands down. I won't go back!

My wife and I went for lunch today for the first time and it was excellent! Having moved to Meridian from Twin Falls a couple of years ago, we were delighted to discover that our Server used to wait on us in Twin Falls at La Fiesta. What a small world! The menu was extensive, the food was hot and plentiful and tasted great. The grilled chicken tacos were perfect. And the service was excellent. This will be one of our regular spots for Mexican Food!
Eclectic mix of cuisine, with everything very nicely done. Sushi, pizza, and gelato at our table. Nice place to get away from the ordinary.

Seriously how did this place get good reviews?  This place is gross and NOT authentic Mexican food.  I just moved here and decided to check it out based on the reviews and I regret it.  Do NOT order the Margarita, it tasted old with a musty after taste. The chips and salsa are not freshly made, which is inexcusable. I ordered a taco and an enchilada...again NOTHING here is fresh. They served my "crispy" taco lying in the beans, making it impossible to eat by picking it up, which is the whole point of a taco.  You could buy all of this pre-made crap at the grocery store and do a better job.  We ate half then gave up, paid, and won't be back.  Gross.

Great place to catch a game and comfortable booths.  The food is sub par at best.  The app platter is what you would find anywhere else.  The chips are a nice touch to munch on while drinking an ice cold beer.  There was a weird energy with the service staff.  It's hard to put my finger on it, but there was a tenseness that fill the air.  I overheard a server at her station tell her boyfriend how much she didn't make tonight, oh and the bf was camped out for an hour by himself, taking up a booth.  The bartender was the bright and shining light of it all. She was on top of it and very refined and friendly.  Might come back for a beer and a game, but doubt it.

Great location right in the heart of the Village.  Grab your food and you can sit inside or outside next to the fountains for the hourly show.  On the first visit I tried the carnitas, carne asada, and crispy pork belly.  Now the first two were darn tasty but that crispy pork belly in pepper jam is absolutely incredible.  Definitely up there in some of the best tacos in recent memory.  The doubled up corn tortillas are nothing special, off the grocery shelf variety.

Recommended, will definitely be back.

I love the layout of the building; this place shares the same space as the Asian fusion restaurant, Rice Works (also highly recommended). It's a beautiful location with comfortable seating, lounging in a chair or a couch. Cool, relaxed and casual. 

There's a lot to the menu; anything you order, be it a taco, burrito, torta, or any of the specials, has a choice of protein. I loved that they offered shrimp and fish, and funny enough, potato. I ordered the torta and it was amazing; soft, fluffy almost gourmet hamburger bun. The next time, I tried the huevos rancheros and street tacos, both excellent. They also serve craft sodas which were also tasty.

I was a big Wing Stop fan from California but haven't been to one in over 10 years.  I was super excited to try them out when I heard they were in Meridian.  I went there last night.  I read a review that their fries were salty and decided to just do wings.  I ordered 10 bone in wings which came with 2 sauces.  I did 5 wings Lemon Pepper and 5 wings Mango Habanero.  It seemed like it took a while while there was only one order a head of us but I love hot (temperature) wings so I didn't mind the wings being fresh and hot.  When they finally came, I was disappointed at the size of the wings.  My friend's boneless wings seemed to be decent sized.  Since the price of wings have skyrocketed over the years, restaurants decided to market "larger wings" so when these bone in wings got to me, I thought I had ordered quail wings.  They were fresh and seasoned well and tasted great but way too small.  One of the reviews said they don't charge for ranch or bleu cheese but THEY DO charge, FYI.  I ordered 10 wings and a side of ranch for almost $10 (just water, no drink).  I thought it was a little too pricey and although they were good wings, there is better out there with bigger wings.  My friend got a combo plate with fries and I tried the fries and they were salty and I wasn't a big fan of them.  I am sure they will do well having a drive through on a busy street but I will stick to my other spots for wings.  Location is a bit quirky in the Lowe's shopping center on Eagle/Ustick.

I'm not really sure how to rate this salon... The girl I had was nice and she was ready for me when I walked in. The shop is nice and clean. The problem I had was that the haircut I got wasn't the greatest... I have really short hair and I just like something that I can just put some gel in and go. The haircut I have sort of does that but not all of it is blended very well. One side of my head has a pretty noticeable chunk that was not blended at all. I think honestly she was rushing to get to her next client. It's just kind of frustrating though because the haircut was $30 and I gave her a $5 tip because I always tip at least something. But what I got for $35 was not worth it especially with how short my hair is.
My first time here was for my 3 year anniversary. We ordered the croissant sandwich, and wow it's amazing! They are so good and the guy who works/worked there was so nice to us.
First time I went was great not a long wait. The older gentleman did my nails I forget his name but he was Super fast, gentle, and did a beautiful job!

I took my grandchildren here while on vacation. Everything was laid out for us with artistic consults if requested. Went over and beyond to get our projects back before we flew home. Thanks so much for the wonderful experience!

I love Dutch, BUT I won't be going back to this one. Maybe it was an off Saturday morning. They weren't very friendly, well the person taking the order outside was, but not the people making the drinks. It took a long time considering there was one person ahead of us. The outside of cup was covered in sticky syrup AND the drink was wrong. Good thing there are other ones around, I stopped at the next one I saw where they were super friendly, fast and happily remade my drink. (All I ordered was A coconut americano w cream). I think I would feel differently if they were at least friendly but they were far from it.

Great food all around!  I love the lunch fajitas and the pollo a la crema burrito for lunch too. The people who work there are super kind and quick to refill the soda. The Diet Coke is good too.  Price is what makes this place so great too. A great value and experience.

Dr. Payne is the greatest orthodontist to ever walk the earth. Why does he not have any reviews?  Because all of us are trying to keep him a secret from the chuckleheads out there who do not understand what true orthodontic art is. 

My kids were not only plagued with the horrendous bite of early civil war era spittoon cleaners, but the rickets and scurvy that often accompanied their thankless trade. That was, until Dr. Michael Julius Payne bent stainless steel to shape and refine their teeth - nay their very souls. 

They say that Leonardo and Michelangelo were more than mere men or ninja turtles. To say that their works are simple "paintings" would similar to reviewing Dr. Payne's work as mere dentistry. 

So stay well away if you've ever non-ironically considered drinking Dr Thunder or Mountain Magic. This man is the real freaking deal.

Great place to grab a beer or cider!  Has some amazing ciders on tap for growler fills being gluten intolerant the cider options are perfect. Ace pineapple is my favorite. Right now they have a Ace pumpkin cider which is fantastic and delicious! Swing by grab a quick drink or a cheap growler fill it for a great price and enjoy responsibly of course!  Plus don't forget to sign up for the rewards program!!
LiKe the lemon pepper and garlic parm... Fries are delish. The combo is the way to ORDER. -enJOY!

BEWARE: I've come to realize this dentist just wants your money, really pushy about getting dental work done 'right away' when it doesn't need to be. Make sure to ask for your 'monthly' bills, or they think it's ok to just wait for your whole family to be seen then send you one large bill with no breakdowns on it!
This place is okay. I ordered the Alaskan Salmon Filet and it wasn't bad, but also not the best. It was a little dry. Overall this place is average.

I love Chronic Taco.  The deep fried potato taco is unique and delicious.  Chips are hot and fresh - good guacamole.  I also like the black bean soft taco.  A million times better than other fast food Mexican places!

I live right around the corner from this place and am ashamed to admit I have only been here 3 times. That being said, however, I have found each visit pleasant and just what I was looking for.

There are tons of big-screen TVs, so you can catch just about any sport that's currently on. Happy hour has very fair prices (things get a little more pricey when it ends, so if you like big beers for good prices, Happy Hour is the time to go) and the food is pretty good. The beer selection is moderate, but pretty pedestrian. They do have a 25 oz mug though, so I can pardon the somewhat mediocre selection.

My first visit, I went alone because my girlfriend was having a ladies night at the house, so I went for a quick beer (which turned into 3) and a personal pizza. The beer was cold, big, and delicious. The pizza was great. Oh, and they will give you a basket of chips to munch on when you sit down.

In subsequent visits, I had hot wings and finger steaks. The wings were great, but I found the finger steaks lacking. All things being considered, this is a great place to go if you're in the mood for some sports, a friendly atmosphere, decent food, and a big, cold beer.

We tried them out for pizza.  Pizza was very soggy and grease filled.  I do realize cheese can attribute to this.  But, Pizza hut/dominoes is better.

Tonight, we forgot to to pull something out for dinner and I had already been to the store.  SOOOooo... we decided to give Chicago Connections another try since they serve things other than pizza.  So hubby got the french dip sandwich.  Au jus was good.  But barely anything inside the sandwich.  So... um $9 for bread with a sprig of meat and cheese.  I got the gyro salad.  Last time I checked, gyro meat was supposed to be soft and moist, flavorful.  Not burnt to a crisp.  I have a wonderful picture of the so-called gyro meat.  Uh yeah.  $9 for that salad.  I would of been better off with mcdonalds.  Fool me once, shame on you, fool me twice, shame on me.  Lesson learned.  Will never go or order from this store.

Nice place to stay with great rooms. Loved the showerhead better than at home. Very nice staff. Could not give it 5 stars because there is very little  soundproofing & we had to purchase ear plugs to get a good nights sleep. The breakfast was also just mediocre.

1st time here.  Lunch was delicious. The fish n fries great - subbed tradition for their garlic. Well worth it. 4 good size pc of fish batter dipped very good. Husband got the shrimp & penne. Good size portion & he said very tasty.  Will be back as there is still several items on menu I'd like to try. Many tables had their own TVs, or good views of the large TVs.

We were here relaxing before they closed & I asked 3x what time they closed. We were completely ignored, the 2 guys were on their headsets talking to each other then my nephew asked again & before we finished he yelled back at us & says 9. And when we first arrived no one was here & one of the guys said I will be with you in a minute it took them 5 minutes to help us, definetly customer service issues needs to be addressed by this guy for sure!!!! We were here on evening of August 27th.

We placed a catering order with Baja Fresh to cater for 50 people and it's as good as it can get!

They were super prompt in delivering the food and setup. I over ordered and had a ton left over for the next few days. (which no one complained about)

It came with:
- Salad + dressing
- Pinto & Black Beans
- Flour/Wheat Tortillas
- Steak/Chicken
- Fresh Tortilla Chips
- Salsas, Limes, Guac
- & all the tableware 

We got the Fiesta Fajita Bar option. The food itself was well seasoned and not too salty. The ingredients were fresh and the chips were still warm when they arrived. 

Everyone loved it!

Well organized, friendly and no high pressure sales!  Very patient and explained as much or as little as needed.  Worked with me on the price to get what I wanted at the right price.  In fact, everyone I talked to was a Vet.  Highly recommend Kendall for your next vehicle.

Awesome place to come enjoy beer, whether you're enjoying tastings, pints, or finding your latest favorite brew to fill a growler with! I went in for my first time and was happily greeted by two employees. Both were very friendly and helpful with suggesting beers to try, and I enjoyed talking with them about beers we've enjoyed lately. The tap selection is huge! There's definitely something for anyone that comes in; they even have some ciders and kombucha. They have tons of different growlers and beer glasses you can buy, and a few specialty beer bottles. Whenever I'm in the area, I will definitely be in again!
Excellent menu choices, excellent meal! Service excellent. Highly recommended family owned and run business.

I received a Brazilian and the girl did an amazing job. It lasted months! The ripping off the wax part was the least painful experience I have ever had in the treasure valley!! It was so smooth, no bumps. They have a special wax specifically for their company and its amazing. I just wish their was a location closer to where I live vs their meridian location. But if the results are this good, yes it is worth it!!

Made my third visit to Mi Casa today for lunch. I first tried them for dinner about a year ago and was very disappointed. I cannot remember what we ordered (which probably says something) but what ever it was we decided not to return. Fortunately for us, my wife went back for lunch several weeks ago and fell in love with their Chicken Avocado soup! Took me back to try it - very, very good. Today she stayed with the soup but I branched out, going with the Chili Verdi Pork Enchilada w/rice and beans. It was a five star lunch! I now regret waiting a year to return, which tells me I always need to give places a second chance.

So why only four stars? One of my favorite parts of visiting Mexican restaurants is the chips and salsa. Mi Casa serves chips, salsa and bean dip. Chips were okay, could have been fresher, bean dip was fine, but the salsa was thin and runny - I know, its not a deal breaker, but it was a disappointment.

But overall, we are happy eaters

There are some really good things about Freddy's. I've had good service there and I do enjoy their shoestring fries. Steakburgers aren't my thing as they tend to end up as a less juicy version of an Arby's sandwich. That said, if you are going to put frozen custard in your name, you have to do it right. 

Freddy's doesn't do it right. 

Frozen custard should have a really smooth but really firm texture. It can't be runny. It shouldn't taste like a Wendy's frostie and that's what you get here for triple the price of a frostie (Not that I mind a frostie). If you want to know how custard should taste try Ted Drewes in St. Louis (hands down the best) or even Nielsens in Rexburg, SLC, and Vegas.

A friend of mine swears by this place.  I prefer a place in Boise.  Anyway,  she got me to go there finally and the experience was terrible. We showed up on time and they told us we were early by a half hour. We checked and they were wrong and they admitted it.  Then,  we waited for nearly an hour to get just a polish change on my toes and fingers.  No one seemed to know what I wanted even though I explained over and over again. No one could tell me the difference between gel and shilack when I asked. They told me that it was the same thing. However, the same girl that told me they were the same also later told me it was different. Anyway,  I just wanted gel polish on my fingers and toes.  Seems simple enough.. you'd think... after waiting almost an hour past the scheduled appointment time, we finally sit down with someone.  I ask that my finger nails be filled and trimmed to the same length. I like them short, seems easy enough. . Wrong.  She didn't make them even and she used a freaking drill to take my old polish off -- which happened to be gel polish from my favorite place in Boise done over a month before -- this making my nails very thin and weakening my nails to the point they would fold where she didn't shorten them as I had asked! Ugh... anyway,  they got me all painted up with what one girl called shilack and one called gel --who the heck knows -- and it actually looked decent.  I loved the color. So we leave and literally the next day my finger nails are chipping already.  Within the next few days they were pealing off. Now,  if I was a person with no life, no job, ect. I would have taken my disgruntled butt back over there and asked it to be fixed. But, I don't have time for that -- nor should I have to in the first place -- which is why I'll never go back.

Best Mexican restaurant in the Boise/Meridian area. Just simply delicious! Been a few times now and every time it's awesome! Super friendly people as well! They just moved into a new place that's more spacious and super cute inside. If you love Mexican food, this is definitely the place to try! Mi Casa plate is my favorite, but the chicken fajitas are probably the best I've had :) yum!

Needed some last minute puu-puus. Sunday afternoon turned out to be a little challenging finding something everyone agreed on AND a place that was open. 

Great selection of fish and toppings for a create your own poke. Everything was very fresh. Came up with a couple ono  combinations.

Fast friendly service. Glad we found this place.

It's a really cool place. I didn't know about it at first until my step niece told me about it. It's not a chain, but it looks like one. Love the huge projected screens and they even have a few booths with personal tvs. they hedge great beer and their burgers are.....freaking delicious! You can't say no to their bacon burger !

Seriously thee WORST pizza place I've ever dealt with!! I placed my order online and it took 2 hours for it to be delivered. Then when my pizza came, it was very obviously upside down in the car. All the toppings were stuck to the lid and it wasn't even warm!! 
I tried to call the manager, I called for 30 minutes and got a busy tone ever single time. So annoying. Won't ever give this place my business again.

Great menu and comfortable gathering space for grabbing a refreshing bowl or cold press juice elixir.  The focus on quality is evident once you start reading the ingredients to the first bite.  It's great to have a cold press concept similar to what you see in Portland, Seattle or Denver.

Went for the first time. Food was very good but very slow. Waitress's first night on her own she was trying though and very friendly.  Like the food enough to try it again two days later. Pizza was very good. My wife had their grilled macaroni sandwich which was GREAT. We will be back for sure
Not that great. Winco's grocery store sells better tasting wings--their salt and vinegar. They are delicious and less cumbersome on the pocketbook. Actually, most reasonable!
Pleasantly surprised, this place is great! $10 is a little steep but it's more than enough food. The staff was friendly and helpful, I'll be back soon!

I had a great salad in a beautiful atmosphere and was treated like a house guest.  If you are in the area and want a nice place to sit, have a beer and something to eat, take a trip to Gramercy Park Pizza.  The owners and staff are really friendly and they go out of their way to be sure you are satisfied.  I will come back again.

I agree, this place is GREAT! Had a salad (try the vanilla basil vinaigrette, good stuff) and a pizza (Manhattan, also excellent). Had to wait about 10-15 mins on a Sat evening, but the service was prompt and very good. I'll be back for sure!
Excellent service! Started when we first walked in. Staff was very nice and helpful. Food came out fast. I had the carne sada burrito. It was Muy Bueno!

I have been waiting for this franchise to come to Idaho.  I ordered 7 bundtlets and 1 large bundt cake to give away as gifts to co-workers.  The cakes were decorated and ready go within a short amount of time. The recipients of the cakes were pleasantly surprised! 
Great job!
I had been hearing about this place left and right while visiting and HAD to try it. I had the white zombie which wasn't to sweet or bitter. It was great, and the people there seemed to be hyped up

This place is tops. Came to see it for the very first time and was blown away. I could not even believe how awesome it was to be able to get a grocery list taken care of and grab a couple of things from the clothing rack. Great deals on Carhartt and Columbia.

The place was super clean and when I was just checking it out since I have never been in one, was stopped a few times asking if everything was ok and was I finding what I needed. Thought I was until I went over to the other side of the store. 

They had a deli that was amazing. Got some meat, cheese and was ready to go home and tackle a nice size sub. I am definitely looking at coming back her and do some more shopping. Thanks to the amazing staff for the great and friendly service.
Nice place, lots of screens. Service was fast & good. However, the food is only so-so. I won't be back... too many other places nearby with much better food.

Excellent, friendly service!  Extensive menu with many choices and accurate descriptions of the dishes, including many photos of actual plates.  My wife had chicken enchiladas Verde, accompanied by refried beans and Mexican rice.  I greatly enjoyed the pork fajitas, served with refritos, rice and flour tortillas.  The garnishes included generous portions of pico de gallo, guacamole and shredded cheese.  The pork was tender snd flavorful, and very juicy.  The topper of the meal was the perfectly prepared sliced onions, red and green peppers, and more melted cheese.  Best fajitas I have enjoyed in many moons.

Top notch service, great food, reasonable prices... can't ask for anything more!

Absolutely thrilled to have listened to our friend's recommendation to try Mi Casa. Service was good and the establishment was clean. Now let me share how impressed we were with dishes we ordered queso (cheese dip) to start with their fresh and warm tortilla chips then ordered El Molcajete and Carne Asada Comination with chicken chimichanga. All so good and so much food. This is definitely going to be our "go to" Mexican restaurant.

Technician, Jeremy pay attention to fine details. His professionalism and skills was exceeding my expectations. He repaired my mom's garage door quickly. I had used AGD quite awhile ago. I am so happy the company is still around.

I was looking forward to trying these donuts after seeing them at the 1,000 location opening for Orange Theory. But sadly when we actually went and ordered some donuts we were a little disappointed. The donuts are super dense and smaller in size then a typical donuts. There is a strange icing that is on a lot of them underneath the "flavored" icing that doesn't taste that great. I am a big donuts fan so these just didn't cut it for me. I feel like it was good attempt at making a healthy donuts, but very bland.

Can't find anything wrong with this place! 

Drive thru was packed with the line out into the parking lot! Every table was filled with a fast moving line inside! With that said I was SHOCKED  how fast our order was completed!

Awesome staff, went the extra mile and brought our food to us out on the patio!! 

Everyone devoured their burgers! 
Brownie custard sundae was delicious, will order again!
My mom was also impressed with the Turtle Sundae she ordered! 

Good quality all around!! 
Will be back :)

We love coming to get bowls and juices. They have excellent flavor and very fresh ingredients. My favorite bowl is the PB& J and I ask for macadamia nuts to be added to the top. They are always so accommodating to my request. I highly suggest giving them a try!

First time being here since they opened & boy can I say, they will be seeing me often now! Great, friendly service & the food is even better! To top it off they also have teriyaki bowls to so everybody has a fix! Brought two home with me a chicken and a beef & my brother & dad were stoked something so good is finally close! Keep it up guys!!
Our first experience was not great-- but the management had reached out to us about it.  So, for their effort, I am giving them three stars-- will update later.

Meh. It is an okay Panda Express. Only one friendly person working at the front counter. If you come in while they are busy the food is fresher. Chefs seemed to be happy and on task.  

Watched one of the front workers make faces whole waiting for an older lady to order. Not impressed.

my husband and I brought our 2 young children in and I appreciated the staff being quick, efficient and accurate. I forgot to look at name tags but the young lady and young man that helped us were very nice and a pleasure to speak with.

Great Pizza and super nice staff. Come on down and support another great local place. Most likely be ready to pick up as they only have 3 tables to eat in. That is ok because for these folks it's about the pizza and the passion. Great job Relic. I'll be back.

AMAZING!!!! This was my second time there, and it's where I wanted to go to on Mother's Day. This time I wanted to try the Molcajete. Bye-bye burritos and tacos. This Mexican "stew" of chicken, steak, prawns and cactus was what I've been waiting for all my life. Even if was boiling the entire time in its stone serving bowl, and burned my tongue, I'm hooked. I'll be back very soon for another. My husband said (and I agree) that Mi Casa is the BEST here.
They also gave me a long stem red rose and a free dessert...Super special day.

Wife and I have eaten at 5 Guys a few times.  I give it a 3 1/2, she gives it a 4 1/2, so I settled on a 4.  Food is OK to good, fries are very good, burgers, now that I've figured out their system of condiments are not bad.  We will drive there from Nampa now that Squeezers closed down, and there are no real good burger joints in Nampa anymore.  But I think Smashburger is better if not more expensive.  I like the bags of potatoes & peanuts & stacks of oil that other reviewers find offensive.  Keeps it from being too sterile an environment.  For us, it's better than average.
The food was good but overpriced. Paid $11 for a chicken bowl that should have been priced around $7. If the prices are ever adjusted I will go back but not until.
Went here on Tuesday after a lunch in Boise.  We all ordered chocolate dipped cones.  There was barely any chocolate shell on it.  Waste of money if this is the norm.

They call it Happy Hour and wine is 1/2 price, it was terrible tasting Chardonnay and they charged us $4.50 a glass (a small pour) which means this is $9.00 a glass!!! I can't imagine. No happy hour food or appetizers. Now I know why this place is empty on a Friday night. We will NOT be back. So to the new owners you need to look at what the previous owners did. This place was always busy. When we pulled into the parking lot we thought it was closed because there were no cars.
Calle 75 has the best tortas I have had in Idaho. When you go, you should get the Chan Chan. The service is always great and the food is always great.

Fred Meyers Meridian has become my favorite grocery shopping store. I have noticed that when I travel out of state or even to different grocery stores I find myself missing the quality and selection that Fred Meyers offers. 

I would rate a 5, but the high food prices are a drag, but it's obviously not a deal breaker. I feel that with the prices we're gifted with a great amount of selection and choices. The organic section is great and features everything from frozen food to produce. The deli is average,  but the boars head meat is a plus. They also feature a great wine and cheese section with sales staff dedicated to those positions. If you have a question about a specific brand just ask. 

The butchers is why I kept coming back. The meat quality is by far the best I've seen in town. The cuts are good and the meat is fresh.  The seafood is non frozen during the summer and frozen during the winter. I personally don't recommend buying salmon or fish if it's been pre frozen. You can tell by the dark red pigment of the protein. 

Fred Meyers isn't just a grocery store they offer everything a standard wal mart would. They even have a jewelry store and chase bank. 

Definitely recommend this store and hope you have as much fun there as I do.

Called "geek on a scooter" to inquire about a issue my PC was experiencing. I was warned that it would be 5 days before it could be looked at. I was okay with that. I drove over to drop it off. I informed the receptionist I had spoken with a gentleman a minutes previously and I understood it would be about 5 days before you could get to it. A week went by and I did not hear from anyone so I called and left a message asking if they could give me a call to let me know how things were going. I Did not receive any call back. So here we are 2 weeks later. I called and spoke with the receptionist and was told it would be at least a couple more days before they would have the data recovered. Now obviously I'm not a computer tech but when you deal with one and they give you a time frame you would think they would be reasonably close to it. Here we are at 3 weeks and I get a call back from them to tell me that the motherboard is bad and needs replaced. I give them the go ahead and I was told it could be a week before it's fixed. 2 weeks later I call and leave a message. 3 days pass and I still do not get a call back. I call again. 2 days later I get a call and I'm informed they received the wrong motherboard and they needed to reorder. I consent and long story short 2 weeks pass without a call from them so I call them leave a message which was returned within a day only to say that they cannot fix my PC. Almost 2 MONTHS later. Way to go Geek on a Scooter! This is how word of mouth can affect your business.

We recently moved into the area and wanted to check out what's around. Chinese food that delivered? Definitely had to test their worth. We came for the buffet to try out the different dishes but came at the wrong time. Don't recommend going in at 4:30. It's right before their dinner time and there weren't many selections. 
Despite this the host was friendly and let us know what was going on and that if we saw something missing that we liked we could let him know and he'd yell at the cooks to get the ball rolling. 
I always rate Chinese food by their fried rice (my all time favorite dish) so I filled my plate with that and sweet and sour pork. The gals let the host know what was missing. 
The fried rice was... Above average. I've had better but I would eat this happily. The sweet and sour pork was surprisingly tasty and could've eaten my fill with just those 2. I had some oysters tho they were cold cuz of the bad timing so that's all I can say. Tried the crab rangoon and thought it was average. 
Sadly this is all I really tried... Other than the crab legs (which came out later after we requested them and the host yelling at the cooks a 2nd time. Though it was friendly yelling :]). Had 2 plates of them and I was content. 
I definitely recommend coming here and I know I will again. Looking forward to having them deliver to us as well!

Michael the manager totally took cAre of me. Great server, Courtney, jumped on my every need.  My Favorite sports bar in the greater Boise area. Place has nice decore.  I was trying to find a place to watch 2016 National Frozen Four Championship.  They accommodated my every need!   putting them in for raises.  They deserve it.

Some people use YELP to rate food.  Everyone has different taste.  Just because someone does not like it does not mean that others will not enjoy it.  The rating should be much much higher.

Brought my family to one of my fave restaurants to celebrate my birthday & it did not disappoint. I had the Mexicanos Seafood, which was outstanding! My teen daughters enjoyed the Mi Casa & the Sopes, while my wife also loved the Chili Verde. 

I've had nothing but success here & it remains a "good to" for a good meal.
Absolutely delicious! We have ordered from there for sorts of events. Such an amazing treat! One of my favs!!!
Best Mexican food I've had in Idaho plus you get a frosty mug with your beer! My Carne Asada Burrito was great with the bonus roasted Jalapeño on the side. Can't go wrong here.

Cute place! Love that they have lots of little sitting areas in an open space. There's a fireplace & a kids room to play separate from boring adult people! $3 for loose leaf teas & a good selection of baked goods & smoothies. Definitely a perfect neighborhood alternative to Starbucks.

Gramercy is one of my families favorite restaurants! Their menu has such amazing options. The food comes quickly and the service is always top notch. My mouth waters when I think about this place. At peak times, it can be hard to find a parking spot, but I figure that is a good sign. :)

I fell in love with Sur La Table -- literally "on the table -- when I lived in Seaside, on the north Oregon coast, in the early 1990s and made infrequent trips to Seattle. At the time, Sur was still a one-store empire at 84 Pine Street and still owned by founder Shirley Collins. 

Sur was famous for having a ton of gadgets, lime reamers, garlic mincers and Silpat no-stick baking liners. They also carried Cuisinart food processors, the exclusive distributor for many years in the U.S. Noted cilantro hater Julia Child stopped in whenever she was in Seattle. 

Sur is now owned by a global investment bank -- Bahrain-based Investcorp. The company has continued its expansion, allowing Treasure Valley shoppers to enjoy Sur in person.

This store is smaller than the Seattle flagship store and shops in Portland and its Tigard suburb. Even so, it has a large selection of those same gadgets as well as baking and stove-stop pans, coffee and espresso makers, and dishes. The staff is friendly and helpful, the same as in the other stores I've shopped at.

I'm also glad to see they included a cooking class kitchen. Sur La Table stores in other cities have a wide selection of cooking classes that they offer regularly. Classes are held both on weeknights and on weekends. Three sessions were offered on the Saturday that I visited: Desserts, family meals and date night meals.

I really wanted to like this place because of other reviews, but unfortunately, I can't. I ordered shrimp fajitas (on the menu) but when it was brought out it was not the description that was on the menu. They put a plate if shrimp and hard carrots in front of me. I complained, so they only charged me for my drink. So disappointed!! I really wanted to find a good Mexican place!!!

I can't say enough about Chris and his business! He is passionate and knowledgable about what he does. It's a great atmosphere to work out in...the people are friendly, no mirrors...and very challenging without being intimidating! Give it a try, you'll be glad you did

Great staff and clean rooms.  Really enjoyed my stay, however Marriott Corp continues to baffle me.  Marriott Corp has great hotels, and for the most part staff, but please do something about the breakfast and coffee machines.   

This particular location unnoticed the water is very cloudy and doesn't clear up.   

Will stay again if needed.

Alright where to begin. First off I have a 2015 Road glide and I have pretty much either trade it in or bought a new Harley every year for the past six or seven years. I am no stranger to the Harley dealership and the tactics that salesman use to try and upsell you. I am new to Boise so I contacted my local dealer high desert Harley Davidson to trade in my 2015 Road glide with 2000 miles on it for a brand-new Dyna Lowrider s. At first everything seemed pretty typical it started with a phone call and then I actually went into the dealer with my bike, met the sales guy and begged him not to waste my time and just be straight with me and that I was no stranger to a Harley dealer. Anyways he agreed seemed like an all right guy but then as we got closer to financing and actually making a deal the people at this dealership completely wasted two days of my time making me late for work with false promises first of all they tried to lowball me on my bike worse than I've ever been lowballed before my bike is worth what it is as trade and they came in at almost $4000 less, second of all I have excellent credit and the interest rate that they came back with was absolutely ridiculous they insisted on going through their private bank and not the Harley financing program. We went back-and-forth for a couple minutes obviously this is just getting pretty annoying by this time. I decided to get up and leave agreeing to disagree that we were just too far apart to make this deal happen as I was leaving I asked the sales man kindly if you could tell me what my credit score was and what bank they ran my information through since an inquiry on your credit does lower your score and as a consumer you have every right to know exactly what they pulled and what it looks like. At that time they absolutely refused to tell me my credit score and refused to tell me where they sent my personal information and refused to give me a copy of the credit information that they pulled after that I called consumer affairs and had the Better Business Bureau contact them directly. After all these shenanigans at this shady dealership I went to the great folks over at snake River Harley-Davidson in Twin Falls which is two hours away to get this deal done not only did they beat their price by thousands of dollars they also got me all the accessories I needed financing that is a quarter of what I was offered at high Desert and gave me a reasonable price on my trade in the end everybody made out they sold a new bike and I got my new bike please do not waste your time at this dealership the sales manager is shady as hell and I think they used to be in the car business because nobody in there looks like I can even ride a bike. Anyways. SNAKE RIVER IS DEFINITELY WORTH THE DRIVE ask for Dave !!!!

We have been to Chronic Tacos in Meridian a couple times, and been sorely disappointed both times. The first time we visited, neither of us finished our food, and it both gave us an upset stomach. I also noticed that the place was dirty. There were splatters on the drink fridge, food on the floor, dirty rags on the counter....No thanks. The second time we came through, they were apparently out of every meat but carne asada and only had refried and pinto beans. I bit my tongue and ordered a burrito with the ingredients they had, and also ordered a chorizo breakfast burrito for my boyfriend. Both were greasy, and the eggs in the breakfast burrito were hardly cooked. For $12, I would rather save my money and just eat at home. We won't be returning.

I am originally from Southern California and I definitely know tacos!!  This place knows what hey are doing. Their tacos are wonderfully cravable!  And don't get me started on The Green Pig.  Oh My, I just slightly drooled!

I can't wait to try the new spot in downtown Boise.

What a treat!
