I'm happy to report that the valley's first poke place is fresh, great tasting and well worth the price of admission. 

I see a few reviews here complaining about the price for what you get and I disagree. Apart from salmon, the fish they offer here is not readily available as it is in Seattle and Cali. 

Is it truly a five star level joint in terms of taste and experience? Maybe not. Normally I'd give a place like this four stars but just based on them delivering on this level of freshness with raw seafood and plant based ingredients, I have to knock it up a star.
Five guys in my favorite burger place it is just so bomb and they give you so many fries and free fry sauce
Awesome place when you are shredding for summer! Great taste! And recipes are less guilty. A 1/4 of nutritional overload of sugar/carbs/fat from regular donuts the staff is cool too!
Great food, service and atmosphere. The food is delicious. One of the best Mexican restaurants I've been to. Have visited here a couple of times and have never disappointed.

This review is for California sushi roll and gelato only. Cali roll was nothing special. It looks awesome, but the taste is pretty bad. Also, I have never seen carrots inside cali rolls. This is what probably kills the taste. The gelato is allright, but too pricey.
Service was some of the best ever for 5 Guys. If you want a burger or hot hog this is the place.

I was visiting from out of state and a friend recommended this place.  Hands down... the BEST woodfired pizza I've ever had!  Service was great and the pizza was SO, SO good!  I will definitely be back!

If you are looking for great, high-quality in-house made food and fair prices this is your place.  I think the name of the restaurant may be somewhat deceiving because the food is not just sports bar/grill quality this is a full service restaurant that happens to have a sports bar them.  Individual flat-screen TVs at most of the tables are a cool extra.  When I think of a sports bar or grill I think of mediocre food at best.  The Pinnacle is far from mediocre! 

Some of my review may seem over the top but I was really, really impressed with so many components of our experience because the food, atmosphere and service stood out above many other restaurants in our area.  

We started our meal with side salads.  Different from other places, the lettuce and other veggies were very fresh, cold, crisp and colorful.  So often a simple salad is wilted, slightly chilled with brown spots etc.  Not so, here.  Their salad dressings were also made in house and tasted great.  

For our entree I tried the Kobe beef meatloaf and my girlfriend tried the finger steaks.  I'm a fan of comfort/home style food and the meatloaf which was a perfect choice.  The flavor and seasoning was perfect and skillfully prepared leaving it moist and tasty.  This isn't just your Mom's meatloaf!  My girlfriend had the finger steaks and was very impressed.  She's especially particular about the quality of meat and strongly dislikes fatty and gristly meat.  The believe the finger steak meat is from a NY steak and the meat was very, very tender and without fat or gristle and seasoned well too.  

This was the first time we ate at the Pinnacle.  JT was our server and was very attentive and friendly and answered our many questions and was very knowledgeable about the entrees and food on the menu.  Their soups, desserts and sauces are all made fresh!

We will definitely be going back and look forward to trying something different on their menu.
Pretty good but For what you spend here I would rather go to buffalo w wings . This would be a great deal if they would be a lot cheaper. So that's why 2 stars

Full 5 stars, i ordered online. The guy who served me when i came to pickup was polite, read out my order confirmed, took payment and and was very respectful. 
Food was great, nicely packed.

They have a great happy hour offering, and their chips are amazing. Service has always been good, but I wish they would rotate their beer handles more frequently. With so many fantastic local brewer, I would think more options would be available.

As excellent as a convenience store and gas station can get.  I so appreciate the level of cleanliness and excellence that Mr. Eddy puts into his stores.  Staff is always friendly.  Monthly car wash passes are available as well as great pricing at the oil and lube center.  Did I mention the tires that I purchased at the lube center were cheaper than what Wal Mart quoted me?  Shad, the manager of the car wash center and Justin who manages the lube center are always courteous and always willing to go above and beyond their normal duties to provide great service.  I bring all my convenience, gas, car maintenance and wash needs to Fast Eddy's.  I like Chevron gas so if you apply for a Chevron gas card, only Fast Eddy's Chevron takes an additional $.05 off the gallon price.

I love this place. I have to say, I was a little surprised by some of the very poor reviews I read. I have always had the best service here. In addition, I appreciate that the technicians talk to me and not to each other while working on my hands and ignoring me. I like that if one of my nails becomes damaged within a few days after my appointment, they have always been more than willing to repair it at no cost. Once, I had a leaf pattern painted on a couple of nails and I wasn't completely happy with the result. After a couple of days I stopped by and they not only fit me in immediately, but redid the design on those nails to my satisfaction at no charge. I work until 6 PM and cannot usually get there before 6:30. On multiple occasions, technicians have been willing to work me in, even at that late hour. I think that the prices are spot on and the service has always been fantastic.

We went  here for breakfast burritos. They were terrible!  An over cooked egg patty topped with some bacon and that was it.  I would value that at about $2 but KB's says its worth over $6.  My husband had the Ketchum burrito which looked better but the four of us that got breakfast felt ripped off and hungry.
Best Caesar salad. Wonderful wood fired pizza. Love the fresh treasure of the Jolly Green Giant. Patio is shaded in got afternoon sun, and tvs are available inside for games. We frequent here often.

This is totally a sports bar. If you want to be able to watch sports on four big flat screens, this is your place. We came there for dinner. I ordered a cup of Clam Chowder and the Fried steak bites appetizer for my entree.

It was such a let down that my Clam Chowder wasn't hot in temperature. I didn't send it back because I never send food back just because I'm paranoid to what they will do to my food. The fried steak bites were pretty tasty. They were fried and it's not a kind of food that I can eat all in one seating. It's definitely not an appetizer portion.

Service was so so. I think our server didn't really want to be there that day. Overall, I will come back when I'm in Boise because my fiancee's family love this place. I will not order the soup tho.

Stay Away!!! This place has only been open for four weeks. We visited at 11:00 today.  Open only 30 minutes, the first thing we noticed upon walking in was that the place was filthy. The tables were dirty, the floors were in desperate need of sweeping (dirt and grass everywhere), the chrome on the chairs looked like it had not been wiped since the grand opening. A visit to the restroom led to more disgusting, unsanitary conditions. Asked to speak with manager who was rude and arrogant. After telling  us that he was "aware of a problem but couldn't address it as long as he was talking to us" and trying to give us free food (the dining room and restroom were so filthy I wouldn't dream of eating anything from their kitchen), we gave up trying to have a reasonable conversation. Visit another burger stand. This one isn't going to last at this rate.

Fast and friendly, that's what you want when you need medical care on a weekend in a strange town.  The staff at Primary Health Medical Group provided that and more! As walk-ins, we expected a long wait, but we were greeted by the receptionist immediately.  She was very helpful and checked us in right away.  The nurse was right there and put us at ease as she checked our vitals before settling us in an exam room.  Again, we anticipated a long wait, but we had only just sat down when P.A. Frix arrived.  He was very kind, polite, and professional, taking time to listen to our concerns and answering all our questions.  We highly recommend this clinic.

Amazing! You want great nails that are unique and done perfectly go to amore! I've gone there for 4 years now and would not go anywhere else!!! Nicole is my fav!!! I get stopped constantly and all over the U.S. When I travel with complements on my nails!!

I'd used to frequent this coffee shop when it was Big Star. I needed a place to crash for a few hours for work tasks this came up in yelp. I ordered a standard mocha and I was hungry so I went with a bacon breakfast burrito. The mocha was good; the breakfast burrito was a big miss. The breakfast burrito was made utilizing a microwave so the cooking was very uneven. The outside was in some parts was was too crunchy and the hash browns were so crunchy from being overheated I think they were more like potato chip texture (not very pleasant). I am honestly not sure how to execute a good breakfast burrito microwave to me has its flaws which definitely showed in their breakfast burrito which was a big miss for me. The customer service was awesome; super outgoing and friendly baristas. I'd definitely go back for the coffee and friendly service..if you are in the meridian area definitely worth checking out if you are looking for a coffee shop.

My review is about the Garden center.  Great place for filler flowers & organic fertilizer, this always my "quick mart" for garden supply.  Prices on specialty plants are high.

This is also serves as a "quickie mart"  for specialty foods, organics, vitamins, and junk jewelry.

Have been a number of times...wings are actually fine. My issue is with the actual operation of the restaurant...always get to go and generally use the app. Most times, I have to wait 5-10 mins after the requested time...while annoying not a huge deal. Tonight, was literally pulling into the drive through and received a call telling me the order was going to be another 30 minutes. No apology. No anything other than, "we just need you to come 30 minutes later..." Good wings, but their management needs to learn how to run a restaurant.
23 minute wait for 5 bland, flavorless tacos. Unimpressed, save your $25 and go to a legit Mexican place for tacos
Very nice room, WIFI cheap, double under $50. For seniors, $55. Regular, pets allowed WOOHOO

coffee was not good. small latte, milk was over heated and scalded. couldn't even taste the coffee. ended up filing it in #13. they did have a great quiet open space for studying with ample seating though

Cheaper than Albertson's and better selection than Winco.  They have the best produce section in Meridian.  Lots of specialty items (gluten free, organic, etc).  Friendly service and plenty of checkout lanes (including self-service).

I've been to many Victoria's Secret locations, but this one had a great, friendly, and accommodating staff! The ladies made you feel comfortable and assisted me with sizing, style choices, and directed me to sale items, which I found to be a huge bonus! I will definitely be shopping there again!!

Mi Casa is a great Mexican restaurant in Meridian. The molcajete was delicious and was the on tap Negra Modelo. My partner's pollo a la crema was also quite good if a bit heavy on sour cream. The staff were absolutely terrific. They were attentive and warm. We will definitely return when we're in Meridian!

This place is my go to place! The trainers kick my ass every time I go in and I wouldn't have it any other way. Instead of wandering around and trying to think of things to do it's structured for you! I call this place my second home! If you hate regular gyms then you will love it here!

I should specify that this review if for Calle 75's Farmer's Market stand (I have been to the restaurant itself in Meridian but only for Village Coffee but they share the space). I've probably been to Idaho like 8-9 times over the last year and have yet to sample the Mexican cuisine, because you know, it's Idaho, and I have the best Mexican food in Los Angeles. 

Well, I had to give these guys their day in court. I talked to the gentleman manning the stand and he told me that these tacos originated from Los Angeles in terms of style and that their head chef studied in (don't remember if he was from there) Guadalajara, Mexico. They're made to order, so feel free to ask for them however you wish. Some of the people behind me wanted cheese, so I chuckled internally. 

I ordered two small ones, which are huge still; an asada and an al pastor, with just the chopped onions and cilantro. They asked if I wanted pineapple in the al pastor and I said no. I topped them off with the red hot sauce and they were pretty damn good. The asada one had lots of meat but it was not minced enough. The meat squares were plentiful but it needed to be chopped up even finer. The al pastor, however, was off the hook! The marinated meat was spicy and tangy and the red hot sauce lit it up quite nicely! 

My only regret is that I overlooked the Idaho potato tacos. Damn it. Next time I'm back I will partake of that one and other menu items. Tacos de papa are always welcome.

Really cool place that offers great smoothies and wheatgrass shots along with other healthy options. I got the Peanut Butter Power and 2oz Wheat Grass Shot and they both were the best I've ever had! Nice staff and clean inside. I will definitely be back for more since I haven't had a better peanut butter chocolate smoothie anywhere else!
Love this store as it's super interactive and the team is very knowledgeable! They were able to get our family in to new phones and got some promotions with DirecTV.

Really shocked that at a coffee shop with a drive through and lobby, only one person was working! I felt pretty awful for her since I saw her running around working hard, but it took about 15 mins for one iced latte and a smoothie, and it wasnt really "busy" by coffee shop standards, just too busy for one person. That said, she was very friendly and the coffee was good. :) Great atmosphere and lots of comfy chairs!

Watch out Chipotle, the Village has some real burritos! I was skeptical at first, but after a couple of burritos I'm a believer! I have had the pleasure of meeting Rosie and Mike and excited they have brought there unique style of street tacos to the Village in Meridian. They are always working and always ready to make you a build- your- own or one of there already created local fav's. Try the surf and turf, with fish or shrimp (fish is better!) and wash it down with there unique selection of fountain drinks. (I like the root beer.)

No guarantee you will have the person you request on the booking site Vagaro.  I was not given an explanation as to why she didn't greet me or do the manicure.

Not professional in my opinion.

Long wait time to receive your food if you order in-store. Have to pay extra for ranch or bleu cheese?!? If you're selling hot wings, you'd better have some sort of moist wipes available...most wing places do!  Lacking in flavor and value. Wings were almost wet inside rather than juicy. Seemed cooked straight from frozen causing a wet center. Not crispy at all. Skin was soggy and fatty with an uncooked appearance. Fries are loaded with salt. Restaurant atmosphere is blah and boring. Cafeteria-feel. There are better places to grab some wings in town for the price. We've been to Wing Stop in CA and this location is far from hitting the mark in Idaho in comparison.

I love Five Guys - it's my family's favorite place to get a good burger in Idaho! We get the burgers wrapped in lettuce instead of a bun and they will customize it however you want - grilled onions, raw onions, mushrooms, condiments, etc. Their fries are delicious and a decent sized portion and their customer service is always top-notch. The beef of the burgers is so fresh that it literally falls apart as you're eating it. Highly recommend Five Guys!! (for the record, I'm a CA transplant that absolutely lives for In-N-Out, but Five Guys makes my top 5 list of burger places ever!)

I went for lunch. Good service. Our sandwhiches are great, I had salmon BLT which was super, had some spicyness to the bacon. My husband had the cheesesteak which he really enjoyed. Someday I just want to order appetizers.

Great place to shop.  Beats the --- out of Walmart.  The employees are very knowledgeable and recieve a fair wage.  They are helpful and know where EVERYTHING is not just their section.  I think their prices are very good given the service and quality.  I love the Meridian store's meat section.  Organic areas are growing and selection is good.  Keep it up!

I've eaten here several times and the experience is always good.  Good service and awesome food.  Had many items and all good, but I can't stay away from the most delicious pot roast philly cheese steak sandwich.  The owners of this establishment seem to really know what they are doing.  They have been in business for several years and the business continues to grow through constant great daily execution.
Great food at a decent price. Mexican beer and a two taco meal was a 11 bucks. Floors need to be kept cleaner though.

Hand's down ... excellent experience. Just left my 3 day stay, and am already kicking myself for relocating to another hotel (due to distance for work assignment). The staff was exceptional. I receive large packages for work, and staff took proper care of my load & then assisted in the delivery of the boxes. 

Lobby: Always filled with fruits/water/tea or coffee. I love this because obtaining water from a faucet just isn't fun.

My room was amazing !!! Full kitchen (ie. stove/dishes & cleaning supplies ), desk, sofa, & walk in closet (its attached to the bathroom) for a price under $100 a night! I mean can you really beat that. My only two gripes are oatmeal was undercooked ( hey, I love my oatmeal) & I'm convinced the bathtub wasn't rinsed ... I purposefully left certain things there to see if it disappeared, and it never did. They could tighten up on there housekeepers.

Overall: Quiet, well-priced,clean and kind staff.

Am considering a new street bike and normally buy Japanese, but decided to give HD a shot. Met Milly, and was impressed with her enthusiasm and knowledge, which exceeded 90% of the Japanese salesmen Ive dealt with. Keep it going HDHD and Milly.

Way, way, WAY overpriced. I called about getting a bad hard drive replaced and was quoted more than twice the MSRP of the hard drive, plus $50 for labor, plus $250 to load the operating system. Loading an operating system takes like half an hour and does most of the work itself (AKA you can just walk away and it does it itself). I just looked up how to do it myself online and it was a piece of cake. This guy is a serious ripoff, even worse than Best Buy. Update: On top of that, I checked out his reviews and he totally tried to leave himself a 5 star review on Yelp. How dishonest!
Good burgers, but it's not up to In-N-Out standards so far as food quality is concerned.  But then, In-N-Out isn't here, yet!

I have been wanting to try this place ever since it opened. So glad I finally did! It's super casual with a walk up order kind of feel. I ordered two Street Tacos with chicken for $5! I got them "Baja Style" I cant remember for sure what it meant, but they were SUPER yummy, so I would def. order that way again. 

I got a glass of their lemonade (YUM) and took my food outside. I so much enjoyed my lunch from Calle 75, sitting by the fountains. I will definitely be back!
Great coffee, great customer service. Their White Chocolate Frappes are delicious.They have a nice patio and plenty of indoor seating to enjoy a cup with a friend.
Stopped by here on our way through town and it was excellent. Definitely try the miso peanut salad dressing.

Another great visit, great food, super clean, and the people are so nice!!
good value for the amount of food.
Awesome poke place! Very fresh. Very friendly. I visit here when I'm in town for work. Life on the road makes it hard to find good food. This place ROCKS!!!

Great place to catch something to eat for lunch.  The menu is diverse and you can find pretty much anything.  The home made potato chips, well they are awesome!

Looks like a good place to watch a game and have a cold beer.

I was treated like royalty today at one of the Dutch Bros in Meridian. They were amazing. I was shocked how friendly they were to me. I called my husband bragging about how I've never been treated better. Thanks for a fun experience and treating me like a friend. The Italian sodas were amazing too. They've got my business for sure!

Just moved back from So Cal where the Poke Bowl trend has absolutely taken off! Delicious and fresh. I love the "healthier" choices of sauces. The portions range on the small side especially for the price but seeing that Idaho isn't near the ocean and the only Poke restaurant in Meridian (at the moment), I get it. I hope in the future they had garlic and onion flakes for the end topping  Totally coming back. My four year old loves the Ursula... (Octopus!) hehe.

Love this place!  The cakes are amazing - perfect for a party or just a little afternoon snack.  The store is clean and the staff is so helpful.  I ordered the cakes for teacher gifts and they were a huge hit.  Highly recommend.

Shoestring fries that are too skinny to hold seasoning or sauce. Wafer thin charred crunchy burnt to a crisp burgers. I would have sent the burger back at McDonald's but apparently this is normal here. The ice cream melted into soup immediately but was still the best part of the meal. Go up the street to McDonald's instead and get a double cheeseburger meal and an ice cream for half the price with much better food.  This was terrible .

We have had Christian build a new computer and rebuild an old one in the past year. Both are working perfectly. The pricing was fair and he was very forward about the time and costs for each. The only problem is reaching him. Have left messages and not gotten a response for a few days. I have recommended Geek to others and will continue to do so.
Great place to stop and have a couple beers, watch a game on one of many small and large flat screens, some at ur own table. I have taken food to go several times.  nice atomsphere...

Growing up in California, my love for Mexican food has no bounds. Unfortunately, Boise isn't what you'd call a hotbed for authentic Mexican cuisine. Good Carne Asada is one thing in particular that I've had a hard time tracking down in the valley. I think my search has come to a close. Mi Casa's Carne Asada is unmatched by any Mexican joint I've had outside of Southern California. It just has that 'perfect' flavor and tangy presence that makes the meat absolutely addicting. I recommend the Carne Asada Taco plate with some squeezed lime and their house salsa. Looking forward to trying some of their ceviches as well. The ambience of the small dining room is great--reminds me of some great spots back home, and the service is prefect.  Awesome to see some quality Baja/Mexican food in the Boise area. Can't wait to go back.

UPDATE 7/13/2017:
Had a particularly pleasing experience at Mi Casa last weekend and I feel compelled to update this review. My parents were in town, visiting from California, and I wanted to take my mother out to dinner for her birthday. She requested Mexican food, which surprised me, given they have some of the country's finest Mexican restaurants all within an arm's reach at home. I took them to none other than Mi Casa and couldn't have made a better decision. Not only was the food great (Dad said he had the best seafood burrito of his life), but the staff went above and beyond to give my mom a memorable birthday night. So much so that everyone was still buzzing about it the next morning. In my humble opinion, Mi Casa is the best damn restaurant in this valley. One of my all-time favorites.
Best smoothies I've ever had. Ask for a mango blackberry peach concoction

right now I'm sitting in this store trying to exchange my note 7 factory RECALLED an all I'm getting is the runaround.  I've been hear for almost an hour to do a simple exchange. This absolute BS! A  word to the wise stay clear away from this store!!!!  There has to be a better way to do business!!

I'm updating this post your say Jeorge is a competent sale representative of AT&T he was able to settle my concerns. However policy still needs to be changed with AT&T how they deal with recalls. Enough said!!

Baja fresh is very good! If you have Celiac's or are allergic to gluten like me, is best to ask for accommodations like change of gloves, whipe grill before coming your food, etc. Their beef and chicken do contain gluten, so be mindful of that.

I recently bought a 2016 Lowrider S from Jeremy at High Desert Harley Davidson and I wanted to let anyone interested know that my experience from negotiating a fair price to picking up the bike was first rate from beginning to end. I had priced out the bike at several other dealerships, but they tried to upcharge and surcharge for "market pressure". High Desert gave a fair price from the beginning without a hassel. I saved several thousand dollars ultimately. I'd rate my experience with them at a five star level.

A crappy Long Beach,CA dive occupied the space before but, it did not rub off on Ketchum Burritos.  This place is clean. 

As long as you are not expecting a street taco from Tijuana after clubbing at 3:30am, you should enjoy this place.   They do 'Caucasian-Mexican' and they do it well.  I had the Ketchum Burrito with steak, black beans and extra jalepenos.   The meat was correctly seasoned and grilled, the tortilla was heated on the flat top and I love the texture that gives,  a little crunch.

The Decor is not exactly Mexican..   its more a mix of... Modern, World Traveler and a hint of South American.  Don't expect to walk in to a Mexican fiesta,  just expect dang good food and, and prices that are in line with other burrito joints.

I loveeee this coffee place. My husband and I make this coffee shop as our stop for their delicious smoothies after our hot yoga class. They have amazing smoothies. My favorite is the berry bomb, triple berries, vanilla yogurt, coconut water and protein powder. I like my husband's favorite too. His is the green monster, banana, spinach, vanilla yogurt, peanut butter, coconut water, and protein powder.
Service is excellent....the food Amazing. I honestly have no complaints. However I will say this make sure you have an appetite because there is no such thing as a small portions here.

I had my first trip there today with a group of 11, 4 moms and 7 kids(ages 2-7) and we had a blast! The only reason i did not give 5 stars is because it would have been nice to have an explanation of how there process works when we first got there, rather then having to wait and then finally ask once the kiddos started getting impatient. Just a thought but maybe if there are some signs or poster explaining how the process works then it might be helpful! Our next trip will be a moms trip, for sure!!!!

My wife came here for supplies to do a school project with my daughter.  The girl working was not helpfull. She was rude and treated my wife like she was a bother. They were also out of just about everything we needed.  We wont be going back.

This place offers great choices of smoothies, protein shakes, acai bowls and juices. The interior looks very modern and spacious with plenty of other shops and restaurants next door in The Village. Staff is very friendly and helpful. Highly recommend if you want a healthy option in a feel good atmosphere.
Can these cakes BE any better???? Haven't had a bad one yet!! I freaking love this place!! All the flavors are delectable!!!

I think this store has some really cool stuff! But the way its organized is hard to find things, because they could be scattered throughout the store. Also thought their prices were very expensive for basic arts and craft supplies, otherwise I would have given it 5 stars. Too pricey.

We called to have a garage door opener installed. No answer, we left a message. After a few days without a return call (I should have known then that there would be issues with this company) we called back. Woman seemed put out to answer the phone. I asked to purchase and install a garage door opener. She interacted with me in one-word sentences..."Name?", ""Address?" Poor phone etiquette. She quoted me a reasonable price and scheduled me for the following week. 
The day came and nobody showed up in our 12-4 window. We waited all day and had things to do. We couldn't get a hold of them when we called them. Eventually they called us close to 5 to apologize for a scheduling glitch, would we be willing to let them come the following morning between 8-12? We gave them another chance. 
The next day by 11:15 they didn't show so I called for an update. The story kept changing from there. First they couldn't find my appointment at all. Then they said I was scheduled from 12-4 in their computer. Then after I told them they were supposed to come between 8-12, they said the installer cane at 9:00 and knocked but nobody answered so he left. We were home all morning so, no, he did not show up. 
Nothing like getting the runaround and half-truths from an unorganized company with poor customer service to ruin your day. Look at the other reviews for this company, lots of bad ones. I wish we had read them before and saved ourselves a headache.

We came in on a Friday night after 8 pm and it was PACKED. The wait for two was 20 minutes and it ended up being slightly longer than that. No worries there though - we were able to sit at the bar until a table opened up for us and have a drink. The bartender was amazing (I wish I had gotten her name) and let us try a few different beers since they have some unique choices. We ended up getting two of the ones we sampled and they went great with the food we (later) ordered. When our table opened, the bartender was nice enough to keep our tab open and waitress for us. Going out of her way was much appreciated.

We had the veggie wings, mac & cheese sandwich, and jolly green giant pizza. Let me tell you...they were all some of the best food my fiance and I have EVER had. The veggie wings had a nice crisp on the outside and made something that is usually pretty bland like cauliflower something extremely delicious. The mac & cheese sandwich was perfectly cooked and something I can't wait to have again...such a simple concept tasted so amazing, I was shocked. The fries that came with it were also good, the fry sauce is the real star there though. It is better than Artic Circle/Dairy Queen, and let me tell you, those places have some really good fry sauce. We knew the pizza would be great just based on the fact that a couple sitting at the bar near us had a large one and had eaten half on their own. I can't blame them because ours was so good. It would be worth ordering a pizza to go, that's how much better it is than your typical pizza restaurants.

The atmosphere is nice - several televisions are scattered around making it easy to watch the game or whatever else is playing regardless of where you are seated. You can see in to the kitchen which is pretty cool, we got to see them toss pizza dough, impressive. I'd highly recommend coming here, despite the fact that it's going to make the wait even longer now!!
OMG! I hate to complain as there are so few options by Rumbling Bald...but it took over two hours to eat on a Monday evening. I feel bad but mediocre food and excessive wait=will not return!

Rude drive thru service and soooooo SLOW!!!! The girl at the drive thru was rude when asked a question. In drive thru for 20 minutes. Thought this was fast food. Other McDonald's in the area are faster and nicer than the service I received here today!

I have been going for about three months now and never want to quit. They make it fun and I enjoy how supportive the trainers and fellow classmates are!! Try the Saturday classes that are free to the community and see for yourself, it's addictive!!

I've always loved your pizza and your food is great! Tonight we ordered a large, and when we got home it was medium. We measured it before calling to mention the size difference. Upon calling and going back to the store we were treated like we were stupid & wrong. The manager, brandon, was rude, degrading and continued to do so, even in front of other costumers.  We were told that the difference was because the pizzas shrink so much during Cooking.  We left after no resolve! After calling a different location (overland & eagle) explaining to them the issues. They were happy to resolve the issue and discuss that it is a miss leading fact that should be brought up to corporate. Much better customer service at the 2nd location than this one. The staff here needs to learn how to be kind and give the costumer a pickle! (Google for the video)

This was the most pleasant, even fun car buying experience I have ever had. I felt each staff member was focused on finding the perfect car for me. The atmosphere was friendly and relaxed. Brend DeArmond was amazing. He made sure I found exactly what I wanted. He was knowledgable and explained everything to me. Cameron Iacovelli filled in when Brent was with another customer and patiently showed me numerous cars and explained each option they had. Curtis Bailey helped me with financing. This is the first time I've fulling understood each paper I signed and all my options. Your crew here is amazing! I've already recommended Kendall Ford in Meridian to several people. If I ever look for a new car (which I can't imagine since I love mine so much!) I will definitely head back to Kendall Ford. Thanks Brent!

This is probably the best burger chain I've been to so far, although cutting out red meat has significantly narrowed my options. Anyway, it's a pretty good place to grab some quick, quality, customizable burgers at a decent price if you want a restaurant-feel and to not be interrupted. There's even an arcade area for the kids, and I think all of Sunday is "kids eat free" as well as some weekday hours, but I don't have kids so didn't pay too close attention to the times posted on the door.

They have unusual options like veggie (well, it's kind of unusual for Idaho anyway), ostrich, buffalo, and sometimes venison burgers. Their salmon burger isn't overcooked or re-compacted; just a huge slab of properly cooked fish with teriyaki and tartar sauce on the side. The tartar sauce could be better, but it wasn't bad on the burger.

After receiving your food, you go to their buffet-table of toppings to load your burger however you see fit, then over to the pump-style sauce and cheese cart. The toppings are all pretty standard, but you can choose more "unique" toppings for an additional price when you place your order. The cheese sauce is the gross plasticy gas-station-nacho variety, but everything else is as expected. At the tables they have brown paper towel rolls in place of napkins, which is appropriate for the mess-factor. 

Two salmon burgers + fountain drinks + an order of their onion rings & fries combo cost ~$20, but we were too stuffed after the burgers to even eat the $4.25 side.

Truly random menu with gelato, gelato drinks (alcoholic and coffee), sushi, and smoothies.  They have begun phasing out their boba (er... tapioca) drinks recently due to competition from Yokozuna's next door.  Apparently, they also have sandwiches and pork fried rice.  

This place gets 5 stars because it has good gelato and the owner was fairly nice.  The restroom was also clean and there were plenty of places to sit.
Meh it's okay. I will eat at the five Guys in Tacoma once a month. Just another corporate chain where everything tastes the same. I find it real unsanitary to be throwing peanut shells on the floor.

I come here weekly! Some of the best smoothies ever! Highly recommend the peanut butter power and exchange the PB for almond butter. The after party is delicious as well. Also, the employees are always the nicest!

Last minute stop in with the kiddo for a haircut. No wait, and we were greeted pleasantly and quickly. The person (I'm so sorry I forgot her name) was very sweet and listened well, and did a great job with my son's hair!

We will go back for sure.

Let me say... I love me some Five Guys.  The burgers are awesome and the fries are tasty (and plentiful).  That said... I went for the first time in about 9 months today.  I live in Nampa and don't get out to Eagle around lunch very often.  Anyway,  the burgers and fries still rock... HOWEVER,  MY GOD the prices are just not acceptable.  They were expensive before,  but after their latest price increases,  they've managed to price themselves right out of the market (for me).  I won't be returning anytime soon.  $8.50+ for a "Bacon Cheeseburger".  $5.50 for large French Fries + $1.70 for a bottle of water.  That comes to $15.70 total ... just for me to eat.  With my wife an 9 year old son the total came to $35.22.  THIRTY FIVE BUCKS for 3 burgers 1 regular fries,  1 large fries and 3 waters.  For THIRTY FIVE BUCKS I could have gone to Red Robbin,  had just about any of their burgers,  unlimited fries,  and just about any drink PLUS paid the tip.  THIRTY FIVE DOLLARS for two adults and a child to eat?   That's just not going to cut it with my family.  Sorry Five Guys... i do love your burgers but I am not paying that kind of scratch for fast food.  Never again.   I'll go to Habit Burger or Frugals (which would have been HALF the cost... literally... HALF.).    You guys are pricing yourselves out of existence IMHO.

Moving from San Diego- finding an authentic Mexican food place here has been a struggle. We love coming to this family owned spot! The owner Sonia is amazing along with the rest of the staff! If ur looking for great service and tasty food- you've found it! It's our go-to spot- they also cater for a great price!

The food and service were fabulous! Our server was very attentive and helpful. We had a large group and the place was packed but she stayed up on our refills and needs. The food was amazing!! So, so good. Highly recommend the carne asada as it's the best I've ever tried. The shrimp fajitas were delicious, as well.

I came in at 8:50 and they said it was already closed while it is advertised to be open until 10. I understand that it is near closing but that is still not professional. If you are going to close earlier then advertise it that way. I just wasted time trying to come and now don't have time to find an alternative . I will stick with tropical smoothie cafe. When confronted about the time, the individual working made me feel like I was ridiculous for coming in and thinking it was open.

2 street tacos for $6. Great carne asada! The tacos were overstuffed with meat and pico! Great fun atmosphere, family-friendly, many menu choices to choose from! It was fast service and perfect lunch size! The carne tacos with pico were mild (which I appreciated), and delicious! Highly recommended!
Moved to 203 S Main Street. Best equipment rental store in town. Everything you need to do your projects

I love this place! I always feel positive energy when I walk inside, and I love the glass bottles the juice comes in. I love the more earthy (beat, kale, ginger) flavors, and they always have something that I love. I would give this place 10 stars if I could! The employees are always kind and welcoming as well.

I have only gone here for the "concrete" ice cream which is very tasty. I have heard from people that the burgers aren't worth trying, so I haven't even tried. I would say the "concrete" is better than a DQ blizzard. They have a lot of flavor choices, such as cookie dough, mint, etc. 

It's a fast food style chain. The establishment is clean and service is decent. The seating is decent as well. They announce your number on the intercom which can be difficult to hear because they don't stop the music in the background, so you have to pay attention.


If you're wanting a good dessert location, this is definitely a place to add to your list.

I first ran into wingstop when I lived in Texas. I absolutely love their wings and fries with a side of cheese sauce. Their sauce flavors are unique and tasty; Cajun and the mango habanero are two of my favorites. They are always introducing limited time options like their Serrano or Korean bbq. I am in this store probably 2-3 times a month hint go on Monday or Tuesday boneless wings are .50 cents. I have read a lot of the reviews on here I agree the customer service experience is usually very up and down. Honestly I warned the owner before they opened not to fall into the meridian customer service staffing issue; pretty much most of my worst customer experiences have come so far in the eagle road area; I don't know what the issue is but so many stores staff employees with horrible customer service. I have never had an issue with the food; if I did it was corrected. If your willing to look past the so so customer service and want the best wings and fries in town this is the place!! Oh their fries are chopped fresh each day fried and are tossed in salt and soaked in a sugar brine the night before. Delicious!! The last 30 days the customer service experience has been a lot better; fast and more friendly sometimes it resembles a high school saggy pants and high school behavior but no more rude employees that's a step forward!! Give them a try you won't be sorry..
The burgers taste plain, nothing special and the same with the fries. Not worth the time and money to dine here.

I come here to get my pedicures and they do an awesome job! The gel polish they use lasts forever! I've been to other nail salons and my gel polish peals off, but not here! I can go 5-6 weeks with this polish. I'd definitely recommend amore.

So not a bad place staff is friendly but when it comes to the offer check in of $2 off your order apparently they do not accept it since it's not a coupon that was offered via email. So I wouldn't bother with it but other than that the food does taste fresh.

When this reopened (from the old Chronic Tacos) I was looking forward to a new place that was highly rated (as they are over by Sun Valley).  Unfortunately, this was just average for a burrito joint.  But the prices were extremely high...$8.50 for a burrito is too much above average prices for average fare.  I'm not a huge fan of the "coke can" style burritos with everything in it.  Would rathter have the beans and rice outside of the burrito.  Flavors were just OK.  Would not drive out of my way to go there, unless I was on Eagle road allready, and then I would probably go down the road to Baja Fresh instead.
Monica at the Eagle/Meridian has been amazing!! I refer so many people to this business!!! I will NOT go anywhere else!  Thank you Monica!!!

2 stars is being WAY generous!  The employees had bad attitudes (read HS students rolling their eyes at you), the food had way too much oil in it and the chicken dishes had "mysterious chicken pieces" in it.  The Spring rolls got tossed out as they were not even edible!!
Panda Express is pretty basic cookie cutter Chinese food, but this location can't even seem to live up to the very basic standards.  I will not be back and would recommend avoiding this location.
I may try other local locations but if they are all owned by the same franchisee, then I have little hope for improvement.  Whoever owns this store needs to take stock and step it up.  PASS for sure!!!

I finally tried some of the frozen custard here and I have to say, it's pretty darn good. I had a chocolate concrete with Butterfinger and Heath bits in it. Very yummy. May have to give the regular food here another try because of a this.
I love this candy store ! It's really reasonably priced and has tons of fun unique stuff !

Our family was starving after church and Christmas dinner was hours away. Nothing was open, it was Christmas. We drove by Jack n the box and to our surprise they were in full operation. We were greeted by Foss, she had the biggest smile on her face. She wanted us to know that we may have a longer wait than normal, but she was there to serve us and will do her very best to keep us satisfied. Foss did not allow any stress to impact her customer interactions. She was friendly, helpful, and engaging. We were very pleased with the service and the food!
The staff was unprofessional and messed up my order. I also ended up with food poisoning! The worst!! I'm never going there again and wouldn't recommend it.

I probably won't be back. I was at the store yesterday to return a journal and pen WITH the receipt. When the cashier called the manager for help, I was told, "We don't do returns on pens." I asked why not, even with a receipt and it's never even been out of the bag. I was told that was the store policy. That policy was never made clear upon purchase. Then, to top it off, the manager said they don't return items that don't have original packaging. The packaging was with the journal, I had just opened it to see the inside. I was frustrated to say the least. I did get my money back for the journal, but not the pen! Buy your pens elsewhere!

I was on the run between errands. Went inside to order a quick bite. After standing at the front for a good 5 minutes and having 3-4 of JIB finest stare me blindly without saying anything. I called it quits and left. A+ customer service there folks. Will come back, NEVER.
Freddy hires the hottest girls in Boise. Freddy has the best burgers in Boise. Freddy is the bomb. Come on over to Freddy house.

Good burgers, amazing fries and service!  If you've been to in and out and are trying to compare the two, don't, they are different.  Both good in their own ways but don't come here expecting for it to taste like in and out.  It won't.

That being said, the burgers are good, not the best but I am a fan.  The fries are delicious - finger licking good!  I can never get enough!  The service is always great and the employees are very friendly.

Outstanding selection of beers, and they rotate them often. Great place to hang out and enjoy a cold beer. And nothing is worse than getting a beer that sucks, and that's why they let you sample any and everything! What a concept.
Great cakes! They are spending but for a special occasion or a different taste combo, I will return. Excellent customer service!

First off I recommend this place and to the owners, we miss seeing you but such is life and owning a business I suppose. 
I liked it better when they first opened up shop and it was more family run. They were a lot nicer all around. 
I'm a fan of chips and salsa, and as easy as that sounds it bothers me when they don't keep you stocked or they want to charge extra after the first basket which is now what they do here. I don't like that.  It's the small things. 
The food is good and this was my favorite Mexican restaurant in town previously, however employees and maybe some delegation has lowered the experience some in my book.
I thought the pizza was good for the prices. I would eat here again so I could try some of the sandwiches. It was fairly crowded at lunchtime.

I've been here a handful of times and always received nice, friendly service.  My family and I have tried different flavors and different sized of cakes and have always enjoyed our treats.  My most recent experience was with placing an online order for 11 individual cakes for a birthday party.  The order went off without a hitch.  My order was accurate and ready at the time I requested.

We had an early dinner here to beat the crowds. Timing was perfect and they were able to seat us right away. We started with the Smokin Hotties and they were PERFECT! Then we ordered a half of a Hidden Valley salad and 2 personal sized pizzas. The Maui Wowie and Low Rider. The salad, unfortunately came out at the same time as the pizzas. But everything tasted really good and the pizzas were plenty big enough! We each had a slice of each pizza and brought the rest home. 

As far as atmosphere- the booths around the perimeter seem cozy. We were seated at a table that looked into the kitchen with a wall on the other side of us, so now the greatest placement. The tables all feel a little open in the middle. 

Overall it was good and we'd go back.

This used to be my coffee stop when I first lived in the Meridian area during relocation.  The owner is a lady and I am admiring her entrepreneurial personalities. Therefore I'd like to give my critical feedback to this shop and hope improve the experience in someways.

- The location is near nowhere. This contradicts to the urban style of running a coffee shop in the crowd. It seems to me that this shop doesn't serve that cultural benefit.
- If the business model is not to focus on serving people needed the most in other words, for those who are too busy to make a cup of coffee on their own. Rather is focus on gathering people around and relax here. Then the interior space, outside view or least something should grasp that attention. But the overall impression of the store isn't memorable. (From the service and design standpoint)
- A cup of good coffee should be original in its nature. I felt the flavors in most the cup I had took away those qualities.

This Wingstop don't know how to make good wings or fries. Wings barely had any sauce on them. The fries were not even cooked and was served cold. When I told the cashier about it they redid my order which took another 15-30 mins and it was the same result. I was so upset I just threw it away. I'm never coming back here again.

Thank goodness for a Mexican restaurant that doesn't take its cues from Taco Bell. 

Where else can you get albondigas soup, or Mexican potato soup? Now, if they only offered posole, I'd be in heaven. 

The pollo a la crema -- chicken in cream sauce -- is wonderful. Tender chicken and a hearty cream sauce. Sprinkled with crumbly, flavorful white cotija cheese -- instead of that yellow stuff that most Americans associate with Mexican food -- this is a wonderful dish.

The employees are extra friendly and return often to refill drinks and make sure everything is going well.

The portions are ample and a take-home box should be standard issue.

The name says it all. Stop making Wings. The worst wings I have ever had. For something that is not hard to screw up and is the only reason you exist. How can you make the worst wings ever? If you want wings go somewhere else.
Nice clean suite for only $71/night.  Conveniently located next to I84 Highway.
Not impressed. Horrible quality. Sucks leaving a salon with your nails done just to already be looking forward to getting them done again.

In my ongoing quest to sample hamburgers all around the world, I am distinctly bent on avoiding the larger chain burger restaurants (and corporate fast food in general) unless absolutely necessary.  If you know me personally, you know that there are a few exceptions to this rule, and one of the exceptions is Five Guys.  I do like their burgers and fries, and enjoy the atmosphere of the restaurants.  Since there are several locations in Boise, you can get a burger anytime you like, so it can be a bit routine.  For me, on this day I needed a quick lunch, and found myself nearby (as the crow flies) to the Eagle location.  I decided to pick up a Five Guys burger, which caused me to violate one of my other life rules: "Avoid traveling on Eagle Road at all costs".  Because I was out of position, I had to do two u-turns, wait for what seemed like hours at different signals, before arriving at Five Guys.  I realize that this isn't a review of the Ada county roadways, and it really isn't Five Guys fault for the potential traffic and congestion, but it is something to be aware of if you want to grab a quick lunch.  Despite the road situation, I still got my lunch, and I still enjoyed it!

Love this place!!! I have been coming here for years for gel toes and they all treat me like family when I come in. All the girls are really fast and talented at nails and definitely know what they're doing! Love them and their prices!!!!

Not sure about the hype. Chips looked and tasted like they came from a bag and were stuck under a heat lamp.

Allergy alert! If you're reading my reviews you know I take into account allergy issues - especially gluten issues - in my reviews.

I don't often have issues with gluten in Mexican restaurants; however, in this case I was surprised to find out there is wheat flour in both the red enchilada sauce AND the chicken used for the enchiladas. So even if you order chicken enchiladas with corn tortillas instead of flour (as I occasionally do) you can still get glutened. Anyway, I am glad I asked in advance and was able to avoid.

What to do?: Ask for the "veggie" sauce (which apparently contains no gluten but tastes vaguely of hot dogs) instead and substitute the chicken for a different meat. If you're dying for something with chicken you can go for one of the pollo dishes but be sure to specify the gluten free veggie sauce on anything. Reminder: Always confirm there is not wheat or gluten (or whatever your allergen is ) in a dish with your server.

Anyway, aside from turning my enchspectations (enchilada expectations) upside down, this place is small but has a good clean look to it. They are open on Sundays which is cool for an after-church brunch/lunch option.

My husband with no allergies tried the mole and thought it was okay, but not as great as others he has tried. 

Note, I have been here 3 times. I really wanted to like this place. Maybe I will try other menu items? Probably not, the threat of being glutened looms near here. The search for our favorite Mexican restaurant continues....

Just loved this place. We have completely struggled to find a good and more importantly consistent Mexican restaurant here. No one has really hit the mark for us.

I wouldn't say we were blown out of the water here but everything was very enjoyable. I tried the Tequila Mangonada which is a Mango margarita with spicy Mango candy in it. It's really different. 

My husband got a michelada and besides saying it needed a touch of salt, loved it. 

I got the chicken mole enchiladas, first time ever trying mole and if all mole tastes like theirs, I'm hooked. It was very tasty. Loved using my rice to soak up what remained. 

Husband had the crab enchilada and was pleased.

Their rice and beans were great. We find a lot that the standard rice & beans seem pretty unimaginative and while theirs wasn't wild or anything, both tasted VERY fresh and the beans were super creamy.

We were too full for dessert but we definitely will next time. 

Service was very friendly and attentive.

Overall very nice. Hoping for the same consistency next round and we will have a winner!!
Dirty and every order was returned for it was wrong . Even a dirty reused tray paper the lid holder was so gross you wont want a lid even .
I've eaten here many times the food is most of the time great. A little pricey for the slow service in the afternoon. It's kinda a hit or mis on how good it's going to be.

All the ingredients are fresh so how can you go wrong.  I had tuna and salmon in my bowl.  Really good portions and several options to build a tasty bowl.  Best part is that it is a healthy lunch option in the area.  I'll be back for sure.

We arrived for my Dad's birthday lunch yesterday before 1:00.  Aside from the tasty food, our whole visit was pretty much a disaster.

First, at the register, we were behind a woman returning her take-out order because something didn't taste right.   They couldn't figure out how to ring that up.

We placed our order and went looking for a table.   It wasn't easy to find one!   There weren't many customers in the dining room, but the remaining tables were all full of dirty dishes!   It was the messiest dining room I'd ever seen.  Nobody was out there even trying to clean it up.  (But we did notice some of the workers just standing there watching TV.)    As you can see in my photo, we found a clean table at the end of a row of four tables -- the three next to ours were all dirty.

Our food tasted good, but definitely not a good value.   We got 2 beef burgers, one order of onion rings to share, and one soda.   Even with a free burger coupon for his birthday, this cost us $15.00.  We liked the idea of the dress-your-own-burger, but the tomato slices didn't look good and the onion slices were unworkably thick and uneven.

We won't be back.
I have gone to Jocelyn at amore twice now and she did gel nails on me and a polish change on my toes and did a great job. She is so sweet and easy to talk to and had a very good price.

Piggy Pottery For 9 Year Old Girl Birthday Party

My daughter celebrated her 9th birthday at Piggy Pottery. We had 10 kids in attendance.  We had a nice size table and two people helping us. Overall, it was a positive experience

Pros
Lots of room
Great selection of items to paint
Attentive staff
Really beautiful piggy bank made for my daughter as an extra gift for her
Good value

Cons
You do not need two hours. This is the party allotment. I found myself having to buy more items to keep the kids busy while they wait for their parents to come.

I requested the kids have a choice between two small items or 1 large one. Both options were the same price. The person I set up the party with said yes. However, when I got there one of our helpers said no. I told him it was supposed to be allowed and he agreed. However, most kids already started painting. He wouldn't let them switch even though it was his error

Took longer than the promised 3-5 days to complete

I was not at all impressed with this location. The staff was incredibly rude and the food was not anything special.
  We waited in a short line for what I felt was to long. When my family received their order I told them it didn't look correct. They checked my receipt and talked to me like I was stupid and insisted I had everything. One of the guys was swearing as he was talking to his co-worker about me and my order in front of me. After they made me feel stupid and uncomfortable. I sat down and my husband decided to go inquire about it. They were a lot more respectful to him and they mentioned that they had dropped half of our order on the floor and they didn't have the ingredients in stock to make it again so they gave us what hadn't fallen on the floor. Instead of telling us of the mistake, they tried to rip us off and made me feel stupid in the process. Just as I had thought, we were missing part of our order and they were rude to me when I questioned them about it. When the truth came out they apologized to my husband and gave him a different meal on the house. By that time my food was ice cold. I didn't appreciate the way I was treated. We will not be coming back. We had a lot of family with us (30 people) half of them ordered from another restaurant, but they all witnessed what happened and they have all decided not to give this place their business again either.

Been going here for just over a year. I came back to Meridian after being gone for about a year and needed a new barber. Walked in and they were extremely kind and got me right in a chair. Brenda was the woman cutting my hair and it was like she had been my barber for years. Have been going to her since. Also a great deal for a great haircut!

I went to their grand opening for lunch. I've ordered Small bowl, with white rice, tuna & salmon as proteins, spicy mayo as sauce and I have tamagoyaki, seaweed salad, ebiko (tiny fish eggs), cucumber & edamame as toppings. The food was fresh and healthy. I will use lower calories sauce the next time I go there. It is kind of spendy $10 for a Small bowl,  $12 for Medium & $15 for Large. But I've expected to pay that much for it. 
You can also order other things if you don't like poké. They have teriyaki bowls, soups and some appetizer items.

I'm so happy my daughter referred me to Dr. White. I had never been to a chiropractor before and I was very nervous. His bedside manner is great and adjustments are just as good.

I unknowingly had piriformis syndrome for two months and it only got worse as I was packing and moving to the area. I could barely walk.

After about 6 visits, my pain is completely gone and I wish I would've gotten in to see him earlier.

I've already referred him to a friend!
Love Dutch brothers and the employees are really friendly. Always my favorite place for coffee and the Smoothies are amazing.

Delicious!! Visiting from California, we of course yelped restaurants & came across this gem. From the pleasant service, to the homemade guacamole right in front of you, this is definitely a great place to bring the family and enjoy fantastic food!

We ended up here by mistake. And I am sure glad we did. My daughter was craving good Mexican food and the original restaurant she wanted to go to was closed. Yelp brought us here when we thought we were going somewhere else. I am so glad we stayed. The service was amazing. Someone always at the table with water or making sure we were cared for. The chips came with salsa and beans. My daughter who hates beans ate them all. Once the food arrived we all realized our heads were bigger than our stomachs. We had the chicken super burrito which was huge and stuffed full of meat. The chimichanga, cheese enchilada and taco. All surrounded on a huge plate of beans. Everything was amazing. Not too spicy for us. But if you like spice may want to ask for a kick. As ate an early dinner and as we were eating the place filled up. Definitely not the only ones who found this small gem.

What a great spot to grab a brew!! They have 4 big screens of beer and cider. I am a cider guy myself love the selection they offer plus they are one of the only places in town to carry ace pineapple cider. This place is a great place to grab a brew with a friend or grab a growler on the go for the game. The space is very sharp and the guys at the counter know their beer. If your looking for a spot to hang out or simply find new beers/ciders to drink this is the place(maybe before seeing a movie at the majestic)!!

For what can I get you to the village Saturday we ate at the Cecilia's Italian food. So today you came back to try to try out the  village again. So today we came back to try the Delete again and ate at street tacos. food was less than good. it was ok what the greatest what's the worst. but very expensive they do not refill drinks except for and lemonade. you wait in line the people behind the counter just look at you, you asked for a refill and the people behind the counter just look at you. my recommendation try the Italian food across the way.

The BEST customer service! I had a gift card that covered the drink and I only needed $0.75. I was scrambling to find change and came up with $0.34 then went to hand my credit card to cover it and the sweet gal said just to give her the change I was able to come up with and she'll cover the rest. I appreciated the nice gesture. Also, I love that you can tell them basically any combination of flavors that you want and they make it, no questions asked.
Chicken Americano tacos are my favorite!! They are fresh and full of flavor. Tortillas are always soft and fluffy and the chips are never stale. My family adores the salsa bar, too!!

So first time to this restaurant, service was good at the bar.  I had the pot roast sandwich with side salad.  The meal arrived promptly.  The salad didn't seem fresh, wilted lettuce and the diced tomatoes were mushy. The pot roast did not taste fresh, overall meal was mediocre at best.  The one positive I had a nice tangerine wheat beer which tasted great!

Good comfort food. I had the bacon jalapeño Mac and cheese and it was really tasty and packed with good stuff. It was a bigger portion than I could finish. Definitely a good place for my repeat business.
I'm suggesting that you don't waste your money! I bought two meals the price for both was almost $30.00 dollars, complete waste of money!

New to this state so I'm trying out all the places I can. 
With all of the 5 star ratings I would expect to have seen more than the 5 or 6 customers in the hour I was here. 
Good atmosphere, friendly staff, convenient location. 
Coffee: pre-brewed, not fresh. 
Pastries: I ordered a scone that looked delicious in the case however everything was wrapped in plastic which means they repurpose as long as they can. When they warmed it up for me it was done in the microwave and therefore destroyed the scone. It was rubbery chewy and was not warmed all the way through. It was cold and semi-lukewarm.
The music is just loud enough where you can't really have conversations. Funky music and too loud. A song came and apparently one of the employees loved it so they cranked it up a little bit higher which made it worse.
Too bad, it seemed like a nice place. I think I would have been willing to try it again if the pastries and coffee were fresh.
My guess is that most ppl here don't really care about quality so they'll probably do fine here in Idaho.
Still here...my gosh, the music has got to go. 
Leaving now.
Staff are always friendly and professional. Tiana is the best! She is thorough, professional and fun to chat with. Definitely recommend this location.

We don't often eat at places like this as my spouse is actually allergic to beef, but it was just me and the kids and with the significant allergies my youngest has, this actually was a safe option. The menu is super simple of course and if you need any option without beef go somewhere else - they have burgers and hot dogs and fries. No salads or chicken etc lol. 

We chose them for a rare lunch treat out because I was able to go online and easily see exactly what my kiddo could eat. When we arrived it was pretty slow (shortly after opening on a summer weekday), and the locations to order and pick up aren't clearly obvious. Go forward and the cashiers are on the left- the woman who greeted us was super friendly, and was quick to be helpful (and ask for help from a co-worker to double check) and ensure we had a plain burger patty for my wheat/soy/dairy allergic kiddo. This woman made our visit, with her sweet, understanding and friendly nature. The fries are great and allergen free aside from peanut oil. 

We got cheeseburgers for my oldest and I, and sat to wait. They have peanuts to much on which my kiddos adore- fun and keeps them busy lol. I love that they have all of the extra stuff (forks, knives etc, plus fry sauce and ketchup AND lids for those containers) easily accessible. 

The food was prompt, fresh and delicious. Everything was devoured (well, we got a large fry to share and that is a LOT of fries so we took some of that home with some fry sauce!). The cheeseburger is delicious, and the tomatoes/lettuce/pickles/grilled onions I got on it were fresh and crunchy.

The big kid loves his little cheeseburger (one patty vs two) and probably could have eaten a "big" one (he's eight and thin as a stick too haha), but filled up on some extra peanuts ;)

I do really wish they had a salad of some sort- some fresh or healthy side dish at least. However I understand the focus on the few main things- choose a few items and nail them every time is a good strategy.

Over all a great visit! Great service, clean environment and delicious food. Add one or two other options to round out a meal and we'd be there more often!

This has to be some of the best Mexican food we've ever had. With living in the southwest and several trips to Mexico and Central America we have experienced several different takes on many of these dishes and these were amazing!

We came here for apps and a drink. The inside is nice with dark wooden tables and a nice bar. The acoustics were loud but the place was packed. We order the veggie wings (cauliflower bites) and the gyro fries. The veggie wings were good but wish they would have baked the cauliflower to make it have a nuttier taste. The gyro fries were amazing the lemon aioli and parmesan made the fries taste like heaven. I will be back for dinner soon to try the green pizza or a burger both looked good!!!

Man, this place is legit. Been trying to get here for a while and finally did around 6 PM on a Monday night. 

We were seated in a reasonable amount of time and promptly got our drink orders taken and menus, followed shortly by chips, salsa and beans. Beans had shredded cheddar on top. Take Michele R's advice on the extra spoon and napkin request. You do read her reviews before you try a place, right? 

Everything we had in our party of four was awesome. My burrito was as big as my arm and packed full of goodness. Enchiladas were stuffed. Chile relleno was huge and packed full of cheese. Tacos were legit street style with cilantro and onion on top. Portion sizes seem to be on the giant side. We took food home with us. 

The only thing that lacked was it took a while for our food order to get taken. This was NOT due to the fact that the servers were standing around doing nothing. They were running around the whole time. However, they kept our chips and drinks full, so we were happy. Food took a bit of time to come out, but hopefully that meant it wasn't all microwaved. It sure did NOT taste that way!  Everything seemed fresh made. 

Give them a shot and bring your friends and appetites. We'll be back for sure. Get yourself that spoon and extra napkins!
I cannot believe the quality of this place. Worst food after it actually arrived. Waited over 1 hour for food and we had small kids. I could barely eat the food, dirty restaurant and just bad.

Every once in a while I run into one of those places that for whatever reason the masses seem to enjoy but I just don't see what they're seeing. Freddy's is one is those places for me. I stopped here with relatively high hopes and left thinking, I don't get the hype.

I found my chicken sandwich to be sadly bland (thankfully they have seasoning salt, use as much as you need), half of my fries were un-dippably tiny (which was too bad because their fry sauce was pretty decent), and the custard to be ho-hum/A-OK (I got nothing to add here).  

Meh!

My FAVORITE juice bar ever. Their juices are amazing!!! They honestly taste so good I think I'm addicted. They just seem to have the magic touch on how to combine the right things to make delicious juices! I can't stand the taste of beets, but I can drink them here. Their green juices are all delicious, as is the Wanderlust! I have purchased juices from other juice bars that I couldn't even drink... they were awful, but I enjoy them all here. Their bowls and smoothies are delicious as well. The store is beautiful and clean and the people are helpful and friendly! You can't go wrong here.

The facility is so nice looking inside and out but unfortunately my friend and I tried the protein shakes they were so bland I was so disappointed after our workout to have that, because they looked so good and once you tasted it I was definitely sad haha. The employees were not friendly besides the one gentleman that was working that night the other two young ladies were very petty just seemed to look at us with  judgements, not sure why... but just weren't friendly no one said much, the environment was not comfortable, I guess I just expected more from this place. Might go back to give the fruit bowls a shot but we'll see. I've traveled a lot and I've just had better especially out in San Diego I've experienced so much better, but Idaho is trying and I do like that!

My wings were hot and juicy and served by a very polite young man. I ordered bones in and had dry spice. I loved em. I'm a big hot food guy and each order is made to order. Prices were normal.  I had no fries or drink. I will go back especially since I heard they may have lunch discounts.
Love the burgers and the thin fries with great seasoning! They even came by our table to see how everything was!

One of the best massages I've ever had. David worked out every issue I had in my back. I made him work! Was so relaxed and calm by the end. He was so professional and kind, and had really strong hands. Everything you would look for in a massage therapist. The facility was clean and quiet, and everyone i met was peaceful. After a long day at work this was perfect. Going back!

Took my 2005 Ford F-150 in for a "tick" noise I suspected was an exhaust leak. I called on Friday AM and was told they were very busy but might be able to sneak it in to see what the problem was. They did just that and I received a call that evening stating it was $625 to replace the exhaust manifold, including the kit which I believe to be the gasket bolts and other associated hardware. I called them back Saturday AM but the advisor I spoke with Friday wasn't it. They were not eager to give me information to tell me what needed to be done nor did there seem to be interested to help. They just stated "he is out and his mechanics are also today".  so I went to pick up To take it somewhere else. Upon arriving to get my vehicle they wanted to talk more about the repairs. I was then told they could get me in. After speaking with others about "service advisors" I was told since the guy I talked to on Saturday wouldn't get commission on the repair since he didn't "write it up" and that explain his initial hesitance to help on the phone. I know when I arrived he re-wrote the work order under his name so he would get credit. I understand these things occur which is understandable but when the customer is inconvenienced it is a problem. Also the price I was quoted that had been written down was now about $150 or 23% higher! I was told the original quote was for the other exhaust manifold on the other side of the truck which was easier. We negotiated a rate between and I had the work performed. I also had a flush done on the transmission. As I finalize this review on 12/11/12 the repair was satisfactory but my experience working with them was far from. 



As it turns out I was correct.
Best pizza ever! Love the crust!

Five Guys - The Best - Across the country and in Idaho too - The Best
(I guess I like Five guys duh!)

Craft Warehouse is a large craft store.  It's part of a small chain run out of the NW, 8 stores in total right now.  Departments include beading, home decor, fabric, paper crafting, framing, and even some miscellaneous toys, magazines, etc.

I appreciate the variety of items available in the store.  I spend most of my time (& money) in the paper section; purchasing ink, rubber stamps, and embellishments.  I find that they get in new products quite frequently and they feature the new lines on end caps so they're easy to find.  I'm concerned about the recent (and significant!) reduction in the rubber stamp selection, so I'll have to see how that pans out.

Customer service here has always been good.  The salespeople are able to answer questions about products much better than the people at JoAnn's or Michael's who can't.  Jon, the manager, is often on the sales floor.

Every fall they have a huge open house, and it's a lot of fun.  Big sales, music, refreshments, and prizes.  It's definitely something my friends & I look forward to attending.
Very sweet girls in there! I just switched from another nail salon that I wasn't impressed with anymore, so I decided to try Amore. My nails look wonderful.

Just tried Dutch Bros for the first time.  Both my husband and I used to work at Starbucks and we believe their customer service is not as great as it started out.  The barista at Dutch Bros asked us about our preferences and gave both of us great recommendations that fit what we wanted.  My husband got a 911 and I got a white coffee.  This is the best experience I've had at a coffee shop in a long time.  This is the experience that used to be the standard at Starbucks.  Great job Dutch Bros!

Customer service was not great. Young staff were more concerned with their own weekend stories and checking their phones. Food was average and part of my take out order was wrong. Over priced and small portions
Great fresh ingredients. I've been twice and it doesn't disappoint. If there is a line it can be a bit of a wait but worth it. I've only tried it with salad so don't know how good the rice bowls are.

Sometimes it's just bad timing and not really anyone's fault for an experience. I think that's what happened at our visit several weeks ago at Pinnacle. We didn't plan on going there, but our other two options were closed. That Thursday night was super busy. Most if not all of the restaurant was reserved for the U.S.A women's soccer team against Colombia in the World Cup. Our server was friendly among the craziness and the order did not take long. We started with some boneless wings. They were more like gigantic chicken strips. The sauces chosen were spicy garlic and Korean BBQ. Both flavors were odd in texture and flavor. We couldn't quite figure it out but the sauces were not something that you positively remember weeks later.  The most disappointing part of that were the sides of ranch and bleu cheese. They were both extremely watered down. If Lighthouse Chunky Bleu cheese is on the chunk side of the dressing, Pinnacles' version of Bleu cheese would be at the other end of the spectrum. Dressings should not drip like a leaky faucet. I ordered the Calzone, the other members of the dinning party ordered a burger, fried shrimp dinner and chicken breast sandwich. The only stand out was the Calzone. It could have been because of this girth. It was huge. Matter of fact i was only able to eat half of it. The dough was good and it was apparent that the Calzone was hand constructed but it was missing something. Not sure if was the red pepper flakes or more oregano but it didn't stand out because of its flavor profile. Overall, this summed up our visits. Good, sure, but with all the possibilities of spices and flavors, it was like someone decided, " Keep it simple, our customers like it bland " Maybe I'm spoiled. Maybe it was an off night but if I'm looking for a short drive and good beers with plenty of TVs then I'll come back but I'll make other plans for dinner.
This is by far my favorite Mexican place.  Fresh food, good portions at a fair price.  The food and service are great and consistent.
Love this place! Great coffee and breakfast burritos. I love their brown sugar lattes.

The lunch vibe is festive and relaxed. A large pizza for $13 is an excellent value. The bartender was friendly and seemed to really enjoy his job. Like, seriously and genuinely enjoyed his job. Didn't catch his name, but he's the dude with a man-bun and glasses. 

The food is good and so is the service.

Would definitely come here again!

If you enjoy burnt burgers and over cooked fries, this is your place.  The signs inside brag about how they are the best burgers from 2007. 

In 2017 they are what I consider to be the worst burger.  Have given these 'guys' multiple tries, every visit is the same terrible quality.
