I ordered on line for a 4:30 pick up.  Waited 2 minutes at the window for staff to stop chatting and notice me.  15 more minutes to get food--and I showed up on time.  Wrong order!!  Ordered boneless and got classic, bone in wings!  How does this stuff happen????  Too many other choices and I will not go back.

Delicious juice if you like paying over $8.00 for one bottle.  Too bad, the idea has potential but most of us average wage types can't justify spending this kind of money on juice.  Albertsons makes delicious juice also for around $3.00.

Great store and friendly owners. I have been in the store several times and they always go above and beyond to help me out. They can order just about anything you need at a great price if they don't have it in stock. They have also been very supportive of our local flying club and RC community.

We enjoyed our time here, but the theft of two high-value bikes has left an awful taste in our mouths for this place. My wife's was stolen a couple of months ago; the crooks cut a thick cable lock and walked off. I had conversations just that week with other residents who had their nice bikes stolen as well.  My bike was stolen in the same fashion just today... so I'm still pretty upset. The problem lies more in the fact that the apartment is not concerned enough to do anything of value. They'll send an email or print something on a flyer. That doesn't seem to scare the bad guys away. 

There's an ongoing pattern of theft, mixed with turn-over and apathy within the staff. I'd like to give a positive review, but until that factor changes, this is the best review I can offer. The thefts will get bigger, cars and apartments will not be exempt as long as there is a comfort zone for crime here.  

Love the hot tub though.
Just wasn't the same as when we came in the past. Sorry Pinnacle -- you need to revisit what made you popular to begin with.
My go-to location.  Friendly staff and always get my (complicated) order correct. Thanks for making my mornings brighter!

We ate here on a chance on the day they opened, saw the sign and went in...we were blown away by the food.  Have been coming back ever since, usually once or twice a month.  Service is excellent, owners are great people.  I continue to try different things from their very extensive menu and am never disappointed.  Many of the other Mexican places in the valley invariably get a certain flavor to their food, it all more or less tastes the same due to the sauces they cover everything with....not here.  Different sauces and no two dishes are the same, very good cooks and we will continue to eat here!

Horrible experience! The waiter there was a complete ass! Markus was extremely rude and condescending! Never experienced anything like it. Every time he spoke he was mouthy and rude. Spoke to the owner and I really don't even feel he even cared. It was awful! Won't ever be back! Would give 0 stars if I could.

Some may think a 900th review (as this one is) might need to be more whoop-de-doo than for outpost of a franchise operation that specializes in bundt cakes of all sizes.  But some may feel differently when I say if you are among the first 50 people in line here tomorrow (Saturday December 6) you will receive a certificate for one free bundlete cake a month for the next year.  How cool is that!  Now you know if you want to go.  This the season...Ho-Ho-Ho!

This 'Nothing Bundt Cakes' location is the first in SW Idaho, is right next to Bed Bath and Beyond in Meridian and has been open just a couple of weeks.  Based on our first visit in my hubby and I are fans of the sparkling space, the friendly people, the free sample to try and the cakes that come in sizes from little mini's called Bundtinis ($18/dozen and a swell gift alternative to that box of chocolates) to little Bundlets ($3.99 to serve one or two) to 8 to 10 inch Bundt cakes starting at under $20 and feeding 8 - 20.

All cakes come iced with a yummy powdered sugar, cream cheese  and real butter made buttercream in generous amount of striping on the cake. (This also helps define single slices for those inclined to that measurement.)   Those who prefer their cakes with less icing might like to know you can order them lightly frosted as option by asking to have the frosting "drizzle"..  

There are nine regular flavors and one seasonal option (this month it is gingerbread cake).  We've tried  the chocolate - chocolate chip and the lemon cakes so far and both were very good.  Light texture, moist,  perfectly baked, flavor filled and just sweet enough.   Pecan praline, red velvet, marble, carrot, white chocolate, cinammon swirl and white chocolate raspberry will call out "eat me, eat me" on another day.

The only thing that's missing is a good coffee place next door.

THIS N THAT:

1) PARKING:  In the big lot.

2) HOURS:  Mon - Sat 9a-6p

3) ACCESSIBILITY:  Level in and throughout.

4) GLUTEN FREE:  Option or options available in some flavor or flavors.

5) GIFT WRAPPING:  They have gift wrap options for the Bundlets in single size or in towers of two or three single sizes.  Cute and only a couple of bucks to have it done.

Two times I have been there, they have been out of ground beef
and today I went in and they were only accepting cash because their credit card machine wasn't working.

Not really motivated to return to this location.
Still love Jack In a The Box in general, just not this store. (I went to Taco Bell instead haha)

I have frequented many Pandas in the area and this is, by far, my favorite branch. I always order Bejing Beef and it is always fresh during my visit. This branch has served me the best Bejing that I have ever had in any branch. Please keep up the good work.

Reece is amazing! She's professional and thorough and is so easy to talk to (even when you're getting waxed in the most uncomfortable of places). I bought a 4-wax package and will definitely keep coming back after I finish those sessions.

I almost fell for this place, until I bought the Idahome Bowl for the second time and bit into FROZEN STRAWBERRIES. Im sorry, but hell no. Charging us $9 an acai bowl with frozen strawberries is a scam as far as im concerned. Honeshtly. Truly.
Edit: im willing to give the owner the benefit of the doubt in this case on the frozen strawberry, maybe it was the granola that had the texture of crushed ice. The bowls are tasty, but whatever i bit into was extremely unpleasant. Id have to say the acai base doesnt taste any different than anything else ive had and therefore does not justify the $9 price tag. IMO 6 or 7 would be a much better price point and draw more business and gain a fanbase. So again, if she says the strawberries are 100% fresh, I will consider that they were extremely cold and what i experienced was something else in the bowl. Thanks.

OMG Freakin Amazing food!!!!! I was in Meridian for work and was told about this place by a co-worker.  The staff are very friendly and took the time to explain to me the food.  

The different rices are excellent and have great flavor. The meats are to die for. 

My ultimate favorites have been the pineapple spam fried rice, the teriyaki chicken and the coconut encrusted salmon. Absolutely amazing!!!!

I would highly recommend this place to anyone!!!

Service was exceptional, choice of flavors, exceptional & best of all that had a gluten free option!  Just one- but i think anyone will love it (like i did!!!) GF Chocolate chip cookie dough- it was decadent!  Rich & still moist the next day- loaded with chocolate chips!  And did u know they can decorate the cakes?!  Small & full size versions are both available immediately & by order. A huge bonus was the gift shop inside- that actually had all kinds of gifts I'd actually buy!  (Good quality & reasonably priced too!). I did not see a bathroom, but there is a big & clean bathroom at Bed, Bath & Beyond locates next door.  Parking is right out front in the parking lot- big wide doors they keep open on nice days.  So high marks for accessibility, yumminess, bonus of creative  gifts & genuinely helpful service

My normal nail place was booked so I decided to give this place a try. Noemi did my nails and did an amazing job. She fixed a crooked nail my other place had done and did a much better job making my nails look more natural and less bulky. 
This will now be my go to place, the staff was entertaining and let me know what specials we offered and when.  They also guaranteed their work and told me I could come back in for a fix even if it was my fault for breaking the nail.

I love Fred Meyer and I think their prices are great as well as their overall cleanliness and selection. I love their fuel points and rebates! My only complaint is how slowly they check you out (at most of the locations, although Target is twice as slow). I understand the small town neighborly atmosphere, but you can carry on a conversation and still continue checking someone out.
Amazing selection of unique items.   Great assortment of misc supplies for my art business.   Plenty of helpful, happy staff.   Family owned local business.   I'll be back often.

This place is probably my new go-to for wings. I had trouble with Buffalo Wild Wings since they never put enough sauce to cover the damn wing, unlike this place. My favorites are the garlic parmesan boneless wing, always hot and fresh to bite into. The fries are way over seasoned, so just stick to the veggies and you will be okay. Wish they had more of a drink selection, but you get what you get. Prices are somewhat reasonable. Longer wait time than what you expect so if you are dining in, expect to chat with your loved ones or  be on your phone for a while. Otherwise for to-go, you will be fine with hot food when you arrive to their place. Staff is always nice when assisting me with my order. Hope this place improves more because I would love to come here more often.

I have to agree that their 6 week FREE(we're serious) Challenge is bait and switch. I wasted 45 mins at"orientation" to find out you have to pay $700 which will be refunded if you lose 6% body fat or you can sign up for a 1 year membership for $160 a month. I really wanted to try the challenge so they motivated me to go to Camp Rhino and join their 6 week challenge. They are upfront with the terms and conditions upfront unlike DB who wasted my time.

I loveeee this coffee place. My husband and I make this coffee shop as our stop for their delicious smoothies after ohot yoga class. They have amazing smoothies. My favorite is the berry bomb, triple berries, vanilla yogurt, coconut water and protein powder. I like my husband's favorite too. His is the green monster, banana, spinach, vanilla yogurt, peanut butter, coconut water, and protein powder.
Quality food,quality service ,local beer! Best place to go in meridian. I love local that supports local!

Went to the drive through tonight at 3 am after a Halloween party and they told us they were closed and no longer taking orders because they would not be able to get everything done by morning if they kept taking orders... Isn't the appeal of jack in the box that they are open 24hrs?

Ms Analize, personal banker at the Meridian Fred Meyer location, should take some customer service classes before she will scare all the business away. Disrespectful and rude. Learning company's culture will help as well. If people sign in to talk to a personal banker, you should follow the order not just pick any random couple, and then be rude to everyone around. It's my first bad review, but she deserved it 100%.

This will be the second time I have eaten at the meridian location.  Second was better than the first by a smidgen.  But honestly both times were bad.  The food was dry, tasted like it had been made three days prior and laden with salt.  Well, at least I gave them a second chance.  Seriously.... don't waste your money.  Not worth it.

Having a sister who lives in Hawaii...I have come to love Poke...Even went to a Triple D suggested Rest....Poke Bowl is the best..Why...bowls are not pre- made...you get to choose Whatgoes in it and how much...You can get 2 scoops (4 oz's) for ten 3 scoops for 12...etc...they do charge an extra 2 dollars for the Lobster and Octopus...they mix your fish with the sauces you choose...then you get to add up to 5 toppings at no extra charge...avocado is an extra 75 cents...

The only bad thing I can say is...Now I have one less reason to go and visit my sister...

~~~Updated 2 August 2015~~~

Well, Mi Casa has moved to a different location, but the food has remained the same.  Excellent.  Tonight I ordered the Mi Casa plate, and everything there was delicious.  My wife got the Chicken Fajitas again.  I have to say, I am impressed with how they cook their meats here.  All of the meat is very tender and very well seasoned (contrast with tough and bland at some Mexican restaurants).  This is definitely our new favorite Mexican place!

~~~Original Review~~~

Ok, as some people know, I'm pretty stingy with my five start reviews.  You have to be consistent (meaning I've been to your place multiple times, and found the experience top notch), you have to be good, service has to be great, and I have to like the atmosphere.  Mi Casa fulfills the criteria for all of these elements.

The food here is pretty typical Mexican dishes, based upon the items I have had.  However, the flavor of the dishes here is extraordinary!  Tonight I had the Colorado Enchiladas, and my wife got the Chicken Fajitas.  Both were excellent.  The Colorado Enchiladas had beef chunks in it that had perhaps been marinading for a while, because they were super tender and super super flavorful.  The red Colorado sauce was delicious, with a subtle but noticeable tingle on the tongue after each bite.  I "borrowed" the guacamole from my wife's dish and spread it liberally on my enchiladas, since avocado is well known to be beneficial to your cholesterol, and also because it was yummy!  In fact, all the veggies, from the beans to the salad, tasted very fresh and flavorful.  My wife said that the fajitas were delicious, and she let me sample her chicken meat, which convinced me that she was correct.  Yes, our dinner was delightful!  And as I indicated, this wasn't our first time here, and every time we have come we have had very good tasting food.

The service is not to be overlooked here either.  The waitresses are all extremely friendly and helpful.  I also want to point out that our waitress was EXTREMELY honest with us.  When she brought out my wife's sizzling cast iron fajita skillet, she said, "Please be careful, this is very hot."  I know she was telling the truth, because as I was arranging our dishes to get a photo for this review, my finger accidentally came to rest on the edge of the skillet.  The pain that burned on the edge of my finger validated that the waitress was being completely honest, and that the skillet was indeed "VERY hot".  

We will definitely be back here, and will endeavor to try to not hurt myself again.





[  Our butcher shop flooded in the storm this week. I helped them move all of the meat to the top shelf... 
...and the steaks have never been higher.  ]

We loved working with Whitney!! We will definitely refer our friends and family. Whitney was amazing, she answered all of our questions and we were able to close on time. We were first time home buyers so we had a lot of questions in the beginning. All of those questions were answered. Academy Mortgage was so helpful and we will be going to them in the future!

I hate leaving bad reviews about a local business, but here goes. I wanted to like this place because it's got great open seating and the baristas were friendly.
However.
I ordered a small amercano, which is $1.95. I paid $2.65, and I don't know why. I didn't notice until after I paid that it seemed like a lot and then didn't want to confront the employee.
When I got my americano, it was lukewarm. That means their hot water or espresso wasn't hot, either of which isn't good. My coffee was so bitter. It tasted underextracted and just sour. I have been living in Seattle and spoiled by good coffee but this was subpar by any standards.
I got a breakfast sandwich and they must microwave it because the egg was super rubbery and it just tasted like it was made a week ago. The whole sandwich just had the same chewy texture and no flavor. For like $5.00 I expected more--an Egg McMuffin would have been half the price and twice the quality. 
To add insult to injury, the Wifi went in and out as I tried to use my computer, and finally just went out. Everyone doing homework there had to pack up their laptops and go. When I asked the baristas if they could fix it, they didn't. They seemed too busy chatting with each other and the friends that came in. It's nice that it has a friendly atmosphere but not if the quality of drinks is bad and the advertised service isn't offered.
They ran out of the ice water they provided on a counter and never refilled it even once someone asked. 
Please improve your coffee and have your baristas focus a little more on their jobs and less on talking. It's nice that they're friendly but man, this was the worst coffee shop I've been to in ages.

The Village in Meridian is treasure trove of little shops tucked away and hidden among the beautiful landscaping and the myriad of parked cards that align its busy streets.  Funny, how it seems its the same cars in the same spots every day but that's a topic for a different website.  Most visitors know of the center fountain with the restaurants that surround it but there are plenty of other stores and restaurants on the streets that deserve some attention.  Sur La Table is one of those. 

 Sur La Table is a cooking fiend's or foodie's store.  The inside reminds me a classic French Mediterranean market.  I know you're thinking this place must be expensive. Well, it can be, but there are some great specials and clearance items that are available, you may have to look for them, but don't pass them up because they will not be there the next time.  One item I was looking at really caught my attention, It may not seem like much but they are spoons especially created for ice cream eaters. They're not like your traditional teaspoon or tablespoon. The handle is quite long and the spoon part is quite smaller. I envisioned my dear friend, who is a retired dentist, but loves vanilla ice cream, using these spoons every day for his daily escape into his ice cream dream state. The staff is very friendly and the store is not crammed with inventory that is makes it difficult for one to browse w/o a cause inside the store.  One could spend hours in Sur La Table, so take your time, like you would eating at a nice restaurant and savor every minute. You'll feel one with the Nespresso machine and feel like you have been holding and chopped with knives your whole life.  

Whether you are looking for a Macaron Mix, Himalayan Rock Salt, Caq Au Vin Entree Base, or simply wanted to take a cooking class enjoy the fountain at the village, but save some time to walk to Sur La Table and enjoy all that is inside.  You may end up taking a Delicious Thai at Home class that is being offered twice in July in Meridian. 

El pueblo en Meridian es tesoro de pequeñas tiendas escondidos y ocultos entre el hermoso paisaje y la gran cantidad de tarjetas estacionados que se alinean sus calles concurridas. Divertido, lo que parece sus los mismos coches en los mismos lugares cada día, pero eso es un tema para un sitio web diferente. La mayoría de los visitantes conocer de la fuente central con los restaurantes que lo rodean, pero hay un montón de otras tiendas y restaurantes en las calles que merecen cierta atención. Sur La Table es uno de esos.

 Sur La Table es una cocina de fiend o tienda de gourmet. El interior me recuerda a un mercado mediterráneo clásico francés. Sé que estás pensando en este lugar debe ser caro. Bueno, puede ser, pero hay algunas ofertas especiales y artículos de limpieza que están disponibles, es posible que tenga que mirar para ellos, pero no pasa hacia arriba porque no van a estar allí la próxima vez. Uno de los puntos que estaba viendo realmente me llamó la atención, puede no parecer mucho, pero son cucharas, especialmente creado para los comedores de helados. No son como su cucharilla o cuchara tradicional. El mango es bastante largo y la parte de la cuchara es bastante más pequeño. Imaginé mi querido amigo, que es un dentista retirado, pero ama el helado de vainilla, el uso de estas cucharas todos los días durante su fuga diaria en su estado de sueño helado. El personal es muy amable y la tienda no está repleta de inventario que se hace difícil para que uno busque w / o una causa dentro de la tienda. Uno podría pasar horas en Sur La Table, así que tome su tiempo, como lo haría comer en un buen restaurante y saborear cada minuto. Se sentirá una con la máquina Nespresso y siente que ha estado llevando a cabo y cortadas con cuchillos toda su vida.

Ya sea que usted está buscando una mezcla de Macaron, Himalaya sal de roca, Caq Au Vin entrante Base, o simplemente quería tomar una clase de cocina disfrutar de la fuente en el pueblo, pero ahorrar algo de tiempo para caminar al Sur La Table y disfrutar de todo lo que está en el interior . Usted puede terminar teniendo una clase tailandés delicioso en el hogar que se está ofreciendo dos veces en julio en Meridian.

Real deal Hawaiian. A ton of fun and one of my favorite restaurants. Quality food from people who clearly love what they do. This is primarily a catering business but they allow us to enjoy whenever we want by serving their amazing food in this restaurant. The ribs are wonderful. At many Hawaiian restaurants these are dry and rubbery. Not here. They are moist and perfectly cooked. The mac salad is awesome. Definitely a place worth visiting again and again.
Great service, great foam on my Latte! Love the look of the place. Cozy and hip at the same time.

Yes, Dr. Hill can be pushy about getting dental work done. He's doing it because he truly is concerned about your health. I've been a patient here for over 10 years, and I've been in multiple scenarios where he's helped me work out payment options after doing work that "needed to be done." Don't let the bad reviews turn you away - this is an office that cares about you, your health, and your family. 5/5 in my book :)

Ask, ask, ask questions!  Do not expect the staff to know your wants and needs.  Every mind is its own world.  We are from out of state and buying in Idaho from Coleman Homes/Meridian, Idaho. I was an Escrow Officer for 32 years, which never stopped working.  It was a thankless job.  The more I did for my clients the more the client complained.  I am a huge yelp reviewer before a buy or visit a place.  I almost did not buy from Coleman because of the horrible reviews I read.  Then I thought and remembered my career.  When credit is due I feel the need to share my experience and feelings in hope that someone will sit back and think before they write.  I reread these reviews and honestly about 80% of these clients are never gonna be happy.  There is more deep inside that having a home built will not fill that void of unhappiness.  On the first day I received so much literature and I had not even decided to buy.  I asked all sorts of questions.  Like wow will my home look like this it so nice and big.  No, this "Model" is enhanced and lots of extras have been added.  Here is this literature etc... also, please know real humans build these homes and mistakes can and will be made.  if your buying a home you are an adult so, ask.  In addition most adults pretty much know within the first 60 seconds if you like someone and how they treat you, so if you don't like someone's service request someone else.  We have that choice as adults. Yes, this a real yelper not an employee. That's my take on that.  On a more positive note I want to acknowledge the work and service I have received from Matt Lotridge. He has been beyond amazing.  He answers all my questions (& goodness they never stop) and I have had him spinning his wheels.  I know this because  I go beyond asking questions and change my wants often.  He has helped me by filming lots for me and then I change them. It's so hard because we are not local, but Matt has made that process possible as he is our eyes.  I can hear him taking a deep breath as there I am again as I did many years in my career, but remains professional and pleasant. He has even filmed with a drone and gone out walked the lots in mud. He lets me know that it is raining and sorry for the delay. Who does that? Seriously God why did you get in his way.  Seriously, if it were me I would be like next and sell it to the next family that walks through that door, but he hasn't.  I am at the beginning of my process and I am sure that it will be a long haul, but guess what it is he that will be dealing with our (my) nonsense. All I know that today I am thankful to Coleman for having Matt Lotridge as an employee. Give this gentleman a raise he never stops working - oh and yes he answers his cell even when not working on is day off And after hours answering if there is a walkway with grass.  My partner says seriously...lol .  That's how silly real humans can be.  I will be making him dinner when we  ( helps us...lol jk) move in.  Be kind y'all.  Peace.  It  will all turn out ok.  Enjoy your home and make the best of it.  Look at the bigger picture how many people get to be you! You are unique and special.
Was definitely feeling skeptical about this but the donuts turned out amazing! They don't have the texture of an donut but for sure they were delicious for a fit donut.

The front desk staff was AMAZING. The doctor, on the other hand, barely even spent 2 minutes with us, didn't actually check any of the symptoms my toddler was experiencing before sending us away citing "probably a virus". Went to the ER later that day where she was diagnosed with strep. Will not go back.

We ordered two pizzas, the Maui Wowie and the Astoria.  Both were very tasty and made with quality ingredients.  The leftovers were taken home and ate cold for breakfast.  The pizza tasted a little different cold, most pizzas do, but maintained great flavor and texture.  I think we liked it cold more than hot.  Our waitress provided good service but seemed a bit standoffish, it was her first day working without a trainer so she was probably just shy.  We will definitely be back.
I'm a bit picky since I eat out a lot.  I mist say this was average at best.  Chips and salsa very bland and the enchiladas were so so

Yesterday on March 17th, my boyfriend & I stopped in for the first time. I informed the girl at the register that I was allergic to nuts & I couldn't have any of the bowls that had nuts in them. I know almost every bowl has some sort of nuts in it but they told me that the "Oregon bowl" had no nuts, so I chose that one. We paid almost $20 which I understand the price, but then once we received our bowls 20 minutes later, I decided I should check the bowl out to make sure they accidentally didn't put any nuts in it, thankfully I did. The granola had walnuts & maybe some other nuts that I didn't catch, but if I hadn't checked & just dove right in I would have had an extremely terrible allergic reaction. I understand if I'm allergic to nuts maybe I shouldn't go to a juice bar that has mainly all nuts, but I also think they should have some nut free options, or have their employees more education & should be more informative. 

Other than that, the environment was friendly & the girls working were very polite. Just wish I could have eaten what I paid for.

Yummmmy! Really good coffee. I ordered a 16 oz espresso White chocolate mocha.. cones with 3 shots! Coffee is smooth but strong. They also offer a limited food selection... breakfast burritos, yogurt parfait, donuts, baked goods... smoothies, Teas etc
I absolutely love this cake place! Whether just for myself or with a friend or a whole party. Guaranteed to be terrifically good and special.  It does get hard to choose flavors.  Enjoy!

Well the only thing that was good here was the food. The 2 ladies working were the worst thing to ever happen to this establishment. Rude with a capital R. She asked my boyfriend and I "what do you want". Excuse me!? What do I want??? Wow. Unbelievable. Seriously can't believe the attitude. Among other condescending comments were exchanged during my short lived visit and I won't be returning.

I remember the fanfare and flocking when Freddy's arrived sometime ago last year, circa 2015.  I remember raving about the customer service and the uniqueness of the concretes and the burgers.  As time went by my visits were less and less frequent. It was the little things that troubled me and eventually led to my choosing to go elsewhere. My son who is very particular still likes Freddy's but only for the Hawaiian Delight in a cup.  I'm not sure if the "specialness" wore off or that having multiple locations reduced the coolness of Freddys.  Here's what I do like.  

I love seeing the pictures of Freddy in various moments and locales on the wall. 
 
I like that the pickup area is different than the front counter area

I like how Freddy's uses and embraces social media, especially Twitter

Incorporating the classic Car shows


Here's what I don't like

Constant use of the apron as a way to remove whatever is on the hands.  I know that most restaurants have some of this  issue but this has happened on more than one occasion with more than one employee.  

The smattering of shake or ice cream all over the back side of the cashier station any day of the week.  I know that customers love the frozen custard, buts its not appealing to see it splattered all over the back splash, the floor, and the equipment.

Uniform noncompliance.  I think Freddy would be rolling over in his grave if he saw the majority of his employees with the shirts untucked, spotty, covered in frozen custard, and/or either too small or too big and then there's the jeans.  Specifically, either too tight, too long, were the bottoms/ hems, are dragging and tearing as they are being caught by the heels of the shoes.  As a former restaurant manager and relief Area Manager for a national chain, the employees appearance is a reflective of the manager and the restaurant. I would encourage the team to re-visit the uniform standards and dedicate themselves to ensure that Freddy's standard is being adhered.   

Dinning Room.  Seeing multiple tables with leftovers and trash is not welcoming. I will be the first to acknowledge how hard it is to keep up with the dinning room.  Its very challenging as one moment the dinning room can be spotless and the next moment look like Mr. Clean and Febreeze commercial.  The trick  is to have the the employees responsible to be on the lookout to pick up trays, trash and so on.   Freddy's did this when they first opened, most likely when extra labor was afforded but now it's probably a little more challenging. I would encourage Freddy's to look into secondary duties for front line employees so that the dinning room is kept to Freddy's standards. 

Food Quality.  The burgers, err Steak burgers, were an interesting taste at first and a taste that I enjoyed but after several visits, the flattened to wafer thin crisp burger patty just didn't peak my curiosity anymore and alas that's the biggest issue for me.  I love me a great burger and have had some phenomenal ones. Freddy's is an one-trick pony that I got to ride, and now that I have done it, there's nothing else for me to do.  So, while the restaurant is filled most nights and especially Friday and Saturday night, with denizens of Meridianites, you most likely won't find me there unless I need a Hawaiian delight for my son.

I've been here about a dozen times, and have a few consistent points of feedback.  

The coffee is good.  Not absolute five-star good, but a solid four, and every time.  I usually get Americanos or Mochas, so I can't speak for the blended stuff.  

Breakfast was good.  I had a breakfast burrito, and for the few bucks it was just fine - three to four stars.  It's not a restaurant, so I'm not expecting all the extras, but it was tasty and hot. 

Service is really good.  Five stars good.  Really friendly, genuine, and the kind of folks that are chatty but not too chatty.  

I was just talking to another customer today about the wireless, and we both comisserated.  The wireless sucks.  And I mean, really sucks.  I can't use my work laptop here beacause it's too spotty to use with VPN.  My iPad / iPhone do connect, but at a 2001 AOL dial-up speed.  Really frustrating - to the point where when I'm not coming to this part of town for an appointment each week I probably won't be back unless they fix the wireless issues. Which is too bad because I really like the folks, the food, and the coffee.  If the owners read this and get it fixed, let me know!

Bottom line, if you don't care about wireless, give this place a try.
This place is delicious, I can't wait to go back! I had ahi and salmon, the toppings are great. Very generous servings and great prices

I am very excited about the opening of Revitalize. Their bowls and juices are fresh and amazing. I have had most of their Acai and Pitaya bowls with my favorite being the Aloha Pitaya bowl. This a locally owned business so it feels great supporting them. I'm headed there for lunch, again.

We are several months into our build process and have been very happy with Coleman Homes.  Bryan (at The Oaks) has been great with communication and working with us, since we are out of state.  We just completed our construction orientation with Arielle and we are very pleased with her as well.  We are excited to finish the process in the next few months and get moved in to our new home!  Everyone at Coleman has been knowledgeable and professional.  Highly recommend!

My son and I came to Pinnacle post-golf to lie about what happened during our round, and have a little something to address a gustatory deficit we had developed.
Egads, they no longer serve beer in the 25-ounce frosty cold wonderful life-enhancing goodness-affirming mugs.  All gone.  When queried about this, our server told us that the mugs kept breaking until management decided to get rid of them.  I suggested that perhaps that narrative might benefit from revision, but she just said that was what they had been told to say.  
By the way, the service was splendid and the food was just fine--we only had a couple orders of wings and some loaded fries.  
It's consistent and solid, although the recent menu changeover has somewhat diminished the selection.  Will be going back, but with a wistful longing for the mugs.

Honestly today I'm disappointed with revitalize today. I'll continue to come back cause I'm just hoping today was an off day but the fact that I waited for over 20 mins for my bowl to be made and and two ladies that received their bowls before me came in and ordered after me. I got there in a timely matter so I wouldn't be late for work and I was cause of the time I sat there..

Hubby and me were looking for lunch after clothes shopping for him.  Truthfully, we were looking for Habit.. but I'm telling you the GPS directions for that place are horribly messed up.  As it turns out it was rather intriguing that those directions put us close to Freddy's so we stopped in.  
It was noon, so the place was hopping.  The noise level when we walked in the door was horrific-and since the restaurant has the 'open ceiling warehouse feel' similar to Five Guys, that was no surprise.  We waited in line, looking about to see if we had even a prayer of getting a table- but it didn't seem in the cards by the time we got to the front counter so we placed our order to go. 
The young man behind the counter was friendly.  Since the place was so busy I didn't take as much time as I normally would on a first encounter with a restaurant, but the patty melt caught my eye.   Hubby, being a burger freak, went with his standard double cheeseburger, but DID opt for bacon.  We made them combo meals.  Paid, then stepped aside to wait for our number to be called.  
It's a different kind of set up at Freddy's..you order at one counter, and pick up at a counter rather off to the side.  
Luck was with us, as a couple was just vacating a booth- so hubby planted himself there, and I went to the beverage bar to get our drinks.  Now, overall I'm a fan of the self serve beverage bar, but I have to say that during a busy lunch rush on a beautiful Saturday afternoon, I was a bit annoyed as other patrons were sending their young children to fetch their own drinks.  I'd much have preferred for my drinks to have initially be filled when we placed our order, but oh well.  
Another truth.. the Yelp reviews I'd read didn't have me frothing at the mouth to even try Freddy's- my husband being a bit particular about burgers means I tend to avoid places that have been opined about as kind of 'Meh'.. because of that- but when our food arrived and I opened up that patty melt of mine... all my worries went bye bye.
I KNEW the patties at Freddy's were going to be different, but I didn't realize how different.   My first bite of that freshly grilled well seasoned STEAK burger almost had angels singing inside my head.  I knew the fries were going to be of the shoestring variety- a cut that can go horribly wrong if they are overcooked. I can't say they were the best fries I've ever had.. but they were fresh and hot and very well cooked.   
When I checked our Freddy's special seasoning blend I was immediately struck by how similar is to Red Robin's special seasoning.  I also didn't find the fry sauce to be particularly great, but your mileage may vary.  
Hubby on the other hand was not as thrilled with his bacon double cheeseburger.  I had a bite and thought it was divine, but his taste buds rated it as too salty.  (It may have been, I'm a known salt junkie). 
As busy as the restaurant was, I have to say that we DID feel a bit rushed.. but not by the establishment. more so by manners and knowing that others were waiting for tables.  We opted not to try the frozen custard this time around, planning to go back and do so some other time.  This is why my rating is only three stars. I'm leaving room to be wowed by a frozen delight in the future. 
I would go back to Freddy's again.  I want to try their hot dogs and their onion rings, as well as the frozen yogurt.  In THIS instance I'm rather glad the funky GPS lead me away from the place I was seeking, and I'm reminded once again NOT to prejudge a place by it's reviews.   That was MY BAD.  
Over all.. LOCATION decent, with access from both sides of Eagle Road.  ATMOSPHERE: 50's kitsch, a bit loud due to open ceiling.  SERVICE: Friendly. 
FOOD: Tasty   Go check it out.

My wife and I recently purchased our first home and used Academy Mortgage. We worked with Tressa and Terry, mostly Tressa, and were very happy with our service and homebuying experience. Academy was recommended by both our realtor and a co-worker who had used Academy and was pleased. Tressa explained everything in terms we could understand and was always available when we had questions. I have already recommended Academy to friends in the area looking to purchase a home.

Having recently returned to Idaho after a 10-month stay in the Finger Lakes region, I was craving New York deli food.  I spotted Gandolfo's while out running errands earlier in the week and returned today for lunch.  Wanting the most basic of deli sandwiches, I ordered the Corned Beef on Rye with spicy mustard.  The menu didn't specifiy the inclusion of cheese but my sandwich came with melted provolone.  Not bad so much as a distraction from the simple flavor of bread and meat that I desired.  The bread is a marble rye (also not stated on the menu); I prefer a full-on rye, dark if available.  The sandwich was something of a disappointment...not bad really, but definitely a let down after months of authentic NY food.

Service was rather slow.  There was apparently only one person preparing orders, despite it being during the noon hour.  Laid back attitude evoked more West Coast than New York vibe.

Food is great but cashier was very poor he ignored us while we were ordering didn't tell the cook light mustard like we asked and forgot to give me a soda cup and also forgot to make my husband's milkshake we had to go to the counter to remind him. He was too busy talking anyone he could find.

The people are very nice and the place is also very clean. My mom goes there to get her face waxed all the time and so do I since their wax is so far the only one we arent allergic to. I went to get my nails done as well and they did a good job. Since I work in a place where I cant have my finger nails painted it's nice to at least get a pedicure. I will definitely keep coming back. The price isnt bad as well but they did have to up their prices a bit recently which is sad but understandable.
I'm not gonna lie, I had ly doubts about these donuts but I absolutely love them now. I ecspecially enjoy their chocolate coconut donut. I will definitely be returning.

I usually like Fred Meyer. However, Wed. April 18, 2019 we bought a rotisserie chicken that was like shoe leather. Please, Fred Meyer's where are you getting your chickens? To your credit, you gave us a refund when we told you our experience.
They have decent products, not over priced however, the staff was rude and hassled me when I asked about a military discount
Kanak Attack Express is AMAZING. We ate there last night and I'm already going back fo lunch today.
Surf turf burrito pretty good, nice sauce. Food came out fast, enjoyed the water feature next door. Would order again.

This place is just cool.  We always stop by and shop when we go to the Village.  They have just about everything the home (or professional) cook would ever want or need, including classes for those that can burn water.  

We've bought a couple things from here, including some baking sheets and a silicon dough mat.  Most everything here seems to be of high quality.  Lots of name brands and a few I've never heard of.  The staff has always been very nice, and will make you a cup of coffee from their machine that you can take home for a cool $3600.  Last time we were there, the staff let us (and about 20 others) stay and shop for nearly an hour after they closed without saying a word.  I thought that was pretty cool.  

Prices here are a little higher than average, but what I would expect from a shop of this type in the Village.  However, I much prefer the charm of this place over their competitor in the mall whose name sounds like Williams-Sonoma.  Check out their cooking class schedule in the front window left of the front door.
5 for the food , but cleanliness is starting diminish.  The concrete outside doors looks black dirty greasy...  steam clean maybe  bring it back to new

This place was horrible. It took a long time to receive our food and then the order was wrong.  After we were done eating we ordered desert.  We ordered three concretes and one sundae.  Took over 20 minutes and they made all four as concretes. Very disappointed. Foods here is great, even the desserts.  This came down to poorly trained people.

The staff at Five Guys showed us what good old fashioned customer service is all about.  After a slight mistake on our take-out order, we called the store and spoke to James.  He apologized for the mistake and offered to comp our next meal.  Today he made good on that promise.  

Mistakes here are few, but a business that puts the customer first is gold in our book.  

The ingredients are fresh and the burgers are outstanding.  Make a point to try Five Guys - you'll be glad you did.

This place has street tacos. The prices are pretty high for a taco even if they make their own tortillas. A six inch tortilla - taco is a snack. For a fiver, I expect two of them, not one. Three tacos for $11 is too much. They aren't "that" good. So, I will pass on this expensive version of what should be an inexpensive food. This restaurant offers a pleasant array of beers from local and non-local breweries. In the future, I will pass by Calle 75.

At 6 months pregnant, finding a good chiropractor was a must. I had been seeing the same chiropractor for the last 3 years. I felt as though I had a rib out of place and my entire right side was in a lot of pain. My previous chiropractor adjusted me, but unfortunately I didn't feel as though the problem had been fixed. Sure enough 3 days later the pain came back 10 fold. Our previous chiropractor was not open the day the pain returned, so we found Dr. Woolner and his practice. Dr. Woolner took the time to sit down with me while I explained the pain that I was experiencing. It took him one adjustment and I was feeling instant relief. We are now patients for life! Knowing that we have a chiropractor that will take the time listen and fix the problem the first time means the world!
The White Chocolate Raspberry and Red Velvet are amazing! It's hard to stop eating with one slice. ;-)

We have frequented Gramercy several times over the past few years. It was one of our recommended restaurants for family when they came into town. For me, the restaurant was 5 stars before the remodel. Since then, I have been back 3 times and each time have left a little disappointed. The pizza is always great but the pastas have not been the same. It is almost as if there is a new cook that isn't as passionate about the outcome as the previous. The Gramercy bread bites are excellent though! I love to support local startups so I'm sure I'll be back and hopefully upping the stars back to their former glory!

I had Kanak bring the food truck to my office for a catered lunch. The food was fantastic and everyone seemed happy - which can be difficult to achieve when you are feeding a large group. Booking was easy and the on-site service was really great. I recommend Kanak if you are feeding a large group!

I was searching for some great enchiladas tonight; too hot too cook my own at the house. My search led me to this little eatery sandwiched in between lots of other enticing choices. I could tell I made a good choice; it was packed at 6:30 always a good sign. My server super friendly..they are very fast honestly you could be in and out in 20 minutes lol. First the chips and salsa..the bean dip with freshly shredded cheese is a nice touch. I have to be honest I've been to other places where the salsa is just water I was thinking when I first saw it here we go again lol. The salsa a little on the liquid side packed a lot of flavor along with fresh chopped tomatoes/cilantro even a little heat on the back end. The food came out almost right after the chips and salsa super fast!! I loved the chili Colorado; big chunks of meat tender juicy full of that authentic chili Colorado taste. The rice was delicious too; beans were pretty flat lots of cheese not a lot of flavor. Portion size better ask for a box!!
Okay I really wanted to give this place a 4 star; that's what I had originally put then the service went south. They were really attentive the first part of the meal then it was like they forgot about me. I waited 10-15 minutes after finishing to ask someone for the box and my check. Then I got my check and I gave her my card-I watch her run two cards then she runs to two tables I figured she'd taken my card to another table. After another 10 minutes the family in the booth goes up to the hostesses says this isn't my card. She comes over to my table drops it off doesn't say anything. I will give it another try just for the food hope you get the first part of my visit when it comes to the customer service.

This was my second visit to Gramercy. The first, we were at a table in the bar and the waitress kept forgetting to bring our second beer - brought other drinks to the table, but had to be reminded about the beer. However the SoHo Salad was so good, I brought my family in for supper. We waited for about 15 mins for a table, although there were 2 booths and 4 tables empty. I understand sometimes that's a staffing issue, but as we were waiting a member of the wait staff went home. We also watched as THREE staff - the buser, the host and a waitress - cleared a 4-top. When we were finally seated, it was at a table with no silverware - the waitress took about 5 mins to take a drink order - only brought two waters for a table of 4 (in soda cups because there weren't any water glasses clean) -- apparently the people that order drinks from the bar don't get waters too. When the beer came, it was spilled and slid across the table. I got up and got more napkins to clean it up. The fish and chips was over-cooked (both orders) and the pizza had so black olives on it, it was inedible. Our waters were never refilled nor were we asked about a second round. 

Your staff needs training.

The food was fair and the service could improve.
The chips were poor and the salsa fair. There's a lot better Mexican food out there, but maybe not in  Boise Idaho.

I live close to this McDonald's location for 3-4 years now. So I definitely go to this location often, but today will be the last day I come here. I honestly don't even know where to begin. Action provided garage doors and auto openers for our new home.  This supplier, chosen by our builder, was one of the few on the project that showed up on time and did what they said they would do.  Not without hiccups.  But the problems were well resolved.  So this review will comment on Action and the general contractor given in home construction everything is related to everything else.  Bottom line:  were we needing garage doors or openers again, Action Garage Doors would be at the top of our list.  Were we building again, we would not use the general contractor.

SELECTION
A very good selection of styles and qualities in garage doors and opening systems.  The staff knows the features and functions of all and can help homeowners make selections that fit form and function and stay within budget.  There are several sample doors in the office / showroom and also brochures available. 

INTEGRITY
Owner, Billy, is top notch for knowledge and also running the business with integrity, based on our work with him.  We met him early one morning at the office (as I recall he's there as early as 6a every day) and reviewed several options.

The tailored styled, super well insulated doors (our garages face due south so that is important) he helped us select were a better fit with the home design and several hundred dollars less expensive than the door the builder used as 'placeholder'.  Billy also recommended we invest in better garage door openers than the builder's specification, which we were pleased to do based on his clear description of function.

Happy news was net cost for doors plus openers was several hundred dollars saved for us.  Billy provided the new cost numbers and told us he would send the adjusted invoice to the builder the next day.  Which he did.  In the interim, we told Billy that we would let the builder know the choices made and the cost savings they should see in the revised invoice.  Which we did.

Imagine our surprise when the builder's bill to us reflected the original, higher, price for these items and not the newer, lower total plus the expected builder markup.  When we advised the builder's rep of the problem of billing being out of whack with expectations, the response was this, nearly verbatim: "This is why we don't want suppliers discussing price with clients."  

Really?  No kidding.  Not "Sorry, we'll fix our billing error. Thanks for letting us know."   Nope. 

In three previous custom home builds, our builders wanted suppliers to share builders' discount price with us so everyone was on the same page.  It is how homeowners make decisions to stay on budget.  It is also how homeowners double check for accuracy in builder  billing after adding in the contract specified builder mark ups.  Because Billy operates with transparency and had been in full disclosure with us about prices, we knew what to expect from the builder in billing.  When the builder's bill was higher, we knew there was an error somewhere so we did not overpay due to builder admin error.  On the builder's part, staff makes errors at times so no worries there but this builder's staff made a lot of them and there was never apology.  

INSTALLATION PROBLEM QUICKLY RESOLVED
On the day the garage door opening system was being installed my husband noticed the openers on site were the lesser powered, lower cost units than we ordered and paid for.   Once installed it would have been more effort to get the items uninstalled and replaced and cost Action money in labor time.  The time for quality control was before these went in.

The builder's project supervisor was not available so my husband asked the Action installers to check their work order to see what was specified.  The lower function unit is was on their orders from the builder.  At my husband's request, the Action guys stopped installation until the builder's rep could talk to their boss.  Sure enough, the work order was wrong.  A day or two later the right units were installed. 

But this was a pattern during this build, unlike any we've ever had in the past, where my husband and I seemed the ones doing the QC (quality control) to ensure what was ordered and what was used on site matched up.  In our past builds, the general contractor did that checking before all installations. 

THIS N THAT:

1) PARKING:  Located in one of the area's myriad of small industrial strip mall sites, this has a small lot associated.

2) ACCESSIBILITY:  Accessible parking spot in the lot and accessible route to and through the door.  

3) APPOINTMENT:  Given how much building is going on and how busy Action is, my advice is call for an appointment if you need to get some advice.  Someone at Action will be happy to spend time with you when you do.  It may not always be possible for walk ins.
I don't care for their coffee as much- but nice big location, plenty of parking, big windows...

Let me start with saying that I appreciate the thorough help delivered at this location. On multiple occasions, I've worked with Joe. I am a REAL cheesesteak fan, I mean that thinly sliced juicy beef married to creamy American whiz (if you do it right) on a chewy Jersey roll...its like baseball and fireworks, a solid metaphor for democracy accept way more tasty. Well I knew this cheesesteak was not an ordinary steak so I got that feeling right after ordering like I made a mistake, you know the feeling...like you forgot your little girls birthday and everyone has a gift for her but you, it's horrible no one should ever feel that way. I'm only one dish into this joint but I can see some solid potential. I will be going back.

Chicago Connection USED to have the absolute best pizza in Meridian.  We've been regular customers for more than 25 years.  However, the quality of the pizza and the service have gone steadily downhill to the point where even Little Ceasars and Dominos have better quality pizza and FAR better customer service.   

The "last straw" for us came on Sunday night.  It had been a long day, it was later (7:30 ish) and we just wanted something quick and easy for dinner.  So, we went to our go to favorite and ordered Chicago Connection for delivery.   Now, I ALWAYS order tomatoes on my pizza.  I prefer them fresh, but since I've had issues with Chicago Connection in the past forgetting to put the tomatoes on my pizza when it comes out of the oven, I'll frequently order them cooked onto the pizza.  For many years, there was even a note on our "file" to double check that the tomatoes had been included. 

 Sunday night The delivery time was better than expected.  We were told 45-50 minutes, and the pizza arrived at right at 30 minutes.  That was the end of the good experience.  The pizza was downright awful.  Almost no cheese and very skimpy on the other toppings.  The worst part was I ordered tomatoes on half of the pizza and guess what?  No tomatoes at all!  As soon as the driver handed me the pizza, I immediately opened the box to check for tomatoes.  I told the driver "No tomatoes.  There are supposed to be tomatoes".  His response?  "Call the store and complain".  So I did.  

After calling the store, I asked for a manager or supervisor and the gentleman who answered stated that he was the manager.  I very calmly explained the problem and shared my frustration that the pizza was not what I ordered.  I paid for six toppings - I got five.  Not to mention the virtually non-existent cheese and very little of the other toppings.  The manager told me I needed to stop yelling at him (trust me, I was about as far from yelling as it gets -- I work in customer service, so I know that yelling doesn't solve anything).   I stated that I wasn't yelling at him - I was explaining the issue with my order and expressing my frustration that the pizza was prepared incorrectly.  I went on to explain that this was a recurring problem and questioned my own sanity about continuing to patronize a business that doesn't even care that the order is incorrect.  I asked him what type of incentive I had for continuing to do business with Chicago Connection.  He just said he was sorry, so I asked for a discount off my next order. He then stated he was just getting ready to offer me a free pizza the next time I ordered.  I accepted the offer of a free pizza, asked him to make sure the note was still in my file about tomatoes and ended the call.  Honestly, though, I doubt I will ever redeem the free pizza.  The food and customer service are so bad that I'm better off ordering from any other pizza place in Meridian. 

Bye-bye, Chicago Connection.  Too bad.  You were once the best.

We do not have a Freddy's where we live, so we always try and eat at the one in Boise, when visiting my parents. We visited this location on 2/16/19, I'm only mentioning that because the staff that day was so awesome! We came in around 1:30pm for a late lunch. The girl at the register was very friendly, and we placed our orders. We always order fries, they have the thin ones my sister and I are addicted to, especially with the seasoning salt!

Awesome homemade bacon breakfast bowls and gluten free lemon bars!! It's a great place for my business meetings with actual food! I would highly recommend if you are in the area!
They do beautiful nails and always so friendly!!! I'd recommend Angel Nails to all my friends!!!

The best tacos i ever ate in my life the staff here are very friendly I love this place

We decided to try the local location after visiting them at the Capital City Market.  There are several things in general to remember about the nice and new Village in Meridian.

(1) It can be spendy. and (2) The smaller restaurants like Calle 75, Rice works and others have limited space and limited amount of wait staff. 

With that said.  The burritos and other offerings were very flavorful.  Its expensive so its a treat. We would not be able to come once a week b/c its about 30 dollars for three people. Its a little awkward since the cashier/cook/everything else, knows if you have tipped or not.   I want to try the goat cheese taco next time, just have to save up to get it.

Revitalize is just amazing! All of their bowls are literally what dreams are made of. Whenever I want to "treat myself" they are my #1 choice. The atmosphere is great, I love that it is locally/family owned, and the ingredients are so fresh. I've tried açaí bowls from many places around the US but nothing compares to Revitalize!! I would highly recommend this place to everyone!

I almost went with 4 but after going a second time that was amazing I'll just say not everything is fantastic but a lot is. They make everything in house: pizza dough, salad dressings, possibly bread? It can get really busy and food cab be slow. 

Food that is excellent: veggie wings!!, Soho salad, peach burger, and amped idahoan cheesesteak. Kids pepperoni pizza and Mac n cheese were very yummy and I didn't taste them but the Thai chicken tacos liked good too. 

Food that is okay: garlicky bread (swimming in oil), poutine taters, and balsamic chicken sandwich. None of it was terrible but certainly not as good.
Excellent customer service. Good security. Convenient location. Everything we needed. Thank you, Acorn Storage Team.
If you want a moist, delicious slice of heaven - you must stop by Nothing Bundt Cakes !  Staff is friendly, service is great and cakes are delicious

We absolutely love this place!!! The food is authentic Hawaiian food and the vibe is perfect. We come almost every other week. Everyone who works here is very friendly and helpful with explaining the menu if you need it. The food is amazing you can't make a wrong choice.

One of my favorites. I've never had a bad meal here, ever. The food is just unique enough without being outright "trendy," and everything is flavorful, fresh and made with care. I mostly have been here for lunch but wouldn't doubt that their happy hour is great too.

Service:
Quick, efficient and attentive. Not too much or too little, and they're vigilant about dropping off/picking up the check (an extra point in my book).

Food:
Delicious. The salads are HUGE and I've had occasions where I can only make it through half. I had the Spicy Peach Burger the last time I was here with spicy peach compote, caramelized onions and brie--it was every bit as amazing as I could have imagined. The menu is inventive but not alienating, and the portions are robust. You'll walk away with a happy tummy. The only thing I haven't tried is their pizzas (so no, I don't necessarily think of this as a pizza joint). The prices are around $10-15 for most items, so it's a little spendier than some lunch places but very, very worth it for what you get.

Ambiance:
Inside/outside seating, with booth, table, and large group arrangements. It's definitely not somewhere you go to for the ambiance, but it's pleasant, roomy, and clean.

Overall:
A stellar go-to spot when you don't know where else to go for lunch. Easy in/out within an hour, and you'll leave satisfied. A perfect blend of foodie-friendly offerings in a casual environment.

This review is in regards to Specifically Cindy who works for Diamond Lawns. I did not move forward with their bid and know nothing of the quality of work. Delicious coffee and adorable coffee shop in Meridian. I ordered a hot 12 oz sugar free caramel, decaf latte with almond milk! Yum!! I love the windows all around the inside. Such a cozy atmosphere.

Revitalize juice bar is my very favorite place in town to go and get an amazing and healthy smoothie. Every time that I order something off of their menu I just feel like I am buying love for my body. This business is fairly new and the atmosphere and environment is just lovely and full of light, decorated beautifully, staffed with young, happy, vibrant people and they've always been so helpful to me. My favorite things I've ordered off of their menu have been their charcoal and avocado smoothies! Do yourself a favor and go try them!

I love coming here! My kids love it too. You don't have to deal with the hassle of the village. I am SUPER BUMMED that you don't have the almond milk froyo option anymore. It was so nice to have a dairy free alternative that I liked. I vote you bring it back.

The place is a serious "meh". The service was good, therefore they get two stars. The best I can say for the food "it'll make a turd".
Ordered the Amped Idahoan. The meat was overcooked, too much horseradish, yet still dry? Couldn't finish it. With the amount of other restaurants around here, you best stand out- in a good way...this place misses the mark completely. Won't be back.
Dr Woolner is the best! Got to the heart of problem and started to fix it right away!! Very satisfied customer!

I come here often and several of the staff know my name. In the past few months, the restaurant has been severely understaffed. I have had to wait longer than usual, but watch empathetically as these employees do the best they can with less staff then usual. I have noticed there have been more staff working lately and wait times have gone down. I feel like the people leaving negative comments expect way too much from young kids working their first job. Maybe the negative ninnies should try working there for a day or two?

I went here last week. I was pretty underwhelmed, giving how busy and nice this place was on the inside. I know it says steak burgers, but these burgers were about right on par with any other fast food chains frozen patty burgers.
