I am happy to report that the last few times I have ordered it, it has been back to its gloriously high standard.  I always order it with extra jalapeños because I like the spice.  . I have heard that their other stuff is really good too.

Don't trust Coleman to fix anything that may go wrong at your house.  If you are after the 1 year warranty period they will literally say "Nope, we can't do anything to help you." They seriously don't care.  So many neighbors have so many stories with similar problems with the heating and Air they put in, or the crappy grading they do which causes flooding from neighbors yards.  We have had 3 years of flooding and spent thousands of dollars trying to fix it, with no help from Coleman admitting that they sucked and got lazy with the grading of the yards/properties.  Also have problems with our floating hard wood floors. I could go on and on about little issues, but I won't. Plenty of other quality builders in the area, and spots to build your dream home.

Horrible experience... oh and they charge 9 dollars for a glass of crappy house wine. They won't even give you a wine list because they don't want you to know how much they are going to scam you for. Service was descent but the kitchen is slow. They used to have an awesome menu now it's pretty bad.

Yesterday we went here for lunch and it was so delicious! There was a silly mix up with orders (portobello vs pork belly, makes me laugh!) But the staff was quick to fix the mistake and we SO professional and quick. We appreciated the chips & salsa on the house!

Their coffee tastes good and their is a good selection of food and treats. 

The one downside is that the prices seem pretty high.

Panda express to the rescue.  I originally ordered from another place but was told it would be a 2 hour wait.  I came to your location, which was really busy.  The staff was efficient and friendly while still keeping everything moving right along.   Even when having to wait for more food when an item was low or out the staff communicated wait times.  The food was delicious.   Should've just come here in the first place.
Love this place! They have excellent chips and salsa. My favorite dish is the Casa Grande burrito with three meats in it. Its huge and I usually make two meals out of it.

I purchased 2 XL twin Medina mattresses on 2/9/19 for a total of $1,187.18.  I was told it would take 2-6 weeks for delivery.  On 3/23/1 (6 weeks) I went to pick up my mattresses, only to be told they had not arrived, but was assured they would be there by the following Tuesday....then Thursday....then Monday.  On 4/1/19 I asked for a refund and was told by furniture manager, Mike, that he would contact Serta to inquire the location of the mattresses and would contact me by the next day.  On 4/2/19, after not receiving a call back from Mike (informed that he was not in), I called and spoke with Eric, the store manager.  He assured me he would look into the situation and contact me by this morning.  At noon I called and asked to speak with Eric only to be told that he was not at the store today.  I have bought quite a bit of furniture from Big Lots in the past, but am extremely displeased with the lack of customer service I have received.

UPDATE:  After messaging with Big Lots last week in Yelp and leaving feedback on the corporate website, which ensured I would receive contact, I have yet to hear back from Big Lots.  It's like they don't actually want my business.  No surprises here.  My money spends just as well elsewhere.  I just wish they didn't have the benefit of soaking up my interest for over 7 weeks.  I could be $30 richer.

Bait and Switch Cheats!!!!  They did a "complimentary" introductory consult that I just had to pay $137 for.  They wanted to charge me 4 times as much for the services to bill to my insurance.  That sinks of insurance fraud.  Run Far Fast!!!!  The services were ineffective and the massage was useless.

I totally recommend this place. It is clean! They use a different stick every time they dip, and they change the paper on the table, unlike nail salons. They are also so friendly! And not to mention my brows look great! Check them out. Ask for Chelsea. She did a great job!!

Came in for the first visit and got a free eye brow wax! That's so awesome! The technician also went over with me to talk to me about brow shapes and how to properly groom and color them in. She talked about the products they sell and obviously they make their money selling them but it was still nice to have her suggestions and guidance. I really like the type of wax they used, it did not need any cloth and was very gentle on my face. Will be coming back even though the prices are a bit higher than the average ($20 for brows) but they do have a lot of perks such as discounts for referrals and points from products you buy. Hoping to come again soon

I have been a long time customer and have been spoken to in person and over the phone by Becky one of the owners quite rudely. We have shown up over different occasions and asked if they had room for our group to paint, Becky would say very abruptly "you really need to make a reservation!" When I asked if they had room she'd say "yes we are just very busy!" On Sunday Dec. 18th we had made a reservation to paint over a week in advance. Family members came from Middleton, Nampa and Boise. It takes a lot to coordinate 10 different schedules so we thought we would spend some time all painting. After being there a very short time , Becky the owner called me over and wanted to know how long we planned on staying     She said they had overbooked and needed our table. They wanted us to leave because of their error. When I said it was rude to ask us to leave , she rolled her eyes and said " she wasn't being rude". One of the male employees said " I was the one who was rude , for staying ALL DAY ! "After only being there 2 hours. Becky stood by and allowed her employees to be rude and insult paying customers.  Whatever happened to customer service? I will never go back to that place of business again !  I do not need to give my money to people who treat the very people who keep them employed so rudely! 
If you are looking for a fun family experience ,DON'T go here !  12/18/2016

I live nearby and I eat their salmon entree at least
Twice a month. It is so good. Their cardomin old fashion is amazing.
Best hawaiian food in Boise. I really like this place. High quality food with a lot of selection.
Gross. Food is to damn sweet. I know it is supposed to have sugar on it but it was gross. I might as well just eat a bag ful of sugar. Way over priced too.
Quick, simple and delicious. Carne Asada and Al Pastor tacos. Both really flavorful. Street tacos should pack a punch. No frills needed. These hit the spot before heading into a movie!
The best cakes ever!  Love the single serving cakes so I can get a variety.  I purchased the bundle pack so I can buy 3 and get one free every time I bring it in.  So yummy!

Impressive!  Yes, I just said that.  My husband has been wanting to try this place for awhile but I wasn't in the mood for pizza.  Finally he twisted my arm and I am oh so glad he did.  Gramercy Park is so much more than pizza but the pizza is darn good too.

The place was pretty busy for a Thursday night.  We grabbed a couple of seats at the bar and were immediately impressed with their taps (after taking in the view, yes, actually there is a bit of a view from the large windows facing the foothills).  Our bartender was the nicest, most helpful guy.  We ordered a Georgetown Porter and a glass of wine while checking out the menu.  So many things looked good.  We started with the veggie wings.  What a unique, delicious dish.  I love buffalo sauce and it was an ingenious idea to batter up some cauliflower slather it in buffalo sauce.  I could have had a couple of orders for my entire meal.  

I ordered the trio of pork belly sliders for my entree and JP had the GPPG wood-fired pizza.  The sliders were an ample size for my entree especially after stuffing my face with the veggie wings so I tried 1/2 of each one.  They serve an Asian, American and Mexican.  The Asian was my favorite but the other two were close.  The onion straws on the American slider were a bit salty for me.  Perhaps a few less on the slider would help.  

JP was so excited about his pizza.  What's not to love about something that has salami and chorizo? The crust was really well cooked.  

I could easily see us making the drive out here from the North End weekly.  Lots of things on the menu we want to try.  Go for the food, stay for the service, simply outstanding!

Popped in for a slice for lunch based on Yelp reviews.  Can't comment on the pizza since we canceled our "slice for here" orders after learning they have no bathrooms in the restaurant.  You know how it goes...we'd been at a construction site all morning and then on the run and by 2:00 to stop for a bite needed to wash up and use the loo while we waited on our lunch.  

Since no other reviewer has mentioned that, thought I'd add that info to the mix.  Had we known about the absence of loo, we would not have stopped here with the plan to eat in.  Now we know, we may go back for take out some time but not as eat in destination, like say Guido's is for us.  

When we asked how it was they were running a food service business that didn't provide a bathroom for customers the answer from the nice kid behind the counter was swift, as if he'd been asked before.   "We aren't required to provide bathrooms since we are strictly a take out food  business."

Tilt.  They are not strictly a take out business.  They invite people to eat in and provide two tables to do that.   Absence of bathrooms good to know before you go.    In the meantime, if you're desperate for both a bathroom and to have this pizza you can use the loo in the bar next door. 

We opted to leave and have lunch elsewhere on this particular day.

THIS N THAT:

1) PARKING:  In the lot in the little strip mall location.

2) ACCESSIBILITY:  Level in the door,  One table at standard height seating.

This morning I got a text saying that no food had been ordered for an event that was to start at 11:30am for 25 people.  I placed a call to Claudine the catering manager who then called the chef.  Not quite 30 minutes later I had a call back saying yes we can help, but also a contract in my inbox.  They solved my problem so quickly and graciously!  Not only was Claudine so nice and accommodating the food was delivered on time, set up, AND delicious.  Kahula Pork,  Teriyaki Chicken, Coconut Rice and and a house salad satisfied everyone including those who are gluten free.  The Island spirit of hospitality was very present and the food was very tasty.  Thank you so much Kanak Attack for saving the day.

Became patients here a year ago. Love their treatment of my daughter. The doctors are very respectful of personal choices and so good with toddler checkups. They listen to concerns and give informational answers. Very pleased.

I nearly walked out today 1/22/19 when I overheard the older Asian worker disrespect the customers a few people in front of me. She was yelling at them and being so rude. The younger Asian boy is so friendly and kind - great customer service. If it wasn't for him helping me - I would of left mid order. The food is good, slightly over priced in my opinion - but just by a few dollars. I'll be back on occasion - but I'll stay clear of the wicked witch employee.

I just wanted to leave a review in regards to our past several visits to Freddy's. The hospitality we received from Jason Corral exceeded our expectations. He was so friendly and kind. It was truly welcoming and set the atmosphere for your resturant. I wish every place in the valley had hospitality like Jason. He also made some great recommendations since we are new to the area. Best steaks burgers!! We look forward to our future visits.

I would NEVER bank at CHASE.  I am a executer of a estate. The deceased had many banks that I've had to deal with, CHASE was by far the worst. The policy of having to wait 30 days to close a account when you have proof of complete power is absolutely absurd. Chase was the only bank out of 7 that had that ridiculous policy. Having called prior to going the first time only to find out I had to wait 30 days, then waiting over a hour to be told that. I have been given so many different answers for every question! I have had to wait at least 40 min at both branches prior to even getting service.... I'm sitting here again waiting to close out the account. Been 45 minutes so far.  I WOULD AVOID THIS BANK LIKE THE PLAGUE!!!!!!

I've had many great past experiences with Dairy Queen but, this time it wasn't so great. Although the food is still good the service was terrible. We waited a good 20 minutes to get our food and after we had finished our food we had found out that they totally forgot about our blizzards. All in all it was a very bad experience and i wouldn't go to this location again. Disappointed:(

The brownie fudge ice cream is such a small amount they pretty much bend you over for the 5.29 or so that it costs.  Coupled with the fact there's no seating, the place is packed on a raining day and it stinks  to high hell because of so many people and crappy ventilation.  Totally not worth the time or the money  for the overall experience.  Web sites proclaims they have Apple Pay and they don't so be prepared to run back out to your car.

Love this place ! 
We have recently moved to Meridian and have used this restaurant for delivery (quick!) several times now. 
Love their house special fried rice, its a winner in my family.
First time going here very busy but that didn't effect them from getting my truck was fast and detailed out. Great job!! Will be going here a lot more often.

We were in town for a soccer tournament and wanted to think outside the box in what to eat for both the players and parents. Claudine and her team were awesome in orchestrating the details and accommodating our request for a part of that size (100-125). The crew arrived 30 minutes early and were up and running in a matter of minutes. The average turnaround on orders was legitimately under a couple of minutes and the rice bowls were a hit. We will be booking them next year for at least one catering event, if not two! Mahalo!
The employees were making out at the window. Took five minutes for a small Americano ... got instantly sick afterwards. Worst Dutch experience ever

The tacos were delicious, and quite surprisingly, filling. Sometimes food truck tacos aren't filled with much meat. I can honestly say, the tacos left me satisfied. I ended up getting the Korean Beef, Pork, and Brisket tacos. I didn't have room in my stomach for the sides. 

Great shift from the standard food trucks I've tried before. Especially since it's influenced by Hawaiian flavor.

This is our first visit to Meridian, Idaho so of course our first visit to Dutch Bros. I wanted to compliment Kenna for being so patient & helpful in explaining all the different coffee's. Kenna was professional and courteous and I would certainly recommend Dutch Bros to the relatives we are visiting. I was so impressed I felt I should take a few minutes to complement her for her great customer service.
Thank you Kenna!
Barbara Mitchell
Stanton, CA

First off, the facility is great. I have been in three times in the last two months and have not waited more than five minutes each time in the waiting room. The facility feels clean and is modern. The staff are professional and seem to be very well trained. Dr. Jeremy Frix is excellent! He took the time to introduce himself to me the first time we met. He asked me several questions to get to know me before starting to figure out what I needed to get back to 100%. He followed that up with what care and prescription that I needed and the signs and symptoms to look for if it didn't work. An overall great experience!

Me and my husband stopped by here for a quick breakfast and it is now our favorite coffee shop! He go the caramel macchiato and I got a caramel frappe, plus we both got breakfast burritos and it was all delicious! An added bonus is the staff is super friendly!
Brought my son in for a hair cut. Brenda did an amazing job with my son and his vision of what he wants. We will be back!

Best Mexican food in the valley we have tried. Service was outstanding. It is not a big restaurant and the place was really busy. We ordered the carne asada tacos, enchiladas and carnitas fritas. The fritas were so tender and had great flavor. The carne asada hit the spot. We will be back.

Tip: Split a dish because the servings are HUGE.

Christian is superb in his field. My wife and I had our home desktop computer's hard drive fail and we received the dreaded blue screen of death. We took it to Geek on a Scooter in recommendation by my in-laws that said he was fair and a stand up guy to boot. Christian determined it was a bad hard drive and said he would try and recover what files he could. About 3 days later I got a call saying our computer was ready and he was able to recover about 30-40 gigs of data. We were very pleased with the speedy turn around time the excellent customer service and knowledge he was willing to share with a couple computer dummies like my wife and I. I always aim to support local businesses and I will continue to go to Geek on a Scooter for all my computer needs thank you Christian and Kat you guys are amazing.
Highly recommend Dr. Hill. I've been a patient for 15 years and he and his staff  are friendly, capable, punctual and work extra hard to make sure you are a happy customer.

Amazing customer service and donuts! We tried 7 different flavors and everyone of them were a hit. Very family friendly place. This will be our go to treat. I will say we eat sugar free and low carb. If you're not use to Stevia type sweetener it's takes some getting use to. We are very health conscious and have grown to love the treats and the customer service. I'd rather feed my kids healthy while their little and teach good eating habits that will last. We always order extra! They're even better the next day after sitting in the refrigerator. This is not Krispy Kreme the difference is it's a "fit" donut.
Mi Casa is family owned. They are the nicest people! We have made it our Friday night regular spot because the food is so good.

I adore this place. Their menu is unique , fresh & delicious. I have to admit... their fried spinach ... I am obsessed with it. Had it for the first time on salmon dish & yes, salmon was amazing. Also, on one of their pizzas & that was also delicious. The poutine is also out of this world. My favorite restaurant bar none. Love this place

Our stay was great. Staff were nice, the room was nice and clean. Other families in the pool were not very respectful. Wish they had mini fridges and microwaves. Our room was fairly large, and our king bed was great. We stayed for 3 nights, and would definitely return. 

A lot fancier than I thought! (For a Motel 6)

Not bad Acai bowls but horrible customer service. I showed up with 20 minutes left before they closed and they seemed upset that I came in. After I left I sat outside for a while and saw them refuse to serve a customer with 15 minutes left before they closed. As soon as he walked out they locked the door behind him and laughed as other people tried to come inside to order for the next 15 minutes. Find better employees ASAP, very disappointed.
This place is so good, fresh clean ingredients and always clean. Will definitely be back for more. Gotta get the togarashi spice on top with salmon.

I would like to note that they are open about an hour longer than Paddles Up. I never realized how many poke places are on Eagle road and I am happy that I found this one. Poke Bowl is really cool and has a nice staff with a smile on their face.
This is like the Asian version of Subway. What is really great is the menu in back of them that provides step by step directions on putting your poke bowl together. 
They have a variety of items to add. I chose salad, tuna, wasabi shoyu, tobiko, green onions, cucumbers, and tofu and this was delicious! 
If you feel like getting some poke I recommend Poke Bowl. Great food and a great team.

Surprising find while on a business trip! Excellent tacos (had the shrimp one and the curry cauliflower one). Who would have ever thought to put blue cheese on curry?!?  It was fantastic. Excellent margs! They had a special two tacos and their marg for $12. Had to try it!
Nice, clean bar! Recently reopened/remodeled  new owner! Great service and prices! In town only for a week, but will go back, before leaving town!!!!!

I don't know why I always end up getting some crafty stuff here lol. Well, first off there's a lot of great establishments nearby so it's like a one stop shop especially when Babies R Us was still here. I'm not sure if I'm getting a good deal coz I've never been to other craft store to compare it with but I always get sale items anyways. There's tons of things you find here from home decors, arts, all sort of crafts like beads, jewelry making, painting, quilting, you name it! Tons! If you want to kill time & be inspired just come & you'll end up buying & making some stuff lol.

I don't get how this place is even open. This is my first time here, and the employees are rude. The soda machine is broken, apparently it's always broken and never works. There were 8 people waiting at the register for an employee to come and fill their drink orders with the soda machine behind the counter and guess what?! THERE WERE NO EMPLOYEES AT THE FRONT FOR LIKE 5-8 MINUTES. Like HELLOOOOO?! Clearly none of these people have customer service skills and don't care about their jobs. My sister spoke with with a few employees and they still seemed to not give a heck, the manager seemed to care more about her cell phone being charged than the customers!! Why the F*** do have a job if you don't take pride or care at all? Unbelievable. Go elsewhere! Avoid this place like the plague!
Wow! Had a great experience here. I was visiting from Az and desperately needed an adjustment. I was so impressed with how gently he corrected my issue. I wish that they were located in Az.

I took my daughter to get her nails done and the nail technician was very nice and professional. The technician took her time to get my daughter's nails done perfectly. Her nails looked beautiful. 
They offered us water bottle while we were there and got me a chair to be next to my daughter. 
Their customer service is outstanding!

Normally I love five guys but I have went there recently and was so disappointed it had no flavor and the bun got soggy fast.. for the price I expect quality and that's not what I got.... the employees came off cold and unwelcoming, 2 of them even went as far to point and make fun of me while I was standing there. Definitely won't be going back!

Align Chiropractic is a friendly clinic.  I was suffering from back pain and went to see Dr. Woolner.  He helped relieve my pain and was very professional and cared about me as a person.  I highly recommend them to anyone seeking chiropractic care.
We frequent this place often, and it never disappoints! Just great sandwiches and great service!!

I am so glad we found Dr. Butuk, he is very knowledgeable and cares about his patients. My two children  who are 2 and 4 are no longer scared of going to the doctor. In addition, the nurses are sweet and great with children. 
This is the best doctor my children have had and I highly recommend him.

Disappointing first visit. 

The employees didn't acknowledge we were even there for the first few minutes while they chatted in front of us.  We almost walked out at that point. The guys making the pizza were good. 

The pizza was okay for fast food pizza. The guy at the register was honest and said there was a problem with the soda fountain and there wasn't any sugar free bottled drinks, so we didn't get any drinks. 

Overall, pretty average to below average visit.
This is a hidden gem in Meridian. Meghan's fade skills are on point! Seriously, one of the best barbers in the area.
Great salads and pretzel bun burgers! A great selection of local beers.
Lots of sandwiches to choose from, too bad they made the one I chose completely wrong. Very expensive for what you get, won't be coming back

Unfortunately we did not have the best experience here. I had been wanting to try this place for quite some time and was excited about the opportunity to with some out of town guests. When we initially walked in, we asked for a booth by the window (all of the booths by the windows were open) and we were told by the host that we could not sit there as it wasn't in the servers section that he was supposed to seat next. Ok, I thought. He's a young kid and probably isn't sure what he's allowed to do yet, but we'll just ask the server. The server gets to our table and we ask if we could sit at a booth by the window, to which she gets very obviously annoyed and while hastily grabbing the menus from our table says, "I guess if you HAVE to, you can. But it's not in the rotation so it messes up our seating." We tell her to just forget it. 
Give me a break, guys. When I go out to eat I am paying to enjoy my experience, and if that means a spot at the window that was completely open, that's where I should get to sit. If it was reserved or on the complete opposite side of a very large restaurant I could understand, but that wasn't the case. Please teach your servers that your customers should not be made to feel as though they are burdening the staff with a simple request of seating arrangements. Oh and guess where two customers later were allowed to be seated!
By the way, the three stars are for the food and the expansive menu.

This is the second time I have ordered from here, the first time  I ordered  8 dozen assorted Bundtlet (size of a cupcake) perfect size! I hid some for later. Everything is fresh and always delicious. I found them to be consistent and helpful with orders and suggestions. Everything is So good! I ordered a lemon  cake for a birthday  Just yum

Good, basic, homestyle burgers but with a nice range of add-on's ( I suggest adding grilled jalapeños). Their Cajun fries are yummy, and their milkshakes (chocolate, banana) are really good. Def come here if you're looking for a quick but solidly good food. 

As a California girl, I'd say In-N-Out burgers and plain fries are a little better.. but maybe it's just nostalgia.

Do not buy a house with this builder, they are not willing to help you when you have a problem. I bought a home from them in October and now that its cold I have 2 areas of that house that are 10 degrees colder than the rest of the house. This includes 2 full baths, my master bedroom and master closet.  I have tried to tell them I had this problem but they are siding with the Arctic Air another bad company with poor customer service. I cannot even take a shower in the morning because it is 63 degrees in the bathroom.  They just sent us an email the day before Christmas telling us that our house was fine, we use a space heater to heat our master bedroom.  This is a brand new home. The staff was welcoming and my uniforms (blazer; dress) and a silk top were all dry cleaned very nicely, to my complete satisfaction. The location and hours are very convenient.
I'll be bringing all my dry cleaning here!

I was sent here by my regular barber who was too busy to get me in. I showed up without an appointment, but John gave me a fantastic haircut and treated me like a king. I get a cut every two weeks, and liked that he didn't shear me off like some shops. I will stay with my normal barber since it is closer to my home, but I would recommend this place any time. Gave me the full old-fahion barber treatment that I like.
I was not a fan of their coffee, tried it twice just to make sure I didn't get a bad cup but disappointed in the end. I liked Big Star coffee better. Staff is friendly though!

Excellent, professional service. I walked in and was able to begin my cut within minutes. Richard did a great job with my hair. Fantastic local shop!

 ~ CASH, no cards

 ~ Walk-ins welcome
Very nice stay , clean & friendly . James very helpful , good lil breakfast . Pool room is a little strong smelling of Chlorine but overall would recommend and stay again .

Awesome Pizza and very affordable especially during Happy Hour....Have also had very good luck with their sandwiches and love the Jalapeno Bacon Mac and Cheese.

We will keep coming back!
Stopped for lunch after church.  Very good food and nice service. Think I preferred the shredded beef taco over the ground beef but they both were excellent

Finding gluten free treats that satisfy can be a daunting and expensive task. Finding ones that are actually made of healthier ingredients, and LOWER in calories than the typical wheat counterparts is next to impossible.

Craving baked sweets on the fly, I did a quick Yelp search and found Fit Donuts. After a phone call to confirm GF status, I had the hubby turn the car around, STAT!

Once inside, we were still trying to make sense of the place by the time the young woman behind the counter was ready to assist us. Well then, nothing for it but to order a mixed half dozen (actually 7!). I felt good saving $$ on a fairly speedy specialty treat, and the extras will be popped into the freezer for enjoyment as 'needed' later on.

Is it a traditional donut? No.
But it hit the mark, and I know I'll be going back for more later on.

So let's break this down...

Ambiance: like pretty much everything in Meridian, it's tucked in a little strip mall. The interior is super low budget, nothing fancy or pretentious about it. You definitely get the feeling it's a start-up, and they're trying to be responsible by not outspending their revenue where possible. Cool. And they're really playing up the 'fit' part with their printed posters and prime location next to Crunch Fitness.

Aesthetics: if you're looking for gorgeous sweet treats to adorn a picture perfect party table, you're gonna want to look elsewhere. It's ok, just head on over to Lilly Jane's over in Eagle, and the (slightly obnoxious but well intentioned) woman at the counter will reassure you just how pretty each one is as you select based on flavor combos. The donuts here at Fit, in comparison, are all just complete gooey sloppy messes. AND THAT'S OK. Seriously. I'm not showing off to anybody, I'm just looking for something sweet and spongey to stuff in my face, that won't make me sick. Yay!!

Texture: I don't get why so many reviewers are saying these donuts are super dense? But I've also never understood the draw for Krispy Kreme. I want to chew my baked goods. I want to feel them in my mouth, and feel them taking up space in my stomach. I just don't get the appeal of a baked good that hits your tongue and dissolves into a tenth of the original size, sliding down your throat before your body is able to process that it received something that might satisfy a craving. It just leaves you craving more donuts. Maybe great for business, but a train wreck for the waist line. Speaking of trains, I derailed. The texture of Fit donuts falls somewhere in between a cupcake and an old fashioned cake donut. Which works for me, since those are two of my all time fave baked goods!

Flavor: the donut part has a great flavor, well balanced. The white base is light, with noticeable vanilla, and the chocolate base gets the flavor across without being heavy and cloying (no death by chocolate here). The glazes however do seem to be lacking just a little something. They're all just a teensy bit... watery. It's like grabbing for a glass of whole, or 2%, milk and unexpectedly getting skim. The flavor is ALMOST there. It really wants to be, and is just missing the slightest push to reach that flavor saturation that satisfies a craving. So. Dang. Close.

Sweet: they're using Stevia. Props. It's a different kind of sweet than sugar, and not everybody is adapted to the taste. It can be pretty great, or pretty horrific with a nasty aftertaste if done wrong. THEY'RE DOING IT RIGHT (no bitter aftertaste)! Yeah, it's a sweet donut. It's. A. Donut. But unlike a full sugar version, it doesn't leave you doing the 'dog-eating-peanut-butter' tongue thing as you recover from a too sweet treat. It also doesn't leave you feeling like crap from either too-much-sugar nausea, or cause tense muscles and cranky exhaustion from a quick sugar peak then crash.

And to circle back to the best part of all.... they didn't make me feel sick. Gluten free, remember? That's something that will keep me coming back for more, which is totally OK since they're pretty good nutritionally speaking!
So horrible.  So so horrible.  I had Reyna cut my bangs.  I might as well have had my dog trim my bangs.  I look like a 3 year old who trimmed their own bangs!  Avoid.

Just be prepared to WAIT! Every. Time. I. Come. Here. This time I even called ahead because it was a Friday night and expected it to be busy. Called at 6:08pm for a basic 10 piece bone-in combo. I arrived at the store at about 6:20 and paid. They said about 5 more minutes on my order. I usually wait about 15 minutes when I don't call ahead (which is ridiculous to begin with) but I tried to save myself the frustration tonight. So at 6:47pm they called my name. Yes, that's right, 40 minutes to fry chicken wings.

What's even more frustrating is that the guy who paid right before me (didn't call ahead) got his about 5 minutes before me. 

There are a couple of saving graces that make me come back: first, the wings are very good. I am not a fan of slimy wet wings so I always get the Louisiana rub which is a nice, spicy Cajun dry rub. If you ask them to make them "crispy", they will actually cook them extra as well. Love it. Second, even though you've waited for 15 minutes or more, at least when they serve them they are clearly right out of the fryer. Molten lava hot. Again, so at least you've waited for SOME reason: freshness. Tonight, though, it was clear that someone just forgot about me because the  wings were not molten-lava-hot. And not to forget the dipping sauce. I get the bleu cheese dressing and it is wonderful. My wife is a "connoisseur" of ranch dressing and she loves theirs as well.

Basically, if they weren't so good and usually so freshly fried, I would've given it ONE star for the service. Repeatedly. Okay, and even if you've read this and decided to call ahead an hour in advance to surely not have to wait, the napkin and utensil situation is terrible. Paper towels off a roll for napkins. Oh, and they give you like, ONE dressing with your 10 wings. Otherwise you gotta pay more for the others. If you like to dip a lot you'll be disappointed as well. Also, if you sit in the restaurant to eat, this location has no trash can in the lobby. Not kidding. No way for you to help them clear room for others when everyone is waiting. They clearly aren't quick with the cooking and not efficient with the cleaning either. Just kind of a mess, all of the time.

Last thing: I know it sounds petty to knock them down for just having to wait and especially tonight because I got forgot. But this scene just plays out every night in a way. One night I went in there and ordered (didn't call ahead). I sat down to a table adjacent to an older gentleman who worked at the Lowe's that shared the parking lot with Wingstop. We had a bunch of time to chat (again with the waiting) and he looked at his watch and said, "man, I'm not going to have time to eat". You see, it was his first time there and his break was only 30 minutes. Use 5 minutes to walk to WS, 5 minutes to walk back, and then... YES, 20 minutes to order and get his food. Literally just took his food and walked back to work without being able to eat it. 

The vibe is clearly fast food, not luxury sit-down. I would recommend that the checkout person be more upfront about the wait. Maybe a sign that says, "current cook time is 15 minutes". So someone like this nice, old man doesn't have to just miss out eating on his lunch break!

Over the years I have been writing reviews, I have found that weather one likes, or hates the food at a particular restaurant, depends largely on where you are from. 

For example;

I am from Texas. I moved up here around 15 years ago. Most Texans want their food to have a lot of flavor, a good amount of spice, and some, to a lot of heat. 

Here in Idaho, most tend to like their food more on the bland side. With little to no spice, and little to no heat. A case in point is my wife. She is a native Idahoan.

Her idea of hot sauce is ketchup. 

I have this same problem at home when cooking. I am the primary cook in the home. The problem is that I like spice and heat and I am cooking for 2 ladies (my wife for now, and my daughter). Neither like anything even remotely spicy.  Now, I want to cook for that they will like, but when I taste my cooking, what seems very mind to me, is very spicy to them. 

Ugh!

Of course like most anything else in life, there are exceptions, but this is a general guideline. So going forward, when writing reviews, I will do my best to give food 2 ratings. One for spice lovers of the world, like me, and one for the......less spice lovers out there.

Before I went to Mi Casa to eat lunch, I read the reviews. This place has a lot of people that seem to just love the food here.

In addition to the food, I want to eat in nice surroundings. Now, I dont consider myself a food snob, but there are certain things that bug me. When I walked into Mi Casa, the 1st thing I did is look around. In the words of Shania Twain, "that dont impress me much!"

There are exposed electrical panels, the bathroom is right there in plain view, and there was some sort of odd looking picket fence thing in the corner. I don't know about you, but when I am eating my food, the last thing I want to see is some guy, or gal, going into the bathroom. 

Yukaronney, or double Yukarooney, depending on if they are going there to do #1 or #2.

We started our meal with the normal chips and salsa and refrieds. The Chips were...well they were chips. The salsa was ok. No heat to it and very little flavor either, but it was fine. The refrieds were pretty bland. They could have been anything at all. Thats how flavorful they were.

I ordered en enchilada with shredded beef and a Chimichanga (Hamburger meat). My 13 year old daughter had a chicken taco. The shredded beef Enchilada was tasty. I was impressed by this one. No heat, but it had some spice to it.

The Chimichanga, on the other hand, had no flavor what-so-ever. I even added the sour cream and Guac that came with it hoping that this would add flavor. But nope. No flavor at all. The flavor machine had left the building.

Next I tried my daughters chicken tacos. OMG is all I can say to these. I have served better tasting chicken to my dog. Even my daughter, that loves chicken, turned her nose up to these. 

So the bottom line here is that it will depend on where you are from if you will like the food here. If you like your food more on the flavorless side of things, you might love it here.

If you like spice, heat, and flavor, I suggest that you keep looking. If anyone out there finds a good Mexican restaurant that serves good, flavorful, full of spice and heat food, please let me know. I have been searching for this 15 years.

Ratings 1-10 scale (1 being "Yukamunga" and 10 being a "foodgasm")

Food (Spice lovers of the World) - 2
Food - (The Spice less population ) - 5

Next door to the Meridian location of The Griddle, I've walked right by this storefront before without even noticing what it was.  Thanks to Yelp friend review, I did notice as I walked by yesterday and popped in.  Every kind of soda and candy, domestic and imported from Europe and Asia, one might imagine.  Some of these same things you'll find in other stores for maybe a little less money, the more common brands, but some of the goodies here are more unusual to find anywhere and for sure not as common to see all in one place.  It even smells good, in the way that fresh sugar does, when you walk in and the friendly service is the proverbial icing.  

Many of these items are "sweets for the memory" for shoppers of a certain age.  They took me back to childhood days and the people who inhabited them with me.  As example, the decidedly non-PC for this century packages of candy cigarettes, just as I remembered them as a kid and even the same style boxes.  In that day before the Surgeon General warnings, we wanted to grow up and smoke like our grandparents and the people we saw in movies. The candy cigarettes we'd buy ourselves were the "pretend until then".

Truth be told, I likely would have been a smoker but when I was nine my dad offered me $100 if I didn't smoke before I turned twenty-one.  That sealed the deal for me.  In that day a hundred bucks seemed a fortune for a nine year old.  (Want to know how the story ends? Goal oriented kid I was, the smoke free me collected the $100 bill on my 21st birthday, went to the store, bought my first pack of cigarettes and smoked occasionally for six months with my friends until that was enough of that. :-) )  

I can't imagine a single parent or grandparent wanting to buy candy cigarettes for the kids in their life for 'role model practice' these days.  But I sure was tempted to buy a box yesterday to see if they still had the little painted "red tip" to mimic the burning ciggie.  Would make a great gag gift for a friend giving up smoking.   Well.  Let me rethink that.  I've never know friends to have a sense of humor while in nicotene withdrawal.

If you have friends or family who are fans of sweets, this store could be a good destination for some stocking stuffers with the holidays approaching.

I have watched Freddie's every since they 1st went in. They have been open for just a couple months now.

I almost did not try Freddie's. From the outside, they look like a normal run of the mill burger joint that is part of a strip mall. The only thing that caught my attention was the fact that is new (I am a sucker for all things new) and the fancy script font used for their sign along with the color. Red stands out very well.

I have been so very disappointed by so many burger places, that I could just not bear to try yet another one.

Well, I am happy to say that I am glad that I did try Freddie's. but still have reservations with it. 

When I 1st entered Freddie's I felt like I was in the movie Back to the Future. I was now Michael J Fox being transported back to a 1950's diner.

The diner looks and feels like a 1950's diner right down to the music that you will hear.

My 1st issues is the staff. Its not a big issue, but it is a pet peeve of mine. When I go to a theme restaurant, or specific type of cuisine restaurant, I want to be fully immersed in the experience.

After all, the atmosphere of the restaurant is just as important as the food. It adds to the overall experience. 

For example, if I am going to a Chinese restaurant, I want to feel like I am in china. I want to hear Chinese music, be waited on by actual Chinese people, and feel like I am in China. 

When I am in an Italian Restaurant, I want to be served by Italians, hear Italian music and when I walk out, feel like I have just visited Italy.

When I go to a 50's diner, I want to listen to 50's music, eat 50's style food, and be served by staff that are look like they just woke up from the 1950's. 

The staff at Freddie's looked and acted like any ordinary Joe Blow's from the 2000's. 

When I approached the counter to order my burger, I asked for a normal single patty hamburger. The young lady at the bar instantly told me that I should get a double due to the fact that the patties are very thin.

She said that she did not want me to get the single patty burger and say to myself, or her, 'Wheres the beef?"

The question I had to ask myself was; Was this lady speaking the truth, or was she just trying to up sell me to a double burger?

I told her that I would have the double. My objection here is this. Whats the point of even having a single patty burger on the menu since they are so small that their staff dont even recommend them?

When my food came out, I knew that my young lady at the counter has spoken the truth.The patties here are very thin. Almost paper thin!

This is why they can cook them so quickly even to order instead of cooking them ahead of time like so many other places.

The patty had a nice crispiness to it. It was cooked on a flat top. I am not usually a fan of burgers cooked on flat tops because they lack flavor. But the char of the meat from it being on the grill and pressed down, gives it a nice flavor.

The patties are so thin though that even with having 2 of them, I still did not get enough meat. A few of the bites of my burger had no meat in them at all. This is due to a patty that is not big enough to fit the entire bun.

On my hamburger-ometer, I give the burger a 5 out of 10. Though it had a good flavor, I had to rank it down because of the size of the patty and the thinness of the patty.

The burgers here are not cheap. The single patty burger is a pretty typical costs, but do not order it. Its way too thin and wont give you enough meat to feed a field mouse.
You will be disappointed.

When I went home for the night, I had..well you know....gaseous anomalies! That means that either the burger, or the fries were greasy.

If you go here, you will want to order at least a double and maybe even a triple. I know the next time I go, it will have to be a triple for me. Given that the triple here is equivalent to a single at most every other burger place in town, its over priced.

The saving grace for me on this burger is the fact that it comes by default with MUSTARD. I think only time will tell how well this will go over up here in Idaho where Mayo is so popular, that it is its own food group.

Personally, I love the fact that they have chosen Mustard over mayo. I am from Texas where all burgers are done with mustard.

Next come the fries. They are very thin as well. They are what are known as shoe string fries. They are way too thin to have any flavor to them. On my Fri-Ometer, they get a 2 out of 10.

The lady at the counter offered us some frozen custard. It was Delicious!!!

If you dont here for nothing else, you have to have the custard. Frozen custard has all but poofed from the market. I have no idea why because it is sooo much better than ice Cream or Frozen Yogurt.

Its very very creamy and just plain good. I highly recommend the Frozen Yogurt. I dont recommend the fries and do recommend the burger as long as you have a double or triple. If you can afford it that i
