I entered the little store which seems to always have the parking spots in front of the store full. Maybe it's because the dry cleaners share the parking with Jamba and UPS. So keep in mind that you may have to trek over to bring your goods to Martinizing. Once inside, I was greeted by a friendly lady who very genuine and sweet. I can't remember her name but I explained the situation and she let me know that she had to a call another lady in regards to a quote. No problem since I knew that this couch cushion's cover was on life support. She informed that the cost could be anywhere from 7 to 20 bucks. I was impressed and not offended by the wide range. She seemed to be ready to defend the pricing but I am simply not that guy and she was relieved. It's work that I can't do and couch cushion cover was under FEMA's damage relief.  I told her to call me when it's ready. She told me that maybe a week. I said ok and got one of those famous dry cleaner slips and put it in my wallet. It was like an achievement unlocked as I had not done that before. Anywho, the next day I get a call from a Boise number that I didn't  recognize. I thought maybe it was Karen or Ophelia asking me if I wanted to join them on a beer scavenger hunt so answered. It wasn't Ophelia or Karen but the lady from Martinizing. She told me that the cover was ready and her little elves were able to save the it for 10 bucks. Holy Sheets!!! I brought it home and put the  cover back on the cushion.  While 1 Hour Martinizing maybe be great dry cleaners, they saved the bacon for us in regards to the couch cushion cover and for that they earned 5 stars.
This was the best mortgage company!  They helped us finance our new home and it was the nicest home loan experience we have ever had!  Thank you Vicki!

Great place to stay. Easy to get to from airport. Front desk and housekeeping staff friendly and efficient. At check-in the front desk clerk went out of her way to locate a luggage cart for us. Housekeeper helped us solve a problem. Clean room and great to have a small kitchen. And did I mention the breakfast that's included in the room rate?

When you have potential customers coming in to possibly change carriers, it'd be a great idea to acknowledge people who walk though your doors and at minimum say, we'll be right with you.  Not let them walk in, sit down and wait for five minutes and have no one say a word.

This by far is the best Starbucks I've been to. 

The customer service is fabulous! They treat their customers the way customers should be treated. Additionally, I can't think of a time my drink was incorrect. When you spend $5 for a coffee some might think you're crazy. Fine...but I don't mind it if my drink is on point. My drinks are always on point because the workers actually care!

Great selection if beers, service is great. Very knowledgeable and helpful.
The growler station trend is really growing in Boise/Meridian, but one thing that will keep me coming back to Growler Guys is their updated list of available beers on their website. I can check their selection rather than going there only to find they don't have anything I'm interested in buying or having a whole growler full of. However, with the variety available I doubt that will ever be a problem. I love that you get tastes, can buy a pint and enjoy it there or have the option to take it home (or do all three if you are me and my husband!)
It's nice that there are some food options available just a few doors down. In fact, on our first visit another customer brought in his food to enjoy while drinking his beer. However, my new favorite pedicure place is practically next door so I know what I'll be enjoying after my next visit there.

Terry Anderson at Academy Mortgage is very knowledgeable and finds the best scenario for you in order to help you qualify for a home loan.  He found me much better rates, and lower points, than any traditional bank did, as well as several of the credit unions I looked into.  I would definitely use them again, and recommend them to my friends and family.

Another great visit to this Dutch Bros. location.  We came by to cash in our punch cards for free drinks.  Their punch card promotion is buy 10 drinks and then turn in the card for a free drink - any drink, any size.  

Our drinks were perfect and delicious:  Peppermint Bark Freeze (like a milkshakey iced peppermint mocha) and a Blended Starry Night Rebel (like a berry slushie energry drink).  

We were heading home to our dog and wondered if they did something like Starbucks does with the little cup of whipped cream calling it a puppuccino, so I asked the girl about it, and she said "ohhh yeah."  And then she asked if the dog could have treats, and I said yes.  So, she put together a small coffee cup with whipped cream and 3 treats on top which we were grateful for ... almost as much as our dog was.  We walked in the house and told her we had a treat for her from Dutch Bros. and she started the rapid tale wag and then enjoyed her deliciousness.  --- thanks again, Dutch Bros.!

I called to order bundtinis for my son's birthday (he's a BSU student) and I was informed that there is a $50 minimum in order to do delivery. WOW! I ordered from the same place last year for his birthday and it was not a $50 minimum. When I questioned it, she said it had been effect for two years which isn't true. For those of us who live out of state and want to send a special birthday treat, this policy is very unfortunate. Nothing Bundt Cakes lost a customer :(

Went with friends and we all got something different. I believe they were the oregon bowl (acai base), piña colada bowl (coconut base), and the aloha bowl (pitaya base) every bowl we tried was so good and fresh!! My favorite was the pitaya bowl tho! We also tried a health "shot" which was surprisingly tasty.

Maybe the most eclectic dining experience in Boise! Everything from Sandwiches to Sushi to Martinis and of course Gelato!

I love Gelato Cafe for a number of reasons. I've been coming here since they opened and it just got better after the new owner Brian bought it. The food is always fresh and delicious and the drinks are liberal and very drinkable!

My 7 year old daughter and I love going here for a light dinner and gelato or just for gelato and fun. The live music on the patio is a best kept secret, you'll always get a seat and always get great new music.

If I could give Gelato Cafe 10 stars I would. This is a hidden gem.
My favorite place for coffee in meridian. They genuinely kind, make excellent espresso, and always give my dog love through the drive thru window.

Sad... This is the 2nd time in two weeks I got a French dip in the drive through and got no dip!  Awful dry without the dip. And my Coke is a Dr Pepper, not a Coke. Oh well..... Carl's Junior is right next door!
We have been here multiple times and we leave happy every time! We have tried the juices, the bowls and the avocado toast! All delicious. The Staff is always very friendly and helpful.

My brother was in town from Portland and invited me to lunch here. I had the special "Turkey Cranberry" sandwich.  Very delicious!!! Loved it, plus my brother paid and I collected the stamps  so my next visit is a free sandwich. Yay!  We sat at the table next to the plug-in fireplace, enjoyed the sunshine and had a great lunch. Dining area very clean and you get free drink refills. Anyway, great place to share a lunch with your brother.

My chicken in my fajitas wasn't fully cooked and neither it not the steak had any flavor. My husband enjoyed his combo meal but our friends didn't enjoy their meals either. Device was good but the atmosphere is lacking. We won't be returning.

We love Meridian Family Medical, they are all so friendly! 
PA Scott Frisbee is amazing with our 6-year old son and always communicates well with us!!! 
My husband and I are seriously going to change to their Office as our primary care office!
Thank you all for such quality treatment!

Cindy, Tom & Logan Lucas

The poke bowls were good. Decent variety of protein, sauces and toppings. We especially loved the seaweed salad. 

My only critique would be of their teriyaki menu. We ordered from the teriyaki menu since we had our youngest child with us and she wasn't sold on eating a poke bowl. First, we felt the prices of the teriyaki was high, especially for the quality. It took us about ten minutes for us to get our order and the chicken we ordered was thin, dry and the sauce wasn't delicious at all.

All in all, if you are going there for the poke bowls, you won't be disappointed. If you are there for the teriyaki, I'd recommend eating some where else.

This place is AMAZING!!! They have the most tender and moist pulled pork I have ever eaten. It melts in your mouth! AND... they loaded up their truck and went up in the mountains to feed the fire eaters on the fire lines!! AWESOME! AWESOME! AWESOME business and people!! They don't come any better than these folks!!

The Fit Donut exceeded my expectations! The shop itself is pretty minimalist, but the donuts (the important part) were so good! We went out of our way to stop here on a long road trip per a friend's recommendation, and I'm glad we did for the donuts alone. We tried 6 flavors and they were all good. The most impressive part was that the donuts still had a moist texture when we first tried them 6+ hours after picking them up, and then even STILL days later. I would stop here when going through Boise again.

Slowest service when it comes to checking out,i is the gal that was sweet and help me find my item bit the one in the picture, I had to asked them to open another register while they were gathered up chatting non work related, I got an attitude from the gal in the photo for asking to be checked out I also wasn't even asked the same check out questions like the other lady just the evil eye
Cut Loose got me in last minute for a much needed refresher. Mia (I hope that's her name!!) did a killer job. I'm so excited to come back and get my hair colored. I 100% recommend this salon!
Person at register was very unfriendly and non welcoming. Couldn't wait for us to leave and it was not closing time.
One person working the register, two people cooking. 80 people waiting for burgers. Eating area is a dirty mess. Place is a disaster.

Finally!  WING STOP IS HERE! Look out waistline. ..now I can have my favorite fast food wings all of the time! I used to travel for a living nation wide...I would land in "whatever" city....Yelp the nearest Wing Stop.  It was my good luck meal for a successful business trip.

LEEEEEEMON PEPPER...WET...WELL DONE....DRUMMIES ONLY!

Mango hab.....well done....drummies only.....

Ate there last night, after a weekend camping.  

Will I ever step foot in BWW again?  Probably. ..but not for wings!

I got the right advice, the right new mountain bike, at the right price from Paul (owner). Additionally, the crankset on my new ride had some persistent problems and after adjusting things twice he offered to install a slightly more expensive replacement at his expense. I've been riding 2-3 times a week since and am loving it!
- 
I just moved into town and had been wanting to start mountain biking - I tried foothills singletrack a few times, loved it, and had to buy my own ride. With the foothills so close it was no-brainer.
- 
I've been road riding for a few years - Already having chewed through a cheap road bike and upgraded to a nicer model, I knew I'd want to go for at least a midgrade bike for durability and performance. 
- 
I went in on a friends recommendation and he gave me a few options including a 29er full suspension on sale for about 30% off. Based on my size and the price he pushed me towards the 29er, which happened to be about the middle of my price point.
- 
Since the sale he has been knowledgeable and extremely helpful (including the new crank/chainrings) and has been willing to come very close to internet prices on components I've needed.

The pizza we ordered was nothing memorable.  We had a half mushroom/half mushroom+pineapple+olive.  When I phoned, I could barely hear the employee taking my order because the noise in the bar was so loud.  It was a super thin, greasy pizza.  We also had side Caesar salads, and those were good.  The croutons were from a box, and weren't that tasty.  I don't like to give reviews that aren't "happy" ones, but my experience wasn't that great.  Note:  they do not deliver to hotels.

I am giving them a two star for the simple reason that their customer service is severely lacking. I went into buy a mini bunt cake and asked for a fork. The response I got was that they could sell me four forks for a dollar but could not give me one. 
While I enjoy the taste of the there Bunt Cakes I will never be back. 

If you don't have good customer service then you don't deserve my business!

I searched all over Boise for the best breakfast burritos and I found them at KB's. In addition to the burritos, this place is super clean, the staff is very nice and they have an unusually large beer selection.  Whenever I'm in the area, it's KB's for me for sheez!

very cool casual atmosphere, great beer selection and staff that really knows what they're talking about, very good at giving suggestions based on a vague description of my tastes. Everybody there seems to really love their job, which is always nice.

We were out with friends and were looking for a spot to watch the Duke V. North Carolina game. 

We wandered into Pinnacle after striking out at two other sports bars (one was playing UFC exclusively and the other was playing the game sans volume). Pinnacle sat our (pretty large) group right away and brought portable speakers to our table so that we could all hear as well as see the game. Nice!

The majority of my companions went for their beer options except one who got a (rather good) Scotch while I went for an Old Fashioned (not as good). Overall, I think beer is probably your best bet here (not complaining...I like beer!).

For dinner, I ordered their Turkey Melt (turkey, cheddar, tomato, and bacon on sourdough). It was the perfect example of Sports Bar eats (ie: casual, unpretentious, filling, and satisfying). Our server was on point throughout the evening and kept track of our large group rather well. 

This is not a place I would necessarily seek out for dinner, but if you're looking for a place to watch sports (and actually hear the game!)--this is solid spot!

Get to it!
Sooooooo good! Love all the different flavors and combinations, love the new watermelon flavor!
They have suckers for kids and you can check in on the app! So convenient for moms. No complaints.

I got there half an hour before closing, which I thought would be enough time to find shoes that fit before the store closed. As it turned out, Holly spent a little over an hour showing me different shoes, watching me walk around the store and on a treadmill. The latter was videotaped for a minute or two, not just a couple of steps, and used to analyze my gait. 

I settled on a shoe that we both agreed would be a good choice. It fits well, is comfortable to wear, does not rub anywhere, yet didn't cost any more than at other speciality shoe stores. I'll definitely go back for my next pair.
Son went and got a hair cut on 11/9/19 and they totally botched it! I did a better job fixing it and I have never cut hair other than buzz cuts.

The food was one star, the two is because the waiter was nice. There were 5 of us, only one of us thought their food was okay. Their signature soup bowl tastes like tomato soup with jerky shrimp, the carnitas were cold, the flavors were bland, and the carne asada meat tastes like it was from a grocery store. 
The customer service was good so I really appreciate that.
I am really excited about this place. Having worked with almond flour before, I knew not to expect traditional donut texture or flavor. But since I miss junk food, this totally hit the spot!

The people here are always friendly, and make some awesome coffee. I usually go with an americano, or cappuccino, but sometimes I'll get their Mexican mocha and it's amazing. Everything I've had ha been delicious. One of the best I. The valley, probably the best with a drive thru.

I would NEVER bank at CHASE.  I am a executer of a estate. The deceased had many banks that I've had to deal with, CHASE was by far the worst. The policy of having to wait 30 days to close a account when you have proof of complete power is absolutely absurd. Chase was the only bank out of 7 that had that ridiculous policy. Having called prior to going the first time only to find out I had to wait 30 days, then waiting over a hour to be told that. I have been given so many different answers for every question! I have had to wait at least 40 min at both branches prior to even getting service.... I'm sitting here again waiting to close out the account. Been 45 minutes so far.  I WOULD AVOID THIS BANK LIKE THE PLAGUE! Update: Now we are three months after the death of the account holder. I am still waiting on a CD and was just told today it could be another month or more. I have had to prove that I am the executor of the estate to this bank at least Ten times. I have wasted hours upon hours dealing with this bank just to try to get bank statements so I can do the deceased taxes. I absolutely would not bank with this bank if they were the last bank on earth. This bank is holding up closing the estate. Honestly people there are so many better banks out there. Do yourself a favor and don't bank with chase. I have credit cards with Chase and they are fine. But have been checking savings and retirement products with this bank is a joke. Don't do this to your loved ones. They are extremely hard to work with for the executor of your estate . Absolutely the worst!!!

This is the 2nd time I've used Clearco Windows. The first time was this past spring in which I purchased a Groupon. I expected an additional cost as the Groupon clearly specifies what is covered, and I was happy paying the extra money and just as happy with the overall cost and service.  When you consider older homes, screens, panels, stories to climb on ladders, these guys are SUPER reasonable!  I did not use a Groupon this time, and I still feel the overall cost was still super reasonable and affordable. Todd was just as friendly and professional as I remembered and the service was nothing less than I expected. I just love walking around my house and looking (and seeing) out the windows! Thank you Clearco for providing great a service!
Outstanding customer service! The employees are courteous and very friendly! Yummy smoothies and coffee!

Purchased a Groupon and then when I balked at some of their pricing, the cleaner explained why.  I said to go ahead to clean the windows and I would pay the extra money.  He went out to "call the owner", came back in and literally told me that I should go buy a Groupon from another glass cleaning company because there were better deals available right now.  Two things: that is a complete untruth - there are not other deals on Groupon and you cannot call Groupon because they don't take phone calls.  I am appalled at the way the whole thing was handled when I agreed to pay the additional money in the first place.

I've been to juice bars all over the country and revitalize is my favorite. The quality of the juices is obvious from the look and the taste. Relaxing environment and friendly staff. My favorite juice is Mother Earth and Tree Hugger. Also, try the açaí bowl...Trust me!!

Easily the best diner style burger in the Boise area. It might not be the place for you if you like a big gob of meat that tastes like it was washed in the blood of the lame. I happen to like thin well-done patties that are browner than grasshopper spit. It gives the meat the familiar flavor of an old home burger in the distant diner of the mind. The bun is fine, the dressings fresh, the stick taters tasty, & I don't give a hoot to pollute my chute with any custard. I'm sure it's good, but I'm on a low fart diet. If you've got any funk in your spunk, you'll like this place, even if it is a chain.
Nasty, fishy tasting yellowtail and salmon. So much rice and so little protein. Wouldn't have minded so little protein if it actually tasted fresh. Feel quesy after eating this for lunch.

I drive by this restaurant every day and have wanted to try it for a while. My husband and I finally went and weren't very impressed. They sat us right next to the front door which was busy and cold, and the food itself was mediocre. We tried the Thai tacos and a pizza. The crust is an interesting consistency, dense and almost seemed to not be done. Overall, not worth the money in our opinion.

The food was really quite good and our service was great. $1 Rainer beer happy hour can't be beat! I'm glad we stayed to eat, we almost left based on the bathrooms. The 3 stars is for the SUPER slippery floor, the disgusting bathroom and lack of decor. I used the restroom before ordering and almost left based on the facilities. It looked like an old gas station bathroom. The kitchen hoods looked dirty from our seats and the paint is coming off the walls behind the booths. Really no wall decor. If the place felt clean I would rate 4 stars.

Love Towneplace place suites because of the separate bedroom option when traveling with four kids. The staff here Were friendly and beds were clean. The white doors throughout the entire building were gross dirty. Please add that to your cleaning routine. Even in an older hotel if the doors, handles and kick plates are clean it feels ok.

Heaven. I've arrived! For me there is nothing sweeter, nothing more deliciously decadent or craveable! The stuff of my dreams and impossible standard no other healthy treat place can have a hope of living up to. Sorry guys, but this is MY happy place! 

Peanut Butter Bowl, add honey and GF granola. A carrier full of gorgeous raw juices. What else can a girl want? I mean, free diamonds of course--but unlike this place, that's one unicorn that just doesn't seem to exist. Still looking. :) 

Go now. Spend a fortune and thank them for taking your money! Get lost in healthy decadence! Revitalize bowls are legal drugs--that must make you hotter or something. LOL Insane in here! I don't even live here. If I didn't have family in the area I'd travel to Idaho just for this one meal. Word! True story!

GREAT cakes (I was an employee at a different location, no relationship to this store) but disappointing customer service. Wanted to get a delivery for my grandmother's birthday, and was willing to scrape together the already-steep delivery fee. Her zip code was not listed, but she is located closer to their store than many of the $15 delivery zip codes, so I assumed it would be $15. When I called in to place the order, I was informed it would be $20. I explained that I was working with a very tight budget and asked if there was any flexibility with this policy, as she is in fact closer to the store than many of their other $15 deliveries. In spite of this, I was given the runaround by the manager as well as the owner. I understand the policy when it makes sense, but when it makes or breaks an order, I was disappointed they chose to break it. That wouldn't have flown back in my day... our owner read me the riot act for not accepting an expired coupon! I took my business elsewhere.
Probably the best Mexican in Idaho that you'll find.  Friendly service and great food.  Must try the Pollo al a creama!  Best margaritas in the west!  Get them with Patron, you won't be disappointed.

I like this place a lot! They offer a lot of dairy free options which is great for me because my daughter is lactose intolerant. Their smoothies are definitely refreshing and not overly sweet, if you don't want them to be. I like that because sometimes I just want a healthy smoothie instead of something packed with sugar!

Better than regular donuts as far as health but very disappointed that you no longer use almond flour. I can understand the higher cost for that,  but not for a grain. Please bring back Almond flour for one or two of your donuts for those of us who have stoach issues, etc.

My husband had an appointment of 1PM (appointmentmade earlysame day). We arrived early and let the team know we were there but would be going across the way and be back before the appointment. The person in the first chair said okay see you then. We came back 20 mins. later and only after we took off our coats and sat down were told they were running about 3 hrs. behind. There were a number of reasons they were behind; one girl was sick, one with family death and just short handed in general. What upsets me was why the heck weren't we told this when we first arrived? Why did she wait until we came back? In my opinion if the owner already knows she is short handed then 1) dont take walk ins 2) make sure to get a phone from people who make same day appointments so a phone call can be made about an issue or make a change to the appointment and 3) let people know as soon has they walk in about the situation.  I would not recommend this place based on this issue. Also I heard from someone who went there about a week ago pretty much the same thing happened to them. However my friend chose to wait the 2 or 3 hours.
It wasn't to bad, wasn't outstanding either. The store was nice and clean. But you could tell it used to be a coffee shop, which was strange being in a poke shop with chairs with coffee cups on them.

My favorite local place in meridian! We come here at least once a week. The staff is amazing and thw food is excellent. Happy hour is pretty great, 4 dollar well drinks and 4 dollar food. The vibe is great and we will continue to come here

I just had my second of (2) purchasing experiences with Pulse Running.  The first was almost 2 years ago when I was looking for a trail running shoe; I found the shoe I liked (Altra Superior 2.0) but they did not have it in my size so they ordered it for me and also gave me a %10 discount for a reason not remembered.  The Shoes did not arrive in time before departing to Oahu but as soon as they did arrive a couple of days later they offered to ship them to me and I received them a few days later.

My second experience was just yesterday.  I have transitioned from longer 7-12 mile runs a few times a week to shorter high-interval speed work but explained that I would still like a shoe that could hold up to the occasional longer jaunt, I have gained 20+ plus pounds and my feet have taken a pounding over the years from wearing 5.5 oz. zero-drop neutrals.  I wanted to get away from zero-drop a little, have enough cushioning to help my feet get back out of being de-conditioned for almost a year without foot fatigue and pain, but still have a highly responsive and lightweight neutral. (I was under the impression a shoe of that nature would be impossible to find and felt a little silly explaining what I was looking for, maybe it was easier than I thought because I was use to running on zero-drop and basically zero-cushioning after the shoe was compressed to nothing after a few hundred miles).

Five out of the 6 shoes Holly gave to me were pretty much on point but ended up with a Kinvara4, offset 4mm drop at 6.5 oz.  It's heaven in a shoe and Holly was extremely patient with me while even offering to me the chance run around outside in them even though I was on one of their (2) world-class treadmills (which they record your stride on) just a couple of minutes earlier - and they were %30 off which Holly made sure I received even though the shoe was not on display/priced and I would have had no way of knowing any different.

Awesome consumer experience and I will continue to drive to Meridian for my future purchases.

Dr. Payne is the best! I can't believe there are only a few reviews!! I never do reviews, but I truly felt he deserved the recognition. My daughter just began her orthodontics treatment and after the 1st day we had to go back to fix something and wanted to discuss the "appliance" that was being used on my daughter. He has such a way with his patients that shows what a truly caring man he is! My daughter was in tears and he had her laughing by the time we were done! 
Honestly from the first time we went to the office for a consult, I knew he was going to be her orthodontist. He doesn't make you feel like just another customer that he's making money on. He makes you feel important and that he is passionate about what he does !
Best custard I've had! Got the mini vanilla with strawberries and bananas! So yummy! Was busy on a Saturday night, service was still great and quick!
Read all the reviews! These guys are terrible! Rude employees and I won't be using their services any time soon!
Decent pub food with a small beer list. interesting combinations. Watch your final bill, the servers have a hard time with math.  Overall a pleasant experience. Place was clean, atmosphere modern.

I needed to update my previous review.  I got a call back from the service department a few days later, and it turns out that the service manager ended up being out of town on business and that's why I wasn't getting a callback for the appointment.  They were super apologetic and everything ended up being taken care of in the end.  It meant a lot to me to have them call me to explain what was going on, and to offer to make it right.  I also recently had them put ape hangers on my bike and everyone from Scott, the parts guy to everyone in the service department was really helpful the whole way, and I'm really happy with the result.
Very nice top end fully functional one stop does it all. Only wish the vacuum's  in Tacoma were free! Would Fast Eddie's consider opening up a shop in Tacoma?

We were looking for something light to eat one Saturday afternoon and wandered into Chicago Connection. The place was clean and quiet with a nice staff.  We both ordered flat breads. Mine was called BTC:  bacon, chicken, tomatoes, and olive oil on a wonderfully crispy, homemade flat bread. I asked for a side of ranch dressing for "dipping."  It was just the perfect bite for a light appetite. At $6.50 the price was right. 
Liked the choices of toppings on the menu for the "build-your-own" pizza, but after adding toppings, which cost extra, I felt that the price was too high for basic pizza.
Will be back for the flat breads, tho.

I got an appointment at 11, it was 11:35 I walked out. I feel like it's disrespectful to do that to people. 10 to 15 delay is the most I will wait. If people are running late,  they get service within their alowed time. Definitely not going back. If they had called me to let me know,  it would have been different.
Usually really good food and service. Today, only 1/3 full, took 15 minutes to get my salad, and shrimp way undercooked. Used to love this place.  Took shrimp back, no one seemed to care.
Eh, this Mexican restaurant was ok...not one I would go back to.  I'd rather drive the extra 15-20 minutes and go to Enriques in Kuna.

For being a healthy donut these donuts kick ass and I love the no guilt factor especially when you're trying to eat clean and you have goals!!!!!! I would give these 10 stars if I could!!! I will be back and I will be a regular customer! I don't have a favorite because they all taste amazing!

This is such a fun coffee place with quality coffee, friendly staff and a comfortable inside and outside seating area as well as a drive through. Easy access off of Chinden headed into Boise on the way to work, this is a must for a morning cup of Joe. They also have fresh baked goods and have GURU donuts! 
They are pup friendly on the patio and will bring your dog a treat. Lots of flowers and Adirondack chairs on the patio are and inside tables, chairs and high tops. I have meetings here frequently as it is not too noisy and the coffee is superb. I highly recommend you give them a shot- they also have Clover (app) and after a bit you get free drinks and such. All the staff is amazing and the vibe is perfect.

I ordered the mi casa nachos. The first time they were brought out, the entire bottom of the plate was covered in grease. 90% of the chips were so soaked they were mushy. I hate to return food but it was seriously inedible. The waitress brought me a new order and it was pretty good! But I was still unimpressed with the amount of food I got.  They were $7.95 for about $1 worth of food. No one else in my party had any problems though. Service was good too!

We had a LiftMaster unit that was REALLY loud so we had AGD quote for a quieter model.
We received a 10% discount out of the gate as they installed the original and then another discount because we didn't need replacement remotes.

Brad, who had lubed & serviced our door free before (under the 1 yr warranty) was schedule within 48 hours by an AGD dispatcher.  He called 30 minutes before and was straight up on time.  He's very professional, personable, & certainly knows his garage doors.

He installed the quieter model (belt replaced chain model) quickly and programmed our remotes & key pad.  He explained everything that we should know about the door & answered all out questions.  We didn't feel that he was rushing us through it as some service/installers have done.

I would highly recommend AGD.

The growler guys.  The name says it all..  A quick place to stop and get your growler filled with up to 50 fresh craft beer, small batch kombucha, rootbeer, cold-pressed coffee, and cider!  When you sign up for their newsletter you get a FREE growler!  Awesome!  Also they have really  cool growlers in evey shape and form, including a mini keg.  With all the growler stations popping up all over why is this one the best you ask?  5 starts..... Because of selection and the friendly service when you walk in the door and the samples keep coming!!!  They WANT you to try as many as you want.. So with all of this said ive found one of my new favorite  places!  And im now a member earnings points for free stuff!  :)

Was really hoping this would be a new go to place since it is so close to home. I ordered the pepperoni and a Hawaiian. The Hawaiian had peppers and bacon on it. How can this go wrong? I was disappointed with the lack of punch the sauce and toppings had. One of the best parts of pizza, in my opinion, is leftovers. The leftovers were not edible. 
Customer service was good, hence the two stars and not one. Bummed it just wasn't my kind of place.

I was visiting a friend that lives in Boise, and she took us here the day we landed in Idaho. She's obsessed with juices, but I can usually take them or leave them. I tried the Wanderlust juice, and it was so refreshing, and not at all overly sweet. I also had the kicker toast too, which was a nice snack after a long day of travel. My friend had the PB & J bowl, and she was super happy with it, and said how filling it was.
Always good reliable Mexican food!  I love the place!!

Food was excellent.  We went early on Valentine's day to avoid the crowds and it was packed by the time we left. The waitress was helpful but our drinks were empty more than they were full.  Thats my only complaint. 

We tried the smoked jalapeños for an appetizer. They were spicy but not hot. The filling was cheesy and bacony. My husband who isnt a foody, goobled them up. 

I had the Italian Grinder and it was probably one of thr best sandwiches I've ever had. The pepperoni, salami, and sausage must have been chopped and grilled with cheese, green onion, green pepper and olives. Because the meat and cheese were grilled it was crispy and chewy. I had the fries with the yummy fry sauce too! 

My hubby had the Jalapeno Bacon Mac and Cheese. The sauce was flavorful and not horribly spicy. The bacon was still crispy. The foccacia bread that went with it was ok. Needed some Sea Salt on the top. 

We will go back again!

Review:  Pinnacle 
Overall colon overall I was completely please with all the  how to be to this restaurant the service was Ray the food was great  and the venue looks awesome  the prices of food for the quantity of the few that you're getting fairly cheap inexpensive  I would be happy to come back in future ordered the pizza that I was totally happy with my wife order the macaroni and cheese both of our meals came out on time and our server was awesome use a certain type of seasoning on the macaroni and cheese make sitting incredible  I had to start taking  my my my wife getting mad at me because I can taking her food  but the pizza was all so awesome.  It was perfect there was lots of cheese with that the server kept our drinks full the whole night. i will definitely be coming back again in the future.

My office is near here and I have eaten lunch at this establishment a few times. The atmosphere is nice. It has a nice, local, friendly vibe. I bet it is a great place for happy hour, although I have only been here for lunch.

My latest meal here was the Rueben sandwich. It normally comes with fries and a pickle. The fries were excellent! The are served "natural cut" in a square paper container. They were perfectly cooked and crispy, which is rarely done to perfection (in my experience). The Rueben was also above par. It was crispy, not overly greasy (keep in mind this is a Rueben, so expect some greasiness) and not too huge. The marbled rye bread was good. Most of the sandwiches are in the large size, so no worries if you have a hearty appetite. If not, eat half and save the rest for later.

The individual pizzas are an excellent choice, too.

The staff is very friendly and attentive. 

Overall, this is a great choice for lunch. If I lived nearby, I'm sure I would also check it out for dinner or drinks. Good quality, reasonable price, and friendly atmosphere pretty much sums it up.

Eh! It was okay. Nothing special, custard tasted like ice cream not how frozen custard should taste. Fries were bland, seasoning didn't stay on. If you want a really good custard and burger w/ fries go to Culvers in Twin Falls, ID or Culvers in Utah. Popular in the midwest, but this they have some locations close but it is soo soo good compared to this business that is trying to be similar and Culvers knows how to do frozen custard the right way!!

My husband and I stopped by to check out another restaurant nearby but when their reviews were questionable and hardly anyone was there.  We decided to try this place. At the height of the dinner rush for a Friday night (6:30pm) we were seated immediately and given our chips and salsa with beans. I ordered the chicken enchilada with mole sauce. My husband ordered the chicken burito crema. Both plates are large portion sizes but my husbands plate was ENORMOUS. The mole was the perfect balance of sweet and bitter. The chicken burito was very heavy on the onions, in my husbands opinion, but had a great flavor. The horchata is on the watery side but tasty, and the Hugo de Jamaica is pretty good. 

Or biggest complaint is the service. No refills, rarely came to check on us and we had to wait a while for the food to come or our chips to be refilled (but not the rice or beans apparently). And they didn't charge us for the drinks, so being the honest people we try be we let them know. They promptly put the drinks on the bill that added about $5. If that's how much they charge for horchata and a hugo I don't want to know how much their "specialty" drinks are. 

Bottom line. If you're having a hankering for Mexican food. This does the trick, as long as you are OK to be patient with slow service.
Cycle gear has anything motorcycle related from cruisers, street, and dirt bikes.  They have gear, parts,  oils, tires, to accommodate any and all of your riding styles.

I've had hit or miss experiences at Massage Addiction.  My first few visits, I tried a couple of different therapists.  I asked for light to medium pressure, but felt like they were doing deep tissue. I was literally in pain and I walked away feeling more beat up than relaxed.  One of them also called twice (I only saw her twice) asking if I could come in at different times.  I couldn't. Then, I found a therapist I liked, but she was gone after 2 massages.  She also asked both times as I was leaving if I was going to tip her (and I do always leave a 20% tip in the room) which I found very uncomfortable.  Next, I found someone else I liked as far as pressure goes.  But, she cancelled 2 out of 3 appointments because she was sick or hurt - and these appointments were always her last appointments in the evening.  Coincidence?  Could be. I like the location and they do have competitive pricing, but I'm willing to pay a little more for a little more professional service.
Delicious and quick,  healthy meal choice.. i had tuna and yellow tail, very fresh. Tuna tastes sweet. Will go there again!

I've been to Gramercy more times than I can count. Guess its time for a review. My first time here was with some coworkers for lunch. I wasn't expecting much, since I had experiences at the previous restaurant that occupied its space that were not so good, I suppose I was jaded. Gramercy blew me away. 

SERVICE: The service was great. I often relish when a little something to goes wrong during an early visit so I can gauge the restaurants service skills. I have only had one order that was too salty and once brought to their attention, it was remedied immediately. No questions asked! No attitude! The Manager gave options of making something else for us or remaking the too-salty dish. We chose to try something else and they didn't charge us for either. This is one of the reasons I continue to go back. I know that if something goes wrong, they don't question the guest. They fix it and move on. Big stars for this!

FOOD: Fantastic! After my first visit,  I have since been back with family, friends and more coworkers and all have loved the food. Definitely try the crabber tots, flat iron veggie sandwich, green giant pizza, and a salad with vanilla basil dressing. Really, try anything, it's all good. Oh and if you want salmon but not on the sandwich (a little messy to eat that way) ask for it on a salad. They'll do it!

AMBIANCE: The place is a little small, but it is lovely and comfortable. If they are full, sit at the bar and chat with the bartender. Always a hoot. And that chandelier! If I could figure out a way to stuff it in my purse and walk out......

I Heart Gramercy.
I had been meaning to try them for a while and I am sad I waited so long. The chon chon torta (I think) was effing delicious. I will be back often.

While visiting my BFF in Boise we found Calle 75 Street Tacos vending their tacos at the Farmer's Market. I had their shrimp taco and it was amazing! Being from California, I've eaten many and theirs is the best hands down!

Paula said their chicken taco was excellent. 

Thank you owner Mike Weems!

Not the worst so doesn't deserve a simple 1-star rating, and I was hungry so I ate half my meal. And the service was quick and smiley. Wasn't very busy when I arrived and a handful of tables were dirty. The rice was full of undercooked pieces so I got tired of crunching my rice and left more than half. My growing 17-year-old son even left a pile on his plate. We nibbled hoping the next bite would be better. Futile hope.  It's been a few days since I've visited a Panda Express and it'll be longer before I come again.

Visited on St Patrick's day and it was excellent!  The corned beef special was amazing, we should have ordered more to take home!  Even though it was busy, service was very good and timely. We had the bread pudding for dessert and it was also very good. The $4 Jameson was an added bonus. While the menu is not large there are several items we will be back to try.
Had variety of dishes from appetizers to desert.  Pizza was excellent,  Cubano was unique, not your traditional Cubano but it was delicious.  Citrus salmon was good.  All n all I would come back.

This place is such a cool concept.  Donuts were really good.  Do not expect them to taste like the sugar laden heart attack giving donuts you are used to.  Thanks for making something healthy and delish.  Favorite was the chocolate anything...

Stoped today for lunch. Had a tuna bowl, Terri chicken and Teri beef bowls. I have to say I'm not really a fan. There was two pieces of broccoli and a couple slices of carrot in the Terri bowls. Not much sauce on the rice so by time we got to the bottom the rice was dry. 
The tuna bowl was OK. Not what I really wanted. I compare to what to get in HI. I guess I was looking for tuna that had been marinating in shoyu and seasonings all day spooned over my rice.

Wow! An instant favorite. Best pizza in Boise, hands down. 

Hand tossed crust, home made sauce.... Everything's super fresh. Friendly service. Simply excellent.

I had the Stonehill Merlot and the Peach and Chong pizza and that pizza was amazing. They unfortunately only have spicy sausage which was a no go with my kiddo, but everyone enjoyed their pizza. Bonus was the short distance from our hotel. I would honestly stop by here again while in town.

Man Oh Man! That Green Pig Burrito is absolutely amazing! Great Guacamole!! My only complaint would be the chips and salsa. The salsa has a slightly odd after taste even though you can tell it's very fresh. The chips always seem kind of stale.

Amazing little Bundt Cake shop! I was warmly greeted and the lovely counter person graciously help me pick out my sister's 60th birthday cake. One of a kind bundt cakes reasonably priced and Delicious.
A little disorganized, granted they had just opened! Great seafood and sauce! Prices were a little high but great food!

I believe this is the Boise area's first poke bowl restaurant. It's in the Roseauer's lot on Eagle Road, next to Togo's.

I ate here for lunch (actually carried out) on opening day, with my wife. We shared a "regular" (3 scoop fish) poke bowl on white rice, with wasabi shoyu, crab, seaweed salad, green onions, cucumbers, and sesame seeds. I was impressed...service was quick, and although $12 for a bowl seems pricey, it's a lot of food...basically de-constructed sushi...so really it's like $6/person. It was opening day, so they didn't have credit cards working yet; cash only.

Logistics:
You can see from the pix what the menu is and how it works. Basically it's Chipotle-style, they build a bowl for you. The fish was good (maybe not the best in the world, but still tasty) and the serving sizes were reasonable (of course they could've been bigger, but they were decent-sized). The interior was clean and nice, and I was surprised by how many people were there.

Food:
No complaints...shoyu had a nice amount of wasabi, fish was tasty, rice was fresh, and toppings were quite good. It feels like a pretty healthy lunch, but I suspect if you check it might be less healthy than you think. Still a nice indulgence.

We will be back...this can easily go on the lunch rotation. Tasty and filling, and kinda scratches the sushi itch. I hope the place sticks around...based on the volume of business today, they'll have no trouble.

I am currently staying in Seattle but was back home to visit for the weekend. I love the poke in Seattle and saw that this restaurant just opened in Meridian. After my first visit I was very impressed by the quality of the fish and sauces. I got the tuna, salmon, and white tuna with the chili shoyu and sesame shoyu. Very tender meat and tasty sauces! I would high recommend this place for a quick and healthy lunch or dinner. Also, there was a very good selection of toppings.
Nice place to stay. We stayed in a 2 bedroom suite and it was very clean and spacious and very low-priced. The breakfast was really good and I would definitely stay here again.

slow delivery poor customer service. food was cold upon arrival, soy sauce burnt into rice no vegetables more breading than chicken in the mandarin chicken soggy slimy noodles...overall worst Chinese take out experience ever. kids chose top ramen for dinner

Yesterday was my 2nd trip to Pinnacle. The food was alright & priced average to average high. My turkey Ruben was tasty but the fries tasted a bit off...old oil maybe? My friends buffalo chicken Mac n' cheese was tasty. The worst part of our trip was the lack of chips. They no longer offer chips as a free appetizer.  We won't be back until the free potato chips return. For the price they charge I can get a better meal elsewhere. The chips offset their prices.

These guys catered our lunch on Saturday for an all day seminar.  Great stuff.  

I wish I had a chance to talk food with the chef; I was too busy stuffing my mouth with all the steak and chicken.  The meat was nicely cooked and there were several sauces to pair them with.  It was just as good plain than having to go crazy with the different aoilis that were offered.

Absolutely the BEST Harley shop in the US, and I've been to plenty. Helpful staff, non-pushy sales people, awesome techs, fun people, great events, and sometimes even free beer :) Shane in service is the man. And Scotty in parts is the best in the biz, period. Bayne in sales is a stud.
The people are so nice, the iced mocha is beyond delicious and the huge dog treats are an added bonus that makes my dog start drooling when we pull up.  An excellent coffee shop!

I took a cooking class from Chef Daisy and it was outstanding. She is a rockstar and the kitchen area in the back looks like it's straight out of America's Test Kitchen. 

The menu we cooked was really tasty and I learned a lot during the 2 hour class. I feel more confident in my cooking and picked up some tips to improve my knife skills.

This is a pretty cool gas station if you ask me..  Did you know Fast Eddys now has a growler filling station?    For you non beer drinkers thats a place to fill you jug ( growler) full of your favorite beer.  How cool is that??    And they have half size growlers to boot.  So on my way home I got the truck washed and I did a quick vacuum and then drove up to the drive up window.   And guess what I ordered?   Yep you guessed it....A half growler and a bag of Cheetos..:)    what's not to love about this place?    And I'm going back tomorrow because I spilled the bag of Cheetos all over the front seat. Opps.  But the beer was safe because I would never open it in the truck on the way home.  ;)

This is for the Nampa location. They screwed up on my drive thru order on my 10 yr olds burger and when I went back to complain they went way out of their way to make it right. I have only had one other bad experience and that was with over salted fries(they had enough salt on em to give you a stroke) Overall the food is pretty good(not as good as In and Out Burger, but then who is?) The custard is amazing! My only other complaint is they are pretty pricey but their meat is as close to the real thing as you can get compared to the sawdust /filler faux burgers the other fast food joints serve, I wont mention any names Mc ahem! or Jack in the ahem! Freddy's would get 5 stars if they were a lil more affordable. Oh, the staff are extremely polite, helpful and just plain nice. Not only that, but they seem to actually have brains in their heads.

This place is fantastic. I had a Mango Maniac and loved it. The staff was friendly but quiet. A few things I didn't like was the time it took to make a smoothie, it was about 20 min after ordering. It was nice to relax but if I were in a hurry to be somewhere I wouldn't stop there to get a drink. I felt there wasn't a lot of energy in the room. It was really quiet and everyone was kind of sitting/standing around and not talking, which was a little awkward. I think if the music was a little louder or the staff was more talkative the energy would have changed a little. Those are my only complaints. I would definitely go back as the smoothies were worth the visit.

The Gelato Cafe is an awesome, unique place! My fiance works at a business in the same strip so he eats there a lot and I love to meet up with him there for lunch. The menu is kind of all over the place but it somehow works. Pizzas, sandwiches, gyros, sushi, homemade soup, grinders, martinis, gelato, there is seriously something for everyone. Everything we've gotten has tasted amazing- the sushi is fantastic. Brian, the owner, is a really nice guy. There is live music on the patio some days of the week. We will always return for the quality of food and service.

Loved it. Came for breakfast. Stayed for the Mimosas ($3)

Atmosphere: Really nice, clean sports bar with lots of large flat screen tvs. Did I mention clean? Very important to me. I sat outside because the weather was so awesome. Lots of Eagle Rd noise but that's to be expected. 

Food:  Fresh ingredients.  Not frozen or canned like Le Peep next door. I asked for something not on their menu and they were very accommodating. I had a spicy Italian sausage link with eggs, hash browns and English muffin. Everything was delicious. 

Service: Karri was my server.  She was at my outside table within a minute of my arrival. She made suggestions and highlighted the menu items for me. She very sweetly went to the kitchen to ask about my special request. She was attentive without being a pest. She made my visit enjoyable.

I will be back to try their happy hour (s). From 2 to 6 on weekdays. They have drinks and appetizer specials. I will post an update.
Super friendly service. My latte was way too sweet for my taste, and I specifically inquired and was assured by the barista that their drinks were not heavily sweetened.

Went here to meet some friends and WOW! What a nice, fun, family friendly place to eat, have a martini, which are awesome, and listen to some live music! Can't wait to go in the summer and hang on the patio. Highly recommend

We just moved to the area and this is our favorite spot! Gramercy bites, the low rider pizza, hangover burger, jalapeño spicy Mac, it's all good. This place is a "made from scratch kitchen" that's been there over 5 years and it's got that small town vibe that we like so much. It takes a little bit longer to get your food sometimes because everything is made from scratch, however we think it's worth the wait!

Fantastic! I love the simplicity of the dessert with the complexity of flavor. Delicious. Sweet. Scrumptious. You must stop in to grab a sweet treat or some seriously cute kitchen decor. 

They offer samples which just proves this should be a daily stop. Service was terrific and happy to see us. We can't wait to go back.

I got vanilla custard with strawberries, bananas, and hot fudge! It is seriously the best I have ever had. Will def be returning, and recommend!  Really, really impressed! Will be back tomorrow for some burgers and fries.

This review is many, many months overdue.
I first arrived in Boise in June of 2014 to accept a new position and open a satellite location for my work. I would be working in the Village every day, and had no idea what kind of culinary spoils would be available to me. I'm from CA and grew up with consistently amazing Mexican food. The sheer idea of "mexican food" in Boise turned me of, but I took a chance.

Wow. This place does it all RIGHT! I've eaten here in excess of 50 times and everything I've ordered has been spectacular. Outlaw Burrito? Yum! Idaho Potato Taco, what? Freakin amazing! Breakfast burrito during the crazy holiday retail season (and 4 hours of sleep)...hits the spot! 

For a short bit, they couldn't get the quality of goat cheese that they prefer for one of their tacos; instead of substituting, they stopped selling the taco (this is INTEGRITY). Their pricing? Spot on. Solid value.

Everything has proven itself to be fresh, innovative, and of top quality. The owners (Rosie & Mike) are delightful and are always willing to speak to their passion for their craft. Well done, guys.

(and yes, they cater and have a taco trailer, too!)

This place has an awesome massage therapist guy! Not sure about the doctor never been to her. I did call about her services. I asked if they work with people who don't have insurance. I was told the doctor would call me. I never received a call. Guess they don't! Lol. It's okay I don't even need a chiro now that I have insurance. I'm going to Upper Cervical Heath Center. My pain is gone now. It's truly life changing. They adjust your atlas which in turn corrects your whole body. I got so tired of wasting my money going to the chiro. Dr Blöm is awesome!

Horrible service and very dirty. I use to love Chicago connection until the past several times have been horrible. I believe in second chances, especially when they've been great in the past, but the last time I went in , I watched one of the guys in the back drop a bunch of food on the floor, pick it up, and put it back on the counter, to what I'm assuming eventually went on the pizza. Absolutely disgusting!! I've even reached out to the manager/owners (whoever responds to the emails) and it was nothing but rude reply's. Thank goodness there are plenty of wonderful pizza places around Meridian and Boise , for us to enjoy.
Super rude staff, like, really rude. Notice the thermostat read 81 degrees. Um, I guess that's why I don't ever come to these "types" of places....

Have always liked FM there not the cheapest place to shop but they seemed to have good sales and there always super clean and there variety is always better the the lower cost places. And there points system is great for discounts on gas.. all around great place..

Less then expected even for fast food. I ordered blizzards and food for me and my group, watched several people walk out with blizzards while we did not have ours yet. Finally called me for our food and no blizzards had to remind the person what they were and the sizes and wait for them to be made to find maybe 2 pieces of cookie dough in my cookie dough blizzard, and unfortunately as the person tried the upside down "trick" with the blizzard one literally leaked all over. The fries were old and burgers dry as can be. Constant line in the place even though they seemed to have plenty of staff, the term quantity not quality applies here as most of the staff seemed to care less that you were a customer in the establishment. Such a shame for this location as my family enjoys most Dairy Queen locations.

I would absolutely, hands down, recommend Dr. Payne to anyone, young or old.  My son has had spacers, braces, then retainers thru him.  We love his staff too!  Pretty rare to find an entire office that is sooooo positive & supportive.  Our three years of needing orthodontic care has honestly been a great experience,  including their williness to work with us on our financial obligations.   You won't go wrong with this office!   ~ The Creasey's

Very good food great service very small dining hall.

We will be coming back to try something different
The pharmacy at this Fred Meyer store is excellent!  They move a lot of people (customers) in and out of the pharmacy everyday.  For a small pharmacy they do a great job!

OK, so I've tried this place a couple times A few years back and didn't think too much of it. However I just ate there on Easter with 14 other people. The food has completely changed, it was amazing! The owner is a super nice gal, and the chef has done an amazing job. Here are a few reasons we will be back:
1. Over 90% of the food they make is done in house, very little prepackaged. And you can taste the difference, it is fresh and flavorful. 
2. My daughter has some food allergies, and because they make most items in house, they knew exactly what she could eat without fear of cross contamination. Beyond that, they bent over backwards to make sure that she got what she wanted to eat.
3. The staff, while very busy, was over-the-top nice and accommodating. It did not feel like a nuisance to ask for something.
4. The food was amazing. Granted, it was Easter brunch, but those were the best finger steaks! And everything else was amazing. 

We will definitely be back, this is likely our new go to place.

This is a nice Motel 6.  Newer construction, indoor pool and hot tub, more modern design.     Minor concerns include mildly cloudy water in the pool and spa at the time of our stay, ice/vending only on two floors, and limited parking and proximity to a neighboring hotel (same bigger lot).  Plenty of stores, restaurants, and activities around the hotel.  Great value for the area.
Fresh, fast and friendly service. Definitely best Mexican food around. Will be back...probably very often!

I started seeing Chad because I have lower back pain. Throughout the past months, While helping me greatly with my back, he has helped with numerous other things that seem to creep up the older I am getting:). Recently I had a double ear infection, one of which they put me on a round of antibiotics for. Come to find out, I am resistant. The Drs wanted to try another round. With chads help, I was able to avoid that, and within 24 hours of an adjustment, saw a huge improvement. His office is new and beautiful. Staff is awesome. Go see him, you won't regret it.

Wanted to try a new delivery, should of went with something else. Estimated delivery time went from 50, to 110 actual. Called and operator informed me that the delivery guy is running behind. That's cool I can deal with that. What I can't deal with is the guy showing up like he was doing me a favor. 

We ordered a caeser, wings, and two philly cheese steaks. The caeser was actually pretty good (cause they are so easy to mess up), the wings reminded me of frozen wings from Costco tossed in a oven and tossed with whatever. Being a wing nazi I was annoyed, however again I will let it slide because my pregnant wife liked them. However both of our sandwiches where soggy. I expect that is from them sitting around for 45 minutes in a car. Both sandwiches ended up in the trash, and I'm sitting here now eating a bowl of ice cream.

I ordered the double California steakburger combo. The fries were thin, oversaturated with oil, and under-seasoned. McDonald's has better. The burger was very sloppily built and hard to eat. For being a "steakburger", I was unimpressed by the meat. The burger I ordered had 2 patties, each about 1/8" thick... Extremely thin. Again, one McDonald's patty would be a bigger portion than two of these. The Freddy's sauce that came on the burger was a thousand island-type flavor, but there was way too much on the burger for my tastes. I can't speak on their frozen custard because I didn't try it. I wanted to like Freddy's but it just didn't live up to the hype. I won't be back.

Paper thin burgers,  seriously not kidding. Chilli dog had a little over a t spoon of chilli on it. Service was good. Looks like the frozen custard is what may be the draw  here. Did not indulge in the sweets. The custard looked tasty and everyone else that cam in ordered the frozen custard. So in short I am sure it is a good place for many flavors of frozen custard but not good for the rest of the burgers or chilli dogs.
I saw Chelsea today and she was fantastic! So kind, professional, and fast. I appreciate that the receptionists are always so sweet and helpful. Best place for waxing services!

My husband and I both tried three tacos. I got carne asada, carnitas, and chicken. The meat was great, as was the pico de gallo. Next time I'll add habanero sauce and cheese since it was a little plain without it. Service was great. The guy in the San Jose Sharks hat was personable and conscientious. I plan to return!!!

We've been looking for a good Mexican food restaurant here in Meridian since we moved here in December. We may have found a small gem in Mi Casa. Many things to like - the young ladies who greeted us and served us were pleasant and attentive to our needs. The chips and salsa/beans we ok. Would like to see authentic flour chips hot out of the oven, but hey, this is Idaho, not SoCal. I had the Albondigas soup - very hot and full of flavor - great start to the meal. My daughter and I shared the 3 carne asada tacos with beans and rice. The meat had excellent flavor with just enough celantro and onions. Tortillas were very good. Overall, this was the best Mexican food we have found in the area so far. A little too pricy but worth the visit.

Great selection of beers and always great service.  We love coming here to try all the new local beers and you can request one of your favorites and they'll email you if they put it on tap.  Great location and great atmosphere.
Modest location, I didn't expect much when I went in, but it has really great food, and excellent service!

I went here tonight for dinner, craving a good salad bar and some pepperoni and bacon pizza. The yummy ranch did not disappoint. It looks like your favorite pizza place inside, big tables, two separate rooms and a TV. Pizza was chicago style deep dish... a little cheesy for me, but it tasted good. Next time I might try the thin crust and ask to go lighter on the cheese.
Denise at the bar! Everytime we come in is so welcoming and very enjoyable to have as our server.
I find myself returning here a few times a month. Their prices aren't the best always, but they have quite a few unique things that no one else has.

Super awesome burritos here! The street taco are what you expect but I really enjoyed the burrito. They are huge! Their hot sauces aren't that hot if you want spicy you might have to go somewhere else.

CLOSED SINCE NOV 2014- Good food, tasty stuff with a good selection. Family of five with various tastes and everyone gets what they want. Service is friendly. As well, they will cook whatever you want fresh if the steam tray is looking tired. We go like twice a month.
So wonderful! We would be there eating tacos every 6 hours if we could swing it. As it is, we go at least once a week and it never gets old. Love love love this place.
Stop.  Go to another nail salon.  It is all about production here.  Poor quality, and the staff looks tired.
Frddys provides a good burger and great fries.  Only complaint was from my son cause his hot dog bun wasn't cut deep enough......lol.  we will definitely come back.
Their burgers are made with REAL MEAT... let's start there. The fries are crisp delish. It's clean. Staff is polite prices are VERY reasonable!!!! The custard is OUT OF THIS WORLD

Just came here for a haircut and my stylist Katie did an excellent job on my high fade. She was actually really easy to talk casually with, it didn't feel like I was forcing myself to make small talk and my hair looks so good! Grab your fedoras and a copy of Atlas Shrugged, 'cause this week we're hitting up Gramercy Park.

I'm not really sure what archetype I'm supposed to be referencing in the above. It's mostly a way to peak your interest and have you continue reading.

Gramercy Park: this place is really nice. Like, really nice. I wonder if the founders were planning to set up in the bay area but the rent was too high or they didn't configure Google maps right. The place looks like a mix between a sushi bar and a startup. It's got that refined, 21st century aesthetic. The waiters are charming and sophisticated. The prices are pretty darn expensive. We ordered a half Pepperoni, half Peach and Chong. The pizza was flatbread-style (aka tiny) and came out to $25. Took 15-20mins. Let's dig in.

-Pepperoni-
Crust was crunchy and delicious. It had a little bit of thickness to it so not quite a flatbread. Tasted really good. Cheese and sauce were nice but nothing really outstanding. The peps were a no-no. They did the thing where they use salami for the peps instead of pepperoni. I love salami but I don't like it baked into my pizza. The flavor is a little too weird and fatty and just throws the pizza off a bit (yes, salami and pepperoni taste differently).

-Peach and Chong-
A very original pizza. Peach sauce, mini onion rings, and brie. This is the kind of pizza that Tom and I want to see more of. Only three focus ingredients. Makes you go "what in the world does that taste like?" When you bite in, the flavors play together really well. I appreciate that they're doing something legitimately creative here instead of just throwing 12 toppings on a crust and calling it done.

-Nirvana Bites-
So we saw a bunch of orders of these going around and decided to try some for dessert. These Nirvana Bites are essentially large doughnut holes topped with cinnamon sugar and served with vanilla ice cream on the side. Delicious. The perfect frying (crispy on the outside / gooey on the inside) makes these a few steps better than your typical doughnut. The cinnamon + caramel on top adds an extra layer of sweetness. Ice cream plays around with the texture the same way it would on a hot brownie; making parts of it colder and harder while most of it stays warm and soft.

-Verdict-
If we were judging on the pepperoni pizza alone, this place would be good but nothing special. Definitely not their strong point, especially given the stupid prices. We have to give them credit where it's due though and that's in their original concepts. Peach, onion rings, and brie don't sound like anything together but taste surprisingly nice. Def curious enough to try their other specialty pizzas. And those Nirvana Bites... taste like so much more than teen spirit. Those alone deserve a trip back. Recommend this place to people making dolla dolla bill who are searching for a unique culinary experience.

My wife ordered aguachiles. Unfortunately, it was not what she had hoped for. The aguachiles were presented cold and the shrimp was not fully 'cooked' by the lemon and lime. My daughter had a gigantic combo plate almost fitting for two people. As we dined, more customers came in and dined which was good to see. Early August of 2017 I took my 4 year old son to this Primary Health location.  We went to Primary Health because we had a wonderful experience when they were at their previous location, but were told they had moved to this building.

My son had thrown up that morning, had a mild fever, and spots in his mouth and throat.  They ran a strep test.  The provider (Christian Crawford) came in and told us the strep test was negative and that we needed to take our son to the emergency room.  There was no explanation of why, the doctor just seemed like he didn't want to deal with us.  I was completely caught off guard, but I felt if we didn't take our son to the emergency room we would be neglecting his health.

We took my son to St Luke's Meridian Emergency Room where they were surprised and confused by why we were bringing him in.  I explained our Primary Health experience to them, so they took him in, repeating that they weren't sure why Primary Health would send us to the Emergency Room.  4 hours and a throat x-ray later, we had a very large emergency room bill and still no answers.

The Emergency Room sent us home and told us to wait it out.

October 2017 I received a bill from Primary Health for our visit.  I called them and explained what had happened to several people.  They kept sending me down the line, but I was eventually told I would receive a call back from a manager named Sensa about a "no cost visit".

I never received that call, but got another bill mid December, a letter saying we were 90 days past due.  I called Primary Health again on December 20 asking for an update.  I had to relay the incident again and was once more told that Sensa would call me back about a no cost visit.

Once again, no one ever called me back and the 1st week of January we received a collection letter for the Primary Health balance.  The next day I finally received a call from Sensa who informed me she had gone over the doctors notes and after talking with him, she felt that we did not warrant a no cost visit.  Sensa told me that Primary Health had called the emergency room and explained why my son was coming and that due to his symptoms there was nothing they could do to help.  She asked if I wanted further explanation, which I declined because, frankly, I was fed up, frustrated, furious, and just done. 

The very least they could have done was call me back when I originally asked in October.  I paid the balance, which included interest because I hadn't paid while waiting for someone to respond to my phone calls, but I will never go back to Primary Health or recommend them to another person.
