I hadn't any real desire to run right out to Five Guys when they came to town, I didn't know anything about them,  I also had no desire to make my way down to Bodo, or deal with traffic on Milwaukee to eat there. However, as my husband and I were on a shopping mission near The Village in Meridian last weekend we decided to take in the experience that is Five Guys.  We were probably their first visitors of the day.  The location was open and bright, very very clean.  The gal on the register was great at explaining to us how things worked.  My husband ordered a 'big' double cheeseburger and medium fry along with a beverage.  I went with the same burger (only bunless) with a small fry and beverage.  We opted to split a hotdog.  Handing over almost $30 for food we could have certainly eaten at any run of the mill fast food place was a bit of a shock, but when you're trying something new you gotta be willing to go for it!   We filled our drinks and chose a table.  It had started to pour down rain outside and I quickly noticed how chilly it was inside that big open space with so many huge windows.  Luckily our food was ready soon so I had other things to think about.   First off, packaging. Um.. hello.. kill trees much?  Each of our orders in a GINORMOUS brown paper grocery bag.  I'm sure Five Guys is trying to cut down on overhead by not having to pay someone to collect and wash plastic trays, but seriously?  If you're going to eat in you should at least have the option to save a tree.   That aside, we forged ahead.  I really SHOULD pay attention when I read the words of other Yelpers because oh my heavenly Hanna the amount of french fries was huge!  Fresh cut, fresh cooked, hot and right out of the fryer.  Crispy on the outside, mealy inside with just the right amount of salt.  I may have to try the Cajun spice next time.  Burgers were meaty, well cooked, graciously topped (TWO tomato slices.. full on THICK slices.. not tomato slivers!). The only thing we would have like is if the cheese had been in a more advanced stage of melt on our burgers.  I adored my bunless burger- placed neatly with my requested condiments in a foil tray.  The hotdog (I chose a regular dog, on a bun with mustard, relish and grilled onion) was another wonderful bit of noshing.   We did notice, as more patrons came in, the physical plant had a few more issues.  Orders are called out by number with no speaker system.  If we had not been seated near the counter, say around the corner of the place near the restrooms, I don't think we would have heart them call our number.   We had PLENTY to eat, but I did manage to liberate a few of the peanuts placed out for folks.. tasty indeed.    Overall this was a good experience, I'm glad we did it for a bit of a special occasion (we were shopping with tax return monies), but given the cost I can't see going back anytime soon.

Friendly staff and always well stocked.  Always clean, even when the place is packed.  Lots of flavor and topping varieties, seasonal items too.  Great place for a night out or meeting up with friends.

This place is pure magic. As a fat guy that's trying to be a slightly less fat guy, this place is my favorite. The staff is all super friendly, their donuts and cookies are all great, and they're surprisingly fast. I highly recommend checking them out!
Go us right in no wait !! Fixed my girls headache right up!! We were back on the road in no time thanks primary health!!!!

Food was good.  Would have liked for there to have been paper towels in the men's bathroom. It is of the utmost importance that this is not overlooked!
I was just tryna wash my hands with the boys

This shop use to be a moxie java. So far in still has the same great coffee and the same great service. 
I am giving it the same 5 stars for now and will rate it again later.

The gelato itself looks amazing and tastes delicious. 

The owner is nice, honest, and generous with gelato samples.

Although I've seen several groups enjoying the creamy & gelato martinis, I have yet to get one. They're only $7.50 each, which is a good deal because a scoop of gelato is almost $3.

I also want to try the tiramisu made in house and cannoli with chocolate.  

I agree with the previous yelp reviews because this place does have an extensive selection. There's sushi, desserts, coffee drinks, and pork chop fried rice.

Entertainment book and Ada county hometown values may have deals for Gelato or drinks.

Fantastic!  I only recently discovered Poke, and this one hits the nail on the head.  Delivery of the ordering method is spot on.  It's build-your-own bowl directions are clear on the screens of step 1, 2, 3, 4, and 5.  The size of the bowls are determined by how many scoops of protein.  Since I love Poke, I wanted to make sure I had enough so I ordered the regular bowl - meaning 3 scoops of protein.  I may downsize next time - cause that was a LOT!  I'm used to Poke by itself, but this method is more of a balanced meal portion with rice or lettuce base, chosen protein with chosen sauce (Oh SAUCE), and 5 sides (think salad toppings) to be included in the bowl.  The whole ordering process took less than 5 minutes and I was out the door.  The staff were super friendly and didn't snicker when I butchered the names of some of the side items.  When I asked which sauces were good, he melted a little and replied, "They are all so good."  Okay by me!  Will definitely be back for this special treat!

When I drop my dry cleaning off, I want to have confidence in the staff to get it done by the date it is promised. This dry cleaner couldn't live up to that promise. Instead, I had to drive to their cleaning location and pickup my shirts that were more wrinkled than when I dropped them off. I don't recommend anyone utilize the services at this business.

If you have never eaten Hawaiian food before, then you are in for a treat. This business started as a food truck, but found an open spot in Meridian, and the rest, as they say, is history! The still have the food truck. They took it out this summer and fed the crews working on the firelines! But I digress......

The food is AWESOME!! They use all authentic Hawaiian foods, including seaweed wrapped spam, and they can even accommodate those of us with gluten-free challenges. The servers are warm and friendly and the barbequed pork is out of this world! You just gotta go and try it!!

The food... delicious! I love the ramped up bar food menu. 
I had the fish and chips and dang...they were great. Good breading, good double fried fries. Nice touch. The pizza was very good also, we had some sort of crispy spinach thingy that I loved.
I think I'd hit this place twice in a day if I lived in Boise.

I love this dutch! I go about the same time, most afternoons and get the same gal a majority of the time. She is seriously so sweet and energetic. She remembers her regulars and what they drink. She even has a regulars book she puts your name in...if you make the cut lol. The one time I had to wait a bit, she comped my drink. Those are the things that keep people coming back. She always has suckers for my kids with whip cream on them (she calls them the super heros, even makes them have little mohawks)! When I'm not feeling my regular coffee drink, she'll make recommendations of something new to try but not something completely the opposite of my usual drink. Such a fun girl and of course the coffee is good too!

Seriously! So grateful this place is in my hometown! When I need a low carb sweet baked treat, I appreciate this place so much. Their presentation is adorable. I only wish there were places like this in other cities to which I travel.
Bought 3 bikes from them. Best dealer I have ever been too. Go see Joe, sales. Still don't like finance depts anywhere. Wish I could find a car dealer like them.

The entire Team at Heron River has been outstanding, from initial contact and determining our interest, to weekly updates on the progression of our home.
 You could not ask for a better customer focused home building Team than Eric, Natasha, Paul and their entire crew!
Good breve the wife and I had.  One of the better cups of coffee in Meridian.  The baristas were friendly.

If I could give them no stars I would!!!  I ate there several times and loved the place absolutely did but then the food wasn't great I just like the football, cold beers and hot wings.  So upon returning I ordered a cheeseburger and it was gross something was wrong with it.  I told the server and he said sorry you don't like our burger and walked off.  Didn't apologize didn't ask to take it back and get me something else nothing.  Then came back and said would you like me to move your plate then charged me for the nasty burger!!!  I will never ever return worst service of my life

Es bado asso!

(That is Spanish for pretty darn good! )

The fajitas were huge...enough for 2 very hungry adults. 

El I willo be backo!
(I will try them again- at some point)
These are fabulous! We were in town for a wedding and found this gem. Best GF donut I've had:)

I came by and asked for a s'mores blizzard the lady says "we don't have that anymore it's only a summer thing" butt last time I checked it's August 29th it's still summer don't tell me that s'mores is "gone" if s'mores technically is a winter type thing and they've had that on the menu for months before summer started. If there was a 0star that's what this would get.

Poké was pretty good, pricey though for what you get. Only complaint I have is that when you pay with card, the only tip offer is "15, 20,or 25 percent" and there's not a "no tip" option. Very frustrating if the service is undeserving of a tip. I would suggest paying cash, if possible, so that you have control of the amount of tip.

I have never had a bad experience here. I enjoy their burritos and quesadillas the most! Today I tried a "back by popular demand", the Cilantro Lime Shrimp Bowl and yum!! It hit my shrimp-craving spot. They are a little spendy but the amount of food you get feels justified. I don't ever leave here hungry. The food does take a little bit of time to come out but that's because its well, FRESH.
There is ample seating and I've always had pleasant cashiers. The salsa bar is a good option to have, and your usual fountain drinks.
Tried this place with my wife based on Yelp recommendations. It was decent food and good service.

I've been to numerous Freddy's locations in both Arizona and here in Idaho. I don't go enough really. The food is great and the prices cant be beat for the amount of food you get, and at a place that isn't a fast, drive-thru type place. I ordered a Cali. Double combo and added bacon..and only paid with the $10 bill in my pocket. Wow. The steak burgers are good, but the patties are of course thin so I recommend getting the double for the full steakburger tasting experience. The bottom bun was soggy, but that kind of thing doesn't bother me. They come with skinny fries or you can sub for tots. As I was half way through my meal, I was offered a free pecan sundae as they made an extra...and I haven't ever tried their custard before because I'm always too full to think about dessert. OH MY it is delicious!

This is the fourth time Vicki has completed a loan for us (refinances included). She is kind and patient even when everything seems to be going wrong. Vicki and the Academy team are always professional. Can't say enough good about them. I guess the fact that we've come back so many times says it all!

We used Kanack for our wedding, it was an absolute hit!!! The staff are amazing and were very accommodating from start to finish. We had around 100 guests and with one guy manning the truck they were very quick and fluent! The food was incredible and arrived right on time, we did what we imagined a small tasting weeks before the wedding and they brought us a feast! All our guests loved the food truck idea and a different approach with Hawaiian bbq. My favorite part was after the line was through he seeked my wife and I out and personally asked us if we wanted him to stay longer. He packed us both a large to go box and was on his way. This was a definite highlight of our wedding and we are so grateful to have had Kanack Attack apart of our wedding!

Great food,but the service was beyond bad. It took way to long for when my meal was served after my wife's: . We had 4 different servers, who were all preoccupied with larger groups. May try it again, but although the food was good, it didn't command the price. They also have raised their prices that aren't reflected in their menu on yelp.

It is so awesome that we now have a Starbucks on the south side of the freeway in Meridian!  Yay!!!  If you know my tastes in Coffee, you know that the Starbucks on Meridian Road just north of the freeway has been my favorite for years, but since this new one is only about four blocks from my house....  ...well, I just had to check it out.
My wife and I got an afternoon coffee today and this brand new facility, and YESSSSSS, it was very good.  I'm so happy!
Great Portion Size for the price! Food quality is wonderful. Exceeded our expectations and we'll definitely be back!!!
Does everything have to be $5?  Why is everyone so nice.  I wait more for the conversation to end between the clerk and the car in front of me than for the coffee

I was not happy when I picked up my food the wing were over cooked and dark like the grease had not been changed in ages before moving to Idaho wing stop was one of my favorite places to eat now it's just ok this is my second time at this location and they just can't get it right unfortunately this is the only location in Idaho so I probably will come back I'm hoping they get it together so that I can frequent this location
So glad they opened up this wing place here in Idaho. Good food and amazing fries. The wing flavors are on point.
Always sooo good. White coffee mocha with ninja flavoring.. I wish I had some of these around the part of the country I live in.

I love their donuts and so do my kids, even my son who is the pickiest eater. I know I can have a sweet delicious treat without feeling guilty when I eat their donuts and their prices I very reasonably and compatible to a lot of other donut places that make specialty donuts. Plus I earn points everytime I shop and get freebies, which is always good! Highly recommend!

Our family loves this place. The fries are our favorite- thin crispy and hot. We like to add some of the extra seasoning they have on the table. The burgers are good- I prefer they california style with the special sauce but the family likes them plain. I have one vegetarian and she says the veggie burger was decent. The frozen custard is also really good- the concrete is their version of the blizzard. A mini is plenty as custard is really rich. The place has been packed every time we have been there but they have never screwed up our order or kept us waiting! We prefer this leaps and bounds above Five Guys.
Awesome boys haircut spot! No lines, TVs, clean, friendly staff! Love the girls working here! Will be back on a regular basis!!
I love this place! I highly recommend it. Sushi is outstanding and the gelato is delicious!

I ordered the Idaho honey latte and chai tea latte with an old fashioned donut and blueberry scone. Everything was really good. The scone was a little dry. If you get their punch card they do double punch Sunday's! I will be back (on Sunday lol)

This is the first time ever that I have been to a less than super friendly Dutch. The girl taking our order in the line just walked up to the car and looked at us. Not having a Dutch Brothers where we live, it takes us a minute to decide. The guy at the window was super friendly, but as he handed us our light ice chai and even said it.... I was wondering if it was truly light ice. It wasn't. In fact, I think that it had extra ice. Bummer that we can't go back and have it fixed.

Great staff and a very clean hotel. The pool and hot tub were well maintained and the breakfast fast area was clean and kept full. They offered several gluten free options and the only negative would be the repetition of the menu. . Though I've been told this is a Marriott corporate driven move. . . TV programming backend has been upgraded, but not the tv's they are still +10yrs old and it shows :(

I really love this clinic. It is very friendly! The wait time is short. The doctors were really informative and sweet. I love the method they use to give shots, very effective. My kids did not seem scared at all of the staff or the doctor! Best experience I've had in any clinic! Thank you for such a great job! Definitely coming here for a long time!

Everytime I come to a 5 guys you always know what your going to get. Fast freindly service and a a good burger and fries. Price is a little on the high side. Your looking at 12+ bucks for a single bacon cheese with fries and a drink but it always a good burger and I have never been disappointed with my meal. They always overload u with fries and have free peanuts so if you leave hungry it's your fault.

We don't normally stray from our favorite pizza place, but tonight we decided to try it. My husband has had Chicago Connection before (from another location) and said it was decent. So we ordered from here and sat back waiting for our dinner to arrive. While the pizza arrived hot and fast, it left a lot to be desired. There was absolutely no flavor. We ordered a cheese and a pepperoni along with breadsticks. The dipping sauce for the breadsticks is like tomato paste. The breadsticks reminded me of the prebaked stick you get from the grocery bakery. Not good. I really have nothing more to say about the pizza. It was just completely flavorless. We won't order again. For $40, we could eat at our favorite place, twice, have leftovers each time, and be fully satisfied. The leftovers from this place will go right to the trash.
Friendly bartenders, delicious food and good drinks . It's a fun Friday night there !

We had a steak burger, fries, chili dog and frozen custard peanut butter sandwich. Good food, fries are shoestring, chili dog was lacking. Custard sandwich though was fantastic. I'll be back for the custard.

Our overall experience was excellent and our meetings at the Design Center was a great experience.  Trina was awesome and made it fun and stress free. She gave us lots of options and offered Her advice when asked.  We couldn't have been matched with a better designer.  Our sales rep Bo was also very helpful as is our concierge Aslinn.  I highly recommend Coleman Homes. You won't be disappointed!

My second time in a week lol; I went through the drive through this time. I ordered the peppermint bark mocha (very unique holiday drink); it was yummy!! If you are looking for a delicious new spin on a holiday drink grab that one. The baristas here are always warm, outgoing, and friendly. I ordered another breakfast burrito; the owner actually reached out to me wanted me to try the burrito again. They use fresh eggs/bacon and even stuff their burritos with hashbrowns versus potatoes. This burrito was a lot better than the last try; for a cup of great coffee and a burrito on the go in meridian this is a must stop!!

DO NOT MOVE HERE!

It USE to be a nice apartment complex... with upstanding people... small families and young professionals...

However, the management has changed AT LEAST 3 times since I've been here (2 years)... and thats a low estimate.

The original management was organized and seemed to really understand that this was a nicer complex that required them to be professional and on top of things. 

The current management has dropped the ball in so many ways. 

I'm the type of person that pays my bills on time, and correctly. I never miss a payment and have never had a complaint on me... 

... Yet for some reason... they CAN NOT get their stuff together and put my file in right!? I'm CONSTANTLY getting notices that I owe rent.. I've even received one on my door once, which was awesome... makes me look like a lowlife.

I've sat down with the main manager, and several other management team members MORE THAN THREE TIMES now.. the last three were three months IN A ROW! They blame it on the computer and say "it's acting up" or "someone didn't put it in the system last time"... sometimes they've even argued me about the total I owe, which is NONSENSE because given the track record, its clear I'M the only one that knows whats going on!

I don't even know how they come up with the balances they do? Then when I go down there they pull something out of no where that doesn't even make sense!? So then I show them the document they gave me last time about my rent total (i've learned to ask for everything in writing!)... and they start to back track.. and then the excuses come...

So pretty much.. I constantly am being told I owe more... with no rhyme or reason... and they apparently can't handle a computer system.

On TOP of that... 

When I first moved in they seemed to really care about the type of people they allowed in this community. Now, it just seems like they let anyone in... people there's NO WAY had decent credit.. or just by looking at them.. could guess they wouldn't be a good tenant. 

There use to be a sweet old couple in our building... they eventually moved out because they couldn't afford it anymore. That apartment got filled with FIVE twenty-something boys that were constantly partying and smoking weed all the time. 

There are so many more cigarette smokers now too. During the summer we use to be able to leave our door open with just the screen and have a nice summer breeze... but now if I open my door it ends up smelling like a casino within minutes. I'm talking chain smokers. 
I remember when I first moved in getting month flyers and calendars talking about the community and how to keep this a nice area. Examples.. not smoking on balony, not letting dogs pee in the close by grass to keep it green... they would even stand out in front of the office on weekday mornings with a table with bananas and granola bars to give to people as they left for work!

Completely different now. Very disappointing... especially for the amount they charge for these apartments.

Gramercy is hands down our favorite neighborhood date night/quick bite/easygoing family dinner/etc. The beer and wine menu have never failed us - and the bartender is always knowledgeable on the microbrews. We are IPA fans and have never been disappointed. I order the salmon blt every single time. It is always cooked to perfection and the flavors meld together perfectly. We're also fans of the flat iron veggie (add chili bacon) and the Gramercy sandwich. The pizza is great, and the kids mac keeps the kids quiet while we eat. We've always had great service, too. Reading through this review I see a lot of "always" and "never" - but what can I say? Gramercy is the best!

10-2013- Gassed up $30 or so and no gas went in at all. Workers and management were very much LESS THAN HELPFUL. They did not give a refund saying it must be our car issue. It wasn't, bank got our money back. I WILL NEVER SPEND MONEY AT THIS STATION EVER AGAIN.

The butterscotch and coconut scone is sure to have you wanting more. Pack on the pounds. 
My dad, Bob, loves this place. He appreciates the friends he has made here and raves about the owners entrepreneurial skills.
To the three star review, I can't help but get defensive. The location is FABULOUS! The amount of retirees in the communities surrounding really brings in business and this should be a focus. Also, it's on Chinden, so it's the closest coffee shop besides McDonalds (which shouldn't even count) for miles on a heavily trafficked street. 
It's not about the decor, it's about the people.
This seems to be a great meeting spot! I would love to see some community events here!
The tacos were fine, but I ordered the queso and it had zero cheese flavor. It tasted like flour. Then they served it with grocery store tortilla chips. Terrible.

I give good applause for the nice store and friendly staff. The main product, bundt cake, is not for my taste. It is very sweet for me, even without the icing. It is also very pricey. The icing was waaaaayyyy too sweet, I even asked for light icing. They do not offer different levels of sweetness, so for that, I may not come back.
John is a pro. He gives the best haircut in the Treasure Valley. Gave my hubby a wonderful cut!
Kayla Morris is the BEST!! She has taken my hair from blonde, to dark, and multiple colors in between....very professional and always on time!

Didn't LOVE it, didn't hate it. I would go back. 

OH! Their blueberry muffin was BOMB. I'm like whatever about coffee so I don't have much of an opinion about it. Easy location to find & staff was nice

I've been here twice now and though both times I just managed to squeak in before closing, I found the service to be excellent and friendly. The poke?  Stupendous. It's a super long drive for me to get here but will still do it every chance I get for my poke fix.

Went there in January. Waitress brought out the wrong food for my wife. Then she argued that it was the correct food but then conceded it was the wrong dish. Absolutely zero acceptance of responsibility and the service that night was terrible. When she brought out the correct dish she didn't say a word. I left a note for the owner to call me and left my phone number but no call. We started going there when they first opened and my kids have grown up in that restaurant. We won't be back.
Favorite spot in the Boise area. The molcajete is to die for and I frequently eat both lunch and dinner here when I'm in the area for business. The staff are friendly and accommodating as well!
This location in particular has always been the BEST Dutch Bros. I've been to several around the Treasure Valley and these group of boys/gals are always so friendly and quick!

They have such good prices!!! 3 for 8 and you can choose which ones it was so good!! They had a huge place to dine in and eat and a great view of the fountain/little water feature! Will for sure be coming back!

Stopped in for dinner based upon favorable reviews and was disappointed. I read that the enchilada sauce was good so I ordered the Shawn Special, two enchiladas with fried eggs over the top (however this is NOT New Mexican cuisine!).  Only a trace of enchilada sauce was applied so I was eating unseasoned shredded beef with fried eggs. Wife had flour flautas with the same beef with the same blase taste. The prices are high enough to expect better. Also, it is apparent that the management tries to nickle and dime the customer to maximize profit.  The third serving of chips and salsa costs $3.00.  The soda costs $3 a glass but if you ask for a refill to-go they will charge you another $3, even if you never received a refill while dining in. Wife asked to substitute guacamole for sour cream and that would be an upcharge so we declined. But then they omitted the sour cream without being directed to do so. Watch your wallet in this place; they are out to milk the customer. Service was unattentive as well. The management does not seem to care about pleasing the customer here.
Easy to work with. Jason O. knew exactly what we needed. Helped us through the VA Loan. Made our home buying experience run smooth.

When having a baby you really realize what is super important to you.   For me it was finding a pediatrician who was super knowledgeable and able to share that wisdom with us so that my husband and I could make educated decisions for our daughters health.  I found that it Doc. Butuck!  I am all about natural remedies for what ails you and i was worried that i wouldn't be able to find someone who would list to what I thought and help me to understand the medical side.

What I love about Doc. Butuck is that he sat down with my husband and i and went through every immunization and treatment that the nurses would want to give our daughter at the hospital and gave us the pros cons and his recommendation, and this was all during our interview with him before we choose to have him be our pediatrician!   

I know immunization is a big topic for a lot of parents but I am so glad to have found a Doc who is okay with modified schedules and doesn't push them at all.  At each of my daughters appointments he just asks if we have any new questions. 

 I have have already refereed two of my friends that have had babies in the last year to him and I will keep encouraging other friends to check him out and see if he is a good fit for their medical philosophies.

Would give zero stars if it was available. Room was a complete mess. The floors and walls were dirty. The bathroom was even worse. The toilet and tub was not cleaned. Overall, my experience was awful. Do not recommend at all.

Oh poke bowl, I love you so! First, you pick how many scoops of protein you want. 2, 3 or 4. Then you can pick rice or salad as your base. After you choose these, you slide down the counter and pick your sauce. You can get as wild as you want! Next, you pick your toppings. This is where all the magic happens and it all comes together! Tobiko, seaweed salad, avocado, tamago and so much more! And then there's free toppings like furikake and tempura bits. Now, you sit down and inhale the entire bowl in one sitting. One bite and you will be hooked!

Called because they forgot my tenders in my order (8 of them) and they told me my 'only' option was to go back and they'd make them for me. Does that make sense? THEY forgot my food why would I need to go back? I also ask if they can just refund me and send a balance to my email since I live pretty far out and they said "that's your only option". It's beyond me, this has been the 3rd incident. Will not be going back to this location!
Ordered to go and it was great.

My wife and I scouted this place out recently and tried the following:
All of these items were tried fresh since we got there a few hours after the lunch rush and the buffet had been sitting a bit. 
Egg rolls- slightly bland with bits of hamburger meat. Not bad tho, crispy. 
Spring roll- had some kick, peppery, very crispy, excellent. 
Crab Rangoon- tried these everywhere, less cheese and more crab taste than most places I've tried. 5 stars. 
Pork fried rice- smoky flavor. Delicious. 
Generals chicken- not the usual spicy variant, but more of that same smoky flavor, good except it was over cooked and hard to chew. 
Walnut prawn- would go back just for this!
Best Mexican food ever!!! Its our favorite place to eat! Great staff and excellent food every time!

Your bathroom IS DISGUSTING!!! No lock on door to the stall a bunch of toilet paper just piled on top of toilet paper dispenser in the other stall. Paper towel holder broken and opened up to get to paper towel, hand soap empty and just God awful DISGUSTING!!! Store cleanliness was decent so I expected the bathroom to be clean and decent boy was I in for a surprise.  If your management doesn't care about how your business looks why should your staff. Who ever owns this location you might want to revamp your whole staffing department.  There's people out there who would like a job and have pride in it.  CLEAN UP THE DANG BATHROOM!!!!
Super yummy. I like to order the bundtinis so I can sample them all. I did an online order and it was ready in less than an hour. The store is clean and has unique gifts.

WOW WOW WOW!! Everyone needs to know about this place! 

The quality *chef's kiss* is 5 stars
The service: 5 stars
Cleanliness: 5 stars
The speed at which food is prepared: 5 stars

10/10 would eat again and again and again!!

I had a wonderful experience today picking out new running shoes. I was given many different styles to try on. I ran on the treadmill as the associate watched me run and make sure I was receiving the correct support. I was not rushed at all. I even had my two very busy children with me and I received nothing but patience and courtesy. I would recommend Pulse running shop to anyone who wants to receive the perfect fitting pair of shoes!

Very flavorful Donuts!! You'll have to give them a try at the Villiage in Meridian, Idaho. 
Order up..... fresh, warm, tasty Duck Donuts!!
Quack Quack!!

Everything. Overpriced and overbearing. I left each visit more uncomfortable with the environment. Dr. Baker assumes that everyone has the same political views and continually spues his rhetoric as if everyone in the room agrees. I just wanted a good Chiropractor(which I believe he is). But if I felt like I was attending a rally twice a week and be grossly overcharged for that privilege. After I informed them that I would not be continuing to come to the office instead of sending my final bill they just decided to deduct it from my account. Don't be fooled by the charm infused high pressure sales pitch. I ended up paying more for 7 adjustments(3 weeks)and a bag of junk then I did for just under a year of treatment from my previous Chiropractor. Don't drink the Kool-Aid!
My whole office loves this place and we usually celebrate by purchasing a dozen or more. Thank you for the variety and helping us celebrate each other.

Antigua Coffee has been a second home for me while I'm in school. The owners are some of the nicest people you will ever meet and go above and beyond to keep you coming back. 
The coffee is better than anywhere else in town. The pastries are fresh and homemade. The food is fantastic and unlike anywhere else in the area.
There is a warm fireplace with a couch for cold mornings, and in the afternoon there is plenty of sunshine getting in. If you are looking for a new place for coffee, snacks, food, or even just to hang out, this is the place to be. They truly make you feel like family.

We relocated from Arizona and needed a good quality and well located apartment... The Fields at Gramercy fit the bill. Never had any issues with neighbors and always felt comfortable and welcome by all. No matter your situation in life, this is a great location and awesome service.
I got a wax from Shannon this week. She was very friendly. She made me extremely comfortable and she was very informative about every step. The reception desk was also very kind.

BFC food truck fed our school staff today. The consensus was 5 stars for communication, organization, service, and yummy food! Sarmad and Masar even pulled off perfect weather. They made our pandemic-weary staff feel appreciated and helped us celebrate the end of a challenging school year.
Joni

Janae (sorry if that's misspelled) in the drive through for this location is by far one of the most incredible people I have come in contact with. I've always had great service at this location but there is something special about how she brings a smile to my face every time I go there (which is a lot) I love seeing your face friend! You make my day start off just right! Happy holidays!

I have been here plenty of times to have the ultimate review. I really love this place.it is real swell. The service is great. That lady in the reviews above or below me is whack and out her damn mind. BLIMPIES IS THE OG, f that subway eat fresh sh*t (pardon my French hehe ;)). The sandwiches are premium and I wanna keep shoving my mouth full of their meat. Yummy is all I can say.

God bless y'all

(Blimpies enthusiasts)
Great food, best Happy Hour in town and great service.  Calzone is awesome, as well as the prime rib dips.

Freddy's has been my number one spot for quality fast food ever since I moved to Boise. These burgers are absolutely delicious. There's nothing quite like sinking my teeth into one of these fabulous greasy steak burgers. It's the only thing I think about sometimes, especially after a hard night of drinking. I swear there's something magical about these because they make my hangovers go away just like that. Not even joking around a bit. They really do. Especially drenched in their delicious fry sauce. I'm so glad they sell it by the bottle!

My one complaint is the ridiculous shoe string fries. I'd like to have a chat with the person who thought these were a good idea. They are so difficult to eat. Reminds me of picking up a bunch of sticks or something. I can't even efficiently dip them in sauce without making a complete mess and getting dip all over my hands. I've learned to ask for a fork so I can actually eat these and not bitch the entire time. I suggest you do the same!
Ice cream is wonderful but the gals there are not interested in waiting on customers.

warning::: to our biker friends......fyi......
wost place ever!! dont let them wrk on your bike they'll leave all new part loose and not give two shits ! how do put brand new handle bars on our bike and when  we fucking tke off 2 miles down the road the fall? thats the 1st thing the next thing is our fish tail pipes they installed are  loose and almost feel off as well as the exhaust heat shield real professional. 2,500. later my husband then went in to tlk to the manager. he didn't give a shit. never ever again. mad man is the best motorcycle shop around.  service manger sucks he didnt even apologies for all the fuck-ups his shop is responsible for.

Recently bought this 2020 CVO and the purchase process was as expected. I started to experience some issues with my sound system and the service department, "Levi" could not have been more helpful, actually ALL of them went out of their way to help.  Turned out to be a factory issue so I decided to reach out to the executive branch of Harley for assistance.  
In the meantime "MARK" one of the owners of High reached out to me.  I honestly can't say enough about this contact, but leave it to say we decided to wait to hear from Harley. 
Received a call from the Executives rep by the name of "Vince" Case #4109518.  He told me he reviewed my issues and in so many words Tough luck good-bye!  After owning numerous Harleys since 1982 I was beyond shocked and disappointed!

I reached out to MARK who was just waiting for my call.  He knew the corporation would be of little to no help.  He assured me that I was HIS customer and we would make this right!  So here is the owner of a dealership with NO backing what so ever from the corporate level offering to stand by his customer!   Who does that? The Corporation is whom you go to when the dealership won't help you!  Here we have just the opposite!  In just a few weeks the problem is resolved and they have an advocate for life!   You just don't see this kind of service in this world anymore.  As angry as I am with the Harley Corporation and as much as I would love to attack them I can't!  Mark, as one of their franchise owners has saved a customer all on his own, actually in spite of the horrible service from the Executive branch! The newest CEO could learn a thing or two from Mark and perhaps Harley could turn their dying business around! 
Thank you Mark and High Desert Harley Davidson for doing the right thing and simply being outstanding in the customer service department!

Fantastic food and kind people are the key principles at Gandolfo's. They have so many great options to choose from, its hard to make a decision on what to order! Practically everything is made from scratch too, so quality doesn't suffer at all to make up for the large menu.
I love that they offer New York style classics along with bomb breakfast sandwiches, and some really fun creations like The Big Apple. I definitely want to come back to try their Philly Cream Cheese Steak, which was recommended to me by their very sweet and friendly cashier, Lexi. I really appreciated how knowledgable she was about all of their sandwiches.

I ordered the Rockefeller Rueben, which was piled so high, I could barely get my mouth around it! They definitely don't skip on the meat here! It was absolutely delicious, and had just the right ratio of sauerkraut to Swiss cheese. The corned beef was tender, melted in my mouth, and had tons of flavor. I opted for mustard because I love the tang, but I'm planning on returning to try another one with their house made Russian dressing. The portion was pretty big, so I only was able to make it through half of my sandwich. It worked out for the best though - the other half made a great leftover lunch the next day. 

I had the pleasure of meeting the owner briefly while I was there, who is a very kind guy. He was busy running the kitchen for the majority of my visit, but I did see him come out to check on guests whenever the line at their cash register tended to wane, which wasn't too often, as this place is steady. He personally thanked each guest for coming in, which was such a nice touch! I will definitely be coming back for their incredible sandwiches, and would recommend Gandolfo's to anyone looking for a good bite.

Alright...so this is one of my favorite chains and one of the best examples of an overall reliable and consistent and relatively high quality chain. After a beating my stomach took due to another chain, I wasn't looking for anything too challenging, just comfort. 

As to the execution, they did the burgers to near perfection, well-cooked and moist and juicy. The bacon was a bit destroyed and speaking directly to the restaurant now and anyone else who might have one that serves burgers, don't give me cold cheese, cold unmelted cheese, a big chunk of it from the slices that didn't melt, like this place did. 

That aside, Coke Zero mix was good and I always like the peanuts. Awesome to have those rather than fries. I would have put this place at more like a 3.5 than a 4 as there were some noticeable cleanliness issues...and that unmelted cheese thing...however, they get the push because I got a kick out of the kitchen staff singing along to the overhead, even though hair metal songs from the 80's are considered "classics" now and that sort of made me feel old...anyway, burger was fine. Definitely worth hitting up.

If you want them to make you a burger my way, choose either single or double patty, add cheese, bacon, mushrooms, jalapenos, A-1 sauce and get thee face full. Sometimes I will also add green peppers and less frequently a little splash of lettuce, but that's more of an option; the other toppings are standard.

Burger perfection on every visit. This Meridian location was just as clean, safe and limited dine in as every other location has been. I liked the fact that Idaho potatoes were in use, while in Idaho :)

Last night, we went to this wingstop in Meridian, and received the wrong food.  I ordered and then was told to wait 15 minutes and our order would be ready.  We ordered the food at 6:53 and did not receive the order until 7:48.  I went in 2 times prior to receiving the food and was told both times, your order will be ready in 15 minutes.  It was like that was the script that they were given, and they were sticking to it. Meanwhile, I witnessed several others, two of which ordered at the same time as us, in the store, so we know that they were not pre-ordered situations, receive their food before us.  No problem, we knew we ordered a large amount, so we waited in the car until I thought enough time had passed to go check again. When I went into the store at 7:48, 50 minutes had passed, so I figured, they would be ready by now, and the guy who took my order  said, your order is ready Deniece, let me bag it for you.  He bagged and sealed the order.  We drove home, and then unbagged our order.  We ordered 25 Lemon Pepper and 25 BBQ.

What we got, was HOT wings, and BBQ Wings.  Keep in mind that I live in South East Boise, deep into the city, on the other side of BOISE STATE UNIVERSITY, so I am irritated that I have to drive back to Meridian anyway.  My son calls the order in, and explains the situation, only to have the manager tell us, you want a credit on your next order, or do you want a replacement of the wings.  Um, yes, I want a replacement.  There is a reason I ordered 50 wings, I want to feed my family tonight. Anyway,  I drive back to get the hot wings replaced, and Kekona, the person who originally got our order wrong, has the bag sitting there, he said here you go, sorry, and kinda tosses the bag at us onto the counter;  I start talking to him because I want to discuss it with him so they pay attention, and while I am talking, he said: "Sorry about that", and turns around and walks away, WHILE I AM TALKING TO HIM.  He didn't hear anything I had to say, nor did he want to.  He was in the wrong, and clearly didn't care that he was. I said what is your name, and just as bold as he walked away, he looked back over his shoulder and says "Kekona" and keeps walking away! I think I am done.  I am so disgusted that I spent almost $70, had to come back to get the order right and then could not even get the courtesy to be heard.

Look at my lemon pepper wings.  They have very little lemon pepper on them.  What is this Ill fry them, leave them semi-naked, and you can season them again when you get home?  I paid for lemon pepper wings, not greasy wings, with a little sprinkle of something on some of the wings.

My veggies, look at the serving size, ridiculous, and where is my ranch.  Why ask me what kind of dipping sauce I want if you are not even gonna give me dipping sauce.  I cannot understand this one bit.  The receipt said 4 dipping sauces, I received 0.

Each time I come here, I spend well over $50, and each time I am disappointed. I won't be back, and I am going to tell the people that I know that come to the this location to look elsewhere for their food or  make it at home because this is going to be a waste of their time and their money!!!

Stopped in on my way to work to purchase pomegranate arils for a salad I was making.  This was the third store I stopped at without success.  HOWEVER the produce employee Tracy went into the back and quickly broke down two pomegranates for me--saving the day.
It is this kind of customer service that makes Fred Meyer the excellent company it is!
Thanks Tracy
My bacon was so very salty so it ruined the skillet for me. My husband gives this place a 2 because his rice was Very under cooked. Crunchy rice and bland chorizo. Super cute & clean place though

When I got my car from my dad I found that there were a few things that I needed to fix. But when I went to find The parts, i did not have them. So my mom took my down to Action Hobby's and man they are a life savor. They found things that I did not know were Brocken. They fixed my car and let me help do it too. The next time that I break my car I'm going to go there and not wast time at other stores. 
The people that work there too are awesome, they are cool people and are nice. Would go there in a heart beat. 

Thanks!!!

Quality and Consistency Not Good

I work for a large Auto Dealership in Boise Idaho  of which they have several dealers in Idaho and Utah - Today we purchased 23 Burritos from 1440 N Eagle Rd, Meridian, ID 83642 and I am really disappointed at the quality of each Burrito - We Paid in excess of $8.99 per burrito and no consistency at all - I just took photos of my Burrito and here are my findings 11.1oz - 7 1/2 inch Long and at one end 2 inches thick at one end and the other just over 1 1/2 inch. The thinness of the burritos was not what we had expected for the price we paid and the amount and we order from Baja Fresh 992 N Milwaukee St, Boise, ID 83704 (Now Closed) frequently enough the regardless it should be better for all customers and worth the $8.99 paid. This was our first experience with this location and not a good way to start off.

What a web of misinformation I was given by the a salesman at High Desert Harley Davidson. I purchased the bike on line and had it shipped. I asked the sales person if the bike had any damage, "no" was the answer it is in top condition. He said it was Harley Davidson owned and they knew the bike and took great care of it. They also charge me almost $500 more because it was "Harley Owned". They told me that it just had its 20000 mile service. So like a dummy I believed them. 
Once the bike was delivered I noticed that one of the handbags had a deep gouge in it and was touché up with spray paint. I found out the bike was a repo out of CA. and not Harley Owned and this dealer knew nothing about the bike.  I requested a copy of the service records on the bike, I did not receive any of them, the hard bags has custom anti theft locks on them that the sales person was going to send me the key, they did nothing. Calls and emails did not help. I am very disappointed with Jeremy and High Desert Harley Davidson. Yelp is my first stop

So different and so good! I had tried poké once before but because of all the combinations that you can put together with these foods, it's a new experience every time. Their main combinations all sounded amazing which made it hard to choose which one to try. They have several options of meats, veggies, etc. to put in your bowl. I built my own bowl which was fun and the employee was very nice and helped me choose the best/most popular things to put into my bowl. Highly recommend!

The poke bowls here are pretty good.  The fish is fresh and chopped into bite size pieces.  For some reason they don't offer spicy tuna (which has been a popular staple at all other poke bowl locations I've been to).  Good selection of sauces and toppings.

I waited a month for my 1st appt. I suffer from 4 herniated disks, compression fracture, and severe sciatica. Within that months wait, I had to visit the ER for my severe pain. I called this office to see if they could squeeze me in a day early. So I arrive today, only to be told that they don't give out prescriptions for pain. So I wasted a whole month just to find out they don't prescribe pain meds. When I first called to make the appt, that was chief complaint was severe pain. Apparently the front office lacks to tell patients that they don't prescribe pain meds. So here I am, still in sever pain and a month wasted when I could of went elsewhere to get the help I needed.

First time visit. 
Atmosphere was inviting and the place was clean. 

The issue is how can you not get right the oatmeal. It was like soup. After telling them of the issue they bring out new oatmeal that was like soup as well. Couldn't eat it. I should have told  them again but if they cant see that it's not right then there is nothing I can do for them.  Quality assurance is key to success. 

The rest of the food was ok.
This place was amazing! Great customer service and was kept very clean. I strongly recommend it, especially their pupasas.

I was in Boise for the half Ironman event in May... The day after the event was looking for something to do found Kanak Attack at the taste of Boise event... Kept going back for their tacos!  will track them down next visit.... Keep up the great work!
Best sub sandwich I've had in years. Literally. The business is clean, the people are friendly and the food is great. Way to go everyone!

My wife and I just love Lucky Perk.  They are very consistent with their drinks and always taste delicious.  I get the Shamrocker (double espresso & chocolate syrup) & my wife gets an Iced Chai tea.  

The employees are the best.  Always nice, always!
Our favorite is a young college student who is a twin to Julia Roberts.  She is going to go very far in life.  Great attitude, always smiling, and beautiful.

I am sure most espresso aficionados would love Lucky Perk.
Angela was out server today and she was a rock star. Congrats on the new location we are so glad to have watched boifood and found out about his gem  we can't wait to come back

Ok, I've been here 3-4 times now, so I'll give my yelp opinion. Love this place. Great food, great service, great atmosphere. 

Sat at the bar last night to eat as the place, like usual, was very busy upon our arrival. Wish I could remember the bartenders name, but he was simply awesome. Reminded me of my older brother who tended at one time in his life. Knew his craft through and through, and could recommend something to everyone. I listed to him with other customers, and he's the type that deserves the tip and the extra wage to keep people coming back. 

The pizza here is amazing. Can't go wrong as far as I'm concerned. Last night we shared the Mac n Cheese. What a spicy, yummy treat. Also love the Gramercy Bites as an appetizer, but only if I'm not having pizza. Too much bread!! 

We aren't in this area too often, but we love knowing this place does well and will be here when we are around and craving decent food.

Our carbon monoxide and smoke detectors have gone off multiple times in the middle of the night and other random times. The fire department came. It was very scary (We have 4 small children).. They told us we need new detectors. They aren't working properly. Does Home River Group care? Certainly not.  We called about this in the early summer and here we are in January- NO FOLLOW UP, NOTHING!  We are paying for a home with 2 full bathrooms but only one toilet is usable. We have also called about this with no help.. that was a few months ago. Two weeks ago, our garage wouldn't close and we have valuable stuff in there. We called and STILL no help or even follow up.  It is sad enough that they don't fix the problem but even worse,  they won't even communicate professionally. I would love to warn anyone looking to rent from them: Please don't! They treat people so very poorly.

This store totally messed up my account. I had to back out of an upgrade because it involved a plan change that took away features that we were using. All the changes were not rolled back and now I am paying $40 to insure 4 devices, instead of the $18.00 on the 2 devices I previously had insured. Called customer service to get it put back and they wouldn't do it...told me I had to take the phones to the store...it is complete baloney...you didn't roll back the changes why do I need to take them in? Also, it was a good thing I checked my current phone before I left as it was not longer working.

I have eaten at Broken Yolks in SoCal and enjoyed there food.  The Meridian Broken Yolk is not only on par with these, they have definitely added to the welcoming Idaho spirit.  Decor was modern and very nice, food was hot, plentiful, presented very nicely and very tasty.  Service was excellent. And for those that are COVID crazy well they were adhering to the local guidelines and seen regular wipe downs.  By in large definitely recommend for great meal.  Thank you Broken Yolk.

We stopped here for dinner one night and it was pretty good. We weren't super hungry so we split a large Caesar salad and a personal pizza with red sauce, pepperoni, and pickled jalapeño. The server was very nice and quick with our food. The pizza was super hot when it came out so we started with the salad. The salad was a standard Caesar salad. The pizza they had though was great I love the personalization with a nice crust.

These guys don't double check their orders before they send them out for delivery. We've ordered from them a couple of times & they are constantly getting it wrong by mixing up what dish goes in which plate...
Luckily they haven't added any seafood to our orders, because of allergies.

I have to say, there are few places in Idaho to eat along the lines of health food of this type.  When I visit the area, I tend to indulge in local fare such as craft brews, burgers, wings and fries. Lots of fries. 

Revitalize helps me keep balance.  Friendly, knowledgeable staff.  Clean, comfortable space.  Excellent quality offerings at reasonable prices.

Service was okay.. Not very friendly unless you are a regular...  I was waiting on my coffee and a regular came in the barista gave me my coffee and then started talking to this regular customer and totally completely ignore me the fact that I also order a muffin and they forgot to give it to me until I have to wait to get their attention for them to notice me to ask for my muffin that they forgot to give me...

UPDATE: I saw the review from another patient that was extremely critical. I've never had such an experience.  He does like to get things done I'll grant you that​, but only in the sense that if you put it off, stuff tends to go south.  He will listen if you wish to postpone something.  He has for me.

Other patient also complained that office was money hungry. I tried to pay in cash today and they said no thank you so that doesn't seem consistent.

Found out today how good he was at cosmetic stuff.  He did it as part of a filling on the same tooth.  Now I have a nice tooth in place of the jagged one.

I have been a patient here for several years and expect to stay put.  Good dentists are very hard to find.  This one is on Eagle just south of Overland Road.

On our first cross country motorcycle trip, my boyfriend and I were in the vicinity of Boise and stopped by to borrow a wrench for a loose piece on our pipes. 
First of all, High Desert Harley Davidson is ABSOLUTELY BEAUTIFUL! I cannot emphasize this enough- it should literally be a tourist attraction because of how awesome it is!
The employees in retail sales and in motorcycle parts were the kindest Harley employees we have ever met! they were super helpful with whatever problems we were having with our bike!

Great simple sandwiches! Love the shredded lettuce. Great meat and plenty of cheese. Bread is fresh and soft. My second time at Blimpies and tbh, hands down the best tasting sandwiches. Try one, you'll never go back to Subway or Jersey Mike's.

I have a coworker who is always suggesting we eat at places no one in the office has heard of.  This time it was Gramercy Park Pizza and Grill.

My first impression is that it's a small place and I don't particularly care for small places.  I like being able to move around and not knock into tables and chairs.  The first employee we interacted with was very friendly.

Ordering was easy.  We had a group of 7.  6 of the 7 orders came out correct but the 7th order was completely off.  There is a burger with all the fixin's including hash browns and sausage gravy.  The 7th order was said burger sans hash browns and gravy.  When the order was delivered to the table, the burger was COVERED in unwanted gravy.  The server was alerted to the issue and with a "sorry bro", the burger was whisked away for a new one.

I ordered the El Capitan which is a chicken sandwich on chibatta bread with Franks Red Hot sauce, blue cheese crumbles, coleslaw and jalapeños.  I hate to say it but it was just alright.  It was small and not filling at all.  I figure if I'm paying $10+ for a sandwich, I had better be filled up when I leave.

For me, I won't be back.  There was nothing about my experience that blew my mind besides being hungry 2 hours later.  I suppose if I would have spent $20 or more on my meal, I would have been full but I wasn't willing to pay that much.

P.S. - There is a full bar and I believe it was weekdays when they have a happy hour from 3pm to 6pm.  We were there around noon so I have no idea what the specials are.  Well, I think I remember being confused by a can of $2 Rainier Beer or something else from the Pacific Northwest that no one should pay $2 a can for.

Had always used a competitor in past, just bought a new house in meridian & one opener had issues ; Actions sticker was on wall & they originally installed openers so i called them. Excellent receptionest, actually had knowledge & pleasant personality. Brandon was exceptional also; on time ,very knowledgible,prices were very reasonable, very comforting when so many service related companies are using "flat rate" price gouging !  Turnsout i have obsolete openers that will most likely need replacing, i will definately call action to do this. I was having the carpets cleaned @ the same time & he even commented on how impressed he was with Brandon & that he will use action from now on !

I recently attended an Agate Nightlight Make and Take class at Craft Warehouse.  The project was a fun idea and very reasonably priced at $8.  To purchase the materials otherwise would have been more like $15-$20 for the project.  Unfortunately, the two employees running the class were not very helpful or professional.  One of them was very impatient and had an attitude about everything.  The other employee was busy making her own agate nightlight.  They both kept openly joking about the fact that the second employee saw a really nice piece of agate in the pieces set aside for customers and decided to grab it and make herself a nightlight.  Meanwhile, the remaining pieces of agate we had to select from were actually two small for the project.  Most of them weren't large enough to extend beyond the small bulb of the nightlight and/or had cracks.  They both were incredibly unprofessional.  As I was leaving, the impatient employee had come to the front to argue with another employee who apparently wasn't doing the receipts correctly got customers attending the class.  Ooy!  

Otherwise, the store seemed decent and stocked a wide variety of crafting materials.  I think the crafting classes are a fantastic idea, if only the employees working it had a better understanding of customer service.
Delicious and fresh food made exactly to order. Clean sitting area and everything stocked up. Definitely a must stop!

The initial process is great, but once you are moved in, there is NO customer service.  All the phone numbers go directly to voice mail!  You can't get a hold of anyone if there is a problem.  It is always a third party that tries to help, but nothing from Coleman Homes - very disappointing!

This is the best coffee and hot chocolate in town.
I found this great coffee shop on a recent trip to my b-in-laws for Christmas and I have been returning here every trip to the treasury valley.

Big burritos. Not your traditional burritos. If you don't like ranch ask for no white sauce otherwise your burrito will be drenched in it. Chips and queso are delicious. Sweeto Burrito is one of the family favorite.
The amount of food you get is weak and if McDonald's could make biscuits and gravy they would do a better job than you guys poor excuse for food and you should consider removing it from your menu
Walked in during stayed business hours, the man told me that he cannot do my 2 boys haircuts because he's leaving for DR appointments! So ridiculous!

I walked in Amore and immediately did not feel welcomed. I felt I was an inconvenience to everyone in there. I had booked a mani and a pedi, and left without the pedi because I was so disappointed. Also, it was extremely hot in the store and it was very uncomfortable. I will not be going back. Save yourself, DO NOT GO TO AMORE.

Love living here! Very clean, all the appliances are new. Also rent includes not only trash and water but also cable and Internet. 
Amazing staff! My husbands car got stuck in the snow. Not only did we have one employee helping us but 4 other guys came to help! Also, apartments are beautiful! Probably going to continue here after our lease might just upgrade apartment size.

I was in the Fred Meyer/McDonalds parking lot this morning and saw that a new coffee shop had popped up that I haven't tried yet. I pulled into the driveway and a super friendly barista took my order. I had a French Press coffee and the Guava Cream Cheese pastry. Holy cow this pastry is amazing!! It's sweet and crunchy and tropical. They are made fresh everyday, and it shows! My coffee was wonderful as well. Love that they have a drive through. 5 Stars for great service and great food/drink. :)
What's not to RAVE about when offered a healthier version of what we all want, a delicious treat!! I really enjoy that all versions are also available and gluten-free.

This place is okay when you're needing a quick cut. They cut my son's hair a bit uneven, not terribly but enough for me to notice. They were quick and got us in on short notice, and I was grateful for that. If you go, make sure to pay attention to detail.

Tried Sweeto Burrito for the first time. Used the app and was pleasantly surprised at how easy it was to customize our order. Really liked how they delivered to car after marking we were there in the app. 

The food was great. The sweet pork was flavorful and their tots were some of the best around. We will be ordering there again.
Reberta did my hair, she's very good at her job! I love the way it turned out, the people here are very professional and nice, I will definitely go back!
Haha, it took one year for this response! That is how great customer service is at Coleman Homes!

Tried for the first time. I was the only customer in the store. I ordered online for pick up order. There was a lot of staff behind the counter. When I asked about picking up a pre-order, I was rudely barked at by a male staff member. I arrive 5 mins before pick up time. Food was already on the shelf. The breaded onion rings were old and cold, with a few burnt ones. I would definitely not recommend them. The burrito was scantily filled. Not worth money or experience.

I like Poke! So when I found this restaurant I had to try it. YUM! Of course Unagi Don - fresh water eel - is one of my fav's so I had to try theirs. I know it's not Poke', but it's still great. I ordered a carryout and it was so enjoyable. The restaurant was clean. The food fresh. The employees both knowledgeable and friendly. They were following the Covid protocols for safety.

When eel is prepared it must be cooked first which takes a few minutes. It was no problem waiting ten minutes for my meal to be ready for assembly, especially as it's one of my favorites. This also gave me time to see what other selections they had for enjoyment. They do have a lot.

I hope to return soon.
Tacos were salty and the burrito wasn't even mixed in. Also side note, they weren't from the streets smh, the hot sauce tastes like they use tomatoes instead of tomatillos like they should,
Bad food/ service the beer tower is the gimmick and it's over priced. Iggys was better and cleaner!
Its great the biz feeding the needy and homeless. I love that vibe. Definitely be going there in the future. Awesome job!

The wait here was crazy. We just ended up sitting at bar as soon as possible to avoid a 45 minute wait. Even after sitting at bar it took about another 45 minutes to get it food. The bloody Mary's here are pretty good even tho it's from a premix. The coffee tasted like water and not good. The lemon ricotta pancakes are very plain and boring. It was definitely a disappointment after the long wait. The montecristo was better. The price was good.

This is my favorite Starbucks. The baristas are very knowledgeable and kind. ESPECIALLY Cara. I visit this location on average about once a week and I always enjoy being able to chat with Cara. She's personable and always crafts my order perfectly.

Food and service was amazing! Kerry was efficient, friendly, and had great recommendations. Personal pizzas were larger than expected and tasted great! Our new favorite spot for pizza. Also definitely recommend the Gramercy Bites! The only thing missing from this place are chicken wings (but that definitely won't stop us from coming back).
Wish I could put one star the dumb girls there don't listen and can't do there job they rather talk and forget your order don't go here unless you don't care about customer service cause it blows
Worst nail salon I have ever been to so dirty and the girls  are mean and she made my GEL NAILS LUMPY how do you make gel nails lumpy
Best coffee in town which might be saying a lot if go out of your way to find the decent shops. Pork meat pie with chimichurri is phenomenal! This place is a gem.

We have stayed in this particular hotel many times the last several years. It is a decent stay. But usually quite busy. In fact, the last two times we have gone down for breakfast in the morning they have been out of everything. Beds are VERY Firm. Not my back's favorite thing. They are pet friendly which is helpful. Staff is friendly and helpful. Rooms have always been clean. However, I am always baffled to find the disposal stop sitting on top of the clean washcloth in the kitchen when we arrive. Gross. Overall a good stay. WAAAY BETTER THAN THE TRU next door. We stayed there once to save a few bucks. Never again. Marriot is lots better.

Hands down my favorite coffee shop! No matter which location you visit you will get your favorite drink just the way you like it! Their drinks are way better than those OTHER coffee joints! I don't usually get drip coffee since I can make that at home but I can speak to the mocha and Americano varieties...mmmmmm! Also notable are their muffins. Baked on site, fresh every morning. My personal favorites are the cranberry orange and the morning glory muffins! 
As an added bonus the staff is always delightful, even at the crack of dawn! The genuine friendliness even reads through the speaker in the drive up! It's also a nice, cozy place to hang out and have a cup of coffee with a friend!

Great location. This is a small place but they do well with the space. I liked the food. I am a fan of Mexican food and I generally play it safe, which I need to break free of, therefore I can't say the food was bad by any means. Most places give you beans and salsa with the chips; however, this place put shredded cheese in the beans which I thought was a nice thing to do. 
I had a pina colada, which I never drink, and it didn't have much taste and I never felt the effects of the alcohol, which tells me there was very little in it. Overall, the place was good and I will likely visit again.

Good food. Good selection. Decent prices.
Not a huge selection on tequila's but decent.
Molcajete is good. Bacon wrapped shrimp,if you get it, and you like a twist ask for a side of lime and tapatio, it's a very tasty appetizer(not on the menu though).
Good atmosphere enough music volume too not overhear the table next to you but to hear the people at your table. Been here several times haven't been disappointed yet.


Wanted to add to the review of ketchup on the tables is an outright lie. Pics to show Darren's LIE

I cannot say enough about Meridian Family Medicine. I'll start with the front desk. I've always been made to feel welcomed, always greeted with a smile, and they are super polite. I have seen Janelle Barney there and my husband has seen other providers as well and we are amazed by the quality of service provided. Janelle spent a good amount of time with me on my first visit as I was feeling overwhelmed from my move from another state to hear and really listened to all my concerns and for the first time ever I had a doctor that really address all of them. I have to say in the short time I have been seeing her I have felt better than ever. My husband also had a great experience with his provider Scott Frisby. My daughter and her family go there as well and I'm impressed with the love and care my little grandson has been treated as well. Next is the staff nursing whom are also wonderful and relay the msg to the doctor and get back to you in a timely manner. They greet me as they know me and I really do feel that they care. I'm so glad I found this family practice!

Having dinner and my son asks for water because the food was hot. The restaurant guy says he can't give me a water, but I can pay for bottled water. WTH, what restaurant doesn't offer water unless you pay for it? Won't be patronizing this Baja again.

Alright so I was a HUGE skeptic that for 1-4 grams of sugar a donut could actually taste good or anything like a donut for that matter, but it's a donut AND its gluten free AND it looks amazing so I had to try it.  Man, am I so glad I did!  Soo tasty!!  Having been gluten free for several years now, this was my first (gluten free) donut in, well, years!!  Not only do they taste good they are actually "relatively" good for you, not full of artificial fillers and such, low carb, low sugar, and high in protein. 

Now for those of you who frequent Krispy Kreme and other such "regular" donut shops, lets remember to compare apples to apples.  These donuts are much more dense, however, they still manage to be moist and gooey (not dry and flaky) which is soo hard to find when it comes to gluten free baked goods!  

A downside (for some people) they do have a ever so slight whey taste, which personally I don't mind at all.  As I've been on a low to no refined sugar diet I found the donuts just a tad too sweet for my taste, but the rest of my family (who eat like regular people) they thought it was just fine/could be a tad sweeter.  Its all what you're used to!

Overall, they looked great, tasted great, and I will be back for more!
Good coffee, pastries tend to be on the dry side. Low rating because entire staff on hand was not wearing masks. Pandemic isn't over just because you're over it.

We were looking for a new breakfast spot........ and I think we found it!! The place was crowded (on a Weds morning) but the bussers are super fast at getting tables cleaned and ready. We sat right down. The hostess asked if it was okay if we had a table (instead of booth). We said no problem but I thought that was very considerate. The service was great and the food was amazing. My wife had the Chilaquilled and I had the breakfast burrito . We shared a gluten free pancake. It was all great and we will definitely be going back!!

For at least the last 5 years this has been my favorite burger until today. Last month I went in for lunch and noticed the bun was way larger then the burger. Today the bun was the right size but very dry and dense. This guy came by and asked how the food was so I asked if they had new buns. He said no that it was exactly the same as always. He then sort of got very argumentative about this and didn't want to know why I even inquired about the bun. That combines with the fact I sent a friend there who had never even tried it before and their comment was about the bun being way bigger then the burger. I will not go back because of the dismissive, argumentative way I was spoken to. I have included a pic of the guy who was arrogantly rude for no reason. Here's a tip, if you don't care about how someone's food is, then don't ask. Simple.

I hesitate to write this review. The reason is because I only had 1 thing here so far. I think it is only fair that I try several things before I can really rate any place.

I decided to go ahead and give it a rating. Just please keep in mind that I just had the one thing and on one occasion. 

Every place has its ups and downs. Every place has things that it excels at and things that are just ok.

I had a small chocolate bunt cake. I found it to be dry and not very tasty. The icing on the top was very overpoweringly sweet.

I would not try this one again, but I will come back to try others, When I do, I will be able to give this place more of a full review.

I have returned here and bought another chocolate (I just had to give it another chance) and a lemon, which is my wife's favorite flavor.

The chocolate was again dry, so I think my now I can give this a good evaluation of...... NOT. I highly do not recommend the chocolate. Its just plain not very good. In fact, if I had not known it was supposed to be chocolate, I would not have known it was chocolate if that made sense.

I have never before had a lemon cake. Its just not a favor that does it for me. In this case though, the lemon bundt cake here is good. It was....well, in my wife's vernacular, a foodgasm. I hope I can say that. :)

Based on this, I had to upgrade my rating from "Not a Fan", to "OK". I wanted to give this place even more stars, but one good cake out of two is not a very good ratio. I may go back here again and try more flavors on their cakes. My bottom line here is that the jury is still out on this place.

I dont have enough data yet to give Nothing Bundt Cakes a thumbs up or down.
So yummy and cute! And the barista was the sweetest girl who was quick and not stressed out even though there were cars on both sides of the drive thru

The best we've found since leaving California. Everything is good... Some items are better than others, but tonight was a winner for me. The Asada super burrito was awesome! Meat was great quality and burrito was enough for two meals. Can't beat that. My husband ALWAYS gets the chicken mole... he loves it. Super happy that they expanded to a larger place. Friendly staff... always sweet and helpful. Highly recommended!

I've seen this place a couple of times recently and I've been intrigued by the name, plus I love tacos. I came to Yelp to decide if it was worth trying and the most recent reviews were good so we went for it. It's delicious!! I notice some comments about the food being cold, it must have been a fluke because we order through doordash and it took about 15 minutes to get to us and the food is still hot. Would definitely recommend the queso and the carnita jefe.
Good, healthy donuts!! Great customer service! Our 4yr old LOVED her chocolate sprinkles donut, but kept calling it cake.  Solid healthy donut shop.
Whoever is running this place should get an award. The staff is friendly and helpful and it's been years since I got such a pleasant, clean room for such a great price. This is how it should be done!

I know this is a new location, and with new locations it is often for mistakes to be made. 

 They significantly messed up my order. I had one sandwich missing. And when I called to get a refund they asked very few questions and so far no refund has been given. Whether or not I return depends on whether or not they follow through on their promises.

We will see how things go in the future I would recommend waiting a few weeks before visiting this location so they can work out their operating procedures.

If they follow up with me and give me my refund I may add a star to my review.

Great chiropractic care for our whole family! My wife struggled with back pain for years. Dr Baker identified several ways to relive her pain with treatment. Our active son sustained injuries on the playground and football field. Dr Baker fixed his injuries quickly. Old injuries from a car accident continued to bother my hips and lower back. Dr Baker's treatment and suggestions always made me feel better. Highly recommended and worth the investment!

Looks like they've changed staff. Much better service. My order was finally correct, the burger was good and there were a few bag fries as expected when going to five guys. I look forward to coming back!
The staff at Meridian Smiles are so friendly and accommodating.  Dr. Howard is very thorough in his exams.

Ok, No one likes to go to the dentist "just for fun" and I am no exception.  So I dragged myself in last week, thinking it would be pretty routine, and it turned out that "need for a crown soon" turned out to be that day!  I really did not want to proceed, the thought of painfully having my mouth propped wide open while trying hard not to drool, and then biting into that squishy compound that kind of hits my gag reflex was making me feel rather anxious and unhappy.  Well, let me tell you, it stung a little with the injections... but Dr. Howard had numbed my gums first, so that was truthfully minimal... and it was done so quickly!  No goopy stuff at all, no props, no sore jaws... and my temporary was done via digital "pictures" of the tooth to be crowned!  I could have had the permanent one done in just a few minutes longer but not having planned on the crown, I was running a bit behind schedule.
