Two days later (could have been sooner but I scheduled it for a later day) it took 15 minutes for them to put in my shiny new crown!  Magic and painless, and best of all- FAST! Love it!
Dr. Howard and his staff and fun to be with, and they are state-of-the-art in Dentistry!

Was in town and was looking for something locally owned and we stumbled upon this place. Having lived with a couple Hawaiians I have been spoiled with amazing cooking from them and their families. I must say this place did not disappoint! Upon entering we were greeted and given a rundown of the menu. We ended up sharing the 3 meat plate and it was glorious. We had the loco moco(simple but amazing!), katsu chicken(a little different then I've had but was damn good with the sauce), and the Kalua pig(by far my favorite! Was super tender and fatty just how I like it). We had the Hawaiian Mac salad for the sides and had a spam musubi which is always great. I suggest hitting this place up because you will not be disappointed

This is the WORST property management place I've ever dealt with, and I've rented a lot. To start...it was an absolute nightmare just trying to get into a place. They were not helpful at all. I wouldn't have rented with them if it weren't for me needing a place ASAP. Then while living there my bathtub faucet broke and their "maintain" person had no idea where the main water shutoff was.  he even told the plumber to just shut off the complex's water completely to fix it...pretty sure that's not legal. But overall TERRIBLE experience. DO NOT RENT FROM THEM!

Apparently, Kroger believes that in order to COMPETE with WalMart, one must BECOME WalMart. After being in my TOP 5 Fred Meyer stores for years, I sadly have to admit that this place has been on the slow decline ever since Kroger took over Fred Meyer like a decade ago. Although some other Fred Meyer stores have not sunk the way the Meridian store has, so perhaps it has more to do with the local labor pool, but I don't think so. There seems to be a real disconnect between management, and well, everyone else. The guy ahead of me in line yesterday bought an $800 gazebo (the one currently displayed) only to find out it was out of stock. Apparently, there was nothing to indicate it was out of stock when he brought the slip for the cashier to scan to the register, and I even heard the lady on the phone that the cashier was using to track down the item for the customer laugh as she let him know it was out of stock, and seemingly offered no further help. The cashier apologized profusely, but no manager came to offer to call other local stores to find the item for the customer, or even to sell him the display unit. The guy had groceries too, he was trying to spend upwards of a thousand dollars in the sore, and management was just too busy to care. I could tell the cashier was cringing, sweating bullets. Management did NOT care. I come to this store occasionally to buy batteries since the little coupon printer always gives me a great deal on Duracell's, but now I guess I may as well get those on Amazon/Walmart like everything else. I feel really bad for the employees, which in years passed seemed somewhat positive, but now mostly look as suicidaly depressed as your average Target worker. Sad.

We have these for a quick lunch at the village they were tasty and reasonable. The only downside is they don't offer regular water. I think that that needs to be resolved but the tacos were tasty and delicious.

Great folks and great food! I have relied on KAK to help with local lunches and they have never failed to provide great food, reasonable prices and excellent service. When my lack of planning has become their emergency, they have stepped up admirably each and every time.
The food was good and the service was very good. We got delivery and it was ready in a timely manner and packaged really thoughtfully.

Great receptionist's, feels super friendly and professional. Love the interior design. As of the chiropractor care and overall well being, I can't say enough positive things so far. Great care, personalized insight, I felt heard, wasn't rushed through and walked out feeling great and with a plan. Can't wait to keep going and see what improvements I can make to my sports performance and overall optimal well being.

I'll go in order of my impressions. 
What is with the masked wrestler theme? Honestly, I'm curious. 
We were greeted with friendly service. The menu was not like any other burrito place, unique or strange and no burrito jumped out at me, so I chose a salad and stuck to my diet. 
Our table wasn't washed down, so minus a star for that. They weren't busy so seemed like that could have easily been taken care of. 
I overheard a customer walking in ask for hand sanitizer after he touched the door and the girl at the counter said everywhere is sold out so they don't provide it anymore. That no one can get it. Well just FYI, Costco sells it by the gallon and I've seen on shelves everywhere.
The food was average. My salad was fine, I was impressed by the generous amount of meat on the salad. However it lacked a little flavor. Maybe more pico or a salsa, maybe black beans. It was basically steak, rice, lettuce and dressing. Fresh, just lacked something. 
My husbands burrito was also average. He got the carne asada, it lacked a little flavor. The husband enjoyed the chips and queso. 
It was solidly average, didn't love or dislike anything.

We really like this place it has speedy service, take care of issues right away and great food. Juan the manager helped us with an issue with our card and we're very happy with the overall experience. Definitely recommend this place especially after hours at night we go there quite a bit and the service is cool.
On time, did the job as promised for the estimated amount. He even tried to pair the garage door with my car. It didn't hold though. Happy customer.

Favorite place to hang out with friends and have fun. I especially like the food even tho usually bars don't have the best gourmet food. Drinks are reasonably priced and they often have specials on weekends and holidays.

Have never been a big donut fan ... Ooooooh my GOSH Duck Donuts has changed my mind and is now my ONLY go to donut place!! 

I chose the Raspberry Fluff & Coconut Island Bliss...   Yummy warm & delicious CAKE donuts with the perfect combo of toppings!!!!!!  The fact that it's best to use a utensil is perfect for me ... especially to scoop up drizzle remnants before they dry on the box.   If you are brave enough to eat with your hands be sure to pick up the wet wipes they offer ... you'll need SEVERAL.  Can't wait to try other flavors!!

The fact that they are "made to order" AND have non-traditional donut shop hours is seriously EPIC... means I will never need to feel rushed whether it's for breakfast or an after meal dessert!!

Had high hopes for Calle 75 but was quickly and continuously disappointed.  Off the bat they got our order wrong.  We finally got it changed to 4 breakfast tacos and queso fundido.  However once we received our order we received 4 "standard" tacos and queso fundido.  

1.  While tasting the queso I experienced a first, gritty queso.  I don't know what was in it but it wasn't cheese.  Maybe they broke the sauce, who knows. 
2.  Other than the tacos being incorrect they were also mediocre at best.  The carnitas were incredibly wet, too wet, soaked actually and bland.  Brisket was dry and flavorless.  The carne asada was just average.

Good prices, poor service, and bad food.  First visit will be our last.

They wouldn't sell me a single bundt cake only a 4 pack or a gift pack although I watched them sell the man at the counter a 4 pack plus one more. They are trying to upsell you. You have to pre order although they have a display case full of singles.

Amy and Dave are AMAZING!!!  Took their time to explain the process.  Quickly responded whenever we reached out with questions.  Top notch Customer Service!  We are about to refinance our current loan with them (thanks for the Anniversary card Dave!) and very happy with the ease of the process.  We have several family members moving to Idaho and they will all be referred to Academy Mortgage!

Never had rice I couldn't eat!
What the... 
Like actual DAY OLD rice  
It was like there were a bunch of little rocks in. 
Worst part is that it infiltrated the meat and sides so there was a rock surprise in some bites. 
I need a trip to the dentist  
UNREAL

Was super excited to try a new place for us and we were starving for tacos. The Carnitas tacos were amazingly delicious, tender and juicy, though the brisket tacos were very dry and needed allot of salsa! Also, when we arrived our waitress informed us we were just in time for happy hour and mentioned a few good things. We ordered them, then half way through our drinks and meal, she told us that nothing we ordered was on happy hour except $1 off chips....Later we noticed that the carnitas tacos we ordered were on the happy hour menu, though we were billed full price.
Extremely friendly service. Excellent value for the price. Definitely recommend. The lady taking my order made me feel welcome and was very nice. I will be back soon.

Five star rating from a down to earth guy. Reason: no high pressure sales people, but those who merely go the extra mile to help and answer your questions. 

My wife and I have been in here a few times, but yesterday we were on a mission to buy grown up cooking knives. Chef knives specifically. Matt stopped by as we were looking over their selection and proceeded to answer our questions and allow us a personal demonstration to choose the knives that fit us personally.  We were given many options with varying prices to try out, but the decision was left to us.

I'd say their pricing may be a tad higher than other places, but I think they are competitive on most, and the personal attention is definitely a plus in my book, and worth the price if you walk away with a decision well made.
I brought my Harley Davidson here few months ago to have it serviced and they did an exceptional job taking care of both me and my bike. Highly recommended!

Bizarre  concept but apparently it works.
The service is super friendly & accommodating.
I tried a local micro brew which was good.
The gelato is not made in house but appeared legit. Really varied menu. 
Out door seating & good tunes make for a cool spot to hang out on an afternoon or for happy our w friends.

Everyone here has been very nice and helpful! I lost a filling when I was flossing and while it was expensive, they made it a positive experience. I had to go back to have them adjust my bite and the dr wanted to make sure everything was perfect. If I stay in the area I will definitely be back for the friendly service!

I was super excited to try this place since I am Gluten free and havent had donuts in years!  First let me start by saying the service was absolutely wonderful. The fact that they are even open during these times,  take orders and payments by phone,  even willing to bring our order out to the car when we arrived was a huge plus. We tried the mudslide, chocolate overload,  chocolate raspberry,  and cookies and creme flavors. All of the flavors were great,  and I absolutely loved the texture. Honestly to me they were more of a moist,  dense cake then your typical donut consistancy but it was a nice surprise and would have been really decadent if it weren't for the horrible chemichal-like after taste of sweetner alternative. It was so bad and so dissapointing we could not have more than a couple of small bites of any of the flavors we bought. I truly am hoping this review is seen and used as constructive criticism because overall we really loved the idea and would absolutely be willing to try it out again if they began offering options with other  sugar alternatives. There are many like honey,  pure maple syrup,  date syrup,  agave,  coconut sugar,  the list goes on,  that do not have the awful after taste that ruined an otherwise great donut.

Loved it! We are from out of town & this place was excellent. Super friendly staff & beautiful place to relax. I loved my iced almond milk latte & my husband loved his vanilla latte (his usual- says that this one was especially flavorful). Highly recommend!
Just went today for the first time. Incredible food and smoothies. I got a wrap that was amazing. Service was friendly and fast, and the prices aren't too high. I highly recommend it.
So good! Friendly staff. I got pineapple (tastes like a dole whip). The cotton candy/pomegranate & raspberry mix was great! We will go back!

Sales and design center employees are amazing. After that the process has been horrible!! They didn't like someone with knowledge pointing out the crappy build so they have decided to lock us out and not allow us back into the home that I asked to build.I posted a fraction of pictures of the drywall that they have ignored the issues. If you want a quality home built, stay away from Coleman!!!

Our favorite sandwich shop! Everything is always done perfect. Our sandwiches are made just the way we order them. The new chipotle mayo is awesome and makes your sandwich taste better then any other sandwich out there. If you are wanting a great sandwich where they cut everything themselves (yes the meat too) this is your place!

What a special treat made extra special by the sweet crew at Cold Stone Creamery on Eagle and Fairview! Thank you so much for your kind gesture.  I've always had such a great experience at this location, and ordering ahead on the phone has been a breeze. Almost no wait time, skip the line and it's ready at the pickup counter.
We applied for a house yesterday or the day before. We have called the office and sent emails and have heard nothing back. Disappointing

This local biz is located in the same parking lot of Fred Meyer and was recommended to me by an awesome Elite who picked up these awesome pupusas right before we met and I just had to swing by and get some for myself!! 
I tried the revuelta (cheese, bean, pork), chicharron (pork and cheese),  Loroco (cheese and herbs), and the Friijo con queso (bean and cheese). 
My favorite of the bunch were either the Revuelta or the Frijo Con queso - the beans really add a great texture and balance! 
It's all made to order but I also had a couple left over that I saved and ate just a couple hours later and it's maybe better cold/ room temperature. The leftovers really hit a nostalgic spot on my stomach- it's like an upgraded version of the quesadillas that i'd pack for lunch. 
If you haven't tried pupusas before, this is the spot to get some!

The receptionist was exceptional but their policy sucked. I rented the unit based on their measurement. Afterward, I got my non-working car towed there for storage. When we tried to push it in, the unit was too small. Their policy is not to refund money so we were out that plus we had to get the car towed elsewhere and rent a whole other unit from another facility! I would not go by their advertised measurements and be sure you don't change your mind if you give them money. You will lose it and be stuck like we were.
Great place and thank you for taking masking seriously, we appreciate you!

I can't say enough good things about Will and Action Garage Door!  They have helped us fix multiple doors at our primary home and rental.  We receive great service every time.  We won't go anywhere else.  Thanks Will!!

I love that they are local so that's why I go. Everyone is very friendly, service is fast, and location is OPEN. Why are places still closed? Good grief. WiFi seems solid enough for free and I love the atmosphere. So that's the good. The ok is the coffee and breakfast. I've had sandwiches, burritos, al overpriced for what they are. Reheated and made way before. Not that flavorful and nothing more than what you'd get as a gas station. I typically now go for packaged oatmeal. Coffee just isn't my favorite. It's pretty bitter and I get mocahs. I'll go every now and then cause thankful they are open during COVID and local. Just wish they were better.

Gelato + martini? Yes please!

This is my go to spot to grab a drink and now that I've tried several food options from the menu I'm hooked on eating every time I'm there as well.  The menu is VERY diverse so there's something for everyone.  The gelato is exceptional!  

My favorite thing about this spot is the exceptional customer service.  The owner is there nearly every night preparing food and drinks...  His homemade soups are delish!  All of his employees have been friendly, helpful, and well trained.  

My faves from the menu... Peanut butter martini, the Italian hero sandwich, the California turkey sandwich, the soups, and of course the sushi rolls (I like mine with rice paper).  If you haven't been you need to try it!

I am going to leave this review based on the fact that a frequent question yelp asks is this place good for groups? I am going to say that Gramercy Park is not good for groups since they refuse to take reservations for large groups. I tried to call to make a reservation for 15 people they said we don't do reservations. I explained we are a large group; how are you going to seat us if we just walk in? We could end up waiting an hour or more; he didn't care. This is extremely frustrating I just feel like business such as Gramercy care nothing for large groups it comes across as very arrogant to say "we don't need your business we are good". Definitely taking our business elsewhere.
If you are trying to find a restaurant for your next group outing large or small this is not the spot.

Yum yum yum! Had my first Bundt cake and it was fantastic! Had the lemon cake....amazing. I bought my hubby the pecan praline and while the cake was light and fluffy, the flavor of the pecan praline wasn't strong enough. Loved my lemon!

The Good: Nice sports bar, super clean and modern. They have booths with private tvs and good visibility of the larger big screens. They make their own potato chips.  

The Bad: I ate with a party of 11 and everyone was unimpressed at best by their food. I however, had the worst pizza I have ever had. I felt like I should have a given my server a medal. The menu advertises brick oven pizza. It's a Cysco Brand frozen pizza with extra cheese. Also, I am pretty sure mine was microwaved and I am 100% sure it was not cooked in a brick oven. When I complained the server just took my pizza and still charged us for the pizza I had taken one slice from. This is a restaurant being run by people with money but no experience in the food business. 

Conclusion: If you want a place to drink and watch the game, go right ahead. If you want to eat something, you might want to consider packing a lunch.

Great place to stop passing thru Boise - east off and on I-84
Great coffee and super nice staff!!

*Beware* 1st visit roughly 200$, 2nd visit 100$ They will not discuss prices with you or run your insurance until 3rd session which at that time your bill will be close to 400$. They told me the reason for this was that they wanted to see what kind of 'treatment plan' would be needed. I was assured by the receptionist though, that this amount would take care of my deductible and from there out would be no further out of pocket expense for me. What a relief(eye roll). I'm not a special case and had no major concerns.  I asked why the bill was so high and was told the first visit was so high because of all the testing. I was present for that first visit, and they simply asked me about my lifestyle and had me stand on one foot and hold a small device which accessed my sense of balance. Oh, and this part was conducted by, as she informed me, just the daughter of the massage therapist. After said tests were done Mr Allen came and retrieved me from the room and took me straight to the adjustment area and adjusted my back and that was it, maybe 7-8mins with him. 2nd visit was just an adjustment which was even faster this time 5mins tops then he had me lay on a table with a roller that went up and down my spine for a 10-15mins. I will not be seeing them again. I'd advise you to shop around.
I would definitely recommend Dr. Payne. He is very good with children and very professional.

My family and I were very excited to try the broken yolk cafe, and unfortunately I will not be back. We did get seated quickly, but once we got seated and our waitress came to take our drink order my husband saw that they had espresso on the menu so he asked for an americano (which is 2 shots of espresso and hot water) and the waitress looked completely clueless to what that was.. She said "we don't have that here we only have lattes".... I think she was confused so we just ordered drip coffee, and a latte then she comes back 15 minutes later and tells us "actually our espresso machine just broke" we came for breakfast and coffee.. And I understand things happen but for a place that's supposed to provide something like coffee in a breakfast establishment it was weird. So then we ordered food and we all said "if this food is great then it'll make up for everything else" food was good, not great. Our hash browns were VERY over salted and the potatoes didn't feel like they were fully cooked through. Over all not the best breakfast/brunch place and won't be back.

We've tried multiple coffee spots on this trip & this by far is my favorite. Their latte is good, their spiced chai with oat milk is great & not watered down & their cold brew is very very good !  Best cold brew I've had thus far. Cute little spot as well!

IF I COULD GIVE 0 STARTS I WOULD!

 NEVER EVER RENT FROM THE HOME RIVER GROUP 

Yesterday I got a bill from them for the unit I rented with and $1,100 charge AFTER they took my security deposit....

Charged me for:
- Carpet cleaning 
- Carpet Treatment 
- Replacing the carpet in the ENTIRE unit

Here's what's bullshit:
- I hired someone in flooring and PAID him to fix any and all damages on the carpet. It was just the normal wear and tear on the carpet (normal wear and tear is NOT my responsibility to pay for but I did anyway) I can also have them vouche for me that the carpet IN NO WAY needed to be replaced! 

- I was charged for carpet cleaning and carpet treatment... If the carpet was replaced, it should NOT need to be treated and deep cleaned because the carpet would be brand new...! So now I'm thinking they didn't even replace it! AND I pay upfront for carpet cleaning, so why am I paying for it AGAIN??

- they charged me $200 for cleaning! THATS THEIR RESPONSIBILITY! I left that home SPOTLESS and did my due diligence on everything that was my responsibility to take care of...

- Whenever I needed maintenance on my property they refused to send me anyone so I had to pay for all the damages from the renters before me out of MY OWN pocket, and when I moved in, the unit was TRASHED! Moldy food in the sink, broken faucets, dirty walls and floors, stained carpet, broken panels on the staircase, etc... I PAID to fix all these issues because they wouldn't send me someone to fix them... 

NEVER RENT FROM THIS MANAGEMENT GROUP

I will definitely be fighting these charges
Used to Love this place. Then they sold out to Jackson's. The new manager says "Nothing is going to change!". Not true they immediately raised the price of the Rhino Rush and moved stuff around.

Don't order to go!
They forgot the sides and the drinks for two kids meals. I called and no answer.  Left a VM and no return call. Thanks for wasting my money.

I was very disappointed with the customer service.  I waited in line for 35 minutes and there were still 6 people in front of me that hadn't been helped when I left the store.  There was one guy working with customers and a second who was more interested in doing store chores than helping customers.
Delicious. Went to Gramercy for the first time recently and my friend recommended the Mac and cheese. I LOVED every bite. Will definitely be back.

Have to write this review because I have major concerns with Molly Maid of Boise. I was a long time customer of their service and was very happy with the service and staff.  This was until they had an internal issue that I was inadvertently caught up in.  

Seems they had a staff member who was going out on their own , leaving the company to start their own business and while this individual did not solicit me directly, they asked if I knew of anyone that needed service who wasn't a customer of Molly Maid which I might refer.  I accepted their card and wished them the best in their new adventure expressing that I was going to continue with Molly Maid... This was until I found that the staff members who replaced them actually went into my office drawer to take a photo of the card that the (ex) employee provided if I had any referral.

I was incensed !  I contacted Molly Maid of Boise demanding a reason why their employees would go through (assumed) private areas to take a photo of my personal property to be used in their internal issues and I was assured that the photo was taken at another customers location not mine... Like that makes a difference!?!?!  They are clearly enabling their employees to look through their customers belongings...

So when I exposed this I got the standard apologies and such but we parted ways and left it at that.. 

Till I actually saw the photo taken of the property, it was taken on the perfectly matched granite countertops that I had just gotten installed.. They lied to me yet a second time...It wasn't my house?  Yes actually it was....

To add insult to injury, I was recently contacted by them asking for a final balance.. Apparently there were two cleans one (6) months ago and the last, that were still open on their books, I replied saying , are you serious?  After what you have have (acknowledging through emails that I have WELL documented)  done violating my privacy, apologizing for. You are going to ask for the last payment months later to clear your books?  Well these folks cashed the check...

I cannot recommend this service if you value your personal privacy, the sanctity of your home or the trust of having these contractors not identify or document your personal material for their own use...

So many reasons to give this hotel a meh rating. First, the male at the check-in desk was condescending and daft. Then, we got to the room and their were only two towels and no coffee. Then, they said the hot tub was broken and we were on the 3rd floor. So, for ice we had to go to the first floor to get it. Also paper thin walls. The worst of Marriott experiences I've had. This hotel cuts corners and doesn't make their guests feel welcome.

The houses are nice, but they are extremely difficult when it comes to warranty work.  My sense is that they try to stall as much as possible, hoping to go beyond the warranty period.  The communication during the process is abysmal - they put contractors directly in contact with you, and you're left dealing with 10 different people.  There's no accountability - everything is the contractor's fault.  Sorry, Coleman, I bought the home from you, and I want it fixed.  If you choose to build in an economic climate where contractors are hard to come by, then you should have remediation plans when the contractor becomes the problem, rather than just passing the problem onto your customers.

The contractors on warranty work and pre-build finish work (such as countertops) appear to have no oversight or review.  Be prepared to spend a lot of time looking for mistakes, then prepare to spend more time managing the jobs to fix it yourself.

Continued requests for contacts to escalate the issue go ignored.  When they finally reply, it's apparently someone who is just paid to listen to you gripe, but can't actually do anything to help the problem. 

Once they have your money, they no longer care about you.

EDIT 6/14/2019:

After talking to several people at Coleman, all I've really received was a lot of blaming the vendors for this issue.  They've insisted they want to "make this right" and have made commitments to better communication that have gone unfulfilled.  Nothing has been done to improve this situation, and I still don't have a new door.

The response from Coleman here refers to the issue as "cosmetic".  I believe this in hopes that readers will interpret this as me somehow being nitpicky about this issue, but make no mistake: my front door is defective. The very first person who came to look at the issue (I think it's been 9 months now) immediately told us that it needed to be replaced.

First foray to this "Pizza and Grill" (which may be more aptly named "Grill, Bar and Pizza" for apparent focus)  surpassed our (low) expectations based on other Yelp reviews to deposit us at AOK.  Which means we'd go back for another try given the...

...friendly service (by an over stretched server given but one to cover all tables), 
...better than expected eats and a more creative than anticipated menu, 
...creative cocktails (even if it was too early in the day  to try out that Cardamom gin drink that was calling our names),
...a variety of seating options from standard height tables, to booths, to high seating at the bar to patio seating (even if it is as hot as Hades right now) and
...reasonable prices (two people for lunch with takeaway for dinner under twenty bucks). 

The cook in the open  kitchen said "thanks for coming in today" as we left.  I'd like to see this place be successful.  It seems on the cusp of "four-ish" with a little more finesse and spit n polish.

MENU & FOOD
Pizza purists will may be disappointed here but if you're up for adventure in very thin crist pizza (today's special featured a housemade blueberry barbecue sauce and a wealth of fresh veggies with lots of - maybe too much - cheese) or looking for other food and beverage options out of the norm (buffalo wing-styled cauliflower spears) or even choices inside the norm (those aforementioned burgers and fries), this place is worth a try to see if it fits for you. 

The menu is tilted to carnivores but a a person leaning vegetarian can enjoy  good options too.  As example, the "spesh pizza" today included shredded chicken and was easily made veggie by leaving that off.

We also tried 'vegi wings' from cauliflower made buffalo-style.  I love cauliflower but found this just OK.  My hubby, on the other hand, brought home the leftovers to reheat.  (Note:  What makes them crunchy is a cornmeal coating.)

The house salad that came with our pizza had  greens that were were crisp and tender at the same time in a nice mix of lettuces along with fresh eggs, tomatoes and cold, crumbled bacon.  I could order this as a standalone meal (sans the bacon next time now that I know) and be a happy diner.

Here are some tips:
1.) If you order the Thai peanut dressing (you should), ask for extra lemon or lime.  Good on its' own.  Would be better with that add.
2.) If we ordered pizza again we'd order it left in the oven for a couple more minutes.
3.) The personal size pizza which is cut in four slices easily feed two lighter eaters or be shared by four as a bar snack.

LIBATIONS
Several beers, several wines by the glass that were interesting mid range choices in both reds and whites (about $6 - $10 glass), specialty cocktail list included maybe ten house specials and seemed well priced at about $10 each.

SERVICE
No greeting at entry and it took a bit for our server to make it to our table but it was understandable given that although it was going on 2:00 the place was jumping,with new folks coming in as others left, and she was not only waiting tables but manning the bar.   Friendly and efficient.  But short staffed with her alone for the entire place.  

VIBE & SEATING
More bar and grill than pizza parlor, so if you're looking for the latter, a forewarning.  TVs on each end of the high bar which opens to the dining room with open kitchen on the other side.  "Step up" booths (think Dish) down the middle of the room seat about 16.  Another booth is right next to the bar.  There are also standard height tables and chairs in the space.

HAPPY HOUR
Monday through Saturday for a couple of hours (maybe 4 - 6) they offer half off on well drinks and a discount on some beer and wine.

THIS N THAT

1)  LOCATION:  Meridian is awash in a bunch of sort of tacky, poorly laid out strip mall like places.  This is in one of those locations but not as bad as some others.

2) PARKING:  Private lot has a good amount of spaces, but not enough for evening hours.

3) ACCESSIBILITY:  Accessible parking in the lot.  Level in and throughout.  Standard height seating options.  One booth adjacent to the bar may be low enough for people using wheelchairs. 

4) NEIGHBORS:  Fat Guy's Deli next door.

This is an update to my previous review.

This is the most underrated shop in the Valley.

Meghan has some of the best fade skills - hands down. She is extremely thorough and does not stand for mediocracy. You will leave her chair looking good, whether you want to or not. 

This is coming from a 16 year Army/Air Force military member. 

Also - Desert Fox prices can't be beat.

My partner and I called TownePlace Suites home during the Thanksgiving Holiday this year as we explored hot springs in the surrounding area. I'm so happy we chose to stay here as it met our needs perfectly.

We enjoyed a complimentary full breakfast each morning, plus a convenient kitchenette with a stove, refrigerator, microwave and cabinets stocked with pots and pans and everything you'd need to prepare and enjoy a meal. In addition, the pool and hot tub stay open until 11 pm each night.

My favorite feature of our room (King Studio Suite) was the ample storage space throughout the room. The office area has plenty of drawers and cabinets, as does the kitchen. But the best feature is the massive closet between the kitchen and bathroom with multiple points of entry. There is space to store luggage, dirty clothes, shopping bags and anything else you'd like to stash so as not to clutter the room.

This hotel was a great value, offering mid-range accommodations with lots of convenient features.

Additional Notes:

1. If you are staying on the first floor, keep in mind that it smells strongly of chlorine due to the proximity to the swimming pool.

2. There are only two rolling carts for wheeling luggage to your room. Hopefully you'll be able to snag one of them in the lobby before someone else. Please be kind and return it when you're done so it doesn't go MIA.

3. This may be petty, but the hotel sure skimped on the artwork throughout the hallways. Every hallway is lined with the same red, abstract illustration of a labyrinth. The prints are tiled, one after another, down the length of each hallway. It's mildly amusing.

Meghan made the visit worthwhile. She helped us put together some food that fit within some difficult allergy restrictions. She was thoughtful and patient. The food was good too! Nice place to go for lunch by the water fountain.

Had the carne assassin burrito yesterday, although it had good flavor, the size wasn't that BIG. Maybe I got the wrong size, maybe I didnt. For the price I expected bigger! Local vendors beat them hands down for size/price point. I won't go back.

The service man that showed up at my door clearly did not want to do his job that day. Since I was using a Groupon he wanted to make sure I knew all of the up charges he was going to charge to do my house including a charge for using his own ladder and the charge for every time ($5) he has to move it with a minimum charge of $15... then there was the bit about if he doesn't do the top windows he won't do the bottom because they only do a whole wall or none of the wall. Before all the extra charges for the ladder were added it was going to be $360 to do my 2400 square foot 2 story house. I said okay, how about you clean what you'll clean and let me know what I owe you when your done. This man was not wearing a mask, he was crunching on peanuts, he was condescending and before you knew it, he was gone before he started. He said, "you know, I'm not going to make you happy so I'm out. Get a refund on your Groupon." This was after waiting a month for him to arrive in the first place. The only reason I'm giving 2 stars is because the manager tried his best to get him to go back and do his job, but the man refused even his boss. The manager apologized and said sorry but we can't get anyone back out to do your job for another month. No thank you! After reading other reviewers with this same experience I'm going to say stay away!
Cashier touches money and food - NOT OKAY!! Two of the three burritos we ordered were missing the bacon they were supposed to.

Did a take out order and it will definitely be my last. The food quality was very poor and we didn't even eat a 1/4 of it. I could get better cooking in a high school cafeteria. Very disappointed for the money we spent. I won't be back!!!

Strange hot dog bun drenched in Mustard was so messy I had to throw it away before it messed up my clothes.  Burger had zero flavor & was so thin you need 3 patty's to make it a burger.   They left out napkins & straws after asking twice.  Frys are ok.

Horrible service. Wouldnt cash a $300 check from Chase, let me point out, because of my name on my ID was slightly different. Didn't even try to use common sense. That's why I use Idaho CU, out of state banks are ridiculous.

Bought a brand new bike two months ago and it is STILL not finished. I've been lied to about parts being there that aren't, I was sold a tuner that doesn't even work with my motor - at High Deserts suggestion. WORST experience buying ANY vehicle ever. STAY AWAY!

Left a bad taste in my mouth (figuratively) and my kids mouths (literally).

Their policy of surreptitiously adding a 3.99% fee for using a credit card is a slap in the customer's face after they've just charged you up to $26 for dozen donuts.

When they ring you up and tell you the total (and you see the total w/ tax on the screen), THEN you see this additional "fee" only on the printed receipt.

When confronted they pointed me to a tiny 3x4" placard with fine print saying something about "use cash and get a discount" (when that really means "use cash and get the quoted price, and we'll charge you an extra fee if you use a digital form of payment"). Discount, my booty.

Not sure if they understand how business works, but when you can get upwards of $3-4 per donut (keep in mind the donuts are about 2/3 the size of a typical donut you get anywhere else), it takes some audacity to make the customer also pay your processing fees (otherwise known as "cost of doing business.")

I remember reading a news article about a restaurant in NYC that pulled this stunt and they got shredded in the news and on social media. Perhaps nobody else has ever noticed that Fit Donut is doing that, or they're just too low-profile.

I'll likely dispute the additional fee with my credit card company.

I liked the donuts OK, and I was pleased with the very low sugar content. The kids really didn't, none of them could get through one.
I was hesitant to come into a chiropractor for my back but I am very glad I did. Pain relief chiropractic was gentle yet firm, and I felt so much better for hours afterward.
I've been having this pizza since I was a little kid and I still think it's some of the best in Idaho. Now that I've moved away I always make sure we get some whenever we are in town.

Whittney was an amazing loan officer. I think "above and beyond" is a phrase often over-used in the business world, but Whittney truly exceeded expectations on multiple occasions. Not only was she incredibly responsive, replying to texts and e-mails nearly instantly, but she was always pleasant, patient, and asking if there was anything else she could do to help. She provided amazing service from start to finish. We will definitely be going back to Whittney with any future mortgage needs.

Great service. Fast and friendly service. As soon as you sit down they bring you chips salsa with refried beans. Then ask you what you want to drink. The portion size is large. I judge a Mexican restaurant by their rice here is really good. The spicy jalapeño margarita was excellent. The environment is nice and they abide by all Covid restrictions. Prices are good. I know everyone loves Enríquez out and Kuna but this can stand up to Enríquez without the long drive.

This is a cute place with a number of inventive smoothie and bowl combinations that I haven't seen at other places in town.  I didn't yet try their pressed juices, as I usually like something more substantial, but they had a number of options for those as well.   The smoothie creations were especially fun with flavors like lavender, pumpkin pie, and maple matcha.  
We ordered an "everything toast", a maple matcha smoothie, and a "Rocky Mountain" açaí bowl.  The everything toast was entirely underwhelming.  If you're going to call something "everything", the quantity of ingredients on the toast should reflect that.  The toast had maybe a quarter of an avocado, two slices of tomato, and some seasoning. Don't waste your time with this.

The maple matcha smoothie was very delicious.  Nothing like we'd had before at other smoothie shops in town.  Not too sweet, and a mild matcha flavor-- not grossly "grassy" flavored like a lot of matcha products are.  The portion of the açaí bowl was very generous, the toppings tasted fresh, and the granola in the bowl was tasty.  The açaí mix itself though was nearly flavorless-- I tried to eat it by itself and couldn't really taste anything.  This wasn't a huge deal though, as everything mixed together tasted pretty good.

The employees are extremely friendly and helpful and were very helpful when we asked them questions about the menu.  In the future, I'll probably come back to try their other fun smoothie flavors and a juice, but probably not the açaí bowl and definitely not the toast.
Have eaten there several times now and the food is consistently super fresh and prepared quickly. Delicious! One of my new favorite restaurants!
A better quality establishment of fast food burgers compared to other large non speciality chains. Docked a star because of the cleanliness.

The food was good but the service was terrible. The kid taking our order missed half of what we ordered and we had to repeat the order three times, and then place a second order when I realized he left off half of my husbands order. When he served it up and called our number I stood there waiting for the rest of our order: he forgot our orders of chips & guacamole and chips & salsa and was just standing there prepping, and when I reminded him, he tried to give me only one bag of chips - until I reminded him that it was two orders of chips +. He tried to keep one hand gloved and one hand ungloved to take orders and receipt money (not sanitary-- should have taken both gloves off to handle the computer and money and regloved after). The guy cooking up the food was great and kept the place running but the kid at the front made the experience annoying for his lack of customer service and general lack of wherewithal.

So this location underwent an update recently. It's a popular location that's close to freeway traffic and busy local roads so not surprised they needed the update with the massive traffic they must get daily. 

It's beautiful inside and lots of comfortable seating in the lobby. But I'm impressed with part of their kiosk ordering system. I've seen this available at other locations but this is the first that allows you to just grab your own cup after ordering. Now you don't have to wait for a counter person to be free. You don't go thru the awkward explanation of how you ordered but need a cup. You just grab the cup and fill up at the self serve beverage station. Very nice!

My husband and I ate here on a Sunday night. The location is excellent-very scenic in the village, but the food was terrible. I got the fish tacos and side of Spanish rice and my husband got the pork tacos. They were quite small and lacked flavor. The rice was gross, two bites was all I could muster. With a soda and water, our meal totaled $24-which was way overpriced for the mediocre meal we received. Very disappointing! We will not be back.

Okay, I legit wanted to love this place...but after stopping in last Friday night there were too many misses to give it higher than 2 stars. :( 

I love the energy, seating & the casual style of the wait staff. The menu has a ton of great options. I was torn between a buffalo blue cheese chicken sandwich, and the mac & cheese sandy. Ended up with the chicken sandy - and if Buffalo & Bleu Cheese is your jam ORDER THIS! It was tasty! 

Here's where it gets bad... Our server, Sammy was cool! We were totally on a vibe with her, and it was going awesome. Until she kept walking over to our table and shaking our beers, to see how much we had drank so far...Then out of the blue, before even asking us...she brought us 2 more Rainiers. Popped open the cans and winked as she walked away. ...I had to drive to an event later, and I did NOT ask for the second beer. I didn't want it. It was such a weird gesture. I've never had a waitress do that before. 

Secondly, I asked for sweet potato fries, and I ended up getting regular fries. Boo. Lastly, the person I was with ordered fish & chips, and it came with no lemon. I know this is a minor edit, but come on. 

As we sat looking at our unwanted second beers, we thought maybe they were "on the house" and she was having fun and being kind. NOPE. charged for both. It was just such a weird experience being served and having to pay for something we didn't ask for. Ugh. 

Sad that I left this meal feeling unhappy. :(
My wife and I adore the veggie rolls and get them all the time. Sweetened tofu, avocado, cucumber... Simple and delicious!

For some reason when I order my coffee at this location, it tastes  too sweet and it's dark roasted. 
Our order has been messed up a few times, and it only has happened at this location. It seems like the app orders run behind, which should be the opposite. 
We pick up our orders at this location because it's on the way to take the freeway, but other than that, we avoid it. 
There's room for improvement and growth, and they should take advantage on this location.
The wings were dry and the fries were way over seasoned. Save yourself the time and go to buffalo wild wings.

Boris Shmukler is talented Artist. I sent him my drawing of citrine gold ring I wanted and he helped to buy a beautiful, nice clarity 14c citrine and did computer 3D design. After approval, in a week I got my ring. He did perfect job, exactly what I wanted. Definitely will be back.  I highly recommend Boris!
My wife and I love Gandolfo's. We are so excited that they are now in Meridian! I had the Polo Grounds breakfast sandwich and it was delicious. Highly recommend.

I have lived here for nearly 5 years, and hope to spend many more years here.  The location is ideal in Meridian, near walking distance to parks, entertainment, shopping, and more.  The apartments are great and very well maintained; as are the grounds and the many amenities.  The staff is very friendly and if there is a maintenance request submitted, it is taken care of very quickly and efficiently.  A great place to live.

This is a complaint about their ordering to pick up system. The reason you order before you get there is so that it saves you time and it's ready when you get there. Not at five guys you're at the end of the line by the time you get there waiting for fries, even when the have fries available. They put you at the back of the line. (Burger is made and getting soggy) while you wait. You would be better off to order when you get there.

My son needed a helmet and a few other things because he just bought a new bike. I looked and unfortunately there are not a lot of places in the area that sell gear. I read the reviews and was dreading going in but like I said, there really wasn't any other option. When we showed up I was surprised, the people there couldn't have been friendlier or more helpful. There was no pressure at all. They stressed their hassle free return/exchange policy which was nice to know and left us alone when we just wanted to browse. I am not sure how the other reviewers could have been that unhappy. Honestly these people were some of the most courteous people I've dealt with since we moved here.
I would definitely ignore all the negative reviews and make it a point to check them out if you need any gear.

Great Sandwiches
But I Crave...not kidding...CRAVE !!
The Red Potato Salad w/dill, also the
Macaroni Salad ( Yankee Doodle) 
Often drive by and just get salads...delicious 
Great customer service to top it off, 
always friendly and helpful.
PS. I'll add photos later...ate it all
Bomb ! Came here today with my husband and son service was friendly and the donuts are delicious we will definitely be back!!
We weren't expecting much because of the past experiences in California. However the tacos are much tastier than ever. Too bad they got rid of their monster taco.

Absolutely love this Church.  When you hear Pastor Steve's message with his analogies and humor, you walk away understanding his message completely.  I have never learned so much in any of the other Churches we have attended.  We have been with Ten Mike for about 4-5 years now.  My husband and I feel completely at home.  The classes that are offered are exceptional as well.

No Bull...Just TACOS!
There slogan says it all. I have had Taco Cow on my to do list for a while now and finally stopped in. The restaurant is easy to find and locate right on Overland Road. Inside you will find a ton of funky stuff all relating to bulls, tacos, and plenty of puns. Seating inside is limited to a couple of tables and window side stools. 
The owners offer a good selection of online/delivery options which was great to use given Covid-19. 
Speaking of selection....how about 35 taco options!! Yip...35. They have something for almost everyone. For me, I went with 4 tacos today....which leaves me with 31 to go...
I ordered the Fish Frito, Carne Asada, Kurobuta Carnitas, and KC Chief. All the tacos were served with fresh in store made tortillas which is a game changer. The restaurant also provides tasty green and red sauce....grab both!
The Carnitas was my least favorite of the four. The pork was a bit flat on flavor imo. The Carne Asada was tasty along with the guac and cheese along side it. My second favorite of the options was the fish taco. Don't let my horrible photo deter you. The very crispy coating provided a great crunch and the fish inside was not dry. The cabbage added additional crunch and flavor. Great taco.....ohh...it's huge too!!! Largest portion of the 4 by far. Last but not least, the Super Bowl Champs, KC Chief! The flavor of the meat was great! The BBQ sauce added a great twist to the taco. I highly recommend the KC!
If you are looking for some unique tacos with tasty ingredients, you will not go wrong with Taco Cow.
Cheers Always!
this location was very filthy and the garbage smelled like it hasnt been cleaned since they opened. burgers are mediocre and overpriced. fries were soggy too. overall horrible experience.
They don't wear masks at all and the waiter doesn't even try to social distance.  The food was fine,  but it's not worth being ignorant.

Delicious tacos, tons of interesting options, breakfast tacos too, which is a major PLUS.  Finally SOUTH of town has a good option for tacos!  Trust me, check this place out, your stomach will thank you.  Also, like any good taco shop, this place is easy on the wallet.  Great value and great food, what more could you want from a taco shop?  This place is a new STAPLE :)

I've overlooked this gym but always knew it was there. I finally went when I realized the 'class' type of fitness wasn't working for me because I work so much. In this phase of my life I need the 'anytime' aspect of my workout - even if I only have a half an hour. It's open, clean, not crowded and quiet- I love it.

If I could give this a less than 1 I would.  In fact it deserves a negative star rating so we'll make a -3 stars.  The food is way over priced for a burrito that matches the size or smaller than Taco Bell.  Which is really sad for a place to be focused on burritos and can't even measure up to Taco Bell.  I too, was excited to try this place and I was sadly disappointed.  They might as well just close this location and cut their losses because it is not worth it and I've already spread the word to just go to Costa Vida on Chinden or Eagle if they want something of value.  Even with it's prime location, I foresee the parking lot being completely empty for this place, unless customers for actually good restaurants need a place to park and walk across the parking lot.  Save your gas, time, and money and avoid this place completely.

As a California transplant I can say this is the best most authentic Mexican food in the treasure valley! The bean dip and salsa are amazing. The cheese enchiladas and menudo are also wonderful. Great customer service as well. Get a mechelada you won't regret it!

Food here is always solid. The service not so much. I have gone in there the last few times with 2 or 3 people working. Today it was 2, on a Friday!  So the service is super slow.  But my issue was the fries.  I got the cup and splash more, not the usual by any stretch. Mess with the fries. You are gong to get the review you deserve. Damn shame, 5 Guys you took a dip today
We randomly stumbled over this place recently when  we were at the Village- the kids loved the ice cream (even I did and I don't usually care for ice cream).

Fantastic place for a nice little snack on a hot day. Service is great and the lines are rarely long. So many options for toppings and finding out they have new flavors for ice cream bars really made my day. Bite Me is a worthy gem and were lucky to have them in the Village

Been twice now, food and service were both great! First time I had the Reuben and the second time the Wall Street club.  Both were delicious.  Side of choice was their potato salad, also very yummy, super creamy with sour cream and bacon.  Their chocolate mousse cake is to die for!! One of our new favorite places!!
Food is over priced for the amount you get and the service always leaves something to be desired. Have been there several times and the service is always lacking.

I came in to buy a pair of shoes, I got way more than hey what color do you like. Yeah the red ones are nice bro. They put you on a treadmill do an analysis of your foot gait and help you decided which shoe fits best and functions the best...strange right which shoe functions the best. Why would you want that! Beth the manager was incredibly knowledgeable and friendly and I just walked out with a new pair of great shoes. I would highly recommend going there to see what you need not what you like.
Horrible Property Management Company. They don't respond to poor and unhealthy conditions.
Antigua is gem in Meridian.  Tyler is a great barista who will make you feel at home.  Fireplace is super comfy!  Thank you!

Our family has been popping in and out of this cycle shop for the past couple years. We are not avid riders, just recreational, for fun. They've always been awesome and professional. They have the best customer service! Just popped in there because my tire that they replaced two years ago was having issues staying inflated. This is the second of three Calle 75 enterprises if one considers chronology of appearance.  First their food cart-truck, then this order at counter fast food spot inside what amounts to The Village Mall's closest thing to food court, and now the third is the recently opened Calle 75 bricks-and-mortar eatery in downtown Boise.  Inasmuch as Meridian's The Village upscale outdoor mall has a food court analog to the indoor malls, the building in which Calle 75 is located is it and they share a big open space and seating tables with RiceWorks and a coffee place.

THE DRILL:  Stand in line to order at the counter.  Find a seat and they'll call you when your order is "up".  Carry your own to your table and bus your own when done.  As expected in a food court.  

MENU:  Open for breakfast too with an option each for their versions of heuevos rancheros, breakfast taco and breakfast burrito served then and all day.  Otherwise a list of about 7 specialty burritos and tortas ($8 - $10) plus a menu of "build your own" for street tacos (2 for $6), burritos ($8) or lettuce cups ($2 for 6).  In those you have a choice of protein or veg fillings, then a "style it up" option of a package of four different adds.  For example, Baja is  cilantro garlic aioli, cabbage, pico and chipotle crema.  Rice and black beans available as ($2ish) side.  Applause for them having Bucksnort Rootbeer and Jarritos on the beverage list. 

LOCATION: I am self proclaimed as one among maybe only 16 people in the Treasure Valley who dislike The Village and avoid going there.  But if you must be there, say to pick up an off-set spatula at Sur La Table which is roughly across the street from Calle 75, its' location is convenient.  https://www.yelp.com/biz_photos/calle-75-street-tacos-meridian?select=E5Nmu17Ws9e7WRbZjuzpcg  And on a nice day when the outdoor seating is available, you can walk out the glass back doors of the building in which Calle 75 is enclosed and eat at the fountain side outdoor tables.  Plus the seating space is clean.  Which leads me to surmise that in the pantheon of food court eateries this is probably among the better ones.  But as tacos and tortas go, I wouldn't rush back for either and this wouldn't be recommended for destination eats.  

EATS:  Our Chan-Chan Torta had sautéed spinach ingredient in it and both that and the Bigwood bun on which it was served were so unpleasantly over-oily as to be inedible, literally.  We picked out the other ingredients (like carnitas, tomatillo pico, chimichurri and cojita) and tossed the rest.  (What a waste of the great Bigwood Challah dough bun which I use often in my home kitchen.)  Veggie tacos fared better, although the filling seemed only half heated.  At this point we were glad we passed on the rice and beans which we saw being carted in from a truck as we walked back to our car.

SERVICE:  Folks at counter were no more or less friendly than expected for what amounts to fast food format eatery.  But counter staff could answer our questions about the menu ingredients so good for them for that.

ACCESSIBILITY:  Level in from the sidewalk, all on one level, order counters at ADA and Idaho code compliant height, standard height seating.  

RECOMMENDATIONS:  Very good Mexican food can be found in Meridian at Mi Casa sit down, friendly full service restaurant.  Great Mexican food can be found in Boise at Andrade's which is also the same for full service.  Fantabulous street tacos can be found at Madre Boutique Taqueria in Boise which is fast-casual eat-in or take-away with great service (it can be done).   Good Tex-Mex street tacos can be found at Tin Roof in Boise.  (The Meridian location of same is still hit and miss.)
