2. I don't know why.
3. Apparently they can't take the time to call me to tell me what I can do to feel better. Which was the purpose of me seeking medical care in the first place.
I'm going to have to find another Urgent Care or wait for a primary care Doctor to see. I will not be returning to this place.

Love this place! Kahlua pig is sooo delicious and I also recommend the spam and pineapple rice, spicy Asian slaw and Mac salad. Don't forget the Hawaiian Sun in lilikoi passion flavor. Yummm this food is so good! I lived in Hawaii for several years and I'm so happy this restaurant exists in meridian! The restaurant is decorated really cute inside too and they play great Hawaiian music. Treat yourself to a quick escape and grab a plate lunch here.

I never leave reviews for grocery stores, but our experience last night made me want to be sure that management is aware to better their staff. We actually like the store, but if customer service is not top priority, I can't justify going there. Last night, we went in to get a couple items and postage stamps. Our cashier was sweet when she found out she didn't have any in her register and called for assistance from her manager. We waited a couple minutes before we offered to step to the side so she could keep checking people out. We didn't want to hold up the line anymore. Standing there, with our two small bags of groceries, looking around for any sign of a manager to come help. Well, we saw the manager (name tag said Michelle) at least 6 times walk past us or go to help other registers and never once acknowledging us. Who stands at the end of checkout with their bags for no reason?! I have always seen managers be ultra aware of making sure their customers and cashiers are taken care of. I felt terrible for our cashier who had to keep calling for help and apologize for something that wasn't even her fault. We waited for almost 10 minutes! When Michelle FINALLY showed up, she didn't apologize or acknowledge our wait which is good customer service to do. She obviously needs to work on her awareness. She helped everyone but us which makes me wonder what really was going on? Seriously. Look for people who need help at all times if you are going to manage a store. Thanks.

Perfect balance of ambiance and caffeine. 

The intimate sipping area is comfortable, and yet productive. Nice lighting and perfect temperature while surrounded by windows and the typical sights and sounds of the La Marzocco expressing the delicious nectar out of the beans cup by cup. 

The girls behind the counter were upbeat and friendly greeting vehicles at the drive up and counter quickly and professionally. 

Simple menu selection of coffee drinks, tea, sodas and the limited selection of Nam Nams (breakfast burritos, baked goods). 

Wi-Fi is available and they employee Apple Pay as an option as well. 

The location is perfect for northbound traffic on meridian rd, but a little tricky if heading south towards the highway interchange. But it is worth the effort in smiles, value and smiles.

Parking lot was full when we arrived after midnight, but I'm not going to ding them for that.  Many places have full parking lots after midnight.  The Check-in attendant lacked social skills (I think maybe we awakened him and he was groggy and not thinking properly). After I gave him my license and credit card, he looked at my picture on the driver's license and he checked us in.  While the computer was working, he commented that my hairstyle on my driver's license picture looked better than the hairstyle on my head now.  "WHAT?!"  REALLY?!?!  Then his facial expression changed as he realized what he'd said.  He "back-peddled" a little and tried to clean up his statement. I let his statement go without reproach.  I didn't "tear him a new one" nor record his name to report to a manager.  As I said, I think he was just waking up (should not have been sleeping on the job anyway), was really groggy and just said the first thing that popped into his head.  Maybe I give people the benefit of the doubt too much.   Maybe....

Anyway, the lobby was small and not particularly inviting.  The sofa and chairs did not look comfortable.  I don't know if they were because I did not sit on any of them.  The elevator was a bit small, stuck in a corner against a wall.  Because of this, we had to really maneuver our luggage to get inside it.  One good thing was the FAST elevator.  While the hallways were lit, I felt that the overhead lights were not bright enough.  Surprisingly, the room was nicer than the lobby implied it would be.  Though, the King-size Bed was big, it was not really that comfortable.  The room was a decent size, but the placement of the electrical outlets was awkward and not user-friendly.  There were none by the bed so I couldn't charge my phone by the bed.  This meant that I could not charge my phone during the night AND use it as a snooze alarm in the morning.  Because the phone was so far from the bed, I'd have to get out of the bed and walk a few steps to snooze the alarm. This defeats the purpose of a snooze alarm.  
The water at the sink and shower heated really fast.  Yeah! thank goodness for the small things.  But there was a long, blond hair in my face towel....when I unfolded it and before I was about to use it.  (YUCK!)  Hopefully, you can tell (by my pictures) that I don't have blond hair.  This made me a little bit ill and I just said a prayer for the cleanliness of the bed and other towels.  
 
The electric heater was adequate but it had no automatic shutoff or working adjustment once the desired temperature was attained.  Because it was cold, we turned it one.  So, when we started sweating, we turned it off and hoped that we would not freeze during the night. I was surprised at the temperature in Mid-June.  I didn't expect to deal with temps in the low 50's.    
Although the room did not have a microwave, we were happy that it had a refrigerator.  After check-out, we used the microwave in the lobby to warm our food.  

The older lady who checked us out was not overly helpful, but not quite rude either (at least I did not think so). She was very stoic and did not return my conversation "niceties". While I did not detect any rudeness, my male companion felt that she was rude.  Also, he saw her giving him the "evil eye" (my back was to her) while we warmed our food and ate breakfast at a nice table that was in the lobby area.  That's probably why he felt that she was rude to me earlier.      Who knows.....?  Who cares?  it's not like I'm going to be in that part of Idaho anytime soon.  We certainly will not stay here.

I've been going here for 7 years, since I moved back in 2007.  Guess that would make it more 8/9 years.  But who's counting.  Great staff.  I'm picky about my hair.  I've only ever let Katie or Audra (she's no longer there) cut it.  Katie does a great job and she's cool to chat with.  You'll like this place.

Great local beer genius to support! They bring in great flavors from surrounding breweries and have great knowledge of what pairs well with what.

Love the concept of bringing your growler back for a refill and plugging into someone's passion for good brew. 

Great prices, great service and a comfortable ambiance!

Wow, I received a personal call from Alexandra at European Wax.  She renewed my faith and confidence in the fact that European wax cares about their customers and my business. Thanks for the great wax and the service guarantee.

Came here for lunch with some work friends!  They were out of a few items on the menu due to shortages but still had good options!  We were seated promptly and service was great. I had the maple bacon burger on lettuce and it was delicious! I loved it! Their fries are delicious as well! Our table enjoyed and ate everything. This is a great lunch option if you work nearby!

NO ONE WANTS TO DO THEIR JOB. 
DO NOT WASTE YOUR TIME.

I've working with trying to get my husband some help with his tonsils. He had an episode of his throat closing up so bad and I needed him to get in ASAP. It wasn't as serious as the ER but we needed to get him checked out right away. 

Everyone was very rude that was on shift when he had gone in. Many eye rolls as he walked in and made him feel as a bother to their day. No professional AT ALL.

Was negative for his COVID test and strep and refused to help him any further.

He has had this happen in the past before and they had given him some medicine that help at-least relieve him enough to eat food. This last time- they refused to give him anything as there wasn't enough 'sores' in the back to allow him to get some.

As 2 days went by after his first appointment // which was a terrible experience// we had no choice but to schedule another day to show the same person that saw him before that there was NOW 'sores' that were very large on the back of his throat. We figured he would FINALLY get some help.

As I talked to the nurse that I was referred to in the 'back' as what they said, she then refused to even go about the appointment and said she wouldn't talk to me as I was not my husband. I WAS SPEAKING ON BEHALF OF HIM- AS IT HURT HIM TO TALK.
SHE THEN SAID TO ME- " YOU NEED TO HANG UP THE PHONE AND CALL 911 as this is something that we would just send him to the ER for." LIKE I DIDN'T KNOW what condition my husband was enough. He was fine- HE JUST NEEDED an aid that would only be proscribed by them.

A few days later, I had to get some labs done. And the doctor said that I can go to any urgent care in the valley and they would send it over. I double checked and called the same urgent care the night before to make sure I needed to have any appointment set up or what I needed to do in order to get my labs done that next morning, and the person on the phone said that there was nothing that I needed I just needed to come in.

I THEN DID AND THEY REFUSED TO HELP ME.
Because I did not have my main primary care holder there. This was nothing that was told to me on the phone and was very frustrating and unprofessional.

DO NOT WASTE YOUR TIME.

I get my nails done by Ashley Ledbetter at Grand Illusion. She is AMAZING! Her prices are affordable and she does a good job every time. She is fast and she has a large variety of glitters and colors to choose from. I always get the glitter tips and she gets them right every time. I am picky about my nails and I drive all the way from Boise just so I can get them done from her. The salon is always clean and the other girls are friendly. I highly recommend anyone who is picky about their nails to go to her.
The Big Growler pizza is my favorite. Great section of beers on tap and a great patio out back.

Would be really nice if they accepted American Express and Discover since almost anywhere you go now accepts ALL major credit cards. Especially now that (due to COVID) credit cards are a required/preferred method of payment, it's time to change that.

I have tried ordering on the phone and they put me on hold for over 25min and no one answered. When I got there, 9:45. The manger had no respect and didn't take the order. I don't recommend coming here.
Credit card machine down for days, your a McDonald's and with all the credit vendors these days someone could've set up a temporary account

I would give no stars if possible. My 6 piece nugget had 4 nuggets...now I know math is hard but come on. We didn't get sauce and the McDouble was a mcsingle...again I know math sucks. Never going back!

This is probably my favorite wing stop in town; I've been a fan since living in Texas. I know not everyone is a fan of theirs. I keep it simple boneless wings and fries with a side of cheese sauce. Tonight the guy who took my order was friendly and even gave me a better deal (substituted my drink for cheese sauce even!!). I love when customer service gets taken to the extra mile in place of being just an order taker. The food here is always consistent in taste; I like the Cajun, spicy Korean, Louisana rub, and hickory smoked Bbq. They have a new boneless wing special: available all the time 5 wings/fries/drink for only $5 (I substitute out the drink for cheese sauce). If you are looking for a great wing spot this isn't a definitely a must stop (get it wing stop haha).

I walk in for a simple French tip acrylic and walked out with a mess! The stylist was very rude, uncaring and unprofessional. The whole place was so dirty and all of the stylists were sitting around talking. I explained to the stylist what I wanted and she did the exact opposite! I had leftover acrylic all over my fingers and my nails were so thick, chunky and short!! I looked down at them in horror and almost started to cry. 
I did not feel comfortable telling her that I didn't like them because she was already so unfriendly and so were all of the other stylist sitting around me. I was also in a hurry to get to MY birthday dinner! I was so embarrassed by them that I had to hold back tears at my dinner and hide my hands! When I finally got home I ended up filing the nails down to thin them out and just wished they were longer! All of this to say, I would never go back to this nail salon and would not recommend it to anyone! Especially if you have special plans for the evening!

Many of you might think he is great because he rambles on for an hour about nothing that makes no difference all. I am here to tell you he is the most inconsiderate Dr. that I have ever seen. I was out of my thyroid med levothyroxine & the soonest appt. available was 22 days out. I have Blue Cross and no problem having an appt. So I asked for a 20 day supply of levothyroxine until my appt. & he absolutely refused!?!? I was totally appalled and shocked! It is detrimental to go without your thyroid meds for more than 3 days. He didn't care that I would be without for 22 days! What Dr. Does that?! He is arrogant and rude & does not listen to a word you say! Go to Embrace Wellness & see Elizabeth Hachova!!! She got me in the very next day!!!! She is changing my life! She cares! She is a 5 star amazing human that actually listens, cares & wants to fix the root problem instead of a bandaid!!  I told 6 people after my appt. how impressed I was with her ....never in my life have I felt that great about a Dr! Good things do come of bad situations. I'm glad Jeremy denied my meds because I found her! Bye jeremy Frix!

Place is uncomfortable for seating and not inviting. Their were flys all over the place.  The outside seating wasn't set up properly and also Uninviting.  The blueberry compote on the heat burger might just be the worst thing ever to be put on a burger.   Over priced and not worth it. Won't be back.

My experience at Gramercy was better than I expected. I didn't see much on the menu that got my attention so I wound up ordering their maple bacon bourbon burger and a salad. I lettuce wrapped it and they were happy to accommodate. The dressing on the salad was delicious, burger cooked to perfection and very flavorful, and I tried their vanilla basil dressing a friend had on their salad and omggg that's one I'm attempting to create for sure!!!

The only reason I am leaving 2 stars is because they have great gluten friendly bundtlets. That's it. 

We had been going to this location for 4 years for every family members' birthday for those bundtlets. But, not anymore.

My husband stopped by here with our THREE kids (all under age 5) in tow to pick up enough to celebrate his birthday. He had forgotten the bundtlet carrier for the carrier discount, so understood when they wouldn't give him the discount. He then proceeded to tell them it was his birthday (it was his actual birthday). They said they couldn't give him his free bundtlet without his birthday email. Frustrated and pissed off, he left. And I don't blame him. 

So, I called to try and make it right. They did nothing. I was told in a very quip manner that all he had to do was show his ID. I said if he had been asked to show his ID he would've (It's the guys' 41st birthday, and he's not an idiot). And was then told their birthday emails had been glitchy. Even more reason to ASK for ID.  Regardless, who's running the business? The people that work there or my husband? It's their responsibility to make sure his experience is a good one and not the other way around. I even offered to try and rush over there with our bundtlet carrier and his ID since he was refusing to return after his shitty experience, and was told that wasn't possible. That it would have to be him.  I don't blame him for not wanting to go back after you guys did literally nothing for him, and offered him subpar customer service. 

Guess what Nothing Bundt Cakes? Your gluten free bundtlets aren't THAT good. And your customer service is shitty. We won't be returning.

While the wings are fire. If you want to watch a cluster f**k in progress, order online. They will without a doubt mess your order up. Doesn't matter via the Wingstop app, doordash, or Uber eats. Y'all will be disappointed. I loved to eat Wingstop when I lived in other parts of the country. This particular store just can't seem to get it together.

First of all, the service was great and the people working there are super nice.
However, if you are going to label something as a smoothie for kids... maybe make sure there's actual fruit in it. This thing is NOT a smoothie. Green Apple smoothie sounds somewhat healthy and when my son was asking for a smoothie I stopped at one of these drive throughs to see if they had one and I was excited to see an option I thought was on the healthier side.
It's literally like green apple candy concentrate and ice. It's fucking terrible. Label it what it is, a candy drink bro! I'm never going here again.

We go to this Dutch Bros fairly often as it's real close to the kids' high school.  The crew that works here are always friendly, shiny happy people who seem to be having a good time at work.  I stopped in for my free birthday drink and the line was pretty long on both sides, so the kid was taking the orders on the iPad or whatever.  Nice kid - told him it was my  birthday, he wished me a happy birthday and placed my order for a large bubblegum frost with the birthday works.  I got up to the window and the shiny happy girl asked whose birthday it was - told her mine - she wished me a happy birthday, wrote on my lid, and gave me my fun, delicious drink.  This place is rad.

I don't understand how there is so many positive reviews. Service was horrendous. There food was barely even edible. I got sopes. Ate the shredded beef one because I was hungry. Couldn't have ate the chicken one if I tried it was way overcooked chicken extremely dry. The beans and rice were bland. I can't remember what my bf ordered but it wasn't edible either. I got a margarita and it was absolutely fucking disgusting I literally took one sip of it and couldn't have drank it even if I plugged my nose. Any resteraunt I have ever been to would have asked to re make it or comped it from the check but nope I got charged for a $13 margarita that was completely full left on the table. We weren't even asked if we liked our meal. So to sum it up of you like good quality mexican I would definitely avoid this place. I wouldn't be back and will be sure to tell my family not to waste their time eating here. $50 later to be very dissapointed.

This company's office in Jacksonville, Florida manages two of my investment homes. I've left several voice mails and sent several e mails with ZERO response. I have not heard from them in months.
Would like to know how my tenants are, property condition etc.
Thus far I'd have to say Home River property management sucks on the communication side.
Steven David
Ocean Reef, Fl.

Boise Bully Bread Rescue needed to move our huge 278 lb,  7'X6'X3' Port-a-Cool into our warehouse building from the drop ship location. Dereck was extremely helpful. To save us a trip he took the forklift to the shipped location and put the cooler on the trailer with the forklift and then delivered it and unloaded it at BBBR's warehouse. All at a price that was unbeatable. Unparalleled customer service and an unbeatable price. We will be using them again for any of our equipment rental needs.

The store is good for certain things and especially when they are on sale. I took a chance on one of their 'staff favorite' red wine blends....called Second Voyage 2018 and it's just awful, even second day after 'aerating a bit' !  Sad I wasted my money and didn't buy the well trusted, always good 19 Crimes red blend (also from Australia)  And their FM website does not allow reviews on their products...thus here I am on Yelp just in case anyone reads this and is thinking about buying that wine....don't do it.
15mins after eating there this evening, a sicking tummy ache hit me. The chicken taco was the only different I ate from the hubs.

Pup cup.

They offer a pup cup of frozen custard for your DOG. 

After 3 meals in 4 hours, it was only natural to stop by and grab frozen custard through their drive-in--especially since it was ONE HUNDRED AND THREE DEGREES THAT DAY. Oy.

Frozen custard is richer and creamier than ice cream: more cream and egg yolks. I figured I would go with the "healthier" option of the Hawaiian custard with pineapple, strawberry, coconut, macadamia nuts, whipped cream -- and a cherry on top. 

We were just about to finish our order when I saw the option to have it made as a 'concrete' which is mashing all the ingredients together like a Dairy Queen Blizzard. We all adjusted our orders to be concrete.

The drive-thru attendant was super. Then he said the magic words: "Would your dog like a pup cup?" Pretty sure my dog doesn't speak English but she immediately perked her head at his offer. 

And although I only had a few bites of my own (so rich and sweet!) I know that we'll always stop in at Freddy's when in the neighborhood.

Dropped by to buy a Dearler logo T-shirt since we were spending the night in Meridian.

This place has a LOT of bikes in the showroom and apparently an ample fleet of bikes to rent.

The T-shit selection ws rather disappointing.  At $35+ for a garment that costs $5 to make, you'd think they would have everything in all sizes but not so here.  I usually but two T-shirts but I only found one that I half way liked and I wasn't all that crazy about the one I purchased.

Oh well....

Cool ladies, managers at their front desk, felt they were open minded to outsiders that they want living in town, you know to mix things up a little (if you're picking up what im putting down ;-D). They hooked me up when in real need of a place earlier this year back in Jan. '18, but unfortunately another family emergency took me away to Michigan and the rest as they say is history. I will be back someday to look these folks up once again no doubt, but yes enjoyed the week or so long stay in southwestern Idaho. Decent area, weather, scenery etc. This was a newer complex in a now rapidly growing market which is Boise City (Meridian) Idaho, thanks again coastal Californians for making things expensive around the country even where it gets cold, lmfao! IMHO Idaho Wyoming Montana South Dakota areas are still somewhat pure and untainted in their own little ways at least for America and so lets not ruin them too, please and thank you to all the new residents who move there from somewhere and locals alike. I want to have a reason to return to living there for good again someday truly do. Signed midwest at heart but go west and be smart. RCO1972
We attended a badass party here a few months ago. It was pretty huge and they really know how to throw a party. They have a pretty awesome selection of gear, merchandise and of course, Harley's.

Oh my g_d! Great donuts (more like a delicious cake) without any of the guilt or ruining staying in ketosis. The plus side is they are reasonably priced, great and fun selections, and really delicious. We had four different kind and all were a treat. My only regret is they are not in the Los Angeles area - where I live. I am craving one now and wished that I had taken some for later.

We stayed here for 8 days and loved it.   This place is impeccably clean.  Everyone is extremely friendly.  Your room sparkles after service.  Breakfast is hot and fresh every morning.  The pool is the perfect temperature.  The fitness center is well maintained.  Plus, it's close to everything.  A little piece of paradise!

I wrote a review when this place opened giving it a great review I now have to take it back . 
I took my daughter there for her 22nd birthday for a nice breakfast . 
The girl at the front was very rude so you can see how this meal is heading already and we haven't even been seated yet . 
So we finally get to our table and 10 minutes later our waitress decided to come over and help us . By then we already knew what we wanted . We gave her our whole order . Another 43 min later we received our order . Took 22 min to get a refill on my coffee. 
Neither did my daughters finished their breakfast and actually one of them didn't eat any of the French toast because she said it tasted like plain dough with butter on it . She did enjoy the crispy bacon and her hot chocolate. 
I had the eggs Benedict and it was edible and I will leave it at that ! 
Over all this place was horrible and we won't be returning again . 
Franchise food and horrible service !! 
I don't recommend this place at all and please disregard my past review from months ago !

Really nice couple that own the place! I would recommend getting an appointment because every time I go there on a whim I am told they don't have space for me. Hopefully they can hire some more people! 
Pros-
Great foot massage
Clean
Friendly
Water bottles
Cons-
Not enough staff
My pedicures don't last very long compared to other places.

What a rip off for family medicine. I just moved here, wanted to have consultation to find a doctor out here and spent 20 min with the Nurse Practitioner "talking". They did take my blood pressure and my husband was present and all we did was talk about my 47 years of life so she could get to know me and I her. I received a $300 BILL. From the Doctor, I did not see. Again, I saw the NP. They billed my ins. as pre existing condition. Duh!! Im 47, when you ask me about my life the whole THING is pre existing. So they refuse to lower the bill and tell me I have to pay within 3 months. I will not pay them. I will not go back. I do not recommend. They are high priced and all smiles and no substance.
I have worked in Emergency Medicine for 20 years, I know what Im talking about. Do not go. Plenty of fine Physicians with reasonable charges and down to earth out here in Southern Idaho

I used to love coming here even though it's expensive. Not after tonight. I placed an order online for asap pick up which said 7 minutes. my husband was already there having a "daddy/son" dinner. I sent him all the order info, even put the order in his name. The order was to be picked up at 6:26pm. 6:42 comes and I get a text they hadn't even started the order. Here is my husbands info on what happened: 
After being told we're getting ready to make it, here it is 20 minutes later and it's still not made?? When asked again, where is my order? I'm told, we don't have your order, you didn't order it at this location. Yes, we did here is the receipt of the order with THIS address.......know what just give me a refund I'm done (we're 30minutes past pick up time at this point). "Well you didn't order it here so",...she the puts I the order number and we get our refund now (with no apologies from anyone, In fact a shitty attitude from management). And if your giving me a refund you obviously you DID have my order.........

Such a fun office, especially for kids! My son is always so excited to go to his appointments and earn "Payne Points" for super awesome prizes. Very clean and friendly staff and a very welcoming environment. Dr Payne does not push unnecessary treatment. 5 Stars isn't enough!

Ridiculously Fabulous!!

We actually began our stay at the Tru Hilton. Big mistake, you live and learn. 
So we moved over to Marriot's TownePlace. Big improvement!!
Wonderful staff. 
Clean Business Class Rooms!

I previously only rated this place three stars, but I've been here several times and each time has been superb. Today I ordered chicken fajitas and the plate was full of chicken-- which is much more chicken then I've ever gotten with fajitas before (see my photo). This place is consistent, flavorful, and friendly and for that reason I need to give them 5 stars. 
Thank you MI CASA!

Our favorite drive through coffee!  Delicious, strong, and quick. They're friendly without being overly talkative before I've had a chance for my morning life-giving coffee. I love they have a good selection of alternative milks too!

This is not my usual Fred Meyer, but I happened to be in the area and needed a few things, so I went in.  I don't know that I have ever been to a Fred Meyer with such horrible customer service.

I cruised by the meat counter and there were 2 staff people behind it and the female was yelling at the male "you better not screw me over again!" and proceeded to tell him - loudly - what he had done wrong before, case this, the meat that, whatever.  So, I stopped directly in front of them, waited to be acknowledged, wasn't, then said "excuse me."  She looked and me and said nothing.  Just gave me that "what do you want" look.   I said that yelling something like that and going on like that in front of customers and children (there was a little girl of about 5-years-old next to me) was probably not a great idea.  She said nothing, and kind of smirked, and then went on to berate the guy.  No comment, not even an "I'm sorry, how can I help you?"  Nothing.  So, I asked for a manager.  She said he's not here.  I asked if there's a store manager, she said there probably is "out there somewhere."  I asked her if she could page one for me.  She smirked and walked away.  A manager came from the front of the store and I told him what had happened.  He seemed to listen and care.

Moving on.... I'm at the clearance area and there's a door where staff comes in and out with product to stock.  And these 2 staff guys were there going on about this worthless girl who does this and that and has all this wasted time.

Then I'm looking for the Free Friday item (frequently on Fridays there is a digital download for a free item).  I can't find the item, or even a space for it, so it doesn't appear that they carry it.  At other Fred Meyers, if they don't carry the item, or are out, they'll substitute something for it.  This Friday's item was a small bottle of Nuprin Ibuprofen.  So, I got a small bottle of store-brand Ibuprofen and went up to Customer Service to ask about a substitution.  Another smirker.  I said something like "it doesn't appear that you carry this item .... are you substituting anything for it?"  She said, "oh we had some, we got plenty, if you didn't get one, that's too bad."  I said "oh, at other Fred Meyer's they'll substitute and give you something else."  Snarky response ... "yeah, no, we don't substitute.  Like I said, we had it, and you missed out."  Alrighty then.  {I don't mind not getting the item, it's the tone and the words that I have a problem with.}

They had these Squishmallow stuffed animals on sale for half price.  And they were all in this sort of tall wire bin.  And a lot of them were dirty.  The white was dingy, scuff marks, etc.  It took me a while to dig through and finally find one that was good enough to purchase.  When I got up to the register, I asked the girl if she had a big bag that I could put it in because I didn't want it to get dirty.  And I was holding it for her to scan the tag so that I didn't risk it getting dirty, she says yes, snatches it from me, drags it on the scanner and then shoves it into a small bag.  Ugh.  I wanted to hold it to make sure it didn't get dirty, and she just dirtied it and shoved it in to a small bag when I asked for a big one (that they have and I saw there in the cubbies).  Annoying.

I did find some fun things on markdown, so that was a treat.  I didn't stay long enough to check out the other half of the store because I was annoyed with them....

I really enjoy going to new grocery stores.  It's something I enjoy doing when I vacation in different places.  It's neat to see how it's laid out, what products they have, are there any hot little deals, etc.  However, this Fred Meyer is one I don't think I would return to.

Hello, we have tried calling into your store all week, to modify our order placed online. Have had no luck reaching the store. What's the best way to contact your store?  I'm not able to visit in person until pick up time.

My favorite place to shop, the employees are all extremely nice without being overly "helpful "  I like to shop and not be asked every 5 feet if I need help, that gets annoying and I end up just leaving when stores have their employees do that!  This location in particular is my favorite because the relaxing feel and vibe. I noticed the other shoppers here are respectful and kind too, unlike other big box retailers. I love taking my time here and browsing all their stuff!

My 19 year old daughter came home today from having her hair worked on by RHONDA, very upset and beaten down. RHONDA had immediately berated and criticized her upon arrival, "Oh my God, what did you do to your hair!". Throughout the session RHONDA continued to badmouth and chide my daughter with, "I can't work with this", "it looks shaggy", "it doesn't match your natural hair", "these are cheap". By the time she arrived home she was in tears the rest of the evening from the words this woman left on her. This woman should not be working with the public with her strong opinions and mouthiness, and needs a lesson in public relations by her employer before returning to work. She is representing HAIRSPRAY SALON & SPA, her employer should be very concerned.

I don't even want to give them one star, if I was able to give a negative rating I would. I have never been more appalled at the workmanship done on our home. We haven't even been in the home for 2 years and the paint is peeling off of the walls. When I called to speak with someone she stated "we've never heard of that happening" and when I spoke with the people at the paint store they said it was likely because it was not prepped properly or want primed before being painted and she replied "well that's their opinion." However when I researched this online paint professionals had the same exact reasons as to why paint would be peeling across the board on previously unpainted walls. I would really think long and hard before spending hundred of thousands of dollars building with Coleman Homes. They aren't even willing to have someone look at a potential mistake made by a contractor they hired because our warranty is up (another builder offers a 10 year warranty on this issue). I won't even go into detail about other issues we found while replacing our floors. We would have never known this was an issue if we didn't have to remove the trim so that we could replace it at the appropriate height for the new flooring.

Such a disappointment.  Scrambled eggs not freshly scrambled. If you want fresh eggs, request poached or fried. There omelets are 4 egg omelets. I wanted a 2 egg ham scramble a la cart.  Was charged 11.49 for this. I asked for a manager who said he would take care of it by giving me the senior discount. That ended up being $8.99.  Will stick to Terry's Cafe.
Ther service was really good and the food is the best we have had in the area.  So glad we decided to try it.  We will be back to explore more items on the menu.

Dropped in Saturday (10/3/2020) for grilled chicken tacos that were soggy and bland.  Adding salsa made them way too wet and still didn't add much flavor.  Not terrible, but definitely not a good taco.

Had been meaning to try this place for a while and so glad I finally did, it was SO good. Amazing service and really great food! The owner overheard it was our first time there and they gave my daughter a free slice of chocolate cake - which was incredible! Thanks Gandolfos! Almost everything is made from scratch! Plus, they have a drive thru! I highly recommend!!!

I ordered their cheeseburger and it was raw!!! Not cooked all the way.  I watched them cook the meat, they had to cut it to see if it's cooked over and over.  When I got it and took a bite it was raw and gross!!  The fries was over salty and gross.  The foods are way over priced. $14 for cheeseburger and fries. Not even worth it at all. Never going back there again!!!

Final Destination Location. 
That's the term the doctors use when they tell you that you have ALS. You have to hopefully find the place that will serve as your last location to live for the rest of your life. 
Sounds kinda depressing and a bit scaredy unless you find a location that feels like it was made just for you. A staff that actually new my name the 2nd day that I moved in. A maintenance crew that can and do everything on the first request. No delays, no missing parts, nobody your afraid to let into your apartment. I would and offer any of the staff at The REGENCY at any time to just walk in my appartment because that's what you do with family and that's how they treat you. If you get an Appartment at The Regency at River Valley it's like living at Disneyland. Everything is clean and working. I've been there a Year and they still welcome me every time I enter the office. The location is INCREDIBLE. You get The Meridian Village and all the stores that come with it. You will find shopping, restaurants, playgrounds, fishing ponds, outdoor activities in the park right across the street all summer long. From my wheelchair I can buy a pizza, grab a burger or sit outside in the shade and enjoy a large variety of daily happy hour specials from to many restaurants to count.
Maybe I will just go down and listen to the live entertainment on Friday night's throughout the Summertime or sit down and watch a movie and order a long Island and some buffalo wings from my chair at the local movie theater in The Village. If you had to have a "Final Destination" you could do a lot worse than being around family and Living at Disneyland.
After several attempts they still have refused to bill my insurance company.  The office manager is often rude and non responsive.  Time to find another dentist.

I stumbled upon the shop while running errands. I don't spend much time in Meridian, but you bet the next time I am around I will be stopping in.

Great location to swing into the drive thru, but even better inside! The decor is simple and adorable. 

I am simple and just like a cup of house brew with heavy cream, but it did not disappoint. 

As a new customer, they were very friendly and efficient. More importantly, I enjoyed listening to the two gals working calling customers by name, already knowing their order, and checking in on life events.

Everything you are looking for in your new local coffee spot!

This is my first time in my life giving a bad review to a place!! so many bed bugs in that room I have an allergic in my neck!! And the worst is not that -- it's the manager telling me that a professional came to the room and told my they leaved a note that is was no bedbug in that room-- good thing   Iphone shows proof of date and time where u took a photo---
Tried The Broken Yoke today . The eggs were fine, but my waffle was served over cooked and cold, not enough heat to even melt the butter.

Omakase is real sushi! The fish was absolutely amazing none of that funky American sauce drenched rolls just real high quality sushi! The Umi box is perfect for two people! If you haven't tried it yet do yourself a favor and order from crave delivery!

Boise fry Co. was recommended to me by a friend and after visiting I'm certain we ordered different things. I have to give credit where it's due though. The fries were very good and while no sauce stood out to me there were soo many options and were all worth trying. The burger on the other hand was terrible. The patty was bad on its own but the lettuce was wilted and the cranberries just did not work for me at all. If you love fries or cranberries, this spot is worth a visit but I would not recommend it to the average person.

It has been 30 days since I moved out, I left the house very clean and even turned the keys in 10 days early. And I still haven't received my deposit or any answers. They are not returning my calls or emails.
Best place ever! Everyone so friendly and sweet and the community is just amazing. Positive vibes all over from customers and baristas. Definitely a place you need to be at!

Do not have Coleman Homes build your home. They are horrible with customer service. 
They built a kitchen island instead of a raised bar island and when I asked for a discount because this was not what I wanted, they offered me $100. Frankly, that was insulting. When we told them the offer was not good enough and we wanted to have the island we asked for, they offered us $500 (another insult). We had them redo the island.
A couple of weeks after the sale was final, the water valve in front of the house was defective. They refused to fix it. There is a one year Home Warranty on the home. One month later we sent a punchlist of what needed fixing, we received no answer. We reached out again today and this time, we were told that the warranty is null because we are renting the place.
The island countertop was poorly polished, the top of the house's paint is unfinished. We also have an issue with the electrical system and now have to pay an electrician to come over and check why the GFI is tripping. I am so disappointed with this company and will never use them again. Don't use them either.

I would definitely recomend Boris to anyone who is seeking a unique piece of jewelry. He is a very talented artist.  Design of my ring and earring set reflects my personal story. I love wearing my set and getting complemented every time. Also Boris has done  jewelry repair and ring sizing for me and his work anyways made me feel satisfied.
Wanted to get fills and a Mani/pedi for my daughter. Walk-ins welcome, sign says. However @ 310pm told they couldn't help us, before closing time of 7pm. We saw no one else waiting.

I came into this lovely coffee shop this morning with my two boys, and we were able to enjoy the ambience and our snacks while waiting for our vehicle repair next door. I ordered a iced caramel macchiato, and it was quite tasty. I'm glad we stopped in because the two employees were top notch, along with their hospitality, great customer service and empathy for my son who needed to use their restroom ASAP. Thank you for a great experience. I will try the drive-through next time!

I come in every month for the best dozen donuts in Idaho. They're very reasonably priced, and handmade, Hand dropped in oil, and prepped in front of you. You're also supporting a local Idaho business. i would highly recommend!

No stars, internal communication poor. Final documents changed from day to day. Only one appraisal with no comparable listings.
Communication with broker, escrow company, and homebuyer not clear.
Some requests ignored.

Absolutely the worst medical experience I have ever had. Went in on a Monday morning because my throat was starting to feel sore. Very similar feeling to when I had strep throat before. Wanting to catch it early this time I decide against my initial instinct to wait and see if it got worse. After a few questions about my lifestyle I was giving a standard swab test for strep which came back negative. I left with nothing but a "Sorry that we can't diagnose it better" and a promise I would receive a call after the test came back from the lab. 2 days later and no call but in much worse shape. Throat so swollen haven't eaten in two days and can barley drink water, cold sweats, fever. I return to the same primary health in hope they may have received results from the lab. Was told that results still weren't back. I asked for a note excusing me from work and was told the only way one could be provided is if I pay my ins co pay again and have then run a second test. This place does not care about its patients well being whatsoever and only concerned with $$. After agreeing to pay again I was checked in had 2 different doctors come in and look at my throat all with no ideas really other than referring me to the emergency room. One of the doctors was nice enough to write me a note excusing me from work. Still no recommendations on how to treat the issue. Will avoid this location at all costs in the future.

Update: Well it is now 5 days after my original visit and still haven't received any call in regards to lab tests. Did receive a call re affirming what I was told in office that I would need to return and pay again to receive a work excuse. Even tho I was there on wends and received a note from them they seem to not be aware of this. This place is a complete joke. Avoid at all costs.

Best Poke I've found so far here in Boise! Reminds me of San Diego Poke! The fish is so fresh and they have tons of toppings to choose from! I got a lobster bowl with white tuna and spicy mayo (which was perfectly spiced btw ) and my boyfriend got an octopus, salmon, white tuna and lobster bowl which was also delicious! Definitely our go to Poke place! Reminds us of home :)

Top of the line designer and person! He was always in contact with status updates and revision designs. He designed the most perfect wedding ring and I constantly recommend his work to all friends and family. 

We constantly get complimented on his work.

Molly Maids have been cleaning for me for the past three years. Their staff are kind, honest and trustworthy. Recently I dropped a small diamond earring. I thought it had gone down a drain or was lost forever. Two weeks later, when the crew came, I returned home to find the earring on a pad of paper on my spotless bathroom counter. I appreciate not worrying.
My home is very clean, the way I would clean it myself.

We had an absolutely unacceptable experience at this restaurant.  We had approximately 20 people and were utilizing the group area.  The computer system wouldn't work and as a result the restaurant was basically not able to function.  No one there was capable of making any decisions, making change, processing orders, etc.  We ordered salads and waited well over 30 minutes for food to be ready.  Our group won't be back.

I did a TON of research before buying my car and called and visited MANY dealerships in the valley.  Kendall Ford was by FAR the best dealership that I dealt with.  Starting with my first call to Julie-she was attentive and on top of things and gave me wonderful customer service.  Jeff took care of us once we got there and he spent many hours with us and was wonderful. I REALLY wanted to buy a car from Jeff and I'm happy that I got to.  Even our experience with finance was great.  This was the best car buying experience I have ever had.

The staff was excellent. I give the staff five stars for accommodating our needs as best they could. They were friendly and put up with our arrivals and departures due to our truck being in the shop. I only wish there were microwaves and refrigerators in each room. It's necessary to have microwaves and refrigerators for those guests staying more than one night.

The lab staff is great, but that is where it ends.  COVID sample taken 14 days ago!!!! No results yet.  Here is some irony...this is what it states on the MyQuest homepage:

Get your test results, faster
View easy-to-understand test results as soon as they are available - because when it comes to your health, knowing sooner is always better.

All these places are so quick to take your money - 129.00 and yet none of them deliver on turnaround times.  When time is of the essence, that take your money and if you are lucky get results 2-3 weeks later, when the results are essentially meaningless!  No wonder COVID keeps spreading!   If you can't turn samples around in 48-72 hours, you have no business in the lab area, much less taking people's money under false pretenses.

My fam and I are obsessed with Dutch Bros. The drinks are consistent and so is the service! They have the best workplace culture, and going to get a drink really is just always an enjoyable experience.

This particular shop is my favorite, I'm slightly biased because it's just a few min from us, but I love all the employees we've met so far!

This truck makes my favorite food. You get large portions but not at the cost of quality. The couple making your food are authentic and joyful, and the food is made with diligent care. They also always provide an extra something with every single plate. It's a tradition now

My wife and I went here last Sunday after church.  We got there around 1:30 and were seated quickly.  

I ordered the breakfast burrito and my wife ordered a chicken wrap.  The service was great and the food was fresh.  

The breakfast burrito was generous, with bacon.  The salsa was fresh, and the burrito just melted in my mouth.  My wife was very pleased with her food as well.

We had one of these restaurants in Temecula as well, and we are so glad one came here to Meridian.  We went by yesterday and they were packed.  We went elsewhere because of the wait.

This restaurant has breakfast and lunch.  If you are in West Meridian stop by, you won't be disappointed.

Apparently the customers time isn't valuable. Think I could call in a cake? Nope. Can I call in a cake if I pay over the phone? Nope. Any order has to be made online. Terrible business model as well as terrible customer service. So now I wait for a cake for ten minutes that could have been ready when I got here. Oh it's ok, your time is much more valuable than mine, obviously. 
I don't know how hard these cakes are to produce because I guarantee they're brought in frozen and thawed. A generic cake shouldn't require me to pay in advance when it's your best seller. What a joke.

Good idea in theory.  They price themselves as a premium donut ($2/donut), but the taste is just average.  Their base donut is small/medium size and dense, like an old fashioned or sour cream donut .  The only differentiating quality is that you can customize their icing and thinned out icing they call "drizzle."  If you're looking for innovative, try out Guru donuts.

Amazingly good, I'm obsessed with these donuts!! 

So warm, and the endless choices of creative they get.. MIND BLOWING!

I came in here to eat to try it again. The last time I ate there the food was OK. The juices were actually terrible. I even told the server that they were not that good. The service wasn't that great. But this time I came in And sat down to order. I waited quite a while and no one came. Then the waitress came by and said I'll be with you in one moment. I waited quite a while but no one came so I got up and left. I really can't recommend a place that supposedly is
 based on food quality and service and those things aren't delivered. I don't recommend this place at this time.

I really liked eating here. Everything was clean, the entire staff was friendly and welcoming. Also had face masks and practices social distancing, along with sanitizing between costumers. 
The menu has many options for breakfast, everything was delicious.
The  Stuffed French Toast is easily one of the best I've ever eaten.

Ordered tacos delivered from Taco Cow. None were labeled all were over salty, greasy, fatty & really unappealing. Plus it took over 80 minutes to get our food & we were missing food, though it was difficult to tell what tacos for certain. We won't order again.
The fries are insane here. I mean, it's to be expected but they are for real. Shoestring style is legit. I'll be back Boise Fry. We will be back.

My review has nothing to do with the food and everything to do with our waitress. The food is great very tasty and big portions but our waitress was very rude and unfriendly. My husband ordered a messy caramel latte I guess because it was so freakin loud in the restaurant she thought he ordered a Bloody Mary when she brought it we kindly said he didn't order that and you could tell right off the bat she was annoyed. My son dropped his fork on the floor when I nicely asked if she could bring us another one she walked away from me without even saying anything then brought it back and handed it to my son like that annoyed her too. And listen I get everyone has bad days but we're big tippers especially if the service is good but she got a 0$ tip and we probably won't be back simply because of that.
He is a great Dr. lots of information provided. Very knowledgeable and can back up his information. Highly recommended by my family.

I had a different experience. My first time there, my stylist was Lexi and she did a fantastic job. I wanted lowlights and layers and she did exactly what I wanted. The salon is clean and fun. Lexi was easy to talk to, and I left feeling very confident in my look.
Donuts are so good. There hot and gooey and you can put whatever toppings you want on them. The Carmel frappes don't have much flavor at all.

Absolutely horrible. Many things wrong with the place. When we came we stood outside in line (first people in line)  this rude man completely ignored us and went and talking to the people behind us asking if their ordering. Well obviously they were ordering, the man was just trying to be ignorant to us. Then after waiting forever the man finally came back out to take our order. My sister had gotten a burger bowl, and told them everything she wanted on it. She had also gotten some fries.  She was the only one that ordered. I did not get anything. After waiting again for our food which was taking forever. They brought out her fries and bowl. First off, the fries were not worth the price at all. Way to crispy and salty. But the bad part was the burger bowl. She opens it and it's a hamburger patty, with lettuce on the bottom and throw in onions.  Poorly , Poorly made. She then got up again to tell them she wanted a bun and the man rudely stared "Well u said u didn't want a bun when I asked". When she surely did. Even if she wouldn't have he still should not of rudely said that and should've just gotten her her bun. And on top of all that. There was hair in her bowl. All of the chefs there are so un professional and no hairnets or anything. This one girl even had her hair up, but with the top of it having her hair pulled out , (pulling out the side and top of her hair).  I would never ever recommend this place.  She even stated the food was not good at all especially for the outraging prices. And a very very low selection of items on the menu.

My boyfriend and I are huge BWW fans, we generally don't venture out when it comes to wings. We decided to give Wing Stop a try tonight and I am sad to say it was not amazing, or even great.. 
The fries are VERY, VERY salty and a tad sweet.. Which is strange - I will post a picture (my boyfriends comment - they out FRIES on their SALT). 
The wings were drenched in sauce - I am good with wet wings but these were soaking in it.. 
The meat was extremely tender which I ENJOYED but, the seasoning and sauces they have are so.. Disappointing. 
I don't think we will be coming again, the service was fine, not incredible and the wings didn't live up to their hype.

Staff is extremely friendly. Ladies pack your own hair dryer. This motel does not come with one. In fact they give you one tiny bar of soap and thats it. There is not a water fountain to be had in the entire building. You have to fill your water bottles up in the bathroom sink. Do not stay in the rooms by the exit doors. Extremely noisey all night long as modern society has lost social skills and couteousy. People were slamming the door shut all night. The beds were awful and hard as a rock. I could feel the springs in the mattress. Next to freeway very noisey.  The walls were paper thin.

I purchased a used bike today in Meridian (I'm from Caldwell) and it needed a new tube.  I stopped in to see if they could replace it - and even though they were busy, they fit me in right away so that I wouldn't have to drive back from Caldwell. SO nice, quick, efficient and helpful.  THANK YOU. It will be worth the drive for future repairs as they do take care of their customers.

Great pedicure! Walked in and they seated me ASAP. Had great color choices. The guy that took care of me spent so much time on my feet, it was great. He also kept great convo with me the whole time! I will be back for more!!

Solid donuts.  Kids loved them. Lots of different flavors - almost too many to choose from . Because it's donuts made (decorated) at the time of order, it's a longer wait.  We only had one other person in the store and still had to wait several minutes.  It's was worth it - but I would be curious how they do it with bigger crowds.  

All in all, my kids have a new favorite donut shop.
Went for a basic hair cut.  Staff were friendly. Called ahead and put our name in. No complaints.
We had lunch and found the food to be delicious.  Service was prompt and courteous.   Prices were reasonable.

This place is closed. Just drove all the way here to find its out of business.
