No maybe this is long enough for Yelp to let me post this as a review to save others the time of driving here to find it closed.

This was the worst experience I have had at a supercuts. I went in for just a quick trim on the sideburns and back of my neck. The lady who was helping me could care less and spent 3 whole minutes on my cut. My sideburns aren't even and there was hair all over me when I left. When it was done she tried to charge me $16 for a full cut. I usually pay $10 with tip for such a clean up and she tried to tell me it was a full cut. Wrong! We went back and forth and she eventually said she would ring it up as a "buzz" cut. Her attitude the whole time was awful and said a total of maybe 4 words to me. Worst service I've seen in any customer service setting before. 

Just overall an awful experience. Supercuts in general is never my go to but for something so easy I figured I go and give them my business. Never again. 

Don't go here people, it's not worth it. Not even for a trim of the sideburns. Lesson learned the hard way.

Best best best donuts I have never had!!!!!! Warm each of them made to order love is put into them you can tell I've eaten a lot of donuts in my life and these are the best I've ever had! Can't wait to go back!
Fun little coffee joint. Found it while driving though town. Super nice staff and a convenient drive up windows. Check it out!!! Good breakfast burritos too.

Stay far far away from this company. They build a terrible home, botched installs and terrible customer service. If you want your emotions to be torn then ignore the reviews you see here. They do not comply to your contract, we have concrete dumps all over our backyard, our concrete work is cracking after just months even in our garage. We feel bullied by the warranty department and are now having to seek professional assistance and council. So here we go with home inspections and legal battles. They have 0 integrity and do NOT conduct themselves in an Idaho way. BIG COMPANY BIG PROBLEMS. I stepped on a nail the other day from constructio
n next door as I was walking my children to our pool.. very scary. Please please stay away.. CBH at least fixes their mistakes. Be careful of M$#e he has scared my children.. and quite frankly conducts him self how I would imagine a gang member would.. feel free to ask me any questions and you will soon here us on the radio...  sad sad sad..

Food was just ok. Tried the burrito bowl and it definitely lacked flavor. Looked and sounded great, but I was not impressed. Also, was a lot less food for the money than similar restaurants. Will stick with other options.

Dairy Queen is a place of my childhood. I always have fond memories thinking of stopping by after a school or church function.  
But you'd think I would know better by now because I always end up with a stomach ache after leaving here. I think this is probably my last visit. I don't know if it's that they're not using real ice cream or what the ingredients are but every single time. Very disappointed.

I typically don't leave any reviews that are super negative but I think something needs to be done in management because people are obviously not having good experiences here. Not sure what else to say but I definitely love the food just wish employees and managers would clean it up a bit.

I purchased a 2017 Harley LowRider S from Salesman "Joe". The bike had 7800 miles on it. During the sale I asked Joe if the bike has had a inspection and services. Joe stated that the bike has been inspected and has had all the fluids changed. After working out my Trade-In price we decided to do the deal. 
 I got the bike home and started to check out my new baby. It's a beautiful bike. A ton of work put into it from the previous owner. Than it came time to check the oil. The dipstick was dry and nothing on it. So I put the bike on my bike lift and shined a light down inside and couldn't see any oil. I called Joe that next day and let him know what I found. He said to bring it in and they would change the oil if it needed it. I had a slow day at work so I went up and purchased 5 quarts and a filter. I wanted to ride this last week since the weather was great so I decided to just eat the 100.00 in fluid and do it myself so I can ride. 
 Well, I got it on the stand and looking at the plugs I could tell they haven't been out ever. The cover hasn't been off ever! So I drained the engine and less than 1 quart of engine oil came out. Pure black with tons of metal shine in it. I finished doing all the fluids. I took pictures and documented everything. I went in today and all I got was we will give you a oil change for free. There has been damage done to the bike from this and there is no arguing that. Lots of wear and tear out of the normal. Either Joe is a complete liar and he knew that it didn't get a oil change when it was traded in or the technician didn't do his job. But this needs to be on High Desert and not me.

Okay, this was probably the weirdest worst pedicure of my life. I never went in a tub ever.. I sat at a manicure station with my foot up on the ladies lap and she removed my polish and painted new polish. I couldn't even see my feet or what was happening. I realized it was going to be $55 and said no way so she said we can skip the tub (which would be after my polish) and then it would be$30. All of the pedicure chairs were open so there is no reason why I couldn't sit in a massage chair and soak before. It was so weird and uncomfortable.I will never come back. I would rather go out with ugly toes. She was nice, but I don't even know what to say about this experience.
the BEST treat ever! I enjoyed these yummy ice cream bars, the only downfall is they fall apart easily and are messy:( I would still go a million more times and recommend to any of my friends!

I walked in with a tricky request, and walked out with a smile. Jennifer was extremely pleasant to work with and super helpful. She was patient and spent time making sure we were on the same page. She even followed up with a phone call to check in on me. Thank you, Jennifer!

Took both my boy's RC vehicles in for service. The guys were great! My youngest has a Traxxas Rustler, they serviced it cleaned it up and gave it back,  NO CHARGE... My oldest has a Traxxas T-Maxx, it needed quite a bit from sitting for about 3 years. They serviced, changed out some parts, and got it running. Very-very reasonable on shop rates! If you need RC service, this is your place. They have a light inventory but will get you what need/want. 

Great customer service!

Just bought a bike from them and have to say that it was an awesome experience. The entire process was easy, painless and did not take very long. After the sale was taken around and introduced to the entire staff. I would recommend these folks to anyone!!

I pop into this establishment a few times a week and spend my hard earned money. This rating is simply about my experience tonight. I arrived and asked the host if I could sit at the bar area. I was told yes so I walked to a table. I sat there a good 10 minutes with zero acknowledgement. I had 3 servers all pass by, not one even looked at me. I got up and left. I won't be back!

Okay, so I ordered a taco, queso, a side of beans and churros. They gave me the queso, and my taco came out like 5 minutes later.After about 10 minutes I went up and asked about my refried beans for my toddler. The guy acted like it was a huge waste of his time to grab crusty lukewarm refried beans for me and was like well let's aside so it's not supposed to come till later... But I'm confused because I already got my food. Anyway, another 20 minutes and I just asked about the churros, she was like oh I must have missed it on the ticket... Well, still waiting for my churros she said it would take a minute it's now been about 10. By the way they aren't really busy at all and it's too much trouble for them to actually serve the food they're supposed to be serving. Definitely not coming back

Options were great to pick from. Homemade tortillas are good. Great flavors! Good prices for what you get.

This order was To Go and the only downside was that my food was cold :( and I don't live far. The guacamole was ice cold, so I assume that is why the food was cold. Once this was microwaved and warm the food was delicious!

Great twist on a  staple.
love the sweet sauce and various meat options.

Stopped by to get some kitchen gifts for my parents. When checking out, there was a very long line with only 1 person on register and three other employees standing directly in front of the other registers, chatting with each other. I was standing in line for 5+ minutes before one of the other employees offered to open another register. I understand it's busy during the holidays but they weren't even trying to get people through the checkout. They also couldn't accept my Apple Card. I get that it's somewhat new but I've had no issues with it anywhere else.

Lemme tell you. I could eat the avocado and a different juice every- single- day. The Bronco blue wasn't my favorite flavor but I was curious about it. I love the juices that have more orange or red in color ..and with ginger, love. I highly recommend their cold pressed juice. I'd totally do a week long cleanse if it was in my budget. SO good.
Ps it's black pepper AND chia in the pic

The table side guac alone is reason enough to go check this place out. The food is always delicious and the service is great. Plus the portions are huge and you'll almost always leave with left overs!

Don't rent from these people they don't care if you pay rent on time and they definitely don't care how much you pay this company is the worst I have ever dealt with poor maintenance department and lacking customer service

Typical poke place with all the fixings. Enjoyed the service and food. Will go back in the future. 
Got a large bowl with salad no rice and spicy mayo. Fish tasted fresh and the ingredients we tasty. The Mayo was not very spicy but I got extra wasabi which made up for it. The octopus salad was delicious however and so was the seaweed salad as well.

Do not buy with this builder!! Warranty work is a joke and dealing with them is like pulling teeth. They refuse to take responsibility for anything and have a list of responses and excuses. Like many other reviews, we are also dealing with a back yard that was poorly graded and floods. 14 days of standing water. It doesn't drain or soak in the ground, just sits waiting to evaporate. 
We are still well within the warranty period and their response was "you should have addressed the issue before closing on the house"!! How were we supposed to know that it had an issue then?! It's not like they forced it to rain for us so we can see if the yard drains properly. The manager Kyleur McArthur who gave this response is a tool and should be fired. Very rude and only responds with robotic answers. Exactly like the responses you read from Coleman on other reviews here, "we are sorry, reach out to our team of experts", etc. This is the biggest mistake we have made buying this home. We have been in for 6 months and will be selling it soon. We are done with dealing with the lies, dishonesty, horrible service and poor craftsmanship. Anyone considering a Coleman home after reading the negative reviews is crazy. Spend your money elsewhere!! You win Coleman. We are done. For everyone else you have been warned.
My son and his wife LOVE this sandwich shop... they brought me dinner the other night and I have to agree!! So So Good!

Great food. Food was delicious as usual. A small wait because they make it fresh but the wait didn't feel too long. Flavors were great. Restaurant was clean and staff friendly. For being out of town people we felt it was delicious.

If you are looking for a Friday lunch spot, you should come here. This is one of my go to places in Meridian, not only that but Friday at lunch is the only time you can get the Mac 'n Cheese pizza. 
It. Is. So. Good. 
2nd runner up, fried spinach on your pizza. I kid you not, it is devine. Making vegetables taste this good has got to be wrong. The other vegetable not to pass up is the cauliflower buffalo bites. Get extra blue cheese, you'll thank me later.

Service seemed bothered to be there. Portions were a joke. Wasn't impressed with the sauce choices or the fact that you only get 5 toppings. Don't think they have them here but Poke Port blows this place out of the water. I'll be looking for somewhere else to eat poke

The Pokè Bowel was so delicious! We'd occasionally eat there again. Prices are a bit too high. We went there for lunch and paid almost $30 for two bowels, a small and regular. Beside the pricing, I'd say a five star for the bowel. Customer service was okay. I recommend turning the music down, my husband could hardly hear the staff through the shield with the music in the background.

Horrible management. Run away from this place ... save yourself the stress and headache of living here. I can go into detail but there's more negative than positive. (I.e multiple rent increases, maintenance invading your privacy and taking pictures of your place when you're not there (in places they shouldn't even be), stuff breaking down all the time and it takes months for them to "fix" it)  STAY AWAY

Good: spacious, nice decor, large tables and booths, HD TVs for the games. Cheese burger comparable to any other place. Not really a "good" this was my first timers there so I ordered staple food. 

Bad: staff needs more training ( more like supervision). Staff did not great me at the door. I had to find my party. Waiter did not seem to know what they were doing. Very poor service.

Suggestion: Don't go.

I. Love. Their. Food. Especially the wings. I highly recommend the wings if you like a lot of meat on the bones and well sauced. I have also tried a bunch of other items on the menu and its all very good, depends what you're in the mood for. I for one am also a soup lover so I will get their soup of the day or chili with my meal. The servers have always been great, I've never experienced any problems out of the times I've been here. 
The breakfast buffet on the weekends are great, when I'm not working I'll try to get over there. Can't resist Sundays $3.25 Bloody Mary's and Mimosa's. 

All in all, I love it here. Very family friendly, atmosphere is nice, food is great, servers are on top of it. Everyone has bad days, so I wouldn't have one bad experience to write them off. They make up for it in many other ways !

Bought a 2009 Ultra last summer.  I was told upon purchase all three fluids had been replaced.  When I went to remove the derby cover bolts, I found that I had to remove them via an impact gun.  Those bolts should NEVER be that tight.  Needless to say two of the five stripped out.  I contacted high dessert to find out why they overtightened them.  The service manager reviewed my bikes history and told me they never did a three oil change, they just changed engine oil.  Had I known I had been lied to I wouldn't have ridden it to wisconsin and back with old oil in the transmission and primary.  That also explained why the oil was so dirty as I drained it.  The salesman who sold me the bike has moved on to the indian dealership, but that doesn't excuse high desert harley.
I will never spend another penny in that dealership.  It's easy to earn and keep my business, just never lie to me.  It's profit over honesty at high desert, beware.

Love Duck Donuts! Best donuts I've had in the valley so far. Their donuts are formed from a vanilla cake base and from there there are a variety of options to choose from. I've had the Bacon in the Sun which is a maple glazed donut topped with bacon and caramel drizzle and the Peanut Butter Chocolate flavored one. They have over a dozen flavors, maybe even over two dozen and honestly I'm planning to come back to try all their flavors. They also have an app to where you and earn rewards. I was able to redeem a free donut after buying my first one. Decent indoor and outdoor seating and pretty quick service. A bit pricier than other donut places at $1.99 a donut but they get cheaper if you buy them by the half dozen to a dozen. Buy a dozen for an office and you'll definitely make a good impression with your coworkers with just how amazing they look. Can't wait for my next donut!

I went here for lunch fairly recently for the first time and wasn't super impressed. For starters, the parking lot is pretty terrible - incredibly difficult to find a spot, and the spaces are some of the tightest I've ever had to park in. Initially parked in the medical office across the way since there were no open spots available at lunch time, until I saw a sign on the front door of the restaurant saying the owner tows cars for people who aren't patients. Okay, move my car, order my food. I ordered the turkey and Brie sandwich which might've been my mistake, given the fact this is a pizza joint. The sandwich was okay, but the fries that came with it were terrible and tasted really old. It also took forever for our order to be taken or to get the attention of our waiter who seemed to be working the bar as well. Due to all of these things, I wouldn't return.
Why would you close at 7pm during the week? What about the dinner crowd? This was crazy to see....Chipotle stays open later. Great dinner there! 7pm??

One year ago: I used to love this place... until now. The chicken was hard and the steak was tough. When we told the staff the steak was hard, we were told "That's just how it is here." Then when we asked for chicken instead of the steak, the cook didn't believe it was tough and asked to see the steak meat. Now, is it just me or does that almost imply I'm lying? I will not be back and I don't recommend coming here. So sad to see the rude staff treat customers like that.

I ordered a bundle of Bundt cakes. 50 plus. And asked them to put into a box so my daughter can blow out her candles. I went to pick it up after waiting 15 minutes and I got them in a bag. I will never go back after seeing this presentation and paying over 50.00 for all the little cakes. Don't tell the customers you can do it when you end up not doing it. Lame. Not going back.

Sent my child away bleeding from her rectum for being 15 mins late. I have 4 children and have been coming here for years, since their births. In the begging it was great to come into this office, and I went on to refer all my family and friends to Dr Frisby and they became patients, at least 5 families w multiple children. Recently I called to have the referral they gave me sent to a different provider, a gastroenterologist because my daughter was continuing to have severe constipation issues, not pooping for 7 days at a time and after giving her suppositories as they had previously recommended she was bleeding softball ball sized rock hard poops. Because the appts take upwards of 3 weeks to get into, we took our toddler to the urgent care and they wanted her primary care provider to provide the referral. The referral couldn't be found in the file so they insisted I come in for another appt to get another referral. They wouldn't let me see another provider in the office w an earlier appt time, their office policy.  After waiting weeks, upwards of 3 weeks and having my daughter suffer the entire time, the day of the appt I got stuck in the mud from the snow on my way in, I called the office immediately at 3:20 when my appt was at 3:30 to let them know I was 4 miles away and running late about 10-15 mins for my appt time. They were so kind and said it was no problem at all and to drive over. When I arrived at 3:45 they told me they wouldn't see me and that they had to reschedule over 15 mins after telling me to come anyway! The time on my Verizon cellphone said 3:45 when I checked in at the office, they had me wait about 5 mins and then told me that their clocks say a different time, so when my apple iPhone cellphone from Verizon said 3:50 at this point they said their computer clocks said 3:55. This is ridiculous at this point and when I asked to speak w an office manager there was not one at work the day this happened, I asked for a doctor or someone that might care. I was asked to wait to see their clinical manager she came in and told me some ridiculous story about how if I had been even 5 mins late they wouldn't have had the time for my child. But I called and was told to come! She was beyond rude, argumentative, talking about respect and not making people wait, she did a lot of talking for an office that doesn't have any time for their patients w emergencies, and they sent my child away w blood in her underwear unseen by the medical provider with whom we had a half hour scheduled. We arrived at 3:45 and left at 4:30 after all their talking. After 5 years of fidelity to this provider I will be sure to tell everyone I know not to come to this provider. What kind of office w a heart, sends a child away bleeding from her rectum over 15 mins when I called and was told to come anyways. That's pretty beyond messed up. 6 months pregnant and I was so upset, my child bleeding from her rectum and they sent us away over 15 mins! So wrong in so many levels.

Love Piggy Pigs, the staff is awesome, they get to know their customers and treat them like family.  I have been going regularly and love the selection and their pricing.  They are very reasonable.  Their turn around time on the finished pieces is amazing,  I have been very happy with the results and everything they have to offer.  Highly recommend this if you are looking to try something different, start a new hobby or just a great way to spend some quiet time relaxing.

This is a Garden Variety Mexican Restaurant, just like most others. It's hard to find a Mexican Restaurant that offers true Mexican food and this certainly is not one of them.
This is my first visit. I went to the restaurant this evening by myself with the plan to enjoy a Margarita or two and have some chips and salsa before ordering 2 main menu items to go for my wife and I. I received my Margarita along with chips, salsa and bean dip and all seemed well. About 1 minute later, my waiter began harassing me to order my food to go. I told him I would let him know when I was ready to order but he was relentless in trying to force me to order before I was ready. I decided to order a 2nd Margarita and requested more salsa and bean dip (they give you a very small amount of each). I could see the disgust on my waiters face when I asked for it. The second Margarita showed up along with some salsa, but no bean dip. I ordered my food to go and left once it arrived. My wife and I both agreed the food was nothing special and after being rushed as I was, I will be taking my business elsewhere.

Great donuts -- dense, moist, filling, not greasy.  Delicious! I would give 5 stars if the protein content were higher and the price more reasonable. I paid well over $7 for 3 donuts. Donuts are around 100 calories each which is great.

I wish I could give zero stars. They are rip off artists. They advertise $39 for cleaning, exam, and x-rays. It's a bait and switch. They will not clean your teeth the same day, and they make up dental health issues in order to up sell and make additional money. So disappointing.

Great customer service! They have a lot of sandwiches to choose from, and they can make any of them into a salad. They also have hotdogs, which my husband said were really good. They didn't have Coke Zero, but they are attached to Stinker gas station, so you can get any drink you'd like while they make your order!

Dr. Hill is highly skilled with a steady hand.  Hygienists also very good.  All are patient and understanding and respond well to any situation.

I have been a patient here for several years and expect to stay put.  Good dentists are very hard to find.  This one is on Eagle just south of Overland Road.

These burritos are amazing!!! Went here to try it for the first time and was very happy with everything! The restaurant was very clean, the customer service was perfect, and the food was to die for. We will 100% come back again!
Never recommend!! Terrible service and food!!  Avoid at all costs! Will never go to panda again.

We tried this last night.  The sushi was pretty delicious... though it was definitely pricey for a commercial kitchen with no restaurant overhead.  I wish their a la carte options were more reasonable:  $8 for 2 pieces of nigiri is expensive anywhere in the world, let alone from a commercial kitchen in Boise. 

The salmon nigiri was particularly good. Albacore nigiri was a bit dry.  I wouldn't get it again.  The rolls were all tasty, though for the egregious prices, they should be rolled a bit better. They looked more like Korean gimbap than sushi.  Not something I'd normally complain about, but for the price they charge, one expects a career sushi chef is rolling these things. 

I wish they offered hand rolls! 

We'll order from them again.  Great sushi is sparse over here for the time being... make hay, Crave!

Had a very good breakfast here! I got the Fiesta burrito, big, great green sauce and outside of the tortilla very keto. Really good! My wife had the monte cristo which was also excellent. Had plenty of meat on it and very good jam. Fried potatoes were really tasty! Sat outside which was a bit warm, some umbrellas would really help, but very nice. Our server was attentive and on it! We will be back!

Had a great stay. Very friendly staff and our room was very clean. I liked it that they had a little mini store that was open 24/7, came in handy when I ran out of a much needed beverage. I wish there were some restaurants a little closer but overall had a nice stay. I do recommend this hotel.

My 8yr old had to use the restroom & the employee was so annoyed with it. I understand not wanting a ton of people using the bathroom who aren't customers but he was about to pee his pants, he's almost in tears. Y'all can do better and be nice. I will not be giving you my business because of it.

I feel bad writing this review considering how nice the owner is! We were promptly greeted and had really great service. We tried two donuts. They were crazy overpriced but I understand there is a premium for healthy foods, so kind of shrugged it off. The donut itself was cold and sticky...not at all like a donut should be. Both were sickeningly sweet (artificial sweetener) and left a horrible aftertaste. Think powdered protein meets a bag of Truvia. Gross gross gross. We will not be returning.

I'm too old to be young and too young to be old, but my body is yelling at me, 'Honey, you need some serious exercise. 

Never been into exercising my entire life. Used to call it the 'e' word. So, you can imagine the shape I am in at 60+.  Late-blooming massage therapist who loves this gig and wants to continue into my 70's. Well, now I have incentive to work for it. 

Been to many gyms in my life. Hated it. The environment, type of people who worked there (and frequented), the crowd and how dirty it could/would get, the sweat (and I mean wet) that would be left on the machine seats was gross. Many times it was more of a pick-up joint-folks sitting on machines yakking away. Got tired of paying for that experience.

This place is none of that. First day there, met the owners, Rick & Jaclyn and my trainer, Renee. Everyone was down-to-earth and genuinely happy to see me. No hard pressure to sell. Rick gave me the tour and the thing you'll notice first is the cleanliness and 'feng shui' layout. You will also notice how well equipped they are, too.

Been going 3 times a week for two weeks and the place had never been packed or had to wait for equipment. Note: I don't go early morning before work or 5pm. 

I really like my trainer, Renee. She's dedicated to my success. They use apps to keep in contact and follow my progress. Keeps me honest, kinda like WW. They also use a Evolt Active machine to get accurate readings of your bod. It's pretty amazing. 

Okay, so guess you can tell I am a huge fan of this place. Looking forward to being in the best shape of my life.

This is my favorite place to meet friends. Always plenty of place to sit, and the rooms are quiet enough to hear one another talk, but not so quiet that you feel others are forced to eavesdrop! ;) The atmosphere is comfy, the staff is super pleasant, and they have fresh breakfast bowls that fit even my restrictive Keto diet. Coffee is great and consistent. Always feel at home every time I go here.
Nice guy but after buying a new router and paying for 2 hours of labor our wifi is slower than before.  Extremely disappointed.

Great coffee. Great location love the interior and two drive thrus. What a great use of space. The place appears to be female owned and run and everyone is sweet and cheerful. Can't wait to return when we are in the area. Much better than a Starbucks or chain. And they really know all of their regulars too.

Only because I cannot give ZERO stars.
The service repair man came out and acted as if he did not want to repair the door?!? 
Imagine my confusion all he wanted to do was give quote for a new garage door. 

I stated "I do not need a new garage door, I need this one repaired". 

The Garage Door Service Tech states: "I will give you a quote for a new door, maybe try calling Overhead Door Company to repair."

Imagine my surprise and confusion.

By the by I did cal Overhead Garage Door Company and the did a great job on the repair!! Under $200 to repair vs. $1200+ for replacement.

Needless to say unless you need a new garage door I do not think I would use Action.

Exceptional fresh Mexican food, I especially love the burritos and salads, this is one of my favorite lunch and dinner restaurants. My five year old daughter also loves the food there which is a big bonus because she mostly only wants chicken and fries. 

The service is fast, friendly, and very attentive. Food is fast, hot and fresh. You definitely won't leave hungry either, the portions are large.

I really love the consistency of my experience too, I've eaten at all the Baja Fresh restaurants in the Treasure Valley and each time my experience has been superb.

Great place for lunch, dinner, or office lunches.

We tried many christian churches in the valley before we settled into Ten Mile.  So many other church bodies were polarizing and unfriendly when you walked in.  Not so here, we felt welcomed. They have a unique child security system that set our minds at ease so we could worship with out worry. There is plenty of opportunity to learn, grow and serve.  This is our 3rd year as members of Ten Mile, come join us some Sunday!

We had the best experience resetting my great grandmothers diamond ring and designing my husbands wedding band. Boris is incredible! He is immensely knowledgeable, creative, and passionate about his designs.

I wanted to reset my great grandmother's band to something more practical with a lower profile setting. My husband wanted a low profile, timeless, and classy band and Borris overdelivered for us and fast! Our rings were ready in only a couple of weeks. We are so thrilled with how everything came out there is no one more trust worthy, qualified, or creative as Boris. We can't wait to refer all of our friends and family to Shmukler Jewelry Design.

We showed up without reservations with 26 people, including 17 teenagers.  Mi Casa couldn't have been more accommodating.  The wait staff was fantastic friendly.  They handled the large group with mutiple tabs with ease!  We will definitely be back!
Loved the ice cream bar with pretzels, chocolate, and caramel. What an incredible idea that made my taste buds go crazy. Super yummy. I definitely recommend!

Went in last October to change my plan. Sales rep was helpful and said we qualified for a veterans discount. We retired and all we wanted to do was to reduce my data. My bill was about $90.00 a month at that time. After their vet discount my bill went up to 110.00 a month. Went in and got a different sales rep who said it takes a couple of months for discount to become effective. Bill still stayed 110.  Until last month when it went down to 85.00. Went in every month since October and was told they would credit me the money back within two months and they even called the main company. Here we are eight months later and still nothing. I have had AT&T since they started in business. I'm not one to complain but if you are a veteran and they offer you a discount you will get ripped off. I am switching to Consumer Cellular and with the same plan I had with my so called veterans discount at AT&T I will only have to pay $45.00. Pretty crappy service for veterans I think.

I will never I repeat never go into the store again. They have a sign out front stating that it's the law you have to wear a mask. The two ladies that were running the cash register's both had masks on one was below her mouth and the other one was below her nose. They might as well have not worn a mask. The lady kept trying to touch my phone to see my coupon and I had to tell her to stop. This place is a germ factory. I believe the one with the mask below her nose was the manager so believe me she should have known. We stood in one line while the cashier talked chitchatted and gossiped about some guy named Jim and then finally looked up at us and said oh this register is not working you have to go stand in the other line we had stood there five minutes. I suppose that was our fault but the other line was long I will never I repeat again never go into the store again

Being on keto, means you have to make some sacrifices, but this place just made me realize that donuts aren't one thing you have to sacrifice, I bought three donuts open up the box and said "wow". I couldn't decide which one to eat first so I took a bite out of each one, phenomenal!  I love chocolate, so I had the chocolate overload, the cookie dough and cookies and cream donuts.   I would highly recommend this place for anybody wanting to satisfy their sweet tooth without all the sugar.  If I'm ever back in the Boise area, I will be back here

I called this company for a estimate, a female that answered the phone was rude and disrespectful,later I found on my written estimate copy a note she had written, I felt  hurt and disrespected like a customer at a restaurant after reading a hurtful comment written by a waitress on a receipt.The guy that gave me an estimate was a great guy.It's sad that some people hurt their own companies.
Soooo good. We always have it delivered and it stays completely frozen! So many options to choose from
5 Guys is always great. It's a fantastic option for gluten-free folks. Dedicated fryer for the french fries. Burger can be lettuce wrap or in a bowl with all the fixing and sauces.

I should have wrote a review a long time ago, but now is better than never. Let me start out by saying I have gone to this location and many others MANY times and every single time I have gone I always have the best experience with every location but this is my favorite! The staff is what makes me love it so much. All of the drinks I've gotten are so good, but the staff is even better! They are kind every single time. They all seem so happy and always put a smile on my face. Best location with the best employees!!!

So far, i love this place. 

It's got a rowing machine, stationary bikes, treadmills, a stair master, and yes- they do have ellipticals. 

They also have free weights, weight training machines, yoga mats, them exercise balls (i see people sit on them in work places) battle ropes, and everything you'd expect at a regular gym. 

Love the attitude here- everyone is always cleaning up the machines after they use it. 

The bathrooms are clean. The shower is nice- these are individual showers in a room. 
It's extra nice that it's not a gang shower with some creepy old dude being neked. 

I spoke to one of the owners, she said they just took over a month ago. I don't know how it used to be. But they have a friendly inviting vibe. They keep the place clean and nice. There are some older 'regulars' and it's good to see that there are people that are regulars. Clearly this gym is doing it right by me!

This is a mixed review.  When I went in I ordered a hamburger with ketchup and pickles, drink and onion rings.  The burger was okay however it had gristle that was on the outside edges of the burger.  They used the long pickles which was different.  The onion rings were good.  Most places I've ordered onions rings they seem to fall apart however these were solid.  I didn't try any of the deserts so, they may be what brings people in.

In town for a business trip and have stayed here several times. Being Platinum Elite I love staying at any all Marriott's to rack up the points. Here are my quick observations from this stay. 

PRO's:
-  Newer property. Not sure when it was built but the building is well maintained and cleaned. 
-  Room is pretty spacious with a king size bed. Small kitchenette with a counter depth fridge, love sofa, desk/work station, and a 32" flat screen tv. 
-  Standard Paul Mitchell toiletries 
-  Staff has always been great. Friendly, attentive, and tell you the food options in the immediate area. 
-  Hot breakfast starts at 6am
-  Gym and indoor pool
-  If you didn't get a rental car they do have a airport shuttle. 

CON's:
-  Not specific to this hotel, but all Marriotts it seems. They stopped putting shower caps in the bathrooms. 
-  Like others have said, they don't really recognize status here. Not a big deal, but usually they'll ask if you want something from the snack bar. All I was offered was some Keebler cookies or some Goldfish? I felt like I was 8 years old haha!
-  My recommendation would be to allow guests to roll some dice for extra points or spin the wheel for some more points like a lot of the other Marriotts do. Not a big deal. 

All in all, this hotel is a great value for the location and cleanliness along with the friendliness of the staff. Will be back next month when work duties call.

Great place to buy a Harley from people who know and own Harleys.
They have all the new models and a super selection of used models.
I bought a used 2014 Fat Boy with low miles and some warranty left.
What a fun bike at a great price from Harley people.

My new favorite coffee place. I don't leave reviews, but this place is awesome. The staff and coffee are both amazing.

The Frozen Maui is my go to.

Authentic? I think not. If you are looking for the real deal go to Pantera Market off the Franklin exit or Tacos El Rey in Nampa off the Garrity exit. The only thing this place has going for its self is the location and the open space. Their tacos are way overpriced. The only good thing about it is their presentation of the food. My stomach was hurting for days.

Good menu with some nice offerings for food and beverages. We had a freshly made Papusa with some smoothies. The smoothies were delicious. They have tropical, PB Banana and Nutella, Antigua blast and berry party as options for smoothies. Lots of options for lunch and dinner as well as freshly brewed coffee with beans from Guatemala. Service was great. Staff is friendly and welcoming. Cafe is clean and comfortable.
Best donut I have ever had.   I generally would not eat a donut. Bit with whey protein and other wholesome ingredients I ate it with no guilt.   Ps. Who would have guessed in Idaho.

I've been here several times and every time the person I used previous had quit.  The girl who cut my hair this last time didn't seem to have a clue what she was doing.  Waste of fifteen dollars. 
They can't seem to keep employees and hire the under qualified, I won't go back.

Great little place but not a five star drive across town for Mexican food.  I would return if / when I'm on that side of town but three star is more appropriate for the food and atmosphere.  

Nice local place please try before going to one of those "national chain" places.

super fast service- food flavors was good. 
cute little place and plenty of parking. 
our party was for 4 and we loved all our meals. 
decor was fun.
This place is the BEST! Don't settle for those corporate chains. Coffee was so delicious
I've had a root canal, a crown and crown replacement done here. Dr. Howard is awesome and knows what he's doing, and his staff is just as awesome.

We had the pork fajitas for two. Sooooo goood! And so much food! I can't describe how creamy the bean dip is or how light and crispy the chips are-- the best! Our waiter was working the whole floor on a Tuesday afternoon but he was attentive and prompt. They are taking social distancing seriously and cleaning well. Strongly recommend!

We wanted to view a listing through them but you can't call them or email them. Instead they give you a link to click on a showtime. Every single time I click on a listing, there are no show times on any of them. Plus, I have tried to unsubscribe to their emails but I get about a dozen a day. Whatever you do, don't give them your email. How do they expect to rent out places if none of them are available for viewing and there's no way of getting in touch with them? Sounds like a possible scam to me.

We have used Academy Mortgage with both of our houses and have been so impressed. Our first gal is no longer there, but we went with Ryan Shelby last time and he was outstanding. They have gone above and beyond to let us know what we needed to do to get approved both times. Great company! Have sent several friends there!

I spend a lot of time on the road for work and I have had some pretty bad burgers handed out to me.  This Dairy Queen nailed it today with one of the best burgers I have had in along time.  The sandwich was put together and look very appealing when I unwrapped it.  Everything was hot and fresh, fries not overly salter or reheated.  When in Meridian I will remember this location.

They were ok.  I should have done the carne asada instead of the brisket.  The brisket was bland--more like pot roast.  Also, the grilled cheese added to my wife's taco was odd--a plastic sheet of cheese should not be on a taco.  Overall, they were average for the price you pay.

First time at McDonald's in years. Had a hankering for some fries.

The Drive Thru was empty and service was fast. We ordered 2 large fries and 2 large drinks.

I am very disappointed at the quantity of fries. Looked like 2 small orders in 2 large containers. 

Won't be going back there.

Always enjoy having my nails done by Raquel. 
I had my nails ruined by another salon and she fixed it and more. Everyone at Amore has their own style and can do nails well. Highly recommend

We had some basic clean-up we were looking for help with in our flowerbeds. We called Diamond Lawns and were quote $85 for an hour with two individuals cleaning up. We expressed we're OK with that and if it went over by just a little, if they looked like they were nearing completion, we'd be open to a little more. The crew arrived (three individuals), did a good job pulling grass out of the beds and were done within an hour. Both of us were home during the whole clean-up and nobody came to us with anything other than to say they were done. We were prepared to pay the $85 right then but were told they couldn't accept any kind of payment; the office would take care of that. 

Two days later we received an invoice for $110. Naturally, we called to ask where the difference was. Stuart at Diamond Lawns stated the additional charge was for the third member of his crew. Asking for clarification Stuart said he was on the truck from the job before us and he couldn't just have another member of his crew not paid for even though we agreed to a crew of 2 for one hour. He said it was unlikely they could have gotten it done in an hour with just two so it shouldn't matter. I asked how this is the case when I watched the third individual carry around a garbage can for an hour. Again, home the whole time. Stuart stated we expressed satisfaction with the end result so they assumed all was ok. I asked Stuart "so what you're saying is you assumed we'd be ok with being charged more because we were satisfied with the result and because he put another person on the crew from a job before us?" Stuart replied "that's basically it yes."

Diamond Lawn quoted us $25 less than they charged us because they elected to add another person to their crew without any communication beforehand on the additional charge and "assumed" it would be ok. It should be noted we paid the $110 because we're honorable people. Diamond Lawn however, well, let's just say that's the kind of business practice that won't last long. We will never work with them again.

The front desk woman was very friendly, even gave me directions when I was lost. In addition, she told me about additional specials the European wax center was running. 
The woman who did my waxing was great;good energy, friendly, fast, and did a fantastic job. Very professional. 
Would recommend to anyone.
No thanks No inventory everything has be be ordered which I can do myself cheaper. I wouldn't waist your time pass on by and hit Hobbytown.

Unless you like getting about a dozen emails a day do not contact this place. They will harass you endlessly and when you finally give in and try to schedule a showing, there aren't any available. And based on the rest of the reviews that I am seeing here it looks like I dodged a MASSIVE bullet by not renting from them.
Dr. Baker goes above and beyond to make his clients smile! I highly recommend Prehab for chiropractic care!

Kanak has a wonderful new cafe in the Boise Plaza building in downtown Boise. I've always loved their food truck food but now we get to try such a rich variety of Hawaiian foods by their amazing chefs. This includes their take on fresh salads, soups and they have their own onsite baker who makes amazing savory and sweet; pastries, muffins, breads and desserts. They also have a freshly made to order sushi bar and smoothie bar/acai bowls. I love to add their homemade macadamia nut butter.

We visited from out of state and decided to come to this donut shop on the recommendation from local family, and it was so good!! The donuts are warm, a little crunch, and so soft on the inside! All of the toppings are very, very fresh! From freshly melted hot fudge, to their blueberry icing mixture. DEFINITE RECOMMEND!! And their breakfast sandwiches are delicious as well! 

Staff is very friendly and the building is clean!
Not impressed. Beef sandwich was hot in some places but mostly cold overall. Bread was dry and hard on the end, I'd call it stale.

I went through the drive thru about an hour ago. I enjoyed the fries in the car, and my pumpkin pie cement (which was a pumpkin pie shake that had pie chunks in it. Needless to say, it was amazing.) I thought this place was great, it was my first time eating there. 

Until I got to my chicken sandwich. First of all, it looks nothing like the picture on the menu (it looked breaded and crispy, except it was grilled.) and two, it didn't have anything on it. Not even the top of the bun. It was literally this soggy, chewy piece of chicken on a piece of soggy bread. This was all very disappointing, this place seemed good. 

When I called to let them know, the lady I talked to started out happy and nice. But when I mentioned that they left the whole top of my sandwich off, she became bitter and didn't even attempt to apologize in any way, shape, or manner. Thanks, now I'm still hungry. 

The ONLY reason I give them two stars is because of their custard an their fries. Other than that, I will most definitely not be referring people to Freddy's. There are a lot better places to eat in Boise (example- Smash Burger).

to We went for dinner to watch the Oregon/Texas game on the last night my daughter was with us before she went back to school. The food was TERRIBLE! 

1)  mozzarella sticks-The inside is suppose to be soft and gooey.  These had cheese that was still cool and  solid.
2) BBQ Rib ends- They tasted disgusting- the ribs were old!
3) Singapore wings-  We didn't get wings.  We got chicken mcnuggets/strips coated with buffalo wing sauce... NOT the asian spicy sauce.
4)  PIZZA- I ordered a pizza with cheese, mushrooms, onion and canadian bacon.  My pizza had an undercooked crust, very little cheese that WASN'T completely melted and no  canadian bacon.  It truly was worse than a supermarket cheap cheap pizza.

We spent $68.83 on truely the WORST meal we have EVER had. (receipt #170248, table 54)

Not exactly sure what went wrong, but truely horrible food.

Popped in for a tire check while visiting my son at BSU. Can't speak to all the issues noted here, but was greeted by a salesman who was friendly and just glad to help without trying to sell me something. Took the time to show me some different handle bar options and answer questions even though he knew I was not local and not buying. Service staff jumped right on the tire check and I left wishing I lived closer as this place felt very welcoming compared to the dealer near me that is a third the size and has eight sales people I have to fight off just to get to the service dept.

Poor service. I have came here multiple times due to convenience. However every time I have been here either my food is served cold or items are missing. The only thing that is consistent is the lackluster service.

The company sucks out loud. For the renter, there is no response. Try to talk to someone besides the knuckle head receptionist and you will get no where. Nothing but problems, over billing and lack of service. End of story, RUN!!!!!

There are two Growler Guys in the Boise - the one that I visited was a small one at the end of several stores. A smallish, quiet place where you can taste and imbibe in many beers - mostly local, regional, and a few national brands and oh boy, too many to sample and order.
I visited during a quiet weekday and the friendly, knowledgeable beer tender behind the bar made great recommendations and samples. A good way to end the day sampling and enjoying some great tasting beer!

I really wanted to like this place. I only give it 2 stars cause I love all the sauce options and the staff was nice. Burgers were so burnt and somehow tasteless despite all the ingredients on it. Tried the yam fries and they also were so burnt and just unedible. Got 2 burger meals for almost $40 and hv never been so disappointed.

Well, I hate to say this about a new business but this place is awful and merits this review. I went in and ordered 12 tacos and spent $33 in doing so: 4 chicken, 4 carne asada, 2 supremes, 1 brisket, and 1 lobster. I ordered to go as I live less than a mile away and waited 20 minutes for my order. The inside of the place is nice and looks clean. There is a machine that takes balls of tortilla dough and turns them into tortillas. So, imagine thinking that you are about taco pig out on freshly made tortillas filled with tender asada, chicken, and lobster. What I got was a mess. All of the tacos were ICE cold, I'm talking freezing, cold to the touch. So cold, the tortillas were almost hard in places. There was very little ingredients in each taco relative to the tortilla size and the tortillas were not freshly made but store bought. The lobster taco had so much sauce on it the tortilla was soggy but there was a adequate amount of lobster. The asada meat itself was decent but there was a large dollop of guac on one side of the taco and virtually no cheese. The chicken tacos didn't have much flavor. The Supreme tacos were probably the worst as they were filled with cold ground beef and retried beans. There is virtually no way I am coming back here. I wish I had taken more pictures but just ended up so pissed that I threw everything away. $33 in the trash.

Pretty bummed with the new ownership, and from the reads of recent reviews, I'm not the only one. A lot has changed, I've been back 3 times to give it a go but to no avail, it's not as good as it once was. I used to be ecstatic over the wings but they discontinued my favorite flavors, and cut the options down to half of what they had. Don't fix what isn't broke.

I'm so excited I LOVE Gandolfos especially their pastrami and reubens and their breakfast sandwiches are AWESOME!! . I ate there every morning, when I lived in Utah - and this one has a drive thru!!! This made my day!!

This review is specifically to give a shout out to the manager.  Yesterday I ran into grab a couple of burritos to go.  Apparently I set my purse down while I went to the salsa bar and forgot to grab it on my way out the door with my burritos.  By the time I realized my purse was missing and searched high and low for it the restaurant had closed.  I called this morning at 9am (they don't open until 10:30am) and spoke with the manager who confirmed that I did leave the described bag in the restaurant.  I was told that he had it held safely in the office and he had not gone through it yesterday because he was waiting for me to come back.  When I went to pick up my purse today he also verified that I was in fact the proper owner (picture ID in purse) before allowing me to take it.  I am grateful that they take these steps for security purposes and I am even more grateful to have my purse bag with nothing missing.  Thank you thank you!

BTW... The burritos were delicious (as always)!  I even got one free with my stamp card :)

Had to make some switches on our AT&T account due to personal issues. Eric was very kind and helpful in getting everything sorted out. He took his time to look at what options were best for us. This visit to AT&T was a lot easier than it could have been and it's because Eric was really helpful. Also, they were taking extra precautions as a store to keep everyone safe during the Covid Pandemic. Extra hand sanitizer, spraying disinfectant and face masks. Thank you for a great visit!
They reached out to me with a very sincere apology and want to make things right. To me that means a heck of a lot!  I will give them another try and I'm excited to see the improvements.

90 minutes to give blood and they took over 20 vials
They had no clue what they were doing and were googling the codes
They blamed my doctor, but I can read the labwork just fine.
My doctor says the 20 + vials is "beyond crazy"
Im pretty angry about this as I have no idea if what they tested for is correct and (shocker) their phone number does not connect to a person

Ordered the Cali Breakfast Burrito and all I can say is it's underwhelming and definitely no where close to a California breakfast burrito. It appears they don't fully cook the bacon (and don't give you much of it) and wrap it up in a tortilla with cheddar cheese that doesn't melt. The main part of this burrito is under seasoned potatoes and over cooked eggs. They give you a side of what I assume they think is pico de gallo but it's just diced tomatoes with onions. The beans and rice is okay, nothing special, same with the burrito. Been looking all over this state for some decent Mexican food and a good breakfast burrito. This place definitely isn't it. Bland, under 
 seasoned, and no where close to actual Mexican food. I'd order something else on the menu. So disappointing, plus they charge you $20.00 for it, you'd think it'd actually be better.

Food is phenomenal &' presentation is good! The aesthetic of the place is cute. I don't recommend any of their drinks. The coffee is watery &' bitter, smoothies have ice chunks, &' orange juice is sparkling orange juice. Service is hit or miss. 
Had to wait to be seated because our hostess asked a busboy to wipe our table &' another employee came up complaining about a bathroom key. My hostess asked 3-4 times for him to wipe the table while being spoken over by the conversation about the key. The other girl who came up to complain then told the busboy to "wipe the f***ing table". Our waitress was blunt &' did not once smile during our visit.
Went to pick up two burgers and fries to take home for dinner. My wife selected the yam fries and ended up with a plate of burnt bits of yams that were neither warm or crunchy.

Wow, I got to see horrendous customer service in action tonight. I didn't realize that the store was closing at 7 o'clock, I truly thought it was going to close at 8pm, so after I walked in one of the employees was standing in the vestibule area and she gave me a look of utter disgust and told me in the nastiest voice "we're closed" after I asked if I was allowed to enter through the door I opened to come into the store. I attempted to apologize and convey my misunderstanding but I was greeted with the same nasty look and rude "we're closed" as if I was some kind of moron. I will NEVER even think to shop here ever again, I'll definitely take my unwelcome money elsewhere.

We were seated quickly and the restaurant was clean. They were short-staffed, but that is the way of the world right now. The server was friendly but looked at me liked I had two heads when I ordered an Arnold Palmer (it was on the menu). The food was disappointing. The pancakes had a very artificial and weird almond extract flavor. I didn't finish my breakfast and stopped somewhere else to eat on the way home.
Always treated with courtesy, great staff had to go in for an ingrown toenail today.  NP Jessica was a 10 on helping me out.

Have bought 3 Harleys from there over a 6 year period , had issues with each bike that weren't addressed during their pre-sale I spection. This 3rd bike I caught a error in trade in dollar amount between their deal paperwork and my final finance paperwork. Return today and was told it was correct. They do a bate and switch tactic. Offered me 12,720 on my bike and salesman pointed to it and said here trade value and right above it was 12,000. Next to the 720 it said tax credit which I didn't see. So when I returned today they told me that's the credit I got in taxes since I traded in. That's not how it works , I already paid taxes on the the one. Simple paperwork at any dealer shows one trade in price and one purchase price then on final finance you pay tax on the difference. I have friends that work there and love the Harley culture and going there as a destinations but every time I seem to screw myself trusting them and buying bikes. Their finance method is shady and unethical so either don't buy there or really look over every line of paperwork. Service dept inspections are marginal so really look over any bike you purchase. The parts dept is awesome and go on and above and salesmen are always friendly and go above , just shady ways selling.
I was hoping today they would just make it right, I would have even been ok with in house credit even but no dice.

After brunch with some girlfriends, we decided to pop into Duck Donuts for a little sweet treat. Not disappointed! The soft, cakey donut covered in icing and toppings: 10/10 WOULD RECOMMEND. So many flavor options, gonna gain some lbs. Will definitely be back!

These cakes are yummy!   Moist, with real buttercream frosting.  Expensive  But worth it. It's a franchise so you're technically patronizing local owners, the shop is cute, with little gift items, and the service is friendly.  

Their lemon is my fav but with all our monthly birthdays at the office, I've tried them all and NONE are lacking in luster.  

If you can handle the trip on Eagle Road, I highly recommend
Very good service rented from them often and have never had an issue! Highly suggest this place for all your rental needs!

We LOVE bfc and I'm a big French fry fan. Their online ordering system is pretty bad, so we always call. But today I called and at the end of the order I specified how many burgers I ordered, we agreed on 5. We brought the food all the way home and there were only 4 burgers in the bag. And one of the two sets of fries was really overdone. We brought this dinner to our in laws and being short an entire burger and having half the fries as rock solid was a big disappointment. I think it will be a while until we return .

After many visits here I can't say enough about how great this place is! All the ladies are so friendly, and do a great job. Stephanie is my stylist and she's amazing. The owner is super nice & always has tips for you. They're not expensive at all. Overall great shop. I definitely found my forever salon!

I just purchased two blizzards. Unfortunately this location is only pick up with not even a single table open for dining. They don't even have covers for the ice creams on the go, apparently not even giving a thought that with hot weather the ice cream will melt easily. Needlessly to say the Blizzards were liquid by the time I got home and they made a mess inside the car. I learned my lesson but my advice is for people to avoid places that don't even make an effort to have a table open for dinning in which could easily be cleaned after each customer. I would give them zero stars if I could.

The food is fresh and delicious! I love the variety. And I love the consistency, every time we come in here we have a fabulous meal!
My daughter said, " I came in not very hungry and left craving more."
The staff is awesome...keep up the happy vibe....the music is different everyday and they remember your drink and name always

Back in the day the food was so delicious. Not sure what happened to their standards or their recipes or the fact they are that accepting of bad customer service. After trying them out again recently twice at an event and food truck rally... I can officially say the coconut rice is bland, the mac salad is nothing like it use to be and tasteless, and the chicken was super dried out. Even their sauce was so watered down it was unbelievable! Disappointed. Used to be my favorite Hawaiian food in all of Idaho. Never again.
This used to be a great and colorful place. Now you can tell no one wants to work here and the food downgraded so bad that it's nasty to even see the food

My first impression of this place is meh.

The chip had been good though the salsa tasted like watery tomatoes.
El Pastor street tacos so awful, couldn't be finished. Carne Asada street tacos actually weren't too bad.

Only plus side, the margaritas-  delicious and unique.

We went in on a Saturday morning for breakfast, the food and the service was incredible!! Everyone we met thoroughly loved their experience.

The food was perfect. Perfectly cooked absolutely delicious and made exactly to order much better than we ever expected.

Our service was off the chain! Our server was Jamie, she was awesome and friendly and made the entire experience wonderful. She get 10 Stars!!!! 

We will be going back time and time again this place is great!!!
Ive taken my boys here for years they always get them in really quick no apt needed! Most the girls have been there a long time. Very affordable too

Terry Anderson was wonderful to work with! He even offered to drive to my house one time to pick up some documents because he knew my printer was giving my trouble and I was busy with my two small children.

I went in with my son to buy a charger for one of his RC toys, and I was blown away by how great the customer service is there.  All the employees are very knowledgeable, and they clearly enjoy their work, it really shows.  I'm also considering a purchase of a quad copter for areal photography, and the owner of the store actually owns the unit I had investigated.  After we talked, I had a full appreciation of how unprepared I am to get into that level of control and power.  So I ended up purchasing a MUCH smaller copter to practice and learn on.  In theory, they saved me a 3K headache, and for that I'm very appreciative!  I won't forget that my son and I now have a new hobby that we both seem to enjoy, and there is no price tag that can be placed on that.

This was our first time here. A friend recommended it. I appreciate the social distancing measures and masks however our server was wearing her mask below her nose and took it off every time she went behind the server's area. I'm sorry but there is just no excuse for this in our current time. I wear a mask and shield for 10+ hours, it can be done. Now on to the food. It was very good. We had stuffed French toast with eggs and bacon and a Monte Carlo. The chia latte was good but pricey and the Bloody Mary was ..... weird? It had a lime taste and was very heavy on the pepper. Not bad just not the usual taste. Service was definitely slow and it was a Wednesday. Probably won't come back.

Tired and didn't want to go to far from hotel.  So, why not something quick.  Turned out their California steak burger was a winner.  Got a pineapple malt and onion rings. 

Service was fast, friendly and efficient.  Better than average thus the 4 stars.
So good. Burgers are so good. Fries are super thin and yummy. The turtle custard hit the spot. Perfect fast service.

Today was our first visit and it definitely won't be our last! We can see why TJ is the employee of the month and I hope that Austin will be the employee of the month next! Both were so friendly. My daughter loved watching Austin decorate our donuts and he moved closer to us so she could see better. He talked to her about our mommy daughter day that we're having and she was so happy leaving that she told me she wants to come back and see him every day lol. 

A great start to our day together. Thanks for the awesome service!!

This company has the worst customer service ever! Emma the girl who answers the phone is so rude. She also talks super slow like she doesn't care that your time is valuable. They will not even go out to the property without a credit card. I won't ever recommend them. Not easy to work with!!

Typically great pizza and fast delivery/service. Must have been a busy night, but delivery was projected for 60 minute and turned into a little under 2 hours... paid prior pineapple to be added and it wasn't and pizza was a lil overcooked. We will try again but not as soon as we typically do.

They gave me the wrong order so i knocked on the door and an employee refused to help me and told me to use the drive through again to correct it. It took another 35 minutes and then they told me to park out front and they would help me (whaaaaaat????)  And then it was another 20 minutes before an employee came out to help me, and then another 25 minutes to get the correct order. Go literally ANYWHERE else

The meals here are probably the most authentic thing we've found in the Boise area.  I've been enjoying Mexican food my entire life, even taking cooking classes in Mexico so a good wet carne asada burrito is important to me and this place delivers!

Great coffee. Great breakfast burritos. Great vibes. 

The staff is always very friendly to me and my pups, but not excessive (like some other coffee stops). Easy access from the road for the double drive through. Not a lot of parking if you go in, but the inside is super cute and offers a great place to chat with friends or do homework. The coffee is 10/10 hot or iced and I very much appreciate the simple menu. There's always delicious muffins and other treats to satisfy your cravings. My personal favorite are their breakfast burritos. They never disappoint!!

Review # 18

I wasn't a fan. Waited 19 minutes for my food. I checked in on Yelp and they refused the coupon check in offer saying they don't do that and it's not real. The manager was talked to and said they don't accept this form of coupon. Not all locations have this check in offer, so, ummm ok... 

The food was just okay. Nothing special at all. The customer service was average but I did like the salsa bar. It was well stocked and fresh looking/smelling.

Believe the reviews folks, I did and found out that HDHD Rocks!

Rode my 2 Duece in spitin and coughin on a xcountry ride. Deon Lewellen in service took my pain to heart and got me taken care of as quick as he could. Luckily it was only a bad plug. A set of plugs and $90 later I was rolling east again. During my wait the crew at HDHD treated me like royalty. That's the kind of place I'd like to work.

Worst customer service/fast food experience i've ever had. Ordered there $20 take out deal with me picking it up since we weren't home. As soon as i placed the order i get a confirmation from door dash saying a driver is there to pick up my food and deliver it to my house when my receipt clearly says i will pick it up myself. I called panda express for clarification and the store manager was useless and wasn't even willing to look into it. He told me he had no clue what happened. Door dash told me this was all done thru panda express. Ended up having to cancel my order 45 minutes later because of this. Horrible experience. STILL WAITING FOR A REFUND!
UPDATE: after being told my order was cancelled but not receiving any confirmation i decided to call back just to be told we couldn't cancel your order!!! So you charge me for food i didn't even pick up and refuse to refund me. Shady business practice. Will file a complaint with the BBB.

I've been shopping around for a road bike and stopped in today after being completely ignored at another popular bike shop. I had a wonderful experience and will definitely be back in to test ride some bikes when I have more time. Thanks!

Like so many things in life, we all have different experiences. This usually depends on a persons taste. I don't like grease. If you like grease, you will love this place. The fries had so much grease on em that they soaked the bag they were put in. The burger is not much better. Nothing but grease. So if you like grease, you will really like this place. If you are like me and prefer a burger and not grease, you will hate this place.
My favorite pizza place in the area.  I go there often and the restaurant is clean, the service is great and the servers are friendly.  The food is excellent.
We were looking for some good Mexican food places in meridian....first time at this place it was YUM!!!! Happy customer ...me & the hubs will be back for sure! :)

Tried this place last night.  We got the White Chick burrito, and the char broiled chicken bowl.  The food was good, but there were too many people standing around behind the counter.  If you go into Costa Vida, they are spread out and efficient.  

I realize this is a new restaurant and young people need jobs, but this could hurt them in the long run.  The food was good, the portions were smaller than Costa Vida, or Chipotle, but it is worth it.  

The food was fresh and good.

Easily one of the best experiences I've ever had at the dentist. Everyone was incredibly organized, professional, and friendly. Seriously, if you're looking for a dentist in the Treasure Valley, look no further.

Nachos are awful like inedible. Barely any chips wayy too much cheese. I don't understand how you mess up nachos. I will never be back but that's just me. Also very overpriced for the quality of food. Food was gross only ate two bites and threw the rest away.

Do not take a cooking class (or shop here in general)!  I signed my wife and child up for a cooking class on Mother's Day, only for them to be rejected at the door by the extremely rude "chef".  
Backstory... most of their child classes require the child to be 8 years old, this one however was listed on the registration site for 8 and younger.  I had assumed this was because it was with a parent.  To make sure, I went to the store the day before to verify my child (not yet 8) could attend.  They told me the child had to be 8, but I pointed them to the registration site.  They confirmed and even went to the kitchen to confirm.  
Fast forward to Mother's Day, when my wife and child arrived they were told they could not participate (awesome Mother's Day surprise completely ruined) and there could be no exception made.  
Very sad for my wife and especially our child who came up with this idea as a Mother's Day surprise.

As I walked in there was 4 people on the floor place was empty. Not a greeting or a welcome in. I waited for 5 minutes just being looked at by all these workers until a girl came out from the back and looked confused I made eye contact with her and said no I have not been helped. She came up and thankfully enough I submitted an order online. Gave her my name and they had it ready to go because she grabbed it from the freezer so I guess the time I spent waiting to get help of any kind was the time it would have taken for them to make my order. All in all terrible service don't recommend coming here for a while.
Dr. White is great! Super professional and caring. My husband and I needed a new chiropractor and he got us in quickly. We both got great adjustments! Highly recommend!
Great place! Good service, a little slower because of staffing, I was looking for good fajitas and I found them! Good chips and salsa. Great beef enchilada. Nice location.

Clean and staff was friendly and helpful. Only complaint is that I ordered my sandwich cold (hot day) and it was made hot. Flavor and value were both good. Will try a different sandwich next time and update.

I am a business own with a small local business and found out I have to move locations in October 2017.  I found a commercial building in the "Bellissima" business complex, that Bolton Property Management runs, that I wanted to rent.

The application did not go through via internet, 2x of filling it out.  They said to come in and fill out the application.  Everyone seemed nice at first.

I set up a time with Cory to check the building out.  He was 15 minutes late to viewing. I told Cory I didn't want to pay double rent (my place I was in and the "Bellissima" rent). And asked if I put the deposit down could he hold it for a month.  He did not like the idea, even though "no" other applications had been submitted for the building.

After a week I decided I would pay dbl rent and called Cory back.  His receptionist(s) said he was in a meeting and then the 2nd time I called back they said Cory was on vacation.  I called back another week later and the receptionist "Bailey" said he was still on vacation, now making it 2 weeks he was out of the office, and said "Umm I suggest looking for another place to rent from".

Cory told me that potentially he wanted to not just rent one room out to myself, but the 2 rooms available and the receptionist area.  I gratefully found another place that knows how to do business with the general public.  I called to get my $35 application fee back, calling 5x and leaving a 1 vm.  They never picked up the phone, I went into  Bolton Property Management and they said "Oh yeah we got your vm" but Corys in a meeting lol.

This company had all my updated contact info and never once reached back.

Took pie and gallette class.  They had two groups of 4 people and 1 group of 5 people.  How the heck are 5 people supposed to roll out pie dough for one gallette.  For $69 per person for this class, I think it was the biggest rip off ever.  They always pair people up - if you're any kind of student or cook - you want to do this on your own.  Not share the tasks with a bunch of other people.  I took the sheet pan dinner earlier in the week and we were paired up but I was in a group of 3. Not sure why they think people want to pay this money for a hands on class and have to share the tasks.  So ridiculous.   I will never take another cooking class at Sur la Table.

After being to the other VS and online, I was finally able to find what I needed at this location. The staff was also able to get my order straightened out that BM did wrong. The selection is amazing and it's less crowded than Boise. I'll be back.
Worst experience ever!! Marcus is a horrible waiter and to make matters worse the owner didn't even care about the way my family and I were treated! Would give 0 if I could

Color me impressed! We were looking for a local spot for a birthday takeout and came across Mi Casa. I found the the portions were FAR larger than I expected for the price and none of us were able to finish our meals in one sitting. We also enjoyed their Salsa - delicious without being overly spicy. Also, I will dream about those chips - so great. I'd suggest you order a big ole side of chips and salsa.

We are a family who loves spice foods, so for us, the more generally appealing spice level was a bit of a downside. However, one person got the Chipotle Chicken and was pleasantly surprised in the mole style kick it provided. We were pleased and very full (with lunch the next day) so we will definitely be back. The online ordering link also made this an easy process - winner winner!

This is a charming little drive through in Meridian. When social distancing is over, there is a little bit of indoor seating (with gorgeous house plants...swoon). But for now, drive through for the win! 

I'm a drip coffee gal so that's all I've had. Mt Timber tends to have some more fruity coffees and I like it! Mix in some 1/2 and 1/2 and it's perfect. They have amazing breakfast burritos! You must get one. I don't know where the scones come from. But the one that I had was lemony, slightly sweet and had nice fresh blueberries. 

Don't get out of your PJs and get some delicious drive through coffee!

This is a great place for a haircut!  Professional, clean and honest along with great prices compared to most places in the area.  I went to this place for the first time and Meghan did a great job cutting my hair.   It was the best hair cut I've had in a long, long time.  I strongly recommend getting your haircut here!

We got our name on the list and waited in our car for about 45 minutes. Once we got seated and placed our order, the waitress then informed us the kitchen was running about an hour behind. It would have been nice to know that when we added our name to the waitlist. A 45 minute wait just turned into an almost 2 hour total wait for food. The server was nice and was trying her best during a very busy morning. We got the monte cristo (which was pretty good!) and the huevos rancheros (it was disappointing). The menu is pretty big though and I'm sure we'll try something out again. Hopefully the wait times and kitchen delays improve in the future.

We had heard good things about Sweeto Burrito and they didn't disappoint! Food was good but had an issue with our door dash. Half of the order was gone. Called up Sweeto Burrito and Mike (asst mngr) and Caleb (?) we some of the best customer service I have received. Far above any fast food joint I have eaten out at. Solid food, solid service and do yourself a favor and some churros

Not a destination.  It's a last resort type when all your faves are packed.  Their hash looked like it came out of a can/ flavorless.  The sausage gravy was missing....sausage.  If you like average at best food with great service by all means do go.  It's bright and airy and noisy.  Too bad.
Very good subs, but skip the banana pudding desert (it's terrible).

I needed a quick pick-me-up and this tiny coffee hut seemed to the be only drive-thru near me. It's located right near downtown Meridian in a small, quaint little building. 

I had an iced vanilla latte. While it was yummy and did the job, it was just a little too sweet for my liking. I did grab a delicious lemon bar that was just the right amount of crumbly and zesty-ness! I'd love to go back when I have some more time to enjoy the outdoor seating area and more pastries!
