Restaurants, bars, gyms, pools are open all over town, but not the Marriott! They would not service our room, had to ask for toilet paper, Kleenex, towels, etc. No hot breakfast, cold cheese omelet and  no meats? Doesn't make sense other than they are saving money at our expense. I could have easily heated up the omelet and bacon/sausage, but no! No proteins/meats for you! Stayed five miserable nights. The pool/spa and gym closed, they stated it was due to lack of staff! Why should we expect less because you are not calling in more staff. I phoned and walked over to the Hilton TRU, they share the parking lot,  they were serving breakfast sausage sandwiches, oatmeal, bananas, granola bars, juice...not the Marriott! Hilton allowed usage of the pool and spa. Phoned Marriott Corporate and they promised to reduce our stay expense(points), when we reviewed our account and nothing had been done we called back the next day and they decided not to compensate us at all. After an hour and twenty minute wait, we were finally seated (and only because we complained about the open tables ... apparently they were "waiting" to seat us (4 adults, 2 small kids (1 & 3yo) at a corner table while other tables that could have equally fit us remained open. My husband liked the hashbrowns and thought they were a good amount of crispy, and he was satisfied with the Monte Cristo sandwich. Temperature was an issue for his food too. The caprese Benedict was great- I love a good arugula, mozzarella and tomato mixture, and the green sauce was flavorful. The Sope Benedict was good, but would have been waaaay better warm. It was the coldest thing on my plate. The pancake was just standard, good scoop of butter on top. Not the cheapest place, but they have a good amount of food to choose from. Honestly, it reminds me of a very upscale Denny's. Our server was wonderful, our drink were never empty and she brought extra napkins as soon as I asked. Gram Grams is one of my very most favorites in the Meridian area. It deserves every single one of the five stars I've given it. From the local vibe to the variety of delicious eats, to the superb happy hour selection, I'd pick Gramercy over almost any other joint in Meridian on a daily basis. If I were going to be a "regular" somewhere, I'd want it to be at GPPG.

Food: There's not one food item that I've tried that I haven't been in love with. I'll start with the happy hour food menu, as that's usually when we're there. I LOVE the cauliflower Veggie Wings. I have ordered them both buffalo style and spicy Thai peanut style, and both are delicious. The Thai peanut has a heavy hand with the garlic, so be advised that you'll taste it for days (but it's still so worth it!). I typically order the Veggie Wings with a side grilled chicken breast and it's a perfectly (almost) healthy meal. The personal one-topping pizza on the happy hour menu is rock solid. We love ours with their house-made spicy Italian sausage and a side of ranch. What seals the deal for us every time is their Gramercy Bites. We prefer them baked (you have to specify) over deep fried with a side of marinara AND ranch. They used to serve them baked and then switched to fried, so we are fans of the original version. Their grilled mac and cheese sandwich is so good... it's a cheesy, ooey-gooey overload. The salads are also great, nice and big and topped with all the goods. No matter what you order at Gram Grams, you're going to be happy!

Drinks: AWESOME drinks, cocktails, beer, pop, you name it. We prefer to go in during happy hour and order well drinks & draft beers. You can't go wrong. Josh (bartender) makes great drinks!

Atmosphere: We love the vibe at Gramercy. It's not huge, so there aren't a ton of tables. I like that they have options from comfortable booths, to low tables, to high tables, to a private(ish) area in the back as well as bar-top seating. There are tons of options! We love to sit at the bar and watch the foothills & sky in the evenings (and the TV, of course). 

Service: It says something when you see the same people working there who have been there for years. Josh the bartender is our favorite, and we always sit barside when he's there. All of their servers are super nice, helpful and friendly.

Happy Hour Offerings: Mon - Sat 3-6 with food AND drink specials, like $6 personal pizza, $4 Wings & Gramercy Bites, $2 off well drinks, $3 glasses of wine and $2-$3 drafts/cans. We think they have one of the best happy hours in the valley. 

Healthy Hack: Order the veggie wings with an a la carte chicken breast. Or opt for one of their salads!

Tips: Try the BAKED Gramercy Bites. Give the spicy Thai Veggie Wings a shot (over the suggested buffalo). Ask for Josh! :)

The time change is official on November 4, 2019. But had us leave at the earlier time that they had been on the week before. Understandably the hours that they were used to had changed and they weren't expecting it. I get it.

However I just barely walked in and the lady said that I had about five minutes, I kind of just then understood and rush to get the things that I needed. Then within that two minutes there was an announcement that they were going to close and everybody had it to read th however I just barely walked in and the lady said that I had about five minutes, I kind of just then understood and rushed to get the things that I needed. Then within that two minutes there was an announcement that they were going to close and everybody had it then leave the store. A man started approaching me and my daughter and gave me a large glare without any hesitation and told me to leave even when we were looking at the socks.

Then I just put down the one thing of batteries that I was going to buy, and just wanted to leave because I didn't get anything close to what I needed. Then as I proceeded to exit the building the manager approached me and said did you get everything you needed? I replied nope I didn't have any time however I am sad to think that the hours that I looked at for not correct. I then showed him the time on my phone that red 8 o'clock and asked then, if they really closed at 9 o'clock like they reported online. He then replied to me with annoyance and said that the time change isn't until the second week of November. However, it always is the first week and of November just like how it has been for many many years before.

I hope to have a better experience at a different location with a whole other form of management, because I have loved the products I have gotten from biglots in the past.

They take COVID-19 very seriously here.  Obviously you can't wear a mask when they are working on your teeth but hygiene procedures are compliant and professional.

Dr. Hill is still the best dentist I've ever had.  I value a dentist that knows how to minimize pain when administering a topical.  Office manager is not rude as reported in an earlier review. Quite the opposite, a very patient and decent person.

The food was fine. Good options on the menu. I got lunch and hubby got breakfast. The onion rings are awesome. The bloody mary was good, but they use "vodka spirit" not actual vodka. And they didn't have the stuff for the bloody mary flight listed on the menu. It was good and I still enjoyed it.
Hubby said coffee was good and not bitter like so many breakfast places around here.
The reason we will not venture back is the service. Beyond slow and inattentive. All the tables (with limited capacity rules followed) were full and the 3 servers and one hostess had no hustle or sense of urgency at all. The first excuse was for my bloody mary, that the bar was a bit backed up. They only do mimosas and bloody Mary's! Our order was taken quickly, but 25 minutes later and after seeing our food sit on the counter for 10 of those minutes we were finally served. Hubby's coffee was only refilled after he asked and again after way too long for a breakfast place. And then the waitress completely forgot to pick up our card to pay for it.
Over an hour for lunch/brunch was only acceptable because neither one of us had to get back to work. But it was the middle of the week so I'd never recommend for a lunch break.
Not living in Meridian I can say the service alone would keep me from making the drive back to Broken Yolk Cafe.

I can't explain the joy of buying a new or even your first bike! Johnny Robinson here at High Deseret will take you under his wing and show you what you NEED not necessarily what you want. I thought I would fit well on a sportster, Johnny took a hard 5 second look at me and already imagined me on a fat boy. The man knows his stuff very well! And they absolutely make sure you're taken care of and 100% pleased with every step of the process! Thank you so much High Desert!!!

I have been going to European wax for years. I have always had a positive experience until today. I called at 4:28 and according to my GPS I would arrive at their location on Chinden in seven minutes.  Shelby told me that she could get me in at 4:30 I said I'm about seven minutes away I arrived at 4:39 as I walked in the door and Shelby said sorry I'm gonna have to cancel your appointment because once it hits nine minutes we have to reschedule. She was inflexible she didn't care about service and she had a horrible attitude as soon as I let her know that I was recording the conversation all the sudden her attitude changed and she explained the policy and explained why she had to reschedule. In all my years of going there I've never had a time where I was late however I've had several times where I had to wait past nine minutes and they didn't do anything to make up for it. I asked for the manager and she got more attitude and told me that the manager wasn't in and I'd have to just wait until she contacted me. Shelby then sits there while I'm waiting for my appointment and types and types and types that she sending something to the manager this has been the worst experience and then I had to go in and get my nose waxed while I am fuming about Shelby's horrible attitude. I still paid full price I still got my wax and I was still polite to the person that did the wax and gave her a tip however Shelby needs to go bye-bye. I also have a recording where you can hear sure Shelby talk about policy policy policy that I've never had to use I've never had explain to me and I arrive right as it changes to nine minutes completely ridiculous get a clue about customer service Shelby. She certainly doesn't want to continue to have good customers and continue to get a paycheck.
Wow those tacos were freaking awesome. They do need to start labeling them though so you can easily tell which is which when you buy a ton though. Amazingly delicious though.
Food was alright, sauces were good. They add too much salt to the fries I don't often have issues with food. The burger was over priced for what it was.

I don't drink coffee, but I love Dutch Bros! The funny thing is that I don't even ever order anything for myself from here, but I still give it 5 stars. Here's why:
I have 2 teenagers who love to get drinks at Dutch. The love the Rebels and the Hawaiian hot chocolate. Anyhow, I regularly bring them here before school and the service here is always on point! The energy and overall vibe is great. Music is always good, employees are laughing, & happy. The staff always asks how your day is and even shared about theirs.  I have even been given a free drink when different things happened.  For example, my son broke his foot and after the hospital we had to get prescription medication at Walgreens. We stopped here to grab a drink for him  and they gave him his drink on the house.  It was a really nice gesture. 
The prices are comparable with any of the other "competitors " but when it comes to quality, taste, selection, & service they are in a league of their own.

Homeriver group is inconsiderate and all around sucks. Scammers and they get away with it. They evicted us over "dog waste" after simply sending us a warning telling us they'd fine us next if we didn't "cure" it and we DID they proceeded to give us a lease termination, and we had 30 days to be out. On top of that they didn't renew our lease for months after it being over the previous year. They never did any maintenance, and I'm surprised they haven't cause fires from it. They're a waste of time please don't rent from them!

I was SO excited to try this place after seeing it advertised on Facebook. Tonight my husband and I decided to give it a try. 

We both ordered the "Sweeto Burrito" which seems to be their original or classic or something. We are both big fans of sweet pork so we figured that burrito was a good choice to try on our first visit..NOPE. The burrito itself was full of over cooked rice and beans with hardly any meat. I got through 1/2 of my burrito until I got one bite of meat. The sweet pork was sooooo dry and chewy. Some of the pieces were actually tough to bite into. We didn't even finish them, they just were not tasty at all. We also ordered a side of chips and salsa and a side of tots. We ordered To go and both were just thrown in the bag and bit in any type of to go container or lid...

I unfortunately won't be back. This place was sooo hyped up and it seems it's been disappointing others too. I'd rather go to Costa Vida.

We were out looking for bikes and a Harley is probably one of the last bikes we would have guessed we'd end up with. We visited several dealerships and at some were not helped at all, others the service was lukewarm. We were pleasantly surprised with how well we were treated here. John our sales person was so helpful. He listened to what we were looking for and spent time explaining features and just tips for a new biker in general. He was not high pressure and l could tell he just loves bikes. We are so happy with the bike and experience in buying it. Probably the best vehicle purchase experience I've ever been involved in. Everyone else at the dealership that we encountered was super helpful as well but I'd highly recommend John.

As we live 30 miles away it's been 4 years ago since 1st visit. That time we were astounded how good it was especially for a strip mall restaurant. Good prices, large quantities, good service and spicey authentic flavors. In fact I took pictures of the dinners to send to my kids bragging what a great find by accident.
This time prices although higher we're still fair, quantities we're still large, service was fantastic but also we believe the authentic spicey flavors have been toned down to "Americanize" to the mass public. Don't get me wrong it was very good and everything was fresh but just not like it use to be. May not make that special trip again but if in the area wanting Mexican will go again.

If you are looking for great choices, great food, friendly, attentive staff, this is THE place!  Their serving portions are huge, the price is right, and the food was delicious!! Even as the cafe was extremely busy, the wait was minimal and our waitress and management was on it!! We will be back!!

I'm sitting in the lobby, just finished our ice cream. I had read the reviews before we drove here. I was cautious. 8 people sitting and eating , 2 in front of us. We were greeted right away. Eye contact and no vibe of rush. The nice extra was the staff behind the counter helped each of us... instead of one employee helping 2 people. The woman who rang us up, chatted and was above average personable. Only sad thing... they make minimum wage  - so tip, don't be shy.
Went in and the place was dirty. Yogurt spilled all over the grates. Dirty chairs and tables and none of the items pictures were available. Disappointing.

Got a few hours to kill before you obtain a burrito? Yeah, plan ahead. Probably best to bring your own lunch to eat while you wait for a one minute burrito to be made over the course of an amazingly excruciating amount of time. You'd think the burrito would be gold or something for as long as this takes. Do yourself a favor and pass on by, extremely not worth the wait.
Got our food finally! Tots were cold and just basically dumped in the bag, onion rings must have been made yesterday because they were cold and so oily like things usually get after sitting for a good while. The burritos were average size. Not really huge and not small- just ok, They were cold as well. I had them bring it to the car, in my order I had placed I ordered two churros, the attendant had two churros in his hand and was like "hey you want some free churros?" I figured it was because it was for the looooong wait. No, just the churros I had ordered being given to me as a "freebie" after I had bought them. Are you serious about this place? Nah bro, just nah.

We recently had both of our garage doors replaced, and they replaced both on separate occasions. The repairman worked speedily and were done within 15 minutes each time. They know how to treat their customers as well as leave their work to speak for itself. In addition, both repairman cleaned up after themselves as well. I would recommend this company 4 any garage door needs, maintenance or replacements.

Bought doughnuts for my work Halloween party a few days ago, one of the doughnuts had a hair baked inside the doughnut, it was absolutely gross... called the business to let them know what had happened and the owner  answer was this happened to even with hair nets or when pulling your hair back, she acted like it was nothing, no apology, no offered to replace the doughnut with the hair in it, even tho I  paid for that doughnut, worst customer service EVER!! Not coming back.

I am reluctant to write this review because I don't typically believe in writing negative things on the internet. (Which is why I am still giving it 4 stars because I don't intend to hurt this business) However, the service I received today was the epitome of "toxic coffee shop girl" vibe. I recognized this because I was a barista for 8 years and know coffee shop culture pretty well.  The moment that I walked in the door, I could feel that I was not welcome. I came to use the internet and work, which is why my first question was "Do you have wifi?".  I ordered my coffee and went to set my computer up but it didn't work for my phone or laptop. After politely letting them know that it wasn't working, one of the girls practically shouted at me "ITS THE GUEST NETWORK.." and repeated the password, as if I had done something wrong.  I showed them on my phone that there was something wrong with the internet. They responded, "Well its working for us.." Just voicing this concern seemed totally irritating to them. They called their boss and said they would be trying to get it fixed. In the meantime, I used the hotspot on my phone to work. I sat there working for probably 3.5 hours and not once did they check in with me to see if my wifi had started working. I honestly feel like they treated me differently based on my appearance, because after overhearing how they interacted with others, I could tell that our experience was not the same.
Great food and even better service.  Best Happy Hour in The treasure valley!   Love the Pizza, and the sandwiches.  Highly recommended.

Align Chiropractic takes great care of their patients. The staff is so friendly and attentive to the needs of each individual patient. Dr. Woolner and Dr. Allen are very knowledgeable and helpful in their chiropractic care. I have been extremely impressed with the one on one treatment I have received. They truly care about my health and well being. Their expertise makes all the difference in the improvement I am experiencing with my overall health. Their massage therapists are incredible as well! They have a great team! This is an exquisite chiropractic center! I highly recommend!

Amazing food and great service. Our waitress was the best sense of humor and very attentive to make sure everything was good by coming around often, and did I say food was great !!! It's about $15 a plate on average but so worth it!!
Great attention to detail, great value, recommended to several people the same day I had my cut. Best haircut I've ever had.

This review is strictly on sushi - I cannot account for gelato or anything else:
The customer service was great, however the sushi was not so great. We got the California Roll & Spicy Tuna - both rolls were pretty bland, mostly vegetables and very little meat. The Spicy Tuna roll had different types of bell peppers in it, which was unusual. The cucumber stood out most of all in my California Roll. I personally didn't care much for the sushi at all, so I wouldn't say we would come back for that aspect of this place. However, I do plan to try gelato next.
I'm obsessed with their poke bowls. The staff always makes it fresh and delicious! And the staff is always in a cheerful mood.

I was only here for a hot second but it struck me as a cool place. Great location with plenty of parking. Very nice selection of motorclothes. The staff was attentive but not overbearing like they can be sometimes. No one was following me around asking what size I was, lol. I'd come here again.

I have gone to various EWC's in both Idaho and California and have always been satisfied with their services. The shop is clean and my waxer Chelsea is the best! She is so great at the waxing part but she is also really good at making you laugh so you aren't dreading the next strip of wax. Speaking of the wax-I love that it's the "hard" wax so you don't need the actual strips of cloth to go over it-makes it WAY less painful in my opinion.

Conveniently located on Chinden between Meridian and Locust Grove. Under new ownership with friendly and caring owner. The coffee shop is warm, friendly and inviting. All the staff I have interacted with a very friendly and helpful. Excellent smoothies and coffee with delightful treats and snacks. My go to coffee shop in Meridian.

Update: After going through the operations manager and Marriott corporate,  I finally was able to reach the GM for the location who acknowledged their issues and gave me a refund for the night. I appreciate the consideration so I added another star. While the GM is 5 stars the rest of it wasn't.

Moved to Boise a short while ago and finally made it to a place that had Hawaiin food. The quality was very good and taste ono. It is a short drive to home so we will be frequenting this place more often when the stay at home orders are stopped.

Not to happy with the staff every time ive come to the store the staff follow me around as if im gonna steal something always asking if i need help no thanks I've got it i know what i want so ive recently bought a tire and are having them mout and balance it why is it taking three days for maybe at the longest 30 minute job stop chasing me around and change my tire  

I come to the store because noone else has what i need  so kinda stuck right

It was good.. It is just like Balboa bars but not as good. They have ice cream, and frozen bananas and bubble waffles. We picked bananas and ice cream. I had the topping of almonds which would have been better if the flakes were just a little bit bigger. But it was a cute little shop. My sisters raved about how good the actual bananas were. The employee was kind of cold, not a ton of personality for how cute the store was! But it was good if you're looking for ice cream at the village! If not, maybe just try Häagen-Dazs. It was okay, wouldn't go back or recommend it ‍

From reception to medical staff to the doctors they are all friendly and helpful!!! Deann and Tasha have been 
extra wonderful going out if there way for myself and my kids :) 
The waiting room and office  is very clean and comfortable !   Ive never had to wait long for an appointment which is a huge plus!!

I have been with Anytime Fitness for over two years and I am amazed at the personal touch that Bridgette, the manager of the Meridian gym, has put on the gym and the members.  The equipment is much better then I have seen around the other gyms, and I have checked them out.  The people have become like family because they are given a family enviornment, thanks to Bridgette.  I watch her and her demeanor, her professionalism, her personal touch even when it gets crazy busy.  She is top of the line in all areas, in my opinion and everybody else that has been there for a while.  The only kind of person that doesnt see what I and hundreds of other members see, is an unhappy, unrealistic person!  Sorry for them that they wont get to experience a gym thats more then just a gym.....its a lifestyle of health and wellness with people that adhere to their surroundings.  
I recommend this gym and all the staff, very highly!!  Its a beautiful thing when you cant wait to get to the gym to workout and say hello to people you have a great relationship with.

Worst customer service ever! Although the young man that helped me was genuinely sweet this was my experience: I went in and ordered a dozen mini Bundt cakes for a birthday party. They come complimentary with decorations e.g. party hats pom-poms other designs. I asked for six party hats six pom-poms and was told I had to pick 12 of the same thing.I acted extremely surprised they're toothpicks, and the complementary and I'm not asking for any more just to split it six and six. I was told they come in a package and they would have to open a package to be able to accommodate me. I thought that was strange as I could imagine a lot of people would ask the same thing as me. Either way it's a package like a baggie I'm sure they would use them. Then as if that wasn't bad enough while I was waiting for them to gather my cakes I was shopping e.g. spending money at their store looking for cards and gifts. I turned around and noticed they weren't gathering my cakes. I asked if they were gathering them and I was told by the young gentleman that I had to pay for them first-- keep in mind I did not have them so there's no risk involved for them but all it did was force me to stop shopping. That seems silly as you would think they would want the business so I stopped shopping paid for my cupcakes and waited while they gathered them and then I left. It just seems ludacris to me that they are trained to not think/work outside of a small box. The cakes are fresh and good but since you're already paying 4X what you would cupcakes I would think the plus side would be the wonderful customer service, which I did not receive.

I just completed a 3 day cleanse with Revitalize. I have never done a cleanse like this before, so I was really nervous. I went in to get started, and everyone was so friendly and helpful. They packed up my first day right then and there and I was able to start the next day. Throughout the process, they allowed me to customize my juices with the flavors that I liked the most! Trippy Hippie, Surfer Girl, and Star Struck were my absolute favorites!!! I lasted through my three days only drinking juices and I didn't die! I wasn't starving all day either! I was really impressed with how great I felt during and after the cleanse and seriously dropped almost 7 pounds in the process. If you are considering a cleanse, do it here and you won't be sorry!

Wow. I have no words for how much these guys mean to me and have been there for me. Some very unfortunate events have happened to my bike and when I took it in, it wasn't looking very promising for me to ride this year.. 
between Kyle in parts and Levi in the service department they have gone above and beyond to make sure I have reassurance and can sleep at night under these circumstances. Every phone call I received was unfortunate news about my bike but they made sure to keep me in the loop about every aspect and delivered the news very professionally. I know I won't have my bike back for a little while but,, I know the work is in good hands and the parts are exactly what I needed. No better duo than Levi and Kyle thank you guys immensely!
Excellent carne asada, fast friendly service, we are coming back with all our friends.

This office is a straight scam. My wife was the one going to him. He wouldn't give her any real feed back it was all about his sales pitch. She felt like she was only a number to him, not a patient. But anyway they wanted me to come in so we could come up with a treatment plan. When we went there we were given a iPad and was told to watch a 45min video of Dr. Baker explaining all about how his type of chiropractor care is the fix all for every type of illness. I couldnt watch the whole video because I was laughing so hard. If you think I'm over exaggerating please go visit all of his social media. If you're cool with a dr. adjusting unvaccinated babies, overcharged visits for what you actually get out of it, and insurance fraud then he is your guy.

Been there two times now and the experience has been great.  Customer service was good, fast, and polite.  The tacos and chips were excellent.  It was nice as the restaurants we booked for longer then an hour and the street tacos was a good option before the movie.  I would definitely recommend this place.  The place was also clean which I appreciate.

I thought I would give this place a chance, since it is so close to where I live. I asked to get an acrylic French tip manicure. It took her just 15 minutes to do the full set (she just rushed to get it finished). After paying for the full set, I went home right after to file them all down to make them even and then painted them! Glad I paid $50 just to go home and do them again. I will never be back, and I hope you read all of these reviews before thinking of going there.

If you want to find the BEST donuts that are HEALTHY, look no further than fit donut. Fit donut offers a huge selection of health conscious donuts, with low sugar and caloric options! Plus they taste better than a normal donut! My personal favorite is the peanut butter snowball, or frankly any of the peanut butter ones! Fit donut also has gluten free offerings which is great. The donuts are made quite quickly upon ordering as well! Would highly recommend to those looking for a healthy sweet treat! :)

I have been a client of Amore for the last few years, always had good things to say about them.... Until the last 6 months or so.  I utilize their online booking and book a few days in advance, they send me an email to confirm which I do. It started with them being about 20 to 40 minutes late for prior appointments which was annoying but not too bad. That said last month I booked with a specific nail tech who when I arrived was unavailable so I was give to another nail tech. No explanation, no apology.. This month I booked a gel manicure for myself and a pedicure for my friend,, we arrived  and at first she could not find my appt. Then she found it and said they had rebooked my for later in the day a few hours later. Unfortunately I had other commitments, they attitude while telling me this was unapologetic, flippant, and uncaring. They have permanently lost my business.

I'm keto and probably wouldn't survive without this place. Their doughnuts are amazing! I'm super sensitive to whey protein (it makes me sick if I taste it) and hate artificial/ chemical taste of sugar sweeteners and I don't taste either of these things in their amazing doughnuts. I'm literally in their bakery every week and I never leave without a box of their cookies (they sell out pretty fast they are that good). 
 
Side note: they have amazing customer service. The girls are super friendly and nice every time I go in.

As always and what they're known for, greasy delicious burger and cajun fries. I will advise that the more toppings you get, the harder it is to eat and of course, messier. I docked a star because of the customer service, I feel they could be more welcoming and approachable as the many times I've been here they have not shown great hospitality. Overall, I come for the food but a friendly hello would make a difference

Called the day of my appointment to reschedule it. It's SO upsetting to me as it's incredibly hard to make time for appointments. I run my own business working full time and have a baby to raise and in between those two it's beyond difficult for me to rearrange my whole schedule to make it to appointments. Not only that but I also lost out on income for today to be able to make it to my appointment and My job is my only source of income to support my family and I.  You guys would charge ME if I cancelled my appointment the day of!!! If only I could charge you for the money I missed making today. 

No sympathy or compassion or any attempts to make it right. I am beyond livid.

I purchased a Groupon to try this window cleaning company since we all are at home enjoying our homes and the windows needed a refresher! They did not disappoint although the Groupon did not cover all the windows it was a good service and friendly as well! My windows are clean and shiny and ready for the summer!

OK, now this is a real burger.  I got the double meat, double cheese with grilled onions, bacon, mushrooms, lettuce, tomato, ketchup and mustard.  It came with a big soft bun that held up while I mastered eating this beast.  It is a bit pricier than Smashburger, but with the option of mushrooms and grilled onions, it is understandable.  It was big, greasy, tasty, cooked-correctly and seasoned-correctly, work of food art.

The big drag on the rating were the fries that I got with the burger.  There were a lot of them in the regular size order, but they were cut too thick and don't fry up so good because of that.  They were limp and not so appealing.  This is an area where Smashburger excels with their perfect fries.  Looks like I will be skipping the fries on any subsequent visit to Five Guys.

Totally recommend this burger because you can order it exactly the way you want it from the level of how the meat is cooked to what goes on it.  The really good news is if you overdo it with the toppings, the bun will likely not fail - that is rare in the Treasure Valley hamburger hunt I have been on.

No photos as I was enjoying my burger done my way.  You can do the same.

I did see one review that correctly stated that if you like grease, you will like Five Guys burgers.  I totally agree, as I was raised on greasy cheeseburgers, but not greasy fries.  If you were rasied on neat, tidy, tasteless, plain things that were labeled a burger like McD's, then go for those, not these.  A burger isn't a burger unless the grease seeps thru the bag.  The opposite is true of good fries.  One expert's opinion.

P.S. Five Guys stop automatically putting fry sauce in the bag!!!  All fry sauce is nasty.  Offer ketchup instead, don't assume everyone in the world is a fry sauce freak, because most of the world is not.

Awesome ice cream/dessert place! Have been in twice and both times have been amazing. Great product, staff and owner.
Thank you!!!

I can't beleive how wonderful all of the women are in this salon!! Karen does such a good job coloring my hair and she is also easy to talk to with. Since she has been doing hair for so long I'm able to trust her with my naturally curly hair!!!!

Update:  After some serious discussion, my hubby and I decided to give it one more try and claimed our free pizza tonight. It was wonderful!  Great service (even though I was asked to hold three times while placing my delivery order).  Generous toppings, cooked to perfection, and they actually remembered my fresh tomatoes!!  It was like Chicago Connection used to be years ago. The only reason it doesn't get 5 stars tonight is because I'm afraid this is a "one time only" performance because of my previous review.  Although I'm cautiously optimistic, until tonight, the service and quality of the food at this location have been steadily declining for years. I truly hope they are making a comeback, because we really do love their pizza when it's done right.

Donuts were very dense and tasted like protein powder. Whatever they use for "frosting" is really sticky and I actually had a hard time getting it off my hand. The doughnuts had a very strange after taste. The coffee and lattes they serve are from a kurig, which you would think if they were trying to be healthy they would just get an actual espresso machine and use milk for their lattes instead of those kurig pods things which have who knows what in them and probably a ton of sugar. I was really hoping to support a local business and that it would be good but it just wasn't for me.

Free parking in the lots around the restaurant. Good service. Really good pizza, salads and appetizers. We love the fried spinach on the pizza and the cauliflower hot sauce veggie wings. Restrooms are separate for men and women and nice and clean. A few tv's in the bar area for watching BSU games.

I love Dutch Bros coffee.  I had watched the owner on Undercover Boss and I had a feeling I was going to really enjoy them!  Now that I live in Charleston I can only get Dutch Bros when I head back West so I was glad to see Boise had one.  I was doing business in the area and made a point to make a stop to Ditch Bros a part of my morning.  
   I got the Nutty Irishman and it was delicious.  It was cold that morning so this hot treat truly hit the spot.  I walked up to order and the young gentleman was super friendly and the owners laid back attitude.  My order came up quick and I was on my way with my favorite coffee.
  What makes Dutch Bros stand out from their competition is the fun atmosphere.  Their customer service is totally different from SB.  Dutch Bro employees at every location I have been to make you feel welcome and have a fun personality.  If you ever Watch the episode of Undercover Boss with the owner it will make sense.  That is their corporate culture and I wish they were in my hometown as I would be there every morning to get my Dutch Bro fix!!!!!

This place is very clean and good security. The lady in the front office is very pleasant and very helpful being new to the area. We felt safe leaving our belonging here and not have to worry. The prices were reasonable and we got our deposit back in a timely manner.
Fit Donut has delicious guilt free donuts and more importantly they have gluten free delicious donuts.  Every donut I tried was simply amazing.  Give this place a try you won't be disappointed.

Abysmal.  The surly hostess blatantly sneered us and then within earshot challenged the servers to get a tip out of us. When we asked about vegetarian options, the server was clueless, but she did say we could skip meat on any salad "but it wouldn't be any cheaper." I have rarely encountered such rude people. What is going on with your staff there? This is a beautiful restaurant, but, Boise people, avoid it at all costs.
always good best coffee around ... kicker, cho milk, green apple smothie = amazing

Terrible customer service!!  I called these scam artists because I needed to get a door repaired or possibly replaced. I told them that i needed a quote for the work. Ill I  knew is that the door would not open and looked like it was in very bad shape. Two weeks later I get a call from the technician with replacement options as the door was not repairable. He then told me that I owed $75 for a service call, when all I wanted was a quote. I explained that I was not told there would be a charge when I called to set up the appointment. He then argued with me for a short while. I then called his boss and had the same argument. After which he told me to take my business elsewhere. Hmmmm. No problem.

Love eating here. Food is always good, no complaints. The acai bowl is tasty and their waffles and pancakes yum! Tiki french toast is suuuper good!  Breakfast and lunch both good. Only downside is weekends get crazy crowded with long waits all morning.

The ONLY reason I gave 2 stars instead of 1 is because our food was good. However, a dirty table with food all over and under it sat unattended to the whole time we were there while works were milling around the soda machine. 3 other tables were dirtied and never cleaned up in the meantime. I had to ask for lids for my kids cups 3 times. I went up get condiments and a worker was restocking some condiment cups and was not going to let anyone get in there for ketchup until she was done. The soda machine was empty on everything unless you wanted coke or sprite and no one had any sense of urgency when told about this. Very poorly managed.

Best Mexican in greater Boise area! My husband and I are very fussy about our Mexican and after trying 11 other Mexican restaurants in the area in the last year, we had given up our search to find a go-to spot in our new hometown. We stopped in here for lunch one day after discovering that Buffalo Wild Wings still has their dining room closed, which turned out to be a blessing! The salsa is fresh and just spicy enough, margaritas are tart with fresh lime taste (not sugary or syrupy), and bean dip is hot and savory. When our entrees arrived I was thrilled with my extra crunchy flautas and mildly seasoned chicken; my husband raved about the Super Burrito exploding with flavor. To top it off, the service was speedy and abundantly friendly. The waitress remembered to leave the guacamole off my husband's burrito which is rare. We will be back with the family in tow!

This is the best place ever for urgent care!
I came here about 3 months ago for myself and had a great experience and my husband needed antibiotics for a sinus infection so I told him to come here. They took great care of him and his appointment was quick. 
Erica who helped us schedule the appointment was amazing and so helpful, thank you!

Ion really wish I could give a half star, I think 3.5 is more appropriate. 

My brother and I shared 3 tacos at treefort and thought it was pretty spendy. The shrimp taco we got was awful. So much acid and that's pretty much it. The lengua was very tender, like crazy tender. The sauce and seasoning wasn't super impressive. The pork taco however was crazy good. The flavor and texture were phenomenal. Not sure if I would be back though, campos definitely has them beat.

I been coming here now once a week and I love the authentic popusas are so good. I have tried every single one they have and they are good. Yum yum in my belly..lol.. no really they are good. 
The coffee great I had a dirty chai with half and half and coconut and hazelnut syrup. It perfect.  
The smoothies my daughter loves the BP and Nutela banana. Every thing is great!!
Best Poke I have ever had! The fish is fresh, prices are fair, location is great, and the staff is unbelievably kind and attentive.

Excellent food and the service was wonderful.  I was surprised to get fries with my burrito and quickly found them to be the best fries I've ever tasted!  

Very friendly and helpful staff.  We will definitely go back.

I come to Calle 75 Street Tacos all the times for drinks I love their Italian sodas!!! They have many many options for drinks! You can get a small cup of water for free as well!! I recommend coming here 100%! I will be trying one of their tacos next time I come!
I LOVE wingstop and I REALLY love getting free fries for my birthday! Got mine yesterday and they were SO delicious
the shop is so cute and the cakes are super moist and delicious. We tried the lemon and white chocolate raspberry. Both were divine. Will definitely go back

such a good restaurant, one of our favorites! We love the nacho burrito! The guacamole and chips are also really good. It can be a little loud when you're outside when there's music on but you get to watch the fountains.

This review is mainly about the service.  Sat around for 30 minutes waiting for my food while the 5 or 6 people working were standing around bs'ing and huddled together looking at a phone.  Then when done they hurried and put my order together.  Get it together!   And once we got home and ate, the food was decent but they forgot to make our tacos Baja style which we ordered and paid for.

I have gone to the locust grove and Fairview Fred Meyer consistently since I moved close to its location and in the past couple of months I have been not only disgusted with the lack of mask enforcement but also the disregard that the staff, especially management, has for the health and safety of all community members.  If you are going to post no mask no entry then stand up and enforce it.  If you are not going to enforce it then shut your doors like you have shut your mouths.  As recently as today I was in the produce department and saw roughly 1 out of every 5 patrons not wearing a mask.  I expect better from Fred Meyer.  Too bad they don't care about their customers.  Corporate probably does, time to let them know.

This company is participating in false advertisement. They claim that they are giving a free 6-week challenge but it isn't. 

You have two choices: to pay a non refundable $160, or put $600 down and if you lose 6% body fat and complete the 6 week challenge they claim you will receive your money back.

For wasting my time and claiming to give me free 6 weeks of training, this company has lost my business. 

I won't be back.

I was a little nervous to return to KBs since I haven't been there in over 5 months and I saw some reviews that made me think they may have changed their breakfast burrito. (my favorite thing there)  I was however, pleasantly surprised to experience the same nice staff, same clean environment, and same great breakfast burrito. I ended up eating there for breakfast twice  and even had a veggie burrito for dinner once night.   I haven't been able to find anything that can even compete with KBs in Boise.

Boris has made a few various custom rings for my family and I that also include wedding rings.  His work is immediately noticed by others who inquire about the product.  His work is top of the line and he understands the business and customer desires.  I continue to recommend others to him who seek jewelry repair and customized work.  Over the years he has truly shown to have the highest of Intergity and has become a friend of our family do to the constant interactions we have continued to have over the years.  This has my highest of recommendations!

I finally found good Mexican food in Idaho and I don't have to drive very far to enjoy it!  Now that I've experience Mi Casa's food I got back at least once every other week.  The food is delicious but a little on the pricier side compared to other local Mexican restaurants.  The only reason I'm not giving it 5 stars is because the ambience leaves something to be desired.

**UPDATE**  I forgot about this review for a year and I have definitely frequented this place on a regular basis introducing many of my friends to my fave Mexi spot in Idaho.  If you enjoy seafood you MUST try some of it here... my husband loves the seafood enchiladas and anything shrimp.  We have yet to try everything on the menu because we tend to rotate between our top 5 dishes.  Unfortunately the ambience still leaves a lot to be desired... at times the music is too loud, the bathrooms are not always clean/stocked, and the bar doesn't have a regular bartender and COLD tequila.  All the negatives aside the food is absolutely delicious and the wait staff is very friendly.

We decided to give a new local business a try...I'll start with the good part. I would get the queso again. It was cheesy and delicious. Some of the chips seemed homemade and I enjoyed them. We attempted to try 5 different tacos but our order was wrong so we had 4 different ones. We got everything to go so we expected the food to cool down but the tacos were ice cold. All of them! The grilled shrimp taco didn't have any flavor. The brisket was so tough that I couldn't eat it. The tortillas didn't seem heated at all. We asked about taco sauce  and were told it would be in the bag. We didn't have any. Like I said, get the queso and skip the rest.

The donuts are delicious, but seem too soft to me. You try and pick one up, and it kind of folds in half. they are cooked well, and they taste great though. The toppings selections are awesome. I was a little sad that my donut started to get stuck to the box when I tried to pull it out though.

Wow. We were extremely impressed by this place. Best donut I have ever eaten. I'm not even a donut person. We tried the French toast, the chocolate caramel crunch, and the blueberry lemonade. A worker also suggested we try a special "churro" donut. They came out hot, soft, and delicious. They melted in our mouths. Not to mention the fun atmosphere and very friendly employees. We will definitely be coming back every chance we get!

I had a new wifi enabled motor installed today and a repair to a spring. From the quote process over the phone with Boise Rep Krissy to the installation process with Jeff this morning, the whole transaction was smooth, professional & friendly. The work was done well and when Jeff realized the spring was broken, he quickly made the appropriate phone call for the part, then he proceeded to work on what he could until the spring arrived. He was personable and efficient. I also felt the pricing was fair and reasonable for parts and labor. I would recommend Action Garage for any Installation or Repair! 

Jayde - Boise, ID

My in laws suggested we eat at the broken yolk because it was great. Ummm did not have a great experience. Our waiter was rude and I wanted softly scrambled eggs with my French toast with whip and fresh strawberries. I received dry eggs and no whip and strawberries. I would need to think twice before I go here again.

Ordered on line I was in a hurry to grab and go.
I waited in line 15 minutes and the green haired girl says you will have to wait we have other online orders ahead of you. But I am here there not. She said that I can wait and it will be only ten to fifteen minutes for my order that I already paid for.
Believe me I will not be back. She is a total bitch too

I wanted a really nice picture frames. I was told they would do the best job at the best price, lower than the competition. Not only was the price higher AFTER the job was completed, when I got home and unwrapped my print I saw ripples in it. I was so angry I WILL NOT go back there ever. I do not recommend them.
Boris is great! I enjoyed working with him because he is so easy going and knowledgeable. I highly recommend Shmukler Design/Boris. They are professional and do excellent work. I'll be back for sure.

Wow they have huge serving sizes!! My husband and I came in on a Tuesday night because I was starving!! He.....not so much. We were able to grab a table right away and the server promptly brought out their bean dip and salsa with chips. We shared (meaning, he had a bite) a combination platter with a taco (HUGE!) and chili Colorado pork burrito (Also HUGE!). The platter came with rice and beans as well. Although this isn't the most authentic Mexican restaurant in the valley, they satisfied my Mexican food craving well. 

One downfall was the margarita. They definitely use a mix that is too sweet :(

I agree with Mandee, split a plate!

These came to us as a nice December surprise from some family members. The delivery person was great. She was super friendly, wore a mask, and kept distance when I answered the door. The flavor of each cake was amazing, but the peppermint one was definitely our favorite! Each cake was nice and soft and the frosting added the perfect touch. Can't wait to order from them again!

I go to this location literally almost everyday. I USUALLY have a good experience. But this morning was a little different. I get something for myself plus something for my kiddo, then sometimes i get something for my mom. Hers is a tall white mocha with soy no whip. When i got home i realized THIS is how full it was. I wouldn't complain if it was flavor or whatever because i used to be a barista so I know stuff happens. But to give out a cup with this much room is sad. Especially when the drink is$5

Wow...where do I even begin?  I'd like to rate it a 0 but that's not an option.  We were excited to try this new restaurant.  We were hoping for a new local restaurant to support, but sadly we were disappointed to find out that it is a franchise.  
The inside is light and bright.  Filled with booths and tables (socially distanced). The men's bathroom was filthy :(. 
We were seated in about 5 minutes.  We waited about another 10 to get someone to come by to get our drink order.  My hubby ordered a coffee and I ordered a mocha latte.  His coffee came out fairly quickly....mine didn't.  After about 20 minutes I told our waiter to never mind and take it off the order, which they did.  About 5 minutes later he asked if I still wanted it because it was now done.  I accepted.  Basically a cup of coffee with chocolate syrup drizzled on the whipped cream...Not worth it. 
As far as for the food. It took quite a while for the food to come out.  When it did it was already cold. I ordered the two egg breakfast with home fries, links and a biscuit.  
Everything was cold.  The eggs although cooked correctly had absolutely no flavor.  The potatoes were cold, some raw and with no seasoning whatsoever.  The links were lukewarm at best. The biscuit although decent came with no butter.  There were a couple of jam packs in a container on the table.  No variety, just strawberry.  
My hubby ordered an omelette, bacon and cheddar. Although made to order it was only lukewarm in the middle.  His potatoes were the same, cold, raw and no flavor.  
Our server was nice, but very slow and seemed to lack confidence in his job.  We waited a long time just to get a coffee top off.  Another server actually did it for us.  
We probably won't be back.  There were other tables around us that had trouble with their orders as well.  We don't understand what the hype is other than it's new.  We would not recommend it at all.  A franchise should already have all the kinks worked out and be able to deliver a quality product.  Sadly, this one doesn't.
The price in our opinion is high for the quality of food...28.00 for two generic breakfasts. 
Hope they get it together soon.

In the last week Mi Casa has moved a couple doors down to a bigger space.  We ate at the new location and it was really nice.  The tables were spread out and you didn't feel cramped.  The place was decorated nicely and it had a warm feeling.  The chips and salsa were good as we waited for our meals.  I ordered the Chile Verde and to my surprise the dish was huge.  It was late at night so I didn't finish my plate but it was very flavorful.  As we left we asked the waitress, what are they known for and they said their Molcajates Bowls, in which I am looking forward to try on my next visit.  Definitely worth giving them a try, it was well worth it.  Friendly and patient waitress as we stayed there beyond closing time without feeling rushed.
Can't wait for the opening. We are from San Diego. I am ready for my Mimosa and Eggs Benedict.  I saw staff being trained as I went by today. Hurry. Hurry.

I went in here to submit a application for a house for rent. I asked Andrea point blank about a question on the application. I filled it as she had told me to. Later when I returned to follow up she was so rude. I guess she didn't like being a lier in front of her boss
Food is really good, but their on-line ordering is all messed up...2-3 times in a row, "never got order" and had to wait anyway!!!

I really like the staff here! They are friendly and are so willing to explain each procedure and answer any questions and concerns. They make you feel important and valued. The atmosphere is pleasant. There are TVs in each room at each chair which is nice if you have to wait. Dr Howard does beautiful work also. One of my favorite things here is that they made my crown IN the office with their state of the art equipment. I didn't have to have a temporary crown put on and then come back weeks later (and get numbed up again) to get the permanent crown on. They do it all in one visit. Great for me because I work full time. I never want to go to any other dentist. I've found my favorite!

This was one of the only places open to eat at 8pm.  We went here not expecting much.  I ordered the salmon BLT and was blown away at how good it was!!  It was so good that we went again the next day and I ordered the same thing!! Highly recommend you go and try it!

I wouldn't give any stars if possible but management sucks they don't do anything when drama goes down they never know what to say  . The employees there are super fake . Always talkin shit about customers walking in or even talkin shit about other employees making it known , and watch out for one of the emoloyees she's always walking around mugging people and giving dirty looks just bad attitude for no reason not friendly ever . . So watch out they suck !! . ‍‍

Great breakfast tacos. You may have to wait a bit after placing your order because everything is made fresh. It is so much better than any fast food taco restaurant. Prices are reasonable as well. Highly recommend!
Not a fan. The food is ok, the price is high and the service is pretty terrible.   For reference, we paid $7 for two street tacos that were made with ground beef.

Stop offering me that turtle concrete shake thingy. Please, just stop. I have no power to say no. :D

Management has really stepped it up here lately. Faster, fresher. I just wish their corporate standards could include some garlic and cumin on their burgers!!!!

Solid burger joint. From a simpler time.

The food was amazing, we made sure to get a variety of things so we could really see what they offered. The server we had was nice and not overbearing. The only negative part of our experience were the assholes next to us that were complaining about everything. They even got the manager... but other than that it was awesome.

Meridian Cycles is such a fantastic shop. Super helpful, super friendly. This is the place to go for any bike needs. I've stopped in for everything from parts - to emergency help when I got a flat commuting to work. This place is fantastic and the customer service is always tops.

The build-your-own concept here at Duck Donuts was slightly overwhelming at first, but our cashier came to the rescue to help us out. I did not get his name, but he was tall, had a southern accent and was so nice and patient while walking us through the process of ordering.

Now on to the actual donuts... I personally am not the biggest fan of cake donuts, but their toppings and sauces are A+. My only actual complaint is that the toppings melt off the donuts pretty quickly since they are served fresh out of the fryers. This isn't a problem if you're eating them right away, but I did notice everything was slipping and sliding around in the box when I got home. Definitely keep the lid off the box if you have to travel with these donuts! Overall I think this place is going to be a long-term hit and I imagine that kids will LOVE it.

Horrible experience. We built our small retirement home in 2015. I have waited this long to write this so I can tell the full story. First, they put the furnace in the attic. It clearly shows it to be in the garage. The superindent told me after I discovered it in our first walk thru, "We put them in the attic in all of our builds, its a more efficient way to heat the house. Really. We selected the upgraded carpet pad. All the bedrooms have lifted and wrinkled carpets. We have to replace one at a time. When  they pulled up the carpet we found the cheapest pad had been installed. We had to repaint the entire interior because the paint was so thin it started flaking off the walls. Our furnace interior was filled with paint and dust. I learned a lot about how the happens in new builds. I would have ruined our furnace had Western heating and Air not found it and cleaned it. The list is endless. When we asked Colman for help they said your warrenty is up and stopped returning my calls. Every chance I get, and I get many where I work, I warn others not to go with Coleman. They do not care about this because of the growth.

The owners of Calle 75 hit a home run with our catering order.  We fed our entire crew their authentic tamales and they were an absolute hit.  They accommodated every dietary request and they exceeded our expectations.  I heard multiple associates say, "that was the best tamale I have ever had!".

Thank you Calle 75 for your amazing service and exceptional food.  Merry Christmas to you and your team.

The Boise Co-op at the Village

Experience with colemon home has been great thus far. We are about 4 months into building and the process has been great with all the employees. Until we did our first walk through on the house. We had a couple things wrong in the house that the construction supervisor took care of which was awesome. But there was a bigger issue that could not be fixed and I quickly became a very dissatisfied customer. All the salesman have been a very upfront on what is provided with their homes and what options you get to choose from. Problem is when we did our walkthrough we noticed the garage was a very small size. From here I asked their construction manager if they get a lot of complaints on their garage size, he snickered as he said yes. I was in awe of the size of this garage. It felt like three cubicles smash together. The last house we came from was 1870 square foot home with a fairly decent size garage. We paid 215 k for the house. We are now putting 295k into a Coleman home and their garage is half the size of our old garage. not to mention when they poured the foundation it was placed where it should have been for RV parking. They said the foundation's Porta can't do nothing about it, they also said the rough sawn so we can't do nothing about the garage. Supposedly in our buying and building process there is an option for oversized garage. No one had offered or said one word about the garage but everyone always focused on what the home amenities will be. Needless to say is a hard-working family we are very very disappointed and Coleman homes communication process and also trying to help us on the matter. They told us if we want to back out of the home it'll be around 10 K and there's nothing they could do. So now our family is going to build a $290, 000 home with less than a 300 square-foot 3 car garage that can't accommodate my vehicles and my toys of where I previously moved from. If you ever buy a Coleman home I would immediately asked for the upgraded garage and extension cuz you will not be happy. We honestly will end up buying this house and looking to resell in the next 4 to possibly 5 years because of their mess up. So much for our last house build. I would tell you this customer service is great except for a couple downfalls. Their products seem to be good too. But if you don't look into everything and catch every little detail it's a possibility you will be very dissatisfied with Coleman homes. Personally I think they're overpriced from where we just moved from. I had all the same amenities but in this house we added on another 420 square feet. I personally am kicking myself for even moving Thank you coleman homes for your down fall in communication and not getting the home that we anticipated. Nothing like paying to 95k for something you don't want. Congratulations for being that company.

When I lived in Idaho, I worked in Meridian and he often used to stop in to grab coffee when it was Moxie Java. I moved away came back to visit my daughter and we used to go there together when it was big star which I really loved. After a really bad experience that lucky perk where they dumped table saw in my salted caramel mocha, yuck  I decided I would try out mountain try Mt. timber  coffee.We use the drive-through and we both ordered breves. I got a vanilla toffee nut and she got a caramel hazelnut both drinks were made to the correct temperature she offered with cream and toppings plus to use high-quality syrups sauces and add Ins. 
They do charge extra for using half-and-half which is to be expected with the small independent coffee shop, the staff was amazing and friendly and she offered us a loyalty punchcard will definitely be back next time I'm in town!

I have been coming almost everyday to Anytime Fitness off Ustick and Meridian location since January 2021 and its almost May now.  I'm super impressed with the new owners Jaclyn and Rick who took over last year.  The place is cleaned on a daily basis, weights and machines are well organzied and someone is always there during their normal business hours to answer any questions.  Their equipment does the trick, I don't ever feel like its too crowded.  Its nice that I see them updating the equipment and also bringing in new equipment in.  The owners and their trainer Renee are all very down to earth type of people who ACTUALLY CARE.  Ive belonged to many gyms over the years, I like this one due to location, cleaniness and them having all the equipment I need to get in, get out and get fit!  I highly recommend this location!  Thank you for making working out enjoyable.

Decided to try this place out when I got a sweet tooth, and went with the drive thru. The girl at the drive thru was friendly and helpful, the service was quick. I decided to go with a Signature Turtle Concrete, and went with their smallest size, the "mini". Just over $4 for the little guy! Not a good start, there was a hair on top of my custard. Moving on to the frozen custard itself... It left me a little disappointed. Not because it wasn't delicious, because it was! The problem herein lies with the high price and hype around frozen custard. It had me expecting something more for the price I paid. What I got was something no more special than what I would find for half the price at Dairy Queen. The Signature Turtle was reminiscent of the Peanut Buster Parfait at DQ. It was really good, but not over-$4-for-a-small good. I may come back to give this place a fair chance at a better review, but next time I have a sweet tooth, I'll probably opt for DQ.

I am burned out on Five Guys. They used to be awesome and what you got was always good and I LOVED eating there! Over the years the service and food have both gone severely downhill. Here's a tip for the young lady taking orders; onions are white, pickles are green. When someone orders onions on their burger, it means they want those white things NOT the green things.

I usually write decent long reviews but I'm going to keep it short and sweet! Dr.White is awesome!! He knows what he is doing and definitely gets you feeling pain free quickly! I have been in about 3-4 times and I'm feeling so much better already. Oh! Can't forget to mention his chair, it's so comfy! I've been to about 3 different chiropractors and honestly he is just the greatest. He listens to you and helps you figure out what is wrong and why that is you could be feeling that way. Totally recommend!!

My husband and I were looking for a place to have a drink last night and we just happened to find The Bottle Cap Bar.   We were so thankful we did.  The owner, Kristen served us.  What a nice person and a great bartender!!!  The bar is super clean and decorated nicely.  There were several other couples in the bar and we all ended up chatting with each other.   Very nice atmosphere!  We will definitely be back!

Me and the son stopped in for a couple of beers. This is a fun little taproom with a great selection of beer. We had a bomb Hazy IPA called Massif Haze by Payette Brewing. 

Payette brewing isn't well known for hazy IPA. Up until this point I haven't been that big of a fan. Yesterday changed all of that!!  Thanks to the Growler Guys I was able to try this awesome beer out. It was a collaboration with Icicle Brewing. 

Way to go guys you hit pay dirt with this one !!
Excellent customer service from Oscar knows how to handle the situation when it needs to be fixed. Wings are hands down better than Buffalo Wild Wings wouldn't change anything about it keep it up

My wife and our three little ones have been stuck in the minivan since Michigan go visit my parents in Oregon.  We have stopped at many Starbucks and fast food establishments.  All have fallen flat in the hospitality and engagement realm.   Let's talk about the gem of hospitality in a 2 minute experience.  Her name is Kara and I'm sure her face is as lovely as her spirit l, however under a black mask to protect herself and our family.  She asked us how our weekend was and was very polite and understanding how amazing it is to drive 30 hours across the country with 3 little kids.  Sarcasm.  Haha. Who offers water to their patrons on top of the amazing service?!   Kara!   This establishment is more than lucky to have such a dedicated and lovely person working here.

I called in to ask if their monkey meal smoothie was gluten free, bought one, came home and tested it with my Nima gluten sensor and it isn't gluten free. Glad I didn't drink it as I have Celiacs disease and could've ended up in the hospital. 

If you're a celiac, go elsewhere for your smoothies!!!

This is an amazing spot to try something a little bit different than you will find amongst most restaurants in the area.  As a fan of sushi, I knew that I had to try a poke bowl as well and I was very glad that I did.  The poke bowls here are wonderful. I enjoy the ability to design my own bowl since they have so many great options.

Will definitely return to eat here!
My first experience was not great. Second experience was much better!! Donuts weren't greasy and flavor was great. Todd the owner is great and made things right.

This place is my beer heaven. So much variety, decent prices, great service. My favorite is the Ayinger Brau-Weisse Hef (I'm a sucker for German beers) but I have also enjoyed every single sour they've ever poured and the ever surprising Belching Beaver PB Stout. Last I checked they had 54 taps! 

Our groove is frequently thrown off by small humans, so we go there for Growler fills and the very cool aluminum can fills. 

Warning: You cannot bring your 10 month old baby inside, even if you're just getting a growler fill. Not that I'm speaking from experience...‍

You'll spend 10-15 minutes in the drive through, then you'll be met with a rude employee and there is a definite chance you'll be missing something. The only reason I ever go to this location is because it's the only one nearby but I NEVER go unless I have time.

Working at Dairy Queen was my first job when I was 16 and we never provided service this poorly. Just because you're younger doesn't give you an excuse to not work hard and be nice...
So glad we found this place. My husband can't have dairy and they have so many options for him. I was excited to walk in and see Dole Whip, yummy! We will be back very soon.

Although the actual pedicure wasn't bad, and the girl was nice, it was hard to get past everything else. When I walked in the "receptionist" was on her phone and didn't look up, I waited about 3 minutes before I said "hi, I'm here for my pedicure." She points to the wall (not looking up from her phone) and says pick a color. That was the extent of her communication. I pick and wait, while there was at least 4 employees, none greeted me. Finally I walked up to one who was setting up a foot bath and asked if that was for me. It was. Glad I asked! I had scheduled what their website said was a deluxe pedicure, got a run of the mill quicky one. The receptionist that greeted me eventually came and sat at one of the pedi stations and curled up with a comforter and watched tv. It was awkward. When I went to pay a different girl checked me out and was just as rude. I have no idea how this place is in business. They need to fire those receptionists and have an owner around.

What a cool spot located in the Boise Commons shopping area...came here for desert on a very high recommendation from my daughter who lives here. Basically an ice cream bar dipped in chocolate or other flavors and topped with pretty much whatever you want! Who doesn't love ice cream and what a cool and creative way to enjoy it. Really cool place for sure and glad we stopped in. First the Boise commons is a really nice out door shopping area and this place is great for taking a load off and relaxing. A definite must stop while visiting the Boise area.

Was skeptical based off reviews, but was very impressed with the service and quality today. Based off of other Yelp reviews it seems they have really addressed all issues. They were very attentive and even replaced a burrito after my wife dropped it on accident (totally our fault and we weren't expecting a replacement). Food was amazing. There are reviews stating cold food and lack of meat. This was not the case for us in that it came out warm and there was plenty of meat in each bite. Size is standard compared to other establishments. Timeliness for food and service was good as well! Will go back!

The first time I walked into Dr. Baker's office, I was shocked by how happy people were as they were coming and going. People of all ages, even small children, had smiles on their faces and were treated with such genuine love by the entire staff. I remember watching a little girl give Dr. Liliana and the front desk ladies a big hug as she was leaving with her family. I was so comforted by this scene, and I  always know I am in good hands at PreHab. Dr. Baker has gone completely out of his way for his patients to ensure their safety and comfort. He has gone to lengths that I have never seen a medical professional go before-- I was suffering from trigeminal neuralgia and he adjusted me after hours at his own house. That's how much he cares. He follows up with his patients, and he strives to remove interference in the body that is stopping proper healing. He celebrates when people dont need their meds anymore! I am so blessed and grateful to know him, and I hope you all are inspired to join the PreHab family!
Amazing customer service and donuts! We tried 7 different flavors and everyone of them were a hit. Very family friendly place. This will be our go to treat place.

I had one of HomeRiver Group's property assessors come to my house and start taking pictures of my property. When I asked if I could help him he told me he was assessing the property. When I asked why, he said he was told to. I told him it wasn't their property. He asked if my house was a particular address and I told him it wasn't, the address he was looking for was two houses down the road. He then began to "school" me on the law, ranting that this is public property and he could be there if he wanted. He stood on the sidewalk taunting me with his toes all but touching my lawn. Then he proceeded to take more pictures. I contacted HomeRiver Group's office to let them know how unprofessional their property manager was but the person I talked with wasn't the right person to handle my complaint. Apparently they don't care, as I have yet to receive a call back from them. So, here I am writing a public review. From what I can tell, HomeRiver Group has incompetent, unprofessional, and rude employees. It makes me wonder about the company as a whole.

Great burritos with a unique taste! Their burritos are nice and big and they have plenty of styles to choose from! From breakfast burritos to asada, they spare no expense in giving plenty of meat and whatever else it takes to fill up a legitimate burrito!

Today was the second day I came to The Broken Yolk. Yesterday (Saturday) at 7:00am it was fine. It didn't blow me away, but did not have anything bad. It was just an average breakfast, but super close to home. We were excited to have a place close to the house and I wanted to bring my wife and kids for the first time. We usually drive 15-20 minutes to "The Griddle" but thought this would save us time!! Haha. Boy was I wrong. We rolled into the parking lot right after church, and made it there at 9:26. We went up to the host stand and she said it would be 25 minutes. It was a little chilly and we had our two girls so we waited in the car. I received a text saying that our reservation was made and they would text when it was ready. We waited 30 minutes and did not receive a text so we went up to check on how much longer. The person taking the reservations said "25 minutes" my wife said "oh, you told us 25 when we checked in 30 minutes ago." She apologized and said "yea they weren't keeping me up to date on how long the wait is". We debated leaving, but felt already committed. After we got back in the car and noticed the text they send has a link you can click on, and sure enough after clicking,  it said "25 minute wait." We hung in the car and waited until it hit zero, then negative 1, negative 2 etc etc all the way until -22. We waited a total of 72 MINUTES when they told us 25. We weren't thrilled but thought if we could get out quick we could salvage. We sat down and got ZERO acknowledgment from a server or someone with water. We finally stopped someone after about 5 minutes and said "do we have a server!?". She looked confused and said yes. She brought over a nice gentleman and he realized he had forgot us and apologized. No worries but we have been waiting and are ready to order. I wish I could say that was it but it wasn't. The wrong table's food got brought to us twice and we literally didn't get ours for close to 45 minutes. Our server was nice and our food was average. I really hope they pull it together. I know it's the first weekend but it was a rough experience today. We pulled in at 9:28 for breakfast and pulled out at 12:10!! . I have never experienced anything like it with counting on a 25 minute wait. The manager or GM never once came over to apologize but the waiter did comp our meal. It would have been much quicker, to drive to the griddle!! We will try again because it's close, but this was a bad bad experience. I am not a big complainer and never have issues at food establishments but so many things could have been done to fix or avoid this!
Staff was super friendly and the donuts were amazing! Definitely will be back. The sunset and the fluffernutter were spectacular!

The smothered chili verde burrito is the best in the area.  Ask for the spicy.  

The staff is very friendly and expedient.  The facility is clean.  I'll come back.

I love this place. They have such a different variety of crafting goods compared to Michaels or Hobby Lobby.  I have found some really lovely crafting items that I did not know I was even looking for. I like their policy of staff members doing a clean every hour. This was at the height of the pandemic . I have not found their prices out of line. They also have some lovely unique fabric

Absolutely love Dr Baker and staff!! I've been getting adjusted for about 2 months now and have already benefited tremendously from their care. I
highly recommend checking them out especially if you love the truth!

Never follows through with customer request. Never calls back after customer leaves messages. Customer is not important it seems...company must be too busy to worry about losing a customer. I would highly recommend Ex-Cello Garage Door instead....they are professional, on time, call you back, interested in providing excellent service which they do. Dont waste your time with Action. I am honestly confused on why my home builder chooses to work with them.
