Great food, Great service and super cute ambiance. My husband and I shared the mushroom burger and it was delicious!!  We started with the veggie wings and sticky riblets as appetizers and loved them as well. We definitely will visit this restaurant again.
Coffee is great and the folks are super friendly! Drive-thru is a great option. Space is limited for indoor seating. Love the cappuccinos!

horrible people. kelli and gabby laugh at customers and make smerks about them when they come in. tried to redeem a birthday coupon and they treated me like shit i wouldnt go see them at all. emailed shannon cline we shall see if she fixes this issue. until then i wouldnt go to them. by the way they dont make the cakes they are all frozen when they come in. false advertising.

Convenient location for me, near my house. I don't need to drive all the way to the mall. The store is pretty complete, large, and in great location, near the water fountain. The staff are friendly and helpful.

I am a current renter and when I first moved in they seemed to care and would respond to questions/emails quickly but I was warned by a neighbor 2 weeks after moving in that they never take care of problems and that I should get used to dealing with things on my own because the property management could care less. I hoped this statement was wrong, but here I am almost 6 months later still not getting resolutions for problems and even worse, getting blamed multiple times for these same issues! Ever since I moved here in August we were greeted with large amounts of poop scattered all over the lawn outside our front door. Since, I have let the managers know and even then the grounds inspector has tried giving me a fine for not picking up the dog poop when I don't even own a pet. They have poor communication within the company and even worse communication skills with their tenants. I would NOT recommend this property management company to anyone!

The food is good, the beer is delicious, the location is very nice. However, the thing that got me really excited to write this review was how they treated my entire family when we came last weekend. 

The guy who sat us (probably the owner from the obvious pride he took in doing every job - hosting, bussing, waiting, holding doors, delivering drinks, etc.) beamed at my children and gave them high fives. He brought coloring for "Hungry", the 4 year old, BUT THEN he brought toys for the baby! Excuse me while I lift my jaw off the floor! It was so thoughtful and kind and kept us sitting at the table for almost the entire meal. "Hurricane" couldn't hang for the last 10 minutes but sitting for the first 30 was a miracle sent from that sweet man. Kudos to you Gramercy!

I don't usually enjoy pizza from places that don't specialize in it. Those large and diverse menus usually don't treat pizza right. But this place does a great job. The pizzas are cooked in a wood fire oven which is always a great place to start. And they have such fun combos! I love the Maui Wowi. It satisfies my pineapple pizza loving heart. Last weekend, I had the fish and chips, "Hungry" had the kid's mac and cheese and my hubs had a sausage and mushroom pizza. The baby threw food. 

Everything was great. The mac and cheese was pretty dang hot for coming off the kid's menu, so maybe they can toss that sucker in the freezer for 1 minute before serving to kids? Otherwise, we have no complaints. In fact, I'm still thinking of that amazing batter on the fish. 

Thanks for making us feel welcome!

I was a couple stores down so I thought I would try it out. I got the medium bowl and as my protein, which you get 3, I did 2 of them tuna, and then I paid the extra $2 for the octopus. The tuna melted in my mouth and the octopus was so good. You were giffen so many options to add things to the bowl that was already in the price. One of the options to add was seaweed salad. It was probably one of the best ones I've had. It was so filling and so good I brought the rest home and ate it for lunch today.

I had a garage door spring break during the night. I called Action in the morning and the door was fixed before noon. The person on the phone was so helpful with finding the door make and setting a around time.  Our service guy Lenny rocks he was quick a very thorough on service of the door and repair. Definitely two thumbs up .

Do not go here if you have plans for something soon after grabbing a smoothie. I ordered 2 smoothies with only one guest behind me and no one ahead of me and it took 15 minutes. Other than that, pretty good smoothies but they are way overpriced.

Went to get my eyebrows waxed and was done by Madison (short blond). She was nice but didn't do a good job at all. I have tiny scabs all over my eyebrows. And they're uneven. When I left, it looked fine but once a day or two passed, I can see the errors. This was not worth the money.

I'm not a huge bike enthusiast, but I do enjoy the occasional ride to the mini mart or a cruise on the green belt. Anyway, we came in to pick up a basket for my bike, and a speedometer for my son. They had both in stock, plus lots more I didn't know I needed! Bike gloves (for riding in the cold weather), rechargeable bike lights for the kids & pegs for my son's bike. The guy working was so helpful, friendly and knowledgeable. This is a great locally owned shop!

With so much going on, I didn't realize the new BF on Chinden had opened. Well hello and welcome to this end of town!

I wasn't feeling a burger. Just a snack. The one thing I do know is Boise Fry has awesome fries BUT have you ever had their fried Brussell Sprouts?! So good. They are served with a maple bacon jam. So. Good. Honestly, I ate them out of the container with no sauce and my fingers. Yeah I did. Delicious!!

Absolutely love Bite Me!  Their ice cream bars are not only adorable but also totally delicious.  The Yabba Dabba Do is my personal favorite.  Also pop in and grab a kombucha or a coffee (they have really good coffee) every time I'm at The Village.  And the place is super cute and the staff is friendly and generous with toppings

We love this place!  One of our very favorite places to go with our daughter.  Such a cute idea!  Their dipped ice cream bars are just delicious - really wonderful and unique flavor combinations.  Last time, we shared the frozen banana with salted caramel and chocolate and some other yumminess on top.  OMG it was so good!  I'm not even normally a banana person, and this was out of this world.  This is hands down our daughter's favorite spot for a treat - to go with us or for us to take her with friends.  The kids just love it because they can each choose their own bar, and it's so cute to watch them choose what they want. 

This Halloween, we got their caramel apples - also so good.  I don't know what they put in their caramel, but it was pure heaven.  And for Christmas this year, we got the chocolate bombs for presents - such a hit!  They were not only delicious, but like everything in the shop - so pretty and artistically put together.  

Such a lovely, friendly staff.  They always greet with a smile and are just delightful.  They deliver too, which would be perfect for birthdays.   We're grateful for their covid precautions and mask mandate; it makes us feel safe to drop in even during these difficult times.

Awesome mexican food has finally arrived in Meridian! My husband and my favorite food is Mexican and so we are very picky about quality, service, price, and quantity. They've been open for 10 days so there are a few minor kinks they're working out. We will be back and we highly recommend this place!

If you were around a few years ago when there was a Kanack Attack in that strip mall off Broadway, this is the same owner. They still have their coconut rice. I HAD to try them out as I do love my hawaiian food! I ordered the korean chicken and decided on the pineapple and spam fried rice. When my food came out, I was so excited. The rice was dry and flavorless, the macaroni salad was missing oomph and the korean chicken's sauce tasted burnt. I was sadly disappointed. In all fairness, the chicken itself was nice and juicy. I'm not sure if they were having an off day or what, but I am perfectly content sticking with Island Kine Grinds.
The appetizers, pizza, beer, and dessert wilder all delicious! The atmosphere is pretty cool and the service was quick. We will definitely return if we are ever in the area again around dinner time.

Amore nomore! My family (a group of 7) went in for pedicures because they had a $20 pedi special. My mother in law called the day before our appointment and the lady was rude while making the appointment.
The day of our appointment we showed up and they were bringing us back a few people at a time. Most of my family had cold water (amore's water heater went out), only a few of us had lukewarm water. The lady that did my pedicure was nice but the other ladies were either rude or didn't talk at all. 
My sister in law had to wait almost 20 mins just for them to heat up water in bowls. Also the lady that was doing her pedi kept telling her she should have rescheduled. 
The seventh member of my family didn't even get a pedicure because the water heater wasn't turning hot. They informed my grandma that she could reschedule but she would have to pay that day and then come back at a later date. She just cancelled it because the other 6 of us were already done with our pedicures. 
When we left there were still 10 people waiting and no one was at a pedicure station.
I would never recommend this place.

My daughter and started going to Sheila last year! We absolutely LOVE her!  She does an amazing job on our eyebrows! She is so personable, sweet, considerate!!
Want a great waxer? Sheila is your Lady!!!
The Receptionist are amazing as well!!

Super excited to try their breakfast! DoorDashed my order (live a block away). Omelet was just ok. Order was missing the toast. Hollandaise sauce was not good, has a strange sweet taste to it. Won't order again. Pretty disappointed. Was hoping to make this my new breakfast place. I'll stick with Express cafe as it's all about the Hollandaise for me.

The place isn't very clean and the guy working was very grouchy. Not to mention our açaí bowls had chunky yogurt, frozen blueberries, and açaí itself was really watery. Will not be returning to this place. Pretty disappointed

Only had coffee and toast.  Nothing to really rate or compare. I may try it again.  
Busy at lunch time.

Ordered a birthday cake over 24 hours ago. Came to pick it up on time today . It wasn't ready. Music blasting and nobody even came out to greet us. Although I saw the girl look at me from the back. Finally finished... the name on cake was misspelled and smeared. Employee couldn't care less and said she didn't know how to offer me a discount since I already paid. Never again is an understatement. The combination of being DUMB and NOT CARING is the end for me. Go somewhere else.
5 plus dollars for a shake that was gone in 3 drinks!!! Tasty, yes. Rip off... also yes. Disappointment!

The Burger is ok, I went with with Patty Melt, IMO it would have been better with Sourdough Bread instead of Rye.
Wife got the California Burger. 
For Ice Cream, I went with the Vanilla with Pineapple, Strawberries and cherries she went with the Chocolate thing they have

Unless you are a person who will be living alone and have no friends, do yourself a favor and find another place to live. Seriously. The problem? Parking. It doesn't sound like a big problem, but trust me. It becomes awful, more than you would think.

If there are two people living in the apartment--and there probably will be since these are all two-bedroom units--or If you have any friends who will hang out with you for more than a few hours, they will have to park illegally because there are only a handful of unassigned parking spots. And then they may be towed. Every single renter I've talked to at these apartments has the same problem: Parking. Well, some have other problems with the property management company never responding to requests, and that is certainly an issue that may keep you away as well. But parking problems will screw up your life. Find an apartment without just one assigned spot, and make sure there are dozens of unassigned parking spots so your co-renter or friends won't keep coming up with reasons never to leave the apartment, or never visiting you.  

The apartments themselves are nice. They are relatively new, and the floor plan is great. But when you are a prisoner in that apartment on the weekend because you dare not move from one of a few precious unassigned parking spots in the lot--you will come to hate it.

Find another place, seriously. Do your research ahead of time by asking actual tenants what they think of the place. Check out online reviews (but you'll usually only get complaints like this one), and see if your must-have comforts are there. From now on, I will NEVER rent at a place without super-ample parking.

Oh and another thing. That pool? You have to pay $25 for a key to get in. I never had enough money to do that, and consider it a royal ripoff. Just let the tenants have a place to unwind from the stress of not having enough parking, HomeRiver Group. 

And if you are ever even a day late with a payment? Bam--$50 charge. They are not open to listening to good reasons, or to having a grace period. 

SO many apartments of this exact same type in Boise and Meridian, with responsive property managers, enough parking, an actual key to the pool, and prompt attention to sidewalk and parking lot ice in the winter.  This isn't one. Move on, next.

If I could rate this negative stars I would. The staff is not so helpful. These apartments were new when I moved in, 6 months later I had a leak in my ceiling that they took 3 weeks to fix. Not only that, they also had to use a heater the whole 3 weeks and ramped up my bill by $15. I showed them proof to one of the staff showing all my previous statements and I never got a refund. When I finally move out, they tell me that they can't prorate so I get stuck with paying a whole months worth of rent. I've never lived in apartments this horrible. This place is not worth your money.

I'm in love!!! As someone who takes their fitness pretty seriously, it's tough to find treats that don't totally screw up your macros. These donuts are AWESOME as a seriously decadent treat with remarkably good nutrition. The banana cream pie and maple flavors are my faves - the chocolate and peanut butter ones didn't do it for me, but I am definitely going to try them all. Hallelujah for these magical donuts!!!

While the staff was helpful, kind and timely the dr that attended to my daughter was clearly in a rush. His time with us was literally 30 seconds where he said he had no idea what was the cause and he'd prescribe something. That was it...what a waste of time and money to the utter discouragement of my daughter. They graciously get one star for their support staff.

Since moving to Boise, I have searched everywhere for my new local coffee shop and Mountain Timber Coffee has definitely filled that position.
The service is quick & friendly, options are robust, and the coffee delicious. Bonus is the loyalty card to get free drinks.
My favorite drinks here are the White Mocha w/ Maple Spice (Think of drinking Pancakes) and Dark Mocha w/ Toffee Nut. All five of the Mocha flavors (White, Regular, Dark, Kona, & Mexican) are wonderful in their own way.

This place is amazing! Outstanding employees! Their general manager Brad is customer friendly and runs a great hotel! We have been here since April 9 (7 weeks) due to an issue with our home and we're waiting for the insurance to get it fixed. The staff is caring and very accommodating. The hotel is well-maintained and we can tell the employees take pride in their work. I am a lifetime titanium member with Marriott, so I've had an opportunity to experience outstanding customer service with several Marriott brands. This team at the TownPlace suites Meridian have gone above and beyond to make us feel at home. Highly recommend.

I've been to several chiropractors throughout the years and he was the first one to take X-rays.   I absolutely love the pre-workout before you see him.  I literally feel my body loosening up.  I've read his reviews and he does not over charge.  He's actually a little cheaper than some of the chiropractors I've seen.   His staff is extremely nice and very professional.  Dr Baker seems to genuinely care.  He called to see how I was feeling after my first adjustment which is a first for me.

We got our food to go and when we got home we realized both of our burgers were WRONG. This was the first time trying this place and we were both disappointed. The burgers weren't very good and the fries were very soggy. Wont be back!
This is a great Starbucks!  Friendly staff and even when they are slammed they get the product to the customer pretty fast.  No complaints here!

I dropped 5 shirts for laundry service.  I waited the 3 days for their completion, arrived and no shirts.  Worker indicated they were busy and their completion would not be as indicated.  This is my last visit today.

I first went to freddies back in Florida right when they opened so I was happy to hear that there was one in boise when I moved back.. have been visited here a couple times already and each time the food is top notch and service is fast and freindly. Everything u would come to expect. I would say this is the best fast food burger in town hands down. And don't forget to try there custard we were lucky to get a free one and now we order one everythime.. very well rounded meal..

As a former gym owner with 40 + years in the fitness industry and National Fitness Hall of Fame inductee I know something about gyms!  Anytime Fitness Meridian is a well equipped and extremely clean facility.  It has all the equipment you need to get a great workout no matter what level of fitness you are at. I bring all my MS clients here and they are welcomed by members and staff. Best atmosphere I've experienced in any gym in the area. Most importantly it is owned and run by Rick & Jaclyn Hess who are welcoming to the members, always available and make this gym a one of a kind location. I highly recommend Anytime Fitness Meridian to anyone who wants a comfortable place to exercise without the overcrowding you find in many gyms.

I decided to write this review after encountering the A-Team, Amber and Alex. I hadn't written a review up until now because honestly I was too busy enjoying myself. I love their Poké Bowls here, and every employee here has been a delight. Alex is the OG of the establishment and my first encounter with him was letting him know I wanted everything (including the rice) mixed up all together; so he had to get a separate bowl and kinda change up the process, he didn't complain at all, he was really great about it. And those are the kind of friends I like, friends that don't mind when I complicate their lives and I give them nothing in return. 

The food is delicious, and if you're not into the fish, then they have other items available, like chicken teriyaki and whatnot. The prices are pretty fair for what's usually a fairly pricey food, and they have stamp cards to help reward you for your return visits. 

There's a big TV in the establishment as well, so if you're on an awkward date you can distract yourself with moving images on a screen. There's always plenty of seating as well. And that's it... I'm not sure what else you want to know. You're asking a lot of me if there's something else you're expecting.... um.... there's lots of parking. It's right by Urban Fox if you want coffee...

Listen I don't know why you're still reading. Or what else you want to know. Just go. If you like Poké Bowls then just go here and stop reading this review.

Seriously now this is getting weird for me. You need to have the common courtesy to know when you're supposed to leave a review. I invite you in, you read some stuff about some stuff, now is when you go.

Okay my name is Justin and I like long walks and silly behavior and I travel for a living. What is this tinder now?

What? What else do you want?

Yes I'm very lonely. 

My only friends work here. Alex may be my closest friend in Meridian. I told you I'm lonely what more do you want?!?!? I'm not perfect okay?!?! I've got issues!!! We all do! YES I eat more macaroni and cheese than a 31 year old man should!!! Why are you doing this to me???!! Why won't you leave?!?!
I had the Jalisco Plate, unbelievable flavor from  the bacon wrapped shrimp to the enchilada and the stuffed chicken. Super large portions and chips and salsa was also fabulous. Definitely be back.

Fit Donut (Meridian, Idaho)

Fit Donut is....

Perfect if you're on a low calorie diet or on poverty macros,
Perfect if you're on a low-carb or low-fat diet,
Perfect if you're looking for something small to fuel a workout,
Perfect if you're looking to supplement your post workout meal,
Perfect if you love peanut butter,
Perfect if you love donuts,
Perfect if you love cake,
Perfect if you have a sweet tooth,
And Perfect if you love awesome customer service.

I typically favor a raised over a cake donut, but at Fit Donut I'll make the exception and I'm glad I did.  Donuts at Fit Donut not only taste good, the macros are good too  Where else are you going to find donuts that are low in calorie, low in carbs, low in fat, and moderate in protein? Even the fiber in some of their donuts rival a cup of brocolli.  I'm not going to lie and state that Fit Donuts have the best tasting donuts in the world. But they do have the best tasting "clean" donuts that I have ever had.  I had their Peanut Butter Xtreme, the Caramel Cream, the Candy Bar, and a Peanut Butter Protein Shake.  I paid less than $15 for everything and all it cost me was only 538 total calories. I recommend all 3 donuts that I had and the shake.  I'm not on a strict contest prep type diet.  But I do watch my macros.  Regardless if I'm trying to shed a few pounds or if I'm trying to add tissue, Fit Donut is perfect!

Tip #1:  Located a few steps from Crunch Fitness Meridian

Tip #2:  Their donuts have a texture of cake.  This means you'll need a fork.  You'll thank me later.

Tip #3:  Ingredients - Almond milk, whole grain flours, coconut oil, stevia, and whey protein.  No way?  Whey!!

Tip #4:  All donuts are 107 calories or less. Carbs and fats less than grams. Protein between 5-9 grams.
My go to place for Dry cleaning services. Prompt service and quick turnaround times keep me coming back.

These guys are awesome!!!! Family owned and employees have been there for a couple of decades. They know what they're doing, are reasonably priced, and are super friendly people!

I backed into my brand new garage door on a Sunday And way overpaid another company to get my car out, who then quoted me $1600 to replace a couple of panels then told me i May be able to get the price down if i talk to the sales manager. Why wouldn't they have just given me a fair price to start with?

So i called Action Garage Door and not only where the panels half the price, but they also gave me a second option that was under $200 since the panels weren't damaged too badly if i was most interested in saving money. 

I appreciate the same day call back, honest evaluation, and super friendly staff Wes and Jeremy!!!

I showed up 10 minutes before closing and all I wanted was a small shake. When I pulled into the drive through the voice promptly informed me they closed in 10 minutes. No friendly greeting or anything. I told them I just wanted a small shake and then was informed that they had already turned off the shake machines. I replied saying I thought they were still open for 10 minutes and all she said was ya sorry. Then when I drove past the window I could hear loud cheering. completely rude and unprofessional. If a business is open until a set time you should be able to order 10 minutes before that time and get any item on the menu. I'm not even sure their shake machine was off to be honest. I think they just didn't want to help a paying customer. So I guess I will take my money else where form now on.

We absolutely LOVE Duck Donuts! We lived in Virginia for a bit & they had them all over there & were so excited they are now in Boise! Definitely a fun place to go and get a specialized donut. The owner was also really friendly!

I have always loved coming to The Boise Fry Co but will not return to this location. My mom specifically asked that her burger not be well done but that's exactly what she got. It was very dry. This is not why we won't be back. When I spoke to an employee about it (who was also the cook) said "well what do you want? You want another?" The rest of us had already finished eating so I asked for a refund for her burger. He said "fine" and walked off in a bit of a huff and no one said another thing to us. The attitude we received is why we will not return to this location.
Like the worst and slowest Dutch bros on the west coast.   Avoid at all cost.  Line doesn't move and coffee is not consistent

I'm from California, and this little hot spot was recommended to me by my local friend! We went together and had a fun night out with some great food! Don't be overwhelmed by all the options, the staff can definitely help you decide! I definitely atw here at least three times during my shirt visit to boise and could have had these fries every day lol!
Our family loves meridian family medicine! We've seen a couple doctors there and all of them and the staff is always very friendly and helpful! I would absolutely recommend them to everyone!

This office is not very professional and way overcharged for what you get. I've seen multiple chiropractors and this was definitely the worst. They try and sell you on everything and they say you have more problems then you actually do.
I tried (and my attorney) tried for over 2 months to get medical records and our calls and emails were ignored. If I did get ahold of someone they were rude and very disrespectful, the doctor included. They are definitely a scam and I do not recommend. Please find any other office to go to!

A local favorite. Big menu and very family friendly with many booths that can seat 6-8. Yummy breakfasts had generous portions and healthier options were available. Expect a wait on weekend mornings. Service staff were very friendly and attentive.

Loved this place! I was in a time crunch and someone came up to help me right when I walked in to. I don't know much about gear and the staff was kind explaining everything to me. The whole staff was smiling and so friendly I'll definitely come back here.

I am a current renter and I am very displeased with the group. They are not helpful at all, no one responds to calls or emails and when they do it is days later. When my husband and I went to pick up our keys, all I saw were workers walking around, laughing and having coffee, nowhere near their desks. I give it two stars because there was one person I did find very helpful. Lauren Daniels definitely helped but I can't say the same for the property manager.
The homes are beautiful but management is poor. I've grown white hairs with the amount of stress they have put me through.
UPDATE: I'm changing this to 4 stars. It's good for fast food burgers, but sometimes it's too greasy & the high school pimply minimum wage help is very sketchy at times.

This new cafe is excellent ! The food was so freshly prepared (I had the Greek omelet with crispy hashbrowns) and they'll make eggs Benedict in two different styles for one order. That'll be my next taste trial! Service was exemplary and prices were very reasonable. We're definitely going back to try all the different items!

One of my favorite foods to eat of all time are burritos.  And this place does them right!  Add this aspect to great service and fresh food and its a no brainer!  Whether it's for breakfast, lunch, dinner, or some cervezas, I'd recommend giving this place a try.
The best Wingstop around!!! The gentleman was very kind! Come here if you want it tasty wingzz!

Conveniently located on Chinden between Meridian and Locust Grove. Under new ownership with friendly and caring owner. The coffee shop is warm, friendly and inviting. All the staff I have interacted with a very friendly and helpful. Excellent smoothies and coffee with delightful treats and snacks. They even carry Fit doughnuts. My go to coffee shop in Meridian.
The graveyard shift crew are the sweetest people I have come into contact with! So hospitable and kind!!
Great staff, friendly and fast service. Always consistent. Great kids menu and awesome pina coladas! So so good!!!!
Tastes out of this world. One of my favorite places.  But be prepared to wait awhile for your food. Also some of the staff are very incompetent and rude.

YUCK...On Friday Nov. 15th, 6pm, They served us old dried out wings and slimy ones that hadn't been cooked well, all luke warm. We didn't look at the wings until we got home.They had a strange taste and smell and my husbands order had **super** small boneless ones, which was such a rip off for what you expect to get. And hardly any sauce on them. After having a few bites i couldn't eat anymore bc I didn't want to get sick. 

I strongly advise to the business-

#1 Dont serve old, cold food, EVER 
#2 Cook and sauce it properly 
#3 Portion your food correctly 
#4 Practice proper food handling and cleanliness in order not to make people sick 

If these things don't change please close your business. Worst Wing Stop I've ever been to.

We've been going to this dentist for the past four years.  Dr. Howard and his staff are great!  We're always met with pleasure and treated as treasured patients.  They work with us per our discount dental plan and even go beyond to help save us money!  Dr. Howard will refer out if the treatment requires a specialist, which he has done for us.  We will certainly continue to be dedicated patients of Dr. Howard and his friendly, helpful staff!
Best donuts I have ever had. My daughter said they are so good she could die! Warm, soft, and made to order! Puts Krispy Kreme to shame.

A fresh and yummy treat or meal replacement. Lots of options for fruit and some vegetables. 

My favorite is the PBJ. You can add a lot of things to your smoothie (such as protein powder, wheat grass, supplements, etc). Buys beware - - additions add up very quickly and you could easily end up paying for an $8.00 large smoothie. 

A lot of the smoothies are made with nonfat frozen yogurt which I'm not a fan of. I'd rather just have fruits and vegetables. And the smallest size (12 oz) starts at $4.00, so it's definitely one of the priciest places to get a smoothie. 

They're taking COVID very seriously. No dine in option, absolutely no entry without mask and even special entry and exit doors.

No results from my lab test taken almost 2 weeks ago! Had to go to the doctor without the lab work, not good.
So disappointed with quest diagnostics I'm going to look into another lab to do my blood work.

3rd times a charm? Nope..... 

I cannot in all good faith recommend this place. Oh boy. Where to start? 

Let's just review the overall concept: creamy EVERYTHING. We all love sour cream on our burritos it is indeed a staple of burritos everywhere to counter the heat and acid and salt of the meats and salsa. These guys tip the scale WAY WAY WAY too far to one side. Why is everything dripping in creamy sauces?? Every bite of one of these burritos is just a sloppy, wet, nondescript mess because of all the creamy stuff that goes into making one of these things. 

I've tried this place 3 times, thinking my first experience was a "new restaurant jitters" experience. We accepted our free meal vouchers and gave them a 2nd shot. 2nd time was all but inedible with soggy diapers wrapped in foil being tossed in the trash after a few bites. 

3rd time? Same nondescript flavors, same soggy diapers being tossed out after a couple disappointing mouthfuls of overly creamy flavor downing out everything else. 

Overall, it's a white people burrito by white people for white people; no spice, no flavor.

Great customer service and a quick turn around. I was on a cross country trip and came in with oil going everywhere it wasn't supposed to go. They got me in that day, showed me what the crack mechanic didn't do and got us back on the road the next day. I would stop there anytime I came through.  They take care of the traveling riders and send me on my way knowing I can ride into the dessert

Terrible customer service. 45 minutes before closing, there were 5 workers there, all messing around not doing their job. Bumping eachother to purposely mess with the ice cream, and we were served melted ice cream. Not to mention there were 5 staff and it took them 20 minutes to go through less than 10 people in line. Not going there again.
Love Gramercy Park!  The pizza is always great and never disappoints.  My favorite though are the pot roast melts.  Holy cow!  They are fantastic!

Took my grandsons here for the younger ones birthday breakfast. We were seated quickly and our waitress Kassi came quickly and took our drink order. When ordering I mentioned we were celebrating a birthday and kassi rounded everyone up and sang and brought a muffin with whipped cream. Big hit for the 7 year old. We ordered the waffle sandwich the biscuits and gravy for the boys I ordered the monte cristo sandwich. The boys were happy with their meals but the monte cristo was sooooo soggy which is definitely NOT how it is supposed to be. I would indeed go back and try something different. They have a nice menu with plenty of options and service was great.

I want to start off by saying I love this company and have had great experiences in the past at other locations. 

A couple of months ago, I was using the online system to place an order for pickup later in the week. I ordered one Bundtlet and one personalized box of bundtinis. I got an error message after putting in my card information and it stated to call the location. After numerous times calling, no one ever answered the phone. (yes, I checked to see if they were open). I then started over on my online order and then got to the same spot with the same error message. Again, after calling multiple times, I never got an answer. 

I then decided to drive to the location after noticing my card was charged twice even though the webpage was stating they did not receive my order. This was not exactly convenient for me as I live about 25 minutes away from this location but I felt I had no choice because again, I LOVE their cakes. I was able to go in an place my order with the girl working at the counter. I spoke with the manager about my card being charged twice and now a third time at their location. She assured me my card would be refunded for the other two times within 3 business days. (It was refunded within that time frame). I set my order to be picked up later in the week. 

The end of the week comes and I go to pick up my order. The same girl was working at the counter that helped me place my order earlier in the week. I tell her I am there to pick up my order and give her my name. She looks through several different systems and papers and says she cannot find my order and has no record of it being placed. She asks me a couple of questions and then remembers that she had helped me. 

I then spoke with the manager again and she assured me that they would be able to put my order together right away. Come to find out, they had to frost cupcakes as they didn't have any ready. I had to stand there and wait 15 minutes for an order that should have been ready when I got there. 

I do not write this review to bash on the business. However, I do know that this is a franchise and I think it is important that the franchise owner is aware of the experience I had. I never received an apology from the worker or the manager for all of the trouble I went through. If they are having online system issues, they should be answering their phone. There is no excuse. From someone who has previously worked in the food industry, this is no way to treat customers.
I had my first massage ever, yesterday at this place and it was AMAZING!!!! I was so nervous but they made me feel comfortable and I was able to relax.
These ARE NOT! Marriott beds! We stay at Marriotts so we can count on a good nights sleep in a good bed. This place is a fake!

The chips were stale, and the food was very bland. I went there because of the high review rating, but was very disappointed. The service was good, which is the only reason I'm rating 2 stars. If my review were based on food alone, it would be 1 star.

I've never been so annoyed trying to get some sleep in a hotel. The people above us had several kids in the room and they were running around, jumping and slamming doors at 10:30/11 at night. I finally had to call the front desk to let them know and they said they would investigate. About 15 more minutes went by and it sounded like a herd of elephants! I finally went up the stairs and the kids had the door opened and I asked them to be quiet because we could hear everything and we couldn't sleep. My kids had a baseball tournament the next day so they needed to get good sleep. Finally it was somewhat quiet for my kids to fall asleep but for another hour all I heard was loud creaking from the ceiling!! The walls and ceiling are paper thin! Don't stay here if you want a nice, peaceful sleep!

Pretty cool little place, you choose your thing chocolate vanilla or Berry ice cream bar, also you could you a frozen banana, then they dip it in chocolate or put marshmallow on it and sprinkle toppings. Basically a build your own ice cream bar.

I chose chocolate ice cream with caramel marshmallow and Oreos, and it was delicious. They even gave me a little wooden spoon to eat it with which I liked because I didn't have to get my beard messy.

Would definitely come back

Food was great! Owner was amazing as he offered to break up one of the large plates into 4 smaller dishes for my kids. He took special care to make sure we didn't have messy containers and offered extra napkins and forks since he saw my kids were little. Amazing foods loved the wings and the beef! And the Mac n' cheese was fantastic. Highly recommend!!!!!
Great variety of protein options and good service. A little on the pricey side but it was worth it bc the generous serving size.

This place is GREAT!
While their pot pie is not actually a pie, the filling served is outstanding.
The pork belly sliders are really really good as an appetizer, you get three of them and they are each different so if you are sharing them, split each one with your partner to experience the wonderful tastes that they provide.
The brick oven pizza is really good. You'll just have to trust me, you'll like it. 
The big thing though is their burgers... OH MAN! Each burger is served on a PRETZEL BUN! That's correct! A bun, made of pretzel dough!
FRIKKING OUTSTANDING!!!!
The best part about this place, not that the food isn't killer enough, is that the owner, Park, puts out a couple of guitars at about 9pm and invites anyone and everyone to come on up and play a while!!! Believe it or not, but this place has KILLER ACCOUSTICS and the guitars can be heard clearly even though they are not electric. There have been several times where people have picked up the guitars and treated the whole establishment to original music that is truly world class! And they were just patrons..
Everyone is invited to play...
Sessions, with sessions beer was my suggestion.
The wait and bar staff is awesome. The owner Park is is a really great guy. This place is definitely worth a try for the burgers on PRETZEL BREAD BUNS and you'll never know who will pick up one of the guitars!

You get two ways to order, online for either in store pickup or have it delivered. When I arrived I gave my name to the cashier, after she wrote it down a woman came out from the back and asked my name again, I gave it. I was then questioned if it was Elizabeth? If my name were Elizabeth, I would have given that name. My online receipt shows Beth and my legal name is Beth. Once past that, I asked for two separate bags because the cakes ordered were going to two different people. I was told the cakes are wrapped to present as a gift, but for an extra charge they can be wrapped separately! Meanwhile, I'm trying to get my order because they don't answer the phone, it said on their recording to dial an extension, I was hoping for curbside delivery as I had my two dogs in the car. It was 74 degrees and I needed to get back to them. Ordinarily, I wouldn't bring my dogs, my boy has lymphoma cancer and has maybe two weeks left...I wanted him to get as many car rides as possible...we live in Nampa, so this was a treat for him. He's a therapy dog and deserves presidential treatment for all the happiness he has brought to people.I finally got the cakes, in two separate brown bags?!! First and last experience.

Hi I'm on my mom's phone and I am eating at la creme!!! The ice cream is sooooooooo good and I think everyone should go because they have lots of really yummy flavors and toppings and you get to CHOOSE WHAT COLOR OF SPOON YOU GET!!!!!

When they're open this location is fine, usual McDonald's experience. However, this location is randomly closed with no notice or signs, just cones blocking the drive through and this is the second time this has happened in the last week.
Food was late, cold, watched it sit on the prep table for about 12 minutes. Fries old and cold. Worst five guys I've ever had and I've had a lot!

I wanted to browse the aisles in the store as I normally do. I needed to use the rest room. There was all kinds of stuff in the way of getting to the rest room, almost like a barricade. I figure that if Big Lots wants me to shop there they need to provide a rest room that is easy to get to. I left without buying anything.

I travel a lot. Been to a lot of dentist offices and have to say this place is by far the best one yet! I will be traveling back to Boise Idaho for all my dentist work moving forward. There's nothing fun about getting shots in your mouth, expensive bills, or listening to a drill grind your teeth! But I can actually say I'm looking forward to my next visit. Thanks guys!

This particular location is very dirty. Flies everywhere, tables weren't really cleaned, floors are filthy.  The outside patio smells like garbage, seems like the garbage in front hasn't been cleaned out in a long time. Will not recommend this location.

Drove down to get some food and they were closed. Who closes 5 hours before they are scheduled? What a joke. 

Update the hours on your website before you waste my time and gas.

OMG worst place ever!!!  Besides bad cx service try out the gun range across the street with non stop 50 calibers being shot at 7am tell 11pm.  They're still raising rent prices like the place is worth it too top it off.  200 dollar price increase in 12 months!!!  Enjoy trying to SLEEP (NOT GONNA HAPPEN) thru gun fire and your weekends well hell you can enjoy it ALL DAY LONG if you stay home.  Place is horrible STAY AWAY if you're smart!!!!

Masks are required to enter but not once you are seated. The staff was very warm and welcoming to their clean and bright dining room. We were seated quickly and our drink order taken. While we were looking at the menu, the general manager came over to say hello and answer questions about the menu. 
Kids meals are generous and good variety. Good was hot and delicious. 
My husband loved his chilaquiles with carne asada, eggs were cooked perfectly and the waffles and cinnamon pancake were delicious. What a great combination of well made food and great service. We will be back!

The location on Eagle Road has an awesome framing department. I have had several pictures framed and they helped pick out the perfect Matt and frame. I would highly recommend them!!!   Here is an example

Heat up your tortillas please. This place has a lot of potential, but every taco was served on a tortilla that had to of been taken directly out of a fridge. The salsas were also very cold. If they'd heat up the tortillas or even have them at room temp it would have been a lot better. Hope those little things change by the next time I stop in.

SoCal transplant to Boise area. Read all the reviews I could find for the 'best' burger. Freddy's was the most popular. Got their California style cheese burger. It was okay. Did try fry sauce first time-like it better than ketchup. For now, the best burger locally is 13th Street Pub & Grill. Hands down.

Unfortunately, they have very poor customer service. Customers are coming to bring business, so treat them well and put them first. Nobody getting their nails done there is a sign to run. Learn to be kind and put a smile on and happy to answer questions without an attitude when customers go in. People will want to stay and support small businesses when they feel accepted and comfortable.

Thank you Home River  ! we  lived in house for ten in Half years pine ave went through Three  different property managements . we left house cleaner then when we moved in  Home river went off our move in check list  and did not  try to charge us for previous tenants damage that was there when we moved in and we received almost all our deposit back ! Thank you for your professionalism and honoring our move in lease ! 
Brian

Is it that hard to actually call in the prescription that the physician has prescribed?  More than once I have had to call the office receptionist to have the prescription sent to the pharmacy.  This is after waiting more than an hour after the appointment.  I'm not going to even begin to describe the irritation felt when having to wait 30 in the examination room to be seen by the PA.  Go to a different location!

Awesome store with great cooking classes and employees.  They carry a pretty wide variety of merchandise....employees are extremely courteous, not pushy and really go the extra mile to help you find things. Pricing is comparable to other stores that sell high end kitchen supplies.

I took two cooking classes which were so informative, nice and my food was very tasty.  The instructors are fun and full of information. The instructors are organized...teach very well...and overall made cooking fun.

I can't wait to come back to Idaho for a visit..so I can take more classes.

Jamie is a wonderful server.  Served with a smile, checked on us and kept our water glasses and coffee cups filled and our meals were hot!  Loved the dishes and the rest. was filled with families!  Best Sunday breakfast after church!!  Thank you Broken Yolk for hiring such fine staff/amazing servers!!  You have done well!

I regularly visit this Jack in the Box store & I have to say that I am absolutely impressed each and every time. I have only used the drive thru. Every time I pull up to the speaker, the worker greets me in a really nice manner, not over the top animated where you feel like they are faking it. They seem a bit genuine. 
The drive thru is usually pretty busy, but the employees are always moving fast to make sure you aren't stuck in the drive thru for days. 
Each and every time I have visited this JITB, my food has been fresh, hot, & cooked according to my specifications.
Jennifer is super helpful and was able to close in two weeks! I highly recommend this awesome company!

Enjoying the amazing sunshine that beautifully streams through the big windows along with a lovely flight of dark beers. 

My personal favorite so far is the 18lb from Georgetown. Yummy!!

When you walk into the Revitalize Juice Bar you can  smell the fresh pressed juice in the air! We tried their Ignite and Millennial. They also carry kombucha and acai bowls. They both tasted really good! They were yummy and made us feel alert. The juice didn't taste disgustingly healthy and was very drinkable. 

They have a pretty big place for people to hang out and many outlets for charging. It was very modern. This would be a great place to work or study in if you want a change of environment.

The prices are steep, since it is $8/bottle, but it was well worth it. We will be back!

I have been to Mi Casa a LOT since it opened, and the latest experience I had there was not good. They were clearly short on wait staff, and the results were that no one stopped to even check on refills on our drinks, it took probably 25 mins to get our order once we sat down, and when we had another person show up late but still join our table, they never even asked if she wanted anything nor did they offer a menu to her to look at. The food was good, which is the only reason this is 2 stars instead of one. Incredibly disappointed and not sure I'll go back. I hope they do something to improve the dining room experience or they won't be around much longer, regardless of their food.

I'm disappointed in the all you can eat mondays, I'd consider myself a regular here and I get the same thing every time. The tiny cups they offer are their only size now on mondays and it wasn't even big enough to get everything I wanted. It's a ripoff. And when I asked if I could just get the regular size the girl said I had to do the $4 fill up. Ridiculous
Very fresh, tightly wrapped, flavorful burrito.  I usually have to keep adding extra hot sauce, but this had plenty of flavor.  Friendly and timely service.

What a great addition to Meridian. Great service and amazing selection of breakfast and lunches. Food was wonderful and can't wait to go back and try another dish. Highly recommend everyone trying this establishment.
Fast and friendly! Went through the drive thru to get some chicken strips. In the drive thru for less than 5 minutes, greeting kindly by the person at the window, and my food was delicious!

I am going to gain 100 lbs eating at freddys. Everything that I have tasted seems like it was prepared by Demi gods and fried in happiness. I've never had anything that I was disappointed with and have nothing but good things to say about this establishment.

My daughter and I had a great breakfast this morning at the Broken Yolk . 
Their menu has plenty of options for everyone to enjoy . 
Their portion sizes are large and filling . 
Their pomegranate mimosa was fantastic. 
It was clean and the wait staff was very friendly . 
Our waitress was very helpful in suggestion on what we should choose . 
Hope you enjoy it as much as we did !!
Easy online ordering and quick pick-up. Unfortunately, the burritos were cold and soggy. So disappointing and definitely do not recommend.

We finally checked out the Growler Guys this week after we couldn't get a drink at Slanted Rock.  It's awesome!  My only complaint is that I wish they had more tables (or at least more chairs).  We got one of the four tables available but two people had to stand until some chairs were freed up.  I do understand that their intention is NOT to be a bar; however their selection is awesome and I would prefer this over a bar any day.  

I'm not a beer girl but I've recently discovered cider and I love it!  That being said, the owner was VERY patient with me.  He actually lined up samples of all 5 ciders he had and let me taste all of them.  My choice of the night was Hopsation IPA.  My husband is usually a Coors Light drinker (don't judge haha) and he was venturing out of his comfort zone.  To his delight he found several beers that he loved.  We'll be back for some growlers before Saturday's game!  I don't think either of us has felt more comfortable asking to taste different kinds.  Most of the breweries are packed full of people and the employees seem like they don't have time to wait for you to taste and decide.  

Speaking of growlers... They have quite a selection to choose from.  Not only is there a large selection of beers and cider, you can choose between glass, stainless steel, mini kegs etc.  We thought he might be a Vandal (because he had some really cool Vandal growlers) but apparently the Boise State growlers flew off the shelves and sold out.  They also carry great gifts ranging from $20 hoodie sweatshirts to party packs that include a full growler with glasses.

On 1/5/21, I tried this Meridian-based food truck for the first time. It was well worth the trip. Chowobunga offers Hawaiian plate lunches, healthy Grain Bowls, and weekly specials. There are also a couple of desserts.

Plate lunches are your choice of beef or chicken teriyaki skewers with rice, macaroni salad, shrimp tempura, and salad. There are three different sizes, Small (Grommet/young surfer), Medium (Wahine/female surfer), or Large. (Kahuna/Big Guy). Beef is slightly more expensive than chicken.

I ordered the medium size plate lunch with beef ($13), but asked if I could switch out one of the 3 beef skewers for chicken. Owner/Operator Eric Inaba was happy to accommodate my request. In fact, he threw in an extra beef skewer, which means the chicken skewer was on the house. When I returned to my office, I was surprised to see Eric had also added some Kahlúa pork to my plate.

Teriyaki isn't something I order often because I don't like "sweet meet" and most teriyaki sauces are too sweet for my taste. Eric's teriyaki is the best I've ever had. It wasn't just the perfectly flavored teriyaki sauce itself, which must be homemade, but the combination of the teriyaki sauce and the perfectly grilled meat. Both the beef and chicken had a nice char but were still moist and flavorful. The Kalua pork was excellent as well, as were all of the sides. The portion size was so generous that I ended up with enough leftovers for a second meal. I liked that the plate lunch included perfectly cooked shrimp tempura and a fresh salad. The customer service was excellent as well. I can't wait to return!

To find Chowobunga, like and follow their Facebook page and Instagram, as well as the free app StreetFoodFinder. Per Instagram, Chowobunga is at Central Valley Baptist Church (600 N Ten Mile) every Tuesday and Thursday from 11 AM to 2 PM, and at the Idaho Youth Ranch Thrift Store (231 N Main St.) every Wednesday and Friday from 11 AM to 2 PM. Both locations are in Meridian.

Highly Recommended!!!

Not a good visit or showing. Dinner service for Moms day and they're out of fry sauce and failed to give us our entire order. I had to go back and get everything. Lack of customer service and attention to detail. They were almost bored it was so slow and couldn't get our order right. Avoid this place and visit another outlet.  
Cheers!

With the exception of the furnace being in the attic, most issues came to light after the first year. I will continue to tell everybody with two areas how horrible my experience was. I know Coleman doesn't care now anymore than it cared for years ago. I'm not the only one of my street that feels  that way.

They do wings!!! Period. This is my go to spot. I used to love eating at Wing Stop while living in Texas years ago. I was thrilled when it came here to Boise/Meridian because there really isn't anything like it other than wing nuts in Nampa which is only "so so" but I like this place much better. 

The fries are fresh home made with a unique seasoning that I just love. Dip some in the ranch and you've got a home run!!

They offer an absolute killer deal of a $5 lunch available all the time/everyday. Wings/strips, fries/side and a drink. My favorites had become the chicken strips. I know I'm not traditional anymore eating real wings ( they're also great here).

I'm not sure what the complainers are taking about. This place is far better than most places for wings and hella cheaper and better than something like Buffalo Wild wings crap.

My husband and I have been here on 2 occasions and have not been disappointed.  Delicious food and excellent service.  On the first occasion I had the Jolly Green Giant vegetarian pizza.  The odd ingredient is the avocado but it works!   Thin crust pizza was absolutely delicious.  On my 2nd visit I had the Flat Iron Veggi, which I liked even better than the pizza.  The sandwich was delicious and the side salad I ordered was very fresh.  I ordered blue cheese dressing and it is clearly homemade.  Spot on!

Both times my husband ordered the Gramercy sandwich.  You have to order it to believe it.  Hubby doesn't normally order the same thing from the menu on the 2nd visit because he wants to try new dishes.  But he said the Gramercy was so good he couldn't help himself.  The sandwich is HUGE so plan for leftovers or sharing or order only if you have a very big appetite.  It is piled high with corned beef, pot roast, French fries, coleslaw, swiss cheese, and tomatoes.  Plus you get a side with it.  My husband ordered the French fries at my urging because I wanted to try them.  The fry sauce is probably one of the best I have ever had.  My husband said it reminded him of the Artic Circle, though I can't comment as I've never been there.

The service was terrific.  The wait staff was efficient and friendly.  And on the first visit we spied a person (we assume to be the manager) double and triple checking all orders for accuracy before they went to tables.  And the prices are very reasonable.

We will absolutely be back.   It has become one of our favorites.

We have patronized this particular Arby's four times via the drive thru (due to covid-19).  EVERY time our order was wrong... charged for lettuce and tomatoes that weren't on sandwiches...charged for double meat that wasn't received, etc.
Tonight we called the store and their 'solution' was to return the sandwiches to the store.  They make an error, but "can't do anything" unless we incur the expense of driving back.  Suggested an email of a coupon - nope.  
We will not be returning.  Beyond disappointed.

Went here just based on Yelp reviews and proximity to where we were running errands. Pacifico on tap is always a great start! Hubs had 3 Carne Asada tacos and I had chicken fajitas. Delicious!! Maybe share the fajitas, I had to take home half and I am an eater! Very generous portions and chips and salsa were yummy! Clean, friendly and great food. We will go back!

The picture of the dirty napkin is from  the floor in our kitchen area. I spilled water after we came back from dinner and went to wipe it up and this was the icing on the cake. I took this up to the front desk and he said it didn't look good and he wondered who cleaned the first floor. I asked him how we know our room is clean after this? He didn't know. We had already been in the room an hour when this happened and changing rooms was a huge hassle because of our dogs so we stayed in the room. I pray to God I don't catch anything while I'm here. I was traveling to help my sister, reluctantly because of Covid and now I'm a little scared. This is not what I expect from Marriott. I'm sorry to have to leave this message but do not stay at this hotel! Obviously they are not taking the cleaning and sanitizing of the rooms seriously.
Fantastic dealer with tons of events year round , great Service & Motor clothes employees

First and most importantly...the food was AMAZING! Also the family that runs the truck are so nice and helped figure out gluten free options for me. He allowed us to try the pros, chicken and Mac salad before ordering. I ended up getting pork and I WILL be back.

The customer service here is awful. Tonight the young woman that was at the register, I will leave her name out, clearly hated her job. I paid for my food. Where she told me good bye and instantly started ignoring me. The thing is I had yet to be handed my food. I stood there for nearly 2 minutes thinking she would notice me still there. She hadn't, she continued to chat with her coworker. When I finally asked for my food she rolled her eyes and in a very blatantly annoyed manner threw it in a bag without saying a world. If i were this girls manager she should have been fired. I work 2 jobs in customer service and no matter how much you hate your job you should put on that show to make the customer service spectacular.  I am not one to write review but I am absolutely appalled by this service.

Wasn't sure about this place after reading other reviews....but I am here for it! I ordered two crispy fish tacos, two carnitas with just onions and cilantro, and four cauliflower tacos at around 12:30 on a Friday for pick up. Got a notice that they would be ready at 12:41 and I showed up then and they were delivered to me curbside. They weren't cold at all! Bag was warm to the touch and they stayed warm for my drive home. Carnitas was juicy and tender and the fish and cauliflower were surprisingly crispy even though there was a generous amount of sauce and toppings on them all. Plenty of sauce (7 containers) to support alllll the tacos. I will definitely be back. The value, flavor and service were all there! What more can you ask for?
If you like stale chip and nasty ass margaritas this is your place. GROSS!! Don't waste your money.
Just so much mayo... Banana pudding is great, bread is working for me. Gotta remember to ask for less mayo.
If you eat low carb/keto, this is the place. We stop every time we are passing through and get 2-3 dozen to go home and flash freeze since it's an 8 hour drive one way. Gluten free options!

First time to a Freddys. Got lucky enough to  be greeted by Jason, the manager, and he took my order. Told me to get the  #3 double Steakburger and pumpkIn custard shake. Was bomb! Employees are happy and helpful, reflection of a great manager. I won't go into details, but a young child had a messy accident (stomach) and Jason very professionally came out and helped one of hIs employees clean it up. Refreshing to see a manager appreciate, respect, and get his hands dirty with his employees. I'll definitely be back. Hopefully, less vomit on the next visit.
This has a fun play land for kids but the bathrooms need some consistent cleaning. Always messy tables that need wiped down and the food area doesn't get cleaned as much as it should.

Since arriving in Idaho I hadn't found the right dentist over the years and then I was sent over to try out Silverstone Family Dental and they hit it out of the park! Great staff, service and they have helped getting my teeth taken care of the right way again! Thank you! :)

13 years ago I was shopping here and passed out breaking my arm in the shopping cart.  I was pregnant with a rainbow baby after a miscarriage, with my 3 year old buying him dinner.  I was taken care of with live, and my toddler kept near and safe while an ambulance was called.  You called my family and helped care for me along with the people behind me in line a firefighter and police officers wife.  My baby is turning 13 this year.  So often in life we see people in a hurry.  But when this horrifying event happened to me when I was shopping alone with my toddler you helped care for me, care for my toddler and kept me calm as I worried about the baby inside of me hoping I wouldn't lose him.  Your store sent me flowers as I recovered.  Thanks for being awesome and caring for me as a member of the community in my most vulnerable and scary moment.  Everyone is happy and healthy today :)
Amazing church with real people and a true love for Jesus and His people. After attending an abusive, cult-like church for ten years this is the safest I've felt in a long time. Excited to grow here.

This is the bike shop with the customer service, knowledge, and brands you'll love. They've recently moved into this old church location on Main Street and it is perfect. Paul is the owner and has been in the bike industry forevs and so was his Dad. This place is family friendly and the vibe is awesome. We get all our bicycle needs met and more here. Gotta love it.

We didn't get a chance to sample the food because they seated us, gave us chips, no water, no drinks, no silverware and 20 minutes later, after no more attention  and two tables who came after us had been served we walked out. 
Probably good food, lots of people, but incredibly bad service.

On 2/26/21, I visited The Broken Yolk in Meridian for the first time. I was disappointed.

The original Broken Café started in 1979 in Pacific beach, a local beach community in San Diego. They were known for their breakfasts in particular, as well as homemade food in large portions. They are famous for their Benedix, and for their Golden State Benedict in particular. 

While I prefer traditional Eggs Benedict, I was happy to see the Order Two option for $12.29 that allows you to order any two Eggs Benedicts and get half of each of one. The Broken Yolk has six Eggs Benedict's: Classic, Caprese, Golden State, Border, Sopes and Chicken & Waffle. I chose Classic and Golden State with Home fries. The Classic is a toasted English muffin topped with Canadian bacon, poached eggs and hollandaise sauce. Golden State is a toasted English muffin topped with grilled tomato, tomato avocado, applewood smoked bacon, poached eggs, hollandaise sauce, and a Sriracha drizzle.
 
My English muffin didn't appear to be toasted on either. I like the hollandaise sauce, though it was a tad heavy on the lemon. I liked that the Classic had what seemed like a good quality and thick piece of Canadian ham. The Golden State had unripe avocado and too much Hollandaise, which quickly made the bacon soggy. I can see how this version of a Benedick would be a hit, if well executed. The home fries, though ordered crisp, were not. They were oily and needed some seasoning.

A lot of my friends like biscuits and gravy. I asked for a small sample of their gravy, so I could report back. I didn't care for it. It had very little flavor and almost no visible sausage.

I don't normally comment on interiors, but I was surprised to find this restaurant has a hard plastic, fast food like interior. I'm OK with that if I am in a fast food joint, or in a place that has exceptional food, but that was not the case. I have been to Denny's that felt more welcoming.

If like me, you love a great Eggs Benedict, I would highly recommend the one at Goldy's in Boise.
I bought a new bike rack from meridian cycles and had a few questions. Great shop, super friendly, decent prices and the bike tech hooked me up and fixed my shifting issues!

I had the pork street tacos and let me say, they were full of flavor, delicious, and I was instantly impressed. Until I got food poisoning and had to literally crawl to my bathroom from my bed. Other than that, it was good! I just hope its made fresh!

We have used them twice this year for brush and juniper removal and both times they were quick, efficient and safe.  The last time, they took out a large stand of junipers, filling their dump truck in only a couple of hours.  They also trimmed an out of control pine, so it looked nice and even brought a load of topsoil, to "sculpt" the land into a blank canvas for us to plant this spring.  Very impressed.

If I could give less than 1 stars I would.  We were there for an hour and 20 minutes for two sandwiches and a kids meal followed by 2 pre made deserts.  The service was extremely slow and my guess is the kitchen was slower.  The waitress messed up our order and we ended up sharing the one entree.  We use to go here all the time, but after this experience we will not be going back. To add salt to the wound...it wasn't even busy.

Dr. White has completely transformed my life!! If you live near his clinic then my friend you are very lucky!! 

(The last time I went to a chiro the guy tried to use a electric clicker down my back and then wanted me to sign up for 25 sessions of that!! NO THANKS) that was 10 years ago. I figured all Chiros were the same so I kinda wrote them off and stuck to foam rolling and some lacross ball work. 

I was visiting my Family in Meridian for a week but not without first throwing my back out loading luggage into the back of an Uber on our way to PHX Airport last Friday evening . I'm in my 30s and threw my back out, but according to Dr. White, it happens quite often! 

I thought I was in for a week of inactivity and moping around but that all changed when my little sister recommended I call a chiro that's open on Saturday. I am so grateful that Dr. White answered the phone and was sympathetic to my situation, got an appt. the next morning! I was floored by his knowledge and ability to teach it while he performed hands on treatment. He could feel where the underlying issues were and even get to the bottom of what created the angry situation my muscles and joints were undergoing. I was at a level 10 pain and within a few hours after the first Pain Treatment my level was at a 3! I mad two more appointments with him, I saw him every other day while I was in town, even my Wife who didn't think she needed it gave it a try and we found out she was just as wound up if not more than I was lol!

I say he transformed my life because he gave me the experience I wish I had been given a decade ago! I now know there is tremendous value in having scheduled Visits with a Chripractor and not just any but one that shows up and gives 110% to his/her patients! I am on a mad hunt to find one of Dr. Whites caliber now that I'm back home.

Duck, North Carolina originated (hence the name) chain of  shops with "warm, delicious, made to order" (their slogan) donuts  made its' landing in Idaho at The Village in Meridian (next to Rooster's Men's Grooming) as a local franchise owner store serving up a "duckzillion" (their estimate) of topping variations to finish off tender, light vanilla cake donuts all cooked fresh when ordered.  

VIBE:  It smells good inside the moment one walks in and on a lovely warm day (as was the one we chose) with doors open on both sides of the bright from windows all around space the 'ahhh...'roma wafting out had what seemed a raft of people (did you know a group of ducks is called a raft), mostly women, saying "ooohhh...what is this?" and walking in as we sat outside to enjoy the day and donuts.  

But clearly some folks had already discovered this because there were also several people, all men as it happens, coming in to pick up boxes of donuts ordered in advance to go.    And now you know too.

SERVICE:  All good as it goes for donut options but it is also the super friendly people working here in the sparkling clean space that are the...well...special icing on the cake donut shop! 

EATS:  And before we get to the donuts, here was a surprise for me...they make milkshakes too using Breyer's ice cream (any of us who have lived on the East coast know that name)  in maybe ten flavors.

This time donuts but next time it will a milkshake for which I waddle in.  (Do you suppose ducks waddle because they've spent too much time in the Duck Donuts calorie pond?)

They also have coffee that is served nice and hot including a light house blend which I passed up in favor of an Americano to sip with the donuts.  They also have a pecan flavored coffee (remember the North Carolina origin) that I can't imagine any West Coast person would order but one never knows.  

Breakfast sandwiches made with donuts were also on the menu and as Yelp is my witness someone called in an order for same when we were in the shop at mid afternoon so they must be available all day.

DONUT DEETS: I don't eat many donuts, you could likely count them on the fingers of one hand with digits leftover and get it right,  as in general I don't find them worth the calorie investment but these were tasty.  A plan cake donut is actually my fav of any and to give these all cake donut options a fair test I ordered one plain, or bare as they call it, and one chocolate covered both to share with my hubby at a table on the sidewalk outside.  Since they are all cooked to order the donuts are served up (in a great little box) nice and warm.  Both options were tender and tasty although for my palate I prefer my plain cake donuts with some nutmeg in the batter and you won't find that here.  Still, both my husband and I enjoyed these enough, not to mention the friendly service, to look forward to going back again to try more topping options.  Coming from two usually non donut eaters that is high praise.  In particular since we are also people who avoid chains of any kind.

HOW TO ORDER:  There are plastic covered, double sided 8.5 x11 pages with photos and descriptions of just a few dozen of the umpteen possibilities in the store. Basically it works like this:  you start with the plain donut and a) pick a coating, b) pick a topping, c) pick a drizzle... https://www.duckdonuts.com/menu/made-order-donuts/

HOURS:   7a to 7p I think. 

PRICES:   Any donut is $1.95.  If you think that's spendy, consider the local Guru options that clock in north of three bucks in some cases.   Coffee is $1.75, Americano $2.50.  Milkshakes TBD when we make our next visit since they are quacking in my brain "come back and try me".

ACCESSIBILITY:  Meets all ADA marks.  Level in the door, all on one level, standard height seating at table (in addition to high counter option).  Parking lot has marked ADA spots - 2 - including 1 van accessible.

SEATING:  Limited but there is some inside and outside too.

Took my kid there to get a smoothie. Small and quaint. Prices are reasonable. No public restroom. Drive through. The perfect place for meeting up with a friend. Not good for big groups. Cute coffee shop.

This review is regarding a re-sale home, I did not build my home in the preserve, I purchased a home previously built by Coleman. At move-in the house was 1.25 years old. 

My comments are regarding the design of this home. I previously lived in a custom home in another state, with very thoughtful design. This home is in a wonderful neighborhood, peaceful, serene, but the architectural details are ridiculous.

Our laundry room connects the garage to the kitchen. The doors both swing in and they touch. WTH? Try to imagine, you've got your arms full of your groceries, you walk in door 1 (garage) and you have to close that door behind you, to open door 2 (to kitchen). If you happen to have kids, as I do, imagine if you have a laundry basket in that room as well (um, always). Did they really just design two doors that touch in a tiny space? All that would have been needed was a pocket door at kitchen, OR exactly TWO inches more space in laundry room. 2 inches would mean the doors didn't touch. But pocket door would have been a thoughtful approach. No space lost with the kitchen door access swinging into the laundry room. I will be paying for a remod of this room in 2020.

Master walk-in closet. The entry door swings in to the right, blocking an entire wall of shelves that cannot be accessed unless you walk all the way in (it's small too) and then close the door. This was not a female architect who designed this closet, no way. I guarantee it was some dude who never ever thought about using those shelves. I will be discussing what I can do to remodel this closet in 2020.

Bathroom. The door swings in and covers the drawers of a very small bathroom. Not a female architect! No woman would have ever designed a bathroom that you cannot open the drawers to grab a lipstick without going all the way into the bathroom and closing the door. This could have been remedied easily with thoughtful design. Instead the door swings into the drawers.

I love this neighborhood and we are torn about leaving it, have thought of selling, have thought of remod, and will be getting quotes for the latter so that we can make this a functional home. If you are considering building with Coleman, I urge you to review the plans closely. Specifically, look at the doors to closets, laundry, etc. The house feels solid otherwise, just not very well designed.
I went here a few months ago for work on a bike. Nice people, but the place was busy and no employees were wearing masks. Went back recently and same thing - 4 employees, 0 masks. This is not OK.

Very disappointing! Where do we start... All of the tables were gross sticky dirty. Lots,  I mean lots of Flys crawling over the dirty tables & dishes stacked in the bus trays. We asked if the hamburger patty could have some pink in it & the cashier said they have a little pink in them, what we received was very overcooked,  burnt & charred.  The buns were refrigerator cold. Asked for red fries & got russet fries. Needless to say, we will not be going back.

Let me start by saying I really really really wanted to love these donuts. Donuts are my vice but I am also a fitness enthusiasts and was drooling at the idea that somebody may have cracked the code on edible "healthy" donuts. It was way more than I could have hoped for. 

I also really really really wanted to be able to support a local great idea that encourages folks to eat healthy in balanced way.

But....it really was a dream that got lost in the donut hole.

I got the coconut cluster and banana bread donuts.

 The donut is a "cake" style donut, served fridge cold which it the first major draw back. When I think donut, I would ultimately like it as fresh as possible and at least room temp. The donut tasted like a week old stale fridge, and bitter cheap protein powder with a dash of chocolate or too much low grade imitation vanilla. You really can't put enough toppings on it to cover the flavor...but they try.

The frosting on both donuts have that incredibly strong bitter, lingers in the back or your throat, fake sweetener flavor. The vanilla frosting on the banana donut was especially gross loaded with way too much banana extract. 
I took two bites out of each donut and couldn't bring myself to finish them. 

I would easily $4-5 a donut for improved ingredients and flavor profile...just sayin'.

When I want a cheat day, I will just opt for a traditional high end donut, have just one, and savor every bite.

Hadn't been here in years,  only because we don't live closer,  but what I remember was much better.  Was in the area today and optimistically called in for a takeout salad.  Dressing was tasty, greens were good, but it wasn't a $17 salad after I added the grilled chicken, which was bland.  Supposed to have grilled tomatoes which did not look nor taste grilled and tasted like an average grocery store tomato.  Wasn't provided nor at least offered plastic utensils (which for the record I try to avoid but today I needed them), so I was in a bind to eat when I got to my destination.  Either way, food was average and overpriced.

I was extremely impressed with the quality of the Italian Grinder. This sandwich is huge, has an incredible variety of meat and vegetables, and the perfect sauce. Accompanied with a generous portion of French Fries (don't forget the Fry Sauce), it is the perfect greasy meal to satisfy. I got my meal to-go and it was ready within 10 minutes of calling and placing the order. Prices are extremely reasonable, the service is wonderful. Will be back!

Our rep struggled with basic math, wouldn't follow through on basic tasks, had to be continually convince to make a basic effort and when called on it his manager was condescending and insulting, mistakenly sending us an internal email insulting my wife.   No apology made...
