We were constantly finding errors in their work requiring corrections and when we called corporate to complain, their complaint mitigation officer flat out lied to us and outed himself on the call: he claimed he had no contact with the office processing our mortgage yet and asked our permission to contact them about our complaint...  after mentioning specifics we had never given him that he only could have obtained from those people directly.

I have never met a mortgage company this flatly
Incompetent:  They ordered the appraisal way too late, they forgot required fees and could not answer some rather basic questions "this is kind of a black box to us; we put in our numbers and thus comes out." They lied to us about being able to have partial payments applied; a fact we found out the actual signing of the loan.  

They forgot a key provision on signing day which left us in the car an hour from anywhere trying to negotiate to get the loan to record 30 minutes before the recording deadline because of their last-minute failure.  They even threatened to pull the loan after we asked them to corrects mistakes.  Even the escrow company said they have been a nightmare to deal with. 

But here's the topper: They violates Federal law and sent someone else's mortgage papers in with ours and told the escrow company to ignore the fact that they sent duplicate copies of a bunch of provisions and said "Make them sign all
Of them". Really?  You want to sign someone else's loan papers?  What absolute morons!  I don't know how they get a single good rating, but I do know the "mandatory customer survey was missing from our loan docs at signing, which is probably how I'm the only one outing their felonious behavior.   Fortunately all calls
With them were in our recorded line...  We'll see how this turns out, but stay away!  These guys have no clue and no desire to get one!
Over the top w the mask thing, dining still closed.   Same rush you through ordering and u take it home cold.  No thanks until they stop being afraid and seat a few people again.

Background: 3-4 prior deliveries of mediocre sushi.  Delivery is so convenient though.  I only wish tonight's dinner was mediocre.

Tonight's nigiri and rolls were the WORST quality and preparation I have ever encountered.  Support voided the ticket, offered a $50 credit for the next visit, and offered to send more.  My private feedback was meant to ensure they stop serving that salmon immediately, certainly not that they resend the order.  The two possibilities for the texture was that the salmon being previously frozen, or a parasite.  Any chef or experienced cook would have identified a parasite when fileting the fish asked, so I hope that (instead) it's previously frozen.  

Oh, there was also plastic wrap still on the piece that I tried to eat.  Amateur mistake.  The yellow tail nigiri was poorly cut and sloppy.  Definitely not freshly cut because the corner was dried out.  

Epic failure.  Beware.
They have the best staff. That Maxwell made my burrito like a champ and it was delicious. No cap.

Only eat here if you are not on a time crunch. I ordered online so that it would be ready when we got there. My order said it would only take 16-21min. I am still waiting and it's been 30min. The customers in front of us even asked for a refund because they were taking so long. We should've followed them instead of thinking our order was almost done. Wrong decision on our part.

I have been a faithful customer of VS, but I r ed recently bought two demi t-shirt bras and cut off the tag to wash them and wear them, since I have never had a problem with their bras before. Well, in the washer the wires that fasten the bra together totally got messed up after one wash. I came back to request an exchange and they said since I cut off the tag they couldn't help me. They also said they couldn't look up my transaction in the system, even though I have worked in retail for 6 years and I know you can always look up a transaction. Its Christmas time, and I thought asking kindly for an exchange since I am a loyal shopper and I simply cant use these bras would maybe cause some sympathy and kindness from the store. Wrong. I am not shopping with VS again.

I am not coming back. I spent $30 on yogurt, and when I asked for a cup of water they insisted on charging $0.50 for a cup of tap water. They can go jump in a lake, I'm not paying $0.50 for tap water, and I'm not coming back. Everything here is overpriced, not just the tap water.

We've been here twice now.  Last time, the bartender (can't remember his name) was great, very helpful- and a nice guy.

He's the reason we returned yesterday.  Spoke with Kristen (bartender/owner).  Just a great person- very nice and helpful also.

I used to play pool (meridian pool league) in this bar in the olden days.  It was a good bar back then--- Great bar now.  Kristen has done a LOT of work to clean the place up and it shows.  Great atmosphere, almost "cheery" from the moment we walked in. 

We'll definitely be back.
Tha cakes themselves are soooo tasty. The staff is horrendous. I felt like I was being judged by the mean girls in high school when I walked in.

Covid my ass!! Covid has nothing to do with customer service. The kid behind the counter answered the phone 3 times while I was standing there waiting to order. After 15 minutes he tells me that what ever I choose to order the wait, will be 20 to 30 min for 6 wings. No thanks!

This is a cute little drive-thru with some indoor/outdoor seating. The woman at the window was very friendly. They have basic to-go options, including some homemade breakfast burritos, which I NEED to try. I got an ice almond milk latte and was satisfied with it. I can't wait to go back and try more food and more drinks.

This is my go-to coffee spot for dates with the Mrs. or to relax. The coffee house is small, but cozy with really comfortable seating. The coffee is excellent (highly recommend the Mocha with Oat Milk) and the selection of pastries is good. The customer service is always friendly and quick. Highly recommend checking this coffee house out if you're driving through for a cup on the go or walking in to relax.

I have been to gramercy several times. I used to love it. But the last 3 times were not good at all. I ordered a side salad instead of fries my salad was wilted and slimy had to pay extra for salad. Told the waitress she just apologized and didn't come back to our table until she brought the check. I went another time ordered a new pizza with balsamic reduction that was to be drizzled it was doused. Couldn't even eat it. Plus sat in front of kitchen and watched as one of the chefs sat and ate the whole time he was cooking. You kidding me!!! Never going back!

Solid 4! Definitely one of the better places I've eaten since moving here. Their poke bows are yummy as well as their Salmon teriyaki bowls. I'd definitely come back to try some of their other dishes.

Just stopped in to nothing Bundt cakes to buy a one serving Bundt cake which is one of my favorites it's always moist and Great asked for a plastic fork because I was going to eat it in my car they no longer give you a fork you have to buy four plastic forks now I will not be shopping there any longer that is ridiculous
Will never buy from anyone else.  Have meet owner, believe in him and his caracter. Good example of a man and an American. Save yourself a lot of trouble ,drive from any state, buy here.

I have been waiting for this place to open! It finally opened and it did not disappoint! The food was so good and boy was there lots of it! The servers were super awkward, but the food made up for it! We watched them make their mimosas and they filled it up with champagne with a splash of juice. Extra brownie points there! The only downside was the fact that they didn't get their liquor in yet, so we couldn't try their Bloody Mary flight. Be sure to call ahead for seating as they were crazy busy. We waited about an hour for a table. This place is worth the wait!

I gotta say, I was pretty skeptical expecting decent food at a coffee shop. I think of the poor items Starbucks pawns off on people. This place, Antigua Coffee Co., advertised a "delicious Cuban sandwich" and "because you love them" pupusas. 

There were only seven Yelp reviews, but they gave Antigua Coffee high marks.

I ordered a Cuban sandwich, a pork and cheese pupusa and a chile relleno to bring home for Kristy and me. And a mocha on the side.

I was pleasantly surprised. I've had a number of Cuban sandwiches over the years. The best was at Sol Food in San Rafael, California. The Antigua one rates as one of the best I've had, better than what they serve at Casa Blanca Cuban Grill in Boise.

The pupusa ranked with the ones at Pupusas A&J's in Caldwell. It was very good. It came with a curtido that had a bit of a bite. Wonderful!

The relleno was also very good. It was served with rice and black beans. 

i enjoyed the mocha, made with Dawson Taylor coffee, was very good.

I took off a star for inconsistent mask wearing by the counter employee. She had it on when I first came in but later took it off and had it off when she brought the bags from my order.

I was surprised to call up Antigua's Yelp page before I started this review to find that Carl Y. filed a review today, too. He and his wife must have been there the same time I was, but not having met him in person, i didn't realize it was him. I'm glad they liked it, too. He has good judgment.
The biggest fucking bikes parts/gear distributor in the country doesn't balance and mount gently used tires?? What the fuck??? Where else am I suposed to get them re mounted then???

My husband and I were looking for dinner on our date night. With COVID being around our options are limited. We decided to stop by this 5 Guys and we were pleasantly impressed. 

All the employees were wearing their masks and wearing them correctly. It was clear that they did everything they could to keep employees and customers safe. Our order was up quickly and we sat at a table outside to eat it. Everything was really clean and the food was tasty. We will definitely be back.

Keep up the great work!

I love love going to Revitalize. I love their toast, bowls, atmosphere and my kids love their smoothies. I loving taking my laptop and working during the day because it has such great energy. I want to try the cleanse in the next couple of weeks but have only heard great things. I just took my be nieces who are from New York and are always eating açaí bowls. They said Revitalize was way better then anything they have had.

Hidden Gem in the Valley! Fantastic menu selection, LARGE PORTIONS, great value! Mi Casa Mexican restaurant that makes my whole family happy and I love taking my friends and family who visit me in Idaho here! Gooooooo! You won't be disappointed!
Bleu delicious!  Fish and Chips!  Highly recommend.  Pepperoni Pizza!  Pork Belly Sliders!

We visited this place and i really enjoyed our drinks. 
They tasted good you can taste the coffee in the drink. Its a small location with a lot of traffic there. Very satisfied with our drinks.

Honestly I love cake donuts so these were easy to love. They have may different toppings and came out warm. Staff was super friendly. They really made us want to come back. We will definitely be back.

The employees were polite, most were around high school age and were probably pretty new, seeing as she took a little while to put my order in the computer. I always get the same thing, a regular half and half brownie sundae add hot caramel. Just like that. After getting my order wrong twice, I gave up trying to fix it. Neither employee helping me ever got the manager to help them understand what I was getting. I've gotten this at Freddy's numerous times. I was serious disappointed.
Buffalo wings extra wet, yum yum my favorite, this location is awesome! The staff is always welcoming when I visit!

Save your time and money. Skip the Kanack locations at the Boise plaza building. I've taken back three meals in less than a year because they were inedible, including breakfast today from the new kiosk. Not worth the trouble.

I can't believe that McDonalds service is better, cheaper n faster then The Curb in Meridian 
Oh and friendly staff!!!

This studio is yoga done right. Joining this community of loving, strong people that will hold you accountable and push you to be your best self... while somehow loving you just the way you are? One of the best choices I have ever made.
The classes are wonderful. The teachers are impeccable. Try Baptiste or Yin, those are my absolute favorites.

Weekends are busy as expected but great find during the week as well.   Suprisingly efficient with all the covid precautions in place. The food is fresh and unique.  The sope Benedict is out of this world.  Hash browns are crispy and well seasoned.   Our server Lisa is knowledgeable and fun and remembers us each time we're here.  Never disappointed with our experience.
Laura is the best!!! She just moved to the Meridian location... much further from my home, but I'm willing to make the trip for her! She's the best. Truly transformed my eyebrows. :)

I am so glad we have a place like Tate's Rents.  We have always had good luck renting equipment that we need on a short term basis and their costs are very reasonable.  Their service is great and they are our local go to place.

We arrived just after 10 on before New Years. The kitchen was closed and that was disappointing. However, the server made us feel welcome, offering chips and salsa to us as a courtesy. We enjoyed a couple of drinks and learned a little about the town. Our server was a local, and like us genuinely enjoyed the conversation. We left a generous tip to reward the effort (the chips were no charge). We'll definitely return.

Tried this place for the first time today. Although they were busy, we got right in. The interior is large and open which makes for a very noisy atmosphere. The service was fine, but the food is expensive and mediocre. Two people in the party ordered omelets. The omelets are sizable, but the cheese wasn't melted in either one and the eggs were rubbery. Their "homestyle" potatoes are thinly sliced, undercooked, and oily with little seasoning. I had traditional Eggs Benedict with hashbrowns. The hashbrowns were crispy, but bland. My "poached" eggs were just shy of hard boiled and when I asked about it, I was told that is how they are normally cooked. Our server did offer to bring me a side of eggs which I declined. The ham is very sweet and when topped with an overly lemony hollandaise, the dish was unpleasant. 

All in all, not worth the money.

Broken Yolk is so awesome! Speedy, efficient service while always busy! Never had to adjust any orders and everything always tastes amazing. I've brought quite a few people here and always heard good things! The tiki toast, açaí bowl, ALL of the Benedict's- everything incredible! I recommend the mimosa sampler too- yum  Today at our visit my sister ordered the avocado toast and asked if BYC had any red pepper flakes- they didn't, but our waitress ran over to Sweeto Burrito and got some for her! Above and beyond and the staff is so attentive and awesome. Thanks for being here BYC!

Neat Little corner Coffey shop. Very nice and clean inside. Large verity of Coffey choices. They also provide food which is surprising for a Coffey shop. They have a drive through window makes it nice for fast service. Food was presented very nice. And even one of the cooks came out and served the food. The food was phenomenal. Do recommend this cute place.

TIMBERRRRRR


Generic latte. Drive-thru is slow, but staff was nice. Inside is cute.

This cafe is fantastic! Our group of four showed up around 10am on the Saturday after Christmas so we expected to wait a minimum of 30-60 minutes to be seated. 

Wrong! 

We were seated immediately and got our drinks less than 3 minutes later! *mind-blown*

Our waitress was friendly and attentive and the food was outstanding. The menu was so enticing that we ordered a little bit of everything. (We ordered so much we could barely fit all of it on the table.) 

Everyone in our group loved the food and raved about the service. We took our leftovers to-go and polished them off a few hours later. YUM! 

We will most definitely be back!

Amazing customer service . I was helped w so much care and offered options . I love the ambience of this store . Everyone is helpful  and eager to answer your question . The sales staff , wrapped my husband fathers gift so perfect . Ready for gifting !!!!
Meredith gets all of the stars! She is the most compassionate NP I have ever encountered! Highly recommend!

Bought a used Harley here in November, had 11k miles on it, I asked if it had been through the inspection and if it had any issues and if it was ready to ride, I was told it checked out great, oil was clean, brakes were good, safe to ride. I rode it around my neighborhood a few times on warmer days to keep the oil circulating and noticed it seemed off, I trailered it to my fathers house 200 miles away to have it checked out and custom painted as hes been a Harley mechanic for going on 50 years, come to find out the oil in all 3 holes is filthy, the front wheel is bent, the brakes are shot, handle bars and controls are all bent, and I'm pretty sure the bike has been wrecked, possibly more than once, I bought this after hours in a hurry taking their word for everything, and I know I bought it "as is" so basically I got screwed hard, but in going to a lot of the harley shops to buy all the items that need fixed and replaced to make this thing even rideable, I have definitely gotten to voice my opinion, show pictures, and hear others stories about the things that have been pulled by this dealer, at this point I'm debating whether to even continue trying to fix this bike as it is going to cost thousands more to fix the bent wheel, and tweaked handlebars, bent controls,  that I didnt even notice were damaged until I got to ride it for a few miles once the weather warmed up enough to do so. BUYER BE VERY AWARE of buying used here!

Not sure what the previous reviewer was ranting about.  We have been there several times and it is not trashy, not racist, and it DOES provide a good cut for an excellent price.  

Jessica, Bella, and the others have been polite and professional.  It is hard to find a good barber\stylist that you are happy with, when you move into a new area.  We think Cut Loose has proved to be our place.

The instructor talked too fast, I felt like I couldn't get into my pose quickly enough, before she hurried through to the next pose. I didn't feel like I got a thorough workout. The room could've been hotter. 

Pros: super friendly staff! :) like the atmosphere, lovely music throughout.

Getting ready to go on vacation and made an appointment for a manicure and pedicure.  I don't treat myself very often, and am always have a hard time communicating what I want.  I Really wanted something special as this is the first vacation in many years.  They got us in quickly, we got amazing and relaxing treatment, and my nails have never been so beautiful.  I had short ugly fingernails going in and left with Hawaii ready nails....flowers on each finger that were not all tacky, simply beautiful. ( I will try to post picture later) Along with the quality of the service we were made comfortable and the technicians ( artists) were very friendly.  I am certainly glad that I learned long ago that any business, no matter how good they are, can receive a "bad" review.
Close to home, great nails, pleasant atmosphere....I am now a regular   THANK YOU ANDY

NEW OWNER! I had heard this location was run down in the past- today I came to see for myself and could not have been more surprised with how amazing my experience was. My husband ordered the chicken wings and I had some chicken tenders tossed in hot sauce. The French fries with our orders rivaled the ones I get at the BFC near me, which really shocked me! I am usually super picky about my fries. After meeting the new owner and experiencing his enthusiasm and passion for the restaurant industry I expect this location is about to get busy. we will absolutely be back! I also learned they cook everything to order which is AWESOME. Always hot and crispy, well worth the wait. That being said I likely will order online next time since I'm usually in a hurry. They have a drive through which I've never seen for a wing place so I'm excited to try it out.

This juice bar has a wide selection of juices and smoothies. The only thing I've tried is the kombucha smoothie which was to die for. There wasn't a wait when I got there and it only took them a few minutes to make my drink. The staff was kind as well which is a plus.

I'm a big fan of wingstop so I tend to grab some no matter what state I'm in when traveling. This wingstop serves the best wings out of all the other wing stops I've ever tried across different states. Dem boyz know what they doing in there!

Not overly impressed. Chicken Caesar salad had no dressing on it and the chicken was overcooked and cold. Beef fajitas were tasty but expensive at $16. They kindly replaced the rice, beans, and tortillas for a salad that also had no dressing.

Wow... hidden gems. 

Choice of getting sashimi on top of salad, love it. Tasty and made with your specifics choice of ingredients and sauces. I take large size with spicy sauce and my wife take medium size, they're good size.

My son loved the unagi don. Need to wait extra but it's good.

Unsure why you need to pay extra for octopus, so minus 1 star. Without it, solid 5 stars.
Friendly staff, terrible product. I always see plenty of cars here, I guess those people are ordering something that I'm not. Their drinks are all way too sweet and all taste like chocolate?!! Wtf
Sosa & Chris were the freaking best! These guys helped me dispute charges and helped take me from a level 10 frustrating to a zero. Go here for the best service ever.

I live in Denver co and drove to high desert Harley to pick up a new Road Glide. Everyone to a man or woman I interacted with treated me like I was their number one concern, beginning with Mark Dukes the owner, to the front receptionist.  I was their main focus. Buy your next motorcycle from these guys you won't have any regrets!

This place is bomb! So many choices, such good food! They cook their tortillas from scratch. Fun to watch. I see a lot of reviews commenting on cold food, but I don't think they dined in.  Food like this easily goes cold if you get it to go.  We've eaten inside every time and food is warm. My carnitas street taco has always been warm and juicy with just the right amount of onion/cilantro. Hubby has been trying different tacos and has loved them all. Cool ambiance inside, but I don't think they have bathrooms. Can't wait to experience after Covid!

This is long overdue as I have been seeing Dr. Howard for the last 4 years and I am extremely impressed. If you are looking for somebody who does top quality work, cares about details, and easy to work with, look no further than Meridian Smiles. I have had many complicated services provided by Dr. Howard and his team and all have exceeded my expectations. He uses all the latest technology and up to date equipment. He runs a very clean and organized business. His dental hygienist staff have provided the best teeth cleaning my family has ever had. He not only cares about your oral health, but your overall health as well. He is very patience and comfortable to work with. He has has always provided me options and given me all the detailed information needed so I am able to make the choice that is best for me.. He finds out what your big picture goal is and helps lay out the steps to help you achieve it. His dental work is very precise and detailed.

This is our new FAVORITE Mexican food in Treasure Valley. Since moving here in the last couple years, we have tried to find a fantastic restaurant to be our go-to Mexican place. We had a lot of mediocre experiences UNTIL MI CASA! *swoon* We love this place!

This place is hopping at lunch time - mostly because they are fantastic and maybe a little because they are right in the middle of a ton of large businesses. Dinner has been relaxed atmosphere, but I'm sure that will only last until the word gets out on this gem.

Service: OUTSTANDING. Friendly, helpful, speedy. We've been in several times and each time they take fantastic care of us.

Food: SO DELICIOUS. Everything is fresh, high quality. They chop their own veggie mix in kitchen FRESH for Pete's sake! (I don't appreciate when restaurants drop quality for the convenience of junky frozen chopped veggies). Try the Mexican Potato Soup. Love their mole sauce. And the chips & salsa at the table? YUM! I love their fresh salsa (usually a medium spicy). Veggie & whole bean chimichanga is my one of my favs (chimichangas are on the combo part of the menu). The menu is huge.

Check: our bill is always less than we were expecting - dinner out with a table of six usually adds up pretty quickly. Even if we all order extravagantly, out ticket is still less than if we went out to a big chain restaurant. This makes me happy :)

Wish I could give Mi Casa seven stars!

Christian knows his stuff.....PERIOD.  It's pretty sad how far competitors will go to write false reviews to discredit a reputable company.  I still call Christian for advice and I live on the East Coast.

This is by far the worst stay in a Motel 6 I have ever had. I only give it 2 stars since the shower was really amazing after a long drive on a road trip to Meridian ID to see family.

The showers in my room were the most powerful, steadily warm shower I have ever had in my 40+ years staying in motels/hotels. Even better than a 5 star hotel in Manhattan.

That being said, the enjoyment stopped there.

As a loyal Motel 6 customer for over 35 years, I wanted my stay at this one to be the best.

1) Mystery $150 fee charged to my card.

Upon checkin, I was charged a $150 fee in addition to the room for 4 nights in advance.

I asked the front desk clerk on the phone about the charge, she explained it was a security deposit for incidentals.

I have NEVER been charged this kind of fee from any Motel 6 ever in my life. Incidentals like pay per view or other were charged "AFTER" you checked out. The clerk apologized and said they would waiver the fee. It never was waived.

2) Dirty sheets on one of the 2 beds in the room

I asked the same clerk if they cleaned rooms between guests because one of the two beds had dirt/debris that looked like burnt toast scraps on the sheet. The clerk immediately became angry at me, mistaking me for someone else, and chastized me about how rooms are not cleaned on "stay overs", and "You noticed just now that your bed was dirty!?" in an impatient/condescending voice.

After I corrected her about checking in just 2 hours before, I told her that I just pulled back the covers for the first night in preparation for bed.

She immediately apologized and offered to move me to a new room or remake the bed. I opted to remake the bed. This was done quickly and with a fountain of apologies for the misunderstanding.

3) Missing Manager.

I asked the original clerk to have the manager call me the next morning and she said she would. (Just after remaking my bed that had the dirty sheets). That never happened.

The next morning I asked for the manager. The new clerk said the manager had left for the day. I asked how come the manager did not call me as requested? She did not know, but put a request for the manager to call me Monday.

I never received a call or voicemail or a note on my pillow, semaphores, skywriting, or other communications from the missing manager.

We checked out Tuesday morning, at the desk.

As of today, 4 days later, the $150 deposit has not been refunded.

The missing manager has no name, no number or email, and apparently either ignores messages, or the employees prevent him/her from getting guest complaints.

Motel 6 in Meridian Idaho is not a good one to stay at unless you want to be misidentified by a rude clerk, charged mysterious fees ninjalike (the checkin clerk said nothing about these fees, and since I used the mobile app to reserve and pay, did not take a credit card from me. Just 2 signatures for the pool and the room.

To her credit, the evening clerk that made a mistake apologized profusely, but failed to waiver the $150 fee and failed to have the manager contact me about my concerns.

I don't use a bike shop often (about once a year). I recently needed a repair done on my bike. When I went into the shop, the employee who came to help me was not wearing a mask. It made me so sad to see such poor customer service.  I will be choosing a different shop from now on.

The best place for pre-made juices but dont stop in for a coffee unless you have 20 minutes to wait for it.  Four people working on, what appears to be a to go order.....since I was the only person there when I came in and I still waited and waited.  I would think that if someone comes in....in person... and orders a coffee that would go ahead of the 12 bowls being prepped?  Or at least they tell you you'll be waiting awhile?? Ultimately the big disappointment was getting to my office and realizing it wasn't what I ordered.  What I ended up with tasted like simple syrup and dirt had a lukewarm baby.  Disappointed
I love Fred Meyer! I always find everything I need from housewares, school supplies, toiletries and food.  The best produce and sushi in the deli.  Starbucks too.  And the cheapest gas in town.

I used to eat at KB's when I lived in Bellevue, so we were excited to try the Boise location.

We walked in at 8pm and the two employees were sitting at a table eating and seemed annoyed that customers were coming in. First we ordered 2 bean and cheese burritos for the kids and were told that they were out of refried beans. A burrito joint being out of beans is like McDonalds being out of french fries. Translation: It's 1 hour until we close and we don't want to make more or dirty any dishes.

We decided to take our business down the street. We were barely out the door before they were clearing the tables off for closing...an hour before they were supposed to.

AMAZING customer service! I walked in not knowing what to expect, but I needed to repair my 3yo daughter's bike. I walked in with two toddlers and the employees were so welcoming and accommodating... especially to my special needs 2yo. Gave them fruit snacks and allowed them to see the repair process. So thankful for this local establishment that fixed my daughter's bike accurately and quickly and helped my rambunctious kiddos. Lifetime customer earned!!
The flys were landing all over their custard as it was open and uncovered, very unprofessional and gross

The poke bowls are amazing here! However the chicken teriyaki bowls are very bland. The chicken tastes & looks fake and rubbery. Kind of of disappointed since I paid $30 for it. Oh well, now I know not to order that again.
I would sell my soul for the eggs Benedict options they have. Delish food and always great service. Love watching the manager actually jump in and help everyone. Will def be going back.
The food is amazing!! The staff are friendly and courteous.  The portions are huge!! Ask for the sweeto burrito sauce!!! Loved it!!

If you think the pizza here is good you are missing out on what good pizza is because this pizza is literally the worst pizza I have ever had. Bland sauce and way too much cheese the crust is awful not enough toppings they barely put any pepperoni. I don't think it's too hard to make a pizza but apparently it is at this place. I wanted to like it but after coming here twice and having the same experience I just can't give this place another shot. Call me a Pizza snob but I have had great pizza and this place does not have it.

I have had the great pleasure of working with Boris on a few pieces of custom jewelry for myself, and I have never met a more talented designer and artist! I would highly recommend Boris to anyone looking to get any type of jewelry whatsoever, as his skill level is unmatched. I will be going here to ultimately get my engagement ring as well when I am ready. Thanks so much!!!!

What a gem! Sweet family coffee shop and light lunch spot with a South American flair.  Great service and chill ambience. Super authentic food, with abuela in the back making the pupusas! Delicious coffee drinks. Worth a try if you're in the area for a beverage or lunch.

This review is based solely on the food.

I called and asked if they were open for dine in! Was told they were. Arranged to meet friends for dinner! And was shocked to see carry out only! Dont know who to be mad at really covid, or the dumbass answering the phone.

The desk clerk wise uninformed as to how this motel works. He gave us all the keys that would not unlock our door. I have never experienced such awful customer service in my life. He has no personality whatsoever and was notfriendly

Let me start by saying if you're looking for non healthy, Krispy Kreme like donuts. Probably stay away. 
But for the people who eat Uber healthy and are looking for a treat that is still much better for you in terms of ingredients. Come here!!! 
I love that they make any donut gluten free. Cause I am celiac! 
They are delicious! My Husband and I loved them. My favorite was the lemon!

We rented from Home River group for a year. We left that place extremely clean and did our best to leave it better than when we got it when we moved in. When we got our security deposit back, they listed that we left everything dusty and said that they had to scrub the floors and baseboards due it being "still pretty dirty" with a variety other comments that didn't match how  we left it and the photos taken to prove otherwise. We left that place near spotless and CLEAN. It said that the fridge wasn't clean and needed to be wiped down. See photos... I bleached it twice  and took out all drawers and scrubbed them in the sink.  have rented from many places over the years and every single time get my full security deposit back. Apparently being a decent tenant and spending days cleaning everything  doesn't matter since you won't get much of your deposit back. 

Do not rent from this company's  as they will screw you over on your security deposit and not do a damn thing when your neighbors are partying it up until 4 a.m.  Nor will anyone get back to you about maintenance concerns or other issues if any arise.   Don't expect them to have the common decency to tell you rent will be increasing... as they will just  increase your rent $200 plus with when they issue you a new lease.

Bite Me is one of the trendiest dessert spots in the Treasure Valley right now serving a unique dessert experience! 
This spot is located in The Village at Meridian and I treated one of my friends to an ice cream here for her birthday after doing some shopping! Bite Me is a great way to make a day at The Village extra special- Great for friend dates, romantic dates, and little family outings! 
It's open a lot later than most of the stores here, so make sure to stop by before you head home. 
Bite Me also offers Takeout and delivery! This was my first time here so I definitely appreciated the knowledge and help from the staff when ordering my ice cream. 
I ordered the vanilla ice cream with a chocolate shell, peanut butter drizzle and topped with "Afterparty"- which is peanut m&ms and potato chips (I love a salty-sweet moment!!). 
My friend ordered the "Yaba daba do" of fruity pebbles and marshmallow drizzle but with the chocolate shell and mango ice cream! I was a little skeptical of how that flavor combo was going to be but it actually tasted really fricking good!! I guess you can't really go wrong here. 

I will definitely be back to try their bubble waffle and frozen banana. I will probably stick to the Afterparty topping because I loved it so much but once again I don't think you could go wrong with any of the sweet treats they offer.

Met some friends here last night.  Must say that I was not too impressed, the service was rather blah, the waiter didn't smile and basically didn't act like he wanted to be there.  I know I would have been better off had he not been.  The owner would stop by our table and check on us on a regular basis for some reason, I believe he should probably spend more time shadowing his employees and raising the customer service level a notch.

I only ate appetizers (boneless chicken bits, finger steaks, mozzarella sticks and jalapeno poppers) and would not recommend this to anyone. Any bowling alley serves up better apps than this place.

100 oz. beer towers are interesting and maybe this places niche.  With all the competition on Eagle Rd, I don't know why anyone would stop here.

I walked in with a smile and out with a frown. I had a scheduled new patient exam, cleaning, and X-rays.  I should have known it was too good to be true, especially when I was asked for payment up front.  The hygeniest checked me out, sent the dentist in, who elaborated on my condition.  I must say that the staff treated me with courtesy and respect, and I thought they were very knowledgeable.  However, their operation is a little sketchy.  I paid for the exam, CLEANING, and X-rays, but they refused to do the cleaning.  First they said the hygienist was busy and could not do the cleaning unless I came back later.  And if I came back I would need a periodontal cleaning which would cost about $235 more.  Then they offered a discount if I paid a fee of $111, which would bring the cost down to $60.  Just the old shell game.  And the discounts only brought the cost down from inflated prices to ballpark going rates for the procedures.  Needless to say I won't be returning.
To give them credit I was refunded my payment, and received an explanation that the new patient special was only for those without any periodontal problems, and that it says that on their website.  Of course I made the appointment over the phone and was not informed of this.

I understand there is a new manager in town and you sure can tell. Silk is a very beautiful soul and her integrity shows. I love the way everyone is so  kind and friendly and well groomed. The breakfast lady took care of us as if we were at a restaurant. They ran out of hot chocolate and she filled it, poured it and brought it to the table. wow love that service. Israel is a fun guy and his laugh is addictive. His smile makes you want to smile right back at him. The rooms are so clean and well cared for. These people seem to love where they work and it shows. We will be staying here as often as we can. Summer break is right around the corner. We will be coming back with friends and more family. Cant beat the price or the family atmosphere. Feels like home.

Wasn't impressed with what I received when we stopped in for lunch.

First off it's nearly impossible to read the black on teal menu screen unless you're standing on top of it, who picked those colors?

I started with the guac and chips which was a measly 4oz serving and not nearly enough for the bag of chips they give you, I should have passed.

The tacos were ok-ish but I found them to be all light on flavor, the pastor was too close in taste to the carnitas and those two should be noticeably different. I expected more based on the reviews.

A huge fan of blizzards, my husband and I consider DQ one of our go-to treat spots. I wish I could say a little more about this location, other than its convenience, but I don't have a stellar review to give as the service is always give-and-take. However, with a suspected high turn-over rate, I don't expect that we could ask for TOO much more. We still go often, despite the service, because we love the treats!

Food: I don't order the food much, but the new snack melts are really good. Pass on the chicken mozzarella sandwich... the bread is rubbery. Blizzards are our favorites. The turtle, salted caramel, strawberry cheesequake, and Reese's are all winners. Try the monthly special, it's usually really good!

Drinks: n/a

Atmosphere: We use the drive-thru!

Service: This is where this location struggles. Sometimes they honor a 10% military discount for us and sometimes they do not. It depends on the day. Once, my husband left his debit card with the cashier. After several phone calls in which we were told they did not have the card, on our third time back and just checking on a whim, they somehow managed to find it. Very odd! We were grateful to have it returned but they should have process for instances like that.

Happy Hour Offerings: n/a

Healthy Hack: n/a

Tips: Show your military ID for 10% discount!
Best restaurant in Idaho hands down. Try the antigua breakfast for an empty stomach. Guava pastries are to die for.

Their website is nice and easy to use, but no one ever answers the phone when you call. I've called countless times over the past few months to ask about properties and I leave messages, but no one ever gets back to you. I had to get a person's email from a friend who filled out an application to finally be able to talk to someone about the townhome I was interested in. Just go to their office if you ever have questions because I've had no luck with calling or emailing what they have on their website. I'm giving four stars because they have a very reliable website with easy to set up self guided tours. Everything is always up to date and they provide a lot of pictures.

Ashley Garner was so great to work with. From giving me and my girlfriend multiple options that fit our budget, and size, she new it all! If you want a pleasant experience looking for a place to live, I HIGHLY recommend her!

Very expensive for lunch.  It was about $16 for a bowl and a soda, much higher than next door, Togos Sandwiches.  It was okay and the variety of sauces you could choose were good but just not good enough to spend that kind of money on.  For $6 I could get a huge sandwich and a drink at Togos.
Great healthy low carb and gluten free options. All of the donuts can be made gluten free. I highly recommend this spot

We used to love Gramercy Park, but tonight will be our final visit. 

I was disheartened to learn that they no longer serve pizza and that my favorite dish is no longer on the menu. I absolutely loved the Mac and Cheese Sammich. It was so unique and yummy! It really was the reason I would come eat at Gramercy. My family loved their pizza and that's gone too. Not sure why they still have pizza in their name....???

Our server was very friendly and super apologetic about the items being removed. He was very personable, but as time went on, his service  faded. I waited 10 minutes for a straw, he never checked back after our food was delivered, and we had to wait for 20 minutes for our check.

The Gramercy Bites were just okay this time. Pricey at $9 and a  much smaller serving than in the past. 

The French fries were not even browned up. They were seriously mushy and undercooked. I was going to see if I could get a new order, but unfortunately, our waiter never returned until well after we were done. 

We also ordered the Veggie Wings, which again, are normally delicious. Not this time. A good sized portion, but the cauliflower was almost raw--barely cooked. 

My son had the Western Burger and thought it was mediocre. He ate half and was done after that. 

All of the prices have gone up significantly. I'm sure increasing food prices and wages have warranted that, but I'd rather spend my money at restaurant where we can enjoy the food and get good service. 

I'm wondering if there's a new owner or management because our last couple of visits were nothing like it is usually. 

It makes me sad to leave such a low review, but hopefully Gramercy Park will improve with real feedback. If they don't, I'm worried they may not make it.

Used to be my favorite place to eat. This past weekend we ordered our usual meal. As soon as my husband had his first bite, he gagged and spit out the RAW BONELESS CHICKEN WING. Wish I could post pictures if not just one piece but ALL our boneless wings were RAW. 
I tried calling to complain but no one answered. Since my husband is a previous employee he knows the manager MARK.  We call his store in Nampa and let's us know he will meet us at the Eagle store. We get there to ask for a refund and we get denied because "it's against store policy".  Mark's excuse for the raw chicken was " it was a mistake ". SERIOUSLY ?! A mistake would be forgetting what sauce went on our order or not enough sauce on wings something small but how the heck do you mistakenly forget to leave the wings in the fryer till it beeps?! While my husband keeps asking for a refund the very unprofessional manager decided to say " I'm going to leave now ". C'mon now... don't run away from an issue like that. We could have gotten food poisoning from eating the RAW CHICKEN. Mark if you read this... I'd be so embarrassed to have been the one to hire the employees at your Eagle store. None have any idea of what great customer service is or what a clean table should feel/look like. They all seem so unhappy to be there. You as a manager definetly NEEDS to go over the 10 commandments of customer service ! After that you'll realize You have horrible employees at the Eagle store representing wingstop.

I love Fred Meyer and I think their prices are great as well as their overall cleanliness and selection! My only complaint about them is how slowly they check you out (at most of the locations, although Target is twice as slow). I understand the small town neighborly atmosphere, but you can carry on a conversation and still continue checking someondout. 

Update: Still love Fred Meyer, but the vibe at this location is slowly starting to become different. The cashiers/stockers/cart peeps are always very friendly. The self checkout people, however, typically seem annoyed to be there and never say "hello" or "thank you" or seem to acknowledge you. Not a huge deal, but it's frequent enough it's worth mentioning. Also, a few of my key items (which I have bought weekly for years) are suddenly out of stock, no longer being stocked, or have increased in price by .50-1.00 each. I know price increases happen, but usually it's a bit more gradual. Either way, still love my store and appreciate the cleanliness, friendliness, and selection, as well as the gas discounts and rebates! Self checkout people, smile!

I thought they did a fantastic job.  Our specific needs (no mayo, plain burger for the kid) were met--food came out perfectly.  Service time was great, staff was polite.  Not sure why they have such terrible reviews--our experience was great.

I've been really torn about whether or not to write this review.  The carrot cake I got was amazing, but the customer service was terrible.  I've been really excited to try this place and my sister-in-law has one where she lives and loves it.  My husband and I went in and were greeted by a pretty little display case filled with bundt cakes.  My husband asked the lady there if any of them were all natural.  First of all the lady didn't really seem like she knew what that meant and said, "Oh yes.  Like for example the carrot cake has carrots and pineapple." There was another lady in there, who was identified to us proudly by the first lady as the owner of the shop.  The owner asked what we meant by all natural.  She was really defensive almost from the beginning, even though we had asked the question nicely.  As consumers we have the right to know what we are eating.  So I said, "No artifical colors or flavors."  She told us the red velvet had food coloring in it (duh!), but none of the others did.  Then she asked what were artificial flavors.  I said I didn't know, because the labels always say "artificial flavor" with no details of what that actually is.  She looked really confused.  So my husband said, "You know, like if you buy a cake at the grocery store and look at the label it often will say 'artificial flavor.' She got huffier and snootier and with her nose in the air said , "Oh, I would never buy a cake like that." Then when I looked closer at the mini bundt cakes I saw every single one of them, except the carrot cake, said "Natural and artificial flavors." !!! I said this out loud, with the owner standing right there, and when I looked up she had conveniently disappeared into the back! Vanished! A couple minutes later she sent someone else out to help us and we never saw her again!  Now, I know many foods have artifical flavors.  But I choose not to consume them so I have a right to know.  I thought it so strange that the OWNER of the place didn't know what was in her own product, even though she proudly told us the cakes are made on site.  Also, why was she so rude and defensive?  It's not like we were accusing her of something.  We were just asking a simple question.  Also, the other lady didn't know what was in the cakes either.  Very strange.  I KNOW we are not the only people in Boise who care about this sort of thing, and we won't be the last customers to ask that question.   All the people at the shop should be more educated about their own product. The only reason I'm even giving 2 stars is because the carrot cake was pretty amazing.  I don't know if I'll go back though because the owner is beyond rude.

The food is pretty good. Like a C+/B-. Not amazing but average. 

I am writing this 2 star reveiw mainly to talk about the menu that was uploaded by the business on to yelp, and even the menu on their own website, as they all have INCORRECT PRICES. The prices have been raised and do not reflect the current prices, which is false advertising. 

I ordered take out yesterday and was a bit annoyed that it was listed on yelp BY THE BUSINESS- Patron Special as $16.95, but when I went to pick up my food I was charged 19.99!! That's about $3 more! Uhhh..what the?!?

I then checked their own website and the price was still wrong- Patron Special listed as $18.95. This is terrible and needs to be fixed. Just check out the pictures. 

 Also I wanted to upload a picture of my receipt, but the guy doing take out gave me the wrong one. But as you can see 19.99 + tax was $21.19...and no, I did not order a margarita to go!

Best Mexican food in Idaho sorry not sorry best queso! Great service. We never go anywhere else I'm from Oklahoma and I couldn't find a Mexican place here I liked until I came here now we never go anywhere else!

I love this salon, and not just because they're in my neighborhood. Jessica, the owner is super friendly and always has tips and ideas for making my cut and color just a little bit better. Heather is our favorite long-time employee and my husband and teenage son and daughter all get their hair cut with her. The establishment is always clean, prices are fair and employees are friendly and knowledgeable.
My wheatgrass shot was lovely, & my friend enjoyed her juice... but I don't think I'd come back... kind of a dark inside & then icky smell outside...

Would strongly recommend staying away from this business and if I could give it negative stars I most definitely would.
I personally dealt with Lauren Daniels in a meridian town home. Really nice place, but really crappy business
Lauren was very unorganized and very fake, with minimal to no communication.
It started off with THREE different move in dates. It was a brand new place at the time, but every time we drove by nobody was there or even working on the unit. The floor in the bathroom and back door wasn't installed properly, we sent in multiple work orders, only to hear absolutely nothing in return, so OF COURSE we got charged for those things upon move out, and which we NEVER received a move out checklist to begin with. I asked for the paint color, to make some adjustments on the walls, and what do you know, never heard back!
They charged us for things we didn't even have, like a fence? where was our fence we supposedly had? or the blinds in the bathroom with fly poop on it? I never had blinds in ANY bathrooms in that 2 bed 2.5 bath place. Also charged for the hard water stains.. excuse me but if you're going to have cheap ass appliances in the joint, expect to get cheap ass results. oh and charged for there being spiders outside..  
And from the looks of it, it looks like not many people were pleased with this company.. haven't seen more than one star from anybody on here!
Also its a legal 30 day policy on returning security deposits, well they were 5 days over due.

I found this practice over a year ago and am so glad I did. The whole practice staff from the Dr to the front end are friendly, efficient, comforting and on time. I've never had to wait for my scheduled appointment time. Reminder calls and rescheduling are easy.

Visiting from California & had to search for a great brewery out here in Idaho and I was not disappointed!! Such a big selection of beers and wonderful customer service! Hope to make it back one more time before I have to go home!

I am extremely sad to leave this review, i have been a loyal customer of revitalize. I stop in here several times a week. I came in tonight after work ( 8:15pm) I ordered 3 juices and avocado toast. The young man who was cleaning the glass at the counter finished what he was doing. Walked around the counter set his things down and with the same gloves he was cleaning with grabbed the toast and started making my food. My husband and I are visiting and wanted a breakfast spot! The food was delicious and the staff was so incredibly nice! I would def recommend. My husband had their steak rice bowl and I had their Rise & Shiner. 10/10

The donuts are nothing special.  Every donut is just a cake donut.  The name of each donut is made up by the frosting applied on top, it's still just a cake donut.  If they put something in the mix to make it special, then then they can call it a special donut.  I say mix blueberries into the batter, then call it a blueberry donut, mix raspberries into the batter, then call it a raspberry donut mix lemon zest into the batter, then call it a lemon donut.  Don't just frost it with a flavor and call it a special donut.  If you put lipstick on a pig, it's still a pig. C'mon Duck Donuts, let's get with it.

We ordered and had Crave deliver. I can honestly say I've never had more disgusting sushi. The fish was soggy and had a disgusting after taste. I couldn't even finish what we ordered it was so bad. Needless to say I won't be eating here again.

If I could give 0 stars I would!! I went in this store to get goggles online $29.95 and store $32.50 one guy said we can get the online price and get to the register and the other guy refuses to give the price.

Bolton Property Management was the worst company I've ever worked with.  I recently moved from their property when my lease finally expired.  When we moved in food in the cupboards,  yellow goop down the brick walls, hair everywhere, a food caked microwave, and chunks of glass on the carpet told me it hadn't been cleaned.  I contacted them and learned that they would "reprimand the cleaning company", but that there was nothing that could be done at this point.  There was no way a cleaning company had been there.  I spent hours and hours cleaning, shampooing the carpet and steaming the whole thing.  
There was a discrepancy in what they said they were going to charge me when we moved out and what they actually did charge.    It's not a huge chunk of money, but I'm not impressed.  So far they won't return my calls.  There were also random charges for names not being on the check, etc while we lived here, but I documented everything we did with photos. 
I don't recommend this company's properties.

I am absolutely pleased with the service I receive from Doctor Howard and Dr Fowler and the entire staff at Meridian Smiles and Orthodontics!!! Everybody in this office treats myself and my entire family with exceptional care! My children absolutely love the doctors and staff and look forward to going to the dentist like a field trip. I refer every single friend and family member to this location because of the high quality experience and care that both my entire family and I receives. I always recommend Meridian Smiles Dentisty and Orthodontics because I personally know that my friends and family will get the very BEST care available in Meridian Idaho, not pay an arm and leg, or be tortured in the chair. You literally will walk away with the smile you've always wanted to share! "When someone doesn't have a smile, give them one of yours", that my friends is possible because of this Office!!!!!!

This was my first experience with Poke and I thought it was delicious!!! The staff was super knowledgeable and gave me their suggestions for a newbie. 

I got the 'design your own' poke bowl. With fresh salmon, tuna, tobiko, and lots more. The fish tasted very fresh and don't have that 'fishy' taste. I would describe it has a sushi bowl. I told my husband, 'Why haven't I been eating this until now?' My husband had the teriyaki chicken bowl which we both thought was nothing special. But good enough.

There were also having a free miso soup day! Free? Soup? Yes please! It was a great tasty miso and a good addition to our lunch. 

We will definitely be back!

I don't usually write reviews, but oh my WORD. This place was so good. My boyfriend a I went here on a limb, got the sweeto burrito and sweet pork salad and it was amazing. So much flavor, and I believe very fair prices. Great customer service as well. Highly recommend and will be going here again soon.
Excellent service and amazing coffee! My favorite so far in Idaho! Love the atmosphere and the personnel attending given to the order by the employees!

I have been at SEVERAL events where they have catered.  Each time they were late, extremely unorganized and didn't have great service.  They forgot things on the day of the event and had to leave to get them.  Completely unacceptable.  I would recommend using a different caterer if you want a stress-free event.

Great place for breakfast food and coffee! Meridian has always been lacking brick & mortar coffee shops so it's exciting to see a new one. 

In regards to the review below, I don't think it's fair to give a low rating on someone's business because they weren't wearing masks when it was not a mandate. Please be kind during these difficult times. This is someone's livelihood and you are interfering. 

If you've been here, show these guys some love!

Probably one of my favorites regarding sandwiches.  The Blimpies Best is really good.  Standard line sandwich shop, bread, tell them which sandwich you want and do you want a combo.

Nice, comfy atmosphere, typically a little quieter than most places.  My go to place for a sub in Meridian.

Really really good. Good coffee every time, most of the staff is friendly. Only thing is my drink (same every time) is a different price every time I go. Still good prices regardless but would appreciate some consistency.

The staff was nice and donuts were really fresh. BUT the donuts were so greasy they squished when we bit them. The glazes had good flavor but paired with the awful donut it couldn't be saved. Then the price, $10/half dozen. Nope.

My husband and I were going to try Antigua Coffee Shop today but the staff was not wearing masks. At this time I won't eat anywhere that doesn't take the very basic precautions.  Please take the steps to make your customers feel safe.

Not really a donut. It's not tasty and doesn't taste like any donut. I really don't understand why this place still exists. 
And the price is just outrageous!
Was introduced to this little hole in the wall, and I am glad that I was. The food was great.

They were so fast that they got my food before I had time to sit down. Buttt going in i had to wait what felt like forever. The lady just kept ignoring me and was not wanting to take my order. And she didn't seem to be listening to what I was saying either. But the food was very tasty and fresh. I also love all the salsa options. I don't see the point of the numbers they give you for the tables if instead of looking to match the number they ask what you ordered in a way that makes you confused if it's even yours.

Tasty but tiny.  My son ordered a taco and I've seen bigger tortillla chips.  Their burritos were also not huge as described in other reviews.  Next time we'll take our money to Casa Verde or even ... Taco Bell.  At least then we won't leave hungry.

I've been in Eastern Oregon for almost a year and was soooo excited to find a European Wax in Meridian.  I moved from AZ and have purchased their services since they opened in Scottsdale; I have to drive 2 hours but it's worth the time!!!

Beware that all the items that say they are made with nonfat frozen yogurt are not. They yogurt they use has 9 grams of fat per serving. I only asked because ether smoothies are so rich and creamy. The lady looked at the container for me. They should disclose this.

Awesome customer service. Went looking for gift for my son's 4th birthday & came back with my 16yo daughter's Traxxas & they were able to find the issue with in minutes. Picked up a nice charger that we can use for both cars now which will be very convenient. 
The next day my son crash my daughter's Traxxas so we went back in & not only was the part in stock but we had an option for us to choose from.
My husband had compared prices online and they're right there for the items we were looking at (even with free shipping). It was nice to be able to take it home vs waiting for a delivery to our home for the same item/price. 
Kids are trying to talk us in to going today haha
Arrived 10 mins before closing. I got an Oreo and a French toast. Didn't expect my donuts to be so fresh and hot. Super nice staff. I'll be back to try more.
Fantastic variety in coffee options. The Mexican mocha is everything. Great great spot for drive thru and sit down. Good work Meridian.

I dont think I should get endless text about how good a deal they have on a new harley. And when I get down there High Desert can not back it up. 
The price was beat considerably by a competitor as well as the interest rate was significantly better. 
I was seriously trying to buy at my local dealership,  but when it comes to my money I'm going to find the best deal. It took one phone call and they stood by the deal.  2-K and 2 points on the interest rate is a big deal to me. I'll drive an hour or so to save $4,000 
In the end I just want a fair deal when I'm spending $30,000

Delicious food with a wonderful food coma after. I have never had any lack lust food from here. Their food always hits the spot in the most tasty way possible. I need a nap almost every time after eating here. Definitely worth checking out!

Disgraceful!

Asked the Minister, Steve Moore to help with the cost of installing a window in a drafty trailer for a financially challenged mother on dialysis to help keep her and her blind daughter warm during the winter.  The response I received was, "is she a member of Ten Mile" and when I answered No the Minister turned down our request.

We proceeded to buy the window ourselves and disassociated ourselves from the church - what a fraud this church is.  Ken & Carol

Worst service I've encountered in a while. I have tried this place on two separate occasions. Both times I Called a to-go order in. Both times I was give an estimate of 15 minute time for pizza to be ready for pickup. BOTH times I've shown up only to be met with confused looks and somehow my Order didn't get made. I can't explain how frustrating it is to plan ahead when you only have an hour lunch break, call ahead of time, walk into restaurant, wait 10 minutes all for them to figure out-oh we never put her order in our system. And this freaking happened twice!!!!!I will never try this place again. Maybe the food is good- I will never know as my orders seem to go into a black hole around there. Be warned.  I'm a loyal pizza girl- you guys just lost credibility with me.

Wandered into the kitchen,the doors wide open, while shopping and was rudely addressed by the instructor after asking a simple question as to "what are you making?"  The so called "chef instructor"was leaning on a counter and having conversation with a friend not paying any mind to the class... until she peeled up when I approached the counter. She then blurted "we're making stuff!"  I could go on but... eh.

Friendly, family-owned place for breakfast, lunch, and dinner. Coffee is the best in town, rich and smooth. Pastries are made in house and worth every calorie, especially the almond croissant and the beef wIth chimichura. The Antigua breakfast is a complex variety of colors and flavors that includes homemade tortillas, black beans, sausage, egg, plantains, and cream--a feast! We will be coming back for more.
Horrible service, order was wrong as usual, everyone was rude and 3 employees outside smoking. no wonder they where rude I interrupted their smoke break. Horrible horrible service

I can't even begin to describe how frustrating this company is to work with.  We prepaid for their services and then never heard from them again.  They refused to set up an appointment and said that they would rather just "show up".  However, they require you to be home in order to do the work.  I called every week for a month and was told they would be there soon.  With all of the lawn care companies in the Treasure Valley, I highly suggest looking at anyone but Diamond.

If i could give negative stars i would but i can only do 1 .Sorry to say we were extremely excited to eat at this place. So we decided to go out and eat for our parents Birth day and after picking this place to try something new rather than going to the usual places we usally go to. My sister made a reservation for a party of 14. Not once did we get checked on to see if everything was ok i asked a waiter if we could get the rest of the beverages out to us an she replied that she was not  our first waitress but didnt get ours to do it either so needless to say it was a horrible experience i will never go here again nor will i recommend anyone i know. The food as mediocre at best. Also i can not belive they automatically added the tip to the bill when to be honest the way they work and how they never came by our table to check i would of not left a tip because they did not deserve it.

DO NOT RENT FROM THESE PEOPLE IF YOU CAN AVOID IT. Quite honestly the worst property management company you can imagine. Our apartment wasn't finished being built when we showed up out coming from of state to move in. We don't have internet in our unit because they refused to repair a builder error with our wiring. The property manager assigned to us neglected to ever answer us or get back to us with our concerns/issues. Horrible experience and I am SO glad to have only signed a 9 month lease. Will never rent from them again

This is my favorite Mexican food place in Meridian!! I've had the enchiladas (chile verde & chile colorado), sopes (shredded chicken), horchata, agua de jamaica, sopapillas, rice, and beans. Everything is served on these big thick ceramic plates, and it's so good & comforting. I always leave full but not in a food-coma way lol, and honestly if not for COVID I would have gone more often by now to try more items. The staff is super nice and warm and also I love the wall art. (Will update this review in the future with pics)

I decided to return to Mi Casa with both my wife and daughter. My last visit was less than stellar, but you never know right? Any place can have a good day, or a bad day.

In order to get a really good idea of a person, it requires multiple visits to get to know them. You have to find out who that person is, their likes and dislikes. You have to find out if they fit you.

Its like when you meet that person on the first date, both of you are on your best behavior. It's not until you have  been with them a while, that you find out who they really are and what they are really like. Thats why its always best to be friends first and take your time before jumping into a committmemt.

Evaluating a restaurant or business is no different. When you first visit there, you might have one experience, but the next time, it might be completely different. It takes time to get to know a business or restaurant before you can really know if you like it or not.

So, keeping this in mind, I returned to Mi Casa to give it another go.The decor both inside and out has not changed. It was as drab and boring as it was the 1st time. They only really life was hanging from the ceiling. 

When I looked at the menu, I could not help but see misspellings. It as as if they jumped right out at me.

Fortunately, this did not hurt anything except my sense of perfection. When they developed the menu, they left off the "E" in Tamale. As my wife tells me all the time, Spell Check goes a long way.

So when our waiter came to take our order, I ordered an enchilada, a taco and a Tamal. 

This time, I will just focus on the two things that really bugged me.

I ordered tacos and so did my daughter. Now the laws of physics and logic should tell you, me, and anyone else, that something that is supposed to be crisp, like a taco shell, should not be laid in something wet because it will get soggy. 

Who knew right?

This is exactly what happed to our nice crisp tacos. They were served laying in a bed of beans, so guess what? (Drum Roll Please) They got all soggy, so when we tried to pick them up, the shell disintegrated and all that was left of our tacos was a pile of meat.

My wife had the fajitas. The chicken was way overcooked, so it was dry and burned. 

After 2 tries here, I give up! Sorry, to everyone that has given this place several stars. 

For me, my search for good Mexican food in the Meridian/Boise area continues. 

Anyone that knows of one, please please please let me know.
Large hair in my taco and I paid for a large fry and it wasn't in my bag. Pretty disappointed this Jack n box is the one closest to my house...please get your stuff together

I have to say, I Love this company. Delicious cakes and great customer service, until I moved to Meridian. I placed a birthday cake order online a week in advance, I wanted to edit the order, tried calling over 3 days multiple times a day and no one answered the phone. CRAZY! 
The cake was ready as I ordered it and was good but.....how do you not answer a business phone, Ever!
This place has amazing donuts. I love that it's super fresh and everything was made to order. The young lady helping us was also really  nice and helpful.

Great spot for a tasty poke bowl! The salmon and hamachi were both very fresh and cut in good size pieces. The fact that they use the words "shoyu" instead of soy sauce and "poke" instead of poki is also an indicator that they probably know how a poke bowl should be. 
I'm not from Idaho, but if I ever get back to this area, I'll visit this place again!

I'm usually a fan of this place, but they missed the mark today. I placed an order this morning for breakfast and went to the restaurant at the time it was ready for pickup. It was busy when I got there but the hostess said it would be another 10 minutes. That was fine, but I ended up waiting for another 45 minutes and watched other people come in after me and pick up their orders. The hostess was calling out orders when they were ready but never called my name. She never provided any updates or an apology about my order like other restaurants do. I checked the to-go table myself and there was my food, sitting there for who knows how long at that point. It was lukewarm to cold when we got home, and we had to reheat our food. I asked the hostess how long this was sitting here and that I was waiting patiently, and she seemed indifferent and didn't apologize (like they have at other places). They forgot my parfait, so I had to ask for that as I left, and when I got home realized they forgot the gravy for my biscuits and gravy that I ordered. I didn't have the means to go back to the restaurant and get my gravy, so I wasn't able to enjoy the breakfast I paid a pretty penny for.

Love the in-and-out process. If you get an appointment it's the best, never waiting, they are always running one time. Very convenient. This location is no where near my house however, because of the ease of the customer service and b/c they are always running on time. I stick with the location. Taylor is my girl, sweet and super fast, very experienced.
The pizza was absolutely awful!!! Anyone that can stand behind this pizza hasn't tried good food. Literally take the pizza out your name. Very disappointed!!!!

I didn't know what I was getting in to with these. They smell and taste like protein powder. The donut itself is very muffin like and the toppings are bland. I'm obviously not their demographic. When I get a donut, I know what I'm getting in to. I'm not looking for something healthy or looking to hit certain macros. Not my thing. I will stick with DK, Guru or grocery store donuts.

Visited this gem of a eatery this past weekend again. As usual, we LOVED what we ordered. My husband enjoyed their Chan Chan torta and I had one of their breakfast tacos! Once you get ahold of the taco, its HUGE and very scrumptious. The Chan Chan torta is one of our go-to favorites. Their menu items all have small twists from the original Mexican dish, and have me dreaming about our next visit. 

On this last visit, we met the owners, Mike and Rosie. They are really cool and excited about their restaurant/creations. Hope to see them again the next time we head over. Love to see restaurant owners that are proud of their food, their staff, and their restaurant!

Hey y'all! If you are in Meridian/ Boise area you MUST try this place. The food is delish! Some of the best brisket I've had in some time! The service is +1, the price point is way more than fair and the portions are generous. Yesterday I last minute ordered lunch for the clinic where I work (company paid ). I recommended Kanak Attack Katering/ Pineappleexpress. The guys were insistent they could make the larger order work! They were thankful for the business and we were so excited to purchase/ support local! One gal told me she could eat her weight in their brisket. Everyone loved the mac salad and the fried rice is my new fave! There is something for everyone. I heard they will even do plated style. Get the Ohana package. Best bang for your buck! 

Thank you again! Your generosity and great food is welcomed. Can't wait to eat it again. Likely this week because my family is mad they didn't get it. 

Together we will get through this!
Minimal seating, solid beer selection and decent prices.  No food.  Not much else to offer compared to other places in the valley.

This location has some of the worse service. Four kids standing around talking and not doing anything. Took almost 20 minutes for me to get a cheese burger and fries. Three people that came after me got there food before me. Also spent of the workers were not even wearing gloves while handling food. Terrible place!

Was very happy to see that they finally put a wing stop in boise. I have stopped in probably 3 times since they have opened and every time good quality food. I wish the place was a little bigger but once the weather cools there is some outdoor seating to help. Place is very simple. You select how many wings u want. If you want boneless or original. Then you select your level of hotness. I haven't tried the atomic but the original hot is very good doesn't have much of a bit but good flavors. Would easily rate this as the best wing place in boise for sure and the fact there open untill midnight is awesome.. I can see some 10-11 o'clock runs to grab a late night snack here for sure..

My wife and I are always looking for new places to eat. Ok. its more me than her. She looks for these mainly to appease my addiction to new places and writing reviews. I love reviewing places and searching for the best places to go in the TV.

The Broken Yoke is yet another chain. I'm not really a fan of chains as their food tends to reflect mass production and they more often than not lack originality. With Covid going on though, If I were thinking on opening a restaurant, going with an established chain if the safest way to go.

I am from Texas, so anytime I see a Chicken Fried Steak (CFS) on a menu, this is what I have to order. Its a compulsion. Unlike the rest of the country, in Texas, there is a bit of a variation from the 4 major food groups. They are;

Fried Food
CFS
Mexican food
and Potatoes

I saw a CFS on the menu and I was hooked. I was not capable at the moment of ordering anything else. My wife had an omelette and hash browns, which is her go to breakfast food.

The 1st thing of note is the menu. Its in the shape of an egg. More places would do well to take note of little things like this to make them different. It made me want to read through the menu!

The next thing I noticed was something called the BYC challenge. Its a 32 egg (I think but I was not able to find this on their web site) potatoes and more. If you can finish it, you get it for free. A nice hook, but if you eat this many eggs in 1 sitting, my guess is your next stop may well be the local hospital. 

Can you say Cholesterol clogged arteries?

When rating a CFS, I have to go with a Texas scale and an Idaho scale due to the fact that its an Idaho dish that is attempting to replicate a staple of Texas.

The steak was tender, but it just had a breading. This is the norm is Idaho, but not Texas at all. The steak was not real steak. It was just ground beef which no Texan would dare make their CFS out of. It had no flavor except for the gravy which was more of a darker gravy that white with pieces of sausage in it.

On my Idaho scale, I give it a 2. On a Texas scale, I give it a -4

I ordered my eggs scrambled, but as expected, they were not scrambled at all. They were cut up pieces of omelet. This is typical though of breakfast places in Idaho. I have yet to find a restaurant that knows how to cook real scrambled eggs. Scrambled eggs should be fluffy, and light so when you put them into your mouth they melt and give you a good egg flavor. 

I give them a 1

What they do know how to do here is hash browns. They are crispy on the outside and gooey on the inside like they should be. Also of note was the toast which instead of just plain slices of bread was more akin to Texas Toast.

The star here by a landslide was the waitress. She was very friendly, funny and a pleasure to be served by. Jamie made the meal. 

I would say that overall, the food was a little better than a Dennie's.

We have been working with Jennifer Bender for several years now and the consistency of ability to get the job done right is off the charts. She is a true professional in every sense of the word and I never have to worry about whether or not our file is in process and on track with where it should be. She knows what she is doing and has mastered her craft. She meets and exceeds deadlines and works very hard for her clients. We recommend her regularly and have never been disappointed. I can't express highly enough how great she is to work with as both a client and a partner. I've been both. And you know she must be good if I'm referring my own children to her.
