I love wingstoptoo but the last 3 times I have been there. They have forgot to put  my ranch and barely give me any fries when I have a to go order. What's the point of having ranch cost extra and not even giving me it!

Love this place ! I pay out of pocket cash so when I come to places like this I expect the best and here you get it , the staff is so nice , I love my dentist he's really funny and makes you feel comfortable , it's clean and organized all the stuff is top of the line and updated I never mind Forking over cash here because I known I'm getting the best of the best I highly recommend them they are awesome !!!!
What a great store! They are so helpful and really got me on my way to feeling good and running better. Their staff is so knowledgeable and I couldn't be happier. Thank you

Very helpful and friendly sales people. John found a great first bike for me without any of the typical pushy salesperson attitude. I felt very comfortable finding my bike. I never would have imagined myself choosing a Harley but John took the time to help me find what was right. I also took the Learn 2 Ride 101 class. Brian and Andrea were amazing and patient teachers. There were all types from me who had never really been on a motorcycle/dirt bike, to people getting back on after many years. Overall some of the best sales service I've had and a great route to go for learning the ropes of riding. Thanks High Desert Harley!

Run, Run as fast as you can! The agents are kind, and great. The contractors who have come over are wonderful. The people pulling the strings... not so much. It is a nightmare to get an answer on anything, the most common answer to a problem is "We are still waiting on approval." I thought the extra cost would be worth a professional management company, I was mistaken. It is hard to imagine how a company with such poor management stays in business.

Wow! In town on business and myself and  a coworker stopped in here after dinner. Wasnt expecting much, but greeted by a young lady who made it day. Waffle cone and great ice cream and great service.... perfect. Will return next time I'm in town!

Burritos were huge. Hubby got an egg breakfast one and I got the chicken, bacon, onion ring one. It was $30 for burritos (they include sides) plus a drink and tip so it's not cheap but our food was really good. There was no one inside so we enjoyed eating inside since we didn't have to worry about covid and all the employees were masked properly. The nice manager also brought us out a free dessert since we were the only ones there and he said they like to treat new people well. We thought it was good and would definitely go there again but would likely split a burrito
Not very impressive, same Curley fries as jack in the box. Kraft singles on the club sandwich.
I had a terrible experience here and they made it right, it's nice to see a business respond and fix an error. I'll be back to try it again... I'll write a post when I go back.

Ended up leaving....walked in...waited 3 minutes for a hostess....waitress walked by, looked at us, kept walking. Finally acknowledged by staff, told to seat ourselves. Seated...no menus...no servers.....5 minutes pass with no contact. We walk out. Nobody says a word.

Holy moly, these are outstanding! Tried them for the first time yesterday with a friend, then had to drag the husband back to try them today. Im a huge cake donut fan, but my friend and the hubs typically aren't - they loved them! The staff are so friendly and do a great job answering questions and cranking out the orders. Want to try their breakfast sandwich on the next visit.

The food here is always good and we have introduced the Broken Yolk to others. Jamie is wonderful ... I thought she must be the owner, she treats customers so well. We love her! We met Nick (one of the owners) and he is a gracious guy who deserves to do well AND he knows Jamie is the reason we keep coming back:)

K, to be clear- I'm not a Harley guy, and will probably never be one, but the treatment people get at this dealership makes me wonder if I should be...

My experience here was with Learn to Ride offered through the dealership.  I was looking for an intro motorcycle safety course, and my cousin recommended these guys after having taken his skills test with them.  Note- he's also not a Harley/cruiser guy, and while they did rib him about getting "a real bike," it was very lighthearted and he thoroughly enjoyed working with them.

I may screw up the structure here, but Randall was our main instructor, Brian seemed to be in charge of the program, and there was another instructor who was on the course with us.  All three were super friendly and approachable, and at the same time very direct with feedback.... I mean they're trying to keep us from killing ourselves, so they better be direct, right?

Randall kept the classroom sessions informative, and entertaining enough to keep all of us adults (mostly) awake, and was always concerned with making sure that any questions we had were answered.

Our practical sessions were on HD Street 500s.  These were all well-maintained, as opposed to the stereotypical, ratchet, nasty bikes used in similar classes.  Felt like a new bike to my inexperienced eyes.  Well done.

During our practical sessions, Randall and the other instructor were clear with what our exercises would be, what was expected of us, and helped us get the most out of our time riding.  The time actually riding was fun as could be, so bonus.

At the end of the day(s), all people involved seemed to take pleasure out of being involved in our learning how to ride.  It was great.

If you are a new or non-rider, and want to learn to ride, or just learn the skills to get your motorcycle endorsement, I would absolutely recommend taking the L2R 101 course here.  I can't imagine a better introduction to motorcycling.  They offer more advanced courses, and I'm looking at taking at least one of them.

So we drove over 300 miles to come take a cooking class for my brother' birthday. He had taken a previous class and apparently enjoyed it. This class was AWFUL. The instructor had a fancy way of of cooking pork, well by the time we were ready to eat the pork didn't look done but he cut it and assured it was ok.  It tasted TERRIBLE and was not done.

The instructor was much to excited (due to the fact he was quitting and this was his last class)to really "instruct" or teach. Both of those words are what I associate with a "class"-silly me. 

Upon complaining about the entire experience, they offered us a refund in the form of a gift card. There was 6 of us @$69/ person. Well we got emails with the gift card information attached. Less than12 hours later the gift card was cancelled because they were just going to issue a full refund. Well this was almost 2 months ago and none of us have gotten a refund. Will not be giving this company another dime.

Went with 3 girlfriends before a concert,had a poor meal here before but thought i'd give it one more chance,BIG MISTAKE!! After asking our server about the prime rib,which he described as "best in town" I made the mistake of ordering it,dry and flavorless.I ate about 3 or 4 bites and left the rest on my plate,while picking up the plates he asked if I liked it to which I replied "no I did not" did he offer to remove it from my bill ?? No!! never again will I eat at this joke of a resturant.
Great friendly service. No pressure. Good selection of clothing and of course great selection of Harleys.

Like the store, but Pharmacy staff have ensured I will never patronize them again.  

Went there for ten years (longtime customer).  Arrived before closing time to find pharmacy closed. Spoke with BOTH pharmacists (Daniel and Alex) to say "You closed early"; I'd come to pick up meds already packaged.  
One said "alarm has been set"; other said "don't know what to tell you, it was 7pm on our clock". 
No apology for wasted trip.  For years I'd driven past two grocery stores and three pharmacies to shop here.   Now knowing how little my business means to their pharmacists, I will opt to spend my money elsewhere.

Absolutely the best in the area.  The service is amazing.  They literally make the topping fresh and hot right in front of you.  What an experience.  Great flavors.  Have to try the Bacon in the Sun.  Real chunky bacon used on it.   Amazing.

Do not stay here if you do not want to hear animals making noise all night long. The rooms smelt like cat and dog urine, all the animal smells really bugged my allergies even though I didn't stay in a pet friendly room. Despite that the customer service at the front desk was phenomenal.

Have gone everyday for the last 2 weeks & everyone is so nice & so fast! I accidentally said the wrong drink & they made it already. They made the drink I meant & didn't charge me for it, I felt so bad! Thank you so much Dutch! Such sweet & kind people & a fun environment to be in! & they are always giving back to the community
Excellent Burritos and friendly staff! We had the all American and the Buff Chick and both were tasty.

We came here for the play place, and the kids had a blast for hours. There were kids of all ages playing together. Our food was good and hot, and they kept the restaurant clean. In the play area, they have a single bathroom so you don't have to take everyone to the bathroom together every time someone has so go. Big plus for me!

They have a pretty large menu. They serve breakfast all day. They have a large variety of chicken, ham, steak, turkey, and a lot of other meats like pastrami. Only the drive-through is open currently but the service is pretty fast and they have really good customer service. You can build a sandwich or you can order one of their many variety of sandwich selections. The mac & cheese is pretty good just need some salt and pepper. Will definitely return to try out some breakfast items and another sandwich.

The hamburger was good. However, I would have never ordered from this restaurant had I seen what it looked like before I ordered my food. It was disgustingly filthy. In the 1-hour we were there today, not one person wiped down a table. Actually I should restate that, the guests wiped down the table not the employees. Absolutely filthy and disgusting. I could go on and on about the laziness of the employees but what's the point. Good thing Department of Food and Health didn't stop by today.

Just want to counter the 1-star review I saw regarding masks...we've been to BFC several times and it's great and even greater that they are willing to do the right thing for their employees and customers and continue to heed the advise of medical professionals. Thank you and hope to be in again soon!

The donuts are amazing and the crew is equally amazing.  Kimberlee, the owner, is extremely engaging and remembered my name the second time I came in.  If you want a super unique donut experience where they make your donut to order and you can customize it tons of ways, this is your spot.

Thank you for moving into the Village!

Nothing but problems with this terrible management group. They will NEVER leave you alone. It's constant inspections. They are always bothering their residents and do not respect privacy at all. The management is lackluster and apathetic. Problems are not resolved. Prices are above market rate for a given space and location. Low quality buildings and low quality materials. Above ALL they nickel and dime you on every single turn. You will get screwed on the move out inspection regardless of condition or efforts made to leave the apartment pristine. There is no respect from them demonstrated towards their residents. DO NOT RENT HERE.

I have been waiting here for over 20 minutes to pick up an online order. None of the employees even asked me what I was there for. I finally got pissed off and got someone to help just to find out the order hadn't even been started yet. All the employees were fighting with each other and swearing loud enough I could hear them in the dining room. This place is being ran by a bunch of retards.

Hidden gem! The name has been changed to BRIGHT EYES.  Had a fabulous lavender, almond latte. Yummy!  Stopped by the drive-thru on a whim and will go back because the interior looks cozy and they even have a few food items.  Later they serve beer and wine.  Warm and homey and it's locally owned versus the mammoth Starbucks which seems cold compared this this place.
Made an appointment I was late but they took me in anyway. Fast check in courteous service. Everything was explained very pleasant experience. In and out in 15 minutes.

Apparently the customers time isn't valuable. Think I could call in a cake? Nope. Can I call in a cake if I pay over the phone? Nope. Any order has to be made online. Terrible business model as well as terrible customer service. So now I wait for a cake for ten minutes that could have been ready when I got here. Oh it's ok, your time is much more valuable than mine, obviously. 
I don't know how hard these cakes are to produce because I guarantee they're brought in frozen and thawed. A generic cake shouldn't require me to pay in advance when it's your best seller. What a joke. Update:owner is a complete b$&&@. No accountability on her part for the ridiculous process. And also tried to say she didn't need "people like us" as customers. Told her she was a bitch and that's about it.

All of the employees at High Desert HD were fantastic. I have bought several bikes from them and they always have great customer service that makes you feel like you're working with professionals that truly care about their product and service.

SO HELPFUL.
I am not a runner.  Anyone who catches a glimpse of me would know that immediately.  But the staff here never treated me like they noticed my weight, and were SUPER helping me find shoes that helped with my plantar fasciitis and my tendency to pronate (curve my steps in)--though other stores told me I supinate (curve my steps out) because of how my shoes wear, the staff at Pulse watched me walk without shoes at all, and we realized part of the reason I was struggling was because I actually pronate, but the support was too strong on one side and made it look like I supinate.  REALLY helpful, and I'm so grateful!

Dr. White is amazing!!! I had lifted heavy boxes while moving and the next day I woke out of my sleep because both of my arms felt like they fell asleep. The tingling down both my arms got a little better over time, but by the 5th week of feeling strange sensations down my arms to my fingers I knew I had to do something. By the grace of God I found Dr. White. He figured out what was wrong and he adjusted my back and now there's no longer ANY numbness or tingling!!! After just one session!!!!!!!! It's so wonderful to have my old arms back!!! He is the real deal! Amazing!
Pricey but decent. Comes with a side (fries or tots). They're very drippy, but have decent flavor.

Great customer service that far exceeded my expectation. Brought my 15 year old in as a first timer. It was free for first visit. So, that was a plus all on its own. Gals at the front desk knew their stuff and were super kind. And Kari our wax gal was incredible. She carried on good conversation and explained the whole procedure. She was very efficient. Place is kind of spendy. However, we will probably be back because of service and the referral program which seems like a great deal.

Dr. White is amazing! We were visiting from out of town & my partner needed a last minute emergency adjustment- Dr. White got us in same day, was a joy to talk to, detailed in his adjustment & explained everything he was doing throughout the process. If we were local, this would be our GO-TO chiropractor for sure!

It's so fun to see Duck Donuts opening out west! The owner is a native Boisean and has created a welcoming, fun atmosphere. The donuts are like none I've ever tasted, and made fresh on the spot! There are toppings galore, made to order. I still love my plain (odd, I know), but I find myself craving one at the oddest times. If you haven't had the "Duck Donut experience," or need a creative treat at your next party--this is where I'd hit next!

Wow the carnivore has a great flavor and kick to it very good burrito, tots came out just right, had a small bite of the all American wasn't my favorite but wasn't to bad over all, 2 burritos with sides and 2 small drinks plus tip close to $28 isn't to bad over all

The worst property management company ever. They are non-responsive, charge a percentage add on for everything they do and do things that don't need to be done.  Never hire them to manage your properties!
This place has the BEST unsweetened matcha a girl could ask for. Every time I visit the drive thru everyone is so welcoming and kind. It's the best. Don't question it, just do it

Yummmm nothing quite like a delicious greasy creation from Five Guys after a backpacking trip! My husband and I stopped by on the way back down from Stanley for a well deserved dinner. My cheeseburger ($7.69 including fries) tasted heavenly - especially after eating freeze-dried meals for 3 days straight. They also gave us so many fries! Our to-go bag was completely full of them. We paired our meals with a vanilla milkshake ($3.99). Not the healthiest was damn well a delicious wonderful dinner!

I have enjoyed everything I have tried at BiteMe Bar. My husband and I shared a Midnight Delight, and on another visit, I had The Dark Side. Both were delicious! I ordered hot cocoa bombs for my kids here, and they were a huge hit. I appreciate that they enforce the mask mandate, like responsible business owners and humans.

Bait and Switch!

We moved across the country to Idaho, so unfortunately we were reliant on Honesty.

My wife and I were informed that they had a unit on the fourth floor in a new building. We were hesitant, but agreed because this particular building had elevator access.

We were assured that there was plenty of free parking as well.

Fast forward to move in day. We get the keys and before we even unlock the door, the nob almost fell off it was so loose. But they did a walk through today? I don't think so. 

The complex has claimed 90% of the free parking to rent out to their residents. 

Worst thing is that they gave us a unit in an older building for the same price with no elevator access at all. My mother-in-law has lupus, so am I supposed to carry her upstairs? Also since there is no elevator, the moving company will be charging an additional $1,000!!!

Also, they only have one dumpster, so you are expected to carry your trash down four flights of stairs and across the complex every week. 



Moving is tough enough, but regency at river valley proved they didn't care about us or their current residents while costing us money in hotels while we figure everything out. I start a new job in 6 days. Thank you Regency for validating my distrust in these turn and burn apartment complexes which thrive on necessity while causing real problems to their applicants and residents alike.

You can do better.

Waiting on a resolution,

Lance

Great food and delicious drinks. The staff makes the experience even better! :) Our waitress was always attentive to us and was quick to get our order in even though we did it super last minute for take out. Definitely recommend!!

There are so many things I love about these donuts. They are low fat, low carb, low sugar and packed with protein. All donuts are under 107 calories. The concept is fabulous and the execution is even better!

Keep in mind that these are not your typically fatty greasy  deep fried airy donuts. They have more of a cake-like consistency, dense and heavier. It's more like eating a protein muffin, still rather delicious. You probably want a fork; they are pretty dang crumbly. My favorite was the chocolate with chocolate frosting and sprinkles. It pretty much just tasted like a chocolate cupcake, but heathy! I also greatly enjoyed the lemon raspberry flavor, it's one of my go-to flavors. 

My only criticism, much like other reviews, is that some of the flavors leave a chemical-like aftertaste from what I assume is the artificial sweetener used in the donuts. I once tried the cookie dough donut, and while the toppings and frosting were great, the dough itself left a strong, unpleasant taste in my mouth that was hard to get rid of. I hope they try to experiment with alternative, natural sweeteners! This place has so much potential to be the best in its area if it can get every donut to taste as delicious as the ones I mentioned in the paragraph above.

I will still continue to drop by here occasionally but I will stick to my usual order. Great place!
We loved this place! Super cute, yummy food and the waiter helped us with all our questions and was very attentive. A very good experience and I would recommend to anyone!
Can not recommend this place enough! Staff is extremely friendly and helpful!! And the food.. is very good! Pupusas.. best I've ever had. Cuban sandwich on point!

Drove through, only 1 car in front but takes 10 minutes? This isn't terrible.. but what is?
Its the burritos that are packed wall to wall with potato and egg, with a slight hint of meat or cheese... its Chipotle flavored potatoes and eggs... which I can just make better at home.. for $9?!
They forgot my chips and queso that I also paid for... leaving with just a burrito id pay $4 for and a $13 bill with nothing else.. on a very non-busy day/time. Empty lot with 1 car ahead of me.. cmon.
I can't see how anyone would want these unimpressive burritos packed with cheap ingredients so they don't have to actually add much meat or anything else worth wanting?

Hard pass on this place, I was very hopeful as well.
The service was slow and me and my fiend got açaí bowls that were terrible, hopefully the juice was better.

Wow. Wonderful place. We were driving through and did not want to go to far off the highway. We were greeted by a lovely woman that was so friendly and gracious. Two very large margaritas were ordered followed by the entrees. The food was to dye for ! The atmosphere and vibe was so cheery and festive. If I lived here I would come often. The people here and food are both genuine !

They got my order wrong and I didn't notice until I got home. It was annoying, but understandable because it was the first day they were open and they're still trying to iron things out. The one star is mainly because you're paying over $10 in most cases for a small burrito that isn't a full meal for most adults and there was nothing fantastic about how it tasted or the ingredients. It was mostly rice and some weird ranch dressing. West Meridian has plenty of mediocre food already.

OK I know this is weird, I was shopping at Baskin Robbins for an ice cream cake for a friend's birthday party (well, that was the ostensible reason,  I was actuly looking to settle into my hotel room with a huge stash of junkfood and marathon Gilmore Girls in honor of its 20 year anniversary, but the man at the counter didn't need to know that) and another customer noticed me looking and recommended I check out Dairy Queen. I was like, are you serious DQ is going to have better cakes than BR? This lady was adamant the DQ cakes put BR to shame. So I went and checked it out, and OMG do all Dairy Queens have fancy cakes now?? I remember them being lackluster before, but this little dinky DQ in some speedtrap town in Idaho has the most amazing ice cream cakes you'll ever see. And to my infinite satisfaction, it was FRESH too. I know that sounds funny to say the ice cream was fresh, but seriously I've gotten one before and it tasted like the freezer. So good job!

Chowobunga is a new food truck we get to enjoy in Meridian. With the loss of our local Hawaiian place in downtown Meridian, this truck is a very welcome site. The truck is sitting in a few different locations during the week from what I learned. They have a website that shares their locations if you are looking for some good Hawaiian food.
I ordered the lunch plate with beef. The plate is filled with steamed rice, slaw salad, shrimp tempura, won tons, mac salad, and skewers of beef. The beef skewers had tons of great flavor. I could eat a ton of these no problem. The shrimp tempura had a great crispy texture. The slaw salad is fresh and the truck allows the option for dressing. Thepork/shrimp won tons were cooked nicely and were very good. There is no Hawaiian lunch plate without a mac salad...and they got you covered. 
If you are looking for some Hawaiian food, give Chowobunga a try.
Cheers Always!

With the new year time to clean up the diet and make more consistent food choices. Came into Sweeto Burrito and ordered the smoked chicken rice bowl with extra chicken. Good amount of chicken to hit that protein intake and good carbs with fresh rice with black beans. Good clean fresh food for the body to break down and recover from a workout. Good place to swing by after the gym. 

Ate so fast no time for photo, sorry!
This place is amazing!!seriously the best fast food burger I've had.I visited boisie for only 2 days and ate there twice.Thank you freddies!!!
Fro yo was good with lots of refreshing summer flavors. We got it and ate by the fountain, which was nice and relaxing.

Downloaded app tonight to see if this would be more efficient and get quicker service. Most of the time I order plain quaterpounder plain, cheese only no sauces, etc. I ordered two tonight and after arrival my hotel, one of the burgers had all the fixings. I called and explained the situation. The employee was nice and offered to fix the order and gave me not just 1 but 2. I would come back again but I know now to check both burgers next time.

Not impressed - though our 'new normal' is an adjustment I think waiting 2 hours for any pizza delivery is unreasonable in Spring (no rain- sunny out) weather during a little traffic time. Then after waiting for the two hours try to call them and get a busy signal with every attempt to finally get through and find out they haven't even left!Tells us on the call he's leaving 'right then' ...

Ridiculous.

Thennn wait ANOTHER 20 minutes to have to call AGAIN  and mysteriously they 'didn't get the order' even though they confirmed on our FIRST CALL the address and the name of the order. ... manager stated the order hasn't been received but they could make it 'right then' to be delivered'.  I asked for a refund and they gave a multitude of excuses of what could have happened but the manager was nice. Offered a credit for the next time we order (very highly unlikely) but appreciated it.
The Best Mexican Food Ever !!! The owners are so sweet and nice.. Margaritas is like the best I ever had.. Thank you for the great friendly service !!!

I've been to La Creme a few times now and I'm always suprised by the selection. I feel like several other Forzen Yogurt places in the valley dont have more traditional flavors and as someone who likes my safe treats I dont like to get them. La Creme had a very good selection of exciting new stuff to try, but also my safe place for frozen yogurt flavors. 

Every time I've visited its been very quiet and I've been able to find a seat and enjoy the TV without much ambient noise. 

I'd recommend this location to anyone who is looking for a quick tasty treat.
The food was great. I think the Famosa Burrito is the best burrito I've ever had.  Service was good and not too pricy.
Really delicious food. The carne asada is 5*s and the burrito meal was fantastic. Fresh and fast to order for take out.

The first time I tried Wing Stop at this location it was amazing! We did an online order and picked it up within the time frame given. Walked in and walked right out with my online order. The second time I made an online order and went to pick it up at the given time frame was absolutely awful! My time to go pick it up was 28-33 minutes. I got there almost 10 minutes after that time and STILL WAITING 30 MINUTES! There was a long line, multiple people waiting on their orders and 1 cashier. Mind you, the 1 cashier was juggling the register, drive-thru AND the phone. He had no sense of urgency, actually no one really did. For a while the 1 cashier ignored the line and continued on with the phones for about 5-10 minutes without acknowledging the people waiting in line. Our food was way different, fries didn't have seasoning, our "wet" tenders were DRY. Not sure if I will be back at this location, it was that bad.

This Yelp location isn't correct- I went to the new store front 499 S Main St Meridian.
I've been waiting for Kanak to open its store front for months and I finally got a chance to stop in after work today. I ordered a bit of everything I wanted to try and there were some ups and downs. The two different rices were really good- the coconut rice and the spam/pineapple rice (my new favorite) and I got the kalbi short ribs (great flavor, not a fan of the cut) the shredded sweet pork (really good) and my go to- pork adobo. I was raised on adobo and I've eaten it around the country but this pork adobo was too salty, very tender but overly salted. I also got the mac salad (yum) and tried the corn salad (surprisingly good with a touch of heat). I was hoping for lumpia, which they had but only banana. They are newly opened but not a new company in this area... I'll be back to try them again but I'm not in a rush.

Finally got the chance to check out Freddy's this weekend with the family.  I'm not a huge fan of fast food burgers but Freddy's was great!  I had a regular cheeseburger combo and loved their fries.  My daughter had a grilled cheese with onion rings and I stole one bite of my niece's chocolate custard 

There food and service was exceptional and the prices are lower than Five Guys.  We will definitely be going back!
What an amazing find. Great service with a large menu. The breakfast burrito, home fries and mimosa flight are my favorite.

Great local bar with plenty to do inside to keep you busy. Sports on the TV's, 6-8 beers on tap, full bar, great food choices like quesadillas- my steak one was fabulous. 

I met some friends there for darts. Pool tables and music available too. 

Pitchers of beer available and social distancing ans masks are in place.  No standing at the bar.

Not sure how I can give a good review since I didn't receive my bike yesterday as I was told by the salesperson who sold my first bike on Friday. 
I waited for it for hours, very disappointing, not even a courtesy call. 

Their policy should be first come, first serve. Not just about making a sale. I'll be contacting Eaglemark Savings Bank to share my experience and see the possibilities of taking my business to Twin Falls.

We were in town for a wedding and saw this place here on Yelp.  12 of us showed up for lunch and they accommodated all of us very well.  The place was very clean, including the restrooms. 
The chips salsa were great! We all got several different items that included chimichangas, shredded beef burritos, and shrimp fajitas.  Everyone loved their food. 
The service was great and the food came out quick.  Would recommend this place as a go to Mexican food joint.

Having recently relocated to Idaho, I was desperately seeking legit Mexican food. That place is Mi Casa!! As soon as you sit down, warm beans and cheese, salsa Fresca and the perfect tortilla chip basket magically appeared. I ordered a Pacifico which came in the coldest mug ever!! The ceviche tostada is life changing filled with fresh shrimp it is so fresh that it must have been caught that day! The citrus in the dish keeps it the perfect balance to an ice cold beer and chips. Can't say enough about how much I love this place!!
Waited for20 minutes because they didn't tell us it was sitting on back counter. Ordered boneless and got bone-in. Bathroom dirty.

I have walked by Revitalize downtown for a year and have wanted to try it. Today I brought our staff for a fun morning outing.  I was extremely disappointed that all the juices are "pre juiced" and up to 5 days old.  And you can't order off the menu.  We were told we could just get a juice out of the cooler.  It was $10 per person for 5 day old - pre done juices. Very limited choices.  Spending $10 per juice, I feel like I should be able to get a fresh juice and made with the ingredients I like and I know are good for me.  I seriously wonder what you put in the juice to make them last for 5 days - I never did get a clear answer on this.  I was super disappointed that I couldn't order a fresh juice and one that I wanted.  Very high priced for no customization, freshness and customer service.

Acorn storage has several hundred storage units on both sides of the street. The price isn't bad. I pay $9.99 for a 5x10 closet style unit. This basically holds my Christmas things and some other stuff I only use once a year. 
You can call and pay your bill via phone or even pay annually (they will refund if you leave). You only have to give a 5 day notice when vacating. They also have a trailer for you to use free of charge on move day.

Yummy!!! This ice cream shop is so good and fun. Not only is their ice cream yummy but they have so many toppings choices to make some great flavor combos. Plus it's very convenient to take an ice cream on a stick to-go.

This is definitely worth checking out.  It's a small pub(?) tucked away on Overland road and easy to miss if you're not paying attention.

To start, we got a table almost immediately, even though they appeared quite busy. I wasn't expecting there to be a full bar, which was an added bonus. 

We ordered two appetizers, the Somkin' Hotties and the Gramercy Bites.  I would go back here every day just to have the Smokin' Hotties.  I actually hate jalapeno poppers, so I wasn't too excited about these, but they are absolutely amazing. (We will be making trips back just to order these!).  The Bites were good as well, but I think they couldn't live up to the Hotties.

My wife ordered the Vanilla Panzanella salad.  Vanilla in a Basil Vinagerette on a salad sounds horrible, but our waitress said it was worth getting. Since we're at a "pizza and Grill" I ordered the Astoria Pizza.  

Both the salad and my pizza were amazing.  Atmosphere was great, service was great.  We had a wonderful experience and we will be back.
Cut Loose is easily the best hair salon in Meridian, Idaho. Jessica, the owner, really cares about her clients, and I'm so glad she cuts my hair. Cut Loose keeps me looking my best!
If you're looking for a normal donut this is not for you! But if you're want a healthy, good tasting post workout donut, then this is for you!

Horrible Customer Service from personal banker to branch manager! The manager made an assumption that my cousin and I are not US citizens and that is the reason why the business account cannot be opened because of the address verification! That is discrimination!!! She also said that they couldn't verify my cousins address and we gave them all the paperwork that they need. The personal banker asked my cousin to notarize her lease agreement! Ridiculous!!! Bad customer service ever!
So yummy ;) new fav desert place and the staff member was super friendly and helpful.

THIEVES !!!! 
WORST HOTEL EXPERIENCE EVER. Visiting my first time to Boise for training for a new job. Booked my reservation on Expedia . When I came to check in the told me "we can't find your reservation." I said ok . Showed them my email confirmation. Showed them my app confirmation. Said it did not exist. That my reservation had to be under another name. 
I obviously needed a room with my training going on. Asked if I could still book a room then for the price I have on my
Reservation on my email . Told me no. Because my reservation doesn't exist in the system they had to give me their price which was $30 more a night. Expedia called them twice and they continued to argue saying "it's not here sorry. Nothing we can do" She booked me for 1 night. My stay is for 3. The first room they assigned to me was already taken with a dog.. I went to use my key and a dog was right behind the door barking. When they got me a different room, I realized she only booked me for one night when I needed 3. I go to the front again and some different guy tells me "oh well I don't know if I even have that available" ????? Are you joking. Then tells me "you can stay in this room tonight and tomorrow and you'll have to move to a different room Saturday. I was like ok fine. He never booked my room for for Friday. So I had to go to front desk FOR A THIRD TIME. Had to book a room AGAIN. I was so frustrated and done with this place I checked out early. 

BEST PART: THEY STOLE MY 45$ PHONE CHARGER. 
I went through all my bags. Couldn't find it. Called and asked if I could come get it. They said they couldn't find it. That it wasn't turned in and I must have it. 

So basically F*** this place. AVOID AT ALL COSTS. 
The fact I have to even give them 1 star is insane.

Nice local chain coffee shop. I like this location since it's easy access to the freeway. This location also seems to have the most seating of the 3 locations. Decent place to come get some work done (be nice if they had a few more outlets). This was the first time I had their drip coffee and it was pretty good. Blueberry scone was pretty good too. Definitely get the scone warmed up. Tasted like it came right out of the oven. Overall the service was good. The wifi, at least when I went, wasn't really working. Also would be nice if they would open another location in Boise closer towards downtown.

Why rent a hotel room when you can get a suite for the same amount of money. When you're traveling with your family Townplace Suites makes total sense. Not only can you bring the family but bring your dog too - at the same time you earn Marriott rewards points.

This property offers nice accommodations in the Meridian Idaho area. The rooms are contemporary and clean, in fact, they look almost new. Flatscreen TVs in every room, fully stocked kitchen and comfortable beds all combined with a cozy seating area. What really completes the package here, is the fact that you can get two separate bedrooms in your unit for a cost of $149 per night. That's a tremendous value!  On top of that, you get included with your rate, a free breakfast buffet every morning.

Other amenities include a fitness center with nice treadmills and a full rack of dumbbells. The dumbbells and the bench combined, make for a good workout while traveling. You'll find the treadmills to be in good condition plus they have built in fan and built in TV.  The indoor pool was too cold for small children who just like to play in the water and too small for adults to swim laps in it. That being said, I was not a fan of the pool. The hot tub was heated to the proper temperature and kept clean.

You'll find they have easy freeway access - situated on the interstate and Eagle road. There's plenty of guest parking and it's easy to get to your room from your car while toting your luggage. Several dining options are available within walking distance of the property. You can read my review of Fat Guy's sandwiches that I posted this week.

So if you need more than a basic hotel room at a reasonable price point, give the Townplace Suites in Meridian a try. I know I'll be back.

Salute!
We love Mt. Timber coffee! Service and quality is consistently great, and I love the double drive-thru.
I absolutely love Gandolfos so it was so nice seeing them in the Boise area again! Such great food and awesome service!
It's ok. The food is good and all that however unlike other Poke places in town they dont help you out with suggested bowls. I don't live on the islands so common guys, help me out!

Lorena helped us out the other day. She was so sweet and attentive. They were definitely understaffed, but she didn't make me feel like she was stressed or overwhelmed or even that I was rushed. She was very kind to me and very kind to the man who ordered after me who had quite a few questions about every item he was ordering. She was so sweet with him. Which was really great customer service because she didn't make him feel bad that she had other things to get done and he was taking forever. She treated me the exact same way...she was kind to everyone I saw her interact with and patient with them. Which can a bit more be rare out here. She was very diligent about safety  measures also, which I'm adding in my review because I know that is real important to some people right now. I also watched the cook and he was very quick with making the food and worked very fluidly. Made it look easy, which I'm sure it isn't. Anyway, great experience for us.
I had no idea this place existed. The coffee is great, but the food is the reason to come. The owners are from Guatemala and El Salvador and make pupusas from scratch. Good stuff.

Pretty tasty spot.

The employees were very attentive and helpful, even as I came screeching in 5 minutes before close. 

Some of the burritos we ordered looked like they were alternating sizes - even though we all got the same size.

All in all - it's high on the list of places to eat for the Meridian Area.

Burritos - delicious
Churros - Excellent
HORCHATA - Well, it was normal horchata.

One of my favorite gas stations / convenient stores to stop into. Always super clean and very good variety of drinks and snacks and u can even pick up sushi from local places and papa Murphys pizza's. They also have an amazing self service soda machine and a good selection for your beer guys to fill up your growlers. They even have a drive thru is you just want a quick in and out. It's almost like the actual gas station is an after thought do to the oil change bays and car wash and full service detail they offer. And they also fill propane. Even though there usually pretty busy service is always fast and I applaud them for making exits a little ways away for the actual store this way u get no backups going in and you can always get out and going in the direction u need.. please build more

I really love this place! The value for the price is amazing. I enjoy the atmosphere, almost all of the staff is usually really kind and helpful (sometimes quiet or reserved, but never mean), and the entire inside of the store is in pristine condition. 

My favorite are the acai bowls, I haven't tried the pitaya or the coconut bowls yet. I have gotten many of their juices and they've all been really good. I like that they use glass jars and they provide a small discount if you return the jars to them.

I've got to give these guys 5 stars, and here's why...  having never tried Boise Fry Company before, I had a hard time making sense of the menu.  The guy at the register who greeted me, took the time to explain everything to me.  From the different types of patties, burger styles, sauces to the different types of fries...  all explained.  I chose to try the "funguy" patty which is part beef, part mushroom to which I added Swiss cheese...  delicious!!!  I chose the gold potato which was perfectly fried and salted.  Yum!  I'll definitely be back!  The whole thing was produced promptly and with a smile detected under the mask!  The only thing I'd recommend is asking for extra napkins... you'll need them if you're taking it to go like I did.

I used Molly Maids in the past, but discontinued their services because I wanted a detail clean and I wasn't getting that.
After a couple of years I decided to try again, thinking that maybe I was too picky.  They came to clean today (I called ahead and they knew I needed an excellent job done because I have a vow renewal at my house tomorrow).  In one hour they claimed they were done.  There was trash left in 2 cans, my leather furniture didn't get dusted or wiped down.  There were 2 dead flies left on the windowsill in my living room.  They weren't going to change the sheets until I asked and then the top sheet was put on backwards and the decorative pillows laid in a pile on the floor.  They said they wipe the fronts of cabinets, but there were makeup fingerprints left in the bathroom. My laundry room was never touched.  The hallway floor had dirt and debris left. . . so it wasn't touched.  No cob webs dusted.  No baseboards were touched.  I'm furious.  So while getting ready for this big family event. . . . I get to clean my house.  
NOTE:  They did offer to come back out and do it again. . . . like I have time for that?  Why should they have to come back?  On my last clean they had to come twice too.  I'm in every way VERY UNHAPPY!!!!
This tiny place has such great coffee, service and vibe. I got The Briar Patch and loved it. Will definitely be going back!!

First time stopping by Gramercy Park Pizza and Grill and I'm glad we did!  

Great business casual atmosphere with community seating in the bar yet the place does not invade personal space. Service was a bit slow to start, however, was very welcoming.  

Fish & Chips ... Amazing!  Finally a chef who's not afraid to fry to deep GBD (golden brown and delicious) and use a hefty hand with sea salt.  The thin batter held a crispy exterior from the first bite to the last.  Fresh fries and crunchy slaw rounded out lunch.  

Can't wait to try a few other items on the menu.  There was a pretty good looking charcuterie board that passed by out of the kitchen. I guess that's next on the list.

A great Church that preaches & teaches the Truth of the Bible. 
They're making a powerful impact in & Meridian & around the world. 
Through Compassion International, TMCC has changed the lives of over 400 kids in Ecuador. And their Celebrate Recovery program is helping local folks overcome addictions. 
Check out one of their Sunday worship services at 9, 10:30, 12, 4:30 or 6.

Great family run business, with amazing food and customer service. Best Cuban sandwiches I have ever had and their Antigua Breakfast is so flavorful and mouthwatering. Finish your breakfast or lunch with their delicious guava pastry!  I highly recommend this quaint coffee shop.
Great burger, generous amount of fries and free fry sauce.  The soda even seemed to taste better.

Idaho seems to be a mecca for doughnut shops. They pop up here by the dozen! (Pun intended)

The newest one to rise is called Duck Donuts. Im not a big donut fan, but we got a flyer in the mail offering a free donut and a breakfast sandwich for a dollar. I cant resist truing new things and even more so I love me a deal, so off my wife and I went.

Duck is in the village by chipolte. The donuts are cake and not traditional yeast. They are all made to order, but fortunately, they have a lot of flyers around with suggestions on them of donuts combos they have come up with.

The cake itself was pretty light and not dense like I expected. They look amazing, but unfortunately, the taste does not even come close to the look.

The best one for me was the chocolate iced. The rest were just ok. My wife had a coffee. Im not a coffee drinker, so I have to rely here on here evaluation. She would not give me a lot to go on. She just said it was not good and thew it out. 

They shorted us 2 donuts, and overcharged us. We would up spending over $20 for 6 donuts, a bad coffee, and an ok breakfast sandwich. They also ran out of batter while we were there which meant we waited for quite a while before our donuts came out.

As a former GM, when mistakes like this happened, that were our fault, I would either comp the  customers order or give them a good discount. You only have 1 chance to make a good 1st impression on your customers. Especially when you are 3 weeks old. 


I am pretty sure that we wont be back.

We ordered both plate lunches (1 pork and 1 Beef).  Nice sized portions, really great flavor and an excellent value.  The fast friendly service from the owners completes the experience.  We love Hawaiian style food and this truck reminds us of being on the islands!

Disappointing. They forgot my mother's meal after 45 minutes of waiting for food to come out. I can understand if it was busy and backed up but they weren't. On top of that, our food was cold. Prices aren't worth it. Food doesn't taste good. It's way worth going to the griddle than this place. No one came to apologize that one of our meals was forgotten. I've never been so frustrated with a place before. Honestly, I should give this place a one star review but the fries made that extra star.

I bought a Coleman home 3 years ago. While at design center, I paid for a solid wood door. I was thinking of my family's safety. Feeling safe all these years, because I had a dead bolt wooden door. I came home yesterday to the attached picture my solid wood door a a center that was made of wood and held in by tiny finishing nails. No wood glue nothing but it was a upgrade that I paid dearly for. Thank God we were gone at the time of the robbery. What if this was a home invasion. We would be been hopeless. Oh many others paid for an upgraded door that's not going to give them any protection?

First time at a Dutch brothers coffee and I was gifted a free drink for that very reason!  I chose the baileys Irish creme one in the hot and was delighted!  I've found my new go to coffee place!  Buh bye Starbucks!

Argh... they won't let me post until I add something...

This place is so good.  The service was wonderful. We had Sherrora as our waitress and she was so sweet and funny and very helpful with her recommendations. We used to eat at the Broken Yolk in San Diego.  We were so excited that they opened here in Meridian.  The corporate trainers were there helping and training and we got to meet the owner.  It was really nice to talk to them all being from our hometown.  There was one omelet  that I used to get in San Diego (The John Wayne Omelet) that they didn't have on their menu.  But.. being the wonderful and accommodating staff that they are; they made it for me.  The flavors were still the same and sooooooo good. It has chili, cheese,mushrooms and onions and I asked to add fresh sliced jalapeños.   My husband was able to try two different kinds of eggs Benedict and the kids had their crunchy French toast with raspberry sauce and My son ordered from the kids menu.  You really need to try this place.  It was super clean, the staff are all wearing masks and the tables were perfectly spaced for social distancing.  I heard a couple of great things from the staff which make me feel like they have a great management team. It speaks volumes when the staff has tried the food.  It makes it easy for the staff to help customers when they have specific questions about flavors and ingredients. Can't wait to go back to try new things.  Oh yeah, They also have a dozen egg omelette challenge.

I've been having Madison wax my eyebrows all year. She does her job very well! So friendly and kind too.
This shop is top-notch! It's always been a pleasure.
The service was amazing, they took time on my nails and made sure they were exactly how I liked them. They were so friendly which i haven't experienced much as nail salons. I recommend!!
The best two words to describe Mi Casa, Never Again. Dirty,horrible service and WAY overpriced. It's a shame because it actually was good for a while.

I love that they have Dole Pineapple, just like the Dolewhip at Disneyland. They have raspberry syrup to add too, which at Disneyland I get the pineapple raspberry whip. Just bring your Tajin and you're good to go! All of the flavors they carry are delicious. Love the variety of toppings and syrups available. Baked goods are behind the glass display, and are another tempting delight. The place is always clean. They have gloves for you to wear while getting your frozen yogurt. Employees have always been friendly and pleasant as well. Don't forget to sign up for your points to get free frozen yogurt in the future! To the manager: please keep the Dole pineapple flavor year round!

Rigid, inflexible and non responsive.
"Our rules are our rules!" I'm the client and if you (Molly Maid)
cannot accommodate my simple request then I will go elsewhere. 
No follow up as promised so I will cancel.
THAT'S WHAT I DID.
I started interviewing other cleaning services and every one of them
could give me the service I wanted. I'm a real estate agent and will
share my complete displeasure with other agents. Their attitude is unacceptable.

I can't believe I never submitted a review for GPPG...  I'm in Boise fairly often for work, but on the last trip, I stayed in Meridian, instead of Boise.  That meant driving around new areas and finding new gems, like this one!  It was near my hotel, so I stopped to check it out, and it is now my favorite place in Idaho!  

I was trying to watch what I eat, so the first couple visits, I managed to steer myself toward the salads, but I couldn't resist everything else for very long.  The salads were great, but let's face it...  Even a great salad is a salad, so let's talk about the real stuff:   all of the pies I tried were fantastic, but I'd have to say the GPPG was my favorite.  The chorizo really pushes it over the top.  If sandwiches are more your thing, then go with the Gramercy.  Pot roast, corned beed, fries and slaw!  So messy, but oh, so worth it.  And can't avoid mentioning the Crabber Tots...  I mean, come on...  tater tots, right?  Not the most elegant dish in the world..   Tater tots with crab, bacon, cheddar, and smoked corn?  Damn, now I'm hungry again...
Great coffee! I had an oatmilk ice latte and it was excellent. Great service too. Thank you very much!

We just discovered The Broken Yoke about a month ago and what a discovery!  On our first visit my husband and I had their split flavored Eggs Benedict.  It was incredible and I practically licked my plate clean because the unique hollandaise sauces made them so unique!  The second time we went my husband had the Cinnamon Roll Pancakes and I had the Avocado Toast with poached eggs, both winners.  Next time we are going Mexican and trying their many versions of Mexican breakfast delights!  It's a great restaurant with cheerful servers!

Super disappointed in Molly Maid right now. I tried to re-schedule a cleaning because my moving date got changed, and they told me with the late notice (over 24 hours notice) that I would be charged a $100 fee. And since I have cancelled a cleaning before (within their cancellation time frame) the manager told me that they would no longer allow me to receive cleaning service from them anymore. Very sad that I am being charged and not allowed to reschedule my cleaning service. Especially because I use them every time I move, and use them for my rental properties as well. The last time I hired them, they had to come back and clean the home again because it was a mess, and I decided to give them another chance. Super disappointed.

None of that is true, I was absolutely told that if it was cleaned I would receive my deposit back.  
He took pictures and said it was very clean and that we'd only be charged for light bulbs and oven liners. I'd really like to see the pictures he too, funny how they aren't being provided. 
Ive heard many stories of deposit fraud but I really didn't think they were true I felt I'd get my money back, it was left spotless, we never caused problems and paid the rent early. 
This could have been prevented, we could have at least met half way and split the $120 for the cleaning, no way in heck your cleaning person had to spend more than an  hour doing whatever she had to do. 
I was also told that I had to use your vendor to clean carpets and that should be illegal because if I have to pay I should be able to use whoever I want, I did have connections with a carpet cleaning company that was half your price. 
As far as the pool issues, we did bring this up to Hannah, I had to go in there because my mail was being put in the wrong box which happened on 3 different occasions and she talked to the mail carrier and after 2 days I got my mail back. I went in their to find out if there was a lost and found because my son left his flip flops there one day and a towel. I was told that there is no lost and found. While speaking to another tenant at the pool she mentioned that you guys do a morning check of the grounds and throw away anything that was left. Just my opinion but you should really have a lost and found, we were there until the pool closed at 10:00 pm, I went back at 9:15 the next morning when I realized he left them there and they were already gone.

I tried this again recently in hopes for a better experience. The place is really nice also very nice staff. It took me 3 tries to finally pick something they hadn't ran out of on the menu. Seems like I may be going at the wrong times. 

I ordered the vanilla ice cream with a chocolate shell, topped with Oreo's!

Why can't you give no stars or at least a .5 if they can have a 1.5 a .5 is better suited for this slime ball agency and that's being nice. We've lived at a property for a year now. One time we changed the account we used to pay rent the day the system allows us and because of their issues not ours, we were charged a late fee ($145 I believe). Seperate note, they said we had till the 18th of our ending month of lease to decide if we were staying or going. We tried to call, email for over a week and a half w/ no response. They called us the day after it was too late and said "we must leave by the first!" Company calls us a few days later and says there's been a mistake you have till the 15th due to the family not being able to move in, though we wanted to stay originally! Then they send us a nasty email and call us saying they made a mistake and must be out by the first because a mother and children are moving in. We literally just bought over $200 in groceries and now we have 48 hours to move out by the first? Well we called complained they said "sorry nothing they cam do, we need to be out!" So we lost the grocerys, had to call out sick and it's been almost a week and nobodys moved in. This company will ignore you, not respond to calls or emails. But has no problem sending you an email that's trashy, unprofessional and simply rude. I hope they soon go out of business they've put our lives upside down and not sure the reason but greed, ignorance and bad business practices!!! Terribble staff, rude customer service and please do yourselves a favor and STAY AWAY!!!

Definitely in my top two favorites for Fast Food burgers! One of the best fast burgers I've had in Boise. The fries are also amazing - shoestring style which I am a fan of. Best fry sauce I've ever had! I wish I could stock up on it. The burger patty had so much flavor! We are huge fans and will definitely return. The only problem we had was that they forgot the top bun on my burger - but they were slammed and I know how the food industry goes.

What a joke! We picked Coleman Homes based on their "custom model home" shown to us by a local realtor. We were captivated by the way it was explained we could choose all our custom finishes and how the craftsmanship of the home was sold as top notch. NOT the case. Start from the beginning, customer service is terrible, design gallery is not explained and the options unless you want to overpay are quite minimal. The build has gone far from according to plan starting with day 1 dig! They failed to mention the giant utility box that would block our driveway and when WE noticed and brought the their atttention we were brushed off. Now maybe if they had actually met with us on site like most builders this could have been avoided. It went downhill from there. Here we are nearing the end with an excessive list of repairs that need to be done in order to justify the outrageous sales price and make it move in ready. Which of course I'm being hounded to hurry and close no doubt so they can omit fixing the bu**shit job they did. Stay away.

This place proves that just because something looks good does not mean it tastes good!!! I've been GF for many years now and am used to a different texture in those type of products, but this was just wrong. Imagine taking a cupcake, putting it in the fridge, and running it under water.  Skip the prices here unless your idea of a donut is a cold, wet, sticky food-like product with the aftertaste of toothpaste!

Love Mountain Timber . The coffee is good and fresh but the staff is the memorable part. They are always quick, friendly and generally welcoming in a time where this seems hard to find. It's the only coffee shop I need.

After putting up with the loud noise of our garage door opener for over a year, we decided to have a quieter unit install.
Action was recommended and we're happy we selected them.
Brad came out, gave us a very reasonable quote to replace our new but loud unit, and scheduled an installation the same week.
Brad did the install himself, arriving right on time, and did it in good time all the while being informative & friendly.
After 5 months the door (not the motor that he installed) began making a bang on occasion upon opening the door.  I called today to schedule an appointment to fix it and was given a window for tomorrow morning. The person I spoke with was very polite and had a fun sense of humor while quickly getting me set up.
I would recommend this company without reservation!

I just had the regular poke bowl with raw tuna and an order of spring rolls. The spring rolls were not crispy and were soggy. The poke bowl smelled like strong fish right when I took the lid off and it tasted not good at all (not fresh). I couldn't even finish it. Very sad because it was pretty pricey. I wouldn't order again from Pole Bowl.

The owner is freaking hilarious and seems like he's doing what he loves. It's always nice to see that in a world full of franchises and multi national corporations. Thanks you for doing what you do, wish there were 10 more of you nearby
Only drive through open right now..but hubby The New Yorker and I got The Rockefeller Reuben. Huge portions. We had 1/2  for lunch half for dinner
Got the Carne Assassin. It was ok, but didn't feel great later, but probably more of a me problem. Nothing groundbreaking, but worth trying and seeing if you like it.
The best poke in the treasure valley! Comparable to the best poke in Las Vegas. Staff is very kind and it's a family run business.

My buddy and I just came home from a 3200 mile trip and this is the 2nd trip I had to stop in High Desert Harley with a mechanical problem.  Once in 2017 and again this year.  Both trips they went out of their way to get us back on the road, even though they were clearly busy.  The staff in all the departments are super friendly and helpful.  This is by far my favorite dealership.
Great spot for breakfast/lunch. Good service m and great food. Wait was a little long, but that was due to the Corona sham mandates, every other table was closed.

Dr. Hanson is amazing. I had been dealing with a knee injury from basketball that previous doctors and physical therapists told me it was all in my head because they couldn't find any reason for why my knee was hurting. When I visited Dr. Hanson, not only did he make my back feel a lot better, but he figured out that the reason for my knee issue was because of some issues with my hips not being properly aligned. He fixed the problem and I no longer have knee pain after years of dealing with it. He is so good that once I moved to Mountain Home, I still commuted to Meridian each month for treatment. I highly recommend him.

Long wait at the drive through and no one there. Made order and waited again.
Not hot but cold and potato salad was the worst.
Wont be trying this place again.

I stopped by "Fit Donut" this sunny Saturday morning. (I discovered them through Instagram.) The owners emphasize "high protein, low fat, low carb, [and] low sugar". LCHF majors on low-carb, high-fat, and moderate meat. Still, with only 3-9 carbs per donut, I can enjoy these as an occasional treat.

I was not expecting a perfect low-carb food, but these come pretty darn close! We cut them into small pieces so that I could sample my 7 selections. While no substitute sweetener will completely mimic table sugar, my sugar-eating husband and son found these treats to be tasty. I'm sugar-free and I thought the sweetness was perfect -- not overwhelming.

Selling Points
- High protein, Low fat, Low carb, Low sugar!
- Healthy alternative to processed pre-packaged snacks!
- Made with fresh "clean" ingredients.
.
Main Ingredients
- Almond milk
- Cashew milk
- Almond Flour
- Spelt Flour
- Coconut Flour
- Whey Protein (which contains milk products and soy products)
- Gluten Free Oats
- Stevia
- Honey
- Powdered Peanut Butter
- Cocoa Powder
- Sprinkles
- Sea Salt
Pick up was easy cake was delicious can't ask for more ... I could go with out as much frosting as they use but it's easy to scrape off.

Had the Reuben, do not try this. Nasty!!! Dried Rye, crunchy Corned Beef and some unusual sauce. I would not try this again.  I did appreciate the homemade chips up front but would be better with a dipping sauce. The sweet potato fries need a unique dipping sauce as well. Served plain on the plate isn't the way to go. I have been here a couple of times, had a burger before. Seems the route to go, however this night was not that good.

Every single bill we've gotten from them we have to call because they messed up. They do not seem to be able to bill a primary and a supplemental insurance company. For 4 months I have been unable to get a bill straightened out from work done 6 months before.  I feel like they are either waiting for me to get tired of fighting with them and pay it out of pocket or for it to go to collections so a collection company is bothering me.

My burger fell apart after the first bite due to a cold stale bun! I had to take my burger back because they forgot the bacon I ordered on the side. I ate the beef only and it was cold inside! Fries were good.

Nice coffee shop right on Chinden. In addition to coffee they have wine, beer, canned soda, Italian soda, smoothies, tea, and food items such as muffins, breakfast burritos, cookies, hummus. I got a vegan breakfast burrito from the cold case that they warmed it up for me. And also a sugar cookie and canned soda for my son. The burrito was good but I probably wouldn't order it again because it had too many green peppers and onions for my liking. 

Lots of seating available. I was attending a group meet up so we sat at two tables joined together that seat up to 10 people. You can also reserve this table for a specific time. 

There is a little room towards the back that is for kids to play in if they get bored. It has books, a coin arcade game, chalk board with chalk, and magnet board with letter magnets. 

Staff is friendly, welcoming, and fast. Masks are optional. Drive through available.

I had a tasty, fresh burrito ultimo with chicken.  The chips and salsa included were good.  The burrito itself was fine but not otherwise outstanding.  Service was speedy.

Inside, the tables are spaced apart as per COVID standards but the employees made no effort to clean them while I was there.  I asked for the one in the corner to be cleaned and the cashier wiped the surface with a rag on the counter.  She seemed depressed and left the stools dirty.  If there was disinfectant on the rag I would be surprised.

This is the last of the Baja Fresh's in the Boise area.  I used to like them for their salsa bar.  I only hope that this review wakes up the owner to re-engage the staff, energize it as a highly disinfected place to get carryout (spray and wipe the door handles, counters, tables...) or eat-in, and survive the pandemic.

Highly recommend. Our first time was last night and I got the pollo a la crema and my husband got the Mi Casa Plate. This pollo a la crema was delicious. It was light, yet creamy and tart yet salty. So the perfect balance and really good with the house made tortillas. My husband chose the plate because of the other reviews we saw and so that he could try multiple items. Also really good. The carne asada had great flavor and wasn't too tough or chewy. 
The restaurant was clean and the tables were a good distance apart. I also could tell that they sanitized the menus, which made me feel a little more comfortable. The service was good and the employees were kind and helpful. This will definitely be a new staple for us.

PSA..
HomeRiver Group is the WORST property management place. 
We had our townhouse in nampa professionally cleaned. Also did a walk through after it was done. Well they said we had animal hair in the carpet and dead flies on the window sill.. also urine all over the toilets. 
I can't even leave a review on their page so hopes someone will come across this post! 
ALSO we didn't have any pets for there to be any animal hair! 
They charged far too much for carpet cleaning on your lease so be aware. They just love to take your money. They are also the worst when it came to communicating. I went through 3 different managers while we had our townhouse. I wonder why people leave that company..I would be embarrassed to say I work for this company. AVOID HOMERIVER

It's Starbucks so what are you really expecting? It's the customer service that makes the difference at each individual location. What I really like about this location being next to a Dutch Brothers it's typically pretty easy to get in-and-out of quickly. And you don't have to listen to the music blaring & a conversation about nothing when all you want is COFFEE.
Mmmmm!!! Perfect summer dessert, or ANYTIME dessert for that matter. We travel 30 minutes to get here, and it is SO WORTH IT!!!
Great spot for lunch. Have tried their pizzas, sandwiches, salads, all are amazing! Servers are always super friendly too!

Top quality delicious burgers at a reasonable price. Served with a smile. Enough fries for a small army. I love that they serve blue Powerade along with regular soda options. They are very good at accommodating food sensitivities. Lots of scrumptious toppings to choose from. Definitely recommend this place.

I love the menu and food here. I especially like the ability to order 2 different types of eggs Benedict. The employees are also friendly and fairly efficient. Minus 1 star for not staffing well enough at peak times, so there is a wait for both ordering and food. Also, on one of those times, there were 2 employees at the hostess area talking (during a brief lull in customers coming through the door), and I thought at least 1 of them could be helping in another area

This is the worst apartment management I have ever worked with!
 
The apartment was disgusting when we were trying to move in: Food all over the microwave, hairs all over the bathroom, Ramen Noodles in the cupboard,  nasty carpet with glass chunks.  When we asked management about it we were told the cleaning crew would be reprimanded and that the carpets had been shampooed.  
I hired a cleaning crew and rented a carpet cleaner myself.  There was no way a cleaning crew had been there before.  This is how I got to spend the week of my wedding....

There were also times where we charged random fees with our payment for things that were not specified in our contract; such as not writing our name on the check.  

When we reported maintenance needs the took months to be fixed.  

I do not recommend working with this company.

I've seen the same dentist my entire life, but recently moved to the area and had to find a new one. I was a little nervous about the experience, but everyone there was super friendly and helpful. It had been a while since my last visit due to the move. They explained everything they were seeing and provided options to me without pressuring me into any decisions. They were able to fill cavities that day and the dentist made sure I was comfortable through the process. I really appreciated the way she worked with me to understand my issues and ensure that I was okay with everything. I will definitely be visiting again and continuing my long term care with this practice.

I love trying a new flavor of entree each week.
The ingredients sound so good together that it is hard to choose just one.

Way too expensive!

I got a corned beef on rye.  It was OK, not great.  But when it costs $12 for 1 sandwich it should have tasted great.
My wife got a pastrami sandwich.  She said it was OK too.  
It would be a good restaurant if they cut their prices by 1/4-1/3.  Way too expensive for us valley residents.

Food tasted old and definitely not fresh.  The carne asada tasted like over flavored beef jerky.  Chips were nearly burnt and queso did not taste good at all.  Very disappointed. Won't be back.  Worst food I have had in months.

My hamburger was tasty, however the meat on my double patty burger was very thin.  So next time I will order the triple patty burger.

My granddaughter ordered a hot dog with only catchup on it and she loved it! 

We also had desserts.  She had the mid sized Dirt and Worms Sundae :)   And I had a chocolate concrete with oreo cookie crumbles.  Absolutely delicious!

There were many staff available and they were ready and helpful.  Some appeared to be new and in training.  It appears they were doing a good job of training them.  We will be back for more!

I took my 4 year old son here for a haircut because my husband goes here and the kids salon we used to go to closed down. My husband has taken my son here before and he has done fine. The stylist we had was very unprofessional and just plain rude from the start. My son is scared of the clippers but can usually calm down once we get started. For the first 5 minutes when she would try to start he would shrug hid shoulders up and she would say she can't do this. I said he doesn't like clippers, so what do you suggest. She went at it and muttered the whole time with nasty comments like "this is ridiculous" and "suck it up, life's not fair" to my 4 year old. I have never had a stylist that acted like this before
 She either hates kids or hates her job and it is very evident to her customers. We won't be coming back.

First time I have used their service today. They arrived on time, worked for the full two hours, and did a nice job. The house smells great! 

I appreciated that they took out the garbage, changed the sheets on the bed, and left a little candy and card. It's a nice personal touch. I also appreciated that they brought their own supplies, including vacuum.

The ladies were polite, courteous, and worked efficiently. In a nutshell, I would call them again. I also liked that I could do a "one time clean" sort of deal and that they were available on fairly short notice.

I've never taken the time before to post a review about any business.  So the fact that I'm doing it now reflects on the sincerity of my entry.  To put this in perspective, let me say up front I'm a neat freak, I admit it.  I've had house cleaning services in the past and experienced average to adequate  service.  But no one cleans as thoroughly as I do; until now.  

When I met with the representative of Molly Maids I was impressed with the high level of professionalism.  We spent ample time going over my home, discussing expectations.  When it came to the bid, I was pleased but frankly a little skeptical.  To get that much accomplished in the time allotted, for the price we agreed on was ambitious.  

I've been a satisfied customer since the first cleaning.  They did what they promised to do, when they were supposed to do it.  And they followed up to see if it was done right.  My home was clean(or if I was brutally honest, cleaner than it was when I did the work).  They set a schedule for cleaning that fit my needs.  And on one occasion I happened to come home while the crew was in the house so I had an opportunity to meet them.  They reflected the management's concept of professionalism.  

Sometimes, when you've had an exceptional dining experience, you're reluctant to pass that on because you never know if it will be consistent.  After several months of having my home cleaned by these folks, I'm totally comfortable recommending them.  I know they will replicate my service for anyone.  

Dennis
In Eagle, ID
Nice people but very slow service and cold food served both times I tried.  I so want this place to be good but honestly, I can't say they are yet.  I might try a third and update if it changes.

Wonderful spot! 

If you're looking for a hot yoga studio, look no further. Authentic Yoga has a nice mix of classes and times, a clean space, and great vibes. 

Amanda Mendez was very welcoming, provided clear cues and challenging sequences, and a calming presence.

You can walk in, book ahead on the Mind Body app or reserve a spot using ClassPass.

Parking is easy in the lot out front.

I'm so happy that I've found my go to spot for hot yoga in Meridian.  I highly recommend that you try them out!

This place is great. A VERY convenient location for me, and the staff could not possibly be more helpful.

Highly recommend.

Stopped here on way to Washington in afternoon of 6/23.   Pleasant environment partly because there's no drive-through.    Clean. Friendly.  AND this was the best teriyaki we've ever had. Didn't even need sauce.  Yum!

Top notch friendly servfice from everyone in this store, the very nice guy who is manager and all on the floor and behind the counter.  Although I  lived in Seattle way back in the day when Sur La Table was launched there as first location and we shopped at Sur La Table in Berkeley when we lived near there for many years and once in a while popped into the SLT in Potland, I have become more a Williams Sonoma shopper in the last twenty.  Now I move Meridian's SLT into first place for local kitchen items shopping for great service leading the way.. 

FANTASTIC CUSTOMER SERVICE
The quality of service here is the differentiating factor for why we would go back here over Boise located Williams Sonoma.   The people here make it special.  They could answer our questions and make feature /  function recommendations from things as simple as potato ricers ($30) to espresso makers ($1300) under consideration for a new kitchen.  The latter discussion even came with a demo and a free espresso to boot.

We popped in to pick up one small thing as we had time to spare before meeting friends for lunch.  We walked out with a shopping bag full of treasures.  It was the service that led us to want to do that and the fact that the store was easy to shop in.

EASY TO NAVIGATE:
The space  is well laid out with ample room in between aisles, it is brightly li, well organized and the ambiance is welcoming.  I hope they can keep it that way has some Sur La Table stores, Portland''s Pearl as example, are nearly impossible for getting through the aisles...which means I leave.  

PRICES:
Prices are on par with their competition for similar kitchen tools and items.  Some food products are also carried here and you'll likely pay quite a bit more here than other retailers for similar items. (We comparison shopped, for example, the brand of organic California Olive Oil we often buy as well as a specific salt we use and both were a good 40% more here than what we pay at the CoOp.)

COOKING CLASSES:
Cooking classes are offered  in a roomy, state of the art kitchen.  They are not inexpensive, most it seems around $69 / each.  But they are hands on, last 2 to 2 1/ 2 hours and you get to eat what you cook at the end of class.  (Plus they do the dishes.  Nice!)  A class schedule is published for the current month and the one upcoming. You can pick up copies in the store or likely find them online too.
