And it seems in Meridian right now, given the store is newly opened, some of the regularly priced at $69 classes are being offered for under $10 as "special offers".  (As you might imagine, those filled up fast.)  

UNIQUE GIFT IDEA:
Gift certificates are available for the cooking classes.  With classes from knife skills to macaron baking to soups to "date night" meals, there is something for every cook or wannabe.

ACCESSIBILITY:
Level in and throughout.  Ample space between aisles for ADA compliance.  Works as well for the mom pushing a stroller inside or an older gentleman using a wheelchair, both of whom were shoppers and buyers on the day of our visit.

LOCATION:
In The Village Mall in Meridian (right across from Grimaldi's and the fountain) that mall seems a love it or hate it locale.  So that is what it is.

While resting w my very pregnant daughter in law, we decided  to order food for lunch. How can you pass up a hotdog? I actually told my daughter in law it's pretty hard to mess up a hotdog but I guess I'm wrong! Our order was completely botched which we took in stride. When you're hungry as long as it tastes good I am an easy critic. I can excuse quite a bit especially in this day and age but this? My chili dog looked like it was from last night. Chili dried on w no cheese. Each hotdog looked dried up with hardly any condiments. I'd love to try again just out of guilty pleasure love of hotdogs but...

I switched locations to follow my waxer Laura. Just like the other European Wax Center, this location also does not disappoint. 

European Wax Center offers so many different waxing services, there is something for everyone! Male or female. To be honest... I didn't realize hair grew in so many places haha! 

They also offer a variety of products to help prevent ingrown hairs, sunless tanners, make up, etc.. they are also very good with last minute add one if time allows (as much notice is always appreciated though). 

If you've been on the fence about trying waxing, I would give European Wax Center a try. Laura is my gal and she is awesome. However, just from my experience with this company, they would not hire anyone who wasn't awesome. 

I had a little bit of a hard time finding it at first, but it is right next to the Baskin Robins near the Fred Meyers.
Hands down the best breakfast I've ever had!!! Menu has a large variety of sweet and Harty meals. Hash browns are to die for. I had the Hash skillet,  OMG! Put this place on your bucket list.

This was my first time here. I wanted to try 2 different drinks. So I got the dark chocolate breve blended and the Nighthawk, which is Mexican mocha and caramel, iced. 

Kaylee was working and she gave me great recommendations, she was extremely kind, hard working and moved fast. Both drinks that she made tasted DELICIOUS. She also spoke very highly of the owners and the business itself. I would come back here and recommend this place off of her alone.

Thank you!!!

Most of the instructors are great and most of the classes are really informative. We have found that some instructors are our favorite (ahem, Elizabeth Strong is the best!), but all have a lot of expert history and experience. The classes are a little pricey, but they go on sale at half price several times throughout the year - so just sign up for email notifications and do a half price class if you're concerned about price. I check the schedule regularly, my daughter has loved doing some of the week-long kid's classes and I've never had a bad experience. We continue to make some of the recipes we learned in class at home later. We've probably done at least 10 cooking classes at this location and two down in Salt Lake City.

I was driving near the location and my sister texted me... if you are near Duck Donuts ...drop some cash. They donated a dozen donuts to each floor of the hospital at St. Luke's (Meridian) during the pandemic. We went in. Super bubbly environment. Designed for your eye and nose. Greeted warmly by the man who I later learned is the part-owner. I was a bit negative ("just cake donuts?" No buttermilk bars? ). He weathered my vibe, had the staff make me a taster. Explained the process, didn't appear rushed (sorry to the lady and her 2 daughters behind us - but - I shared the taster as she was a first timer as well).
Long story. Then we made it home. Made coffee. And started cutting donuts into 1/4s. The texture of the cake donuts ... flavors were/are worth your experience!
I also want to compliment the young staff members who have been working there for 2 months. Great eye contact, manners and we watched them make their donut art. Todd, we'll be back!
Amazing food and service...love the mimosa flight! Get it every time. Sydney was great!

It's alright. Nothing amazing. One nice thing is it's open late night.

Teenage workers can be AMAZING. But some teenagers still need a lot of training and supervision. Good grief, during my visit the girl taking my order was so rude. After I ordered, I sat down and looked over the menu again to see if I missed anything. I noticed from the menu that you can pick a seasoning for the fries.

She brought out the fries and then I asked her for one of the seasonings. Geez, you should have seen the disdain on her face. You would have thought I was asking her to wash/wax my car. I didn't understand the reluctance. I thought maybe it's a special season that had to be applied while it was being cooked. Trying to understand her reluctance, I asked, is it just seasoning that you sprinkle on top? She said yes... she stood there like I was speaking Japanese. I said, can I have some please? She walked back to the kitchen with sass as she held my basket of fries and her coworker gave a few shakes. Good grief. I would put it on myself. She wouldn't have made an additional trip if she would have asked what seasoning I wanted in the first place (I told her it was my first time there).

So in sum. The food is just OK. The sassy/rude worker knocked down the whole experience for me. No place I am real eager to go back to..

Amazing staff.  Amazing selection of services. My 85 year old dad has had some terrible dental care in the past.  At his age , quality of life is our mantra. They are so invested in providing exactly what works towards our goal, but nothing unnecessary.  He has had several falls, and this staff , from the boss on down, makes sure he is carefully handled from the time we enter the parking lot till we leave.  Absolutely everyone is so friendly and caring. The facility is immaculate and has everything needed on site.   How did we pick this office you ask?  Believe it or not, they were on the Humana list of recommended providers.
I would give zero stars if I could. They unlawfully charge their tenants for repairs the tenants didn't cause and for normal wear and tear.

We ordered out and was happy to get our food.  But after tasting it, bland and canned gravy.  Omelettes have cheese right? Nope guess not.  Have to order that extra.  Over all not good food.  Sorry but we have much better places in the area.

Holy freaking goodness. When I opened the plate, my mouth dropped. I can honestly say this is the BEST Hawaiian food I've had in Idaho. I've lived all over the state, and this food truck takes the cake for me. The portion is ridiculous. I have no problem finishing plates, but I had leftovers with this one. Everything is killer. It seriously tastes like I'm at a family party eating foods that I picked from the buffet line. SI cannot believe it took me this long to discover Chowobunga!

If I could eat here every day, I would! I typically get the yellowtail regular bowl with brown rice. They were out of yellowtail so I asked  the guy behind the counter to make a recommendation  based on what I typically order. He gave me a mix of tuna and salmon and it was EVEN BETTER than my normal order! It was so good. The staff is consistent and friendly, so there is never variation in my excellent experiences there. Best poke around!

Yes, this is an ok spot for a casual meal.  Is it the best burger around?  Not hardly!

We were met by a very enthusiastic employee who helped us through the choices.  There are lots of choices, all the way down to what kind of salt you want on your food.  I really don't think I need to tell them a dozen things I want on or done to my burger.  Waste of time.

We both had beef burgers, but there are a few other meats from which to choose.   One burger got the normal russet fries (from a choice of 6 different potato types), one got the Brussel sprouts with maple bacon jam.  That was a really good choice.  

The fries were not life-altering as some ridiculous reviewers have suggested.  One burger was requested as the extra hot with habaneros mixed with seasonal berries.  Good heat and very tasty.

If you never had an In-N-Out, you don't know that a Boise Fry Company burger is really not a great burger.  This ranks way down on the burger scale in the Treasure Valley, especially for the price - ugh.

Dr. B is always so wonderful with my girls. We've been seeing him since my oldest, now 6 was 12 months and we won't be going anywhere else anytime soon. He is always warm and welcoming as is his staff. He never pressures our family to do anything we're not comfortable with (the reason we left our first ped). Dr. B respects us as parents and our decisions to vaccinate or not and on whatever schedule we choose. Anytime our girls have been sick we've been seen same day, without any problems. Although same day appointments don't guarantee a visit with Dr. B all of the staff is loving and knowledgeable. Thank you for providing our family with such outstanding care MFM!

I really like Fred Meyer. Right after the produce section is a nice sized organic and health food section that also has lots of vegan choices as well as gluten-free choices. I am able to find a lot of vegan food that my local Walmart does not carry. And then right after the health food section is an aisle of bulk foods and then after that is all of the wine and they have a good selection. Everyone is always very friendly and helpful at Fred Meyer as well. If you sign up for a free club card with Fred Meyer you will also receive some discounts on groceries. The only thing that would make it better is if their curbside pick up was free like Walmart instead of a five dollar fee.

My son and husband both get their haircut from John and/or Brenda.  They both do a wonderful job.  There are usually a couple people waiting, but it doesn't take long and is worth the wait.  Their price is very reasonable as well.  They are wonderful, nice people who offer service with a smile.  As far as the person who was pissed off that they couldn't get a haircut for their kids because the barber had a doctors appointment, I think that rather cruel as he is fighting cancer.  He may have had an unexpected appointment.  Did you really have to write a negative review and bring down their rating because  you were THAT inconvenienced?

Rarely provide reviews unless they are good but my experience is broad and would not want others to encounters these situations.  Have a 12 year old home and spent $400 + on the garage door opener--have another home same age and spent $60 on a preventative call. Have replaced the opener and that took three tries as the motion lights were not connected to the wall the first time and my door was being opened by neighbors due to programming glitch.  Now the door came down on my car and then I couldn't get it to close all the way. I called their emergency number and the serviceman kept advising me that it would probably cost $100 even though I had a year's warranty still in place. I finally advised that I would figure it out--he called back to apologize and said he was 'grouchy because he had been woken up'.  It was 10:00 pm or at the latest 10:30 but not all that late. I advised him that I wouldn't use them again.  I called the office on Monday and they were quick to advise that it didn't sound like their opener and they would likely be charging me for the service call. It is really a safety risk and luckily I don't have small children but still don't want that heavy door coming down on anyone or anything. Vote of no confidence for Action Doors.  They don't seem to care too much.

Gandolfo's is one of my favorite (if not favorite) sandwich shops at the moment. I've never had anything I didn't love  from breakfast to dinner. Most recently, I got the French dip which, quite honestly, was juicier and had more flavor than most higher-end restaurants. It was absolutely delicious. Even better, this location has some of the friendliest staff around. They're always so polite and cheery. If you're looking for a hearty, delicious meal without breaking the bank, try it out! You won't be disappointed.

Level of custom ability is a huge plus to this joint. Located right near the village, this is a nice spot with plenty of room to seat a decent sized group. The service is quick to receive your decently sized bowl. For $12+ tax the regular bowl will do just fine. There's 4-5 kinds of fish and shrimp and either squid or octopus. Overall, nothing blew me away, but they didn't pack the bowl with too much rice, which means they are not skimpy on the real components to the bowl. Which is a good thing!

This location is great. We first encountered Sweeto in Salt Lake City. The burritos are delicious and the customer service is always the best. I left super full but in a great way. Food didn't taste greasy at all.

I ordered a seafood burrito and nachos on Halloween. The taste was great on the burrito but it was really small for the price. The problem I have is I found a raw shrimp in my chicken nachos. My guess is it fell in when making the burrito, but still....gross. This was our first time here. We just bought a house close by and so trying local spots. Like I said good flavor on seafood burrito but it was mostly tortilla and raw shrimp in chicken nachos is why three stars

I just had to he most pleasant experience in trying to get my computer printing problem solved.  "Kat" answered my call and easily walked me through how to fix the problem after having  no luck talking to three different techs.  from my cable provider.  She fixed it in 5 minutes.  In the future, you know who I will be calling first!  Thank you Kat!

Unbelievable service. All automated calling, no person-to-person interaction. We've been inquiring about multiple locations and they won't respond/say they're too busy. 

Went to view one place today, they gave us a lockbox code and the lockbox was dead. Thankfully we were already in the area or it would have been a complete waste of time. We tried calling and no one would answer, again, multiple times. 

Ridiculous, and their pricing and deposit is completely extreme.

So we've lived down the street from this place and have never really cared to make it a priority to try it. My husband wanted to finally try it though so we know if we will continue to go. 

He got the carne assassin and I got the white chick. We both tried each other's and I would go for the Carne one because it didn't have a huge sweet factor. The white chick tasted a little too sweet for me, I'm not much of a sweet food person. The chicken wasn't dry either so I think they use chicken thighs which made the chicken tender, (dare I say moist?). The burritos were good sized and the fact that they come with tater tots was nice. Everything was nice and warm and we didn't have to wait too long in the drive through. Do not get the chips and salsa, salsa was horrible, chips were good though. Based on everything I rated this 4 stars, would have done 3.5 if I could have.

Ok ok ok...if you like mac n cheese....YOU HAVE TO TRY THEIR BACON JALAPENO MAC N CHEESE!!!! ohhhhhh man is it good!!! All the food I've tried here is really good actually...they have a fresh interesting menu with clean ingredients. I also really like the date and wild mushroon pizza...sounds weird, but it is sooo good! The reason I gave 4 stars is because sometimes I feel like the service is slow and not very attentive.
Soooo good! They catered our wedding at a very reasonable price and everyone was raving about the food. I hope the meridian location opens back up soon so I can get my fix more often!

Self-serve frozen yogurt samples... one of the things I didn't appreciate until it was gone. But this yogurt shop has opened sampling back up and I am here. For. It. 

They have about 1 flavors or so of frozen yogurt and several other dessert options. Some of the dairy-free and sugar-free options left a lot to desired and were icy. The regular flavors were good, but not the best frozen yogurt I've had. I felt the price was reasonable for the area.

I would probably rate the yogurt 3 stars on its own, but the friendliness of the staff, cleanliness and upkeep of the shop, and the samples bump it up to 4 stars.

What a great donut shop! Yummy donuts and always accurate!! I've had other donuts from around the treasure. Valley and all taste old or like they were packaged and just microwaved when sold, or just not up to par. What a amazing staff!! The neat thing is, they always ask the customer how they look so you know your getting what you paid for !! Definitely recommend !! My family will be back!!

L-O-V-E this place. The selection is fantastic and the customer service is top notch. Lots of favorites and new and unusual candies from around the world. The fun soda selection is great. They have a whole Harry Potter selection which is great. Hopefully they'll expand their HP selection.

I was pleased they open so early at 8 a.m. as I hate having to wait until 10 a.m. to get a cut anywhere. The cut was good, a tiny bit rough but it was good. They do a lot for the price of $20. The only thing that kept me from giving full 5 stars sadly was the negative talk about the current leadership. People do not come to get a haircut to hear others whine that Trump is not president anymore.

Michelle was so kind and helpful. We messed up on our order and she was super sweet about it.
The place was crazy busy and understaffed but she gave us her full attention and seemed happy to serve us.

We called to have a garage door opener installed. No answer, we left a message. After a few days without a return call (I should have known then that there would be issues with this company) we called back. Woman seemed put out to answer the phone. I asked to purchase and install a garage door opener. She interacted with me in one-word sentences..."Name?", ""Address?" Poor phone etiquette. She quoted me a reasonable price and scheduled me for the following week. 
The day came and nobody showed up in our 12-4 window. We waited all day and had things to do. We couldn't get a hold of them when we called them. Eventually they called us close to 5 to apologize for a scheduling glitch, would we be willing to let them come the following morning between 8-12? We gave them another chance. 
The next day by 11:15 they didn't show so I called for an update. The story kept changing from there. First they couldn't find my appointment at all. Then they said I was scheduled from 12-4 in their computer. Then after I told them they were supposed to come between 8-12, they said the installer cane at 9:00 and knocked but nobody answered so he left. We were home all morning so, no, he did not show up. 
Nothing like getting the runaround and half-truths from an unorganized company with poor customer service to ruin your day. Look at the other reviews for this company, lots of bad ones. I wish we had read them before and saved ourselves a headache. 

Update in response to the business owner's comments: I was not told I was given any discount when I booked the original appointment, nor was I offered another 10% off for my "headache". If these things happened, it's all news to me. I appreciate that you responded, but a new front desk staff does not account for an installer who claims they showed up when they clearly did not. We were in the front of the house all morning waiting for him. Either you are not being truthful in your response, or your staff members are not being truthful with you. I truly hope you are able to turn this around, as the old products in our home from your company are in fine working order. Would have loved to do more business with you in the future.

Unreliable service and customer service.  I have dealt with bad businesses before and this was probably the worst.  The owner himself is a jerk and doesn't care for the customers. They have been a no-show a few times and super aggressive when you confront them on it.  Even if you have a scheduled appointment they don't show up or call to advise they are not coming.  If it wasn't for the home builders choice of garage companies I wouldn't use them or RECOMMEND them. I hope they actually start losing contracts with the home builders.

Abaolutely loved the service! Our guy did everything he could to save us money but also was honest about the pricing and gave us options to fix our garage door that I backed in  He wasn't pushy at all and got the job done real quick. Highly recommend!

We have eaten here several times; mostly before a movie at the cinemas next door. The place is run by VERY young kids at their Meridian Village location...not a put-down, but a different "oh well" attitude when things aren't just right...and they're NEVER "just right". I like to change things up and tend to order different things at the same restaurant just to try them out and I can tell you that they ALWAYS seem to be out of some key ingredient of my first choice for a menu item (e.g. "we don't have any more chorizo"). That said, the food that you do get when they have it is pretty good quality and I will say that the kids ARE polite. Because of the food, I'll say it's a 3.4 so I'll round down to a three but I would never come here as a Mexican food destination, but rather a convenience factor for a quick bite to eat before an evening movie at the cinema. I hope the owner sees the review and tries to do a better job on keeping key ingredients on hand and maybe even reach out to me and try to make good on some free chorizo tacos since I can never get them. After tasting those perhaps I'll round up and four stars may appear.
Great sandwiches!  The pastrami and the Italian sub were excellent.  It's very casual and part of a convenience store.  Not a comfortable, clean place but like I said, the sandwiches are awesome.

Loved this place. The service was great we had a wonderful service she was so good with our kids! 
I ordered huevos ranchero it was soooo good! So much flavor. The cinnamon roll French toast was soooo good

We spent 4 months there while searching for our home. During the 4 months it was nice, great location, with the exception a lot of drama at the pool with children and their parents. Some Parents  were  really rude when confronted  about their kids acting up, they let their children run around and knock on doors and run away. As far as the staff, they pretend to care but they don't.  We found our house 2 months early so we paid $2200 to get out of our lease which I don't mind, it was in our contract. However, during the move out process they charged us $80 to clean carpets, they said I had to use their vendor, and they charged for 2 burnt out light bulbs and for drip pans.  
Keep in Mind non of this is in the contract! Ok, whatever but then I specifically told them I was cleaning the apartment myself, she told me that was " fine" but to understand if I missed anything I would be charged for missing it. I honestly spent  more than 3 hours cleaning that place, it was cleaner than when we moved in even the guy that did the walkthrough mentioned he couldn't find anything other the than law requiring new drip pans be replaced for new tenants, and the light bulbs. I left that place spotless! Well 3 weeks later after I called to see why I haven't received my deposit back she told me we were charged $120 for cleaning. I explained I was told during the walkthrough all I would be charged for was the drip pans, lights And carpet cleaning. We went back 6 different emails with nothing but excuses   She said her cleaning lady told her she had to spend several hours cleaning it. Of course she wasn't going to admit it, that place was spic and Span! 
She said I would have paid $120 if I didn't clean anything and left it dirty, so why in the world would I spend 3 hours cleaning it if I was getting charged the same amount if I didn't clean it at all? All she said was "I know your time was valuable there must have been misunderstanding"
I asked to see pictures of what needed to be recleaned but of course they don't have any to show me, funny because the guy who did the walkthrough specifically told us he had to take pictures. 
After I told her I wanted to talk to higher up and that we have a video of the place after I cleaned it now none is returning my calls. I left email and called. There are so many other nice apartments in meridian, please don't waste your time or money at the Regency plus the traffic there is out of control being right off eagle road it can take 30 minutes just to get to the freeway during rush hour.

This company couldn't tell the difference between a garage door and front door.  They were sent out to my house by LiftMaster to inspect my openers and without even touching anything they automatically determined it was the door(they installed) is the issue.  I wouldn't hire this company to fix my worst enemies garage door.

I LOVE THESE CAKES.
They are so moist.  Anyone can make a cake at home - box or scratch - but the moistness in these cakes sets them apart.  And the cream cheese frosting that is the right amount of tart, and cream, and no sugar grit, is just the literal icing on the cake.

This visit was to get my free birthday bundlet.  You sign up for their emails, and you get a free bundlet on your birthday.  When I walked into the store I was asked if I wanted to try the pumpkin spice cake.  And they had all these little squares of cake with a swirl of cream cheese frosting on them.  (I may have taken more than my fair share on the way in and on the way out. But man, they were soooo good.)  The girl wished me a happy birthday and then called the manager out to ring up the promo, and the manager wished me a happy birthday too; sweet girls.

For my birthday bundlet I went with the pecan praline.  And it was everything I had hoped it would be: moist, flavorful with pecan pieces throughout, and topped with that luscious cream cheese frosting.

$4.50 for a bundlet - WORTH IT.
$32, $42, $68 for the bigger cakes (and they decorate them) that would impress when you are entertaining because of the flavor and the decoration that I saw on some of them that were ready to be picked up.

I'm a fan.
I stopped in here during a 600 mile ride.  I didn't buy anything other than a couple of souvenirs but it seemed like a great dealership.  If you've moved to Boise, this is your dealer.

Delicious coffee! I've only been here one time and I have the maple breve and it was so good! I am going back today! I don't get into Murray in very often but if I do I'm always going to go here for my morning coffee!!

Our garage door broke on a weekend, so we called their emergency line on a Saturday night (7-17-21) to have them come on Sunday morning. Someone came out and  took a look and helped get our garage door in a workable place temporarily. He was great. The emergency visit cost $180. No problem. 

We were told that this $180 would end up going towards the final cost to fix the door. I was told when paying the $180 that an estimate for the broken door panel would be sent to us via email, and it was, and I immediately agreed to it online. It was $975 for the cost of the door and labor. All good.

I was then told that "one of the girls in the office" would be in touch on Monday to go over everything. They never called. I then called after-hours on Monday to leave a message that I was curious about my estimate and wanted to just get a picture of what the plan was and asked if someone could call me back.

I received a voice message at 8:20am on Tuesday, saying "if you still need service, call us back". Nothing about my voicemail or estimate was mentioned. It was a generic call back. I waited to see if I was going to get another call specifically about my estimate thinking that maybe they were just really busy. Nothing. Nothing on Wednesday. On Thursday I called them again and talked to someone that seemed confused when looking up my estimate. After finding my estimate in the system, they told me that the part was ordered and that they would get me an eta and call me right back. They never called back. I called after-hours again and left a message about my estimate and that I was somewhat frustrated that I was still in the dark about what was going on.

The next morning I got a call back at 8:30am on Friday with the same generic message that if I still needed service to call them. Frustrating to say the least.  So, my wife called Friday afternoon, and she was able to get a few more answers. Our door panel replacement will not arrive until November and apparently the $180 that we were told would go towards the final estimate of $975 was not accurate, and that only the labor costs ($95) would be waived.

I have no issue with the costs, but so far my experience with this company and their lack of clear communication has been subpar, which is the frustrating part.

As of right now, I would say to look elsewhere to avoid these kind of easily avoidable frustrations that this company has self-inflicted by their lack of clear communication.

Motel 6 is a basic no-frills motel chain so do not expect anything beyond basic ambiance and basic services. Our room was immaculately clean, the beds were comfortable and the motel is well-maintained. Others have mentioned that the "walls are thin" meaning that sound does travel more so than in higher priced motels. This motel chain does welcome guests with pets, so don't be surprised to hear an occasional dog bark or two. We chose this location adjacent to Interstate 84 as it was easy to access, and convenient for us as we had business in the area the next morning. The lady at the front desk was efficient and pleasantly helpful, and gave us excellent directions when asked about how to drive to our local destination from the motel. All in all we were quite satisfied with our stay at this Motel 6 location.

This place is a nightmare if I could give no stars I would but I can't!! Where do I begin we have lived here for two years and this place is a joke they have so many rules and restrictions it feels like you live in a prison camp. The pool isn't heated and is completely unbearable in the early months of summer. It has a patio area by the pool with BBQ grills and seating but you have to rent it out to use it and Its expensive!! It has bikes under the stairs of all of the apartments but you will get fined if you put a bike there. Your restricted on what can go on your balcony or patio I mean like little to nothing is aloud. They told us when we moved here that there was a lot of free parking but they decided to once again try to suck every dime out of you and start renting out parking spaces out. They have taken most of the parking away and it sucks trying to find a space especially if it's later in the evening. I have talk to so many residents that are unhappy with how this place is ran and micro managed it's ridiculous and I could go on for hours about how this place is ran by greedy money seeking trolls but I have better things to do with my time. DO NOT MOVE HERE!!

I don't shop here often, but when I tag along I'm always impressed by this location in the village. One I really appreciate getting more high end businesses in the village.

This will only help drive meridians economy and this shopping center. 

The layout is clean and easy to navigate. Even on busy holiday weekends it didn't feel too cramped. 

Recommend this business to anyone doing shopping in the village.

I am not sure how anyone can dispute the value of this place when the average Taco on the menu including brisket and some seafood are $2.50 a taco. If you cannot afford that find another restaurant.

They don't have a ton of space to eat inside but by far this is one of my new favorite places in the valley, I had a brisket Taco that was great lobster roll that was also good ($5.50 but its lobster come on ) and a shrimp little Jefe roll up that was only 1.99.

They sell guac, cheese roll ups for only 99 cents. Homade tortillas. Come on guys. Do I have to go on?

No the Treasure Valley doesn't have a genuinely good Mexican restaurant still but with this addition we have another great place to get some super good tacos.

I usually go to the European Wax Center off of Miluakee, but this week I tried out their Chinden location. Totally out of the way from where I live, but my friend and I decided to go together and she really favors this location in particular. Despite my reluctance to drive out this way, I caved and decided to make the trek so my friend and I could have appointments at the same time...because friends who get Brazilians together stay together. (Totally joking, but actually kind of serious.)

The girl who I normally go to at the other location had recently moved on to another opportunity, so not knowing who to request, I let the front desk girl book me with any of the waxers that were available. I had an appointment with Taylor, and she was fantastic! So friendly, totally made me feel comfortable, and made the process as painless as possible. 

They tell you that if you keep up with it, the pain is less and less each time because the growout isn't as intense. This was my third consecutive wax, and don't get me wrong it still is not a comfortable endeavor, but it really does get better as you keep up with it! Probably 5 times during my appointment I said to my waxer, "Oh....that wasn't as bad as I expected."

When I was paying, they informed me that they are soon doing away with their student wax package (4 for $150), so I caved and purchased it. They let me divide the package into two payments also, which was really nice! $75 now, and $75 again in September. Now I've got 3 passes sitting on my account, which I assume will carry me well into November - not a bad deal at all!

Also, I stated this in my last review, but I'll say it again here - you get 50% off your first time!

Super fun and unique ice cream shop. You choose from ice cream, a frozen banana or a rice crispy treat. Then you choose whether to dip it in Chocolate or marshmallow and then lastly they dip it in whatever toppings you choose. The more toppings you choose the more expensive the treat is. They also have already pre-made flavors you can choose from. This is a very cute business with yummy desserts.
Simple bar but does have top shelf liquor, lovely. Nice local woman owns the bar, she was fun to talk too. Enjoy.

Decided to pop in here for a quick lunch before heading to the airport.  Upon walking in, I couldn't help but notice how clean the place was- which always makes me happy.  The interior was bright, colorful & vibrant.

The staff was very friendly & the menu was easy to read/follow.  I ordered two shrimp tacos, which were very good. The sauce was very runny and made a mess on my plate, but I would order them again.  My friend got their burrito, and it was very good- she let me have a bite.

We weren't sure what to do with our trash, so we had to ask.  I guess they pick it up for you.

The service was friendly, and the food was fast! The restaurant was very clean. The A/C feels really nice and balances out the sweat from the hot wings. I gave it a 3 because it wouldn't be a waste if you tired it once, but it's not a place we will probably visit back. Also they don't have a trash can anywhere so I would recommend making one available to the customers. 

Heads up, the fries have sugar on them if that's your thing. If you want water, just buy a bottle, DO NOT try their fountain water.

Just finished physical therapy and had to grab a bite. Thought of checking out this place since so close by. I walked in and up to the cashier, who was friendly and patient as I chose to go with the Carnivore burrito. Was told to take a seat and my food would be brought to me. 

I sat down and noticed the table/seats were clean with cool decor. My food arrived very quickly and first bite I thought "Whoa!" I made a good chose and sure I ll be back again. 

Thanks for the good food and service!

My previous review absolutely still stands in regards to my feelings about Dr. Butuk and the overall experience I've had at this office. So please refer to my previous review below to read more.

What I feel is worth updating is my experience as of late with unplanned appointments and the physicians assistants that I have met with. I have made appointments for both myself and each of my kids in recent months and each experience was so much better than they have been in the past. I commend Meridian Family Medicine for recognizing their areas of weakness and making an effort to improve.

Our last two visits have been with Dr. Scott. He is so great at breaking down medical terms in language that the rest of us can understand. He is always very personable and does not give you that feeling that he's in a hurry to move on to the next room. On our last visit, my son was very talkative and Dr. Scott let him converse with him like he had all the time in the world.  It's those little things that make children feel comfortable going to the doctor's office.

I must also commend the office for always being able to get us in, in a timely manner when the need arises! 

Our primary care physician for 7 years now!

Megan is the absolute best. I've been coming here monthly for the past year for a fade and a trim and she never disappoints. This is not the place to get a 15 minute, in and out cut. It's very reasonably priced at $15. Why would you go to a strip-mall quick cut when you can get a perfect cut for the same price. Old time barber shop feel in Meridian and you'll leave with a perfect cut. Closed Sundays and Mondays. Open for walk-ins Tuesday-Friday 9am-5pm and an occasional Saturday 9am-2pm.  (I believe the hours are wrong on Yelp). The other ladies are nice but ASK for Megan.

Gréât adorable coffee drive through in meridian I had to try... only downside is smoothie is a bit on the top sugary side (from concentrate she said so I should've known) but latte is amazing! Want to come try their breakfast burritos nex5 time!! Yum!

What a great place.  I was there with a group of friends and everyone else's food look amazing but I was disappointed with my avocado toast.  It was small and boring.  I'm definitely coming back and having anything but the avocado toast!  Great ambiance and fast service!
I am very pleased with this office. Everyone was very friendly and helpful. I saw Janelle Barney and felt like she listened to me, and was willing to take care of all my needs. I will be coming back!
Don't drive all the way out here on the assumption that their posted hours of operation mean anything.

We have lived in the Boise Area for over a year now and I am still searching for a great burger.  Most places fall short.  Five Guys does not.  These burgers melt in your mouth.  The flavor is great with toppings that don't fall out of the burger but are plentiful.  The cost is well worth it for a treat like this.  Their fry sauce is my favorite over other places.  The fries are plump and tasty.  It has been a few hours now after eating a full burger, a medium order of fries, and soda and I am feeling pretty good.  

Other items to note during COVID times:  they require masks per the sign on the door.  They will pack your order to go.  If you decide to stay and eat indoors or out, of course it is sans mask.  Tables are marked for seating at only every other table.  Everyone seemed to comply with the mask wearing including every employee.  Many people opted for dining in.
Duck donuts is great for the kids and but amazing for the parents as well.  So many sweet and savory options.   Every donut we've tried has been warm and amazing.
Worst place ever to rent from wish we read the reviews before renting from them. They kept 80% of our deposit even though we left that place spotless. Such a joke. Fuck this company

The people in this store were so nice friendly & helpful. We were in town for a wedding and we always like to visit different Harley stores wherever we go. This one was exceptional, such a wide selection of merchandise. Love it will definitely go back.

We went to several Lucky Perks in the area while visiting from out of town. We had great experiences everytime. Our last visit to this location we dealt with Ellen. She was horrible to us; unfriendly and rude. It was honestly unbelievable. Ellen was terrible to us, for no reason. Will not be back because of the way she treated us.

I did have a little problem calling in to make an appointment getting transferred around to 3 different people, before ending up in a voicemail that I was not sure was the correct person. But they seem to still be adjusting to the new building setup. So I decided to go online and try your on line appointment service and it worked great. I received a call back and email confirming my appointment and my service was completed in a very timely manner. 

Thank you very much for your service and dedication to customer satisfaction.

Joe Callahan

Broken Yolk is a family favorite - go so many reasons!  The food is great, the drinks are fun, but it is the service that makes it stand above all the rest!  We are there at least 3-4 times a month...and it never disappoints.  I have to give it to Jamie!!! She is so sweet, friendly and fast.  She remembers us every time and always has the most kind words for my kiddos as I.  I don't know that she ever has a bad day...if she does...you would never know it!  Her smile lights up and room and she makes you feel you're the only one in the room (when in fact it is always packed).  In today's world, this is what makes the difference.  Kindness, smiles and a love for what you do and who you do it for!  Ask for Jamie next time you go in...just as long as you don't take her from us!  Dont get me wrong, they are all fantastic...but she is ours!  Thank you for being amazing!

We hoped for a painless experience in buying new phones but our expectations were exceeded and the experience at this ATT store was even fun thanks to Ivan's expertise and customer service!  My husband is  one of those who, like most I imagine, has his phone on and with him all of the time.  I hate phones - there I've said it and I once worked in this industry - so I avoid using mine as much as possible.  Although mine was an older Samsung it would have worked for me in perpetuity but for ATT deciding to close down the G3 network on which it relied by Feb 2022.  So new phones were needed by both of us and after features / function review with Ivan we chose the Samsung model that fit our needs.  This location was out of that model on our first visit but the phones were easily ordered and in the store for us to pick up in 5 days.  With Ivan's assistance our old ones were traded back to ATT and data transferred to new ones.  Big woohoo too because since my hubby is ATT retiree we got a nice discount on phones and accessories.  The only 'aww shucks' is they had no cases in the store for this model...most of their cases are for iphone.  That is the single thing which I'd wave my magic wand to change here.  Otherwise all really good.

APPOINTMENTS:  You can make one or walk in.  Recommend the appointment.  Mornings seem to be slower than afternoons.

LOCATION:  Convenient right on Eagle road, directly across the parking lot from the Boise CoOp Meridian location at The Village.   Windows on two sides so light and bright.  Well laid out inside for displays and product. 

PARKING:  Private lot.

ACCESSIBILITY:  ADA / Accessible parking right outside the door.  All on one level.  In addition to standing height tables they have a couple in the back that are standard seating height. 

COVID PROTOCOL:  Appreciated that all staff here were wore masks and tables were well spaced out.

My wait and anticipation is over. Finally a Wingstop close to home. I'm familiar with Wingstop from my travels in California and Texas.  It's different than BBW and has a more comfortable feel rather than a sports pub. 

The menu is not hard but watching the newbie customers walk in and have a glazed over stare clearly means that they did not do their research before visiting. So take a moment and visit their website.  It's not hard.  Here's the steps.  Go to order@wingstop.com and check out the options.  First decide on what you want. A single meal with wings or a pack. A pack is like a family meal. They wing amounts range from 10 - 60 or so.  Then decide if you want boneless or traditional. NOTE: you can do half and half. Just decide which ones are going to get which sauces.  With the 40 pack, you get 4 sauces.  Here's my recommendation. Mango Habanero, Garlic Parmesan, Original, and Lemon Pepper. Then you get one side. They suggest fries, but I would skip the fries, while fresh and hot, they were a little too salty for my taste. Not to worry there are other sides to choose from like coleslaw, potato salad and others.  At Wingstop, you don't have to pay for your Ranch or Bleu Cheese. With a 40 pack you get 4 dipping sauces, 2 Ranch 2 Bleu or 4 Ranch etc.... You also get fresh cut celery and carrots. Refreshing!!! It's about 14 minutes from order until it arrives at your table. There's a fresh roll of paper towels so help yourself.  Two TVs and a self serve beverage station. Our order was presented to us correctly and the flavors were perfectly executed. The boneless portions are larger than some competitors and the boats are not swimming in their sauce. Wingstop is a great addition to Meridian. Grab a magnetic business card from the counter and out it on your fridge so when your are craving wings, call, go online or simply visit the store to fill your craving. Highly recommended.

We haven't been here since their remodel but it's still as good as it was. The remodel allows for more seating which is spacious for those of us on wheels. Luckily we arrived before 5:00 and by the time we left it was packed! 

Must try: Veggie Wings (cauliflower with buffalo sauce) and the Riblets (generous portion) appetizers.

Service was spot on.

Life long SoCal native with 60 years of eating Mexican food rates this place for first time here

Bland Mexican rice
Tasty black beans
Pretty good carnitas burrito 
Good carne asada tacos al carbon

Nice to be served warm refried beans with cheese with the chips

Courteous and friendly staff

Will be back to try some other dishes
Excellent food and huge portions. Food was served hot and drinks refilled as needed. Great service by Kassy.

Looking for a sandwich for lunch today and stumbled upon this online.  Ordered the Knuckle Sandwich and was not disappointed!  Takes a bit longer to make because this is not fast food.  They have a drive thru behind the building for convenience and the wait was not that long.  If you're in the area or willing to make a trip, I highly recommend.  Very tasty!

Fit Donut is always the spot for when you're craving sweets and not tryna feel like crap after eating. The specialty donuts are superb, however, the plain cookie like donuts with no toppings are average and could use some improvement! In conclusion, I love Fit Donut and will continue to come back!
I love it here I took a cooking class last summer and it was really fun. They have great equipment it is sad to see it go.
This place is adorable. The people are so sweet. The food is delicious, reasonably priced, and tastes like it was made with love. Coffee is delicious.

Went into Blimpies on main street today. Of the six employees only one of the males was wearing a mask. The rest of the employees had it hanging from their ear. One didn't have a mask at all and she was the one cutting the meet for customers. Did not feel safe to eat there and took my business elsewhere. Masks are required in ada county.  Disappointed.

Wow I am so impressed with the quality and freshness of the food here!! Absolutely worth the wait! The burger, fries, & cheese curds are absolutely delicious. Hot & fresh. Milkshakes are smooth and rich, everything tastes amazing! Totally recommend if you're looking for a good burger. Totally worth the $30 we spent on just two meals with milkshakes!

A few weeks ago I came here for a cooking class, "Night Out: Paris In Spring", and had a blast. Start to finish, my experience here was wonderful--from the hospitality of the employees, to the guidance from the chef, and enjoying a delightful meal that you cooked at the end of it--the whole night was thoughtfully put together and executed.

We were given instruction from Chef Frank Finney. He did a great job explaining all of the products we were working with and how to best use them. He did a wonderful job teaching us how to best work with the ingredients we were using. Plus, he included a few dozen free jokes to keep us laughing the whole class. 

A few lessons learned from this night:
- The success of your roasted potatoes begins with cutting them all down to the same size
- It takes a lot to make clarified butter burn
- Always pat your meat dry before you marinate it...especially if it is chicken
- To make soufflé not split down the middle, line the cooking dish with butter and sugar

At the end of the night, we ended up with a delicious herb marinated steak with blue cheese butter, roasted potatoes and shallots, as well as a gluten free lemon soufflé with strawberries. It. Was. Delicious. 

Overall, such a fun experience! Plus, I learned a technique or two that I've been able to take home and use in my own kitchen.

Went in for some new shoes. Cute little local shop. It seems like there isn't a lot of selection, but after a 1-1 consultation, choice was not an issue. Tried out a few pairs, assessed my gait, selected a few more to try on and then we ordered a pair (new model wasn't available in my size). A few days later, I picked them up and took them home. The pair didn't fit right, (for some reason they were REALLY small.) I took them back for an exchange, and found that my new size was going to back ordered for 6 weeks, so we went with an older model. Owner refunded the difference on the shoe and added a discount for inconvenience (without asking) Great Customer service. Nice to support a local store.

I wasn't impressed the first time I came here but i believe in second chances so this was their second chance. They failed again. For the price, I expect a very good burger. This was just so so.. 

To start with, my Little Cheeseburger ($5.69) was wrong. I even double checked our order number. It had about 4 more ingredients than I had ordered. Rather than take it back and wait for another, I just scraped them off. If your cheese isn't melted, doesn't that mean your burger wasn't warm enough to melt it?  Cold bun, cold cheese, slightly warm burger. The fries..... not bad but over priced at $4.19. The drink was great although overpriced at $2.79. 

It was a beautiful day to eat out on the patio but have this ever been cleaned? Ick! We sat as far as we could from the dried puddle of what looked like vomit. Just ick!!

So over $40 for 3 adults and a child for a so so lunch.

Cold heat lamp fries right from the drive-thru.

Also they don't salt their fries.

Nasty and unworthy of Jack in the box

FIRST OFF, I want to point out that this review is based off their food only as I got a to-go order and have yet to dine in! Now back to your regularly scheduled review...

I was craving Mexican food as it was a day of the week that ended in "y" so I decided to branch out and check Yelp to see what had good reviews near me that I haven't tried yet. MI CASA IT IS! Great reviews, good lookin pictures, nice selection...could THIS be the new go-to spot for local Mexican food?!?! The lady and I ordered three different things to split...we got their seafood burrito, a bean and cheese burrito, and chicken nachos. Let's do some pros and cons:

Pros...the food was all really good! Super tasty. The seafood burrito had a ton of flavor with ok-sized chunks of fish and ummmm other seafood pieces which I already forgot about. The sauce they made and used in the burrito was fantastic. Almost like a creamy sauce but not too much, but generally super tasty. The bean and cheese burrito was a very good bean and cheese burrito and was covered in some red sauce that actually made it potentially better. That brings me to the beans and rice, both of which were good. Excuse my lack of adjectives but I'm not sure else how to describe them...super good. They also have a pretty good sized bag of chips to munch on, which, surprise surprise, were also good. As for the nachos, they were....yeah, you know. Good. Again, I want to use different adjectives but it wasn't too much more or less than good. Overall, the food was good(omg no more with the good please). 

Cons...before I start these, once again keep in mind that this review is based on take out and not eating in house. For what you get, it's too expensive. I wanna know what they give you if eating in house, but the to-go version doesn't give you enough entree for the amount they charge. We spent over 40 bucks for three items that was all dominated in one sitting. Furthermore, they only have two small sides of salsa for the generous side of chips they gave. It wasn't enough salsa even really for a small side. But I digress...let me get back to the lack of food they give you for the mains...the seafood burrito, while very good, was incredibly lacking in terms of actual seafood and "innards." At first glance, it looks pretty big as it's a long tortilla with plenty of sauce and melted cheese on top. But as soon as you cut in, it's mostly tortilla! What the crap?! Both ends of the burrito are like 3 inches of tortilla before you even get to any other ingredients, and then when you hit those, it's just a thin layer. Again, tasty, but disappointing. I would have been happy with both burritos if they were about 5 bucks less each based on the amount they give you. $12.99 for the seafood burrito would have been perfect and given this a higher review, not $17.99. Also more salsa. Duh. 

Now with all this being said, at some point, I WILL go here again and eat in-house to see what's different. Maybe they have some crucially good margaritas? Maybe they make the entrees bigger when they put it on their plates? Maybe they will just straight refill your salsa when you quickly run out?!?? These are things that will one day be discovered.

The best customer service around. I visit my daughter in Idaho and I have no idea where they find these kids as they are all so friendly and get your drinks so quick and they are always packed. Too bad I can't find any employees like this in CA. I'm curious as to their training as it is working perfectly. I hope and pray that they will one day make it to Orange County.

Ordered and picked up breakfast 10 minutes later. 5 minutes after that I attempted to eat it.  Everything was cold.  Blueberry muffin, ice cold no butter, dry as hell.  Biscuit same coldness and so dry it crumbled to nearly dust.  Fruit was juiceless and tasteless.  Very disappointed. It seems that pickup orders are taken advantage of because they know we won't be there when we realize how horrible the food is.

I understand that the market is crazy but that doesn't mean you are allowed to treat people with disrespect because there may be someone else in line.  I called today to let them know of my interest in renting and told them which apartment I was interested in, I have to have a building with an elevator or an apartment on the 1st floor due to my Rheumatoid arthritis, and asked if they would be able to help me with a 30 day move in and the associate on the other end of the phone stated that I would need to move in within 1-2 weeks.  I explained that I would need to give my landlord a 30 day notice just like I expected he would appreciate  and he agreed and I asked if he could help and he said not really.  I stated that he must not want my business then and said goodbye and he said goodbye, without even attempting to help me....what happened to good old fashioned courtesy?  Caring for your fellow man? Not somewhere I want to Live.

Very impressed with this place on every level.

The food, service, and atmosphere all work together so well that I genuinely felt like I was on vacation while eating there.

Tyler is an incredibly friendly barista and made wonderful suggestions.

Highly recommend their pupusas.

I took my 12 year old son with me today to get both of our eyebrows waxed.  My son has been getting his eyebrows waxed for about 5 years so he is very comfortable with the process, but it's always unnerving to try a new place. 
We were in Eagle Island shopping center & noticed EWC. We stopped in and asked the receptionist if there was any availability for us. The receptionist was really nice & helpful. I wish I remembered her name! She was able to find an appointment for us that was in less than 30 minutes. It was great! 
At the exact time of our appointment, our waxer came out into the lobby & called us back. She introduced herself & then walked us back to our private waxing room. Once in the waxing room, she asked both of us what we like & dislike about our eyebrows. She also inquired about what we would like them to look like.  She listened to everything we said, it was refreshing! Prior to waxing, she measured the spacing & placement to make sure our faces stayed symmetrical, cleaned & prepped the area, then she got started. My son had several questions while he was being waxed & she happily answered his questions and treated him really well. She spoke to him & treated him like she would treat a 30 year old customer.  It was really considerate & appreciated. 
The waxing experience was great. We facility is clean & well taken care of. This will be our new go to waxing salon!

Good food, good service.  

I have been there a dozen or so times and every time I have had tasty food!

I'm from Wyoming so I never even tried Sushi prior to moving to Idaho. That being said I can't pretend I know anything about "authentic". Which I'm starting to think is just a made up Californian word used to describe how everything here tastes like shit compared to everything in California. 

Since I'm a poor daughter of an immigrant who lived off rice and beans growing up take my opinion or leave it. I think most the sushi I've tried here is good. I've never tried a Poké Bowl before today so I was a little upset I've been using my life savings to eat sushi rolls when I could get this cheaper (great tasting and more filling) dismembered version of sushi. 

This establishment was very clean. I would let my kids eat off the bathroom floor that's how clean it is. The employees were very kind and welcoming. They guided us through the proccess and gave reccomendations.The outcome was satisfying. It's kind of like a subway or costa vida set up. You pick your meat, then add your choice of rice, veggies, and saucea. I got an ahi tuna bowl with brown rice and a mix of veggies and the recommended sauces. Everything looked and tasted very fresh. I'm excited to return!
Customer service was pretty good just was out of a lot of things making it hard to choose. Definitely on top of your mask policy.

I reached out to Claudine at Kanak Attack to cater our son's groom's luncheon after his wedding. She was so good at communicating to me all the information I needed to make a good choice on the menu, which was so delicious. She even made a last minute change on dessert! I had so many people ask me where I had ordered it from and had so many more tell me how wonderful it all was. The rolls were fresh, the kalua pork was soft and tender, the rice was so good there was nothing left in the pan. Everyone was fat and happy! Thank you Kanak Attack for taking care of the hard stuff so I could enjoy my boy's big day!

They've cleaned our house bi-weekly for several months. They do an ok job. They have steadily cut the amount of time they spend cleaning to just a little more than one-half of the original time they estimated and used to spend. As a result, we have been paying about $70 per person-hour for cleaning and some things aren't getting cleaned as well as they should.

We will begin looking for a new service.

Dropped into Mi Casa on a work trip to Boise. The location isn't too far from downtown, about 15 minutes. The restaurant itself is decorated with sombereros and Mexican blankets and Mexican music  was playing in the background. The server was really friendly and made us feel more then welcome. We had a couple of Spanish speakers in the group and he was able to toggle back and forth with them which was kinda fun. One of my favorite things were the beans -they served them with the free chips In addition to many of the entrees. They were not canned and flavorful!  For my entree I ordered the cheese enchiladas with beans and rice. The rice was full of flavor and the enchilada sauce was solid. The portion sizes are more then generous and you will definitely walk away full! I would come here again!

Seriously?  Leave pizza out of the name.  I ordered a plain (east coast talk for just a cheese pizza) and it doesn't rival Little Caesar's - esp. for the price.  That said, if you like over-seasoned  under flavored tomato paste and some mozarella slapped on a crust with too much cornmeal....winner!  This is your place.
I'm giving the place two stars because some other east coaster said the cheesesteak was good (and that review only counts if he's from Philly; which I'm doubting) and I'm willing to give the place another chance, but not with their pizza.
If you billed that as pizza back east, you'd get punched in the face.

After more than a decade of receiving care for myself and my family members from Meridian Family Medicine, it is with great regret that I write that I no longer trust this practice nor their policies to protect and provide proper care for my family.

I reached out to them to inquire about whether they refer patients for Monoclonal Antibody treatments for Covid and was promptly told my the lady who spoke with me on the phone, at Meridian Family Medicine "they don't do that," which I believed she meant that she was telling me that people are not treated in this way for the Covid Disease. I then informed her that she was incorrect, that this was the primary treatment in Idaho right now for people infected with Covid to keep them out of the hospital and asked her to have a provider call me. No provider ever called. I then obtained referrals for myself and my wife from another provider who immediately referred us for this potentially life saving treatment.

Later, after my daughter, a client of Meridian Family Medicine was also diagnosed with Covid I reached out to them to request testing. At that time I asked them to clarify my previous conversation with the receptionist and their policy regarding referring people for Monoclonal Antibody treatment. A provider called me back and told me that no provider currently at this practice had referred people infected with Covid for Monoclonal Antibody Treatment and that the only other provider who had, one who we had seen many times, had left the practice. I then asked the provider if they would refer my daughter for treatment and they said that they had never done so and knew little about the treatment and had only begun looking into it. This was despite Monoclonal Antibody treatment being the primary treatment used by the Hospital network they were associated with to keep people out of this hospital.

I then told the provider their answers and apparent lack of support for this treatment was concerning and asked them if they would refer my daughter should she need treatment. They then said that IF her conditioned worsened they would consider it. I scheduled my testing appointment and got off the phone with the provider. The provider then called me back and stated that they did not believe my daughter qualified under the guidelines and said that they would refuse to refer her for monoclonal antibody treatment at this time and asked if I still wanted to keep my appointment for testing. I did and the test came back positive but the provider had already refused to refer my daughter for treatment for Covid at the infusion center.

Soon I personally received treatment for Covid receiving Monoclonal Antibody treatment at St Lukes infusion center. At the center, a pharmacist, giving my treatment, with a decade of experience, invited me to bring my daughter in for treatment. I told him I could not as her provider at Meridian Family Medicine had refused to refer her for treatment at this time claiming she did not qualify. The Pharmacist looked at me with shock and flatly stated that she qualified. He then suggested I take her to St Lukes Urgent Care to get the referral. As it was after hours on a weekend I did so.

At St Lukes Urgent Care I told the nurses and doctor who saw my daughter about the provider at Meridian Family Medicine claiming they did not believe my daughter qualified for Monoclonal Antibody treatment despite her positive test result and symptoms and that her provider had refused to refer her for treatment. They too were shocked by this and the strange way Meridian Family Medicine had treated my requests. The doctor at St Lukes Urgent care stated that Monoclonal Antibodies is the primary treatment being given to Covid patients at this time to keep them out of the hospital, stated they had already referred five patients that same day, and gladly provided the referral to the St Lukes Infusion center.

I just received a response from the St Lukes Infusion center stating in part the following regarding the referral that was sent by this doctor at the St Lukes Urgent Care for my daughter to receive treatment:

"You were recently diagnosed with COVID-19 and referred to St. Luke's Infusion Services for follow up.  You are receiving this message because you qualify to receive the monoclonal antibody treatment either [bamlanivimab and eteseviam] OR REGEN-COV (casirivimab and imdevimab)."

This is contrary to what I was told by the provider at Meridian Family Medicine. The provider was likely misinformed. What greatly concerns me is that they initial response I received from the receptionist when I told them my reason for my first call, indicated that the Meridian Family Medicine center was not supporting the standard of care widely recommended for treatment of early Covid in order to keep patients out of the hospital.

Other providers willingly referred my wife and I but Meridian Family Medicine initially denied my request to refer my daughter to receive this treatment.

Not a very good pizza. $14 for a plain pepperoni and it was just bleh. Not sure if it was a off night but it had no taste. Had to try it because of the reviews but I would not go back. And I love all pizza usually. Pie hole down the street is cheaper and better.

I am a big fan of five guys and this location proved to be no different. The burger and fries were great. 

My choice:
Little bacon cheeseburger
Add grilled mushroom, onion and jalepenos with a little A1 sauce... very good.

My wife is a vegetarian and gets the veggie sandwich.

A small fry feeds both my wife and I.

2 sandwiches, small fry, and one large drink around $18.xx

Burger is fresh, bacon is crispy.

Yum, yummy burgers!  High prices!  I love the greasy vibe of real fast food.  Love the complimentary all you can eat peanuts.  Don't love paying $10 for a greasy fast food burger or $5 for a shake.  We've done it twice.  It's a treat.

I wasn't even planning on stopping in here during my last trip to the Village, but I am so glad I did! I walked past the door, stopped, turned, looked at the sign, backtracked a few steps, and impulsively walked in. 

I glanced at the menu and was greeted by two friendly workers. I told the girl behind the counter that I had a cold and was looking for a little "pick-me-up". She directed me to purchase a few "Electric Light" wellness shots (about 2 oz each) and take them over the next few days. These wellness shots are packed full of apple, lemon, ginger, honey and cayenne pepper and come in the cutest little glass jars. The best part is that they are only $2 each! (This might feel spendy to some, but it is awesome when compared with prices of other local juice spots.) These wellness shots are tart and intense in their flavor--but you aren't really buying them to sip on--the purpose they serve is to give your body a surge of good nutrients.

All of that to say, I took one wellness shot a day over the next three days and I got over my cold very quickly. Not saying that it is all thanks to these wellness shots, but I do believe they supplemented my speedy recovery! I'm excited to come back and try some more of their juices, they all looked so yummy!

Also, I should note that the vibe of this place is awesome. It's open with a clean and comfortable design, and it has a mellow feel to it. I've been waiting to find a juice shop in Boise that gives the same calm feel that a coffee shop provides, and this place does just that! (Woohoo!)

Check 'em out--if you're feeling under the weather, or just want to hang out and grab a healthy drink, you know where to go!

This was an unexpected but delicious find. The hubby and I were on a date night (thanks to VBS) and needed something close and with a mix of food. Saw the reviews and stopped in here and we were more than impressed. The fry appetizer was delicious, the sausage was scrumptious and my hubby and I clashed forks for the last bite. Then I got my pizza (the hot one). Holy smokes it was delicious. The crust was so fresh and light and the flavor exploded in my mouth with every bite. My husband got the bbq burger and it was his nirvana aka a burger that tasted like it was served on French toast. We ended our meal with the cookie and it was also delicious. The ambiance is strange, kind of has an industrial/homeless/dusty feel but who cares the food is AMAZING.

Wish I could give no stars. This place is a big scam you know why? They say they have unlocked the keys to what would be a healthy version of a donut. Seemed inspiring but I can tell you right now if you believe that bogus you are gonna be disappointed. The moment you make a donut healthy it's no longer a donut. If you actually want a donut go to Krispy Kreme or something. Don't waste your money on this overly priced awful tasting hipster place.

I am not sure what people expect from a McDonald's it's like expecting 5 star customer service from Walmart. First I am not a McDonald's fan but when u have kids u tend to visit one from time to time. I have been to this location twice. It is always clean the staff is friendly and food is decent. They have a nice play area for the kids which is always an added bonus. I wish they had the self ordering but I am sure it will come soon enough.

I wanted to like this place but all of the donuts I tried are just so sickly sweet and over priced. It's a cool concept and obviously a lot of people think it's great. For much better donuts, try Sweet Sensations.

This was the first time that I've tried Kanak Attack in house. I've had their awesome catering before, but I had no idea that they had a storefront so close to my house. We needed a quick, but delicious lunch and trusty Yelp guided us here!

This location is right next to their catering office. So you can try some delicious food and then hop next door to book them for your next party. The interior is very cute. Open and bright. There is plenty of space between tables and they are all table and chairs. The decorations are nice...obviously Hawaiian themed and they look pretty authentic (to my very untrained eye). 

Their menu has a decent amount of choices, but it's not overkill, so we easily made our decision. You order upfront and then they'll bring your food to your table. One thing that drove me crazy was the freshly lacquered tables. We kept sticking to them! Obviously that will correct itself soon, so no big deal. 

I only have one dish to go off of, because the hubs and I ordered the same thing. We both got the street tacos, trying out each of their meats. My favorite was the teriyaki chicken, my husband liked the pork the best. The brisket was good too, but a bit more plain than the other two. All the tacos are served on a corn tortilla and has a crunchy, sesame slaw on top. The teriyaki chicken was a bit spicy and the chicken thighs were so juicy and tender.  Overall, the meats and the slaw are both pretty saucey so all of my tacos fell apart. My tortilla was pretty soggy so I had to just eat the meat and slaw with a fork. Not a huge deal, but sort of took away from the taco experience. Perhaps they could drain the meat a little more or double up on the tortilla. 

Overall, we were so stoked to try this place out and we can't wait to bring out of town family here!

Excellent burrito!!  I hafta try them all!!!

I had the carnivore.  It just needed more sauce.  Other than it was very very good.  The right size, price and delicious tots as a side....if u like unique burritos, this is the place...cheers!!!

The food was excellent.
Admittedly, I don't know much about Hawaiin food. (See I don't even know how to properly spell Hawaiian the first time there?)
The staff at the counter was so polite and knew their menu - I just glanced at the first 10 reviews here and when I visited, the staff actually identified EVERY issue mentioned and noted that I may or may not like something reviewers commented on. 
That's not the norm, at all ... that's a staff that listens and cares about customer experience. That alone is 5 stars. 
Tried some variety of chicken and some variety of steak. Both were 5 stars.
Place was spotless. 12 of us ordering took ~15 minutes to reach our table so the manager brought us donuts while we waited. Nice gesture.
I couldn't tell you anything else except that the flatware is BAMBOO! Why isn't everyone using recycled/recyclable wood? LOVE IT. 
Keep it up Kanak Attack.

Tonight I took my date to a Tuscany themed cooking class. I was super stoked because I have always wanted to try one of these, but never took the opportunity. 

The dinner had us making several different segments of the meal. A salad, risotto, some sort of topping for the pork, and an amazing lemon desert. 

First let me describe what I was disappointed with. It's not much, but it did have me wanting more. We did most of the prep work for our given meal, but the only thing I truly feel like we made from start to finish was the salad and risotto. The lemon dessert was finished while we ate the main course and the pork was cooked without us doing anything. We just put salt and pepper on it. I'd like more hands on, especially since there were only 4 of us total. 

Other than that it was great. The food was awesome and gave me confidence that I could make this at home. The cooking instructor was clear on how to prepare everything, but he didn't offer tips or instruction on how to do certain things. (Knife skills in particular.) I still had a grea time and I think it's a unique date that many people would enjoy. Would go again but probably not for a bit.

So, it's a fun schtick. They serve the doughnuts warm, and decorate them to order right in front of you. The same fast food theatre as Chipotle. But the doughnuts are all exactly the same underlying flavor and texture, therefore, and they have no "chew", they just fall apart in your mouth. 

I have a dark secret -- I dislike fresh doughnuts. The texture improves over time I feel. You get a nice crust and the crumb dries out a bit and it provides a better bite. I tried these a few hours after purchase and they were still just okay, Maybe just not my thing. It's fun that someone is trying a new experience in doughnuts, and this clearly is a winning formula. 

The staff were all fantastic and I am sure this is exactly what many people want, but I just didn't love it. 

Plus I ordered the pumpkin frappé and it didn't taste like coffee, even, much less pumpkin or spice or sugar. It was weird.

Not a fan  and over-priced!  If you want to change a burrito to a bowl by removing the torilla it costs $1.00.  Also, if you want actual hot sauce $.75 cents.  Might as well go to Parilla Grill.  Better choices, cheaper prices and you won't be charged for actual hot sauce or making it a bowl (which is absolute BS).  Just wondering when the owner is going to start reading these reviews!

Do not trust this property management. They might try to hook you with low rent prices but they'll charge you all the fees they can. And outrageous fees at that. I currently have charges on my account for $220, $300 "late" fees. They don't try to work with you.
They do not take care of their properties either. At least, not mine. I lived at the Michigan house for a year, all four seasons, and in the winter, not once did anyone show up to take a look at the house. There was a big thing on the news about ice dams and to look out for them and we had them. I sure as heck wasn't going to go up on that roof myself and break something trying to clean that mess.
This summer, up until around July 15th, we finally got an AC that worked. Meaning, in the 100+ degree heat, we were melting in that house. We couldn't sleep, we took cold showers, anything to try to help. But I'm sure the property managers were going home to an air conditioned house.
It's unprofessional on their part. If I'm going to end up paying $1,000/mo, I expect better service.

I went into the store specifically looking for an RC car that could exceed 30mph+ and was given a few options I was told would work. After getting home and setting up the car, it didn't even reach 25mph. I figured, no problem, I'll have my PA call and arrange a return so I can get something that works. Well, no go, they flat out lied about the speed then, they wouldn't even help resolve the issue. Given that my kids are so young, they've lost a decade+ of patronage and guaranteed I'll just take my chances online. I mean, how could online shopping be worse? At least most online retailers would accept a return.

New breakfast place which is a good eating choice for breakfast and lunch items. It is staffed by very conscientious young people (mainly) who were all business and keeping the place running smoothly.

The food was well prepared and satisfying. The place is new and the help was keeping the place clean and appealing, Prices seem higher than other places we patronize, but the servings are large and we felt could be split easily.

Parking was plentiful. Surprisingly busy for a weekday.

The only thing that made us think we might not come too often is that the place holds a lot of people and is a bit hard to hear over the background noise.. it is not really loud, but the large areas of windows make the acoustics hard to overcome..

Would you believe me if I told you I don't really love sweets?  because I'm definitely more of a savory person. My girls and husband however...
