This place is fabulous!! First, it's gorgeous. All the white for the ice cream to pop and lots of gramable backdrops. Really great location to get your new profile pic. 

The gal who was working was so sweet! Kind and genuine greeting when we walked in, followed by a quick rundown of how everything works. The kids ordered for themselves and loved watching their ice cream get dipped in the pretty toppings!! That alone is pretty fun for them. 

Husband suggested we share and I agreed. I'm normally one who only wants a bite or two, then I'm done. But this was heavenly, and I was a little sad when it was all gone. The salted caramel and pretzels balanced the sweet chocolate and peanut butter... it was amazing! 

We will definitely be back! We have so many more combos to try.

The service at this place seems to be going down faster than the Titanic. This restaurant is close to our home and we have visited many times, I would say most visits are average when referencing the service or the food but we like the building. The last two times have been a different story. Prior to last night the time before we went we ordered our food and did not get any condiments and parts of the meal were missing , and our drinks were never refilled. But what I'm really here to talk about is my visit last night, it was a picture perfect bad visit. When we entered the restaurant there was no hostess at the station but after a few minutes she showed up and promptly seated us. After a while the waitress showed up seem nice took our drink order but couldn't answer basic questions about the menu. Fast forward a while and the hostess is asking asking if we seen our waitress yet because we still don't have our drinks. We told her yes and continue to wait and our drinks came.  We finally ordered our food and the waitress said she would get me a refill of my soda and took my wife's water glass to get her a refill. Our dinner came she ordered a pizza and I order the finger steaks I asked for basic condiments and they never did come also let me remind you all but still we are without drinks. My wife's pizza came on the pizza tray with a spatula but was not offered a plate. We asked for red peppers and asked about our drinks and she said that she would go and get them. I will just go to the end, my wife never did get a plate, she never did get a drink, we didn't get the red peppers and tell after we had boxed up the pizza, and I never did get my condiments. The finger steaks at this establishment are nothing more then highly breaded slivers of meat. Oh and I better not forget to mention that at least one third of my finger steaks were chicken.  

I've seen that the manager often answers to win people post negative reviews, I don't know my table number or my receipt number but if you'd like to Mr manager feel free to look for my receipt it's got a note written on the back of it saying some of what I just said. I challenge you to watch the security tape and argue any point that I just made. Needless to say I doubt wild horses could drag me back into this restaurant

Don't go here they don't put your food in the bag, I ordered food and back to back twice in a row they didn't put my food in there. at least double check before you leave or tell your DoorDash to check.

Decent wings. I forgot to ask for extra crispy but they were still very good. I did the parmesan fries and those were amazing. Im still a sucker for the lemon pepper for the wings. We also did the Korean flavor, good but very messy. Was a great easy take home dinner. You can order online and pick up at a p/u window. Convenient.

What can I say but absolutely delicious and great customer service after a rough day travleing. I had the mojate....spelled wrong I am sure, but the sauce was bubbling hot and fl of meat and bacon wrapped prawns. Coctail was a little light. Only in Boise for a few days, but this place is a diamond in the rough.

Had dinner there last night with my family. Burgers would have been better if they went and picked them up from 5 guys next door. Ahi Ciabatta wan't bad but over cooked for ahi. It also reminded me of the 'where's the beef' commercials. When it came time to pay I left a 12% tip. My wife asked why? I said I wasn't sure who I was tipping as I had three different people serving me. Didn't like that at all. Eight to ten tv screens going and not one had baseball on? Womens soccer? really? that will get the crowds into a sports bar. I know why the place was mostly empty now.

Brought my Mom here while in town visiting. Thought it might be something fun to do and offer a little girl time. We have never been before, or anywhere similar so it was an entirely new experience.

Pottery selection seemed vast at first, but I realized it was just spread out over a large area and in the category of small pieces there wasn't a ton to choose from. I can assume these pieces are the most popular, so maybe they were just between shipments?

Process was explained very well to us, and we were checked in on several times to see how we were doing.

Paint color options fair for the beginner. There was a woman there who obviously frequents regularly, mixing her own custom colors. So apparently the selections can be built upon if your confident in your color mixing abilities.

Brush supplies were good. I honestly had no clue how to use half of them. So maybe a quick brush lesson could have proved useful.

Offering something to drink would have been nice. Painting for 3 hours made me wish I thought to bring something with me. Though I saw a fridge in the corner with nothing in it. So maybe that offering is coming?

They do offer birthday parties. One happened while we were there. Kids seemed to have fun and party seemed to be organized.

Great place to relax and meditate a bit. I would absolutely come again. My kids would love it here too. Though I kinda want to keep it to myself!

These people don't know what a chocolate malt is. I ordered a chocolate malt and the girl put crunch bars in my shake. The worst tasting shake. If you don't know your job you should quit or be fired!!!

Wait e an additional 30 mins for an online order. When it finally came out, biscuits were cold and hard, gravy was cold and barely covered my biscuits. Staff was not watching to go orders at all, they just sat on the shelf instead of calling out names so people could go on their way with a warm meal. The staff seemed nice, but would not go back due to food quality and service.
The food is very good. They cleaned well for my wife's celiac. Madison is a rockstar server!! The mimosas are great.. bloody Marie's are just ok. Highly recommend to all of western TV.

Very disappointing. Not Chicago deep dish style at all. And not very good. Way too salty. And I am usually told I use/like too much salt. The crust was soggy and lacking in flavor, like mushy cardboard. 

Sadly, I cannot recommend.

I have been taking my kids here since they were born (the first 4.5 years ago)  I was immediately impressed with Dr. Butuk, as he made a "house call" to the birthing center I had my first son at, hours after he was born to look at a possible hernia. 

I love Dr. Butuk's approach to medicine.  I personally question immunizations, medications, etc. and want to be educated and given the choice, and not told what I should be doing. He has worked with me on both my boys, to create a modified immunization schedule that I am comfortable with.  He is also great at answering any questions that you may have in language you can understand.

Always straight and to the point, no nonsense.  

My boys LOVE the nemo themed kids waiting room.  Great paintings on the wall, low doorway entrance that makes them feel like they are entering a special magical place.

Wait time is never very long, and whenever it does get a little lengthy they are always quick to update you on why things are a little behind.

They allow you to drop in, if you need an immunization between regular appointments, which is nice.  And saves you a doctor visit point on your insurance program.

Only criticism is the hit and miss service you get with the nurse practitioners.  My husband seems to have the worst luck, when he gets stuck with these visits.  There just seems to be inconsistency on diagnosis, a sense of being rushed, vague explanations to diagnosis, and I don't ever feel the "right to choose" approach that Dr. Butuk always gives.  This area does put me on the fence about lowering the review to 3 stars.  

Example: Took my infant in for a bad diaper rash.  Nurse told me he had a bad diaper rash with a possible bacterial infection and prescribed an ointment.  One week went by and the rash was not even a stitch better.  Returned, saw same nurse.  She didn't even remember that I had been in literally one week to the day and asked what I had been doing thus far.  Discovered that he had an ear infection and for sure a yeast infection in the diaper area, and prescribed an antibiotic.  Infection and large percentage of rash went away.  Had a well baby check soon after with Dr Butuk, I asked about the rash and he actually explained to me how these rashes happen and ways to help prevent.  He also refilled my prescription for the diaper cream.  When I picked it up, it was actually a powder.  Genius!  Do you know how much easier it is to put powder on a squirmy 16 month old, than a cream?  Got me thinking, why didn't I  get this in the first place?

Only other bummer I ran into, was when I was pregnant with my second child I got a horrible rash.  I didn't have a primary care physician and needed to see someone to get it checked out.  They wouldn't take me, because I was pregnant.  Ended up being shingles, which sucked because it ended up being about a week before I finally went to an urgent care to get diagnosed.

The worst property management ever. They are thieves, they try to charge you extra money as much as they can do. They charged me extra $140 for deposit even though I paid $500 before I moved in. I refused to pay, then they charged me for late fees. I requested a maintenance service and they never take care of ot. Terrible Property management. Stay away these guys...

After one or two drinks I quickly became hooked on the coffee here! The drinks are balanced and delicious and, in my opinion, some of the best coffee in the valley. Unfortunately, the drive through is killer. Wait times are usually a little high- which I understand; quality takes time- but I waited probably close to 20 minutes in line this morning. I recognize the challenges of food service, especially on a Sunday morning during the pandemic, but it just wasn't worth it for such a long line- and then when we got to the window, we weren't acknowledged for even a minute or two more. A little disappointed in the service this morning. 

Tl;dr- great coffee, get ready for a wait. And avoid the drive through!

Always friendly service, and they have a lot of options for people who like white chocolate! Instead of the regular chocolate or speckled "quail's egg" chocolate coffee beans that most shops have, they have extra super tasty white chocolate covered coffee beans (which they will let you buy in a little sack if you are so inclined) and I hope they never stop offering them, since my Mom and I love them. 
Don't worry if you prefer the others, they have those as well :)
My current favourite drink is the white hot chocolate, perfect for warming you up if you're cold, or just relaxing you after a stressful day. 
That said, their smoothies are also super tasty!
We love the atmosphere too. It's a great place to meet up with people and chat over a coffee or two (or more)

We went to try a new place and to give some support to a new, locally owned business during these trying times for restaurants. 

Inside we found a great selection of different foods for a coffee shop. Their signature dishes were Papusas which originate in the El Salvador and Central America area.  Pupusas are traditionally served with curtido (a pickled cabbage relish, analogous to German Sauerkraut and Korean kimchi that comes in mild and spicy varieties) and tomato sauce, and are traditionally eaten by hand. They are similar to the Mexican Gordita, but gorditas are usually open at one end. They are hearty enough to serve as a lunch item with a coffee or soft drink.

Coffee is Dawson and Taylor.

Other food items available included fajitas, pastries, and meat and guava cream, flake pastry pies. The cooking is all done by the owner and she cooks to order. We enjoyed the food and free wifi. We will return.

One night, we decided to go the overload routine and have a burger and fries. Hadn't done that out in a long time. So we decided, 5 Guys would be our return to a diet of meat, fat, grease and salt; the basic 4 food groups.

The place is pretty much a burgers and hot dogs place. The location was open and bright, pretty clean for the dinner hour. The guy on the register was great at explaining to us how things worked. Pretty much order what condiments you want. Could even have a bunless burger with a "lettuce bun". Fries can be had in several sizes in regular salt or Cajun Spices. There is no vegetarian burger choice, but there is a BLT available.

Burgers come in large and small. the large burgers have two beef patties and the small has one patty. Cheese and bacon are available for an additional price.

Cooking was to order and pretty quickly done. While you wait, you can eat as many peanuts in the shell as you like. The food is delivered in a plain brown sack with the fries grease sort of soaking thru the bag. The burgers come wrapped in aluminum foil and a wax paper. That sort of steams the bun. some like it that way, some do not. Personally it makes the burger seam greasier than normal, since the bun gets sort of squishy.

While I found the burger and fries OK, my wife didn't like the burger much (too greasy), she say. We found the fries were tasty, but salty. Probably wouldn't do the Cajun spices again. The combined calories and fat in that meal adds up to more than the daily load for any kind of healthy diet. Wouldn't pay to eat that meal very often.

Summary? We would probably not go back again, as there are other burger places we like more. Different tastes for different folks. The standard for my comparisons is the burger at Goodwood BBQ.

Great Mexican food in Boise, very authentic unlike others. My go to restaurant when I want the closest to Mexican food I can get. I love their carne asada tacos with beans and rice. Beware that their portions are huge! But if you're like me and can eat then get your own plate.

The hype for this restaurant didn't live up to expectations unfortunately. The location is okay, hard to get too going north bound, but it's workable. 

Food is extremely pricy for what you're getting. The burgers are small and left me hungry. I even was confused because I ordered a double but it looked like a single. Went to the counter and was informed that both patties were there. Couldn't believe what I though was a small McDonald's patty was 2 patties here. 

Ordered a frozen custard and didn't finish. Was too sweet for me. A bit disappointed. Won't return for awhile.

If your in the market to buy a new home, please be prepared for a LONG wait, and they will lie to you about the completion date by MANY MONTHS!  They will always use the weather as there fall back, but when the weather is in Spring, etc, there is NO excuse.  Also, be prepared to have horrible customer service!  Their warranty guy (now) will tell you all the things you want to hear, but when it comes time for repairs.... Hold your breath as they are mostly focused on building NEW homes, not fixing yours.  It took me 1 1/2 years to get the exterior of my home finally touch-up painted - as a good example.  There were also items that were repaired, that needed another repair (just outside the warranty) and although it was the exact same repair (house settling and door wouldn't close) I was told too bad.  I also had a siding repair that should have been addressed, but was told that since it would cost over $1500 they wont address it, and I was still under my 1 year warranty.  These comments go neighbor to neighbor, I haven't spoken to 1 yet that didn't have similar issues with them.  I was told prior to buy a new home to stay away from Hubble Homes as they are not good quality, then CBH Homes, sort of same thing, but good customer service, then comes Coleman - home quality is OK, but customer service is at most a 1 star.  They completely focus on getting you to sign the dotted line, then you are just waiting in line.....and they do NOT uphold the completion or milestone dates they tell you upon signing.  We were told 4 1/2 months, took 9 1/2 months to complete ours. Really love living in a hotel for shy of a year with all of our personal belongings in a storage racking up those bills... Thanks Coleman, we will never buy one of these homes again.  

1 last note.... I did work as an Operations Coordinator at a Home Builder for 7 years and the top priority was the homebuyer, and how happy they were with our homes we built them, this is NOT even close tot he case with Coleman.  I have warned ya, I hope you hear these words and look elsewhere. You'll be happier for it!

We visited this restaurant again last week and I think we might make this a regular breakfast spot. The food amount is very generous, not to mention extremely delicious. Service was phenomenal and staff was very attentive which is saying something when you show up with two babies. As the name implies they have a large selection of breakfast foods, basically anything and everything breakfast related. My wife's omelet was huge and we were glad to take some home for a mid-day snack. I ordered the club and boy that thing was enormous! If only this place was closer to my neighborhood. Highly recommend!

I've stopped in here a couple of times. Both times the wait staff was attentive and friendly. Food was served hot and had fairly good flavor. I prefer this place over the more commonly known mexican joints.

This was my 2nd time at the Broken Yolk. This time, I again had the CFS. What can I say, Im a sucker for Chicken Fried Steak. This time, it was way worse. The steak was very greasy.

My guess is that this is a frozen CFS and not even real. Again, the eggs were not scrambled. The hash browns were good, but unsure if they were real or also from frozen.

There was a sign on the door for help. This seemed normal with the state of so many places. But then I took note of the greeter at the front. She did nothing but stay at her station and play on her cell phone.

At one point, she saw someone she knew that came in, so she followed them to their table and talked. At the same time, there were people waiting at the front to be seated.

Sorry, but for me, I wont be back here again.

Wasn't a huge fan. I had chicken in a creme sauce (see pictures) chips and salsa also very average. Probably won't be coming back, maybe I should have went with the option on the front of the menu (looks good). Still searching for that 5* Mexican restaurant in the treasure valley.

I really like this spot! One of my fave poke spots in The treasure valley! 
I will say it's a bit pricey but the bowls have unique choice toppings and really fresh fish.
Location is awesome as well since there are a lot of local shops on Eagle rd. 
Will most definitely be back!

Broken Yolk is the hopping new breakfast place for North West Meridian. I recommend calling ahead to secure your seat as the wait times can be a long time, especially during weekends. 

The location is clean and bustling. Really enjoyed the vibe, especially post lockdown, really enjoyed going here for the atmosphere. The food is about average though and nothing to write home about. There is a lot of competition in the breakfast joints, especially in Ada county, and I feel broken yolk rides very comfortably in the middle of the pack. Prices were high and for tbag cost I expected a bit more.

I have been wanting to try Duck Donuts ever since they announced they were coming into Eagle. Well, my husband surprised us with a box coming home from work! What a sweetheart! 
I love that they are freshly made, and we live about 20-25 mins away and once my husband got home they were still warm! 
I wish I was there to be able to pick the flavors I'd personally like, but overall most were very good! 

One thing I'd like to add though, they throw out the donuts when they're not made perfectly the way it's supposed too. Why?!!!!
No eliprical machines????? I mean not even one machine????? Big building with open floor plan. Clean equipment but no elliptical kills it for me.

I have told everyone not to believe the low star ratings for Broken Yolk Cafe, and if you haven't tried it yet, you would go elsewhere from reading what others say.  

 Whenever someone tells me where is a good place to go for breakfast, I tell them the Broken Yolk. You ought to go there and try out for yourself. There are vegan options too that I and everyone else I take there taste and they love it and want to go back. 

The place can be packed, so to avoid waiting in the long line, you can request a reservation online by their website.

Love Freddy's. We had this back home in Kansas and it's so yummy! Really satisfied the burger and fries craving. And their pumpkin custard is so good!! The only reason I have to dock one star is because they don't have enough booths to sit in at the restaurant.

This Meridian restaurant used to be known as Gramercy Park Pizza & Grill. In August 2021, due to the labor shortage, and to serve their guests more efficiently with less staff, they made the decision to remove all pizza and pastas from their menu at this time. I'm sad to hear that because they had a unique pizza on their menu that I loved,The Jolly Green Giant. Their current menu has some new items, as well as some old favorites.

Idaho Cheesesteak ($14) - Slow cooked pot roast served on a hoagie roll with caramelized onion, your choice of cheese (American, Cheddar, Swiss or Pepper Jack), black pepper aioli. Served with house cut fries. Substitute sweet potato fries ($1.50) or half Hidden Valley or Caesar salad ($2.50). 

The Idaho Cheesesteak, while not traditional, is one of my very favorite menu items at Gramercy Park. I get it with house cut fries. 

Highly Recommended!!!

Address: 1626 S. Wells Ave. - Suite 115
                 Meridian 

Hours:
Sunday - Monday - Closed
Tuesday - Thursday: 11:30 AM to 9 PM
Friday: 11:30 AM to 9:30 PM
Saturday: 12 PM to 9 PM

Came here after church on Sunday, arriving before the lunch rush so the place was pretty quiet.  Was seated immediately and order was taken pretty quickly.  Wait for food seemed a little lengthy considering what we ordered.  Waiter was friendly and fairly attentive.

However the actual food, which is what we came for, right?  Was so disappointing I honestly am not sure I will go back. Ordered the Huckleberry Salmon Salad.  Sounded AMAZING!!!!  Candied walnuts, sliced pears, dried cranberries, bleu cheese crumbles, huckleberry vinaigrette. Sounds mouth watering right?!?!

Well . . . What arrived was a plate of romaine lettuce, with a very small piece of very dry salmon.  Toppings??  At first I thought they forgot them, but upon digging around I found they were all at the bottom of the plate.  Pears: four thin slices.  Really??? Probably the equivalent of 1/15th of a pear.  Dressing:  Thank goodness I asked to have it on the side.  It was like syrup it was so sweet.  Totally disappointing.  :(

Ordered a grilled cheese with curly fries for the kids.  Meh . . . Best part of their meal was the free ice cream dessert.

Definitely not high on the priority list to revisit again anytime soon.

Just finished a Christmas cookie making class this morning. Very disappointed with the overly rushed schedule, way too little to show for the $69 fee, elementary / rudimentary baking techniques. We ran out of materials; frosting, sprinkles...even paper plates on which to carry our 11 cookies home!
Instructor was sweet, & assistant staff were lovely. Friends who attended the class with me were delightful!  
Next time we'll meet in one of our homes and have the same fun but will go home with 4 or 5 dozen cookies, each, to share with our families for Christmas.

We received s gift card from some friends of ours for this place so we thought we would order takeout last weekend. I ordered a salad with ahi tuna which was so bland and overall disappointing. My husband ordered an appetizer and a burger. The appetizer were these fries with melted cheese. It was awful. So so gross. Tasted like they used expired ingredients. My husband said his burger was pretty good hence the 2 stars. We were expecting the dishes to be stellar because some friends of ours ordered pizza from here and it was pretty good, however we will never order the main dishes again and will stick to only pizza if we return.

The hotel grounds is completely full of dog poop - it is everywhere!!  Front, sides and back area - you can't avoid!! The guest don't pick up after their dogs. I have never seen so much dog crap surrounding a hotel. The smell and filth is terrible, gross, very unpleasant.  I approached the clerk at the desk and inquired why has the hotel hasn't done anything to curb this major problem. She just shrugged her shoulders and said "I don't know!"  There was fresh poop and old poop everywhere. Don't stay here. Run from it!!  Not even worth one star.

Good product, good environment, and good prices. I normally would love a place like this but the barista at the register wasn't wearing a mask my entire visit. I know it's different in meridian and it's not mandated anymore but I certainly won't come here ever again
Stopped in today for a growler refill. First time here. Cool place. Super friendly staff. Great selection of beer and ciders. Jam-packed so no where to sit (and good for them) but we'll be back!

We have eaten here several times and each time we are pleased with what we select.

The food is tasty and authentic. Always friendly and cordial service by young ladies. They will suggest items if you ask.

The previous reviews pretty much set the scene. We find that the soups are good, but perhaps a little too much cheese can be added. So be aware and ask for a little less cheese. The beer is served very cold and in a frosted mug. The margaritas are also nicely done.

Serving sizes are ample. We often have to hold ourselves back or we will end up taking food home. For sit down Mexican this is our choice. But for quick fare street style , we like Lorena's (see my separate review).

This is a tricky review to write because I am not a super huge fan of this place because they don't have many options for vegans, however my family loves this restaurant. So overall my summary would be this is a great place for vegetarians and meat eaters, but probably not the best pick for a vegan. 

They do have steel cut oats though and a few of their sides are vegan such as avocado, fruit, and toast. You could make the avocado toast entrée vegan by omitting the egg on top of it. They do have açaí sherbet which the server confirmed is vegetarian but I am not sure if it is vegan. It comes with honey and I just got it with agave syrup instead.

The kids meals are a fantastic deal, six dollars for an main, two sides, and a drink. You can pay a dollar extra for the hot cocoa, which my kids loved. Two dollars for a kids yogurt parfait for dessert is another option. The three kids meals we got were pancakes, hamburger, and grilled cheese, all of the kids love their kids meals. 

My husband loved his breakfast egg skillet meal and especially his bloody Mary. 

We went for Sunday morning breakfast. It is a very popular restaurant especially on the weekends so try to come before 9:30 AM if you don't want to wait. 

On the main yelp page it says social distancing is enforced however it is not because it is too popular of a restaurant to do every other booth, the wait would be too long. 

Staff are friendly and we didn't have to wait too long for food even though there were many customers. It is a sit down restaurant with servers. The temperature is a little chilly inside so you might want to wear long sleeves if you get cold easily.

Yummy warm donuts! Glad we made the trek from DT Boise for these. 

P.S. Please open a donut shop by the University...we need more options!!

Kinda bummed they didn't have any of the "Cheesecake" promo flavors.
But loved that you can decide to make your own donut flavors and can have a full customized dozen if you choose to. 
Adorable and super helpful that they put reheating instructions right on your donut box. 
The shop's hours seem wonderful especially if we get a hankering for some tasty treats on a Friday...haha
Recommend giving them a try! 

**Apologies on the not so great pic I took of our dozen**

Nice instructor, nice participants, great environment, very accessible. 

I thought the instructor seemed what you'd want from one--super kind, knowledgeable, and bursting to talk about yoga should you want to.
The participants all seemed really supportive and kind, definitely a community vibe, again, what you'd want.
Environment was super-accessible (right off overland, 5 minutes from my place and about the same from work) but upon arrival is immediately a warm, quiet sanctuary. One again, it too was exactly what you'd hope for

I had a blast with my whole family taking a sushi class here. We were in town visiting my parents for the holidays and all signed up to take a class together (6 of us). The entire process was well-led,super clean, as fun. The only downside is that my husband and I had to work with two strangers because you have to work in teams of four (I would have preferred just working as a couple). Will definitely be back for more classes at our local location.
Don't bother if you're Jewish. The old management valued diversity, the new management DOES NOT.

Tried to order online, unable to accept order.  Called store and was told too many orders so they couldn't take online orders.  My wife drove over, 4 people in line, ordered and waited 10-15 min- reasonable.  Got home, $7 fry was barely a full cup, no extra in the bag.  Went to bite burger bun was stale and hard.  Hamburger was clearly over cooked and like hard jerkey.  Called the store for the manager to tell me they were busy and trying to shut things down.  Worst five guys experience ever.  For $16 for a burger and fries I at least expected fresh food and good portions. Avoid this business like the plague.

After almost 2 years in Idaho I have finally found authentic Mexican food!!! I owe a huge thank you to fellow Yelper, Greg D! He recommended Mi Casa to me several weeks ago.  I tend to be very hard to please when it comes to Mexican food.  I grew up in Southern California, so my expectations are very high! 

We arrived at Mi Casa right around 8pm on a Thursday evening.  As we walked in I was surprised to find out that Mi Casa is actually a full service restaurant. With it being in a strip mall and not being a freestanding building I expected it to be a fast food type establishment.  We were quickly greeted by our server who came with chips & salsa and beans WITH CHEESE!! Nice touch! We took some time to look over the menu and finally decided on the following:


Steak fajitas
Bean & Cheese burrito

I am uber picky about refried beans.  I gauge the authenticity of Mexican restaurants by their beans.  I absolutely hate it when they add a bunch of unnecessary things to refried beans! 

Our food arrived quickly and looked & smelled amazing! The portion size of the fajitas was huge! The presentation of the fajitas was also very nice! They gave us everything that we could possibly want for toppings.  The steak was delicious! It was tender and seasoned perfectly.  Talking about it now makes my mouth water!!  The burrito was also delicious.  

Our server was attentive and very nice.  She does her job very well.  She was very friendly and you could tell that she really enjoys her job.  She went out of her way to make a personal connection with each of her tables.  It's a nice touch. 

Mi Casa is definitely now on my list of restaurants that I will regularly go to! 

**note** So, I wrote this review months ago & forgot to post it! I just found this in my "drafts".  I'm a moron! Lol.  I have visited Mi Casa several times since writing this & I continue to be impressed! I have nothing bad to say at all!
I have called and left several messages. No one ever returned my call. If they are too busy to accept new clients, I get it. But the polite thing to do is to let a person know.

I usually find AT&T to be almost nail biting but this location was amazing. We came in to add my elderly mother to our plan to save her some money (I take care of my mother as she has early onset dementia)
The specialist we dealt with had first knowledge with Alzheimer's and trying to change my mothers current cricket phone to a new phone was too much for one day but this gentleman was willing to work with her every day for as long as it took for a new phone when she was ready. I definitely recommend this place.

What the heck do you do in Idaho in the winter time???   Besides hunker down indoors like most peeps, you venture out to eat and for God's sake..... DRINK BEER!!!    While visiting my son for Christmas (yes this review is severely late)  I had researched a bunch of local places to try if we got a get out of jail pass.  

By reading this review, it is safe to assume, we received that "jail pass"  lol. We were very happy with the tap list.  I come from NCal and IPA is king here.  Hazy especially!   They had an awesome Hazy from Revision Brewing that we absolutely loved.  

We took it upon ourselves (meaning me) to school up the local beer tender on all things IPA and Hazy.  Yes, it is a gift and I am thankful hahaha.  

If you are ever in bum freakin Idaho and are craving real suds, give this place a try and let them know Dave sent you.   

Of course that won't do anything for you or know who you are talking about but it will fulfill my passion of being recognized as a "hop head"   :)  

Thank you for your service  "Merica!!!!!!

You guys got rid of a lot of great things on the menu. I was very disappointed when I could not order the beef stroganoff or even pizza. Only ordered drinks and then left. This used to be a go to place but not anymore.
Ever since the new owner took over it's gone to shit. The owner doesn't care about any customers and is a complete bitch when she doesn't get your order right

I don't like to leave bad reviews, I really don't. So I'll start my review with a positive note. Customer service was friendly! 

I have heard the ads for Sweeto burrito. I have passed it a few times, and thought "I should try that".  I finally decided to give it a try after hearing a passerby talking about how it was good while I was in Costco.

I left Costco and it was lunch time so i decided yesterday was the day. I have $24 worth of regret lol. Seriously. My husband threw his burrito after two bites--he NEVER does that. NEVER. 

I decided I wasn't gonna waste mine even if it wasn't great, so I ate as much as I could. But the amount of mayo based (I think?) sauce was overwhelming. The flavors were confusing. The meat was mehhh. 

As if that wasn't enough, the trips to the bathroom after have really sealed the deal.  I wish I was kidding.

So since it came down to the last few weeks before close Coleman and specifically Matt Jolley and Brian from the Oaks community sales staff have been anything but helpful. Coleman has no complaint line or customer service number to call and get the right information. Matt repeatedly told us that his sole responsibility and care is for Coleman and not us. He called my wife instead of me because he thought it was easier to bully my wife and not me. Coleman botched the closing process terribly told us repeatedly that we didn't need the certificate of occupancy or the finale purchase agreement. His exact words were, "I have done this multiple times and you don't need that to close, we do it all the time!" I have since checked with multiple mortgage companies and was told that it is required before they can even give a finale approval. They caused us to close late and caused us to pay more rent. If it were the other way around they would charge us daily for not meeting the expectation but since it's in their best interests they don't seem to care. They stonewall you when you want to talk with anyone except the sales staff because they see it fit to keep the complaints under the table. Matt stated multiple times that he didn't care that she was upset even though we had just closed this morning on our home. They have to be the worst builder in the state when it comes to customer service and they will make the closing process Hell. Coleman homes and Toll brothers should be considered a used car dealer of the home builders section.

This craft store is pretty good, but I find it to tailor mainly towards certain hobbies, more than an overall supply of all things craft.

If you are a beader, a scrapbooker, or a quilter than this store will most likely have something for you!

I find their selection of silk flowers to be of great quality, and frequently on sale=good prices!  I also love their selection of games and toys for kids. Lots of non name brand games you have never heard of, that all sound so fun! They also carry a great selection on Melissa and Doug toys, which both myself and my kids love.

They are open till 10pm on weekdays, which is great when you realize at 9pm you need a supply to finish a project!

First to start I will say for the most part I had a really positive experience with the customer service I received. The receptionist was nice and answered all my questions and my waxed was super professional and also made it a quick and awesome experience for My first wax with them. The only reason I'm giving this 3 stars is because the amount of hair patches I have down there is annoying and frustrating to think i paid to not Be fully wAxed. And I honestly don't know how's it was missed. Not sure if I'll  be back to this location or not. Currently seeking new recommendations

Delicious coffee, plenty of seating, and friendly customer service. First time visiting this place and I was very impressed. 

I drive down Chinden quite a bit and always see the "Coffee Studio" sign but never actually thought about dropping by and checking it out. When I first walked in, the place was practically empty and there were so many options to sit down and study. I was even pleasantly impressed that they had a printer and gave the public access to print material for a small fee of 10 cents. A great thing to keep in mind if you're a student and need to print something last minute. 

I ordered my typical coconut flavored latte and the price was a little bit more than what I am accustomed to. Nevertheless, I was happy to find out that their sizes were definitely bigger than what I'm used to with other coffee shops. Also, the person who took my order came out from behind and physically came to my location and gave me my coffee. Now that's service!

I do have to mention that during my stay, a middle aged couple came in and sat in the corner of the store where they proceeded to have loud conversations on their phones, especially the gentleman who used headphones to talk on his phone and paced back and forth. The most disturbing part was the countless amount of times he would open the entrance door, went outside, and immediately come back in while talking on his phone. The door kept slamming and letting in cold air. A bit rude and quite disturbing when you are a law student simply trying to get some homework done. 

I don't want to be quick to judge this place. I really hope my next visit will be a pleasant one and I would like to bump my review from four to five stars.
Food was fresh and tasted great! Just a little pricy. It was clean and the two young people that served us were polite. Would definitely eat there again!

I am absolutely in awe with Mt Timber Coffee. The excellent customer service, to the super cute and unique atmosphere to the deliciously crafted coffee, is all wonderful. This coffee shop is incredibly cozy, and reminds me of home. The windows radiant an incredible amount of light + good vibes along with the incredibly comfy seating options. The coffee is crafted incredibly well, making my Iced Irish Cream Breve, the best I've ever had. Mt Timber has taken it's place as my all-time-favorite coffee shop, and I'm incredibly stoked to have even found it!!

The problem I have with them is that they came in and quoted 2 hours of service and performed that level of service and billed us that for the first few months. Then they steadily decreased their time until they were spending less than an 1:15. Sometimes they were in and out in an hour so we were paying $70 per man hour.

They do an ok job. When they spent the time it was fine. Otherwise it was very fast and superficial. My younger son started leaving little tests on places like the faucet in his bathroom to see if they'd catch it. It took weeks before they got one.

Stopped by on a Saturday. I've been looking forward to trying this place ever since I saw their storefront. Plus, it's just down the street from me! 

Having spent many, many years in the bakery/donut shop business, I've been very curious about this product. What could be better than a sweet treat that's low fat, low carb, low sugar with a fair amount of protein? 

I'll do pros and cons....

Pros: 
They taste good for what they are. No strange after taste. Light and sweet. 

Fair priced at 18.99 a dozen. I think individually they were $2.00 each. 

Cons: 
It's not a replacement for a real donut. More of a light muffin consistency than a donut. Not a yeasty raised donut of course. 

They don't have a display case so you can't see what you're buying other than a photo of the item on the sign on the wall. They take your order and prepare it in the back.

As far as the shop itself.... it was nice and spacious with multiple tables and barstools. 

I'm sure they are still figuring things out but a little professionalism goes a long way. I don't mind seeing your muscles but I do mind your armpit hair over my donuts so sleeved shirts would be more appropriate in food service. Also... I know every kid in town has a runny nose this time of year but that's all the more reason to keep your kiddos in the back. Not real appetizing to see one with snot running down his nose, mouth and chin and growling at customers. It was funny though! 

Will I go back?? Probably not because it's just not my thing. Would I recommend to others?? Yes! Give it a try and see for yourself!

This is one of the very first businesses my husband and I happened upon when we moved to Boise.  Four years later, we are still patients of Dr. Hanson.  I personally have  now been through 2 pregnancies in that time, and absolutely attribute relief from back and hip pain to their care. Very friendly staff, so accommodating when setting up an appointment, and never a long wait time.  They now even offer massage!!!   Only wish my insurance would cover chiropractic care, so I could go even more often!

This is a place of great understanding of the proper use of Chiropractic. (Getting adjusted on a regular to help keep your body in tune with itself. Instead of coming in only when it hurts.) If you would like to learn the truth about your health and how to stay healthy ( by knowing what to eat and drink or not) and being fit (proper ways to exercise) to sleep better than you ever have and live the longest fulfilled life possible. Knowing the five essentials with Living as intended. Go on in see Dr. Baker. He is a great guy who cares deeply and you, with the understanding of your body and what it needs to thrive, heal, and survive. He will help your innate heal your body from the inside out. I've seen him make miracles happen. Just you come and see help you and your family live up to its fullest potential! You won't regret it!
Decent sports bar with plenty of TVs for viewing, good beer selection and better-than-average food.  The buffalo chicken sandwich is great!

I have been getting regular monthly massages for the past 10 years and this was the first time I felt like running out as soon as arriving.  Because of our recent move, I haven't had a massage in about 6 months, so I was well overdue, plus, I had injured my neck and desperately needed a massage.

First, I arrived early and received a text from my masseuse saying she was running behind and I should just wait in my car (oh yeah, that's because it's in a professional business building on the 2nd floor and the building locks up at 5pm...my appointment was at 8pm).  Then after the gal comes and lets me in, she chats the entire time, which was fine, I am a talker too....but not during a massage, so I thought OK, she'll stop after she begins.  Then she shows me into a room that looked more like a storage room.....that's it? I thought to myself...weird. All I could hear in my head was "Run....Run!"  Then she began to change the table sheets (which looked like they were brought them from home...floral prints, no print...IMO).  I explained I needed her to concentrate on the right shoulder area only and needed it really worked, not super hard, but not a feather touch either.  She talked the ENTIRE time which I hate the most.  Of course, I should have said something, but she was really nice and I kept thinking she would stop, but she didn't.  Oh well, that kind of thing can always be worked out later with future appointments, so I wasn't too worried.  But I have had the same complaint for years and so do most women I talk to, don't massage therapists know you are there to RELAX? Talking is seriously annoying. 

Then on to my massage, or what was supposed to be a massage. Seriously, my 5 year old niece gives a firmer massage.  I told her she could go a little harder, but nothing.  That's all you get...I told her at the beginning what I wanted and expected and then again told her to go harder, so I was done.  

I got up and left as fast as I could.  Still in pain, but not as bad as it was, but I would definitely not recommend this place.
Had a great experience. They were able to get me in and out quickly and I got a great haircut! Nice quiet environment. Highly recommend!
Good stuff and supper good service custard id good and all problems are taken care of Nicely.

I want to give 5 stars because the food is good but the attitude of the 20-somethings working at this location is so disappointing.  Not a smile in sight.  Customer service is an inconvenience for them. I was impressed by the food the rudeness of the employees. Disappointing. So millennial. So makes me not want to spend my money here.

Wow! Wonderful staff here with great attitudes! Makes me want to upgrade my bike! As soon as we entered we were greeted by beautiful young lady with a great smile! All the other staff in the store was very helpful and friendly.
Great Ice cream and the sweetest staff!! We love coming here! And its always the go to place for our out of town guests. Everyone says its even better than what we could have described!

I have been amazed at how welcoming this neighborhood coffee shop has become. The coffee drinks were always good, but I haven't been in for quite awhile since we lived only a few blocks away. 

But yesterday day we went in for a cup of coffee and a snack about mid-morning. I was surprised at how many people were there. It has become quite a gathering place. There was still plenty of place to sit. They have comfy arm chairs, standard tables and chair, and outdoor seating. Good for those walking their dogs. 

Brewed coffees, smoothies, espressos, Italian ices, and more are offered. Pastries by Gaston were offered. 

Good for a visit with friends and leisurely passing the time.

Great food, but VERY COLD inside today. The air conditioning was not changeable. Today was not as hot outside, but inside Freezing. It was hard to enjoy our delicious sandwiches and burgers. Still love Broken Yolk, but very disappointed with this limited.

We signed a contract to purchase a home from Coleman Homes (now Toll Brothers) in August  2019 in the Fairhaven subdivision. We moved in to our new home April 2020. After many years of back and forth looking at different builders and communities, we settled on this builder because of the location of the neighborhood and the value of what we were looking for as far as size of home and a floor plan that fit our needs. 

Toll Brothers aka Coleman is a semi custom production builder. It's one of the biggest builders in the Boise/nampa area.  

The good:  The build experience by the most part was very positive, with the exception of one incident which I'll go through in the "bad" section.  But overall we had a good experience from start to finish.  Coleman/Toll Brothers is all about the experience from their beautiful model homes  to their sales/build experience.  They keep you informed, and for us, we were able to walk on our property pretty much every day (our temporary housing was only five miles away) We have now lived  in our home for about 18 months and both my husband and I feel it's a solid build.  It keeps us cool in the summer and warm in the winter. 

The not so good:  This builder hires subpar paint, finish and tile sub-contractors.  Let's start with the paint, the trim around the outside of our home is terrible and I will have to repaint it.  In defense of Toll brothers, because of "life," I did not catch the poor work until after our year warranty was up. Tile work... honestly I don't want to go into the details of how bad the tile work is, and Toll Brothers did fix one issue after much argument and debate, but as far as the rest of the house, bathrooms and laundry,  I'm not happy at all with the results--small uneven cuts, sloppy grout, etc.  Finish work:  again some pretty poor workmanship in the baseboards, particularly in our staircase going up to the bonus room.  This issue was never fixed, even though it was addressed during the warranty time, but the warranty manager moved on to a new neighborhood. My husband emailed a couple times to follow up but I believe there was no response.  

I think overall we were the lucky ones because I've heard so many complaints from neighbors about warranty issues,  but with the exception of the paint and baseboards, ours were all met.  

My advice to anyone buying a home from Toll brothers is  to first understand that the beautiful model homes are all upgraded!  All the fancy fixtures,  cabinets, moldings, flooring, etc are extra cost. We knew that going in and budgeted accordingly. Also, I guess this was one of my pet peeves...lighting--what you see in the models may not be what they offer in the showroom.  Meaning, they don't offer the pretty "Pottery Barn" looking lights above the kitchen island. You will have to add that on your own.  And that is exactly what we did.  Their lighting they offered, even the upgrades, was not to my taste at all, so we did builder included and purchased lighting to install afterwards.  Kind of silly to do that to a brand new home but Toll Brothers is SEMI-custom and so their options for lighting, plumbing fixtures, appliances, etc, is limited to what they have in the showroom. 

In closing, we are happy with our home, and this community, in particular, is awesome!

I'll be honest I'm surprised at so many positive reviews yet lower end scores. I usually am stingy on giving out 5 star ratings,  but I believe that this Baja fresh deserves it.

The food prices are very decent. Don't expect to break the wallet ordering for a family,  although enchaldo style can be a bit pricey. 

The drink selection is better than what you would get at most chain locations with a wide variety;  given this,  I still only order Soda or water. The refillable drink cups are good value even at home. 

The staff is kind and have been working here for awhile. Just quality customer service. 

Major plus. They still do punch cards!  Any location that does this I can get behind! Support this business because I think you'll enjoy the experience.

Disappointed. We went to the wait list and placed our name on it, waited the 30 minutes till our name came up. Our name did come up for us to be seated.
We went inside only to be told that it would be another 35 minutes until we could be seated and that the wait list was wrong in determining our time.
We've been going here twice a month, at least, always placing our name on the wait list and this has never happened.  Very disappointing. 
I hope that it was just a computer problem or new staff because the food is great and the wait staff is excellent.
Jamie was so nice and welcoming. The inside is beautiful and comfortable. Good portion sizes and reasonable reasonable prices. Loved our experience
I'm not a coffee drinker, but they make excellent smoothies and hot chocolates. This place has a cozy, eclectic interior and is a must try.

The food was of good quality and quantity, but a little pricey. Excellent service. The place was very clean. The food was delicious. 

I got the hash skillet with corn beef and was bummed that it wasn't homemade corn beef hash  - or didn't taste homemade, very reminiscent of Mary Kitchen canned. My loving husband of 31 years got the country skillet and thoroughly enjoyed it. The gravy was very good. The plates were cleanly presented. 

We would come back here when we are in the area again.

Bite Me bars is absolutely delicious!! My kids love the ice cream bars and I am a HUGE fan of the frozen banana with sprinkles!!! Great customer service and I also love that they follow the Covid mask mandate! We are fans for life!!!

Pretty good pizza, friendly staff and tasty cannoli's

Would definitely come back again

I normally love this place so this is based off of my most recent experience. I get the white mocha, which is amazing. I was enjoying my Friday morning coffee and all of a sudden there was a hair in my mouth... definitely not mine. I opened the lid and found more hair...ewwww so disappointed
Bruchi's is a yummy addition to the local restaurant scene! Super good bread and subs - but my favorite is that chicken/walnut/cranberry salad they have - SOOOOO good! Definitely, one I crave often!
I've eaten here twice now.  I had the noodle soup both times and it's really good.  My daughter loved the chicken strips and fries.  The server was very friendly and checked on us frequently.
Traveling through Idaho with my boys and what's better than Kona coffee and smoothies. Very tasty and friendly staff. Highly recommend.

Visited here when they had been open only about a month. Food was expensive and average.  Got the Pad Thai and it was not tasty.  Got a refund and ordered another dish that was equally as meager but the manager was friendly and apologetic.  Drinks are overpriced.  At least the decor is neat and trendy.  Hoping my experience was just a kink being worked out from recently being open.

The overall village is an unbelievable place to visit.  It is a must do if ever in Meridian or Boise.   Something for everyone . All the restaurants are four stars or more.  Big Als and alot of new shops opening all the time.  Fountains are spectacular and absolutely beautiful.   The lights are like the 4th of July every night.   The movie theater is over the top.  Just come and sit by a cool heater or fireplace and look at the lights and found in perfect rhythm with the music.  The Village is truly an awesome place.
I've never been disappointed by my Twigs experience. The sticky cookie is worth every penny. The salads are huge. Cuban roll sand which is AMAZING. I'd get it every time if I could.

I had the brisket sandwich and it was really good. The waffle is really light and crispy. The sandwich had grilled onions and bbq sauce. I recommend the Parmesan fries. I'm excited to try other items in the menu.

Very interesting place, first of all the place was nice and new looking, clean and organized. Very nice presentation of the menu items on big lcd monitors. However the most interesting part was like Asian soup bowls with your choice of meat. Then a pretty great sounding selection of sandwiches on Waffles. I tried the herb jalapeño chicken and cheese sandwich on waffle. I was very impressed with the waffle, not like I've ever had. Very flaky like a croissant. Great presentation and good flavors. They gave us a sample of the Thai Tea and the Milk Tea and both were really good, but pretty sweet. Definitely taste the tea.  They had a great Christian pop music station playing in the background in tbe kitchen. The best part of the meal was their friendly service and what seemed like locally owned business
The place to go for Tuesday happy hour prices. Always excellent in food and service. Great atmosphere. Extensive menu.

We had the brisket street tacos, and they were absolutely amazing! The sauces & coleslaw on top were the perfect combination. The staff was so friendly and helpful. We don't live in Idaho, but if we did I would definitely be back to try more food options!

I wouldn't even give them one star but I'm forced to give one to write this review. The first thing I'll say is the other reviews have got to be bogus or from the owners friend. While we were sitting eating for our meal two other tables were complaining about their food so I'm positive this bad review shouldn't be their first. It's dirty its too bright it's got bad service it's cold (the food I mean) the food is tough and fatty it's overpriced (I mean expensive $50.00 for 2) and not worth your time. I feel sick from spending my money. Trust me.
Yummy! I love this place! Great location in the Village. Atmosphere is perfect. Family friendly!

Food was yummy.  The wait was long once our food was ordered, but the waitress was attentive and made sure our coffee and water was full.  Overall a good experience.  I recommend you go with a plan to wait to be seated because they are busy.  This is not a restaurant for a quick in and out meal, sit back, relax and enjoy your company!
Awesome place with awesome prices. Happy Hour is the best time to go with nearly half price sushi and appetizers along with some great alcohol specials!

I have had two so terrible experiences here that I'm compelled to write a review. First, I must say the owner seems like a friendly well-meaning person. Secondly, I think their choice in employees is terrible. Mostly teenagers or young adults with little to no knowledge of the menu, and who just don't care about doing a good job. But most disappointing is the food. The Italian beef is entirely bland and the buns are reminiscent of store brand hoagies. Soggy in seconds and no crispy outside, the way an Italian beef sammie should be. The au jus is terrible. In my mind, it is herb water, not even au jus. The pizza is also less than worthy. No flavor except tomato. This last time, I ordered a tamale, and for $2.25, I got something as wide as my thumb and as long as my pointer finger. It had absolutely no flavor. I legitimately wonder if the chefs have dead taste buds. I don't think this place is worth a dime, and it is not cheap. I wish I had better things to say. I think unless this place makes some really drastic changes to recipes and staff, it simply won't survive.
Definitely a fancy pants place. Would be a good date night option. Food menu is not interesting. Drink menu, if you like martinis is interesting.

Honestly was super disappointed from the second my family walked through the door! We had called ahead of time to reserve a booth and the hostess had assured us over the phone that upon arrival we would be seated in a booth. Well we got there and not only did they not seat us in a booth, but upon questioning the host if there were any available she rudely said no, dropped the menus and walked away. The food took about 40 minutes to get to our table, and to be honest for the price we were seriously disappointed. My husband got sick the second he got home. I am not one to usually complain unless I have an exceptionally terrible experience and this was one of those times! We will absolutely never be going here again!
This is definitely one of the better parks during the week, but whenever I've gone on the weekends it is extremely over crowded, eagle island is probably the best in the valley in my opinion.
Fun martini selections and good wait staff. The food was pretty good but I would come back for drinks and app.

I came in today completely expecting disappointment.  I've never really been satisfied with hair cutting places. Mainly because I have different tastes. However Susan was great she greeted me the second I walked in the door and reserved my spot that minute. Within ten minutes they called me up and I was seated. She them asked what I would like so I explained what I envisioned for my hair both head and facial. She even lined up the nape of my neck. She trimmed my facial hair to the point that it looked neat and not bushy. I couldn't have done this myself. I suggest people go see Susan for great Clips of the hair.

Came here for the first time and I'm glad I did! Great beer and great atmosphere. I hate when beers aren't served really cold and I definitely didn't have that problem here. I tried the initial point IPA and red ale and they were both great!
Most comprehensive park ever. Huge play area for bigger kids. Musical instrument area. Little kid play area. Tennis courts. Pond with ducks. Splash pad. Literally the best park in the Boise area.
Favorite local breakfast stop for us in the Treasure Valley. Happily swapped out eggs with avocado to make vegan friendly dish. Always at least a short wait. Friendly staff.

This is a review of DQ only. I love their soft serve and that's typically what I order. I went through the drive though and ordered a chocolate dipped cone and asked for the chocolate soft serve. When I got to the window, I was handed an vanilla dipped cone. I let them know I had ordered Chocolate soft serve. The young gal looked and me for a few seconds and then said... we're out, sorrrryyyyy and walked away. If I would have know, I would have purchased something different. I drive away unhappy and dissatisfied with the horrible customer service. There was no effort to make it right. They should have let me know when I ordered that they were out of the chocolate soft serve and I would have changed my order. I understand running out of a product, but the way it was handled was horrible.

My 88 year old father is doing great, but is not the careful consumer he once was.  He's developed into a very trusting soul, and quite easy prey for merchants with ill intent.   When I found that he was taking his vehicles to Meridian Auto, I was compelled to check them out.  

For my first observation, I took Dad to pick up his rig after getting a call that his vehicle was done -- Dad's instructions to Meridian Auto was to "figure out what's wrong, and fix it."  No cap on price, no instructions to "call me first to get authorization".  Sounded like a nightmare situation to me, and I was expecting the worst.  We go to the counter, and the summary from Meridian Auto was, "No bill for today, Mr. F.  The problem turned out to be in an area where we had serviced the vehicle earlier this year, and whether we caused the problem or not, our work is covered for 1 year.  We've fixed the problem at no charge.  Please let us know if you have any more trouble with it."

What a great show of integrity.   This is where I'm taking my stuff from now on.

Nothing special, that's for sure!

We waited over half of an hour to get a sandwich and some chicken strips. When we got our food, there was nothing special about it.   The chicken strips were your average frozen strips, and the Italian beef was pretty flavorless. The fries would have been good if they were still warm. 

It wasn't disgusting, but we won't be back :)
Great value for a car wash. Unlimited for $29.99 a month including vacuuming. Multiple locations. Use them very often. About four minutes or less to get thru.
It was too expensive and didn't even have water for my sister instead we had to buy a 50cent bottle of water for $4

My only issue with this particular Winco is the parking. But, that's not a big thing. 
Like other Winco locations, they have great prices.  If you know what you're there for you can generally get in and get out. I'm SO glad Winco has self check out!

Great salad & soup. Sashimi was good but pricey for what little you got. Sushi was great ! Noise level was such that you couldn't converse with others at your table. Food service was terrific!!!

We will definitely be return customers... Location suits us very well :-)

If you're willing to pay, LuluLemon is the best there is for active wear. Mens and women's alike. Lululemon pants can make a bad butt look good and a good butt look great. That alone is worth the coinage. #butts

Such a treat to have Hawaiian cuisine here in Idaho!! My husband and I each got a two item entree plate and neither of us could finish it. The portions are very generous and definitely worth the price. I got the coconut crusted salmon and teriyaki chicken with broccoli salad and brown rice. My husband tried the ribs and brisket with spam and pineapple rice. Their side options change daily which is plenty fine since we would love to try it all. Go hungry and leave happy!

Oh my word... delicious. I've eaten alot of places and had alot of meals but the deep fried french toast stuffed with blueberries and cream cheese was quite possibly the best thing that I've ever eaten. You HAVE to stop here! You MUST try this french toast. I swear to you... you won't be dissapointed. You might even kiss me in thanks for showing you this life changing meal. You're welcome. ;)

Food is good but don't expect good service. When we first walked in, there were three people at the front. None of them acknowledged us at all. Then this older woman walks up and rudely asks how many. We put our names down then the woman nastily told us to tell her if we leave. They were busy today but if you can't be kind don't work at a restaurant. It's not even that I was asking for fast service but they were so rude it was as if we were inconveniencing them. 

Don't worry. We won't be back.

I am one of the biggest fans of The Village. I think its so beautiful and all the stores are great. If you threw in a Forever 21 it would be perfect. I love how it looks at night and during the day. Everyone who works at the stores and the movie theater was very sweet and I just love everything about The Village
Our first time and we loved it!  Food was excellent as was service. Lots of choices, for meat as well as sides. Clean and tasteful decor. Will become one of our regular places for dining out.
Love the Varsity Pub!!  I especially love the dueling pianos, the girl is awesome, and well, they are all just great!  Prices are decent and the comedians I have seen are hilarious.

My boyfriend and I went and tried Kona Grill today for the first time. We wanted to try it be cause we are huge sushi lovers and I am always on the lookout for a new sushi place. We had the lunch special. I chose a lunch roll combo (4 piece Cali roll and a 4 piece tuna roll) and the oriental salad. My boyfriend had the lunch roll combo and sushi combo (3 pieces of assorted sushi). We also ordered a wave roll and a Las Vegas roll. The price was a bit spendy for what we got but not too bad because we had the lunch special. The sushi overall was good, not fantastic. The Cali roll and the tuna roll were great but I don't know many places that can mess those up. The two speciality rolls were just alright. Nothing too spectacular and I would say for the price, not worth it. The oriental salad was delicious however. Perfect mix of all ingredients and nice and crisp like you would expect. The service was fantastic. All the staff we encountered were kind and very courteous. All in all, we likely will be back but doubt we will order the sushi again. There are better options for good sushi in the valley.

I returned for the last time to Bono's to try the legendary deep dish pizza. I found that it's a legend of overpriced, underwhelming, tiny pizza. The owners should be ashamed to call this "authentic" Chicago deep dish. Almost $20 for a tiny pizza that barely feeds 3 people. My family almost laughed when I brought the boxes home. 

The crust is slightly deeper than Pizza Hut and their idea of authentic simply means the sauce is on top. What a joke!

I've had real Chicago deep dish pizza and this isn't even close. I feel like I've given Bono's a fair shake. I've been 3 times now. I won't be going back. Boise remains a barren waste land when it comes to authentic deep dish Chicago style pizza.

My girl Danielle is by far one of the best nail techs I've ever been too! I know my nails will always turn out perfect! She is extremely talented and if you're looking for a place to get some amazing nails, then definitely check her out!!! I promise you wont

I had a great brunch at Joe Momma's today. Tri tip scramble was awesome as were the red potatoes. They were serving a special pineapple upside down pancake that was really yummy too. I will have most  of that later for a snack. Very fresh food, Tri tip melted in my mouth. Will go back for sure.
Seriously the most wonderful feeling/beneficial massage that I've had! And I've been to A LOT of massage therapists!! Thank you, Ashley!!!
Always satisfied and impressed with the service. The food is amazing and the portions a great, especially for the price. Keep up the good work!

The look of this hotel on the outside is great, until you get inside.

The vents are falling apart, the rooms aren't cleaned very well because my room smelled horribly like the man that stayed in the room before me. Had the A/C been working well, the stench would not have been lingering. 

The double shower heads were cool but they didn't adjust and the bathtub sounded like it was going to break at any second. 

Further more, I would not have stayed here because the girl answering the phones was incredibly rude and completely lacked any customer service. She was saying what she supposed to say but her voice sounded like she hated her job in the hospitality industry. On top of that she looked like she had just left a Hot Topic and put on a La Quinta uniform. 

Last but not least, there is practically no access to the Main Street making it extremely frustrating trying to get to the hotel the first time you arrive.

I won't be back, I don't care that they are pet friendly, the TV's are huge, and the beds are comfy. The price is not worth the poor experience.

I gave it two stars for the Atmosphere which was nice and the restaurant is neat. Service was decent the wait staff seemed more interested in flirting with the guys behind the sushi bar than waiting tables and the food at best could be described as mediocre. Our waitress spent the majority of our meal talking to her boyfriend who was seated at the next table and we had to drag her away in order to get our bill which we waited for almost 15 minutes before we had to literally wave her down. We tried the Las Vegas Roll which was ok but messy and fell apart the minute you picked it up. Also tried the Lobster and Shrimp Roll which was just so-so and the miso soup was a bust overly salty with no flavor but salt. Overall wasn't that impressed and probably won't go back

Lovely oasis for massage- quiet and soothing both. Receptionist/schedulers are always helpful.  I've had massages from Nina and Shandrea and my friend visiting from AZ had Johnny. We both had excellent experiences last week.  Highly recommend this place!

Place was super busy for lunch, but boy was it worth the wait. I ordered the Italian and by far the best tasting sandwhich I have eaten in a very long time. The staff here were super friendly and killed the customer service. I will deffinetly be back with friends and co workers.

I called ABC to have my septic tank pumped and inspected for a home sale they were able to make the appointment for my day off and they showed up on time the tech "Adam" was professional informative and through. I did have a problem with my tank the inlet baffle had been broken off and would not pass the inspection. Adam explained what needed to happen and gave me a card of person that could fix it for me I chose to do it myself with very good results and was a big help and I was able to get it fixed and put back together

If you want your dog and/or cat neglected and mistreated while you're away on business, or leisure, then leave them here. If you want to be lied to about the care that your pet receives, then leave them here. I left my dogs here and watched them on the video cameras that they have set up above the kennels. We where told that our dogs had been taken out and allowed to run and play. We were told that their kennel was clean and that our dogs were doing well, well the camera don't lie. Our dogs were never let out and they had to stay in their kennel filled with feces, urine and even one puddle of vomit. We were told that their pin was clean, but when we looked at the camera it told a completely different story. 5 minutes after we called one of the staff went out and started cleaning the kennel. We had our dogs removed asap. We then demanded a refund, the supervisor on duty said that she would confer with the manager and call us back. She called us back and told us that they had just changed their policy and that they could not gives us a refund, how convenient for them. We DID pursue this thing further with the BBB and we did get a refund. If you love your pets, don't waste your time with these people.
First time here. It's a Sunday evening when some items are discounted. This place was phenomenal! Great food, great selection, great atmosphere all for a great price. Period.

I was very happy with my food and service.  I thought the prices were a bit high in comparison to what you got, but no regrets.  I ordered sushi as my entree, but it was really more like an appetizer, there were maybe 4 or 5 in my serving.  Luckily my wife wasn't starving so I finished off her leftovers, otherwise I still would have been hungry after supper.

This is probably one of the Meccas of hipsterness here in the treasure valley. Even though I say that, it's not necessarily a bad thing. The ambiance and atmosphere here is like none other that I've found in the area. This is a place for those social elites to come out and "see and be seen." If Facebook was a physical location you could actually go to and interact with people in person, The Kona Grill is probably what it would look like. Aside from the atmosphere, the food here is pretty good. I think it is far from the best that I've had here locally, especially when it comes to the sushi, but not bad. I haven't had much of their food outside of their sushi menu, so bear that in mind when I'm reviewing here. The one thing I can tell you about this place however, is that they have killer desserts! I love their key lime pie and the butter cake is also pretty fantastic. All in all, a really solid restaurant. A place to come more for the location and atmosphere than a 5 star dining establishment, but great if you're going out on that date, out for drinks with friends, or looking to meet new people from the area. If you haven't been here or to The Village, you owe it to yourself to do so!
Good BBQ. We had the brisket and pulled pork. The brisket was great. Cut it with the fork . The pulled pork was good too but I would recommend the brisket.
Really good sushi and great view if you sit outside.

A newer property with nice rooms.  Room was well decorated, clean and bed was very comfortable.  Breakfast was good for Hotel faire, fresh chocolate chip cookies in the evening were addictive.  The decor, other than the rooms, and exterior appeal is somewhat lacking, but hey its not a resort!
Had the Benedict. It was pretty good but not super delicious. I didn't love the hollandaise sauce, it seemed rather flavorless. Price was decent, but the quality was mediocre. It was a solid 3 stars.

Oh wow do I love this place!  Someday I will even try something new...but the spicy veggie scramble is bursting with flavor and the pancake is my most favorite in all the land.  Can be busy on the weekends,  but worth the wait.

Traveling through Idaho with my boys and checked Yelp for good restaurants in the area. Looking for BBQ and found Big Daddy's Diner. Outstanding food and great service. The burgers were giant and the meat dinners delicious. Highly recommend.

The good: cute sunny ambiance, quickly greeted, seated and brought drinks fast.

The mediocre: temperature of food, french toast, bacon, eggs, bland hash browns, portion size, coffee, overall service

Nothing bad to say but nothing to rave about. Staff was friendly. It felt like they had 100 staff members moseying about and sorta working /snacking/socializing. But everything was taken care of.
Beautiful farm with a great selection of fruits, vegetables, and plants. Also my kids love the ice cream and the beautiful grounds.

We had multiple dishes tonight, including Pho, Spring Rolls, and delicious entrée.  The food is prepared by the owner using old family recipes. It is truly a delight to the pallet.  You won't be disappointed.

We decided to try cafe ole for a post-Christmas get together.  It had been more than 15 years since I had dined at a cafe ole and I now remember why...both my entree and my friend's were served lukewarm and our waitress refilled our drinks twice even though we were sitting with empty glasses.  I ordered the Sope de jefe,which had decent flavor, but was cold upon arrival.  I was also disappointed with  the salsa bar as all the salsas were off tasting and not very enjoyable.  Later, While we had all clearly finished eating but weren't ready to leave,  our table wasnt cleared even though there were five employees standing around.  Overall not a great experience

Very good food! The prime rib was tender and moist, the Cole slaw and the beans were delicious. It was one of those meals that you wish would never end. Haven't had a prime rib that good in a long time. The staff was friendly and helpful, and the service was lightning quick.
Food was ok but the wait was forever. Not like the typical pizza place but after the long wait it wasn't really worth it. It was also privy for what we got. All in all surprised they are still open.

I hate to say it but subway's meatball sandwich is better than this. I asked of they had tea and the employee said yes. There was nothing but water when I poured a glass and when I asked to have it fixed they hooked it up to soda. I won't return.
Delicious sandwiches and you can make any sub a salad or lettuce wrap. Clean and quick!  Averages prices. Great meal for a quick lunch!

I found this hidden gem when I was in town for business and needed to buy lunch for my clients.  Karen, the owner, was so delightful to work with.  She was excellent about following-up with the order and had everything ready on time when I arrived.  The meals were placed in a sturdy cardboard box so it was easy for me to carry.
