The sourdough bread is incredible, period.  You can't get bread like that at any old deli.   You can tell this local restaurant takes a lot of pride in their food and pleasing their customers.  I think one of the best things about the restaurant is how wonderful Karen was...she just had this warm demeanor and was incredibly appreciate for the business.  I'm all for supporting local joints, especially in this economy.  Definitely try this restaurant if you're looking for a delicious sandwich and homemade cookie :)  

Thank you Karen and staff.

At the epicenter of Treasure Valley population you will find two fine institutions to greet your arrival at the mecca of breeding and consumerism - one is Krispy Kreme and the other is Fusion Asian Grill. What could be better than some killer pho followed up by a free sample of fresh hot glazed?

Seriously though, this is the best pho in the area. The noodles are fat ones. The broth extra savory. Tons of herbs and quite a variety. And the thin sliced beef! The best cut and tenderness I have encountered. The chicken soup is to die for. I hear the chicken curry is awesome too. I also second the first course selection - fresh spring rolls with pork and shrimp (Gui Cuon).

The menu is so huge, I am going to have make many pilgrimages to mecca in the days to come. I just won't buy any KK doughnuts so I can watch my caloric intake. Why buy them when they just give them to you anyway?

I thought the food was excellent and the staff were all very friendly and attentive.  The food made it to the table at the perfect pace for a quick bite out with colleagues and as delicious on top of that.  Excellent variety of drinks and the one thing I would say to anyone like me from out of town - finding the place is tricky as development of the area is recent so Google maps couldn't get us there.  Our local colleague had to get on the phone with us and guide us there which made us late to the party.  It was a great experience overall though!
Love it here. We order eggs from them 2 times a month. Love going in the Spring and Summer to see what they have. Plus it's close to our house

My wife and I went here for lunch.  Unique approach to a sandwich shop and a good menu.  Multiple vegetarian options which is a plus.  I ordered a medium black bean sandwich on wheat and my wife ordered a tomato avocado on wheat.  Mine came out as expected but my wife's came out on white bread instead of wheat.  We mentioned the mistake to the counter kid that helped us but he really didn't acknowledge the mistake.  Getting the bread order correct AT A SANDWICH SHOP should be a pretty big deal.  My wife stuck with the white because we didn't want to wait for another one to be built.  The whole process took about 3x the time to order and fulfill compared to Subway or Blimpie.  Service was slow but the sandwiches were very good.  Actually really good.  Bottom line is check this place out.  You'll be happy if your not in a real big hurry and ok with sub-par service.  They do make a really tasty sandwich.

I had been very excited to try this place. I had called twice to make sure there was no wait, mostly because I was with a very hungry 4 year old. I had called twice to check if there was a wait, both times they said there was no wait. I walked in 2 minutes after calling and they told me it was 45 minute wait. I decided to try and wait and see if a table on the patio opened. I ended up going to another place since we couldn't wait. They ended up calling me a HOUR after being put on the wait list. To say the least that was upsetting, it seems that who ever I talked to both times didn't know what was going on in the restaurant. Not sure if I'll try to go back.

I'm a shawarma eating fool and wanted a wrap. This place only has a shawarma sandwich... As I wiped my tears, I ordered the sandwich... It was delicious! They just opened so menu is small. They were very polite. If you like shawarma try the sandwich with extra sauce YUM.

I could spend all day (and *gulp*, all my money if I'm not too careful) in this place! The staff is very friendly and knowledgeable, helping you discover all the bits and pieces from your childhood that time forgot. I found an old Star Wars die cast set that I originally got for my birthday in the early 80s. Plus, I couldn't put a price on my wife's tears of joy as I surprised her with a She-ra action figure like the one she used to have as a child!

Also, they are the local authority on all things yo-yo and Kendama. Check these guys out, you'll be glad you did!

This isn't Gino's East, Giordano's, Uno or even Lou Malnati's. You can tell first off by the whitish deep dish pizza crust. The real deals in Chicago are yellow from the butter they infuse their dough with. The sauce was more like diced tomatoes with a few herbs sprinkled in than a complex sauce simmered for hours.

That said, Bono's pizza isn't bad. It's just not what I expected from a place trumpeting "real Chicago food."

I will return to try their Italian beef sandwiches and see how they stack up to Al's # 1, Johnnie's Beef and Portillo's. They have big shoes to fill there, too.

First time here, looking for a good BBQ place close to home.  Hard to get closer to home than this place so we gave it shot.  

We noticed right off that the place is very clean.  That always scores points with us at mom and pop places.  The menu was basic but broad enough to give you a good idea of what your appetite will have in store.  The gal behind the counter was very friendly and helped us right away.

Food was outstanding!  Brisket was delicious. Wife got the spicy sausage. And it also was terrific!  We recommend this place ten times over!  Hit it if you're in the area. If you're not. Get there anyway!
This is a wonderful place to bring your kids. I especially love their happy hour. My favorite is the Northwest Italian Soda

Planned my boyfriend's birthday party and selected Kona for dinner. We had a group of 8 and 2 of them were vegan. I had made reservations in advance and showed up with about 1/2 of my group and the other half on their way but they would not seat us. It was a little irritating because they suggested we ordered something from the bar while we waited but the bar was packed. Fast forwading my group finally showed up and we are seated and place our orders. When the food came out, it there were many mistakes my vegan friends pasta came with cheese, the others salad had bacon, and one person ordered a flat bread and it came out ice cold. The items were sent back without a problem but when they came back the salad that was sent back had cream dressing. It had to go back again. We ended up staying for a while waiting for food. I wouldnt have been irritated if the items ordered were modified but they weren't and we're orders of the vegan menu. And as for the flat bread it was pretty soggy and unflavorful. My friend didn't eat half of it. 

The sushi was really good though and everyone who ordered sushi had zero issues. So, my suggestion would be to stick with sushi or go elsewhere.
The bartender was cordial, nice and attentive.  The beer was cold, served in a chilled glass.  My experience was good.  It was late Tuesday and not many patrons in the place.

Fabulous!!! I eat here at least twice a week and I cannot get sick of it! Their sandwiches are to die for. Their soup is good too. The owner is there every day and she remembers my super special order and my name. I love everything about this wonderful place, especially the people!

Great place!! Really clean store, colorful, and fun. Very helpful and friendly staff. They are generous in offering samples to try all there yummy flavors. Great selection of toppings - we'll be back!

I took my dog in today to get my dog groomed. They did an amazing job and the price was great. They even gave us a free goody bag. Even though it was a really busy day for them they welcomed us to come in and didn't make us wait for another day to bring my little girl in. They had great customer Serive and everyone was very friendly. I will most definitely be bring my dog Sasha back.
Love Bruchis!   They have wonderful food and quick service.    It would be great if they offered a lettuce wrap sub.
We love stopping here for happy hour before or after catching a movie. The pizzas are gigantic and perfect for sharing! My favorite is the vampire taco and the truffle fries... Very tasty!

Stumbled upon this place driving through Meridian. Tried it for lunch and had the Shawarma (beef), Sarma and Bosnian coffee. The food was outstanding with attentive service. Don't be fooled by the strip mall location.

$20 was much for a pho but my daughter and ex-wife marveled over the good taste and complexity of their meals! (And they have eaten at many Pho restaurants!!!) So I tried their turkey, cheese and bacon sandwich which was unbelievably good: fat back bacon on melted cheese on a good helping of turkey. The bread was a waffel. The girls got exited when learning they had Boba tea. I didn't like the tea. It reminded mee of having tadpoles in my drink! I had at first ordered their cold coffee drink but was told they ran out. Then their line cook (who I'll refer to as the "chef") made a coffee drink  that reminded me of a frappe w/o a blender!!!! A small but interesting place to go in Meridian!!!!!! They've been open for about two (2) months. Give them a try.

A friend and I came here a few nights ago . It looked pretty dead in there so we decided to sit at a table in the bar area  instead of the restaurant. First of all , we weren't given menu's by the hostess  which was odd but figured someone somewhere would. Well ,  already waiting ten or so minutes we were ready to order out drinks , and so we waited , and waited , and then waited some more and after waiting an unthinkably slow  20 minutes or so all the while being looked over a couple of times by a handful of servers  from time to time ( all standing around in unison by the line perhaps waiting for their food to come out ? but never greeted , offered water or anything ) We decided to make a mad dash for the large revolving doors and go over to Yard House instead . Glad we did since we were sat and taken care of upon arriving. Given the amount of poor reviews I noticed I give this place another year before they go out of business . They clearly do t want to make money , because they don't serve you , period !  Really just a waste of space of a place . Weak , Lame  , sad vibes all around here.

My wife and I just moved here from California and we found this gem! I got the Big Daddy and my wife got the Brisket Melt. Both were very tasty. Service was great too. Pricing wasn't too bad either. Will definitely be going back here!

Decent food, but terrible and awful wait time. We ordered a pizza and three piece chicken tender basket. The pizza came out after about 20 minutes, which wasn't bad, but the tenders came out more than 40 minutes later. It's been very similar experiences before this, too.
Excellent food and great service, and we had a large party. very nice menu with several options.

The best Russian store in town has mostly everything,
always fresh products friendly stuff. 
highly recommended.

I would have given Soda Stop an extra half star if I could've. It wasn't quite good enough to earn 3 stars, but not bad enough for 2. Our server wasn't very friendly and didn't explain the process of getting a soda very well. We asked for no cheese in the sandwich we ordered, but got cheese anyway. Soda Stop was mediocre at best.

Well I should have known by the reviews but I gave it a shot. Chips were ok.  Salsa was ok.  I ordered the chicken chimichanga with Colorado sauce.  I got two very little fried burritos that had been rolled about six times with shredded chicken that I could hardly find.  So it tasted like fried flour. I have spent time in Texas, lived in Arizona and Southern California.  And been to Mexico many times so I know what Mexican food should taste like.  I know this is Boise area but for Mexican food I'd rather eat at Del Taco. Sorry but this is not good Mexican food.  I gave the place a chance and spent my 15 dollars on food that was not good at all.   I travel to Boise every month on business and try different places to eat but I won't be coming back here.  .
Service and food was the best. Ashley, our waitress was absolutely awesom. Amust try us the avacado wraps.

I had a very pleasant experience at Kona. My server was Mindi and she was on point!!! Who knew vibe alone could sell you on a place. The food was good, your boy can get down with a Vegas Roll... you best believe dat!!! All in all let's be real you're going out for the experience, I'm old enough where most foods don't warp my mind. It's all about the experience and she just made it that much better. If you want to know specifically what it is that made everything amazing you have to go yourself. Ask for   Mindi's section, no need to thank me.

My family went to this restaurant today. There were 5 people in our party. We were seated promptly because we had a reservation. The waitress was nice. We placed our order with the waitress and continued visiting with our family. We then waited 40-45 minutes to get our order. We were very upset that it took that long for our party to receive our order since other parties at the restaurant placed their orders after us and received and ate them before we got ours. Our orders were wrong when we finally received them. A person in our party asked to speak to the manager. The manager came over and asked us the problems we had. She then told the manager that we have been waiting 40-45 minutes for our meal and that it is wrong.  The manager then proceeded to argue saying the order only took 23 minutes from the time it was submitted per her order tape. The manager was aggressive and talking over our table making it very uncomfortable for our other guests. The manager kept insisting and repeating that it only took 23 minutes for our order to cook to the point where we stated that she could just go. I've never had a manager act the way she did. It was very unprofessional by the manager and very uncomfortable for our guests. I will never attend this restaurant again. The manager needs to learn how to talk to her customers. The manager did comp us one of the meals but it did not change my feelings about how she treated us.

They were so slow, SO SLOW!  I ordered French toast and there were two normal sized slices on the plate and nothing else.    I had to share with my husband because I was afraid if I ordered anything else I would never get out of there.

Tonight we went to cafe ole for happy hour after work just after 9pm and we sat down for over 7 minutes (I timed it) and not one of the three people working in the bar greeted us or even acknowledged our presence. I asked the short haired brunette passing by if we could get some service and instead of helping us she told us someone was on their way over. Two minutes later we were still without service so we left and took our business elsewhere. Its disappointing that "the best margaritas in the treasure valley" come with the worst service.

I always love coming to Kona for a quick Sushi fix. Jordan has helped us a few times, and tonight she was absolutely wonderful. We connected on quite a few things, and made our meal so much more enjoyable! It makes a meal so great when your waitress is able to laugh with you, and tell you stories about her life. Thanks for making a great impression!

Been to Kona multiple tones, and each time I have had poor service. The servers aren't very friendly, and hardly come to refill drinks or check on you. Plan to wait 20 minutes to take your order 30-45 minutes for your entrees, and another 20-30 minutes for your main dish. No refills on drinks and chances are if your meal comes out missing something, the server won't be back to your table until it's time for your check! The food is good but overpriced and not worth the wait.

The car wash has left scrapes and dings on my car do not go here, spoke to Lucas Hadley  there and he told me to my face that the dings were caused by the car wash, but the mysterious scratches couldn't be from them, now Monday 5/1/17 after waiting all morning to hear from him, I had to call him to get him to call my husband and I back I'm now being told none of my dings and scratches were caused by them. This place is horrible, unprofessional to their customers, do not go there you're better off going to j's car wash they wash by hand. Lucas Hadley be a better so called "manager"
Super friendly and knowledgeable staff!! Prices are fair, produce is delicious and they even let us sample multiple types of melon- canary is the best!!

Love this place . The Brie kisses are awesome, we had delivery at a hotel we were at. Pizza was good had a house salad as well . We ordered from here three times and it was always right and the food was great . But the Brie kisses are the best
Very nice set up for a car wash. The location is perfect and conveniently accessible. Can't go wrong, this place provides a great wash.

We have eaten at Twigs three times now.  The first time we ordered a pizza and salad and when the pizza came out, it was not the correct pizza we ordered. They said we could keep it and they would make us another one but we told them that was okay. Once the bill came, we noticed they didn't charge us for the pizza (which you would hope a restaurant would do) but it was nice to see that we didn't have to complain about it.

The second time we ordered off the appetizer menu and had calamari, fish tacos and the sliders.  All were delicious but I cannot rave more about the calamari.  What a different twist with artichokes.  So good!  We also ordered some martini's which were delicious.  

The third time we came we had reservations. When we arrived, we had to wait about 10 minutes for our table (not a big deal as it was a busy weekend night) but when we were seated, the manager came over to apologize and said we could order any two appetizers off the menu for free for having to wait.  I didn't feel we had to really wait very long but this was a very nice gesture and just good service. For our free appetizers, we decided to try something we have not ordered before so we ordered the bruschetta flatbread (it was just okay) and the artichoke frites (pretty good). Wish I ordered the calamari again because did I mention (SO GOOD).  For dinner we had the bison burger (VERY good) and the pesto margherita chicken (pretty good). The kids had just regular Twigs signature burgers and they devoured them.  Everyone really enjoyed the fries that came with the burgers.  
We have had great service at Twigs and the management and staff have always taken good care of us.  We have really enjoyed the food and the variety of the meals and would recommend this place for sure!

Wow! Once again Kona Grill knocks it out of the park!!!! The sushi has always been great. Tonight we had the Grilled Salmon and omg it was phenomenal ( never been a fan of any salmon) but tonight we stepped out of our comfort zone and amazed, convinced us otherwise!!!!!!!!! Will definitely order again, the glaze was fabulous 
The servers are fantastic and superb personalities..... Thank you

Vicki & Kevin Vierra

Tasty sandwich. I had the supreme cheesesteak and I found the meat to be somewhat over cooked and it was all tiny little pieces. The bread was soft and the staff was great and happy. I would give it another try.

Kona Grill is one of our top spots in the area for happy hour, as it offers it until 7pm which most of the restaurants in town stop theirs at 6pm. Kona is upbeat, one of the busiest places in the village with a menu that is filled with a big variety and lots of tasty food. There's something for everyone at Kona! The only thing I wish is that the bar area wasn't open seating... table sharks are on the frenzy there when it's busy.

Food: Oh gosh, the food at Kona is great. From their appetizers like lettuce wraps and avocado egg rolls to their flatbreads and sushi (crab crunch & bama rolls are great!), and all the way over to their pad Thai... it's all good. They also have an excellent dessert menu, with a delicious piece of key lime pie being the highlight.

Drinks: The drinks are great. They have a good sangria, which is loaded with big chunks of fruit, and nice margaritas. I just love the happy hour prices for the drinks--it's hard to beat.

Atmosphere: This is the one thing that gets me down about Kona. We love to sit in the bar area when we go out, and as Kona is a first-come, first-serve open seating in the bar, it makes for a very uncomfortable environment whether you're on the lookout for a table or whether you're the one dining and feeling like the table sharks are hovering. It's a bummer! If you want to avoid it, you can put your name in but you'll face a pretty big wait to be sat for the most part. Other than that, the ambiance is really nice, with their water features, comfortable seats, blue lights and fancy tables. It seems like a very upscale spot!

Service: Noah in the bar is our favorite. We often sit in the bar area and they're super quick to help out their tables. No complaints on service! 

Happy Hour Offerings: Later happy hour than most, which goes from 3-7 M-F and late happy hour only on the weekends. They have a TON of food and drink specials on their happy hour with really reasonable prices.

Healthy Hack: The appetizer chicken satay and lettuce wraps make a great option. I pull apart my butter lettuce and turn my lettuce wraps into a small salad which fills me up with out a massive amount of calories.

Tips: Check your receipts for offers of a free dessert upon survey evaluation. The survey takes less than 5-min (if the online version doesn't work, just call in), and then you get a free dessert! Lucky you!

We went last night (saturday) yeah we got there late but at 9 pm and they close at 10 as we were getting out of our car they turned the open light off but didn't lock the door so we proceeded in.

 My husband wanted the catfish soup but they tried telling him since it was a whole fish he wouldn't like it (yet he does, they just didn't want to cook it) so he got mu shu chicken he said that it was pretty standard,  and I got the hot and spicy tofu which was pretty plain. We also split a vitaminese coffee which was delish! 

When the lady was asking us to change our order because they didn't want to cook it she was talking very loudly in vitaminese from our table to the kitchen which I thought was kind of rude. We also had the crab ragroon which was also just okay.

Overall we would not go back.

We haven't been to Shari's in years but we were talking about the yummy stuffed hash browns they make and decided to go on New years Eve to have some. Our waitress was awesome, on the ball with taking our order, bringing us our food and refilling our drinks. Our food was so yummy, I was surprised at how good it was since we haven't been there in such a long time. This beats Dennys and the sunrise restaurant. I have also been to Steves Café, the Griddle and most of the other breakfast restaurants in Meridian and can say our food was comparable with the other restaurants plus the tables aren't so close together. Maybe we got lucky with a good cook and waitress who knows but we will be going back for stuffed hash browns again soon.

Always had amazing food and friendly service.  Family owed and operated and you can tell!  Quality is high, portions huge and reasonable prices.  I always split the veggie hash and blueberry pancake with my hubby- plenty for two!

i've seen this place all over town but hadn't tried it yet- so glad I finally did!

I got the "Z" which is gyro meat, grilled onions, tatziki, hot chili sauce, feta cheese, and wrapped in a pita. 

from first glance they don't look very big. I don't know why, but in my head they should be gigantic! plenty of food though! I was full after and i'm a good eater.

the gyro meat was sooo good. it was a little crispy, a little soft, seasoned and flavorful. I loved it. with the addition of grilled onions it just makes the flavor even better. I totally demolished it. 

I will warn you that it's a messy meal, so make sure to get some napkins- especially if you think you're going to be eating it in your car! LOL- watch yourself!

looking forward to coming back and trying some other ones- the chicken bacon one looks delicious! luckily, this place is near my work so i'll have many opportunities.

I have come here lately and the employees are kind and helpful. So far the food taste good and I have not had any problems. I don't know about other McDonald's but this one is giving free breakfast to all the fathers today.

Service was great and food was delicious. I didn't really like the Mac n cheese that much but everything else was great. The ribs and brisket were my favorite. Definitely would come here again. Great price for yummy food. I loved the Smokey flavors. The portions were great my husband and I couldn't even finish it all lol. Would recommend & I'll be coming back :)

Food is average but their big problem is turn over of servers. It makes me feel like if I spend my money there that the company is doing well by treating employees so poorly they never stick around. I won't go back.
Very tasty and ECLECTIC menu! We had everything from sushi to french fries, and all good. Definitely a super place for a group...with a full bar and excellent, friendly service!

I am a reluctant fan of The Village.

My main reluctance is that I live in north Boise and it's a bit of a drive.  

Plus, I consider myself all downtownie and think of The Village as all suburbany (I'm occasionally ridiculous--I admit it).

The Village has finally won me over. 

The thing is--so much to do and see!  From eating the to-die-for gorgonzola fries at Twigs or the juicy and delicious salmon at Kona Grill, to drinking deep the manhattan at the Yard House (I know beer is their thing...but seriously...the manhattan with the peach puree?  Order it.) or enjoying a beautifully crafted mocha at Village Coffee--this place is pretty dang...well...cool.

There.  I said it.

Plus, so many shops (highlight for me? Sur La Table!  I want to buy everything they sell.  Seriously) and more satisfying people watching than you can shake a stick at (and if you DO shake a stick at it...I would guess the people watching would only be rendered all the more fabulous).  The 'burbs are nothing if not fascinating.

Another perk? This is a great spot if you live in Boise and you've a friend who lives in Nampa.  It's half way (ish) and you can hang a good long while before ever getting bored.  And, if you do get bored?  You can always take in a movie at the theater.

So...Village people...you've won me over.  

Much like your predecessors did with their klutzy and clunky dancer friendly tunes Macho Man and YMCA (even I, with the coordination of a inebriated basset hound, can turn my body into a passable Y and M and C and A...and hey look every body!  I'm dancing!). 

Get to it!

Went for lunch and had a DELICIOUS grilled sandwich called the Vancouver-- turkey, swiss, pesto mayo and peppers.  I'm not usually a sandwich and soda fan, but I love the menu.  It's extensive and I could go for just about everything on it.  The soda was a fun treat for my kids who loved their grilled ham and cheese.  
It's a clean, small shop and we'll go again.
First time here and won't be the last.  Breakfast was great, fruit and veggies were fresh and service was great. The Almond Mocha is worth the trip alone. And best of all, it's kid friendly!

John gave me a manicure and gel polish today. It was awesome. They were super nice, and my manicure was the best experience I've had. I walked in and was served quickly. I'll be coming back regularly.

5 STAR customer service. when we were repainting our small office building we took down the letters for our name on the front of the building and put them in the side yard to repaint. Overnight one disappeared. After calling all around los Angeles where i could not find anything remotely like what we had i turned to the net where i discovered Woodland Manufacturing. They did not have that font as a regular item so when i sent them a photo of the sign they somehow copied the letter exactly and at no extra charge. I felt like a king with the special time and attention they took to make my very small custom order of only one letter. 

THAT IS FIRST CLASS CUSTOMER SERVICE!

Decent service, decent food and a fantastic atmosphere. I've been here a couple times now and have enjoyed the meals. The lettuce wraps are delish, just spicy enough and full of flavor. It comes with enough in the order that it could be a meal on its own. I ordered the flatbread that came with figs and Brie, it was by far the best thing I've had there. This time, however, I had the caprese chicken sandwich. It literally was gushing juice when I picked it up off my plate. The bottom bread was so soggy that it disintegrated as I attempted the first bite. I ended up pulling the bread off and just eating the breast by itself. Clam chowder is average, needs a little something. Overall a good place for a night out. I can't wait for summer time dinners on that gorgeous patio!!

My husband and I live within walking distance of Twigs bistro. So on one of our nights we didn't feel like cooking we walked over. We walked in expecting to have a lot better of an experience then we did. 
First off the food was delicious, no denying that. They know their food. We had the crab & artichoke dip appetizer, fish & chips entree and I had a pasta I can't actually remember the name of, but it was delicious. 
Where I cut off three stars is because of the service. It was AWFUL. 
The crab & artichoke dip comes with a generous portion of dip, but only six or seven measly pieces of bread. We were spooning a lot of dip on our bread and there was still half a bowl of dip left. So we did like any normal diner would and asked for more bread, which we were informed would be an additional $1.50. Our host (which happened to come by our table at that moment) also said,  "Oh yeah everyone asks for more bread because there isn't enough." If you know there isn't enough, ADD MORE BREAD. 
Wait, I'm paying for something I've already paid for? I've gone to restaurants at $75-$100/person and they don't charge for bread...then again neither does Red Robin! Ridiculous! 
Immediately we were turned off. 
As we waited for our bread to come out our entree's showed up. Then, not a moment later so did the bread. I told the waitress to excuse the bread because at this point it would be pointless to finish our appetizer with our entrees sitting in front of us. 
During our meal we had a visit from the manager upon hearing of our evening from the host and our waitress. We explained to him what they could do about the dip, reduce dip portion or add more bread. Duh. Charging for bread is dumb. He also asked if they could do anything for us, at that point we had enough and decided no. 
When we received our bill, nothing was reduced (as most restaurants would do to bring you back) or comped. 
We won't be back. Which is a shame, the food was good. The service, WAS TERRIBLE.

Definitely a well-run establishment. My family all really enjoyed their meals. I ordered the corn beef hash, I wasn't a huge fan of it. Definitely recommend getting the pancakes if you have a hearty appetite. Undoubtedly worth a trip for breakfast.

Don't come at night with a big group. You will wait for ever for your check. As the waiter was flirting with this one table. I just wanted to walk out but had to pay. Waited for 20 minutes for a check! Frustrating. But what do you expect from this place.

I'm actually from out of town, but I loved this place because the two clerks were so nice and hospitable it made me feel like we were family, I do not achieve this feeling in many Russian/European stores.... as you can imagine.
I only had their lettuce wraps and was very impressed. The delicate flavor and the use of Boston lettuce was a cleaner choice.
Absolutely loved it, wonderful drinks, good atmosphere and food so good I ate as slow as i could to savor it.

Nothing special and nothing terrible. Good stop for run of the mill Chinese food. I didn't order any Vietnamese because it was pricier and there weren't any lunch portions. The location is convenient.

I love happy hour and Wine down Wednesdays at Kona Grill.  They have great sushi, a wide variety of adult beverages and a great patio.  Love to meet with others and connect after work.  They also have a room for events if you want something special.  The staff and managers are always helpful with whatever you need and quick to fix something that's not quite right.  The Villages is a great place for live music on Friday night's in the summer...and their fountains are worth seeing too.  Grab some friends and head over there.  You won't be disappointed.

Had a special family dinner here.  Wow was I impressed.  Service was amazing and the food was not only well presented but was so flavorful.  I had the Ahi Tuna dinner and could not have been happier with the choice.   Will be returning for sure.

We came in for happy hour and weren't disappointed. We were promptly seated on the patio, our server was friendly and attentive and made good suggestions. I had the Chocolate Kiss Martini which was very good, I'm not a big drinker and a bit of a lightweight so for me it was strong but it wasn't over powering. My husband had the Lemon Drop and he said it was good but it could have used a little more citrus favor. The bruschetta flatbread with the mozzarella and balsamic is excellent. We didn't order any entrees this time but we would definitely come back for dinner some time!

This place was...Ok.  The waitresses were very nice but the food was mediocre. I got the salmon pasta and the veggies on top were extremely vinegary and over powering. Also there was so much water and grease on my plate it was starting to look like soup. The salmon was a tiny bit over cooked but was decent. My husband got the personal pizza and he said it was ok but not great. I was hoping for a little bit better quality. Not sure if we will return.

Inexuseable business practices. Poor service. Slow! Better than average food. Beware of gift certificate nonsense!

My takeout orders have been incorrect in some way, 4 out of the 6 times I've ordered to go.

Hold times and order times on a busy day can be extreme.

Staff is consistently frazzled, rushed, nonchalant and sometimes rude. They employ so many people on any given night that I am repeatedly stunned at how long it takes orders to come out of the kitchen, or the fact that they appear to be untrained in the processes or the system. Perhaps the turnover is high. But you can never say they are understaffed!

Kudos to the owners for employing so many local students, but shame that it's an inaccurate first work experience for them - potentially making them feel they can behave this way at a "real job" someday and get away with it. Possibly, they don't have time to train them.

Gift certificate: We attempted to use a $50 gift certificate with limited success. First, they said they do not accept gift certificates (I promise it is a legit one given by a friend and not a fake one made in Photoshop). Then when pressured, they said they accept it but I am required to use the entire amount now. They would not give a cash or even a CREDIT refund on the balance. They suggested we order a pizza to go that we can eat another night. What kind of business is this?

And BTW it took over 90 minutes for our order (hot dogs and sandwiches, no pizza) to arrive, all while there are only two other tables of customers in the entire restaurant. If this is their form of punishment for using a gift certificate, that's upsetting.

The food is usually good - pizzas very good. Decent variety on the menu. Reasonable prices. Delivery too. But their other consistent and inexcusable failings take my review down from a 4-star to a 2-star.

I was excited when I first saw the signs for Bono's. 

I grew up in the Detroit area and have visited Chicago many times. I love Chicago style hot dogs.  Bono's makes a very nice Chicago dog, the only problem is you could get one faster if you flew to Chicago.  
17 minutes for two Chicago dogs and fries is ridiculous.   I almost got a divorce after ordering carry out for my pregnant wife who was at home.  By the time I drove there, ordered, waited, and then delivered the food home she was super h-angry.   
Oh well. I guess it's back to Costco for hot dogs in the future.

Wife and I love their streak sandwiches and go there often. Thing were a little slow when they first opened but it has much improved since then. Friendly staff and glad they have the driver thru open now.

I have been on a sandwich kick lately but was looking for more of a healthier option so I thought I'd try out my favorite beach club sub unwich style. So delicious! But... Half way through I found a piece of hair. I was so disappointed because it was tasting great up until that point. I called the Jimmy John's location and spoke with Ben about my sandwich. He was super friendly and immediately got my information to put a credit towards my next visit. I know those things happen from time to time so I will be back to try another one. Without some hair of course.

They are usually short-staffed and the place is kinda grungy. Not dirty, but not fresh and clean either. The drinks are ok, but far from amazing. Frequently I have seen help in the backroom come out, stare at a line and turn around and walk away. One time she even looked right at me when I was next, played around on the register and then walked off. I feel bad for the regular gal who works there, but I just cant give them a higher rating.
Was unimpressed with the Yard house and came here and LOVED IT! The waitress attitude was fun and they had great drinks for the price. I WILL return with friends.

Fantastic food and every more fantastic owners! Great people! 

They do cater- I have had them at Chamber and networking events.

I've been to Bono's a few times, my wife really likes the meatball sub, I can't seem to make myself like it, the pizza was pretty good but again, didn't stand out. The price seems too high for what it is.  We were treated well each time we went, I think it is a family owned restaurant. I wish I liked the food better.

I was teetering on the verge of giving this a three-star review, but ended up with four when I considered the pros and cons. I always like to start with the bad news.

Cons: It's expensive. There, that's it. It costs way more money than I care to spend on appetizers and drinks. It's like any-damn-where you choose to eat at The Village. I have the same complaint about Yard House and Grimaldi's (except I LOVE the food at Twigz and Grimaldi's... not so much at Yard House).

Pros: Awesome service; clean, beautiful, classy interior; great-tasting food; a good selection of drinks (even if the beer menu is a little lean, this is more of a martini / cocktail joint, anyway).

If I were a lady, I'd write: "This place just SCREAMS ladies' night!" But I'm a dude, so I'll probably just come here once in a while with my wife before movies (yes, the fools at the cinema told us they weren't serving food that day; we later found out they were, so I suppose it was their loss). We had the calamari appetizer (awesome, perfectly fried, great sauces including a basic-yet-killer aioli) and a flatbread (also a win; basic, but well-flavored).

In short: ehhhhh!

I am so grateful that there is The Village of the Meridian. This area of shopping, which is about 10-15 minutes west of Boise, has the higher standard of shopping that I'm used to within the Dallas-Fort Worth, TX area (Southlake Town Square, Highland Park Village). Some places are pricey, yes. However, there are some places that meet price expectations. 

Parking is plentiful, the ambiance is very upscale, and the store choices are quite varied. So glad that there is a Grimaldi's Brick Oven Pizzaria close by, as well as Fountain Square to observe local events catered to children and adults alike. There is usually something always going on here.

You'll find the Village complex a bit of a walk, which is okay. There are also several big department store locations further down the street that I would recommend driving to. Definitely glad that you have this major shopping area that is in close proximity to Boise so that you don't have to travel terribly far anywhere else to get what you want.

This is a direct comparison to BBQ for Life on Vista in Boise. Overall, 4* - a wash with my go-to place. If It wasn't so much farther away, I'd happily split my BBQ time between the two.

Where Big Daddy's Loses:
Meat cuts. Keep in mind I am a picky picky person who does not like gristle or fatty parts, which are the parts my husband thinks are the best, so this negative for me, may well be a positive for you. While I've only been to Big Daddy's once and BBQ for life several times, I've never had a single piece of meat on my plate at BBQ for life that I couldn't eat; At Big Daddy's, I had to pick through the meat in my sandwich (50/50) before thoroughly enjoying it. Don't worry... my husband ate what I refused :)

Side Salad: It was pathetic. I'll grant that most people don't go to a BBQ place expecting to eat salad, much less good salad, but this was really just a small portion of iceberg and onions with a tiny bit of cheese and tomatoes. It was boring AF. I mean... I think if you're going to put something on your menu, at least try. I guess iceberg is what boring-palate kids want, so it's understandable... just a disappointing to pay $3.50 for a tiny bowl of blah. Charge $1.50 at most or add some real lettuce and make it bigger.

Fries. Their Fries are just bland. Good amount of potato, though, and they're nice and crispy on the outside, but they could use some salt or paprika or garlic or... something. Meh at best. But with Chili all over them, yes. 

Meat cooking: My meat was dry (brisket and pulled pork). The reason I list this last is I love their sauces so much, it didn't really matter after I drenched it in their awesome sauces. But just the meat alone... nah. Maybe Sunday afternoon isn't the best time to eat there... maybe I just got unlucky. Maybe it's supposed to be dry and my lifetime BBQ experience has been a huge lie.

Where Big Daddy's Wins:
Portions: Big Daddy's portions per dollar were about half again as much as BBQ for life's.

Breads: Big Daddy's buns and hoagies were better - not only was the bread itself better, but they grilled it, which gave it a nice crunch on the inside and a barrier for sauce.

Sauces: I prefer Big Daddy's sauces across the board, so I totally didn't mind juicing it up a little bit. My husband loves the Chiver's BBQ sauce served at BBQ for life, but I prefer more depth of flavor and spice. Big Daddy's had a sweet sauce (thickest), a spicy sauce, and Carolina sauce, which was a bit vinegary. I mixed all 3 for the perfect sauce. mmmmmm good!

Mac-n-cheese: Big Daddy's Mac-n-cheese was creamier, but I like the spice in BBQ for life's Mac-n-cheese; Overall, I'd mix them together and add more bacon for total win. Kids like this version better.

Brisket Chili Fries: YUM. Our plate of chili fries was gone in two minutes flat. Not kidding. This chili made me think I should start eating chili. I'm not a chili person at all and I loved it. Perhaps too much sour cream, but nothing I couldn't just scrape off to the side.

Jalapeno sausage: Total win. Delicious. Get some.

Ribs: I didn't eat them, but my daughter liked them better than BBQ4life - whatever that means - she is pretty enthusiastic about her ribs, so... I trust her.
I travel for a living and avoid chains whenever possible.  Kona is not by any stretch your typical chain.  I love the drinks and sushi. Really great.

I grew up on cheesesteaks living in Philadelphia.  Lived in Colorado a few years and never could find a good one there so I was not expecting much in Idaho.  I was really surprised to find a good one here.  The roll was not the same as a Philly sandwich but it was still very good.  The meat and onions were flavorful and I thought the price was reasonable.  I am happy.

I've written it before. I'll write it again: Winco is an Idaho gem. They continue to shine. Great selection, low prices, bag your own groceries. 

The only downside is the name. Waremart was much better. "Winco" reminds me of President Gerald Ford's WIN program, Whip Inflation Now. A shortened version of "Winning Company" isn't very creative. That doesn't stop me from shopping there, though.
Sunrise NEVER disappoints with their delicious housemade breakfast and exceptional service. Tanya is a pure delight!!

If you like hot sandwiches this place is probably great. I don't an was in impress with my sandwich. The cheese is low quality  for the price you're paying. I had pepper jack and it was super processed. The experience of this place is fun however. You start by choosing the type of sandwich you want pick a bag any bag. They are each different depending on what meat you want. Them on the bag you pick all the toppings. Then move to chips and pay then wait. I have to say I am an extremely picky person so this place may be amazing for you. If you like hot sandwiches.

I have ate here several times with friends and family.  Always a great meal.  Staff is responsive and polite and always seem to have a smile on their face when greeting you.  Seems to always be busy whether I've arrived with my family or for an impromptu business breakfast.  Popular place for locals. Portions are huge, we always struggle to finish our meal. Great place to for breakfast

Menu full of options.  Great clarification for food allergies and raw foods.  Started with a few sushi options and soup.   Sushi fish seemed fresh. Had a Chicken Caesar for lunch.  Great food overall

Server was in training.....working with a trainer.  Very good service, with minimal wait time 

Really enjoyed this place.
Great food as always!! Hit up the happy hour half price bottles of wine and take any remaining home!! Service as always was also wonderful.
We finally got to eat there. Great food. This is a place where breakfast for lunch would be good.

The food and service was great. The bacon breakfast burrito was awesome the green chili sauce is a must. The eggs Benedict is very good too. The drinks are good the have a twist with s the spicy cocktails

Gluten free bread option!  Yes not as fun as the sourdough, but sure appreciated!  Pastrami was phenomenal, coleslaw was light & refreshing, service was exceptional, enviro busy but somehow wRm & welcoming too!  I was impressed by the multi seating options for people waiting for food... in addition to the indoor & seating.
Fast service and little wait. Not very crowded and the fish tacos are good. They have a kids eat free special that we use often.

Slanted Rock serves up great brews in a great little space with a perfect friendliness!

Came here after our Yelp Community Event at High Desert Harley and enjoyed a Iron Butt Red Ale.  So delish.  I also enjoy their Silhouette Dark Ale and had a sip of my companion's Imperial Stout, which was all kinds of amazing (probably my favorite!).

The servers/bartenders are prompt ad completely lovely.  A true neighborhood kind of place.  If it was anywhere near my hood, they'd find me a frequent visitor.  Even without living in the area, I still definitely look forward to making the trip on regular basis.  

If, for no other reason, than I noticed on their website that one of their seasonals is called: Pantyhose Imperial Baltic Vanilla Porter.  Porter is my fave and theirs sounds just downright delicious!

Get to it!

Great service with menu knowledgeable staff. Try the Kentucky Mule, it's fantastic. The calamari is some of the best in the valley. Sushi is always fresh and very flavorful with good happy hour deals. Can't wait for spring again so the patio can be enjoyed.

Stayed at the Hilton Garden Inn that is literally across the street from this terrific local establishment. Why pay almost $11 a person for breakfast at the hotel when you can get so much more - that's so much better - for the about the same price at Joe Momma's?  Started with their homemade cinnamon roll. I was lucky to get the last one. It was a soft, warm serving of deliciousness slathered with a lip-smacking cover of cream cheese frosting. Oh so good!  Followed that with a "light" breakfast of an egg-cheese-ham-spinach sandwich and a bowl of fresh fruit. My husband had the special of the day, the peach stuffed French toast. More than either of us could eat. And, bonus, our cups were always full of excellent, hot coffee. Lots of food. Great service. Go, and go hungry.
Steak sandwich was more gooder than expected. First time here & will definitely be back!!  Thanks for a good lunch.  I'll return!

3.5 We have been here a few times and I like it, but I don't love it. It feels like a chain restaurant. The interior is very cool. Both times the service was pretty good but not very personal. I have had the sushi which was pretty good but not stellar. It's a fun location right by the Village.
Vina has some great traditional style Vietnamese food. By far the best spring rolls in town.

Exceptional Mexican Cuisine and awesome service. The owner(Jose - the chef) and his staff came by our table to make sure that everything was prepared to our satisfaction. I was impressed by the freshness of the food and the perfection of the preparation of the salsas and entrees. I will be stopping in at least once a week for this fantastic Mexican food. The Carne Asada w/ fried jalapenos was some of the best I have ever had and the beer was super cold.

With the ongoing proliferation of brew-houses/micro brewery/restaurants opening in the Boise area, it's so nice to find a really choice one south of the 84 freeway.  Now you don't have to get caught in the BoDo traffic mess to get great beer!  I used to go to Brewforia (two blocks away) but their prices for selections on tap have climbed to the point of the ridiculous.  Enter Slanted Rock Brewing Company with great tasting beer and an acceptable price point.  Just in the nick-of-time!

Have been to this location a few times and always enjoy my experience. The same young man is always working and is so polite and professional! Always greets us, comes over to offer samples, and is pleasant at check out. The flavors are good, waffle cones/bowls are amazing and the spread is good too (would recommend an Oreo topping though!). Thanks for the great clean spot and awesome customer service!

Plenty of people have already griped about lousy customer service and goofy billing tricks. Now here's a twist -- a couple of CenturyLink salesmen (persons?) came to my house, declaring "we're switching all your neighbors to a fast fiber optic internet". 
I've already been around the block a few years with Century Link, and this sounded intriguing. But its same old 4-wire copper phone lines in my house, going to some fiber optic interface down the street. And I know for a fact that my nearest neighbor is NOT switching to CenturyLink, as he just subscribed with cable one.
And here is a tip. Whoever is your IP provider, dont pay them $50+ for telephone "service". Get Magic Jack voip. All long distance is included, no extra nickle and dime baloney.

This company was an absolute pleasure to work with. We needed a new roof urgently at a very busy time of year. They scheduled us promptly and got the job done in only one day, including cleanup!

I particularly liked that the estimate was given without someone having to come out and look at the roof. It was nice to hear back about the cost within an hour or two of my initial contact. I don't know what magic they use for this but it definitely streamlined the process of gathering bids.

Ok so their food is made to order which is delicious, but their Pho broth was too sweet! Their cups or glass can use an upgrade! Seems like they are not washed or over scrubbed! They need to keep up with cleaning their restaurant as well, dust every where and utensils have food stuck.

We only planned on staying here one night but wound up staying three!  We FLED another motel towards downtown Boise due to a bug issue.  The greeting was warm and sincere and the rate, for this nice of a motel, was only $20.00 more than Expedia's El Cheapo Super Duper rates.  Huh!  The place looked, smelled and WAS clean.  My wife and youngest were elated and who would have thought something as simple as that would have made a vacation THAT MUCH MORE enjoyable.  Breakfast is good, staff totally rocks and the rooms-  WOW!  I hope they don't change a thing as we plan on coming back next year and you know where we will be staying.  FYI, the pool/spa is 24 hour!!

All the staff here are fantastic, which I had my dogs spayed hours later at home one was hurting so bad she couldn't stop shaking the vet advised bringing her back, they kept her overnight to control the pain better & only charged me for any medication they gave her, now my latest trip here, April 28, 2017, my girl was sick and I wasn't sure what was going on, turns out she has a bladder infection I got antibiotics from them & have had questions since which they've kindly & politely answered for me over the phone. The true compassion this entire staff has for animals shows me this is the only Vet my "baby" is going to. I highly recommend them to all pet owners!!!
Thank you ALL!!!

This new location of recently opened a couple of weeks ago but we had a breakfast and the food was served cold and the pancakes were thin and tasted like cardboard.  We brought our issue to the waitress and when she brought the check, she stated Sorry and we would do better next time.  I will do better and go to Moe Joes instead.  I will say the other sunrise restaurants are much higher food quality.  Disappointed.

Cafe ole is one of my favorite restaurants to visit when we are in my hometown. Since they closed the 8th street marketplace location, we had been visiting the mall location (and were starting to get a little discouraged by the service and ambiance there). This was our first time at the meridian location and oh my gosh, my faith has been restored. The restaurant is much more comfortable than the other location, our server was incredibly attentive, and even though he messed up one of the four of our orders, he quickly offered to remedy it and it was no big deal at all. The food was fantastic and the margaritas were delicious!!! I now know it is worth a little longer drive from the north end to meridian to get the experience and food I literally dream about when I'm not in boise.

10 starts is more appropriate for the outstanding service!! 

My best friend and I are regulars here dining in at least twice a week. Every time we come in we are greeted with a smile, and the servers are amazing. 
The best time to dine in is during there happy hour. Half price on sushi rolls are amazing! Speaking of the sushi, It is to die for. 
We're always looking forward to eating here after work. It has such a fun atmosphere and the patio has such a good view of the fountain.

My favorite coffee place in the nation. Hands down. I've been dreaming of this place ever since I came back to Pittsburgh. 
My favorite drink is an iced caramel macadamia nut latte with coconut milk. To. Die. For.

Have now visited cafe ole 4 times and have not been disappointed. Beer is ice cold and my wife loves their margaritas. The food is always fresh and especially for being idaho where good Mexican food is rare. Taco Tuesday is a good time as well.
The whole experience here is superb great service and even better food can't think of a better place to come eat. I would probably be here every night if I could be.

Every time I've visited All Valley I've seen professional and courteous staff. My dog was treated very well while there. When I went back to recovery to visit my dog I found a tech putting a second blanket on her because she was shaking coming out of the anesthesia. The dr.s were very caring and I love the options for and level of care that this hospital has for various problems. The rescue/adoption center is a favorite place for my daughters to browse while we are at the clinic and I think it's great that the Dr.'s choose to do this for these animals!

This place is still one of my favorites! The atmosphere is cute, the options are seemingly endless, the baristas are exceedingly kind. just all around a great place. The lemon muffin was absolutely delicious and moist. But I have to say, since moving to the Boise area, this is one of my top three favorite coffee stops. Still a fabulous choice, though.

Love the Crispy fish sandwich!

IMO...Better than McD's and the fries & fry sauce are an added bonus.  Of course, you should get a small sundae to dip your fries in, if you are so inclined!  It's DQ after all

Usually come here for happy hour sushi. When it's happy hour I don't mind paying the 4-5$ per roll. However would not pay regular price for the rolls. Somewhat dry and flavorless sushi. Happy hour pizzas and margaritas are very tasty and they always make the margaritas pretty strong. Overall another chain restaurant that's slightly overpriced during regular hours.

Bonos service will never fail to disappoint. Your meal can be great IF you get what you ordered. I've given them as many chances as I can and tonight was the last nail in the coffin. Every employee's attitude exudes "I'd rather be anywhere else right now".

Apparently a large Italian beef, wet with hot peppers and a side of au jus translates to plain dry meat in a bun. 

Goodbye Bono's, no more of my money for you.
It was good...but not wow. The service was amazing, though extremely slow.... And I was one of two customers. I had a sandwich and cookie

My son and I walk on into Bonos, before we order we are told there is no beef or chicken wings. As we order, the man is not sure what is in stock and what is not and goes to check 3 different times. We ordered a thin crust pizza, chicken caesar salad, and onion rings...they are out of Caesar dressing so they gave us cheap watery Italian dressing. I ordered iced tea and he then had to check if he had tea, come on! It took 20 minutes for our food to come when we were the only customers in the restaurant, normally I wouldn't think twice about food taking 20 minutes. There was another couple that left right as we sat down, it looked as if they got tired of waiting for their food because their number was still sitting on the table as if it never came. When the man comes to serve our food, he tells us that he almost dropped the pizza and that he was a train wreck! He tries to put the pizza on the table, drops our silverware, and picks it up and gives them to us off the floor without giving us clean silverware. As he is serving the Caesar salad he says that the cook is out back smoking and he just took the salad and the cook did not know if the food was delivered or not. The owner's office seems to be a booth underneath the TV, he has his computer and papers on the table in the main seating area of the restaurant, beside the booth there is an outlet where his phone is plugged in and laying on the floor. Several tables are covered in crumbs.

This place has so much potential as the food they had in stock was decent and the atmosphere was pretty cool but the service was atrocious! Yikes! This place is going under if they don't make some serious changes!

Consistently a great wash! I have a black Escalade that looks stunning when clean but not so much when dirty. I've been through the epic shine car wash about a dozen times and bought the best monthly wash package for both of my vehicles. I appreciate the towels to dry any remaining drips and the powerful vacuums for the inside. A clean vehicle if really important to me as a Real Estate Broker and this is the best way for me to accomplish it!

If you want to read a short review, here it is.  . . FANTASTIC!

The owners are extremely friendly and remember me every time I come in. The food is excellent! Best BBQ I have ever had. Although it wasn't planned, I somehow ended up buying a house close by ;)

Price: 4/5 - A little pricey, but it makes it a nice treat once in a while.

Atmosphere: 4/5 - Feels like you are at grandma's house for dinner. Not a big concern as the food is what is most important. It just isn't a place that you would go to dress up and go on a date. 

Staff: 5/5 - Extremely friendly. Mom & pop business.

Location: 4/5 - A little off the beaten path & hidden, but makes for a nice treat when you are in the area. 

Food: 4.5/5 - Excellent! Took .5 off just because sometimes the meat can be a little fatty, but for the most part it is always great. 

Value: 5/5 - Big portions of great food. Includes 1 large side and a huge entree.

I've been here twice, both times unmemorable/mediocre.
On my most recent visit on October 7, I came here for dinner. Place was packed, due to homecoming or prom or whatever it's called these days. We had the potstickers, which were meh. Filling was cold and dry and tasteless, and the dipping sauce was lacking in flavor as well.

My boyfriend had never tried miso soup, and I'm sorry this was his first experience. It was overly fishy, to the point to where I could only handle one spoonful. I would think that the server would notice that we didn't like it because our bowls were untouched, and I also told her I didn't care for it, and her response was "oh". 

I had a sushi roll, is was decent. Boyfriend had sushi sampler. It was okay. Had the snickers pie which was okay, but I'm not a big sweets person.

Service was adequate. Food is blah. Won't be coming back.

We went here for the smoked trout eggs. They were very good. We arrived early and it is a good things we did. the place filled up quickly on a Saturday morning. The coffee was average. the French toast was average and the potatoes, despite being in Idaho were average. The food was not bad but is sure not the best in eagle.

Late night dinner after 8 hours of traveling. Two adults and 4 children 2-16 years old.

Host greeted us warmly but started us with no kids menus, crayons and when the drinks came out he didn't think about a kid's cup.

Server was very nice but very forgetful. Constantly had to remind her.of things we asked for. Most of our food came out together except for the two year old's. It took an additional 10-15 minutes and all it was was food from the fryer. Good thing she was patient.

Food was as good as Shari's food is. Even though the menu looks great the food is nothing to write home about. I know that's more of a personal preference.

Bottom line, you get fed with ok food, but if you want attentive service go somewhere else.

After being overcharged for over a year for a device I never had, they offered me $30 instead of $140 to fix THEIR mistake. That was a while ago. On June 26th my service with this nightmare of a company ended, and while on the phone with their customer service was told that they bill in advance so I would actually get a refund check. Great! Not. On June 29th, AFTER I was no longer their customer, $60.99 out of my account. My refund check just arrived .. $26.43. Of course, I called and was told the exact opposite of what I was told the day I cancelled. Losing sixty bucks to no longer be their customer actually seems worth it.

Another favorite. Great menu and drink selection. Food presentation was beautiful and tasted wonderful. I had the Shashimi dish. It was fresh tasting. Staff was friendly and professional. Liked the ambiance of the place as well. Impo, its a 'great date' night place!

So much yum here! The sandwiches are good, the platters are awesome, and the service is fantastic! Wish they had cornbread muffins instead of rolls and a slightly larger beer/drink selection but even so, it's easy to give Big Daddy's BBQ a 5 star rating!

Yay Soda Stop! It's always a treat when I get a message that family is meeting up there. I'm always fascinated by the various options of sodas they have. 

Being gluten free its sometimes hard to know for sure what I can eat and what I can't. The staff was kind enough to reach out to their manager for me and find out some of the ingredients on some of the food orders.  I ordered a build your own salad. Love this option. 

I'm looking forward to my mother returning to visit me from out of state so I can bring her. She is a soda flavor mixer enthusiast. 

My only comment would be to be mindful of the temperature. I was freezing and had to step out to warm up a bit. Otherwise, I definitely look forward to coming again and trying new flavors.

Variety of latte choices with soy milk option. Good service and good food if you eat eggs and cheese ;-) The veggie breakfast burrito without cheese or eggs add avocado is what I have tried and it is pretty yummy.

I came back with a group and have to bump off a star. My friend made a reservation earlier in the week that was lost, which wasn't that big a deal, but rather than apologizing and leaving it at that, they treated her like she made it up. The original plan was Yard House, which doesn't take reservations during the weekend, so settling for the second choice was disappointing enough without the awkward interrogation.

They did provide appetizers to make up for the wait, but a sincere apology would have been nicer rather than giving the customer a hard time. One of my other friends previously had a bad experience when attempting to eat there as well. I think they need to keep in mind a couple more restaurants are opening at the Village in the near future, at least one of which will dip into their target demographic (not that poor service is ever okay.) 

Comparatively our servers were very nice. 

I tried a cosmorita. I'm leery of "skinny" cocktails because they can be overly sweet, but it was really good. It really tasted like a cosmopolitan flavored margarita, and it worked. I also had the red velvet cupcake I've read such rave reviews about. I think they incorporated sour cream in the frosting, and in just the right amount to counterbalance the sweetness. It was light and luxurious all at the same time. 

There were a couple groups there for birthdays, including ours, and they do bring the birthday guy or girl a cupcake with a candle, which was unexpected. Really, once we were seated everything was wonderful so it's a shame the initial experience soured it.

Love this hotel! We had to stay a couple days because our family wasn't quite ready for us, they checked us in early, the staff was always friendly and it's very close to the freeway but not loud at all. Rooms are clean, the pool is nice and the breakfast has a good variety . This is where we will stay again when we come back .

Super nice staff and super fast and I am just amazed at how this place always has a positive vibe. We also get food delivered frequently to our house and they are SO fast! I am just so impressed with the whole chain and this location is no different. Top notch all the way!
Nice atmosphere when you enter the facility; however i found the food to be mediocre, especially based on their pricing.

I have found gluten free items at this restaurant making in possible to enjoy eating out again

Talia at this restaurant makes you feel like you really belong when you walk in.   Some places "home town" you meaning that if they don't know you, you are not treated well.   Not with this person.     

Will return many times
Everything with this restaurant is great. The food was great the service was great. The menu has  a good variety and the restaurant is very modern. We had a great dinner.
Fantastic food and service!!! I'll let everyone know about my experience. If you want a graet breakfast with high-end food....this is your place

Finding a stylist after a cross country move can be as difficult as finding a new medical provider, especially when you're a female with finicky hair. Sydnee was recommended to me by both friends and family and I've been so pleased with her service, sense of humor, and honesty!
As forecast, this place has closed.  You can't have bad service in this town and get away with it for long.  Bye bye Bono's, hello Flat Bread Pizza Co. - Welcome!!!!
And that's being generous. There are several places nearby with much better barbeque search them or and avoid the indigestion that this place gives.

This is one of my husbands and child's favorite places to eat and we come here frequently.   We have been to this location twice this week and the first time had poor service, mess ups in the kitchen and food coming out at various times.  The manager gave us a discount, a $5 coupon and a free appetizer and apologized.  Tonight we came back and same issues.  Very slow service, wrong orders and the pastas came out 5 minutes later then the other food.  Plus, the pastas were very dry.  The only reason I am giving 2 stars is we have been here many times with good service and good food and I am hoping that it might be new Management, new staff or new kitchen staff and this will help them focus on making improvements.
Great food! Cool atmosphere! Have gone back a couple times! Would definitely go again! Interesting menu, lots to choose from!
Took a second trip Cafe' ole and again I enjoyed. I would recommend good service and good. Portions are large and can be shared.

Ken stands by the work that comes out of his shop and has proven that to me a few times now. When I bought a Mercedes from him that he had rebuilt in December, 2014 he guaranteed that there were no mechanical problems with the car.  On a couple occasions some problems arose that he could not have foreseen, and he fixed them out of his own pocket.  This is definitely a shop you can trust to do good work and not to take advantage of you.   Not to mention they undercut the rates of the local dealer while providing excellent quality service.Anyone with Mercedes or other German cars should give German Star a shot.
The only thing  they could do better is offering the chile relleño daily. Staff is helpful, location is clean and service is great.

Having a gluten allergy takes a lot of the fun out of dining, but not at Twigs! I had already eaten at Yardhouse and Kona Grill at The Village, and was pleased that they both had GF specific menus, but they were very limited and not exciting. Twigs has a great GF menu!  Everyone else in my party enjoyed their food as well. The atmosphere is nice, and so is the patio.

I wanted to like this place.  I was looking forward to trying this location. The waffles looked awesome. I was so disappointed.  The smell after I ordered was enough to make me sick and the sandwich had the worst chemical taste.  It's like they put Pam in the burner and it baked into the waffle. All you could taste was chemical and burnt. The sandwich looked amazing and had so much potential.  
I ordered to go so couldn't say anything while onsite. The customer service for ordering was nice.

My wife and I had two hamburgers, onion rings, and a salad. The burgers were DRIPPING with oil, the salad had been made, uh, a while ago - it was not fresh! The burgers were obviously frozen, and served on "ciabatta" bread (actually some sort of baguette) which left awkward half-circles of meat protruding from the sides. The relish looks like some sort of neon-green chemistry project. I will say, the onion rings were EXCELLENT! But not good enough to rescue our abysmal gut-bomb lunch. We won't be going back.

Another great yelp find of an independently owned and operated, out of the way place. I had the California Benny based on an earlier review and it was delicious. Tried the county style hash browns and they were cubed about twice the size as I prefer. Normally I'd drop one star for that but can't because their flavor was awesome. 

I went on a Tuesday morning about 8:15 and they were about 1/3 full. Oddly, around 9:00 they got pretty busy and the place filled up. Good service overall. 

Get here. You won't regret it.
Been there twice. The food here is the best Texas style BBQ I've had in the valley to my tastes. Lived in San Antonio for six years.

Finally found some killer bbq in Boise wow! I've travelled the country in search of great bbq and this place nailed it! The pulled pork, sweet sauce with coleslaw and potato salad is freakish awesome. My daughter thought the Mac and cheese was primo and I agreed. Great craft beer and excellent service too!

Happy hour seating is open seating but all taken and regular seating is all empty. Happy hour of course doesn't allow you to take out the food you buy, but then staff are less than helpful to arrange seating.
We drove clear from Caldwell to get cake at you store because the internet says your open tell 9pm. Change your web site or your door but please pick a time!!!!

Love this place.  Not typical but so worth it.  New rice bowls now, yummy noodles, and the surprise, a crossant pressed sandwich which was surprising delicious.  Tony the owner is great, and loves to explore fun food.  If you like to explore, you'll love it here.
I'm being generous is giving 3 stars. Over priced and not very good tasting. I've had WAY better BBQ. Save your self a trip. Hubby and I spent $50 with our little one.

The food is amazing and the service is friendly.  This is my favorite breakfast spot in town.  Their pancakes are perfect and the cinnamon rolls are to die for.  Only complaint is that they don't serve cinnamon rolls during the week.  Expect to wait if eating here on the weekend.  Well worth it though.

Kona Grill use to be one of our favs to go to, however the menu changed and so did the quality of their food. Last night we ordered lettuce wraps and they were clearly salty and uneatable, so I kindly mentioned it to our server and she said they go by the same recipe each time with the same ratio of salt...huh?...then walked away. I did not eat it and when the bill came I let her know I was not able to eat it so I cannot pay for it! She said I need to get my manager...he came and offered me another one with the sauce on the side...really? I said No Thank You..we are clearly ready to leave, yes there was an attitude from him which I found to be upsetting, we will not recommend this restaurant to anyone. Also ordered a rum drink on the happy hour menu for $7 and ordered another shot of rum to add to it because it was way too sweet. I looked at the bill and they charged me another $7 for the shot...what? rip off!!! Very disappointed!!
Relocated to live here and moved all my medical records with all my new doctors they are more then willing to assist with my health care and do so in a very timely manner

I grew up in Spokane, the birthplace of Bruchi's Cheesesteaks and Subs, so when we moved to Meridian in the fall and I saw the sign that it was being built next to Black Rock, I was thrilled. I've always been a fan of their turkey (it used to be called the Western, roast turkey and provolone on their freshly baked bread) and now I enjoy it on their Caesar salad.

This location has been open for two weeks and still has some operational kinks to iron out: specifically supply and wait times. I can't fault the community for becoming early adopters! They've sold out (well, run out of bread) and closed early several days since opening. While we haven't had any complaints about the wait, I know when you have a hungry family that a place that's considered 'fast casual' should be, in fact, fast.

We enjoy the quality of the food, the proximity to home, and the friendly atmosphere. Rooting on their success...and an increase in baked bread.

Worst selection of Nike shoes I have ever seen in one of the Nike factory stores locations.  It is as if all the other factory stores sent all their rejects to this store .  I have stopped at this location on many occasions to see if they have updated their selections of shoes and it's all the same terrible stuff. They had a good selection of walking and running shoes with but god awful colorways.  The selection didn't have a single pair of Jordan's.  There was 2  pairs of Kobes which both had bad colorways, 1 pair of Kd's ,no Lebrons ,no Kyries, no Air max , no hauraches....what a joke of a so called Nike factory store.  Keep your Air Monarks

I am so thankful for All Valley. I take my dogs there for their normal check ups and for any concerns I've had with them in the past. My dog recently had to get stitches and the first clinic (not All Valley) I went to let us wait 3 hours before even seeing her just to tell us they couldn't get her in for surgery until the next day. She was bleeding profusely and they stuck a bandage on her (without cleaning the wound) and sent us on our way. So instead we went to All Valley's emergency clinic and they got our dog in to see the doctor within 30 minutes of arrival and took her back for surgery minutes later. They gave us hourly updates while she was there and kept our costs as low as they could (in fact, we paid less than the low end quote -- but I will add that I know that can't always be the case as complications can occur during surgery). Our sweet pup was alert when we picked her up and they even sent us with a nice booty to put on her so her bandage wouldn't get wet outside. This was a nice change of pace as the last pet ER clinic I used my dog came out incredibly delirious and they told us to wrap her paw in plastic wrap to take her outside (seriously?). All Valley's staff took wonderful care of my dog and of us during that stressful time and I would recommend them to everyone!

I spent a week here for work. It met my minimal requirements of a quiet, comfortable place to sleep. Here is what I noticed:

The good:
- Above average cleanliness for the price.
- Responsive to any maintenance needs. Light was out and it was fixed within short order.
- Room was quiet and bed comfortable.
- Internet worked well.
- AC/Heat worked well and was reasonably quiet.
- Accept dogs, which is a plus for me.
- Decent pool area.
- Exercise room was small and limited, but at least they have one.
- Fresh cookies in the evening.

The not so good:
- Below average breakfast. Oatmeal was inedible most days as were the scrambled eggs. I usually ended up with a hard boiled egg, toast, and yogurt.  
- Had to drive to get a meal or drink, unless you wanted McDonalds.

Used to love this place but the attitude of the hostess left a bitter taste in my mouth. I choose to spend my money where customers are appreciated. If the meal was free I wouldn't step foot I. This establishment.

I'm so happy that I live near The Village. My family enjoys a lot of the restaurants and our little boy is in love with the water fountain and light show that happens on the hour, every hour. We love the movie theater (especially the $5 Tuesday night deal) and if we want to walk around but not in the shopping area, we can quickly cross the street over to Kleiner Park wth trails, a view of a small lake, and a great playground and fun water area for kids to play.

Inside was nice and clean but the food experience wasn't great.

Bought the basket of wings and fries. 5 wings and fries. Wings were under sauced. Barely any flavor on the wings and fries were over-salted.

On top of that, my 5 piece wings was just 4, they shorted me a wing!  Won't be returning.
