My two sisters, my 86 year old dad and myself had planned dinner at Kona for over a month.  I am having major stomach surgery and after today I will be on a liquid diet only for six weeks. 
We ordered for my dad a steak with clam chowder added on.  Waitress even confirmed added on. My sister and I split a filet medium.   Then our waitress disappeared. Water never refilled and chowder never came.  Finally food was delivered the chowder came out with my dad's dinner.  When we cut into our filet it was Very rare.  Still no waitress so flagged down a manager she said they would refire our steak.  By the time it came back we had finished the rest of our meal, still not cooked properly but no one came to check. Waitress showed up finally asking about dessert we told her we were deciding still. So she left table leaving all our dirty dishes behind. We saw that she was helping a large table so we waited ten minutes for her to come back to get dessert order.  We ordered our dessert plus two cappuccinos. She said she didn't know if machine was working but would check and come right back. We told her if cappuccino machine was broken we did not want dessert.  She said I'll go check and be right back.  She NEVER came back. My sisters tracked her down and the manager.  She said she was learning how to make it.  At that point we canceled coffee and dessert.   after complaining about raw steak again she asked manager and the steak was removed from our bill. However, manager never came to our table even though she knew how unhappy we were. Worst experience ever.

Had dinner here with the family and give this place 2 stars based solely on the attentive service that we received. The food and drinks were less than mediocre. We had a couple of martini specialty drinks and apps while waiting for the last few people to show up. The bruschetta flatbread seemed to skimp on everything but the balsamic glaze and the calamari was your basic uninspired calamari. The specialty drinks all crossed to the overly-sweet side of the street. Unimpressed, I decided to play it safe (and light), and go with the roasted beet and pear salad with goat cheese and candied walnuts. The walnuts were good, the pear slices were good and that's about it. The beets were diced (as in very tiny) and had that rubbery texture that you get when they've been sitting in the fridge a day too long. The goat cheese was sparse at best. Pretty tough to screw up a beet salad, but now I've seen it done. No dessert. The service was very good.

I ordered a medium Turkey sandwich. I asked for Mustard. Bad decision. When I got my sandwich the mustard was drenched and it made the bread soggy. I will never have them put mustard on my sandwich again. I feel like I paid $10 for a soggy sandwich. I might try it again but not sure yet.

Pretty good food, and service. Monday morning, we expected breakfast, but it extended into lunch. Way more food than we could eat at once. My farmer hash was delicious even after I reheated it for lunch. Floor was immaculate, until my toddler spilled his apple juice. No close access for handicapped, but my wife was still able to navigate the curb.

A very nice facility, and Great Customer Service.
Pam the Service Advisor, was Awesome , she kept  me in the loop about the progress of my vehicle, was very friendly and great to talk too.

I came here with a friend on Sunday for lunch.  My friend had Sushi and said it was very good.  I had the cheeseburger sliders and was very disappointed.  I requested they be cooked over well - pink and they were very well done and dry.  The toppings also left something to be desired.  The best part of it was the bun.  We also waited a long time for our food.   Our bloody mary's had old and wilted celery.  I've heard this place is good, but don't know that I will eat here again on a Sunday.

While the service was good, the food was decent and it comes with a hefty price tag for such small serving sizes. We ordered the spider roll, Brie and Apple flatbread, clam chowder, a vodka cran, and a passion fruit iced tea. The spider roll came with 6 pieces of sushi for $12 and the batter tasted burnt. My fiancé was still hungry so he ordered a clam chowder which was good but tasted more like bacon chowder and the bowl was only half full. The Brie flatbread was good but I ended up picking most of the apples off as they were very overpowering. $46 later (plus tip), I feel I could have gone to Chik-Fil-A down the street for a fraction of the cost and would have been more satisfied.
Absolutely AMAZING! We are so glad we came and will definitely be back. The food is delicious and homemade (like the best hummus of my life) and the service is awesome.
I have been a couple times! Not a fan. My kids didn't eat the food and they are just always to busy and overwhelmed. This is more of a place to go for business or on a date not as a family
Best Starbucks ever. I always go to this one because it's close to my house but mainly the line is never bad. And if it is they are super fast. Great job sbux. My favorite one in Boise easily.

Never a bad time here at Kona. Always packed whenever I come, which is a great sign. Food is always filling and service also good. Calle was our server tonight and kept things simple and easy, like how we like. Def coming back.

I boarded my chocolate lab at All Valley in August 2014. When I had toured the facility before hand I was told that I could have her vaccinations done the day I dropped her off to board. This is also what I was told when I made her reservations. 

I dropped her off the day I was leaving town and was once again told that it was no problem to do her vaccinations that day.
About three days after we took our dog home she was throwing up every hour and had a hacking cough. I took her to west vet in Boise and was told she had kennel cough and possibly pneumonia. I was shocked to find this out because she had been vaccinated for kennel cough at all valley. When I called all valley nothing was done to help me. They wouldn't even refund my money for the vaccination.

In the end I ended up paying $90 for vaccinations, $79 for an emergency vet visit, and $120 for my dog's antibiotic. 

All Valley gave me incorrect information about vaccinations and because of it my dog got incredibly sick and instead of admitting their mistake and making it right they denied everything.

I will never take my dog back and I would urge people to take their animals elsewhere.

This is a really upbeat restaurant! The music will pump you up and you may have to talk louder than usual at this restaurant. I personally like a more calm and lively place to eat but, an upbeat place was different to me. I'm not quite sure if I like it or not but one thing for sure is that the food is amazing! I ordered a medium-well steak and it came with a corn mix. The steak was perfectly cooked. I prefer a steak that melts in your mouth, this steak was very thick and had a lot of chewing involved. My waitress was very helpful by checking up on us every once in a while.
Love this place so much! The waffle sandwich just melts in your mouth, so delicious! The milk teas are also good. Not a fan of the boba but that's just a personal preference :)

I haven't explored the Village too terribly much, to be honest. However, every time I have been, I've been to the are with the fountains. 

The ample amount of outdoor seating is fantastic, especially surrounding the different restaurants and bars. I love that everything flows so well and is integrated into a large "community" feel. 

The fountain show is fun, especially for the kiddos. The play structure is a great having, as well. The Village is perfect for a girl's day filled with shopping and wining and dining, a family movie night out, or a classy date night. The selections are abundant and you can't go wrong, no matter where you end up!

The customer service with this company is awful!!!! AWFUL! I thought I had set up services with them and then every time I called back after that no one could find my order and no one seemed to know what was going on. The people were very rude and just seemed pushy to sign me but were terrible with communication after that. I cancelled my account after being placed on hold with a salesperson for 20 minutes, I could hear her typing but she wouldn't tell me what she was doing or why I was holding for so long and gave me attitude when I asked what the heck I was on hold for! Definitely not a great company to work with
Sarah just cut and colored my girlfriends hair.  The color is perfect and the cut and style looks fantastic.  Very impressed!!!!

Wonderful paninis!  We got an Italian and the Vancouver, they were both amazing.  I'm super impressed with their cookies as well - Delish!  I don't generally chill my cookies, but we really liked them.  I don't feel that they taste frozen (as another reviewer had posted). Lots of different custom sofa options, I can't wait to go back again.  Owner/staff are very friendly and helpful, they told us that they do deliveries as well.  Prompt service, super clean storefront. Five star service and food!
Nice big store but the customer service sucks!  Long lines and very slow check out and the manager is an old grumpy bitch!!

I've been several times and the food has always been good, as was the service. The prices are a bit high overall, considering their competition at The Village. Some menu items (and cocktails) are overpriced.

I had the worst experience I have ever had at this restaurant today. My waitress, who's name was Hailey, was the rudest waitress I have ever had. The manager (who's name I do not know) was very unprofessional and rude, as well. They would not let twelve year girls order off the kids menu and just assumed they were older than 13. My friend and I tried to take our younger sisters to dinner. We decided to bring drinks from a different restaurant into the Kona Grill. Our waitress made us throw them away and wanted us to buy their drinks instead. Had she been polite about her request, we would have understood. We were going to report our waitress to the manager, but discovered he was rude, as well.  Not knowing what we had done wrong, and having our evening ruined, we decided to take our order to go. That seemed to make matters worse. Let's just say I'm never going back there and I hope they see this.

Just had a terrific lunch today. Bruschetta flatbread was outstanding - great flavors. The soup of the day was unique, but worth every penny. It was a Chicken-pineapple-chipotle soup that was sweet but spicy, awesome. With all the options in town, we sometimes forget about the great food at Twigs. Can't go wrong by choosing Twigs for lunch or dinner. Our server, Kelly, was outstanding.

This is our go to every year when we are driving cross country.  The Steelhead Scramble is amazing!!!  Everything about Joe Momma's makes you want to come back including the friendly staff and endless cups of great coffee.  Keep up the great work!!!!

We went lastnight for dinner, I had never been here before. It was a fairly good experience. The food was hot and very flavorful. I noticed that the owners kids were doing most of the heavy lifting there, which I think is great. But, you still have to supervise the kids to make sure that everything is going smoothy and the customer is getting exactly what they need and want. They did great for being young teens but they are still kids and dont fully grasp what people are wanting. But other than that, the service and food were great, our glasses were never empty! :) come enjoy the great food just be a lil patient with the young ones, they are still "in training". Lol

Great atmosphere! The hot dogs are good but some of the staff seem rude and like they don't have time to help you. I've even seen two people who work there fight over who had to clean a table after a customer left.

I've tried a few sandwiches there and they've all been great. I now have a 'usual' I get every so often. The multitude of good add-ons is a big positive for me as I'm super picky. Food is great and customer service is spot on. I'm always greeted as soon as I walk in and given direct attention, even when it's packed inside. Also, their oreo shakes are amazing!!

We went there on Mother's Day, which we did incur an hr long wait which was expected on this day. After reading the Yelp reviews I went with the chicken fried steak which, is a real steak that they get from Porterhouse next door. It's not the rap you get at most restaurants. I ordered I it medium rare, everything issue from scratch so you at wait a little longer than normal. We seemed to have received our meals pretty quickly. The CFS was cooked just right, the over easy eggs were perfect as well. Our server Cody was on top of things and when I told how good the CFS was we fist bumped!  Gotta love that. People complain about the prices, I found them
To be in line with other places. Coming from San Francisco the prices were cheap to me. Highly recommend, we'll be back.

My husband took me to Twigs for my birthday. It's like Baskin Robbins for 'tini drinkers. When we arrived, they said it would be a 30 minute wait. No problem, I wanted to browse a few stores anyway. The cool thing is instead of a pager, they just get your number so they can text you. Our wait was only 15 minutes. 

We started with calamari, which is lightly breaded and seasoned with the occasional chili flake to give it just the right amount of heat, and the lemon garlic aioli was very tasty. Then my husband had steak with a red wine glaze and I had Alaskan cod and Twigs' signature fries. We also had an extra side of the lemon garlic aioli, which offset the heat from the cayenne on the fries perfectly. 

Amazingly we saved room for drunken donuts, which were so good. What could have been cloyingly sweet was decadent and creamy.  The apple pucker caramel was my favorite of the dipping sauces.

I also had a huckleberry lemon drop (something I could only find downtown until now) and a black stiletto, which is my new favorite drink. It's Black Velvet caramel whiskey, amaretto, a splash of sour and a cherry. It was so smooth. 

Our waitress Kayla was the right degree of present, always there when needed, never there at a bad time. The wait for food and drinks was minimal. Perfect service. My husband even requested to speak with the manager Laura. She is very passionate about Twigs and eager for feedback, good or bad.

Overall, Twigs is cut above the other Village restaurants with a more mellow, sophisticated ambiance and amazing food and drinks. I'd say it even rivals if not surpasses my downtown favorites. Most places have a particular drink or dish I like, or an ambiance I appreciate, but Twigs is the whole package.

Update: we've been back 3 times, and service has been consistently wonderful. The signature burger is transcendent. I recommend trying it without the bacon because the burger has such a good flavor already.

We heard amazing things about this place and were excited to try it.. Ribs were yummy, the sides were way small for the price of them. My husband had the brisket and that was pretty good too. One of those places you probably wouldn't go again but if the food is in front of you, you'll eat it.

This was a stop for the whole family.  We had a family reunion of sorts in this restaurant.  On a busy Sunday--smack in the middle of a holiday weekend and 12 of us looking for a table and they were able to accommodate us. (They don't take reservations).

They placed two tables together and were able to squeeze us in.  We were served promptly and with some tasty delights.  It was good fare, I had the French toast which was tasty.  However, the only French toast, I've ever had to use a knife on so there's that.

The meal was quickly served and we were on our way.  A side note, however, this is not the place to attempt any kind of conversation as it is noisy when busy.  They had a 45 minute wait they mentioned as we were leaving.

All in all a good meal.

If you can afford it, make the move for some LuluLemon attire. It is well made and classy as hell. Make sure the underwear fits you right! If can sometimes run big and not great for long runs it it isn't snug.

First time customer...just moved here and was very nervous about trusting my hair to someone new. Cindy did not disappoint! I sent my mom in later the same day and she was also very happy! Cindy is very knowledgeable about hair! You can trust her!

After a failed attempt to find something relatively close to the nearby water park, we wound up at Shari's.

It's Shari's.  Nothing stood out, nor made us question coming in.  Just your average everything.

I did order a milkshake for nostalgia purposes.  My boyfriend and I used to hang out at the Salem Shari's after I'd get off work and split a shake and a fry.

My daughter had a burger and wolfed it down, the airplane apparently had not served her any food on her flight.  It looked just like every other burger at all the other Shari's in the state.  No complaints.

Not a bad choice if you happen to be looking for something close, fast, and cheap.
Service was wonderful! Food was great, especially the sushi rolls! And they have some many gluten free options! I will go there again whenever I have a sushi craving!

Tasty Tuesdays! 2 dollar micro brews! Good clean tasting room and friendly staff.

There are cool quotes and beer art and a clear view of all the brewing operations.

Had an excellent breakfast here this morning!  They were busy and it took a little time to get our food, but our server was great and the food was delicious!  Will definitely be back. Highly recommend the Philly Hash and the biscuits are sooo yummy!!!

Chef's menu was a hit. However my grandmas burger didn't come out til after everyone else's plates arrived. Great service, and the outdoor patio is covered during the winter so you can watch the ice skaters. Great place to hit up after a movie next door. Happy hour has much better prices, but limited options. The house wine is a steal @ $5 a glass

Exactly as the two star rating states....I HAVE experienced better.  So many new restaurants to choose from in the area, what better way to sample than to attend happy hour.  My guest and I ordered appletinis and the French fries with gorgonzola sauce and the crab and artichoke dip.  The French fries were $6 and an additional $3 for the fondue.  Not worth it at all. The French fries were not special in any way.  They were $2.50 fries sprinkled with some paprika for color and sprinkle of dried basil that didn't stick to the fries and just fell to the bottom of the plate.  The fondue was o.k.  Again nothing special and frankly too rich to dip the fries in.  The crab artichoke dip was very good and generous enough for the appetizer portion, but I agree with another poster that there was not enough bread and we were not going to face the $1.50 dilemma of ordering more when there wasn't enough provided to begin with.   I had to walk to the bar to order my second drink and the restaurant was not even 10% full.  The martinis; The apple ones were o.k.  The huckleberry lemon was really good.  The staff were friendly, but not attentive.  Our waitress was nice but not very available/attentive and the bartender seemed put out when he was doing his job.  

Reporting back to my husband, I said ehh...happy hour menu not impressive, overall I wasn't impressed with the service.  I will not likely be over eager to go back.  I just wasn't wowed.  Sorry.

There are two Starbucks in the valley that I would go out of my way to make sure I go to. The one that's on Milwaukee and Franklin, and then this one. The staff here so nice and friendly they always greet me with excitement and smiles, the fact that they can remember me even with all of their customers makes me feel great. Today "purely by accident" the barista managed to put a heart and my latte and it's going to make me smile all day I can tell. Thank you so much for making me feel at home.
This place is off the hook good. The tri tip omelette is unbelievable. Fast service and absolutely great food.

Honestly I never take the time to write reviews but Kona is one of my favorite places to go splurge and eat they have such yummy foods and I love the Picasso Roll! However it's beginning to get a little ridiculous, I work in the customer service industry and how we were treated wasn't how I treat my customers. I made a reservation for 7:15 on a Friday I get it it's the busiest night people are coming in like crazy. I show up and get told 'it'll be a couple more minutes' to me that means okay 2 minutes sure, I see other people waiting looking extremely annoyed. So I wait I've learned to time my wait time, I look down at my phone it's now 7:26p so I ask the hostess again how much longer, she doesn't even turn to look at me and say another couple minutes and walks off. At this point I'm a little annoyed because now she's annoyed that I've asked again. I just think when the hostess up front isn't the friendliest and can't handle those situations better maybe not the best face for such a popular restaurant. We finally get our table about another 9 minutes later... I ordered an appetizer my waitress was very kind, however I got my dinner and was begging to eat and she came to check in and said 'of that roll never came out, I'll go check' a few minutes later another waitress brings it over at this point I've already started on my entree. Didn't hear an apology or nothing just here you go. If I wanted it as a dessert I would have asked. I don't mean to bash on them just seems like they maybe need people that like doing what they do one & work a little on the overall customer experience.
Went here on a business trip and the sushi did not disappoint! Our waitress was very friendly and gave us great recommendations.

This is the perfect location for traveling individuals. It has delicious great quality food. I got the veggie hash and it came with French toast (pancakes or biscuit if you prefer). Price was reasonable for the amount you get. If you eat a lot get the chicken steak for breakfast.

Let's keep it simple. Great place for a great meal and excellent service. Remodel looks fresh and inviting. So many terrific breakfast places in town, this is a definite must! You won't be disappointed.

The corned beef hash is epic!!! Corned beef is sliced thinly and browned on a flat grill, so there are lots of carmelized crunchy bits. It is served over potatoes and topped with fried eggs. Swoon. It comes with a perfect mammoth pancake. The dish is well priced and feeds two.

My friends and family sing the praises of the rest of the menu, but I will eat only the corned beef hash forever. It is that good. The service is wonderful! The wait is never terrible - a rarity at a great breakfast joint. In all of Boise, this is my favorite breakfast.

My wife and I were excited to try Kona's sushi because we had heard such good things about it.  How awesome it would be to have an excellent sushi restaurant in Meridian.  The atmosphere is very cool though a bit noisy.  We ordered the Picasso roll and the Houston roll and unfortunately we weren't that impressed.  I mean, the presentation was nice and they have the nicer chop sticks, (the round ones) but the sushi didn't really have any flair or excitement, it was just kind of plain.  

Our waitress was nice and did a good job, we ordered a slice of their velvet cake and I must say, it was wonderful.  We will go back if nothing else for the cake.  We do want to try their coconut shrimp roll to see how it is.

For now, it was ok, I will go again and hopefully it will be better but I know if I want really good sushi I need to drive to Kyoto in Boise for the spicy Johnny roll.  :)
I'm so so happy this place opened! My family just loves it! Amazing burek and Cevapi! Awesome customer service and really cute atmosphere:) I'll make sure to bring my friends back!

My 17 year search for great Mexican in the Boise area is OVER! I'm stoked!

Friendliest of staffs, fabulous food, and great prices. Get TWO of the Enchilada Suiza; one for the next day...it was great! 

Peeps mentioning the decor/tables....it was CLEAN!!! Have you been to other Mexican restaurants? CLEAN PEOPLE!!! And you're only sitting there for maybe 45 minutes if you drink your Modelo really slow and order two baskets of the delicous chips. You're not taking the furniture home with ya...

Thrilled....can't wait to get my next fix.

A little hard to find, but the sandwiches are totally worth it.
The bread was nice and fresh and tasted like true sourdough. I had the corned beef & turkey sandwich. It was huge but too good to leave for leftovers. I can't wait for fall/winter to try their soup in a bread bowl!
Very nice staff and quick service. The only downside is they are not open on the weekends. Makes perfect sense for their location though.
Food took forever to come but management did take care of our meal. will give them another shot.

Loved Twigs!! I first thought it was going to be too pricey, but it wasn't too bad! It wouldn't have mattered because the food was my fav! Me and my husband shared their stuffed banana peppers for an appetizer. Then for our entree we had their steak salad with roasted cashews, feta cheese, red onions, roasted tomatoes and balsamic dressing. Oh it was delicious! Then we had their donuts with three different dips chocolate, Carmel and my favorite amaretto! And our waitress was genuine and nice. It's officially become my new favorite restaurant!

I had been looking for someone to make a sign for my sons' home gym to no avail. I found YMC through a recommendation and I couldn't be more thrilled with my fabulous experience with them! I met with Joe and his partner, can't remember his name but I'll make sure to get it. These guys are creative, engaging, smart, and excited to be involved in the creative process. They came up with ideas to make this sign even better than I was thinking! There is some creative genius going on there! The lovely lady at the front desk couldn't be sweeter! This is a Chritmas present for my son, and although it's a very small job for them, they made it seem like it was their priority! I pick up my sign tomorrow and know it will be creative and perfect!! Thanks guys!!
The customer service was great! The food was ok, my sushi rolls fell apart and happy hour prices felt more like regular prices. Nice atmosphere with friendly staff.

Troy from ABC pumping came and took great care of us.  It was complicated because we bought an abandoned house and had no idea how to find the tank.  Thank you Troy and ABC for taking good care of us.
Food here is really good. Servers are friendly. Drinks are yumm. I enjoyed appetizers and main course menu both every time I was here. I'd recommend.

Went there for a work meeting and we had an excellent meal and excellent customer service. 
Members on my team got the Lobster mac, the Kona burger, and I got the Kona Club.  We also got the fondue appetizer. 

Customer Service was EXCELLENT.  Every time our drinks got low we had a new one already on the table.  Our server was very attentive to needs and did a fantastic job making sure drinks were full and food was hot.  Really great job there. 

Good was very tasty and very good and also very reasonably priced. 
The fondue came out with apples and pretzel bites.  WE quickly ran out of pretzel bites and still had a little bit of cheese left.  We asked for a few more and she brought those out free of charge since we wanted to use up the cheese fondue.   Appetizer was very yummy!  Everyone was very satisfied with our meals.   It was our first time there and definitely a place we will go back to.  

Also, I used the open table reservation app available through yelp to make our reservation. That was easy to use and they had our reservation ready and set up for us when we arrived.  

Overall, very excellent dining experience and great food and fantastic customer service.

Went to Twigs at Village in Meridian with friends last night and had a great dining experience.  The waitress was tops and the food very good.  We had, of all things, the lb of Fries, for an appetizer and all 5 of us agreed that they were actually the best fries we'd ever experienced and I've ate a lot of fries over the years.  Cooked to perfection, seasoned just right and the ranch that we got (along with ketchup) to dip them in was just right too.  
Then, for entrees, we had Penne dish with Chicken, which is large enough for two.  We split it and it was very filling and I'm a big eater.  One of our party had the Shrimp Salad and loved it also.  
Second, the waitress was courteous, knowledgable about the entire menu and very honest.  If she didn't like a dish she told you.  Also, her response about her favorite dishes was not the standard "oh, I like the such and such", which also happens to be the most expensive dish on the menu, hoping to pad her tip trying to jack up your check.  This attitude is rare, but brings out the ease of tipping large in this penny pinching diner! i.e. 30%+.  
My earlier experiences with this establishment, soon after opening, were not nearly this good, so I have to say they have really come up and I have to give them a 5 star.

My wife and I have been here twice, so I can give them a honest review. What I'm not partial to was there corned beef hash, homemade and fresh. Guess I was raised on canned hash for two many years. LOL.. Really great place to eat, with good service. Not only was our food good but as I walked by everyone else table Thiers looked good to. You won't be disappointed.
Ken is great to work with. I brought in my sl550 from out of town to have some work done and he did the job quickly and for a fair price.

Truly awful food. The ambiance is nice, the service is good, but it's a huge disappointment. With such a prime space, one would expect good things. I've been twice now. I've tried the fish, salad, pizza, and ahi tuna "sashimi" (it was not). The food doesn't even taste mediocre, it tastes bad. Do yourself a favour a mind grab a pizza from Grimaldi's next door.

First time at The Hungry Horse. Absolutely amazing!! My brother and I had one of their sandwiches and the soup. Not only was the food great but the service was excellent. Tony the chef came out to check on us several times. We will definitely be going back to eat The Hungry Horse.
Great drinks. Management friendly. Staff was a little distant and the service was slow. Food dry and disappointing for the price. Good atmosphere.
Unique in it's own way.  Terrific food and friendly service.  The only problem is that it is so crowded.  Go early and go often.

Was here with my mother during happy hour. We really enjoyed sitting outside in the patio and near the water fountains. Made us feel like we were in a vacation. We ordered two expensive dishes here but they weren't good:( but the tea was good:)

Not all who wander are lost. Due to my impeccable lack of direction, I found myself at the end of Ten Mile road and Chinden Blvd.  Looking for a place to turn around, I drove directly into Wagner Farms and what turned out to be one of my better adventures. What a lucky find.
We've been coming here all summer. They have the best corn, tomatoes, peaches, pears, and peppers. I also buy their honey which is collected from "Treasure Valley bees."
The people are really nice and funny.  Last time I was there, they threw in a few orange tomatoes for us to try.
Big hugs all around for farmers and the dedicated work that they do just to bring fresh food to our tables.

On a much coveted "date night" we were wandering around the Village trying to decide on a restaurant and decided to try Kona Grill. SO glad that we did! The food was fabulous. My husband and I both ordered the Macadamia Nut Crusted Chicken... it was AMAZING! We both loved it and barely spoke once it arrived. The drinks were good... he ordered a pumpkin porter and I had a sparkling sake sangria. Mine didn't blow me away... I am a lover of Sangria... but it was good. The service was pretty slow... Our server was polite, but not overly helpful, and definitely took way too long to get our drinks out or take our order. Like 20 minutes after we ordered our drinks, they arrived and then a while later she came back to take our order. She also asked if we wanted another drink and it didn't come until after our entrees arrived, which I don't care for. I should have just cancelled it.   Now I'm thinking it was the manager who came by to check on us at one point... She was fantastic. Personable and welcoming. She noticed that there was sauce waiting to go out in the kitchen and saw that we both had the macadamia nut chicken and assumed we had asked for more of the fabulous sauce, which we had. She just brought it right out... which I appreciated because I doubt the server would have brought it before the end of the meal. All in all an excellent choice... we'll be back... with the kids! :)

All in all Kona has been a good experience for our family of four. Sushi has always been good. Love the atmosphere and ambiance is very chill. Perfect for date night, first time date, family or a large group gathering. Happy hour prices make this place an affordable joint for anyone. The only down fall is waiting for seating to open up in the bar patio area. It's first come first serve so earlier may be the way to go.
One of the best GF breads I have had in the valley. Customer service is amazing. Go and try this local company.

Your definitely getting your money's worth at this location. Great room, clean and comfortable... Bathrooms are immaculate. Plenty of parking and a friendly staff, this is one of the few locations which has a small personal item store located at the front desk just in case you need something in the middle of the night. 

I definitely recommend this place!

Best deli around! This is my absolute favorite European store. They have a great selection of meats available and the staff is very friendly, willing to help you out and give free samples from the deli. They have delicious fresh bread that Is baked everyday at the store.you can get a variety of European drinks like kvass and there's a great selection of canned food, which include things like caviar, pickled tomatoes etc. one of my personal favorites are their fish, you can get them fresh or dried, both delicious! Overall the store had a great selection of food and the staff is very nice and professional.

Our first visit to Twigs was with some friends visiting from out of town and we'll be going back for sure!! We all had different entrees and we all loved them.  The martini menu is fun to look through and the 2 we had hit the spot!  Fun atmosphere, very friendly staff and the food was great!

Waiting for pizza and hot dog for 45 minutes. Don't hear any "sorry for waiting" or any warning before placing the order to let us know that gonna be this long wait. Nobody here just a few people drinking. $26 for deep dish "mancave"and it's not good. Cannoli is good.

When we walked in, there was no hostess and had to wait for a while to be seated. Then once seated, or waiter was extremely slow with every step - getting our order, drinks, and even longer to get our check. The food was also sub par but the thing that makes this a 2 Star rather than a 3 Star is the service. It was EXTREMELY slow in every way.
Great food, great atmosphere and great service.  We like the different salsas on the salsa bar, and bean dip is best in the area.

Iwas really disappointed after my visit. I was looking forward to happy hour with my girlfriend and it ended up almost upset. In such high traffic and contemporary place I was expecting more attentive servers. It took them forever to get to our table. 
Lemon Drop martini was waist of money.

7 tap handles...exptected more for this area.   Only 3 big tv's for football watching all next to each other.  W ould  not reccomend for football watching.

Chips were stale.   Queso had WAY to MUCH garlic.  Greek salad was disappointing for $8.  The Beef Dip was good other than being cold from sitting around.   The bread was completely soaked by the time it arrived.   Fries were cold as well. 

There were only three other people in the bar for lunch... so not sure why the delay. 
The beers arrived quick every time.   Bartender was great.
What a great place! We stopped in for the first time last week and were pleasantly surprised. Food was served up quickly, was hot and tasty, and reasonably priced. Keep up the good work!

I have been seeing Katie at Mane Street Salon for about six months now. She's so talented and I have yet to have a bad experience. If you're looking for a new hairdresser, go see her. Or anybody in that salon. They're fantastic.

Don't go.

Go south to Mi Casa, if you want to sit down, have table service, order off a menu. Go south to Los Betos if you are drunk, hung over, or want something cheap, fast , and good. But do not eat here.

Went for lunch with co-workers. Had a burrito, which was topped with ranch dressing. Do I need to say anything more? $10 got me a burrito like Betos has for ~$4, and it was topped with a little sauce and ranch freaking dressing.

Most of my co-workers had chimichangas, which looked OK, if that's your scene. They were covered ("enrobed") with a square slice of white cheese. Another colleague had a tostada, which also, inexplicably, came with ranch dressing.

Chips and salsa were ok; salsa had a canned flavor, and was redolent of bottled garlic powder. I can't speak to the margaritas, but they seemed popular.

Avoid this place.

We drove from Twin Falls to get here.  For some reason they do not cross train. We get here "our fry line person didn't show Up" WTF if someone don't show up manager should step in and do it.  Not fuck it it's down we will 86 half the menu. Wish I could tell you what the food tasted like. Other than $50 in gas
Wonderful wonderful wonderful! Highly recommend this place, sit outside watch the fountains! Food is amazing!

After walking in with a toddler, and asking for a high chair. We never saw it. Never got served any water. After 10 minutes of being ignored we left. 
NOT the first time service was that bad. 
Garlic fries was the only thing bringing us in. However, we are done for good. 
Tried Eagle location, something worse happened there.

Great noodle soup...broth is fantastic and flavorful. Also had the waffle sandwich and that was yummy, too. Good spot for lunch during the work week. 
They also have boba tea with a lot of flavors.
Good breakfast food with huge portions. Only downside is the space is pretty small and gets crowded quickly.
Passable, solid purveyor of delicious orange chicken and other items you wish were orange chicken.  And exceptionally bland fried rice.

Love it here such a great place to go if you want to eat or have a good time with family and friends lots to see and do. A small park for the kids, movie theater, and large park nearby, and great restaurants! Sometimes prices are a little steep for most of the stores but everything is very appealing.
Unique menu! The cocktails are awesome! The atmosphere is very hip, and the the service has been good every time I go.

The ribs & brisket are a must - ribs have a smoke taste to them and the brisket is just delicious. Great customer service. We got in right when the lunch doors open and we were not disappointed at all - food served HOT...so delicious.

Stopped by to check them out.  Was wonderfully surprised,  the aloe shot,  cinnamon teas,  and The Berry Splash (?) was WONDERFUL!

The staff takes the time to tell you about their products and its nice to have a lot of options. 

I will be back lots,  and when my wife gets back in town,  WE will be in.

Stopped by today, 2/9/2017 and saw Brittany. Mentioned I was on lunch from Boise. She made my Fruity Pebbles (yes a drink that tastes like the cereal), quickly, I paid and I think I spent 5 minutes there. I felt so much better after drinking the aloe, tea and drink! LOVE THIS PLACE

Great menu, great food, really friendly staff and owners.  The goulash, the pies, the hummus, the tea, coffee, and desserts...everything is delicious.  This is one of my favorite restaurants in the valley, hands down.

We were a group of seven, and we've dined here several times now. It was their Progress St location. It was for dinner only, so I can't comment about things like breakfast or the coffee.

We really enjoyed the food. The menu is pretty extensive, so no one had difficulty in deciding what to order. The two strawberry milkshakes we ordered were great, and the extra was almost enough to make for a third. Our server, Samantha, took good care of us. It took a little on the long side for our food to arrive, but Samantha was good enough to explain that there was only one cook that evening. It only bothers me when the food takes a long time to come, and there's no explanation or apology.

I have to comment about Joseph. If he comes to your table, be prepared to be entertained. He's a really funny guy with a great sense of humor and he kept us all laughing. I had no idea what his mission was there, because Samantha was our waitress...so is he the manager? Waiter? The real Shari in disguise? It was lots of fun, which you rarely see in a restaurant.

We'll be back on our next trip to Idaho!
Love this quirky little spot! They have the heat up so it feels like it's actually a tropical spot while you drink your yummy smoothie. Good coffee too!

Do not, I repeat do not, stay in this motel!!!!!
They will give your room away, right under your nose. 
We had booked it for two nights, having to be in Boise for a funeral.   Just leaving the funeral dinner we get a call that they are cleaning out our room because it is reserved for tonight. 
Whaaaat?
Yeah, by us. 
So, we get there and the maids are nearly done cleaning it and our things are thrown helter skelter. 
Wouldn't want to be in Dan's way----he was fuming. 
So, thank you LaQuinta, for making a hard time harder!!!

Stopped in to kill a couple of hours. I had Google mapped looking for a place to belly up to the bar for a cold one while I waited. I love BBQ and BBQ places, and had never been to Big Daddy's. When I walked in I knew this was a real BBQ place by the heavenly aroma. I had visited their website and pursued the menu. I had plans to have dinner later so I just wanted to try the Tater Pigs. (House made tater tots with bacon and white cheddar) They were delicious! Beer was cold and Kiki my server was a doll. I'm already planning my next visit, maybe a Friday night for the smoked prime rib.

OK, so guys aren't supposed to be finicky and paranoid about who does their hair, right? Wrong! I have only had a few people ever touch my hair, and to get to that level they have to be very good. Cindy has been my hair stylist for over 10 years. What impresses me the most is her commitment to her art; she continually invests in herself by attending cutting edge workshops and seminars to stay ahead of the pack when it comes to new styles, products, and techniques. Yes, she's funny, colorful, and always happy. But more important, she always makes each visit special. Thank you, Cindy!
Great atmosphere! Wonderful staff and delicious food. One of our favorites even though it's a chain. Great sushi and great happy hour!

I enjoy the food from here and find myself craving a Big Daddy every once in a while.  It's good enough and unique enough to keep me coming back.  I am border line 3 & 4 stars but am going with 4 because want people to try it.  I want it to stick around for a while and get a chance to mature.  Seems like only the BBQ chains stick around and I dislike the chains.  

Only complaint is this: I wish they did a half size version of the BigDaddy that was less expensive and easier to eat without slobbering half of it down my shirt.

Have not tried the ribs yet but every place around here seems to fall down on the ribs so I am afraid to try.

This was one of the worst places I have ever eaten.  I order the lobster Mac and cheese. It can out in what looked like a kids sized dish. I was noodles with some cheese grated over it and about 5 pieces of lobster. For $16 I would have expected a lot more. My sister ordered the seered tuna and it was hardly cooked at all. They had the music so loud you couldn't here across the table. It was awful.
Food was good, cloth napkin smelled terrible like they had been left in the washer too long.

This place has great atmosphere! The everything from the music to the decor and fish, this place nice.
We went here for my birthday and had a great time. The wait staff was really nice and attentive. The service was fast. I was amazed how quick the food came out to us.
The food was great, we had the calamari, spicy tuna roll, spicy salmon roll, and the checkerboard roll. They were all yummy and reasonably priced.
I would totally come back here and try something new.

Joe Momma's is one of our favorite places for breakfast. The menu is creative and yet traditional including choices for both small and big appetites. Their house potatoes are "killer" and their pancakes are huge! Their family owned and operated operation includes several family members so there's familiarity for "regulars". And, they have the best decaf ever! Highly recommended with one exception. Prepare to wait on weekends.

This is the worst sandwich shop I've ever been to. I got a chicken Philly cheesesteak with three bell peppers, very little meat, it was cold and half the size of the bag it came in. My girlfriend's sandwich was just as bad. We both felt sick afterward. We are moving to Idaho and will tell everyone never to eat there. Have to say, however, the staff were very friendly and the establishment was very clean.

Slow service, which is weird when all you're getting is a soda and a cookie. The cookies used to be good when we first went there, now, very unimpressive, you can tell they were at some point frozen. Very disappointed.

I've been here 5 times now. I've tried something new 4 of the times. The pizza is good and the restaurant's casual atmosphere is nice. 

That said, I won't be going back for a 6th time. This place has HORRIBLE service, thus my poor rating. Aside from the fact they're super slow, the staff's attitude is awful. Last time I went I waited five minutes before even being greeted. Then the lady gave me an extremely poor greeting - "what do you want." 

I place a lot of value on service and wouldn't recommend the wait nor the service for the marginal food menu.

I found this by mistake but what a pleasant mistake it was.  The service was beyond friendly and the food fresh and flavorful.  The bread was freshly baked and the presentation appealing to the palate.  The menu is limited but you can only eat so much and the portions are generous.  I've never had Bosnian food so I have nothing to judge it against but would return to try a few more items on the menu.

I was so impressed by this salon! Lauren cut and colored my hair and was fast, efficient, friendly, and cuts VERY GOOD HAIR! She was extremely helpful in my color choice and gave me exactly what I was going for. She was even able to get both my sister and I in and out in two hours! Price was outstanding as she discounted my first visit. I will definitely be back!

I took my wife and her family to Sofra and had a very nice experience.  Very good food and friendly staff.  The waiter walk us through the menu and answered questions.  Service can be a little slow so this may not be the best option if you are in a hurry.
Service and cook times are slow but the food is good.  No one yelled at us while we were their.  This place is ran like a ma and pa kind of place.

Excellent breakfast location close to meridian and eagle.  Convenient location and a parking lot! 

TIP!!!   There is usually a long wait so call ahead to get your name added to the list. 

Breakfast is phenomenal.  The breading for the chicken fried stake is legit awesome! And the flavor of the gravy is one of the best I've ever had and I'm from the south! 

Today my hubby got the chicken fried State with red potatoes, but it's as good as the biscuits and gravy so either way you can't go wrong.  Both are excellent savory breakfast choices.  

Today I wanted sweet and got the small breakfast option of two French toast triangles, one egg, two slices of bacon.  Excellent and sweet, cooked to a golden perfection.  

Today they also had the cheesy hash brown casserole so we tried that too.   It was ahhhh-mazing!!!

It is an excellent breakfast stop.  Highly recommend!

I wanted to have money transfered from on bank to another bank in Denver and it was a nightmare. Avoid this credit union at all causes. They want your money but the only time you need the service they drip the ball. I spent 4 hours trying to have this done and they lied to me 3 times saying it was done. It got returned and they tried to blame it on me anyways I did exactly what they told me to do.They told me to look on my check and get the routing number and account number and put it on the request sheet.  Then they told me that it takes a special wire routing number from Bank of America so I gave it to them. Then they try and charge me a $45.00 return wire fee anyways I did exactly what they told me to do. It's total fraud and unethical. They basically are trying to commit a white cols crime.

I love being able to go through a car wash as many times as I want to for $20/month. The wash works well on our wagon but our SUV tends to have to go through a couple of times due to the way it is shaped, not the fault of the car wash. The helpful staff always sprays the front and back really well before pulling in. I do like getting the little wipes for the interior while driving through. This place beats the heck out of standing in your driveway with a bucket of suds!! Plus their heavy duty vacuum cleaners (free with wash) are awesome. I am a fan!

We have fallen in love with this place! The bread is perfection and they taste really authentic. We get the steak classic and it's perfect. I would say to eat it fairly soon after you buy it. It dries out a bit if you wait too long to eat it.

This was a very enjoyable place to have a leisurely weekend lunch! It was fun to watch the fountain outside do its special display (apparently, it happens every hour, on the hour), but best of all, the food was really good! I especially recommend the flatbread that came topped with a mouthwatering combination of brie, grilled apples, onions, and figs. The tenderloin were also very good. The waitstaff seemed professional and pleasant. Unfortunately, the noise level made it difficult to enjoy a conversation, and the decor seemed very random and impersonal. In spite of that, we'll be back!

To start out, the Village is such a beautiful addition to Meridian.  The night started off a little on the wrong foot as we had reservations at 8:15pm and we specifically asked for a table and they said they would make a note of our request.  After waiting about 10 minutes after our reservation time, the hostess brought us to a booth.  If you have ever been to Kona, the restaurant consists mostly of tables.  After letting the hostess know, we sat for another 10 minutes before we were brought to a table.  It was a real nice corner table near the aquarium.  We were instantly greeted by our waitress, Breanna, a very sweet and kindred spirit.  She was excellent at having the perfect balance of being on top of her job and yet not being too over bearing.  She was a breath of fresh air when it came to service.  My wife and I split the Pad Thai noodles with Chicken and Shrimp and had the Potstickers for appetizer.  I wanted to try their sushi but many reviews said the sushi was just ok or flavorless so I stayed away from sushi.  Overall had a really nice experience, great service by Breanna and food was good.  4 stars only as I think the food is overpriced for what you get but back to my first comment, the Village is a beautiful place to hang out and I am sure they have a huge monthly rent.  I would definitely go back.

I read in some of the reviews that Rebecca was a great waitress.  When I told Breanna about her, Breanna added a touch of class and asked Rebecca to come say hi.  I thought that was going a step above and beyond so hopefully Breanna received the extra tip I left on the table as I left.  I will be going back to try different things on the menu.

Went to Bono's today craving their delicious beef sausage combo that only they know how to make it. Twenty minutes after ordering our food, I decided to check on our orders status. It took two times asking for our order until we were told with no apology that they were out of beef and sausage.  I am talking noon folks. I can see that Bono's is on their last leg which is unfortunate. We told so many people about their once great food and service but that has truly passed.

Sadly, it's time to update my review... And not for the better. Our past two visits have been slightly below average. Service is not consistent ... This last time was great service, the time before that was awful. We ordered our favorite macadamia nut crusted chicken.... Just ok. The chicken had an odd texture and I bit into something unidentifiable, but not good, in the chicken. Ugh! On our most recent visit I  ordered the sweet chili glazed salmon... The salmon was edible but over cooked and swimming in a overly salted sauce. Definitely not glazed. The sauce covered the entire plate and soaked the rice served with it. The green beans were not cooked long enough... They were difficult to chew or cut. It just was not something I would ever expect to be served, especially for the price charged. I think Kona had a lot going for it, but with the quality of food dropping so much, I doubt we will be back.

Village is run of the mill outdoor mall(in a community with 4 seasons which is dumb). Smack dab on the busiest traffic corner in the entire state of Idaho. Full of middle of the road brand stores and below par chain restaurants.

The service and atmosphere is great! The house potatoes are delicious, I got the regular eggs Benedict and did not find anything too special about them. Pretty bland, and the ham is very thinly sliced. My husband got the chicken fried steak and said it was to die for. Overall, good experience but I will definitely try a different food next time.

Big Daddy's BBQ  would be great if I was going over to a friends place and they made food like this.   i would not say a word. I would think there was nothing here that i could not do better on myself however.  it;s not worth it, its sad... I think they stay in Business because some people do not know what good food is.  bottom line.  WAY OVERPRICED mediocre food.    
     No one should be able to go into a place like this with a partner and spend over 50.00 eating.    any two people can easily do this here.   ya get what I am saying?

I have to admit that I work nearby and that's why I dared to try it. I took 2 of my employees to Twigs for dinner and was impressed with what I found! The atmosphere is modern and fancy, fitting in perfectly with the rest of the theme at The Village. They had great specials and an extensive menu. What was most appreciated was that our server (Jeff) was knowledgeable about the menu options and was able to provide clarity when asked. We grilled him on his favorites and the most popular. Ironically we each picked a favorite of his from 3 different categories and am so happy we did. Their menu offers a great variation in palate pleasures as well as price ranges. Their pizzas are great, with a variety of flavors that you wouldn't have thought to combine off hand; the sandwiches were well put together and more than enough to fill you up. 

I will be honest that I didn't try any of their famous martinis but was impressed with the enormous selection that they offered. 

I would highly recommend checking it out and giving it a try !

Can't wait to go again when the patio is open!
Always great service and friendly staff. They really know how to get a crowded drive through moving along. Coffee as good as any other specialty coffee place.

Nice little hole in the wall with a very attentive server. We had an idea what we wanted and it came out in a reasonable amount of time. The food was good as the service and we will be coming back again when in that part of the valley. The cabbage rolls were good but I think next time we will be trying the full assortment platter. Just to get a good idea.

Everything tasted like fish.  Pork, tasted like fish.  Chicken Blue Corn Tacos - tasted like fish.  The blaring trumpets and mariachi music didn't help the experience either. Felt like I was in a Mexican Chuck E. Cheese. Sorry to say I won't be back.

Owner is an ass. Was lucky enough to walk in as he was berating someone about his order-so I'm guessing it was his food purveyor. If that's how he treats people who are supposed to be partners I can only imagine how he treats customers. Pass. Heard just enough to know I didn't want to give this guy any of my hard earned money. Turned around and left. Thanks for helping me dodge a bullet, guy!

I have always enjoyed Kona Grill. 
Today, I had the broccoli, chicken strictly fry. 
Chelsea,  my favorite,  Recommended the dish.
Chelsea is new here. Came over from a competitor  
Kona scored!
I will be back and back.
Place is great. Had to come here again. Omelettes are wonderful. Today I went for the Country Bennie, biscuit, sausage, scrambled eggs smothered with gravy. It was great.

Went again a few nights ago. The food is average at best. Worse than the first time I went. They still can't get an order right and the staff just make excuses. Need I say more?! Don't bother with the food. Cocktails are good. Better choices in the valley than this place.
Went here unplanned and was pleasantly surprised. They have a great happy hour. Great service and nice atmosphere.

Well first off based on these reviews I was excited to try out this restaurant but after experiencing it myself I have to say this is not good barbecue. The ribs were not good, they were chewy and tough, and to top it off everything was cold. All in all never going again, false advertisement here based on Yelp reviews. Disappointing.
One of my all time favorite sandwich places! I always order to go. They are super fast and friendly. They even remembered my name! The food always tastes fresh and they have good soups!

FANTASTIC frozen yogurts in a small, yet highly varied set of flavors!  Much better taste than Aspen Leaf and cleaner than Uswirl!  Great topping selection, as well!  There were non fats and low fats...even a Greek Yogurt option. Can't wait to go back!
Delicious! Got the meat pie and a cheese one. Certainly very unique and tasty! Nice and clean environment, I will definitely come back.
Love this place. It's right next to my office, the sandwiches are great and they know me by name.
Best pumpkin pancakes and apple cider syrup I have ever had!  Everything else was delicious too but I'll be back for the pancakes.

On a sunday night,  just before happy hour is over. We are sitting in the bar.  One bartender / waiter, working his butt off,  no help and we're aren't getting refills on anything.  Feel sorry for him.  Should be 2 here.  Disappointed

Awfulllllllll!!!! Worst experience ever! 
Went there for my moms b day and called to make A Reservation so we have enough room and we get there in time and they gave it to someone else!!!!!!! So we had to wait FOREVER!!! Got a tiny little booth that was hard to have kids at! They toook a looonnng to even ask what kind of drinks we wanted. Finally got our food nastiest street tacos ever!!!! Like no meat on it and that's all I asked for! Didn't taste good at all! Everyone else at the table also said there food wasn't good! We were there for about 3 hours awful service. Awful awful awful 
Rather go to chick fil a anyday compared to this place.
Best grocery store sushi anywhere! The new company that came in here about 3 days ago is doing a spectacular job. Everything is made fresh everyday and the prices are cheap.
They have a music area, smaller kids play place, bigger kids play structure, splash pad, tennis courts, huge open grass, and so much more! Best park I have ever been to!

I had really high hopes for the food at Kona Grill, unfortunately it was below average.  Specifically my wife and I were in the mood for sushi and we only ordered from the sushi potion of the menu.  The pot stickers were fairly undercooked and very greasy unfortunately.  The nigiri we ordered, the fish came out and it was clearly not super fresh, beginning to dry and discolor around the edges.  Finally, the sushi rice was like glue, it was loaded with mirin and sugar, you could not distinguish the grand of rice from one another, it was inedible.  Our server and Lazaro were very gracious and took some item off our check.  The location and the atmosphere are hard to beat, hopefully when we come back we have a better experience.

So my first experience here was a bust but since then we have tried it two other times! I have to give my first major kudos to the management. After our first experience and my first review the manager reached out and apologized for our experience and invited us back. We tried it again about six months later and had a much better experience. Our waitress was extremely friendly, helpful and attentive. They all seem very knowledgable about the menu which for someone with food allergies I greatly appreciate that. We came in late for happy hour, the happy hour menu is very good. We tried a few of the sushi rolls, and while they were good they were about average in terms of quality. Taste wise they are average and I would say they are definitely stronger sushi restaurants in the area. That being said boil the Voodoo Roll was my favorite, but the Bama Roll was pretty good as well. We tried the Philadelphia Roll however I thought the smoked salmon was dried out and the smoke was extremely overpowering. The star of Kona Grill is their dessert menu, I had the Butter Cake which was excellent, the cake was perfectly moist and is crusted in sugar which gives this great crunch, the raspberry sauce is an excellent pairing with the cake and ice cream. My husband had the Key Lim Pie and said it was superb. Their desserts are huge so I recommend sharing them, we made a second trip in here this last week just for dessert and drinks and were met again with great service, friendly staff and good food!

We really enjoy this location!  Have never had an issue here.  Sandwiches have always been accurate and the staff has always been friendly.  Whenever we're in need of a great and quick sub, this is the first place we say out loud.  Definitely check this place out if you get the chance.

Christian Brothers Automotive is truly a great family owned and run business in the Treasure Valley! They are honest and fair which in the auto repair business is very difficult to find. If you need you oil changed or car fixed in the Treasure Valley this is the place to go. Brett Clancy is the owner and personal friend of mine. To give you and idea of what type of person Brett is, every year they they do free oil changes for single moms in the Treasure Valley and this year they even gave a single mom who was greatly in need a free vehicle!

Love this place...!  Place is nice and casual, clean, super fast service and the staff is very nice and courteous.  I had the pulled pork sandwich...it was loaded w meat...I had a choice of 3 different sauces.  Portions are huge...I had enough left over for another meal. 
I would highly recommend this place if you enjoy BBQ.

A friend of mine (male) got a haircut here, and we were impressed.  His stylist, Erica, listened to what he requested, which was HUGE for my pal -- he left his previous salon stylist because she didn't listen.  Erica was pleasant and accommodating throughout, and did great job (and what a great price!  My pal did come on a coupon, but still...).  

I decided to give Erica a try -- first of all, my friend had only good things to say. Second, Erica has a personal style I like (I'm not quite as adventurous, but it's great on her!).  She was awesome! Again, she listened to what I wanted and delivered (hard to find that!). She also told me some things about my hair that no one else had, including my previous triple-the-price  *salon/spa* stylist.  Erica showed me some product I could use but didn't push or pressure.  She also gave me a styling tip that no one else had either.  I have difficult hair (thin, fine) and was just hoping for a trim...but ended up with much more.

I don't know about the others (but everyone seems very friendly and service-oriented in there), but Erica is the tops.

I had a mean sushi craving and my friends wanted to eat in the new Village, so we stopped in Kona Grill. In every way, I was wowed. The sushi menu was large, great variety, and I especially loved the the rolls were laid out in order of spiciness. We got 6 rolls and absolutely loved them all. We also tried the calamari, which was great.  There were plenty of other options on the menu, and I think anyone could have found something they loved regardless of their palate. 
So I was happy the food and drinks were great, and I should also mention that our server was attentive, knowledgable, and friendly, but my favorite part was the ambiance. It was like ocean meets mountain, and somehow also trendy and modern. It was absolutely gorgeous. We had a couple of kids in our party and they were really excited about all of the water features. 
To sum up, if you're pining for a night out of great food and a unique experience, Kona Grill won't disappoint.

I saw the excellent Yelp reviews and this place is just down the street from my house.  So I gave it a spin.  Everything good everybody else says is spot on so there's no point in repeating that.

What did happen when I went there is they brought us out little brownies for dessert. Hooray! We didn't order little brownies but they were tasty and soft and yummy.  Want to make friends? Give them little brownies!

My brother was with me. He sucked down his Boba Smoothie so fast he got a brain freeze.  Best be careful, good food comes with hazards.

Strongly recommended.  Located in the little strip out in front of the Majestic cinemas.  Not super cheap but quite reasonable given the value you receive in return.  Will definitely be back again.
Reasonably priced, always there, quick appt scheduling, and good vets.  Love these guys, especially the front staff

BREAKFAST REVIEW ONLY:  Joe Mommas has earned a rare five star because I ate here based on an enthusiastic recommendation and have been back twice.  Excellent all times.  

I ordered the California Benedict (Benny with tomato and avocado) and asked them to add ham to it-Awesome!

I had the chicken fried steak another time with a full breakfast-awesome!  They use an actual cut of steak for their chicken fried steak, so the quality is outstanding.  Can't wait to go back.
Enjoyed a combination of chocolate and chocolate sea salt caramel yogurt with a good variety of candy toppings.  The topping selection was good.

Everything is made from scratch for your order!  Having quite a few food limitations it can be really hard to go out to eat especially breakfast.  It is amazing to find a restaurant that is so accommodating.  I was able to create my own meal, they let me choose from the items that the had available that day in the kitchen that I could have and they were so kind and happy to make something custom for me AND it didn't even take that long for them to whip it up.  I was so please with the service and the food tasted great.  

The portions were big as well.  Neither my husband nor myself were able to finish our food.  Our server was very friendly and after bring us our food check with us to make sure everything was made to my specifications.

Great place!  It's a must try in my book!

It was disappointing when I ate here. I LOVE Bruchi's and have frequented the Bruchi's in Kennewick Washington I must have eaten there fifty times they deserve a ten star review.  Unfortunately this new one in Meridian does not match up in the quality of food.  The bread, the meat, the fries.. fries were not hot and compared to Kennewick were not crispy enough.  The bread was cold and soft and in Kennewick it has a much better texture.  In Kennewick,  you unwrap the cheesesteak sandwich and steam comes out and the smell wonderfies you.  Not here.  Please do something to step up your Bruchi's game so I can enjoy my favorite restaurant finally coming to town and change this to a five star review


UPDATE!



Tried this location again, and it seems they've responded to my comments.. or the new has worn off and they've figured things out..  I will be frequenting this place now.
Breakfast was the best I have had out.  Service was good restaurant was clean.  I had the steak and eggs.  Excellent.  Even something as simple as orange juice was awesome.

Can't say enough good about Meridian Automotive.  Yesterday I had a problem with my Lexus.  I just happened to be driving by their shop at the time so I stopped in.  They dropped everything to assist me and discovered the problem within minutes. Campbell and Jeff were amazing!  They also took care of a minor issue on my wife's car when she came to pick me up.  Although it's never a good time when the car breaks down, they turned what could have been a very frustrating day into a great customer experience. They have earned my business with their superior service.  I will be taking our vehicles to Meridian Automotive for future servicing.  Thank you!
We love Winco!  We make a trip there about once a week.  Love the prices, they beat everyone in the treasure valley and when you have a family to feed this is a great plus.

So happy! GF options and menu, very careful about my daughter's dairy aversion and the kids got to play while we ate since it is next to the playground. The food was really amazing, and the GF peanut butter pie was decadent. I will be coming back here! Changing table BOTH men and women's bathrooms, plus a family bathroom. Very modern decor with sliding window doors to the patio. Really fun and delicious.

My husband and I ate here for an early dinner. He had beef rolled in flakey dough and I had chicken kabobs. Both dinners were very good. Loved the rice. My only change would be with salad. I would serve garden greens and not iceberg. Service was great. We will go again.
They have craft sodas which make being the DD here not too shabby if I do say so myself! ! Great little brewery for meet ups and hang outs .

Ugh cannot get ENOUGH of this place! If I had unlimited credit I would be here once a week, lol. It is so clean, so relaxing, and every single stylist is so so friendly. Every time I book, I see Lauren. She is SO awesome and accomodating- I always make drastic changes to my hair, from color, to style, to cut, and I can always tell she is just as stoked as I am. Highly highly recommend this salon, and Lauren!

I went there this Sunday to watch the Superbowl. Everything was cool except the stupid manager who wear the Clinton Portis jersey.  He gave everyone the raffle tickets except me.  It was for a while also. Its not like he did not notice me. I just kept quiet and kept noticing him if he will realize. Nope he just running around like a kid passing out raffle tickets except me. Cause I am Asian ? ...such a discrimination. 

Other than that the waitress is really cool and the food is good.  I will still go back but hope they straighten the manager out.
Food was terrific and our server was great..only complaint is the silverware is soo cheap..step it up
Great service and happy hour is the best. Salsa bar has mango habanero, it's nice and spicy

One of my favorite places in town! I absolutely LOVE the village. Anytime I want to go out for a nice date night, go to the movies, go shopping... it has it all. 

Kona, Grimaldis, Twigs and Bodovino make the restaurant aspect great. 

Lush, Victoria Secret, and anthropology are my favorite places to shop. 

The movie theater sells BEER! I love the VIP section it makes seeing a movie way more fun and unique. 

Also love Big ALS and the option to go bowling. 

The ice skating and Christmas decorations are sooooooo cute in the winter. 

Amazing spot for patio lunches in the summer. 

I could go on and on but I think you get the point. It's the best!!

We tried this spot because it was close to our hotel and it seemed to be popular with tourists and locals alike. We had to wait 20 minutes to be seated. It was worth the wait! I had the classic breakfast with Idaho potato cubes and blueberry whipped cream french toast. Holy moly! The waitress was a little less talkative but considering we had to wait 20 minutes for a table, she was probably very busy. Altogether a great experience!

This cute store was recommended to me, and I'm so glad I went. Their bread is amazing, and they have  a lot of the desserts and cheeses I enjoyed when in Croatia. I got a loaf of bread, and it did not last long :) I'm drying to try their drunken cherry cake.
Great customer service and a great wash!  Wish it dried slightly better but most of them don't!

This place is amazing, I could eat there every week. If you're going with 3 or 4 people than get the sampler! Next time I would swap out the kebabs for something else, they are the only thing we have been disappointed in. But in my opinion, it's hard to cook Kebabs without drying out the meat. Otherwise everything we've eaten had been excellent and they make everything in house. And get dessert! The sofra cake was one of the best things I've ever eaten! Can't wait to try it all

Visited with family. Beautiful restaurant with friendly staff and very good food. Tried the Cuban dip, caprese flatbread, homemade soup and pear and beet salad. All delicious!  Wish there was a Twigs in the Seattle area

We came here for sushi and we're very disappointed in the quality. The Bama which the waitress recommended was really bland and the texture was way off. We ordered 6 rolls and 2 of them had good flavor. I would not recommend getting sushi from this place if you eat sushi frequently. The rest of the menu looked decent, but it seemed like they were selling atmosphere more than the quality of the food.

Just got back from Don Diego's with a friend and wanted to beat him to a first review. 

We walked around 8PM and were the only people in the restaurant. I think part of that is due more to the location rather than a reflection on the quality of the food (which was tasty but not spectacular). 

Within minutes of sitting down, the waitress brought us warm bean dip,  tortilla chips, and fresh salsa. She was happy to provide recommendations. I went for the carne asada plate for $12 and he got chicken in a green sauce [I forget the name]. The dish came with a fair serving of meat, rice, beans, lettuce, and warm tortillas. The vegetables were very fresh and the meat was flavorful and well seasoned. I think my carne asada was more well-done instead of medium-well, but it was still good. 

Service was prompt and friendly. We had our drinks refilled several times and the chef even came outside to make sure the food enjoyable. 

We have yet to try it, but they serve margaritas here!

Overall, I feel each plate should be about $2 cheaper.

Ich habe mich verliebt!
Ich war anfangs skeptisch da ich auch schon vom KFC enttäuscht wurde und ich dieses Lokal vorher garnicht gekannt habe.
 
Ich wurde eines besseren belehrt!
Hier gibt es sehr viel gesundes Essen, versuchen sie unbedingt die Shrimps, diese waren der absolute Wahnsinn!
Ich werde auf jedenfall noch öfters diesen Laden aufsuchen!

Das Personal war auch sehr freundlich!

The constant attempts to upsell every time I'm there by the front desk are extremely annoying. If somebody wants a foot scrub or a facial by your mediocre skin care line, they'll inquire about it. 

If I say "No thanks, I'm not interested", don't reply with "Are you sure? Because etc etc..." 

YES I'M SURE!

Victor is the best, he always shows great pride in his craft and ensures that the food being served is how he'd expect it as a patron. Great food (I get the loaded Greek salad), great prices, great Service!

Best BBQ I have had in quite a while. Much better than your typical Dickie's or other chain place. They really put the time into their food, you can just tell. The appetizer that is a must is their "Tater Pigs" which are stuffed tater tauts and they are to die for. I am not even a fan of tater tauts but these were delicious, especially with the ranch sauce. YUM! We had a combination of of their brisket, ribs, pulled pork, and jalapeno/cheddar sausage. Each was sooooo good. Their BBQ sauce was also great, I loved mixing the spicy with the sweet. Sides we had included their mac n cheese (delicious), their mashed potatoes (average), french fries (average), and baked beans (average). We definitely go back one day and would recommend it to a friend.

It was disappointing when I ate here. I LOVE Bruchi's and have frequented the Bruchi's in Kennewick Washington I must have eaten there fifty times they deserve a ten star review.  Unfortunately this new one in Meridian does not match up in the quality of food.  The bread, the meat, the fries.. fries were not hot and compared to Kennewick were not crispy enough.  The bread was cold and soft and in Kennewick it has a much better texture.  In Kennewick,  you unwrap the cheesesteak sandwich and steam comes out and the smell wonderfies you.  Not here.  Please do something to step up your Bruchi's game so I can enjoy my favorite restaurant finally coming to town and change this to a five star review.

The sushi is great.... the Flank Steak Churrasco is way way too salty... and I like salty!
The Naruto rolls keep getting smaller and smaller every time I order it.
You'll get a snobby waitress every now and then.
I go just for the sushi now and maybe some appetizers. The dinner items I've had is not great.
Happy hour is great.... but the check came out to about $160.00 for 4 of us during happy hour... and we only had 2 drinks each. We ordered a lot of food tough .
This is my favorite car wash! My car always comes out looking new! Also, I'm very impressed with the staff and management. Excellent customer service!
Location is a little hidden. In a business plaza kind of hidden from the main road. Sourdough is awesome. Bread is what keeps me coming back. There is a great selection of sandwiches.

Wow wonderful lettuce wraps. And the broccoli chicken, We were told it was spicy, but it wasn't. But still had great flavor. My daughter had a weird crab roll wrapped with cucumber, which was oddly warm for something that was supposed to be cold. But in all the experience was wonderful for me as it was my first time here. The staff is very good with their service, polite and quick to make sure as a customer that all your needs are met. I'm looking forward to a return trip in the future.

First time here because it just opened apparently.  There isn't a sign up yet which made it a little hard to find, but I'm told it will be up soon. It's an easy to get to location downtown Meridian.  Plenty of on street parking. 

The salon has a great modern, industrial feel I love. The staff, both the ladies and guys, are friendly and welcoming and talented at what they do.
