Sydnee did a cool gray/icy blonde baylage breaking up the golds/yellow blonde I have. It turned out amazing. I have no issue trusting this girl with my fine blonde hair. 

I feel like finding a salon can be one of the hardest things when you move. I'm so happy I found syd and this place.

PS...There is some cool graffiti in the alley beside the salon which I might have taken a selfie showing off my new hair in front of lol.
Excellent food, drinks and quality of service. Loved the orange chicken salad, the house salad, and the loaded waffle fries!

Im on day 3 of 5 here. I use speak to text so I won't be going back to fix some of my errors on this review but pop tart & popcorn on sheets, sheets not changed they allow pets which there was pee in the elevator?, next day the elevator was broke so we missed breakfast by a few minutes, they hardly  accommodated for it or had no sympathy that my son would like waffles. (we went out & got some). The hot tub was swamp green and looked be used as  everyone's personal loofah to jet off their dead skin & bathroom (as their is no readily accessible bathroom with in 50 feet of the pool area) - I mind you that you won't be able to see this as your sitting in it with the Jets on but when they turn off your going to be thinking it's the run off of a foot spa down the road -

room cleaning lady's adorable and friendly & after noon desk person [one of them]

early morning desk (big haired Mexican lady)& late night desk (long haired hippy) kinda dgaf - 

would I stay here again, I'm easy going too & dgaf but for ppl that are not they probably won't ever be staying here again. 

plus side 24/7 food next door & gas station & the interstate to drive away fast

We were visiting and were told to check it out. I loved this place! We sat outside in beautiful weather enjoyed drinks (Happy Hour all day....what?...My sangria was $2.99 and it was really good.)  Can't wait to go back!
Decent selection of beers. The Fish and Chips  truck there on Saturday is the best. Saturday also features $3 pints and $6 growler fills.

I've been a huge fan of Which Wich ever since I first tried it out in Colorado - needless to say I was ecstatic when they showed up in the Village! These sandwiches are some of the best I've ever had. It certainly isn't cheap, but they don't skimp out on toppings.

First things first, this isn't like walking into a Subway where you "follow" along with the sandwich down the production line. The first thing you'll do is find a large menu on your left, and underneath are corresponding brown paper bags and red sharpies. You'll grab the right bag and mark which sandwich you want, what size, what kind of bread (or lack thereof, salad, etc), toasted or cold, and which sauces and veggies you want. I recommend the Bachammon (bacon and ham) or the Italian grinder if you don't know where to start. They also have some unconventional sandwiches, such as turkey and cranberry sauce, if you want to go crazy. You can also choose if you want double meat, double cheese, etc.

This paper bag method might be a turn off for some who are picky about their sandwiches, like you only want three tomatoes or extra pickles, etc, because you hand the bag to the cashier, they ring it up, you pay, sit down and wait for them to call your name. You don't see or follow the process of adding veggies behind the counter. Even I'm a somewhat picky guy who likes lots of peppers on my sandwiches, but they always put just the right amount on there. The HUGE advantage to the Which Wich system, however, is that you're not rushed or pressured by people standing behind you in line to hurry up and order, so you don't have to be or deal with "that guy" who holds up the entire line while choosing a sandwich.

They also have unconventional sauces and veggies - some that I always add on every sandwich are pesto, spicy mayo, hot pepper mix, and different mustards. The sandwich is stuffed to the brim with ingredients... but as long as you keep it wrapped up and un-wrap it as you go along eating the sandwich, you'll never have a problem with a messy sandwich. The ingredients are balanced just right and every sandwich is super tasty. The bread is also really nice! I will say, it's the most expensive sub sandwich shop I've ever been to, but it's well worth the money if you have a superb palette and a big appetite. Go for the biggest size, double meat and double cheese, and you'll walk away with a sandwich that's about the size of a small child. These guys don't mess around.

This other guy on here who is complaining about the *gasp* "tacky" wire and *gasp* "tacky" paper towels and *gasp* "tacky" to-go bags is straight crazy! Who cares?! It's a great ambiance and whoever gets hung up on silly things like that obviously isn't in the right mindset. The food is downright delicious and it's only been crowded once during lunch hour. The ambiance is great and the staff is friendly. Go enjoy a great sandwich - you won't be disappointed! I've recommended this place to at least a dozen people, and all have come back to me and thanked me for it - they are now big Which Wich fans, too! Go give this place a shot. You won't be disappointed.

Tried this in Saturday it was busy with a 1/2 hour wait but it did go by fast. The food was great! We had 3 if us ordered the chicken fried steak which was fresh and hash browns I should have gotten the home style cause they were awesome others had a skillet and it came with a pancake that was as big as the plate. I would go back for sure if you are in Eagle Idaho you have to check it out.

FOOD rating ; 3 stars. Had the Pho and Vietnamese Eggrolls ---deLiSH. Dipping sauce could be alittle stronger. Tasted alittle dilute. And would liKe to see chili paste as an option not just rooster sauce.  
This food fix every 3 weeks; I'm happy!

The food was good and decently priced. But after arriving at 10:30, we were finally eating just before noon. They were a little busy and looked a little disorganized, it took almost as long to get the food than it did to wait for our table. But the food was good, so I can't complain about that. Just be prepared to wait.
The food tasted pretty good and the service and atmosphere are great, but my wife has gotten really, really sick both times we have eaten there!

The food and drinks are amazing, prices are readonable, and the super friendly staff like Damian, Adrienne, and Anthony are great!!!  I was sad to see this locations hours were cut to 10am to 5pm Monday through Friday because the Nampa location is just too far from North End Boise where I live!!! A downtown Boise location would be awesome!! You gotta try the  Mediterranean wrap or the Vancouver Panini... the Pom Pom or Southern Mango drink...and add a sugar cookie....yum!!!
Wonderful service!  Very accommodating!  Jenna gives a great massage and she listens to your needs. I will definitely be back!

Great wash, great vacuums, great staff!  Integrity rules.

BEST IN AREA BY A MILE!

I've eaten a lot at Kona and the last few times my sushi didn't seem fresh. The rice was hard and almost chewy. For the most part I enjoy eating on the patio when I go with my friends. Nice happy hour menu though. I'll he back to give it another try.

Could anything be any slower? Slowest slow of all the slows. Ordered the special and it still took forever, its a simple chicken parm, its not rocket science. Sauce was tasteless, chicken was semi-done. Glad it was a Saturday so I gad all day, because thats what it took, all day, to get... the special.
3 out of 4 times we gone there they have been sold out of a dessert. On the 4th trip, we received the last one.

Nice ambiance and a great place to have drinks with friends. That being said, do NOT waste your money on the sushi here. Everything is overpriced for the quality of food you get. Best to get a variety of appetizers and drinks rather than ordering an actual meal. Try to get there during happy hour to get the most bang for your bucks!

Very tasty BBQ ribs and sides. One of the wait staff members seemed short and very overwhelmed with how busy their lunch hour was. It's a good problem to have being busy. None of their clients seemed upset about the slower service, but the waitress was making it more tense by her non friendly approach. It's my fourth time here with consistently good food each time! I'll be back!

I love this store!  It's just so refreshing to find everything I need under one roof and for reasonable prices.  The staff are helpful and friendly, and the bathrooms are clean.  I was shocked the first time I shopped here and filled my cart for under $200, and I love their huge bulk food and spice section.
Great food, good beer. Very fast service and the smell is amazing! Food was great, service was even better

This is a really nicce place inside which is totally unexpected from the outside.  Our waitress was very nice but not quite as attentive as I like as far as clearing the table of dirty dishes.  The food was good but I wouldn't say great.  We had the spring rolls which were tasty and I ordered the chicken pho which was very good!  My husband had the mushu chicken which I thought lacked flavor but he thought it was good.  I asked for sliced jalapeno for my pho which where I come from is a traditional addition for the soup along with the bean sprouts, basil, etc. and they had no idea what a jalapeno was!  So the chef personally brought out a thai chili for me which was a very nice touch!!  :)  I'd go back for sure.

Best stores, restaurants, service, and entertainment!!  Love bringing the family and exploring the shops. 

I usually park over by Charming Charlie and walk down the middle road or park on the north side and there is a "short cut" through the glass doors. 

Love the proximity to Kleiner Park too!!

We totally stumbled on this place while visiting from out of town. We were very impressed! Great food, awesome kids menu and excellent service. Very nice atmosphere even though it was super busy. I had the macadamia nut chicken and my wife had the macadamia chicken salad. Both were good portions and very tasty. The kids both got little bento boxes and they loved it. We even had a view of the fountain show. We will definitely be back.
Love everything dutch from Italian sodas to mochas to muffin tops and more, delicious and satisfying

I work right around the corner from Sofra and finally got the opportunity today to try it for lunch with my boss.

The food was delicious.  I've never had Bosnian food before and have never been to Bosnia so I can't attest to it's authenticity. I ordered the beef sausage sandwich (I'm not sure what the bosnian name was), the small version, which is just the sandwich with no sides. It was simple - sausage and onions in a soft pita-like bread with sour cream and a sauce that's name escapes me now.  Anyway, it was delicious.  The bread was great and the sausage was very flavorful; definitely not your typical breakfast or stadium sausage. The sandwich was kind of big and unwieldy so I ate it with a fork . . . hopefully that didn't offend anyone.

The price was right at less than $10 for each of our meals and there was a decent amount of food. Service was good if a little slow. The biggest drawback was the noise.  It wasn't very crowded but with two TVs and music going all at once it was a bit of a cacophony. Not so bad though that we couldn't hear each other across the table.

Certainly I would recommend trying it yourself and I'll be back as soon as I can convince someone to go with me again.  Gotta try me some of them pastry buns.

Horribly loud dueling pianos bar.  It started out great, and got louder and louder.  Moved to 4 tables hoping to get away from the over-amped keyboards.  By the time some yahoo started pounding on a snare drum, I about turned my table over in my haste to get out of there.  And in my attempt to pay for my diet coke, you would have thought by the slowness of finding my order, that the server was ringing up a months worth of groceries.   I finally shoved $3 bucks at her and told her I hoped it was enough and stormed out.   Note to musicians- your musicianship isn't helped by being louder.   Too bad, but I won't be back.

The service of staff was wonderful. I called in a to-go order for a gyro salad. Both over the phone and in-person the staff was truly friendly and made me happy to give them my business and excited for the food. The salad was great and flavorful. I wish I would have ordered some pita bread on the side as I wasn't quite full from the salad itself. The gyro meat was delicious and both of the dressings including tzatziki (on the side) tasted great on the salad. I'll definitely be returning to try other items.

Our home flooded on Good Friday, a call was made to Ken Hurst, who  sent his team to our home immediately. Kaden Isaacson and Fernando evaluated the situation and went to work. They did a fantastic job pulling up carpet in the living room, dining room and family room, removing our kitchen flooring and wet cabinets. The fans and other equipment were removed by Kaden and Justin on Wednesday. 

This is a very professional and thorough company with great employees. I highly recommend them .
Best Barbeque in Idaho  - that I have tasted so far!  I have tried several restaurants and they remain #1!

This place is so stinking adorable I wish it were in my backyard. It's a charming farmers market with a great selection of in-season local produce that is ripe and delicious!!! My sense is that the selection changes throughout the year so if you are looking for specific produce you should call first to make sure they have it. Also, when you turn in it looks like you are coming up someone's driveway...keep going it's okay! The store is in the barn under a beautiful canopy of trees, you just don't see it initially. I will be back all year because this is exactly the way local produce should be displayed and sold.

I  am trying not to get sick even writing this.. We have had a bad sushi experience here previously (over a year ago.) On Saturday night we were with family and someone wanted to dine here and we decided to give it one more try. BIG mistake. We ordered our dinner and everything seemed fine, (drinks were good, seated in a timely manner.) Everyone's food was good except one of our family members chicken was difficult to cut. I had her turn her plate to me and the chicken was raw in the middle. We told our server and he was not very apologetic and took it back to be remade. I observed the wait staff as they were about six feet away from me and I saw them laughing and rolling their eyes while staring at our table. (Manger included.) Once finished, the manager brought the meal back saying they used a thermometer to make sure it was cooked throughly but was being demeaning and quite frankly a huge dick about it. Our server came and said the meal would be comped but sure enough, we received our check and it was never removed. I will never come back here and will be sure to tell everyone we know not to come. Your staff is incompetent, your cooks are amateurs and you all seem to be stuck in junior high. Learn how to run a real business that doesn't compromise people's health. Simply disgusting.

Excellent food, good service, good value.  Overall great restaurant.

If we're in Eagle, it's definitely one of our favorite breakfast spots.

Depending on the day you may have a wait, but it's worth it.  Grab a cup of coffee and relax.

This place is awesome! I saw a review by David F and he said that place was a great place to try compared to the other Pho places in Downtown. Knowing that he and I have the same taste in food, I decided to try thing place out. (Thanks David!)

I've seen this place before but was kind of skeptical because usually when I pass by, there  wasn't many cars in front of the restaurant -  I assumed that it wasn't good. Anyways, I am really glad that I got a chance to eat here! Its one of my top places to eat now in Boise now and all it took was a good recommendation and a sip of their soup :)

Their menu is so different! There are plenty to choose from and I can't wait to try the rest of the items.. Of course, I stayed on the safe side and got the beef pho (whoops, can't remember the name) and a side of egg rolls. The pho's broth was simply delicious almost perfect! Haha. Right amount of noodles, and decent portion of meat. The egg rolls were crispy and delicious as well.  The bowl portion was around ~8.00 (sorry if I'm wrong) , but to me that was a little expensive for my taste. Just because, I had the idea it would be cheaper since it a smaller bowl comparison to Vietnamese Restaurant on Franklin. Their bowl is 8.00 but their bowl size is HUGE! Enough to feed 2 people. So, In a way I was kinda bummed on the price. 

ORDER:
Complementary? - Mini Egg Drop Soup 
Beef Pho
Egg Rolls
= YUMMM!!

I can't wait to eat at this place again! :)

Pretty cool little place.  The owner was there and super accommodating and kind. We came way past lunch hour yet the food was spot on.  Their rendition of Pho was actually super tasty.  We asked for more fish sauce and chili paste but with those, it was perfect.  The waffle sandwich was so different and good. A little on the dry side so next time I might ask for more sauce for the sandwich but really? Different and delicious. 

The boba Smoothie was seriously one of the best.  Don't be afraid to ask for more boba they were super accommodating our love for boba. 

Check it out.  You will love it.

The worst food I've had ever. The egg rolls where not freshly fried, they burnt and broken apart. The coconut rice had zero flavor to it, and the macaroni salad tasted like deli salad. Everything was NOT prepared fresh, instead it was just in warmers like a catering buffet. I would not recommend this place at all.

Cuban was very good my sushi rolls with tuna seemed as if the rice was dry. Slow service but the Cuban was good and it is a very Nice looking place. Once again flying solo but hey I would probably go back but haven't experience enough of Meridians other locations to go there right away.

Not only is the food delicious, but the owner offers customers the ability to call ahead to be added to the wait list! Since this wildly popular restaurant typically has a long wait, the call-ahead feature allows me to still plan ahead for my family to go!

Kona has great food but terrible service. The delay in food caused out server to not properly give us a five star rating. Kona is located at the Village a new upcoming area in meridian and the atmosphere is spectacular compared to others. The sushi is good, you can't go wrong with the jalapeño roll if you like spicy. The dessert is off the hook too. I like the brownie if you are feeling like a heavier dessert, or the red velvet cupcake with ice cream. Yum! Everything was good besides the service from the manager, Greg, and the delay in food. After expressing our frustration that we had been waiting for twenty minutes for a drink on a Sunday night at 8, the process seemed to speed up.

My brother & I had lunch here. I wanted green curry, but it wasn't on the menu, but asked the server about it and she brought a yellow curry with fresh basil that was very good. My brother ordered a calamari dish that he enjoyed. The spring rolls were good, but lacked peanuts - strange. The 2nd time I ordered pad thai, that came with a thick brown sauce - I have never had pad thai with thick brown sauce. My brother ordered a yellow curry, because he liked what I had the 1st time. His curry was served with a thick brown sauce - what? It was such a letdown. I will never be able to talk him to go there again.

Ehh.. I won't go back. There are less expensive options that have impressed me more. I stopped in this afternoon for an iced coffee. I asked for recommendations of a candy bar type flavored iced coffee. She made me an iced caramel mocha. I was shocked at the price of more than $8.00. My drink was still warm because it had such a small amount of ice in it. I ended up stopping at a gas station and purchasing a cup of ice to add to it and make it ice cold. So for slightly more than $8.00 I was served a warm iced coffee that had a strange after taste. I won't be back.

I'm giving this restaurant three stars for the happy hour. Buy one get one is too good to pass up, especially when they have the self-serve chip bar (chips, 4-6 diff types of salsa, refried beans) to help fight off your drunk. There are plenty of funky, little happy hour appetizers, too, but in our experience they're kind of small and lackluster for the price. The food is pretty okay for American-style Mexican.

Who am I kidding? Go for the happy hour, especially if there's a game on.

Worst experience (only happened once): We asked our waitress if it was happy hour (a Saturday) and she said yes. We proceeded to order shots of Patron, which is like $11 per shot. After finishing our party times, we were informed that it was not happy hour and we were on the hook for the bill, close to $100 at a Mexican restaurant bar. We were pissed. So ask them to double-check.

The good news: I called a manager a day later, he checked our ticket in the computer system, made it right with some gift certs (although, I would have preferred my money back). Still, they deserve praise for trying to keep their clientele happy.

This is your typical Massage Envy layout. 

The only thing that bothers me is that massages are NOT 60 minutes, they are only 50 minutes so you feel cheated out of time...

Sidney was pretty good, I'd recommend her if you like deep tissue massage.

Very disappointed to find that their HH ends at 6:00 pm-used to go until 7:00pm. 
They have changed their HH food options and upped the prices. The HH Martinis are shaken-not stirred and taste like water. This is NOT the establishment that we came to enjoy since moving to Boise in 2014. We are looking for a new spot-any suggestions?
Chicken fried steak. That's it. Don't bother ordering anything else. It's AMAZING. Business hours are a little funky, so look it up before driving out to Eagle.

Beef Sandwich!!!  So tasty! Can't wait to have another. Also the staff was very friendly and they had a great kids area that made the meal even easier to enjoy. They have tasty local brews on tap. Overall can't wait to try again! Oh and I had a thin crust Alfredo sauce with sausage, onions, and spinach...not only was it cut right, true Chicago box cut, but it is superb!! Great job Bonos on bringing Chicago a little closer!

I had the salmon salad and it was awesome. Portion size was nice and filling. Service was quick and attentive. 
I thought the pricing made it someplace I would go only for a special occasion.
Great wash and very courteous attendant, he asked if I was a veteran and said "thank you for your service ". Very convenient location. I will be back!

Just had lunch at Kona Grill at Meridian Village:side salad-ok, iced tea good, bread pudding with apples and ice cream - blah. $15.90+tip.  Service was good. Nice ambiance with patio overlooking fountain.  LATE ADDITION: Went back for Happy Hour.  Had Cheeseburger sliders and pot stickers (appetizers), chicken chili and passion fruit Crème Brûlée.  Sliders were char-broiled, with cheddar cheese (real), and had good garnish (lettuce, tomato, etc.) on a small pretzel bun.  Good taste!  Pot Stickers, good taste, nice presentation, but nothing special.  Chicken Chili (red) had really great flavor.  Passion Fruit Crème Brûlée had a great flavor and texture in the Crème, but the Brûlée part had a bad texture.  The sugar is supposed to be in a glass sheet, but this also had large granules that gave a bizarre texture as you ate it.  Still, it was delicious.  They had Buckler non-alcoholic brew - a refreshing break from the std Anheuser-Busch offering of most restaurants of this caliber.  GREAT service from Catalina!!

Came in on a weekday and spent a long time waiting to be seated without even being greeted, meanwhile there were many open tables.  We were 5 and they sat us in a booth made for 4 at best.  I had read about the service on yelp so had set the bar low and figured the food my make up for it.  The food was definitely below average.  Had their burger and salmon plates, kids had their mac and cheese and meatball sliders.  Their french fries weren't too bad.

I am rating this place 1 star and at that they don't deserve the cashier was rude and gave me no information to the special they had going on ask about straws for the drinks and was totaled need to use small ones due to we ordered the wrong ones I ordered Chicago style hot dog that took what worth over 45 minutes to get where it was not on a sesame bun it was not a  Chicago hot dog at all if you are looking for Chicago style food then this place is not for you it seems like they are budgeting what they sell and are under poor management conditions completely disappointed
This is my second visit to Joe Mamma's. The corned beef hash was fantastic. Excellent service and the food was fresh. Would definitely recommend to anyone looking for a great breakfast.

My husband and I had lunch at Twigs yesterday and  had a really nice experience. The salad was great...crisp and cold. I had the pepper salmon and was very impressed. I ordered the smaller portion which was just the right size. My hubby had the steak sandwich, tendered and cooked perfectly. Our service was outstanding! Our waiter was able to answer all of our questions and offered suggestions. He was helpful and prompt. 
Twigs will now go on our list of places to return to. We enjoyed having this new restaurant in our community.

I love Cafe Ole and I always enjoy the the three combination plate. However, if you have more than 3 or 4 people, then eat elsewhere. This restaurant has ONE group seating area. If you go when another group is there, then you will have to wait over an hour to eat. I never had this experience at the location on Milwaukee in Boise
Super slow service every time we come here. Decent happy hour prices if you want to wait, but marginal food at best. Manager wouldn't even comp ANYTHING after waiting 1 hour for food.

This is a great store!  I really love all of the bulk bins where you can find everything SO much cheaper than on the shelves.  Plus you can find those hard to locate items like aborio rice and such.  They have a wonderful deli and seafood specials that blow everyone else out of the water!  I also really love the ethnic selections.  It's nice that they cater to most ethnicities and I don't have to go store hopping to find what I need.  I'm fortunate to be able to shop during the weekdays because the weekends can be really busy!  I don't mind packing my own groceries in order to be able to save so much money!

In Idaho visiting family for Christmas. We were a party of six and only had to wait 5 minutes for a table. Our waitress was phenomenal! Fast, accurate and friendly. The food was so good. I had the trash taters. Yum!!! This place was fun, reasonably priced and delicious. A must try.

My family and I really love this place! Food is amazing, and the staff is great! There is often a wait, so I suggest you get there early!

I recommend you come here if you are looking for a good breakfast joint!!!

Thanks to Carl Y's review Wagner's came on my hubby's and my radar.  First visit in a couple of days ago and we left with fantabulous, farm fresh produce including two kinds of tree ripe peaches, Christmas melon, two kinds of fresh peppers (Basque and ?), tomatoes, onions and corn.  A big bag (we always bring our own cloth shopping bags) and it was full to the brim for a total of ten bucks. Even.  What a great value for such wonderful produce including the best corn and melon and peaches we've had all season.  The friendly people who work there are an added bonus.   We are eager to return for more.  Highly recommend you go.  

THIS N THAT:

1) PARKING:  Gravel lot.

2) ACCESSIBILITY:  Loose, big scale gravel here is not doable for folks using wheelchairs. 

3) HUCKLEBERRY BONANZA:  They had fresh huckleberries in ziploc bags in their refrigerated case.  Apparently there is a bonanza crop of huckleberries this year.  These came from Baker OR area.
Good food... not the best but we still enjoy coming here often. Queso very mild flavor. Carne asada dish is really good but a few times the cut of meat was tough and grisly.

Great quick carwash. The only thing I wish they had were some towels available to get the drips of water that the dryer doesn't blow off. I'll definitely be taking my vehicle back for more epic car washes.
The service is great and the pancakes are the best I've had in a very long time! The restaurant is clean and inviting with plenty of seats.
Overly priced for what you get.  You are paying for the ambiance of this place. Would I return?  Nope - unless someone else were buying.
Best happy hour around with a lot of different food choices and drinks. The sunshine roll is my favorite unfortunately it's not on the happy hour menu.
Don't have one bad thing to say about this place. Excellent service, amazing food and awesome atmosphere. Took my wife here for our anniversary and it was awesome. Will be back a lot!

Kim's Grill is a great place to hang out for happy hour. We like the patio during good weather where we can watch the fountain. Happy hour menus and drinks are just right and the service is top notch.
I have eaten here twice now and its great every time. Love the cultural experience and the food is amazing. Also love the coffee.

My Boise family kept telling us how great this place was so we decided to try it out while we're in town visiting. Sad to say it started out ok but quickly went downhill. Ordered a pomegranate margarita which was good.  Others also ordered drinks which were good. We then ordered the Brussels sprout cauliflower appetizer which was tasty other than it didn't contain any cauliflowertold the server who offered up a second appetizer which she represented as comped but then charged us for it.We then ordered dinner which took 40 min to come and when it did ALL of it was ice cold.  Told the server who said they forgot one of the salads so she had to wait for it. I would have brought the hot food if it was me but I'm not a server so maybe there's some delivery protocol.  Asked for the manager who asked me what I'd like him to do. A good manager would have comped it all. He decided he'd remake one sandwich and give our table of 8 one free dessert. Also our server never refilled our drinks and left dirty dishes on the table. I recently spent over $1800 for dinner on a family vacation so I'm not looking for a handout, just good service and good food.

This is some of the best bbq we've had! I love their pulled pork melts and their mashed potatoes are to die for! We've had them cater a small Christmas party and were a hit! Glad they've moved closer to our house, but wish they still had their drive through.

Just had the jambalaya. An unexpected find on the menu.  Full of chicken, crawfish, sausage and seasoned to perfection. Not for the faint of heart. Hot, hot. This place always amazes. Great drinks; superb wait staff.  Our go to date place. Pot stickers are the best as is voodoo roll. Tuesday happy hour.
Great food and great service! The 50/50 with sweet sauce was amazing and so was the garlic smashed potatoes. Great place to sit down for home style BBQ!
Chicken satay was excellent, sushi was good. Nice ambiance. Hostess was rude and curt but I would return

By the name of the restaurant, it sounds like a Hawaiian fusion restaurant like Roys. The sushi rolls and spicy calamari as appetizers were excellent. I debated whether to order steak or fish. Grill indicates steak, but it also could mean grilled fish, but Kona is definitely Hawaiian. Therefore, I decided to order some Asian fusion. I scanned the menu. The NY steak looked good, but I resisted the temptation and ordered the glazed sea bass with the fried rice. That turned out to be an excellent decision. The sea bass was perfect and the fried rice was unbelievable. It was crunchy and delicious. For #Thinsulin fans, there's green light foods for you to lower your insulin level. I definitely would go back to this restaurant.

Very cool place and really good food. I had the firecracker sashimi on happy hour and a rainbow roll. I am picky about sushi rice and theirs was surprisingly good for a mixed menu restaurant. Fish was fresh and reasonably generous especially at this price point.

I have a short pixie haircut and sometimes, it can be difficult to find a hairstylist who is familiar enough with this style to cut it correctly and can cut it quickly. Erica at the Great Clips on Chinden is really good. She listens and is fast! I loved my haircut.

We were here at the busy hour on a Friday, with a party of 4. We made reservations and were seated immediately. Mostly adequate service- we had to request drink refills even after our empty glasses were cleared, and it was never asked if we'd like refills. Our appetizer was fine, but the breading on the calamari was slightly undercooked, while the meat itself was slightly rubbery. 3 out of our party ordered sushi, and it was good, although rolled very loosely and falling apart. I ordered the flank steak, which was ok. It was cooked well, the chimichurri was delicious, the brussel sprouts were inedible due to lack of seasoning, and the potatoes were thick and gluey in texture. There is no salt available on the tables- which would be ok, except that the food needed salt in a bad way. We also had to request soy sauce- which should be given automatically when ordering sushi. This is our 2nd time at Kona, and the 2nd time I left feeling severely underwhelmed, especially for the price point. After a $100 meal for 2 people, I want to leave feeling more than "meh..."

Worst customer service.  Broke the antenna off my car.  They filled out a form and said a manager would call.  A week later, no phone call.  Asked a week ago to cancel my membership.  They bill me anyway and took too long to call me back.

The wash is ok but the dryers are terrible and leave water spots.  Vacuums leave a lot to be desired.
Waffle pressed Sandwiches are unique and brilliant. Croissant crust melts in your mouth. Noodle soup was flavorful and filling! Staff was super friendly. We will be back!

went last week end and the wait was insane. about 45 minutes. So we went outside for a 1/2 hour across the street, played with the kids, etc. I went in to check our seating and make sure and some old lady was a complete jerk, and said "we said 45 minutes it hasn't been 45 minutes" I explained that we had been not within ear shot for the last 1/2 hour, and so that was the only reason I was checking. She just IGNORED me. Completely IGNORED me. We will NEVER be back.  Food was quite good.  And the Griddle we went to for breakfast yesterday (however LATE 11a.m.) and the wait was 10 minutes, and Lexi took AMAZING care of us. Recommend there, and let Jo mama's learn how to have some customer service or close.
We've been here several times. It's similar to Denny's and the food is consistent and price is good. Service is not the best - slow, seems like lots of turnover. Nothing stellar, nothing terrible.

Had a nice dinner with a good friend.  The service was prompt and friendly. The food was good.  We had to sit in the bar and it was crazy loud; not very conducive for conversation.  The hostesses always seem curt and snobby when I come in, especially when I don't have a reservation.

Years ago when exploring the area for the first time, I came across this place. how could you not eat at a place called Joe Mamma's?? This was the highlight of my visit to Boise that year. 

Now as a resident I frequent JM on a regular basis. honestly, it is just the perfect place to go. Local - personable - great food and service.

Some of the best bbq I have ever had! Their brisket and pulled pork alone is a good enough reason to visit, but then you see all of their homemade side options, like my favorite, the mac and cheese with bacon. The great service is also a major reason to go back, let alone being able to feed a famiy of five for under $50! Can't wait to see what else this small mom and pop shop has in store for them.

Solid golf for the $$$, driving range over the lake but they have an outstanding restaurant/bar!  Great service!  Prime Rib Fridays with live music.  It's not Chandlers but if you're looking for good food, great service and a fun atmosphere, You should try LakeView!

Staff were so very sweet, however the sandwich(s) we ordered were marginal at best. Similar taste to Jimmy Johns. I would not eat here again. They should consider a garlic pesto, perhaps some cashew cheese spread instead of Swiss. The potential is limitless!!!

We had a long night tonight being that our last flight was delayed an hour and when we finally arrived at this hotel, they tell us that they over booked and do not have a room available for us. I am just trying to figure out why/how they over booked. I feel like a well established hotel such as La Quinta would not let rookie mistakes like this happen. I am thoroughly disappointed with my service.
Needed my Bono's fix having grown up in Las Vegas (Trop & Eastern).  Did not disappoint had the Chicago Dog and Fries, can't wait to come back and get the Italian Beef I love their Giardiniere.

Awesome new joint! Just opened two weeks ago, and me and the family stopped in for bubble tea. It was so good! The boba was fresh and the perfect texture, the bubble tea itself was delicious, and the owner was awesome! He was so friendly and had an great sense of humor. I would highly recommend coming here. This is the best bubble tea I've had in the whole treasure valley area! It's a definite must-try!!!

I love all the staff and the chefs are the best cooks in the world  we eat here three times a week or more you need to try it for sure ! So come on in and meet the staff you'll love them all . 
Tell them Vicki and Steve said to say Hi

The only reason I'm giving this 2 stars is because the nurse and desk lady were very nice to us but other than that the experience(s) haven't been good.

I have taken my husband here for an ingrown toe nail removal 3 times in the past year (2017) for the exact same toe and the exact same side. When they saw that we kept coming back for the same problem they told us they "don't know how it could happen" and acted as if it wasn't an issue. Now it's grown back for the FOURTH TIME and are NOT coming back. After calling multiple places for second opinions they all said that the root had not been extracted! Thankfully we finally found a doctor at another office with a good reputation that knows what he's doing! Will never go back or recommend Idaho Foot & Ankle to anyone!
Went for happy hour and had a wonderful experience! Plenty to choose from on the happy hour and great prices (unlike most places). Had a great server too! Would definitely recommend
. We had the jambalaya and pork tender loin the atmosphere. Food and service was awesome. Our server David did an awesome job.

First time my husband and I went the food was pretty good, but the service was bad. Our server looked like she was in a bad mood, but we didn't really care....we all have bad days. So today we walked in to grab some dinner and the same lady was there and she seemed to be in an even worse mood. Like, I didn't even want to ask her for a straw because i felt like she was going to ignore me or something. I told my husband that I wasn't comfortable eating there, so we just left. Sucks because the food is good. Definitely won't be returning.

We ordered several starters and several sushi rolls for a large dinner party. The starters were great! I highly recommend the lettuce wraps and chicken satay. The rolls were ok, prices were a little high for what you receive. The service was not that great. When I made reservations I had to call 3-4 times before someone would pick up the phone. When someone did answer they "had to ask the manager" if they could take my reservation. This made me second guess if I wanted to have a special dinner party there. When we arrived, the front desk was overwhelmed and unorganized. The waitress that served us was constantly interrupting our conversation without regard or apology. Once our food arrived, she was out of site and nowhere to be found. Before our dinner was done other employees were trying to take our plates before we were finished and taking our table apart since we had guests leave! I would understand if they needed the table, but they didn't. It was towards the end of the night, no one was waiting to be seated, they just wanted something to do it seems. They did just recently open so I am sure they are still working out kinks. Not a very good first impression.

I'm not one to ever do a negative review, however this was highly disappointing. I called for take-out so didn't look at the food in the bags before I left...and I was the last customer of the day. Pad Thai was just a blob of dried out noodles. Fried rice was a container of brown rice with strips of thin pork on it. That was it. Not even fried. No vegetables, nothing. I'll find another restaurant next time!

I don't know if perhaps the doctors were having an off night, but they completely misdiagnosed my 3 year old cat and sent him home with antibiotics. Had I not trusted my instincts and taken him to another vet the next day, my cat would not have made it through the night. Even though this is the only 24 hour animal hospital near me, I would sooner treat my animal at home and wait for a better vet to open than go to this hospital.
Solid coffee, friendly service, and fast. The drinks are too sweet for me at times. I love coffee and drink a lot of it every day, and I come here when I want something for dessert.

Service was on point! Delicious Pumpkin Spice Latte. Chorizo Hash was really good. As was the Cali Eggs Benedict but the star of the show was the House Potatoes! My mouth is watering just thinking about them again. The French toast was not bad but nothing special. The people next to us got a pancake and it was huge and looked fluffy. I wish I'd gone for that.
The polynesian pizza is AMAZING! Haven't had a bad meal here yet! Great atmosphere, great service & reasonably price.

It's Dutch. The staff is AMAZING & the drinks are even better. I love the Sugar Free Rebels & the infused teas. If you are looking for a refreshing drink stop here. They also have these little things called "Muffin Tops" ....get the chocolate chip one. It will change your life!

Three years ago was the first time I went looking for organ music at Dunkley's. It was all Gordon Young with a few 'collections' for pianists trying to play organ, so no pedal line. WTH. I guess it was partly culture shock, as Portland has Sheet Music Service, which is da bomb, who keep a full time person for organ/choral sheet music alone. Of course it IS a warehouse of sheet music with a huge demand in the area.  
About a year ago I started hearing, they have good deals on used pianos (they do have some very fine samples). Then I had to buy stuff on short notice, and the sheet music, it was better. ?  Then a few weeks ago I had to buy more sheet music on short notice, and found multiple bits of usable material. I don't know. Maybe I complained to the right set of ears, but now they're stocking Barenreiter, which is basically the standard for Bach organ music. So hey, maybe they aren't terrible after all.

I saw the positive reviews on Yelp, and am new to the area,so I thought I'd give Cindy a try. I had a hair color recipe from my former stylist and texted it to her and she indicated she could follow it. When I got to the salon she told me that the recipe was not the best for me and talked me into letting her do something that would make me look better. I ended up with black hair( which was NOT the color I wanted), many tears, and had to go to a reputable salon to get it fixed. I would not recommend going to Cindy.

Great little breakfast place I can see why they got good reviews. They have an excellent menu selection. Gluten free options,  and a wide variety of choices and options.

Service was quick and attentive. Food was excellent and they offer military/veteran discount.

I came on a weekday and it was moderately busy, but I heard it's super busy on the weekends. Anyway, this place is so yummy!! I got the California Bennie and added ham to it... amazing! It comes with homestyle potatoes and they're delicious. My husband got the Classic and it came with so much food for the buck! We love this place!!!!

Great food & service! I was very impressed with Cody our waiter. He was very accommodating, made great recommendations, and kept our beverages full. I ordered one of their chili rellano special dishes and it was very tasty! Served with fluffy eggs and their home-style red potatoes, I don't think I've ever eaten so much in one sitting. Definite recommend! Heard it does get busy on the weekends so get there early and expect a little bit of a wait.

Excellent food and great service!! Definitely recommend the baked spaghetti!! This location had changed their meatballs and I didn't like it as much but now the original meatballs are back and just as tasty as ever!!! Eat here and you won't be disappointed!

Got the peeper steak sandwich. Food was pretty good but the wait time was awful. Severely understaffed and don't have their act together. Review update: have been back twice since first review, wait times even during busy times has improved.

Great food, owned by a super awesome family.  My husband and I had the noodle bowl. A large helping of homemade bone broth with tasty toppings, and rice noodles. Kids ate buffalo wings, which they both loved. The owner, and his son were both very sweet, and more than generous. Thank you for a wonderful experience. We'll visit again next time we're in Boise.

I had a prenatal massage with Gerald today and I was so impressed I got a 6 month membership! Clean facility, incredibly friendly staff, and a FANTASTIC massage! I would definitely recommend Massage Envy in Meridian!

Excellent food. Pizza is the best around, although a bit greasy. Crispy thin one time, a little chewy the next. Meatballs are true Italian, and delicious. Awesome custard. Service is very slow, even when they aren't packed. Delicious, so calling ahead might be the ticket.

For a quick, fast-food alternative that is still pretty fast, Which Wich is a great sandwich place.  I like it that, in specifying all the things you want in your sandwich, you are actually participating in the success/failure of your meal.  When we first started going here, I would select pretty much everything on the bag, choosing it all to go into my sandwich (because I like pretty much everything...), but that made the sandwiches too over stuffed, big, and messy.  Now I have dialed in my favorite sandwich type and the ingredients that I like, and it is really, really good:  Crab & Artichoke, Provolone cheese, spicy ranch sauce, olives, banana peppers, oil, vinegar, and all the spices.  Also, their house chips are sooooo wonderful.  I love them.

[ A ham sandwich walks into a bar.  The Bartender says, "You'll have to leave.  We don't serve food here." ]

Never even Heard of this place, until today while looking for a place to get a good smoothie.
This is a great place to try something new that is actually really healthy for you. Staff is really friendly and really want you to like what you order.
There is no added sugars, and real fruit is used.

I really enjoyed the food and the professionalism waiter Taylor gave my wife and I.  He did a very good job of customer service.  The food is always good there.  I have never had a bad experience there.

This has to be one of the best sandwich shops in Idaho..... food is fresh... breads are great and the staff is very attentive.... very nice surprise... have eaten there twice and both times it's be off the chain... thanks you

This place is awesome! I get my hair cut there by Pam - she's great but I heard about from my girlfriend who gets her hair and nails done there. I really like the way Maria does her nails - always very artistic. Pretty cool looking place to boot.
Tasty homemade sandwiches on sour dough, Don't forget the soup of the day AND cookies!

The food here is pretty good and the portions are hearty. The price is a little steep though for a breakfast. Two breakfasts w coffee and no juice is going to cost you $28 on average. Potatoes and eggs aren't that expensive but if you don't want to cook it yourself then this is a good option.

Best breakfast ever. 
Win for serving half orders of eggs bene
Win for cooking the potatoes perfectly
Win for having the most velvety hollandaise sauce.

If you're ever in the area, eat here.

I have eaten here twice and it is a nice, solid restaurant with ultimately forgettable food.  It has a lovely ambience, is good for a date, and has a pretty safe menu if you like fish.  I would have to write a review immediately after eating there to comment on exact plates because an hour after you eat you will have forgotten your meal.

I remember now.  I did have sea bass one of the times I ate there and it was a well prepared and safe sea bass.  Nothing fancy, just safe and adequately prepared.  Solid three star meal.

This is the best sourdough bread I have tasted since moving up here from San Francisco. The sandwiches are very tasty and they are quite large. Everything is fresh and the service is great. Highly recommend.  Salads are also go.

Came on a Tuesday night. The dining room was packed but we were able to get a good spot on the patio. The avocado egg roll was delicious and the dipping sauce was good; not too sweet but with lots of flavor. My boyfriend had the Macadamia Nut Chicken. It was delicious and the mashed potatoes were really tasty. I don't know if it was $20 worth of tasty.... 
I had the Caprese Chicken Sandwich and substituted the bun with lettuce. It was really yummy but pretty messy. The sweet potato fries that it came with were perfect and had a tangier version of fry sauce to dip them in. 
I would definitely recommend the Butter Cake for dessert. Next time i'll ask for extra raspberry sauce on it! 
The service was quick and accommodating : -)
Always a great place to bring your kids, awesome playground and what kid wouldn't love a miniature Water Parker?! Way cool!
Whoever had the idea to add the willie wonka bubble making sound machine deserves a raise, it COMPLETED our Experience, we love car washes and that made it amazing!

I'm updating my review on Joe Mama's. I went in on a weekday late in the morning so they were not very busy. The prices still pretty steep but I will say that the quality and the creativity allow me to feel more comfortable w the cost. I had the veggie hash and it was full of fresh veggies perfectly cooked and hot. I had to particularly appreciate the egg that was done just right so when I broke it open it ran appropriately over the hash, not over or under done. My husband had the special which was a philly hash and he enjoyed it very much. The service was friendly and even though they messed up my order at first, they had it corrected quickly. I did drop them a star because I found the coffee to be very bitter and it wasn't very good. Dawson Taylor coffee isn't one of my favorites but this seemed like either the pot needed to be cleaned or it was over heated or something. Breakfast is not quite the same if the coffee is bleh.

I've been going to see Cindy for about a year and it is AMAZING what she can do!  When we found each other, my hair was in need of a major color correction and it was dry and brittle.  Fast forward to a few sessions later and my hair is long, strong & healthy. Cindy is a wealth of information and will only do what is right for your hair. I can honestly say that I TRUST her recommendations every time. Cindy is full of knowledge and maintains consistent education in all of the newest hair techniques.  I love when she shares what new products and styles are coming up!.... she is simply the Best!

Brought my food out but brought my husband the wrong order. Then had to wait 15 more minutes for his food. I ordered cinasticks they came without the frosting when I requested the frosting they told me they were out. When I requested a refund they suddenly had frosting. When I went to the bathroom I could hear the employees trash talking me. Would never go back again
Great food and even better drinks!  Prices aren't the greatest but if you're looking for a higher end restaurant before watching a movie this is definitely a place to check out!

In town on work and always looking for some place different.  Tri-tip steak on a waffle with added avocado. The waffle was buttery, flaky and deliciousness.  Steak was cooked to order and the greens on it were crisp and fresh.  Fries were... well fries... overall having a waffle as the bun gives this place a must stop for all as I have never seen this done before. Staff and cook were attentive and quick to get your order out! Great food! Only draw back was the waffle was sooooo flaky that I ended up with a lot of waffle flakes on my lap... but it was so worth it!!

currently visiting and stopped in here for a light dinner.

we do not have this restaurant in california and i'm sad about it! the happy hour menu was really extensive and well priced and we decided on some drinks and a few sushi rolls- all of it was super fresh, and well made. i have to say i was extremely impressed.

our server was so friendly and accommodating too, even giving us some tips on where else to visit in the area.

i can't wait to come back here again!

also- try the checkerboard roll if you like spicy- it was SO yummy!

HORRIBLE!!!
We have a family of 6. Took my 2 youger girls in for cleanings. They ended up doing all these extra services WITHOUT my approval. $198 bill. It should of been around $70. 

I was furious. Its not about the money but principle!!
I will NEVER refer them or use them again. Shady business practices.

I between 2-3 stars.... Only had 4-5 balls in the bubble tea.  Not a bad thing since they were dehydrated and hard..  Rest to the tea had good flavor.  Sushi rolls had way too much rice.  if your hungry i guess they will fill you up.  As noted in other reviews service was all over the board... Very random experience... I will go back as I so want a fast japanese restaurant in the area.  Hope it improves as the food in general had a good flavor

Came for a drink (I'm a dirty Dr. Pepper lover from all those other soda stops including the new one in Eagle) and was really disappointed. So much syrup and barely any soda. It tasted flat cause there was barely any carbonation- need to work on the ratio- it should be Dr. Pepper with a splash of flavor, not the other way around. Also they have the good ice! Why ruin it with a plastic cup? The ice melts immediately and waters down the already flat Dr Pepper. I would have been better off going to Maverick and would have paid half the price for a superior drink. I guess I'm a drink snob but they aren't that hard to get right- especially when the price is so marked up.

It was ok.  The sandwich selection is pretty good, it all tastes pretty good.  The price seems a little high for a sandwich.  Overall, it's fine but you have a lot of different options around that are on par or a little better.

Ordered take out, and have to say this was the best BBQ joint I have ate from in a long time. The sauce is delicious, loved the spicy sauce the best. Split a rack of ribs, and they were perfect. The sides of mashed potatoes and mac n cheese were okay, but the meat was great

We were passing through Boise and stopped here for a quick lunch because the place had such high ratings on yelp and boy did this place deliver!! The sandwiches are clean and delicious and the salads have all the best ingredients. Karen, the owner, and everyone that works here are incredibly friendly and accommodating, and the physical location is open and has tons of natural light. 
A+
Way over-priced.  Way too slow.  Out of ingredients.  Staff standing around gabbing while we waited 40 minutes for chicken strips & a hot dog ($26).  I thought you were out after 3 strikes!

We stopped on a busy evening for dessert and coffee.  Our waiter, Robin, was friendly, warm and provided excellent service.  To say we were pleased with our experience at Kona Grill does not do justice to our time there.  We very highly recommend dining there for a meal, dessert or drinks and appetizers.

This place has pretty amazing drinks. The only drink I have ever ordered here that I didnt like, was the lemon drop. All of their mojitos and martinis are fantastic. The don't jip you on the alcohol at all here, that's for sure. This place is great for a casual date night or even a night out with your friends. They offer nice dim lit seating or the bar area which is a fun and lively. The reason I gave this place a 3 star is simply because their main courses haven't been very good or really something to talk about. I have ordered their gorgonzola burger and it was super charred and with the chesse, their were too many overpowering flavors. I have also ordered 2 of their pizzas and there was barley any sauce and little toppings which made for a dry meal. Another time I had their pasta, it was alright but a lot of strong flavors in this one too. The only main course meal I got and really liked was their turkey BLT wrap. It was the perfect ratio of meat and lettuce and the wrap itself was so great. The appetizers here are PHENOMENAL. I usually stick to just appetizers when I eat here now. They have a very delicious crab artichoke dip that is my favorite. They also offer flatbreads that are to die for as well as calamari and  tacos. I recommend this place for drinks and appetizers but that's about it. It's got fun atmosphere and the servers and service here is outstanding.

The only negative I would have on Kona Grill is that it's always so packed and difficult to get a seat during peak hours.  Good is always excellent, from a big chunk of red meat to sushi. We will definitely be returning.

Only about six weeks ago I found out about this brewery and it has become my favorite brewery right on the first visit. On my first visit the place was almost empty so I had a lot of opportunity to talk with Bob, who is one of the owners. I love pretty much all of their beers. How do I know? Well, you can sample any beer you like which I did. They have several darker, slightly malty beers which I like, however also lighter beers and more hoppy ones. All of them are very delicious. Bob has an attractive staff to serve up those brews. There is also a great bonus program. Drink five pints and the next is for free. Best of all, on a Saturday you can fill your growler for $6 and it counts towards your bonus program! Bob has you hooked, lol!
If I wanted to many a suggestion, it would be to improve the acoustics in the bar room. All surfaces are highly reflective which makes it very noisy and hard to understand one another.
Great beer and non alcoholic beverages staff is attentive and friendly And willing to let you taste before you buy which is valuable to me as a beer amateur

Pretty pissed off, I used to like coming to this place to grab a bite to eat, been here quite a few times. I called in an order to go for the family this past Saturday and of course told them what I wanted. So I ordered the kona churrasco, the oriental salad, and chicken skewers for the kids. Sat there and told them the same thing to make sure they got it right. Go to pick it up and get home and didn't get the skewers, instead got 2 little chicken nuggets instead even though I told them on the phone a couple times and it still ended up wrong. I don't know if there is new people working there taking orders, but they should repeat the order back to you if you ordered over the phone. So I probably won't be eating from there again.

Luv luv luv this place!!! Glad to see they made it to Idaho!! The Italian and Wicked were awesome as usual.  Since these sandwiches are customized with an incredible amount of choices, they are not as fast as some other places, but the wait is always worth it. This location in Meridian is convenient and the manager and staff were very friendly. I will be back for sure!

Always dependable, good quality food and drink. Excellent choices for kids as well and it's a ton of food for that price! Have had several things on the menu but last night had the tuna which was really nice...wife had the salmon which was yummy too. Not a sushi fan so can't speak to the sushi but others at our table got it last night and had rave reviews. It gets packed on weekend nights, so highly encourage a reservation!

Joe Momma's is a newish breakfast joint in Eagle, just across the river from Boise. On the good side, I agree with the reviews that say the food is good. On the bad side, I also agree with the reviews that say it takes  a while to get food. 
I went in, during my lunch hour, expecting to have a nice lunch with my family. We were seated right away by a very nice and responsive waiter. We ordered shortly after being seated, and were served some excellent coffee (Dawson Taylor). Then we waited for 40 minutes. I have young kids and they are not very good at waiting. When the food arrived, it was good, but a bit short on portion size (the french toast was only two pieces). I don't mind paying more, but I want a good portion.
I hope Joe Mamma's keeps getting better. I may try it again in a few months when I have a craving for good coffee and breakfast.

Huuuge breakfasts, tasty American style flavors!  The meat Bennie on home potatoes with toast rocked, and the breakfast burrito was straightforward not Mexican style, but some fresh salsa on the side.  Added bonus points for Espresso drinks, cappuccino and all.  Recommend,

Good mix of menu items, the apps were good: crab Rangoon & spring rolls combo. We had spicy chicken/beef, spicy beef/shrimp, & spicy pork/tofu. All were tasty. Service was slow, but another restaurant was closed (which was where we going) early for company party. Server (probably owners wife?) was very apologetic! This place is worth a try just for the mere concept; different types of Asian food under one roof!

This is the first time I have ever been really scared in an automatic carwash. It looks nice on the outside, but I think they have some serious issues with the mechanical stuff. While inside, we were stopped three times, and I could see guys running around on the edges pushing buttons and trying to make us continue. I literally thought I was going to be stuck in there. Yuck. Avoid this car wash!!!!

I overall really enjoyed this place. The owner is a gem and it was a treat, my pleasure to spend time in that store. Should I find myself in the area again, I will find myself in this store again and if I can in any way manage it, the one in Garden City also, which looks to have a lot of stuff I would have like to have browsed. All of the stuff was in good to excellent condition, for the most part, a good percentage was labeled and there was a good amount of rare stuff I hadn't seen before, all of which tends to add a very happy tone to a visit filled with several happy notes one after the other. Organization could use a touch of work, but if it's the one-man-band show it appears to be, I can let it slide. Definitely didn't diminish or dampen my enthusiasm in any way and this could very easily be pushing a 5 on subsequent visits.

I was all set to write a not-so-A-OK review for the All Valley Animal Care Center after taking our puppy to the monthly Spay & Neuter Clinic in Meridian, but the excellent follow-up care has convinced me otherwise.

I was told at my local All Valley Pet Clinic on Federal Way that the monthly clinic was the most affordable option for neutering, as all the add-ons were included in their pricing, unlike at the local clinic.(Offered the second Wednesdays of the month, slots do fill up quickly, call ahead for an appointment.)  

Yet when I arrived with the pup for the early-morning drop-off, I was given a list of pricey add-ons, several of which were highly recommended.  Suddenly the price of the procedure had more than doubled.  Sigh, so, buyer beware on pricing.  

When I picked the puppy up 12 hours later, he was licking his newly-altered parts something fierce, and "we" quickly decided he needed to be a cone-head, yet another add-on.  The pup was fitted with a cone and ready to go, oh, but wait, they forgot to remove the catheter?!  

This is where the review gets a bit better:

We returned a few days later for the gratis re-check.  His parts were a little red and swollen, so they gave him a shot and some (free!) ointment.  The vet we met with was very kind, very helpful -- the best I've encountered since adopting the puppy and moving across the country.  We've seen a few.

We returned a week or so later to have the sutures removed - took all of three minutes - and this time I was again impressed with the staff.

Here's the weirdest part: as I walked him back to the car, the pup broke free and galloped right back into (sliding doors of) the clinic.  By the time I made it inside, he had made it through the lobby and into the back rooms.  The tech who had removed his sutures brought him out front: "Missing someone?" she giggled, and said he seemed "Pretty pleased with himself that he made it all the way back there."  

So here's where I'm landing:

Doggie's choice: My dog enjoys his visits here so much, he jailbreaks IN to the vet office.  This has to count for something, no?

Spay/Neuter services: If price is important to you, this can be a good deal, even better than the Humane Society, but do your homework in advance to know which add-ons you may want/need, and figure this into your total cost.  

Staff: Expect that on monthly clinic days the staff may be a bit more harried than usual.  Otherwise the staff has been very impressive, helpful and good-humored.

24-hour emergency services: The Meridian clinic is available 24/7 for emergencies, ALWAYS good to have the number for one of these in your back pocket, just in case.  (208-888-0818)

Extras: Connected to the clinic is the All Valley Animal Resort for Boarding/Grooming/Adoption.

We arrived at the end of happy hour and the server indicated we could order off the happy hour menu. After ordering, and eating, the manager on duty came to our table and asked us if we took advantage of his server. He went to talk to her, they made up the bill and the manager came to our table and said he would negotiate  the bill. The server indicated it was all right to use happy hour prices however the manager over rode her. The server was pleasant and caught between what she had promised the customer and her manager. The manager was confrontational and rude.

I am visiting here in Idaho from California and my mom suggested I get a massage at Massage Envy.  It was great b/c my husband and I could get massages in the same room.  The front desk was super friendly and my masseuse Victoria was great.  My husband liked his massage also, done by RaeAnn.  Very professional and good prices.

Another great breakfast at Jo Momma's! The food is always fresh... and tasty. Service was super friendly
and efficient. We called ahead to add our names to the waitlist and they told us we had 35 minutes. We arrived in time and waited 5 minutes to be seated. It was great!!

Three stars for the butter cake, but two stars for the service. Definitely frustrating for a waitress to not bring sweetener and spoons for over 10 minutes after receiving our cappuccinos =cold coffee...then doesn't bother to check in for way too long after. Step it up, Kona! Great location and ambiance, but service was lacking tonight.

Went to Twigs with high hopes. Unfortunately my wife ordered the black and blue ny strip.  What we received was a 1/2 inch thick overcooked piece of beef?!?!  Out of what was supposed be a 10oz steak was actually a 6oz tough piece of beef with 4oz of fat attached.  For $34.99 I expected an actual steak, this could have passed for a $5 Wal-Mart cube steak.  My wife's $9 dirty martini had no olive juice in it, but we did get to pay $2 for blue cheese stuffed olives.  Luckily my $6.50 white russian didn't have any vodka in it so we were able to stay consistently disappointed.

Have been going to Epic for awhile now and just met the manager Liz last week. I've always had great service there but she just made it better. Liz was super friendly, helped me vacuum my car and we talked like we had known each for years. Nice to know there are still friendly people out there who are genuinely nice good people! Great job Epic in hiring Liz!!!
Food was excellent. I had a margarita pizza and my wife had the Cuban dip. Food was delicious and service was excellent. We will definitely be back.
never again...not here at least.... the food was...just....how can I say bad without being mean...

What a great find! I recently saw the sign on Main St for Don Diego's, so my best friend and I checked it out for lunch today. The chips and salsa were great, the staff was friendly and attentive, and the food was outstanding! I'm a vegetarian so I asked if they could make a veggie burrito (there wasn't one on the menu), they did, and I have to say that was the best veggie burrito I've ever had at a Mexican place... It had broccoli, cauliflower, squash, carrots etc. a REAL veggie burrito! My friend had the chicken burrito and thought it was great. The kicker was when the chef came out to make sure everyone was enjoying their food, you don't see that happen much these days! Definitely check this place out!
Great food. Waffle sandwich is light pastry dough. Super good!! Customer service fantastic. Will definitely come back.

Our family was visiting from California and my son decided he wanted to go shooting for his 17th birthday. We are by no means gun expert's but the guys at Independence made us feel welcome and catered to us the entire time we were there. This facility is large with a huge variety of guns to both buy and try out on the range. Kudos to the manager Steve, and Rick, the range master. Thanks guys, you helped make our vacation memorable!
Love the chicken dish they serve their. Service always wonderful. My husband loves their sushi and you can't go wrong with their chocolate brownie and ice cream dessert.

Holly Cow!! My daughter decided to come here for her birthday the other day and we had the best experience and meal EVER! We ordered multiple sushi rolls and desserts and we were blown away! The desserts were GIANT (perfect to bring home:) and the rolls were perfectly flavored and presented. Definitely coming back!! I'd give it 10 stars!!

The owner works the counter. The food is delicious. The servers are happy and pleasant. I got the Spicy Veggie scramble and it was fantastic. My son got "Joe's Trashy Taters" and it was one of the best potato scrambles I've ever tasted. My daughter got pancakes and I thought they were perfect. My coffee cup never got empty. My wife got the eggs Benedict and she said it was great. Lots of fun. Highly recommend for you and Joe moma!
The environment is beautiful however the food here is terribly bland. Everything is way overpriced for such dull taste. No flavor and no seasoning.

Great place for a cold night meal.  Sopas del jefe was perfect. You add your own degree of heat and it tastes fantastic.  
Server was super attentive.  
Margarita was pretty good.
Nachos with carnitas was just right (diced jalapenos were very spicy)
I'll be back
Friendly and kind staff. Great food. The kalbi short ribs are the way to go for a tasty meal.
Wow!!! SNS nails is the only way to go!  Cindy did such  a great job!  I wish we would have taken a before and after photo.  Very knowledgable about the product and I highly recommend her.

I am so excited Boise finally has a huge place for family entertainment. The Village is the perfect place to go out for a date night or enjoying a whole day out with the family. The variety of restaurants, shopping, and cinemas are so accommodating and will keep you entertained all day! The Village is very clean and is staffed with so many helpful and friendly people. I can't wait for the entire plan for this development to come to fruition.

So, last night New Years eve was our first time at Kona Grill.  
I have heard mixed reviews from friends about this place.  Our reservation was for 6:15. Promptly seated were our friends and we joined about 5-10 min later.  They ordered their drinks before we got there. When we were ordering our drinks, I wanted one of their "signature" drinks. It was not available, cant remember why, out of ingredients or no long making it.  Friends got their drinks, we got ours maybe 10 min later.  

Ordered Calamari as an app and it was just OK.  2 of us ordered the fish special, I ordered the Oriental Salad and waiter suggested pecan crusted chicken added, I opted for this.
  
Husbands drink was Myers on the rocks, he ordered another one and was told they were out of it.  His next choice was Appleton Rum...they had none.  When our food finally came, I thought for the price the portions were small.  My salad was underwhelming.  The extra 5.00 for chicken was not worth it.  It also had kale in it which to me tastes bitter and it was not listed on the ingredients.  Applebees Oriental salad is ten times better and portion is 2 times bigger.

Desert....one of the items listed they no longer make.....chose another and espresso.....no espresso....machine is broken...

Where we were seated, we could see the kitchen....I watched one of the cooks mix something in a little ramekin with his bare hands....he later put on gloves.  I watched the manager chew out a waiter....twice.

This was New Years Eve but very early and in my opinion not extremely busy.  We had a great waiter that had to explain each time we mentioned items missing from the menu or the slowness of the bar.  For 196.00 and a 40.00 tip, in my opinion was a bit of disappointment.  PROS:  Getting to spend New Years with special friends made up for it all.  

The place is beautiful, comfortable and clean.  Would I go back...maybe one more time.

My husband ordered the pulled pork (no surprise there) and covered it with the 'sweet' BBQ sauce. His fries looked yummy. (I wouldn't know, he didn't share.) He mentioned later on that the food passed his test, which means we will be going back.

Now, here's the thing, I don't like BBQ. I go to these places because HE likes BBQ. So I was checking out the menu hoping to find something to eat. I noticed that they had baked potato, so that made me happy. I was going to order a burger, but they were all  1/2 lb. and those are just way too thick. Then when I read they were  1/2 pork and  1/2 beef I thought, well they probably taste yummy, but I didn't want to risk it. I asked if they had smaller burgers on the kid's menu, but they don't.

However, on the kids menu they have a grilled cheese sandwich! I ordered it along with my potato. The sandwich was perfect! Just the right amount of American cheese, not under cooked, not burnt, just the right amount of crisp. I was happy. The baked potato was hard rather than mushy, so I had to slice it with a knife. It did taste good though, so I gave the sandwich and the soda an A and the potato a B. 

I wanted to try the bread pudding, but at $6.95 didn't want to risk not liking the flavor. Wish they had that in a half serving. Anyway, we received the bill which was around $20 for 2 people. Always happy to get a yummy dinner under $25.

They have fallen all the way off. The chips are stale, service is mediocre and slow, and the presentation is sloppy and luke-warm when delivered to the table. Even the chicken quesadillas were dried up.

The service was good, kept checking in on us often. The food was DELICIOUS! It's not cheap I mean it is BBQ, but it's worth the dollas!! Small inside tho so it's not big family friendly. I'll be bringing my girls back again!

I am new to Idaho and the thing I like to do most is go out to eat.  I decided to try this Smokey Mountain Pizza and Grill since it is very close to my house and... boy what a disappointment.  I went in and placed a to go order for the black and blue burger with the upgrade to Garlic Parmesan fries.  The burger was ok at best but I was surprised on how long it took to make since it isn't even a big burger.  I was expecting a half pound beef patty, maybe even a third of a pound since it took forever to cook..  but no...this thing was a quarter pound at best, it looked like a frozen burger that you get at the supermarket just smaller and it really was just OK.  Then the Garlic Parmesan fries were not what I expected.  I thought they tossed the fries in a garlic butter and sprinkled grated Parmesan on them afterwards but no.. It was shredded Parmesan tossed on them, not even melted, and garlic at the bottom of the fries.  To top it off the bartender told me that it came with some kinda chipotle sauce.. What a joke..the sauce was just mayo and ketchup mixed together.  Now I see why they don't have more than 3 stars..my mistake next time I'll check yelp before venturing to new places.
Came across this by accident and was blown away. I love good a good poke bowl and these guys do it right. It's a little on the spendy side but I'll be back.

My two companions and I chose Twigs Bistro and Martini Bar for lunch. 

The Food:  Beautifully presented but did not execute fully on taste...hence the 3 stars.  My companions chose an appetizer of Loaded Waffle Fries.  She said they were tasty.  My other companion ordered a Blackened Chicken Sandwich with a side salad.  He thought the sandwich was small but tasted good and the salad was over-dressed.  I ordered the Ancho Shrimp Tacos. The tacos were palatable but uninspiring.  I also ordered a side-salad that was swimming in salad dressing.

The Ambiance:  Twigs probably may have gotten a 2 star rating but I was impressed with the hip, chic decor.  I also loved the bar area and it's vast display of spirits. 

Service: Our service was friendly and prompt.

Price:  Spendy for lunch.

Next time I will try out Twigs for what people have raved about....the martinis.  I think I may go again with girlfriends during happy hour or with a date for a drink and appetizer.
Great food and wonderful service. The food is light and flavorful. This place is THE place that my wife and I go to in the greater Boise area for Asian cuisine. Prices are also very reasonable.

I ordered the  Oyakodon ( chicken with onions and egg). My mother is Japanese and would make this for me regularly as a cheap comfort food that I always enjoyed. The Oyakodon here was fairly good they use the chicken they have cooked on the grill so you get that grill taste to the chicken which is not as traditional but still very good ( my mom cooked the chicken in the sauce). Also the egg when cooked traditionally is not really cooked at all but cooks only with the residual heat of the chicken and onions. The egg was overcooked for traditional standards but probably perfect for your typical American. I received my food at Shige express ( they will walk it over)  and when the sushi chef ( not Shige but a younger gentleman) found out I ate mine the traditional way he called over to have it made that way but it was a little to late I think but I appreciated the effort.
