Either way I gobbled up my food and it only cost $6.95 which is not bad ( yes you can make it cheaper at home but you can make everything cheaper at home no matter where you go).  I will definitely be back the service was very nice and its nice to have a fast option that is not hamburgers or greasy Chinese food.

I still haven't really "gotten a hang" of the village. Yes I understand there are shops there. Maybe it's because I don't necessarily like the setup. It's like an outdoor mall. You have to park and then walk around to all the stores. 

I usually go for the cinema and maybe check out one of two of the stores
I like this place alot. The Chai is pretty good and the prices are on par for typical drive through coffee bars.

Always a great time at The Village. It's our date night go to. Never any issues. 
The Yard House is our favorite place to dine. We also love the Cinema. It's won us over!
Excited to see what new shops will arrive next.

Good ambiance and friendly service, however, the food was lackluster resulting in the 2 star rating. Caveat this review is based on rolls / items with fish and may not be reflective of the larger menu.

We had the checkerboard roll ($14.5), lobster & tuna flat bread ($15.5), and spider roll ($14) as well as beer and sake. The first item we noticed was that the rice was mushy - given the importance of rice in sushi this is unforgivable. Second in terms of value each item was approximately $2-5 more than I would expect even given the village location - alcohol pricing was competitive. Specifically in terms of value the checkerboard roll was a surprise - minimal amount of fish on top of the roll and no fish inside of the roll.

The happy hour menu looks interesting with a broad selection with pricing that negates our concern on the value. We'll be back to try the happy hour.

My wife and I just moved to Idaho from California and were in the mood for something traditional. This place is WONDERFUL. The food was amazing and very reeasonably priced for the portion size and the staff was extremely nice! My wife and I will spend many hours, dollars, and good time here in the future!
Thank you for a great experience and smoothie! I'll be back when I'm back in Meridian!!
Best happy in Meridian. Sushi great value and fresh. Recommend to anyone. Service is food

Mmmmm Baaarbeeequuue!!

I love me some bbq and Big Daddy's fits the bill!  ... I LOVE (LOVE) pork to an obsession, but for bbq beef is where it is at. 

Those big beefy ribs that are so tender yet require a little chewing (you know what I mean!) ... YUMMM ... and don't get me started on the brisket!!!

If that isn't enough, they don't neglect their sides! Mashed potatoes, mac n cheese, even coleslaw were really good (just ask my 10 yr old niece - she ate with gusto when we took her there for the first time the other night!)

Big Mamma informed me everything is homemade ... I don't doubt it!!


EAT HERE!!!

When reroofing our 20-year-old home last month we consulted three different contractors. Although all of them were professional Idaho Roofing was the choice we made. They were not the least expensive but the most attentive to answering our questions and following up with us. Rick and his crew were there on time every day and completed the job in the amount of time they told us it would be done.  I  only had one small concern after the job was completed and they were there the next day to take care of it.  I would highly recommend them. Although a roof not the most exciting thing to have done on your house, I am excited to have it done and have it look nice.  I am confident it is done right.  Thank you for the great work.

Food was horrible and the server got the check wrong twice.  She didn't give us the happy hour price even after I mentioned it to her.  She was nice but seemed clueless about the menu.  I ordered my kids meals right away and they still came out with the rest of the food.  I ordered the Philly Cheesesteak, Hardly any peppers and the meat tasted off.  My fires were overcooked and cold.  Overall not a good experience!
Much better this time, though a bit pricey (soup at lunch $10) for what you get. Other ' chinese' style lunch specials for $6.

We were going to see a movie at movie theaters nearby so we went into Kona.

We started off with the Smoked Gouda Fondue and it was great.  Very tasty, however the moment after the food runner brought the appetizer another food runner came with our entrees.  The two food runners almost bumped into each other!  This is really a pet peeve of mine.  I want to enjoy the appetizer and then have enjoy the meal after a few minutes, it seems pretty simple but obviously not for Kona Grill this time.

The service in general was a C-, between the problem with the timing of the entrees it also took far to long to be able to order drinks.  Our waiter (I don't remember his name, but he is a large weight lifter) seemed more interested in socializing with the bartenders than taking checking on our drink status.

That being said, the food was great all the way around!  I can't find good Jambalaya anywhere but Kona Grill.  It's always spot on, I've never been let down.  She had a flat iron steak and it was great.

We really like the location, and the food.  However the service was subpar, otherwise it would have been five stars.

My GF and I swung through here on our way out of town and were kind of in a hurry. Right when we went in we looked at each other and thought maybe we should leave. There was no one at the ordering station but we hung out and checked out the menu which looked pretty promising. We should have trusted our instincts and left. We waited 30 minutes, still no food and very little coming out of the kitchen. We ordered two sandwiches, meat on bread, how hard can that be? Finally, the low energy cashier/food delivery person, noticed we still hadn't gotten our food and said 'you guys still haven't gotten your food'! Well no. So we asked for our money back. She went to the manager and we followed. The manager apologized and said that sometimes the kitchen printer misses some orders. Are you kidding me! Fix the stupid printer because now you have lost a customer for life and I'm here writing this crappy review. Get a clue and step up the urgency of service during lunch time.

I had injured my neck and was in real need of massage therapy right away (I could barely move my head).  I went to another place the day before and it was awful and I was still in pain.  I began looking online, but everyone requires an appointment so I decided to just go in to Lotus this morning to schedule an appointment and was surprised when she said they could do my massage right away.

It was truly a massage therapy, no wishy-washy super light touch "fake" type of massage.  My therapist was the perfect combination of medium pressure to harder pressure (but not overwhelming to the point you can't breathe), and only in the most necessary spots.  

I look for 3 main things in a massage business; (1) Ambiance, (2) Great massage, and (3) No talking from my therapist.  This place has it all.  It is clean, quiet, great lighting (very soothing), nice, gentle music, beautiful decor, and has individual rooms for the massage.  Now, there is a little bit of a language barrier, hence why there's no talking....love that! And it only got a 4 star because their credit card machine was broken, so I had to go back home and get cash, but not a huge ordeal.

They used hot stones, warm oils and a true "full body" massage that leaves you light-headed and super relaxed at the end.  My therapist was so sweet and she did an excellent job.  After I was done, I could turn my head left to right with no pain!  I HIGHLY recommend them, just call first if you aren't going to pay in cash (no checks either).

The only thing missing from this park is more shade.  Otherwise it's pretty awesome. It has a water play area that isn't too intimidating with only big water dumps but smaller sprinklers too. There is a little kids area, a rock climbing area, a preschooler area with a pirate theme that focuses on balance, climbing and running.  There are multiple swing sets and a gigantic lawn to run on.
Really great food complemented with excellent service.  Definitely coming back for seconds. Perfect place to go before or after a movie.

***three star casual/classy dining***
Seems to be going downhill. I went there when they opened,  frequented them often and they had been superb! The food was awesome and service was impeccable. Now, not so much. Their pork sliders got fatty and tough spots; also more spicy- not necessary to change a good thing. The sushi is so huge you need a gorilla mouth to eat a piece, and the nori is so chewy you think it was bubble gum. Ok...so the food is going downhill in quality..but service too? Dont make a mention; they're above that and you must be an uncultured swine to not know uber high quality food has unique flavor and textures- as well as prices. They'll charge you as they please for the wine, though you specifically ordered the $6.50 glass of cabernet not the $8.95 cabernet....then tell you that you that you remembered wrong: even though everyone at the table remembers exactly as you do! They will not back down! So, in short, sub par food and snooty servers. Maybe they'll read this and be humbled that while we are uncultured swine, we are tech savvy enough to tell others our experience!

Pretty good spot to get a sandwich. The best part about this place is that you can custom-order a sandwich without really having to talk to anybody. Just snag a bag, mark what you want on it, hand the bag across the counter, and pay.

The sandwiches themselves are alright, but some of the ingredients are sneakily oily (i'm looking at you, hot pepper mix). If you're in need of lunch and nothing but a sandwich will cut the mustard, this'll be alright. 

On occasion, the meats can be on the skimpy side, even if you indicate you want that bit doubled up. Overall, it's pretty alright.
Winco is by far the best grocery store for produce and meats. Not the best place for body soaps,  toothpaste and other personal products but for everything else it's a great place to shop.

We were super excited to try this restaurant but we were so disappointed! We ordered clam chowder (which we love) and waited for 15 minutes to get it....it basically tasted like baked potato soup. I had the Macadamia Nut Chicken.  It was very tender but the dish was so salty! I couldn't finish it. My Fiance had the Hawaiian Ribeye and asked for medium. It was chewy and overcooked. When the waitress asked us about it we let her know and she sent the manager over. He said "I heard there was a problem with your dish" we explained and he said "but it's tasty right?" We said the dish has flavor but it wasnt cooked right...and he said ok and walked away. Not accomodating at all. Especially for a 70 $ meal.

I'm so grateful to have finally found a mechanic I can trust!   With only a few European automotive specialist in the treasure valley and  a BMW and a Mercedes I needed someone I didn't have to wait weeks to get in with, or who wasn't going to do sub par work they had to correct regularly.  ken has been so helpful and has saved me money by not taking advantage of the situation where others tried.  German Star also has a couple of loaner cars that make the pain of a broken vehicle a little less.
Amazing food, large portions, creative menu choices (lemon poppy seed pancakes!), and great service! My personal favorite is the sausage breakfast burrito topped with country gravy! Yum!

First time to the Kona Grill and I was absolutely wowed! I had the delightful Macadamia Nut Chicken, the chicken was tender the sauces complimentary creating a flavor explosion. I also delighted in the mashed potatoes, they were an unexpected treasure and fit nicely with the chicken and green beans. My wife ordered the Pork Tenderloin it was cooked to perfection as I sampled this extensively. Our children both had the kids meals and I was impressed by the selection (many healthy and uncommon higher end selections, salmon) and the portion size. With two growing boys it was wonderful to have a restaurant where they had more options and enough to fill them up.

Nice mid-range hotel.  Has a good list of local food, a few of whom will deliver (although sadly, not Applebee's, as we found out the hard way).

Breakfast was a standard continental.

My wife and I purchased a Groupon on the 12th of January and had a delightful time that evening utilizing it to the max.  I felt we had a good value for the face value of the Groupon.  I had a sushi roll, #22 I believe and it was just fine, very fresh as well.  My wife had another dish that she enjoyed and we took yet another combination home.  Yes, we will be back and will try the "Express" site next door another time.
Best place in the Treasure Valley to shop, hang out, have fun and enjoy great food.

Well what can I say, I have lived in the area for only two months and was super excited to go here.  My family and I are pretty good at making out minds up about what we want, but we didn't know what we were in for here.  We sat got our drinks, waited about 10-15 mins for the waiter to come back and take our orders. He does and then the wait begins, I start to get a little upset then I notice people who have been seated AFTER us have gotten their food and we had not.....but we keep waiting....finally someone checks on us and asks is everything okay, I said no because those same people who were sat after us have now paid their check and are leaving I see 5-6 groups who were seated AFTER us come and go before they even bring my 4 year old his burger (10 mins after another server said they would get it about an hour+ after we originally orderes) Everyone keeps saying to us some cook walked out and they would give us free dessert and discount the check.  FINALLY the food comes out, I ordered pollo de fuego comes on a skillet.....I make a wrap take a bite....cold.  I take the protective cover off the skillet and pick it up cold...HOW LONG WAS MY MEAL SITTING THERE WAITING?!  I know I was waiting WELL over an hour.  The entire meal was comped and the excuse was one of the cooks walked out and they were short handed.  How did 5-6 other groups get their food before me and my family?! How come after waiting over an hour my food came out cold?  How exactly is it that ONE cook walks out on New Years Eve and the other two cannot handle the workload?  Did this entire food establishment rely solely on this one cook? 

Worst part, I was really looking forward to eating here because I spent 6 years working the kitchen at a similar restaurant in Virginia.  However, after this terrible experience I will NEVER go in this place again and I will tell everyone I meet that asks where to go eat in Meridian, I will tell then where not to go and that is Cafe Ole.

Very friendly and knowledgable group of people!  My girlfriend set and appointment here and they have been absolutely amazing!  Gave the time to answer al her questions and provide so many options.

Even on her first appointment we had to leave early to take kiddo to the ER (unrelated incident) and they were completely okay with it, they didn't even charge a cancelation fee.  

These people are amazing and I can't wait to schedule an appointment of my own!

We are new to the area and are so thankful we found this park! Our 18 month old has a blast every time we come here; we love it more than other parks because there are more options for toddlers. It is always clean, and full of families enjoying their time together. It can be a bit crowded on the weekends, especially if there are soccer or flag football games going on in the fields next to the park. All in all, I highly recommend Settlers Park to any mom looking for a safe, clean and fun place for your children to play!
Terrible service, poorly made salads, orders came out wrong, missing ingredients, no hostesses available, no timely check in by services. The food was not fresh at all.

Atmosphere is amazing. The People are cool. If I had ordered something else my review may have been different. As it is, I ordered chicken strips. I asked if they were fresh and they weren't! What?! Why??? Use fresh ingredients, people! Couldn't finish the fries. Just not good. Also didn't finish the chicken strips.  Underwhelmed over all. Hoping their meatball sandwich and pizza is better.
A hidden Eagle jewel; wonderful breakfast, great service!
We enjoyed breakfast. We left full and happy. The cupcake latte was a great treat! Pancakes were delicious!

The food has always been mediocre. The customer service experiences I have received my past few times in have been fairly poor. Wait time on food is long. We waited 40 minutes for our appetizers alone. Decent restaurant, it's not a personal favorite of restaurants in the village.

Wowww! Best BBQ around! Tried the brisket, pulled pork, and jalapeno sausage...amazing! The sauces just added to it all! Also, best potato salad I've never had! Loved the BBQ beans and the Mac n cheese. It's a must try!

We really enjoyed it. We just had hot dogs, so it was nothing particularly special. I had the Firecracker I believe it was called. And it was great. The kids had more basic hot dogs, and everybody enjoyed their. The quality of the meat was good. Service was average speed. We will go back.

We had breakfast at Joe Momma's yesterday morning (1/26/18). When we arrived there were two people waiting for a table/booth - we put in our name and were told it would be about ten minutes. I was kind of surprised since I could see one table and one booth open (and I couldn't see the entire dining area). After about ten minutes we were seated in the booth that I saw was open from the very beginning - hmmm...?

Anyway, after we were seated everything went smoothly - the service was excellent, the food very good, the atmosphere was comforting. I had French toast, my wife had a ham and cheddar two egg omelet which she declared to be fabulous (loved the ham). We also had a side of bacon and, although it was one the crispy side, was very tasty.

We are always looking for new breakfast experiences and it was nice to add Joe Momma's to our list. All restaurants have their own special character - that which sets them apart from the others - Joe Momma's, at least for us, was simply good food, good service and a warm ambiance.

Can't go wrong with pizza and salad. The food was good, ordered the smokey with a ceaser salad, wish it had more red sauce to make it excellent. I tried asking my server for more sauce but had to wait a while because they didn't check back on us after delivering our food, except to offer us a box. There were only 2 other tables and another server had those. Really disappointing all together. After I got the sauce the pizza was much better. I just wish we had better service, as it would have really made a difference
Great place to shop, eat and bring the kids. Very clean, elegant and relaxing outdoor mall. Great events on the weekends.

Been a customer there for a number of years. When they first opened, their processes left a lot to be desired. Over the years they have continuously improved in all areas. Only reason I'm not giving 5 stars is I think there's still room for improvement in continuity of care across different doctors, and there's still quite a bit of employee turnover with the techs and reception staff which can be frustrating at times. But I will say they've made big improvements in these areas too. The rest of my frustrations and gripes are probably all the same at any other vet facility. Another thing i like about all Valley is they have very flexible hours and a relatively fair cost structure around those hours.  The boarding facility has 24x7 drop off and pick up and they are very fair about how they apply their boarding charges too.

Excellent... food, service, & decor! Found this through yelp and was not disappointed. The garlic potatoes are amazing, highly recommend getting them for a side. Hubby had loaded fries and he loved them. I had the pulled pork sandwich and it was delicious. Would eat here again.

The restaurant is nice and clean, and the lady behind the counter was very friendly.  I love brisket, so I tried the sliced brisket sandwich with fries. The fries were very good, but the brisket was just ok. The biggest problem was that the brisket was cut with the grain, instead of across the grain.  One piece was almost 1/2 inch thick and even though it was cooked about right, without being cut across the grain, it made for a chewy sandwich. There was a good bark, but not a lot of smoke flavor in the meat. The liquid smoke in the sauce overpowered the meat. 
My wife had the mac and cheese, and it was pretty weak with small elbow noodles and a thin cheese sauce. 
We went for lunch and we were the only people in the place. Maybe we caught them on a bad day.

The staff at Christian Brothers went far beyond excellent customer service in handling our vehicle's mechanical issues and our comfort during a cross-country trip in our camper/van. The Meridian shop deserves the highest rating possible for the help they gave me, my partner, and our traveling cat and dog! From our experience I can attest to that fact that Christian Brothers does things VERY differently from a customer service perspective; their staff was kind, communicative, honest, and increasingly helpful and concerned with our situation while doing without our home during repairs. It was not the type of treatment that folks have come to expect from mechanic shops... how refreshing. If you want to know the specifics, read on...
Our Ford cargo van was suffering from a lack of power (driving from Chicago to California!) so we stopped in Boise to diagnose the problem, and went to Christian Brothers per the recommendation of my uncle, who had been impressed with their work in the past. The shop diagnosed a transmission problem based on burnt-smelling fluid and the power issues we described. They tracked down a rebuilt transmission and quoted us a reasonable price for the parts and labor, so we decided to go ahead with a replacement. 
Several days later the new transmission was installed, but it didn't solve the problem... it drove as badly as before! To complicate matters, we live inside of this van, so at this point the service manager Dave became very involved in assuring our comfort while they tried to get another transmission shipped, assuming the first was defective in some way. The arranged and paid for us to stay in a nearby RV park for several days, and got creative by having our original transmission rebuilt by a local shop. 
On the day of the second surgery, the shop got us a rental car so that we could cruise around with our pets and stay cool (this was July in Boise) while the work was completed. The transmission was replaced (again!) but still something was wrong. The shop staff immediately began searching for a hotel to lodge us in for the weekend and gave us a gift card for dinner at a local pizza restaurant... and it was finally at this point that Dave discovered the real culprit: a clogged catalytic converter. Not the transmission all along.
Because the van's issue was misdiagnosed, we didn't have to pay anything for our rebuilt transmission. On Monday, we checked out of our free hotel, got into our (fixed) van, and finally left Boise after 2 weeks of wondering what would happen next. In the end, the amount we paid was far less than what Christian Brothers spent to lodge us, feed us, and fix our vehicle. I am so grateful for the exceptional treatment we received.

I love Love LOVE this place. I am a big fan of sourdough bread and this place has the best. Karen usually remembers my name. Sometimes she calls me my sisters name because me and my whole family come and it's understandable :) my husband gets the sourdough because of all the meat. I like to get the turkey. And get the spread on it. It is DELICIOUS. best sandwiches in town for sure.

I am updating my review in response to the owners reply to my initial review review. In his reply he mentions that he has reached out but is has not been given the opportunity to contact the real person. I am the real person. He reached out to me accusing me of not knowing the real shop I took the car too because he couldn't find my name in his records nor could they recollect any issues like I described. The records were in my fiance's name even though this is our car. I paid for the repairs, I spoke to Mike regarding the repairs and my name is on emails regarding the repairs. Since my last review, however, it has come to my attention by another repair shop that the repairs done by Meridian Automotive we're not satisfactory. Not only do I feel I was overcharged, but the work they did hasn't corrected the problem and in fact appears to not have been done accurately. I appreciate trying to stick up for your business, but bad practices, overcharging, and wrongful statements seem to be a normal occurrence here. Assuming another repair shop has lower rates because they cut corners is a gross assumption.

Love the service....not fast but ALWAYS friendly...however, we were creeped out by what was going on.  "Owners" were there and that was all good...until one guy got romantic with a lady friend and proceeded to join her in the ladies room.  Not sure what went on...not really comfortable with using the restroom.  Felt bad for the bar tender because he is a big reason we go there for date night.  Bottom line that is not what I want ant to see if when out on a date.

On a drive from Denver to Portland, we decided to stop in Meridian for the night. While we've done this drive a few times, this time it was to move, so our vehicles were too packed to drive out and get something to eat, once we stopped for the night. Reviewing the places that would deliver, this looked the best, due to the wide menu of delicious-sounding food. 

At about 8 I called in the order. Explained that we were at a hotel, which they were familiar enough with that they had the address already. I gave them the room number, then provided my mobile number (twice), in case of issues. Now, I used to travel for a living, and have had a few mishaps with food being delivered to hotels, so I also called down to the front desk so they knew who I was and where I was ordering food from. No problem; I would have a medium pizza, Napoli salad, creme brûlée, and beverages in 45 minutes, an hour tops. 

An hour and twenty minutes later, I called to make sure everything was still going to go down like we planned. I was hungry. I was waiting for food. And what I was told was that, wouldn't you know it, they had the wrong room number. They TRIED to deliver it, but there was no answer at the door they had, and there was no way to reach me. Funny thing, that, having given them my number, my room number, and informed the desk. They could have asked them, or shown them the receipt with my name on it, and they could have surely found SOME way to contact me. But, no, tragically, nothing could be done. They sure we're glad I called though, and they'd get me my order right away. 

Fast-forward to 10:20. Over two hours since I made my order. Twenty minutes since they closed. We gave up, and we're going to eat road snacks for dinner. I was going to the car, and in the lobby ran into the delivery guy. I showed him my room key card and let him know the food he had was for me. I showed great restraint, but to be fair, I was probably just fatigued from lack of sustenance. 

So, that was the lousy service then. On to the food!

The Napoli salad was fine. It was a salad. There was supposed to be penne pasta on it, according to the menu, and there wasn't. There was some pita bread though, and an additional item that was described to me as a "flat cracker thing, like pita bread, but crispy and hot." It was apparently pretty good. 

The pizza was leathery. Turns out that they thought, hell, just because we screwed up this order and waited all this time, the food is still good! They took my original pizza that they tried to deliver to someone else and then took back to the shop where it sat around a while and just ran it through the oven again. It was overdone, tough, cheese was not the least bit melty or stringy. It was a little gross, and made worse knowing that it was old food they couldn't be bothered to re-make after having screwed up once. 

This whole "just give them the shit we didn't deliver last time" strategy did explain why there was no ice in the iced tea though, and it tasted so watered down. 

And the creme brûlée...one of my favorite desserts. I wish I hadn't ordered it. It made me sad for all creme brûlée kind. It seems that fate conspired against it. For one thing, presentation counts in a creme brûlée. But, unable to find cheap class ramekin or whatever, even at the price they charge, when one orders a creme brûlée to be delivered this means you are ordering a creme brûlée to be sort of scraped into a plastic bowl with a lid. There it spent the two-hour delay waiting, losing the balance of a chilled custard with a hot caramelized crust to become room temperature all over, and begun to separate. Looked like what you might find if pigeons developed outhouse technology. Tasted like vanilla jello pudding poured over 4 blackberries. Only found a little of the crust, which, having been poured into the plastic bowl, mostly collected into these two half-caramel lumps. Didn't bother finishing it. 

All told, I wish the entire experience with this place never happened, and cannot forget it soon enough.
Good customer service. Decent coffee, messed up order twice but fixed it both times. Espresso sometimes tastes burnt but I think that's just the bean they use. Overall good
Great service and the food was awesome. Maybe the best pancake we've ever had. If they have the cheesy hash browns you should get that too.
I've been multiple times. The service is always fabulous, but every time I go I tell myself not to go back  unfortunately the great service doesn't make up for the fact that the food is subpar.

I frequent the coffee shop next to Big Daddy's BBQ and am always tempted by the wonderful smell of smoke and BBQ permeating the air! After weeks of being greeted by the early morning scent of coffee and BBQ, I finally talked my family in to dinner at Big Daddy's last Saturday.
It was early...about 4:45 and we were the first diners to be seated. The hostess was really friendly, handed us our menus, told us the specials and went to greet more folks.
Our waitress came over directly, reiterated the specials, took our appetizer and drink orders then left us to decide on entrees. 

Our appetizer, Tater Pigs were quite tasty! Fried perfectly crispy, they didn't disappoint the taste buds. The jalapeño ranch dipping sauce however, had no detectable heat and tasted like plain and simple ranch dressing. Everyone likes ranch though, right?

The four of us ordered prime rib, two racks of ribs and a pulled pork meat plate. Sides were garlic smashed potatoes, mac n' cheese, coleslaw, fries and asparagus. The asparagus was one of the specials that evening. It was delightful, perfectly cooked and seasoned! The coleslaw and fries were good, no leftovers. The mac and cheese had overcooked noodles and so much sauce the teens wouldn't eat it. The garlic smashed potatoes had great flavor but rather than being smashed, which I envision having lumps and bumps, were overworked and more like wallpaper paste. Albeit very tasty wall paper paste!
The meats were seasoned wonderfully. The ribs had a thick glaze of gooey sauce and they melted in your mouth. The pulled pork also had great flavor but was a touch dry. My prime rib had excellent flavor but was over cooked for my taste. It WAS the end piece, however. I prefer medium rare but it didn't dawn on me until I ate several bites that I wasn't given an option for the cook and it was early enough that I was probably served the first piece of the evening. In hind sight, I should have requested a center piece cooked medium rare and I do wish our server would have asked my preference. Perhaps she was new at this? 
Our ticket for four plus tip ran right at $100. I'm pretty sure we will give Big Daddy's another go....they could use a little attention to detail but are definitely on the right track!

My experience with Twigs was not good.  Host was not to be found when entering the restaurant, all well managed restaurants would not allow this to occur.  The wait staff was pleasant and service was good, but that does not make up for the food.  The salad and food mediocre at best.  My salad, citrus chicken with cashews was too sweet, and the cashews were burned.  No dressing on salad, and rather dull in flavor if one can get past the terrible chicken which I pushed to the side and avoided after one bite. I will not go back. I have experienced better salads at fast food restaurants.   I have eaten many excellent salads but this was a poor excuse for one. The turkey bacon wrap and fries were flat in flavor and dry and the fries had too much pepper,  For someone that likes spice and seasoning, I wondered if the owners ever eat what they serve their customers.

Love this place! My wife is from Spokane and got so excited when she saw they were coming to Meridian. I didn't think a sandwich place would live up to the hype but it sure did! Bread was delicious, steak and cheese was perfect. Fries delicious! Owners were friendly and super nice. Be patient with the new folks training! It's worth it!

I love the Gyro Shack and are so excited they are now in Meridian.  The food is tasty and always consistent in what you get.  We also like that they have kids meals, but wish they would make a small gyro for kids in a kiddie meal since our boys love gyros.  Great service and they are very fast!

We decided to try them again, my wife likes the sandwiches here. She ordered this Italian beef sandwich, kind of like a French dip and oh man...it is actually really good. The person that helped us was very kind and helpful as well. I am improving my rating after this last visit.

Do you like pretentious douche bags, overpriced crap, mediocre food, and miserable parking? Well, then...The Village should be right up your alley. Listening to the locals go on and on about what a wonderful 'experience' the location represents makes me more ill than the prices in the store there. I can't help but wonder what the place will degenerate into during the next recession and the high end retailers pull out of the location.

Outstanding food!!! We have come back multiple times and love it every time! The service is great and the food is the best Bosnian I have ever  had. It takes a little longer to get your food, yes, but it is worth it. I mention that because it is not a quick half hour lunch place . Everyone should visit this amazing place!

REALLY GOOD FOOD!

Atmosphere is fantastic and food is out of this world.

Will come here again and again.

Stellar service! We had to seat ourselves but our waitress was so nice and always checked on us whenever our drinks were near empty or to take away our empty plates. I had their dragon roll sushi and OMG IT WAS SO DELICIOUS! I love this restaurant and can't wait to come back!

This place gets so packed especially on Fridays so having a reservations by phone is awesome! I've been here a couple of times but I'm gonna do review based on tonight! So we came 15 minutes early & surprisingly we were able to get a table as soon as we got in so that was sweet! We got a free appetizer, thanks Yelp which was good, the chicken & shrimp lettuce wraps. Sashimi was yum according to my expert hubs & the Hawaiian steak was good as well. Overall, food was great. We also had a sweet & smiling server!

I can't recommend this shop enough! Took my dirk bike in for an issue with stalling/low power. It turned out to be a very minor issue that was easily corrected. They would not charge me! I'd have gladly paid for the service but they felt like it was so minor that they shouldn't charge me. When does that happen???
Everything we've had here has been amazing! The staff is super friendly and always look like they're working and enjoying it! You won't be disappointed!
Sofra is excellent. The food is delicious and the restaurant is very clean. Staff is super friendly. Sofra has turned into one of our favorite restaurants!
Bombtastic. Cha yor and tofu pad Thai are seriously delicious as is the green curry.  The staff is incredibly friendly and professional.

I've gone to Varsity many times. I loved going for the dueling pianos. However, the service and staff is horrible. The bartender/ servers were rude and treat you like you're a bother. I finally found another dueling piano bar in the area that is an awesome time! The service is great and the people are nice. I don't go to Varsity anymore, which is a shame because it could be a great place.
I use to love Kona, until they changed their menu. Their fish use to be fresh and red, now it's not fresh at all. Their portions are so small for the price you pay. Probably won't be back here again.

The restaurant is very clean and simple, and the staff was very friendly and considerate. I tried the Beef Sharwarma sandwich, which comes with fries and hummus at the side. The sandwich was gigantic! I only finished half it and had the other half to-go. In addition, the fries was seasoned perfectly and are a little salty, which suits my taste. I would definitely come back here again since the food here is delicious and inexpensive.

My 4th visit in, 2 of which were Italian soda orders only. My first visit I had an Italian soda and the veggie wrap, the veggie wrap was disgusting and there was something hard in it that left such a bad impression that I returned the next two times only for the Italian soda for fear of trying anything else. I work nearby and decided to give it a go again and got the Albuquerque wrap and tomato soup. The tomato soup was good wrap was much better too. I waited to give the review because I like to give places the benefit of the doubt the disappointment this trip was they asked me with my wrap if I wanted chips or potatoes salad I opted for the potato salad and received neither one. I was already back at work and my lunch break over before I noticed so overall I would say between the 4 visits it's worthy of a 3....maybe the experiences might be better if you stay there and eat as I went through the drive through each time?

Best toddy coffee (cold brewed Kona blend).  Love their smoothies and especially love their breakfast burritos.  Just wish that they would have more staff on busy mornings.  But, it is worth waiting for.

This one has it all: great service, inviting atmosphere, and and delicious food!! The menu offers multiple levels of spice with a variety of unique side options like sweet potatoes and succotash. The sushi bar is top of the line. Garrett, our regular server, is knowledgeable and attentive! This our favorite, by far. Even picky eaters can find something traditional to eat like sliders and pasta.
My favorite place to eat a sub in town. The sandwiches are fantastic! Never had a single complaint. It's always prepared right and always delicious.

Homemade phyllo dough is nearly unheard of today, so to learn that a local restaurant makes its own daily, I figured that was a great reason on its own to visit Sofra Bosnian Grill.

It's a bit hidden on East Overland Road, just east of Eagle Road. Look for Zamzow's on the north side. Sofra is in a strip mall directly across on the south side of Overland.

I ordered the burkek, a sort of ground beef pie with onions. But instead of looking like a pot pie, the filling was rolled inside a sheet of phyllo curled like a rope. The presentation was beautiful.

That meant I got a bite of phyllo and the meat mixture in every bite. It was a very good dish. 

I also ordered breadsticks so I could taste the ajvar dip, a Bosnian roasted red pepper sauce. It was excellent with the bread and also with the burek.

The family that runs the restaurant is very nice and pleased to share food from their homeland. It's a great addition to the Meridian food scene.

My family and I had a quick dinner at this new eatery. First impression, the staff was very welcoming, restaurant was clean, and the menu was visually appealing : ) .  We ordered the noodle soup (similar to Pho), waffle sandwich combo (pastrami w/ pepper jack cheese), garlic parmesan fries, thai tea, & lychee milk tea. The noodle soup was a good portion and had a great flavor. Initially the server offered me spices for the soup, but found out I was able to get the bean sprouts, basil, & lime. Waffle sandwich - waffle good, pastrami good, pepper jack cheese good, but together as a sandwich it was okay. The waffle was light, buttery, and very flakey. The pastrami & cheese combo was delicious, but I think the flavors all together didn't mesh well. The garlic parmesan fries were delicious - perfectly cooked and well seasoned. I'm a thai tea addict and I enjoyed it from here - well priced and proportioned : ). My family and I will be back to try more items. Welcome to the neighborhood!

Improvements
- provide all of the condiments for the noodle soup immediately
- make some changes to the pastrami & cheese waffle sandwich
Excellent gyros. Tons of meat and all the fixings. Good prices and sign up for free gyros on the website. With every 5 you buy, you get one free.

Disappointed in the food. I ordered a combination plate. Each item was either bland or too salty. Tamale sauce tasted like spaghetti o's. Chimichanga wasn't crisp. Margaritas were weak. Only redeeming quality was our server being attentive. Wouldn't recomend.

Being from Texas, I'm always weary of BBQ in Idaho. But this place had fantastic brisket (a true testament in my book). I had mac n cheese and beans for my sides. They both had a TON of flavor (the beans were really peppery, which I loved, but might not be someone's cup of tea). My husband and I were really satisfied and the food and service were great. We will be back!

Plus, white bread served with BBQ is just natural where I come from, thanks for the added touch!

Went for happy hour to try out their martinis, I had a dirty gin martini which I really enjoyed. My wife got the Bellini martini - which was too sweet for her. We shared the Fig flatbread which was amazing, we'd definitely go back and order that again. The server was very attentive and polite, it was a great experience!

I have always been a fan of the mall location and never been disappointed in Cafe Ole and was excited when this location opened up.  However, I think I am going to have to go back to the Ram next door for happy hours. The service is atrocious, and the one bartender/server is extremely rude and is obvious about disliking the public. She needs to be reminded that she is in the service industry. Each time I go in I have to ask for happy hour drinks, and this afternoon we waited for 15 minutes to even be greeted although it was not busy, and there were 2 servers working the bar as well as the bartender. Thank you's were not acknowledged and food was dropped off in passing. Food quality is mediocre at best. So sad because I used to go out of my way to eat at the mall location, but this may have me soured. Judging by all of the other reviews, cafe ole needs to step up its game before it goes by the wayside as the downtown location just closed this week. Seems like this would be a good opportunity to shuffle some staff who enjoy coming to work and takes pride in their product.
Excellent family-style Bosnian food. The sarma, cevapci and mixed grill were wonderful. As good as the food was, the service was even better. We felt very welcome and will be back soon.

Wow!! What a great experience. Tony and his wife have done a great job bringing something fun, unique and delicious to the area!! We had the noodle soup, and a brisket sandwich with Thai Tea and a Strawberry milk boba tea! Everything was delicious. The waffle sandwich was so good, flakey and light and you could taste all the goodies on it! The noodle soups was flavorful and HUGE! Tony and his wife are personable and great to chat with. We will be back for sure! Make sure you check it out.

I was seriously skeptical about getting my haircut here because I usually get my haircut at Fantastic Sam's. I went in thinking "well whatever happens, happens" I sat down and waited. (The salon is seriously crowded) and when I got my haircut I was shocked about how good I look. However, I got a design but it isn't that noticeable. I would go again though.

this place is amazing!  the restaurant is beautiful, atmosphere great, food to die for!  i highly recommend the butter cake or the creme brulee for dessert!  you will not be disappointed!  a little pricey but my boyfriend and i like it for certain occasions.  you are definitely paying for the quality

I will stay here again if needed. The staff was very friendly, the room was clean, comfy and up to date. The shower was awesome - double shower head! 

Check in is 3pm but my flight arrived at noon - I called and asked if they had any rooms open yet for me to check in (I knew the hotel was booked up so didn't expect a yes) and they said yes they had a room on the second floor! 

Breakfast was just okay. Cereal, muffins, fruit, etc. No eggs/bacon etc, but they did have a waffle maker and hard boiled eggs which were yummy! The dining area is big, the lobby has lounge chairs and a little fireplace. Indoor pool and hot tub. 

The surround in area isn't great if you're wanting to walk to food, unless you want subway or gas station food. But if you have a car there is a great shopping center called The Village.

Ate here twice in the last week, small, friendly 'mom & pop' place. Super clean, fast service and extremely tasty Q!. I've had my usual sliced brisket/pulled pork plate both times, brisket was perfect (nice smoke, tender), pulled pork was a little dry the second time (fine the first time!).

Sides I tried were bbq beans (good, but I wish they had some brisket scraps in them....) and the smashed red garlic potatoes (excellent!). 

Going to try another place today, but I'll definitely be back here before I leave Idaho :)

Super slow service it took 30 minutes to get our food at a fast casual place. There was only 4 tables with people. The staff wasn't very helpful and didn't seem to care much about us waiting. We ended up having to get the food to go since they were so slow. 

Need to step up the service big time. My first and last time to visit Bonos

I am extremely picky with my restaurant choices. I would confidently say this would be my number one choice for breakfast. Everytime we eat breakfast there we leave overly satisfied. The food is perfectly scrumptious, the hot cakes are to die for.  Great service! I would recommend this to the pickiest foodies.

A little bit expensive. But overall good experience. Our server corissa went out of her way to make sure we were taken care of after the kitchen messed up my girlfriends order. For this reason alone I will be back.

Clean, new, comfortable, friendly staff.  Definitely get your moneys worth.  The only reason I'm not giving 5 stars is because the breakfast food was pretty gross, but its hotel free breakfast...it is what it is.  Otherwise, its a great location and very affordable.

First time here. The service was great and the pizza was yummy. Drinks were refilled before asking, extras like dressing were brought quickly. My 6yo loved the spaghetti. I think it deserves a better overall star rating.

Today was my first visit at Gloss Nail Studio, and it won't be my last! Christian did a perfect job on my nails! She was so nice and friendly  The shop is beautifully decorated and very clean. I'm so happy I found this nail studio. If you're looking for a great place to have your nails done,look no further, this is the place!

Terrible service, overpriced hourly rate and dishonest practice...that sums it up!
I had them to my vehicle towed their shop after they told me my insurance would cover the cost of towing. If I would have gone through my insurance instead of Meridian Auto the insurance would have covered it but they did not so I was billed $96, and that's just the start. They charged me almost $2,000 for a project that was quoted, afterwards, by another shop at around $800 total. They also build me $190 "diagnose" an issue that another shop diagnosed and fixed for less. I will NEVER take another  vehicle to these guys, EVER!

Food just ok.   More of Idaho Chinese Food.  The food all comes on dry store bought thin crispy noodles.  We will keep looking for ...  The owner is awesome and she worked very hard to please my family; even having us try other dishes for free.  She buys fresh each day. Since others like it.  I wish this place well.

When we moved here 12 years ago, the Cafe Ole' on Milwaukee was our Go To Mexican Place.  When they opened one in Meridian we didn't think it was as good.  Then it got better & we went there exclusively.  But our last couple times, the food was just not great.  We usually go for lunch & I like the Grande Burrito or something like that.  The last one was a gummy tortilla & just not good.  Husband thinks they used to serve 3 street tacos & were now bringing him 2.  Looking for a new place....  last time we had a Margarita there it had no kick to it.  We brought our new neighbors & I don't think they ever went back either.

I have been here twice both times getting the sushi and loved it. The peppered tuna the sunshine roll the lobster and shrimp were all really good and we also had the chef make a special one that also turned out delicious. I keep coming in the winter I would love to sit out on the patio in the summer watching the synchronized water fountain display in the village.

Love this place!! We don't have this in CA but I can tell you that any time I go to any state that has a Jimmy Johns, I always bring some home on the plane with me. My favorite is the #3 which is the tuna. I love tuna but it's hard to find places that make it perfect where its not too dry and doesn't have too much mayo. They also put cucumbers and alfalfa sprouts (i know it doesn't sound good but in this sandwich it is!) and I add hot peppers! DELISH!!! My second fav is the #9 which is the Italian. The bread they use is good and i also add hot peppers to this one too. I'm a big fan of this place and they are always fast!

I've used All Valley since my 3 year old was a baby. I thought it would be a good idea to use a clinic that was open 24/7 in case of emergency. I had my girl spayed and all routine exams and immunizations performed here. I have never seen the same vet or the same front end help in all my visits, so therefore I never have felt like an established client. No one makes you feel like you are anything but one out of thousands they treat. This last week I unfortunately ended up using the emergency services for my ill dog. After taking her in twice in a 3 day period and she still wasn't getting better I opted to try another vet closer to home. Let me just say WOW what a difference! At All Valley neither vet ever touched my dog other than listening to her heartbeat. No physical exam was done they just suggested tests ($$) and prescribed meds (more $$) I spent a lot of money for them to "guess" what might be wrong.  May I suggest that a really good vet listens to the pet parent then thoroughly physically exams the dog! Amazing! Obviously All Valley has become a money making machine, no personal touch there! Needless to say I won't be going back and I recommend everyone check out a "real" vet and make informed decisions when seeking great care for your best friends!

great customer service
great smoked food
cold beer
what the f&&ck else do you need or want??

One of the most uninspired club sandwiches I've had. Very basic, very plain. Banana cream pie wasn't much better. The crust reminded me of a crisp cookie that got soft from moisture. Waiting staff was great

Family of four, we visited on a Friday evening.  Restaurant was about 1/3-1/2 full.  Wait staff was nice, drinks are a little overpriced. Most of our food was ok, nothing amazing but also not bad, except for my steak salad - the meat was cooked already cut into chunks so it was overdone and unseasoned/tasteless. Menu prices are high for what you get. Too many other choices at the Village so we won't be back.

Great food!!! Seriously. I had The Heater and was impressed. I will definitely be back to try more items. The only reason for 4 stars (instead of 5) was the service. They need more servers! At the lunch rush they only had 2 servers, which is impossible to handle even though it is a smallish establishment. I do sincerely hope they can grow into a larger place at some point to meet the demand--it seems as though it's a very popular place:)
Tried Kona Grill once more and still not for me. They took off the only thing that was good on the menu, their version of a bang bang shrimp. sushi is mediocre. rather spend my money else where

Ive been buying Lululemon items for many many years. I know I have enough Lululemon workout outfits to last me a month without doing any laundry! That's how much I love Lululemon items!! They stand by their products. Sure it's expensive but it's worth it. They also offer free alterations if you need them whether you buy it from their store or from online. My husband even loves all of the workout tank tops that I pick for him. Keep up the good work!

I ordered a Tall Soy Flat White , but it looked more like a dry cappuccino . So much foam! Not the first time either. Unfortunately, it's a hit or miss location. Some days their coffee is textbook & delicious, other days, not so much.

The food is what you expect at any Panda Express. If this location is busy be prepared to wait in line. I noticed that even those who had ordered online were spending time waiting. I'm thinking my one and only visit this last weekend was simply a bad time to have walked in. Will have to give it another try.

I take my car to the local dealer's service center, and they find a problem totally independent of the reason I took it in, and give me a quote to fix.  Good -- they're looking out for me!  I would, however, like to try out my dad's favorite garage, so yesterday I take the car to Meridian Auto.  I document everything the dealer told me, and ask them to give me a quote on fixing the problem.  

Near the end of the day, I get a call on my cell.  "We checked the area you pointed out, as well as all over the car that would be even remotely related to the problem described.  Your car's in great shape -- no service is necessary, so you're free to go, Mr. F.  We hope we can help you out next time."  

Honesty and integrity -- Meridian Auto is in the business for the long haul.

This place is nothing fancy so if you're looking for the full on day spa atmosphere then you need to go elsewhere. It's pretty bare bones but if you're just in need of a good massage then that shouldn't be an issue. It's clean, the staff is nice and the prices are reasonable. They offer a new customer special for a 1 hour massage for $39!! My masseuse was really excellent and the overall experience was very relaxing!

I am so disappointed in this location. Anthony Williams ( manager ) approached me as an artist to offer the use of their space for my Mommy and Me paint parties. The idea was to build business for them as well as give me a location for my parties. I was never told that there was a minimum requirement occupancy to make it happen. Tonight my 15 to 18 party guests were turned away because Anthony felt that this wasn't a big enough party to Warrant his time and energy. He cancelled my party and left... I had guests just arriving waiting at the door when I got there saying they were told it was cancelled and the place was closed. This is terrible management and it made a huge dent in my business... Remember you came to me I didn't come to you. This could have been 15 extra meals as I had people coming all the way from Nampa to attend including a birthday party.... All of which were turned away at the door. I will never step foot in the soda stop again thank you.

Brought my S-Class into these guys to have the PSE Pump programmed. They were quick and charged a reasonable price to do it, one company in Nampa charges double the price and would have taken 3 hours compared to the 30 mins they took. They were friendly and didn't try to give me the run around on price or tried to get me to fix a bunch of things like the dealership. Definitely bringing my Benz back for other things that need worked on! Would definitely recommend!

Food ok service terrible it was really slow we were in the bar and the Waitress had friends at the bar she was talking to and not paying attention to us.   Waitress Jess never came back around to ask is for more drinks or chips or anything.

Just went there with my wife. She got the cranberry walnut short-stack and hot chocolate. I got the chorizo hash with a biscuit and hot apple cider (with whipped cream and caramel sauce!). The food was lovely and there was tons of it. My wife ended up eating one half of one pancake, taking the rest home in a box. The hash was a perfect blend of savory and spicy, with enough burn to notice but not enough to make it unpleasant. The hot apple cider was divine. The only (small) blemish was my wife's hot chocolate. Great whipped cream, but it was obviously just swiss miss mix. And not even evenly mixed - she kept getting small chunks of powder. But that can be easily solved by getting the apple cider next time instead.

If they were open at night, I could see spending a *lot* of money here. As is, it will be a special treat for when I have time to get out during the day. All the thumbs up.
Great friendly service. Lobster mac & cheese was off the menu, but the chef still made it for our daughter. Thanks for a great dinner!

I absolutely love this place. The service (which makes a huge deal on my reviews) is always top notch. The martinis are my passion and everything I have ever ordered here has been delicious! A little expensive yes, but in my opinion you get what you pay for and this is WORTH it!

We really enjoyed our lunch here on a recent trip to Boise.  Our Server could not have been any better.  He had an awesome attitude and really seemed to care about our experience...kudos!

As for the food, all of us enjoyed our meals.  We started with a spicy salmon roll.  Very good. Husband really liked his Cuban with sweet potato fries.  Other likes were for the Shrimp Salad, and in my case for the Chicken Pad Thai.

Overall, this is a lovely, comfortable restaurant with good food and great service!
I love Jimmy Johns, and probably eat there twice a week on average. The portions seem like they are getting smaller, and I do wish they'd bring back sprouts...but I'll keep coming back anyways.

The place was way too loud, service was slow and when I got home the dipping juice lid was not put on tight ,spilled all over car and the food was not worth going back for. Much better places to go in Meridian that this place.
Went there yesterday for the first time for lunch, the street tacos are excellent, great atmosphere & service.  Great time!!!

I was predisposed not to like this restaurant. I'd read reviews that it wasn't very good, it looked expensive, and in general I'm wary of The Village.
They won me over.
Our server, Noah, was amazing. He kept our drinks filled, was attentive but not hovering, was gracious and quick. He's a keeper.
We sat on the patio, where we could watch the fountain and the people walking by. It was a hot day but under the misters and the shade, we were perfectly comfortable. It was a little noisy, so prepare to speak loudly to be heard.
The menu has a good variety of foods, and as a vegetarian I was happy to see lots of meatless options. Even the sushi had veggie items, which is rare.
I ordered the oriental salad, which was a massive pile of cabbage, onions, almonds, ramen crunchies, and sesame dressing. I didn't feel shorted at all, like I often do when I get a salad. It was filling, the vegetables were fresh, and it was a unique blend of flavors.
My dining partner got the goat cheese and sundried tomato flatbread, which was also delicious. It was crispy bread, a larger portion that I expected, with pesto, goat cheese, capers, and sundried tomato. The combination of flavors was original and bright. I'd order it again, or try another flatbread.
Prices were in line with everything else in The Village, and equivalent restaurants. The only added cost was the tip, because it needed to be huge to reward the great service we got.
Try it out. I think you'll like it.
I grew up in Chicago and was a weekly patron of Portillo's. I was hoping to capture that magic at Bono's. I found the menu to be more expensive and lower quality ingredients than what I experienced.
Love Lona happy hour. Coconut mojito for the win!! Can be difficult to get a table so arrive early. For regular dining it feels a little expensive for me. However the food is always good.

Dang. This place is good. My husband and I ordered appetizers/sides for our meal because everything looked so amazing, and it did not disappoint. We got the BBQ nachos, macaroni and cheese, brisket chili, and filled tots. I can't wait to come back and try more of the menu. 

The service was efficient and friendly, too.

I like this place because you can pig out (lobster mac and cheese, snickers ice cream pie) or eat clean and healthy (lettuce wraps, sushi), depending on your mood.  Happy Hour lasts until 7pm, and service is usually great -- especially Chris -- he's fast, super friendly, and knows the menu inside and out -- we now ask for him by name. He's also impossibly good looking, but whatever...  Then there are the DRINKS -- Coconut Mojito, Raspberry Ginger Lemonade, and the culturally sensitive Kamanawanalea... They're amazing and they get even better the drunker you get. (I guess that's true with everything.  OK now I feel like you're judging me.  Look at least I don't drink alone. Unless no one else is there).  Anyway just shut up and go there -- eat, drink, and ask for Chris.  You'll thank me.   (I don't know when you'll thank me because I feel like we hardly ever see each other any more.  Are you avoiding me? Be honest.)

We went to Kona to enjoy a glass of wine, sushi, and watching the water from the patio. We were disappointed to find the patio already closed, service was pretty good until we were done eating... had to wait quite some time to receive our bill and pay. Sushi and wine was good but small portions for both. The cheeseburger was super delish though and YUGE AND THICk.

Good selection of year 'round staples, as well as some tasty seasonal specialties.  If you like reds, the Iron Butt is great.  For a dark try their Silhouette.  If you're in the mood for something funky, Senor Jalapeacho may be right up your alley.  Initial Point for you IPA lovers.  And the Farmer's Daughter is a terrific farmhouse ale.  Always a nice selection of rotating taps to suit pretty much all tastes.  The tap room is small but not cramped, and additional patio seating is also available.  No food is served but you can usually find a food truck outside.  Slanted Rock also hosts a trivia night on Thursday's which is a fun group outing.  Bob and his staff are always friendly and make this a great place to enjoy some brews with your buddies.  If you're looking for some good local beer, stop in and give Slanted Rock a try.

Pretty cool place.

The interior is very well done, it is classy, cool and hip all in one shot. I love the outdoor seating. It is the best shaded outdoor seating in the village and provides a great view to watch the fountain. It is also a perfect view to watch your kids play on the playground while you enjoy your pre-dinner drinks. However beware, the patio here is open seating, meaning first come first serve. So it doesn't matter if you have been standing there for 30 min longer than the next group that walks up looking for a seat, it really comes down to who gets to the table first. 

As for the food I went with the Seven Spice Ahi Salad. It was quite refreshing as it had strawberries and pineapple slices mixed in with the Ahi tuna and traditional salad fixings. But what I really enjoyed was the shrimp penne that one of the ladies in my group ordered. It was delicious!!! I will be going back at some point just to order that. The kids dish was really well done. It was broke up into different sections and offered a few things in moderation. My kids got a California roll, mac and cheese, sweet potato fries and an orange which was a pretty good meal for a couple kids to share. 

I did think the service was lacking a bit. By that, I don't mean that the service was not friendly, they were, and I do not mean that they were not helpful, because they were. I mean that they were slow! Although it was clear that they were all very busy so I am going to make the assumption, know knowing a thing about food service, that they are probably understaffed.

The Varsity is fun for the dueling pianos. Since they remodeled the place and removed the wall between the bar and piano area it is not nearly as unbearably loud as it used to be. The drinks are poured well and service is good. Had a couple appetizers and they were just okay. Really you should just go for the music and entertainment.

Went here with Mark Wiars.  Coconut Shrimp Roll was OK, but it seemed like it had been fried, but left out, because it was not warm.  Shrimp and Lobster Roll was very good and had a nice little kick to it.  This has place had very wild and fancy rolls, and an awesome selection.
This is a great lunch spot in Meridian. The food was fresh and good. The restaurant is also completely refreshed and clean. In my opinion this is the best Hawaiian food in the Treasure Valley!

I went to the Kona grill and ordered ceviche. Let me start by saying that I F*&King love ceviche. I paid over 10 bucks for 4 tortilla chips with a small amount of salad grade shrimp ceviche. Biggest ripoff in the Boise area. Ceviche is  a dish served with a healthy bowl of fish and possibly shrimp swimming in citrus with a bowl of chips to match.

When you get it like Kona grill, 

1. The chip quickly decends into mush. 

2. The amount of seafood isn't enough to satisfy a gupy. 

3. You'd expect that ceviche contain more than 4 dollar a pound salad shrimp. 

These guys are taking advantage of a trendy location, "The Village", and serving something well below expectations. 

They attempt to be a master of sushi, mexican, island and seafood and end up being a failure at every cuisine. Total waste of money for sub-par seafood. Go somewhere else.

Fast friendly service, excellent Brisket!  Reasonable prices.  My only "beef" was that their beer license was expired; and the selection was so-so to begin with. They have a sign indicating they are a "Mom and Pop" business and might sometimes run out of a certain meat.  I'm sure this is true, as the meat was outstanding.  

So why carry mostly Corporate American beer?  Please carry some excellent European beers, such as;  Heineken, Becks, Pilsner Urquell, etc.
I love their bread ... so soft and "real" feeling versus other sub places. The people are nice and the service is quick.

My girlfriend and I ate here about a month ago and I've been meaning to post this. 

The fries were amazing, the sandwiches were good although I would try something different next time. The boba tea was delicious and the customer service was amazing. We were the only ones there at the time but the owner checked up on us to see if we needed anything and then brought out dessert! It was a ice surprise and he did not charge us. We chatted for a bit and enjoyed the I've cream which was great.

Overall we had a great experience and they have amazing customer service.

Like many of the Yelpers chiming in here, we spent a few years in Chicagoland and came to love, among other things about that great city, Italian Beef, Portillo Dogs, and Chicago-style pizza. 

My take on Bono's is, first, they didn't make us leave Chicago and they have no obligation to replicate exactly our culinary memories. Anyway, I believe that "terroir" applies to more than just wine and if Lou Malnati himself moved to town and opened a restaurant, it probably wouldn't live up to our high expectations. So as for Bono's, pretty close would be good enough for us. The food can be great without being geographically pure. (Of course, there is that "Real Chicago Food" claim. Maybe they should shoot for "Chicago-ish.")

Sadly, it doesn't measure up to even that standard. The hot dogs and sandwiches are really pretty good on their own terms. The "other" Chicago-style pizza -- with the thin crust, cut into diamonds, with lots of gloppy cheese that usually slides off -- is also decent. But the deep-dish is a disaster. All three times we tried it with the same result: pale soggy crust, top-heavy with "sauce" that tastes right out of the can, and undercooked to boot.

But our biggest gripe with Bono's is that it just doesn't seem like a well-run restaurant. We gave up ordering take-out pizza after multiple attempts over the first year after they opened. They would say 20 minutes and we'd get there and they hadn't started it yet. Or they'd say 45 minutes and it had obviously been sitting out for a long time, even though we arrived a little early (we live 5 minutes away). A couple of times they lost our order entirely, or got it wrong. 

Okay then, scratch the take-out, we'll eat it there. Others have chronicled how there always seem to be a lot of employees running around like crazy, but what they're actually doing is a bit of a puzzle, since the food takes a long time to come, even when they're not crowded. Assuming somebody is there to take your order to begin with, which isn't a given. Sometimes the tables haven't been cleaned recently (crumbs, glasses). And what's with the get your drinks over there at the bar?

Honestly, we would be more or less regulars, even without the deep-dish, if they'd hire some professional management. They way this area is growing, there will inevitably be more dining options in the future other than fast-food, and Bono's will have to up its game.

I have lived all over the USA and am very particular about who does my hair. Going to a new place after moving here was very concerning for me because you just never know how it will be the first time you visit. I am overly happy that I chose Mali at Mane Street Salon today! She was very professional, precise and very knowledgeable about her work. She was personable and came very highly recomended by the other ladies who had just had their hair done right before me today! She listens to what you want and does not try anything that you arent in favor of doing. She is easy going and she was available when I needed my hair done! She was not pre-occupied by other people or things, just doing my hair to perfection! I gave her the most stars I could because she is the BEST ever! Thank you to Mali! (pronounced: "Molly")

Well-made breakfasts way above chains like IHOP or Denny's. Like home-cooked food here. Home fried potatoes were excellent. California Benny was good. My only complaints would be the prices are too high for breakfasts, and it is a little slow - food took a while even though the place was empty except for us and one other table. But the quality of the food made up for it.
Went here for a date night, the atmosphere is a little loud but not overbearing. The service was great as well as the food. I will be returning :)

First time coming here for my husbands birthday dinner and it was nothing short of amazing. Great customer service, atmosphere and food. Best brisket and pulled pork combo I've had since moving to Idaho. Don't let anyone fool you the prices are well worth it for the portion of food you get. Together my husband and I spent $30 .. I highly recommend
Had an amazing lunch! They even had gluten free!!! Service was wonderful. Sushi was fresh, every thing was delicious. I had the lime shrimp salad, I'll definitely repeat it.

Had the half veggie hash and it was delicious and so filling! The eggs were cooked perfectly and the pancake on the side was a great addition! It's gets really crowded so make sure to get there early or be ready to wait on weekends. Would suggest this place if you are in Eagle for breakfast.

This location is my personal favorite. They always seem to make perfect drinks and it is never unbelievably slow like other locations. The employees are awesome at this particular one and will ask you all about your day while they get your money and your drink quickly. They are always welcoming and apologize for even a slight wait. If it's your first time trying Dutch go to this location for the best experience for sure!

This place is a little bit to hyped up but nice to see something like this in Boise. The restaurants could be a better. Also they should have designed the center with more space. If you want to do live concerts, have a fountain, kids running around every where. Take away a few parking spaces on the outside and design the place with a bigger center area.
So happy they have a place like this in Meridian! So much to do. Always a fun place

I actually quite liked this place on prior visits, so you can imagine my disappointment when I received my sushi with short brown hairs on it. Yes it was replaced, but I could barely stomach to eat the new plate of food as I was considerably disgusted. The server also forgot to put in our appetizer, which we cancelled, and the manager said he would take care of dessert as an apology. However, after we'd ordered dessert and the check came, we noticed that we had been charged for dessert. The manager curtly explained that he had meant he would only comp ONE dessert for our 4 person party as though we were trying to take advantage of his generosity. Needless to say, the tip was deservedly slight. 

Will not be back.

Had breakfast here for the first time and am very happy that Yelp helped me find it! I had cranberry walnut pancakes that were to die for. My husband had blueberry stuffed French toast, it wasn't as sweet as it sounds, and my 16 year old daughter had the blueberry waffle. We also shared a small order of biscuits and gravy. Everything was wonderful! Our server, Erica, was wonderful as well. We will surely be returning! 
P.s. the process were super reasonable to when you consider how much food you get!

I returned and tried the Italian beef sandwich. I had it dipped. It was OK. I suggest straining some of the grease from whatever you dip your sandwiches in. I tried a scoop of the vanilla custard. It was better than the chocolate but nothing to call home ot mom about. The  Giardiniere was average. I'm still not impressed. I'll return to try the deep dish pizza.

We've have enjoyed the Cheesesteaks at Bruchi's on four different occasions.  It is a new restaurant and they are working out a few operational kinks but overall the food has been very good.  Mind you, it's not a "Philly"cheesesteak, who needs Cheese Whiz anyway....but the bread is freshly baked, the meat is excellent and the veggies are plentiful.

We will be regulars....

I had the chicken bacon ranch gyro and it was amazing. The veggies were crisp and the meat was well seasoned. My boyfriend had the Philly and he loved his too. We may have found our new favorite place

Out door setting let's you enjoy not only your dinner and drinks but everything going on in the plaza. I was really impressed with the patio heaters and how well they worked without being right on top of you. This is really the only reason it was possible to enjoy our dinner on the patio as there was a chill in the air that evening. 

As for the food, I was very happy. The portion sizes were not small and they even had the option to order half size plates which worked out well for my wife. Everything was prepared well and tasted great. After we finished our dinner we did not feel stuffed and lethargic nor did we feel like we wanted more, everything was just right.

Wow! This place is absolutely beautiful! I can see why people will go out of their way to spend a couple hours here. Plenty of stores to shop at and so many seating arrangements for relaxing and chatting. A absolutely must for those visiting the area! Fantastic outdoor mall that offers stores and services to choose how you want to pass your time.

I  love Cindy and the talent she has for styling hair.  I first met Cindy 4 years ago when I walked into the salon for a pedicure.  Cindy was the hairstylist working that day. I took noticed to the clients hair, she was doing a Brazilian blowout and style.  I was new to the area and also was looking for a hair stylist. I was able to book a hair appointment for the following day.  I was quiet pleased with my hair cut and color.  My husband also took noticed and really liked my color Cindy had chosen for me.  What I liked most about Cindy is she often came in early to accommodate my busy schedule.  I have referred family and friends and they too are pleased with her talent.  I'm sad to say I have moved back to Northern Cal and miss her.

My favorite place to get a sandwich. If you love eating in San Francisco then you will love how they brought that feeling and flavor home to Idaho.  The bread is soft and delicious. The sandwiches are dressed perfectly.  Their sourdough bowls are great as well.
This is one of the middle of the road americanized mexican places kinda like Chiles or Applebees  if you want something good keep driving to Mi Casa

We tried to eat here once, the wait was over an hour, we waited for the hour and there were still several people to be seated before us. So we left and went to our normal breakfast spot The Griddle who never make us wait that long for anything. We arrived there the wait was about 10 minutes and we had our food within 30. We have heard great thinks but are not willing to wait over an hour just to be seated.

This is the best hospital for pets. They took us in last minute, and put my cat asleep last week due to being very sick and dying on his own. The staff didn't rush us at all when we were saying our last goodbyes, and kept asking if we needed more time. During the procedure, the vet was petting our cat and being very kind and friendly with him until he passed. They also sent a very kind post card giving their condolences. Also delivered our cats ashes today, right on time at no extra charge. They truly do care about your pets and your needs! I will always go here from now on if I decide to get another pet. Thank you all valley for making the passing of our beloved 13 year old cat somewhat easier!!! You are appreciated.

Steak tasted good, but a little overcooked and overpriced. The mashed potatoes were a bit dry and the green beans under cooked. The appetizer showed up 10 minutes AFTER the entree!

The steak knives were super dull, which made the steak seem tougher than it was. When we brought that to the manager's (or whoever it was that walked around awkwardly asking how things were) attention, he just said "yeah, we don't send them out to be sharpened." No apology or anything that indicated he cared.

The mojito tasted pretty watered down.

If it were half the price I would have given it 3 stars, but at this price? Not going back.
