Have been here a few times now. The sandwiches are decent but not something I would go out of my way for. The ladies that work there are extremely nice and friendly. Overall, I would say the biggest reason for 3 stars is the price. The small sandwich is 3 in and the full is 6 in. To me this is unheard of especially because the prices are the same as what you would pay for a 6in or ft long at subway, blimp i.e. Or Uncle Giuseppe's.
Incredible ambiance, the view from the bar is unbeatable. Nice mix of offerings and the staff was outstanding.

Casual and small but Wow! Really great sandwiches are made with flaky waffles for bread. 
I'll come here again

I come here once a month sometimes more for the first time I paid attention to my bill and noticed that they charged me for extra food I never received. If you go here pay attention to your bill. They will add on Little Things hoping that you won't catch it. Really disappointed don't think I will ever come back again.


Just looked at my account not only that they tried to charge me for extra food they changed how much I left a tip for.

Good food! Great service! Honestly, it would be far too easy to talk about the good food from here. It was my first time having sea bass and I was not disappointed. It was probably the best fish dish I have ever had, and the butter cake was a delicious way to end the meal. My wife's meal and dessert were equally good. However, our meal experience was eclipsed by something else...the fabulous service from our waitress Mandy! She was very friendly, and answered our questions. Even better, she got my wife more iced tea before she was even half done with her glass. My coffee was never left cold or ever below half a cup. We never had to flag her down for anything. She was on target with everything and brought her A-game from start to finish.

Don't get me wrong; the food was spot-on as well. But they could have served us half frozen chicken nuggets and juice boxes, and Mandy would have still made it worth our while. We happily gave her a good tip, as it was well earned, but still somehow felt we didn't tip enough. We will definitely be returning for the food, and requesting Mandy as our waitress again. If the other staff is anywhere near as good as Mandy, the manager should take a bow at having a good crew.

This seems like a dress-up version of a Baja fresh, Except for the food is not as good. It really seems like they rely on a lot of cheese and salt for flavor. The saltiness of my veggie burrito with unbearable, and I kept having to ask for water to keep eating. I'm not sure if some people like that salty taste, but it's a cheap way to flavor food, and doesn't do the job for me. Also, apparently there are a lot of options for margaritas, but none were told to me. The sign says best margaritas in town, but the one I had was about average. I come to Boise about every six weeks, and I look for places that I can come back to enjoy food. This will not be on my list, as I literally left a third of the burrito behind.
And now, five minutes after leaving the restaurant, I think my stomach hurts... Yuck

Stopped by for a late dinner and was glad I did. I had the gorgonzola garlic burger with the   house fries. The burger was slightly overcooked but was full of flavor.  The fries were great. I also found that twigs is a chain, so I will have to visit when I'm closer to home.

This was my favorite cheesesteak joint in Spokane, I am so excited they have finally made it to Idaho. Please open a shop in Boise, southwest Boise or downtown!! You won't be disappointed.. my taste buds are happy again!

Service was great, on the other hand they do not trim the steaks, also my steak was covered in cheese more cheese then steak my wife's steak was good with the Demi glaze, doesn't offer a military discount

My mother in law was visiting in town, and I really wanted her to see how cool the Village was.  With the pretty water show, fun playground for the grandkids, and what I was hoping would be a great dinner. 
It was my first time at Kona Grill and I was excited to try it.  
My mother in law is disabled, and uses a walker to get around.  I asked the hostess to seat us at a booth so she could be more comfortable.  Not to mention we had the grandkids (2 and 4 years old).  She walked us right past a booth and brought us to a table!  My mother was so uncomfortable trying to get situated, I asked her if she wanted to move.  We ended up picking everything up, menus included and seated ourselves to a roomy empty booth within footsteps. 

The waitress was friendly, and said that popular items were indicated on the menu.  I ordered the Merlot Sangria and the Oriental Salad with chicken.  When my Sangria came out I was surprised how plain it looked.  Just a slice of orange in a wine glass, no other fruit or garnish.  The cocktail tasted like watered down house wine, hard to taste any juice, definitely no hints of citrus or juicy fruit (a staple in any sangria).  My mother in law got a margarita and she said it was the smallest margarita she'd ever seen.  It was gone pretty quickly, but she did say it was good. 
My toddlers hardly eat anything when we go out, they are so distracted by everything.  I got them a kids plate to share.  Our waitress came out with a box and plops it on the table in front of them.  "Can we get a couple plates for them?" I ask. "Of course!" friendly tone, but why does the customer have to ask for things a server should already be anticipating.  We wait for the plates to arrive... 

The worst of it all was my salad.  It was a giant pile of cabbage, barely any chicken, and definitely didn't taste any crispy ramen.  I took a few bites, but actually started feeling a little sick as I picked at it (I don't know if it was the dressing or something I ate earlier that day and was just hitting me then ). I told the waitress that I was not happy with it at all, the giant pile of cabbage remaining in front of me.  She said that she felt bad, but it really just depends on who makes it in the kitchen. WOW. 
$85 dollars later and a stomach ache we are on our way out.  Definitely won't be back!  Next time I have family in town I will try the Yard House...

I wish I could give this place a higher rating as they did pull my animal through some hard times... But there are too many glaring deficiencies to warrant anything better.   I think if you read the other reviews my observations will be validated.   

There was a whole lot good but there also is a whole lot of bad. 2/3 of the time when I call I get put on hold... Sometimes up to 10+ mins...    Some front staff are very helpful and some are down right lazy.  Example... I ask if they have my bill tallied so i knew how deep i was in.  The bill was going to be quite large as the animal needed quite a bit of care...The response was I doubt it.. Hmm well i am not asking for an opinion... Look for it.. And if you don't have it, add it up.... I understand that this may not have been done  But work to get to a solution to my request instead of looking at me with a blank stare and assume your lazy answer is sufficient..   
Doctors were for the most part very caring... I would rate a 3-4 on the doctors.... .. With a high five for one special doctor....  

Bottom line.... Some great..... Some bad.... Some in between At all levels of care...

It's all pretty much hype. I mean they make decent coffee and speciality drinks but I just can't get past the amount of cash one can easily spend here. 
Generally I only go here when we are stocked up on gift cards.  
If your a coffee fan and enjoy lots of puffery and spectacle while getting a mocha then this is likely your spot.

Beautifully decorated facility! The mood setting was perfect for the date night I was looking for, my only complaint the sushi was not appetizing at all, it was a complete dissapointment since I have heard so many great things about it. All of the other food we tried was super yummy! And our service was great, not sure if we will be back. Definatly not for sushi.

1st visit & just let me say...yay! some good bbq finally. it's different from my fave back home but very good in its own way. not to busy today, gave me plenty of time to look over the menu & ask a couple of questions just to make sure i was sticking with my first choice. i got the big daddy sandwich, coleslaw, iced tea & mixed berry crunch. tried all 3 sauces & a sample of the potato salad. the potato salad bite was good on first bite, love that it's made with red potatoes, but it had a little to much going on. was that egg in it? it wasn't bad just busy. will try it again next time i go in. liked the coleslaw very much not bland at all. thought the iced tea was going to be really weak because it was so light in color, but it was about average (i know it's wrong, but i drink unsweet tea not very texan sorry). will agree with other reviewers, the sandwich roll was a good choice. the pork on the sandwich didn't have a lot of flavor, the brisket was a little bit dry, but good flavor & the hotlink was not hot for people that love hot, but for me it's plenty hot enough & made my nose run just a tad. tried the sweet sauce first way to sugar sweet for me. the spicy was good, just not my type of spice. but the carolina sauce wow. loved it. do wish it was a thick sauce so it won't make the roll soggy, but the flavor was an absolute win for me. just shake it up really well & don't dump it on till ready to take a bite & it doesn't sog the sandwich. the mixed berry crunch is very good & not overly sweet. i like that very much. was surprised it was served cold. not a complaint because i had to bring mine home i was to full for it than, but just thought it was going to be hot, not fridge cold. the brandy sauce they gave with it is also good & pairs well with it. a little bit goes a long way. so on the whole i am happy with bd's  & will go back very soon.

Food was very good... slightly overpriced but worth  it as we sat outside near the fountain and it was lovely... we asked three times to please delay dinner and let us enjoy our $50 dollars worth of appetizers and drinks before serving the entree... DID NOT HAPPEN!!! Dinner right on top of appetizers... REALLY??? Manager came over and only offered excuses... no compensation just pretty-boy talk! DISAPPOINTED FOR $200...

I've eaten here at least 5 times in this city and several times in other cities and pretty darn consistent and good for a chain. Perfectly cooked salmon each time, great sushi and service usually pretty good. In Boise the greatest location to sit and watch the water fountains dance to the music and night
We enjoyed another great breakfast. Large portions, very friendly, attentive young waiter, and delicious food!
Great sourdough sandwiches......!   Friendly service......good atmosphere.    This restaurant is a little hard to find; but well worth the effort to find it.

We had Valentines dinner at Kona grill. I was easily one of my best experiences. The food was delicious. One of the best meals I have had. The ambience was outstanding. They put us in a quiet corner with  candlelight.  The waitress was prompt and helpful and very good at her job. I hope we can go back next year
for Valentines dinner. I highly recommend Kona Grill if you want to impress your date.
We rolled into town and we're starving. Looked up a few options before deciding on Big Daddy's and we are all so happy we did.  Very good sized portions and everything was delicious.

Fantastic! We came here on our way passing through Boise with a friend, and I can't say enough good things about this bistro.
The atmosphere is great, with lots of ornate, modern decor, and everything was very clean. They have a full bar, and as their name suggests, a huge drink and martini list. Our waitress was fantastic, and even though the place was packed, she took plenty of time to chat and make us feel welcome, and our orders came out just as we'd ordered them. Everyone at my table had a salad (I had the Pear and Roasted Beet Salad- highly suggest it), and all of them were fresh and delicious, and the plates we saw getting delivered to other tables looked just beautiful too!
Next time, I'd probably come here on a quieter night, but that's pretty hard to predict. All in all, best place I've tried in the Village!
Service was good but t-bone steak was horrible. It was hard could not even cut it. Atmosphere was shady. Would not go back
This is truly my favorite place to get something to drink. Everyone is so friendly and the atmosphere is amazing! Whenever I go it's often a highlight of my day!!

Best BBQ in the Boise area so far, being from Texas it's hard to impress. This place was a certainly worthy contender and worth going back try the items I just couldn't fit in during this trip. Tried the brisket, pulled pork and jalapeño sausage. The sausage truly beats many places in the German area of Texas, really nice tender abs great flavor. Brisket very great flavor l, nice bark and cooked really good. The pulled pork was good and the 3 different flavors of sauce showed a great understanding of flexibility of true bbq fans like me. Some like it hot, some like it sweet and some, well like a little tangy vinegar. Good sides, with smoked green beans, garlic mashed and baked beans. Give this place a whirl

We went there a few times in the first two months they were open. However it took so long to get your food even when the restaurant was nearly empty, that we haven't tried now for over a year. However, I thought we would give them another chance today and order pizza to go. I called ahead and she was very helpfuland assured me the pizza would be ready in no longer than 20 minutes. I showed up and the pizza was not ready until almost 30 minutes and when we got home it was also burnt. when I went in there there was only one table occupied in the entire place. How do you burn pizza when it's the only thing literally that you have to cook at the moment?

A long overdue review...Jo is simply amazing! I was in desperate need of a cut and color but I have experienced some hair trauma so I was hesitant to trust my hair to anyone, but Jo was great!  She talked me through everything she was doing, the type of color she was using, trimming just enough but still keeping my length and my hair turned out amazing! I would highly recommend Jo at Salon G.

Food was tasty, wait was about 20 minutes at 9 am on a Sunday. Service was good.

Now the bad news. Took 20 minutes to get our order and the hottest item was the plate. Potatoes we tepid at best and California bennie including sauce was again tepid. Not at all hot.

I have enjoyed plenty of decent meals at the Cafe Ole locations near the mall and downtown and was expecting the same for this new location. I was completely wrong and the entire table was disappointed. It started with the salsa which was bland as all can get and kept on going with the terrible service and flavorless enchiladas and tiny plate of which are usually enormous nachos. Maybe they were having a bad night, I hope so because I've had better with Cafe Ole.

Finally! A BBQ place in Meridian we can be proud of.  Tonight I ate the best brisket and ribs I've ever had in Idaho, Hoss has some serious BBQ skills. His brisket stands up to anything I've had in the South, definitely the best the best in Boise. 

The portions are generous, and the simple menu has exactly what a BBQ joint should have. Prices are reasonable, especially considering the portion sizes. 

I was particularly impressed with the mac n cheese. Many BBQ restaurants put lots of effort into the meat, and fall way short on their sides. Hoss obviously puts effort into the sides, and the mac n cheese is delicious.   

Getting BBQ anywhere else would just be a waste of your time and money, so don't bother.

Enjoyed the Gorgonzola Garlic Burger on the patio with great attentive service and yummy drinks. Our server was friendly and welcoming and answered all of our menu questions. She didn't even rush us out when they were closing as we finished our drinks.

Celebrated our Mothers 70th birthday. Had a group of 21. The manager and waiters were awesome! Great food and excellent service!!! Thank you Kona Grill. A special thanks to the manager Michael Torres for taking great care of our table and everyone at Kona Grill for an amazing evening. :)

.Not a bad place to get a sandwich - so long as you don't want multigrain bread, warm meats, or anything toasted. Still, I keep coming back for the ultimate porker. Freaky fast - that's an accurate description. It was in a paper wrapper ready to go within 30 seconds from when I ordered it.

I don't usually write reviews, but this place is awesome! Not only was their chicken waffle sandwich amazing, but they also gave us free bacon fried rice! When we were almost done eating, they brought out ice cream and gave that to us free as well!! This is the best place ever, and the owners are so nice!!

Love the new Sunrise! We ordered the Carnitas Breakfast Burrito that was loaded with meat and a really yummy hollandaise sauce. Coffee and food came out fast and Michelle, our server, was really attentive and checked on us often with coffee refills. Looking forward to coming back and trying something else!

We ordered the Salmon and a couple of sushi rolls as well as the calamari for an appetizer. Our salmon was good! The sushi was ok not great it didn't seem to have a ton of flavor and the calamari was great too. Prob won't be going back for a while.
I love this Dutch Bros.!  They are super friendly and quick and give my dog treats every visit! Also, the coffee is delicious!
Delicious! We were excited to find this little gem of a restaurant! We love Bosnian food and Sofra Grill didn't disappoint! We will definitely be back.

Gorgonzola fries were legit! Our server Holly was great. It was everything I heard it was, good drinks and okay food. Nothing really stood out. The ambiance is strange, the music is very low so there is an awkward silence.
Had it not been 80 degrees in the place, I would have givin another star. Just so you know, it was in the 40s outside. Food was pretty good, it was just hotter than hell in the dining room.
Great service and best breakfast in Eagle! Bacon is cooked just right and the coffee is decent :) great menu selection.
These guys are the best have ordered twice and on the second time just needed to order didn't have to give address or anything

My husband, daughter and I tried this place after church. It wasn't very busy but the service was terrible. My daughter asked for a calzone and the girl at the register shot her a dirty look and said, "You realize that will take thirty minutes?" And then stared my daughter down. We were taken a back so she ordered something that would be quicker to cook. It still took FOREVER for our food to arrive and when it did the fries and mozzarella sticks came ten minutes before the sandwiches and burger. The mozzarella sticks were burnt. When the burger came it was burnt. The cheese was literally black, hard and crusty, and resembled charcoal. We were done eating and still waiting for wings and a sandwich we ordered for our sons who were home not feeling well. The person bringing the food to our table looked shocked when she asked when we wanted our to go food, and we said now. We were all done eating, and had been for ten minutes....and ready to leave. It took another ten minutes for the to go food to make it to the table and when it did after we got home we found the wings were not in the bag. Terrible food, terrible service. We will not return or recommend this place.

This place is awesome! The decor is so pretty, with a huge aquarium and open kitchen where you can see them cooking your meal. Everything I've had here is so good from the burgers to the sushi to the desserts and cocktails. It might be a bit pricey but so worth it. If you're looking to save some money, they have a great happy hour. Great views if you sit outside too. I highly recommend it!
Love the Tomato Bisque Soup and the Kona Chopped Salad! All fresh ingredients and a great flavor that's not too over powering in the dressing. I keep coming back!

Where do I start?? I've had Christian Brothers service and maintain my vehicles for a couple of years now.  If you're looking for a company that gives impeccable customer service as well as professionalism, look no further.  Brett and his crew of repair specialists are great! I have many friends and family in the Meridian area looking for a great repair mechanic.  Now they have found one!! Christian Brothers is the only way to go! Not to mention, they have the cleanest shop I've ever seen!!!

Was our first time here while visiting Idaho. The atmosphere was stunning. The service was quick and with a smile. Only issue we had was our server brought us our sushi with nuts in them when we told her no nuts due to allergies to peanuts. But they made it right. 
We loved it!

This was an excellent find for something out of the ordinary.  Brought the family here - everyone ordered something different and all were excellent.  The meat pie was the overall best of the night but the goulash was a close second.  Bosnian music played in the background and decor was quaint.  Staff was friendly and explained everything.  They were moderately busy but food came out quickly.  Appetizers were awesome and enjoyed leftovers.  Fabulous place to try.  Great for kids as well.  Highly recommend.

As a fairly new resident to Boise I have to say I absolutely LOVE Winco! I only discovered it about a month ago after a friend's recommendation (after living here for a year). I've never found such quality groceries for such low prices. Sure there are cheap places to get groceries in every city, but the quality of items is usually pretty bad. Not at Winco!

This location in Meridian is not my favorite. I like some of the fresh-made lunches better at my store in Boise. But this location is still good and only blocks from where I now work. It's now a routine to come in and pick up breakfast and lunch items and I regularly pay less than $10 for both. And when I'm in the mood I'll pick up a fresh steak for dinner. I did that last night and had an awesome steak I only paid $3.68 for. Amazing store!

Delicious food but not the healthiest. ;) 

Eat the chicken fried steak or the blueberry stuffed French toast.

Very clean and relaxing place. I called this morning with a raging headache and they were able to get me in today with Kelsey. Kelsey did a great job on focusing on my problem areas. It was a relaxing 60 minute massage and I will definitely be back. I am going to sign up for the wellness program and go monthly.
I love JJs!!!  This place has a drive thru window and great dependable sandwiches, a solid fix.  Great location when coming from the Boise airport.
This place has an amazing environment. Fun decor and lighting. The food is pretty good but not what they charge for it.

Absolute best breakfast place around! The portions are sizable and pricing certainly reasonable. The cinnamon rolls are FANTASTIC! They make for a great shareable breakfast appetizer before a savory meal - nice and fluffy, perfect icing ratio. It does get pretty busy on the weekend mornings we have gone right after opening at 8 so be sure to plan accordingly if you'd like to get right in.
yummy sushi happy hour options, great patio seating! excellent for family dinner or date night, have been several times and will continue to frequent thanks to the location, great menu, and ambiance
Best chicken fried steak I've ever had! Great service! Can't wait to go back!

Food was very good. Excellent hash browns and biscuits. Eggs were perfect. Pretty quick. Went in just before 10 on a weekday left by 1035. Service was mostly polite but not friendly. Prices are reasonable. I did not like the coffee. Pretty bitter even with getting a "heath bar" version.

We decided to eat here for our daughter's eighteenth birthday. The service and ambiance was awesome. The food was only average especially for the price. We had two steaks that were not good, but sushi and sandwiches were fine. Fun place, and great employees but probably would not go back.

Love this place. It is a comfy relaxing environment and really good food. The staff is very friendly. The sushi was delicious and presented very well.  This is our second time coming here and they have been wonderful burgh times.

Definitely one of my top breakfast spots! 
Pros: AMAZING pancake (and I usually am not a pancake fan), large portions, not too spendy, awesome service, veggie breakfast burrito is awesome and very flavorful not that bland potato stuffed breakfast burrito (even if you're not a vegetarian it's delicious) 
Cons: It does get packed to call ahead or get there early, hard to accommodate to large groups because it's mostly booths and small tables

Three stars for the butter cake, but two stars for the service. Definitely frustrating for a waitress to not bring sweetener and spoons for over 10 minutes after receiving our cappuccinos =cold coffee...then doesn't bother to check in for way too long after. Step it up, Kona! Great location and ambiance, but service was lacking tonight. 

Update: For the record, as we were walking out, the manager comped our coffee.

My wife and myself for my birthday with our son and his two kids decided to go to Smokey mountain pizza for dinner.  Let me tell you this was by far THE WORST DINING EXPERIENCE EVER.   My wife and son ordered baked pasta dishes that we were told would take extra to bake, fine.  My fish and chips that I ordered  for my birthday dinner came out from the kitchen as they were finishing eating their meals. Fine my fish and chips were "comped',big deal. 4 people in 1 group and the 4 meals couldn't be served at the same time?  More than 10 minutes apart. Once the fish did get served it was so overcooked and the batter so hard you could barely bite through it.  We couldn't stand to stay any longer to get my free birthday desert. We will NEVER be going back. I do not know how they remain open for business.
Amazing staff!!!! Fantastic food every time I visit.  Thank you for the wonderful experience.

There is so much to do here.  We have been here well over 20 times and kids are never short on fun.  This time we came for movie in the park which was cool that they do this.  Kids played themselves out :) and slept in the next day.  This is our go to place for all day fun.

I went in for a late breakfast and I'm really glad I did. 

My server, Cameron, suggested the Chicken Fried Steak. I took his advice and ordered it with home fries, two eggs over easy and a biscut. 

I've probably eaten faaaar too many Chicken Fried Steaks in my life, but the one I had today was the BEST I've ever had. It was a good cut off meat (which is rare these days), flavored and prepared perfectly. I can't think of a single aspect of this meal that wasn't 10/10. 

The service was prompt, friendly and attentive (without being overly so). 

I will certainly be back soon, I can't wait.

The atmosphere is great at Kona Grill. The staff is super helpful and friendly. We had our food promptly and had a great experience. The food didn't "wow" me and my wife at all. The calamari was way too salty for our liking, so if you go to get calamari then ask for it to be lightly seasoned. We had heard that Kona Grill was overrated by all of our friends but wanted to see for ourselves. We now agree that the food is way overrated. I don't think it's worth the money to go back.

Had a turkey sandwich! It was definitely delicious! Cool sandwich place with a lot of choices. Bread is delicious and I'd recommend eating it there or asap. Also had a cookie which was surprisingly good. Very friendly staff, seemed like a great spot, and I'll be glad to go back!

Everyone here was and always has been wonderful to us and our cats. Especially 14 year old Foo that I rescued out of Nogales when he was a kitten. He traveled all over the country with me and even saw the Grand Canyon (people thought he was a hairy Chihuahua), and he loved to ride in a car, and would sit in the passenger seat. This last many months he was stubborn and went outside where he got hurt, we got him better the first go round, but the second didnt work so well, he was so sick, he cried( he needed help to go home), and put his paw on my face and purred, my face was on his, he rubbed his nose on me and was gone (I lost one of my best friends)...all the people in there, there was not one dry eye, everyone said goodbye including the critters...everyday he is missed...everyday he is taken his catnip...if it was not for All Valley this could have been horrible....they are loving, kind, compassionate and honest no matter how difficult it maybe. All critters are important to them as they are not just critters,  they are friends.

Came here for a milk shake. 

The place:

When we got there the drive through was backed up to the street. The place is kinda small and popular but we didn't have to wait very long.

The shake:

Have you ever tried to make a homemade shake? You think "It's easy. Just milk and ice cream." So you put some ice cream in a cup, pour some milk in and mix it together. But then when you go to drink it you realize it's not as good as you thought it'd be. It's chunky or at best gritty, not smooth as expected. It can't be drunk through a  straw very well and the milk ends up being drunk first , like the flavor in a slushy. Now remember how you wished you had a real milkshake? Well that's how my milkshake left me feeling.

If you're saying no to my above questions, then imagine making that homemade shake. Imagine a cup of ice cream and milk mixed together and put in a cup. Imagine a cup full of gritty ice cream, kinda like when eating freezer burnt ice cream. that's what I received.

It was actually the worst shake I've ever had and I wouldn't wish it upon any shake lover. I actually never finished it and ended up throwing it out. 

In all, this was my very first time being at, or hearing of, Dutch Bros and it will be my last.

The best feature of this restaurant was the decor and ambiance. The food was mediocre at best. We waited 36 minutes for a hot dog and cheese sticks on a Tuesday night at 7:30. Staff was unapologetic. 

It's too bad. As I love to support local business, but we won't be back.

Good as always. Nicer in their new location. Orders were taken and food arrived quickly. Was checked on to make sure everything was in order with our meals. Nice having Hawaiian food close. Going to be on our monthly lunch stops.

My wife and I went to this restaurant with high hopes. Tried the sushi once and wasn't impressed. Decided to give it another try and went back to order a soft shell crab sandwich. It was terrible. My wife had a sandwich that was just as bad. The drinks were outrageously overpriced, along with the food. DO NOT WASTE YOUR TIME OR MONEY HERE!

It could be that I had higher hopes, but they didn't deliver what I was expecting. The ambiance was so so and the service was not so great. It has the making to be something great but they need to up their game to compete. I would much rather go to the Yard House or Kona Grill.

I had such high hopes for this place. It was stunning inside and made you feel like you were really in for a treat. The service was poor and the sushi was basic. nothing special about it at all. I would like to go in just for dessert some time, but will never go back for sushi.
The food was excellent, the staff was friendly and the music was awesome.  Well worth a visit!

On the way to moving to Denver my boyfriend and I stayed at this hotel. It was one of the only pet friendly places in the area. From the moment I stepped into the place I knew it was going to be good. We were promptly checked in and they gave us a room on the first floor as we requested which was great! We entered into our room and it was huge! We had two queen beds plus a little living room area. The shower was amazing after a long days drive. Double shower heads with massagers. 
I highly recommend this hotel to anyone travelling in the Boise area or travelling with pets. Nice place!

Elements is a wonderful place with great therapists. Vonya is my favorite not only because she gives a great deep tissue massage, but because she really helps you feel better between visits by recommending stretches and explaining why you might be sore. She really knows her stuff!

We used to really like this place but they have made the food portions alot smaller than they were before, like 10 fries with a sandwich same for the tots that you pay extta for, also it has Always taken forever to get your food,  and dont go on the weekend everyone and theor broyher are there. Too long of a wait to get seated.  Now i always want to go elsewhere when my husband suggest we go here

What a surprise hidden gem on Overland road! I walked in and instantly got great customer service. The atmosphere is rustic with a few tables but typical of many smaller sandwich restaurants we have been seeing appear. The waffles are your bread. They were very tasty but a bit flaky, so if you have a beard like I do, you will be taking some home with you in it haha. I had the Jalapeño Baked Herb Chicken and cheese waffle sandwich. The chicken was flavorful, cooked perfectly, and complimented the not-to-spicy jalapeños. I also got the fries and they paired with the sandwich really well! My friend had the Turkey bacon and Swiss waffle sandwich and loved it. I really like their simple menu and easy to follow ordering process as well as their price to portion ratio, it is right on point. They also do their own version of a pho with a homemade soup base they make in-house so I'm very curious about that and will have to give that a try next time, if I can pull myself away from that excellent waffle sandwich.

If you like spending an hour of your lunch break on the phone with them once or twice a month trying to get your money back from their over charging, then this is your company! They are great at adding on fees and overcharging! The best part, the customer service reps will treat you with disrespect and talk in circles and then will not solve the problem in the end without a second phone call on another day!

Busy little spot but worth the wait. Friendly staff and great service and their yummy fresh food tops it off. The hubby had the California Bennie and I went with a half order of corned beef hash (and still took half home!). We will definitely be back again.
Great food and great service. They even had some good options for restricted diets. We tried the chicken brisket and pulled pork. All really good!! Mac n cheese is pretty awesome too!
Another great experience with Joe Mamma's. Got the Chorizo and Jalapeño hash. Fantastic. Service was great as usual.

I am telling you a secret dish that hasn't been put on the menu called the Temptation Roll.  For those sushi lovers. Make sure take the chance to let the chief make you some of those. You will love it and be loved by it!

We received our cake topper today from Wedding Cuts.  It is so beautiful that it brought tears to my eyes! We ordered a Monogram M with crystals and ivory pearls.  I cannot wait for it to sit on top of our wedding cake!  I would highly reccommend Wedding Cuts for your wedding cake topper!

I can't tell you about the food but the service was lacking. We were seated and given menus right away. Then we sat for 15 minutes with no contact from the wait staff. The restaurant was not crowded. We are now having great bulgogi at Rice Works and still have plenty of time to get to our movie. This ap insists I give a star rating even though I want able to try the food so I'll have to go with a 1 since there isn't a zero.

When Jimmy John's opened up, it became my favorite sandwich place. I've been to this one on overland about 4 times because it's close to work and have been disappointed almost everytime. The bread is always hard, not fresh as advertised. I have complained and got a replacement sandwich but when I went back a different time, the same situation. The downtown one is the better choice, never had an issue down there.
The sushi here is fantastic they have a great happy hour.The last time I was in Anthony was my chef I sat at the sushi bar, he gave me great recommendations. The hamachi tasted great! :-)

Wow, not sure why reviews were fair to mid. Wife had a veggie Sando and I have the bacon avocado special sandwich. Bread they use is awesome. Much better than Subway, etc type franchises. Was one of the better sandwiches I have had and will be back for more!!

We wanted a nice meal with a beautiful atmosphere. Kona was it!! The food always pleases everyone who goes -- as there is a lot of variety on the menu. I typically get chicken while my family gets sushi. The drinks are great and the desserts are amazing. I highly recommend the carrot cake -- WOW!

We have been to Kona grill three times now. I think the waitress/waiter staff has to many tables as our service has always been slow.  We waited 20 minutes to get our drinks and 45 minutes to get food. This time I counted how many tables our waitress was serving and I counted 7 with a total of 28 people.  I think this place needs new management, as its in a great location with only 3.5 stars.

I am sad to give this place a bad review. I had such high hopes for coming here! Don't let my review turn you off to this place though because maybe it just wasn't for me. I only had a chance to order the sushi and nothing else. I heard the entrees are the way to go, but I went against that because I was really craving sushi. The rice was overcooked majorly so it was all gooey and I forgot what kind of seafood I ordered to go inside of it, but that was also really mushy. 
On the positive side, the atmosphere was beautiful, the staff was very friendly, and they had a fish tank! The fish tank was so lovely to look at while waiting for the food. 
I will try to come back again to try an entree, but I will probably never order the sushi again.

The individual who cut my hair was very courteous and professional. Did a good job on my haircut. The place is clean and well maintained. My only gripe is that the two girls doing some of the check ins were kind of rude and impatient.

Yo if you can ask for Garrett you're in for a good time. He is the best server I've had here and I come here pretty often! He was very on top of his section and checked in frequently. He is the type of person that includes himself in your conversations when you weren't expecting it but then you're later thankful he did. He threw out some fire hashtags for an insta comment and has a lot sense of humor!! 10/10 would recommend.

Obviously something went down when a previous reviewer was there...I wasn't there so don't know the facts. What I can say is that my family has gone there multiple times and always had a great experience. Our two little kids love it, the staff is always friendly and the food is great. The only negative I can comment on is sometimes the kitchen gets backed up and the food takes longer than it should...the last time we were there was one such time with our bfast taking about 40 minutes. Overall though, this is our "go to" breakfast place in Eagle/Meridian.

A beautiful, rustic-themed farmer's grocery. The produce is delicious, and at a great price! There is a home-made ice cream and sorbet stand right when you pull up with something like 15 different flavors at any time. Highly recommended!

LOVE this place! I have a (sometimes) high strung Yorkie with anxiety which can sometimes cause his trachea to collapse if he gets too stressed out. All Valley always lets me call ahead to reserve a room if one is available so he doesn't have to be around other dogs. Dr. Loweth is the best vet we've ever worked with! She is extremely knowledgeable and caring. My dog just had a minor surgery yesterday, and Dr. Loweth even stayed several hours overtime to hang out with him until we were able to pick him up. The rest of the staff is great as well. If you're looking for a new vet, this is definitely the place to go!

Three of us went in for lunch and were seated right away.  The restaurant was fairly slow (4 other tables), we were not acknowledged and after trying to flag down a waitress and 12 minutes of waiting we walked out.  Very disappointing because we used to enjoy going here.

My girl Danielle is by far one of the best nail techs I've ever been too! I know my nails will always turn out perfect! She is extremely talented and if you're looking for a place to get some amazing nails, then definitely check her out!!! I promise you won't be disappointed!

Great breakfasts big portions and wonderful service!  Had the homemade pork tamales red potatoes and eggs.  Tamales were small and perfect.  Tri top, chorizo hashes were also good and pancakes light and huge.  Cinnamon buns are good too.  Great breakfast and value

The last 2 out of 3 times we visited our food was not good. They run out of food ,serve our order ,and not think we notice they switched the orders. We have also been served stale buns for our Italian beer. Tonight we asked for Au jus sauce and for some reason they gave us the hot sauce. Also they were out of 2/3 of their draft beer.

I really had high hopes for this place. I've really tried to like it because it's a good location and a cool little restaurant but the people who run it are totally brain dead. Worst service the gal at the cashier/counter was totally clueless like she was high.  tonight they were out of corn dogs chicken strips coors light bud light hot sauce and out of to go containers. Learn how to run a business. This place is a joke don't know how it's still open.

We came for a birthday and it was incredible. I had the pesto margarita chicken and it was everything and more than I thought it would be. Our waitress was extremely helpful with helping us order drinks. I had the basil lime kamikaze and the blood orange martini and I would totally get them again. Everyone in our party was extremely satisfied and I can't wait to go back!

OK, from first glace I was a skeptic....However, because I love to try new things and new places I  was willing to try this place.  When I walked up (it was about 1 p.m. on a Saturday) there was no one in site....Including inside!!!  This scared me!!  However, once I sat down, I was  given menus and water.  The waitress wasn't the most welcoming in the world BUT...once the food came out I was willing to overlook that!!!   OMG....I am from California, (the Bay Area to be exact) so, if you're looking for good Asian food there, I can tell you where to go.  Now, I am so enthusiastic to be able to have a place to take out of town visitors to have a "taste of home"!!!  They offer Vietnamese, Thai and Chinese Cuisine which seems like a lot but they seem to do it all very well and I will definitely be back!!!!

Food was great, drinks were great but the service.... Omg. So slow! Took 10 minutes to get a second glass of wine and to get hot sauce.... Kind of a bummer! I will return to give them another chance to see if they can change....

I highly recommend this place. Fast , great service. My mother & I walked in with out an appointment and were taken care of right away. I got a gel polish change and my mother got a fill & added gel polish. Both looked great. I really enjoyed that the nail tech took the time to soak off my gel polish instead of drilling it all off & burning my nails. All in all we had a great experience! Thanks!

This park is FANTASTIC! it's set up to be accessible to all children, lots of great features on the playground (which is huge).  my kiddos played for hours without getting bored with the playground. there is also a splash park in the summer, sports fields, and  a catch&release fishing pond. there's bathrooms but we haven't needed to visit the facilities yet so no info on cleanliness there.

Massage envy here in Meridian idaho is fabulous. I've had the same therapist for 5 years. Victoria loves her job and she is great with my problem areas. I've seen tons of different front desk girls but they are always so helpful and never pressure you into add ons

Lots of flavors & very clean!! Lots of sauces & toppings to choose from too! First time for me & my kids. We're very impressed & will be back. The only con is the music they play is elevator music. They need to play more upbeat tunes!

So it's been a long time since I last visited a Smoky Mountain. I was craving the turkey, tomato, basil on fococcia. Turns out that is no longer on the menu. Bummer.  I settled for the French dip and my husband had the pastrami sandwich. We got it to go and took it home. I opened the box and the bread looked amazing but where was the beef?  There was so little meat on both of our sandwiches that all we tasted was bread. Now the bread was good but we didn't order bread.  So it was very disappointing. We weren't impressed enough to pay $10 for bread and a small side of meat again.
Great food...good prices.  really like their yellow sashimi with jalapenos.  yum

Amazing food!  After Kanak Attack closed their Ono restaurant, I had nowhere to go for authentic Hawaiian food unless I knew where their food truck was.  After I saw Kona Grill's menu, I knew they weren't going to cut it.  Enter Pineapple Express!  It's pretty much the Kanak Attack truck with more options and it's always in the same spot.  I've tried quite a few different things there and all of it has been delicious.  Since they've opened, I've been in at least once a week.  It's got great atmosphere and island music to accompany the delicious food.  Also, always get the coconut rice... always!

Been there several times enjoy the more open feeling you get while sitting at the bar vs before when there was a wall. Friendly and very help full staff drinks are good not watered down for a reasonable price. Only real suggestion I have is they need to fix tv's to were there more viewable to a larger amount of people   Will return

I've become somewhat of a chain snob since moving to Boise because we have so many great locally sourced options downtown. Still, I have to give Kona Grill high marks for beautiful ambiance and setting, and the ability to craft a solid cosmo. While I'm a connoisseur of new and unique cocktails, I still love the classics. 

We dropped in after a movie on a Saturday night around 10. It was still hopping, but there were some nice seats out on the patio. Yes, the patio. In November.  And it was wonderful. They have some really impressive heat lamps. In fact, I removed my jacket even though I only had a short sleeve sweater underneath. 

They also had these sheer covers they lowered while we were there that kept the area well insulated. We had a great view of the fish tanks, fireplaces and bubbling columns inside and the fountain show outside. It's a great setting for a date night. Casual yet classy. 

We're not into sushi and it was late for a full meal so we shared the calamari with spicy aioli sauce. They had a good amount of heat, and were not at all rubbery despite being rings. 

The dessert menu was very tempting. Next time!
It is an alright sandwich. Nothing special. The prices are pretty high for a sandwich. It was suitable and filling. Might go again sometime.

Don't ask for a fry without salt because if you do, then they dump half the fries into the hopper while trying to dump them in a fry box. In the process you end up with a small size fry in a medium box. 
Also make sure that you get the sandwich you ordered. Even after I repeated my sandwich twice, he was still only doing a quarter pounder. So I insisted on getting a double quarter pounder, it wasn't my screw up.

Absolutely Fantastic! Hands down the best BBQ I have had in Idaho. You could smell the delicious-ness right as you stepped in the door. 

I enjoyed the pulled pork sandwich with their a combination of their sweet and Carolina sauce. I also had a side of fries and their bacon mac 'n cheese. Everything tasted awesome and cooked to perfection, I will definitely being be coming back!

They take pets! This location was clean, new, and the employees were friendly. We drove through on a Tuesday evening and were able to get a room. Fresh baked cookies at the front desk, yes please! For the price, this La Quinta was impressive. The bf in the morning is complimentary, I don't think a huge spread is necessary. It had a little something for everyone, totally acceptable in my eyes! Enjoyable overnight stay for certain.

A New Yorker visiting the treasure valley here.  I'm used to eating great Vietnamese food on both coasts, but I never expected to find a nice gem of a restaurant in the area.  Regardless of the Asian food friendly name of the place and menu item descriptions, this place is fantastic.  Their pho (beef noodle soup), bo luc lac (shaken beef salad), and summer rolls are as authentic and tasty as it gets.  I had a chance to talk to the chef and owner, and I assure you that she is the real deal when it comes to making great Vietnamese food.  It was so good I ate twice here during my stay.  I heard that the business is slow so my brother and I told her that we'd help out by spreading the word about the restaurant.  I highly recommend this place for my Idaho friends and family, and hopefully other area Yelpers try it out as it would be sad for something this great to leave the area.  Plus, I want this place to be around the next time I come to Boise!

Took two hours to receive my food and the food was terrible. I ordered fettuccine Alfredo and when I received was lukewarm greasy noodles with some melted cheese, no sauce at all. I also ordered an old fashioned soda, what I received was something they found in the back of the freezer. So many ice crystals the drink was bone dry.

This is the third terrible experience in a row, I waited a few months to order again thinking I'd give them a chance; bad idea. Never eating at this place again.

It is hard to come by good serve these days. This place was the first restaurant on our food list while living in Idaho. The service did not disappoint. First it is a quaint little place that wasn't busy. No long lines. We were pretty much the only ones there and ordered to take home. While waiting for our food the manager offered us drinks on the house!!! Who does that anymore!? So kind and friendly. Much needed with us being strangers to a new city. The wings are made on the spot and were delicious with their unique flavors. Same with their French fries. Not the best wings I have ever had, but still delicious and less greasy than most. 5/5 service & experience. 4/5 taste of food.

If the food would have been better, then I wouldn't have minded the hour wait as much!!  And, that was after they told us it would only be 20 minutes or so!!  I'm surprised they call their House Corned Beef Hash, hash at all.  It's literally sliced corned beef on top of potatoes. Chicken fried steak.... terrible!  I would not recommend Joe Momma's!
My husband and I went here a couple days after it opened. We were very happy and full! Lots of meat on the sandwiches and very delicious, we can't wait to go back!

Great boba teas!! The original milk tea is a perfect starter if you've never had boba tea. Not overly sweet and their boba is the perfect texture. So happy this place is in Meridian! Also great sandwiches and really friendly service. A great place to stop!!

Did someone say green eggs and ham? Joe Momma's did. This little place of breakfast heaven is tucked away by the river in Eagle. There seems always to be a wait but I take that as a good sign. The coffee is always hot and strong, just the way I like it. The green eggs and ham is a favorite of mine, with a biscuit and strawberry jam. Try this place out you won't be disappointed.

Very nice people.  The lady (she's always there) is the owner and very attentive.  The food is hit and miss, but when it's good, it's awesome.  My favorite is the Bun Thit Nuong Cha Fui.  I get it every time.
The greatest breakfast meal I've had is the corn beef hash. Insane. The crabcake bennies are up there too. Phenomenal pancakes and perfect bacon. 5 stars seems too few!

Best color and cut I have gotten in years! I haven't had my hair cut in years and I have been using $8 box color. Megan transformed me! She is awesome and she has a client in me forever! 
Everyone there was so nice! 
Thank you Megan!

Service was a bit less accommodating than I am used to. When I entered the restaurant was empty and I asked for a table for four towards the back but the host insisted we sit towards the front in the higher traffic area. Also, they would not seat me until the rest of my party arrived.

Although the food was flavorful my order was incorrect and it took a little longer to get to the table then I am used to. Prices were moderate to a little higher than most restaurants in the area and not justified by the portion size or flavor.

Overall a decent dining experience I may come back a second time if it is a convenient stop during shopping. Probably would not make a special trip to be here

Kona Grill has a variety of different options at a very great price. the location of the restaurant is right in front of a water fountain which really sets the mood for the dining experience. when you walked into the restaurant you can tell it's a lot different from anything else Idaho has to offer. the one dish that I tried was amazing which was the miso sake sea bass it had a lot of flavor, if it's your first time I would definitely recommend this dish, they also have a really good happy hour.

I'm a sucker for a decent Happy Hour, and Kona Grill delivers! They offer bulk of their sushi for half off, and enough of their appetizers to make me look for any opportunity to show up. The quality of the food has impressed me multiple times, and the atmosphere is both fun and relaxing.
Great place to eat for a date.  We sat on the patio and shared amazing appetizers and a salad.  They have an amazing bar and great drinks to select from..

Great cuisine for the price! From the outside, this place doesn't look like much. It's in the middle of a strip mall and didn't look all that busy. However, once inside the ambiance was nice. On a Tuesday night it wasn't packed at all and we got our order very quickly. We had some spring rolls which were top notch, a pot of seafood soup which was to die for, and mongolian beef which was not a traditional variety and had peppers in it that I was not expecting... but it was very good. 

The menu has a good variety of Chinese, Korean, and Vietnamese food and from what we could tell it was all very very good. A great find for the area! We'll definitely be back!

First I want to say I have tryed Bono's several times before doing this review.  The decor is fun to look at and really makes you feel like your in Chicago or want to go there. The man cave is really cool and what a great idea having a chalkboard wall for the kidos!  Great job.. 
       
Food,  Well I am a big fan of a Chicago bog and the first time in that's what I got for lunch.  Dog, fries, and a beer for lunch... So happy!  The next trip in I got an order of the Italian beef sandwich to go.   I would not recommend this.  Got very soggy and was just not the best.  On my next visit I was helped  by the owner ( very nice lady I might add)  and she asked why I wasn't eating the Italian beef.  Told her the story and she insisted I try again.   And it was much better but I'm just not an Italian beef.  I'm sorry because it makes no sense to me. I should love it but it's just not my favorite.  Now let's talk about the pizza.  I ordered a thin crust cheese pizza for the kids and asked for the best and most popular recommendation.  And the nice lady behind the register said without hesitation    ( The man cave pizza)........ It's a beep dish pizza FULL of all the meats. So I said.. Oh were so doing that's pizza!   Cheese pizza came out and it was a hit.  Gone In a matter of minutes as we waited the 45 minutes for the MAN CAVE.  She did say it would take longer thats why the chalkboard wall came in handy.... And then It came OMG it's something!   If you like over the top meaty, cheesy, buttery rich pizza then this is for you.  I ate almost two slices (not sure you call them slices)  I will tell you non Chicago folks like me that it's not like any pizza you have ever had.  And I will let the pictures do the rest of the talking.  Oh and one more thing.. I ate it 3 days ago and I still have heartburn..  Or it could be from the leftovers I've been eating even day since.  Glad it is gone and I hope the heartburn will finally go away.. Just try it.. Trust me...     

Service,   This is not a complaint.  Because I'm not a complainer.  But the ordering is a bit awkward and cumbersome.  People coming in are not always welcomed right away and seem a bit confused.  And the food to table seems the same way.  And the weird thing is that their is lots of friendly hard working employees.  They just don't seem to be  in sync with each other.  So I just hope they can get this down a bit better because this is a great place to get a Chicago bog and heartburn!  Which is a good thing!

We were in town visiting my son.   Stopped here for a family dinner. Smelled wonderful when u walked in.  My food was good.   The only bad thing is the waiter did not tell us there was a salsa bar so we missed out on enjoying that.  Other than that the service and food were great.

I absolutely love this place! I visit Boise once a year and eat here at least twice when I visit! their food is SOOOOO good!!! If you are hungry, YOU HAVE TO EAT HERE! their pancakes are also HUGE! chicken friends steak and corn beef hash are favorite! if you plan to eat here on the weekend, there will most likely be wait.. but i promise you it is most definitely worth the wait!

I went here with my wife, 18 month old son and my 80 year old grandparents. My grandparents aren't cheap so remember that for later in the review. The food wasn't bad at all but the service sucked. I can't remember our servers name but I will remember the service and never come back here. We arrived a few minutes after my grandparents. Awesome high chairs for kids I must say. Very classy. We order-my grandma asks about the pad Thai and if it's spicy because she can't handle much spice. The waiter says very clearly "we can take out the spice no problem". Awesome! Grandpa orders the sword fish, wife gets the macadamia nut chicken and I get the basil pesto linguini. Grandpa orders a side salad ($4) and tells the server that he and my grandma are going to split it. My wife orders one as well. 
Salads come out and my grandparents each get their own but they arrived a few minutes after my wife's as the server said they had to re-toss theirs. Ok cool they got an extra salad. Salads had great leafy lettuce but the dressing was very sparse and they came with one tomato, 2 croutons and a couple pieces of cucumber. Ok I guess but Texas Roadhouse side salad is way better. Things are going good. Then the entrees come out. All were pretty good except the pad Thai. It comes out sans sauce. Uh, really? Grandma asks the manager walking by where the sauce is. He says, you ordered it with no heat right? If that's the case it doesn't come with sauce. That's great, but why the hell didn't the server just say that up front so she could order something else instead of getting that disappointing dish and not eating? She has him take it back and asks for some garlic bread so she has something to eat. 
Out comes the bill. The salad they "split" rang up as $10. That's more than if they each ordered a side salad. Weird. $2.5 for the garlic bread wasn't bad but definitely tacky. Server comes out and when asked about the salad he says "we don't split side salads so I rang up a large house salad". Why wouldn't he say that up front? Why wouldn't he have been up front about the pad Thai? Very unprofessional. Manager did apologize and when asked about the garlic bread being on the bill his response was "well did you enjoy it?" That's not the point jerk. He did comp the salad (applause) and did give a couple cards for free appetizers next time (there won't be one with my grandma). Really guys, teach your staff that being complacent and not speaking frankly or honestly doesn't turn out well-$90 and a total let down when someone in your group can't eat their entree because junior wouldn't just say "I'm sorry if you don't want spice you won't like the dry pad Thai that will be served. Thanks man!
It's good. New staff every time you go in. Food is good but made different ways every couple of months.  This place has little consistency.

Love this place! Food is very tasty, portions are large, wait staff is friendly, and prices are decent. I like that I can order a pancake as the "bread" side to my veggie hash. Service is on the slower side, but they are usually very busy.

I hate this place.  So much.  Ventured over to take my son to Grimaldi's for lunch after some playground time at Settler's Park (I live in Boise but this park is worth the trek).  Never made it to Grimaldi's because the parking situation is absolutely obnoxious.  I get that you want people to park and walk around the "village" but seriously, you're a stupid outdoor mall in the suburbs.  I don't even want to imagine what this place is going to look like during the holidays - and the fact that people have to park out by Eagle Rd. and walk the vast expanse of parking lot to get to this stupid place is annoying.

Yeah, sorry. After eating real sushi in Japan and even in California, it's tough to get excited about Kona Grill. Especially when they charge you $1.50 more for fresh salmon instead of smoked in a Philly roll. Crazy...

I was really hoping they would have even decent sushi, but it's the same frozen / defrosted / farmed stuff pretty much everyone else has. Even the fresh salmon has a smokey, farmed taste to it. Just not palatable. That was my first experience.

So I decided to give them the benefit of the doubt and go back another time and bring my wife to try as well. We get there on a Friday night so expected a wait. The hostess told us a 45 minute wait, and she told us that at 730pm sharp. So I figured okay, we'll come back at 8:15. She instead blocked us down for 8:30 and asked for a phone number. Okay a little annoying to be told 45 minutes and then given an hour a moment later but whatever.

Came back at 8:20 to check on the status of our reservation and the hostess, kinda rude this time, asks "is it 830 yet?" or something to that effect. So I said oh okay, I'll come back. And she says I will call you when it's ready. So we waited till 9pm and never got a call and finally went to Blaze across the way and got a killer meal for 1/4 of the price. 

I'd recommend steering clear until the quality of the sushi justifies the price and the host staff is better trained.
From the food, to the drinks, to the atmosphere, Kona exceeds! I really enjoyed my tomato basil soup and the service (Sanja) was incredible.

As original southerners, this place had all of the makings of a traditional BBQ restaurant. It has nice, country style decor and smells lovely of bbq smoke just inside the door.

All of the staff was welcoming and friendly.

We tried the stuffed tator tots for an app and they were quite tasty though we thought a touch pricey for the amount you get.

My husband had the mushroom swiss burger, it was packed with smoked flavor. I had the smoked turkey salad that was really very tasty for a salad at a BBQ joint. It kind of looks small upon arrival but it's actually quite large as they stack it high.

Our child had the grilled cheese and it was great for what it was and her fries were superb. 

We also tried the bread pudding, it was delicious but was definitely missing a scoop of ice cream that typically most bread puddings come with.

Looking forward to returning.

If I could do a negative star I would have.  The older lady at the counter refused to seat us at a booth that was available. Then she proceeded to talk to the customers about the situation in an extremely rude and unprofessional manor rolling her eyes and giving me dirty looks like she was dealing with a child. What happened to customer service idaho style!  Would never go back there alternative breakfast across the street much better and actual professional and much more efficient!!!!!!!!   Maybe some therapy would help.

We have been twice for breakfast and will be returning again soon. The staff is very pleasant. The food is made fresh so there is usually a bit of a wait for your dishes. I had the Jo Bennie and the potatoes and hollandaise were delicious. Worth the wait! I would give it 5  but two other dishes I tried, a breakfast burrito and the philly hash scramble lacked a bit of seasoning/spice. Overall a super cute place!

This place is great. Think Eastern European meets Mediterranean. High quality food, large portions, and friendly service. I had the cevapi sandwich. Highly recommend it. They also have traditional Bosnian savory pies, gyros, hummus, and more. I'll definitely be back.

If I could give this place negative stars I would.  Stopped in cause the kids just wanted a quick hot dog and some mozzarella sticks.  Hot dogs are served with "skin on French fries".  

So we wait, and wait, and wait.. 30 minutes go by and I go to the counter to ask the only girl working what the delay was.  She says, "we ran out of fries, but they went to get more".  I ask, where did they go? "Next door to Fred Meyer" yes, they ran out of fries and they got more FROZEN FRIES to make for us.

The hot dogs come out and honestly, they are pretty good.. The 5 mozzarella sticks are burnt to a crisp... So we send those back and ask for some new.  A few minutes later they bring more and our fresh frozen fries.  They tasted exactly like you might imagine... And now the 4 mozzarella sticks (original order was 5) are still cold or frozen in the middle.  We get our money back on those.

Bottom line the hot dogs were good, but not $30 good for a family of 4.  The food is mediocre, the restaurant is dirty.  I seriously wouldn't even chance going there again.  Maybe if they get a great big "UNDER NEW MANAGEMENT" sign and even then I would be skeptical.  You could get 15 hot dogs for $20 at a Wiernerschnitzel and it would be 1000% better!

Drove through Epic Shine after a 900 mile road trip. A smiling staff, a fun ride, and a few minutes later my car was sparkling clean with no road bugs in sight! I was so impressed I drove around to thank the manager on site, only to be further impressed by the pleasant and professional customer service. Love this car wash.

We made reservations at Kona for our anniversary. They asked us if we were celebrating any special occasions when we made the reservation and we told them. I'm not sure why they asked as they never mentioned it when we checked in. Plus they stuck us right by the door at a table that got half the restaurant passing us as they went to and from the front door. The server was friendly enough and the food was ok. For the price point there's plenty of better options. I won't be going back anytime soon though.

I LOVE this place! It has a slew of great shops and a theater but the best part is the ambiance. They have amazing water fountain shows that are often synced to live music. They have speakers littered throughout the outdoor mall so yoi can hear music from anywhere. In the winter they have a small ice rink in the common area. They also have a playground for the kiddos, a couple outdoor fireplaces/firepit lounge areas. It is an amazing experience!

Disgusting. I ordered the Phó and my wife ordered the spicy beef noodle soup. Both tasted like armpit. I assume the broth was a few days old because the place has no business. 

When we first walked in for lunch the place was totally empty and their was dirty dishes on tables everywhere.  That should have been our first clue. But we will not be returning.
This store is one of the best I've been to nationwide... Huge store, a ton of options. Check it out if your in the area.. Will not disappoint !

We've been to Kona Grill several times when visiting from out of town. The drinks, food and atmosphere were excellent though our server, Haven, was not up to Kona Grill's standards. He was friendly (when we could get his attention), but made several mistakes throughout the meal. 

For starters, we asked for a side salad instead of fries with one meal (happy to pay for the swap), but his reaction was more appropriate if we asked for a side of lobster for free. All four of us actually thought he was joking (he wasn't). He specifically asked if he should bring the salad early, and my friend replied that she wanted it with her meal. So the salad arrives 20 mins before our food, yet  ketchup and mustard took at least 15 minutes to track down after the food arrived. My sashimi was smoked salmon instead of fresh salmon. Half the table ordered a second drink. I didn't, but he brought me one any way. He quickly took it away, but any other server would have left it (for free) to avoid the awkwardness. Also, we had to ask for water refills several times. 

We all make mistakes, but after the first few I expected him to pay a little more attention. The rest of the wait staff was super responsive in his absence. The last straw was how long it took to get our check. He was laughing it up with the diners at the table next to us, yet couldn't make eye contact with us when he rushed by our table. I will probably return to Kona Grill, but I won't sit in Haven's section.

I tried irena's back in 2013 when we first moved here & the selection was pretty slim. Lately they've been able to get another vendor & it has improved drastically. I love their meat and cheeses & European canned food selection. It's amazing now & very fresh. Make sure to bring your own bags, I love that they moved to reusable bags.

Another AMAZING visit at Kona!!
My coworkers and I came in after a long day at work and we were greeted with a huge smile even if it was close to closing time.
We ordered our sushi and as we waited we enjoyed each other's company. It took a little extra time for the sushi to come out but we didn't mind at all, also shout out to the manager for checking on us on multiple occasions!! He made sure that we were doing good. This is one of the things that I most enjoy about Kona, there is always a manager on the floor and they are checking every table to make sure they are doing great and having a good time. 
I always look forward to coming here with my friends, and I can't wait to come back!!

I returned home from vacation to a flooded rental house. I didn't think it was too bad, neither did my property management company. We were wrong! When Brandon and his crew got involved, THINGS GOT DONE PROPERLY. They have instruments that help to find things that other people would never be able to. Brandon even found old water damage that could have created possible mold and problems for my family. Based on what Brandon found and documented, all blame was removed from me and and the owner took care of all costs. Brandon handled EVERYTHING and I could TRUST that it was done properly even if I was not there to check on it. Brandon and his son even came over late on a Friday evening so we could get it done faster. Most companies would have waited until Monday or sent someone else to handle it. That is DEDICATION!

MOTHERS DAY BRUNCH 2015 was such a DISAPPOINTMENT! We have been to Twigs many times and had great food, drinks, and service... Hoping Mother's Day would be the same. NO.. Food was horrible and cold service was bad and the pricing was $35 a person for a buffet!!!!! Would of rather had Denny's at this rate! Writing this review in hopes management learns a lesson.

My group thought it was awsome. A pre-teen who won't eat beef LOVED the Italian beef.  A teenager with bottomless stomach complained he was too full.  Staff couldn't have been nicer.  And the peanut butter pie was. ...incredible!  Four 1/2 stars cuz it's a long way from home.
Don't bother. Limited selections. Not all taps flowing beer. No atmosphere at all. Place could could use some personality. Very lacking.

We ate here for lunch with our family while visiting the village. It was a huge place with open air seating. We chose to sit inside and since it was a week day and a little later in the afternoon no one was really there. The food was insanely good and the bloody mary was incredible. Service was great and when my mother in law was stung by a bee while sitting in the restaurant, no fault of theirs, they paid for her entire order. The staff that helped us was timely and professional. We really enjoyed our food and would go back again in a heartbeat.

By far the best prices in town. Emplyees r always helpful if needed, but they won't bug u if u r just doing your shopping. 
I have found their deli bagels are exceptionally good.  
The winco brand products can save u a bunch of cash too, some r even better quality than the name brands. 
You do have to bag your own grocieries.... oh well i like the cost savings.

This tucked away restaurant is a hidden gem.  Great atmosphere, 3 kinds of sauce at the table and good sized portions at fair prices.

The pulled pork is smoked in house for 12-16 hours, and it tastes like it.  Juicy and flavorful.  The beans were really good, and the fries were crispy and delicious. 

Highly recommend it.
Where breakfast IS good again.  Excellent in fact - Pappy

Great place to stop before movie.  Lots of martini to choose from which is kind of cool and fun!  Other's that have yelped about the fries and  fondue are correct!  AWESOME............ But our other appetizers were only fair. Meat just not very good.   Restaurant atmosphere very contemporary  and trendy.  Service was excellent and you can tell everyone is having fun working at this new and exciting place.  Obviously a bit on the expensive side but a kind of place you have to try.

I've worked in The Village for over 6 months and today was the first time I had lunch at Twigs...I can easily wait another six months until my next visit. It was uninspired and the food was just not very good. A colleague and I split three apps...waffle fries, Moroccan beef and a bbq chicken flatbread. Really the only edible one was the flatbread which was just okay. None of the food was warmer than lukewarm...the fries were covered in this gloopy mess of a cheese sauce and the beef was under seasoned and tough. Overall there are much better options to be had in The Village.

Awesome place to take your pets, especially in an emergency. My cat had an abscess on Labor Day.  They were awesome to work with.  They only did what was absolutely necessary and all follow up visits were covered in the costs of the first visit. They had a newer facility with digital x-rays. Really kind vet tech's and Dr.  

We are new to the area and this place was a really pleasant find!

The food here is authentic, delicious, fresh, never frozen, and definitely worth trying. The restaurant was very clean, the service was fast, and the staff were friendly and personable. They have a decent variety of vegetarian options, which I loved, but they also have a wide selection of other dishes, including many unique and tempting options. 

This isn't the easiest place to see from the main drag, but worth the effort and conveniently located near the mall and other shopping.

Went in and gave this place a try. I can say we were SOOOO happy we did. Great food, great people and a great atmosphere. Loved the noodle soup and chatted up with the owner and head chef. The sauce is to die for as well. If you like Pho but want a different take on give this place a try. So yummy!!!
sent wrong item, did not help with return,  would avoid seller at all costs

The qaulity at twigs bistro and bar is 10 stars. I'm always completely amazed on how consistent they are on the taste and presentation of food. The steak melted in my mouth. The drinks across the board are A plus. This is a restaurant that always brings there A game. Thanks for making my night wonderful.
Very good bread makes these the best subs of any chain store in the Treasure Valley.

Went for the first time during Happy Hour.  Waited 5 minutes at the bar (only customer) for the bar tender to acknowledge me while she was giving decorating advice to a server.  Broken martini glass over the bar serving counter & ice bin, nothing wiped or cleaned, only picked up the pieces and put them puzzle like into the broken glass. Satisfied that no glass fell into the ice bin (wow!)  Still water exchanged for soda and the still glass replaced in the serving area to be sent to another patron after already at our place setting.  Had to wave the credit card to get a check because the bartender and a waiter were having a conversation. Up side.  Food was excellent and reasonably priced.  Don't know given the customer service issues if we will go back.  Many other options in the Village.
First time here and it definitely won't be my last, it was absolutely amazing!!! I ordered the crab cake Benedict, my husband ordered the big joe burrito, ham steak and the most amazing pancake!

Restaurant is very clean, ambience very nice it's located in a high-end shopping center. The food is very tasty but is also smothered in seasonings.  Hope the chef or manager will read this review and try to change up the food prep.  I wanted to be able to taste the food not taste food covered with spices and such.  Our food server was nice and very attentive ....however I don't know if it's because I am Asian she assumed that I would be ordering sushi and really pushed us to order it.  I wouldn't call her style "selective selling"...but I really didn't care for her assumption. I am not sure if I would return back since I'd much rather dine at a place where I can really taste the basic ingredients such as the meat.
The macadamia nut chicken salad is the best!  I was visiting Boise and a friend said we needed to eat here.  Lovely place, good location, fabulous food.

The food that's served would include mostly Vietnamese, but it also serves the more basic Asian foods that most people are accustomed to. The service was very prompt, accurate, and I felt well taken care of. They presented the food like it was a very fancy restaurant and for some reason it felt like a place where I could take a date.

We had the place to ourselves which was nice but makes you wonder how long a place will be in business. It was a Thursday night though. We had the Spring rolls for a starter and they were VERY good. The entrées were good as well though I didn't think they were worth what they charged for the food. The decor was nice, music choice was a little odd but easily overlooked.
Energetic amazing service. Gave me a free drink card for next time since it was my first trip to a Dutch bros an normally your first drink is free. They seemed happy to be at work!

Kona is by far one of my favorite places to go. They have great sushi options and many others. Their prices are a little high but they have a great happy hour to make up for it, also a wonderful location that's perfect for date night.

We loved our stay.  My son has relocated to the area. R room was great.  The breakfast was good.  The front desk staff was great.
