The best staff member though was for sure Sadie in her yellow dress.   So cute and fun.   Our room was very clean and spacious.  We stayed in one with a full size fridge.  Loved the separate kitchen.

Good deals but absolutely horrible customer service. My shoe broke 1.5 months after purchase, so I went in to the store and the lady said there's nothing she can do and that's how long their shoes normally last. Shoes should last longer than that, especially at the Nike price.
Argentinian fish tacos are awesome!!! Five stars every time we eat here! Buffalo burger, crab Mac and cheese, fish and chips, ALL five stars!! Wait staff ALL five stars!!

Love this restaurant! Great atmosphere and menu! Some of the best sushi I've had in Idaho!!! The rest of the menu is wonderful also with a great variety. I always leave there pleased with what I ordered and what I paid! Only suggestion to customers is to make a reservation! It can be busy (because it's so yummy)! Suggestion to restaurant, don't make the bar and patio open seating. It would be nice to make a reservation for one of those areas. It's always full whenever we show up.

By far THE BEST asian food Ive had since moving to Meridian last year. Dishes we tried included the grilled lemongrass chicken, stirfry tofu on rice, spring rolls and sweet and sour chicken.  The place was virtually empty and sadly the owner expressed that she might not be able to hang on much longer due to the lack of business.  "Tell your friends" she asked.  So Im on a personal mission to spread the word and if nothing else, hopefully a few other people will take the oppurtunity to try this awesome restaurant before it goes away.   If you're looking for your average panda style gmo and additive laden good for 10 minutes then it transforms into a totally different material kind of chinese fast food, I think theres a Panda Express right down the street.  But if you a want truly unique blend of Chinese/Pho/Korean cousine cooked and served by a passionate family who really care, this is definitely worth an evening out.

Against my better judgement we purchased tickets for a fund raiser for St. Jude's last night. Was not excited that it was being held at this establishment but is a great cause and we like the artist that was going to be playing.  We arrived early as per instructions at @530 pm.  The staff seemed unaware of what was going on and still setting up room for 40 people.  We were seated at 6pm.  Not that I was surprised considering the two times we have been there previously, it always seems customer service is a concept that they have no clue about.  Water was not on the table as would be expected.  One server taking drink orders for 15 people at our table.  Drinks finally came, dinner order finally taken(3 choices which is expected). Food finally came, no salt or pepper in table.  Food was good to okay.  The evening was great due to the amazing artist and knowing that we were helping St. Judes hospital.  They were understaffed for the this group.  This will be the last time that we will go here.  But it seems nine of the food establishments at the Village have a concept of great customer service.  When I pay for overpriced food I expect outstanding service.  Have never received but horrible service at Kona Grill.  I will take my money elsewhere.
Tried a couple of times and just have to say it is just OK.   I don't think I get the deep dish pizza, but I did like the meatball and stringed meat sandwich.
By far the worst service ever, constant issues, lagging times, I wish I could back out but signed a contract

Friendly service, but they don't pay attention to my order... ever. I always get iced coffee, and ask for whippy on top. I *never* get the whippy. They hand me a flat-lidded beverage every single time. I remind them about the whippy and they happily remove the flat lid, add the domed lid, and add whipped cream. But it's getting old having to ask. Also, seems like the flavors aren't consistent from franchise to franchise. For instance... Their Kokomo. (I think that's how they spell it... the coconut flavored one.) Sometimes it's dark brown, sometimes pale tan... wtf. Sometimes I can taste the coconut, sometimes it's more mocha than anything. Never know what you're gonna get. Makes me wonder if they're getting the sugar-free part right or not. They are friendly (and oddly attractive! Do they even hire ugly people? hahaha) but they don't pay attention to orders at all. And now that prices went up? Yeah, I'm done. $5 for a medium iced? I don't think so.

JoeMomma's JUST opened in Eagle right across Eagle Road from Bardenay (next door to Porterhouse)!

I'm loving their open and clean atmosphere and the service was top notch - almost overly attentive actually. Before I was half way done with my diet soda, another one was in front of me! Definitely not the worst thing that could happen :)

I had the Bourbon BBQ Chicken wrap with the sweet potato tots. OMG... sweet potato tots were TO DIE FOR and the wrap was stuffed full of chicken, lettuce, cheddar with a great smoky sweet BBQ sauce. Good portion too. 

I was impressed with the expansive menu with lots of choices - I will definitely be back to try the omelettes!

This is by far my favorite La Quinta hotel! It's always clean, it's comfortable, and I overall generally feel comfortable and safe staying here with my family. The rooms are nice and clean and roomy, the beds are comfy (I've never questioned the cleanliness of the bedding) and the breakfast is always fresh and hot! The pool is open 24 hours, and we've seen it closed for cleaning on more than one occasion, which I feel good about because it means they take care of it! The staff is always friendly and helpful, and we've never had any issues here, we've even received upgrades that we didn't ask for! Of the other La Quinta hotels, I recommend this one 100%!
Best bison burger I've had! Comfortable, yet trendy and great service. Massive drink menu with choices beyond a cosmopolitan. Would definitely return and recommend to locals and out of towners.

When I first came here I wasn't to ecstatic about the place. I guess I just expected more. Once I came back the 2nd and 3rd time that's when it really grew on me. Their cocktails are very good, and have really good happy hour drinks as well. The twigs amber ale is really good choice if you ask me. The happy hour food isn't big portions what so ever, but still good though. I would say the best time to come in would be during the late night where it really sets the mood for a cocktail bar.

Maybe a little pricy, but great interesting food with wonderful service from very sweet people. We tried wings, chicken tenders, and a brisket waffle sandwich. The sandwich was definitely the highlight. It was smoky, tender, and delicious. The waffle is made from croissant batter, so it is buttery and flaky. Also, the boba drinks are fun, and delicious.

Average, not horrible it wonderful, just average. 
Our group ordered the Cesar Salad, miso soup & lunch combo roll. The miso was great, best I've ever had. The salad & roll were just bland. Not much flavor at all. After all the hype we had heard, we were left disappointed. 
Service was adequate. I may go again, maybe not.
Good advice from fellow Yelpers.  Give this place a try.   Very authentic and great service.

The first time I took my Mercedes in, the work was done well but I was told it needed some more work. I asked what it was, the reply: "I don't have the paperwork handy but I will call you".   I did not receive call.  When I called again, I was told to bring car in again because paperwork was lost. I took the car in again but it took two more phone calls to have estimate of repairs emailed to me.  

The work "needed" included * fuel filter ($180.00) which they had actually replaced themselves two months prior,  tune-up, work related to a "one way clutch", and replacement of some other parts in the front end.  All for a total of almost $1000.00.  A little concerned, I took car to the dealer where it was confirmed that my car does not have a one-way clutch, the front end was fine, otherwise I would be hearing noise, the fuel filter did not need replacement, nor did I did a tune up.  In other words, my car sounded and ran perfectly.  

They do good work, but make sure that you really need that work.  Also, make sure you keep all your records because they sure don't, nor are they good with follow up.
Very good hawaiian food. I had teriyaki chicken, kalua pork, white rice, and spicy asian slaw. It was all very good and tasty. You get plenty of food for the price.
Excellent BBQ, great sauces and sides.  Very fast.  Definitely worth it.  We had 18 people there and tried just about everything.  Nothing but good words from everyone.

This place has some serious staffing issues.  My first visit was an excellent experience.  Since then, I've been back twice and the service has progressively become worse.  I hope this is not a sign of things to come.

For some reason the restaurant is short of plates.  Yes, we were told the reason we had to ask for starter plates was because they were in the washing machine.  Lucky us!  We had the pleasure of using warm plates for our spicy tuna roll.

The service is a sad drawn out joke that only your uncle Benny would tell or get.   No silverware, clueless bartender and waiter.  It really just sucked.

The food is passable yet unremarkable especially the seafood.  

I'd go back for a beer or cocktail just for the people watching.... Otherwise, no joy.

I really wanted to give a better rating, but I just can't. This used to be the Dutch Bros I frequented until I tried the State Street location. The coffee just isn't good. I'm not sure if it's in the preparation or what, but you can taste it.

It makes me quite sad, as the people there are the greatest!

Excellent barbecue, the meat was perfect. I had a brisket sandwich and barbecue beans and a salad with blue cheese. Salad was nice fresh crisp lettuce with cheese onions tomatoes croutons and the entire meal was a joy. The Carolina style barbecue sauce is amazing, as is the sweet. Hydro 45 minutes just to eat barbecue here. It certainly did not disappoint! I would highly recommend it.
Awesome!  Who would have thought that a chicken fried steak would be an actual Steak that is chicken fried!

I recently visited this restaurant last Sunday and  I was very pleased with the service and the food.  I especially liked the pancake which was even a little crispy on the outside.  They have come a long way from when they first opened and I think this place is a nice asset to this area.

The restaurant decor is really pretty with there fountains and branches on the ceiling.  Our table though was sticky and looked like it was peeling.  Our server seemed less than friendly and distracted like she didn't want to be there.  The food for the most part was ok.  I looked forward to eating here as I heard good things but was let down.  The potstickers were tasty and had plenty of filling.  I would order these again.  We also ordered the calamari,  which was barely edible. Instead of crispy, it was soggy with the breading coming off.  It was well seasoned though but definitely not worth reordering at $11.50.  Our entrees were good though.  I had the salmon with fried rice. Tyne salmon was flavorful and prepared well.  The fried rice was ok.  It was a little cold and the portion was small.  My fiancee had the pork sliders which were tasty also.  Overall most of the food was adequate but over priced for what it was.  Their food isn't nearly as good as the other restaurants in the village and the service leaves something to be desired.  So we're probably never going back here.

Pretty nice place for breakfast. Pancakes are bigger than your head. And their breakfast scramble was great. I went with the chorizo, jalapeño, tomato and cheddar scramble - really well done. Their half portion was more than enough to fill me up. Friendly team running Joe Momma's, but service was a bit slow. Worth trying out next time you're in Eagle, ID.

We didn't have a grocery store like this where I grew up.  I always feel like I'm getting away with something when I shop here.  I end up with a huge, full cart of groceries and a smaller bill than anywhere else.  I especially love all the bulk food they provide - I have always hated having to pay for packaging.

You do have to bag your own groceries.  Does this bother anyone?  It seems like a small price to pay for much lower prices on everything I buy.

I not from this area but my daughter is and she recommended this place for breakfast.   Fabulous is all I have to say!  It was Sunday and they were busy but we were seated in less than 5 minutes and the service and food was great.   Don't miss it if your in Eagle Idaho!

I love this place, especially their Wine Down Wednesdays where bottles of wine are half off.  My favorite items are the Kona Chopped Salad, Avocado Eggrolls, and the Checkerboard Sushi.  They have a great happy hour menu with discounts on food and drinks.  I really like their atmosphere, and the patio seating.  Their customer service is outstanding!!

I think this restaurant along with yard house is nothing more then the opening of the village and the hype. I've eaten here twice now and have yet to be impressed. Sushi rolls were disappointing. One positive is the service was very good.

Outstanding and great service. Very accommodating and excellent selections
Our server was amazing and great personality !!!

The Village is a perfect fit in Meridian, it looks and feels like Disneyland, phony and tacky. Twigs fits in perfectly in the Village. Twigs attempts to feel upscale while falling far short in execution and service. 

Yesterday was my second visit to Twigs. I had the full order BBQ Cobb salad.  The portion size was ridiculously small, maybe 4 oz of poorly seasoned chicken on a bed of wilted brown romaine. There were bits of bacon floating in the soupy Gorgonzola dressing. The dressing itself was a watery bland preparation I would expect to find at a cafeteria salad bar. A split hard boiled egg completed the salad that was visually disappointing. 

Had our server bothered to check back I would have asked for some kind hot sauce to deliver any type of flavor. To say this salad was underwhelming would give it too much credit. At $15 Twigs should be ashamed to let a dish that looks/tastes this bad leave it's kitchen.

Two underwhelming visits to this faux haute establishment is all I will be tricked into. 1 star is being generous.

Food is generally pretty good, especially the pizza. The hot beef sandwiches really don't compare to what you find in Chicago but not bad. If you are Jonesin' for a beef, it will hold you over. 
As regards the service, try to avoid the place during peak times. They have a habit of losing orders and running crazy slow on getting orders out. Staff and mgt are not very professional when under the gun.

Big Daddy's is our go-to BBQ restaurant. I have typically taken the meat by the pound to go, and it is always great, but we recently dined in with some family visiting from out of state and were really pleased with their meals and service. 

The restaurant is cute and clean and everyone loved their meals. Lots of unique choices in addition to the regular combos. The pulled pork and chopped chicken are my favorites, but my daughter had a burger that looked fantastic. I may have to try that one next time. Huge portions too... I made two and a half meals from my dinner, which is awesome! 

I recommend  for both dine in and take out

Great place to get a quick bite. Friendly relaxed staff and awesome authentic food. I would go more for the teriyaki chicken and kalua pork than the poke though. Its a little overpriced for the quality.

Big thumbs up. My little family of six love this place. Always amazing counter service and they're always running out asking if we need anything. I love love their dogs. Best in town and the pizza is pretty darn good too. They've always got the best sports on so if you're looking for a place with a TV they're your man.

I've never been left hungry by a Chinese restaurant until now. I ordered the Kung Pao chicken and the honey walnut shrimp with rice. The proportion of entree to rice was so meager, and the rice was so bad that I was left with a full plate of rice and an empty stomach. Nothing really memorable about the entrees really, other than not enough.

Good food but the service makes you forget that...was there Saturday morning and arrived early before the big breakfast rush. Not only did it take about an hour for our food to show up, but when it did it was not hot but rather lukewarm at best. The waiter was apologetic but really couldn't do anything about it.

Frustrating because clearly there is a service problem there, but based on all of the comments on Yelp it appears the owners don't have any interest in addressing it.

Not sure if we'll be back but sadly there is a lack of good breakfast places around here so am guessing we will be.

I had the best lunch today at Kona Grill.  Sweet-Chili glazed salmon with shrimp and pork fried rice and zucchini with bacon side dishes.  It was so good I can't wait to go back and order it again.  The fish was cooked perfect and the sides went perfect with it.  Yummy!   The service was very good also.  Love this place.
Service here is just okay, not quite as fast as they say. I've found that the lobby and sitting area is just too small and it gets very very crowded.
I love their beer.  About to head there for discounted growler fills (Saturdays) just in time to take to family get together for Easter tomorrow.

Their bread is amazing! I haven't tried a wide variety of sandwiches cause I'm just in love with the turkey salami. Staff is very friendly even during their lunch rush they are helpful and apologetic for the wait. Location is kind of hidden. I couldn't find it the first time. Definitely try this place if you love sourdough!

I want to say a huge thank you to Alex the bartender here. He is always so nice and accommodating to us. Willing to go the extra mile and we enjoying our time because of him. 
I also very much like Erin the server as well. She always takes care of us and treats us so well!!!

Will definitely be back because of them!!! 


One of the best happy hour on eagle

A downtown Boise park this is not, give it another 20 years and the trees will be just as big and shady. The park is still great for kids, lots of playground equipment for all ages and I love the padded ground around the equipment. In the summer kids love all of the water play and musical instruments. There's also lots of room for big bbqs and picnics in the covered shelters and picnic tables spread throughout the park.
One word...delicious! I had the spinach and artichoke soup and it was amazing. The bread on my sandwich was fresh from the oven. I will definitely be back. Staff was super friendly as well!

Having spent time in former Yugoslavia, we knew what we were looking for. This place is authentic and wonderful in every way. Would consider driving back to Boise just for the food. The Cevapi was excellent.

My parents were in town and we thought meeting for breakfast would be a great way to catch up. We took the advice of a previous Yelper and went before 0900. Good advice. We had eight in are party but didn't have to wait long at all. The menu has a pretty good selection but with all the creative names it can take a while to find the item with the correct combination of things you want. Everything looked good though and I think only the French toast was ordered by more than one person. I had a scramble like dish and should have known better. That isn't a dish to selected if you're hoping for something lite. It was okay but I'll probably not order it again. The surprise was the French toast. Neither my wife or daughter were very impressed with it. Both thought it was rather bland. Even with syrup it was still kind of plain. The service was very nice. Attentiveness and keeping coffee and water full are huge things for me. Breakfast is not a time to leave a customer with an empty coffee cup and our server never let that happen. For "American" food that isn't bad at all, they'll treat you right. Just remember that getting there early is better.

I went there for lunch on a business day. The eatery was fairly busy with about a dozen guests dining. Cody was my server and, from the time I walked in, I was made to feel completely welcome. The food was perfect - exactly as I had ordered it. Cody kept my drink refilled and went out of his way to ensure the food was cooked exactly as I had ordered it (it was). I couldn't fault the premises, the food, or the staff in any way at all. The food came quickly and it was absolutely delicious! Everything was absolutely perfect, and I will definitely be going back there again.

My husband bought us a Groupon for this place this morning.  After getting stuck in construction for 15 minutes trying to get there and then waiting in line for 10 minutes in cold, lack luster place the lady told us Groupon wasn't supposed to sell any more coupons.  She then called the owner who told her to refuse the coupon and our business.  We left feeling completely cheated, instead of getting to judge Shige Teriyaki on there food we got to based on their poor customer service.  We will make sure to tell our friends, family and fellow Yelpers not to waste their time and money on this place.
Food is great. But extremely slow service. I go all the time but only when I have the time to WAIT A REALLY LONG TIME FOR EVERYTHING.

I came in with high hopes. Nice setting. The only reason it got one star was the layout of the restaurant. Open. And clean. Also nice. 

First started with me waiting five minutes to place my order. No one in the place and actually upon asking the cashier they said it was prepping time. They were too worried about getting prepped to take new customers. Bad sign. 

The food came out quick enough but I was immediately annoyed at how little seven dollars got me in food. Small messy six inch food. The meat was like ground beef and was soggy and wet. The layout of the sandwhich was bad also. It only had cheese and peppers on one side of the bun. 

But the bun was cut all the way through so that stuff fell out continually. I ate in two minutes and the entire time was disgusted. My uncle with me as well had the same feeling. 

Gross food. Too little for the money. Don't go here unless to get drunk and if so take a PB and J with you. You will be more satisfied with that.

I went to Smoky Mountain Pizzeria to get a drink and a pizza for my birthday. I sat at the bar and Mark, the bartender mixed me a delicious cocktail. Mark went above and beyond to make me feel welcome. I had the Ultimate Pizza, chock full of goodies. Mark suggested the Original crust which was not chewy and charred just right. All in all, a great visit and a great bartender. I'll be back!

Jessica Olguin did an INCREDIBLE color and cut on me!!!  "The Processing Bar Salon" Meridian (726 N Main)!!!! She is absolutely AAAAAMAZING!!! I loooove it! It's EXACTLY what I wanted!!  After seeing 3 different stylists, 3 different salons.... 4 seperate 3-4 hour sessions total from all these different stylists...  Jessica was the one out of everyone who did it exactly like the photo I showed her and everything was PERFECT!!!!! She's amazing!!!! I live in SC and my sister recommended her to me while I'm in Idaho visiting family. I am going to get my hair done across the entire country every time to have Jessica do it. She is THAT GOOD!!! Highly highly highly recommend her!!!!

Went to this place three times in three weeks. The first two times were PERFECTION (I had ribs the first time and the pulled pork sandwich the second time). I had the pulled pork sandwich the third time and it was super fatty (my husband had the 50/50 with pulled pork and brisket and his was perfect). I couldn't eat most of the meat. I'm hoping that it will be better next time. Also, they have the best French fries we've had since moving to Boise six months ago. 

The staff is incredible. I love the young woman at the front door (she always gives us extra candies).

Suprising interior for a strip mall restaurant, nice, and every time we have been there the servers has been attentive, professional and friendly.  We've come with 4 kids in tow ranging from baby to tween, and all were welcome.  

The menu is a mix, as you'd expect, of various asian cuisines.  I have a few favorites, the Pho Tai as well as some of the grilled chicken entrees and some of the standard chinese entrees.  

Definitely go for a bowl of Pho of some variety here.

We enjoyed this BBQ very much! We've traveled a extensively, had bbq across the U.S. and found this restaurant to be a pleasant surprise. I know it's good bbq when I don't add sauce in order to eat the meal. I had the brisket, couldn't finish it, took the leftovers home to our daughter who is particular about the meat she eats...she ate my leftovers! My husband had the meat sampler plate and loved every cut, with the exception of the sausage - just a texture preference, the flavor was wonderful. The mashed potatoes were tasty, as was the Mac 'n cheese. We even had the fried tator tots, they were fun, but I'd rather save room for more of that wonderful bbq! We'll definitely be going back and would take friends with us. The only "issue" we encountered was my soda tasted weird, when I mentioned that to our server, she immediately took care of it and brought me a new one (turned out the soda bib was low, so I had more carbonation than syrup). The fact that she addressed the issue quickly and apologetically only increased my opinion of this strip mall restaurant!

This place is amazing. My husband and I stumbled upon Twigs when we were checking out the Village. I had two signature cocktails and the mojito was the best I've ever had and the presentation was flawless. If there lunch time bartender is that good I can only imagine how good the one in the afternoon is. The margarita pizza is to die for and my husband loved his steak. 

I'm extremely excited to make this place our new date night spot when we finally move out to Idaho in a few months.
I feel horrible because this is the closest restaurant near my house and I don't want them to go under... But the food is awful I have gone 3 times hoping for a different result.

This place was adequate, there really is no better word for it than that. Upon arriving, an employee rushed to open the door for me, which was nice! 

Once inside, there appeared to be 2-3 teenage girls working. One of them took my order, not asking what I'd like, just standing at the register waiting for me to tell her. There were clearly at least 2 others in the back having an incredibly loud conversation. 

I ordered a mango blended lemonade, and a roast beef/ghost pepper jack panini on sourdough. The drink was fine- refreshing, but nothing I would return for. The sandwich was bland- which is surprising for something containing ghost pepper. There was virtually no flavor to be detected. I ordered chips, rather than the potato salad, so I can't speak on that, and the pickle spear was left out of my order. The price point was high for the quality of the food. 

Overall, it was fine. I probably won't return.

Car wash is decent but will leave areas in the car that could not be reached.  It's really apparent on my black truck.  Search for coupons but make sure they are printed out instead of on your phone as their their scanner will not read on the phone and the attendants won't adjust the price.... Only option is pay or leave.   The unlimited vacuum is a nice option.

Great sushi rolls and a pretty good menu. The servers are attentive just wish their front desk, host/hostesses were better... Every time we have gone there they are busy on their phones or are short and kind of rude. I'll return for the food and sushi but not the hostess/host service. Which is hard, I try not to judge places by people who don't serve me but every time I go there they have such poor attitudes.

So I was super hesitant about eating at this restaurant as it doesn't seem like a great place at first glance (I was looking for something more fancy than plastic baskets). However,  the staff was fantastic and the food was some of the best ever!. The owner's daughter and her friend were our servers (we asked since it seemed like a family run business). The server let me try the pork prior to ordering it and it was amazing! Between the 4 us at the table we got sevwral different things (ribs, pork, chicken) and it was the best BBQ I have had. I highly recommend this place!

So last night me and a couple friends went to this establishment for the first time. We made a reservation, which the lady over the phone was rude and it seemed like we were waisting her time. We showed up 15 min early and they seemed annoyed for some reason. 

We ordered our food and it took about 45-55 minutes to get our food. We ordered sushi! I don't know about you but sushi dosnt take that long. We wanted to get more but it was taking so long! 

After About 50 minutes our friends entrees rolled out and we asked how long out other order of sushi was going to take and the waiter said it could take up to an hour to get our order. It seemed the whole night that the waiter didn't want to help us because my soda and water never got filled up. 

My friend ordered a rib eye and it was cold and all the veggies were soggy! The other friend ordered a burger and it was good! But as for me and my wife we were really hungry and we're not being taken care of. We finally complained and we asked to talk to the manager came out. He told us that he was sorry but they only have 2 sushi chefs working tonight. Which for a restaurant that size should have more. He then tried handing my friend  some gift cards but all we wanted to do was get out of there and get our bill. 

The assistant manager didn't even take ownership of the situation, he just keep blaming other people for everything. After that the general manager came out and awkwardly asked us questions and what we needed to happen for us to have a present night. We wernt looking for a free meal, we wernt looking for anyone's handouts! He then told us he was going to take care of everything, but he failed to do so! He took the bill and charged us. After we walked out I talked to my buddy and told him that we wernt going to pay for this crap! I walked into the building and demanded that we get our money back! They gave us back our money and that's the only reason that they got 2 stars! I don't recommend this place to anyone. Too long of a wait for anything, and the service sucks. It's very loud and food was not good quality, except for the burger. They did have a cool looking place though but it wasn't enough for the experience we had.

I went with a group of seven for lunch on a Monday. We had reservations at noon and when we arrived promptly at our time, the front staff seemed confused about our reservation so we had to wait for a table. Table side service was okay but it took a long time to get our food. By 12:50 PM, we still hadn't received our meals. The food finally arrived almost an hour after we had ordered but a couple of people at my table still had to wait because there had been an error with their orders. The food was good and portion sizes were adequate. I ordered a salad and left with a take home box. I was really disappointed in how long it took to get our food. It was nearly a 90 minute lunch so probably not somewhere you want to go if you are limited on time.

Best breakfast eatery I've ever been to and I've been to other countries as well as many states. Excellent omelettes, pancakes etc. Bring your appetite...huge portions..enough to share for a few people!! Well price

Wonderful service and I got my food quickly. Last time I was here, I had a bad experience, so I'm glad that I gave this place another chance. Will come again. And their house salad dressing is fan-freaking-amazing.

Worst service we've ever had last night. Went to Kona with my mom and two kids last night. Normally I go for lunch with customers or with my wife on a date. I'd say I go to this kona about 5 times a month. The lunch staff is always fantastic and knows our orders at this point. Last night our service was The worst it's been there ever. We show up at 5:00 and the patio and bar were decently full but the regular part was pretty empty. We sat down and our server "Kate" was pretty quick to get our drink order. We had a 4 and a 2 year old with us and they get antsy if we sit for too long so we ordered drinks, appetizers, and the kids food to get things rolling. After our order we waited about 15 minutes and still no drinks.. finally we see her and said "are the drinks almost ready" and she kinda give us this look and returns with them. Another 15 minutes go by (total of 30 since our order) and still haven't received our appetizer and kids food. We looked around and people who walked in 10 minutes after us were already eating their meals. I looked at where the food is staged and saw two kids meals sitting up at the window and though, "oh good, they are coming out" I see Kate back there and wondering why she isn't grabbing them. About 7 minutes goes by and they are still sitting there. I wave our server over and ask why we haven't been given our app or kids food. At this point she gets extremely rude and starts raising her voice saying that it's happy hour and she can't control the kitchen. I politely say that I see two kids meals sitting up there for the last 10 minutes. She says well the sides aren't done. I say that that is fine, bring the chicken tenders so my kids can eat something. At that point I looked at my mom and said "do you want to just leave... I'm pissed" she said sure but then we would have to start over somewhere else with the kids...By the time she got back there the sides were in the meals. She brings the kids food and appetizers. We were given cold appetizers, cold chicken, and hot sides..... not ideal.  As soon as we take a couple bites of the appetizers our food arrives. Our food was good like it always was but our experience was already ruined. If I wasn't a semi regular at Kona I would never be back. The manager stopped by and asked how things were and at that point I didn't want want to chat about it. I didn't want a free dessert or anything else. I'm not one to complain to get something, but this server needs to learn customer service. She could clearly see we were waiting a long time. She could have said "I'm sorry the kitchen is backed up right now... is there anything I can do to help" or the sides aren't done, but the chicken is.. I know you have little ones, would you like me to bring the chicken out now so they can get started." But firing back at us and giving excuses about happy hour is bogus! And saying "I'm doing this best I can" with an extremely rude and condescending tone was not ideal. Will be awhile before I go back at dinner or with kids. I have an extremely bad taste in my mouth right now. Not the Kona I'm used to!

I love The Processing Bar! I am a client of Tisha's, and am continually blown away with the work that she does. Every hair stylist I've met here is not only sweet, but has incredible skill and produces beautiful hair. I get compliments on my hair everywhere I go!
I love the fun atmosphere, and the location is so cute. I highly recommend this salon to everyone I know!
I personally love seeing Tisha, but I know that every hair stylist here would exceed any expectations and execute beautiful work. You will not be disappointed!
I am a PB girl for life.

They ruined the paint on my car. Asked for them to fix it and they refuse. I would not use them at all. Phil the GM doesn't care and neither does the cooperate offices in Arizona 1-520-615-4000 is the phone number. We will never go back.

Bummer!  Another bad experience with Smoky Mountain.  They have great food, especially their pizza - but stick with delivery or takeout.  The customer service was horrible - we brought in a big group for a kid's pizza party - they gave us one server - we pre-ordered the pizza for the boys and then tried to order off the menu for parents and siblings.  The boys were done and the poor server was still trying to take orders when the boys were done - I asked if maybe someone could help and the manager made me feel like a criminal - said she was the only other server and the restaurant was full - uhh - it was not full!! She snapped and me and said that she did not realize that parents and sibs were going to order off the menu?  What would we do?  If someone would have told us it was going to be an issue with service, we would have ordered a pizza bar.  The parent that made the reservation DID tell the person who took the reservation that the everyone else would be ordering off the menu.  Plus, restaurants usually want to make make money?  The manager also was snotty to our coach who wanted to leave quickly to go and watch his daughter at another sporting event.  He tried to order an appetizer and a drink at the bar and the manager refused.  I think we were all ok with the situation until the staff was rude to us.  And,  there needs to be better planning.  I write few negative reviews and two have gone to SMP in the last two months.  No more SMP for us!

If I could give a zero star I would. Just read all the other bad reviews. This review is no different. They fell through on installation four times. I wasted four full days of work trying to get Internet installed. I heard enough apologies to last a lifetime and still didn't get service. Three out of four appointments were zeroed out by Install Techs or Dispatch. Lots of finger pointing but still no internet. Not understanding how this company stays in business.

Great place for good everything!  The drinks are amazing and so are the deserts. It's a little expensive but it's  worth it especially if your trying to go to a place with not as many kids as everywhere else.

Sofra was such a nice surprise.  While the service was a little slower, they made up for it with friendliness and helpfulness, not to mention the quality and flavor of food.  Their gyro surpasses that of the local drive thru gyro stand and other restaurants serving similar food. While their toppings are fewer, they do not lack as their flatbread is burrito sized and made in house, tender and full of flavor.  They don't skimp on the thickly shaven slices of beef and lamb, which are simply seasoned and not overpowering with  seasoning as I've experienced elsewhere.  Their tzakiki sauce was freshly made: nice, creamy greek-style yogurt with just a hint of dill and cucumber, and a touch of feta.  It was a good value considering the flavor and size ( their gyro is equivalent to 2 gyros at the drive thru).  My only wish would have been a couple peperoncini peppers, for a touch of heat. The French fries on the side, seemed a strange accompaniment, and would have preferred a more authentic side like a salad, but they were nicely golden brown and well seasoned.  Overall a great little cafe and well worth it.

First time going to this place and I think we found a good one.  We parked in front of the coffee shop right next door and as soon as we got out of the car we could smell the BBQ. Seriously, my mouth started watering. The aroma that filled the air was the very first part of what made this place great.
     When we walked in the setting was just fun. Lots of fun signs hung up all over the place and the hostess made us feel very welcome. She sat us and took our drink order very quickly. As we sat and waited for the waitress we looked over the menu. It had all the normal BBQ place items, which is perfect.  
     I ordered a sandwich that had pulled pork, brisket, and a hot dog.  My fiancé ordered the sandwich that had the meats and coleslaw on it. Both were amazing. The hot dog was perfect. Crispy with a little spice to it. The other meats were just melt in your mouth.  We tried all three sauces that were on the table and decided we liked the sweet one the best. 
     Thanks for having a very good fun place to eat good BBQ at. I know we will be returning again in the near future.

Thank you Edina!  The Cevape were the best!  I appreciated your hospitality and look forward to spending more time visiting!
Vera Boyovich
Eagle, Idaho

I live 4 hours away from town and didn't know they couldn't wash the car with the storage canoe on top. The manager got some guys to remove it for me and replaced it when I was done. A+++ for customer service!

Brought our 4 year old for her 6 month check up. Angela the dental hygienist was wonderful with our daughter.  The dentist Dr. Imam was very gentle and caring. I'll be back for my appointment and will update my experience.

We love Christian Brothers Automotive. They have worked on our classic car and it is now better than ever. They have the expertise and care to work on any type of car. The owner, Brett is great and Dave the service manager has been very helpful. They are better than your average car repair center - they practice honesty and integrity.

I've eaten here twice. The first time for lunch, and the second time we had food delivered for a work meeting.

The first time I ate at Kona Grill it was at the restaurant and (to be honest) it didn't look like my kind of place. I was actually gearing myself up for a disappointing lunch. Why? Just because the place looked a bit pretentious and I am not a fancy-mall-go-shopping-and-eat-an-expensive-lunch kind of a guy. Much to my surprise my lunch order of the Chicken Caprese sandwhich was actually quite delicious. So were the sweet potato fries and the dipping sauce that came with them. Surprise, surprise, surprise. We asked the server what was in the dipping sauce, but she wouldn't give it away. I'm pretty sure I figured it out, but no need to divulge secrets here (if indeed, it is even a secret).

I saw the other reviews here about slow service, but we were slightly early here and there was no issue with our food delivery and the server was friendly.

My next experience with Kona grill was for delivery to our office for a lunch meeting. We ordered the chicken pesto pasta salad, ceasar salad, bread, and brownies (and maybe another dish or two which I have forgotten). The food was delivered right on schedule (that's pretty important for lunch meetings) and arrived on nice plates which they pick up later. The chicken pesto pasta salad was quite good and had a bit of a kick to it. It was quite nice, and a nice change from our typical lunch meeting fare. The brownies looked great, but too rich for lunch. That didn't stop our other employees, though, as quite a few disappeared. 

So, well it's 2 for 2 so far for a restaurant that I wasn't expecting to like in the first place. I'm still not a fancy-mall-go-shopping-and-eat-an-expensive-lunch kind of a guy and I never will be but kudos to Kona grill for surprising me. Twice. Should I try for  three?

I've been to Twigs for lunch and dinner.  We had family in town and decided to stop in for happy hour.  The $6.00 martini on happy hour were only MAYBE 3/4 full.   Looked like they made 2 and split it three ways...Disappointing at best.  The appetizers were the same way.  Won't be back, will head to Kona Grill instead.

At first I really liked this place. That was until my meal came out, and it had sweet potato fries instead of regular fries. (I really don't care for sweet potato fries) I asked my server to just replace them with regular fries, she did, but didn't tell me there would be extra charge. The pork sandwich was just too spicy for me to eat so I told her, and asked her just to take it. I didn't want to wait for another meal so I didn't order anything else. When we got our check it had the charge for my sandwich as well as the regular fries. We asked the server why she charged us for the fries, and she said because it didn't come with the meal. I told her she didn't even tell us we were going to be charged. She just argued with us so we asked to speak to a manager. All he did was apologize for the confusion. They wouldn't take the meal off nor the fries off our bill. That's not really what bothers me its that they argued with us about the fry charge. Which the menu stats that there's a $1 extra charge for sweet potato fries. I worked in customer service for 10 years, and I would never treat my customers how they treated us. They were extremely rude, and didn't seem to care what we had to say. This was my first and last time at this place.

Wow! We are visiting from Nevada and came to Joe Mommas due to the reviews! Best decision we've made! Yum! Definitely have someone have the hash! Most delicious flavor ever! The pancakes are humongous, fluffy pancakes ever. Try the cranberry walnit. Definitely could split the pancake! Do not leave Boise without trying Joe Mommas!

Great BBQ. So glad this place has lasted and upgraded in Meridian. I always get the 3 meat combo because all the meat option are so good I can't decide. It usually lasts me do 2 meals. The Mac and cheese is my favorite side. The green beans are good but can be greasy sometimes. Always pleased everytime I go. Maybe the tap beer could be a little colder. Highly recommend!

Had breakfast here and it was fabulous. Ordered a two egg omelette with spinach, muenster cheese and bacon. It had tons of all three and was cooked perfectly. The potatoes were crispy and not greasy. The service was very attentive and friendly. Will definitely go again.

By far the worst service I've probably had. The lady at the register didn't say hello or even put a smile on our face. They didnt even have the hotdogs we ordered. Plus, she never gave us a number, so when our food was ready they had no idea who to give it to. The only reason I give two stars is because the food was good.

I've been a fan of Big Daddy's since before they opened this location.  Good food, done well and close to home.

It's not backyard bbq and can't be because it's a restaurant.  But when I'm too lazy to make it myself these guys are my go to.

Friendly staff, clean establishment, recommended.
I have to give you kudos to the right just. How she was able to handle group of dunks I thought it was okay to smoke in the restaurant

Good low priced drive through. Employees are friendly, very fast overall. Don't really understand some of the negative feedback prior to my comment, the employees certainly are friendly and do their job, the wash itself is more than satisfactory as it gets the job done quite nicely. Never had a negative experience here and don't expect to.

I just found this place. It offers so much more than a regular run-of-the-coffee-mill coffeehouse! Besides coffee, they also have exotic teas and smoothies. I had a delicious tropical smoothie, and was able to add protein and a fresh banana as well! LOVED it!  Cant wait to go back and try some of the lunch specials, particularly their chicken and rice bowl that looks delicious. It is decorated nicely, with a fun fountain in it. I took note of a couple of generous sized meeting rooms, that I will definitely keep in mind for meetings.
They told me they couldn't give me a price for a neuter/spay over the phone and then said that it might vary based on my pet. Something shady here! Use caution and shop around!

Food was ok - just ok. Service was a disappointment. Screw ups on everyone's orders before us and ours included. No large Kirin beers available, couldn't get anyone's orders right-bringing the wrong orders to all the tables, missing orders for a table. No ice in the ice machine & the employee had a customer go next door to the Express for ice. Total D-class joint & if it didn't have the Shige name & if I didn't purchase the recent Groupon, I wouldn't have come to Meridian from Boise to eat here.

My husband wanted Italian beef so we stopped by, it was closed.  Someone left a note on the door stating they've stopped by four times, none of which times they were open.  Patio furniture is still sitting out, so who knows what's going on.  Good thing I ordered Portillo's italian beef for his birthday.

Primarily a pet supply store, with your typical selection of common household pets (fish, a few birds, rodents, bunnies, reptiles etc.).  They also have a cat adoption center, which I think is wonderful!

Store is always clean and stocked.  Employees are always friendly, though I have felt on more than one occasion that there seemed to be a shortage of staff on hand.

 I can only review based on items for dogs and fish, as these are the pets that I currently own.  I find the overall selection of dog and fish supplies to be so-so.  They have something for each of your needs for these animals, but in many cases one option and that is it.  Prices I tend to find are actually a little higher than comparable stores like Pet Smart.  

Actual fish selection, in regards to fresh water fish, is mediocre.  They do seem to carry a few less common fish, which are fun to look at and consider, but there never seems to be anyone available to educate me on whether they would actually work in my community tank.  

Their return policy on fish is generous, I believe it is 3 weeks from purchase date.  I find it kind of odd that they don't want any proof that the fish actually died, just a sample of your tank water.  Seems a little too much on the honor system if you ask me.  Of the fish that I have purchased here, several haven't made it.  Not sure if this is lack of education on my part, or unhealthy fish.  My tank is well established, so I know I have to be at least doing something right.

Although the sandwiches were good, the cost and customer service were really sub-par.  We walked in and, this being our first time, the method of ordering was explained to us, although I can't say it was explained well.  I brought our ordering bags to the register and paid - um, wow $30 for two adult and 1 kid sandwich! But ok...  So, although there were at least 6 employees milling about, there were only about 4 halfheartedly working while the other were gossiping, complaining, etc. and it took forever to get our food.  Now, I must admit the sandwiches were fresh and good - bread was nice and soft, baked recently, lettuce was crisp and overall just a good sandwich but I don't think we will be returning since there are plenty of other faster, cheaper sandwich shops around the area.

Good for a quick, Tex-mex type meal or to snack on chips and salsa. 

However, at this particular location they have hired the most angsty teenaged boys to host. I always feel like I'm ruining their lives by showing up. No greeting, no verbal direction to which side of the restaurant they will lead you to, which can lead to said host tripping over you. The hosts are either totally silent, and really bad mimes, or they grunt at you. It's awkward.  Train your hosts!

On a high note, when you sit down, the waiters/waitresses are so attentive and enthusiastic, it makes up for the cave man act upon arrival. Wait staff is great!

Thought we would give this place a try, well we were wrong. Our waitress took our order, the food was brought out at reasonable time. The food had a lot to be desired, not very good. Our waitress never returned to our table to offer drink refills or ask if we needed any thing else. Won't be going back.

With the windows open on a warm sunny day, this place has a great atmosphere.  Looking at the menu while we were waiting got us excited - who does a Coulotte Steak anymore?  The three star rating was unfortunately for the execution on the food and drinks (normally a two star) and the recovery by the manager.

The Moscow Mules were not served in a copper cup.  I know that seems like a stupid thing, but it's half the fun of ordering the drink...especially for my wife and I who have a sentimental thing about it.  They were listed on the menu as such, which made us want to order them for nostalgia's sake.  The server looked at me like I was nuts when I asked about the cup (I probably am nuts, but that's independent of cup construction). The more important part was that they just tasted off - like someone used ginger pulp or ginger liquor instead.  Not undrinkable, but off.  So I gallantly downed my wife's drink and she ordered a Malbec which turned out to be fantastic.

We both ordered Pork Saltimbocca for dinner.  It was leathery and overcooked, but otherwise had all the salty-sweet flavor you want in that dish.  Unfortunately the mashed potatoes were a disc of glue under the pork, like the chef pretty much phoned it in.  The vegetables (the easiest part of the dish) were actually pretty amazing though.  

Did I mention we had an about-to-melt-down 10 month old in tow?  Normally I'd take the time to send something back if it was gawd awful, but in this case we dined and dashed.  I figured it would be wrong not to give the manager a head's up, so on our way out I chatted with him, and he was apologetic and gracious, gave us coupons for two free entrees, and handled it like a champ.  We'll go back, and probably try something that other reviewers have commented on.  Any suggestions?

I've been to Kona Grill twice. Both times I have been very impressed with how good this place is. Being from Hawaii, it's very difficult for me to find a restaurant that serves good Asian/Hawaiian food, especially in Boise. Since the place is named after a city in Hawaii, I was hoping to get authentic local food and they did not disappoint. The sushi rolls were amazing! My favorite would have to be the volcano, although I wish it came in a bigger portion. They also serve sushi rolls with rice paper wrappers, which I do not recommend getting unless you despise the taste of seaweed. Needless to say, I did not like it at all. Other than that, everything I've tried here has been great and it's a really nice place to go out on a date.

First time to this establishment.  Glad we called ahead and got our name on the list.  Highly recommend you do this too.   Simple decor... think that's a good thing.  Menu options a plenty.  Food was great. Pancake size of the whole plate.  I will MOST DEFINITELY go back!!! It worth it to me.  One down side though,  they should hold back a little on the gravy.

I have been here three times and I feel as though they are more interested in rushing me through to get to the next person than cutting my hair as requested. I have gone as far to show them a picture of a previous haircuts that I have had and they still mess it up. I will not be going back

The only place in town that serves authentic Balkan cuisine. It has been a long time coming but thankfully it's finally here! 
Ćevapi are a definite must try! ;)

Suggestion for Dutch Bros: Send someone out to the long line of cars to pre-take their orders. I've passed by many times because the line is always around the corner. 

I love Dutch Bros, and the college students working here are awesome! They always have cool stickers, too. Two thumbs up!

Apparently this place used to be a Durango's Mexican grill. The waitress mentioned it used to be a Mexican fast food joint but closed down. 

Don Diego replaced Durango's but Google maps isn't updated.
Great food, slow service....
Yum. We had bacon, eggs, hashbrowns and toast.  The bacon was perfect: crunchy and peppery and I appreciate breakfast places that offer hasbrowns. Friendly, quick and tasty.
Food was amazing! We had the best crab ragoon ever and the fondue beef wraps were delicious! Very clean and good priced. Great atmosphere:)

We have been here twice and equally bad both times. They are always empty but yet service takes forever. Both times our server was rude and it took 20 min just to get our drinks and then got mad when I asked for a water ( I had eaten some chips and salsa while waiting for my margarita). Usually when you over an alcoholic drink the server brings a water as well especially if your waiting. Won't be back.

Hands down my favorite Asian food! Period. 

My usual order - Rice noodles with grilled pork and crispy spring roll is a party in my mouth!

Staff was very friendly and the inside decor was appealing. The food was ok. No wow factors. The chief over seasoned everything from the rice to the veggies to the meat. We needed 6 cups of water to get thru the amount of sodium that was added.

My favorite coffee place in the nation. Hands down. I've been dreaming of this place ever since I came back to Pittsburgh. 
My favorite drink is an iced caramel macadamia nut latte with coconut milk. To. Die. For.

This restaurant is in a business park. Not very convenient to get to but, the service and the food were very good. Ordering was interesting. You can order, at times, from two different places. It's so busy that you think your order will take a long time but, no! They were pretty quick too!

Yes, I'll go back! The ladies who work are are very nice! Keep up the good work!

When asking a co worker where to take my kids for the week we were in boise she said the village! With no hesitation.  In explaining what  the water fountain looked like she said.... "Have you been to the bellagio in vegas?"  Lol! Giiirrrrrrllllll stop...let's just NOT ok. Lmbo! Needless to say it was nowhere  NEAR the bellagio but it WAS cute and the kids loved it.

The restaurant decor is really nice ,open and modern.
However, we found ourselves seated at a dirty table. When we mentioned the dirty table it was wiped down with a rag.
The menu has ample choices something for everyone.
The wait staff was sluggish at best, zombies.
The food so so..and the worst part was the paper nanpkins, and spotted flatware. For a $40 lunch not including alcoholic beverages, I expected better.
Will not be back and will not recommend.

This place is always a great time! The food is fresh and delicious! If you happen to have Lazaro or Brittany as your server/bartender you're in for an AMAZING EXCEPTIONAL EXPERIENCE! They know their menu and drinks (always a bonus)!!

I have used this car wash several times. Each time asking them to spray in problem crevice areas. Each time being waved off casually by the employee.  I'm tired of going home to finish shoddy wash job or going to another wash to have them finish the crappy wash I get at epic.   The employees couldn't be less concerned about it when I mention it.  Tired of being blown off by this place.  I'll drive a few extra miles from now on.  I get my car washed a minimum of once a week in the winter so it's not months and months of build up and every other Carwash simply sprays those hard to get areas before the run the car through.

Some bad meat and 3 piles of puke later and we found ourselves at All Valley Animal Care Center.

We had to call around to find a 24/hour vet and found it a bit frustrating when not a single one would tell us anything except "bring him in" which is reasonable considering his conditions; however, when asking All Valley they didn't give us a diagnosis but they gave us alternatives of what the problem could be rather than giving us the impression they just wanted our $70 after hour vet fee. 

Great service, wonderful staff and considerate to "owner frantics" - we felt confident taking our doberman here because of their personable staff who communicate, deliver & gave great attention to our pet's health.

Slow, slow, slow. 55 minutes for a deep dish pizza almost makes me think they forgot to put it in the oven. Food was ok but service was terrible. When our pizza was brought finally the waiter didn't bring plates (we had to ask) didn't bring a serving spatula and could barely be bothered to grunt at us beyond bringing the food. I had to go ask how much longer for the food as my kids were starving at that point I was looked at like I had just bothered them. Better idea, when you order they should tell you how long it takes to cook said pizza as we would have changed our mind on the order. Food was too expensive for what you get. Extremely under impressed. Won't go back. Ps, there were only 4 other patrons in the building so they weren't busy at all.

This was our 5th time visiting Kona.  Service was absolutely terrible!  Our server acted as if we were bothering him.  We told him at the beginning we would need separate checks, no big deal.  He only came back to our table once after our food came.  Kona Grill is just an overprices mess of a restaurant!  Not impressed, and this will be my last time visiting.

I love bruchi's. I travel to Tri-Cities quite often and always make it a point to stop and get a sandwich. So I was so excited to see it to come to Meridian. I've eaten at this bruchi's three or four times and each time I've gotten something different. I love the cheese steaks. The bread is always fresh and the amount of meat you get is crazy. But if you're not a Cheesesteak person check out the burgers and salads both delish.

Watch your charges on your bank card if you come here.  Not stopping again unless I have cash.  Authorized for one amount...charged another.  Not cool.  *Apparently the dollar added to my bill was a tip that I did not leave,

All I can say is OMG.. The food here was amazing and service was great.  Try the sandwich with the mac and cheese and pulled pork.  It was so delicious and I was absolutely stuffed... I went back and took the husband and he loved it too. I will be back.
Really beautiful. Very nice shopping center. Still under construction from when I visited November 2013. Visiting from Tacoma, Wa

I make a point to come here whenever I'm out in Meridian! I have liked everything I've tried, but I especially love the kebabs and the various pies. I had the spinach one last time and it was so fluffy and warm. The cabbage rolls are great too. 

I think my favorite thing here would have to be the bread. It's always fresh and I love to munch on it with tzatziki and hummus, I always make the mistake of filling up on before the main course comes out because it's so good.

Service is always quick and the food is always great. I recommend to anyone who loves Mediterranean food or is looking for something different.
The service is good. The food is not that great I've had better Italian food at corporate Italian restaurants. The only reason I ate my food was because I was starving after a long day of flying.

This is an amazing place. I love the people who work here. So informative and helpful. The experience feels like a billion dollars but so reasonably priced.
Wish I loves here so I could enjoy more than 2 times a year.
Get the crab cake benny with that potato casserole stuff(weekends only). Love this place!!
Love Big Daddy's, great BBQ.  I prefer the Prime Rib on the weekends.  The brand and Mac/cheese are tasty too.

I love the atmosphere at the village at meridian in general, however this restaurant in particular has a brownie that should be considered a meal in itself. Not only is it huge but it is also delicious, can't wait to see what the village brings next!
Best sushi I've had since I moved to Idaho...had excellent service and the staff was fantastic..... I would highly recommend this place to anyone.
I had the blue stack and the pancakes were so huge that I couldn't even eat 1/2 of one. They were very good. Cute place too.

Amazing breakfast, have ordered several different items and have left happy every time. They tend to be extremely busy, but the staff is never rude or flustered and they work hard to get you seated as soon as possible. The chorizo scramble is my favorite.

I have eaten here several times before and found the service and food to be very good.  However, the last two times I've gone to eat here I've been disappointed.  A couple weeks ago I had a turkey sandwich and was very disappointed by the size and lack of meat on the sandwich.  (I suspect they are in collusion with someone to put me on a diet.)  I really hate having a lunch and still being hungry afterwards.  Today I decided to give them another chance so I stopped by right at 11 am and found that they had not opened yet.  Their signs say they open at 11 am M-F.  After waiting till 11:10 am I decided to leave.  Others were gathering and then leaving also.  Now when I am adding this review on Yelp, there is a notice on Yelp that they are temporarily closed.  Hmmm.  Why can't they put a sign up at their business so people don't wait around for them to open?  I am uncertain whether I will give them another try.  There are several other good sandwich shops in the area that are just as convenient.
Incredibly disappointed- food was tasteless, orders were incorrect. Spinach dip tasted like flour paste, gyros were edible after being covered sauce. Do yourself a favor and don't go here

The food is good but the sushi chef is chinsy on the fish.  He puts a third of a piece of fish that is normally on a sushi roll.  For what they charge, at least give the people what they are paying for.  Store bought sushi rolls have more fish on them.  Not sure if I'll be going back anytime soon.
LOVE Kona's happy hour! I've never had a bad experience here. The bar tenders are fun & attentive and create an awesome atmosphere!

3.5 score for us....Everyone relax...we are not talking about Michelin star rated cuisine.   I try to come see these folks for a local bite of Asian food.  It is run by a quiet lady and the unseen kitchen staff/cook.  If you are needy and high maintenance, you may need to go to Olive Garden.  
I like the variety of offerings.  Try the deep fried mushroom app....from fresh mushrooms and light batter.  We had General tso's chicken and Szechuan beef.  Great tender beef...big portions....give them a try.

One of the coolest places in Boise!! You don't even have to spend money to have a good time just walking around and enjoying the architecture is enough. The fountain is a must see! It changes color and moves to the beat of the music. 

Perfect place to come with the family because of the movie theater and many different places to eat including everyones favorite snack in the summertime which is ice cream.

After our first visit to establish care and for a routine cleaning, I am lol eased with the service we received. The staff were friendly and helpful and the assistant and dentist were thorough and considerate.

This is my first Black Rock experience. Came through Sunday am around 9:30. Graciously greeted at the drive through window I mentioned it was my first time. Told her my usual favorite coffee drinks and she suggested an Iced Caramel White Mocha! Sooo Goood!

This place might look nice but looks aren't everything.  3 of us went on a Saturday evening and we sat in the bar area. The waitress seemed nice but wasn't very outgoing and hard to hear to a loud restaurant.  We ordered a salad, sushi sampler, and chicken sand which which took about 25-30 minutes to come out. The food was brought to us by a girl and guy in a shirt and tie, most likely a manager. He just looked like he didn't like his job. No smile, no comment, didn't even ask who's food was who's. We had to initiate the conversation.  I could tell the food had been under the heat lamp for awhile because the food was not very warm. The taste of the food was ok and is the only reason I'm giving it an extra star.  The waitress took awhile to get us our check. Will probably be the last time that go to Kona grill.  Can get much better service at a better price at 3-4 places right around it.

I've been here 3 times now, once for a regular manicure, once for a gel manicure and today for a gel pedicure. Each time I've had someone different and they all do a great job.
They are a little out of the way and probably easy to miss if you didn't know where exactly they were located. Their sign says they take walk-ins but I've always made an appointment - usually last minute and it's never a long wait. 
Lots of gel colors to choose from and it looks like they do lots of very cute nail art too, if that's your thing. 
My gel pedi today was just about 30 minutes, shorter than other places but I don't feel like anything was skipped. Very nice employees and clean shop.

If I could give 10 stars I absolutely would. My husband and I are in here AT LEAST once a week. Incredible food - brisket and pulled pork are our favorites, amazing service, amazing atmosphere. I could seriously rave about this place forever. They truly care about their customers. Shout out to Kolt who is the best waiter and always always takes great care of us!

Good selection for herring fish, feta cheese and various breads. Bought caviar was spoiled. Quite annoying when one package is no less than $7. Great for those with cravings for food from home that you cannot find just in any grocery store

Absolutely love this place! If your looking for a go to for a great date place, Kona Grill has you covered. Kona has the best HAPPY HOUR in Boise.  I first found this place in Las Vegas. I would rate the food a ten, the frozen margarita has just enough alcohol to get you buzz. The only thing that needs improvement is the customer service. Dave at the Summerlin location in Las Vegas was the bar tender with the best customer service. Thus far, I would rate Boise's service 4/10.

Absolute grubbery going down here! This place is the real deal. The guy at the front desk was friendly and quick to get us seated. Chicken fried steak is no joke. Most places have flat thin steak, this place gets their steaks from next door at porterhouse real good sized steak. Just like everyone else's comments state about the home fries, they are also scrumptious, the seasoning is something I wish I could do at home. You can always judge a breakfast joint by the way the eggs are cooked. Over medium eggs isn't that difficult to master but very few breakfast places get it correct, usually they are over done, these were perfect. The blueberry cream cheese stuffed French toast is also a winner for the sweet tooth lover in you family! It was amazing. The service was great, we got a very personable blonde with tattoos and she was attentive and quick to our every request. Even the cook working the grill was very friendly when we peered over the wall to catch a peek of the magical mastermind at work. When it was time to pay the piper the same guy who seated us was fun to talk to while running our card. It was quite obvious that everyone here we dealt with was positive and enjoyed being there. All in all this place is phenomenal. We are going back soon for the crab cake Benny's. I hear a lot about them on here and from someone else while we were there. Can't wait.

Our family started coming here 5 years ago.  We were afraid to leave our last dentist as they were the best.  But Dr Mortenson is awesome.  I had to have cavities filled in my wisdom teeth.  What a great experience.   Cody is our kids hygienist and is the best with them.  I have been scarred of dentists since I was a kid.  Never had an issue at Willow tree being scarred.
Love the fact that they give you options on your dental work cost before they do the work.  Highly recommend them as a dentist

At the insistence of another Yelper, I'll add this: Loma does not work here anymore. He was here to train sushi chefs and guided us through this special event. You will not have this identical experience if you dine here.

I cannot say enough complimentary things about Kona. I will say that I put off trying this restaurant because I tend to shy away from the trendy places and The Village at Meridian is certainly one of those; an outdoor mall with lots of places that intimidate me, as a weirdo. Very trendy and mainstream.

Right off the bat, I need to give big ups to Manager Michael T. and Sushi Chef Loma. Dear lord, those two took amazing care of us. If you like sushi, I think the only way to do it is to make sure that Loma is present, sit at the sushi bar, and take his recommendations. Don't order your standard CA roll, spicy tuna, blah blah; seriously, take his recommendations.

The sushi was unbelievably fresh and bright tasting. Everything we tried was off of the menu, so who knows if you'll ever get to try it. One of my favorites was tuna sashimi, topped with diced red onion and green apple, a tiny dab of herbed goat cheese, and a very traditional house-made ponzu. I don't care how weird that sounds to you, it made me cry. My wife has certain dietary restrictions right now and he had no problem not only catering to those needs, but making to-die-for bites that she went nuts over. He also recommended another off-menu item, the salmon cake (like a crab cake, but... salmon). There were so few bread crumbs that you basically got a ton of delicious salmon. Not only that, it's finished with all of these touches (roast corn in the mix, jalapeno / cream cheese on the bottom, buerre blanc, the list of awesome goes on and on).

Speaking for the restaurant in-general, we dug the modern decor. There is awesome lighting, bubble tanks, metal furniture, it all worked together very well. Servers were ridiculously friendly and helpful. People who I hadn't been working with at all would come up and refill my water, offer me another beer, clear our plates, etc. The menu itself goes for miles and will have something you'd like to try. There is much more to be had than sushi and everything looked killer.

I'm going to finish by repeating myself: Michael T. and Loma took amazing care of us. It is so obvious that they care about their patrons leaving happy, so you seriously have no excuse to leave dissatisfied. If something isn't right, I would tell a server. Like I said, everyone was friendly, understanding and eager to please.

The ONLY negative to this experience was the kicking myself feeling, muttering under my breath "Why did we wait so long to try this place...."

My first time going to Which Which and they are delicious with fun flavor combinations. They're pricier than say a Subway but that's because you're getting real meat and a hefty portion of goodness. I ordered the 7in turkey with stuffing and cranberry and OMG it was like Thanksgiving day all over again. I was worried about the amount of stuffing (I didn't want just a stuffing sandwich) and it was the perfect amount. The 7in was big enough to split between two meals for me although I'm a smaller person and was satisfied with that and their delicious homemade chips! For a 10 1/2in for the hubby, 7in for me, a bag of chips and large drink was $20 so not too bad for a quick dinner with leftovers for lunch the next day! The service was a tad slow but I think it was because they messed up my original order, but not long enough for me to say anything. The nice young man apologized about the wait and then gave me a coupon for a free sandwich next time! I thought that was so sweet and wasn't even necessary, but they went out of the way to offer it. The great food and customer service has definitely made us a returning customers.

Excellent beers all across, I like the Kölsch and Stouts the best! 
2 dollar Tuesdays are great, better come early to get a spot. Sometimes the Kilted Cod food truck is there but I wish they would do something else too.
Nothing special just like a goulash, chili or some cold cuts would earn you 5 stars easily!

Let's be honest; this isn't a fancy restaurant but rather a good Chinese fast food establishment. The food tastes good , the establishment is clean, and service is efficient. Despite the name, no panda meat is actually available.  

There are a few healthier options; they offer brown rice now as well as steam vegetables for sides. A lot of their main dishes aren't breaded, but I suspect there is a good amount of sugar in the sauces of most of the food. They also have one of the best ice teas I've ever had. 

In this particular establishment they offer seating outside, which is nice at the right time of the year. There are no booths, just chairs and tables.

Great store! Staff is always helpful and friendly. The store is always clean! If I call with a question to see if they've gotten something in yet they are always willing to go check or if I don't see my size out on the floor. Every time I go visit their store I'm excited as I drive there not just because I love their products, but because every time I shop there I have such a great experience because of their customer service.

Excellent service and car wash! Very impressed.

efficient management of the multiple vehicles waiting for their turn... great instructions !

Amazing, authentic Greek food with homemade pita bread. Make sure to get the house dressing if you're getting a salad- it's really good. The owner was very friendly and attentive to customers' needs. Will definitely be back next time I'm in town!
I love the atomosphere at Kona! They have tasty food. We love the passion fruit Crem Brule! The patio area is next to the water show, and it's just a gray addition to the Villiage.

I ate at Shari's at 9pm Friday... we saw a waitress wearing her  hair down flipping it. She went to the window to get food to serve scooped some butter with a scoop and licked her hand!!!! I am sickened by this being allowed in a nice restaurant that we enjoy eating at and we do frequent often. Rethinking our decisions of where to eat!!!

It wasn't bad- it was just on the boring side. The cheese steak sandwich had a good meat base, but it was lacking in flavor. It needed a sauce to give it some oomph! When we asked for Bruchis sauce, do you know what they gave us? Fry sauce...of which I'm not a fan- but to put on a cheese steak sandwich!? Not very interesting. 

My kids had kids hamburgers. They seemed fine- except that one was cooked only enough for the very outside edge to brown. The rest of the inside was a dark pink. We showed the workers at the counter, and they made it right. I'll chalk that one up to a new restaurant with new teenage workers. That's forgivable.

Will I go back? Definitely not. It was 'meh' boring food with no flare or imagination.

The Village is a nice wide open mall with lots to offer.  There are lots of shops and places to eat and drink.  There are also lots of areas to sit throughout the mall too.  We were sitting by the fountain and  all of a sudden Huey Lewis music starts playing loudly and they'd coordinated the fountain with the music.  It really made the atmosphere in the area fun.  On a sad note we went into a candy store after being nostalgic for some of the candies that we grew up with.  As we perused the store we found a corner with what we thought were joke candies.  We looked at the stuff and discovered some more "adult" type things that they really should not have out when children are going through the store.  We decided not to purchase anything and left immediately.
excellent!!!!!!   consistent, friendly, great ambiance, fantastic happy hour.  amazing staff!!!!! thank you!

Absolutely horrible service. Seated 30 minutes after our reservation. 6 in our party forced to sit at what was essentialły a 4 top booth. Took OVER ONE HOUR to get our food. Waitress was rude and extremely annoying. Will never return.

I came for a cheesesteak sandwich, I was really excited after always being disappointed when ordering a cheesesteak at other restaurants, to find a place that does it well. I went through the drive through and ordered a large drink and a 12" classic. As I opened it I made sure to save the sticker holding the wrapper on so that I could use it to save half of the sandwich. Took the first bite and was in my happy place, it's good!!!!!
