Next thing I knew the whole sandwich was gone and I'm trying to decide if it would be weird to hit the drive through again. Service was quick and pleasant. The sandwich was really good, exactly what I was hoping for, I know people have different opinions on what a good cheesesteak is, this is it for me.

Ginny cut and colored my hair, and did a fabulous job! She made sure I was cool with losing the length before she began. It's an immaculate salon, and she makes great suggestions. I love my hair, and I'm glad I found a stylist that I want to stick with.

Anyone looking at my reviews knows I give out way more 5 stars then one or two stars.  

I also have a theory with restaurants.  I never use YELP to rate the food so much.  People are different in what they like. So I really never thought for a restaurant that; that it's  fair to rate a restaurant on food.  Unless you find dirt in  food or something beyond normal. Some will like the fries some will not.  It personal opinion.  So restaurants stand great chance to get 5 stars from me.  Right a cross street at Kona Grill I gave them 5 stars.  And we will return to Kona. 

So my rating is based on service and overall fun experience.  Well Twigs failed here.  And the only person that should take any of the blame is the female manager.  

On a warm Boise night my family takes my in-laws to  the village.  My wife and I and two kids. And my wife's sister and her husband and their two kids.   We get to twigs about 10pm.  Only few people in restaurant; so we are all thinking maybe it's going to close soon.  I go in alone to find out.  No one at desk.  So I walk around till I find a waitress.  I ask her if they are open. She says they are and will be open for a while.  Cool let's eat here.  I go get the rest of my group.  They go inside.  My 9 year old WON in a Twigs sponsored contest a free order of  fries.  He brought the coupon with him but left it in car, so we go to car to get it,  5 min later we return and my group is  still in quiet restaurant waiting area, they have  not been seated as the staff is  fixing our  table.  

Stay with me and you will see how this comes together.  I asked and  I've been told the restaurant is going to be open.  My group is waiting 5 mins to be seated in empty ( maybe 10 other customers ) restaurant.   

So while we are being  seated I go wash up and go to bar.  I order $25 round of shots, from manager/bartender.  Two buck tip. She says she will bring the drinks out.  I now for first time sit down with my group.  They have waitress with them and are telling me to hurry up order that the kitchen closes in 10 minutes.  What?  I just asked and was told Twigs was going to be open for while.  My group would have had 15 minutes to order if we were seated immediately.  So while I was buying a $25 round my group is being told hurry up and order.  OK go with flow I think.  

Now remember the free French fry coupon my son WON from Twigs?  He has been holding onto it.  It expired unknown to any of us Dec 2013.   But he did not have someone give him a coupon he won it in a Twigs contest  when they first opened. How can a winning gift expire?  He wanted to use it sooner, but we always went to Konas or Big ALS.  So not my sons fault. He is 9 and did not know about expired dates..the very nice waitress says she will ask her manager if they will take it.  I know the manager, as I just bought 25 dollars in drinks.  I'll ask her. After all I just bought $25 in drinks and we will have a $100 dollar food bill soon.  

I speak to manager.  She says it expired last year.  Last year you mean 6 months ago.  She argues a year ago.  I argue 6 months ago. We agree Dec 2013.  And she even took these coupons in to Jan. to be used.  But my sons winnings are not valid anymore.  I tell her one strike, and two strikes we were told the restaurant was going to be open but are now being rushed.  She started explaining their hours of operation.  Which I did not care what the hours were I was just told they were going to be open.  I was not told we close in 15 or 10 mins.  3 strike the manager did nothing to compromise on any of my complaints. She saved the company of Twigs $6 for not honoring the French fry coupon.  But how many more $25 rounds did Twigs loose by not making an acception.  How many more $100 dinners did Twigs loose out on for not honoring the coupon.  I wonder if twigs will be happy that the manager saved $6 for company.   The manager will say she apologized to me.  But explaining the store hours or saying I wonder who told you that is not an apology.  A good manager would been at my table and apologizing to my group for rushing them.  And thanking my son for holding onto his coupon for a year as the manager said,   ,,,,,or 6 months as I said.  Thanking my son That his constant commitment and badgering his parents to eat there paid off.  

So now my group is not impressed.  My son sees nothing cool about this place anymore.    And I think the manager sucks.  As she is taking money from me for a fun nite at Twigs while my guest are being rushed.  I think Twigs owes me 27 in drinks and an order of French fries.  

Kona Grill made more money tonight.

Drove past this place this morning while I was looking to satisfy my bagel craves and just had to check this place out for lunch. I'm so happy that I found a place that does Hawaiian mac salad! Love the kalua pork with coconut rice and if you have a gluten-intolerance or celiac, I recommend the elote salad (which is a corn salad) to go with the kalua pork. My partner and I will be back

Went to Twig's on a Sunday for lunch. The place was surprisingly empty but I was kind of glad considering it is brand new which generally equals bedlam trying to get a table. We were seated immediately and given the food menu and extensive drink menu. They have a huge selection of martinis and mixed drinks, which I would hope since they are a martini bar. They've got mojitos, martinis, margaritas and lots of drinks that are made with their signature lemonade. Tons of wine selection and a decent amount of beer. 

For lunch we ordered the Turkey BLT Wrap and the Fajita Chicken Salad which happens to be gluten free (salad, not the wrap). The food came relatively quickly and was hot and as ordered. My sister enjoyed her wrap, said the basil mayo paired with the basil that was sprinkled on the fries was almost borderline too much basil but overall she enjoyed her sandwich and fries. The fries had a little kick apparently. My Fajita Chicken Salad was excellent-- the chicken was tender and moist and the veggies were cooked perfectly. The chipotle ranch pair well. The salad was quite large, you have the option to order a half which I suggest for lunch. 

Overall it was a good experience, the restaurant gave off a good vibe without being overly pretentious.

Beautiful!  I don't know that I've ever seen such a gorgeous outdoor shopping center!

 Brought here by a Local to dine at one of the restaurants, I couldn't get over the care that went into the design and construction.  I have never been one to prefer dining outside because most of the time it's in someone's parking lot, but to have it designed FOR outdoor dining with a view of the mini Bellagio-type fountains, complete with music and lights...well, I would be here all the time if I lived nearby!

We very much enjoyed our lunch at Kona Grill, then enjoyed walking around and checking out some of the stores.  Even when we needed to find a restroom, I was blown away by the gorgeous office area and the incredibly nice restroom!

As if all that wasn't enough, we checked out the Movie Theater...WOW!  Unfortunately we didn't have time on this trip to see a movie, but what a beautiful theater!

We drive through Boise on our way to WA. If we stay overnight, we'll drive the extra 25 miles to drive in to Eagle to eat at Joe Mamma's. Fresh, made from scratch everything. The Eggs Benedict are flawless and the house potatoes delicious. Ask for Erica! She's an awesome server.

If I could give this business zero stars, I would.  

I had an older car that went thru alternators like they were candy.  When we were preparing to move to the Boise area, the alternator went out, and I was basically stranded.  Blindly, I went to the first shop I found - this one.  

I explained that my alternator was on warranty with a national auto-parts chain (and called the local store personally to ensure that there would be no charge).  I also knew that this was an easy job - I had watched my preferred mechanic (in our home state) do the job in under 30 minutes.  They assured me that the job would be done the next day.

The next day, I get my car, and a bill for $600.  WHAT?  I knew that the alternator would've cost approx. $300, but I had one on warranty, so there shouldn't have been a charge.  I got them to drop that, since it was such an obvious overcharge, but could not get them to budge on the $300 in labor...for a 30-minute job.  Dealerships don't even charge this much.  

When I've shared my story word-of-mouth, I hear other people's experiences, and they're very similar.  Stay far, far away from this shop - your car and wallet will thank you for it.

My wife and I went here for dinner to try it out, the service staff was kind and quick. The food could use some work. I ordered there special, prime rib finger steaks, they were ok I would order them again. My wife ordered a combo plate with brisket and pulled pork both were flavorless and room temperature. Her mash potatoes were sitting out because the outside was cold. The Mac n cheese however was amazing. I would try it again in the hopes that we just went at a bad time( middle of the week at 7pm).

This place is great! My two favorite therapists are Natalia and Julia. Julia is from the Boise location but she was filling in here amd im so amazed with her. 
I always leave feeling 120%happy with my service. 
Thank you ladies for always taking such good care of me

A unique sandwich place.  You get to pick the ingredients and mark your choices on little paper bags.  Probably fun for little kids.  

The best bread, and probably the highest quality ingredients of any sandwich shop in town.  While the sandwiches take longer to prepare than say Jimmy Johns, the ingredients are of a much higher quality.  

For example, jimmy johns avocado comes as a premixed processed spread that they squeeze out of a factory packed plastic bag.  The avocados at which wich are actual slices of a real avocado.  You will taste the difference.  

They have desert here.  Milkshakes and cookies which I haven't tried.  

Good luck sandwich eaters.

Grab any of their mochas! Seriously! I'm not a huge mocha fan, but theirs are sooo yummy here.  I specifically like the Double Torture - sweet but still strong. I got introduced to Dutch Bros Coffee by a local when in Bend and for the rest of my trip I was searching these shops out.  Yes, this is a chain, but it's delicious and worth a stop. They are located all over the west coast.  They have a killer business model, great coffee drinks, and happy employees wherever you go.  This location was super easy to get to and they were pretty fast.  You can enjoy any of their drinks hot, blended or iced.  I loved that the iced beverages weren't watered down.  If you don't drink dairy, they have milk alternatives such as soy, almond, and coconut.  Have you ever subbed coconut milk in your coffee drink? It's awesome.  If you need caffeine, check this place out!

Kona grill is a hip and fun environment, it is stylish and clean. It is not too loud so good for conversation and chairs are comfortable. What lacks at kona grill is the service, we sat in the bar during happy hour, our server could not take more than 5 drink orders at once, when we asked to order food too, once he finally came back we ordered. The food came out and was sub par. Our caprese sandwich came and was well made but the fries must have been at the bottom of the batch and were burnt and few. We mentioned it to Tim, our server, and he failed to acknowledge it. The food is decent and the environment is fun, but there are things that need to be changed within the servers.

Local automotive shop in Meridian Idaho. 
Brett and Sandy Clancy of Christian Brothers were amazing and so incredibly caring. Family owned operated. Loved our service we got there on our car.

A little bit of a wait on Mother's Day.  But well worth the wait.  Tasted fresh and home cooked.  Delicious! Several of the staff checked on us. The freshly made chips were delicious! Had the veggie burrito, yummy.
Has gotten very expensive. 1 adult and 3 kid-size cups for over $20. I'll skip next door next time for Sonic.

Walked in at 8pm on a Tuesday, so we weren't expecting a packed house. The place was absolutely empty. The young hostess/server was busy sweeping the carpet, but quickly acknowledged us and seated us.
We ordered crab rangoon, I had a fat tire, my wife had a glass of cab, and we wandered thru the extensive menu.

I ordered the charbroiled pork plate, my wife ordered a Vietnamese prepared catfish dish, but was warned that it would take 30 min. To prepare, so she opted for a spicy chicken dish. We also ordered a mixed protein fried rice in a clay pot to see what it was, knowing we would be taking it home.

The wait wasn't bad, the food was fresh, delicious and generously portioned. The fried rice was especially good. Not as greasy or salty as most tend to be, and even better warmed up for breakfast.

All told, we will be back. Don't let an empty room scare you away.

Meh. There's better sandwiches for much less around here. You fill out what you want on your sandwich on a bag that you grab at the door. They give you red sharpies to mark it and take the bag from you to make the sandwich. All that and they still got mine wrong. It was right in front of them. C'mon. 

The guys there were very nice making sure we understood the menu. They seemed dumbfounded when I said my order was wrong. I was, too, as the bag was right in front of them when they made it. The meat in my Italian was tasty and a bit spicy (which is good) but the bread was VERY thick. It took quite a while to make the sandwiches, too. I had almost all of my chips and drink finished before we got them. On the plus side, they carry Zapps Voodoo chips. 

I probably won't come back here unless you're paying. Let me know if you want my punch card.
Great Pizza! Great hot dog! The food was so good. We really liked this place. Really clean. Kids have their own table and the people are super friendly. Awesome!!

My new favorite breakfast place. These folks know how to do it. A long wait on a Saturday morning but it's worth it. The half order options are nice, so that you can still breathe afterwards, and the sausage patty is a must try. Thank you for living up to all the hype!

Wife and I traveling with dog and booked this hotel. Fairly new and accepts pets. Mid class type hotel with fresh breakfast and coffee in lobby. Staff was exceptional. Room was spotless. Had  fridge and very clean room. Very pleased with stay and will look into this chain for future travels.

The French fries with Gorgonzola cheese were very creative and tasty. 
The crab and artichoke dip was delicious. 
The shrimp and grits with jalapeño slices was crazy good !
The Lime basil kamikaze was perfectly mixed. 
The downtown Manhattan was delicious. 
Now for the entree: the Osso bucco pork shank was melt in your mouth tender and was perfectly seasoned.
I will be back.

We had to attend our son's graduation from ARMY basic training and found ourselves with a dilemma. Our Golden Retriever, Charlie, was due the day we were set to return. I called All Valley and spoke with Dr. Amy. She assured me in the event Charlie had the puppies while we were gone, they would take care of everything. The second day we were in Georgia we got the call. First puppy was born. She had 9 healthy puppies. All are doing great. Words cannot express out gratitude for the excellent care mom and puppies received. The entire staff was fantastic. They went above and beyond expectations. I highly recommend All Valley Animal Care Center to everyone.

I have been here twice and wont be going back. The first time we went was when they first opened so I let the blunders of that night go. Went with a group of 6 adults and a child last night. My husband ordered a coctail. There was no alcohol in it. We did get it corrected. We ordered the gouda fondue, it was ok, the apples it was served with were brown and had seeds in them. The candle was not lit so the cheese got cold and started to get lumpy. I had a side salad which was fine and a BBQ chicken flatbread. It didn't have cilantro as specified which I love. It was just ok, the sauce was a little spicy but lacked depth of flavor. My husband ordered calamari which is his favorite and said it was bland but the sauce it was served with was ok. He compared his sushi to Fred Meyer. Nothing horrible, just not worth the money for very average food. My M-I-L and young niece both had mashed potatoes. Both of them said they were very spicy. So we all tried them and they were weirdly spicy. Not at all ok to serve to an unsuspecting 6 year old. My M-I-L ended up sending her plate back and ordering something different. It took forever for her to get her food. She asked to cancel the order, they brought it out to her packaged to go instead. 

I asked a question about another item that I did not order it had a sauce on it - I asked what the sauce was and was told it is name of the sauce. (I don't recall actual name of the sauce) this is not helpful information. I know how to read - I don't know what the sauce is made of. At the Village there are lots of better options and won't be going back here. The decor however is really fun and I like that and my niece loved the aquarium.

Every time we go to Twigs we are happy with the food and the waitstaff that takes care of us. The manager here in Meridian is an awesome guy and is willing to make your time here at Twigs and enjoyable event. I saw him checking on the guests multiple times, running food and helping with drinks many times. He isn't above his staff, but works with them. I feel like that is why the environment there is so great. This is our go-to dine out restaurant in Meridian. Highly recommend it to everybody.

Wonderful place.  Arrived early for my appointment.  Staff was very friendly and the atmosphere normal.  Could have been an anomaly but didn't experience and kids running around screaming like a typical doctor office. 

Doctor experience was great.  He was super friendly and explained thoroughly the issue he saw I was having. 

This is a place you visit only if you need to.  I don't plan on being back here again unless I have another foot issue.  If I do have another foot issue, I'll be back for sure!!!
Definitely recommended this place for car wash, reasonable price. My car was full of dirt on the rims and body, but it was shiny after the car wash.

This was my second visit to Twigs and both times I have been equally impressed. A bit on the spendy side but absolutely worth it. This visit we hit up the happy hour before seeing a movie next door. I had an amazing Moscow mule and some great apps to share. Definitely get the traditional fries with the Gorgonzola sauce. To die for!!

If the electric company shut off your power a day before they were supposed to you could file acclaim against them for spoiled food. These jerks cut off the phone and Internet service without telling us and then go "whoopsie, Sorry about that".

This is some of the best Bosnian food I have ever had, as close to home cooking as one can get! Trying the Bosnian food in the different cities we travel to is a must, so happily surprised to see there was some in Boise.

First, I must say how clean and welcoming the restaurant itself is. It is in a nice area of town, in a strip mall that offered plenty of safe and convenient parking. The owner greeted us and took our order when we were ready and answered our questions. She was very kind and friendly and even took time to have a chat with us at the end of meal.

We ordered the Cevapi lunch special, it came with french fries and a huge drink. The cevapi sandwich was tasty (not overly salty as cevapi tends to be) and the bread it comes on was fresh and moist. The french fries were super-duper hot, obviously freshly made. No one wants cold fries, right?! We also ordered the Sirnika (cheese pie) and Burek (meat pie) combination plate, which came with a nice, refreshing salad. The cheese is home-made and so is the phyllo dough. You can tell by the mouth watering smell and delicious taste that someone's mother made these pies with love. Both were so amazing, in fact, we ordered another two to take home after the meal! 

Overall, great choice for a casual meal. Generous portions, appealing presentation and reasonable prices.

If you are thinking about trying Sofra, stop delaying and go today....right now!

We finally went and ate at Kona Grill (Sat Aug 8th).  I  say finally because there wasn't a line and we were immediately seated.  We were a party of 4 with intentions of eating at another restaurant.  As we entered the restaurant we noticed the very up to date décor and beautiful fish tank.  I asked to be seated near the aquarium and we were seated next to this amazing view.

We started out with 2 orders of pot stickers and they were fabulous!

I ordered sushi Crab Crunch, Crab Special and Shrimp Tempura rolls (EXCELLENT!)
My wife ordered the Cuban sandwich (yes, I snacked on her meal), brother in law ordered the Big Kahuna Cheeseburger, my sister ordered the Avocado Chicken Club.

And for the finale I ordered the "Ultimate Fudge Brownie" and let me tell you that was a slice of Heaven...  yum, yum, yum...  This dessert was enough for all 4 of us and yes they ate their share.  This is a great place to eat when it is not packed.  Which, by the way means it is a very good restaurant.  

It is a fun place to eat.  If you think it is too loud you should eat at a fast food restaurant.

I use to rave about this place, Im pretty sure the vet that saved my Cujo from Parvo by taking time to teach me how to do an IV at home and really explaining everything I could do to pull him through it, only charging me for the fluid bag and medication when I came in with a very sick puppy and told her I couldn't afford to treat him has been fired for being too kind...  This place is no longer about the animals. The vets are greedy, they spend the entire exam trying to push expensive and unnecessary procedures on you and if you can't afford them? You're basically told "Sorry, you can just take your dog home to die a slow and painful death, NEXT!" Better have a gun with a bullet ready, in case after spending 800 dollars on tests and treatments that dont work you can't afford another 200 dollars euthanize... They really don't care about you or your pet. My elderly mother took her Jack Russel in for a teeth cleaning. They told her when she admitted him, that her bill would be 280 dollars. That was fine, she could afford it.... When she came to get him? The bill was 864 dollars and the vet, without contacting her, had pulled all but six of his teeth out of his head and tacked a whole bunch of other things on that he didnt even need. They recommend the humane society... Well thanks to all the bitching from the vet hospitals around Boise about how to humane society was cutting into their business, they no longer offer most services. God forbid the vet can't afford his Lexus payment because someone doesn't have thousands of dollars to spend on their best friend. Another fine example of their greed? Low income shot clinic, one of their vets screwed up the vaccines and now my little guy is in so much pain and is so sick he has not moved in 48 hours. He's a stalker dog. He has not been more then twenty feet from me since he was 3 weeks old. I offered him a piece of steak? He just laid there, stiff and whimpering and staring at the wall... I explained that having just spent 130 dollars on this vaccine that is killing my dog, I cant afford to pay them to help him and asked if there was any advise they could give me or anything they could do to help. I was snarkily informed that even though they are the cause of my dogs problem, an office visit is 60 dollars... Dont take your dog here if you want a vet that gives a shit about anything other then his pay check. Shame on you All Valley.
Excellent food.  Eggs Benedict was awesome as always and the home fries red potatoes are great.  Nice location, quieter than Boise Overland one.  Will definitely eat here often.

My wife and I visited here during Happy Hour based on a positive recommendation from a few of my co-workers. We were warmly greeted and sat at the bar. Our bartender was Karen and she was extremely friendly and genuine. We each had a couple of drinks that were poured/prepared correctly and professionally. We had the potstickers and a sushi roll off of the Happy Hour menu. They were both delicious and very fresh. One of the managers, Maddie, thanked us for coming in and when we saw her notice one of her employees do something wrong, we saw her address her professionally, coach her positively and make it right for the customers. This is service that you should expect for your valuable money and time. The only reason for not giving 5 stars is that I think they should have all beers on the happy hour menu. They are still $3.50, so it's not like they are still not making money.

Appetizer: Shrimp Tempura Roll - Perfectly good!

Order 1: Club Sandwich with Fries:  
Didn't really care for this at all. I felt like a cold make a better sandwich at home. The lunch meat was so cold it made it taste cheap. The shoe string fries appeared like that scraps at the end of a batch.

Order 2: Japanese Udon with Black Been Sauce
This dish was good. Very fresh red and green peppers, tender steak strips, and fluffy udon noodles. 

Dessert: Butter cake w/ raspberry sauce. The cake was great but there was very little sauce, which the dish really needs to balance the sweetness of the cake. 

A bit disappointed that when I went to order Pad Thai, which I was dying for the waiter informed me that it was VERY spicy, and that other customers had not been able to eat it due to the spice level. So I had to switch my order to the noodles.

Our waiter (Jason) was great!

I've been here twice with both boys. Both times seemed like I was bothering them by giving them my service. Hair cuts were average and rushed. They do keep notes which is nice but you may not get the same person and results vary from stylist to stylist.
I love Dutch Bros - especially this location. It is so nice for them to run up to the cars lined up and take their orders so that when we pull up, our drinks are ready for us!

Vina, I had so much hope for you. Blaring fluorescent light is sometimes the sign of no frills greatness. Not in this case. The austere decor is symbolic of lackluster all-around performance.

Another Pho disappointment. What little herbs were delivered were not on the side, but were instead thrown in the bowl. Green onion, I can appreciate, but raw white onion slices were overpowering. The beef was so so.

I don't think I will be going here again.

We gathered at Twigs with a large group.  The ambience is nice.  The menu is quite extensive.  And the server was prompt and attentive.  I had the Kalua Pork Sandwich with signature fries.  My wife had the TNT Coulotte steak.  Several others had the tacos from the Happy Hour Menu, which was a good value.  Both my sandwich and my wife's steak arrived luke warm.  I suspect they cook the food ahead and just assemble it as the orders come in.  Our food was tasty and the presentation of the food was great.  I am not one to like fries much, but the signature fries were delicious.  While I enjoyed the meal, I am not sure I would rush back to try this again.  I thought many of the food items were pricey.

This is a stylish restaurant with a varied and interesting menu. My husbands Cuban sandwich was delicious, and my salad was great (beet/pear/walnut/blue cheese and chicken). The service was good. It is more mellow than both the yard house and the kona grill. It is family friendly. The prices were reasonable. We will go back.
Good customer service. Decent coffee, messed up order twice but fixed it both times. Espresso sometimes tastes burnt but I think that's just the bean they use. Overall good
The Village Meridian is a fine, yet superficial place where suburbanites gather.   It is also a place where urbanites shudder when recognized.

This place never ceases to impress us. Great brews that change regularly, consistently friendly and happy servers, and a clean well decorated venue make this the perfect location to relax and have a few. They also let you bring in your own food (or have delivered)- which is awesome. Always looking forward to our next visit!!
It's the cleaner tastier smarter subway...with pizazz.
Best breakfast spot in Eagle.  Might have to wait a while to get in but worth it.  Very good drip coffee, also offer espresso's.  Every menu item We've tried has been great.

The menu is very low on vegetarian options, so I ordered the caprese sandwich without chicken, which baffled the waiter. The sandwich itself tasted okay but had a mayo-based pesto, which was pretty overpowering. Unfortunately it had none of the fresh tomato, fresh basil or balsamic flavor I expect in a caprese dish.

The sweet potato fries were great - my son devoured them. The portions were appropriate, meaning not huge piles of food but enough to be satisfying. I suspect many guests will claim there's "not enough food."

Regarding the atmosphere, I don't feel Kona Grill has a real identity. It looks a certain way on the surface, but on the inside, it was hot, noisy and full of strollers and high chairs. The menu options are all over the place including shrimp, burgers and pizza.

The service was prompt and friendly without being annoying. We'll probably go back, but I won't order the caprese sandwich again.

2 for 2 on the dishes we tried!

 Caribbean Chicken: juicy with great flavor and a spiciness that set in later (rather than overpowering the initial flavor)
 Kona Chopped salad (with breaded chicken, bacon, and grape tomatoes): had fresh, great tasting ingredients with a nice mix of crunchy, juicy, and fulfilling

The drinks are expensive and okay. For the price, I would appreciate if they made them less sweet.

The service was fine.

The ambiance rocks. I'm really psyched on the "mini-Vegas" they've created at the Village and Kona Grill has seating right next to the fountain show.


Disclaimer: Food fluctuates with the chef of the night, so I'm not sure the food will always be as good as we had it that night.
I stopped in before I went to the airport.  The service was great! Food is excellent. The employees like their job and the customers love the food! Highly recommended!

I had some hemming issues with some pants and had to make 3 trips to the store (I was residing in payette) Becca went above and beyond with her professionalism and helping me out with my frustrations. Great customer service!

I loved this coffee shop! Stopped by while running errands and stepped into a tropical paradise-perfect break from a hot summer day. Lots of plants and a water feature. I was greeted with a friendly "aloha" , then the baristas answered my questions, made a nice cold brewed coffee and I was on my way. I'll definitely be back.

I love this mom and Pop barbecue shop.  Food is fresh to order and the customer service is amazing.  I often pick up a meal to go and bring it to meetings where people often ask where I got it. No need to advertise because once you see this food you'll be sold. I've tried the beef brisket tacos -which are very filling since they come in three tacos. I love the California pulled pork sandwich too. They have sauces on the side in the store and both sauces are great!

Great place to get your pancake fix.We had to wait to be seated,there was a waiting line which usually proves it's a great place to eat and that proved to be the case.Joe Momma's is our next favorite place to eat.
GREAT BEER! I believe they have some of the best beer in town. Outstanding selection. All their beers are well thought out, tasty, and in good balance. Highly recommend!!!

I'm visiting the area from LA. Want a local breakfast place and Joe Momma's is great. Though they have local favorites and very delicious looking specials i went with the traditional. Food was fantastic, serves very friendly and fast, but my favorite was the bread. They use a special bakery, I have to say it was the best bread I've ever had. Than you for a great experience!

The place - I think this has become my go-to spot for fine dining in the village!  Walking in, the place is super trendy with a bar area, seating area, and backroom that was open to the public but capable of holding private parties.  

The service - the hostess was less than friendly but our server was amazing even though she was in training!  Although we had a designated waitress, other staff weren't hesitant to step in and fill waters and help with whatever I needed which was nice and made for quick service throughout the dining experience.

The food - outstanding!  My date and I got the twigs house burger and the fiesta/fajita salad.  I don't know if I've eaten a tastier salad in Boise!  The burger was cooked perfectly to medium rare with fresh toppings. The salad was crisp with lots of toppings and an amazing flavor.  Our waitress even brought us a plate of pickle spears per my request!  

My only regret is not trying any of their signature martini's, but I will be sure to on my next visit!

First time and not impressed, upon arrival, the two girls that were working taking orders were out in the parking lot chatting.   Made order of sausage/meatball sandwich and a polish dog. There was only 1 person preparing food and handling the bar while all the rest were just visiting with friends. Waited 15 min. for a plain polish dog and finally asked for money back.  Felt like a hangout for high school kids (and their friends that don't work there).  First time I've experienced total non-professional people in an establishment in Boise/Meridian!

Went for dinner on a Monday evening. The service was excellent, I believe our servers name was Alex. She was very accommodating. The service was great. The food was great! We sat in the lounge and it was very loud.(music). We asked the manager about the level of music, he said the fountain music outside was loud. I understand we were in the lounge but the dining room was no better. People usually like to talk while eating dinner...not shout!
Maybe next time we sit outside!?
First meal of the day was here. Food was amazing, service was good, and I would come again! On Wednesday's it's free pie day! How neat is that?! I highly recommend it if you're ever in Idaho (:

Some of the best (if not the best) tea I've had in Idaho. They don't fill the cups with ice, which is great. Most other places do and your drink is gone in just a few minutes. We got a Thai tea with boba and an Almond flavored milk tea with boba and both agreed that it was the best Thai tea we've ever had. 
We didn't try any food, but it all looked and sounded great. 
The employees and owner were very friendly. They both asked how we were doing and made sure that we got punch cards. I hope they find lots of success and loyal fans in the treasure valley.  
I'll definitely be back and will be sure to bring friends.
Worst fajitas I have ever experienced. Very low quality meat that tasted pitiful. Maybe the enchiladas or burritos are better, but I would avoid the fajitas.
I haven't even stepped foot in this place and already extremely disappointed. I've been trying for two days to make an appointment with them. Left messages. No returned call.
Fantastic, delicious and enormius portions.  The staff is so friendly.  I love this place and plan on visiting there again this weekend.  Desserts to die for too!
Great food, fresh every day. Fantastic portions. As someone who is trying all breakfast spots in the valley, this one ranks up towards the top!
Amazing authentic Bosnian food! Try cevapi and the meat pie (Burek). The desserts are also delicious. Nice and clean place and staff.

So happy Bruchi's came to Idaho. Went there about a week after opening. It was delicious! I normally like steak for cheesesteaks but here I actually love the chicken. Get the chicken supreme, you won't be disappointed. I think the negative reviews on here aren't giving a new place a chance to get into their groove yet. I will back all the time!
This is the worst Mexican food I have ever had. We did have a hostess and our waitress was quick, even though she was clearly overwhelmed. The food was just awful though.

I am looking forward to my next visit. The restaurant is clean and the staff is friendly and knowledgeable. I ordered four meals to go and a milk tea while waiting. They offered me homemade banana bread while waiting...oh my lord, it was incredible! Full of banana flavor and soft and moist. Seriously incredible. The waffle used for sandwiches appear to be croissant dough! The brisket was a bit dry and they don't have real cheddar, which is a bummer, but overall, super excited to go back and try the Noodle soup, which looks like Pho. So yes, this place is highly recommended!
This is one of the best places to eat in Eagle. Great food and large portions with great customer service.

Outstanding Haircut/Haircut Experience. My 1st time to Mane St, so this is what I thought. Full disclosure, my previous stylist did my hair from 1979 - 2015 when he passed away. I'm kinda particular. I also have a very dinged up head, more stitches than a baseball, so I don't bring a nice round noggin to the shop. Mali was waiting for me when I arrived, and I told her about all the divots and 
whoop-d-dos involved with my head, and she went to work. My former hairstylist would be proud. I waited a day to make my critique, but I think she did great. Better than I expected, because of all the "issues" I carry with head configuration. I believe I have a new hair caretaker! Thanks Mali

Visiting from out of town and stumbled across Joe Momma's and we're so glad we did. Excellent eggs Benedict (The Joe Bennie) with the home fried potatoes. Great corned beef hash too. We both loved it. Really nice staff. Absolutely recommend going!
Went here expecting great things.  The food was really salty, and for a martini bar, they did not make a good side car martini.  Won't be back...
Blown away by the food and service each time I visit this great restaurant. My favorite is the chicken & broccoli stir fry and the Wave roll. Calle takes great care of us each time we visit.
First time trying and it was great. Great food and boba! And its only 5 mins from where we live. Definitely will come back and try more of their menu!

My father in law was visiting from Arkansas so we decided to eat here after seeing a movie.  The food was good and the service was wonderful.  My wife found a hair in her dinner, though it was replaced promptly and without hesitation.  Nothing can be perfect all the time.  All in all, a nice dinner with the family.  Reservations are recommended.

The lady who did my nails made them lumpy, uneven and crooked. Not worth the 25$ fill, didn't even try to do the design I asked for after telling me she would try her best to do so. Waste of time and money

Yay for service that doesn't suck in the first month of being open!!!

I ordered the Sashimi flight and loved it all. It was a bit over-priced for what I got, but still delicious. I didn't order the sushi but I saw several plates go by and was so very underwhelmed by how it looked. I hope they spunk that up a bit.

This review for Cindy is long over due. Cindy is awesome! Not only is she great with hair... she is also fun to talk to. Never an awkward pause or a dull moment. Her prices are reasonable and you'll leave looking fabulous!

This place is amazing. 

First off having gone there several times I've had several different people wait on me and their staff is great. They answer all my silly little questions and have all be pleasant to talk to. 

The food though is what really matters and it does not disappoint. Their gyro is honestly the best I've ever had and since I've realized that I just keep ordering it. But I've had the meat pie and that was fantastic.
Try the mocha mo for an interesting change in lattes and regular coffee . The cold drinks are even better especially this time of year.

There was one taco choice that I thought was good (wish I knew which one it was) the other two tacos... Some of the worst tastes I've had in a long time. I started freaking out that I wasnt going to be able to down my food in front of the guys who I was with and requested that we eat here. Just not a fan. Sorry. Best part of the meal was actually the peach dessert things that they had.

This Dutch Brothers is across from the high school in Meridian.  So if you go in the morning at 8:25 like I did today plan on a bit of a delay.  6 cars on one side and 6 on the other side. 12 cars in total. :)   And most of the cars were filled with more than one high school kid.  And no I did not get a total number of people in both lines. That would be silly.  So my point of telling you all this useless information is that I got my  mocha in 7 minutes of pulling up.  And it gave me 7 minutes to count cars not people and think about what I drank before high school.. I think it was  chocolate milk or orange juice.  Man How times have changed.  And I'm getting old.   So if your driving by this location and the lines look long just know they get you though pretty quickly and are very friendly ( a bit much something)  but better than the alternative I guess.    Oh I almost forgot. ... I'm not an expert coffee drinker. ( coffee snob)  but the coffee is very good as well.  Sorry if I offended any of you  coffee snobs out there.  :)

OK so many of our friends said they had pleasant experiences....  So I thought we give another try.  

When you go to the front counter just like last time no one is there.  But someone showed up and we got a table.  After few minutes waitress came by and asked us if our waitress had showed up. She had not. Few more minutes same waitress came back saying she told our waitress that she had customers.  Few more minutes waitress showed up.  She had no clue to the beer list and left to find out.  She came back.  We ordered immediately as not to cause another trip.  

Bottom line is we will not be back.   To many other options.  Kona Grill is excellent and we will try Yardhouse next time.     

And really good restaurants respond to the people that post poor reviews.  Just shows this place is not on top of things.
If you like salt you will love this place. All of our food was SO salty!!! So salty it was hard to eat :/. Martinis and environment were amazing but they use way too much salt in their food :(

It sure ain't your momma's kitchen. The food was both innovative and delicious. So good in fact that I was psyched when starving after skiing and still had half of the enormous burrito. The red potatoes with beets and bacon is a must have!!

Their breakfast was bleh. They had the signature waffle machine but for people who avoid carbs like me, there wasn't much to choose from. 

Rooms were spacious, clean and we liked it for a night. The pool was really great, too. 

My kids love the cookies at the counter at night!
We had great service and my husband really liked the chicken fried steak.  It is the first time I ever saw one that was juicy and did not require a knife to cut through it.
Lots of options to choose from, big portions, friendly staff and great food! We loved it and will be back, thank you!
Delicious breakfast. Great eggs & bacon. Nice to enjoy brunch in the outside breezeway.

Best car wash in the valley. If you purchase the premium wash you get a free wash to be used within 4 days. The employees are friendly and always help with your payments. I won't use any other car wash in town. Reasonable prices with great results.

Good homemade breakfast food, very respectable in every way except one. They don't have real maple syrup and their fake syrup is a poor choice, at least it was the one time we tried it.

Everything else is fantastic, the chicken-fried steak is top-shelf, and their hollandaise is as well.

I would be glad to pay more for my pancakes so I could get real maple syrup, even if there was a premium $1.99 add-on to get it, or something, I would go for it every time. Seems like a margin-increasing opportunity for the owners to at least offer it for a premium price.
This place is a delicious little gem in Idaho. The staff is friendly and the dishes are spot on. I ordered the Sonoma chicken and was very pleased. We will definitely be back.

I was on vacation visiting family and on April 10th we decided to try this place. We were all newbies in ordering.  The gentlemen that helped us was so patient in showing us how to order, etc.  I had the Muffuletta with added Provolone cheese.  I loved it.  They may be a little pricey compared to other sandwich chains.  But they have numerous sandwiches and the ability to make your own choices.   I just discovered that I have one near me in So. Calif.  To the employee OR manager, thank you so much for your patience.  I would definitely go there again.

This is a good little family owned restaurant, Servers are friendly and food is good. They dont have some dishes on the menu that you would expect to see like fajitas but they will still whip them up for you. Thanks Chef

Pros: Good food, great bar scene, good for late nights. 

Cons: Too Expensive, tiny portions.

One of the best Winco's around...  I've been shopping here since it opened.  I also shop at Wal-Mart because Winco doesn't have all of the items that I need, (Spicy chicken patties, adult diapers, vitamins) but their prices are better or comparable to Wal-mart.  Albertsons and Fred Meyer's prices are horrible in comparison.

They used to not take debit cards which was a pain, but since they have started taking the debit cards, now it's a pleasant shopping experience.  

I don't expect much in the way of customer service from the employees, I'm just happy to be able to save money.  Most of the time they just do their job and ignore me.

I have seen moldy fruit, but I just don't buy it.  Any fruit I do get I check very well...  Apples are good, however smaller than at other stores etc...

I have seen frozen food sitting out in the middle of the aisle for hours late at night, and again, there are certain items like waffles that don't do well once they are re-thawed, so I just don't buy those at Winco.

We try to get in a lane at checkout that looks like the people checking out might be good at bagging their own items so we don't have to wait.  Stay away from lanes with people and overly full carts... It will take them FOREVER to bag all of their stuff.

Winco has THE BEST chocolate cupcakes.  I have compared all the stores around and they are the best!  Also love the fresh made bagels!

Wal-mart is always out of stock on stuff I want so I trek over to Winco and they have it in stock.  Way to go Winco!
This place has good food but a 47min wait is not good service and that is why I think that a wait like that deserves a crap 1star rating

If you've never been here before, ordering is very different.  Don't expect any help, the staff was not helpful or friendly at all, even after telling them we had never been there before.

After getting home, the sandwiches were pretty good, but for the poor service and the expense, there are too many other good sandwich places to choose from.
Free outdoor movies in the summer.  Bunch of toys for kids.  Lots of grass.  Fun park.

I bought my boyfriend an unlimited car wash pass for this location and today going through the car wash we came out with a HUGE crack in his windshield. There was no preexisting cracks or chips, his windshield was perfect. The people there were no help and told us they could do nothing. We are still waiting for a call back from customer service.

I was recommended Joe Momma's by a co-worker on a recent business trip to Boise, and I was glad to find out about this little place. I ate the first breakfast at my hotel, and was left disappointed, which is not surprising.

I had the green chili omelette with the almost egg whites, and it was damn tasty.

Two thumbs up from me, and I'll come here again the next time I'm in Boise!
This is a nice clean and great place to eat and hang out with ur family great food nice service

The entire team at Meridian Auto is amazing. I stumbled onto them in 2008 after I just moved here and needed a car new battery.  They have been taking good care of me ever since.  I trust that the repairs they suggest, as well as the routine maintenance are what my car needs and are not over-the-top in an attempt to swindle me.  I know I can go to them with anything and that I will get their honest diagnosis on my car.  They even helped me find the car I recently purchased - I could *not* be happier!

Prices were cheap but food wasn't fantastic. It was okay while we were eating it because w were starving, but as we continued it became less appetizing. It was cheap and cheaply made, 4/10 stars. TBH, there are better BBQ places

Cafe Ole is a slick, strip mall Mexican restaurant with two locations (I think) in Boise and Meridian, ID. Absolutely nothing wrong with it - it just doesn't rise above the completion (it doesn't fall below them either). Food seems more commercially prepared than handmade, but I could be wrong. I guess what I'm saying is it is a comfortable place to get good Mexican food, with good service and good prices. It is close to us, so it is a quick and easy place to eat. One exceptional offering is the salsa bar, it has many offerings and is very good.

A friend and I came in on a Saturday morning about 9:15. It was PACKED but we got a two people table really fast. Service was slow, but they were really busy so it could be expected.  I ordered an omelet, hash browns, and toast. Again, it took a really really long time to get our food, but it was worth it. The omelet was jam packed with cheese and ham. 

If I was here on a normal day, the slowness would not have been an issue, but we did have to go to work. If you have time to relax and enjoy a nice home made breakfast def, go to Joe Momma's. I can't wait to go again when I can really sit and enjoy the atmosphere and my food!

I really enjoy the Village.  Some good shops, a nice movie theater (with $5 tix on Tuesdays!), and many bars and restaurants that rock.  Not only are all the businesses there pretty great, but the atmosphere is fun.  Pretty lit up fountains, an ice skating rink, Christmas lights, music, beautiful buildings...  It's fun and trendy and a great place to spend a night out any day of the week.
The sandwiches are great other than the fact that they are not true to size.  A 6 inch is more of a 4 inch.  My Boyfriend and I were disappointed twice now.

We came here with a party of 8. The food was good but service was terrible the server forgot someone's food and we were all finished before he finally got his meal. Our drinks took forever as well. For the price of the food and drinks I would rather spend my money elsewhere where the service is better.
The calamari and an apple martini (well, 2 cuz it was happy hr) I enjoyed iT all and had to walk home ; drinks worth the $

Paid for the $11 shine wash but when I got home it looked like I only got the $7 wash, tires were not shined and  truck was still dirty. It did a good job on painted surface but running boards, grill and tires and wheels still very dirty.
They were very busy so I'm sure I was just mixed up with another customer. If I do ever go back I will only get the $7 wash so I'll at least get what I pay for.
Also get a receipt so you can prove what you paid for, I told the girl I didn't want one, mistake.

First time here. Nice relaxed atmosphere with reggae music playing. The staff was very friendly. And the food.....YUMMY!! I got kahlua pig, coconut rice & Hawaiian macaroni salad. The portions are huge! I could only eat half! We will definitely be back!!! OH!! And the bamboo plates & wooden utensils are super cool! Mahalo!!
The name always had me curious. So finally stopped in. Very good wrap. And the potato salad was very good also. Now the drinks. They where awesome. Definitely worth trying out.
This gas station is awsome! The coffee is great, there's one on every corner and this one was walking distance

I went in to Bono's on the Thursday of their opening week. Seemed to be a decent amount of people in line, mostly people on their lunch break. On this first visit, I pretty much just wanted to get a menu, but decided to get two cookies and a cannoli (I am a cannoli FIEND) to go. The cookies are ok - good if you like a lot of chocolate chips. As far as the cannoli...it was probably the worst I have ever had. The shell was really thin and crispy and it tasted like they used orange zest or something in it. I couldn't even really taste the filling, but maybe that was because I couldn't get past the grossness of the shell. In any case, I would have given them a 2/5 for that.

HOWEVER, I did end up trying it again for the pizza. I do not eat meat, so I got a straight up cheese pizza. It was DELICIOUS. Totally a classic Chicago pizza, deep dish, not greasy, and tons of sauce on top. Definitely something I would get again, only I would probably get more adventurous and add some veggies, because no doubt it would be even more tasty.

My family tried their meatball sandwich and sausage sandwich. I was told that they were both quite tasty and they would have them again.

Based on that, I upped my rating to 4/5 stars. I would definitely go back for their pizza, sounds like the sandwiches are pretty good, and the atmosphere is ok (they have some booths which is nice, and a "man cave" with a television playing sports). Just be wary of the desserts they offer if you go, they're a complete miss.

Worst car wash ever!!!! Car got stuck inside today as the washer thingy's smashed into my car. There was a guy inside watching who shut the car wash off and told me to drive out and go around for a re-wash! When I did the manager freaked out and told me to go to the end of the line. The line was out onto the Pine Ave about 20 cars deep! Crappy car wash, crappy manager, crappy customer service! Never again!! Canceling my frequent flyer program! KMA Metro! You're not the only game in town! Hope you go out of business soon!!

The only thing missing from this park is more shade.  Otherwise it's pretty awesome. It has a water play area that isn't too intimidating with only big water dumps but smaller sprinklers too. There is a little kids area, a rock climbing area, a preschooler area with a pirate theme that focuses on balance, climbing and running.  There are multiple swing sets and a gigantic lawn to run on.

One of the worst experiences I have ever had in a restaurant, the waiter was very inattentive and seemingly inexperienced considering he was identified as a trainer. Considering that I travel frequently for business and eat out 3 times a day, I have never had worse service than at the Kona Grill at the Village in Meridian, ID. The manager offered the party some complementary appetizer vouchers to compensate for the inadequate service that we received during the visit, which we left with the tab. I will not be returning any time in the future. I strongly recommend avoiding the Kona Grill in the Meridian Village should you want a pleasant dinning experience.

This place is AWESOME!! Joe Momma's beats the best of Lake Tahoe! And I'm not just saying that lightly. Chicken fried steak was super tender, service awesome and environment welcoming, not sure about the farm animal pictures on the wall up high though... Otherwise delicious!!

I really enjoyed it. Get the ahi tower. Very good. Also enjoyed the variety of a whole different menu in the back side of sushi isn't your thing. Great ambiance I thought.  Beer selection little shy though.

The Pesto Chicken was fantastic! Don't order a pizza unless you want to be disappointed... Service was excellent, quick and my water was always full. 

Wish they had Coke products...

I accidentally discovered this place while driving for Uber Eats. Brought the wife back to try it. Ended up ordering too much food. It's so delicious. The bread is fresh and delicious. The bean soup is hardy. The sausage is delicious. Do your self a favor. Go check it out.

I must have been to a different place than the other reviewers. The place is plain much like the food. The meals were bland and not appealing.  Probably the worst representation of food I've had in a while. 

I had flautas which had no flavor and were over cooked. The tamale served to me also was bland.  Wife had a combination plate that was flavorless too. Save yourself the time.  

Disappointed especially from the radio ad hype and reading the other reviews. I should have just went across the street to Taco Time. 

Staff was nice and always checked up on us. More of a lunch counter than a restaurant.

I had a scheduled appointment for my dog for a simple check up.  It was 45 minutes before we were even brought back to a room and another 25 before a vet actually came in to see us.  The vet was great, but I wish they'd told me they were "short staffed" when I checked in, or even called ahead of time to let me know.  I lugged my newborn baby there with me and would have gladly rescheduled.  The front desk people were ruuuude.  Not going back

Went on a Wednesday night with friends around 6. The restaurant was busy, but we were seated right away. 
We ordered drinks, beer etc...  Took forever to get them. My wife ordered shrimp tempura, what she received was beer battered shrimp. The waiter explained that is Kona's version of tempura. It was whimpy and bland. Our friends complained that the bread, they ordered sandwiches, was soggy. No offer from the waiter to fix it or offer another entree. Poor quality of food for the price. Won't go back.

i have been here quite a few times but tonight was amazing. the food was so good, salad was awesome i tried something new....and the waitress was phenomenal! Miss Cassie (sassy) was just like talking to a close friend. She was cheerful, kind, gave us great suggestions and was on top of getting our drinks refilled before they were running out! Fabulous server, fabulous team member, fabulous person!! Absolute wonderful night.
The staff is so friendly and helpful at this location! They're even polite while standing in the height of the heat!
The best I've ever had. Staff is incredibly accommodating and is good at what they do - massages! go you will be hooked and will not have to look further!

Dr Knighton does it again! My little Betharoo needed a miracle to fix her heart, and he was able to successfully fix her heart condition called a PDA with surgery.  She's a homeless dog and she didn't have anyone to help her! He helped her!! She's made it through surgery because of his skills, now she just needs to keep up the good work of recovering.  Thanks again All Valley for having such caring and wonderful staff.

Mother's Day you can expect a wait. Ours was an hour. Watching people get seated before you that showed up later than you was frustrating. After being seated we plenty of time to read the menu as it took 20 minutes for our waitress to come to the table. We then waited an hour for our food. People seated 30 minutes after us were already eating. Our food was cold and the sauce was watered down. Previous experiences were good but this was enough that I will not be back.

If you like a welcoming atmosphere, music, food, drinks and people watching......this might be the best place in the Treasure Valley for you! This is where my wife and I go to sit back and unwind.........mainly to observe the random people and discussing what we "think" we see. Of cores this is after we enjoy a lovely dinner and a few drinks at one of the many eateries available within only a few feet of each other. We have even enjoyed some very cool winter night in the Village as all seating is found in close proxcemity to a heater of some sort. If you haven't been here yet...............stop what you are doing and check it out.
Great drive through hot cocoa! Convenient and easy.
Delicious !!  Best fresh cut hash browns without GREASE EVER.   Love making my own omelette

We love Smokey Mountain but this one gets a slight ding. The quality of food was lower than what we are used to at this pizzeria. The cook must've been off his/her game. They were also short handed which is not good for any restaurant. Alas, we still enjoy a great the Smokey Mountain food and will visit again.

My wife and I had lunch Sunday and it was terrific. Food was great and ambiance was perfect. I had the Avocado BLT Wrap - this was the best wrap ever! Kudos to the chef. My wife had a salad with grilled chicken - outstanding! A magical setting outside on the patio. Highly recommend this place!
Good wash and friendly service!  The 4 day guarantee on the Protect Wash is great.  You essentially get 2 washes for the price of 1.

I tried the Polish sausage which was tasty. I thought the cannoli was really good. It wasnt too sweet. They let us sample the frozen custards which were super yummy. The strawberry one tasted like strawberry shortcake.  We also sampled the Italian beef which had good flavor. Next time the pizza! I would definitely eat there again and Im from Chicago so very picky. I like the decor inside.
Excellent new restaurant to enjoy in Meridian.  Excellent atmosphere and very hip. The food and service was very good!  I think I will be dreaming about the drunken donuts for some to come.
Hidden away, but well worth the find. The sandwich and soup combo was the perfect size for me. The bread was fresh and soft. Great meal!
Uninspired pho (more like glorified ramen), unfriendly staff
Quick review and short and sweet.  This is fantastic BBQ.  Yum.  You will have great food in a good atmosphere.   Have a beer with your BBQ and enjoy.  The Carolina sauce is authentic with a twist.

Delicious and unique drinks with a Hawaiian style. I have only been here twice but enjoyed it both times, once for a cold drink and once for a hot one. Service is friendly and the environment is cozy and exotic with an indoor fountain and Hawaiian decor. Prices are comparable to other coffee shops in the area but they seem to have more unique items on their menu.
Dave did a great job explaining the problem and working with my aftermarket warranty policy to get the repair done correctly.

A BBQ artist. Wow it's hard to find good authentic BBQ and I just found it at big Daddy's. Amazing flavor - love the spicy sauce! Big generous portions. I come to Boise once a month and this is on my "must stop" spot. Wish I had one of these in Seattle!

Positive - great service, open until 10

Negative - I love it cold but this place was freezing. I remember when I lived in Idaho, smoky mountain was the best but now it has gone down hill. Our party ordered a half santa fe and half thai. Both varieties were terrible. We used to love the Thai. The crust was super thin and limp (no crunch). I will not be back. We had some leftovers and I ended up throwing it out (I usually love pizza leftovers).

Don Diego's is fabulous! The owners are amazing and always come out to check on their customers. The food is so good, always consistent and service is great. If you are looking for great mexican this is your place and well worth the drive!!
The atmosphere and service at Kona Grill was truly amazing! The food delightful (avocado egg rolls..amazing). I will definitely return!
Great boba tea and very friendly owner. Highly recommended for a tasty drink ( I got the Honeydew smoothie with boba for my friend and the milk tea for myself...and we both loved our drinks)

I was very impressed.  Tried the clam chowder and the sushi sampler.  All the food was excellent and made me want to go back.  The service was very good also as well at the atmosphere.  It's pretty pricey so won't be going there a lot but will definitely be going back.
The cheesesteak supreme was on point... option for cheez whiz would be great and the condiment bar needs horseradish and some Franks red hot or other hot sauce options.

Top notch facility, all around! Great staff, competitive pricing, very clean facility. I have spent a good deal of time on the range there and always a blast. Even had the gunsmith do a couple things for me and was surprised at how low the prices are. If you are a vet the deals get even better.

For example, I had been looking for a new rifle. The one I wanted was either special order, or out of stock from every where else I checked. I went in and talk to Blake. He said no problem and had my new BCM there a week later. Great deal and one of many great experiences.

These guys really know there stuff and their prices are reasonable.  I use them for all our vehicles.

Rich

Great food, slow service....  We had issue with very slow service and brought it to attention of manger.  She gave us gift card for future and apologized.  Good enough for us.  We will go back. Love the pancakes that are as big as the table.

I really felt like trying a new (for me) Thai restaurant tonight, and man was this place the wrong choice!  It started fine with very tasty cha gio, although we got the appetizer 15 minutes before our drinks arrived.  The rest of the meal was a disaster.  There was one waitress for the entire restaurant, and she was running as fast as she could.  There was no way she could keep up.  I asked for the yellow curry chicken to be extra spicy - asian hot, not Boise hot.  In spite of the large number of red flakes floating in the curry, there was almost no discernable heat.  The chicken in the dish was dry and crumbly, the rice on the side was dry and hard, and the curry flavor was mediocre at best.  The curry dish was mostly composed of potatoes, with a little carrot and chicken.  My wife had the stir fried flat noodles with shrimp and vegetables, and the minimal flavor the noodles had was not pleasant.   Even the water we had to wait 20 minutes to get, didn't taste good.  We won't be going back.

Atmosphere:
The atmosphere is what you'd expect in a gun store. It's clean, we'll organize and individuals safety is the first priority. 

Sales Associates:
The sales associates are knowledgeable when it comes to guns. 

Prices:
The prices are reasonable, comparable to other gun stores

Classes:
They have great classes

Most importantly... would I come back
Yes!

Very underwhelmed. I ordered the Las Vegas roll which was not crispy and it's not served with wasabi and ginger. I've never been to a sushi place that doesn't serve wasabi and ginger. Then I ordered the Cuban sandwich. The sandwich and meat was cold and the cheese barely melted. The menu stated that it came with house made pickles but instead I had raw cucumber on my sandwich. The manager happened to be walking around checking on tables so I mentioned that my sandwich was cold. Of course he offered to have it re-maded but I declined because I didn't want to go through the process of waiting for a new plate and then be eating after everyone else at my table was finished. The manager shrugged his shoulders and walked away offering no other solution.  I really want to give this place another try because everything on the menu sounded delicious. Just wished the plates came out as the menu described them. On a positive note I had the pineapple cilantro cocktail and it was amazing!!

If there was a negative star rating possible i would give All Valley a  -5. 

I had two very negative encounters with this facility and would highly recommend anyone requiring care for their pet seek an alternative solution if possible. 

My experience all started with wanting to transport my black lab to Hawaii. They have very stringent rabies entrance requirements and process which spans at a minimum of 120 days (self quarantine). I did extensive research on the internet and provided all the forms documentation and instructions required for pet travel to HI. 

The first time I met with the staff I explained the protocol required and provided all the forms, detailed documentation, and instructions. They indicated they had never dealt with HI or International travel requirements and would need to research. They did however provide me with a an estimate of $511 to cover the FAVN test, Pet Heath inspection and Pet Health certificate required by HI for Entrance. They quoted the FAVN test at $270, and the Pet Health inspection/certificate at  $195. I paid in advance the $511 to get the process started. (October 2012)

I thought the fee for the FAVN test was a bit high so I went to the KSU  web site and found the test fee was only $70. There is only one place for civilians to get a FAVN test and that is Kansas State University - also mandated by HI. I took this info back to All Valley and explained I thought a 4X markup was a bit steep. Jason their 'PR guy' agreed and they refunded $120. So far so good.

Bad experience #1 - December 2012. My lab had developed an ear infection in November while I was in HI, so when I returned to Boise I took her in to All Valley to get treated. After checking in and being escorted to a waiting room I sat for over an hour with no one so much as sticking their head in the room and saying we'll be with you in a bit. So I got up and walked out, took my dog to another vet I had used in the past. I walked in, no appointment, and they were treating my dog in about 15 minutes.

Bad Experience #2 - March 2013
I returned to All Valley after the required 120 waiting period for the self quarantine process and asked to talk to the office manager. I had decided not to take my dog to HI. I requested a refund for the Pet Inspection/Pet certificate charges as this service had not been performed and wasn't going to be. She looked at the paperwork and explained it had been several months ago that I was in and charged for the services. I had to point out that it was a 120 day process and was just returning when the next steps were to occur. She went and consulted with Dr. Knighton and returned to explain that they weren't going to refund the fees for services that had not been performed. Their explination was that the vet (a recent graduate) that was assigned to my case had spent a lot of time researching what was required by HI for the process. I found that totally unacceptable as I had provided all the documentation, instructions, requirements necessary - all she had to do was read them. My perception is that I was paying for professional services for my animal - Pet Inspection/Health Certificate (which was never performed)  not staff continuing education. I felt totally ripped off.

Evaluate your options before putting down your hard earned $$$ - my view this guys a thief.

Nicest workers that helped me out today! First time here and they were extremely helpful! Freshest bread... And delicious soup- 
Can't wait to come back!

Twigs is a fantastic place to stop in for a work lunch meeting or cozy romantic place for a date night.  Food is excellent every single time.  

My favorite for lunch is the steak salad. I switch out the Gorgonzola with feta, and it is perfect.  The steak addition is so nicely seasoned that it really adds such a nice touch.  

For dinner I like the twigs filet. It is the perfect small portion of steak and veggies.  My steak has always been cooked exactly as requested so they have a great chef/cook on staff! 

Dessert is alway creme brûlée.  Nothing too fancy about it.  Would be nice if it came with fresh berries, but it's still good just plain. 

Suggestion for twigs: make sure on to go orders to ensure everything ordered is in the bag.   Twice I've had to go back, Park, Walk in to get what they forgot to put in the bag.  Food is always delicious though!!!
Food was gross, soggy, service was poor. Go to the one in Boise instead! Went with four different people and everything was bad except the taco salad.

Great place to hang out, eat out at Yard House or Kona Grill and then go to a movie or bowling at Big Als.  This is the best place to do it all in the Boise Area.   Sit by the fountain and enjoy the outdoor fireplaces.  This is the place to be!   If you have time to work out, before dinner, come check out the best high tech gym, Axiom.  This place has a lap pool and the best equipment you have ever seen!

Came here for Happy Hour with my Mom and Significant Other and it was fantastic! We ordered quite a few of the Happy Hour specials, lettuce wraps, rainbow roll sushi, slider burgers, avocado egg rolls and a Margarita. So much food for 3 ppl and my goodness it was tasty! The service was also funny, friendly and attentive. In the middle of our experience we were already discussing when we could come back with my Dad. Truly a great place for happy hour! Also the fish was super fresh (probably bc it was Thursday and that's when most sushi places get deliveries) either way super tasty and a great experience!

Just came back from my first outing to Big Daddy's BBQ.  My son has eaten there several times and highly recommended this eatery.   The 50/50 sandwich (pulled pork and beef brisket) with french fries is what I choose for my inaugural meal.  I was not disappointed.  The meat was cooked perfectly and melted in my mouth. I choose the sweet bbq sauce for the condiment.  Excellent flavor. The coleslaw was great also.  Not too sweet.  Not too sour or bland.  BBQ is one of those things where when you do it right, like Big Daddy's, it's a culinary delight. You can pay much much more for BBQ in the Treasure Valley, but in my opinion, you can't find better.  My son had the pork ribs/smashed potatoes/mac 'n' cheese. which looked amazing as well.

I love the concept of this store.  It's big and clean and well stocked.  As other reviews have said, they have great BBQ supplies and they even have a BBQ pit in the back that serves BBQ.  Saturday they serve pulled port sandwiches.  We had ours with their smoked Mac N Cheese.  HORRIBLE!  The sandwich was dry as dust.  The Mac N Cheese had very little cheese.  Again, dry as dust.  YUK!
But the rest of the store is awesome!

As a transplant from San Francisco I had try this place. I will tell the sourdough was pretty close to the sourdough in San Francisco. Great choices of sandwiches! I truly enjoyed the turkey sandwich I got. Nice clean place. Great service and the people working there are top notch. I highly recommend this place!

We went at 5 on a Saturday and it wasn't too busy. We decided to sit outside because they have misters on the porch made it very comfortable. We could watch the fountain show from where we were seated which was fun. There are plenty of TVs so we were able to watch some football and golf. 
It started getting a little busier after a while so the service wasn't great. 
There are a wide variety of things on their menu but not so many options that it takes you forever to decide.
We started with the salmon sashimi which was unbelievably good. They gave us 5 large pieces. The salmon was so tender and flavorful, it just melted in your mouth. I could have a made a meal out of that alone. 
We also ordered the sunshine roll and flamingo roll. The sunshine roll was really delicious. The rice in the roll did seem a little dry but with a little soy sauce it was perfect. 
The flamingo roll was amazing. It came in 5 large pieces so my husband and I fought for the last piece. It doesn't have rice which I really liked and it had some lemon and a drop of Sriracha on top which was amazing. 
They also offered low sodium soy sauce which I thought was great. 
Overall this is definitely a place I would come back to. I'd love to try other things on their menu.

I'm going to respectfully disagree on the slow service comment...

Our experience was anything but slow.  In fact, multiple servers came to our table to check on us, make sure we had everything we needed.  I got the feeling that the servers worked as a "team" (at least where we were sitting), because the one that took our order was not the same person who brought our food, and was not the same person that filled our coffee, and was not the same person who brought us more jam...and so on.

We got there at about 9:00 a.m. on a Sunday - it was about an hour after opening.  We were seated immediately, someone came to take our order AS we were sitting (geesh!) down, but we had ordered and had our food by 9:15.  We ordered a "short stack" of pancackes (which I would think would take longer) - and by the way they are bigger than your head.

They had vegetarian options (which for me, have been scarce in the Boise, ID area),  and my fiancee raved about the sausage pattie (which was hand packed - not a hockey puck).
Although the food is good it just takes so darn long to get it. Staff is okay.... definitely below average.
Very slow service and the meatball sub was lukewarm and nothing to brag about. Very disappointed was expecting more...

Amazing sandwiches, gluten free bread available and the absolute best service ever experienced!  The bread is warm sourdough roll with just the right amount of firm on the outside and soft in the inside. The #9 ham and pastrami with coleslaw was just amazing!  Chips and drinks also available.  Would highly recommend this place and will certainly come back when in town!

First off I am born and raised in Chicago.  I worked at a Beef stand in HS.  I am an expert.  The 4 stars are for the sandwiches not the pizza.

The place is good for beef and a dog, however you need to get cucumbers on the dog menu.  And when someone orders a tamale on a bun, know what they are talking about.

The bread more than likely comes in frozen, nothing is better than the trucks dropping off the fresh bread in Chicago, but this is Boise, and they are doing what they can....may want to bake longer IMO.

Are you a fast food or casual dining?  A beef and dog should take minutes if not seconds to make, the efficiency needs to improve.

The pizza....sorry but the crust is what makes Chicago Pizza Chicago Pizza...this is more of a chewy avg run of the mill doe...not PIE crust.   Growing up with Home Run Inn, Palermo's....You need a pie crust that is almost flaky, like a pie.  Sauce, not sweet enough for my liking, but that is personal taste....All in all it is just a avg run of the mill pizza.  

My Dad just moved here and he loved the Beef as well....It is great.  Only complaint, the hot giardiniera is not to my liking, but then again I make my own.  Plus I am spoiled having Parisi's and Duke's homemade on the south-side, where all the best Beef joints are located.  Growing up in Chicago, we are spoiled at the culinary treasures we get to partake in daily.  

However these are minor complaints, the beef is great.

Improve the pizza and speed the service please!

Dr Sheryl Kepping and her staff are wonderful. They  helped to make the crossing over of our beloved pet Bella peaceful.  We thank them so much and are grateful they have a 24 hour service.  Thanks again.  Brett and Teri Reid, Meridian Idaho.
