I LOVE LOVE LOVE Dutch Bros Coffee and wish I could get it in Houston! It is a must for me to get Dutch Bros. as many times as I possibly can while I'm visiting Boise. 

They're easy to miss since they're basically just a little shop in a big parking lot. Pay attention to the way the lanes run. There isn't anything like this in Houston, so maybe that's why I am easily confused. 

The employees are always extremely nice and full of energy, even at 6am. It is amazing to see the energy some of those people have. Even if there is a line it goes fast, and you can park & walk up if you want to. 

I always get the Camelizer. It is delicious, comparable to a caramel machiato but better. 

Utilize their stamp cards for free drinks!
Tried this place after hearing about it from friends. Very good omelette, healthy portions and the BEST Bread I have ever had. Place is quite noisy but the food is worth the wait!

Moderately priced Chinese food.  You get lot of fried rice or noodles to start.  And then you get to pick 1,2, 3  entrees.  So pretty simple right?  I would say the food is fresh depending on when you go.  Better during busier times.  And not so much at closing time. But that makes sense.  So why a 3 star instead of 4?  Well it's because of the up charge.  All of the entrees like shrimp or beef are up changed to a $1.25. :(..   And those are the ones that always look the best when I'm really hungry.  Just sayin.  So I end up paying $2.50 more than the rest of you people that just stick with the orange chicken.  Life is not fair!   OK so next time I go I will also just get orange chicken as well and save some money.  I won't even look at the shrimp!  And I'm sticking with 3 stars.

WHOA This place is as good of a breakfast place as you can find.  The Blueberry stuffed french toast was phenomenal.  The crab Benedict.....my mouth is drooling now just thinking about it.  The proof is in the pudding for this place when you come here come early cause everytime Ive been here, there is a line.

Christmas morning we had no water.  Look in the crawl space, and there was a good four inches engulfing the bottom of our home.  We called around and these folks were the only company that had any interest in helping during the holiday.  Brandon answered and was incredibly empathetic!  He had Richard and another guy over to the house within the hour, because they knew that without a clean work space, no plumber was going to go down there to fix it.

Richard got there and was very VERY good at making us feel like the company cared and wanted to get us fixed.  He and the other gentleman (I apologize, I don't remember his name) were at our house on Christmas day for about 9-10 hours!  I know they were paid well, but to spend your entire Christmas with us, that was above and beyond.  

Since Christmas, Richard has been back a couple times each day to make sure the blowers drying out the crawl space were doing their job.  The fans are still in and it's getting dried out.  But regardless, the work they put in allowed a plumber to do their job, and without them, this experience would have 10X worse.  I HIGHLY recommend Brandon and his crew to anyone, anytime.  Could not have asked for a better bunch of guys!

So this was my first time eating BBQ in Meridian and we were looking for good food good service and good atmosphere.  We got it all here.  The food was fast, hot and tasty.  Will definitely go back one the future.  I told my son, this is the place to bring out of town guests.  Loved it.  PS... plates were all clean
Twigs is always a great place for dinner. Lots of great options for everyone. One of us needs gluten free food, and they always come through with good tasty options. Great wine selection as well.
Service has always been great, however We always sit on the bar side. Get their Jalapeño Martini... You won't regret it!!- Especially before a movie, maybe even a rated "R" movie.
I am impressed. Food was clearly homemade and fresh. Service was good. A bit of a wait, but worth it.

Very good "any style" Asian restaurant.  More Korean / Vietnamese but the menu is broad.  I had the Beef fondue, it was reasonably priced but all it really turned out to be was "make your own" spring rolls.  After we left I swung through a drive through to get something else to fill me up.   

The food is fresh, very fresh and the staff is extremely helpful and friendly.  I don't know if I would come back again because it was $40 + tip for dinner and I still left hungry.  I give them 4 stars for quality and freshness.   It's my own fault this style of food doesn't fill me, I'm a big eater.

Food is good, wait staff are fine.  However do NOT visit without reservation as the front desk is inept.  No real assessment of time.  45 minutes actually means 1 hour and 30 mins.  Nor do they afford every customer with the same information.  (For example, one party is told they can wait 45 mins or go to the bar section which is free seating.  Another customer - us - isn't told anything but the wait time.)

Great pizza! I haven't had any of the other food besides the mozzarella sticks, which, I'll be honest,  weren't my favorite,  but I love the pizza and I love the ranch. Ranch is pretty important,  people.

The people there are super friendly and always deliver pretty quick. I'm glad they're so close to work. Very convenient for me.

Great experience here. First, they called me to schedule an appointment much sooner than I'd expected. The appointment person explained everything extremely well on the phone  -- it wasn't just a scheduling call. Since this was my first MRI, it was comforting to have some expectations set even with that first call.  Also received information about how much it would cost.  Next, having read another review, I used the website before my appointment got a printable estimate -- which was EXACTLY the same as I had been told by phone.  NICE. (I'll post again if the final bill is any different.)  

On arrival, check-in was handled in a very friendly, efficient (!! No wasted time!) manner (thanks Kendall!).  There were several other friendly faces helping me along the way -- where to change, asking what music I wanted to listen to (awesome, right?), helping with positioning on the table, etc), and everyone seemed to understand that a patient might be nervous, so were warm and friendly. Ryan was my MRI technician -- he was also very personable, and also to-the-point (in a good way), explaining exactly what would happen.  His was also the voice I heard every step of the way, letting me know when the next burst would begin, how long it would be, etc.  Kinda audio-handholding.  

As for the facilities -- based on the previous review, there must have been some serious remodeling or a move since 2015.  The lobby was clean, bright, good temperature, spacious.  Changing room/s are big, with good lockers (like a high-end gym). Inner waiting rooms are big, bright, with TV, etc. The MRI machine itself looks brand-new, as does the room it's in.  Kind of cool white spaceship decor. 

As for the MRI itself, it took less time than I was told (yay! good managing of expectations!).  They provide hearing protection--with your choice of music, so the "noise" was muted and in some cases, a little hypnotic.  I think I fell asleep for part of it!  Ryan was very clear about how long each burst would take, so that made the experience easier.  

The whole experience was positive, and I wouldn't hesitate to go to IMI again!

Pizza was excellent! Over the last week I had a thin crust and also a deep dish pizza. Both of the pizzas had plenty of cheese, good crust and excellent sauce. I'm usually disappointed by cheap ingredients and hardly any sauce on most pizzas. This was not the case at Bono's. The sauce had great taste. The crust was crispy. The ricotta cheese on the windy city pizza was delicious. 

The deep dish takes a little longer to cook but I was not in a hurry. The service was great and the people were very friendly. Highly recommend their place for good pizza.
Best breakfast place I've ever been to! Super delicious food and the servers are the sweetest. Highly recommend!!!
Good bulk candy, bad service you have to bag your own groceries. Good prices and a well maintained parking lot, a nice change. Still better than any Walmart I've been to.

This place is a cute little country restaurant with friendly staff. I ordered the joe mammas omelette and it was a little heavy but super delicious. The plate was filled with food and I couldn't even finish it! Their biscuit was so soft and fluffy with their berry jam it was the perfect side. I definitely recommend stopping by for a great breakfast!

My family and I love sunrise!  They have the best coffee and friendly staff!  The hostess Sierra was super nice and very attentive to all of the patrons and our server today Parti was very nice and funny too!  Always a great experience and really feels like you are part of the family when you eat at Sunrise Cafe!

Waitstaff was polite and got the food out fairly quick. We had the glazed Salmon meal a couple of sushi rolls and house salads. The house salad really didn't have any dressing hardly at all and consisted of greens with a plum tomato cut in half and two crumbles of blue cheese..seriously!  The sushi rolls were  just ok. The glazed salmon meal however was really delicious and came with good quality fried rice with shrimp and vegetables. I would consider going here again but I most likely will not order the sushi. Also the coctails are really good here!
Loved the outdoor seating. The food was very fresh! Great service. All three rolls ordered were devoured. Usually one or more rolls are so so at an unfamiliar place, not the case here! Very good!
Meridian's best supermarket chain. Homegrown and better than the other chain headquartered in Boise. Good selection of produce, meat and bulk foods. Friendly staff.
Nice... If no one walks in during your massage. Otherwise, they did a decent massage. Both foot and body are done well. Their prices change depending.....

A great happy hour place! But I don't like the food enough to go consistently not at happy hour. Buy the most expensive middle section of the sushi options on the happy hour menu because it comes with so much more fish. The cheaper sushi on the happy hour menu is a lot of rice but so cheap it's not bad. The avocado egg roll is good but is really just deep fried boats filled with avocado. Great dirty martini but $1.25 more for the olives that aren't that great. Service is always awesome!

My sons (16 years old) and I stopped here one night as we were passing by.  We were happily surprised!  We ordered at the counter, and Pamela (the owner) helped guide my son in his first Italian Beef order (wet or dry, etc).  My other son and I ordered deep dish pizza.  We ordered and then looked around - the place was packed and it looked like everyone was having a blast.  It was Friday night, and they were playing Music Bingo.  I flagged down a passing waiter (Nick) and asked how to play.  He ran and got us cards and daubers, and we played bingo while we waited for our food.  It is so much fun...my kids and I had a great time and this might be our new regular Friday night family activity (and based on the regulars who were there, we won't be the only ones!.  The food was great, Nick was a great waiter and seemed to really have fun doing his job.  My boys were looking around and kept commenting on how they would love to work there - they loved the food, the atmosphere, the whole thing.  We also got to try a cannoli when Pamela, the owner, stopped by the table with a free sample for us.  It was very good, too!  Give it a try for the food, and if you want to have some good family fun, go on Fridays for Music Bingo.

Carrie is the best waitress I've ever had. Period. Pulled through with some brisket when they were "out"!!! Awesome. Even packed up my baked beans for my motorcycle saddlebag :) Thank you, Carrie. Sam

I am SO EXCITED!   THRILLED is another word that can be used.  Pretty much ECSTATIC.  Much like Chris Matthews when he saw our ex POTUS,  there is a THRILL running down my leg.   Why might you ask?  It's simple: On Saturday CableOne will be here to install phone and internet and I will FOREVER be rid of having to deal with the most amateur hour telecommunications company I have ever had the displeasure of dealing with... CenturyLink.  Leaving an 11 year customer (multiple services mind you!), who does his business out of his home office exclusively, high and dry with NO PHONE and NO INTERNET SERVICE what so ever for 6 full days... all the while LYING to about when the tech would be out on three separate occasions... has demonstrated the fact that CenturyLink does not care about it's customers,  and with amazing clarity.  That is 11 years down the drain.  I hope it was worth it... but somehow,  I don't think anyone there gives a damn.

If I could give this place no stars I would because that is what they deserve.  My husband and I went to this restaurant about a week and a half ago.  It seemed nice when we walked in.  I order the monte cristo and my husband had breakfast.  The wait to get our food was long and our waitress finally came over to explain that they were having a problem with the computer system that prints out the orders.  OK but she hand wrote the order when she took it so they could have cooked our food from that.  My monte cristo was awful.  All breading and not much of the ham, turkey or cheese and I had to ask for the jam that normally comes with this sandwich everywhere else.  So my husband continues to eat his breakfast and finds a long hair under his eggs.  He shows the hair to the waitress and she says "sorry and she hopes it is not hers" and takes the hair and leaves.  After this we decided to leave but cannot find our waitress.  I see her talking to another waitress and them waiting for another employee that I am assuming was a manager.  She eventually comes with our bill and we get our to leave.  Nothing was done or said about there being a hair in my husbands food.  When we went up to pay our bill there were other customers paying their bill and each of them had a coupon.  The lady who I think was a manager said that there could only be one coupon per table and the customers said that they were at two table pushed together.  The manager said that she would take both coupons this time but she continued to grip about this to these customers the whole time they were paying (I made a trip to the restroom and hear her griping the whole time I was in there).  When I came out to meet my husband as he was paying this manager was continuing on her rant about these customer with the coupons in front my us and other customers.  This will be last time we visit this place and have told others about our experience.  Joe Momma's is a No Momma's for us.
The breakfast is fresh, and tasty with numerous selections.  The wait staff are courteous and prompt.  Sarah is is a fantastic waitress.

This is such a poorly managed club. This is the 2nd or third time my technician didn't show up. The manager said to me"Well, we really can't help it if someone calls in sick" I would like to share with other customers that this seems to happen a lot. If I operated my business like this, I wouldn't have a business. Also, when I brought my husband they ended his massage 10 minutes early. What a disappointment. I had hoped to write the franchise owner a personal note, instead of this review, however, the manager would not give me her/his name.  I've had several very disappointing experiences at only this clinic located on Eagle Rd. In meridian, Idaho. I've had great experiences at every other clinic I've attended.
Love the food! Sushi is great and the miso soup is super tasty. Every time I come in I am more than satisfied with the service and food. I love it here
The BEST chicken fried steak I have ever had.  It is a real steak, not the meat-like product that is usually found in chicken fried "steak."  Good coffee, good service, good pancakes.

We like to go out for breakfast and Jo Momma's is very close to home. Service is ok, but not really friendly? Maybe it's us? Maybe they don't like working there? 
Ambiance is just ok. The place has absolutely no soul. Very sterile kind of a place. Food ok. Huge pancakes. OJ, watery. Coffee could be a lot better. 
Prices are ok. The kids can share an order of pancakes and be absolutely stuffed for $6.
We'll probably go back, but it isn't a place we'd go out of our way to patronize. 
Still looking for a great place for Breakfast outside of Boise.

Seth, the owner, always helps you out. I started buying stuff from Revved up a few months ago. Prices are great and it's always a good experience. I ordered an exhaust that ended up having a split in the weld from the factory (not Seth's fault) But he gave me a full refund with no issues. I will continue to purchase from no one but Revved Up. Give them business over Cycle Gear for sure, just do it.

If you love beer, truly love beer, this is your brewery. 

Slanted Rock is the first and only brewery in Meridian.  Imaginative beers like Señor Jalapeacho and Vanilla Imperial IPA prove to me the brewmasters show a love for their art.  I asked for a tour and while checking it out one owner said "You can't get in this business if you aren't prepared to dump beer". Meaning, if they don't like a batch they make, the pour it down the drain.  

THAT is how passionate they are about the beer they brew.   It shows in a big way.  Slanted Rock is the Gem of Breweries in the Gem State.  Look for them at grocery stores or wherever you get your beers as they are steadily growing as a result of their passion. 

Also, food trucks.  Beers and food trucks.   Yeah. I'm sold.

Ate at fairview location. Would have rated 3.5.  Sides were decent, chili was really good meats were slightly above ok (i.e., turkey, brisket).  I asked for fattier brisket with some bark and got thin sliced from the flat that was closer to a pastrami than a Texas brisket.  Overall food was decent but not what I would call good bbq.
Sorry for the delayed entry here. Most excellent breakfast. Definitely worth the stop. Great coffee!
Love the customer service. Always willing to help with any questions you may have, and they have great auto loans.
I really enjoy this location. The changes that Crunch has made to the class schedule rocks! I look forward to the future changes to the gym. Staff is friendly and the gym is clean.
Very unfriendly, inconvenienced woman working the front. I recommend going across the street to the griddle where you will find good people, great service and awesome food!

What a gem of a place to eat.  The sandwich was incredible.  A little hard to find, but find it people do.  There were a lot of people there, and staff was most welcoming and helpful, even during a huge rush.  Wish they were open weekends!

We really enjoyed our lunch at kona grill.  While many menu items are higher priced, it's still easy to find choices that are $15 or lower.  The chicken and shrimp lettuce wraps are very tasty and packed with flavor- from the sauce in the filling to the sauce you drizzle on top, nothing was lacking, and my messy hands were evidence to this.  Also tried a spicy tuna roll which was slightly disappointing in that the spicy was little if any...but the fish was fresh and  the sesame seeds it had been rolled in added a nice nuttiness to the roll.  The staff was friendly and helpful and our water glasses never went empty.  Overall a great experience.

This is a horrible place to take a first date. Went in at 7 after I met my date and was seated right away. Our waitress at the Boise Village location was Courtney. She checked in with us and didn't check back in for 45 min. Not talking after we got our wine but nothing for 20 min and then water from another person and then we were able to order wine which took 20 min. She checked in with us 3 times total in over 2 hours and then tried to be funny at the end as to improve her tip. We ordered 2 rolls and 1 bottle of wine and it took over 2 hours?? I would have given this feedback directly to the GM but no info for who that is on the website or on the receipt?? It's disappointing considering the food was good. Don't go here if you want to impress a first date.

When my group arrived the line was literally out the front door. There was a woman at a counter filling out a piece of scratch paper taking orders and giving the paper to the customer with he order on it. You collect your drink and chips and then take it to the cashier. The staff then collect the orders and make the sandwiches or whatever you order. 

The sourdough loaves were still warm and tasted AMAZING!!!  

I would totally go back here for lunch any day.

Ginny @ Salon G has been tending to my tresses for well over 15 years.  There is some distance between us now (about a 10 hour drive) and I tried some other salons close to me and not a single stylist could get it right.  Now I travel, several hundred miles, to Ginny at Salon G and I highly recommend her.

Always crowded and usually a long wait.  They don't have enough hair cutters working, and some of them just wander around.

Never know what kind of cut you are going to get because of the various hair cutters each day.

When it's too crowded I usually walk across the street to Fantastic Sams and get a quicker cut...

I travel for work, off Monday home Friday. Sometimes I find time for a quick one and I thought that's what this will be. But it turns out to be nice. Good drinks food it self was great. Surprisingly great. Bar tender made good strong drinks. Nice spot good view. Great location

Service has been super-good, breakfast fare pretty-good and we're all-good going here if someone suggests it but it is not our good-to-go first choice for breakfast left to our own devices.  Breakfast menu has the usual suspects and a couple of unique things.  Food has been just a tad salty for us and maybe a tad over oiled too.  Different strokes.  But they do get some of their breakfast meats from Porterhouse next door and that is  a good-thing.  Also while it's a little dark if sitting in the back at booths and it can be crazy noisy when full, there is the big advantage (in our books at least) of all tables being standard height seating. 

THIS N THAT:

1) Parking:  In the decrepit parking lot of this strip mall.  Not the restaurant's issue but the strip mall owners that this is so poorly maintained. 

2) Accessibility:  One spot of quasi accessible parking in lot.  As with many strip malls in this area the parking here is non compliant with 25 year old Federal codes for scope and maintenance.  If you can work around that, the restaurant is level in and throughout.

3) Yes, it is 'related...sort of:  Joe Momma's is related in a way to Moe Joe's in Meridian.  The Joe of the latter is also the Joe of the former but exited the former due to marriage breakup and opened the latter.  We think the latter, where Joe is now, is better food fare.

My dog had been scratching his ears and it was getting progressively worse. They were able to get me a same day appointment on a Friday when I called in the morning and said they would squeeze me in even though they were booked up. I met with Dr. Dale Lake who listening to my concerns and answered all of my questions. His recommendations were excellent and before they performed any services another girl came in and gave me a lowest and highest estimate for what the services and tests would run. His technician seemed a bit rushed on explaining how to apply the antibiotics in his ear but Dr. Lake explained it to me again in a much more detailed way to help make me feel comfortable. A day later he called me a left a message to see if how my dog was doing and if he had improved. He gave me the results of his tests and said if I had any questions to contact him. I have never had a vet do that. That is going the extra mile for me.

Took the family out for a late breakfast at Joe Mommas.  Service, food and atmosphere were great.  It took a while to get a table but it was worth it.  Kids loved the waffles & bacon and the Denver omelette I had was great.

Definitely shop around and call other vets before going to this one. They are 24/7 which is convenient if you have an emergency. They are also very expensive. I have gone in for scheduled appointments during the weekday and I have never left in under and hour and 45 minutes. They seemed to be very understaffed and continually say "we only have 2 doctors here" that seems to be there go to for an excuse. You would think being an emergency vet, you would have plenty of staff on hand especially with all of the complaints from other customers. I will not be using this place again nor would I EVER recommend it! They could careless to lose business and they definitely don't make you feel like a priority. After talking with several other vets about 24/7 clinics they all highly recommended West Vet. I've never had to use West Vet but if there is ever another emergency in our family we will for sure be calling them instead of this place. On the positive side, I will say that when they are with my animals they are always friendly with them.

We love this place! Super quick, easy, and so so so good. We usually get the spicy bacon avocado and it is always delicious. Also if you sign up for their rewards program you earn points and get money off.

We have been twice.  First time it was only a couple days after opening.  Not stellar but we know Bruccis well so we gave it another shot this past week.   My husband I both ordered the same sandwich.  Mine was pepper overload and his was bland.  How does that even happen?
The place is nice and clean but they apparently still have some kinks to work out.  I forgot to order a pickle.  My husband got back in line and ordered one for me.  He went to reach in his pocket and the cashier said, "pickles are free if you order them with food".  My husband explained to him that he had just taken our order and that we were waiting for our food.  So the kids yells back to the kitchen, "they forgot to order a pickle, do I charge them"?   A woman yelled from behind the wall somewhere, "if they forgot, they pay".  Hhhhmmmm.    Great customer service huh?
Moral to the story - don't forget to order your apparently free pickle when ordering your food.   No where on the menu does it state they are free, in fact they are listed at $1.25 each.   Still sort of confused over this one.
I will say that their crinkle cut french fries are very good.  No grease at all and very fresh tasting.  Will we go back?  The jury is still out.......

Went in for dinner last night and was less than impressed. 

I ordered a Garlic Gorgonzola Burger and my girlfriend ordered the Lamb Sandwich. Food came out in a reasonable amount of time, but when I cut my burger, I discovered that my request for medium rare had been translated by the kitchen as "well done". I showed my server who agreed the temperature was completely off and let her take the burger back to get a new one fired. The 2nd burger came out about 10 mins later... and surprise... it was well done again. 

At this point I was hungry enough that I didn't care anymore and decided I'd just eat the burger as it was... Definitely a mistake. The meat was incredibly poor quality, had virtually no seasoning besides the garlic cloves and was dripping grease. I let my server take it away after just one bite.

Ended up eating half of my girlfriend's Lamb Sandwich which was very forgettable. The meat was extremely dry and I've had better Tzatziki Sauce from Costco. 

I will point out that the manager did a good job of trying to smooth things over and ended up comping much of the meal and getting us desert. The creme brule' was actually quite excellent.

But even though the manager gave me a card for a free entree as enticement to come back, the quality and taste of the food was so sub par that I doubt I will ever go back to Twigs.

The manager and the service staff are the only reason I don't give this restaurant 1 star.

My dog was recently in need of her latest round of immunizations and I brought her to All Valley Animal Care Center to get them done. 

I made an appointment for 10am on a weekday. I arrived on time. When I got there, there was nobody waiting in the waiting room and only one person ahead of me in line for check-in at the front desk. The ladies at the front desk were not terribly friendly. I checked in and was shown to an exam room where we then waited nearly 40 minutes to be seen. 

I was told I would be seen by a vet tech (who would take her temperature etc) and then by the veterinarian. The vet tech never did arrive, but after 40 minutes, the veterinarian arrived and administered the immunizations (temperature etc was never done). 

I'm assuming the wait is due to the fact that they're an emergency clinic and that is certainly understandable. And, in the case of an emergency, they may be a top notch option. However, if you're a busy person who doesn't have excessive time to spend waiting for regular wellness appointments--this is probably not the best option.

this restaurant tries to be everything to everyone... it swings from swanky martinis and high-end entrees (and prices) to pizza and burger menus. We were there on a Sunday evening for date night. restaurant pretty empty (despited packed Village outside), so maybe its many hats holds off customers from comitting. Anyway, we were first offered a table on an aisle behind hostess stand. We asked and got moved one table over. We tried the martinis. dirty goose interesting, if you like that salty olive taste. a little too overwhelming. and classic was pretty strong! liked the pecans added to traditional caesar salad. The fig and prosciutto flatbread appetizer was the tastiest thing we ordered. Would go back for that. Entrees were good - orange chicken salad and a pepper salmon. Waiter tried to appear savvy, but pretty clear he was a novice when it comes to guiding the eater around the menu... when I asked what the restaurant was known for, both martinis he recommended had cucumber in 'em. It was what he liked. I asked about two entrees and his reaction sold me on the salmon, but my favorite part of the plate was the grilled vegetables. we did go salted caramel cheesecake for dessert and it was pretty rich.

This is difficult to rate, our service was above and beyond but the food was very tasteless. The restaurant was very clean and nice decor. It could have been a bad day to I guess. I know other sunrise restaurants have better tasting food.

I work just down the street from this place.  I've been there for lunch and dinner.  Everytime I go in the people who work there (everyone) are always genuinely nice.  The food is FANTASTIC.  If you haven't been there yet, it's definitely worth your time.

This is where my wife and I take our dogs for all there needs. The doctors are so good with my two dogs, a Husky and a retriever. All Valley never makes us wait and were in and out. Also they have military discount which is ten percent of the final bill. I like All Valley so much I'll be bringing my Husky back tomorrow for a grooming and on the 23rd for another appointment.

Disclaimer: I lived in Chicago for 25 years.....and I am critical when it comes to pizza and dogs.

First trip: hot dog was good...had the right ingredients. Italian beef was ok. It was a little cold and not as flavorful as it could be but I would order again for sure. There is nothing else even close around here. I did not like the giardinera....it was not enough pepper and too much celery, but maybe this is just personal taste. My dad loved the fries so much he ate all of ours!

Second trip: Deep dish was lacking the buttery crust and was pretty thin on ingredients.... there should be twice the amount of filling.....I would pay more. Sauce was great! Thin crust was great! Not as good as my fave place in Chicago, but for Boise it is amazing. Service was great and they were nice considering I had a problem with expired groupon. I would go there more if it were closer to my house.

Okay...I've been here a few times for Happy Hour and loved it. This was the first time I went just with a dinner reservation and it was okay. The food was good, and the roll I got was delicious. The part that was disturbing for me was I PAID $18 for a double vodka soda, which was just house vodka!!! 

At the time I got my bill I was like "wtf $18???" That's ridiculous. I was gunna as my server if it was a mistake since my bill said x 2 and I only got one drink, but then I thought, maybe it's x 2 since it was a double? 


I dunno. I don't think my sushi roll and 1 drink was worth $40, at all. Rip of.

Always good food and fun place right by the fountain.
I go there about once a month and haven't ever been disappointed.
Please be prepared for 2 hours for lunch. No service at all. Got about 15 people working but don't kown what they do. Have to ask multiple times for water refills, sauce. Terrible.
Good but not amazing. Very similar to Greek. I wish the salad wasn't made with iceberg lettuce. The waiter was very nice and attentive.

Friday night around 7 pm place was empty. Service was ridiculous. Took forever to come take our order. Once we got our food he did not once come back to check on us or refill drinks etc. had to stop another employee to ask for a box and check. Not ok since the place was so empty.

I am new to Yelping (strange word:)) so I forgot to take a picture and check in at the time. I went to Twigs for the first time last night and the food and service were both amazing! We had the Mezza ( garlic hummus, tomato confit (sweet tasting), feta and an olive tapenade wuth pita bread) and roasted Brussel sprouts that comes with an over medium egg on top (sweet and salty dueto the bacon and sugar). We also shared a chocolate and coconut dessert that was pretty good. It was very rich..yet we ate the whole thing:) Most definitely going back!

These small, mom-and-pop, international eateries are saving my restaurant dining life. Sofra serves up the most incredible, delectable fare. We ordered the gyro and a cheese pie. Both were sensational. The cheese pie is like no "pie" you've ever had. It is made of thin layers of phyllo dough, topped with cheese, rolled up in a rope, then swirled into a circle and baked. Amazing. Hub loved his gyro peta sandwich too, which was perfectly seasoned. The side of fries was fresh and crispy.
And here's the thing you NEVER see anymore....everything is made in-house and from scratch. Including the phyllo, breads, and cheeses. And it shows in the quality of the dishes. The cheese is crumbly like a feta, but less tangy and more buttery.  I suggested that they sell some of their foods as deli items....I would be a constant customer. 
The menu is limited, which allows Sofra to concentrate on quality.  The restaurant environment is very clean, comfortable and the wait staff friendly and welcoming...very European and homey.  I wish they would open a restaurant in Eagle....I'd be there everyday.

Great happy hour options: half off drinks and $5 appetizers! This location in Meridian is better than the Boise location. The bartenders are attentive. We've had great service every time we've eaten here. David, the manager, is awesome and nice to talk to!
Oh and try David's specialty salsa, it kicks!

A couple changes to this location...same general location, but moved on down from the corner spot towards the middle of the row of buildings and all of the Garden City stock has moved into the new location. Combining 2 separate locations while also moving into a new spot is a trial in general and the new location is somewhat of a work in process. Still, probably my favorite collectible shop proprietor and as always, some very, very cool inventory to be found. It may take slightly more digging to find it, but as always, well worth the effort.

I eat here at least once a month because I am in town quite often. I sit up at the bar every time. The food is so delicious and definitely is 4 stars, the problem is the bartenders who are serving us. We never seem to get good service. The first few times we thought it was just an off night but lately we have decided they hate their jobs and us.
Pizzas and sandwiches are great but the Teriyaki Chicken Fettuccini is something real special that you must try :))

They've finally got a Gyro Shack in Meridian! The facility is brand new and much nicer than the one I'm used to in Boise.

In addition there are bunch of types of gyros. They've got their standard super gyro and veggie gyro, but they've also got a bunch more. I had a Philly gyro which I found really good.

As expected with a new establishment it was fairly busy, but the service was prompt and they were friendly. I could tell they were still learning the system, but it wasn't a big deal. 

One item I didn't like was the turn around for the drive thru, which is fairly sharp. They have a counter next to the window, which made me think I had to be closer, but because I was turning I didn't notice the concrete curb, so my hub got scratched up. 

They have 2 windows for walking up and ordering. There's a few parking places. I would recommend parking and then walking up to order.
Great food and a lot.  You definitely don't leave hungary.  We just moved to the Valley and have been there 4 times.  I highly recommend it.
Michelle was excellent! She was prompt with taking our orders and very open and friendly. Which goes a long way these days!

Oh man, it was way too early in the morning when I rolled in here to take a picture while driving back from Las Vegas to Portland. It's a pretty standard Starbucks with a drive-through window that gives the standard Starbucks fare. It is exactly like any of the other million Starbucks across the United States although the staff was slightly friendlier than usual. Certainly more friendly than they had any reason to be at such a god-awful early time in the morning. Anyway the coffee is fine.

The only other piece of information to note of interest is that if you're coming off of the freeway to this Starbucks, you will not be able to directly get back on the road toward the freeway. You will need to exit from the shopping center it is in and make a U-turn regardless of which exit you take.

After moving from California last year, I started ordering from Smoky Mountain Pizza and have been a regular customer.  I love their delivery service and Cheryl has been a great provider of delivery and am always pleased to see her.  She is a great representation of Smoky Mountain as are all I have been in contact with.  Excellence in customer service!

Every single time I go here im amazed by the service and food. Food comes out fast and taste amazing. I highly recommend their happy hour and just ordering everything off their bc all the food taste so good. Their whole menu is great but their happy hour is top notch

Went to Kona Grill and was very disappointed. I had the macadamia nut chicken. If you are going to charge $19 for a chicken dish it better be fresh. It was NOT. The chicken was dry and rubbery like it had been cooked hours earlier. The mashed potato's were actually cold in the middle and the veggies were terribly over salted.   My husband had the pulled pork sliders. They were ridiculously spicy/hot...always makes you wonder if it was an accident in over seasoning or covering up old meat when a restaurant does that.  The sweet potato fries would have been good if they would not have put so much salt on them. The sauce that came with the fries was very good.  That is pretty bad when the best I can say is the sauce was good. Not ever going back to Kona Grill. Ridiculous price for BAD food.
Outstanding food as always; even in the new location! The prime rib, pretty much the best one I've had in the valley. Keep up the great passion!

I have to say that I am pretty picky when it comes to my nails, I want what I want and I want it done right!! Gloss lived up to every one of my expectations, Christian is by far the best in the Treasure Valley.!! If you want to go to a salon that is friendly, clean and can carry a conversation with your nail tech, This is the place to go!! I brought her a picture of some nails I saw on Pinterest and she copied them exactly, even better then the picture!! I will be going back to Gloss, along with as many friends as I can tell!!!!!!

I have lived in this area forever and have never noticed this little gem! I tried a peanut butter shake and a raspberry tea. They have me a shot of aloe to take before my shake. All three were amazingly delicious. I cannot wait to go back and try different flavors and products.

I went there last evening, after walking out of The YardHouse. Sat at the bar and immediately, Becca came over and asked what I'd like and if I wanted a menu. We had a conversation about wine and she offered me a taste of one. I didn't care for it. So, I ended up ordering a different one. She checked on me periodically. I ordered an appetizer and it came out almost as quickly as she pushed the button to send it to the kitchen. As always, the potstickers were very good. Becca continued to check on me and I ordered a to-go dessert and left. A very good experience.

Shawn, a manager, even asked me how my service was.

In the previous visits there, Daniel has always taken great care of me when there. 

Thanks Kona Grill! Don't let your service slack.

I have been to kona several times and other restaurants in the area. This last weekend we had an awful experience and will not be back there. There was a group of 12 of us for 7pm dinner. We all ate appetizers and dinner and had drinks. At about 11 we went into the bar at the suggestion of our server who said it was happy hour. We went into the bar where we sat at a table and the men were at the bar. While sitting at the table an assistant manager comes over and informs us he is cutting off our entire group. No one was loud, rude or being out of control. He informed us they now have a three drink maximum. After speaking to both him and the manager we realized they had made the decision after a complaint from a table of women next to us. Not for any specific reason and this was never discussed with us. No one in the group was a yound individual, as a matter of fact we had people up to the age of 60 with us. This was a very embarrassing and uncalled for event. My best friend is having her rehearsal dinner in june there and presently helping her look for a new location as I don't want her special night ruined.

Came here for lunch on the weekend. There was no one inside and the place was kind of dark. The ordering process was kind of confusing and it seemed like they had just opened because the employees seemed a little confused on the process. 

Gave 4 stars because the food was good. We had the chicken Katsu with the macaroni salad which is the best I've had here and has been hard for me to find in Boise. Only complaint about the food was I asked if they had regular teriyaki sauce. The teriyaki they give you is a little different than traditional and no one seemed to know if they had any. 

The ambiance is the reason for 4 stars instead of 5. If I'm not mistaken they recently opened and I think they're still working out the kinks. It was just dark and quiet and we felt kind of uncomfortable eating there like we had to whisper. Will eat here again, but probably for take out.

Special Occasion - Never Again!  Family Event, loved ones in town for the holiday season and we are out on a shopping adventure. We stopped in just before noon for a special family lunch.  Restaurant was not crowded.  It took about 20 minutes for us to get water and ice tea.  Another 20 minutes to take our order.  30 minutes latter and still no appetizers.  Food comes out and our neighbors (seated after us) get their food, but at least we get our app.  The four-top next to us gets angry and leaves (I don't think they even had order taken yet.)  More time passes and I head up to the front desk to ask for some assistance.  Nada.  The lunch was declared dead at 2:10pm and we stood up to leave.  On the way out a "manager" asks if we would like our food boxed up to-go?  No thanks.  The "manager" turns his back on us. No "sorry" or consideration.  I recommend that you skip Twigs unless you have all day and like being ignored.  Me, not so much.

The spin instructors are awesome! The equipment in spin room definitely isn't being maintained. This has been brought up to local management several times since March 2018 and it still hasn't been addressed as if June 2018. A large portion of the bikes don't work properly. The bikes aren't calibrated and monitors don't work. The room is extremely warm....80 degrees. Their answer for the entire room was two fans that sit on the ground and don't oscillate. It's a pathetic excuse for a spin room and we pay extra to use it!!! Please address the issues!!!!!

Best breakfast in town. Period. Great staff, nice atmosphere, and delicious food. Faves include green eggs and ham and veggie hash. Don't know what the secret ingredients are, but their house potatoes and bacon sides just taste better than most. And my coffee cup never goes empty.  Only complaint is that it appears lots of people agree with me; there is almost always a wait. But even that is pleasant; we are all looking forward to a great meal!

Friendly, VERY friendly staff invites you into the pleasant strip-mall neo-Mexican decor.  Everything we were served was fresh, fresh, fresh, and home made. And each dish was pretty to look at, too.  But we found it way too heavily salted, starting with the salsa, albeit freshly made that day, and otherwise quite tasty.  The refried beans served with the appetizer chips was also salty, but not as severely.  Our entrees, however, matched the salsa, being so salty, we each choked down two glasses of water with them.  Although I'm not on a sodium restricted diet, and in many cases add salt on my own, unfortunately there was no way I could subtract it from this otherwise quite nice meal to make it minimally palatable for my tastes.
Excellent food! No greasy omelettes here! Everything is fresh and delicious. Best place for breakfast.

I will just start by saying that the waitress we had was super nice and did a fantastic job. I think she was the only waitress there on a Friday afternoon. We did like  the artichoke appetizer and the brownie dessert was also really good. We ordered the butternut gnocchi and caesar salads.  I have never had a gnocchi meal that was so bland and dry. I felt like it had been re warmed and the butter sauce was sucked into the pasta. The caesar salads were only good after requesting more dressing as they were also very dry. Martini's that we tried were ok but lukewarm.   I really don't think I will be returning here.
Very courteous staff. New equipment is a plus. Waiting for new weights! Overall the price is well worth it.
Good food.  Friendly staff.  Liked the waffle bread which was lighter and fluffier than a typical sandwich.  We will eat here again.

First off I could I would give them a -5.  These people are incompetent of communicating with you when you ask them anything.  I used to bring my dogs here to them for over 5 years, every time it was a new person that we saw and they never looked as us other than $$.  Yesterday 11/08/17 my dog was brought in without my knowledge and the person that brought him in said that he was aggressive and needed to be put down.  I had asked them in the past to put a note on both of the dogs charts that anyone that brings the dog(s) other than me they are to immediately call me and verify this with me, this request has been put with them number of times and it never got updated.  Well... long story short my dog was put down last night without my knowledge.  I went to the facility today to speak to 'upper management' which are dumber than a box of rocks, to see what happened because the conversation I had with them over the phone they wouldn't tell me anything as to why and what had happened.  But Sarah, who I spoke to on the phone and wish to never speak again to, told me over the phone that the dog is 'not a human being or a living thing' and that b cause of HIPPA she can't disclose what happened because she is not sure if I am the actual owner.  I role her if you are thinking that way, you should not be doing what you are doing and since he is a 'thing' according to her HIPPA doesn't apply then, since it applies to living breathing creatures. Then she proceeded to tell me that the dog is property.  All in all, nothing is going to bring my dog back but be aware and stay away from this place.  They will never treat you like a person, they will always look at you as a chart and $$$

Re: St. Luke Travel Medicine billing. I booked a joint appointment at St. Luke's travel clinic with my wife. We have same immunization history, and were travelling together. The appointment was fine and saved St. Luke's a great deal by having a joint appointment. Yet, we were billed for two separate appointments ($191 each for a 1 hour joint appointment). Then we were charged $45 each to administer a Typhoid vaccine. What was the $191 for? I can somewhat understand charging for my wife's Typhoid injection (not really...), but I was also charged $45 to be handed 4 oral Typhoid pills (instead of injection). I am sure that the $70.65 pills had a profit mark-up on them as well. I find this outrageous. When I called St. Luke's billing support, I was informed that St. Luke's was "entitled" to charge for two appointments, and "entitled" to charge a vaccine fee, even for pills that were handed to me. Just because they are "entitled", does not mean that they earned that money or that it is ethical for them to charge that amount. $630 for one vaccine and one batch of pills. Many people are complaining about rising premiums being the fault of ObamaCare, when premiums are rising due to unethical business practices such as illustrated here by St. Luke's.

My go to spot for Chicken Fried Steak. Crunchy crust, not too thick and the steak is still a little pink in the middle. Lovely gravy seasoned just right and not gloppy. House country potatoes on the side with two eggs.

The scrambles and the hash are always well executed. My wife is a fan of the Denver Omelet.  

I think they also have the best house made biscuits in the valley. Light, fluffy and not dry. A little Marion berry jam tops it off nicely. The coffee is very good here as well. 

The lack of a fourth star is based on lunch. There's been some disappointments there. But a big thumbs up on the breakfast menu. The food is good and the portions are huge. Come hungry!
The classes are good. Instructors are very motivating. The female side could use more equipments but overall is nice
My first happy hour tonite. Excellent service by Patrick , food tasty & delicious & good portions. Perfect happy hour prices. Mgmt made rounds and hospitable. Highly recomend.

walked in and was taken back.  Very cute location, relaxing environment.  Massage was 4.3-4.5 stars.  The minor issues I have, is the dog walking into our room 3 times (what if you have allergies) and sniffing my arm freaking me out while getting a massage.  And 100% NO intakes.  No want us to focus on any specific area, why are you in? any areas I should go lighter, etc.

From before we checked in to the time we left we had nothing but problems. Did not have our reservation on file. Check in took about 45 min because it was busy with phone calls and people checking in anf out. Our boys had a suite reserved but because the owners didn't pick up there dogs ours got left in a small kennel. Dogs were not fed proper amount, were fed late and were lied to about when they moved our dogs into the suite. Cameras were "down" and medication was not given to my dog who is sick again because of that.  Top it all off dogs have kennel cough and fleas now which can happen but never got the complimentary wash they were supposed to get. Overall horrible experience.  Almost ruined our vacation worrying about our boys. Look around at other places first.
I love when there's no hesitation to recommend a delicious beverage. And there are always sweet people working the windows.

First time ever! I was so glad to find a coffee shop (drive thru) that serves Red Bull drinks! Both baristas were fast and friendly and willing to chat while I waited on my drink. The punch card, $1 off card and espresso bean were a great perk!

The sandwiches and the soup were delicious! Loved the Thai tea too!
Customer service was great as well.

I had high expectations going in. Ordered to go Greek Salad with gyro toppings. Unfortunately I didn't get to try the meat part because it wasn't on my salad at all!  Heavy on the cucumbers and tomatoes but light on everything else. I do prefer more feta (not just a dusting, I like the crumbles) and well the dressing was ok. Tzatziki sauce was pretty much good. The pita was the best part! I look forward to updating this review but next time I'll order the original gyro and skip the salads all together.

We stopped by to try the new coffee bar at 8:45, when they were supposed to close at 9:00. But apparently they closed early and didn't turn off their OPEN sign. For a new business, this is a huge turn off.
This gym is a good gym, but it still has its work that it needs to complete to be a great gym. They have been making a lot of updates since crunch bought it and that is a good sign.

The food lives up to my expectations deliciously tasty. I've been to this cafe ole twice now and I ordered the del Mar. A seafood dish with a scrumptious twist. The dish was excellent however each cook cooks differently and the difference in the taste was apparent. I also ordered the ole burger with guacamole. The burger was presented neatly with pickle and tomato on the side if you desire to put them on it. I will continue to come here whenever I desire their take on mexican style foods.

This was my first time into this store.  All the clothing appeared to be great quality, in well thought out designs.  The staff was all very helpful & informing, without being pushy.  The prices initially intimidated me- but the quality of the material, design & high use of recyclable/fair trade- makes the prices actually quite reasonable.  As Athletics is a B Corp- I'm also confident & feel comfortable about my hard earned dollars going to support other hard working people.  This store is in the interior section of the lovely The Village Shopping mall- which makes it fairly quiet & chill to shop in this store.  I definitely recommend this company & this specific store.
Amazing food! We ordered a little bit of everything and split it, and there wasn't a single thing I didn't like. My first time trying Bosnian food and I will be back!

Good prices but feels like a warehouse.  I shop a lot in the evenings and it is kind of chaotic with all the pallets in the walk ways and beeping forklifts.  If saving money is the most important thing when shopping, this maybe the place for you.

This is the best breakfast place I have been to in the Treasure Valley.  Their biscuits are fluffy, the gravy is savory, the house potatoes are surprisingly tasty and the chicken fried steak was easily the best I have ever had (get yours cooked pink in the middle).  Next time I am trying an order of Eggs Bennie (Benedict), as I heard great things from other diners.  My wait time was much shorter than what others have posted, I think the new location has improved that.  10/10 will go back again.

Loving their new menu with a wider selection of items under $16.  Our server was great, drinks were always full and food came out quick.  Food was excellent, like always.  My steak salad was delicious: steak was cooked perfectly and nicely seasoned.  The salad was crisp and fresh tasting, but could have used a touch more dressing, as it was slightly under-dressed, but the flavors were good and it offered a variety of textures pleasing to the palette. Also enjoyed their lemon tart which was largely portioned and like a giant lemon bar served with fresh whipped cream and a drizzle of raspberry...it was excellent.  Overall a great meal, and sign up for their dining rewards and get coupons and special offers including $15 off your birthday meal.  One of the best dining club offers out there.

Arrived and did not realize it was opening day. A line of people waiting to get their names on the list and the waiting area was kept full all morning.  The wait was about thirty minutes to be seated. Drinks were on the table within minutes. With a full house, the staff stayed friendly and positive. A few guests, not so much. 

Food - Slow in coming, however, expecting quick service with every table occupied, well that makes you a special kind of person. 

Drinks - apparently they didn't have enough glasses for their mimosa demand.  AA might have been canceled this morning? Either way, the taste was good and the drink strong. 

Staff - They did great!
Really Poor food and Service, Also one of the priciest places to eat in the entire Village.

I'm knocking them down a star or two because I made the mistake of going during the busy hours and they failed when their time to shine was due....

You can accept a GOOD breakfast place being busy on the weekends but what I couldn't accept is that I waited 40 mins for an order (Joe Bennie, (eggs Benedict)) but when it arrived (again 40 mins later) the "poached" eggs were hard boiled, the hollandaise was actually (strangely) bitter...

Look dont want to knock them too much, service was amazingly polite and receptive.... but it seems that the Eagle location cant keep up the quality when the 'demand' hits, go in the later hours and Im sure you get the best breakfast/lunch you can imagine. Thats the only time I'll be back and I wont ever order eggs benedict from them again due to the sauce, want the BEST benedict in Boise.. goto http://www.rembrandtscoffeehouse.net

Absolutely some of the best food and service I have had in the Treasure Valley in many years! The hamburgers were made to our exact specifications, the grilled romaine heart salad was impeccable, and my kiddo loved being able to make her own pizza. Our server, Kayleena, was without a doubt one of the kindest servers we have encountered and everything she did was done with ease (though we know being a waitress/server is DEFINITELY NOT an easy job) and grace. I would return to this Smoky Mountain over and over again just for the delicious and unique food and the kindness of the staff. Way to go Smoky Mountain!
Food was really delicious, service could be improved just a little unorganized an slow.

This is the first store they've opened in Idaho! The store looks nice and feels inviting. Everybody there is so helpful & nice! They even let you use their restroom, which is well kept, while other stores will tell you that they "don't have" restrooms in their store!:)) This is my first workout outfit that I bought from them and I love it already! The price is justified because the fit suits my body so well and the quality is higher! I am so excited about this store! I now have one more store to add to my favorites for shopping! I'll be back!

Smoky Mountain has terrific service and very good, consistent quality. It is reliable, friendly and food is delicious! My colleagues and I recently had an event at the Eagle location and the servers, particularly Katie M., managed the evening with grace and patience.

Wow is all I can say.  I miss living in Meridian.  This park has everything from a jungle gym area for the kids, small water feature area for the kids, new baseball fields, new tennis courts, horse shoe pits, stocked fishing pond and a nice track around the whole park ( I heard it is a 1 mile track but I have never confirmed).  During the summer months, the city will put on movies in the park on a big screen on Friday nights for a fun family gathering.  One of the nicest parks I have been too.
Not so good.  The meat was overcooked and the sub roll undercooked.  I'm bummed out... love italian steak & cheese subs, but will have to keep looking for someplace that knows how to make them.

I loved everything at Kona. The service was excellent. I want say John was our server. He was patient with me the entire meal. I tend to take forever to decide on things and I'm a slow eater. I can turn into to a Friday night servers nightmare. However, this was a weekday and I decided to take my time since it was my second time in and the first time was only for happy hour. I had sushi that I really enjoyed as a starter. I also had the potstickers that I was told are made in house which added to their deliciousness. I had the bartender make me a manhattan (my go to) and I was just in Heaven. I also enjoyed the chicken chili with mini corn bread which was just the tastiest thing. I also tried the jambalaya it was not the greatest version I've ever tried but tasty nonetheless. Everything was great.
Bad customer service. I need an interior detail and I have tried calling five different times and not once have they answered their phone. I will take my business elsewhere.

Do not give your business to this place! The manager does not know how to run the place! I can not believe the lack of respect Anthony Williams has to his customers. We tried to bring in customers to this place and he sent them away! Why in the world would he send customers away before you are even closed!?!?!? He purposely closed the store down early after sending away customers and told people the party was cancelled when it WAS NOT and to turn 15 to 20 customers away bc that wasn't enough business! Are you kidding!?!?!? The management at this business is the worst I have ever seen and we will never come back! We will NOT be doing out paint parties there ever again. you can thank Anthony for the loss of the extra business!
Great place, great experience. Friendly help and very organized. Highly recommend. And a full service range.

My favorite lunch place right now! The pastrami is ridiculously good! Parmesan fries or Cajun fries with fry sauce- the BEST original Milk Tea with boba. The sandwiches are on a croissant that is pressed into a flakey waffle shape. And it's all together on a lunch special for around $10 (including the boba tea) Win!
Authentic Vietnamese food. This is where I always get my Pho. It works every time and I feel better in 1-2 days. They also have sandwiches and fresh spring rolls. So yummy

This location changed their meatballs to some turkey mixture and they are terrible now! Used to be fantastic but now the flavor and texture are not good! I love the baked spaghetti but if you want fantastic meatballs with it, go to the Eagle location!

Drinks were good,  ordered blackened chicken sandwich $12.50 Way, way too small!  Especially for a man!  Thin sliced little piece of chicken, all bread!! Way too expensive for what you got! , too small!  Disappointed!

Great instructor and class (Concealed Carry Manipulation)

I took the Concealed Carry Manipulation class from Bill and it was fantastic. He was patient and fixed a lot of my accuracy flaws before we got started on holster work. I was incredibly impressed with his demeanor and style...he's very approachable but effectively conveys the seriousness and potential hazards of drawing from IWB. He laces the class with real world anecdotes he's seen during his career about what can go wrong when you aren't diligent. Really makes the lessons stick.

Bill gave me the fundamentals I needed to start feeling comfortable carrying and practicing safely from an IWB holster. I was incredibly impressed by the quality of the class, especially considering the price.

Was a decent breakfast but not sure what was up with the wait time because half of the tables were empty the entire time we were there. We ate at the bar so we didn't have to wait but the folks who walked in with us were told 90 minutes.  We assume it was a kitchen capacity issue but that needs to be fixed, fast, since they decided to move into a bigger facility in order to "serve more and eliminate wait times" (or so said the news article we read). 

They definitely need to train their staff on how to make drinks! Our bartender was fine but the other gal making mimosas had no idea!  I would have been pretty disappointed if I received one of her drinks.

We most likely will not return, as it was overall just mediocre.

Good luck!

My family chose Kona for a special Valentines Day dinner. Our experience was absolutely terrible! All I have to show for the night is a $70 hole in my pocket and a massive stomach ache that I'm praying won't develop into food poisoning. Our waitress seemed friendly at first, but as the night progressed she became more and more standoffish. I ordered a $15 sushi type dish and was not warned that the portion would be so tiny it could not serve as an entree. I couldn't finish it, as the fish was not fresh and the flavor made me nauseous. Our children's portions were tiny for $7 a piece and my older two left starving and asking for more food. My seaweed salad was vile and inedible. The waitress did not ask how we liked the food. For this price, we could have had an incredible dinner out as a family at any one of the local restaurants we typically frequent -- twice! If I hadn't been completely overwhelmed with stomach pain and three still-hungry kids I would have asked for an immediate refund.

Believe it or not I really like this place. The salsa is OK but the guacamole is amazing. Unfortunately Mexican food does not sit well with my digestion so I always stick to the salad or soup and I really like them. My family tries different dishes and they were very happy with their meal. Service is great and atmosphere is fun.

Twigs is great!  Every time we have gone, we have been very pleased with the food. Fresh ingredients, cooked perfectly, with lots of unique flavors.  The only aspect of their business that needs a little improvement is their service but it is still a top notch restaurant!

This Winco is horrible and I can't wait to go back to Vancouver, Wa where the employees are nice and help the customer. I was walking around looking for a container and three employees walked by me and could see I was looking for something because I would pause at an aisle and peer down it then continue to the next aisle, my husband went to an employee and asked if they had the item I was looking for and instead of finding out if they had it he told my husband they don't sell things like that.
   So we continued shopping I walked down an aisle and THERE was the container I had been searching for, I am giving 1 star because of the rude inconsiderate customer service and 1 star because I finally found what I was looking for so they get a total of 2 stars.

This place has some decent dishes, but can be inconsistent.  The pasta dishes are usually pretty consistent, but I am very unhappy with the calzone I ordered today.  It was $10, was advertised to have 2 cheeses, ricotta & mozzarella, but I had trouble finding any cheese at all inside the very overcooked dough.  It really was a disappointment, but I don't think anyone knows how to make a good calzone in the Boise area.  Oh well, I guess a trip to NYC'S in order

This place is consistent as it gets.  I have been here several times and every time I receive the same excellent service and quality of food that is consistent.  I have had breakfast items and have also ordered off the lunch menu, all really good.  My favorite breakfast item is the chicken fried steak.  My wife enjoys their lunch sandwiches with great french fries.  It does tend to get loud in there at time when it is busy but it it's busy for a reason.

I'm disappointed that this review will not sing all of the praises of a new Hawaiian food place. I love Hawaiian food and was really looking forward to Pineapple Express joining the Meridian area. First of all, I have gone here twice for lunch and I had the same issues both times. The service is great, prices are good, the servings are BIG, the proteins and sides need some improvement. I have tried four different proteins in two different meals: chicken katsu, teriyaki chicken, kalua pork, and braised brisket. All items were dry, over cooked, and the pork was super salty. I have only tried the coconut rice and Hawaiian mac as sides but the rice was dry with flakes of coconut but no real coconut flavor and the macaroni salad was okay but lacked flavor.  Overall, I do wish them luck and hope they can work out the issues with their food but I won't be back for lunch or dinner any time soon.

Since Sunday was so good, I brought my family back on Tuesday for my birthday. Word to the wise: Tuesday is discount day at The Village, with cheap movie tickets and discounts at a number of stores and restaurants, so the place was packed. The parking lot was bad as BSU, with people circling looking for a spot, any spot. Getting a reservation was a challenge, even a few days in advance. I'd suggest maybe trying a different night if you'd not looking for a giant crowd.
Anyway, we again had a great experience. The server immediately brought a stand for my infant nephew's baby seat, and was helpful all night long. She recognized that it was a birthday from the vibe of the party, and brought us a dessert at the end of the meal, which was a great touch. As a side note: the lemon creme brulee is delicious. I'm not much for custard, but those who were loved it, and we all fought over the caramelized sugar on top. It was great to have such an astute and considerate server. In general, she was always available and made sure we were happy with our food. Thanks, Cassandra.
I split a margherita flatbread, which again was massive, and really good. The roasted asparagus salad was also huge, and a nice choice for the vegetarians among us. Other dishes at the table included the jambalaya, a pasta dish, and the chicken teriyaki bowl. It seems like with such a variety of dishes some of them would have missed the mark, but everyone was satisfied. Note--when they say the dishes are spicy, they mean it (Idaho spicy, anyway. I won't pretend they're incendiary by other standards.) If you need them to tone things down, speak up.
I will probably make this a special occasion place, as it's got such an energetic vibe, the food is good, and the service has been fantastic. I'd like to hit Happy Hour next for discounted appetizers and some of their vast number of drinks.

I love this new eatery! My husband discovered it and introduced me to their delicious waffle sandwiches and noodle soup. The owner Tony and his wife are very accommodating and very friendly. I come here every week and am so excited that it's 10 mins away from my house. Welcome to Meridian!
Good customer service,  Worst internet service Ever!!! Been there customer for 23 years don't even have  my house phone worse service ever!

I ordered the TNT Coulotte steak which came with mashed potatoes and vegetables. The vegetables were the perfect balance of tender and crunchy, the sugar snap peas every thing that a sugar snap pea should be. My husband had the chicken truffle penne. The truffle Parmesan sauce was perfectly paired with broccolinis, asparagus, and tomato. Our waitress, Christina, was timely, kind, and spunky. A must try.

I absolutely love this place for breakfast!  Their pancakes are delicious!  Be careful, as their portions are 3x's more than you need. I tend to eat more than I should when I visit. They are also extremely busy, so you make want to make reservations or plan on waiting for a piece of breakfast heaven.

This place absolutely hit the spot after the sleep-deprived winding drive down from McCall.  I was starving by the time I reached the lowlands, and thank goodness for the stoplight at the 55 & Fairview...out of the somewhat carsick fog I happened to spot the sign that said "Fusion Asian Grill".  It was fortuitous because this Thai-Vietnamese fusion place was a godsend.

There is plenty of parking in this newer strip mall...and I had no idea that it would be so nice inside.  You walk through this velvet curtain thing to enter the bamboo-walled restaurant...full of dark, soothing colors.  I swear I heard a recreational water feature of some kind somewhere, but I was too hungry to even look for it!

Anyway, I was thrilled to see the menu filled with different Thai and Vietnamese dishes.  We ordered the fresh spring rolls with shrimp to get things started...they were fat and fresh, rolled tightly enough to stay together.  It seemed as if it had been rolled at the time of order (unlike the chewy rolls I've had at other places that were made hours beforehand).  The accompanying peanut sauce was a flavorful complement.

This place has fantastic lunch specials on Monday through Saturday, but since it was a Sunday - I ordered a bowl (what turned out to be a giant bowl) of Clear Noodle Soup.  OMG it was beautiful to look at - and the noodles were the fat chewy round "glass noodles" I love so much!  The broth was light and delicate, and it was enhanced nicely with a few squeezes of lime juice and adding the fresh jalapeños and basil.  The bean sprouts also gave it a nice spectrum of textures.  It has shrimp, pork, and chicken - which is especially good if you can't make up your mind about what you're hungry for.  :)

This soup was enough to get me back on my feet again and I thoroughly enjoyed the "comfort food" feeling it provided.  I hope to find the equivalent here in San Diego!

I like this gym. Its not crowded when I go and actually have enough machines to go around. I do like the cross fit add-on but definitely miss the basketball court. We need that. Staff is always friendly and my daughter loves the daycare there. If the sauna could stay hot that would be cool.

Our server Natalie, was a kind, courteous and attentive to our large racecar team needs during breakfast on Sunday morning before we headed to the race track. We would definitely stop there again, next time we are racing in town. Excellent service.

I wanted to like this place more, really.  The atmosphere is what makes it worth going to at all.  The food was OK, but honestly WAY too expensive for what it is and how much they give you.  I didn't have any of their drinks, but I think that may be the reason why people like this place.  It definitely can't be because of their food...

Dear Boise Yelp Community,

All self-respecting Vietnamese food reviewers MUST try Fusion Asian Grill. Despite the non-authentic sounding name, the new chef is absolutely brilliant. The spicy vegetable soup with shrimp sets a very high bar.  The new owner scours the valley for the perfect fresh ingredients/meats. 

This gem of (now) authentic Vietnamese food WILL go under under unless we take action. I challenge the most jaded of the Yelp community not to fall in love with the above-mentioned soup. Call to action Yelpers: Do not let Fusion Asian Grill be plowed over for another Boise Red Robin!  Try the Fire Pot Fisherman Soup :)!

Kona used to be my favorite spot in Boise. 1. They got rid of there famous frozen margarita 2. There service is terrrrrrrriiibbbblllleee.  We were sitting at our table for some time before the waiter. She then came over and said the service at kona is bad. Was that suppose to be a joke?

Little bit of a wait. Large portions & really good food. Service was very good.
I'll be back!
Liza M.

I went to the "soft opening" to find a very nicely designed store... much nicer than the existing local store on Franklin.  Also has an expanded selection.

This chain is notable for its frequent coupons.  Do not expect to get one in the store... be sure to print one off before you get here or bring your smartphone.  They do take coupons that you can see on your phone.

They carry all kinds of crafts stuff for rubber stamping, scrapbooking, beading, knitting, crochet, wood models.  They also have Crayola goodies for kids.  Also plenty of home decor, like faux plants and flower arrangements, posters & frames, etc.

Friendly staff, very eager to help.  Large & accessible restrooms.

Really enjoyed this place, I ordered the Gyro with fries and my husband ordered the special, which was kebab with yellow rice and salad. We were both very happy with our choices.  The service was friendly and the atmosphere was fun, we enjoyed the Bosnian music and decor. Price was very reasonable and portions were generous.

My 2nd time to Big Daddy's and it was just as grea as the first time. This is not the place you come if you want a nicer restaurant but if you want scrumptious food and amazing service,  this is definitely the place!  My dad and I both had the Sriracha sandwich which was a mix of brisket and pulled pork with pepper jack cheese and cheddar cheese on a super yummy bun. The sandwich is not hot though what you think it would be with Sriracha in the name. Even though I was looking for something on the spicier side it was still amazing! Even the french fries we're better than most places they were seasoned and cooked to perfection

The server was very attentive and accommodating. I wish I'd gotten her name but I watched her interact with other tables and she was just as friendly with everybody. Apparently they have a really good brunch on Sundays too. I looked over there menu and it looked like the perfect place to go if you want something unique and off the wall. As I left that place I told my dad I think this is my new favorite casual restaurant

The Village at Meridian is a new outdoor shopping center in Meridian near Boise. There's a similarly themed San Tan Village in Arizona, but it has nothing on this place. Yes, the restaurants and stores are mostly on the pricier end of the spectrum, but I know it fills the needs of an existing niche audience. 

As for my husband and I, when we have one of our rare date nights, we want to go some place special, which usually takes us downtown. It's nice having options closer to home.

That's not to say fun can't be had on a budget. There's a large play structure my sons love, as well as an elaborate fountain with lights that "perform" to different songs every hour on the hour. The opening festivities were great, but the Halloween trunk-or-treat could benefit from better crowd control. Right now, they have a cute house for Santa pictures and a small ice rink. There's a fro-yo shop across from the playground I look forward to trying.

I suspect we will spend a lot of weeknights or weekends here with the kids when the weather warms back up.
Bartender with the beard is an ass. No respect for him what so ever! Drinks were strong though but he killed my buzz!

Texas I traveled from Texas and the reason is Tisha she is the only one I trust with extensions 
The new locale is UBER up tempo light open and airy. So glad that The Processing Bar was a dream someone had that came true
Check it out(Krispy Kreme donuts on counter
Bob Marley BONUS)
My food was dry. Very unhappy about that service was ok not the best but it was ok your staff gave me attitude as well when I brought my DRY food back I'm so ever unhappy

I am so disappointed! I have been taking classes here for many years. Unfortunately, the previous owner (who was amazing!!!) moved and new ownership is not helpful or pro-customer. After a problem with my billing and class card, I needed to speak with the owner. After 2 follow ups and no response, I finally got a message from the instructor that I spoke with.
