There was no attempt to resolve the problem only the response that I was out of luck in fixing things. Thankfully, my class card is used up (due to the error) so I will move my practice to a studio that wants the best for their clients versus seeing dollar signs.

5 of us had late breakfast on Sunday, 40 min wait but worth it. All the food was wonderful, Wait staff was great, kitchen was a bit slow but very busy. Prices were very fair. We have been looking for a good brunch in the area for a while to no avail......not a brunch but great menu and facility.

We love the original Joe mommas! With the bigger location the wait times are ridiculous. We've tried 3 different times quoted an hour to an hour and a half each time.... with open tables? Stating they are try to keep it even for the kitchen. I'm guessing they don't have enough employees? Or not efficient enough kitchen staff. Super disappointed :/ I hope the work the kinks out soon!

Update: we tried to come again for our sons birthday breakfast! It says they open at 6:30am online but they open at 7am. Super disappointed

This place is no good. I've been to the place they're trying to copy and they totally missed the mark. The cookies are disgusting, precooked, frozen, and served cold/frozen. The drinks are just off, I don't know what it is but they do something weird that is not good. The kids who work there are super unimpressed with their jobs and not remotely courteous. We've given them a few tries, thinking maybe it was an off day and wanting to support local businesses, but nope, it is consistently bad.

My daughter and I went into this store to set up a phone because we kept getting tranferred from department to department via the customer service line. We received no apology for our inconvenience, nor was there any understanding. We ended up having to purchase a SECOND SIM card, which almost 4 hours later, we still have no service. When we contacted the store, again, we received no sympathy whatsoever. I asked to speak to a manager or someone in charge to express my concern regarding the poor customer service, and was told no. I finally received a half-hearted "sorry", but I have policies to follow. I am very disappointed with T-Mobile and will not be returning.

Best breakfast in the Treasure Valley. We go Every Single Weekend! Their breakfast meats are particularly amazing. Probably most famous for their chicken fried steak, which is an actual premium cut of steak where they ask you how you like your steak cooked. Yummmmm. Homemade sausage, big thick ham steaks, Tri tip, seriously. My other favs are the chorizo jalapeño hash, tamale and eggs, Tri tip scramble, and California Benedict.
Great place for a diverse family. Something for everyone. The atmosphere was louder than we like but the food was flavorful and the staff was nice.
Love their happy hour! The food and drinks are good, service is awesome! Will definitely come back! Glad found this place!

Delivery was quick and the food tasted great. Only problem encountered was that online ordering stated that delivery was not available. Had to call and confirm they were still taking delivery orders and order over the phone rather than online.

Great gym! Still fairly new so you can be 1 of 5 people using the gym. Hopefully it stays like that for a while. Very clean. Has 2 showers and a big locker room. I wish it was 24 hours or had later weekend hours however.
Had such a good time. You really can not beat their happy hour. We will definitely be coming back to enjoy this place! Friendly wait staff and super fast service.

The noodle soup is amazing.  Bone broth that tastes like it was simmered all day (or longer); perfectly cooked rice noodles.  Lots of meat.  The pressed waffle sandwiches are unique and fantastic.  As someone else said, "a croissant and a waffle hooked up and....." The smoked meats are home-done and taste like it -- and are tender too! We went back two days later for more! Great that it's a family-run business too -- the care shows.

We went to Twigs at The Village in Meridian with anticipation however we were very disappointed with the food and service unfortunately. We started out with the Moroccan Beef appetizer which was just OK and then being priced at $15!!!!! This is way overpriced for what you get. In my opinion any appetizer should not exceed $10. Now for the entrees. The person I was with ordered the butternut squash gnocchi and boy was this a mistake. Again WAY overpriced, did not even taste like butternut squash and the entire dish was very dry not enough sauce so we sent the item back and ordered the clams which was better but was basically an overpriced appetizer. The manager came and brought the clams entree and did not even apologize. Now for my entree. I ordered the fish and chips which was nothing special and the fish was over fried and dried out. For over $13 you can get way better fish and chips elsewhere. Now to finish our night we decided to get a desert nothing special just some turnovers. We then get the check and they charged us for the desert!!!!! Typically when you send food back when your not satisfied with the quality of the food and you have to wait for your entree they will have the decency to give some kind of compensation. Not these guys!! They think because they are in The Village they can price gouge and treat customers like cattle. Well I will never return to this dump and I will tell everyone I know to avoid this place like the plague.

Sunday breakfast for us, we arrive around 755a and were seated by 803a.  Drink orders were immediate and then we ordered three entrees for breakfast.
The food took 49 minutes to get to us...I know this is the "it" place for breakfast and it's busy as all get out, but we came early to avoid the rush and enjoy what has been touted as the best breakfast food in the area.
The food was hot when we got it, but no apology for the delay and little to no follow up from the server after that.
The food is good but it's no better than another handful of places in the area (i.e. Moe Joe's).
I may go back if it's not busy but won't go out of my way to go here again.  The menu does have a lot of choices and again, the food was good, just not life changing as some describe.

Your poor business practices will ensure we never eat or try your location. If you want to close at 1:30 and turn people away don't stay open until 2:00. I do hope this location fails so someone with actual business acumen can replace it.

I honestly hate to give as good of a review as it deserves because I don't want to wait any longer at 9 am on a weekday for breakfast!! All kidding aside, I have not had a bad meal here. Reminds me of my grandparents restaurants in the late 70's. Amazing homemade hash, if that's your thing, best pancake I have ever had, and it's a "side dish" that is the size of a dinner plate. The green eggs and ham is one of my favorites with green chili's and cheese and pit ham omelette. They also have many Benedict options, quick service and coke products! Also patio seating available.

Waiter seemed too busy.   Did not get silverware or water offered, though I did arrive late to my table of friends.    Loved the outdoor setting!   The lettuce wraps were plentiful, but slightly too much oil for my taste.   The satay chicken was delicious, but the coleslaw that came with it was soggy and lacked flavor.  I'll go back again just for the lovely outdoor setting, and try something else on the menu.

Katelyn made our first visit memorable. She went the extra mile with both service and suggestions.
Excellent salad in addition to great pizza!

Great gym! Love the new HIT equipment with the bumper plates and squat rack.  Staff is always friendly.  Love the utilities including pool, sauna, massage bed, and racquetball court.  If they brought back the basketball court I'd give it 5 stars.

A good place to go when you are looking for a decent and fast sandwich.  Sandwiches are consistent.  I've tried several sandwiches here and they are all pretty good.  I like having a wide range of pricing on sandwiches.  If I am looking for a quick snack, they have inexpensive items called Plain Slims which is a normal sandwich minus the veggies and sauce, a regular sandwich and specialty sandwiches.  Although I have not used their delivery, I hear they are extremely fast.
Whenever I visit my Brother in Boise we always go to Joe Mamas breakfast restaurant. The food and service is outstanding. The employees are always very friendly and the atmosphere is amazing!

I enjoy working out at Crunch for starters they have plenty of treadmills and bikes and so many weights and machines. I love their Zumba class and if you want to give it a try make sure you try Jessica's class she is a wonderful teacher.

Yeah, two stars. Bring on the hate.

The overly-inflated reviews I see for Slanted Rock remind me exactly of the ones for Boise Brewing. I know that tastes differ and it's all down to opinion and, yet, it isn't at all. There's a reason everyone talks about brews like Pliny the Elder (even though Blind Pig is way better) and breweries like Stone, Deschutes, Lagunitas, Firestone-Walker, Rogue, etc. There is good and there is way better. I can appreciate locals being loyal to local beer, but it would be hard for me to give Slanted Rock a five-star review when all they do is beer and I don't think they're one of the better beers in the valley.

I will admit, right off the bat, that this review reflects an experience that happened one year ago. I am, in fact, giving this brewery a two-star review to motivate me to return and give them another shot. Breweries grow! They do! Edge and Crooked Fence are shining examples. So I hope that all of these stellar reviews reflect a seriously improved tasting experience. When we tried Slanted Rock, every brew was mediocre, the IPA was barely discernible from a fairly standard pale ale, and I believe the Kolsch was the best thing they made.

I say, without sarcasm, that I can't wait for the opportunity to try them again and, hopefully, agree wholeheartedly with all of the stellar reviews. Sadly, like every brewery that doesn't also serve food, we won't be allowed in with our child. I won't be able to taste here until we find a sitter for our baby, which is tough when you don't know anyone in town.
Not a bad place for happy hour. 3-7 is good range, but keep in mind that happy hour is only offered in the bar and patio area. I really like their wave sushi roll and pot stickers.

This location was good when it opened. They stopped offering sprouts even though sprouts are listed on the national web site. The meat portions seem smaller. The bread is still excellent, but that is just not enough.

Ok I FINALLY made it to this place! My dad was craving an Italian Beef so we headed over there yesterday. Unfortunately, we drove all the way from the Borah neighborhood to discover they are now closed on Mondays. *sigh*. Tried again tonight. We both ordered Italian Beefs, wet, with an order of fries and drinks. Two of the soda fountains had "out" posted on them - luckily there was still diet Pepsi to be had. Our sammies came out first. Appearance wise - very close to the real thing. Taste was sooooo close to home! The beef was a little tough, but the bread was right on and the flavor was all there. The fries came out once we were halfway through the sandwiches, but at least they were hot and tasty. 
From the menu, I wouldn't try their pizza because it's description does not match what a real Chicago style pizza is, but that's ok because I can order Lou's overnight. I will come back and try their dogs another day. This definitely satisfied my craving since the closest Portillos is in Vegas!

Very good food, friendly waitress, fast and delicious! My husband tried some new dishes other than our regular and we both liked them! I like this one much better than the one in nampa. Although we live in Caldwell, we would rather come here to eat!

The great food is only eclipsed by the inability for the staff to handle the amount of people.

The facts:  Joe Mamma's just relocated to a much larger space on Eagle Road in Meridian.  It's Sunday morning, which is peak time for most breakfast-centric restaurants.  Because they are a new-kid-on-the-block, many people are going to want to try them out.

What happened:  We got to Joe Mamma's about 11:30.  Our dining companion had gotten there at 11:20 and put our names on the list to be seated.  As we were entering, there were several parties of people who were leaving because they had been told it would be a 90 minute wait.  The entrance was full of people waiting.  

Since we were already on the list, we stayed and were standing toward the inside of the restaurant so we could see everything going on.  We did wait about 40 minutes, but were amazed at the amount of names called for people who weren't there.  We were equally amazed because the entire time we waited, there were always at least 10 empty, cleared, tables waiting to be used.  Is this because the kitchen staff is overwhelmed?  Do they need more than one person seating patrons?  Were they short wait staff?

When we finally were seated, the waitress was very quick and got our drinks and orders.  The food was all very good, portions generous, and wait staff was very friendly.  The potatoes were crisp and delicious.  The pancakes not from the regular Krustez mix, and one fills a plate.  The eggs were done to order, and coffee was good.

The conclusion: This place definitely deserves a second chance on the food aspects alone; but, to maximize ROI on the bigger space, they could use new organization, skip the reservations in favor of people already waiting and/or walking out door, and maybe get a few more people to help.

We decided to give Joe Momma's a try again, after a couple of year hiatus following a somewhat bad experience.  I am happy to say that this place has more than redeemed itself, and my wife and I really enjoyed our breakfast experience today.

I ordered the #4 special, eggs over medium, with french toast, and a side of hashbrowns.  My wife also ordered #4, scrambled eggs and a pancake.  Everything we had was really really good.  Even the coffee was great.  Lots of times breakfast diners like this have mediocre coffee, but this morning ours we delicious.  The only minor downside was that my wife noted that the pancake was a "thumper" in that that's how it feels when it hits your stomach.  Rare is the place that can create a light and fluffy pancake that doesn't go thump.  Still, the pancake tasted delicious, and the overall breakfast was wonderful.

The servers were friendly; the place was busy but there was no wait.  The location is very pretty, right along the river, which just adds to the pleasant morning meal.


[  People who use similes are as numerous as grains of sands on the beach.  ]

Atmosphere:
Very pleasant! It was cold outside, my husband and I were greeted with a roaring fire from the fire place. The restaurant was a bit upscale, and we weren't not expecting that. We were more expecting something like Chili's or Applebee's. 

Staff:
The hostess was very pleasant. She greeted us with a warm smile, and promptly got us seated. 

Waitress: was eager to get our drink order in, and gave use significant time to over view the menu. She was very nice and recommended her favorite dish when we asked. 

Prices:
It was about $10-14 per person 

Location:
At the Village, next to the movie theaters. The location is perfect for large groups. 


Parking / Venue: 
Plenty of parking, as it's in The Village Shopping Center. There is enough room to entertain two or forty in your party. It's great for either an intimate or social setting. Wheelchair accessible, and plenty of room to maneuver.  

Food:
Don't Judge me! I got a half steak salad and drunken donuts. My husband got the half chicken strawberry salad. 
The drunken donuts are to die for!! It comes with three dipping sauces. As you bite into the warm donut... expect this... your thoughts leave your mind as you bite into a little piece of heaven. It tastes like a funnel cake. Delicious! 

The salads were good too. A very healthy portion for half salads! 

Specialities / what "they" are known for?
 
Their drink menu is pretty selective. 

Star rating:
4 out of 5 stars. 


More importantly Would we ever go back? 

Yep! My mouth is watering for the drunken donuts as we speak! I can't wait to go back to taste the variety of drink selections. They have a jalapeño drink I'd like to try. I also want to try the pizza!

Best place in Boise to have breakfast!!! Food is amazing and portions are generously sized. You will not regret the wait. They even make really good expresso drinks. Reasonable prices as well. 5 stars.

I've been working with Krysti St. John for a long time now, and have always been so pleased with her work.  She is efficient, on top of all the details, and easy to get a hold of.  When closing on a house, it is important to be available, and knowledgeable, and she is both! Thanks!

La Quinta is a great place to stay. It's close to the interstate and there are plenty of restaurant choices nearby. They have good breakfast, clean rooms, and are dog friendly but you do pay extra for such amenities.

My coworkers and I were in the Boise area for a training.  It was suggested we check out The Village at a Meridian.  This is such a cool place to visit.  We stumbled across your restuarant while there.  I had the black pepper salmon; so good.  The best thing we experienced were the french fries with the gorgonzola fondue.... OMG this was amazing and your blood orange martinis were delish as well. Great experience overall.

I've been to this Kona Grill in the past for drinks but this was my first time there for lunch. We both chose the Kona Chopped Salad. Delicious flavor / texture combo with the breaded chicken, bacon, and lemon dressing. We both agreed after we got about halfway through our salads that this menu item is heavy on the chicken and very substantial. I still loved it, but next time I'll probably split it and save room for dessert. Definitely worth the price!

Yesterday, may 3, I and my social group with a membership of over 500 became ex customers of Kona. In our last two visits there we have felt unappreciated as long time and repeat customers    .  We typically book space months in advance and confirm numbers at least a day before. This time we had about 40 members who meet for social Hour to chat with friends and enjoy drinks and food. We meet at least 4 times per year over the last 4 or 5 years. In the past previous management always accommodated our group and made us feel welcome. In the last two visits we find the new management not welcoming and non-empathic and seemed to care less if they had our business. As a result our group went to Bodovino Ristorante who welcomed us with open arms and gave excellent service in spite of the last minute and unscheduled group. 

I rated experience as 1 star because I couldn't rate lower.

Stopped in a a last minute dinner with family. Place was busy (Christmas week). We'd sat down at tables near the bar area figuring we would get faster service here.....Wrong.
We waited 5-7 minutes to be acknowledged. Waited brought waters, but no menus. I walked up to bar, and grabbed a few off there. 
Another 6-7 minutes later, waited came back for drink order. Placed our orders, and another 15 minutes passed. I looked over at bar , and there was only one bartender taking care of a full restaurant.  No wonder.
Drinks do ally came, and we decided to just order a bunch of appetizers.  Apps came out 15 minutes later, and no plates. We tracked down another waited, and she got us so e plates.
As for the food. It was ok..... PIZZA was fine. Moroccan beef was really good, crab and artichoke dip was good, and fig and prosciutto flatbread was bland and very skimpy on toppings.
Lots of choices in the treasure valley. Probably won't be back, at least for food.

One of my favorite restaurant to get sushi from. Their menu has such a wide variety and it's perfect for dining with family because everyone can find something they like. Amazing food and amazing wait staff!

We love the original Joe mommas! With the bigger location the wait times are ridiculous. We've tried 3 different times quoted an hour to an hour and a half each time.... with open tables? Stating they are try to keep it even for the kitchen. I'm guessing they don't have enough employees? Or not efficient enough kitchen staff. Super disappointed :/ I hope the work the kinks out soon!

My first meal here was the Chili Cheeseburger... the burger was smoked with some amazing flavors! The Tater Pigs (their version of a "loaded" tater tot) absolutely amazing! Spending and living in North Carolina... their Carolina sauce is on point! If you want good BBQ, this is the place you need to eat! The staff was friendly and warm as well... this hidden gem is AMAZING!!!

Meal started great.  Ordered chicken fried steak, California Bennie and Full Three Meat hash.  5 mins into our meal we found a long dense Black hair cooked into an egg of our Full Three Meat hash.   Notified server.  We did not want our food remade as the appetite was lost.  Upon receiving our tag, the waitress only removed 2.50 from the bill for a coffee.  An excellent customer service situation would of removed the item the hair was in or at least charged us for a half order since most of the dish was not consumed.  Thanks but no thanks.

Enjoyed my first visit to Kona Grill, quality food option in The Village.

Met a group of friends for dinner, and was pleased with the service and the professionalism of the servers. Place was packed, but never had any issues with timing or quality throughout.

I liked the "starters," enjoying edamame and miso soup. Both were served quickly and good-sized portions. Liked the temperature of the miso. 

I really liked the Kona Stir Fry that I ordered as an entree. Chicken with carrots, cabbage, broccoli, samball cilantro, sweet hoisin, and sesame jasmine rice. Thankful for the server's recommendation, as it was served at the right temperature, good portion size, and tasted great. 

I wish I remembered the server's name, as he was really good, a positive guy with a good feel for the menu, and paid superb attention to our table. 

I recommend getting reservations on a busy night, nice atmosphere, and a really good dining experience.
We have only lived here for 30 days but I've visited Joe Momma's three times and each time was excellent. Great breakfast place with wonderful home cooking along with very attentive service.

I live in Meridian and like all kids, mine love the village. I know Kona is a chain, but I've been there so many times and it has always been good. Good drinks, good food, and good service. The voodoo roll is amazing. The wait staff there has always been more than perfect with the kids. Always a pleasant experience.

Hubby and I are fairly new to Idaho. We were celebrating our anniversary and decided to have a nice dinner before our movie. We decided to try this place due to the reviews and pics from yelp. The drinks were yummy, but the food was forgettable. We ordered the calamari as an app, and the truffle pasta and pork bucco as our main entrees. Again, they were good, but did not "wow" either of us. After spending over $115 on our dinners, apps and drinks, we both experienced buyer's remorse and will probably not be back again.
The food is to die for. Everything I've tried has been superb. I wish the hours were longer though!

Century link is notorious for bad customer service and this review is no different. A complaint with the American Disabilities Act and the Better Business Bureau is in progress. This store in particular discriminates against individuals with disabilities. My friend is deaf so the internet is his prominent form of communication. When it went down he was unable to communicate to customer service without help translating. After I assisted him in making multiple phone calls with an excessive amount of hours spent with customer service, we were referred to this location in order to speak with a Century Link representative in person. We called the location to set up an appointment with the manager to be met with comments such as "he can go to the library and video chat" and "You're his worker, you help him." First, they asked a deaf man to walk 4 miles to a library to video chat. He can't chat because he can't hear. And second, I'm not "his worker". He is a capable individual who is smart and kind and able to complete most tasks on his own; with the assistance of his internet of course. This is appalling. We simply were asking for a representative of the Century Link company to sit and talk to a man that has spent his life not being able to hear ;something each one of us take for granted. If you choose Century Link please call and get your service a different way than through this store. They do not deserve your sale.

This is my 2nd time here. The pho noodle soup is excellent. The brisket option was different, nicely smoky . Prices are reasonable, I know another pho place in the area that is about 50% more. Will be coming back

For variety and value, WinCo is the only game in town.  WalMart can't come close and all the "designer" (Whole Foods, Fred Meyers, Trader Joe's) grocery chains are a joke.   It must be a self esteem issue with the people who just must pay more for the food staples in life.  Granted, Winco doesn't have a juice bar, coffee lounge, messuse, tarot card readers, bank or optometrist.  Nor dragon fly wing seasoning from Jakarta.  WinCo offers real value and good selections.  I and do like bagging my own groceries. The take 'n' bake deli pizza's are very good and priced well below the competition. They do have self check-out stations now which is an added plus for the quick trips.

My wife and I recently visited Cafe Ole' Meridian on a trip to Boise from Austin.  We thoroughly enjoyed our dining experience.  The staff was exceptional and our waitress was absolutely awesome!  Great service and yummy food!  Big portions so be careful!.  When I saw the Veggie Burrito my brother ordered I did a double-take!  

Complimentary chips and salsa are excellent as well.

Great atmosphere, easy parking, and a good location.  

Thumbs up for sure

I am very picky when it comes to upholstery and carpet cleaning.  When I had Craig give me an estimate I had asked a ton of questions.  Craig was very patient, professional and assured me he would do a great job on my couch, bar stools and carpet.  Craig's team didn't rush through the job and made my carpet look brand new.  

Craig is on time and is a man of his word.  I highly recommend this company.

This is one of our favorite fast food restaurants in the area. The food is tasty and the portions are generous. Service is outstanding. We just have compliments for the staff and the food! 
Highly recommended.

I ordered delivery tonight (03.17.18) and from the second the phone call began to minute my food was delivered, I had absolutely amazing service. The lady who took my order was so so friendly and the lady who delivered my food (I'm not sure if it was the same lady or not) but she was also incredibly nice. I order delivery all the time from here but this was by far the best service I have received. 
And my sandwich was still hot as if it just came out of the kitchen. My salad was fresh and tasty. The only reason I'm upset is because my food is gone. Thank you Smoky Mountain!

First time and last time visit.  Sent the calamari back as it was unedible.  Waitress was not pleasant and the service was horrible.  Continually had to ask for items.  Will say burger was not bad.  Hard to believe that the level of service will help sales.  What happened to customer service.
I love the variety, cleanliness, and fair pricing here! Unfortunately, it can be difficult to find someone to help me. Still a great craft store to check out!
The facilities have always been clean and the staff very friendly whenever I have arrived. I rarely have to wait to use equipment on the days and times I workout.

Twigs has a secret menu! Yep!! It's true. 

Ask for the Polynesian Pizza. Even add feta. Its absolutely to die for. Pulled pork, pineapple, veggies and a magic sauce that will blow you away! 

Side with a pear and beet salad and you've finally lived knowing just how good it can get. 

Add a pint of no li IPA for absolute heaven.

Staff doesn't need any coaching , bc they know how to do a great job for a glorious evening!! 

Highly recommend!!

My family loves smoky mountain! My daughter always gets the grilled salmon pasta which is phenomenal. We always start out with brea kisses, wings, and mozzarella sticks. We share a salad and my husband and son share a pizza and I get a French dip. I have never had a bad meal here. We always have the same waitresses Michelle and Molly! It's always nice getting a familiar face! I highly recommend this place if you want dang good food!!

Or first time here consisted of a potential hour and a half wait in line.
Until we can actually get in and try the food, this is where my review will sit.
My recommendation? 
Call ahead, otherwise if you just walk in you may be in for a long wait.
Go to West Vet in Boise, save your time and the price is better.
Definitely the best cheesesteak in Boise/Meridian. We loved it and will be back!  We ordered a burger, pepper steak and steak supreme as well as fries. All were delicious. Beer is a great price.
Great service and excellent food! We will definitely be coming back to try the rest of the menu items.

I visited with a group of six, on a Friday night, so slower service was expected, but holy shit it was slow. Water didn't come until I had been seated for at least an hour, well after I had finished a very small mule, and refills on either drink apparently didn't exist. I had the fish & chips, which were led by stellar fries, and 2 lackluster pieces of Alaskan Cod. My table mates had Pesto Chicken, Thai pizza,  blue cheese pizza & 2 lamb burgers. Pesto Chicken included a free 4in long piece of plastic. Meal might have been comped, but receipt was confusing and staff didn't appear to care to explain. 

Dessert: powdered sugar donuts with dipping sauces were fantastic. A lone high point of this meal.

Will only return for the rare cocktail.

This is one of those places where when you are visiting a certain town you always have to stop by. 

I've only had Joe Momma's breakfast items and I've never been disappointed. Today, I had their Upside Down Pineapple Pancake special which was served with a side of bacon and an egg. You will have to really like a sweet breakfast to enjoy this one. I love sweet breakfast items so this was in my wheelhouse. The pineapple is glazed and cut up.

The atmosphere is lively and the servers are always wearing big smiles. If you happen to be in Eagle (right outside Boise) or even in Boise, make your way down here!

So you guys supposedly have a pretty great gluten free menu. We get there tonight and are told pretty much only 2 dishes are gluten free! Apparently your vegetables are not gluten free!!!???!!! What the hell is going on? They are vegetables!! Why do you even advertise a gluten free menu when you obviously have nothing gluten free. Worst gluten restaurant ever!!!
Hudson was great! Did a fantastic job on my hair and my sons! Also he trimmed my beard!

Probably one of the best places to get BBQ and actually more bang for your buck compared to other places. I wish there was one in Nampa. Then again, maybe not... I would probably gain 100 pounds if that was the case... but oh so delicious!!
I have eaten there twice in the last month. Both times the people were nice and the food was good. I ordered online the second time and it went smoothly! Thank you!

I stopped in Cafe Ole for dinner. On a Monday night there was plenty of seating and I was promptly seated in a comfy booth. My waitress, Stephanie, returned quickly with my drink, chips, salsa, and beans. Due to dietary restrictions I needed to make some changes to the entree and Stephanie had great suggestions and was very accommodating. My meal arrived super fast and was a larger portion than I was expecting. The grilled chicken salad was amazing. Stephanie returned several times to check in with me about my meal and refill my drink. While the meal was good, the customer service was a outstanding. Thank you Stephanie!

Great food. Great service, a little slow but can't complain. I was referred a sausage and meat with ausju. Very good!

 pricey for certain types of beer. First time being their and will be coming back for sure.
Very good sandwiches, very very very slow services, I was the only customer and it took me 20 minutes to get my sandwich

The place has a great feel and the wait staff is very friendly.  I have been here a few times and the burgers are fantastic.  I ordered the full rack of ribs the other night and although they were good, they were not fall off the bone good.  Overall great place, great service and good food.  I am looking forward to trying other things on the menu.

Far and away my favorite eating spot. I'm stuck on one item, lately, and that's pictured here and it's the corned beef hash. 

Coffee is great, toast is a quality bread, pancakes are huge, service is stellar. My favorite restaurant, period.

Lastly, I went to the Eagle location and, although it was more of a drive, they allowed call ahead seating as the waits could press an hour! New place is closer to my home, Meridian, seats more people, even nicer atmosphere and they have added a digital wait list for call ahead.

Stopped in one morning. I was surprised how busy this place was. We had to wait a few minutes but that's ok the food was worth it. I had the corned beef hash. The corned beef was house made and was great. Everything was really good. The pancake was huge and delicious. Highly recommend this place.

I have been here a couple of times. The service was great every time and the staff is very friendly. 
The food was always excellent. Tonight a had the Roast Beast, the seasoning for the meat was perfect and the veggies were cooked perfectly with a nice bite to it. I'll be back for sure.

What Settler's Park lacks in the natural beauty of the parks along the Green Belt, it more than makes up for in being toddler friendly.  The Adventure Island Playground includes eight toddler swings (most parks only have two to four) a toddler-sized play set with slides and a tunnel, and a "sound garden," as well as regular swings and a larger play set for older children.  Instead of the usual wood chips, the playground has rubberized mulch.  

(I prefer rubberized mulch in general but be advised that it does get hot in the summer.)

The "splash pad" is a great way to introduce your toddler to water before trying out a local pool or water park.  One of our fifteen month old sons loved playing in the water, the other, not so much.   To other parents with smaller children, just be cautious of the larger buckets of water that occasionally tip to the delight of older children.  

Shade is limited, as are benches so bring a blanket and a big umbrella if you have one.  The park has a concession stand.

So I have to lower my rating for Kona as much as it pains me. The new happy hour blows. I liked the three tiered options before, and the prices were better. Oh well. The food is good, but it is not that amazing so I guess I will visit other places. Coors Light should never be priced at $4.50 for happy or really anytime.

We had a fantastic waitress named Erica who took excellent care of us. Shared a perfectly cooked omelette with a big, fluffy pancake on the side and refills of our sodas and tea never ran out. Really enjoyed our visit and will be back!

Just left the Hungry Horse Eatery! Whatever you do, order the Pork Belly rice bowl and ask for the dipping sauce! We are moving to the area next month and this I already know this will be a regular spot for us. Their tri tip pho was delicious as well. I originally wanted to go here because they have boba and when searching their menu I saw my go to order, almond milk tea. I had to go. My husband ordered it for me and when he asked if it's hot, they said no but that they could make it hot for me! My day was made! Try this place not only for their yummy food but also because of their excellent service!

I ate at one of their food trucks and got a brisket taco I think and it was ok for a taco. The texture was nice but the bbq sauce was sour and kind of threw off my taste buds because the meat tasted bland with no seasoning. My brother thought the same for his brisket sandwich. The fries are pretty good and the staff is friendly. Give them a try if you like bbq.

This place is awesome. I feel very healthy and energized. I'm a vegetarian and here visiting my grandma so finding a veggie based juice bar and energy source other than coffee is awesome! We will definitely be back and I wish there was a place like this in Portland! PS there is a dog here. That's basically the best part.

After my last experience, I will not be visiting this location again.
I checked in online after the app said there was a 0 minute wait. That seemed very good for a Saturday afternoon. I arrive to find I was number 4 in the queue and the waiting area was very crowded. I stood at the counter for about two minutes, waiting for an employee to greet me. Tow of them looked straight at me and said nothing, left me standing there. Customer Service goes a long way, and this place doesn't seem to have any. I took my business elsewhere, and will from now on.

Food was okay, not exceptional.  I've been at this location twice and won't be coming back a third time.  Both visits were on Sunday evening.  The first time the service was really slow.  This time we waited more than the 5 minutes told to us when there were a number of tables open.  This is a way to help the kitchen catch up, but it never happened.  Three in our party of four got our pizzas together.  My 4-year old grandson didn't get his cheese pizza for another 20 minutes.  The waiter said they hadn't put it in the oven.  So, other people were getting their pizza who came in after us.

First time here and they didn't disappoint. It's a small and cozy place. Food and service was great.  We had the Noodle soup and Bulgogi Rice Bowl  and they were both very good. 

I checked in and got 10% off which is a plus

Our Massage Envy home away from home.  My wife and I make the long drive from Napa Valley here in California  to the Boise area at least once a year to visit family.  A visit to Massage Envy in Meridian is always a must do.  The staff is always very welcoming and friendly.  This trip we each scheduled 90 minutes with April, and thought she was easily the best therapist we've experienced (and we have experienced many good ones in our travels) in our long relationship with Massage Envy.  Thank you April and everyone at ME Meridian! :) Luke & Cheryl

Father's Day called ahead but they didn't have us on the list when we got there. (?) The wait was an hour and a half, but--No problem, they got us in right away! Service with a smile is what we like and got. And with an 18 month old who has the attention span of a gnat, we were glad we didn't have to go somewhere else.

Food was good, but the portions, OY! I ate half of the half portion of the Country Bennie and was stuffed. Unless you eat like the incredible Hulk, plan on splitting a meal. Pancakes are easily 12" around. My son got the veggie scramble and it was loaded with yummy veggies.

The atmosphere was crazy on this day, but still we will go back as it is a nice place for families and an easy going atmosphere. What a find!
This is me and my boyfriends favorite place for date night! Food is literally ALWAYS good. We tend to stick to the same thing each time but even when we try something new we always seem to love it!!

Casual and small but Wow! Really great sandwiches are made with flaky waffles for bread. 
I'll come here again for sure!
Came here for dinner last night with my wife and son. The food tasted good and service was ok, but the food was lukewarm when delivered to our table.

Pretty friendly folks other than they forgot me...

They offer shuttle service which is a nice feature for those of us with only one car.

Pretty quick service but unfortunately very, very expensive. They were the most expensive overall for the same repair of about 6 different mechanic shops in the Meridian area.

Unlikely to return.

Kona Grill has become our go to upscale dining in Meridian.  The decor is awesome, the food is very good and the service is above average.   I think we are lucky that Meridian ended up the the Village as it is a big city outdoor life style center that you would see in Scottsdale AZ or Orange County CA.

So far, I have eaten here only once, but I will return. There is usually a wait...it is that good...so plan on that. The place has a brisk pace, you get your food quickly and it is a lot of food. Our server was friendly and attentive. Our food was yummy. I cannot remember what I had (should have done this review sooner), but I remember it was delish. Try this place, you will have a new favorite.

Best pizza in town! I order it almost weekly.   To top it off, after they forgot to send dipping sauce in my hot wings and my extra salad dressing order saturday,  they sent me a $10 gift card to make up for it and all I asked was not to be charged for the forgotten sauce.  They went above and beyond,  Love them!!

Slow service and a very expensive sandwich. Too bad they couldn't even get my order right! After pointing out the mistake, the worker didn't offer any remedy. (I probably wouldn't have wanted to wait for a new sandwich even if he did.) Recommendation: Skip this place. It's not worth the money or time.

We get the cheesesteak supreme from Bruchi's and they are GREAT! I wish they toasted them - we always get the foot longs then save half and toast them ourselves but that's the only thing I would change.

This is one of the cleanest hotel I've stayed at in a while. I'm a little OCD and I like to black light my rooms as soon as I arrive. This room is spotless! They cleaned every nook and cranny. The ladies at the front desk were awesome and gave us amazing customer service!

It gives me no pleasure at all to write this, but it appears my 3-star review in January was too generous. Based on our experience this week I've gotta knock this down to 2 stars. (Although in this case, it's really 1.5 rounded up, with the fractional .5  awarded because Bono's is one of the rare eateries in Meridian that's not part of a fast-food chain. Without that "gimme," maybe it truly should just be a 1? But I do try to reserve the 1-stars for places that should be condemned and bulldozed immediately, with the site quarantined for multiple half-lives until once again suitable for human habitation.) 

Sorry, where was I? Oh, Bono's. Wednesday. Lunchtime, 1-ish. Quiet. In fact, nearly vacant except for a party of 7 or 8. Two refrigerated cases that formerly held soft drinks stood sentry by the entrance, empty and sad. 

We wanted a Chicago dog with fries, a rare indulgence for us. Iced tea. Cheerful young woman took the order and we paid. Note that at Bono's you have to go all the way down past the kitchen area to the bar, where the self-serve drink machine is located. Hand-written sign on the iced-tea dispenser: "No ice tea." 

Okay, it happens. Back to the counter. Cheerful young woman had not gotten the memo about the missing iced-tea, but apologized. No problem, it's just that we don't do sugary carbonated drinks, so could we just get a refund for the tea? Absolutely, but cheerful young woman didn't know how to process a refund on the register and neither evidently did anyone else. After a few minutes during which they called Chicago or something, cheerful young woman managed to return our $4.47. That was when I noticed for the first time that we had actually paid $4.47 for two iced teas. A profit margin like that, we should get valet parking and tuxedoed waiters. But as Harry Chapin might have put it, I stashed the bills in my shirt and we sat down.

Then, we waited. There seemed to be some confusion over at the larger party about parts of their order missing. Some appeared to be half-finished eating while others were still waiting. The line cook seemed a little annoyed and exercised over all this but I guess it all got straightened out and, after maybe 15 more minutes waiting, we got our hot dogs with fries. 

Well, truth be told, they were "warm" dogs. The fries were piping hot, though, suggesting the dogs had been prepared before someone noticed the fries weren't cooked yet. Five degrees cooler, we'd have sent the dogs back, but we might still be there.

So, all this over iced tea, warm dogs, and untrained employees? Alas, yes. In the context of our prior experiences and the many, many other negative comments posted, Bono's is simply a poorly-run operation that shows no sign of improvement and in fact seems to be headed in the other direction. This is hard to fathom. Given the area's rapid growth, the place should be packed. The food is generally pretty good, after all, with potential to be very good if someone would just pay attention.

That rounded-up half-star is looking mighty shaky.

The service was great! We sat down and they asked us what we wanted to drink. After a bit they came by and gave us what we wanted to drink and asked us if we needed more time and we said yes. We ordered and when it arrived, it was so good! Beware: the pancakes are huge! But they taste great. The eggs were fantastic and the bacon was nice and crispy. Will come here again.

Ugh, I hate to admit this but I enjoyed myself here.  More importantly, however, my 2 year old son had a blast here.  We made a wrong turn somewhere and ended up on the highway west so my husband asked if i wanted to go.  I felt like pizza, and my husband being infinitely more patient than myself, I knew he would find a reasonable parking spot.  He did and off to Grimaldi's we went (no Casanova, but yummy!!).  We sat on the enclosed patio, heated for the winter, facing the fountain and my son couldn't wait to get out there.  We quickly finished our lunch and I chugged the last of my second white sangria (sooo yummy!) and got him out there.  In addition to the fountain is a large kids area with climbing area/slides and comfy outdoor furniture for the parents.  He spent over an hour running around on the rubber turf and climbing to his heart's content.  I can't speak for the shopping because again, i don't have the patience for it (thank you, interwebs!), but a fantastic time was had.

Not a fan of this shopping area. Not friendly and welcoming feeling and mostly national chains instead of local fare and merchandise. This place just doesnt give me a good feeling, and the restaurants are mediocre or worse.

Service was great, they were so nice.  But to call these roast beef sandwiches Cheese Steak Sandwiches is wrong.  The sandwiches were ok but not steak, shredded beef.  A little disappointed. I will go back and try their sub sandwiches but I won't be tricked again.
Great service and drinks! I had an Italian soda and my sister got an iced coffee. The gal that made our order was super friendly and quick. Highly recommend.

I really needed my hair done. And I was in town for a few days then going on vacation then moving. So it was kind of last minute but I saw the good reviews and took the chance. Bad idea. I got my hair color done by Ginny (who is supposedly great). And I was just going a little lighter than I already was. She was so rough on my hair. It had bleach and she was just pulling on it. I've been to hair school and I know that's bad. It breaks off like crazy. And when I asked how much I would be charged they said in the 125$ range. And I walked out paying $175. Keep in mind, when you pay with card, you are forces to tip. And I didn't want to tip cause I didn't like my hair at all. The color was nothing how I wanted. I even showed her a picture. Sorry but don't go.

I want to apologize to CBH in regards of accusing you of stalling  my friends house.  I was in error for suggesting the stalling was in any way related to my friends race.  If I hate race baiting, I shouldn't have stated his race as a reason for my friend not getting the house he wanted where he wanted.  You did not know his race and cannot be held to blame for the the delay due to his race.  He loves his house.  He has everything he wanted except for a three car car garage.  You went out of your way to amend the plans to give him the house he wanted.

I use the Crunch Meridian location since some of the water classes have been canceled at the Nampa location (which is closer to my home).  Now  Meridian management has canceled water classes also.  After our water class on Wednesday 9/19/2018 (with a really awesome instructor) - we decided to go speak with management since the supervisor of the water aerobics class was on site.  We all felt very disrespected by the answers we were given by the manager of the gym, the gym district manager and the supervisor.  It is obvious to us that there is age discrimination towards seniors based on how we were treated by these individuals and we cannot let this continue.

Many of us attend the water classes at Crunch gyms on the recommendations of our doctors and are advised NOT to work out using the gym equipment that takes up the majority of the gym's physical space and budget.  We were told by these 3 people that instead of working out in the water we can always go upstairs and use the treadmills, bikes, weights, etc.  Water aerobics is the only workout we can safely do and to be flippantly told to just use the machines shows no regard for our desire to workout based on medical advice.  At the end of our query, the district manager simply apologized for not meeting our expectations with no solution or possible answer to help the situation.  Crunch simply wants our month dues - don't count on any customer service or consideration!

This is my fourth or fifth trip here. They have excellent gluten free options (well, except for the bread). My dining companions are also always satisfied. 

A note about the bread. Their GF bread tastes like white wonder bread. I had their bruschetta last time but I was unable to stomach the bread so I ended up eating it with a spoon.

I love this place! Their Moroccan beef is my absolute favorite appetizer. I've never had a bad experience. Their gluten free menu has a good amount of selections. All the martinis are delicious but my absolute favorite is the Key lime martini (no longer on the menu but they'll still make it )

Loved this place when it was in Eagle.  I think they were not prepared for such a big turnout when the moved to Meridian.        They must need to hire more servers.  There is at least 10 empty tables and you still have to wait 30 or more min.  Service was not great.

Horrible.  My equipment would not work, so I called Tech Support. After 20 minutes they put me through to Sales, where the guy tried to talk me into buying their television package.  BEFORE they got my internet working.  
No. No. No.  
Finally he says, okay, let me transfer you to Support!  So I wait some more;  Support gets on the line, asks for ALL the same information I already gave - account number, address, etc - then says "hmm.  It looks like it is working.  How many phones do you have?"  
None.  
"Okay, wait some more please.  Hmmm.  Did you follow steps 1, 2, 3?"  She asks.  
Yes.  Three times. ( I have a degree in Computer Science, BTW, and I know what i am doing.)  
"Okay, let me run some more diagnostics." She says.
How about you send someone to fix it?  I say.
"Let me do this first," she says.
Now, about 30 minutes in, I am tired of the game. So I say, "Never mind. I will box it and return it."
"I am sorry you feel that way." she says.  No offer to send a tech.

Just to confirm, I called a local IT service provider and asked if he would install CenturyLink in my home.  He said "not on your life. Nothing works like it is supposed to. Even when you get it working it is one tenth the speed they promise."

SO... I call a DIFFERENT number to cancel. I will be fair and say that rang right through.  (The  number for our Boise area is 800-244-111)
Why do you want to cancel? He says.
"Because I could not get it to work."
"Can I send a technician to your home?"  He says.
I laugh out loud. "I asked for that before and got stalled. Now it is too late. I am done with you."
"What if I send a technician AND give you another $10 a month discount?"
Hahahahaha!   Where was that the first time I called?  You guys are a joke. Just cancel."
Which he did. I hope.

Lesson here?  Don't get stuck with them. If you ARE stuck with them, call and threaten to cancel if you want a better price.

Do not recommend this company for any services. I called  to schedule to have service in the early morning and at the end of the day they said they cannot do it on that day. The lady scheduler did not gave me a clue that she might not be possible that day and could be tomorrow. But at the end of the day, when I even told they can come anytime even 9 pm, the service manage who had no customer service threaten me that he cannot confirm the service can be done that day. I have done more 20 k business with this company and this manager does not cure about it. Why would he? He would if he was a owner. I am done with them.

Wow went wayyyyy downhill. We've been lifelong fans and suddenly its crap. Prices went way up and portions way down. Very few staff and literally no customers. The chimichanga looked like it came out of a bag. What happened to this place? $11 a plate for this????

Stopped in for lunch simply because we wanted something new and we were not disappointed! Sandwiches are made with puff pastry pressed in a waffle iron. The result? A light and tasty sandwich "bread" that ties your meal together perfectly, allowing each flavor time to shine.

Small but comfy interior with fantastic customer service. We'll be back for more.  Truly a unique place that you will want to try at least once (and then maybe again and again).

I have reviewed JoeMomma's before, but I wanted to add an update.  They opened early one morning to have food ready to go for our company breakfast meeting.  It was boxed and ready at 7:00, which is generally when they open in the morning.  Now that is service!  Everything was hot and perfectly prepared.  It made our meeting so nice to offer our employees such a great breakfast.  Finally, a company who understands good service!

I was there for a friend's birthday. It was my third time eating there. Our waitress was not very attentive, the salad was good but too expensive for what I got, and I asked for an ice tea with lemon three times before the waitress brought it. Then I never received a refill. At $3.00, it was the most expensive ice tea I've ever had to try so hard to get.

One of my most favorite happy hours! The happy hour drink and app selection is great! 
I personally love the saki bombs and the pepperoni flat bread! I recently tried the cheeseburger sliders and they were fairly tasty. The margaritas (in the rocks) are scrumptious! Cheers!
Great sandwitches and service. Might be the best in the valley but they are only open for lunch.  Expect a short wait if arriving right at noon.

Turkey bacon swiss was delicious and service was fast.  I thought a waffle sandwich would be too rich but it was light and satisfying. Restaurant was clean and had a nice casual vibe.  Definitely going back soon!

Arrived at Joe Mommas at 12:30 on a Friday morning.  We were told it was a 15-20 minute wait.  Surprised because they close at 2:00, but OK. After about 20 minutes our name was called and we were escorted to a back room with at least 10 empty tables.  I asked why we had to wait 20 minutes with so many empty tables and was told there was only 1 waitress for that room.  There were 3-4 other occupied tables at various stages of eating so we figured we were ok.  We had looked at the menu while we were waiting in the lobby so when the waitress came to take our drink order (more than 5 minutes after we were seated) we told her we were ready to order.  20 minutes later no one had checked on us, refreshed our drinks or, obviously, brought food.  Flagged waitress down who said she'd go check.  5 minutes later still had not seen her again.  Went up front to ask for a manager and was told that he was handling something else and would be up in a few minutes.  That was enough for us so we left, a full hour after we arrived. So, I guess I can honestly say I never had a bad meal there because we never did get a meal.

My brother and dad were talking up joe mommas all week. I love The Griddle cafe in LA and they told me it was comparable if not better. It took a while for the server to come but my brother said she's normally very friendly so it was fine. It ended up taking almost an hour to get our food (not counting the wait) so that was a little long. Apparently they upgraded locations recently. The omelette I ordered was really good though! And the rest of the food was decent. Would come back again if I had a few hours.

Ate here for the first time.  I don't care for breakfast food so I had a Reuben sandwich.  It was soooo good and the fries were fantastic.  I really really wish they would open another location and put one in Star.  We are desperate here for a place like that.  The place would be packed if they built one here which would accommodate Middleton and Star which is growing like crazy. Great place...I will be back.

I always leave this place with a smile. When I wash my car, I feel like I have gone into space in my versatile car that turns to a rocket. Space just takes over my rocket ship, I mean my car :), and little alien monsters scrub my car, spray my car,  soak my car and then I enter back into earth's atmosphere via a wind tunnel then ...... ahhhh... the light at the end of the tunnel, my car is clean. 

I then get spit out to free vacuum machines.

Might be my new weekend tradition, space travel via a fold in the universe disguised as a car wash. Tricky.
We love the movie nights in the park during the summer! The playground is so large that it's difficult to keep a close eye on multiple kids.
Awesome!  Best breakfast in Meridian.  Big plates and great service.  Be prepared to wait because this place is busy especially on the weekends.
Went here looking for pho soup, it wasn't pho, but it was pleasantly different. Its like pho, but with different ingredients. The staff were very friendly.

They have amazing breakfast options. I've been back multiple times and havent been disappointed, they also have giant portions. So either be ready to split the meal or be ready to take some of it home.

Closes at 2. Ok so if you come in at 1:30 your service/food sucks. I guess you shouldn't take care of your guests in your establishment that made it before the doors close at 2pm. Instead of a close time post a time that the service/food deteriorate.
I know service. Im in the industry 20+ years. Unfortunately Ihop or Sharis would've done better. Sad because the food & service is normally outstanding.

I am visiting Meridian Village often and we enjoy going to Kona grill, wether for the entire meal or just for drinks. Love the atmosphere and their menu. Kona's stuff is always polite and the establishment is top-top clean. There is no difference in value you will receive at Kona, regardless of the happy hour or of any other promotion they offer at the time. Try Calamari !

This place is always busy so thought the fam and I would check it out. We are vegetarian so my daughter wanted to sub the kids meal meat for some hashbrowns. Denied! We just had to pay full price for less than a full meal. My omelet was flavorless and so was my husband's hash. The pancake was huge, but there was no buttermilk tang that you would expect with a buttermilk pancake as the menu describes. And oh my gosh, the maple syrup was the most horrible syrup I've ever had, I'm so thankful I dipped my fork in it to taste it first. So after a eating a dry pancake and getting ripped off from having to exclude meat for no substitution, we will never be back. My momma DEFINITELY can make a better breakfast than this.

Everyone on Next-door.com has been raving about this place so we HAD to try it.  Horrible.  Won't go back.  I ordered a French Dip.  Roll was under baked, falling apart.  Au Jus was like brown water.  Beef was gristly.  Didn't see any advertised cheese on it.  Husband had a $7 cheese steak sandwich & said it was nothing to write home about.  They don't give you a number or take your name when you order & we weren't sure how we'd get our food.  I'll buy a roast beef & make several French Dips at home, thank you very much.  I gave him my pickle & chips because he was still hungry when we left.  Felt like we wasted our money.  Could have gone to a favorite restaurant.
Very cool place ! Good food & good service but very crowded. The tuna melt is awesome

I was in town for business and everybody recommended going to Kona Grill for their food. I had to try the avocado app I was told and man was it great. I added sriracha to the sauce it comes with and it was perfect. I accepted the recommendation for the sushi chef on what to have for a roll and he recommended a house favorite - the portions were fantastic and great food.

We return to this location often because of the consistency in food, drinks and service. The BBQ chicken flatbread and the Cuban dip are always great choices. The Kahlua pork sandwich and the turkey BLT wrap are nothing special, but consistent. I will say that their "signature" fries are not signature in my opinion. Their cocktails are all good, but the drink menu is large so if that overwhelms you, be prepared.

Food isn't worth the wait.  Nothing special.  It wasnt bad food (It was hot and hash browns were crispy, it just isn't worth waiting for when there are other great options where you don't have to wait, or if you do wait it's worth it)Lots of empty tables but still have to wait. Is that to give the impression that you are so popular?  I went once and waited.  Went back again with my daughter because she had not dined there.  Twenty minute wait but many empty tables.  We didn't stay.  We did find a great little cafe close by- so thanks for that!  Sorry, I won't go back to stand in line for mediocre food.

Cafe Ole, whatever happened to you? They used to be awesome. I used to get the sampler and a kiwi flavored margarita. It was delicious back in the day. I used to love your chips and salsa. 
I don't know if it is the fact that I am now accustomed to going to places like Jalapenos and El Tenampa. I went to Cafe Ole this past weekend and it was like bleh!
The staff is friendly and the restaurant is very nice and clean. I loved the vibrant Cuban music that was playing. Cafe Ole has turned into a fast food restaurant and I found this depressing.
The food arrived quickly as though they were grabbing it from a buffet. The chips and salsa were not as fun. I like the delicate chips that you normally get, but these were thick and not as appetizing. 
I got the chicken chimichangas. I was expecting more because of my previous experience. Nope. These were so disappointing. Instead of shredded chicken it was  this blended concoction of carrots and something that I think was chicken. The only good thing on the plate was the rice and the lettuce with the tomatoes and cilantro. I came all the way to Meridian for this? 
Not only that the margarita probably came out of a Slurpee machine. It was good. I just received the order quicker than normal for a blended drink. 
Needless to say I was disappointed in Cafe Ole. I used to come here all of the time. I really miss the one that was downtown Boise and now their food. I will be sticking with El Tenampa from now on.

LOVE the Carmelizer!!! Being from the Seattle area I tend to be too much of a Starbucks snob, but on our trip to Boise we were urged to try Dutch Bros because it was my daughter in law's favorite and I'm now a Dutch Bros convert! I wish we had them closer to us, I'll definitely search them out when I'm traveling. The staff at both the locations in Boise/Meridian were so warm and friendly - they really made my great espresso drink even more amazing.

I don't know what it is about changing locations, but things are never the same again.  I've had breakfast twice since the move and have actually been there more than that and have opted out due to the wait.

Breakfast should be a relatively quick experience, so you can get on with the day.  When time becomes a factor, it becomes brunch or something else.  Today's "breakfast" turned into an almost 2 HOUR experience.  After waiting for a table, then waiting about 1 hour for food, my appetite for food and Joe Mammas has gone south.

So many things have changed since their move, I probably won't go back anytime soon.  In the old Eagle location, you were greeted by the owner/founder at the front desk.  The wait was reasonable, the table staff was experienced and responsive.  The food was great.

The new location appears to be an expansion of 3-4 times.  The front desk is the standard couple of young girls handling a lobby full of people.  The wait staff seemed overwhelmed and have minimal interest in advocating for you with the kitchen - the computer system is sequencing the food orders (not enough cooks, space, food servers, whatever).

I'm sorry for the rant, but I marvel at great places that get greedy and want to scale up success but explode it into a failure.
Delivery service was great and the food just as awesome as dining in!  I highly recommend.  Food was hot when it got here and salad fresh and yummy.
Best gluten free eggs Benedict in town! Delicious breakfast house potatoes. There's a wait sometimes, but they get you seated pretty quickly and it's worth it. Great family restaurant. Love it!

I really wish the staff here would provide sanitizing wipes on the gym floor. The dispensers are frequently left empty. I see a lot of staff hanging around in the office,  so surely someone should have time for maintenance. The difference between this location and Eagle is notable.
This place was so dirty.  The folks were trying hard but the system was so slow.    Not very fast, fast food.

Tried the breakfast burrito this morning, and it was simply the best I have ever had! I had the two meat option with pulled pork and brisket. It came with a side of salsa and sour cream. It was huge and simply delicious!

I First went there in 2013, and saw some very bad cleanliness habits within the food area, prep time was extensive, and the quality and taste of the food varied so two times was enough. A friend of mine is here from Seattle  and wanted to try it out. Ok....when we walked thru the doors the beverage cooler was 95% empty...interesting...the girl at the counter was coughing/hacking...i asked her if she was ok? she stated she was just "choking on her spit"...we continued to look at the menu, and felt safe with hamburgers...we did notice that it didn't come with fries, those extra, except with the dogs, but they did come with everything else...there were five dirty tables in the entire small place, and there had only been a man and his son in front of us. Our hamburgers and mozzarella sticks(4) got to us 30 minutes later...the hamburger bun was a 1/2 inch larger all the way around  the burger, 1 teaspoon of mayonnaise, large leaf of lettuce and TWO QUARTER SIZE PIECES of tomato, like from a Roma tomato, a very small piece of melted  cheese, one slice of bacon cut in half, and the bun was greasy. We really were not sure what to make of it either, as we kept looking at each other, the taste of the meat was off...my friends opinion was that the bar was so small (4 chairs)that there was no reason to sit or even go there, and he didnt like their "man cave", but his concern was with the co-use dirty bathroom and the staff that were seriously in the rough. My friend was going to start cleaning the tables when one member of the staff began to do so as we were leaving. Needless to say our suggestion is...Money is better spent...the food is better...you are treated better....and it will ALWAYS AND FOREVER BE HARD to beat in every given way at "BIG ALS"...I would have not have felt so awful (we both got upset stomachs )....i would have felt proud to have taken him to Big Als..

I read some of the other reviews and almost didn't come. Glad I let my love of Mexican override the comments. I completely enjoyed it. The service, salsa bar, mole sauce and margaritas we all excellent. In the area? Come on you'll enjoy it.

I've been going to this practice for about 20 years (WOW) and this is the first time I've thought to write a review. Shame on me! I've seen a few dentists in that time and, thankfully, they've all been good dentists whom I do trust.
I highly recommend Joe Mamma's for a great breakfast this was by far one of the best breakfasts I have ever eaten in my lifetime. This is a must for even the most picky breakfast eaters! So Yummy!!

The food seems okay, nothing to die for but okay. That said my biggest point in the review is around the oddity of having a large screen TV behind the bar where they play pro games like football and baseball 

The thing is that last night in the middle of the game (3rd quarter) they came over and said they were sorry but "...they were closed so I needed to leave) l

2nd visit. Everything was as good as the first time. Lots of fresh ingredients and great flavors. Split a noodle bowl and rice bowl with my wife. We had the smoked brisket in the noodle bowl. It added a nice flavor as you enjoy it. The noodle bowl was teriyaki tri tip.

I have been wanting to try this place for a while, and it was just as delicious as everyone says! We got the chicken jalapeno and pastrami pepper jack sandwiches. The waffle puff pastries are so flaky and delicious! Fries are basic but solid. service was excellent! Can't wait to go back and try more stuff!

We've been coming here for the past couple of years because our older dog required emergency care several times. After we got our puppy last March, we decided to take him here as well since we never had issues before. We ended up getting the "puppy pack" which costs more, but is supposed to save you money in the end if you have all of your services done here. Since we have a Great Dane puppy, we decided to have him get laproscopic gastropexy and neutered at the same time. I made the appointment back in May for July 5 and took the whole week off work so I could take care of him. At the time, the scheduler said she wasn't sure if Dr. Lake was available since they don't have their doctor's schedules that early in advance. When I called back around June 22, they said the doctor was not working that day and that the next opening was July 12. I rearranged my vacation time, had my father rearrange his trip from California to visit us so that it would co-inside with my time off. They told us to drop off our dog between 6:30 -8am and we dropped off our puppy at 7am, assuming that the surgery was done in the morning. My husband got a call at 2:20 from a gal from the front desk telling him our dog was ready to be picked up. We figured we'd leave him there for another hour so they could observe him. 30 minutes after my husband gets this call, I receive a call from Dr. Lake saying that the scope on the laproscopic machine is not working and that I may need to reschedule the gastropexy. I was concerned about the risks of putting my dog under anesthesia twice and he said there was nothing to worry about - he would try to get the scope to work and would call me back to let me know if he was able to get it to work, or if he would go ahead and only do the neuter. Dr. Lake called me back at 3:33 and said the scope was not working but that he did the neuter and my dog was just staring to wake up and to pick him up at 7pm. When I got there at 7pm, the gal at the front desk said there was no charge since they weren't able to do the surgery. I told her that I still needed to pay for the neuter and I find out that they NEVER did the neuter.  I questioned her several times since it didn't make sense to me and she told me that sometimes the doctors there do stuff that don't make sense to us. They brought out my dog and sure enough he is not neutered, BUT he was anesthesized and they did shave his stomach area and they brought him out with the leash tied around his neck. When we asked what happened to his Gentle Leader harness, another gal came out with it in pieces as she explained that they left it next to him and he chewed it up. I was absolutely livid and bewildered that I left my dog at the vet for 12 hours, and they put my dog under anesthesia for no reason and to top it off they let him chew up his harness. I am switching immediately to All Pet Complex which I've heard great reviews from other Great Dane owners and hope no one else ever goes through this type of experience.

Very nice staff and well run facility.  They have everything you may need from targets to ammo to new setups and even gunsmiths.  Always clean and the 100 yard range is a rare find among indoor ranges.

So sad to say we had a baddddd haircut from who appeared to be a seasoned stylist. She actually hurt my 11 year olds head by pulling hard while thinning his hair out. He regularly gets a cut every 2-3 weeks so he did not have a wild amount but she sure thought he did. Won't be back. She was also not very friendly which was another disappointment.

The food was good - I had the teriyaki chicken, rice, mac salad, and eggrolls. Atmosphere was awkward since we were the only ones in there, lighting was dim, and no music was playing, but I guess that could be avoided by taking your food to go. Girl behind the counter was nice and seemed to know her stuff, but forgot to put in our order of eggrolls until we had already finished our food.

I love Kona Grill but I especially love their happy hour times and days. I specifically picked Kona Grill for my Mother's Day lunch because they have all day happy hour - I don't love it for the drinks as much as their sushi specials.  So we went today only to find out that "corporate decided" that they would not honor the all day happy hour prices that they do every Sunday.  No signs saying so, nothing on their website just "we are not honoring it today".  And I wonder why you are needing to file bankruptcy?  Bad corporate decisions perhaps?

Good service. OK food. Not the best barbecue in town. Had very high hopes and expectations after trying the taters in the culinary walkabout. Taters are still fabulous. Mac & cheese very very so-so. Beans are good. Not my favorite meat.

Just got a new fog and took it in for a check up. The staff was friendly and professional. Was particularly impressed with Dr. Hondo, she wss so patient and gentle. It was a stress free experience for my dog. Rates were reasonable. I have never before seen a vet and assistant sit down on the floor with a dog just to make the dog more comfortable. Am new to this area and am so glad to know there is a vet I trust and respect

Very clean and nice little place, staff was very friendly and helpful.  Got the brisket and pulled pork, sides where mac & cheese and mashed potatoes.  The portions are huge, more then enough food for 2.  The pork was pretty good, the brisket, normally my fav at BBQ joints was absolutely horrible, fatty and zero smoke flavor...had two others with me and we all agreed.  The mac & cheese was awesome!  The garlic mashed potatoes where okay.  I won't be going back, sad to say it was a great enviorment, and excellent people, but the food was not up to par.
Best breakfast around. Although, get there early otherwise there's a long wait. People know a good place to eat and Jo Mamas is just that.

My wife and I went here for our 21st anniversary. Service was great and prompt. Our waitress was very enthusiastic and made sure she stopped by often.  The Diablo shrimp was pretty good with just enough spice.  My wife loved the sweet chili glazed salmon.  I ordered a sushi roll that was not on the menu but recommended by our waitress. I originally inquired about a tiger roll.  It was perfect.  Atmosphere was good and it was not loud as others mentioned.  Had a great dinner and were able to catch up with each other.  One of the managers even stopped by to make sure everything was fine.  This was our first visit to this restaurant and plan to head back for another date night. Thanks for a great experience

This place rocked. 

Marginal and cheap places the chicken fried steak comes looking like a patty out of the freezer. Here it was not and it was cooked/fried perfectly as was the gravy. 

3 egg omelette special equally delicious.
I went here because of a well placed coupon in the mail, super friendly service and they got my food out super quick, one of the best, if not the best sandwich i've ever had. definitely will be back.

Great little spot for lunch or snack! I had the tri tip bulgogi rice bowl and it was made fresh to order. Also sampled the egg roll and potstickers and both good. My kids got chicken finger baskets that came with fries and juice box - they have a kids menu, it's just not on the board. Choice of waffle grilled cheese, 2 chicken fingers (good size portion), or a corn dog and fries or chips and a drink. We also got the mango fruit tea with rainbow jellies which was nice and refreshing! Their noodle soup looked so good, will definitely try that next visit!
Nice and easy. My credit card is charged $30 monthly for unlimited car washes -- and it is the best wash with the wax, etc. I love it. Usually, the lines go quickly and the staff is so helpful!

Mike G
I took my classic car to have the AC charged. I was assured by Dave that it would be working as they had two Experts AC techs. After charging it still blew hot air and I was given the "bumbs rush" they did not have time for me. But, they did have time to collect their bill! I will not be back, very poor service!  I thought I had an appointment and my car would be fixed.

What an awesome "vibe" this place has! Going from Idaho farmland to European adventure, this place has it ALL! Stores, restaurants, playground, movie theaters, wonderful water fountains complete with sound and light show, outdoor music speakers play as you walk around the entire village. It possesses a very positive vibe. People are happy when they come here, you can tell. I love all the social events they put on there for the community to participate in. And, might I add......ample parking!!!! This is DEFINITELY a 5 star rating from me! So glad they built this here!

A fast food drive through (I wasn't expecting) that begs for tips. They make you sign a receipt. If I was in the business of subsidizing businesses' employees through tipping, I'd carry cash with me anyway. 

Also, the raw onion pairs terribly with the avocado, bacon, tomato gyro. Tried per another user's recommendation and I don't agree.

EDIT: to the customer service response - um no. An establishment would actually require a signature to protect themselves.
