So that when a bank or credit company comes to you, you can say this is the users signature. The bank protects me, which is why I report fraud to my bank, not where the charges are made. Most businesses do not require a signature for small items because of efficiency, this is why competitors of yours like Starbucks, Panera, McDonald's and more do not require a signature with purchase. Other stores do not as well such as gas stations, grocery stores and more. The fact that you do not need the effeciency is only a further indication that a tip is used to subsidize the employees.

You can always remove the tip line from the receipt?

I tried Bruchi's right after it opened and gave it another shot today. I guess if it's your thing, great, but when I'm dreaming of Tony Luke's, Jim's or Dalessandro's, the steak here doesn't fit the bill. 

My steak today was very over-seasoned, like a pepper bomb. The meat didn't have a lot of flavor (I can guarantee it's not hand-sliced ribeye), the cheese and onions were a bit lacking, and the roll was just... weird. 

The meat had an almost bacon-y taste to it. Don't get me wrong, I love bacon, but not when I ordered a cheesesteak. There was plenty of it, which is a good thing, but it didn't taste like the meat on a quality cheesesteak.

And the roll.. Oh, the bizarre roll... It's almost like a par-baked roll that is intended to be baked before serving, but they forgot to finish baking it. It's not browned at all and the texture is, as I said above, just weird.

I gave it two tries, there probably won't be a third. Like I said, if it's your thing, great, but it's not mine.
I love this place. Everyone is super friendly the food is excellent and I'm always glad I ate there when I'm finished. The portions are generous and very well done.

I really would recommend skipping this place. I was so excited to get my favorite dish and it was poorly done. The noodles were overcooked, the fish sauce was poor in taste. The crispy spring rolls were like overcooked sponges ;(
Overall very disappointed

My wife and I are here on Saturday for the first time. I got the breakfast meat scramble and my wife got the tuna melt. The food was delicious and that tuna melt was one of the best we've ever had!!! There was a long wait time and I can see why.... worth the wait! (Quick tip... adults can sit at the bar for quicker service) Highly recommend!!!

Quite the contrary, no one was yelling or cussing at your employees. If you had any smarts its called frustration with horrible service. And by the reply to my review it doesn't surprise me your restaurant and customer service are trash.  No wonder we watched numerous people walk away from your so called establishment. And as far as being human and having respect why don't you take a good long hard look at your bad attitude and how you treat customers and people in general.
 Maybe if you weren't " to busy" you could have heard from us and the right story of what happened. Putting us down is not very professional. Truly showing us that finding another establishment is the right move.

We came to Kona Grill on a Sunday night and were pleasantly surprised to learn it was happy hour!  The happy hour menu was a great value, and we all enjoyed the sushi rolls.  My favorite was the wave roll.  

We also ordered the Gouda fondue, lettuce wraps, bulgogi tacos, and a BBQ flatbread.  All were delicious but if I could only pick one, I would get the tacos.  The fondue was tasty but my daughter was really disappointed that they were out of the pretzels that are normally served with it.  We agreed to substitute garlic bread for dipping instead of the pretzels and I thought it was a good substitution.

Service was excellent.  Our servers were attentive and the management came by and checked on us a couple of times.  I liked that it wasn't really loud in the bar area.  I didn't feel like I had to strain myself to hear or be heard.  Also, the area we were in was really comfortable temperature-wise.  Most restaurants I go to are uncomfortably cold, but this place was perfect, even as the first snow of the year was falling just outside. I would definitely recommend this place.

This is probably the best breakfast place in town! All of their food is made with quality, I have yet to find something I don't like on their menu. They have amazing customer service, even with handling hundreds of people. Everyone works so hard to make sure you have a good experience. LOVE how the app makes getting a table easy. The food is so worth the wait!

First, I have to say, we are from Bend (Oregon), the self-proclaimed micro-beer capital of the entire world.  We were passing through the Boise area on our way home from Moab and were thirsty.  Google maps lead us to Slanted Rock because it was both close to the freeway and the patio is dog-friendly and we were so glad it did.

The young man working the place was the absolute sweetest!  Just a doll with the right amount of attentiveness.  He knew his beers but also seemed to have the ability to read his clients.  Without telling him my preferences, I asked what beer goes best with the fish n' chips from the food truck on their patio, and he brought me two samples - both of which were rather dark and delicious and rivaled any beer I've had in Oregon.  The one I choose was the perfect match to the fish n' chips and he clearly steered me right.  Hubby had the IPA and was also impressed with it.  The dogs loved the water the server-man was kind enough to give them.

If this place were in Bend, even with all the competition here, it would be one of our favorites.  It just felt so comfortable and casual and had just the right mix of busy-ness.  The food truck's prices were totally reasonable and their food was very good (and their waste was minimal).  The beers and the service were simply as good as it can get AND the whole vibe was "you are absolutely welcome here".

Helped with more than just carpet cleaning.  They were able to give us solutions we can use long term.  They did a great job on the whole house and we were thrilled with the price.  Really an excellent value.  Would highly recommend them.
Try the Spicy Bacon Avocado with Green Spicy. You won't find a similar flavor profile anywhere

We made the mistake of coming on Sunday. We waited 2 1/2 hours before our food came. While the pancakes were plate sized, the rest of their portion sizes were small. The food was nothing special and overpriced. Save your time and money and eat anywhere but here.
Are you kidding me?!? A one hour wait and I counted 8 tables open. Hire some more people!

Came here for Mother's Day breakfast with my husband and 2 small kids ...we were told they had no high chairs available right that minute...we decided to be seated and wait for a high chair ..which the hostess assured us wouldn't be long ...we were then seated at high top table that a high chair wouldn't have worked at anyways ..when our waitress realized she moved us to a regular booth where I again had to remind her that we were waiting for a high chair ... she was somehow under the impression that we would be holding out baby the entire time we sat at the restaurant ... she then let us know that they only have 2 high chairs in the entire restaurant and the tables they were being used at were still eating ... needless to say we walked out and will never be returning . Not quite sure how a family restaurant only has 2 high chairs ..
The best sushi and seafood in treasure valley ! I would suggest the tuna sliders and also the calamari to anyone.

Cute place located inside The Village. Outdoor seating faces the fountain and kids play area and right next to the cinema. The atmosphere was nice, it would be fun to come here for dinner or late night appetizers. We were here on a Monday for late lunch and it was pretty much empty. We ordered the Argentinean fish tacos, strawberry balsamic salad and half the pear and beet salad with chicken. They have an assortment of mocktails to choose from which was fun!  The total was $43. Kinda spendy. 

Not too impressed with the tacos or the strawberry salad but the beet and pear salad was very good! Glad I ordered the 1/2 size because it was very hearty and filling. 

Next time I'm in town I wouldn't mind coming here for dinner or dessert.

This McDonald's was recently remodeled! The play place is great for the kids, and there's a single bathroom in there. The kids working here were working hard, the food was good...that's about all you need for a McDonald's!

The restaurant is trendy. That is the only nice thing I have to say about the Kona Grill. We ordered sushi and it was fine. Not good, not bad. Just alright. Nothing to get excited about. The problem was with the wait staff. They acted as if they were just too pretty to help us. Our waiter didn't check on us once after he brought our drinks ( about 20 minutes later), and he was not that busy. We will not be visiting this restaurant again.

I've heard great things about this restaurant. After many failed attempts to get seated in a timely fashion we finally got in. The restaurant was clean and the server was great. The man at the front wasn't so friendly. He almost had an attitude that we were privileged to be there. I ordered a breakfast burrito that was disappointing. There wasn't much flavor. If we go again it'll be for the flavored pancakes. Those looked really good.
Since I can't respond back to you Kathleen I'll respond here. Maybe Mark was having a bad day. I don't know. I do know he wasn't very friendly to us. 
I didn't feel it was necessary to tell our server about the breakfast burrito. It just didn't have enough flavor for me. My husband liked his breakfast. That's why I said if we go back I'd get something different. Thank you for your response.

The sandwich that I ordered tasted great.  They even had Mr. Pibb as a fountain drink selection, thought it was no longer made.  The little things are lacking.  The sandwiches are overloaded, so things get messy.  Unfortunately there were no utensils at the counter, nor even any napkins at the tables.  A roll of brown paper towels must did not cut it.  A bit overpriced for the poor experience

We went with a large group and the service was great (thanks, Kat). We had Picasso sushi (great), BBQ sliders (delicious!) and a salad that was also fantastic. The atmosphere is fun and is probably even more so during the warmer months. I would definitely recommend.

They have the worse customer service! I stood in line trying to wait patiently to pay for my overpriced small beer that was $6 when the manager said they should've told you to get a large for $7! He should've been more helpful seeing that his cashier was obviously struggling!! We were better off waiting to get back into Boise to get dinner. Note to self, don't waste the drive. Better priced places in Boise and better customer service....

This is probably the second time I have come here. I was really wanting a good burger and was kind of disappointed with everything. Our waitress was awesome and she kept our drinks filled. Unfortunately the strawberry lemonade tasted watered down on both glasses that I received. I ordered the Wagyu burger with BBQ on the side. I ordered it medium and it was a little dry, my fries seemed like they were baked. I do like that they do have a good selection of foods, and lots of drinks. One thing I do hate is having to wave the flies away from our food because they left the door open for outdoor eating. The place is well decorated and bathrooms are very clean. I would give it a try again because they do have good people working there with great customer service!

Walked in bout 9am ish on a Friday, lots of empty tables inside and we were seated outside. Eagle is a very busy road and it was quite noisy. It took 20 minutes to get water then another 15 to place our orders. People who came in after us were served first and my food came out cold. My husbands food was hot . Would not go back I think le peeps food and service was much better

Walked over to Shari's Cafe & Pies from our hotel, for breakfast. We were quickly greeted, seated and offered coffee by the host.  Our server, Mike aka "The Chosen One", came over to our table right away to check in and did so with great genuine enthusiasm.  He made us feel welcomed and ready to take care of us.  Food was great too :)

Went to the new Fairview location.  The wait was 50-minutes before food arrived.  Staff was friendly and comped a desert for the long wait.  Food was mediocre and very overpriced for the quality: $60 for 2-people, no drinks.  Charged extra for double brisket on a 3-meat combo meal even with only ordering brisket and sausage.  Definitely not a good value for the high cost.
The ribs were bouncy like rubber and smelled foul when close to the nose. If you want good ribs avoid this place.

Great place to eat. Excellent bbq sauces. Awesome waitress. Only issue was a fly that did not leave us alone! Literally this fly was around us the whole time and it was uninvited!!!! I've never had a fly being at my table but it happened here!

When I found out that All Valley also had a hospital and that they had animals for adoption from said hospital I was intrigued.  I went into the cat section and they had about 12 cats up for adoption.  On the bottom row, sitting very quietly was the cat of my dreams.  Same face, same markings, same demeanor as one I had lost recently and loved dearly.  I held him in my arms for over 15 minutes and he showed no eagerness to jump down.  He was wrapped in a blanket so I had no idea what was underneath.

I took him out of the blanket and was a bit alarmed to see that all of the fur was removed from the lower half of his body.  He could barely walk.  The nurse said he had been run over by a car and the accident had broken his pelvis in 3 places.  A passer-by had dropped him off at the hospital and the hospital did the required surgery for free.  She assured me that since he was so young, that he should be able to walk again and his fur would grow back within 6 months.

I adopted him for $40.  They would not give me his surgery records since I was not his original owner.  I brought him home and he limped his way under a dark place.  My family thought I was nuts to bring such a creature home.

We named him Scruffy although sometimes he was called Stumpy when he limped after some John Wayne movie.  Scruffy went from a bad limp only walking on 3 paws to running on 3 paws to tentatively walking on 4 paws to running on 4 paws.  It has been 6 months now and all of his fur is back and the only way we can tell he ever had broken bones or surgery is that he doesn't like to be petted on the bottom half of his torso.

This would be a 5 star very happy story if it weren't for one thing.  When we brought Scruffy home he had very very smelly diarrhea.  I read a lot about pelvic bone breaks and surgeries and assumed that it was part of that and that it would go away.  

I changed food which made his stools more solid and the other cats didn't mind.  The smell went away and I figured problem solved.  Jump ahead a month and all 3 cats have diarrhea and Scruffy's had blood in it.  I rushed him to our personal vet.  $800 later it was determined that he had Coronavirus which has no cure and that he had spread it to our other two cats.  So all three of them had an incurable virus which apparently is quite common and easily spread.

The vet said there was no way that All Valley would not have known about the virus given the state of his stools when I adopted him. My cats are currently on very expensive special food and off and on treatments of medication to try and make the intestines not bleed.

*** Update

Blood in the stools for about a year, nothing much for the past 3 years.  Scruffy is our number one cat, and I thank whoever decided to put him back together every day.

Best HAPPY HOUR AROUND! 
I came to Kona Grill about two years ago when I visited Idaho. I just recently moved herring this was the first place I had to go! I am from Hawaii, so good, fresh, sushi is hard for me to find. Their sushi is amazing, my next favorite would have to be the chicken lettuce wraps. The food is so good and the prices can no be beat. A major plus is sitting outside to catch the next water show!
Really impressed by this salon!!  I had my first set of dip nails put on over two weeks ago, traveled to Europe and just returned with *still* perfect nails!!  Definitely would recommend!!

First time here. They were a little tough to locate because they are on the back end of a business mall. THE WERE WORTH HUNTING FOR. THEY ARE AMAZING!! Great people and great food.Good quality and awesome tasty. Would absolutely recommend them.

Wow. Just wow. I'm so pissed off right now. New location is horrible. I loved the old location. Service was sub par. Our breakfast absolutely sucked. Gravy had no flavor what so ever. Ask for over medium eggs, got over cooked. Ask for an extra egg. Did not get it. My wife asked for salsa on the side of her burrito. It was but so was way too much salsa in the burrito. Not only is the food delicious, the service is great! They are so quick and very nice. I would definitely go again, and would recommend it to anyone who is in Nampa.

Food:  Fresh yet boring.  

Service:  Slow, very slow and inattentive.  Friday night and only a couple of tables and still could get our server to wait on us.

Dunkley claims to do guitar repair. I brought my guitar in for repair. I was informed that the repair technician wasn't in. Instead of them calling the repair tech, they told me I had to. Cindy is absolutely amazing! I wanted a change after years of having the same look. She reassured me and eased any anxiety I was having. I will never go to the dump again. The cashier was a total idiot, couldn't make change even on the computer. And of course the sandwich was wrong. And they wouldn't hand it to me because you have to walk to the back to pick it up, even if you're the only one there. The place sucks from the beginning to the end.

Went to tmobile to switched carriers. Steve was fantastic. Everything went with ease. Steve made it so stress free, was very knowledgeable, competent in what he does. Got our new phones and we were off..happy campers!!! Great service, helpful, great attitudes. Tmobile has the greatest rices with unlimited data and no data usage with Hotspot when on YouTube, ESPN, AND NETFLIX!!! PERFECT!!!

I wanted to like this place - but I was underwhelmed. It smelled like old oil from the moment I came in (my clothes slightly smell like it now after leaving a half hour ago). Big Daddy delivers with some GREAT BBQ! The Carolina and Big Sriracha sandwiches will blow your freakin socks off! Great spot for some great food
I love this place, the food is great and the Price's are reasonable for the portion size

My go to place for bbq supplies.  I've even picked up some great recipes and other ideas from staff I've gotten to know.  Knowledgeable, friendly and candid--they haven't just tried to sell me the priciest items they have. Pretty much the same as all the other reviews: slow service that was mostly unfriendly (aside from one guy), soggy, forgettable food that was way too expensive and skimpy on the portions, awkward and uncomfortable atmosphere. How is this place still open?

Dr Hess has been our dentist for around 12 of those years and has helped me immensely. I needed a transplant, but before I was illegible to receive one, I needed to have some much needed dental work. Slow service, portions of meal served Luke warm, flavor ok. Would avoid if I was you.

The au jus' for the French Dip (or any hot sandwich) is full of rich beef flavor, not watered down like a lot of places we have been. The only complaint is we have been there 3 times and each time one of our sandwiches is wrong and we have to go back and get a new one.  That is frustrating!  It seems they have a very young staff and I am not sure management is present in the evenings to double check the orders.  I think with an improvement in that regard they would be 5-star easily.

This is the ABSOLUTE BEST sandwich place I've ever been too. The gals that work there are so personable and get to know you and your order.
The sourdough bread is to DIE for  
I have had the Italian which is so delicious and fresh tasting. 
My favorite is the Ruben. Best Ruben in town for sure! Very fresh. Amazing meat portion and made with love every time. This place is busy- yet the only place I'll wait and have patience for-it's that damn good! If you haven't tried it- what are you doing with your life?! Go there
Food and service was excellent! Really friendly staff took great care of my family and I. Food was solid. Next time I'll try something else. Drinks were good as well.

I ordered the beef stir fry. The flavor was excellent but the meat could have fit in the palm of my hand without being anywhere near the edges. This was less stir fry and more of a salad with some stir fry sauce. I guess it's a good option if you are on a calorie restricted diet, but I wish I had ordered something more substantial.

I like that McDonald's tries to keep up with the times and that they change things for the better when it needs to. They try very hard to please all of us, and for the most part they succeed. I would have rated them even higher if I didn't have to watch CNN as I drink my coffee and have breakfast with the other geezers in the mornings.

IAC was operated with marginal maintenance for several years.  Broken equipment was not repaired timely.  The steam room at the Caldwell facility has been damaged for two years.  After a lot of excitement with the new ownership, conditions at the facilities have steadily declined.  Specifically at Caldwell, the locker room paper product dispensers are empty and the shower area has mildew.   The personnel are excellent.  Crunch needs to invest in their clubs to be competitive.

I drove out to Meridian to Irena's after reading the positive reviews by J.W. and Michelle. There were several people shopping when I walked in. I think I was the only one who didn't speak a second language.

They stock a wide variety of meats, sausages, cakes and canned and packaged goods. 

The dried beef and pork sausage sticks located on the bottom right edge of one of the cold cases are excellent. 

I viewed the by-the-pound cakes and asked the man behind the counter the difference between two of the cakes. He looked at me quizzingly and then told me "they have different ingredients and different flavors." To myself, I said, you don't know, either. Ha.

I tried one that appeared to be chocolate. It ended up being very good. Another trip, I wanted the same kind of cake, but the owner said she just pulled that one out of the freezer and I'd need to come back a couple of hours later, after it thawed a bit. I tried a different one instead.

I'm glad to see a new ethnic store in the area. I look forward to returning and trying some things I'm not familiar with.

Everything was good, glad the older lady who is so cranky was not there since she is such a downer. All the employees seemed happy and were very nice. This is the kind of environment that I like to come into.

We had potstickers and three different sushi rolls. The potstickers tasted fine but were a little pricey. $10 for 5. Each one was definitely not a $2 value. The rolls all tasted good but they were rolled very loose, to where they fell apart during the transfer from plate to sauce to mouth. Pretty sticky and messy if you're into that sort of thing.

First, the service is super friendly.  They have good espresso drinks in addition to god old fashioned coffee.

We ordered the Italian Benny which rivaled any we've ever had.  It was served with prosciutto and balsamic vinegar.  It truly a divine experience.

This place is deserving of the full five stars.  Well done JM!

My poor dog decided she was more hungry for my kid's toys and various chunks of garbage than she was for her dog food. So low and behold she ended up in surgery cutting mini toys out of her gut. I did some calling around and these guys were much more reasonable than some.  To her to a pet Hospital and they gave me the hard sell and guilt trip like a I was killing my dog if I didn't let them take her right then. That's why I shopped around a bit.. They took her in and took great care of her. Have been back since with other things etc. Staff id great and doctor is nice and caring.

I was recommended this spot by a friend. It was our first time here. The coffee is decent and the Chicken Fried Burrito is delicious! Our waitress was super nice. I would have given 5 stars if not for the snobby food server. The attitude of this young lady was horrendous. We spoke to our waitress about it and she stated she let management know. If she did in fact tell the manager, the manager NEVER came out to speak with us about it. Very unprofessional. Because of this, I don't know if I'll be back.

All in all, a pretty solid gym. The recent upgrades have been needed for a while (member since 2000). I'd like to see more detail/attention given to the sauna/steam area, as well as an upgrade to the swimming facilities. It seems that management is trying to raise the bar for this gym and they are open/willing to suggestions.

I can. I can only speak about the coffee here. I ordered an americano and it tasted no different than any diner coffee. It's a light roast with sour notes-the Boones Farm of coffee.

The line to exit and pay long, staff minimal on a Thursday in August.

Last weekend my husband and I decided to visit this restaurant after our son's football game. We visited this restaurant once during their first year of business and had a nice meal, so we thought we would revisit them since we were in the area. As other's have mentioned there was a wait, but that's not unusual for a good breakfast eatery. What was odd though, was the amount of empty tables. It just didn't make sense to have so many people waiting if there were available seats. Also, when we were quoted the 30-40 minute wait time we were told how lucky we were to have that wait time on a Saturday. Ok... They did offer us a cup of coffee  while we waited and my husband accepted, only to find a hair in his cup once he finished. When he brought this to the hostess's attention she did give him another cup but kind of brushed off the hair. Alright, things happen, so we let it slide. Once we were sat we were impressed with their menu and specials, and their prices seemed very reasonable. I ordered The Crab Cake Benedict with a side of the hash brown casserole(special). My husband ordered a breakfast Chile Relleno (special) and we ordered some Peach Stuffed French Toast to share. My husband and I devoured our meals, they were delicious! Unfortunately, when we got to the French Toast we discovered yet another long, dark hair cooked into the batter of our treat... Our waitress ( I didn't get a name, but she was blonde, had tattoos and wore a BSU shirt. She was also kind, and very attentive. ) apologized profusely, and removed the dish from our ticket. After we left, we discussed our experience and tried to determine whether they were an awful restaurant or if we just had a fluke bad experience. We finally decided it was the later. 
That leads us to our second visit which occurred yesterday afternoon. Again there was a wait, and again we noticed several empty tables. We were not offered coffee this time, and when I requested one it took quite a while to receive it. (There was no hair this time, so there's that!) Once it was time to order,  I ordered the same meal that I had the week before(less the hb cass as they no longer had it), my husband ordered blueberry stuffed french toast w/ a side of scrambled eggs, and my son ordered biscuits and gravy. While it took quite a while to receive our drinks the food came out quickly. Again, there was no hair, but when my husband took a bite of his eggs he noticed that they were under cooked. (For reference, they were very runny with uncooked whites and yolks dripping off of them.) We asked our server to replace them with eggs that were cooked a bit longer she said she would. Once she returned, she told our table "We are very literal about our eggs, so next time please let us know that you would like your eggs hard scrambled. " Um, ok? I guess I should have also requested that my poached eggs be "soft poached" so that my yolks weren't cooked solid as well?... This time we not only had issues with our food, but the service was pretty bad as well. On our way home we decided that our 1st bad experience wasn't a fluke and that we would definitely not be visiting this place again. This decision was solidified when my husband started experiencing stomach pain, nausea, and vomiting a few hours after our meal. Turns out, eating undercooked eggs can cause food poisoning, who knew? (Every one. Everyone knows this.) 
In conclusion, if you are into bad service, hairy food and gastrointestinal issues, this is the place for you. If not, save yourself the (unnecessary) wait and get your breakfast elsewhere.

Great food, I initially had a review on here that reflected an issue with wait times.  Up until my recent issue it has always been solid.  I edited my review because the owner of the establishment made the effort to reach out and make it right. For me, like many that is all we really want. And they did that.  We all make mistakes and they addressed theirs.  So kudos for that. And my rating now truly reflects the overall experience I have grown accustomed to at this restaurant :).  PS. I am not accepting a free meal, the effort to make good was more than enough and speaks volumes:)
Great Hash and a gigantic pancake to boot. Home style and a great place to feel the morning beast. Classic morning cocktails are a bonus and accompany all the comfort food you can stand
Pizza was great. New strawberry chicken salad was awesome. Molly was one of the best servers I've ever had.
Love a coffee place with heaps of sugar free options. This little drive thru hit the spot. Coffee was hot, not too sweet, with a bonus coffee bean in top. Yeah, caffeine!

I absolutely love this deli. The owner Karen is extremely on top of her game. The hot out of the oven bread just melts in your mouth. This location is somewhat lost in a business park but worth the search.

I truly love eating here. The food is very good and the atmosphere is beautiful. I've always had very good service as well. My only complaint, is that the drinks are lame. I'm not even a very big drinker and for the price I would like to be able to taste the alcohol.

This pizza is so good!! I like the set up of this restaurant, you actually get seated and there's a menu to order off of. We got the kids "make your own pizza" which comes with a drink and gets served on a frisbee, and an adult pizza to share. The waitress was so helpful, and we just had a great experience here. 
There's also a little video game room in the front in case you have to wait for a table.

I'm visiting from California and wanted to catch up with an old friend over breakfast .I called ahead at 7 am  to make sure they were open as its a holiday and they said they were. 
We hopped in the truck and headed over, we were seated right away, our waitress was super friendly and since she was the only one out on the floor ; so she was also very busy 
my friend had one of the hash specials 3 meats i think. Just  a half portion with scrambled eggs which he gave to me as he dislikes eggs ; weurd huh! French toast , i sampled a few bites and it was pretty tasty , he said it was  little overcooked and dry . 
I had a caramel macciato which I'm sorry I do not recommend it was super sweet and just tasted like regular coffee with a bunch if syrup dumped in it. Gross 
My breakfast however was amazing the papa joes trash taters- potatoes were cooked perfectly with lots of tasty bits, peppers and mushrooms bacon, onion  and cheddar cheese on top followed by biscuits with gravy .  they were nice enough to scrambke my friends eggs and add them on top ;yummy downhome hot and comforting 
If you want a fancy or fun  decor it  is non existent but there is plenty of parking and good food in abundance. When you are catching up on old times what's better !  We were there to eat and talk , and did just that_. I  would go back again, thumbs up 3.5 stars until they learn how to make barrista style coffee

I have never seen service so bad. Gave them a pass first time. 12 minutes for 3 blizzards. Came to us to appologize saying there was a busy druve through. 8 employees standing 3 working. You know what your getting when it comes to dairy queen drive ti a different one.
The chicken fried steak was good, the biscuit and gravy was bad. The mimosas was good and a good price. The waitress was really nice and attentive.

On Easter Sunday, my wife and I wanted to go early for a nice brunch. I wanted to try something different and thought let's give Joe Momma's a try. Left our house right when they opened, and beat the crazy Easter Sunday rush.
Decent atmosphere, and great service even though they were busy with the amount of people calling to try to reserve seats.
I decided to go with Papa Joe's trash taters. The name sounded right up my ally! Described as "golden hash browns, fresh mushrooms, sautéed onions, green bell peppers, and our house baked ham covered with cheese. Served with your choice of toast, French toast, pancake, or biscuit." I added a side of gravy and love getting rye toast when we go out for breakfast. I should have added a couple of over easy eggs, but it was still delicious! My wife ordered waffles with a side of sausage. Which had grill marks on it like a steak. The sausage was quite good.
If you're in the mood for a solid breakfast and in eagle, give Joe Momma's a try!

I took our family pet there over the weekend for an emergent situation.  I called first and was told to bring her right over.   We arrived late morning.  She had an evaluation and we were told to return at 1pm.  She hasn't been seen.  Return at 4pm.  She hasn't been seen.  7pm still not seen.  Phone call report after 9pm. We live over an hour away.  Returned the next morning to pick her up.  She smells bad. There is blood and puss on her fur.  I waited 45 minutes in the waiting room for them to deliver her to me.  No communication from staff, inept staff, and over charged.  $800  and I'm just glad to get her home.  Never Again!!

Don't go here.  They used to have decent food, but that was years ago.  The salsa is tomato paste, chips had no flavor, avocados were not ripe.  We even attempted to make our own salsa adding salt and another salsa.  No avail. 

One taste of the rice and it ruined the rest of the meal.  My man exclaimed, "What the F is that?".  It's worse vomit.  I thought for sure he was exaggerating.  Nope.  I spit it back out on to my plate.  I've never spit anything out at a restaurant before.  

Also, the tacos were grease soaked. 

The server said her manager would comp the rice. WTF...our whole dining experience was HORRIBLE!!!!  

Cafe Ole will be out of business in the area with this caliber of garbage being served.
Love this Dutch!! The staff is so friendly always have a smile on their face. For a quick pick me up gotta try the shooter with chocolate milk.

This place is the go to when you want Southern BBQ at its yummiest in these northern parts. I had the ribs with a lovely Cole slaw. The mac and cheese wasnt anything to write home about, but the exceptional ribs and burgers more than compensated. Lovely selection of beers, friendly service, and Southern comfort food.  Definitely a keeper.
You guys fucking blow stop being Jews and upgrade your coverage you bums slow service 24/7 and nobody else likes the service.

Keep in mind only one side of the restaurant is happy hour. They say all day happy hour on Sunday. Not true if you dine on the wrong side. Food is good but service is very slow! On the positive side, if you want long conversation this is the place for you! 3 hour experience minimum. You would think they would want to turn tables faster!
Not your everyday restaurant in Meridian....and food is very very good.   Staff is friendly and helpful.  Will be back.

Love this place.  Ridiculous portions and a great number of breakfast and lunch offerings.  Family owned so you can order wild assemblages.  We watched (were greatly entertained) a guy next to us who compiled a seven layer burger- beyond imagination. He ate it like a watermelon- keeping the bottom on the plate and biting his way in.  Hilarious.
Food was ok, but communication and wait for food was nothing I have ever seen.  I work in the service industry and it will be awhile before I go back to kona

Great resources are provided. We were able to get the car washed. Towels are provided to dry drops on car. Moist towelettes to wipe down interior and strong vacuums are awesome. My only complaint is the foul water smell at this location.

Dennis Anderson

Not a real good meal, I ordered the crab mac (20 bucks)and was very disappointed. I would expect to find at least a chuck or 2 of crab but the crab was so ground up and fishy that I could not finish it. My wife had the chicken and she said it was dry for the price I would expect better.
     Before I left I used the mens room and the seat was so loose it was almost falling off and there was no TP that I had to use a seat cover for you know what. Very upset and will not be back.
Their work is always amazing. Hudson and Tisha did and amazing job on my hair but I've been all their stylist work and they are amazing.

It's the perfect place for just about everything. Seriously, what else is there to ask for? There's a theater, a bowling alley, a small park and playground for kiddies, that pretty water fountain! And then the numerous amounts of shops and eateries - what a variety! This whole place has everything for everyone. I'm not from anywhere remotely close to the state of Idaho but this place is comparable to a few SoCal spots boasting these kinds of settings. 

It was a good stop. Gotta keep 'em on my radar for the next visit.
Had my first appointment with Kristen. She did a good job and was very thorough.  Everyone was nice and friendly. Recommend!
Happy hour on Sunday is the best and only time we go. Drinks are great but watching them sit for 10min at the bar is unbearable. The carrot cake is a MUST!

I'm altering my original post after a few days thought and a chat with the owner. Here is the truth. I had a bad experience with one specific employee. I will not be going back so long as he's employed there because he was rude and dishonest. But we all have bad days. Maybe I just was unfortunate and got the brunt of his bad day.
That being said, it's not a bad company. In fact, I think it's probably a pretty great one. Prior to this, I loved them. 
The owner saw my review and took the time to contact me and hear me out. That alone made a huge difference. I'm sad to not have them as an option any longer but there are certainly far worse places you can take your car to be fixed.

This place caught me off guard - in a very positive way. The only negative is I often eat too much and need a nap. Everything I have tried is good. Currently into the brisket and teriyaki chicken. The Spam fried rice is pretty tasty. Huge portions, proceed with caution!

Very disappointed with service. They will not stray from the menu an inch. I asked if I could have cheese on top of the fries and they said no. The table I sat at was wobbly and almost spilled my drink. And the staff had frowns and when I said good morning as a greeting the cashier ignored me... the two things that are good are the place looks nice, and the food is pretty good.

Went here for the first time. This place serves large portions, and the pancakes are a good size as well. Great place for Breakfast. Reasonable priced. Plus they serve a great Bloody Mary. I've found my new Breakfast spot!!! Service was on wonderful. They were busy and still made time to get to everyone in a timely manner. You guys ROCK ! I'll definitely be e repeat customer

Got grossed out when I watched the main cook handle the food with bare hands.  Not too big of a deal if kept clean like a professional cook, but he was constantly adjusting his baseball hat, wiping his nose and messing with his ears.  
Sorry, won't be back.
I just started going to this one and it's from now on my favorite stop. The baristas that I've encountered so far have all been so sweet and my drinks are always so tasty.

Now that I've wiped the tears from my eyes after laughing when reading J W 's FTR for Irena's, I say he got it exactly right about this nice little European food market.  Although I observe it is mostly EASTERN European foods.  My Italian heritage husband did zero in on a package of Italian cookies but most of the food and labeling language would be more recognizable to my Ukraine born and raised sister-in-law than it was to my husband and me.  While we were shopping a woman who was clearly a regular customer stopped in and she spoke Russian to the sales person who replied in kind.

J W captured it so well for contents of the sparkling space and friendly service.  Although I observe and add that my hubby and I were both surprised to find maybe better than 60% of the store contents were sweets; cookies or candies or cakes.  The nice young woman behind the counter laughed when we made the observation and said "Maybe 70%!".

And it was as we were talking to her and getting ready to make our purchase that we spied them. The cakes. Luscious looking multi layer cakes in a refrigerated case behind her.  How we missed those until check out is a mystery to me.  So I'll add that when you enter the store you should look right and be sure to observe these sooner rather than later.

The cakes come in frozen from New York and are thawed to sell by the pound at a bargain for the quality at $7.99 / pound.  One pound is the minimum purchase for now. We were told when Irena's evolves to provide deli service then the cakes will be available by the slice.  

There were about half a dozen from which to choose and we opted for a honey cake with maybe seven uber thin and moist layers of cake with filling in between each and frosted with luscious buttercream sprinkled with dark chocolate and sliced almonds.  It was just sweet enough but not too much.  We sliced it into three generous but not overly large slices at home and we were told it will keep for several days in the fridge. (AS IF we tested out that factoid.  This cake was history in 24 hours.)

As delicious to eat as it is pretty to look at, my husband's comment about the cake was "This is company worthy!"  His comment made me think of a comment food personality and cook Ina Garten often makes.  It goes like this:  "My guests do not have a better time if I make the dessert."   I think she and her guests would like Irena's cakes too

THIS N THAT:

1) PARKING:  Private lot in this Meridian small strip mall location.

2) ACCESSIBILITY:  Accessible in parking in lot. Level in store and throughout.

3) PAYMENT:  Sign at the counter says checks are no longer accepted.  If you use a credit card you will be requested to show ID.  Or, in a nod to J W.'s delightfully entertaining review, you can "pey with kesh".

We checked out other reviews before deciding to eat here. Awesome decision. 

My boyfriend thought the waffle would be weird. But it was so crunchy and flaky. It was delicious. 

I feel weird saying that they're fries are so good, especially since BFC is a few doors down. But I really enjoyed their fries. 

I had the turkey bacon swiss and my boyfriend had the chicken jalapeño. Both were excellent. 

We basically had the place to ourselves (because it was barely 5 PM) but the service was good. And we can weren't smothered for being the only ones there. We will be back!

So I finally finished a six week fitness program and was able to eat real food again! Of course I wanted some beef, preferably smoked and delicious. I knew right away where I would be going and what I would be trying! It had to be Big Daddy's BBQ for their smoked prime rib! I love prime rib, however most of the prime rib I get in restaurants is disappointing at best. I smoke a damn good prime rib and have given up on most restaurants. I will however try new places to see what they have to offer. If you've read my previous review of Big Daddy's, you know that I was sold on this place being a legit smokehouse from the time I opened the door. So it was, with the expectation of real smokehouse prime rib, I arrived at Big Daddy's on a Friday night to try their rendition of smoked prime rib. First things first, I noticed they had a stout on tap so I had to order that. Then we were given  the special of the day menu choices,  8 oz, or 16 oz prime rib. We decided to split the 16 oz because I eat lots and she eats little. That meant we could split the baked potato and smoked green beans with bacon and onion. The prime rib was so good, my Lady said she hated to swallow it! She wanted to keep chewing and tasting it. I also thought the prime rib was very good (not as good as mine). The BIG surprise of the dinner for me was the smoked green beans with bacon and onion! What a beautiful dish! I have always enjoyed green beans with bacon and onion but the delicate smoke flavor really set it off! It's those kind of dishes that differentiate Mom and Pop places like Big Daddy's BBQ from big chain BBQ. And as a bonus, we had Kiki, who is not only the best bartender but also a great waitress. Also, we liked the whole experience so much, we bought a gift card to give to family as a present.
Shoddy service and no consistency in their food. Any trained culinarian can spot the fraud in their menu a mile away.

My son was referred to Intermountain Medical Imaging for an Abdominal CT Scan. We were pleased that they could schedule him in the next morning. Not having Health Insurance, we were concerned about the cost, and were pleasantly surprised that if we paid our bill in full the day the Imaging was done, the cost would be $400.00! All of the people at the front desk were very kind, helpful and friendly! Thank You All for Being such a Blessing to My Family!
Great environment, and many very good shops! Fun atmosphere to be around. Will be back!

not the absolute worst mexican food i've ever had, but not good, either. we had enchiladas. utterly forgettable. sorta sloppy, watery. and the chips and salsa were basically the macdonalds version of real mexican chips and salsa.

i've yet to have good mexican food in the eagle/meridian/star area. starting to wonder if i need to travel into boise to find it...

Just stopped in for the Sunday all day happy hour and we were really impressed! We ordered some cocktails, sushi rolls, and half price food off the happy hour menu. We enjoyed everything we ordered and will definitely be going back!

Must try this new restaurant!  Food was delicious and other yelp reviewed inspired me to try this place.  The smoked brisket waffle sandwich with fries was fabulous!!  Owner and staff were super friendly and atmosphere very welcoming and clean.  The menu was priced great and had a surprisingly wide variety of yummy food selections plus a lot of drink choices (smoothies, teas, Boba, etc).  I cant wait to go back and I will try to save room for the yummy desserts.  I was full from my meal (generous portions which is another plus) so didn't do dessert this time.

The Mecca Gym is a gem of a training facility located in a strip mall area right off the freeway in Meridian, ID.  It is tucked back in such a way as to allow for back door access to the back lot for Prowler runs, farmer's walks and tire flipping.  

Owned by local natural bodybuilders and powerlifters, Eric and Kacee Cafferty, the locals all have a sense of ownership and familial bonding after only one visit to this gym.  Go in without your headphones on and you'll see what we mean.  Everyone is friendly, willing to help, coach, co-train and chat about pretty much anything.  We saw a 130# gossipy female (very entertaining) trying to pr her squat with a 210# beefcake mainstay of the club.  

All of the equipment is top-of-the-line and the Cafferty's own several unique pieces we have not seen anywhere in the Treasure Valley.  These include a Nautilus pec-deck straight from Venice Beach, a Roger's squat (if you haven't worked your ass-quads-core in this remarkable piece of equipment, a visit to The Mecca Gym is worth it just for that.) and a seal row bench.  The powerlifting staples are of the best quality we've seen in the entire state and if you are trying to just work on your Big 3, this is your gym.

Cardio equipment consists of a row of treadmills and a step mill.  They also own a Jacob's Ladder, which is great.  The step mill has no platform for a phone or iPad to watch a movie so that's disappointing.

The staff is all sincerely friendly with welcome greetings, big furry smiles and surprisingly, the females don't annoy us with their friendly chatter.  The "Mecca Family" (meaning the members) are always available to help spot you, inform you or give you a tip on how to hit that little-know muscle group or to share a new delicious recipe.

The reason we gave The Mecca gym only 4 of 5 stars is that it also offers tanning and childcare-neither of which are note-worthy or worth it.  The child care room is always unmanned and you have to ask a staff member to hang out with your kids.  This would be fine for older children, but if you have a little one, training over an hour gets you feeling guilty as there are RARELY any kids to play with here.  They do have a tv and the kids can watch movies or play with the plethora of trucks, baby toys or a toy kitchen.  Also, there is really no set limit on the childcare hours like at other facilities so you could come with the kids at 3 am and train until noon if you so chose.  Also, you could let your kids hang out with you on the floor as long as they are well-behaved.  This is something you really don't see.  The tanning bed was used by us twice in a row and not a drop of color after 15 minutes which tells us that the bulbs must need changing.

All-in-all, this is decidedly FABULOUS gym and we could train here for hours!
12 flavors of frozen yogurt along with varying toppings. Price was decent, we had coupons that we used and shared 2 between our family of 4. Nice atmosphere and friendly staff.

To anyone who reads this I want you to know this review is solely based on my opinion and does not reflect the overall character and quality of the business, products, services, food and employees.  Please base your own opinion by visiting the establishment.

Thank God for Yelp or I would have never heard about this treasure tucked away in an industrial park off Eagle Rd and Goldstone Dr.  At that intersection, go East and your first driveway to the north you will find this fabulous deli.

I love finding places like this.  My first impression was that it was very clean and well organized.  I was instantly greeted with a friendly employee who helped navigate me through the menu.  I asked her for some recommendations and I was not misled.  I had the turkey and pastrami sandwich with coleslaw instead of lettuce and a cup of mushroom brie soup.

The sandwich was terrific.  It was full of flavor and from the picture, you can see they didn't skimp on the items.  I ordered the full sandwich with a cup of soup and I was full after eating just half.  Yay for leftovers.  I thoroughly enjoyed the sandwich and I am looking forward to coming back and trying other things.  I am always at Pioneer Title which is a stone's throw away and I have never been here.

The soup had a great flavor but was a little watered down as it needed a thickener and maybe a little salt but the flavor of the mushrooms were terrific.  It came with a couple pieces of bread and would have loved to have some butter packets but they told me they didn't carry any butter.

Overall, really cool place, very nice employees and good food.  Looking forward to coming back soon.
This is probably the best place for breakfast in the Valley.  The serous good but the food is great. Prices are fair. I would call ahead to get on the list.

Went to Joe Momma's on a Sunday, early afternoon. The food wasn't too shabby but the wait at the table from sitting and waiting to place the order all the way until we got up was ridiculously long. We probably sat for an hour and a half, if not two hours. The place was incredibly busy. The food comes in GIGANTIC portions so you get what you pay for. The restaurant is clean and has overall friendly staff.

Thank you for responding to my review, Kathleen. To clarify, when I say we sat for an hour and a half that is total sitting time from the moment we sat down to the moment we left. We sat for around 30 minutes while waiting for drinks/waters, 30/45 minutes to get our food once the order was placed, ate for about 15 mins and waited for our check for another 15 mins. The wait times were abnormally long.
The tri-tip noodle soup was 10/10. Would definitely recommend on a cold day. Staff is friendly and chill.
Got straight up hooked me up...asked for a rootbeer float, they technically can't do it but they did it for me. Love me some macdonalds! Haha

Kona grill menu and variety was great! The variety of choice the group of us made were all above average and all enjoyed very much. Service was a little slow but it was first night jitters. Only thing didn't care for it was really noisy.
Wonderful Smoothologist, Brittney perked us up with Oatmeal Raisin and pumpkin spice latte smoothies! We will be back!

Be aware! We entered into contract with CBH for a new home in Boise Idaho. This was going to be an 8 month process, we of course had a loan approval when we started the transaction. 2-3 months into the process (home had not began building yet) I had an employment change (not by choice) and could no longer qualify to purchase the home. I contacted their offices to let them know and they very abruptly told me that I would not get my deposit back ($3500) and that it was my fault for changing jobs. When I explained to them that this was not by choice and that my contract clearly states that the deposit is still refundable "subject to underwriting approval and appraisal" they did not respond. It was a very disappointing experience and we are now to the point of hiring an Attorney to fight for our money that we as a family need very much.

Went here a few days ago. Was very disappointed. We ordered a mixture of things to try out. The ribs were very dry as if over cooked and not much meat on them. The pulled pork was good. Brisket was mostly fat. My daughter has a cheeseburger but they said they didn't have any kid burgers at the time so they gave her a regular sized one instead. It was so dry she took one bite and left the rest. Ordered a few different sides. Macaroni and cheese was dry and was supposed to have bacon in it but if it did we didn't see any. The fries were good as well as the beans. To make matters worse our waitress never came back to check on us and there were quite a few flies. I doubt we go back.
The wait time at this place is horrendous.  The food was not up to par compared to their prior location in Eagle.  Disappointed but will probably try them again.

By far the best emergency veterinary hospital in the Boise area!
If you're seeking a professional staff who's highly educated, thorough, honest, and compassionate in a state of the art facility, this is your place! Even in the most urgent and saddest of times, they are a comforting light.
We first came to them seeking a second opinion after spending months following the advice of a veterinarian we've gone to for over 30 years. All Valley saved us time, money, heartache, and what would have been an excruciating death for our family dog. Less than a month after switching to them, they saved our cat's life too.
So far I've been blessed to meet Dr. Loweth, Dr. Veal, Kayla, Ashley, Abigail, and Britney and they're nothing less than phenomenal. I'm confident the entire staff is amazing and whole heartedly recommend All Valley Animal Care to everyone in the Treasure Valley!

This is an update to my last review. About two months ago, I gave this place another try with my mom and a friend. I showed the reply to my last review from the old general manager about making our experience right, and the new GM honored it. I have to say, the food and service was great. I am glad we gave it another try. We will be back.
Try the Spicy Bacon Avocado with Green Spicy. You won't find a similar flavor profile anywhere else!

They have some of the best chicken fried steak around. The jam they use is amazing, reminds me of moms.  Love their coffee as well.  They need to up their hot chocolate game.  Also work on poaching eggs as they tend to be undercooked.  Overall great place.

Very disappointed visit today. Got there right after noon and there was hardly anyone in the restaurant so I figured service would be fairly quick. The food took over 30 minutes to arrive with no explanation or apologies and it was served by another server as ours seemed to disappeared for quite some time. I also have a little beef with the updated hummus plate-- being charged the same amount as before when it included olive tapenade and tomato and hummus but now all you get is hummus with a little sprinkle of feta and a bunch of veggie sticks. Totally cutting corners in my opinion. Not up to par with what I'm used to coming here...
Wait time was very inaccurate I signed up and had a 5 minute wait left supposedly and I still had another 30 minutes when I got there. Why do you even have an app to check in if you don't honor it.
Waitress was nice food was cold coffee was cold!!! Management wasn't very nice!! Food used to be good will not come back
The food was okay. Service was okay. Atmosphere was okay. Just nothing that stood out to me.

The food was excellent along with the service.  It's the closest to being actually down south as you can get. Willing to tell everyone that this is the place to go for great awesome barbeque and desserts

Incompetent! Was there 1 hr and 15 min. and my dog never got examined. Horrible experience! Quoted one thing on the phone & wanted to charge 3x's that at the office. Should have done some research before wasting my time.

We had such a good time at Smoky Mountain Pizza last night! The food was really good. We especially loved the MYO pizza for my 4 year old. What made our visit exceptional was our server, Molly!  She was so timely and efficient and went out of her way to make us all happy, especially my kiddos!  She really was on top of her game!

I am actually really sad to be writing this review. I have been to Joe Momma's 2 times before where the food and service was great, but this last Sunday, I was so disappointed that I probably will never go back. We walked in on Sunday to a very very crowded restaurant, we gave our name and sat down. Prepared to wait, we sat patiently, and sat, and sat. The entire time, the waitstaff had scowls on their faces, complaining how busy it was, and that they are running out of food. they all looked like they were going to have mental breakdowns. So we decided not to wait any longer, I got up to leave and one of the staff actually yelled out the door "Thanks for letting us know". Now normally I would have cancelled my wait reservation, but they were all running around like chickens with no heads, and I had been waiting 20 minutes without any of the 5 other groups in front of us being sat or even acknowledged. I thought that comment, as we walked out the door was so very rude, and uncalled for. I know they were having a tough day, but you do not yell at customers, no matter what. Im sorry Joe Momma's, but you lost my business.

We drove a 2004 Chevy Malibu in we new there was a problem with the fuel filter. We were c as lled told how much it would be to fix. We to lo d them no they were way to ex po endive. We were told to come pick up car. We got there the car no longer worked they broke a part and refused to fix. But still insist on making us pay 300.00 for diagnostic work. There rude and nasty and there mechanics are incompatent. After a long of arguing they towed the car to our house, but the point is they broke they should have fixed what they broke
Not super great. Waiter was rushing us to order even though lots of tables were open. Food was extremely greasy, fries were soggy. Friggin 2 outta 5, hard meh.

Really good food.  Nice diverse menu and plenty of flavor and spice when called for. Only complaint is the wait time because everyone wants to eat there. How can that be bad.  Will try the website before going next time. schedule ahead. But highly recommend this daily run place for breakfast.
Outstanding. Probably the best sandwich I've had in the Treasure Valley. Reasonable prices and extremely nice staff.
The food sizes are filling and it was a wonderful eatery!! Pricing was just right! Wait times were short for a Sunday Brunch  loved browsing the little shops as we passed time

We ordered six sandwiches during our visit. We were happy to have many options to customize our take-out dinner. The service was friendly, the food was quality, and our order was completed quickly. This will be on our list of quick takeout places going forward. A perk to those with young children, on certain days kids' meals are only $1, at this location the kids deal is on weekends :)

My (first) experience today at Christian Bros. Automotive was a definite "10" out of "10".  As a single female "senior citizen" I am always wary of being taken advantage of by auto service businesses.  Being new to the Boise/Meridian area I had no idea where to turn so I got on Yelp & looked at reviews and headed to Christian Brothers on McMillan Rd. Every employee I encountered was wonderful - polite, informative, respectful.  They changed my oil & replaced my brake light quickly and their prices were very reasonable.  I sat in their very comfortable customer lounge on my computer & they brought me coffee.  Will I return? Absolutely.  Would I recommend them?  Without hesitation. It is a relief to know I have found a place that will take great care of my car. Thanks guys!

Great place! Super friendly employees and a very clean porta potty if you're like me and drink too much coffee on the way :) some highlights for me visiting in July was bread from zeppole, marionberry jam, corn on the cob, local honey, blackberries and eggs. I got all that for $26 so quite reasonable prices as well. 

It is small so don't expect it to be an "event" or a way to spend an afternoon but it's perfect for getting those farmers market type essentials!
Pretty good. I was a little underwhelmed by the lack-luster greeting and the server's personality was blah. The food was tasty and I'd go back.

Beef pho was amazing as well
as the crispy spring rolls!  Real tea with leaves and a great atmosphere. Only complaint is that the booths and chairs are not padded and therefore not comfortable if you plan to stay for long dinner visit with friends. Friendly service.

Gross. Do not come here!! Everything on our table was inedible. We paid and got the hell out of there and went to mi casa down the street. Honestly, we never should have even paid for our food but what were we supposed to say to management "hey, literally everything you served us was disgusting!" ??? Haha 

Even the chips and salsa is nasty. DO NOT ORDER THE QUESO! Yuck. Disgusting. Just don't go here. Ever. 

Our server was really sweet and obviously the bad food isn't her problem.

Stopped by Big Daddys again yesterday and it was even better than last time! (Is that possible?) 

I just love this place, it's exactly what *I* feel like a bbq place should be like. The lovely smoke smell just inside the door, country music in the background and a casual & comfortable atmosphere in which to roll up your sleeves in!

My husband had the same burger again and it was JUST as good as the last time. I tried a plate this time, got the turkey, green beans and mac & cheese - absolutely perfect. Doused my turkey in their NC bbq sauce and just loved it. Daughters grilled cheese also excellent.

Service is so friendly and sweet here, very welcoming folks.

Can't wait to return!
Best place I've found in meridian to eat!!!! Everything is fresh and customer service is on point!!! My family and I will be returning a lot!!!!!

Terrible turn over. Absentee owner for the last 2 years. Constantly rescheduling my appts because someone quit.  New owner now text me to say because I missed 3appts I can't come anymore. I tried to call to explain I had only missed one appt in 2 years because the changed my appt with out telling me and they had texted my land line in error so I never knew I even had an appt. they said too bad and hung up on me. Wow what a terrible way to run a business and reward loyalty for years (4 times a month )
Surprise, surprise, waffle sandwiches are delicious and big. Great fries and crazy tea drinks.we all liked it and would suggest this place for casual, filling lunches!

Have to agree with most of the other reviews.  Very slow...waited almost an hour for our food, service is far from stellar, no napkins on the tables...they treat it like self serve but hit you up for a tip.  My sons burger didnt come with anything...no fries...nothing, and it wasnt cheap.  This was my second time visiting...wont go back.
Great place, staff, food and drink- Blt with fries, coconut mojito. Nice place to sit outside. Granddaughter was walking around the Village - her first time here

Great Hospital on all accounts. Clean, friendly yet knowledgeable staff, and qualified doctors that all treat you like a human and actually try to help you (whether or not you have insurance)! What a concept!

Pretty good spot. I have mostly had great service though it can be spotty.  The food is quite good and it is fun to people watch if you can get a seat in the patio area. Sort of a franchise/chain feel to it but of the good type.

We have the greatest wait staff everytime we eat at Kona. I can't think of a time when the manager doesn't come by to check on us too, so perfect. The food is served hot, fresh, and delicious. Prices are kinda high but quality is great.  Good job Kona :)
Address is now on Fairview. Nice atmosphere. Very good pizza good service. Reasonable pricing.

When I walked up to the counter, I saw some good looking steak and chicken dishes.  I tried a few and made a choice.  I had the dish with steamed rice and a veggie roll.  The price was a bit high considering the all-you-can eat Chinese Buffet just down the road is less expensive.

Why the 2 stars?  The food wasn't very exciting.  It wasn't very hot.  It was rather expensive.

You simply cannot go wrong here.

For Gyros alone, they are the best in the Valley. The gyro meat, the pita, their,sauces. So incredibly good and fresh. This is a very consistent place!

You can get your items to go or sit outside at this location. 

The staff is always super friendly and quick about getting your order. They always give you napkins, silver, etc never forgetting anything.

So glad there is one in our neighborhood now!

PS. They did have a really sharp turn in the drive thru lane, several cars scraped their tires or went up on it pulling in but they have a pole there now to keep you from coming in to close. There is ample parking surrounding this location. I find it much easier to walk up still

Jordyn is amazing! Hands down best of the best. She is an expert in blonde coloring, I loved that she took extra steps to ensure she kept my length and did not damage my locks - I spent 2 years growing it out before I made the transition to blonde to ensure the health of my hair. Jordyn is worth every penny - I love that I finally found a stylist I can trust to do an amazing job, keep the integrity of my hair & help me achieve my beauty goals with minimal damage! Highly recommend!

Another day, another Treasure Valley Breakfast eatery. The highlights of this place are giant pancakes, huge seating area to accommodate groups of all sizes, and top notch country gravy. 

I like Joe Momma's, I really do, but this is yet another family tradition that isn't necessarily the best breakfast in the area. This is a place my family likes to visit when we're in town. Since last summer they moved locations and now have ample seating. At their old location we would get there when they opened and there would already be a line. That does say something about the following of this place- very popular and always busy.

We went on a weekday morning with a group of eight and service was a little slow. We had to wait for coffee refills several times which is part of the reason I bumped off one star. We tried the trash taters, steak and eggs breakfast, biscuits and gravy, and a few other things. Everyone was happy with their meal - especially my uncle who finished a large majority of his steak, eggs, and giant pancake. We were all just a little bitter he didn't share his pancake with us.

The food was ok downside hash browns were cold. Grill must have been way to hot as the hashbrowns had a nice crisp texture yet middle was cold. The bottom of the scramble was over done as eggs were brown before burnt. 
Wait staff need to be better organized as we had to wait for drinks because she forgot. Then we had to ask another waiter for refills. More empty tables than filled so there was no reason to have that kinda lag. Almost 1 wait staff to customer. Appears that the general manager needs to work on a few things here at this location! The other location is 200% better over all in Merdian.

This place is by far the best place to get a gyro. I love the gyro here. The meat has amazing flavor. And for such a little location (which just opened up around the corner from my house), they pack in a ton of options.

Great service tonight we loved our server Christine. Food is always fresh and always comes out right away
Highly recommend this place family kid friendly and adult friendly
This salon is top notch with wonderful service! Highly recommended! :)

Went there few nights ago for dinner, after all the reviews/pics I saw on FB I decided to check it out myself. This was my first visit and probably my last. It took over an hour for the food to come out, the drinks where never refilled, nobody ever asked us if we needed anything or if everything was OK ... I had to walk up to the front every time I needed anything .... I had extra people joining in as the evening progressed and it took forever ... we all ended up eating at different times because each time we added more food it took ages and nothing arrived at the same time. Even when we ordered things together. Fries where basically crispy over cooked potato chips .... did not taste fresh....they never offered ketchup or anything with them. As you can see on pic we never got any ajvar with our cevapi. The food was inconsistent in seasoning/taste ... we ordered 3 orders of large Cevapi to begin with and they all tasted different...either over seasoned/over salted or completely bland! People that arrived later where served before us. They where a larger group/bigger table! While we watched it go on... few people at my table wanted to just walk out after sitting there forever ...They where out of stuff we wanted to eat. On top of that we had to ask for silverware and the bill after sitting there waiting for a while! I'm a frequent restaurant goer and out of town .... I like to try different international foods frequently! I have not had this bad of an experience in quite a while and being that it was a Bosnian place considering the huge Bosnian population in Boise makes it that much more disappointing which is a shame! Frankly had much higher expectations .... or at least acceptable service! The whole experience was underwhelming and awkward at times. Highly disappointed! I'm Bosnian myself but I wouldn't proudly recommend it to anyone who was curious about our food! For me it didn't represent Bosnian hospitality! For the amount of money I spent here I would have easily went somewhere where I actually enjoyed my experience, where they cared about their customer!

Poor service. Especially from the hostess who refused to sit us in the main dining room even after we asked. Seems like they try to pack people over by the bar during happy hour. Food took forever and the sushi had obviously been sitting out for awhile. Overall a disappointing experience.

This was our last visit to Kona grill. Unfortunate, because this place was on our favorite list. After waiting almost an hour for a table for our group of 7, they sat us at a small table that would normally seat 4-6 ( second time this happened to us). We ordered and it took about 30 minutes for them to bring us our sushi rolls. It took another 30 minutes to bring our dinner. I always get the same thing, Kona chopped salad. This time it was visibly different. Usually the chicken was on top of the salad. This time it was mixed in. Hmmm... it was mixed in for 2 obvious reasons. The chicken was dried out and cold. I should have spoken with a manager but after waiting an hour for it, I wasn't going to wait another hour for them to remake it. Also ordered chicken satays and they were over grilled, charred, hard and cold.
Got the peeper steak sandwich. Food was pretty good but the wait time was awful. Severely understaffed and don't have their act together yet.

We discovered this little restaurant on one of our culinary explorations and are very pleased we found it.  Having had Bosnian cuisine in the past, we knew we liked it.  Sofra provides an excellent representation of the lovely savory components that are so typical of food native to this part of the world.  The owner, Edina, is so friendly and welcoming that it's like dining with friends.  If you've never tried this type of cuisine, give it a shot.  You'll be happy you did. Oh, by the way , try the rice.  DELISH!

The food is really pretty good. The service SUCKS!! We asked for a few extra minutes to look over the menu. 15 minutes later Jamie came back and took our order. We ordered an appetizer. Came out with our food. Jamie checked in 1 time while we ate like 3 minutes after we got our food never again. So my husbands soda never refilled. Then brought a ticket NEVER offered a box and we had TONS of food left. We flagged her down got a box she brought a small box. We waited and waited and waited some more for her to grab ticket to ask for another box. She never came back. We walked up and the hostess got as another box.  We waited and waited and waited some more for our check to be grabbed. Finally the hostess came and got our ticket. The place had so many flies it was INSANE!

I was excited to try this BBQ place. I placed an order online. When I arrived no one greeted me and I waited for 3-4 minutes and finally one of the people standing behind the bar helped me get my order of ribs, brisket and wings.
She asked me if I wanted sauce. I said yes and tried a little of the sweet and also the spicy. Both were boring. The girl said they bought "industrial" sauce. When home, I unwrapped the order. The ribs were dry and unflavorful. The brisket was fine. The wings were good. The side orders were small considering the meat combo meal I bought was $30. The coleslaw was horrible. Basically cabbage and too much mayo. No flavor. The Mac n cheese was good, but a small serving. Basically it was all blah.
I will go to Bodacious Pig in Eagle next time. Excellent ribs, sides and sauce.
If you are a legit BBQ spot, you need to figure out a way to make your own good sauce.

My 4 star is on primarily the food.  We've had the deep dish (awesome), regular pizza (good) and the Italian beef sandwiches (awesome) on multiple occasions.  My only knock on Bono's is that the service can be very very slow at times but the food is always outstanding.
Let me just say the customer service is over the top! Friendly staff.. great beer.. better people. Slanted Rock is a must stop in Meridian.

Saturday for a late lunch, took them 40 minutes to seat us and there Wes a ton of open tables.  They turned away a handicapped couple.  Food was horrible and the service lacked.  We'd eaten at the old location and it was awesome!  They ruined it.

We have eaten here before and had mixed experiences. Today we were unfortunate to have the owner as our waitress. The eggs on my sons plate were wrong and were sent back. As an afterthought she brought jalapenos to the table and said the cook might not have put them in my wrap. When I tried to do it myself the whole thing fell apart. When she brought the eggs back I expressed my displeasure. Instead of being apologetic she snapped that I should be nice and proceeded to argue with me. Taking my plate she stood in the kitchen and complained about me. The wrap was brought back to the table again with no jalapenos, when I pointed this out she argued with me again saying she watched him put it in. Even with me showing her there were no jalapenos there was still her hostile attitude and no offer to fix it. I ended up just stuffing them in the top as I ate. The pasta salad my other son had as a side was not tasty and we had asked that he just get fries when my wrap was taken to the kitchen, these showed up as we were finished with the meal. Drink refills of coffee and soda was not given after my complaint. Dirty dishes were not cleared when she dropped the slip of paper on the table and to go boxes had to be requested from another waiter. On the drive home I realized the wrap had not come with the cheese I had requested which leads me to believe that she put my order in without the additional items and then blamed the cook later for her mistake. With behavior like this coming from the owner it gives a really bad impression of the restaurant. Normally my fiancé does all our social media praises and complaints but I was so disturbed by this eating experience I set up a yelp account just to do this review. horrible experience. We will not be back for further mistreatment.

I've been a member at crunch for a few months and i have loved it. There is a good number of machines and a ton of dumbells, which means im never waiting around to do my workout. The new squat rack with deadlifting platform and bumper plates has been my favorite new addition. I like to get my HIIT on here and will continue to do so for a long time. Bring back the basketball court and I'll up to 5 stars!

Probably the best breakfast in Meridian! You may have to wait a bit for a table but it is totally worth it. If you get a side, get the pancake. They are the size of a beach ball and delicious! I also highly recommend any omelet and house potatoes. Friendly staff and fast service considering how busy they always are.

Got stuck in the worst storm travelling through Idaho. After stopping at several hotels, La Quinta gave us relief when they told us we could park our Uhaul without a problem. The staff was professional, nice and very welcoming to us and our dog. Last night we had a very disappointing experience at the Fairfield Inn in Burley, ID. La Quinta has always been a great chain of hotels. Grateful for this relief from a long trip. The room is tastefully decorated, warm and the double nozzle shower head was heaven. Thanks for a great stay!!
