What an awful experience. I bought my dog to get spayed today and it appears that they changed the price I was quoted over the phone. I found out that they just changed ownership. The staff seemed clueless and unorganized. After agreeing to the new price, I left her there. After 5 hours, I received a call saying that they couldn't get the surgery today and I need to bring her back tomorrow.  No thank you. Now I need to find a new vet. New ownership sucks!

Awesome breakfast.  Large portions, reasonable prices.  Great service. Chicken fried steak is very good as are the cinnamon rolls.  Clean, comfortable dining with a down home feel.  Definitely our breakfast spot when in the Boise area
Great service. Super on the foods. Love the new location lots of seating and parking. Will definitely recommend to my out of town family.

New favorite place.  Have been twice in the lay 8 days.  Great bone broth noodle soup.  I had the smoke brisket and the wife had the tri-tip. The smoked brisket was amazing.  The wife loved her tri-tip but the brisket was the way to go I think.  Huge portions,  I left the place uncomfortably full.  That is a good thing.  The rice bowls with kimchi and pickled veg and bulgogi (marinade closer to Kalbi than bulgogi with it sweetness, nonetheless tasty) are really good.  
The service is great.  The owner is super friendly and remembered us and made conversation.  He also heard us talking about trying the sandwiches and gave a sample.  Place has moved into my top five places bumping Tangos in Boise to number 6.  
Wife and I are planning to go see a bad movie at the majestic next door as an excuse to go back and try the waffle sandwiches.

Split a sandwich with Dad today.  It was over $11 for one sandwich (must have been the medium size) and a drink.  We ordered the shrimp po-boy with classic toppings (instead of Cajun, which would be too spicy for me).   Here's what we found:

- There are no napkins anywhere in the restaurant... not even in the bag with the sandwich.  Be sure to grab a couple of paper towels before sitting down.
- Took quite a while for our sandwich to be made.
- The "house chips" are not typical chips.  They have lemon and pepper!

Our sandwich tasted good, but there were two things that disappointed us about it.   The bread practically disintegrated as we were eating the sandwich.  We needed forks to finish up.  And our sandwich had fried shrimp on it, but we sure didn't see or hear any frying going on.  They must have been fried elsewhere, frozen, and then reheated.  (This lack of frying means the house chips weren't fried here either.)

One more annoyance:  The straws barely peek over the top of the large soda cup.

For the money, there are MUCH better sandwiches that are made fresher and faster in town.  We don't see ourselves trying this again.
Out of the way for me, but well worth the drive. I had the CFS and best in valley so far. Busy for a week day. Looking forward to a return for breakfast. Service was good as well.
Food good but poor service. Wait for order.Asked for jam. Didn't get. Had Togo to counter and ask again. Waited for check.

My family and I just tried this BBQ joint and wow.we had the fried pickles to start and they were excellent. I had the 3 meat plate, brisket spice sausage and pulled pork. All 3 were great. Sauce on the side , as it should be. The mac and cheese and fries were great as well. My wife had the smoked meatloaf which was equally awesome. My daughter had the brisket sliders and she love it. Our waitress was very friendly and attentive. And we had a great convo with the front of the house manager who was a sweetheart. Will be returning often!
All I can say is...absolutely the best breakfast I have ever eaten. Our party of 6, ordered all sorts of delicious meals, and they all came out at the same time. And Hot.

This was my first time eating here! I loved the interior style & being seated in a booth where you could view the cooks. It was really cool to watch them work. Def. make a reservation for a Saturday night! I heard them telling most parties it would be about 45 minutes. 

Our group of 5 was quickly seated & Will was our server. He was full of enthusiasm, smiles & quick service. (considering it was packed!) I ordered a mango-vodka tonic & it was great. Little chunks of frozen peaches? mangos? were a nice surprise! The menu is extensive! Lots of things to try. I ordered the Philadelphia roll for dinner. They were great. 

I would def. love to pop back in here for lunch or dinner again, soon! Thanks for the fun FriendsWeekend dinner!

All Valley has been very helpful during emergency situations. We have a sick kitten that appeared to have lost his eye and they got me in immediately knowing he was feral and would be in a kitten rehab program. Every cane in and accessed him and they took a video of his eye. Got us meds,directions, and guided us to next step. Billing folks are great to work with!

Also someone hit a cat and we stopped to pick it up. He was in bad shape but All Valley was at the door waiting to take him from me. They have a wonderful rescue/rehab for animals without owners!

These guys are a kick. Their noodle soup was excellent. They don't try to say that it's a pho so much. It was good for what they have. I had the bulgogi bowl and it was great. People working there were very very very good. We will come back

Absolutely horrible experience. I came along with my fiancé today for lunch on Labor Day to try and check out a new place. That was a mistake. Took well over 15 minutes to get a drink refill. After an hour without receiving our appetizer, we attempted to leave by closing out our tab at the bar and the "manager" suddenly appeared to tell us she would see what was going on with our food. We received our lukewarm appetizer shortly after this along with our sushi entrees that had been sitting on the counter behind us for nearly 20 minutes. Right as the food arrived, the manager came up to our table and asked us passive aggressively if we still wanted our check or another round of drinks. My fiancé then told her she was still waiting on a previous drink order which she acknowledged by walking off and ignoring us. At this point, our server didn't even want to look at us due to the horrendous service we had received although she never once apologized or acknowledged the awful experience. Of course we did not hear from the manager the rest of the time we were there even though she passed by our table several times as I tried to get her attention while she blatantly ignored our table. For their credit, once I asked for the check I received the most prompt service of the night as it was brought immediately to our table. Of course we were charged for all items at full price as this establishment clearly has no concern for customer service. I have never put in a review before I just needed an outlet to express the absolutely horrendous experience I had at this shithole without making a scene in public. I would give zero stars if it were possible but even Yelp apparently couldn't anticipate how awful this place is.

Stopped in last minute just as they were closing for the evening. I was trying to find something close to chicken noodle soup for my wife who wasn't feeling well. The eatery owner made me feel very welcome even though they were just about to close... not something you experience from many places these days. The chicken noodle bowl he suggested was AMAZING and exactly what my wife was looking for. I am totally impressed with the quality of the food and level of friendly service from the Hungry Horse Eatery... can't wait to go back. Thanks!

Dined here when I was in town visiting Meridian for the first time with a friend. The restaurant is in middle of The Village at Meridian, and the setting is just amazing, well done for families and friends to hang out and make a great day of shopping, eating and just hanging out. Very impressive.

We decided on an early dinner outdoors so that we can watch the fountain show that happens on the hour. We both had the steak salad dinner. The meat was a bit on the tougher side, but the salad was in generous portion with fresh veggies. 

The restaurant is very tastefully decorated indoors and an amazing array of glasswork as well as lighting. The setting was definitely more memorable than the meal.

This is a very consistent jimmy John's store. Either you like the sandwiches or you don't, service is very good, very fast, and very friendly weather inside or drive-through. The drive-through is a little tricky to get in, I drive a regular F1 50 and have to reverse once or twice to get in due to location. But I am grateful they have a drive-through. I get the Frenchy sandwich a large Coke and a jalapeño chips it cost me 7.71 I go a few times a week and they never disappoint me.

I also just noticed they are offering a value smaller sub option called the little John. Any of the original subs in a smaller version for three dollars. May try that on a smaller appetite day
If I could give them a negative rating I would. They will tell you anything to sign a contract, but in the end your bill will be way more than what is promised. PLEASE stay away from T-mobile!

Stopped here for the first time today after a horrible experience at the berry ranch and we were blown away by the level of customer service we were provided!!! We were greeted as if we were friends by the lady working the register and she asked if we had been there before. When we said no, she showed us around and told us about the produce and other merchandise. It's apparent that she loves her job and who she works for and she convinced us to buy a few items. We will definitely be back soon and often! Thank you and kudos!!!

If I could get this place zero stars I would. For starters I came in with my sister to treat her to a Mother's Day gift. When we got there they didn't bother telling us how long it would take to get seated so after waiting for about 15 to 20 minutes we got seated right next to each other. About 10 minuets later (neither of us have gotten started at this point)  A lady walks in and says that she only had time to get her nails done for an hour so they move my sister out of her chair into a random Chair next to me and just start doing my nails so fine She'll wait. He doesn't bother asking me how long I want them to start cutting them and of course he cut them too short so he starts going new nails on top of the old nails so now I have two sets of plastic nails on my hand.. Then halfway through doing my nails they move me to a different station to put my sister in the station I was at and start on her nails. The customer service experience here was absolutely horrible they didn't bother saying sorry or explaining why they were doing what they're doing. The shape and length and quality of my nails are absolutely atrocious.... I will never recommend this place....

I am giving 4 stars. Food was amazing. There were lots of mistakes but they were also very busy. My son ordered a Cobb salad and it came out with just chicken, eggs, and tomatoes. I had asked if we could get  some bacon and avocado because the menu said it came with that on it. Once it was brought to me I was informed it would cost extra. I just said that was fine. The waiter then came and told me it was no charge. The hostess that sat us was standing at the checkin desk eating biscuits and gravy  and could barely talk while seating us because her mouth was full.

The finger steaks were amazing!! My burrito was amazing! I was disappointed I got the wrong burrito but after waiting an hour for it I was not going to complain. My mother ordered crab cakes and loved them! We may go back if it is very early in the
Morning.

I've been to Kona a handful of times for happy hour, and you can't beat $5 apps and cocktails (just make sure you get a seat in the area "designated" for happy hour..).

I can't say the same about their regular menu. I've been here with probably three different groups of people that have had the same consensus about the food -"it's alright". As far as I can tell, there are only a selected few items that are worth getting (based on quality and the above average price), 
 their flatbreads are pretty mediocre and their sandwiches are hit or miss. The most recent time I visited I ordered the new "misu" salmon sandwich and was extremely underwhelmed...it was a BLT with a small portion of salmon on it for $16.50. 
Two of our guests enjoyed the steak and the avocado chicken club, but everything else seems to keep falling short. I think we'll just stick to happy hour here and save dinner for somewhere else I can leave 100% satisfied from.

This place is delicious! Kids said the fries were the best. We had the tri tip waffle sandwich and chicken teriyaki bowl both were amazing ! They got a bit busy while we were there so we had to wait but patience paid off with great food and free icecream! We will be back to try other items on the menu.

When it's good, it's pretty good, but they suffer from major consistency issues. One time the Kalua pork is dry and the coconut shrimp is one of the best I've had, the next visit the pig is good but the shrimp is overcooked. One visit the loco moco is absolutely disgusting because they leave it sitting in the steam table and the gravy turns into a black salt varnish, the next time it's just fine. I've had better luck with their food truck, but anymore the only reason I go to the restaurant is for a quick Spam fix because they keep grab-and-go musubi by the register. More info at my website if you want it.

Epic breakfast this morning with the fam. Loved the feel of this place  the food was fantastic.  I ordered the lemon poppy seed pancakes and I can't wait to head back and have it again.  My kids loved the French toast  and hubby enjoyed the tri-tip scramble

I found this on good ole YELP.  I actually drove 10 minutes out of my way to try this eatery just because the name is sooooooooooooo funny to me.

Well I am glad I did.  When I drove up there was a waiting line with at least 15 people waiting outside.  This was a Thursday at 9:30am, don't people work?  I walked up and asked if I could sit at the bar.  Boom! in 2 minutes I was ordering coffee and getting my menu.  The ambiance is loud and festive.  It has a family vibe with a ton of staff.  I ordered the eggs benedict and they were very standard and delicious.  I have tasted the same hollandaise sauce a 100 times.  English muffins and hash browns.  All of it solid but not special.  I looked around and this looks like a solid place for a breakfast bonanza but I could not tell you what they are known for.  The service was excellent and the pricing was middle of the road.  Coffee, Eggs Bene and tip were $15.  Not cheap but not expensive.  I recommend trying this establishment if you are in the area.

I love Jimmy John's it's my favorite sandwich shop in town!if they would do anything different it would be to add pickles to the sandwiches but for the taste that they have I can live without them because they're that good! I always get a number 16 cut in half and it's never been wrong!

Great pancakes, great vegetables, and great service! We came here for the Mother's Day brunch with a party of 18. Even with our huge table, the servers kept our waters and coffee cups continually filled. 

I ordered the "Veggie Hash" and was so happy that I did. If you like tons of vegetables, you'll love this dish. Side note- it is a little spicy with the green chilies.

Usually pancakes cost extra as a side, but not at Joe Momma's! I got a pancake as a "side" but could have definitely had it by itself s a meal- the pancakes were HUGE  but super fluffy and scrumptious. The Blueberry pancake I had was filled with blueberries! Typically I've had blueberry pancakes at other restaurants with a small amount blueberries, but at Joe Momma's they don't skimp you at all on the blueberries!

The food was very good. The manager on duty went above and beyond and even brought my husband a bowl of soup since he wasn't feeling good. Very friendly people are nice place to be for an out-of-town lunch.

We've eaten at Kona Grill several times since it opened.  It has always been hit or miss with this restaurant.  We like the location but we just can't accept another bad meal here.  Our most recent visit was truly terrible.  My wife and I ordered the Sea Bass and Pork Tenderloin.  We waited over 45 minutes for the food to arrive.  The first thing I noticed was the portion size of the Sea Bass, it was about 2 oz., the rest of the plate was full of rice and ratatouille.  The biggest issue was the Tenderloin, it was served raw.  We had the Manager look at it and she ordered a new dish.  We waited another 10+ minutes.  When she brought it out she said it was raw again and had them cook it some more.  Also, when we tasted the onion crisps they were loaded with salt, we had to spit them out.  We let our waitress know and she said "okay, I'll let them know".  We never saw the Manager again.  Before leaving we ordered the Key Lime Pie to go.  When it arrived it was missing the whipped cream.  Later that night we tried the Key Lime Pie.  This was the last straw.  The pie had a side and bottom crust that was over an inch thick, to make matters worse it was burnt.  We paid over $66 for two entrees, one beer and one desert.  No compensation or apology was given for this terrible meal. This is the last time we will go to Kona Grill.

The service was amazing! Our waitress and bar back had an eye for detail in serving as well the right amount of conversation. Sushi was above average enjoyed the yellow tail sashimi. Would have given 5 star however beer list was weak without any local brews and cost was on higher side.

Serious restaurant workflow and food quality issues.   Was invited to go to breakfast with some friends.  Poppyseed pancakes had no poppyseeds.  Online wait app is confusing.  Lots of empty tables but wait time was still an hour.    Once seated, food took another 40 minutes.        Experience, service and food Not worth the wait.

I am not from Boise but I get up here a few times a year and always make a point to visit Time Zone!   The mix of new and vintage toys is incredible.   They always have something different and I get great deals on things I never knew I needed.  Lol.  The selection of Funko Pops is great but for me the selection of Hot Wheels and Die Cast cars is the most exciting thing. The selection of everything from current models to cars from the 70's, 80's, 90's and even the occasional Red Line! Is really fantastic.  The best part is they get so many they keep the prices low to keep inventory rotating.  I have gotten over the last several years to talk with Dave and Geno at the shop.  Very friendly and knowledgeable.   Great experience at a fun store.

Thoroughly enjoyed our breakfast today. Great crispy hash browns, tasty pancakes, a scrumptious Chile omelet.  Due to allergies, I had a special request; they willingly fulfilled my order. The only thing better was the friendly service. 
Definitely will return.

Pretty Good food and very generous portion sizes. However when I went I had to wait some time before being served even though there was only one other person there. And the the lady who did finally serve me seemed grouchy and it kinda was uncomfortable feeling. Annnd as someone who rides a bike I would appreciate bike parking and a bag for my food because that ain't fun carrying home. Lol But that's besides the point. Just a little personal side comment from me. This restaurant is good so I would recommend going.

Updated review- I have spoken with the management and much is being done to improve the cleanliness of the gym. You actually can see a difference from two weeks ago. They also have scheduled and ordered what is needed to refinish the old sauna cedar. As long as it continues to improve I'll stay, as this gym is convenient for me and has a lot to offer .

French toast and sweet potato tots are pretty bomb!! But don't even try and go in there half hour before they close because they will not say anything to you but you could feel that you better hurry up and get out of there by the time their shift is over because they are not happy about late arrivals well that's is the waitress isn't

I really, really want to like coming here... I really do... my kid loves coming here every week and we do every week...  attached is a photo of a dirty rag sitting on my table, an empty pint glass.. never asked if I wanted a refill ...and my check, which arrived while I was eating my entree..  (every week I get my check while I'm eating my entree), every week we order a 'Pie in the sky 'dessert..they see us every week ...but make the same bad service mistakes every friggin time...

Don't you want to sell me another beer... or  dessert ? Bump the check average? Bigger tip .. I always leave 20% as a former Restaurant owner.. 

But every Wednesday or Thursday you have the same servers running around looking stressed with a half full restaurant, peeved that you added a dessert to your order..  

I really want to enjoy spending here...

The only reason I'm giving this place a 2 rating is because of the sushi service. Those guys actually did their job well and make great rolls. Starts with the hostesses. No greeting, blank stares and no goodbyes. Server didn't give me a name, never checked back with me but was conversing with peers in the bar. The bartender (tall skinny with glasses) is always a douche and unapproachable. Manager (dark hair, thin young lady) was nice and apologetic about the terrible service I received. I used to love going there for sub par food and a great sushi happy hour. Unfortunately the last few times have been undeserving of my business. I have been in the service industry from fine dining to cocktail waitress to chain dinner restaurants and know how tiring the field can be, but the lack of work ethic on anyone's part (minus the sushi and manager) is uncalled for.
Usually our fav place for happy hour. Today the worst service ever.  Waited over a half hour to get drinks and 45 minutes for appetizers. Will not be back anytime soon.

AMAZING FOOD! Horrible service and management. I went there for dinner tonight sat down in the "open seating" for happy hour, it was later and not busy at all. It took 15 minuets for me to get menus, 5 mins to get my water and another 15 mins to get my happy hour menu. I then wave over the manager(took me three times) to ask him for a comment card and he rudely says no. He says I have an email (with attitude). I open my notes app on my phone so he can type it in I then hand him my phone and he puts his hands behind his back, starts reading it to me, and walks away. Finally 25 mins later I get my food. I time everything at this restaurant cause I know how sucky the  service is. Go for the food not the service. Also the whole time I was there before I got my food the manager and four or five employees were just sitting in a both having a good ole time. They need someone to come and fix the service ASAP cause I love the food.
Thank you guys. I was craving curry (not on the menu), but fried tofu and shrimp made the pad thai yum.

I have been a long time customer (over 15 years) and have been going to him since I was a kid. My fiance changed jobs to an out of state one and was about to lose his insurance. I called to see if we could get his prescription filled for another year so he would have contacts until he got insurance again (standard 6 month waiting period and kicks in on the 7th month) and they said no because he was due for an exam next month. The front desk lady said that they would not be able to fill them because of legal reasons, when I asked what the law was she would not answer me and kept trying to answer with policy then. I said it was sad that they would not fill them because they wanted the money from the exam. I will never support their business and will recommend other vision places from here on. I was very disappointed with his office today. He is losing a long time customer because of the actions today.

I would also like to tell me story with meridian vision along with my fiance's. A little over a year ago I decided I wanted a pair of glasses. Since I wasn't going to wear them the majority of the time I bought his cheap $100 glasses. I get them in and they are way to strong of a prescription, so string I can't wear them without getting an instant headache. I tell him this and I go back in. He says he won't change them because they are already lower than my contacts and a weaker prescription than what I had in the 6th grade (im 27 now and that is how long I had been going to him). I tell him again that they are to strong and that I can't see out of them. He tells me to just get used to them. I have tried to her used to them and finally gave up. I wasted to much money on those glasses for them not to work and he didn't want to change them because he is to lazy.
Num num. had a great meal, cheeseburger, fries and a dandy1 huckleberry shake. The food was excellent. I recommend them to all. Oh, the service was wonderful as well.!

Went to Kona Grill for a late lunch/early dinner on a Sunday. We got some sushi which had a great lack of flavor and the rice was hard. I got the miso salmon. The salmon was average. The green beans weren't even cleaned! Still had the inedible stems attached. The fried rice was horrible. The actual rice was under cooked. My husband got the soft shell crab sliders. The soft shell crab had a soggy batter and there was no "bite" to the coleslaw. And then there was the SLOW obnoxious service! I remember our servers name but I felt the only tip I wanted to give him was the tip to get a new job! We will not be returning.
Gyro Shack was a pleasant surprise to find when I needed some quick food but hate the typical fast food junk! It was made to order for me....Add this, leave that off.

I give this place more like a 2.5 stars and those stars go to service and atmosphere.  Our waiter was great. The food was just okay.  My husband and I shared the 16oz rib eye steak entree with 5 prawns. The prawns were a bit overcooked but had a good garlic lemony flavor.  The steak was a bit undercooked but we were fine with a more rare steak then an overcooked one. The problem with the steak was that it wasn't a good piece of meat.  It had a ton of fat on it and a bit tough.  The entire entree with shrimp was $47 bucks.  That's a lot of money for a bad peace of meat and prawns.  The entree also came with mashed potatoes and veggies.  The sides were actually pretty good. There was no side salad or bread offered.  Those you would have to pay separately.  At the end of the meal we paid over 100 bucks with tip for one entree, two glasses of wine and dessert.  I would say we probably won't be coming back.  Too expensive for a mediocre meal.

Colossal disappointment!  We waited 45 minutes for a table then another 30 minutes after ordering.  There were several empty tables but staff couldn't handle the volume of people.  I had high expectations for this place and there was positive pub in the papers but unfortunately it was a major letdown.  I've never had crispy pancakes but apparently that's what they serve at Joe Mommas. They were the worst I've ever had.  The food was lukewarm.  The portion size was large but the quality was poor, the wait was long, and it took forever to get drink refills.  Unsatisfied, I will never go back.

I used to eat at the Bruchi's in Lewiston,Idaho back in the late 90's (?), and I also ate at the location in Post Falls, ID in that same era.  I loved the classic steak sandwich (steak and cheese)- piping hot, with some Horseradish sauce to spice it up.

So, with that expectation, I went out of my way to eat at this location, way out in "Meridifornia."   I ordered both a classic steak and a classic chicken, to go.   It seemed like it took a long time to get my food, and when I got home, I found my sandwiches were mostly "more bread than meat".  I could have made the same thing at home, myself. 

This isn't the Bruchi's I remember.  :-(

So this was my first experience eating at Joe Momma's. Our experience would have been perfect but our order got lost. Once we finally got our order, the breakfast food was amazing. I highly recommend the lemon poppy seed pancake. The stuffed blueberry French toast was crazy good.

I was a patron of one of their original stores in Yakima, WA and, yes, their cheesesteaks are really THAT good.

Thanks for opening a store here for my benefit!  :-)

Horrible waiting list system! Waited on the wait list for a hour and 30 mins. Showed up and the hostess says there are still 4 parties our size that will need to be sat and it will be over another hour. It was clear she wanted us just to leave and not wait. We left and went somewhere else and we were sat in 15 mins.

Wow. Very nice place. Good location. Food was awesome. Kid friendly and great choices. Very neat and clean. Professionalism is top notch. Great service and hostess. Food very fresh. Desert was also sooooo goood. Must try this place. Coming from Hawaii. It's got what you want.

So good.  Everything. The owner and staff were so friendly.  The boba in the tea were better than other places I've had (I didn't know they could be different). The thai boneless chicken was a tasty treat.  The noodle soup I ordered was exactly what I was craving.  And my husband loved the waffle sandwich... I don't like sandwiches and even I really liked it. So unique!.  Can't wait to come back.
Very disappointed in the bed side manner of the staff. No one was very friendly, everyone seemed uptight and that this was a bother to them.

I've been to the Varsity Pub twice, and have enjoyed both visits. I've gone once on a weekend night when it was suuuuper busy, and during the week when it's a light crowd. The two male bartenders there are super nice and friendly. They both whip up drinks fast. The atmosphere is nice, with low lights and sport decor. This is a great go-to bar when the restaurants in meridian are closing, but you and the girls still want to keep drinking without going downtown to the Boise mayhem. Such a low key vibe. I would recommend this bar for a crowd.

Four friends and I went in for Happy Hour last night. I am on crutches with a broken foot.  The entire staff from the hostess to the bus woman to the management team and especially our adorable expectant waitress was so kind, patient and helpful. The bar was very full and I'm slow as molasses on my crutches, no one made me feel rushed or in the way, quite the opposite each staff member made a point of either clearing the way for me or waiting kindly for me to maneuver. 

The Kentucky mules were delicious, the appetizers yummy (we really liked the ahi on crispy won tons), but by far the best part of the evening was the staff. Great job, Kona Grill! Your team is well trained and incredibly gracious!

I had the worst experience here!! My family and I got seated by a woman that we presumed to be the owner and she was not the most friendly and then we sat at the table for at least 10 minutes without and acknowledgment that we were even there and  I had to get up and asked to be waited on. The owner/hostess never apologized just said that she would tell "her", our waitress, that we were there. Then another waitress that was not ours that had looked at us several times before then and asked us for our drink orders, we ordered and she left, then our actual waitress came and asked us how we were and we calmly said something about how long we had been waiting and she very rudely god defensive, never apologized and started to raise her voice at us. She then went on to ask if we wanted another waitress and my father said no and tried to order our drinks and she said "there is no reason to be rude" and then walked away and left us at the table. We got up and left and as we were leaving I I said thank you to the owner/hostess and she gave me a little laugh. I will never go back there we had heard that they had good food and we never even got to experience it due to the horrible service!

Awesome!  Had the veggie burrito, was NOT saturated with oil like most places.  I also had the special pineapple upside down pancake, PERFECT.  It wasn't some syrupy, out of the can, nasty ihop goo, it was freshly cut pineapple with just enough sweetness without that overwhelming sugar rush from most fruit toppings.  Well done Joe Momma's, as for service, our server was very attentive and personable, Thanks!

My girlfriend and I went here on a recommendation of a friend.  It was EXTREMELY busy and was standing room only.  The hostess and waitresses were working incredibly hard to get everyone seated as quickly as possible.  I was initially impressed with the efficiency of the entire wait staff.  The cleanliness and freshness of our booth was nice.  I had the special which was a chorizo stuffed chili relleno and house potatoes.  My girl had one of their many eggs Benedict variations.  The presentation of our food was beautiful and mine was truly one of the most delicious breakfasts I've ever had in my life.  Their fresh salsa was incredible.  The eggs Benedict was an absolute home run of flavor and freshness.  Our waitress was OUTSTANDING.  This is a fantastic establishment and we can't wait to return.  I HIGHLY recommend this place.

Ken is great to work with.  Tells me what I need and doesn't take advantage of me.  I drop my car off and it's ready when he says it will be.  He even works on some Saturdays.  I had a problem with my AC, he checked it for nothing and put me at ease that is was more than just an AC charge.  He's replacing all my belts in the car next week.  He's honest and trustworthy.

This place is trash! Total disgrace to BBQ, I can make better tasting bbq in my home oven. Ribs are overdone and dry, smoked turkey is dryer then Death Valley and taste less. The baked beans are weird, the potato salad is a disgrace to southern style potato salad. The owner should get his ass kicked for serving this kind of food

Very good experience today at Nike! Just a few days before Christmas and they were fully staffed, with extra cashier tables to help maintain the line. The employees helped answer all my questions and helped me with finding sizes and helped pick out shoes for my brother! I was very impressed with an employee named Tyler, he was very helpful and very kind. Good job Nike!

I wish I could give this place a better review, but since it's primary focus is being a coffee shop, and the coffee is pretty terrible, I just can't do more than 1 Star. The shop is cute, the people are nice. The coffee is just bad. A latte tastes like watering old grounds, which is strange since it's mostly milk. I've tried it twice, just to be sure it wasn't a single bad experience. Both times I found the quality of the beverage to be poor. As in, they don't seem to really know much about coffee, or making coffee drinks. I ordered a cappuccino on one visit. There really was no foam to speak of. I'd recommend getting some serious barista training for the staff, unless this is just one of those get blended sugar coffee drink places. I hate to be so harsh, but I honestly believed the coffee at the gas station to be better.
The place had plenty of equipment and I was able to find spots even during peak times. The gym attendants were courteous and answered any questions I had.

We have had Centurylink internet for one year.  Should have been a deal killer when I saw they partnered with Directv.  Our internet is out, after 1" of snowfall.  Multiple calls to customer service resulted in 3 disconnects in phone tree while getting in line for representative.  Then, after a 43 minute wait "on hold", listening to how important my cal was to them, busy signal-disconnect.  I'm a glutton because I'm on hold again, waiting to get a chance to share with them my anger at their in competence.  It's been another 30 minutes, we will see if they are my provider through the week or not?

I don't recommend YMC. If I could give them less stars I would. My A/C quit working a couple of weeks ago and I called YMC, which came highly recommended by several people. They sent a tech out who, without using any equipment to check anything, told me my 21 year old A/C unit was completely out of Freon, there was a crack in the coil (because usually that's where they are leaking from), and that the galvanized tubes from the furnace to the house would need to be replaced as it was out of code. He also said all of the pipes under the house from the garage to the A/C unit would need to be replaced. He provided an estimate of a new A/C and heating system that was close to $9,500 for a 1,800 sq ft home. This is $4,500 more than two other estimates that I received. 
I had a different HVAC company come out later that day - they checked and put pressure gages on the A/C unit, filled it with a couple lbs. of Freon, checked the pressure again, checked for leaks in all of the pipes and the coil - found none. They also turned the heat on and checked the condition of the unit, it worked fine and checked for CO2 in the house. Yet another company came out the next day and provided a similar quote ($4,500 less than YMC!). My A/C unit has worked perfectly now for 2 months. I paid $127 in repairs where YMC would have had me pay $9,500+ for a new unit. 
I also called the YMC manager and spoke to her about what had happened. She was very nice and seemed to understand and empathize with the situation. She referred me to the operations manager who, when he called me back, could do nothing but make excuses for his 'experienced' tech. Not customer focused at all. It was so frustrating I had to end the call. 
I feel the YMC tech didn't do his job and took advantage of a woman, thinking I would take his diagnostic and overly priced quote at face value. I will never do business with this company again.

It was lunchtime and I happened to be in the meridian area so I decided to be adventures and try something new. Hungry Horse had a lot of great reviews so I decided let's try it!! I am still not sure what this restaurant is or what is the significance of their name it's just very odd. I mean is this a boba tea place? Sandwich shop? Asian food? American food (wings, chicken strips, and fries)? All wrapped up in this western themed restaurant it was a little hard to nail down. I went with the lunch special half sandwich,chips and drink for only $8. I ordered the jalapeño oven baked herb chicken; for bread they choose to use waffles which are flaky and light (held up well with the sandwich). The sandwich itself was in terms of culinary prowess was very basic and simple (the sandwich just didn't pop for me). To me it was just simple store bought ingredients ("oven baked" chicken, salad, jarred jalapeños) put between two waffles no real development of flavor or any culinary flair so the flavor was just meh. I understand everyone on here raves about the waffles I agree just the rest of the overall flavor profile of the sandwich fell flat outside of the waffles. I'd like to come back and try their Asian noodles/soup someone else had that and it looked/smelled delicious. I wish I could give more stars as I said the sandwich lacked overall flavor (nothing popped); the customer service was top notch!! Both the gal who took my order and the guy in the kitchen were very warm and friendly. Well if you happen to be going to the movies this isn't a bad stop on the way to the movie if you are looking for some classic American grub (wings/chicken strips/fries) or a simple sandwich served between two crispy flaky waffles.
Awesome breakfast. Everything cooked as ordered, large portions and good service. I'm only giving 4 stars since I've only been there once.

Our dog Rose was hit by a car Friday night and suffered 2 broken hips & a broken tail. Thanks to the surgical abilities of Dr. Lake & the compassionate care of the staff, Rose is at home & recovering very quickly. Vet tech Roslyn was especially kind to our pup. If the need ever arises again, we will surely come to All Valley.

I have a love / hate with this place . While it has many options to choose from to shop , see a movie ( at a theater that serves cocktails ! ) and eat here more than downtown Boise will , it's just ... off . It's a giant mall so it would make sense as to why it's filled with  family's and unruly kids . It's just a weird vibe out here - almost cult like ? I don't quite have it figured  out  but I wish it wasn't so weird . The drive here sucks too because Meridian is well , trash ! Other than that it can be a good place to shop depending on your experience.

They seem to really care here. They follow up with phone calls or emails to check on your babies' progress. They don't rush you out of the examination room. They are generally much cheaper than the places I've tried around the area. They also seem to not just pressure you into an expensive procedure. They consider the needs of the dog and your pocketbook. I have two dogs- one is calm as can be- you can stick him with a needle or stick a thermometer in an uncomfortable place and he won't have a fit. My other one can and will have a fit.  They accommodate both of their temperaments and are loving to both. They also are understanding when you are emotional and concerned about your little furry family members. The office is clean and welcoming.  I highly recommend this place.

Horrible food horrible service 15 minutes just to get water and coffee 45 minutes to get breakfast served I order the egg Benedict crab cake I couldn't even cut through the English muffin with a knife I had to send it back I've never written a bad review on any restaurant and I can say I've never had a worst meal in my life or worst service save your money go somewhere else after I spoke with Britney the manager I decided to write the review hopefully they find a new manager and new servers and new cooks I asked around town and I keep getting the same consensus the place is horrible
Did a great job on my 4Runner. It has a small bubble I was concerned about when I first picked it up but like he said it went away in a few days
This place is amazing. Great food, great service, great drinks. Definitely a must go when considering brunch!! Highly recommend.

Whatever you do, get bacon! Their cheeseburgers with bacon are delicious! Lightly peppered mmm! Staff is friendly and sometimes if you are waiting too long (which isn't long) they offer a free "courtesy ice cream cone" oh yeah the fries are great too!

The food here is largely enjoyable. Their Irish Benedict is my personal favorite, although sometimes you'll get a cook who turns the corned beef into jerky. But their food quality is always decent for a greasy spoon overall, which is why I gave the extra star. 

Their customer service is where this negative review really stems from. My husband and I had an issue about a month ago, when our server blatantly tried to steal some of our leftover cash after cashing us out. Most of it was going to be her tip anyways, but it left a sour feeling for both of us. I brought this issue to the attention of the restaurant, and finally received a response back. 

The owner assured me it was all a mistake and that he hoped I believed him and the server. Unfortunately, he wasn't there to see just how obvious it was. She didn't even flinch when we had informed her money was missing, and knew exactly where it was. We were offered a gift card, which was kind of them, but I care less about the money and more about the customers who don't notice and get taken advantage of.

As the wife of a local business owner, I love supporting other local businesses. Unfortunately, this will no longer be one of those. I reccomend avoiding this location at the very least, and counting your change if you use cash.
Fresh food, great service and pleasant atmosphere. Enjoyed breakfast and will love to try more dishes!
Great with allergens! Friendly servers = pleasant time(: my grandma lovesss there pies since Marie Calendar's is no longer around!

I saw a  bouncer and his LARGE MALE friends BEAT THE CRAP out of a small woman at this bar.  The owner even lied to the police about what happened.  Enter at your own risk, because you won't be protected by the staff.
We've been here a few times when visiting Meridian.  I really enjoyed the food.  We had a french dip that was very tasty.  The pizza is a good choice.  The service is very good.

I have wanted to try the cheesesteak for months. Today I was close at lunch time. I used the drive thru and it did take a little long but the sandwich was made fresh and so worth the wait. It was excellent. As many reviewers stated I too wished the bread had been a little toasted but the flavor was amazing. I felt there was plenty of meat even though several reviewers commented differently. Great job!

Inconsistent. That's pretty much what I can say about Bruchi's after a few visits. I've had the cheesesteak sandwich a couple times and the pepper steak. The first time it was amazing. Very flavorful and cheesy on soft bread. Since then the sandwiches have been sad... very little cheese and the meat was bland. Love the menu... want to love the food... but don't know if I will try them again.

Maybe because it's new to the area, and it was 4pm on a Monday... ordered a salmon plate and was told they were out, after the order was placed.  Had to quickly order something else on the fly...got the big kahuna burger.  Requested well done, arrived pink.  Service was ok, but had a new waiter that mumbled and kept having to go ask someone else the answer to questions.  Kind of an annoying experience but the environment was nice.

If I could do a negative star I would have.  The older lady at the counter refused to seat us at a booth that was available. Then she proceeded to talk to the customers about the situation in an extremely rude and unprofessional manor rolling her eyes and giving me dirty looks like she was dealing with a child. What happened to customer service idaho style!  Would never go back there alternative breakfast across the street much better and actual professional and much more efficient!!!!!!!!   Maybe some therapy would help.

I went here a few days ago with a friend that never cooks and I mean never she eats all her meals out all the time and her kids too for as long as I can remember. She says this is one of her favorite places to eat so hey it was about time I tried it too.
We got there after the luch rush so we were the only ones along with 2 asian gentlmen that came in.
They knew Maggie by name and asked if she wanted her regular order which was spring rolls- gui cuon and a coke which she did
I don't drink soda so asked for a recommendation the waiter said the vietmanese coffe which is kind of like a french press type coffee with condensed milk,served with a glass of ice and then u mix it up. It was ok but a very small amount but at least I tried it
I had an entree with soft noodles and chicken with veggies it wasn't hot or spicy enough for me. It has crisy egg rolls on top which were cooked to perfection (I can't recall the name of my item-sorry)
I loved the decor and was really surprised once I went though the velvet curtains (I did not read the reviews before I went so had no iea what to expect) they have been there 5 years already!
The waiter found out we both just had a birthday so brought us a huge slice of chocolate cake which was moist and flavorfull it had a raspberry sauce too (on the house) that was really nice of him.
We even took cake to her son as we just had a few bites.
I liked everything about my experience and will go back to try more dishes for sure!
A little slow. But the coffee is always delightful and the people working here are friendly and helpful. I would come here everyday if I lived here!

Located in the old  Famous Dave's  BBQ site, you eat in a beautiful, rustic, log cabin type atmosphere which I personally love. This place is crazy busy and popular so expect a rather long wait time at the door to get a seat. Service to our table was rather slow but, again,  they are super busy so that is understandable. But, once we got our food, it was served hot and delicious with extra large, hearty portions. The wait staff was friendly. It's a great place for big, home-cooking style  appetites but, again,  do expect a wait time. It's so popular because their food is soooo good! 4 stars for looong wait time and slow service because they're so busy, otherwise, it was an excellent experience.

I have lots of hospital visits in my life due to family members with serious chronic illnesses.  I have been to this center for procedures, imaging, ER visits, hospital stays and doctor's appointments.

This is a wonderful facility.  All of the staff members we've encountered have been helpful and kind.  

Like any medical situation, it's best to be proactive.  Make sure you have a complete medications list with you -- and you may even need to bring the meds themselves.  One of my husband's anti-rejection medications (needed due to an organ transplant) was not available here at the hospital.

My husband didn't order a breakfast meal for this morning, and I thought it was very nice that they called his room to see if he wanted anything.

The hotel was very clean, the free breakfast was great and they had someone standing watching and cleaning/adding things.   While staying there we met the caretaker/maintenance man who was very friendly and helpful... He made our trip!! Would definitely stay here again!

Went there for brunch with my parents, food was good but the fact that they let a little dog with a bedazzled jacket who was clearly not a service animal. The animals owner picked up the dog and set it in the booth where everyone else sits, it was absolutely disgusting and I will never be back.

The facility was very over crowded and they charge adults the full amount when it is obviously a place just for kids to play at and explore. Seems bizarre to charge parents because there was very little staff helping at each of the stations.  There wasn't really anything educational just 8-10 different play stations that were all cute.  Ja beers in Nampa has a lot of the same stations and is cheaper and also has some more active options. I don't think we will ever go back. Money is better spent at planet kid or jabbers for afternoon fun.

I am not sure whether to give this place a 3 or a 4. I medically boarded my dogs last month for the first time for 2 weeks. One of my dogs is paralyzed in the back end and the other is deaf and skiddish around new people. The pros are that they seemed to have taken care of them both well. They kept the paralyzed dog clean and we were able to board them together and there was plenty of comfy blankets for them both. The cons are that there were some hidden fees in regards to needing an exam that wasn't told to me before when I was booking the appointment and getting the price. I am also not sure they knew how to handle my deaf dog. There was a couple incidents with her, but I also understand that she has never been boarded that long without us being able to visit her so I am sure she was super nervous. I appreciate that there is a place in the valley that offers this and is open 24/7 so someone can always be there. But they are not cheap and are not always forthcoming with prices.

Ok sandwiches, but crazy horrible service. There was like two people here and it took 25, yes, twenty five minutes to make our two sandwiches. Wondering how many people were working? 6. Yup. It's like the place is run by highschoolers with no discernible management. Get it together because these slickly overpriced sandwiches aren't worth waiting for.

Winco is simply our favorite grocery store, and our standard go-to place for pretty much all our food-stuffs.  The prices are the best, the people are super friendly, and they don't go and change the store around all the time (like other discount stores).  We love it, and go here all the time.  Since they have quick-check, it's easy to just drop in for single items, as well as major shopping.

[  True story:  On the way to Winco, I am waiting to make a left turn at a signal light.  My wife says, "You know, you can just creep out into the middle of the intersection to get ready to turn."  To which I reply, "But I don't want to be a creepy guy."  ]
Location is very convenient - need to get in and out for a quick workout this is thre place to go. Clean and not crowded.

I couldn't wait to get home to write this review.

Upon arriving my wife and I and my mom who was visiting us were instantly greeted by a nice smile and seated immediately at a table. Our server Kate who was training a new server was exceptionally attentive and courteous took our order and answered any questions as to some sides I never heard of.
She brought us a small sample which answered my questions.
The manager Vincent came by our table. Oddly enough he remembered us coming in over two months ago, he even remembered me mentioning that I am gone for lengthy periods of time and I work out of state.
I asked him about the Spider Roll which is prepared with a soft shell crab. I explained my concerns about eating something that has eyes and legs. He explained that is was prepared as I expected and assured me it was delicious. He was kind enough to bring us a sample of the roll and I was astonished at the taste and presentation of such a fine roll.
Kona Grill is by far a great dining experience here in Meridian. Great prices and great portions as they can easily charge more for the food and service they provide.

Thank you Vincent and Kate for the hospitality you provided me, my dear wife an dearest mother and making her dining experience tonight so memorable.

We will definitely visit every time I'm back home.

I guess I should have got a cheesesteak, I had the turkey sub. Worst turkey sub I ever had, the meat was almost tasteless and with only a little cheese and sliced tomato with it, there was no taste. Totally dissatisfied.

Our waiter tonight was Barkley (sp?) he was a gem.  Actually all the staff was fantastic!  I will definitely be back to this place again & again- as the Fresh Sheet has a nice mix, the Regular Menu apparently gets routine tweaking, & customer feedback seems genuinely requested- can't beat that!  The drinks were interesting & well explained (my sweetie & I had our first Twigs Martini tonight- yum!) Not being a big drinker, I always appreciate waiters talking the time to thoroughly explain options- ie dirty/stuffed/not stuffed olives, etc.  The waiter did an equally great job in recommending the tuna lettuce wraps wish were outstanding!  It was a bit on the louder side- but it seemed more "vibrant" vs obnoxious noise- a credit to the stellar food & service- loud because the place was packed!
The stuffed French toast is a must! Fried and crispy and sweet, yummmm. Also had excellent corn beef hash and a good cup O' Joe. There was no wait and good service when we went.
As far as bbq go, this is it. Everything is delicious, and has a nice Smokey taste. There green beans are the best!

Let me start by saying my rating is only about their planning, or lack there of.  I think they have some of the best beer around! There IPA is awesome. But here is my issue or issues. When you only brew one IPA, and that is your only IPA, then make enough to last until you brew another batch. Tonight I went in to have a great IPA and they were out. When you only have one IPA you should NOT run out!!! Quit worrying about making your Saisons and get on the IPA's. Also, tell the guy who plays guitar and sings outside to turn the sound down a little. It was so loud we could even talk. It's a brewery patio, not Hannah's. And one other thing, find a food truck who stays open later than 7pm!

So good! Great owners, cool menu. The brisket sandwich was fantastic, kids loved the chicken strips but were stealing bites of our lunches as well. We were all talking about coming back for dinner. Can't wait to try the wings...

I like it. A great place to hang with friends and family's. Catch a movie, get a bite to eat, and browse some stores. There is also much more. But it needs more though. More attractions then just clothes stores would be better.
I have been coming here since the day after it opened. I always have the chicken Caesar salad. The seasoning on the chicken is amazing. The crinkle frys are perfect.
Delicious, interesting food. A staff member really helped us out with all the foreign words, and the service was quick, clean, friendly. Prices were very good too. A fun place to go.

While Kona is a 5 for ambiance and design, I am giving it a 3 for service and food. I don't think the food has been amazing any of the times I've been. And the servers, while nice, haven't been very attentive. Last time I was there, my party was ignored for a good 20 minutes before a waiter that wasn't ours stopped by. I suppose it depends on what your looking for in a restaurant, but I have never been overly thrilled with Kona.

Such a fun salon! Bri did my hair and gave me a rooty blonde with a balayage. Super cute modern chic decor and in a nice location downtown meridian. Even though I live in Houston I'll be coming here every time I'm home for a touch up!
Awesome place to eat! The food was all really good! Try the tri tip and bacon! To die for and the service was very good

Mmmmmmm... That's what I have to say about this place. They have a large selection of breakfast food and, if you show up after 11am, lunch food also. My husband got the French dip and I got the Monte Cristo sandwich. We also got a side of bacon, hash browns and eggs. Everything was delicious and portion sizes were perfect. 

You can also get some cocktails if you are in the mood. For example, I got the Mimosa flight which you can choose what flavors you would like for four different mimosas. My favorites were the strawberry lemonade and raspberry. 

I was very excited that they had the Monte Cristo sandwich because it is not served in very many places and it is so so so good. 

Fair warning-there is always a wait for this place so you can either go onto their website and get placed on their wait-list or go to the restaurant and get on the list. They will send you a text when you are up and you can also check your place in line with a link that they give you on your phone. If you don't want to wait, I heard that there is almost always a spot available at the bar. We waited about 45 minutes... Not too bad but I've heard people waiting almost 2 hours before. So plan accordingly.

 I will most definitely be coming back!!!

Hands down, this place has the best boba in all of Boise. Their drinks aren't too sweet and the boba is perfectly soft. 
Their noodle soup is also very tasty, and reminds me of phó. 
The service here is great and the owner is always  very welcoming and friendly.

I've ate here in the past and enjoyed my experience so when I saw how long the wait was... I expected the food and service to be better.  Waited almost a half an hour for then to seat just me.  1 person.  There were at least 3-4 empty tables/booths and when they did finally seat me I was so cramped and the tiny table for two, that every time someone around me got up, I was either bumped or had someone's "tush" in my face. The server was rude and never checked back on me.  Never refilled my beverages.   The only time she came back by was to drop my check off.  Coffee was bitter but worse when it got cold (never offered a warm up) The biscuits and gravy were dry and bland.  I understand being busy... but no excuse for poor service. Being busy is absolutely no excuse for poor service.  As a business owner/operator for the last 18 years (event planner/caterer) I was shocked at the customer service level or the lack there of.  As to why I didn't address my concerns while I was there.  I had already witnessed people getting agitated about the wait to the person who seemed to be managing this fiasco (realized after reading some more of these reviews that she's the owner) and her responses to them were short and rude.   Shame on you!  If you're so busy that you can't keep up, seat people timely, comfortably, be pleasant at all comments/complaints (even if it's fake) and your food quality is dropping... maybe some new staff, better training, some accountability might be in order or possibly a bigger location if you're going to continue to try to house so many and herd them through like cattle.

***UPDATE***
The Great thing about the edit button... Is if you accidentally hit post prior to being completed you do have the opportunity to go back and fix it. But unfortunately your customer service cannot be fixed. Such a bitter person. Criticism is part of owning a business.

*** looking at my reviews ***
A whopping one other review.... I honestly forget about YELP until I have a horrible experience.  Maybe I should take more time to post positive ones, but I would be on here every day.  My point was made... bad experience spreads faster than good.  Someone has problems with constructive criticism. I would toughen up a bit or it will eventually effect your business.
This place is the best in the area. The kitchen sink omelet is delicious. The cinnamon rolls are great too!

We started with lettuce wraps and the gouda cheese fondue which were very good. 
Then we got serious and tried a variety of entrees. The New York steak was flavorful but not very tender. The Ahi tuna was seared perfectly and very tasty. The market salmon was a little overcooked and because of that a little dry. The sea bass was cooked perfectly and was very delicious. 
The Snickers ice cream pie was a bit too rich and could have fed three of us. The carrot cake was very good with excellent cream cheese frosting and could have been split four ways easily. The passion fruit creme brûlée was just a tiny bit too fruity. The butter cake with raspberry sauce and vanilla ice cream was dreamy and was the best dessert by far. 
I will be back.

As a SLC, Utah boy - this brewery is like Disneyland! So awesome and they were letting us try new brews they haven't even released yet! Not only are they tasty but they're local. Big fan, will come again

This is a no-frills grocery store with bulk bins and *really* competitive prices. They take cash/check/debit only, so leave your Visa at home.

What's good:
Service deli, great grocery prices, bulk bins for all kinds of good stuff, service bakery with good bagels and rolls. Customer service. Cold-case of craft beer and 22oz-ers.

What could use some work:
Donuts. They totally suck. Also, general grocery selection might could use a little work (they don't have the latest greatest cereal, for example) but I suspect it's because the price isn't right. This can be an issue if you clip a coupon for something that sounds kinda cool, then you find Winco doesn't carry it.

Winco continues to be my go-to grocery store.
Very good massage...very good prices...very friendly staff...Tiffyny and her friend make us feel so relaxing...we did there 6 messages... You have to go!!!

I am new to Idaho and still trying to find a hair stylist.  I was somewhat impulsive and wanted it done on a Monday and so found "So Posh Spa".  I set my appt. for a highlight and a cut and brought pictures to make it easier.  The owner was my stylist.  She said she had a "cheaper" way to do my color (meaning easier for her because I wasn't looking for cheaper!) and she did an overall color which was way too blonde.  She next looked at the picture I gave her and said "you want something similar to what you have but a little "sassier".  That sounded right.  The next thing I knew I looked like Mrs. Brady from the Brady Bunch.  This was a horrible experience and I would not recommend her to anyone!

Came here for dinner one night with a friend. We were seated promptly by the window, and our drink orders were taken right away. Excellent service here. Servers are really on the ball. I love the atmosphere it's very nice and open. 

The sushi I had was good and I tried most of the offerings. I love sushi! The prices are high for what you get but I think you're paying mostly for location. Presentation was nice and the food came in a reasonable amount of time. We had a nice meal and we were never rushed at all. The server was very nice coming back to see if we wanted any more Sushi or anything else. Overall it was a decent experience.
Love this place!! All of the employees are super nice and they always make my drinks consistently! They usually already know my order when I pull up!

I am so glad they changed their Happy Hour. Now it is even much better than their previous version. I will be visiting this location more frequently. The only reason for 4 of 5 stars is the selection of wine. They should look into adding local wines to their selection. Better selection of wine will get a 5 star review from this guy.

My husband and I are happy with our home. All of the CBH staff have been great. During my walk through my husband had to work so I took my baby. They guys that did my walk through kept and eye on her as I sign paperwork. Today Dana came by to check on some items we had reported and my 1 yr was all over him. He was nice enough to get on the floor with her and give her a little attention to making her happy. I thought this was awesome.

Today I was by myself and that's when I pay more attention to the service. I've been here many times with friends and so I suppose I didn't notice prior? The food was good, I always enjoy the jalapeño hamachi and the other sushi was standard. However service was subpar; I had to ask for everything I needed; a napkin for example which took many tries because they were too busy polishing glasses? I intended to stay the next hour or so but think I'll move onto a different space in the Village.

To start off, service was bad. I was with a party of four and by the time I received my meal, everyone else at my table was done eating! As far as the food, very bland and just sub par. Will not go back......

I had an hour reflexology massage with Holly and it was amazing! She gives a wonderful therapeutic massage. She had very firm pressure and I could tell she knew what she was doing. She pinpointed areas where I was having pain and worked to relieve the tension! An hour was definitely not enough time so next time I'll be sure to book a 90 minute massage! Also shoutout to Colton at the front desk for being so welcoming and friendly! Overall a 5 star experience!

The food was good but the hostess was such a rude rude lady her name was Dee? 

We got there at 940am. Sat down around 950. I texted my husband if he wanted something to go since he was sick. He said yes. I texted him at 957am. (I have the proof) We ordered breakfast not even 7 mins after that. 
It was like 1030 and the table beside us came in after ya and got their food first. So we asked what was taking so long to get our food. The waiter was SUPER nice. He did a great job. By the hostess was coming at us yelling and snapping and said we only ordered 16 mins ago. Which was NOT true based on my text to my husband. And I had little kids with me that were really hungry. 

The table near us finished their food and still didn't get ours. It was 1046 by the time we got our food. 

The food was good at least. The waiter was respectful and tried to help us. But the hostess KEPT talking about how we only ordered 16 mins ago and we sat two tables away from the front of her counter and the entire time we were eating I could hear her complaining about us. They didn't offer any kind of discount.  

If your a customer you SHOULD NOT BE YELLED AT BY THE RESTAURANT. They didn't apologize. (The waiter did). It was the worst experience yet! I had my in laws with me and they just couldn't believe how we were treated. My dad in law actually walked out! And didn't eat. 

I'll never go back here ever again.

I just recently got into hot yoga, and this was the 3rd studio I had visited. The other 2 studios were located in SoCal, and they can't even compare to Halo. I had a wonderful experience!! The studio is clean, hip, and very relaxing. The lady at the front desk and the instructor were both so nice, and I absolutely loved the flow. The best part is that it's only a $10 drop-in fee for students, which includes a mat and a towel rental! I will be back and I will be investing in a membership for when I'm home from college during the summer!
one of my favorites when going to the village!! absolutely perfect from start to finish. the avocado egg rolls are AMAZING and the carrot cake to finish is drool-worthy

Did they change breakfast cooks?  I know not the answer to that question.  But breakfast fare has been really good on our last couple of visits.  Maybe it's because we discovered good fit items for us.  The vegetable hash and the pumpkin pancakes as example.  They always get my 'poached hard like a golf ball' eggs just right.  (That is more difficult to do than one thinks.)  Same super-good, friendly service  and now consistently good breakfast fare.  Plus it's close to home.   We're fans. 

This n That:

1) Parking:  Last month the owner of the strip mall resurfaced / painted the parking lot.  Much improved.  Also striped and marked accessible parking spots per state code and federal standards.  About time. 

2) Loo:  Yes, it is decrepit.  That is the responsibility of the building owner.   But, it is clean.  That says good things about the restaurant owner.

Our little Havanese, Max, had a bad reaction to a vaccination - of course after our regular vet had closed for the evening - so THANK GOODNESS that All Valley is open 24/7!  The front receptionists ( and over three days, we met MANY different receptionists)  could not have been friendlier or more compassionate!  Max saw three different vets over three days, and we felt comfortable with all of them.  We really appreciated Dr. Zann's patience with us as she helped us understand the testing and bloodwork needed for Max's recovery. We were able to talk with her in a comfortable "living room" atmosphere, instead of a sterile exam room, while we cuddled our Max.  We also appreciated Dr. McGrath for his excellent and informative updates by phone.  He was very familiar with Max's condition, treatments, and prognosis, and truly seemed to care about answering our every question and concern. The medicines sent home with Max were well explained to us prior to checkout.  
The ONLY reason that we didn't rate All Valley at five stars, as MANY others have mentioned, was the wait times to actually see one of their excellent vets: at 6:30 pm with a very sick puppy - 30 minutes to get into an exam room, 45 minutes to see the tech, and another 45 minutes to see the vet. At 1:15 am (no other patients there) 10 min. to get into a room, 20 min. to see a tech, 20 minutes more to see the vet. (Of course, all of these times seem UNBEARABLE while you are holding a very sick puppy with bloody diarrhea! ) 
We thought that the prices for the care and boarding of our Max, while never "easy" on a fixed income, were reasonable.
We are just VERY thankful that All Valley was there for us in Max's hour of need - with a beautiful facility filled with caring professionals!!

My mike elite bag broke so I was getting a new one and I go in and am expecting to spend 75 but was astonished when it rang up at 40.00 and every time I come In here I get amazing service and nothing ever rings up for what it's marked at I would highly recommend to anyone much cheaper there than anywhere else for Nike

It has been a while since we were at Joe Momma's in Meridian, so when my wife wanted Breakfast, we decided to "Give it another Go". We arrived early, so there was almost no one in the place. It was really early after all!

I get asked all the time, how I decide if I like a menu item, or a restaurant. When you try something, or a new restaurant, ask yourself this. Would you have that same thing again? Or in the case of a restaurant, would you want to return?

If you did not like that pancake, or whatever it was that your ordered, then it should rate pretty low. If you did not like the restaurant at all, then rate it pretty low. Everyone's likes and dislikes are different, but chances are that if you did not like it, others wont either.

Thats a pretty simplistic way to look at how to rate these things, but it works pretty well. Then once the person finds your review reads of your experience, they can decide if they feel that your experience will fit in with their tastes, of they should ignore what you said and give it their own try.

Unless all the reviews are bad, or the majority of them are bad, I usually recommend trying the restaurant, or that item for yourself. You never know. I might hate something that I loved or vice versa. That does not mean that either of us were wrong, it just means that ether you had a different experience that I did, or your tastes are different.

Lets move on to this visit at Joe Mamma. I was hoping that things had changed at least a little. The inside is the same. The only new thing I noticed was a new clock on the wall that said Paris on it. I am not sure how Paris fits in with the whole Log Cabin motif but that's ok.

I decided to try something I had not had before. I love hash, and had not had it in a while, so I decided to try the 3-meat hash. When it came out, visually, I have to say I was pretty disappointed. It was served in a bowl, like Oatmeal. In the bowl was a pile of cut up meats. On top of the meats was a scrambled egg.

This showed no signs of creativity, originality, or effort at all. I mean come on, really! How hard was it to pile some cut up meats in a bowl and put an egg on top?

As I tasted it, my initial evaluation did not improve. It was dry, very very salty from all the meats. It tasted like a dry meat omelet. it needed something to bind and pull all these flavors together like some gravy, or anything of a liquid variety. 

When I think of Hash, I think of a something that was cooked on the flat top and all bound together with that egg, or something so that when comes to the table is served in a plate and looks more like Hash browns. The operative word there is hash.

On my 1 to 10 scale, I give this Meat-Hash a 2, and I think that is being generous. I for sure would not have this again. 

On a positive note, the jam was good as it always is and the service was excellent.

Phillip
One of the last breweries that we had not been to yet in the Boise area. The beer was very well made and they had a large selection. My husband liked their scotch ale and the brown ale the most.
The food here is fantastic! Friendly and fast service too.

This is for the new store in meridian. A friend and I stopped in after sampling you guys at a local wine event. The guy working the counter was super awesome-energetic and knowledgeable. I ordered the sugar cane pork (his suggestion) it was delicious/filling portion size. I got the fried rice; it was meh missing something maybe that's why there was soy sauce on the tables. Both my dining companion and I didn't really care for the fried rice. We both got the spicy pasta salad; it was delicious. It was a lot of food though we both didn't eat the fried rice. I'd love there to be a paleo option where you could just eat the delicious meats you offer (pick one like ala carte). The other part was the loud and vulgar music. They were young children in the restaurant sexually explicit lyrics and cussing to me is not really appropriate. The dining room could use some more lighting as well. If I was just rating this visit based on the delicious meat and energetic customer service it'd be a 5 there were a few misses so I would say it was a good experience. Next time I go; I will try to check on just a side of meat that's definitely worth a second visit!!

$70 tag for two with run of the mill soup and mediocre sushi. Our waitress was good. The rice was exceptional. Overall, this place lacked the professionalism and food quality. Those qualities did not match the interior design or decor.

This is no ordinary sandwich deli. They have fresh meet, fresh bread, with unique sauces, salads and dressings. Their desserts and cookies look and smell delicious, but I have yet to try them, because the sandwiches are filling, and the bread will keep you coming back for more. Bright and welcoming with friendly knowledgeable staff. The only draw back is they don't serve diet Coke, but that is an easy fix, I just bring my own.

I'm really surprised by the negative reviews. I've been getting massage therapy for many years from many different companies. I had a gift card to massage envy over a year ago and tried them out. Fantastic! I love the membership and membership pricing. I've found some of the best therapists around and schedule weekly with them. There is almost always an opening to get in if in a pinch, not necessarily with my regular ladies but with someone. They take good notes to make sure your massage is tailored to your needs for future reference and for other therapists. If you find your person, just make sure to schedule out with them to reserve those spots. Some are in quite high demand. The staff is always attentive and friendly and I've had 0 issues in all the time I've been going to them. I highly recommend them.

Well, my boyfriend and I have been here a few different times, different groups of friends as well. As much as I like the atmosphere (I do, honestly) the service is not great *mostly* because the bartenders aren't really friendly or polite. I get that they are around a bunch of drunks but for one, it's their job (don't they want tips?) for two I've been around MANY other bartenders and worse hole-in-the-walls (who DON'T have a bouncer??) much nicer and engaging than they are here. The beers on tap have been flat every time...coincidentally we keep coming when it's the "bottom of the keg".  And finally, they are far over priced for the service and beer selection given. I tried giving this pace more than a chance or two for a regular hang out spot since its close to home.
This place is always great. Friendly service, quality food, nice but not overly-fancy atmosphere
The Front desk was amazing, Rose was a perfect guide and answered every question and covered every topic that could come up. Very professional, highly recommend

They opened at 8:00am Sat we arrived at 8:20 to a 30 minute wait. Apparently there is a way to waitlist from home. I definitely recommend it. Hubby had a caramel mocha, corned beef hash (large portion) and Joe Bennies. Outstanding. I had a smaller Denver omelette (thank god) because I chose a pancake instead of toast thinking it would be average size. Wow!! It was the size of a plate. We shared but left half behind. It was also very good. 
Service was on point as atmosphere. Definitely a repeat in the future.

We had heard the radio ads about Dom Diego's homemade specialities from the state of Oaxaca. With my wife being born in Mexico, we have been sorely disappointed in many locales in the Boise area. We were hoping that we would finally finally a place that would remind us of our yearly visits to Mexico. This was not the case.  The restaurant is family owned and it shows in a positive way. The decor is simple and stated.  There is a typed paper on the tablet tent that talks about the family's restaurant experience. Nice personal touch.
