Chips, Salsa, and beans were good. Usually this is a good sign especially if my wife doesn't have to add salt to the salsa or ask for hot sauce. We started with Ceviche. It was freshly made but was missing lime juice and the spiciness. It was more like pico de gallo with cucumbers and shrimp. I choose the camarones a la diabla.   A well known spicy shrimp dish.  Prior to ordering, I noticed that a lot of the seafood dishes came with mushrooms. I remarked to my wife that I have had no mushrooms on any of seafood dishes in Mexico.  Hmmmmm.  My wife ordered Gorditas and got Sopes instead burried under big chunks of lettuce.  Sopes are little round harden or fried tortillas. Filled with beans and meat of choice with shredded lettuce and cotija cheese.  Not these. My plate arrived with the shrimp and one mushroom placed on each shrimp.  I think there were seven.  This dish is suppose to have chiles and chipotle flavors.  I tasted more ketchup than anything else.  Was it spicy? It was more like boiled ketchup and hot sauce. Honestly, the mushrooms were out of place.  We look at each other and looked in the dinning room. Not a single Mexicano in sight.  This is Mexican food for those who don't know better. Nothing wrong if you haven't been to Mexico or have a Mexican wife who cooks. But from my perspective I rather eat at home.  The standard that I am accustomed to is simply too high.  Lastly, the service is very friendly. The owner comes of from cooking and table touches.  I am not saying don't go.  All I am saying is it's not for us.

It's been a long time since I ate at Cafe Ole. I was very disappointed with the service. Used to be a great place. My wife and I sat there for 10 minutes before we received chips and salsa...which I had to ask another staff if we had a server. 5 more minutes still no service...no water...and the salsa wasn't as good as I remember.  Good news is there are plenty of good AUTHENTIC Mexican restaurants in the valley.

UPDATE: 7/10/2019

Today I got a burger with American cheese, bacon, and extra onions. I've got to say, I have found my new favorite burger place and that goes for all of US as far as I'm concerned. I don't know what they put in it but it's got me coming back for more.
Just look at the photo and you can see the pickles are perfectly sliced thin, crispy, they're not too thick, the onions are sliced perfect, tomatoes are sliced perfect and all laid out in the right order. The shredded lettuce is just enough to hold it all together and keep things from sliding off. The buns are toasted perfectly. All together every bite was great. I hate when you buy a meal like a burger and every other bite, or only three or four bites, are good. Every bite of this burger was balanced with everything. That's a hard thing to do.
Keep up the good work!

Ok, I do not understand how this place receives 3.5 stars. 
Staff are amazingly friendly and professional. Food is fantastic. Easy in and out. Big diverse menu. Real quality meat. What else could you ask for?
I have hade the classic cheesesteak with extra cheese about 7 times now. Always great. Hot, fresh, packed with yumminess.
I tried the French Dip recently and it's now my absolute fav in Boise area. The AuJus is rich and piping hot. Good flavor, not watered down. 
I will share a "mishap" that happened yesterday though. 
I ordered this sandwich and got something that didn't even look close to what I had last time. Meat was fine, as usual, but the provolone cheese was grated and lumpy. WHAAAAAT?!?! No go. 
I took it up to the counter and explained politely that doesn't even look good. 
They gasped exactly as I did then after apologizing hurriedly remade a new one. They explained why that happened, which usually I don't care about but because I really like this operation I appreciated, then brought me my delicious masterpiece. 
Ok, maybe not masterpiece but it was fabulous. Juicy, cheesy, bread was so soft and lightly toasted it was as if it came out of the oven two mins prior. SO fresh. 
Incredible meal. 
Don't forget to get a frequent buyer card and always ask for your military discount (if applicable). They'll ask for proof so no fakeys or posers. 
Get ther
Enjoy

This place is fantastic!! Amazing workers with wonderful customer service skills, some of the nicest people I have ever met. Jeanette is running a great ship there and the food is amazing! Special thank you to Brock for being kind and patient when taking my order. Will come back!!
The food here is delicious, everything our party of 9 had was enjoyed. Cool trendy environment, lots of options for food and drink

Horrible experience. We went to the new location on eagle road. We waited for 30 minutes before our food came and it was cold and she gave us the wrong order. So if that's not bad enough I told the server that we would not be coming back, I wasn't mean or yelling, I just camly said we won't be back. So a few minutes later one of the managers a female came to our table and looked very angry and pissed off at me. Oh and the last thing she did after she ranted and raved for 5 minutes was slam our check on the table and said I  comped your meal, then she stormed off. I was so embarrassed that I couldn't eat another bite and we just left. Worst restaurant experience ever

Used these guys once and that will be the last ... they came out to take a look at the damage done to my house said some one would contact me in 2 days. I waited a week and had to call my insurance to figure out what was going on, they were surprised that NOTHING was done. They came out did the demolition, set all of my damaged cupboards in my garage and were going to re use the old moldy cabinets to "restore" my kitchen. After they were "done" I was told I would hear back from someone in 3 days... a week and a half went by and I had to call them. I did not get a return phone call until 24hrs later. I told them that I had someone come in and tell me the old cupboards could not be reused and that I needed new ones. I also told them that I was not going to use them for restoration. After that I was told that they were not going to "make a special trip" to my house to clean up the old cabinets they left in my garage. Then I told him well you still have your lockbox on my front door... within 5 minutes someone called me so they could retrieve their property. I was charged for disposal and removal, then when they were made to come out and clean up I was charged again. I would NEVER use or recommend this place to anyone. Throw a dart on a map you'll find someplace better.

I honestly feel the restaurants could be much better for how nice this place is. But wow Boise needed this. Such a cool environment. A lot of stores I would probably never go to. But great fountain. Love that my gym set up a location here. Overall 4/5 stars

My boyfriend and I absolutely love this place! We tend to go every weekend. We usually sit at the bar to eat. Food is always delicious! We know sometimes there can be a wait for a table and food...it's expected for good food. Owners always super friendly!

$5.99 for a kids meal seems expensive to me
Maybe have a more simple less expensive choice without meat

Good service and food was good

Empty room out of three one was closed

Lots of people waiting to be seated when I left

Tuesday 10:45am
The sandwiches are amazing!!!! Turkey bacon swiss one of the best I ever ate. The soup is delicious and plenty of it for the price. One of my new favorite places to eat.

This place is a joke, went in and stood by the door and were not greeted until we said "hi" we were stared at for about 1 minute before they asked how many with attitudes. They asked if we wanted to sit in regular or happy hour ( didn't think the seating section mattered) they also didn't give us the specifics on how sitting in happy hour area is the only one that gets deals on food so we chose regular. Our very nice waiter came by and we asked about happy hour and he told us how we needed to be sitting in the happy hour section and he would go ask if we could change. One of the hosts had her lipstick smeared, sad her other host friends weren't nice enough to tell her...  needless to say will not be going back!

Josh front desk at the Century Link location in Meridian was extremely unhelpful, rude and disrespectful.  When I asked if I could speak to a manager he stated they do not have one in the office, I stated weird.  Josh shook his head and said I can stand here all day with him as he has nothing better to do.   When I asked if I could use his phone, he stated that he could not as he needs to keep up on his work.   I cannot even give it a star.  His other 3 coworkers snickered and did not care.   Unfortunately Josh who would not give me his employee ID as he stated I did not need it, stated he could not help me.

The low marks are just unwarranted.  But it looks like someone does not give anyone a 4 or 5 stars.   I hate to see what you might say about a really bad business.  C'mon first night the place opened and someone talking about strollers.  None of the other restaurants are open yet at the Village, so of course it's packed. The Grand opening focused on kids, and if this only place open of course there going to be kids.    And if not enough veggies, I suggest checking the menu before you sit down.  The food was great. Some of best Calamari I ever had since leaving Monterey California. Pad Thai was great and with the left overs will feed us for two more days.  The rib eye had a great marination that made it melt in your mouth.  C'mon first night they did an awesome job.  And our server checked on us about 25 times, she was excellent.  Looked for manager to let him know, but they were packed and busy.  The comments do not justify the low star marks.
Love this place.  Homemade jam, grilled sausage patties and biscuits are the highlight, but have never had anything bad here for breakfast.

I would like to compliment your employees, Perry, Bill and Derrick for the excellent service they provided me last week. Your Service Desk Team helped me to sort out and decide what maintenance was required and, more importantly, what was not needed that dealers were selling me on my Honda. They fix a part hanging from the bottom of the vehicle which was creating an annoying noise, and cleaned the headlights which made them like new. I have always been pleased with the service I receive at your shop. Hence, Your service group's professionalism and enthusiasm helped me with my car problems and exceeded my expectations. This type of professionalism and commitment to the highest level of customer's satisfaction has to be acknowledged. Having in mind such a pleasant experience with your group it would be my pleasure to continue doing business Christian Brothers and recommend my friends to you shop. I never received this customer service from any auto shop where I came from - California!!

I must say i was impressed with how great the food turned out to be. I had heard great things but after reading a few of the yelp reviews my expectations were some what low. The service was great and my sandwich came out perfect and tasty. Was a little bit more pricy then your typical sandwich shop but overall i give it 4/5

My wife and I hit up Kona Grill at about 5:45pm this past Friday. We were  a little rushed as we had plans to see a movie at 7, but we were seated immediately, and service was prompt. 
We tried the potstickers for a starter and they were alright. A little different than other potstickers I have had, I do not know how exactly to describe it, but maybe a little healthier or fresher seeming. Definitely have to dip in the sauce though, or else they would maybe seem a little dry
Crispy Korean Chicken was tasty, chicken seemed fresh and well cooked. I wasn't really sure what to expect by "korean glaze" but it was kinda like a sweet polynesian sauce or something. The sandwich wasn't super "crispy" due to the nature of the tempura style fry, but it was solid. I will probably give a different entree a go next time. 
The manager swung by at the end of the meal to see how we enjoyed everything and shared a couple of words about how they make their sauces in house. I thought it was a nice touch and appreciated it.
Went for our first time this evening. Awesome friendly staff and owner. Food options for every palate including kids. Try the noodle soup.

Atmosphere was really nice.  Sat in the bar area overlooking the water fountain. Beautiful!

We ordered an appetizer of calamari.  It tasted fresh however it was a little soggy and could have spent more time in the fryer.  For lunch I ordered a chopped salad. The chicken was WAY to salty and then add the bacon on top and the dish was almost inedible.  Need an IV of fluids to rehydrate me now.  Husband ordered the pick two lunch option.  He liked his sushi roll but the oriental salads dressing was a little too sweet and the almonds in the salad were burnt.

Service however was fantastic.  I think we were visited by every waiter and waitress in the place at least once during our meal.  They were very attentive. (Almost too attentive.) The restaurant was really busy but the service was not hindered at all.

Would had loved to give them 4-5 stars for the ambiance and service alone but the food is why we came and it could have been much better for the price we paid.

This place was great!  Great food, great atmosphere with the fountains, truly a fun place to catch up with an old friend!  Potstickers were amazing, calamari was delicious as were the lettuce wraps.  This was my second time here and second home run.  Thank you!

This place was slammed and I was hungry. I sat at the bar, service was slow, food took awhile, and it was really only OK. The bartender was friendly but she had too many other responsibilities that kept pulling her out from behind the bar. At one point the to-go kid had to help make drinks for the tables. Next time Id go to Panera instead.
I have bought all my gear ranging from gloves to drag racing parts from these guys. Definitely a friendly place and awesome customer service!

I do not like to give bad reviews on food as I worked in the fast food industry for years. However I feel like this definitely warrants a review. We went through the drive up and the service was stellar. The young man was extremely friendly and helpful as it was our first time there.I ordered a French dip. It was the worst French dip! There was a good amount of meat on it, however it was slightly overcooked and so salty we could not eat it. The bread seemed fresh and and tasted fine. We did not get to taste the Au jus because it was empty and spilled as it wasn't sealed properly. we also ordered a cheeseburger kids meal. The cheeseburger was so burnt (literally crispy on top and bottom almost all the way through!!! The fries were so salty nobody could eat them. We honestly like salt, so somebody has a very heavy hand with the salt. The cookie that came with the kids meal was decent as well. I am not sure how this business has stayed in business if this is the type of food that is served on a daily basis. Our first and Last experience at this restaurant is quite disappointing. We will not be giving them another chance there was just way too many things wrong with the meal!

Only giving two stars because we love Panda Express in general. But this is the second time I have come to this panda specifically and have had unpleasant experience both times. Both times the wait has been more than 15-20 minutes to be even be helped. This time as well the lady serving was very rude when answering a question and then continued to give half a scoop of the dish while giving the guy in front a scoop and a half. Doesn't seem much until you figure you are spending ten dollars on this meal and they skimp on it. Will save time and drive out of my way to a different panda next time.

A recommended restaurant for breakfast. We were sat quickly on the Monday morning we visited. Overall good service and decent food. For the price I would revisit again especially since they have half orders which are large enough for me. There are so many good breakfast restaurants I visited in Idaho that I can't say this rocks the top of the charts however it is good and I would return.

The food was good and cooked well, this was a surprise since there were a couple of people in the line and things were moving fast. I had expected something to not be cooked well but it still was. This was a pleasant surprise. I will continue coming to this one first. I do enjoy all the other ones, it just seems this one feels better and can move fast.
I completely enjoyed the food and the environment. Great place to enjoy breakfast. A number of great choices for all types of palets.

Have your hungry on for this home cooking experience. They are no secret so call ahead, no reservations ,but call ahead works great. Pancakes are light and ginormous. Red potato is a weakness and they cater to my needs. Perfect eggs and most any syrup including sugar free. Price includes smiles with every service keeping customers for a life-time.

Was not impressed by this place. The crinkle fries were cold when I got them and tasted like Orida frozen fries and I think the grease they used was old. The bread on the Cheesesteak sandwich was delicious, but the meat had not flavor and there was very little cheese on the sandwich. I feel that if "cheesesteaks"  is in the name of the restaurant you should blow people's mind with flavor. Very disappointed and won't be going back.

What a great local park for families with children of all ages. There is a large zero depth water feature with varying degrees of soakage. You can get drenched by splashing buckets or dodge fountains from the ground. The playground provides ample space for the kids to roam and there are a number of picnic areas around. Unfortunately it lacks shade and benches are sparse but there is more than enough room to lay out a blanket and vegetate. 

I especially like how the park has features for older kids. There is a rock climbing are and larger play area for the bigger ones but its far enough from the toddlers so no one gets hurt. All in all its a great park. Bathrooms are clean and plentiful - they alao have a family bathroom on top of mens\womens options... which is handy for changing little kids. 
There is a concession stand that is pricey but considering that the park is free, i would say that it is a fair deal.

We had a great dinner here last night. Husband had the TNT Coulotte which he enjoyed. Steak was cooked perfect - med. rare - mashed potatoes were great, seasonal veggies was mainly all squash on his plate. I had the Pork Osso Bucco which I will order again! Fall off the bone tender pork - generous portion too. Loved the mashed potatoes, my seasonal veggies was mainly green beans. Our one complaint is that we would have liked more sauce. The sauce really sold it for both of us, but there wasn't quite enough. We know how cheap mashed potatoes is, so we feel we got a bit ripped for the size of the sides, but I'm sure most get an appetizer. We had the drunken donuts holes for dessert, WAY TOO SWEET for me, but husband loved them. The vanilla sauce was our favorite. The place was clean, and we had a wonderful waitress. Overall - Twigs served a very nice dinner, keeps a tidy place, and hires friendly staff.

i wish my company would find another company to work with.   every single year its the same run around.  they dont get docs. they need you to send again. email. mail. upload, download.  they respond via message and no follow up.  its a vicious cycle and its exhausting.   

they have  my pretax money and i have a bill to pay.   i can't get a response from them.  their phone hold times are hours and they dont return calls.    its strange they are in business.

as a last resort i have asked my human resources manage to follow up with them on my behalf.
Maddie was single-handedly the most amiable attendant I have ever encountered in any of my car wash visits.

Solid comfort food. I'm not particularly wowed by this kind of Japanese comfort food (that would be for ramen), so while I give it four stars it's not the kind of thing I get super excited about. But giving it three stars seems to be kind of a disservice.

It's readily apparent that Shige is gunning for the Yokozuna Teriyaki crowd. My experiences at Yokozuna (which has a location in Meridian now) were fairly lackluster. So between the two, I found Shige to be the clear winner.

Simple setup, with nearly all dishes comprised of cooked meat over rice, with pictures of all entrees on the wall. You can also get salmon and tuna sashimi over rice as well as yakisoba. At first I thought the bowls seemed a bit small. But one time after ordering two different entrees thinking I would need both to fill myself up, this didn't turn out to be the case. There are also a few sushi rolls, with one being a spicy tuna roll and the other the Sugar Daddy, which is apparently a big hit at his sushi restaurant. It's comprised of tempura shrimp, cream cheese, and lettuce, which as a purist sounds nasty and will be avoided.

The katsu curry was the first thing I tried. The breaded chicken was just OK, but I was surprised by how much I enjoyed the curry. It's too mild for me and has to be spiced up, but it had more depth of flavor than the Japanese curry that I purchase at a store. I was told that the curry is made from scratch there and that they serve it until they run out. The unagidon comes with a generous portion of cooked eel in unagi sauce, and the short ribs come with a mildly sweet sauce that ends up being a lot better when you request jalapenos to be cooked on it. The sweet/spicy juxtaposition on these thin ribs has been the highlight for me here so far. I've also had the gyoza, which is also served over rice. They're pan-fried and not like the deep-fried monstrosities at Yokozuna (Edit: turns out that deep-frying is the default frying method unfortunately. You have to request that they be pan-fried, which is what I recommend.). They're serviceable and provide an adequate enough fix, but I've still yet to have above average gyoza in the valley.

Entrees will generally run you in the $7- $8 range. So while it's solid foreign comfort food, it's not super cheap solid foreign comfort food that places like Tango's or Baguette Deli provide. Add a soda or a side and you're over $10 easily. Going there for lunch often could add up quickly.

Gripes: my cup of miso soup tasted watered-down. It was bland generic stuff, and I recommend saving your $1.50 and avoiding it. And if you don't use chopsticks, you're left to use these tiny flimsy plastic forks that look more apropos for use by children. Hopefully they correct this and get bigger stronger plastic forks. I also wish the cups they use for their boba tea were a bit bigger. But perhaps I'm being spoiled by the size of the cups at Baguette Deli, which still provides the best value in town for it.

I would say to head here on Mondays, as Shige himself helps cook the food. Based on what the lady there told me, it sounds like that this will not just be a temporary occurrence. And I became intrigued when told that there's a possibility of ramen being served when the weather becomes cold. But I would hope that Shige brings in a ramen expert from somewhere and that attention and detail was paid towards it like a real ramen-ya would. Otherwise we'll be left with average stuff that Sono Bana already gives us (which is still the only place in town that makes real bowls of ramen). I found out that Shige raves about the same ramen-ya in Los Angeles that I do, so there is some hope here to provide high quality provided he does add ramen to the menu. 

UPDATE Feb. 2012: Shige unfortunately never offered ramen. Too bad because good ramen would've made me a once-a-week regular instead of being the once-every-two-to-three-months patron I'm tending to be here. 

2nd UPDATE March 2012: With the opening of Shige Express next door, there's no guarantee now that Shige will be cooking the food here on Mondays. I was told that he shuttles back and forth between the two places based on where he's needed more, and I figure there's more ongoing traffic at Express to believe that that's where he hangs out more. He didn't make my food the last time I was there. My main course was fine, but there was a discernible difference in the quality of my pan-fried gyoza. I'm just guessing here, but if you really want Shige to prepare your food I'd say your odds are the best if you head there during the time Express is closed between lunch and dinner (like 2:30-5:30).

I was excited to see this was an option on grubhub, this hawaiian is always looking for good food from home. Got a plate with pork adobo, Korean chicken, and kalbi for me and a side of chicken katsu for my daughter. I was expecting vinegar based adobo and they make it shoyu based, not a huge deal except the sauce was so over reduced and overpowering it was unpleasant. Kalbi tasted good but was burnt (I expect some char on kalbi but this was BURNT) in places and had very little meat on it. Also, there was no sauce for the katsu, a first for me! The mac salad was the best thing on the plate. So dissappointed

We love coming to twigs for a good upscale dinner and date night.  Ambiance is warm and inviting, can be romantic if you add a bottle of wine.  We can go on a date night here and not break the bank. 

I get either the pesto chicken or the twigs filet, my husband loves the pork osso bucco.  It's cooked and seasoned perfectly every time.  We don't usually get an appetizer because with dinner it's more than we can eat.  Portions are pretty big so when available order the half instead of the full.  Also, I like getting a glass of wine or a cheaper bottle of wine.  Every thing we like to order is consistently good so we keep coming back.   Customer service is consistently excellent so we keep coming back.  

Overall, excellent choice for dinner.  Excellent choice for a working lunch.  Professional and friendly staff.

Their menu is impressive and I am sure many of the items are delicious, however, my experience today was not so. I ordered an a la carte omelette, side of link sausages and a biscuit. There was no cheese inside the omelette. As you can see in the picture all of the cheese was placed atop and it proceeded to ooze down.  So nothing was holding the omelette ingredients together. Very messy and dry on the inside.  The link sausages were over cooked and cold when they got to me. The biscuit and service was excellent. Overall not a great experience this morning.

Best sandwiches ever! The bread is AMAZING and everything is so fresh and delicious. The staff is so awesome and so kind! They remember your name even after you order and make you feel at home. I'd eat here everyday if I could.

Just finished a delicious breakfast, Denver omelet with hash browns and a homemade biscuit. Everything was fresh and noteworthy. The omelet was packed with  fillings and light and fluffy. The biscuit was served with Marion berry jam, warm and light as air. The hash browns stole the show, they were cooked to perfection and not greasy. Best in town!  Coffee was rich and flavorful. 
This isn't your normal greasy spoon breakfast eatery, it's open, bright and quiet. We had no wait time and breakfast arrived quickly. Will be back!
Service was delayed. Toast forgotten and cold when served. Service lacking and unapologetic which reflected in the tip. Only our second visit and sorely disappointed

I returned to Cafe Ole just to give it another shot. I really do hate leaving bad reviews, but what I hate even more is restaurants that serve sub standard food and people that have to suffer for it.

So I returned to Cafe Ole one last time. A bit like the OK coral. I came in, like the Earp's and Doc Holiday, not wanting a fight, but prepared with my guns at-the-ready just in case.

Well, I am glad I was prepared. The food was bland, and had no heat to it at all. I would say it was like Tex Mex, but that is being too kind. The food here is like Tex Mex's long lost red headed step child's brother. It is no where even close to a relation of decent Mexican food.

The best part of my meal was that the atmosphere has improved, the place looks clean, and the menus are new and clean. This is the highlight of my review.

The chips and salsa was terrible. The chips tasted like they had been fried in oil that was 2 years old. The salsa tasted like it had been watered down. And not even a little watered down, but way on-downtown watered down.

I ordered the fajita chicken street tacos. It had very little meat in it, way too many veggies, and no flavor. It came with a very weird sauce on the side that tasted like a BBQ sauce that had gone bad. I never knew BBQ sauce could go bad till now. The worst part was the the taco tasted of the same rancid oil that the chips had been fried in.

They have a salsa bar that is tucked way back in the corner of the bar area. I had to ask several people before I finally found it. They had 1 salsa that was marked as spicy and hot. It was neither spicy, hot, or flavorful.

I also had a Chimichanga with ground beef. Oh my! It was so bad that I dont know where to start. I have had better chimis from the frozen section of Wal-Mart. 

There are many other Mexican food places here in the Meridian-Boise area to choose from. Dont waste your time or money here.

We had to go in again today as our dog tore a ligament in his leg and once again, they did not disappoint. The staff was great and Dr. Lake was awesome. It amazes me to read all the negative reviews based solely on them being late. Come on folks, it's essentially an ER. They are going to run late. If it was your pet experiencing an emergency would you want them to take you in order of arrival or in order of need?
Thanks folks!!

Service and environment was good. We enjoyed our family dinner here. Two of us got the Sea Bass since other people told us it is amazing. Midway through the meal we both agreed that with each bit of the fish tasted very buttery and delicious, but had a kind of unpleasant after taste. I would personally not order the Sea Bass again due to the taste. The Pad Thai and the Filet ordered by our family members were perfect and had no problems. If I go again I will probably order the filet.  It looked really good.

My overall experience was pleasant. The service was warm and attentive, both from the hostess and my server, Kyle who took the time to discuss the menu with me. I got two sushi rolls. The coconut shrimp roll was very tasty and had a great mix of textures. The 2-piece sweet shrimp left much to be desired though. They served two pieces of shrimp with absolutely no seasoning or sauce. what makes the shrimp sweet, I ask? There were two fried shrimp heads on the plate that were virtually only the brains. Was that what they intended the flavor to be? A misstep on the menu for sure. Kyle said the last person who got that sent it back. I probably should've done the same. Overall, a good experience though. I would come back and try some of the popular rolls.

My kids love this place. They spent 2 1/2 hours and easily could have spent more going from station to station. Lots of "Mom, look! Mom, watch this!" We always look for children's museums when we travel, so it's nice to have one close by. The veterinarian and pizza-making places were their favorite.

As a mom, I'd love to be able to bring my own coffee in (or for them to sell concessions), but hopefully in time those will be things they can add on.

When building you have to expect the unexpected. Everyone we worked with were always professional and friendly. And answered/ resolved every question and concern we had, some quicker than others and in the end everything was taken care of. Kayla & Ami are amazing! Tina & Lisa with the Design Center were super helpful. We absolutely love our shiny new awesome home! Cheers to making new memories with our family! Thank you!
The best pancakes. I believe they add corn meal to the batter. The Cuban sandwich was (for Idaho) surprisingly good!!!

Absolutely the worst McDonald's. In the past two weeks they have ruined my order every time. Ive asked for no sugar in my ice latte and ice coffee and each time they put sugar. I simply have to throw these drinks in the trash bc I can't have sugar. Check your order before you leave the drive through line.

They also put so much ice that once I couldn't even put my straw in the cup.

One of the best Breakfast eateries in the valley. Food is top notch and the service is friendly as well. I love the chicken fried steak, it's a real steak not a frozen patty with gravy. Their house potatoes are awesome as well. Also like getting their tri tip scramble. Get there early as there is almost always a wait but it's worth it!

Oh boy. I have not been looking forward to this piz. Went here once and got a pizza that was pretty sour. I forget which pizza I ordered; maybe I got the thin crust poo-poo? That would explain a lot. Anyway, this time around was much better.

Smoky Mountain is a family-friendly, local chain that started in Ketchum and has expanded all the way to Utah. We got a medium with half pepperoni, half Smokehouse. Came out to roughly $20 and took 15 mins to make.

-Pepperoni-
This was a pretty good pizza! Reminded me of the pepperoni we got at West Side. A classic style that you would get at most american/non-NY pizza places. Nothing special, good amount of sauce. Good cheese with the brown spots here and there that make it tasty.

-Smokehouse-
This one had gouda, tomatoes, caramelized onions, and Italian sausage. PizzaTom pointed out that the onions were not caramelized; they were cooked but still purple. Some onions were even burnt by the oven. This za was really not that interesting. It wasn't bad but it didn't taste great either. The cooked onions lessened the experienced, and the other toppings did little to enhance. Strongest was the Italian sausage which had a good flavor.

-Verdict-
I think Smoky has a problem with their topping pizzas because the pepperoni was good. Was definitely better than I thought going in, so good job! I recommend this place to people who have gone there before, but ordered a poopoo pizza, and need to review their pepperoni, and want to be pleasantly surprised.

3 slices out of 5

Food was okay, wait was longer than expected considering we were the only customers, milk tea was chalky. My husband got a bowl of some sort that he enjoyed. I ordered a sandwich and garlic fries. Fries were good, sandwich was off. I was super excited to try the waffle pressed bread but it was dry and tasteless. I ordered a strawberry milk boba tea and when I received it there wasn't any boba. When I asked about it the girl told me they were out of boba so she gave me a regular. I only got a drink to have the boba so that would have been nice to know when ordering. They also use a powder flavoring so the drink was chalky. The place definitely smelled of oil and the only restroom is through the kitchen.
Definitely brings back memories of traveling in eastern Europe. The beef sausages and burek that I ate were both very good. The place is clean and service was good.
Very nice place. Room was great, comfortable bed. Lindsay at the front desk provided excellent customer service!

When settings an appointment I was told I would be getting an inspection that included such and such. (Of course, over the phone and before you make the appointment they are more than happy to give you false information). I was told my Inspection included a steam power wash to rid some oil. Apparently that wasn't the case. Never less at the end of it all. When I walked in, they took 10-15 minutes Just to find my paper work. Not including the time it took to pay and sign for it. I was told to go wait outside while they find it. I was in need of a tool for my car outside and asked several people in the front if they could help me out. That apparently is against they're bible or system becuz none of them helped me out. Except for a tech that came out of the bathroom. (Which btw provided more customer service and satisfaction then ANYONE in the front desk. And there was a couple of guys up there too.

That alone had left a sour taste in my mouth to not come back again, yeah I will tell people about meridian automotive, and how horrible they are, so they won't make the same mistake i did. Thanks, was a fan, stood by it and now it's gone down hill. At this point I would recommend anyone other than this place.

I love this vet and will always take my dogs there! Rescued a sharpie 2 years ago and they have helped us get our dog in a better health state. Unfortunately that meant pulling teeth but my dog is happy and healthier thanks to them. I also had them do her Entropion surgery for her eye and I was so happy to see how well it was done and how much that surgery helped my baby.. They are always genuine and definitely don't push you to do anything but give you the best advice ever! We have gone in a few times with a couple issues without an appointment and they have made time to take a look at my dog. I will continue to go there!!

Had the Joe Benny(eggs Benedict). Pretty darn good but those enormous pancakes are awesome. 1 pancake is more than enough for 1 person. I was quite skeptical when they moved from Eagle but they must have brought there cooks because there food is still grubbing! Waitress was sweet and fast. I'll be returning

HANDS DOWN best sandwiches in Boise!! Meridian location is my personal favorite! So sad they're only open for a short period of time, but something about that makes the food that much more satisfying! Favorite lunch treat since I was in high school!

We have always been impressed with the food, service, atmosphere, and coffee at Joe Momma's. Sometimes the wait and servers are slow but it's usually pretty worth it and they are always sincere about the apologies. (And let's be honest... We are asking people to be our servants for an hour... We can be patient to a large extent.)

I like the veggie omelet with bacon!

We LOVE Kona Grill, it has become one of our first choices for date night. Great atmosphere, yummy food, great service. Manager Brad is the best! We go to visit with him. GET THE CARROT CAKE. Just do it. Also love the sushi, the tomato bisque.. Honestly everything we have tried is good.

Went in around 11pm. It was rather busy! We got seated quickly by a really nice lady. Then we had to wait around 15 minutes to order. A different girl came to take our order.  We ordered pork nachos and a club sandwich with a salad. The nachos had about 10 pieces of cheese that wasn't even melted. The pork was all burned to the point it had no taste and there was about 5 pieces of tomato. No onion as the menu stated it came with. Basically just a pile of chips and sour cream. The sandwich had no condiments. 1 piece of lettuce that was smaller than the bread. One slice of tomato, no avocado (chicken avacado club) and the bread was completely falling apart. We grabbed the attention of the gal who initially sat us and she had the sandwich remade. The second one still had no avacado, or condiments. We gave up at that point. The girl who took our order was no where to be found. We paid the check and left the tip with the 1st gal who at least tried to make an effort. For an establishment that is always advertising 24 hours i would expect at least semi attentive staff.

St Luke's Meridian Obstetrics & Gynecology Department was awful. The girl at the desk was so rude to me because I had questions about charges and she dismissed the conversation that we were having because she didn't want to talk to me and said she had an important call to make. I'm a very reasonable person and was in utter shock that someone could be treated so poorly. I'm glad that this was an establishing visit because I've chosen to go with another healthcare provider. There is no way I will go back to that office and it's put a distaste in my mouth for that hospital chain all together. My first visit and ultrasound with a doctor there was over $1,000.

Everything about this place is phenomenal but the strawberry milk tea with boba and the pho (both kinds!) are my favorite. So flavorful!! We have been back many many times since discovering this place and will continue to frequent it. Thanks for the great options, Hungry Horse!

We went here for breakfast last Saturday and it was pretty good. The food was fine but the service was lackluster. We ordered the classic breakfast with fried eggs, bacon, hashbrowns and wheat toast, breakfast burrito and kitchen sink omelette. The classic breakfast was solid and I loved their bacon because it is thick and not to crispy. The breakfast burrito was pretty good but a little bland and would be better with a sauce over the top or more stuff in the burrito. The kitchen sink omelet was very good and it came with a side of biscuit and gravy. However, the service was HORRIBLE! We waited 30 mins for table which was fine for a Saturday morning. The issues came when we were seated because it took a while to get our drinks and place our ordered. After placing our orders it took fifty mins to get our food. When our waitress dropped off our food she never said sorry or apologized for the wait!! Also, we had burnt toast and she forgot a side of bacon. I doubt we will be coming back since there are a lot of great breakfast places in Boise that have much better food and service. But will try to give this place one more try since people seem to like it. I almost gave JM 2 stars but gave it 3 for their bacon.

This place is a great place to take up some target shooting. It's a fair price for the high level service and convenience this facility provides. I love going here to blow off a bit of steam. They have some great classes and annual membership benefits too.

I love the Meridian club. The new ownership is really trying. When I complained about the room being so hot (and others did too), they make sure now that the room is cool for us. They have added equipment and repaired the broken equipment, and the new classes are amazing.
Great interactive place for kids of all ages.  Immersive experiences, from Dino dig to space ship to vet to fishing.  You can even milk a cow! Great afternoon!

This place is awesome! We had a large party and they put us where we could all chat away. The white pizza is incredible and you can get practically anything gluten-free! Talia was our server and she is the BOMB! She is sweet,personable and everyone had a great time because her attentive service was so spot on. I think that for a group of 10 people it truly doesn't get any better than this!

I have heard great things about this place for a long time. It's always very busy. Finally got in there and have a an extremely disappointing visit. Food is just too expensive for that kind of presentation and service. Had to ask three times for the coleslaw instead of fries. Had to send back fish tacos that were rated 1 at Best.  Ham and turkey on salad was lunch meat. Bathrooms were dirty with toilet paper all over. I'm really not sure what has happened here but their span of control seems to be lacking. Will not go back and cannot recommend..

I have enjoyed Kanak Attacks food truck for years! Now we have access to their amazing food in their restaurant. 
When you enter the place, you will be greeted with a ton of Hawaiian flare. The place is roomy and clean that is very comfortable. The employees are super friendly and will greet you with a hardy Aloha!
I ordered the 1 meat plate. The restaurant has a couple of special fried rice dishes to try. On this day I went with the Pineapple spam fried rice........will be on every menu in town soon. The sound of this was not great, but I figured why not and I am happy I did. Get out here and try something different and tasty. For the meat I went with the Kalua pig. I have heard this a million times on their truck. Very flavorful and moist. The last component for the plate is a salad. I think they have like 5 or 6 different options and I selected the Asian slaw. The slaw was crunchy and sweet. 
The one thing that I did not like and will take some getting used too was their choice to use wood utensils (might be bamboo). The texture and taste of wood in the mouth was not my favorite and changed the flavor of the food for me. I will need to get used to it. 
I highly recommend this place for anybody looking for great Hawaiian food. 
Cheers Always!

My wife and I have been to Kona Grill multiple times. The atmosphere is great, but the service never fails to disappoint. No matter how slow they are you can always count on terrible service. In fact after you order you likely won't see your waiter again for the duration of your meal. On the few occasions we've been there I've had my water refilled ONCE. With the exception of happy hour appetizers, the food is extremely overpriced and low quality. The only reason I've ever returned is for the fun village atmosphere and cheap happy hour sushi.

Well where do I start. They estimated us wrong, removed the insurance off my phone without informing me, then told me I could not have insurance cause my phone is paid off which in actuality, a day later, I found out that is a flat out lie. THEN, they gave me the wrong monthly prices for phones(I know because I headed to a different T-Mobile store where they actually seemed like they knew what they were doing). The manager here is condescending and doesn't care about what the customer says. 10/10 would never go to again. Ever. 

Literally was lied to, cheated, and they only wanted the sale with no respect to the customer. I've worked in customer service for 3 years and sales. This isn't how you do business.
Overall good food! I loved the pork/veggie stir fry! The Kahlua Pork was very salty and the corn salad didn't have great flavor.

I went here Monday 2/3/14  for a late lunch (around 3 PM), and having looked at other reviews, I didn't go in with super high expectations... glad I didn't.

If you don't feel like reading the details of my review, let me cut straight to the chase. While my experience wasn't entirely negative, save yourself the trouble and go somewhere else.

First impression: Don't come here for the atmosphere.

Second impression: Though the entire building (strip mall exterior and restaurant interior) were very outdated and a little worse for wear, at least this establishment has very, very clean bathrooms.

Highlights of my visit: My water cup was never empty, and was surprised by the over-sized fresh spring rolls. Also, I learned a thing or two watching Dr. Oz on the television while eating my meal.

Lowlights of my visit: Never expected that warm shrimp in a spring roll that's supposed to be entirely cold, and I was highly disappointed with the pho.

In fact, I came here mainly because I craved a bowl of pho, and Vina happened to be on my way back home. This is really the worst bowl of pho, I've ever had. The beef tasted like it had been previously frozen, even a bit of freezer burn aftertaste. By the time I neared the bottom of the bowl, the broth began to taste like dirty dishwater. And while I truly don't know what dirty dishwater tastes like, that's the first thing that came to my mind. Needless to say, as soon as that thought did come to my mind, I abandon the idea of finishing my soup. Normally, I clean it to the bowl to the bare bottom... not so this time.

Overall, this was also one of those times that I went to check out a restaurant prior to taking my wife there on a date. She loves pho as much as I do, so the good that came of this was her NOT having to experience what I did.

We ate here on a Friday evening. We sat in the bar area and the weather was nice. They have doors that open up and it creates a great outdoor environment without being outside. The waitress was great, she always made sure we were being taken care of. We ate the Polynesian pizza. It was excellent. We will be back.
Ate here for the first time today. It was delicious! And if you're a tea drinker, I definitely recommend trying here. So many options. And the staff was super nice!

We were excited when this place was going to open as its near our home, now its a complete disappointment and we won't be back.  Ordered 1 deep dish pizza, a house salad and two beers. Weird that you have to walk around to the bar to order your beers.  No salad came within 30 minutes, they forgot it and we had to go get it. No forks or napkins came with the salad, wrong dressing, and it was poorly prepared, lots of big chunks, and of course no knives.  It took and hour and 10 minutes to get the pizza, and when it finally arrived we got attitude from the staff saying "we've been busy with take out".  How about serving the patrons that are in your restaurant?  Frankly if you can't manage take out and in store service at 6pm on a Friday night then you don't deserve to be in the pizza business. Your prices are ridiculous for what is served. And like many other reviewers, your Chicago deep dish is not true deep dish. It's a regular pizza with a thicker outer crust, that was baked to long and not manageable without a knife. To the owners, you may be able to get away with poor service and poor food quality in the big city, but not here.

The place is clean and the customer service is on point. The kid who took my order had to be like 15 but he was articulate, polite, and clean cut....well done for his parents lol. A young lady in the back running around keeping people moving looked like she took good care of the place.
I'll definitely be back.

A deceiving restaurant with a nice and comfortable atmosphere but nothing flashy or standout in terms of food or drinks here. I don't prefer the Village but coming here for a birthday party was our 4th or 5th option, I would recommend looking elsewhere for a fancier spot to eat and drink.

So, I am conflicted between 3 and 4 stars so, I am I am going to have to go on the low end because of my experience and give them a try another time. 

We showed up at 11am on a Saturday with a party of 7. We were ready to wait because we know better than to roll out that deep at that time on a weekend. We were checked in about 11:10am and I had given the Hostess my phone number for a text when they were about ready to seat us. We all found a seat in the waiting area directly in front of the Hostess. We were talking and whatnot for about 35-40 minutes. All the while there were 2 Hostess calling out peoples names to seat them. I get a text message saying they were just about ready to seat us so, we gathered ourselves up and waited for our name to be called. 15 minutes pass and no name call. I follow the link that was texted to me and our name was no longer on the list. I go the the Hostess and ask "I got a text a few minutes ago and am just checking on that?" The older Hostess states "You were supposed to come up here. Just one minute." They work on getting a table cleared. It's now about 12:15ish. Cool, no big deal we were in zero rush. 

We sit down and order drinks and start looking at the menu. Me, being the only one from out of town was really the only one that didn't know what I wanted. It was about 12:30 by the time we ordered. Food starts coming out in waves by 12:50. 

Portion size was nice and large. I got a pancake side and the pancake was dense, it felt really hearty. I enjoyed it. The house potatoes were just a tad lacking in flavor. Good not great. Prices are fantastic for the quantity of food you get. Finally handed my card off to pay 1:45sh

Overall I want to say that it wasn't really impressive because of the time it took but the food was decent and prices are good.
The restaurant was clean. That's the only good thing I can say about it. The food was bland and extremely dry. Never again.

Great food. However, the customer service is always very spotty. We've had great service. Today was not our lucky day. Our server never checked on us to refill drinks or even ask if we needed anything else. This place sure seems like they choose to hire the "cute" staff over experienced servers.
Love their food!!  I would give them 5 stars if they held true to the hours they list on the door.  It will show their open until 8pm, and some days we get their at 7:30 and their closed.  ‍

To start, the atmosphere is classy, in keeping with the surrounding area, and it is a great place for ladies night or date night provided there isn't live music going on at The Village (it can be a bit noisy for pleasant conversation).

I was not overly impressed with the service - I have usually had to wait some time for a table even though the place was mostly empty and the server is frequently slow to refill waters, etc. They do bring the food promptly, though.

That said, the food is satisfactory (possibly slightly overpriced). The drinks are fantastic, always and happy hour begins at 9pm for select drinks.
This place is awesome 5 stars hands down ill be returning as well as my brother .... may ever buy a gun from them hell you never know !  Awesome staff very friendly you guys rock !!!!!

The customer service was great; however, the actual pedicure was below average. My polish was really thick on some toe nails and thin on others. Within the day I had chipping on 2 toes. My pedicures usually last atleast 1 month and because of the paint being applied so poorly I felt I had wasted my money. 
Since the people were friendly I am rating this a 3.
Express Wireless is a bunch of crooks. You can get better service at a lower price with Sprint, Verizon, ATT or even Cricket. Dont spend your money with Express Wireless-Tmobile.
Great restaurant and the owners are awesome! They really know how to make a good Monte Cristo
Good place good food but dad they moved from their original spot. More room just created more wait..

Our dog sadly passed over a holiday weekend where we couldn't get in to our regular vet for cremation for a couple of days. All Valley was open and helped greatly with the paperwork. They were so sweet and comforted us during this painful time, both dropping off our dog and picking up the ashes. Their cremation options were very reasonably priced, even cheaper than our vet's. We got a very nice urn that we plan on burying once it warms up. On top of that, All Valley sent us a lovely card that the staff signed with their sympathies. It was a very nice touch and so sweet after losing our beloved family member. Thank you All Valley!

I went to French Nails Salon for a gel manicure. They did a decent job, though a few days later I'm noticing some bubbling. I was disappointed in the misleading advertising. I went there because I saw a sign stating $15 gel polish, but it just meant color change. I wouldn't go out of my way to go there again.

This is one of the best massage services I have ever received. The business environment is very clean and quiet, and my body and mind have been very well relaxed. The technician's technique was very good and relieved my shoulder and neck pain. A good night's sleep today. It feels really good. Thank you technician MAGGIE. We will visit you next time. We must introduce our friends!

Came in here after some shopping in the plaza! This place is huge, very open seating, socially distant and overall aesthetically pleasing! We got the hummus platter and it was delicious! Came with feta lots of veggie and delicious pita! I would come back!
Had a much better experience than I ever had at Norco. Therapist did a good job actually fitting and explaining the gear.
Great Saturday morning breakfast. Usual good stuff in abundance. No sweet rolls however. Very attentive staff. Good coffee. Worth the visit. Get there early. The word is out.

Looking for something completely different and this place doesn't disappoint!  Genius idea with the pastry and waffle iron!  If I lived in Boise I would make this a regular place to eat...checks all the boxes for me!  Good food, good price, great people!!!

For Boise, this breakfast restaurant is good as it gets.  The food is always good.  Since it is weighted on the heavy side we always split a breakfast.  It comes served on two plates with no extra cost and no whining by staff.   Another indicator of quality is good tasting coffee -  that is a primary consideration.  Secondly, house potatoes are fresh cut potatoes.  The sausage is flavorful with little fat.  The staff have all been there a while and are genuinely friendly.   You can't beat Jo Momma's in the Boise area for breakfast.
Best pulled pork sandwich ever. Love their sauce and the rolls it comes on. Their catering service is awesome. I used them for a wedding and baby shower.

I was hoping for more high end stores at least for men when we moved from Seattle as it looked like this new shopping was going to be special.  It's really nothing more than nice restaurants and stores I've never heard of or would go shopping there plus, not a single anchor store.  It might just be demographics and not a huge demand for high end stores in Boise which I get.

I like the design better at Bridgeport, Tualatin Or, The Domain , Austin Tx. and Redmond Town Center, Redmond Wa.   Those locations have a more open air feel plus they all have parking structures instead of a stadium parking look.

I was going to another carwash until they opened the Epic Shine near my house.  At first it was just out of convenience, but WOW! This is the best drive-thru carwash I've experienced yet.  It not only gives my car the best wash ever, but it does the tires, rims included, to shiny perfection.

I love that they have small hand towels available to use (since I always seem to forget to bring mine).  The staff is always super friendly and paying the $25/month is so worth it.  It's so convenient to just pull in on my way home from work and at that price, I sometimes wash my car 2x a week, especially in the winter.

I HIGHLY recommend this and consider it the best here in the Treasure Valley.

Really? A pedicure done by a gal whose own nails are 2" long?  I should have left then and there as it got worse. After she put lotion on my feet, she started to polish them. I asked if she was going to prep the nail (she had no intention of using a base coat) and I said no, you need to get the lotion off the nail with alcohol. When finished, I asked if she was going to put on a top coat and she said no. Overpriced ($40!) and the entire atmosphere is very unprofessional.

I had read the yelp reviews before booking. I wish I had listened to them more because they were all spot on. For the price it's good. But they really don't  deep clean. Couch has obvious dust. There were surface stains and smudges everywhere. Walls had hand and grease prints. Room smelled. White stain on bed skirt...didn't get into the hot tub but saw that it did look sketchy like other reviews had said. Breakfast is whatever but free. I was looking for an outlet to plug my phone in and it looked like they had not vacuumed behind the nightstand in years. Heater was noisy. It would rattle loudly randomly. Staff was nice

This place is a freaking hidden gem!
This place uses croissant/super flakey pastry type dough for their sandwiches and it's amazing. Got the tri-tip sandwich along with a Smoked brisket noodle soup (very much like Pho), and it was all amazing. I can't believe I didn't find this place sooner. The Thai tea was some of the best I've had out here as well. 

I still can't get past how awesome the sandwiches are and I love that it's not actually waffle batter. Definitely coming back here as often as I can.

Everything was amazing.

Service was excellent,  had papa joes trash taters was really good the Ham was fresh. Also had a mocha was made really well. Have been here a few times and it has always made me happy. You get what you pay for.

Hungry Horse Eatery has the best pho in town. And that is not the highlight of the menu for me.

The sandwiches are spot-on. Nothing complicated,  just meat (or a three-cheese blend), cheese, and mixed greens in a ranch sauce, but the bread is absolutely amazing! It's a flaky croissant-like waffle that is a nice touch.

It's small, so expect a little bit of a wait, but the quality of the food and more-than-reasonable prices make the wait more than worth it.

I have been going here for years. The welcoming environment and completely professional and kind staff keep me coming back again and again. I highly recommend this great spa to anyone interested in an excellent therapeutic massage.

We are visiting from out of state went in there to see if he could fix my glasses the temple was loose... Besides being small and crowded people behind the counter didn't look like they cared about their job I walked out before I could even get help I figured I'd go to a bigger business .

I prefer this location over the Nampa location. More equipment and more areas to workout. Both tanning beds are always available when I want to tan. Could use more leg machines for hamstrings. I will be sure not to go after 9 am on Friday since they block off part of the gym for a group class ( they have a group fitness room, but another class was going on). That was annoying.

Flies are all over the eating area. The teenagers behind the cash register do not greet you and ask if they can help they just stare at you and wait for you to order.. The workers in the kitchen are so loud that they detract from being able to eat in the eating area - very disappointing. The food is decent but I have problems with the way the way the workers behave. How about some training.
Really great pizza and garlic bread and a very attentive server. Nice seating on the patio too, not in the sun. It was a really good experience we'll be back for sure.

This little restaurant is tucked away in a small shopping strip located where Fairview becomes Cherry Lane in Meridian.  The place looks like many barbecue "shacks" that you'd find in the South except that the owner and chef is a guy who grew up in Idaho and just developed a passion for creating smoked meats!  There is corrugated aluminum siding on the walls, numerous old license plates and very funny posters.  My favorite:  Vegetarians--seasoned right they taste delicious!  Walking in the aromas are mouth watering----the smell of a smoker going just really whets the appetite!

Our favorite meat here is pulled pork---it's tender, tasty, and the extra sauces provided are up to the diner to use.  I really like the Carolina sauce which is vinegar based and really brings out the smoky pork taste.   Yesterday, we opted for the one meat sandwich---my husband had pulled pork and I tried the smoked turkey.  The turkey was very moist, thickly sliced, and really needed no extra topping to make it taste delicious.  There was mayonnaise, tomato, and lettuce on the bun which was perfect!   I chose coleslaw as my side and it was tangy, tasty, and lightly dressed.

For dessert, we shared bread pudding topped with a caramel sauce.  It tasted like cinnamon rolls that were incorporated into the custard mix and baked.  The server told us that it was made the traditional way with bread.  Either way, it was moist with the egg custard taste, lots of cinnamon, and the topping really made the dish.  The portion is huge so I recommend sharing, although I was tempted to scarf down the whole thing by myself.

There were several tables of folks having lunch so there is a faithful clientele as most of them knew what they liked and what to order.  The prices are very reasonable and the service is very personal.  I also noticed that smoked Thanksgiving Turkeys are available, which might be a good choice for those that would like to enjoy the holiday without spending time slaving over a turkey and stuffing!  Just a thought!

Generally great food. Been a fan of the Meridian location and food truck for quite some time now. All of the BBQ options are great and their smoked wings hold a special place in my heart. Dragged my wife (who isn't a fan of BBQ) in for my birthday this weekend and was genuinely excited to share this special place with her and the kids. I sold her and my son on the lineup of burgers and none of us were impressed. Just a notch below what we were expecting, but whatever, it's a BBQ joint. 

The real turnoff though, was that we wanted to order just a kids grilled cheese a la carte for my toddler and were told by the waitress that it had to be ordered in a kid's meal. I understand that this may technically be a "special order", but this little thing, over a couple bucks, rubbed me the wrong way. I've always viewed Big Daddy's as a neighborhood-style restaurant, but the fact that it's against policy to sell a kids grilled cheese for $3-4 is a bit of a bummer. 

Again, great BBQ, but some things left to be desired.

I travel a good bit throughout the year and stay at a lot of hotels. My standards are pretty high and I'm happy to report that this La Quinta exceeds my expectations. I have no complaints! Cleanliness is number 1 on my must-have list and I have found everything to be remarkably clean! They allow dogs, very important. You'd never know it though because there is no tell-tale odors, stains or hair left behind.

They offer a continental breakfast which is nothing fancy but more than enough.

Safety is another big factor. The parking lot and surrounding area are well lite and I feel pretty safe out walking my dog.

All in all this has been one of the best hotel experiences ever! I highly recommend it.

Update 05/13/13: We checked out this morning :( 
I just want to say again that this La Qunita is the nicest place hotel/motel I've ever been to. It's perfect!

They were able to get me in right away and were very friendly. 
I got a gel manicure and a regular pedicure and I appreciate they had two technicians available so I could have them done at the same time. 

They did not have the matching gel and regular polish options which is a bummer so I had to do the best match.

Been to Kona Grill 4 times and my 5th is most memorable in a sea of unremarkable (past 4 outings to Kona) visits.  Sadly it was such a let down, cuz the atmosphere, staff & location are pretty great but the prices and food need serious improvement. I ordered Pad Thai (Chicken), potatickers (chicken), and a side salad.  Now I would swear to you, with my hand on a bible that the potsticker were made with ground beef (NO JOKE)!  The salad looked quite appetizing, good portion size and brightly colored veggies and crumbled blue cheese. The house vinegrette was the dressing:  it was the color and texture of applesauce and tasted like what I imagine rancid oil mixed with a dirty ashtray would taste like.  Lastly, was the entree, which smelled great but my enthusiasm and dropping heart stopped there.  The noodles were under cooked, not aldente, but hard.  The chicken looked pan seared bit tasted microwaved.  There were WAY too many peanuts. Possibly the abundance of nuts was to hide the lack of bean sprouts or veggies. I think this is past my limit on chances to get it right.  I would have sent the meal back, but it was deliver by UberEats, which was the ONLY positive I could give Kona.  They chose a good, fair priced and quick to deliver delivery service. Sadly, that's where the enjoyment and this review ENDS... God luck & Happy Eats!

Went into Kona today must say it was very interesting. The sushi was delicious and fresh. There was an incident where one of the waitresses spilled wine on my hair and jacket. honestly, I couldn't get mad she seemed sincerely apologetic. She apologized up until I left. Also, one of the managers, Glenn, offered to pay for my dry cleaning, comped my meal and made me a whole new order even though I had 1 roll left! Over all it was a good meal and Great service I will definitely go back.

I have been a member here on and off for the better part of 20 years. When I heard about the purchase by Crunch and that they had plans for renovations I was excited because this location is in serious need of some TLC. 
My daughter and I  don't use the facility to its fullest potential we just go work on the cardio machines. We were in the gym 4-5 mornings a week while school was in session last spring. Due to crazy summer schedules and activities we took the summer off. When I started back after school had resumed and I had a consistent routine I was very disappointed.
I had assumed that renovations on the facility were waiting for what I would consider to be slow time over the summer. What I found were TV screens on equipment still not working and the couple that I have found working the headphone jacks don't work. While I am there on a treadmill walking for an hour you can't help but try to find something to watch. Since gym goers, myself included, don't like being stared at, that leaves to looking elsewhere in the facility. What I found were last springs dust "bunnies" in the lighting fixtures now seem to be more dust "families". There are multiple lights out and the dust on the duct work and vents seems to have not been touched.
We do however have a new fancy towel dispenser and new towels. As nice as that is as a member of the club I would have rather seen a few more towels purchased and the rest of the money spent on cleaning and paint. 
This facility is very convenient for a lot of people in the meridian area. I feel it's almost as if  that convenience factor is taken for granted. 
As a business owner myself I often have to step back and get in the mindset of a customer when I walk into my own business just to get a different view. Sit where customer sit, do what customers do, see what customers see.

This is my new favorite place. I just went for the 3rd time this month and every time has been fantastic. 

I've had a few different sandwiches and haven't been disappointment but my favorite is the jalapeno chicken. Finally branched out and tried a rice bowl today and now it's my favorite. I got the tri-tip steak teriyaki and wow, just amazing. The teriyaki sauce is made in house, great balance of ginger, sweetness, and heat. 

The owner is an awesome guy, very friendly and generous. He goes above and beyond every time. Small things like splitting our teriyaki into 2 bowls when he knew we were going to share and bigger things like giving our kiddos a watermelon boba slushee. My favorite place at the moment!

Great little place with delicious food.  It's mostly Asian (phô, rice bowls, bubble teas, etc.), but my husband had fantastic buffalo wings (there are other flavor options, too) and they have chicken fingers, as well.

We both had tri-tip steak phô that came in 12" bowls.  The broth was bone broth, and had a nice light but beefy flavor with a hint of rice vinegar and just the right amount of seasoning - not too spicy or salty.  As I pulled the noodles through the broth, I caught an occasional taste of fresh salt, as if they had given the dish a finishing sprinkle before serving. 

I had one of the best egg rolls ever, and the potsticker app was deep fried and sooo good.  The tri-tip in the phô was tender and yummy, not tough like some brisket can be (they also have a brisket option and an herbed chicken option).  

Not knowing how huge the soups would be, my husband also ordered the wing basket - 5 wings and a bowl of fries the size of our phô bowls.  He should have stuck with just the appetizer!

We are definitely getting two more meals out of this lunch for ~40.00

This is probably my favorite restaurant in town. The pita is amazing, by far my favorite. The staff is super friendly. The food does take a little longer to receive but it is definitely worth the wait. It's delicious.

Gave this location another chance, but should have stuck to my "never again conviction" from my last visit.  If you are thinking about this restaurant....just don't.  

The service is comprised of a bunch of high schoolers that would rather be working.  The chips and salsa were not up to par.  The salsa is like watered down ketchup with a few tomatoes in it.  The mini chimichangas were dry and over-cooked.  

I absolutely love the Milwaukee and Downtown locations, but Meridian just can't get their act together.

Love that Marionberry!

Usually get the whole fruit slice, but our wonderful server Haleigh recommended to get on the Cheesecake.

Haleigh was a delight and we will return for her personality and the pies/food!

This place was awesome. I wish I could give it a perfect 10. 10 on service, 10 food, 10 on decor! I was in Meridian for work and an elementary school friend suggested that if I go to the Village at Meridian to try Kono Grill. So I dragged my coworker's for lunch. It was a bit pricey for the area but we'll worth it. I loved it so much I brought another coworker who was also away from home to try it for dinner the very same night. He loved it so much that he took our VP of sales there for lunch the next day. That alone has to say something for this establishment. Next time I'm in town I'll be back for sure. I highly recommend their avocado egg rolls to start! They had an amazing sushi roll in soy paper with crispy shrimp, mango, nuts and cream cheese, somet h ING I would usually skip in my sushi but OMG yum! I ordered their trio street taco special, one was fresh fish another was Lobster with corn and the third was shredded pork with figs. The pork one was by far my favorite. For dinner we got the same things but also the miso seabass and a crunchy crab roll. The dessert was every bit as yummy. I asked for the Key lime pie, they way they packaged it to go made it even more appealing. What a treat. Make sure you try thus gem if you find yourself at the Village in Meridian Idaho!

If you've ever said, "I want to try something I've never had before," this is where you need to go. Rice bowls, Asian noodle soups, bulgogi, chicken wings, & sandwiches served on puff pastry dough cooked on a waffle iron. We will be back soon.

I had heard this was open, but had yet to try it. I finally did and I'm kicking myself for waiting! The food is delicious. The variety of food is wide. The portion size is large, and for the price it's very affordable.

Pretty sure you're not supposed to microwave pastries in their plastic wrap. Came here last week for a croissant and it was super chewy and terrible, probably because I asked them to heat it up and it came to me warmed up in plastic wrap..

Eaten here several times and enjoy the food a lot. We have never been disappointed. I have had the cheesesteak sandwich with mushrooms, onions and peppers.  It was fantastic. I do wish the bread they use was cooked longer but the flavor is great.

came here with my mom for lunch. sat on the heated covered patio that overlooks the fountain and the Christmas tree. very great location, and the restaurant inside is beautifully done.

I ordered the sushi combo which comes with 3 pieces of sushi, a full size roll, and a salad for $12.99. i swapped out the california roll it comes with for a shrimp tempura spicy tuna roll for an additional $2. it was very delicious. coming from california, I will say the sushi is just not as good here but it was still very fresh tasting and the rice was cooked and seasoned perfectly! I enjoyed it.

the salad it came with had this blue cheese on it that was just so so good. It was a weird combo but it totally worked!

my mom had the coconut shrimp roll and OMG it's my new favorite- I will be ordering it every time I go there. if you like coconut shrimp I highly recommend it! and it is a non-raw sushi roll so anyone can get it.

I would say the best part about my meal here was our server Jordan. she was so so sweet and accommodating and honestly such a great server, she was super friendly and chatty and made our whole experience even better. I will be sure to ask for her every time I come now!

i'm looking forward to coming back!

We placed an $800 order and the order was shipped a week late , we did not get what we had paid for and requested to be sent. Instead we received something we wanted at a later time and an extra item we never asked for . 
We still have not received our signed Ron English Mario character.  We were not told it wasn't being sent in order nor was it explained why. 
They sent us an extra item without informing anyone like it was suppose to make up for not getting what we paid for , and the fact they sent the wrong item with an extra item to make up for it shows they did it intentionally without informing us. 
That's horrible practice and since then the customer service has been horrible they won't send out the Mario and are requesting the free item be sent back and we pay for shipping ? It's been over 2 months ...
Avoid at all cost

They have really stepped up the sound proofing! Our server said she was new but was FANTASTIC! We can always count on quick and friendly service. And the people who run the place genuinely seem happy to be there. That's refreshing! The food was wonderful! The house potatoes are my favorite, though I haven't had the hash browns because I love those so much. You guys rock! Keep up the good work!
Love athleta!! The sales team are amazing, so helpful and knowledgeable. I couldn't be happier with the service. Thanks guys!!
Food is average at best service was great the doors to the outside patio are left open with now blower to keep flies out, we were fighting the flies the entire time.

This place has only been open a couple months. My wife and I have enjoyed trying out a few new places here in Meridian on Eagle Rd. I see that this place focuses on Sushi and sea food. I dont like either, so I cant review that. I hope that they do a lot better on this type of food. 

My wife and I both have the Big Kuhuna Burger. The patty was indeed big, but had no flavor at all. Im pretty sure they used no salt at all. There was no salt on the table or any condiments at all. And nothing on this sort was brag out or offered.

We had to ask for salt, which did not help much. It was one of the worst burgers I have had. My wife felt the same.

My daughter had chicken strips. They tasted like they had been fried a couple days before, left under a heat lamp, then when we placed our order, put back into grease in an attempt to make them seem fresh. To make matters worse, the chicken tasted like fish. They had not even bothered to fry their chicken separate from the oil they used for Fish.

When we were there, there was maybe 5 people in the restaurant section. But we waited 30 to 45 minutes for our food.

If you want a good hamburger, skip this place and go to Famous Daves.

Pretty extensive list of yummy Martinis. The service is swift and friendly but not pushy at all. The food is pretty darn good, from what I've tried. Haven't had a complaint yet, and my super picky eater (fiance) even loves it. He special orders every time and no attitude whatsoever from the servers, that's rare in my experience lol. Let's be real though, it says "martini bar" in the name. I go for the that reasone alone, and if I get an awesome meal too that's a plus

From my ER experience to my surgery and hospital stay, the level of care was exceptional.
Room spotless, everyone kind and attentive
I have no negatives in my entire 4 day stay

I have been with crunch since February and minus the construction of the bathrooms and the reaplcwment of equipment (both of which was needed) I love coming to this gym. You are always greeted and questions can be answered either on the phone or the front desk. I love the Zumba classes!
