I'm actually still sitting at my table as I write this review. I take full responsibility for having made the choice to eat here. I should have been able to tell from the schizophrenic menu alone that this place would be an absolute disaster. Flat bread and sushi on the same menu? WTF? Again, I had ample warning. 

We started with the pot stickers. Holy Sh*t. Has the chef even had a real pot sticker? These were deep fried and dry as a bone. We orders a kids' bento for our son which was the most half-assed miserable excuse for a kids meal at a restaurant that I've seen. A Happy Meal at the Golden Arches would have had more soul. See the photo. 

Next came my husband's filet, which looked and tasted like it had been left on the charcoal grill for an hour before anyone noticed. $29 steak, which was one of the most expensive items on the menu was utterly inedible. Our server apologized, but our dinner was ruined. 

My sushi? Again, I should have known. This simply confirms that a restaurant tells you what they are all about with their menu. Flat bread and sushi said it all. They cater to everyone, therefore do nothing well. Sad.

Went to JM's on a cold, snowy Saturday morning and the place was PACKED.  The hostess indicated a 45-minute wait, so we saddled up to the bar.  Service was fantastic and the food was absolutely delicious.  Large portions and very, very good.  We will absolutely be back.

My husband and I tried this place after seeing a post about it on Instagram. So glad we did !! It is fantastic. I had the tri tip steak and pepper jack cheese (pro tip: add avocado!) waffle pressed sandwich and my husband had the jalapeño baked herb chicken and cheese waffle pressed sandwich. First off, we learned we could have shared one because the portions are fairly large large. These came with fries which were also quite good. 

The waffles are so tender and flakey, very, very flakey!  I'm amazed something so seemingly delicate can hold together like they do. They also have wings and chicken strips, noodle soup and dessert waffles as well as specialty teas and blended drinks. I can only speak to the sandwiches and fries but based on those I imagine their other offerings are good too!!

The service is friendly and fast. The owner has been present both times I've been there and is very nice and attentive to his customers and their experience. So yes, I went back and took my mom with me. We shared a sandwich and it was perfect!

Definitely a place worth trying!

Very disappointed. I'm from Texas and know good brisket--- and this isn't it! Wasn't cooked properly and not sliced  correctly either. Which left it tough and dry. My daughter had the truck fries which had tons of grease at the bottom of the fry basket. Yuck. The brisket poutine was also horrible. Nothing we ordered was any good and will not be returning to this so called barbecue joint.

This one is better than. The mall location. Either of them have the amazing pineapple salsa that will rock your socks off. For real I tell ya! 
Happy hour has great bar bites,but my fav is the guacamole for sure. Or the street tacos ... 4 for $5!! Or ... well they've got a lot of options and you're sure to enjoy them.

I finally had the opportunity to check out The Village in Meridian while in town. It is spectacular and makes me so jealous we don't have anything like this in the Spokane area and why didn't we have anything like this when I livef here and was growing up? Boo:(! I didn't get to checkout the shops but the restaurants all look amazing. The kids play area and the fountain are pretty awesome. Now that we've been I'm sure we'll make more of an effort to stop by especially since everything is within vicinity and it's a nice place to get your steps in!

I took my car to get the fluids checked and replaced. Less than a week later my car over heated because it ran out of coolant. I paid premium price in my opinion for them to almost destroy my car. - terrible service

This review is for the tree lighting event and does not count for my overall opinion on the place. . On Nov 28th we went for the Christmas tree lighting and see Santa. You would have thought they were giving away free gifts or something with the huge crowd.  First of all we were packed in like cattle, there was really no room to get around, and if you had a stroller, forget about it. Not to mention we had to park clear over past Toys R Us. The heavy crowd aside, Santa was only there for 30 min so 99% of the kids got screwed out of seeing the big guy. Also, the tree lighting was pathetic. This could have been a real fun event had it been planned better. I was surprised that such a high end shopping center had such a Charlie Brown tree for the lighting ceremony. All that being said I must say that the center itself is very impressive and flashy. My kids love the fountain (especially at night) and I love the patio dining so you don't have to roast inside a stuffy restaurant while eating.  We all go as a family once a month or so and wind up eating at one of the eateries in the Village. My only complaint  (other than the tree lighting debacle) is all the self important  pompous yuppie clientele the place attracts. Lets hope they get it right next year. Now I'm done.

If you want to take your beloved pet to a hospital that has passion and compassion mixed with state-of-the-art equipment, I recommend going to this hospital! Dr Knighton helped my dog's hip dysplasia tremendously with surgery and never gave up on trying to help him, even with how difficult his case was. Thank you All Valley for taking care of my boy!

Awful.  Hostess was too busy chomping her own food behind the desk. Super slow afternoon and they sit us in a terrible seat. My husbands steak was so rare it was awful. It was our anniversary and i ate my food by myself while he watched. Wont be back.

Shari, Is nasty. they need to replace the back of their bench seats or have them CLEANED.  Repair the cushion where they are RIPPED.  They also need to clean the waitress work station. I will not go back until this done.

Hands down my favorite breakfast place. It was the first place we found 4 years ago when we moved here and not one other has met up to it. Everything is good there. Especially their omelettes and THE PANCAKES

Their brisket is excellent! We frequently have the pulled pork, chopped chicken and my favorite spicy sausage (not for the timid pallet) The cold slaw and baked beans are our favorite sides and they often have tasty cheese cake! The proprietors are friendly, the service excellent and the restaurant is very clean.  We are fortunate to have Big Daddy's near by our neighborhood.

When they first opened.....WOW!  Great results, truck completely dry.  I haven't timed the process but it seems the cars are rushed through.  My truck requires three of the provided towels to dry.  The Armor All tire dressing is now poor at best.  Now that's marketing.

I've been there twice now.  Each time for a comedy show.   The first time it was for my girlfriends birthday party.   The service was great, the comedy (the 1st time) was GREAT.   I cannot say the same for the food.    My girlfriend and her husband ordered the prime rib.   It was a very small serving and they both commented how little food they received.   I ordered a cobb style salad and it came with a white creamy type dressing which, after tasting it, I assumed it was some sort of house dressing, almost like a sweet slaw type dessing, very sugary.   I asked the waitress if I could have some Blue Cheese dressing and she said 'that is the Blue Cheese dressing'.    I made a face like,  REALLY?  and she smilled back at me knowingly as if to say....'it's bizarre, isn't it?'.   I couldn't finish the salad, the dressing was so bad.

The second time to the restaurant was tonight (Oct 12) with my husband, sort of a 'date night'.  Again the service was great, everybody is very friendly there. The comedian for tonight was not nearly as funny as the 2 comedians who performed the first time.   Unfortunately the food experience tonight was not good.   My husband ordered sliders with chili and a side Cesar Salad and I ordered a Pesto pizza.

Firstly it's so dark in there that you can't 'see' your food well enough to know what color it is or in some cases..what it is exactly, so you need a certain amount of 'faith' to start eating it.   

My thin crust pizza was so so .    The crust was not crispy AT ALL, it was chewy.   The toppings were unusual.   The prosciutto was tough, there wasn't very much cheese and the sundried tomatoes were too big and tough to chew.  The pizza itself wasn't very hot and it took over 30 minutes from the time it was ordered.

My husbands food experience was also bad.    He ate his sliders but couldn't finish his cesar salad, he said the lettuce was soggy and the dressing tasted funny.  He took approx 3 bites then stopped.   Nor did he finish his Chili as he said it tasted funny.    This is VERY unusual for my husband who eats EVERYTHING and NEVER sends food back, ever.    Even if he doesn't really like something he will eat it anyway and finish it.   

We sat adjacent to a couple, at a table next to us, who ordered wings and some sort of salad to share.    I overheard them tell the waitress the wings were good but the salad seemd 'off'' and had it sent back.

During the comedy performance, the comedian interacted a lot with the audience.   The couple at the table in the front row, right in front of the comedian, sent food back also.   The reason I know this, is the comedian made a joke about it by asking the lady, at the table, why she was getting a 2nd dinner delivered to her table, and the lady replied she sent the first dinner back.

Tried this place on a friend's recommendation. Things I liked: their bacon was thick and cooked the way I like it, the place is big and comfortable, they move you in in a reasonable amount of time, and the menu has a nice variety of choices. Things I did not like: our server was not exactly helpful when we asked what the possibility of changing tables was (from high top to regular table since high tops are very uncomfortable for short legs like mine!) which kind of set the tone for the rest of our experience. Waters and drinks were slow in coming, but the worst part was how long it took our food to arrive. It was over a 50 minute wait for an omelet, a breakfast burrito, 2 eggs with toast, and biscuit and gravy. That is wayyyyyy too long, especially after waiting 30+ minutes for a table. Our server never came to check on us or explain the wait. I finally had to flag her down and ask her to check with the kitchen about our food. The food came about 5 minutes later with no explanation and no apology. It was weird. And the toast was burnt, which the server kind of acknowledged, again, no apology. We didn't send it back because at this point we were running late since the food took so long and we had to eat quickly -- we just dealt with it. My breakfast burrito actually had the wrong meat in it and we were out of hot sauce, but again, we just dealt with it. All in all, I think the food was average but the service was a real bummer and pretty much ruined our experience so I doubt I will go back. I get that things happen, but the difference between good service and bad service is an apology delivered with a smile. Ignoring the problem just makes customers feel frustrated and disrespected.

The food was good - and the full servings are huge portions. The pricing is excellent. Seating is tight in the center tables. The house potatoes were tasty, the coffee is good, the service was very nice, the pancakes are as big as the plate, and I am stuffed.
I like the rustic atmosphere of the log walls and ceiling. I like that it was brightly lit. I like the chickens painted on the walls. I would have liked to try one of the Bloody Mary cocktails, but Idaho liquor laws says no hard alcohol to be served before 10am. Pfffft.

If you don't like wait times, go early. There were people waiting for tables by 8:45am. If you go later and have to wait, find your happy place and quit whining on Yelp. Order a cocktail or a mimosa. If you're in a hurry, go somewhere else. If you like a hearty, tasty breakfast with family or friends, you will be very satisfied.
Great breakfast...just very hard to get into! Took me three times trying.

Unfriendly service.  It took us flagging down a server to have our order taken after being seated for 15 minutes.  The restaurant was not busy.  When we finally had a server take our order, she apologized and said the server in that area didn't see us.  Unbelievable.  We had two young kids and were only the third table in her area.  She blatantly ignored us.  Once we received our food, it was luke warm at best.  My son has French toast and the butter wouldn't even melt.  My eggs and hash brown were cold to the touch.  Extremely disappointed.  The only reason I gave a one star is because the server who did finally help us apologized.  However, good service would have at least offered to take something off our bill or gone over and above after we had been sitting for 15 minutes without even a drink order taken.

My kids (three and one) really enjoyed this place. We stayed two hours and had to drag them away when it was done. I didn't encounter any problems with staff. I do think one adult should be free per child however--$8 for an adult pass to supervise a kid seems a little steep. Basically a single parent would pay $16 to go with one kid. We bought a punch card and entrance fee comes down to about $4.50 per visit, so at least that cuts down the price.

So not pleased, came for something new and to support the local business. BIG mistake!! There for 30 min just to get our name down, come to find out a tone of people cut in front if us. Then to our surprise they sat an 11 top before us... When it was just 2 people. Very unorganized!!! Don't know if I feel I will ever go back, we didn't even order.

Leaving home to a hotel is always bleh. You miss your nightly routines, and you always feel like a guest. Try not to talk to loud bc the neighbors are sleeping. Is my tv too loud? Crap, I forgot my toothbrush.

This was not the case when we stayed at La Quinta. They offered an atmosphere where an individual can feel relaxed. An individual cannot hear their neighbors talking. The staff was exceptional. An A plus for hospitality.
Very friendly and a great energy! Always great conversation while waiting for our drinks! Hot, iced, coffee's or tea, we are always satisfied!!

What a unique, little lunch spot! These waffle pressed sandwiches are so original and flaky. They have pastrami, jalapeño baked chicken, tri tip, smoked brisket, turkey bacon, and more. The fries are seasoned to your liking: Cajun, Garlic Parmesan, or Sea Salt Original. My husband is a huge fan of the noodle soup!

The food is great, but I would drive by and come in just for the boba smoothies alone. They are amazing! Taro boba is my favorite, however the avocado was great as well. Will definitely be coming back in the future!

I'm a patient of Dr. Anderson's. He was nice, did a complete exam, took X-rays, gave me a steroid injection and suggested four different procedures/surgeries. I've had ongoing foot issues for decades.  While I can't stand foot surgeries as they take time and are difficult to recover from. I have confidence in my doctor and his staff.

Today was my husband and my first time at this location we usually go to the one on meridian road, and I have to say it was so delicious. I had the cinnamon French toast and my husband had chicken fried steak both were outstanding. My husband ordered a vanilla iced mocha and he didn't care for it he said it was watery and didn't taste much like coffee but other than that we left totally satisfied

If u r looking for a good Sammie go to Hugo's down the road. This place is just a step up from Subway and that ain't saying much. For the price I think I'd rather get a $5 footlong. I also think I chipped my tooth eating their chips
Best happy hour in town!!!!! And the salmon is to die for, I love this place! Happy hour is 2-7!! Also give the chicken satay a try (big serving) for $5 on HH
Great coffee but this stores hours are awful. Seriously.

Super yummy! It was our first time and we got the meatball and French dip special and shared them plus the broccoli cheese soup and it was all so yummy! The meatball was probably a little better but overall we left super happy. I wish they had a drink fountain instead of bottled drinks but that's not the end of the world. All of the staff was super friendly and even thanked us for coming in when we left and they were slammed. The sourdough was soft with a little crispy top and had the perfect amount of sourdough flavor.

Uuuugh, this place is a hot mess.

Over the past year we have eaten there twice and never again.

The deep dish pizza was decent.. for a faux-Chicago restaurant in Idaho.

I aslo ordered a meatball sandwich. I hadn't had an MBS in years. I brought it home with the intention of having it for lunch the following day. I immediately placed it in the refrigerator and dreamt about the hopeful delicious goodness as I counted down the hours until lunch.

Finally, lunch time arrived the following day. I broke out the MBS and nuked the huge sandwich. I sunk my teeth into the end, right into a big, meaty meatball. That's when it happened. My teeth encountered a massive vein or artery in the middle of the ball of meat. I nearly gagged as I looked at the sandwich and saw the severed artery sticking out of the meat.  The rest of the MBS was given to the dogs who thoroughly enjoyed it. Please tell me how in the world does this happen?

We have never dined in, though the delay in picking up the food for a to-go order felt like we should have ordered in. Both times we have ordered to-go I ended up waiting at least 20-30 minuted past the quoted ready time. I think I ended up watching an entire quarter of Monday night football during one wait.

We will not be returning to Bono's.

The food is so so. The crab Rangoon is gross-it's supposed to have a light flaky crust and be creamy and rich, this place cooks theirs in a thick casing and the filling doesn't taste right, it's off. The sweet and sour sauce is from a bottle. My daughter ordered chicken and the lady brought us beef, she gave me a really dirty look when my 5 year old said she really wanted chicken. Then immediately started talking very loudly in Vietnamese. Not exactly a welcoming feeling. She did like the chicken pho though and my summer rolls weren't bad. We are new to the are and there aren't very many Vietnamese restaurants around, we will probably come back.
I've been here a number of times and the sandwiches are consistently good. I can't say I'm a fan of the chips or the cookies, though.

The rooms was nice and bed comfortable, the pillows were kinda small though. Breakfast has lots of choices but the eggs were way funky. They were super dry and not good. The waffle was yummy. The people were nice and it was pretty quite while I was there.

Kona Grill must have gone through some staff changes or something, because it's back to being perfect again! I really do love this place and I'm happy to see them exceeding expectations again. The last few times I've been in I've noticed a woman (manager) checking on tables, including mine, and she really seems to have turned this place around! New happy hour menu is AMAZING !

Love the ambiance, lots of pretty details to look at, including the food presentation!!!

Friendly service, nothing bad to say! 
The food, drinks, dessert, and the check came at a good pace.

All of the desserts were awesome!
Creme Brulee = delicious, perfect consistency & caramelized shell!
Strawberry Sunday= huge and I scarfed it all down, fresh strawberries, YUM!
Smores Dessert= Fantastic brownie & flavor!

Pesto Margherita Chicken- really good!! Loved the veggies, potatoes and of course the chicken! Would order again!

Pork Osso Bucco- My Dad really enjoyed this


Bruschetta Flatbread- Mom also enjoyed this, no complaints


TNT Coulotte- flavorless steak, husband didn't care for the sauce, or how it was cooked... wouldnt order again! Looked way better than it tasted.

Overall great experience.
I had the eggs benedict with the crab cakes.  It was very good, service was quick even though it was near packed.  On the down side it was a little pricey.

Simply the best! We have been going here for couples massages for the past few months , and every trip is a great experience. They are always on schedule, great at listening and adjusting the massage to your personal needs, and just super friendly people all around.

This place has taken me a little bit to really like, which has to do with what I ordered. The staff is friendly and always pleasant to order from. My very first visit I got a roast turkey sandwich. The turkey was so dry that I could hardly get it down. I decided to give it one more shot and got the classic cheesesteaks and that was really good. It was completely opposite from my turkey. The meat wasn't dry and it tasted great. I love how the cheese is really mixed into the meat, so every bite has a consistent meat and cheese flavor. I've gone many time and only get a cheesesteak. For the 4 stars, sometimes it's greaser then other and I wish they put more veggies on it. I always ask for more, however I never seem to get more. I will say, the fresh baked bread is delicious.

Don't get me wrong all Dutch bros will leaving you waiting for quite a bit, but this one is the worst. Worst customer service out of all of them too which is a rare occurrence.. Do not go here.. Go to the next one around the block.

I was looking for someplace different to go for lunch with a friend.  It was the middle of January and we were just now getting together to exchange Christmas gifts and we didn't want to go to the same old places or a chain.  The Yelp reviews for Sofra Bosnian Grill were good, so we decided to go there.

I got there first and was going to secure a table.  I wasn't sure if we order at the counter, wait to be seated, or what, so I sort of hung out in front of the counter waiting to be acknowledged.  And it took a few times for the server to pass me to finally ask if he could help me.  I asked if I order here or could I sit, and he said to sit wherever I wanted, so I did.

My friend got there, and we immediately started to visit.  The server came for our drink orders, and we visited some more.  Then he came for the food order, but we hadn't looked at the menu at all.  He said he would give us 2 more minutes.  Having never been there, and just now opening the menu, 2 minutes was not enough.  He came back, we asked for more time, and he was obviously annoyed.  I tried to get his attention when we were ready, and couldn't, but was ready when he finally came back over.

Gyro (Beef/Lamb), $10 
Beef-lamb gyro meat sliced over a bed of salad mix and wrapped in a pita bread, served with tzatziki sauce, hummus and fries.
The wrap for my gyro was soft, tasty and big.  The inside however was not.  The meat had an odd taste/smell to it and was extremely salty.  There was feta cheese on it - (which I like) - but that just added to the saltiness.  There were large slices of raw onion in it - too big, like they just rough-chopped the onion.  The fries were overcooked and had no seasoning.  I added salt to them but when you add salt after they are cooked, it doesn't adhere.  You need to season fries right after they come out of the oil.

Krompirusa / Potato Pie $12 
House-made thin filo dough filled with diced potato, served with fresh cabbage salad. 
The potato pie was large which would have been a bonus, but it was pretty greasy.  It had a good amount of potato and onion in it, but because of the oiliness it was not as enjoyable as it could have been.

We shared the sofra cake ($5) for dessert.  It's not that big, so we should have gotten 2 pieces because this was the only winner here.  Sort of a chocolate mousse, just the right amount of walnuts, cake, and cream on top and then caramel and chocolate drizzle.  The best part of the meal.

Sofra Bosnian Grill was a generous 3-star for me based on the hit (cake) and misses (everything else).  But then there was an incident at the end which is why I am taking them down to a 2-star, and actually with the food and service probably should be a 1-star as I am never going back.

We hadn't even ordered dessert yet - but had asked our server about the cake - and then the owner brought the check and said, "no rush."  
Then our server came for the check and we told him that we wanted the cake and he said he could add it to the check.  
It's now after the meal and before dessert so we decide to open our gifts.   But before the cake showed up, I noticed the place was clearing out and the owner, our server, and another male were at the counter kind of glaring at us.  The other male brings the cake and I ask if they were closed and he said, "oh no, you're good."  Ok, cool.  So, we finish our gifts and share the cake.  
In the meantime, I check online for their hours - their website and google shows that they close at 5.  It's almost 3 o'clock, so we're good.  We asked for drink refills and our server was visibly annoyed - but didn't say anything.  All body language with the face and the heavy sigh.  And we're finishing our drinks, and the cake and chillin'.  And then our server comes back.  All bold.  "I'm sorry, but we're going to have to ask you guys to leave.  You have been here AN HOUR past our closing time."  Wait, what??  They are open until 5 and the owner said no rush, and the other guy said we're good.  I said "oh, but they said .... and your website and google say you're open until 5."  And he says, (again all bold) "IT DOESN'T MATTER what it says, because we closed at 2."  Oof.  Way to lose my business forever, fella.  So, we quickly got up, bused our own table, threw out our garbage and left .... to never return again.

BTW - their website and Google still show they are open 'til 5 during the week.

Before the last couple of times I ate at Jo Mammas I raved about how great it was. It was my favorite breakfast restaurant. We would drive from Boise to Eagle to eat there. Since they moved to Meridian the food has really been affected. I liked it because it was healthy and there were healthy choices. I have hash browns that were so greasy I couldn't eat them. The whole presentation has gone down. I loved the freshness of the food. I was so excited when it moved because now it's much closer to me. I actually feel sad that last Saturday I went to another breakfast restaurant because of my past experience. I hope they can find a way to expand without losing the quality and freshness they once had. I will try again. I gave a four star because of the restaurant they were before and I hope they will be again. Not a greasy spoon like many others.

I love crafts, craft supplies, and all the things IN Michaels.....it's BEING in Michaels that's a disaster for me.  The service on the floor has improved -- there are bodies, and each time I've asked for help, I've gotten it.  It's the check-out that makes me not want to go to the store.  Long lines, one or two check out people -- while others bustle around the store floor.  I have  seen many people lose their good humor simply standing in the line.  Knowing that I'm going to waste time in line makes me purchase more on-line, which in turn (more choices) leads me away from Michaels in general.

Decided to try out this place based on other Yelpers reviews. We had Carolina, grilled cheese, pulled pork, and ribs.  They were all good.  Really Liked the option to try the different BBQ sauces they have sitting on the table.
Folks are beginning to visit with one another because we now hold a common bond of hunger

We stopped here on Wednesday night, 4/11 and we had great service from a waiter named Marshal (I think!). He was extremely personable and nice, also very attentive to our table even though it was busy. 

Aside from the great service, the food and wine came out promptly and were both delicious! Really a great experience overall.

I've been to the old location several times (quite busy and felt cramped), and the new location once when they first opened. That day they were very busy and I was told a 15-20 minute wait. I looked in the bar area, which had opening at the bar and open tables. I asked about that and was able to take a seat where I wanted, no waiting. I chose the bar since it was just me, ordered my breakfast and it all came in a timely manner. Good food, Good service, decent atmosphere I'll definitely will be back and worth at least 4 stars.
Delicious "not your average" breakfast food, healthy portions, great staff! Be prepared to wait if you go on the weekend.

I'm not surprised that this Winco store has the highest ratings of all Treasure Valley Winco's. It's my favorite. The store is always fully staffed with friendly employees, their motorized scooters are always fully-charged and in good repair. I've never found anything out of date, expired, or spoiled. Good prices, great people. My favorite grocery store ever.

There are lots of good shops, restaurants and a fun play area for kids. Who ever is in charge of the Village should invest in a shade cover for the play area. It was so hot when we went because we needed to get out of the house and we could barely stay outside. There are tons of shops from candy stores, to lingerie to clothing and jewelry. Once the weather cools down it would be so much better. There are also shops on the main road but it is not within walking distance. I have friends that live close by so it's a fun easy place to meet up at. 
I would recommend this place mainly during fall, winter or spring. Summer is a bit too hot.

The last 2 times we have been here they are short staffed. Today it took over 30 minutes to get our food. Once we got our food; it was cold. We will not be returning. This location on Overland is very disorganized.

Our go to spot for pedicures. Even a week after my polish looks as good as it did when I left the shop with just a basic polish.  Friendly staff and they remember you from one visit to the next which is nice as they remember what you may prefer.

I was a skeptic for quite awhile with Jimmy John's, they really had to earn with me because of competitors with similar menus in my previous city of residence, but I am regretful of my previous avoidance. I LOVE that they deliver, and I will happily report FAST. The staff has ALWAYS been polite, and I rarely speak in absolutes, but ALL of my experiences have been professional, prompt, and delicious. I don't have a favorite from their menu...there are several "regulars" that I order. If it's been awhile, give 'em a try.

Called ahead to see how long the wait was. They said no wait come on in. Got there and was a sudden 20 minute wait. We said we could split up party (we only had 6) and made no effort to accommodate us- we said we could sit wherever to get in. After 30 minutes of waiting we left.

I always order sushi from here, and it's always delicious. Great food, wonderful atmosphere of the village, and always great service. My mom and I always come here to eat and it's never disappointing.

Great food and atmosphere    Good wait staff and accurate bar.    

Would be great if management visited the tables
A very professional place with great customer service. Ordered a Cast aluminum plaque and they did a wonderful job. Price was good and very impressed with the packaging and shipping. Would use again.

I joined M.E. in another state and was in town visiting. My massage therapist took awhile to come back into the room after her initial greet... she also smelled like cigarette smoke and her perfume was really strong and the mix of both was making me nauseated most of the time. She also didn't ask about the pressure or pay attention to the areas I asked her to. I have a contract with this place so I'll def try a different therapist next time.

We LOVE Rocky Mountain Pizza!!! The food is delicious and the service is superb!!
We love the pizza, we love the salads and we love the pasta selections. We can't recommend Rocky Mountain Pizza strongly enough.

The service was outstanding and everyone seemed legit from the front door to the bar. 
Food was good and drinks were better.  I'll make a point to come back and bring some friends with me.

My wife and I were gifted a night away from our newborn and went to this location last night for dinner. We ordered a bottle of wine, an appetizer and both got the Kona Filet (I believe the most expensive entre). After Shane took our order, he disappeared for a half hour and I had to ask the hostess station where he was. Shortly after a different young lady brought out our steaks, even though we hadn't even seen our appetizer yet. After sending them back and some confusion among staff our original server Shane came back to apologize and said our appetizer would be out shortly. We eventually got our food, which was undercooked. I asked for medium (I know, I know) and got something around rare...it was almost purple inside. Shane tried to make up for it by bringing us a free dessert and comping our app, but then decided to swipe one of the gift cards I used to pay. I put down a $50 gift card along with a separate 10$ gift card, and my credit card to cover the balance. Total bill after discounts was $85 and some change. Got the $50 gift card receipt along with my credit card receipt with the $35 and change balance. No $10 gift card to be found. Would not recommend or return.

My husband and I went for lunch on a whim.  We ended up getting the combo lunch specials.  I got the chicken chili and crab roll.  He got chowder and a roll.  It was just okay.  I should have looked up the nutritional information on the crab roll before I ordered it (over 600 calories for a little roll, really?  I could do better nutritionally with fast food).   However, that was my fault in not researching better.  
Our server was nice.  The food was slow getting to us, but she kept checking back on us (so we knew we were not forgotten).  Small servings for the price.  The food itself was just okay (not bad, but nothing to write home about, either).  The rest of the menu looked over-priced for the Boise area.   We probably won't be back, but it was interesting to try.

We had great food, but the service was super slow. Our server was lovely,  but she hardly checked on us for refills or whatever. It was close to closing time, but there seemed to be plenty of employees around, so I'm not sure what was happening. We will definitely be back,  but we are hoping this was a one time thing.
Best grocery store ever with the best prices. Staff is always so friendly at my eagle Idaho location! Couldn't ask for a better grocery store!

I normally go to the black rock on broadway, but I came here with my dad who was having trouble explaining what he wanted. The lady with black hair was extremely short with him and had an odd attitude with him. I'm normally not into all this review stuff but this was a very interesting experience. If you dont want to work and give a good experience to the customer then why are you working??

Love their happy hour specials and they have good sushi. I hate that it's so crowded every time I go and if you aren't in the happy hour section (that is overfilled and no room left) then they refuse to serve you. It's pretty horrible. I would have left a 5 star if my husband and I hadn't been treated so poorly because they didn't have enough seating and because we were 2 tables away from the "bar area" we would be served happy hour dishes.

I ordered some sandwiches and chips online for kids school picnic today. When I arrived at the school, I found my 3 chips not in the package. I called them about the missing chips, they spoke without patience and even no apology. I had to drive back to get my chips after. Even when I went back to the store, they did not say anything about their mistakes. Shame on them!
Culotte steak absolutely delicious! Very impressed same menu as lunch menu.  Ambiance lovely outside and heaters close by if needed. .. definitely will be back!
Sarah has been doing my hair for years.  She is consistent and always does a great job!  She is especially talented with color!
Apparently Jason from member services is impossible to get ahold of. Very frustrated with this company. Shady.

I really like the food here.  I've had the noodle soup,  sandwiches,  and meat and rice bowl.  It's good food for when you aren't in a rush. I also really like the staff here.  They are always really nice and friendly. The atmosphere is also pleasant. I would eat here a lot more but for two issues: the price feels a bit high and the smell of the deep fryer sticks to you bad. If I even stop in for a quick boba smoothie I smell like a French fry for the rest of the day.  If this place could get the ventilation figured out, make things a little faster and a little cheaper, I would be eating here a lot more.

This is one of our few go to spots for breakfast. The atmosphere is welcoming and warm. The staff is friendly and on top of refills. Food is yummy and on point.  I love that you can call ahead and put your name on the waiting list as well

Their BBQ Brisket and Pulled Pork are amazing!  Plus if you love breakfast...their breakfast burrito with their pulled pork is to die for!  The homemade salsa that accompanies the burrito is tasty too!

Came in around 4:00 and was greeted and shown our table right away. The seater explained their happy hour and brought us water. Bri, our server came over took our drink and food order. She brought out our drinks, beer was very cold. We had the smokehouse pizza...it was EXCELLENT!!!

My wife and I come to the Boise area almost every year.  We found this place a couple of years ago.  They were in s hole in the wall and we really liked the food and the people.  We almost always had a wait but it was worth it.  This year we found they had moved locations to a place that is 4 times larger.  I dont know how they did it but the new place feels like the old and the food is still great.   We told locals about the place and all our family and friends love it as well.  All the food is really good.  It is big for a "grease spoon" but the people are friendly and fast.  Expect a wait if you dont make a reservation.  The cool thing is they can accommodate larger groups and you can make a reservation.  Oh yea everything on the menu is great.  The pancakes are huge and coffee is outstanding.

Dunkley's has moved my pianos on several occasions.  This last time, Richard had Seth and Chance come to our home and set up our 6 foot grand.  They young men were competent, friendly, and well capable for the task at hand.  I would highly recommend Dunkley to move anyone's piano.

LOVED our breakfast here. We got the California eggs Benedict, omelette and blueberry stuffed French toast. All was very good. We came on a Saturday morning around 10am. We did have to wait about 30 minutes but well worth it. This place is always busy but they get people in and out pretty quickly. Highly recommend.
I have had a great experience from Keith who enrolled me to Matt my personal trainer. He listened to all my needs and has exceeded my expectation.

Stopped in today and was blown away. Seriously? Waffle sandwiches?  I had the turkey bacon. So flaky and delicious! The garlic parm fries were great, too! Now let's talk milk tea. I asked the cashier/server what her favorite flavor was and she said original. I was skeptical and went for almond. It was sooo good AND she brought me a sample of the original flavor just because I had mentioned I'd never had it before (which was also super good btw).

I don't know how many people work there, but today it was a young man and a young girl. I hope they read this and see how amazing my experience was! The service was awesome!!
We have eaten in and taken out. The takeout was better as it was earlier in the day and the meat had not been in the hot hold all day. Very good pulled pork sandwiches.

I went back in today, and all was totally awesome again. I think it was just a bad day when I was in there last. Back to 5 stsrs. I was concerned the Christmas Eve would be insane but the staff did awesome and the food was awesome. It as nice as a server who was not even ours grabbed my drink and refilled it twice and that's awesome!!

This place blew me away! Our server was so helpful and friendly, there was only one of him though so I'm not sure what they do when it gets busy. It wasn't an issue for us because there was only a few other patrons. There isn't much of an atmosphere but the restaurant is definitely clean and well-kept.

On recommendations from our server my husband got the sausage sandwich and I got a meat pie and a cheese pie (can't remember the Bosnian names), also a side of fries and rice. First, the portions are huge. Split or plan on leftovers. The sandwich and pies were AMAZING. The red pepper jam they had was delicious! The rice was good, but was all sage and lemon so if you live sage then you'll love the rice. Fries were really good too. Small menu but everything sounded amazing and probably was, hopefully we will be back in town to try it all!

Horrid service, we waited 1 1/2 hour and both manager and hostesses blew us off. We were told 1 hour and watched many get seated ahead of us. They say no reservations but you can call  and they will give you a spot in their line. Uhm isn't that a reservation???? Poor people skills! Manager kept saying if you stop yelling at me....when the rest of the people sitting with us in wait (none that we knew) said our voices never raised. Very frustrating indeed.

I was so excited about going to Kona Grill. I've heard great things. I ordered the Pad Tai, it was Bad Tai. The shrimp was so small,i thought it was canned. The presentation was terrible. The Sushi display was Gorgeous, too bad I'm not a fan.  The  service was more than lacking. It took 30 minutes to get a soda, never was I offered a refill, 
It saddens me to give this review. I never want too be the author of an unfavorable review.

We've been die-hard loyalists for years, but have now had two substandard experiences.  

With growth comes challenges and the worst part here seems to be getting the new staff filtered and trained.  I had heard that the new space was intended to reduce wait times, but that's definitely not the case now that they're in a more heavily populated area.  We miss our quality service by the original crew and medium-rare chicken-fried steak.  The last two servers didn't even ask how we wanted it prepared.  

Rather than waiting outside at the old place, we get seated and wait for too long for a server.  Not a pleasurable experience, made only less enjoyable by the music.  Just wanted to pay and get out. 

Bigger is not better.

This place is amazing!!! I've had the noodles w/smoked brisket twice and it's been perfect both times! Their Waffle sandwiches were flakey & fresh! The boba drinks are on point. But most importantly the service is    !!! Tony is friendly and funny! A must for those who like good boba & noodles !

This is the second or third time I've eaten here. They are always busy I get that but if a table your serving has coffee check on them. I also asked for almond milk for my coffee got it the first time not the second.  The wait staff should also repeat the order back as I ordered The B & G and her heard half order.  Yes I could have sent it back but I was hungry.  But it's still a good place to eat. Just expect to have a long wait on Sunday mornings.
This place is amazing. The food could use a little umpf but it works. The fountains and music are great. It can get crowded on the weekend, but during the week it is a ton of fun.

I chose Twigs for my NYE/Birthday celebration this year. I'd never been before but I'm a Martini girl and wanted a place to gather a small group of friends central to us all. There were 14 in our party, had a 730pm reservation and was seated at just before 8. Our server seemed overwhelmed and bit inexperienced on how to serve a group. Salads and appetizers were forgotten. When the manager came by and we mentioned the items missing he simply walked away without a word. Our server came right over, acted as if the items that were forgotten were our fault? but she would get them. I had the Cod and fries with Gorgonzola dipping sauce. Nothing special about my meal but the Gorgonzola sauce was late to the table, cold and way too salty. I had a bite of the crab Mac n Cheese and it was really good. The Thai pizza also looked delicious. The best part of the night were the Martinis- I ordered a huckleberry lemon drop and a mango pomegranate martini- both tasted amazing but both glasses were only half filled? If I pay $10 for a drink, I expect the entire drink.
Bottom line- only come for the Martinis, don't bring a large group and for the price you should eat elsewhere. Only reason I'd return would be for a Martini after a dinner/movie date.

Ok I'm giving 4 stars because, while not typical Chicago deep dish pizza, Bono's deep dish rocks. I really enjoy it. Tons of delicious sauce on top of tons of cheese and "toppings" (under the sauce).  And the crust is excellent. This is definitely a knife and fork pizza. 

Now for the bad: service is worst for any restaurant I've been; staff usually seem lost; touch spendy (but deep dish is filling and weighs a ton).

Why go?  That deep dish is killer.  Just remember, this NOT your traditional Chicago deep dish people are talking about from the usual hot spots. 

It's different but just as good IMO, maybe better.
Stone fox is hands down the best salon ever. Sara is amazing but so are the others as well. Book your apt. You won't be sorry

I can't tell if the reviews from people are just because they haven't had good breakfast or they've been eating at the Golden Corral for so long that this is just right in swing with their primitive desires. 

The tables are understaffed and overpacked by Section, so your server really doesn't give you the time you need or care.

We waited for 20 minutes to be seated with two toddlers after being told 10 minutes, and then when we sat there was a dozen empty tables available. 

The food was good. What I got.... 
I ordered a biscuit, and then had to ask for it. 
Then realized that I didn't even get the bacon I ordered, so ... that's awesome. 
Then had to ask that it be removed off my check. 
Just silly sh!t...

Let's be realistic. 
You want good breakfast, friendly staff, and the right order--Chik Fil A wins every time against Joe Mama's.
Had a few solid cocktails and the blackened chicken sandwich. Not on the menu but they were happy to make it upon request. Great atmosphere

Garlic cheese bread rocks! Dipping sauce super good. Side salad yummy.  Only suggestion is use all romaine vs. weed lettuce. Baked spaghetti delicious. Grilled salmon pasta is really good---perfectly cooked salmon! Calzone- if you like cheese then pick that! Service was great. Good thing I didn't read the reviews before coming here or I might not have come. This place is great!!

Food is still so good and the service is super quick!! I got the Joe's waffle which was the perfect size not TOO big and not too small and the batter is sweet and moist. Also, got the ham instead of bacon and I was so glad I did, filling and full of flavor.

Worst Bbq I have ever had. Ordered the brisket melt, suppose to have pepperjack, looked like provolone. Ordered side of smoked green beans, which tasted like they just poured liquid smoke on them, so bad tasting i couldnt eat more than 2 bites of the green beans. The sandwich hardly had any meat, mostly just chunks of Fat. I definetly will not waste my time or my money going back there. You want real BBq, go to Dickeys, well worth the money.

Jambalaya,  Lemon linguine and  deep fried calamari starter were all awesome!  Cucumber mojito seemed really light almost to the point of tasting like water, but the raspberry martini was good.
Live in s/e Boise, but will not hesitate making the drive to Meridian for great food from Kona Grill.

Only had some of their milk tea with boba. It's not like THE best, actually kind of flavorless even with multiple added flavors. Still just tastes like milky ass tea, but I'm also not very cultured so that might be the way it's supposed to be I guess. The boba is delicious, unique texture. Anyway, the employees are really nice. I like the space, it's cute and edgy. Personally think drinks can be made a little faster, but won't hold that against anyone as I've never made a boba milk tea myself.

Staff is so friendly and helpful.  Don't hover but don't leave you hanging. 

Very quick and good price. I came late afternoon and had the range almost to myself.

Been here a few times and previous visits food took quite awhile however tasted good. This review is on my most recent visit- not impressed! Placed my order on the phone and was told it would be ready for pick up in 45 min- when we got there to pick up our pizzas we were told it would be another 20 mins!! When we finally got our food and brought it home pizza it was cold and tasted like it had been sitting under a heat lamp for awhile- and the "Chicago style" pizza was lacking in sauce- may give them one more chance

Very good barbecue at a reasonable price. The salad was fresh, crisp and topped with excellent dressing. The pulled pork was juicy and delicious. The cheesy sausage was delicious as well. The sides were also great. Our server, Kristen?, was tremendous and took great care to make sure we were 100% satisfied. I would return here for sure and highly recommend this place. 

These folks know how to balance just enough smoke flavor as to not overpower the meat. Almost forgot to mention the sauces. Fantastic! In addition to the standard mild and hot sauces, they have a watery sauce that was out of sight. I can't remember what they call it. I look forward to returning to Big Daddy's for round two!!!

The food was good, I've had better. My steak was over cook the first time but they did cook me another one that was much better. The drinks were good and strong. The service how ever was not good at all. I saw our server maybe 2 times the whole time. She hadn't even asked if things were good. We had other servers taking care of us more than she was. I would go again for drinks and maybe an appetizer.

I took my dog here and did not feel like they cared at all about him - just about how much money they were going to make. I only go there for the free shots (and not the fun kind!) on the first Saturday of each month. Go to Pets First instead.

Cafe Ole is a great restaurant...just not at this particular location. I have good experiences with the food consistently at both Boise and Meridian locations, but the service is vastly different between the two. The Boise location has fantastic servers with great presence and skill, whereas this Meridian restaurant has unskilled workers, many of whom look like they'd rather be anywhere else. I no longer go to this location due to the service, but the food is still good!

If you find better tzaziki or however it is spelled, lol, let me know first. This stuff rocks it! Any gyro you get here is good, but dang, that ziki would be good on a flip flop. Hummus is equally as good. They are always friendly and nice. You cant find a seven dollar lunch many places these days, this place is worth double that. Thanks!!

Great experience after our dog broke her front paw. They took care of the broken bones, including meds, all for under $400. This would have easily costed more at West Vet. Thanks for the good service and not breaking our wallets.
My family loves Sunrise! The food is delicious and never disappoints. Every weekend, my boys request Sunrise over any other diner.

i was driving down the road someone had hit a cat i went into panic mode having two cats myself i had no idea were to take this poor cat i seen zamzos they reccomended all valley animal care center so rushed there they were so nice took him rite away VERY BIG HEARTS REALEY LOVE ANIMALS i was worried no one would take him because he was a stray THANK YOU GUYS SOOO MUCH FOR CARING

Big Daddy's is the best BarBq this side of the Mississippi. Being from Virginia....I know BarBq and this is simply the best around. I especially love their ,"Carolina " with slaw! The fries are really good and the fountain Dr Pepper is perfectly mixed. If you're hungry and in the mood for some hard corps southern style BarBq then Big Daddy's is your place!

They had stuffed peach french toast which was a game changer for me. So yummy and they are the type of place to make the order the cheapest price possible by switching in and out menu items. My husband also LOVED his pumpkin spiced pancake which was HUGE.

Really good shrimp tempura appetizer bites  but just Okay cucumber salad because I've had better elsewhere. The sushi here tastes and smells way past its prime - I would say probably 2 weeks or so old ? If this were Japan it would have been thrown out an hour after it was caught Service is also on the kind of crappy side  and slow but it is a Meridian Idaho restaurant so set your standards low.

The name itself called to me. I wanted it to be like going home but it was far from anything I've ever had served in Hawaii.

The food just didn't live up to the decor. I ordered the spicy yellow tail and it just wasn't that good. Maybe it just wasn't that fresh. Probably. 

I also ordered the black bean stir fried noodles and it just didn't meet my expectations. The noodles were udon and the black bean sauce had waaaayyy too much vinegar and too sweet.

The restaurant itself totally fits the look of the Village. It's furnished with modern flare and lots of natural accents. I totally dug that part. 

Our waitress was really nice, too. She did a great job, considering we took up two 4 tops. One filled with adults and the other table filled with kids ranging from 14-7 years of age. 

The space is beautiful .. The service was fantastic ...If they could only improve on the food.

We came to Twigs for a late night happy hour and sat in the bar section. No one came to ask us our order. No one. We sat there for about 15minutes and then walked over to the bartender and ordered our drinks from him. He was very nice and said that Mary would bring them to us. Mary arrived with our drinks without an apology for her not taking our order or noticing we had arrived. We thought maybe now Mary will come back and be attentive from that point on. That was not the case. We sat with empty glasses for ten minutes, so my husband walked over to the bartender again and ordered our next round. Mary delivered them, no apologies. Such bad service started to make the cocktails taste salty. So we bailed with a very low tip.
Excellent experience.  Talented massage therapist, Kyle, was able to customize my massage based on my needs.  He was awesome, very knowledgeable.

I would like to thank Ruth Olson for sticking with me!!!! I knew what I wanted and she took the time to find out how to do it.  Ruth took her time, step by step, to eventually get my hair and highlights to the color I wanted.

If you need a good stylists/colorist, try Ruth!

I lovvvve coming here. I have yet to have a massage that wasn't a 10/10. Everyone is also so friendly and the atmosphere is so relaxing. I would recommend to anyone looking to have a blissful afternoon.
They help me get road tar off my Camaro they are Awsome thank you so much always really friendly

We have bought and sold many homes in our life, and have never had a bad experience with a title company.  Their job is to be precise and complete, a good attitude is a bonus.  Well after 15 homes, we have had our first poor experience.  We were expecting a small check back from our sales, and even had our real estate agent confirm the amount.  When we started signing papers, we were asked for our check.  Of course we had none. After showing the employee the email that she had sent us confirming that we were to get a check, she admitted that she misinformed us originally.  She gave us a discount, which would have normally satisfied us.  But, we never felt welcomed in the office.  The employee was cold and did not appear to want to be there.  The meeting started out by her telling us how glad she was that it was Friday.  I will not be back.

Always fast, just like they say, and you always receive great quality subs. I go here a couple of times each week and I'm never disappointed. They're even cheaper than subway right now, and have all-in-all the best quality in their sandwiches. My favorites range from their Gourmet Veggie to the Club Lulu. I always add onions and extra lettuce because they're lettuce is so good and fresh. I had one from the Nampa location today, and it seemed to be a more bulkier sandwich than what I usually receive from this location, but im still looking forward to visiting this location since it is so close to my house.
Love the Picasso Roll,  and every thing else I have tried.  Great friendly staff,  must try if in The Village.

The breakfast here is as good as it gets.  Prices are reasonable and servings are large.  Enjoyed their eggs benedict, potatoes and a bloody mary.  I love that you can get a half order of many of the items.  

Breakfast was cooked perfectly, service was great and you can text them ahead to get on their wait list.  Nice sized waiting area

Was craving something different, rather than usual pizza or takeout, so decided to come in here due to the pictures looking real good. Food wasgood, had a plate with chicken katsu and korean brisket. Unfortunately, I ordered chicken egg rolls, 15 minutes gone past. Woman never put in the order.  No compensation on her error other than a "sorry." Nobody else in here besides us so it couldn't have been a rush issue. Do not think I will be returning and instead going to Island Kines in Nampa. I hope the next people to come in receive better service.
This hotel was clean, had good service, and all at a great price.  We have four children and our stay was well worth it.

We called to order 5 sandwiches delivered.  1st we were told out of pork, so switched to beef on restaurant owner's recommendation.   Also ordered hot dog with sour krout & onions but no bun due to gluten intolerance.  Two Bono burgers & frys, onion rings, plus a meatball sandwich completed the order.   We were told 30 minutes.  50 minutes later; Just about to call about lack of food when the order arrived.  Paid and sat down to eat.   First found the beef sandwich had soggy bread and not much flavor.  The hot dog was in a bun- not as ordered.  It had almost no krout.  The meatball sandwich was not good enough to finish.  The hamburgers did not have lettuce & tomatoe as ordered and promissed.  They did have a too- bright green relish that did not taste like relish!  They forgot the onion rings (we were not billed for them either.)  
Over all poor order accuracy & just OK food.

We live out of state but everu time we come we go to the children's museum. My son has the best time and always sleeps like an angel that night. There is so much to do. Our favorite section is trader Joe's because my son loves the carts.
I got the Special Pedicure and it didn't disappoint! Look at the fancy glow this color emits in the sunlight!

The food is absolutely amazing here. The service is even better. They are always on top of refills and the food quality is out of this world. I always get their biscuits! They are so flaky and delicious. I dont like going anywhere else for breakfast

Born and raised Chicagoan.   I was super excited to come into today as a surprise from my hubs.  Holy Hannah though...a wait for 2 beefs, fries and a plain dog?!  

There are a lot of authentic parts to the food but they lost me on the dry bread for the beef, the obviously not steamed poppy seed bun for the dog and the Idaho seasoned overlooked fries.  Where are the true crinkle fries?  I hope the beef and dog were Vienna brand and for cripe sake, train the staff about the food.

Wow! All I can say is that, if you decide to order the 14" sandwich you had better be hungry! I ordered a 14" roast beef with virtually all the vegetables. It was absolutely amazing with the vegetables definitely fresh. The staff were very friendly, helpful, and professional.

Subway has nothing on this place! If you want a great sandwich with fresh ingredients, this place is the place to go. It's not the cheapest sandwich option, but it is the BEST sandwich option!

Beautiful presentation of a large amount of quality furnishings, mattresses and home decor. Staff was attentive but not intrusive. Very helpful. I found some great bargains in home decor. I would recommend checking them out! I think you will be very pleased
***Liked it so much, I got a job here. Lots of in stock merchandise, and new furnishings and decor all of the time! Come see me if you need anything!

Most delicious pancakes ever! On a busy day we were seated quickly. Nice atmosphere, clean & comfortable. Besides the pancakes our party of 4 also happily devoured the chorizo hash, a meat Bennie and French toast.

I'm sorry but this place looks nice from the outside but dirty inside and smells like pure chemicals. I also had the worst massage done here and the lady who gave me a massage informed me that she wasn't a licensed massage therapist, which is illegal... The whole place is very relaxed and unprofessional. This is a real review from a real previous customer.

In our quest to conquer the Village food scene, we added the Kona Grill to our list.  We were bummed that we missed the recent UYE there, and vowed to try it ASAP. Glad we did.  

Our first trip landed the Jambalaya dish on the table.  It was surprisingly delicious and big enough to force me to take some home. It was filled with Andouille sausage (or a similar substitute) and was not too spicy.  I would order that again.  Ended with apple bread pudding topped with ice cream.  Heaven on a plate.  Just order it.  

We returned a few weeks later and I checked out the sushi menu.  Not able to find the roll I wanted, our waitress brought the sushi chef to our table.  I asked about the roll I wanted and two of them showed up to the table a short time later.  Coupled with some edamame on the side and, of course, apple bread pudding for dessert, I was one happy Villager.  

If you plan on dining on a Friday or Saturday night, call ahead for a reservation.  We did and got seated right away while the rest of Meridian waited outside for a table.  When full, this place gets very loud making it hard to have a conversation without raising your voice.  Go on a weekday if this is a turn-off.  If it's warm out, try for the patio and enjoy the fountains while you eat.  And get the bread pudding.

I see most people have flocked to Bono's because they are personally familiar with actual Chicago food while living in the Chicagoland area.  I'm not different; I grew up in the Chicagoland area and spent a total of 18 years there.

I go out of my for authentic Chicago food; especially pizza.  I've gone as far as to mail order Giordano's stuffed pizza.  After finding out about Bono's, I was amped to no end.  Today we ordered a stuffed Canadian Bacon and Pineapple pizza.  I couldn't stop talking about how excited I was.  When I saw our pizza was up, the excited look on my face was replaced with disappointment.

This "stuffed pizza" was an epic fail in every sense.  It felt and tasted like the pizza was made by taking a thin crust pizza, putting toppings, sauce and cheese on it and topping it off with another layer of thin crust pizza.  The taste was decent for what it was but any true Chicagoan would be embarrassed to associate this pizza with Chicago.

As for the service, the female that took our order was also delivering food to the tables.  She seemed a bit out of it but she wasn't rude at all.

I can sum up my visit in one line:  If you are AT ALL familiar with true Chicago food, think twice and think hard about visiting Bono's.  Though the food is decent, it can't hold a candle to authentic Chicago dining.

EDIT:  I'm sitting here having a cold piece of my "stuffed" pizza (because I'm hungry, not because I like it) and half way through, I'm overwhelmed with disappointment yet again.  I REALLY wanted to like this place but I reckon I got what I paid for.  I'm now going to throw away the remaining 50% of my pizza :(

Nope, nope, nope. 
It took 45 minutes for us to get our orders. Our friends ordered drinks which were almost $10 apiece and ended up being watered down or too syrupy. When we got the food, I ordered a shrimp salad which was made with only iceberg lettuce, little to no sauce and the shrimp was rubbery and had no flavor. My friend, she ordered a pasta dish that had way too much sauce and the meat was cold in it, and the pasta was almost undercooked. 
3/10 stars

I like it here. While most restaurants in Idaho are mediocre, Kona Grill has some interesting and unique choices on their menu. The variety will make it easy for anyone to find something enticing. Service has always been pleasant and efficient... but not overbearing.

Food was fantastic! I got the veggie hash, Bloody Mary and a red beer..so good! There was a long wait time but we found a couple seats at the bar which was perfect. Super friendly staff and fun atmosphere. I will definitely be back!
Excellent waitstaff, friendly and caring owner's, excellent portions and hot food. I highly recommend the chicken fried steak!!
LOVE LOVE LOVE Joe Mammas!! I dream of that big fluffy pancake and I am not a pancake person. I have never had a bad meal there and the service is always great!
Consistently good food. Service is almost always exceptional. Probably the best food in The Villages of Meridian. One of the better moderately priced chain restaurants I've eaten at.

First time going here with my friend for my birthday and we waited 20 minutes and no one came by to even take our drink order. The place wasn't busy, in fact there were many empty tables. We just left, worst service I have ever experienced at a restaurant.

I visiting Maui Wowi to see a friend who was there for a vendor fair.  I am one who feels that I should patronize a venue when I go to an event, so I stepped up to the counter and surveyed the menu.  The splashy tropical theme is evident at Maui Wowi, and I found my mood boosted by all the cheerful colors.   I had already enjoyed my morning coffee, but had not yet breakfasted.  Noting that some of their smoothies contain fresh banana.. I decided on a Mocha Banana smoothie. 
The young woman behind the counter took my order, and my money, and told me that if I wanted to go on into the vendor fair, she'd bring me my smoothie.   When she did I was delighted!  With just a hint of coffee and a great balance of chocolate and banana I knew I had made the right choice.  I was a tad apprehensive at the price ($5.50), but for a treat at a special event it was acceptable.    As you enter the building that Maui Wowi shares with some other businesses, there is a lovely lobby area with a fountain.. the kind of place I would enjoy going back to some day to take in the ambiance with a book and another beverage.
After driving 1901 miles round trip Boise to San Diego and back...still an Epic Shine!!! Thanks for suggesting the wash with the  protective coating!!!
This is head and shoulders above any other breakfast place in the valley. Excellent food excellent service.
All the Ribs you can eat the sign said.....Bait and switch! Single ribs...deep fried..not grilled or smoked...DEEP FRIED! Beyond bad....fool me once......

This place is great! I love the food. Veggie hash is to die for. Half order and you still get 2 eggs. I love that french toast can be ordered as your toast side. The pancakes are huge and tasty. Great service, friendly and quick. Plus the food is great. 

I wish they bad stayed in Eagle!! Went today bad service from Sarah! She was disappearing constantly. At the end she apologized and said she had to go ti the bathroom. Really? Not what you want to hear from your server. The food was good but We have been to the new location 3 times and have had bad service each time. I am going back to MoJoes.

While visiting my family, my daughter-n-law made an appointment for us. She is a member. We had a 2 Hr. massage. It was perfect. The staff is very nice and the masseuse very professional. I am thinking of becoming a member myself.

We've been wanting to try Sofra for quite a while but when we've come by during the week it's closed. We found out they close at 7pm on Fri/Sat and 5pm during the week. Nevertheless- I enjoyed the food, the waitstaff is friendly and take the time to explain items on the menu when asked. Atmosphere is simple, welcoming. Booths and tables. We had the beef kabobs with onions and peppers, great flavor and the house made dressing is delicious. We also had raznjici (small beef sausages with bread and condiments) and my favorite, the burek (meat pie). The burek is simple and, he thought, lacking heat but I'd love to get a couple to go along with the cheese pie version I haven't tried and make a spicy dipping sauce while watching the game. The dough is flaky, buttery and amazing- simple ground beef and tender onions inside. We'll definitely be back!
The wait staff was very knowledgeable about the Bosnian food history.  The food was very good. They have specials of the day, which I had and was very good.

I am pleasantly surprised every visit to this establishment. Because of the range of dishes and atmosphere of this dining establishment it holds a coveted place in my heart as one of the very few that I do not mind being on a waiting list for. 

I suggest the Raspberry crème brûlée for a desert, that first. The sushi is comprised of a very wide spread that can find its place with almost any palate. The main course dishes are more than what I would expect, flavorful when normally dry, rich where normally bland. 

All in all Kona is a great way to treat yourself for a night out, or bring close that date you've been courting for a while. It even fits for an outing amongst your friends. 

Take an escape to this little haven and leave your troubles at the door

the breakfast here is SO good and SO fresh!
Staff is extremely friendly as well!

my only complaint is that there bacon has pepper on it, but that is just a personal preference for me. Since I hate pepper, but LOVE bacon.

Must eat at breakfast joint.

Thouroughly disappointed in the whole experience. On their opening day we of course expected a long wait, we got to the restaurant around 11:00, we were sat within 45 minutes, which was not bad. When they sat us our table was disgusting, & had not been bussed. We waited an additional 15 minutes for our waitress & 15 minutes for our drinks. We then placed our order, & waited over an hour to get our food. We considered leaving many a times. Mind you when my spouses mimosa was brought out, it was a quarter of the way full in a plastic cup, while other tables were getting actual mimosa glasses that hadn't looked like they had been passed on from the table next door.

I understand it was the first Saturday, but if a business is not ready to take a jump from under a hundred seats to over 250, then they should not open. 
We paid for our entire meal with no compensation. My spouse and I have both worked food for a very long time & know how to handle these situations. 
There was a party of 10 next to us who received exceptional service, offered them boxes, asked how their food was & if there was anything else she could do. Like our money did not matter. 

Will never be back.
The food quality is great. The amount of food is huge for the reasonable price. They are neat & clean. If you want a pretty place and bad food go somewhere else. We order out it's great

There are a lot of things to like/love about The Village:  upscale shopping, family events and a great movie theater.  I like the outparcels (i.e. Noodles or Michaels) a lot more because of the easier parking situation.  The Yard House is terrific for Happy Hour.
Exelente sercicio y comida algo innovador que hace de que tu  paladar se satisface con los diferentes variedades de como hacer los desayunos

Pretty decent bbq considering we're not in texas.  Decent (generous, actually) portions at a reasonable price.  Wait staff was fine, no complaints there.

The pulled pork was quite good.  Also the garlic mashed potatos and mac and cheese.  The brisket was very fatty and needed to spend a LOT more time in the smoker so minus one star for that.  This place is better than just "ok" but if you are looking for really amazing, Texas bbq this isn't the place.

I'm a big eater and I was satisfied and full when I left....at $20, not so cheap but as I said, no complaints except for the brisket.

My son & I took a Basic Pistol course together (private lesson) from Leroy and had a great time.  Leroy is an excellent teacher; kept things clear and simple ("keep it simple, stupid" makes learning and recall easier).  He made sure we understood everything and spent extra time with us in the range.  Could not recommend  him and this course more highly.

Great service, the lady who served us was very friendly and accommodating. The food is great ... if you are tired of the regular American food and want something different but not too different ! 

I got the traditional Kabab and I also ordered the rice with kebab ! It was delicious  


The Turkish coffee is a very strong shot of espresso , so you definitely need something sweet with it ! The baqlava is the right choice ! Although I got the cake and it was great!

Really nice atmosphere - not too loud to have a conversation (like many other places at the Village). Service was prompt without rushing us or being annoying. My martini and margherita pizza were delicious.

Like waffles? Like sandwiches? Like crescents? Well the. Order one of their waffle sandwiches. There are some great choices including a grilled cheese for kids. The bread is a cross between a waffle and a crescent. So flaky and buttery. The crumbs all over my dress was proof of the flakiest crust I've ever experienced.

My sister ordered the rice bowl and it was huge! The veggies were incredibly fresh and perfectly cooked. 

And don't forget the huge selection of teas including varieties of boba, milk, blended and coffee! I ordered the coconut milk tea with boba and it was very refreshing!

There isn't much seating in the actual restaurant so if you come during the rush, you'll most likely have to order take out. But it's worth it!

My family and I were excited to try this restaurant. The decor is really nice. Very inviting and fun atmosphere. So we had high hopes. Unfortunately, the service was awful. I mean reeeaaallly bad!  It took way too long and two of our dishes were incorrect. So they had to remake it which also took forever. Very forgettable food as well. We will not be back.

Friendly customer service! I've been to Emily here three times now and I always leave feeling refreshed!  She has a firm touch which I like a lot! The membership is definitely worth it if your coming in at least once a month!  Highly recommend Emily!

This is the best service I've ever had!  From he initial call to set my appointment, they were super friendly and extremely professional. I had a major battery problem and they fixed that and did a full service on my car in a single day. I was thoroughly impressed with the quick turnaround and will definitely be back. I'm telling all my friends!

We have not been to Sunrise Cafe in years and decided to go on a Saturday, which was risky since most popular breakfast places have a long wait.  To our surprise we didn't have to wait to be seated.  The portions are big here so my husband and like to share a combo breakfast and then order an extra sometHing on the side. I ordered the cinnamon French toast combo that comes with three pieces of French toast coated with cinnamon sugar, four pieces of bacon and two scrambled eggs.  My husband ordered a side hash browns and two fried eggs.  There was plenty of food for both of us.  The French toast was yummy, my eggs were cooked perfectly. The bacon could of been a little more cooked and the waitress even asked if I wanted it cooked more.  I declined and really it was fine.  Overall it was a really good breakfast and I'm sure we will be returning.

Wow! What a park! What do you look for in a park? Fields for you and your kids to play sports? Various playgrounds for different ages? A splash pad? Giant musical instruments? A horseshoe throwing area? Paths for running on? Bathrooms? Tennis courts? Volleyball nets? Faux rocks for your kids to get rid of all of that pent-up energy? Plenty of parking? This park has it ALL! I first came here for my daughter's soccer practice, but came a little too early. No fear! We found the giant musical instruments and the splash-pad! It's quite a place! Very family-friendly. The park is giant so if you go, be willing to spend some time to truly explore.
This is the best place for breakfast in Eagle! I have been here many times and every meal has been excellent. The pancakes are simply amazing!!!

So happy I was referred to this salon, as I am new in town. Being my first time there I was a little nervous as I have really long hair. CJ made me immediately feel at ease and explained the the transformation process. We were transforming my very dark, dyed brown, long hair to gray/silver. Gray Hair, Don't care !! I'm so done trying to stay on top of the gray root grow out. Bless her heart just the foiling took about 3 hours, (we should have counted the foils LOL) but she made it a pleasant experience with getting to know me and telling me about place to go, as I had just moved here this past May. It was nice to have her full attention, as other places I have been, the hairdresser is working on other clients as well as me. My hair came out great and will go back to CJ to continue the process.  CJ thanks for the cheese and crackers :) The rest of the girls were really friendly also. Great Salon !!!
Really inviting atmosphere and the food is excellent whatever you order from the menu is really tasty and especially the desserts

Jimmy John's makes a decent sandwich. Their cheeses and meats are good quality, and their breads are decent. I don't like their tuna fish mix, as they put WAY too many onions or chives in there. Besides that, it's an okay choice for a sandwich in Idaho.

Met the owner Irina... she was amazing! Told us all about her different delicacies! So nice to have an authentic deli/European market in town that reminds you or home...even though you were born in the US.

I think my  daughter has created a following at school. She will take bags of these little Romanian Pufuleti for all her friends. I might have to buy a box next time.

If you haven't been there, make sure and stop in next time you're in town.

I was in the mood for calzone AND Philly......  How lucky I was to find both, and delivery.  I thought.  Philly has some VERY thinly sliced meat with a mystery white cheese.  Dry and bland.  The spinach and sausage calzone was horrible.  No cheese inside, the sausage was almost like ground beef, and the spinach was definitely from a frozen bag.  Stay clear.
