Great lunch place!  Is a hidden gem in the misheard of a business park. Friendly staff and great food.

We were seated and waited 10 minutes to order drinks. After they came we ordered food which took 45 minutes! 45 minutes for pasta, Mac and cheese, a burger, and a pizza! It was terrible and the food was mediocre. The restaurant was under staffed and the poor waitress (not her fault) kept forgetting our sides and drinks. The management here needs to hire more staff, the place was busy with only 2 waitress serving so many tables. Not as good as the other locations.

Visited Smoky Mountain Pizza in Meridian Idaho on 4/22/2012.    Talia the server was ahhhhmazing.l

Was personable, friendly and informative.    Just like a server should be and more.  Took time to talk to be informal as well.    Service fantastic and food good as well.

Thanks

Ate here with my mom yesterday.  The first booth we sat in, the table was so far away you couldn't reach it.  Very uncomfortable.  We moved to a better booth, but was next to a loud group.  Food was good.  Actually the cabbage rolls were very good, the kebobs were a bit overdone and on the dry side.  Baklava was a bit soggy. Music was fun, and I may give it another try as the waitress was charming and very helpful.

If I could give less stars as a rating I would. First off they said our apt would be between 12-3 and that they would call and let us know when they were a half hour out. We called at 1:30 to find out if we could get s better estimate of time for their arrival and was told we were next. The technician Marty finally arrived at 4pm. No call, nothing to explain he would be late or that he was on his way. When we asked how much it would be to install a kitchen faucet we were told $276 and it would take at least 2 hrs to install. Having waited all day for him to show up we decided not to proceed. Marty then said "It's ok, I have already put in my 9 hours today!" Then he argued with us and said that the company doesn't give estimated times of arrival, even though we were told by 3pm at least twice. Considering he was late and extremely expensive I will never recommend this company to anyone and nor will I ever call them again!
My son later in the week installed the faucet in less than 40 minutes, and he doesn't do this professionally.

Love Winco! People ask me why I don't order online from stores and have them deliver...
Well, I love stopping by and seeing my favorite employees   Michael & Yolanda in the deli, and Charles at the checkstand 1. They all are so kind and make my shopping trip with small children so pleasant. The store is always super clean and if I have any problems, the staff is always willing to help. Customer service and just plain nice, caring people are hard to come by anymore sadly. I appreciate the smiles and hard work from the store and have never had a bad experience. Been shopping there every week since they opened.

I had a business lunch here after checking out the previous Yelp reviews. What a fun and great place to eat! I couldn't decide so I had both the pho soup and one of the waffle sandwiches. The food was all great, especially the waffle sandwich which had this amazing, flaky, melt-in-your-mouth croissant-like waffle bread that was delicious but hard to describe.

Even better than the food was the service, you couldn't get better and more individualized personal service from a 5-star restaurant. A great place to grab some yummy and unique food.

I ate at this restaurant several weeks ago, and the food was good, however we had to wait about half an hour to be seated while the hostess did god knows what. There were about 3-4 other groups waiting to be seated along with us. I looked in the dining room, and counted at least 8 empty tables. There were an additional 4-5 that needed to be bussed. One group ahead of us was a large group, and we had to wait while the tables were arranged (not by the hostess), and that table seated with menus, and water before we could be seated.

We tried this restaurant again today, and the situation was again the same, a few groups waiting, numerous empty tables in the dining area, and the same hostess tried to look busy. We were told it would be a 25 minute wait. 

We left, and drove down the street to the Sunrise Cafe on Overland east of Orchard. The dining rooms are roughly equivelent in size, and it appeared to have about the same number of active tables. There was no line and we were invited to sit anywhere. A waitress was on our tail as we entered the dining room, and had menus on the table before we were able to sit down. As we seated ourselves, she took our drink orders and we had hot coffee and water in less than a minute. The menu is the same as the Meridian location, but the service is prompt and polite. Again the food was good. Perhaps the wait staff should be rotated through the Boise locate to see how a restaurant is supposed to be run. I'm sure it would positively impact their bottom line.

We had dinner with our kids in this place because we read the great reviews and people were right. The food is delicious, the portions are abundant, and service was good!
We had to wait for 20-30 minutes to be seated, but it was worth it. 
We will definitely go back with our family.

Second visit since they moved to new location.  1st Time was not a good experience but this time was great.  They don't have a senior menu but you can order half of the order.  Food was great, service was great, mimosa just so so

This is one interesting place as it's met with mixed reviews.

I personally love the pizza but occasionally we would get an over cooked pie while dining in. One would be cooked perfect and the other one not so we would have to wait while others would eat.

We thought this establishment was going to be our go-to place for weekly pizza but hasn't panned out because of inconsistencies.

When this restaurant first opened, it was quite busy and alive but the last time we visited this past summer, it was like a ghost town and the inside appearance reflected that.  No longer as clean and appeared to have a lot of employee turnover as some of the staff seemed inexperienced.  

We might give it one more chance.

I am mad it took me so long to try the gyro shack. I have now been 3 times in the last few weeks and have not been disappointed yet. The bread is soft, the fillings all pair nicely, and while the menu isn't huge, there is good variability between options to keep it from becoming mundane. Prices seem very fair, with the gyros ranging from around $5 up to an extra fully loaded one for around $10 (I'm a big eater and that one fills me up nicely). The staff has always been friendly and had no issues with minor tweaks or requests in order to give me a great experience. If you haven't been to one yet, do yourself a favor and give it a shot
Avocado egg rolls blow my mind! And the Macadamia Nut Chicken was to die for. Love sitting next to the giant windows that over look the fountain..! Fun!
Open from 5am to 8pm, conveniently located, with plenty of parking and a good staff. I have come to this location a number of times and have not been disappointed once.

Had dinner at Kona Grill a couple nights after they opened to the public and to my surprise, it was excellent.  The managers were everywhere, the staff was friendly and accommodating and the food was delicious.  No reason to give this place anything but a 5 star rating.  We will be back next weekend.

Yummy! What a variety of food and delicious flavors. We have been here several times and will be back! So far we have tried the pho, the fish and chips, the waffle sandwich, the boba and my favorite their egg rolls!!! Packed full of veggies and cooked just right, a must try! I also love their fries, seasoned and slightly spicy, I love it!

I received my invoice -- and it was actually less than what I was initially quoted.  I like that the technician made decisions, all in keeping with what my physician needed -- and ended up saving me money.  Didn't have to happen that way!  Yay IMIC!!

I love this place! The martinis are always spot on!! We ordered Brussel sprouts for an appetizer and they were phenomenal and I have always hated Brussel sprouts but they make them amazing. For dinner I had steak penne and every bite was savory. They don't skimp on the steak either. You definitely get what you pay for. The only bad part is the took the best meal off the menu... The steak sandwich.
I didn't love my meal. I thought some of the flavors were bland. Although a bit different (Greek vs. Bosnian), many of the food choices are similar and better from Mazzah.

Our food was delicious- our server was super sweet, but we felt like she knew nothing about the menu when we asked any questions; it was pretty frustrating. Again she was very pleasant, just didn't have a lot of confidence when she spoke, nor was she able to give good recommendations. 
Being first time diners our takeaway was that the servers menu knowledge could have huge improvements; that's one of the most important things to know in this industry

Great spot! I am a huge breakfast guru and this place was an overall great experience. First, we were seated right away and our waitress was really accommodating. There is a huge menu so be prepared to have to choose between a bunch of yummy options. I decided to have the Denver omelette. It came with a huge omelette, a HUGE fluffy pancake and hash browns. Huge portions and delicious comfort food. Our total for 2 of us with drinks was $34 and we had leftovers. Great find! I recommend to anyone in the Boise/Meridian/Eagle area.
I like for the most part. I am not sure if it's really worth the cost of the food... I feel like I am paying for the venue more than the food. I will go back. Service was great.

We have a child with allergies and went to Kona grill because they are known to be on top of allergies and have had a previous good experience. They completely let us down at lunch today on many levels. After ordering for my son and saying to have his burger dry 3 times they said it always comes out that way for kids. It had sauce on it he couldn't have that had egg in it. He complained and I had  a bite and realized it was sauce. This is his lowest allergy so we were grateful to deal with  bathroom issues and hives vs his breAthing stopping like all his other allergies. 
The manager clearly had  no idea what to do and alMost seemed unbothered by the  mistake that could have cost a life otherwise
Beyond that we had ranch served to us that wouldn't move because it was so old and congealed. Like tip
Upside down and nothing  moved. Who wants to eat  raw fish if that's what the ranch looks like.

Nice, fresh spring mix salad with raspberry vinaigrette and the best white pizza EVER!  Would eat there often if I didn't live in California.  Am anxious to eat there again when traveling through Meridian.

We came here for Sunday breakfast. We happened to get a waitress who was working on her last day. It was very apparent it was her last day. The service was the worst we have ever had here. I am giving it 3 stars because we have had better experiences. Today was not busy at all. We had a $100 table. Each kid had raw pancakes so I don't recommend the pancakes. We also never got drink refills.

I had the eggs Benedict which were pretty good. If you come to eat here I highly recommend ordering biscuits and gravy for breakfast. For lunch finger steaks.

This place will make you feel like grandma made home made bread, went to the deli, put together one of her perfect sandwiches only she can do and sat you down and said...eat up.

Simple laid back atmosphere, day changing good attitude from all the staff, and amazing bread make this a must go lunch spot if you are in the south meridian area. These are the type of simplistic sandwiches you crave at lunch. Nothing crazy different going on here, but the quality of the bread and attention to detail make these sandwiches crave worthy....its like they imprint themselves in you so you need them, yern for there soft chewy sourdough goodness, and leave feeling satisfied and in high spirits with a rejuvenated positive outlook on life....just like grandma's do. Keep it up sourdough eatery, and whatever you do, dont lose that starter.

Really nice place to shop, hang out, and eat some delicious food. There is a nice playground for kids by the big fountain. Stores you would find at any other mall- Urban Outfitters, PINK, American Eagle, Anthropology, etc

We were a party of 9 visiting from San Diego California and our visit was great! We originally heard about Joe Momma's from WebMarkets . I had the Kitchen sink Omelet and it had to have been one of the best omelets I've ever had. My aunt had the chicken fried steak, and it was amazing. We will definitely be returning on our next visit.

Worst ever customer service. 
Seems like a big red flag. I've been a customer for 25 years with a land line and internet and had to go through multiple updates to my system to keep current.  As long as you don't have an isssue all is well but if you call customer service, hold on to your vacation time because your gonna need it. 
I've been having issues with my service crashing and I have to reset my router over and over and this last time I couldn't get it to come up so I called the hope desk. First thing they tell me is that I'm eligible for an upgrade to my internet speed. I explain that I can't get to the internet so what good is a faster connection... it will still be zero. She didn't understand so I had. To explain that if centurylink won't connect me to the internet it doesn't matter how fast my upload and download speeds are because they are all zero. 

Now I finally make it through the first line of terrible customer service...sellsellsell and am able to talk to a technician who has me run through the same diagnostics that I've already told them I've done and nothing works.  I'm told that I don't have internet coverage for service calls of their own products so I have to upgrade my line-backer to cover internet so I pay for that and make an appointment. I schedule a 9-1:15 window and take a vacation day from work. The tech is a mo show. I call and get some excuses that the system flagged my service call as an error and it was not dispatched. So I had a new appt scheduled for the next afternoon and took another 1/2 day vacation to be home. Again no technician and no notification. Called again and asked for a manager and had to wait for 10 minutes. This guy works with me and schedules an appt for Saturday morning stating that he has a different set of technicians so Saturday would be great. So Friday afternoon I get a text that the technician is on his way. What am I supposed to do in 5 minutes I bust my butt to get home leaving work again because I know that if I'm not home they will cancel me again. 
The technician works on my line and updates my router and all is well for 5 days. Now I don't have internet again today!  
Working from my hotspot today just to get some work in. Looks like I need to find a new ISP because centurylink is no longer anyone I want to trow my money at.

We went to Pineapple Express the other day and everything was great. The lady let us try everything we weren't familiar with and was very patient. The portions were huge and we had lots of leftovers. The Kailua pork was outstanding. The coconut fried rice was great and the spam fried rice even better. I love the concept and atmosphere.

Not use to the area, in town for a long business trip. I couldn't find this place at first, it was like my GPS took me to the wrong place. It was around Noon on a Friday, it doesn't face Eagle Rd, but in the back office suites that face the other direction. 

PROS:

- I had the Pastrami Sand which and Minestrone Soup. I didn't think I would be able to eat all of it. I was wrong! Large portions, but VERY good! One of the best Pastrami Sandwiches I have had. It comes with a pickle too. 

- The price is good, not too high but not cheap either! You get what you pay for.

- This place was packed, but moved quickly. It being packed isn't bad at all, it was a good sign that I have found the right place. 

Neutral:

- Doesn't take AMEX. 

- Open weird hours, lunch only
Summary:

I will defiantly come back here and will try to come back again while on this trip. I will recommend this place to my friends here in Boise.

We had dinner here as a family.  The food here isn't bad.  A bit pricey overall.  One of our meals was too spicy and we sent it back.  With one bite out of the sandwich they charged us full price and decided to tack on a set of fries for an additional $3 to make us happy.  We weren't happy about how they charged us.  I guess we wont be going here anymore since their customer service was terrible.  I was very calm and also very surprised we were treated that way.  The manager refused to accommodate also.

My family has been hitting up Big Daddy's regularly for a few months now. We love the Prime Rib special on Friday nights and the pulled pork. The only thing keeping this from a 5 star review is their side items are not great. Baked potatoes are a consistently hard.  Maybe need to cook a little longer.  The servers are always wonderful and would really encourage others to give them a try.

Second time eating here and will be the last, thought we would give it another try even though we weren't very happy the 1st time. Should have turned around and walked out when we walked in because it smelled like wet dirty carpet... there were 4 of us and nobody was happy with their food. The hamburgers were bland, I ordered a Calzone and it was disgusting. The waitress was ok but not very friendly.

First Time Eating Here

Food: 4.5/5 (Turkey & Swiss)
Waffle was nice and flacky went great with greens and turkey. 

Fries were solid

Price: 4.5/5
$10 for a sandwich and fries

Atmosphere: 5/5
Staff was very kind and decor was very cute. 

I will definitely come back.

Food is ok, drinks are good and a good price. Service is SUPER slow. Especially at the drive through. I've been sitting here 10 min... still waiting.... so I guess I'll just come for the drinks from now on.

This is some seriously good bbq. We were new to the area and found the location very convenient with and easy in and easy out parking lot. The wait staff were exceptional. They were very friendly and the bbq was awesome. We will definitely be coming back again.

I go to this gym nearly every week day and the staff are very knowledgeable and helpful with any questions you may have. Currently there are some renovations being done and some of the equipment has been replaced with newer stuff. Overall a very good gym and would recommend it to anyone looking to exercise or get fit.

93rd review of Big Daddy's BBQ in Meridian, Idaho off Cherry and Linder. This is my 397th review. 

I'm a fan! I've seen this place several times when passing by and it's an option on Uber eats. AS I was driving by tonight, I thought "tonight's the night"! and quickly pulled in. I've been looking on Yelp and I've wanted to try the stuffed tots, and they didn't disappoint. 

I needed to get "to-go" since my family was at home. My daughter, Britney and I, sat inside, had some good laughs, took pics with the sweet and spicy sauces (she's way more spicy than sweet-- don't let her fool ya!), and played tick tac toe with the crayons and kids menu that they provided to us. 

The inside is on the smaller, yet perfect size. The place is decorated pretty cool, with stuff everywhere, but it all works. The staff was friendly. My daughter asked about their logo, and the waitress explained that is a replica of her dad, the owner aka "Big Daddy" which my daughter thought was cool. 

As I said, we got our food to-go, which took no time at all. The bundled up each meal in a styrofoam box, with plastic silverware and 2oz. plastic cups of extra sauce. 

We ordered: A chili cheeseburger with fries (you can select any side, a mushroom swiss burger with upgraded stuffed tots ($6.99 as an app), a kids meal ($6.50) with upgraded ($.50) mac n cheese with bacon, and brisket nachos (french fries). All the food had good flavor, was well put together, and a nice albeit average serving size. 

I recommend Big Daddy's BBQ! Order it on Uber eats if you don't want to go out.

This is undoubtedly my favorite Hawaiian place ever. Better than Maui. The staff is super friendly, expectedly laid back and the food is so authentic and flavorful. I have had the pork and the Korean chicken and they are both amazing. Super fresh food and the restaurant is clean and comfortable. An absolute must if you are in Meridian.

A lot of big companies get a lot of bad reviews for customer service, and rightfully so. I, for one, absolutely HATE automated attendants!! They suck! For one, you input all of your information, who you are, where you live, your account number, date of birth, your social, your parents' and siblings' birthdays, how many children and pets you have, your neighbor's mothers' maiden names, etc. (You get my point.) And then, you wait the said 93 minutes on hold, listening to the repetitive music and message, only to have non-English speaking person ask you to repeat everything you just input. RIDICULOUS!!! So irritating! That alone, should piss everyone off!

So, back to Josh at CenturyLink. I walked in to discuss service for a business purpose. (I've not had cable or internet at home, for years.) I walked out with a new modem/router and the feeling that this guy was going to take care of any (yes, I'm expecting them) issues I may have with the installation/service of my internet service. And, he did. (Josh, there was that like three or four day delay in responding to my email. Forgiven.) I believe I got a fair price for the service and equipment. I dislike paying for technology, since it changes every six months. Oh well!

I had issues with setting up my service and was told that I'd get a one-week credit. Then, according to my software company, the service was "jittery" and it was recommended that I upgrade my upload speed. I spoke with my service tech and Josh about and it's being upgraded today.  Then, as Josh was looking at everything going on with my account, noticed that I was eligible for a different upgrade and put in the order for it. That will happen next week. I think that's pretty good service!!

No, I still despise automated attendants and think the world would be a better place without them. Truly. I think that good customer service is not outwardly appreciated enough and people are so quick to post negative reviews/videos/memes/tweets/grams/etc. 

So, Josh! Thank you for your good service.

We've taken our cats to the All Valley Animal Care Center several times during the last year, even though they regularly see a different veterinarian. The staff was very good about communicating with and faxing information to our regular veterinarian.  All Valley center is open and staffed 24/7 so can take veterinary emergencies at any time. (No need for appointment, although they also provide well care by appointment.) They can also process lab work in house so you receive quick results from blood tests, x-rays, etc. We've dealt with several different veterinarians at the center and they've all been great.  Their prices are very reasonable, especially for an emergency center when you're taking your pets during weekends or middle of the night.  The lobby is large and comfortable (so it's easy to keep cats away from dogs while they are waiting.)  Our cats seemed at ease during their visits.  When we visited during regular hours, they were much busier and we had to wait a little longer. But the staff asked if our cat was actively having a seizure and would have taken him back for care immediately if he'd needed it, even though their treatment rooms were all full. Like E.R. at the hospital they must give priority to emergencies. All Valley center also provides boarding which can be especially helpful if you have a pet which needs medications while you're gone on vacation. We live in Southwest Boise so this Meridian location is conveniently located for us. When our pet has a medical emergency it's nice to have a place close to where we live.
This is a place we frequently visit and have never been disappointed.  The food is always good and the staff friendly.  We even have family from out of state that eat here every time they're in town.

A picture would be worth a thousand words BUT I dug in and started eating and it was gone before I knew it! If you haven't had the Stuffed Blueberry French Toast here-don't wait any longer!!  I had never had French toast that was deep fried before. The crunchy texture it gives to the thick slices of bread is awesome! This toast had the perfect amount of cream cheese and blueberries stuffed inside. I was not disappointed at all. The serving is generous for one person.

This review could actually could actually cover both stores; the one in Meridian and the one in Eagle. 

We were killing time waiting to eat in Eagle and decided to stop in the Pizzeria to have a beer and watch the hockey game and were very pleased. The service was great and beer and drinks were great. 

Then on Sunday on the way to some friends we decided to get a pizza on the go and it was was great. We ordered a Gluten Free pizza and it was some of the best we have eaten. 

Both places were great. If I lived here I would return. For all of you who do live here you are lucky.

The food was pretty decent, no complaints there. If the food was the only factor, probably would be 3-4 stars. But this is supposed to be fast-casual right? I was thinking like a smash burger type pace. It was literally 42 minutes from order to food. Homestead is faster than that. May try again in a few months when they have their kinks worked out (apparently they had two people quit today and a broken cook top, but still, at least let us know that up front). Food was decent, but Hugo's is just around the corner...

Since the acquisition of IAC, many improvements have been made & continue to be done. I mainly go for use of the pool. The water has been cleaner in both the pool and hot tub. There are plans to remodel the locker rooms and showers. 

I just hope that Crunch continues to hold the Aqua Zumba/ Tabata classes. It's a great varietal addition to the water fitness courses.
Love the bbq nachos, and the sweet heat wings! Great service, and great local place to eat.
Clean and cute yogurt bar. Friendly girl working the register. Our family tried a few flavors and really enjoyed our treat! This was our first time visiting and we will definitely be back!

Best breakfast in Eagle. I eat here every time I come to Boise! They have a smoked Steelhead trout Eggs Benedict that is to die for! Homemade Hollandaise that is velvety smooth with a lovely lemony finish. The poached eggs are always perfectly done and the hash brings have the perfect crispiness. The service is also friendly, attentive and always with a smile.

The stuffed French toast is the bombbbb!!!! Everything is top notch from the crispy hot hash browns to the generous portion of fresh grilled ham! You may have to wait a few minutes for a table especially on Saturday and Sunday morning but it's because more and more people are finding out about this hidden gem! Service is prompt and kind and they even have an espresso machine which my girlfriend is very happy about:)

This place is incredible.  I've only been twice and had the Pho Tai (soup) both times, but it was very good and consistent.  Even though I've had slightly better elsewhere, it was still very good, and the service was great.  The guy remembered us from our first time, asked us some related questions from our first visit of a week before, remembered what we had ordered, and even remembered to bring me a specific garnishment that doesn't come standard that I had requested the first time.  I mean, c'mon, how can you beat that?

The ambiance is also superb.  It's very clean and upscale.  Very nice total immersion.  HIGHLY recommended.
I love the new classes Crunch offers. They're only 30 minutes, but they work you hard!

I'd give a better rating. If they had more stuff and more organized you know if we need more efficient at what they do the food was exceptional everything we got tasted great. Large portions of food too.

Meh, ok food. Waffle "bread" was tasty (something unique).  Highly recommend getting food to go as the joint is very greasy smelling . Expected a bit more meat on the Pastrami sandwich.  What was there was good, but a bit stingy on amount.  I'd eat there again, but call in order ahead and eat elsewhere.  3 stars for ok food.  If I was only rating on the physical location I'd probably drop to two or one star for the aforementioned greasiness wafting throughout the joint.

We live in Lochsa and love having this place right around the corner. They have a large dining area with comfy seating. The staff is always accommodating and the food is great! Can't go wrong with the steak classic!

Parking and entry into the theater is my only complaint. Because this theater is located within The Village, parking can be limited. You have to enter though The Village which does provide great shopping and restaurants. The theater is beautiful. A good selection of concessions including reasonably priced gelato. 

Leather(?), electric reclining seats are exceptionally comfy. Overall the experience feels very luxe.

Always a great hangout place! The village location has many things to do and I often come here about 2-3 times every two weeks! Some of the people are weird but that's everywhere you go. The restaurants are fantastic but most are over priced. The shopping is great and there's a movie theatre. What is better than that??! Love the place and all the activities that one can do while there

Great happy hour prices, 7 days a week! Awesome bartenders with sparkling personalities! :) Tons of tv's to catch the game on, pool tables, dart boards, dj's on the weekends so you can bust a move on the dance floor, some patio seating if you prefer to enjoy whatever Idaho weather we're having, and an elevator for your convenience!

Great!!! The dentist and office personal are very pleasant to use. I trust my dental needs and kids with Willow Tree. 
S. Jackson

Went in to have a gel manicure and new polish on my toes. I have natural nails, not acrylic. So, rather than soaking the gel off, the owner filed all the polish off, taking with the polish my natural nail and beds. She did not soak my hands, just pushed the cuticle back with the file and did not bother even trimming them. So, $64.00 later it looked like a child painted my fingernails with gel and polish on my toes. By the next day all my natural nails began breaking off at the quick cause they had been grinded away. My nail beds are trashed and now I have to grow them again.

Stopped in for a nightcap after an evening in the Village. Nice atmosphere, not too crowded and we were sitter quickly. Older crowd than the bar across the way we checked first, but a mix mix of people all around. Service was very slow, and it took us almost a full hour to get a sprite, coffee and a piece of cheesecake. Server was very friendly, but it was ridiculously slow from greeting to check. 

Cheesecake was heavy but delicious, and they kindly put the caramel sauce on the side (great move and I highly suggest it!). Atmosphere was good and we enjoyed the last stop of our evening out. I would love to give them four stars but the lagging service made me hesitating to try them if I ever have any place to go after eating here, such as the attached movie theatre perhaps.

They are nice and friendly. However they sometimes mislead you and I've had to pay for full masks out of pocket because they say my insurance won't cover them, which may be true, but one day someone tells me it's fully covered and no cost to me and the next day they are calling me with past due charges.  I would t trust their billing department anyways.

First time at the new place.  Senior couple with a cane.  First we were taken to the Bar area with very high seats and booths that you have to climb up to get into - hello seniors should never be expected to maneuver that.  The wife not only had a cane but no way she could boost herself into a tall seat.

Went to a different area which was much better accommodations.  They only had service set up for one and no spoons to stir your coffee or tea.  

My toast was just warm and had little or no butter.  Hubby had to ask for jelly.  His toast was warmed bread is now he described it.  His Omelet was ok except the cheese was not melted at all.  It was very crowded on Jan 2nd.  

IMHO they moved from a smaller restaurant to one that is too big as it appears they can't handle the load.

We might return in 6 months or so and see if it has improved.

Best cheesesteaks in the treasure valley - by far. Friendly, helpful service, clean, inviting atmosphere. The garage doors were open which gave it a cool indoor/outdoor vibe. My wife says the chicken cranberry walnut salad was on of the best she has ever had.  We will be back for sure!
They could do so much with this space because right now there is no ambiance. The service was slow and the food was very average (chili-dog). It's too bad because they are in a great location.

OMG - Amazingly Delicious! I visit Boise 2 to 3 times a year and today was my first visit  I will visit every time I visit from now on! The food waa perfectly seasoned and just melted in my mouth. The coffee was pretty strong, just how I like it  The service was great as well. The staff and food made the wait worth while.

I needed a tooth to fill up called 2 other dental clinic Lowery Dental and Affordable dentire they quoted me $400 tooth fill up with x-ray and exam. Than I called Willow Tree Dental Meridian and Cherry Lane they said the X-ray and Exam is $1.00 and the fill up cost $180 so they had appointment available for the same day and I couldn't do because I had to go to work. They schedule me for the next day after that I read their reviews online I was a kind of didn't  want to go their, but the next day I did go anyway. The customer service, nurse, and the doctor was friendly, new building, but the equipment are a kind of old. They tried to sell me a little more than I really went for, but that is the nature of being in business, but be smart. They don't charge too much which helps some people a lot, but a little disorganize and overall they are good I will go back their if I need to go back.

Joe Mamma can cook.  But Joe Momma needs to learn to hire better.  Best hollandaise sauce I've ever had, and eggs benny were D-lish!  But the waitress was possibly high...or really slow of wit.  She never came back once to fill my coffee.  I asked for a set of silverware and eventually after our food got there just pirated it off another table because she forgot.  I asked for water and she forgot that too... and it was only moderately busy.  

Bottom line: food is good. Help is hit or miss.

Good food at a reasonable price. The broccoli and beef are a favorite as well as the orange chicken. They are fast and you are on your way quickly. I usually get a three item meal, I'm at about 8 bucks with that meal. WAY better than a burger and fries, and better for you.

We are visiting from CA and this is a really great place for breakfast. We had the veggie scramble and the flavors were superior. Price is really reasonable.  We highly recommend this restaurant. Nicole was really friendly and attended to our every need. Thank you for great meal

Convenient location.  And kind of a cool little layout.  But my night was immediately dampened by the bartender with a heavy and condescending attitude - short, bald guy with a full beard and a little less in weight and width than the other tender.  This guy was rude both times we went up to the bar, as if he was incredibly annoyed at my mere presence and audacity to ask a question.  The attendees were a nudge towards the lower end of the spectrum though.  So maybe he was just telling me I didn't fit in.  I'll give it another shot in the future... The other tender was kind--such a novelty.

Other than the price, which was still not as bad as we feared, everything was great. Our waitress (Jordyn) was excellent and the manager stopped over to check on us. Our food was prompt and delicious and my husband was obsessed with the fries. He said the sliders were a good sized and well made. 

The over all atmosphere was awesome, we are poor 20 somethings out on a random adventure and felt like treating ourselves and this place fit the bill. We had tons of fun and really enjoyed watching the fish!

This is one of the worst night out dinning experience in a while. The wait was long the food was OK the price was high and they were out of a lot of things at 7 PM on an event weekend. People said they were out of things and when I complained to the management they found it for me but it took a long time with no real apology. For a supposed better dinning experience what a let down. I will never go to the jobs grill again unless it is forced on me by a wedding or a funeral.

I didn't experience any bad attitudes or rude behavior on my visit. I walked in with a true emergency. At 7:30pm, I called and let them know I would be arriving shortly. My Berner swallowed an oxtail whole and it was lodged in his esophagus. Dr. Griggs was fantastic and took the time to walk me through the endoscopy procedure, good and bad things that may or may not happen. I have only been in Idaho a week and have not been able to develop my team of doctors for my boys' care. They are my babies! I can't say enough about the front desk staff too, cheers for the night crew, they made me feel like I was the only patient and dropped everything when I asked how my boy was doing. I did not give 5 stars because I haven't received a follow up call. Welkin has made a full recovery and I'm happy to have my youngster back!!

My husband and I enjoyed a wonderful breakfast. Love that they have espresso style coffee. The huge pancake was totally awesome. My husband enjoyed his crab cakes beenie. Didn't have much of a wait from the time we ordered to receiving our order. We will be back.

This is my first review of a restaurant.  We checked in online and were seated within 5 minutes of arriving.  We then ordered our food.  30 minutes later they brought 5 of the six orders we immediately informed the guy ghat brought it out that we were missing the club.  Our waitress stopped by 10 minutes later and we informed her the order was still missing.  I then had to go to the manager and after waiting another 10 minutes.  His response was "oh let me see" by this time everyone at the table had eaten there entire meal.  The order did come out with the check.  The food is good here but the service SUCKS.

We stopped into Bono's because we were wanting to try some dessert and were digging the sound of "Frozen Custard".  I had the frozen custard with butterscotch on top and wasn't impressed in the least. It tasted like standard food service ice cream to me. We also tried the cannolis. They were super bland and forgettable. I'll revise my review after trying their pizza and italian beef sandwiches. I won't be returning for the sweets for sure.

I won't be going back to All Valley!  After taking 2 dogs there for 2 years and spending thousands of dollars on their care you would think that you would be treated better!  I made an appointment at the beginning of the week to take my 2 dogs in for heart worm tests on Friday.  We arrived and checked in and were told we would be put on the board and taken to a room soon.  As per usual it was busy and there seemed to be many employees but not much getting done.  We waited and waited and had front desk folks look our way but never asked if we had been helped yet.  After 45 minutes I went to the desk to ask how much longer and they didn't even know that we were waiting and needed to be seen even though we were checked in and had the dogs weighed.  She went to check and find out what happened which took 5 plus minutes and returned and said a vet tech would be out to do the test- we didn't even need a room!  After a few more minutes of waiting we told the front desk we were leaving and going somewhere else and all they said was ok.  Not exactly the way to run a business!  I shouldn't be surprised as it is always a wait with an appointment and then  a wait to be checked out and get  meds.  Most of the Vets want to run lots of expensive tests for each visit and make you feel like a terrible pet parent if you refuse.  I keep going back because we love the boarding facility but this is it.  My time is valuable and they don't respect me as a customer.  Good luck if you go there, hope you have lots of time and money.

I'm stealing my girlfriends account so I too can leave a review on Joe Mommas. I am a self proclaimed pancake enthusiast. Trust me when I say I've eaten more pancakes than most, by a lot. These are the BEST freaking pancakes in Boise. They taste like the quintessential perfect pancakes, not flour, not something that should be covered up in toppings or drowned in syrup. I've talked personally with Ms. Joe Momma and though she wont share her recipe she has told me there is like 20 ingredients in her recipe. Again as the pancake king (dont question that its true) I must say these are in the top 5 pancakes I've had in my life.

Purchased some letters. We were not happy and contacted the company to see if they could help rectify the problem. They offered a 50% credit on a reorder.  Since shipping was paid for the first purchase and would be for the 2nd it doesn't really offset the cost. A $100 spent that was a waste of money for letters that were really worth $20! Won't purchase from this company again. Not all that impressed!!

German Star is the best place to take your vehicle.Ken is honest and trustworthy.
They do not overcharge and they tell you the truth.I would not take my car anywhere else.  Tony

We waited 2 hours for our food and it was never delivered. We got up and walked out. We sat down in our area first before anyone else. The tables around us filled up and those tables were all served before us. We tried to be nice and stay but for heavens sake it's Christmas! We have family in town that we now had to book another lunch spot at. The manager never came over to acknowledge the delay or even offer us gift cards. My family will not recommend or come back.

I keep wanting to like Kona, but every time we go the service is inattentive as if the servers have too many tables. Food is so-so; happy hour redeems somewhat but only because I wouldn't pay full price for the food.

Wow, watch out for the hard sell and scrutinize your bill!

Our family group of 6 (4 adults, 2 teenagers) went to dinner at KG last night and found out the hard way that we really needed to read the menu closer, as well as watch out for charges on our bill... 

Our server was like a commercial. She made it clear that KG's corporate level business provided them access to the best meat, highly recommending the two most expensive meat entres on the menu. A bit of a turn off, I must admit. But then, to top it off, when our nieces ordered, in a casual tone our server asked would you like soup or salad with that, implying that it was included with the meal (which it was not, and she did not bring that to our attention either) but also not drawing our attention to that fact that each soup/salad was really a meal in itself, not a first course sized offering.... kaching, ring up another $25 on the bill! Upsize that shrimp pasta with extra meat (really, did you think it was needed?) Kaching... another $8. Wow, in one fell swoop, our bill was upped by 20%. She was good. Moving on...

An appetizer was ordered (angry edamame) and it arrived as plain... an offer was made to bring some 'angry sauce' to dip them in but that took another 10 minutes to reach the table, by then half were already gone, rather than let them get cold. Oh well.

The piece d resistance was my husband had ordered the Ahi Sandwich, looking forward to the aioli and taro fries that came with it. When our order finally arrived, brought out by other server-helper types, apparently our server had upsized him to the ahi entre (which included neither of the things he wanted) and the server helpers acted surprised when we pointed out this error as well. It was impossible to get our original server's attention (she was too busy getting a coffee delivered by a friend from Starbucks or the like). Rather than make a fuss at this point as everyone else at the table had already been served, we said the plate would do but mentioned that the price of the entre was different from what we ordered. They acknowledged that and did offer to bring out an order of the taro fries as that is one of the things he had looked forward to with his original order.

Well, finally along came the bill. To our surprise we found that not only did we get charged the all the additional soups and salads (to be fair we didn't read the menu close enough to realize they were extra), we were charged full price on the ahi entre we hadn't ordered AND were charged for the order of taro fries that had been offered by the server. AND the taro fries ended up on the wrong tab as well.... seriously....?!?

Needless to say we were astonished at the hucksterishness of the server and her parrotlike ability to shower us with the glories of KG but then not respect us enough to listen to our orders and educate us on the process of KG's menu. Our experience was less than ideal. The food was fine, but we won't be back.

We decided to give this place a try tonight and WOW is it good!  From the friendly staff to the delicious home made recipes, this is now our favorite BBQ spot in the treasure valley!  If you haven't tried it, be sure to stop by soon!

Maui Wowi is a great meeting place for coffee, snacks, smoothies and other fun stuff.  I love the set up of this coffee shop which has a nice Hawaiian theme with a water feature and tropical forest as you enter.  They have a variety of seating with couches, tables as well as conference rooms that you can reserve if your party will purchase something to help them in return.

Pros: Quiet meeting rooms that are spacious and so convenient.  I really appreciate how Maui Wowi has set themselves apart offering coffee along with meeting rooms.  We had meetings here for over a year and the drinks were always great and the service was always a cut above the rest.

Cons: Parking lot is awkward with very little convenient parking and tight spots.  It is hard to back up when parked at the front.  Minor issues.  Drinks are much higher priced here than other coffee shops.

Great food and service. We went for my mother's birthday she got a free personal pizza. We also went as it turns out was happy hour so we got our appetizers for half off. Not only was the food delicious we got a great deal on it to. I am definitely going back.
Poor service and lousy food - not going back. I think we waited 15 mins for 2 sandwiches and the staff brought us plates for pizza - confused
Great place for breakfast! Incredible Homemade strawberry jam for your toast! Overall it's well worth the breakfast meal

Good quality food. Great service. At home feel to the restaurant. I suggest you do the online waiting list on the weekends. It lets u know how long u have and they will text u when it's your time to be seated. The weekends can be up to an hour wait! Crazy huh?! That's how good this place is.

Not the first time we have been disappointed by this location. The fries are always cold and tonight takes the cake. They forgot one of our orders of fries. Asked for them and gal told me they were in the bag. I then handed her the bag so she could verify since not believing we were missing an order. Got home and my boys opened their burgers. Ketchup only is what they ordered. I'll post a pic of what they got. We will be sticking to the other location from now on.
Karen is wonderful! This place isn't open for much of the day, but it is so worth it to stop in for lunch. You won't be disappointed here!

Great food. Worth the wait for a table. Even worth the wait for service. We go when we do not want to be rushed. Despite the people lining up for a table they do not rush you.

Try the chicken fried steak. I usually order something somewhat sensible. My husband always orders the steak. I always eat half of his plate.

New location on Eagle Road can serve alcohol. Nice to have a mimosa if the mood strikes!

I went there last week because it's close to my place. Very satisfied of the service. Clean space, everyone were friendly there. Jenny did a great job on my releasing my neck and shoulder pain. Will definitely go back again! Highly recommended Jenny.
This place is out of business. It's empty with a for lease sign.   There's another store front next to it, but the hours posted are not the ones posted here on yelp.

Stopped by this morning to get something to wake me up before I head out to work and the Kicker did just that. The moment you pull up to the window you are greeted by a friendly work staff that seem to be enjoying what they are doing and have no problem starting up a conversation with you. 

This is a go to spot if you enjoy a friendly environment and good coffee. Sometimes the lines tend to be long but its worth the wait.

We came here for a girls lunch & I am so glad we did. The decor is unique and I loved having the whole wall of windows to look out. The place was empty, which was nice because we just wanted a low-key lunch. The menu ALL looked appealing. The waitress had to come back 4 times because we couldn't decide what to order. Thank you for your patience! 

I had the Carne Asada tacos. They were delicious! I didn't even mind that they were served with french fries. My friend ordered the pesto chicken and it looked amazing. We didn't try any cocktails because it was our final day of a girls weekend so we were recuperating. ;) haha 

I will definitely keep this place in mind next time we are in The Village there are so many things on the menu I want to try!
Gag!  Can't say I will go back.  The food tasted a bit old and refrigerated.  My wife and daughter wouldn't finish their meals because of the taste.  Sorry Big Daddy's, just not our kind of BBQ.

This is one of my fav local Starbucks.  Fast & efficient- & most importantly consistent service!  This location has indoor & outdoor seating, layout friendly to both solo as well as group work sessions- & tends to be the quietest Starbucks location in Treasure Valley.  (Busy, but generally quiet noise level.). If u need a respite from Eagle road- pull in here!

Do not use this facility if you have migraine headaches and need to have Botox injections given in a timely manner. I have been trying to get an appointment for my daughter since SEPTEMBER and it is December 10th. The schedulers are incompetent, rude, unprofessional and desperately need retraining. The excuse given for this treatment is "they are understaffed." If you want to be verbally assaulted by incompetency at it's finest, try and get an appointment with their neurology department.

My boyfriend and I took the 8 hour Enhanced Concealed Carry course and it was excellent! They covered everything from home defense, how to properly shoot, and the laws that would affect you if ever you were put in a situation. Even my boyfriend who has been shooting his whole life learned a bunch. The instructors were able to keep the class engaged and interested the entire 8 hour span. Thanks for a great experience... wish you guys weren't closed on Sundays so I could go back right now!

I travel for work, off Monday home Friday. Sometimes I find time for a quick one and I thought that's what this will be. But it turns out to be nice. Good drinks food it self was great. Surprisingly great. Bar tender made good strong drinks. Nice spot good view. Great location

Cool ass bar. (THEY DO NOT DO PIANOS ANY MORE TO SET THE RECORD STRAIGHT, I ALMOST DIDNT COME HERE) I'm from Seattle and I travel a lot and have seen many bars, this bar is a great spot. The environment is laid back yet up beat. I came here on a Thursday where they are playing good music and doing karaoke in between (not over kill of one or the other).

Came here for brunch and to catch up with a friend. The restaurant was pretty empty when we came in, just a few tables in the dining room and in the bar. We were sat right next to the door (it was winter)and asked to move, but the hostess said they didn't have any other tables other than another one by the door. I understand seating depends on the section the server is working in but they didn't have more than 2 tables.  

The food was pretty good though and the mimosa as well. It just wasn't the most pleasant dining experience because we were uncomfortably cold.

This is a great establishment! Our waiter was kind and super efficient in meeting our requests quickly. The portions are huge and the costs are very reasonable. We found this location to be very busy so we were happy to find the waitlist option available online and glad we did so or we would've had to wait an hour and 40 minutes.

I had Cindy do my hair a few months ago after a friend recommended her to me and my hair color still looks good! I showed her a picture of what I wanted and she tweaked it a little so that my hair complemented my skin tone. I like that she said something and my hair turned out even better than the picture. I've recommended her to all of my friends and they too love her work. She also she takes her time with every client and makes them feel comfortable which is a HUGE plus for me. Thanks Cindy!

Underwhelming experience here. To start, the woman at the front asked how old our toddler was. We told her it was actually his second birthday. Rather than, "happy birthday!" we got, "well I'm going to have to charge you for him." His grandparents were in town for his birthday, so we paid $40 for one child to play, that's pretty ridiculous, what a terrible pricing structure. It seems to encourage a lack of adult supervision. 

While the parental supervision may have lacked a bit, have no fear, they have staff members to walk around and wordlessly scowl at everyone, that'll keep the kids in line!

The space is fairly small and was packed. The "exhibits" are all advertisements for businesses that you play in, that struck me as odd. I was hoping for enrichment - sensory activities and such, not stuffed animals in cages, though some of it was still pretty cute. It was much more a play place plastered in advertisements than a museum. 

All that said, my kid was entertained, but we won't be making the trek back out to Meridian for this place anytime soon (if ever). I'd much rather stick to the Discovery Center and indoor playgrounds like Planet Kid.

I have to admit I was fooled by all the hype; best of Boise/4-5 stars on Yelp and google not only that it smelled great walking in and the place was full. I figured your at a BBQ place you gotta try the meat so I ordered the one meat plate and chose brisket. This is supposed to be the best BBQ place in the valley they gotta have killer brisket right? Don't be fooled this isn't even close to one of the best BBQ joints in Boise. So the brisket came out and it was definitely not smoked(no smoke ring; nor was there any pink). I am guessing either boiled or baked in the oven. I've had lots of BBQ in my day I can taste when something isn't smoked. The sides were meh-I had Mac and cheese and their "garlic" mashed taters (didn't taste any garlic. The Mac and cheese was bland supposed to have bacon didn't see any. It's very spendy$-17 for a one meat plate. The spicy BBQ sauce had an overpowering vinegar flavor just not very good. Service  was okay; gal was slow at times even made a face when we asked for separate checks. It took her about 15-20 minutes to get everyone squared away; normally the waitress takes all the payments back and cashes them out she did it one by one which was a little odd. For a BBQ place that was supposed to be best in the valley this place fell flat so many other great choices around don't be fooled-don't waste your time or money here..

Service was not very good and not impressed with the plates I've ate their twice just to be sure I didn't like it and yeah not missing out on anything on the menu and the plates aren't very big or filling the only thing I do like is their drinks at the bar but again I can get those made anywhere.

We were visiting some friends in Boise, back in October, and as we passed Joe Mamma's, we decided we had to eat there, just based on the clever name.  So glad we did....the food and service was great, and we loved the down to earth feel of the place.  We will definitely be back on our next trip to Boise.
Cool concept but the food just wasn't good. Paid over 8 dollars for a 6 inch Philly cheese steak. It was very gross. Had gristle in EVERY bite and the bread was soggy.

Let me start off by saying I'm a picky girl when it comes to my nails and how they're done, I know what I want and I know what I like. Before I moved from WA to here, I was going to a lady who had been in this business longer than I had been alive, she took great care of my nails and pampered me. Since moving, I've been in search of a new nail tech to fill in the void that is nails. 
With that being said! I am VERY pleased with how my nails have been turning out, so far. My nails are very temperamental and love to lift on the corners after two weeks due to how my nails grow and I'm pleased to say each set/fill that I've gotten, none have lifted and they're very strong. Danny has been amazing and had gotten the shape I desire and adore. Very clean, very friendly, and very presentable. Highly recommend!

Car wash is good. Doesn't dry completely, but never had any car wash that really does. Very friendly people. I have a monthly pass and love the ability to go whenever. I had to have my windshield replaced and went to swap out their pass sticker. I have a vet plate and they upgraded my membership at no cost. I never ask (or asked in this instance), but their model is to recognize and thank people. I will support businesses that are just focused on providing great customer service.

I have had 2 CBH homes and not a thing wrong with any of them.  The only issue I had on the 2nd home was getting the build started, but once it was started, it went quickly.  They have responded promptly to any concerns I had and had great customer service.  I realize not everyone has had favorable experiences but mind have been great....two times!!

Love the Kona grill, one of our better Asian / Sushi / American restaurant mixes in the area.  Their happy hour is pretty good and honored throughout the restaurant from 2-6 M-F.  
I also love that that they have a great kids bento box which provides plenty of options while providing the staples most toddlers / younger children want.

The service is hit or miss at times but luckily we got Chris last night who is unbelievable!  The guy has a knack for serving, plain and simple.  He was busy as usual but we felt taken care of.

Food was great, we went full sushi dinner with 5 rolls and some sashimi.  Jalapeños were very spicy last night so be careful if you have them and aren't into hot stuff.

Ribs are good but the side portions are super small and the instant potatoes are horrible for the cost of what it is to eat here you should at least get real potatoes there literally like 2 bucks for 10 lbs.  although the ribs are good I won't be back as everything else is lack luster
Try their home style potato's! You will not be disappointed. Service was great and very friendly.
I just found out that there are movies in the park on Friday. I love this place even more now!

Last Sunday I took my wife and 4 kids to Joe Mommas. It was our first time visiting their new location. What a beautiful building. The staff was absolutely on top of it. I was even super impressed with one of their bus boys, Rueben, who was so polite and helpful to both us and our server. The food was out fast and was to die for. Soooo good. Will definitely be making brunch a tradition there. Their online waiting list was literally accurate to the minute for us, and we were late getting there - oops. They had our table ready when we got there. 5 stars!!!

A comfortable (and tasty!) place to spend time with friends and family. Monday night was moderately lively, and Lorena was our server. Her knowledge of the menu was impressive and service impeccable! We had a great time. I highly recommend!

Extremely disappointed.  The sushi was blah.  No flavor, just slapped together and falling apart. Service was awkward and food was slow.  Our daughter had to wait for her kids meal to come out for 15 minutes after the rest of the food arrived.  Will never go back.  Overpriced and overrated.  I've had better from national chains that prepare pre-cooked meals from frozen in microwaves.

Me and my family visited this location while on vacation in Boise Idaho. We went to the Meridian location ordered a pizza and Teriyaki fettuccine. Both were fabulous but the best part of the meal was our waiter Mark, he was friendly and observant. Mark even noticed that we were missing a topping on our pizza before we did. I hope to go back to Smoky Mountain Pizza before we leave town.

Bruchi's has such amazing flavors and exquisite tastes, but at the same time it has some of its drawbacks . The staff there is so nice and friendly and the place has a nice aesthetic. But the sandwiches could be better. I ordered a ham and cheese with mayo and that was it . But when I opened up my sandwich it had pepper and oregano smothered all over it. I wouldn't have minded it as much if they hadn't used so much. All I could mainly taste was pepper and oregano. My friend got the New Yorker with Roast beef, black forest ham, pastrami, and provolone cheese. When she got it she was surprised when it came covered with lettuce and tomatoes. We went to the menu just to make sure she had not missed anything on the menu, and sure enough it said nothing about lettuce and tomatoes. She was a little disappointed as she had such high hopes hearing how good the place had been. I asked if she wanted to switch and she was okay and didn't mind it a lot but just wish she had known that it would be on her sandwich. We after eating thought that the food was amazing ,making up for the minor errors with the food . Everything ended up pretty well in the end. This place is amazing, I would just recommend asking for all of what's on the sandwich. In total Bruchi's is about a 4 out of 5

I had to come here for some specialty services, even though I live in Boise. Just like their downtown location, the grounds are beautiful. The volunteers at the front desk are helpful and friendly - compared to st. Alphonsus, where the desk in never  manned 

The floor plan is kind of confusing but they have good signage. 

They're cafeteria is wayyyy overpriced, in comparison with maybe 4 or 5 other hospitals I've been in for extended periods.  I didn't get to eat any of their prepared food, as it was 10:30 and there Was no breakfast and lunch hasn't started so I bought a 4 inch turkey sub for $2.69.  Idk maybe their meals are more reasonable but I've had a full meal at st als for that price.
Fast service. Delicious food.we shared an omelette and hash browns.  There was a good amount of food. We both were satisfied and full.
This is for the clinic on Findley (federal way). The experience was beyond terrible. Maybe just an off day? Who knows, but I won't take my chances.

I can't speak to whether it is representative of Bosnian food, but I can say the food was phenomenal. The ambiance is pleasant yet simple and the service was friendly and prompt. 

According to the waitress everything is fresh; no cans and no microwaves. I didn't barge in the kitchen to make sure, so I can't confirm or deny this claim personally. I can state that the food is really good.

To me the place seems like a great place for lunch.  They have a lot of sandwiches, but they also have a few platters. 

The atmosphere is pleasant and the seating is comfortable. It's a fairly new establishment and is esthetically pleasing. The staff have been courteous and provided prompt service.

I've had the cavapi (beef sausage sandwich) and it is delicious. I would also highly recommend trying the baklava. This is not your typical super gooey baklava, but rather a nice balance of sweetness and crispness. I have been indifferent towards all recipes I tried until this one blew my mind.
We eat at Smoky Mountain Pizzeria several times a month. We request Christopher S. each time. He is a great waiter with a good personality and takes care of us well.
This is by far my favorite place to get a great breakfast, highly recommend for anyone looking for a homemade meal that is fresh every time.

I honestly had the worst experience ever, one the nurses there was really disrespectful and rude and kept yelling at us to sign some papers when she didn't explain what was going on with our sick pup, I believe her name was Abby?! 
My mom speaks poor English and I had to translate to her and when we would ask her questions she kept talking over me and shouting to sign papers, we ended up leaving this place after $200 payed for nothing and fixed nothing all to just get yelled at and being treated like we didn't care about our dog. 
I'm never coming back, to say the least.
Come check out the new Salon. It is friendly, modern, and welcoming. You will look and feel gorgeous.

So I'm from Alaska and I had never heard of such a thing as "Dutch Brothers..." I thought it was a furniture store when my coworker said we HAD to visit on our business trip. But LET ME TELL YOU ABOUT THE CARAMELIZER. I think that's what it was called. It was like nothing I had ever tasted. It was smooth and creamy and absolutely delicious. I may come back to Idaho just for that. The girl who came out to the car to take our order was also super super nice. She asked about Alaska and told us how amazing this state was and she was right. I don't know her name but she was short with long dark hair. GIVE HER A RAISE!

The two star rating is given for the service, not the food. Our steaks were well prepared and our side of brussel sprouts was delicious. 
First negative impression: my boyfriend went to use the restroom and an employee started bad mouthing the restaurant and management. My boyfriend made a comment about that's why he has his own business and then later that employee came to our table asking for a job. 
Second negative impression: when I used the restroom, a server left the restroom without washing her hands. 
Third negative impression: their card/payment system was messed up and both of our parties cards were declined, but after one went through for a partial payment. I have never known credit cards to run a partial payment without someone entering in an amount. I understand technology and things happen, but how it was handled was not ok. We ended up having to wait an extra 30 minutes to get everything figured out and the manager's behavior was unprofessional. Not only did she make us wait, but acted like we were an inconvenience to her. 
The restaurant was not very busy so one would think that they would want to take care of a customer that just spent $150 in their establishment. I wasn't expecting a free meal, but a sincere apology would have been nice. 
I will not be dining at this location again. We were not impressed.

I know why they call it time zone toys. I was literally transported back to my childhood. Bionic Man action figures. YES. Star Wars action figures from the original movies YES. Transformers, Voltron, Power Rangers, Indiana Jones, and Funko POP from wall to wall. As I starry-eyed walked in the store, I could hear Cheap Trick, Heart, Joan Jett, Howard Jones and A-HA all play in my head. Dave runs an awesome shop and is very knowledge. He's got another store on Chinden but this location is right on my lay line to childhood. I took my kids today and I am not sure who was more giddy me, or them. These were real toys and actually stood the test of time and didn't fall apart and weren't overpriced like the ones now. Time Zone Toys also has yo-yo competitions from time to time so check them out. We needed up getting some exclusive Funko POPs but I'll definitely be back. If only I could play with Steve Austin, Oscar Goldman, and Dr Rudy Wells. Maybe I'll ask Dave if he'll let them out of the case for a quick 10 min play against Sasquatch.

I presented a difficult problem for Joey, one of the sells reps when I purchased a new phone outright but went back the next day to take advantage of the $350 trade-in value. Joey, went out of his way to do everything he could to help me. Sucks that I had to pay a $50 restocking fee but in the end I saved $300 in the long run.
The food was AMAZING! I got the VN 13 as suggested by others on here and loved it! Will definitely go back again!

Horrible service. Standing and waiting for 10 minutes to get service. Only one person in front of us. The server was too busy chatting with the customer at the register to acknowledge us. Apparently blind to the fact that 2 customers are just waiting while she quizzes the guy about where he works etc. No one else working there acknowledged us either. We walked out.

I've been here a couple of times over all the food is not amazing but it's not bad either I feel like this place is overhyped for what it is and a little overpriced I've ate a lot of different locations hence being a Yelp Elite I like to frequent different locations and try them out and this place just didn't really stand out. The staff was awesome though no problems there whatsoever but to me this was a typical chain restaurant I ordered their Sushi and a Hawaiian style burger both were not that great I still will give it a 4-star rating though, because I can't really complain about much other than the food was just not that great in my personal opinion the interior was nice and it made you feel like you were at a fancy restaurant.

If you have a true pet emergency, this vet would not be my recommendation. We came in Monday night with a pug walking crooked, collapsing and clearly struggling to breathe. We ended up with X-rays (where his condition, while hard to spot, was missed) and an ear cleaning. Nothing else. No offer to do blood work, or observe him overnight. They were busy and just sent us on our way with a $300+ bill saying sorry, but they didn't know what was wrong. Five days later my dog is fighting for his life at a true vet hospital across town where tests revealed a blood clot and hemmorage. (Not to mention he was rushed back and put in an oxygen chamber immediately.) For FIVE DAYS my dog has been suffering and now may not survive because this vet hospital didn't have the expertise to spot something complex. Save your time and money - and maybe your pet's life - and start across town where there are true animal physicians and specialists.

I have visited this restaurant on 3 occasions.  Each visit we had terrible customer service. The owner was terribly rude. It takes a very long time for them to get food out. When they do they have difficulty getting it to the proper table.  Part of our pizza fell on the floor and the waitress asked if we would like that one or should they make a new one. In addition, our salad was delivered at the end of the meal.  I am all for giving chances especially to I independent biz owners. Will not be back. Big disappointment.
This place is amazing. What ever you do get the bacon cheeseburger, it's the best. Milk shakes are amazing. I wish there was a Artic Circle in Tacoma, Wa

Just stop in, you will not be disappointed. The two dishes I have had so far, one of the rice bowls and the rice noodle soup were outstanding.  They were both super fresh and well seasoned. The menu items are priced reasonably and the people behind the counter take pride in what is served.

The food was better than average.  Service was good and then we found a flyor some type of bug on our pancake.  We were in kind of a hurry because the initial service was slow. So I gave my credit card and said at least take that off.  The waitress came back and gave me a $1.99 off our meal.  The manger  avoided us and didn't want to talk to us.  When we finally spoke with her she stated she didn't want to argue with us, she would take it off and then stomped off.  We left and they never took anything  off of the bill.

It's always hard to find a good salon where you leave feeling satisfied. This is the best salon I have been too in a long time. Always leave loving my hair and loving the experience! Julie is phenomenal and would highly recommend!

I have been curious about this location of San Francisco Sourdough Eatery for some time. So, when I found myself on Eagle Road in Meridian looking for lunch, I jumped at the chance to try 'em out!

Very happy I did. 

I ordered the turkey and avocado sandwich (technically, I ordered their turkey, bacon, avocado sandwich and requested they omit the bacon). The sandwich is quite large (half was plenty--so for the price, I would happily order it again and take the rest for dinner!). It doesn't come with a huge pile of meat, which is fine with me--but if you're someone that likes a high stack of meat on your sammy, you might request they add extra. Which, I'm guessing they would quite graciously do as the workers were just plain delightful.

There is plenty of seating for dining in, or you could certainly take your sandwich to go. They offer a wide array of bottled drinks and chips to go with your meal. As I mentioned, the service was lovely. They were incredibly friendly and very efficient. We were only seated for 2-3 minutes when our server arrived with our paper plated sandwiches. A-mazing!

Get to it!
Absolutely the Rudest front desk staff you will ever encounter. No compassion for what people are going through when walking threw the doors of an Animal Emergency Hospital

We did an online pre check-in yet still had to wait 30 minutes to be seated. Nearly another 30 minutes before food was served. I ordered a mocha which was bitter and grainy. Most of the meats were burnt. House potatoes were not seasoned, and they were cold.
Not worth the wait time.

*rude waitress 
*overpriced 
*bland 
*small portions
Have had better sushi for cheaper.

My husband and I came here before hitting a movie at the Village Cinema. We came right after the lunch rush (or so I thought) and figured we'd be in an out quickly. 

Alas, this was not to be. 

It was snowing outside, we walked in and were asked if we wanted to sit in the patio area which was self-seating. Sure, no problem. It's a gorgeous view, completely enclosed by one of those plastic window-things, and had gas flame warmers so it was nice and cozy. 

The vibe was that of middle-aged people on break from work. A lot of office talk; not much that was interesting to eavesdrop on, forcing me to actually talk with my husband. 

The waitress came over and brought menus. We ordered drinks. She brought mine and forgot my husbands. When she came back with it, it was the wrong drink. 

Our orders were fairly simple, and nothing special: pulled pork sandwich for him, miso soup and a veggie roll for me. It took over twenty minutes for them to bring it out. Her excuse was that they had a big table in the back they were serving. I totally understand that; however, I wish she'd told us beforehand so we could have opted to go elsewhere.

The food itself wasn't bad! My miso was less tangy than I normally like but otherwise palatable. The veggie roll was good, and I am thankful they have both a vegetarian and a vegan menu, although the waitress didn't seem to know much about either, or about the gluten free options. I feel like if you're going to offer these, the staff should be knowledgable in it - especially with the prevalance of Celiac and general gluten intolerance these days. 

Overall, it was a mediocre experience. I might come back if it was a spur of the moment thing but the service was slow and distracted, and we ended up missing the first few minutes of the movie because of that. As a result, this won't be one of my go-to's. I'd choose the little Asian place with stir fried veggies and teriyaki with rice right down the walkway before I'd go here again.

Love this local brewery. Each day of the week they have some kind of special. Nice patio area. And they generally have roating food trucks on the weekends.
My go to is the Afternoon Delight, but I love all of their seasonal beers too. 
Tuesday nights gets loud and crowded for $2.50 pints. Get here early when the weather is nice because the patio is the place to be on that night.
Aside from Pats and Gino's cheesesteaks in Philadelphia, these are the best we've had. The only negative is that we did not get extra sandwiches to eat when we got back to our home in Oregon.

This place is amazing! We came for breakfast this morning and the place was packed. We were seated after about a 15 minute wait and ordered shortly after. We only had to wait a short time before our food came. The waitress was awesome about filling drinks and checking on us. The food was great and I loved every bite of it. I can't wait to go back!

Great place in a good location.  Always a good selection and their fries are the best!  Have had some hits and misses on the service level, it's tough to keep the consistency with a more youthful employee base.
Food is ok. Wait is horrendous. I think they're still figuring things out with a bigger space. Wait staff was excellent
This is the coolest store. The owner is great and they have a huge collection of rare collectibles and toys. You have to come back often because the inventory changes all the time.
The cheesesteak is surprisingly soo good the people aren't very nice though seems like a common problem in this area of restaurants for some reason
Amazing!! Went twice in three days. Trash Taters are awesome as was my waffle. Will definitely be back!
The smell of smoked meat hits you when you first walk in and it doesn't disappoint. The brisket and spicy sausage was delicious. The salad was enough for two.

Good, fast and cheap Greek food! I really like all the different varieties of gyros too. You have choices of regular, veggie, chicken, and even breakfast gyros!!! The flavor is spot on and doesn't taste like fast food.

You can sign up for their loyalty program which has great perks! Just give them your phone number and every time you purchase a gyro it gives you points towards free money put into your account. Plus during your birthday month they load your phone number with $5 off any purchase! Makes for a perfect birthday treat!

There are a lot of these stores all over the treasure valley which I love! I'm usually not too far away from a hut and a delicious lunch or dinner!

Ate here twice. Brought a friend here from out of state. He loved it. Once sat down right away and another time we waited only 22 min on a busy Sunday morning when they were packed. The breakfast was cooked to my order. They have great sourdough toast and eggs made perfectly. Hash Browns could be cooked a bit more. Our second visit my wife went with a club sandwich which was made with REAL roasted turkey, not deli lunch meat. She loved it.
