(Happy wife, Happy life) Service was fast, servers were nice, friendly and always smiling. Big portions for very reasonable prices. Ambience in their new location is very nice. Log cabin style eating area and nicely lit. I would however suggest that someone needs to get on a ladder and dust off the logs cutting across the dining room as there is much dust up there, even large dust balls that are pretty nasty. Definitely a nice place to have breakfast or lunch. Comparison: Black Bear Diner but Joe Mommas's is on larger and grander scale. If you eat in the large dining area it can be hard to hear your party talking. Comfortable seating. Clean bathrooms. Great place!! *Menu's are worn and hard to read*

I ordered from this restaurant on Uber Eats. The service was delivered fast but the food was COLD. I ordered two entrees at $13 each. The meat was very salty. The shrimp was  good but only got four pieces for an entree. Super small servings. I was charged $6.99 service fee and 15% automatic gratuity. For over $30 I will continue to try other places in the Boise area. Food container was 8 1/2 in by 6 in. All Information I would have liked to know 
before I chose this establishment.
Love this eatery! Fresh eggs, friendly, attentive servers. Delicious food with a variety of special offerings. Highly recommend.

Love this place for breakfast.  The servings are very generous and you can easily share a plate even if you are hungry!  I have not had anything here that I haven't enjoyed.  Recently had the California Bennie with tomato and avocado, and it was delicious.  On the weekends they make some beignets that are delicious -a must try! It gets very busy, so make reservations online, or go early for breakfast.  The inside is all light wood and gorgeous!

This place is great! I love the food. Veggie hash is to die for. Half order and you still get 2 eggs. I love that french toast can be ordered as your toast side. The pancakes are huge and tasty. Great service, friendly and quick. Plus the food is great. This is our new to go to for breakfast.

So had to finally hit the all day Sunday happy hour at Kona. A couple of drinks and a nice selection from the happy hour menu and it was great. Not nearly as crazy as a weekday thank goodness. We might make this a Sunday ritual.

I've gone to Cindy twice now and will continue to go to her. She is a hair genius! She did an awesome job fixing my hair when I had a lot of bad color in it and I went back to add more and loved it!!! She knows how to give you exactly what your asking for but she also makes sure to only do something she knows will work with your hair and look!! She makes me feel like a model every time I leave! lol I've never been more happy with my hair, I totally trust her judgement when it comes to my color. In addition, she's very sweet, hospitable, and takes her time with you. Love it, thanks Cindy!
Best breakfast I've had out here. Always busy but worth the wait We go atleast once a week the pancakes and jam are my favorites

They tried to kill me. I ordered a heath bar blizzard last night and saved it for today to eat it. I went to eat it and it turned out to be butterfinger. I am allergic to peanuts! Thank goodness I'm not a little kid who doesn't know any better. Peanut mistakes should never happen at restaurants!

We were very pleased with their bar. The food not so much. My husband ordered the TNT steak. It was cold but had food flavor way too much gravy all over it. My son got the turkey BLT with a side salad, we asked for it with no bacon, came with bacon. Side salad had no dressing on it. My daughter ordered the shrimp twigs tacos. Took us a minute to decide if the meat was infact shrimp or chicken. We finally decided it must be shrimp because it was so cold. My nephew ordered the waygu burger & we all thought it was excellent! I asked for it to be prepared medium & it was definitely rare, very rare. I ordered the drunken pig pizza & it was good. Not very warm but good flavor. When my nephew asked for a side of ranch w/his fries we figured out why the salad didn't seem to have any dressing...the "ranch" was like water. Literally we poured it out into a glass. Gross!! Definitely a great place for drinks but get dinner across the way for sure!

very hard working individuals! I unfortunately had my septic line blow TWICE and without fail and always with a smile, they took great care of us! They had a new employee they were doing a working interview with and she was fantastic as well! For being her first day on the job, this was one heck of a working interview. Josh and Hailey were amazing! Hailey, great first day! Josh, just like last time, you made a crappy experience (pun intended) the best it could be for what it's worth. 

thank you!

Reasonable price and portions, but I felt the wait staff presented themselves unprofessionally with the facial piercings, tattoos, ill-fitting clothing, and lack of attentiveness. My glass of wine came with foil wrapping from the bottle, and my water glass had lipstick from the previous patron on the rim.

I've had Barbecue at almost every joint in Meridian and Eagle ID; Big Daddies is by far the worst!  The smoked turkey may as well have been cardboard, and none of the provided sauces were particularly good. The service was awful. It took over 30 minutes in a near empty restaurant to get my food!  

I'll never go back.  The Rib Shack in Eagle is the place to go for great barbecue.

Went to this Dairy Queen on McMillian Rd.in Meridian on 3/23 around 5:00.  What disgusted me the most are the people that work there are very unsanitary.  Why would you go from using the cash register and wiping the counter to placing my food into a bag.  The fries are not covered when they come from the kitchen.  Why would you handle them and place them in a bag without at least putting on gloves?
Both my hamburgers and fries were also cold. I ordered combos on both meals and did not receive any drinks either.  I ended up going somewhere else for my meals.

The guys that work here went the extra mile for me!I just returned from a road trip and had a lot of dead bugs on my car. The car wash usually gets them off after a second time through but this time it didn't. After 3 attempts and still a lot of dead stuck on bugs, one of the workers (Matt) came up to me while I was vacuuming and said "we don't want you to go home with a dirty car" so he told me to go back through the line and he would spray goo-gone on the bugs to loosen them up. Then he and three other workers proceeded to hand scrub the front of my car with goo gone and pads before I went through the car wash the 4th time. It finally came out clean! I am a satisfied customer who will always come back. Customer service is very important to me and these guys were awesome and friendly.

Somethings about Twigs bugs me. I have been twice. Their food is so-so. Their lack of speed and customer service is mediocre. In the scheme of restaurants/drink places, Twigs would be my last selection. When I feel "blah" about a place, I do not return. Maybe Twigs has gotten better in the past year?

Great sandwiches! We split the brisket and it was delicious. The bread is a light pastry that's pressed in a waffle iron.

The milk teas are great too. Fast and friendly service!

Several of us at our busy clinic ordered Jimmy Johns for lunch. Within 1/2 hour after eating, two of us became pretty ill. Nausea, almost vomiting, stomach ache and profuse sweating. One of our team members spoke to Matt, the manager over the phone and explain the concerns. Matt did not express any concern or regard to how Jimmy Johns has made us sick. Beware to anyone who may eat here.......eat at own risk....
Delicious breakfast. Friendly service. The corned beef was legit and fresh. Would come back!
Yummy, hearty & delicious! You may have a bit of a wait depending on time of day, but it's delish I worth it! Large portions & lots of options- something for everyone!

Called to book an appointment 3 days ago for today. Showed up and they couldn't find my reservation. Finally found it and said it was actually for a month away and the only thing they could do was get me in in 5 hours. Bad customer service.

My friend and I sat in the lounge area for Happy Hour. The bar manager waited on us and he was so nice, fun & friendly!! The service was fantastic- our food was at our table so fast. I will definitely be back!!

We had reservations for my daughter's Birthday. We were seated a little after 6:30. The initial service was attentive getting our drinks and orders for apps and dinner. Let me start with the fact that the food was very good. We had all ordered Sushi dishes. The apps came fairly quickly. We had ordered our meal by about 6:45. We waited and waited... and waited. After we had the apps it was at least another 20 minutes before we saw the waiter again asking if we wanted more drinks. Nothing about delays. After a while, we all started doing the prairie dog neck snap looking around. You know, the one that every service person should be telling our waiter to check on us. It was at least another 15 minutes before he came by again and we asked about our meal. He said the Sushi staff was swamped from the Happy hour business. Sorry but not a good excuse to give those paying full price for the same dishes and having to wait 20ft away. He said that the manager was literally standing behind the Sushi chefs to prod them along. I asked if the manager was "helping". We are normally overly patient but jeez. By this time it was about 7:30. About 10 minutes later the manager comes by and apologized with the same "happy hour swamped us" excuse.  This is 40 minutes after Happy Hour is over and not even an offer of edamame. Around 7:55, we got our meal. During the whole long wait time, our waiter was not coming by but maybe once or twice. This is an hour and 10 minutes after we ordered and about an hour after apps were delivered. 
Now after we were done the waiter came by and offered desert and he asked if we wanted the bill on one or divided. We said divided. It took 3 tries to get the division correct. (We told him how AND it was 2 couples, one in their 60s and one in their 30s. A little obvious) He first divided it seemingly random. Then he divided it men and women. Then he got it right. We got the last correct bill at 8:23pm. 
The evening was long with a HUGE gap from apps to dinner. The apology was minimal and we spent over $160 on 4 people. We will not be back.

Service is slow and food is mediocre. We ordered the lobster and shrimp kona roll was below average. It was flavorless, and the texture was rubbery as if the meat were previously frozen. First time here and We probably won't be back. Would much rather go to other restaurants in the Village than here.
Probably one of the worst dining experiences I have had. Don't bother!! Seriously- way too many other great places to go. This was awful.

The corned beef hash is my test order for a breakfast place and this place has the best in the Treasure Valley.  Yes, a very popular place for good reason, therefore I don't go there when everyone else would. When I dream of breakfast, I'm visioning the hash here (eggs over easy with an English muffin, coffee, orange juice, easy on the potatoes)

Staff, equipment, and location is generally nice but the construction has lasted for-damn-ever.  Not too smart to start construction right after new years.  There seems to be some kind of school partnership where students come in and use the machines.  Might have been a one time thing, but it happened to me and my workout buddies and we couldn't get a bike, eliptical, or treadmill for a long time.  The new lockers are sweet, it only took 3x the time that the signs originally said.  I think they should get a discount on the renovation personally.

Great location! Great hotel! The beds are amazing and breakfast was great! They love pets which made me love it even more. We normally stay in La Quinta hotels because of great price, comfort and locations. This was no exception! Great service!
This place has good bbq kinda pricy but well worth it I've been here twice and never disappointed the service is ok definitely worth a try if your in the area

Pretty god food, decent service,  ok prices. Had the crab cake Benedict and the corned beef hash.  Everything was solid,, nothing necessarily great.  Not bad.  Just a decent meal for okay prices.  Meal came to 30.18.  Not bad for a crab cake here in Idaho.

We chose The Varsity Pub this year, to host our annual Managers Christmas party. We try to find a place centrally located, to all of us, for the purpose of getting home. Lol. We checked out there website and menu, and with the pool tables and especially the happy hour drink specials, we decided this was the place.. What a mistake. Walk in to find comfy couchs and a relaxed atmosphere, so we took a seat. Immediately got yelled at by the bartender (from across the bar, with other customers watching) ranting about sitting down before ID's were checked. Apparently she doesnt know her way out from behind the bar. We should have walked out then, but we stayed. There is no wait staff, so if your thirsty, you've gotta go see the warden. They weren't even that busy. The happy hour special is great, if ya dont mind drinking rot gut booze. We drank premium instead (we do put some value on our liver). We spent at least 3 hours at the Varsity, and I can assure you we will never go back. A 1 star rating is to high, but its the only choice I have.
OMGosh, the food is amazing here. Add a mimosa, and you cannot beat it. The only draw back would be the wait, but it is SO worth it, so sign your name in, you won't be disappointed!

I can see why the line is always out the door at this restaurant! The food is absolutely incredible! The employees are so kind and accommodating. Highly recommend checking this place out and getting those pancakes!

The following is a complicated review about nothing more than trying to get a glass of house, or less expensive, dry white wine with my dinner. The details sound ridiculous, and what transpired actually was. 
We were given a gift card for this place and had been looking forward to checking it out. Met a couple of friends there last night, got seated promptly and all seemed well. I asked for a glass of house, dry white wine and it all went downhill from there. The server didn't know the wines - I said I didn't either, that's why I was asking...another server came by...they were suggesting wines but again, I said, I don't know the wines...can you just give me a basic, dry white wine that isn't expensive (the prices started about $7 a glass and went up -several were in the $11-14.50 range). I normally drink red wine, but it was over 100 outside and I wanted something lighter. I finally settled on one brand - $7 a glass, and the second person went to get it for me. Soon after, a man came to the table (manager?), and said they were all out of the wine I wanted and suggested another one that he likes. He told me if I didn't like it I didn't have to pay for it and so I told him okay. After he left, my friend checked the menu and it was a $13 glass of wine. When the server came back I asked her if she realized the wine was $13 a glass - she went and talked with the guy and he said he would knock $3 off the price. 
When I tasted the wine, I didn't like it...seriously, I have tasted much better wine out of a box.
Sooooo, I told the server I didn't want it and got a glass of red wine for $7 (I'd had before) which was delicious.
ALL THIS TO SAY. WTH? The server actually made some comment about my request being difficult-and genuinely seemed to believe this-she was very sweet, but had no clue about the wine. I just didn't get it. It was NOT a complicated request and I was nothing but nice the entire time. 
I have NEVER in my life been in this situation, and although the food was actually pretty good (except our friend didn't like here sushi saying the rice was undercooked), and the service was just fine, I WILL NEVER COME BACK HERE AGAIN.
Lastly, our bill came to $110-we tipped $25, which I thought was more than generous. 
We will happily spend our hard earned money somewhere else next time. That is all.
My 12 year old shih tzu loves coming in to get groomed. He has such a fun time there and loves the staff. They always get him in and cleaned up. Pet Co it's where the Pets Go!

Went for breakfast/brunch on a Tuesday morning and the place was busy but not super. The three of us were seated right away.  The staff was all very friendly and helpful.  Portions are huge!  I ordered a pancake, two eggs, bacon, and home fries. I don't know if it is because I ordered the cranberry walnut pancake or if all pancakes are that size but my pancake was bigger than the dinner plate it was served on.  Next time I will just get the pancake was sooo good!  The bacon and home fries were really good too.  My mother ordered a half order of corned beef hash and it was the perfect size for her.  She said it was good but she prefers her corned beef chopped into the potatoes instead of slices laid on top.  My sister ordered Green Eggs and Ham and said it was good but really liked her biscuit.  Our only complaint was how noisy the place is, even when it isn't full.

I have always loved cafe ole since I was a kid. The Boise restaurants are so nice with such wonderful decor and scenery. This meridian location is pretty flat and boring compared to the Boise locations. This location has always been clean inside and out including the restrooms. I have never had a problem with any staff member. Everyone is always so happy and smiley. I have probably tried everything on the menu, and have enjoyed every dish. Cafe ole is known for their margaritas, and I totally stand behind them and back them up on that! Best margaritas ever. I love their peach and blackberry margarita. They add the right amount of salt. Too many bars and restaurants add soooooo much salt, you balloon up after 1! But I don't have that problem with cafe ole's margaritas.
Their happy hour is amazing both the food menu and the drink menus are amazing as well. Seating is tough during happy hour though so get there early.
We go here all the time.  Good food and service.  Too bad we are just outside of their delivery area.

Solid sandwich joint.   Tons of custom style sandwiches.   The product seems to be fresh and clean. 
One of the best sandwich joints in town of you are looking for a quick bite. 
Recommended!

I visited Chardoney's for the first time today.  It was a cute place with a comfortable atmosphere, and the service was great!  The selection of eclectic gifts also made it a fun spot to visit. 

I will visit again!
Fantastic food! Prices are good with more than enough to eat. We'll be back.

Avoid them unless you like dealing with deceptive business practices of making promises and then getting cryptic billing statements and lack of working with your insurance coverage or charging a fair amount for equipment. Prices on-line are over 50% lower than what they will charge.

I have been to Sofra many times and it never disappoints!I always enjoy it! The food is very authentic Bosnian food and it's delicious! The owner, Edina is very accommodating and takes her time to answer any questions you may have. You can't to wrong with whatever you order but I do recommend getting the platters that includes many different foods that you can try especially if it's your first time!

This could possibly be the best pulled pork sandwich I have ever had! The pork was tender and the bun was amazing! Sometimes with bbq the smell is deceiving, but with this place it smelled good but also tasted amazing! We will be back!

"Good things come to those who wait"
The food was good but from the time we placed our to-go order to the time we left it was 32 minutes. Yikes! To their defense it was only their 5th day open and their first Friday. 

They close at 8 and we walked in at 8 on the dot (We were those people). Jayson was at the register and was more than happy to still serve us! Sorry & Thank you thank you! :)

I ordered the 7" Pepper Steak and they were very generous with the meat. It was flavorful and delicious. Thank you for the extra fries and free cookie!

So Jimmy John's is just what it claims to be.  Basic sandwiches at cheap prices and you get them really quick.  So, if you desire a quick basic sandwich and you don't want to spend much, this place is a reasonable choice.  Today I got a ham sandwich, and my wife got a turkey sandwich.  There was nothing wrong with these sandwiches, and they fit our need to get a quick lunch and get on the road.  The restaurant was really clean, and the staff was friendly and helpful.  And yes, we got our sandwiches pretty quick!

So while I'm not one to recommend large chain fast-food places, I think that Jimmy John's has its place in my mind as a food choice for when I'm in a hurry.  



[  On the other hand, you have different fingers.  ]
Best breakfast in Eagle. Make reservation because it's very busy. I love their enormous pancakes!

Bruchi's is fantastic.  The Classic Steak is excellent, bread is baked on stir every day and is nice and soft, sandwiches are made when ordered.  Sides include chips, dill pickle, crinkle cut fries with their own fry sauce which are great and fresh baked cookies.  I just tried their burger and it's one of the best in Boise. My wife loves the BLT. They have Coke products and beer on tap and bottle.  Staff are fun and helpful. Only down side is the ice tea is weak but typical of non brewed tea.

Normally I have nothing but good to say about this place. But in the lat 6 months every time I have been there... approximately 6-8 times now the service has gotten worse and worse..sadly enough it was a go to restaurant for when I had friends in town or just wanted to have a nice dinner but until I here of the food getting back to how it use to be and the servers not leaving you sitting for 15 min before asking for your order or if you would like a drink. I'll go to Twigs or downtown where they actually care.
Best Country Fried steak in Boise! The Country Benedict is amazing as well. The wait can be a lot so put your name in online as you leave the house and get a seat when you get there!

Still amazing sushi! However, the drinks were not very good. I sent back the first drink because it did not taste good at all. The second drink was a Pina Colada.  It was better but really heavy on the cream. Made it harder to drink with that much cream and was weird cause it was on the rocks and not blended. I love the place because of the sushi and environment but the drinks could definitely improve.

Best sandwiches in the valley! The atmosphere is awesome and the employees are super friendly. Service is awesome. But, let's face it, I'm here for the sandwiches and they don't disappoint. I get something different every time and I've NEVER been unhappy. This is a dine-in or grab-n-go. I do both regularly. LOVE IT.

Packed restaurant at 9AM on a Wednesday- good for you. Food taking an hour to reach my table- bad for you. Lots of help standing around- how about a coffee refill or perhaps water or clear dirty dishes. Hash browns way not cooked enough. Probably won't bother again. P.S. Hollandaise sauce DOES have flavor- yours did not.
Had lunch here and it did not disappoint. Notorious PIG was great as well as the chips and cheese. Garlic mashed potatoes were not good though - I took one bite and didn't touch them again.
Amazing food! The team tries extremely hard to keep up with the huge demand. The new location is awesome.

Happy with the quality of service I received. The prices are worth it. The gym was undergoing a makeover while i was there so th smell of paint was a little bother some. But I'm sure it looks great. I moved before it was finish.
Would use the gym again if I'm ever back in Idaho

Owner/manager is immature and incapable of dealing with unhappy customers in an appropriate manner. We sat for 30 minutes and never even got a hello from our server. When my husband, obviously annoyed, asked if we were going to be helped at some point the owner came over and accused him of "screaming" at her (he asked her, in an annoyed tone, with no raise of his voice) and then she stormed away in a huff without finishing or resolving our conversation and proceeded to talk to other customers about the "incident." She was completely immature, inappropriate and incapable of being a manager who can appropriately handle conflict in a business setting. They were already on their second chance and we will not be going back. Not a well run establishment.
DELICIOUS! I every shape way or form. I've been to many breakfast places in the valley, these guys are better than my home cooked breakfast! W O W!

They were fantastic! Got home from vacation and found a large abscess on our cats neck. They were able to get us is, as a new customer, within the same day and was able to fix the abscess without a problem. They were also true to their quote they gave us, even knocked some $$$ off which was nice! I definitely recommend them to anyone looking for a vet!

I love this car wash so much! Everyone is so kind and their worker sterling, always has a smile on his face. He is so helpful and always leads me where I need to be. My car is always fresh and clean. I will never go anywhere else. I also love the worker named Cort, he helped me my first time there and made me comfortable with the process. You guys do a great job and everything is so efficient. You're employees really make this place SHINE.

Kona Grill is one of the nicest atmospheres and menus I've seen more experienced...
This is a beautiful place to sit and enjoy a meal.

I go here once or twice a week. The Staff is always very helpful and friendly. The place is clean and everything is always fully stocked, they have a great selection of toppings.  
I like to go around 8pm and there are usually a couple other people. Love eating my Frozen Yogurt and watching the sun set.

This place is very promising but today, my review is only mediocre. I came in by myself and wasn't noticed for 10 minutes until I vocalized to a passing waitress that I hadn't been helped. The waitress seemed to offer decent service to others, but not to me--I had a feeling she was a avoiding me because she thought I would be an aggravated customer from then on. The food was decent but not outstanding. Butternut squash soup was over-spiced and not as pleasing as I would expect. The crab and artichoke dip was just so-so as well. The crab was slightly fishy which offset the whole dish. I've eaten at another Twigs before and really enjoyed it. The martini menu is fabulous so this is probably a great place to unwind and have a bite. I'd like to give this location a second try. I have a feeling this was just a bad day for them.
Morgan is amazing at massage therapy.  Very strong & intuitive!!!  Haven't had a better massage since I left Thailand until I was introduced to her.  I'm very grateful!!!

Ok, I do not understand how this place receives 3.5 stars. 
Staff are amazingly friendly and professional. Food is fantastic. Easy in and out. Big diverse menu. Real quality meat. What else could you ask for?
I have hade the classic cheesesteak with extra cheese about 7 times now. Always great. Hot, fresh, packed with yumminess.
I tried the French Dip recently and it's now my absolute fav in Boise area. The AuJus is rich and piping hot. Good flavor, not watered down. 
I will share a "mishap" that happened yesterday though. 
I ordered this sandwich and got something that didn't even look close to what I had last time. Meat was fine, as usual, but the provolone cheese was grated and lumpy. WHAAAAAT?!?! No go. 
I took it up to the counter and explained politely that doesn't even look good. 
They gasped exactly as I did then after apologizing hurriedly remade a new one. They explained why that happened, which usually I don't care about but because I really like this operation I appreciated, then brought me my delicious masterpiece. 
Ok, maybe not masterpiece but it was fabulous. Juicy, cheesy, bread was so soft and lightly toasted it was as if it came out of the oven two mins prior. SO fresh. 
Incredible meal. 
Only downside as with all places is that I don't care for their fries. They're like store bought frozen fries. 
Sorry Bruchi's. 

Don't forget to get a frequent buyer card and always ask for your military discount (if applicable). They'll ask for proof so no fakeys or posers. 
Get there!!!
Enjoy

Inside out: ample parking but not the easiest place to get in and out of, the main door faces eagle road... which is less than fun. The inside is clean and interesting. I like the bright colors and plants.

The service was great, our waitress was lovely and attentive. My brother in laws birthday was smooth and they were patient with my niece and have a kids menu she enjoyed. I wish the service made up for the food. They were silly and fun, kept our drinks full.

The food was just food, it wasn't stellar, it wasn't bad, it was just meh. I wouldn't eat there again, 13 bucks for three meh fish tacos and some black beans and rice didn't floor me, they didn't even register to me. Chips and Salsa is key at any Mexican eatery, it's the worst here. I will say the fish taco was actually better the next day cold.

Oh my goodness!! Some of the best food my husband and I have EVER had. I got the California Bennie, which is the eggs Benedict with tomato and avocado, with their country potatoes and a side of bacon. They cooked my poached eggs to perfection, gave lots of hollandaise sauce, cooked my bacon to the perfect crispness and seasoned the potatoes perfectly. My husband got the turkey, bacon ranch club and he inhaled it. They roast their own turkey in house and thick slice it for the sandwich. So delicious! The service was amazing and we highly recommend this place. Be sure to put your name on the waitlist early and know the wait is well worth it!

When they first opened.....WOW!  Great results, truck completely dry.  I haven't timed the process but it seems the cars are rushed through.  My truck requires three of the provided towels to dry.  The Armor All tire dressing is now poor at best.  Now that's marketing.


Either I have the weirdest shaped vehicle (Ridgeline) or something is wrong 
with their equipment.  It's scratching my truck above the bumper under the tail light.  Going to cancel my monthly plan and see how the competition does.
Best chorizo breakfast burrito.  Mimosas are amazing.  Our favorite breakfast place to take the family.

This is the best park to go to for kids. It's fantastic I live within walking distance and My niece loves it here we could spends hours here and she would never get bored there is so much to do. The splash pad is great to cool down kids in the heat of summer great walking paths or go see the ducks in the pond. It's fantastic

Weed Man Boise is a great company to work for. There is a great culture that fosters a positive attitude and rewards creativity. There is the opportunity for growth as they regularly promote from within. The people that work here are great and helping our customers gives a sense of fulfillment by providing them with exceptional service.
Our favorite place for breakfast. Servers are friendly, place is clean, food is excellent. We were recommended, and now we recommend this place.

Been to Kona a few times. Love the atmosphere and the huge fish tank. Staff is terrific. Food is great...my daughter loves the sushi. I, myself, love their Lemon Tart...it's so heavenly. Smooth, creamy, right amount of sweet & tart together. Go try the tart, you won't be disappointed!

I can't say enough about Meridian Vision!  I've been going to them for more than 16 years, and I keep coming back.  Dr. McElroy is extremely professional, thorough, and has a very kind and caring manner about him.  The staff at Meridian Vision is friendly and professional, and has always done a great job at helping me with each new pair of glasses that I need.  Today I am enjoying a new pair of prescription glasses as well as a new pair of sunglasses.  They are awesome!  Thanks MV for all you do!

Our friends introduced us to this awesome breakfast place. We've checked out a lot of the breakfast places in town, we're pretty picky. This has become our favorite breakfast place- it's consistently good every time. They have great coffee, really good service, delicious house potatoes. I really like the country Bennies, and my boyfriend loves the Trash Taters. The only thing that's a downside is the wait and distance to drive- the longest wait has been 20 minutes on a Sunday, but that's not unusual for breakfast places. The drive is worth it for us.
The other thing we like about this place is the casual, welcoming atmosphere. Every server we've had here has been very friendly, the coffee gets refilled quickly, and the one time one of our orders got mixed up a little they fixed it without any hassle. We try other places but keep coming back here.
Our new favorite place. Waffle sandwich is light  and crispy. Great flavor. Rice noodle soup was really good! Great service!

Food was alright, brisket portion was small and mostly fat, bbq sauces werent the best, one had the consistency of water, beans were ok, cole slaw was pretty good, trivia game was pretty fun, id like to go back some time when i have a little more time and have some drinks, service was really good!

First time that I had been there since their move from the former location in Eagle. They now occupy the former Dave's BBQ facility which is much larger. This was a great decision on their part since you would often have a wait time for a table since the Eagle restaurant was much smaller. I had the "Momma's Favorite" omelet, and it was excellent, topped by friendly and great service from Laura.

We loved it!! 
1) online reservations
2) Our table was ready immediately when our party arrived
3) Staff was friendly and prompt getting us coffee
4) Father's Day Mamossas were delightful!
5) Food served promptly hot and delicious 
Our dining experience was very enjoyable and we will return

Great place to drop in or make reservations. Awesome sushi bar, great appetizers, plenty of beverages, patio seating in a great atmosphere,   and secluded dining area for partys or get-togethers. Always on my list of places to eat.

Came here on a busy Saturday afternoon for a party planning session over lunch with a friend.

We were seated promptly and our drink order was taken immediately.  Our server took the time to go over both their seasonal and regular menus with us.  I settled on the caesar salad with salmon added.  The caesar was everything a caesar ought to be--fresh and flavorful with what appeared to be freshly made in house croutons.  The salmon was the star of the show.  It was moist, nicely peppered, and absolutely delicious.  My dining companion ordered their chopped chicken salad and raved about the flavor as well.  

The manager came over to say hello and encouraged us to try the cheesecake on their new seasonal menu.  He said, "I'm from Jersey and I know my cheesecake--we really took the time to perfect it."  

Authentic NY style cheesecake?  You don't have to tell me twice!

My dining companion shared an ample slice.  It was, in a word:  amazing.  Rich, creamy, and featured a drizzle of raspberry sauce that was the just the right amount of tart of offset the sweet cheesecake.  Holy loveliness! My understanding is that everything is made entirely fresh.  From their grill options to their dessert sauces.  They also have a fun cocktail menu that we didn't partake from but which I look forward to sampling from in the future!

The service was on point throughout our visit.  This was particularly awesome given my friend and I got caught up in chatting and party planning--and the next thing you know we'd been there for a few hours.  They never rushed us or made us feel anything but welcome.  I so appreciate this as I know our taking up a table that long may have been a little inconvenient (totally lost track of time--sorry!).  What a great group of servers they have here!

The atmosphere is modern and chic and lent to the overall awesome experience.

Get to it!

I have tried getting a quote for replacement lettering for a sign that is only in metal but to have it updated to have LED behind new lettering.  I had thought this would be a simple quote based off of the website page: https://www.woodlandmanufacturing.com/outdoor-signs/outdoor-lighted-signs    I just wanted help in the direction of which option would be best for the area of Wisconsin.  When given an initial response from the company, I was told to go with non-lit thin Acrylic lettering. I then clarified that I wanted to place led lighting behind the lettering but was told "We are not a UL listed company, so I would not be able to tell you how to place the lighting on this.  This would be something you'd have to check with a local sign shop that does light about."  At which point, I was confused as the website offers a page solely on outdoor lighted signs.  At which point, the "quote specialist" decided that based on the picture I had sent, I had vinyl letters applied to a sign.  I had then clarified that they were 1.5" deep metal lettering that was intended to be replaced with outdoor led lettering.  I was then given this link: https://www.woodlandmanufacturing.com/block-style-fabricated-metal-letters.html   which had no LED lights included in the package.  With already a few days wasted on emails and confusion, I had figured it was best to call and clarify what I need.  Being that I am the local sign shop needing the quote, it might be easier to describe what I need over the phone.  A guy had answered my call....to which I had described my situation and had informed him I was working with Julie Verkerk.  That ended up being a mistake on my end.  I was finally being transferred to Julie as she was "available"...only to have it go into voicemail....I had called back to talk to the same guy and was told that she was too busy to take my call and was told that she would call me back later that day when she was ready....I am still waiting on that call (It has been a week thus far).  I had even requested a different sales person as I really did not care who quoted it in the company or who I can explain my situation to but was told that I could not hence the mistake of saying the sales person's specific name.  At which point, it was time to cut my losses and quote with a different company.  After a short Google Search, I ended up requesting a quote from Signworldamerica.com using the same initial message I gave Woodland Manufacturing.  They were able to give me a quote later in the evening.

Cracked my windshield that was not cracked before I went in. There was no chips or scratches in my windshield before I went in. The temperature outside was 89 degrees, but that is hardly a temp to crack a windshield of 1 year old F150. Learned a $300 lesson today after talking to the unapologetic management at Mister, that they don't do anything for this situation or others and all liability is off of them. USE AT YOUR OWN RISK!

Was more interested in the martini part of the menu, asked about specials at @ 3pm . Ordered a Kettle One dirty martini.  Then a Twigs martini dirty. Call drink was 13.50,  and twigs tini was 11 bucks.  Something wrong on prices here.  Happy hour seems the best deal.

I visited this location twice with my husband as he dealt with a work related injury. 
From the get go the building is confusing.  When you come through the main doors, there is no signage directing you to the immediate right, which is where the check in desks are for Intermountain Medical Imaging.  We went into the lobby and to the elevators then realize we were in the wrong area and backtracked.  A simple sign would have ended the confusion.  The check in windows, access door and waiting area for Intermountain Medical Imaging are situated just outside of an access door for the hospital emergency room and also the entrance for the lab.  I'm not sure what kind of a morning the staff member had experienced before we got there, but we found her to be short tempered with us- a strange experience when my husband and me are both gregarious and patient people.  Once checked in, we waited for my husband to be called back for his procedure.  Near large windows the waiting area is well lit, but cold, and the environment is kind of an oatmeal 'blah' in terms of color and design.   Thankfully my husband reports that things on the other side of the door were much more friendly. The technicians explained things well and did what they could to keep him comfortable throughout the procedure.  It's a shame that the first impression of this facility is so disappointing.    On our second visit we found things much the same in terms of the lobby.  Too too sad that people choosing to work with the public, especially in a medical situation can't find a away to be a bit more friendly.

Crunch Fitness (Meridian, Idaho)


When I'm traveling for work, I do what a lot of people do and that's to find the nearest gym. I found Crunch Fitness through Yelp. And to be honest, Crunch Fitness wasn't my go-to gym when I'm the area. But the gym I usually workout at closed their doors and the other gyms that I have memberships to were too far. I don't have a membership here so I can't give you an opinion on what it's like to be a member. What I can tell you is that this Crunch Fitness has some of the best old school equipment that's becoming rare to find at big box gyms. I usually pay $10 for a 24 hour pass. This may seem like a lot and it is considering that most monthly memberships are around $20. I'm all about stretching my funds and will typically get 3-4 workouts in a 24 hour period.  By far, this is my favorite gym in the Boise, Meridian, or the Eagle area. I highly recommend this gym if you're just in town a few days or if you're local.  

Pros:
-I love the equipment. This gym still has some of the older Nautilus and Hammer Strength 
-Metal plates and bumper plates 
-One squat rack and two power racks. 
-Deadlift platform also available 
-Heavy steel dumbbells 
-2 Smith machines
-2 cable stations 
-Enough cardio (dreadmills, bikes, & stair-monsters)
-Seated barbell rack for pressing
-Safety collars! No one steals them here. I didn't need to use my own.
-Nice and polite members. 
-Very clean gym. There's always a staff member cleaning. 
-The Manager and staff treat me like I'm a regular 

Cons:
-Tight dumbbell and bench area
-Only one flat, incline, and decline bench. Good luck on Monday aka International Chest Day
-Missing a Lying Leg Curl machine. Or, did I miss it?
-Not enough equipment for calves.

They only get one star because I have to put one. My car got completely butchered by them and still had to pay every penny. On top of that my car still wasn't fixed. Absolutely not drivable and died on my not even a quarter of a mile away. I had to sell it because over three grand was put into it for them to set the timing off on my car for it to then screw up the motor. Apparently the turbo was toast as well. NOT. The man I sold it to is a diesel mechanic and fixed the car himself and it was then in perfect shape. No need for a new turbo. If christian brothers actually had a diesel mechanic working on my car maybe they would have know where to set the timing. I could have googled it and done it better. After he fixed the timing (which was set off) and fixed the motor (which the entire motor did not need replaced) he drove it up to washington and back! Got almost 50mpg (diesel Volkswagen Jetta). Screwing over a first year college student living off campus probably wasn't the best idea.

P.s. when i got the car to my house, I opened the hood and a hose was pinched off with pliers. thanks for the free pliers but that doesn't make up for the worst service I have ever received from anybody in my life.

Came in on a Saturday afternoon with an appointment for a Jelly Pedi and a fill on my fingernails. Had a great experience with Jade. His pedi was AMAZING. My feet feel great and the Jelly Pedi is an experience. If you haven't tried it, DO. Its worth it. 
My nail fill and polish was fun. Jade listened to what i wanted and gave me great finger nails to go with my Football Sunday Team. 
The shop is super clean and professional. Owners came in and chatted with customer. Such nice people who have been in the business and know their stuff. I trust these people with the nails. So happy I came. Will be back again.

I would give them 0 stars if I could.  Months after I stopped using them, I find out that they are FRADULENTLY charging my insurance for items I am not using anymore.  When I called to see why, I was treated like I was dumb and hung up on.  Literally, hung up on!  JJ, whom I spoke to was very condescending and said I obviousy don't understand how billing works.  I might not, but I do understand that it is your policy and my insurance carrier's policy to have you call me before you send me any new equipment which they did not do.  Now, I have to go back and figure out how many times they fradulently charged my insurance and get it straightened out. 
 Stay far away from them!!! I have a recording of the call that I will be submitting to BBB when I file a claim with them.

This gym has a lot to offer. It is not the cleanest gym ever though. There is a layer of filth on everything. The sauna is disgusting, the walls and seats are rotting out from years of sweat . I was told it was going to be redone before the end of last year. When I spoke with other users, they said they also were told that, over a year ago. The sauna is one of the reasons I chose this gym and it's so gross you really don't want to touch the seats or walls. I'm not a germaphobe but it does gross me out every time I'm there. The tanning booths are very weak, after using them for 3-4 times a week for  three months it made very little difference to my shade of white, as they only allow ten minutes per day. So basically don't join if you are doing it for the tanning or sauna, as you'll be disappointed. Or if germs and dirt built up on the machines will bother you, because it really is dirty. The pool is nice and warm and clear. As far as the weights and machines, they have a lot, I've never had to wait to use anything but I do go at 'off' times, I'm not sure about the before and after work hours. I think for basic work outs this gym is ok, but if you are paying for all of the extras (like towel service, tanning, etc) it's not worth paying the extra cost.

Beautiful presentation of a large amount of quality furnishings, mattresses and home decor. Staff was attentive but not intrusive. Very helpful. I found some great bargains in home decor. I would recommend checking them out! I think you will be very pleased.

I gave two stars because the food was really good, however; the price is very deceptive and horrible customer service. I ordered a plate which was suppose to come with 2 entrees and one side for $6.90. The cashier charged me for two sides and one entree plus charged me separate for another entree which brought it up to $8.90. I tried explaining to the cashier I ordered the $6.90 plate which was suppose to come with 2 entrees and one side, which was what I saw in to-go box. I did not see anywhere where that entree was suppose to be a separate charge on the menu because they were all grouped together. The cashier wouldn't listen to what I had to say and then rolled her eyes at me after I left. I hope she gets fired! I will never eat there again!

If you aren't hungry before getting here you will be as soon as you step out of your car and smell the heavenly scent of smoked meat and bbq! If you are hungry, the smell is going to make the wait for your food seem like an eternity. But it's well worth the wait!
Lunchtime on a Wednesday wasn't busy at all, but we were seated directly next to the only other full table in the restaurant. More about the restaurant: a few TVs on the walls playing everything from golf, to a car restoration show, and HGVT. The music was typical country, but was low enough that it truly was background music and low enough for us to have a conversation (seems to be a rarity in bbq restaurants anymore). Three different kinds of bbq sauce on the table and a whole role of paper towels for messy fingers.
I got the Southwest salad with brisket. The menu does not say it has cheese on it. I verified with the waitress that it did not come with cheese. Guess what? It came out with cheese. They were very apologetic and offered to remake it for me. Otherwise it was a beautiful and delicious salad. The jalapeno ranch it came with was pretty good, but I prefer mixing the bbq sauces to make my own dressing.
Hubby got the PB&J sandwich - which was a jalapeno & cheddar smoked sausage, pulled pork and brisket in a hoagie roll, topped with coleslaw. It came with a side and based on the waitress's suggestion he went with the mac & cheese w/bacon. We both loved the brisket. Great flavor, a bit salty but what we'd expect with a good rub. His pulled pork was the best! Great smoke ring, still moist and super flavorful. He liked the sausage, but thought it was a little light on the cheese (compared to other spicy-cheese sausages we've had other places). Nothing special about the coleslaw and the mac & cheese was really good, but we weren't sure where the bacon was. No hint of a smoky or bacon flavor and definitely no chopped up bacon in the melted cheese.
They have five or six beers on draft and I saw a sign saying they had wine and bottled beers also available, but didn't see any menu or list of those. Being a bbq restaurant, my hubby went straight for the sweet tea. His comment was that it wasn't bad, a little weak, as if they have it hot or at room temp and then add it to ice to make it watered down a bit. But it didn't stop him from getting a refill to-go.
Overall, great food. Eat there and you will leave smelling of bbq smoke (as I do now). I also commented to the hubby on our way to the car that the smell again made me hungry. He thought I was crazy after all we'd just had to eat. "Hungry" might have been the wrong word. It was more like I can't wait to try more off of their menu! So much so, that I mapped the distance to my work and found it would be completely do-able in the near future!
A sign on Cherry advertises Happy Hour. I'd love to grab a beer and some smoked wings or brisket poutine anytime after work.
I went back in today, and all was totally awesome again. I think it was just a bad day when I was in there last. Back to 5 stars!!

Eat here!

The food is amazing, and the portions are large! The prices and service are great!

My only suggestion to the management/ownership would be to adjust the lighting. It is very harsh, very LED flooded, which takes away from the cozy charm of the log cabin vibe. It feels very industrial and stark, though they seem to using the fake warm lights which just make everything look yellow/green. If they could adjust this little thing, 5 stars, easy.
This morning was my second time here. It was fantastic! Good orange juice, and once again, fantastic food! I had a very good time. Definitely recommend!
Best breakfast around! Food is fresh, delicious and the service is good. Great for breakfast, & Lunch!

This is such an amazing company! They are working out a payment plan and helping me with a severe toothache. They are kind, understanding, compassionate about their jobs and even more so with their patients!

Thank you!!!

We finally got the chance to try Kona Grill this past Saturday.  With the lure of picture perfect Saturday afternoon at the picturesque Village in Meridian what could go wrong. 

Even at 5:45pm for a party of three we didn't need reservations and were seated after some discussion as to where to seat us.   Josh was prompt, courteous, and funny.  We watched as the foot traffic near our table was akin to Times Square or even the Strip in Las Vegas.  There were servers, bus-staff, expeditor, and customers.   The menu items were hard to read due to the low lighting but the menu layout was easily defined.  At the bottom of the menu, kudos for defining Gluten-Free, Vegetarian, and Vegan dishes; however, those icons are very small and need color to stand on the menu.  It's really hard to see the VGN, for Vegan when it's stuffed inside a box that is .5 mm Square.  Here's some advice.  For the Gluten-Free items, GF without the box and give it a color, for Vegetarian, use VEG and color it as well. Lastly for Vegan, a simple V will do and color it Green.  

Speaking of Vegan options. There's the Edamame and Veggie Sushi rolls. Trying to Veganize a dish while perhaps can be done doesn't lend itself to be easy.  

The Angry Edamame was good. Really good and spicy but the Veggie Sushi and my fellow diners stir fry and caterpillar rolls were underwhelming.  We actually all left hungry.   For $60.00 for three without drinks, the juice simply was not worth the squeeze.  While the views, sites and sounds maybe worth the price of admission for some, it wasn't for us.

Wth. This place has horrible service. It took 52 minutes for 3 sandwiches and one roll to get on a Sunday at 2pm. And it wasn't even busy. I do not recommend this place because its pricey, service is bad and the food is not very good.

Wanted someplace that had good food, reasonable service and was kid friendly. This place worked out well. We did have a bit of a wait even though there are large seating areas and our server was a bit overloaded in our area but once we got noticed and placed our order the food came out in an acceptable amount of time. The items were excellent and large portions. Four in our party and we were all over the menu. I chalk up the slow service to it being Sunday morning an hour before closing. I would definitely hit this place again when in Boise.

Enjoyed dinner, was crowed with Friday night diners.  Husband and I both enjoyed our meals.  I had the wings and would order again husband ordered on of the pork sandwiches, enjoyed and would get again. Though next time in we'll be trying something new to explore the menu.
Their sandwiches are pretty good but I have had better in this area (hence the 4 star)! If you want a cheesesteak though, they're definitely delicious!

Like waffles? Like sandwiches? Like crescents? Well then order one of their waffle sandwiches. There are some great choices including a grilled cheese for kids. The bread is a cross between a waffle and a crescent. So flaky and buttery. The crumbs all over my dress was proof of the flakiest crust I've ever experienced.

My sister ordered the rice bowl and it was huge! The veggies were incredibly fresh and perfectly cooked. 

And don't forget the huge selection of teas including varieties of boba, milk, blended and coffee! I ordered the coconut milk tea with boba and it was very refreshing!

There isn't much seating in the actual restaurant so if you come during the rush, you'll most likely have to order take out. But it's worth it

I wanted to give this place 4 stars. But 4 stars means that I am a fan. So I decided to go with 3 stars. I think the 1 to 5 scale is not enough and should be expanded to 1 to 7 or 1 to 10.

Anyway, the best thing about this location is that it is new. So everything is still nice and clean. 

There are a lot of Mexican restaurants in the Boise area, but most all of them are run down, and look dirty. 

The fact that this one is all new is the main reason we went here. The staff was very friendly, which is another problem I find at most every Mexican restaurant I have been to in Boise.

My wife and I had Fajitas for 2. We really enjoyed them with one exception. In every other Mexican place that I have been to, they bring you Cheese, sour cream, beans, Salsa, and sometime even guacamole comes with it.

Not here.

If you want these things, you have to ask for them and they are extra!

I will be going back to try other Mexican dishes here, so stay tuned for updates. But as of right now, I am a fan on this place. But I do really hope that they will reconsider this policy of not giving you these things that you need for a really good fajita.

Oh yeah, one more thing. The Salsa they bring you with the Chips is very watery and has very little flavor. Not impressed at all.
Food was great and the service was amazing!! The guy that took our order was very nice and gave my wife and I some helpful information.

We went here to try this place. We'd never been to this restaurant before So we decided to try it out and we were not impressed. Our food took about an hour and a half for 1 order of the big Kahuna cheeseburger with fries. Easy order I'd say I could make at home in about ten minutes tops as well as the fries were cheap tiny little fries not even good quality...My spouse had a fillet steak which was a little more understandable however it also took forever to bring out to us. An hour and a half goes by we finally get our food and both of our meats for our meals were burnt...... my burger was black and his steak was also black. I'm not sure what this salad thing was on his plate next to his steak. I almost wasn't sure what I was eating in general. We read reviews and they seemed to be all bad. And we understood why when we got our food. Not to mention the service was....interesting and not in the good way. We will never go here again. However it is off our bucket list and we kept an open mind about this place. I hope it gets better eventually. All we know is we aren't coming here again.

After at least 15 years, they have "updated" their menu and taken out my favorite meal. The VEGGIE PLATTER!!! 
BRING IT BACK!!!  So rediculous to drop items from the menu. Won't come back until IT comes back!!!!
Rice bowl was fantastic. You can select your own ingredients to add to your rice bowl. Staff felt like they had just started their jobs and didn't work cohesively but the food was good.
The only thing I would change is to be open 24/7 everyday instead of only the weekdays. On weekends I would rather go to chatsworth than northridge

I eat a lot of McDonald's so I am a bit of a Mickey D's expert. This location is the best McDonald's in the Treasure Valley. The fries were golden, crisp, and salted to perfection. The Big Mac was visually perfect and tasted as it should. Simply perfect. The crew working the shift was courteous and helpful. Could not of asked for a better experience.
Had an amazing meal and an amazing server, Erica! We enjoyed ourselves the ambiance was great and the food was delicious. The sticky cookie is a must.

We have had dinner and lunch at Kona a handful of times and they are getting worse every time we visit. Won't be back for overpriced, cold and mediocre food. We had 3 kids meals which came out cold, and after mentioning the issue, no action was taken. Good thing there are much better options in the area.
Great food. Meal was perfect. Bartender was very friendly and personable. It does get busy but the wait time isn't too bad. For all those 21 and over- I believe the bar is first come first serve.

Large restaurant with small patio, Started with bacon Bloody Mary, pretty standard. No t a long wait to be seated, however, ordered food 36min ago and still not out. Don't come hungry is all I'm saying. Food was average, nothing that screamed "worth the wait". If you live neatly, it's a decent breakfast spot, however, I don't live close and I don't think I'll make the drive again

It is a shame that this place can not figure out how to properly seat people. Their food is awesome, but the last two times we tried to go here they couldn't not figure out how to seat us and turned us away. We thought this would have been solved moving to a larger building, but that was not the case. Unfortunately, we will not be returning as we have not actually been able to eat here in quite some time.
Never pay with cash. Employee lied about adding a tip after taking two cars through the wash.

I love this gym. It's not super crowded in the morning and it's the same people so you don't feel judged. It's a slightly older crowd so you also don't have that meat market feel. There is some equipment you find at the Crunch on Overland that I wish they had here, but otherwise they have a good selection.

It took us 3 HOURS to get in and out of this awful place. the host was really rude and didn't let us do the happy hour deal. we waited forever for our cold, overpriced food. the service was terrible. spend your money elsewhere this place really sucks

1 Star meal at a 4 Star Price

Let me start with the good news.  The best bourbon and seven I've ever had.  The restaurant is beautifully decorated and the staff is very friendly and helpful. 

Top to bottom:

My daughter said her sushi was very good, but her miso soup wasn't. 

I had the 30 dollar Kona ribeye. It was good but undercooked and had to be sent back.   The mashed potatoes were very good, but the vegetables were cold and hard. Definitely not worth the money. 

My wife had the Kona burger.  She ordered it medium rare.  The outside inch was good but the middle was raw. She sent it back and ask that the reminder be boxed up to take home.  The manager came over and said they were going to make a new one since the other fell apart.  When she got home she found the original one cooked better but in pieces.

After recommendations by numerous Co-Workers, I decided to give it a try. Friday afternoon, medium size crowd inside. I order the 1/4 Ribs and the sausage.

My lunch was COLD!! The ribs were clearly from the previous day and were "beef jerky " consistency. I couldn't tell if the sauce was any good because it was re heated. The sausage (the child's portion I received) was even colder and had the warmth of the previous day's leftover deli tray.

The upside, my server was very friendly and the Cole Slaw was tasty. Totally disappointed, I know Hass from his radio days and know he wouldn't be happy with what the staff put out.

Was ok service, charged 14 for tire rotation even though I was paying 70 for synthetic oil change. Rotation should have been free, won't be back. 
       Well no one from this place called to resolve this matter, they only lied about it to try an halt a bad review. So not only are they overpriced, but they lie to customers. Go someplace else these guys are overpriced crooks and liars!!!
This place is one of the best you could go to. They work with you to help you with your pet. I had a lady, Lexi, go completely out of her way to help me with my dog. Definitely recommend completely!
Family-friendly. Fun and clean. Pricing is good. Food is great!

Joe Momma's is a new addition to Meridian. Though I am ok with traveling to other areas around town, its always nice to be able to go to a place close to home. 

Joe Momma's is a move from their old location in Eagle. They moved to Meridian because they outgrew the old one and Im glad they did. Now this is my first time at this place, so I reserve final comments until I have been here 2 to 3 times more times. 

The reason for this is simple. Every restaurant can have a good or bad day that is not typical of them. So in order to make a good overall judgment of a place, I need to visit them 2 to 3 times in order to come up with an average.

I am always interested in where owners have come up with the names of their restaurants. I will have to ask them on my next visit about this. My guess based on the name is that the owner's name is Joe and it's his momma's place. 

I also thought about a slang expression for "Your Momma" (Jo Momma) but the spelling is wrong for that one. Joe Momma has taken over the building from Famous Daves BBQ. It turned out that Dave was not that famous after all so, after just a few short years, they buckled.

And good ridens to Dave. His BBQ was fatty and not that good. His version of Corn Bread was more like Corn Cake. Yuk and double Yuk.

The only good thing that Dave left for Joe Mommas was that BBQ smell. Maybe this is a pet peeve of mine, but I love when restaurants have a smell. When I watch cooking shows, they always say that you eat with your eyes first meaning that the plate of food needs to look good. For me, I have never really agreed with this. I can just imagine a hand coming out of my eye, grabbing the food, then taking it into my eye where little eye teeth grind it up. 

What I do think is true though is that you eat with your nose. Have you ever walked up to your fav restaurant and that smell wafts right up your nose, you take a deep breath to take it all in, then your mouth starts to water, and you all the sudden you get real hungry and cant wait to get inside?

Every restaurant needs a smell to entice your taste buds and get you hungry and ready to eat. Most restaurants have these smells except for Breakfast places. Famous Daves left its smell for Joe Momma and it made me hungry to get inside and eat.

I have been reading reviews for Joe Momma's. Come on people, really? You are going to rate this place down because of wait times? Its the new place in town, so of course its going to be busy. Even Famous Daves was busy when it 1st moved in until people found it was no good and it tanked.

Even if it stays busy like this, plan ahead, reserve using the app, or go during a less busy time.

The other wonderful thing that Dave left for Joe Momma's was the beautiful wood log cabin. Way to go Dave! I love the look and feel of the log cabin experience and wish more places would do this.

Every breakfast place tries to come up with something different. Something unique that will set them apart from the thousands of other breakfast places out there. Joe Momma has something on their menu called a "Bennie". 

When I saw this, the first thing that popped into my head was they were selling hats. Where they came up with this I have no clue. I wish they had taken the time to explain what these were on their menus and tell us a little story on them. Even if it was something made up.

I went on to read the various Bennies on the menu and some were pretty normal while others were different. I settled on the "Country Bennie", which sounded like a traditional Biscuits and Gravy meal. I also happened to see quite a few half orders on the menu here. Most places dont do this. In America, our portions have gotten way too big, so half portions offer a good alternative.

When I got my Bennis, I was quite impressed. It is a simple, but different take on the same ole Biscuits and Gravy that we have all had. It is a biscuit on the bottom, a sausage patty on top of that, scrambled eggs with cheese on top of that, and the gravy on top of it all. When I took a bite, It was like a cake of everything. I got the eggs, I got the cheese, I got the gravy, I got the sausage and I got the biscuit in every single bite.

This is how Biscuits and Gravy should be. My only criticism on this is that there was not enough biscuit. But other than that, this Bennie gets 8 out of 10 stars. You all need to go try this. Its such a simple twist. After I finished it, I had to wonder; "Now why hadn't anyone else thought of this?"

My wife had a bacon Omlett and "O My", was it full of bacon. I love bacon just as much as the next guy, but this was almost too much of a good thing. It overpowered the eggs and made this taste like you were just eating bacon. If you are a bacon lover, you will probably love this. For me though, it was just way too 1 dimensional. 

I will update this review after a couple more visits, including maybe a lunch trip, but as of now, this is my place of choice for Breakfast in Meridian.
We ate here because of the funny name. Joe's momma can cook!! The place has a lot of fun stuff to look at. The service was spot on and the food was abundant and tasted delicious!

I use to call this place the Palace because of how it looks in the evening. It's perfect for dates, families, shopping, browsing or just a casual stroll. There's something here for everyone even a gym! I love all the events that are put on for the community and the different themes of each season! It's the first place I took my parents to show them the best of Boise/Meridian area and they saw exactly why it was a favorite of ours to come to!

This place is very close to my house I'm hook on the ice cream shakes they have Evey combination you can think of the hamburgers are okay just a typical fast-food hamburger but the chicks are out of this world
I just joined this gym a month ago, people are nice but the gym needs more cleaning and equipment updating.
They charged me $1.75 for a cup of water. No excuse for this. I could understand small cheap cups or $0.50, but $1.75!
Checked in online. Said 50 min wait. Then took an additional 35 min. What good is the app? None.
I love this place. Milk teas, boba, reasonably priced smoothies, and amazing crazy sandwiches and "pho" style soups. They're SUPER nice people and I want them to stick around :)

I went to Twigs for a fun, celebratory lunch after shopping for a wedding dress.  The wait staff was so nice and accommodating, the atmosphere was wonderful, the cocktails were delicious and unique, and the food was amazing.  10/10 would recommend Twigs to anyone!

Yeah, you don't wanna go here.

I rolled up from out of town. Thought I was going to a Sports Bar. Even though the home team Boise State University was on tv, the place was empty. Even locals don't go there to watch the game.

Very small food menu. The entire menu could fit on a napkin. The Street Tacos were great, but I'm sure that was an anomaly. No waitresses. If you want anything you have to go back to the bar to order. Not that that is a deal breaker, but a waitress would be nice. 

Not much of a beer selection. At least not for a, so called, Sports Bar. The drinks were way over priced. The bartender became perturbed when my friend studied the itemized tab. He became argumentative before we even questioned the tab.

It must be noted there were two bartenders on duty. The bartender with the beard was cool. When I asked him about one of the local brews he was able to articulate the taste with accuracy. The negative bartender review in no way reflects on him. It was the bartender with the narrow face that was a jerk. After we told him his prices were overpriced he became upset and wanted to argue. As we walked out he yelled something at us. I let it go because I was tired of dealing with him. 

One star because I have to and one star for the bearded bartender.

I've never heard of Dutch Bros. until I came to Meridian, Idaho last year to visit some family. It's down the road from where my sister lives, so my niece took me there one afternoon. I've never tried their coffees and don't really plan on it, but their smoothies are AWESOME!! That's all I go there for and too bad there isn't one near where I live. The closest is Woodland and I'm not going to drive all the way there just for some smoothie. I will visit Meridian again later this May and I can't can't wait!!
Great service and food. Kayleena was outstanding!  Very kid-friendly and we love their pizza.

This is fantastic Vietnamese food! The eggrolls are awesome, and number 13 on the menu is my go to. The staff is very attentive. The seats and decor could use some updating, but these "worn" places always seem to have the best food, and Vina is no exception.

If you want St Lukes to bill your insurance they won't, they will tell you they did then bill you $900 when your insurance says you owe $200 then they will put $900 into collections. But I mean if you want that to happen then by all means go to St Lukes!!!!! WORST COMPANY EVER

Love this place!! Coming from living in my home state for 30 years, it was hard to adjust to finding a new hairdresser. I am so thankful I found Alicia at Urban Roots. She does amazing work, and is so caring about her clients. I love her work so much, I even recruited my husband and now he is a regular client! She great, defiantly recommend.
Great food great atmosphere. Quick service and very easy on the pocket book. Customer service was great I felt right at home.
Excellent breakfast. We went in about a week ago with a group. We had varying ages in the group and the menu was perfect for offering every one a tasty choice. Will definitely go back!

The service guys up front were awesome: professional, freindly, and knowledgable about my car. They recommended things to repair and not to repair, which saved me money. When did you ever hear of a car shop telling you NOT to do something! Thanks Perry, Derrick, and Matt. And they make a great cup of coffee!

 Ps. The freebies for the car were incredible. The best air freshners!

This office did a great job of getting me scheduled.  Rose was a perfect guide and answered every question and covered every topic that could come up. Very professional.  Their follow up has been phenomenal as well - to answer questions, order supplies, clarify coverage and costs.  I would highly recommend this office!

Two stars for the DJ and the location has its own parking which makes it nice when you absolutely don't feel like going DT. However, the bartenders are just soooooooo soooo soooo rude!!! No smiles no nothing. If you don't want to work hip hop nights don't. Also my friends and I always tip very well we all worked at a bar or restaurant through college so we get the struggle but I cannot stand when people seem like they hate being at work. Get out of the bar business if you can't handle certain nights owners obviously need for business. Fake it til you make it. They are fast so they do deserve a 10% tip but we always tip 30% or more. I hope they tip out the DJ he deserves it and so do the door guys.
Good selection of tennis shoes, workout gears for Men, Women, Teens & Kids! They always have sale going on! Make sure to check out their Clearance Racks! I got crazy deals from time to time!
Always great food, we always get the chicken fried steak which is amazing. Erika is our preferred waitress. She is always kind and helpful. Expect a wait, but it's worth it.

I've been here a couple of times for brunch now and I've enjoyed it both times. I loved the crab cake Benedict. My husband had the chicken fried steak and loved it. The atmosphere is great & the staff is very friendly.  I would highly recommend. Also, if you haven't tried a Brewmosa yet, I recommend you do.

I've never walked out of a restaurant. Until tonight. Walked in around 10pm and the dining room was not very busy. We were seated and given waters. About 10 minutes went by before we realized that no one had been around to take our orders. I made eye contact with 2 waitresses who promptly walked the other way and continued to ignore our presence. The tables surrounding ours were receiving service. At about 15 minutes in, we decided that we clearly weren't welcome. I didn't have super high expectations to begin with but cmon- that's just ridiculous. If I could give them 0 stars, I would. Will not be back.

Came here with my boyfriend a few days ago. We got there around 1:25pm, google says they close at 2:30 but they actually close at 2pm. The person who greeted us (although it wasn't really a greeting) tried to turn us away by rudely informing us that they close at 2pm. Then, she told us she would follow us to whatever table we wanted. When we sat down, it felt like all the staff were staring us. We asked the server if she would prefer us to order our food to-go and she told us not to worry about it. We ordered our food - breakfast burrito, sausage scramble, and a pancake - and received our order around 1:40. Food was somehow cold. No pancake, but I didn't say anything because I didn't want to upset the kitchen workers or be there past 2. We finished, paid, and walked out right at 2. Overall was just an uncomfortable experience and I don't think we'll be coming back any time soon.

Who hasn't heard about Twigs?! It took me nearly a year to get here and I am definitely happy I finally made it. 

I ended up here as a backup option to Kona and when the kitchen was down at Kona we quickly migrated to Twigs. I was there for my dad's birthday and he was so happy to relocate. 

Our waitress suggested wonderful martinis and she was more than okay with switching order details ups. I asked if it would be okay to change the protein in a salad and she was happy to provide me a new option. 

I look forward to trying out happy hours and even the lunch and brunch menus!

Excellent. 

What a great family owned restaurant. Edina is the owner and her father is the head chef.

Very authentic food. My entire family loved the service and the food.

If you're going to eat ai Joe Momma's, definitely use the website to check in ahead of time to avoid an extended wait.

Portion sizes are generous, but the coffee tastes like a cheap dark roast and everything was greatly underseasoned.  The hollandaise was bland and runny and the biscuits and gravy were below average. House potatoes were good, hash browns were crispy but unseasoned.

My server was very friendly, but rarely came by and it took us no less than 20 minutes to get the bill after we were done eating.

There's not much of a chance we'll be back, I was hoping for something better than average.  Oh, well.

Pretty great car wash place! They provide clean drying cloths to wipe up anything the car wash couldn't grab. Very clean. Free powerful vacuums. Suckers for kidos. A friendly employee usually helps you pick the wash at the kiosk. Will continue to use for our vehicles.
Nice and clean atmosphere, with no real complaints. I would definitely go back again, as it is one of the better places I could find after a quick search, both in terms of location and staff.

Great customer service. Everyone was so welcoming. The food was awesome. I couldn't finish all the food on my plate even though I tried my best. My name is Joseph aka joe and my momma was there for breakfast with me and my wife and daughter. Felt like home. Thank you to everyone there.

The place was jam packed, but we got in quicker than the expected 30 minute wait. I ordered the strawberry and cream cheese stuffed French toast and it was DELICIOUS. The hashbrowns were bland, but the sausage patty was huge and yummy too. The waitress forgot my husbands coffee order, but with the busyness if that's the only thing missed, that's okay.

We loved the food here. Make sure to get on the list like an hour before even leaving your home. We only waiting about 15 minutes after arriving at the restaurant. My only complaint would be that the lighting was too bright, but the service was awesome and food was delicious! We will be back!

This is my favorite breakfast place in the whole treasure Valley. They make the most incredible pancakes ever. Their veggie hash and their corned beef hash are awesome and original. I've been going their for 8 years-though they are in a much bigger location than before. The food is as good as its ever been but they lost a bit of their "everyone knows my name" feel. Still great though!!

This was our first time to the restaraunt. The service was great. The guy in drive thru was friendly and the food was out quickly. 

We gave it a 3 because of the food. Our order was wrong. I ordered the Steak Primavera with extra cheese that they forgot to put on and, appearently, they forgot to season the meat. It was bland.
