My wife ordered the BLT with cheddar added and no onion (because who the heck puts onion on a BLT...gross). My wife's sandwich was missing the cheese and had onion. Oh, and did I mention this could have been serious as my wife has a raw onion allergy. Luckily, she didn't have a reaction this time, however, I am not sure we would come back in the future.

Definitely not a community credit union. Financed my car through them and they offered credit card to go with that transaction. It was difficult to pay them due to them not accepting electronic payments. Even paying them via online, my bank had to mail them a check. I paid off the car but still had the credit card. I got divorced, I went in for a new card but instead they cancelled my card, taking away the credit I had paid for. I asked them for help and they made it harder. Now my credit card is past due for last month and they are calling my references, even though there is a payment processing, they won't be able to see it for at least a week due to their non electronic choices. I will NEVER use their services again.
Great food and great service! I had the grilled chicken and shrimp, it was delicious! I will definitely be back.
Nice selection of shoes. Clean store and friendly staff. My son was able to get the orange shoes he wanted for school. Glad we stopped while vacationing!

Went for our anniversary.  Husband had a great portabella truffle penne and the artichoke appetizer was good.  BUT, we were given a menu of the WEEK'S specials and I ordered the Lobster Risotto (on Tuesday).  Waitress said they were out.  She brought drinks and set mine on the wrong side.  I ordered salmon which was billed as Alaska Sockeye Salmon.  I could swear (and I'm going to have it checked out with leftovers) that it was Atlantic farm raised salmon-color and really fishy smell and flavor.  Left a really bad taste.  When I mentioned to waitress she asked if she could get me anything else and said she'd tell the chef then moved on to another table.  Nothing else. Very disappointed. Not interested in returning.

This is an awesome park easily accessed on Meridian Road.

The parking lot is located directly on Meridian Road and is large, so the actual park is set back and away from the busy thoroughfare. They have a little something for everyone...and their dog.

There are large expanses of green open space for sports or games of any kind or to run your dog around a bit (on leash). They have mutt mitt stations to clean up after Fido. They have play equipment wonderful for children of a variety of ages. There's a pond for fishing, picnic area for a little alfresco dining, tennis courts, and even a 9 hole disc golf course.

With all the amenities, this is truly a destination park. You could easily and happily spend an entire sunny Saturday in complete relaxed enjoyment.

Get to it!

I went in with a friend for HH.  Typically, the bar is seat yourself, so we proceeded to walk into bar and sat down in an empty bar.  The bartender came to scold us for not going through the hostess. Ummmm, who does that??? We came to give you business and tip you and you want to be a Nazi on where we sit in an empty bar? My friend ordered her 2 drinks, and I order food and 2 drinks. Nothing passed just bar food.  I would come back if the service was better.

Unbelievably rude service. Jennifer (community service rep) and Jess (managed) in particular. If you are a FitPro professional they will give you such a ridiculously hard time completely opposite of Lululemon. Athleta also charges high prices like Lululemon but the quality is far inferior with Athleta.

Pulled pork was super dry and the brisket was decent. Servers were awesome. Place is very speedy for the level of food, but the hospitality was very good.

Will try again to see if pork is better.

Poor service, waffle had a hair on it. No offer to take it off the bill. Just make another after we waited 25+ mins for our food. Won't be back, sad to see this place going down hill. Used to be one of the better breakfast places in meridian!

Mouth watering good barbeque. The mac & cheese is a must side. The ribs are bone sucking good. The brisket is very tender. I will be back for more!

Brought friends from Austn, TX. First words from them were"The portions are large and the taste is fantastic". I personally had the smoke prime rib which you can only get on Friday and Saturday. It was fantastic, tender-and tasty. 

We are bringing our foodie group, Boise Food for Thought of Idaho from Meetup.com on January 7th.  We just can't get enough of this place!  

To pass it by is your loss!

Pineapple Express by Knack Attack Katering is the real name of this establishment-- their door and menus show it and when I added this to Yelp I put Pineapple Express by Knack Attack and have asked for it to be changed twice, but nothing. The employees did say it's weird and no one is calling it by the real name. Humm...

When I saw them doing construction I was happy to have another place to eat in my neighborhood. I couldn't wait to eat here, but I didn't get the chance until today and I have to say that I am really on the fence with this place. Full disclosure-- I haven't eaten much Hawaiian food so I can't compare it to others.  

5th person to review PINEAPPLE EXPRESS by Knack Attack Katering . This is my 452nd review. 

AS you approach the establishment there are large blue lounge-like chairs for you to sit and talk (no tables).  Walking in there are two doors-- one directly ahead appears to be the Knack Attack Katering office. I saw two women working in there with lots of stuff all over their desk. A small sign on the door says to use the other door for their restaurant. 

Opening the door and walking in you see a place that has very good use of the space. It's decorated pretty cool with picnic tables with large leaves on them. The place has lots of color. The menu is clear on the board (only half of the menu at this time). The staff was friendly yet let me confused on how to order. Near the register, there are fried foods such as eggrolls premade and sitting in a heat case. When ordering the eggrolls the girl said they're over there and I didn't know what the heck she meant until I got to the register. The food is behind the glass lade out like a Qdoba or Subway. The plates are strong, all wood utensils (see my photos), and sturdy cups and lids. 

THE FOOD IS EXPENSIVE! Expensive like my meal was cheaper at the Fork and Madator kind of expensive. I got a two meat tray and it was $13. My son got three tacos $10 and the sodas were a whopping $3 each-- for two people it was over $34, which was high for me for a lunch and not at a nicer establishment. The three meat plate costs $15, which is even more expensive than a BBQ place. Again, maybe average for Hawaiian, but not worth it for me. I've reviewed the cost of its competitors such as CK and Rumi and this place is the higher cost of all three. For the record, you do get a lot of food! 

Near the register is another glass door into the office. The people working in there make awkward eye contact with me, twice. I really feel that this is super awkward for a business and perhaps they should cover the door with something. Again, they have great decorations and ambiance, so that shouldn't be too hard. 

The food: As I said earlier, I am not super well versed in Hawaiian cuisine. I ordered the pig meat because the guy working told me that it was made with a little salt and then slow cooked in all the natural juices for over 24 hours. Well-- all I could taste was salt-- like a lot of salt which was nearly unbearable-- I didn't eat it. I gave it to my other and without saying a word spat it out and I asked me why I put so much salt on it. NONE! I put NONE!

I also got the pineapple chicken (two thumbs up), the spam rice and some corn salad-- I enjoyed all but the pork. The food has a spice to it-- all items that I tried. Unfortunately, my son was unable to eat the tacos because they were too spicy for him. I tasted them, and yes they were spicy. With that being said, we are unfamiliar with many of the items on the tacos such as kimchee; therefore, this may be something that's normal. Just beware in case you're not into to spicing. We also ordered the chicken eggrolls which were good but were awfully liquidy inside and juice squirted on my pants and down my leg--whoops! 

All in all I say it's an A-OK place. Put less salt in your Pork, cover the office doors up, and lower the prices a few bucks and I am sure you'll have a hit. Word of mouth travels fast and I just can't say this is the spot! Maybe a table or two outside, too-- the picnic table theme would go well with that idea although you'd be eating in a parking lot for the most part. Perhaps make it like a Tiki Hut them or something. All in time.

The service was great.  The food was below average.  The unagi roll was plain rice, mushy eel...although well presented.  I know fresh ocean fish
Is hard to come by but maybe, just maybe they can figure out a way to
obtain it at least once a week.

Great drive up shack to grab a tasty meal! Love the original gyro, pure and simple deliciousness without the additional calories, but all the kicked up ones are yummy too, of course!  The employees are friendly & the wait goes by fairly quick. You  drive straight to the pick up window to order-- but sometimes the employees come out to take your order, if it is busy and you are waiting in a line of cars. Really happy that they opened up on Fairview near Hugos & the European store!
A favorite sushi spot, especially during happy hour. Drinks with 'heavy pours' are hit or miss, but doesn't discourage us from visiting when we have a sushi craving.

Went here because my heater stopped working, they got me right in and fixed the same day. The staff was extremely friendly and I will definitely refer all my friends and family to them. Hopefully I won't have anything else go wrong but if it does I will be back!

Stayed one night en route between WA and TX. This La Quinta is modern, clean and friendly. The king room was spacious and comfortable. Nice cookies at check-in. It is far superior to the La Quinta in Caldwell. Only complaint is the eggs at breakfast. Why do motel scrambled eggs always taste so awful?

This place has a little bit of everything. Gas is Texaco so not the cheapest not the worst, there convient store has a good variety but not amazing, they also have a feed store and outdoor and horse supplies. They do have some kobe beef local raised meet and some nice grills for sale also.. so not a bad all around store

Hands down the worst restaurant experience I've ever had! 

Do I have your attention? Good because this place is a joke. 

Why am I so fussy? Well, I hope you packed a lunch because this is going to take a while to read.

I was hosting a UFC viewing party and needed 8 large pizzas to feed a group of folks at my house. Being new to the area, I decided to try a new place out for delivery rather than my usual staple, Idaho Pizza Co. This decision ended up being the worst move I've made since buying stock in MoviePass.  

When I called, I was greeted with a gentleman who had no business answering calls. Why? Well, because that's what he told me! "Sorry man, I usually work the kitchen not the phones." I should've used that as a sign to hang up, but I decided to continue down the path of awfulness. After a lengthy conversation of repeating my orders and him yelling, "will someone answer line 4", my order was complete...or was it?

I was told it would take about 45min to an hour. All good, it's Saturday night and McGregor is fighting - I get it. After 1  1/2 hours I decided to check in as my company was getting restless and I didn't want to end up in an armbar by one of them (UFC reference). A nice lady answered who I believe was second in charge. She asked for my address and told me the driver was out for delivery. Boom - dinner is on it's way, boys. 25min later, I decided to call back for an update. I apologized for being "needy" as I'm a millennial and we are a weaker bunch and didn't want to put her out. Anyway, the same girl answered and said "if she's not there in 5-10min call back". Fine, there were still a few crumbles of chips left that could hold us over for the time being. After 15min, I desperately called back. 

If you're keeping track, this was 2hrs and 10min since I originally called in my order. Again, I spoke to the same girl who took my address again and now advised me that I live in a "dead zone" where they don't deliver! Needless to say, I was speechless. She said my order should've never been taken in the first place. Again, speechless. "Why did you take my address and tell me it's been on the way for the past 35min" I asked and was met with an, "I'm sorry sir". I did the only thing I could think of and pulled a Karen and asked to speak to her boss. After 3min of waiting on hold, I was hung up on! 

Now I'm sure you're thinking, "no way, this guy is making this up". But oh no, my friend - this really happened! I called back and finally I spoke to the final boss of the night. She apologized and asked if I remembered the guy's name who took my order originally, like I was responsible for remembering the kid who was in charge of answering their phones! After pleading with her to drive an extra mile to my house for all the mess, she advised that was a no-no, but did take down my contact info for the owner to call me the next day. Fine - it is what it is. I called Idaho Pizza Co. for help and they let me know they were running 2hrs on delivery. "What's happening" I thought to myself. Did I die and am now in Hell? Out of desperation, I called Papa John's and told them about the pizza nightmare I had just been through. Cold and shaking, they took me under their wing and saved the day just before the main card started. 

"But wait, what did you say to the owner when the called the next day?" Well, just like high school, I waited and waited for my phone to ring from that special someone and it never came. That was Saturday and today is Wednesday. Because of this, I've lost all hope in this place and will shout from rooftops that no one should give their money to such an awful business. And, if you need pizza in a hurry, go to Papa John's. It's not that great and their spokesperson is a racist, but at least they can do their job right. 

I hope you've enjoyed my review of Smoky Mountain Pizzeria Grill in Meridian. Stay tuned for episode 2, should their owner ever call me back...
I bought 15 pounds of produce and only 1/2 pound was useable trow the rest away. We trued the farm up by emmet fresher and last longer.

We visited Twigs early Sunday evening. There where seven adults and one two year old child.

Fist off it took awhile to be asked for our orders. After we ordered our drinks it took quite awhile to get the as our server was also the bartender   We 
ordered alcoholic drinks  along with our dinner 

After waiting thirty to forty minutes we received our appetizers which consisted of fig flatbread and cauliflower and Brussel sprouts dish. The flatbread was great but the cauliflower dish had no cauliflower. Informed server and she said she was informed earlier that they had no cauliflower. She offered a substitute which was a fig flatbread.  

After waiting about forty minutes our order finally arrived. My daughter ordered a lamb sandwich and strawberry salad. The sandwich and fries were cold as was the pizza we also ordered. Asked for manager and he offered another sandwich that he took from another waiting guest. After that he asked what he could do for us. He offered a dessert  for eight people. 

Needless to say this was a terrible experience for all. Probably will not return


A

This restaurant is family owned.  The waitress remembers my name even though I have only been there a handful of times.  Vina's was my mom's favorite restaurant and when she passed the owners gave the nicest gift to my dad for her funeral.  They don't use MSG or artificial anything- and the food is amazing!
my mother works here. and she loves it! or gone there and they are always making sure everybody is doing ok! this place is very clean and can always find people around her happy

Stopped in for a wash cause my car was horribly dirty. What a great place. They give u a good quality wash for a good price. Everything is automated but there is a person to walk u through the process if you get stuck and there is someone to guide u in the wash other then that sit back and relax takes just a couple mins and your out then they have rows and rows of free vacuums for u too use. Staff is nice and freindly and my car is nice and clean.. win win for me will definitely be back when I am around this area to get a nice clean..AAAAAA +++++++++++

SERIOUSLY AMAZING FOOD!!! I've ordered through DoorDash a few times and every time i fall more and more in love. The meat tastes amazing, I always get extra cheese and they give a ton of extra cheese! The sandwiches are very responsibly priced and the taste is amazing. Great job!

We found this new local coffee shop in Meridian. They are so nice! It is a family business. They have all the normal coffees and teas. You won't be disappointed.

What really impressed me is when I was finished ordering a gentleman came in and the barista and owner, Chardoney, started his coffee order. The reason I was so impressed was that this is a new business and the staff already know their customers and they have regular customers.

We will be making this shop one of our regulars as well.

5th review of Hungry Horse Eatery in Meridian off Overland near the Majestic Theatre and Mountain View Highschool. This is my 400th Yelp review! Whoo Hooo I'm a fan! Mmmmmmmm!!! 

The Hungry Horse is a great place to eat-- there is ample seating, good food, friendly people, excellent drinks (including boba) and big portions. 
Note** smaller location with no "public" bathroom. The owner allowed you to use theirs, but you have to walk through the kitchen, which is cleaned and well organized. Tony and the lovely lady helping him (his mom I assume but I didn't verify) were extremely friendly, good wholesome people, and I really enjoyed my time with them. 

I was able to speak with the owner, Tony (I believe) and he shared that he had a restaurant in Southern California then came here to open this one. We got two different sandwiches which are a take on a waffle sandwich, but much more than that. It's almost like a croissant and flaky, not heavy like a waffle-- important to know if you think having a sandwich on a waffle is gross because this isn't gross-- it works! 

I never had boba before. We were treated to chai tea with boba and the tea was super yummy, nice and sweet, with that tea taste that we all love. I recommend trying the Hungry Horse 10 fold!!

Came here to have a little ladies day with my girlfriend. I asked for a manicure with gel polish and my girlfriend was getting a mani/pedi both with gel polish. 
The girls were nice but they were VERY unprofessional. The whole appointment became about the employees, their stories, and their comments instead of my gal and I having a nice girl time. Many of their stories and comments were awkward and inappropriate. And after the one employee finished painting my nails she cracked a beer and on top of this there was no "mani/pedi" to do with any of our treatments. 
Both my girlfriend and I had our cuticles trimmed and nails painted..... that was IT! Not your typical mani/pedi you'd expect. 
I got French tips and the white polish is thin in several places. My friend is also very unhappy with her nails. They are thick  and the tips are uneven.
I gave three starts instead of two because it was only $35 for the gel polish (not manicure) and overall she did a fair enough job that no one will notice the thin spots at my event this weekend ‍ 

However, I will NOT go here again nor recommend it to my friends or family.

I can't really get into Jimmy's, I find the sandwiches bland and uninspired, and the price is similar to other chains. The food is fresh and well prepared, I just can't find anything to make me go here instead of my other favorite sandwich shops. My other big objection is that everything comes covered in mayonnaise, and if I take that off (not a fan) there are not a lot of flavor options available.

Pros: 
Good quality meats
Good bread
Fast Service

Cons:
Mostly bland
Mealy soft tomatoes
Few customization options

Nextitle (Eagle office) Multiple issues, errors and challenges. Never had an experience like this with a title company before. They never seemed to have it together. I will never do business with again.

I was looking forward to a nice meal here as a late lunch, and to possibly bring my wife back for dinner, given we are staying in the Candlewood Suites nearby.

I was intrigued by the pies, given the ratings here, especially the homemade phyllo dough. I chose a meat pie and a spinach pie. They came out and it was almost entirely phyllo dough, with a sprinkling of ground beef in one, a similarly small amount of spinach in the other. You had to look carefully to find any filling at all in parts of the pie.

The pies were tasty, if you expected to eat an excellent croissant, but at the price charged, I was quite disappointed. I was also told I should get the entree vs two pies since it was just a dollar more and you got a salad. Well, the salad was a couple of cucumber slices and tomato pieces, not even worth a dollar for the 2-3 bites.

Overall, it was ok, the dough was tasty, but I'm definitely taking my wife somewhere else for dinner.

You can make a better sandwich at home... I was super excited when I saw the cob wrap on the menu, so I decided to stop in and grab one. I picked up the corresponding bag and when I got to the cash register I asked the guy if I can make a few changes. Instead of chicken, Ham, no avocado and add pickles. I figured this was going to be a good size wrap! At least 8 inches.. right?! NOOOOOO....
(See pic) also.. where the hell is the bacon?! Seriously?! Just a dripping wet mess of a 4 inch wrap. 
ON TOP OF THAT.. it took them 25 MINUTES to make it.. if you run a sandwich shop.. and you're that slow.. you should not be running that shop.. that's total BS.. ITS LUNCHTIME! People don't have 25 minutes to wait!! Absolutely insane. Will not be back.
Love the lemon drops here! Oh and the food is great too. Very nice environment for the family or date night. Perfect location to take in a movie after a nice dinner.

Several years ago when I was running a private performing arts High School, I was able to purchase my first piano, a Yamaha 6 ft baby grand. I LOVED my piano, but in my last few years in a small Portland, OR apartment, it became too much to manage and I had to sell it. The last few years have been really tough, not being able to practice or write music really.  Last month, I decided to buy the bullet and look for another instrument. I didn't have the money for a baby grand, and so I was looking at uprights and hybrid pianos. Hybrids are cool, because the have the convenience of technology with ever improving sound. I had been looking at the Yamaha version but found a new Kawai instrument called the Novus NV10. I went to Dunkleys to demo it, and then again to a local University to try it out again. It is leaps and bounds better than anything else out there, and when it was time to buy, the folks at Dunkleys were awesome in helping me get financing, and buy my new baby!!! They set up delivery, and even took our old upright and facilitated a new home for it as well! The best part about Dunkleys is the sales people are extremely knowledgeable about the instruments, and work with you to make sure it's a good fit between instrument and buyer. Thanks to Melody and everyone for a great experience! Once I sound a little better, I'll be sure to have y'all over for a short recital! Highly recommended.

Fantastic breakfast location with a wide variety of excellent choices. Insider tip: go to their website and put your name in the waiting list before you go to save on waiting time while there! Super useful during busy times.

take a seat for this one.... I show up 20 min early for our reservation & two hours later, we are still here. First of all, the waitress thought a Roy Rodgers was sprite & vanilla syrup  Anyways, I'm thinking about taking our food to go after the 5 cups of water I've already had. if I'm going to drive 30 min to the village I'd rather get an orange panda from Kona Grill at least!

We went in yesterday and talked with Tomas about switching to T-Mobile. He explained the plan I wanted that matched the plan I had with my other carrier, it turned out to be a bit better.
I flled Tomas today, his day off, so he called his coworkers to let them know we were on our way. Shelbie helped us to get a new iPhone 11 for my wife and switching my Galaxy S9 to them. She was very professional getting the iPhone setup so all of my wife's information transferred without an issue. My phone was a little quicker to set up for T-Mobile. The iPhone was free through their promotion.
Over all I save over $30 a month compared to the other Carrier. When I gothome I had to try calling from our office where connection had been an issue, with getting connected and dropped calls. With T-Mobile it was 100% better. A shout out to Selbie & the whole team, two happy customers.

The drinks were very good but the staff acted like we were a bother to them.  I asked if instead of Buffalo sauce, if I could get bbq. A very reasonable request and so she talked to the cook,they said fine. I got the food and there was no bbq and an over abundance of buffalo. I asked her for a new one with bbq and she told me the kitchen had closed.  I was also charged for it.  I don't think I will be coming back unless it is only for the drinks cause the bartender was awesome.

Great selection in their new location.  Their sales staff has been as happy to show me a 75.00 ukulele as they have a 7000.00 Kawai piano.   A few years ago, I was just beginning to shop for my first 'real' piano-and I didn't know diddly.  But Mona (who has since retired) spent a great deal of time showing me the differences between all the different brands, including some $$$ Steinways.  Long story short-I always stop at Dunkley's FIRST for my musical needs.

30 minute wait on Monday morning. 30 minutes to get food. California Bennie delivered without holindais. Back to the kitchen and returned luke warm.
They have some issues and I think it's over rated.
Finger steaks are ok.

This place is really freaking good!! I got the  jalapeño baked herb chicken and cheese sandwich with parm fries. I also got a honey dew milk tea with mango poppers. The sandwich was pretty awesome. The waffle was super flakey. Prepare for a messy sandwich. The guy working behind the counter was friendly and courteous. Such a Great place. Make it here if you can!

I am so picky about my breakfast and Joe Mammas always satisfies. They are fun, bright, and enjoyable and their food is to die for. I never have to wait here either as I put my name on their virtual waiting list and head there when it's near my time. I love the convenience of having my name on the list and laying in bed 15 minutes longer. Love Joe Mammas!

My family was visiting from California so I brought them here for Valentine's. I thought it was a cute little spot with great Bosnian food. I know good cevapi when I taste them, and theirs are spot on. My mom had tarhana--which was authentic.

Besides that, service was a bit lagging as far as checking up on us (it wasn't very busy at the time).

I don't stumble into too many Bosnian restaurants in the Valley, so I will certainly visit again.

This was the second new house we've built. 
Our experience was pretty good for the most part, some hiccups but nothing ever goes as planned when you're building. Megan was amazing and so was Karissa. The people at the design studio could use some retraining on customer service, and the landscape company CBH used was not someone I would have chosen- they did fix our back yard. Other than these few things the experience wasn't to bad.

My friend and I brought my cat in during the day, for an ultrasound of the gut, as my regular vet doesnt have a machine. My cat wasnt eating and was losing weight fast.
After a very long wait, of at least an hour, we were taken into the exam room, where I explained the symptoms to a tech and what I needed.
He left to relay the info to the vet. He came back with lots of papers to sign for treatment. 
The vet then came to examine my cat. She didnt really look him over at all. She said she would get me an estimate and left.
She didnt come back. But the "tech", who really didnt seem like a medical tech but a go between gopher, kept having me sign papers and kept saying "let me give you an estimate for that". And they said they were going to "hospitalize" him and mentioned a price of I believe $150+ a day.
I left my cat there for the ultrasound that afternoon. They did another abdominal xray. They said they were going to have to "send out" the radiology for reports. ($140 was billed without giving me an estimate)
I went home and the Dr later called and said his xrays etc were done. I decided to go get my cat, right away to avoid the expensive overnight stay for no reason.
When I got there, after waiting awhile again, I was escorted to the exam room.  The Dr came in and told me my cat had possible lymphoma that had spread to the lymph nodes. I asked if surgery would help. She said, if she thought surgery would help, she would be in surgery now.
I asked her specifically on the initial visit , and when I went to pick him up, about one of his strange symptoms, of vomiting what looked and smelled like diarrhea.
I had read online it could be IBD. The Dr didnt answer me and actually said "Huh.. " AND NO ANSWER!
I left with my cat and an $800 bill (with senior disc. Glad I asked)!
 My regular vet charged me $30 for an abdominal xray. Their price was $ 155! 
$90 for a quick saline IV. My current vet doesnt charge extra for that.
I had to ask several times to get a copy of the records and xray/ultrasound. Still wasnt ready when I went to pick them up. I had to wait.
I had no hope after leaving All Valley, that my cat would survive. He was given prednisone. Good luck.
I ended up going to a holistic vet, who diagnosed him IBD and a blockage. She did surgery for $275. Kept him 5 days for $20 a day.  My cat and best friend would be dead, if I followed All Valley's theory. He is recovering and is fine!
Dont bother with All Valley. In my opinion its a clip joint, that nickels and dimes you and gets you to sign lots of papers unlike I ever seen. And you will wait and wait.
How they got voted Boise's Best in the past is beyond me.

It's our favorite place to be! Beautiful fountains and water show, great stores and restaurants, love the fire pits in the winter and events year round. Also, I appreciate the security it makes me feel safe letting my teenager go there with her friends.

I have been going to Crystal for about 6 months.  I have had a lot of sports injuries and Crystal is the one person that has the ability to get in there and get the knots out.  She isn't afraid to hurt me, she is little but super strong so she can really work the tough spots, she tells me what she's doing as we go along, she is excellent.  

I like Massage envy. They are not pushy with sales products. It is really easy to schedule and if need be reschedule.  I'm pretty specific with who I want so scheduling isn't too tough.   

Some extra features I really like- essential oils!  I really like the option for lavender in my lotion. I don't do this every time, but I love it is an option for when I want it. Another feature I used once but actually don't love - hot stones.  Although it was nice, it doesn't get the knots out like hands. 

Overall, excellent, reliable, and professional.  Customer service is first class.

Always happy when I leave here. The customer service is beyond top notch. We love the chicken classic. It's flavorful and hits the spot. They also have really tasty fry sauce. Being from Idaho that's a must.
Thanks, Angela!!! Great job on my hair. Color is great and as always you are very gentle and do not hurt my tender head. Oh...and the texture of my hair is great and feels so healthy!!!

I've been bringing my dogs here for a little over a year now, was always friendly and professional. I was told you pay for an exam for each dog once a year. I took 2 of my dogs in to get rabies vaccine. One of the dogs was seen 11 months ago. They told me they charged me the exam fee because he was going to have to be examined in a couple of weeks anyways. WOW, they say he is good for a year then 11 months later charge me again. DON"T  TRUST THE WORDS COMING OUT OF THEIR MOUTH. They lost a loyal customer who use to rave about them and send people their way. Lost a great customer.

Visited on a Saturday afternoon and it was quite busy, however, they were able to seat us right away and considering how busy it was everything moved along in a timely fashion.  Lots of menu choices from breakfast foods to lunch sandwiches and burgers.  Only complaint with the menu is that gluten free items weren't notated directly on the menu and the menu was very faded on one side making it hard to read on all of our menus except for one.  While the gluten free options weren't noted on the menu, they do have lots of options and do offer gluten free toast substitutions.  I got a classic breakfast plate with 2 scrambled eggs, hash browns, and peppered bacon.  The peppered bacon was AMAZING and they give you four huge slices.  The hash browns and eggs were cooked perfectly.  The GF toast came with really tasty good jam.  The environment was clean and bright and staff very friendly.  Food was awesome and can't wait to go back and try more of the menu! Two thumbs up!

We were kinda on the fence about hitting this place up and I'm so thrilled we went. The brisket was tender and had a great flavor. The waffle bread was so flaky. It wasn't that dense texture you can sometimes get with waffles. The best part is that it's a family operated business. The kids were far more polite than most adults. Trust me when I say it's way worth the stop. You will find yourself craving the delicious food and the friendly staff
We are so bummed that they discontinued the basil pesto linguine.  Replace with a salmon pasta when more people I would think people would eat more of the pesto pasta as many don't like salmon.  Sad!

The best breakfast food in town! The pancakes look and taste homemade, unlike the instant powder pancakes you'll find at any 24 hour diner. This is the only place in town with good, seasoned, non-burnt bacon.

The atmosphere is very cozy, like you're having breakfast in a cabin in the woods. There's adorable decor and a grand fireplace. 

The service is excellent as well, and there's always someone close by that's ready to help. Waiters are very friendly and helpful. I'll definitely be back!

Stopped through while traveling cross country because of a recommendation from a local. So glad we did. The food was excellent, coffee was excellent, and the lady who served us(I believe she's the owner) was a gracious host. My travel companion is a picky eater and even he enjoyed the new experience. We ordered the sample plate and it was more than enough food for the two of us.

Do not use their grooming services. After my experience I do not trust these people with my pets. The only time I would come here is if nobody else is open and I absolutely have no other choice.
They charge more than other vets in the surrounding areas. It is great that they are 24/7. The downside is that they charge an after hours fee even though they are open 24 hours a day. 
I would rather take my pets to Ada Veterinary Hospital or Idaho Humane Society. They charge less and I trust them more with dogs than anyone else. 
They are greedy. You cannot ask them a simple question without them saying that you need to bring the dog in. They are just as bad as a human clinic. 
Here is my story. When I first got Oreo she was a mess. She looked like she never had her hair done. She ended up in this same exact condition many times since she is difficult to groom. I have NEVER had an incident until I took her to the groomer at All Valley Animal Care Center. 
When I took her in I should have walked away. I saw the groomers horsing around with another dog instead of working. I dropped her off anyway because I had to be taking care of my other dog and I did not have any time whatsoever. When I came to pick her up she was shaking her head. I didn't think anything of it.
I take her to the pet store and noticed that whenever she shook her head there were droplets of blood. I took her back to All Valley and placed a complaint about the groomer. All they did was look at her and the groomer stood there making excuses. Instead of taking ownership of the situation I had to spend $800 for their mistake. They had messed up while grooming her and she ended up needing to get her ears drained. The only thing they could say was that she had mats and it was a freak accident that can happen. Again, I have never had this happen before therefore they did something wrong. 
When I took Oreo in for a follow up people were shocked at her appearance (she had a bandage wrapped around her head) and they would ask me what happened. I pointed at the groomer area and told them that All Valley's groomer did this. This shocked them even more. 
This experience was traumatizing to both me and my dog. Ever since then I have been having a difficult time trusting any groomer with the dog.

Always wonderful service. Best happy hour around, although it seems to constantly be changing. We love the atmosphere. Outdoor and indoor seating is wonderful. Great for a date. Dinner with girlfriends, or family dinner. This is a go-to for our whole family! The sushi chefs are super friendly!

We found this wonderful place around a month ago and it has been awesome. The food was super, the customer service, the ambiance and everything. That is until this morning. It was medium busy at best yet our server was far more interested in chatting with the other employees then helping us. I ordered a double burger with bacon and crispy fries yet I received a double burger with no bacon. By the time she returned, we were 15 minutes past eating and just stuck there waiting.
I try to be a fair guy with these reviews so I'm keeping a 4 star unless another bad day experience arrises.
This is the best place for noodle soup and boba drinks. We always have wonderful conversations with the owner. We highly recommended  it.

What a great place to stroll and shop. We've been to Boise several times and watched this place get built but did not visit till this year. Fountains, shops, people to meet and a leisurely walk are the great things waiting for you at this Village. Don't pass it up...er actually maybe you should cause it'll be less crowded when I go :-)
Really enjoy going here for a nice family dinner or hitting up happy hour to have drinks and appetizers with my mom group!!!

First time here. May experience was stellar! And the staff was a tentative and informative. I ordered the pepper steak, and it was amazing. I don't eat a lot of cheese steak sandwiches, but this place could build an addiction for sure. I got the 7 inch and it was plenty for seven dollars. The meet was hot tender and seasoned just right!!

Do yourself a favor and come eat! 

If you don't like cheesecake have lots of other options burgers deli sandwiches gourmet subs.

Meh....So many other choices in the Valley. I am a RE Professional and I always get errors and excuses at NexTitle. I'm sure there are some good individuals, but save your money and buy a lottery ticket.
Thanks for a great lunch option guys! Appreciate your flexibility helping craft me a vegan shake. And how adorable is the pup?! Definitely try this place out if you're in Meridian

It's clean and relaxing in here.  The staff were courteous and welcoming.  I had a prenatal massage and enjoyed it.  I'll have to go later on and do an update for deep tissue massage once I'm not pregnant.  
The one thing I LOVED- is there wasn't tons of talking- the hallways were quiet- which is how it should be in a spa when you are trying to relax, clear your mind, and focus on your massage. My therapist also didn't talk my ear off and let me enjoy my massage.  That's priceless.  I hate going for a massage and having someone question me for a full hour.  I'll definitely try them again.

First time visiting. Wasn't sure what to expect. 
Well, it didn't disappoint. 
Food was great! Isaac,(waiter) was great! 
I had a calzone filled with meat,so good.
My wife had the salmon pasta, delicious!

Good atmosphere. Wasn't too busy on a Tuesday night. Got drinks and apps promptly.

We will definitely be back to try some more.

We have driven by this place on several occasions and have never went inside.  A family friend told us about this place so my wife wanted to try it.

We went in around 5:00 PM, and were able to catch Happy Hour.  Our waitress was Ngyen, and she was outstanding.  She brought us some sampler beers and we both had a  pint of beer.  My wife had a scotch ale, and I had a peanut butter stout.

For appetizers we ordered Brisket Street Tacos and Tater Pigs.  Both were great, but the tacos were outstanding.  Next time I come  here that is what I want.

We ordered the three meat sampler with brisket, pulled pork, and tri tip. It was great, our sides were baked beans, and smashed potatoes.  Everything was great.  

Our waitress made it that much more enjoyable.  If you are ever in the area I would suggest you stop in and enjoy a meal.

Craig saved us from having to replace our carpet after a nail polish spill. I'm so glad I called a professional. I highly recommend him for your carpet cleaning needs and will definitely be using him again in the future.

We had never heard of Soda Stop until the owner dropped a menu by our office last week.  We were so excited to have another option for DELIVERY!  They offer a variety of hot and cold sandwiches, panini, wraps, and salads.  The drink menu is a little overwhelming because they have so much; however, the possibilities are endless.  You can pretty much create anything you want and the best part is that they use that perfect pellet ice (also sold by the bag cheaper than Sonic).  

I called and placed the order around 11:45 AM and the person who took my order was very polite and helpful as it was my first time.  Our order was delivered by the owner around 12:45.  I would recommend you plan ahead when placing lunch orders.  I didn't think an hour was too bad considering that I called right during lunch.

I ordered the All American Panini (think grilled ham and cheese) with a bag of maui onion chips, a frosted sugar cookie and a Creamy Loco Coke-O.  I was very happy with my meal but next time I think I'll try a cake pop.

My husband built his own roast beef sandwich with salt and vinegar chips, a snicker doodle cookie, and a "witch doctor" to drink.  Our other employee ordered a wrap.  They both enjoyed it but agreed that next time they would both choose the GRILLED option :)

We will definitely be adding Soda Stop to the weekly office rotation.  Jimmy Johns gets old and there are way more options at Soda Stop.  We got all of the food listed above for a total of $32.99.  Another added bonus is that they offer a REWARD CARD!  For every $25 spent you earn $2.50 in rewards.  I requested a card when I placed the order and he brought it with our delivery.  It was very simple to go online and register my card where I can also see my current rewards.  Looking forward to online ordering (coming soon)!
Great atmosphere and amazing beer! Different food trucks just about every day. We love bringing our pup here on sunny days. Dog friendly inside and outside!

We ordered delivery. We were told it would take 45 minutes to an hour. It took an hour and 25 minutes.  I called after an hour to inquire, but the woman who answered didn't seem to care. Said it's on the road somewhere.  When the food finally arrived, it was cold and did not taste good. Very unhappy with service and quality of food. Wont be ordering again.

We were visiting friends who recently moved to Eagle, Idaho from Southern California and they suggested a breakfast place not far from their home. Well, Joe Mommas is the spot for breakfast, that's for sure. Their short stack pancakes consist of two pancakes that are hanging over the edge of the plate, awesome with cranberries and nuts. The breakfast group had various meals ranging from omelettes to a Cuban Breakfast sandwich. Of course, we sampled them all and each was terrific. The service is first rate and the servers are cheerful and upbeat. The ambiance is noisy but that makes the experience fun and festive. If you order the short stack, be prepared to take most of it home. I wish we had a Joe Mammas is Southern California.
Great food and service every time we come here! Also on Sunday's it's kids eat free!! Once we cake in and they were out of kid's burgers and chicken strips which was a bummer though

We stop in here every week: it has become a tradition for us now. We love dropping in, getting a mocha and getting a new comic book.

Everyone is always friendly and helpful.

The atmosphere is great and we love it!

In today's lending market accuracy and timely communications are key to a great customer experience.  Our own experience with WVB was lacking on several fronts, with routine errors and miscommunication from start to finish.  In-spite of these challenges,  we were eventually able to close on our home loan but not without an 11th hour hiccup that nearly delayed the close process.  Owning your mistakes is key to building a business, doing what you say you will do is also paramount - in this particular customer experience ..  much to improve upon.

I had to take my senior dog in last week for some GI issues.  Although it was not Emergent there was a sense of urgency.  They were so GREAT!!! I have to say I had a very positive experience.  My dog was seen very soon after we arrived and the whole process was about 1.5 hours.  Brittany the technician triaged my dog and was very professional, friendly and comforting with both mine and my dogs needs.  I was kept in the loop several times during the course of his treatment.  Dr. Marnie Troska presented my options for treatment and his plan of care was set in place.  I was not allowed to go back with my dog due to COVID, however they kept me updated throughout the entire process.  I was very happy and satisfied with my experience.

This place is very clean, the therapists are usually pretty good and it has a nice spa feeling. It is one of the most expensive places to get a massage in the valley though  and I'm not convinced that it is totally worth it. I waffled back and forth between 3 and 4, and ultimately landed on just A-ok. 

I've had probably 10 massages here over the past few years. My partner loves to get them for me for Mother's Day and birthdays. Which is always so sweet and welcome. Sometimes the therapist is really good and listens to my desires, other times they just do their own thing. The atmosphere is pretty nice. They have calm music playing in the rooms and low lights. The beds are pretty comfy and they use a heating pad to keep you warm. 

The main reason that I can only give them 3 stars is the bang for your buck. You're quoted as getting a 60 minute massage but it's really 45-50 minutes. The appointment is 60 minutes. One time I was shorted so much, I said something to the admin and was told that the therapists need time at the end to discuss "medical needs". Eye roll. If they could work on their affordability, I would feel comfortable patronizing them more. As it is, I can go somewhere small and local for cheaper.

Not impressed. An error left us receiving over $6000 less than NexTitle's original closing statement. Their local commercials sing the lines "it feels like family here - it goes faster here - it goes smoother here". Not in our experience. Bring your calculator and ask questions.

Met another couple for dinner here at Kona Grill, good service attentive waiter and even the manager checked on us after we got our food.  For an appetizer we had the calamari, which had a good spicy sauce with it but the calamari was only so-so and included way too many of the tentacle pieces which were dried out.  Shared the macadamia nut chicken full order and they split it on 2 plates, as you can see in the pictures it was more than enough food for two people, very impressive flavor and the gravy and mango sauce that comes with it take this entrée over the top. Ordered a side Cesar to split as well before the meal, it to was so-so and was very small and unimpressive in size. The couple we met each had the Asian chicken salad's, they appeared very large and they enjoyed them and even took some home. Overall good experience, surprisingly not as loud as we thought it would be and were able to talk freely at our table without too much background noise annoying us.

First - fire the snapchat watching hostesses. I would have fired them long ago. 

I've tried four times. I will never go back. Just a bad spirit about the place. Where do I start? About a month ago I was drinking a beer and I noticed a bug was in it. I saw a manger walk by and I mentioned it to her. She snapped at me, "Sure, after you drank half of it." My wife wanted to jump over the table. 

We had another terrible experience there two months ago, but I will skip to last night. 

The waiter took our order about five minutes after sitting down. We ordered two waters and two beers. About five minutes later we got our waters. The drinks did not come. I went to the bar and got them myself. The bartender gave me a very dirty look. 

We LITERALLY never saw our waiter again. After about 20 minutes went up to the Instagram trolling hostesses and asked to see a manager. They never got one. They had a serious snapchat going on their iPhone 10's. 

To the managers credit, she comped our meal. She offered to pay for another meal if we came back. No thanks. 

The food is pretty good, but would never go back to that place.

All around great service and good ole fashioned food. The chicken fried steak was probably the best I've had. I opted for the breakfast potatoes and I'm glad. The biscuit is home made and it's good and fluffy. Definitely a five star restaurant.

Due to the downgrade of the menu I gave it two stars. The happy hour menu was what really made this place fantastic. They really cut it down to only select things. Not only that, but the food is in smaller portions and MORE expensive. Example bbq chicken flat bread, we used to get 8 full sized pieces for $7.50. Now, it's $9 and it's 4 full size pieces (cut in halves). The wave roll came in 5 huge pieces, now it's  8 really small pieces. The chocolate brownie used to be so rich and decadent, it is now a really cheap tasting brownie with no fruit on top. I'm really disappointed. I live in California and I was looking to coming back to my favorite restaurant back home. I hope you guys go back to not being so greedy and cheap with your p

Had my nails done yesterday, and I am impressed, love the SNS powder dip, they look fabulous. Both Cindy and Sandy were friendly, the shop is neat and clean, nice selection of nail colors. Will be a return customer

I don't do traditional fast food, so the Gyro Shack is a great option for (mostly) fresh food. It is especially handy when I don't want to drag "Hungry" and "Hurricane" into a restaurant and just want a drive through.  

I have had just about everything on the menu. My favorite is the deluxe with lettuce added (kinda crazy that they charge extra for that though...) or the "Z" (love those pepperoncinis) The tzatziki sauce is awesome and the hummus is creamy. The meat is a pretty typical gyro meat, nothing spectacular. I have had it served lukewarm a few times and that's a bummer. I would like it crispy and juicy and it's just never reached that finger lickin' level.

I have been to an event where the Gyro Shack catered and they did a great job. Punctual delivery, hot food and abundant portions. However. The veggie patty was SO awful kept warm in the chaffing dish. It got soggy and floppy and lost the bit of crisp that makes it normally palpable. Avoid that if you're catering.
Dedicated to making their customers happy! They helped my family get into a new rental after we arrived to a place that wasn't up to their standard. So happy to help. Thank you!

If I could give this place less than 1 star, I would. This place is a complete shit-show. Bar staff and cool guy, hipster, "bouncers" are poorly trained and unsupervised. Having cro-magnon bouncers and staff who don't know how to listen logically to situations, is a recipe for disaster. We are going to be filing a lawsuit against this establishment for injuries suffered during an altercation perpetrated by the bar staff. Hope this place is shut down in a year.

I had this place at a 3 but after going to the new place on Eagle I have to dock it another point. There's just nothing special about this place. Too many options in the Treasure Valley and Moe Joe's crushes this place. Pretty sure the Orange Juice is from a Walgreen's Container.
Nice server though
Bring back the old happy hour menu. Prices way too high for what you get now! How can you have a happy hour menu without sushi rolls on it?! You guys were a go to place. It's a shame!
YUMMY, YUMMY, YUMMY!! Steak classic and crinkle cut fries...the best! Clean restaurant, friendly people!
WOW WOW WOW! I will be here once a month for the rest of my life. So healing so relaxing just pure magic. I love this place!!

We stopped in for lunch.  I was disappointed.  The sandwiches, while reasonably priced, were small.  I ordered a hamburger.  It had quite a bit of gristle in it.  I kept chewing on stuff in the meat that I don't like.  My wife ordered a Polish sausage sandwich.  It too was small.  The fries were very good.  We both ordered coffee.  Wow!  We each got a 6 oz cup which was delicious, but definitely not enough.  I kept thinking that maybe someone would come by and ask how we liked our lunch, but that did not happen.  I was going to ask for more coffee if someone came by, but like I said, that did not happen.  The music was a little too loud which made it had to carry on a conversation.  I went to the Men's Room to wash up and it was dirty.  Oh, and the table was dirty when we sat down.  There weren't many customer's there, so I don't understand why the tables weren't cleaned.  So in summary, I would not bother to stop at this place, unless you had absolutely no other choice.

Absolutely terrible service for barely warm, average food that took way too long.  After being seated, it took our server 25 minutes to take our order, and she arrived only after we asked another staff member to get her for us.  The food took an hour to make it to our table, and one entree was missing. What did arrive had clearly been sitting in the window for a while--it was dried out and barely warm. During that entire hour of waiting, our waitress stopped by our table ONE time. She didn't even deliver the food, two others did, and we didn't see her again until she dropped off the check. There was no explanation, no apology, nothing. I expressed my frustration and asked to speak to the manager, who never showed up.

This is a Great place to grab a beer or cider!  I Finished a pedicure with my friend next door and decided to grab a beer afterwards. They have a super friendly staff and a great selection of Beer and Cider that rotates. 

There is plenty of indoor and outdoor seating for groups. They also have Televisions if you are wanting to watch a game. 

Every week Loose Screw has all kinds of fun events as well.

Our server was good, but the food has gone down hill and their prices have gone up. Not many selections. Not impressed.
We used to come here all the time for their happy hour but now it's a pitiful menu.

Great hospital, the staff is very attentive, the nurses are fantastic and friendly, and the doctors are one of a kind. My name is Juan I spent 8 days there with sepsis, DKA, Blood clots, stomach infection you name it, and Dr Appezato left me walking out of there like a new man. Words can't describe how much I appreciate this place, they literally saved my life and I'll be eternally grateful. Thanks Dr and all the staff, God has a good spot for all of you in heaven one day. God bless, and may continue blessing you all. Thanks again.

drainage issues because they took the a ton of dirt out of the sub division, and then built it up so all water settles in between both neighbors yards.  Most of the subdivision has water in their crawlspace.  Their solution?  Take the neighbors sump pump and pump it into my front yard.  

Then I get yelled at by the HoA.  *MY* solution was for Corey to come HIM (the CB in CBH homes) and mess with my sprinklers so now my grass that was just installed is dead (went on a trip came back to dead grass) Dana (my contact point) says sorry he's the boss this is how he does things.  How he does things is ignores all the pictures that Dana took, and says "we'll wait and see" when my home warranty is up next month.  

How is killing my grass going to fix the problem that I pointed out during the home walk-through but I was lied to, "your neighbors are over-watering, it won't be a problem" $1,500 dollars in flooded fruit trees later proves it IS still a problem, that they "Fixed" by turning off my sprinklers and killing my grass.  They just closed the open ticket they had for me...

No stars (had to choose one to make this review)
One of the owners was the waitress'd our table. I ordered the BBQ chicken wrap with only the grilled chicken and the side salad, it came out and had grilled cheese and BBQ sauce, and the side salad dressing, I ordered balsamic vinaigrette, and I accidentally tip it when picking it up and only the oil came out, we showed the owner and there was no balsamic vinegar, it taste like oil. I sent it back for the reason above, stating I would not have time to get it all prepared and finish my meal so I told her don't get me anything. A few minutes go by and she bring out the correct plate and I told her I did not want it but she took it, came back stating, she was next to me on a previous visit, the scrambled eggs were wet, and the gravy had so much pepper I couldn't eat it. I paid that bill, I noted on the bill those two things, and since I was sitting at the bar and the male owner was bartending, I did not give him any tip, be cause he is the owner. Anyhow, she said every time I come in, which I've only been 3 times, and the second time no issues, so she said I'm not welcome back, she doesn't want me in her establishment because she made these items non-edible. I don't recommend anyone to this restaurant, IHOP and Denny's has better food, go there instead.
Great coffee drinks, always a pleasant greeting, baristas smile, will make you a special drink if you ask. I don't need to return my drink, ever. Great Job Dutch Brothers!
good food nice ambiance and in the middle of lots of places

Food is FANTASTIC!!!  Only problem was that on a quiet Wednesday morning, the owner (?) had a VERY loud conversation on her cell phone while sitting at a table in the middle of the restaurant.  She was talking to her accountant or lawyer, and I know now much more about her and her business than I care to know.  It really took away from the great meal.

I love this place and my dog wouldn't be alive without all the amazing doctors! I have a 5lb chihuahua that got into a accident with another dog. My dog was rushed into this hospital and they immediately started the process to save him. Bentley has had his face reconstructed, leg amputated and we are working on his little eye getting better but I bring Bentley in about once a week to continue his eye treatment and everybody greets Bentley and takes such good care of him! Dr. Macintosh and Dr.Lake were the docs that saw Bentley from beginning to now and I forever owe them and am so grateful for their knowledge and compassion. 

Thank you All Valley for giving Bentley more years!

How crunch managed to be worse than IAC is beyond me? I'm always baffled how a sales team can turn me off from spending $25 a month?  I've gone there 3x to buy a membership and ended so turned off by the front desk I leave, every time.  Ugh now I have to go fight traffic at Axiom but at least they actually want people to buy their membership.

This is as a very solid breakfast and based on my experience nnott sure of some of the other not so great reviews. Our experience was great from start to finish.  Walking in the decor is  cabin and country which not my  style I was here for the breakfast and not the decor. 

Walked in and we were immediately seated...forewarning we got here  early right at 9am and by tHe time we left there was a 45+ minute wait. Once seated a super friendly waitress by the name of Madison C came over to our table and was so great welcoming us in. We enjoyed a few mimosas and had such a great breakfast. I had the green eggs and ham which was  freshly roasted Chili's, house smoked ham and I added onions, mushrooms and switched out  for pepper jack. My wife had the crab cake benedict which she thoroughly enjoyed  along with some crispy bacon. 

Everything was cooked perfect and all of us really had a great experience all the way around...look forward to another visit while visiting our daughter.

We had a company Christmas party back in December here. The service was OUTSTANDING, and the food could've been great if they had a better way to keep the temperature right. I got a free dinner for two due to the comments we made about cold dinner that night. 

So I tried it again last Sunday (Super Bowl). The service was again OUTSTANDING. The Coconut Prawns was great. The 16-oz ribeye steak my date ordered was great. My angel hair pasta with lobster was ok. The lobster was great, but the pasta had too much cheese in it, the whole thing was one big glob - the noodle wouldn't separate. My dessert (creme brûlée) was great too. Overall, the flavor of foods there is pretty good.

We have had a wonderful experience with our now 2 year old daughter at Montessori Academy. She is thrilled to go to school, and we couldn't be more grateful for the safe and fun learning environment the staff creates everyday!

I would give more than 5 stars if I could!  Kim is amazing and the owner is just as great. We've been back multiple times to purchase furniture for additional rooms in our home. I have been eating breakfast in the valley for quite some time. I always find myself coming back here, especially when friends come into town. The service is great, and the food is even better. Visiting from out of state.  Tons of stuff here.  Prices are all fair.  Very friendly staff.  Glad we stopped by.  Will definitely return as well as check out there online stuff
The weakest coffee I have ever had. Not drinkable. I ended up pouring it out in a planter once the coffee cooled off. The plants are now dead.

Haven't been here in awhile. Kinda turned off by the larger location. Lots of noise, and service wasn't that great. But today I gave it another try. First observation, screaming kids everywhere! Mark those words!

Delicious! Had the #17 cracked pepper turkey sandwich for lunch this week and it was delicious!!! Delicious turkey and the flakey sourdough bread was amazing! Can't wait to try out different combinations. Great sandwich for a great price! I am fan!

I absolutely love this place. They are always professional and happy to see us, no matter when or how many. Our server was Mark and he is always delightful and prompt. Everything on the menu is great. I haven't had even an iffy meal yet. Bronx is the best manager I've seen in a long time. Alway helpful. If you need to see him and he is not on the line helping out in the kitchen he will drop by your table and visit like you are the only thing on his plate at the time. This place is worth your time and money.

Love their beer but.... half the new location on McMillan is filled with games for kids. I love kids but the yelling, screams and excitement of gaming pushes the noise over the top. Lose the games, put in more tables and sell more of your great beer.

Call this dubious. I went in person to open an Idaho Medical Savings account. I used a debit card to transfer my deposit. Note this was the first time I have used this debit card in over four years. I awoke to two unauthorized transactions on the card this morning. I immediately deactivated the card and now I have to wait to dispute the charges once they post to my account.
Jamie was our server! The best service I've ever had! And her body wasn't to bad either!!!!!
Professional through and through. The house was great it was extremely clean and very fresh. We will absolutely come back and visit again and stay in the same place

I was told this place was good. Well it's not. Patio, dishes, glasses were dirty; food was mediocre and the service was the worst! Our Server was more concerned about impressing the chick at the table next to us than he was on making our guest experience enjoyable ...O'well we won't be back. We left Kona Grill and walk across to Yard House where we knew we'd have an enjoyable time.

Lovejoy's Real Ice Cream 

On 7/31/21, I tried Lovejoy's Real Ice Cream in Meridian for the first time. They have a nice mix of traditional and nontraditional flavors, as well as a couple of vegan flavors. I tried a scoop of Banana Cream Pie ($4). I liked it. Is it the best ice cream I ever had? No. I like that they have this particular flavor, which most places don't, but the scoop was a bit small for the price and it wasn't as creamy as expected. Even so, it's a cute place and definitely worth checking out. I was there around 8:30 PM on a Saturday night and it was busy. They have two different sizes of ice cream flights. You can also buy fresh honey from the owners' beehives. I look forward to returning and try and more flavors.

Location:
1760 S. Meridian Rd. - #101

Hours:
Monday through Saturday from 11 AM to 10 PM
There is always a line for a reason. Great home country food with a personal touch. Go, plan to wait and enjoy!

This has become one of my favorite places in town. The prices are pretty good and everything I've tried is delicious. You can't go wrong with any of the menu items. Definitely treat yourself to the baklava too!

Agents be aware the CBH home Orientation it is not a friendly one. The orientation crew walks fast through the home as they are providing important information to your Buyers and do not want to be interrupted, to distract you from looking or finding items wrong with the home.   I was asked to stay with the crew and listen.   I found some items that required repairs and the heavier man doing the repairs argued and yelled at me several times and tried to tell me the Buyer was not asking, I interrupted the inspection to show the Buyer and yes the Buyer asked for it to be repaired and painted. It was very frustrating this was not a walk through it turned into a meeting and not a final walk through.  The agents Jordan and others are very pleasant and helpful until you get to the home orientation. My next Buyers will be aware ahead of time to request to do a final walk through before or after the talking session.

5 stars for the quality of frozen yogurt, toppings, and the cleanliness of the shop. I was however really disappointed at the young girl working there. We came in around 6pm, paid and sat down. A few minutes later two young guys walk in and proceed to tell her that they are trying to get the cheapest thing possible. The girl proceeds to tell them that she has a huge stack of free 5oz cards in the back which she plans to take on her last day. She then gives them both a "larger" sample cup and allows them to fill it until it is overflowing. It is this type of young person that is willing to take from their employer that makes me sad. 

No wonder small businesses can't stay open. I will return to this location and maybe they will have hired some better employees.
I had the Rock (And Roll) Road ice cream. I love that they didn't skimp on the marshmallows. My wife had the Banana Cream Pie and both flavors were delicious!
I love them!!! The bowls are amazing.  The gyros are tasty.  I only wish they opened earlier for breakfast because a rice, egg and chicken bowl would be perfection.  :)

This place is gorgeous! Alex is an incredible bartender. They are open now, they close at 10pm, I believe they are open Wednesday - Saturday. Do yourself a favor and order an Old Fashion, they're dank.

The Good: The food was good and the portions were great for the price. The people were kind though not very attentive, and not because it was busy. We were the only table seated on a Sunday night after about 20 minutes of arriving. The menu was very extensive!!! Chinese, Thai and Vietnamese dishes. That's pretty diverse! My wife had pho and liked it, I had pork egg foo yung which was good and my kids shared a massive plate of orange chicken. We were all happy with the food. 

The Bad: the bathrooms are disgusting, which at a food place is very concerning. It looked like the bathroom hadn't been cleaned in about a decade and the urinal basin was brown and the pipes literally leaked when I flushed it. Cobwebs in the dining area, dust everywhere and even the fish tanks were mossy and neglected. The Thai iced tea was 98% ice cubes and wasn't typical of a Thai restaurant, I don't recommend it. 

The Ugly: the decor and ambiance are awful. Before you call me picky, ask yourself: why do I eat out at a restaurant, and pay somebody else to cook? For me, it's to enjoy a really good meal and the experience of an outing with my family or friends. The seats were all ripped and uncomfortable, everything was dusty and dingy and the place probably hasn't been updated since 1982. There was some incessant beeping sound coming from the kitchen and in a place that's dead silent (eery if you were alone) without music playing, it is annoying. The inside of the place is awful and you would never take a date or even your in laws here. 

To be honest, I was relieved and a little surprised none of us had stomach problems. Somehow they get a "Grade A" from the health department, so that's good, but they must not inspect the bathroom. If I'd gone in there first I would have left without ordering. This place could be amazing because the food and service is good but everything else is poor. I recommend takeout only. I won't be back.

This is specifically for the ER- I was charged $937 when I went in with my 9 month old. We waited 35 minutes in the waiting room to spend 5minutes with a DR who said he had a "bug"...  the billing department informed me that it was a more expensive visit because my son was vomiting.... ummm....he did not vomit at the hospital, or the patient room. We were charged more because they had to escalate it as an "emergency".... wait, what? So you are charged more when it is more of an emergency? Who can afford this kind of bill, I'd like to know? Never visiting this hospital again. It's too bad because I love our OB Doctor there. 
The billing guy was rude and talked over me and didn't take two seconds to listen when I spoke. Ugh, ripping off people with sick children- way to go St Luke's!

Staff were wonderful and helpful. Any questions I had - even as someone newer to some of the collections - they were happy to answer. The store had a lot that was spread out so if you can't find what you are looking for, ask the staff. 
Owner was out about with the customers and very personable. If you are looking for a rare find definitely check this place out!

Went to Kona for my birthday dinner. Server spilled our drinks all over the table and two glasses shattered and cut my husband's hand. Got the check and it was full price! Talked to GM and he took less than half off the bill. How tacky that we had to ask and they didn't even comp the meal...and our meal was only $60. Terrible customer service by the management. So disappointed because the food was excellent. Hopefully the glass shard in my husband's hand doesn't get infected or they'll be paying much more than our $60 meal. What a slap in the face!

My kids love this place. The entire staff is so friendly & accommodating and Dr. Blair is fantastic. It's clean & comfortable & my kids are totally at ease here. And they never rush us which is nice. My daughter used to be so frightened going to the dentist but not here. We're very happy with the level of service we receive.

We've been to this place just once in warm weather when we could dine outside, we love the food since it's made on sourdough bread. The biggest bummer about it is that it's only open on weekdays and closed on weekends..

I love Kona Grill. Fresh fish, awesome rolls, and great drinks. The only complaint I have is that the sashimi portions seems to be somewhat inconsistent, but that's likely due to the piece of fish they are working with on a given day.

One of, if not the best, shooting ranges/gun stores I've visited. The range is clean with ventilation and fans, lighted stalls, and a hand-wash station with special soap that removes lead. All of the staff were super friendly, especially Sonny. Prices were actually pretty good, for both the range and for the firearms. The whole interior is modern, but still very homey and professional. Will definitely be coming back, and probably going to enroll in some classes!
Good food and nice atmosphere. They were extra cautious during COVID which was super helpful
Excellent Deltaco very well ran, well trained team, don't need 30 sauces with my order but besides that great job

Went to Hungry Horse with my daughter for lunch. What a cute place. My daughter had a beef rice bowl while I had the chicken bowl. Perfect size to fill you up. 
Atmosphere nice and clean. 
My only thing was my rice bowl had way too much ginger that it over powered everything else. But it won't stop me from going back.
Best Ice-cream ever! Check out their Ice-Cream Panini's! Clean, fun place to go for a treat! We will go back for sure! Manager so nice to visit with us and their staff hard workers and kind.

Only giving two stars because the food IS good. However, I went in today and saw only ONE staff member wearing a mask! There was NO social distancing, NO enforcement of masks and NO spacing between tables! Very disappointed. Did they forget people were still dying from COVID19?

I was hoping when the new owner Crunch took over the gym would be better taken care of. I have been waiting and waiting and it only seems to be getting dirtier. I won't even workout in the mornings anymore because I have to shower for work and the restrooms are so dirty. I only hope that when the remodel is done then they will start actually cleaning the place.
The only thing that keeps me coming is the instructors are great I would give them  five stars.

Each time we have waited for over an hour. Susan is great and so kind. But she takes her time. 

Hard to be a mostly single part and get stuff done when working full time. Wanted to send my teen over on his skateboard before he works. No way to pay!

If you're luck to get both they are out of soda. A manager needs to check out daily operations especially when the drive thru is 6 deep and employees are on there phones.

A decidedly average breakfast joint in an area full of top notch eateries. 

Menu: Breakfast oriented menu in keeping with its overall theme of a breakfast restaurant. Nothing on it seemed to be unique. All items can be found anywhere else at any diner in town. Being in such a prime location, I would have expected a few items or specials that were at least attempting to make them stand out from the crowd. 

Food: Bland, bland, bland and as a change in pace more bland. Everything was edible, nothing needed to be sent back for being over or under done but nothing had any flavor. Breakfast food is simple, so even a modicum of effort would have made the food tasty. Of particular note were the biscuits and gravy. When the gravy can't cover the entire biscuit and then some..... there's not enough gravy. But that wouldn't have helped much, there was so little sausage in it that it just tasted like flour. I had to add a considerable amount salt and pepper to have it taste like anything. Clean your drink fountain, the orange juice had a bitter funk to it. 

Service: Below average at best. Our waitress wasn't the same one who ran our food so when it did come out there was confusion on their part as to who's food was who's. Drink refills came slowly too. Generally I view this as a cost saving measure which is unacceptable to me and indicates a possible lack of customers bringing in revenue. 

Overall: Hard pass. There are so many other stellar breakfast eateries in Meridian that are far out of Jo Mama's league. Le Peep is just down the road if you're looking for a more "fine dining" breakfast and plenty of hash houses and chain restaurants that serve the same menu with better flavor. Like Famous Dave's before it, Jo Mama's might not be long for this world unless they take a good hard look at their menu and make some immediate changes.

Craig did a great job. Took his time and did it right. Carpet was not left soaking wet. He also did out tile. Our grout lines looked terrible prior to cleaning but look much better now. He was very responsive to emails and text messages. If you want a good job at a FAIR price call him. If you want someone to hose your carpet down and leave you in a bigger mess than you had, don't call him.
Super happy to find this place. Nothing extraordinary, but very nice servers and cold cold beer. Had the pretzel, played some darts and pool and drank some beer. What more could you want!
After making an appointment a week prior, they called the day of and cancelled on me.  Other massage places that I have been to will at least attempt to reschedule me at a different time.

Extremely disgusted and disappointed. $7 for this 2 piece chicken strip basket is a joke...What made this meal even worse were the fries weren't even cooked all the way and were still half frozen and drenched in grease!!! Nasty. So unhappy with my experience here today.
