We only stayed for a night but would not mind staying here again if we are ever in the area,
Ssssllooooooow. Not enough cooks. Food is great but need help in the to go orders!! Expedite! If you order for pick up or delivery. Expect to wait...

What a perfect way to end your day of shopping!  We made reservations (thankfully) so we were seated immediately! The place was pretty busy the whole time we were there.. 
Our waitress was very nice and accommodating, I ordered the macadamia nut chicken... I really don't have words to describe how delicious that was.. the crust was perfect, and the nuts were ground up so there wasn't any "chunks" of nuts... the sauce on top matched the chicken perfectly.. and it had a small amount of apple sauce on the side to dip it into... it was like a flavor explosion in my mouth! The stars alined! I wanted to eat the entire thing but I knew their was no way! The mashed potato's blended perfectly with the dish and the broccolini was still slightly firm. By far one of my favorite stops! 
The only downside was this place is a bit pricey... 19 dollars for a burger was a bit much... 
Side note kids meals came with an adorable edible bear!

We have eaten at this establishment 5 or 6 times. It is only a couple miles from our house. The breakfasts are flavorful and hardy with homemade sauce and gravy. Portions are generous and staff is on top of it's game. You will not get breakfast on a weekend without a wait. That's how good they are. We usually go during the week. It's a great place.

I expected a wait today so I was prepared to have to hang around, but they offer a service to text you when the table is ready so I felt comfortable running an errand at Lowe's first.  The time estimate was spot on, and we were immediately seated when notified.  Our server, Echo, was friendly and responsive; our order was prepared exactly as requested and delivered in a timely manner; the menu offered a variety of more standard offerings mixed with some unique combinations; and the food was delicious.  I'll definitely be back!

A good place to fix that ice cream craving! We live around the corner and wanted to try it out. We got the cookie dough ice cream and it was pretty good for the both of us.  They even gave us free corn dogs since they made a extra one by mistake. Overall, good experience and I will definitely be coming back!
The noodle soup is perfect for this time of the year and the bowl is huge with tons of veggies and protein!! Also Tony is the best and will always make you feel welcome. Highly recommend!!!

This was our first time in Idaho. We were driving by and the name of the restaurant caught our attention. Based on the yelp reviews we decided to give it a try for breakfast. We could not have been more happy with the service and quality of the food. The portions are gigantic and everyone in the family (2 seniors, 2 adults, 2 kids) loved their food!! We went for breakfast so I don't know about lunch, but I would highly recommend it to anyone in the treasure Valley area!

But the machine rag rollers inside the tunnel are not too harsh because I could not figure out how to turn off the automatic windshield wipers on my husbands car and even though the wipers were furiously going back and forth under the big roller and I was panicking, the wipers were unharmed. 

The regular wash is only 7 dollars if you don't have the monthly unlimited membership. Every wash includes being able to park in a stall afterwards and vacuum your own car with their powerful hose vacuums. They also have three cool perks that I have not seen before. The first one is an automatic floor mat washer machine. You take your floor mat over to the machine, push start, and start feeding your mat into the machine upside down. Then two minutes later you go back to the machine and your mat is nice and clean and waiting for you in the metal bin below the machine like a piece of toast that is perfectly done lol. The second cool thing is you can vacuum your mat by sticking it in a big clip by the vacuum holder. The third thing is there are clean rolled rags available on the wall by the vacuums. You can wipe down any leftover drips and then place your used rag in the top of the container which is separate from the clean rags. All the extra self cleaning perks are included in every wash.

The food is excellent. But they are very very very slow. I went in to pick up a to go order. I saw them bring out three dishes that were obviously going to go out and put them in a looks like a little warming area. 5+ minutes later a girl goes to the warming area and pulls out my order and brings it up to me. I asked her why when they brought it out of the kitchen They didn't bring it directly to me. She didn't have an answer and apologized and asked if I'd like another one. I believe she was flustered and really come up with the right thing to say. Which honestly there wasn't anything she could've said. They said our order would be ready in 15 to 20 minutes it was 30+.

Purchased our CBH home last October. It was an office model for CBH at the time. We liked the floor plan and the small size lot so we went for it. 
Once we moved into it, we found several issues and some got fixed already but some cannot be fixed without major work which we won't be able to tolerate. 
Generally we find that their sub contractors are very poor in workmanship from plumbers to framers to masonry to landscape ..etc... These contractors run amuck from parking in front of occupied homes to leaving dirt and trash in the street to, cigarette butts, dirt piles on driveway and sidewalk, construction refuse everywhere, workers clothing, water bottles...you name it. CBH has lost control of the necessary oversight to ensure the house they are building is marketable and the owners of the homes where they are building are respected.
The CBH inspectors or better defined "inspectors". They lack attention to details and interest in what a potential buyer should not have to deal with after purchasing the house. They also lack knowledge of what to look for in making sure their company reputation is sustained by a quality home. 
I will give a high note to their warrantee staff which is very professional and patient with the filing of claims. 
This review comes behind their lack of improvement after calling so many times to get issues resolved. They are reactive and try to fix problems but have very poor prevention practices. I hope they care enough to change.

Best ice cream around hands down. Truly tastes homemade! Their chocolate flavors are amazing. Very friendly staff. They also do parties that are adorable and fun! They made a fun sign for our birthday party we had there and put it out front. The kids played ice cream themed games at the birthday party we had there and we made our own ice cream that we got to take home that was absolutely delicious.
Great Service!  The workers were wonderful!  Food was great and the environment was very clean.

I will never go here again. The food tasted like it was nuked. Ordered breakfast. First mistake. Complained about food, second mistake. The service sucked and when we  brought it to the attention of the shift manager he did comp the bill. But the service was so bad we did not even leave a tip. (we always leave a tip). As we left I almost went back in to crush that idiot servers head that we had. As we got in our vehicle, he was cleaning our table....(we sat at a window) and the dirty looks were just flooding out. I could swear he flipped us off but I was not sure, so I just dropped it. He was just a young punk and I didn't want to go to jail over a meal.

Recently ate here and had breakfast with my two sons. Great service, food is fair, price is fair. Not much great to say except it's just a big high-volume breakfast house. Nothing special or fancy. My negative is that I had a broken juice glass that didn't get caught by the quality control team in the kitchen.

We came in to the showroom for a new set of kitchen cabinets and gave Monte our details and time frame. He promised to prepare a plan and come out to measure our kitchen in the following week. We never heard from him again. Months went by. Typical behavior I guess when you have plenty of business you can be disrespectful to customers. Needless to say we went to a competitor and were taken care of promptly.

We orders sandwich trays for a wedding prep group
The food is delicious
We had a problem with our order but the staff made it all good
Very impressed with the customer service
Thank you for keeping the joy in our day

Love this place. Alex and Adam are the best bartenders in the Boise area.

Excellent mixology.

Excellent atmosphere.

This is what a bar should be.

I spent the first 22 years of my life in Chicago and one of the only regrets I have is not having Italian Beefs or a decent Chicago Style Pizza.  Bono's has filled that void like no other in the Treasure Valley.  We didn't try the dogs, even though the Vienna Beef trademarks made me way too happy.
The Italian Beefs were eye rolling good.  We wound up having to take our pizza home.  I don't understand how anyone could think the sammiches were too small.  Ours were packed with beef, just wet enough in the right place to give it a good chew without taking all of the crisp off the french bread entirely.  The peppers and giardiniera were amazing and just like I remembered.  The staff was friendly and really attentive.  
Lots of screens with sports on and one smaller screen with Kung Fu Panda and kid sized tables and chairs.
We'll be back.

I have closed with Nextitle for the 4th time last week.  I had a great experience as I always have.  I refer clients to them whenever I hear of someone doing a RE transaction.  Hats off to these guys!

My favorite restaurant in Boise never disappoints! My boyfriend and I went on Valentine's Day for dinner and we loved everyone's accommodation! It was insanely busy but everyone was super helpful, kind, and quick! We loved our server (I believe her name was Cheyenne?), and Journey and Sarah were also extremely kind and were running food left and right across the entire restaurant! The hosts were amazing and super organized for how busy it was. We loved our dinner and will definitely be back very soon!!
It's a quaint little place with a relaxed atmosphere. The food was delicious. Prompt and courteous service. Definitely will be going again to try the noodle soup.

The Hungry Horse.....yip...funky name!! Check! Already a good start. The menu is just as creative as the restaurants name. Noodle soup, waffle sandwiches,  chicken wings.....just as funky as the restaurants name. 
I stopped in for lunch and ordered noodle soup. The soup arrived full of tasty ingredients and full of yummy broth. The chef added spinach instead of thai basil which was a unique taste. The broth is very savory...more savory than most noodle soup broth that I have had. The ingredients were well balanced and fresh. The brisket was very tender with good flavor. The brisket complimented the broth nicely.
The restaurant is small, clean,  and organized. The employees were very friendly and nice.
I look forward to going back to enjoying another bowl of noodle soup for sure. I really want to try one of their funky sandwiches. 
I definitely recommend this place!!
Cheers Always!

We don't generally eat at Sharis and it's been many years since we have been in one.  But I have to say that our experience here was quite good.

We were tired, didn't feel like looking around for a good restaurant, fighting traffic and so on.  Sharies was just on the other side of the parking lot from our motel so off we went.

Amazingly good service.  The fries were very good.  My club sandwich was "ok".... her burger was good.

We were both full and happy for a little over $12 each.  Not too shabby.  Perhaps Sharis has upped their game or perhaps this particular franchise is very well run.  Whatever the case, we liked it!

Had the club sandwich been a little better the review would have been five stars.

Came in for the week of Thanksgiving to visit our daughter and we were in the mood for good food and looking for the best places in town. 
When I saw the reviews of this place on Yelp and the recommendations of locals, we thought we'd make it for breakfast. Since it was a weekday, there really was no wait. The service was friendly from the start at the door, and our server was just as chipper. The portions were hefty, and I felt like I was already experiencing my Thanksgiving feast. 
We tried different restaurants around town at least 2X daily for 9 days so we covered a lot of places. We actually came again before trip ended just to eat here one more time!
We will be be back next holidays and rest assured, our first meal will be at Joe Mommas!

My wife and I walked into Independence Range this afternoon to take adavantage of the full auto experience after attending my fathers funeral in Star. We did it to lighten the mood for us and take advantage of the fact that gun laws in Kommiefonia blow.
     I wish I could remember the name of the gentleman who helped us at first but it escapes me now. He was as friendly and knowledgeable as it gets. Kuddos Sir!
     John was the range master who went with us to the firing line. He set us up patiently and with a friendly attitude. He got me going easy. 
    John then intsructed my wife with patience. He got her shooting in no time
Thank you John and all of the crew at independence. 
It was a great afternoon. 
We will be back whenever we visit Star
Food was okay. Service was good.  Still a little expensive even during Happy Hour I thought. Great location in the Village though.

Asked for an Old Fashioned, bar tender looked at me as if I asked for a penguin , he stated "were not that kind of bar, you should check out downtown Boise".... so rum and coke it is!
 Service was ok at best, however, they were showing the UFC fight and there was plenty of tv's to watch it on, so that's definitely a plus!

Worst massage I've ever had, and I've been getting massages for almost 20 years. I'm honestly surprised at all the good reviews. Besides the massage just not being very good in general (I left hurting worse than when I came in), I was shocked to discover that the door to my room was left open nearly the whole massage. The massage therapist had my naked ass exposed to whomever walked by for almost an hour, that is beyond unprofessional. I feel embarrassed and violated and cannot believe this happened to me.
Love this place can't wait to go back. Great staff great product in stock and they have ammo cheaper then any other shop in town. Best indoor range I've ever been to!

My husband was dying to try this place, saying "if they put cheesesteak on the sign, it better be good". Well, it wasn't bad, but nothing to write home about (or Yelp about). His take away was "underwhelming". I went for the crinkle cut fries, which were good but get cold fast. We shared a Supreme steak. Onions and peppers were not evenly distributed, so I got most of the peppers. As others have said, the meat stops about an inch from the end of the bread. The sandwich did come out piping hot! Not enough cheese for me and really no juices. The kid who took our order was a dry, no personality but still polite person. The place is clean,lots of seating, pretty cool simple decor. We would go back again, but maybe to try the French Dip instead.

This location is now down to (2) 1 hour water aerobic classes per week. The club is open M-F 4:30am to 11:00pm, plus weekends , (a total of 117 hours per week). The current manager feels that we should share the pool during that 1 hour, twice a week,  with lap swimmers, which is  creating problems, including a swimmer purposely coughing in several people's faces to make them move out of his way this week. 
Still feeling like "second class" members.

Mark Enger was sent out do deal with a bedroom door, after it was replaced with the wrong sized door and not hung correctly during the first warranty claim.  Mark was so friendly and knowledgeable from the start, thoroughly explaining the issue and what he was going to do to fix it.  Without being asked, Mark offered to walk my wife and I through the interior and exterior of the house, providing tons of tips related to maximizing our AC/Heat usage, properly sealing windows and doors and many other things I was unaware of.  He took it upon himself to check all of our doors, and fix issues as he went along, teaching as he went.  If you have an CBH warranty issue in his field, I highly suggest asking for him to take care of it.  Mark is awesome.

I come here every so often with my girlfriend.
The wait is usually no longer than two minutes and the food is always great.
I've never had a problem with the employees.
It's overall just a great place to grab a quick bite.

It was a great experience. We were able to get in on a busy morning within a decent amount of time. They're following all of the rules and regulations for Covid-19. Our waiter was very responsive and helpful. The food was absolutely delicious, really great price for the quality and quantity of food. The iced coffee as well as plain black coffee that we got was also very good. Looking forward to returning and trying out different dishes down the line.

We really enjoyed our first visit to Royal Coffee. With so many barista chains out there, it's refreshing to support locally owned and operated businesses. And... the coffee was AMAZING. Try the white chocolate mocha with lavender and oat milk. My new fav. Check out this hip shop with plenty of indoor and outside seating.

Not a huge fan. It's just mediocre food I'm ALL about breakfast and I've been three times and it takes 20min to get a water... the wait times to be seated are long 30-40min and there are empty tables everywhere. Portions are big but nothing worth taking home... I hate leaving 1star reviews but after the 3rd visit this was nothing really exciting to change my mind.

The rice was super dry and old, and the workers didn't wear masks over their noses. 

Bad enough to flagrantly disregard people's health, but doing it over cold, raw food makes it so much worse. 

We much prefer Poke Bowl.

This is one of my grandson's favorite places to find comic books. The owner, Tom, is very helpful and friendly. He'll order the comics that my grandson is missing and call when it comes in. The store has delicious coffee specialties and baked goods to sit and enjoy while reading the comics at clean tables and sitting areas. It's becoming one of our hangouts! There was a fun event of raffle giveaways and costume contests all day last weekend for Halloween. Lots of free comics, candy, snacks and prizes made for a wonderful Saturday! We're hoping to keep this local business successful for years to come! It's truly a treasure!
Love the food but lately when I call for take out they don't answer! Literally called 10 times and no answer. It's happened multiple times now. So disappointed

Factory and Outlet Stores seem to get a bad rap lately. Overall Factory and Outlet stores serve a purpose,which is to obtain name brand items without the mark-up from a department store.  While some factory/ outlet stores don't really offer a significant savings or provide returned or mismatched items, that is not the case with Meridian's Nike Factory Store.  This store is jamming all the time and there are savings to be found, but you need to know where to look.  Start with the back wall of shoes.  To the left is Kids and Womens, and to the right is Mens.  There's sizes from petite to 17.  Granted some styles may not be for everyone but you are sure to find a deal if you look. The next place is the clearance racks. In these racks, you can find severely marked down prices on everything from leggings, to tank tops and more.  The closer you are to the front, the more expensive the items, so stay close to the back and sides.  There are always very helpful Nike employees running around the store, don't be afraid to find one and ask, " Do you have this one in this size? " or " I'm not sure which one I like, what do you think? " or " What is the difference between cross trainer and cross trainer x ?" 

The line moves quickly since there are about 4 to 5 smiling cashiers ready to get you checked  out.  I would recommend the Nike Factory Store for shoes and apparel.  Here's my slogan, 

" Just Look for the Deals "
Totally delish, you should go there. I got the trio of sauces appetizer and the meal for 2... It was huge. Honestly, that could fees 4 people. Very nice owner and great food. 5 star

They leave their job sites like shit. Construction material everywhere and trash blowing in others residents yard and fencing. We have complained on numerous occasions. I am a contractor my self and would never think of leave a job site in this condition. He, CB, is only concerned about the $$$$.

Stretching, Facials & Massage all offered here! All the therapists have been sincere & well trained, the management is mindful of safety, & check in/check out info is personalized thru great notes they take & keep via their computer system. Yes- it is hard to get scheduled sometimes- but do consider calling in to see if there is a last minute cancellation- that helps u & the therapist

We had a 9 am appointment for an oil change and got to the shop 10 minutes early. In a time when Idaho's COVID19 numbers are spiking, not one office person wore a mask and there was no plexiglass shield. Even worse, they knew I was going to wait because I am not comfortable riding in a vehicle with anyone at this time - particularly people who refuse to wear masks. I had to wait for 3 hours for an oil change with a revolving door of people coming in and out of the office. No apologies for wasting my time and not being considerate of customers' health. Not going back after using this shop for the past several years. I'd recommend shopping around for someone who actually wants your business.

They make you pay BEFORE your massage. I should have taken that as a clear sign that my experience would go downhill from there. The massage "therapist" left me completely uncovered for the entire massage and kept leaving the room to talk to someone and at one point, stood in the doorway talking with the door halfway open! Then when I went to leave (trying to get out of there as fast a possible) she asked if I was going to Tip! This place is a nightmare, don't go.

Fabulous breakfast!  On the weekends they serve a casserole and gray cinnamon rolls until they run out. The casserole (think hash browns with with green onions and cheese and sour cream) was wonderful!  The cinnamon rolls were pretty good, but wouldn't get them again. The bacon is a must as well as the homemade Marionberry jam.  Oh!  The biscuits are a must as well!  We try biscuits wherever we eat out and these were the best I've had!  Our daughter got the sausage patty which was huge and delicious!  We will come back here whenever we return to Boise!  

-  Excellent service!  Olivia was our waitress and was wonderful!   She was attentive and positive and made our experience so enjoyable!

I like Urban Roots.  I'd like to keep coming. Today nobody in the entire salon, stylist or customers, were wearing a mask. My 2 teens wore them and the stylist still didn't.  I don't approve.  Face coverings are required in Ada County.
Spine Center, Diabetes Center & Lab Center here are awesome- but this hospital location & other providers here- nope- go to Boise or Nampa.

Called to get my vehicle aligned and a man answered the phone who was very condescending after I explained the issue with my vehicle. Brought it in anyway and after dropping it off they stated that they would call when ready. Dropped it off a little after 11 and at 1pm they still hadn't called. I called and they stated they were at lunch and couldn't provide  a time for completion. Finally, drove back over to the area of the shop to wait for a call. Never received one, by this time is was 230pm. When I walked in, there were roughly 6 men standing around just talking it appeared. I was appalled. When I approached the men they all looked at each other with confusion about my vehicles service status. The mechanic came out to explain the details of my vehicle and proceeded to berate me about the underside of my car being muddy and insinuating I went off-roading with my Honda Civic.  I felt very uncomfortable and upset. Meanwhile, the other men in the shop were compensating with kindness,  for his abrasive attitude towards me.  Upon payment,  I was suppose to get a 15% Costco discount and they stated they already gave me one? Don't see discount on the receipt and at that point I just wanted to leave and never come back. I was humiliated. Attempted to explain my frustration with the customer service and the man said, "I was just joking with you."

Everything a serious weightlifter would want. Strong man gear, reverse hyper, west side style belt squat machine, lots of barbells, squat racks and deadlift platforms, and more than enough competition style bench set ups. Very well equipped gym. They just need heavy kettlebells lol.

UPDATE:  Decided to give them another chance 3 days later on a Wednesday.   Couldn't possibly be as bad as on the weekend.  Guess what, it was just as bad.  With few fewer customers, I still waited over an hour, and ultimate cancelled the order, which was for one hamburger.  Unbelievable.

I am so happy Paddles Up returned to Meridian - they have the best poke by far. The location in the Village is pretty convenient, especially since orders seem to be to-go only during COVID. Their ingredients are always fresh, service is friendly, and they do not skimp on ingredients like other poke places I've been to in the area (e.g. making the bowl about 80% rice). I frequently order their build your own bowl as well as the delicious brookies that they seem to procure from a local bake shop. I highly recommend this location!

The check-in was not only 3 hours late but the house hadn't even been cleaned. We paid to arrive early. They never responded to us wanting to rent the UTVs at the correct price we were quoted. 

When we walked in and we were greeted with garbage on the floor. As we walked further, everything was dirty, no, filthy. Food and liquids on the floors and table tops. The microwaves are both filthy with food and baked on things. Both fridges were dirty. Downstairs the "amenities" of Foosball and air hockey were untouchable. There is dried liquids on them both, appearing to be beer and what I hope was milkshake, at least I hope that's what that was. The extra blankets are unfolded and shoved in a closet. Presumably uncleaned and previously used. The downstairs closet reaks of something I can't explain. Every single window was disgusting on the inside of the house.

In the house there is literally feces all over one toilet and over full of toilet paper. All the toilets are filthy and covered in body hair. The sinks nor mirrors had been cleaned and had hair. The bathtub is COVERED in long black hairs and body hairs. Clearly it had been uncleaned.

The condition of the house is pretty run-down. Many light switch plates are broken. The handles on cabinets are falling off. There are chunks out of the shower wall. The steps to the hot tub are broken cinder blocks. The fire pit area is mostly a mess. It is not private as you have neighbors very close in proximity. There is an apartment over the garage so that definitely diminishes privacy even more. They give multiple quotes for renting their utvs but never follow through when asked. Over all I wouldn't suggest any family or group rent this home. (Broken Rein in McCall)

Flavorless garbage. My wife ordered scrambled eggs-they were liquid eggs according to waitress, they had zero flavor, she put so much salt on them to extract flavor that it made them unedible. Bacon was cooked to death. I ordered a sunrise platter. It was supposed to be on sausage with hash browns smothered in sausage gravy. The gravy was wall spackle-flavored, tasted like flour and milk. I am not sure what happened to the hash browns, they were cooked to death, and I looked for a hint of sausage, there was a little, but not much. My over easy eggs were absolutely perfect. We go in here all the time. Now I think it is time to call Robert Irvine in there and redo this dump. Would someone please clean the ceiling fans and tear out that filthy carpet?

They have now CUT HAPPY HOUR BY AN HOUR,  INCREASED prices of happy hour sushi rolls to $9.50 and taken items off happy hour menu.  Used to be regulars,  no more!!. Also,  we had the rib starter,  $11 got 4 tiny ribs,  tiny tiny!!! Worth about $5. Disappointed.

I came in to have a poke bowl and sushi.  The decor and ambiance is good.  Prices are Westcoast/Eastcoast.  Bowl for 15 bucks and two pieces of eel for $6.50.  Throw in a hot tea , probably $25.  With lunch partner, $50 plus tip  maybe 58.  But wait, waitress  who was a trainer screws up my order.  She denies messing up my order but does not acknowledge her screwups.  An empty sushi plate with an empty dipping sauce tray attests to her lie.  I called her on this but she says i messed up and has that attitude of ...my conclusive statement is that the hamachi was not fresh and was probably an amberjack, not yellowtail.  I'll never know what the eel nigiri tasted like because it never came.  Management would be well advised to train using better trainers who actually know a thing or two about customer service.  I would not reccomend out of town/ state visitors who know acceptable service.  I would not bring in high tech directors and executives who may want to bring business in Boise until such time as local accommodations and service improves.

Would not even rate it if I could. I've been here multiple times and every time there's something different. - went in to the VIP and as my ID said my name and my gender, got called a lady with a straight face. Being transgender And have a full beard, out of respect this worker did not hesitate with saying that to me. Brown hair to shoulders working VIP at 12:45 and checking tickets on 09/25. Unreasonable, hurtful, rude, disrespectful and down right unprofessional. 

The VIP section was still 100 degrees and constantly hearing tapping from the people next to us and would not shut up through the entire movie. 

There's always some dumb kid working and rude as shit, or doesn't even know how to answer to another human being normally. Food and drinks are fucking disgusting and outside the theatre smelled like 4 day old trash. Not very soothing and I will never come back here again.

We have been taking our dog and cat to All Valley for several years, but we were going to the Emerald location. When it was time to make their appointment this year, I used ol' trusty Yelp to look for locations and there was one only 5 minutes from our house! Hurrary! So this review factors in the many times we have been to All Valley over the years, and a lot of specifics for this location. 

Firstly, they were able to get us in pretty quickly for a checkup. They had availability 2 days after I called. This location is super big. It includes an adoption center, grooming, boarding, and the animal hospital. It is to the side of the Majestic theatre. Be sure to have your cat in a carrier and your dog on a leash. And your fish in a bowl. Lol. 

The staff was friendly, though a bit slow. We waited about 10 minutes in the lobby. The vet tech who did the animals vitals was really sweet and efficient. After she left we waited about another 10 minutes for the Vet. We saw Dr. Lake and he was definitely the best part of the visit. He was so great with the animals (check out his arms...SO many scars!), but also really great with people. He listened to our concerns about our kitty and gave us his best guess on an ailment. But of course, a real diagnosis requires over $300 worth of tests. He explained all the parts of the tests, how much they cost, and all the options we could choose. He also explained how much treatment of the possible ailments would be. He was totally supportive of our questions about cost and understood that not all people want to/can spend 1000s of dollars on their pet. Overall, the fee was pretty affordable (two check ups + 3 vaccines).

This is a newer location and it is sparkly clean and does not have the vet funk smell! I always feel kinda nauseous being inside a vet, but not at this location! The lobby is lovely with a beautiful fish tank and a huge water feature. But I am most appreciative of the lack of smell. :)
I've been looking for someone who knows colors and Sara at Stone Fox does!  My blonde highlights look amazing!!

If I could give them negative stars I would! It looks like a child built these homes...no actually I think a child could do better! Beware and stay away from these people! CBH must stand for crappy built homes!

Great little sandwich shop tucked away off Eagle Road. Ordered pastrami on sourdough with all the options, amazing warm soft bread with slight crunch, delicious! Barely finish the whole thing sorry didn't post a picture but take my word for it.
This gym is filthy and not well kept. Machines are broken and there's hair and dirt all over the floors. I would not go back!

Horrendously slow service on a Sunday with only 3 other tables in addition to ours. From the start is was painfully slow to get our drink order, just as slow to get our food which came out barely warm- must have sat back in the kitchen for a bit. Then we had to get up and ask the host to help us get our check as we were waiting for quite some time, clearly done with our meals. It took another 10 min for that to happen. I had ordered another drink before our meals arrived but never received it - of course it was still on the bill. 

Mediocre food and painfully slow service has ensured we will not be returning.

Sad to say this about All Valley Animal Hospital 

Longtime customer 18 years. Waited over two hours they took people who came in after us after an hour of waiting I listened in on these people who were walking in ... they were people who had never been there before!  They are just looking for new customers and don't give a sh*t about their current customer.   

After complaining about the wait was told I was next ... didn't happen the guy from California beat me out!

Our first time here. Costco saved the day with $100 of gift cards for $63.99.

The food is delicious. They seemed understaffed or inexperienced. 

I do recommend everything we ordered.
Kids had shoestring fries to start. They also finished both their personal pizzas: a cheese and a pepperoni. 

The adults shared Crispy Chicken Thai Rolls, large White Cloud pizza, a Calpine. Again, all is recommended.

When the fries came up for the kids I ended up going to the bar to get appetizer plates and ketchup. We asked for a remake on my daughter's strawberry margarita. It had too much sweet & sour. 

Our server Aubri seemed bothered when we had to ask for something like refills on our drinks, ranch dressing, or silverware. 

The restaurant was clean but there was a lot of clutter lying about as they were decorating for Christmas. 

We will definitely be going back but may wait until after the first of the year to let them work out the kinks.

BIGGEST MISTAKE EVER CHOOSING THIS CREDIT UNION!! 
I need a bank where I can transfer money using my mobile app to my husbands account or vice versa and I need a mobile app that gives correct information on my available amount!!   Also went to the ATM at 11pm and there are no lights, only light was the ATM screen. HORRIBLE HORRIBLE HORRIBLE!!
Only reason I gave 1 star is because I can't choose no stars!!

A friend and I ended up here on a whim when Bodovino had no seats available and it was getting close to their closing time. I'm glad we did. The only reason they are getting four instead of five stars is because I felt like our server was a bit salty when we were initially seated. He provided great service overall, but he just wasn't very friendly at first. Not sure why. The food is SO GOOD as are the mixed drinks. We ordered a couple of the more expensive mixed drinks (the patio bubbler was yummy) and went crazy on the late night happy hour menu. The avocado egg rolls were the best I've ever had and that sauce...OMG, the sauce. The waiter tried to take my plate with the sauce still on it while I was finishing the last roll and I about smacked his hand lol. We ordered another round of them and we also had pot stickers and a crab crunch roll. We also ordered two more drinks because the prices were super reasonable. Overall, it was a great time and good food. This is a great late night place. I will definitely eat here again.
The best barbecue joint in town. You can tell that they put their heart into it. Highly recommend the swine & cheese sandwich.

The Village is an outdoor shopping mall that caters to the haves and not the have nots in Idaho.  Most of the natives who are not inside the circle cannot afford to sustain the cost of shopping at The.Village.  The new immigrants arriving from California, Oregon, Washington, Colorado, New York...are familiar with much higher prices and The Village is a bargain.  The native demographics is the have nots.   Not quite 5th Avenue or Fashion Island in Newport Beach,  The Village was designed by the same group that made Victoria Gardens.  The near future will see boutique stores come and go and some anchor stores suffer.  I have seen malls go through ups and downs because there is not the manufacturing industry that Boise, Merdian, Eagle, Nampa or other surrounding cities have that provides the disposable income to have a large population of higher income people.  There are no high tech companies in Idaho that fuels the wealth of Idaho.  Plexus is a high volume printed circuit board contract manufacturer with thin margins, On Semiconductor is small time that is hoping to one day be acquired so founders can retire, Micon? Just small potatoes.  Memory ICs are manufactured in higher volume and faster speeds with lower costs by Korean firms and the Peoples Republic of China and Taiwan.  Without the influx of retiring immigrants from other states, The Village will fade as a dumb idea.  Idahoans best treat immigrants well and not hate them as they currently practice.

Not worth it for the price. Ordered about $40 worth of food that was way less food than $20 at other great sushi places I have eaten at. Quantities were terrible and the food arrived cold and seemed absolutely not fresh at all. If you're looking to get sushi from anywhere I would recommend you go anywhere else.
Great food and value. We are surprised at how the place was not packed. Maybe a hidden gem?

Unhappy outcome.  Family went for dinner last night.  (Friday December 27th, 2019)
The restaurant was busy which you might expect for a friday at 5pm.  We entered, gave our name and the number in our party.  We were told 15-20 minutes.  After 40 minutes of waiting we decided to leave when the restaurant did not seat anyone in 3 of the open tables.  We witnessed at least 12 or more people leave as well.  So, we left, hungry, after 40 plus minutes.  Seems that the management needs to examine what's realistic for time management and table clean up and a re-seating efforts for recently vacated tables.  After watching the vacant tables for more than 5 minutes we left.  Not sure if I'll give this particular location another try.

Took forever for them to seat us. I may be treating this place unfairly because the bar has been set in Boise/Meridian but their food/service combo just didn't do it for me like some of the others in town. Not a bad place though. I'd go again.
Helpful staff, good prices, can shoot fully automatic firearms. Bought a safe and delivery team did a great job of setting it up for me with a challenging delivery.

My son said, as we were leaving, that this was a "once in a lifetime experience"...that is, we NEVER want to go back. I thought, with two hour waits, this had to be a good place. But no, the service  was slow and disinterested...just TRY getting a refill on coffee, the waitress wouldn't even make eye contact when we were trying to ask! We ordered, and waited about 40 minutes with no food, no coffee refills, no waitress checking with us. I finally got her attention and asked, and she brought out food that had obviously been under the warmer for a long time. The food was tasteless and  dry. She never stopped by to ask how things were. And this was my  BIRTHDAY dinner! There are so many GOOD breakfast places in the valley...avoid this one!
Very relaxing environment and great massage place for an oriental experience.
Great sandwiches and taking Covid-19 safety precautions:) All wearing masks, so I definitely will be returning!
CBH Homes offers a great home/value. The process of buying from CBH was easy, the customer service during escrow responsive, and the post-close warranty portal is awesome!

My wife and I had never visited this business. Once inside we looked around. They were rather busy, which is a good thing in this day and age. Kevin approached us and we engaged in a nice discussion on what they offered, there program etc. . Even though We didn't buy this time. We came away with a better understanding and a path forward for our needs. Thank you for taking the time to answer all of our questions.

This is my third and last time at Twigs.  My Friday night date and I were seated between a couple of ladies in gym clothes and a table full of children.  It was well lit to the point of no real ambiance existing.  Why, when other tables are available are couples with no children that are well dressed seated amongst kids in high chairs?

We ordered a couple of cocktails to ease the pain.  My manhattan was fine, but her dirty martini was far more ice and olive juice than gin.  In between bouts of achingly slow visits with the waitress and an undercooked flatbread, we decided to skip dinner there and head to Bodovino.   Our reward was a $47.00 bill for one serviceable cocktail.

Meh.

As a massage therapist, I'm always on the lookout for quick, foot massage places. This one is close to home and reasonably priced. Had a foot massage a couple of times (basically, you're entire body but clothed) and full body sessions. Just know going in, this place has rooms with walls that don't connect to the ceiling, so you will hear noise. Personally, I don't have issue with that. The rooms and massage areas are clean and they follow covid protocol. 

If you are looking for a 'great' massage, this is not the place. Just being honest, it's okay. When I need some relaxation after a long day, I go here. Most of the time the owner works with me, but the last visit, I had another person. It was definitely a more 'you put the lotion on your skin' kind of session. If you want deep pressure, call ahead and book the owner. 

Been going here 8 months and sitting on writing a review, which was a solid 4-stars. They lost one because the therapist I had added a $10 tip to my credit card after I told her no, because I gave her cash. I always give cash tips vs credit card. That was disheartening when I saw my debit card statement. Also, know that they would like you to 'level up' and get the 60 minute body/30 minute foot massage instead of the 60 minute foot massage. Sometimes it feels a bit pushy (not rude), just stand your ground if you only want the foot massage.

This is a fun place to head for some solid breakfast brunching and libation enjoyment.

The menu is the size of most average torsos ie. a pretty large selection. My friend and I have to look through Yelp to see the pictures to decide what we want to go with, every time. We also ask that annoying question often, "What is your favorite?" to our pour server. The best server suggestion was the Korean Hash (not on the online menu). So my friend said yes to the.... hash? (Get it, yet to the dress but it is breakfast. Anyways.) I don't always have FOMO with food. Correction, I always have FOMO with food but extra, a lot more than normal when this dish came to our table. My friend was generous and shared. It was extremely unique and I will get it next time for myself. 

We also choose to share a pancake so we can get our butter and syrup fix. The pancake should be shared, not mandated though. In addition to sharing a pancake, you should probably make sure you get a toast/biscuit with your meal. The jams/jellies are some of the best I have tasted. The strawberry is phenomenal, the marionberry is up there as well. 

Other dishes to make you stressed so you can't decide what you want: Trash Tators, Kitchen Sink (super unhealthy and super yum), Crab Cake Bennie.

Our service is usually wonderful - ok. There was one case where our server was so fun, attentive, and well fun and now I think I need to pick him out of the crowd and request his section. 

Con - the wait. It actually isn't logical. There is so much space in this place and almost every time it is half full with a 45 minute wait. I am thinking it is linked to being understaffed?

Worth a try! Getting there early is suggested. Do not go after 9:00 am if you don't want to wait for a long time OR eat a snack before breakfast so you don't show up wanting to eat your arm. Waiting is cool if you aren't ravenous.

Horrible experience with this company. Definitely avoid if you're a college student. My son lived in one of their properties with a few other students, and his experience with them from start to finish was horrible - so much so that everyone's parents had to get involved.

The wait on a late Sunday morning was an hour and half so we figured it must be good. We put our name in and waited. The menu has so many unique offerings it hard to choose and even after I ordered I found myself second guessing if I had ordered right. Needless to say my kids ordered a few different options and I was able to sample the stuffed French toast which was amazing. I ordered the chorizo jalapeño hash which really hit the spot. The chicken fried steak burrito was a hit with my older son. All in all I would say one of the best breakfast places I have been to. Service was good considering how busy they were, but it was worth wait.

What can I say but I'm a fan of La Quinta hotels for many reasons therefore it's my first choice to book at. On a recent trip to Idaho I stayed at this hotel and was not disappointed. The hotel is very modern with all the amenities you need to feel at home. Because I am a gold member I got upgraded to a king suite and wow what a delightful treat. The room was extremely roomy, immaculate and decor was up to date modern. A few important features to me are cleanliness, a comfortable bed and a hot shower with water pressure. I was not disappointed. I stayed here for two days so I was able to enjoy the free breakfast & free homemade cookies and milk at night. Definitely will return if I'm in town again.

Birthday Celebration was Perfect!
The service was top notch including singing to me in Italian by our server!! You can't top that! 
I love love love the carrot cake. It is big enough for 4 people. I almost can't make it through dinner thinking about it when I go to Kona. 

Speaking of dinner, they also have a nice selection of everything you could imagine-pastas, salad, steak, sushi, pizza, etc.. Even with our large group of 14-16, they handled dinner wonderfully! We had a lot of appetizers and drinks before dinner and it all went perfectly. It was the beginning of the holiday season too. 
Thanks for a lovely birthday.
good food, good portions, only drawback was loud and small, but the service was great too, so will go back again

Was our first time and we had a good experience. Husband and I shared the fajitas for 2. We got chicken and shrimp and really enjoyed it. The chicken was tender and the shrimp didn't taste "fishy" it was perfect. My dad got 2 chicken enchiladas and he really enjoyed them. He also got a margarita and dang it was yummy! $7 was a little spendy for it but at least it was good.

I've been to this place twice now, here are both my experiences...
My first time there was for a firearms transfer. I purchased some things online on their website because they were all listed "in stock", so I assumed I could show up at the store to pick them up at the time of my firearm transfer. Upon arrival I was told they "drop ship" and they should be there in the next 30 days. I ended up canceling the order. I would recommend to them to make it more clear that the items on the website are not exactly in stock and ready to ship...
The transfer went okay, the guy helping me was pretty good at keeping me informed on the process and let me know the system was running slow. He ended up letting me leave and called me when my background check was complete. My refund for my online order was pretty slow, I send a couple of emails following up to make sure it was processed to make sure they didn't forget about it. I'm not sure how long it would've taken to get refunded if I wasn't a "squeaky wheel".
My second experience here has me kind of annoyed. I went to get some suppressor sights put on my Glock 19. The guy helping me was nice and told me it would be done in a couple of days. I asked him if it could be done now and he obliged, which was awesome! He said it would be $40 and I accepted that. It took him about 10 minutes to install the sights. I checked them out and they looked good. I shot about 100 rounds through the gun after they were installed. When I got home and cleaned the gun I noticed the front sight had come loose. Like super loose, the little screw was about to come out that holds it on. Today I looked on their website and saw their pricing. Gunsmithing is 40$ per hour and sight instillation is 25$. 
Number 1 I'm upset about the poor instillation. And number 2 I feel ripped off. Maybe he charged me 40$ because he did me a favor and put them on for me right then?
I imagine they would fix them for me if I went back, but honestly it's really out of the way. 
The place I would recommend to get your guns worked on is HawkTech Arms if you are in the Boise area. They are super down to earth and honest people. I've had great experiences with HawkTech.
I don't think I will be going back to Independence. I chose to give them 3 stars because they have a very large selection of items. I've always been asked if I am finding everything okay, and there are a few employees there that are super nice, (The older guys haha). I would recommend that the bosses there straighten out their younger employees.

This is the very definition of meh.

Now if we go back 20-30 years, this would be truly top-notch Mexican food!  Huge portions!  Chips and salsa, with a salsa bar!  Speaking of the salsa  bar, some of the salsas are placed so far back under the sneeze guard that people look ridiculous trying to scoop it.  I felt like I was being pranked.  The salsas are pretty decent TBH.

So I got my standard that I get at any of these old generic Mexican joints, which is the two-item combo, chicken taco with cheese enchilada.  They put the effort in on the taco.  Spiced the chicken instead of just boiling and shredding it, fried the taco shell... shell still fell apart on me less than halfway through (they didn't dry it after they fried it.)  The cheese enchilada did the job.

Interior is nice, servers are nice.  Nice place to go when you're feeling nostalgic.

I've lived here for almost 2 years and go into Bruchi's at least once a week. So if you do some quick math, you know that I've been here almost 100 times. I haven't had a bad experience yet. I've tried almost everything there and have yet to be disappointed. And as good as the food is, the staff is even more amazing. From Jeannette on down, they make me feel like family every time I walk in. I love this place!
Please please do not visit this McDonalds location at all.  Can you believe they had me wait more than half hour to get 2 chicken sandwich and gave me totally raw chicken in this pandemic situation.

Twigs has overpriced, mediocre food and drinks. We also did not receive good service. The host was unfriendly. Our server did not come to our table for 10 minutes, and she forgot things we asked for. Do not waste your time or money at Twigs.

Big praise for our knowledgeable "foodie" waitress, Chantal! Her recommendations were all on point: ribeye meatballs, patio bubbles, Luna roll, carrot cake. Delicious! Would rally to sit in Chantal's section again for even more recos!

In town looking for the week, hands down our best meal!!! Way to go team Kona!

Great selection of entrees, in addition to a fantastic sushi bar!

Did I mention the amazing cocktails!!!

This is one of my favorite places.  I love going to dine in.  Tonight I was excited to have dinner here but it did not happen.  We walked in and they asked if we wanted to sit in the bar.  I am not one for sitting in the bar because it is a little too much noise for me and I have bad hearing.  The two girls sitting folks said it would be 15 min to get seated.  A couple came in after us and they sat them immediately.  There was multiple open distant seating tables.  I am not sure what made us look different that we had to wait 15 min vs the folks that came in after us and were seated immediately.  My wife and I left.  One of my favorite spots and they did this.  Makes me sad to be treated that way.  The two girls seating people knew that what they did was wrong.  It may be a long time before I try to go back.

I'm used to Eastern European markets in Detroit.  There, the vinyl flooring had potholes worse than the Boise Greenbelt.  The canned foods expired when Stalin did.  And with the callousness that only the horrors of both Communism and Detroit could instill in someone, the shopkeepers would snarl, "you hyeff to pey with kyesh" when you'd hand them a debit card.

So I was shocked to find that the shopping experience at Irena's - Boise's only (correct me if I'm wrong) Eastern European market - is a pleasant one.  Irena's is clean and new, brightly-lit, and filled with cakes and candies in colors that are so happy they're surely banned in Russia.  The shopkeeper is kind, generous with samples, and eager to explain ideal preparation methods for products.

Irena's most varied selections are their bulk candies (priced per pound), freshly-sliced halva, tea, and snack cookies.  Thumb through their borscht mix packets and chicken seasoning packets.  Pick up a can of pickled herring or caviar.  And bring home a bag of frozen pelmeni, in veal, chicken, Ukranian-style, or Siberian-style.

Irena's sausage selection is admirable.  But their best is the Polish kabanosy, a wiry foot-long made of succulent, salty pork, with a dainty brush of caraway.  Fresh and dried versions are available - I recommend the fresh, grilled for a few minutes.  The hog casing is papery, yet impermeable, requiring a good amount of force with the incisors to pierce it.  This is the most epic snap you'll ever experience - even more so than the 250 lb., leopard print-wearing, finger-wagging, cheatee on Jerry Springer, shouting "Oh, no you di-in't" while getting dragged offstage.

Rustic breads are baked fresh twice daily at Irena's.  The loaves come in frozen, and Irena's tosses them into an oven.  While I can't help but believe that from-scratch would result in a superior product, Irena's loaves are nothing to sneeze at, and may circumstantially best some Zeppole loaves.  Irena's farmer's rye is impressive - crusty, heavy as a brick, and at once both sour and mild.

Irena's is a joy.  They make shopping for Eastern European groceries enjoyable.  Their stock is fresh with presumably high turnover.  And, as long as you're spending upwards of $5, you don't hyeff to pey with kyesh.

I gave one star but would have given a zero if that were an option. I have a feeling the woman giving my massage had no training at all. She took three phone calls during the massage, left the door open when she told me to get back into my clothes and went in and out of the room during the massage to get things (leaving me exposed with a towel barely big enough to fit over my body). Those weren't even the worst parts. She actually climbed up on the massage table twice putting her feet beside me and straddling my body and then massaging ‍. The weirdest experience I've ever had getting a massage!! I don't even have the words to describe how strange it was and NOT relaxing or therapeutic. I only stayed because she had me pay up front. YES, that should have been the first red flag. At a couple points during the massage I almost started laughing because the longer she went the more bazaar it was and I couldn't help but think someone from the show Impractical Jokers was going to pop out and tell me I was being pranked. I could go on and on about how every bit of it was just wrong and not just technically . Even someone that's not experienced in getting massages would have known that this woman had no clue what she was doing.

My girlfriends and I went here for happy hour and we got a good amount of food: flatbread, tacos, and some sort of loaded waffle fries, lol. We also got a brownie sundae to end off the night. All were good.. but nothing spectacular. However, our cocktails were good, I enjoyed that the most.

The restaurant is pretty huge with a modern/fancy feel. The staff is nice and friendly. I would come back for happy hour cocktails again!
We had a great time going out to eat here! The food was delicious and our server, Lylark, gave us great service and was very accommodating. Will return for some more delicious Brie Kisses!

Can't say enough good things about this place! It's excellent food....we always get Beef brisket and or Chx Wings. Save room for chocolate pie! This place often has tables to actually come in and sit down- at least I've never experienced a 40 minute like so many other restaurants.

If I was basing this review purely on atmosphere I would give it a 5. They have beautiful underwater design pieces through the restaurant plus you can sit on the patio and enjoy the fountain show that goes off every hour at the Village. 

However, I've never been a huge fan of their food. It's not bad by any means. But it does feel very much like a chain. But I have had good experiences with their wait staff and they have very tasty cocktails. 

I'll be going back for cocktails and patio seating, but not for a meal.

I never tried Bosnian food. Since I was staying at the hotel nearby I decided to try it. What should I say, I was extremely surprised. I ordered meat pie. It was sooo delicious and waitresses were so nice! 
I already recommended it to all my local friends and think it is a definitely a must...

This specific location has a lot of room to roam, with new free weight areas and fun equipment. Preston at the front always makes a point to say hello and goodbye and the other front desk workers help me when needed. 
    They remodeled and I love the new additions. Only issue is that the ladies locker room could use some no slip mats and paper towel dispensers.

Good happy hour menu. I had the margarita on the rocks, rolls (half off), calamari ($6), and more calamari because they are just really good. The server is very cool, I think his name is Kevin (tall). He got our order right and quick. Loving the place, good food, and good location.

My first visit here individually but not for my attending party, we stopped in for breakfast with my 3 year old for location and selection. 
Short wait, 10-15mins to be expected on a Saturday am, the hostess was very welcoming and accommodating to move us to a booth she cleaned for us to sit with my son.

Our server, Sierra was not so welcoming and gave an unfriendly attitude through most of our meal, asking we remind her for my sons drink, not providing silverware and napkins and when bringing them to us seemed annoyed. 

I ordered a basic omelet that came uncooked with the contents mixed into the eggs almost like a scramble with too much sauce. My 'farm fries' or diced potatoes were so uncooked they were inedible. My meal remained untouched as she walked past us and dropped a check.. not even offering boxes for my sons pancakes which were fine and my moms meal which was perfect. 

We flagged down a manager- did not grab her name. She was very kind and receptive and explained the possibmr

I fell and was brought here by ambulance. From the time I came in the door I was treated very well and  with respect. Dr J Saunders was very through with my exam. The X-ray tech was  kind also. They called in a young lady from BtownFields at 3am to fit me with a brace. They were very busy so the time was lengthy but that was to be expected. Great service good job St Luke's

We love going to Café olé! Since it's not over at the village there isn't typically a huge weight on a Friday or Saturday. Which makes stopping in for a quick dinner with the family a typical go to.

Tortilla soup is hot and hearty and will warm you up in the winter and you can choose from a couple combinations for dinner between tacos enchiladas floutas or burritos.  Whatever you choose there's some thing for everyone! 

I also appreciate that there is a changing station in the bathroom so I can go with the baby and not have to run to the car to change a baby in the back seat, I can in the bathroom at the changing station. 

Also the team at café ole is extremely friendly and attentive .  Our drinks are never empty!

First time eating a poke bowl...absolutely delicious & awesomeness. Mine had blue rice! No I did not make a typing error - blue rice. And it was yummy just like white or brown rice. Packed with crab, avocado, roe, seaweed, crunchy cucumbers, ginger, salmon, tuna & some delicious sauce. I ate every little yummy morsel - now in poke bowl coma!! Stuffed to the gills. You gotta try it!!
Great group of people belong here.  The golf course has improved over the last several years.  The food needs a lot of improvement though!

Let me first say, I am a foodie, I love food, I love every kind of food, every ethnic food there is I love. I gave Kona a try with a family gathering while I am in Boise visiting my son and wife. I was TERRIBLY disappointed as we all were with the food we received. I left over $100 there and I feel I was ROBBED. It was NOTHING food. My daughter who loves clam chowder told me she didn't like it. She is 12 so I thought she was being picky, I tasted it and it was horrible. It tasted like it was burnt, it was just zero in my opinion, as was everyone else who tasted it. I am sorry, no one at the table will ever be back. My daughter in law liked the pork slider as I did when I tasted it. But over all it was WAY too much money for the quality.

Perfect place for a great lunch or dinner. Eating outside while enjoying the view of the water and village is amazing! Food was nothing but perfect, great portions and amazing drinks! Got the cheeseburger and margarita flight which was delicious! Check this place out when nearby!

Sent the following email last week and still have not received a response from management: https://www.thespruceeats.com/ketchup-catsup-storage-and-fun-facts-1808081 This morning we visited Joe Mama's on Eagle Rd, Meridian, ID at approximately 8:30 a.m. The ketchup bottle exploded all over my clothing and food when opened. While the server was quick to bring napkins, I now have a dry cleaning bill, which will need to be paid (none of the meal was comped). Also, seating people next to a screaming host "SARAH, PARTY OF 3!!!!!" is not a pleasant experience.

UPDATE following response from Kathleen.  I'm sorry we didn't demand to see the manager at the time it happened.  I thought I would just come home and wash the jacket, not realizing it has to be dry cleaned.  However, upon that revelation, I immediately went to the Joe Mama's contact page: https://joemommaseatery.com/#contact  Thankfully, the site sends the customer a copy of the emailed message.

Breakfast burritos are always on point.  I did try the chicken fried steak breakfast burrito this time instead of bacon/sausage and was happy with the choice. That's all I've had there to date. Have ordered out every time and it's always prepared quick. Recommend trying for sure.

We decided to stop for a quick lunch and it was a mistake. Although they've done a great job with social distancing,the food was below average. I had midday breakfast and hard to ruin. However, my wife had a prime rib dip and it was awful. It looked fine but the meat was TOUGH! (Yes, I tried it too.) She pulled off the meat and I gave her my bacon for her sandwich so she could at least eat something. Needless to say, we will not return.

My roof was 23 years old and missing a few too many shingles. I dreaded the process of finding a roofing company, getting bids and ultimately paying for it.  I contacted 2 roofing companies after doing extensive research  and reading reviews to avoid any problems if possible. Idaho Roofing Contractors contacted me right away, made time around my schedule and did an amazingly quick and thorough job putting my bid together. Kyle was friendly, articulate and addressed all questions and concerns with absolutely no hesitation. He was more interested in educating me about the product than he was trying to sell me something. He made us feel so comfortable and at ease with the whole process. 

Fast forward to scheduling, I was a mess. I was delayed for multiple reasons and life did not want to slow down for me to be able to catch up. Not one pushy call from anyone at Idaho Roofing. Every time I called I was greeted with a friendly and exciting tone and eventually, I was able to pick a date. 

For whatever reason it was like Christmas morning getting a new roof. We picked out the most beautiful shingles! Kyle was here the morning of install to introduce me to the crew, answer any last minute questions and grab the crew breakfast (bonus points! It was cold and I felt so appreciative that they value each other like they do!)

As I came and went from my house over the 2 days they were here, they were always working. I mean, always working. They put in some long days and I don't even know how they did it. The crew members were always kind, cleaned up everything  constantly (even my junk, oops) and the level of detail making sure everything was perfect was outstanding. 

I now have an absolute gorgeous roof and a company that I recommend whole heartedly. Don't try and save a few pennies by using someone who might not finish or do sub par work (my biggest fear, my neighbor didn't have a roof for over a month!) 

Thank you, Idaho Roofing. Thank you Kyle. We are truly blessed!

Great guys worked really hard and did a great job.  I felt comfortable enough to leave my home and come back later.  Carpet and couch came out great.  They also offered a scotch guard service which I jumped on.

The fish was high quality and the ambiance is really relaxing by the fountains. But I've never paid so much money to leave a restaurant hungry. Their dishes and rolls are way over priced for the small amount of food you get.
If you're hungry, go someone else. If you want to over pay for ambiance and leave hungry, then this is your place!
Great place! Good service, the manager is super nice and attentive even on a very busy night.

I'm a local business owner and took one of my service vans in for routine maintenance. The folks at Meridian Automotive took in my vehicle, returned it same same day, and did all of the work for a VERY reasonable price. I plan to have all of my vehicles serviced with them on a regular basis to keep them running right so we can be out there serving our customers.

This company has left me and many neighbors out to dry with chronic issues of poor drainage between lot lines blaming the issue on poor watering schedules between neighboring lots-NOT TRUE!!!  CBH is passing the buck by not addressing these chronic drainage issues (I am part of an on-line neighborhood communication called 'Next Door' ) and the complaints on poor drainage between lots from MULTIPLE CBH neighborhoods throughout he valley is unacceptable!  I had to pay $1,500 out of pocket to have a landscaper tell me the lot was improperly sloped and the top soil was crap thus, my poor drainage issue (killing grass-standing water) I am hearing from other neighbors that water has been draining into their crawl space.  I tried contacting the city of Eagle and they said the builder is responsible for the 'swail' of drainage. 

BUYER BEWARE!!!!!

Terrible dentist.  I had to use them because of my employer's insurance.  I came to Boise with all my teeth including my wisdom teeth.  I was 50 years old when I started going to Willowtree.  10 years later, I've lost 11 teeth.  Found out they don't fix crack or aged fillings!  They tried to have all of my wife's front teeth pull!  If you go here, don't expect to keep your teeth.

We visited for our anniversary tonight.  One thing that I really appreciated was our waiter welcoming us and asking if we were celebrating anything special.  After we responded with our anniversary, he immediately asked if we had any advice for him.  He took a real interest in us.  It's the waitstaff that really made our meal tonight.  The food was just a bonus.  thanks Kona for making our evening great!

Great good. Great value for the money. Amazing Japanese foos even this far from the ocean. LA quality food. Love it. Good bartenders and great drinks. Sake bombs are great obviously !!!!  Great experience.  Love it here.
We love Dr. Blair and his staff! Hands down the best quality of care for your kids teeth.

Their Oahu house was perfect for our family of 6. Clean, right on a beautiful sandy beach for the kids, private but close to everything we did and needed. The house was spotless and newly remodeled, had everything we needed to be comfortable and cook our own meals. Truly hope to come again!

To start off, I didn't have the best experience at The Village location. I felt the employees were not reaching my expectation and our orders were always off. Either the order was made wrong or items were missing. Immediately the Owner Dan reached out to me and ensured my next visit would be different! He went the lengths of spending a lot of time at the location, working with the current employees and encouraged me to return back to the location in a few weeks. I believe that the best thing a business can do is always striving to improve themselves and that is exactly what Dan did! I rarely leave reviews.  Typically only when we receive exceptional service and/or horrible service.  Unfortunately, this review is all about the horrible side of things.   On this day, we (my family of five, which included our little grandson) decided on Joe Momma's and that's where it all started (downhill).  Making the online reservation was the only positive thing about our experience.  When we arrived, the person at the front desk could not find it, kept telling us it's not there (we should've just left), but did eventually (took her a few minutes).  After we were seated, waitress did bring us waters (ordered Irish coffee, but never got it) and few mins later took our order.   Went totally downhill from there.  After watching several tables being served (still no Irish Coffee / no waters being topped off).  We started to wonder, if she just simply forgot us.  Once tables after us were getting their food, we looked for our waitress, found her (which she never came back to our table), and were told "I'm sorry - forgot to submit your order, but will do it right now".  If this was only a few minutes, that would be one thing, but it was an hour (1hr) of waiting (with our initial empty water glasses and nothing else).  We were completely left alone, no water topped off, no Irish coffee, and not even checked on literally the entire time.  At that point, I told her, forget it, we're leaving.  We gathered our stuff and another individual came to us and stated, she's new / first day.  Majority of this negative review is to their management for not supporting her, for not being with her, for not training her, and on her, for not asking for help or at least checking back with us and/or even just simply telling us she's new.  Unfortunately, this isn't the first time we've had horrible service, but it will be our last.  Far too many other places to give our business to.  Food is not the worth the wait or worth the extreme poor service.  If after this review, you still want to go there, my advice, after a few minutes, check with your wait staff to make sure they submitted it, kitchen has it,  and keep checking back - just so they don't forget you.  Service Horrible and never received any food to comment further.

I had a pulled pork sandwich, green salad, and diet Coke.  The sandwich came with a fair amount of pork which was pulled, but there were still chunks. The green salad came in a small bowl and was actually packed in so there was more than what appeared there.  The good part was the salad was very fresh.

I might come back and try this again sometime.  Maybe it will be better.  I am hopeful.

We had a November completion date with December kinda thrown out as a possible completion date if weather was problematic (weather was never problematic). Then when we received a final walk thru date of December 7th we asked for a pre inspection. They responded if we wanted a pre inspection we couldn't move in until December 27th. Really? Move my family on Christmas week? 3 weeks to correct items on a new home? It was the last straw. We ended up canceling with CBH and walking away. It was worth losing $3500.00 dollars to not support or do business with this company. They DO NOT CARE about their clients. They are cashing in right now due to market, but their reputation proceeds them. When the market slows, which it always does, it will undoubtedly hurt them as their poor treatment of clients will not be forgotten. Its disappointing as we were financially and emotionally invested, but in the end walking away was the best decision.

I understand some people have the money to tip everywhere they order food but others like myself might have left the house with $8 in their bank account for a special treat. Just saying.

Out of 244 reviews, I have only given 15 one stars. This restaurant deserves a solid one. 

To say the least, I ended up tossing out almost my entire plate of food. It was that bad. 

To start off, they are not transparent about their pricing. I ordered a plate with salmon and shrimp and they said it would be an additional $3 surcharge for each item. This is absolutely acceptable, but at least put it down somewhere on your menu. So I opted for a two item plate, with coconut shrimp and teriyaki chicken. 

The only good thing I had here were the coconut shrimp. They were so crispy and "garlicky" that I could eat them with the skin-on. I selected the teriyaki chicken for the other entree and the chicken was so tough, I could swear I was eating a teriyaki-glazed piece of leather. Granted, everything has been sitting in a chafing dish for a while, so only the shrimp were made to order. 

Initially, I was really excited when I saw the variety of different side dishes available. But the fried rice I selected was incredibly "clumpy" and had no seasoning. The salads and slaws were loaded with mayo. If you're into that, then check this place out. 

But even more disappointing were these fat egg rolls they have on display before you pay. This may have been the most disgusting egg roll I've had in my life. The egg roll wrapper was incredibly tough, almost like a dog chew toy. The inside filling...I couldn't even make out what was inside because it was so mushy. 

Granted, this was one of a handful of Hawaiian food restaurants in the area, so respect for trying to bring it to the masses. But it had a lot left to be desired.

Our daughter has unfortunately had to spend a lot of time at the dentist- but Dr. Blair and his team have made that time as painless as possible! Everyone from the lady at check in, to the dental tech, to Dr. Blair himself are welcoming, professional, and caring. We always have a good experience at the office, but there are 2 times that really stand out. 
1) Our daughter had a space retainer for a molar come loose and start cutting up her gums. I called and left a message, as they were closed that day. I was called back promptly, and given instructions until we could get into the office for an emergency appointment.
2) We were camping and had a horrible accident- our kiddo had gotten a concussion, and knocked out a molar completely. This was on a Sunday, and we left the ER without anyone addressing her knocked out tooth. I called and left a message with details on the after hours voicemail. Dr. Blair HIMSELF CALLED ME BACK WITHIN MINUTES! He told us to come in right now, and he would take a look. She had evidently also concussed her two front ADULT teeth, and he was able to give us care instructions to make sure they didn't get damaged further! I didn't even know you could concuss teeth! Dr. Blair came in ON A SUNDAY NIGHT, and did x-rays himself just to make sure our kiddo was taken care of! He also gave her a stuffed puppy that she still has today, he was able to make her smile, and feel better for just a little bit while in a ton of pain. We can't thank Dr. Blair enough. Please take your family here, this is a dentist office and team that truly cares.

It was 20 minutes after sitting down and still hadn't even gotten water. Our entrees came out before water or any other beverages we had ordered hit the table. They also had beautiful chocolates and truffles as well as a few baked goods. I am going to come back to try the candy as this is what their core product was when they got started. I have had many dogs in my lifetime and many veterinarians!  We are new here to Boise and we suddenly needed a vet.  Our 16 year old wonderful, sweet dog was quickly coming to the end of her life.  She began to have very painful seizures and needed to be euthanized as soon as possible.  It was late at night and we didn't know who to call.  We started calling any vet we could find.  Most had either no time, were closed, or we couldn't be in with our dog during the procedure.  If you love your dog, don't leave them frightened and in pain with a stranger at the end. Be strong for them.  When we found All Valley and told them our condition, they said come in AND YOU CAN STAY WITH HER!  We were met outside and brought to a private room as we watched the kindest most caring group of people ease my dog out this world and take care of my wife and I at the same time.  This is the place to come with your animal. We received a sympathy card in the mail. Who does that?   I wish I could give more stars.
