Drink prices are of course not listed. I believe I got the Cucumber Southside which was fine. I obviously forgot what it was. I then switched to beer as I had a feeling it would be stupid expensive to get more cocktails.

We tried some Avocado Rolls (no description on the menu besides the dipping sauce), and guess what, for $15, there is ONLY avocado in these rolls! Booooring. They were just okay, and there's only 3 pieces. So that's a whopping $5 a piece. I coulda bought like 7 avocados for that much. 

Thankfully we decided to split an entrée rather than us each getting our own -- the surf and turf for $39. You get a few choices on what kind of cut and roll you want, but FYI, you get up-charged if you want a more "special" roll. We ordered the ribeye. It was decent, but a small cut. They cleverly deliver the dish on a little cutting board with the roll and some green beans so it takes up the space, making it look bigger than it actually is. The Las Vegas roll was okay, too, but they only give you 6 pieces. 

Overall, cool lounge-y place to stop for a drink BEFORE real dinner somewhere else, but I would not have multiple drinks or food. It's a ripoff for the whole she-bang. The quality does not match up with what you have to fork over.

Everything we tried was delicious! We got the puddle jumper to share between my husband and I and it was just the right amount and a great price. Our favorite flavors were the Strawberry Colada and Toffee Lovers. Great atmosphere as well and friendly staff. We will be coming back!!

Extremely disappointed in this facility. As stated in other reviews the people at the front desk spend more time with their head stuck in the telephone than greeting the customers. Literally was never greeted as a member for four months. The personal trainer that I paid for was weak at best and no showed on one of the occasions. Also when you try to cancel, good luck can't speak to anybody, took two emails, two phone calls and finally an email to corporate. Still not sure they'll quit taking money out of my account! Their are many other better options in this Valley. Don't waste your time or money!

This is definitely a favorite lunch place for my coworkers and myself. Today we went for lunch and I did the small pizza and salad. It was perfect for what I was wanting. I love their Italian salads in the house dressing and I love getting a small pizza with a side of ranch dressing. They aren't usually too busy over lunch so you typically can get in and out in an hour.  Lunch menu has a good variety this is just my favorite combo.

We have a spinet piano that was in our family for generations.  When one of the drop lifter elbows broke inside, we decided to schedule an appointment for one of Dunkley's piano technicians to come out for a tuning and replace the damaged part.  I called Dunkley's to make the appointment and the gentleman on the other end was very rude and condescending.  He said that the next available appointment would not be for another two months.  TWO MONTHS.   Whatever, so we would have to live with a broken key for a while... we went ahead with the appointment.
 
Two months later the technician arrived at our house as scheduled, having been given advance word about what the problem was with our piano.  Instead of giving a detailed estimate for the repair and doing the servicing we requested, he gave us a condescending lecture about how he suspected the problem was with the drop lifter elbow but that we would be wasting money to replace parts made from old plastic.  He said that we should either haul the piano straight to the dump or keep it as a decorative piece since the wood was in such good shape.  When my wife asked him if he could just fix the one damaged key and forget about tuning it since it seemed there'd be no way to ask that much of him, he responded, "no I don't have the part and quite frankly I'm over 65 and I won't get down there anyway, especially with this old piano."  What?  So if you don't even want to get down there in the first place, knowing this was required ahead of time, then why even bother to come out and waste 20 minutes of our time?

He then proceeded to "do us a favor" and listed out several  "nice" pianos back at the showroom floor for us to check out.  That's not all though... he even pulled out his cellphone and called the sales manager to give him a heads-up that we were coming in, along with our names and contact information, just like a used car salesman would.  The new pianos he listed at the showroom ranged in price from $4,000 to just under $10,000.
 
When he left we did some research and found a pack of 12 replacement drop lifter elbows online for under $6. My wife also found several YouTube videos that show just how simple it is to replace these yourself in a matter of minutes. Apparently this is a common problem with a simple solution that anyone can fix.  My father-in-law had also replaced some other drop lifter elbows a few years ago and the piano worked good as new.

So essentially we called out a company that specializes in this kind of work only to experience a technician who was clearly not interested in a simple repair job but was more than happy to refer us to the showroom to sell us a new piano.  Please, we weren't as dumb and gullible as this guy thought we were, and he more than likely gets a commission for sales references.  The only positive that came out of this experience was that he waived the $70 service call fee, and only because he thought he could sell us a new piano.

These people are definitely not worth your time.  Do some research and get a second opinion elsewhere.

Delicious food, delightful service and attentive staff!! Highly recommend. They have a great assortment of breakfast foods, from savory to sweet! I just ate breakfast there with some friends for my birthday and again, it was satisfying and excellent!

The best breakfast in Idaho! Extremely large portions so beware! My teenage daughter loves the classic breakfast gives you a little bit of everything. If you have kids you can definitely split one pancake between two people. The mixed berry jelly was amazing! Great service great food! Went during the week if going on the weekend call ahead or go online. We are from Tennessee so we love ate country breakfast in Idaho!

Ordered a pizza at 6:30-arrived at 8:50 p.m. After waiting over an hour for pizza to be delivered, I called to inquire when the pizza would arrive. I was told that the delivery person was on their way. After an hour and a half, I called back to check the ETA. I was then directed to a manager who was rude, spoke over me, and talked about re-training her staff. I was just calling back once again, to inquire when the pizza would arrive. When asked "what I wanted to resolve the situation", I just said I would like to know the time of arrival, and was met with a snarky reply of "okay we will just refund you." This is how businesses close down...

Pretty disappointed in my service here this morning. Called to order from the biscuits and hogs menu for pickup and specifically asked for fresh fruit and toast instead of hashbrowns with our scrambles. Then we were instead served hashbrowns and upcharged $3.29 and $2.29 respectively for fruit and toast. 
Then they didn't even put the fruit in the bag. Paid extra for something I didn't get, and then got what I didn't ask for. In addition, the avocado on my scramble was brown and overripe. Two very mediocre and mixed up breakfast orders for $41. Will not go back.

My Bambino-Sphynx mama was in hard, active labor for almost 24 hours.  After two babies had been birthed, the progress stopped.  I took my cat, Miss Littles, to a local vet to get an x-ray to confirm that there were more babies in her uterus.  Those x-rays showed two babies inside, but the vet didn't do surgery so I would have to do elsewhere.  Those x-rays cost $250.

Took mama home, tried to have her rest so she could deliver the last two kittens.  It just wasn't happening so we had to find an after hours veterinarian, and ended up at All Valley.  When we walked in, they quickly ushered us into a quiet room.  A tech came in and did a quick assessment, took vitals, and took my cat back for an ultrasound.  Within a few minutes, the veterinarian came in, listened as I recounted what had been going on so far, and decided a c-section would be the only way to save mama. The ultrasound did not show heartbeats in the kittens.

Mama was taken back and a technician came in to discuss costs.  The estimate was itemized, and each expense explained.  It was going to be roughly $1500 for the c-section.  Included was a $70 fee for CPR on the babies.  I was given the option on whether or not I wanted to have her spayed.  I appreciate that they allowed me to make that decision and didn't pass judgement on the issue either way.  I left and was told it would be later in the night if I wanted to come pick up mama, and hopefully babies.

Three hours later I got the call that mama did great and was recovering peacefully.  Unfortunately, the kittens were indeed deceased and there was nothing they could do.  

I took this moment to test the ethics of the clinic.  In my mind I was wondering if the vet was still going to charge me the $70 to try to revive the babies?  This was going to tell me a lot about the clinic and whether I would return there.

When I arrived, there were tears for the lost babies.  No way around it, it was a painful loss. Mama looked really good.  She was no longer in distress, and she wasn't terribly drugged up.  Her incision was the best I've seen on any animal surgery.  I've bred rare cats for 22 years and could say this was the best closure I'd seen.

Then came the bill.  The admin staff requested payment of just over $900 dollars, which is $600 less than the estimate. Not only did they remove the $70 revive kitten fee, but they charged ethically and honestly.  I had taken my cats to other emergency clinics when I lived in Phoenix, and it was always the exact quote or more than anticipated.  Never had I had a clinic that only charged me so honestly, especially when it was significantly less than quoted.  They could have easily held me to the $1500 quote.

More important than the expense was how Miss Littles recovered.  Prior to her c-section, she had successfully birthed two babies.  So out of four mama still had these two to take care of, and now had a new, tender incision down her tummy.  The care and method of closing her would left her ready for the wear and tear of being a new mom.  The babies immediately started nursing and mama had no problems keep up with her milk flow.  The incision stayed closed and clean.  I was given the option of a three day follow-up, but did not see any need as she recovered beautifully.

The staff at All Animal was professional from the moment I came in.  It's sad to read the negative reviews.  Theory is that if you provide stellar service to a client they will tell their family and friends about it. If someone is unhappy with your service, they will tell EVERYONE.  

But I can say this was the best experience on one of the worst of days.  I will bring my cats and dog here for routine care, and in the event of an emergency will return without hesitancy.  I will also recommend All Animal to my clients, the families that adopt out the babies.  

Many thanks to the staff at All Animal.  Miss Littles, Chick and Laslow are happy and healthy.

Cornerstone property management company handled our recent rental experience with true professionalism and excellent customer service! My husband and I had to find a short-term rental while our house was being built. Cami and Alisha were so accommodating and understanding to our needs, and the communication between all parties involved was handled very well and promptly. Cami was great to work with and very kind. She truly cares about providing her owners and renters the best quality of service. Thank you Cami for all your help and expertise. We will absolutely recommend this company and staff to our friends & family!  Erin

Disappointing experience.  Server forgot appetizer after having a conversation about it then forgot second beer.  When asked about The appetizer her response was did you order an appetizer? When we reminded her of the conversation she took responsibility (which I appreciated her not blaming the kitchen) and she said the manager would come by.  The manager however came to our table hunched over and with a raspy whisper said to keep in mind that dessert was on her...we didn't want desert.  Since we didn't have an appetizer the only way to judge the meal was on the main course. The mashed potatoes were extremely garlicky the vegetables were spicy beyond being edible but the steak was good.  Would not return or recommend due to inept management.

My husband recently had procedures done at both the Cherry Lane clinic and the Wood Sage Clinic. He is a 100% service connected Vietnam veteran, He had been going to the Boise VA dental clinic for over a year to have an implant done on a front tooth due to an error the VA made during a root canal procedure. The appliance they gave him to wear kept breaking and causing additional problems with other teeth. He ended up with an infection twice and needed help right away.  Every time we called the VA we were told they were not open, nor could they refer him to an outside dentist. We contacted Willow Tree and they got him in right away, prescribing antibiotics and soon after did a root canal due to the incorrectly fit appliance given by the VA.  Not only did they get rid of the infection, they  completed the partly done implant procedure that was started by the VA. 
I cant completely describe how much I appreciate their genuine kind, caring and courteous nature of both offices! They should be highly commended. Everything they did was greatly appreciated. Thank you

Got there for our appointment.  We were told that she was running a couple minutes behind but she would have her assistant do my husband pedicure and she would do mine as soon as she was done with the nails she was working on.  Heard her talking to someone in the back explaining what she needed to do.  Out comes her 13-14 year old daughter who proceeded to give my husband what was supposed to be a pedicure.  She in no way tried to hurry with the other customer.  I finally got out of the salon two hours later. While doing my toes we had a long conversation about how they don't charge extra for gel polish. I don't think I would have been mad, but when I was checking out she said she was giving us $25.00 discount and then charged me  $50.00. I was a little taken back and asked how much the pedicure was and she said  a gel pedicure was $50.00 Won't be going there again.

My experience was just with the gun smith.  I took in 4 rifles for simple cleaning and trigger jobs on two. The old man was nice enough when I left the rifles and said it would be up to two weeks to get them back while complaining about people that expects two day turnaround.  I said two weeks would be fine.  After 2.5 weeks I called and was treated rudely on the phone like, why am I calling when they are so busy.  So I went in and was told the rifles were not ready and he didn't like people who expected immediate turnaround.  I reminded him that he had told me two weeks and that I had waited over two weeks.  Without saying anything he went to his computer, looked it up and said, "Well, it's just outside two weeks."  I asked how much longer and he said, "At least a week."  I told him to give me my rifles back which he did after 5 or so minutes of "clearing me out of the computer" and without a word let me take my rifles back.  Bottom line, don't use these rude folks for any of your gun smithing needs.

We have been trying to go to Sofra's for about a year. They have pretty limited hours, and we haven't been good at planning ahead. Usually we're wanting dinner on a weekday and they're only open for lunch during the week. So we were SUPER excited when we planned ahead and were able to check them out for lunch!

This is a small restaurant run by a real family. You see them running orders, mixing coffee and ringing up customers. That scores big points in my book right away. I also love how unique and different this place is from other Mediterranean places in the valley. You can get a super good gyro, but you can also get special savory pies or incredible sausages and fabulous desserts. 

We had Hungry (4) and Hurricane (1) with us, so we were so grateful that it wasn't terribly crowded and the employees were so gracious about us having children. We ordered Gyro with fries, Sirnica (a Cheese Pie), and Cevapi (the Sausage Sandwich). My husband got the Bosnian Coffee and I tried the Turkish. My kids love spice, so they gobbled up the gyro meat, the fries, and the sausages. The gyro and sausage sandwich were money! So flavorful, not too salty and served with plenty of condiments and extras. Their tzatziki is some of the best I've ever had! So creamy and full of flavor. I wish I could bottle it up and take it home. We really liked the tomatoey, chili sauce that came with the Cevapi too. 

The Sirnica is really interesting. We all agreed that the pastry was fabulous. A little flakey, but also a tad doughy. The cheese is interesting. It's kind of like a mix between scrambled eggs and cottage cheese but with a really mild flavor. Definitely not what most Americans are used to. BUT that's also why we try different cuisines! Get out of your comfort zone. think I think I'll try the potato one next time. 

We both loved our coffees. The Turkish coffee is really special. It's served on a beautiful platter and you use a turkish delight as a stir stick! My littles helped me eat the gooey treat. 

A few things weren't amazing, which is why this is a 4 star. The fries weren't spectacular. My guess is they come frozen in a bag. Of course the small people liked them just fine. The pita bread was really tough. Again, I think I'm used to soft, white, pillowy pita bread, so this comes from my own American hang-ups. I think I'll save myself some calories and just eat all the gyro insides on top of my fries next time! I also was not a fan of the hummus. It is really heavy on the tahini, which gives it a slightly bitter taste. Hurricane, however, ate it by fry-full. So...to each her own. 

Overall, we will absolutely keep coming back. I can't wait to try more things on the menu.

Absolutely, positively an amazing experience! The atmosphere and food was nothing short of first class! Our waitress Mandy was superb and her expertise in food choices and drinks was second to none!  The decadent appetizers she recommended was mouth watering and left us in awe of what was to come. We decided to take her vast knowledge of the menu and ordered the pawn in salmon pasta and the pork dish Gucci. Needless to say every single morsel was consumed with a smile on our faces! Mandy was the cherry on the top of our dining experience at twigs! Give this woman a raise now! See my photos... I guarantee you will not be disappointed!
Great food, slightly slow service.  Some may not find it worth it but we do.

Surprised to see that this place doesn't have a higher rating. We came here after a friend recommended it for a good burger. It did not disappoint!

Between the 4 of us we had the regular cheeseburger, Gorgonzola garlic burger, wagyu burger and the honey curry ahi sandwich. (Those might not be the exact names)

The Gorgonzola garlic burger had so much flavor and all of the beef was extremely juicy.

What really surprised me was the honey curry ahi sandwich. I love rare ahi on just about anything and this sandwich was AMAZING! Insane flavor and cooked to perfection.

A little pricier for a burger but a great atmosphere and nice to stop while walking around the village.

We will be back!

This is my second time coming to this location, haircut was mediocre. Needed to use the restroom as I open the door I was horrified by how the floor looks. It seems like they haven't mopped the floor for months. Dusty, sink was dirty. GROSS!

For those of you looking for fresh produce, free roaming eggs, fresh baked goods, and dairy products during this pandemic, Wagner Farms is a gem.  They are providing a pick up only service where you text in your order for pickup on Tues, Thurs, or Sat.  The produce is available in three different box sizes and the quality is fantastic.  The fruits and vegetables are far superior to anything I've purchased from a grocery store in the past few months.  The ice cream is unbelievable.  The products available are posted on their Facebook site.  Simple to text in your order and then pickup in the five hour window they are open ...... on the day of your choice.  Bonus points that you can pay with Venmo so it is a completely 'distance' experience.

We took our very ill Dog here Sunday 2/212021 evening as she had been vomiting and had diarrhea since Wednesday. She was becoming very lethargic and not eating or urinating. We have been here before and have been happy with the service's provided to our dogs. I am not sure if there is new management or what but this experience was terrible. They drew our dogs bloodwork, gave her "fluids under the skin"and took an x-ray. Not finding anything "crazy" they sent us home. We were there for over four hours, and ultimately sent home with an antibiotic and special dog food. By morning our dog Had become even more ill. Not moving at all, not able to stand, drink or urinate still! I called and spoke to somebody at the front desk. They said all they could do is offer us an ultrasound but was not able to provide us a price or even an estimated price. The lady that answered the phone said I need to "let the antibiotic do it's job" even after I gave her the update on my dogs condition. After spending over $700 the night before I felt as if they should provide a little bit more care and/or follow up if she is not doing well. Considering they asked me to call if she got worse. I ended up taking her to a second veterinarian to ask for another opinion which we were recommended to "rush her to West Vet for life saving measures" . By Monday evening she was admitted to the ICU at West Vet and is still there to this date. bottom line is no matter your animal's situation, make sure you are taking it to a veterinarian clinic that will take your animal serious and will get your animal the care they need. I really do not enjoy writing a bad review by any means nor do I typically even ever write a review at all, but this needs to be known! I would never suggest taking your animal to this business.

Hours lie they aren't 24/7

Because the review is too short
Hours lie they aren't 24/7

Hours lie they aren't 24/7

Watching our 18-month old granddaughter head off to "cool"  this past week has been an amazing experience!  She has only known the caregiving of her parents, grandparents and special nanny.  Her realms of experience have been limited to her home and our home.  All that changed on January 4, 2021.  We were ALL nervous and excited--we questioned how she would cope with a different setting, new adults, other kids, a prescribed routine????  The answer:  FABULOUS!!!  The Montessori team made our Austen's transition from the known to the unknown an unbelievably positive experience!  Day 1 our girl came out to greet us with a big smile on her face and those smiles have continued with each passing day.  We get "real time" photos each day of her interactions with other children and her teacher, with stated goals and very cute captions.  At day's end Austen's parents get a daily report, summarizing her day.  

We are thrilled with all that Austen is learning!!!  Every moment is a teachable moment, and I, a retired teacher, truly appreciate this Montessori school.  It will be great fun to see Austen grow and learn in such a caring, learning environment

We order from here frequently and there was a mistake with our pick up and the management went ABOVE AND BEYOND to make it right with us! We appreciate their customer service, yummy food and having such a great local restaurant in our community.

Had a good lunch at BD's. Pulled pork sandwich was good with lean pork and a toasted bun. The garlic mashers and Mac and cheese were very good.  Great BBQ sauce choices and quick service. Not as good as Good Wood, but a close second.

I ordered an 8 inch personal pizza, a house salad, a soda, and a warm apple crisp through delivery. It wasn't good. I don't like great big hunks of toppings on my pizza. For example, I like tomatoes on my pizza, but when it's huge chunks of tomato, that's all I can taste. Same issue with the pineapple. I would like to taste something in each bite of pizza besides pineapple or tomato. The cheese was a bit gluey, and right underneath the sauce, it tasted like the dough wasn't completely cooked. It just wasn't a tasty pizza.
I also ordered the apple crisp for $9. I do love me some warm apple crisp with a nice, fat scoop of melting, vanilla ice cream on top. I thought, this must be the biggest, best apple crisp ever to cost 9 bucks. It wasn't. It wasn't big, and it definitely wasn't the best. You can get a larger serving of a better apple crisp a la mode at any Denny's, for half the price. Welp, the search for excellent (I'd even settle for good) delivery food continues.
Full size glasses in the flight of mimosas, CFS is solid and filling and done correctly. Good thick gravy without being glop, you know what I mean!
Professional and a great value.  Super nice staff.

I am not one to write bad reviews, but after waiting months, with no change, this one has to be done.   
    Have been a member here for years.  I have to say with the new ownership I think they forgot to hire a cleanup crew.  The equipment has piles of dust on it. There is a huge strand of cobwebs or a cacoon stuck and strung across the speakers, tons of dust on top of all equipment to the point it was falling off as I lifted weights.  The staff always seems to be sitting on the counters texting and chit chatting.   Maybe introducing them to a dust mop would be beneficial?   I walk in , don't scan my card and walk out with the staff head glued to their phone and they never even notice.  It's a sad situation.

This review is regarding the sales side and not the shooting range. Nobody seemed very interested in helping me except a gentleman name Michael which asked if I needed help a couple times. Other then that, it seems like everyone was there to just hangout at work and not put customers first or going out of their way to help someone. I'm sure this review would not affect them but they definitely lost my service
Their options are great! I love the pulled pork salad and the sweet barbecue sauce is incredible! This is my go to place when I want bbq food!

We had a delicious breakfast! I don't always order pancakes at restaurants because not everyone makes them the way I like my pancakes but the pictures made them look so good. I decided I give them a try and YES, my pancake was so delicious!!! All you need is one Pancake since they are so huge, I could barely finish the one I had. The bacon was PERFECT. I love good quality bacon and they definitely serve that here at Joe Momma's. I wish the serving of eggs that cake with the meal was more. 

My husband ordered the biscuits and HASH. Warm, delicious and fresh biscuits. He enjoyed his hash meal as well. 

The coffee was great and we never had to ask for refills. We had a great sever who made sure to always check on all her tables. The food was quick and the wait wasn't long. It's a large restaurant with plenty of room for social distancing. 

We would definitely return for the pancake breakfast!

My husband just transferred his CPap support group from one of the major contenders in ID, and he could not be happier.  Before, a call entailed long waits on hold, an in-office visit entailed waiting while staff decided when and if to talk with us.
   CPap Now, Boise office, recommended to us by the sleep clinic as responsive, has exceeded our expectations.  In fact five days after an office visit the technician Kara called, as promised, to see how the new equipment is doing.  Prior to this visit, our former tech who has transferred to a new location within the company called to get us set up with her replacement.  Jamie spent as much time as needed to answer our questions and get us transferred.
   The front desk staff are friendly, helpful and ensure that you have a good experience with them as well. 
   All these companies receive Medicare reimbursement, but CPap acts more like a private company wanting to earn your business. I hope some of the earlier reviews about inaccurate billing has been solved, because it has not been our experience.
    I highly recommend CPap Now - efficient, helpful, caring and knowledgeable.

We ordered 2 personal pizzas and a small order of baked spaghetti and meatballs. The food arrived within the time quoted and it had a good flavor. Except for one of the personal pizzas, which was basically crust and sauce. The slices of green bell pepper were also too thick for a pizza that's size.

The reason why this location lost two stars was because of Molly, who was the employee who took my delivery order. Everything was going smoothly or pretty standard for Smokey Mountain customer service, until she asked for my card number.  I read off the number, followed by the expiration date and tried to follow it up with the security code. She interrupts me in the middle of my sentence, which would have taken maybe 3 more seconds of her time, to inform me in a rather nasty exasperated tone that she did "NOT need the security code." Excuse me, my mistake... next time I order, from Smokey Mountain I'll make sure to remember that detail so as not to provoke the staff.

This place is AMAZING. They fit me in as a walk in and the masseuse I had, Jenna; was fantastic. She clearly knew what she was doing and used techniques I've only experienced in high-end boujee places. She left me so relaxed and was so sweet. I can't wait to come back!

I feel like a fraud writing this, because I'm not the biggest frozen yogurt fan. Eesh, I know. Un-American. But...I am a big fan of clean, well run, and kind establishments. Zumberri hits all these boxes. 

We needed an evening pick me up, so we hit up the closest dessert place to our house. We were the only customers (Thank goodness..."Hurricane" was on a war path) so we had a great experience. The young lady and man who served us were very kind and helpful. They even helped me locate my keys when "Hurricane" hid them on a high chair in the corner. :-/

This place is a pretty typical set up. You pick your fro-yo flavor, feel overwhelmed by all the topping choices, weight it, pay and enjoy! I'm a simple gal when it comes to ice cream. I mixed cheesecake with chocolate and sprinkled a small amount of kit-kat and drizzled a smidge of fudge. It was nice. My biggest complaint about fro-yo is that it's a bit icey. It was no different at this location. 

My oldest daughter "Hungry" got vanilla (lame) and the grossest concoction of toppings. Sour gummy worms, nerds, rainbow sprinkles, fresh strawberries, boba and whipped cream. Yikes. But according to her it was "the greatest ice cream EVER." So if you trust a 4 year old, feel free to copy her recipe.
The Gelato was so good, the place was very inviting the kids loved it. Great place to get your sweet tooth fix.

This place serves a decent breakfast, however waiting for over 30 min to eat here makes it a negative sotuation. There are better places around that have little to no wait. Use caution here as they will tell you 30min wait and two hours later....even when there isn't a pandemic going on... smart ass.

Terrible. They want you to pay up front... how can you leave a tip???

The lady was turned off by my $8 tip (I should not have left one at all because I'd not received any service)

She then decided to look at her phone the entire time!

How do I know?

Well of course I was face down, but the entire massage was off because she'd start working an area and then stop, she's move the remaining had just a bit while she reached for something. I thought "No way she's messing with her phone." But sure enough, when she left the room to go get a towel to wipe me down...

I looked down by my feet and sure enough... there was her flippin phone!!!!

What a joke! 

Don't go there.

Went here the other day with my husband for lunch. We don't eat out much and had really high hopes for this place. Upon entering the restaurant, I will say it was beautiful inside, clean, and smelled delicious. We were just going to get a burger but the lady told us the Italian beef is what they are known for so we figured why not. I've had a good Italian beef before being from NY and visiting Chicago..this was not even comparable. The photo on the menu had giardiniera on it. Since we were sharing, she convinced us to get the $8.50 jumbo version of the sandwich because "3" wouldn't  be enough" and I am pretty sure the sandwich we got was 3 inches long! It was so pathetic and tiny looking and only had green peppers and shredded provolone on it (which we were charged $1 for even though it should only be $.50). And who uses shredded provolone?! Blasphemy. 
If I am paying $9.50 for a sandwich, it better have more than the basics on it. The beef tasted great so they are doing something right, but the sandwich wasn't enough to fill my 2 year old. It was a total waste of our time and money (neither of which we have a lot of). Coming from an Italian, this is an all-around bad representation of Italian beef and Chicago style food. Go elsewhere.

I love this place! Great food and great, fast service. They are always adding new delicious things to their menu. I recently had their breakfast gyro and it changed my life.  Just a few minutes ago my new friend Victor (What a an awesome dude.) made my son James and I the new Grueben (Just what it sounds like Its a Rueben Gyro. I didn't know that was possible) and it was pure ecstasy. James almost drove off the road and we were parked. Thats how good it was. Five stars I recomend this place to everyone. Go there right now,  you will never be the same. Ask for Victor that dude will treat you right.

Restaurant was maybe a quarter full on a Friday evening.  Not sure how they make any money.  Prices are fair for Mexican.  I had a tamale and it was awesome. Beans were good.  The Mexican rice was pretty awful.  But I usually don't care for that anyway.  My sons chicken quesadilla was looked amazing and it was like $2.59 what a bargain.  The male server was pretty awful.  U would think being the restaurant was so sparse, the wait staff would be very prompt.  Guess not.

We had to take our boxer to All Valley after he was attacked by another dog at a park. We had hoped the blood coming from his ear would stop, but after 3 hours of it dripping, we made the call to go to All Valley at 10pm. Everyone at the center was very nice, we were able to walk right into one of their examination rooms. After the vet stopped the bleeding, bandaged him up, and gave us pain meds, we were escorted to the front desk for payment. **Eeek!** In my past experience, after-hours hospital visits warrant at least $500 bill, but to our surprise the bill was much much less, dare i even say less than $150! Overall, I am happy with their service, their hours (24hrs), and feel their pricing is very fair.
She has really tasty pastries, soups, sandwiches, and desserts. I especially love her Flourless Cake and Chubbies.

What a great little spot!  We stop in not knowing what to expect and we were not disappointed.  Turkey waffle sandwich and chicken bowl -- both so delicious and fresh!!  And the service was amazing!  So friendly!   We will be back soon!

Today was one of the worst days ever, we were forced to put our dog down. I have to say that these folks were awesome. They were beyond slammed but still gave us all in the time in the world to say goodbye. They treated our dog with the utmost love!!
They get 5 stars in my book!! I truly want to thank the doc and her staff. The only negative was trying to understand the technical terms used by the doc. It was like she was telling one of her doctor friends what was going on. Other then that, they were great. I am a bit of a dullard though so it might of been me..

This is a great shop that probably doesn't get enough attention due to their location.  The sandwiches are fantastic, their service is top notch and you have zero reason not to try this place if you live south of 84!  

Everyone has their go to spot for a good sandwich, not arguing that.  However, if you've yet to have the bread here or been greeted by a warm staff who genuinely wants you there, then I dare to say you've experienced one of the best sandwich shops in Meridian.

Stop in, say hi, get a pastrami with coleslaw sandwich and a cup of chowda....you won't regret it!

Do yourself a favor and go to their website and put your name in. There is always a long wait, staff is ok, not the friendliest but not the worst either. Food is good but not consistent and not worth the wait. The first time we went it was great and then it's just been so so, hit and miss since then.

My employer loves to feed us, and I'm so happy someone suggested Paddles Up Poké because I've been wanted to try this place for forever! First off, props go to whoever named the dishes. You got "Sun Valley Ski Bum," "California Invasion," and my favorite, "Eagle Road Rage." Y'all know exactly what they're talking about lol!

I filled up to the Eagle Road Rage (Salmon, Wasabi Shoyu, Seaweed Salad, Cucumber, Jalapeños, Pineapple, Wasabi Cream, Siracha, Chili Flakes) mainly because that name is just too good and it sounded delicous. To make things fun I ordered mine in sushi form. Yeah, a sushi burrito! If you haven't tried this you're missing out. Anyway, it was delicous! I loved it and would definitely order it again. Everything was FRESH and SMOOTH. That poké literally melted in my mouth. And it was rather large. I only ate about half and saved the rest for the trip home. It saved surprisingly well. Only complaint? I think the wasabi cream and sriracha was forgotten because there wasn't much flavor. Thankfully I had my own little bottle of sriracha. If I ordered this again, I'd order a bowl. 

10/10 recommend!

Tuesday, 8/31/2021, I was about to take a road trip and decided I could use a massage before heading out. June Massage Spa was able to take me on short notice. I read some of the reviews online beforehand, many good, some not so much, so wasn't sure what I would get. But I was pleasantly surprised at how good it really was. I selected their 1 hour body massage for $60, paid up front. 

The table was one of those that has a cutout for the face. They had some cushioning to make it comfortable. My masseuse worked my shoulders, arms, back, and legs, both front and back. A little stretching was thrown in on the arms a few times, but not the legs.

My masseuse wore a mask but I was not required to. The actual massage lasted 55 minutes. There was a step-out for a minute a couple of times to get a hot towel to wipe off any excess oil. It would have been nicer if there had been towels heated right there in the room.

After it was over and I was dressed, my masseuse was waiting for me with a tray holding a (very) small cup of water and my choice of hard candy. I decided my tip would be $20, partly because I didn't have change but mostly because they booked me on such short notice and did such a good job with the massage.

I got the name of my masseuse, Lily, as I intend on returning. Next time I think I might try their 90 minute body massage.

Bread was hard and the amount of avocado spread they give you for $80 is ridiculously small. Generally I like Jimmy Johns but this location is not up to par.  When I complained about the amount of avocado they acted like they were doing me a favor by giving me a tiny bit more.

Crunch has a great vibe in it! The staff and managers are very helpful and friendly. Some of the equipment is brand new other is less, but overall it definitely meets the standards of a good gym for the price you pay.
And I love the fact you can always bring in a friend with you.
Definitely recommend.

What an amazing park!?!?!?!  Our son is less than 2 years old (but close) and had an absolute blast!  He climbed, he slid, he ran and he climbed some more.  The two play ground areas have rubber ground so even if he took a digger, he was ok.

The only downside was the volume of older kids running here and there without concern of who they knock into.  BUT, that comes with any play ground.  

I hate to recommend this place and increase foot traffic but my wife decided this is her new favorite park to take our son to.

I got a same day appointment for my 16 year-old who is very particular.  The salon is beautiful and the staff is professional.  My daughter said she felt listened to and got a  great cut.  The cut was $35.00.  A good value. We'll definitely go back.

Melissa Scoran - Colorist and stylist extraordinaire! A true professional who loves her work and clients. Always listens to what you want and does it!!! I have been going to Melissa for 3 years - she is amazing!!! She will be your forever stylist!!!

I worked with Kyle and Jessica to get a counter top installed and they were both fabulous! The whole process was done from picking out stone to installation in less than a month and we love our countertops!! Everyone was friendly and professional. Absolutely recommend Big Wood!
don't go there bad service and waitstaff tried to over charge us. will not be going back again!!! i mean trying to make a extra $15

First things first - BE SURE YOU HAVE A RESERVATION.

I've gone here several times on the weekends and always forget that they take reservations. If you don't have a reservation plan on a 40 - 60 minute wait. They could do a better job of managing the combination of walk-ins and reservations.

The food is consistently good here. Solid American breakfast fare from eggs to omelets and biscuits and gravy to skillets. The menu has a large selection for a breakfast restaurant so you'll be sure to find something you like for sure. Don't expect fancy, this isn't that place. Expect good, home cooking in reasonable quantity.

The service is average. They are very busy and you'll definitely wait for refills and a longer than average wait to get your food once you order. This  is the good and bad about this place. The food is good enough that people want to eat here often but they haven't figured out how to get it out good and fast and that's what keeps me from giving it 5 stars.

The last two times I was there, I ordered eggs sunny side up and they came out medium on the bottom with the yolk thoroughly cooked halfway through.

I'll definitely go back and bring friends but I'll be much more specific in my ordering and I'll be sure I have a reservation.

You can't beat breakfast at Joe Momma's. I love their lemon poppyseed pancakes, their French toast, and my last time there I ordered the chorizo hash at the server's recommendation, and it was A-Mazing. Highly recommend!

The brisket tacos and notorious P.I.G. were amazing! The tacos are advertised as an appetizer but honestly it's like a meal, their so filling! Service was fast. Would definitely recommend if you are looking for a bbq place in treasure valley! I will be back! Plus on Sundays kids eat free!

Well we've been wanting to try this place for breakfast since they took over the old famous Dave's which I was quite disappointed do you want to Boise. Joe mamas always looks crowded when you drive-by on Eagle road and we've heard that it is quite packed with people. Today we went in for a late breakfast/lunch. Not a lot of people so we got a table fairly quick. 10 minutes later we got our waitress, found out they're understaffed and there were far too many tables in that place for the few staff that were there. Breakfast was mediocre at best. My wife had to send her French toast back because it was all cold. My chicken fried steak breakfast was only so-so, eggs cooked on to Heart of a griddle and a flavorless small chicken fried steak, under cooked hashbrowns to boot. I'm usually a regular at Terri's Café in Meridian which I will continue and try and remind myself not to stray again, I have no idea what all the rave was about Joe mamas on Eagle Road. This is not your typical cozy friendly small family breakfast joint, it occupies a giant former restaurant that is way too spread out and unmanageable.

It's OK.  When they first opened they were awful.  I understand they have since got new equipment, however, for the price I'll take Rocket Carwash any day of the week.  Also, I understand they plan on putting another car wash across the street.  I guess these folks like competition.  They are going to get it.  AMEN!

Best sandwich shop I've ever gone to! The bread is delicious and the women that work there are great. They always have my call in orders ready in less than 5 minutes, I truly don't know how they do it! If I could eat here everyday I would.

I heard about Love Joy from several of my local friends on Facebook and had to stop in! We were in town from Pittsburgh and were delighted to see a new ice cream shop in town. There really aren't too many around Meridian, at least that I can remember from living there ten years ago. The shop is suuuuper cute and clean with plenty of places to sit. If I'd known, I would have brought in an old ice cream scoop from my parents house to get a free scoop! What a fun and clever idea! Love joy has tons of fun flavors and something to please everyone. We got the banana cream pie and chocolate peanut butter single cup to share and it did not disappoint! Can't wait to come back next time I'm in town!

I ordered furniture on 2/28/21 and I STILL don't have it! At this point it's come in but they "can't fit me into their delivery schedule" until July 30, 2021!! This is absolutely ridiculous! If I wouldn't have to place an order somewhere else and could buy it and take it home today I'd just cancel the whole thing and get my money back!! 

I was originally supposed to have gotten my furniture at "the end of March or beginning of April" but when DeMeyer never called me in April to schedule delivery called them and was told it was "now on back order" and would be here at the beginning of July. They never even called me when they received notification so I could possibly go somewhere else! They never did call me to schedule delivery fir July so I finally called them AGAIN today and they said they have me down for a the 30th. So were they ever going to call me to let me know that delivery date or were they just gonna call when they were on the way with it?! Oh ya, they SAY they called but 1)There's no record of it on my call logs and 2)Theres no voice mail from them. Forget about making arrangements to be HOME for the delivery!! I finally had to have them deliver the love seat and chair because I had NO FURNITURE WHATSOEVER!  Its beyond me how they stay in business with their lack of customer service! 

But hey, thanks for the great example for my high school business classes of what NOT to do as a business and how to cause a business to fail based simply on the lack of customer service!! There's no way you can tell me they couldn't have made a delivery a PRIORITY when the customer has been waiting for FIVE MONTHS!!

Ice cream is all I want to eat during this insane heat. Seriously, I could eat it for breakfast, lunch, dinner and in between. And yes, it could all be from Lovejoy's.

To begin, I love the shop's name. The owners are one-thousand percent passionate about spreading both love and joy through their product. I've seen several ice-cream shops pop up in recent years, however none bore a name such as Lovejoy's that caught my attention and delight. The name just sounds happy and we could always use a more of that. :) 

On to the goods. The ice cream is made is small batches right in the shop in all kinds of flavors. The first one that will catch your eye is Avocado. I sampled a little and YES, it does taste just like it, albeit I was more in the mood for something nostalgic. I decided to go with a small Butterfinger and dang did I choose GOOD! The ice cream is super creamy and packed with candy pieces and chocolate in every single bite. It was incredibly rich, smooth and refreshing! My size small was more than enough for two servings. It saved very well too. I stuck it in my freezer for 24 hours and it tasted just as great! 

I plan on poppin' into Lovejoy's again very soon to work my way down their huge menu! I recommend you do as well!

We came here visiting for my brother's lacrosse tournament and decided to go to Gloss because we got a $5 off coupon at Big Star. The gals were very personable, but it was the worst manicure my mom and I had ever had. It felt like we were having middle schoolers do it. They did not seem to know what they were doing (we got no hand massage, cuticle treatment, or for our hands). It was also way overpriced in our opinion, $35 for a VERY subpar shellac manicure that was basically just a polish change.

We are new to the area and am happy to have found my children a great dentist. The staff and hygienists were kind and my children have since asked to go back to the dentist because they enjoyed their visit so much.

Darla is the absolute BEST! When I moved here from out of state and was given her name I was hesitant to let anyone new touch my hair, but not only is she friendly, but she even honored the price for a cut and color that my old stylist gave me! She can usually get me in within a week if I call last minute! Love this lady and will follow her if she were to ever leave this place!

Size does matter.  Bigger is not necessarily better.  It is easier to scale down a successful big model than size up a small one to work.  These 'truisms' came to mind as we soldiered through our first - and likely last - meal at Joe Momma's new location in the old Famous Dave's BBQ building which Joe Momma's owners purchased, revamped slightly and opened for business last week.

They have painted inside accents of the eggs and chickens motif of their old location (it in leased space in aging strip mall in Eagle).  But  given they upsized seating by 300% (from just under 90 to almost 290) in this yuuuge building, it seemed as if the mascot-motif should be a cow for the "moovvvvee 'em in to the feed lot" feel of the place.  Nothing worked for us.

I like eateries to evolve so I'm not 'boo-hooing' about change of address.  I seldom went to JM's old location because the waits for a table could be long and other eatery options are plentiful.  I imagine waits will be less long to sit down here, given the tripled number of seats, but everything about this huge space is awkward.  And whether you wait 15 minutes now for a table vs 45 in the old space and then wait 45 minutes now for not-as-ordered food to reach the table since with cattle-call seating of 290-ish capacity neither servers nor kitchen can keep up,it is equally 'tilt' for us.

TIP: May be wisest not to plan for quick work day lunch hour here.

VIBE:  Similar to the Three Blind Men and The Elephant parable, you may have a different view of this space depending on where you sit.  The seating being used for dining in the dark bar is all high top tables too close together and step up booths at walls.  In spite of ADA going on 29 years old, if you have a disabled person in your party, you will not be welcome there.  If you sit in the cavernous main dining room with high timber ceilings and too-bright lighting and manage a table near the fireplace, you may be happier.  Or if you sit in a booth along the walls.  But tables down the center of that room are too tightly spaced for anyone's comfort.  And if your party includes a wheelchair user, passages are too tight for that person with only a table or two in the worst location coming into the space being available. (There's a "thanks for your service - NOT" to a vet in a wheelchair.)

Also 'thumbs down' to the cheap 'mess hall quality' awkward flatware.  And for the distant 'mono quality' sound system playing pop music mix.  And for the table clearing process involving a person carrying big plastic tub around to dump dishes into it...crash, clang...

SERVICE:  Very friendly folks trying hard to cover the too many tables in the too big space.  A long pause between seating and greeting and disconnected food service throughout.  See rest of review for details.

MENU:  On oversized, double sided laminated page and a tad confusing looking but actually not difficult to wade through. New items have been added and old favorites remain.

EATS:  Lackluster experience of not as ordered food and lukewarm dish for one of us.

Something we appreciate about JM's is Benedicts are offered in half portions.  For which we always order the eggs "poached hard as golf balls".  I the old location the kitchen always got this right.  So we each ordered half-Bennies here.  Alas, not so good for eggs outcome.  With no way to fix it.

Because after a long-ish wait a runner arrived at our booth to 'auction off' our dishes.  "Who gets Carnitas Bennie?"  Answer "He does".   With "OK" as response the plates - his warm, mine not - were plopped on the table.  Our very nice server was busy somewhere in the huge space but nowhere in sight so we went ahead to eat around the eggs.

In a medium-ish while she arrived to check on us but we were half-ish finished with the food.  The revelation the eggs were wrong was met with sincere "Oh sorry...".  A phrase we also heard the hostess say to folks walking out as well when she asked "How was everything..." with negative feedback offered by some.

This was in essence 'soft opening' week.  So hiccups are expected.   But my instinct is this place is just too big for them to get it right.

BOOZE IS A PLUS?:  Although JM remains a breakfast into lunch hour eatery with "Breakfast"  embedded in name and hours no later than 2:30, JM's owners acquired a full liquor license when they bought the Dave's building.  (Given how difficult it is to sell behemouth sized old chain restaurant spaces, Dave's building owners may have been eager to offer the license to sweeten a sale).  So for those who really must have alcohol with breakfast or lunch, you can get a bloody Mary or mimosa or beer or shot of Makers or anything else.  (They don't start pouring hard stuff until 10:00 per state liquor control rules.)  Given we'd heard "multiple flavors" of mimosas touted, we each ordered one - cranberry for him, raspberry for me - with lunch.  Marginal even at $4 price.

VALUE:  Two Half Bennies + 2 Mimosas = @$25.  Good value.

I stopped attending this dentist office as the staff was rude.  My husband continued to attend for a couple more years (until 2009) until the treatment plan he started had ended.  He made payments to them as he went through the plan.  We thought we had paid them what we owed them by the end of the treatement.  Then all the sudden four years later, I start getting contacted by Bonneville collections demanding money that I owe Willow Tree Dental from 2009.  I am completely floored.  We have never received any correspondence from then asking for payment, so we had no idea.  Now we are receiving rude and insulting letters from a collection agency, when Willow Tree could have made their own attempt and I would have paid.  I do not find them to be proffessional (from my experiences in their offices) and do not recommend them to anyone one looking for a kind and caring dentist office.  For as much as you pay for Denistry, you should be able to expect to be treated with dignity and respect.

I've only been at this Kona Grill maybe a couple of times. It's so difficult to get in. My meal was great but it's so loud, can't even have a decent conversation. You need a reservation, every time. If you want to eat here make sure to make a reservation.
Absolutely love coming here. They always do a great job. They don't just try to throw you through.

How is it that I'm just now discovering this place? I mean, I've only driven past it well over a hundred times since it opened.

If you're local (or visiting for that matter) to the Boise / Meridian area, you need to check this out...

Lots of upscale shopping and you can throw a stone at about 6 attractive eateries from the seats surrounding the fountain.

Speaking of the fountain, there's a fountain show synchronized to music every hour. Really cool. Especially on a hot day, if the wind is just right, you might get cooled off by the mist.

There's evening concerts every Friday in the summer. And the cinema has 5-dollar movies every Tuesday, all day, all ages.

And if you're on a date, this can be quite a classy destination if you plan it right.

This is still a fledgling complex, so new stores are opening up every couple of months or so... a great reason to come back.

I ordered a rain coat on line that arrived just in time for a trip.  The double zipper on the rain coat did not work smoothly.  I actually had to step out of it and fumble with the zipper many times before it would release.  I took this item into the store to attempt to exchange it.  The store did not have any rain coats in stock.  I was extremely frustrated because I'm leaving on a trip and now I do not have a rain coat.  The ladies in the store tried really hard to help me, even offering to ship a new one to my hotel.  Unfortunately the associates felt the zipper would probably be the same because of the thin fabric.  I appreciated the help but am still frustrated about the product.  I paid over 200.00 dollars for a rain coat with a zipper that sticks.  I find this product to be poorly made but the service in the store was excellent.

Overheard the Owner in Target today! 
Wow am I glad to have been ease dropping!  Stopped by Bruchi's
to try it out and who was I greeted by but the Owner herself.  These are 
the BEST CheeseSteaks sandwhiches I've ever tasted.  Can't wait to
go back to try all their other menu options!  Wonderfully Delicious!!
It's now our new go to sandwhich resturant!

Debbie S.

First time trying this place. Definitely will be back.  I ordered the mini cinnamon rolls ( very soft, lots of flavor and icing) for thanksgiving breakfast.  I also bought a cherry and apple pie for dessert.  Both pies were delicious and my family agreed, that the pies were better than any bakery in the area!

I used this company after being referred by a neighbor. My excellent experience began with my first phone call to Terry. He was extremely friendly and knowledgeable. Terry had everything in stock and scheduled me for install right away. 
The install was completed quickly, neatly and professionally. 
I would absolutely recommend using Terry and his crew!

these guys are excellent scam artists. they charge 100 bucks to tape your feet, my athletic trainer did that in highschool every game for free, but these clowns make a living off it. Some MA taped my feet up and did it wrong so I ended having blisters on my feet the next day. Since a podiatrist talked to me I got a fee of 170 plus 104 for the foot taping. nice 274 dollar bill that i cannot afford and they wont try to negotiate. real nice people.

This is a great frozen yogurt spot. Nice selection of flavors and toppings. It was also very clean and well stocked when we visited. Employees were friendly and helpful to assist with a sample when asked.
Friendly staff, but really bland sandwiches. The sandwiches don't have any seasoning on them and the bread is kind of hard and not very flavorful either.

So good! Top notch food from an independent business. Highly recommend for unique and healthy foods. Had the Smoked Brisket & Pepper Jack waffle pressed sandwich. Will be back soon for the bowls and noodle soup.

What an unfortunate experience! Thinking folks are just used to subpar food these days. Boise does seem to have an abundance of crappy restaurants and this one tops my list! A rare date night where we intended to spend some hard earned cash turned into a really underwhelming & unpleasant experience.. and man do I hate being disappointed. I've had better sushi from Albertsons! We ordered a variety of expensive rolls that arrived looking like cat food.. not that quality I expect for an $18 roll! The manager responded with a smug "this is one of our most popular items.. I don't understand the problem." The miso soup (a personal favorite I can usually not get enough of) tasted like dirty pond water. An order of TWO potstickers, yes, I said 2 for $3.00! lol. I hate being critical but I work hard for my $ and in the food industry the customer is ALWAYS right, even if you think otherwise as the manager! Serving sushi that looks like it was killed twice IS NOT APPEALING! We drove all the way across town in 6 lanes of 5 o'clock traffic and struggled to find a parking place in the Village (which is a place I detest going) for garbage food! Wont make that mistake again. Ugh Save your money and make your own at home or go downtown to Yoi Tomo! Super disappointed foodies here that won't be going back!
Food is always delicious; I never have a bad dish. Staff is iffy; some servers are amazingly friendly, where some have been a dud. Overall tho, one of my favorite breakfast places!
Simply amazing. Incredibly relaxing, welcoming environment, and excellent techniques. Will definitely go again!

Came here with some clients on a rainy day and enjoyed a great lunch.  This clubhouse is gorgeous with beautiful views of such a well maintained golf course.  We sat by the window and were greeted by a cordial waiter who took excellent care of us.  We ordered some salads and a couple sandwiches and some coffee.  All four of us really enjoyed our lunch, the view and the level of excellence we encountered.  We will definitely be back to try other menu items and their golf courses.  There is a executive course with 9 holes called the Challenge course and their full 18 hole course called the Champion course.  Hopefully will be trying both courses this year.
Really tasty ice cream (the banana cream pie does taste like a frozen banana cream pie -- so good). The environment is inviting and the staff are all quite friendly. Highly recommend.

The food was good.  The server was nice but did not make sure we understood all of the menu options.  Would not turn down an invite to meet friends or family there for a meal but probably wouldn't initiate the choice.

Kona grill has an enjoyable atmosphere, friendly staff and a good selection of drinks and food options. Unfortunately the food was decent but unimpressive and the portion size was slightly smaller than I'd typically eat. The price was excessive as well at around $20-$30 per entree, that is reason enough on its own to deter me from returning. It may be worth a visit if you love seafood but I can't speak to the quality there. Just know it won't be a cheap meal and that there are better options nearby.

How a massive firm like EY decides to use the services of this half-baked, post-WWII era technology using insurance service provider is beyond me. It takes 2 months after MAILING a claim form for Covid PCR testing to get it processed, somehow only a fourth of the claim is processed for refund when there's a federal order for free covid testing. 

When you call, after waiting 20 minutes to speak to customer rep, they take your call back number, go and ask a supervisor for help on my every question (individually), then after 45 minutes the call drops while on hold and you never receive a call back...WTF. Website is outdated, team is clearly poorly trained, and claim forms are mailed to a PO Box with no confirmation of receipt or processing... for months!!! What a joke.

First visit to this restaurant,  what a wonderful evening. From being greeted to the meal. Marshall  took great care of us from the get go.  He made sure we had everything we needed.  Made sure our meal came out to us and said that another member of the staff would bring out our food if wasn't available.  Marshall fit right in with our family, no awkward conversation he was totaly enjoyable.  Made the meal that more enjoyable.  Thank you and we'll  be back. Would recommend this restaurant to any one.

This review is for Dairy Queen only.  I haven't had any experiences with the Stinker Store side of the business, although I do love the green dinosaur! 
I've eaten here a couple of times & haven't reviewed it....I'm not sure why. 
My hubby, my son, & I arrived at DQ around 9pm. We decided to eat at DQ because we don't eat there often therefore we are not familiar with the menu. The lobby area of the restaurant was very clean & well stocked. The tables were all clean, no overflowing garbage can. The employee at the register was patient, friendly, & very helpful.  After ordering I noticed that we were overcharged for substituting fries for onion rings.  I let the cashier know and her manager quickly came over to help. The manager noticed that the overcharge was due to a pricing error in their computer system from corporate.  She apologized multiple times & refunded the overcharge. 
Our food was delivered to our table by the manager and she even apologized again.  As I was handing out food I noticed that one of the burgers was the wrong one.  I notified the cashier and she said that they would fix it immediately & bring the new one out to me. When the new burger was delivered the manager apologized profusely & insisted on giving me 5 coupons for a free Blizzard.
I was really impressed by everyone who worked here.  Were mistakes made??? Yes.  However, they went above & beyond to rectify them.  I will not hesitate to come here again. It's nice to see people who care so much about customer experience.

We have been using Christian Brothers for all of our auto repair needs. They always do a great job. Honest and up front. We recommend them to all of our friends.
A shout out to the Manager, Perry. 
Great guy to work with. Above and beyond.
Great customer service.

Great sale..I bought  2 pair of shoes for my boys..
The staff was very helpful  asking g me I needed help..
They keep the store safe and clean for everyone..
Best BBQ I've ever had! Such good flavors and great selection of BBQ, sandwiches and more. Service was the best. Will be going back for sure!

They forgot my food, then when we went back to go get it, they gave us cold ass food, the manager snipped at my husband for not wearing a mask. Rude management. Cold burrito was in the trash three bites later. So annoyed.

Our truck went through their wash and came out with several large scratches all over the hood and a few on the side panels. We brought it to their attention immediately and they simply said "sorry, you signed a waiver saying we aren't responsible for any damages but we will take your number and tell the owner." So we left and a few days later we spoke to the owner, she too just said, "sorry."
We are 100% positive it happened there and they did absolutely nothing to even try to make it right.
Some time passed and we forgot to cancel our membership. I called and spoke to a gal on the phone and simply said, I'd like to cancel. She asked my name and confirmed our address. Then said ok, you're all set until the billing cycle ends.
That's it.... no questions asked as to why we are canceling, it was maybe a 45 second phone conversation. 
Pretty poor customer service all around. 
We are now new members with another wash and have been very happy with th
It's still just so good, sour dough is delicious. Meat is good quality. And somehow that dang Mayo spread is delicious as all heck.

Completely horrible. My wife and I have a subscription for monthly massages.We call 2 weeks ahead of time to try and get a appointment. Since they know we are members and they already got our money they always say they are booked up for the time we need. I than always call from a different number and say I haven't ever been in before and imagine that.... They have openings! Horrible company. Do your research before going here.

Times have changed. Kona used to be the place to go for Happy Hour. Well, today, my wife and I went in for a Happy Hour experience - sadly, we won't be back. Menu is a fraction of what it used to be. Prices have gone up and service was fair at best. Food was ok but not as good as in past. Check came out to $45 for 2 people with only one drink -glass of wine that used to be on the Happy Hour menu but no longer. Truth is, there are so many better Happy Hour options in the valley - my prediction is that this Kona will be out of business soon. Ungood experience!

I really liked the online reservation process that was recommended. They made a few accommodations for an extra body we had that showed. Food was wonderful and the staff was awesome. The owners are super cool. They always keep it cool in coolsville.

I chose them based on friends' reviews, but I was skeptical because I've NEVER had good luck with carpet cleaners - they either leave it too wet, do t rinse enough and it's soapy, or the smell is crazy strong.  THIS company, however, exceeded my hopes!  VERY clean, dried well, NO soapy film, and NO smell!!  I loved them!!
Decent coffee but tables in lobby are as sticky as a no cover night club. If you want to get a little work done here on a computer, FYI the wi-fi has no internet connection after you connect.
Hashbrowns to die for! They make them crispy! So good with their Eggs Benny! Service is friendly, and quick. i like that you can be put on a waiting list online. Makes it simple!
Meridian needs more places like this! Great atmosphere, friendly staff and plenty for kids to do so they don't get bored while their parents are enjoying a delicious beer!
Best location around. Customer service is amazing. Wash is better then Nampa's locations for sure!!

Joe Momma's is one of my all-time favorite breakfast spots! They have great food, very reasonable prices, a cool atmosphere, and excellent service. They've always been cool about face masks for customers through this COVID silliness, but they just recently also stopped requiring face masks for their EMPLOYEES! Hooray for courageous business owners!

We just had lunch delivered through doordash and it was amazing.  I had the bean burrito and cheese enchilada combo and my daughter had the steak tacos combo.  Both were delish!!  I was very impressed the food came very hot and all of our special requests were followed exactly.  We will defenitly order from them again.
The warranty department is awesome! Katie helped us get a plumber on very short notice.They are very professional and thorough. What a great team!

Wow, just WOW!

Imma cut to the chase on this one, come and eat here! Restaurant is like a log cabin in the middle of the city, super sweet and cozy. Service is great, despite the Covid weirdness. But the food...

Fresh beignets we on the special, so we snagged an order a an appetizer. We got an appetizer or brunch, yes.

My husband orders the chicken fried steak, home fries with a side pancake. To call it a side pancake is beyond hilarious because this is a dinner plate size pancake, lol. The home fries reminded me of homemade pan fried potatoes growing up as a kid, they were perfectly crisp and soft and well seasoned. The chicken fried steak look like a real cut of meat, if you're a CFS eater than you know some resemble a flat tire (though still taste amazing!), but this was beautifully battered and fried and cooked exactly as ordered! 

I ordered the Joe Bennie with home fries. The hollandaise tasted fresh and home made, you know it's good when you get that hint of lemon. The ham was fresh and soft, the eggs Ooooh emmm geee! Then of course you take the extra hollandaise and toss the home fries and you're in fat lady heaven!!!

I been to Kona Grill a few times since I moved to Idaho and I must say that I love it.. It's a great place to have pretty good sushi but the chicken pesto pasta is amazing the lettuce wraps are delish and the mule drinks are by far my favorite... love me sum whiskey...

Mark is awesome...he came here for a flooring issue and ended up showing me how to handle the irrigation, program the sprinklers, handle the vents, what type of sealant is the best for the grout and sinks as well as seasonal maintenance. He's just a great guy who is always willing to help.

Amazing comic and coffee selections! As a local coffee addict, I can pretty much recommend all the drinks they offer.
I also like picking up coffee and something to read while waiting for a table for brunch next door.

Excellent cheesesteak sandwich (I had steak and mushroom). The bread was delicious! It is some of the best sandwich bread in the area. The only downside was they were a little stingy on the meat. The roll was only about 3/4 full.  Overall, an authentic - as authentic as you can get outside of Philly - and tasty cheesesteak.

We came in today and it is a lovely little bakery but unfortunately, the people who work there are incredibly unfriendly and really didn't acknowledge us and then were extremely rude when we decided to not get a coffee since one person thought they had coconut milk and the other one thought they had almond milk. We won't be back

My wife and I + baby were greeted quickly on Tuesday nigh and the wait was brief. Our waiter (forgot his name 12/7 Tuesday night 8:00 pm near the entrance Black short hair heavy set) immaculate service he fired our kids meal quickly and saved our night from headaches. It was the probably the best experience I've had in Idaho.... Now the food was alright my steak was over cooked asked for a medium it came closer to WD.... I'm not one to complain especially if I'm hungry. That waiter will keep us coming back. Thank you
I love this place. They opened a month ago. Everything's new and clean. The atmosphere here is relaxing and the massage was comfortable. Will definitely come back again.

Our laundry room was in desperate need of a facelift, and I knew Big Wood Cabinets was the perfect company to get the job done. During our initial meeting with Mike he was able to plug in the dimensions on his computer and show us several design options to choose from. The showroom also had multiple different door styles available, and I loved being able to see and feel them before making such a big commitment. Everyone we encountered at Big Wood Cabinets was friendly, knowledgeable, and professional. I also loved how they never made us feel like our job was too small since we only needed 3 cabinets in total. We absolutely love our cabinets and could not recommend this company enough! Thank you again!
Massage envy is an amazing! Creep and affordable! See Lori, letesha,Rachel, Tom, Holly, penny, sharla, georgina, lena. chandelle. They Are great! Try them and you wont be disappointed!

Customer service is lacking, employee here rolled her eyes at me when I cancelled my order this morning when they were out of 2/4 of the beverages I ordered. I ordered two snowy mochas and two kids' drinks. A few minutes after ordering one of the employees came and said they were out of snowy mocha and asked if I could do lattes instead, to which I said no and proceeded to tell them to cancel my order. The employee quickly retorted that they were out of snowy mochas at all
locations. If they had known this initially, why wasn't it specified at the beginning?! Don't just assume a latte will be happily accepted.  I will likely never be back to this location because of this poor interaction.

The museum is neat but it was soo crowded when we went. Because of the set up it felt very congested in most areas, at least that day. I think there are some better "play places" around, even though this is considered a "play place". The staff was not very kid friendly which is probably why I'm not considering returning. I did want to check out our first Children's museum, maybe in the summer when there is more outside exhibits I'll try again.

I don't like to write bad reviews, but the whole time we were eating here we kept asking ourselves "why is this place rated so high?".  To be fair, we only had waffle sandwiches so we cannot comment on any of the other menu items, other than the water, which tasted like dirt.  The waffles were awful and the brisket and other meats tasted funky.  It's too bad, we really wanted to like this place.
I have to agree with another review on here that it definitely doesn't look like the pictures they advertise, but they still taste great!!!
Amazing, fresh, authentic. I can't say enough about this place definitely a hidden gem but so happy I found it! Highly recommend worth the drive from Boise!!!

Food is good, online check in is HORRIBLE! We checked in online with a party and waited 20 min before heading into the restaurant. We got into the restaurant and waited for another 45 min. So over an hour total wait. 
Another party of 6 came and checked in and got seated within 30 min!!!!! 
The shift management was rude as well, definitely not coming back

I love this coffee shop!  The employees are nice & friendly, but not overly so like some of the other coffee places in town.  They are extremely quick at getting people through the drive through, yet you don't feel rushed along when you do finally place your order.  I like the variety of drink options they have on the menu as well.  The classics we all know & love as well as a bunch of fun specialty drinks that are fun to try!
Long wait for mediocre food better places to go for a whole lot cheaper. At least the people are nice.

NEVER bring your vehicle here. They ripped up the interior of my truck, made the window come off track, and they couldn't fix it right the first time so it had to stay an extra two weeks. Overall meridian automotive cannot be trusted and you should never ever bring your vehicle to this place unless you want it screwed up!

I tried the Henna Brows that they offer here and LOVE the results! I had never heard of this kind of brow darkener and wanted to try it out. The owner, Pam, is the one who did them and she was REALLY cool! You could tell she knew exactly what she was doing and the salon was super cute and clean. Will definitely be back to try more services.

Cutest little bakery!  I bought a cinnamon roll, sticky pecan bun (they also have a sticky sliced almond bun!) and cup of chocolate chip toffee edible cookie dough.  The bread of the roll and bun was light and fluffy with the perfect chew.  The cinnamon roll was heavily frosted with a very light and creamy cream cheese frosting.  
I thought the pricing was a bargain.  They offered to warm up the rolls which was nice (but they taste great room temp too).  The edible cookie dough came chilled but I loved it best after it had come to room temp!

We are new to the area and decided to stop into Joe Mommas for breakfast, this is where all the "Joe Momma jokes stop" because breakfast was absolutely terrible.


We ordered:

California eggs Benedict with homestyle potatoes - Homestyle were good, crispy and actually seasoned. The Benedict.... absolutely terrible. Their homemade  hollandaise was thin and without zero flavor, none. It was just a yellow liquid barley clinging to the eggs. The eggs, just poached enough to hold together. Whites and all with the yoke not even warm.
