Biscuits and Gravy - for fuck sake why are we still eating glue paste sausage gravy like we are still in the Great Depression? Tasteless, glue like and just terrible, covering these poor biscuits that are not even toasted.

This is a common theme of boomer restaurants, no taste no care just shove out food and have people shovel it into their faces.

Only reason for the two start review is the service was great, I'm sorry you're servers have to put up with that lack of quality of food.

Cheers to you, Joe Mommas.

I'm a little late for the hot yoga craze, but after many months of hemming and hawing, I finally decided to sign up for classes with Essential Yoga. There are TONS of hot yoga classes in the Valley now. Several years ago I took a total of two Bikram yoga classes. From what I remember, they were incredibly hard to get through, our water breaks were regulated, it was hot as Hades, and we were highly discouraged from leaving the room. I knew I didn't want to go back to Bikram but I wasn't sure where to go in the Valley until a friend told me about Essential Yoga. 

The first plus for me is that Essential Hot Yoga is close to my house. And there are four locations: Nampa, Meridian, Glenwood, and Broadway. I can go to whatever location works for me on a given day. Secondly, there are tons of class options. If I don't make a morning class I can easily adjust my schedule to make an afternoon or evening class. One thing I noticed is that they don't have late classes, so you pretty much have to commit to waking up early or taking a class by 5:30ish. Sorry, night owls!

My very first class at Essential was in Nampa. I was nervous but the teacher that day (shout out to Linda S!) was SO friendly and understanding. The big difference between Essential and the other classes I took years ago is that it is sooooo easy-going. You can drink water whenever you want to. You can leave the room if you need to. You are strongly encouraged to focus on your own body, your own work, your own progress, and not to compare yourself with others around you. You can literally spend the entire class in savasana if you want. In every class we get (more or less) the same script, and this is part of it. Do you. Embrace the progress you are making. Don't compare yourself to that skinny, freakishly flexible person working next to you.

Also in that first class I met some very friendly, outgoing people in the dressing room. They were encouraging, affable, and cool. I don't remember meeting anyone like that at the other studio I went to, where everyone seemed so competitive and self-absorbed.

I signed up for the two week introductory package and tried to go every day. Somewhere around day 4 I had to take a day off to go to the chiropractor. Rather than feeling like I failed, I took a different perspective. I have since discovered that going every day might not work for me, but with every class I learn a little more and am able to do more. It's the first time I've ever felt that yoga - hot or otherwise - might be something I can commit to for awhile, and not just a fad.

I haven't had a bad teacher yet. Each instructor is different, but on the whole I feel like I've encountered some very caring and understanding guides. One big con of the studios for me is that it's sometimes hard to hear because of the acoustics in the room(s). I wish that could be improved, but if you are going for the first time, just make sure you look in the mirror and follow the people near you. One teacher also gave us some valuable advice: If you have any issues or need any help, talk to your teacher beforehand. I have done this - explaining that a part of my body was hurting and asking for modified poses - and my husband has done this (most recently he asked a teacher to watch the position of his feet), and each time we were very happy with the direction and extra attention paid by the teachers in class.

One plus I see about Essential is that yes, it is hot in class. But for some reason it seems more tolerable than the other studio I've been to. Temps are usually between 100-105 degrees with humidity at 40-50%. In the short amount of time I've gone, I've only felt like it was unbearable once, and I think that had to do more with my hydration levels than anything else. If you're new to hot yoga, understand that you basically have to change the way you hydrate yourself. I make sure I stay hydrated all day, so that my body is not in shock when I go to class.

One of the things I've also wondered about is whether it would be a good thing to have more medical information about the students in class. I didn't have to fill out a form that said I had medical issues, and if anything happened to me in class, I wonder how that would be handled. I've read many articles about the benefits and pitfalls of hot yoga, and I know that it's not for everyone. I think this would be good information for students to have when signing up for classes.

Tip: After day 3, you will start to know the flow of class a little more. You may want to move back from the front if that's the case. The teachers don't necessarily do every pose in class, but if you situate yourself towards the back of the room (which means you won't necessarily be near a mirror or be able to see yourself as well), you may be able to see and hear the teachers a bit better, as they tend to hang out in the rear quite a bit more. Sometimes they will demonstrate poses near you, which is a huge plus.

Had a good experience with Meridian Vision. Dr. Hogg and his reception team took good care of me and the process for getting the eye exam and contacts exam was simple. My bill for my vision and contacts exam came out to be much cheaper than what I was paying from my last optometrist. Even my daily contacts for the year came out to be hundreds of dollars less than my last prescription. Overall happy with my experience with Meridian Vision and highly recommend them for your optometry needs.

Best Poke Bowls that we tried in town. Very flavorful and fresh. Very knowledgeable and friendly service. The guy answered all our questions in a professional and friendly manner without looking annoyed. Prices are great. We are definitely going back.

Kasey was so helpful, we'd had another company double book us and we found out at 1030pm. Kasey found us a place quickly which was such a blessing after driving all day with a newborn, 2 kids and a dog. The home was immaculate and so cute. It had everything we needed! My daughters loved sleeping in the "Paris room."

Fine doctors and staff.

Unprofessional and inaccurate BILLING! 
Sent in check payments for two different service dates. Instead of applying the payments to the service dates written on the check, they created new "unassigned payments" and showing I still owed the same amounts for the medical visits. 
I EVEN GOT A CALL FOR HAVING A HIGH BALANCE! since they did not apply the payments to the bills. 
These kind of practices can ruin ones credit reports. So inaccurate!

This review is solely regarding the gunsmithing services available at this business.
I took my rifle and custom stock to their gunsmith, to have the action bedded and barrel floated. After waiting nearly two months I got my rifle back. The barrel was not properly floated and was contacting the barrel on the left side. I had to finish floating the barrel myself. My brand new Boyd stock has two sizeable dings on the sides. I won't be using their gunsmithing services again.

Wonderful service, great food. Such good people and patrons around us. We got the Idaho nachos, amazing. Loved the fact that the fries stayed crispy and not soggy under the delicious topics. As for the bbq - the brisket, jalapeño cheddar sausage and chicken we tried were awesome. The Mac-n-cheese with bacon is great as is the potato salad with the dill pickle & egg for our sides. SO good. Plus, there are lots of tv's to watch games and lots of good draft beer plus great appetizer options. Highly recommend.

First time Monday I thought this is fantastic!  Took a long time to get food but it was quite busy.  Came back Wednesday because I kept thinking of Monday it took even longer for food to come terrible!!!  I ordered the same thing!  The meat was like jerky cooked so long.  I called the waitress over and told her the vast difference between Monday and Wednesday she got irritated and grabbed my whole plate and stalked off.  No I'm so sorry or even a oh no let me take care of it.  Everyone else at the table finished their meals.  Mine arrived back it was much better meat but the crostini was so hard I couldn't cut or chew.  I was so disappointed Monday was so great and Wednesday so terrible.  I'm going back and forth whether to give another chance that I could get the Monday experience again.

We have been going to this place since the day it first opened and it's only gotten worse. If you want amazing sushi for great prices go to Sakana on eagle rd... if you want overpriced subpar sushi in a convenient location.. come to Kona. They have kids menus but they don't have crayons or coloring paper- I don't know why I always forget this piece of information. It's honestly a restaurant you can cross off of your bucket list. I am kicking myself for sitting through yet another hour of this place. It always seems like a good idea, but we never leave satisfied.

This was a great international experience. Everything seem to be original recipes made in house. Amazing flavors fresh food interesting textures. It was hard to decide as there were two or three things for each of us that were very interesting. We will definitely be back to try other selections.
Big tasty portions.  Good coffee.  Fine service.  Loved my plate sized pancake.  Will become a regular patron.

So rarely am I blown away by a restaurant dish. But I got the cilantro like chicken when dining with my husband one random weekday afternoon, and I must say, WOW. It was one of their gluten-free options, which I needed, and I've never had rice taste so good! It was also a good portion of food, not too much, not too little. The yogurt sauce that came along with the dish was light and flavorful and I loved it. My husband ordered two sushi rolls, plus a calamari app, and enjoyed them. We came to Kona because it was highly recommended to us by friends, and it did not disappoint. We will be back, and in the mean time, I will be in the kitchen trying to figure out how to make the turmeric rice!

So, my husband is highly allergic to meat. We have gone here over the past 12 months and STRESSED that he is vegetarian, meat allergies. What did we get? 8 out of 12 orders either with meat in it for my meat allergy husband, or plastic tabs from bread loaves or plastic wrap pieces in it, or I got half of what he ordered in his calzone and half of what I ordered in mine...WTF? The very last time after I confronted the manager with "do you really want an ambulance at the door of your restaurant?" And hubby said just give me a Ceasar salad. She had the audacity to charge us for his salad and my meal! DO NOT EAT HERE!!

Great fun! This park is nearby my home and we frequently ride our bikes to enjoy the scenery. As you can see, the pond is quite relaxing and I like to watch the ducks. Many families are out and about enjoying their day, passing the time fishing or throwing horseshoes or playing tennis!  This park offers many different types of activities and has good parking and access. There's so much to do while at Settlers Park, that every trip is a new adventure!

Last year I took my truck in for an oil change and to have my tires filled up. No problem I was told, that would be taken care of in their free multi-point exam.  Fine, just fill up my tires.  It wasn't until I got home that I noticed my tires still looked the same.  Sure enough, they never touched them so I had to drive back and have them fill them up like they said they would.  So today, about a year later I need to replace my valve cover gaskets, a simple straightforward process.  I told them I'd do it myself but it's too cold.  They asked me if I have an oil leak and I said yes, it's coming from the valve cover gasket.  Well, we need to charge you $119 for a leak check.  I balked and he said he was mistaken, it's only $59 for a leak check and it doesn't go towards the work I want done.  I said I don't need nor want a leak check, just replace my valve cover gaskets.  No can do, I can pay for a leak check or go elsewhere and that's what I did.  Never going back, even though I have to go further to another mechanic but at least they don't argue with me as to what I would like done and they do what they promise to do.

I have driven by this place on numerous occasions.  I read a review the other day and decided to try it.  The staff was very nice, the restaurant was clean.  I ordered the bacon cheeseburger and a large fry.

The food was great and the prices were reasonable.  The meat was tender and juicy, the fries were crispy, the bread was fresh.  I will definitely be back, and will try other items on the menu.

I have gotten the turkey  submarine to go and it was excellent.  Today I stopped in and had the french dip.  This was also excellent.  Very tender  and juicy.  The staff was polite and very nice.  I recommend this place to anyone.

OMG! My new addiction!  Love the new restaurant and menu! They are going to outgrow this new place quickly I can already tell. 
Haus is a great guy and his wife is a sweet heart!

Love Kona- I almost always get sushi or the chop salad .. tonight I got Churrasco steak, garlic mash and almond green beans .. it was fantastic .. their cocktails are always on point. It was busy but my date and I found the last two open seats at the sushi bar .. let me TELL you about this carrot cake tho - outstanding and I'm very picky when it comes to cakes and pasties - best carrot cake I've ever had without question. Will def have again..
I got my credit card bill - the charges were NOT credited. This place is awful. Now I have to file a dispute. Do  yourself a favor and avoid this hole.

Really wanted to help a local business around my town.. but honestly these guys are unprofessional and way over priced for what they are. Frames cost an arm and a leg and even with insurance it's costly. Regardless don't go here for frames or lens, America's best will take care of you for half the price. I've walked out of Meridian Vision twice within the month upset and irritated. Not worth the time
This place is incredible! Every flavor of gelato I tried was amazing. My favorites were lemon cookie and huckleberry cheesecake. Good service. Great gelato.

This is my first review during the Pandemic.   It's been a strange and different world for everyone. Dining out was always something to look forward to at least for me and my family. Now, dining out requires a little more homework. 

Are they open? 
Is it only takeout or is Dine In available?
Limited menu? 
Cash only or is there contactless payment? 

It can be a challenge but take a deep breathe and engage either through Yelp or other online platforms.  I did a quick search on Yelp
and found the Gyro Shack on Fairview in close proximity.  

While times are challenging our dining party can be a challenge to any restaurant.   We have one vegetarian, one vegan and a picky teenage omnivore. Our dining choice needs to be able to safely accommodate everyone. 

We pulled up to the Fairview location, parked and I put on my mask.  I saw that there were cars in the drive thru but no one was sitting outside in the patio area.  I approached the front window from a distance and simply only asked if we could eat in the patio. The employee greeted me and gave me a friendly, " Sure ". While I couldn't see her smile, I could hear it and that was all I needed.  

The rest of my dining party joined me at the table with our masks and sanitizer and we reviewed the menu.  

The Falafel Pita drew my immediate attention sans Tzatziki sauce.  My wife wanted a BLT pita sans bacon and our son wanted the same but with extra bacon.  

The employee asked if we were ready to order and I proceeded with our complicated and substituted order. 

She and the rest of the team were very accommodating and were had no issues with ensuring our requests were met to delight.  

Hidden Gem Note:  Theres an Extra Menu - Make sure not to overlook that. While I did not want Feta or Tzatziki sauce, I did want to add Kalamata olives, cucumbers, and pepperonis,  

Any of the pitas can be ordered as a combo or just the pita by themselves. 

The sides that we chose were Fries and a Greek Salad with no Feta and Vinaigrette dressing on the side. 

My Falafel pita was enormous and it came with three Falafels. While they were a dark brown to black on the outside, they were soft, tasty and picture perfect green inside. 

My hummus was good. Creamy but not liquid like. The rest of the veggie selection were fresh.  The stars were Kalamata olives.  They were so exquisite especially since there were no pits. 

All of our individual orders were made correctly and our dining party enjoyed our first meal at a restaurant in the patio area in more than 90 days. 

FOLLOW-UP

A week later, I returned through the drive thru and enjoyed my second Falafel pita " veganized " and it was just like the first.  Fresh, Tasty and Enormous.  

Thanks Gyro Shack for giving our kitchen a break and we appreciate you and your staff working and dealing with all of us.

Was super friendly,  came over later in the day (6:30ish). Robert (I think was his name!) answered questions readily and intelligently.
 
Receptionist to book the appointment was helpful and friendly.  Easy peasy! 

Definitely use and refer them again!

We had a great experience here when our vet was too busy to fit my geriatric fur baby in when she was in distress.
Within minutes she was triaged and on oxygen.  They kept us in the loop and allowed us to make the decisions.
Ultimately, they gave us 36 extra hours with our girl to say goodbye.
I could not have asked for more caring and personal service when the time came to let her go.
Not cheap, but everything was explained to us an completely our choice.  The last hours with her were priceless.

Stopped by the store in Meridian to pick up a Boise State flag. Even though they were closed today (Labor Day), the young lady who was there let me in and helped me find the flag I was looking for. The price was good, the service was top notch and I will be a repeat customer.
Great breakfast spot. Make sure you are hungry because their friendly staff will make sure you have great portions of delicious food!

Super fun golf course along with great driving range and restaurant.  I enjoy overlooking the lake driving range when having a drink or bite to eat in their restaurant.  A pleasure to visit and thoroughly enjoy every visit.
This place was average. The waitress was pretty scattered... You get what you pay for.

Randomly found these guys on my instagram feed, what a great shop! Asked them if they had an item I wanted in stock late at night, they responded quickly and within a few days my item was here! Great pricing too by the way! Awesome communication! Wish I lived locally to stop by in person. Thanks again !

I love this place. They are alway busy but efficient and let you put yourself on the waitlist online. They have great menu as well. The stuffed French toast is amazing! I also love the flights of mimosas they offer. Definitely my over all favorite breakfast place.

New to the area and referred to Mecca by a friend. I am from California and have trained at multiple gyms through the Bay Area. I was very impressed with the equipment and cleanliness in Mecca. 

There was some leg equipment I have only dreamed of training on. Only seen it online and there it is. Really helped me on getting a good leg workout while recovering from shoulder surgery. 

After being unable to train for over a year, Mecca was the right call to get back on track. The staff was very friendly and professional. Seeing the other members inside, you know fitness is taken serious here. Just what I needed!

09.24.21 - 7:00am - I am so disappointed in the quality of the food I received this morning. I had always tried to order the Chicken Fried Steak and I got more coating than I did steak the Crust was really hard and pulled away from the steak when I stated to cut it. I liked them more when they had the smaller restaurant down my Eagle and State St.

I will definitely think twice to ever come back to Joe Mama's again
Thank you for an amazing morning that we spent with our almost 3 year old granddaughter!!!! Your exhibits and layout are great!!!! Wish we lived closer to be able to visit again. What a GEM!!!
Love the food here! Delicious and super cheap. Customer service is always great though a little slow.

Just ordered for the first time! And man!! This could have not been any perfect for someone craving good bbq food. The wings are the best I've ever tasted!! The potato salad and beans are so bomb!! And the turkey and chicken delicious! Will be ordering again very soon

Really disappointed. 

I went here for a few custom things and they did a poor job. They told me they could build me an exhaust system, I towed my car to them and then after delivery, they decided they didn't want to do it. I then paid for a tow truck to Ammerman's custom exhaust where I had a great custom exhaust made.

Had an awesome foodie friend send me here. All I can say is Hello Big Daddy!! We have frequented several other BBQ establishments in the area. I said to my husband 'I think I have found a new favorite!' 

Friday at 11:30 we drove over and the place was starting to fill up with other hungry folks. Diet Coke in hand, I scanned the menu and we asked for suggestions since it was our first time. 

The Brisket Meatloaf Sandwich spoke to me. Topped with grilled onions, sweet bbq sauce, Gouda and served on grilled sourdough with a side of crispy fries. There is something about melty Gouda cheese. I would order this again in a heartbeat...except there are so many other options here!! Also had a side of the smoked green beans. Delicious. 

Big Daddy Sandwich had a spicy sausage, pulled pork and brisket on a roll. My only criticism, and I'm stretching for it, I'd like to see the sausage sliced lengthwise, so as to be able to enjoy it a little more with the other two meats piled on top of it. So much meat in this one sandwich. It was excellent. 

Tri Tip is a BBQ staple in our home. It's one of our favorite cuts. This meat was perfectly smoked and sitting next to two sides of your choice; beans and garlic mashed potatoes. Finish the plate with a roll and there you have it. 

VIOLA...lunch really couldn't have been better. I cannot wait for my next visit. We spent about $50 for our three meals and sodas. After looking through the menu, I think we maybe should have tried the family platter. I think there were six or seven meats and a couple sides. Would have been great for the first visit to sample all the meats they smoke in house...especially since it was the same price. Maybe next time!!

Sometimes you get your hair done and feel meh, other times you get your hair done and feel AMAZING!! I cannot say enough great things about the owner, Sarah Kelly. She is so professional, efficient, and knowledgeable! She seriously knows how to solve any hair problem. She always puts the client first and it shows in her work ethic! Super happy I found her salon!

Honest and great customer service I will be back! 
  
Got quoted extra to take off existing tent and when I came to pickup my truck they didn't charge me the extra because he claimed it was easy to get off.

Our dog, Labradoodlesaurus Rex was tragically hit by a car last night on Meridian Road. The Good Samaritan who saw it happen scooped  him up and rushed him here. 

From my first call to the receptionist through to when my family arrived and talked to the doc the care and compassion provided to us and our furry family member was nothing short of top notch. They did their best to quickly assess and intervene but the damage was too severe. They had him laid on a mat with blankets and even pads under his head. The vet talked with me and my wife so kindly and with personal compassion. The tech hugged our daughter as she cried. The receptionist was so kind to my wife as we checked out. Nothing but 5 stars here. Our family's sincerest thanks that you were here for Rex.

Great indoor range, gun store and they offer a variety of useful classes. I took a Traumatic Injury Response course, it was in it's own large classroom and had a great instructor. 

They have an indoor 100 yard range with cameras at the 100 yard line that you can view on a screen by your shooting bay - so you can zero rifles here with ease. They even have Caldwell Lead Sleds, shooting bags  and other "fancy" gun rests you can use.

You can also rent super amazing guns here that you would most likely never be able to shoot. They even have ammo for all the calibers. I shot a Marlin 1894 Bolt Action in 45-70 and it was a BLAST (pun intended). It's the gun from Jurassic Park that Chris Pratt used to fight off dinosaurs. Almost $2 a bullet, but they were in stock!

They also have an indoor shooting sports competition where you can try your skills competing against others.

I haven't purchased any guns here so I can't comment on that aspect, but as far as gun rentals, classes, competitions and a sweet indoor range I'm a fan.

Due to the downgrade of the menu I gave it five stars. The happy hour menu was what really made this place fantastic. They really cut it down to only select things. Not only that, but the food is in smaller portions and MORE expensive. Example bbq chicken flat bread, we used to get 8 full sized pieces for $7.50. Now, it's $9 and it's 4 full size pieces (cut in halves). The bans roll came in 5 huge pieces, now it's  8 really small pieces. The chocolate brownie used to be so rich and decadent, it is now a really cheap tasting brownie with no fruit on top. I'm really disappointed. I live in California and I was looking to coming back to my favorite restaurant back home. I hope you guys go back to not being so greedy and cheap with your products.

I wanted lunch not a sass fest. We came to Idaho to visit a friend and see the sights not to get rude service and mislabeled food. We order about 6 gyros paid for our food but when they finally handed all our orders they were rude enough to say "next time call ahead" and then shut the drive thru window without even hearing me say "sorry I'm from out of town". Now I don't know if there will be a next time. Then when we finally got to our friends house three of the gyros were mislabeled so we ended up taking a bite of the wrong gyro. That  made my day worse than it was already. I hope by the next time they learn better customer service.

Our experience with premium RV rentals was very unprofessional. Our pick up time was delayed. The RV itself had the following problems. 

Awning lights did not work
Screen door was busted off the track
No blind or screen on back and that track was busted
Bed busted
Hose leaked 

In addition we were told that we could reach out at any point and get help with problems. At one point in the heat of the trip the generator was not working and as much as I texted and called Kasey he never responded. 

I would never go with this company again.
Super cute bar with fabulous drinks and a great patio.  The patio has plenty of seating with a taco truck. The artichoke taco is a must.

I am always bummed to leave less than 4 stars, but the service, food and booze were mediocre at best. My girlfriends and I needed a night out filled with chips, salsa and margaritas. We got it... accompanied by a sassy staff and generic Mexican food. 

I ordered the Chimis de Pollo. The chimis were fine, the rice was ok, the beans were luke warm. Without a doubt the best part was the Habanero Jelly (which should be renamed- it is a sauce, nothing gelatinous about it). I also had a House Margarita, on the rocks with salt. Meh. Clearly made with a mix. But I shouldn't have ordered the house drink. That one's on me. 

We asked for more salsa and were told, "Well you can go get it yourself, you know" and we were rushed to pay our bills and never saw our waiter again. We would have each ordered another drink, but we just received a check instead of a "check-in". 

It was fine. Next time we are looking for spectacular.

I helped my client with his new home purchase using CBH and they were amazing! Easy to work with and eager to help at all costs. They responded quickly even with these unprecedented times. I appreciate them making it easy for our transaction every step of the way. Will happily recommend them to everyone and hope to do business again.

I love this ice cream. Banana cream pie literally tastes like eating a banana cream pie. The scoops might actually be too big, but I'm not really going to complain about it. 

They have swings as chairs and a plethora of flavors to choose from. Creamy, local, and delicious.

Took my dog in on a Sunday for an eye infection and via a call ahead I was told that they should be able to see my dog, even though their priority was emergency care. After arriving I was taken into a waiting room with my dog and after vitals were taken was told the vet would be in shortly. An hour and a half later I left without seeing anyone. While I realize that there may have been emergencies that took priority, nobody checked in with me and the front office staff didn't seem to care that I had waited so long. All I needed was a quick exam and some prescription eyedrops for my dog. If you can't see me in a timely manner, tell me ahead of time so I don't waste time waiting.

They got rid of our vet who was the best for no reason and the idiot they got to replace her didn't even look at my puppy. Just said over and over that they hope to keep our business. I will tell you for having to pay for that trip and losing our amazing vet I refuse to ever go to all valley again. I will tell everyone again and again how horrible they are to work with. All the good office staff left after they got rid of our vet, so that is pretty telling. I hope they clean their act up but I doubt they will.

When we got here there was a little bit of a wait time but not too long; maybe 15 minutes. When we sat done we ordered drinks right a way, then are food. Service was fast and HOT. I enjoyed my brunch. Thank you!!
Very unprofessional service! I got the worst massage ever! The staffs were very rude!

This is the best gun range I've ever been to. They have  Huge selection of firearms anything you can dream of is available . The range was great the instructors Michael and Zane were very knowledgeable and definitely added to our experience. Thank you very much

I came in this evening after my trip to the grocery store right next door. I didn't look at the selections they had available before starting my order, which I guess is my bad. There were maybe a handful of selections to choose from after the chow mein and fried rice, which has never happened to me before lol. They were able to cook anything to order but it would take 5+ minutes wait for it depending on what it was. I asked The employee if I could get one of the available selections for the regular price Considering there was almost nothing to choose from, that was not happening. Don't get me wrong The store was clean and the staff was fairly friendly but look before you order, it will save yourself the wait time.
Best hair salon ever! The owner is beyond amazing and does a fantastic job on hair. I'd recommend Alicia to anyone!

Giving 2 star review for the following reasons:
-Added a service plan to my account without my knowledge.
-Friendly service
-Easy to add a line

I was overall happy with my experience. Super disappointing that the protection plan was added without my knowledge.

Thoroughly enjoyed our breakfast today. Great crispy hash browns, tasty pancakes, a scrumptious Chile omelet.  Due to allergies, I had a request; they willingly fulfilled mThe only thing better was the friendly service. 
Definitely will return. 

Back again, excellent as always!

They say the proof of the pudding is when something goes wrong. Last week my Traeger quit working, I was not happy.

I went in and talked with Danny who has always taken great care of me. He agreed to come out to the house, take a look at the Traeger and let me know what needed to be done.

It turns out that the motor and auger units had broken. Danny told me to contact Traeger support as I would still be under warranty and to send them the pictures to the address that they would give me. I did and Traeger is now sending me a unit with both the auger and the motor, and has authorized Danny to come to my house, repair the unit and let Traeger pick up the labor as well as the cost of the parts and shipping. 

It is a pleasure to work with Legacy Fuel and Feed.  They took good care of me, even when it was me coming to have something fixed. I'll be back.
I love there rolls, crispy veggies every time. Never disappointed, ask for extra eel sauce ! It's amazing here!!

My first time there and I will be back.  I had the shrimp tacos and they were very good.  So many other things I want to try.  I really recommend this place.  My friend had a margarita and she said it was good.

I've been really into spaghetti lately and this was some bomb spaghetti. Big thanks to my waitress Christine for being patient with me and going above and beyond to check if everything was vegan for me!

Honestly while it was nice to have a couples massage with my boyfriend in the room, I was constantly taken out of the ambiance of my massage.
1st the woman who massaged me climbed over me a couple times which made me uncomfortable.
2nd she used a lot of bone and most of this massage hurt even though I consistantly asked for less pressure
3rd and maybe the worst was that she left to answer the phone 2 to 3 times during our hour session.
Overall I would say you get what you pay for. It was fairly cheap for both of us and I didn't expect a quiet room with burning incense but I guess I still expected a little more service than I got.
Bright side the facial massage was very nice!

Cornerstone Property Management is the worst property manager I have ever worked with.  They did not understand the rental market when one of my rentals became vacant resulting in thousands of dollars of lost rent.  They are unresponsive, use their own maintenance company which overcharges, double billed me for expenses, etc.  They are completely incompetent.
The dj was amazing. I enjoyed my sushi rolls while listening to the music I was pleasantly surprised and would love to hear him play again!

My sister and I make the extra time to drive out of our way to eat at this Artic Circle. 
It used to be really good. 
Today, at approximately 4 :30 pm, we pulled into the drive thru. We told the young girl working we had a coupon for $4.99 for the double cheeseburger combo. She should never be allowed to work the drive thru. It took us 4 times to explain our order. 
It was ridiculous!! She still overcharged us a$1
Lol    
She charged us 40 cents for the lime Ricky drink in the combo. When I asked to make my drink a large she would not do it, I said I would pay extra, nope can't do it, because you have a coupon?? And yet, she let my sister get a different drink and charged her the extra forty cents??
It was really crazy    
Our food was cold and sloppy. 
We have decided we can't go back there to eat. 
The time before about 2 months ago, they charged us fifty cents each to have tots instead of frys. Never had done that before? Also charged us fifty cents each for a white sauce. Also charged my sister extra for having a lime Ricky for her drink in the combo meal. 
That should be noted. 
There used to be boys working that drive thru and they were smart, fast and our food was always good and hot!
Never nickled and dimed us...
No worries...really I don't blame the girl, I blame poor management. That's what usually puts a business out of business , poor management. 
Good luck in the future! 
Training is important

My 2 year old lab started freaking out on her right ear. It was 10 pm on sunday night, she seemed to be in a ton of pain. I found all valley on google and gave them a call. They did tell me on the phone it would be $75 .. np.. i have $80 in my account, so I rolled down there (from columbia village I might add). After waiting about an hour, i was finally seen by the vet. Up until this point a tech took my dogs weight and checked her temp.

After the vet came in .. she gave me a slew of things that she could do .. all with a price tag of course. Which is no problem, I mean, I would spend whatever i could to take my dog out of the obvious pain she is in. Unfortunately all I had was the initial $75 that they quoted me on the phone. That being the case, they wouldnt do anything for my dog.

Big waste of time and money. 

I understand companies need to make a profit but that was a bit ridiculous.

Needless to say I went home a bit poorer and my dog got no help what so ever.

I've never been impressed with this place. Don't waste your time or money. You will wait an obscene amount of time for your food and it will be subpar. We have come here every year for my Moms birthday and it's gotten worse and worse.

Went into T Mobile to check out switching from Verizon due to all the hype from there advertising.  I made the change seemed like the thing to do told them I wanted to beat or be equal to my Verizon bill they assured me no prob.  Received the bill then it all started, the bill was over $60.00 a month more so I called there customer service.  I spent over 3 hours on hold and talking to no avail so I went back to Verizon.  Now T Mobile who took my old phone and hot spot will not pay it off to Verizon, so they have my equipment and I am stuck with a $628.00 bill.  There is no transparency no copies of anything or receipts.  As far as I am concerned they stole my equipment by not paying it off nor will they return it.  So I am filing a complaint with the Attorney General's office and the FTC if it fits into there scheme of dishonesty.  All they had to do was honor the amount of the bill and I would not be here.  So buyer beware if it sounds to good, walk away!

I don't normally leave negative reviews but considering the service I received, I'm being too kind. When my order was complete, the girl working literally handed me my food and slammed the window shut. I didn't even get halfway through my "thank you". The food itself was average. I'm from Seattle so I'm accustomed to a higher quality product and something that is more authentic. I might give these guys another try but hopefully someone else will be working.

Updating from 3 stars to 4. Went again, much better service.

I am not a pancake person, I tend to go savory with my breakfast foods, but their options of pancakes called out to me. They have a flight of pancakes!?! I tried the pineapple upside-down and lemon poppyseed pancakes,though you can choose up to 4 different flavors. They were so delicious. The pancakes we the fluffiest ones I have ever had. I just can't get over how fantastic they were.
 The customer service was great. I really enjoyed my dining experience here and will be back soon.

We came there day after they opened they had some bluegrass band warming up with banjos and mandolin.

We got the sampler flights with one of all of their beers on tap. My husband liked their beer, it was a nice atmosphere in their building.
They don't have food but you can bring outside food into there.

We will be back!

Best Eggs Benedict I have ever had, Joe's Bennie! Eggs, perfect. Ham, so much better than normal, thinly sliced and real. English Muffin, perfectly toasted. Hollandaise sauce so yummy but not too rich to over-power the other ingredients. I added a side of avocado for freshness, so glad I did that. And the house potatoes were crispy on the outside and soft in the middle. Very impressed!! Thank you for a delicious meal!

These guys are superstars. Bought an old place with no plans available for the lot. They found it on the second try (yeah, they tried high tech and it was a no-go). Then they had to remove 30 years of crap, literally. Did an awesome job and cleaned up perfectly. There is NO ONE ELSE to call for these services. This is my second time using them and they are now on speed-dial.

So far my only reason for not being able to give a 5 star rating is the little things that have already started to fall apart. But they will be easy fixes and under warranty so still worth 4 stars! Our home buying process was easy, we used our own realtor who worked with the CBH realtor. The final walkthrough was very informational and I really liked how they fixed every thing we pointed out right then and there. A week into our new home and we love it. We were hesitant at first because of hearsay, but overall very happy with our purchase!
best breakfast in boise!! try the chicken fried steak, breakfast burrito and stuffed french toast! bennies are the bomb too, especially the carnitas bennie!!!!!
Mouth watering good barbeque. The mac & cheese is a must side. The ribs are bone sucking good. The brisket is very tender. I will be back for more!

Do NOT go here!!  They've changed ownership, raised prices, and decreased service, and are no longer open 24 hours.  They were great up until sometime in June, or so, this year.  They handled the passing of our beloved German Shepherd dog back in February wonderfully; to the extent that we decided to stop going to our other vet.  Not now.  Am going back to my old vet.  We got a new puppy in early July, this year.  Brought her in for a wellness check to comply with the puppy warranty.  That visit went fine.  Then scheduled appt with Dr Megan Ware for next round of shots for 9AM one morning in mid July.  That went well and Dr Ware is super great.  With Covid restrictions we had to meet in the parking lot and they took our dog inside for her shots.  I couldn't go in.  Went back for next appt 2 days ago (Aug 18) scheduled for 9AM.  Receptionist was nothing but lip service and no action.  Was told to wait in car and they'd be with me "shortly".  At 10:15 I finally got a call that a tech would be out "shortly" to get my dog and take her in for her puppy shots.  Out she came 5 minutes later to get the dog.  Nearly 45 minutes later they called to go over everything and sell me on a number of surgical procedures I had the option of doing when we take her in to be spayed.  That's not in the plan for at least 1- 1/2 years from now, but they had to give me their sales pitch regardless.  When our dog finally came out, they didn't bring any paperwork including her shot record that I had given them to fill out, nor any of the worm, tick, or flea meds I had requested.  So, the tech went back in to get them.  10 min later out she came with them and an invoice for $192. I did not get to see or talk to  Dr Ware whom I had an appt with at 9AM. In fact I saw her leaving the clinic about 9:45AM and was curious as to what was happening.  I never got to talk to any vet on this visit and am not sure our dog really saw one.  The vet techs can give the shots.   I have one more round of shots to do in 3 weeks.  Politically correct receptionist said they are not accepting appts that far out because they don't know the vet's schedule yet.  What?  Three weeks out?  I expressed my extreme dissatisfaction and said thank you and I'll not be back.  Of course they're going to blame their problems on Covid restrictions like many others who are giving poor service and doin't want to own up to it.  Yelp reviews offer many other better veterinarian options for you in this area if you care to do a search for them.

We continue to really appreciate Mark Enger with CBH.  He always goes above and beyond with Home Warranty service.  He always takes the time to answer our questions and really listens to us.  Mark is very knowledgeable about home construction and is one of our favorite CBH people!  Thanks for always taking such good care of our homes Mark!

Almost every employee was either 1) outright refusing to wear a mask (the manager / owner fell into this category) or 2) was wearing their mask incorrectly. Regardless of their personal beliefs about COVID, it was very disappointing to see so much of the staff refusing to follow CDC guidelines, or even just wear it to make their customers feel better.

Of course this was not true of every employee, and Juan was (thankfully) super respectful and an awesome salesperson. Very informative and not at all pushy for sales. Highlight of the experience for sure.

In addition, the manager / owner (same one not even pretending to wear a mask) was reprimanding her employees very loudly in the entrance of the store. Super unprofessional.

As for the furniture (couches in particular) they were a bit too firm for my taste - but that could be preference - overall good selection, if not a bit pricey. And their delay for ordering couches is VERY long at 3-4 months.

It's been at least several years since I've been to this park. We came out for my son's baseball game, and I was so pleasantly surprised!! The park is very clean and maintained! Now they are mature trees throughout the park. The baseball fields are also well maintained and prepared. So wonderful to see such a big improvement in a few years!!!

If we could give zero stars we would. Had to bring our car back on 4 separate occasions... last time was assured multiple times all leaks were fixed. Upon picking our car up, what do ya know, another huge leak. 

A 4th wasted trip and another excuse why it was leaking. More then 24hrs after leaving the car, still no update... and this after was reassured by the owner it will personally be handled. Upon calling, come to find out Perry the service manager had no idea where the part needed was and no clue when it would come in. 

After weeks and multiple broken promises, our last resort was to threaten legal action at which time the service manger told us to come pick the car up and proceeded to hang up. 

After another wasted attempt to call back and speak with the owner, we will now be picking up our car with a significant oil leak... in the end, DO NOT BRING your car to this shop... plenty of other local shops to be trusted... definitely not these imposter mechanics.

My favorite is the mint julep made with Sprite Zero.  Little hard to find but worth it. Just off Overland Road in El Dorado Business Park.  Drive through available around the back, just drive by Dickey's Barbecue Pit and follow the signs.  Have not tried the food yet because I'm there for the soda.

Food is yummy too.  Parlor seating inside and on the sidewalk.

Amazing cheesesteaks! This is my second time here and i had their special of the month for March. The Reuben (hot pastrami with sauerkrout, swiss cheese, 1000 island dressing on roasted rye bread) it was sooooo good! I wish i taken a picture of it before i gulfed it down!

I wish I had gotten it sooner I had to move to Florida and this was the last drink I got I miss the place and I can't wait to go back to Idaho sometime just for this one place who ever opened it should open more around the world it would be the next big hit.

We drove to Idaho and met with my twin sister who was in Idaho on business.  She had been looking at CBH Homes and wanted to show us houses after she had met Teschia Tucakovic.  After trying to look at a house, with no relator, we drove to meet Teschia.  We told her what we were looking for and after looking at one house she suggested a house in a brand new development.  Well, we fell in love with the house, the lot, and the area.  Teschia made it so easy for us because we lived in California and needed to sign documents, arrange a walk-thru, etc..  We've been here since October 31st and have nothing but praise for CBH Homes and its staff.

They need to find out what a real cheesesteak is. It doesnt have swiss cheese to start with. I have been in here three times now, and it is just really disappointing food. Nice building, nice staff, clean, just not very good food at all. A real cheesesteak takes six napkins, and has melted, runny cheese. It has bell peppers and onions, you had to look to see any on this sandwich.

My 3 kids (ages 4 & 2) had a lot of fun at this place. They enjoyed the pretend play and the outdoor play area. 
However, there are a few things I wanted to note in my review. 
1.  $8 admission is not bad, BUT they charge the adults also and not just the kids. This place is obviously made for just the kids so I do not see why adults are being charged. Charging the adults makes it expensive and not worth it. I will not be going back at least for a while. 
2. While I can understand why no food/drinks are allowed I was surprised that I couldn't even bring in water to offer to my kids while they played outside. Water fountains are available but honestly I do not think they are sanitary and are hard to use for the little ones. 
3. Most of the staff we encountered are rude. They do not seem to enjoy their jobs at all. We were at the museum towards the end of the day and I could tell they had started cleaning up and organizing toys already. Whenever we would go to a new "station" a staff member would follow us and watch very closely. It just felt very awkward and I could tell they didn't want us playing with and messing up what they had already organized. Mind you, we still had at least an hour of play when I noticed this. I also made sure we cleaned after ourselves but I just didn't like being followed and watched every minute by something. 
4. While there is definitely a lot of pretend play this place could use some more educational activities for the kids. STEM stations, water station etc...
Belong to Spurwing and find the club and awesome play ground.  Love the golf course and excited about the new practice nine.   The food and service at the club is very good!  I'm glad to be a member.

This place is completely disorganized, confusing, misinformed and completely chaotic. Disgusting lack if communication between Dr.s, office and here. OMG...
I feel that because the severity of my disability I am taken advantage of.
For three weeks I was in severe pain. My Doctor said they sent in the request for the ultrasound. Intermountain said there never a request. I was put into a highly dangerous situation. 
Nobody communicated to each other, not Intermountain with Doctor, or vise versa, I was made to feel completely incorrect, and disregarded 
Dr.s, office said that because Dr. has been so busy that he forgot to enter the order. Three weeks of gut wrenching pain and highly lame apology.
 PRIMARY HEALTH IS FAR MORE ORGANIZED.
In February had 6 major seizures and coded. In Neuro-ICU at St. LUKES. Injury to right knee/leg from violence of seizures.
On April 13th Ultrasound finally ordered asap, on 17th over 36cc taken out of knee. On 17th MRI ordered, over 6 calls/messages with Intermountain over MRI. I get there, no appointment for MRI. BUT, I can make one for an X-ray. O.k. fine. When I looked at X-ray it is beautiful. X-ray's sent to Dr.s, office on April 22 at 4:40, I watched, Dr.office said they never recieved them, again today at 10:15 am, the X-rays are again resent. Again all the confusion and no communication. Medicare and Medicaid/Blue Cross were just as confused by all this.
MONIES WERE WASTED...WASTED BY REPEATED PROCEDURES...WASTED BY INADEQUATE MEDICAL ASSISTANCE.
I had THE smallest margarita in the world, OMG!!! And they took items off the happy hour food menu!!!!  Changes SUCK and taking items away is the worst!!! Good not as good
Horrible experience. I paid $15 for nothing. My car got a little wet that's about it. Might have scratched my hood too. Stay away

This was my first experience at getting a massage and I feel that it was a relaxing experience.  Granted there may be some places that are better and some that are worse, but Golden Massage Spa seems to be a good value for the price.  The woman who gave me my massage read my reactions to the massage and adjusted her pressure accordingly.  It was a calming environment and was nice to relax for an hour.  The hot rocks and hot towel treatment included in the hour long massage were an added surprise.  I will be returning for a 90 minute massage next time.
Top notch here folks. Excellent whiskey selection and a few beers on tap. The antique woodwork and bar are awesome. Bartenders can make anything and the atmosphere is great

First time at this place. Pretty awesome. Felt safe with a range master walking around and checking on everyone. I know it's a pretty new place, but it was clean. Very good layout and seems to be very usable. Keep it up.
I'm not a stickler for covid enforcement knowing how the covid has crushed businesses but it was nice knowing they had a good policy for it. Great food!

Less than impressed... slow service. Incorrect orders. Ordered my burger med well, came raw... someone in my party ordered the tuna raw... came well done. Drink orders were wrong or given to the wrong person. Just not the quality that one would expect.

I completely disagree with the poor rating from Utah. In the last 11 years I have searched high and low to find the right hairdresser for my finicky think unmanageable hair. Once again, I was smiling the day after I got my hair cut and colored by Ginny and I finally think I should tell the world about her!! She is a fabulous cut and colorist. I have no fading, the color is always even, I get compliments everywhere I go, its cool and funky, and the best thing-it is easy for me to maintain and wear! That is the sign of an excellent cut! Often you don't get what you pay for yet Ginny is worth every cent she charges and worth every second I save NOT having to fight my hair.
Mark Enger was super professional and did above  and beyond. So happy with his work. I would recommend him to anybody!!!

Stopped here after getting lunch nearby and I'm glad I did! The flavor options are some of the best I've seen in terms of creativity and diversity. The cheesecake Gelato was very good and the salted caramel was good but not great. The staff was also friendly and helpful. I definitely plan to go again to try other flavors.

We have contacted Taylor several times since we moved into the De Prado tract with requests or just questions.  She is the best!  Our emails or calls were returned promptly in a very pleasant, helpful and professional manner.  Her crew was equally quick to respond.  We have felt very taken care of and appreciate Taylor and her entire support staff!

I had the Roast beef and cheddar sandwich with jalapeño quinoa. Fabulously flavorful sandwich - loved the horseradish aioli!  The quinoa was complex in flavor which was great, although I did end up adding salt. 
I sampled some wonderful scones, but ended up deciding on some pecan sticky buns since I can never find those anywhere.

I could not even get the HR manager to call me back.  

Mindy thank you for all you did to try and help me and then did do something to try and make it right.   I am very thankful for all you did and for your caring heart!   She is a 5 star employee.

Not sure what was going on with Twigs on Saturday 4-10 but the wheels fell off fast and hard. From our arrival to departing 2 hrs later, not one thing went well. Not sure if it's new mgr or what but a lot of issues that need to be addressed before we come back.
The place was filled with smoke? Large doors opened and cold air pouring in.
It took 20 mins from the time we sat down to get water?
We finally flagged down our absent server and we decided to order everything at one time as we saw numerous people getting impatient with food delivery. Well that didn't work! Our appetizer NEVER arrived, our food finally showed up and sadly both our orders of halibut were over cooked? Spilled dressing on the table, no water refills (computers were down, someone used all the hot water etc) we were then told that we would be given a free dessert. Then what appeared to be a leader comes by and says "your food is 50% off tonight" while that was nice, we came for a nice evening of good food. So all that being said, I don't believe we will be back for quite a while. Hope you get things back on track soon. We don't need more disappointing dinner options. Best of luck!
Love be the pineapple upside down pancakes and Marion-berry jam is so yummy.  Great service and very friendly place.

I went to So Posh Spa because they ran an Amazon Local Deal for half price services recently. First, when I called to make my appointment, the woman on the phone was rushed, did not give her name, and did not tell me who would be my stylist for my haircut. When I arrived for a 4:30 pm appointment, I walked into the salon expecting a clean, modern look, because the name implies a more upscale spa/salon experience. The decor was very dated, and almost homey, and I noticed hair on the magazine race, the rug, and some left on the broom after the other stylists swept up. The stylist who was going to cut my hair was with another client, and I was told to have a seat in the waiting area, and that Patti would just be a few more minutes. It was 5:02 pm when she was finally ready to cut my hair. I realize that sometimes people get behind, and I was ready to chalk it up to that after I was taken to the shampoo bowl. After discussing what to do for my cut, I realized that the stylist was inexperienced. She asked me more questions about "How should we cut this section?" and " Are you wanting to keep the length, because I think that would be easier to just trim up the split ends?" My hair was just about dry by the time my cut was finished, so I didn't get my style. The stylist handed me the mirror to look at the back of the haircut, and she said she still hadn't bought a bigger mirror; this one is the one she had from beauty school. The haircut is a decent cut. It does look acceptable, but it doesn't compare to the haircuts I have received from other area salons in the past, from experienced stylists. My advice to someone else looking for a more "Posh" spa/salon experience, is to go to one of the modern salons in downtown Boise. I hate when my time is wasted, because I value my time, and I want an experienced stylist who knows what to do without asking a lot of questions. I didn't feel like a million dollars when I left So Posh Spa, and I want that feeling when I make a trip to the salon/spa, especially since I am not one of those women who go in for "maintenance haircuts." I get my hair cut once or twice a year, so it has to be awesome each time.

The most expensive auto repair shop you can go to.  More expensive than dealer prices for repairs.  Very sad.  Simple fluid replacements for differential and transfer case were double the price that a dealer charges and even a drive through oil change shop charges.  Very nice people, they're very polite but I will NEVER go there again.
They have me a shot from a nurse that didn't know what she was doing it hot my bone and my arm was in a lot of pain for a week
plan ahead there is always a wait but they have something for literally everyone in the family. take advantage of their virtual waiting list it rocks!

The space that this coffee shop in is super cute and cozy. The perfect place to escape the cold for a bit and take a break from shopping. I got the iced vanilla latte. It was very delicious and the espresso was the perfect amount of bitterness with the vanilla. Staff was friendly, definitely enjoyed what I ordered and the space. I definitely recommend coming here!

I've lived in Boise for three years and never knew we had this awesome location here in Meridian! It's absolutely stunning, they have an amazing staff and they're all about the Second Amendment! If you're looking to enjoy some indoor shooting this is the place!
Eaten here three times now.  Food is good and service is adequate.  Kind of pricey but everything at the Village is.

I don't buy physical comic books anymore, but the coffee here is cool and it has an East Coast Midtown comics vibe when you walk in! The themed drinks are cool! I think they use local roasted Dawson Taylor coffee as well which is really good.
Everything is so yummy! Never disappointed. With the new expansion service is much faster. My only previous issue.

I'm blown away with every flavor I've tried. They've masterfully crafted each one and only wish they had more because they run out so quickly on the best options. Do not hesitate to indulge in this place!

Another great evening. ..still very impressed with food and service.  Still sat outside with clients that had never been to the Village. Everyone thrilled with food including the Gluten Free menu (one member of party,  this was very important!!) For dessert we had the Sticky Cookie...yummmm! (Ok,  one in party had gluten free and still very happy with it)

We lived in the Magic Beach House on Oahu's north shore for 4 months in the fall of 2021. Overall, the house was very nice. The view is beautiful. The AC worked great, which was awesome. The beds were comfortable. The kitchen had most of what we needed and everything was clean when we arrived (although we couldn't check in on time because the maid was there for 2 hours past the check in time). It's a great place to stay on the north shore with a couple of caveats.

1) It's right on the main road. Invest in earplugs.

2) There is a leak in the master bedroom, over the right side of the bed. The owner was aware of the leak before we moved in (end of August). He called it a "small leak." Every time it rained, there was a shower over the bed. I went through a ton of beach towels trying to keep things dry. I notified the owner that we would need this issue to be fixed, especially before my partner came out to join me when we would need both sides of the bed. Despite MANY texts and calls and promises, the roofers did not show up until mid-October. Watching what they were doing, I could tell they were not fixing the problem. I let the owner know. Sure enough, with the next rain the shower was back. I let the owner know. The roofers never came out again, and the owner never offered to make things right. Luckily, we got a dry spell for a while, but in December we had a massive storm and my partner had to choose between a wet mattress or the couch. Not cool.

3) I had trouble getting the owner to respond to my texts and calls about the leak. However, when I had my partner contact him, he responded right away.  (I am female, my partner is male.) So if you want a response from the owner, maybe use a man's name?

This place was mostly good to us, but I would not stay here again.

Liked this place a lot. We had a great server. Can't remember his name (apology) he was an older gentleman and was working extra to put his daughter through college. Very nice and guy and very informative. Food and beer was great. Very good atmosphere.

This is my 3rd time at Twigs. My 1st visit was a few months ago. They had a Roasted Garlic Burger that was really good. Unfortunately, it must not have been popular enough and poofed from the menu.

I was sad to see it go, but I have to bow to the popular vote. The 2nd visit here was just a few days ago. I came here with my wife and her boss. I had the signature burger and....Wait for it...was blown away!

For any of you that follows me and knows me, you will know I don't say this sort of thing lightly. I am a burger connoisseur . I love me a good burger as I assume most of you do. I hate sub standard burgers and Im hard on the reviews of places that claim to have good ones but some up short.

Im not a fan of burger cooked on the flat top. I prefer a good smoky grilled over an open flame taste and this place has it. 

I cook a pretty good burger at home. The key is high heat, 400 to 500 degrees or better which cooks the meat very quickly so it holds in the juices without being bloody. A decent cut of meat is also important which usually leaves out fast food burgers because in order to complete and have good prices, they have to cut corners when it comes to their choice of meat.

The burger here is smoky, flamed, woody, juicy without being bloody and delicious. It has a garlic aioli on it which was garlicky (Not garlic enough for me, but probably enough for the average Boisite) and creamy. The brioche bun was soft and complimented the burger nicely.

I had a foodgasm. Yeah, its that good!

We also had the Moroccan beef as an appetizer. I did not care for the focaccia bread or the gorgonzola fondue, but the beef itself was very good. There was just not enough of it. Im struggling to describe this one as well. 

It was like no other beef Ive ever had. It was spicy but not hot. If I closed my eyes while eating it, I would have thought I was in the far east somewhere mystical on one of those flying carpets. You need to try this one as well.

The areas for improvement.

The Fries
The fries on my 2nd visit were very good. No ketchup needed. But on the 3rd visit, they were just ok. 

My hats off to Twigs for attempting to elevate a frozen batch of fries. They have truffle oil on them which is a good addition, plus they add some seasonings, which on this occasion where sparse. The truffle oil was also not applied equally to all the fries. The addition of truffle oil adds a very nice flavor to the fries that I am not sure I can describe. You will just have to try it for yourself.

Some of the fries had the oil but most did not. The fries are shoestring cut and obviously from frozen. If they did their fries from fresh, they might have a hit here.

Repairs to the building
On our 3rd visit we were sat in a booth with a badly ripped seat cushion. Twigs seems to aspire to be a somewhat fancy restaurant. How can they be fancy with ripped seat cushions? I had to remove a star for this.

Strange Temps
I dont mind this one. They have an odd sense of temperatures here, but most places have their own ideas on temps. Im talking about when you order your burger well, medium well, medium, or rare. 

The 1st time I came, I had the burger medium well which for me, was a little over cooked. I usually order my burgers medium well, or in the case of Red Robin, a little pink. This time I ordered it medium and it was perfect. No red, no pink, but still very juicy. Typically Medium would be pink to red.

Our daughter has been going to Meridian Montessori for 1.5 years now.  she has thrived and loves going to see her teacher and friends.  Her speech and social skills have improved dramatically.  We love the teachers and staff and they feel like family.

would put 0 stars if I could. it was a total disaster. friends and I went in to get our nails done and we paid $53 dollars for uneven and thick pieces of garbage. looked like my kindergartener did them for us. owner did them for us, so we expected better. had to go to another salon just to get them fixed and when we called this salon asking for a refund, they said they they don't do refunds. won't be coming back to this salon ever again. what a disappointment. the owner talked very poorly of her employees as she was the only one there. very unprofessional!

Oh yeah, this place is good! When you walk in the door and smell the joint you know it's gonna be good. We ordered the fried pickle spears. Very good. Yesterday was our first time here and definitely not our last!  I was craving hot chocolate and decided to try the frozen.  So delicious!!  It was pretty much perfect!  Heading back today to get coffee!

Phenomenal salads and service. Very clean and good views of the fountains. We had lunch here and would gladly come back for a different meal.

All Valley Animal Care Center is not what they advertise to be. They are not currently a 24hr vet clinic and they are not an emergency vet either. We could see staff members inside and not one bothered to even see if our dog was ok or needed assistance. The person on the phone recommended us to try West Vet instead. We will no longer be giving All Valley Animal Care Center our business and will save time and possibly our animals life by going straight to West Vet for now on.

Thought I'd give the new location in Kuna a try.  Ordered Fettuccine Alfredo which comes with your choice of chicken and/or vegetables according to the menu.  Do not recall being asked on the phone after I placed my order which I prefer but figured I like both so didn't call back.  I was asked which size portion I wanted and I asked for the smaller one.  I was told it would be ready in about 15 min.  15 min later I walk in and there were several people waiting for pick up orders but the restaurant was not even half full so I figured they'd work through us pretty quickly. I had the lobster mac and cheese, I kind of expected a wow factor and I just didn't get it, this may just be me, but I kind of felt it was meh. The food quality is great. The amount of food is huge for the reasonable price. They are neat & clean. If you want a pretty place and bad food go somewhere else. We order out it's great.
Great place for breakfast; lots of seating and a huge menu with all the classics. Giant portions so you'll never leave hungry!

Ugh I'm so sad to give this review but I feel like others need to know. I have a Big Daddy's BBQ in my hometown and it's my favorite so I was excited to try it here. Never again. I ordered through Door Dash which was perfect service as usual. I called the restaurant to add dipping sauces to my order and the girl was sweet and helpful. Then I got my food...
Almost $17 for a burger is on the high side anyway but coming with a side I was accepting of the "meal" price and thought we would try it. The side of potato salad was tiny, and nothing special. Under-seasoned, run of the mill potato salad. The burger was delicious but would I buy it again for $17? Probably not. The wings were advertised as "whole smoked wings" which would make me think 8 wings is actually 16 pieces separated but again I was wrong. I had 8 pieces of wings, nothing whole. The flats were so dry they were inedible. The hot BBQ sauce wasnt spicy whatsoever. The sauces were good and I was thankful I ordered a spicy one but I had to pay extra for all of that too. I ordered a side of onion rings with those and it truly looked like they had grabbed a little handful of leftover onion ring scraps from someone's plate. There was honestly only 3 full round, circular onion rings. So all in all I paid $50 for one good burger and a bunch of mediocre to bad food on the side. I'm SO disappointed.

Just had Bruchi's for the first time and it was fantastic! My wife and I had the turkey club and the Santa Fe cheesesteak and both were delicious. We also got the crinkle cut fries which were also very good. Definitely coming back here!

I was so glad to hear that Massage Envy in Meridian was open again!  I have always had good experiences there with massages and facial services. I went to a new therapist when they re-opened - James. He was great! If you are looking for a firm or deep tissue massage he is great - ask for him.

I was in town visiting family and decided to come try this restaurant out.  I loved my experience here and would highly recommend this restaurant.  The staff was very friendly and the food was excellent.  The avocado egg rolls were an awesome appetizer!  Really fun place!

I have called numerous times to obtain records for my pet.  Got part of them and called back to get the rest and they just don't follow through.  There non-veterinarian personnel are the worst when it comes to the public.
Best massage I've ever had!!!! Waaaaaay better than massage envy!!! You tell them hard, they give it hard the whole time!
Everyone was very friendly there thanks Daniel and Danny for everything god bless you both
The people who work here are seriously the best. Always so nice! Keep it up Starbucks crew, you guys are my favorite
Great food friendly servers awesome pie!

I am a true believer that of your feet ain't happy you ain't happy. I only buy Nike and find the best prices here. I had a 2 year old pair of air max that popped and they were willing to help me out. Problem was the guy who I dealt with was rude. Acted like I was there trying to get something for nothing. Any other day I would of dragged him outside. I still have my air max buddy. Oh fire this guy by the way. Anyways the lady who helped me was extremely helpful and knowledgeable about running shoes. I am very satisfied with these tailwinds. Thank you

My experience with employee name tagged rob  was he is unprofessional, has a really really stinking bad attitude, and the customer is a bother to him. He is put out to help people. I love this food. I built my own bowl with salad and plenty of fish. The ahi and salmon. I think this is one of my new favorite places. I look forward to trying the sushi burrito next time. I ordered through Postmates so I can't say anything about the employees or environment but the food was fantastic!!
Used to love this place. I will never go back after finding a hair in my food and watching the sloppily cleaned tables. Not the same as it used to be.
Enjoy the gluten free options and extensive drink menu. My friends and I always have a good time here. Something for everyone.

So we came back for a visit and as always, the food was great. The place is happening and the staff very courteous and on top of things. The coffee was good and the good, OMG, huge portions. Not good for a guy on a diet but, what the heck, it was good. Look forward to going back soon.

Vanessa was awesome! She was our waitress and hostess. She was very friendly, got everything on our order correct and made sure that our drinks stayed full. She checked in often to see if there was anything else we needed! The food was really good. We will be back!

Good food, great bartender.  Good martinis. Menus is pretty basic, but options for everyone in our family. Calamari excellent. Enjoyed the mahi mahi tacos.

Best Frozen Yogurt place I've been too in the treasure valley! Reminds me a little bit of Pinkberry. I gotta say it's wayyyy better than La Creme, plus this place has amazing toppings and a good selection of frozen yogurt.
After the remodel it's lighter, brighter and a great environment. Classes, tanning and racquet ball courts and a pool. Great environment and a great range of ages and dynamic of people work out.
Great well made products here in the USA. Brandon is very professional and knowledgeable. Definitely refer FP Farm and Brandon to all of our neighbors and friends!
