We were in and out in less than 30 mins and have literally no complaints. There is no question this is our new favorite place to eat. Thank you Kirsten for completing our dine in experience.

One of the few breakfast places open on Thanksgiving! Even the local drive throughs were closed. Social distancing ans masks are needed. 

Lots of breakfast choices, and we settled on the sandwich and skillet with the extra side of pancakes. 

In my opinion the pancakes were the best of the day. The sandwich was delicious too. My skillet was ok. The amount of meat in it was disappointing. 

Our server was excellent, on task and extremely attentive.

7/18/18. Best Eggs Benny I have had this year, and I had this same meal at 10 different breakfast places including Goldy's & the Trolley in Boise. Red potatoes were awesome as well, service was good. Very good experience!
Wow! This place is AMAZING! Great beer and great service. Thank you Matt and Jennifer for showing use what's good!
Waited 90 mins only to be told wait was another hr. Said no thanks and left. Masks not required social distancing not enforced

Super clean, owner was very nice.  We went about 25 minutes to closing and manage to have a good selection for dessert.  I had the pecan nut roll which was gooey, soft and delicious.  We also ordered cinnamon rolls which were equally as delicious.  I can't wait to go back and try their soups.

There are others reviews on this place...none of which are showing.  All of the reviews have been positive.

I would love to give a shout out to Mark and David from the warranty team! They have come out to the house on two different occasions and both time went above and beyond. Today they fixed some squeaky floors in our upstairs bathroom. Mark takes his time and explains everything they are doing, he also goes above and beyond by taking the time to answer any questions that we might have. Very professional guys that work great together!

I've had Cinn-Nom-Nom's "pop-up" preview and her cinnamon rolls are amazing. Size is perfect, not too much, just enough to make you want more. Other items I've had and crave; house made candy bars, until you've had one you don't know what you're missing, marshmallow - perfect to add to your hot beverage... truly a treat for winter, and pumpkin and cranberry breads - yum! Looking forward to each visit. I've already shared with my office in Boise and people want more and so will you.

If I've ever given a score that I felt so confident about, I think this would be it. Elements is the epitome of an average massage parlor. Good variety of services are available, but I haven't tried them all. What I have tried, has me questioning their value. As it stands, elements is extremely expensive for the valley. They offer different enhancements for your massage, and 60 minute session are more like 50/45. The conversation time at the beginning and end eats into your service. I have never left this massage parlor feeling refreshed or experienced the draining sensation.
 

Unfortunately, because of the cost and the average service I can't rate this higher that a two. If it was closer to $50 a service it would be a three.

Got 2 bowls and the food was nice and hot. Orange chicken / veggies and Steak / fried rice.  I had to wait a few minutes for the steak but I didn't mind because it would be hot too. 

Good service here. Staff was cleaning and cooking as I ordered. They greet you with hello as you walk in, friendly and nice.

There is really much I can say about this place that everyone doesn't already know. 
The Village in Meridian, is a fantastic spot in the treasure valley. So many wonderful shops, a fantastic theater, great restaurants and we all LOVE the Bellagio-esque dancing water fountains.
It's kind of an upscale place...so bring a bottomless wallet, purse or whatever you carry.
They have an H&M, which is fantastic, but the mall location is still my favorite of the 2.
Also, the Urban Outfitters at the Village is whack, yo! The downtown was so much better. I still don't understand why they closed that one being so close to campus.
So I guess there ARE some things to be said about the Village lol.
1) H&M is good, but not the best.
2) American Eagle, my favorite store in general, but the village location is super small and has half the stock that Boise mall has.
3) Urban Outfitters is LAME! even the staff is awful. I love almost everything at Urban Outfitters, just not this location.
4) LISTEN UP, VILLAGE PEOPLE (hahaha!) The ones who run the place....
The village is huge! Which is again, fantastic! However, having ONE BATHROOM for the entire place is ABSOLUTELY RIDICULOUS! The ONE bathroom by the water fountains is great, but when you're at the other end, like at American Eagle or H&M, having to walk all the way back, when you're about to burst or have a BLOWOUT....yeah, going back to the other end... suuuuuucks! Can't believe a place like the Village only has ONE public bathroom for the entire place. Surely yall have gotten complaints about this? Not just from bitchy people like myself, but probably, most definitely, undeniably, from the older folks, lol.
So, when.....uh....when...when do you think you could squeeze in another one before someone accidentally squeezes one out when and where they don't want to.
One day I was there and I had to go el numero uno. I asked a security guard at the H&M side "where is this ends bathroom?" He said, "sorry, we don't have one at this end, by the fountains is the only one" 
I gave him this...."wtf" look. He even said, "I know, it's weird there isn't one at this end, but hop on, I'll give you a ride back to the fountains" 
So he gave me a ride on the golf cart. That my friends, was my guardian angel for that day.
What an awesome guy!
Aside from those 4 things, you can't beat the Village. It really is a wonderful spot. Great for families, with the playground, which is an ocean rink at Christmas time. They go all out for Christmas and that makes me SO HAPPY! They really know how to make sure everyone has a pleasant and wonderful experience there.
Hey Village, when are you gonna add a Crate & Barrel? With the huge influx of, (ugh, LOL..kidding) Californians and everyone else, the valley is LONG overdue for one of those stores and if/when we get one, we all know that it will end up at the Village.
Gucci store would be cool too. Seems like a great spot for a Gucci store.

Ok, I need to end this before I write too much only to have Yelp tell me "your review is too long. Go back and edit some of it out" ....and that my Yelpers ...makes me sad because if you can't tell, I love to write, lol

Ok, I'm done! Enjoy, The Village! If you can't enjoy it, do you even enjoy life? Lol

Cheers, Yelperedededs!

AMAZING  this place is always full and lines outside waiting to be seated which gives you a indication 
It's quality of food and service it's Stellar 
Need I say more? Mic drop 
Mary W

Very professional service from start to finish. The sales person was friendly, knowledgeable and responsive. The roofing crew was fast and efficient and above all very clean. I was super impressed with how well they cleaned up after themselves every day of the job. Communication before, during and after the job has been great. This has been an all around great experience that we were not expecting. Only because recently we had the interior of our house remodeled and it was the exact opposite experience. So to work with a quality group of people for a change was great. And to top it all off the finished product looks fantastic. Thank you for a job well done!

We made a reservation on what looked to be a busy night and were seated right away. This was our first visit to this restaurant and we had a very nice experience. We ordered drinks and they were amazing! Hubby had a smoked old fashioned "Old Smoky". It was really a treat. Something we've seen but in places like Vegas. The bruschetta app was great and our meals were good. Overall great service and great wait staff and host team. We will definitely return soon. (With reservations!)

Over the years we've had really mixed experiences here, both with food and service.  More often than not the food is good, but the sushi is about 50/50.  The pricey rolls tend to be quite tasty but some of the more economical versions (especially those containing "crab mix"), are actually gross.  We've had great service, terrible service and several "average" dining experiences, hence the 3 star rating.

Great massage I got from Marie very professional 
Good staff clean place I definitely be back again

Maybe I had too high of expectations for a place that specializes in cinnamon rolls. I was expecting hot, fresh, delicious cinnamon rolls, but got what tasted like day old bread. The cream cheese frosting was delicious though. We actually went back to ask for a refund and instead got a replacement of ones "just frosted". "Just frosted" does not mean just made, still tasted day old. When we reheated them in the microwave, they did become more moist and tasty, but if you don't have access to a microwave, the rolls taste day old. I can't comment on any other products. I just don't think I'll be back.

So good! This has got to be one of the best sandwich places in the valley. The bread is like next level, it's warm, fresh, tender. The sandwiches are simple and SO DELICIOUS!! I hope Nampa gets lucky enough to get one. Until then it's so worth the drive.

This location is lacking. Customer service is generally pretty good, However I've received the wrong order twice now. The drive through is extremely slow for a restaurant that claims to be freaky fast. Usually need to plan on being in line for at least 10+ minutes. Not up to par with other locations

Shoe salesmen were condescending and pushy...very small selection of shoes in womens size 9.5/mens size 8.  Obviously when you go in to a "Nike" store you should wear nike, but I didn't expect to be treated disrespectfully because I was wearing a different brand of shoes.

I broke my two front teeth and needed a root canal and cap on one of them. Dr. Mortenson and all the staff at Willow Tree were amazing to work with. From the start the office staff was so helpful in doing the pre-auth form for my medical insurance to cover since it was accidental tooth damage. Then Dr. Mortenson went above and beyond to make sure my cap looked perfect. I felt like they treated my like family. I'll never go anywhere else.

What a disappointment! I have heard, and read positive things about this place for several years. We went at late Sunday lunch time today, 1:45 ish for the first time.

We were greeted at the door by a perturbed hostess, who informed us after we were seated, in a fairly full, busy dining room I must add, that we must order quickly as the restaurant would be closing soon. That should have been our first clue!  We were then notified repeatedly by the drink server, wait people, busboy, and any other staff walking by "you need to order quickly, as we are closing soon." The couple sitting in the booth behind us, jokingly commented as they were leaving, you better order fast!

After a brief scan of the sticky menus, we ordered a Reuben Sandwich and a Bacon Cheese Burger, with simple fries, beating tihe invisible but ever ticking, timeclock we were apparently sitting under. After ordering, our waitress quickly returned to inform us, french fries were no longer available, in fact we were told "we ran out, not a fry to be had." It was suggested the sweet potato tots were really, really good. I am pretty certain we were given the days end, cold tots most likely in a cold, warming tray, from atop the dirty dish washing pile. Our "so called" lunch soon arrived in record, "lightning speed" TIME!  My luke warm, Reuben was sopping, in grease oozing a pale white liquid next to a giant pile of tiny cold greasy tots, floating in the white whatever. The few bites eaten, were with a fork, as it would have been impossible to pick up the goopy mass on my plate. The dried out burger was on a pale, doughy, cold, untoasted bun with a scrap of core lettuce that in my household would have been thrown out, again with a "million" tiny,  cold, greasy sweet potatoe tots. I was quietly informed by my dear, sweet lunch partner "not good."

On a positive note, the bacon on the burger I was informed was really good, and the coke products we drank were cold and delicious. The fountain settings and tank temps are right on!

We were never offered water, had to ask for silverware, and napkins which was hurriedly dropped in a pile, on the center of our sticky table, and hovered over, from across the way until we paid. We quietly left a dining room void of anyone, other than than a lone young man putting chairs on tabletops. And...you guessed it nobody said thank you, LOL!

We are reasonable, pretty chill, people! We both have past experience from our college days in real restaurants. 

My SIMPLE, common sense advice to management...who I pray was off today, if you are closing your restaurant in minutes, or perhaps seconds in our case, obviously, shutting down fryers, grilles and the kitchen, nicely turn people away! As first time customers, we had no idea until being seated, and handed "sticky" menus, you only served breakfast and lunch, and were READY TO CLOSE! The wait person was friendly enough, and tried to be nice, but our overall 39 minute, first time experience in your business was over the top BAD! If I could give you minus stars...I would!!!! We will never ever, ever, ever, EVER!!! darken your door again, and if the occasion arises, be assured, we will share our 30 minute ordeal, in my case in detail. I am writing a long, rambling review, because it was that BAAADDDDD!

We hit another establishment just down the road who welcomed us with open arms, and assured us they were open!!! We had good, hot, tasty, food and friendly, attentive, relaxed fun service...as it should BE!  As for lunch at Jo Mamma's, run for your life...the OTHER WAY!

We ordered delivery through UberEats. Minus our driver not being able to find our place, the food was DELICIOUS.

We ordered the loaded BBQ fries, three meat platter and bbq salad. Ummmm.... SO GOOD! 

My husband couldnt get over how delicious the brisket was.

We will totally order from this place again! This time, more brisket.

Mark Enger is a shining star in the CBH team. He is honest, straight-forward and incredibly knowledgeable as to the source of the problem, how to fix it and then completes the work with excellence. Mark definitely represents CBH Homes well. Thank you, Mark ... you are still an excellent teacher!

I'd figured I'd try this place with my mom for a late Mother's Day breakfast since we can eat out now.

Food was ok, waitress was a bit standoffish, and that lady at the front of house - just took the cake to us.   Probably won't go back.  People were telling me good things about this place, so much for listening to friends.

The really remarkable thing through as I was getting into my car, a white-haired gentleman fell while walking on their "improvised" walk way to the front doors.  Just took a header, face first onto the ground.  I was headed over there to help, but several other bystanders were helping the poor guy up.  I feel for him as his day kind of sucked at that point, caked with mud and water.  Then before I left I saw this poor guy's wife getting into an argument with the hostess who came out.

Very disappointed. Service was just not up to par. So over rated. Tried to sushi rolls and they brought mine first and 15 mins later when I'm done brought my boyfriends! Biggest pet peeve! The rolls were just ok nothing impressive. Would never order again. Long time  before we even give them another chance!

I just got a Carmel cold brew and it was so good! I have been struggling to find my every day coffee for a why'll, well today that all changed. I couldn't find a coffee shop that had that one coffee that I just love, tried Starbucks... too sweet, tried Dutch bros... too bitter, but now I found two places being black rock and lucky perk being absolutely perfect. So if I'm feeling a hot coffee I'll go to lucky perk and for the delicious cold brew black rock is my shop.

If I could give it zero stars I would.  To start off they had a sign out front that said live music.  A stereo was there version of live music.  We then ordered our food.

Food was ordered and paid for but we had to proceed to the bar for our drinks.  Bazaar.  Drinks were paid for and we went and sat down.  Food came out but was wrong.  My sandwich was real dry with nothing but meat and cheese.  My wife sandwich did not come so we had to order and pay for another one cause they got it wrong.  Went to the bar for a drink and the guy taking orders was at the bar drinking .  No wonder our order was wrong.  

The inside of the place was very unclean.  The lights were dusty and dirty.  Cheesy Christmas lights hanging all over.  Tip jars everywhere.  That's probably why you have to order and pay for food the order and pay for drinks.  Leave a tip at order counter leave a tip at bar and leave a tip at table????? If you want another drink you have to walk up and get it yourself even though servers are everywhere.  Makes no sense.  

Server must have felt bad so he came out with two cookies and offered saying fresh baked cookies.  They were frozen yes frozen and must have been a week old.  He did not even try to nuke them.

I don't get this place.  I ask person at bar what beers were on tap.  She looks at them and said I am not sure.  She was trying to read the handles.  There were only 5 and she only could tell me 3 of them.  She said one is 208.  I said what kind of beer is that and she said she did not know.  Dang.  Guy behind bar pours a glass for himself.  No wonder this place is terrible.  Walking around and drinking while working??????

When you are drinking while working you have a problem.  How can you give good service buzzed??????  This place will go out of business soon.

You have to get the pulled pork! So good. We were visiting from out of town and had someone suggest this great Hawaiian place that just opened up a brick and mortar store after being a food truck. We weren't disappointed. You should find this place and give it a try. Fun atmosphere and good food!

This place is horrible. My dog got into it with a neighbor dog and had two deep puncture wounds. It was after our vet's normal hours so I called here. They said it would be a 2 hour wait. I called all the other emergency vets and they all had longer wait so we headed here.

After waiting for almost 2 hours in my car, I went in and they said I was next on the list. I waited another 40 minutes before we were brought into a room.

The tech came and looked at my dog and said the vet would be in to see him in a few minutes. 50 minutes later I called the front desk-I didn't want to leave the room because my dog had finally laid down. They told me it would be another hour or so. I said that when I called over 3 hours ago they had told me it was a 2 hour wait. The lady said that it has changed to 4-6 hours when I arrived (which was only 10 minutes after my initial call and this wasn't communicated to me). They said that even though I was there, they kept bumping me because of more critical patients. Well my dog was bleeding all over the floor so that seemed pretty critical. Plus no one came to tell me this.

We ended up leaving after waiting 3.5 hours and made it into our vet the next day. He required stitches. I'm just glad he wasn't bleeding any worse and something happened to him during the night. 

I can't rate on the actual vet services since we never saw him but the customer service can be vastly improved.
We had a great date night here this past Friday!  Love the ambiance and super tasty (and affordable!) cocktails and Alex was a gem of a bartender!  We will be back soon!  TY!

CBH Service Rep/Repairman Mark Enger drained approximately 9" of water from crawl space.  Mark was very knowledgeable, courteous, friendly, and professional.  Mark even offered to help fix a broken clock while he was there!  Class act top notch!!

Love this place, the service and food!

I am a customer and frequent this restaurant frequently.

I believe that when you go to any restaurant and you remove your mask you risk your health, if you believe the mask will protect you. 

If you don't feel safe don't leave your house.  Such ridiculous comments about enforcements.  Who do you think touches everything you touch and ingest.  Live off the grid that is the only way you won't risk your life.  Live a little.  God determines your time and date!

As for Joe Mommas and all the other restaurants that don't take my freedom away - thank you don't change a thing!

P.S. open up earlier lol
Sam Farris and her team was very supportive and resorsfull. We like  our new house very much. Transaction was done online using DocuSign. It was very smooth transition. Highly recommend.
Customer service is excellent, the prices are fair, the atmosphere is great and the drinks are delicious. Alex the bartender is insanely good, very impressive at what what he does.

The food is great.  The service is atrocious.  When the staff tells you that your order will be ready in 15 minutes, you better plan on waiting 45 minutes to an hour.  Don't point that out either, because you will be verbally attacked.  Too bad that the operational staff dont care about their customers.  My tip to you, choose another BBQ joint.

One of the worst pedicure experiences I have had in 15 years of monthly pedicures.  Was told I needed to soak my feet  because she didn't want to "Smell stinky feet".  She was very forthcoming through the whole process that she did not like pedicure's & did not want to be there.  After spending $50 on  a third choice color, I woke up with a very infected nail.   Never again!  If you hate doing pedi's, save everyone misery & just don't accept the appointment.

I was in back of store maintaining 6ft distance far from any employees and the store only had one customer checking out. An Employee approached me held a mask up in my face and said "u need to wear this or u can't be in here" I politely explained "I have a medical condition and can't wear a mask".   Her response to me was "if u don't wear a mask u can't be in here if u need u can do curbside" I will not be shopping here again this is not my first bad experience with this particular store!

Best bar in downtown Meridian! This place has a nice vibe with plenty of indoor and outdoor seating. It was not very crowded when we were here but it was very early. The drinks were good and the staff was friendly. I wish they had a larger cocktail menu. They offer a few on a board but it is not enough. That is my only feedback for the place. 

We will definitely return.
Great service and friendly wait staff that cared about your eating experience. I will be back soon.

I don't understand any remotely negative reviews. These guys are great to deal with. They are knowledgeable and care about their customers, are very friendly and a pleasure to deal with. These are the kinds of small businesses that might get overlooked but need our local support. 

I know it's a toy shop, but it's also a nostalgic and fun slice of history. Support these guys so we keep them open for years to come. Yeah it's a small shop, but that sort of makes it special given the amount of great finds here. Things change rapidly so be sure to drop in often to see what you might find next.
You have to wear a mask to go in and eat. Haven't they heard. No masks are needed. Plus, you're going to wear it only to take it off.

I have been sleeping on their iced coffees 
Their coffee is so good, have flavor choices and have almond milk too boot!
The foods was delicious, service was good
The portions are seriously large, go in with an appetite for sure!!!

I wish I could give a better review unfortunately not ... The first time going to bonos was great. Food came out amazing and service was good too. Second time going back I can say is where it all fell apart. Food is never consistent. I've seen them in Fred Meyers buying food on a regular basis. Even saw the employee being rude to another customer while in line at Fred Meyer. Service is crap now. Employees are running around with their heads cut off if there is 2 people in line at once. Honestly I can't give this place long if they keep going in this direction.

When this place first opened, it was great food. We loved their jalapeno poppers, not being fans of their fries.  Today we ate there and my taco salad was almost all lettuce, with very little else. My husband's chicken burrito was skinny and not well filled. And my husband and I can no longer order the jalapeno poppers.  Not a good place to eat anymore.

I'm re-reviewing KG after going there for Happy Hour last night. Sat at the bar again and had a Patron Margarita (excellent!) and the Smoked Gouda Fondue. Okay if you order this fondue, you get a ginormous amount of bread pretzel pieces AND a green apple for $6! Get Out!! Way more than I can eat, so shared it with my neighbor, a complete stranger but nice man. I had another Patron Margarita, yummy good! Then surprise, the bartender over mixed a Cosmo so she gave me that comped. My evening came to $20 before tip...not bad! One thing about the Kona Grill is their bartenders know how to be respectful to Baby Boomers like me. And I tip well because of their excellent customer service. I will go back, and back. It's a place where a single person can be and receive a great meal and/or appt. Try it, they do it right at KG!

FYI; my GPS took me around back of the store first and there is no entrance on that side. 

Ample free parking out front in the strip mall. 

Free WiFi with no password needed. 

Extremely friendly staff. Literally everyone wanted to help me. 

Good quality products. Clothing has regular price, 30% off, and clearance pricing. I found it easy to buy everything from the 30% off sales that were very abundant. I personally didn't buy anything at msrp. 

Shoes; enough to choose from in running which I was shopping for. Most were 30-50% off MSRP and there were definitely good deals to be had. The really discounted section for men was in the back left corner of the store. They did not have tennis shoes (at all) or many of the things I had in my Nike app cart that I wanted to try on and buy in person. For example running backpacks or specific running shoes that I found online. 

I removed one star for the lack of bathrooms. I'm such a large store with so many families with kids how do you not have a restroom? I asked a couple of workers and got answers from go to Toys R US, go to Target, to the Gap, to "I'm disappointed no public restrooms too." I eventually went to Toys R US which had fine restrooms in the front right of the store. But it's closing down very soon so that won't be an option.

On 6/17/2020, Mark arrived at my home (located on S. Palatino Ave.) to repair the concrete on my back patio. Mark arrived early and did a great job repairing the patio. Mark then went above and beyond. He educated me on how to save at least 20% on my energy bill and he plumbed my front entrance door. Everyone should be more like Mark. He truly cares.
Food was delicious!  Lots to eat, took half of it home for later. My daughter had the 1 entree plate with chicken veggie stir fry and loved it.

This is by far the dirtiest and most neglected gym. I was told there would be millions of dollars put into this gym, not! The male staff here are idiots and lazy as all get up. DO NOT GO TO THIS GYM. GROSS!!!
Brisket platter with Mac and cheese and coleslaw was excellent. The meat just fell apart, was juicy and great flavor. Highly recommend and will be back.

These guys are amazing. Having moved from out of state, I was a little nervous to be leaving a solid pediatric dentist that we'd been going to since my daughter cut her first couple of teeth. I wasn't sure I'd find anyone who could hold a candle to that office. 

Thankfully, I was wrong. Dr. Blair was highly recommended by a mother's group I'm in. After checking yelp reviews, I opted to go with him. When I called to make our initial appointment, the receptionist was very nice (which is cool because nothing sucks more than an awesome doctor with a lousy support staff). She was able to get us in the following week. 

The waiting room is kind of Ikea décor (stark and modern) but the people are warm and welcoming. They checked us in quickly. There is a room off the main waiting room with a big screen tv that was showing Frozen. Two old-school arcade game setups kept my husband busy for the (very short) wait to see the hygienist. There is also a giant train table and a reading nook (which I love!) 

We went in and the hygienist settled my daughter into a chair. With our permission, she took x rays and proceeded to clean her teeth. My daughter was a bit nervous but the hygienist was so kind and explained everything she was doing; she even used the toothbrush head on my daughter's finger so she knew what it would feel like in her mouth. There are TV's in the ceiling so she just hooked into a headset and picked a movie! I also like that the hygienist (man I wish I'd gotten her name, she was so sweet!) didn't even give us side-eye when we told her no fluoride. Usually we get a little heckling, or at least a couple questions about it. 

Dr. Blair came over and introduced himself, gave my daughter a coin, took a look at the x rays and told us about her dental health. Nothing we didn't already know. I like that he didn't push us one way or the other about our options; he just laid everything out and let us make a decision. I really appreciated that! We made our follow up appointment and headed out. On our way out she got a t-shirt, a toothbrush and various other Blair Dentistry swag. Also, it turns out they have quarter machines full of toys at the exit door and that's what the coins are for! They have 4 machines to choose from and they can put their coin in and get a toy. My daughter was absolutely THRILLED about this :) 

Overall, the staff is kind, caring and gentle. Dr. Blair is amazing with kids and doesn't seem too pushy; I didn't get the feeling he was pushing anything unnecessary to make a buck (I've heard other dentists do that). The office is clean and welcoming. I'm so very thankful I was able to find another dentist my daughter is comfortable with!

Rick provides exceptional customer service! We just stopped in today and it was by far our quickest trip ever to a cell phone store.  And we replaced 4 phones! Rick did everything so quickly and he really knew what he was doing.  Seriously, the best TMobile store we've ever been to. Rick & Jen know how to provide great customer service. I HIGHLY recommend this TMobile store!!!

I'd like to say to start that my grandson or husband have never had a bad haircut at Great Clips Cherry Lane in Meridian Idaho. I will say though that my Grandson, who loves everyone and has always loved going to get his haircut has now decided he'd rather Grandma buzz him at home. I asked him why and before he opened his mouth I knew what he was going to say because I feel that way every time I go in that salon and I don't even get my hair cut there. I'm just sitting waiting for my husband or grandson. THEY DON'T TALK to their customers. You can hear a pin drop. No one chit chats at all. My grandson who is 7 loves to talk but he learned early on that they don't talk back, so he's uncomfortable. What's wrong with talking, laughing, sharing or showing interest in the person sitting in your chair? It's not a Covid thing....it's been going on for the past 2 years we've been going there. When I go get my hair cut the best part of it is chatting and enjoying conversation. Do they not realize that people are uncomfortable sometimes walking into a new salon and would like someone to break the ice. My grandson said to me, "Grandma, why won't she talk to me? Is she shy?" So great haircut are a plus......I'd give you guys a 4 or 5 if you could make that little room of yours a happy place to walk into. Even starting at the front desk! How about a smile behind that mask and a loud, WELCOME TO GREAT CLIPS! Personality goes a long way.....

We have loved going pre COVID to Joe Momma's for their delicious and yes large portions. When COVID hit we would order and take home. Get this our fave is the Eggs Bennie... stunned to open the styrofoam to go upon arrival to a still warm yet egg yolk slowly runny when cut into! How do they do it ( and it's happened on both occasions when ordered). Great menu, ditto on the earlier review of chicken fried steak.

Horridly long wait times.  Understaffed although the vets are knowledgeable.  We will find another vet.  Lack of appointments available.  Stressed out receptionists.  Sad.......such a wonderful place to be so understaffed.

Ordered a Steak Bacon Cheddar and French Dip sandwiches. We ended up throwing away 1/2 of each sandwich as it was barely edible apart from the bread. The steak was very dry and barely distinguishable. The crinkle fries were cold and hard and definitely not cooked fresh to order. 

Definitely suggest that you pass this on by. There are a couple of other dining establishments in the plaza that I would try first.

This was my first time to eat at Joe Momma's.  The atmosphere was typical breakfast place.  Service was okay, nothing special.  Food was disappointing, though.  I had the Crab Cakes Benedict with hash browns.  I asked for the hash browns to be crispy.  Well, the crab cakes benedict  arrived luke warm and the hash browns were very dark on top.  But the hash browns were never cooked on the other side.  They were not cooked.  Nobody ever came by and asked how my meal was.  So, I may try this place once more; however, there are many good breakfast places and I just may not want to risk it.

I know Christian brothers through reputation only they are a fantastic organization. The name just sort of spells out honesty and integrity. As a Christian myself I can always appreciate a business that takes care of its own. It's sort of a do you want to others mentality that means that everything has got your best interest in mind not just their's but yours. The shop is impeccable the shop is impeccably clean. And their technology state of the art I highly recommend them.
Oh did I mention that their location is terrific for students at Boise State.  No they have a shuttle run you back to campus
Excellent service, love the new location. They are always ready to help me and sometimes can fix my machine on the phone, saving a lot of time.
Host said 30 minute wait, ended up being an hour. Have been going here for years and service got worse over time.

Food wasn't bad for my first time there. The service was terrible and they don't offer military discount. I had to wait for ever to have my order taken and then had to ask for salt and pepper which wasn't already on the table. I had to wait forever to get a box and the check that I was ready to leave 30 minutes ago. Don't know if I'll try this place again.

Delicious food and amazing service. Get a breakfast burrito, they are big enough to share and so delicious. I've been going here since they were in their old location and it's always been a great breakfast spot.

Yummy breakfast spot. Friendly service from the moment you walk in. You will WAIT to be seated but it is worth the wait. You can make a reservation which we will do next visit. The omelet was delicious. The French toast superb. The service was okay but under the circumstances, aka a packed house, we got adequately tended to. Rustic theme. Oh and NO MASK NAZIS!!!!!!
This was one of thee best massages I've had in some time, I am here visiting from out of state and needed this after my 10 hour drive. I will go back before I leave.

We had an unfortunate situation where we we're concerned our puppy possibly ate one or several grapes. We took her in and the staff were so helpful and friendly and comforting. Dr Myers explained everything to me and helped me understand why each part of the treatment plan was important, and gave me several options moving forward. That same night I got a text from one of the night staff, Sarah. She sent me pictures and updates and cuddled our sweet baby puppy every day, while we were so scared. Dr Myers called me as well to provide updates and explain the next steps. We picked her up today, and I couldn't be happier with the service we received. Hopefully, we won't have to bring her back again for anything, but I trust them with our furry family, 100%. Thanks All Valley!

Gorgeous and such a great vibe! The decor was so unique and classy. This place is spotless. The bartender made some awesome drinks!! He was fun to watch, like watching an artist create his masterpiece. Most beautiful bar I've been to in the Boise/Meridian area!

It's not easy finding good gluten free crust, but the gluten free pizza I got from Smoky Mountain the other night was great. I have had gluten free pizza from a lot of different places over the years, and this was definitely one of the best.
Ice cream is delicious, with large portions! Staff is always super friendly. The place is very clean. So far this is our go to ice cream spot.
Boise finally gets a legit hipster ice team shop. We've enjoyed Molly Moons and Salt n Straw in Seattle for years. Lovejoys might be even better. So many inventive and delicious flavors!

A bit overdue for this review ... but better than never :) 
I was in town visiting family and heard of "Sofra " my family has paid a visit once or twice before and so did my husband while traveling for business... so they assured me it's a "must try" .
With a short visit in town we made the time to go in and have a sit down lunch.

I'm sorry I didn't get a chance to take photos (my bad) but when you have a 14m old on your hands it kind of makes it a bit harder.
But that does not mean the food was any less than.

We've ordered several different dishes. All of them were beyond delicious and FRESH. You can taste the freshness  of all the food and dessert. And that alone deserves 5 stars.
After that visit we did another take out this time adding "Pita" to our order. Pita like other foods served at Sofra is very familiar to me however this Pita that's served at Sofra is beyond any I've tried .. of course "your mamas cooking is always the best" but I'm not used to Pita made this way. It is so soft, fluffy yet thin enough for your belly to handle since this is made of dough and it can be a bit heavy , nope not this one at Sofra. 
My order had 15 pieces of "Pita Sirnica " and 5 of Burke. ( Sirnica = cheese filling.. don't know what kind was used but it was quit delicious and Burke = ground beef with lots of spices (none hot/spicy) i arrived for a pick up they were just being pulled out of the oven. The kind order taker Edina asked for exact time of arrival to make sure Pita is not only ready but hot out the oven. 
That's some great customer service and delicious pita folks. :) 
The kitchen is visible from the dining area and from what I can see while the cooks and servers where in and out is an absolute cleanness and neatness. Working with food can get messy we all know that but Sofras kitchen is spot on clean ( as well as the rest of the dining area) All of the cooks wore hair nets and aprons. Many hand towels hanging and hand wash around. Huge plus. Shows you how clean these folks are. Makes me feel safe as I can see how everyone and everything is clean. 
A girl named Medina greets  you upon arrival (Bilingual) huge plus as there's a large Bosnian community it is important to have someone that can address guests in both languages. Yes English is all of our primary language and we practice it on daily but when you have a grandma who stopped by for a cup of soup  she'll definitely appreciate a hello in Bosnian. Huge plus for the owners.
Medina, is super sweet, kind, friendly and knowledgeable. While we dined in she made it twice to our table asking if everything was ok and if we needed a drink refill or anything else.
Tables were all clean and in order when we arrived but I also noticed upon guest leaving tables are immediately cleaned and prepped for next coming guest. You will also hear low playing Bosnian music very nice to hear (super low) not disturbing at all. Place is calm, cool and collective. Very nicely put together and very inviting.
That my folks is what I've gathered for ya! I hope you find this review helpful and give this place a try. 
Good luck to the owners. 

Can't wait to come back again!

My first experience here. We went inside to order 3 sandwiches for carry-out. The friendly staff was strictly obeying COVID recommendations which we appreciated. This is a very clean & attractive shop. These are the reasons I rated 3 stars, along with the quantity of the food.
Regarding the food, this is the best compliment I have, the servings are generous, in this regard you get your money's worth. 
I had the Italian Beef. This is not the right shop to order Italian Beef, their method of preparing this meat is 1 star at best. 
Another sandwich in our order was the French Dip sandwich. This person enjoyed the bread, could not eat 1/3 of the meat because the quality and taste of the meat was so poor and the au jus tasted bad. 
The third sandwich, which this person who had been here multiple times had ordered before, was the Turkey sandwich. She said it was good.
Note: the food is safe to eat, the quality of the beef in the two sandwiches we had was not what we hope to get when paying a deli for a sandwich.
The $1.25 dill pickle was delicious.
Great breakfast options, and great new location. My only complaint is that they don't have normal hash browns  like breakfast places should.
We love the village - Great atmosphere, food, drinks, theater, coffee house, toys for kids, the water fountain is great, and near our home.

Very tasty sandwiches and the workers were very friendly and helpful. I tried the Italian fully loaded and it was delicious. Their bread and meat are excellent. I was concerned about the bread being too dense (carbs aren't friendly to me) but it wasn't and was surprisingly spot on. This is definitely one of the best sandwich joints in the valley. 

My only recommendation to them would be to have a soda fountain carrying coke products and to step up the dessert game (not that it'd stop me from coming back but it'd make me more motivated to make the drive). There's a pad by the Hilton in Eagle - you should put a location there with the aforementioned improvements. ;)
The ice cream is so SO good!! The scenery is amazing they have little swings to sit at and it's SOO awesome! 100% Recommend. I got the minty cookies and cream

Joe Momma's is a big hot spot for breakfast in Meridian. There was a bit of a wait to get in, but it was tolerable. 

We got a couple of scrambles, pancakes and a few other things in our group. It was pretty good, your standard breakfast spot, but maybe a little better. Our waitress, and everyone else, was super friendly, and the black coffee was pretty good. 

What I love about Idaho is the friendliness and family feel of the restaurants. A few more healthier options would be great, but whatever, you can make it work. 

Nice little spot.
This establishment might have a really lovely golf course but they do not treat their employees well. If looking for a job I would look elsewhere.

Mediocre at it's finest. Maybe I'm alone in saying this. Perhaps its because I'm bitter my favorite downtown Boise location is closed. Idk...I do know that people must like it because it was pretty packed by 5:30 on a Friday. 
We were seated quickly after playing follow the leader with the hostest. Bumping into several other hostesses as we navigated.  *GET OUT OF THE WAY PEOPLE!!!* I violently shouted in my head. Our waiter brought menus and was back within 3 minutes to see if we were ready. We weren't, because honestly we hadn't planned on going here. Everything else around had long wait times. So we sort of rushed which I admit wasn't the best idea. 
Best items we had were the chips and salsa and our beers. Ha! The margarita seemed lackluster. 
We had fish tacos 2 ways and my grilled ones tasted very fishy, that's literally the only flavor they had. My other guest had taquitos and those were even way over fried. 
I really used to love cafe' ole and perhaps I'm just a snob now. I can say this much...I won't be back to this location for a very long time, if ever.  If you enjoy tex mex and light alcoholic beverages this just may be the place for you.

Rosie did my gel polish and it looks great! They have over 500+ gel colors. The salon is recently remodeled so it's beautiful & super clean. The only thing is they do charge $3 extra if you use card, so I will bring cash next time.

Amazing. Healing. My therapist was "May" and she listened to my problems and made my massage to fit my needs. I am never going somewhere else. So professional, skilled and the best massage I have ever had!
Great atmosphere! Fun and experienced baristas! Highest quality! I crave it daily! They have white chocolate milk! Different options for the kiddos! Very efficient!

Not impressed with this Crunch location at all. I decided at the beginning of the summer to get a membership at Crunch while I was home from college due to the ymca being overcrowded, and I regret my decision. When I signed up, the cost seemed a little on the expensive side for 3 months, especially after the annual fee they charge you during month 2, but I was desperate to find a gym so I agreed. The lady who signed me up told me they didn't have any kind of 3 month contracts, or student deals, but afterwards, I talked to a friend of mine who signed up at the Eagle location and she was given a 3 month membership for A LOT less than for what I was going to be paying for. So of course, not happy. I didn't get a free shirt that they advertise, and when I asked the next week, the lady at the front desk seemed to not know what I was talking about. Also, the facility itself is pretty dirty and not well taken care of. All of that being said, I decided to cancel my membership after just 2 months because I didn't want to waste another $40. I was told when I signed up that all I had to do was call before the 9th of the month (the day I get billed) and that was it. Well, I called today, the 6th, and was told that I had to email their corporate office and I needed to do it 10 days before I wanted to cancel. I explained to the staff member on the phone that that wasn't what I was told when I signed up, and she apologized but basically said too bad, I will be charged. I'm not happy and very disappointed at management and customer service.

In town for the weekend visiting and it was recommended to me as a yelp elite to hit up Joe Mommas for my opinion.... here goes, drum roll please....

Joe Momma's is a must! And I now know why it was recommended, this place rocks from the top to the bottom at every aspect in what a great restaurant should be doing. 

Started off with a call ahead and was seated as soon as we arrived. Loved that! Are you kidding? Reservations for breakfast? Totally helped on a packed Sunday morning too! (Insert Dab move here) (disclaimer: I do believe the staff does not refer to this as a "reservation" but a call ahead seething due to the fact you may still be required a short amount of time for a table to open up)

The establishment is clean, bright, decorative and with just the right ratio of openness and cozy. The vibe is cool, relaxing and comforting. 

Ok the food right? Yeah well the food was great. I loved the menu options because yes it had pancakes, biscuits, hash browns and all the other fan favs, but it has this nice unique mix of things like chimichanga chorizo burritos and berry stuffed French toast. One thing I noticed is they have a cool selection of meat choices for most of the dishes also and I believe that stems from (what I was told) is that all the meat comes from the prime meat market/deli right next door! (Mic drop). 

What I liked most: man, this is tuff because the call ahead seating had me at hello, but the food and prices really set this place up for a 5 star rating. You choose....

What I liked least: it is currently 503 miles from my living location... :/

My wife and I tried this restaurant for breakfast. There was a bit of trepidation based on some of the negative reviews we read but decided to try it none-the-less due to a recommendation from a friend whom lives here in Meridian.  Some of the negative reviews must be a "hit and miss" sort of thing; we were greeted and seated right away. The server was at our table within three or four minutes, took our beverage orders and returned promptly with the beverages and took our food orders. Our food arrived without too long of a wait.  The food was okay, not something I would rave about as a "must eat" place but we had no issues with the taste or temperature of our meals. Our server was attentive and seemed engaged in her work.  I guess it is either a hit and miss place or perhaps we view life with a different set of expectations.

This is by far the coolest park I've been to for kiddos! 

They have tons of picnic areas, a few covered and appeared to be reservable.

There is a large splash pad with water activities for kids of all ages. 

Then the playground, wowzers! Where so I start!? There a huge play structure with multiple slides, ways to climb up, sensory toys and bridges. Then there's a smaller structure for littler kids, with lots to check out. Then the coolest part is the musical area, tons of giant chimes and drums. Way cool.

There's also a rock climbing area with giant (fake) boulders for kids to climb up.

I love that the play areas are covered in a foamy absorbable rubber. It's not only nice to walk on but obviously is there to aid in decreasing booboos. 

The bathroom facilities are also very nice. They have a multi stall woman's and men's as well as a family or gender neutral bathroom.

The park itself is also nice and well maintained.

Support this local small business! Yum! 

I ordered a coconut smoothie with peach boba add in.  I have never had boba before so this was a treat to try something new.   My coconut smoothie was awesome, I am a coconut lover, and the peach boba add ins were such a fun and sweet addition! 

I had a turkey bacon and Swiss sandwich with garlic Parmesan fries and although it is a little bit of a messy sandwich, it tasted amazing! The waffle is made from philo dough so it's crispy and flaky.  The inside of the sandwich is super flavorful.  It's a pretty large portion so I had a half for lunch and a half for dinner.

The inside of the restaurant is light and airy and fun. There's high top tables and low top tables so plenty of seating if you want to stop in or take it to go.  Restaurant was very clean and the person working was very friendly.   This will definitely be a repeat lunch stop for us.
Never in my life have I ordered sushi and have it delivered with no ginger or Wasabi. $19 shrimp and lobster roll was 90% rice. A pathetic waste of money. Never again.

Customer service from the manager no less is not a priority.... Unlike all the other sandwich shops that will let you call ahead to order he won't because he has "a line out the door" which consisted of 3 people. While their sandwiches are good the manager may need to learn about customer service.

The restaurant wasn't busy but the service was vary slow.   Sat at a table for ten minutes before anyone ask if we would like a drink.  Another few minutes later someone different came by to take the order. When the order finally came it appears to have sat ou for a while because it was cold   Frustrating as it was we ate thee cold food and then left. Probably won't be back. And won't be recommending it to anyone.

This mister car was mechanically is crap people were very nice great customer service. My car wasn't muddy and it gets cleaned 3 times a month at a Jackson gas station for a fraction of the price and guess what it comes out clean.  Your liquid soap must be junk and the front brush doesn't even reach the entire front lol and it doesn't even touch the back

The office staff is a complete mess. Nobody knows what their doing or who is doing what. They mailed stuff to wrong address. 3 different estimates for same treatments. Ask questions on phone without getting name of person, that was a big mistake. Got the ole proverbial run arround. End up canceling treatment to find another dentist

We actually went here based on all of the reviews but we're so disappointed in the food. It really was shocking that it had so many high ratings.

 We ordered two different sandwiches to share and we each only got through a half. The waffle sandwiches are an interesting concept but the flavor is off. Almost like rancid oil. 
The sandwich itself was completely dry. Meat and this waffle bread substance. That's it. 

It came with a small side salad and french fries. After I'd finished taking a few bites of each I inquired if there was something missing from the sandwiches and was told normally people put the salad in the sandwich. Not sure how you're supposed to know this, but ok. The meat itself was similar to what you would buy at the deli at the grocery store. Nothing special. 

The french fries were good & came with a side of fry sauce.
Incredible food and the service was really helpful and super fast. My food was out so quick and tasted really rich, definitely the authentic experience. I will 100% be coming back and glad I came in.

I had the worst experience at a hospital ever this past Monday Feb 6th. I have had stomach surgery in the last year and I'm not suppose to be left vomiting under any circumstances - I told the check in nurse this when I arrived however; I was left lying on the floor vomiting for two hours waiting to be seen, during that time I passed out twice and they acted as if ' no big deal'.  I will never go to that location again. I will drive all the way downtown where they actually know 'how to correctly  evaluate "emergency vs non emergency". Because I have had three back surgeries as well I was in a lot of pain and having back muscle cramps - when they finally did get me in the back, the nurse was being abusive and angry at me for having to sit up while I was vomiting (I had to throw my legs over the side of the bed - to much pain in my back from the trauma of being left vomiting for two hours. So what happens the nurse (Rebecca starts getting all pissy with me and saying ' I'm not putting up with that) then she tried to get abusive with me and I told her 'I'm not putting up with your anger". So she backed off - because of all this I would give them a zero - the only professional interaction I had there was with the doctor.. Bad hospital to go to if you are very ill and need immediate attention!!

Avoid CBH Homes at all costs! We bought one a year ago and are having major flooding and water damage issues to the point that our foundation is crumbling and CBH refuses to address the issue. CBH developments are notorious for water drainage issues. We wish we had never bought this house. We should have bought a Hubble Home instead.

This spot is local and amazing. American breakfast without the Breakfast hangover. I can only imagine this is because they cook with great ingredients.  The location is great, makes you feel like you're in a beautiful mountain cabin. Highlights are the eggs Benedict and all of the hash's are super fresh.  You won't be disappointed. Oh yeah, and amazing large pancakes as well.

Caveat emptor. Had a funny experience  that made me think I was at a downtown Chicago or New York hotel. My husband ordered a Patron gimlet at the bar; I ordered a drink off the Martini menu. Mine was a normal/expected price --$11. We were, however, surprised at the $23 charge for the Patron gimlet. We were heading to our table and didn't question it but we did get a good laugh. Seriously ... in an Idaho mall restaurant?!!!  We know now that, in Idaho, we should ask for a full bar menu before ordering. And, of course, question such an oddity. 
Dinner was fine for a moderate restaurant and the service was quite good.

We had lunch and were disappointed with the food.  We ordered the daily special "prime rib sandwich" and instead of enjoying the flavor of Barbecue we received meat (I guess) covered with a ton of melted cheese ! I don't know if there was meat under all that or not. What we received was a cheese sandwich-- I could have stayed home for that.

I only go to Cindy for my haircuts! I have never wanted to get my curly hair cut at a salon, but someone had told me Cindy has all the skills and talent in cutting all types of hair. I am sooo thankful I found Cindy! She is so kind and I love what she does with my curly locks. She also recently did my
Makeup and hair as a bridesmaid. The up-do turned out gorgeous, and I the makeup was perfect. I would recommend her to anyone.

I would be giving it a 4 star review for the food but our experience was a bit odd. 

We came in for happy hour on a Sunday (they have it all day which is great). The place was not that busy but there was no host/hostess to be found. We stood there for about 5 minutes and a server finally came by and told us someone would be right with us. The phone rang multiple times while we waited and no one came to answer. 

Finally someone came up and told us to seat ourselves for happy hour and acted like we should have known that somehow. There should be a sign to seat yourself or maybe someone standing there doing their job but not a huge deal. 

We were also brought a couple wrong items and had some incorrect stuff on the bill but our waitress was very nice and fixed the issues and apologized. No apology necessary because I know mistakes happen but it was nice of her to show she cared! 

Now onto the food. We ordered the spicy shrimp tempura and it was great! 

Then we got a bunch of sushi. Some of the rolls were discounted so we took advantage of that. We ordered a rainbow roll, checkerboard roll and wave roll. Fish was good quality and the flavor was good. 

It's definitely a chain restaurant and there are things that could be improved but the food is pretty darn good!
I love the atmosphere and location because they make and treat you like family.  The house dressing is golden so, please visit because you want regret it.

This is probably the worst Vet Hospital to take your pet. We have been back 4 times for the same issue, and saw different vets (or just an aide) for the same thing. Then the wait times are incredible--the shortest belong 90 minutes, the longest 3.5 hrs. All of these except one have been WITH an appointment. The excuses have been everything from, "We had an emergency," to "Sorry, we were training a new person, and you got put on the wrong list," to "Oh, you wanted to see the vet and not a technician?" Do not take your pet here unless you have hours to waste, don't mind seeing different vets for the same issue, and get no resolution of the problem anyway. I'd give a negative star if it was an option.
Poutine!! It was awesome. Fries were perfectly crisp. Love the cheese curds throughout the dish. Brisket smothered with savory gravy...YUM!! Sorry no photo. I would totally get it again!!

Craig was awesome. I messaged & called the morning of, and he had availability at the end of the workday. We had a few stains that needed attention & he was able to help. I will be calling this company again in the future for all of our carpet cleaning needs, and I recommend you do the same.

My keep patriot was a tiny bit dusty after driving  30 minutes on some gravel roads.  It just needed a light rinse but  this "washing" just turned the dust into mud on the backside of my jeep and the windows all around were spotted.  A hose at home would have been better.

We went here after leaving another restaurant and we are so glad we did. We sat on the patio, drank martini's and had some great food. The rib eye was great! Service was spot on and atmosphere was on point. We didn't have to wait long for anything. The drunkin donuts for dessert were a hit!

Car was is great but not that it always bends my front license plate!  Second try and yesterday used a plate holder- wash bent my license plate and cracked the holder too.  Sorry - gotta go back to Rocket - doesn't happen there!
Great coffee and treats.  Good spot for daily coffee.  My office relocated. Ill miss my daily dose of drip coffee and the occasional Mexican mocha.  I will still visit when I'm in the area.

Along with the other reviewers, I have been a long-time (12-year) member of Idaho Athletic Club.  IAC had never had great customer service, I will admit, and the Meridian gym (on Fairview/Locust Grove) is just old, musty and run-down.  Absolutely no upgrades have been completed on any of the IAC locations that I have frequented.  I too, was excited that they got bought out and had high hopes for an improvement in equipment, better customer service, etc.  Within the past year, I have specifically been going to the smaller location on Eagle between Victory and Overland, due to the proximity to my house.  

For the couple of months that Crunch had been running the gym, 30% of their treadmills were broken (20% still are), customer service was basically non-existent and there were no towels available.  There were a couple of times I asked, so I can wipe off the machines, and I was told they were in the wash.  An hour later, after completing my workout, I asked again and the front desk kid said they were not ready yet.  When there were towels, there were about 5, hidden in the cabinet at the front desk.  Since there wasn't anybody at the front desk, I had to open the cabinet to check and see if they have any and just take it out of the cabinet.

After all of stuff mentioned above, I went to work out this Saturday (6/17/2017) and the doors were locked and the sign said they had closed the doors for good.  There are not very many gyms in South Meridian, so I was completely take aback.  They had also just debited my account for $30 two days prior.  I am sure they will not be refunding me, so I will just have to take the loss, but I should have backed out long ago.  Time to find a new gym that actually cares about its customers, the people who pay their paychecks.

I am pretty disappointed as I have heard good things about this place.  I took my sister to breakfast.  It was fairly busy but no wait.  We were seated handed menus asked if we wanted anything to drink and left.  We waited about 10 minutes for her to come and take order.  After we ordered it took 20 minutes to get our food.  It was served pretty luke warm.  I was too hungry to complain but even if I would have wanted to, the waitress never came back to see if our food was acceptable, good, bad etc.  I don't think I will be going back.  Star Cafe here I come!

Let me preface this review by stating that I completely understand that this is a 24/7 emergency animal hospital, where emergencies happen at only a moment's notice.  In these cases the staff can only do so much at a time.  I understand this and politely respect their dedication and service to our four-legged friends.

However, when you make an appointment and have to wait up to 30-45 minutes in the waiting room only to be herded into an exam room for an additional 25-30 minute wait before even being seen by the techs (plus an additional wait time to see the doctor) while other people who come in after you for non-emergency treatments are seen almost immediately, something is wrong.

This has been our experience with every visit here.  Long wait times aside, we have seen a different vet for every visit, and each of them have prescribed different drugs and different care plans while seemingly never having consulted the chart from the previous visits, as if they have never seen us before.  Long story short, we have spent hundreds of dollars on treatment plans for our special-needs dog that in the end turned out to be unnecessary.  It's almost as if they are so overloaded with patients that there is no time to plan ahead and ask questions, they just seem to be quick to prescribe expensive treatment plans and get the patient out the door as quickly as possible.

In the end we ended up switching vets, and as soon as we did, the new vet informed us that our Boy was long overdue for some necessary vaccines.  They found out this information after reviewing the records that they got from All Valley.  Throughout our repeated visits to All Valley, they  never informed us that our Boy was overdue for these important vaccines.

The one star goes to the waiting room, which is very nice and has privacy walls for our Boy who gets very anxious around other dogs.  Other than that, rude front desk staff and a medical team that acts like we are first-timers and treats you like a number to be herded through instead of a loyal patient.

My lawn was in terrible shape in the summer of 2018.  I tried to resurrect and made things worse. I decided to seek help for the 2019 season and am now in my second year with them. From texting to phone calls to email, I've had nothing but a great communication experience with them. And the results have been incredible. I'm sharing two side by side photos from May 2019 to May 2020. Very happy with this service!

Wow! 

Just Wow!!!

If you haven't tried this authentic high quality restaurant, you're truly missing out.

Simply superb, fresh, made-from-scratch food. A remarkable find and a spot worth moving to Boise for. 

It's that good.

These outstanding tastes were complemented by a very hard working and proud owner. We loved it!

My wife had just completed medical school interviews nearby, and we couldn't have asked for a better oasis to reconnect prior to our five hour drive back to Bend, Oregon.

I have an auto loan with Icon and their online service is horrible. You can't see anything other than current payment amount, due date and that's it. It's like a 12 year old designed their website. Extremely frustrating loan experience. I don't recommend getting an auto loan with them.
Great place for smoked ribs, tri tip and chicken!  Outside dining in our small town of Lockeford

Ordered steak supreme philly.  The bread was yummy.  Too bad the
rest of the ingredients were garbage.  Even my dog turned his nose.

My buddy brought me to Shari's and told me that it is better than Denny's. I am the type of person who can barely drive past a Denny's without stopping in so I was skeptical to say the least. 

We were seated promptly and had waters and menus within thirty seconds. I ordered the veggie omelette with a side of french toast and my buddy got a fiesta chicken omelette with hash browns and toast. I was expecting a single slice of French toast and a mediocre omelette but I was shocked by what I got. Two slices of thick French toast and an omelette filled with mushrooms, spinach, onions, and blue cheese, then topped with avocado, onion, tomato, green onion, and cheddar. I inhaled the food. 

We came in on a Saturday morning for brunch and the wait time to get our food was less than ten minutes. Overall, a wonderful experience. The prices are actually less than Denny's when you factor in how big the sides are. I just wish I had had room for pie!

Craig is fantastic.  I can honestly say that the carpets look better after us moving-out than when we moved in three years ago.  I don't know how he did it, but he did 1000x better and his rates are so reasonable.  If I need any work done in our new home or someone needs a recommendation, he is at the top of my list.  Thank you Craig!

I just switched to Crunch today and I already love it! The staff is so friendly and helpful! Lauren got me set up today quickly and I was able to use the gym within 15 minutes! No waiting at a fitness counselors desk for an hour. Would highly recommend over any other gym, the facilities and extras they offer are amazing for the price!
Really good food and service.  If you're a mask wearer, understand they aren't, but you can wear one anyway.

Cold inside and not allowed to sit on the patio?  Went for happy hour and were told management was in a meeting and we had to sit in the dinning room.  She also said we could move if the patio opened.  To our shock, when we left there were people on the patio.  Oh...and can I get service?  Empty glass means...nothing.  Food was meh. Love the variety on the menu, the chopped salad, meatball appetizer, tempura sushi, all SO good! It's a fun atmosphere and our kids love it too, with the mix and match bento box option! Food quality is great, it's a little pricy, but I'll pay more for good quality food! So grateful to have a great go-to favorite!

What a perfect way to end your day of shopping!  We made reservations (thankfully) so we were seated immediately! The place was pretty busy the whole time we were there.. 
Our waitress was very nice and accommodating, I ordered the macadamia nut chicken... I really don't have words to describe how delicious that was.. the crust was perfect, and the nuts were ground up so there wasn't any "chunks" of nuts... the sauce on top matched the chicken perfectly.. and it had a small amount of apple sauce on the side to dip it into... it was like a flavor explosion in my mouth! The stars alined! I wanted to eat the entire thing but I knew their was no way! The mashed potato's blended perfectly with the dish and the broccolini was still slightly firm. I went back to Joe Mommas for breakfast today. My wife, daughter and I love to go to new places and review them.

We went on Sunday morning and thought we would get there early enough to beat the crowd. We were wrong. My advice to anyone that is thinking of coming here is to use the app to check in ahead of time. Just go to their web site.

We waited 20 minutes and as we were leaving, we heard them tell someone that the wait would be over an hour. The good news is if you do have to wait, they have a really nice large waiting area.

If it stays busy here like it has been, my advice to the owners of Joe Momma's would be to reduce the size of the waiting room and use that space to increase the size of the dining area and add more tables and/or booths. 

Being from Texas, I had to try their CFS (Chicken Fried Steak) this time. Their version of a CFS is made from a Flat Iron Steak, so this peaked my curiosity. The reigning king of the CFS in the Boise/Meriain area is Goodwood. What follows is the blow by blow account of the battle.

"In this corner weighing in at 1 pound of Round Steak, the reigning heavyweight, The CFS from GoodWood. (GW for short)" 

"In this corner, weighing in at a 1/2 pound of Flat Iron Steak is the contender for the crown, The CFS from Joe Mamma's (JM). 

Most every restaurant uses round steak for their CFS, and there is good reason for this. Round Steak can be made so its fork tender and is pretty darn flavorful. Every place that has tried to make a CFS from a different cut of meat, in an attempt to be different, has failed.

When my CFS came out, it looked fine. It did have a weird looking uptick on the end that, if I did not know better, I would have thought it was a tail. I wondered if they had given me fish by mistake. But then I realized this was probably due to how they cooked it. 

"The CFS from JM attempts to land a shot to the head of the CFS from GW, but completely misses"

The steak was way overcooked and almost tasted burnt. As expected, the meat was tough and nowhere near fork tender like a good CFS should be. 

"The CFS from GW lands a huge uppercut to the head of the CFS from JM"

The crust had completely separated from the meat. So what I ended up with was some bites that contained both the crust and meat and many other bites that were nothing but crust. The meat was also way smaller than the crust. So it was like a smaller portion of meat floating inside an outer shell crust.

"The CFS was JM tries another blow to the head of The CFS from GW, but again completely misses."

The final piece of this puzzle is flavor. After all, everything else can be forgiven if the flavor is there. Alas, the meat had none. The gravy was of no help either. If the gravy had not have been there, I would have never known it. The final part was the crust of the CFS, but it was also flavorless. 

"The CFS from GW lands the fatal blow to the head of the CFS from JM confirming its reign and superiority"

I also tried their house potatoes this time around. I was very impressed with these. Many places serve hard potatoes that almost seem raw and have little real flavor. These potatoes are nice and tender and had a good potato flavor.

I love going on these restaurant reviews with my wife and daughter because they always share their food with me. My wife says; "hunny, you have to try this. Or my daughter says; "Daddy (yeah she is a teen and still calls me Daddy) do you want to try mine?"

My wife had something called a "Meat Scramble" with Bacon as her meat. Its basically scrambled eggs with meat. I tried it and it tasted good, but very very baconny. If you love bacon, you will probably like it. For me, the balance of Bacon to Cheese to Egg was off. As a side to her dish, she had a pancake. The pancake took up the entire plate and was light and fluffy. It is one of the better pancakes I have had.

As a side to my CFS, I had a biscuit. This was one of the best biscuits I have had and I have had a lot of them over the years. I was disappointed that they only gave me 1. The star though was the jam. They brought out a Marionberry and Strawberry for me. 

Just about every place I have ever been too serves very boring jam in those small square plastic containers that are made for restaurants. They have very little actual fruit in them and even less fruit flavor. Well, Im happy to say that you wont find them at Joe Mammas. The jam here is made in house and is good. I could actually taste fresh Strawberries. It was one of the best Strawberry jams I have ever had.

The Marionberry was way to sweet for me and so less good, but still leaps beyond any pre-packaged jam. I will have to return here someday and try the house-made hash. 

They really need to list House Made jam on their menu. Very Very few places make their own jam and for me, it's a HUGE reason to come here.

In spite of a few misses, this is my vote for the best breakfast in town!

I am the 22nd Yelper to review Shari's in Meridian near the freeway- Easy on and off the freeway if you're a traveler. This is my 429th review. 

I've visited Shari's, many different locations, for years. It's never been my "go-to" choice because the portions are "average" and I used to be (on vacation from) an overeater wanting the big portions. But now I've learned that Shari's has good food! It's a chain, so you're not getting the small town feel, local establishment atmosphere like you would elsewhere. 

Today I didn't order food. It's the last day of the month so it's... CHEAT DAY! ...and all month I've been craving Shari's pie and it did... NOT... Disappoint! Marie Calenders closed here in town, so Shari's is a great place to grab a yummy pie and at a good value (12.99-14.99). They have lot's of pies: creamy caramel pecan crunch! Banana Cream Dream!! Smores galore!!! Sweet Montana Cherry!!!! Strawberry Rhubarb Delight!!!!! Oregon Marionberry!!!!!! Dutch Apple!!!!!!! Coconut (okay, too many !!'s)!  Sour Cream Lemon, Chocolate cream supreme, Peanut Butter Chocolate Silk and Strawberry Cream Cheese!!!!!!!!!!! (yes, that one deserves all the !'s). So good! And quicker than running into Wal-Mart and it's open 24 hours!!! 

UBER EATS!

I don't know if it was an anomaly,  but the food today was awful. The French fries were twice cooked and burned, and th gyro meat was much to salty. They also had no ketchup.  There's an Albertsons a stones throw away. The lack of enthusiasm for service did not help. After all, I was the only customer . Management issues?
  I'm an occasional patron, and it's hard to earn back business when you lose it. Perhaps an explanation  is in order.

53rd person to review Sofra Bosnian Grill, Meridian, Idaho on Overland and Eagle. This is my 410th review on Yelp. 

I enjoyed my time here. It's a nice, small, relaxed environment. The food was very good as well. I haven't eaten too much Bosnian in my life, but what I have, I've really liked. 

The server was the owner. She was very friendly, answered any questions that I had and made suggestions. I saw the people working in the back, hard manual labor, from scratch, which makes the food taste so much better! 

I am glad that I went here and I will be back for sure.

First to review. 
My 395th Yelp review. 

AS GOOD AS IT GETS! 
Perhaps I am somewhat biased because I really like the Sunrise menu and I've been a fan of the brand since my kids were little (15 years now). However, each one is different, have their own subculture, and even variations of the menu (from my understanding several of the late owner's children own different franchises of the establishment and one started the Egg Factory).

I like the home cooking feel of the brand. The food is large in size and everything tastes super delicious! This is a new location (March 2018) and it's located on a corner lot, near the Majestic Theatre. This location has a sports theme with memorabilia on the wall and a bar in the middle, something New to the Sunrise brand, although I don't believe they sell alcohol. 

Good location, great service, and really, really yummy food! P.S. They have the best homemade RANCH!

It's 2019, let's just spend the extra few bucks and get flavored creamer. Take one of the 3 types of Tabasco off the table and that'll cover your cost. And your staff won't always have to say, sorry no we don't have flavored creamer. 
Now, the food is just ok too. Nothing to write home about. Not a ton of flavor, just run of the mill. Actually, and I know this might blow your mind, but I'd much rather eat at Cracker Barrel. They also don't have flavored creamer but at least their food taste decent.

So grateful for Dr. Blair and his staff. I brought my 4 year old twins in for their first dental appointment and they made the whole process fun and not scary for the kids. They explained everything in terms they understood and listened to their questions and provided simple answers. My son asked when we could come back so I know he felt positive about the experience. Thank you, Dr. Blair! We are so happy we found all of you!

This place was superb! Probably the best breakfast eatery in all of Boise/Meridian area. The waitlist is pretty crazy on weekends - but if you plan ahead, you'll be fine. I brought my Mom and she absolutely raves about it every time she comes to my house. It was honestly, the best breakfast I've probably ever had. Must try it out.

The only reason I didn't give this place 5 stars is because of the customer service we experienced today.  We always used eat here until today, and used to love their food.  Let me explain what happened: 

We arrived there this afternoon (12/22) and walked up to the front door at 1:50pm as another couple of 2 was right behind us walking in.  The Open sign was up on the door.
