We walk through the first set of doors and as we reach to open the second set of doors the hostess that was inside behind the hostess counter began shaking her head no and swiping her hand back and forth on across her neck to motion "no" or "not a good idea".  

My 20 year old daughter said, "oh I guess they're closed" but the hours listed and on the door said they were open until 2pm. This hostess never came to talk to us, or apologize for not allowing us to enter, but just mouthed the words "were closed" several times while motioning at her neck and shaking her head.  

The couple behind us became upset as well, stating it wasn't even 2 yet.  This woman still never left the hostess counter to say anything to the two groups of customers she just turned away.  

As our group turned to walk out the second couple was upset and opened the door when we could hear the awful hostess say, "We close at 2." When the man said "but it's not even 2 yet?" She said "but we're full anyways".  They were not full, and quite far from it at this point.  She must not realize they have windows all around the restaurant.  

I was so appalled at this level of customer service I can't support a business that conducts themselves in this manner.  If they refuse to allow customers to enter their restaurant if it's within 10 minutes of closing, then they should change their hours to show they close at 1:50pm rather than 2pm.  I have never heard of a restaurant doing this.  If a restaurant lists their hours from 12-4 then the doors stay unlocked and people should be seated until 4pm, then lock the doors and take down your open sign, but continue to serve the people in your restaurant.

This is our current foreign food go to! Every time we have gone there, the place is frequented by Bosnians, and if that isn't a good sign, I don't know what it is. We have tried the meat, cheese, and spinach bureks, the cevapi sausage, the kefir, the gyros and fries and the side salads. We have also tried the honey cake dessert. Our favorite, by far, are the cheese bureks!! The meat comes in close second but has a ton of onion that stays with you for hours afterwards. The customer service is out of this world . We can't recommend this place enough.

Now if they would just extend their hours and add more weekend hours we would be on cloud nine!!

My husband and I just bought a home from CBH. Being first time home buyers we weren't too sure what to expect. My parents came the day we moved in to check out the house and they were amazed with the craftsmanship of the house, so they bought a house too. My parents had bought their first house as a tract home as well and were by how well built the house was including the insulation. The house has a very simple design on the inside and we love it because it is really easy to add our little touches to make the home ours. The only negative I could say is the paint chips very easily, but they left touch up paint so it is really easy to fix.

Since the covid19 has hit Idaho, its been advised to stay at home. I just found out this week that Wagner Farms sells fruit and vegetable boxes. Small, medium and large boxes are so convenient! We preordered a medium box on Wednesday and paid via Venmo. We drove up today, they asked for our name and loaded our car without us even getting out! They were super friendly and quick! Looking through our loot, everything was so fresh and beautiful! We are so excited to eat our produce! We will absolutely be ordering again!

Periodically I get back spasms, and in typical fashion I exhaust my home remedies and treatments before I hobble into Golden Massage Spa--now the only place I'll go when I can't walk.  The pain in my back was so bad I couldn't stand upright, and for 90 minutes the therapist worked (mostly fought) with my 6'3'' 220 pound frame.  While walking on my back she was pressing so hard I thought she was going to push through the roof of the building as I could hear the walls and ceiling flexing!  I can't express how grateful I am that they are skilled enough to be able to help me when I was twisted up so badly.  

The store is super clean and relaxing, as are the curtained rooms.  The staff are friendly, responsive, and genuinely want to help.  I can't thank them enough and give them incredibly high marks.

i took my family to Twigs last night. Ok, so my wife dragged me to Twigs. So Sue me.

Speakin of So Sue Me, do you know of this sound on the Mac? Its actually called SoSumi. When Apple was 1st coming out with the Macintosh line of computers many years ago, they were going to have all these cool sounds. Before Apple, there was no such thing as sound in computers.

The music industry did not like it because Apple was infringing in their turf. Music. They told Apple not to put sounds into its computers

Well, Apple decided, in tru Apple style to do it anyway. They named one of these system sounds in commencement of the music industries opposition and called it "So Sue Me" (SoSume).

Ok, back to the review. I am more of a tee shirt, shorts, sandles and peanuts on the floor type of guy. Nod here to Texas Road House.

My wife is more of a foofoo upscale type of diner. Like Cheese Cake Factory, which this place reminds me of.

So, going to Twigs was not my 1st choice, or even my 111th choice. Even the name "Twigs" did not sounds good. It gave me visions of Rabbit Food and well. twigs. I want meat to eat, not very small tree branches.

But to keep the peace and keep harmony in a marriage, its a really good idea to keep your wife happy. 

Happy wife, happy life!

So off we went to Twigs. I have to say that I was pleasantly surprised. There were several things on the menu that raised my attention level. Unfortunately, many of them are just way to foofoo and expensive for me.

So I settled on the Hamburger. The one that got juices flowing was the Roasted Garlic Gorgonzola Burger. Garlic???? Color me there!

My daughter had the Oodles of Noodles. My wife had the BBQ Chicken Cobb. 

I was amazed when my burger came out to see full sized cloves of garlic. Not just a few wimpy pieces of Garlic, but FULL SIZED GARLIC CLOVES!

Count Dracula would never order this burger. In fact, he would probably die from the very sight of it.

I have to admit that I was scared. In all my years, and I have quite a few of them, I have never seen full sized cloves of Garlic used on anything, much less a hamburger.

I hesitated, but worked up the courage to take a bite. Wow! The Garlic Cloves were cooked in such a way that they were soft and chewy. I even took one out to try it on its own. It was like biting into butter, and had no bitter garlic taste at all. In fact, If I had not known it was garlic, I might have wondered what it was. 

It did taste like garlic, but it did not have a strong flavor at all.

The menu said that the burger was a half pound patty. I am not sure I buy that one. The hamburger though was good. I did not taste any Gorgonzola though.

It tasted charbroiled and smoky, I am a fan on this burger. I could taste what was an attempt to do something interesting with their fries, but it was just no where near enough to make them stand out.

My daughter was brought out a huge mountain of noodles. I was amused to see that they carried this hugeness of the noodles onto the actual check at the end of the meal. Every other item is in a normal small case. But the OODLES OF NOODLES was all in upper case.

The noodles were....well, what can I say about noodles. They were nothing special. Just noodles.

My wifes BBQ chicken salad was good. The BBQ sauce had a pretty good smoky flavor to it. I was not expecting that. The chicken was tender and juicy. 

I will be back
I recently had my Toyota 4Runner tinted here. They did a great job, were super quick to get me in and out, and their prices are reasonable.  Will definitely bring more business here in the future.
I had the same exact experience of Natalie and Jen- totally left exposed and door left open- not relaxing at all. Will not return

My first time to ever eat at Twigs. I'm going to be honest here, and say, it will be my last.  For the price and description of the entrees, I was just expecting something more.  I ordered the grilled Coulette, medium.  This cut of meat was well done if not more.  There was no pink, it was tough. It reminded me of eating a cheap steak from the grocery store as a kid. It was tough.  The Gorgonzola fondue was very overwhelming, slathered over a tough steak. I left looking for something else to eat, somewhere else to get the taste out of my mouth.  The service was decent, and my mixed drink was good as well.

This place is incredibly delicious! I always go on bike rides and stop here. All of her desserts are AMAZING!!! The food is incredible!! It's also a very affordable place! I can never decide what to get here, everything is so good!

Wow! If you would like terrible customer service and a sandwich that has literally 2 pieces of meat on it then this is the place to go. Otherwise, FORGET IT! I've been multiple times hoping for a better experience and its just not happening so dont bother.

You know what this is. .it's a grocery store, nothing fancy,  no super center, just basically groceries. But...just had such fantastic service I had to say something!  

Phyllis (aka, awesome night time checker ) went out of her way to tell me the better price on the larger bag of chips avd go grab them AND then. .gave me a coupon for items I had but had forgotten the coupon-that's nice!  Thanks Phyllis!

Save your money and dog or cats safety. Take your time and business to another vet. My dog has a broken hip and potentially a broken rib. I called I brought my dog in 12/11/2018 and have called in 4 times now being told each day we will have a vet call you back. So here we are on 12/15/2018 now it is 1:07pm and I just called in being 100% respectful to be told the vet that was supposed to call me is on vacation and wont be back till Monday which is 12/17/2018. ( ok yeah let me just wait 6 days to hear back about if my dog has a broken rib or not) and after had just paid almost 400 dollars and waited 3 hours to be seen. Whats even worse while we are waiting another 20 minutes in the vet room all you hear in the back is oh can she cover this shift, I need to start going to this gym, I wanna try that place. You guys need to figure out a new system badly because this is beyond infuriating. Let me check your dog out for broken ribs and make you wait a week and each time calling in have you be told. (oh.. hopefully we will hear something back soon) (middle finger).

We just ate there tonight, we ordered Nachos "without" pico, but they came with pico, when we asked to get new ones the waiter asked, "are you allergic to Pico"? like that has anything to do with it. 3 min later he came back and I quote, "here are your new nachos". However, as we started to eat them we noticed pico still on and in the nachos, they simply picked through my food and removed it with their hands. Seriously? The other waitress said that the manager would be right over, 20 min later still no manager and we left. That combined with simply terrible service, I will never be back. Oh but hey, they didn't make me pay for those nachos, so nice of them. Worst restaurant in Meridian.

Another anniversary marking 7 years since I underwent a horribly botched surgery at St. Luke's Meridian Hospital.  Instead of experiencing a carefully and cautiously executed surgery, the Meridian employed general surgeon expanded the targeted surgery as he ran amuck removing normal body parts and destroying nerve(s).  Impossible to forget given the result, the permanent loss of my voice, the cause of a surgically induced and permanent rare disorder, and the unrelated removal of yet another normal body part.  Whereas, I went into the surgery a very healthy whole person, I am now disabled by the loss of my voice, and while once an extrovert am now reclusive due to my loss of the ability to communicate.  Instead of sound my voice produces mostly air due to the paralysis of my vocal cord.  I suffer from and require ongoing medical care for the irreparable surgically induced hormone disorder.  I replay my mind the experience of a horrific extended and painful recovery from massive surgery, knowing that with experienced capable hands I could have had minimally invasive surgery and minimal recovery.  Later, in conferring with experts I learned that my injuries should never have happened, they were clearly due to incompetence.  The physical suffering made indelible by the fact that the general surgeon and hospital never acknowledged their mistakes and resulting injuries, there was no accountability and no apology.  My message is this:  your doctor and your hospital will never reveal their past mistakes, and the legal system will not protect you, and even the Medical Board will never reveal your complaint to the public.  Your only defense is to do your research and seek out the very best qualified surgeon, and in fact question the need for surgery.  General surgeons are among those who are least likely to be the most qualified.

So the story with Joe Momma's is that Joe and his Mom run the place, which explains the quirky name. You could easily drive by this place if you didn't know it was here. We came into the place during the "no man's land" of one hour before closing, expecting that we would get the stink eye from both the wait staff and the cooks, but they were pleasant and accommodating. Points for that. They are slightly disorganized and not the fastest place, but the place is crowded, which is always a good sign, the food is really good, the wait staff is nice (except for Mom, who will get grumpy at you if she has to make a shake for you) and everything is cooked fresh. Not my top breakfast place, but really up near the top. I wouldn't hesitate to go here again.
Awesome massage! Loved the attention to details from the heated bed to the nice but not overpowering scent on the sheet that covered my face. The massage was wonderful and I will definitely be back!

Absolute scammers. Changed my battery and then all my lights didn't work. Took it back in and they said it would be $1200 to fix it cause all the casing was broken. Took it into the Volkswagen dealership and they diagnosed it! $62. It hadn't been plugged in correctly, I will tell everyone and anyone to NEVER use meridian auto. I am so disgusted by their dishonesty, trickery, and scamming. Shame on them

Made reservations for 8:15PM Christmas evening for 9 people. Crazy right?

We had been tearing up the kitchen for 2 days & needed to get out & let someone else clean up after us!

Checked in at 7:45PM, would be ready to seat us at our reserved time of 8:15PM. Reservations only Christmas day. When we called about 1PM 8:15PM was the earliest available time.

We were seated at 8:15PM and given the limited menu for Christmas day. Plenty to choose from, but since it was a limited menu some items weren't available. No "hard" alcohol served on Christmas day, beer, wine, and sake only. Huh?

Definitely chaotic! Too many customers & not enough staff. Food took about an hour to get to the table.

The food was good! Turkey, potatoes & broccoli. Lettuce wrapped chicken with ginger and a spicy tuna roll.

I don't usually give a 4-star review on a first visit, but the staff did a great job despite the chaos! I look forward to another visit when it's not chaotic!

Cheers - Eric

Idaho Roofing Contractors were very responsive and professional when I was getting bids to replace a roof that was improperly installed by another contractor in 2012.  It was working with attorney, insurance company, engineer and another contractor who was fixing water damages which delayed my selection of a roofer. Andrew was patient, helpful, and wasn't pushy. In the end I selected another contractor due to cost but would not hesitate one minute in referring Idaho Roofing Contractors!

I was A little skeptical about taking my  2000 Mercedes-Benz ML320 to a shop. It has 240,000 mi. on it and I do most of the work and service myself.  I needed something done on it outside of my capabilities so I called. Nick at German Star Auto was Extremely nice, helpful, and knowledgeable with the most outstanding customer service! Thanks Nick for your transparency and honesty! German Star has my business from now on.

If I can give it 0 stars I would. The servers, to the manager to even the GM are very unprofessional . Don't try and go there on a Sunday and do happy hour and kids eat free. They only honor one or the other with out a sign not mentioning that info. The GM molly is rude and does not care about her customers.  Don't recommend at all
Friendly staff, efficient service. The Big Daddy sandwich was huge and very good. Smashed potato side didn't have much zip. I'd probably select the beans next time I'm in Boise.

I ordered a soy mocha and a breakfast burrito. After finishing preparing my mocha the barista asked if it was OK to put cheese in the burrito (assuming their may be a lactose issue). It may seem like a small thing but this sensitivity to dietary restrictions is all too rare, it was clear he really cared. Overall the service was above and beyond, and everything was delicious. I can't recommend this place highly enough.

We went here several nights ago. Immediately, we knew the food would be awful because it arrived alongside our drink order that was placed at the same time. The food tasted off, but we were hungry. Part way through the meal I started to feel pretty nauseous (probably from the oily chips) and I ended up having to leave the restaurant and go sit in the car so I wouldn't have to sit at a table full of rancid tasting and smelling food. We complained to the waiter about the queso on our street nachos tasting awful and he threw a stink about us not telling him soon enough- and he wasn't going to take it off the tab. My husband requested to see the manager, who came off very combative, but ultimately removed it from our tab. We will never be back. The margaritas and free chips and salsa (chips are triple fried and nasty) weren't even good enough for a return trip. We will not be shocked if this place closes.

This gym is clean and offers a friendly, attentive staff. I recommend this gym to anyone looking to improve there over all Health and appearance. They have all the machines and equipment you can possibly need and they also offer pretty cool classes like Zumba , yoga , bootcamp, and many more. Hours of operation are also convenient.

Our Goldendoodle was having trouble walking on his front foot. My 17 year old took him in Friday night where she waited 4 hours. They said he needed surgery and thought it was cheat grass so convinced her it needed to be done that night and was done at 1am. He was sent home with pain meds and an antibiotic.  When I returned from out of town I noticed there was an oozing puncture  higher up in his foot so I took him back in Monday for a recheck and sat in my car for 3 hours. The doc on staff didn't know what the other dr had done it was not in the notes where the puncture came from. They had advised me to go back to my own vet if I didn't want to wait. But I had already invested 3 hours and my dogs foot looked infected and bleeding a lot after surgery. So I waited for the doc that did the surgery but since I had to wait in the parking lot I was not allowed to speak with him. They called me and said doc put the puncture there to drain and that they would have to put him in a stronger antibiotic costing $150 + 30 for recheck!  The surgery was already $380. At this point I have $560 invested and no resolution. After a week on stronger antibiotics it still was oozing blood and puss so I took him back to our regular vet. Long story short my vet Ada West Animal performed another surgery opened it up and easily found a 1inch piece of bark embedded. He had 3 staples and they included stronger antibiotics which the area already looked better all for $213 total! Most importantly they fixed my dog at more than 1/2 the price and more than 1/2 the time.  All Valley is expensive with poor service. Not a place I  would take my animals to again. Beware...

Today I stopped in with my 5 year old granddaughter to see about getting our hair cut together.  The woman was so rude. No hello or welcome. She just flipped the computer screen around and abruptly said... Did you check in online?  I have all these people scheduled and one in the parking lot.  There was only one person in the salon getting their hair cut and about 9 empty chairs. We went down the road and we're treated kindly and got great haircuts. I know that woman scared my granddaughter because she grabbed my hand. Not cool!

The staff are not wearing masks,  at least 2 salespeople we saw did not have masks on, and they were waking through the store taking loudly. Very unsafe! Also they do not ask customers to wear masks. Take your business elsewhere to a company that cares.

Great name..  less then great experiance. Staff acts annoyed to be there. Food was all over the map as far as quality. Burger and pinnapple panckaes were amazing. Biscuits and gravy were so bad as to be almost worth sending back. Ditto steak fingers. Staple items like eggs, hasbrowns, bacon were totally unremarkable. On par with a hotel buffet breakfast.

The real star loss is the service. Quoted us a 1215 reservation. Didnt seat us til 1245. Despite walk in 4 and 6 tops getting immediate seating. Food came almost and hour later. Repeated queries for updates were met with "doing the best we can". No smile. No apologies. Mandatory 18% tip for large tables so whats the incentive for good service other then pride of place. Obviously not here. Blonde tatooed host lady was flat out nasty. We would be unlikely to return.

Let me start by saying I love the atmosphere when I came in last Saturday! The place was nicely decorated with Christmas lights and decor, the staff was busy but very polite. I was in one of the parties in the back room and Michelle was our server. My friends and I can be a little difficult at times but Michelle never cracked and always had a smile on her face and a positive attitude. We ordered the buy 3 pizzas get 4th free and they all turned out to taste amazing! "The Smoky" with garlic and jalapeños was my favorite. All my friends and I will be back!

This store is quite unique. It has a kind of business professional type atmosphere probably because of its location right next to St. Luke's hospital and the tall Portico Office Tower in front of the store. 

Baristas are very courteous, polite, and very efficient. While I was ordering my coffee with the cashier, the barista was getting started on my drink. By the time I wamy wallet back in my pocket, my drink was ready. I was pleasantly surprised by this. 

Also, their north side wall is simply amazing. It's like nothing I've ever seen before and it really gives the store that special coffee feel. 

My only note is that tables are quite small and I had a hard time having more than one item out while I was doing homework. Nevertheless, this is a great spot to meet up on a date or simply catch up with a close friend.

Really recommend you come check out this store and have a nice pumpkin spice latte.
Love this salon. The ladies are the absolute Best!!! I recommend them to anyone looking for a new place to go.

So I called in for a carry out...  the lady takes my order tells me my total which I was like hmm high for pizza but whatever.  Then says that since I ordered 3 pizzas I get one for equal or lesser value for free.  But my total goes up about $10. How is that a free pizza when I didn't need another but if it's free whatever..  so had the girlfriend pick it up and bring this concern up to them. They give her a 2 liter soda to make up for it.  Hmmm a two liter for $10 wtf.  So I call and talk to the manager who took the order.  Right off the gate soo fn rude would not even explain why this went up in price but yet won't even be respectful.  Who the heck are they leaving in charge.  She Says I got a free pizza but no ... I got a 2 litter for 10 dollars. What a scam.  I Can't have a civilized conversation "with the manager" about why and get hung up on.  Never will we use Smokey mountain again. .... I have a business and would never talk to my customers in such a away ... nor will the company be using the services for any company events after the disrespect and lack of communication...

Super clean shop...employee was so friendly and helpful.

Good flavors of yogurt available and I loved the toppings bar.

Oh my gosh I can't believe I've gone this long without experiencing the yumminess at Twigs.  We were invited to a friend's birthday dinner with a group of about 12 people.  The host made a reservation for 6:30 PM and when we arrived they were already waiting.  The best part about eating in larger groups is you get to try ALL THE THINGS!  The downside is that the service is sometimes slower.  Hence the 4 stars (for now), our service could have been better but we will be back to try again in the near future.  

Drinks-  This place is known for their martinis so of course I ordered one.  I chose the Strawberry Lemon Drop and was rather underwhelmed.  Fair warming, it is disgustingly sweet!  I would definitely categorize this as a dessert cocktail.  I passed mine around the table as I was being heckled for not drinking it and most people in the group agreed that it wasn't the greatest.  My husband on the other hand had a wonderful patron margarita that he enjoyed very much.  Everyone else around the table enjoyed their drinks which included a  Twigs Martini, Margarita, Beer & Wine.  

Appetizers-  I really wasn't joking when I said we tried all the things.  We ordered quite a variety of appetizers to share throughout the table and they were all delicious.  We had Calamari a la Romana, Twigs Signature Fries with Gorgonzola Fondue, Crab & Artichoke Dip,  The Works Pizza and Garlic Pesto Chicken Pizza.  It was all wonderful!  We ordered a second round of the Gorgonzola Fondue to go with our dinner fries but it was forgotten about.  They did give us some to go so we'll see how it is on second warming.  I will definitely be ordering pizza again because it would be perfect for lunch.  Something, if not several, had a hint of heat to it so I look forward to investigating that more in the future.

Dinner- After so many appetizers we were pretty full by the time dinner arrived.  My husband ordered a Prime Rib Dip with fries from the Fresh Sheet menu and he said it was a little on the dry side.  I ordered the Chicken Bacon Avocado sandwich with a side of Loaded Baked Potato Soup.  The soup was AMAZING but I wasn't a huge fan of the BBQ Chipotle sauce on the sandwich and will probably never order that again.  I'm secretly hoping that ALL of their soup is just as good as the potato because this will be my new go to spot for fall.

Dessert-  Okay if for nothing else, I will definitely be back to indulge in more dessert (possibly before the week is over).  We shared desserts around the table like we did the appetizers.  Definitely had to try the Rocky Mountain Bread Pudding from the Fresh Sheet (my choice) and it was good but a little on the dry side as well.  We also ordered Drunken Donuts, The Sticky Cookie and Chocolate Haupia (Birthday Girl's choice).  The Sticky Cookie was hands down my favorite dessert but I can't wait to try the Crème Brulee as well.  

One of the best parts about this restaurant was the ambience.  The décor is beautiful but not over the top and you can actually carry on a dinner conversation.  After enjoying a wonderful meal you can also take a nice stroll and enjoy the ambience of The Village at night.

The service here was excellent and the food was to die for. Our server Kayleena was very friendly, punctual, and efficient. It was our anniversary and smoky mountain made our special day great! Thank you!!

I paid around $70 at the cash register. Then was packing my groceries and the WinCo plastic bag teared up and  a glass jar with Alfredo sauce dropped on the floor. And the plastic bag was not even heavy.  Nobody even offered me to replace it. It is not about the money, it is about the customer service. I showed a plastic bag to the  cashier, she just looked at me and said nothing.  Every week I spend around $100-150 at this store. I just felt they just didn't care about me, because I already paid for my groceries and it is my problem. I don't think I will shop  there again. I felt really down when I left the store thinking employee own store doesn't mean anything

Just finished. The country Bennie it was yummy. As a breakfast aficionado I am adding this to my list of potential morning targets. 

The atmosphere is warm and inviting. It is both classic Breakfast. And modern with out over doing the kitch or the spariness. The staff is quick,  helpful and nice. Booths large and tables are not tight. It's a well thought out space. 

Our table ordered two  full country Bennies. ( biscuit scrambled egg grilled sausage patty and gravy) and a Special. Which was truly phenomenal it was a chorizo stuffed chili rellano. Which was battered and fried on top of a scrambled egg. Three of four of us had the potato casserole ( hash browns with cheese and green onion)  that they are know for. The odd one out had ranch potatoes normal ole breakfast potatoes. But still really good. One of the bennies we had split and it was no hassle. The waitress brought it to the table on two plates. Perfect. 

Over all. This place is a hit. Service food and ambiance all. Very good ... I'm going back.
Delicious BBQ, I had the 50/50 pulled pork and beef w/ a side of mac and cheese. The pickle fries were good too.  Great staff!  I'll be back for sure.

Wow, what a great egg's Benedict. I came with a friend & her meal looked great too. This is like an old fashioned diner with all the great foods. The only complaint I had was that they stopped pouring coffee as soon as we finished eating. No one was waiting for tables & they weren't busy at the time. Our coffee was only refilled once when the food came. Other than that, the food & atmosphere are great!
SO. GOOD. The bread bowls are amazing, especially if you're lucky enough to get clam chowder before it sells out. And the service is the best!

My first time there.  It's in the Village Shopping Center, which is gorgeous.  The hostess was friendly and our server was great.  They did make a mistake on my order (no biggie) and offered us a free dessert.  We ordered the coconut rum cake which was awesome.  The food was all good and so were the drinks we ordered.  I think my only complaint was it was a bit expensive for what it is.  I attribute that to high rent in that location.

But I would go back, probably not as often as I would like to.

My husband and I cannot say enough about Big Wood Cabinets. 

We received numerous designs/estimates from others including big box stores and private contractors, and picked BWC because Monte was so wonderful to work with, and gave us a fantastic price for the amazing quality we wanted. 

The process was smooth and so easy, Jessica was always prompt to get back to us with any questions we had, and the schedule was laid out and right on time. 

The crew that did the demo was fast and left the area cleaner than when they started. Alex and his assistant James, did all the install and finish work, and we could not have asked for nicer or more talented men. Every last detail was meticulous. They showed up every day, and swept the area clean every night before they left.  The handwork is stunning. 

This wasn't our first experience with remodeling, but it was certainly our very best one, and we can highly recommend this great team!  We love everything about our new kitchen, and are thrilled with the process and the result.
Good  quality food, friendly engaging environment loved the uniqueness of the service and product.  A bit pricey for breakfast but just a great place to enjoy a good meal.

We were riding around in Meridian on Black Friday and needed a place for lunch.  A couple of places the wait was too long, the menu too costly, or just not a good fit for whatever reason.  We needed to do some more shopping ("needed" - ha ha) at the Village so decided to go there.  I had a recollection of Twig's being good, but expensive.  I checked their menu online and noticed they had $10 lunch specials and called them to confirm that they were still offering them.  And they were.

My daughter ordered the Crispy Cod Sandwich:
Beer battered fried cod on a brioche bun with Dijon tartar sauce, sliced tomato, and shredded iceberg lettuce. Served with your choice of side.

And I ordered the Classic BLT:
Toasted sourdough layered with bacon, crisp lettuce, sliced tomatoes, and garlic aioli. Served with your choice of side. 

We were both very pleased with our lunches.  We both ordered fries for our side and they were delicious, perfectly cooked, and aplenty.  The only criticism, if even one, is the bread on my "classic" BLT.  Sourdough.  Is that classic?  I don't recall that being classic.  I thought it was always just plain white bread.  So, the taste was different obviously.  I enjoyed it just the same.  Even Bon Appetit's recipe for a BLT calls for square white bread.

Our server whose name I don't recall was attentive and warm.
Twig's is a really nice place with great food, great service, and a lunch deal - I'll have to keep them in mind for future lunches.

The most disappointing service in town! After 2 years I'm out! They have not corrected the issue with BLACK OIL being put on your wheels during a car wash and when I went to cancel my 2 years of monthly subscriptions the associate was dismissive and rude. Your NOT the only game in town anymore and you've lost a good customer of 2 cars. Sad.

I looooove the patio, but the quality of the food has seriously  declined. The last 3 times I've went, I've left feeling  like my dollars weren't well spent. I expect great food when I decide to go out. The best food in The Village is either Cacicias, Riceworks or Calle 75... the rest are yawnable.

I was very pleased this morning with the service and food quality. This was my first time ordering and picking up food curbside but, considering the current state of things, it was very good experience. Everything was at the same normally high standards and we will be returning soon for curbside or dine in once we have that opportunity.

The fact that I can smoke a better brisket is a huge red flag! We used to be frequent diners and have seen this restaurant's quality slip big time. Please read your reviews, don't hang on the coattails or rave reviews of yesteryear. The fading "best BBQ restaurant in Meridian" stickers didn't mean a damn thing today. 

Restaurant- Located in a strip mall on Cherry, you'd drive by it and never know it was there. Interior is sort of country style. There is quite a bit of damaged drywall that hasn't been repaired lately, which is off putting.  

Menu- It's not huge! The food SHOULD be stellar given the simplicity! It's smoked meat on salad or bread or by itself! 

Food- I smoke meat myself and I can tell you beyond a shadow of a doubt that brisket shouldn't be dry and salty. The rub was WAY too heavy and completely kills the smoked flavor. The quality of the meat is very important with smoking and the brisket and sausages I ordered didn't seem to be of a high quality. This is an unfortunate complaint to have because when I go out, I expect to eat better prepared food than what I can do at home. Our pickle fries appetizer was one mass of batter and pickle as well. It was admitted that the freezer that they are kept in is dying and the pickle fries had thawed before being dropped in the oil. 86 them instead of serving them as a huge mass to an already jaded customer. My wife's salad included the butt of the lettuce. That's just flat out LAZY. 

Customer service- The servers apparently knew about the busted freezer but let us hang anyway. Thank goodness for them being free from our previous poor experience! That's just poor customer service right there, pushing poorly prepared food and not warning people. No food should be stored in a freezer that can't keep food frozen! And why are you freezing the fries and pickle fries? 

Overall- I smoke better meat with baby's first pellet smoker on my patio; do better than my Treager.

This review is for the St. Luke's Travel Medicine and Immunizations Clinic in Meridian.  I'm traveling later this year to Mozambique and South Africa and was pretty nervous about all the immunizations and medications I'd need.  I went to Saint Alphonsus' travel medicine center first and after a one hour consultation, was even more confused and full of questions.  Basically, the NP there spent an hour reading the CDC recommendations to me and then said I'd have to make my own decisions on what to get.

Upon advice from my fellow travelers, I made an appointment at St. Luke's travel clinic.  They had a cancellation and got me in the same day I made the appointment.  Sarah Sparks, DNP is amazing!  She went through all the precautions and information, discussed her recommendations with me, and answered all my questions.  I got great advice on which vaccinations I really needed, which ones I might want to get boosters for, found my previous immunizations through ISIS, and before I left, I'd started on the process (shots are not my favorite but at least typhoid is a series of pills).  They even phoned in my prescriptions to my pharmacy for my malaria, antibiotic, and sleeping pills for the airplane.  Easy peasy.  Sarah and her nurse were friendly, professional, and easy to understand.  I feel much more confident and ready to explore the world. 

Best part is they will bill my insurance directly so I only paid my office co-pay during the visit.  Saint Alphonsus has you pay everything up front and then they will submit the services to your insurance for reimbursement.

I highly recommend St. Luke's clinic and especially Sarah for travel medicine advice.

I really don't think I've ever been so disappointed in a coffee before. We were passing through town and I wanted to try The Human Bean since I've heard great things about them. When I go to any sort of new coffee shop I always order the same thing, a iced caramel macchiato, a simple drink.
I ordered exactly that, nothing more nothing less. When I got it, all I could taste is sugar milk. No espresso, no caramel. It's was honestly so gross but we couldn't turn around since we were already on the road before I had a moment to taste it. The only reason I'm not giving 1 star is they have decent customer service. Definitely won't be going back.

I have eaten at Cafe Ole a few times now, though it has been over a year since my last visit. When last I was here, I gave Cafe Ole passable rating. So when my parents drove up from Texas for a visit, and they asked for Mexican food, I decided to try this place again.

In my party were myself, my 12 year old daughter, my wife, and my mom and dad from Texas. We arrived at 2:30 for a Lunch / dinner, which we call Linner.

We arrived for Linner and was met at the door well enough and then guided to a booth. After a few minutes, a young man came to ask for our drink order. So far so good, right?

After the had brought our drinks, next he took our order. I ordered a Chimichangas de Pollo. My wife had a Fajita salad. My daughter had Blue Corn Tacos, My dad had a combo of an enchiladas, and my mom had fajitas.

We had a long wait for our food, which was quite surprising since there was only 1 other table full that we could see. While we waited I took the opportunity to look around. The light fixture right above our table was very dusty and dirty. I imagined the dust falling off the fixture and it looking like snow falling on our plates.

Another thought that I had was that I could blow on it like one of those weeds that you pick with the white seeds that float. But then I thought better of this and decided not to. I also could not help but notice the painting on the wall that was crooked. This bugged my wife and I to no end.

When I food finally arrived, it looked fine, but that nice feeling soon dissipated as we dug in. My Chimichangas were not bad, but lacked flavor. My moms Fajatis were piled high, but the pile was all veggies with very little chicken. What chicken there was was dry and flavorless. It was like eaten star foam.

My daughters tacos were make from the same dry chicken, so there is not much else to say on this one. I have tasted better tacos from Taco Bell. My wife did not have mush to say about her salad, but it was also made from the very same chicken, so nuff said.

My dad did say that his enchilada combo was good though. So out of 6 dishes, one was good. I think in most anyplace you go, including a ball game, 1 good one in 6 is going to mean a fail.

Our waiter was not very attentive at all. Toward the end of the meal, he did come back and checked on us, but by this time, we were ready to go. At a few times during our meal, we could see him just hanging out up and the cooks area, while our drinks were left to die a slow dry death.

So, it looks like Cafe Ole has gone down hill and will probably have the same fate as the recently passed On the Border. All I will say to this is; "Vaya Con Dios Cafe Ole:"

My mom and dad took me here as a present i have been here multiple times and it was good ,but today was bad my dad returned his eggs three times and when my dad tried to talk to the manager she was extremely rude my dad said that he comes here a lot and enjoys it but today it was a little off my potatoes were burnt and my was burnt and over hard the manager Cathline then proceeded to argue with my dad saying he didn't know what he was talking about we then proceeded to get kicked out we will not be coming back to this establishment. P.S. our waiter Echoe was really nice and does not deserve to be treated in such a way.

This was our first time here and this place did not disappoint!! The service (Emmy) was outstanding standing and the food was indescribable. I had the Prime Rib Dip and it is the BEST sandwich I've ever had. The fries are super crispy and the soda ice cold and bubbly. Leaving very satisfied and I highly, highly recommend!!
they don't have a great selection of food. Wouldn't recommend the only nice thing about the restaurants was the restaurant. food was okay and service was horrible.

This BBQ place is legit and ever so tasty. This is not fast food so remember that when ordering. The brisket, chopped chicken, and tritip have been absolutely outstanding. Their gravy is the best and they have new fans.

I have been fighting with them to call back me since tuesday and went tonight got there a few mins before six truck in front of me got looked at waited ten mins to come to my car then just said closed wanted to get checked and my 15yr old checked i am type 2 diabetic and have had pneumonia before and have body aches and feel stuffed up no runny nose with. Cough  and not sure about fever and 15 yr old has asthma and has had pneumonia and feels a little warm and has cough we have 70 yr old diabetic and a 10 month old in me and my wifes home and guess what still not tested

Went with my husband, tonight.  First impression, hostesses where unfriendly and disorganized.  Because it was just the two of us, we were taken to the back room, which clearly was for overflow. I was dissappointed as it made me feel a bit ostercized(The lighting was brighter and completly different from the main room.  I also noticed there didn't appear to be any smaller tables mixed into the main dining room.) 
 But then our waiter came over.  Garret was wonderful, he picked up on the fact that I wasn't very impressed and worked very hard to get us engaged again.  He started a conversation with us and helped to warm the situation.  We both ordered Mai Tais, which wear surprising strong, and good.   We ordered the calamari starter.  Good, a bit greasy and could have used a small dash of salt.  I ordered the Macadamenia Chicken....OMG SO delicious!!   The macadamia gravy is to die for.  Husband ordered the Kona Rib eye.  He really liked the pineapple and fried onions, but thinks it was a bit over priced and could have gotten a better quality steak from Outback.  The decor was nice.  But it was a bit noisy.  Sitting so close to other tables,  made it difficult to hear at times.  Garret was a fabulous waiter, very friendly and attentive.  Give this man a promotion and or a raise!!! Great place to go for a date night.

This will forever and always be THE place in Boise to get Excellent BBQ!! Amazing owners, excellent crew at both locations and Bread Pudding!  You can't go wrong no matter what you pick but my personal order is a Big Sriracha with potato salad on the side and tater pigs to start! Plus you can order for pickup on the way home from work.

Whatchu sayin bout my momma? I can't hear you because this place is so acoustically flawed. There are two Eagle breakfast places with hard wood floors and no noise deadening fixtures - this is one of them. The other is the Griddle (formerly Original Pancake House). Designers of breakfast joints should take care to install textured wall surfaces, fabrics, or ceiling treatments. In the morning, I want a chill vibe, not a bustling echo chamber of squealing hogs at the trough.

Be prepared to wait. This is a popular spot. Put your name down and go for a walk on the greenbelt. This will make room for the high caloric extravaganza to come.

OK so now you are seated and you've got to kick it up a couple of gears to keep up with the acoustic energy of the room. Order a cup o' delicious  Dawson Taylor coffee and you will be fueled for the future.

The specialty is the Bene, quite good. Many variations are available.

The waffles are also excellent.

We had good, fast service and the bill was small. I can see why it's always packed.
Best Credit Union ever! Nicest, most helpful staff, very responsive. Also great loan rates. I switched from Wells Fargo many years ago, and have been very happy with Westmark.

Busy place but in spite of that we were taken care of in a timely manner!  We had a good experience shooting at the range.  It was a nice, clean place with good customer service.  We would go back again.

NEVER EVER EVER EVER buy a CBH home. Extremely poor and cheap quality and if I would have known what was meant by "entry level builder," I would have never have purchased one. Cheap finishes and they nickel and dime you for the most basic upgrades which are customary in other manufactures. I just opened a complaint with the Better Business Bureau on a major drainage issue in our backyard due to the poor soil and sloped yard we were left to work with, that CBH doesn't want to take responsibility for. I am going to have to rip out my entire backyard (which I installed less than a year after I took ownership of the home, and have to install an extremely expensive drain, into the thousands. They are trying to blame the actual sprinklers for the issue, however it's not an issue since three other neighbors have experienced the same issue. Avoid CBH. Worst EVER.
Beautiful property. Convenient location, phenomenal furnishings.  We had 12 people and still had tkms of room. Swimming pool was amazing and the highlight of the trip for the kids.

Ordered sweet/ habanero wings, the right combination of habanero not to overpower the wings giving them just the right amount of kick. Staff was very friendly. Waitress was very friendly and helpful on helping choose my food. Definitely a must try.
Nice love the inside bright and cheery. Awesome help, got seated right away. Waitress came right away with water. Nice clean bathrooms. And very friendly help.
Tried to sell my pro flute here. The appraiser told me it was worth about a grand, and then offered me $400 for it. Total joke. I snatched my flute and walked out.

Been coming here since it was Village Coffee. Still has the charm and a fair drink selection. The prices are reasonable and they are pretty quick to have your drink ready the biggest highlights are the seating and the service.

There are enough chars and tables for a proper get together with family and friends, one seat by the fire, a few near plugs for a laptop or phone. There's a seat for just about anyone even on their busy days. 

The service is fantastic. The crew always smiles and seems like they are treated pretty well. Some even remember my odd selections and drink requests making me feel like a regular.

There's plenty of reasons why I always seem to end up here during my free time. Keep up the great work, Royal Coffee :)

My motor fan stopped working, so no heat was coming out. I called several places and either no one could do above basic auto services, or get my car in for at least a week, which is too long in this cold. I am new to Idaho from California and so I had little knowledge of reputable auto shops. Christian Auto was able to see me right away, and provided a shuttle to and from work, which was super helpful for the 2 days my car was being fixed. Reasonable prices and honest people. Michelle, who drove me to work was just amazing! I highly recommend this place!

Our friends had been to Bono's a couple of times and really liked it so we thought we'd give it a shot. It was 8pm so I chose to order sandwiches instead of pizza so I could get the food home to feed the family. I inquired about the Italian Beef sandwich and decided to order it dry, with sweet peppers and giardiniere, with the au jus on the side. When I unwrapped it at home, I noticed it didn't have either. It was pretty boring without those items. I ordered my husband a meatball/Italian sausage sandwich. He really liked the sausage but not a big fan of the meatballs. I ordered my son a plain hot dog. I knew he wouldn't like the poppy seed bun, so I ordered it without a bun. When we unwrapped it, it was indeed in a bun. Not a big deal, but shows they don't read the order. My son said the hot dog was frozen in the middle and very hard to chew. I would like to try the pizza but probably won't go for the sandwiches again.

On March 1, 2019 I brought my 7 month old Aussiedoodle into All Valley Animal Clinic on Emerald for a routine spaying.  I picked her up at around 3:30 that same day.  I was told by the staff that she did well, and there were no problems or complications.  I brought her home and could tell she was in pain, so I gave her the pain medication they had given me.  It didn't seem to help.  She got steadily worse.  At around 7:00 PM I called the number on the instruction sheet they had given me.  It just rang and rang.  No one picked up.  I thought is strange that there was no answering machine.   Not knowing what else to do I decided to keep a close eye on her.  She would try to stand up and would just fall over.  I tried the phone number again with the same results.  At about 9:30, I noticed she was having difficulty breathing.  I called the number again and let it ring.  After 10 rings the answering machine picked up with instructions of what to do in case of an emergency.  I put my puppy in my car and rushed her over to the All Valley Clinic in Meridian, but it was too late.  She died on the way over.

They get one star because they refunded me for my puppy's surgery, and didn't charge me for her cremation.  The clinic promised me they would make changes so emergency contact information was available, but as of this writing and a week after loosing my puppy, the answering machine has not been changed.  If that is all the care they have for the animals they are responsible for, that is pretty scary.  I am posting this because I don't want anyone else to go through what I have gone through.

Absolutely 5 stars for Christian Brothers in Meridian! I made an appointment to get an alignment done on my truck and they got my truck in at the scheduled time! While this should be a given, I don't know how many times I've scheduled an "appointment" at other repair shops and hours later my truck was still in the parking lot waiting to be pulled in. Their shop and waiting area is very clean, and the staff is very friendly and professional. I will definitely be back!

The Spine Wellness Center, Humphreys Diabetes Center (incl Chronic Conditions Counseling Services!) & the Lab here are all awesome. Note I strongly recommend St Lukes BOISE Hospital or Meridian for inpatient HOSPITAL purposes.

I'm giving 5 stars only for the service Garrett gave me and my family tonight. Food was just average in my opinion. Came for a dinner with my parents and 3 kids, Garrett was very attentive and patient. Thanks Garrett!

This isn't the easiest review to do because it came from such a hard experience, but I do have to acknowledge this clinic and how truly wonderful they were last week when I had to put my dog to sleep. She was ready. She was old. She was sick. And the staff there agreed that it was what was best. They were so kind, they were helpful when deciding about the final arrangements. They let me sit with my dog for as long as a I wanted and I held her until the very end. The vet was so nice. He answered questions and walked me through the process as it happened. I hope I won't have to do this again for a long long time, but if you're looking for a compassionate clinic, this is it. Thank you.

I have been several times each time when I was with other people. I'm not exaggerating when I say I have never had good service. This for me is huge! Especially, when your paying these prices. The food & sushi are good. I have probably will not go again.
Amazing folks. They are super knowledgeable and do not take advantage of people. Will return going forward.

Excellent range, organized and professional, great facilities. The staff is very helpful and comprised of highly knowledgeable people as well as awesome combat veterans. We had an issue with some magazines we bought from another store that were jamming, and they had their gunsmith fix them for us free if charge. Highly recommended.
Excellent customer service. Clean facility and knowledgeable staff. No surprises and fair prices.

Yuuuummy food! Slow but nice service, super satisfied- but don't go here if you want clean and polished silverware!!! Had to ask twice for a new roll of utensils and both times the fork and knife enclosed were unpolished and GROSS!! Yummy finger food made up for it

A bit of a hot mess. Ordered drinks, took 20 minutes to get them. Ordered food, wow. Took a long time to get and it was not good. The nachos were dry and almost no toppings. The loaded potatoes skins were dry and I am confident they were a day or two old. Then we were told they didn't have any dishes for us to use. Then we ordered another beverage. It took a while and I also ordered a regular Coke. I was asked several times what I was drinking and I still got a diet Coke.  If the food was regular pub food and it tasted good, that would make the experience much better. Food is really bad.
One of my favorite breakfast places, I always get a flight of mimosas & the raspberry is the best! It's always busy & the service is pretty good too

Came here for a business lunch, clearly a focal
Point of "the village" it is beautiful.  Although a bit large to say "high class". Prices are about as expected. A little much for the quality but not outrageous 

I ordered the blackened chicken sandwich. Got the clam chowder instead of fries. The chowder was really good, lots of potatoes.  Could've used less of that.  One thing about the chowder that I have to say - I know a lot of places but nutmeg in yheir chowder and I don't really like it.  They didn't here, or if so it was not noticeable. Was a good, old
School chowder. 

Sandwich was okay. Companions got a lamb sandwich and fries, looked pretty good. It she didn't remark that it was anything special - and the roasted beet salad. 

Presentation was good, food was okay and without going into a long drawn out description, the service was pretty terrible. Maybe the server was just having an off day but many mistakes in the order,
Never got water, then they overwhelmed with checking on us once we were taken care of. 

I'd try it again. Maybe we will get  a classier server next time. Their dinner menu looked creative. And I want to try the martinis for sure!
Awesome place went there and bought some comics and manga love the atmosphere totally gonna come again

The hostess that was on the shift today needs to learn how to speak to the customers. She was completely rude and couldn't stop going back and forth with me about a reservation that she made a mistake on. A complete bitch if you ask me. I spoke with her on the phone when I made my reservation and when I showed up it she began to lie and say she never spoke to anyone on the phone. Continued to argue with me back and forth. There's always an issue each time we've been. But the way she spoke to me as a customer was not ok. She should be fired for the way she spoke to a customer. Lost my service. I will never recommend this place to anyone.

Nice outdoor open air mall. Gets crowded on weekends. Some stores are pretty pricey mixed in with moderately priced stores. Restaurants, kids play area, movie theatre and large water fountain that does cool movements with colors and what not. Lots of families hang out and couples on dates, all congregate in the main town square area.

Would give 0 stars if possible. Service is terrible and the workers are simply money hungry. Months ago my clutch broke and I needed it repaired. I saved up about $2,000 and had to use $1,600 to repair the clutch. Then a week ago a part of the clutch gave out and I had it towed to Christian Brothers again. They said it was going to be another $700 repair after checking with another repair shop it was only $250 to repair. The workers are inhospitable and rude. If you want a good price and customer service anywhere in The Valley will do a better job.

Getting a call back from this place about anything is almost impossible. I've been waiting between 2 weeks and a month between each time I call (and wait for a call back) on things regarding my bill and future appointments that need to be made. 
I didn't really want to go here based on other reviews but I needed in quick which they were good for.   :/

One word......YUM!!
We are new to the area and had tried a few other Mexican restaurants before finally finding Don Diego's. The location is not the best. A bit out of the way in a bland strip mall. When we got there we were a bit concerned because there was only one table of 4 eating there. We were wrong to have any concerns. From the second we sat down the service was spectacular. The beer came with a super chilled mug and fresh lime. The pico de gallo was the best we have ever had. We each got the carne asada plate. Wow....it was perfection. The meat was superb and perfectly prepared. The kids menu was great as well...at only $3.50 our kids had plenty of food. This is now the only place we will go for Mexican. It was so good we have no desire to try any others in the area. Note: On the weekends the kid's meals are only $1.95. Crazy cheap.

We were looking to move to Idaho and our realtor suggested CBH for a new home over some of the other builders. The process of buying a home through CBH has been very straightforward and we were really happy about the final price we got on our home. Moving into our home we've found it to be pretty nice. We've only been in the house for a week or so but we haven't had any major issues with it. The appliances work as expected, the exterior finishes are very nice (interior-wise we may eventually upgrade the counters in the kitchen but they are fine for now) and with the exception of balancing the heating throughout the house - we think everything is great. The community looks nice and we're satisfied with our purchase. If you don't want to haggle and get into a bidding war over a good home in Idaho, CBH is the way to go.
Angela was such a kind and attentive server. The food was amazing and was fast for how packed they were. Will recommend 10/10. Call ahead to avoid the wait.

Excellent clam chowda. Let me take a moment to comment on one other menu selection. The poke was an architectural work of tasteful and visually pleasing culinary art. The poke option consisted of various layers - thin slices on green cucumber as the foundation, then a layer of cubed pinkish ahi tuna, followed on top by a layer of light green avocado. Use the white and orange wonton chips to slice up and serve yourself a taste of those three layers. Make sure to include in each bite the sliced mango that is landscaping the base of the three layered stack. Don't be shocked if time seems to slow down and all is well in the world for a few moments.

...and if you are starting to get the sense that I liked the food, then the service was even better. I'll put it this way - the waitress earned a 50% tip. I don't state that for any other reason than to demonstrate that she went above and beyond even what I'd expect from a country club. If she and her skills are a reflection of the establishment, then I will return with friends and family many more times. When I dine at country clubs I expect a few things - the servers should be experts on the menu. If I ask for their opinion or recommendation, then I expect enthusiasm from the server for one to thee menu options. Even better is when the staff asks me a few questions about my preferences, then makes recommendations based on my preferences. Another expectation is that I expect to be treated as if I am the only one in the place - even during the busiest times. The above can be trained and is par for a country club. What is unique and rare and what I noticed in this waitress was a passion for service, high character and desire to attend to her guests, and a general eloquence of style that just seems rare these days.
They have amazing Chicken Alfredo and their breadsticks are delicious. The waitresses were very helpful. They have a really cool Game room with a pinball machine and a Candy crane.

My new favorite place to eat in Boise.

Wow amazing food and best tasting home cooked delicacy from Bosnian cuisine. I can't believe how low their prices are compared to local restaurants. Definitely recommend this place if you like Mediterranean style cooking or some grilled meats.

Service was excellent and waitress was friendly and warm. Excellent place for lunch or dinner with freshly made food.
Consistently always the most dried out barely edible salmon. Common now salmon isn't that hard to cook

Just showed up for my 9am appointment that was made two days prior. Called to check in and was told i did not even have an appointment on the schedule. My husband and i were both there when the appointment was made. Will not be coming back.

We can't recommend All Valley ever again. We made an appt. to have our 9 month old Great Dane neutered . About 2 weeks before the date, we called and said we had heard good things about stomach tacking. So we said yeah, lets do that. 5 Days before the procedure, we called back and said....no we don't want that done..... The receptionist said ok. This morning at 8:30 am, we took Merlin in. I told the receptionist we were there for Merlin's neuter. Then I took Merlin off to the side. My wife stayed at the desk and filled the papers. My wife oked the additional things if they were needed. Still thinking the neuter , not the stomach tack. That was not brought up during the conversation. We left, about 4-41/2 hrs later the Vet called my wife and said the neuter and stomach tack went well. When I spoke to the supervisor of the receptionist, he stated maybe that information didn't get put on Merlin's file. So therefor they proceeded with that information. When I questioned him, he did say all calls are recorded so I want to see and hear the recording for the 23rd at 11;07 AM. If my wife thought she was signing just the neuter why would she question the paperwork? The information was obviously not on his chart so All Valley did what was on his chart and charged an extra 350 dollars.We will be watching how my 10 month old Great Dane does in the next 14 days to determine my/our future actions reguarding All Valley Animal Hospital

We were saddle shopping and stopped by Legacy Feed to buy supplies and view new and used saddles. Bob, the owner, was so incredibly kind and helpful. No pressure sales. Love this store! Highly recommended.
Your food was ok yesterday just ok, the fondue was delicious other than that our $300 meal was ok
Ordered ribs and wings.  The wings were great except the blue cheese dressing was runny and smelled like it had gone bad.  The ribs were dry and over done.  Flavor is fine but very dry.

I'd give it a 3.5 if I can, so I rounded up :) I took off one star because at this particular location, when you enter the car wash it STINKS! Dirty socks soaked in year old water comes through your vents. This is somewhat understandable, but the other locations doesn't have this issue. They smell kinda peppermint like. That takes a whole star off, for me. 
Another  .25 star is because it never seems to get my car 100% clean. I understand that my car is an odd shape (Dodge Journey) and other car washes have a problem with it too-- but not all... 
The last .25 star is the location. Albeit a good location for town, their lot is super small and sometimes there are thirty or more cars lines up and out onto the street holiding traffic up onto Pine and then into Meridian Rd. 

The staff is always nice and they added a large selection of vacuums. More than doubled their old machines. I take advantage of the $30 unlimited car washes. I always feel kinda bad doing this-- $30 a month to wash your car... but I have a white car and everything makes it look gross and I end up washing it every week-- too, too, too lazy to do it at home!

Average experience, the stylist used techniques not appropriate for me hair type, it was cut in a way no one one has ever cut my hair, and not in a good way. The salon was cute and clean and my appointment was on time.

It was my boyfriends birthday and we wanted to try something new, I had heard good things and thought this would be something out of the norm for us. We were seated right away and the server was right there to greet us. We ordered the pork tenderloin, chicken broccoli stir-fry with a side of sautéed mushrooms and the crab special roll as an appetizer. This is where the night didn't go so well. For starters we had to remind the server about our drinks. They brought out the crab roll In a timely manner but they also brought out the side of mushrooms about five minutes later. ( why would I want these now?) We then waited for additional 30 minutes for our food. About 40 minutes from the time we ordered our food. Our server only checked on us once in that time. (food was brought out by table runners,including the meal) Food looked great but when I went to eat the pork tenderloin it was cold. Not happy! It had great flavor just cold. One of the managers stopped by to see how everything was, I explained what happened and asked if I could just box up my food. If I was going to pay 20 dollars for something you bet I'm going to take it home. She was nice enough to remove the meal from our bill, Which is why I am not giving a lower score. I have been a server before and know that things get busy and backed up... But this was not the case, we were seated by the kitchen so could see everything.. Not many tickets and two out of the three cooks were just standing around talking to each other. Pretty bummed about the entire night, was hoping for something more.

Love love love that they have a new Paddles up poke in meridian at the village!
Great location and great staff! If you haven't tried Paddles up poke, this is the place you need to try and this specific location!
Had the chicken fried steak for breakfast and it was money! The staff was great and excellent service! Everyone with us enjoyed the food! Most def would come back to eat here again!

We went out to Kona to celebrate our daughter's 21st bday. She was so excited to go. Our server did a great job. There were 5 adults and one 5 year old. I ordered the Ribeye medium, it came out cold way undercooked, unseasoned and super fatty. Horrible steak. The potatoes had no salt or flavor as well. My wife had the lemon garlic penne with shrimp, very bland when it came out and not even warm at all. Our daughter had the pad thai and it was some how super fishy even though she ordered the chicken pad thai, her dish was the only one that was warm. Our son in law had the chicken lemon penne he said it was also bland. Our bday daughter did enjoy her sushi roll. I am not one to leave Yelp reviews, but I was so very disappointed in our food experience that I wanted to share. Our bill was over $232 , I believe we paid over $270 with tip. The last thing we wanted to do was complain or send food back on our daughters bday. Didnt want to embarrass her. We would typically politely say something to our server and get different food, but like I said we were out celebrating and chose Kona for our previous experiences. Wanted to say again our waitress did a great job. Just really very poor food, unseasoned  and very cold.

I've seen a lot of eateries with a lot of misleading menu pictures, but this place takes the cake. The only thing more disappointing than the undercooked bread and the paltry amount of fillings was the gumball-sized piece of gristle hiding inside. At least the sandwich was hot and tasted decent until that hunk of nastiness completely ruined the meal for me.

I took my husband to breakfast at Joe Momma's yesterday and it was the BEST breakfast we've had in the Treasure Valley.  Let's start with the coffee: The coffee is strong and they provided fresh cream which is a huge plus for me.  Most restaurants do not provide that! 
I ordered the kitchen sink omelette and it was fantastic! It's a very heavy meal so I actually couldn't even finish it and skipped lunch and had a late dinner.  The biscuits y'all were to die for!  I asked for the marionberry jam and it was so decadent that I just wanted to eat it straight from the spoon.  
My husband ordered the chicken fried steak and we both agreed it is the best damn chicken fried steak we have ever had! I am a Texas native and we both have lived in the south, this is the real deal y'all! It's like a southern grandma made it!
Service was phenomenon and efficient.  Our waitress was excellent! We look forward to coming back again! Hopefully to try a mimosa.
Had numbers wrong on paperwork, late getting started, swapped social security numbers on paperwork, and... I never got my latte!
They have delicious gyros! Their hummus is amazing and so is their Tzatziki sauce. It's great to have a place where you can get drive-thru Mediterranean food.

Pretty good! Lots of choices to make your own bowl and the musubi was tasty but for some reason the rice was blue?¿ Not as much flavor as other poké places I've had and the salmon was pretty fishy tasting but all in all a solid choice. Great prices.

Seriously one of the best breakfast spots I've ever been to. My husband and I were visiting from out of town and decided to have our family brunch here. The hour long wait was to be expected as to it being 10:30 Sunday morning. But their app made it so communication was easy and we didn't have to bother the hosts. When we sat down the waitress was great at communicating so we never felt forgotten. My husband loves to ask the age old frustrating question, " which is better? I can't decide." But our server was ready with a response and impressed us all. 
The chicken fried steak was the best my husband has ever had and he's a self proclaimed CFS expert. 
Our mimosa flight was perfect with such great flavors. And all of us could have our favorite while giving little sips to each other and wanting more!
The price point was very reasonable and we WILL be back!
Thank you

Not too bad, came here one evening during the week for happy hour. I'm not a huge Village fan, but not bad. I like it that the happy hour goes until 7, hard to find. Our service was fine, kind of slow at the beginning but then she picked up the pace realizing our table likes to drink so keep them coming. Will go back and this time we will hopefully get to sit outside.

Another visit to Hungry Horse Eatery.  
I had taken my daughter last time, told the family about it, and now my son wanted to go.

We stopped in on Saturday afternoon, I ordered the garlic parmesan fries (again) and a strawberry milk tea with rainbow popping boba.  My son ordered a rice bowl with beef (no vegetables) and a strawberry banana smoothie with rainbow popping boba.

My son got his dish, and I was waiting on my fries.  I saw the owners working on other things, and their son (about 15 or so who had taken my order) kind of looking at me realizing I needed my fries.  So, he told his parents and they got right on it.  I don't know how they did this, but I got an order of warm fries fairly quickly, and he told me they were bringing me another one.  And then the mom brought me a piping hot fresh order of fries and apologized for the mistake.

Our drinks were delicious.  I had never tried milk tea before, and it was really tasty.  A milky fruity drink with the fun fruity popping boba.  My son enjoyed his smoothie and the fruity popping boba.  And said that his rice bowl was really good too.  We enjoyed both of our delicious orders of fries.  And when we were done, we had to get the waffle dessert.

It seemed to have more fruit than last time - big sliced bananas and big slices of strawberries, vanilla ice cream, Nutella, chocolate sauce and powdered sugar.

They stay on top of clearing and cleaning the tables as people come and go, and when they do that the owner checks on you and asks how everything was.  

Even with the fries hiccup, they are still a 5-star in my book.  Good food, good service, and they care about their customers enjoying their experience and leaving happy.

This place is my go-to for work lunch breaks! The sourdough bread is baked fresh daily and all of the ingredients taste so delicious! The sandwich-makers aka employees are so kind and accommodating. This place is only open until 2:30pm, so make sure you get in and try it during the lunch rush hour! I'd highly recommend This place to anyone!
I took my wife there for dinner and was not disappointed! Roasted boar shank was fabulous!

We just had delivery from here and it was awful. A complete waste of money. The meats weren't hot or warm. The brisket was dry and without flavor. My husbands ribs were worse than what we would make at home. He attempted to eat the meat with a knife and fork because it was not tender, fall off the bone as you'd expect with ribs. The aides were also horrible. The coleslaw was too runny and the potato salad was more like egg salad with hardly any potato pieces.

First time coming here and I have to say the food was very good. I had the pecan mini roll and my friend had the original cinnamon roll. The dough was soft throughout and the fact that they didn't skimp on the toppings. We shared the biscuit and gravy and that too was amazing. The biscuits were soft and the sausage gravy was perfect. I'd recommend this place to anyone who has a sweet tooth or just looking for a good place for lunch. Can't wait to come back next time. Definitely a hidden gem.

We typically visit family in Idaho once a year, and we crave this stuff! I love the java chip and usually whatever their daily drink is. They will also do a lot of things in decaf if you ask. I love the chocolate covered bean that they give you with each coffee! I wish we had one of these where we live!

In an old Famous Dave's, this place is cool. They have turned it a little more country than BBQ theme, but if you've been to a Famous Dave's you can recall the inside ambiance. We went here for a late breakfast, which for my husband turned into an early lunch.  We noticed they had a full bar, and hey, you can't drink all day if you don't start in the morning! We got great service from Katherine/Kathleen? I forget. She was super friendly, super attentive, and super nice. I ordered the Denver Omelette and it was great. Ham, peppers, and onions diced right size to enjoy each bite.  House potatoes were really good, and this is a thing for me. Sourdough toast buttered like I would butter it, I hate when you get toast and there is basically no butter on it. Husband went with the Club Sandwich. He loved it. He said the ham on it was just delicious. His side salad was great too. We were lucky for no crowds on a weekday at an in between time, but I hear this place will fill up fast at peak times. This will become one of our go to's.

This place is new clean and well-stocked. Everything works perfectly and the range officers were extremely helpful and nice. All around it was a great experience and my family and I love shooting there. I also love that you're  involved in the community promoting gun safety.

What a wonderful yoga studio! Excellent location, with parking in the back of the building. 

As a beginner into hot yoga, I was able to check out a couple free classes during their Hot Yoga Week this year, which I saw in the events section on Facebook. After checking in, you walk upstairs to a very clean and spacious locker room area right next to the studio. Staff and teachers are very helpful and answer any questions you may have. I like to rent their special yoga towel for my mat (it's $2). Or you can order your own online if it's something you get into and prefer to use your own. 

I love that they have an app you can download to your phone that allows you to view and schedule your yoga classes. The app is called Achieve. Occasionally they have free classes that are taught by new teachers (usually on Saturday's around noon). 

I would highly recommend checking this place out if you've ever wanted to try hot yoga! They also have other types of classes, which I hope to try out soon.

If I could give them .0000001 star I would. Willow Tree Dental is highly unprofessional, disrespectful, and completely ignorant when it comes to wasting your time. I called in on a Wednesday to see if they could get me in right away because I had an old filling come out. They got me in on a Friday, which a gladly took. I came to the appointment did all of my paperwork, sat down got x-rays. Then they were doing insurance searching while I was sitting in the chair, we have Tricare, paid premiums, my husband is Active Duty. They literally left me sitting in a chair for an hour, mind you, I took time off work 2 hours plus to go to this dentist appointment, they just left me there in the chair. Didn't get to see a dentist, no dental work got completed. So, went up front and Cassandra yammered on about billing. So I told her I needed to get this done so I could go back to work and responses were poor and unprofessional. Then after sitting in the chair for an hour, I was told I'd have to be rescheduled. Hard no. Not going back, their office is outdated and mildly dirty. The outdated portion would be overlooked by customer service but, that was piss poor. Disgusted with their customer service and patient care.
