I brought my 16 S550 in today, mostly because of the great reviews on yelp. I was not disappointed. The service was prompt and friendly and professional. They do a great job. The pricing was very fair and I would definitely recommend this business to others. They even went out of their way to do a couple of other little things I asked for free. Great business great owner great employees.

Not all Starbucks are the same and there are plenty that are just plain corporate. I really like the Eagle and Franklin location for the following reasons 

1. It's very personable. It's like Cheers but for coffee. I know Scarlet and several of the other baristas by name 
2. There's outside patio seating as well as seating inside.  The seating inside is portioned out nicely. Sure, there's the community table but there are nooks and two tops designed for solo coffee drinkers 
3. The location. It's easy to get in and out. Some locations feel like you're driving in downtown Tijuana. I just want coffee not a wacky race 

Thanks Eagle and Franklin Starbucks, you're a fan favorite, I just wish more locations were like you.

Great company! Quality made products, everything is custom made. Attention to detail is put into every product made. I've recommended Woodland Manufacturing to all of my friends and family when they need a sign made for their business or letters made for their home. They always turn out great!

Kudos to CBH Home Warranty service. We bought our home about 21 months ago. Little did we know we had a faulty deadbolt lock until my son in law opened our deadbolt with his thumb. Knowing our home was beyond the one year warranty, I decided to call to see if they might fix it. Well....a CBH technician just showed up today and replaced the deadbolt mechanism with a new one, and it is secure. 
Thank you CBH for standing behind your homes, even, in this isolated case, when it was out of warranty.
Solid bbq...and we're from North Carolina! The mac and cheese was good but the fried were amazing. Dont forget the fry sauce!
Great food, strong/tasty drinks, and a beautiful patio! My family had such a great lunch here yesterday, and we are already excited to come back!

BRO THEIR CRAB CAKE BENEDICT slaps. Their food really is delicious. Joe momma has been my mom since mine left. If i could give 10 stars i would. I do wish they were open around 3pm for breakfast THOUGH  not everyone gets up at an ungodly HOUR.

Four of us went to Twigs last night. The restaurant was not busy.

Service was EXTREMELY slow! Our appetizers took 20-25 minutes (after ordering), our dinner probably 40 minutes, and our one dessert, 20 minutes. We were at the restaurant for over 2 1/2 hours, not by choice.

It took a long time to get our second drink and after an hour or so we had to ask for our waters to be refilled. That should have been obvious.

Appetizers and entrees were really good, drinks were weak, and the bread pudding was good, but dry.

I loved the Caesar salad except mine was served with a mosquito(?) and a piece of ice among the lettuce. The calamari has little to none breading or anything on it but it's sitting in a pool of oil.  A POOL.

We have used Weed Man for the past several years... i can recall at least 4-5 times during this time we would arrive home to have the service notification stuck in the neighbors yard... i would call and they would assure me that they had treated my yard,  they said the technician most likely just put the placard in the wrong yard... 

well yesterday we happened to be home when they came and they were at the neighbors... we approached the technician and questioned and he assured us he was at the right yard... when he finished and pulled away we received a text of our bill and notification of the service that he had applied to the NEIGHBORS YARD!!!  

I called (customer service is not handled locally)... and was told someone local would get back to me... they didn't.... i called again and Lauren... (who has excellent customer service demeanor... and is very professional) said that the technician did come back and do our yard... ok fine... but did he?... how many times over the past few years have we paid for the technician treating the neighbors yard and not ours?..  

Make sure you have someone home or a camera to verify that the service was performed on your yard.

We moved into our new home a month ago and we noticed our tree that was planted in our front yard did not look very healthy. We  tried some xtra watering and tree food all to no change in its condition. We called and they put in a work order to the landscaper. We really appreciated their quick response to our concern. 

PS We love our new home and neighborhood.

Caught happy hour here. Very impressed! For five very good apps and drinks for four people our bill was under $60.

The Kona Grill is an upscale chain restaurant. I'd compare it to PF Chang - but slightly nicer. They do take reservations. Finally, a restaurant in the 'burbs that takes reservations! 

The lounge and bar area is nice but can be quite crowded and noisy. If you don't get there early expect to fight for a table. 

Took off one star because our service was sssllooowww. Maybe that will correct itself as the restaurant gets its feet underneath it. 

The Village (mall where Kona Grill is located) is a great addition to Boise. Far nicer than anything we've had. You'll feel like you just stepped into Seattle or San Diego.

Great shopping experience!  If you want to feel like you're shopping downtown, but have the convenience of shopping at the mall then visit the Village.  There is parallel parking to get the downtown vibe and a large parking lot available for mall like parking.

Be sure to drop by the fountain feature in front of the theater.  Great spot to people watch.

Had the first appointment today for our dog since moving to the area this summer. I did extensive research to find a clinic for our pup since we didn't have a recommendation for one. I'm very pleased to say that the techs and Dr Tami we're very warm and welcoming to me and my pup. They're clinic cleanliness and safety measures in the midst of Covid were top notch - I felt vary safe. Thanks so much - I look forward to our interactions in the future!

Service was terrible food was cold we had to send it back my wife and I couldn't even eat together because she had away food to be warmed up very lean and Mrs. last year Adamic wasn't even here in my opinion not a great place for breakfast at all take your chances

Came to have a nice date night with my wife as we have been to Twigs many times before and loved their cocktails. I ordered The Bulleit (their Old Fashioned) and my wife ordered a Cosmo. First sip from both of our drinks and they were VERY weak and VERY watered down. After telling our waitress they were bad she had the Manager come over to talk to us. She then proceeds to tell me that she made my drink and she takes her whiskey "very seriously". Stating that the drink is "pure alcohol" as if I don't know what I just ordered and that "maybe the ice cube melted some". There was also no garnish in mine might I add. All to say, she was arguing with me on my dislike for my cocktail. HORRENDOUS customer service. She then turns to my wife and throws the bartender under the bus who made hers and offered to "Happy Hour price" my wife's drink only. I've never felt more insulted and unsatisfied at a restaurant before. Needless to say, Twigs has lost our business for good.

Came here today Mon 4/5/21 and ordered a combo plate: Fried rice/chow mein, Beijing beef, Sweet fire chicken breast, plus walnut shrimp.

This location is probably the stingiest in terms of portions Ive been to stingy. Also when I came in, there was no one in the restaurant, but the girl made me wait for about 2minutes because she would rather handle the pick up orders first.

When I got to the register, instead of ringing me up, she made me wait again while she went back to handle the pick up orders again.

This location sucks.

Very polite friendly service.  Food was fresh, hot and good.   I have not like panda much because it is not always the best but first time I have ate at this location and I will for sure go back.  Portions were good and very satisfied with the food and service!

I would not go back to this coffee shop / bakery.  The lone attendant pops out from the back when you arrive, but then hides back there once the sale is done.  She was unfriendly and downbeat.  

The coffee comes out of a machine - like a vending machine.  It's nothing like the actual brewed coffees or handmade coffees of most coffee shops.  My wife's was way too sweet, and my cafe mocha seemed like diluted packet hot chocolate (watery Swiss Miss...) with a little coffee flavor.  It's the first time I can recall that I didn't even finish the cup.  

The cinnamon roll is really just gummy dough in the shape of a roll.  I love cinnamon rolls, but I threw it away after only finishing half.  

The store was empty except for us, yet there was a pile of dirty dishes sitting out in the bin behind our table.  The napkin dispenser was empty.  They ran out of plastic forks.  

It could be a nice place to go, but the service was poor, the food/drinks were not very good, and there was a general lack of attention to details and the customer experience.

The food is yummy!  Things we had were the kitchen sink omelet, papas tatters, California Bennie, biscuits and gravy and Belgian waffle!  Everything was awesome!  Service was great!  Definitely want to come try their lunch!
We like this BBQ and come here regularly. Good flavor, good quality, good service. Spicy hot too hot, imo.

Happy hour here is incredible. The appetizers, drinks, and atmosphere is exactly what you need on a day or night out. The music selection recently changed and definitely tended to a younger crowd, but no complaints here. Staff is friendly and most importantly, the service is fast. Overall, this place gets an A plus from me.

This was my second time here the first time in only had drinks. This time we actually had food and the food was very good. Great taste. Our Bartender/server was great. He was funny attentive made out girls night great thank you Ian. He did forgot my village discount but it's okay. Everything was great. We did put our name on the list for a table so we sat at the bar to wait for a table the wait wasn't long at we decided to stay at the bar. Over all it was good.

What a place! We ordered some takeaway right when things were opening up post quarantine and they really had their things in order! From clearly demarcated stopping points and signs directing you to a specific location as well as covered faces, gloves, and a UV light for the takeaway area, we felt absolutely safe picking up our breakfast! Add the giant portions and excellent food, and we are sold on coming back for more! While the area is exceptionally busy, the location was convenient for us and the ordering online process superbly easy. I loved my pancake and my eggs and my husbands breakfast burrito was ginormous! There's a little something for everyone, so it's a great family restaurant. We will def be getting food from here again!

Top notch service...i.e. the guy (didn't catch his name) at the window was super friendly and very patiently helped me (a newbie) with our order. As for the order...The Mexican drink was really good! The energy drink was ok, but it was the Mexican Mocha that stood out as unique and very tasty.

Every time Im in Boise, Royal Coffee is my go to place for frozen coffee's and yes Im secretly in love with one of the servers.. The staff there always has a smile for the customers and again the coffee is the best all around town in my humble opinion.. Now if I could only build up my nerve and ask that beautiful server out

I tried working with Jordan Wise to get a loan approved.  She would not return my emails and was very rude when finally taking my phone call.  Regardless of me being paid nearly 2-years in advance on an active loan with Westmark she seemed to not care to help me and spoke to me as if her time was more valuable than my own.  I am so excited to stop doing business with Westmark Credit Union.  Also, they're website is a practically useless clunky mess.

I love this place.  I stopped by on my neighborhood walk and the staff was incredibly friendly.   The smaller cinnamon rolls are phenomenal!  They were so good, I took a dozen to work.  The Mexican wedding cookies are legitimate and delicious.  I'm looking forward to hanging out in their cafe this week to enjoy some coffee and more of their treats.  I noticed they have conveniently packaged lunch items, which I'll try taking for lunch.  Our neighborhood deserves a great local bakery, stop by and support this small business or drive out of your way to try it.  it will be worth your time.  Best of luck to the owner and her team!

Brian and Shelbi were amazing. Always very helpful and quick to follow-up with any questions or concerns I had throughout my home purchase. I highly recommend contacting Brian Fullmer if you are thinking about purchasing a new home.

We are happy to provide Teschia Tucakovic with a five-star review.  We have worked with her several times, and the service has been thorough, prompt, and professional.  As an out-of-state investor, she has been willing to handle several details, making the process simple.  I recommend her and her team at CBH.

We have never used UltraClean and never will! Tonight an UltraClean truck tailgated is for 2 miles honking and flashing their light. He eventually passed us illegally. If this is the way you represent your company I want no part of that! My daughter was scared he was going to follow us home. I will spread the word!

My wife and I came here for dinner without kid. The decoration and location are really good. If you're seated right, you could see the water fountain. Our waiter is great as well.

We ordered mojito for a drink and we'd like it. My martini is rather bland so I requested the mixed version.

Loved the appetizer and they taste great with our drink.

Food is average with very large portion, so I'm expecting more out of this high-end place. 

Anyway, good dining experience on overall.
The turkey club, cheesesteak and fries were fresh and delicious. This was my first time visiting this location. We will be coming back.

My first time coming back in a long time. We came during happy hour and got sushi along with some drinks. Overall food was great, but service is where they lost some stars. Our server made us feel pressured to leave, I get the business is to flip table fast, however, it was a slow day and it wasn't necessary. 

One thing I noticed on the happy hour menu is that in order to see the ingredients of any item you have to go look on the regular menu to see what is in the dish, somewhat inconvenient.

Yesterday late lunch time. Food was good. Service wasn't bad. But it wasn't great. 
We had one child come in with her free birthday drink from a regional coffee chain. The other ordered a breakfast plate and I somewhat nibbled on that as well. We weren't super hungry and knew we were going to dinner later with family to celebrate their newborn and my big baby's birthday.
Just needed something to tide us over.

But I had to specifically ask the cashier when I paid if they have anything for birthdays.
That's when I finally found out about the free slice of pie.
The waitress just seemed halfhearted toward us after we only ordered one meal. I felt like I had to explain why we weren't ordering more.

But my money is still USD and I still tip 15-20% even when the service isn't great cuz we're in Idaho, and their base pay is about half of minimum wage, which is only 7.25 or something here.

I had a very comforting experience recently when bringing my Chihuahua here when he sadly passed away. I was truly heartbroken and showed up at night frantic and upset. The workers there were really compassionate and comforting. They sat with me and we just talked for awhile about how much my dog meant to me. They listened and offered some kind words to help with his passing. I took as much time as I wanted in a private room to say goodbye to my little guy. I really appreciated the kindness and care they showed me through this difficult time. I got my dog cremated threw them and a company they use and the urn box was beautifully made and you could see the time and thought put into it. Special shout out to Abby and Mindy who really was able to shine a little light on my sad situation, I can tell they really care about animals and their clients and to me, that makes all the difference.

Had a great experience in both purchasing a new 1911 and utilizing the range.  It's a clean and new place and certainly has the tactical feel to it. Had an overcharged on the 1911 purchase, but was quickly refunded the difference right away when pointed out a few days later with no trouble.  Leroy did a great job facilitating my order and kept in contact during the process ensuring I was being taken care of.  In sales myself, I felt he and the company was there to ensure customer satisfaction rather than just getting the sale.  As a cautious suggestion to our friend in Portland questioning the patriotism of establishment because of not flying the flag at half-staff, you better be D certain of ones intentions before labeling unpatriotic.   Being a deployed veteran, I find them 100% American and professional and would disregard that nonsense without evidence or credibility.  I plan to utilize the range more often and will probably purchase my next firearm from them in the near future.  They have a great selection of new, used and consignment weapons to choose from with a gunsmith on staff.

brought our cat in for a  spider bite, first they charged us over $600, with success, then proceeded, with another doctor saying he needs xrays, and that didn't tell them anything, then another doctor said we needed to skin grafts and give him antibiotics and pain meds, now and over $1000 later, my cat was becoming skinner and noone at the vet could give me an answer.  Today, my cat couldn't even lift up his head, and when call the vet, we got nothing again, except it would cost $98 to put him to sleep.  This place is a rip off, who cares more about money, then really trying to find what is really going on with my animal.  I feel like a fool who got ripped off, not only did my  cat see 3 different people, everyone, kept giving me another different reason to help him, and instead they killed him.

I came here for a massage because of my tight shoulders and soreness from practicing jiu jitsu. I thoroughly enjoyed the treatment and left feeling more refreshed. The environment was clean and the masseuse was very friendly.
the corned beef is awesome and you have got to try the tatter pigs are so yummy a little expensive but the best!!!

What a funky little shop. The Hungry Horse has a small food menu, but that simply means that each dish is carefully crafted and executed. I was so impressed. It is a weird mix. Rice bowls, noodles and waffle sandwiches. But it all works great! 

Came for a quick lunch on a Monday with my minions and sister. I got the Teriyaki Chicken bowl and a Honeydew Boba Tea. My sister got the Turkey Sandwich with fries. We shared with the small people. I love boba and this place did not disappoint. It tasted like it was made with real honeydew. It was fresh and flavorful. "Hungry", my 4 year old, loved it and said the boba tasted "squishy". I was so pleasantly surprised with my rice bowl. How many times can I use the word perfect? Perfect rice, perfect broccoli, perfect pickled slaw, and perfect sauce for the chicken. We all loved it (ok, the baby threw it on the floor, but she can't be trusted.) I couldn't believe how fresh and expertly cooked the broccoli was! 

My sister got a waffle sandwich and it was so interesting! Really flakey. We are still undecided if it was made with puff pastry or some kind of croissant waffle? Regardless, it was an interesting texture and flavor that made it more than just a sandwich. The cheese was melty and rich. I like a crunchier outside to my fries, but it was the only thing "Hurricane" ate, so they're still 5 stars in my book. 

So glad to finally try this small place. We will be back!

Working with the team in Kuna, especially Karissa, has been an amazing process.  The home that my clients chose was well done and beautiful. The care, expertise, and quality from this team has been nothing less than impressive.  My clients and I have had a great experience with this team.

This facility is gorgeous but employees are idiots. I always recommend this place, but no more. My brother in law wanted to shoot, being from CA and never shooting anything besides a pistol before they went in to rent guns and play around with diff kinds. However first gun rented was the 50 cal, they were turned loose in the range with no idea on how to use it aside from 5 sec rundown they got when handed gun, which if they had shot one before would probably have sufficed but they hadn't so were lost. Then when the went to find an employee to help as no one was back there, they came back to door being locked and their targets gone. For the amount of money spent I would have expected a lot better treatment. I really hate to do this.  I almost never give this bad of a review.  I wanted this to be a 5 star night.  It's my First Ladies night in a very long time.  Wednesday, one of our friends made a RSVP for Friday at 7:30.  We arrived at 7:28pm.  Super excited for our evening.

So finally they clean our table and we are seated.  It was a tight fit.  One of my friends stated she felt like it was Thanksgiving dinner and she was a kid that was smashed in between the grown-ups.  
My 2 friends ordered Shirley Temples.  They brought them out with no cherries!   I've never heard of a Shirley temple without a cherry! Apparently while we were waiting for a seat and standing between the tables, a floor manager noticed us and decided to comp our appetizers. That was nice, I will give them that. So we ordered the Avocado eggrolls and edamame. That came within a reasonable amount of time. We ordered our dinner, when the appetizers came. We all decided to have sushi. The sushi came an hour after we ordered it. I had the spider roll because I figured that was safe. I normally like all sorts of sashimi and sushi but tonight seemed like they were a little bit off here. My spider roll came and I took one bite and spit it out. It was fishy tasting and obviously bad.  I asked one of my friends to try it in case it's just me being off and she confirmed that it tasted like it was spoiled.  My other friend had a Kona roll and a shrimp and lobster roll. Her shrimp and lobster roll also tasted  off to her and she couldn't eat hers. Our other friend also  had a Kona poke roll and a spicy tuna roll. She said hers was ok.   So 2 out of 3 of us had to return our meals. I will tell you in 20 years I have probably done that one time. I am not a returner of meals to the kitchen. But I was afraid I would get food poisoning if I ate it!   
So we had a bill that was $128. The restaurant actually comped the entire meal,  other than my martini which was $12. So they did the right thing which is why I gave them another star.  Otherwise they would have just had one.  
I'm not sure what happened here tonight. I don't know if they are short staffed or if an order did not come in, but I expected a lot more from Kona Grill. It was really disappointing and after we leave the restaurant we are actually going to go find a place to have dinner because we are still hungry. At least I had fantastic company with two wonderful ladies.  I just really hope We aren't sick later.

Indoor accessories:  Plenty of them to go around. Anywhere from handgun to rifle accessories, ammo, etc. However they are "pricey" compared to online stores and other local companies around the Idaho area. I take a lot of time reading reviews, researching and finding the right companies to support around this area.

Indoor handgun range:  My first time I was hesitant to come back after the front desk asked for my ID and then "scanned" it into their computer after being asked NOT to.  I for one dont let any company or corporation scan my personal information into their computer.  The second visit I had was a little better but nothing special and it was packed with a lot of gun newbies which I dont prefer to be around as my back in turned away from them.  BUT knowing the staff is always watching does help.  The staff inside the range while you are shooting are knowledgeable and I respect that.  Especially asking questions on their experiences.  

Class taking:  I have not attended classes here as I have another company that I attend with.  Smaller classes means more 1 on 1 training.   

Overall: this is a good place if your new to the area and want to try different weapons out.  But for me personally I likely will not return as the other places I have to shoot are out far away from any person or place and I like that better.

Very hard to find pharmacies which can or will fill prescriptions. Many of the most common pharmacies, to include CVS, Caremark, and Walgreens, will tell you that Ameriben reports that they are not contracted to fill prescriptions, so must charge full cash price.  What is especially bad about this, is that CVS and Caremark are listed as the pharmacy of choice on the back of the card.  Walmart can sometimes fill the prescription, but cannot give you pricing without out actually filling the prescription and reporting what the amount is at that time.  This insurance only seems to be good enough for barely meeting the government requirements for possessing insurance and thus providing the member with basic preventative care coverage.  The member ends up paying the full price for just about everything else.

My wife and I went to Which Wich's for lunch. The 1st thing that Im not a fan of is the name. It sounds like they are just making a play on word. Asking which sandwich you want. But the name Which Wich just sounds a bit to close to asking Which Witch you are wanting. 

The next thing that I found interesting was the way that they take the orders. In a normal sub shop, you go up to the counter and place your order. Then the person behind the counter ask you what veggies and such you want. You can get as much or as little or none.

In Which Wich, you choose a paper bag that is the sandwich that you want. Then you place checks on the bag beside the veggies and such that you want. Then you give that to the person at the register. After he or she total your order and you pay for it, then they put it on what looks like a clothes line. The sandwich is made, with no more input from you at all, and they call you to come get it.

How my visit went. 
I had something called the Wicked Sandwich. Side not here is that the name of this sandwich is adding to my poor reaction to the name of the restaurant. The taste of it was actually very good. I asked for mustard. I can only assume that they must have put mustard on my sandwich with a spoon or spatula. It had way too much. 

My wife had a turkey sandwich. My wife also ordered mustard. But just like was the case with mine, her sandwich was slathered with mustard to the point that she did no enjoy it at all.

My daughter had a turkey sandwich. When my daughter received it, it looked small, but not unreasonable. But then she began pealing back the layers of paper. I was astonished at how wasteful this place is with wrapping. 

After my daughter finished pealing back these layers, all of our jaws hit the floor with what was left. None of us could believe how incredibly small the sandwich was. It took my daughter 1 bite to finish it. She is 9 . There was barely any meat in it and very little bread. I could not believe that we wasted $4 on this.

My sandwich was $10. My wife's was $9. My daughter's horrible excuse for a sandwich was $4. My daughter got a chocolate chip cookie, which tasted like it was made 3 or 4 day ago and had been nuked in the microwave in an attempt to make it taste fresh. 

The cookie was a $1.25. The drinks were a whopping $2.50 each. Add to that 3 bags of small chips at $1.25 each, and our lunch came to a grand total of $31.27 !!! We will not be back

Score Card

The good 
* Their process of taking orders should speed up sandwich creation for them. 
* The restaurant looks clean

The bad
* The clothesline where they put the bags/orders on looks tacky. 
* There are plastic bags that hang on the outside of the counter. These bags are for carry out orders. This looks tacky. 
* Instead of napkins, there is a roll of paper towels near the drink dispensers. This looks very tacky and cheap.

The down right ugly
* The selection station where you choose a bag corresponding to the sandwich you want and the number of choices on the bag is over whelming.  Especially for a 1st time customer to this restaurant, its way too many choices.
* The bags that customers choose is right near the front door. Customers have a lot of choices. So they will be spending a good bit of time here choosing which sandwich they want. Especially if they have not been here before. This creates a huge bottleneck at the front of the restaurant and often results in lines out the door.
* This restaurant generates a ton of trash. There is the initial brown bag that you take and make your choices on. Then there is a foil like wrapper that they restaurant wraps your finished sandwich in. This foil wrapper is put in yet another paper wrapper. The result is 3 to 4 times more trash than other sub type shops. This makes this restaurant one of the least green restaurants around. 
* In other sub shops, you choose from 6 or 12". This is what customers are used to being able to select. Here the sizes of subs are small, medium and large. There is no comparison chart of any reference that we could find to tell us what a small, medium and large was. 
* Prices here at very high. This is one of, if not the, most expensive sub shops I have ever encountered.
* In a normal sub shop, you stand at the counter and tell the sandwich maker how much you want of  which veggie, or condiment. Here you have 1 chance to make your selection and that is at the start. You cannot tell them how much, or how little, of a veggie or condiment you want. 
We saw the guy making sandwiches  blow into his glove. To do this, he put his mouth on the glove. This is a food contamination.

Which Wich is new to Boise. In any new restaurant, Just like any other business, I expect there to be bugs. That is why I sent my review directly to the restaurant owner. 

I had hoped that he would apologize, give my family a free meal, or do something to compensate us for a bad experience, but he did not.

I've never spoke to such close minded rude agents and workers before. Just because my preapproval isn't where it'll be in 4 months when we rerun our approval doesn't mean you should tell people they're in the wrong area and laugh at them and refuse to show them floor plans so when they do get to that house price they know what they want and can add or subtract on upgrades. Renee was extremely rude over he phone and completely unwilling to do anything for us today. She should take some customer service courses from Hubble homes reps and agents. At least they are willing to show their homes and talk to buyers about possibilities instead of telling them "you can't even build a home for that" and laugh. RUDE AGENT! I doubt I'll even humor CBH homes in March when we buy.
Great prices.  Love the good quality bread loafs.  Most winco brand labels are good and save you $$$
I'm new to the area and have been seaching for a place to get farm fresh produce, egg, and dairy. They have a great slection and nice people working there.

Good BBQ joint in Meridian.  Excellent ribs and quality brisket.  Brisket is where most restaurants have difficulties and the product ends up dry.  Big Daddy's brisket is moist and tender.   This place ranks high on my BBQ list with Bodacious Pig and Goodwood and the Big Daddy's brisket is the best, I do think the sides are better at the other two.
I highly recommend this place for great ribs and brisket! 

Ordered a Togo order that took forever and to my disappointment, the brisket was dry and tough.  It seems this place is going down hill.  Back to Goodwood from now on!

I had the pleasure of having Mark Enger complete a requested work order for our home today. His customer service, professionalism and knowledge surpassed my expectations. I felt comfortable with him in my home and he even showed me a couple
of things I could do to make my home more energy efficient. 5 stars for Mark!

It's very tasty! They have a large menu and their combos are fairly priced. They have really yummy enchiladas, burritos, and tamales. Since the lockdown, I've ordered out from here a few times. They're pretty fast at making the meals I order. Please order out from here you won't regret it.

The menu has plenty of options. Came in for lunch on Sunday and it was easy to find seating. Rebecca was extremely nice, friendly and provided great service. 

Turkey burger and sweet potato fries were on point.

I live in southern California. I have to say this restaurant is a must stop for breakfast! The quality of food was very delicious, the portions is a perfect amount.

One suggestion dont change. Everything was perfect, thank you il be back for that chicken fried steak. Yum

Decided to try this new Del Taco because Taco Bell across the street had a long drive thru line.  I now know why no one was in the drive thru of Del Taco.  I ordered nachos and went to the window.  When the cashier opened the window the smell coming from the restaurant was overwhelming and not in a good way.   It smelled like old grease and rancid tortillas.  The nachos were a mess and almost Inedible.   Do not recommend this place.

FYI; my GPS took me around back of the store first and there is no entrance on that side. 

Ample free parking out front in the strip mall. 

Free WiFi with no password needed. 

Extremely friendly staff. Literally everyone wanted to help me. 

Good quality products. Clothing has regular price, 30% off, and clearance pricing. I found it easy to buy everything from the 30% off sales that were very abundant. I personally didn't buy anything at msrp. 

Shoes; enough to choose from in running which I was shopping for. Most were 30-50% off MSRP and there were definitely good deals to be had. The really discounted section for men was in the back left corner of the store. They did not have tennis shoes (at all) or many of the things I had in my Nike app cart that I wanted to try on and buy in person. For example running backpacks or specific running shoes that I found online. 

Also, be aware that items do go on and off sale there weekly. So something you saw on sale Thursday may or may not be on sale over the weekend. 

P.S. I removed one star for the lack of bathrooms. I'm such a large store with so many families with kids how do you not have a restroom? I asked a couple of workers and got answers from go to Toys R US, go to Target, to the Gap, to "I'm disappointed no public restrooms too." I eventually went to Toys R US which had fine restrooms in the front right of the store. But it's closing down very soon so that won't be an option.

This has become our new fav today was my second time in and I brought my husband. Friendly fast  service and delicious food. My husband said it was so good my only complaint I is I wish they had flavored coffee creamers other than that we will definitely be back!
They have in their shelves some Henle and Bärenreiter editions. Plus, they have a separate room for their Steinway collection. Also, they let me play the Steinways!!

Extreemly disappointed in this builder.  My family has lived in this new construction for less than 6 months and we've had to file 2 major warranty issues due to bad plumbing and landscaping.  They do the bare minimum when repairing and leave it up to you to handle the rest.
I've taken 2 of our vehicles into Christian Bros and they've always been very truthful, professional and extremely helpful. I would recommend them to anyone!

I saw the positive reviews on Yelp, and am new to the area,so I thought I'd give Cindy a try. I had a hair color recipe from my former stylist and texted it to her and she indicated she could follow it. When I got to the salon she told me that the recipe was not the best for me and talked me into letting her do something that would make me look better. I ended up with black hair( which was NOT the color I wanted), many tears, and had to go to a reputable salon to get it fixed. I would not recommend going to Cindy.

I am sorry to leave a negative review but I wouldn't want anyone else to experience what I did. Typically any stylist I have ever used offers to make the error right or refund my money. Cindy did neither. I paid her $90 in cash and gave her a $35 check that didn't clear due to a funds transfer error. I've rarely had checks not clear but in this case I'm glad it didn't. I ended up having to spend a lot of extra money to fix the bad hair job. I'm sorry to be negative but feel I need to be honest about what happened.

Located in a nice area. If you seating outside you will enjoy dancing fountain. Nice and huge restaurant for sushi place cuz the sushi bar is half empty. Food presentation is nice but taste and freshness need improvement. Attentive server but not hostess. Don't forget to ask for happy hour
Classic saloon with modern tasty cocktails. One of the best in Meridian.  I recommend the basil gimlet.

Oh my gosh! Pad Thai was DELISH!! 
And oh wow! Will is soooo freakin sweet! We had confusion (on our end I'm sure) and he smoothed everything over so nicely! We will be back for sure!

Two simple words to describe this place - "Too Cute"!  This Children's Museum is a child's paradise.  It has everything from a mock Boise airport, big display of a hands on train and train station to a Trader Joe's mini store.  It is truly a child's wonderland because there is so much a child can do.  I took an official tour yesterday with a nice woman named Tamara.  I was impressed that they sterilize all toys and areas nightly.  

Price admission is reasonable at $9.00 - especially since your child can pretty much stay there all day long because of all what this museum has to offer.

The only warning is that your child may not want to go home.   Our grandson from Vegas didn't want to leave and said this was his favorite place to visit in Idaho.  This place is a Must See and visit!

This place is just bad.... Terrible food and the service is nonexistent. You know it's bad when a 17 year old teenager doesn't even finish one slice of cheese pizza.....

The service was terrible from the start. Our server didn't check on us at all. We ordered the boneless wings which were disgusting. They were chewy like they had been microwaved. When the server brought them out, he didn't bring any utensils, ranch, plates, etc. We asked and had to wait 10 minutes to get utensils. I ordered iced tea and had to ask for sweetener 4 times.

We ordered a large pizza, half smokehouse, half cheese. The cheese pizza had no sauce and was doughy. Like I mentioned our server never really checked on us and was just kind of standing around. 

It's embarrassing when you bring family to a restaurant that is so awful and disappointing. I will never return to this place. It's a bummer because it's a great location. But the customer service and food quality is terrible.
We waited a really long time for very normal (overpriced) food. The service was great though and it's in a great location!

311th person to review Kona Grill, at the Village in Meridian, Idaho. This is my 401st Yelp Review. 

I've been to Kona Grill a few times now and I've enjoyed it each time. The staff is always friendly, upbeat, and top notch. They have a fairly good happy hour (late night, too), ample seating, water/fish displays and a great bar. 

We ordered drinks and sushi mostly. I had a great time with my Yelpie friends Yulia and Ryan and I had more drinks than food, but both were equally good!  We ordered the King crab crunchy roll, dragon roll, caterpillar roll, and for drinks we had the beez neez, and some Kona Mai Thai's!

I've also ordered from Uber eats, right to my door for lunch last week. I highly recommend the Cuban and seasoned fries! If you want to stay home, but have a good meal, that's a good way to order.

Nice facility...but even with an emergency the wait is long. I took my dog there for 6 years and the staff acts like they have never seen us before everytime we arrive! Their is no personal attention, no care, no compassion....go to West Vet, it blows this place out of the water!

Happy hour specials and staff were great which is why I gave them two stars instead of 1!  The club was dead for a Friday night. The staff later in the evening was extremely rude.  When we asked for our bill, they ran our card and never gave us an itemized bill.  After we disagreed with the total, they never provided us with an itemized print-out an instead insulted us insinuating that I "shouldn't drink if couldn't pay my tab."  I've been in a few times but will never return to this establishment. I suggest if you go, don't open a tab and pay cash for each drink.  Even the bouncer admitted that this happens quite often.  A better use of your money will be to go downstairs to Lucky Finns.  They're top-notch!  The entertainment at The Varsity is not worth the hassle.

This McDonalds is the best McDonald's in the area. I live no where near it, but it is still worth the drive when I want some good fast food. The staff is the friendliest I've ever experienced at any restaurant and the quality matches. What are all you people doing reading this review? Hurry up and get over to this McDonald's and have a great meal experience.
Their staff is giving the chicken sandwich place a run for their money in politeness and engaging with customers and the food is great!

If you're looking for someone to listen to your requests/hair concerns then make an appointment with Darla Cummings. She is amazing and worth waiting for to see. She also won't upsell you products or overcharge you. Truly a gem in the industry!

They used to be the best. I guess they have new owners and I will no longer go there! There are no appts, walk in only. With Covid still active you have to sit in the waiting room for who knows how long? Seriously? And prices have gone up! Now looking for another vet.. I had gone there since they opened many years ago. Makes me angry we are treated like this!

Came to visit my sister in law and kept being told how good this place was! I was super excited to go with my family!

Ordered the tortellini with Alfredo sauce & it was delicious! Our waitress was SO nice! Honestly really liked this place & the food was fantastic. Definitely will be back.
Clean place, friendly staff, I just like my bread baked longer should be golden brown not off white, meat quality was excellent just not happy with the bread - but service good and fair price

Expensive, even with coupons. Actually the coupons barely cover tax. So let's just make that Expensive. The service is nice though, guaranteed for years and probably the best locally operated shop in town
I've been here to buy a Taylor acoustic guitar and to buy a Malala uke for my kid. Both times I've been very happy with the inventory and the staff.

So I am not a golfer ..lol..but my Dad belongs to Lakeview and golfs about 3 days a week. He loves this place. He and my mom have lived on this golf course for 13 yrs. My review is not about the golf but rather it is  concerning the food and service. My mom passed away last month and we decided to have her Celebration of Life at the club. MaryClaire is the person in charge of events like this apparently and she did an amazing job! She was attentive, very responsive and accomodating. She even tried to fix the horrible flowers that were delivered. She also did a great job with the food. We just had finger foods but she really encouraged us to get these chicken skewers and boy was she right! Everyone loved them! They didnt charge us for the room as long as we ordered $300 in food. To us, that was a great deal! Also, the people that work there were very sweet to us and Becky and Coleman are hard working bartenders who took great care of us too. It was a great experience despite how emotional it was:)

Been to Jimmy John's before but not in a while. Hoping for a better sandwich than before I took a chance. Ended up with the same basic sandwich as before. It is a tasty sandwich but my gripe is that there is not nearly enough meat and other toppings compared to the bread. It's so light on flavor and just so plain. 

Staff was friendly and the place was clean. I'll stick to my other sandwich shops tho where the ingredients are more generous for the price.

Overall a very nice gun shop and range to visit and shoot at. On my last visit, I was checking out a gun I'd had spring and trigger work to, and a brand new Walther PDP. It's great hanging a target and knowing exactly how far away it is. 5 yards, 10, 15, 25, and the new gun was spot on even at 25!

Independence is a little unique in that they have both an indoor 25-yard pistol range and a 100-yard rifle range. I just need to figure out how to get on the 100 yeard range with my PDP and new red dot sight.

I started going to the Processing Bar about a year or so ago. I had been searching for awhile for a someone that truly understood curly hair. I have definitely had my fair share of horrible haircuts and no one had ever shared their knowledge of how to care for and style curly hair the right way. So . . . I started researching salons that specifically mentioned they knew about curly hair.  I called and left a message and within a day I got a call back from Syndee who told me she was the salon's specialist in the curly world, had been trained on how to cut curly hair and deals with curly hair on the daily because her daughter has curly hair too.

Since then I haven't considered going anywhere else but here. Sydnee always does a great job and is continually sharing new tips, tricks and products that come to market. I appreciate a stylist who is never done educating herself. 

The salon is very open and airy with kind of a modern boho chic vibe. All of the girls that work there are super cute, very nice, and if you follow their Instagram page I think you'd agree they all do great work. The location is in downtown Meridian, with lots of parking options. The owner Tish is a stylist herself and is known for the special method she invented for doing hair extensions.  She travels all over the U.S. training other salons about her method. 

If you are searching for a new salon. Give PB a try. I'm certain there is a stylist there to fit your specific hair type and styling needs!

I had previously posted about a less than stellar experience. The management contacted me and rectified the situation. I am grateful for that. We will try again 

I went a few months ago with my 2 kids and husband for hair cuts. I wanted a layered (Jenifer Anniston) for my daughter and basic cuts for husband and son. My daughter you could NOT even tell they did anything. My husband the cut was awful, we had to come home and fix it. Son was ok. TODAY we went beck (my mistake! Shortest wait time, now I know why) my sons hair is SOOOO uneven! Are these ladies really even trained & licensed?! How do you mess up a basic men's cut so often!!! Will NOT be going back!!
Service: Hair styling

Dr Turner is a wretch. She yells at her staff, belittles them in front of the other staff and clients when they make a mistake. If you have an issue with your staff, that certainly is not the way to handle it. I can only imagine how that girl feels from that mental abuse.

Biggest rip off ever, way overpriced! I went in for a CT scan which they told me would be about $1000. when I got my bill it was $2500 and that is what I have to pay out of my pocket. when nothing was found on the CT scan my doctor requested an MRI. so I went to an imaging place out in Caldwell which charged $420 cash I asked them if they do CT scans and they do and they said that a CT scan would be $400 cash I will never go there again and I will do everything I can to let everyone know that they are way too expensive and not willing to work or help you!!! so look around and don't go here!!!!!

First time here since they opened at this location and not disappointed!

The wait was manageable (if course you wait when they're that good) and the hostess staff very accommodating!

Seated at a high-top and very comfortable.

Food is what makes the wait worth it, I had The Classic.  Knowing you're only getting one sausage patty may be a negative, but when it comes out as a side of pork, the world is okay!

Finally, Cameron the Server was great!  He had numerous tables but made us feel as if we were his only customers!  Great service seems rare these days, refreshingly nice here!

We'll be back!
Jess is the best. She listened to my needs and made the process fun. When my hair didn't take to the dye the first time she worked with me to come back in to do again!!! Also super cute salon.

We had an excellent dinner during happy hour. I had the Kona Grill bowl with chicken and the wife had the chicken/shrimp lettuce wraps and we both had the red wine sangria. Everything was perfect with great taste and presentation.  
It has a cool and relaxing vibe with large aquariums with lively tropical fish.  This is an excellent part of the Village.

It was a great experience. I've tried a few carpet cleaning businesses before and been disappointed. But these guys are it! The service was excellent.  He came in, was very friendly. He got the job done fairly quick and very well. I was so pleased.
I finally found a good carpet business and I'm keeping them. Also their prices are really reasonable.  They are excellent over all. I would recommend.

Okay last time I was here we sat out in the patio and I got gum stuck to my pants the manager was so sweet and caring. I was so embarrassed but they made me feel good about how the situation was handled.  Today we came back my daughter loves the vegas roll and I like that it's on their happy hour. I gotta say that I do love their happy hour. So for a single mom who her kids love eating sushi happy hour is the best. So far I haven't had any issues with a long wait for a table. My only issue on this visit was the flys but hey they are every where, and my chair spot I got bumped a few times with the ice bucket and the glass skate carrier but Chesney was so sweet and nice attitude with kids and she paid attention to us. My kid is on a wheelchair so sometimes it's hard finding a good table that is not gonna be blocking the way. So today was a good experience.  I do love Kona Grill I do wish you guys bring the pesto pasta back tho.
Found a hair in my pancake! Told the manager about it and they did a lot of nothing about it.

Why no towels to dry your car afterwards?? Also first time going I purchased the unlimited pass like an idiot. My car is black and came out with visible new scratches . Smh! I'm canceling my membership as we speak.

I was just reading the rest of the posts and it seems that this restaurant argues and makes excuses even after people took the time to write a review. You all know that the owner/manager is so rude and angry. You know that, but you defend her. You know that if you do not call ahead that you can wait for an hour. You know that there is not enough wait staff yet you argue and make excuses. What is wrong with you. Just fix the problems, don't make excuses. Make changes.
 I have gone here several times but I do not think I am going again. It is VERY busy and VERY loud. The waitresses are always so busy and last time we were told that the "cooks did not have time to peel our cucumber or cut the lettuce smaller on our salad. We asked when we ordered. My elderly mother has allot of teeth issues and needed this done. The waitress, who had previously been nice to us on many visits, was so put out and rude that I said something to her. 
The food is good, but NOT worth the price, the waitresses, and the noise. I will NO longer suggest this place to people

Awesome large park.. a small oasis for locals. Cute pond with lots of ducks and sitting benches (you can also fish here). Huge, nice playground.  Splash pad open in summer. Very large open grass areas, well maintained. Attached tennis courts (or bachi ball.. whatever that's called).  Only downside is how crowded the playground portion can get on a weekend with nice weather, especially when it's hot and the splash pad is open. Parents please stop letting your soaking wet kids run all over the playground portion straight from the splash pad and go on the equipment.. watch them better.. it's rude to have them getting everyone else wet who didn't go there for the splash pad and it's dangerous to have them spreading water all over the playground and equipment. Only reason for four stars is the large summer crowd. All in all, lovely park!
We love all of the food! And especially the owners! Staff is amazing! Food made to order with fresh ingredients!

Another good place to get boba! I got the Matcha Green Tea Ice Blended, it was great, perfect sweetness since I am not a fan of too sweet drinks/desserts. I hope there will be Chè in the future. I also love the garlic parmesan fries. Perfect family snack time on a Saturday afternoon...fries and boba! And we got a surprise...ice cream for everybody! Thank you! Will be back to try more of the food.

An update to my last review. . . . the tooth that my husband had fixed has since turned black all around the gum line!  He said it still gives him pain and it doesn't feel right.  Now I'm going to have to try and convince him to go to another dentist to have it looked at.  He said he refuses to go back to Willow Tree, even if they should be the one's to fix it and make it right.

What's a Black rock waiting in line like normal. This time was a little bit longer than normal the car in front of me was talking with the lady with the red hair and they were talking literally not lying at least 20 minutes. I thought we'll maybe they're waiting for their drink to be made but as a came closer to the 30 minute time. Keep in mind it was nobody else in line I was the second car. I literally backed my car up and left. I knew she knew I was there because she looked at me and my wife. So disappointed. The barista with the red hair should know not to have a personal conversation with somebody what other people are waiting. It's a drive-through for a reason it's supposed to be quick. For this reason I would not recommend to use this company. This was yesterday Friday at 12 o'clock that it happened. I recently discovered the human Bean. I never really wanted to try this but since I had to wait so long at Black rock they're actually literally pushing me to try another coffee shop. So disappointed

Stellar design a great place to come and hang out to enjoy the outdoors, where kids and adults can chill together in a very nice setting. Totally reminded me of outdoor shopping in Southern California. Very thoughtful design. Water  features, small playground, ice-skating rink in the winter months, fire pit, a solid variety of wine bars, pizza, fast food and nicer restaurants to please every taste. Excellent movie theater with ultra comfortable seating, live music, great shopping - higher end and better brands.
Had some time to spend and found this place by chance. The two employees that were there were nice and helpful and the coffee was pretty good.

I've only had 2 pedicures and my first one was pretty good but this one was SO much better!! My daughter and I went and we both got fabulous pedicures. Staff was friendly and service was great! Highly recommend!

Service and food were excellent. Very informed staff, knew their menu well and what what we should order based on our questions. Loved that you could oder everything from sushi, pad Thai noodles, and my teenage son ordered himself the 12oz steak! Delicious!!!!

While this is a great play space for children, it is NOT a children's museum. There is very little science, math, creation, experimentation or investigative learning. The stations are cool...my oldest child, "Hungry", enjoys the Trader Joe's section and loves to dig in the "dirt" at the Farm station. But these sections are no different than other play spaces around the Treasure Valley, such as Jabbers. I have been to several other Children's Museums which had water features, experiments, creation stations, and MOST IMPORTANTLY... a space for my children to eat. Until the Children's Museum of Idaho adds these types of elements, they really need to stop calling themselves a museum.

My two grandchildren absolutely love the school and have been going from the day they opened. My youngest was an infant when she started. From the poor review on Yelp, no, the Infants were not taught Montessori, but we were told upfront that started at 3. The teachers LOVED her and she has thrived. Our little 2 year old started with very little verbal skills. He was cared for and learned so much that first year. He is now in the 3-year old class and the teachers....every single one has been outstanding. Can't say enough great things about them. My other grandchildren started at the Park Center Montessori, owned by the same company. Excellent experience there as well.

SO DISAPPOINTED. Bought a house in the winter and was super excited about it. My parents liked the look of it as well and decided to buy in the same neighborhood. After living here for a few months, I realize how cheap the construction of the house is where the paint is chipping easily on the inside. The window sills are cracking after only two months of living here.

Aside from the construction, the COMPANY IS AWFUL AND ONLY CARES ABOUT MONEY. We bought a house on the backside of an empty area where the house was advertised as "no neighbors". I saw some construction behind it and asked the head of develop or construction as the lady who did our walk-through stated. She said they were "CBH developers, but she didn't know what was going to be going there." Then I asked about the construction and she said, "it should only be a few more months." At the time the construction wasn't terrible and they maintained a good ratio of quiet and noise. 

Fast forward a few months: MY HOUSE IS SHAKING LIKE AN EARTHQUAKE EVERY DAY MONDAY-SUNDAY. I WAKE UP TO CONSTRUCTION BEEPING AND OTHER NOISES AND GO TO BED WITH THE SAME NOISES. I also have a newborn in the house who doesn't get a break and cries all day because with the coronavirus we don't have any other place we can escape to. I HAVE CALLED and EMAILED CBH who DIDNT CARE AT ALL. It gets so bad I have to call the police and City of Kuna. Now I am going to have to make a statement at the next town hall meeting just to get a break from constant noise, disturbance, and the ground shaking. ALSO, I am not able to stay at my house I have to go to stores and restaurants to keep my baby from crying from all the noise at the house. 

DONT BUY A HOUSE FROM THEM... THEY ONLY CARE ABOUT MONEY AND NOT YOU AS PEOPLE.

Billing office/department/person was terrible. Our family went here for over four years and were happy with services until this happened.

Got billed for a routine cleaning that should have been covered 100% when they added a new dentist. Had to spend hours trying to get a correction only to get a bill for the amount of discount that our insurance company gets!! Numerous more calls and time wasted and they would not remove the charge until I contacted my insurance administrator who then contacted them. Finally, the charge was removed the the credit I had before all this started was gone.

Wasted enough time and energy on this. Our credit was gone and now so are we.

I ordered this place for all of my employees a couple days in a row. It was supposed to be for 4 days in a row but we cancelled after I got some really bad customer service from the events coordinator and most of my employees agreed that they didn't really care for the food. I heard some employees say they really liked the street tacos but that $10 for 3 of them was a bit high. One guy couldn't even take more than two bites of his Pork Adobo because he said it was incredibly too salty. Like I said, a couple people really liked it.. out of 25 people.. I didn't like the food but I really didn't like the service I got from the events coordinator. Woman got some attitude with me and hung up on me over a very solvable issue that I was willing to work with her on even though it was her mistake. When I called her back to confront her she insisted that she didn't hang up on me that she thought the call was over (in the middle of our conversation?). She gave me some excuses like she's been dealing with emails since she sat down at her desk, has been dealing with crappy internet all day, and her assistant didn't show up that day. I get having one of those days but you don't ever hang up on a customer or treat a customer like that. That's how you lose business...

Some nice things to say: The food that we did receive in those two days was delivered on time each day and the presentation was very nice. It's obvious that the chef there takes a lot of pride in his work and does his very best.

So I always start off my bbq reviews with a disclaimer that I am a bbq snob and I usually am disappointed with eating bbq out only because I have mastered the craft myself. Well not true with Big Daddy's. I came her last week with my daughter and son in law and had a great experience. I love the fact that this is a locally owned BBQ joint and really delivered on the books or should I say meat...

Looking over the menu and reviews I already knew I was having brisket and for a little variation I had a jalapeño sausage out on the side. The brisket was super good and has great smoke flavor. However it was a little on the drier side which I like more moist but either way still retained great flavors. For sides I had the slaw and fries and both were super delicious as well. I really enjoyed the spicy bbq sauce which had great spice but not too overpowering. These fries could be a drug in themselves how good they were and the slaw was as well. 

My son in law got the Big sriracha sandwich which consists of brisket, pulled pork, cheddar and pepper jack plus their sriracha bourbon sauce.  This  looked so good and he gets this every time they come and loves every bite. I know on my next trip this is what I will be getting for sure. 

This was a real treat and unexpected to find such a great place here but goes to show you there are hidden gems all over and this place (quote from Guy Fiere) is for sure one of them!
Food and atmosphere were great!   Really loved the service. Jodi and Marquel were excellent.

The ice cream is good, but nothing extraordinary. We also felt that the prices/sizes weren't as generous as other local ice cream shops, and that the variety of toppings were lacking. However, the employees are very kind & the store is clean with a homey atmosphere!

It seems so many people rave about this place, so my wife and I finally ventured out to see for ourselves what's so special. 

The fish tank is pretty stink in' cool, I gotta say. And this word of compliment comes from an expert in salt water aquariums. I kept my own tank from the age of 19 for several years. With the seafood options abundant on the menu, the colorful array of coral reef natives is a nice touch. 

Beyond the reef, however, I was a little disappointed. The prices seem out of place in the overall experience. The portions were very small. Our waitress, I'm pretty sure, was a last minute fill-in from the truck stop diner. And I couldn't find much that suited my gluten-free taste. 

So, I don't think we will be stopping here again. Why should we when there is an abundance of 4 and 5 star places in Meridian? The Yellow Tang was amazing to look at, but in the end she left me high and dry.

We purchased our home brand new. CBH has skated around several of our warranty claims. Now, conveniently after the home warranty expired, two years later our water heater keeps leaking and flooding our garage. Not only is CBH not offering to pick up the service call by the vendor they hired to install it, but the vendor, Shiloh Plumbing, is insisting I agree ahead of time to pay $125 for them just to look at it and states there would be no warranty for parts. No water heater should be leaking after only two years of use. Yet another mark against cbh and it shoddy home building.

Went for breakfast on a Monday. Ordered the mimosa "flight"- which instead of trying 4 types of mimosas- was 4 REGULAR SIZE MIMOSAS! Nothing to write home about- but it was my birthday so I got it. They were fine - basic juice and cheap bubbly. Still fun. Ordered the eggs Benedict. Good. Would have ordered the hashbrowns to be overcooked in hindsight- they were undercooked and I hate that. All in all- my whole family ordered their breakfast preferences and were happy. The building is large and stately for a diner. Felt cozy and happy. Wait staff was kind and didn't mind us entering the wrong door. Our server was lovely. American breakfast at its core. Would go again.

Gave this place multiple chances. First time I loved it. This is visit six or seven. Dissatisfied for various reasons the last couple times. Paying for a whole cheesesteak and only partially filled is unacceptable. See pic. And hey I see the beef but where's the cheese?  Don't quite know what to say. Spent 35 bucks today and a fry was missing from the bag too. Usually I would call and complain to management but who really has time for that anymore. Staff is very nice I will give them that.

Stopped in at Lovejoy's with my wife and in-laws recently. Lots of fun options to choose from and the aesthetics of the place is fun and trendy. They also have a wall of different ice cream scoops am which is kind of cool! 
My wife and I shared a regular and got the peanut butter chocolate (her favorite) and banana pudding. I really enjoyed the banana pudding! It was creamy and soft but still had the texture of the Nilla Wafers. 
Reasonable prices and I'd come back again when I'm in town again.

We stopped here after dinner, and had a great experience! There are a few options on how you want your ice cream, and we went with the "Puddlejumper," where you get five small scoops served on a plate. With around 25 flavors (dairy-free, gluten free, and vegan options as well), everyone was satisfied with their selections. Some favorites were the Strawberry Fields, Snickerdoodler, and S'mores (with real marshmallows inside!). Seating is clean and cute (note the swings). Fairly new joint in Meridian and did not disappoint! They have floats and paninis as well. Everything is very affordable and delicious. Stop in for a nice treat!

I called Golden Massage Spa at almost 7pm on New Year's Eve to see if there was any way they could get me in for a 1 hour reflexology foot massage. The lady who answered the phone happily said that it was no problem & told me that I could come right over.  I arrived about 10 minutes later. 
As soon as I walked in, I was greeted by the woman who answered the phone.  She escorted me back to my room & asked me what temperature I wanted my water. I have been to dozens of reflexology spas and never once has anyone ever asked me about my preferred water temperature before. When my therapist, Amy, brought the water it was perfect.  I put my feet in the water, laid back, & relaxed. 
Amy massaged my head, neck, face, arms, & hands before massaging my feet. She was very attentive and made sure that the pressure she was using was comfortable for me.  It was! Just when I thought the massage couldn't get any better, Amy started on my feet.  She used an exfoliating scrub/lotion rather than just plain lotion. It made the massage even better.  The scrub wasn't really gritty, but it was gritty enough to feel great. It was honestly utter perfection! Amy finished my massage with a rub down of my back. 
I can't say enough positive things about Amy & the Golden Massage Spa. They exceeded my expectations & I can't wait to return for another massage.  The only thing that I will do differently next time is I will get a longer massage (90 or 120 minutes). 
If you want a great massage at a reasonable price, head over to Golden Massage Spa. It will not disappoint.

Fresh off the smoker my asterisk.  I spent a lot of money for lunch for four and was served leftover garbage.  The meats were dry as heck.  Probably had been reheated several times.

If your charging this much money to serve this quality of food you're failing on more than one level:. The chef is failing.  The cooks are failing.  And the server is failing.

Show some pride in your product for crying out loud...

Blech.  No thanks!

Best coffee place I've found in town. Plus, it's within walking distance from my house. I never wonder if they're going to get my drink right, whereas with other coffee places, I leave worried. The consistency from this location is awesome. I also love the points system and the deals they have all the time!

I don't know if this was just an off day for the restaurant, but our experience was subpar to say the least.

The good:
*Lemongrass chowder and the sushi were delicious
*Kid's bento box with the orange slice bear was adorable

The bad:
*Our sodas were a little flat, our server even mentioned this as he thought they were running low on syrup. This wasn't a huge deal, but with the rest of the experience it's worth mentioning
*our server spilled sprite on our table, which got on us, and in my sake, he said sorry and threw 2 napkins on the table
*we all ordered the $19 power lunch special, other than the sushi and soup, the rest of the food was mediocre at best. The bbq flatbread was gross, it had a very strange funky flavor to it
* We ordered calamari as an appetizer which the server forgot, we reminded him when our food came out. We finally got our appetizer after we had finished our lunch only to find that it was undercooked and the dough was still raw, not to mention way over salted. Gross
* After letting him know about the calamari he took it back but still tried to charge us for it? No. Luckily when asked about it they took it off.
* I ordered the sake flight, one of the sakes was absolutely delicious, I would've loved to know more about it and potentially buy some. Too bad our server didn't even tell me what was in the flight, he just brought the 3 glasses and put them on the table. After the horrible experience there was no way I was going to ask about the sake because I just wanted to leave.

Overall very disappointed. Overpriced, bland or straight up gross food, and horrible service. Would not recommend and will not be back.

This is probably one of my favorite BBQ's and the prices are great. You get a healthy amount of food which is not over sauced and done perfect.  Cute place, down to earth hospitality and super good!  The menu is amazing!

We waited about 45 minutes to get a table. Once we got inside the restaurant after ordering it had been about an hour, and we never got our food. The server was argumentative about how long we had waited. In the end we left without eating. A manager never came to our table. I would not recommend this place to anyone. We ended having to go elsewhere to get food. We will not be back.

Tea bombs: amazing! 
Waffles: WOWZA! 
Açaí Bowls: OMG!!
Smoothie: Blow your mind! 

This stuff is healthy & amazing! 

Winner winner! 

Reese's shake...

Amazing food! Amazing service. Had lunch today with my wife at Bruchi's. We had an All Meat and Supreme Steak Cheesesteak. The roll was soft and flavorful, fries were piping hot. Will definitely be hitting Bruchi's up again.

Downtown Meridian has a bar worthy of any big city downtown. The Roosevelt is a bar that offers historical vibes, warm wood decor, classy but casual style, and a great bar to pony up too.  The Roosevelt provides seating at the bar, in private booths, and out back on their patio. The patio offers plenty of seating with a food truck near by.
The Roosevelt is super clean with a great bartender (Alex i believe was his name). 
If you are in downtown Meridian and looking for a well made cocktail, the Roosevelt will not disappoint. This place is a great addition for Meridian and I look forward to many drinks in the future.
Cheers Always!

Not sure it's worth the hype. This place was super busy when we went and the bar area was literally a dog-eat-dog first come first serve type seating situation. There were people circling like vultures. Once we found a spot, we were served quickly and the martinis were good but nothing exceptional. They had some yummy desserts but again not sure the wait was worth the price tag or the wait.

Went to this place for the first time yesterday. I had high hopes but unfortunately walked out feeling unimpressed. I did like the flight of mimosas we ordered they were good. But the rest was just mediocre. When the food came out it wasn't very warm, the flavor wasn't anything to die for, and the cinnamon roll was so dry and barely had frosting on it. Plus when the bill came I was very surprised that for four people two of those people being little kids out bill was 70 dollars for breakfast!!! Yikes
