First time here. Cool wood and rustic decor with cozy booths inside and a big patio outside. Upscale type of bar with Mexican food truck out back. No waiters that service tables and you order your drinks at bar and make a separate order of food out back at the food truck. Food truck owner was super cool and food was good but seemed like it didn't fit the bar. Had a handful of beers on tap and a bunch of specialty mixed drinks which were good. I would go back again.

Do you live in the greater Boise, Idaho area?  Do you love Kansas City style barbecue and other genres of barbecue, all served at the same restaurant?  If so, you're in luck, as you can get your "Kansas City fix" at Big Daddy's Barbecue, located in nearby Meridian.

As you enter the restaurant, you'll be greeted by a friendly "meeter/greeter" staff member who will cheerfully seat you.  You'll also notice the "specials" on the "old school" blackboard, the somewhat rustic decor, and he full-service bar at the rear of the restaurant.

We loved the corrugated steel that serves as wallpaper on the walls, which adds to the "rustic" and barbecue atmosphere of the restaurant. As you enter the restaurant, you'll be immediately greeted with an "old school" blackboard which announce the current specials.  We loved the horse shoes, which are set in the "good luck" mode.

The restaurant has a definite "sports bar" theme, as the decor is rustic, there is a full-service bar, and there are many television monitors around the dining room.

You have to know this will be GOOD BARBECUE  as each table is set with a roll of paper towels, along with three varieties on in-house-made barbecue sauce.  Those little amenities are the mark of a restaurant who knows all about barbecue.  Alright... with the sauce, you can choose between "House" sauce, "Mild" or my preference, "Spicy."  All are made in-house, and all are good, but tonight, I went with the spicy variety, and I wasn't disappointed.

The menu offers three styles of barbecue:  Kansas City, Carolina and Memphis.  What more could you ask for?  OK... maybe Texas?

From the "Platters" section of the menu, my friend ordered a "One Meat and Two Sides."  Her choice of meat was pulled pork, and she smoked green beans along with "Smashed Garlic Potatoes" as her two sides.  How much would like the bet the potatoes were locally grown, as southwestern Idaho is the "potato capitol" of the United States.

My friend raved about her dinner, as her green beans were tender, smoky and full of flavor.  Like the pulled pork on my "The Big Daddy," her's was juicy, smoky and tender.  She had actually ordered gravy on her "Smashed Potatoes" and her order arrived without gravy, but with a timely word to our friendly server, a bowl of gravy quickly arrived.  The bowl of gravy made her dinner complete!

From the "Sammies" section of the menu, I finally went with "The Big Daddy," as it seemed to be the "signature" offering on the menu, as it shares the name with the restaurant.  The "Smoked Burgers" section truly tempted me, and I spent about 10 minutes deciding on my order.

The menu describes "The Big Daddy" as, "Spicy sausage link, chopped brisket and pulled pork, piled on a toasted hoagie.  The dish comes with one side, and my choice was "Smashed potatoes" with gravy.

This is a BIG sandwich, which will satisfy a Big appetite!  It starts out with a toasted hoagie roll and the foundation of the sandwich is a large, smoked hot link, Cajun style.  Yes, it's spicy and hot, but "doable" for just about anybody who appreciated fine barbecue.  On top of the large link, you'll find a generous helping of smoked pulled pork and brisket.  Wow!  Such an amazing sandwich!

The hoagie roll was lightly buttered and perfectly toasted, and the meat was "melt in your mouth" smoked, flavorful and tender.

And the "Smashed Potatoes" with brisket gravy... where do I begin to describe such goodness?  I can start by saying the side started out with red potatoes, seasoned with garlic, perfectly cooked and mashed, with little bits of skin mashed in, which something I simply love.  The amazing mashed potato side dish was covered with brisket gravy, and sprinkled with green onions.  Oh yeah!!!

My friend and I enjoyed our delicious dinners, and enjoyed the amazing service that Big Daddy's Barbecue provides. This amazing restaurant should be a "go-to" for anyone who savors delicious barbecue in the greater Boise are.

When you combine amazing Kansas City style barbecue, along with other barbecue styles, a comfortable and informal dining room, a full-service bar, delicious food along with friendly service, Big Daddy's Barbecue is the perfect restaurant to enjoy great barbecue!
Clean inside and friendly staff. Oh, and the beer is good. You can sit and hang out while drinking or play games, shuffle board, random board games, skee ball, or old-school video game.

Larger potion? yes.. but is it worth the time and money? nope, it's just your another average Joe's breakfast place with an extra long wait time!  Be prepared to wait for at least fourty five minutes for the food to arrive after you place the order. I just had to sip in 3 refills of coffee and practically survive a headache before I got my food. Now with all those caffeine, time to get things done! Oh wait, half of the day is already gone.

Whoa! You gotta go to Kona!! 
I've been frequenting Kona for years during happy hour. It is my colleagues favorite place to eat and drink after a long work week. Due to Covid we haven't been there in a long time. My partners day job co worker asked we come in and check it out so we made a date night. We used the online registration process for a table by the window and pretty sure we had the best seat in the restaurant. Our server was absolutely delightful! Chantel was attentive, personable, and worked diligently to make our dining experience positive! The manager (Sean?) even came to our table and chatted with us about Andy (day job coworker) and offered to comp our first round of drinks for coming in on Andy's request and for coming back after such a long time away. Very professional and personable manager. We noticed he was working the floor checking on each guest. Very impressive! 
We had the most delicious dishes. Calamari, shrimp and chicken lettuce wraps, spider roll, shrimp and lobster roll, yellow tail sashimi. We highly recommend all the dishes! We also had carrot cake to go. I would recommend sharing because one piece is HUGE! 
We will definitely be back sooner then later!

Straightforward buying process. These are not custom built homes so comparing them is not apples to apples. You get a good house at a reasonable price that is a blank canvas ready to turn into a home. Just be prepared to bring up the level of finish and do some landscaping at you won't be disappointed.

My wife and I had been to Kona grill before. Now it's just another expensive restaurant with subpar food and drinks ! $21 for a French dip sandwich. I've had better sandwiches drinks at a cheesy sports bars for half the price !
Argentinian Fish TacosArgentinian Fish Tacos. Good food and service. Had to look hard to find fish. Small piece in each taco about 1" X 1/2". Cole slaw was good tho
Amazing gyro! One of the best I've had. Fries were on point too. Definitely worth stopping in. Fast service, great food.

This place has well earned a 5-star and beyond rating on my book.

After seeing every review on Yelp, I have decided to pay a visit.  It's a very clean little eatery.  Probably not good for a large crowd but it was perfect for a late lunch for me today.

I was eyeing on their waffle pressed sandwich and the soup noodle.  Decided to try the sandwich first.  Love , love, love the sandwich "buns" (??). It is not bread but buttery flaky croissant-like pastry with ham, cheese and avocado (extra charge).  An order of sandwich comes with fries, but it is huge.  I think 2 people can share an order of sandwich with an extra order of fries.  Or their lunch special a half sandwich, a bag of chip, and a drink.  Since I just can't after my 3 hour hiking, I ate it all.

I love Boba drink, so I had to try theirs.  It is alright to me.  Milk tea tastes great but Boba too soft for me.  I didn't complain but commented it when the owner asked me what I thought of their food.  The owner explained that he used to make them chewy but most people like softer texture so he started making them soft.  I can totally understand, knowing most of non-Asian don't care much (like) the chewy desserts or sticky rice, so it makes sense to me.

Service is awesome, great, friendly!  They even gave me a slice of banana bread after meal.  I bet it was made in their kitchen because it was full of banana.  Before I left, the owner made another cup of Boba drink with chewier Boba for free.  I was in shock, because I wasn't unhappy about my drink, it was just not my type of Boba.  

I sure will be back to try the noodle soup.  Their friendly service is definitely welcoming.  This is a place I will go back not only for their food but also for their smiley faces and service.

P.S.  check in a Yelp will earn you 10% off of your purchase.  I checked in after I placed my order but I can save it for next time.

Hidden gem! This place is not just for gamers/comic collectors- caffeine addicts shouldn't be fooled by the lack of coffee-related signage. I was pleasantly surprised to stumble across this bright, clean store with excellent, friendly customer service. Full espresso bar! Tasty, local Dawson & Taylor coffee. I had a delicious Green Goblin pumpkin breve made as a latte- highly recommended! Sounds like they may be adding some lavender drinks as well. Grab a drink at The Collector's Outpost while you're waiting for your table at Moe Joe's (drip coffee only there).

Great service!  The staff is super nice and helpful.  The food is always fresh and so yummy.

I love Athleta products, but this store at The Village needs to do some catch up regarding prices and customer service. I've had mixed experiences at this store, there have been some nice associates and sometimes I've been totally ignored. I returned items that I bought at the store because they're cheaper online, so they should sync their price list. Difference was 50% off of said item price. 
There's a lot of room for customer service improvement and you have the tools to do it.

Just got out of design studio with wife. We are having home built in Meridian subdivision. From the cbh agent Jodi to the design studio gals, all have exceeded expectations! They have been informative and pleasant to work with on every aspect. Wife has had so much fun picking out interior and exterior options, even kids had fun picking their cabinet colors. Hopefully, the build and rest of the process goes this well. Will update every few months!

Update: I am just now getting a glimpse as to why all the 1 star reviews. I was literally told by everybody I talked to to STAY AWAY from CBH. Came here on a Thursday night for my friend's birthday dinner. 

I first noticed their great selection of drinks and couldn't wait to try them. I ended up ordering a Huckleberry margarita. When it arrived at the table I noticed how beautifully garnished and filled to the top of the glass it was. As soon as I tried the drink I realized that it was watered down and I couldn't taste any tequila. I had my friend try it just to be sure that I wasn't just crazy and we both agreed that it was watered down. My friends strongly suggested​ that I needed to send the drink back & mind you, I've never sent anything back to a kitchen or a bar and felt really bad for asking the server to make another.

When the server brought out the remade drink she said that the bartender told her that she had thought she forgot to add the alcohol to my first drink... Like WHAT?? How do you forget to add the alcohol to a margarita?? If you thought you forgot the alcohol, why did you fill the glass to the top and made it seem like a full drink? If in doubt wouldn't you try the drink or just remake one from the start?? I have so many questions but I'm just so glad my friends made me send the drink back or else I would have paid $9 to drink ice and Huckleberry syrup. 

No apparent apology was made for not adding alcohol to my drink at all. No comment from management or anything. No discount on the bill. Just thought it was an interesting way to handle it.

Moral of the story is: send that shit back if it doesn't taste right cuz something might be missing.

Food: ordered the steak bistro salad and I loved the dressing. I just thought it would have been nice to get thinner slices of the beef instead of the chunks but I cut it up on my own and ate it all anyway so it doesn't really matter right?
If you're looking for the best desserts then you really need to try this place the frozen yogurt treats are to die for, I'm going to bring my family and friends here for years to come I know it.
Omelet was even cooked was still wet. Got our toast and it wasn't even toasted . Wont go back

Ok, guess that's it for me, Yelperfolkers! 
Thanks for reading!

Cheers!

First off I was told to be 30 minuets early for my appointment due to being a new patient. I showed up for the appointment early as requested yet the office did not open it's doors until 10 minuets after myth scheduled appointment. When I was finally brought back to see the doctor the reason I originally scheduled the appointment for was not addressed. Instead the doctor focused on two different issues that we're not causing pain or concern for me and almost behaved as if he were a commissioned sales person trying to convince me to have an elective surgery and to purchase orthotics.

Mediocre at best.  Waitress did not tell us that there was a hotter salsa available with the free chips.  What we got was very plain.  Food was dry and needed more sauce.  The rice was over cooked to the point of being crunchy.  Also we were not informed that if we wanted sour cream we would be charged extra.  Overall, I am sure there are better Mexican restaurants in the area.
Was in town for a wedding. Stopped for breakfast ordered chicken fried steak. It was without a doubt the best chicken fried steak I've ever had! The service was fantastic as well.

My car was damaged during my last visit for a routine car wash. As the employee was ushering me in, a chunk of my hubcap broke off onto the pavement. A couple hours later they called and lied, saying that I steered the wrong way and that they weren't responsible. I brought my dad in a couple days later so we could review the tape and Phil (the manager) lied again to both of our faces. When the video proved that I didn't do what they say I did, he made excuses, continuing to say they weren't responsible, and that I couldn't record/possess the video for myself. As someone who works in retail this is the worst customer service experience I have ever had. If anything happens to your car here, don't count on them to be responsible OR honest.

You have to order through an electronic kiosk, which tells you to pick a seat and wait for your order. All the seating is blocked from use. No one acknowledges your order, you just stand waiting for someone to bring your stuff, which takes forever. Seems like they focus on the drive through. The place is also dirty- the soda station had sticky soda spilled all over the table. My food was decent. Avoid this place.

I have been craving Kona's Pad Thai Noodle & the Sunset Roll  Ohh my. Usually soo yummy. I was so excited to take my family of 6 ( usually 7 ) for an early dinner/ late lunch. From the Ladies at the hostess stand, where we checked on our reservation, to the " manager" & our waiter... we received nothing but poor poor service ( we were giving them unlimited grace, due to staff shortage etc UNTIL the " manager " brought 2 too many miso soups to our table & sat them down while pwe were trying to explain we already received the 2 we ordered. She proceeds SK and Kb

I love this joint. Best bacon I've ever eaten at a restaurant. I've tried several items on their menu and all are great. The coffee is strong and regularly topped off. The bread that comes with their meals is out of this world!

Kona Grill has great food, I ate at the bar with the bartender Jody , she creates an amazing atmosphere hard-working , and attentive to all of her customers at the bar and the table surrounding.
I recommend Kona Grill Meridian highly, food is excellent, the atmosphere in the bar is amazing because of Jody..

I've been bringing my cars to them for about 6 years, a total of 7 different cars of different makes and models. I've always been very satisfied with both the repairs and the way they treat their customers. Before I retired I spent over 30 years in various aspects of the auto repair industry, everything from mechanic, to service writer, to auto insurance claims, and I can tell you these guys do things right. And I can also tell you that there were 2 occasions over the years when a part failed or there was an issue with the repair and they have stood behind their warranty 100% on both occasions. I have personally dealt with Perry, Brett and Bill and had a great experience with all of them.

I really... really expected better.  It was like Chuck E Cheese, but with slightly better pizza and without all the cool games.

Took like 5-10 minutes to get served.  Server was nice.

Got a personal pizza, and a Caesar salad.  Salad had the same creamy lousy Caesar dressing that most places have anymore, and didn't seem to have anchovy or anything.  The pizza was one step up from PapaDominoHut, so they've got that going for them.

The best thing I had was the people watching.  Apparently, if you've got kids, and want a place where they can act like absolute maniacs while you feed them for cheap and drink yourself to oblivion, this is the place to be.  Every other table had multiple kids, all of whom were terrible.  The table next to me had like four, the family left an atomic mess which took over 5 minutes to clean up, and there was still pizza crust on the floor after the table was bused.

I'll eat here again if I end up with 5 kids, am broke, and want to drink enough to not hate my life while feeding the flock.
Okay place. Sat at the bar. Attentive bartenders. Excellent edamame, excellent drinks. Packed! May go back.

These are the rudest people I have ever had to deal with. The unprofessionalism is outstanding. They way I was treated was unacceptable. It seems like they are hurting for money, the place is run down, while doing the procedure, things were coming unplugged left and right and mistakes were being made. I originally wanted the tooth pulled because I couldnt afford a root canal, they kept insisting that I do a root canal and that it would be cheaper and when I asked for a quote they dodged the question constantly, they ended up charging me $1500 for a root canal with insurance and $500 for a crown, after I was told $900 and after going to a different dentist they told me it would be cheaper to have the tooth pulled!! Truly a terrible experience, after getting a root canal, my tooth was in excrutiating pain, i felt little "nicks" in my other teeth, I assume to break through the enamel so I can return to give them more money.I only make $13,000 a year and am in medical debt up to my eye balls, i missed 3 payments and they sued me and garnished my wages, can't afford my car payments or rent. These people are scum bags.
I highly recommend seeking another dentistry.

The wait staff here during the noon shift was superb- very attentive and friendly. We think a C-minus on the food, however. I've had BBQ so tender and flavorful each bite is a delight. This was merely ok. I don't recommend the lemonade. It's just a yellow concoction with (probably) lemon flavoring.  And then we get to COVID precautions. The management clearly isn't taking it seriously. They had the requisite "masks required" sign hanging--in the window of a locked door! No such sign hangs at eye level on the entry door. Inside, the wait staff wore masks, but customers waiting for food or ordering food were unmasked. As new strains of Covid move into Idaho, the warning from scientists should be heeded: if you're going unmasked, you're about to run out of luck.

Professional and courteous. 

I was working from home... as many of us do today, and Craig came in and did the work with minimum distraction and without needing direction beyond the initial walk through of the carpets. The downside to that is that I might have expected him to ask if I wanted additional work done on some persistent spots, but that's not a reason to dock a star in this case.

I'd say that he took his time to do the job well and the carpet came out as well as could reasonably expected.

So disappointed. Wow!! It was so poor, that we didn't even get to eat. Let's just cut to the chase. Talk about poor costumer service. We sat at our table for less then five minutes when our waitress practically attacked me when I asked if there was eggs in the bread because my son is severely allergic to eggs. She yelled in my face and was very hostile toward me, saying how rude I was and how I was so disrespectful. I literally asked if she could check the bread for eggs, just check.. and all she kept yelling, "I'm not an allergist... I'm not an allergist". I wasn't asking her to be an allergist, clearly she isn't one, she works at the restaurant, and my sons allergist said he is severely allergic to eggs so what's the big deal asking if there was anything eggless on the menu? And if I tried to say anything she would just jump on me about how rude I was. Clearly, she has no respect for people. I am a mother advocating for her 2 year old son. I don't know when that turned bad. Maybe you guys should teach your staff about costumer service???... and when to bite your tongue? I have been a nurse in a hospital for over 9 years and I would never talk to my patients that way, no matter how hard my day is. I have never been so disrespected in my life. All I can say is wow, how do you sleep at night? So rude.


- As a first time costumer, I will take my business elsewhere; thank you.
Being from So. Cal del is a staple. This only shares the name of my beloved chicken soft taco Thursday nights.  I've given it a few chances.  Just seems worse each time. Never going back.
Sooo Good! If you are wondering if it's worth the trip, it is! You won't find better.  Pamper yourself a little.
My wife and I both went here on a Friday evening. Food was very good and the atmosphere also. I would recommend this barbecue joints to anyone.
Got me in relatively quickly, turnaround time wasn't bad either. Compare to Vegas prices seemed very reasonable.  Will take BMW Wagon in again for future service.

Disappointing experience.  Server forgot appetizer after having a conversation about it then forgot second beer.  When asked about the appetizer her response was did you order an appetizer? Since we didn't have an appetizer the only way to judge the meal was on the main course. The mashed potatoes were extremely garlicky the vegetables were spicy beyond being edible but the steak was good.
Awesome place for breakfast! Food was excellent and the champagne flight was amazing!

We love Joe Momma's! We always make sure to go online and get on the waitlist before we arrive because it is always packed. Mimosas are wonderful and flowing and the food is so good! We have always had amazing service and the owner,Kat, is always available to say hello amongst running around. This is our favorite breakfast spot, hands down.

One star is one too many.  Took my truck in for a check engine light.  I had another company replace two sensors prior and told them when dropping it off.  They replaced the same sensors that had just been replaced instead of the ones causing the problem.  As soon as I pulled out of their parking lot the light was on again.  I spent $530 bucks for them to replace the new sensors and when the light came on and I went back they said I had two different censors that needed replaced and it would be an additional $530.  Really??  Job done wrong and in the hole  $530, what a joke!

The Moroccan steak bites are phenomenal, but even better is Laura who tends bar and has to be one of the best servers I've had in the hospitality industry. She is Beyond thoughtful, always one step ahead, v quick on her toes and an absolute joy to chat with. She's very professional in a fun way and the GM, Mike is alway extremely helpful and provides amazing customer service.

Also, did I mention the Moroccan Steak bites?

The staff is always welcoming and listens to your help fitness needs. Love the facility and how FRESH and CLEAN the gym is. Everyone is always upbeat and personable. I always feel like family here at this gym. Loved the fact I got to meet with the Fitness Manager and get some information about proper form and supplementation. Diet was a huge take away. Thank you staff for all that you do. Will be recommending to friends and family.

We went here for the very first time and we had an amazing experience! The food was great and our waitress was even more amazing than the food!! Chantel was so kind and caring. We had 5 kids at our table and she was great with them. She is the ideal waitress and knows customer service! I can't say enough good things about her. We will be requesting to be seated where she is serving anytime we go. A++ to her!

Had lunch with my husband.  After 1pm.  Not to busy.  Slow service.  $22 Pad Thai that was sticky and not very tasty.  Ordered the lunch special. Salad, Pad Thai and Brownie.  Salad was great.  Main course was OK
Never got  brownie.   Looks like just drinks from now on.

When I called for an appointment, I was instructed to just show up and call from the outside. When I did so, I was made to wait for an hour and a half. I tried to call them at the 1 hour mark, and they said they would be right out to get my cat. Another 30 minutes passed with no service. Rather than risk having my cat die waiting in their parking lot another moment, I drove away. They finally called me at the 2 hour mark to say they were sorry for getting "backed up." Unacceptable. Also unacceptable to leave people with pets (and plus I had my toddler with me) to sit outside or in their car for hours when it's this hot outside. Wish I had read the Yelp reviews before wasting my time.
This is a beautiful location with delicious food and great service! Our server went above and beyond, making refills on drinks a treat for my two nieces.

We've used ABC for many years now.  Adam was superb, fast and very personable.  

Highly recommended!!

If I could give zero starts I would. The staff here are complete inconsiderate of their customers. Very rude when I called in about my issue. Cups were covered in ice cream. Fries not cooked. Wrong sizes, wrong blizzards. Their response was not let me fix that, it was "we can't take it back sorry". Worst management ever

Came in, asked to sit outside, the hostess handed me the menus and instructed me to sit anywhere and the server would be out.  Sat for 20 minutes and no service.  The tables around me were in dire need of refills. I went back in, returned the menus and went next door.

My family loves coming to this park. There is something for everyone here.  Their play area has a great assortment of structures for all ages. My son has never not made a new friend while playing here. They also have several different faux rocks to climb and a fun interactive music area.  There is also a water park, which is welcome relief from the hot days. And a free way to cool off!

During the summer months they have a snack shack if you forgot a drink or need a quick snack for a hungry little one.  There is also a lifeguard on duty for the water area, who monitors the kids to make sure they don't get out of hand.

There is a small catch and release pond, which my dog loves to swim in. A huge grassy field for flying kites, a football or soccer game or throwing a frisbee. Several tennis courts, a really nice horseshoe area and several baseball diamonds. There is also a paved pathway around the outer border of the park, which is great for evening walks, bike rides, roller blading etc.

Nice clean bathrooms and a few drinking fountains.

During the summer they have movies in the park. Giant blow up movie screen, relaxing on the lawn and a family friendly movie. They have other activities lined up for the late afternoon, if you want to make the day of it.

Definitely one of our favorite places to kill an hour or two, and wear down the kids! :)

Permanently closed December 2021.  :-(  This locally owned franchise of a California headquartered chain served up delicious gelato in a plethora of flavors, including several that changed with the seasons, as well as local owner made chocolates and pastries in a sparkling space with convenient parking in an Eagle / Meridian strip mall and maybe the best part was the super friendly young women at the counter who could answer questions, make recommendations and offer samples.  Not to mention making the most unique affogato we have ever had...and since my husband is Italian heritage we have had quite a lot of them in 40 years together.

The interior space was completely accessible to people of all ages and abilities with both hi top and standard seating and lots of room to get around to all seats, plus a few seats on the sidewalk.  There were also decks of cards and board games if one wanted to, for example, beat one's husband a few hands of gin rummy while enjoying an affogato.  

I kept postponing writing the review, even after we had been in three times, and now I find through communication with the owner yesterday, the shop has closed for good.  She shared publicly with me and so I'll share it here that they experienced a 300% decline in sales since September and were not able to renegotiate with the owner of the space on a lease.  The prices for the gelati were 'up there' but it was a luxury item and no  more expensive than the up end ice cream shops in Boise.  

The space was charming meets modern and the service so great, I can't explain why it didn't work except perhaps for the strip mall location.  This is one of the places I feel really bad about closing.  I wish the owners all the best.
One of my favorite spots in The Village. Happy hour on the patio is my favorite. Wait staff are always awesome. Definitely a frequent flyer. Shamelessly.

I have been wanting to try this place for a while now. Well finally today I tried it with my husband and I was so not impressed.  The rice was dry and chewy and the tuna seemed mushy and warm. The taste just wasn't right. Definitely have had way better poke bowls elsewhere.
Great vibe, good cocktails, & good friendly service. Diverse demographic w all ages. They have an outdoor seating area as well. Nice hangout overall.
Great place! Cindy is very knowledgeable about curly hair and her prices are awesome. I highly recommend this place. I got a wonderful haircut and will definitely be back!

Husband and I visited on Memorial Day, May 25, 2020 at about 2:00PM. We ordered the 12" supreme steak cheesesteak which included grilled onions, green peppers, mushrooms, and melted white American cheese. Also ordered a Bud Light draft and an IPA draft. There were maybe 10 other people in there and visitors kept arriving. 

They had every other table blocked off to comply with CDC guidelines. All employees were wearing face masks. I saw someone twice go and wipe down areas with cleaner while we were eating. I feel like they are doing their best at keeping their dining area as clean and safe as possible. 

Our food was delivered quickly and the food was hot. My picture does not do it justice since the smell was so inviting, we didn't take the time to adjust. The filling was overflowing, they don't skimp on the meat or veggies or cheese. You have to see the size of it for yourself. The meat was super tender and veggies the right texture. The bread may look a bit wet but the sauce, but it wasn't noticeable after the first bite of deliciousness. It had its own texture to add to the sandwich. We shared the 12" and were both very content after eating and drinking our pints. 

We frequent the area often and are disappointed we didn't try this place sooner. We would 100% recommend this place and we're excited to go back and try something else!

Quick and sloppy. Won't be back. I went in to get a powder dip and the guy who did it seemed to care less what it looked like. These places charge way too much and I'm so tired of feeling ripped off and disappointed when I leave.

Do not go to Dr Zaho. So disappointed after a 2 1/2 month wait to see her and hear the same meds that caused obsessive compulsive disorder I might want try again! Are you kidding! She is so non caring. So cold. Save your copay. Would give her a minus 10. Money wasted.

Wagner's will be opened until Nov. 1-2, 2014 weekend. Then it's curtains until next season. We've enjoyed all the fresh produce and eggs. Ate more than we ever have in the past and at good prices too. Thanks. Enjoy your winter rest.

We went here a couple weeks ago, during all this covid stuff, we went thru the drive thru. I ordered the supreme steak & my husband ordered the pepper steak. The guy was super friendly and everything came out piping hot. We absolutely loved this. The sandwiches were so hot & steamy that we could barely eat them. I'm only giving 4 stars because it was a little bland, maybe they forgot the seasoning? Maybe there isn't any seasoning? Anyhow, some season all salt would make a huge difference on the meat.

A great place to learn more about your weapon, only suggestion would be to check at the front counter if the pistol range is being used by large 
bore weapons...standard ear protection will not work well...drove me out.
Took the AR 15 build ...great class and weapon.

Mark Enger was fantastic! He has been to our house a few times and each time has been extremely friendly and thorough. He not only fixed what he came for, but also fixed anything else he saw as he walked through the house. Mark also gave us tips about our home and the city. Could not recommend him enough!

In the emergency room with mom/grandma.   We've been here about 2-3 hours.  The first two nurses that assisted us were very patient & accommodating.  It must have been shift change because now we have the nurse from hell (Lindsey)  I walked out the door of our room to ask for assistance, she was texting on her phone so I tried to wait until she was done.  She finally noticed me & ordered me back in the room & she would be w me shortly.   In the meantime I overheard her yell at another individual for standing in the hallway.  She told him he needed to go to the main lobby & wasn't allowed to stand in the hallway outside of the rooms..  Prior to his interaction w her he was told to wait in the hallway by another medical staff personnel while his wife changed into a gown & was situated, Then he could return into the room.  Some people should not be allowed to work in positions like this if they can't be professional & tactful when speaking to people.  St lukes needs to do a personality check on their employees prior to employment.  If they already do, I think they might have had a miss sight on this one.

I was going to Lotus and their two other Ocean Massage stores. But now they have a sign in the lobby. While on your stomach, no massaging the butt. And while on your back, no massaging from the shoulders to your thighs. I don't understand-other massage spas are still massaging there. So needless to say, I won't be coming to the Ocean/Lotus massage spas anymore.

I made a reservation for my roommates birthday at 8pm. We arrived on time and we're not seated until 8:40 with no apologies to follow for the long wait. Our server Amber was incredibly rude and lacked so many qualities of what a good server In tails. I'm not sure if she was in training or simply unable to provide proper qualities of good service. Our food and drinks took forever to come out with again no apologies for the wait. One of our orders was incorrect and Amber was not sympathetic about the mistake she made. The service was unbearable and honestly upsetting. We choose Kona because the birthday girl wanted a fun night out with good food, although the food was quite tasty once it finally came out. The service was not worth coming back ever again.

Mister Car Wash is a place I do not think we will utilize again.   We understand things are different during COVID-19, though what is happening to us is not okay, no matter what hardship is occurring.  We have two membership accounts with Mister Car Wash, one for each car.  When our local location closed due to COVID-19, we called to end our memberships.  We were told we would not be charged for our memberships while the local location was closed.  When charges did show on our credit card, we called and were told they would be removed and we would receive an additional free month.  When the charges weren't removed, we, again, requested to cancel the memberships.  We were told everything would be fixed and that we would receive another month's credit for the mistake and because our local location was still not completely open, and they could see we weren't using our memberships.  We have now, for a third time, asked to cancel our memberships, and been told we will receive refunds.  To date, neither has happened.  We have been forced to go to the lengths of calling our credit card company and blocking Mister Car Wash, along with disputing the erroneous charges.  Mister Car Wash is no longer responding to phone calls, either to their customer service line or the local location, and even email requests are not being answered.  Now that Mister Car Wash is no longer responding, and hasn't honored our requests, nor their promises, we have been forced to turn the matter over to the Better Business Bureau.  We understand delays happen and the need to be patient.  There is nothing that excuses what is happening to us.

I love love love Key Lime Pie. So when we got the flyer from Shari's advertising Key Lime Pie, I told my husband that he could get me that for my Birthday instead of cake. So we filled out the online order. He got fish and chips and a slice of Banana Cream pie. Easy. I asked for grilled salmon, a baked potato and my Key Lime Pie. 
He got Fish and chips with Banana Cream pie. I got Blackened salmon, mashed potatoes and ANOTHER SLICE OF BANANA CREAM PIE!!  Happy Birthday to me!!
We have attempted to contact Shari's three times since then and have received no response. 
Not going to be going back.

I am not sure why my experience is so different from so many other reviewers.  We were welcomed warmly by the owners, and  they were very helpful in making suggestions, but that's was the best  part of our experience.  We ordered 2 different sandwiches so we could try them.  The waffle bread was interesting but dry and not nearly  as good as I expected. A small amount  of meat with no sauce of any kind,  and a small salad on the side. We were told later the salad was supposed to go on the bread. So meat and dry bread, not a fan.  The fries were good, and the cup  of ice cream they gave us after was a pleasant surprise.  All told though, I can't recommend it.

Got to try the pressed sandwiches! Yum yum! Figured out that they are made with puff pastry which is pressed in a waffle iron. We tried the turkey, swiss, bacon (generous amounts of bacon- huzzah) with the garlic parmesan fries. It was so good and fresh. "Hungry" my oldest, exclaimed "These fries are all sprinkley and I LIKE IT!" ;)

The owner was working by himself (on a Wednesday for lunch) and they were slammed. So it took about 15 minutes to get our order to go. But hurray that they're busy! Does my heart good. 

A great to go option during COVID19.
i am very pleased with abc pumping service of meridian idaho. their employee adam does an exceptional job. i would hire them again based on our experience with adam.

Brian was very professional and prompt to reach out and answer any questions every step of the way. We changed our minds between new construction loans and a refinance multiple times and he was very courteous and accommodating to our needs. Never was there any question that he was not doing the absolute best he could, and in a timely manner. We closed today without any hiccups. 

Thanks Brian!

We decided to update our kitchen after being in our home for 25 years! We decided to use Big Wood Cabinets and we couldn't be more pleased with our decision!  They helped with the whole process step by step! We even decided to do granite countertops and they helped with that process as well! They were friendly and eager to help and answered any and all questions we had! There sub contractors are great as well! Very professional!! We plan on using Big Wood Cabinets in the future!! We highly recommended them!!

Great breakfast, friendly service, large portions, and well prepared.  Came here after church last Sunday for breakfast. There was the obligatory early Sunday morning wait, but was only 15 minutes. Our server was very nice, friendly, and prompt.  She kept our glasses topped off, asked us how our meal was, and never had us waiting.  I had eggs Benedict, my friend had a very large 2 egg omelet.  Both were tasty, along with crispy hash browns.  They are located where the homestead bar used to be located,  highly recommended.

So disappointed in our service today. I had two children with me and my 80 year old grandmother. Our food took over 45 minutes to receive between 2-3pm on a Tuesday, not very busy at all! I had ordered a kids meal for my girls to share (they are $7!) unfortunately they brought out two kids meals instead of one like we asked and charged us for both. My grandmother hates spice and we asked to have her sauce (that was spicy) on the side, which didn't happen, we asked them to fix it, they never did. Lots of other annoying things happened but afterwards I called the manager because I didn't want to do it in front of my grandma and he was super defensive and rude. So disappointed.

I had never heard of Jimmy John's prior to moving to Idaho. Their commercials definitely piqued my interest because the food looked great.  However, I was a bit cautious because the main chain sub sandwich store in Cali has commercials with awesome looking subs as well. 
So, after a day of shopping with my mother in law, we decided to go try Jimmy Johns.  I called home & asked for my hubby & the kids to view the online menu and give me their orders. When I arrived, I noticed that they had a drive thru (impressive), but I was a bit gun shy & opted to go inside for my order because I didn't trust in Jimmy Johns yet. 
As I walked into the store, I was immediately hit with delicious smells & I knew that I had made the right decision about where to eat.  We were happily greeted by the guy working the register & he asked if we were ready to order.  He told me to take my time & if I had any questions whatsoever to let him know. After a bit of time, my mother in law & I determined what we were having. We walked up to the register & I had an odd request.  I asked the guy if it was possible for me to taste their homemade Italian dressing. I am super picky & I wanted to make sure I liked it.   He thought about it for a sec & said that he wasn't sure how he could accommodate that request.  I told him that he could literally put some on a shred of lettuce & that would make me happy.  He obliged.  The dressing was easily one of the best Italian dressings that I have ever had. We placed the following order:
2- #9 (the bigger version of the Vito)
2-Club Lulu with extra bacon
1-#11


The total for the 5 sandwiches were under $36. The guys got our sandwiches done in a very reasonable amount of time. As I sat there waiting, I was chatting with one of the employees about their products.  He told me that they make their own pickles & they are to die for. I decided to go ahead and pick up some pickles. When I ordered them they asked me how I would like them sliced (whole, half, of quartered). I was so taken aback. I'm not used to fast food restaurants asking me how I would like something....well, other than if I want fries & what size soda I want. Lol.  I was a bit worried about how the sandwiches would hold up on the drive home because a few of them had the Italian dressing on it, but when I got home and tasted the food there was no sogginess at all. The bread was still soft inside with a slight firmness on the outside just like an Italian roll is supposed to be. 

I  am beyond impressed and the kids are already asking me when we are going back. I highly recommend Jimmy Johns. It's so hard to find a fast food franchise that blows you away....Jimmy Johns is the place.

Great sandwiches and delicious soup! Warm delicious bread! The gals that run the place are so sweet. Gets busy at lunch time, if you go a little early or later ( before noon or after 1) it's all good.

The #1 WORST DINING EXPERIENCE OF MY LIFE. No exaggerating.
I was craving Pho- A Vietnamese soup that My fiance and i love.. We were going to try a new restaurant and decided on Vina since it was located in our neighborhood. I actually read a review from Shagen and thought we'll give it a try. I like trying new restaurants and love food..

We walk in and there was no one there except the lady at the register who ignored us. We found a table in the middle of the restaurant and sat down and waited 5-10 minutes to even be acknowledged. (ONLY PEOPLE IN THE PLACE).  We asked for a booster seat for our 2 year old, and she completely ignored us. After she left and we waited awhile my fiance got up and went to get one because we were ignored.. She asked us what we would like to drink and we ordered 3 waters. I could tell that the lady was visibly upset at this point because she was very short and refused to engage in any type of conversation etc.. She brought back our waters and began moving the bottles from the center of the table and slamming them over out of the way, and slamming down our water glasses at one point some actually spilled out of my glass onto the table. At this point my fiance was wanting to leave but I thought we would give them the benefit of the doubt and still try out their food as I read that the service wasnt great but the food was. 

I went to order my soup,  and requested extra Lime. Said on the menu it comes with Lime. She said We dont have lime. I said ok well it says on the menu that it comes with Lime. She said Lemon only. Now I dont know if you eat Pho but You kind of add stuff and flavor it how you like it and without lime is like mashed potatos without gravy.. So we both changed our minds. She stood over our table not saying a word. I changed my order to Generals chicken (one of my chinese favorites) my fiance was taking a minute to order. The lady then went and sat down in frustration at the table next to us and just glared at us.. because she was I guess tired of waiting thirty seconds for my fiance to order or offering to come back..  We ordered Crab Rangoons as an appetizer, and we asked what the special was for our 2 year old which was Orange Chicken. We asked if it was spicy and she said no.

She then went back to the kitchen, and returned with our appetizer.. NO PLATES. I guess we were suppose to eat off the table.. The rangoons you could tell were FROZEN with cold spots and a HARD chewy texture. 

At this point we had decided we had enough of this dining experience from HELL. My fiance got up and knocked on the wooden door to tell them to cancel our order. It was at that point she said she saw that our food was ready so she came back and sat back down and we thought we would give it a try AGAIN. We are pretty patient people and I will usually eat anything.. She brought out the food and it was HORRIBLE.. Hard as a rock, OLD. I had enough. I told the waitress that we were not eating it and therefore not paying for it. She then went into a Profanity laced tirade about us to another couple who came in and she was rude to as well - and said she was calling the police. I said Fine call them.I will wait here for them. I called them myselfand gave the dispatcher my name and number. The woman was out of control.

We then left and went down the street to Mcdonalds where at least we knew what we were gonna get. The police called me back, they said that she clearly lied to them because she told them that we had eaten all of our food and left without paying. The officer said he refused to take a report when he found out that she was telling a lie because our food had Clearly not been touched..

STAY AWAY FROM THIS DIVE!

I'm so disappointed. I found this place last year when they had a different owner and jenni was so good and did an amazing job on my nails but out of convenience I was going to another local salon and after being let down I wanted to go back
To gloss I was so excited about my appointment and when I got there I found out none of the same staff was there anymore :( I gave it a try anyways and it was a huge mistake! The girl took about 2 hours for a full set and she "free formed" the nails which did not look good at all very sloppy work that took forever even after shaping them the tops weren't all the way to my cuticles and within two days one lifted off. Went to another salon to have it fixed bc when I called gloss they could not get me I  for 3 more days! The other salon told me within a day or so the others will follow bc of how poorly they did. Sure enough I got home and another one popped right off from just lightly tugging a throw blanket. Now I have had two broken nails in 2 days and I have NO time before I leave for vacation to have them fixed.  I won't be going back.

They are always consistent with their food and good service! The sweet stuff is as good as the savory, California Bennie is one of my favorites. And the Blueberry Stuffed French Toast is always a fan fav!

I would like to commend CBH on their quick response to our warranty claims.  Not only did they get our problem fixed quickly, but the repair person (Mark) that they sent out was phenomenal!  Not only did he fix our problem, but he also went through the house and showed us ways to improve our energy efficiency (which is already amazing) but he identified an area in our garage that could allow fumes to enter the home and showed us what to do to resolve the issue.  We have only had minor issues with our home since we moved in, which is to be expected on any new build, and CBH has been quick to resolve them for us above and beyond our expectations! We definitely love our home.

Went into club house last evening for dinner.  We live in the subdivision and visit once or twice a month for food.   Food is not bad and priced right.  We aren't looking for 5 star service but last night was unacceptable.  Walked in there was 3 tables seated and 2 of them had their food.  We sat down at a table.  Server looked at us twice walked by our table with out saying anything.  5 minutes later 2 more tables walked in and sat down.  She grabbed menus and silverware and greeted the two late comers.  We got up and left.  When we left we explained why we left.  Once again why is there a lack of service in restaurants?
Best sandwich I've ever eaten!!!!! Been going to San Fran for years! Great owners and fantastic food!

We were out-of-towners looking for a workout while on the road and found this place using Yelp. It is a GREAT lifters gym with lots of specialty equipment, TONS (haha) of free weights, and three squat racks. The desk help was super friendly and accommodating, they even found a couple of bath towels for us to use so we could shower afterwards. It's a no-frills gym, so don't come here looking for a luxe locker room experience (which, admittedly, I was kind hoping for), but there is plenty of equipment for a great workout and everyone was friendly.

It's a 5-star place for local lifters for sure. If Yelp were granting wishes I would have wished for a slightly nice locker room and towel service, but I recognize that they aren't catering to visitors, instead they focus service on their regular clientele. If I lived in the area, I'd be back.

We are so thankful that we had the opportunity to meet and work with Brycen at Willamette Valley Bank. He is an absolute amazing person and Loan Officer. I can truly say that he was a godsend when it came to purchasing our first home. My wife and I were introduced to Brycen by our amazing Real Estate Agent and I can honestly say that I have never met a more trustworthy and hardworking pair. Brycen was extremely attentive, responsive, informative and helpful even when it came to home buying process. As a first-time home buyer, we were not aware of many things and Brycen was extremely patient with us. Brycen always went above and beyond his duties and we will never be able to thank him enough! I cannot stress enough how much we appreciate him. You'll be hard pressed to find anyone greater! -Kevin & Marie.
Some flight on flight action! Great service & waitress! Food was very good and so were the drinks very full very busy but overall great experience.

Avoid buying anything from this company's website. The level of deception you will find there borders on fraud, and "customer service" is nowhere to be found.
Case in point: Item is listed as "available," while other items are "out of stock." Order and pay for "available" item, show up at the store the next day to pick up, only to be told, "Blah blah it's been ordered but will ship within 48 hours." And then the phrase "Did we call you yet?"
Get used to hearing that phrase, as it will become very familiar over the next couple of WEEKS as you visit and call repeatedly regarding your order. You will never receive a tracking number or even any evidence that your order will EVER be fulfilled, other than the previously mentioned rudemouth comment from a female employee you will repeatedly hear. Ask the female for a manager and they are all "Unavailable" according to her.
There are no disclosures on their online portal that would reveal that they do not actually HAVE the merchandise you just bought, or that it will be weeks or more until you might receive it, or that you will be treated poorly if you express concern about your $800 purchases. In fact, after disputing the charges with my CC issuer, I noticed this company lists the transactions as a "phone order," as if to imply that you spoke with a human at some point. Another falsehood and deception from this company.
You know how it's a sign of a bad tattoo when it has to have a label next to it telling you what it is?
Well, if you read the management replies to reviews here, you will notice a recurring theme: "We really care about our customers!" "Our employees are trained to provide the best customer service!" I guess they figure if they keep SAYING it enough, they will never actually have to PROVIDE it?
Anyhow, you have been warned, do not give this company any of your money unless they are putting the item you purchased in your hand at the same time. Otherwise get used to hearing a very sarcastic "Did we call you yet?" whenever you are trying to find your items you purchased weeks ago.

Wayyyyy overpriced! Just ONE example- K9 vaccine is $50 for the first and another for the booster (which you need both of). Other vets are $20 per vaccine. 
Everything I've had done there is 2-3x more expensive. 
The front office staff is super unprofessional. 
On the plus side- the Vets and vet techs have always been good. Needless to say We will not be going back to Treasure Valley Vet Hospital.

We've had a membership for almost a year now, and while we've got our money's worth, we won't be renewing. 

Like others have said, this is a nice enough play place, but it isn't a museum. Labeling it as so is really a let down for visitors. 

The play areas are fun and my kids (now 2.75 and almost 4) always enjoy their time here! Two hours is a good amount of time to spend, usually they're ready for a snack by then, so we have to go. 

I'm disappointed that there's nowhere to have a snack or a drink in the facility. I get not allowing it everywhere, but they should have an area it's allowed (like all the other play places around the valley).

I hope they update and add some stem activities!

The best breakfast in town. We always share a full joe Benedict and a pancake when we go. Plenty for two people and so delicious! I like how efficient the service is. Seems like they take Care of the customers as a whole team instead of just their own tables. Make reservations online if you go on the weekends, they are so packed!

That person who wrote a bad review doesn't know what they're taking about! I went to get a cinnamon roll during COVID-19 through the drive-through and the service was super fast. I got a four pack a cinnamon rolls and they're delicious. The frosting is the perfect level of sweetness and roll is a BIG size and the staff are wonderful! 10 out 10 would recommend and I will definitely be going back.

4th review of Great Clips Meridian, Idaho. This is my 387th review on Yelp. 

I've been going to Great Clips for many years. Primarily because I can check in on an app and it holds my place. I can check in an hour before and still hold my spot. This is helpful, especially when they have an hour or more wait. 

My friend, Jon M., reminded me that GC keeps your haircuts on file, and will ask you if you're still doing a 2 on the sides and a fauxhawk on top, for example, so that you don't have to tell them what you want all over again each time-- pretty cool! It's regestered to your phone number. 

The haircuts are of good quality. The people generally talk to you and build a rapport. This particular location is close to my hour and has staff that has been there for a bit, which is nice to see a friendly and familiar face. 

The haircut is affordable. It's generally about $13, but you oftentimes get postcard or coupons in the mail for $6.99 haircuts or coupons on your receipt.  As a note** be careful on the postcards you get. They oftentimes, in the small print, list specific locations. Some other locations will honor other locations, some won't.

Ordered Turkey burger.  It was fabulous but got very,  very,  very, did I say very small portion of French fries.  For the money.. Pathetic.  Took a picture and told the manager.  He brought more,  twice what I got with first order.  Thanks Kona,  but give people what they pay for first at  $12 for a turkey burger.  Have to say, portion was smaller than I have seen in many restaurants around.  Would not be enough for a man and at $12 should be alot of fries.  Disappointed in our favorite go to.  Manager and waiter said it was a good portion.  Sorry,  I disagree

This is the worse place ever to take your pet. $700 dollars later and they said nothing is wrong with my cat, the next day it is peeing blood. They are using people's love of their animals to make money.  DO NOT TAKE YOUR ANIMAL HERE!!!
The food is good. The price is very reasonable. Very loud, hard to socialize. The hostesses could be friendlier.

Cheaply Built Homes. That's what CBH should stand for. I wish I would have read thru all of the reviews on this company before we bought our "spec" home. They pissed me off before we even moved in by charging us the VA fee from our loan by adding it to our purchase price. Thank God for our title company that paid the overage instead of us because for my husband and I both being veterans this was a slap in the face for us. This company does not support veterans, so dont use a VA loan when buying. Then on our final walk thru with the project manager of our house, I wish I could remember his name because he was a complete asshole, saying home inspectors, who we hired to do the inspection on our new house, need a real job because he had pages and pages of issues. I was pointing out things everywhere and not until we were halfway thru did this guy decide to start writing things down as he was trying to get it done as fast as he could pushing us from one room to the next. To many problems to list. The main issue that we had was that my daughters room above the garage was getting 20 to 30 degrees hotter in the summer and 15 to 20 degrees colder in the winter. We had an insulation company come in and they told us that the 3rd car garage wasnt insulated at all and that a piece of plastic was put up to block it off from the rest of the house. We didn't even have to tell them who our builder was they knew it was CBH because they have told contractors that by putting up this plastic is completely illegal. It sweats during the summer, gets wet, and then drips onto the insulation below causing mold. So we spent our money to get our entire garage as well as the 3rd car garage spray insulated and now my daughters room isnt any hotter or colder then the rest of the house. We will never buy a CBH home ever again.

This review is only for the location and the cinnamon rolls as those are the only things I've currently experienced!

I came here because they have a drive-through and that really speaks to my soul. But unfortunately, the day that I came, (on 3/6/20) it was out of commission. Alas, I had to get my butt out of the car to get my sweet treat. :) I asked the lady (pretty sure it was an owner) behind the counter and she sighed and said they were working on it. Hopefully I didn't rub salt into a wound! 

The cinnamon rolls are very good. Moist, generously portioned and absolutely dripping in icing. If I'm being honest...it was too much icing for me, but I think I'm in the minority here. I loved that it wasn't too sweet though and clearly made with real cream cheese. I bought 4 and it cost me just over $10. Not too bad! 

The inside is super cute. Small tables, a nice comfy couch and lots of cuteness on the walls. There is even a little section of cute home decor for sale! Will definitely be back to try the savory options and other baked goods.
Great food and service. The smoked prime rib and the beer selection are great. Friendly staff with a smile and great owners
Cheryl delivers to us almost once a week!  We love her, she's friendly and the food is always hot and delicious :)

I love a cheesesteak sandwich and couldn't wait to try this one! 
Maybe my expectations were a little high but I was disappointed.
Although my classic sandwich had plenty of meat, it was bland... not enough cheese and the bread which people rave about was very soft.. almost as it was under cooked. 
That doesn't mean I won't try it again because sometimes I want something a little bland, soft to chew and will fill me up.

What a great place to shop!  Staff is friendly and helpful and this store serves all body types!  I bought my first outfit and although it is pricey, the quality shines thru.... I absolutely love the mannequins of all sizes...so inspiring!  I will be back!!!!

LET'S SAY IT TOGETHER: PRICE GOUGING‼
We Had a mini split two zone system installed in our home by a certified electrician. We called YMC to come and do a start-up for us. The very nicest of service people showed up to look over the system and complimented the wonderful job that had been done installing it. He then proceeded to explain to us that since we were new customers we could either sign up for the annual warranty service,at  almost $175  dollars per year spring and fall, and that would reduce today's call down to $650. If we chose not to be part of their annual warranty program the service call and start up would cost over $750‼‼  Again, a very nice technician, to whom we sent on his way with a thank you, and our eyes bulging out of our heads and our jaws dropped to the floor!
Prior to our calling YMC we called another Company for exactly the same service but had to wait because they were booked up until the middle of June. The dispatcher asked if we would like to be placed on the list in case there was a cancellation and that would speed up our appointment time which we did. We received a call less than a week later and the very nicest technician showed up, checked out the system, adjusted everything and made sure everything was in ordering less than an hour, and charged us $119 for the complete start-up and set up service. He was professional friendly and efficient and need I say FAIRLY PRICED??? YMC , you ought to be ashamed of yourself for PRICE GOUGING the customers you service  in the Treasure Valley.  It will be a cold day in hell before I ever recommend your company to anyone. And if it was a cold day in hell you'd probably charge me over $750 to heat it up again!!

FOR FOOD DELIVERY DRIVERS!!
DO NOT pick up orders here. they take forever and will literally serve every other regular customer in the store and every new one that walks in before they even think about making your order. 30 minute wait minimum. HUGE waste of time.
Reasonable prices, lots of stock. As usual for out time, ammo in not cheap. The range is great! RSO is observant and non interfering.  Wish I lived here!

If you love excellent coffee and exceptional customer service, there's no point going to any other coffee shop. I highly recommend their blended rebels and Iced teas. I love Dutch bros and have for years, but this location takes their quality, speed, and service to a whole other level. Their employees are perfection. They have never messed up an order of mine and I come through at least 5-10 times a week. They try to create a genuine connection with each one of their customers whether a first timer or a long timer. If you need a pick me up and a good laugh I wouldn't think twice about where to go.
 Dutch love all the way.

This brewery hits all the sweet spots! Beautiful decor with plenty of seating. Air conditioning to get a break from the heat. Games to play. Clean bathrooms. And, of course craft beers. Fun vibe inside this spot as sublime played summertime and the livings easy. It's an easy choice, come here, drink the beer, be happy!! The apparel and logo is super cute. and I love the names of the beers. Also, they're delicious! The offer a few guest taps and of course their own craft beers, made on site. Behind the bar the beer stillery is in view. Forgot to take a picture of, but seriously, come here!! If you're in Idaho and if you live here. I'd be here all the time. Cheers!! Happy yelping.

Cannot say enough good things about Athleta! 
I was hiking in my Athleta leggings the other day and was startled by a snake on the trail. In my rush to escape, I fell, injuring my legs. However, despite scrapes and the injuries on my leg, the leggings stayed in perfect condition and didn't tear at all. These leggings literally saved my life.

It was an awesome experience! Nate was such a help and calmed my nerves as it was my first time learning to shoot. The staff was friendly and helpful. The facilities were clean and available to us. They had all of the things we needed and were happy to help us with everything we needed.

By far the worst customer service ( if you can even call it that) from management. I was made to feel like their error on my order was my fault and the manager did not even attempt to resolve the problem. Absolutely blown away by her inappropriate, unprofessional behavior and will never support this business again.

We really enjoy having Cheryl deliver our Smoky Mountain dinners... She is always so friendly; the kids love her and so does our dog who always gets a treat from her. She is always so friendly and very prompt with her deliveries.

This DQ is always clean and well-staffed.  There appear to be a lot of people working, but maybe that's what it takes to keep the dining room clean and the orders coming out timely and efficient.  So, good for them - and good for them for keeping kids employed.

I love that DQ always has special flavors to dip their cones in.  I wish they were more than just for a limited time because this cotton candy dip that they have right now is SO. DAMN. GOOD.  I may or may not have gone there 4 days in a row for it!  And I always ask for it to be double dipped for an even thicker and more delicious shell.  These kids are always happy to oblige.

Also, the receipts always have a survey on them.  Do that and you get a coupon to come back for a FREE Dilly Bar!

Awesome little hole in the wall, if that's what you can call it. It was hidden in a shopping center, but it was nice and clean inside. I knew it would be authentic since most people inside the restaurant were Bosnian I'm assuming. 

If you are looking for something unique, fresh, delicious, with great service, look no further. I ordered the sausage sandwich. They had a large portion size and small portion size option, so I ordered the small portion size. Ordered some fries on the side, and was brought out an entire basket of fries!
Medina, our adorable and helpful server, asked what sauce I wanted, and since I'm from Utah, I naturally asked for fry sauce and she was kind enough to mix me up some! The fries were perfectly cooked. No complaints whatsoever.

My sausage sandwich had a white and red sauce and they did not skimp on the sausages inside either. I will note that if you don't love uncooked onions, this may not be the dish for you. 
This was unlike anything I've ever really eaten before, so nothing to compare it to but was very delicious.
My eating partner ordered the lamb gyro which should she said was also very delicious. 

If you have little children, they have a kids menu option with a burger option, Nutella sandwic onh, and something else I can't remember what. But it is a place that will accommodate whatever kind of eaters you have in your party. 

We paid $10 for each of our meals, which included fries and my drink, so that is very reasonable. I would say they could charge more and I would have not complained for how much food we received. 

If I ever find myself back in this area, I will definitely stop by again!

Finally went to try their sandwiches. Not going lie took some time trying to locate the shop because it's nestled in a business area. If you go it's across from T Mobile in Meridian. 
Place was decorated nicely and roomy. Fast service and staff really nice. 
The bread is my favorite...crispy on outside but soft inside. I wish they just sell their bread...it's so so good. 
You get tons of thinly sliced meats plus extra goodies too. Sandwiches are great tasting, great quality and reasonable priced. Definitely worth trying out!

Okay....so quick disclaimer, I'm a project manager for a large commercial builder so this will be not only an honest review but highly qualified and just. 

That said, let's get to it because we have a bit to cover....

Reviewing their business on Yelp they only have either 1 star or 5 star reviews. Not to discredit any other reviews here because that's not my gig. but they are in truth neither. I do acknowledge however they are good at certain things and horrible at others. Here is the run down from our home purchase experience:

We bought a spec home (one already built) so I cannot speak to the design process, but I have heard thru the grape vine they will no longer be building homes from their design center and all homes will be spec homes in the near future due to the market. The home itself is actually pretty nice for the dollar spent. We scored a large lot but that is not typical. There are a few different aspects of the process where their rating should be broken out...see below:

Home quality -
The overall build quality of the home is average to above average, so 3 stars here. I have heard directly from framers in the valley that Corey Barton homes are sticklers when it comes to the framing/structure and I can vouch for that living in the home.  The interior finish quality is average however,  many little details only I would notice but I know cbh supes see them and dont bother taking care of them before turnover.

Buying experience: 
Here is where it hurt...1 star...I know.  Getting thru the actual contract was painful..absolutley ridiculous at times...with some  brief insane moments. I write these contracts for a living mind you so I know what they can and cant do....so I pushed back hard on some things. But without getting Into details they tried to sneak things into addendums, consistantly got addendums incorrect, and nearly delayed the closing of our home....oh and failed to have a washer and dryer and fridge in the home  before move in....for 4 days!!! And didn't disclose it!!! Fail.

Warranty: 
I am happy to report their warranty process is smooth and very easy. 4 stars. Everything that has come up has been Taken care of timely and professionally. Please note I know the difference between a warranty item and a punch item. 

All these things considered they are a 3 star builder. If you can endure the purchase process with them you will be in a nicely built home for a good price. I have no regrets thus far and we have been very happy with the house, but mind the ratings above....stock up on some qualudes and hang in there till closing and give them hell on the final walk thru and everything will be fine.

Happy hostess. Seated right away. Met with 4 glasses of water for the two of us. Better to have too much than too little

Waitress was funny and attentive.

The bacon was cooked to perfection and my custom omelette was so good, I am going back tomorrow.
A surprising variety of excellent dishes.  My only complaint is the sashimi often does not come with wasabi or soy sauce.
Every time I come here it gets better and better. Amazing food and even more amazing employees. Jeanette left the sweetest note on my bag. Seriously MADE MY DAY!!! You guys are the best!

I finally got to experience Big Daddy's BBQ, for my birthday dinner.  Now I used to live in Oklahoma, and I am very picky about my BBQ.  I've had a hard time finding a place that I really enjoy.  I really enjoyed my experience at Big Daddy's.  The wait staff was great, and very accommodating to the size of our group, and the food was really good.  I liked the menu choices a lot, and I look forward to going back and trying something else next time.  Keep up the good work Big Daddy's.

The pizzas are good and I figure that the sandwiches would be good as well.  Unfortunately, I wasted almost 11 dollars on the Philly cheese steak.  The sandwich is too small for the price and there was nothing special about it.  You can get a large sub at blimpie for less.

The range and restaurant are family friendly and a great place to relax. It is tucked into a quiet neighborhood. 

The food tasted great and was delivered quickly! They offer a variety of food deals and music on Friday evenings. 

The range is a lake with a nice fountain in the middle. The one downside is that you cannot use your driver most of the time. 

Overall, it is a great place to hang out, grab a few drinks, food, and hit some balls (or play the course).

The only reason I gave them one star is because it wont let me give them a negative rating. This is by far the most uncaring and unethical establishment I have ever had the displeasure to do business with!

My little chihuahua had gotten a dog treat lodged in her throat had had choked to the point that she was unresponsive. Although I was sure I had not reached her in time, I continued to do my best to provide CPR on her after dislodging the obstruction from her throat while my wife drove us to All Vally Animal Care Center where we have been taking our pet for some time.

I immediately entered the emergency entrance and handed her to a vetinarian assistant and told them to do what they could. Just as the girl was about to take her back to be treated, another employee shouted, "NO!" then turned to my wife and I and said "You need to fill out paperwork first!" I told them to take my dog back to get treated and I would fill out any paperwork they needed me to. The woman again said, "No. You need to fill it out now. If you don't I will get in trouble." It took approximately a minute to fill it out, THEN they took my dog back to be treated.

In the end she did pass away, and there was nothing they could do to revive her.

As I stated, I realized that I had gotten to my beloved pet too late and that she was most likely gone, but for All Valley Animal Care Center to tell me I had to fill out paperwork while my wife and children sat there looking at another employee hold our little dog is reprehensible and TOTALLY UNACCEPTABLE!!!

The following week I went in and spoke with the manager and explained what had happened the previous week. I was PROMISED that the incident would be investigated and that I would be contacted IMMEDIATELY with their findings.

Its been almost a month and I have not received so much as a phone call. I guess their way of handling an issue is to ignore it or the customer.

Its apparent that not only does All Valley Animal Care Center not care about a beloved pet over some paperwork, they apparently do not care enough to call me back and explain themselves.

I will, under NO CIRCUMSTANCES, ever use their services again.

Lived in Chi-town for a decade through my years of higher learning and the Chicago style Italian Beef sandwich was always a treat I've enjoyed. Portillo's, Buona Beef, the no name hole-in-the-wall beef joints are places I miss quite a bit... and... after I've had Bono's, I miss them even more. 

I REALLY, really, wanted to like this place. I was on their website every week before they launched, stoked about the prospect of satisfying my Italian beef cravings... but after a total of 4 visits since, I feel bad to say this but, I really wonder if these guys have a future here in the treasure valley.  From the look of it, it seems pretty clear that they thought they were going to storm into authentic import food scene and have several locations in a couple years. Not a chance. And by the look of things, with each successive visit, the place has look more and more dreadful... and empty.  

Psst, it's not because Italian beef is an acquired taste. It's not.  Location? Nah, though a first location in downtown Boise could have helped, with what they got wrong, it would have probably sunk them faster. 

Here's my list of their seven sins: 
1) Their bread sucks. White and pasty looking. Would have passed for something sold at winco... Maybe (no offense, winco) But for an Italian beef? Fuhgettaboutit. 

2) Fries please? You mean to tell me, I paid you nine bucks for a jumbo and you can't throw in a side of fries? Every joint I went to in Chicago did and they did it a dollar cheaper.  You're in Meridian, low-rent, Idaho, and you mean to tell me fries don't come with a 9 dollar sandwich?

3) You call that a jumbo? My daughter got a regular and my wife got a jumbo (due to previous experience), no joke, the thing was barely an inch longer. Portillos had the beef exploding out of their regular size beef sandwiches for less than what these guys are charging. 

4) Is it worth it? Unless they hid some caviar under the beef or slaughter only blemish free red heifers, that question is the single biggest dilemma, that despite my cravings, made me visit Bonos only 4 times since it opened. 30 bucks. 30 bucks for 3 pasty breaded, low beef, pathetically not-even-close-to-jumbo sandwiches with no sides.... & One drink. And the order was wrong EACH and EVERY time. Tell me why this is worth 10 bucks more than the more filling foot longs I can grab for my family down the block?
