They can't even convince a family that craves Italian beef, much less convince newcomers of it. 

5) Poorly trained, poorly screened staff. Busy playing around, not once did they get the order 100% right.  To their credit, the last time we went, our order came to us quicker... but maybe that was the case because it was dead.  Take a page from Chick-fil-A, a chain with far more traffic to deal with, and learn what they do.    

6) Let there be light! I get it, The mancave needed to be dark... Why are they so married to the mancave concept? It isn't even a Chicago exclusive thing. They have the whole front of the joint looking like they have a strip joint in the back. They spent so much money on the décor inside why make it look so dingy from the outside?

7) Listen to the feedback, skip the "come talk to Pamela and Ronnie." We've personally spoken to Pamela.  We told her the same thing I'm laying out here. Either Pam or Ronnie or both have some humble pie to eat rather than scratch their heads and wonder if Boise folks just don't get Italian beef.  Get this: You're competing for our money. If you want it, you'd better make it worth it.
My favorite sandwiches! They are always so fresh and delicious. Friendly staff and fast service, it's tucked behind some business but it's worth the search!

Where do I start... I'm so thrilled and grateful to have had Mark Enger and David Hoff over to help fix my flooring. Mark came over before the flooring team just to do a thorough inspection of the issue. He was very attentive to my concerns and showed me step by step why I was experiencing the issues. David was so detailed with every step to fix the floors correctly. In fact, he inspected my trim and dry wall in the kitchen to see how insulation was done. He found some places where air was coming through, and fixed it. David came so well prepared in contrast to other workers and the quality of what he uses far exceeded what I've seen being used thus far. He was neat and cleaned up after each project, very meticulous with whatever he did. He also went around a few places in my house to inspect and ended up adjusting, advising or fixing it. He was polite, witty and overall just a very nice guy. If you have an issue with your CBH home, MAKE SURE to ask for David Enger to come and look at/ give an honest opinion or do the job. TRUST ME, I've had quite a few (4+) CBH guys come through my home and talk to me about the job(s) that need to be done, etc. David will make sure the job is done right, it's aesthetically pleasing, cleaned up after and his spirit will definitely brighten your day. 
Secondly, I'd like to acknowledge David Hoff. David assisted Mark with paint touch up and caulking. David wasn't the usual guy who does a quick and careless job. He was very precise to ensure it looked neat, clean and properly filled. Previously, I didn't even have my kitchen baseboards filled and painted after install under my counter. But, David took the time to come ask me for my sample paint so he could patch and paint correctly. In addition to this, as David was leaving he notices my front door wasn't closing correctly, and it had give after its closed. Instead of not caring, and moving on, he informed me of what he noticed wasn't right. He and Mark went on to fix my front and garage door; they're perfectly working now! Such a breathe of fresh air when people come through who #1 know what their doing, #2 are super detail oriented and #3 treat your home and space as if it were theirs.  
THESE guys made me believe in CBH's quality and character.

Bruchis cheesesteak sub was so disappointing I had to tell people what to expect. What I think you should know are a couple of things...

1. The meat is not steak, but it is beef, chuck roast I think because it tastes like it and has that stringy texture. (I have been cooking for years).

2. There was no cheese on my sandwich at all.

I might try a different sandwich like an Italian sub because their bread is good if I go back but if cheesesteak is what you crave, don't go there.

Half the time you call for benefits and insurance coverage the phone just rings and rings, no answer. If you can get through to the call-blocker you sit on hold for over an hour. 

They have the gall to put in their recording "your call is important to us" which is absurd and dishonest. They couldn't care less.

Paid almost $700 for a month of nothing. The cards wouldn't work, trying to purchase simple cholesterol meds got rejected at the pharmacy repeatedly. Basically, they stole $700 from me. And despite numerous attempts at calling, only getting to an actual person one time, nothing changed. I would describe this company as incompetent, indifferent, perhaps even bordering on criminal.

Went there this morning  for breakfast  before the BSU game started. As always it was a pleasant experience.  It's not fancy or anything like that,  but what it is, is very dependable, good wholesome food at a reasonable price. The wait staff busts their butts to make sure you have everything you need for a great dinning experience and for that reason  Joe Mamma's will always be my go to for breakfast.

Horrible service.  Ordered drinks. Could not get a beer on draft... maybe offer a bottle.  After waiting 40 minutes for dinner I asked for a bottled beer .  Oh I guess we have a bottle. An hour to get a beer.  On to dinner.  Don't ask to change something on the menu ( i.e. No tomatoes) because they will forget everything else.  Flavorless, dry hamburgers and New York Steaks was not cooked properly, but we were not going to wait another hour. 
Keep in mind, you  will have to share your water glasses because it impossible to get someone to serve you.  All in all a complete disappointment.

I've had these guys tint three of my vehicles over the last three years. I went to them because they offered 3M Film that was computer cut. I happy enough with the first two jobs, I expected the film to be installed closer to the edge of the glass than it was, but it was good enough. The last tint job on my Subaru WRX was poor at best though, there was at least a 1/4" gap on all of the doors, and every single window (5 total) had significant bubbling/dust contamination. I meant to follow up with them on this but never got around to it before selling the car. I don't think I would go back again. It doesn't matter if the film is computer cut if it's not installed correctly and is full of bubbles and dust.

The server was great the actual owner sucks and has a real  crappy attitude when I informed her that my hashbrowns had to be sent back 3 times because they were under cooked and not crispy. The owner didn't even apologize for the error. She asked what she can do to fix it and I asked if she can just take the hashbrowns off and she refused.  I also told her that my partners poached eggs weren't well done as requested and that they also had to go back.  Then her excuse was she has 450 people in the restaurant.  She then went to the back of the restaurant and IMMEDIATELY started to talk to the wait staff about us complaint about hashbrowns. She was vocal enough that I could hear it.  I gave my payment to our server who was again great, and the owner came back with it and THREW it on the table to where it actually fell on the floor and kept waking. I really hope this is not the everyday attitude of the owner Kathleen.

If your looking for a good restaurant in Eagle/Boise it's Biscuits N Hogs.  I recommend going there!

Wonderful experience from start to finish. Front office staff was welcoming and kind. Facility as very clean. The person that completed my MRI was kind, knowledgeable, and explained everything that would take place. He checked in on me throughout he whole process through the headset they provided me with. I was able to listen to music that I chose through the headset, hardly heard the machine at all. I was in and out quickly. Highly recommend Intermountain Medical Imaging!

Food was really good. 
We had the Original Gyro and a Baklava. The Gyro bread was soft and fresh (which I think makes or breaks a Gyro). The T-Sauce was delicious and the meat was tender and tasty. One of my favorite options.
The Baklava was ok, but it was the Gyro that shined this time.
That being said, my favorite part of the visit was Victor. He was just about the best food service worker I have run into in quite a while. Personable, talkative, obviously enjoys his job with one of the biggest smiles I've seen in a long time. Kudos to this young man! However. I must say I was enjoying his conversation so much I completely forgot to tip this gentleman. So Victor, next time I order and if you are the window guy, you are getting an extra tip.
PS-I know food service workers are getting blasted a lot by impatient and rude people and I want to send kudos to all who work in this type of business. :)
Sandwiches are one of my favorite lunches, and this company has some of the best ones. Everything I've gotten here is delicious. They also have a very good potato salad.

We waited for this place to open and was really impressed the first couple times. 3 months ago we went back the food and service was horrible. Two weeks ago we gave it another chance, worst then the last time, how can owners let their business go so far downhill?

The village is our favorite spot in Meridian. It's a large outdoor shopping mall with restaurants, bars, a play structure for kids, a music synched water fountain with hourly shows, a nearby park and splash pad, movie theater, bowling alley and arcade (big Al's), and live music concerts each Friday in the summer. We love The Village at Meridian!

I normally go to this restaurant once a week but, this time was Awful. I ordered the chicken parm as always. I regularly get just white sauce with pesto on the side. The waitress (must be new as I've never seen her there) ask do you mean Alfredo. I replied yes. The disk came out with a watery sauce on the bottom of the plate, not creamy at all, the noodles were crunchy, the chicken was dry and looked as if they were out of a pre made box. The cheese is normally backed on real cheese, this was a deli slice of lunch slices, cut in half with each half on each piece of chicken. The cheese was translucent like it was microwaved. This completely disgusting. I told the waitress, petite blond girl don't remember her name. She made no attempt to help. I think the new hires they have are horrible. In conclusion, my family of six visit once a week and won't be back.

I am always impressed at what Children's Museum has to offer! They have rotating exhibits that expose my children to experiences they can't get anywhere else. The staff is kind, and the kids always leave excited and enriched. Would highly recommend.
Great pastries and coffee. We were able to get in and out in just a few minutes and loved the different pastries and cheesecakes we have had over the many visits.

This is the best place if you like gelato, chocolate, or anything sweet! It also has a great vibe, and I love the tables they have! There's also games at each table to entertain you and my kids love the chalkboard wall to draw on! We always look forward to coming by!!

If you're looking for the artificial Christmas trees described in their weekly advertiser, call first.  This store had not one tree. I walked the store aisle by aisle twice thinking that I was missing them somehow.  However there was a very large vacant area in the Christmas area that looked like it could have accommodated trees, yet simply empty floor space.  Perhaps they sold out yesterday, or perhaps they have yet to put up the display.  Either way, Michael's, put up a sign stating status.

I've had many positive experiences with Michael's out of state, but this left me not wanting to come back.

The salon is clean and tastefully decorated. I liked the music they played.  The bathroom was pretty and clean - I liked the cloth hand towels, a nice touch.  I am happy with the hair cut and color but her assistant did the dye job and left dye on my hairline which wasn't so great.  But, Sarah called and said she'd take care of me on the next appointment.  I really appreciated her professional response to a problem.
Eat there last night. My favorite thing was the butter cake. Amazing! Sushi was good, but I've had better.

I'm giving them a three when their food is a 4 because when we ordered takeout they did not give us any bbq sauce. When we drove 20 minutes home and opened up our boxes we realized there was no sauce. My husband asked before he left if they put sauce in the bag and they said yes. Spent 65.00 to eat bbq with Albertsons sauce we had in the pantry. Please check your order before you leave.

Due to the fact your name is indepence and are supposedly proud of our country, the fact that your flag has not been at half mass in lue of our countries recent loss is appalling. Strictly for that I will tell all my friends who regularly shoot there to never again. And unfortunately for you they frequent there quite often. You should be ashamed of having the flag up at all

They were super busy today so I'll take part of the blame here.  Remember to check you order before you leave.  

Definitely not the unwich I ordered, and no side pickle, but I did get extra pickles on the sandwich.  

I'll try them again though.

Went in today looking to get some different fish for my aquarium. After looking for awhile and picking the fish out, we were waiting around for a good chunk of time. We decided to go ask the employee working the fish department if she could help us whenever she had a moment. After asking us what we needed and hearing the different fishes she seemed annoyed and didn't care to hide it. Not only did she question us about our tank size, but she also put 3 different species of fish all in the same bag together. We could barely let the bag float to adapt to the water, because all the fish were starting to get aggressive with each other. Usually I have a good experience with most workers in the fish department, but today I can't say the same.

It's DQ...Blizzards...Chicken Strips with gravy...Orange Julius...those amazing ice cream cakes!  A total throwback to when I was in high school 30+ years ago.  Some things never go out of style.  A big plus to this set up is the convenience of having the Stinker station right there...and a drive through with easy in and out access.

All these good reviews are real. Wonderful and flavorful food. Don't know about consistency yet. Wonderful costumer service and my daughter loved the music there. Bosnian of course. For my Mediterranean ears it sounds like Greek / Turkish. 
Mouth watering spices. Will go again now that I tried them at last.
Tried this place for the first time today and the service was great, ice cream was yummy, (so many different flavors to choose from,) and I love the cute little swings they have as seats.

This is my favorite breakfast spot! I've never had anything on their food menu that I haven't enjoyed. By far my favorite and what I get pretty much every time I go are the short stacks. Their pancakes are the best in town! In the fall they have a pumpkin pancake with an apple cider syrup... those are a must try if they have them. My only complaint, I don't like their espresso beverages, I'm not sure why, but I don't like them. I usually get an iced vanilla latte, but I'm not sure why I'm not a fan. 

Pro Tip: this place gets crowded and very busy. Keep that in mind when going. If you want to avoid the wait and line,  avoid the peak times. Get up early and head in when they open. There is no wait. However, it is worth the wait!

Pretty much exactly what you'd expect from a roadside, drive through Gyros shop. 

Sticking with the classic gyro sandwich, there are several options starting with the Original, it includes gyro meat, Tzatziki sauce, tomato & onion. One step up is the Deluxe that adds feta cheese. Next up is Super that adds on bacon, hummus, lettuce, pepperoncini, Kalamata olives, and spicy sauce. At the top end is the Ultimate that chicken, grilled onion (in addition to raw onion), and serrano peppers. There are also non-traditional versions including the Spicy, Chicken, Philly, Veggie, and others. I recall enjoying a Philly, but when I'm in the mood for gyros, I'm in the mood for old school gyros. All of these are available ala carte, as either rice or salad based bowls, or as part of a combo that includes a medium fountain drink and your choice of Tzatziki & Pita, Hummus & Pita, Greek Salad, Rice, Fries, Chips or Veggies. There are also three breakfast Pitas currently available.

Of the other available sides, I've bought the Greek Fries in a single-serve,  the larger size is better simply as a function of there being more fry surface to apply the seasoning and feta onto.

About my only improvement suggestion would be to get a little bit of brown toastiness on the pits before assembly, but that's a personal preference that others may not enjoy.
Love the Pad Thai, angry edemame, and coconut mojitos!!! Very good food sometimes the service is great and other times very terrible but food is awesome!
I'm so happy to have found this place. Great food!  Huge portions. Friendly staff. Online checkin. Upbeat atmosphere.  This is my new breakfast spot.

We had reservations for 7:30 pm. We arrived at 7:25. We weren't seated until 8:25. It took 45 minutes to get our appetizers. Then it took another 45 minutes to get our food. When we got it, my prime rib was cold and flavorless. The Au Jus tasted like it had been made from a gravy packet from the store.  To top it off the server completely messed up our bill.  I do not recommend this place.

Had a wonderful experience here on Labor Day. I wish I got the girl's name who helped us, but she was a gem. It was about 11am on Labor Day and she was wearing a white and black polka dotted shirt from Urban Outfitters...sounds super creepy that I know that, but she told me and I want her to get recognition for being so helpful and kind! Anyway, I don't know what it was about Labor Day, but many places we went for food that day seemed to have angry/rude employees, I'm not sure if they were mad they had to work or what, but this girl was a breath of fresh air and so kind. She was super helpful and got all of our orders correct, she even helped me find a place I could get a breakfast burrito! I also loved my blended Irish cream drink. It was my favorite coffee I have had in the whole local area! Yum!  I felt I needed to review this place because this isn't the first time I've been here and every time I've come here, it has been nothing but kind and helpful service and yummy drinks!

Came in today with an appointment. Had to wait 15 mins. The nail tech didn't let my gel polish soak long enough so when she tried filing the rest off with the drill I had to tell her a couple of times it was burning the nail underneath. Then the water was cold to soak my nails in, making her have to dig, instead of pushing my cuticles back. She proceeded to cut one of my cuticles pretty good, didn't ask how I'd like my nails shaped and did a rather poor job with the gel polish on my thumbs.
Also at the beginning of the manicure I picked out a glitter polish to go over my base polish. It was too heavy of a polish, which I'm glad she checked on, but she said she'd find another that would work. That didn't happen. 
This was one of my go-to places. Under their new ownership I will have to think twice about going back or wait until I can get in with the one remaining employee who's been great in the past.
New remodel is nice, still lots of polish colors to choose from, now open on Sundays.

7/19/16-not even a week and my gel polish is peeling. Ridiculous. Save your money for somewhere else.
Went here for lunch. The food was great, the counter guy was super helpful. Had food for every taste bud. I had the brisket pho which was smoky and super flavorful.
Great BBQ is hard to find. This if truly great BBQ with a wide selection of meats. The sides are just as good and go well with the bbq meats. Definitely will be coming back for more.

Worst experience I've ever had. When I first chose them, they came of very helpful & responsive. Very unresponsive, slow, didn't follow signed  agreement, kept details of the tenant from me, such as having unauthorized dogs in there pissing all over my floors. When my property became vacant, they took 2 1/2 weeks to even get me a quote for cleaning or carpet replacement. They use there own maintenance company & tried to charge me INSANE AMOUNTS & unnecessary repairs such as carpet replacement, I got it cleaned and it was fine.. For example, $900 for move out clean, I had it cleaned myself for $350. I ended up finding all the companies for each service needed myself, and saved TONS of money. 
They showed no urgency in trying to get repairs done to my rental so I could get it back on the market and filled. Resulting in me losing thousands of dollars in rental income & multiple hours of work on my end finding vendors so I wasn't ripped off. Although they do only charge 8%, its not worth all the money you'll lose & headache they cause. Choose a different company and pay the extra 2% if necessary.

My boyfriend and I stumbled upon this cute little place when I typed in breweries on maps (we are new to town). We had soooo much fun! Games were a nice touch, & it was a nice, warm environment with friendly service. Very family friendly. We are excited to go back!
The blonde chick who's built like a man is extremely rude and the reason I will not be going back to this store.

Well, it is a nice piece of real estate; the patio is nice, the food was marginal borderline underwhelming especially the sushi.
The server was nice; she was attentive as she could be; she had way too many tables, so she was not able to probably give the service she wanted.
The men's restroom was a shambles, and it really hasn't been cleaned in a while with the sense of detail.  I would come back for a drink on the patio, but that's about it.

When the app asks if I'd recommend this business I wish they'd allow for an exclamation point after YES! Because that's the one I'd pick!  I went to The Curb yesterday and noticed the sign outside Lovejoys advertising many flavors one of which particularly caught my eye. Wookie Cookie.  I had to try it so here I am with a cup of Wookie Cookie and oh my goodness it is DELICIOUS!  The ice cream is obviously made of high quality ingredients which I very much appreciate.  I have to mention also that the shop has several swings to sit on while enjoying your ice cream.  Yep I said swings! How unique!

I'm a huge soup and sandwich fan, so I had to try this place based upon the great reviews I see. They did not disappoint! Chowder and bread was especially go, will come back again I'm sure (and bring some friends :-) ) 
Love it!

I love that I don't have to think about my post workout nutrition every day, because Good N Healthy has it handled with their complete meal-replacement smoothies.

They are definitely the best smoothie shop in Meridian (and Boise for that matter).

It starts from the moment you walk in. The staff gives the warmest of welcomes and makes you feel at home right away with a complimentary aloe shot (mango or cranberry to choose from) and a warm or cold green tea blend in one of 6 flavors.

Dozens of flavors of delicious smoothies to choose from, but don't let the menu overwhelm you... I highly recommend the peanut butter cookie, fruity pebbles (yes, it tastes exactly like the cereal) or pumpkin-blueberry to start.

The smoothies are low calorie, low sugar, and packed with protein and other essential nutrients.

Warning: you may feel like you're cheating but you're not.

My wife and I just bought a place in Meridian and one of the first things we want to do is replace the existing kitchen cabinets. I came across Big Woods and decided to go check them out for the project. Upon arriving at their shop we were greeted by their friendly staff who seemed to have a genuine interest in helping us figure out what would work best for us and our project. I felt like they genuinely cared and were not trying to just make another sale. They showed us around their shop where they make the cabinets and we discussed several different design options. Their estimator that came out to our house and did all the measurements was very knowledgeable and professional as well. To say the least, we were very impressed and will be using them for our project.  We can't wait to see the finished product.

Originally from San Francisco bay area, relatives in the city.  There is nothing to compare to the chew of great sourdough, this had a softer exterior but the cravings chew was there.  I tried the cold corned beef and was extremely happy.  Boise location.  Will try for a photo next time.

I'm sure the owner would hate to know that they are turning people away. The host is telling everyone "after your seated its a hour wait to get your food" when the place is empty because everyone keeps leaving. We got our food in 17 mins.

Who doesn't love burgers and bbq? We ordered a black n blue burger, pulled pork, and brisket tacos. All was mediocre. The burger was overly pink, the pulled pork and brisket were very VERY dry and the fries were overly greesy & salty. The bbq sauce was good but everything else was just blah. Received 2 stars because we ate it.
What a great place to eat!   Had the Vancouver for lunch and it was amazing!  All the drinks are fantastic.   Service was good as well.   I'll be coming back here often!

Sean was amazing called him do to some carpet cleaning for my daughter I live in California and
She's here in Idaho. He was easy to set something up did a great job. Would differently recommend him

It pains me to leave this review but people deserve to know what happened. I called TVVH before getting my dog spayed and simply asked "How much does it cost to spay my dog?" I mentioned my dog was in heat and we never been there before. They gave me a range of ~$340 - $380. Okay. This comprised of two visits. They charged my wife the first visit of $166, the doctor didn't mention this was an extra cost but my wife paid assuming this was part of the ~$340-$380 estimate and assumed TVVH was considerate of peoples' finances, like some businesses are. On the second visit they wanted to charge me an additional $352.62, which totals to $518.62 plus more in tax. Eric Rust, one of the owners, comes out angry with me, because I was angry with them, and I said I budgeted for the estimate they gave on the phone and I was willing to pay the estimate they gave me on the phone. He threatened me and said " then we'll send the rest to collections!" at least a couple times. They strong-armed me into paying the full amount. I responded and said I'll have to add a google review about this cause people have to know. He responded and said "then I'll get a lawyer!". Ha, funny! We end up settling for $451.48 plus tax, which is still over the estimate, after they gave me a $63.00 discount. Eric acted like he deserved a medal for this generosity. They said the $166 was an blood work exam fee was NOT part of the spay surgery fee. BUT then they said they CAN'T DO the spay WITHOUT the blood work! In the real world, this is considered part of the cost for spaying a dog. They couldn't even let me know of this cost before I came in if they knew I had to get blood work done! To my lesser judgment, I ended up calling him back later on the phone to apologize for the mix-up but to firmly remind him he shouldn't be doing this to customers, I put him on speaker-phone so my wife can let him know that her experience with the staff and doctor wasn't exactly ideal to go along with over-charging us. We were totally calm and factual and I think Eric frustrated himself into ending the conversation saying my wife was "insulting" and being completely rude to her. We wanted to help him improve his business by giving him some of our experiences and to make amends from the afternoon before, despite before threatened AND over-charged. I didn't even ask him for money back. So I was over-charged, threatened 
with collections, threatened with a lawyer, rude service and rude to my wife. I highly recommend a different Vet. I hope the owner responds and see whether or not he simply refutes ever saying those things that I quoted("") him or if he apologizes and admits wrong-doing. We'll see.

What a yummy place! The new owners (as of mid last year) are really nice. Yay better than the majority of other sandwich shops. I actually really liked my shake too! I love that they have specials on Wednesdays and the weekend. I will be coming back for sure!

After trying to decide where to eat, we settled on this place. It just opened and we wanted to try it out.
We ordered two cheesesteaks- one Supreme and one Pepper steak,  a kids turkey sub and a kids cheeseburger. 
The cheesesteaks are NOT what I would consider to be cheesesteaks. They also had very little cheese. The turkey sub could only have lettuce and pickles because they were completely out of tomatoes. (How can you run a sandwich shop without tomatoes?!)
The turkey was good, the bread was fresh. The cheeseburger was pretty dang good. The fries were probably my favorite part of the whole meal. The meat on the steak sandwiches was kinda funny tasting. 
It's a bunch of teenagers working there, but they're very polite. The kid taking our order kinda drove me nuts though. There are four of us and I walked up and ordered the kids turkey sub and he said "is that all?" No. There are four of us! We aren't all going to share one kid sized sub. He did this after every item I ordered. I can't stand when people do that. I felt a bit rushed and you could sense he was stressed out.
They weren't super busy, but it took about 15min to get our food. Looking around, other people were waiting for awhile too. 
I would probably go back, but my husband is a solid no.

if i could put a negative number i would!!!  dont take your car to this car wash they only use water to clean it and expect a tip the the car did not get clean and dry.  went thru again still same thing no soap and did not dry, must be COVID shortage on soap.  Gal was very unprofessional and could care less.  No towels to dry car off but charge premium money to go thru.  NOT WORTH IT AT ALL!!!   Don't waste your money.
Service was awesome! Made a reservation on OpenTable and were seated right when we showed up. Good food and even better service from Ian!

Happy hour menu is half what it used to be!!! Beer no longer on happy hour other than two cheap, horrible beers, glad WAS  NOT chilled!! $5 margarita was almost a shot glass, very small!! Very disappointed, we were regulars, not coming back

Heather did a fabulous job cutting my hair.  I'm in the process of growing out my locks and it was looking shabby. She suggested a cut that reduced the "shelf" looking layers I had. I've received many compliments regarding my new hairdo and violet highlights!
Excellent job.  Craig quoted me a reasonable price, and arrived when he said he would.  I was super happy with the end result.

Do yourself a favor and skip this place. Seriously one of the worst meals we've had in recent memory. I give it one star because my steak was good and another star for friendly service. But the Thai roll (they forgot our dipping sauce), boneless wings (mostly breading), sandwich (they forgot our side soup), and pizza were all really bad/inedible. Also this restaurant still believes there's a mask mandate in Ada County, when there's not.

Tonight we called and got reservations for 3 to eat at 8pm. It was my wife, my mother in law (who was in town visiting for my wife's birthday) and myself. We were seated at 8pm, shortly after seating we ordered drinks, appetizers, and our entree's. About 10 minutes after we we're seated the table next to us was seated, they also ordered, and about 5 minutes after they ordered they were served the exact appetizer we ordered. That was 15 minutes into our night, now I get it we ordered 2 appetizers no big deal, another 20 minutes go by, our server checks in with the table next to us fills their waters and still doesn't address us. Finally she stops by to let us know the starters should be ready soon, it took a total of 37 minutes to get our starters and of course they are nuke warm at best. I take a look around the rest I and realize the only difference is my wife and mother in law are the only minorities in the restaurant. In a sea of white families and patrons the table with minorities is getting bad service, slow food, and when finally served is getting nuke warm basically room temp food. I have never been so embarrassed and disrespected in my life at a restaurant. I will never take family or friends here again. #racistrestaurant
Slow service, horrible customer service and crap food. This place needs to be torn down and a Taco Bell should be built

Working with the warranty team has been easy. Not all homes are perfect, and unfortunately we had a leaking valve that caused damage to our floors in the kitchen. Very pleased with Steve and Richard. Super nice guys and prompt!

Love there breakfast and lunches.
Atmosphere is great and staff is excellent.
Ordered eggs over well brought them out over easy which I did not complain but waitress caught it on her ticket and comp the breakfast. I thought that was sweet. Will be going back as much as I can.

My friends and I went in for a birthday dinner on Saturday night. The Brie kisses were amazing, highly recommendedour server was personable and quick with getting the food out to all of us girls! I eat here frequently, and will definitely be returning soon.

I went a few months ago with my 2 kids and husband for hair cuts. I wanted a layered (Jenifer Anniston) for my daughter and basic cuts for husband and son. My daughter you could NOT even tell they did anything. My husband the cut was awful, we had to come home and fix it. Son was ok. TODAY we went beck (my mistake! Shortest wait time, now I know why) my sons hair is SOOOO uneven! Are these ladies really even trained & licensed?! How do you mess up a basic men's cut so often!!! Will NOT be going back!!

I had been using Rocket Car wash on Chinden in Meridian and the last time I had to go thru twice and car still was not clean so I decided to give Epic a try and wow what a difference I have used 2 different locations and both time beautiful shine . 
 The employees are super nice and friendly and my overall experience has been amazing 
Thanks Epic Shine.

We started having the gurgling sound of our toilets on a Friday evening. 
We called ABC Septic Saturday am. After speaking to Scott about what our concern was he immediately understood.  He said this is an issue that needs to be addressed right away.
Not only did Scott come within the hour but diagnosed the problem and went over and beyond what his job was.  A plumber should have been called but Scott having the work ethics that he has took the whole job upon himself and did not charge one extra cent!  With all that being said our review is as follows...
Scott is a Top Notch Professional that has high standards and does not lower the bar.  

ABC Pumping Services has to be grateful to have someone as attentive as Scott.  He left with a smile and we were so very happy! 

Thank you to Scott!!!

Jack and Toni Lindgren
Star, Idaho

No, this certainly isn't true authentic Chicago pizza. Having been to Chicago this fall and dining at Giordano's, Lou Malnati's, etc...I was a bit disappointed. The pizza looks authentic, but the taste just isn't there. Crust was missing the buttery goodness of a traditional deep dish. The sauce had an okay flavor, but there was TONS of it coating my cheese pizza. Our food took about 35 min to arrive at the table, but the odd thing to note on our visit was the young waitress we had. Most everything there is counter service...ordering, drinks and silverware. The waitress dropped by to ask if we needed anything and awkwardly stood at our table for a few minutes. Then, about 5 minutes later, she comes by to tell us that our pizza is still cooking. A few minutes later, she brings us the pizza pan riser and two plates. While she was very nice, it just seemed odd to us and our conversations kept getting interrupted by her dropping by every few minutes. 

Since my first visit was with a friend's Groupon, I will be back to spend mine another day.

Wow! Coming from Oregon I didn't realize what I was missing out on. Their pizzas are soooooo gooood. Not only that but they were so friendly here. I had to wait a bit longer for my pizza since they were closing soon and they offered me a drink while I waited and even threw in a free salad at the end. Will be craving their Smoky pizza forever

Been wanted to try this place since I saw it 6 months ago (just moved here). Even though it was in the midst of covid, I would see people waiting outside. Didn't know if that was a good thing or not, as many restaurants weren't doing dine-in.

I am a breakfast junkie. I love eating breakfast foods any time of day or night. Finally got in here last week for half a Crabcake Benedict with hash browns. Serving size was just right - even though I know I could of scarfed down a full order. Practicing good portion control is hard dang it. Like ordering something I would not make at home. Crabcake and salmon bennies are my usual go-tos. The hollandaise sauce was good, not great and it could of been a bit more generous. The egg was slightly overcooked - no spreadable yolks here folks. I was hungry and it filled me up, but I didn't get the, 'Wow, this is something I'm coming back for.' 

The inside was rustic looking and there were a fair amount of patrons. I felt a bit self-conscious when I walked in and asked for a table. The staff was mask-less and as I looked around no one was wearing one - just me. Was glad they put me in a corner booth in the room with the bar. I felt 'safer'. The tables were spaced apart well and thinking of germs floating in the air didn't even cross my mind. 

I thought there would be a more varied breakfast menu for a place this size. Noticed they also serve lunch, but probably won't go as the lunch menu was limited also. I really wanted to love this place, but oh well. The hunt is still on and shucks I'll just have to continue being a guinea pig.

This is a great place to have some authentic Hawaiian food. Everything is delicious! The Kahlua pig is very moist and the coconut rice is not too sweet, just tasty. Some items are gluten free. They have tropical fruity drinks. The decor is fun and they even have outdoor seating. We will definitely be back!
Michelle always has a smile on her face and makes our experience so great. We look forward to seeing her every time we go there.

Haley is amazing! Perfect for light to medium! I will definitely be back

And the front desk gurl Vivian is soooo sweet!
High end with high end prices for Boise at least but worth it. Great date spot and good food and drinks.

I've gone to Joe Mommas before when they were at the other location and always had a positive experience. I took my mom who's visiting from out of town to the new location this morning. We paid $14 for a mimosa flight and couldn't even finish any of them. The glasses smelled like chemicals or gasoline which made the drinks taste like that. We asked our waiter and bartender if they could remake which they did for us but then the 4 mimosas again smelled and tasted like chemicals. Between two of us we finished 2 of the 4. We gave our waiter the other two full ones saying we couldn't drink them because of the awful smell and taste but still had to pay $14 for 4 mimosas when we only finished two. They looked at us like we were making it up or were crazy and seemed like they could care less. I was more than happy to pay $8 for the two that we did drink, that's not an issue. I'm more than happy to pay for what we drank but the other two only had a sip taken from it. We were not looking for free drinks this morning. Safe to say I won't be going back.

Day after Christmas the store is crazy, totally understandable. They have 35 employees (shocking for where the world is at right now) most of them are standing around picking their butts and being annoying. Totally unhelpful. There's a "3rd cashier" who says she can't help me with a return that I need to get in the 3 mile long line after she literally just helped the person before me who walked in right before me do a return. I will NEVER shop at lululemon again after this experience. What a freakin joke.

There really isn't something that stood out besides the fact I think people definitely OVER HYPE this place. Their wait time is ridiculous. 

1st Visit- I was excited to try the food because many said it's "the best" breakfast joint (again, OVER HYPED for sure!) I waited exactly an hour and 30-45 minutes to get sat down at a table. Our waitress was all over the place. She forgot to take our drinks. Then after ordering, my family and I waited for another 1 hour and 45 minutes for our food to get to the table. All of our food was cold, at this point we weren't just hungry but hANGRY! My cold eggs (which they got wrong by the way/asked for sunny side up and somehow got them over hard) and my waffle that I ordered seemed like it was just sitting out for a while as well. Also, the hash browns weren't cooked all the way. First time, wasn't impressed BUT I give restaurant 2-3 chances.

2nd Visit- My girlfriends wanted to go there (their first time, my second visit here) expecting a better round this time and again, they took our order late. We kept looking around looking for our waitress. Finally got to us and only took our drinks. Brought out the wrong drinks, then sister in law asked them for orange juice and our waitress NEVER brought out the orange juice. She ordered sunny side up eggs and house potatoes and somehow got scrambled eggs and hash brown. My potatoes were over seasoned and this time my eggs were RIGHT but my pancake wasn't cooked all the way.
We were seeking something new. This was an incredible find. Ordered the cabbage rolls and Zeljanica, spinach pie. Excellent. And the bread,... wow

I am SO grateful for Rick's help today! I had an absolute nightmare of spending over 5 hours on the phone with corporate yesterday, simply trying to get them to swap to a new number and keep my old number on the digits app. He helped me fix the issue with corporate in less than 30 minutes, and now I have my new number and my old number just as I requested. I was genuinely considering canceling my tmobile account after the corporate experience, but now I will continue being a loyal tmobile customer after his help. Thank you!!!
Great price. Super yummy food to eat and watch tv. Great vegan options. The beyond meat is really well seasoned. Feels like it's not a healthy meal little stodgy

I just had a toenail permanently removed,  Dr Les and his staff are AMAZING! They changed my appointment to fit my needs at a short notice, they are Very friendly, helpful, it was a pleasant experience,  I HIGHLY RECOMMEND IDAHO FOOT AND ANKLE,  
Crystal Gant

By far the best indoor shooting range I've ever shot at.  I was very impressed.  Bring your own paper targets or buy them at the range, they have a huge selection to choose from.  

You have the ability to move your target back in 1/2 foot increments to a maximum of 100 feet.  

The shop has everything a gun enthusiast could imagine.  Ammo is very pricy as expected during times like these.  

I highly recommend that you make this a stop in your schedule one day when you feel the urge to target shoot.  You won't be disappointed.

I had a terrible experience with Premium RV Rentals and specifically Kasey (owner). I would not recommend working with them as a business. I summarized my experience with them below.
· The day before I was scheduled to pick up my rental, I reached out multiple times to arrange pickup and finally got an answer from Kacey telling me that the RV I had reserved was being repaired but I could "upgrade" to any of their other RVs. He suggested one and I accepted it. He also pushed me through his personal site instead of using the RVShare platform that I originally rented from. He didn't want to give me price parity and I had to push him on it multiple times.
· I tried multiple times to coordinate pickup and even offered to drive further to Nampa to get it as early as possible. I didn't get a definitive response from Kacey until 10am on the day of pickup.
· The pickup/walkthrough process wasn't organized.  There wasn't a checklist or any documentation that was given to me to help answer any questions that came up when I was actually on the trip. I wasn't notified of any issues with the van which there clearly were (outlined below).
· Here is of the things that were broken on the van that I wasn't notified of:
o Sewer: There was a hole in the black water sewer line that was duct taped. They said it was completely functional but I found out it wasn't as I was emptying it at a dump station and all of the blackwater went out the wrong side of the vehicle. I took a picture of the tape job and called Kacey who sent me to voicemail. He had one of his staff call me and essentially told me that it does leak and to add more water pressure into the toilet as I'm flushing it to help push it out.  Below is a photo of the "functioning" system.  
o Small things broken in the van
§ Table was broken and unable to be used
§ Awning lights
§ Window shades for the front and back were not provided
§ Windows shades on the rest of the van both rattled (were missing the plastic grommet) and some were unable to be lifted up after being down
§ Sliding screen door
§ The sewage pipe was in a plastic bin that was too small to actually close causing a bad odor in the van. I purchased a new one to resolve this for them.
· My drop off was just as bad of an experience. I was told to drop the van in a cul-de-sac. Noone met me to do a walkthrough. To my surprise, I was charged a few days later for a completely new tire and missing hub cap (~$500). I called Kasey to talk through this. I had just driven the van over 500 miles the day before and I would have noticed a tire issue. I had also only driven the van on paved roads and didn't have any collisions/issues. He wasn't willing to give me any more information and said he would follow up and call me back. I followed up via a phone call and text message but haven't received a response.

I was not offered any fair compensation for the issues I had.  I wasn't even given the respect of a conversation.

I like Twigs...I realize it's a chain, but the atmosphere is great and the martinis flow like water...and for those two reasons, when I'm in The Villiage this is one of my go-to places!

The menu is fresh and well executed, and the rotating specials are usually inventive and worth trying. If you are looking for a must try appetizer...try the gorgonzola fondue...its a rich-yummy-holy crap my tastebuds are in heaven-kind of dish!

The staff is efficient and friendly...and I'm usually not a lemon drop fan, but Twigs HAS A FANTASTIC LEMON DROP! And its on their happy hour menu which is just a sugary yummy surprise! 

If you're in The Villiage hanging out, or waiting for your movie...pop into Twigs and order a drink!
The atmosphere is nice but quite loud. The food is average and I feel overpriced for what you get. We were charged for our ice tea refills which is not the norm.

i had only been to this place once before and it the food was good. the second time i went it was the last day of school and my mom was taking me to lunch. well she went to the bathroom and i asked for a table and she refused me and told me to wait for my mother in the car. i was offended. i left immediately and drove (in my own car) to the far superior jimmy johns.
Friendly environment, very clean the mamosa's were great & we had a really nice waitress. Only thing is my spicy hash was way too greasy & the chicken fried steak was too tough..
My 2 year old granddaughter loved her time here Friday afternoon! I can also see bringing my older grandchildren ages 6-10. Lots of things to play with and see ! Perfect indoor experience.
Boom Thai Tea, boom turkey waffle sandwich, boom fries and boom service! Check out their lunch special.

AMAZING place THANK YOU! My husband loves cheese steak sandwiches, so I ordered delivery from here today. They were so fast! Our delivery driver was super friendly and courteous, and was wearing a mask. I ordered my husband the cheese steak with green peppers and onions and I got a turkey sub. They were both delicious and clearly made with care and quality ingredients. So glad I found you guys! Will definitely be back!

So insanely good! I didn't think Indiana had good BBQ, but this place proved me wrong. Their rib tips and that sauce were out of this world. Not only that, the staff was so incredibly kind. Will be back for the fried pickles!

Stay far far away from CBH homes. The absolute worst home builder and worst experience working with them. There is a current lawsuit filed against CBH homes and I completely can see why. They slap the homes together with no land and charge outrages prices all because they are the number 1 builder. Don't even ask for them to fix anything cause it will never happen.

We stopped for breakfast on Thursday morning about 10:00 AM.  The food and service were very good as expected.  We saw one "buss-boy" cleaning and sanitizing the tables with a face mask on.  There was no social distancing or face masks being required or used by the staff other than what I noted.

Apparently they think the pandemic is over.

We will not return anytime soon.

Ps, we have been patronizing this establishment since they first opened in Eagle.

I am being genuine when I say I do not know how this place is still in business. I guess because they are in the middle of a very busy area where there is lots of foot traffic, so people just naturally gravitate in there- that has to be their only saving grace. 

I have been multiple times. this review is not just for one visit. the first time we came it was happy hour. we got a bottle of wine. we ordered a flatbread- it was cold and dull and gross. my son got a kids meal. it was old oil and gross. I didn't want to order anything else. our check was $50+ . I was so irritated. I thought I would just never come back.

then tonight we come in for a drink. we went to kona for dinner because kona is amazing and the service is great and the food is fresh. they deserve to be there. twigs was packed. again. I don't know how because every experience I have had here is disappointing. we went to the bar for a drink. the bartenders looked annoyed and stressed. they are busy. not as busy as yard house so what's the problem? we asked them if they had a chocolate martini. mind you, this was after being ignored for 10 minutes. the bartender rudely said n-  they were "out of everything" and suggested something else. 

nope. that's all it took. i'll never be back. I don't appreciate the food, the service, or the attitude here. way better places in the village to spend your money- don't waste it here. trust me on this. yuck.

I am pretty cautious about having a lot of apps of on my phone. In order for me to have 'your' app, I got to use it regularly or else it does not make sense for me to have.  I have a friend of my who travels quite a bit. One moment he is in North Carolina, and the next he's in Las Vegas. He has the Great Clip app, and I thought, " What a dope!" Why do you need an app for a haircut. Well, I take all those words back and more. This is a very handy app to have.  Here's how it works. Create an account and enter your location while only using the app. There are usually 5-10 Great Clip locations in each metropolitan area, sometimes more sometimes less. With the app, you can see the expected wait time at each location. Pick your location, and then figure out how it will take you to get there so there's not prolonged wait time in the lobby.  It's genius.  

I've used this app in Meridian and have been serviced at three different Great Clip locations. The service is quick, friendly, and professional.  The best service I received was at Eagle and Chinden location near the Fred Meyer. I don't remember the name of my stylist but she was a rockstar.

Worst customer service!  After waiting for over 50 minutes, I went to the receptionist and said, "there are 3 of waiting and no one has been seen or called in, in over 50 minutes", she was very disconcerned and snotty when she replied "oh, ok" I stated I wanted to be taken off the waiting list, she simply said, "ok, you're off the list".  No sorry, no thank you for coming in...no concern.  I am glad I didn't actually have them look at my dog as I am sure it would not have gone well with her and I want to take my animals to a place that cares.  I will dash this company to everyone I know.

I ordered food through postmates for pickup. It said the location on state street in boise was open. Upon arrival I realized that although signs on the door said they were open for take out, that the entire restaurant was closed. 

Postmates said the food was ready and when I tried to cancel the order it said I would not get any money back and it was going to charge a cancelation fee. I called this location and spoke with Tammy about the dilemma and what we could do about it. I couldn't run out to the store to pick up the food as I was getting ready for work and wouldn't have time, so she sent a driver my way with the food. 

Tammy more than helped resolve the problem even though it meant sending a driver all the way into Boise. Tammy deserves a raise and I will only order from this location going forward.

Oh my goodness I love this place their chicken pad Thai is by far my favorite I never order anything else because it's the best pad Thai I have ever had! Also their angry edamame pot stickers and sushi is good to snack on. I love sitting at the bar area there is a few bartenders who have worked there for a while and always get the best customer service from them I try tables here and there but I always end up regretting it. Happy hour all day on Sunday's is where it's at too!

Our meal last night was totally spoiled by an extremely and unnecessarily loud barrage of music. The 4 of us  would not hear each other without shouting. The waiter had to do the same thing to communicate. Other tables were doing the same thing. The result was a cauldron of sound. It took over an hour to get our food. The food itself was fantastic; the only redeeming thing in an otherwise unpleasant experience.

Did a take out order of cabbage rolls, I am now a fan of cabbage rolls. I honestly could eat them weekly, a nice mellow heat, not over powering. They are a local restaurant, which I love, and of course all smiles when you go there. Great little place.

Fresh, yummy  food with fair prices and good service. Mycah was our server today and did an excellent job. This is 'gringo style'  Mexican food, but we have eaten here 4 times and enjoyed it every time.

This was our first experience but we have had the same issues as so many others.  We ordered a large pizza to go.  Half veggies and half pepperoni with extra pepperoni.  What we got was pepperoni and ham, no sauce on the pizza either side, little to no cheese and it was tasteless.  More broccoli on the veggie pizza and the rest lots of onions with a little peppers and almost no tomatoes.  We won't try again.

Can't wait to come back!
If you have been debating to get the prime rib STOP debating and get it! I agreed to the 32oz (the biggest!) and wasn't really thinking about size as much as I was hunger! Oh it's big! It was delicious! It was perfectly smoked! 
I can't stop thinking about it! The service was great! The Mac and cheese was so good! The French fries were super yummy. There was even a  baby changing table in the restroom! No complaints-not even the price.
Our server really was hilarious! We brought my brother from Texas and he loved everything just as much as us! We won't be strangers! 
This was actually my first dine in experience. The first & second was take out. My Dad always told me: you know the best way to critique a business is by evaluating their consistency. I must say this place is winning!! Thank you Big Daddy!

Absolutely the worst locations. the first time going to the bank it took me 15 minutes just to find because all of their signs were hidden by trees. you can't make any form of payment over the phone. There are two locations and they're both on the worst Street possible, Eagle Road, good luck getting anywhere quickly. this is a great bank if you enjoy driving all over Boise just to be disappointed and sent back home. I have made countless attempts to pay bills and they continually shoo me away because I can't close my account unless.... So many excuses as why I can't close down my own credit card and account it's ridiculous I'm fed up I'm tired I'm done! "Oh I'm sorry bank you don't want my $500 in cash to be paid towards my credit card to close my account as of right now, oh you're willing to overpay so you don't have to drive back out here sorry we can't do that here at westmark" DONE. YOU HAVE BETTER OPTIONS BOISE. A bit of advice to westmark. Location. Location. Location. Hint: not Eagle Road. Hint hint. Wink wink. 
Good day to you!

Great coffee for a quick grab. Because I was new I went a basic black coffee and a hot chocolate for my daughter. Hot chocolate was yummy. You could actually taste the chocolate unlike other coffee places I've been to where it taste more milk then chocolate. The only thing I wish because I wasn't up to the menu I was greeted in the drive was is to know what popular go to's were or to see a menu. Still a great spot for on the go.
Ordered chickens bacon bowls , and they give me gyro , with mean attitude telling me that that's what I ordered. Last time . So many better places around.
This place is pretty good been there many times. I would say but the customer service is pretty good to the prices are pretty high though but during their happy hours they are great!)

I love this gym.  The classes are great, I love the hydromessage, my kids love the day care and go every day.  Eden is great with the kids.  In the past year they have really added a lot and it is feeling good!

Great credit union. I get all my vehicles for work and personal through these guys. Sean and JJ go above and beyond to accommodate us. 
As a growing company we need to know or bank backs us and not only wants our deposits. 
Now my son, wife and 2 teenage daughters have accounts here. 
Highly recommended. 

Safer Chimney llc

Ok.. better than I thought was going to be! We were given a gift card so trying it out. It was pretty goid and the service was fantastic!  

It was a pretty slow when we arrived but greeted with bubbly personality and just stayed positive and helpful throughout! By the time we left very busy but everyone still pretty happy.

Mr had a Canadian & Bacon & Meatball Calzone and I the Thai Grilled Chicken salad. My chicken was cooked perfectly and was tender and juicy.  Pretty good portion of greens. Mr said Calzone was pretty good too. 

If I could give another 1/2 star I would!

13 minutes ago

My bestie and I have been going here for a while. Honestly, I haven't been impressed with how the management deals with the gross men, who go here. They get away with all kinds of unexceptionable behavior. This place gives off creeper or sexual predator vibes. I bet there will be or has been date rape situations here. My bestie was spanked/assaulted and felt unsafe and the management ignored her. The management is usually so drunk they can barely walk or function. What kind of a place is this? A not funny joke!
I like the location and Mark the dj. That's it!

Super friendly and great staff. From the moment you walk into their office, you feel very welcome. My husband and I are on the younger side and felt like we were not taken serious at other sale centers. Samandra and her team went above and beyond. They made the whole process easy, especially for first time buyers. Will definitely be referring friends and family to them because I highly recommend!

Omg! I am visiting my birthplace Weiser,  Idaho  and and wanted to bring my host a dessert. Reading all the positive reviews I decided to visit Cinn-Nom-Nom Bakery. I am so glad I did! The clerk suggested the pumpkin cinnamon rolls and they are so delicious. Not too sweet and a hint of pumpkin. A great treat to start the fall season. I also had a croissant breakfast item that was very tasty. You will not be dissatisfied with any baked item from this establishment.

I have been looking for a cinnamon roll that was a worthy heir apparent to those legendary ones from Raedeans. Finally, I have found them! These rolls are pillowy soft with an extremely good cream cheese and vanilla frosting. Heat them up with a bit of butter and they're existential! They also make a chocolate muffin that will satisfy any chocoholic! Add to that super friendly service. This is the go to for cinnamon rolls. Just stop looking elsewhere!

Really disappointed in this place. The shakes are chalky and melt really fast. The service is unfriendly. Also they don't have an option to just get a shake. If you don't want the tea or aloe they will not accommodate your request.
Excellent car was with all the bells and whistles. Recently added Mat Cleaning Machines.  Nice people and good service too.

Grill Kona (Matata), what a wonderful place
Grill Kona (Matata), it's my new home base
It means no worries, no matter what's on your plate
Food's locally made; Coffee's Fair Trade
Grill Kona (Matata)

Kona is one of those restaurants where you can close your eyes and point to the menu for the waitress and it doesn't matter what you order, it will be great.
I've had rare steak and tuna which were so tender, I could cut them with the handle of my fork. I don't recommend doing so because then your handle is covered with raw fish, but the option is there.

The service is attentive and seems genuinely concerned with our experience.

The decor is beautiful; many glass and water sculptures, waterfalls, a very nice custom aquarium. The general feel of the place, and of "The Village" in general is of happy, progressive fun. Everyone seems glad to be there.

The price is manageable but if you aren't careful, it is not at all difficult to hit $100 for two people, even without alcohol. There are many lower-cost and probably still very good items on the menu.

Try the Brownie dessert. Brownies are hard to screw up, but it is also very difficult to make an exceptional brownie. Kona has among the best I have had.
You have got to check this place out!!! The food is amazing, and creative!! We have eaten there twice, and I need to go back! We love that the owners are so friendly and down to earth!

The place was super packed around lunch time. It was a bit hard to find but it seems maybe like a spot that the office people nearby frequent. It was a decent sandwich. I gave it a three because it wasn't bad but not exceptionally great. I had a turkey pesto sandwich. It was fine, not much flavor. Not sure what their special sauce was. The bread was warm so that was nice. Still on the hunt for a good sandwich place in Idaho.

Well... where do I start... I have been going here for years and have never been treated so poorly. My family and I went in today for lunch, and got out drink order taken.... but never got our drinks... we sat there for 24-30 min with no service at all. And when finally a waitress came by (after we flagged one down) "ready" to take our drink order again.... and when we told her we already ordered our drinks and have not received them yet, she VERY rudely spouted "WELL YOUR NOT THE ONLY ONES HERE." So needless to say we won't be going back, which is really sad because that's where we would always have our family gatherings. Over all we are not "Karen's" and expect to be waited on hand and foot, but we do expect to be treated kindly, and a simple "sorry we are busy, I'll get those drinks." Or anything would of been just fine. So with that being said... if you want kind service do not go here! They are very rude, and have a new Manager that over all could care less.
Jessica was very thorough and answered all our questions.  Front desk was super efficient.

Great shop with great displays!  We went in looking for a couple new weapons and met Ben.  He gave us the rundown on each weapon and some classes. 

This place rocks!

Horrible experience. Ordered, they took our money, then had to sit at a dirty table as no others were open. Waited 15 minutes for food only to find out the food had been returned to kitchen because server could not find us. You want service? Forgettaboutit! Never going back!

Oh my goodness I love this place their chicken pad Thai is by far my favorite I never order anything else because it's the best pad Thai I have ever had! Also their angry edamame pot stickers and sushi is good to snack on. I love sitting at the bar area there is a few bartenders who have worked there for a while and always get the best customer service from them I try tables here and there but I always end up regretting it. Happy hour all day on Sunday's is where it's at too!

If you are use to a really good massage do not go here. I had a terrible massage. It was torture waiting for it to end. The massage is suppose to make me relax not make me miserable. The place is mediocre at best. The massage table is outdated, blankets are staunch, and the sheets are maybe a 100 thread count.  I told my MT I liked deep pressure. I told him 3 times (as he never asked) and his pressure never changed. In fact, there wasn't any pressure at all.... just a miserable rub! If I could give ZERO stars I would!

As we were waiting for food I noticed the girl making the food had gloves on. But she was also talking on her phone.  She then proceeded to put her phone in her back pocket and continued touching the food with her contaminated hands.  I spoke to the Manager as she was doing this and the manager said, "ya we tell them not to do that."  I again asked for the manager and told her how disgusted I was and she said I spoke to her about it.  They actually could have given a crap. Won't be coming here anymore. 8/10/20 3:30

The service was a disaster. On the reservation it stated it was my child's birthday. My food came out before our starters and the starters were not correct. When I sent my salad back because it wasn't the right order the servers attitude started. She ignored us and slammed down the check with my cocktail right after our entrees were served. We hadn't even had the chance to enjoy our meal before the check was delivered and on top of that no acknowledgement of my child's birthday! My daughter was even wearing a birthday crown as she was so proud to be out celebrating her special day. A very young man came by stating he was the manager but had absolutely no training in customer service and left us more bewildered by the whole experience. We left and took the family else where for birthday dessert and we won't be going back.

I just want to say thank you to Dr. Ware and the staff. I took my senior girl in after hours of her walking in circles and whining. When I first called, I was told I could bring her down to be checked to see if she was critical. If not, which she wasn't, I could be put on a list and be called to come down when it was our turn.  It made me feel better knowing that while we waited to see the doctor. As promised, they called me and we went into a room right away. From the start, the vet techs were wonderful and Dr. Ware was great. Tests were done as needed. I highly recommend All Valley Pet Hospital.

Fantastic atmosphere and excellent addition to The Village.  We had a lovely time enjoying a variety of small plates and martinis.  The bar service was excellent and we really enjoyed our wait staff, Warren.  Try the truffle fries with Gorgonzola fondu, you will not regret it!
Great place for breakfast or lunch.  The pancakes, waffles, french toast, corned beef hash, etc are delicious.
Bread is nothing like an authentic cheesesteak. Very disappointing. The meat was good and tender and the flavor was nice.

Love going to Big Dadfys for some good BBQ. Got some wings for an appetizer with their sweet sauce which was good. Was really bummed they didn't have their pickle fries though, they are awesome and hope they bring them back! I got the Big Sirracha sandwich which was 2 meats and 2 cheeses with a spicy BBQ sauce. Super good and will probably get it again. Wife got the chopped chicken meat platter with the Mac and cheese and fries. Mac and cheese was good she was hoping for a bigger portion of that and smaller portion of fries. Fries are great though especially with their fry sauce!

Homes made poorly. Crooked walls, nail pops in ceiling, air conditioning unit struggles, white vinyl fence put in with visible gaps, squeaky floors and crumbling concrete. It's more like a manufactured home which probably would have been made better than my CBH house. 

The CBH repair men do their best to fix issues, but they can only do so much after the fact.

The workers here are super rude and very unhelpful! My friend had their drink made wrong and they argued with us about if it was messed up or not... when it was! Super inappropriate and unacceptable!! Terrible customer service and horrible coffee! If I could give zero stars I would

In short, they misrepresented their services, costing me a great deal in time, money, aggravation to a physical injury, progress in a competition (top prize of 20K), stress and distraction from work/goals, and have had me waiting for many weeks/months on a refund for unused services and on official confirmation that my membership was cancelled.  I've never seen such poor business practices in a gym. I'd highly recommend that you take your business elsewhere.

Went to Bonos not to long after they opened and had a good experience. The decor was nice and service was prompt. We ordered a deep dish Canadian bacon pizza and got hooked up with some tiramisu.  The waiter warned us of the long wait on the deep dish pizza, but it was a pleasant wait because we stayed in the man cave and were able to put 2 college football games of our choice on the TVs. When the pizza got there we were very pleased- my wife's favorite part of the pizza was the crust, and it had a lot of crust!  The toppings were fresh and it came out piping hot.  The tiramisu was melt-in-your mouth creamy (it's hard to find a good piece of tiramisu in Boise).  Definitely will go back again.

Had a good experiencing dining here is my wife and friends on a double date. I appreciated the beans on the side on top of the chips and salsa they served as a free appetizer. I heard Café Ole has been a staple Mexican food place in the valley for many years and I can see why. The portions were pretty generous and the food was pretty good for Mexican food you can find outside of Mexico and CA. My wife and I will probably make this our go-to Mexican place from now on. Its a good place for a casual dinner date and the service was good. Had our food out in minutes and the servers were very attentive. Food prices are around $10 - $20 dollars a plate with generous portions and they had a pretty good happy hour menu from 3-6 PM with $5 Appetizers. I'll probably come back to try the happy hour or to get their PANZA GRANDE again which is a burrito within a burrito. It was pretty huge and enough for seconds or thirds. I'll be back!
Great food, good service, enjoyable atmosphere. The carrot cakes is one of the best we've had.

The first day I can actually recall it being hot. And what do I do... lock my keys and phone in the car. I had been waiting for a tow truck for over an hour. When MJ saved the day!! He had me back in my car in no time. He was super great and reassured me it happens all the time. Thanks, wish I would of thought of asking the staff an hour and a half ago.

Well last time I ever shop for my wife or my staff at any Lulu lemon.  Bought extra at Christmas for her and extra sizes, at the full price might I add, so she could for sure have the right size.  Unfortunately we find out they have been "updating" their return policy.  It is only 2 weeks to return any item! We are only one week past the deadline. Needless to say we are stuck with extra sizes of the same uber-expensive items that we cannot use and cannot return at all!!! Not even for a discount.  
So this is me saying Adios To the corporation of snotty nosed Lulu lemon policies and un-bending retail workers.  IMHO you are never so lofty that you can color outside the normal lines of society with alacrity and not pay the consequences of offending your clientele.  
I nearby pledge to never shop again at lulu lemon and to disparage those who shop there or wear their clothing.

This bakery makes the most scrumptious cinnamon rolls! If you have not been here pop in &  support this business! They also have other goodies and treats in their establishment as well. The best cinnamon rolls in town!!

Service was not good. The food was tolerable. Looks like they haven't vacumed the floor in months. Maybe you will have better luck. 
One lady came in when I was eating.  Nobody talked to her so she just left.

We were greeted at the door with "Do you have reservations? " This was at 3:00 on a Monday.  The restaurant had tons of available seating.  I guess they aren't hurting for business.  Would have been nice to hear good afternoon, welcome to Kona Grill. Obviously we went elsewhere.

SO, after I posted a review and Elizabeth (the Customer Service representative) wrote a comment back to me asking for my contact information - I did just that.  And I have not heard from her at all.  This is what I am talking about - No real customer service at this gym and plenty of negative reviews should tell this branch of Crunch Fitness that they have some real work to do.
Great place to sit down, grab a beer, and some really good bbq. Get there early because they sometimes sell out of the good stuff........

I am not much of a fan of sourdough but this place changed my mind. My wife and I both got a soup and sandwich and the sandwiches were delightful. The soup was clam chowder and it was nice and thick, not enough clams for me but I still thought it was good. Kind of wanted one in a bread bowl after. The tables are nice and spaces, a little hidden but a treasure if you miss the bay.

They don't follow state of Idaho COVID protocols for restaurants. Tables not adequately spaced (not spaced at all), bar seating not spaced, waiting area full, condiments left out on tables not disinfected between parties, no employees wearing masks. 

Other than that, the food is good. Just eat at your own risk.

I am not one to write reviews, however, crunch has confirmed its reputation of having terrible customer service and overcharging. I have been a member at crunch for a few months. Being new in town and crunch's new member, I was excited to see the changes happening late last year. However, the entire six months I had my membership with crunch, I was overcharged.
In September (when I first signed up) I was charged $47.65. In October, I was charged $56.55 (I was told that this was the annual fee). Then, I was charged $51.55 and $37.05 in November!! At this point, I was stunned. I spoke with the General Manager; he was very nice and helpful. He attempted to dispute the transaction on their end and initiated a refund. However, it never reflected on my account. At this point, I had decided to cancel my membership instead (not only because of the billing issues but also because I had a free gym accessible to me). I have attempted to cancel my account via email to the corporate - twice, but no response. I finally went in the gym to talk to the manager. He still very nice and attempted to help me; he mentioned that he cancelled my account in response to my email. I told him that I never got a confirmation email. He pulled up my account and verbally confirmed that it was indeed cancelled (hindsight, I should've asked for a paper trail of the cancellation). A week later, I was charged. Today, I spoke with the manager.... Apparently, I needed a signature to cancel it. On top of all of that, I found out that my monthly invoice was $21.15 but getting charged $37.05! That's over $10 difference!!

Overall, the gym was nice and has good equipment. The manager kept his nice and helpful composure throughout. However, I do not support how the crunch do their business and the lack-there-of the corporation's common courtesy of just acknowledging the issues brought up to them.

I love this great place. Everything is so new and clean. I enjoyed the massage so much that I had to extend one more hour to focus on my lower back - it helped to sooth my back pain.  At the end the owner even let me try the heated bed for free. Would definitely come back and recommend this good place.

Buyer beware of unlimited washes! I paid for unlimited washes however, this is not the case at  Mister carwash on Eagle in Meridian. If you have ANY mud on your vehicle you will be turned away and told to wash it before taking it thru their car wash. It's been raining for a  week and there is going to be mud on vehicles that go thru a CAR WASH...we live in Idaho! I have cancelled all my cars that have unlimited washes with this business.  The customer service was very poor and the managers are condescending. I paid for a service that they were unable to provide!

This is a really cool park. Tons of unique features, HUGE, and very popular with the small humans. 

This place goes way beyond the typical swings and slide park. It has rock climbing walls, musical instruments, tire swings, handicap accessible swings, a huge splash pad, massive fields, tennis and pickle ball courts, plenty of seating and tons of concrete for kids to practice their bikes and scooters. 

One of my most favorite things is the rubberized surface under the play structure. This makes it ideal for beginning walkers. However, in the heat of the summer...that black color is BRUTAL. It is seriously 10 degrees hotter in the play structure area than on the concrete or grass. This is still a newish park so the trees are medium sized. But what really needs to happen is that HUGE sun sails can be strung across the whole structure. I've seen it done in California and Arizona when we've visited there and it's a must for our Boise summers. 

The splash pad is great. Wide and open which makes it seem slightly less chaotic when 50 day camp kids are running around. This is another reason why I had to give Settler's 4 stars...it is so dang crowded in summer. It's a great park so everyone loves it! It just makes me hesitant to bring multiple children when I'm the only (semi) responsible adult. This is not a "sit and relax while my offspring run around" kind of park. You really have to stay vigilant if your kids are under 5.

My family discovered this gem a year ago and have made it our weekly outing. The owners are very intent on providing the best meals available. A great variety of delicious breakfast and lunch items on their menu. Will continue frequenting and enjoying this fine establishment.
