I had an eye exam here 2 years ago and bought a pair of glasses I loved! The process was timely and no problems. The real cement for my loyalty was yesterday. I was driving and all of a sudden I had a burst of what looked like black spider veins in my right eye. I couldn't blink them away and I was terrified. I pulled over and called Meridian Vision. The darling receptionist, Christina answered. I explained what was happening. She calmly said "You need to come here now, ok?" I was a half mile from them so I drove there. They took me right away and the doctor took great care of me. I will never go anywhere else. Why would I?

I've now managed at least 6 trips to Joe Momma's.  Man is this place popular.  Usually that's a bad omen, especially during covid, and during a labor shortage.  Nonetheless, I am giving a solid 5 STAR rating.  Food is always above average good.  Chicken fried steak, all meat hash, French toast, and OMG the pancake on the side(instead of toast) is a wonderful meal all its own and the best flapjack in town.  

Some have criticized the service.  I was concerned seeing the teenage hosts upfront, but my severs in particular have been excellent.  I'd describe them as very professional, checking in more regularly than you would think the crowds would allow for, and not one forgetting the extra butter for my pancakes.  

My original impression was that value was only par due to pricing, but have learned many half portion meals are more than enough and then the pricing becomes a better than ave value.  

Now I need to try a Bene!
Very delicious first time I've ever tried a Gyro and lamb and oh my goodness very yummy will def be eating here more often!

I don't believe I haven't reviewed this wonderful little place sooner. Cinn-nom-nom is freakin phenomenal! I rarely get a sweet tooth, but I happened to get hit by one when I was in the area of this little delightful place. I went in and was greeted by a nice young lady as well as someone who turned out to be the owner, Brandi. She was super sweet and was telling me about how most everything made there is made from scratch. I ordered a bowl of soup(wish I could remember what kind...dang it memory), a scone, and one of their famous cinnamon rolls. 

First off, I was wow'd by the soup. I don't even believe I'm saying that seeing as I was in a bakery, but the soup was amazing! I think it was possibly a corn chowder or something? It was really really good! The scone I remember being good but I barely had any because my wife stole that one. But the cinnamon roll?! YES! First off, the roll passed the test perfectly with it's moistness...I was so hoping it wouldn't be one of those rolls that had good icing but then a dry roll. Nope, this was perfect and fresh. Then the icing? Well that was the icing on the...roll. So good and sweet. But again, what I loved so much about the entire roll in addition to the sweet taste was how fresh everything was. I really loved everything. I don't eat out much these days, but next time I'm going by here, I'm picking up EVERYTHING!!!

I ordered a pair of orthopedic inserts 3 months ago. After repeated excuses and apologies,  along with reassurances that these would be rush ordered etc... I still don't have my orthopedic inserts. I finally canceled the order and requested a refund,  but the complete incompetence and concern i received was inexcusable. I would recommend taking your business elsewhere.
Best cinnamon roll I've ever tasted! They had a great variety of other tasty treats as well.  Very nice ladies run the bakery

Only complaint I have is my entire party was wearing a mask as mandated by the city, but they were letting people wait in the lobby that were not wearing a mask.  Service should be refused if they are not following the mandate.  We all hate wearing masks!
Came out to spray crabgrass also had preventative put down.  I guess the product doesn't work.  I have crabgrass and weeds worse than I did before using weedman.

Fruity Pebbles, Thin Mint, Peanut Butter Cookie...how could any of those things be healthy for you?!  Only at Good n Healthy, do you find delicious, healthy and filling shakes, with flavors that will blow your mind!  You should try their teas too!  Basically Canadian, POM BOM and other savory teas await you with different levels of caffeine to suit your energy needs!  I stopped in for the first time a few years ago and have been addicted ever since!
Stopped in for a couple of beers and really enjoyed the ambiance, great service and great beer! We will be back! The merchandise is really nice too.

We met friends in the bar for cocktails and dinner.  One of us had strawberry & spinach salad w/salmon .. she said it was the best salmon she'd had in awhile .... kept saying it was yummy the whole way through eating it.  I had a Greek salad, without chicken, but with prawns ... YUMMY .. I ate every last bite!!  Someone also had the Grilled Citrus Mahi-mahi and said it was great ... he ate it all, too.  We forget about this place ... maybe because the parking at the Villages is so terrible ....and sometimes it is too busy to get in.  Our waitress, Courtney was sweet and took care of us.  We'll rgo back again because the food is always pretty darn good!

OK folks if you like pulled pork you are in for a yummy treat at Big Daddy's.   I made some funny humming noises with each bite which means "I'm loving it".  Fries were hot and crispy.  Didn't have to wait too long and waitress was very friendly.   Lots of sides to go with burgers and sandwiches.  Next time I will try the smashed garlic tators and emphasis on next time since I will be back.

Such great service everytime! Recently, we went to pick up our guitar after being restrung. We left our wallet at home and they were so kind and told us to take the guitar and we could call back with the payment. It's such a small town feel. We will definitely be back!
We ate here this past weekend with friends.Molly was our server she recommended the strawberry chicken salad it was fantastic. We will be back soon!!!Thank you!

Okay so this four star review is based solely on my husband's experience this week.  This was our first visit to Slanted Rock and I arrived late to a packed house.  That's to be expected with $2 Tuesday woot woot!  When I showed up there wasn't a single seat open in the place (except mine that my husband was saving) and you couldn't even get to the bar.  

I love love love the fact that they use the local food trucks rather than serving food in house!  It's one last thing that the brewery has to worry about and the variety that comes with food trucks is FUN.  On Tuesday they had Burgerlicious; however, I didn't get the opportunity to try it because I couldn't even get a drink.

To be fair, they were absolutely SLAMMED.  At one point a lady came and took my order but she never came back to deliver it.  In the meantime they ran out of glasses and hard to start using plastic cups.  The next time someone came around to our table we just asked for the bill and sent him off with a $20.  That's it $20 to buy rounds for the table and include a nice tip.  If you haven't tried it I suggest a $2 Tuesday but get there early.

I have been coming to this location for years and I've noticed the service has gone downhill.  Just last week I was at this restaurant and after a trip to the drive thru ended up with an extra $100 charged to my debit card and an order of fries (that I paid for) was missing!  The gal who overcharged my card was very apologetic about the overcharge (it was credited back to my account 5 days later).  When I discovered the missing fries, I called and left a message, but nobody ever called back.  When I went in person to discuss the $100, I mentioned the message and missing fries, but the manager on duty didnt' seem to care too much regarding the incomplete order.  When I called to talk with the owner regarding the $100 over-charge, she never returned my call.

It's a shame because I really do like their food, but if this is how they feel about their customers, I'll have to be taking my business elsewhere.

If you do go, and especially if using the drive thru, check your receipt and order for accuracy!  If they do overcharge, and offer the cash, take them up on it, otherwise you are out the money for several days!

I have been to Kona Grill 4 times. Only one of the visits was good. The worst was one night with out of town friends - wanting a nice meal. The grill vent was broken and instead of a nice meal all that was available was salads and it was really smokey.  Then - on Friday we were there - asked for  well scotch on the rocks with splash of soda. Our server asked if we wanted 12 or 16 yr MacCalum (sp) - I said no - the house was fine and were told they didn't have a house scotch so ordered Dewars - $9.00 a drink. When we left I asked the bartender who said yes they had a house scotch and it was $6.25.  BAD TRICK!  Never going back.

I have been referred to Idaho Foot and Ankle three times now over the past three years for heal and arch pain. Every time I end up with new orthotic inserts that do not work and taking anti-inflammatories. Being a problem that has persisted through the years, I would hope for some kind of help. 

My first problem is that the problem has been identified with no solution in sight. The second is that the assistant was not very friendly. Being an early appointment on a Tuesday, cheer up!  Thirdly, the Dr was not very professional.  He had made a comment as to the lesser quality of work another Dr in the same office does. And even made the comment to me that, "he did not have a magic wand"!
Truly some of the best sandwiches we've ever had! Our bag even had a an encouraging note written on it which made our day. We can't wait to order again and to eventually be able to dine in person.

Nice place!  Came here tonight with a large group (24 people, 3 tables), and service was very good still!  Nice relaxing atmosphere, and good variety of menu items.
     I had the sea bass, highly recommended by our waitress.  It is marinated for 72 hours, and I asked for double vegetables instead of the rice which they allowed.  We also had the shrimp Diablo (spicy snd very good) and the calamari (good).  My friend had pad Thai and really enjoyed it.  The snickers Deseret looked good and was devoured up by others at our table as was the carrot cake.
     Beautiful fountains outside make a nice setting.  Give this place a try!

Very cute and clean little salon on Main Street in Meridian.  I love the little downtown vibe and the cute look of the house that has now been converted.  The owner kept things clean and simple with the décor and it is not overcrowded with only 4 hairdressers.

Let's talk about the MOST COMFORTABLE hair washing stations I have ever experienced!  No joke, I could lay there for hours.  I get a conditioning treatment and waxing done every visit and it is so much easier and more enjoyable at this salon.

**Blondies** if you're looking for a new stylist check out my girl Amanda Johnson... she's the bomb!  Amanda specializes in blonde and you won't be disappointed.  I've been going to her for 2 years now and she is ALWAYS professional and on time.  She is great at what she does and I am in and out of her chair quicker than any other stylist I've been too with better results.

Sydnee is the absolute sweetest! You can see her passion and dedication in her work. She listens and actually hears what you are wanting to achieve with your hair. 
She takes her time and is very detailed oriented- doesn't make you feel rushed and like you're "just another client" in her chair.
She's very personable, friendly and outgoing. 

Make sure to book in advance she fills up very quickly! 

**The only negative things I have to say about my experience are that the shampoo bowls are very uncomfortable- not that most are comfortable- but these ones were a killer on my neck!
It would also be nice if they at least had water to offer clients- most salons I go to have that, plus coffee, hot tea and sometimes even beer / wine!
But other than that it's a very clean and inviting atmosphere!**

I am the self proclaimed king of cinnamon rolls and I know a good one when I taste one. Cinn-nom-nom has the best cinnamon rolls I have ever tasted. I, personally, think there's too much cream cheese frosting on them. I know, I'm weird. I scrape most of it off, I realize this is my issue but I do this to anything with frosting. The frosting itself is amazing, I just prefer a thin layer. 

Her egg salad sandwiches come on a croissant and loose leaf lettuce which is to die for!! Try it!!!

Lastly, her biscuits and gravy are FIRE!!!! Her biscuits are buttery and soft. Her sausage grave is full of flavor! Only thing I will miss about Idaho is the food from here!

We were curious what our experience would be after reading a negative review.  Happily for us our experience was very good!  We are cinnamon and pecan roll fans and have been for over 60 years.  Needless to say,  we have had many.  Some great, some good and definitely some not worth the calories.  My husband had the cinnamon roll and said the roll was perfect.  The frosting was buttery and not too sweet, the bread was soft, not dry and not doughy.  I loved the pecan roll!  I had no complaints, it was awesome!  We will be back!

I have been to Meridian location several times since it has opened and was served a good product. 

I ordered online and went in to the location on 06/03/2021 and when I got home and opened sandwich I found dough instead of baked bread. Uneatable, I had to heat up oven and cook for another 15 minutes to brown the bread.

I sent email with attached photos and have yet to hear back? Prompt customer service, yes/NO?

Clearly the leadership is lacking at this location, I saw only kids working there. Who would put that beautiful cheesesteak on an uncooked roll, no brown at all, come on?

Very disappointed, will not be going back until they figure it out!

Updated from owners reply:

IT is definitely not baked bread, there is no crust, no browning on the outside, it's dough, trust you it is baked? 

Why would I need to cook for an extra 15 minutes to get dough brown and crunchy? If you were there that day and overseeing the operations, then wow. I will definitely not be going back to your establishment, your clearly incompetent. 

Product in pictures is clearly uncooked and no apology or even a suggestion of a refund or compensation.

Good luck.

Hopefully this message reached Bruchi's cooperate.

I'd give 0 stars if I could. Waited over 45 minutes from the time we ordered watched 3 other tables who came in 15 minutes after get their food. Worst service I've had in a restaurant in a long time. I do not recommend. I would avoid. Looks can be deceiving!
Very decent BBQ. We were definitely pleased with the food and service. We qill be back very soon.

Great job. Both ladies were great. Overall massage was nice. The only thing, not sure about their linen changes. They had us lay on top of sheet and then cover with a towel. That makes me feel like the bed is not actually changed in between massages :/.

How things have changed in a bit over a year! Tonight my party sat for 45 minutes without receiving the appetizer we ordered. The person assigned to "wait" on us walked by at least 7 or 8 times and never thought to stop and inform us of how the order was progressing. How long does it take to cook & serve Pot Stickers?   

What once was among the best restaurants at The Village is now a shell of itself. The food that was coming out looked like the quality is subpar now and the "service" at least tonight was nonexistent. There's a Chick-Fil-A around the corner, I'd recommend going there over Kona Grill, at least you'll get service with a smile.

Never Going Back Again ($1 to Lindsey Buckingham).
Love! Love! LOVE! The wait was worth it. Everything super delicious esp the Beignets with the coffee sauce!!

St Luke's Meridian Emergency Department is a malpractice suit waiting to happen. They are always understaffed. The care sucks. It is like they are a over-priced referral department. Sort of a 'We don't know so we are going to send you to a specialist. Here's a bill for $2500. Wait here for a couple of hours while we find a doctor to sign your discharge papers.'
The only Emergency Department that is worse is McCall Hospital. Oh yeah. That is St Luke's, too.
The cafeteria just adds insult to the long delays in the Emergency Dept. The food is lousy and grossly over priced.
Drive a few miles down I84 to the new Emergency Department at the Garrity St Al's Hospital.

Great Massage!  I have been to almost everywhere in town and this was definately in my top pics for massage.  Love that they are open 7 days a week and late hours as well.  Not sure what the other reviewer was so uptight about, tables were great, had a hole for your face and actually softer than any I have been on before.  Very friendly staff, glad to welcome them to my neighborhood as my go to massage parlor!  Loved it!

Visited this gym yesterday... the GM (Preston) was the first person I encountered when I walked in. You could tell he was very busy but dropped everything to show me around. The gym has everything you need including a nice functional zone near the weight room so I could get my entire workout done without having to transition all over the place. Pretty clean too!

Sorry not the place for me and my family.  Food is decent, attitude of the folks working there is bad.  I am not a fan of the attitude that they are doing you a favor by giving you a glass of water.  The place is nice, the food is good (not great but could be) but just the snarky, you're bothering me attitude kills it.  Lose the attitude, quit acting like people are bothering you, maybe you can turn it around

Ok we ordered here 4 the 1st time ever and were very excited 2 enjoy the 4 lamb gyros we ordered. We ordered 2 with no tomato due 2 an allergy. Unfortunately, tomato was put on all 4, so 1 of our guests could not eat. He's allergic to tomatoes. The others were great, but we had 2 order elsewhere for our no tomato guest. I called the following morning, and everything was sorted out. The staff was amazing, and everything was taken care of. The manager gave me a credit for the two sandwiches that were made incorrectly.
Good vibes, great beer, friendly service, and trivia night. I'm from WA and it was fun to have an evening out where it didn't feel like the world was dealing with a pandemic.
The house is only one year old and all of the issues I addressed were submitted. Check your records and stop trying to minimize the issues with these homes.

My wife and I tried to have drinks before our movie today. We spent at least 10 minutes at the bar with no staff members checking on us or even acknowledging that we existed.  It wasn't busy so there was no reason they couldn't have taken our drink order or even said "hey I know you are here and I will be with you soon."  We walked right out and went over Yard House and had great service. I don't recommend going to Twigs Bistro.

Guys. First: Do you like milk tea with boba? Please check this place--it's legit. They brew their tea (no powders for the milk tea) and the boba is just the right consistency. Two thumbs way up!

Second, the food? Yum!! We've tried the sandwiches, fries, chicken strips, and noodle soup (their version of pho) and it's all so good.

The sandwiches are served on a laminated dough (think croissant dough or puff pastry ) that's been cooked in a waffle iron. It's really tasty but a bit messy (like, don't try to chow it in your car on the way somewhere because you'll get it all over yourself). The meat is quality and tasty. The French fries are good and so are the chicken strips (just standard frozen then fried fare but it's always fresh and cooked well). 

But, I'm really sold on their version of pho. It's a slow cooked beef and pork bone broth base (so, so savory and tasty) and then you get to choose your meat (I like the thinly sliced tri-tip) and then they add rice noodles, spinach, and green onions. I think it's delicious and I'll keep going back to get it.

Last, but not least, the owner, Tony, is such a nice and friendly guy! He'll chat with you and get to know you a bit. When we were in last, we had our three year old son and Tony went in the back to make him a smoothie special when he saw he was with us.

Give this place a try! You won't be sorry! Spend your money here instead of at a chain restaurant down the road and keep this great place in business.

First time coming here with my husband.  This place is really nice. 

They run tight ship here and that's probably what makes this a nice shooting range. 

We will definitely be coming back here quite frequently as it's close to our new home.
This is the best Dairy Queen I've been to! It's clean, the employees are nice, and the food was good. They even bring your food to the table. There is a drive thru, and tables outside as well.

We just bought CBH home in Caldwell at Delaware Park and love it! The process was easy even with us moving from out of state. Jordan G. with CBH helps us and our realtor navigate the home buy which was pretty painless for us. Even though we are first time home buyers. The Home Owner orientation was quick and very informative. I was glad I got the low-down on the AC unit, water heater, water shut off, all the nitty-gritty technical stuff that needs maintenance and care over time. Dan H. led us through this and was great.

Pineapple Express, latest venture by owner of Kanack Attack food truck (or perhaps trucks plural - there may be two now) and catering, is order at counter and take away or eat-in sit down restaurant.  People working the counter are very nice. Thought went into the interior.  But for us eating here was a disappointing experience and we won't go back.

FOOD:  For first time here we stuck with the usual suspects for comparison to past meals at other Hawaiian food places; Kahlua pork, coconut rice and mac salad.  One of the things I most like in Hawaiian-food joints is that mac salad is often potato-mac blend and while that was on the menu here the guy behind the counter told me it was only available to catering customers and not in the eatery.  OK -  but take it off the posted restaurant menu.  Still, the plain mac salad turned out to be the best part of the meal.  Even if bland in flavor it was well chilled and the pasta was not overcooked or overdressed.  

As for the rest, coconut rice was unremarkable and Kahlua pork was, this is not exaggeration, at least 30% flaccid pork skin and flabby fat mixed in with too dry and very salty meat.  If flaccid skin and flabby fat is considered a delicacy addition to a customer's Kahlua pork plate, it is new to me to have it served that way.

We also ordered elote (spicy corn) salad as a side and it revealed another of my pet peeves - the people facing the customers don't know what is in the dishes.  I asked the nice woman behind the counter if the elote was made with fresh or frozen corn. The query drew a surprised "I have no idea" response at first.  But she works there so she should know and I trusted that she did when she then said, "I'm sure it's fresh.  There are only fresh things in our kitchen."  So elote ordered; pretty good flavors and nicely chilled but decidedly not starting with fresh corn.

Two of us were sharing one plate and side but we tossed out more than half of the meal because it was, in the vernacular of a good friend, "bad calories".  Which doesn't mean inedible necessarily (though the flaccid pork skin and flabby fat was that) but not worth investing calories to eat it.  Is this the way Pineapple Express food is supposed to be or did we catch them on a bad day?  I don't know.  

Total for eats, no beverages, was just under $14.

THE DRILL:  Walk through the seating area to the order counter at the back.  Veer right and you'll work left as your order is fulfilled to get to the register where you pay.

A big menu is posted overhead with paper version at the counter.  The paper version had a few things lined out, permanently removed from the menu, but they still appeared above.

Order counter, with hot food in trays cafeteria set up style behind it, has a high "food shield" atop making it tough to hear and be heard by the folks behind it if they are short, as was the staff here when we visited, and you are short too, as is true with me at 5'4".  Your food choices are heaped in more than ample portion onto the plate (I intuit this heaping plate is a Hawaiian-mix-plate signature) and waiting for you when you reach the payment register.

This may explain why we found the food here less good for our palates than other "from the kitchen" Hawaiian-mix-plate eateries we've visited.  In my experience, steam table food doesn't hold up well for anything.

Plates are disposable and bamboo looking, a good fit with the theme, the serving utensils of spoon, knife fork were an awkward to use but likely environmentally friendly material that seemed nearly wooden. 

VIBE:  The door in from the parking lot has you enter into a vestibule with a Hawaiian totem standing at greeting.  I appreciated the tables were all standard height and well spread out to avoid sardine can seating.  But a flaw in the set up is the bus your own here because it is just true that some people are sloppy eaters, especially when rice is piled on small plates, and some of the tables were strewn with rice, some of which seems to have permanently settled in the grooves on the tables.  Grooved tables may not have been the wisest choice for that reason.  But grooved or not, it would be wise for them to keep tables  wiped up during the day.  Still, it was a pleasant enough space and I enjoyed the sort of Island karoke mix of music in covers of artists like John Legend, Sia and Adele.

ACCESSIBILITY:  Once inside the space is all on one level.  Standard height seating.  However order counter and service counter heights both exceed the ADA and Idaho Building Access Code maximums. ADA is law that is 28 years old. This is a new space.  Zero excuse for non compliance.

LOCATION AND PARKING:  In one of Meridian's many awkwardly laid out strip malls.  A Jimmy John's next door.  Sho Ramen far across. Two accessible, AKA ADA, parking spaces but mall owner ignored requirement to cut curb from parking to sidewalk, using non-compliant asphalt ramp with safety issues.
I highly recommend going to epic car wash. I have taken my truck their twice now and really enjoy the set up they have, very clean and well maintained.

I came in to get an oil change and upon finishing the service they told me my car would pretty much shut off when I drove away and stop working so I needed all of these things done to it. I don't know if they thought I was an idiot because I was by myself with my daughter. After hearing this I brought my car to a close family friend who has worked on cars for 30 years. He told me everything they said was completely incorrect and just a way to get money out of you. I would 100% not recommend coming here. Unless you want to try to be manipulated into getting unnecessary work done on your vehicle. Not very "Christian" of you guys.

We were waiting for a table at the breakfast place across the lot and decided to get coffees here.  They were pretty good.  But the Lemon Ginger scone!!! So glad we stopped by here, I'll have to take my pastry chef sister here next time she visits.  It was legit the best scone I've ever had and I love a good lemon scone.

This is a huge shout out to Whitney Bareither, from the warranty team. She  is amazing! She took the "bull by the horns" so to speak to create a work order for an excellent landscaper to mitigate an issue we have been dealing with for weeks. Her "can do attitude" and her willingness to go the extra mile enables us to know we will be taken care of in the event another situation arises. Keep it up Whitney!!

Rob L

Then the wheels came off , in 3 hrs of dining our table got 1 refill of water and soda and the alcohol we had to ask . Food to the table was slow and no communication on what was taking so long . IT'S ALL IN A NAME!

Going to start with a 1 for now until I can see what kind of follow-thru their business has and will update at that point. 

Went into Epic Shine just 30mins ago while out running errands. Place was extremely busy as expected with the state of things currently. They are NOT enforcing social distancing or masks in their waiting area!! We were waiting for a table and tons of people walked in without masks and some even sat right next to us and our children in the waiting area. We left before they sat us because of this. They have a sign saying masks are required but they definitely aren't even saying anything to their customers who aren't wearing them in the common spaces, which was at least 40% or 10 individuals from various different parties when we were there. Sorry, those types run rampant lol. This guy was total opposite and he needs to be recognized for being a super nice guy and extremely accommodating. So thank you whomever you are. The parts I saw of this gym were nice. I think if I lived in Meridian that Crunch would probably be a gym a workout at. I have a membership at IFF that I won, so I'd utilize them too lol.

Thank you, Crunch for hosting us Pound Pros for the weekend. Was a great spot for it. I'd definitely recommend this gym to anyone who lives over there. I'm in NW Boise soooo yeah lol. My regular gym, Fitness Lab is literally 2 mins from my house, so I love that lol. How's that for a bit of info that wasn't necessary lol.
I just want people to know Crunch Meridian is a nice gym with great people and if we was closer I'd join....the poooool!! 

Thanks for reading YelperPros! 

Cheers!

Worst  experience at a restaurant in a very long time. I have been here twice now, hoping the first time was just busy and rough, (went second night they were opened). The two managers were throwing things around the bar, walking around making rude gestures and one of the managers was even cursing, like he was hanging with friends. 

Once we finally got our brunch, 15 mins after our apps,  a full hour had passed. I ordered hamburger sliders. The buns on my sliders were hard and very stale. The way the managers are running your restaurant will surely run the place into the ground. It is very clear to see why this was the only place with out a wait in the new Meridian Village shopping area and I hope this complaint helps raise some red flags.

SAVE YOUR MONEY AND GO TO TWIGS OR YARD HOUSE!!!! 

Sincerely, 

Concerned customer.

Friendly people. Modern facility, knowledgeable and helpful staff. The offer a number of courses that would be beneficial for shooters of all skill sets.

Here's the food scoop...  the pancakes are large ,  plate sized,  the coffee is strong, the eggs are made to order though a little greasy, the bacon was also cooked to order.. but the hash browns were under done.  They could have used at least another 2 minutes.  

The staff, really friendly and obviously doing their best.  My server was super quick to bring more coffee when asked.  He also helped me to choose a good meal for myself based upon what I told him I was looking for.  The menu is a bit daunting at first go.

Other than the front door being too far away from parking for my disabled arse, I was thoroughly satisfied.
why would you change the margarita flatbread the new one is yucky and my parmesan cheese was chewy like rubber

My friend & I decided to make a late night adventure to Shari's to escape our children. I had never been here before. I didn't have high expectations from what I appeared to be a 24 hour Denny's look alike.  However, I was pleasantly surprised.  
When we walked in, we were warmly greeted by a woman who showed us to our seats & promptly brought us water. This same woman would end up being our waitress.  She was friendly & attentive. She also gave me plenty of time to look over the menu to decide what I wanted to eat.  I decided on a breakfast plate that included 2 eggs, bacon or sausage, hash browns, & toast   My friend ordered a side salad.  I am a pain in the ass about my eggs. I like them scrambled hard, but I don't want them brown & over cooked. I like them to not have any sliminess. Most often I get over cooked eggs & just eat them. 
After a very short time, our waitress appeared at our table with our food. I was quite impressed by the speed. Then she sat my plate down in front of me......the heavens opened up....my eggs were PERFECTLY cooked! I almost cried! The eggs tasted great. The rest of my food was good as well, but nothing could impress me more than my eggs. 
I brought home some pie for myself & my husband. I can't wait to try it!

Today was my first time at JM. I have a bunch of family now living in the area (all So. Cal transplants) and they love eating there and told me to try it on my way to the airport this morning (returning to LA). 

I ordered the Joe Bennie and the bacon bloody. Both were GREAT.  This was the best and most perfectly cooked poached egg I've ever had in my life.  The ham was very flavorful and complemented the egg so well.  The hollandaise was perfect with that welcome hint of lemon finish.  I'm in and out of town all the time and I'll be back alone and with my family.

I ate in the bar area, and the server was excellent and very professional, courteous, personable, fun and pretty.  Thanks guys!
Damian is a gem. He took the time to answer any questions on the menu. We got the chicken fried steak and bennies. Ohhh my goodness...AMAZING!

I got a pound of wings for $15. They were a bit charred and dry, but at least not the frozen junk at a lot of places. No bargain when considering price per wing. No complaints about service. It was up to par.
Best chef in town.. So glad to be a member of such an outstanding country club..

I really like the idea of this place.. the outdoor kind of mall concept seems to be the current trend.. the only problem is this place is a little confusing to get in and around and some people don't know that there is an interior part of the village which imo is the best part. Hopefully over the next couple years they will tweak everything and make this place amazing

I normally love Black Rock, I haven't physically been since March (DoorDash) I ran over tonight and got in line to grab some coffee, hung out in line for 10 minutes while the gal working there talked to the car in front of me who was not ordering drinks, which is fine seeing friends is always nice right? Mark Enger has been great to work with for warranty repairs.  He is very knowledgeable and professional.  We really appreciate the time and attention he has given us and our home.  He is an asset to CBH!

We were excited to see the changes that we thought were going to happen when Crunch Fitness took over IAC, but sad to see that since Crunch took over that at least 6 water exercise classes have been cancelled since the beginning of the year.  We've been told by management they either can't find instructors or class sizes are too small. The latest cancellation that appears to be coming is a class that the instructor left, and now 3 weeks later they say they can't find a replacement. This class consistently had 15 to 20 people each week.  Front desk staff keeps telling us there are other classes we can take, but for some people, especially seniors, exercising in water is less damaging to their body. It's beginning to feel like the gym is trying to cater more to a different kind of fitness group.

Bring me back to the islands!!!

Did I mention this place is amazing?!  Well, this is one place you must not miss checking out if you are into some island flare type food.  I had to check this place out.  To my surprise, this place did not disappoint.  We came here over 4 times now and all throughout, my experiences has been consistent.  Great food, awesome service and excellent drinks!

Beautiful ambiance, awesome servers and excellent food and  drinks!

You can get lucky getting a table if it isn't during prime hours for dinner or happy hour.  If you really want a confirmed table, my recommendation is to call and make a reservation.  Oh, don't forget to join their Konavore Rewards, you get perks on your bday as well as great deals sent.  

Dishes we ordered:

Sake Flight- Yummy!  A perfect match for sushi!

Shrimp Tempura appetizer - perfect munchie while sipping on some cocktails   or sake before your meal comes

Miso Sake Chilean Sea Bass - tender and very flavorful fish with yummy fried rice.  This is like - Take me back to the islands!

Surf and Turf - Big Island Ribeye with kona poke roll - yummy tender beef, french beans cooked prefectly.  Plus, we were able to choose the sushi roll here and it is perfect!  Just the right amount of rice for the roll and is topped off with tuna poke. YUM!  Always a winner!

Pad Thai (Shrimp) - this is as close as authentic can be.  A good amount of tamarind and sweetness.  The noodles are not mushy, just perfect! Sorry, no pic for this as we literally inhales it and I forgot to take a pic...oops.

Kids bento box - edamame and grilled salmon with rice (so many choices for the kids bento.  

This place is always a favorite spot for me.   Consistency throughout even when they are busy, the manager will see to it that you are taken cared of.  Kudos to the whole team.  I am very impressed!

My husband will only eat bbq from here. We went the other night for a quick bite to eat. My husband had a pulled pork burger with fries. Burger sizable. Hubs said very tasty. I had a brisket melt with potato salad. Their potato salad is super yummy - you can taste every ingredient. Clean and refreshing. For dessert my husband had bread pudding with a caramel bourbon sauce. I had a chocolate cream pie. Both were delicious. Great atmosphere and price.

We love this place! My husband and I have a membership here and go quite often.  

I recently took a women's basic pistol class to help me get more familiar with my pistol.  We had one instructor + 5 class assistants. It was a fantastic 4hr class.   We had classroom time, instructor time and range time. So not only did we learn about the rules and guidelines if working with any weapon, but also got to out what we learned to use in the range. 

Outside of the class when my husband and I go, we always have a great experience.  There is a range "patrol" in each range and they are very knowledgeable.  I've had my gun jam and I've put it down got the range guard, and they've always been able to help me and give advice.  I really really appreciate that. 

The range itself is top of the line, state of the art, and the best in Idaho.  The ventilation system is so state of the art, other places from all over the country come to see it and learn how to do the same at theirs.  It is a very well planned out state of the art facility.

These guys are great. The only reason I didn't give then a 5 is because they are a small so they have a limited inventory, it's not terrible, just a bit small.  I stopped by to see if they had anything I just had to have, they did. I ended up talking to them for quite awhile bouncing some ideas about weird issues I had been having with one of my bikes. He gave me some ideas on things to try and a few things to check I had not done yet. 

Nice to have someone talk with you other than just asking you to put your PIN in. I will add them to my list of bike places I go to get my stuff.
These guys must have went out of business or don't want your business. Never returned my phone call to setup an appointment, nor answer their phones.

I came in to shoot my 357 on a Friday afternoon.   The initial interaction was good.  Then the staff accused me of being unsafe. I stayed for less than a half hour and left. The manager was not nice at all. I think they were unhappy that I brought my own gun and ammo. I'm guilty of not spending more.  It's a shame, pretty building ugly attitudes.

The least value of any restaurant we've been to in Boise... (only been here for 5 months) Who would pay (or charge)  $11 for a bowl of miso?! And no,  there are no gold flakes or black truffles in it. (Obviously didn't order it) $12 for a 2 piece order of nigiri. $21 for a rainbow roll,  lol.

Have you ever paid $17 for a 5 piece sushi roll? And not a regular sized roll  cut into 5 pieces,  just 5 regular sized pieces,  and no explanation of that on the menu. (Unfortunately did order it) 

Ambiance was nice, I can't knock the normal quality of the sushi,  and the service was less than ok,  just make sure to come during happy hour to get decent bang for your buck. 

The Jalapeño Yellowtail sashimi was excellent.

I work at a restaurant that costs more than here,  but I would be embarrassed to serve here based off our experience.

Jacuzzi suite seeker. 
Thought Id give this location a try. I still prefer the mall location. The AC unit in the room sounded like a Harley Davidson was starting up each time it kicked on. Breakfast was so so. Pretty noisy. Pool area stunk something horrible. They are pet friendly so that's a plus.

The company did reach out, and I always appreciate that.  I didn't take them up on that due to a hardline rule of what you experienced in the beginning is usually what you will experience in the end.  But to be fair, they are attempting damage control and I wanted to note that for anyone looking into this company.

Sooo the two little teenagers working in the restaurant had the place already shut down at 750 pm on Sunday- we pulled up and asked to order and they informed us that they were closed already because they "close at 8 on Sundays" and refused to cook us anything. It's more annoying than anything because they should have been open. There was also someone in front of us and behind us in line who they turned down. I'm sure their manager would be happy ;)
Delicious food, delightful service and attentive staff!! Highly recommend. They have a great assortment of breakfast foods, from savory to sweet!!

Real garbage. If you're thinking about CBH you'll need: 1: a sound understanding of building codes 2: an hour each day to make sure build superintendents are actually supervising work 3: a home inspector on standby 4: a degree in landscape design and 5: a lawyer on retainer.
You cannot trust what they say and what you've agreed upon. I've been fighting them for almost a year.

Every time I eat here I am more impressed than the time before. Our party of 5 was seated promptly and in an area big enough for us all. I did not catch our waitresses name but she was friendly and helpful with clarifying any questions we had about the menu. Our food came quickly after ordering. I had the stuffed blueberry French toast and it was absolutely delicious- I highly recommend it if you're having a bit of a sweet tooth. The prices were reasonably and you were served with plenty of food. Overall, a great atmosphere, filled with friendly staff and great food.

I bought my first gun over the weekend! Earlier this year I took a gun safety class, "first shots", where they go over some gun safety and get your feet wet. 
This past weekend I decided it was time to purchase my first gun. I told Shane that I was looking to buy and he was helpful, he shared his passion, walked me through the process, took time with me, presented different guns to me depending on my feedback after shooting them. 
I took my time making the decision and Shane took the time to be sure it was a good first gun for me as well. The rest of the staff were friendly as well and would chime in on other ideas as well. They aren't there to belittle but truly want to educate you.
If you buy a gun, highly recommend renting and shooting a few of them before buying. Don't rush the process, be smart and safe about it.
I'd recommend this place to anyone looking to explore, learn, buy, and/or shoot. I'll be back for sure!

I was lucky enough to get stranded near this automotive place. Perry was so kind to get me in and take care of my car. The communication from them was on point and they genuinely care about getting you in and out. Perry was the best! Thank you for getting my car fixed in a timely manner. I will be back!

Fun atmosphere, lots of games. First bartender we had was beyond rude, completely inconvenienced by the fact that we asked for beer recommendations and sat at the bar. As a former bartender, this is part of the gig. When she left, her replacement was better. Beer was decent, not great.

OMG! Best Philly steaks ever. We have guests from out of state and they have requested them for a second time this week. I like it because I am allergic to beef so to get a chicken cheesesteak is great. They are delicious and I like the bread rolls that they use. The kids that work there seem to work really hard and I think they are struggling to find enough staff. This one is a keeper for us.

Great breakfast!!! Well established restaurant with a wonderful menu!!!
Plan on returning soon!!
Very clean, nice, and great service.  I had a pedicure and a gel full. Kelli did my pedicure and it was amazing, I can't remember the name of the lady who did my fill but she did a good job.

I've been overcharged twice now and I have only been going there TWO months. My first charge was the day I went in and signed up and I got everything sorted out and the first charge was fine. Second charge was an over charge by $10 which isn't a big deal but I still called and was asking what the extra $10 was for? The girl on the phone told me it was tax. This month rolls around and my third charge came through, $51 dollars over my monthly charge I'm suppose to be getting. Happy hour! Burger sliders, portabella mushroom pizza, dragon roll, voodoo roll and a surprise creme brulee because the waiter noticed my birthday was this week. One of the best experiences I have had because the food is reasonable and the surprise dessert made me feel really special. Thanks Kona!!

Me and my family wanted something new, so we tried this place out.

What a mistake. A woman who was there before us was complaining about waiting an hour for a pizza(a staff member also commented that she had been there for over an hour). The woman taking the order said "I don't work here, I'm just the help". That should have been a clue right there.

So we order - the woman mis-rang my order of a combo beef and sausage(the thin cut beef and italian sausage) for a combo meatball and sausage. It was....decent. The bread was overly dry though. My wife chicken club was two chicken fingers, and no bacon(even though it was advertised with bacon).

The wait to actually get our food was ridiculous. An hour, at 7:30. No excuse there, frankly. 

The best part was the soda(which is serve yourself) and the kids' pizza. Never going back, I will spend my money somewhere better. Like McDonald's.
gross food waited over an hour for it to be cold & the mimosas taste like cheap champagne

Their staff is giving the chicken sandwich place a run for their money in politeness and engaging with customers and the food is fantastic.  Kena said the BLT was perfect and the Bruchi Burger excellent
I love going into Athleta! The staff or always friendly  and  very helpful. The clothing is high quality and there are a B corp company which makes it even better!

I've only had their appetizers, drinks, and desserts so I can't comment on the entrees, but so far I've loved everything I've ordered. The calamari, flatbread, oysters, giant cookie with icecream, creme brûlée, and mojito were all delicious. My husband enjoyed their unique drink options. I can't remember exactly what he had, but it came to the table in a container infused with smoke. I definitely recommend Twig's. We had an early dinner at 4:30pm on a Saturday and there was no wait and the service was great.
Delicious breakfast/ brunch spot. My husband can get breakfast and I can get lunch items that are good and make us both happy.

This clinic is in desperate need of new procedures.  The check-in process and length of waiting is ridiculous.  My elderly dog shaking, heart rate and panting just to get blood work completed I am sure decreased his lifespan. In 2 separate times in the last 2 weeks I have had wait times of over 3 hours in the parking lot. I love Dr. Vogel, that is why I come back. I will sadly be changing, my dogs heart can not handle the wait times any longer.
So delicious. Lots of variety and it's all so good!!  We will definitely be back many times. The service can't be beat as well.

Played there today June 25. Front nine played at about an hour and 45 minutes. Good pace with no delays in play. Arriving at the 10th hole without a club house visit we found ourselves fourth to tee off. Where did these groups come from that didn't impact our front nine play?  It's like the pro shop sent groups off 10 that didn't play the front. This continued backup continued the full back nine. Poor course management without a ranger to manage play. May never go back

$20/month for unlimited wash, dry, and vacuum. Have had this service for as long as they're in business, before they changed their name. Never had problem with the service. The people are always nice, professional, and helpful. They have to stand outside in the cold/hot but always smiles. The machines do their jobs well, my car comes out clean each time. Then finish with vacuuming, great vacuum pressure, sometimes when I am not careful, I accidentally 'give away' stuff to the vacuum hose. It does its job very well. Overall, I am a happy customer and will continue the biz for more years to come.
Big Daddys barbecue was absolutely delicious one of the best barbecue places I've tried make sure to get the bacon mac & cheese and the fried pickles are a must have
Great breakfast place lots to choose from on their menu. We all were very pleased including the kids. We will be back!

Stopped in yesterday for lunch, and for my birthday meal, and could not believe how delicious everything was! We started with the Motherlode app which had the Brie bites, garlic fries, spinach artichoke dip, and mozzarella sticks-all SO good! Then I ordered the teriyaki chicken fettuccini and we also ordered a personal pizza with sausage, garlic, and black olives on it. They also had the option of soda water with huckleberry syrup so we had one of those too. The food was so, so good and I think it's really great that they give a meal for your birthday. Can't wait to get back to check out more of the menu!

I love coming to the Village. It takes me back to the upscale malls I grew up around, and it is so unexpected for Boise! 

There is a movie theater, tons of restaurant options, and some specialty stores. The outside fountain was designed by the same guy who did the fountains at the Bellagio in Vegas, so yeah, it's incredible. In the winter, it freezes over and they actually turn it into an ice skating rink! The fountain is surrounded by artificial grass, and there is oversized lawn furniture everywhere in the summer. It creates such a comfortable atmosphere that it's hard to leave. 

Great parking, and tons to see and do.

Great idea for family/outside food friendly establishment considering this location is in the middle of Meridian suburbs and not downtown Boise. Not going to be a completely quiet all adult bar but it wasn't designed to be. Good beer and openly supportive of first responders, what more do you need?

The menu change was horrible. Staff were a little annoyed for us even asking about it or for side options. Want something very basic or a slice of pie? Come here.  Sad to lose one of our favorite places for a family night .
Never had a CPAP before. They were professional and very courteous. I would recommend them to family members that have sleep apnea.

Not gonna lie, this place is usually jammin' busy. Great food- servers are kind, friendly and professional. My favorite is Angela! My daughter and I showed up one Sunday at 1:30pm ( they close @2) and it was disappointing to be turned away- they did seat us when I asked kindly and sort of insisted. Posted hours should be adhered to but i also understand every place is understaffed- so they wouldn't have lost me from returning again. Very highly recommend!

Just stop in, you will not be disappointed. The two dishes I have had so far, one of the rice bowls and the rice noodle soup were outstanding.  They were both super fresh and well seasoned. The menu items are priced reasonably and the people behind the counter take pride in what is served....

Updated... just used their public restroom on the 3rd visit. The lack  of cleanliness took all desire away to ever return. Am amazed what the owner allows such a disgrace. What a shame.

Don't waste your time. If you are standing at their door step with a sick pet they will refuse to see you and suggest that you "may want to" try West Vet. Follow their own recommendations and don't waste what could be precious time for your pet and just go to West Vet like their staff recommends to you. Their staff will tell you to go elsewhere as you are standing in front of their doors talking to them on the phone with you sick pet watching the staff just walk around without a worry in the world. 

My dog was having an allergic reaction to something, her entire face and nose were swollen and she was starting to have a hard time breathing when they turned us away, over the phone, while standing at their front door. 

All Valley Animal Care Center should not claim to be an emergency vet clinic if they cannot help pets that are having an emergency.
Hailey did my nails and I'm obsessed with how they came out! I highly recommend people to go here. Everyone has a great attitude and I love how they care for their clients:)

I come to Paddles Up Poke often, but I might have to start looking elsewhere. I always get the same XL Bogus Basin bowl, but the toppings that used to be liberal have been pretty much non-existent. When I came home this last time I had to add more sauce to give it somewhat flavor. Any other place that I go to adds a good amount of toppings which adds to the flavor and texture. I am not sure if it's a training thing since I never encountered this in Boise. I'll update my review if it improves any, for now... I'll visit some other poke places in the area.
Very crowded but they were able to seat us in the patio. The food was so good & great service! The restaurant is so beautiful...a must see!

I have had a few MRI's and X-Ray's done here and I highly recommend Intermountain Medical Imaging. They have a couple locations in the Treasure Valley which is super handy. 

It is very easy to get an appointment. Usually with the hospital systems here you have to wait awhile for the scheduling department to call you then it might be a few weeks before you can get in. Not at IMI! I have literally been offered appointments the next day every single time. 

Let's talk about the wait time...there is none! I don't think I've waited more than two minutes in their waiting room. They always get me back very quickly and do their best to get the imaging done fast and painlessly. 

The staff here are also nothing but kind. Each staff member I have encountered are always cheery and personable. I have experienced very compassionate employees from the front desk to the radiology techs. 

Plus IMI is WAY cheaper than the hospital systems here in Boise. Skip getting your images done at St. Luke's or St. Al's. Have your doctor send orders here and you won't be sorry.

15 months with our house and it just feels like a money pit. CBH put the smallest concrete pad in our back yard. So we paid to get it extended 15 more feet, which then resulted in us needing to fix the POS gutters that CBH just puts along the house over the 10 foot pad. So we paid to get gutters along the entire back roof of the house, along the back of our 3rd car garage that had no gutters at all and along the 2nd story roof that also had no gutters. It seems like CBH just does the minimum with everything. Now what a surprise we dont have flooding issues when it rains hard.

My past experiences with box gyms have not been positive ones. Especially when it comes time to part ways. Some big box gyms will milk every last penny out of you by slow rolling requests to cancel or just being difficult in general. Things turn ugly quickly.

That was NOT my experience with Crunch Fitness - Meridian. The General Manager was incredible to work with -- he listened, was understanding of my personal situation, and worked with me. Although I was ending my membership, he was extremely professional, positive, and provided a level of customer service that I have not seen at any other gym (big or small). 

If you've been burned by box gyms in the past and are reluctant to get involved with another one, I highly recommend giving these guys a chance. While there is a "corporate" side to the gym, the corporate office seems to allow the local gyms to operate with some latitude and focus on managing healthy relationships with members and the community at large.

As a member, I truly enjoyed my time at Crunch Fitness. The gym has a ton of offerings at a pretty awesome rate. The facility is not as spacious as some, but I never had an issue in being able to make use of the equipment or the facilities -- even at peak hours. 

The staff were always ready and willing to help with anything I needed, the equipment and facilities were clean, and they have tons of options when it comes to classes.

If you are at all like me and have a long history of bad experiences with gyms, or you are just on the fence about joining another box gym, I recommend taking a chance on these guys. I don't think you'll be disappointed.
Delicious food with tons of vegetarian options! Great ambience, great service! Enjoyed the happy hour till closing time. Must go when in Boise.

It was not bad, the place is clean so that is good. But not a fan that they leave the door open during the massage so people walking by the door can look in the room if they wanted to. I also think they should have table showers for many people that is the thing that puts it over the top in terms of good. The girls need to act as they care about the client as a person as well. I am not saying do not go there I am saying simply put it is not a great massage overall. Not worth the $60 cost, you pay $60 but feel like you are getting a $40 massage.

Literally best massage I've ever had. Sunny the owner took me in on the same day I called. She took her time and hit every sore point. Made sure I was comfortable and afterwards, served me tea! I mean what a treat! You must try this place.

This review is for the store and for the company in general. My service got interrupted, I know my fault, I took care of it right away. I called the customer service number around 12:40 on 01/13/2017 and a girl answered. I asked her if my TV and internet would be in when I arrived home later that evening. She told me yes but was going to call DIRECTV to be sure. I ended up getting hung up on and lost time on my lunch hour to call back. I got home at 7:00 that evening to find out that the services still weren't on. I called DIRECTV and they told me that CenturyLink would have to contact them since they were bundled. I hung up and called the next day, CenturyLink customer service was not there, so I called the store. The guy hung up on me, I called back TWICE and they wouldn't answer. After pulling my hair out, my husband calls their technical support for answer. He stayed on hold with them for an hour and a half before HE got hung up on. I attempted to file a complaint online and that wouldn't even work. This company is a pile of crap, their customer service and stores are all crap. They have no idea how to even handle customers or their rapport and that is just plain sad! Stay away from these people at all costs!!!! Seriously!!!!! STAY AWAY!!!!

Just close the transaction with Cbh Homes in the Kuna / South Meridian area.  Samandra and her team were stellar...like always.  I've always been impressed by her team's promptness, friendliness and professionalism.  My clients hired a professional inspector and the inspection was one of the cleanest I've seen in the past 16 years.  Good job Cbh!

Idk if it's a chain thing or just this location but I ordered 3 bowls for the family and everyone thought the poke was fishy. The bowls are big but mostly rice. The toppings didn't look or taste fresh. There's definitely room for improvement

Overall good selection, easy parking, okay prices.

Where they are loosing stars is due to their customer service. When purchasing a coffee table and tray from a sales associate named Kim she got very curt and snippy.

We will be making all our future purchases at RC Wiley, where they value their customers. And discount floor models and damaged furniture without an attitude.

So Big Daddy's has moved.  Still a drive but waaaaay worth it.  It has become a sit down dining experience.   Same great food, same awesome prices.  They now have draft beer and wine at their new bar.   Big tv's to watch games if you want.  A def upgrade, however the food is so good I don't know how they would upgrade that.  Real southern BBQ recipes.

Always fair and reasonable. Get regular service on my E and the wifes ML. Never felt I was being taken advantage of. 
Quick, to the point, prices reasonable. You get the sense they actually want to treat you like a lifetime customer.

It would be nice if the people in the kitchen made what the customer ordered. At least 80% of the time, the salad my wife orders is prepared wrong. She hates feta cheese and substitutes Parmesan instead. Most of the time the cheese is wrong, or it's missing some other ingredient. It's a great way to ruin a meal.

In town visiting and came here with a family member for a small bite to eat and some drinks. Cilantro is my fave ingredient in the whole world so naturally I had to try the Serrano cilantro margatini. It was DIVINE! I had two. We also had the bruschetta flatbread and I am so glad we did. Amazing! I will definitely be back next time I'm in town!

I absolutely love your food! Only suggestion would be a sign telling us where to stand for pick up orders. I went in and waited in line so the workers didn't know I wanted pick up. Then another customer told me, "You need to stand over there or they don't know you aren't waiting in line." That's fine and all but how was I supposed to know.
This was some of the best poke I've ever had! Everything about the establishment was clean, organized and delicious! 10/10 recommend

I have attempted to eat here multiple times, but every time they were closed.  My 1st try was on their opening weekend and they ran out of bread & several other times they were just closed.  They close pretty early (like before 9pm, even on weekends). Finally, I had the opportunity to give them a try this past week.  My family ordered the following:

Bacon Cheddar Cheesesteak (Large)
No onions
Original Cheesesteak (regular)
No onions or peppers
Hamburger
Kids meal with a turkey & provolone 
With mayo, mustard, & dressing
Lettuce, tomato, onion, & pickle. 
Large French fries 

So, here's the positives.  The store was very clean.  The employees were very nice and it didn't take long to actually get my food.  They weren't crowded when I arrived. It seemed like they were making my food fresh, but.....more on that later.  Anyhow, they also had a decent selection of condiments to take home with the food. 

The not so good (Bad isn't the right word)
The prices are high for what you get.  When paying $10 for a sandwich I kinda expect to get more than I got.  The sandwiches did not have much in the way of steak or cheese.  I would estimate my large sandwich had around 1/2 cup of meat and 1 piece of cheese that had been cut in half.  The regular Cheesesteak had about a 1/4 cup of meat.  The meat was VERY CHOPPED and didn't have much texture left, except for pieces of fat.  The cheese was also lacking.  They don't use any sort of cheese sauce so the sandwich seemed a bit dry.  The meat to bread ratio definitely was mostly bread.  The cheese wasn't quite melted, it was in that in between state where it wants to melt but it just ended up coagulated.  The "large" crinkle cut fries were a bit small for the price & were not hot.  The burger was not worth $5! The burger was the only item that was served hot. I believe that is probably what they were cooking. It was a thin patty with standard veggies & sauce.  The sandwich for the kids meal was a decent size.  It was actually heavier than the $10 Cheesesteak sandwich! The only negative on it was they forgot to add the mayo, mustard, & dressing, so it was a bit dry.  
I really wanted to love the food here.  I don't know if I will actually come back unless there is some sort of coupon or special.   I spent just under $40.  If the food had been worth it, I would never complain about price, but it just wasn't worth the money.

We have had work done at Meridian Automotive 3 times. Why we keep going back I have no idea. The work they do is fine, but they are very very expensive.

One bill was over $1400
The next bill was $400

On the most recent, we took our expedition here because the window not only would not roll up, but completely fell down into the door. We took our expedition here to find out what could be done.

We told them to do nothing without calling us 1st. They ignored us!

They called and gave us an estimate of over $600 just for the work. We also asked them to look at the handle to the back to find out if they could fix it. Get this, they charged us a diag fee just to look at the handle and tell us it was broken!!!!!

So on top of the actual repair is $200 worth of diagnostic work. Even if we look for someone cheaper, we are over a barrel here because they charge the diag fee weather or not we decide to have them do the work. 

What a rip off!!

My advice is to save yourself and find someone else that can work on your cars and truck reasonably

AWESOME!! I ordered a 7 inch lettuce wrap club sandwich and it was too big for the bag!  I am gluten free and LOVE a place that has great options.  They had forgotten the bacon and gave me a generous supply on the side.  My kids are not gluten free and their sandwiches were also great.  They both report the bread is wonderful too.  The staff is very friendly and they are generous with the fillings.  I love the ordering system because everything can be marked on the bag and I don't have to repeat the order instructions.  The shop offers a wide variety of complementary toppings, including coleslaw and olive salad!  I also love that paper towels are the "napkins", since that works great for my family.  Besides the great food at great prices, my most favorite thing is that they will put house made chips ON the sandwich!  My new favorite sandwich shop.
The customer service is great! The girls are always super sweet and you never have to wait too long for your drink!

My girlfriend and I were at The Village on a Saturday and decided that Kona looked like a nice place to enjoy a few drinks, a bite to eat, and to do some people watching.

I ordered a tall IPA and the Wave Roll to start. When the Wave Roll arrived the first thing i noticed was that it looked very unique for a sushi roll. I always enjoy trying new foods, and sushi in particular.

After eating a couple of pieces my girlfriend pointed out that there was a large black hair nestled inside one of the sushi pieces. Neither of us have black hair.

I called the server over and pointed it out to her. She went back to the kitchen and out comes who I can only assume was the restaurant manager. He was dressed in a suit and had the look and demeanor of a tall Joe Pesci from Goodfellas. No exaggeration at all. Total mafioso looking guy. He offered to have a new roll made. But, his tone and demeanor made it clear that wasn't the preferred option. I'm not sure if he thought we were trying to scam them for a free roll or something. We're not a couple of teenagers out for a hustle.

I told him to forget about it and that it was fine. I wasn't about to risk getting the "special sauce" on the new roll. We paid our tab and then went to Twigs for the rest of our time at The Village. We haven't been back to Kona Grill since.
The pizza was perfect, but don't leave without trying the  Brie kisses. Lovely service! I will definitely come again!

I have been going to Katie at Mane Street for years now. Her prices are great, her talent is amazing, and she has never given me a bad hair cut. All the girls at Mane Street are nice and listen to what you actually want, not what they think you want. Check em out!!!

Went to Kona Grill on Christmas Day.  After making reservations we waited 1 hour for our food.  Prices were very high and food was "ok"!  They were definitely taking advantage of the holiday situation by over booking reservations.  It was wall to wall people.  We won't be back!

Indigo needed sandals and we headed to the Village to shop. I realized she hadn't eaten a real breakfast (a donut and cheez it's kind of counts right? Don't answer that). 

Looking at my Gucci it was about that time, ok I don't actually have a Gucci Timepiece it's just a great line. 

I didn't want to get Indigo junk food and I remembered that Which Wich had PB&Js. 

Ordering: check mark what you want on the paper bag with a red pen and hand it to to the nice people at the counter. Then you wait. And wait. 

Meanwhile, I got water for Indigo and then I proceeded to have a fight with the ice tea machine. 

I pushed the button for unsweetened and out came tea. Then I tried to shut it off and it had other ideas. Tea was everywhere and I finally shut it off while screaming Stop! A little girl was watching this the whole time and suppressed her laughter quite well. 

Finally the sandwich was ready. Indigo ate while I sopped up tea which happened to be sweet so I tossed my drink. 

Besides my sweet tea disaster, the people were nice and the PB& J was quite good (believe me, you can screw it up and it happens more often than you think). 

Indigo gives this place 30 stars for solid PB &J and a kid friendly environment.

I would consider this restaurant middle of the road in terms of overall: service, food, atmosphere. They have several locations, this is the first time I have eaten at this particular location. My review is strictly for this location.

I came here on a Sunday with my hubby and our two kids. We arrived a few minutes before 11am, which is when they open. Our family and another entered at the same time. I commented to my hubby about how, this would probably be a quick lunch since no one was there.

Well.....it seemed to take quite awhile for our food to come out, and when it did my beans were cold. I ordered the carnitas tacos. They were good, but not great. I felt like they were a little bland tasting. The rice was probably the best thing on my plate, which is kind of ironic since I find Mexican rice to be really hit and miss.

 Their chips tasted store bought and kind of stale. A real bummer, because who doesn't love warm, fresh tortilla chips with refried beans and salsa?

Our server was friendly and attentive. The restaurant was clean and modestly decorated.

Overall, not the best place I have been. I would probably considering giving them another try if I happen to be on the area, and maybe try a different food option. But I wouldn't go out of my way to return.

Our place was so clean and perfectly central to all Boise area cities! The beds were amazing, and loved that there was a keyless entry. Would for sure stay here again / would recommend this little townhome for future Boise travelers.

Moving across the country, we were a little intimidated at first to just buy a home. We didn't know anyone or anything about the Boise area. We relocated for my husbands work. Luckily we found Siena Groshong which made the process much easier than we had been anticipating.  It was such a pleasure to work with her. She made the process easy and enjoyable. Siena is very informative, has her clients best interest at heart, and makes herself available for any questions you may have. All questions we had were answered quickly and efficiently. She is professional, organized, has a pleasant personality, and goes above and beyond for her clients. We both are very happy with our first home and couldn't have been more pleased with the service. She put us in the perfect neighborhood after we looked at so many! She saved the best home for last, we fell in love with it and she made it happen! We thank you for the time and effort you spent with us, making our first experience as easy as it was! I definitely recommend Siena to anyone and would not hesitate to use her again for ourselves. Thank you for the outstanding service!
Foos was quick and good... the fried rice didnt have much flavor but tasted alright with the orange chicken.

I rarely get out to Meridian.  I mean, why?  I live a $7.00 cab ride from downtown Boise--why do I need to go to out to Meridian?  The Village in Meridian opened and I was unmoved.  Again, what do I need there that I can't get right here in B-town?  Let me be clear--I'm not a Boise snob...just more a fan of convenience.  I live in the north end...let me get what I can get right here in my hood and the rest be damned, thank you very much.  

Theeeen I heard a martini bar was opening in The Village.  Now...far be it from me to travel beyond a few miles for shopping of any kind.  Really, it's more than I can bear to deal with the traffic.  BUT...a martini bar?  I have been known to travel quite a distance on the promise of a good cocktail.  I've structured entire vacations on the allure of exotic cocktails...so...temptation finally got the better of me and on their second day of operation, off to Twigs I went (hey...I waited a whole day and a half...remarkable restraint, I'd say).

I am so glad I did.  They have a menu that includes a variety of cocktails and then they have their dazzling martini menu featuring 36 signature martinis.  So much to choose from!  I finally decided on their Razitini (vodka, Bols Black Raspberry Liqueur, lime) and my dining companion had their French 75 (Bombay dry, muddled lemon, float of champagne)--both were sensational.  I would have appreciated a healthier pour...but I'm a bit of a greedy lush.  

As good as the cocktails were, however, they are not what will have me trekking to Meridian on a now more regular basis than I'll care to admit.  No.  We can blame that on the Twig Signature Fries with gorgonzola fondue.

Gorgonzola!  Fondue!  My people!

The fries come seasoned with salt, pepper, rice vinegar, a light dusting of cayenne, and fresh chopped basil.  Perfect.  The gorgonzola...well...if gorgonzola is the cheese of the gods (which it is...don't mess with me on this people), then fondue is the perfected presentation of said cheese.  To quote our (quite lovely, attentive, and perfect in every way) server, "the gorgonzola fondue is liquid gold.  I'd like to take it home and put it on everything."  I completely agree.  It is just.  that.  good.

I also enjoyed their pear and roasted beet salad.  I got the half order, which was plentiful.  My dining companion ordered the full, which was huge.  This hearty salad is beautifully fresh and flavorful (and also features gorgonzola crumbles).  The pear vinaigrette is light and lovely.  The pears are fresh and sliced beautifully thin.  And...the final lovely touch is the chilled bowl in which it is served.  This really makes a difference as you get to the bottom and you find the leaves have retained their deliciously fresh and cool crispness. 

Beautifully designed, Twigs maintains an ambiance that is chic and modern.  There is really nothing to dislike...and no reason what-so-ever to delay....

Get to it!
Freaking amazing breakfasts, fun and unique dishes that rock.  awesome mimosas as well.  You have to go

I was really wowed by this place. First off it's super clean: and it's apparent as soon as you walk in. The lady who took my order was very personable and likable.   On top of that- I guess I was just expecting a lot of pre made things in a glass container to pick out and make a sandwich, but to my surprise and joy, that was not the case. You order your food and they make it fresh on the spot for you in their kitchen.  What great is that it's fresh but still comes out rather quickly. And the taste wow! I tried a Butka which is a meat pie. The presentation is really lovely- it's homemade phyllo dough twisted into a braid and stuffed with meat and caramelized onions.  So delicious!!! Not greasy and wonderfully flavored. And it comes with two huge pieces and a salad for $9.50.  I am a girl who loves her food- if I got full off of one meat pie- anyone will too.  You can definitely share this meal. It's nice to go somewhere for food but get that homey feel: and this place has it. Will be going again to try more.
Slow service. Even when there is no customers in side or in the drive threw! they will make you pull around and wait for ages. Luckily they have good food
Mediocre job. See for yourself. This is not a finished product. I contacted the company and they stated this is their standard process. Poor quality and craftsmanship.
I really like their coffee and they're super friendly, also it's a comic store as well. 10/10 recommend.
Milkshake? Yes! I drive across town for these! You like "blizzards"? These are way better!! No straws needed, you will eat this shake with a spoon! Never disappointed!
Everything was awesome. Loved the location as we were close to the north shore and the amazing beaches up there. Absolutely love the hot water outdoor shower!

Very disappointed. The website, and Google for this location says it does not close till 10 PM. I came at 9o'clock through the drive-through and sat for five minutes with no help. I pulled up to the window to see if anyone was in there, and there were two workers. I then pulled to the front of the store and saw all of the open signs, three to be exact. The door was locked. I then called the store twice which neither of the employees picked up. I specifically came to this location because it says that they are open till 10. Extremely confused and there it's not a sign that is visible that says anything about change hours. Very disappointed. Not sure what the issue was.

Great club, I've been going here for years (since it was IAC). I seriously can't tell you how much I love this location. My absolute favorite gym!!!! 
They just upgraded their equipment, it looks awesome. They should have anything you want for a good burn or to get those gains. Staff is super attentive and willing to help. Seriously everyone one of them is incredible, make sure to meet Preston and Lauren while your in there!!!! They'll always brighten your day!! 
Crunch is phenomenal for anything from Wieght lifting, H.I.T, yoga, cardio, spin class, classes of all kinds, Raquetball tanning and water jet massage recliner's . This is my home gym, totally endorse this location. Thanks Crunch staff you're Rockstar's!!!!!!

I stopped by here for breakfast while traveling.  I had eaten there once before.  This time I did not have a good experience.  I ordered the breakfast burrito with ham. First, the burrito is huge, a good thing.  The service was super fast.  My issue was the quality of the ham that was in the burrito.
