The burrito is covered in any sauce you choose, but every bite (every bite) I was spitting out a weird piece of ham that I didn't fish out ahead of time (covered in sauce).  The ham used was unchewable rind and fat.  It made the meal inedible.  I don't think the burrito was worth going back for even if i selected a different protein.  I gave 2 stars - 5 for the first visit and 0 for this visit to average 2 (I'm rounding down - the meat was really bad).

Just a head's up - they have no available allergen menu on their website or at the location, do not respond to emails about allergens, do not return phone calls asking about allergens, and when you show up the poor host has to run around asking about allergens, and then try to translate whatever the kitchen/manager said. My company wanted to come here for a meal, and I did try to learn about the ingredients they use days before we arrived, but was unable to get clarity, even when we were there. If you have allergies, proceed with caution.
We love Happy Hour at Kona Grill! Ian was the best - so friendly and took care of everything quickly.

Its been awhile....like quite awhile and I thought....what the heck let's give them a go again.  Why not? 

Honestly,  I feel like nothing has really changed.  The service was so slow and when the food did finally come our kids were brought their food last. As in everyone else was served and your children's pizza will be " right out. " Explain that to two hungry boys. 

I had the checkboard roll and a cucumber salad. The salad was good. The roll was just okay. Nothing to write home about, which I thought surprising because it was flagged as a top pick.

I think one of the most annoying things here is the way happy hour works.  You have to sit in the bar area or patio to order from this menu. This means if you aren't there for happy hour, but come during that time there's absolutely no chance you'll get a spot on the patio. As people literally stand in the bar stocking tables waiting for someone to leave. If you would like to order off the happy hour menu, for say a drink , but want to order a dinner item and enjoy piece and quiet in the dining room; you are out of luck. Not allowed. So I guess plan to get there before happy hour, snatch up a table on the patio and sit it out until your ready to eat.

This is the absolute worst service I have ever had the disadvantage of receiving in my life. I had a 6 week old puppy who started having seizures at about 12:30am a couple weeks ago. I took him in and they took him to the back. The vet (didn't even tell us her name) young blonde with long hair, was the most rude woman I have ever talked to. All they cared about was about my form of payment. After I couldn't pay for all the things they needed to do. (Spinal tap, MRI, CT scan) etc, they sent me away with my little puppy half comatose and hardly alive. They still made me pay $75 for doing absolutely NOTHING. Just for me walking in the door. The vet made me cry even more than I already was. I asked the vet what I should do to make him more comfortable at home and she responded very rudely with "I don't know. I don't know what's wrong with him because we couldn't do tests" I asked to come back and see him as I was crying and I heard my little guy yelping and all she said was "I really need to know what you're going to do about payment first" people like that should not be veterinarians. The only thing good about the experience was the nice secretary woman. My puppy ended up passing away that night. Worst experience ever. I do not recommend this facility to ANYONE.

I first ate here nearly 30 years ago with a group from work, and I still remember the sweat rolling off my brow as I enjoyed their fiery hot but amazingly flavorful Kung Pao Chicken.  I have no idea why I haven't been back since, but today I came with a group of 12 people and the food was every bit as good as I remembered, and the service was friendly and accommodating despite the size of our group and diversity of requests (some wanted family style, some wanted separate checks, differing levels of heat, etc.).  The only thing it needs to warrant a 5 star review is a freshening of the dated decor.

I'll definitely be back, and this time I won't wait another 30 years.
This is an amazing new ice cream shop. Handmade in-house in small batches. Great and unique flavors. Friendly serving staff and classy decor. If you love great ice cream this is the place to go.

Great gelato, kids love it.

Fun place to go and employees are always nice.

Rotating choices of gelato, new and different stuff often!
Great spot if you're hungry and in the mood for tasty comfort food. Probably our favorite breakfast/brunch spot in Meridian. Le Peep's would be second.
We eat here all the time. It's a staple in our dining out. The food is always good. Come as you are and just have a good meal.

First off, the two stars is because staff here are always kind and friendly.  The bad:  I have asked about the cost of services prior to the appointment, and more than once have been over charged.  Once by +$100, which at first I was told was accurate, but after my husband went back in and complained the  excuse was they used the wrong code for billing.  This was resolved with a credit to our account.  I have a litter of puppies and needed health certificates for transport:  I asked about the cost of this during an appointment, which I was told was $25 per pup.  When we called later to confirm and schedule, the price went up to $95 per pup.  This is fairly annoying when you are juggling the expenses of a litter and you rely on your vet's prices for your budgeting.  The final straw, however, was that I called on a Saturday morning because my dog had mastitis and needed antibiotics right away.  Since I didn't have an appointment already I was told to go to WestVet, which as I am sure TVVH is aware has a 4+ hour wait in the parking lot for "non-emergency" patients and charges a premium for their service.  I called around and found Intermountain Pet Hospital was willing to take us on standby until they could fit us in between other appointments, for which a premium added to the normal visit cost was $39, and the wait time turned out to be about an hour in the lobby.  Staff here were super nice and considerate.  The Dr. saw my dog for about 20 minutes and we were out the door with the needed prescriptions.  Why can't TVVH help their established patients in this way?  Too overbooked or not enough vets?  Seems like a management issue to me.  I will never return to TVVH again, unfortunately, and had been a client here for several years.

Have been here on several occasions and the wait staff are always good and the food has always exceeded my expectations.  This place is definitely worth the drive out to Eagle and I don't mind the people watching of all the self important Eagle yuppies either.  Currently I am at a table between a guy who looks like he is going out on his yacht and a man in a tan top and flip flops that should have stop lifting weights ten years ago.  

But seriously the good here is very good.

Food was great! Awesome selection & can't complain about the flavor combos! We came here asking for a specific football game, waited 15 mins for "servers to catch up". They didn't actually have that channel, so Mike was kind enough to make sure we were well taken care of. The bartender forgot to give our card back but whatever. Excuse the service, enjoy the food and atmosphere
Great food, prompt service, friendly staff (thank you Briona!!) And comfortable booths, clean and open. We loved the pie, Duo grilled cheese sandwich with Tomato Bisque soup And pie

The service has really gone downhill...this used to be a great place to go, but not so much anymore...there are so many people working there and yet it still takes over an hour to get sushi on a Saturday at 3pm. Restaurant is not crowded, yet we have been sitting for over an hour and no food. Seeing other parties come in after us and get food within 15 minutes is really infuriating. Will not be coming back here again. 
Please get WiFi if your going to offer digitital menus....
Craig got back to me promptly and was able to fit me into his schedule quickly. He was on time, very friendly and did a great job. The house looks fantastic again. I would defiantly use him again.

They make drinks adequately enough, and some of the employees are super friendly and know me on a first name basis, because I come sometimes 2 times in a day. I will not be returning to this location. I understand they may have needed to adjust their hours due to Covid-19, however, I found it incredibly frustrating that they refused service 1 minute before closing, with hours that are already earlier than their listed hours.

NOT OPEN until 7pm!

Story time. So bummed about this place. The food is really good but our second time there was not a good experience.  The majority of the restaurant was affected by the staffs behavior. 
   A high pitched alarm that sounds like a smoke detector starts to sound. Really hard to determine where the source is. Everyone is looking around trying to figure out where it is coming from.
   An elderly couple, wife in an electric wheel chair get singled out. A server calls out to them that she thinks it's the wheelchair. The elderly man says the wheelchair is off. A few minutes later a worker from the other side of the restaurant comes over to the hostess station. He calls out to the couple that the noise is the wheelchair. Another server walks by an says it is the chair. At this point the guests in the restaurant are looking at the elderly couple.
   The couple had just got their food. The elderly man gets up, turns on the chair and moves his wife out towards the restaurant entrance. I thought they were leaving. The sound did not go away. The couple return to their table to eat.
   My daughter went over to the couple and apologized for the way the staff had singled them out. She got emotional as she was talking to them. The lady was trying to eat as tears were rolling down her face.
   My daughter returned to our table with tears coming down her face. A few minutes later another customer leaving comes by our table and pats my daughter on the arm and tells her she is a nice person.
   Another guest came over to them to also apologize. He asked if he could pay for their meal. The elderly man tried to decline but the nice guy said he wanted to do it and he did.
   After the elderly couple left and we were just finishing our breakfast our server Angel C. could tell my daughter was still upset. Angela apologizes for all the commotion. Angela then tells us, "just so you know, "they are really mean." The more Angela talked the more upset my daughter and I got. She was not helping the situation. There was no excuse for the employees behavior. 
   That did not set well with us. If she talks to us about other guests what does she say to other guests about us? I know my grand kids can get noisy and messy.
  On our way out,, my daughter went over to the nice guy and thanked him for his gesture. He said he will not be returning there to eat. She then told him what our server said and that we will not be returning.

Yikes, how many years have I gone here and I never did a review? Well, at least since 2010. Guess, I should get on the ball and do one.

We have gone thru several cycles with this place. Most of the times the food has been excellent and the selection wide. What made the experience good or not so good has been the service. For a while several years ago, they were pretty surely and it wasn't so pleasant to dine here. But the last year, they have been great And the food seems all freshly made in the shop. 

Favorite items of mine? Corned beef hash, waffles, pork sausage, and the pancakes. Now the pancakes is another story. I made the mistake of ordering the short stack of 2 pancakes. they were great, but they were about 14 inches in diameter. I felt so ashamed to not being able to eat more than half. But, I discovered I can order a one pancake side order. That will do next time. You can also have sugar-free syrup or jam on your cakes, or both.

Don't know if you like pork sausage, but if you do, try theirs either as patty or links. Made to their specs, next door at Porterhouse, it isn't fatty. Full of flavor and a good sized serving for the ala cart order.

So all in all, they are back on my list of places to go breakfast. Be prepared for the weekend crush. BTW, this is a breakfast and lunch only place.

In October of 2021, i went over to this establishment based on a recommendation from a co-worker. I ordered the one-meat platter for $15.99, the food was pretty good and you get a decent amount for this price.  But it seems the waitress i got did not seem very interested in my dining experience. 

The waitress never checked in on me. I ran out of the sauce i was using and waited a while to just ask if i can get more, by the time i had received service, i was nearly done eating and had togo work. The service was fairly subpar. But outside the service being subpar, i rate the experience as acceptable because the food was really delicious!

Service and staff are amazing. Great bunch of cheery people who leaves sweet notes on their napkins to show they care. Their food is fresh and made with care as well. Please visit this place. I'm about to order right now!
Great bartenders good atmosphere and the food truck had great affordable Mexican food

I will not return to this establishment.  First of all, I am someone who frequently gets massages.  I just relocated back to the area and saw the few good reviews of this place and figured that I would try it.  When you walk through the front door, there is a LOUD doorbell sound DING DONG DING DONG that is unbelievable!  Really?  For a massage establishment to have that loud noise every time a customer walks through the door is insane!  Massage establishments are supposed to be quiet and tranquil.  In addition, there was a cell phone on the floor outside of the room that I was in and the text message notification continually went off from the time  I walked through the door until I left.  I believe it belonged to the massage therapist who performed my mediocre massage.  If I have to tell you more than 2 - 3 times that I want medium pressure and you continually apply a deep tissue massage approach, there is a problem!  I also paid for a 30 minute foot massage of which in this place is simply an extension of the massage.  Very disappointing!  Typical foot massage places have reclining chairs to sit in and soak your feet...this is not the typical foot massage.  Also, the massage table did not have the typical heat rest where there is an opening while one is lying face down...I could barely breathe as there was barely any oxygen!  The rooms are very warm and the walls are paper thin.  There are no towel warmers in the rooms either which is typical so the massage therapist walks out not saying anything which cuts into the massage time!  She clearly went to get hot towels from another area.  I also made an appointment specifying that I wanted a 60 minute massage and 30 minute foot massage...the woman at the front charges me for a  30 minute massage and 30 minute foot massage after telling her twice over what I wanted.  Shitty place!

A clean and organized store that honored the Nike Online prices. I wanted a pair of Air Max 90s (my first one, btw), but all they had was a navy colored flyknit. The online stored offered the design I wanted for $79, $40 off of what both Champs and Footlocker had. I showed the attendant my phone and she effortless looked it up to buy with free shipping to my house (which saves on shipping when buying online). 

Quick, reliable, and a friendly staff, so thanks!

I  had heard nothing of great things regarding this restaurant so I had been wanting to go for some time.  I was finally given an opportunity to go with my kids on Sunday morning around 9:45am.  Though the restaurant had about 4 empty tables, we were told there was a 30 minute wait.  I figured that was reasonable considering it was a Sunday morning.  We were in a little time crunch, so I looked at the menu ahead of time so I knew what I would want.  30 minutes came and went and it turned out to be closer to 45 minutes. 

We get seated and were asked about drinks. We gave our drink order, then I said we were ready to order.  At this point, this was the start of the service issues that I did not expect from this establishment.  I was told that she would be back that another table was ahead of us.  I am not sure how hard it would have been to take our order right then if we were indeed ready.  It took somewhere around 10 minutes before she got back to us to take our order.

By the time the food got there, my kids had finished their sodas, and my water was almost gone.  I am not sure if they refill sodas or not, but they never did the rest of the visit and they only filled my water as I was collecting my credit card back.  I went through most of my meal without water. The food was good, but the lack of service we had overshadowed any good food we might have had.  The service was slow and not complete.  

 At this point I have not decided if I will go back and give another chance.

1 . I purchased a safe and asked only that they test the lock before I left the store. I was told by the boy taking the safe out that the instructions were inside and I could figure it out when I got it home. I lock was defective and took two weeks to get straightened out.
2. I put a gun on layaway that the manager had built. It had a catch in the action so I had asked that it be fixed and fully operational when I payed it off and picked it up. I went to pick up the firearm and was informed that they would not repair their own defective work until the gun was completely paid for. On top of that I did not get a 100% assurance that I would not be charged for the repairs on the defect they caused. I said that the gun would need to be fixed to sell to anyone but that did not seem to matter. I declined to purchase the firearm. ANY PURCHASES you make from this store should be DOUBLE CHECKED

Won't go back.  Indoor pistol range is awful.  Last two times I went it was a disaster.   The guy next to me was shooting some kind of homemade pistol/rifle stock gun.  I heard a loud, unusual sound and then a loaded semiauto pistol went flying on to the concrete range floor in front of me.  Apparently his experimental gun failed.  Why was he allowed to shoot that thing?

Very dangerous!  My wife was with me and this could have turned deadly.

Last time there, the guy next to me starts firing an AR15 reeling off as many rounds as possible.  Really!  An AR15 is not a gun to shoot on a 25 yard indoor pistol range.  I would never shoot my AR15 inside a pistol range.  Shell cases were ricocheting  and flying wildly all over the place coming over into my booth.  The sound was far to loud for such a tiny space.

This place just wants to make a buck off letting anyone shoot anything they bring in without regard to safety.

Shoot there at your own peril!!

Came here for a friend's son's baseball game.  This is a beautiful park with several baseball fields.   Clean and easy-to-access restroom facilities and plenty of parking on multiple sides of the park.

I agree with another reviewer that more shady areas are needed.  The day I was there with my husband, it was over 100 degrees and there were very few areas to sit and cool down.

Other than that, this is an awesome park!

Our stay was very good. We loved the way they had upgraded the cottage- it looked great, but felt like home at the same time.  All of their amenities are all planned out to make the guests comfortable.Their customer service is easily available as well,  should things come up. This was especially appreciated by us visitors to a new state. We would definitely stay there again!

Drinks are always great, and I love the distance they're creating for customers by having half their tables closed. I don't love that they've gone to the computer card reader that they being to your table. I'm hoping it's just for Covid? Although, I don't know how having guests touching the same thing is better than just touching a card and pen? 

I tried the White Russian on my last trip in and it was delish! I normally do a martini, but something about that was really speaking to me. Glad I branched out.

- 55 min to be seated, 10 min later than app showed.
- All staff look like a bunch of ragtag rock band rejects. Ripped Jean's, shorts, t-shirts, earbuds, etc. 
- Overheatd a waitresses talking to customers about how other customers were mad about the wait time (not us).
- 10 min wait to get water.
- Call aheads accepted. However, the process is grossly flawed. If a customer shows up at 0900 and has 45 min wait time, another customer can show up 10 min after the 1st one, do a call ahead from the parking lot and get seated before the 1st customer who's still has a 35 min wait time. 
- Waiter informed wife that tables with 4 chairs are for parties of 4. But there are no tables with less than 4 chairs in the business.
- When the concerns were brought to the manager, she defended all actions of her staff and hung up on us. 
- 1st and last time eating here! 
- Would not recommend to anyone that values customer service!

Updated review! A friend of mine surprised me with a super Gyro and oh my gosh was it delicious!!! She went to the new Nampa location which I have yet to visit. The meat was cooked perfectly, even the slice of bacon! This gyro was stuffed with flavor! The tzatkiki sauce was so delicious and there was just the right amount on it! I was really impressed and very satisfied! The pita was soft and tasty! I can't wait to go back! I don't really have any complaints other than my super Gyro was loaded and began to fall apart but that wasn't stopping me for finishing this new favorite of mine! I think I might head to the new Nampa location tomorrow night!

Katie Newman did a horrific job with my nails, I was optimistic when coming in but immediately regretted making an appointment with how unprofessional she acted. I get my nails done all the time but she was by far the worse nail tech I have ever had. She didn't do them even, made them huge and bubble like, and changed me 73$????? 73$ for a horrible job and I had to go and get them fixed, the nail tech at the other salon had to grind my nails down for an hour and a half just to fix what Katie did! Never going again and I suggest you don't let her do ur nails too and overcharge you cuz her business is failing!

Recently moved to Idaho, and was looking for our soon to be regular breakfast place. 

Dude.

SO GOOD.  Pancakes are legit.  Eggs are legit.  Bacon is legit. And the Potatoes? SUPER LEGIT.

Don't mind the wait, because you know it means the place is good. Great customer service, and prices too.  Winner all around. We now have our regular breakfast place!

We have eaten at Cafe Ole for years and always enjoyed the food. We love that the Casey family has owned the restaurant for years and that it is local. But last night was the worst experience I have ever had at a restaurant.
We went the the Eagle Road location at 5:30 last night, Monday February 27th. We were greeted and seated at a table that was right in front of the kitchen. It was a booth and I sat on the side facing the kitchen. My husband and daughter were across from me.
We sat for a good 10 minutes before anyone came to our table. We almost left, but stayed. Finally a waitress came to our table and asked what we wanted to drink. No chips or salsa. We ordered drinks, which came 10 minutes later and still no chips and salsa. She looked to be the only waitress, so we patiently waited. Finally, someone (who we later found out was Alex, the "manager") brought our drinks, and we asked for chips and salsa, he said sure and came back and literally threw them on the table. And it was just chips. We walked to the bar and got salsa for ourselves.
The real problem was when I witnessed the cooks eating cheese in the kitchen. I thought this was odd, so decided to watch them closer. 2 cooks and neither were wearing gloves, 1 of the cooks put a chicken breast on the grill with his bare hands, wiped his hands on his apron and then started to fill a tortilla bowl with lettuce with his BARE hands that had just picked up the chicken breast. This is a huge health hazard. He then picked up more cheese or olives and put them in his mouth, he saw that I was watching him and immediately rushed to the back room. Then the other cook was eating something, I didnt see what it was, but he put something in his mouth while cooking.
This is so unsanitary and furthermore could get every very sick. When our food came there was no way that we could possible eat our food, so we asked for a manager to explain what we had seen.
Alex Saldivar (which is the name he wrote down for me) was the MOST RUDE person I have spoken to in a very long time. He was not listening to what we said to him, he waved us off as we left, and then said we had to pay. At this point we refused and he made us pay for a beer and soda my husband and daughter had. We paid and left.
We will never return to Cafe Ole after being treated so poorly and seeing such awful work conditions.

I took my classic car in to get a simple oil change, when I got the car back my speedometer and odometer no longer worked, when I confronted them about it the response given was that wasn't something the tech would have messed with for an oil change, and it was like that when it came in, the whole time playing that CYA card.  First of all IF the odometer didn't work when I came in then they would have no mileage to put on that sticker they put in the window for your next oil change, but sure enough there it is on that sticker the printed mileage, second, they couldn't at least check the car to make sure that something wasn't out of place.  At one time I brought my classic truck in and they used to do a good job, but the last couple of time I have brought my regular daily driver in they would diagnose with phantom issues, when I would get a second opinion, after checking out the vehicle the response given from the other shop was "I have no idea what they are talking about".  It is one thing to get something misdiagnosed on your daily driver, it is something completely different when it comes to your classic vehicles.  There are not that many shops that work on classic cars in this town and even less are competent at it, something they should learn is that there is a trust component when the owner of a classic car brings their car in for service, when components of your car no longer work after bringing it in and they want to play CYA after the fact, then congratulations trust has been broken, my recommendation would be for anyone to steer clear of this place.

The doctor pushed orthotics or possibly surgery.  Went there in May 2015, received a bill in June and promptly paid it.  This May 2016 a year after my appointment I received a bill.  Called them and the women in billing was so totally clueless.  The bill did not say what it was for and the women in billing couldn't figure it out.  I also asked why it came a year later and she said they had sent it to me( I question that) and that it then went to collections since it hadn't been paid.  Never heard anything from a collection agency.  She then said they pulled it from collections and it finally made it to me.  They had my address and my phone number.  They could of called.  Very unproffessional.  What idiots.

I've been to Kona Grill a few times and each time I was more than satisfied with my meal and service.  The first time was when it first opened and the other two to three times was dinner with my husband and/or with another couple.  I order the same thing which is the Lemon Penne pasta with Shrimp.  I have to say this pasta dish is amazing!  The pasta is perfectly Al dente and the shrimp is cooked to perfection.  The service is always quick but not rushed and our servers have always been friendly.  

So why the three stars?  Well my last visit on January 1,  2022 was somewhat of a mess.  My daughter, granddaughter and I went to the Village for a little shopping and lunch.  Even though we didn't call in ahead of time for reservations, we were able to get a booth so we could park the stroller for my four month old granddaughter.   I don't know if the staff was hung over from New Year's Eve or lunch staff is just not as good as the dinner staff. They were all moving very slow that day. There were plenty of servers but I think the cook staff was lacking--only three cooks we could see. We could see all the servers and kitchen staff from our table. 

I ordered their French Dip sandwich and my daughter ordered the chicken stir fry.  An hour later, our meal was brought to us, both meals were lukewarm.  The flavors were good but both my daughter and I agreed that the food was sitting under the heat lamp for a while.   It was frustrating to watch the wait staff standing around with food sitting under the heat lamps and no one doing a thing.  I really hope this was just an isolated issue.   Also, lunch prices are crazy high.  Twenty-two dollars for a French dip sandwich with a side of chips.   Oh well... I'll come back again and hope that it was just one of those days.

Omg!   The food here is to die for!   Holy fruitcakes batman!  The service was amazing! 

Seriously...   It's McDonald's.   If you want a great dining experience,  go someplace else.   I am here with the kids for the disease infested Playland.   Wish me luck!
If you like hip hop music in a nice, clean & affordable environment, this is the place for you! They also have pool tables, flat screen TVs & plenty of seating. A fun bar to hang out at!

Considering the state of the world right now, I'll go a little easier than I normally would.... Party of 6, Sunday night, I had made reservations early in the day to include a scooter user but when we arrived they had us at a tiny table in a corner appropriate for 4 people. Needless to say that wouldn't work. Our waitress was awesome. On top of everything and doing her best. Most everyone was pleased with their meal. Filet, Macadamia Chicken, Sweet-Chile Glazed Salmon, Philadelphia and California rolls. I ordered the Miso-Sake Chilean Sea Bass and when it arrived it was a watery piece of unseasoned fish flopped over a bed of rice. The presentation was pretty sad and didn't taste much better than it looked. It was a birthday celebration so we got a free dessert that fed us all. All in all it was a nice dinner.

Awesome first time experience here! I have never even held a gun before, so I was very intimidated to try shooting. These good 'ol boys are super chill, polite and helpful. At first I thought "hey, this is a pretty serious thing we're doing here" why weren't they more "bossy" towards us, but it's because they know their stuff. From check in, to suggestions, answering our questions, showing safety video, setting us up in a lane, everything was great. Due to Covid-19, we weren't able to rent safety equipment, but since we will be shooting more often, we decided to buy our own. Once inside the range, Michael G really set me at ease. He took some time to help us get the most out of our first experience. Halfway through, he made a gun suggestion for me, I tried it and immediately improved on my shots! This place is huge, clean, well stocked compared to some. Bathrooms were super clean too. This will be our new range.
The 10 mile traffic signal is operational at the entrance. It will be a lot safer entering and exiting now. Big peaches and plums in season now.

CBH Homes is amazing and very caring to all our customers. I have never had a client unhappy about their service from CBH. South Ada team has been working so hard for their clients every step of the way. I recently visited their office and Rylee was so warm and welcoming which I appreciated. I am happy to work with you all in the future. Thank you for all you do!!
Love this place! Very fresh ingredients and awesome selection. Definitely one of my go-to spots! Highly recommend!

Get the noodle soup with tri tip and you won't be sorry.  Notice I didn't say pho, because it isn't.  It is similar but missing the traditional garnishments.  Regardless, it is high quality and delicious!   Their sandwiches are served in freshly made waffles.  Yes, waffles.  Served with fries you can share and order a sidecar boba.  If you have read my boba reviews, I can say these guys make them the RIGHT way.  Thai tea boba = bomb.  Ok, the kicker is the owner.  He is hustling around the place making sure everybody is taken care of, and happy with your meal.  Check this place out

I know I know I'm not a big fan of chain restaurants either especially since I try to support local businesses, however Twigs is in a category all its own! Not only is in a Martini Bar... Yes I said Martini Bar!!! It also has wonderful food, a great atmosphere and superb staff. We come here often and are never disappointed. Some of my favorites are the basil trance martini and I'm usually not a fan of lemon drop martinis, but they have the best lemon drop I've ever had!!! Also they have Gorgonzola fondue... Yes I said Gorgonzola fondue do I need to say more? Their salads are good as well, I like their steak salad. I don't think you can go wrong with anything you order however, I have probably had one of everything on the menu and I've never been disappointed. Their seasonal items are also worth a try. 
So again I know this is a chain restaurant, however it is definitely worth a look! They also have a good happy hour and a rewards program which is a bonus. It is a little more pricey but you have to remember it's in The Village so that is why. You pay for the atmosphere :-)

We went for a Sunday Brunch and used the online wait list to skip the long wait in the lobby.  It's a basic no frills brunch spot with great food.  

Husband got the 3 meat hash and I got the 1/2 order of the corned beef hash.  The 1/2 size was still more than I could finish. 

I want to comeback and try one of the ginormous pancakes and definitely will.

Ambiance: let me just brag about the energy of this place. AMAZING! If you want a new/secret/hidden location away from downtown this is it! I love everything about this location. 

Drinks: 3 stars for our drinks, it appeared to be somewhat watered down but it had a delightful taste. I had the old fashion and it was good. The presentation seemed to lack the "wow" factor, but overall it tasted good. 

Service: 3 stars.  Our server didn't seem to know much about drinks and seemed a little reserved. I always love when a server can guide our decision or make a drink I've never had but he stuck to what I liked. Overall it was a good experience! 

Music was on point! Def coming back and hope to give 5 stars soon!

I'm a Texas born and raised lover of BBQ. Nothing pretentious. Just good meats and quality sides. Simple decor and sweet tea. Big Daddy's passes with flying colors. Prices are good. My sandwich hit the spot and the tea made me feel like I was back home. The double battered fries were an unexpected bonus. Definitely the best fries I've had from a BBQ joint.

I loved my time at this gym for awhile. They have good equipment and ample space. When it came time to inquire on cancelling a membership, I was told that I was on a contract magically. I was told to my face that it was month to month and I could cancel anytime at sign up. So I canceled both and then still got charged for a canceled membership.

Two things are happening: 1) they don't care about their job (which was easily confirmable the few times I needed to discuss my memberships) 2) too much turnover to have accountability. 

Sign up somewhere else!

My car went in with a check engine light and code. They charged me over a thousand dollars for spark plugs and pcv valve. On the way home from the shop the check engine light came back on with a different code and the car was runningthe same way it did when it went in. I sent it in on a tow truck because it was running so bad yet they "think" it's fixed?? To make matters worse when I got home I discovered there was NO Oil in it. We filled it up before we took it in. Go ANYWHERE else. This is not a trustworthy place.

Nice theater.  Lots of nice waiting area.  I came here to watch beauty and beast at their VIP 21 theater.  

Order your food before you go in the theater and they will deliver.  However they do have a waiter to take orders in the theater but I have not figured out how to do it.  Not like Cinapolis where they have a button to press and call for service.  Nice rocking chairs but not recliners.  For $10 to see a new releases movie , it is not a bad deal.
Paddles up Poke Meridian is so good. I've always had a great experience, the employees have been nothing but nice and helpful!

First week in town, and first date night in town with the Mrs.  Decided to give Kona Grill a try in the Village.  We sat at the bar and waited on a table in the bar area which is first come, first serve.  The bar tender was really nice, but I must say I wasn't all that impressed with the Kona cocktails.  I tried the Mai Tai which was very heavy on OJ and less on more tropical juices.  Followed up with a Old Fashion and again mediocre at best.

Once seated at an table in the bar area we ordered some food.  We decided to stick with sushi, sashimi, and rare seared tuna sliders.  The jalapeno yellowtail sushi was absolutely delicious, good quality fish and flavor.  Next was Picasso roll on the urging of the waiter, well she was not lying.  The Picasso was easily our favorite roll. The seared tuna sliders were also good.

The location and the food make up for the lack luster cocktails.  We will come back again.
I was going to stay but a man tried to sell me crystal meth in the parking lot so we left. ....sketchy area...

This place is legit good!  Reading some of the negative reviews I thought this place might not be any good, but those people must just be negative people or something.

Sorry for no food pics, we were hungry and it was delicious :).  I do wish this place was open passed 2pm, this seems like it'd have awesome dinner if available!

Absolutely amazing place. They are extremely knowledgeable and very helpful. Robert and Jason Kitson were so incredible and sat with me and helped me through all the different types and kind of guns I wanted to see. They helped narrow down what would be the best fit for me. And they never made me feel like they were just trying to sell me. It's very clean and I loved every minute I was there.

I try so hard to like this place.  It seems I am either standing up at the counter for ages waiting to be checked out and have ended up leaving twice with people just standing around looking at books on the counter, or the service just is not up to par to what it used to be.    I have bought 4 guns from another gun store and did not mind paying a little bit of extra but at the same time at least I got  service.  Again, today I was standing up at the counter for ages and just walked out as I was not served. This was my second time in today, this morning I went in and was served by a black guy and he was fantastic. This afternoon I went in and one of the employees was just standing in the middle with their head buried in a book. I just walked out after a few minutes.   This place used to be great but in my opinion has really went downhill from what it used to be and have definitely lost most all of my business except when it comes to the odd box of ammo.

This review is based on two visits, Friday night and then again on Sunday.  On Friday I went with a friend and we ordered off of the happy hour menu, our waitress seemed annoyed that we were ordering off the HH menu but we wanted to try some different items.  I did order a margarita, it was tasty.  We received our food but they brought me the wrong flat bread which they did correct and brought me the correct order. The only reason why I'm giving it two stars was the service, she seemed annoyed with us and when I asked a question about a menu items she was a little short with me, they weren't busy so I didn't understand what the problem was. On a side note... the donuts were amazing. 
Sunday I came here with my boyfriend, we ordered two drinks before we went to a movie, we waited and waited, the movie was going to start shortly,we cancelled the order and left.  The bar wasn't busy and there were three or four other couples in the dining area.

We ordered food and it came out in about 5 minutes.  It was tasty, but almost cold.  Did they forget to heat it?  

Beware of the prices as they are high.  My dad wanted a glass of wine.  I warned him to ask the price first... 10 dollars!!!  That is ridiculous.   

I must say the service was really nice.  They were all helpful, attentive and friendly.

Great food, great service! The decor is super cool, my son won't stop talking about the fish or the open kitchen. Make sure you save room for carrot cake... make sure you bring a army to share it with!!!

Great little place for a bite or a fabulous coffee.  My friend and I both had chili, I normally don't do chili but I wanted something different, it was very tasty and it came with corn bread, score. They have lunch specials during the week and they offer a different pasta special for every day of the week. Very yummy and extremely affordable. The baked goods are lovely and they have a nice variety.  We talked with the owner, very nice person and I am so happy they are out here. Sorry, but I can only handle so many burger and taco places that are out in this area.
I really enjoy the food, it has a little heat to it and it's different than most of the local restaurants. This is my go to for lunch. Keep up the good work.

We are so fortunate in the Treasure Valley to have so many gorgeous parks right outside our door! Settlers Park does not disappoint! This park has great playgrounds for young kids, baseball diamonds, horseshoe pits, a splash pad, lots of picnic areas, & acres of gorgeous green grass.  There's even a pond where you can catch fish! One of my favorite things that this park offers is Movie Nights every Friday night during the summer months.  The movies are sponsored by different businesses. Families are able to set up blankets and enjoy a free family friendly movie under the stars! It's great! They have a snack bar that has plenty of goodies to enjoy. The park offers clean and well maintained restrooms and the parking lot is easy to get in and out of via Meridian or Ustick.

We were passing through Idaho on a roadtrip when we stumbled upon Lovejoy. My sister in law had been craving home made ice cream for days so we were happy to finally have some. I decided on a chocolate cherry concoction which was delicious! The ice cream shop is super cute! It even has swings you can sit on while you eat your ice cream. There is also enough seating where you don't feel cramped. The atmosphere is light and airy and customer service was on point.

"I only love my bed and Joe Mamas, I'm sorry"

If you sing this the whole trip to Joe Mamas with your Drake hating husband you will annoy him enough just to get that satisfaction of making him mad but once you get into Joe Mamas the food and atmosphere will have you falling in love all over again.
{Disclaimer: Not responsible for any divorced}

Seriously though, we love Joe Mamas. The food is always full of flavor and the coffee is the best. Some of my favorite items include the chorizo hash, biscuits and gravy (ate this my entire second trimester, you could blind fold me and I'd be able to correctly guess JM's bng vs. another competitor's bng), and pretty much every omlette. You can taste the freshness of your country fried steak here. No freezer burn or weeman portions either. You get a big steak with the crispy edges and it's flavor packed! When I'm dieting this is the only place I go for breakfast because they make beautiful eggehite omlettes that don't look like they were assaulted and left to die in the pan. 

They make their own jelly too which is my favorite and a bonus that they toast your toast almost perfectly. Also if it's summer and you can't ditch your kids this is the best place to go. The kids portions are very generous. We usually get a pancake, egg and choice of protein which fills them up and shuts them up.

Nicely done store with lots of gelato and sorbetto flavors. Chocolates in candy and drink forms. Espresso in many variations, including affrogato. 

We had a small and medium cup. They will let you get two flavors in the small cup and three flavors with the medium.  The gelati and sorbetti are clean tasting, comparable to what I had in Italy. 

My only observation is that the prices are higher than most may be used too. But prices are posted, so no surprises should occur. 

It is nice to have a good gelateria nearby.

Don't go ice skating here.  Rough.  Maybe good in the middle of the day for your little kid, but otherwise it smacks of a tourist trap with teenagers flying around the rink carelessly.  Skates are broken and sized improperly.  It's just a Christmas business racket.  Wish we just went to a regular old ice skating place.

I don't think I have ever had a bad experience at Kona. The food and drink have always been good. Recently we went and had the surf and turf with the big island ribeye and bama sushi roll. It was so good! Even the kids meals are pretty amazing and they never leave hungry!

Had a great Dinner at Kona Grill with my family. Chantel helped us and made sure we had what we needed. She made great recommendations. We will definitely be coming back to visit Chantel at Kona Grill.
Great happy hour and good to note happy hour all day Sunday. Spicey edamame, peppered tuna roll, and jalapeno sashimi are my favorites.

Took my classic car there for a simple oil change, when I picked up my car I noticed my speedometer was no longer working, and the odometer was displaying 0, when I went in to ask them about they said it was like that when it came in and that an oil change would not have done that.  However, remember when I said the odometer was reading 0, on the sticker they place on the window it had 3000 miles added to the mileage it had when I came in there (not from 0), they couldn't even be bothered to take a second look at the car to make sure, with this lack of caring why would anyone trust their car (especially a classic car) to these guys, and yes 1 star is way too high for this group, do yourself a favor don't walk RUN from that place

We had a great experience in every way. Our contact was super responsive and took great care of us. The house we stayed in had a lot of nice personal touches and was well-stocked from toiletries to kitchen ware. The place was modern and you could tell that they cared about their guests.

When I went to the 2018 Salt Lake Home show in January 2018, I didn't buy marble for a kitchen counter, wood for a pergola, or an impulse accessory for my back yard. I did, however, buy a flag. 

The word "flagpole" doesn't cover all of what The Farm has, but we'll start with that anyway. Their meat-and-potatoes are Titan Telescoping  flagpoles (can be set at different heights). They also have Titan solar devices to reign down light on your raised flag all night long. If you work in a government office or flag-loving company, you'll want to check out their indoor flagpole sets (and their variety of fancy metal tops). 

Obviously, they have a lot of American flags. Most are nylon (with or without sleeve) or 2-ply polyester, all in multiple sizes.  But don't sleep on the variety on the other stuff: Flags for sports teams (NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, NCAA), Military/Service, States (all 50 and D.C.), historic, religious, and more nations than you knew existed. 

This summer, I went to a rural island in the Irish Sea called the Isle of Man. The Flagpole Farm has a larger and higher quality three-legged, red flag for Man that is bigger and better than any I found WHEN I WAS THERE. Score! 

In the final analysis, Flagpole Farm has a great variety of high quality products. Their flags and flagpoles run significantly higher in price than what you find online. However, you are paying for QUALITY, and I'm guessing the flag I got, made of heavy-duty 200 denier nylon, will stand the test of time better than the rest.

My 75 year old mother went to St. Luke's on Sunday night- she was told that she needed her appendix out and surgery was scheduled for the next morning at ten. I went in to wish her well early and she said it was changed to 1pm. I asked the nurse and she said there was a critical surgery that took precedence so that was the plan.
I came back when I could at 2:30 and she had not been moved. I talked to the charge nurse and two directors- they were going to get to the bottom of what happened and in the meantime mom had not eaten since dinner the night before...
Finally met with the surgeon at 5 PM and the surgeon said he put in his notes that she was not to have surgery at all as the antibiotics helped a lot overnight and not one of the nurses had bothered to check his notes all...freaking...day.  Cruel and inattentive care...it was 6pm before they brought her a hamburger from the cafeteria. Discharged the next day. Beware and watch out for your senior family members! She may still be there otherwise!
I have to say this place has grown on me.  If you ask them to toast your bread and that improves the sandwich for me.  Good quality meet and good French Fries.

I have been Twigs on three occasions now, and have yet to have a bad experience.  

The first visit was strictly for cocktails, and I must say they have quite the extensive selection of martini options.  I had an inner struggle with myself to make a decision, and in the end, switched it up between drink one and two so that I could broaden my horizons.  Drinks were tasty and just the right blend of alcohol to mixers.  The service was friendly and attentive.  We sat in the bar area, which has tall pub style tables and chairs.

My second visit was for dinner and drinks out on the patio.  The weather was nice, but there was a slight chill in the air.  Their patio heaters provided just the right amount of heat, to keep me comfortable.  I ordered the pesto margherita chicken and it was delicious.  I couldn't get enough of the amazing balsamic glaze drizzled around the plate.  Service again was friendly and attentive.  Drinks were again well mixed.

My third visit was this past week for a presentation in their private back room.  A meal was provided, and so the menu choices were limited to a small selection.  My fav chicken was an option, and I couldn't resist by to go for it!  And I was not disappointed.  It came out piping hot and was as good as I remembered the first time around.  We were also served a pre-fixed salad called insalada mista which was very good.  I probably would have never ordered it on my own, as it would have been too much food.  But it has delicious candied walnuts and gorgonzola cheese, so how can you go wrong?  Staff was great at getting the food out to the entire group (probably about 15-20 of us) in a very efficient manner.  The room itself was a little bit odd in it's layout (in relation to everyone being able to equally see the presentation) but it was a nice room, none the less.

All in all, I would come back again.  Whether it was just for drinks or for a meal.

Took my truck in for a ticking noise in the engine that would speed up and slow down as I gave it gas when I got my truck back it wasn't fixed and they charged me over 2,000 so when I called them and told them it was it fixed they said well we fixed a tick and i told them not the one i came in for and there reply was well you can't deny we fixed a tick so the next day I took the truck back to see what the other tick was and they told me I needed a new engine and it was going to cost over 7,000 so I asked if the would credit the 2600 I paid the day before they said no went ahead had it fixed and when I went to pick it up they added more money to my bill for some bolts I was never told about and 40.00 in gas because they said my truck was empty but I dropped off with a half tank and it only cost 50.00 to fill the truck got it back with just under a half tank the new engine cost 4100 including the cor charge of 400 and I didn't get the credit for that on my bill so the charged me the cor charge and now they are going to send it back to jasper motors and get 400.00 from them so they basically took me for over 3000.00 so what ever you do don't take your vehicle to this shop unless you don't mind being ripped off

The prices and selection are great. I especially appreciate the produce and bulk sections. It's open 24 hours, which is awesome for my weird work schedule. My only complaint is that the checkout lines get long at night when there's frequently only one or two open. Self-checkout is always an option, but when I have a cart full of groceries it's quicker to wait in line.
Brought my pistol for cerakoting.  Overall done quite poorly, several spots were missed with bare metal showing.

The flag pole sold by this company is good quality and I have no complaint with it.  The company also has available a solar light that can be installed at the top of the pole to provide light for the U.S. Flag as proscribed if not taken down at dusk.  The seller was honest in stating the light available at time of purchase was undergoing re-engineering to provide a better unit and he would sell the new improved light at the same price when it was available if I was so inclined.  I thanked him and waited for the new light to be available.  3 1/2 months after purchase of the flag pole, I have been unable to receive any information of when this new light will be available.  I have left messages for the owner to call me, but received no call.  Apparently, like so many businesses, they are eager to sell you their product, but have no interest after the sale.  Searching for an alternative, I've found a well recommended light for 1/3 the 'sale' price the Flag Pole Farm offered.
Damn that was good! I have had a lot of Gyros from all over and this was the best! Wow! I will be back again and again. I had the Z and my wife had the regular Gyro! 5 Star

Kona is a great restaurant located in the heart of The Village in Meridian. They have sushi and a full menu of other dishes so there is something for everyone! Wednesdays are awesome- they do half off bottles of wine (& you can take home the leftovers that you don't drink!) the restaurant is pretty large but it does get busy so I'd recommend reserve, especially weekends. They have a decent happy hour with good drink specials and though the happy hour food is a little spendy, it is worth it! They have options from I think $5-$10 or so. Give Kona a try, their servers and attentive and the food is yummy!

Reservations at 6:45. Told a 30 minute wait upon arrival. Finally seated 40 minutes later. The restaurant was serving to go orders constantly. Once seated,  we did order quickly, only to wait 
 an hour 
for our order. YET - to go orders were constantly being made & available at the door!
PLUS disco style "music" was being played at ear shattering volume! Seriously, this place will NEVER get our business again! If management puts to go orders as a priority- then just close the dining room! Obviously people who come in person are NOT important to your business model! 
Since There is No Zero Stars - gave a 1

Too noisy. Pretty sure the receptionist started on massage because she kept leaving to answer the phone or door. Incredibly unprofessional. Really loud door bell - who has that is a massage place! Terrible and painful massage. I've had many over the years and it was clear that two of the staff had no idea what they were doing. I'll never go back.

Well, I love getting a massage.  At Massage Envy, you will need to sign up to get member discount.  Members pay monthly fee and will have one one-hour service for free.  I personally like it, because it kinda forces me to take care of myself by getting at least one massage a month.

All the masseuses I have encountered are very good and professional.  No, you can't compare thus to a spa in a 5-star hotel like Four Season or the Wynn Resort in Vegas, but comparing it to lots of massage parlors out there, Massage Envy provides descent priced with professional service.

This place is pretty nasty. The ribs were very dry and definitely was not like MY big daddy's bbq. The waiter was very rude to me and I suspect that they spit in my mashed potatoes. Overall it was pretty good

Big Daddy's does a good job on their BBQ. The location in a strip mall on Cherry in Meridian is easy to get to. Handicap parking is right outside, 2 spots, and with a properly done passage from parking to sidewalk.

The interior is cute, sort of industrial modern. Clean, standard table-chair seating nicely spaced so you don't hear the neighboring diners' conversation. Service was quick and cordial. Questions were answered factually.

Their menu features brisket, pulled pork, ribs-both St.Louis and baby back style pork, turkey, chicken and wings, links, and burgers.They do a brisket in the traditional Texas Way. Nicely done, not too dry, and with a tasty, smokey exterior. Brisket is not found at all BBQ joints around Boise-Meridian. The links are hot and spicy, so be aware. The turkey is a smoked breast, but tastes like it has been brined. My wife thought it was too salty for her tastes. We had sides of french fries, BBQ beans and potato salad. All were enjoyable, better than most places, but not the best we have had. BBQ sauce is available at each table. there are 3 types, vinegary North Carolina style, a spicy, and a sweet sauce.

Beer and wine are available. I had a Sam Adams Oktoberfest and my wife had a Deschutes Pale Ale. Both hit the spot with BBQ items.

We would definitely come back to try the pork ribs.

We took our 14-year old miniature dachshund here due to a persistent cough because we could not get an immediate appointment with our normal vet.  Our dog, Mattie, was diagnosed with an enlarged heart over a year ago and has been on meds ever since.  During the start of the visit, Dr. Zann immediately tried to listen to Mattie's chest and advised that she could not get a good listen to her heart because the dog was so nervous.  Surely my dog has not been the only dog to ever be nervous upon a visit to a vet and the examination by a total stranger.  This was followed by an examination of her teeth and a lecture about the poor condition they were to which I had already acknowledged.  Dr. Zann did no other examination.  She recommended xrays followed by a full dental workup.  I explained that our normal vet had recommended against any dental work due to the concern about putting the dog under anesthesia with a heart condition. Dr. Zann said they do it all the time and reminded me that she had not even heard a heart murmur on Mattie.  This was followed by Dr. Zann leaving the room and an assistant coming back in with a $600 "treatment plan" for xrays, an EKG and a cardiologist review that could take up to a week.  We declined the plan and said that we would wait to visit her normal vet.  The doctor never came back in the room but the assistant did come back in asking us a to sign  "Refusal to Treat" waiver.  The entire experience was very cold and the lack of empathy for both our family and the dog was shocking.

Due to a cancellation we got Mattie into her normal vet the following day who took xrays ($105) and was able to read them herself (no cardiologist needed) and confirmed that her heart had gotten larger and that there was more fluid on her lungs, leading to the additional coughing.  She immediately put our beloved on a regular dose of cough medication and antibiotics which has helped tremendously.  She acknowledged that dental work was needed but was more concerned about first getting the cough under control and making her comfortable.  What a difference!
Cute little cabin feel, good food, good prices, and decent sized bar. Hop on the waitlist because they're always packed!

Not starting out good. I have a doctors appointment tomorrow on January 3 and I still haven't gotten my insurance card.  When I go to their online website I need my member ID to get access, which is only available on my insurance card. When I tried to call their phone number, the recording says they only provide service weekdays 8-5.  The motto is definitely not " providing insurance when you need it"

This review is for 2 visits within 2 weeks of each other. Both times we had an appointment only to wait for 45 minutes just to be herded into a room to wait another 20-30 minutes before being seen by the vet. The 1st time took so long ( 2 1/2 Hours) that even the receptionist said "Have you really been here this long"? when I finally checked out to pay.

 The 2nd time I had waited 35-40 minutes before I asked how much longer because I had waited so long the previous time so she went to the back to ask. Within 5 minutes I was "called" to one of the rooms but before I went in I asked if I was actually being seen now or is there more of a wait. I was told the techs were busy and it would be another 30-45 minutes!! I asked why even bother with an appointment at all if you have to wait potentially 1 - 1 1/2 hours before even being seem? She did not have an answer or an apology for the wait. I should bill you for my time.

Why even make appointments? Thanks for wasting 2 hours of my time.

I fell in love with Montessori education when I worked at a small local school in another state. That local school had three teachers in the classrooms, not the bare minimum for ratios like this school. I personally want to recommend parents to look into sending their kiddos to local Montessori schools not these schools that keep opening up more and more schools for the profit. They were very low staffed but they continued to bring on new kids why? The kids in the baby and toddler classrooms were not being taught Montessori. It's pretty much an expensive daycare. Imagine a full classroom with two teachers and one changing diapers every two hours pretty much leaving one teacher with a full classroom! One teacher even lied that the babies had been painting the day before on the app they use, but when I asked about it she told me no activities were done because it was too busy.  Please look into local schools it really makes the difference now that I've experienced both. I was very optimistic about this school but it's nothing like I thought it would be. They know all the right words to say to make you imagine that your kids are in the best place but that's how it works with businesses that have the money to put into marketing.

This place is the biggest rip-off around.   I would advise anyone to go somewhere else if possible.  Oh, they paint a pretty picture in the beginning but once you get your bill you receive the sticker shock.  Stay away at all costs!!!!

This place has some of the best ice cream I've ever had. Their flavors range from your trusty favorites to unique new tastes. My family and I have already been in several times now. So far I've tried the cherry almond chocolate, butterfinger, and huckleberry cheesecake--all amazing!Plus the shop itself is super cute!

Unlike the Kuna location, this Smoky Mountain franchise is not impressive. Our delivery order took 2 hours to arrive after we were quoted only an hour. I called & spoke to management, and after working in restaurant management, I realize the holiday season is always busy. However, knowing that, over scheduling is a must. They were not prepared. It's not my problem. Management should know that the entire holiday season is super busy! We received a 30% discount, which I appreciate, but hangry guests at home is not cool, esp during the holidays. I'll think twice in the future before ordering delivery here again SMH

We usually are up to a full head of steam on Chinden (Hwy 26) going either way and have failed to stop at Wagner's until the other day. The new highway construction slowed us down and we said, "Why not?" and turned in.

We found a great farmers market in operation since 1982. They're are a local family owned and operated business. They grow some of the produce  sold, such as  lettuce, spinach, kale, tomatoes, summer squash, cucumbers, various melons, sweet corn, green beans, and too many other vegies to mention here. They also locally bringing in, raspberries, cherries, apricots, blueberries, blackberries, peaches, pears, apples, pluots, plums, grapes, huckleberries, & farm fresh eggs. Also have some green plants for sale: herbs, vegies, landscaping.

The day we went we found okra, fresh green beans and some wonderful peaches, smaller but flavorful. Fresh corn and you can shuck it right there and not have to haul the husks home. Cantaloupe was vine-ripe and full of juice and flavor.

Look for the sign on the North side of Chinden (see photos). Right now (8/2014) there is road construction on Chinden, so watch carefully for either of the driveways into the stand. There is going to be a new stop light at 10 Mile and Chinden, so getting into and out of the Farm will be much easier. If, from Meridian, you go past the new highway intersection, you've gone too far. (Note: All photos are from Wagner's Facebook page and their website.)

The parking and access is good to the sales area. Large lot and level. The lot has small gravel (approx. 1/2"-) and is well packed, but people in wheelchairs can practically park at the edge of the sales area building and the inside sales area is concrete and smooth.

Friendly help willing to answer questions and let you know when certain crops will come due.

This stand is so convenient that we'll be sure to stop in at least once a week. The offerings of course change as the growing season progresses. We'll be looking for fresh eggplants soon.

Definitely the worst acrylics I've ever had. I got my nails done 4 days ago, I was unhappy with the shape when I left, she didn't smooth them out at all, and on top of that one of my nails just completely popped off. I didn't even realize it came off until I was washing my hands and saw it. Complete waste of money & I'm definitely never going back. Find a better place to get your nails done.

Customer service is unimportant. Figured I try the Nampa location and actually now I rather go to Boise than be treated like an idiot that will never actually end up paying their bill. If you are considering using CPAP Now-call their number and listen to the telephone prompts, I recently noticed just how condescending the voice prompts are-even to provider offices. I'm ready to pay what's left after the insurance and be done with this company. Going back to Everything CPAP. Shaking my head.

This place is directly across the street from our house, so we regularly stop by on the way out of the neighborhood. The guys and gals working there are always extremely nice and friendly. One thing that has always impressed me is the speed of which they prepare the drinks. Typically it's just a couple moments after you pay they are passing your drink through the window.

It's basically the same price as Starbucks, but quicker service and more importantly you are supporting a local business.  I had my latte there this morning and many more to come in the future!
Food was fear. I had a omelette. My wife had a scramble. Service was excellent. There was a lot of people. We waited for about 5 minutes for our seat.

I have been eating at Artic Circle for 55 years starting in Twin Falls and then in Boise and then Pocatello. We moved out of state for 35 years and when we retired and moved back to Boise we could not wait to eat there again. We have been there many times and each time the food has not been very good, the cheese on the burgers is not melted and the fries are not cooked well and greasy. Today I went and asked for a chocolate chip milk shake and when I got it the ice cream was chocolate and I asked of they made them with vanilla and the young lady said NO, I told her I wished the menu said that as I did not like chocolate and I used to get them and always were vanilla and she just looked at me. Guess I will be going to the DQ as there food is hot and the attitudes are are warm and friendly.

Food was tasty, but our evening was riddled with different issues.

First, they "lost" our reservation and blamed me for canceling it, even though I hadn't canceled. Then it was an accident, then it was at a different time. They use multiple online reservation systems, which is awesome, but seems there are some issues managing them on their end. We ended up waiting about 20 minutes for our table, only once I engaged their manager (who was great!) did we actually get sat.

Second, they were slammed and the bar was very behind. It took a very long time to get drinks, and no comp or anything was offered. Our server was great and communicated well with us, but that was a miss. And we only ended up ordering one round, but had they been quicker we could have had more, increasing our tab, so a loss for the business too.

3rd, one food item was left off (forgot a salad) but they took that off once we pointed it out. Food was slow to come out, but it was hot and tasted great.

Overall, the food was great, but be prepared to take your time and have patience with the staff - they were SO BUSY! Everyone was working hard, just ran into somE struggles,

Let's bring out Skumps the trumpeteer from Sleeping Beauty to announce that this place... is adequate.

Honestly, Meridian has few coffee shops, so this is probably a better option than most... but still not great.
While the coffee is just a notch above 'I-will-throw-this-away-after-two-sips'. The staff is nice, there's a lot of seating, and it's in the Village so at least you have coffee to walk around with.

I attempted suicide with cold medicine. The doctor who "treated" me was rude and verbally abusive. He waited until my loved one was gone for one minute, to come in and yell at me. He accused me of using meth. I told him that was impossible! I was shamed in the ER for attempting suicide, even though I came to my senses and called 911 and got help. I was treated like a meth head and was left in the ER for 17 hours with no food. They dramatically ripped everything out of the room, as if I was going to use ANY item to kill myself, even though I was no longer suicidal. It gave my boyfriend a panic attack. I do not recommended this place unless you are bleeding out.  The only people that are nice there are generally NOT the doctors. I have PTSD from my ER visits there. I have many health problems, due to taking a medicine with deathly allergic reactions. I will never go there again. Even if I need medical help.

This is a chain restaurant and it definitely feels like one. Although the village is a really cool place to hang out, Kona Grill's food is mediocre at best. The atmosphere is great however everything from the sushi to the entrees is just so-so. They do have a really cool wine Wednesday where all bottles of wine are half off. We like to eat somewhere else and then go there for a drink after.

This review is specific for the travel/immunizations clinic-

I was able to get an appointment within two weeks of calling (which I hear is very lucky and not so common - fellow procrastinators, take heed). Upon arriving at my appointment I did the usual - check-in, gave the front desk insurance info, sat down for a moment and waited for my name to be called, etc. My appointment started right on time, and lasted about an hour.

They had me bring my immunization record as well as an itinerary of where I would be traveling to. I was so impressed with the nurse practitioner who saw me (Sarah Sparks) - she was so knowledgeable, professional, able to answer in detail every question I had on the spot, and was also very friendly and personable. 

Going into my appointment I wasn't sure which vaccines were necessary and which were more of precautions for the region I was going to. Sarah made sure I got exactly what I needed for my trip, and then also gave me a lot of helpful information about health and safety while being abroad. To be honest, I was not expecting all of this, but I am so thankful for it! I feel much more practically equipped for my trip after my appointment here. I'd highly recommend this clinic to anyone going to another country where immunizations are necessary. They really go above and beyond here to make sure you are prepared (from a health standpoint) for your travels, and the peace of mind/confidence that brings is invaluable, in my opinion!

Apparently my buyer is using this bank and I have had my closing date changed three times now.  Seems they can't get their paperwork in order in time to complete their process in a timely manner.  
Nice to know so that I will personally never use this bank.  The customer doesn't seem to come first at this establishment.  
Two thumbs down!!
I love love love this place so pretty very good restaurants and drinking places with a nice view. Also it's a good place for family dinners to hanging out with friends to getting day drunk!

I think we're all looking for a neighborhood spot to become our Cheers. When an unexpected date night was gifted to us, I was excited to try out a new  to us place just down the road that had drinks, pool and darts. Admittedly this isn't a neighborhood bar. It's on Eagle road amid all the hustle and bustle of our most choked Idaho corridor. But...it's right next to El Gallo Giro so I was hoping for a fun night with tacos. But Varsity can't seem to decide what kind of bar it is, and I can't really decide either. 

We arrived around 8 on a Wednesday. So clearly not going to be hopping, but boy was it dead! There were two other couples on awkward first dates. It is super dark in there with confusing sections. The long bar greets you when you first come in. It has a very divey feel. There were two bartenders on duty and they were both pretty unfriendly. I don't want to be super chatty with strangers anyway, so I guess it's ok. 

You have to walk around the bar to get to seating, which is laid out like a cigar lounge. Huge leather seats around cocktail tables and couches. A few big screen TVs. 

To one side is a DJ stand with a dance floor and disco ball. So this section is trying to be a dance club?

Through a cased opening, you'll find three pool tables and two dart boards. This section is like a pool hall. The layout is terrible. The tables are WAY too close to each other and the walls. I'm not embellishing when I say we frequently couldn't take shots on the table because our cues kept hitting something. The dart boards are in a little cave area. Again, so dark. 

Layout aside, what really dropped this place to a 2 were the bad drinks. We started with draft beer and it was so warm. My husband had a Coors light and I had a Shock Top. It was painful to drink. They also had no local options on tap which is a huge no no for me. We each got a bottled beer after that and it wasn't much better. Plus a bottled Corona cost me $4.50.

Bummed that it didn't work out here. The hunt continues!

I desperately want to rate this vet care higher as they did preform amazing services in helping my injured animals. I just have a hard time giving a store or business a higher score when they constantly drop the ball on customer interactions.

When you wait for over an hour to pick up a medication you pre called in for is not only mind boggling weird, it's also plain rude to the customers time. Being locked in a waiting room for a vet to visit you for over an hour is also unacceptable. I'm very patient, but at some point you wonder if they forgot about you. 

This might be caused by the fact they are an ER location, but the hours I've had to wait for something that takes less than 4 minutes is just unacceptable. 

The times you do get with a vet is great though. They are thorough on their answers and try to make sure you leave without any unsure areas. 

I wish I could rate higher, but the frustrations I've had here really detract me from wanting to go back. There is something wrong if I'm willing to drive 20 minutes out of my way because I know I'll be out quicker than the location across the street.
Says there open till 6...I'm here at 3 and they are closed!! Really frustrating icon!!! Good thing I don't have a checking account here cus I would switch banks asap!!!

Only use the range.  Do not buy, sell, transfer a firearm here or bring it in for gunsmithing.  They use the ATF software instead of a paper bound book so you can count on any firearm passing through here to be effectively registered.  Registration leads to confiscation.  Get your ECCW and go through a traditional dealer.

I cannot say enough about how much massage and body work has helped me while working from home and dealing with stress of a global pandemic- so grateful for Elements! They are super safe, very sanitized and everyone wears a mask. They have a ton of talented masseuses, and the management and front desk staff are attentive and detail oriented. Highly recommend elements if you are looking for a massage- you can even book online!

I was very disappointed.  Love the Blue corn tacos.  The waitress forgot the best part - the plum sauce.  Took a while to get somebody to help us and get the sauce.  There was a few pieces of steak in each taco.  We had to pay extra for sour cream.  We were asked if we wanted it, but were not told that was extra cost as well as the guacamole.  I used to love Cafe Ole, but this dinner was not worth the cost at all.

I have been to this restaurant a few times now, we were so excited to try some Chicago food we even went on their grand opening day. My whole family lives in Chicago so we enjoy this type of food. I would say overall each time I've gone back the food is just getting worse and worse...not sure if staff is changing or if they are going downhill or what? The grand opening day food was awesome! Great pizza, good beef. I've tried getting the beef sandwich "to-go" and by the time you get home its soggy, so note to self...if you're gonna get this sandwich make sure you eat in. What im really upset about is a pizza I ordered for delivery last night. I noticed they have "WE DELIVER" across their window, thought we'd give it a try. So we tried out a deep dish pizza and some hot wings. The pizza was tasteless and doughy and cold by the time it was delivered...im a patient person tho and realize that can happen and I know they don't have heated trucks like chicago connection(hint hint) but what really got me is part of our pizza was folded over because it didn't fit in the box! Really?! C'mon...does it really cost that much more to get a box that fits your pizza? The wings were ok, we chose mild on the recommendation of the employee...she said hot was pretty darn spicy. The wings were cooked well, they must deep fry them as they were very crispy, but they had no flavor at all! So if you want any flavor I would go with their hot or chicago fire. At least they were edible and we got em for half price because it was happy hour..some places serve slimy gross wings and I hate that. Not sure if we'll be back....hoping this review helps them see they need to make some changes or they are going to lose business.
