I've read lots of recent bad reviews on here..I hope they stay open though...do like to support local businesses. So, if I try it again I will dine in and hope for a better experience.

The restaurant is clean and comfortable.  The staff was very nice and the food has been good every time  I have gone.  Is it the best Bbq around? Well no, but it is good enough for me to continue to return.

Indigo has read the yelp reviews and has been wanting to try Hungry Horse for awhile. She finally convinced me to take her today. 

The decor and music are country. They have wings, chicken strips, waffle sandwiches, Boba tea, and noodle soup. It's a fabulous unexpected combination of American southern food and Asian food.

We ordered the lunch special and went for the three cheese waffle 1/2 sandwich, fries (originally ordered garlic parmesan but was recommended the cajun fries so got that instead), and a peach boba tea. 

I am not a sandwich person, mostly because of the fluffy dry cardboard that passes for bread at sub shops these days, so I avoid them. 

However, At Hungry Horse, they make their sandwiches with waffles (not a breakfast waffle, more like if a croissant and a breakfast waffle had a baby) which has restored my faith in sandwiches.  

I am a boba tea person and their peach boba tea was very refreshing, not overly sweet or watery. It was delightful! 

Which brings us to the fries. The Cajun fries were delicious. Not greasy, not dry, not crazy salty. Just right. Indigo enjoyed them, she appreciates food with a little kick. 

The real gem of Hungry Horse Eatery is the people who work there. They are fantastic, friendly, approachable and genuinely thoughtful. Most excellent people indeed! 

I don't usually eat sandwiches, but when I do, It's at Hungry Horse. 

Indigo gives Hungry Horse Eatery 50 stars for fabulous people, and sassy fries!

Get the chicken salad sandwich. The menu on the wall says it already, "delicious". But grab a fork, 'cause you're gonna need it!

The woman behind the counter who served my dining companion and I was sooooo nice. Helpful, perky, pleasant... all the things one looks for when ordering a sandwich. I wish everyone in customer service was as nice as her. 

Price for the amount of food served is phenomenal. After seeing my full sandwich with chicken salad brimming out the bread, I realized that I should've gotten a half order. 

Having lived and dined in San Francisco for years, I'll go out on a limb and say the bread is OK. It isn't nearly as good as the fresh stuff you can get in the City by the Bay, but hey, you're in Idaho not California. 

Overall, a quick but wholesome lunch in Boise.

If you want to see a 5 star indoor shooting facility, go to this one.  Gun store with lots of inventory. Knowledgeable personnel for sales and classes. I even helped my wife sign up for a class for women learning to handle guns. (Hint: Teaching your wife to handle guns is as difficult as teaching her to use a spreadsheet. I know.)

They also will sell consignment firearms for a very reasonable commission.

The shooting facilities are superb. A range for normal shooting (not combat or tactical), combat/tactical range, 100 yard rifle range. The backstops will handle up to .50 cal rifles. In fact, you can rent a Barrett M107 if you want to try a big boy. Even a telescopic camera system to help sighting in rifles and marking hits. I don't think there is another 100 yard indoor range in the Northwest US.

All the ranges have a range safety officer and full air filtration with a 3 minute cycle time. No lead poison risk here. Targets are on trundles that not only can run targets out to set distances, but can be programmed to stop, expose, disappear, retreat or charge. Lots of fun.

Costs are reasonable for classes as well as for range time, $18 per day- go and come during the day. 

Gee, I might get a part time job here? LOL!

Kona Grill is good year round but my favorite is in the Autumn. Their Jambalaya is the perfect meal for a cold, rainy Autumn day along with a Kentucky Mule to cool your mouth from the hot, spicy Jambalaya! 

One thing I like about this place is that even when it gets crowded and the music is on, you can still hear the person across the table from you. 

Service is friendly and efficient. 

Very roomy and accessible for those of us who need more space.

The staff here is dishonest and rude. I brought my car here and they gave me a laundry list of things to fix along with a $1,300 price tag -- took my vehicle to another shop and was out of there all fixed up for $200. It's not just a money issue -- it's dishonesty!! I understand when companies charge more for quality service/parts, but they were just trying to pull one over on me. They claimed I had leaks and was in real bad shape and neither of those things were true. The front desk guy was a complete a-hole when I told him I needed a second opinion. He badgered me and talked down to me like I was an idiot for driving my car over to another shop. It was crazy and disrespectful. 

Meridian Automotive did the same thing (over price and make false claims about what needed serviced) to my husband and best friend so we will NEVER take our vehicles here again. I will warn as many as I can about their scams and to avoid their business. It is more than a high price tag -- it's dishonesty!

I ordered upper eats. Sushi came really fish smell no Wasabi actually it was two orders of sushi and one packet of soy sauce nothing else disgusting don't order it from Kona Grill it's disgusting I will never go in the restaurant again

This place is great for kids walking age to early elementary. There are so many areas to play, including a mini Trader Joe's, a pretend Idaho Pizza Company, a cave crawl through, a pirate ship, and many more fun things for kiddos! If you have more than one young child it can be a little tricky as the play areas are not all visible at once, you'll have to stick together or bring more than one adult. There is also an outside play area that has giant building blocks and construction diggers. Very fun place for kids- I'd recommend checking it out! Downside- you have to pay for adults! Under 2 is free, everyone else is $9.

Scheduled instillation 4 times in the past month every time no one showed. First three times my order magically disappeared now, they said the tech came and turned it on and should be working ( was home all day and no one came). A month without internet is bull. Have been passed from one person to another and no one is taking responsibility. If I could give 0 stars I would!!!

Great experience!

We visited Joe Mama's on a Sunday, the busiest day of the week! We got on the waitlist which worked out great. Our server, Ruben, was friendly and attentive, all while serving a huge party. The rest of the staff pitched in to help and they were all smiling and thanking each other. I was really impressed! The food was also delicious! I had a spicy veggie scramble with home fries- yum! I definitely recommend this restaurant for breakfast!
The chicken fried steak here is the best I've ever had - it's seriously on another level!  You can tell they use quality pieces of steak cooked and fried in house.  So good!

Service was GREAT!  If you were thirsty before arrive at the restaurant, you won't be after you left Vina. lol

Pretty good fried rice.  

I'm impressed. :)
We had a great time at Happy Hour at Kona Grill in Meridian. Food, service, and environment was so great! Ian provided great service and a fun energy.

Love this place for all of our Traeger needs! We purchased our grill here and absolutely love it. Everyone was super helpful. 

We also come here for snacks when we are in the area. Their Krispy Krunchy chicken strips are DELICIOUS!!! Kids are picky little turds when it comes to food and always devour and request this place when we are in South Meridian. 

Friendly staff!

Food: Delicious
Service: Outstanding
Ambiance: Casual, Noisy
Overall: A
**They are  OPEN ON SUNDAYS**

Stopped by for lunch with friends, and ordered the Special of the Day which was a country fried steak with a side of tots. Was NOT disappointed. The gravy was think, the meat was well cooked, the tots were crisp, and the mac & cheese with bacon was excellent! Also, their fry sauce was so good that we asked what specifically was in it. 

Tried my friend's Loaded BBQ Fries and they were pretty good. The pork on top was extremely juicy and tasty. My only complaint is that the fries on the bottom of the plate were "swimming" in nacho cheese.

Service was outstanding! Extremely friendly and attentive to our requests.

If you're passing by or in the mood for BBQ, definitely give this place a try!

Had a great first experience at The Processing Bar!
Just moved to Boise in august and I'm a little picky when it comes to my hair. I found Mak and the processing bar through hashtags on instagram and decided to make an appointment.
Everyone was very friendly as soon as I walked in.
I'm so use to my last hair stylist (whom I love) killing my scalp when rinsing my hair that I expected it here too. Mak was very gentle and I was able to relax during that process lol. Good to know.
Very happy with my hair, it looks like everything I asked for and more!
Thanks Mak, I look forward to your future services!

We made a reservation for 530 on the patio. They confirmed the reservation. 530 on the patio. We arrived 15 minutes early and were told that there was no table on the patio for us but a booth inside. They then told us that we "couldn't have made a reservation for the patio because they don't take reservations for the patio". 
I get it, you maybe have a new host and they made a mistake... mistakes happen... but a F***ING reservation was made nonetheless. Not only do you not honor the reservation but you make no effort to get us on the patio... any you don't even apologize for your damn mistake. 
I've enjoyed dining with you in the past. I've enjoyed the food and enjoyed the service. I will no longer give my support or business to this establishment.

Arrived early and checked in. The sent me a messzge when taable was ready.  Our waitress was marvelous. The rest of the meal was poor. We waited an hour for our food. And it was general menu items. My Albacore cooked spicy was cold and dry. The fish had no moisture whatsoever, the turmuric rice had good flavor but was also dry and not hot. Plate was hot. They but overcooked, cold food on a warm plate. I was so hungry by then I ate it anyway.  We had ordered dessert when we ordered our meal but still had to wait  over 30 minutes after the meal for it to be served. It was the only part  of the meal that was fantastic, however. When the Bill  came they had charged us  for an extra cocktail, the waitress took it off and she also comped one of the desserts since we waited so long.  The place was packed. Hope the others had a better experience. No COVId restructions here except servers wore masks. We won't  go back.


.
The bread, the bread and the bread make it so good. Tried the tuna, so good! Soup makes it a great match. Busy at 12:00 weekdays.

WinCo gets 5 stars from me for being the first grocery store (that I've seen) that has a sign on their door not allowing animals. I love animals but they have no place in a grocery store. (With the exception of service dogs!)
My kids always have a good time here. We love that you can leave and return after grabbing a snack.

Epic Shine has been my go to spot for getting my car washed since moving to Idaho! The monthly subscription fee is totally reasonable and for one price I can go through as many times as I would like! They have a lot of bays available with vacuums, trash cans, and plenty of microfiber towels to dry your car and clean the inside as well. 
I have tried a couple of other places who offer monthly membership and have been underwhelmed.  So, Epic Shine will forever me my car wash spot!

one girl almost dropped an eggroll and used her body to block it from falling on the floor so it touched her clothing before she caught it and put it back in the tray. food prepared without gloves with gloves very visible for use. Overall disgusting food handling.

I go to different restaurants for different things. Meaning, I figure out what it is that a restaurant does really well, and then go back solely for that. The "thing" that has me hooked at Kona is their happy hour. Their food is good, but their happy hour prices are what make me choose this place over the slew of other sushi restaurants in the area! 

They have rolls varying from $5 to (I believe) $8 on their happy hour menu. I usually snag a vegetable roll, spicy tuna, California roll, or if I am feelin' fancy, a bama roll. Other items on their menu that I really enjoy are the avocado egg rolls, potstickers, and the chicken and shrimp lettuce wraps. 

In addition to their food, this restaurant provides a fun and bustling atmosphere. It is a bit loud/busy, so if that is not your speed, I would recommend coming here during their slower hours. I've dined here during both their busy and slower hours, and the service is aways prompt, friendly, and attentive!

Not only did my parents have to wait like 5-6 hours for a bed, but the admitting doctor who was handling my mom, who has COVID, immediately got defensive and slightly hostile when my mom responded "no" to the #1 question of the year: are you vaccinated for COVID. What happened to working in the health care system for the genuine desire to care for people's health and well-being? One of the only things that most of these health care workers do is follow some garbage narrative that's been so politically-driven for the past 2 years and they let it affect their bedside manner; very unprofessional to the point where my dad is afraid that my mom won't get equal quality of treatment because of her personal medical decisions and that she might die there due to their negligence. That's not what hospitals are for...

I have been coming to IIS for a couple months now. I've purchased several firearms and yesterday I even brought my mom. The staff has been nothing short of welcoming, which is quite a luxury being a female shooter. Tim, Gio, Gavin, and the rest of the crew all get an A+ from me. I'm now a range member and I've taken one class. Back for my Enhanced Concealed Carry soon. 

By far the most consistent stock of ammo around, and not too shabby on firearms as well. I have talked to a bunch of different staff members and I've always been treated with respect and appreciation. 

Thanks, Team, for always being there to answer my questions.

We were so excited to get back in here, to have a drink on the patio and eat some delicious (not homemade!) food. The visit started off really well... which is why they have any stars at all. He walked in with a group of 4 adults and a couple kids. Waited 15ish min for them to set up the patio table.. so far so good. The table is perfect... exactly what we wanted. 
Then we sat for 10-15 minutes without seeing another employee. So when the server finally came for the drink order we just ordered everything.. drinks, food... the works. 
Drinks come out and are delicious but it's another 20 min before we see a server. No water refills, no drink refills. Fail.
Food comes out and it's 2 entree salads and 2 burgers. Both the salads are so over dressed everything was just sitting in a puddle of dressing. 
Both of the burgers were tasty but pretty severely undercooked. Fail.
The food was delivered by runners, so again we have no water refills or drink refills. No service for 10 min easy. My son had requested a spoon for his Mac and I eventually just went and got it myself. No one came to ask how the food was. No refills for anyone. Fail.
The server eventually finds her way back to the table, we order a couple drinks. The server appears didn't hear 1 of the 2 drinks ordered so we canceled it because the drink that finally did come out took 15 min to arrive. Fail.
Never once did any empty glass or plate get removed from our table. We were a party of 6 and glassware is falling over whenever anyone moved. The fact that no glasses were broke is a damn miracle. 
Look, I know it's tough right now... finding people to work.. but this was absolutely atrocious in just about every respect. The wait times alone should have earned a visit from the manager. If the service was crap due to the servers being slammed you'd think that we would see management running food, drinks, touching tables, something... but nothing. 
It's been a very VERY long time since I've EVER seen such a complete shit show. I wouldn't enter this restaurant again if I was paid to do so. 

The only reason there are any stars is for the host staff! They really did a great job at getting us such a wonderful table on the patio. Also, my son (8) said his Mac and Cheese was "the best ever".

Love this place! Large portions, food came out hot, seasoned well, and fresh.

We got the vegetarian scramble, French toast, and hot coffee. French toast was spongy and not overly eggy. Scramble had a large amount of fresh veggies, but was a great balance and didn't overpower the eggs.

Would recommend and will return! Recommend checking in online to get a table ahead of time. They don't take phone reservations.

Had a reservation but waited 45 min to be seated after a lot of attitude from the hostesses. Had a great waiter but had to wait another 45 min to get our food. Food was good but not worth what we went through to get it. I have eaten many times there before but was so disappointed in this experience that I won't be back.

This is a great place for littler kids. It has a bunch of interactive displays that the kiddos love. I would say this is more aimed at ages 3-8. Our 8 year old went and had a good time but was less impressed with the displays and bored a bit easier. It is a tiny space but they did a good job making it feel spread out. I wanted more Idaho history but that's just me.

In an attempt to have a similar experience like I had on my last visit, I've learned that good luck doesn't always strike twice. Since it was a holiday weekend, I went with my hair already just washed hoping it'll make the stylists life a little easier to give me a blow-out. I had a wait, even though I booked online and followed the check-in process. I was eventually serviced by a gal who was more interested in telling me that my hair is superiorly damaged, probably in an attempt to tempt me into buying product. Anyway, my blow-out was far from being acceptable; the top part was ok - it was straight - but once I got home and pulled up a section all I saw was just all kink. Shame on her for giving me a mediocre blow-out at best; I get it that it was busy, but I'm paying good money for a service and the least she could've done was give me what I had asked for (not a kinked mess, which I had to correct myself when I got home).

Let's begin. I don't write reviews but after dealing with this company's poor ethics and terrible customer service I felt inclined. I'll start with, it takes a couple months to even get on the books.. therefore I asked to cancel my membership and was told I needed to use all my accrued hours before my cancellation or that it would just be money lost. So I scheduled, with a massage envy meridian receptionist, months in advance my remaining packages.. 

Well it comes to the final month of my membership and due to them losing their facial employee, im out that one appointment. I was told on the 15th of November after my massage by the Meridian ME receptionist that I had 2.5 remaining hours to use before my cancellation. They didn't have any availability for massages the remainder of the month and even the next month. Therefore, after calling again and being assured I had 2.5 hours, I gifted an hour to my Mom. I then went to my final massage scheduled months in advance and upon completion was told I needed to pay for it because I had no more packages. I stated to the receptionist that they had informed me multiple times I had 2.5 hours remaining and that's the whole reason why I gifted an hour. She said that I was free to go home so I tipped my therapist and left. I was told if there were any issues the manager would call the following day. She never called. Then two days later my bank account is charged. Never did I hear from the manager even after calling about the wrongful charge. Terrible ethics, terrible customer service. Go  somewhere else that conducts better service.
Worst haircut I have had.  It was an absolute butcher job.  I may have been this stylist first ever haircut.
Rude management. I came in last week for the first time and saw the management berating an employee in front of guests. Definitely will not be returning.

For the second time in the last two years I have a family member who received the WORST MEDICAL CARE POSSIBLE in a hospital, once they arrived on the 6th Floor.  What is it with the staff on that floor?  On the relative's last admission they were tied in a bed, due to fall risk, and unable to get assistance for long, long, long, periods of time to go to the bathroom.  I personally witnessed this relative waiting 40 MINUTES for a nurse to arrive for assistance on another occasion and in addition, on a third occasion I had to go out to the Nurses Station and request the Charge Nurse to get assistance. The care in the Emergency Room and the Internist on Staff at this visit were fabulous!!!  Not so on last admission but not to digress.  On this admission the relative was given a laxative and when it started working, guess what??? again, no one was answering the call button.  A Housekeeping employee was flagged down by the patient, but they were not qualified to assist.  Long story short, this did not have a happy ending and the relative, who is terminally ill, by the way, felt terribly degraded, embarrassed, humiliated, need I say more?  Where is the compassion and empathy?  Are there not enough employees to provide care?  Lastly, when the patient was discharged, they were discharged without their personal effects (it actually appears no one even bothered to help).  The patient was confused, terribly ill and at almost midnight that night this writer ended up going to the hospital to retrieve the terminally ill patient's, I remind you, pain medication and blood thinner which had not been sent home with the patient.  Is this the treatment you want for your loved one? How about your terminally ill loved one?  My experience with this hospital is when you bring a patient in with a terminal illness, we all know that terminal doesn't mean tomorrow, they might as well roll over and die.  In conclusion, this patient has beautiful architecture, beautiful paintings and interior decoration but what about the care that occurs within those walls?

We took our dog to All Valley on July 6th and they determined that she needed surgery to remove a foreign body. We were given a written estimate of the cost of service, a detailed explanation of the the charges and asked to sign to consent. We signed and they did the surgery. When we checked out, they gave us an invoice for $1400 with a detailed list of charges. A few days later, she still had not had a bowel movement & when I called, they said to bring her in for a follow up visit at no charge. We went in and they said to give it a few more days and when she still hadn't gone to the bathroom, I called and was told to bring her in, on July 14th and specifically said it was at no charge, when I asked. We did and they wanted to do an x-ray. We were under the impression this was included in the free follow up visit and no explainataion was given about cost or charges before the x-ray, as they had previously done. They did the x-ray, found her to be fine. We checked out and were told we could leave...no invoice was given to us, no mention of a charge or charges, like previous visits where they make arrangements for payment before you leave. We left thinking it was a free follow up. THREE MONTHS LATER, on 10/9/18, we got a voicemail that there was an outstanding invoice for $112.00. I didn't notice the message until 10/18/18 and called and talked to Will and then to Kim who explained that we owed for the follow up visit ($32) and xray ($80). I explained that no one told us about ANY charges that day and we weren't told verbally about a charge or given an estimate, quote or asked to sign an authorization AND weren't given an invoice when we left. I also didn't even get a bill or invoice in the mail and the FIRST I KNEW OF THIS CHARGE WAS THREE MONTHS LATER. They said they don't send bills usually they just call when it's past due. They offered to take the charge of $32 of but said I had to pay the $80 for the xray. I asked to talk to their boss and was told she would only take it off if, after reviewing the video of the room, they saw that there was no consent given to do the x-ray. I told them we DID consent, but thought it was included in the follow up. They made me pay the $80 charge. I would have had no problem paying, if i had been told there was a charge and given the opportunity to approve or decline, or even just be aware of the charges. But to wait three months with no billing or invoicing, and then call about past due charges...that's just bad business and poor customer service.

It was a great range great selection, great fun. I only have a complaint about two out of four employees I had encountered the other two were great. first situation was a older man the was working the floor and I had just shut the door to the range and pulled a granola bar out of my pocket to eat and he disrespectfully shouted to come over to him and in a rude way said to 'not eat in his range' I was quick to apologize and said I wouldn't, remind you  I was out of the range.  After that he continued to hound me if I didn't read the signs and made jokes to another man about me infront of the rest of the customers, I tried to just walk to the lady and get some diffrent guns to shoot and he kept trying to embarrass me I responded ' I can't do anything more than apologize and not do it' he kept going. The other gun range supervisor that he joked with followed me in the range and made sly remarks about the clothing I wore in front of the other shooters, I wear bright clothing but that's my choice I shouldn't have to defend this, so I left early and didn't get to enjoy the range or money I spent on it ( witch isn't cheap). so it was a big bummer .

I get angry edamame every time I dine in, love it! However, I recommend not ordering angry edamame to go. It's magical when you order it for delivery or to go.......it makes you angry. I've ordered it 3 times through a delivery service and it has been poor. This time I went to have a beer and pick it up and it was somehow worse. For one you get far less food when ordering to go at kona grill and the quality suffers. Dine in only restaurant.

I came in today for my first time, and I was very impressed! Right off the bat I was taken by the bright, contemporary atmosphere inside. My dining companions and I sat right near the large fish tank which I thought it was such a cool touch.. The tank was incredibly clean and stocked with some very cool exotic fish, fun for adults and especially kids to look at while you dine!  We all started with iced tea, I tried the blackberry and the hibiscus teas. Both were very floral, bright and totally refreshing. I appreciated that they came unsweetened, with just a lemon wedge and sugar on the side should you choose to add it.  I ordered the jambalaya, my husband ordered the lobster mac, and his grandma opted for the seared tuna. My jambalaya was AMAZING,  I mean seriously, it was on point. If you're like me and you enjoy a healthy dose of spice this certainly won't disappoint. I also tried the lobster mac and cheese and it was insanely good, not to mention loaded with lobster meat! I think Kona Grill is my new favorite place for seafood here in town. Our waiter was very polite, helpful and professional and one of the managers was walking around the restaurant checking on tables so that was very nice. My only sad moment was when I accidentally spilled my drink after we had paid and nobody came to help us get it cleaned up, which totally wasn't a big issue. It just would have been nice to get some extra napkins. All in all, we had a wonderful lunch and I can't wait to come back and try some more of the menu! :)

I ditched the husband and kids for a couple of hours and I came out a new woman. Angela gave me an amazing deep tissue massage! Highly recommend. I dislocated my fibula a few weeks ago and she was super gentle and was even able to massage parts of it where I felt relief. $60 for an hour of straight relaxation!
They had great ice cream and a good menu. The service was great as well, employees were very kind and genuine.

Was able to try this place out for the first time last night and I was pleasantly surprised. 

My friend had made reservations, so we did not sit in the bar area for happy hour. That is one of the things I am looking forward to trying out next visit. I scanned through the items and it seemed to be a decent happy hour. 

What I very much so enjoyed was my dinner selection. I ordered the salmon and tuna narturo (sp?) off of the sushi menu. It had no rice and instead of a seaweed wrap or soy paper, it was wrapped in cucumber. I have really been trying to watch my eating habits lately and this "roll" totally hit the spot and I didn't hate myself after hahah! I didn't feel guilty about having a glass of wine or two. 

The restaurant was very clean and the staff was very friendly. I'm definitely looking forward to returning and sitting on the patio to watch the water show when the weather cools down.

Came in on a Sunday for a day pass. Wouldn't allow me to lift because they don't do weekend passes. Would not take my money because they didn't want to print out a liability waver. Heads up to out of towners and traveling athletes. Wasn't very welcoming

Joe Mamma's of Eagle Idaho. This restaurant came highly recommend to us as we continue our weekly date day breakfast trip. We arrived a bit late for breakfast, close to 11am, but there was still a significant wait time. We were quoted about 20-30. There were quite a few people waiting and what is incredibly weird is that there were 4 visible tables empty waiting to be sat. For the duration of the 20 minute wait several people finished their meals and would leave, tables would get bussed and cleared, and yet no one would be sat down from the waiting area. 

It's incredibly frustrating to wait and see open tables and chairs. Eventually we were called and I did a count of all the booths and tables available and came to 7 not including where we sat. 

Other than the awful first impression I ordered the Denver omlete with hashbrowns and swapped my toast for a pancake (AT NO CHARGE!!). Pancake was huge, bigger than a dinner plate, and fluffy without being too heavy. Easily a 8.2 pancake out of 10. 

The omlete was a bit bland as were my hashbrowns. Overall it was a good meal for the cost. Similar order would be close to 35.00 and we walked out at 23.00. 

3.4 out of 5.

My family and I have been members for 4-5 years now and the golfing staff is great. Love the gym! However, this year, a problem has surfaced at the pool. This year's poolside servers refuse to serve. You have to beg for drinks. We will go up to the window because they won't come to our table to ask for drinks. They say they will bring them over...15 minutes later there is nothing on our table. Most times, I will walk into the pool house to use the restroom and the servers are all sitting at a table doing nothing. I understand this isn't a true restaurant, but at a country club I would expect better service.

Terrible service. Lots of add on prices. Spotty and slow coverage. Despite being rated one of americas worst companies, they have not made any material changes to policy, practice or personnel. While there are limited other options in Boise, do not make the mistake of signing on with this company.

My family and I recently moved to Nampa and purchased a home that needed the carpet desperately clean.  Being that we were in a tight schedule and trying to also keep our social distancing we hoped to find someone who could do the job.  Searched yelp, called a few people until 
I found Craig from Carpet Clean Team. He was super nice and flexible to work with us. We did come to a little hurdle when It came to the water being shut off but he patiently waited. Got the water back on and he went straight to work. Craig did his thing, took his time and the results were amazing.  Carpet was clean and smelled great! No more dark dingy dirty spots. Thank u so much Craig

I went to Slanted Rock when they first opened, excited to try their beer. I was very unimpressed and haven't returned. However, I attended the Pray For Snow Beer Festival this weekend and Slanted Rock was one of the breweries pouring. I was PLEASANTLY SURPRISED when I tried their beer...WHAT AN IMPROVEMENT!!!!! The vanilla porter was amazing!!! I will be heading back to the brewery very soon for some more. Well done on improving your beer over the last few years...WELL DONE!!! They don't serve food, just food trucks outside....that is why I gave them 4 stars.

This place used to be so good. Then over the last year the quality and service has gone way down hill. First the cleanliness is so terrible. Sticky tables and floors, bathroom trash cans ovetflowing and lots of staff standing around. The food quality has also gone way down. It is bland, soggy, and honestly disgusting. We used to eat here a few times a month and were always satisfied, now we barely can eat it. The service is also deteriorating....mistakes on every order and simple things like no beans or extra sour cream. Disappointing as now we wouldn't even give this place a second chance.

We have been used to having good meals at this restaurant since it opened a few years ago. Unfortunately last night was not a great experience. There was a hair in our appetizer, and the other appetizer was so spicy we couldn't even eat it. The sushi roll that came for me was put together so poorly it fell apart before you could eat it. I don't understand why restaurants in this area start out so great and then all the service seems to slip.

Best gym in the Treasure Valley. The environment. The Coaches. The members. The community. Everything about it. If you're looking for a place to lift and a community all about support, encourage, and self growth - this is the place to go  Mecca fam is the best fam. Out of town-ers: this is THE kind of gym I look for on the road. Open 24-7. Plenty of equipment for any serious lifters, plenty of cardio equipment, and showers in the locker rooms. You won't be disappointed making a stop into the Mecca on your way through town.

We found this restaurant about six months ago and go there at least once a month now.  

All of our meals so far have been very good and consistent.  To us that is important since I find this type of restaurant can very depending on the visit - so this is a plus. 

Since the place isnt totally known yet its easy to get in and your served with a friendly wait staff.  Location is clean too and easy if you have children.

It is worth the try and I think you will be happy with the choice to give it a chance.
Cafe Meh.  Food came out too fast to be good - guess they have a high-powered microwave back in the kitchen.

Reservations don't matter to them. We called for a reservation for 7:00 and without any issues was told we got you at 7:00. After arriving and seeing multiple people get seated that arrived after us we asked and was told another 15 min and "we can't make people leave."  Been 15 more min and still waiting. If we thought we could get food before our movie we would not give them our money but at this point we don't feel like we have an option. 

Poor table management and even worse customer service with attitude.

Walked across the village to yard house and got a seat in half the time we waited past our reservation time.

if i could give zero stars I would. The owner and manager absolutely disgust me. We get there and had to wait at least an hour which isn't the issue, but as we were getting seated our host wiped his nose with his hands on 3 occasions ( 2 while we waited in the waiting area) and without sanitizing grabbed menus and handed them to us Which is unprofessional and during the pandemic not safe, especially since my mother suffers with health issues. we obviously thought the manager would like to know to prevent this from happening again. She comes out with an attitude and as my mom explains what happened, dismisses her and asks her what else she needs, and walks away. My mom obviously unhappy with that experience wants to talk to the owner, due to the fact that she feels she would want to know as it is feedback that could help since they serve all kinds of people. Then the owner comes out looking annoyed from the get go as did the manager and then she goes off. I cannot began to explain the rudeness and vulgar words that come out of her mouth. She even has the audacity to put her finger in my moms face as she just sits there shocked. She goes off saying lies etc. She was so vile, and attacked my mother. She said to not shame a child, when all my mother was doing was giving feedback because the snot on the menu made her uncomfortable as she should. This behavior is so disgusting and especially coming from a owner. This could've been handed so differently with just a "of course we will take care of that" I am just so ashamed that someone would talk to my Mom like that, when she did nothing to deserve that kind of reaction. Please think twice before eating here.

Okay. .really, my expectation was low.."just another sandwich shop" is what I thought when coworker wanted to go here..BUT,  these sandwiches are piled high with thick layer of your meat choice atop lettuce or coleslaw on DELICIOUS sourdough with perfect chewy crust!  Extremely helpful staff everywhere  (it was VERY busy) but everyone on top of it, with a smile...nice to experience that!  I had salad (trying to cut down on bread which I truly was regretting once saw & smelled!) but the sourdough crutons good with little chunks of meat (ONLY critique would be that lettuce should be cut smaller!).  Ok,  yes it has an Eagle Rd address but you DON'T see the store front from Eagle! You need to go E on Goldstone, turn north (opposite T Mobile) into center of buildings..voila! Will be back was well worth looking for!

The food wasn't bad but my order being over 30 minutes late with zero explanation or apology was less than ideal! Very disappointed, guess I'll try out some other local restaurants that care about their food and maybe even their customers.

Went in here for a full set - and 4 nails came off 3 days later.  Went back, and they fixed them for no charge, which was great, however, same thing - 3-4 days later, 4 nails came off.  Not sure what's going on, I do love Natalie here, but I'm not going to come back after both of my experiences.  I'm going to have to find a new place and hope that it's successful.

I wouldn't give it one star! Should have believed the other reviews. The server was great. The food was great. It was a last resort at 10pm. One star for the way we were greeted. We walked in knowing they closed at 11pm (Yelp) and the mgr says "his cook had been there all DAMN day"....ok. Dude really? Talk about not feeling welcomed. We stayed at the motel next door and the morning mgr was great. That's why we went back. When is a good time to visit Shari's?

This makes for an absolutely STUNNING family outing, date night, or hangout. In cold and warm weather, this place is where it's at!! 

The beautifully designed shops, movie theater, and restaurant make The Village Outlets look like something out of the movie. There is a breathtaking water show multiple times a day in the very center at the large fountain that I'd highly recommend planning your time around. In the winter, there are even handwarming/fire pit stations in the main square! So charming!! 

Bring a friend, a loved one, or yourself and expect a beautiful experience! The shops and restaurants are tasteful and delicious! 10/10 recommend any time you're in town!
Stopped by on Thursday, worst hamburger ever. Hamburger patty was way overcooked and dried out.  Like chewing on a hockey puck. Epic fail.
Husband & I come here AT LEAST once a week! The best bread in Boise. So tender, crunchy and soft!

Highly recommend this store for their service and ability to allow their customers to make their own personal decisions in regards to this so called "pandemic".  Thank you Dunkley for your business and making this a smooth transaction.  I'll be recommending everyone I know to come see you and shop at Dunkley.   

Rich, I'll be back for that Steinway piano soon. :)

My husband and I went to Joe Momma's for the first time yesterday morning and it was DELICIOUS! We like to try quite a variety of foods when we go to a new restaurant, but then we also like to have our own Corned Beef Hash 
The corned beef was fresh, juicy, and the house potatoes were seasoned just right! We shared a single order of eggs Benedict, another breakfast favorite, and the hollandaise sauce was on point. It had a hint of tang with the creaminess it deserves. 
The pancake was big and tasty, unlike other restaurants who have extra large pancakes that taste like  Definitely get the biscuits, they were also very tasty. 
Our server was Ruben, or Booben on our receipt  He was awesome! Thank you for serving us! 
Highly recommend  We will be back

Had the beef gyro at lunch. Friendly staff and quick service. Really wanted the gyro to be better though. It was ok, a lot of sauce but not much meat. Fries were fries, nothing great or bad about them. I probably won't be making it back anytime soon but would recommend their main dishes more than the gyro.

Meridian pain clinic is manned by malicious liars who  treat their patients with malice and ruin lives.  They banned my wife even though we proved their drug test was false by immediately having a 3 rd party retest.

Their actions blacklisted my wife who
Is now suicidal due to years of horrific pain.  We should have sued them into the Stone Age.

We have proof of malice, mistreatment, lies, malpractice etc.  come at me with a liable
Suit.  PLEASE.  

You took he life from her just because she blew the whistle on your abuses.

The administration of St Luke's Meridian has ruined our lives and all the decent lawyers are on their retainer.... 

And nobody at the state including our governor will move a finger to help.

The pain clinic might as well be run by the devil himself.

Come at me!  I have voice recordings, emails and paper trails galore!!!

Food was good but I didn't think it was anything to rave about.  I think it's expensive for breakfast, check after tip was about $45 for three of us, only coffee for drinks and one person only eating pancakes.  $6 for 2 pancakes is ridiculous, I don't care how big they are they're super cheap to make.   It was so loud we couldn't even hear the background music.  Our service was OK, but we heard one server profusely apologizing to two different tables while we were there so I guess there were some problems.

I would rate this business a negative 1. We we're going to be a new patient . We had an appointment for our dog at 2pm to be seen for the first time. The businesses website link for their Kuna office brought us to an Merdian address. I called the office at 10 till 2pm and said we can't find the building. I told the person on the phone that the link to map quest came from their site. She said sounds like you are in Meridian. I said ok., we will have to go get redirected and would be then late for the appointment. She said if you are more then 10 minutes late they would have to reschedule. I then explained we were new to the area and the address link came from their website. I then told her my dog was ill and needed to be seen Today. The next available appointment for both of their offices was Thursday. I said my dog is sick., she said I understand but we are booked. gee...thanks. Such bad service from the start. We have now moved on to another Vetrinary clinic in the are that was able to see our dog.

With everything that's been going on - lock down, self-quarantine, etc., Easter dinner was kind of up in the air. I got an advertisement that the Sunrise Cafe was doing a full take out ham dinner, and all you had to do was heat it up. We figured we'd give it a try. We had not eaten there before (we're fairly new to the area), but had heard pretty good things. We could have had the meal delivered, but decided to pick it up. It was great! The maple glaze for the ham (which was already sliced) was delicious, the red mashed potatoes were perfect, even the rolls and raspberry jam were good. We had plenty leftover for other meals, which reduced our need for groceries or other take out during the week. I would do this again, even if we weren't stuck at home, and we're planning to try the restaurant when we can get out again!

I've been looking for a premium ice cream place and finally found it. Everything is hand made here. I tried the Peachy Peach that consists of a sweet cream base and real local diced peaches. Kudos to Lovejoy's for dicing the peaches for a good texture consistency instead of large frozen chunks like I've had elsewhere. The ice cream is creamy and not over-sweet. Its a perfect blend of perfection in a cup or cone. Scoops start at $4 for a single large portion which I thought was priced correctly. There are some specialties as well like ice cream paninis' between two cookies. No printed receipts though for us budget hawks.

I moved to Boise 16 months ago and have seen the signs for Big Daddy's......but for some reason, never stopped in. Now I feel like I've been missing out for 16 months.  I lived in the Carolinas so my palette is very particular to GOOD BBQ.    Big Daddy's nailed it.   Sandwich bread was perfectly toasted/grilled.  Brisket was tender and flavorful.   Sauces were right on the money.   Mac and cheese was fantastic.   Decor of restaurant is perfect and comfortable. 

Congrats Big Daddy's....I'll be back !!!

I love the knowledgeable staff, I took my daughter higher and violin to a different store I know silly me, they try to tell me because she had no fine tuners that's what we needed to put on it to get it to tune it. I walked out of that store drove down to Dunkley all we needed was some peg dope BAM we have a tuned violin thank you so much Dunkley for being top in the game you have all my business from now on.

A few reasons to avoid this car wash, in my opinion--

$16 for the same car wash you can get at Costco for half the price (minus the access to vacuums.)

I recently went to this location because I was in the area and didn't have time to go to Costco.  I pulled up behind another car in the regular lane (ie. non-member lane.)  Another car pulled up to the member lane next to me.  I was thinking it wasn't a member...no sticker, waiting there.  Sure enough the attendant went over there to serve that individual first, even though they weren't a member and had butted line in front of me.


When he returned to my car, I asked if the other car was a member.  And he said they weren't.  I pointed out that they butted line in front of those of us waiting in the correct lane for non-members.  I'll spare you the excuse I got.  But, anyway, that's a basic customer service fail and easy to avoid.  What happened to basic customer service?  Why pay an attendant to provide the sales pitch for membership and ask for a tip when they're not covering the basics of managing the incoming cars?

Also, my car wasn't that clean after the first wash.  I went through a second time to get it cleaner.  I left it at 2 stars vs 1 bc the gentleman who swiped me in on the second pass through was a lot more professional.

You make a reservation thinking you will get in and make plans accordingly. You show up and told no table as their kitchen is running behind. 55 minutes later still no table but "clear one for us". Only to be put in bar at table where we specifically chose not to be be seated. Restaurant was our reservation. I could could of showed up and got a bar table in the same wait time. No apology from hostess just dropped us at table and scooted back to the safety of the fortress at front door. So much chaos and upset people at reservation desk that could not hear them calling names. And the digital DJ squeezed in with us all.  Kitchen was behind but you get to see people coming in and out for pick up orders or Doordash drivers. For the expense of Kona Grill I would expected much better customer service and experience. Maybe not a destination dining experience. Only bright spot was server in the bar was friendly and attentive.

I have been to the Kona Grill 4 times now, so I think it is about time that I sit down and write them a review.  Each time I have gone, I have overall had a good experience, but I can never say that it has been a "Woohoo!  As good as it gets!" experience.

I would say the quality and taste of the food is A-OK, I haven't tasted anything that I was smitten over, but also nothing that I would consider to be a horrible failure.  

Items I have tried (disclaimer, I have been told their menu rotates so it is possible that something I list may not be there at the time you visit)

Chicken Satay:  Good flavor
Edamame:  Good balance of salt and very fresh!
Kona chopped chicken:  Generous amount of chicken, I recommend the dressing on the side.
Steak and Lobster Roll:  Flat, I didn't taste anything outstanding on this one.
Atlantic Roll:  Flat, there really wasn't any flavor to this one.
Picasso Roll:  This one was too spicy for me, I couldn't taste anything but the hotness.
Sashimi: Salmon, Shrimp and Tuna:  Nice size piece of fish, tasted very fresh.
Key Lime Pie: Tart, but creamy
Brownie:  This has got to be one of the best things on the menu!  Delicious!! 

I find the sushi here to consistently taste fresh, but there seems to always be something missing.  Something to give that wow factor.  I also have found the making of them to be inconsistent.  Sometimes the cut of fish is generous, sometimes I can barely find the fish in the roll.  On my last trip, the roll I ordered was falling apart before I even got it up off the plate. I have been told the sushi chef's can make anything, if you ask.  But that would require me to have enough imagination to conjurer up something awesome.  Not sure I know how to do that.

On the last visit, the waitress told us to not order the spinach and artichoke dip, so perhaps other yelp reviews are correct that this is not a good choice. 

All of the mixed drinks I have had, have been very good.  The blended margarita during happy hour was delicious!  

The child's menu is very extensive and HUGE!  Two children could easily share it.

The area that I consistently have issues with this restaurant, and where it seems that most everyone else does too . . . . is the SLOW service.  I have been here on a weekdays, weekends, lunch time, dinner time . . . . it honestly does not seem to matter.  The waitstaff is always prompt, courteous and attentive, so I can only assume it has to have something to do with the kitchen area.  On my last visit here, I came with a group of girls for apps and drinks on a Wednesday night during happy hour.  Our mixed drinks seemed to take a considerable amount of time to come out (in fact I opted to not order a second one, because I was worried it would take too long to come out). The apps took forever.  In fact, we finished what we thought was all of them, only to realize that we had ordered more.  The waitress never mentioned that we still had a few coming.

All in all, for a chain restaurant I would say it is better than others. The food is good, the atmosphere is comfortable, the service is friendly.  You just have to make sure you are not in any hurry, so plan lots of time for conversation.
Don't know when they left, but this place is Belly-Up, Kaput, Finito, Non presento, Morto......Closed.

I took my pug here to get his nails trimmed and have only great things to say.  Courtney did a great job and cut them perfectly.  She was great with him and he wasn't a terrible dog during his time there.  I'll definitely be back.

Indigo and I love The Village at Meridian. It is perfect for any occasion. Coffee with a friend? Wine with a friend? Lunch with a friend? The Village. Family in town? The Village. Date night? The Village. Need some cute clothes? Want to see a movie? The Village. Does your kitchen need a brand spankin new rolling pin? Story time for the kids? Christmas shopping? You get it. 

Unless you've been hiding under a rock, you've probably been to The Village. 

There's too much to list, but it's like downtown only with less bars, better free parking, a playground and a Fountain!!!!!!!!!!!!! The location is great for meeting a group of friends and the shops are fantastic even if you're just window shopping. 

The lost and found is on their A game (yeah, been there). The bathrooms are amazing and clean. They have a moms room in the ladies bathroom that looks like a mini lounge, changing tables, and a family bathroom.

The whole place is impeccably clean and has pretty landscaping and flowers. There is a park right across the way with a playground, basketball court, pond for fishing and picnic area. 

The surrounding area has more shops and restaurants as well so if you're a little bored, sort of hungry, need some wardrobe inspo, want to avoid doing the dishes, or just need a fancy garlic press, stop by The Village. There's something for everyone. 

I don't always avoid doing laundry, but when I do, I go to the Village. 

Indigo gives The Village 40 stars for finding her missing stroller.

We had a wonderful experience with CBH. A couple years ago we purchased new in Kuna, ID. We love our home and found practically no problems with the construction. The few minor things were quickly attended to and we've been happy ever since.

The CBH community is terrific and our kids love the friendships they've made in the neighborhood. We are also happy with the exceptional price we paid and consider the value very reasonable.

The only positive were the employees, fast and friendly!

Ordered a regular size classic with fries and a drink. My son ordered the same thing, and the tab came to $27, thats $14 per meal. 

Pretty bad when your fries are the highlight at a cheesesteak joint. I agree with the reviews before mine 100%! The bread was a strange white color with just a little color on the ends. The filling was hardly there and mixed to the point of almost being ground beef. It had that Mcy D's cheese burger taste. But hardly any cheese from what I could see.

The fries were the best part of this pricey meal, but I didnt come to Bruchi's Cheesesteaks for the fries.

Pretty sure this place could be epic, but the whole fast food vibe will keep it down. 

Seriously doubt I will be back a second time

The portions are large, the service was good, the price is affordable, but overall I was disappointed. To me, the sausage was pretty bland and the blueberry pancake was just ok. It wasn't a bad breakfast for the price, but I wouldn't crave it. In an area with so much competition, the food could definitely use some improving.

I surprised my man with a couples massage for his birthday. We wanted a Thai massage but it seemed that they have a more standardized massage they do for clients. They did have a nice atmosphere and seemed relaxing. Another helper mentioned they are not complete separate rooms and are just dividers which is correct. So you can here others which can be a little distracting. The hot stones were nice. The massage was too light and even when asking for it harder it was still mild. After the massage asked about Thai and more deep tissue and she mentioned that she did not offer these services because of limited requests. The price was fair and she did not over charge in my opinion. Overall she is very nice and the place is clean. It was relaxing and great for those who like a more mild to medium massage firmness.

My son got a Classic on Saturday night with bacon added.   When he bit into it it appeared the bacon was pretty much raw, he couldn't even eat it and had to pick off all the bacon, which or course costed extra.   That whole night he was sick and into the next morning.   Please make sure your meat is cooked appropriately.

Medical care is excellent ! Staff is courteous and polite. BILLING system is horrendous!!!!! Takes months to get billing correct. Computer sends out balance due requests that are not accurate. Please turnoff your computer billing till you can figure out how to account for payments, delayed charges, misapplied payments etc. And stop blaming the insurance companies! Accurate financial accounting is YOUR responsibility ! Avoid any contact with billing dept. All they do is explain why it's so screwed up. Can't talk to anyone who could fix it!  Apparently the ivory to tower the accountants live doesn't have the ability or desire to talk or get feedback from actual customers !

I would have given them a four but the gal that made our coffee wasn't the friendliest which was a bummer because we came a couple days later and the guy working the drive thru was very happy and polite. I guess some people just have there off days, I get it.

Over crowded.
I see no one disinfecting after play. (Picking up and organizing, yes, but not cleansing)
They don't allow you to bring water bottles in.  There is a water fountain but who wants to use that right now?
Even pre-covid I've been to pretend play businesses where at least one employee walked around with a rag and disinfectant the whole time.

Went back for more produce. Eggplants were in, more okra, fresh potatoes and the very best thing we got was a vine-ripened watermelon. Best water melon of this year. Not too big for two of us. Lots of small cantaloupes too, just right to eat out of the rind. Seems to be the height of the season for everything.
I had the chicken fried steak. The crust was very crunchy and shattered like glass when you cut into it. More crust than meat. I won't be back.
Brought my gf in a couple days ago to get here nails done, Shannon did an awesome job, and will be pleased to come back

Not being local, I had a bit of a time finding this place but glad I did. Super friendly service and the food was very good. 

I got there right at the opening so a little slower than maybe normal but nothing that stands out.

The only thing was the price for a soup and sandwich was a little more than expected but not unreasonable. Definitely a place I'd go back to again.

Maybe I came in with too high of expectation and too big of an appetite. 

My experience at this Cafe Ole location was mediocre at best. There was no hostess to greet us once we entered and there were already some folks ahead of us who had been waiting to be accommodated. Once someone seated us, we were immediately attended but it's almost as if they completely forgot about us. From that point on, it was a matter of flagging down the server whenever we saw him.

According to their menu, the Burrito Especial is a Cafe Ole favorite which peaked my interest but if failed to live up to its hype. There was nothing special about it and even though I asked for it to be a chicken burrito, it was simply a massive corn tortilla filled with refried beans. I was extremely disappointed with every bite I took hoping for some sign of chicken only to get a mouthful of refried beans. 

My wife and I couldn't wait to get the check and leave. I was more excited to leave the restaurant than I was when I got my food and believe me, that never happens. 

Please listen to all of the previous reviews for this establishment. Don't make the mistake we made and choose to go through the experience first hand.
Best kept secret of the Boise/meridian area. I love strolling about the shops and the fountain before and after a movie at the village cinema. There's everything for every type of person to do here.

My family came in tonight hoping to have a few drinks relax and enjoy ourselves. We usually go to the Boise location by the mall and never have any issues. The Happy Hour, atmosphere, great appetizers, tasty drinks, and awesome guest service is what attracts us to cafe ole and kept us coming back until tonight. Tonight we thought we would try your Meridian location since it's closer to home and what a mistake! I am truly disappointed and won't ever be back to this location. Our servers name was Ash..... we sat at table 43 in the bar and came in a little before 10 pm and left around 10:45 pm. First of all we had to wave our server down every time we needed something. When she would come by she acted as if we were a huge inconvenience. My husbands Dr Pepper was out practically the whole night and my patron margarita and moms well vodka drink tasted like water on the rocks. However we did get a kick out of our waitress bringing us chips after the second time of asking she says well the warmer is off so your chips will be cold. She also brought this basket of chips without any salsa and when we had to get up to find her and ask for salsa her response was there is a salsa bar over there in the corner. Which mind you  was empty!!!! Then as we are waiting for her to come by again so we can order another round she is over in the corner by the register on the side of the bar with what looks like the margarita mix machine chatting to the bartender a shorter white male with a fo hawk short dirty blonde hair cut. All during this little  chit chat he hands her a shot of vodka which she took while trying to hide and or TRY to be discreet about behind the machine making a sour face then pulls her phone out and is texting!!!! I guess there is a first time for everything. Then when she came back over my mom ordered another drink that definitely tasted off so we sent it back requesting it be taken off the bill. Our waitress didn't even ask what was wrong or how it could be fixed there wasn't a manager in sight, but there was a whole bunch of dirty tables, and only a few guests left in the restaurant. Needless to say this is by far the worst experience I have ever encountered. I will not be back and hope someone who reads this I save them a trip.

The breakfast here is made for people who love to eat. When walking in it feels like a big cozy cabin. It was snowing outside and the fire inside was warm and wonderful. If you sit at the bar it's first come serve so this is where we go. The menu is definitely overwhelming and was difficult to visualize well due to having so many items. The pancakes here are gigantic!! The seriously could feed a beast!  The flavor was great but I could barely make a dent. It seemed like such a waste of good food. I think it would be better if they just did it half the size. My man got a chorizo hash and a type of Benedict's. The server was great and let him do half of each so he could taste both. The hash was very good and something worth getting again. Overall very happy with our breakfast date!!! Did you know that Joe mamas is the bomb?!

Saturday morning January 5th my wife and I took our 10yr old granddaughter to Joe Mamma's.  We arrived at 7:45am, it was 23degrees outside with a line of about 20 people in front of us. They made everyone wait outside in the cold until exactly 8:00am.  It was at least 30 minutes before we were actually inside the building and seated.  There was a propane heater at the front door but was not working.  The front doors were wide open until everyone waiting outside was seated so the place was freezing inside by the time they were closed.  They were individually counting out the flatware at the door for every person they seated.  It was the most inefficient way of moving patrons through the doors to the tables you can possibly imagine.  My food was moderately warm when served but understandably we were right in the middle of the morning rush so some concession for that.  Our waitress was very pleasant but the food was average and the dining experience was disappointing nothing we would go back for.  Sorry but can't recommend this eatery over the average run of the mill chains.

Sad to say that I have a problem, an addiction to this place. Spicy Bogus, half brown half zoodles with all the toppings. Insanely good and I'm thankful that one is now conveniently located in the Village so I don't have to drive downtown to get my fix.

AVOID THIS BUSINESS. You and I, were not the type of people who would blindside someone with bill well into the thousands of dollars.  We especially wouldn't do that sort of thing around Christmas.  Even if we did, and it turned out to be in error, we would own up to our mistake and make it right.  We're decent human beings, that's what we do.  But, do you know who isn't? Intermountain Medical Imaging.

Imtermountain Medical Imaging is so greedy and so eager to get "their" money that they can't be bothered to double check a bill before they send it out.  Apparently their greed extends to all things.  Call them repeatedly for weeks, and you'll just sit on hold.  I guess paying someone to man the phones is too much.  But, when someone does pick up, don't get your hopes up.

After I finally talked to someone from the billing department, I found that Intermountain Medical Imaging doesn't actually expect you to pay your bill.  No joke, the billing supervisor I spoke with said that despite the comical demands to pay my bill immediately printed all over the statement, she said 'no one pays immediately, people don't do that'.  Through all of this Intermountain Medical Imaging has been aware of the situation, and NO ONE from the business has reached out to me.

Intermountain Medical Imaging is not a professional organization.  If you value your health and being treated with basic respect I would recommend that you stay as far away from Intermountain Medical Imaging as you can.  Oh, also don't put much stock in the quality of their work either, that's pretty questionable as well.

Hours suck. Close early. I get COVID but seriously? Never open, closes at random and out of everything. All other Starbucks are not like this one. Should just go out of business completely. Clearly the employees don't want to work and when they do they obviously don't want to be there anyways. So over Starbucks and it's inconsistent hours

An indoor giant playroom for younger kids. 

Some cute fun things for younger kids like the pretend grocery store, but not fun how crowded they let it get, how they have hand puppets out for the kids to shove their dirty hands in and share with strangers, and a bit overpriced to get in.

I am so so disappointed. I have gone to this restaurant many times and always had
A great experience. Well not tonight. We
Waited 1 hour for our food. My kids fries were as
Hard as a rock, the steak didn't have any taste, we asked for A1 never got it. Never once didn't management come to table to apologize or ask if everything was ok. After being there for almost two hours we paid and usually get 20% discount off for military and off 102 dollars they took off 3.20!? What?! They could have cared less about our terrible experience. Not only that while we were there 2 other tables had walked out.

We split a calamari appetizer first.  The squid was pretty tender.  The sauce was OK as long as you didn't use too much, then it was WAY overpowering.  I had the Orange Chicken Salad.  Not very good.  Small bits of chicken in too much batter.  The whole thing was slathered in this sauce that was overly tart and overwhelmed everything in its path.  The Twig's Chardonnay was bleak and I wished I had ordered a different wine, but there weren't that many by-the-glass choices.  The only good parts were the service, which was not exceptional but attentive.  And, the atmosphere is nice.  Otherwise, I'm not sure I'd go back.

Ohhh I love, love, love this store!

It's full of beautiful displays and even more beautiful clothes! The employees I've talked with here have always been so friendly, approachable, and helpful. 

Lululemon has a really amazing policy with their leggings - if they begin to wear out, you can bring them in and swap them for a brand new pair (has to be the same style). I brought in a pair that I had gotten a good wear out of, and right on the spot the gal walked out on the floor, grabbed my size, and swapped them out. I went in with faded and worn leggings and left with brand new ones - so amazing! (I also bought a sports bra during this visit because they were on sale and I just couldn't help myself! Pro tip: check out their sale rack, there are some good finds hidden in there!)

Was almost empty around 3:30pm on a Saturday.  They offer happy hour everyday between 3-6pm.  We sampled a bunch of apps like the pizzas, fries, and spinach dip.  Also ordered salads and Mac and cheese.  Everything was good.  It was fun.  Prices were fair!  Not sure if I'd feel that way if it wasn't happy hour.   

Only gripe was that they charged us for additional ranch for a salad.  For a full service restaurant to charge extra for dressing, that's crazy cheap of them.  I'm not griping about the 69 cent charge but that they nickeled and dimed that ranch although it should have generously came with the salad.  They originally gave us a tiny single cup of dressing that wouldn't have covered the large sized salad.   

Whatever the case, it was decent food and fun to sample the apps at a reduced price.

We went through the drive thru for dinner tonight.  When it was our turn we ordered a number 1 no cheese.  We were asked what we wanted to drink and said Coke.  The person taking the order repeated back ok a Pepsi.  Thinking he didn't hear us we corrected him saying a Coke.  He then asked what else.  We said a vanilla ice cream cone.  He then said ok I have a number 4 with a Pepsi and a vanilla ice cream cone.  We again said no, we want a number 1... he then said he had to put us on hold...???..... now we are just completely confused..... asking one another why we would be put on hold???.... talking about what else we were going to order.  The guy comes back on the speaker and says ok let's start again... we restated we wanted the number 1 no cheese with a Coke and a vanilla ice cream cone.  That's when he finally said we don't have Coke products just Pepsi.  Ok we will take the Pepsi was our reply.  Then we stated we wanted a sandwich from the number 5 option with could be a sandwich or a combo.  He then stated it's a combo not a sandwich.  You can't have just a sandwich.  We are now super confused as we are reading off the menu and this guy is telling us we can't order just the sandwich.  We asked for clarification stating it was on their menu as either one.  At this point the guy tells us he is going to have to ask us to leave....????? Now we are really really confused.  We asked why we were being asked to leave.  He said it was because we were yelling.... No one was yelling.  At all.  We literally looked at each other like... what??!!... We literally said back no one is yelling just not understanding why we can't order off the menu.  He insisted we leave.  I asked for the manager.  He stated he was the manager.  I asked for his name.  His reply was, Liz.

I am using the  male pronoun because until he said his name was Liz we thought we were talking to a male.

So Liz then proceeds to inform us they do not give out any other information such as employee ID etc.  I get it.  So we left.  I want everyone reading this review to know that if we had screwed up we would totally own it .

This?  Not only was it unprofessional of Liz but there was nothing wrong on our end.  Liz cost Artic Circle money tonight.  Liz also cost the company a loyal customer who won't be back.

This location is in Meridian Idaho.  1625 W Franklin Road.

To Liz:
Whatever happened on your end tonight should never be taken out on your customer.  And lying about the behavior of your customer... and there were a lot of witnesses Liz...well, I hope you figure out how to find a resolution for whatever it is that is REALLY going on in your life because it wasn't the burger or combo or Pepsi on the menu and there was no one yelling.

I sent my truck in for preventative maintenance and asked to diagnose and treat a  transmission issue. They told me the problem was simple and would be fixed with a flush etc....They talked me into getting the "best brakes and rotors" etc......  and I had some cv joints replaced and a tune up.well, now my brakes squeal going forward rather than backwards! Yay! I spend between $6,000-$7,000 (yup) and got the truck back and the the transmission was not fixed. Same problem. Then they wanted to charge me for another Diagnostic test AND another $1600 to replace the solenoid(s) or another $6000 to replace the transmission altogether. The bad diag caused me to make other decisions to buy better parts for things that weren't a huge issue, therefor, using up the budget I was willing to spend. Long story short, I paid $6,500 or so to have my truck run the EXACT same way, and potentially $9,000-$12,000 to A fix it. I have never written a Yelp review in my life, but this experience left such a bad taste in my mouth that I actually feel obligated to. The employees are nice, but that doesn't hold much water when it feels like you've been taken for so much $. Makes me wish I had payed more attention in auto shop class in high school. My advice? Buy a brand new vehicle before you go here. It'll be around the same price with less headaches. If you live paycheck to paycheck, this DEFINITELY is NOT your place. Sorry/not sorry. They don't give a 0 star option, so I'll count the 1 Star towards the people being nice. Whatever. In other words... DON'T COME HERE. If I was the owner, I wouldn't want my name to attached to this business in any capacity. I would only recommend this company to someone I truly hated. Good luck.

Good stuff!

I really enjoy the peanut butter cookie smoothie with added protein to help me meet my daily goals.

HAPPY HOUR MUST! They have awesome deals on their happy hour for food and drinks. I love the crab crunch roll, the avocado egg rolls and their Moscow mules are delicious. They have a wonderful view of The Village center and you can enjoy the sounds of the water fountains. The staff is friendly with smiles on their faces and they interact well with all guests. The rest of their menu is full of flavor, choices and could accommodate any picky palette

Went here on Valentine's Day with my girlfriend. I was very impressed! Walked in and had a reservation, was seated and had our food in 25 minutes. After we were done they gave us a dessert menu and had that out in under 10 minutes. Reasonably priced for a fun night out. Our waitress was very friendly and quick. The whole dinner took less than an hour and we were very satisfied! They were busy but it was not hectic or loud at all. 5 stars hands down!

There was one customer when we walked in. That is usually a hint right? But I thought, it IS mid-week and this IS Idaho - People don't eat out nearly as much as they do in California and I don't know how adventurous folks are around here. Maybe A Chinese/Vietnamese place is crazy-talk for them.

Worst cha gio (Vietnamese Egg rolls) i've ever had. This half Mexican / half white chick can make better - truly.  These seemed like they were bought frozen. They serve them with iceberg lettuce (yuck) and no cilantro or fresh herbs. 

The Bun Thit Nuong was really tasty. But, having made this dish many times, I could tell the vermicelli noodles were not cooked fresh (which takes a couple of mins to do.) 

The prices were a bit high for dinner. Customer service was good - as it should be when the place is empty.
I probably won't be back since it is out of the way. It wasn't horrible but not what i was hoping for either.

Service was excellent.  We ordered the stuffed French toast, with peach sauce.  It was awful.  Tasted like a donut that was fried overtime.  There was hardly any of the peach sauce, so it was too dry to eat.  Husband had the chicken fried steak and he did say the steak was good.  The booths had a big step up and then down, especially difficult for an older person to get out of the booth without falling down.

Our attempt at eating at their new location was a miserable experience. It is much larger than the old place, but on a weekday there were 20 or more people waiting to be served at 1100 am. There were at least 10 tables available, but it appears they do not have enough service help. We were told that the wait would be 30 minutes or longer. We left. 

It was raining that day and their parking lot is laid out so that there is no secure footing from the northern lot to the entrance. Crossing a sloping, wet, soggy lawn is hazardous and will be prime grounds for a law suit if someone is injured walking there. 

We had eaten at the old place many times, but after this experience, we won't be back.

Great shuttle service.
They kept me in the loop via text.
Offered to pick me up when my suv was ready.
I did do some shopping and this shop was the least expensive. 
Very detailed on letting me know what they fixed, explained there 2-year warranty.
Overall just a great customer service experience. A follow up phone was done the day after my service to see if I was satisfied or if I needed anything else. I definitely will be back and I do recommend this shop.

This place is starting to reveal its scam artist ways the more times you come here for the same problems over and over again. We have been coming to this place for years now and it seems we are having the same problem with no advances done to the vehicle. The last time we was there, we were charged to take off the rim out the tire, after telling us the wheels are staggered and cannot be swapped. I have more stories on why not to come here anymore, along with a hand full of BETTER repair places. Thank you for reading, please note I have been coming here for years and fed up with the way the service has been. We deserve better German star.

I took my car in for an alignment and I was told that I couldn't get one because my steering rack and pinion needed to be replaced and my control arms as well. They told me $2400 would "make it road safe" and that my car was "unsafe" to drive. I asked if drive shaft couplers would help any of the "issues" they were saying my car had and they literally laughed and said no way you have to have these other things fixed the couplers will do nothing for you. So my husband who already ordered the couplers looked at my car and didn't see any of the "issues" or "unsafe" parts that they explained to me. So I'm driving today and my car makes a weird noise so my husband looks at it and realizes it the couplers failing and you can see here that these needed to be replaced and I am so furious that I almost spent $2400 to get unnecessary parts replaced and that they told me the couplers weren't needed. I don't know why they thought that this was ok to do.

This is the BEST breakfast I have had in the Treasure Valley in a very long time. The food was first and foremost actually hot! I had started to expect lukewarm but this food was hot.
