The flavors were incredible. I mean incredible.  I had a scramble and my husband had French toast and they were both out of this world and neither one was a "most ordered" item. Can't wait to go back and try some more awesome food. Also, the service was friendly and high quality.

We bought our home new in Kuna, ID and we love it! We purchased three other new homes in the past and this is the first time we had nearly zero post move-in related issues (two very minor issues that were addressed in a timely manner). The construction and quality is terrific and many upgrades were already in place as part of our package. We have a very functional model for our family (Sonoma - highly recommend). We absolutely enjoy our family-friendly neighborhood. We moved here almost a year and so far not a single negative issue to report! In addition, the price for the home was very reasonable.

This used to be one of my favorite breakfast eateries till we ran into a minor incident where they messed up one of the orders. Now normally, this wouldn't be a problem, but the owner angrily took it back to the kitchen and it came back exactly the same and then lectured my wife on how disrespectful she was. My wife's been working in the kitchen in the food service industry for over fifteen years, so I don't think she was being rude or disrespectful, and she certainly knows what's reasonable. If something is missing in a burrito, it's a pretty simple remedy to put that thing in a burrito. The owner comped the meal without saying anything, which was appreciated, but the owner's seething anger at merely being asked to fix something was absolutely shocking to witness.

So, I'd love to come back here with the family every couple of weeks like we used to, but now the mere mention of the place's name will launch my wife into a tirade about how if she ever let anything out of her kitchen like that and didn't fix it when asked, she'd be out of a job.

An apology and a little less attitude would have gone a long way, instead, I am stuck being unable to return to one of my favorite restaurants unless I want to eat by myself. Maybe the owners of this restaurant should consider that just because its a family business and you can't get fired, doesn't mean you're any more perfect than anyone else in the restaurant business.
No longer in business. Most of produce came from Emmett. He even bought eggs from my farm, didn't tell me he was going to resell them as his.

We've been sitting waiting for breakfast for an hour. It doesn't matter if the food is the best... this is beyond unacceptable!! NOTHING in the breakfast world takes this long! Wait... are they slow cooking the corned beef as we sit and wait?? 
This was a first and this is absolutely a last!  

I should note that the servers are great. They walk around amongst the tables apologizing for the wait times totally embarrassed.

I'll admit that I was "warned" by my pistol instructor against this place but every time I go in here they are so nice to talk to and attentive without trying to sell you anything. I think he had some personal vendetta due to some issue he and his wife had there. They are friendly and not in a hurry to "move on" if you're not in the mood to buy. One Star subtraction for their gunsmith obviously not testing a pistol after he polished the feed ramp even though they have a range there. I brought it in for jamming after each round and after the work was done it still had the exact same issue.

After hearing about Joe Momma's for almost a year, I finally had the opportunity to come here with one of my friends in an effort to escape our kids (she has 9, so it is totally justified! Lol) We arrived around 12:30pm on Friday afternoon and were promptly seated by a guy who literally never looked at either of us when he spoke.  He seemed very distracted, but he was friendly enough. Our server came over quickly and was awesome! She gave us menu suggestions and allowed us plenty of time to look over the menu.  My friend ordered the stuffed blueberry French toast & I had the classic breakfast with scrambled eggs, bacon, hash browns, & French toast. 
The blueberry stuffed French toast was so delicious! I can't even think of an adjective that would properly describe this dish.  The French toast is stuffed with cream cheese and is then battered & deep fried.  It's then topped with a fresh blueberry compote and whipped cream.  It had the flavor of funnel cake from the batter. It was not overly sweet.  It was literally perfectly balanced.  I was so grateful that my friend was willing to share a few bites of it with me.  
My breakfast was pretty good.  The eggs were cooked well and were exactly to my liking.  The bacon was evenly cooked and crisp. The one negative that I have is the hash browns were so greasy...like really overly greasy and not cooked quite long enough.  But, it wasn't the end of the world.  The breakfast was still very good. 
Overall, I would give Joe Momma's a solid 4.5. I will definitely be coming in again for breakfast. I want my hubby to try the stuffed French toast!!

We have gone through the drive through a couple times now for dinner. Both times they have gotten our order 100% correct and given sauces, which does not always happen. I would not recommend going on a Tuesday though unless you are specifically going for the taco Tuesday deals, because the line for the drive-through is much longer.

Beef bulgogi - wow.  Not too many places in Boise to find this stuff but Tony and his staff cook up some legit food and the bulgogi is no exception; it's delicious as hell.  Also, I do not like kimchi, but I ate theirs.  

Their Thai tea - OMG - to die for.  

Seriously.   Go here.  Now.

I ate a third of my delicious huckleberry cheesecake and lemon gelato before I managed to take a photo! Clean, lots of options of gelato, cookies, and a good selection of high end chocolate bars or treats. Fun new addition.

If you need quality medical care, look elsewhere. If I could have given this place zero stars, I would have. This ER employs at least one incompetent physician (Dr. Yeakley) who does not seem to understand the term "standard of care." He left a patient with ischemic/incarcerated bowel sit in his ER for over 6 hrs when it was recommended this patient undergo emergent surgery. He did not re-evaluate his patient beyond his initial cursory eval and refused to speak with the family. He also falsely reported to the accepting surgeon that the patient was in "no pain" when in fact the patient was writhing in pain and had multiple doses of potent IV narcotics, ordered by none other than Dr. Yeakley himself. When the house supervisor was contacted regarding the delay in care, she gave a litany of excuses and could not articulate the hospital's policy on transfers when the house sups job is to coordinate transfers when the patient requires a higher level of care (or the current hospital cannot provide the level of care needed). 

This unnecessary delay in care could have cost the patient their life and instead of owning their mistakes, St. Luke's staff was argumentative, incompetent and rude. If you care about your health or the health of your loved ones, do NOT bring them to this facility. Zero stars. Pathetic St. Luke's Meridian. Absolutely pathetic.

Update: I was directed to contact Patient Relations regarding my concerns and was given two phone numbers, both of which I have called several times each, left voicemails, and still have not received a single return call. Par for the course with this facility. Incompetent, rude, uncaring staff. Yelp readers- take your family elsewhere. St Luke's- get your company under control. You're going to kill people allowing your staff to behave this way.

I think the Village is a great place to bring out of town guests or meet up with friends or family. For those that have never been, it's like an outdoor mall meets a community gathering spot. 
There is really little you can't accomplish at the Village, except maybe filling up your car with gas.  (Something to consider Village, for one of those spaces still awaiting an owner!)

A variety of restaurants to choose from: Those on the outskirts of the property are more of your grab and go or order and sit type establishments.  Those within the inner workings are primarily more of your sit down and wait type.

Shopping kind of follows the same parameters. Stores on the outskirts are more your go to shopping (Michaels, Boise Co-Op, Petco) while the inner stores are more specialty and in most cases more high end (Lulu Lemon, Sur La Table, The Loft). 

This outdoor mall is unique in that it is built to serve as not only a place to shop and eat, but also serves as a gathering place for friends and family.  They have a really entertaining fountain in the center of the complex.  It was designed and built by the same company that created the dancing fountain at the Bellagio in Las Vegas. And yes, it does dance to the music just the same.
 There is also a grassy area that in the summer hosts free concerts and in the winter is flooded and frozen to become an ice skating rink. 
Plenty of comfy outdoor furniture to sit around on, patio heaters when it gets a bit chilly, and background music playing anywhere you go.  While the kids play on a fun tree inspired play structure near by.

The Village also offers a movie theater, bowling alley, gym and day spa.  So quite literally, you could arrive at 9am and leave at 10pm.  :)

Yes, many complain the parking is not ideal and can get a bit crowded.  But honestly, I just go expecting I may have to park a ways out and take a little walk and when I get lucky and find one close; then yeah me!  I do think it was clever that the parking surrounds the Village, rather than one big giant lot on one side.  

Additional retailers keep coming, so who knows what will be added next?  Makes for a great reason to return again; if you haven't been in awhile.

There are things that Kona Grill gets so right, yet I see it lacking at what it wants to be. 
The Village in Meridian already strives to remain the trendy and hippest location in the area. It succeeds on many points and draws a huge crowd each day. Kona Grill launched with the Village and quickly became the focal idea of what the Village represent. 

You'll be blown away by the modern decorations and atmosphere. The wait staff are dressed uniformly and the chef line looks like a top kitchen. The prices on the menu reflect this high end appearance. Unfortunately the food doesn't meet expectations. 

I've consistently seen my food lacking here. It's not that it's bad, it just doesn't live up to what you'd expect from a higher end restaurant. The sushi rolls are small and expensive and the main entrees will be inconsistent. 

I only go here when someone new to town wants to visit. Won't go on my own accord.

As I sit in the waiting room, 2 hours passed the time of my scheduled appointment I'm writing my review. This is our 4th visit here (once for an emergency and 3 times for our new puppy). Up until now, we have had good service but today is not going well. We are over an hour late, the vet tech didn't even know why we were here (read our chart perhaps), and the front office was borderline rude. The plus sides are we have had better experiences in the past, but I will think twice about making an appointment on saturdays this is beyond ridiculous! They are capitalizing on the fact that they are the only vet open on Saturdays I guess. Bottom line great if you are in an ER situation but every day vet care - go somewhere else.

Used this new automated car wash about 7 times so far. Even the $7 wash does a good job if your car doesn't look like it fought it's way thru Iraq. Sometimes I splurge for the mid priced wash and find the car looks squeaky clean. Noticed this week they had towels to dry off the car while you vacuumed for free. Never noticed those before. Hope it is a SOP feature from now on.

Those vacuums are great. They could suck the fuzz of a peach and no rushing to get done as they run all the time. A hose for each side, so no awkward cross over drags to vacuum the other side of the floor.

Saturday, my adult children were in town, so I searched for a place to take them to dinner in Meridian that was practicing social distancing. We all love sushi, so I looked at Kona Grill. It said right on their website that they were practicing social distancing and people were required to wear masks. Neither was true. We made reservations and the place was absolutely packed. Every table was taken. I thought distancing meant limiting people. People were walking in without masks, and our waiter had his nose uncovered until I asked him do so. You have got to be kidding me. I'm sitting here in fear of coming down with this virus.

I've been to Kona Grill before but not in a while. Sought out the one in Idaho and it was amazing as usual. The staff was very attentive and the food was as good as always. It's in The Village which was full of nice looking people. Pretty people. Like me. But pretty. It made for a nice visit to see pretty people eat without a mask for once. It's like Scottsdale Arizona without the money. But still pretty.
Sad that tonight we were craving a delicious gelato. Only to find your closed forever? Sadness and we hope that you find a way to open back soon.
Not overly impressed with the Philly Cheesesteak sandwich, I thought the bread was too doughy and had better elsewhere.

Authentic Mexican restaurant. Mondays is kids eat free and there is a nice kids menu. Drinks are not included in the kids menu but the kids meals are only four dollars. Wednesday is buy one get one free margarita. Free chips and salsa brought out before your meal. No vegan options but they do have vegetarian options that you can make vegan by omitting the cheese. For example they have a veggie burrito and portobello tacos. I ordered Portabella tacos without cheese. They were good. Next time I will get the tortillas not fried.

Saw an add on social media and decided this place was worth a try... I must have good taste because it was damn good. Brisket, tri-tip, and pulled pork dinner with beans and potato salad was great! The service was fast and friendly as well. Worth the stop! See ya soon big Daddy's!

I think that some people give these places a bad rap but this place has some good people working here.  Sure there are some beginners but you can pick to have someone more experienced cut your hair.  A lady named Susan has been cutting my hair there for around ten years and I couldn't be happier.  I love being able to check in online and it telling me how long the wait is before I even leave my house.

I am a super fan of Hungry Horse Eatery.  
I was thinking about coming here for lunch, but I knew it would be a long lunch, and saw pictures of wooden chairs and thought that may not feel good on the tush for an extended period of time.  But one early evening my daughter and I were looking for a light bite and decided to stop in.  And I am so glad we did!

I've read the word "funky" to describe this place and that's a good word - but like a cool, good funky. 

They have smoothies, blended drinks, milk tea and flavored tea written on the chalkboard wall.  All kinds of flavors.  I decided to play it safe and get a strawberry lemon-flavored tea, ($3.95) with peach popping bobas (+25-cents).  It was delicious and fresh and fun and the right amount of tart and sweet.  

I also had an order of garlic parmesan fries, $3.50.  So good!  You taste the garlic and the parmesan, and the fries have a little bit of a crunch on the outside with soft potato on the inside.  The server brought some fry sauce over.  The fries were perfect on their own, but I had to try them with the fry sauce.  They were great either way.

My daughter had the teriyaki chicken rice bowl ($7.95) and she raved about it and the size of it.

Then I saw the waffle dessert ($7.95) on the menu, and I had checked-in after we paid and noticed there was a Yelp coupon for 10% off.  So, we just had to order something else to get the discount - ha ha.  The waffle dessert it was!  Waffle (not too light and not too cakey and not too sweet), bananas, blueberries, Nutella, chocolate sauce, vanilla ice cream, and powdered sugar.  We shared it, and it was plenty, and plenty good.

There was only 1 person working and he was super helpful talking to me about the drinks and I had asked for his recommendation on pairing what flavor with what kind of boba.  My daughter asked him where the nearest bathroom was, and he said they have one.  When she returned, she said that it probably wasn't really for the public as it was more of a janitor storage kind of room.

Service, food, and good funkiness make me a fan and excited to return!

Hands down the rudest, most arrogant, disrespectful  people I have ever dealt with. The only reason these people have decent reviews is because they have people do reviews for them on Google yelp and Facebook when I said to them based on my negative experience here I will be giving them one star on all three platforms they laughed and said your one star won't add up compared to all the reviews my own family and friends do for us. They blatantly looked in my face and admitted gaming the system. They are not knowledgeable they are rude and arrogant like I said and when I met the manager I could tell exactly why. Either don't use T-Mobile as your carrier or go to a different location because these people are out of control. It was not just me both times I've had negative experiences the people on the waitlist in around me are complaining about the same thing and if you really look at the reviews and comments attached to them that are not blatantly written by employees and their family and friends you'll see a consistent issue, uneducated staff unwilling to help, entitled, and just straight up disrespectful don't waste your time and money!!

Taylor and David at CBH are awesome! They took care of any issues that arose quickly and professionally. They both really impressed me with their level of attention as well as kindness. They truly made my first home buying experience something that I'll never forget. You're both rockstars!
Kona grill is one of the best restaurants in Boise! Definitely visit it on your vacations and daily dinners! Love this restaurant!

I think all of the food was prepared and presented well.
The flavors were all thoughtfully planned.
The sea bass melted in your mouth like butter. 
I don't really have any complaints. I think SOME menu items are exceptionally over priced.
I wasnt overall thrilled with anything but have nothing to complain about.

I'd never buy anything there. Typical gun store markup. Honestly their service isn't that great. My girlfriend walked in to try shooting guns and buy one for the first time but couldn't handle the employees and how over the top they were. She went to sportsman's and spent an hour or two with a guy at the counter who just let her take her time and go at her own pace. Which was exactly what she needed because impact made her not want to own a gun. They'd go out of business if they didn't have the hype of the range and the location. I'll probably be back for some range time just because I don't wanna put the miles on my jeep to go to the desert all the time but I'll specifically attempt to avoid talking to the super opinionated sales guys. I shoot nice stuff. I'm just not a Glock attention desiring fan boy like the rest of them.

Good service & great bread! Loved my rueben. Busy Tuesday lunch so had to wait to order & at least 15 minutes to get our food. Husband got small side salad, he picked off the olives & artichoke hearts, bonus for me, yum, I ate them! 
Very clean.

Have you ever had a Coconut Mojito? Did you even know of it's existence?!? I didn't and now my DD will be coming along with me next time!
For lunch I had the Chicken Avocado Club. It was great but my Avocado was not ripe what so ever. I was slightly disappointed and definitely didn't want to tell my SUPER sweet waitress (definitely realized I didn't leave the best tip and will hopefully be able to make up for it). The side of fries was ok. I really enjoyed the fried calamari, it was definitely fresh! So for the Calamari, the Coconut Mojito, and the SUPER nice waitress I give you 5 stars! I had a really great time with my friends and I can't wait to come back!

Yet another great dinner at Twigs!  Tia, the bartender also was our server ... weren't we lucky?!  She's a sweet gal who is sharp, efficient and did a great job as 3 at the table were enjoying their cocktails, so were pretty happy folks.  3 of us had my favorite Greek salad with shrimp, and one had the steak salad.  All were delicious, as always.  You can always count on great food and service.  Even tho we always enjoy Twigs bar for cocktails and dinner, she made it a 6 star last night!  Thanks, Tia!

I'm writing this particular review on behalf of my husband, as he does not have a yelp account. Like most men, he is deathly afraid of the dentist. He had a tooth shatter on him and after much begging and pleading got him to go! Willow tree is very close to our home and I have been here for routine cleanings. Needless to say, his experience was so HORRIBLE he will probably never go to another dentist again, no matter how hard I try. Long story short: He was misquoted for services by over $1,000  ( the office claims, they only told him cost for part of the procedure and not the whole thing). Demanded payment in full without any forewarning and then treated him like garbage when he said he couldn't pay ( office clerk asked if there was someone he could call to get the money  ( is this a bail bonds place??) I talked them into a payment plan, however each time he has returned to get his procedure completed (3 additional times) they would ask for payment in full and then act like they knew nothing about the payment plan. On top of all of this, he said the dentist and his assistant were rude, inconsiderate and unprofessional. They spent so much time talking to each other, learning their life stories there were several occasions in which he waved his hand and they suddenly realized he needed help. The dentist also left numerous times to go examine other patients and left him there with a brick in his mouth. Needless to say, not impressed and now I look like the bad guy for sending them there.  For all our troubles, we got 2 tickets to the movies and a popcorn. Whoppie.

Came here on a whim on a Wednesday morning. Super busy and packed. One of our orders was the tri-tip and eggs with house potatoes. I ordered the classic, eggs/potatoes/French toast/bacon. With the first order it was good but the scrambled eggs with the tri-tip seemed over cooked. The bacon was nice and crispy with the second order along with the house potatoes. Those were really good. The eggs didn't come out like I had ordered, they were much runnier. Also the French toast wasn't was I was hoping for but it was decent. Overall I wouldn't hop out of bed to hit this place up as there a ton of other breakfast places in the treasure valley.

I want to say the food was decent but the service was lacking badly. I don't understand why our server sucked but she did, I asked for stuff for our dishes and she either forgot or my dish was finished when she actually brought what I asked for to compliment my dishes.

This location seems understaffed and rushed. Served me a sandwich with cheese despite my ordering one without. Cheese tastes great, but I'm allergic to cow milk. Guess I should have checked more closely. Good job Zuppas. The take away here: check your order really carefully especially if you have any allergies.

Awesome!!! We are new to Boise and came from the land of restaurants in Colorado, however the customer service there was usually sub-par if present at all.  The customer service at Izumi's is amazing, the owners and very involved and aim to please, despite some of the other reviews I've read.  The Sushi is great, and the Hibachi is SO fun!  I don't usually write reviews, however I have been in the Customer service indusrty my entire career and very much appreciate that as the owners Winnie and Ryan are present and want to provide exceptional customer service.

Generally my favorite place for lunch, Located on a road that seems saturated with corporate restaurants. I like the atmosphere. It always seems busy, but there is never a wait. The 2 meat platter is a no brainer. The hostess Rhianna is very sweet, and cute too!

Fantastic environment for both adults and kids. Our hibachi chef, Andrew, is a real talent. Very attentive and proactive services from Jackie as well. Quality meal at a reasonable price. We will be back!

LOVE this place!  I first came in 2012ish and didn't like it at all...now that Kristi and Sherri own it, it is amazing!  So if you came in before they took over - don't worry about coming back - these women are really professional and it shows in their business.  U DO always smells good, too!  Sherri and Kristi actually groom my dogs, Henry and Pearl, and they do an amazing job.  These are two BIG goldendoodles, and its a big job to bathe them.  Today they even washed the dogs collars along with the other laundry, and they look like new!  The first time I came in I used the "U DO" facilities, and Sherri and Kristi were very helpful and showed me how to do everything correctly.  They will even help trim the dogs nails.  It's a great place...give it a try!
Awesome service and food! Will come again as often as possible. Potato pancake was delicious with apple and sour cream. Lemon garlic chicken was great.

This was our first time at Beef O Brady's and really had high hopes's. Location is relatively easy to get to and there were quite a few people in there. They have a good beer tap menu and the sports bar side of the restaurant seems like it would be a great place to go watch some football.
I gave it three stars for the atmosphere but nothing about the food will bring us back there. We ordered chips and salsa as an appetizer and most likely it was just pace picante salsa which is nothing special. I ordered the chicken burger and even though it was all right, I physically had to take the sandwich apart to find the chicken. The french fries were just your run-of-the-mill french fries. My husband ordered their classic hot wings and received bleu cheese with it. The blue cheese was luke warm and runny. Not great. 
With all that said, I might just go there for a beer and watch football, but other than that won't be having dinner there again.

This place is the BEST fast food around.  Try the pot roast sandwich...yum!  Good fries and super tender chicken strips.  The honey mustard dipping sauce is perfect and the custard is a HUGE winner.  You can mix in any treat for a new flavor every time and they have a flavor of the day for scoops.

Tempura was all breading...very little chicken and vegetables.  Felt like we were dining in a sports bar with several large screen tv's and loud, inappropriate music.  Service was good which allowed me to give it two stars instead of one.

What happened?
Recommended by a friend, we decided to venture into a neighborhood newbie. 
BIG. BIG. MISTAKE! We walked in and it was packed-although seated right away, we sat for a good 15 mins before we got menus and a drink order taken. Then they didn't bring our drinks. The busboy seemed to be our waiter as well as our server? and although strange behavior, did his best to get us dialed in. Took our order and as we sat horrified at the tables not getting their food around us, began to feel the dread that had settled in upon the entire dining room. One couple at the sushi bar asked for their food to go. One family of five with small kids literally got up and left. Dad came back to pay for their drinks. One single Mom was pissed as she and he son scarfed down one of the two plates they had ordered. ( the other one ended up on our table. Yes we ALSO had ordered the "chicken amazing"!!! Oops! She had paid before she even got her dishes!!! Lame.
It was dead silent and as an area supervisor of a local restaurant concept This experience killed me to the core!!! I wanted to bus tables, wipe them down, take drink orders and heck why not, ring in guest checks!!!! Inexperienced waiters and a mix of understaff was the perfect recipe for a major Friday night disaster! 
Families walking out, and WHY are you taking call in orders when you can't take care of your walk in business???? My husbands dish came out first. He was done by the time my Sons dish came out and while I played Traditional Chinese music on my own phone to break up the DEAD SILENCE AND AWKWARDNESS in this restaurant, I eventually got my mandarin chicken.., or whatever it was. I didn't even eat it. It was weird and how do you change the sauce on mandarin chicken??? Seriously? I left hungry. And we felt ripped off after paying our $40 bill. 
Never. Again. Too bad.

Looked on the website for a movie called winchester...their website said they were playing it at a certain time...so me and my mom went down there to see it...we stand in line for about ten minutes to get told the movie was cancelled...um excuse me!!! Maybe you should put that on your website!!!! I will never come back to the village cinema after this!!! And to top it all off the guy selling tickets was very rude about it to...this place definately needs to hire better people and do there job right!!! Ehh ya i urge other people to stay away as well!!! Plenty other places to see movies where your appreciated

Love the VIP area and DBox cinema. Food is great, not to expensive plus the facilities are spotless. Not the best option if your looking for a 4K and Awesome sounding theater but the service sure compensates for that.

I wasn't aware of this eatery just west of that one southern doughnut place that people either love or just don't get the hype. Carl Y. let me know of Thai Basil and that it's run by the same folks that operate Pad Thai House at Overland and Five Mile in Boise.

Unlike the former Taco John's location in Boise, that holds a certain nostalgia for me from my college days but is rather sterile, the Meridian outlet of this Thai empire has an elegant wood decor. 

The menu is pretty similar with Pad Thai House, but there were some special seasonal items offered on a separate menu sheet.

I ordered the drunken, a pseudo pad kee mao with wide noodles. The Thai Basil version includes meat, bell peppers, onions, scallions and Thai basil. It's very good, same as at Pad Thai House. Ask for traditional Thai heat.

The staff is friendly, just like at the Boise restaurant. I recommend both locations equally. 

The one thing I hated was their following new age restaurants that insist on calling their meat choices "protein." That's just lame. But doesn't take away from the quality of this restaurant.

So sweet and makes you feel so comfortable and beautiful about your skin and body. 
Such great work, great products and has you already thinking about your next appointment. 
You will not be disappointed! 
Can't wait to book again!!
OMG!! Awesome service and the food was excellent.  Portions are as advertised!!! Love this place. We have decided to have them cater our wedding.

A little better than average, but nothing spectacular. Had the burgers - very good. But the fries are your typical frozen potato slices. The ranch dressing was really good. Minus points for being really slow. We were the only customers and the burgers took a full 20 mins.

Was in town for business and decided to grab a quick bite to eat since this was on the way to hotel and wasn't too pleased. First off, there were 6-10 flies buzzing around the main sitting area and had to move to another location. As a NY'er, the bar for measuring authentic Thai food is pretty high. I ordered the Pad Thai and was utterly disappointed being that they used Chinese egg noodles instead of rice noodles. Not even sure why I ordered the Vietnamese egg rolls. The dish was similarly disappointing because it was served with no mint leaves and weird sauce.
Very good. Way better than I anticipated. Hot is HOT. So be judicious on your heat level. The butter chicken with cream at medium was perfect.
Solid buffet, great service, nice price! The chicken kebabs and tandoori chicken were amazing!

Loved Beef o Brady's food. I ordered delivery and even though the driver was super sketchy looking and he forgot the salsa, sour cream and guac for my nachos they were still delicous!  Theyre definitely not stingy with thee servings. I will for sure eat there again. Maybe not delivery cause the driver was scary.

Wow, the worst!  We just left and had the worst waitress ever!!  Carissa.  Hardly anyone in here and it takes her 5 minutes to get our refills.  Not friendly at all, would never never never come back, not even for a glass of water.  Dirty, bad service.  Not good.

I've been to Bodovino a few times now and although I've never taken advantage of the "wine on tap" I love the concept! It allows wine tasters to sample & try new things without committing to a whole bottle. The building is awesome; glass walls (perfect for fountain & people watching :) ) and kind of a dark, romantic, hip atmosphere. And if you're not a fan of wine, they also have a full bar!

My boyfriend & I stopped in on a Saturday night for after dinner drinks. Of course it was busy, and we had to grab a busboy to order because we were waiting ten minutes without anyone even stopping by. I understand though - it was a later Saturday night.

So we ordered a bottle of red and shortly after ordering, our waiter came by to say that the bottle we chose was out of stock, so he brought out a bottle that was similar in taste, but higher quality and $16 more than the one we ordered. Without us even asking he said he will price match the bottle since it was their error for being out of stock. So nice! 

Wine was delicious as always. I haven't tried the food at Bodovino yet, but the couple next to us got the ribeye and it looked (and smelled) spectacular. Service was knowledgable, very friendly & pretty prompt! We'll definitely be back!

Full Disclosure: We never even got to try the food. We saw the glowing Food Network review and decided to check it out for Friday dinner. We walk into the place and there are three families ahead of us. A girl comes up and explains that it will be a half hour wait for everyone, even though I can see at least 3 empty tables in the joint. No problem, I see that there are seats at the bar and ask if we can go sit there. The waitress gives us a look like we are really burdening her but acknowledges that we can sit there. So we do, for ten minutes. We don't get a menu, drink orders, or so much as a "how are you tonight?" from any of the servers bustling about making an obvious show of ignoring us. I get that they were busy, but it seemed like they didn't even care about us. To make things worse, a man and his date at the door asks one of the waitresses if he can have a drink while they wait. I couldn't hear the waitresses flippant answer but her body language said it all. The man got immediately angry and said, "How can you treat your customers like this and expect to stay in business!?" and then stormed out with his date. At the bar, the waitresses gathered and proceeded to talk smack about the man calling him names and pretending it was all his fault they couldn't help him. We are in earshot of all of this, but they still continued to pointedly ignore us. By then my girlfriend was practically in tears over how terrible the service was and we left never having seen a menu, ordered a drink, or even been greeted by the bartender. Terrible service and a big disappointment.

I... Love... This... Place.  Out of a purely research based visit, I have to say.... Amazing. I had the Basil Buschetta Burger.  A freaking smashed meatball,  fried on the grill,  with rosemary fries and Alfredo sauce.  My god.  For the record, fantastic. That of course is beside the epic customer service.  Kind,  courteous, and more than happy to oblige with any requests I had.  Thank you for a great experience,  I'll see you again soon.

Pretty solid BBQ joint. I rank it second behind Bodacious Pig in Eagle among the local BBQ spots. 

Had the ribs and brisket, both were pretty tasty.

Here's a couple tips for the restaurant:

First, authentic "Texas Hill Country Brisket", or any Texas brisket for that matter, is NEVER served with the sauce already on it (same with pulled pork, FYI). 
I was disappointed that it arrived slathered in your house sauce (which isn't bad), because I wanted to to use the spicy sauce on it. 

Also, some design advice - lose the carpeting. Not only is it 2015 but if you do your homework, you'll learn that it's housing some really nasty stuff, which can affect the health of your customers. 

Overall, a good place and I'll probably come back.

Don't expect a gourmet pizza here. This is pretty much a takeout only place. The $5 ready-to-go 1 topping pizza is a quick, cheap and tastes really good for the price. They are much more friendly and personable than the other $5 "pizza, pizza" joint across Fairview. I went here one time and they did not have a pizza ready to go and were very apologetic. They already had one in the oven anyway and it was ready within 5 minutes They more than made up for the small wait. You can also call ahead and get any single topping pizza for $5, which is nice because the other "pizza, pizza" joint now charges an additional $2 for any topping other than cheese or pepperoni.

This is a great, budget friendly option for those busy nights when you just don't feel like cooking.

This is not a gourmet pizza joint, nor do they strive to be. They want to be the best cheap pie in the Meridian area. You want some fancypants pizza? This is not your joint. You want to feed a minivan full of hungry people with a quality and tasty pizza run by awesome, friendly people with a great punchcard deal? This is your pizza joint then. During the football season they have a pickem league. Fun times. 

Again, this is not a gourmet pizza joint. IF you go there expecting that, son you will be disappoint. If you are expecting a cheap tasty pizza pie you will be happy. 

Minimal indoor seating- takeout only.

We didn't have reservations- a mistake but got in due to a cancellation. We're so lucky as we had a wonderful meal. I had the lamb stew and my wife had a scallop special. Both were magnificent. Better even than the food was the service. We were welcomed warmly and treated as if we were special all evening.

Very costly. I paid $19 for a sandwich with a cup of soup and I must say the sandwich was good but the soup was terrible. I will never go back because I feel thats a little much to charge for a sandwich. I was very disappointed in the whole experience.

As someone else already noted Treats and Tragedies raved about this place as both a food truck and when they moved to their new brick and mortar at the Village. First, don't let the lack of decor or the lack of a usual restaurant feel fool you. It's a pretty nondescript place glass doors counters and a small kitchen all out in the open. You may think paper plates plastic silverware. Don't let that any of that fool  you this place has killer Sicilian food!!! 
So if your looking for the best spaghetti and meatballs in town this is the place. Holy cow; the meatballs are perfectly seasoned and then seared in a pan to give them that crunchy crisp texture. I could pop these balls of yummy goodness in my mouth all day. Best meatballs I have ever tasted; not your usual dried out meat on a plat of blah sauce and noodles. The sauce is made fresh daily; it is bursting with flavor. I have been to several places in town and honestly I have left going that was pretty blah no flavor nothing I couldn't whip up in my own kitchen by dumping a jar of sauce on some pasta. Their sauce you can tell is made fresh with fresh spices and seasonings finished off with pasta that is made fresh every day. How many places can you go to in town and get made fresh daily pasta? Not only that the price can't beat. The portion sizes are generous and filling. For the appetizer the ravioli is great as well. The alfredo sauce is the best in town so much so that is goes quick like those BBQ places in the south once its gone its gone so make sure you get there before the dinner rush to get it. I actually love the fact everything is made from scratch if they run out they are out; I would take that over a jar of sauce any day. Just says they care about the taste of their food and taking the time to do it right every day without cutting corners. If your in the area on Tuesday they have an awesome deal $5 pasta Tuesdays..
One last thing.; customer service is a bit shaky. Don't let the lack of it or a bad experience drive you away. I trust in time this will come around and it will be a well rounded awesome experience. I have had a couple of bad customer experiences as has had a friend but neither of us really cared because the food is just out of this world you can't get food like this anywhere in the Valley you won't be disappointed!!
Update 7-25-14
The general manager and head chef Jake reached out to me and said "We have been very busy making sure that our food is top notch, change your life spectacular and have unfortunately overlooked that aspect of the restaurant. I hope this is not too extreme of an issue that you won't come back though! this is an issue that I will personally address."

We typically have good luck at this theater.  We like the ability to reserve our seats. Tonight was an exception.  Granted it was their slow night (Sunday at 9:15 pm).  They simply didn't have enough trained employees to handle the eight customers at the ticket counter. One incorrect credit card transaction stopped anyone else from getting their tickets.  If the kiosk had been working, it would have been helpful.

I really like Kohls... They have a great selection of kids clothes and good prices. Go with the mailer/coupons and get up to 30% off! The rewards card accumulates your spending with points that reward $ off future purchases. I have never had issues with returning or exchanging items.
Wowza! The best Thai food we've had in a while. The service was awesome! Couldn't have asked for a better experience. We will be back soon!

What can I say.... Food was awesomely delicious, our waitress was friendly and courteous. Would highly recommend the burnt ends and everything else.  Portions are huge, so left overs the next day, yum. Check it out for yourself.

After going to Epi's, we had lunch at the Basque Market the following day and this only reinforced my opinion about Epi's. The pintxos at the Basque Market are spot-on and the meatballs are amazing! Seriously, try the meatballs at Epi's and then have them at the Basque Market and you'll see what I mean. Epi's are Subway or Pizza Hut quality.

You will not find  better place to eat anywhere! The service is the best I've ever had and the food...oh the delicious food! I love going to Epis! I'm treated like family and its so nice and welcoming. The food  is always amazing and you get so much of it. We love you Epis!!!

We ordered the Stromboli as well as the Manicotti that  was on special. This is the closest to Italian since my Nona made it from her kitchen. The sauce is homemade, the cheese filling was excellent !!!. The stromboli was very good. Ingredients were fresh and the dough was perfect. Can't wait to try everything else. You made a fan out of us Joe, thanks a bunch!!!   Kim /(aka- erica)
Go here every time I'm in the Boise/Meridian area. Never disappointed and highly recommended!

Yummy yummy! Had the chicken makhani and garlic naan! Definitely come try it out!! Tucked in a strip mall this place definitely rivals places I've been and loved in Seattle. Take heed with the spice levels. I ordered 2 out of 5 and it was plenty spicy for me!
What a great new place!  Great atmosphere, comfortable and fun!  The pizzas were awesome. And the creme brûlée was very well done!
Good, not great.  I was expecting something different but maybe my family's description of Basque food was wrong.

I've been in to CT Nails and Spa a few times. I've always had a great experience. The first time was actually during their health inspection. They passed with flying colors. The second time I came in with my sister. Great service and personalities of the employees. Great Manicure and Pedicure. I did make an appointment in advance. They do tend to not give realistic time estimates, but i'm there for the relaxing experience so time isn't always an issue for me.

What has happened to Kohl's?...used to be one of my favorite stores. Arrived here this evening to look for a purse. The place was empty...only a handful of customers were in the store.  Employees were milling around, but no one bothered to ask customers if they needed any help.  Went to the handbag section and the place was a mess. Stuff in the aisles...and the purses were all disheveled. It looked like a thrift store.  I went to the front counter to ask a question and the girl just pointed me back to where I came from. Asked another employee and she acted as if I was annoying her and tried to get away as fast as possible. Saw a couple of managers chatting and another trying to avoid eye contact in case he should have to answer a question.
How sad. This once innovative store looks like a shadow of its former self. When you have more employees than customers in the store, it should be a wake-up call.

These folks go out their way to make sure you get what you are looking for. It's not a perfect place but what place is? I've walked away sometimes without a certain bolt or whatever but generally they have something that will work. As well, their garden area is pretty good.

NEVER OPEN. 

I've driven to this location (which is NOT near my house) twice. Both times I scrupulously checked online hours to make sure the dog baths were open-- the hours were why I was willing to make the drive. 

I emptied my car, loaded my dog, clippers, and brushes, and drove across town. Both attempts were failures. 

Try 1: Father's Day (or something similar).  Handwritten sign saying they were closed. Not a traditional holiday to be closed and the website said nothing. 

Try 2: The most frustrating. Left work early to make it in by 5:45 and still have 1:15 to trim and wash my dog. The website listed a closing time of 7. After waiting for an employee, was told that there is NO TRIMMING AFTER 5. Ever. Even if you bring your own supplies.  No reference to this "policy" anywhere online or in store. 

...is the hassle of getting out a broom really worth losing customers over...? 

I'll never try going back. Not worth my time.

If you are in the area you MUST eat here. If you are lucky it will be a night that Chris makes the "Cream of Shrimp soup with rice", the most delicious soup in a long time. The portions are large so maybe split. Our friends had the Medallions, cut with a folk. We had the Halibut, no fish taste, delicate and oh so delicious. Sides grate.

Cameron was fantastic to work with. He is honest, nice, and a hard worker. No scams, no hidden fees. He did not waste time, he would run up the stairs, walk quickly between trips to the truck, and handled all items with care. He truly cares about his customers and wants them to be satisfied. He takes pride in his work and his business. Highly recommended.

In all actuality I can't review this place. This is because after a half an hour the server mentioned she forgot to put in our order. We are also the only ones in the restraunt.  While still somewhat new, I guess they need to still work out the kinks.

Fun experience. Food is good atmosphere is great certainly a different way to have a dinner. If you want something different for a change head on over. If you're nervous about trying it go at lunchtime they have a special and I'm sure you'll have a good time.

Grilled chicken salad was supposed to be salad with grilled chicken and sautéed mushrooms.  Think I got 3 slices of small mushrooms and chicken was as thin sliced add the lettuce.  I love this place,  it is our neighborhood bar and this salad should have had mushrooms and good pieces of chicken.  Very, very small amount!  Sad!!
"Sex on a plate." So good. Food was so good. Service was excellent. Friendly staff. Everything was perfect. Next time I am here I am coming back.

Epi's is hands down one of the best restaurants in the Treasure Valley. It is a must try...repeatedly. Not only is the food phenomenal and on point every time, but Chris and her team are so accommodating and the nicest folks. They welcome you like family. They never disappoint!

Can't get any worse! Stay away. 
Poor quality food and service. Very dryers thallus and cold sauce. Disappointing.

You feel like you are sitting down to a meal in a home located somewhere in Spain's countryside.  You feel like family, and you can taste the extra care they take in the food.  Don't miss the bread pudding.

Rick's is great because it's local, it's homegrown, and it's very unique! Founded by Rick and his wife (who are also the two main staffers), it's got a small menu with lots of variety. It's a bit on the spendy side, but it's worth it just to say you've gone. And I think, after trying it once, you'll consider it one of your destination spots in Meridian. We recommend making a reservation. You just never know when it's going to be a full house (or completely empty, surprisingly!).

Food: The food is fun, because it's all over the board. From the chili garlic wings (which are great), to burgers (we top ours with cheddar, bacon and a fried egg), steaks, fish, pastas, salad and a whole array of appetizers, you're sure to find something. The steaks are huge and amazing. I have most recently tried their loaded smashed potatoes, which were a little bland, but the burger was amazing. Don't waste your $6 on the celery slaw... it's just OK (not too much flavor). Be sure to check out their special of the day. It's always more spendy than the rest of the menu, but MAN it's always on point. 

Drinks: Full bar! Water served out of wine bottles... that's fun. Their Jameson & Ginger and specialty cocktails are always delicious. 

Atmosphere: Very bar-like, but it's more upscale than that when it comes to the menu. You can write all over the walls and read for hours on end all of the stories/newspaper clippings. It's a very local vibe. You'll always have your regulars up at the bar top. 

Service: Excellent. Many people claim it to be a little slow. That's usually because it's the owner or just one other person serving. All food is made to order, so when you receive your dish, you know it was done just as you asked for!

Happy Hour Offerings: n/a

Healthy Hack: Order a cup of soup & a side of greens. Very flexible menu.

Tips: Free dessert on your Birthday! Try the daily specials!!

Purchased a new bed from here on 4-30-17.  Bed was delivered on 5-11-17, as we were told it would be.  They didn't put all of the items on, allergy cover and mattress pad, as we were told they would by the sales staff.  Not that big of a deal, but then when we went to put these items on, we discovered the mattress was the wrong size.  It seems the delivery people may have noticed it was wrong and just high tailed it out before we discovered the problem.  I call into the store and speak with a gentleman that says he will look into this and get back to me.  He calls me back in an hour or so, says it is their fault and that they have started return process, and that I should hear something in 2-3 days as to the resolution.  It seemed add it would take 2-3 days, but it was apparent he would be of no more help.  Call my salesman on 5-12-17 to discuss what has happened.  He is aware and assures me they have been working on it all day and I should have a resolution and call back by the end of the day.  No one calls.  5-13 and 5-14, no one calls.  On 5-15-17 I again call the store, my salesman is out so a random person speaks with me.  They assure me its being worked on but they still have no resolution and I will be getting a call back the next day, No call the next day.  I send an email to customer service logging my complaint.  I receive an email back on 5-16-17, stating I should be contacted within 24 hours.  I receive a call on 5-17-17, but again they have no resolution because the CEO is out of town and has to sign off on this.   I ask to speak with the Store Manager, I am put in touch with the "manager" who re-iterates they are working on it but nothing can be done until the CEO is back and signs off.  He has no idea when this will happen, nor can he tell me what the time frame is after the CEO signs off.  At this point I figure out this is the Sales Manager, not Store Manager.  I again ask to speak with the Store Manager.  He is also out of town, I leave a message for him to contact me.  At this point, I log a complaint with Ashley corporate stating my frustration in not having a resolution.  I receive a voicemail from the Store Manager on 5-18-17 around 8:00pm.  He has called my office number somehow, and apparently didn't check my file as my cell is listed there.  I receive a phone call from Ashley delivery on 5-19-17 stating that the correct bed will be delivered on 5-27-17. Finally a resolution and we decided to just let it go and deal with it.  I receive anther phone call on 5-23 or 24, from Ashley saying that the bed wasn't delivered to their warehouse, so they can't deliver on 5-27 and I will get another phone call with a new delivery date.  I receive another phone call from Ashley stating the bed will now be delivered on 6-1-17.  On 5-31-17 I get a phone call from Ashley to inform me the delivery people are not in my area on Thursdays and the bed will now be delivered on 6-2-17.  The correct bed was actually delivered on 6-2-17,  33 days after I purchased it.  I am baffled that it would take this long to correct a problem they created and after numerous phone calls to them, that the issue was not escalated and resolved.

Really excellent hibachi dinner tonight with family celebrating a birthday.  The filet minion steak was the best we have ever had at a hibachi style restaurant.  Fresh vegetables were excellent.  Soup was good.  Side salad before the meal wasn't great.  Also tried the Idaho sushi roll which was tasty.  Will definitely come back again for special occasions.

I've been here several times and the pizza is always good. I like the wide selection at lunch time and the service. I walked in and a matter of minutes I had my pizza and eating away. 

They have a very unique selection.  My last visit I had the potato one. I didn't know it was when I selected it but it was surprisingly good.  

The dining area on the roof was real cool also. Had a nice view of Meridian  and a nice breeze.  The temp outside was lower than normal. I imagine it wouldn't be that pleasant on real hot days. On those days I'd surely eat inside we're its cool.

I used to love this place. Now I will never go back after my last experience. We called 2 and a half weeks in advance for a reservation of 25 people for a birthday and graduation party. They said perfect we have that for you. We show up at 5:45 (our reservation is at 6). They tell us yes we are just clearing your party room. 20 minutes later we ask what is going on. This time they tell us they are waiting for people to leave the room! 20 more minutes they host says she is so sorry and the people are taking forever to leave. We personally walked back to each party room. People were just getting their meals made! 20 more minuets go by, the manager told us she was sorry and we could have our appetizers for free. We were literally walking out the door when the lady came running our saying our table is ready. We get to the table and come to find out it doesn't even sit all of us! 3 of our members had to sit at a different table all together!!!!! We got our "free appetizers which we didn't even get to pick they decided which ones for us! Half of us didn't like edamame. To make matters worse the servers we had were horrible. The lady didn't understand that the people at the other table were with us and they didn't get drinks till we complained to the manager... again! The server missed 3 people's drinks even after we pointed it out multiple times. The cook was great, thank god. Then of course when many of us got our bills they were all wrong. Getting someone to adjust it was like pulling teeth. I went to the host desk and of course only the server could change it. She didn't understand what the hell I was saying. They also of course added a nice 18% on the check for themselves. I am never ever one to complain. But seriously this was horrible service all around. I have worked in food before so I know how it could be. But seriously so many things could have been fixed. The manager on duty needs to learn how to take care of her people. Especially when they are bringing 25 people. We spent a lot of money there. And never will again. Just a warning to anyone with a large party.
This place is a hidden gem. Excellent summer roll, along with salad and pad Thai noodles.  Food was fresh, well spiced and incredibly flavorful.   I will come here next time I am in Boise.

I love going to this theater! 
The reserved seating is so convenient and the seating itself is super comfy. When we go I always upgrade to the VIP lounge. The food is really good and it's just more comfy. 
My only negative comment is in regards to the DBox seats. They are cool but no where near $8 extra cool.

I had to make a yelp account to tell you how awesome Jamie is. Hands down the best spray tan I've ever had. I always look on Yelp and read the reviews but never wrote one myself...so here it goes!

I always get spay tans and needed to find one near my parents house in Green Valley as I was getting engagement photos done in Napa on Sunday. I found Jamie thru yelp and read her reviews and reached out to her...super fast response! Jamie is so sweet and feels like I have known her for years. I am definitely a forever client of hers now and getting my tan for my wedding and recommending my bridesmaids and family to her.
Good savory bbq.Atmosphere open and cozy with great service...Friendly...we did a family meal selection off the menu and had major leftovers...Yummy...

We love this place!

We have order in restaurant and to-go and both experiences were really good! 

They have super fresh, high quality ingredients and the dishes are delicious.

My fave:

Pineapple Fried Rice
Panang Chicken 
Thai Tea

Epi's is an experience.

It's Basque food at its absolute finest.

What you should know:

1)  You should enter into a dining experience here knowing that it is a little spendy.  Come prepared.  

2)  You should also come prepared to purchase an appetizer.  Are their portions ample?  Yes.  So, why the need for appetizers?  Ham croquetas.  They have easily the best croquetas in the Treasure valley.  

3)  Your dining experience will take a while.  They give you ample time to enjoy each course.  If you are in a time crunch--this is not your place.  Our party of 9 spent 3 hours dining here.  The nice thing about how they space each course is that you're not filled up on soup, salad, bread, and 'tizers by the time your main dish comes.  The pace is very leisurely.  This could get downright annoying if you didn't have the time for it--so be sure you do.

4)  If you wish to split one meal with your dining companion--tell them and they will bring it out presented beautifully on two plates.  Two couples in our party did this and I so wish my dining companion and I would have thought of it as we both ordered salmon (which was their nightly special) and both weren't able to finish.

5)  Order dessert.  Their bread pudding is stupid delicious.  It's precisely the same bread pudding your Basque grandmother would make you when you were little as an offering of culinary love.  She'd say, 

"I have a little something for you, my little kuttuna."  

And, you'd practically squeal, "ahhh...Amona...it smells delicious!"  

That is, if you had a Basque grandmother.  Which, as it turns out, I do not.  But, if I did?  She would have baked me this same exact bread pudding and said precisely that.  The point?  It's the stuff dreams are made of, my people.

Get to it!

Had the steak and shrimp, the "steak" was so small it looked cute. The cook doesn't clean his grill grates, so you have a nice burned crust on your steak.

The service was great but the food was just blaw....niw three hours later my stomach is killing me, and I sit on the toilet. Yah never again, i guess i should of known with only three people in the restaurant.
The fungus amongus is absolutely incredible! I add meatballs for an extra bit of fun.

We were greeted immediately after we walked in and our drink order was taken quickly. With the Yelp recommendation of the garlic roast beef sandwich, I went for it. I was not disappointed and ate the entire sandwich which can fed two. The service and food were great. They get 5 stars from me!
This is an amazing and awesome place!!!!! Definitely the one that you have to try if you are in Boise. I had butter fish for dinner, the taste was amazing!!!!! And I love all those lovely waitresses!
Excellent food and service. Very friendly. Didn't know about Bosnian food. Found it much like Greek. Had gyro dinner and cabbage rolls. Both delicious. Very "mom and pop". No frills.
The most amazing dining experience complete with the most personable and warm service to the splendid, yummy food! Love, love, love!

The food, the staff, and the memories are fantastic. I had a lamb shank that melted off the bone in a wonderful sauce on top of garlic mashed potatoes - absolutely fantastic. My husband had tongue (not my thing) that he said was delicious. For dessert we tried the bread pudding and Gateau Basque, both to die for. Make sure you go hungry as they provide a big meal starting with a wonderful red bean soup and tossed salad with Grandma Epi's dressing. I'm so full I could pop, but my taste buds are still screaming for more.  The owners greet you at the door like you are long lost relatives and continue with their cheerful interaction throughout the meal. You can certainly tell this restaurant is a labor of love.  For me, it was extra special because as a child I ate the incredible meals that the original Epi created.  Her family has certainly captured the flavors and hospitality of Epi's kitchen. Don't miss this restaurant, it is wonderful.  I will certainly eat here every time I am back in the Boise area!

Fantastic care and service. Flowers were beautiful and incredibly tasteful, fresh and vibrant. No complaints whatsoever, in spite of some hassles with my own credit card and some renegotiating to our schedule. Teresa was incredibly thoughtful and supportive as we prepared for my mother's memorial service. Excellent florist, by far better than any I spoke to in or around Boise. Do business with them.

This place is new for the area. It was busy but was greeted by the cashier who was cheerful and had a smile on her face. 
I ordered the double cheeseburger with fries and soda. 
Order was taken promptly and I say myself. Within a few minutes my meal was at my table. 
The burger was cooked just right and came just as I had ordered. I am personally not a fan of the crinkle cut fries but they were cooked with the just the right amount of crisp to them. 
Several people stopped by to see if my meal was ok. 
Good place for a burger

I have enjoyed the pulled pork on several occasions (although the buns are usually dry), but the 2 stars come from my experience of the ribs which should be great at a BBQ place. Besides being expensive these were dry, had very little meat on them, and the taste was awful--tasted like motor oil and gasoline.

We had a Wonderful experience with Reliance ... they went above and beyond my expectations when they helped us with our move to Washington. Prices were more than fair for the quality of service. I felt like they took the time to ensure all of my items arrived to my new location exactly how they left. I would and do HIGHLY recommend them to friends and family. Will be using their service for my next move! Thanks!

We have always loved Zupas, but the town we live in doesnt have one even remotely close. So when in Boise area, we go here!! LOVE IT!! the food is always good, the staff is welcoming and friendly!! Awesome place to dine!

Not really much can be added to their already stellar reviews. We love coming here... they make you feel like family. Their food is always phenomenal. I usually order a fish special, or the halibut with lobster sauce. The ham croquettas are delicious, as well. You are always stuffed at the end of the meal, but I usually save half of my entree  for the next day because I NEED dessert here. Their bread pudding is the stuff dreams are made of.  Can't wait until next time!!!

This polished Gem has true American Lamb Chops! OMG!!! 17 years of truly outstanding service is present in the staff the minute you arrive. The Gateau cake is made in house by their Basque Chef! The Red Bean soup is a must for the starter. I will definitely be back in between my travels to this great Hole in the Wall family style restaurant!

This was my second time to experience Epi's. The first was a dinner for two while this time was hosting a group dinner for clients.  Hostess Chris welcomed the group and made certain that we were set up for a lovely meal.  One lady in our group is Basque and between she and Chris, they made sure that our group experienced 'real Basque' food such as tongue, croquetas, roasted peppers and traditional soup. We had one diner who ordered the unique ink fish ( which was actually quite tasty). The croquetas were my personal favorite...imagine a light creamy hush puppy filled with ham. I grew up on hush puppies in the south but these delightful morsels rival them as an appetizer. 
The food was hot, delicious and plentiful.  Marty our server was most attentive. 

The dining room is small and intimate with tables for 2-4 yet there was room for our table of 12 to dine comfortably. 

Fine dining, casual atmosphere, affordable with the most gracious hosts. It is an experience dining at Epi's and a must for when dining in Boise.

I hope the new building is better! For the price... I wasn't a fan. Everything is run down and broken, dirty and ran by teen Agers that don't really know what's going on. In the toddler area all the nets that are meant to keep toddlers from falling ( up to probably 5 ft) aren't even secure on the bottom, there for WATCH YOUR KIDS LIKE A HAWK!
This is one of my favorite restaurants on the planet!  I love Chris and co. the food is amazing and it is really accurate.  Cheapest way to enjoy the Basque country without the flight!!!

I called last minute. Kris was so hospitable,  and fit us in. The food was great as always . (Expect traditional since they are Epi's recipes) , but the fish was totally yummy. One of my favorite  restaurants  in Idaho. Such a treat!
One of my favorite sushi places. Good price and good food. My kids love the fried rice as well. Great for my sushi cravings without spending a ton of money!

Such a horrible experience. Tried taking my family to the "eve of distraction". We purchased our tickets online and the email clearly says to present the barcode and the email to be scanned at the gate on your mobile device for entrance. We got to the gate after a 40 minute drive there and a 15 minute walk to the gate followed by 15 minute wait in line. We were told to go home and print them off because they dont have a scanner. Security was very rude and horrible. Lots of in happy customers. Shame on meridian speed way for ruining our evening and stealing our money!

I had high hopes for Panda Garden but I was disappointed. We ordered take out. The Amazing Chicken was quite good, but We were very surprised that a saucy dish did not come with any rice. We also got the Seafood Hot and Sour soup and the egg rolls, they were terrible. The soup had heat but no sour, and the seafood was mostly that mealy fake crab and a few baby shrimp. The egg rolls were just inedible. I would rate it lower but the guy running the counter was pleasant and the chicken tasted good.
I'm not a big Sushi person but the sushi I got was excellent we went at lunch and I thought the prices were Fair the service was good and it was fairly quiet
Whenever I want a place to relax and have a quiet lunch or dinner ricks is the place. located in the heart of downtown meridian its a small café and easy to miss but it well worth finding and dining

Really bad gel manicure.  Only lasted a few days, the gel was so thick the polish came off easily as
If they were press on nails.  I made an appointment with someone who was recommended to me and was confused after she started when I realized this was a different person doing my nails.  It was loud in the salon and she kept saying what and huh?  This salon was unprofessional to the point where someone that worked there was getting her knees waxed in the front.  Back to my nails.  I should have been wearing my glasses but they were awful, gel was all over my cuticles and underneath my nails.  I will not be going back, ever.
Great food and service.  The kids love it. We are having wings, fish and chips, stake nochos.

me and my husband came here with a Groupon. we love Indian food and have been in 2 other Indian places

lots of menu choices I was suprised. I love that the TV is showing some dancing. We are here for dinner, it's clean and the art on the walls is really beautiful. 

the staff is friendly as well the food is good. they have a lunch buffet! I need to come back and try the lunch buffet for sure.

the food was really good, except that I was expecting more cashews when they say the dish has some not like 4 if them on top. 

I would give it a 5 star if my food had more cashews. I wanted free Naan too. all other Indian restaurants have free Naan.

Wife and I love Epi's. When you go your treated like family and the food is excellent. You order your main meal and it's like you get a five course dinner. Things to know, you will need to call and make reservations, as it's always booked full and they typically have to turn away walk-ins. Also it's a small and cozy place, but we like that part.

I brought the kids to use their book-it coupons and ordered a medium for ourselves. It was Friday, November 4, 2016 around 7:30 pm. The waitress was a complete waste. Spent more time cleaning the dining room so she could leave as soon as they were closed then paying any attention on us. The kids were served their pizza's and a promise was made that our bbq chicken pizza would be out soon....30+ minutes later after everyone had consumed their pizza she comes out and says, "what did you guys order again?" say whah??? Another 15 minutes passes and we are told the pizza was almost ready and they'd comp us a measly $8. Beware, they hire twits here....

Loved the food! I'm originally from Tennessee and I can say this place is 100% authentic southern BBQ. Their portions are very generous and I haven't been able to put down a whole plate yet, so I usually end up with some bonus BBQ for a midnight snack. Finally, a legit BBQ place in the Boise area. I'll be going back again and again...

You know a restaurant is amazing when you have recurring dreams about the delicious steak you ate there. Yummy steak, pork chops are amazing, the salmon is phenomenal and I don't even like salmon!  We love the cool newspapers all over the walls and watching Rick in the kitchen doing what he does best. The only thing we don't enjoy is the smell of stale cigarette smoke from the smoke shop next door. Still worth it though to eat this yummy food!

I have been looking for my go-to Thai restaurant in the area and think that I may have found it. After a work meeting, that went waaay too long, we were starved and, with the help of our Yelp app, found Thai Basil.
The interior is quiet and cozy and the servers very friendly. Whenever I go to a new Thai restaurant, I order the yellow curry...it's both a tradition and serves as my rubric. (i.e., If the curry is lackluster, the other dishes will follow.) How happy was I that TB had an exceptional yellow curry that hit all the right notes: rich, creamy curry sauce, with just the right balance of meat and veg. But here's their secret ingredient (I sure they won't mind me sharing): pineapple!  The curry was sweetened by small chunks of pineapple and, I assume, pineapple juice. A wonderful touch.
We also ordered an appetizer of crispy spring rolls that was accompanied by a very fresh tasting plum sauce.
Thai Basil is a little bit out of my way but for curry like this, it's worth the drive.

This place does a wonderful job grooming our Pomeranian, and always provides excellent customer service. We also wash our golden retriever here and love having everything we need provided. Would highly recommend!!

Epi's is a dining experience. The first time I visited my daughter made reservations to surprise me and oh what a surprise! Introductions were made and it was like talking to an old friend. Then we sat down the wine almost beat us to the table. The food courses are timed perfectly and you are never rushed. It was delicious! From the first course (I had scallops and they were to die for and I come from the coastal area of California where seafood is plentiful, these were the best I ever had) through dessert, if you still have room. So pace yourself.

The second time at Epi's was just as good as the first a year later. I was greeted by name (she remembered) and we had another fantastic meal.

I have now been to Epi's multiple times and send my daughter and son-in-law a gift certificate for their anniversary dinner. Everyone loves it. Now that I am actually moving there I hope to become a more frequent visitor. The people, the service and the food are outstanding.

Typically I have attentive and on time experiences here with caring employees. Today I had far from anything like it. I came in at 2 o clock with my children to see if there was any cancellations for the day, or if I could walk in. I was told that I could try for a walk in at 2:30 but if I wanted to not wait and go right in I can take a cancelled spot at 4:50 - my children having swim lessons down the street at 5:45 I figured this would be plenty of time. She even scanned my ID and took my insurance at the time. Unfortunately I sat in the lobby with my two children expecting to be seen right away like I was told sitting for 50 mins having to have a friend down the street pick up my children to take them for swim lessons as I ask the counter lady how much longer it was going to be she told me I was next and they were just waiting for a room. But again, another person was called back and I was stuck waiting. Finally 1 hour later and I get back in a room but unfortunately I'm still sitting here 1 hour and 12 mins after my scheduled appt time of 4:50 and I still haven't been seen by anyone while I've now missed my children's swim lessons.

We were greeted at the door like family. It stated out great and only got better. Staff were all smiles and friendly. The food, oh the food. Home cooking at its finest. Each enter comes with soup AND salad and two sides. An epicurean delight.

We were in the mood for a salad bar and had a gift card for Sizzler so we decided to go on a Saturday evening. We started with the lettuce and the very first bowl had some dark green slimy stuff on top similar to what's at the bottom of the bagged salad after 2 weeks. Fortunately the other lettuce options were fresh. I can't really say anything else was bad, it just wasn't good enough to go back. When I eat out I prefer quality over quantity and the quality just isn't there.

Came in to pick up my online purchase.  The line was long because rather than directing the people to returns for returns and online pickup for online pickup they made everyone stand and wait for returns customers and exchange customers to be helped using the excuse that the computer was not working.  The lie was bold face as they were clearly using more than one computer.  We were then asked after finally reaching the front of the line if all behind us were there for an online pickup as well.  It was at that point they finally decided to radio someone to come and do the job that should already be taking place as they had been open for several hours.  So the entire line of people who had stood waiting to be helped were told to move aside and wait.  The gal who finally came had to physically go collect your items.  What's the value sending your customers a message telling them their order is ready when it's clearly not?  Will never come to this store again.

I love that they have a play set inside - it kept my daughter entertained while waiting for her turn. It's nice that the seats are little play cars and such to keep the kids happy and each station has a little tv with Netflix, which is great. We just went here for my daughter's first haircut. I didn't think the stylist was the most friendly and I think my daughter's bangs look a little funny like uneven (two other people also commented on it), but that may just be because she's a kid and it's harder to cut their hair. The cut was expensive for just her bangs and maybe 1/2" taken off, but I can't complain about that because the price was advertised and I knew how much it was when I decided to take her here. 

They gave her a balloon at the end and they usually offer a sucker at the end, but I asked if she could have it during the cut and it helped keep her still and happy. They do a $2 military discount and have discounts in those Parents booklets that they have at a lot of doctors offices. 

I'd definitely take her back just because of the entertainment for her.
This place was fabulous! Yummy food, and great service! Very nice! Creative plating, beautiful atomosphere! We loved it!

We stopped in last night about an hour before close. We had two burgers with fries.  The burgers were ok, not the best I've ever had but certainly not the worst either. The server was very friendly, but she didn't stop by again until we'd finished the burgers. Ketchup needed refilling so we just snagged one from the next table. Then we ordered molten lava cake. It was very rich and chocolatey. Took a while to get our check, but again, the server was very friendly and sweet. 

They have a LOT of televisions, so if you want to watch sports, this is a great place. 

They were open fairly late, so we'd probably go again. Prices were fair.

Me like. 1st time here. Drove past it a thousand times. I had a Very Tasty Philly Cheese steak. I will be back often for it.
Cheers. Oh and the bartender is very cute and polite, thats not just the 2 beers talking, but it did make it funny for me to write it.

We just moved here from CA Bay Area and this is the first Asian/Chinese we've had in the area. After research and looking for delivery, I settled on Panda Garden. It took exactly one hour from calling to the doorbell ringing, which was perfect, about the same time for a pizza. We had the chow mai fun veggie, pork fried rice, lemon chicken, broccoli beef and veggie spring rolls $27, pretty reasonable.
