Everything was packaged nicely, very fresh, tasty and not super greasy or heavy. The rice was a little dry, but not bad. The broccoli beef had literally 4 pieces of broccoli and all meat, I could of used a few more broccoli. Considering how spoiled we were in CA with the plethora of Asian, and well made Asian cuisine available we were pleasantly surprised and pleased. The service interaction on the phone, and with the delivery person was good as well. All aspects combined: delivery, service, timelines, and quality of product = 4 stars

Haven't had a bad meal at this place!  Super pricing considering the huge portions of food! My favorite is the smoked turkey, with mixed veggies and their heavenly potatoes. Whatever the chef puts in them is perfectly blended with garlic and cheese and salt and texture. So amazing!! Come here for a place to watch a game, have a family gathering, or a date night. Staff was very friendly and willing to customize some of our food to help us enjoy it better!!

I honestly don't think you'll get better service than this place. I felt like I was family walking in and like I was going to be missed when I was leaving. Genuinely, too.

The owners and staff here obviously pour their hearts into every aspect, from the service to the food itself (which is fantastic).

I highly recommend Epi's, and I'll be sure to go back whenever I return to Boise.

Love Zupa's! Staff is friendly. My sandwich wasn't done by time i checked out but they brought it to where i was sitting when it was.  They are newly opened but food and atmosphere is just as great as the others i've been to in UT and AZ.

We went here November 10, 2017 for their soft opening. Atmosphere was nice, but certainly smaller than we expected. Wouldn't want to come during the "dinner rush" as the wait time could add up quickly. 
Pig destroyer pizza was good. It has sausage, ham, bacon, peppers, and jalapeños. A bit skimpy on toppings. Also had the calamari with a yummy dipping sauce. Good texture, but don't think we'd order it again for the price/portion. The outer pizza crust had a great texture with a great smoky flavor, however, the center of our pizza was less than desirable in the crispy department. It was a bit undercooked, soggy and flimsy. 
Our waitress was friendly, but didn't offer any menu details or recommendations, she seemed a bit overwhelmed. 
With them just opening, we understand they're trying to work out the kinks. Nothing bad, nothing amazing. We will visit again to see how they're doing next year.
Burnt ends were great, beans and potato salad are really good too.   Great food, great service and of course good beers.    Check it out.   It's worth it.

I had come in with my family. I ordered a medium well steak and the steak I received was so overcooked it was almost like beef jerky. I told the waiter and he just said well that's how they look when they are done. I am a cook at a restaurant and was extremely unimpressed with how I was treated when I asked for a new steak.

The hibachi is great and the chefs are hilarious. The process is typically a little longer than a usual dinner so always expect to wait more than normal. The filet mignon was prepared perfectly and the sauces are delicious. For Idaho, this is a nice change of pace from your usual dining spots.

1st visit sunday. i am very hard to please when it comes to barbaque since i am from Texas & i know what good bbq is supposed to be. this was not bad compared to a couple of others i've tried since moving up here, but it was definitely not up to my standards. started with the onion rings. very large & i really did like the batter on them. think it would be even better on chicken. i had the 2 meat plate with burnt ends & turkey, mac & cheese & steamed vegetables. the meats were very tender & they were not over cooked or dry. but no flavor on their own.  the brown sauce was to brown sugar sweet to me & to thick. the red sauce didn't seem to have much flavor & no heat. did not try the mustard because i don't like mustard sauces. the mac & cheese tasted like expensive boxed pasta & the steamed veges were very very soft. i prefer some crunch. my sons sandwich was very small & he didn't say anything about it one way or the other if he even liked it. i did get a slice of the key lime pie & it was good the crust was way rich & tasted very buttery, but i like that so it's all good there. prices were reasonable. honestly don't know if i will go back.

Nice atmosphere coming in. Was greeted promptly and seated immediately. The server came immediately to take our drink order, unfortunately a larger party walked in right after us and took about 10 minutes to get our order but it was worth the wait. We ordered the mozzarella sticks and 2 meatball subs and spaghetti and meatball. The subs came with homemade chips and pepperocinis on the side. The spaghetti was enough to feed 3 people and the flavors were fantastic! Highly recommend!
Had the chicken tikka with naan, good not great. Tasted bland to me. The rice was probably the best part.
Just moved here from out of state and so happy I could cry.  They have FANTASTIC Tom Ka!  Also had the pad Thai.  Delish!!!!
Love the theater but the bar could use some help.  I had the worst Blood Mary of my life here on Sunday.  I really should have asked for something else.  My bad.  Otherwise, theater was great!

No service vehicle?!

My rear tire in my vehicle was slowing leaking air so I brought it in to get it checked out (for free since I bought my tires at another Big 0) and they informed me that they could not find a hole in my tire. They thought it was a leak between my tire and alloy wheel, so they used a rubber barrier to seal it and fix the problem. The next day when I was driving to work I realized the same tire they worked on the day before was now completely flat! I called them and let them know the problem and asked for a service vehicle to come out and fix my tire. To my surprise they do not have a service vehicle! I'm stranded on the side of the road in the snow with a 6 month old baby in the car and they suggest for me to either inflate it myself (with what?!), or call a tow truck (who will pay for that?!) what a disappintment. I love the Big O store in Boise on State Street. I guess next time my tire is low I will have to go across town to get that taken care of right the first time.

We were school shopping with the kids the other night, and wanted to dine outside.  After walking out of Pie Hole last summer because their restaurant was so dang hot, I wanted to try their new location.  Especially after seeing the cool rooftop dining!

As we walked in, a young blonde girl behind the counter looked at us.  No smile.  No greeting.  Snobbish comes to mind.  The next thing I noticed was her choice of "clothes", which looked much more appropriate for a street corner.  Of course I expected a very casual atmosphere and dress (much like Flying Pie), but even our daughters raised their eyebrows.  Super short shorts.  A t-shirt that had slices all over the back, which exposed way more of her pink bra than is fashionable.  Looking at the menu, we read about the 2 slice special for happy hour, but could not find anything indicating when happy hour was. Having never been there before, it took us a bit to decide on dinner.  The employee did not offer any help (ex. asking if this was our first visit, giving pizza suggestions, etc...).  We finally decided on a pizza with a price that was hard to swallow.  Ordering drinks was a bit difficult as well.  It was hard to see what was available in the cooler, but were pleased with a bottle of brown and a can of IPA.  The employee was profient taking our payment, utilizing an iPad with Square.  We happily escaped to the roof, as the restaurant was warm - did not have air, or not utilizing AC?

The roof was fun!  Trex(?) decking, or at least the stairs.  Metal seating was comfortable.  Nice umbrellas and view. Though not open, there was a great bar with taps, which to us is much more preferable over bottled beer.  4 other people were seated, and only 3 others arrived after we did, so it was a quiet, casual atmosphere.

Our pizza arrived quickly, and now we understood the price.  8 mega slices of thin crust pizza.  A bit greasy, but very good!  Near the end of our enjoyable evening on the roof, only our family and one other older couple remained.  Suddenly, there was music.  Rap music?  The first song was mellow, but the second song drove us out.

Here's where the caution comes...  It was dark.  Remember the nice stairs?  Now they weren't as nice.  All 4 of us had to step cautiously, as there was no light.  Not overhead.  Not on the steps.  Huge risk for a company.

We will be back for the pizza and rooftop dining, and hope to catch the bar open...  and that it has a friendlier vibe than downstairs.

I would have rated Pie Hole a 4, if it had not been for the tacky, lack of service.

I tried Izumi last night for the first time as it's located right next to work and on the way home. I got a few sushi rolls (spicey salmon and eel & avocado), a "Geisha Girl" martini and a coors light. A friend of mine who also bartends (James) there got a rock shrimp appetizer and calamari for us to share. I gotta say that this place has their food on point! Very fresh and very tasty! The prices are extremely fair and the environment is quite relaxed unless you're eating hibachi (trying that out next week with all the guys from work). All in all I would highly recommend giving this local business a shot, you won't be disappointed! James' drinks are well worth the $$$

Welcome to "Hands Across Generica".  This little mall experience is just another chain beer/wing place with wall to wall televisions.  There is nothing bad nor nothing remarkable about this place.  The staff is friendly and the beer is cold.

Just moved into town and was hankering for pad thai. I feel like if a Thai place can't make decent pad thai then it's not somewhere to try anything else at. Thai Basil delivered on that front... pad thai was delicious, even gave us extra peanuts in our take away. Also ordered the yellow curry and subbed in tofu, it was delicious and I'll definitely be ordering again. Tasted very fresh, my husband liked the little eggplants in the curry. The last thing we ordered were eggrolls, which I don't think they make there (possibly from frozen), weren't nearly as good as the paper-thin ones we used to get at home, I'd rate them as OK but wouldn't order them again. Didn't spend much time in the restaurant, but the girls at the register were very nice and friendly.

Decided to give this place a second chance because the pizza was good the first time I had it. We tried ordering online, on a Sunday, for delivery- bad idea. After an hour we called to check on the status of our order and we're told "it's Sunday and I am the only employee in the building so we don't check online orders or deliver." Awesome! We called "Smokey Mountain Pizza" instead. It was worse than Dominos. Instant regret. Last night we thought about giving them a second chance. We called and ordered for delivery. Nope, one employee working- no delivery. Maybe they shouldn't advertise online ordering and delivery??? As always, the pizza was good- thin, crispy crust...greasy, hot and delicious. I would give the food a 5 all day, but the service needs to be a focus if they want to have the business to need more than one employee. I would recommend the pizza, it's the closest thing to NY style pie in Idaho that I've found- just plan on CALLING and PICKING UP to save the headache. 
Rec

You cannot go wrong eating here! Super people, wonderful food in a warm and inviting family restaurant! The prices surprised me and then we ate! Oh boy was it a treat for the taste buds and you'll never leave hungry!
Amazing service, beautiful presentation, lovely owners and delicious sushi!! We will definitely be back!
This place is amazing. Will never go anywhere else. Every time I go in I'm greeted with a friendly smile and great service. I would recommend V3 to anyone

A sports bar, in my opinion- can go one of two ways.  It's either all hype and no good, or it's lower key but a home run.  I found Beef O'Brady's to be of the latter!  Spacious and level (important if anyone you love has a mobility challenge) and despite dark floors and hardwoods- surprisingly bright and airy.   I visited with my friend and her two sons, one teen, one pre-teen.  We were seated near a window.  The menu has many choices.. which again can be a red flag- I mean if they have SO MUCH on the menu, how much of it can be TRULY good?  It took us some time to decide what we wanted- but we have beverages in the mean time, brought in a timely manner by our server.  We wound up with 3 sandwiches and an appetizer platter.
When our food was brought out our first glance seemed disappointing.. there were so few french fries on the plate- but as we dug in we realized two things-  the sandwiches were good sized and loaded.. AND the fries.. were AMAZING.    The youngest in our group had the appetizer platter 'Land, Sea and Air' listed as: "3 fresh Angus cheeseburger sliders*, 8 tail-on fried shrimp, crunchy boneless breaded chicken pieces and fries. Served with honey mustard and cocktail sauce."   All of the items were on the plate.  The sliders, which were on pretzel buns were a big hit.  The shrimp and chicken unfortunately were over cooked, and the shrimp (as verified by the taster of both adults at the table) was decidedly fishy.   I went with the "Roast Beef Garlic Melt"-roast beef, sliced onions and provolone cheese served hot and pressed on garlic Cuban bread.  The flavors all melded together perfectly for my palate, and it was served up with some au jus.  The teen and his mother both chose the "Buffalo Chicken Sandwich"- hand-breaded chicken breast fried to perfection then tossed in Beef's® Signature Buffalo sauce, served on a toasted brioche bun with pickles and ranch dressing. Both of them proclaimed it tasty.  
True to the nature of a sports bar, the decor and number of flat televisions fit the bill.  They appear to have a good number of beers on tap.  I'd like to go back for happy hour sometime, and again for lunch. I owe my friend Nancy a thank you for suggesting we visit Beef O'Brady's!
Best McDonald's I've ever been to. Staff is great & they never once got my order wrong which I appreciate. Food is always hot & fresh.

This is a pretty generic chain soup and sandwich place. You go in, tell each station what you'd like, and they "prepare" it for you. The soups are most likely frozen and warmed up during the day, and some of the ingredients that go into the salads are most likely the same. If you have any understanding of bread and deli meats, just make your own sandwich at home. If you can use a can opener, well, you've got soup comparable to what they have there. Blech.

Other than the name - I can't help but snicker evrytime I see it- Goodwood is pretty good for what it is. It's a chain, so don't expect that down home BBQ. But the flavors are good, the meat is plentiful, the food was warm, and the fries were crispy. For the price and location, I recommend it.

Went to this restaurant on a recent visit to Idaho while spending some time with family.  My mom and sister had told me about this place being featured on a food channel show called "Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives" and had said that everyone was raving about their phenomenal salmon, both on the show, and off.  So, with salmon being one of my favorite foods, we decided to go there for my birthday dinner.  The salmon dish is a salmon filet breaded with hash browned potatoes, resting on a small bed of some mashed potatoes underneath, and topped with a lemon garlic sauce...YUM!!  It was delicious!  The staff was all very friendly, and I especially liked how they all seemed to really work together.  Instead of one server per table, they all seemed to work as a team making sure everyone was taken care of at all times...it was refreshing to see a group of people working so closely together with obviously the customer's best interest in mind, instead of worrying about individual tips.  

My mom and I had the salmon dish, my stepdad had the meatloaf and mashed potatoes which he said was excellent, and my little sister had the fettuccine Alfredo which I know was also very tasty because I stole a few bites.

Would definitely recommend this place to anyone in Idaho looking for a satisfying meal in a comfortable cute little place!

Disgusted.... It started when we walked in and were totally ignored by 6 different staff members. We were ready to buy right then, with cash, and knew exactly what we wanted! After trying to get help for about 15 minutes, an older couple walked in & were very promptly greeted. We still were being blatantly ignored. Went to a manager to complain and get some assistance.... two hours and $2000 later, we left nothing but an ESTIMATED delivery date two weeks out. That was about a week ago. Today we get a call notifying us that our bedroom set is ANOTHER two weeks out! SERIOUSLY?!?! First ignored and judged for what they though was or was not in my bank account then pretty much blown off after they get our money! Sickened!!

It's difficult to find REALLY GOOD bbq. Don't look at me cross-wise; you know it's true. Anyway. I'm a native Texan. Beyond that, I'm a native South-Central Texan. I've eaten bbq in places like Austin, Houston, San Antonio, Luling, and Lockhart, where you walk to the counter, order, and get it on butcher paper. I've learned from the absolute best in the business. I know what the Maillard Reaction is, and why it's critical if you want a smoke ring. So when I say that I know bbq, believe me, I know it. 
So now that I've established my credentials, let me say that on Saturday 18 November 2017 I got some damned good Q at this place. I walked in shortly before 4pm, ravenous since I hadn't eaten in 24 hours. Not my choice. 
Anyway. 
I was seated immediately, and my server appeared almost immediately. I ordered a Deschutes Black Butte Porter ON TAP. I've never seen this particular beer on tap anywhere, and it's one of my favorites. Extra star for that. The place was clean and comfortable, and the televisions placed strategically around the dining area were still fairly unobtrusive. It only took me a moment to decide what I wanted: the 2 meat combination. I ordered brisket and sausage; the first because for me the true test of any place is their brisket, the second because they claimed it was German style smoked sausage, and I've been eating that all my life and love it. I was disappointed that brisket cost extra to get, but you can't win all the time. I also ordered the cole slaw and steak fries. 
My plate arrived fairly quickly. I received one sausage link and maybe 6 ounces of brisket. Slightly disappointing on the portion size, but then it's possible I was ordering off the lunch menu. I'm pretty sure I overheard a server telling someone the portions get bigger after 4. The slaw was...interesting. It has peanut butter in it to add to the creaminess, though I couldn't taste it. The fries were fries. 
The sausage was excellent. It was peppery, which is exactly what I was hoping for. The skin was crispy, while the filling was tender. I could even see the smoke ring. It went well with the cup of sauce I received on my plate. The brisket was also extremely good. It was tender, but not dry at all. I had hoped to receive a few pickle slices and raw onion with it, but that's just how we do it in Texas. 
All told the damage came to just over $20. Not bad, but a little pricey considering I had one beer and the 2 meat combo. I walked out full and happy, but I would have preferred fewer fries and another ounce or two of brisket. Regardless, considering this place is a chain, I was impressed. That's hard to do. I'll be back in Meridian at some point in the future, and if I have time, I'll definitely be back here.
Well done.

Ate here (the Boise location) the first time in 2000 then ate at this location last in 2007 and NOTHING has changed.  This is a true 4 Star.  Had the 16 OZ Smoked Prime Rib.  It was a hit!  I usually have the Beef Brisket and the Mrs did and loved it.  Spud was good.  Place was clean, including restroom and service was good and friendly.  Place does get a little busy so don't plan on a drawn out deal.

There really needs to be more to draw your attention over to this quaint little pizzeria. If you aren't looking closely you will pass it! My husband and I took a table by the window and loved the warm cozy feel of the restaurant. We ordered a small Caesar salad each, the garlic sticky bread as an appetizer, and then we built our own vegetarian pizza. Service was friendly and attentive, and the food was all delicious! Some of the best pizza we have had! Definitely ranks high on my list of local pizza restaurants. Prices were reasonable, and especially with the great quality of the food. My only complaint... and I see that others have said the same...your to go styrofoam containers should be replaced with cardboard pizza boxes because it makes your leftovers soggy. I was a little sad about my soggy leftover pizza because it was so delicious the night before. We will be back!
Awesome vet. They are all so sweet to my pup and make her and I feel comfortable. Definitely recommend to everyone

This place exceeded my expectations. The smell of pizza, yeast from dough and garlic was met at the entrance. Joe gives the feeling of being in New York or buffalo. Never been there but he extrudes what I think it is.
I had to try different things with the family. We ordered a 16" pepperoni and sausage pie, was delicious; I even ate the crust, which I hardly do. Ordered a stromboli...Omg this was beyond delicious, this is a meat wrapped drug. Also ordered were pepperoni twists, kids ate those up quickly. The calzone, which was meatballs and peppers, there was something else, but dang I can't remember this was the best calzone I have had in 15 years.
My regret is not taking pictures; just makes all the better to go back for more uniqueness and tasty goodness. This place is my go to pizza joint from now on especially on the way home. Thanks Joe for the goodness.
One of the best spray tans I've had. Color is perfect and no residue marks or blotches. Thanks Jamie!!

First time here....Saturday night and was seated quickly. Bar needs back up bartender - waited too long for a drink. Hibachi was fabulous! Entertaining cooks and good meat / seafood. Poseidon sushi roll was excellent.
The complex itself is the nicest thing to come to meridian.  Our gripe is with the VIP food service in the theater.  The food is just terrible! Not to mention that you only get to order one drink.
This place sets the bar.  Amazing service and great food.  If you haven't tried it you are missing out on a gem!  Make a reservation as they are usually packed.
Really good pizza.  Awesome service.  Very nice people.  Desserts were great, as well!

Great food and service.  The ambiance could use some work as the place looks like they never finished decorating.  Also very loud due to hard wood floors and high ceilings.
Food was very good!

Food was excellent, but the service was even better! I got the stake which came out perfectly cooked as requested (medium rare). My boyfriend got the St Louis spare ribs and they're were so delicious. The serving size were plenty and the prices low compared to what I expect to pay for steak and ribs. The most surprising party was the excellent service we received from the server Jessica! I've eaten at some pretty high end places (Pebble Beach lodge/Spanish Bay and the Commander's Palace in NOLA) but she had them beat. If I were a local we agreed we would wait to sit in her section.

Stellar Company! Quality product and awesome promotions! Very knowledgeable sales staff with very helpful managers! 
Paul was great and very friendly
Typical bar food.  Prices are pretty good..   Wait staff was friendly.

Really great BBQ.  We ordered the family feast and with five big guys, had a very tasty and filling meal.  The BBQ was very well done and the sauce did not overpower the taste of the meat. The beans are really good.  Service was great.  Drinks refilled without asking and regular checking to see if we needed anything.

Simply the best!  Not only is the owner and all her staff incredibly warm and inviting (we were giving them hugs when we left), but this is the most authentic Basque food I've had...and we spend our vacations in the Basque Country.

And don't shy away from the Ink Fish (Baby Squid in Ink Sauce).  This is soooo Basque and is exactly like what we had in Donostia (San Sebastian.)  It might not look appetizing but the flavor is right on the mark and took us back to Donostia, if only for a few minutes.

All I can say is: Oh. My. Gawd.

I'm a professional photographer who recently worked with Laticia on a maternity shoot for one of my clients where she did my clients makeup AND hair both.

I have worked with makeup and hair artists internationally and can fully back Laticia's work. I would give her 6 stars if there was an option to do so. Rarely do you find someone that can tackle makeup AND hair and do it as flawlessly and carefully (and flatteringly - is that a word?) as Laticia can. 

My client's skin and hair looked so beautiful and perfect that there was next to no retouching needed on her photos. That's a first!

Not only is she skilled at her craft and pays attention to the details, but she was fun and kind and also had some creative ideas during the photoshoot that I loved. She's awesome and I'm SO sad that San Diego is losing a great make up and hair artist, but I can promise you that no matter where you find her - you will NOT be sorry for hiring her.

I've eaten Pizza Hut a lot , mostly only eat there because my friends like the stuffed crust. I ordered three pizzas , all stuffed crust. Of course none of them were , even though they had no problem charging me the extra 2-3$ for it. The kids inside were friendly when I picked the pizza up, but I didn't think to look at the pizza , nor did they show it to me. My bad on that part. When I got home, much to my surprise the pizza was not stuffed , overly greasy, and not what I ordered. I called and got what seemed like a call center, and nothing but horrible customer service . Well, long story short, we won't ever be back to this Pizza Hut or any for that matter. 
You're better off paying the extra money, to get a better pizza, and better service at Flying Pie.

Loved bringing my daughter here. The stylist was totally supportive of her hair cutting choices (shaving a side of her head) and made sure my daughter was absolutely ready for the changes about to be made!

It took 3 hrs to delivery my food and they didn't even get all of my order correctly..I was crazy mad and will never order from here again, this food wasn't even close to worth 3 hrs. They say they only charged for what they brought, but will have to check my account tomorrow to make sure. Not the best Chinese food at all if not the worst in boise are. Don't ever order delivery there!

Love this movie theater!  I love that I can purchase my seat before hand and don't have to worry about my perfect seat being open.  The seats are comfortable.   Good popcorn and soda.  I am not a fan of the 21 or older seats.  The waiters don't seem to come except at like 5 minutes before and the nachos I ordered took like 30 minutes and the popcorn upstairs comes out of big garbage bags not out of the machine fresh.  Great movie theater in a great shopping area.

Discovered that many of the dine-out venues at The Village, Meridian also participate in lunch specials with the movie theater on its $5 Tuesdays.  After the movie, we decided stayed for lunch and chose a spot near the fountains and purused  the few dine out restaurants.

We were neutrally greeted when entering the building to view the menu.  After saying we were staying around for lunch after the movie, the woman warmed up a little bit and informed us of the lunch specials and the kids menu.  Lunch specials were $5 for nonna's spaghetti and meatballs or fettuccini alfredo.  Our group ordered one plate of the nonna's spaghetti and meatballs, to try this place out.

The serving was very large.  The marinara sauce is actually superb, however, it was served over linguine noodles.  The 3 rounded tablespoon sized meatballs included were too dense, tough and on the dry side and not to my taste.  I think they had added allspice or nutmeg, anyway too much allspice. I only ate one.  There was a toasted piece of bread included on the side which was a nice touch.  I wish they would have used actual spaghetti noodles.  For $5 I felt it was appropriate.

Would I eat here again? Hmmmm, not sure since there are so many other options to choose from.  Perhaps if I had to have italian food that moment.  Maybe some other things on the menu are better? I don't know since this was a first visit and I expected one couldn't go wrong ordering the basic spaghetti and meatballs.  I certainly wouldn't order this dish again, but like I said the sauce itself is superb.
We had so much fun, our granddaughter turned 17. Our chef, D, was exceptional and very funny, well talented.

Was on a vacation recently and found this store on an internet search.  I called to ask for directions and the girl on the phone didn't know how to tell me where the store was, only that it was by 'a Walmart'.  Didn't know how to tell me to get there from a major Interstate, what exit or main road they were off of.  Uh, ok.  Didn't bother giving the phone to someone else, either.
I finally found it, on my own, walked in and wasn't greeted.  After walking around for about 1/2 hour I asked the same girl at the counter if they had 2 lines of paper in stock that I'd been hoping to find.  One was from Webster's Pages and the other was from Prima.  She looked very confused then said, "I don't think we carry that at all".  I informed her that it was all over the store.  (eyeroll)  She then proceeded to come out from behind the counter and walk over to a section of the store, still completely confused.  Then she looked at me shrugging her shoulders and said, 'What is it you're wanting now...something about a LION?"  omg, I have no words.  I carefully and slowly explained again that is was a 'line' by Websters pages about a baby, to which she said, "Well, if we have anything about a baby it'll just be on this aisle".  I had already looked, so guess I'm up a creek.  Nevermind that there are displays all around the entire store featuring certain paper companies.  It is just VERY obvious when someone doesn't want to be at her (or his) job and has 0% interest in the business or how the company works.  Sadly, the girl tells me as I'm checking out that the store is owned by her parents.  At this rate, they won't be in business long enough for her to inherit it.  :(  If they want someone to represent them and give first rate customer service, hire someone who really cares about it and knows product "LINES".   I wish I would have looked up a chain like Hobby Lobby instead.  :/

Salesman was nice and gave us breathing room. Customer service wait times are awful. I called the 208 phone number to cancel part of the order. It took them 13 minutes to answer the phone.-Ridiculous! The woman who answered is just an answering service. She put me on hold while she called the local store. Now, I'm waiting for someone from the local store to call me back. Such a hassle! I'm just trying to cancel a dresser. I purchased 2 bedroom sets and a bookshelf. Hopefully the furniture quality is worth all this.
Awful place and an extremely rude and awful owner. Won't be back since there are better places available.

My first time here and I felt very welcome! The staff was pleasant and friendly. The beer selection is awesome and the personal pizza I had hit the spot (I recommend getting a side of the buffalo sauce. The place is clean and overall, a great end to my day. Thank you!

2nd time there, had the fresh spring rolls, Tom kah gai and the fish (haddock).
Everything was excellent. The fish was fried which I won't order again, it takes all the flavor out of it. We wanted to order the special, steamed fish but they told me they were out but then could try the haddock, strange. Perhaps it was prepared already. I'll come back and try more, just not the fried fish.

To eat at Epi's is an experience.  Everyone, and I mean everyone, is personally greeted by the owner, Chris, with a hug and a greeting so warm you must be family and just didn't know it.   The establishment is a renovated old bungalow on the Meridian main street.   There are just enough tables to make it cozy - and reservation necessary.   If you want to dine there, be sure to call ahead.   If you can't get a table, make a reservation anyway.  Even if you have to wait a day or so, it's worth it!     The food is delicious and plentiful!    Have some of your meal packed up in a box so you have room for dessert.   The rice pudding is to die for!!!!!   I bought the Epi's cookbook, so I can make it for my family!

I wanted to love this place....but....

We reserved our room months ago. Specifically a double room because there are four of us. When we checked in they put us in a King room with a sleeper. EW. It was terrible & they were "full" so we couldn't switch rooms. The pool is VERY small. It only mattered to us, because that was a big selling point with our two little dudes. The last negative was that there was no hair dryer. Seriously?

The pros were that the hotel is very close to restaurant choices & Dutch Bros. The "Courtyard" area was nice to sit outside for a bit. I have mixed feelings about my stay this weekend. :(

I like movies.  Allot.  Which is why I now have a moviepass.  I am still picky about my theaters.  This one will no longer be on my list of theaters.  Today I went to see a matinee, which is when I prefer to go, no people, which allows me to sit in the seats I want/need.  The agent at the counter greeted my movie pass with a "we make no money off these" comment, and then cold shouldered me.  I needed to choose a seat.  I can only sit somewhere where I can keep my leg straight, due to a knee injury and excruciating pain if it stays bent.  She informed me that I couldn't have that seat.  I explained my need.  She then said I would have to wait till the movie started before she would give me that seat.  I asked her if she was serious....  Long story short she eventually gave me the seat, saying there was no one in the movie anyways.  Unfortunately she ended that conversation by informing me it was "state law" that handicap seats can't be sold until the movie starts.   Completely unnecessary behaviour.  Instead of purchasing concessions, I opted to save my money for elsewhere.  Management.  You need to train your employees as to what actual ADA law is.  Look it up.  If you are so upset by the moviepass phenomenon, which is bringing people like me to your theater, en-mass, to spend even more money on concessions and what not...  Go ahead and post a sign refusing to participate.  I dare you.   Fellow movie passers, choose one of the other theaters with just as good, if not better screens, and who are eager to take your money, and treat you with respect.
Cameron said he had a niece so he made sure to cover the items so they stayed clean and also unloaded those items first so my baby could be occupied while doing the rest of the move.
What more to say about Epis except that it was amazing. Very warm and welcoming feeling at Epi's. Food was cooked to perfection! Must get desert while there as well.
Good honest guys help my parents move to their new place . worked great and did extra work at no cost! I would recommend them for anyone trying to do it ur self! DONT!! Get this guys to help!!

Helpful salespeople and great furniture! They listened to our preferences in style and color. They also made some good suggestions. We got a great deal! We'll definitely be back for our bedroom set. We just bought a couch for now to replace our old one that's all scratched up because of our dogs. This new one fits the style and colors of our living room.

Thai basil was good but the food was hit and miss. My wife really loved the pad se eew but my Mongolian beef was a little tough. It's a pretty good Thai place, but not one of the better ones treasure valley has to offer.

We're recent  transplants to the Eagle area and up until now have been pretty disappointed by the BBQ joints we've tried.  Goodwood changed that.  We just had an excellent meal there.  My sausage was just smoky enough and the potato salad was awesome.  My wife's pulled pork was excellent and we both enjoyed the BBQ sauces.  Portions are substantial and service is attentive.  The only negative we found was my wife's margarita - she said they "almost" put tequila in it.  All in all though, an excellent experience and we will be back.

Mercedes was the best server! Always asking if we needed anything !
The prime rib was so good, the burnt ends and sausage OMG! 
Thank you Mercedes!

I was hungry, so anything would have probably tasted good.  However, I'm usually very picky, but was pleasantly surprised.   My chicken strips were delicious, and the waitress was attentive but not intrusively so. A friend and I had a coupon for $5 off $25 or more in food.   We had separate checks and were allowed to each have $2.50 off our order.  I appreciated the server making this easy for us.  (common sense prevails, yay !)   

Other than this restaurant being out in "Meridifornia" as I call it (traffic anywhere in Meridian, but especially around Eagle Road is a nightmare reminiscent of California, and I'd rather dine closer to downtown Boise), this may be my new go-to place.   Nicely done.

Zupas at 6:00 on a Saturday night. The restaurant is full but no wait in line which is a bonus when you have a 1 1/2 year old along. Ordering was quick and efficient as there is a person attending each section for sandwich order, salads , soup and desserts and another at the end of the line for easy checkout. Highchairs were easily accessible and areas were clean. We love their soups and enjoyed our meal. The bread that comes with your meal is fresh and the chocolate strawberry a delight. After we ate an employee was more than happy to help us clear the trays. Very nice experience even with a toddler along :)

The good: Bodovino in the Village has great ambiance. The wine tasting is always fun. 
The bad: Service. On the night we were there (party of 6, eating food) each employee I had an encounter with made me feel l was putting them out by even being there. The server seemed flustered and sarcastic. He had a miscommunication about the payment, which ended up costing a friend more money. He was defensive and snarky, even when my friend was gracious and laughed it off. Something is off about this place. The guy behind the bar was rude and didn't follow through. I had to get my own silverware off another table. Also, I hate to say it but the food was not great. We ordered a variety of salads and starters. The selection was poor and the food mediocre. I spent a lot of money that night and I don't think I'll be back. It's too bad because the Village needs a place like Bodovino (if only they would have excellent service and a food concept similar to downtown).

It looks to me like they need to improve their customer skills. Read the reviews. Decided to just pop in and ask for a fill. They suggested a new set of nails. So I said ok.  When preparing for new tip, sanding off top of my nail, was beginning to hurt. After all completed. I got the bill and total was 31.00 dollars. 25.00 for new set, 5 dollars to remove, fine I get that and then 6 dollars for Emory board and buffing block. Surprised no one told me about that expense. So I tipped 3 dollars. The nail technician comments to owner about it in their language. I can figure out what your saying. Also I noticed that when anyone comes in for a service. They push for more services. These salons need to realize that there are plenty of other salons to patronize. Bye

Good prices great inventory
Had a pleasant experience shopping at kohls. The staff was helpful and the store was clean. Love coming here for the great deals and the good quality products.

Amazing! Not only was the food exceptional but the service and personal chef were beyond fun, tallented and entertaining!! We brought my five year old and he even commented that it was now his favorite place! They even gave him a balloon sword!! This is our new date place and family restaurant!! Awesome!!! ;)

Whenever I am in a new town and want to find a good place to eat, I always gravitate towards an Indian restaurant as my first choice.

When in or around the Boise area, you have a few choices but this should be high up on your list of must try at least once. 

Hidden in a large parking lot next to the hospital. You shouldn't have any trouble finding a space in the evening.

If you want to eat at this restaurant you should probably start by making a reservation as there isn't a lot of space and you might be disappointed if there are no tables left. We were lucky as we didn't make a reservation and we snagged the last available table.

The food had great flavor and we were totally full when we were finished with no room for dessert.  We chose carefully so we didn't overeat. As usual, we over ordered even though we only ordered one appetizer (all tiki) and one main dish (Mughal mukhani).

I really enjoyed this meal and will visit again next time we are in town.
Al is exceptional, honest & very reasonable, nice to know there is still a plumber that doesn't participate in the "Flat Rate" price gouging tactics so many service related buisiness"s are using

Nice location at the middle of the village in view of the fountain. Every table has a great view even when you're not on the patio. I was a bit surprised they didn't have a bigger wine selection but the ones they had were good. There is a $3 charge to start a wine card but it doesn't go bad and you can use it at other locations. Our server seemed new and didn't know a whole lot but friendly enough. The food we got was great! The price reasonable. We will be back for sure.
Love going here to see movies!  Lots of goodies & drinks!  Our grandkids absolutely think this place rocks!!!!

I ordered a cheeseburger only ketchup. This isn't the problem. The problem was that then I got my burger took a bite out of it and there was not a single ounce of cheese. 
I took it up to the counter and asked where my cheese was. He said "you wanted only ketchup, so I didn't know you wanted cheese". I then reminded him that if I wanted only a bun, ketchup, and meat, then I would have ordered a hamburger. But instead I ordered a CHEESEburger, so that means that I want cheese on it. 
The kid made a big deal about it until the manager finally overheard me and got me taken care of

My sister and I just had our first spray tans from Jamie. Scheduling an appointment was easy and she was able to answer all my questions ( I had a lot!) Jamie is very friendly and put us both at ease as we stood there naked being sprayed! I liked that Jamie will come to your home and custom spray you for pretty much the same price as going to a salon. Her setup is very professional so you don't have to worry about tanner spraying everywhere. I have self tanned before and am familiar with the tacky feeling afterwards and this was the same for several hours. My sister and I both did the medium tan. I have more of an olive complexion so the tan came up darker on me initially. She is very fair and never tans. The medium tan was a nice golden bronze on her, looking like she just came back from a day at the beach! It has been one week since being spray tanned by Jamie and I can report that my tan has lightly faded with no streaks or blotching and I actually like it better now.

Food was great, service was great, beer selection was small but ok. Wife enjoyed her wine. Prices were really good for the large portions served. The only downfall was the person who entered the facility and began selling junk table to table. The staff was made aware and she made her escape prior to them confronting her.
We attempted to eat here, but surprisingly they were completely out of steak!! Talk about poor management. This was a huge waste of time.

We came by here one day before they opened for lunch but today we were there when they were open, and I must say that after eating at many other local places in the past few months, this place was worth waiting for!To start, the Idaho Potato Skins were absolutely divinely yummy! We then had the two item platter brisket (tender and tasty!) and bbq chicken (perfection!)and the St Louis rib platter (perfect!), beans and potato salad. Everything was absolutely wonderfully delicious! Sauces, meats, sides were all the very best top notch taste and temperature! Hand wipes were a great bonus for our fingers too! The server was very friendly and helpful. We love this place and we will be back here often! Thank you for such a great place!
excellent first visit!  Sushi platter for two was massive, filled with excellent choices, and very attractive.  Our 4 year old loved her chicken udon.  Definitely will visit again!

Terrible. Just terrible. The roast beef sandwich I ordered was very plain, boring and dry. The cups they give you are really flimsy and if you go with no ice in your cup for support, you'll end up with soda all over your hands. McDonald's uses better cups. I found this out when my cup collapsed and I ended up with a hand and sleve covered in sticky Dr. Pepper. The employee standing near the soda machine just completely ignored me. I went to the restroom to wash it off, but their bathroom sink did not work. Makes me wonder if any of the employees were washing their hands. The rotten customer service combined with bad food puts this place on my do not go list.

I am no expert on Indian food, but I really enjoyed the Shrimp Saag here. I got it spice level 3 out of 5. Nice warmth throughout mouth and upper throat but no outright burning spiciness. I also had the Paneer Naan and Mango Lassi (Lissi?). What I ordered would have been plenty for two to share. Well, excluding the drink. Service was efficient and pleasant. Definitely coming back.

Just stayed, not what it was before.  Very noisy, less than uber friendly check in staff, dead bug on bed (it can happen).  Just wasn't impressed.  This is my third visit as we have family in Meridian.

Very impressed, what a fun unique place to take the kids to let them get all that energy out, totally impressed with the service. Jason was very helpful give that guy a raise! I will definitely come back there soon!

I have always wanted to drive a racecar and this past weekend, my dream came true!!  For our anniversary, my husband got me a Rusty Wallace Racing Experience package for the Meridian Speedway and it was awesome!!  The instruction was very clear and was easy to follow and the thrill of actually getting into the firesuit, putting on the helmet, and sliding inside the car was awesome!!  Everyone was very nice and made me feel at home.  The only reason that I didn't rate my experience as a 5 was because there was someone on the track with me who didn't listen to instruction very well so I felt like a good part of my time on the track was getting out of his way and not focusing on the car and how fast I could take it!

This, in my opinion is a great place to watch all your sporting needs. Lots of HDTVs. The price is right, the food is good. The only problem I have is the service. You'll get a great server one time, very attentive, the next time you can't even order a beer or get a food order in, within the first 10 minutes after you arrive. Very strange that the service can be so lopsided. Other than that, sit at the bar and you always get served right away. Keep working on that service Beefs.

Food was awesome. Our server was either new or didn't care. Terrible service. Chef however was the bright spot of the night. Oh, our plates were oily like they were washed in cold water. Asked for a different plate four times. I could write my initials in the grease. Get it together dishwashers. The chef to get is Andrew.

This place is beyond wonderful!  Chris greeted us as if we were family. I've never been to a restaurant with such a warm and inviting space. The hospitality exceeds all expectations. There is happy chatter and robust laughter amongst both the staff and the patrons.  Oh, and the food! The food is delightful! It's apparent that these ladies love what they do!!

We have been here twice. The first time they did a fantastic job and it was overall great experience. My toddler is very well behaved, he sits super still and does not pull away only needs to be reminded sometimes to look straight or down. This last time we went we made an appointment, arrived ten minutes early, and were told it would be 10 minutes after our appointment time because they were running late. 10 minutes turned in to 30. Who ever was manning the register gave us a discount for the long wait which was nice and we moved on. I wanted a faux hawk, the gal was very sweet and good with colt. But the cut is AWFUL. At the time she styled it and from the angle I was looking it looked great but st that point we had been there almost an hour and a half and we just wanted to get about our day. Through out the day I began noticing the issues. She had only trimmed around the ears on one side, she had cut extremely high on the back of his neck, crooked, and left an inch of hair in a stripe below where she cut. The front is uneven and you can see every cut it's not blended at all. We live out of town but come to Idaho monthly and we happened to be going home that day so I emailed the business from there website. They asked for pictures, I sent those, then no response. Nothing. So I ended up paying for his cut plus tip, and then another full hair cut plus that tip to fix it, and it had to be cut so short to fix it. I am extremely bothered by the lack of professionalism to fix this situation.

I just moved from Seattle and we've had a tough time trying to find really really good Thai and Asian food.  Thankfully I tried Thai Basil for take out.  I've had the Rad Na and the Drunken Noodles and both are very good.  One think that I found odd was that the take out menu is slightly more expensive than the sit down menu.  Other than that the service is great and once in a while the ladies will give you soup while you are waiting.  

I'll be back.
First time going to watch the new 300 movie and it was the best experience i ever had with a movie theater. Being in the VIP section was very cool. The sound and the seating was spectacular.
Maybe the best food in Boise. Take your woman... not your business buddy. The owner already knows you ;-)

Everything tastes the same with BBQ sauce.   You can order the ribs or the steak, but once you try the french fries and dip them in the sauce - IT ALL TASTES the SAME.   You will find yourself leaving with one feeling. Blaah.   I taste 1 flavor and that flavor is good.. but not good enough to be memorable.

Wow, where do I start?

My wife and I are big fans of Pizza Hut, and long for the days of our childhood where one could dine in and enjoy excellent food and service.  The Meridian Pizza Hut is one of the few remaining dine-in locations left in the valley.

When we arrived the place was almost completely dead, very concerning on a Friday night at 7:00 PM.  There was a host podium with a large "Please Wait to Be Seated" sign on it, but no host or hostess there to greet us.  We had to wait at least a minute before we could see any staff members.  Finally a girl came over, grabbed two menus and led us to a booth.  She was rude and definitely did not seem outwardly happy to seat us.

The place had undergone an extreme remodel since the last time we were there.  Gone are the welcoming and homey red decorative lights that hung from the ceiling, a Pizza Hut staple - replaced with bland interrogation room style ones.  The tables were replaced with cold gray metallic styles - definitely not like the Pizza Hut we grew up with.

We ordered a large pepperoni pizza with one salad bar trip and two sodas.  The salads were a joke - the lettuce was mushy and had the feel that it had been left out for a long time.  We could have gone back to our respective high school's cafeterias and had better quality salads.  Even the pizza tasted like it had been rushed... not the same texture as similar pizzas we had at other locations.

Our waiter definitely acted like he did not want to be there.  He was not friendly at all and barely made eye contact with us the entire time.  Other customers who were seated at the other end of the building had to ask the server again for their waters, so it became evident that the poor service was equal opportunity.  After delivering our pizza he never returned to check in on us.  My wife tried to get his attention several times but to no avail.  He spent the majority of the time goofing off with two other workers in clear sight of customers, throwing trash at each other and playing on their phones.  Meanwhile other customers had to ask repeatedly for their orders to be delivered.

When it came time to pay he mumbled out the total.  My wife asked for clarification and he did not respond so she handed him what she thought was communicated and he said nothing in return.  He handed over different change and when asked about it, he said "no it was 86 cents not six cents."

So essentially we drove out of our way to experience mediocre salad, rushed pizza and bad service from kids who think social media and horseplay are much more important than their jobs.  At this rate it would be much better off checking out one of the many competitors around town.

Great experience, shopping with Carlos and Fred.  The delivery was a NIGHTMARE.  The date changed 3 times  I expressed concern with the store manager.  He assured me I'd receive my furniture on a specific date. When it wasn't delivered on that date, I learned that was his day off. The delivery was made 1 week and 3 days after the purchase.  Too many furniture stores here that not only price match but also offer free delivery along with having the items in stock.  Sent an email and no follow up from Ashley HomeStore.

I spend my afternoon at the village theatre enjoying watching a movie, lunch, and a drink all while being assisted by great employees in the upper floor viewing can't wait till next time thanks everyone working at the cinema

Went here the other day to look at purchasing a new knife. They have a HUGE selection of knives so I would be there all day looking and comparing different knives or searching online for the reviews. But, I didnt... the gentlmen behind the counter was very knowledgable and helpful with my search and was very patient while I had my thought processes. Lol overall it was a great experience and I am glad that they have some real experts behind the counters to assist you, even if you have no idea what your looking for. Grade A sevice!

My friend and I decided to try this place for the first time. I ordered the ricotta rose ravioli since I am a vegetarian and chose something on the menu that would adhere to my diet. When our food was ready, there was meat topped on it and I told the girl that was calling orders that I wasn't aware there was meat on it because it hadn't said that on the menu. She said the food was already made and she didn't know what to do, so a guy that was cooking came over and asked what the matter was. I told him I'm a vegetarian and I don't eat meat and he just said "I can take the meat off for you. Or can it not touch your food?" Every worker was staring at me and I said I would like to have my food without meat so he called for a new one to be made and when I went back to my seat I could hear them talking about it. I felt that the general attitude of the employees was not very customer service focused, and as someone who works in the food industry myself I was very disappointed with the way I was treated. It might be beneficial to have a note if there are specifics to the meals so it's not such a hassle for the employees since it was today, and to properly assess the situation in a manner that is professional.
Went out for my birthday. Very friendly and inviting plus fantastic high quality food. What more can you ask for.

I was impressed by the sales staff. No high pressure. Found the same loveseat elsewhere at a lower price. They matched the price, and even took a little more off. That's the positive.
Received my confirmation phone call for delivery. Was told to be home between 3:30 and 6:30. Had to rearrange my entire day, but that was to be expected. No loveseat by 6:45. Called the delivery number, only to find out that "for some reason the furniture was never scheduled to be loaded on the truck." Had to reschedule for 4 days later. 
Am currently waiting for tomorrow's delivery. Needless to say, it had better be delivered, or I will provide an even more detailed and scathing review. Am now concerned about quality and condition of the product. Will keep you posted.

We went to the Tuesday night movie at the Village Cinema. We go on Tuesday's for the food and drink specials they always have. We bought our tickets and went to order our favorite foods and drinks. The menu had many items crossed off with a sharpie. In addition we were told they will no longer serve the special burger or honor the special drink prices. 
We were not the only folks upset at the changes and the dramatic increase in prices. Needless to say we have other movie viewing options. Too bad too. The VIP section was a nice place to watch a movie and they had great employees.

My experience with the moving company started good, Cameron showed on time and the quote he gave me was good.  As I have move often we usually pack most of our things and leave the big items for the movers, to wrap(couch, refrigerator, washer/dryer)My husband even  disassembled our beds and move our furniture down stairs so that all it was to be move was down already. We had only the washer and drier up in the laundry room by the time the movers came.  They come on the day of our move and started to move things in the truck,  we even feed them pizza for lunch that day. When our furniture arrived to our moving destination I was here on the other end, my husband stayed at our old house since we move up state and he had work there still. As our furniture arrived we helped Cameron and the other guy to unload, Marisa, Cameron partner was here too. Me and the kids helped them unload a few items we again shared our pizza lunch with them. As I directed Cameron on we're to put my antique sewing machine I notice the one leg was complete off. I began to notice refrigerator was scratched and had indentations were the security belt is placed. Eventually all our things got unload and piled up in our kitchen, by know I have already scope our items and notice my washer was indented on the top, and a nob was not attach to the dryer. By the way the washing machine was purchased new in February 2014 and there was no damage before. Our dryers is gas and I do not know if there is damage, other items were damage and by the time It was done I had
Told Cameron and Marisa of the damage. Their reply was "Oh!!!" I ask if they had insurance, and Marisa told me it was 250 deduct. Left it at that and told them my husband would keep in contact with them. Here is what transpired from that: (copy of their email to us)

There were a number of things broken or cosmetically damaged in the move. We ate at Blue Tiger Pizza a couple of weeks ago, and I can't wait to go back!  The place is very conveniently located right off of Eagle Rd next to Lucky Fin's Seafood, and Red Robin.  Tucked into one of the spaces that were once a Cheese shop and bakery, this place is a gem!   The owner, Dylan, greeted us right away and by the end of our visit there, it was like we were old friends.  We had wonderful service on our visit as well.  Folks, if you are looking for artisian pizza, this place rocks!  I would say their only competition in my book would be Flatbread Neopolitain PIzzaria.  We started our meal with some delicious baked goat cheese with a rich marinara and some toasted bread, delish!  We tried two pizzas, the ex-girlfriend, and the bacon and eggs.  So the ex-girlfriend is topped with salami, sausage, goat cheese, fresh mozzarella, arugula , idaho honey, and a red sauce.  OK, so that may not sound like something that would appeal to one right off the bat.  WOW!  All I can say is one bite and you will change your mind.  The flavors balance themselves beautifully, and the honey, which i was afraid would either get lost on the pizza or would overpower it.  It was perfect!  And fresh arugula on a top of   a pizza may also be  a turn off for some.  Uh, don't worry about it, take a bite and be converted.  I don't even like arugula, and I LOVED this pizza, as did my husband who was just as pleased as I was.  The bacon and egg pizza was also an exception.  There just isn't anything like a couple of cracked eggs  on top of a white sauce based pizza covered with roasted tomatoes,applewood smoked bacon, mozzarella and provolone.   It is a sunny side up wonder.  Dip that crust in the yolk yo!  It is just stupid good.  So, this foodie girl is happy that she now has more than one place to go for out of the ordinary pizza, and oh, by the way, the prices are very reasonable.  They offer some good looking salads, fantastic looking sandwiches, appetizers and some mac and cheese that looks great.  I look forward to my next visit to Blue Tiger Pizza!

Went there 2 weeks ago about 6:30 pm on a Friday the place was about half full there was a nice crowd at the bar watching the NCAA BASKETBALL Tournament sat down fairly quickly got a menu ordered a  Buffalo chicken sandwich was not very flavorful got a side of Cole slaw which it was not very good CFC Cole slaw has more flavor our waitress which I asked for ketchup waited 15 minutes never brought so I had to  grab it myself she say me never said sorry, horrible customer service food is just below average bar food, portions are also very small go to chili's instead, would only go to this place to watch a game at the bar that's what happens in big chain restaurants well not go back.

We really enjoy this place. Great variety, the food is wonderful, the service can be a little slow. We had a waitress we loved but we haven't seen her for awhile. The other wait staff needs to work on getting to tables faster. Also, the sushi bar can back up if you're in the lunch rush. If it does, expect to spend a lot of time waiting for your sushi and sashimi items.

Overall, we enjoy the hibachi and other menu items. We typically go for lunch and really like the lunch menu. Food is good and prices are fair.

We have been here twice. The first time they did a fantastic job and it was overall great experience. My toddler is very well behaved, he sits super still and does not pull away only needs to be reminded sometimes to look straight or down. This last time we went we made an appointment, arrived ten minutes early, and were told it would be 10 minutes after our appointment time because they were running late. 10 minutes turned in to 30. Who ever was manning the register gave us a discount for the long wait which was nice and we moved on. I wanted a faux hawk, the gal was very sweet and good with colt. But the cut is AWFUL. At the time she styled it and from the angle I was looking it looked great but st that point we had been there almost an hour and a half and we just wanted to get about our day. Through out the day I began noticing the issues. She had only trimmed around the ears on one side, she had cut extremely high on the back of his neck, crooked, and left an inch of hair in a stripe below where she cut. The front is uneven and you can see every cut it's not blended at all. We live out of town but come to Idaho monthly and we happened to be going home that day so I emailed the business from there website. They asked for pictures, I sent those, then no response. Nothing. So I ended up paying for his cut plus tip, and then another full hair cut plus that tip to fix it, and it had to be cut so short to fix it. I am extremely bothered by the lack of professionalism to fix this situation. 

UPDATE
I have since gone in again after being offered first half off, and then finally a free cut. Was told it would be on my account. Went in for a haircut and had keely, she is awesome and did and amazing job, and went to pay. Of course there was nothing on my account saying I had a freebie because someone screwed up his hair. It's awkward enough to ask for a discount and even more awkward to have to ask for it with the gal that had jacked his hair up previously right behind keely. Ended up just paying full price and moving on!

Worst experience! I decided to make my own salad and wow was I shocked. The literally counted out my topping! I got cucumbers slices and they were baby cucumbers and I got five small pieces as one of my toppings. I asked her is that it? and she said I gave you five! All the toppings might have equaled 3 ounces!!! I'm watching my calories but man I will have to stop and eat somewhere else now!! Also for a place that specializes in salads the do not offer oil and vinegar! I can't have sugar or dairy and no choices for that! I paid 7.99 for lettuce and about 3ounces of other stuff maybe 1.00 worth of food. Ridiculous.

Finally, I got to try this new Indian restaurant for lunch today. I've been wanting to come and try their lunch buffet, that way I don't need to spend too much money for a meal that I might not like. I really want to like this restaurant, because it's a local business, but I sadly wont be going back there; the food was disappointing. It just doesn't taste good. Also I have a big concern about their food safety. They don't keep hot food hot & cold food cold. For example, I was there at 1 o'clock and the food was barely lukewarm and they don't even keep their lettuce/salad, rice pudding(which contains milk) & chutneys cold; they serve it at room temperature on the table. How could you do that?? They also didn't do a good job filling up the food, all of the food containers were less than 1/4 way full and they still had 2 hours left until their lunch hours ended! The only reason I give them 2 stars is because our server was nice and their naan is good. Save your money and keep on searching for a good Indian restaurant in Boise!

If you really enjoy good pulled pork this is the place to go in my opinion!  The pork is very tender and I've never encountered any fat or gristle like you sometimes find at other places.  It's not overly spicy or smoked either, just the right balance of flavoring and not overly sauced--you can add more sauce if you want.  My other favorite at this place is the potato salad--I think it's absolutely the best I've ever had at a restaurant!  The service is very attentive and helpful.  We inquired about having a large gathering at our house and ordering food and the server was very helpful about getting us a menu and making recommendations about how much meat to order, etc.  It's a good family place too, I think, as the prices are reasonable and there is something on the menu for everyone no matter what age!  The Texas Sheetcake is delicious and was enough to share if you still have room!

Had the pastrami which was huge but nothing special about it really. Not a bad place but nothing super stellar and in this day and age when funds are hard to come by - super steller is the bare minimum in my book.

My parents rate Thai Food on verbs. Such as Slow Thai (service is slow), Fast Thai ( you get your food sometimes before you drinks), Good Thai (exceptional food and service) and Bad Thai ( you get the picture).

Thai Basil falls into the Good Thai, staff was friendly, informative, and gave my wife recommendations on a few choices because she could not make up her mind.  

The food was outstanding, I had the Thai Basil Fried Rice. AWESOME. I had it with beef, it was a perfect dish, just the right amount of heat to enhance an already good tasting meal. My wife Thai Curry Green Chicken, she enjoyed it, right about of flavor not over powering by any means.  

Thai Basil is very solid Thai Joint, I dont think you will be disappointed, Unless your just a picky and difficult person, if that's the case, don't eat ethnic food :)

This place is just down the road from our house, so it is very convenient for us to grab food when we are in the mood for Chinese.  They also have great sushi too!  Take out is an option, and they even have online ordering, which worked well for us.  Recently, we got the Kung Pao Chicken, Chicken Chow Mein with soft noodles, pork fried rice, and also got a spicy tuna roll.  Everything was really good.  We have always been happy with our meals here.  We definitely recommend this place.
The food is really not too bad and the service was pretty decent. 3 stars for the price though. Over $9 for a 3 piece tenders combo? That seems pretty expensive for a fast food restaurant.

I was excited to try this place. Walking in the smell was good.. very authentic. That's the best I can say. The dining area was filthy. Imagine 5 toddlers in high chairs with all the food underneath. No menu only buffet style which was empty. Price was reasonable considering most of what was left was gravy. Won't return.

Loved everything about Lotus, especially Christina! I haven't had my hair cut since moving to Idaho last June, & was afraid I wouldn't find anyone that understood what I wanted. Christina did, & went above & beyond! I absolutely love my hair, & have found my girl! Thank you, Christina!

I loved Epi's. The staff is incredible and the food was exceptional. Portion sizes were just right. I took my son, his wife and my 4 year old granddaughter for dinner at 5:30 pm. The owner took special care of my granddaughter, even got her to smile and talk. We had the soup, the salad, the main course and dessert. It was perfect. Kid friendly and even a kid menu plus coloring papers and real crayons.

Loved my experience! I have a Boise Brew Card and saw I had coupons for this place and decided to give it a shot. I've been wanting to try it out and was surprised with how much I loved it. The idea is great. You get to load money on a card and walk around and taste different wines. It was a new spin on wine tasting, which I loved. You do everything yourself which would be a really fun date because you don't exactly have to interact with a bartender unless you have questions. The girl who helped us was new but she was so sweet and answered all of our questions. I'm excited to go back!

I did not try the Q but it smelled great ! I instead had the ribeye and it did not disappoint . The waiter said they had some great steak with a good  but secret seasoning they sprinkle on during cooking .
Best sushi in the Valley. I'm a CA transplant so spoiled by an abundance of fresh fish. Izumi is a treat. The service and atmosphere are wonderful

My husband and I went in to purchase a couch for our new home, and we had the best experience! Emma was the sales associate who helped us out, and she was awesome! She was very informative and so sweet. Answered all of our questions and helped us pick out the couch of our dreams. If anyone goes to this store, ask for Emma's help. She's fabulous! Can't wait to get our new couch!

I ate here while running errands at The Village the open food court style meant quick in/out. I ordered the ravioli, and it was awesome --  covered in a yummy tomato cream sauce and served with a couple small pieces of toasted bread.  Service was very friendly and prompt.  I can't wait to come back when I have more time and check out some of the other menu options.

This is an archetypal taco truck, in a feed store parking lot, near a nursery. It's the real deal.

Tacos are fresh and tasty, and available in several varieties...typical gringo like asada, carnitas, and pastor; and more exotic like buche and cabeza. They also sell tortas and burritos, which my colleagues say are good, but I have stuck with the tacos. For $1.25-$1.50ea, 3 tacos make a great lunch.

There are some picnic tables next to the truck in the shade so you can sit and eat there if you don't take your food to go.

 It can be popular, so expect a 10m wait, maybe even longer.

 Definitely in my rotation for lunch places!
This is our favorite restaurant around! The staff is fri badly and helpful and the food is absolutely incredible. The lunch buffet is a great value.

I purchased a complete bedroom set, mattress and sofa about two months ago at Ashley. After we picked out what we wanted it took over 2 hours to get us checked out. They had just opened so we were patient and didn't complain at all.
We found out once we received our statements that they open up two lines of credit, one in my name and one in my husbands and my name. Again that was an easy phone call to close the line. 
The part in this experience that has me fuming is how long it has taken to get all of our furniture. Two months later we have still not received our bed frame. The first time arrived one of the bed posts was completely cracked through. We had to call to even get it rescheduled and it has since been canceled twice. The reason we were given was it wasn't scheduled properly by the supervisor who placed the order to begin with. I have spent my entire day off today waiting for this frame and it is now 5:30 and it is still " on its way". I actually love the furniture otherwise it would be returned by now. I will never recommend this business.

I don't know perhaps if I am ordering the wrong food entirely, or if it really is that bad. I've been there twice in the dining room now just to be sure I didn't miss something. 

The first time I ordered a double butter burger with bacon. I asked the clerk for no ketchup or mayo on the burger and just mustard. She asks me if I want any other condiments, I assume I know what a condiment is by my age and I say - no thank you, just mustard. Granted the burger comes with other toppings like tomato, onion, lettuce (I don't know exactly) but the point is, my whole life I never realized these were condiments. My burger literally came out with nothing but mustard on it. Lame. Also, it didn't taste good at all. I can deal with the only mustard thing, but it smelled like a old bag of ground beef and tasted like one too. They also press the hell out of their burger patties, a little something to bite into is always nice in a burger. Nothing here. 

Second time was several weeks later, I ordered a sourdough burger something or other. It comes with grilled onions, some kind of sauce, and cheese. I love onions so I figured what the hell. I couldn't get past the smell. It is the smell of unseasoned ground beef. C'mon, man! Put some salt and pepper on that frikkin thing. I don't like the smell of store bought ground beef bag in my burger. It tasted just like it smelled. Yuck!! The onions had zero flavor, literally tasted like they picked up the patties and down on the same skillet goes the onion in the unseasoned beef fat. Tasteless 2 times in a row. 

The only thing I've found so far good about this place is the root beer and I can get better root beer in a can at the Boise Coop for the same price. 

Please, Culver's. You need to learn to season your food. It doesn't taste home made if that's what you're looking to do, it just tastes fresh out of a meat packaging plant.
awesome! first time here, best service everrrrr! new favorite sushi j we will totally be back, I've always wanted to be a regular somewhere, I think this might be my chance.. bombdotcom

Went to Chiro next door then we came here for dinner. Wow Mushroom Bisque was fabulous!!!! Left me wanting more. I also had calif turkey but I didn't like the humus ( scrappped it off blah..). I didn't see that was on the Sammy. Otherwise it was good. Soup was the best. Bf had salad and pulled pork. And he said it was fabulous as well. We ate in such a rush I didn't get a pix! Hehe

We are regulars of Goodwood. It's always consistent, the service is friendly and fast, and we love the atmosphere. Every experience at Goodwood has been a GOOD one! 

Food: We have never tried anything we didn't love. My husband gets the BBQ brisket sandwich every single time. We often split it because it's so big. He claims the Mom's potato salad is the best side. It's SO good but I love the Ruth's Pecan Sweet Potatoes. The crispy brown sugar and pecans make it a great side OR dessert. We also enjoy the mac and cheese side and the cornbread. Yum! The nachos are huge and delicious and we always split them... Get the beef! I usually always choose from their soup and sides and do a make-my-own meal of sorts with a cup of soup, side of potatoes and side of veggies. 

Drinks: n/a

Atmosphere: The atmosphere is rustic and cozy. The tables are set up so you don't feel too close to anyone else and despite when it's really busy, it still is comfortable. There are TV's throughout the restaurant so you can stay up on sports no matter where you're sitting. The rustic decor is really nice and makes it feel like a mountain lodge. 

Service: Always so fast and friendly. They constantly refill your water/drinks and the food comes very fast after being ordered. All of their servers are very nice and even remember us! 

Happy Hour Offerings: n/a

Healthy Hack: Try ordering the Ruth's Pecan Sweet Potatoes as a dessert! They're cheap, delicious, and a much healthier option than one of the baked offerings. 

Tips: If you order the nachos, get the beef! The chicken is also good, but the beef sets them apart from the typical nachos you can get elsewhere. Ask for the soup of the day. They don't have it on the menu but you can also ask for a sample!

Most amazing dinner I have even had in all of Idaho!! From the moment you walk in and get a friendly smile from the owner. Food was excellent . Even if the food wasn't good I would have been happy to just pay for the friendly service. Oh my gosh the green apple bread pudding was to die for. I would go 100 times over just for desert. This place is a must go if you have not. Make sure to make reservations .
Absolutely delicious. And the staff is so nice and remembers you. Nothing hits the spot like Spice!
One of my favorite places. This location is new but we've been to there locations all over the Midwest. The food is consistently good and the people are always friendly.

I usually like my BBQ from more "hole-in-the-wall" places than what looks like a full blown chain restaurant. There are exceptions (Moe's, Famous Dave's and Dickey's to name a few). I had never heard of Goodwood, but I was very pleased with the quality of their BBQ. I had a combination platter with great ribs and wonderful brisket. The mac and cheese was perfect! They didn't try to make it fancy and add different stuff to it. It was just good old mac and cheese. However, the cole slaw was just OK at best...and they messed up their corn bread by adding jalapeños.
