Went there last night because we were too last after a weekend away.  We ordered the crab rangoons, Kung-Pao Chicken and Ma-La Chicken.  I was told the Ma-La wasn't very spicy so I ordered it.  They were willing to switch out some veggies, I'm kind of picky.  Overall the flavor was good was too spicy for me, Luckily my boyfriend likes spicy food.  I ate his Kung-Pao, which wasn't spicy at all.  The Rangoon's were too sweet, not what I am used to.  Overall the food was fresh and tasty!  We will definitely try them again.

I would have given them five stars, except they quoted a price of $39.99 each to have some book covers blown up and put on foam board. Then when they rang it up, they charged me another over $8.00 for scanning and blowing up. Shouldn't that be included in the price, or shouldn't I have been told it would be more?  The covers looked wonderful though, and they even put corner protectors on the posters.  Still, I'm leery now that quoted prices there are not really what the final markup is. They don't realize how many of us live on fixed incomes.

Oh. My. YUM!!! We took the kids here for dinner tonight & were a little worried because we have some BBQ haters in the family. Hey loved it!!! The kids menu was perfect for them & our waiter was extremely accommodating with our picky eaters. The portions are huge and none of us went home hungry. In fact, we have lunch for tomorrow! Well worth the money here. Will definitely return!

HORRIBLE!!!
This store is honestly the worst in Idaho!!
Every time I have been in they have mislead, lied , and just flat out gave us BS do they can make a sale. 
I'll NEVER step foot in here again! 
Seriously, go to the Sprint on Milwaukee or any other.

Outstanding customer service... you will be welcomed in as if you are a regular, given an explanation of the restraints origins, and constantly checked up on.
Highly recommended.

Liked this place a lot while on a long road trip where some of the hotels were hit or miss and we were incredibly road weary. It was clean, beds were VERY comfortable, and the staff was extremely friendly.  We asked for extra pillows and they were brought within minutes (and it was after 11pm). I am never up in time for breakfast but the coffee was good and there was fruit available. One of the most comfortable stops (if not the most comfortable) on our trip. Very glad we chose this place!
We had a great experience at Izumi the food was fresh and delicious and the chef was so much fun I highly recommend eating here!

So we bought a bedroom set , The delivery drives were awesome guys , professional and nice . HOWEVER ! They opened up one of the boxes and it was damaged. Okay it happens , they came to us showed the damage part we all took pictures they called Ashley's it was all good . They said if you don't hear from them , please give them a call . 4 hours goes by I call Ashley's furniture. Because of DANIAL BEING SO RUDE FROM THE GET GO , I'M NOT SURE IF SHE WAS having a bad day ?? I asked a simple question gave her a simple answer. And her comment was I can have a Tech look at it . I replied, well I did not pay for a broken foot board . HER :  Well what do you want me to do about it . ME : I want a new one ! HER : Well I can't help you ( IN A SHITTY TONE !! ) Me : OKAY who can ? HER : YOU NEED TO CALL CUSTOMER CARE ! ME : okay what's the number? HER : HOLD ON ..

What a wonderful restaurant. Friendly people and VERY GOOD Food!!! My wife had the Salmon which was the daily special. I had the ribeye and my som has the lamb chops. All of our food was excellent! Tasty, tender and nicely presented. The service was prompt, friendly, and informative. We will be back here again and again! This is a family run restaurant, and you can tell they care about every detail.

Service was not bad, but this is NOT good BBQ. Saw good reviews saying it was so we decided to try it. Not even close. Overpriced disappointment. Desert wasn't even good. We spend less at Texas Road House getting an adult beverage or two with our meal (which we didn't here) and have never left there disappointed.

This was our first time here and let me tell you it was the best dinner and show in the state. We will definitely be back and bring our whole family. The only down size was that our waitress barely spoke English so it was hard to ask questions.

My husband absolutely loves this place as their pizza is super close to pipeline which was is all time favorite! I also was happy with the pizza. Their breadsticks are definitely something unique that you have to try. Not at all greasy and great seasoning with the pretzel salt. The pizza is a mesquite flavor instead of a buttery or herb flavor so if you're a huge meat fan or bbq kind of person, this is definitely for you!

Well I'm not gonna lie..... Wasn't overly impressed with this place. Don't get me wrong, it wasn't horrible. Been to a ton of Japanese steak houses and this place was so so. Maybe I ordered the wrong thing. Reviews looked great! I may attempt to try it again but not anytime soon. New place so I'm sure they are working out all the small details still. The interior design was impressive. Outside was a lil haggered with the lawn and such. Very quiet inside with not a lot going on. Staff needs to pick up the tempo a bit and make it more welcoming especially with it just opening. Very quiet.... All we could hear was the clatter of dishes in the back and chatter from the staff. Hope they get it figured out. Good luck!

Delicious!!! Second visit here because after the first, we've decided it's our favorite Indian food in town  Tonight, we tried all new dishes and fell in love with the coconut naan. Both times, everything was tasty

My husband and I are so spoiled- we won't go to any other movie theater after we tried the Village. We didn't love the D Box seats, but VIP is really the way to go. A little more expensive but worth it for comfy seats and being able to order food and beers or mixed drinks. If my husband can't find it at the village VIP he won't go. If you come 30 minutes early you can usually order your food from your seat and get it before the show but sometimes it gets there after the movie starts so you're trying to eat your salad in the dark. Still, having more food options than just popcorn or candy is pretty great and it's a fun experience. Plus if we have to wait a while for our showing its fun going to one of the restaurants in the area while we wait.

We had dinner there last night and it was delicious! Three of us had a different entrée and they were all great. Pad Thai, Drunken noodles with chicken and a Yellow curry dish over white rice that ended up being our favorite. The service was very friendly and we will definitely be going back.

The store was a bit chaotic in the menswear clearance section. Packed and very hard to find and  xl men's tops. Almost everything was M or 2Xl plus.... they have clean dressing rooms and nice cashiers. I had a good experience overall with my husband and daughter. We found the pants we needed and at a reasonable price.

Otto's help was excellent. He did a great job at answering our questions and had abundant patience with the process of us changing our minds and a screaming toddler in tow. Ashley's pricing was a little questionable because online prices vary so much from the in-store prices and the financing allows for little discount. If you have the cash, you can save 25% based on their holiday offers, which for us would have made almost 1k difference. That hurt a little.

The food is decent. The chicken is really good. The custard is delicious but they take FOREVER to provide even just custard. This is a massive management issue that they need to resolve. When I go in to order two scoops and two concretes and see 4 people just standing at the counter and I wait for 20+ min for my order, there's an issue.

Food is sooo good and the service is even better! The wait staff has been amazing! They are attentive and not bothersome! Very accommodating! We recently moved to Idaho and this has quickly become our favorite eating place!

We took a long ride from our hotel to Epi's and it was so worth it!  The food is outstanding and the customer services is fabulous.  Chris and her team sincerely make you feel welcomed into their home as friends, not customers.  They are so gracious and caring.  We had the halibut and cod.  Both were excellent, but the halibut was amazing!  Its a huge piece big enough for two and so well cooked.  We love halibut and this ranks among the very best!!  The potatoes, string beans and soup were also memorable.  The salad was good too.  We didn't have room for dessert!  We will definitely be back!!!
Excellent take out! I was pleasantly surprised. The food is not swimming in sauce and the veggies are cooked perfectly. The sautéed green beans are a can't miss!

I came in for the first time today at lunch, right after noon. The place was busy. A solid line was formed, slowly but surely making its way forward. A worker stood at the start of the line, offering to answer any questions and handing out menus.

This place definitely seems to be about a balanced meal. There are plenty of opportunities to eat a good blend of the food groups. The lunch combo encourages this, allowing you to choose two out of soup, salad, and sandwich. I decided to go with a large salad instead. All of their salads seem to combine some varied ingredients. They're not afraid to produce a salad that has quite a good portion of fruit in it, for example. Their dressings seem to be top notch in both selection and quality.

The desserts look quite interesting and tasty as well. Brownies, cream Brulé, chocolate-dipped strawberries (one of which they throw in for free, tasty), quite a selection and probably not as healthy as the first part of the line.

Overall, my food was good and fresh. The portion filled me up for a price that was decent compared to the other options nearby.

Service was friendly. They do a good job keeping the line moving. They also keep the restaurant decently clean, especially considering the steady stream of people.

The biggest problem with the restaurant is that it's filled with bottlenecks. There's enough seating inside for the number of people. However, what space is taken up by tables encroaches on the space that should be provided to beverages/condiments/silverware. The way traffic flows during the process of grabbing the aforementioned and scanning the place for an open seat results in multiple pile ups, with literally more concurrent I'm-waiting-in-place-for-you-to-move moments amongst the crowd than I've seen in a while. The single door for both entering and exiting is also terrible. Two steady streams of people headed in opposite directions through a narrow bottleneck. With a flap on it.

Overall, I like the food, and I like what they're doing. I plan to be back. The poor design of the restaurant isn't a show stopper. The service and freshness of the food make up for that.

We have sat in the VIP seating a few times before but this last time we went was the first time we ordered food from our seats.  The food is pricey, came in very small portions, and the "wait staff" never came back after food was dropped off.  They could have checked on us to see if we needed a refill, wanted dessert, if we were enjoying our food like a normal dining establishment would have, but NOPE they didn't.  Just dumped and ran.  Even after we left a large tip.  Next time we'll eat elsewhere.

Had a great time here and the food was delicious. I had the salad and chili which was just a bowl of delicious smoky meat. You could here the hacky sacks of Peta hippies fall in puddles as the plate hit the table.  Aly our waitress was friendly, positive and professional. The atmosphere was good and they accommodated for our larger table. I suggest you give this place a try if you like tasty food and good times. If I had one critic the bathroom had a weird layout.

We came without reservations from Reno and Chris immediately sat us at our own table outside to accommodate us. The beef medallions melted in your mouth and my husband had the fish special of which he said "was over the top". Cruz was our waiter and was so kind and helpful! They both treated us like family! Definitely worth coming to Meridian, ID for dinner!  Graci!!

We have eaten at each of the Basque restaurants in Boise, and read great reviews about Epi's which is only about 15 minutes from downtown Boise.  The reviews were right, this is the best restaurant in the area, regardless of cuisine. I had the Ink Fish, first time for me and it was great.  Others had the pork chop, the halibut and the scallops.  Everyone loved the food.  They took special care of our young child who was celebrating his 2nd birthday.  They brought his food early, and even had the sense to cool down his soup and entree so he would not be burned.  Never have I had such great service.

The dining area is roomy, and the restaurant is genuine Basque with family history to go with the meal. Highly recommended.

Once again, I've gone with a three-star review due to how decent this place is. I want to give it a five-star review, but it puts you through the same BS that all theaters do (high prices; commercials for things that aren't movies; crazy long lines due to our obsession with The Village; etc.). It is a beautiful establishment and, typically, we get pretty decent service. However, we've also had some bad experiences (mostly from patrons, not employees). I don't know whether to blame the establishment for rude patrons or not, or hold them accountable for not creating a pleasant viewing environment. That's why the three-star review; I don't want to overly praise this place, but I don't want to punish them for a-hole customers... at least not too much.

Cons: High prices, like everything at The Village (with the exception of Tuesdays, which include outrageously low prices for what you get). Rude, entitled patrons sitting in the VIP area. Between myself, my co-workers, and my extended family, we've had more than a handful of nasty experiences ranging from obnoxious (continuous texting where we have to see the light of their cell phone; chewing ultra-loudly on popcorn or whatever... and I mean like an unreal volume of chewing; talking at full volume or whispering A LOT), to downright shameful (I asked a couple to please stop speaking [not whispering, speaking] during a movie; they stopped for the final five minutes, then cursed my wife and I out, calling us fat-asses [I presume because we ordered food], dropping more F-bombs than most Tarantino flicks; it's worth noting that I think they were pretty drunk, as they had pint-sized cocktails and plenty of empties around their seats). I do believe that ushers are there to do more than make sure teens aren't in the R-rated movies, so I want to hold the establishment accountable for policing this crap to some degree. The only true critique I have had of an employee is them telling us they weren't serving food on a day when they were, which resulted in us going to Twigz. No big deal.

Pros: FOOD! AND BEER! You can order (effing awesome) food and (effing awesome) beer! Don't like what's on tap? Get some canned deliciousness (like Oskar Blues). Tired of hot dogs and pretzels? Have a plate of calamari or a bruschetta flatbread with black garlic spread! It rocks! Of course, I hear they show movies as well. As previously mentioned, Tuesday features ridonculously good deals and, if we could find a sitter more often, we'd be there all of the time, telling people to stop talking and getting cursed at by drunken 40-somethings.

This place is my favorite Indian restaurant. Nice service  and great food. I have little children with me so it was nice that they can be loud and nobody look at you. 

I used to go to the one on state street, but it way too far from my house, this place is perfect and absolutely  going back there again.

In the Treasure Valley and Idaho in general, Basque food is a long standing tradition.  We had occasion to eat at Epi's in old town Meridian.  The atmosphere is clean, homey and comfortable in a rather small establishment.  On this night the place was completely full and yet the service was outstanding.  The Basque favorites are all on the menu and cooked to perfection and delicious. This food was far and away better than our experience at Bar Gernika, which I in my opinion is very over rated.  Reservations are a must at Epi's.

Awesome! So much flavor! I loved every bite and tried to make it through my meal authentically, without using my fork, but gave in in order to get as much out of everything as I could. I have only eaten at a handful if Indian restaurants, and this is going to be on my regular list. It is more conveniently located that having to go down town. The lunch buffet had TONS of options and everything was bursting with flavors and colors that excited my palate with every last morsel. Eat here.

This place is absolutely ridiculous! Best food within 100 miles of the Boise area. This time I ordered the lemon chicken with the corn mash. I think each meal I get is better than the last. If you are anywhere close to this area, you need to come eat at Rick's. 

I had the pleasure of meeting Rick for the first time tonight and he was extremely friendly and even ordered me a dessert. This was not just any dessert. It was a flaming Tiramisu!  I was absolutely stuffed from the meal, but had no problem taking care of that dessert. (and I am not even a tiramisu fan). 

Although it was a Tuesday night, the place was completely packed due to a soccer tournament in the Boise area. The staff did an absolutely fantastic job of taking care of several large groups, while still making me feel like I was important. I can't say enough good things about this place. Do yourself a favor and stop in for a memorable experience.

I had 2 tacos and 2 quesadillas.  The tacos were asada and carnitas and wonderful.  The quesadillas were pollo and barbacoa and very bland.  the tacos are a 5 star for sure-not sure if it's the meat or what.  The quesadillas are star.  I will be back for sure to try more tacos and a burrito.

The service was A+! The ribs were great! I haven't had anything else but the full rack of ribs  and if you want some good ribs, give this spot a try! See my picture for a glimpse into your near finger lick'n future!

The best place in town for Thai food, I am new in town and tried few places. So far this is most delicious and full of flavor. 
Thank you for your awesome service
Depressing. Tired. Happy hour is coors light pints... :| Seriously? And no HH food? WTH???? Surprisingly busy though. Not sure what people see in this place. Maybe cuz it's close to home?

Great Indian Buffet, so many choices. There are gluten free choices as well, which am not particular with, but might help others who are into this kind of diet. Will be my go to Indian buffet. Will definitely comeback. Highly recommended.
Out of town visitor, Japanese food very good, friendly service, good sake, need to tone down music a bit, too raw for dinner.  Prices reasonable. Will go back when in town.

I wish I could put zero stars after my experience with this company cause that's exactly the level of customer service that they have for their clients.... ZERO!

Where to even start!!! So I went in looking for a dining room table back in November. The one I liked wasn't available in store cause it was just online so they had to order it in to the warehouse, which was totally fine I also ordered a entry table as well along with all the dining chairs so with spending around 2,000 dollars with them you would think my end all experience should be a happy one... but nope! Think again! It was the worst experience I've ever had... EVER!!

So my table arrived and I picked it up just a little after thanksgiving which was perfect cause the entire reason for even purchasing the table was so that my family would have a dining table for Christmas dinner at my home. After putting all the chairs together I then went to open the table and it was cracked. Super disappointed I called customer service and let them know about the crack. They asked for photos which I happily sent.. was told someone would call me back and never received a call.... I then waited over the weekend and called again on Monday, was on hold for about an hour... for the lady to come back and say that it's something that couldn't be fixed "OBVIOUSLY!" She then said she could exchange the table but I would have to take that table back and go pick up the new one. (Are you kidding me??? This was your fault and you aren't willing to take care of it by just picking up this broken table you gave me and bring me the new one?) I was so frustrated I just said. I'll pick up the table but you guys need to come get this one. She made the exchange and said that they would give me a call when the new table arrived at the warehouse. I said, "that's great but will it be here by Christmas cause that's the whole reason I purchased this table!?" She said it would get here the 26th.... that's just great so had you called me back the Friday you were suppose to it would probably be here... super frustrated I expressed this with her... she then said she would send a $50 gift card to me for ashley in the mail for my troubles... I said okay whatever (in my head what the hell is a 50 dollar gift card gonna do for me buy a damn lampshade so stupid).... take in mind I never received that gift card  but that's besides the point, this gets even better on the level of extremely shitty customer service! 

So December 26 comes and goes... my family had to do Christmas dinner with no table I had to rent a foldable one. It's now the beginning of January and I have still yet to receive a call that my table arrived at the warehouse... all the while having this huge box in the middle of my hallway for a month. I finally call around the 15th of January and ask if they have got my table yet... I was transferred to about 3 people before the last lady called the warehouse and said it was there and I could pick it up. So I then find someone to help me go pick up the table. I get there and the girl couldn't find it in the system. I told her the story and she then says well do you have this other table with you? I said no it's a 300lb table that you guys need to come get.... she said no I can't give you this table without the other. I'm beyond frustrated at this point I tell her this and also let her know I know it's not her fault per say but that this company in general is the worst service I have ever delt with in my entire life and everyone I had expressed this to agreed with me. She said that she didn't have authorization to make a delivery happen and or pick up and that I would have to get on the phone with customer care again and that they would probably charge me 150 dollars... "umm what!?? for picking up a table THEY gave me BROKEN!!!" What!?? So irritated the friend with me at the time was just like Katie lets just see if we can find a way to load other table... he found a way to load it and we then went back the lady was less then desirable very rude. So we back the truck up so they can unload this table and load my table. The guy who was there to load and unload the furniture looks at me and goes "I'll probably need you to help me unload this one and load the other one." Ummmmm, what!?? I cracked up laughing... are you kidding me!!? Haaa what furniture store have you ever been to that tells you that you'll need to help them load and unload the furniture into your truck at their warehouse!!? Haaa so wait do I now get to sue them for the lower back pain from unloading furniture for them? Isn't that their job!??? The guy friend I brought to help me helped this guy load and unload my table and made a comment that they needed more workers..... uhhh CLEARLY And obviously some classes on what customer service is!

Be still my heart.

From the first bite of croquetas (which literally brought a tear to my eye, they were SO good) to my last bite of green apple bread pudding, this was a perfect meal.  I had the roasted leg of lamb, which was actually my least favorite of the entrees at our table.  Luckily we all shared, so I also got to have some of the tongue, the baked cod, and the ink fish.  I only tried the ink fish so that I could say that I'd eaten it, but I LOVED it and would order that again on a return visit.  The baked cod was a perfect dish.  The tongue was tasty and well worth a try for tongue fans out there.   The lamb was tender, but the sauce seemed to lack any complex flavors.  The only other complaint I had was that the red bean soup was a bit too heavy for an appetizer.  I recommend the white bean soup.  But even those minor flaws were not enough to put any sort of dent in the beauty of this meal.

The service is amazing, and you will leave this restaurant feeling very much like you were just stuffed to the gills by caring Basques in their own home.

I can't recommend Epi's enough.  I would consider another trip to Boise just to eat there.
Excellent food! Ex-girlfriend pizza was perfect. Brussels sprout starter was yummy! Ham and pineapple-pizza was excellent.
I live in Los Angeles and ordered over the phone for Mother's Day! I asked for wildflowers simple and nothing ordinary. They arrived and the bouquet was perfectly beautiful. Thank you!!

Wow,, the minute you walk in they swarm around you trying to sell. The followed us through the entire store with their sales pitch. Never even give you time to think We finally just walked out. It was basically sales harassment. Used car sales men were less pushy !!

Epi's is one of my favorite resturants in town.  When you walk into the front door you feel like you have come home.    Service and food are wonderful.   If youa re looking for Basque food this is the place to be!!
Assigned seats at a movie theater is the absolute worst idea!  We were a large party and had to spend 20 minutes shuffling kids around.  This is a movie theater, not a live performance theater.
We've eaten here multiple times and it's always been excellent. Best place in town to celebrate a Birthday at the Hibachi table.  Very fun place.

We stayed here for 4 days and this is one of the best places we have ever stayed. Not only was the rate great but the rooms were very clean, bed very comfortable, and staff very friendly. We stayed on the 4th floor and it was super quiet. We will definitely return!

Food is usually good, but don't expect to eat within 2 hours of calling in your order. As of typing this, it has been 2 hours and 10 minutes. I called 30 minutes ago and he was supposed to be already on his way.

Update: Food came from the Boise location after I order from the Merdian location. He brought half my order and told me a driver took my order and now they couldn't get ahold of him to find out what happened.

Bottom line: Will never order from this place again! If I want Chinese food I'll just go out and get it.

First, the positives...great atmosphere, service was great also. Our server was very attentive and had no issues. My kids had the chicken crispers and they looked quite tasty!  The barbeque on the other hand wasn't so great. I had the ribs and they were very dry. I was hoping for fall of the bone ribs but these disappointed. I would not come back here for barbeque. Nice place though. Maybe I will be back for something other than barbeque.

Stopped in for a late dinner. There were no other customers so I was seated quickly. The service was friendly and the menu is huge. Lots of tasty fare to choose from. 

Because it was my first time in I went with what I know: the chicken tikka masala and garlic naan. The chicken was just the right amount of spicy. I ordered the level 3 spice. I like a little eyeball sweat but I don't want my face to melt off. The rice was nice and colorful. The naan soft on top, crispy on the bottom, and the perfect amount of garlic. 

The only downers were that the chicken was a bit too salty and the portions a bit small for the price. However, I will go back to see about some of their signature dishes!

What a great sandwich shop!  Our first time dining here!  
We were greeted at the door to show us some popular menu items and to ask if we had any questions.
We went to the counter to order and was greeted by a very friendly young lady.  She was very helpful, and knew the menu.
The food was very fresh with a great presentation.  
Our food was perfect.
We were surprise upon sitting down to eat.  We found a big chocolate covered strawberry!!  What a great surprise.
For dessert, Carmel cream brûlée!  GREAT!!
You can't go wrong here!
My husband and I both ate dinner and shared one dessert for under $20.
We will return!!

Once in a blue moon we take a few items in to be laundered/pressed. Mostly men's dress shirts. This time I included one of mine that needed pressed. Brand new. Never worn. Super cute and gone! Simply vanished! They're "still looking" but I'm pretty sure I'll never see it again.

Great salad bar well stocked with fresh ingredients.  I've had better steaks, but I always come for the salad bar.  Good for a quick easy lunch that is better than the drive thru.  Not so crowded during the lunch hour that I couldn't stay and get some work done on my laptop.  Staff was very pleasant and courteous.
Great food, ordered the sushi for two boat. The service however was really bad. Waitress forgot many items, had to ask several times to have water and utensils brought out to us.

Sorry but we would not recommend this unless you just want O.K.  The pizza was Okay and the Rocket Salad was not very tasty. It was mostly arugula with few additions for $12.00. The server was nice though.

Excellent staff, especially in the ICU.  They are not as good in telemetry but then I suppose the best of the best are hired in the ICU.   

Facilities and equipment are the best available.

A family member was frequenting the local "hospital / veterinary" in Emmett until we convinced him to go to a real facility.  The difference in care is light years above.

I would give this place a 5 star, except the whole ordering process for the try-2 combo for $8.79 was a bit rushed and I think something was mixed up along the way, or we must've missed something because the explanation was not very clear. The Roasted Red Pepper & Lobster soup was phenomenal, as well as the kale & quinoa salad. Anyway, I completely support the principle behind this place and would eat here again.

Absolutely awesome experience.   Went for an early Valentine's Day with my wife and we sat at the hibachi.  The waitress was very nice an attentive, the chef was insanely awesome and entertaining... SAKI! SAKI! SAKI! He chanted As he shot the saki at me. We got filet mignon and shrimp.  It came with fried rice and veggies... absolutely delectable and tender.  There was a family with small children sharing the space with us and he knew just what to do to please everyone.  Definitely recommend this place to everyone.

GREAT sub sandwiches! :)
Looking forward to coming back for a pie!

VIP seating is where it's at if you're on a date, or just want more room to stretch out. Best part of the theater is $5 Tuesdays, which is the best time to take the kids to see the new movies in the big theater. Service is always fast in the ticket line and the facility is clean. This is my theater of choice over Edwards or any other big ticket theater. Perfect area for dinner and a movie, or watching the fountain show.

I love some cafe zupas!! Their soups are delicious! One compliant I have is during my visit today the lady who was packing my order dropped the bread on the counter...she looked to see if I noticed and made a comment about my kiddo to try to sidetrack me. I am kicking myself for not saying anything while I was there..I normally always do...she put it in my order.... gross obviously I tossed it. Also didnt get pasta they said was complimentary with my soup.
First time and loved it.  Clean, great service and excellent food! Also has Gluten Free options and nice big menu of salads, sandwiches, steak, ribs etc...

Great food, attentive, friendly service.  Lunch buffet so delicious and lots of options!  I like to pile a bunch of stuff on my plate and go at it.  My husband always bases an Indian restaurant on their butter chicken and this place had really good butter chicken -  not too sweet and just the right spice.  We will definitely be back, and probably bring the little ones too!
Love this place, it is our favorite Thai place in Boise. Love the pre dinner salad, the service is great and the curry is amazing.  It is also well priced, which makes me happy!

Laticia Huether was the best make-up artist I have every had the privilege of working with.  She was so sweet and had an extensive knowledge of her products.  She was also very good with my "fluttery eyes".  I have never been able to handle people applying make-up to my eye lids and she understood my issues and worked with me. 

She made sure that my photographer and myself were happy with her work and we were beyond thrilled!  She made sure that all of our needs were met.

I am so glad I had the chance to work with her and I will not only be recommending her to everyone I know, I will also be using her in my future endeavors.

Truly outstanding. Friends first took me to Epi's a dozen years ago and I try never to miss it when I come through Boise.

Very popular with discerning locals. Reservations highly advised.

Don't miss the calamari starter.
Sushi is fresh and creative. I was pleasantly surprised by the interior of this restaurant.  Don't let the outside fool you.  The teppanyaki room looks like a lot of fun.  I will try that next time!

This place is super tasty! My husband and I love Thai food and we will definitely be back. We both enjoy spicy food and ordered medium for two of the dishes and spicy on a third. It didn't seem hot at first but it caught up to us and let's just say I quickly drank my Thai Iced Tea (which was delicious!). Stick with the mild if you don't like it hot.

I have a peanut allergy and they were also great about accommodating that.

My mother brought me here for my birthday and I was not sure what to expect. I kind of expected it to be a typical soup and salad place where you stand in line feeling like you are at the cafeteria. It was kind of like that and it was a happier version of this. 
The lines move as fast as they do at Jimmy Johns. There is a huge menu. So, you forget what you want to order by the time you are placing an order and you forget what you ordered by the time you got to the register. The reason for this is because you order a ton of food and you get a ton of food!
I really liked this place and I hope to come back. I died and went to heaven when I had the turkey and avocado sandwich. I got a chicken and bacon salad with a vinaigrette and it was delicious! You get huge portions of just about everything. When you get a salad you get a huge chocolate covered strawberry. Be very careful with what you order because you get a strawberry with a soup and salad. You order both and you get more food than you bargained for. They also give you bread rolls. 
The beverages are awesome. They have the typical selection of soda, but when you look at the tea you will not be able to make up your mind! I saw a cucumber, basil green tea, but I chose some pomegranate tea and it was the best choice I ever made. If I go back I hope to try the other one. 
For desert I tried the cheese cake. It was absolute heaven! 
I am definitely coming back. I think this would be a cool place to hang out with my friends and family for lunch.

WOW This place is amazing with phenomenal fresh food !!!!
Do yourself a favor come eat here!!
Great wait staff everything is phenomenal 
Ask for Roxi she is the best knows the menu and is very prompt and polite 

This is my new go to restaurant in Boise/Meridian area !!

This pertains to my visits on 12/25 (Sing) and 12/28 (Moana).

I can relate this theater to ArcLight Cinemas on account of these situations:
1. The concessions sell coffee and alcohol.
2. When one orders popcorn, the concessionsists ask for butter if the guest wants it.
3. Assigned seating happens.
Fresh and great quality fish, best in meridian/eagle. Peaceful restaurant, super nice owner. I am now officially a tegular. Highly recommend. Great tangerine chicken dish.

Haven't been here for a while so I decided to grab something quick, and ended up getting the shredded beef bowl. I've had it before and it was ok and all, but this time I have found that the lettuce that I had on it didn't look like it had been washed. It literally still had dirt on it. Now just because of that I probably won't be going there again.
Had a wonderful evening here. The ambiance was quaint yet the service was huge. Thank you
Great food - Awesome service. Very impressed with the high level of food preparation. My Halibut was cooked to perfection and the sides and soups were very tasty. I will definitely go back.

"Please don't save your seat. Order your meal, then sit down. We encourage a fast turn over." Each table at Cafe Zupas is topped with a little plastic card stating the above message. There's something a little hostile about it. The whole vibe of the place is just a little--pushy. Don't get me wrong, the staff is friendly, almost to a fault. When you enter, an employee will direct you to the line, ask you if you've been before, and direct you toward popular menu choices. This always cracks me up, because I wonder why they tell you which foods people like. Do people not like the other foods? If so, why offer them?
Any way, the greeter will point out some of the soups, sandwiches, and salads that people like, and likely mention the combination meals as well. The line moves quickly and you'll find yourself in front of a Subway-style ingredient bar where you can order either a signature salad or choose your own version. They've also got grilled sandwiches and many soups. As a vegetarian, the place is great because you can avoid meat, and there are protein options like beans and tofu, as well as whole grains like quinoa, dense greens like kale, and a range of fruits and veggies from mangoes to blueberries to grape tomatoes. Everything was fresh, ripe, clean and absolutely beautiful. I have to give them huge props for the quality of ingredients. They were spectacular.
I made my own salad with spinach, apple, blueberries, strawberries, mangoes, tomatoes, cucumbers, and poppyseed dressing. It was really outstanding and satisfying. It was supposed to come with bread, but didn't and I forgot to ask. It did come with the promised chocolate strawberry. My friend got the Maui Tropical Chicken, which she liked. She got her bread, but they forgot her strawberry. Most of the signature salads have chicken and fruit. It seemed weird that they would almost all have chicken and fruit, but maybe that's what everyone likes. Most of their salad dressings were similar (fruity) but again, maybe most people like them.
My friend got her daughter the kid's meal with grilled cheese, fruit, and a strawberry, which looked fine. It also came with a drink.
For about $7.00 each, prices were about what you'd expect. It strikes me as funny that we've essentially taken a salad bar and had someone else made the salad and then made it more expensive by having someone else toss it, but it seems fancier that way. 
The restaurant itself was really crowded, not just with people but with tables. It was almost impossible to move around. We had a heck of a time getting a high chair in to our table. A woman in a wheelchair kept getting bumped from every side because seats were packed together so tightly. The whole place felt consciously designed to maximize profit. When standing at the counter ordering, I had a moment or two in which I was trying to decide on toppings, and the server sighed audibly and rolled her eyes.I realize she was trying to keep the line moving, but I was only waiting a moment or two. The moment I finished my salad a busser swooped in and scooped up my dish,not asking if I was done. When I went back to the register to ask if I could have the bread that was supposed to come with my salad, the clerk asked why I hadn't gotten it. I said I didn't know, and thought it had been forgotten. The clerk asked why I hadn't said anything earlier and I just kind of stammered. She made me feel like a criminal, and I truly just wanted some bread. When my friend realized she'd been shorted her chocolate dipped strawberry, we agreed not to go through the hassle. It seems silly to let quibbles like that ruin an experience, but it left us feeling very unwelcome.
Overall, the quality of the food was good, the prices were average, but the environment was disconcerting. I'm willing to try again because I like healthy food and vegetarian places can be hard to find. I also like fast-casual in general and live nearby. I'm hoping with more time management will relax and stop being so pushy toward customers. I prefer to be treated as a guest and not a combatant.

So happy to have an authentic Indian restaurant in Meridian! 

Spice is just as good as our favorite place in Phoenix and almost as good as LA. 

If you like heat, be really firm about that because the kitchen seems to be hesitant to take your word for it. 

The naan is hot and fresh and all of the paneer dishes were fantastic. Palek paneer, in particular was very good. Chana masala was nice and flavorful, as well. 

Service was excellent! We look forward to frequent visits in the future.

Good Indian Food. I visited this place originally for dinner and then the day after, for lunch buffet. 
The food prepared a la carte was very good and tasty. The quantity was good. The spice levels are a tad lower but that is not a big issue. 

The buffet was also good, no complaints either in terms of the range or quality. Being a vegetarian, I didn't get to try the meat based dishes - there were quite a few of them.

The lunch buffet is good value for money. Will definitely recommend and shall visit again.

Early on a warm Saturday afternoon I traveled with a dear friend and her sons out to Meridian Speedway.  Her eldest son was slated to take to the track for his first race that evening, and I wanted to be part of the cheering section.  Because the young man had to be out there early to report to the pits and get ready for some warm ups, I found myself walking into the venue almost by myself- and I'm glad for it.  
From the road you don't see much at all.  The backs of the grandstands and the gates.. but inside.. oh inside.. it's beautiful!   The emerald green infield surrounded by the banked oval track, the bright signage of sponsors on the walls.  The skies were blue when I visited, and seeing the flags ripple in the sky I could FEEL the vibe of races past, and the excitement of the events to come.  
My friend Nancy and me started by reserving some seating (blankets on the benches) for friends and family.  We were on the west end, near the handicapped seating platform- right next to the restrooms and not far from concessions.  
This was military appreciation night, and I was so proud of the way the folks at Meridian Speedway honored our military.  The color guard, a parade of military vehicles and an amazing rendition of the Star Spangled banner by two active servicemen on electric guitar.  
The restroom facilities were clean, what items I enjoyed from the concession area were tasty.  Meridian speedway is famous (or so I'm told) for their fried pickle spears.  I didn't try them but my friend did, and found them a bit disappointing.    I didn't particularly appreciate all the people smoking by the restrooms, but what do you do? 
I will tell you, if you go.. dress for the weather.  I neglected to use enough sunscreen and got a bit crispy.. and when the sun dips below the horizon it goes from hot to BRRR in about 2 seconds flat.  But when the lights are on on the track, and you feel the thrill of all that horsepower going around that track. it's easy to forget about such things as sunscreen!   I'm not a big racing fan, but I do enjoy the excitement- as well as the chance to support the guys at Hull Motorsports!  00 Larry (Bo), 13 Jonathan and 14 William.. you guys rock!

I have the best credit you can get. My husband and I where extremely excited and finally shopped around the store and  ordered some very nice Leather furniture. The problem is I can't get a straight answer if I'll ever get it. The warehouse keeps moving my delivery date. Then they text or email a partial order. They don't show up. Then I call and I'm told we never promised you a delivery. hmmm. That's not even funny after the ninth time of being jerked around. I've been transferred to Texas and put on hold for at least 20 minutes every time I call to check on my furniture.When we ordered our beautiful furniture we where promised it would be here for the Thanksgiving holiday. I bought a new bedroom set and mattress before from Ashley's Furniture in California and was very happy with the service. But this place couldn't even find my account and we had to start all over. I should of realized something was wrong then. Our salesman was nice and even gave us his home phone number in case we ever needed his help with our order. This has been so stressful trying to get our furniture delivery done that we finally called him. And for some strange reason even our salesman is gone. We have had so many disappointments with this purchase that  one of the employees in the office named Jessica, offered me a $75.00 loyalty card for putting up with all the problems. And that has never arrived either.I would never go back to this place. If my order isn't here by tomorrow as promised I am cancelling everything. And they will loose out on almost $4000.00.Its too bad. I was in business for over 30 years myself and when I made a promise to my clients I kept it.

Works with a scam artist photographer in town 
Gagged and gagged in my face all night while applying makeup that she reapplied to other customers 
Never cleaned it after she used it either

Yummmmmmm!!! Chile garlic wings, Cesar salad, grilled rib eye, meat loaf dinner, and of course Rick's salmon in potato!! Not a bad thing on the menu!! Love this place. I wanna take Rick home with me so he can cook every night! Ha! Didn't see breakfast on the menu but I'm sure he knows what's up!! Enjoy!!
Don't waste your time looking around Meridian ID for a spot. Beef Obradys is the best. Great food, great drinks, and great service.
As usual Izumi offers quality sushi and saki for a great price. The birthday atmosphere was enjoyable, especially with the chef's hat on fire.  Great place!  Highly recommend anytime of the week.
Returns line was quick today. Team members worked well together to get through the line.
My wife and I stopped off for an afternoon Sushi snack.  GREAT SUSHI - best we have had in the Boise Area.  5 stars.  We will be back to try the Hibachi.

What a treasure!  It has been a long time since I have enjoyed a dining experience this much. My husband had the scallop special, my daughter had the light garlic chicken, and I had the roasted codfish. All were perfectly prepared. The service was exceptional and Chris and her sister Gina were charming. We will definitely be back the next time we are in town. Be sure you don't pass this jewel up.

Not a review, as I was visiting the facility for a weigh in on a fitness challenge, but a tip.  Spacious place.  Ample parking.  Be sure and find out which entrance is most convenient for your needs BEFORE you park or you could be in for a hike.  The folks at the information desk are welcoming and wonderfully helpful!

I had the tomato basil with the Orzo pasta, chocolate strawberry and slice of bread. It was all very wonderful. The soup had just the right amount of pasta and basil in it. Paired well together. Price is just right on everything.

We had a great experience! After visiting Willey Furniture up the street and feeling like we were being stocked by employees it was nice to not be followed around while we took our time sitting on couches trying to find the perfect one. We don't like being harassed​ and constantly bothered when we are shopping. Say hello and let us know you are there to help and then leave us alone...that's exactly what Ashley Furniture did. Our salesman stayed close enough to be there when we were ready and answered questions, etc. He was not pushy and let us take our time and feel comfortable. I even made a point to thank the manager for training the employees not to harass the customers. My only complaint would be that we had to wait two weeks for delivery...when you don't have anything to sit on for two weeks it kind of sucks. Service was great otherwise!
good food!!!! i love their curry dishes. definitely recommend and the waitresses are really friendly.
Came here because it was new to the area and close by.  This was seriously some of the best sushi i have had...definitely recommend

I love Goodwood, that is why it pains me to write this review. I have been a loyal fan and patron of GoodWood for many years. There brisket is not the best, but it has always been good and consistent. The staff has always been very attentive and friendly.

Well, I regret to inform everyone that things have changed and I can no longer recommend Good Wood. The staff is still friendly as always.

The food quality as gone down. I always have the brisket. About a month or 2 ago, they changed the way they serve it. One of the main reasons why I loved GoodWood was because the brisket was NEVER fatty. It was always lean!!!

In all the years I have been going to WoodWood, I never had once received brisket with a piece of gristle or fat on it. The entire portion was good and edible. Not one  iddy bitty notch on my spit-o-meter.

My spit of meter is what I give restaurants that serve food that I have to spit out. Most places serve meat with some fat or gristle, which I have to spit out. Thus, the Spit-O-Meter was born.

Well, not once in all the years I have been going to Good Wood did their food get a place on this.

I am very sad to say that in my last 2 visits, it has!!

Their brisket is now fatty. Not a lot, but more so than the good ole days of lean. The 1st time this happened, I wrote the company and complained. A manager called me and assured me that due to complaints and my email, this was being changed. They were no longer going to serve fatty brisket. 

I have been to GoodWood twice sense and both times, I had brisket with fat on it. For the first time in 10 years, GoodWood now rates on my Spit-O-Meter.

On my last visit, they have a new menu. On this new menu, there is what the server called an alternative to Brisket. The reason for this, as I was told, is that the Brisket has gone up in price.

So they are offering a lower cost option. This alternative is called Smoked Beef. The server described it as roast. 

Really? $13 a plate for roast!!!

She brought it out a sample and it tasted ok.

My wife ordered it. I had the brisket as usual. My wife ended up leaving this strange meat on her plate with little eaten. It has an odd texture to it. Almost like it is way undercooked. I cant figure out in mind how to relay to you what this new item is like. When I took a bite, it was like mush. Some would say that it Melts in your mouth, not your hands. Oh wait...that is M & M's. 

I would say that this new beef does melt in my mouth, but not in a good way. It melted in ways that made me not want to continue eating it. 

It just has a very very odd look and feel. 

It does not taste bad, but it is no where even close to the wonderful taste of Brisket. The problem with this now fatty brisket is that it is expensive. The price of it has jumped to $15 a plate. And to me, it looks like the portions have shrunk as well.

GoodWood has moved from a well priced family restaurant to expensive. They are way too expensive now to bring my family of 3 too. Our ticket price for a meal jumped from around $35 to over $40.

I am sad to see you go GoodWood, but you are no longer in my restaurant line up. 

You have fallen from "GoodWood" to "Ok Wood".

Our first time in and we will be back soon. Friendly and engaging staff in a fun décor. Ex-Girlfriend and Fungus Amungus pizza's were great. Hand made pizza and it showed. Crust had great structure and character while not overshadowing the creative toppings. We also had the Brussel Sprout appetizers which rocked. Check this place out.

I had the pleasure of getting my hair done by Addie, the sweet salon manager. She was extremely knowledgable and personable. She did a great job with my highlights, cut and style. I purchased the groupon deal and was not disappointed. The salon is also very clean and tidy. I can't wait to try some of their other services. Thank you Inspire!

Denizens of the Treasure Valley, in a perfect world we would all go out to our back yards, pick fresh fruits and vegetables, grow grains for our own flour, and slaughter the family pig for supper.  We would take all these fresh ingredients into our kitchens and we would prepare them with dedication and love to produce the finest meals for ourselves and our families...

...ok you can stop laughing now.  But in the world we live in, there are folks who can dedicate the time and effort to prepare such wonderful meals for us.  That is what you will get at Epi's.  No they don't have the farm right out back, but the ingredients are as fresh as can be and are prepared with all the love and attention in the world.  That is one thing that set this place apart for me from the moment I even made the reservation over the phone.  This is a restaurant run by people who love what they do, and it shows in the food and the presentation.

Everything about our experience at Epi's was top notch.  The service was spectacular.  Our water glasses never went empty.  The courses were properly paced.  Heck we were even offered a second bowl of soup if we had wanted it.  We declined because we wanted to enjoy our entrees.  Dessert came with coffee, which only I availed myself of, but was another very nice touch.  Yes the "bill" is a bit high, but believe me when I tell you, you will get your money's worth.

So how about that food?  Do yourself a favor and get an order of the ham croquetas for an appetizer.  No, I take that back... if you REALLY want to do yourself a favor, get two orders so you won't have to share them with your dining partner, because I guarantee you that after tasting one... you won't want to share.  Amazing.  The soups vary.  Every day you can get the red bean soup, which is perfectly serviceable and tasty, and then a soup of the day.  When we went this was a mushroom soup seasoned with white pepper.  I'm not a mushroom fan so I passed, but my wife liked it.

For entrees both my wife and I opted for seafood... halibut for me and shrimp for her.  We both enjoyed our meals immensely, but strangely we both preferred the OTHER'S meal more than our own... not that we were unsatisfied with our choices, just that after sampling a bite from the other's plate, we both agreed that the other dish was better than our own.  I think a lot of that had to do with the lobster cream sauce on my plate.  My wife is a fanatic for lobster while it is just "ok" for me.  For dessert we absolutely had to try the apple bread pudding.  Man I wish I could learn to make bread pudding as well as some others do.  It is one of my favorite desserts but I never seem to be able to get it "right."  Well no worries about that here... again just amazing.

Bottom line folks, if you want great ethnic fare prepared by people who love what they do and it shows on the plate, head to Epi's.  You will be amazed.

One of the best meals my husband and I have had in years.

We decided to go to for our 7 year anniversary. My husband ordered the filet medallions and all I could hear was... "nom nom nom..."  I ordered the halibut with lobster sauce. It was AMAZING! It was fresh and bursted with creamy flavor. 

The ham croquettes were on a whole different level. So delicious! 

The service was absolutely awesome! The ladies were sooooo sweet. We cant wait to come back! 
We recommend Epi's to all of our friends and family!

I cannot day enough good things about Culver's in Meridian!  The food is delicious, and customer service is superb.  A few weeks ago, I had a long day at work and stopped by on my way home to grab a pre packed pint of custard to go.  I went inside, and the line was quite long - this place is popular!!  I waited patiently in line to pay for my custard, and I couldn't help but notice the employee at the counter.  He was probably in his early 20's, and I could tell he had some mobility issues or a disability with one of his arms, because he couldn't quite extend it all the way.  However, despite his physical limitations and challenges, he was so enthusiastic about his job, and I could tell he loved working there.  He was so very helpful with everyone he came in contact with, and had a big smile.  I got very annoyed at the individual behind me in line because he kept grumbling things like 'this place is so damn slow' and 'I just want some damn custard, where is the service?'  I didn't want to cause a scene, so I didn't turn around and say anything to him.  However, I DID stick around and linger to see how this happy, enthusiastic employee would handle him.  Despite being annoying and using some gruff and choice words, this employee treated this man with the utmost respect and courtesy.  So very impressive.  

About a week later, my son begged to go to Culver's for his sixth birthday, and have the 'nice people there sing to him'.  We went in, ordered our food, and quietly asked for the manager while the kids sat down.  We ended up getting the owner himself!  We asked if he would mind if we put a candle in his custard, light it, and sing happy birthday to our son.  He actually offered to do it for us and bring the custard straight out to him, candles lit and everything.  And so he did, with several employees in tow, all singing happy birthday.  It was so great, and it made him feel so special.  He was just beaming.  Thank you, Culver's, for being a wonderful family place with wonderful service!  We will be back again and again and again...

My wife, son and I came here with hopes of a delicious meal. Firstly we were forced to order before we could even sit down, which was extremely annoying as we wanted to go over the menu, without being forced into a quick decision. This due to the people behind us being in a clear hurry. Fine, we order. They then make us pay immediately. Oh that's great, we pay like we are eating dinner at a fast food restaurant. What a great way to screw your already underpaid waitress. Most people don't carry cash, and we were told we could go to an atm...

The service was incredible, our waitress was amazing. Thankfully we had some cash on us and were able to reward her hard work.

The food though was another matter altogether. The steak I had, tasted more like liver than steak, and the shrimp was deep fried far too long. My son had the ribs, which were buried under a ton of bbq sauce, the meat was chewy and overcooked. Finally my wife had the salad bar and found it unsatisfactory for the salad bar we used to know Sizzler for.

Overall the waitress was amazing, but the price point of such terrible food, was far beyond what it should be, but considering they run their business like a fast food restaurant, it's no surprise. Good thing they charge up front because I would of been hard pressed to pay full price for such a terrible meal.
Reasonable prices for dinner out. Great menu choices, fresh and tasty ingredients and perfect portion sizes. Left feeling full but not stuffed.

Epi's is simply amazing.  Not only the best restaurant in the area, but one of the most authentic, friendliest restaurants that I've been to.  While dining here, you don't feel rushed and actually get a chance to enjoy your meal, which is absolutely amazing from start to finish!

Exceptional service. Great food. Homey feel. 

I've eaten in 5 star restaurants across the country and none can compare to the service level at Epi's. The wait staff seems to genuinely enjoy serving guests. It was more like being at a family dinner being served by your favorite aunt than a for profit business. 

The red bean soup is very good. 

The rib eye steak is tasty. The only objection would be a little too much gristle. The flavor and "doneness" was very good. 

It's a wonderful setting in a house on Main St. 

Highly recommended.

I purchased a complete bedroom set, mattress and sofa about two months ago at Ashley. After we picked out what we wanted it took over 2 hours to get us checked out. They had just opened so we were patient and didn't complain at all.
We found out once we received our statements that they open up two lines of credit, one in my name and one in my husbands and my name. Again that was an easy phone call to close the line. 
The part in this experience that has me fuming is how long it has taken to get all of our furniture. Two months later we have still not received our bed frame. The first time arrived one of the bed posts was completely cracked through. We had to call to even get it rescheduled and it has since been canceled twice. The reason we were given was it wasn't scheduled properly by the supervisor who placed the order to begin with. I have spent my entire day off today waiting for this frame and it is now 5:30 and it is still " on its way". I actually love the furniture otherwise it would be returned by now. I will never recommend this business.

Patient Financial Services is a pain to work with.! They tell you one thing, send you a "secure" email, and it's totally something different. Why,  not tell you while you are on the phone with them?

Then, in TODAYS day and age it takes a month to get an itemized bill to submit to your health care flex account. What a crock, the gals in the clinics used to produce an itemized bill as you checked out, very quick, very easy. This new process is a big mess and super slow.

I have known this family because I have been coming here for years. I went in on July 3rd and had a pedicure done. I did not have a wait. I did not got the option to pick out what kind of pedicure I wanted. So I got the basic. I got home and realized that all I really had done was my toe nails painted.

I went back in today because I felt maybe it was just a bad day for Tony and Cyndi. Shop opened up 10 minutes late. I was rushed through my pedicure again and disappointed. My feet actually hurt and are bleeding today. I notice they have a problem saying no and maybe should take more appointments so customers feel more comfortable. They are great people but service is huge.

This place is just what you need after a long day! Great service great service great food great beer list! I want to make a special thanks to Melissa the bartender, and Heather the server.

I had the wings l, dry rub, they were delicious. The nachos are huge! Definitely enough for a group.

Not the worst Chinese food, but definitely not the best we've had here. And I'm not sure what everyone is talking about when they say this place has reasonable prices... It was expensive for very little and inexpensive portions and I've only taken three bites of my lo mein and I have acid reflux! You want the best lo mein in Boise/meridian area, go to Joy Garden.

Talk about warm and inviting! The people at Epi's are phenomenal- the friendliest we've met since moving from Texas last year. Food is amazing. Simple dishes with a ton of flavor. I love the small, intimate atmosphere. Cozy enough for a romantic date night, but not overly formal, so it's pleasant to take your family along! Kris and Angela are lovely women, and they truly treat their customers as family. Can't wait to go back!

I used this service several times over the course of a few months for my business and everything seemed to be working well. Then I also received a couple of the broken down truck calls and finally no show and no call and no return call. I was using Cameron to move things as part of my business for a very large customer and this lack of reliability or communication almost cost me that client. This occurred several months ago and while I thought about writing this review, I did not as I had moved on. Last week, however, I received several large charges on my credit card from this company and left a message giving them an opportunity to explain it. No return call. Shocking. So we have now moved from poor service to fraudulent activity.

This is my favorite Thai restaurant- we eat here at least once every 6 weeks or so. I would have given it 5 stars, but the last time I went about a week ago, our usual favorites didn't come out the way it usually does. The cha gio was cut into such small pieces that the filling was spilling out. The honey roasted duck was mostly skin and bones, no meaty breast meat although the flavoring was good as usual. The fresh spring rolls were tough and dried out, like it was made hours beforehand. The crispy house special noodles ( I forget the real name of the dish) was drowning in the sauce. Usually it's like a rich gravy, but instead it seemed watered down and made the noodles soggy. We were quite disappointed and the place only had 2 other tables with customers. Sometimes restaurants start cutting corners to save money before going out of business, but I'm hoping this isn't the case. I'm keeping my fingers crossed that maybe their regular chef was in holiday and someone else was subbing in the kitchen. Will go again soon to see if things are back to normal.

This review is specifically directed toward the owners. We love this place and we really want it to do well. I sincerely believe my few pointers will help you establish and maintain a customer base. We want you to stick around!!!
We have come here twice in a couple weeks and seriously enjoy the food. Our favorite dish is the crispy sesame beef. The only reasons I'm not giving it 5 stars are the following:
- The atmosphere in the restaurant is lacking. It needs music to offset the silence when there are few people there. It can be awkward being the only table with no music. It makes you feel like you must speak quietly and it is not a relaxing dining experience. 
- The wait staff needs a little polishing. They make me nervous that they don't write down my order and modifications. Our first time there our appetizer was almost forgotten, though she saved it barely in time and had our appetizer first. There also should be a little bit more training for them to smooth out their service and communication. 
Despite these things that I've critiqued, the servers we have had have been very friendly, courteous, and helpful. 
During this most recent visit we had a server named Alex. He gave us two awesome recommendations: the dragon roll and having it deep fried. It was a great, new experience. He was friendly and opened up over time. I think training for all your servers would help the atmosphere for the restaurant. 
Please get some music and please stick around. We will be back!

I like this theatre but they need to plan ahead to have the hit dogs ready. This s a frequent problem. 

Also today the women's toilet bowls are in dire need of cleaning. It takes a long time between cleanings for them to look this bad!  It makes me wonder how clean other things are.

My husband and I really craved authentic Indian food and stumbled upon this place. We are SO happy we found it! The food was hot, delicious, and filling (coconut naan OMG) and the staff were very friendly. 
Please, please eat here so they can stay in business!

Still haven't heard from Ashley's furniture. Tried calling them again and there is no human to talk to. On hold till they feel like answering. They need to know about the terrible quality of the furniture that has been dropped off. It looks good till you roll it over and look at all the yarn and strings hanging. The Velcro that is supposed to hold the back side of the recliner closed is crooked and uneven. Looks like a kids sewn it. My 6 year old grandson could of sewn a better job. Don't buy from Meridian, Idaho's Ashley's Furniture. They don't stand behind their promises. Come on Ashley's answer your phone and get back to me regarding this mess. And I still don't have tghe money you promised me. I check the mail box again.Where is it?

Super disappointed in price and food. The service was awesome, but the food was salty and didn't compare to other Indian I had in the past. I am upset because we haven't found a good Indian place in the Boise area yet. Unfortunately this was the worst. 

We had the garlic naan which was good
Chicken Makahni was the worst I ever had
Chicken, Lamb, and shrimp madrasi which was recommended was really bad
Rice was great

Free soda refills is awesome. If they were not so nice it would be a 1*.
Very impressed with this restaurant. Food was great. Servers were very friendly and quick with refills or anything we needed. In love with the coconut naan bread! So amazing!

with a reservation we walked right in and we're seated immediately- our server was excellent - 

he recommended the potato skins which were more like extreme potato nachos from the heavens. Crisp, gooey, and creamy. So good!

We ordered the prime rib and split. It was good with a smokey flavor. The char wasn't very strong but it allowed for the smiley flavor to set the pace. 

Very good visit.

We stopped in here to get a quick bite to eat. Very fresh and delicious bagel and crossiant sandwiches. We had an omelet crossiant with egg and spinach, a blt bagel and another meat based bagel. The bagels were fresh and not too chewy, perfect for a sandwich.  The boba tea was also great and we finished the lunch with an apple turnover. Flaky and fresh. Reasonable prices and would definitely recommend this to other sandwich lovers
The best place to go for fist time hair cuts, its kinda far from south Boise, wish they had another location closer, but overall experience was a 10!

I have been a customer of the Cutlery Shoppe for several years. I have purchased between 15 and 20 knives from them. Jeff the owners customer service is among the best in the industry. His prices are spot on competitive. With all of those transactions I 
only had one issue. He resolved it immediately to my satisfaction. I cannot imagine any negative review being factual. I know this from personal experience. I am an ardent knife collector and I would rate Jeff's Cutlery Shoppe among the top 5 in the industry. You can buy from Cutlery Shoppe with total confidence.
Service was very good.  The decor was kind of cheesy.  Fake plants every where is kind of weird.  The service was good but the food was very average.  Not planning on going back the anytime soon

Went to see Fantastic Beasts. heres what i got to experience
-Blurry screen
-Crying Baby
-2 cell phones going off
-people texting
-people who like to kick seats
-a front desk employee who told us "we dont check into theaters when the movie is going"

we DID get a refund, which was nice of management. Doesnt change the fact that we had a terrible experience and will not be coming back.
Absolutely loved it! I ordered half kale & quinoa salad with chicken enchilada chili soup...YUMMY  It was more than enough food.

Good tasting food. Great place. A bit on the noisy side but with all those folks in there, really no way to stop that. We had a large group of 12 and the server forgot three meals (two kids, one teen) but the mgr and server fixed it quickly and we were happy. The comp-ed a few ice creams for the kiddos, that was cool.
The service here is super speedy and polite. I enjoyed my meal.  This place makes it on my top 3 Thai places in Boise.

Great little place! This was my first time and it reminds me a lot of Chipotle. Not as authentic Mexican as I like (given my Mexican heritage) but it's definitely good food worth the price. And the kids eat free deal is pretty awesome!

I had an awesome experience at this store yesterday with Justin and the store manager I think his name is Tyreek. I was trying to decide on my normal Samsung galaxy or changing over to the iPhone and I thought it was great that they did not try to push me either way. Instead they just give me the pros and cons of both types of phones . They were very patient with me while I tried to decide.  Then once I decided on the iPhone, Justin showed me how to use a lot of cool features. (Wow! How have I lived all this time without the ability to send texts with fireworks!!) 
I was there for about four hours because the switchover from an android to an iOS system took a lot longer than we thought it would; my phone kept disconnecting. So even though I had to spend four hours in the sprint store it was a very positive experience. I would definitely go back to this store! You feel very well taken care of:)

Just finished up at Axiom. Figured what better enjoyment after.  Will let you know how it goes.

Ok...done eating. Sandwich and salad were excellent. Every good thing I'd heard about the place are true.

Only negatives...No dine in cups and the to-go cups are flimsy. Also the napkins are too small.
The food is good, not great...  but the service and the people are AMAZING.  You will feel at home, and they will never turn you away.
Best Indian Food I have ever had! Their lunch buffet is amazing! Definitely recommend it! We will be back for sure!

Really disappointed after all of the 5 star reviews.  Service and staff was great, food quality and flavor not so good.  The croquettas were ok, a bit overcooked and somewhat greasy. The marinated mushrooms were the best and left me hopeful for the rest of the dinner.  Unfortunately, the salad was drowning in dressing, I could only eat about half.  They were out of lamb chops at 7pm on a Friday!, so we had to order something else. The pork chops were overcooked, I could barely cut off a piece with my serrated knife, and gave my jaw a workout. I gave up after 3 bites.  The plate was also uninspiring with a bland presentation, and like many others have stated, arrived luke warm. Didn't bother to order dessert as we just wanted to get out of the noisy environment.  Would not recommend and did not experience anything that inspired me to go back.

I guess I should have read other reviews before coming here. I have been using regularly for a year and the prices keep going up. Today I picked up a shirt and it was over $10 for one item! Someone invoiced it as a dress so they charged me a dress. It is clearly a top. The lady kept arguing that it was a dress because it was invoiced like that she has to charge for it. She looked at it and said it's a dress. If I put it on it hits my waist! She was very rude and said she is just the messenger. The regular lady was out today and she is nice. To get my shirt I had to pay the money. She said she would tell the manager about it. I doubt that happens. And I doubt I'll be back.

I first visited this pizza joint using the card best of boise in terms of pizza restaurants. I did two large pizzas as take and bake. Best way to describe this place think little caesar's; honestly I kind of wonder if they took the recipients. The pizza dough is very similar; the pizza dough I had stuck to the cooking tray and the dough was just awful. It's definitely a low cost pizza option if your looking to save some "dough" lol. If your looking for quality so many other options to choose from in Boise. I won't we back some of the worst pizza I have had in Boise.
Would love to eat here but I have to give 1 star for terrible hours. Get your shit together rick

I've generally had ok experiences with movers but a few bad apples give the rest a bad name (ahem, it rhymes with shmironman) . I wish all movers were like Cameron and Eric from Reliance.

A few of the many things I appreciated...They were polite, and very professional. If they didn't know where something went, they asked. I know it sounds simple but a lot of movers don't do that. They did not mess around either. They were working at full speed all day. They were also extra careful with wrapping my baby's things so they would stay clean. 

I had my infant son and my dad was helping me with unpacking and organizing and they frequently asked if either of us needed help. 

My dad, who had never used movers and thought it was ridiculous that I was hiring people for something we could do ourselves, said "wow!! That was totally worth it!"

I will use them for my next move without hesitation and whole-heartedly recommend their services.

I love the 21 and older setting that they offer. The food the drinks and being able to sit back and enjoy the the move without kids kicking the back of your set or talking loud is wonderful. If you want a night out without being bothered, go here. It's like having a theater to yourself with the best food and drinks to boot.
Great onion ring appetizers!! Brisket a bit dry, St Louis ribs very good! Nice waitress, nice atmosphere

We been coming here on and off for years. My kids always beg me to take them here whenever I ask them; so what do you guys want to do today? I have mixed feelings about this place. It's expensive ($10/hour), it's kind of dark but it's a good place to go when it's too cold to play outside. After all my kids enjoy their time there.

1st time eating thai (super late to the game, I know this now). most importantly though, Thai Basil was soOo yummy, not to mention it's a vegetarian's paradise. crunchy pad thai w/ tofu is going to be a repeat fav of mine coming back! the serving staff was quality, friendly + efficient.

Pretty good BBQ and decent service.  The side dishes are just "OK".  Nothing special about this place.  Nothing really stands out.  You can get a three meat combo with two sides for around $18.  With ribs you have to add $1.

I'd go back for lunch but probably not for dinner.  Their wine selection is horrible.  Better to eat with a beer.

A little noisy but not so bad you can't have a conversation.

Pretty much all booths.  It felt a tight with just three of us.

When people say they've had the best pizza ever I never believe them. I must say I've never had pizza that struck me like this. Delicious I'm back the next day for more. Just go check it out Joe is carrying on his family's tradition.

Food was tasty but I should have checked the reviews here first because they got my order wrong too. I even asked nicely for a dipping sauce and the lady said of course and it didn't make it into my bag either.
What a show... rock on... trophy dashes down... heats and mains to come... rock on!!!

Food is ok, service is really good. People are very friendly there and the environment was a great experience. The chef was really good with his showmanship on the hibachi grill. The only thing I did not like is that he went a little overboard with mocking Asians. For the food, the sushi was good, it was not rolled tight and fell apart. Taste and texture was good for what we ordered. The shrimp siu mai was good but not very hot, it was more warm. My miso soup was delicious, not too salty and not too much big pieces of mushrooms. My salad was ok, I thought the dressing was a little too strong because there was too much ginger. The hibachi grill we got steak and chicken.
