I like the vegetables, they were grilled perfect, the fried rice was still hard and tasted like it was not steamed before it was fried on the hibachi grill. The steak was made medium for me and it was perfect! It was nice and juicy with the yummy yummy sauce, yes that is what they called it. The game get sauce was good also. The experience they create there is awesome! Their happy hour from 3-6 is pretty sweet since alcohol is half off. I do like the variety in sushi they have and would go back again.

Admittedly, I've only been here once and I wasn't terribly impressed. My favorite aspect of this theater is the decor. They obviously went for a more "Hollywood" look to the place and pulled it off rather well. The lobby area is very nice. 

The assigned seating when purchasing tickets seemed like a decent notion but while waiting for the film to start I heard at least three different people complain about getting their seats taken. I get that this is a problem caused by customers but what's the point of selling specific seats if you're not going to do anything to enforce it? The seating in the regular area isn't terribly spacious so taller people won't have very much leg room.

Otherwise, there was nothing to really differentiate this theater from any other. Ticket prices aren't any cheaper and concessions are just as overpriced as everywhere else.

Update: The VIP section is fantastic. Literally everything I didn't like about this place in the original review is negated in these amazing seats.

First return visit in awhile. While the hostesses and wait staff were great the kitchen table helpers who brought the food  forgot 4 of 5 salads. Waitress corrected the problem but our entrees arrived as as the salads were being brought by our waitress. 

While I appreciate the reason for staff to deliver food to the tables allowing the waitresses and waiters to attend to other needs (drinks, condiments, more diners etc.) I think these types of mixups can be entirely avoided when the waitresses and waiters are delivering the meals to their tables. 

Food: The onion rings were great. Very nice breading and sweet onion. The slices were cut a bit thick for my taste, but cooked thoroughly. 

Appetizers available in 2 sizes. Meat was flavorful and tender.  Small Cobb salad was more than enough for 1. 

A note: the prices appear to have been lowered, 12 oz ribeye steak was under $20 however to add a salad as a side does now cost extra, and it appears that all entrees are priced without the salad. 
For large groups I suggest calling to make a reservation. The website was unclear regarding this issue appearing to state that they do not take reservations on Fridays, Saturdays or Holidays. Best to call and be sure. 

Despite the food mixup and timing. A good meal for the value.

The Gem State's Hidden Gem

With a modest appearance from the curb, Epi's exceeds ALL expectations. Service was amazing, soups were to die for. They catered specially to a vegetarian and the halibut was perfection. This is a monthly must for dining out in the Treasure Valley.

had a wonderful experience at epi's this past weekend. it was our first time going and everyone told us OMG YOU HAVE TO GO! which i thought was really cool, that so many people love and appreciate this place. 

chris- the owner- was so sweet. she confirmed my reservation by text and she called me. she really does love all of her customers. she greeted us by name when we arrived and came and chatted with us throughout the meal. you feel like you are in her home when you're in there.

the ambiance is low-lit, lots of family style tables filled with people, bottles of wine flowing, the smell of home made food wafting through the air. my husband couldn't help but want to hold my hand across the table- the place just makes you feel like a warm hug.

the food was delicious but the menu is not large so everything we ate has already been covered on other reviews. my review is more about the service and the restaurant itself. we left full, happy, and loved. they gave me a candle on my dessert, and chris hugged us when we left. overall, i look forward to coming back again. a very memorable birthday dinner with my husband!

Wow...we walked into the restaurant, a family of eight, and there was not really room available.  However, the manager made it work for our family and even comped our appetizer.  The food was great...the environment was better, and the service was the best!!!   I am so impressed with this restaurant that I wanted to brag about our experience:-).  Best overall place to eat!

Love this Kohls!!...they're the friendliest, most customer serving. Really,.. you feel like they would wait on you hand and foot, just because you are their customer. Thank you guys for showing 1st class customer service.

This place was a relief to find.  Most of the time when I am in Boise, I acquiesce to the ubiquity of the chain restaurants in the area.  This is especially true in Meridian which if you go to the dictionary and look up bland suburbia, that's sort of what you can expect (until now).  Nothing against suburbia, it's just that cuisine in many places like that is not really cuisine nor is it really cooked completely on site etc.  So, when my colleague suggested that we try this place, I was quite eager to give it a shot.  Especially since I have visited a number of DDD places from Food Network and have not been disappointed.

I had the meatloaf sandwich which was served on grilled sourdough with LTM.   (I asked for the mayo on the side, figuring that there would be enough lubrication from the meat itself.  I was correct and saved myself a couple hundred calories in the process.  So, this marvel of a sandwich was now only about 1500 calories instead of 1750!  The meat was perfectly seasoned, the bread was fresh and the fries were decent as well.  The only way it could have been better would have been if the fries had been fresh cut  

My colleague had the crab melt which was also served on Boise's version of sourdough which was decent but certainly not as good as the stuff I had grown accustomed to in the Bay Area but one cannot be picky when in Boise.  Ultimately this place is a great place for breakfast or lunch and is in old Meridian (or essentially what has not been overtaken by strip malls, Wal Marts, Targets, Starbucks etc.  Oh, one other piece of advice, if you want to write on their wall, you'd better hurry as they're running out of space!!!

By FAR the most amazing dental office I have EVER  experienced! They people treated me like royalty. Everyone is friendly. Their office is always clean and they never keep me waiting. LOVE LOVE LOVE going in for my cleanings because I know I will be treated by friendly people. Thank you for making patients feel so welcomed!

Not happy...
Our last time here, the experience was terrible!  Terrible!!!  We already knew the food is good, a bit on the pricey side, but still really tasty.  We've had different sushi rolls, appetizers, and combo entrées.   Last weekend, we sit down, no one came to the table for 20mins.  Finally, he arrives to take our drink order.  When we ask what type of soda they have, he says "a bunch".  He informed us it was it his first day.  OK, no problem. People have to start somewhere.  He got out order wrong, even though he took it 6 times.  Each time, telling us it was his first day and he just wanted to make sure he got the order correct.  When he brought out the miso soup, he spilled it everywhere.  On our table and the floor.  He tried to bring us new appetizer plates 3 times and actually set down another 3 forks, even though they were already on the table.  Finally, 2.5hrs later, we get our entrées.   Delicious.   But they billed us incorrectly and didn't bother to discount anything.  Partly, the restaurant is to be blamed.  They knew he was having issues, since different people apologized for what was happening, but no one was shadowing him each time he came back to the table.  We honestly felt like we were on some hidden prank show but no cameras came out to let us in on the joke.   After finally getting the , full priced , bill squared away, we were leaving and offered $20 gift card come back.  Which doesn't make up for how horrible our experience was.  
Positive 5 stars for the flavor of the food...negative 5 stars for the experience and management's lack of ensuring the customer is at least happy walking out the door.  We didn't expect a free dinner for all, just show you care about our business.

Thank you for responding  on here from your automatic computer response team, Still haven't heard from you yet though.                                            Dec,2 2015
We have had terrible service from your  Ashley Meridian,Idaho store after we made the purchase. While we where in the store they couldn't do enough. But after you sign on the dotted line and leave the store this is where the fun begins.  I'm not sure if the problem is the store or the Warehouse. They are both at fault. I've tried to reach out to the manager and he's never available either. He has either just left or is just too busy at the moment.Then I try to re-explain myself again to another associate .I've had one person take an interest at the very end and his name was Brian at the front desk. Even gave me his direct number and he usually answered..I have  been promised  10 different times of a delivery date. Set up a day  but no time and then never heard back. So I call to see if they will be coming and according to the person  on the other end they never had a delivery date.
I was promised my furniture before Thanksgiving and it didn't happen. ALL LIES !!!!!
I spoke to Brian the last time regarding my recliners. I did get one delivered. And he said they had two in the store and he would see if I could get one of them. Finally got the OK for that. But no discount was  ever offered since it was a floor model. And its not good quality. It had strings of fabric and Yarn hanging in the back along the edge. Its not sewn straight at all. Very poor quality. Looks like a 5 year old sewn  I still don't have the last item I ordered and that is the Ottoman. Neither do I have my $75.00  promised the you where supposed send to me for all the run around. According to your store manager at Meridian, Idaho he says it must go through all the proper channels. What is that?  Should it take  6 months???? 
He's got a very unhappy customer here and I will be spreading the word. Our family loved what we bought and so did the in-laws. But I've already told them about our service and they won't be buying from Ashley's in Meridian, Idaho. I complained earlier about this same on going problem.You acted as though you where going to "fix" the problem. Asked me to contact you as I did.  But you are just like all the other employees and seem to be nothing more than a robot. I've given you plenty of time to respond. I have waited for a week to hear from you. And still nothing.The few people on here who have give a favorable review must be related or you're doing it yourself. You have received the last dollar from us.

Stop the presses! There's something punny going on here!

Headlines are what draw your interest to a newspaper and can sometimes make or break an edition. Not that anyone under the age of thirty knows what a newspaper is anymore, or even what news is that doesn't involve a social network link. Rick and Julie over at Rick's Press Room know a little bit about newspapers and headlines; or at least it would appear so to the casual observer in their little restaurant in downtown Meridian. The walls are littered with headlines of dead people and old crap nobody cares about anymore. But don't  judge the place by the decor.

The one thing everyone that comes to Rick's Press room does care about, other than trying to catch a glimpse of Guy Fieri and his trademark Comaro (give it up kids, Guy has left the building!), is the food that has received quite a few raves from some of the locals and international customers, many of which have adorned the walls of Rick's Press Room with their own headlines via Sharpie. So, I decided to follow the crowd and try out this little joint. 

I was in the mood to sniff out a good story and it just so happened that the smoker was spewing its little love puffs right outside the front entrance. Nice marketing! Not sure what was in the smoker, but I'm certain it was worthy of its own story below the fold. Now, I think I know what Rick and Julie (the owners - hence the name "Rick's Press Room" - keep up kids) were going for with the interior of the place; that eclectic, shabby, recycled newspaper design with a feeling of casualness and fun, but it was more reminiscent of my old college dorm room than a restaurant setting you would expect to see based on all of the published raves. But my college dorm room was a lot of fun and as I recall, there may have been a bit of smoking going on in there too. So, maybe it works. 

I asked about the specialties of the house and was told that pretty much everything was good (canned answer. C'mon, grow a pair! This is your chance to push the highest margin dish!). So I decided to go with a bit of seafood and ordered the Crab Melt with a bowl of the Clam Chowder. Say it with me . . . chow-dah! My dining partner had the raved about burger with simple bacon and cheddar (che dah). we also ordered a loaf of their warm sour dough bread with butter to get our taste buds hopping. 

As promised, the bread was warm and also moist in the center with a crispy crust. The accompanying real butter was a nice contrast to the whipped look-a-likes you normally get at restaurants. Not bad.

The chowder was the soup of the day and I found myself wishing for a little more density to the bowl. A bit loose for my taste and a little shy on flavor, but it did have plenty of clams, potatoes and celery and went well with a bit of the sour dough bread. Pretty good, but not great. 

The crab melt was not what I expected. The copious amounts of mayo and Parmesan really overwhelmed the mechanically separated crab meat, that didn't have much flavor to begin with, and it became lost in the struggle for prominence within the sandwich. The crab filling was topped with melted Swiss cheese. Typically, the blending of cheese and seafood is a no-no situation and liable to make chefs and food critics a bit crabby. In this instance, I happen to agree. Even though there was a good amount of crab meat in the filling, the combination of the other heavy handed ingredients really didn't do the sandwich any favors and I would have opted for a smaller portion with an emphasis on the crab than the mayo and cheese. 

The burger was cooked well done (as requested by my dining partner) but still retained its moisture and was tender. A bit of salt would have enhance the meat flavor. The bacon was slightly limp but not bad and the cheddar was typical for the area. The accompaniments seemed fresh and crisp, but the most redeeming quality of the burger was the bun; it was warm, moist and was toasted nicely for a bit more added texture. The fries . . . . frozen! Seriously?! We are in Idaho, people. What does it take to get some good fries around here?! The service we received was outstanding! Prompt, attentive, but not overbearing. Kudos!

Overall, really not a bad meal, no headlines worthy of the National Enquirer, but maybe the Red Bud Gazette might be an option.

We have had lunch there several times and it is always fantastic. The prices are right in line and the service is great. Have taken the family there for dinner and it was great. Try the pork chops yummy and plenty.

Deserts are good, better than other fast food restaurants. However, the employees were very apathetic and rude. After messing up the order, they refused to own up to it. The manager blamed us for the mistake in the order and was very difficult and unpleasant.

My experience with this place was great. Walked in and talked to Megan. I'm not to great at picking out a bouquet of flowers, but I kinda had an idea from the website and she was a great help. I ended up substituting a certain flower for a different flower and adding green orchids to make it complete, and was delivered and looked great. Big thanks to floral creations for having the flowers and Megan for helping me out.

From the greeting received at the door to the exit hugs from our server, our first experience at Epi's was perfect. The red bean soup is simply delicious and the croqueta' are heavenly.  In fact, we woke up this morning and joked that we'd dreamed about them...lol.  The ink fish was phenomenal!  Black, earthy and had that briney, straight from the ocean flavor that reminded me of food eaten on the coast. The lamb chops were thick, tender, lightly seasoned and grilled to perfection.  We bypassed dessert and opted for another kalimotxo instead.  Our dinner was excellent and the food is able to stand on it's own without complex seasonings, sauces or accouterments.  The atmosphere has a cozy, comfortable vibe that makes you feel right at home.  Our server (Hailey) was helpful, prompt and had a great personality.  We will be back....again and again.

The food is always delish here.  I crave the lobster bisque and love the yummy bread. Splurged this time and had a mixed berry creme brûlée. One of my sad things this trip:  the choices for diet drinks from the soda fountain has dwindled significantly.   And that is why there is only 4 stars this time.

Such a great experience!!! I cannot rave enough about this restaurant! this place far surpasses Benihana on all levels! First and foremost, every staff member greeted us as soon as we walked in. We were seated quickly and our drinks were there before we even knew it. We ordered the lunch hibachi chicken and it was more than enough food! It comes with soup, salad, veggies, and fried rice (which is almost always an extra charge everywhere else)You can taste the freshness of the ingredients with the very first bite. On top of all of that, our cook was AMAZING!!!! He truly made our experience special. AND THE BEST PART..it was unbelievably inexpensive!!! 1/4 of the price of Benihana. I lived in Boise for 18 years and I wish this place came around sooner! This place is great for every day lunch or for date nights and other special occasions!!! Thank you for the great experience!

So Epi's was recommended as a good Basque Restaurant, so I read the reviews and a bit taken by a five star rating. So called Chris for a reservation, she returned my call and sounded like we known each other for years! At the restaurant we were served by Bridgette.

every course was outstanding! To start the "house wine" an imported tempprnillo was very good, excellent value, especially if your party is 6+ get the magnum bottle!

The calimari was tender, lightly coated, melt in your mouth, some of the best I've had! same with the calm chouder. We opted for the limited avail sockeye salmon, a touch over cooked for our taste but an excellent call on Bridgette s part. Dessert was something best experienced for yourself. One of the best meals of many to come at Epi's

Make a reservation so you won't be desapointed when you can't be seated, Thursday night and the place was full! A must dinning experience in the Tresuure Valley! Hats off to Chris and her staff!

Sorry--as much as I don't like posting a negative review, I rely so heavily on honest objective and subjective input from others that I felt a review was warranted. I happened to be in the area after a meeting near lunchtime and thought I'd finally give this spot a try. What a disappointment. As a matter of fact, it was so much so that while I had optimistically picked up a to-go menu when I came in though was seated at a table with a regular menu thinking I'd want to return or place an order in the future. I threw it out in the trash can a few yards outside the door. The employee was nice enough but the food was truly horrible. The egg drop soup was like water and corn starch with some dark egg strands in it that did not look natural and it was merely a thickened water flavor with little else other than possibly tasting of MSG. The beef dish was hot but had an odd, overly sweet flavor that was not appropriate for a beef dish. It was unbalanced and unpalatable. 

Also, the logistics of the service were difficult as the entree portion was served on such a small plate and the rice in such a tiny bowl that there was no way to be traditional and add some of the entree to the rice bowl nor was there room on the very small oval plate to add any of the rice. Even the water had an odd taste as if it had come from something that was standing for some time. Add to that, it appears to have been a bit thrown together as the chairs seemed completely out of place with carved-out images of steaming coffee as if they were bought from a previous enterprise that served coffee. Definitely not a fit for an Asian restaurant. Sorry--no second time for this one and just grateful I didn't bring others with me. It now makes sense to me why there was only one other table that was occupied though two people came in for takeout. I can't opine about the sushi as I'm not a fan, but the caliber of the Chinese side of the menu was very poor and I actually was eager to leave as it was just uncomfortable.
Very good!! Best basque food i have tried around here.  And such great service and atmosphere! :) I will return.

Clean and comfortable seating.  They also have comfortable sitting area in the lobby also. They even have a VIP section where you can order drinks and sandwiches. Parking is the only issue here- don't cut it too close to find a spot.

Carolina pulled pork sandwiches is the one to get it's extremely moist and delicious and the meet is tasty the coleslaw is to die for and the loaded mashed potatoes are by far my favorite great service great location
The easiest thing is to write a review when everything is awesome. The only down side is that I don't live closer. Go and eat it all!! Great food and service.
The owner is so sweet, She sat down with my husband & I to tell us about her family and the basque people. The food was sooo good!

Lamb stew is fantastic, so is beef medallions, leg of lamb good but not the best that I have had. Triple layer chocolate  cake was good but the rice pudding was runny and rather lacking.  

Friends say that the fish dishes are excellent.  Five stars for lamb stew and friendly service.
We went to Rick's after a great recommendations from a friend. I got the Reuben and my wife got the special - filet with shrimp. The food was good and the servers were friendly. We will repeat.

Culver's is definitely one of my favorites! I went and got m and m concrete mixer and my sister had the raspberry cheesecake concrete mixer. Both were delicious. We went right before they closed and it was nice not having to wait at all for the drive through.  Concrete mixers came out super fast! Only complaint was the m and ms in mine weren't fully distributed throughout and were more at the top with almost nothing near the bottom. Overall very good though!

Rick's is probably one of if not my favorite restaurant in the whole valley. We go for lunch quite a bit, the Meatloaf sandwich is amazing. And have also done dinner here, the Porkchops are great, 2 thumbs up! Rick does an outstanding job, all the food is fresh, not frozen and you can tell, it is good home cooking!

My husband and I stopped at Izumi for a takeout order yesterday; we ordered the Chef Special Dinosaur Egg (whole avocado stuff with spicy tuna, spicy salmon, crab then deep fried in tempura batter topped with eel sauce and spicy sauce), Idaho roll, Philadelphia roll, and King Crab and Avocado roll.  It was all excellent, reasonably priced, and packaged beautifully for a takeout order.  We are definitely going again and again!

I'm not sure why people rave on this place. It's not that it's bad but after 4 trips in five years, I ask the same question- why do I keep hoping it's better than it is? There are several BBQ joints in the treasure valley. Save your money unless you want average BBQ at a premium price. I know I will.

We were starved and I was looking forward to a good evening. We waited 20 minutes to even have any wait staff ask if we would like anything to drink (a table sat after us were served before us). They hadn't even given us a menu with drink choices so it took a bit to get a glass of wine and a beer. I got the meatloaf which was adequate, but the mashed potatoes were watery and the oil the veggies were cooked in must have been old. I really couldn't eat it so I'm glad my husband had plenty of fries! He liked his Rueben- so not all was bad. Dissapointed.

Holy moley was this place amazing. We love Diners, Drive-Ins, and Dives, and we were so glad Guy pointed us in this restaurants direction. I am a vegetarian and Rick himself cooked an awesome grilled veggie and cheese concoction for my lunch while my carnivorous husband had the steak sandwich (which he claimed was absolutely magnanimous.) We decided we hadn't had enough and went back for dinner, yes two times in the same day. Dinner was even better, fettuccini alfredo for me and the salmon for my husband. Both were incredible. Rick remembered us from lunch and came out to introduce himself and thank us for our patronage, which is a fantastic happening for any foodist and DDD fan.

NOT TO BE MISSED!!!

Best Thai food I have had in Idaho. After seeing several reviews in Boise Weekly I decided that Thai Basil was on my must try list. I am so glad I did. The duck curry was phenomenal and I find myself thinking of it daily. I also had a noodle dish, soup (provided free with the meal) and spring rolls. The spring roll sauce was different than most Thai restaurants, but so delicious. I liked their twist on the traditional Thai peanut sauce. The server was kind and prompt. I will definitely go back.
We enjoyed a great meal here tonight.  My wife got the pineapple fried rice and I got the duck curry.  Both were 10/10.  We will definitely be going back.

Went to see Hunger Games: Catching Fire for the premiere, and took advantage of the VIP level. Really love the feature of pre-selecting seats, and also the in-theater dining for the VIP level. Extremely impressed with the visual and sound quality of the movie, the seating was clean and comfortable, and the entire ambience was just top notch. 

Props to John, the restaurant/VIP level manager, who took the time to recommend dishes to us and wait on us personally, and then sought us out after the show to get our opinions. Service staff was excellent the whole time.

Much better than spending $10 to go to a regular theater, sit in dirty uncomfortable chairs with sticky stuff on the bottom of your shoes, and don't get half the quality of this experience. Only a few bucks more, well worth it!  We will be back often!

Tried this place because it was close & wanted sandwiches. There was only one person working when we went in last night. Felt bad for her because it was almost 8pm and several people followed in behind us. She was super nice & helpful guiding us since it was our first time in. There were 3 of us & we all ordered steak sandwiches.  Smelled great when she was making them, however we didn't watch her make them. We got them home & pulled them out of the bag. The wrappers were soaked in grease, Yuck!! We were further disappointed when we opened them & saw they were made with Steak'Ums!!! Are you kidding me??!!! (I'm 1/2 Italian, Steak'Ums are NOT an Italian thing). Also, even though they were dripping grease from the "meat", the rolls were super dry inside & we ended up having to add our own mayo. They were supposed to come with creamy Italian sauce on them but there was none or very little. Anyway, the price was reasonable but now we know why. We will not be going there again.
Nice pool.  Water is WARM.  L shaped pool.  Low diving board and high diving board.  Grass to dry off on.  Friendly staff.  Never too crowded.

Had our company Christmas Party here.  Everyone had a good time and enjoyed the food.  Service was good and the chef's were fun at all the tables.

We plan on returning!

What a fun place!  We came in for dinner on a Friday and it wasn't difficult to get in.  We did make reservations but it didn't appear to be needed.

The set-up is almost like three different restaurants.  There is the a section for teppanyaki, a sushi bar, and other tables to order from a regular menu.  There is also a small bar near the entrance.

We settled into the teppanyaki section.  The chefs were amusing and quite skilled.  Don't wear your best shirt there if you decide to go for the sake or catch a vegetable in your mouth.  It can get a little messy.  In our party, we ordered sushi rolls, steaks, chicken, seafood, and dessert.  All was very good.  The steaks were very tender and flavorful.  The seafood was fresh and done to perfection.  The desserts are very good.  Tea flavored tiramisu may sound risky, but it is light and flavorful.

Suggestions for a better experience:
The seats at the bar are really close together.  On slower evenings, take a chair out and leave the patrons a little elbow room.
Getting drinks was very slow.  I ordered a drink and it took 20 minutes to get it.
When singing the birthday song, pick up the tempo!  It sounded like a dirge.

All in all, a very positive experience.  We'll go back again.

This place is THE BEST! Definitely the best pizza I've ever had, and the mozzarella sticks literally blew my mind. 

The atmosphere is warm, inviting, but super clean and the bathroom was amazing (that's always a good indicator of how clean they keep the back) 

There was not one thing I would complain about m, not one. I highly recommend everyone trying this place!

I purchased a complete bedroom set, mattress and sofa about two months ago at Ashley. After we picked out what we wanted it took over 2 hours to get us checked out. They had just opened so we were patient and didn't complain at all.
We found out once we received our statements that they open up two lines of credit, one in my name and one in my husbands and my name. Again that was an easy phone call to close the line. 
The part in this experience that has me fuming is how long it has taken to get all of our furniture. Two months later we have still not received our bed frame. The first time arrived one of the bed posts was completely cracked through. We had to call to even get it rescheduled and it has since been canceled twice. The reason we were given was it wasn't scheduled properly by the supervisor who placed the order to begin with. I have spent my entire day off today waiting for this frame and it is now 5:30 and it is still " on its way". I actually love the furniture otherwise it would be returned by now. I will never recommend this business. 

- it has been 11 days since I responded to the message below and have not heard anything from the company.
For a soup, salad, and sandwich place Zupas is top notch! They have super fresh ingredients and tons of options. One of our favorite places for a quick bite!

I love loooooooove this place. I cannot go one week without the carnitas sandwich and the maui tropical salad. I do not know why people complain about portions being small, I think they are pretty big and I always leave the place super full))) but healthy full.

Before moving to Idaho, I investigated the food scene in the Boise area and discovered a rich Basque culture. We asked our Basque Pastor (in Idaho City) for a recommendation and his eyes danced as he suggested this restaurant. In his opinion, Epi's is by far the BEST in Idaho!

He advised us that reservations are recommended as the restaurant is located in a quaint bungalow home on Main Street and seating is limited. I called a day in advance and was given the cell phone number of the sweet gal who takes reservations. She was more than accommodating!

The homemade soups were a grand way to start the meal! We seriously could have had seconds!

In the category of appetizers, we adventurously ordered Tongue. It was breaded and incredibly tender! I will be back for more.

Other favorites...
* Calamari --  It was delicious and soft to the teeth.
* Ham Croquetas -- a tapa regularly served across Spain. It offered deep-fried-goodness oozing with béchamel!
* Meatballs served in a seasoned tomato sauce! A winner!

My mother and I were thrilled when that evening's special was the Copper River Sockeye Salmon which is only available for a small season during the year. It was delectably prepared with an incredibly creamy sauce containing small shrimp! We just about licked our plates!

My husband gave 2 thumbs up on the 14 oz. Ribeye Steak! And, although we were stuffed, we did manage to try one of their amazing desserts!

This is one of the best restaurants in town!   The food is great and the service is awesome.   If you have a special occasion, this is the place to go.  You will need reservations as the place is small and very busy.  Family owned and operated and you can tell.   You will not go wrong of you eat here...it is the best!

My oldest son and I have been to Café Zupas twice now.  Once we chose to dine-in and the second we took to-go.  We have enjoyed the food.  The staff has been very friendly and helpful; though I do get a vibe they are trying to move us along, quickly.  During busy times the seating can get cramped.  The only negative thing that has happened was my soup was forgotten on the to-go order.  I think the lady at the soup station got distracted and I forgot to check my order before we paid.  Luckily, my soup didn't even make it on the order, so we weren't charged.  Everyone makes mistakes.  I just recommend paying attention to them putting your order together and checking it before leaving, if you get to-go.  If you dine-in, it is easy enough to go back to the counter for a missed item.  All in all, we have enjoyed our couple visits and plan to go back.  This place is worth trying.
Best Sushi in town!!  MyKayla our waitress was fantastic on guiding us thru the menu. Presentation on our plates was very professionally done!  Can't wait to go again!

Laticia is simply the best. She was prompt in showing up to do makeup AND hair prior to my maternity photo shoot. She nailed both, hands down. I felt beautiful, stunning, "glow-y" because of this gal. She is beyond friendly, I felt as if I had known her for YEARS. She accompanied us to my photo shoot and touched lips & hair up as we went, even helped with wardrobe at times ... my photographer adored her, too. I'll be so sad to see you leave CA, Laticia. I can only hope our paths cross again in the future! North Carolina is lucky to have you.
Very clean place. Well organized and has good movie options for any age. I would recommend to everyone that wants to see a new movie.
Decent steak.  Love the shrimp.  Cheese toast is good.  The managers at this Sizzler run a tight ship and service is always good.

Give me some Zupas and give it to me now! When ever I'm traveling and come across a Zupas restaurant, I make a detour and pull in here!!
This one  is in a great area. It is located next to many other restaurants so if you're with a large group of people,  you can split up and enjoy all your favorites. 
I always get the chicken pesto Panini along with the "nuts about berry" salad. 
This time I ventured out and also got a bowl of lobster bisque soup, which was very delicious. The complementary slice of French bread topped off the soup, but the strawberry dipped in chocolate is the "cherry on top". 
Don't forget to order a dessert. My favorite is the Million Dollar Bar....oh baby! I'm ready for another detour ;)

We have come here a lot, but unfortunately the service tonight was terrible. Every other time the service was great.  Our glasses never got refilled, we had to ask twice for a bone plate and the brownie sundae had no nuts even though I specifically asked.

Visiting family in Idaho mid-April and decided to try this place.  I wasn't pleased with what I ordered. . . . .a Cuban Grilled Pork which had Butter Pickles (which are sweet).  A true Cuban pork sandwich is  "Dill pickles, roast pork, ham, and Swiss cheese are cold, added in layers and thinly sliced".  This was disappointing.  In addition to that, the young girl taking our order was not helpful.   I didn't want a huge salad and she didn't say we could order a half salad.  I felt it was very pricey especially since you stand in line to order and no table service.  I would never go there again.

As a frequent traveler for work, I like to eat at independent restaurants, not chains. I usually ask a local and then verify via Yelp or another app. This is exactly what happened yesterday. I asked and then verified. And after seeing the ratings, I knew I had made the right choice. 

I read a few reviews and of course looked at the overall rating. I am guessing most of the comments were food related. My dinner was excellent... I had the special... grilled scallops with sun dried tomatoes... cream of mushroom soup and Basque Red Bean soup...again, both excellent. 

What I will remember, however, and what I hope comes through in my comments is the genuine warmth and hospitality from Chris, the owner. I have never felt more welcomed at any restaurant in my life! It is really hard to explain via a phone review. 

I called at 5:05 and asked if I needed a reservation for one. Chris said that if I could get there in (10) minutes, she could accommodate. I walked in and she immediately knew it was me (only single patron) and welcomed me with a smile and warm handshake. 

Chris checked on me 2-3 times during my meal, but the reason I am writing this review... as I am leaving.. she comes over with a warm smile and asks for a hug. And of course, I opened my arms and hugged her. I told her I would be back next month and she asked me to call her. 

I would go back to eat a PBJ sandwich. It is amazing and so reassuring to have the owner of restaurant care so much about a patron. I am guessing I am not the first person to feel this way and I know I will not be the last.

Went in a little after three o'clock and ordered the number 1 combo, a single with cheese, fries, and a drink. The sandwich bun seemed different, bigger and doughier then the last time I ate there. It was also stale, hard to the touch and crunchy on the outside. The meat on the sandwich was dry and cold. The fries were natural cut with skin on, the way I like them but these were served oily and limp with last bit of heat dissipating in the time it took to get them to my table.

I realize that my visit wasn't in prime time but a restaurant has to put out 100% quality at all times. This visit just left me feeling like they weren't cooking for me but just passing off some old food that had been around far to long.

Even if the food was served hot and fresh the new buns really suck.

We ate here a couple of nights ago. It was a little off putting how slow the restaurant was during prime dinner hours because this gave the wait staff (and the manager) nothing else to do but stare at us the whole time while we were trying to have a nice date. The bartenders butt cheeks were also hanging out of her dress the entire time. It was completely inappropriate. The food was mediocre. The sushi rice was old. Not what we expected.
I will say, we were pleasantly surprised by happy hour prices on alcohol.

While watching James Bond movie Spector that movie had a problem and was down for 15 minutes afterwards trying to get a refund for another ticket for another movie the manager refused to give refunds to 30 people they were standing there. Never shopping there again never doing business beware. Manager got an attitude.

Ruined the movie for me. Didn't even start where it left off. Bad business

Shucks!
Daawgonnit!
This pisses me off 
The baby back ribs here are almost as good as I can make (spending roughly 5 hours, singeing arm and facial hair, and greasing loading the barbecue grill so that it could qualify as a hazardous waste) at home.  
Being from Alabama I qualify as an expert in ribbage.  It's a birth right
These ribs are a solid A-.  
Better than anywhere outside of Dixie
Flavorless food + dirty bathroom and table  + rude waitress = ZERO STARS!!!! They should be closed!! Never again!!!

Pack yer pistols, bitches.... we're in Idaho.  Where fishing and hunting isn't just something to do in the mall.

It's all about the great outdoors and this store has all of your needs.

When you first walk in, you will be sucked into all of the photos of recent 'kills' and 'catches'.  They even have a board on all of the conditions in the popular spots.  I know, my lingo isn't the greatest.  

This store is huge.... they carry EVERYTHING and the the staff is super helpful and friendly.
Good new place. Sat in the Bar and was greeted and served by the owner "Ryan" from Brooklyn. Food was great and service was awesome. Great happy hour menu. Will definitely be back.

We called ahead so our would be ready on our way home.  When I grabbed the pizza they had made it wrong and had to re-do it.  Not a great thing when you have a tired baby.  Anyway, they did give us some free drinks and bread sticks.  Pizza was average at best for the price.
Reasonably priced and the bagels and cream cheese were fresh and delicious. We were just passing through but we visit the area often and will be back!
Try the honeystung chicken sandwich! Best of the best, hands down!
I've been here a few times.  The food is always good and fresh.  My only complaint is that often they're out of different ingredients.

Perched by the front door is a smoker emitting the wonderful aroma of rosemary and chicken. This was tonight's special, half a smoked chicken on a bed of garlic mashed potatoes smothered with rosemary dripping aus jus.  Party of seven, three had the special, two the shrimp fettuccine, one the double cut roasted pork hop, and the final young person feasted on in-house made chicken nuggets. All were very satisfied. A cozy downtown eatery with comfort food plus. Not just filling, but well prepared. My smoked chicken was crispy, yet tastefully juicy with full flavors. A+!

I heard about this Vet through a friend, who takes her dog to Dr. Mills.  I had tried a few places in the Eagle area, but never found the exact right fit. Well, we have finally hit pay dirt!

We found the Settlers Park hospital to be super clean and modern.  Dr. Mills is a wonderful Veterinarian, up on all the latest, and most of all, very kind and compassionate.  You can tell by how he interacts with our 2 dogs, that he truly has a heart for what he does and for the animals he treats

The front desk staff is not very warm & fuzzy, but you certainly can't fault him for that.  I also found their prices to be less expensive than the ones in Eagle and very competitive with others throughout the valley.

Dr. Mills has performed surgery on both of our dogs, with good results and no complications.  Plus he actually calls you back when you call, and personally phones you post-op to inform you about how everything went.

He is the "best kept secret" in the treasure valley as far as  Veterinarians go, and I highly recommend him!

New home owner. Looking for furniture to fill up the place so I headed in to the local Ashly furniture to check them out. 

I saw a coffee table set I liked online and wanted to ask a few questions about it. Unfortunately, it was not sampled on the sales floor. As we looked at the photo on line together, the salesman was distracted looking at another couple checking out at a bedroom set. He was constantly looking over his shoulder fumbling with the computer distracted by them making excuses. Bigger fish I guess. I have a career in sales....this was really rude. 
Left the store, decided to call and they said they would call me back. After almost an hour I called again. Apparently they were just swarmed with people early on a Wednesday morning?
Doubtful. 

I think I should take my business elsewhere. After all, I have a lot to purchase. Seems like everything is a hassle here.
Great pizza, the appetizer we got were the garlic twists. Good service and very clean and comfortable atmosphere.
I'm from Hawaii and I eat a lot of fish. Epi's served me the best Butter Fish I have ever had. They called it by a different name but it was Butter Fish. The chef knows what he's doing. Aloha.

Have been following on Facebook so wanted to check it out.  We went on a Saturday around 1:30 - restaurant had there were about 4 tables full so we sat at the bar. 

They have all local beers and wines which I like. 5.50 for a pint is a little high in my opinion when you pay 5 for them at the breweries.

I ordered the tomato bisque soup and it was good. We ordered the Pig Destroyer to share - they are 12" pizzas. It was really tasty but nothing special. 

The service was good but I'm assuming it was the owner walking behind the bar and helping out but only spoke to us once asking how everything was. When you're new in town you need to be talking way more than that to your patrons.

pretty good place if you're craving Thai food, fast and friendly service, not too expensive, portions are a pretty nice size, cashew chicken and curry are good, black pepper prawns were a little salty, and if you really like spicy food you will enjoy this place

This place is fantastic. Before trying this place, I never, ever went to Meridian, but this place comes up trumps so I go whenever I can. 

The service is excellent. They manage to pull of a unique mix of delectable food and warm welcome without tarnishing either or coming off cheesy. 

Everything is delicious. I would suggest ordering one special and sharing it with someone, then ordering one more set of sides. You'll be plenty full. 

I can't recommend any one dish because I have had something different each time and it has never, ever disappointed.

Small restaurant hidden between shops. We had the fish pankora in spicy batter, the batter wasn't as spicy as expected, the spicy sauce on the side helped a little. Most fish bites  tasted fresh but one had a not so fresh smell to it. The Seekh Kebab was excellent and good spiced, we tried the 3/5 called Boise Hot. Our 2nd dish was Palak Paneer and was also excellent. I'll come back and try some more Seafood Entrees and see if it gets better. They got the Kingfisher lager and Taj Mahal beers in bottles, I wish they had the whole selections of Kingfisher beers.

Searching for a good restaurant in the Boise area, we noticed the five stars for Epi's and couldn't resist. It was everything the reviews promised and more. Excellent food and service, and they treated us like family. Best table in the house (on the porch) and we especially loved the Basque music!

I am sooo over the moon with this place!! Adorable, cozy, homey, relaxing. The owners and staff are exceptional! When you walk in you feel at home and as if you're part of the family. The food is absolutely amazing! Everything we ordered was phenomenal, flavor, temperature, portions were great! Make sure you have reservations as it is always packed! We will absolutely be back and recommend this place to all our friends and family!

I give 5 stars for everything except the front desk employee Whitney.  Our room was so clean, we received exceptional service from all staff until this young lady decided to approach our group of friends sitting in the lobby..... 

We had just finished a long day of 3 basketball games with our sweet boys and came back to swim but the pool was closed for maintenance.  The boys were enjoying each other's company and we were eating and chatting in the lobby.  Whitney approached our group and told us that we cannot leave trash in the lobby.......we had just started eating and had no plans of moving anytime soon.  We are mature adults and had no plans to leave a mess when we were finished.  Shortly after we were approached by Whitney again complaining that 2 boys in our group were running around and needed to stop or she would call her manager.  She rolled her eyes when we asked her if the boys were causing problems and walked away, threatening that she had them on camera.  We asked the boys to stay by us and to stop running around.  

We then decided to take the boys to another hotel to swim since Whitney stated that the maintenance worker was "too busy cleaning up messes to clean the pool".  

Before leaving me and 2 other moms approached Whitney at the front desk to ask for the managers name.  She said "I cannot give out Kelly's personal phone number" when we never asked for it, we just wanted a name.  She continuously rolled her eyes at us when we asked her why she couldn't just speak to us like adults.  She then walked into the back room while saying "I am being bullied and won't take it any longer".  I am a business owner and would NEVER support this behavior from an employee.  I also manage employees for another company and would never support this type of behavior.  We had a doctor and many very professional mothers in our group.  We will never stay here again for future tournaments and we will be letting  all Utah coaches know not to stay in this hotel. 

There were at least 10 teams staying in this hotel for the tournament and we saw many boys running around playing and feel very upset that we were singled out.  

Also,  when we arrived back from our swimming trip to another hotel the pool had been re opened....... she had to know that they were going to be opening it and just decided not to tell us this information. Very misleading!

The Courtyard in Boise is a great clean, well maintained hotel. The staff is friendly, attentive and helpful, also the breakfast is pretty good too. They offer a solid array of fruits, cereals but best of all they have a custom made egg or waffle station where you can have eggs and wafles done your way. 

I have stayed here for several weeks and each time the rooms were clean, the staff friendly and helpful. Next time I need to come to Boise, I am def. staying here. The only draw back is that it is about 15 min from downtown boise so if you have work in Boise this is a little far, but if you were working in Meridian, then this hotel is a must stay. 

Cheers mates and *ding *ding  lets hope this is no Hotel California.

I ordered two Spyderco Byrd series knives online Monday afternoon and received them by Friday, all the way in Hawaii! They had the best price online and I was even surprised by a free shipping promo that was automatically added for my order.

Awesome service, will definitely be buying from them again!

Love this place!  I missed the Culver's we had in Texas since moving to Idaho, and was thrilled they opened up a new one here. Food is hot, always good quality and with food items that you don't get at most chains. If you haven't given them a try, you should!

Artisan pizza personal size that easily feeds two with an appetizer. For apps I recommend both the brussels sprouts which sounds crazy I know but they are awesome truly out of this world, preparation and presentation both on point, well done. Also loved the in-house made cheese sticks, didn't know what to expect but, are very large in size, And frankly put most cheese sticks to shame.

Chris and the whole staff are amazing!  For years I have been meaning to partake in the awesome food I've heard raving reviews around the valley about and finally was able. Great food, awesome atmosphere and great all around!

We finally decided to give Rick's a try. We started off dinner with the rock shrimp appetizer. The batter is something like a tempura, very light, and is served with a homemade garlic chile dipping sauce and a cool celery slaw. All three elements worked well together and the dish was well portioned for two. 

I opted for the double cut pork chop while my wife went for the salmon in potato. Each were cooked perfectly - flavorful and juicy. The salmon dish was an interesting combination of textures with the crispy potato and tender fish. Clearly a lot of thought went into preparing this dish. The pork chop was cooked thoroughly  despite being nearly two inches thick. 

The service was extremely attentive and considerate. Additionally, the ambiance is unique and interesting. Looking over the press clippings provided for some great conversation. Overall a great value when price is factored in with service, food quality, and ambiance.

Horrible horrible horrible!!! Placed an order online and confirmed delivery ... waited a week for the delivery.... then took the day off work waiting. The delivery window was 12-3 finally called in at 5 and was told that my delivery was canceled and that they saw a note saying it was explained to me. No one called and nothing was done. We had out of town guests expected for today that now have to stay in a hotel and we don't even know when the delivery will be expected because the customer service couldn't help at all. What a terrible company. Much better customer service with mor or rcwilley. Customer service said that they can't refund the delivery fee or give us an updated delivery date.
100% would choose this place for my soup and salad cravings over panera or corner bakery (and I love both!). The pricing, portion sizes and selection is way better! Happy I found this place!

Came here for the first time for our 20th wedding anniversary. Some of the best food and customer service we've ever received. They make you feel like family. Try the tongue and the bread pudding. You won't be sorry!!!!

5 stars. The prime rib, rib-eye and mopped delmonico steak were delicious and grilled to perfection. The baked potatoe skins were awesome and the service staff friendly and cheerful. You owe it to yourself to give this place your attention for fine food in a friendly atmosphere.

Thai Basil is arguably the best Thai Restaurant in town.  The owners/chefs know exactly what they are doing- Very authentic Thai flavors  They even let me sample some off-menu items that blew me away.  

My favorite dish is the drunken noodles.  If you want to go big, like I do, order with added egg, extra noodles, and duck for the meat selection.  Of course, order with high spice.  Be prepared to be stuffed and happy.  Nothing tops that dish.

A+++

Tuesday date night xxxx
FANTASTIC food... husband and I shared the goat cheese gnocchi, brussel sprouts, and a cheese plate. 
Great service...our waiter was very knowleadgable, polite, and attentive
DELICIOUS wine!! Loved all the selection and the fabulous idea of the individual pours!
Can't wait to come back!!!!

Can be a hassle to get to if coming from the south, and it's connected to the gas station, so that's odd. No play-place, no "McCafe" area, but a solid McD's to have lunch at.

Staff is nice and friendly, and the food's fine during he rush...nice and fresh.

The food is great here, but the service is horrible. I have been in 4 or 5 times and have never been disappointed with the food (Pad See Eew and the Purple Mango Sticky rice are to die for).

The servers are inattentive and I've watched the bus boy sit behind the host podium with the hostess while my table and surrounding tables were being stacked with finished dishes or empty drink cups. I only saw my server when she took our order and when she dropped off the check. It wasn't until she gave us the check that I was able to order dessert or ask for a water refill. 

This place is best to get takeout. Not anywhere I would bring someone I'm trying to impress (there is an algae stained fish tank as soon as you walk in the door), but I most certainly would recommend the food.

This review is for Meridian location only. It is new, big and clean. Love this place. So much fun for everyone! We have been here twice and loved it each time. My 3 year old and 17 month old had a lot of fun! Totally worth the $$ for this age group because is is unlimited play. For older kids it seems like it is quite expensive as they charge by the hour. Very relaxed environment and friendly staff. Thank you for the very comfy couches!
Don't forget to bring socks, otherwise you'll have to buy them.

Nice and quiet.  Lots of pizza variations to choose from with appetizers, wine, and beer.  Love the patio.  This place has a comfortable atmosphere that adds to a family out for the evening or a group of friends.

The food at Epi's was great. The small menu provided plenty of delicious options to choose from. Everything was overshadowed, however, by the wonderfully sweet owner. You could tell she absolutely loves what she does.

The ham croquetas were silky smooth with a crisp outer covering. I would go back just for them. The shrimp was cooked perfectly without being either underdone or overly cooked and chewy. They were crisp and well accompanied by a cream sauce.

In town for work and checked this place out after seeing it on Triple D. I wasn't disappointed. After a brief wait, which they almost over apologized for, I was seated. 

Being original (sarcasm) I ordered the salmon in potato dish as featured on the show. Perfectly cooked salmon, encrusted with crisp hash browns, sitting on a small bed of mashed potatoes with a lemon type of cream sauce. Excellent dish fo sho. I would have liked a little stronger lemon flavor in the sauce but that's just a personal preference. 

Great food and very friendly service. Hopefully I'll have enough time to make one more trip here prior to leaving.

I've been here a few times. Used the drive thru for take home and had no problems. Other times I've gone inside to order and enjoy my chicken at a table with again no problems.  Love the spicy chicken. So much better than the other guy in a white suit. Today the chicken was fresh out of the fryer. It was so good I'm going to get another 2 piece to take home. 
Service has always been good. Friendly staff and clean tables. What more could you want??? Ok maybe closer to home but that's about all I could think of. Enjoy!

Probably one of the worst shopping experiences of my life. Some very sweet young lady salesperson met me at the door and whispered to me that she had to Shadow me around the store if she did not her boss would assign someone else to do it I smiled and said fine as I proceeded to wander through the store looking and thinking about what items I wanted to purchase every time I turned around this lady trying her best to do her job and be helpful was right there I felt like I just walked onto the car lot of a used car dealership I totally feels that the customer service sales person was doing exactly what was asked of her however I think their management needs to have his young 20-something year-old inexperienced novice head examined because nobody likes to be stopped while they're shopping it's not like I was going to stick a bit under my shirt it was unnerving it was uncomfortable and I will not be back if they have something I want I will shop online but I will not walk back in the store where I'm going to be stocked like a shoplifter it was an annoying degrading unnerving experience and it showed the extreme lack of training education on sales procedure by the young inexperienced novice manager who should be out bagging groceries at Walmart.

Amazing customer service, and the food...wow the food is amazing! Try the lamb dish! It was a pleasure to get in touch with my Basque roots, thanks to my sister who took me here for my birthday last year. Highly recommended and where something nice (-;

I forgot to post this a while back... I took my cat here the first time because she had an open abscess in her mouth that I hadn't seen and was starting to get infected. So I called the next morning and I asked if I could drop her off and leave her with them to look at her whenever they could. And they did and I really appreciated it. I know she was probably not very cooperative because if I do anything to her she urinates on me but they were still nice even when I picked her up. I also got my little Chihuahua spayed here and she did great and she healed up nicely. I'm very happy with my experiences here.

There were several good things about this place, but there was also room for improvement. 

The sign was really small out front so we had a hard time finding the restaurant, but were pleasantly surprised when we walked and saw how clean and well decorated the space was.

The customer service was great. There was only one girl working both the bar and the floor, and she was really attentive and kind. 

Overall, the food was pretty good, my boyfriend said his "Pie-Daho" pizza was average, but I like my "Jungle" Pie and we both loved the mozzarella sticks. The beer was over priced (I'm assuming they're not buying wholesale since it is a smaller restaurant), I've never paid $5 for a can of beer that I had to open myself. I asked for chicken on my pizza but didn't get, but I didn't realize that I had still been charged for it until after my boyfriend had paid. 

The ambience on the other hand... it felt dead in there. Even with music in the background and several other tables there, the restaurant was weirdly quiet. Besides my boyfriend and I, there wasn't much chatter/laughter and things just felt dead. 

Would go back to give it another go, but, room for improvement.

Cameron and his team are amazing! From requesting the quote till the end of the move communication was impeccable! 
Showed up on time and finished early ! Left everything perfect and just how I wanted it! I would highly recommend...thank guys!

Some of the most flavorful food I've ever eaten.  The lunch buffet is a bit bland to suit the taste of everyone I guess so always order from the menu and you'll leave with a huge smile on your face.  Service is fine as well.

Keeping in mind that they haven't been open a week yet, we went in and even though the parking lot looked full there were still places to sit. Our order was correct and the food was good. The kids meals come with a coupon for a free scoop of custard which was a nice perk. The Reuben was good. The place was a little chaotic but what do you expect for a new business?  The staff was friendly and our food came out fairly quickly and it was still hot. It's a nice change from the same old go to places. The prices were reasonable as well. We'll be going back I'm sure.

This place never disappoints unless you're some sort of snob or something!  The owners are very nice and welcoming and the food is always great. Try anything on the menu from the meatloaf to salmon to the ribeye...it's all very tasty. And make sure to try the corn mash - it's amazing.

Overall the atmosphere was great, the service was very accommodating, prices were good, and most importantly the food was delicious. Some dishes, like the sweet and sour chicken, while really good, was more like a Chinese dish than Thai but the yellow curry and pad Thai were good Thai dishes. We will go back again for more food in the future. The food by itself only warranted 4/5 but the service really put this place at 5/5.

THE SERVICE HERE IS ATROCIOUS!!!

There was a group of us that came here for my boyfriends birthday. To start, we didn't get our drinks until the food we ordered from the hibachi was done being cooked for the entire table. Next, my boyfriend and I ordered the shrimp and scallops to share along with fried rice and grilled veggies, the portions were pathetic... after that we ordered three sushi rolls to share with gluten free soy sauce. Both my boyfriend and I eat gluten free and specifically ordered rolls from the "raw" selection... NO tempura was listed in the rolls we ordered. We didn't get the soy sauce for our sushi until we were leaving and didn't receive our rolls until our friends were nearly done eating. When we finally got our rolls, one of them wasn't even the one we ordered and the other two were covered and stuffed with tempura. When the waiter finally came back to check on us, we explained the situation with the rolls and asked if we could have them remade to the three we actually ordered without all the tempura. We didn't get our rolls until everyone had paid and were waiting to leave. The amount of time we waited for our waiter to get back to us each time was appalling. We asked to talk to the manager and again.... we were left waiting for the waiter to get back to us. The manager never came. We left with our rolls to go. The following day we opened our bag to get our rolls and to our dismay.... we had the SAME rolls they originally made!!! One completely wrong, and the other two still covered in tempura. We were duped! We called the restaurant to talk to the manager who skipped out on us the night before and once again the manager wouldn't speak with us and never called us back. 

I WILL NEVER EVER GO BACK HERE.

Such a great time for the whole family! Come early, grab some grub and beers and find a great seat. If you're lucky it's a night when they give rides around the track.. lots of fun big huge line so be prepared. 
I think it's $11/adult and under 6 is free, can't beat the price to fun ratio here guys!

The sushi was very fresh and flavorful. I asked for mine to be without rice and they offered me a soy paper option for my cali roll which turned out delicious. The service was good and the atmosphere was great, modern and clean. We will be returning when we crave good sushi and hibachi.

We've had better versions of everything we ordered,  elsewhere. Our sushi and teriyaki were certainly adequate, but (based on other reviews) we'd hoped for better. Friday night service kept our server from checking in on our needs as often as hoped. For those who are gluten free, there is no gluten free menu and staff was not knowledgeable enough to make any recommendations. A manager pointed me to three sushi roll options. Two arrived as expected. The lollipop roll I was assured was gluten free arrived with imitation crab versus crab meat (as listed on the menu). Based on tonight's experience, we have no plans to return.

Well, I have lost 60 lbs and now fit comfortably in the Cinema seats.  Whenever anyone comes from out of town we always take them to the Cinema.  Watching the water light show after the movie is a romantic perk that can't be understated.  I haven't noticed any speaker problems, so they must have tweaked them to be just right.  I usually order the tickets about a week in advance to get seats in my favorite spot (center, back row).  I also agree that a sign from the sidewalk would be helpful for first timers trying to find the theatre on a crowded night.

The staff here are always super nice and ready to help. And the food is always awesome too! Today there was a slight issue with my order but the manager was great about it and even comped my meal. Seriously these guys are great if you want good food, great friendly staff and a nice atmosphere this is the place(:

Fast food?  I don't think so!  After waiting more than 20 minutes in line after ordering only 2 medium diet cokes, we waited another nearly 4 minutes to receive our change and were handed our drinks.  Don't think we'll be revisiting!

We're visiting from California and this place was recommended to us by a friend. I had the 1/2 slab beef ribs and the portions were so large I couldn't finish it. As a side I ordered the sweet potatoes with pecan. They were amazing. Outstanding food.

These guys are great. The pick up guy is always nice and polite. I usually run him a water and red bull
Ive forgot to take my can out on Several occasions and they are always willing to come do a pick up. 

Thanks

While visiting Idaho, my boyfriend and I (and his family) stopped by Ricks. We came from the recommendation of Guy Fieri and Diners, Drive-ins and Dives.

We were here on a Friday evening. It was very busy especially with a few big parties around. I advise to make reservations. Since our group was not in a hurry we waited by the bar and ordered drinks. After waiting half an hour or so we were finally able to get a table. I guess with our group being patient we were serviced two orders of Rock Shrimp upon receiving a table.

The Rock Shrimp was amazing. Loved the flavor of the chile garlic sauce. My boyfriend who is not a fan of shrimp could not stop himself from eating it. We ordered the Press Room Burger and Sun Valley Club. We split our entrees and both were very good. The Sun Valley Club was light and crispy. The club was perfect. I order it with the House Salad with Ranch Dressing which was very good. The Press Room Burger was very flavorful and mouthwatering. It was hands down the best burger I've ever had. My boyfriend could not stop talking about it.

Everything with Rick's was great. The service was good and the staff was very helpful. The food was amazing. If my boyfriend and I are in the area we will stop by again, no doubt about it.

After living in the Boise area for twelve years we decided it was finally time to really experience some Basque cooking.   We definitely came to the right place!   Opening the door to this quaint bungalow we saw filled tables of patrons---and this was on a Wednesday evening!   There was no obvious reception desk, but Chris immediately saw us and greeted us warmly.  I had spoken to her a few days before when she called to confirm our reservation.  She gave us a short history of her family and grandmother Epi and was helpful in describing the many dishes to us.

We all elected to order from the lighter side of the menu.  All dishes are accompanied by a soup and salad course as well as some freshly baked baguettes.  I chose a pork chop with pimientos as my main course.  My husband opted for baked cod, and our son ordered grilled cod. The two  soup choices were creamed shrimp with rice and red bean soup.  Both my husband and I had the cream soup which was very flavorful with a little heat to it!

My pork chop was very tasty---marinated in a wine vinegar and char grilled.   I had a sample of Baked cod and vowed that I'd order that the next time----it was delicious with a lemon cream sauce.  I could've eaten that with a spoon it was so good! The grilled cod  was enjoyed as well.   All the dishes had a side order of rice.    Fresh hand cut fries were  served complimentary as an extra side for the table.  We consumed those quickly!

Dessert was shared.   An order of flan and the famous Basque cake.  Both were delicious and well prepared.   We ordered coffee which was a nice robust brew!  

Reservations are strongly recommended for this little restaurant.  There is only one large L-shaped room which seats approximately 50-60 people.  The staff here is very efficient, helpful, friendly, and knowledgeable about the food.   Looking around the restaurant it was obvious that many of the guests are frequent  diners!  There was much conversation and laughter---a sign that people were truly happy in this intimate space!

Been there twice and each time the food and service is impeccable! Met the owner the second time who was so warm and sweet. She knew based on our reservation it was my birthday we were celebrating and she packed me a dessert of my choice on the house and put a sweet bday wish message inside the take home container.  The staff there worked hard for years to establish and share this wonderful basque culinary experience and you can tell they really care about their service to patrons and quality of food. Try the halibut it's a must! Their house chardonnay La Terre was really good too. Calamari is a light perfectly battered seasoned app that melts in your mouth. Will return for sure.
Been here about 7-8 times while I lived in Idaho.  Not one time was I not impressed.  Their Ribs and their Prime Rib were nothing short of amazing.
Great food great service as always. Burnt ends and chicken were great. The spinach dip is the best in the valley.

As far as BBQ goes, Goodwood is ok.  Their BBQ was ...well BBQ done right but that's about it...there was nothing special about it.  A little on the high end for me too. I wouldn't ever turn them down but I think there is better BBQ around

Went last night with a party of 3 adults and 4 kids...menu was traditional sports bar food. The burger was good, beer was cold and a good atmosphere. I've never heard of this chain before, but it looks like there are a ton of them and I had a good experience there ahead of their grand opening which is at some point in the future.

Overall a great time. I started with a blue cheese salad that was very flavorful with fresh greens. The Chicken Parmesan was the main course and it was one of the best I've ever had. Lots of meat and not overrun with batter. Many people like there Parmesan really thin with lots of batter but than whats the point of the chicken? The sauce on the mash potatoes was tangy and unique over the top of more delicious veggies. I paired the dish with a Hefe  by Magma that was fresh and light, perfect for summer and served in a old wine bottle that had cleverly been cut into a pint glass (other micro brews available). The desert however wasn't what I wanted. Flaming tiramisu, the tiramisu itself was good but the sauce had a distinctive rubbing alcohol taste even after the flame burned itself out. I will return to Ricks Press Room and try one of their delicious burgers that walked past me a few times during my meal.
I was very pleasantly surprised.  Great food and a warm and friendly and talented staff!

Hub came here for allergy issues he's had all his life. When he asked for the same Rx, that was effective in the past, he was ignored and given a new medication.  He expressed concern to the PA about using an unfamiliar Rx, but it didn't matter.  After taking the Rx as prescribed he had a reaction to it.  Called the office and mentioned his adverse reaction and was told that the PA who prescribed it was not in the office and the PA on duty wanted him to wait two days before they would do anything....the guy didn't even have the decency to speak with him directly. After lengthy conversations, with two office staff, he gave up and told them that he would never return to their office. The woman's response? "Do you want to speak with my manager?"  Really?  No concern that he had a reaction from the drug.  Not even sure if a doctor is on duty at this site....they never offered to confer with one. This is the sad reality of Western medicine in the U.S. and this company is no different.  I made an appointment for my hub with my naturopath because they are humane and truly interested in helping you maintain your health.
We have eaten here 3 times now since they opened. Their food and service is fantastic. We especially like talking with Randy.

Let me be real for a second. The employees at this store are incredible. Cecilia and my boy Will Nelson have helped me out tremendously today. I had a big problem and they gave all of their effort to help me understand and address the situation. Both demonstrated outstanding professionalism and clear depth of knowledge. My problem had to be sent through corporate to see if I should be compensated, and Will and Cecilia were both in my corner defending me and helping me get the best customer service experience possible. Truly exceptional people, it is now obvious why Sprint excels in great customer service; they have amazing people helping their customers through their issues.
Yum!  This is amazing food!  Spaghetti, true buffalo wings, subs!  True Italian food!   Love it, everyone should come!
Great place to eat. Atmosphere is awesome. Service is great. Food of course is FANTASTIC!!!  Kudo's to all!

Good cheap pizza. The star rating is for a cheap pizza place...this is more of a Little Caesar's competitor. Prices are literally 1/3 of Flying Pie. 

The $6 14" pizza is fresh and hot, tasted just fine. Employees working were polite and friendly, and I chatted with the owner while waiting for my pizzas. 

There's a seating area for "dining in", but this is really much better for carry out. 

I used to get the Domino's mediums for kid's parties and the like, but this is now my new go-to for cheap pizza. Also nice to support a local small business.
Awesome atmosphere. The bar is awesome and the decor is nice but not too nice. Excellent service and great food. Crab Rangoon was great and seafood was fresh.
Great, authentic tasting pizza! Definitely the closest thing that we have found in Idaho that compares to pizza in Illinois. Will definitely be making return trips in the future!

Came for dinner. Wonderful flavors and choices of "heat".  We liked the "New York hot" on chicken palak and the mughlai makhani. Plenty of basmati rice too. Portions were generous and we took half of our meal home, and they even added more rice to our box! Will be back on our next trip through this area. Enjoyed the unique plates and cups, too!
The best food, the greatest atmosphere, and the nicest people. This restaurant is rich in history and well as in love for their customers. We love Epi's.

The food was awesome. I had the salmon with a side of ribs. The bourbon selection isn't great, but I had some Kentucky small batch whiskey that was delicious. The ribs were fall-off-the-bone and I liked the assortment of bbq sauces. The sassy sauce is sweet, but also kinda tangy. Good spot for bbq!

Really good experience here. I was a bit hesitant about which Goodwood we would see after some of the "meh" reviews but we had a very nice time. Waitress refilled drinks without us asking. We ordered a prime rib dinner and a strawberry/chicken salad - both well made and very delicious. Who knew a BBQ place could do that?? Give them a try!!
Loved this place. I think it's gona be my regular spot. Food was super. Staff were gr8. Plenty of tv's so u won't miss any action. Can't wait to go back. The dubliner dinner was fantastic.

.This place surprised me. Lots of options for filling your burrito, similar to Taco Del Mar. They do it one better here, by offering smoked brisket. Wow. Marvelous flavor in a burrito. Also included guac, pico, corn, pintos, brown rice, and green sauce. And for my next visit, I will try some of the taco specialties. 
.Prices are higher than I am comfortable with, yet based somewhat on relative costs of the meats. Beef costs more than chicken now, no matter where you go. No extra charge for guacamole - go figure.
.Clean, comfortable dining area.

I was impressed to say the least! Great selection of pizzas and salads, fun modern atmosphere, good beer, and delicious dessert! We ordered the rocket salad and ex girlfriend pizza and loved it. Would highly recommend for a casual night out with family or for date night!

I got terrible NAIL FUNGUS which caused permanent yellowing/greening of my nail bed from this place! They are set on using old-school acrylic products, and every time I have gone there, there has been leftover product on my skin. This is why I get water retention under the acrylic, and ultimately pre-mature lifting and nasty fungal growth from the water residing inappropriately. 

LAURA AND ANDI ARE THE BEST TECHS at this trashy sorrority of a nail studio-
 so if you can't get in with Ambition's Salon (the best nail techs I have ever experienced, who use gel!), then you will be okay with booking with either Laura or Andi.

Jordyn, the owner, walks around like she is the s**#.  All of my friends who have gone there think that she is the worst business owner they have ever seen. Simple fact, GLITZ: Being bitchy, cold, stand-off-ish, and mean does NOT win you clients...
but I don't think Jordyn has learned this yet.
