Even IF their nail techs were amazing at what they do (which they're not), the first thing that turned me off to this place is that the women who work here are so incredibly rude and unfriendly! The only nice people I have met at this place have been Laura and Andi- SERIOUSLY. They act like you are bothering them by even being there.

CASEY is especially unfriendly and so ridiculously unwelcoming. I have never seen her smile or be pleasant to anyone. She was on her cell phone then entire time she was attempting to give me a pedicure. The massage was weak, and my polish chipped the day after I had it done- and I honestly had not done anything besides wear open-toed sandals and go to work. 

The pedicures are BAD.. oh...so...bad... They maybe last, um, 5 minutes?

This is a place that advertises to be amazing, but unfortunately falls short- waaaaaaay short. Plus, they charge you about $10 more than Ambitions Salon does- for a FAR inferior version of everything. 

I have gotten hooked on gel, and it is SO much better for your nails! And by gel, I still mean "fake," long, beautiful nails. I am soooo happy that I discovered AMBITIONS SALON!! The women are so very nice and friendly, and they actually treat you like you are a real person, opposed to Glitz, where they treat you like you are garbage. They also will provide wine, if you so choose, and not only do they do nails- they do hair, eye-lash extensions, permanent make-up (Cecily is AMAZING!), ...and probably more than I even know about. 

Call 853-2429!!! I promise I am not a rep or employee of Ambitions, just a big fan! What a breath of fresh air and refreshingly positive energy, especially after being abused by Glitz (physically and emotionally) for faaaaar too long than I care to even remember.

The menu is confusing.  The best I can tell is the platter is a multi meat meal and the plate is a single meat meal... Also, the plate meal has additional meat options which are not mentioned on the platter meal.

Ambiance/Service
The restaurant was clean... very cafeteria like.  It had a slight BBQ smoke smell which was nice.  Saw an employee's using a dining table next to the drinks as a computing area... Had both indoor and outdoor seating. Service was good.. People were nice..  Indifferent here but one employee had a visible gun on his hip...   

Food
I have mixed reviews here..  So far I have tried the brisket, ribs, and sausage....    I thought the flavor was good.. but.. the ribs were dry, the brisket was chopped in small cubes like the size I cut little kids( I rather have mine delivered  in slices) and the sausage was cold and cut  length wise..(I would rather have my sausage intact  as I think it keeps the juices better),  the coleslaw and corn were good.   

Price was a little high for the amount of food given.

Went Black Friday shopping for a new range; I visited their respectful counterparts in my quest to look for a new range. I asked three simple questions. 1- How long have you worked in this department? 2- What brands do you have an issue with the most? 3- What brand would you get? The salesperson replied to all three, they had worked 2 years in the department, the told me the ranges I should steer clear from and then I came back later that day and bought an LG convection range. I love the range. It performs well for all my cooking needs. No BS from any of their employees for every other time I have had a need to visit their store.

Regular visitor to this amazing place. They always welcome you like family or a long time friend. Basque hospitality at its finest! 
Food is exquisite, and portion sizes are very generous so make sure you go hungry. Favorite appetizer is the fried calamari which is served as cut strips with a lovely dipping sauce. Best calamari in the area! The other appetizers I have tried are also great, but I love the calamari so much, it makes me feel like I will be sad if I eat there and don't have it. Favorite entrees include herb crusted halibut with lobster cream sauce, rib eye steak, lamb dishes are also fabulous... actually, it is too hard to pick because they are all wonderful. Often the entrees are served along side rice pilaf and another side, which can be seasoned french fries, basque peppers, green beans, etc. There have been a few times that the pilaf has been substituted with mashed potatoes or something else. Same with the desserts, I haven't found one that I don't adore.
Reservation is usually required, due to limited space, but once you eat there once, you will do anything necessary to go eat there again.
Go try it, you will be so glad you did!
I never knew this place existed until we moved a few doors down. By far the best food I have had in a long time, I am addicted! thanks Rick, you have a new regular.

BEWARE!!!  I went in to do an exchange for two different items and both items were full retail at $16.00.  One of the items I purchased yesterday at $8.99 and the item I wanted to purchase today was on sale for $6.99.  The lady at the back return counter did a straight across exchange cause I told her I wanted to "exchange" the items.  She got an attitude when I told her I wanted sale prices since the one I was buying was less.  I then had to wait for a manager to come up and void the transaction.  I was told I didn't say return and purchase it was my fault for not communicating....WATCH YOUR RETURNS/EXCHANGES, are you kidding me?

I ordered the Asian mist cocktail, a salmon roll, eel avocado roll, and a tuna roll. The drink was stiff, not too sweet and delicious. The rolls had very little rice which I loved because there was more meat and less carbs! I will surely go back!

I've had it with their super slow service!  All three times I've eaten there, I've had to wait between 10-20 mins just for 1-2 items.  Tonight was no exception.  Got a number handed to us at the drive-thru for one concrete, and waited over 10 minutes to get it.  Two cars behind us were served first!  The time before that, We went inside and ordered two shakes and they literally forgot our order, and actually told us that when we got our food.  We had waited over 20 minutes, and I saw several employees just standing around doing nothing in the back and it was a slow night.  Food isn't that great either.  Never going back ever again!

Laticia done my wedding day makeup and done a great job. I got lots of compliments on my makeup the entire day. I got the airbrush makeup and it was well worth the price. The cost included my trial and for her to travel to Isaac Taylor Gardens on my wedding day. I have never really worn foundation makeup because I have light skin and have never felt comfortable with the way it looks. The airbrush makeup was perfect and I felt completely comfortable wearing it. I even ordered an airbrush makeup kit online so maybe I can learn to do it on myself one day. I would highly recommend Laticia for wedding day makeup!

Bad gel manicure, cuticles were not cleaned up. The gel is so thick in some places it makes my nail look bumpy. There is polish still on my cuticles and I have little bumps on my nails from something like dust getting on the wet polish that she didn't even bother trying to get out before putting the final top coat on. Looking at my manicure the next day I saw where there were air bubbles and still more polish stuck to the cuticle that I had to rub off. The annoying thing is, I know a girl that got a great manicure from Glitz so I was just stuck with someone not very personable and half-assing the entire thing(seriously, she was looking around at other places half the time she was doing my nails). I don't know if I even want to go back to have her fix it all.

My husband and I chose Epi's based off of reviews and a friends recommendation. We had never had basque food before so we thought we would try something new being fairly new to the area, and I'm glad we did. The service was amazing, very personable, felt like we had all known each other already. The owner greeted us and when we left made sure we had a good time. The atmosphere was very quaint and not all the hustle and bustle of a lot of places. But the food was the best part. It was delicious and the portions left us fat and happy. We had the ham croquettes for an appetizer and there was a very generous amount, perfect and tasty. Our meals came with yummy soup and salad, plus our main course. It was our anniversary dinner so we knew we would be spending a bit more and it was worth it. We will definitely be back again with friends and family.

Nice location & decor.  Appetizers were great, the main course were not as good as expected. We tried the onion rings, potato skins, and the spinach & artichoke dip.  Would go back for these alone. 

Our main courses were the brisket & it a was a little dry and the gravy for the chicken fried steak was to peppery for my liking. (Husband thought it was ok)  the steak itself was very good.

We were with a group, there was a little incident upon food delivery so so of the party was later in getting their meals than others and one member was missing a side. They were very apologetic about the incident.
Fantastic Neapolitan style pizza. We had the ex-girlfriend one and it was spectacular. The beer and friendly staff were great too!

WORST CUSTOMER SERVICE EVER. I refuse to ever go to this store again even though I live 5 minutes away from it!! I would rather go to the mall one!!! THANKS FOR NO HELP KOHLS!! Worst experience ever!!!!!!

My wife and I went to Epi's to celebrate our anniversary last night and had a wonderful experience. Our server, Angela, came off warm and genuine, answering questions and explaining various dishes, and Chris welcomed us with enthusiasm and sincerity, likewise interacting with other customers, both new and regulars, as though they were long lost family and friends.

The various courses and quality/taste of the entrees was superb. I had lamb while my wife had the squid in ink sauce, both of which were rife with flavor and ample portions overall. The restaurant's overall feel was very pleasant, relaxing, and homey, as though we'd truly been invited into a spiritual extension of grandma Epi's house and kitchen. I cannot recommend Epi's enough. Dining there is a lovely, delicious, and unique experience amplified all the more by the kind, quality people you'll interact with. Extremely recommended.

The service was fantastic. Our waitress was incredibly friendly and helpful. The food came quickly and was presented very nicely. The food was good, but not great. The Boise/Meridian area is really lacking for excellent Asian cuisine. Thai Basil is one of the best in the area. Next time I think I'll order everything "medium" spicy, rather than "mild."

The food here is always excellent here.  The bbq platters are an amazing value.  You get two to three different delicious smoked bbq selections with two fresh made sides.  The baby back ribs, pulled pork and bbq chicken are my favorites.  Not to mention the fresh cornbread and honey butter that comes with every meal.  My favorite appetizer is the potato skins that are smothered in cheese bacon and green onions with their hand crafted bbq sauce to dip in.  They also make really yummy salads too.  Their house salad is loaded with bacon, cheese, hard boiled eggs, fresh grape tomatoes and croutons.  All the food there is perfectly craveable!! The staff and the atmosphere are just as great also.
circustrix kicks jumptimes ass.       That is all...this place is lame and overpriced...do your kid a favour go to Circustrix...

Sat up in the balcony in the VIP21+ section. First of all - the movie screen is set too low for the height of the railing. If one leans back in their chair, or isn't tall enough in the first place despite sitting up straight, the screen in its entirety cannot be seen. Second - "heat rises" was the explanation given by our server as to why it was so hot in the balcony. Ummmmm ok. Third - draft beer selection was limited and your beer comes in a plastic cup. How very sporting event ish. An Alamo Drafthouse franchise would crush this place out of business. At least the movie we saw was great!

Good stuff!! So glad I tried this place. Had some chicken makhani and it was delicious! But but but their NAAN! It's amazing! We got garlic, paneer, potato one, and coconut naan! I could eat that coconut naan every day! So good! Super friendly service and everything was super fresh. Will def be back!

My husband and I thought we would try someplace different for lunch , then our regular Sushi restaurant. We were pleasantly surprised.  The sushi was delicious,  service was good everyone was very nice. We will be going back again. Definitely worth trying.

This is absolutely the most amazing dining experience you can have.  The food is phenomenal and it gets 5 stars in its own. But the care and attention that you get from owner Chris and in tonight's case, Bridget is amazing and unheard of anymore. I watched Chris work the room and its as if it's a family reunion and she is making sure that everyone is attended to and having fun. I will never not eat here whenever I'm in town. Love this place.

Very disappointed. Paid $ 3,400.00 cash 
no discount!! Worst service ever. 
I was hopeful it would be corrected. 
It was not. I'm out of the money I paid 
I don't have dental insurance!

I. Had to put a star because there is no -0
-0.

Everytime I visit Goodwood the food is amazing, but what made me take the time to write this review is how beyond amazing the catering from Goodwood was at my wedding!!

The food was great as always despite my wedding being in McCall and the food having to travel from Boise. The servers who came went above and beyond, even serving the cake, bussing the tables and picking up trash!! 

I will recommend all if my friends to Goodwood for their catering needs.

Been here a few times when I visit the area and am usually more impressed. We saw Daddy's Home at a 4:10 showing. The place was a mess, especially the bathrooms. They were pretty terrible. Definitely could use some improvements in overall cleanliness.

This is an exceptional theater.  It is beautiful, clean, possesses state of the art sound and visual displays, and has luxurious second story seating above the rif raf down below if you pay the extra $2.  Best you'll spend.

There is not a lot of mall-ratters here, either, which is a big plus.  Honestly, if you can't give this theater five stars, you can't give five stars to any theater.

The food you order upstairs so quite good on its own.  The Mac and cheese is excellent and we ordered a burger that was forgettable but good, especially for a movie theater.  Pay the extra to have bacon added to the mac and cheese.  

This is the only theater five star review I will give in the whole state of idaho.  Everywhere else get 2-3 stars.

Who would have thought Idaho would have a solid BBQ joint? I was there on business for a few days and on my last night in town I got a craving for BBQ. Goodwood didn't disappoint.  The place is really nice looking both outside and in and I wouldn't hesitate to host a birthday, work event, or anything else there. It's just a classy looking place when you consider the price point and location.  I ate a pulled pork sandwich and small Cesar at the bar and watched Monday night football. It was fairly quiet and intimate in there but the TVs were up plenty loud to hear the game. I didn't partake but there is a full bar and the staff was attentive. Food was out fast and was hot and tasty though I still don't get why people can't discern that if you order a salad with a sandwich you probably want them to come out together. Parking was also abundant and convenient to the restaurant. I'd absolutely recommend this place. It seems very versatile from having a couple of drinks watching the game to Sunday dinner with family, it does it all.

Wings where awful. Burger was good fries too definitely a repeat. My prime rib sandwich was not the best should have gotten a burger but my fries were great. Used Cafe Courier great on New years night.

Came with some friends as an extension to my birthday celebration in Idaho.
Chase, our server, made the Sunday brunch special with his attentiveness.
Enjoyed the bottomless mimosas with choice of juice and berries to add. Chocolate too always a plus. Husband enjoyed the self-service wine bar.
We ordered a Flatbread and Salad to share. Football in the background. Great time.

In the summer, the patio with heaters would be lovely to take in all the activity of The Village. Glass sliding doors do help the atmosphere to feel like the outdoors in inclusive.

Pros: Love my tires. They had the best price in town for what I was looking for. The guy who helped me was nice. 

Cons: I take really good care of my truck and have it taken in and checked out all the time have only had one issue with it ever. I take it in for my tires and they tell me that my control arm has gone bad in my truck. Say it's $350 to fix. My dad says they don't have a bad reputation around town and they are probably telling me the truth. I go ahead and fix it and the next day after I get it back my check engine light comes on. I put in my obd2 reader and it says I need to replace my throttle control sensor. So after buying tires 2 things mysteriously goes wrong with my truck. Not sure if saving the $100 bucks on tires was worth going to them to now have all these issues arise. 

I will continue to go to get my tires aligned and rotated through these tires but will probably not buy from them again or fix what they say needs done without taking it to another mechanic first to check out.

Decent cheeseburger, Amarillo Firecracker Burger and fries with great tv coverage for your sports viewing pleasure. Friendly and happy staff. Sat at a high top in the bar area. Nice pour on the rum and diet. Heinz ketchup and French's mustard if that matters.

I would love to give this place more stars but I can't.  It was a Friday night 6:45 so when it should be expected to be busy.  But no one must have told the staff. Once we got seated it took for ever to get a drink or order. I had to ask a bus boy to hunt our server down. After our order went in we got food but NO silverware.  Then had to hunt down server again to get some. Only 2 out of 3 got some they said they were out of silverware.  This is unacceptable and should not be a done at any restaurant.  The food is acceptable but service was not. Also the apitizer was cold to lukewarm.

I had hopes for this place because of the description of the food on their website. I was very disappointed. One other reviewer said the soup tasted about as good as soup from a can. I'd say it was better than that, but no better than the premium boxed soups you get from the grocery store. Not much to say about the sandwich. First, given the price, there was not much there; and the few bites that it provided did not leave much of an impression.

Wonderful experience at Epi's. The waitresses were so sweet and genuine. My fiancé and I had a very pleasant time enjoying our dinner here.

My fiancé called to make a reservation, since they are only open for three hours a day, for 7:30pm. We called around 4pm and got the answering machine. He left a message for the reservation. They called us back thirty minutes later to confirm our reservation for 8pm. I was excited either ways. We wanted to reserve a seat at 7:30pm because they close at 8pm, but what a surprise, we were still able to be seated at 8.

Seriously over priced bar food. Caesar Salmon salad consisted of romaine, shredded Parmesan,  meh croutons and an over-cooked, dried out piece of salmon. Didn't even take the leftovers home to the dogs. Husband's mushroom Swiss burger was soggy and tasted like it sat too long. Service was friendly but won't go back. $32 lunch for two.

I took my truck into Big O Tires as I replaced my inner and outer tie rods and upper and lower ball joints. On May 5th I called Big O and explained what I did and they told me that the alignment would be $59.95 and I could drop it off at any point that day. I headed over to Big O and of course my alignment was terrible and so I again explained the situation and even showed them a picture that my steering wheel was turned to the side in order to go straight, I was again told that it would be $59.95 to align it. Fast forward 6 hours and I drop off my wife to pick up my Silverado and she called me a few minutes later. She informed me that the invoice showed $59.95 but it was crossed out and $79.95 was written in it's placed. She told me that the tech informed her that he had called me and verified it was okay which was a lie. She also informed me that he said that with how far out my alignment was that they couldn't get it perfectly straight. I then proceeded to call Big O and I was transferred to the tech that did my alignment and he said that due to how far out my alignment was that he was charging me the extra and I couldn't do anything about it. I asked him why I wasn't called to verify this but he refused to answer my question and eventually hung up. I then called back and demanded to speak to the Manager and I explained him the situation, he informed me that the tech said he called me and verified it was okay which was a lie. I informed the manager of this and he ended up refunding me the extra $20 that was charged. A few minutes later my wife called me again, she had turned into our neighborhood and my truck started to violently shake so she pulled off to the side. I immediately headed her way and crawled under my truck to see that my drivers side outer tie rod end nut was missing and so of course my tie rod end popped out. I looked at the tie rod end on the other side and that nut was loose and of course no cotter pins were inserted to help hold them. I called the shop back and I was told that it was not there problem. I am very grateful that the tie rod end popped out when my wife was going just a few miles an hour instead of being on the freeway as someone would have more than likely been killed. I then had to order a new tie rod end nut online, rendering my truck useless for 4 days and my alignment is not very straight either so I am going to have to take it to another shop and get it aligned again. I am blown away at my mistreatment at your shop as I have never been treated in such an awful way.

I really enjoyed the food tonight everything was so fresh! Sushi to die for- I started with blackened tuna which was also perfect. As for the others in my group however they got the wok and said their portions were not what they had hoped for. The filet minion was good but they said they felt like they could have all used more. The man who did our wok was awesome! The staff was pretty helpful however I know it was busy and prom night for some schools but please don't try to push people out by making them feel rushed not okay. I would go back as they did awesome with food preparation I think I would just sit at sushi bar thou! Also at no point did they ask if we wanted more drinks or dessert it was just like ok you are done now leave
We were visiting the area from out of town and got a craving for Indian food. This place popped up on yelp and we are glad it did! Great service. Tasty food!
Best movie theater in town! Great food and cold beer

The only thing better than the food at this restaurant is the service.  The owner greeted us as we walked in, and checked on us multiple times during the evening. Our waitress was very friendly and attentive, as was everyone that came to our table. 

The calamari was cooked perfectly and the sauce that came with it was delicious. We both ordered the red bean soup, and the owner brought us a sample of their cream of mushroom soup. I highly recommend the cream of mushroom soup and wish I had ordered it. I had the lamb shank special and my wife had the halibut in lobster sauce. Both dishes were great! 

When we left we said thank you to the owner and she hugged us both and thanked us for coming in. What an amazing experience, hospitality like that is hard to find these days. We will be back, this is our new favorite spot.

Worst haircut I've ever had! The layers framing my face now have a giant ledge! And since it's 6 inches shorter then the rest of my hair its going to take forever to grow out. The stylist was unprofessional, didn't even try to make conversation with me which made it an uncomfortable hour. She burned my scalp several times blow drying my hair and while straightening it. I left with frizzy large hair. I came into the salon with better hair then I walked out with. Completely disappointing. The second I walked into that place I knew it was a bad idea because it was completely empty! Plus some blonde woman came up during the "styling" to ask about my unmanageable frizy hair and if I was going to get a Brazilian blowout.. No I'm not because I don't have frizy hair that was just your terrible stylist! After the haircut I had a pedicure by a really nice nail tech only my time got shorted because the haircut ran so far over and yet I had to pay full price for the pedicure! While checking out I made an appointment for another pedi hoping to give this place another chance. But ending up having to cancel a week before. But when the day came I got a call wondering where I was for my pedicure! They were rude and didn't even apologize for the fact that that was their mistake not mine!

WOW This place is amazing with phenomenal fresh food !!!!
Do yourself a favor come eat here!!
Great wait staff everything is phenomenal 

This is my new go to restaurant in Boise/Meridian area !!

Ok finally a Japanese restaurant in Idaho that can compete against other Japanese restaurants in other states. The attention to detail ,service and yes the food that is sometimes a little rare in Idaho. On the weekend ask for uni
The food is incredible and you won't find better service anywhere.  One of the Top 5 meals I've had at a restaurant; ANYWHERE!

I went in at ordered my food at 6:37 pm and then I finally got my food at 7:10pm. (didn't order anything special either) I wasn't the only one When I was waiting a lady came in from the drive thru saying she has been waiting for 35 min in her car and the Mgr Janell made her go back and get her receipt form her car before she would give her the food she paid for already. That's not even the biggest problem I seen this night. Janell told a person in the military that he had to wear his uniform before he could get his discount even though he tried to show the mgr Janell he military ID. She would not give in. Sorry but I cannot support this kind of environment. If I knew what was going at the time I would of paid for his meal myself. I didn't find out till both of us were sitting next to each other eating.

Indian is my very favorite food; I went out for it 2-3 times a month before moving to a small, rural town where it's unavailable. So, every time I find myself within a full range of dining options, I jump on Yelp and look for my Indian fix. Spice did not disappoint! The atmosphere was nothing special, but who cares. The service was prompt and friendly, even on a Saturday night. We got the butter chicken, palak paneer, and garlic naan. I was, unfortunately, unable to order the spice level I prefer because I was eating with my 3-year-old. But the quality made up for the mildness: All the bold without the heavy. I might actually buy a cooler and some ice packs so I can order a bunch of takeout before driving all the way back to my Indian-less town.

First time trying Spice. Placed order online at noon. At 1220 my order has been confirmed and said it will be ready between 1240-1250. When I got there I was told to wait. Didn't get my food until 1:15. If you offer the convenience of online ordering, then you need to work on the delivery of it. The food is the only thing that save the rating from being a 1. Sadly not sure if we will try this place again.

We have been here before and my kids have always enjoyed themselves. It usually doesn't smell so good. My kids always made comments on how it stinks.  But this past weekend we didn't smell anything bad.  It smelled like fresh laundry.  It was much more enjoyable for all of us!

I had really enjoyed going to this place. The fills were awesome and seamless. However the service has really gone down. They rush you through and cut up your fingers with the files and drill. When asked to fix their mistake they again rush you and don't take the time to fix it correctly. I will be finding a new place to get my nails & pedicures!

My husband and I have loved this Hotel the last few times we have come into town for Business and Family. We always book their largest room and stay usually a week. We like to be able to entertain in our hotel while we are there. This time the furniture including the bed are so broken down that both of our backs are not happy, and didn't get much sleep. One of the things we also really enjoyed was the Breakfast buffet they were famous for, this included real meat, fresh fruit and a wide variety for the smallest to the largest eater. This is gone and the now have what they call a Bistro. No Room Service. No Coffee available, unless you want to purchase Starbucks. The Staff still the same professional friendly faces, from the front desk, the restaurant and the room cleaning staff. We will miss them. But will no longer stay here.

As all of the previous reviews suggested, this place did not disappoint! The owner greeted us and gave us a little history of the restaurant and made my husband and I feel right at home. So very warm and welcoming. The food was delicious and cooked with love. We will definitely be back soon.
Love my spray tan! Jamie is the best and pays such good attention to detail. Tan is still going strong after 10 days. I'll definitely be using this many times in the future :)

In search of sushi in Meridian on a Sunday afternoon, a coupon brought us in the door. I hadn't heard much about this place, but hey, I'm all about giving everyone a chance, especially when it comes to sushi!

The layout is unusual...very broken up. It's kind of nice being in a different area of the restaurant from the teppanyaki grill(s) though...it sounded like a party! Service was good, but a little slow. Our server chose to bus a recently vacated table over taking our initial order, which was a little off-putting, but she was attentive and prompt for the remainder of our visit. 

I was pleasantly surprised by the sushi - not sure why I was expecting to be disappointed, but I'm glad that theory was debunked! Our favorites ended up being:

Crazy Bumblebee (lobster tempura, avocado, asparagus, topped with mango, seaweed salad and sweet chili sauce)
Firecracker (spicy tuna, spicy yellowtail, avocado, jalapeno, wrapped in pink soy bean paper, topped with salmon, tuna, mango and spicy mayo)

My only criticism - the spicy rolls aren't spicy, and with all inland sushi...the price. That's why we normally go for AYCE sushi (Yo Tomo is the winner there, but they're closed on Sunday.) 

All in all, it's good food and a convenient location, we'll be back! Will probably take the Montana family to the teppanyaki grill when they come to visit - I think my 5-year old nephew will especially like it!

Just moved into town and was looking for good quality, good looking, and reasonably priced furniture. I think I found the right place. Courteous and knowledgeable sales staff and a friendly clean delivery team. The showroom was beautiful and offered more options than I found around town. They offered me a 30 day price guarantee and a 14 day customer satisfaction option to exchange. I loved the furniture I received but it's good to have peace of mind just in case.

Like most "fast food places" it's a hit and miss. The food overall is average and the service was okay. My biggest pet peeve of any place is when you order a large drink and they fill it to the brim with ice! Popeye's, you think I would learn to say no ice when I come here?! Also, what's up with putting the gravy in with the mashed potatoes? It would be better separate but what do I know?  Just an average adult consumer.

Best bistro in all of the west coast I've traveled to for work.  Consider staying in vs going out for meals as their service is above and beyond excellent in comparison to other courtyards I've stayed at.  Food is great and you can sit down and relax just like a restaurant after a long day of travel and be waited on vs other Courtyards that require you to order at the counter.  Highly recommend Feleshia (sp) is the best !

This wine bar is so cute! I met Larry and he was amazing. I ordered the pork tenderloin and it was to die for. Larry helped me pick out a wine that complemented the meal very well (the Ormani Classico). Food and wine was A+! I will be back next time I come to town :)
Goodwood has some of the best bbq in idaho.  Prices tell you how good it is haha.  Get the sampler meat platter for a group and you won't be disappointed.

This is a restaurant for a special occasion.  Staff are not only friendly and knowledgeable but some are descendants of the immigre Epifania, who started cooking in Idaho at her guest house in the 1940s.  
The Basque specialties are savory and succulent, often simmering to tenderness all day. The roasted red peppers that top lamb or fish are new from scratch, as Ami's the salad dressing and soups. Save room for the gloriously decadent Gateau Basque, a custard stuffed cheesecake that absolutely melts the taste buds. So glad I saved room for that. Epi is wise enough to offer some of their favorite dishes in "lighter fare" so that you can indulge in specialty appetizers(like chorizos in homemade pimientos, ham croquettes) and  the delectable desserts ( hers also Basque flan as well as famed rice pudding). 
Not an inexpensive place, but memorable- well worth it. 

I'll be back, with my husband next time!

Panda garden...
 Well tried it a few times, and only gets worst. I try not to do this but tonight was bad.
I called for takeout; they said 10 to 15 minutes. I show up pay the money and then they tell me a few more minutes. It seems like they don't cook the food till you pay them. And now I have to wait 40 more minutes to get the food that wasn't even close to being right.  That's why I am writing this so someone else doesn't make the same mistake. I will not go back. And the dinner wasn't very good at all.

OMG the mozzarella sticks and the garlic twists SO GOOD!!!!! I could eat those everyday day. We got the ex-girlfriend pizza which was amazing with the honey drizzle on top. Service was great and friendly staff!! Definitely coming back
This Qdoba has gone downhill fast!! I use to love this place but they keep increasing prices and the service has gotten worse with rude people. The evening manager is a total douchebag.
Was very pleased with Reliance Moving. Cameron and Nicholas showed up 10 minutes early and worked until the job was done. Will definitely be recommending this company to family and friends.

Great restaurant. Had server-in-training & was excellent service. Combo meal was upgraded to ribs & BBQ chicken. Sides coleslaw & baked beans some of the best I've ever had. Decor was Mix of western & Johanna Gaines. Really homey & comfortable. Will be back on next trip to Boise.

My husband and I are frequent movie goers...we have seen about 7 movies at the Village in Meridian...we prefer the VIP section if it is available...but the regular theater is nice too...we have eaten both at the Backstage Bistro and in the VIP in theater dining a few times...the food is delicious...so far we have tried short ribs, steak frites, tuna tartar, calamari, pear gallette, crème brule, mac and cheese, burgers (My husband's burger was undercooked during a matinee show one time, but other than that the food is really great!), crouque monsuer, pumpkin raspberry upside down cake, paninis, and some of there signature cocktails...the Chef really knows what he is doing...I am impressed with the Backstage Bistro...we only see movies in the VIP now...Thanks Village Cinema and  Backstage Bistro! The staff upstairs are super friendly and really know the menu.  Thanks to Terrance for the great dining experience in the Bistro! The kids in the box office were very polite and knowledgeable about were the best spot in VIP would be.  We just found out last time we were there that they are now offering $5 all day movie tickets on Tuesdays and they have cool appetizers and drink deals in VIP....we are so there....new Tuesday date night!!!
Good taste but total rip off. I order a large salad that wasn't so large. Mostly made up of salad with a small amount of extra like fruit and chicken.

Staff was very friendly and professional. The guys identified my issue with my one bad tire and got to work on it. Great news was the big o guys were able to patch my tire saving me the expense of buying a brand new tire. 
The guys fixed my tire, put the new tire on, took my spare off, and reloaded the spare back under the truck.
This is the third tire these guys have done for me.
Highly recommended for tire service.

I had the old-fashion burger with pulled pork on it and it was amazing! I usually don't eat or like burgers, but they did an amazing job! The burger was moist and their toasted bun was awesome...I have a tendency to be a bun snob but they got it right.  I also really enjoyed their steak fries.  Our waitress was awesome and took very good care of us. We had a wonderful experience there and hope to have more!

This place has the worse customer service I have ever experienced. And I have experienced bad service, but this took the cake. Jim, the manager was extremely rude and unwilling to correct or refund an order that was incorrect on their part. Mind you this was a to go order so it involved driving back and forth. After his employees promised a correction he refused it upon arrival. Unfortunately they have lost us and our friends for upcoming UFC or sporting events. And we usually are the organizers and bring them in. I will gladly go down the street to Buffalo Wild Wings for by Boneless wings UFC And sports.
Customer service is a thing of the past, at least at this place.
I'm not sure about the beer or burgers but DO NOT get the ribs of any sort here.. They're undercooked and wouldn't let me order another without paying for it.. No thank you, left hungry.

First off, all I had was an ice cream cone, their flavor of the day. 

But the flavor of the day was raspberry cordial.  It was delicious with a capital D.  Spiked my diabetic self for a couple of hours but worth it.

Prices appear to be high for a drive-through chain.  Will have to return sometime and check them out more thoroughly.

But recommend you swing in and try the flavor of the day for a couple of bucks.  The flavor of the day for each location is posted on their website.  You can look it up based on ZIP Code and location before you decide to go.

One of the better experiences of my life. Excellent service, small intimate dining area, delicious food and reasonable prices are some of the highlights. 

My fiancé and I got lucky walking in on Saturday night and getting seated, there are only about 15 tables in the building. Reservations highly recommended. We enjoyed a bottle of house Cabernet, ham appetizer, delicious soups, cold fresh salads, Halibut and Steak medallions and finished with a delicious Apple Bread dessert. Everything was good and came out quickly.  Accepted my Amex. We got hugs as we were leaving. Cannot recommend this place enough. Amazing!!!

Prices could be more competitive. Service is always great though and they have a decent stock. Right now at the firearms counter, they have a few boxes of 22lr but not priced low. What do you expect though, 22lr is almost impossible to find lately

Amazing customer service! Went here to buy my first handgun and the guy at the gun counter was amazingly helpful. Paid equal attention to each customer and did not seem frustrated or anything by the non stop questions and customers coming up to the counter. He spent at least an hour showing me different guns and even told me not to rush buy to take my time. So I didn't even buy a gun that day. A few days later I had come to a decision and a new guy was behind the counter but he was just as helpful and the prices were cheaper than other stores I had looked at. It was truly a great shopping experience.

I am a barbecue lover, and if I expected the Zupa pulled pork sandwich to be traditional barbecue it would disappoint me. Its different from the Memphis style pulled pork BBQ, having no barbecue sauce, and using purple cabbage slaw. The dressing was something I can't quite describe, and delicious.
The lobster bisque soup was as good as any seafood dish I've had. 
We fed our toddler without even ordering a child meal - he ate berries from the salad, tomatoes from the Italian sandwich, an applesauce squeeze pack from my wife's purse, and my chocolate covered strawberry. They always include this chocolate strawberry with a pick two order.
My food today reinforced to me an already outstanding  reputation.

The Statesman says this is run by the same folks who run the Pad Thai House, which used to be my go-to for Thai carryout. Now this place is...much more convenient, and same excellent food. 

I got some take out on a Thursday night; I had green chicken curry, med heat, sweet & sour chicken (for the kids) and flat rice noodles with pork, Thai hot. All were excellent, as good as PT House. The atmosphere does not look much different than when this place was Asian Fusion, so it would be fine for lunch or a casual dinner out.

I'll definitely be back...glad to have this place right off Eagle Road, saving me the drive!

I'd say it' in the running for best Thai in the Boise area...
By far, the absolute best nail salon in the Treasure Valley! I have been getting my nails done by Kasey for 5 years now and she just keeps getting better!

Inspire is a very nice salon and spa, attractive, comfortable and clean. If you were looking for an especially clean nail and pedicure salon this is it. The massages are excellent and affordable. I highly recommend this salon and spa.

Best tan ever!  Jamie is super sweet and made me feel comfortable. I stayed tan for over a week! Being a mobile spray tan company is the best part. I can schedule it around my schedule which is amazing!!

When we have McDonalds this is the location we always come to this location. We have never had bad service but never great service either. The young man who was working the drive thru tonight though was the best! I don't think I've gotten better service anywhere since we moved here from CO (people definitely aren't as polite here as they are there) He was talkative, sweet and funny! Loved him! If everyone was like him we'd be there all the time lol
Wish we would've got his name but I didn't think of it until we left
He's the reason for 5 star rating
Better than expected! A great sandwich and salad all for under 9 bucks. I'm a fan

I purchased multiple packages from Precision. and during one of my treatments the tech forgot to use the cooling gel. This caused multiple burns to my face. It took months to go back. The only reason I went back is because I had purchased a 10 treatment package prior. However, upon returning they said I only had one treatment left. No matter the excuses they provided, I felt ripped off.

I love how ribbons and paper can be unique and beautiful. Everywhere I go I travel I often stop at boutique's and small stores to purchase fine papers and ribbon. 
I was very excited to visit a few friends in Idaho this last week. In showing me around their state, my eye caught a small store and I asked if we could stop.
When we walked in I felt that I was not welcome. I did not get greeted, but that did not detour me. I saw speciality ribbons that I wanted. When I saw that there were items that I wanted, I asked the associates to cut some ribbon for me. They told me that I could give them the ribbons and they then continued to do other tasks behind the counter and did not seemed interested in helping me with anything.
When I gave the ribbons that I wanted to have trimmed to the employee behind the counter, she trimmed them and then without folding the organza they proceeded to ball it up and put in the plastic bag.
I am sad to say that I don't believe that is the proper way to handle organza ribbon. I used to work at a speciality paper store and there is a gentleness that needs to be done with delicate ribbons.
I was disappointed when I saw that, so I proceeded to ask  the lady behind the counter is there was another way she could roll up my ribbon and she acted like she didn't understand why I was asking it. She told me no basically.
At that point I would have not purchased the ribbon, but I know that once ribbon is cut it should be purchased. 
I would not recommend this store to anyone and it is too bad, because there was some cool things in it. But I wouldn't want anyone to experience the attitude that I had experienced!
Sandwiches don't have that much taste. Soups are too rich. I must say though the salads are fantastic! And dining area is very neat and clean.
It's a courtyard and noise is minimal so all in all its decent.  The Bistro here sucks donkey balls though so eat out.

We went on a Wednesday so you would think not busy!  Wrong, very busy but only 1 waitress/bartender so service was slow but gracious!  We saw at least 3 groups leave because they weren't seated. We had the salmon!  It was good, really good but not amazing. It had a fishy taste that we know means not totally fresh.

The theater itself is lovely. 
The seats are comfy. 
The popcorn is buttery.
You save your own seats making arriving late convenient.
And they have a coffee bar. 
Cool. I'm down.
But the awful, unhelpful, arrogant (short, red-headed) manager I dealt with one afternoon made me so angry and disappointed in the Village Cinema that I can't foresee myself frequenting this theater. I'm disappointed that his terrible leadership is the example of customer service that his staff gets. I'm disappointed that someone appointed him to be a role model to young staff at all. I'm disappointed that he has to be the face of this beautiful new theater. I'm not hoping he gets fired, but I certainly don't think this represents the company's best interest. 

Hopefully he was just having a terrible day. Hopefully his goldfish just died and that was why he was so rude and pompous and wasted a ton of my time and never apologized for the several mistakes he made (or for wasting my time). Hopefully it was just an off-day. I'll cross my fingers.

I should have known better than to go to Pizza Hut later in the evening.  But for real ppl what a mess.  Salad bar hadn't been cleaned or restocked all day. I had to hunt for lettuce because what u see in the picture is mounds of solid core.  Staff was less than unhappy about cleaning and not attentive at all (big surprise). A special treat...I had some beets that tasted sour and threw up what I had managed to eat so far. We weren't asked how the meal was, probably because the staff is used to providing a less than mediocre pizza with a dirty pig boy salad bar and bathrooms that would scare a hill billy farm animal away.

Super yummy salads!  My favorites are the Balsamic Cherry Chicken, Citrus Berry Spinach, Nuts about Berries, and Strawberry Harvest.  My friends who love savory salads love the BBQ Chicken Salad and the Glazed Chicken Chipotle.  My favorite soups are the Tomato Basil and the Wisconsin Cauliflower!  My favorite sandos are the Honey Bacon Club and the Ultimate Grilled Cheese... both are great dipped in aforementioned soups!  Quick, affordable, and feels like a great healthy fresh alternative to other restaurants.

I really like this theatre. The VIP seating was very comfy. The one complaint I have about it is. there was a hand rail in between me and the screen it didn't really block my vision of the movie but was just a pain to look at. The mixed drinks were a bit pricey but I'm used to cheap drinks so I didn't mind. Very nice place though.

Mariah did my nails and I would not recommend her services. I requested that she not use the machine filer except just a little to remove my gel nails and asked her if she would be soaking/wrapping to remove the rest. Her response was yes but she didn't. Needless to say my natural nails are a mess! Ruined for who knows how long! The salon was not clean either unfortunately, and her station left a lot to be desired in the cleanliness department for sure!
This was my first and last visit.

Spice Indian Cuisine has become our go-to Indian restaurant in the Treasure Valley. Don't let the name fool you. It's not super hot food, although you can have it that way if you like. The wonderful variety of spices will seduce your taste buds. There is a lot of variety and new dishes are always being added to the lunch buffet. If you need a little more spice as some reviewers have whined about, just ask. For obvious reasons, they can't make everything hot because not everyone likes it like that. They also added the most delicious jalapenos that will certainly give you a little kick. It's not just the heat that I loved but the flavor was unbelievable and brings out the flavor of all the different spices.

The family owned restaurant is a great addition to the Valley. We've tried most of the other Indian restaurants and Spice Indian Cuisine has them all beat by a mile!

I would have given three and half stars if I could.  Had take out over the July 4th weekend and it was good.  The ribs were very good and the brisket was also good.  It seems cheaper than Famous Dave's and that makes it a good deal.  Not quite as good as the Good Wood...but cheaper,

Surprised they don't have more stars than what they have.  The place was really clean and they had really good options.  I tried just one taco and it was amazing.  Definitely will be back when I'm back in Boise

We really enjoyed this place!  The service is outstanding and so friendly.  I had the halibut and it was cooked to perfection. My husband had the lamb stew and that was just ok.  He had had better.  The is such a cute place and family ran business.  We really enjoyed the atmosphere and the food!  Try it you won't be sorry.

I was here for a nice evening with the family. Instantly felt sick after eating the sushi. I ended up crapping my pants whilst vomiting in the bathroom. My family had to wait until I finally stopped so we could drive home. The restaurant didn't have toilet paper so you can only imagine. I was so embarrassed to have shat myself in a nice restaurant and the waitress only laughed at me. So did the owner. I will never go back.

What can I say about Baskin Robbins?  It's been the same since my childhood. 31 flavors with a few that change monthly. Friendly staff that were extremely helpful by letting my toddler try some flavors because she was unsure of what to get. They have a special on Wednesdays (free waffle cone with 2 scoop purchase).

My experience with Ashley was insanely substandard. For the past week, I have been in contact with two store associates by phone about purchasing a sofa bed. They promised I would be able to purchase a couch online through a link they would email me. Of course the email never came. I call three days in a row, still no email. I visit the store once I am in town the fourth day, and the sales associate tells me that I was given false information about the color they had in stock in their warehouse, and the new delivery date is one month from now. Completely infuriating customer service that can't seem to get their story straight. Will never be shopping with Ashley again, I'm glad I went to another furniture store to purchase a sofa bed.
Food was okay, but not worth over an hour wait and watching people walk in and get seated before you.

Five stars isn't enough to rate this restaurant. They deserve a ten. It starts with a warm greeting at the door as you enter the cozy atmosphere. Chris and her staff do wonderful things with food and we make a point to eat there whenever we are in town. Whether it is fish or lamb, the food is wonderful.
The only tire place I go. They are always Johnny on the spot service wise, fair prices. Had shocks and struts done there as well. Ask for Ken, he's great.

Came here from Seattle and was told to stop in and eat here. The wait staff and owner were extremely nice and on top of their service. The food was superb from the bread and butter all the way to the desserts. You MUST try the apple bread pudding! It's the owners recipe and she has it nailed down! Will definitely eat here again and will highly recommend this establishment to my friends and family who visit Boise.

The atmosphere and service was really good. Price of food is good and proportions are large. The kids did not like the food. They ordered the spaghetti, grilled cheese and pizza. I had the Sarah sandwich with salad. The wife had the tuna melt with salad. Something about it just didnt "wow" us. We wont eat here again but was worth trying.

This is an awesome word church,  where the word of God is taught whether it is what people want to hear or not!  Why?  Because it's God's word. Like it or not it's what will bring the revelation knowledge to change your life into the life that God intended for you.

They should close at 8:30 pm not 9:00pm! Disappointed in my service tonight! Went in to get a salad after church they were out of the lettuce I like they were out and she didn't want to cut more cause they were closing soon.... I thought you run businesses on making customers happy! Not here! Not if it's close to closing. So shout out to Chic Fil A Salad "not running out" they got my business tonight

We just went here last night and it was a cool movie theater. I love that they have a bistro with alcohol served up stairs. But they are missing the reclining seats and that is a big bummer because I love those type of seats. The theatre itself is big, clean and they have a great staff. I will be back soon to see the new Jurassic Park movie!

I can't say enough about what a great experience I had with Bronze Yourself and Jamie!!  First of all, she comes to your location.  Second of all, with a service that can definitely make one feel a bit vulnerable, Jamie made me feel incredibly comfortable during the whole process. 

I am an experienced and avid tanner of all types (beds, mystic, airbrush) and this was one of the best tans I have ever received.   

And I loved all the little extra options to make my tan even more pleasant. Scents, skin toners, the works!! 

Thank you Jamie for making me feel like a million bucks!!!
Excellent food and service , thanks for Marty for the fast service and attentiveness. Highly recommended ***

I've only lived here for 13 days and I wanted a bite to eat. I found this place by the Majestic movie theater in Meridian.  I had sushi and edadame. It took a little long because there was only one guy making the sushi but it was worth every minute.  The owners were very friendly and there son was helping everyone as well. I will be back for sure.  Keep up the great flavors! !!
Lm

These guys were awesome! They were doing a distance move within the state which required Ferry Transport. They were very reasonably priced and did exactly what we needed. I would deffinitly recomend Cameron and his movers and also would contact them again for future moves!

Excellent thai green curry chicken.  Excellent tom kha gai soup.  Excellent spring rolls.  Very good thai style pork fried rice.  Excellent service.  Nice tables.  Quiet,  good for conversation.  Not decorated much...  Easy parking.  Excellent lunch prices.  We'll be back for sure!

The one bright and shining star of this restaurant is the excellent service. The food was just slightly above average and a little expensive for the quality. It's really hard to judge from reviews where to eat in Boise. I have lived all over the world, and most recently on the East Coast. I love eating out, and I have the money to eat most of my meals out, but it's hard to find anywhere to eat that you aren't disappointed with after reading glowing reviews on here. the only really consistently good place I've found to eat here is Goldy's, but I've only lived here for 8 months and have high hopes. I think Boiseans just have lower culinary standards because every well-rated restaurant is just average so if you are a traveler, bear that in mind. At least this is what some of the natives from the area who have lived other places have told me they think the reason for all the good ratings for average food are. I go out of town once every 6 weeks and just get my fill of good food in other cities.

Thai Basil provided excellent service,  friendly and quiet.  I ordered the Pad See ew. It had a great sweet and spicy flavor and very fresh.  The company I was with seemed to enjoy the food and the ambiance also.  I also tried the Som Yum salad.  It had a fresh citrus flavor.  This restaurant is definitely on my top restaurant choices.

This place has been hands down excellent every time we have dined. I am absolutely blown away by the bad reviews that have been left. I am actually sick of Yelp and sick of those that cannot give a honest review and jeopardizing the great restaurants we have in Boise.

This place is hands down one of the greatest places we have had and continue to dine at. If you want to have great sushi, fresh, great presentation, excellent service? Then support this restaurant. Learn: Take every review worth a grain of salt. Some folks want champagne on a beer budget. Incredible!

PS: Today is my anniversary and I will be dining here!

Just moved to Idaho within the past year and found this place which satisfies my Asian food craving.

I've been here twice and just enjoyed it so much that I have to write this review..  
The service is great, atmosphere is pleasant and the price is awesome.

So far, I've had the Pad Thai noodles with chicken, spring rolls, summer rolls and swai fish..  . My daughter loves their chicken pho. All of these meals were so delicious and are served in a good size portion..

Just got back. After the change in name it seems prices have jumped. 26 dollars for 4 slices and 2 beers Pabst beers which used to be a dollar. I was a big fan when it was pie hole I don't think I will be going back! I could have got a whole pitcher and a large pizza else where for 3 dollars more. I'm still hungry

Just left Zupas.  I ordered the crab avocado bacon melt, lobster bisque,  mulligatawny soup,  and a cookie bar.  I've heard a lot of people rant and rave about their soup,  but I'm a soup-maker,  so I'm harder to impress than most (: The sandwich: good,  but the bacon is so strong it almost overpowered the crab.  Both tomato slices had hard green in the middle,  so much green I didn't eat it.  Overall a good sandwich with a lot of different flavors.  
The mulligatawny: it was ok... had way too much of something similar to cinnamon,  and definitely under-salted.  It was probably my least favorite item I ordered. 
The lobster bisque: it was really pretty good once I added quite a bit of salt.  They use fresh thyme and the vegetables aren't soggy, they had just the right firmness. I agree with another reviewer who said it's TOO rich.  I think it needs to be cut with something,  the cream is just too much.   
It was good all the way around,  but just that-good.  Prices are fair,  staff is very friendly.  I just can't give more than 3 stars to something I have to season as much as I did.

I love Ashley furniture. They have the best furniture. It's quality and looks great in the home. So I was excited when this store opened in meridian. I just rented a new town house and was needing furniture. I actually went without furniture for a few weeks just so I could go the store which wasn't opened yet. I went in opening weekend. The sales person was super friendly and helpful. He had no clue when it came to operations. I think I was given 2-3 different totals by the time we got to the final part of the purchase we were off 2-3000 off the original quote. I think they need to do a little less sales training and more operational training. This review isn't about the furniture it's about the operations at this new store. I wouldn't visit this store or recommend anyone to go there. This has been the worst nightmare I have ever experienced in my life. Your supposed to buy furniture and have it delivered no later than a week. First issue, the salesman said if we run a special up to the month after my purchase they will refund me the difference. He would watch for sales and call me. The next week they ran a 25% sale did I get a call? Nope. I had to physically go the store talk to a manager and wait 30-40 minutes he says you will see your refund in 2-3 business days. Did I ever seen it? Nope. Next issue, delivery. The sales man explained since they didn't have a local warehouse it'd be 3 weeks till my delivery. The delivered my bed set and part of my living room set one chair. The love seat was damaged so they didn't deliver that and the sofa they couldn't fit in the house. Honestly these guys didn't even try they could have taken off the stair railing and took off the light cover to get more clearance. Instead they did extensive damage to my home. Ashley did say they would pay for the damages. So begins my trial; after several trips to the store, several conversations with various store managers, all my unreturned phone calls from store managers I still have no furniture this has now been one month. Finally a nice woman from their customer care in Texas calls me. She was pretty helpful; ultimately it's been two months no furniture no refund nothing. I honestly have to say this has been the worst customer experience ever. 
*note they did cancel my order no clue when I will get the refund.
*I just want the note you'll see the store responded to my compliant. It's interesting when I filed a compliant with the better business bureau they didn't respond to that compliant or attempt to remedy the issue. Now I post a bad review on yelp and they want to respond and talk about timely honestly its well past timely. Two months now no furniture in my home(no one has a place to sit when they come to my home) and sleeping on an air mattress since I have no bed is pretty ridiculous. It's up to you to choose where you take your business; I would recommend going elsewhere quality furniture horrible customer service equals furniture nightmare!!

Probably the worst Mexican restaurant in the Boise area. It's a wonder that the Health Department hasn't shut them down. I ordered 3 ground beef tacos on corn tortillas. The worker didn't even warm them, put in old cooked ground beef and a few flakes of cheese. The only thing that looked fresh was the pico. If you really want the best, fresh ingredients and great home made tortillas, go to Cafe Rio. Don't waste your time here.
Can't go wrong with the Rick's Salmon in Potato. Absolutely fantastic!  I'm not even a fan of salmon, but that was amazing. Great service too.

This was my first time eating here. It was very good food with great prices. 
I had the sweet and sour chicken with egg drop soup. 
The egg drop soup was very thick and delicious. 
The sweet and sour chicken was very tasty and very big portions for the 6.95 price. The sauce on the chicken was very tasty. 
Will go back there again!

Horrible, horrible, horrible. I can not stress enough how much this place does not deserve your business. You can tell this place is going downhill, three stars and I expect it to drop even further. The owner is the problem and he has no clue how to run a services business. He completely screwed up a phone order. We didn't catch it till we got home. His employee, Danielle, was a pleasure to talk with over the phone. She apologized for the mix up and told us to come in and she would remake the order and even comp the meal for the inconvenience since we live about 10 miles away. So I show up, then the owner comes out and completely flips on what Dannielle offered. He even argued with me telling me that he was not at fault and he gave us what we ordered. I used to go to this place and bring friends to watch UFC fights and such, and this guy didn't care at all that he was losing a long time customer. He argued with me in front of the entire store. I even got some of it on video. It was the worst customer service situation I've ever experienced. He didn't just ruin our dinner but he ruined my wife's night and for that, I'll never go back. He should take a hint from his employees and get a clue, for their sake. Seriously, go to Buffalo Wild Wings or The Curb. I can totally understand if a bad server just blows up your experience, but when it is the owner... that is the core of what this place stands for. This is a waste of your time and money.
I was there on Saturday Night after a movie with my boyfriend. I really liked the atmosphere there and we had a great server. Definitely coming back again ! Burgers are Awesome!!!!

I love this place!! Their smoked turkey sandwich is incredible - so juicy! Also their grilled chicken wrap is amazing. As for drinks, you can never go wrong with their spiked raspberry lemonade! Every time we come here, we have a great experience.  Its a fun atmosphere that isn't too stuffy. We will definitely be back.

I have been coming back to this place over and over because I love their sushi platter for 1. I think it's great quality sushi at a great price! I find myself craving it all the time. The ambiance is  more high end than most sushi places, you will also notice that their prices are $$, but it's worth it. They have a wide selection in their menu and the staff is so friendly and helpful! I've also tried their hibachi grill, but I think it's overpriced for the amount of food you get, but you do have to consider the entertainment you get from the chef. I love this place and I'm so happy they're so close to my house that I can just order to-go in the phone & pick it up!

Teppanyaki Tables: OK - these tables are loud and raucous, and the chairs are a little too short for comfort.

My wife and I had great Teppanyaki steak (her) and shrimp (him).  Best in Boise.
Good place to catch a sports game on television.  Plenty of screens and the service is great. Bartender Katy was quick to refresh drinks. Food was good too.

I ordered the egg, sausage and cheese bagel. I was not happy when they cooked the eggs and sausage in the microwave. 8.99 per dozen bagels is not a great price. Winco across the street is selling a dozen for half that price and the quality is about the same. 

Perhaps the boba drinks are good. I won't be back to find out.

Fresh food and fast! I can always count on them if I'm in a for a healthy lunch, but with little time. What would make it even better is a central fireplace during the cold months - or some kind of barrier between the seating area and customers entering from outside.

I've had occasion to call Handyman Connection twice in the past year. Each time, the workmen arrived on time, gave an estimate and scheduled the work within a few days. Both completed the work to my satisfaction. One project involved replacing a missing attic screen and required two trips and being creative about getting to the space. I was very pleased with the work and will definitely use this service again.

It was ok. Had the pad see wa or whatever it was called. It was pretty flavorless and not very spicy until I could put sriracha all over it. Priced ok, but underwhelmed by what I was hoping would be much better. Average by my estimation. May have to try again to see if it was just a bad day.

Denizens of the Treasure Valley, in my years of Yelp'ing I have learned to adjust what exactly they mean.  Panda Garden is a perfect example of what a "three star" experience is to me.  This is the kind of place that, when you are in the neighborhood, will fit the bill if this is the kind of food you are looking for.  Nothing about it will particularly impress you, but nothing will really let you down either.  Basically if you are driving down the road and find yourself in the mood for Chinese, stopping in here will satisfy you.  You won't clear time in your schedule to go here, and you won't truck across town to go here, but you'll leave happy if you stop in for a bit of sushi or chow mein.

In my case, I was taking my son to see the new Star Wars movie at the Majestic, and I let him pick from the restaurants in this strip mall for lunch.  He passed on the burgers and pizza (surprisingly) and asked for noodles... so into Panda Garden we went.  It was still very early so we were the only patrons in the place.  I ordered a few sushi rolls and my son got some shrimp chow mein.  The sushi was serviceable, about what you would expect from a place that does not specialize in it.  The spicy salmon was particularly tasty.  My son's chow mein was good also, although a bit too many veggies for his taste.  He mostly picked out all the shrimp and left the rest for me, which I didn't mind.  

Service was a bit on the slow side, considering we were the only people in the place at the time.  I think they were in the midst of hiring/training some new staff as several of the employees we interacted with seemed a bit unfamiliar with the restaurant and entrees.  So we may just have caught them at a "bad time" in terms of bringing some new staff up to speed.  That said, the restaurant business is rather unforgiving, so if service issues like this persist, Panda Garden may find itself on hard times.

Bottom line folks, if you are in the neighborhood (or in my case seeing a movie) and have the urge for some Asian food, you'll be satisfied at Panda Garden.

Last night decided to try a new place. It was just after 8:30 and saw they were open until 10. So thought great,  no one here no worries still. As the staff cleaned around us with a horrible smell and even removing the candles by us, we still thought it can still be good. The sushi was nicely prepared and taste was nice too. Dinner however was cooked hibachi style  from the kitchen, since we felt like maybe we shouldn't sit at the big table since they can still fulfill the menu item and save them from cleaning.  The food was cold, really.  Maybe focus on the customers first instead of trying to get the staff out since no one was there.

The kids were bored after 30 minutes. Overpriced for what you get. No drinking fountain?!?! C'mon. Seriously. Other jump places we have been to have a much better setup with more activities for the kids. Overpriced at $9.50/person Fri-Sunday. $8.50 other days.

Clean and organized. They make it easy to take your pet in for a quick wash. They also have a wonderful groomer, my dogs always come out looking adorable and smelling great! I highly recommend this place.

We were on Vacation here in Meridian and my partner had a new Cpap mask that was missing a part.  We went in and asked about the missing part and the employee said she'd check in the back for a part.  When she returned she had the missing part that we needed.  She GAVE it to us NO CHARGE! It was only a small plastic piece be very much needed.  
Thank you Norco-Meridian.  We will always go here first.
I highly recommend Floral Creations! Fast, courteous, same day (local) delivery. They helped me find the right floral arrangement for a thank you.
Best price in the valley for a first run matinee movie. VIP seating is so so. Dont sit in the corners . Over all. Good experience.

Super awesome pizza.  They gave me a free slice of the mozzarella pretzel and pepperoni they were testing out.  The potato bacon is the best!  I got two huge slices and two pbr's for $4.18.  I would have paid 8-10$ for this.  This place rules.

Wow!  WOW!  What a gem Epi's is.  They started off by greeting us like old friends even though this was our first visit.  And it gets better.  The food is absolutely amazing.  Heck, I could have made a 5 star meal just out of the rice side dish (kind of like paella).  Awesome culinary experience.  And then as we left were treated again like old friends, complete with hugs from the owner.  Epi's. is a special place.

Reservations are a must.

We have Panda at least once a month. Always consistent and good. Love the fried rice and shrimp. The prices are the same with this kind of restaurant. We always call in our order and pick it up for home.

Pastor Mark is on FOX channel 8 ..AM Sunday mornings.  I happened to catch that for the first time October 2016, liked it and went there a couple hours later.  The greetings started in the huge parking lot where I was asked if I was new and guided to a special parking in the front.  I walked in and was given a gift bag.  I felt accepted right away.  Since then I have taken on some volunteer opportunities and joined a Bible study group.  I love Pastor Mark's sermons.  I've learned a lot and laughed a lot.  The Holy Spirit is palatable and I look forward to going to church.

Great potential, but a few mistakes prevent this from being a fantastic new restaurant. 

I ordered the 3 piece Atlantic cod dinner, substituting one of the sides for a salad. I also ordered the fried cheese curds and drink.

The fish was fantastic quality and significant portion. A bit on the greasy side but I find this to often be the case with fried fish. The crinkle cut fries were also good, as was the salad. 

When my order was delivered they forgot the salad and cheese curds, this was quickly corrected and I didn't think about it until a coworker who went through the drive thru had items also missing from her order, not sure if it is the busy traffic or not confirming the order with the receipt. 

I didn't care for the cheese curds, my preference is probably skewed by another chain which also serves them. 

All in all an ok chain, but with room to improve.

First off, I would like to apologize to all 15 of my Yelp friends for my extreme level of inactivity as of late..... no excuses here, but I do have a lot to write about since my last post.  So I will start with this place.....

Meridian Speedway ----- conveniently located in Meridian, Idaho.   

Now, you are probably asking yourself, "What the fuck were you doing in Meridian, Idaho, you idiot??"  I know.  I know.  A foolish place to be, especially for a liberal from San Diego.  Long story short... my sister and her husband moved there for various reasons, so I went to visit.    I went there in May, but it has taken a lot of emotional breakthroughs for me to accept the fact that I now have family ties in a place known as Idaho.  I think their license plates say "Great Potatoes" or some shit like that.  "Oh really, you guys have killer potatoes....???"  Snore.  

Now, your second question is probably something along the lines of, "Why the fuck did you go to a goddamm 'speedway' in goddamm Meridian in goddamm Idaho????"  Well, the speedway was hosting MMA cage fighting and the cover was only $10, and hey, I was in Idaho... it was either that or attempt to drink an 18 pack of Natural Ice with the rest of the locals and argue with each other over who had the coolest Iron Cross or Skull and Crossbones tattoo.  

So the night moved on at the speedway, and the country music was a wailin' and the fighters were a fightin' and the crowd was a hootin'.  The third fight was about to start, and a local favorite was walking down the aisle to his corner and he was wearing a cowboy hat and a shirt that said "I HATE HIPPIES" on it.  The crowd LOVED this.  "Yeeeeaaaaahhhhhhhh, I fuckin' hate hippies toooooo!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!"  These were the sentiments of the members in the crowd behind me, to the side of me, and in front of me.  Now, I am not a huge fan of hippies or anything, but needless to say, I was a bit uncomfortable.  So I decided to go grab myself a beer to ease the tension that was building up in the crowd.  At the snack bar you can feel free to treat yourself to a bucket of beer (on tap, basically a pitcher's worth) along with a side of Freedom Fries.  And if you are really feeling up to it, get yourself some Chili Freedom Fries, or even some Nacho Cheese Freedom Fries.  "What the fuck?" I ask myself.  "People still sell those things???"  Well, apparently Freedom Fries are here to stay at the Speedway.  So go ahead and get em' while they're hot.  

Meridian Speedway gets an instant star for allowing onlookers to witness full contact carnage for only $10.  This place truly appreciates violence.  And another star for proudly promoting irresponsible amounts of drinking for only $6 (the plastic bucket of beer).  Oh and beware, knives are not allowed inside, but American made hand guns are supported and welcomed.  Only American made though.

Four people here in Meridian told me to eat here. I'm mad at them. This is not good barbecue. Every side is a separate line item on your receipt, and the total for my ribs, mashers and greens with one beer was $24! Not a full slab either. Just some dry meat on the bone with some reheated potatoes. My coworker had a salad, and said it was pretty much a salad, so I can't go off of that. 

Wish we had gone to a local restaurant instead.

We have been a few times and each time has been a good experience. Like another reviewer mentioned, I ordered the roasted red pepper and lobster soup which I really enjoy. There was surprisingly a good amount of lobster too. My husband loves the Wisconsin cauliflower soup. The sandwiches and salads have nice combinations for something different but it's those two soups that have us coming back for more.

Yes it can be busy at times and it's not the best place for conversation as it can get loud, but overall the food and service were great.

Also wanted to note that last time we went we saw an employee thoroughly cleaning the floors and tables. They even wiped down the table pole and base with cleaner which you don't see often, but it made us feel good about the cleanliness. Wish more places cleaned the way they are suppose to.

Beer, hotdogs, lots of excited fans, and loud race cars! Yeaaah!

We had a great time. Buying a ticket to get in was quick. They were very polite and professional. This prevented any sort of line from forming. 

The parking could have been better. Their doesn't seem to be any specifically designated for the Speedway. Folks were parking in the local business parking lots. Fortunately I had a tip to park at the Meridian bowling alley. 

I did learn that next time I should bring hearing protection like ear plugs!

If you're torn between this place and another I can very easily say to go to the other place. I hate when Thai places say they are Authentic Thai when in fact they are not. The food was Heavy, Bland, and not seasoned well. Very nice customer service. But that's about it. Look the other way.
Best $5 burrito your going to find the the treasure valley. I stop here 1-2 times a week on my way home from work.

What a great Japanese hibachi grill.  Our chef was amazing and such fun.   We will recommend to all our friends here in Meridian.  
Service can be slow but they are getting started and should be allowed time to get staffing up to snuff.  It is a keeper.
Super good.  Spiced just right. Nose running due to the chilies. How can you go wrong?  Homemade pickles are super sour.  Not a great wine selection for such wonderful food.
