I did not challenge the norms like most of the other reviews and did not pay attention to if I paid extra for sauce or whatever.  Any claims the others had should be addressed but I did not see them.  Love that chicken from Popeyes and they did not disappoint.  Also no wait whatsoever and very friendly service from nice people.

So why not five stars? Would love to give it to them, but in this day and age every chain should provide Wi-Fi to their customers, especially if they have it for themselves. The Wi-Fi network is private and employees are not allowed to give up the password. They are very apologetic about it but them are the rules. Manager folks, If you like, reply to the review, open up your Wi-Fi to people paying for your food and I'll give you five stars gladly.  Thank you.

Full disclosure: I've never dined in, but their take out is top notch.

I've been yearning for decent pad Thai since I moved back to Idaho, and have tried many "4-5 star" spots that were barely "2 star" spots in my humble opinion. That was until I discovered Thai Basil.

I've called in my order twice and each time it has been made to perfection. My most recent visit, I called it in, came in a little earlier than their 30 min suggestion, which can usually stress out a kitchen and service staff on a busy Saturday night, but they were graceful, accommodating, and just plain nice. They have a special bar area for take out which works really well in this small space. All of their tables were packed and the kitchen crew still looked relaxed. Their expo team had a handle on everything and I watched my pad Thai come to fruition before my eyes. 

I've only had the pad Thai here, but I keep telling myself I need to come and sit down here and enjoy something else.
Really good super secret place. So glad I found this place. Good service, clean, food was delicious, amazing price, generous portions. And the strawberry and banana shake with almond milk was

Always a fun place to visit. I've tried probably everything on the menu and have been so impressed. Come and write your name on the wall with a sharpie. It always feels like Cheers. You know, where everybody knows your name?!

Staff was friendly. I got a pizza for $6 without waiting. Not really much to be expected when you don't buy made-to-order food. Nothing to complain about given the circumstance. Their pizza is definitely better than Little Caesar's.

We went on Friday night and it was packed, which to me is a great sign at a restaurant! The waitstaff kept up with the crowd quite gracefully. The salmon was amazing! My husbands ribeye was delicious as well. So glad we got to try this triple D gem!

Busy but good spot for lunch. There was a good line but it moved quickly. The portions are a little smaller than I'd like but it's good and fresh! I got the thai coconut tofu bowl which is great for vegetarians, comes with tofu! There's a good selections of soups and salads that I'll be back to try.

We will never return to this place.  The food was below average, and the service much worse.  My Surf & Turf entree came out with ice cold seafood.

The buffet bar actually had way too many options.  Some of the items did not even look edible.

Way overpriced for the low quality food being served.  Avoid this place!
Took my 45 lb Bassett hound and cost was $16.00 which I thought was a bit expensive for a self-wash.  Facilities are good and staff was helpful.

My husband and tried this place tonight for the first time and loved it. It has a very warm and cozy feel. Our server DJ was very attentive and made great suggestions on what to order since I'm not very familiar with Thai food. I had a Thai ice tea which I have had before and it was delicious. I also ordered the coconut soup and I can honestly say it is the best soup I have ever tasted. The portions are large and the prices are reasonable. I can't wait to go back and try other dishes.

I like this place for couple of different reasons. First is the food is served quickly. Second they have plenty of options with sandwiches and soups. Third is you can mix and create a salad of your choice. The soups and sandwiches actually taste good here. Last is its close to my office. I'll keep returning.

Epi's is everything and more!!! The calamari is one of a kind! The clam chowder is to die for!! Halibut is savory, everything else is amazing..... But Chris meeting you at the door with a warm friendly hug really sets the mood for an amazing night of relaxed eating and unmatched service.... A real jewel for the Treasure Valley to be blessed with!!! Thank you for the many nights of great food and memories!!!!
A great find!  Each of our party of 4 had different soup, salad and sandwiches and shared!  Everything was tremendous!  Will definitely be back.

Really nice inside.  Realize Theater opening up new. But two popcorn machines that did not work?

Seats were great.  

Took awhile to turn on picture. As we heard previews but did not see them.  

The sound was on way to loud.  Am partly deaf and ears still hurt.   

The worse thing is you get herded out back door.  My wife wanted to use restroom, she could not.  I wanted to talk to manager.  I could not.  

Grand opening jitters so giving them 4/5 stars.

Really like Zupas! but it is crowded and busy that shows a good product. But when I was asked if I wanted extra croutons and I said yes. I saw it was a $0.69 charge. I got THREE EXTRA croutons. FYI for .69 cents you lost a customer for life! Most places I go I get Bread for free. A dozen extra maybe for .69 Cents, but 3 that is a charge of .23 a crouton they must be made of gold. I hope it is because I will not be back for the EXTRA Croutons! Hope they keep you in business...

What!?!! No peanut sauce with the summer rolls? Not a problem! You can order some for 50 cents. Who does that?!? Pad Thai tasted like the oil was old but the summer roles were good and the gluten free red curry dish was delicious. Good service.

A-ma-zing! I've been to two other sushi restaurants in Idaho and I had yet found a sushi place that I loved until I ate here. We ordered the miso soup, wonton soup, chicken udon, chicken teriyaki, Godzilla roll and Poseidon roll and everything was amazing! Even the fried rice was to die for! My husband and daughter enjoyed it all as well. Could not have enjoyed our night out any better. Can't wait to come back.

Full disclosure...I'm from update NY so want very badly for them to be successful as the family is from Buffalo! I came in and ordered a pizza and wings to bring home to the family. Had a great conversation with Joe (the owner) and it's clear to me this man has marinara running through his veins with all of the history in the restaurant business! As I waited for my order, Joe brought up samples of the stromboli for me and the other folks eating in...it was fantastic! Great flavor and the dough was fantastic. The pizza and wings I brought home were really good...I think the time it took to get it home impacted the quality just a bit...toppings slid off the slices a bit and the wings were a little greasy. I think had I eaten in, everything would have been off the charts! As it stands though, this is a great little Italian joint like you find back East. I'm excited to come back and try even more of the menu! This is a family owned, local business and I encourage everyone to try it out! Just keep in mind, this isn't a big corporate-type pizza joint and that's a great thing!

Want truly authentic Basque food?... Then have a  Basque cook it for you!  Epi's! It is to die for!... MUST make reservations.. One of those small out of the way place that is a must go to for any foodie!  You will not be disappointed.

Returned to give Izumi another chance after manager's reply to my previous review. Our group of six sat at the tepanyaki table. Our server was helpful and attentive. Our chef was entertaining (although I could do without the salmonella jokes) and the food was very good. The server and kitchen were also very accommodating to my gluten-free needs, preparing my food separately from the rest of our group. Group consensus was that the filet mignon and salmon were the tastiest.
Friendly staff and comfortable environment. My massage was subpar but other salon services were great.

This was my 2nd time here; based on the last visit I had high expectations for my dinner with my friends. I will remark it's little disconcerting to always see a now hiring sign in the window when you go out to a restaurant (seems like they have a lot of staff turnover both times I've been here they were hiring). On that note, our server was new she was lost most of the time. She definitely could have used more training; I asked about their drinks which ones she could recommend she was kind of thrown off. Seems like as a server you'd know at least 3 or 4 drinks what's in them and why you recommend them. We gave her our orders she actually came back had forgotten what one of our group had ordered. The salad and soup distribution was chaotic she didn't know who and hadn't got their soup/salad. The soup was lukewarm dare I say a little cold. She forgot to tell the hibachi chef a person in our group was allergic to salmon which was important since two people in our group ordered it. I asked for teriyaki sauce by the time I got it my chicken and steak were cold. I ordered the steak and chicken which I found to be a little bland not much flavor their two sauces were definite misses(one of them looked like fry sauce wasn't good at all). The hibachi chef to me wasn't that good compared to others I have seen mainly kept it to his regular routine wasn't very impressive to me seen a lot better. Positive he was very accommodating with the gal who was allergic to salmon and cooked the salmon last to avoid any issues. Our meal just for two was around $50 which is a little pricey as well. As far as a nice evening out for sushi or hibachi maybe they were having an off night I recommend trying other hibachi spots ''tis one one isn't one of the better ones right now in the boise/meridian area.

This was our first visit to Izumi.  We went in with a party of six with a reservation.   We were seated promptly.  The wait staff was attentive, friendly and very professional throughout.   We were served drinks right away, and our server really stayed on top of everything throughout the evening, topping off waters several times, etc..   We had a round of appetizers, sharing Crab Rangoon, a Sushi Roll, and Pot Stickers.  Appy's were fabulous.  All of our meals were  incredibly delicious.  Filet and Crab was cooked to perfection.  Tons of food and we were stuffed. 
 The Hibachi Chef was very entertaining and kept everything moving along, so we weren't waiting any extra time.  Fun evening!  We will definitely be back.

The first thing to note is what stands out the most about the Village Cinema; the quality of the venue. It's a beautifully designed building and its apparent how much they spent on the whole Village project. A great new look for Boise and That's the positive. Unfortunately that's virtually where the positive side of things end. We took advantage of the VIP seats in order to take part in the food and alcohol. The food offerings at first glance seemed to be extensive, especially for a movie theater but upon further inspection is not much more than a few apps and overpriced "entrees". I ordered the Salmon Panini and my wife the Mac and Cheese w/bacon. The panini wasn't bad taste-wise, just a little small for me. Overall good taste, but definitely not an entree as the menu indicated. Also, no sides were included with this full priced "entree". The Mac and Cheese arrived and my wife noticed it was cold. Very Cold. Being that it's a movie theater there wasn't much of a wait staff to come and check on how everything was, so common  to most food serving venues. This led me to have to leave the theater to find an employee to attempt to have my wife's dish reheated at the very least. Their microwave must have been malfunctioning that night because upon re-arrival the mac and cheese was still cold. Not a great first impression and after spending $70+ on a movie with cold entrees that were actually appetizers and overpriced alcohol, it seemed 2 stars is all The Village Cinema deserved.

I can't say enough good things about this dental practice. We just moved here a month ago and my husband had to see a dentist for tooth pain that he's had on and off for over a year. His first experience with Dr. Porter, the hygienist, and the assistant were great. I brought my 2 kids in here, as well, for a cleaning and they were excellent with them. The hygienist was friendly and thorough.  I also came here for a cleaning and saw a different hygienist and she was also excellent. I searched on Yelp and came across all the positive reviews and I'm so glad we tried this practice. I would recommend them to anyone! EVERYONE in the office is very pleasant and has a positive attitude. Five stars!!!

The first time our office ordered lunch a couple of months ago, I had the crab salad sandwich with the lobster bisque. I wish they would have noted they use the fake crabmeat as it was not appetizing at all. Also, my coworker and I both had the same lunch and we both ended up with an upset stomach so I'm not sure if it was the sandwich or the bisque that was bad. That being said, the bisque tasted great. The second time we ordered lunch, I had the turkey bacon avocado sandwich with the mushroom soup. Both were good, but the white chocolate chip cookie was the best part even though I don't normally like sweets. Today our office of 15 called at 11am to order lunch and was told they were too busy to take our order! Since they advertise box lunches that are perfect for office meetings, you'd think they'd want our business! If you want a quick sandwich, you're better off going to Jimmy John's.

I really like Indian food. This place is very good. I've just tried this restaurant recently and eaten at the buffet twice . It's not located near me but the food is good so I'll continue to come back. They offer different items at the buffet. The first time I ate there they served a lamb at the buffet that was delicious. It melted in your mouth. If you eat there I hope they serve the lamb. You'll love it.

when we go into the restaurant, the employees are friendly, but dont seem to be too concerned with customer service. I guess maybe its  the type of place that doesnt really require it, but when your waiting on something and you can clearly see its finished but the girl behind the counter went back somewhere on her phone its really irritating. i have also had a terrible experience the last three times i order for delivery. i ordered it for delivery, and ended up having to go out anyway. i drove by there, and was so upset because there were no cars in the parkinglot, but yet there was still a 45-60 minute wait on the delivery. the last thing i want to express is when i call for delivery they are so not friendly. completely the opposite of when you are in the store, short curt, "what do you want" instead of" what can i get for you" stuff like that. its annoying and if i didnt like the pizza so much i wouldnt order from there. to be honest im a little worried they are going to do something to my order next time i call.

Goodwood is a staple in the Boise area. You will not find another BBQ restaurant in the treasure valley of this quality. The food is always great. I have never had anything bad here. I use them for catering as well. The place is always clean and the staff is friendly. A great Idaho company!

We've been going to the VIP lounge for the last 6 months and ordering dinner and drinks. The food is pretty amazing. However, the french fries is the way to go. The best in town. Popcorn is good but they usually put too much oil on top of it so you have to tell them light very, light on the oil. The waitress staff is always very pleasant.
This is a great theater. Fun to go to and 5$tuesdays rock. Also it is great to go outside and watch the water water show.  Fun for a good date night.

I went right as they opened, and the buffet was insanely fresh! Such a variety of flavors, and all very good. I tried every item (I'm currently stuffed past my brim!) and for $9.99! I wasn't expecting that at all! Wow these flavors are the best in Idaho. I will tell others about this place for sure. I will come back for sure

Expensive, smaller portions, & Prozac-laced employees.

I have been resisting writing a review for Zupas for a while now.  Mostly because I keep wanting to give Zupas a second, third, fifth, twentieth chance.  Now that I am the Duke of Zupas, I feel it is time.

Zupas is a chain originating from Utah.  

The food quality is good, and consistent.  The soups are great.  Absolutely no complaints there.  
 
The staff are VERY friendly.  Like, annoying Prozac friendly.  So friendly, that it makes me mad that I'm not so damn friendly.  But it's also a loud, fake, patronizing kind of friendly.  Especially if there is a line and they're trying to push everyone down the conveyor belt.  They just yell friendly at you.  And if the tall, blonde area manager guy is up front, the loud-friendliness factor is borderline absurd.  But at other times, the staff exude an honest, genuine kind of friendly.  But most of the time, you'll have to fight through the employees' fake smiles to get to the food.  You have to experience this place a few times to know what I mean.

Portion sizes (in contrast to price): small for the price, and can be inconsistent.  Bonus: You'll lose weight eating here--not just counting your wallet being thinned out!

Salads come pre-mixed, or make-your-own.  I typically order a Pick-Two (make-my-own salad and a sandwich) plus a drink. I pay over $11.  

The consistency of serving sizes is all over the board.  Sometimes you'll have staff who put a decent scoop of topping on your salad.  Other times, you get the skimpiest amount.  I counted four (yes, 4) tiny pineapple bits counted as one-scoop during my last visit.  I asked for more, and remember that super-friendliness I was talking about?  It turned into eye-rolling and quibbling over charging me for an extra scoop of topping (.69 cents).  Apparently this server needs more Prozac.  On my previous visit, with a different staff member, I counted 8 pineapple bits per scoop, which I felt was fair. 

The management must be very hard on the staff regarding food costs, and thus the staff must push TINY portion sizes.  I'm aware this may be because of the "free" strawberry and bread chunk that's included with a meal.  I wish I could forgo the Strawberry and bread chunk, just to get some decent portion sizes.  

About a month ago, I asked for some red peppers to be added to my sandwich (part of the Pick-Two deal).  I was told that if I put peppers on my sandwich, they would have to reduce the toppings on my salad.  But yet, sometimes they'll add peppers to the sandwich without hijacking the salad toppings.  Good grief.  I never know what I'm going to get.  

And neither will you, if you eat here a couple of times.  That is, other than an fairly expensive fast-casual meal.  You'll feel that.  But you'll get a "free" chocolate covered strawberry, and chunk of bread.

In all, there's nothing at Zupas that I crave.  They don't have an Orange-Chicken.  I just go because I'm a sandwich addict.  And well, sandwiches.

Good pizza, good beer, and a fun atmosphere!

Service also really quick. Jungle pizza was dope!
Loved Cookie Cutters! The staff was helpful and very friendly. My little guy usually screams the entire time he gets his haircut, this time he was surprisingly okay during his cut!
All around great BBQ. Wife loves their smoked turkey. I favor the pork and beef ribs, pulled pork, and brisket. Service is excellent. Beer is cold and lots to chose from.

This is a great place to have a family dinner. We experienced great service and food. It was not pricey and we felt comfortable. I would recommend this place and definitely will eat there again when in town.
Good Service, Good Food, Fair Price, Good IPA. Came around 4pm, was slow so service was fast. I'll be back. Recommend the Burnt Ends and the St. Louis Ribs! Excellent!
Burgers are great but the winner was cheese curds. And I am going to try the chicken next time. Because. The batter was great on the curds. !!

My wife and I were in town visiting my dad and my aunt for a week and they couldn't wait to take us to Epi's. As soon as we walk in the door the lady working greeted my aunt by name followed by a huge bear hug. We ordered some appetizers which included fried calamari, man it was cooked to perfection, they were nice and crispy. I'll speak to the lamb I ordered.. WOW ABSOLUTELY DELICIOUS. They were finger  licking good. All in all Epi's is a great restaurant with amazing food and hospitality. I will definitely be back my next trip to Boise.

I'm as picky as they come when it comes to Japanese steakhouses. I'm from the Midwest and we had a couple that were out of this world. Moving to Idaho three years ago I was bummers with their lack of Chinese and Japanese restaurants. I had seen izumi many times after it was built but didn't really know what it was until a friend told me. We decided to try t last night and walked in around 5. They immediately asked if we had a reservation. I was a little caught off guard due to it being 5, but said no do I need one. They looked and saw a spot to squeeze us in. They literally did squeeze us in as it was already hopping for being so early. I had a 4 year old and 2 year old with me so they could have easily said they didn't have room, but was very appreciative of their extra efforts. They also made some balloon animals for my little girls who LOVED them. I judge Japanese steakhouses by the soup, the salad, the rice, and finally the meat. Izumi exceeded expectation in all areas and the chef "who could barely speak english" was absolutely hilarious and made the table have a ball with the saki. A few would have liked him to cut the saki shot off a little sooner but did make it pretty freaking hilarious. The girls loved it and we had a blast with great food, great atmosphere, and phenomenal service! Thanks for taking care of my family last night! You guys get it!

Lowest possible score.  Worked with one contractor who was consistently late or didn't show at all.  

He told me that "he didn't care cause HC is filling up his Saturday's". 

He also asked me to pay him under the table because HC takes a cut.

This place is just what you need after a long day! Great service, great great service! great food! Great beer list! I want to make a special thanks to Melissa the bartender, and Heather the server.

I had the wings l, dry rub, they were delicious. The nachos are huge! Definitely enough for a group. 

....Thursday night. Another great visit. Feels like a place to just have a dinner party with friends.  Thanks again Melissa!

My husband and I come here about twice a month. He loves it because he can choose the seats and we go next door for frozen yogurt after the movie is over. They usually have more time options then the other local theaters. You do not have to wait in line EVER.

The food is not bad . The challenge is to get it the way you want it. When we first tried the restaurant we ordered Chicken fried rice it came with carrots, peas, egg and large pieces of chicken which were very tough. After the first visit We decided to order carry out. The order was very simple no carrots , cut up chicken into smaller pieces and cook it . We Got no peas no egg and very little chicken we also got carrots. We tried several times to get it right but it never happened. We would ask the waiter to speak with the cook and make sure it was right .A few weeks  ago we made the same order and all we got was a few pieces of chicken and nothing else. A few days ago I tried something else the waiter asked if I wanted brown  or white rice . I asked for white rice. When  I got home  and took my order there was no rice at all. I called the restaurant and got nowhere . It was decided that I go somewhere else. If you have a lot of time and don't care about getting what you ordered than go ahead. Its really not worth the effort

Very nice theater. Spent a little extra to sit in the VIP and ordered some food. Food was good (had a panini) and the secluded balcony was good too. Not sure id spend the extra money to sit in the VIP again though. Really like the aspect of choosing your own seat. All in all, just another theater, but the food/alcohol/VIP options give you a few more options.

I love this place! I bring my dog here every few weeks for a do it yourself bath. It's clean, neat, smells nice, and all of the supplies are provided for you. I love the walk in tubs that are high enough as to not kill my back. It's very reasonably priced considering all the supplies, the convenience and there is no clean up!  I have always chatted with the owner and he is very friendly :).

We ate there last night. The food and service was exceptional. My lamb stew was warm but not hot. Maybe good for most people. I like really hot food so I was a little disappointed in that however the taste was divine.  I would certainly eat there again many times over if I lived in Boise.

First of all the service here is the best I've ever received!

More importantly, I've never had basque food before, but I know good food and the food here is delicious! This will definitely be a regular spot for me when I'm in town. I'm sure everything is amazing here, but I had:

Roasted garlic chicken
Cream of mushroom
Grilled cod with pimentos & garlic
Green apple bread pudding

Totally recommend this place!

Lamb stew is fantastic, so is beef medallions, leg of lamb good but not the best that I have had. Triple layer chocolate  cake was good but the rice pudding was runny and rather lacking.  

Friends say that the fish dishes are excellent.  Five stars for lamb stew and friendly service.

I will start off by saying I have been hesitant to try this place, mostly because of the name...but last Friday we decided to give it a go. We were a group of 4 adults and 4 children (7-11), when we got there it was extremely busy(don't go if North Dakota is playing hockey) we had a table in the back corner, within about 10 minutes. It took another 15 minutes to get our drinks ordered and then another 10 to have them delivered. The pickle chips tasted like burnt fish. Another 20 minutes passed and our food started to come out....person by person. None of us had our food at the same time, they forgot one of the kids food. Over all it was a horrible 2 hour experience.

Epi's is our favorite place to go when celebrating any occasion because the food and atmosphere are both amazing. Thank you Kris for being such an amazing business owner and making us feel so welcome every time we come for dinner. If you have not been there make yourself a reservation right now and treat yourself because everyone deserves a night at Epies.

A girlfriend and I just went in to look around and I went home with a new bedroom set. There was a great selection and many different styles. Paul was a great help and fun to work with. I'm really excited to get my new furniture in my house.

We were very disappointed. We ate the food from the bistro while we watched a movie. So, I can't say that it was exactly the same as the restaurant, but they bill it as being the same. Most of our dishes were just poor (probably 2 star quality considering the price). But the quesadilla appetizer was borderline insulting. We ordered the loaded quesadillas (paying for the extra toppings). There was one tablespoon scoop of sour cream, one tablespoon of salsa, one tablespoon of guacamole and a microscopic amount of cheese and 5 or 6 large tortilla wedges. We were just incredulous. There were enough toppings for maybe two wedges if you parsed it out carefully. That dish was so poor and so reflective of a disregard for the diner that it brought the 2 star rating down to one. 
By the way, this is my first one star yelp review. We are typically fairly forgiving diners, but I felt that this was an especially bad experience and deserving of my new record low.
This our family birthday place.  Friendly staff. Lunch time I think is your best deal.  Food is always good,  hibachi grill or the sushi. Plan on great show.

Bland us the best word to describe Panda Garden food. Vegetables are limp and dull, not crisp and bright. Most meat is cooked way past tender. Eggs rolls are soggy and greasy. Soups are one area of promise. All three soups I have tried were above average. The sushi offerings are decent. Seared tuna was another good presentation, bordering on excellent. I keep hoping to see  big improvement as they get over new place jitters. They are close to me for delivery. I hope they step it up.

$7 for two slices of yummy pizza & drink complete with a rooftop view!

Good flavor a bit greasy but in a good way. I like the crust!

Open late!
Fast & friendly service!
Good deal!

My husband and I have been here twice and we enjoyed it both times.  The burgers and fries are delicious and their side salad is huge for being just a "side" salad.  

However there was only one waitress working on the lunch shift (one of the owners perhaps) and the place was packed.  I felt bad for her cause she was busting her hump serving and cleaning up.  I wanted to help her out .

But I still gave this place five stars cause she was very friendly and the food was good.
Goodwood consistently provides excellent food, service & friendly warm atmosphere. Great place to eat.

Like another reviewer noted...the food was great, but the staff was unfriendly. I also felt ripped off when the soup server asked if I wanted croutons. I said "Sure," not realizing this was a .69 add-on. I got 5 small croutons for .69. The soup girl also seemed irritated when I changed my mind about which soup I wanted, even though she hadn't started dipping into the soup yet. If the staff had been friendly and not so sneaky upselling something that should be included, I would have given them 5 stars.

I must admit the food is good and I like the concept, however it's way too expensive for the portions and does it really take 14 people to make a salad? What's up with the 7 point system? When did ordering a salad become so complicated?

To start the service was a 10, no problem there. I had the 3 meat combo with 2 sides. I chose brisket, sausage and burnt ends for the 3 meats and mac n cheese and potato salad for my sides. The brisket was fantastic and would be my first choice, super tender with a excellent sauce. The sausage had great flavor but was close to being too salty but still a solid selection. The burnt ends were ok but a bit fatty for my taste. The potato salad had a really good but subtle flavor, that is something I would order again. The mac n cheese was not my cup of tea, it was too gooey. It reminded me of processed cheese. The flavor was ok but not enough to save it.  BTW try the lemonade it was really good and a nice option if you don't want a soda.

Tonight we had a great dinner at Goodwood!   Friday night can be a bit of of a wait but we'll worth it.  As we were waiting I saw this HUGE plate of ribs come by.. Not baby back ribs like I always have but BEEF Ribs. Ong they were so good and tender!  So if you get a chance to try them you won't be sorry.  And the best onion rings in town.

If you're a fan of delicious, thin crust pizza with a fun and creative choice of toppings, this is your place.

In the one year that I've lived in Meridian, I frequented this joint enough to fill-up my "buy nine slices, get the 10th one free" card, and I'm now working on my second. And while I don't exactly have a table with my name on it here, I think that I've at least visited Pie Hole enough to confidently give it a "highly recommend going" endorsement.

More often than not, I show up for a late lunch. No lines. No waiting. Plenty of time to read the writing on the wall... no, seriously. People write on the wall.

Anyway, this is Idaho, so finding that one of their most popular specialty pizzas has potatoes on it, no surprise. They usually have about a 4 to 6 ready-made specialty pies available.

The counter service is fast and friendly. 

One exception to the normally good service, however, was a few visits ago when I came in around 2 pm on a weekday, and I stood at the counter (in plain sight of the employee) for at least a good 30 seconds before she acknowledged that I was there. Why? Because she was so enthralled with texting, or finishing her game of Candy Crush, or whatever it was on her phone that was more important than work.

But to end on a good note, I live a low carb lifestyle, and that means that of the very small amount of starchy carbohydrates that I do consume, potatoes and especially breads are not even on my radar, except on my built in "cheat" days. So to say that this is one of two pizza joints in the greater Boise area that I'll consider cheating for... well, that should account for something.

This is definitely one of the best Sizzlers I have been to. I just moved from California and long ago after my last visit to one in California I vowed to never go back. Many of the ones there are just run down and gross. Not this location! We were pleasantly surprised by how clean and new the place looks. All of the food was fresh and the dessert station had so many goodies. There were brownies, rice crispy treats, cones and more. We are used to only getting the ice cream and maybe some old crumbled cookies. Great service too!

Well this was interesting. The atmosphere is really awesome. The service was not awesome. We order mozzarella sticks; they were prompt in bringing them to us and then they tried to bring us a second order. They forgot the strawberry lemonade. We asked for it again so they brought it and then another person tried delivering another one. The mozzarella sticks we're so big that we could barely eat one. The flavor was decent and the dipping sauces were good. The Cesar salad was large but so plain. The dressing had no flavor. The pizza wasn't supposed to have sausage on it but it came out with sausage. They offered to remake it but we decided to just pick it off. They did give us a discount for that. All the toppings seemed to be on one side of the pizza. The crust was nothing like the pictures. It was kinda thick and chewy...not the way it looks in photos. I wasn't impressed.

Upon walking in, you have to be impressed with the interior design- there aren't many places like this in Boise. It is dark, sleek and very clean. While it LOOKS nice, the set up just doesn't seem functional for a restaurant.

The center of the restaurant is a large square bar (which was completely empty) and then there are three compartmentalized rooms with tables. I found this to be incredibly weird being separated from other diners. The people eating hibachi were separated from other diners and in the regular dining section there are 6 tables squished in a corner. There is another room in the back with tables, I'm assuming it is overflow for busy nights.
The table set up is very uncomfortable. 

I get a Hibachi meal at any Japanese steakhouse I visit and Izumi followed the standard : soup, salad, rice, vegetables and the entrée. Their pricing is about the same as other Japanese steakhouses. Food was good, not spectacular, but good.

Overall it is a pretty decent place for the style of food that they serve. I would recommend to dine in the hibachi side of the restaurant for comfort purposes.
Service is slow, they treat you like you are an inconvenience.  They seem to be short handed and the process being used for outside service by only the bar tender is flawed.
Horrible customer service, they just changed their name and were advertising a $1 promo, we were treated like crap because we wanted the promo price. Also very very very greasy, pizza had no flavor.

Tera Greene has been charged with patient abandonment in two different states. She is now working for CR Smiles. Read what the Idaho Attorney General, the Washington Attorney General and the Better Business Bureau have to say about her.

I had the most wonderful experience with the Meridian nurse-midwives for prenatal care, and the Meridian hospital during the delivery of my third baby. Having stayed at two different hospitals in the past, I can definitely say St. Luke's was easily the best. 

The nurse-midwives are competent, compassionate, and caring. They made me and my family feel welcome at all my prenatal appointments, quickly responded to my concerns and easily scheduled me in. They truly are the sweetest and most professional group of ladies. Tasha is brilliant; she is so knowledgable and detailed. I always go to her when I have questions that need specific answers. She knows the latest studies and goes above and beyond to address your concerns. Helene is also very kind and well-informed. Tamara delivered my baby and she is so sweet, very relaxed and easy going. And their RN and receptionist are warm and welcoming, and remember you by name.

The hospital experience was equally wonderful. The nurses, the facility, and the availability of food (you can order as much as you want, whenever you want), were all incredible.

I am so thankful to all the St. Luke's staff for making my third delivery so wonderful. They even followed up with calls to see how I was recovering, a handwritten note from the nurses who cared for me, and a necklace from the nurse-midwife clinic. They truly gave me the VIP treatment!
Great theater but I can't eat the popcorn because it's super salty. The last time I was there I had to get a refund because there was so much salt it was inedible.
Great service!! Food was also pretty tasty! I'd recommend getting everything at level 2 spice level. It's extra hot after that. Definitely try the Salmon. It's phenomenal.

*****5-star casual dining***** I met some friends here before a movie to grab a quick bite to eat before the show. Boy oh boy was I in for a surprise! Though I'd never been here before, the ratings seemed like it'd be okay. They have a huge variety of hot dishes, and also sushi! Delicious was the orange chicken, with just enough spice to keep it from being too sweet. Can't give you a report on the teriyaki chicken, my 13 year old inhaled it! (I'm not sure if he chewed at all...he made quick work of a huge mound of food!) Seeing as I was going to see Kung Fu Panda 3, dressed panda-style, I figured it was only fitting to order the 'panda sushi roll'. It was very flavorful, and beautifully presented! Sorry I have no pictures this time, though I will be back soon and often with even more friends and not in a rush for a movie, and will post pictures! The service was quick and accurate, as well as warm and welcoming! Definitely recommend!

The sushi was amazing!  We had the king crab/avocado roll, salmon/avocado roll, the Idaho roll with the crunch on the side and my husband had his favorite, an eel/avocado roll.  The server, Yun, was very helpful choosing gluten free rolls and brought out gluten free soy sauce!  The sushi had a thin layer of rice and a good amount of fillings.  The seaweed salad was very delicious and the presentation of it and the sushi was good to look at!  The restaurant is nice and spacious so it had a very relaxing atmosphere.  It was our first time here but definitely not our last!  In fact, we can't believe we waited this long since it opened to try it out!

Stayed at the hotel next door and came over for two different nights. First night I went with the servers recommendation of steak nachos. They were large and very good. The next visit I went with the BBQ burger. Also very good and the tater tots were a nice option. Service was good and a good happy hour.

My favorite Indian Food place in the Treasure Valley. I am super picky about Indian food and this place hit all the right notes. It's a small quaint place where seating for 4 is most comfortable. 

The lunch buffet is extensive and offers over 10 different dishes. The Chicken Makahani was one of the best Indian dishes I have had in some time. They have additional ways to spice up your food should you choose to have more heat. The Lamb Vindaloo was also very good. 

The prices were where they should be. I can't wait to take my family here. The unlimited naan without having to ask for it was a nice bonus. I loved this place and will definitely be back.

Absolutely great service! I called with a last minute request to have a large party catered and they couldn't have been more pleasant and accommodating! They called to confirm my order first thing in the morning and were promptly on time. Nick was a lifesaver for my frantic last minute call. 
Food was great- we had the hot sandwich bar and a few boxed salads. I'll definitely be using them again for business lunches.

I live very close to the Panda Garden and have eagerly monitored the restaurant's progress since they announced they would be opening. There are very few Chinese restaurants in South Meridian and I hoped desperately that Panda Garden would be good. After weeks of waiting, they opened and I was not disappointed! 

For my first take-out order, I asked for the Chicken Amazing (with a name like that, you have to try it) and Crispy Sesame Beef. I also got a side of pork fried rice. Everything was made to order and I waited about 15mins. for the food to be ready, I should have ordered online, which you can do! http://boisepandagarden.com/menu.asp

The food was great! The Chicken Amazing was surprisingly spicy but good and the Crispy Sesame Beef was also good. The fried rice was above average but not the best in town but that is me nit picking details and comparing it to other Chinese places in the valley. 

I will also say that while I waited, the service was very good. I was offered water and then a refill when I ran low. The waitress was very friendly and we talked about cooking shows on TV until my food was ready. 

I will definitely go to Panda Garden again and encourage anyone in South Meridian to swing by there and try them out. If your experience is like mine, you will not be let down!

The food was disgusting. The chicken had no flavor, the gravy on the potatoes was lackluster, the potatoes tasted like wallpaper paste. The worst was the biscuits. They were just disgusting. One bite and my entire family soit them back out. The tasted like salt. Just salt. The lingering taste prompted my to ask my son for his shoe to chew on to get rid of the taste. And after we ended up throwing away the inedible food, my wife ended up in the bathroom to vomit.

Pretty great food.  The salad dish we had with beef sauté and vinegar red onions cucumbers and cabbage was amazing.  Just make sure if you ask for medium spice be prepared to take it in the shorts a little.  But overall the dish was amazing.  
Friendly service.  Only complaint is we went past the regular dinner hour and the staff was too busy talking to fill the water glasses timely.

This is fine dining at its best, without the stuffiness of places with waiters in starched collars and an expectation to dress up. The experience at Epi's is more like going to your favorite aunt's home and having her dote on you.

Reservations are always recommended and I called and left a message on their voice mail Saturday morning for a table that evening. Co-owner Chris Ansogegui (who runs Epi's with her sister Gina Urquidi) called me about noon and sounded excited to have us join them for dinner.

She was also the one who greeted us warmly as we entered the erestaurant, a former home on Meridian's Main Street.

I ordered lamb chops (Arkumea Txuletak) and my companion ordered beef tongue (Mingaina) in a pepper and tomato sauce.Before we got those entrees, however, we had a Calamari (Kalamareak) appetizer that was the best squid dish I have ever eaten.

There were also a house bread, a green salad and our choice of a red bean and cream of mushroom soup. We ordered one of each and they were both excellent. The mushroom soup even had a slight spice bite that was very pleasant.

The main dishes were superb. The lamb chops came grilled and were perfectly charred and very flavorful. The tongue was soft and easily cut with a fork. 

We finished off the meal by sharing a slice of chocolate mousse cake. It was also very good.

The service was impeccable. Our waitress came by often and boxed leftover items as we finished each course. Chris also served dishes and roamed around the dining room talking to patronsand asking how they were enjoying their meals.

This is not a place for dining on the run. We spent two and a half hours there and it was hard to believe we had been there that long. Everything was served in courses and they waited until you were finished with one before moving on to the next.

By the way, the closing hours are misleading in a sense. They aren't when the business shuts down but rather the ending time to seat new diners. So you've still got plenty of time to order and eat your meal.

The Ansotegui family has a long food service history. Epi Inchausti, whose grandchildren named their restaurant in her honor, is considered the matriarch of Basque cooking in Idaho. Epifania and husband David Inchausti opened the Gem Bar and Boarding House in Hailey in 1936. 

Ernest Hemingway, Clark Gable, Bing Crosby and Tennessee Ernie Ford and Gary Cooper were among the celebrities she cooked for. An annual lamb dinner and auction that Epi and other area Basque women organized in the 1940s as a benefit for St. Charles Catholic Church is still held.

Dining at Epi's isn't cheap. The tab can run to $50 a person, but the food and service are well worth the price for an occasional big night out. It's a great experience, as you can tell by reading all of the other reviews here. It's a rare place indeed that deserves and consistently receives such high praise.
I had the signature pedicure, Tressa did a great job! This will be my new go to for pedis!

Savannah our server was fantastic. she was willing to do almost anything to ensure our visit was good one. The host was very polite and got us to our table faster than promised. For this reason is why I regret only rating 3 stars if Goodwood wants to keep my business the kitchen is going to have to step their game up. my food did not come to the table as described  In the menu, and the quality just wasn't there tonight.

Had the bbq sandwich and enchilada soup for dinner - puked my brains out all night. Pretty sure the beef or cabbage had spoiled and got food poisoning from this place. 

Experience there wasn't as bad as throwing up all night but we wouldn't have gone back to this location even before the food poisoning. Messed up our order and didn't really care to fix it.

Food was wonderful and the people were friendly. The service (Marty) was first-rate and very helpful and accommodating for the children.
I had the cod, both ways. The sauce was great for dipping and the fish prepared well.  I do not normally like peas but these were quite enjoyable. (raving about peas, yes I know that is odd)

Second time here and both times had excellent service and food! The calamari is a must try as is the Sunnyslope pizza with tart cherries and chorizo! Also have a good beer selection. Prices are excellent for the quality of food you are getting.

Since I have a new addiction; KNIVES, I have been busy on the interweb buying knives. Well, I NEEDED to get a Spyderco Para Military 2 in orange G10 scales and CTS-XHP steel. I seen it was a Cutlery Shoppe exclusive. My 1st time ordering from them, simply flawless process, and I must say, super fast shipping. I even had to call and check on my order due to an oversight by ME, not sure of her name, but the CS rep on the phone was super friendly, professional, understanding, and helpful. My knife shipped within hours of placing order, and arrive 2 days ahead of tracking! Also was neatly packaged and sent with several suckers and a nice CS pen-nice touch. Just wanted to say it was a pleasure doing business with CS, and I will look to them again soon for more KNIVES! How many knives do I really need? Probably many more........:)

I stumbled upon this place, being new to the area, and was pleased with the decor and smells from the kitchen. The menu was overwhelming due to the choices. I had the berry salad which had an interesting dressing and California Turkey. They were both very tasty. I will have to venture here again.

Date night for the first time in forever with my wife...sorta forgot her name it's been that long since we've been out.  We did dinner at Kona Grill, which is also a decent place, and moseyed over to the Village Cinema for a drink and to watch Agent 47 (her pick) in the "VIP" area where you can have a big kid drink while you watch the show.  

As far as theaters go, the place is nice.  Clean, bright, sorta upscale in the common area.  Nice comfy bar stools, etc.  The standout was the huckleberry collins (no, I'm not a sorority girl, it was happy hour, and it was actually pretty good) and the service by the bartenders.  We had a drink a the bar, brought a second with us to our seats, and ordered some popcorn for the show in the VIP area.

The popcorn was better than a discount theater, but nothing to write home about.  The server was great, and the sound and movie experience were all up to par.  The only nitpick was about seating.  In other 'eat in the theater' places, there are tables in front of you.  At the village, there are wide arms between the seats and that's it.  So you end up feeling like you're on the other side of the couch form your date, fumbling to share the popcorn.  Not horrible, but just a little off.  It made me wonder how people would go about eating a burger or nachos or an actual meal there, and not just something they could pass back and forth with one hand.  

All in all, not bad.  We'll be back someday for date night (hopefully before 2017...)
We come to Sizzler often this time the waitress at the front refused to make eye contact and kept staring at the people next to us, very weird. That is really my only complaint is the waitress .

Decided to take my husband and visiting son and daughter in law along with our daughter for my husband's birthday dinner. We walked in and the place smelled wonderful! We were seated at a table and our server Taylor greeted us with a warm and friendly demeanor, took our orders and brought us some of those delicious cornbread muffins. All was fabulous and then.......our family dinner platter was brought out by Janna, who dropped the platter, dumping the entire $65 platter of food on our table, and shouting sh$t" as we watch our meal scatter across the table in front of us. Then, Janna knocks our daughter's iced tea with her elbow and the entire glass of tea pours into our daughter's lap. To which Janna exclaims, "I love family platters!!" Our daughter sat,soaked in tea. She was not offered a towel or apology. Instead, we were told that our salads were fine. As Janna prepared to serve us our salads with half of the dinner platter still spread across the bare tabletop, we decided it was best if we left. As we got up to leave, Janna was clearly mad that we were walking out. As my family walked out and my husband pulled the manager aside, I watched Janna go to another employee, whisper something to her, and toss her head back laughing over the situation. Appalling display of unprofessionalism How about at least waiting until the guests that you angered walk out before you start humoring over what you did? We  will not return. We don't care if your food is good. Your service sucks.


Update: Owner contacted us and offered an apology and a free meal. We appreciate the apology but for now we will go elsewhere. Thanks.
Fun, clean, entertaining atmosphere with great food!  Perfect for date night or with the whole family.

Came here on Father's Day with the family to try their Hibatchi. I have been here several times for sushi lunch deals and have been impressed with their rolls. They tend to use less rice on their rolls than other places which I really like. However today with their Hibatchi, it was really good.   The chefs were fantastic and very funny!  The show is different than the other Hibatchi spots around town with giving shots of sake throughout their show.  Our group was a mix of adults and kids and everyone enjoyed it. The food was great too!  My husband got scallops and chicken and I got their shrimp.  It was definitely a fun experience with the family!

Took my mom for her 82nd birthday here and we had a fabulous time. Great food and great experience they even gave us a lunch special after 3 o'clock. And will come back. The hibachi lunch is a great deal and you should give it a try mom says it's a nice experience. They even sing to you and let you bang on the drum if it's your birthday.

The food is a 4, the service is a 6, averaging to a 5.

We went for my birthday, 1/25 and it was a Tuesday. I called at 5:15 to see if we needed a reservation because I know on the weekend you must.  I told Kris (the owner) that it was my birthday and that my husband is from Spain.  She is perhaps one of the nicest people I've met in my life.  

Kris' grandmother is Epi, who immigrated to Idaho from the Basque country, and handed down the recipes.  

Now seeing that my husband is from Spain (not Basque Country) we have had more croquetas than one would possibly want to imagine, and I have to say, Epi's has some of the best croquetas I've had in my life. She told me that her brother-in-law, who is Basque, makes them every day. 

The rest of the food was good, but nothing so spectacular.  For my birthday she gave me a piece of cake to-go (also made by the brother-in-law), and I had it when I got home, and it was really, really good too.

I would definitely recommend Epis for a great dinner experience out.
He had Kung pao shrimp (hot) & I had Pra Ramlong Song (chicken, medium) with some Thai Egg Rolls and everything was wonderful! Will definitely go back!
It was really good and it was delivered 20 minutes before we expected it.  Everything that we ordered was good no one had any issues. We all had leftovers. Way more food for one meal.

I love their Panang curry.  I crave it!   My husband usually gets some other kind of curry...green...massaman....and he likes it spicy hot.  They always ask him twice to make sure, but they do add the heat and he always says it's delicious.   This is our favorite little strip mall Thai restaurant in the area.

Bought a firearm.  The counter guys were on top of things, paying attention to every single customer.....just looking or buying.  Knew their 'stuff', friendly and courteous.  Unlike the snobs at their nearest competition (if you could call them that), you know...starts with a Cabel.....uh?  I was invisible at that store.  Too bad for them did I mention pricing?  Sportsmanship regular price was less than the other stores sale price!  Keep up the good work.  They would rather have a customer come in three times and spend five bucks rather than one time and spend ten.  It's called volume and customer service.

First of all they got my order wrong at the window then when I called spoke with the manager he said he said I could come back tomorrow and get my order right seeing how I have to immediately go to work That was supposed to be my dinner for the night so I went back the next day before work for my dinner in the lady that was manager at that time was quite rude and said that policy doesn't allow them to give me a new meal even though it was quite expensive and actually I had to wait 15 minutes for my meal in the first place the service is bad the managers are horrible and rude I would suggest you take the 10 minutes that it takes to drive down the road on Fairview to go to that Popeyes instead of going to this one close to the Village

Very clean well appointed Marriott. Great value for the area. Excellent central location just no from major shopping and great restaurants. The only thing that needs improving is the AM attention to service - I wanted a Coffee (which they used to provide free) and I stood there for 15 min and no one was there to serve it?  Some gal was vacuuming the floor and asked me as I walked out "can I get you something? " uh? Clean that up and I'll be back

Very impressed with Thai Basil. I stopped in for lunch and it was under $20 for two meals. The food was delicious and the staff was so friendly and provided wonderful service. I will be coming back soon and highly recommend it to others.

Updated rooms , close to Boise State , great restaurant in the lobby. Room rates are reasonable and hotel parking is free with plenty of space. If your visiting your family member going to college this is a nice hotel stay !

This is a perfect restaurant.  Nice setting.  Phenomenal food.  Servers extremely attentive, anticipating your needs.  Pricing very competitive.  I love the burnt brisket ends sandwich or platter.  Also, the nachos (with chunks of smoked beef on top) are the best I've ever had and are a complete meal in themselves.  In fact, I often order the large platter and take half of them home.  Don't miss this joint.

This is my new favorite restaurant, the service was awesome! Our hibachi chef was very entertaining, the food was amazing! It was fairly expensive (100.00$ for 2 people,) but definitely made for a great date night!

We went on a Saturday around 1pm for lunch. The place was rather empty but that's probably because they just opened a week ago. We sat down at the Hibachi grill with a little family across from us. Lunch prices were fairly reasonable. My boyfriend was a little upset that they would let him make a switch on the lunch combination by paying extra to add filet mignon as an option. We both ended up getting the filet mignon. It was delicious. The meat was so tender and delicious. The service was great. They very attentive and the dining entertainment was great. Will probably go back sometime.

Relaxed casual place with fantastic food and service.

First, it's a quirky little place and easy to miss if you don't know where it is but it's well worth finding. A bit more expensive than it looks at first glance but don't let that turn you away.  The food is well worth it. 

Even on a busy night, the service was friendly and attentive without being annoying.  They let us eat and talk and enjoy ourselves. 

The food is why we will return though.  Everything is just a little bit different and all delicious, even down to the bread pudding desert.

I had the saltiest potato soup at this location. We stopped by and picked up and order to-go. Without dramatizing, I felt that there was an entire block of salt in my soup and I could not finish it so I threw it out. Also, I counted exactly one piece of potato in my bowl. I've been to a different Zupas and had a better experience than the one at this location.

I really wanted to get excited about a GREAT Meridian pizza joint. Unfortunately, Johnny's is not it. The crust is chewy, tasteless, and forgettable. I have had better experiences with store bought frozen pizza. If a local business can't produce better quality than my grocers freezer, why are they even trying?

Had such a great time. The staff makes you feel at home and the food was Incredible. I had the butter fish special which was melt in you mouth delicious. Soup of the day, clam chowder was so light and creamy. Our waiter brought my son a taste of the tongue which was quite interesting. Desert was incredible too. Green apple bread pudding. Thanks for a great end to our trip!
Wow. Such great tasting food. The whole experience is very rewarding. The red bean soup will win anyone prize for Best of Show.  The lamb is finger-licking goooood!

Reliance moving is the best. They showed up on time. Were extremely professional and honest. Helped my roommate with her stuff. They stayed and put together a very complicated piece of furniture. There weren't any hidden costs.  They were extremely efficient. Best decision for moving!

I was spoiled when I lived in Seattle and didn't think I would find a decent Thai place down here. It took awhile but I found Thai Basil and it is great and good prices. Try the Pad See Eew, my favorite!

100% change from my first experience. My first trip I was so unhappy and left one star but after this trip!!! 5 stars!!! Shelbi was so good with my son for his first cut! I will go back the staff was so amazing
Best. Meatballs. Ever. And I am Sicilian. (Don't tell my Ma or my Grandma, I would be clubbed and shoved in a trunk)

We visited Blue Tiger Pizza after reading about it in the paper because we love supporting local businesses instead of chains. We had the breakfast pizza with over easy eggs and it was pretty good! Although I really liked the runny eggs, I wish the pizza had more sauce and maybe some breakfast sausage or something like that. The cooked cherry tomatoes on top were delicious!
We also had the meat balls, and they were very good.
One of my favorite parts of this restaurant was the beer selection. We are big craft beer drinkers so we appreciated the IPA selection. We would definitely eat here again!

Ordered delivery from here the other day to be delivered to our hotel 
Arrived in a timely fashion 
Order was correct and hot 
Reason for 4 stars was 
1) the egg rolls had a funky taste.  Maybe nothing wrong with them just we didn't care for them 
2) hot and sour soup was bland 
3) the sushi didn't seem very fresh 

All in all it was just ok 
I doubt if in the area we would order from here again

Another strange city, another phenomenal meal thanks to yelp.  I did a quick search in the Meridian/Boise area. Rick's popped up with some great reviews. I checked the website and found a link to YouTube for one of Guy Fieri's dives, Diners and Drive ins. I watched the clip     http://m.youtube.com/watch?v=VxASIhSQf2k   And headed straight for my rented car. 

I walked in the place was completely empty. Not a good sign. Oh well...  I already knew what I was going to order and I was able see that Rick, the owner, was in the kitchen. No guesswork here. I walked straight up to the bar and a cute gal named Curry was waiting for me. She gave me a taste of a couple of the local beers. I chose a pale ale (can't remember the name, but she said it was made with some kind of swamp water...) and grabbed a table. 

From the video clip, I chose the hot wings, a bowl of cheese soup and the potato salmon dish. Rather than bore you with the description of the dishes, watch the clip if you are really interested. 

It was fantastic. The service was great.  The owner poked his head out and thanked me. Happy belly........

O Brady's makes some of the most craveable wings in the Treasure Valley. Never been much for chain restaurants, but they do a nice job here. I usually go for the dry-rub, but have had a couple of flavors of the tossed that I enjoy as well. The happy hour specials are nice and the wait staff is always attentive.
Draw back: nothing to do except stare at gigantic TVs plastered on every inch of the restaurant and bar. There isn't any charm to the joint or personality. Hey, I'm sure it's good for a game, but damn.

Back for a second try at Rick's. Wasn't sure my experience could be better than the last one, but it absolutely was! Pisoli soup was amazing. The Parmesan crusted chicken left me wishing I had a second stomach as I wanted to eat another plate. This is my new favorite restaurant. If you are debating coming here, end the debate and get here now!  Enjoy.

Love it....love it!  Great food...always consistent.  Fab help...
They are SO nice and it is always good!  We all liked our meals!

Probably won't do VIP level expecting something great. We wanted the full experience the village cinema provided. 

Let me first start with the environment. The cinema is quite beautiful and well laid out. So far it looks clean and not dated, as one would expect from a new place. The theater was roomy, and the chairs were wide and comfortable. The backs of the chairs reclined back pretty far. For the VIP, the shared armrest is wide enough to set a plate on it. 

We arrived 30 min early as recommended by the cinema. Well the theater was not ready for customers yet as they were still cleaning. This didn't start good. I shrugged this off though and moved on. 

Next let me talk about the food. There is nothing special to eat. I tried the loaded nachos with pulled pork, the result is I think I can have better nachos at a rodeo or state fair. They were bad, and to make it worse the price was around $11. The service is not good either, the staff is inexperienced and still learning the ropes on how to coordinate a meal with the movie. I felt like they were disorganized most the time. 

Summary. It is only worth going if you want a beer with your movie. I do not recommend ordering food. Just stick with the traditional dinner and a movie date night, that way you get the food you want at a good price.

Eggs rolls were really good.  Pad Sew Ye (spelling) was different than at other Thai restaurants I have eaten it at, but it was good.  Typically that dish has broccoli in it, but they used some other leafy type vegetable that I didn't care for.  A little spicy for 2 stars.  Would order 1 star next time.  The service was excellent.  Will eat there again.

Epi's......... Definitely in a class of it's own!!! I have been wanting to eat here for years but somehow I always forget about it when my wife and I are playing the where to eat game. Due to an UYE (Unofficial Yelp Event) I had the pleasure of checking Epi's off my places I'd like to go and I am adding it to my list of places I will be frequently going!!! 

So I find myself a little confused, I absolutely give Epi's 5 stars but they are not what I would traditionally be looking for in a 5 star restaurant. Usually  I would expect a lot from a 5 star establishment such as entertainment, fancy decor, good service, well plated food and so on. But here it is a little bit different. The decor is more like you grandma's kitchen, the service is more like a family dinner, the food is beautifully served but in a very comfortable way and the entertainment is created in the form of continual conversation among your table and the staff. I had a blast!!

Now for the food. The menu is not huge but I guarantee you will have a hard time choosing between the options. The appetizers were delicious and light. Our group tried, I think, just about every option and none of them were too heavy or took away from the meal. The potato balls were awesome! The rest of the meal came out in waves. First the soup, which I wasn't that excited about because it was 90 degrees outside, but once the creamy shrimp and lobster soup hit my lips, I could care less that I was eating soup in the summer. Then the salad came out which worked like a pallette cleanser before the entree. It was a simple house salad with light vinaigrette dressing, very simple and I appreciate that. Then the entree comes partnered with two sides. One of the sides, the asparagus, was served family style so everyone had to interact with each other and pass around the plate to share, I really liked that. The other was potato wedges served with your entrée, obviously Idaho potatoes......as if I could actually tell the difference between an Idaho potato from any other potato.  As for the main dish I had the lemon zest crusted halibut with a lobster cream sauce and I couldn't belive the size of the fillet. To be honest I couldn't finish it and that was the most disappointing part of my meal!!!! 

Lastly they have some very unique dessert options. I'd go into detail on each, as we tried them all, but if I did  I'd probably be cut off for making this review to long. Really though,  the bread putting. ...... amazing!  The ice cream cake,  killer! But the one I'll be ordering again is the Gateau Basque,  basically a cheesecake but much more dense and tasty. 

If I was to choose the one downside to this wonderful meal it would be that I paid $40 for a $16 bottle of wine. Funny enough,  I'd gladly do it again.  Lol!

With 4 other ladies,we had an amazing evening arranged by Chris and served "Cute Adam". The food was wonderful, we tried mushroom appitizer 4 different dishes, Basque white wine and flana for dessert. It was all wonderful, so filling and beautifully presented. If Meridan was closer, I'd come back on a regular basis. Thank you for a very enjoyable evening.

If I may ask...what is the purpose of a movie theater?? Yes, to SHOW MOVIES. Doesn't matter to me if you have the plushest seats, best popcorn or a 5 star restaurant...your main job as a movie theater is to show the movies. So today was my 4th trip to the Village Cinema to see a movie and now the SECOND trip which has ended with a frozen screen and failed movie viewing experience. This time after waiting ten minutes, decided enough was enough and my son and I walked out of Transformers without any offer to make it right, money refunded, etc. When you have failed to show me a movie on 50% of the trips there, I think you have failed as a movie theater. Enjoy the Village very much, but will enjoy my movies elsewhere thank you very much.

Goodwood is one of the better places in the Treasure Valley to get good bbq. (My personal favorite is (was) Roadhouse BBQ in Eagle but sadly they are now closed). Try the smoked brisket chopped or sliced, the pulled pork and the baby back ribs. Ask for the sauce on the side if you are a "real" bbq snob.

Just left the pie hole after waiting over an hour to get our pizza. The table next to us that came in 20 minutes after we did got their pizza 20 minutes before we did. Service was terrible. Now I know why they have you pay in advance and tip in advance.  I did ask for my tip back.

What the what. I have been to high end restaurants in big cities and Epi's is up there on the top ten. If not the top three. 

I wouldn't consider Meridian, Idaho a thriving foodie capital. But there I was, accompanying my husband at the tail end of his business trip. We were heading out to dinner with his coworkers and randomly walked by Epi's on the way to another restaurant. Since none of us had ever had Basque food, we randomly walked in and asked if they could seat 9 of us (Ambitious, I know). The lovely hostess and owner said she didn't have room and seemed HEARTBROKEN to turn us away. One of us noticed that the patio was empty. Before I knew it, tables and chairs and waters appeared. I was impressed at the lengths she went to accommodate us. 

We ordered. There was lots of wine. Between the 9 of us, we practically ordered everything on the menu. Here are my highlights: 

-The mushroom appetizer. OH MY GOD. Perfectly garlicky and juicy and perfect dipped with their homemade bread. I wouldn't know how the chorizos were, but my companions happily demolished them. 
-The soups. The mushroom is creamy yet light, the red bean is earthy and thick. They are both very good. Choose based on what you're in the mood for. 
-The salad. Really light and tangy. A nice palate cleanser before the main event. 
-The entrees. The lamb was a popular choice around the table. I opted for the citrus halibut, husband got the cod done two ways. I was pretty pleased with the halibut since the lobster sauce was pretty light but I think the baked white butter cod was my personal favorite. I also had a bite of the Copper River Salmon on special and was pretty pleased. The mashed potatoes on the side were pretty tasty. The haricot vert were the weakest thing on the menu but in a mediocre restaurant, would have been super tasty. It was just because everything else tasted so amazing. 
-The desserts. Won't lie, we ordered every single one because we couldn't choose. The green apple bread pudding and gateau basque (With lemon filling! And raspberries!) were my favorites, but every. single. one. was delicious. My companions were weirdly enamored by the ice cream cake (Which she admitted was the one thing that isn't entirely homemade on the dessert menu). 

The best part of this was that every time we had questions or comments about a dish, Chris (Our hostess and owner from earlier) would telling us the story about the dish and how it was constructed on the menu. Considering all of us work in marketing, we were all amazed at how well she sold everything to us. 

By the time we paid the bill and left, Chris insisted that all of us give her hugs and to visit again when we were in town. Now tell me where that happens at a restaurant in a bit city.  

Conclusion: Go here. Call ahead. Or stop by on a whim because Chris may welcome you in the way that she welcomed us. The food and service are amazing. It will be the highlight of your trip to Meridian.

Finally, an Indian restaurant in Meridian! 

Ordered take-out, our food was ready in about 10 minutes, and they gave us water and some crispy flatbread/crackers with chutney to enjoy while we waited. We ordered vegetarian and lamb dishes, both were seasoned beautifully with just enough spice, and the rice was light and flavorful. The naan was definitely an A+, too! They offer a lunch buffet Monday - Saturday, looking forward to checking it out.

The restaurant was almost empty when we stopped by (only 2 tables), so I hope that's not a bad sign. We'd like to see them stick around. In a sea of corporate chains of garbage food, it's refreshing to have options like this!
Food was ok and beer was cold... Best thing about Beefy's was the happy hr prices. Service also was bogey at best.

Yum!  The most amazing croissants and sandwiches.  We love the blended drinks with Bobba, the Strawberry Kiss is delicious.  If you are looking for a great variety of breakfast and lunch sandwiches you have to try Sarah's Bagels.  My daughter would eat there every day if I let her.
First time here, service was a little slow, but waitress working alone, so that is certainly excused. Shrimp fettuccine was awesome. Overall fantastic experience. We will be back for more.

The people here are amazing and really caring...the music is current and uplifting. I can't say enough good things about the environment, culture, and people. Wednesday nights are my favorite because of a focus on ushering in God's presence.

We were so excited to try Spice after reading about it. I was hoping to find a great new place to satisfy my Indian cravings...  I was super disappointed. We ordered the shrimp Makhani, Chicken Tikka Masala, Chicken Madrasi, and  the garlic and coconut naan. It was all very bland. We ordered the highest level of spice for everything... it was really just flavorless. Perhaps it will get better with time, but I'm not sure if I want to chance it again as the prices were fairly steep for the quantity and the quality.

I have never eaten at a Basque restaurant so when my husband surprised me with a random date night I was excited to try this place! Oh my seriously one of the best meals I've ever eaten! From the amazing service to the food, I'd go there tomorrow if I could. We started with a bottle of wine and the ham croquettes. I could've eaten just that and gone home happy. But then the meals come with a soup (I had shrimp and rice while hubby had red bean), the bread is amazing. It doesn't even need butter. The salad saves you from feeling too guilty. By then the entree comes in. My husband got the lamb chop and I got the roasted garlic chicken. I literally could've cried it was so good. I couldn't eat another bite until we ordered dessert. We got the green apple bread pudding. This is seriously one of the best meals I've ever eaten. We can't wait to go back! Yes its pricier than most date nights but you get what you pay for!!

I love this place! The food is great, as is the service. I usually order salmon when I go out, as I think it is (and hope it is) a healthier choice. Their salmon is so awesome, I'd order it even it if had a million calories. We'll be back for sure.

I was looking forward to eating here, but very disappointed.  The server taking orders at the counter was either confused or just trying to mess with me.  I ordered one of my dishes to-go and the rest to eat in, and I mentioned that I would let them know when we were ready for the to-go order to be made.   It took a while to make this clear, and then they just delivered the to-go order to the table before I mentioned we were ready.  I ordered the bruschetta, 2 spaghetti and meatball orders, and one order of the capellini with garlic, olive oil and cheese.  Nothing was very good.  There was basically no basil on the bruschetta and it was made with goat cheese, which was overpowering.  My bad there, I don't like goat cheese and should have payed more attention.   The capellini was a gummy mess, with no flavors standing out such as cheese or garlic.  I didn't finish it.  My adult son and daughter did not care for the spaghetti.  It had a  strange taste.   Maybe I don't get Sicilian food, but this wasn't like anything I have had in the States or in Italy.  
I feel bad, I wanted to like this place, but we won't be back.

Service was pleasant, and restaurant was clean and nicely decorated.  I ordered Jasmine hot tea, summer rolls with pork, and Pad Thai with chicken.  The Jasmine tea was wonderful, summer rolls were fine, but the pad Thai lacked flavor and was dark as if it had been sitting in a dark tasteless broth.  Their menu says that this is a popular item.  I recommend if you like Pad Thai that you consider a better option.  Two stars for kind staff and reasonable prices.

Great find. Very clean. A great wait staff greets you and is quick to bring water and get drink order.

Lamb Korma was so tender and tasty. The palak pener was so flavorful. Order was ready quick and server checked back on table a few times.

Food was very good, except for one terribly important flaw. The basil bruschetta burger was very undercooked.  It was raw.  If this had been cooked right, I would have given them 5 stars.

The Godfather Melt was awesome!

Service was excellent.

I will try them again and hope for a little better experience with the undercooked burger.

Wow this place is great!!! The entire pizza I ordered  was delicious but I was very impressed by the crust! The mozzarella sticks were devine and they have a great selection of beer. The ambience is welcoming and we had excellent service. If I lived here I'd definitely be back.

I've never eaten from this place, today was first. I came after 1 so I get to order quick. The place is clean & nice. I dont eat Mexican food so much coz my husband is not a fan, I only get to eat on the places I'm used at like Cafe Ole, On the Boarder to name a few. The food is not super great & take note I was hungry, usually food tastes so great when I'm hungry lol. I got the salad with beef & it's bland, stale or something. I will try to order a different one next time.

Good place for a beer and to watch a game. It is a little loud. The appetizer was good (fried cheese sticks) and the sandwiches were average. We had the prime rib dip and the garlic beef dip. Both are versions of a french dip. I thought the sandwiches were a little expensive at $10 - $13 each, but I did see the have specials. I think Tuesday was $5.99  burgers, so we might try that.

We had dinner tonight to celebrate my husband's birthday with our neighbors recently moved from New York.
