I had called ahead for a reservation because we were not sure of how many people might be at the restaurant. I mentioned on the phone that it was my husband's birthday. We arrived and all of the food was amazing.  We had eaten here before on the buffet and thought it was the best buffet we had ever had but the dinner  exceeded expectations once again.  The basmati rice was tasty, I had the Maghli Makhani which was delicious with jumbo shrimp, chicken and lamb.  Our friends from New York expressed how amazed they were at the taste of the food and they appreciated how you could have it cooked according to your level of spice.  There wasn't one thing from the appetizers to the entrées that could've been improved.  Then after we had eaten and were quite full...we were treated and surprised with a special birthday cake that had obviously been prepared in advance once they found out we were coming and was not on the menu. It's hard to describe how that bit of kindness touched our hearts and created a special memory.

I had the ribeye which was nothing to write home about.  The salad was pretty good.  The décor was nice but it was unexpectedly loud, much like Texas Roadhouse but without all the fun.  Overall I would try it again but wasn't overly impressed.

Love this place! Comfy seats and reserved seating! Also 21 and over seating. They also are the only theater in the area to carry gummy bears!! My only complaint is that people seem to really struggle with the concept of reserved seating... I always see people having to get others to move out of their seats... how is it so hard to sit in the seat that matches your ticket?

I love this restaurant-- from the friendly staff to the delicious food, it is a great addition to the line-up on Eagle Road. We would definitely go back, time and again. We have ordered take-out (packaged up nicely with no spills) and eaten at the teppan yaki table. I would recommend both!

Yelp comes through again. My wife and I were visiting Boise and didn't know where to go to eat.  We looked up Epi's on Yelp and altough neither of us has tried Basque food, we were accustomed to French and Spanish foods and thought, it's a mix of the two and were willing to try it.

It's a small place that looks like a house. There is no hostess but one of the wait staff will recognize that you are waiting and politely come to you. In fact, they were so polite, I was taken aback only because of the sheer sincerity.  There was a 30 minute wait but the waitress (whom I believe is also one of the owners) was very sweet and kind.

We wandered down the block to the Library Coffee house where they had a young band prepping for their nightly gig.  This place too is very cool and warm right up to the wait staff.

We started out with chowder and my wife had bean soup.  It was above average with some different spices that we were not accustomed to but enjoyed. We then had a salad that comes with the meal and it had a nice light vinegarette dressing that was very tasty and fresh. Add the warm bread, and we were starting to fill up and we hadn't received our entrees yet.   Our main courses arrived as we just started to settle our stomachs.  I had their special shrimp wrapped in sole in a delicious and buttery cream sauce. My wife had lamb stew.  (By the way, this is not a dieters place.  They offer a lighter meal but it's pretty much the same thing without the main course.)  

Overall, the food was fantastic and tasty... more on the Spanish/ Basque comfort food side than petite French servings.  Delicious!  

The prices were fair but perhaps hight for some.  We had dinner, including a bottle of wine and an extra glass, no dessert as we didn't have room (that is saying a lot if you knew me) and we spent $100. 

This is a definite "must eat at" restaurant in Boise but be prepared to wait without reservations.  You will enjoy it if you are not looking for a pretentious place to eat with "foo foo" food.  Instead it is something my mom would have made, if she were Basque.

Visiting Boise area and found this small but mighty restaurant. Our waitress was very fun and took good care of us! Started with Rick's Jameson &  Ginger and the corn fritter appetizer. Oh my, was it good! My husband had the meatloaf and I had the potato-crusted salmon, both of which are house specialties. Great meal! Looking forward to coming back the next time we're in town.

Choose papa Murphys because it was 103 outside and the ACA in the car is broken.  After tonight's disgusting endeavor I'll walk on the sun before I go back.  I ask them to go very lite on the sauce. Which I guess translates to pour it on with a bucket.  You should never bite a pizza and have the pizza squirting and gushing sauce. Not only was it exactly the opposite of what I ordered,  but it was disgusting.  Insert puking sound here.

Ok, this is my second review for Panda Garden, and I have to say, I do like this place.  Take out Chinese is a great choice when you don't want to cook, and this place is close to our home so it super convenient.  Yesterday's dinner was:
1) Spicy Tuna Roll
2) Curry Chicken (Spicy)
3) Chicken Lo Mein (Soft Noodles)
4) Egg Rolls
The whole price, including a tip was under $30, and that also gets me two lunches worth of leftovers.  How cool is that?
The service there has always been really good, with a friendly staff.  

[ True Story:  When I was about 7, my mom told my sister and I that we were going out to dinner, because she talked to my dad, and he was all tied up at work.  My 4-year-old sister then asked, "How could Daddy talk on the phone if he was all tied up?" ]
Went with a large group the service was wonderful, the food was delicious and the company as always was the best. Very entertaining presentation of food. The chefs are silly. Lots of food flinging.
We had nothing but sushi, and everyone enjoyed it immensely. One in our party wasn't a sushi fan going in, but afterwards, said he will go again. Waitress was great. Would recommend.

Incredibly delicious Basque dishes! Family run business. Need to make reservations most nights. The only things I haven't liked there is the squid ink soup and cow tongue, but that's just because they gross me out ;)

This is a case of a great business concept that fails because they are unable to execute it. Take for example the idea of reserving seats ahead of time. This idea is solid gold. However, getting to the theater and finding people in your seats and having to kick them out ruins the whole concept.  What made the whole thing so unpleasant, was I don't think they got the memo about reserved seats. They acted all put off an angry like I was the one being a jerk and kept giving us dirty looks for the rest of the evening. It put me on edge for the rest of the night.
Another failure to execute came at the concessions. After a lengthy wait in line, I ordered two pizzas. I was directed to a second line where  after another lengthy wait, I told a young lady that I had ordered two pizzas.  She proceeded to cook them for me in a microwave while----you guessed it, I waited.  This took way to much time. It's a good thing I had reserved seats, otherwise I probably would've had to sit in the lobby.  When you order a pizza at Edwards, they ask what theater you are in and give you a card. 10 minutes later they bring the pizza in and deliver it to you in your seat. That is execution!
The seats were comfortable. However, they're very narrow and may not be comfortable for people who are large.
Finally the parking was atrocious we had to park near Eagle road and walk a quarter of a mile to get to the theater.
I think that I will be waiting another six months before I go back to this theater. Hopefully by then, they will be able to execute their business concept better.

One stop shopping for a great night out. Get appetizers and a couple drinks at the bistro then head into your 21+ theatre to have wine and watch a movie!? How cool is that? Really the whole location is high end and feels like a destination. 

Additionally having events on location have been fantastic as well. Clients love it and feel like it's such a treat! Works well for any appreciation events!
You have to love this great little restaurant.  The food is truly comforting, and the owner is the sweetest woman, I wish she was my aunt.

It's my favorite place to go to the movies since experiencing the perks of VIP seating. If a movie isn't playing there and in VIP, I'll wait for video release! I've been spoiled you could say...but how can you pass up sitting in bigger & comfy chairs, smaller crowd of people that must be 21+ yrs old and beer!

The first time I went it was great. The second time I made my appointment online. I was supposed to get a confirmation email and didn't. Then I show up for my appointment and after 30 minutes of waiting my hairstylist finally calls the salon said I never confirmed and she wasn't going to be there for at least 15 more minutes and that i could reschedule. Seriously I'm a mom and work I have very few moments to myself and had a rare hour to get my hair cut. I was treating myself as it has been almost a year since the last time I even had time to get a hair cut. It was a special me moment that they ruined and I didn't even get an apology from the stylist. I didn't get and email or anything. If I had at least gotten that I would have returned at some point. But nothing for wasting my one morning to myself in months. There is no way I will be returning there. If she doesn't value my time ill take my money elsewhere.
Wonderful people and awesome foods. This now my go to place from now on. We did the hibachi grill it was very entertaining and they spoiled me since it was my birthday.

The food is pretty.  I love being able to order online for pickup on my home from work.  The customer service is terrible.  I rated 4 stars because of the food and convenience, but they missed a star because of poor customer service.

This is a very special place. The family knows us by name and if you come to visit us it is a guarantee we are going to take you here. The food is great; home style comfort food of the Basque culture. The atmosphere is great, laid back and comforting. This is top of the list for our style of seeking a special, unique dining experience.

Oh, Pizza Hut! How the mighty has fallen... I've often enjoyed excellent food and service at many different Pizza Huts. This one, however,  seems to have become stale and lackluster. 

Two stars tonight. One for adequate food, and one for adequate wait staff. Two stars. Barely. 

The place was empty when we arrived, at about 8 pm, a Friday night...never a good sign. We were not greeted when we entered, had to wait a minute for someone to seat us. Not cheerful, not outwardly glad to have us there. We were seated at a table that was not clean... Crumbs and smudges. 

Waited a few minutes before our waiter came to our table. He asked what drinks we would like. I told him we were ready to order, but he insisted, "What can I get you to drink?". I asked for a local beer, but he said that all Pizza Huts in the valley were now "dry". 

We both ordered the Milan Chicken Pasta, with garlic bread and teriyaki wings. We also ordered hot brownies to go. We asked for ice water to drink. 

The water came quickly, the pasta took about 15 minutes, with no garlic bread. Our waiter said that the bread had been put into the oven too early, left in too long, and was burnt. It took about 10 minutes more for the bread to be reordered, toasted and brought to our table. 

Our waiter was not cheerful nor friendly, but not unfriendly, and was helpful. A few more customers came in, helping to make the eatery more like a restaurant than an empty school cafeteria. 

The food was acceptable, the ice water was clean and cold, and the service was adequate. 

We probably won't be back.

Came in for dinner with a friend and were seated quickly. The waitress was quick to get our drink and meal orders.
The food was brought out surprisingly quick and my drink never went empty. The service was overall great and I ordered the barbecue chicken with Mac and cheese and vegetables.
The chicken was on the dry side but it was good and my sides were pretty good as well.

Met some friends there after work. Were ignored by server for about 1/2 hour (finally accosted one). Ordered the much touted wings. Overcooked, dried out and stringy. Pitchers of domestic beer throughout the Treasure Valley run $7- 8 (and less during happy hours). I order two pitchers of Bud Light assuming their prices were in line with everyone else. When bill came, I was charged $12.25 each. That is insane for a pitcher of domestic BudWater. Will not be returning.

First off, outstanding service. Food only took 7 min to arrive.
As a connoisseur of green curry (and I eat this stuff everywhere) this place has some of the best ever to be placed on my pallet. Perfect sweetness and balanced spice.  Not too much basil not too little. I will come here again and again. Soooo glad I stopped by! What a treat!

OMG!  Best little resturant that I've been to in a long time.  Had never had Basque food before and EPI's left me longing for more.  Ms Chris, the owner, came out and greeted us and chatted with some cajun folk and shared food stories.  If you can get in this is a must eat BUT call for reservations or you'll be left waiting and wanting!  Love this place!
Delicious! The martini's and sushi were awesome and we had the best service! I can't wait to go back and try the hibachi!

It took multi tries over multi yrs... but I just had the most wonderful VIP experience. I had a delicious salad  (tip: was delicious w/popcorn added to it!!!)... also had gelato & the Mgr helped me order a yummy drink that complimented the food.  Excellent genuine smiles & service by all... I'm definitely coming back to the VIP area again!  It seems the best strategy is to just order via the bartender & it will be delivered in a timely manner.  (The times I've tried w/a waiter they have gotten bogged down w/larger groups.)
Had a great time!!! I had the steak and shrimp hibachi dinner and a California sushi roll.

We've been here several times in the last 9 mths for lunch.  The wait staff is super friendly and efficient! We love the burger!  My favorite is the pork chop with an extra serving of grilled veggies.  I find many places here are a bit heavy handed with the salt and sauces, but not the case here!  Just a yummy healthy option!

I love zupas. They have very good, healthy and fresh food. I get the California Cobb salad when I go. Don't try to go there on your lunch break because they are not quick! You have to wait in the entire line even if you are just getting one thing sandwich, salad, soup etc so it takes about 15-20 minutes. One thing I don't like about zupas is that the employees are not authentic (not their fault) it is clear that the company has them on a script saying (miss and sir) to every customer they talk to as you walk down the line, when I walk through each person and every one of them says hi miss how are you and it doesn't build an authentic relationship. I also don't like that they don't give their employees and employee discount. Doesn't seem fair

We came in just 15 minutes before they closed and thought we would be rushed but were instead greeted by a warm smile from every employee. Our server, Michelle was so sweet, friendly and talkative. The curry and Mongolian beef were delicious and sent out in a timely manner. Thanks Michelle! We will be back!!
A+ customer service. Loved the family style dining. Lots of sides come with each entree, but they're all reasonably sized portions.

First off, let me say that I have never had any issues with this theater in the past. Of course, when the customer service you are providing doesn't consist of much more than selling tickets and concessions it isn't too hard to provide a good experience for your customers.

But the measure of a well run business is not how they operate when things are going well; it is how they handle issues when they arise. And my experience today when things didn't go so well certainly left me more than a little disappointed...

I went to see a movie with my daughters. I was having issues buying tickets from my cell phone so I visited the ticket counter where the agent was happy to help us out. We lined up 3 seats in the back row and were excited for the show to start. But shame on me, I didn't double check that he had printed tickets with the right seats on them. So we bought concessions (drinks and candy) and walked into the theater. Upon getting into the theater we realized the agent had sold us tickets to the front row, which was unacceptable. We were promptly refunded the price of the tickets but offered no explanation or apology as to why we didn't get the seats we had selected (he muttered something about the system acting funny today). And when I tried to get a refund on our beverages, the manager told me that wouldn't be possible since my daughters had each taken 2 sips of their iciest which they no longer wanted. Very disappointing!

Long winded way of saying, these guys need to brush up on how to handle customers when things turn south.

I live in meridian and a group of friends wanted to go out.  I ordered the pork sandwich and have been sick since.  Everyone wanted to try the crab cakes but they were out. The next two items were not available either.  Service was real slow.
But they were very nice.  We had informed them weeks prior that our group was coming in.  I'm sure the rooms are nice. But don't eat here!  I wish I would checked reviews before we spent almost 200.00 for our group.

Best basque food in Boise!  Wonderful, friendly staff. Nice wine list. Service is prompt without being intrusive. Our table had the tongue, lamb chops, leg of lamb and stuffed sole special.  Everything was perfectly prepared and full of flavor. Will definitely be back!!!!

I must say this place is by far the most nicest people ever. Their food is AMAZING! I've been here twice now and they remembered my kids from the first time I came in. Amazing food, Fabulous people, the best service you'll ever have. I'll continue to come here for all my special evenings!

Normally when you go to a big release on opening weekend, you have to get to the theater early and wait in line for even a chance at a decent seat...or show up later and risk getting a kink in your neck because only the front seats are left. Then you have people leaving arbitrary spaces between seats as if the theater won't be full, the sucker who drew the short straw saving several seats for friends who don't show until the last minute, and that big mob that arrives late hoping to get seats together. Awkwardness abounds if the sucker's friends haven't shown yet.

Consequently I was ecstatic when I found out a theater was opening that lets you to purchase your desired seat concert-style. I bought our tickets earlier this week for Thor 2. Our preferred middle back was already taken, but we still got great seats. Even better, we didn't have to wait in line to get them. It was a 7:30 showing. We arrived at 7:15, quickly bought our food and went in with minimal wait time before previews. Life's too short to stand around in lines.

As for the theater, the seats are leather with wide arm rests, and you have a lot of leg room. The sound and video were great. 

Update: We tried out the VIP section for Catching Fire tonight. Very comfy seats. I recommend showing up 15 minutes or more earlier to make sure you can take advantage of waiter service. Otherwise, you can still order food at the counter, but get a buzzer (understandable.) I had a 4 ounce burger and fries for $7.50, and they were restaurant quality. 

We didn't go to the bistro, but it was lovely and there was a fire pit on the balcony overlooking the ice rink and fountain.
We love this pool!! We live not very close to it but don't mind the extra drive!!! It's worth it!!

Not a great visit tonight!!  Workers were not changing their gloves after touching clipboards and pens!
I order a half salad then changed my mind  to a full salad.  The worker dumped small bowl of salad into a larger bowl and added one more tong of lettuce!.  I questioned her and was told that it was a full salad.  Hummm!
Their layout for ordering is not efficient.  You order, go through the line and you have to repeat your order again so they can write it down!!
I did enjoy the chocolate covered strawberry!
Even the manager (green shirt)  was unfriendly!

Well, it is what it is, and they do it well.  

The staff are well educated about the products they carry, and you can always find someone to assist you - unlike some of the other huge stores I sometimes shop.  

The parking lot is huge and always has available space.  

The return policy is great - I haven't had a problem returning anything.

Always good at Goodwood!  Three of us had the House ribeye.  Big enough to bring some home, so I had room for the Chocolate cake with ice cream.  Warm Chocolate cake.  So yummy.  And a shout out to our waitress Jessica.  Superb service and attention to our requests.  When we left, the parking lot was packed.  But the other four restaurants in the neighborhood had ample parking--just another indication how Goodwood stacks up against the competition.  Do yourself a favor and enjoy your visit and meal.  Did I mention warm Chocolate cake?

I'm usually a huge fan of Zupas... But with all the other options around, I'm not sure if I'll be back. I went in and ordered three large soups to go. I wanted to get larger portions that I could split up for everyone at home. The server barely filled the containers half full. One was considerably fuller than the other two, so I know it wasn't just to prevent them from overflowIng. If I wanted smalls I would have ordered smalls! I wasn't extremely happy about it, but moved past it. Then they made the wrong sandwich for my husband. Not really sure how they misunderstood that, but they did. This is not the first time they have messed up an order... They are definitely consistent there. The thing that surprised me is that I was the only person in there and there were FOUR people behind the counter. Someone walked in a bit after me, but still, the place was far from busy. We do love their soups... but I think over $6 each for halfway filled containers may have been the final nail in their coffin for me.

Noise level is high but it was also busy. Service was very very good. 
2/3 rack of Ribs were big, looked great, but a little tough, not cooked right, not fall off the bone tender like I prefer.

Pretty good Indian.  Had the lunch buffet,  which I'm normally not a fan of.  I usually prefer order a dish or two.  But everything I tried was good.  I was in a hurry and having to not wait for hot food Indian was just the ticket.

Even if Epi's had the worst food in Meridian, I'd still return just to see Chris--the most outgoing, sincere, warm and personable owner/hostess I have ever met. And probably ever will meet.  She is in a league of her own.

Fortunately, Epi's doesn't have the worst food in Meridian.  It has some of the best food, Basque or otherwise, in the entire Boise area.  You'll have to try for yourself and see.  I guarantee it will be worth the trip.

The food gets 4 stars, wine gets 3.5, and Chris gets 7. Which, on Yelp, comes out to 5 stars.

Like others have mentioned--make a reservation.  Epi's is busy.  And for good reason.

Prior to winter weather my wife wanted to have her coats dry cleaned.  One of them had a hood faux fir on the front edge.  When we picked up the coat the faux fir on her expensive winter coat had been turned into a cotton candy looking mess.  It was likely an honest mistake by an untrained employee but we have been unsuccessful at getting return calls and we have not gotten responses to emails even after following their "procedure" to file a claim from the corporate office.  Beware they don't seem to care about their customer's satisfaction.

Great place to eat lunch. Almost to much food, so plan on a box for left overs. Great service and the atmosphere is as good as it gets. When you walk in the door if you not hungry you will be just from the BBQ smell that hits you as you walk in.

We have eaten dinner here before you the food is just as good but the wait to get seated can take awhile so plan for it.
Unfriendly staff. Not a lot of choices. Not a place to eat if you want to sit down for a minute. We won't be back.
Great service, environment, and staff. Thank you Izumi for making Father's Day that much more special!

I loved the service! Our waitress and sister (the owner) were on the floor serving. Her Mom was in the back cooking along with some other family members I lost track of. Their brother used to own Gernika, but sold it to go back to teaching. So needless to say, the were Basque, and they new their croquetas. 
I like the fact that they gave you the option of the big or little portion of the same thing. All dishes came with rice, fries, soup, and salad. I asked if I could substitute my rice for a couple of croquetas and they gave me 6 (so good too!!!) and rice. I didn't finish my soup because I was trying to save room for what was yet to come, so she offered to box it up and then topped it off!!! 
My biggest complaint was the chicken I ordered. It was overcooked, but I was to shy to say anything. I still ate it, so it couldn't have been that bad.
I loved my experience here, but because of the prices (and it's kind of a trek to get out there) I think I will stick to Epi's on special occasions.

This place is lit. I'm on a diet but I couldn't stop eating because it was so good. The Naan is amazing. You have to try the custom dish created by the cook Coconut Corn Masala. The family is really sweet.  Try the Chicken Makhani. This place just got added to our family favs. I hope they stay in business for years to come. I recommend the buffet to try lots of their top dishes.

I found this place a couple months ago and now I'm a regular customer.  I get a baker's dozen of bagels twice a week for my family.  If you want fresh and delicious bagels you'll find them here.  I appreciate the fast and friendly customer service too.
First time to this BBQ place and our server Raphel was great. The food was finger licking good. I had some BBQ chicken and the sauce was soooo good that you can buy bottles of it!
I moved to West Boise 6 months ago and was thrilled to find Goodwood close by.  Best bbq and steaks ever, nice, comfortable space, too.  My only problem is I want to go all the time!

I've shopped at most of the Lowe's in the treasure valley in the past 20 years, and after moving near the 305 Overland Lowe's store I have been shopping there weekly for the past 3 years. 2 out of 3 times this store is out of the item I went there to buy.  Even after using their online webpage to check quantities prior to shopping, the item is either out of stock, or must be placed somewhere else in the building - as it cannot be located after I made the drive there.  Its extremely frustrating after shopping at other Lowe's stores and knowing what items are supposed to be available.  Today was my last trip to this store, I will drive across the interstate to the Home Depot located 1/2 mile away.

Save your time, drive a little further and have confidence their shelves and inventory are well stocked at the Meridian Home Depot...or the other Lowe's located on Eagle Road.
This restaurant is consistently great. Always have a great meal and friendly service. The honey stung chicken sandwich is my all time favorite.

I use this tire store almost excursively for years, they handle all warranty, rotations, sales, and maintenance in a timely and professional manner. One review stated they were turned away. I just don't see the owners or any of their help doing something like this unless they showed up with a none emergency at closing time.

My husband and I love the Village. The shops are awesome and the atmosphere. The cinema could be better. The assign sitting SUCKS. The last experience we had was the kid taking tickets was literally reading his book while standing there and we had to wait to finish his line of reading before he would look up and take our tickets....so LAME! I can't believe that the managers allow that! It was super busy too! A Tuesday night when it's $5 and super busy! What happened to good customer service???? The bathrooms were disgusting! It looked like they hadn't been clean in a couple of days.

They've been OK for occasional dry cleaning.  I've recently needed someone to clean and press shirts for work, though, and they don't seem to understand that collars should be pressed evenly at the seam.  I've also had problems with creases pressed into the middle of the shirt.  I've taken shirts back to get them re-done, but they come back the same way.  They are apparently not able to take the time to get these details right or perhaps don't understand such routine needs.

Good food just make sure you are aware that the rueben sandwich comes in 2 sizes half and whole. $11 would have been good for the whole not for the half. I about passed out when I saw I was charged $18  for a Ruben sandwich. No sandwich in the valley is worth that much.l kind of feel like the waitress should have asked if I wanted a half or a whole. I am still kicking myself for that fiasco.

Going to take close friends on May 11th for a birthday.  My wife and I have been going to Epi's for over 14 years.  NOT ONCE was I ever disappointed with the food or service.  Chris greets everyone as if they were long lost relatives.  Service always impeccable.  Food, top notch.  I consider myself quite adept in the kitchen but this place shames me.  I have taken business associates as well as close relatives and never had a problem.  Reservations an absolute must!

Epi's has been on our "want to visit" list of restaurants for a while, but every time we called, they were already booked.  We had some family in town recently and I called them up and they could fit us in.  Everything we had to eat was amazing and the service was great.  Everyone was friendly, helpful and explanatory.  I'm a very simple eater, but found many things on the menu I could have chosen from.  I opted for the scallops which were on special that were on amazing.  Everyone else had lamb, which looked delicious.

We decided to check out Rick's following its being featured on the 8-17 episode of Guy Fieri's, Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives. 

This restaurant, neither a diner, drive-in, nor dive is a small bar and grill in Meridian, a burb of Boise. 

Decor is nice, clean and comfy. Service was a bit spotty but the fact that Rick is the cook and his wife and daughter are the wait staff, I will give the spotty a pass. 

We decided to order the chili garlic wings with celery slaw that was highlighted on the show. They were absolutely delicious as promised and they did not disappoint. For the entree, I had the Apple Pecan Salad - except for the pecans which seemed freshly spiced and toasted, the salad was spiritless mostly due to the basic balsamic vinaigrette. Boring! My bf had the meatloaf sandwich which was just plain weird. It was a huge slice of meatloaf with onions, lettuce and tomatoes. The tomatoes on the sammy were so pale it made me homesick for winter in Philly. Yo Rick, tomatoes are in season in Idaho. 

If we go back on this trip, I really would like to try the salmon potato cake also featured on DDD. 

Perhaps between the salmon entree and the chicken wings I would be charitable and bump Rick's to 4 stars. Overall though, this was a very unremarkable experience.

Easily the worst customer service I've had in Idaho. 1. It was cold (45 degrees outside) and they wouldn't close one of the two open doors despite us asking. 2. They were out of the ravioli. 3. They forgot our salads. 4. They only gave us one cup of ice when we asked for two. 

Seriously, this is basic stuff. Obviously the former food truck isn't ready to step up to being a real restaurant. 

(Dear Yelp, please do not hide this because it's not a 5-star rating.)

This place will feed you well! I went there expecting a mediocre BBQ joint, but was pleasantly surprised to the comforting appeal to this place.  Very clean too!

The entire staff was polite and very accomodating.  I believe even one of the owners was there overseeing the operation.  He even thanked everyone as they left the restaurant.

The food...  wonderful!  Fall off the bone ribs.   Oh and the onion rings are huge, definitely a half order for 2 or 3, unless you want leftovers!  The pulled pork was great, brisket tasty and tender.

Good BBQ place indeed!

I have been to Epi's 3 different times. Each time their service was fantastic, as well as food. It is memorable and come hungry!! I ordered the Baked Cod... I dont like fish and I really enjoyed this dish. Nice environment and food!

I don't know how anyone gives this place a bad review. This is my favorite place for restaurant Chinese!! Everything I have ordered has always tasted amazing. And they're sushi is pretty good too. Will definitely continue eating here!!!
this is the worse habachi restaurant I ever had, I have never seen a restaurant can't not share food and they force to take 20% tip. Not recommend at all.
Such a great place! Came from out of town for a horse show and found this restaurant. The staff was super friendly and the service was great! We definitely will be back next year!!

So I just had dinner here. I actually let yelp decide where I would go. 

It's your typical divey pizza place.  Looks like it's big with the kids. What kid doesn't like pizza though? The two employees seemed to be stoned and wearing tie dye clothing. How stereotypical lol

I ordered the pizza by the slice that was on the counter, cold. He put them in the oven and served then hot. 
 I think I made a mistake because I'm not feeling very good. I don't know if it was the grease or old slices but my gut isn't sitting well. Not recommended.

This is, hands down, the best Indian buffet in the state. I like it better than Taj Mahal, who does a killer dinner. They are much, much better than Madhuban, and still better than Bombay Grill (although their buffet is fairly solid).

I'll have to disagree with Mitzi on this one when I say that they go above and beyond your standard fare. I mean, for serious, I was blown away by the SALAD and CONDIMENT offerings. Not only did they have your standard mint, tamarind and (the other one...) chutney, they offered a rockin' onion chutney and maybe one or two other options. The greens were actually dressed (I've never encountered that), but were even better with a dollop of the onion chutney.

Their naan was solid, but I never saw the garlic naan that was supposedly offered. However, ALL of their veggies dishes were pretty stellar and out of the ordinary, in addition to being better than their butter chicken / chicken makhni, which is typically the only draw for gringos to enter an Indian restaurant. Better than the makhni was the mango chile chicken, which was so thoughtfully created and balanced (nice spice with the ACTUAL chunks of mango).

I'd say this one is a cut above most places I've encountered in California and  Oregon, and I'm damn proud to have it here in Boise (or Meridian, whatever). I cannot wait for my next trip here, where I will once again ruin my life by eating too much, going into a food coma, and smelling like garam masala everywhere I go for the rest of the day.

SPICE! EAT HERE DAILY AND SPICE UP YOUR PATHETICALLY BORING LIFE WITH INDIAN TREATS!

WASTED MY TIME. RUDE & UNPROFESSIONAL. I called and asked for a quote and the manager gave me a quote, I then asked if they can do it tonight and they said yes, I showed up to have it done but the owner said they are way too busy to do it. Raised his voice and was very unprofessional. I asked to speak to the manager that I spoke to on the phone but he said he was the one speaking to me on the phone. I will never go to Big O Tires and would give ZERO STARS if it was possible.

Took the whole extended family and were treated very well.  Including the staff showing us other faire -- including my new favorite Squid in Ink Sauce.  Heck, even my kids like it.  Just have to get over the black sauce and tentacles!

Consistently good and attentive service, comfortable setting, great for couples.

I've had the barbecue, and it's good, but holy hell the potato skins...best appetizer in Boise, no contest. I time my trips through the Boise area just so I can stop here and get those. I have been there with many people who tried different menu items and have never heard a complaint.

Get the skins. If you get the big plate, be ready to split it with someone, and you still probably won't be needing any further entrée.

Every booth was dirty.  Instead of telling me she forgot about the breadsticks, she lied and told me they ran out.  Unfortunately, I overheard her conversation about the breadsticks.  The salad bar was dirty and gross. Will never come back!
MERIDIAN, ID: Reviewing McDonalds seems like a futile exercise in OCD behavior or passing boredom, but I think every restaurant should have one review.  This McDonalds was fairly friendly.

This is white people Thai (or, if you like, Thai for people who don't know any better). When you read through my Thai list, this means that the flavors are generally muted, dumbed-down and authenticity takes a backseat to what the proprietors think the prevailing populace wants. Thai food is so flexible that is still generally not bad, but it's a far cry from the glory and taste blast that this food is capable of delivering. In this case, it pissed me off, mostly because it seems to be run by Thai people. 

Maybe this is a place that has one of the secret menus or something, but even though their entrees didn't taste off as much as diluted, there should be some way of signaling to them to step on it for those who want it. I can't imagine a Thai person being pleased by the offerings on the plate that I got, particularly the rice, which was borderline insulting. Certainly none of my Thai friends would have found that acceptable. I've seen them send entire dishes back for less...

The chicken satay was a travesty, as much an abomination as I've ever seen or tasted. I get that the appetizer can be boring and restaurants are always looking for a way to differentiate themselves, but on such a venerable old standby, which I think I've now had in nearly every imaginable way to prepare it, you'd think they could content themselves with just executing it skillfully...on a skewer, instead of a pile of thin fillets. 

Even the green tea was thin and mostly watery, so this was as much of a Thai phone-in as I've ever experienced. Staff was reasonably friendly, though service was a bit slow. Can't imagine I'll ever be hitting up this place again, unless someone else picks it or I'm in the area, like in the parking lot or something and intensely craving Thai food to the point I'd have to have it right that second. I think that this type of place illustrates more than anything that although the population density of Meridian grows by leaps and bounds, the restaurants are a long, long way from keeping pace, at least in terms of quality. If this is any indication, the struggle will continue for a while...

Zupas is fantastic but I probably won't be coming back to this location for awhile. Put tomatoes on every single sandwich in our party despite being asked not to, filled my wife's soup bowl probably 1/3 of the way and completely forgot about giving me mine altogether. When I asked about my missing soup one of the workers responded with an "uhhhhhhh" that lasted so long I thought she was going to pass out.
We went for the lunch buffet. Food was subpar. Didn't really enjoy any of the entrees. Naan bread was pretty good. Wouldn't come again.

The service was terrible. The front counter people were not at all accomodating, we had to stop someone and ask for anything we needed, and the food was only mediocre.  The Boise Sizzler is one of our go-tos, but we will never go back to the one in Meridian.
I'm so excited to finally have found a brow specialists in New Bern, NC! Laticia is absolutely awesome! Can't wait to go back. My brows look amazing with the wax and tint is perfect!!!

We love Café Zupas!  Their service and friendliness are first rate.  The soups and salads are phenomenal and we love the healthy choices, especially the protein bowls.  Our favorite of all the soup and salad chains.

Incredible! Took our two girls, 5 and 2, and they did wonderful with them. Got to sit in car seats, watch Netflix, got balloons and suckers afterwards. They were so good with our girls and the cuts looked awesome. We'll be coming back!!

Terrible customer service. Was extremely rude and condescending. Sent email complaint about situation and never replied.

This is how our experience and email went:
To whom it may concern, 
I have just left my first visit to Cafe Zupas at the Meridian, Idaho location on eagle road. I am not normally one to attempt to contact a company outside of the store, yet the way I have been treated by management seems to call for it. Two friends and I went in, we all have food allergies. Two of us ordered turkey bacon avocados and one the vegitarian. We watched in horror as the entire order was made completely wrong in front of us. We voiced that it was an allergy concern and they turned around to flick the tomatoes off, trying to hide it. I understand that cross contamination is a possibility but that was uncalled for. Appalled we requested the manager, the supervising employee came out and had another sandwich made, while the two of us requested the avacado that they mistakenly taken off. The supervising employee came back over to us, we could tell she was slightly irritated. She handed our food back to us, asked "So what did you order, and what was wrong with it?" We explained our allergies,again. The supervisor said we should be more clear next time. We are all very shocked to have been treated this way. Im wondering if there could be a better way of taking orders instituted. Also, maybe a customer service training or two for management. 

The food we recieved that was finally corrected was delicious. The memory of my time at Cafe Zupas, and the way I was delt with insures I will probably not be returning.

Qdoba is seriously one of my favorite restaurants. I love their healthy options and the naked chicken bowls. I love that qdoba doesn't charge you for everything extra. This location is super clean with friendly and smiling staff!

Wish I would have shown up on one of the days it was cold and the door was open. Nothing worse than trying to eat in a stuffy atmosphere. I discovered this place by accident. I have been back 3 times. Each time the service was great. What really got me was the prices. Very reasonable for what you get. Also, the server actually remembered my name from my previous visit. I had the ravs on my first visit, and the spaghetti twice. The food was awesome!  Traditional old world flavor.( I should know, my family came to this country from Italy so I have been around a lot of authentic Italian cooking.)  The owner was there on all three occasions and he remembered me from my previous visit as well. Yes, the place is new and they are probably still getting their bearings, and the design of the building does not include a traditional door so they leave one of the sliding doors open so people know how to enter. Also, this is more like a deli atmosphere than a restaurant so its very casual.  I would encourage anyone who is looking for some good affordable Italian food to give it a try and form their OWN opinion. Just remember how many times you have read a bad review on something (like a movie) and it turned out that YOU actually liked it. I for one, will return. and no Im not a shill or plant.

Decided to come by and grab some lunch. Our waitress was great. Very personable and funny. I had a hard time figuring out what I wanted. She helped me and the manager helped  me as well. Chicken wraps were so yummy. Hubby ordered the pulled pork. Great food. Good location, great food, friendly staff, clean, and fast service. 5.

Excellent. Amazing find. We were looking around downtown area when we happened upon Rick's. Lemon garlic chicken out of this world! Double cut pork chop melt in your mouth! Apple pecan salad a must do. Beer on tap from New York soooo tasty. The word needs to get out about this place. Can't wait to go back!

I made a point of finding this out of the way place after seeing it featured on the Food Network's Diners, Drive-Ins & Dives. I wasn't disappointed. 

The staff was anxious to serve and impress. The walls in the place are filled with front-page headlines from newspapers around the nation. In between papers are hand written statements, graffiti, from people who had visited the place. The wall is covered and it fits in well with the newsprint. 

The food was out standing. I remembered seeing the garlic chicken wings appetizer, and the salmon with hash-browns featured on the show, and I knew I had to try them. Fabulous. I could have made a meal out of two appetizers, and I might next time.

I saw people served the clam dip. It is an appetizer too but they obviously were ordering it as diner. The was served in a baked potato, a BIG one, it looked so good I almost changed my order.

The salmon was very good; not too moist or too dry. The hash-browns were cooked into one side of the salmon served over a small helping of garlic mashed with a light cream gravy and zucchini squash. I thought I ordered too much, but it disappeared before I knew it. Thanks to the DDD show I found a place that lives up to the hype.
This place was amazing,  super friendly staff, felt like we were at Grandma's house. The bread pudding was phenomenal!
I ordered an Italian Club sandwich. Very tasty. I loved the sauce on it. I also got a bowl of tortilla soup. It was also very good. I'll be back for sure.

The people working here are not very nice, and they charged me $2.50 for a cup of water which was tap water filling a large jug that had some fruit rinds floating in it. I watched them fill it from the tap that they told me that they did not have!?!  Based upon other reviewers, it seems pretty dead on for this crew. So, if one wants to be possibly cheated for some food that may or may not be decent, come on in!  As for me. I will go to a place where I have a better than average chance of getting a decent meal from HONEST people. Thank you.
Best in town if you want a night out to see a movie.   For those negative reviews out there I'm mystified as this place kills it.

Convenient and quiet, clean and comfortable. EST on and off I-84 except for insane Eagle traffic, which can't be avoided.
I especially enjoy the bar and food in the bar area. Great food, best fries anywhere, very reasonable prices.
I will be back.
One of my favorite places to go out to eat. The food is always fresh, the staff very friendly,  and the atmosphere is so relaxing. Definitely recommend!
I ordered an arrangement for a birthday. It was beautiful! Very happy with this florist!
Great Family entertainment. Going to give the coffee crew an A for effort and an A++ for friendliness.

First time here. Hands down the best Indian Cuisine in Boise.  And super friendly and nice. Service was excellent and dishes came out perfect.  Family owned and run.  Have to give it a try.  Amaaaaaaazing.  
We tried the butter chicken and tiki masala.

How about serve a temp in between medium which isn't spicy at all and Thai hot which is "so spicy that your servers have to treat you like you're an idiot for asking for spicy and then saying "Meduim" it's like why not have a "hot option" ?? Otherwise the chowmein is bomb

It pains me to write this review given how much I was looking forward to It, but the service was so incredibly thoughtless that I just cant say anything good. 

We made reservations so we were sat quickly but waited 25 minutes to talk to anyone. We ordered two pizzas, two sodas, and two salads. 

We never received our drinks until we had to go to the bar and ask 2x, we received our salads at the same time as one pizza. We got the wrong salad dressing. The second pizza never arrived, and i had asked for the bill to be split at the beginning and it was not. We were never checked on at all until the check was dropped off.

When we asked about the second pizza we were.told that the kitchen made an error but "he wouldn't charge us for it." Well I would hope not since we didn't get it. 

So, so, disappointed!

We went there tonight as a family and it was AWESOME!
We were seated promptly, and greeted by our server Jordan right away to get some drinks. He gave us a few minutes then returned to take our order.

My wife ordered the 1/3 Rack of Baby backs, a baked potato, and Mac and Cheese. The ribs were delicious, with a perfect smoke ring and bbq flavor. The Mac and Cheese was divine. Deep rich flavor, very cheesy, and firm pasta. The potato was also perfect. 

My daughter ordered the Old Fashioned Burger, and loved it. It was huge, and she managed to eat the whole thing before any of us were done eating... And killed off her steak fries as well. She enjoyed it. 

My son and I both got the Chicken Fried Steak. I got mine with the Smashed Potatoes, and he got his subbed with a salad instead of potatoes. I added a salad to my normal plate. The salad was great with diced egg, bacon, tomato, and lettuce/cabbage mix. It normally comes with onions, but I hate them so I ordered it without.  The meal came and I was blown away by a hand battered crispy Chicken Fried Steak, with gravy (that was also delicious), and the best smashed potatoes also with gravy. It was BY FAR THE BEST Chicken Fried Steak I've ever had. Period. 

We found out they are not a chain, and the owners are in there quite often. Everything, except the Ceasar dressing is made in house, from scratch. I can't wait to go back and devour my next amazing meal from here! We will be back soon.

Move over ArcLight Cinemas - Village Cinema is the new king of the luxury movie theaters. Yes, I'm also looking at you too iPic Cinemas. Village Cinemas is next to Boise over in Meridian. Me and my GF wanted to check out Mission impossible: Rogue Nation and Village had what we needed. They have a VIP 21+ section and the film was presented in Dolby ATMOS. The screen was 60 feet, as well. They have tons of food options ranging from gourmet popcorn to gelato to bacon mac and cheese. The seats in the VIP section are comfortable as hell and they have plenty of room to stretch out and relax. They also feature a prime viewing distance and position. We had already had lunch, so we did not have any food from the theater but the rest of the amenities more than made up for it. 

I looked them up and they only have theaters in Idaho and Northern California. Here's hoping they open one up in Southern California sometime soon. The VIP section only holds 71 people and you can get tickets through fandago. The prices are $9, so on that alone, they beat ArcLight by a mile. Hell, even with the added service charge they beat them by a mile. They also have a restaurant called the Backstage Bistro. Again, we didn't eat here either. The style of the movie theater reminded me of the theater over at The Grove of Los Angeles. It looks like something out of a 1940's flick. They have huge chandeliers and the ceilings are tall! 

I love you Village Cinemas!

This place has fast, affordable pizza. It's not gourmet or cooked in a wood-fired oven or anything. But, it's better than your run-of-the mill Little Caesar's or something. Also, it's a small, local business so you can feel good about supporting your community. And the cinnamon dessert things are really tasty.

Also note that this really isn't a dine-in place. It's a place to pick up your pizza and eat elsewhere.

Bonus: They were very kind to my semi-unruly 3-year-old when we picked up our pizza last time.

I have been to many BBQ restaurants in Northern California and a couple here in Idaho. By far this restaurant outshines them all. Great wait staff, and even better food. The Three Meat Combination Platter was awesome. My wife and I each ordered The Three Meat Combination Platter and we picked 3 different meats on both of our orders and I couldn't have been more happy in dining here. Beats out any BBQ joint I have ever been to.

To quote my wife, "This is the best theatre I've ever been in!". Which I most definitely agree! 
We had to rush to the theatre due to our movie time and a prior engagement taking too long. Prior engagement meaning playing Munchkin with friends. Look it up. ;) 

Anyways... Sidetracked... I was blown away by the looks of this theatre. Marble richness everywhere. And what the poop! $10 tickets? Bloody awesome! (Been in Cali the past few yrs... Dunno if that's the norm here.) Also saw that Tuesday is $5 tickets. Heck yeah! *wild fist pumps* It was kinda odd though since I had to choose our seating at the counter. Recommend the 15 area and closer to the back within the normal seating. There's a balcony seating in which you have to pay a little more and then VIP seating in which you pay a little more than a little more. 

Despite our tardiness we got some food to munch on. It took a little while but kinda expected when yer dumb enough to get pizza. Which was actually pretty good. Wife got gelato and so far has been the best gelato I've tasted in Idaho. So kudos! (Check out DeVine if you're ever in Sacramento, CA. The best gosh dang gelato in the world!) 

The screening room seats were positioned so that the person in front of you couldn't possibly interfere with your viewing experience unless they held their screaming baby up over their head like Rafiki in Lion King... Which kinda, sorta, not really happened to us... But seriously... The seats were legit. Extremely comfortable. Allowed a lot of leniency to recline back. Coulda rocked myself to sleep if I wasn't watching something incredibly awesome on an incredibly sick screen with an incredibly sick sound! There were also plenty of room in between seats so if someone with a weak bladder needs to pass by you dun need to pull yer legs up like a chump. Like at all. But you will anyway cuz you're accommodating like that. :) 

Anyways... Great experience and great theatre! Bringing all my friends here!

This place just rocks. Plain and simple.

I have gone to Epi's three or four times now and if I could afford to, I would go every week. Everything about Epi's makes for a great dining experience. The food is great and has its own unique flavor compared to similar restaurants and the staff goes above and beyond in terms of service and niceness. 

Be sure to make a reservation and don't be surprised if you call earlier in the day and get an answering machine. Just leave your name, number, and time you would like to eat and they will call you back as soon as staff arrive. Epi's only has about forty or so seats so your odds of getting in on a weekend without a reservation are slim. 

The only downside to Epi's is they are on the slightly spendy side but the food and the service is well worth it. I recommend this to anyone out of town looking for a standout dining experience. 

Also, if you need an appetizer order the croquettas, they are amazing.
Wrong order; no sauce and double charged....and a 25 minute wait in the drive thru definitely not fast food.

WORST EXPERIENCE EVER!  Just moved to Idaho and bought a couch and chair in the store.  I was told that if I signed up for financing, I could save an additional 15%!  I was spending a lot of money, so of course I signed up......only to find out once I got home that I could get SUBSTANTIAL savings online and FREE delivery.  They charged me $140 for delivery in the store.  I called the store and ended up being credited back nearly $400!!!  Fast forward, it's been two weeks and still no furniture.  Last week they came to deliver it and the couch looked like someone shoved a screwdriver through it.  I was told they would be here today but wasn't given a time.  I called this morning, after taking time off of work mind you, and was told now that it would be Saturday.  Save yourself the hassle and go somewhere else.  Trust me.

This is hands down the best movie theater ever!!!  All theaters should follow it's lead.
Huge, lots of space, most comfortable seats, balcony.  The VIP upstairs was awesome.  Had a burger brought to my seat!!!!
We loved it!

Love ordering from the backstage bistro and eating in the theater. I don't always like popcorn and candy, so it's nice to have real food and enjoy a movie. Seats are very comfortable and the theater is much smaller than others. So there isn't much Boise from other people. I also like that we can pick our own seats.

Dr Sheryl Kepping and her staff are wonderful. They  helped to make the crossing over of our beloved pet Bella peaceful.  We thank them so much and are grateful they have a 24 hour service.  Thanks again.  Brett and Teri Reid, Meridian Idaho.

I went to visit Meridian / Boise the other day -- we stayed in this Courtyard Marriott hotel, and it was great!  The front desk staff were so friendly, and had a great sense of humor.
The rooms are nice and clean, and the lobby looks great!
Convenient location as well - definitely will stay here the next time we visit the area!

Carson C.
El Dorado Hills, CA

The customer service here really is terrible. We bought pizza here several times because it is the closest pizza to our house and the pizza is not bad. This was the final straw. They got my order wrong again and then refused to rectify it or give me the price that was agreed to over the phone. I have said before we will not go anymore. This time, we really won't be using this particular location again.

We went for dinner and it was awesome. The staff was very nice and the food delicious. The salmon was outstanding and I would go back and have it again. I Will be recommending to friends and family as a great place to eat.

Food was good initially until I bit into my Italian sandwich to find a rock in it! I spit it out and thankful didn't break my tooth. We asked for a manager and she never came out to our table so we ended up going to the counter to get someone to help us. She finally came over when we got to the food counter and we told her I had a rock in my food and gave it to her. She's said "well that's gross, I'll go check my ingredients" and walked away. She didn't ask what sandwich I had even ordered or asked us if we wanted something else or a refund. Worst service I've seen from a manager! The girl didn't even look like one to be honest. Disappointed and grossed out.
Only been there once, but has great potential to be our new favorite dinner or drinks spot.

I usually go to the downtown Boise Jump Time, but after a terrible experience last time, never again. This location is totally different start to finish.  There was once again a problem finding us in the system, but this time Liz S. explained about the update, and fixed everything so we could get to the fun part of jumping! They actually have an attendant ON the trampolines watching the kids and enforcing the safety. All of the employees were friendly and helpful. We had to drive 20 minutes out of our way to come here, but this will be the only location we visit from now on. Definitely worth it!

The Hibachi was amazing and the chef was a lot of fun! We went for lunch and it was not busy at all, we were able to get in and out in about 45 minutes. They also have good prices on lunch sushi and hibachi specials

What happened to the women's section?? It's been cut to practically NOTHING!!!! Compared to the men's section,  it's nonexistent!!! Where are the women's plus clothes you used to carry???? Done with Kohls

Great ambiance, great happy hour.  Staff is much friendlier and attentive at Kona grill, Matador, and Twigs.  You will never be waiting for your glass to be refilled at the recognized restaurants above.  All are within walking distance from Bodovino.   General Manager and owner are FANTASTIC people at Bodovino.  Bartending manager was giving discounted drinks and free shots to his friends, once upper management left for the night.  Fun for his friends.. Not my idea of consistency or customer service.  Upper management can check the receipts. I don't normally give a 1 star but when I do, there is something wrong with the service.
Great pizza and great customer service.   Affordable and close to the house. We are here 2 weeks ago on a Friday night. Very much a hippy type vibe which we liked.

Amazing!  Try the Potatoes on Salmon. It was incredible!  My wife and I were next door at Treasure Valley Cigar Shop enjoying our cigars and good conversation. We decided to eat at Rick's and were not disappointed!  Great service, too!  This restaurant really cares about it's reputation.

Consistent "Mission-style" burritos (that means large, like softball-sized, with meat, rice, beans, cheese, salsa and sour cream). It's a chain, but that's not necessarily a bad thing. The food quality has been very good both times I visited, and the staff is friendly and efficient.

They also have a daily special; free kid's meals on Sunday, $5 chicken burritos on Monday, that kind of thing.

If you like Chipotle, you'll like Qdoba. I'll certainly be back. Burritos are in the $7 range and feed an adult easily.

I stopped in today to have a slice.  After all the rave reviews I guess I had my hopes up way too high.  I bought two slices, one cheese, the other potato and bacon. 

The girl behind the counter was very nice and she told me she had only been there for a couple of weeks.  The place gets a star for this as customer service is a rarity. 

They had a good variety but the slices looked as if they had been sitting out a while but the girl behind the counter said they had made them within the last 1/2 hour.  Okay.. so in went the slices into the oven.  When they gave me the slices they put both on one really thin paper plate and piled one on top of each other.  

Now, these slices are huge and by huge I mean really, really huge!  One thin paper plate won't hold the weight for two of these.  I asked for another plate and the girl kindly obliged.  The pizza's were hot (well, they did just get re-heated in the oven) but they were really greasy.  The cheese slice was tasteless.  I had to put some of the hot pepper on it to get any flavor at all.  Plus, the crust was limp and soggy.  I only hoped the other slice would fare better.  It did, but not by much.  The dough on the potato and bacon slice had the same consistency but at least it tasted better.  The combination was actually pretty good and I never thought it would taste good on a pizza.  One of the stars is for the creativity of a unique tasting slice.  

While I was eating the second slice, I looked up and one of the employees (a young guy with glasses) was standing near the pizza slices and was holding one of the tongs in his hand.  These are the same tongs used to pick up the slices and full pies.  He was tapping the tongs on his back and to make it worse (yes, it gets worse) he was wearing a tank top so the tongs were touching his skin!  Eeewww!  Yuck!

He saw me looking at him and abruptly stopped what he was doing.  I said, "You know you're going to have to wash that before you use it again".  He said sheepishly, "Yeah, I know".  

There are health regulations that prohibit this sort of thing.  I hope I don't get sick from eating there.  I will never recommend them and I will never go back.

My dude loves this spot , he goes a lot its right by his place , he just took me the other day , and I loved it ! Super good ! And I didn't get sick - i felt really really good after I ate it ! So I would highly recommend it ! Taco trucks always freak me out a bit , go here with confidence !

Had the Chile and Garlic Wings and could not stop until I was literally licking my fingers! Rick was super friendly checking in with the guests and food was delivered straight from the grill to your table with the ring of a bell.  Will be back!!

Nothing but good things to say about this location! Very friendly staff. The gentleman who helped us even met us at our location to bring us the vehicle with intentions to walk back to his location! The staff definitely is willing to go above and beyond

This is my second time coming here. But the first time I was with my friend and we walked in and we waited for 5 minutes and they started with my friend and it was about 9:50 and I had to work at 11. But she was getting her nails done, then a couple of people came in and all of a sudden the lady that was doing my friends nails disappeared about 10 minutes into the nail process. And the guy came over saying that she went to go interview the people. So we waited and waited and waited. Then I checked the time and it was 10:40 and we waited for about 25-30 minutes and she never came back so we left. Then the second time, we came back to give them another chance, we both had a design we wanted and the lady did both of our nails and my friend didn't like them cause it felt like the lady didn't put the effort for the design. Afterwards it was my turn and I wanted a certain design from Pinterest and I showed her what I wanted. Then when she was doing my nails she took of my nails that I had on and made me bleed. Then when she was measuring the nails I want and she put the liquid on my nail and I started blowing at it cause it got in my cut and it was burning. Then she's like I'm sorry I forgot about the cut. But she was doing the coating and then I showed her the design again and she didn't completely wrong. She only did the tip of the nails and not the full nail. But we both agreed that were never going back.

My wife and I hated this place so much the first time we went but after everyone always commenting on how they liked this place we decided to give it a second chance and people we're right. It's no where close to being in the same ballpark as Bodacious Pig in Eagle but it certainly has better BBQ then I gave it credit for after making one appearance.

We had so much fun here! Make sure to do the hibachi. Husband and I shared our plates including an appetizer and dessert and it was more than plenty. My favorite part were the hibachi chefs. So fun and entertaining!

Went to catch a matinee today.  It was Veterans holiday but I don't think they thought about that head of time because they looked understaffed.  Only two people were working the ticket booth and the lines to buy tickets were really long.  I think the fact that you have to choose your seats prior to buying your tickets makes the lines take even longer because people are debating over what seats to choose and some people were taking their sweet time.  Good thing our movie we wanted to watch was 30 minutes still from show time otherwise we would have missed some of it because of the lines.

Theatre was really nice.  Seats were comfortable and everything was very clean (although they have only been opened a short while).  I've read other reviews about problems with the movie showing but we didn't run into any issues.  Good overall theatre experience.
First time gotta day the house salad was great and the sasauge was the best I can remember ever having. Great place for comfort food.

One of our favorite places to eat in the Boise area. I think the one in Meridian is a bit better than the one on Entertainment in Boise.  The brisket salad is great. Love their loaded baked potato!  We have dined here probably a dozen times or more and have always enjoyed our meal. The bar at both locations is a disappointment.  Watery drinks are the norm and neither can make a Manhattan to save their lives. I called them on it the last time and our waiter ("made these with my own two hands") got all butt hurt after I sent the drinks back for a redo.  Your "own two hands" need more practice. It happens. Smile and fix them instead of getting all passive-aggressive, kiddo.

This has become one of my favorite places.  The food is great, but what makes this place a step above is the staff.  They are all so friendly and warm.  It really makes the experience enjoyable.  You can get good food in a lot of places in the area, but I doubt you'll find a place with as inviting and personable staff.

Took my daughter here when she was three she was a typical Wiggley three-year-old and the girl who cut her hair was horrible she wasn't patient she got frustrated and then have the nerve to tell me that choosing to do Bangs would be ugly. We go to great clips now and are much happier. Not to mention it's faster and is half the price
Meatloaf was delicious.  Mashed potatoes would have been bland alone but gravy made them. Julienned zucchini was crisp and hot.  Place was deserted at 5:30pm on Wednesday.  Waitress was very nice.

My family and I have been coming to this food truck for years....it's good home cooked food...on the cheap.  Why would someone spend a dime at a fast food restaurant,  when they can have real home cooked food for the same price? I don't know....

Hard working...family owned and operated. 

They make the tortillas for the tacos, as soon as you order them! This makes a good taco, a GREAT taco! If you have never had a taco made with a fresh masa shell. ..you will never look at Taco Bell the same again. (By the way...I was in no way implying that Taco Bell is Mexican food)

The carnitas are moist and flavorful. ..the asada is good, as is the lengua. 

They also have shrimp tostadas....great for a hangover...

Skip the fast food...get ya some good home cooked...south of the border goodness.

I am always on the look out for taco trucks, and this is a good one! I love tortas and this truck has some really good ones! I gave it 4 stars only because the sides lack a little meat and filling, but they are delicious!!

This place is incredible! We took our family of 5 there for Teppanyaki to celebrate our sons 19th birthday.. The service and food was amazing. The Teppanyaki chef, Tommy was so funny and talented and really made our night feel special. Tina was our server and she was so nice and very attentive. We had filet, chicken, lobster, shrimp, noodles, vegetable, fried rice, lettuce wraps and crab rangoons. All were prepared to perfection! At the end of the meal, they brought out dessert for our son with a gong and a drum and sang happy birthday. Really went out of their way by also giving him a gift certificate as a birthday present too. Will definitely be the restaurant that lasts at that location. Meridian needed a great place that is so different than anywhere else!

We love this place! Awesome red/green curry! I can't get enough! Also love love the drunken noodles, I usually get them with tofu and the tofu is cooked perfectly! Chicken chow mein is super yummy too. The service is really good every time I've gone. I love taking my friends there because they always leave satisfied. Definitely check them out! :)
Very good and tasty food. Lunch is super cheap, like 7 bucks for a plate.  Ambiance is nice.  Service is fast.

Never had a chance to eat the food !!! Was turned away by a very unhappy looking waitress with an hour left before closing. She said they were short staffed and basically said leave. 
To bad, we are locals with lots of friends and 4 kids. Ive since told people to go elsewhere. There loss!!!

First off, I'm vegetarian but this was one of the few places off of Grubhub where I could get delivery to my hotel. Twice during my stay I ordered the grilled cheese griller and tossed out the meat patty. Great sandwich and perfectly melty cheese. Then I also had the French fries, side of broccoli and funnel fries with caramel sauce. Nom nom. My husband came to stay over the weekend and he had the steak nachos. Said they were really good with tons of flavor. Even with the delivery time food was hot and fresh. Definitely recommend!

Goodwood is pretty stingy with potions. They charge probably a few dollars more for a plate than what you would expect. The tables feel a little closer together than what you would expect. 
The food is tasty but leaving still feeling hugry is not that fun. The menu is pretty big.  But they upsell you on side, they offer like 3 sides in the base price and if u want any decent sides u have to pay extra.  I hate when places nickel and dime u.

Cocktails are not lacking; they are strong and yummy. 
Chef was fun and very good at what he does 
The food was delicious! We had the hibachi steak, shrimp, filet, and Emperor's Delight. No one was disappointed.  Great atmosphere.

Had a wonderful lunch with great people.  My Cesar salad was great.  Lettuce could have been more crisp. Hubby got his usual of baby back ribs and pulled pork.  Friends had a great serving of Salmon and lettuce wedge with wonderful dressing.  All in all with a great server we were all pleased.

Went for dinner with my daughter.  The samosas were a nice appetizer, really good onion chutney.  I really like that you can pick your spice level for the entrees.  The Mughlai masala was amazing.  Rice is very good, as is the naan.  They overcooked our original naan order, but rather than serve us that brought a fresh order.  Used it to mop up their delicious masala sauce!

We went today for my daughters 11th Birthday. We all were wearing flipflops and as we are being walked to our table all of our shoes almost came off due to the floor being insanely dirty and sticky. We ordered drinks and I went to the restroom to wash up.  First thing I notice is the floor looked like a dried up mud pit and none of the soap dispensers worked.  We ordered our food and waited for the drinks watching the beer sit at the bar for over ten minutes. We were one of two familys at this time in the whole restaurant. I have been to at least ten different Hibachi bars and our chef was a complete joke. He yelled and hollered throughout the so called show and did fire and volcano that's it while beating the crap out of the cook top. The rice was ok the vegies were ok but all the meat that we ordered was the lowest quality meat you can possibly purchase for a restaurant.  The Chicken was bland like injected with water and no flavor whatsoever. The steak was mushy and I don't know how people eat it and my Mom, brother Inlaw and other daughter ordered the salmon and everyone ate a few bite and didn't touch the rest.  My mom is from Norway and I have never seen her not finish a plate of Salmon! Do yourself a big favor and skip this dirty low quality eaterie. No I do not want a refund or to come back and give you another shot.  #stomachache

The atmosphere for a Friday was surprisingly easy going and the staff very friendly, with n a genuine way. I ordered the Chicken and Shrimp Teriyaki Combo with Fried Rice and my boyfriend ordered A Noodle Bowl wth Chicken. There was a significantly any difference in the quality of our Chicken. His was very moist and smooth in texture, where as mine was very chewy/gristly... almost as if it was rib meat, very unappetizing. Overall, everything ordered had fantastic flavor that was fresh and subtle, not overpowering or overwhelming.

We also ordered a summer roll appetizer which again was very light and fresh but had an amazing pop of flavor.

For dessert we had the Tempura Cheesecake & Chocolate Peanut Butter Bomba... both were more than enough for 2 people. The Cheesecake was very heavy/filling, but good. The Bomba was equally delicious with a glob of caramel in the center... can't really go wrong with those things ;)

This location offers coupons in the Entertainment Book. When I tried to use one on the app they informed me they  are no longer accepting it, even though the book is only a month old. It is nearly impossible to get ahold of corporate headquarters and when I finally did, because it is a franchise, the best they could do was tell me they would get the district manager in touch with me within 2 business days. While I, in distress, worked to get in contact with someone who could tell the minimum wage employees to accept the darn coupon, the on duty manager was smirking and rolling her eyes. Finally after I threatened to track down and call the franchise owner she agreed to call her boss, who approved the use of the coupon.  The on duty manager completed the transaction with zero apologies or courtesy.  15 minutes after initially getting to the register I receive my discount and now cold burrito.

We stopped in after lunch for a glass of wine and sat on the patio. A waitress came out and gave menus to the next table but didn't acknowledge us. We sat for a several minutes and she didn't come back for either table for service or to take the order. My wife decided to go in and order from the bar. She tried to get the bartenders attention but he was busy chatting with the waitress and decided to just leave. She came out to get me to go but I decided to go back in and let them know why we were leaving. I stood at the bar for a few minutes and couldn't get the attention of either of the employees consumed in conversation. We love the idea of the wine bar and the location but the service is lacking at best. We will find another spot for a casual drink. 6-22-17 @ 1:15 pm (not busy)

I especially love a good salad it whenever it's warm outside. Café zuppa has a great variety of salads a great variety of sandwiches and a great variety of soups. Today I went in for a strawberry harvest salad with chicken and it is consistently delicious fresh and tasty. Today I did there pick to with that salad and ultimate grilled cheese sandwich which is also consistently very good.  

In previous visits I have done soup and salad or soup and a sandwich depending on the weather but I've never had anything I didn't like here.

I appreciate great customer service I appreciate being welcomed when I come in I appreciate friendly smiling staff and I love that the food is always delicious.

Wow!!!! Came here only based on Yelp reviews.. Reviews were killer so we came just to see for ourselves after seeing the pictures of all the delish meals yelpers posted.. This place deserves 5 + stars.. The service was over the top accommodating, explained each meal with heart and the food was freaking amazing.. I had the wild caught Halibut crusted lightly in a citrus crust light cooked in olive oil and then baked!!
 I don't care of the negative things you hear about Yelp sometimes but Yelp works if you know what your looking for!!!

We have been to this location several times. Sometimes it's swamped with customers, and the wait can seem a little long. However, the last couple of times I have ordered beforehand and picked up at the window, it was smooth sailing. Tonight, for example. I ordered online, and picked it up 30 minutes later. I was at the window for less than 3 minutes total. The employee was very courteous and had my pizza all ready to hand me. And the pizza is always a win for us.

Excellent food. The ambience isn't really in line with the price. However, the flavor and quality of the food were as consistently great as any restaurant that I have visited in Boise (including the fancy ones). My reuben cost $18, but was wonderful. Even the side salads were noticeably great. It is pretty expensive for a mid-level restaurant, but is my new favorite restaurant in the area anyways.
