Excellent, professional, and friendly movers. The entire process was super easy: initial communication, the move, and payment. I used Yelp to communicate back and forth with Cameron, the owner, and he always responded quickly and professionally. He and his partner showed up early and quickly went to work. He and his partner were very friendly during the entire move and communicated everything that they were doing. They worked very fast but in a safe and mindful manner. It was nice to that both these guys got along and worked really well together - they seemed to really love their jobs. I've had very bad moving experiences in the past, but my experience with Reliance Moving couldn't have gone any better.
This is my absolute favorute place to come! They are very friendly and love what they do. I come here every year on my birthday and it never fails to fill me up and put a smile on my face.

My review goes towards the uncomfortable stalking from the sales rep, I would like to some space to look around and if I have any questions I can come find you, I don't like the fact that I have someone breathing down my neck

I walked in thinking this would be somewhat of an Irish pub.  Instead, this is a typical sports bar, with plenty of televisions and sports apparel.  The food portions were meh, while the pizza was definitely not their strong suit.

The service was slow and unattentive.  I had to send a coke back because it had a foul pipe-like taste in it.  A second coke revealed no such pipey taste.

Definitely not worth the drive if you live in Boise.

Hotel is nice and in a nice area. They have free internet and upgraded internet. However, the upgraded internet isn't worth its salt. It's slow and if you're attempting to stream videos or play games you will experience buffering or lag. Compared to other Courtyards, the internet is lacking. Hence the 4 stars instead of 5.

I was hoping for a smaller, down home style barbecue place.  Had a 20 minute wait on a Saturday night, not bad.  Food was good, service was good, sauces were what I would expect.  A decent restaurant, just not what I was looking for in barbecue.  Smoked prime rib had good flavor.

As far as Indian food goes this places is all right.  Its the only Indian place ive tried in the Treasure Valley so I dont have any real comparisons to any other places. It disappointing that none of their dishes where spicy. I used to live in Houston which has a huge Indian population and there are SO many meals just have much better flavor when their is some spice.  The owner told me they used to have the place open in Disney World/Land I dont remember which, I thought that was an interesting piece of history.  As far as Indian goes I would go back here, it wasn't too expensive, the Naan WAS DELICIOUS AND FRESHLY BAKED.....I mean if I where to rate this place on the Naan alone it would get 5 stars.  Ill likely come back here and try the food again just to see if I stick with the 3 stars or it goes up.

Omg their Brussels Sprouts though!! To die for. All the appetizers we had were absolutely delish and the food came out hot. Our server was great. The pizza was probably a 4 out of 5. Their wine menu leaves much to be desired however, not much in the way of options so I hope they kick it up a bit. All in all we will be back!

I'm from Reno and go to Boise quite a lot.  I have never seen a place have so many reviews and ALL 5 stars.  I had to see for myself.  YES, they well deserve every single star.

From start to finish it was AWESOME.  A must for anyone who wants to enjoy a outing 100%.  

This will be a place that is on my list to eat every time I come to Boise.  Thank you Yelp for introducing me to this wonderful experience.

Brought my 2 year old son, who is on the autism spectrum, here for his 2nd ever haircut. They were PHENOMENAL at making it a positive experience for him. The fun car chairs to sit in, ipads with cartoons and kid-friendly atmosphere are great, but it was really the way his stylist went above and beyond to let him know everything that was going to happen (what it would feel like, sound like, etc) that made me almost cry. That kind of caring is just amazing.

Jamie is awesome! I have been spray tanning on and off for a while and needed to find someone local. She picked up my call right away- major plus :) and was able to talk to me about different options. I like that she is so positive and pays attention to detail! She did such a good job on my spray tan - she is my new go to gal!

Absolutely fantastic food, nice atmosphere, great little gem in meridian.   Definitely loved the tomato bisque, and the "butter fish" special just melted in my mouth.   The calamari appetizer was the freshest, best cooked (not chewy over-cooked) I can remember having in the valley.   Also very much liked the basque rice

I love this place. I went with my husband and my father in law. We walked inside and stunned with their place, very nice ambiance and clean. They also use menu that is not from the tree which is good for "conservation message", it felt really odd, first time we touched it and thought why its so flimsy and moist. But it says at the bottom of the menu that its material is not from a tree. 

The price is fine, not too expensive, not too cheap either. But it's worth it to eat there. 

The service is good. Not super great but not disappointed either. I just wish they have spacious place because table seem so close together...

If you walk in and find this place busy, just walk out. Had reservations at 7, showed up at 6:45, yet didn't get seated until 8. Found out our name had been crossed off the list, talked to a manager and finally got seated, then had our seats changed. Everyone apologizes for the delay and their excuse was that they are so busy. Isn't that what you expect on a Friday night? Talked to the manager and they said they would give a $20 gift certificate. Unbelievable!!!

My wife and I did the VIP seating which was nice. The seats were pretty comfortable and very spacious. The big perk to the VIP seating is that there is a concession stand specifically for that area. Now let me clarify, this concession stand is not your traditional popcorn, soda and candy, it has a full menu for food, deserts (we had the flowerless chocolate cake) and adult beverages. I don't know how the food is because we ate prior to the show but the cake and drinks were not bad. If you show up 30 prior to the movie there are waiters that will serve you but this is not something I tried as we showed up about 5 minuets before the movie started. We were comfortable showing us so close to the start of the movies and confident in still having a good seat because this theater allow you to pick you seating on line, much like choosing your airline seat. All in all this is a pretty cool theater and has a lot of really cool perks that are above and beyond a traditional theater experience.
31 Flavors sends out coupons via email. This franchise does not accept the coupons.  I believe they own the one on State also.

i really liked this place! you can't beat the location, and the decor was cute. the restaurant itself is also very spacious and open. it makes for a nice dining and people watching experience. 

i came in on a monday for lunch alone. this place is close to my work and i was craving curry as i often do. my server was super friendly. he made me feel very welcome and comfortable. 

i ordered a thai tea and green curry with chicken. my server informed me that on monday's if you order a curry at lunch you get a half priced appetizer! well, even though i was alone, this was a great deal. i chose the fresh shrimp spring rolls. 

first, they brought me some chicken and rice soup to start that was delicious. i would eat that any day of the week, especially if i was sick. it was great! the spring rolls were brought out next and they were sooo delicious! super fresh and the sauce that came with them was different and tasty. i was in absolute thai heaven. (even though i think they are more of a vietnamese delicacy).

by the time the curry came i was stuffed but i powered through.  as far as green curry's go it was yummy but not the best i have had in boise. it was a little thick. i will say i am a harsh critic of green curry because it is my favorite food. under any other standards, i think someone would love it. i liked it.

i will definitely be coming back again and again to this place- i enjoyed my experience!

Holy smokes this place is DELICIOUS!! If you're worried about it being really spicy, don't. It's perfectly spiced and has options for really spicy if you want. My fiance thinks peper is spicy and loves this place. We continue to do the buffet and it's always fresh and delicious.  Go in! You won't regret it!
This pool is fantastic! Superb instructors, plenty of life guards, and great, clean facility. Love this gem that's often over looked.
Super friendly staff met me at the window and the biscuit was marvelous. I ordered the beans and rice and after a couple bites threw it away.

Food was typical McDonald's which was what we were looking for on a road trip.  Reason for the low rating was after we were 30 miles down the road we looked at the receipt and noticed they overcharged us.  When we were ordering we were using coupons from the McDonald's app and the employee told us how to get the best price.  Needless to say we should have checked the receipt when were there.

Love the VIP21 seating and the foods but the menu keeps getting smaller and smaller and now it's nothing terribly special. The last few times I've been they had to come back to say they were out of something I had ordered. Miss the way it was when it opened.

Very pleased with the bid process, work completion, & cost.  Michael Cook, an owner, came to do the estimate/consultation within a day of calling and was very personable & knowledgeable. He sent me a detailed bid the same day.  He was involved in the entire process and actually showed up while his assigned technician was here. He inspected our crawl space himself for post-winter moisture and threw that work in with the cost of the 3 projects we had done. The work that Sam Austin did was excellent and I kept his card for future jobs. I would recommend this company to all.

I really like the village. I love that you get to pick your seats. Especially for friday or saturday nights with big movies. I love being able to pop onto the web site pick my seats and pay. I love how esthetically pleasing the lobby is. Its clean and food prices are honeslty not bad. I also love doing the 21 and old. Its such a cool concept. The seats are so comfy. And the food is good too! Its my favorite theater!

Tried Panda Garden today for the first time and was pleasantly surprised.  We were greeted immediately by the friendly staff and found a table.  
The young man and young lady that were our servers were quick to get us menus and answer questions that we had.  We ordered off of the lunch menu that had most meals  priced between $5.00-$7.00  We ordered two lunch specials a bowl of Hot & Sour soup and a hand roll.
The soup came out very fast and was probably the best Hot & Sour soup we have ever had. The hand roll and meals were equally as good.  Would definitely recommend this place to anyone that likes good food at a great price and friendly service. Can't wait to go again!
Scott & Holly S.

Why did we ever come here? 12 bucks for salad and cheap frozen yogurt. ..sigh..never again. oh and don't expect much for the service, my server would not stop talking. Just go away and let me eat my over priced salad and watered down soup. I swear the ranch dressing was mixed with milk and mayo to stretch it out. no flavor what so ever. If the kitchen is cutting corners on the ranch and soup, I'm afraid to order anything else.
Great sushi, Mango Shrimp was great, Steak and Lobster was great.  Super service, great prices, I will go back.  Really big restaurant.  Teppanyaki looks fun.

I've been seeing Courtney on and off for years to help with my adult acne. Every time I go in for a facial I leave so happy and calm, and my face clears up shortly after seeing her. She is an experienced esthetician and makes my skin glow. I fully recommend this spa. Always had a great experience. Staff is warm and friendly and always willing to help. Online booking is wonderful and so helpful when I'm the go and too busy to call for an appointment. Facility is immaculately clean and tastefully decorated to promote a welcoming calm environment. I love coming in needing to be a little pampered and leaving on cloud nine. Love this place!

Great food and great service as is the norm for Goodwood. Love their wait list text program. It is awesome. Love being able to send one person inside to check in while the kids can stay in the car and watch their movie on the DVD player, aka parental sanity device.
Great meal. I had a burger, fries and a salad and could not finish it there was so much food. My hubby had the 3 meat platter and a salad and he really liked it.

I just had dinner here with my boyfriend and it was EXCELLENT! From the moment we walked in, we were both impressed. I really appreciate that they separate the hibachi area and dining area so that you don't have to deal with the noise of large parties/kids if you don't want to. 

We ordered soup, salad, green tea, sushi rolls, fried green tea ice cream and the exotic bomba. Everything was amazing. Our server, Jackie, was attentive and delightful. We are already planning on coming back to Izumi later this week. Highly recommend!

I was really looking forward to eating here! Super cool vibe, nice staff... I felt the food was a little underwhelming, but my husband enjoyed it. We got the mozz sticks and white tiger pizza. For how fancy the flavors sounded for the pizza it was really lacking for me. Every once in a while the sausage on it would have a nice strong taste, but I couldn't taste anything else on it. I really like and crispy their thin crust was! The toppings also had a problem of falling off. There really wasnt anything holding them on. But it was the perfect sized pizza to feed my husband and I. The mozz sticks were just the right size too. The best part for me was the marinara sauce we dipped them in. That was my favorite part of the meal - very tasty! I would try it again and get a pizza with red sauce next time just so I could eat more of that sauce! Overall, we left happy. Again, staff were nice and food was good. We were full enough to feel like we didn't over pay.

I am only reviewing their Tom Kha soup, as that is all I have tried.  They put curry paste in the Tom Kha soup, the same brand/kind in your curry dishes. I like curry but it does not belong in Tom Kha soup. I would not order it again.

Having finally made it over here for dinner, my husband and I are trying to figure out what took us so long in the first place.  After placing our order, we people watched and agreed that it felt like being home for a family get-together.  Dinner was incredible.  I ordered the pistachio crusted New Zealand Grouper while my husband ordered the halibut.  We sounded like a bad reality show, literally rhapsodizing about the food, it was THAT good.  The green apple bread pudding is now our favorite dessert, and for good reason.  The apples are tart, the pudding itself is perfect in consistency, the caramel sauce (homemade) was so good we were looking for a spoon to finish scraping the plate, and the whipped cream melted the moment it hit your tongue.  Everything together made for a perfect date night, and it won't be long before we go back and do it all over again.

I enjoyed my experience.  The food is better than some area competitors.  I ordered the Red Pepper & Lobster soup with an Italian Club.  Everything was up to par for me.  Soup was seasoned well and the sandwich was fresh along with the Ciabatta bread.  Seating is difficult to find but other than that, it's not a bad place to eat.

I got a pedicure and a manicure here and will not be going back, nor would I recommend it to anybody.

The pedicure was ok. The gentleman who did it was nice and great to chat with. However, he didn't paint the top edge of the nail, which you really should do if you want the pedicure to last a bit longer.

The manicure is what really ruined the experience for me. I told the woman the number of the color I wanted, and she took out the wrong one. She misread the number. When I pointed it out, she took out another wrong one. This one had most of the number smudged off. So I asked for the color samples back so I could try to show her. She gave me the color samples back but then made me put both my hands in the bowl so I couldn't go through them. Then she asked me what color I wanted, and when I said I didn't know yet, she told me to hurry. I chose a color and then noticed that she cut one of my fingers. She rushed through the manicure and left me with half the nails with rough edges and paint on the edges. The manicure definitely ruined my experience. 

After talking with my two friends who went with me, she cut the finger of one of my other friends, and she used the wrong color on one of them. 

Update: I have to go back in and change my rating to 1 star because it's 3 days, and there's lifting on my nails. It's gel, it really should be lasting longer.
I had a crispy chicken sandwich and shared onion rings and a malt with my mom and I would have to say yummm! I don't eat fast food much, but most definitely will return here again.

My friend and I came to Thai basil on a Saturday night. It was not busy, there were a lot of empty tables. We got sat right away but no server came to our table and no one took a drink order. We sat for 10 minutes waiting. We finally decided to leave when a couple who got sat AFTER us was greeted before my friend and I were. Terrible service. Will never come back to this restaurant. Very disappointed.
Staff was super helpful and the store was organized and clean which was a plus. I would definitely recommend this location

This is a local fav! 5 Stars doesn't do it justice. Definitely one of the best rib eye steaks I've had. It practically melts in your mouth and the flavor is to die for! If you don't have a reservation you stand a good chance of not getting in.

Needed to get the oil changed and tires rotated on my company vehicle. Not one soul in the place and not 1 car in the bay. I was told they were too busy. I must of missed the masses waiting for service. Will find someone who wants my business.

I like this location so much more than the downtown one, but it's probably because there is an amazing playground right outside! Our kids played on a beautiful early spring day and my hubby and I had a drink and snack while our girls ran around and played!! They make a really tasty Bloody Mary! We shared a few small plates, clams, meatballs, risotto balls, and they were all really delicious! Our girls would do a quick drive by from playing to have a quick bite and hey all agreed it was good! Our server Teddy was super sweet and very friendly! Such a great atmosphere for us!

I only thought they had places like this in San Francisco or Las Vegas!  Great place to take someone for their birthday.  The food is very good and the entertainment by the chefs is so engaging you'll forget you were there to eat!

A group of eight of us went there today to eat. The staff was friendly and set up tables for our bigger group.  Unfortunately, I'm not a fan of cold soup, and this was the second time I've eaten cold soup at this restaurant. The party in front of my husband and I was large and together (whereas our group of eight consisted of separate couples). I sat there forever waiting for them to get checked out.  I suggested, with the large lunch line, that they open the second register and was informed that was only the catering register. There was no catering going on, so they made everyone wait for this family with multi-kids to get their huge order completed.  This is NOT a way to run an efficient and well-managed business. How much repeat business will you lose if people, on limited lunch hours, get fed up with the slow service and cold soup? You should have more than one register open to ring everybody up when there are large lines.  You also shouldn't serve the soup until it's that person's turn in line.  I LOVE the food here, but the way the restaurant is run leaves a lot to be desired.  Because of the slowdown, our group of eight didn't get to eat our lunches together either.

Again, as many have posted about, this review is for the food truck side of this business.  To be honest, the food was so-so - it was definitely not the worst Sicilian food I have tasted, but it was not something I would go out of my way to eat again.  

However, their service was despicable and is the justification for my 1 star review.  Poor customer service, poor integrity, and an general lack of respect for the food service industry.  I have catered in the past, and would never treat my customers the way this company treats its larger catering customers.  Overpriced for the serving, inconsistent food preparation, and a lack of integrity in their business transactions.  I do not have a comment on their primary business, but the food trucks should be left out of the picture and a class in customer service taken by all in upper management.

We tried this place for the first time today and we loved it! To us, the best part of the meal was the potato skins they are an appetizer worth getting every time! We also got a 3 meat plate with burnt ends, brisket and pulled pork. The brisket was really good and the burnt ends were tasty, but the pulled pork was rather dry. My son got the ribs and they had a ton of meat and were amazing as well! We would definitely be back and though more pricey, it is worth it!

It is refreshing to find great customer service in this fast food world we live in. Ashley at Zupas is an example of great customer service. She took the time at the beginning to find out exactly what my wife wanted and needed as she is vegan and has had bariatric surgery for weight loss. The store was out of one of her favorite ingredients so Ashley suggested several different things until she got it right. And did she get it right! Her suggestion was delicious and my wife enjoyed the sandwich and soup.

For myself I had a bowl of New England clam chowder. It was different than any other New England clam chowder I have ever had. The onions and other ingredients in the clam chowder mix together to make tastes that were out of this world. The spiciness was just the right amount and I enjoyed the flavors dancing around in my mouth.

And dessert, who can't resist a caramel covered chocolate brownie? It was Heavenly and a great ending to a wonderful evening meal dining with my wife.

This happens to be my good friends favorite Restaurant and I can see why. Chris and Gina are the nicest ladies!!!!
I was told when I flew into Idaho that I was going to be taken to the Epi's for Basque food. I had never had that before, so I was excited to try a new type of food. 
I had a garlic shrimp plate and it tasted yummy! I would recommend the little cheesy hammy fried balls... I don't remember the name but they tasted great.
If you are in the area stop by for dinner.

This sporting goods store has just about everything that you can think of that you would need. I just went in to check it out since I'm new to the area and was pleasantly surprised. My husband said 'Now you won't have a hard time finding things to buy for me!' Since we now that he wants just about everything in the store I don't suspect that it will be difficult for holiday purchases!

I'm going back to get a smoker for myself as soon as I have saved my allowance, LOL!

If your main concern is eating gelato on a plush vinyl chair, Village Cinema is fine, but if you care about the movie you're seeing go somewhere else. Whatever projectors Village Cinema is using are the worst I've seen in the valley. You can see pixelation on the screen during the movie and I've had movies freeze on more than occasion.

I absolutely LOVE Inspire Salon!  Best customer service, friendly and accommodating owner, who also happens to be one of the best Massage Therapists around. 
The ambiance of this Day Spa is beautiful  and soothing with an amazing Mani/Pedi room that is plush and comfy. 
I would recommend going here for your Hair Care and Day Spa needs!

I have to say that I was skeptical at first because the hostesses were disorganized and didn't seem to have a clear sense of direction. There were multiple seats open at the sushi bar yet we didn't get seated immediately. That being said, the owner recognized the confusion and came over to seat us as well as gave us dessert on the house! My husband and I are sushi FREAKS and have tried almost every sushi bar in the Valley multiple times. We also travel and eat sushi EVERYWHERE that we go. This sushi was phenomenal! There were multiple sushi chefs pumping out rolls right and left. They all looked and tasted AMAZING. The salmon sashimi was the best in the valley. They are a new restaurant and they may have some kinks to work out, but as small business owners ourselves we understand what it's like at the beginning as you learn what works and doesn't. The food will NOT disappoint you!

The Treasure Valley is filled with Asian-themed eateries of various kinds. Phô joints, all-you-can-eat Chinese buffets, sushi bars. Fusion. They come, they go, they're reborn, they remain indefinitely. I think I like each variety for what each is. Buffets are fun for me. I do love to eat, but the variety is fun and though there's so much of it, I never get around sampling everything, which pisses me off. The way I see it, if you're gonna pay for a meal, you should be able to eat until feces starts spraying from your armpits. I have to be honest with myself, however, and admit that I can't eat that much -- not even with my love of food, especially Asian food, taken into consideration -- so I love me a quaint little place with great food and service and if they offer a little bit of this manner of fare and that manner, then I'm pleased. I mean, not when I'm actually looking for something more specialized, obviously. Fusion places are "non-buffets". They offer a great cross-selection of regional fare, they mix it up. And they usually do it in a quiet, soothing way. Which, for me, is a great way to enjoy lunch.

We chose Thai Basil, this afternoon, because it's been anticipated, its opening. "Coming Soon! Coming Soon!" And I love me some Thai. Unfortunately, the closest place to me -- Sawadee -- was a great disappointment when I tried it not long after moving to the area. Which was nearly two years ago. I sincerely hope things have changed, but I can't find it within myself to try, sorry.

I'm not really sorry. A restaurant -- or any business -- isn't owed your patronage nor mine. It's gotta work for it. Thai Basil, they worked for it. And succeeded.

I'll mention the one oddity I found right off, just to get it out of the way, because it's what you'll note at first: its front door reads that the business is shut down daily from 3 to 5 p.m. I have to say that though this gave me an initial frown, I realized that this is a painfully slow business hour at such restaurants. I've never gotten a good meal during this timeframe at them, either. We had an hour 'til the afternoon close, so we shrugged it off and went inside.

Thai Basil's interior is quaint and comfortable in an expected contemporary Asian-themed way that looks like- About ninety percent of Asian restaurants in the United States. But right off, we were hit by friendly service. The menu is a fusion of Chinese and Southeast Asian-inspired meals. There are several choices of egg rolls/spring rolls in the appetizers section alone. I ordered the Thai egg rolls, which are deep-fried and come in either chicken or vegetable. You get four, with plum sauce for dipping, and they come hot and fresh and are incredibly good, served on a long bed of shaved carrots and lettuce.

The entrees are huge. My sister and I both chose the beef Drunken Noodles. I, however, chose the "traditional", which is the spiciest offered. My sister also likes spicy fare, but she doesn't like it as spicy as I do, so she accidentally ordered hers mild. Which disappointed her, though it was her mistake and the platter was still tasty, though more sweet than sweet and spicy as mine was, which was spicy-enough to draw thick tears -- a certain way to determine that I'm enjoying a meal.

The beef in the noodles was magnificent. Our soft drinks were bottomless. And our server made sure every -- and I mean "every" -- one of our needs was satisfied, even bringing over a pad of paper and a pen for my great-niece, who's accustomed to having something to color on when dining. I tipped her well.

The prices are moderate. For what you get, very acceptable -- including in consideration of the level of service you'll enjoy. Our only complaint was that we hadn't read the menu deeply-enough to note the lettuce wraps before ordering the egg rolls. The server actually tried to stop the order, but it was too late. I hadn't expected her to do that and indeed ask her not to worry about it, but she was so eager to please. We'll just get 'em next time. I'm glad to say that there will be a next time.

"I'm spreading the word!" my sister assured her, our server. "I don't want this place to go away..." As so many of these places sadly seem to do.  The good ones as well, unfortunately. You can remedy this...

I don't think there is any place that provides better service or a more special family atmosphere than what we experienced on our visit to Epi's.  We visited recently, a little nervous about going to such a small place with 4 kids, but were welcomed with open arms, and by the end of the visit our 4 year old wanted to give hugs all around.  (which is saying something!)  

the food was good and homey, I had  the chicken and my daughter loved the meatballs.  We loved the bean soup, as well.  Definitely go and relax, you'll be well taken care of.
I LOVE this restaurant.  The best customer service I have every had the pleasure of experiencing.  The food is great too.

This was me and my girlfriend's first time at the restaurant, and we will be back!  So good!  The atmosphere is welcoming and open, with plenty of good Indie Rock music playing.  There are some great beers on tap, and amazing strawberry lemonade.

My girlfriend and I had the Sticky Garlic Twists to start, and the Pig Destroyer pizza.

Everything was delicious!  The garlic twists came with two sauces, a marinara and a kind of ranch dressing, but tasted fresh-made.  The twists were hot and chewy but not too hard to eat.

The Pig Destroyer was a very flavorful and enjoyable pizza.  It had the right amount of spiciness mixed with savory meats.

Go eat there and enjoy a fantastic date, lunch meal, fun dinner!!
The Thai Red Curry Chicken is my favorite! The shrimp summer rolls are delicious! Friendly staff, excellent service. A must try!

Best croquettas in the Treasure Valley, hands down. It's a small, close-knit dining area that feels like you're dining in grandma's house (that's meant to be a compliment). The staff is so friendly and will not hesitate to hug you and treat you like an old friend.

After a few visits and being happy we went and had terrible service to the point they didn't charge us for our meal, if fact sending home the stuff we waited for over 45 minutes for.  Once we got home we took apart a scallop roll to see that in an entire roll was less than half a scallop. Previous visits were better and not so skimpy.

We typically get take-out here, just because of small kids. I love that the staff is always friendly and always quick in getting an order ready. The longest wait I've had was 20 minutes, ever. Great food, some of the best in the valley! The basil fried rice is great, and their curries are awesome.

It's a rare thing when an owner, Chris and her staff, can remember the exact spot you were sitting in when a tired mom brings her 1 yr old daughter to an amazing place, and allows the mom to finally eat a meal that is prepared to perfection AND still hot! 
Letting the 1 yr old (it was a slow night), be herself, walking around giggling, and waving to people. That was 16 yrs ago! Last night, Chris and her staff, made sure my daughter was treated to an amazing bday dinner...with her own cake.  Chris is family to us, and if you want a truly amazing meal, go here.  Not one place, that I've ever been too, can compare. We love you Epi's...a true blessing to our community and family!! See ya for Payton's 13th!!! Lol! And! I'm sure 10 yrs from now, we'll be doing a rehearsal dinner there! Oh boy!!!

I greatly enjoy the services provided at You Do Doggie Bath. Everything is always very clean, the grooming stations are spacious, and all the supplies are close by. I have been in 5+ times to shave and bathe my dogs since The new owners took over and I have always enjoyed their cheery attitude. However, there seems to be no consistency in their pricing. My first few times in I was charged around $15 to shave and bathe both of my dogs who happen to be a service dog, and service dog in training. But was charged around $30 a time after that. I questioned such the rapid spike in price originally but since neither owner were present at the time, my questions went unanswered and they lost my business for about a year. My next trip in, I was charged around $15 for shaving and bathing both dogs which I was quite pleased with so I returned today with both dogs, only to be charged $45. Again, the owners were not present to answer to my disapproval of the price descrpancy. I will probably take my business elsewhere until they can nail down their prices. I will not spend $45 to shave and bathe a dog myself. I could shell out 20 more dollars and have it professionally done.

I have been craving a bagel for weeks but no where near the competitor in town I realized Sarahs was open in Meridian. I went in and the 2 gentlemen were super helpful and speedy. I took a dozen as my family loves them. I was glad I did. I was happy to see the salt bagel as they are my favorite but have only ever had them in Seattle on vacation. The bagels were chewy and flavorful. I especially liked the Hawaiian. I will be back!

I can't comment on the entire menu but the hot wings here are as good as I've had ( tied with the Firehouse Pub in Meridian). I love the traditional wings with the blackened rub and sauce on the side. They also have a decent Happy Hour. FYI they have 60 cent wings every Wednesday. When it comes to your wings please do not change a thing!!

Not only was the food amazing, but man that music play list they had going on, my friend and I couldn't stop dancing and singing in our seats. The atmosphere is great, so modern and relaxed, such a great style. Just loved everything about this place.

i recently read an article that said that culver's was #2 burger chain in the nation behind in n out so obviously i had to go and see what the hype was about. i have been before for the custard but didn't really feel like reviewing just for that. (it's really good in case you want to know!)

we ordered 2 double cheeseburgers and a large cheese curd and a large fry to split. it was a lot of food. the burgers were very fresh tasting and i liked that the patties tasted like they had just been grilled. they had a charred flavor to them. the burger also had american cheese, lettuce, tomato, red onion, and mayo. my only complaint was the entire thing lacked salt or seasoning. it tasted like they didn't put salt on anything. and i'm not really a salt fiend, it just was under seasoned. 

i also didn't like the bun very much- my husband and i debated on that one as he said the bun was excellent. so i guess it just depends on your tastes!

the cheese curds were okay. i wasn't a huge fan of the breading on them. the fries were pretty good though- crinkle cut is always a good choice!

i think we will likely be back, but i will have to try some other stuff on the menu. or maybe i will just get custard! haha!
I love the food here. They have buffet during lunch time which has a lot of food options, veg and non veg.   Service is great, 10/10. Definitely recommend this place.

After a not so great road trip my husband and I (his yelp account) just wanted a great meal and we found it!!! We went early and were greeted, like family, by the most beautiful woman! (The owner!)

You really want (need) a reservation, as the place was packed on a Wednesday. By luck she had a table and we proceeded to have an exceptional dining experience! Our server Marty was awesome and the food and wine superb. The Halibut was splendid! Kudos to the Chef.....thank you!
Jaime is awesome ! Best tans ever . She makes you feel really comfortable and even makes the tan smell good . The color came out really nice the way I wanted it to look.

Love the food here! Can get a little pricey especially if you go for the custard which I would recommend.  Love the crinkle fries with the fry sauce.  The custard is so creamy.  Love the turtle concrete. Their root beer is very good too!
Great food and awesome atmosphere. I really enjoyed the entertainment and the food was superb. I will definetely come back.

A completely unique and wonderful experience. Although there was a mix up with our reservation being entirely nonexistent, the owners more than made up for the minor confusion by seating us at a four top even though there were five of us and giving us the most complimentary service possible. The space is small and has room for maybe 30 patrons at once. 

Friendly, polite and homey, the owners mother, son and herself all participated in our wonderful meal. 

Unbelievably, there is a good amount of seafood available due to the proximity to Seattle. 

Chorizo ($13) was grilled lightly. New England style clam chowder was rich and creamy, not too salty. The Calamari is breaded lightly and has a slight snap to it. 

The beef tongue ($24) is prepared in an small casserole dish with a rich tomato sauce - milky, almost buttery, the tongue is tender. No knife is necessary to cut through the generous portion. A dish I have ever had anything like since or prior. 

Several orders of halibut and cod were breaded nicely and prepared with a buttery lobster sauce. Clearly fresh fish, flaky but unexpected in the midwest. 

No liquor, just wine.
Love culvers, great burgers for a great price. So glad this place opened up because I thought moving up here I wouldn't be able to get culvers anymore.

Ate here the other night and it was awesome!! Not just pizza they have great calamari for an appetizer! My husband and I had this and a pizza and the meatball sub for dinner and both were amazing! Can't wait to come back and try more! Dessert also looks fantastic!

Walked in around 5 and we were the only people there. Upon finishing, I'd have to say this is because it is a new place and nothing else. 

I enjoyed the laid back atmosphere: friendly staff, chill music, and rustic-hip layout. We were recommended to try the mozzarella sticks and they didn't disappoint. The cheese came from the creamery next door (mhmmm). 

Our table ordeded the ex girlfriend and fungus amungus. Yes, you read that right. Both were delicious and had local ingredients in them. 

Dylan, the owner, is a cool guy. He briefly mentioned his background and success in Portland. It should only be a matter of time before this place takes off. Highly recommend.

Fun, strange fact: You know what's really hard to find in Boise, ID? A BAKED POTATO. 

That's right. The Mister and I were in town right around his birthday, and I wanted to find the man a place to have a great steak and baked potato... but, bizarrely, it seems you can find most any sort of potato - fries, croquettes, mashies - but not a simple, baked spud. (And sidebar - I made and subsequently cancelled a reservation at a Boise steakhouse that offered a baked potato... because they literally served one cut of steak. Just one. And it's a prime rib (which I love, but the hubs does not, and it was HIS b-day... soooo... yeah. But, HOW DOES A STEAKHOUSE ONLY OFFER ONE STEAK?! Ok. Rant over.]

So, feeling somewhat defeated, I moved past my baked potato fixation and we opted to drive out to Meridian and check out Rick's, because if we couldn't get a baked potato, some "smoked, loaded mashed potatoes" seemed like they'd be a reasonable stand-in. More on that momentarily...

Rick's is a cute place, bedecked with newspapers and such. It took a few minutes to be acknowledged and seated, but the servers were friendly and attentive otherwise. We were asked if we had a reservation, which I found odd given the fact that the place was at only 30% capacity (going up to 60% in our time there), but whatever. We were seated by the windows, informed of specials, and off we went.

* We shared the garlic chili wings as an app (tasty sauce, though the wings could have been a touch crispier) accompanied by their signature celery slaw (in a nice dill-spiked dressing - definitely give that a try!)

* He had a side salad (the feta is a nice touch)

* I opted for the soup, a New England Clam Chowder - serviceable, and not overly salty

* We both ended up with the special: peppercorn-crusted NY strip (his, med.. well... mine, rare) accompanied by zucchini and peppers, which were supposed to come on some garlic mashed, but I subbed in the aforementioned smoked, loaded mashies.

The steaks were well-prepared (though I would have enjoyed it more if mine had been a little less done - it was closer to med. rare than straight up mooing), and the veggies had a nice bite to them. The star, however, were those mashed potatoes I keep mentioning. When they say SMOKED loaded mashed potatoes, they mean it - that smoke flavor makes this side something special, and it's amped up by sizeable chunks of bacon, creamy cheddar, and crisp green onion. I'd be lying if I said I couldn't just house a big ol' bowl of them and be perfectly content.

We skipped the tiramisu dessert being offered, but it looked tasty. All in all, an enjoyable meal.

I went to Thai Basil on Saturday for lunch. I read all the great reviews about this place and thought I would check it out.

1. Ambiance: The restaurant was clean and comfortable. 
2. Service: My servers were friendly, and responsive and quick
3. Food:  I ordered appetizer lettuce wraps and pad thai with Tofu.  I really enjoyed the lettuce wraps, however, having had lettuce wraps before at places like PF Changs, I was surprised that there were no sauces served with the wraps. Other than that they were fresh, and presented well, and had a generous serving.  The pad thai was not the best pad thai I had ever had but it is probably just a matter of personal taste. It tasted more like soy sauce than any other flavorings and there was no spice in it. In fact both dishes were not spicy at all.  I also enjoyed the house salad that they brought out.  

I give it 4 stars just because the food was good, but I have had better pad thai. it's a solid restaurant though and I do recommend it.

Yikes, a most ominous beginning to my first use of Yelp! All these rave reviews of Epi's, including by self-described Basque experts. So disappointed
by 1) the bread, the equivalent of French Wonder Bread.   2) the special Red Bean soup, tasted like Pork and Beans from a can.
   The entrees were good. Not great, good. The salad pleasant. The
gateau basque cake like a shortbread in a contest to see how much butter and sugar could be compacted into each square inch. Had the dinners been priced 40% lower, and the bread, soup, and dessert mercifully not served.......It would have been an "okay" experience.
    I would never, ever send someone there for dinner.
    That said, the owners and waitstaff are the nicest people in the world and I feel a bit bad giving such a pan review.....but they're making plenty of money, and I wish someone, just one someone had warned me against having my one dinner in Boise here. So I am hopefully doing that very thing for some stranger.

On the spur of the moment, I decided to call and see if there might be a spare table for an early dinner tonight...as it was a little before 5, I got an answer machine, left a message and headed off for the restaurant...on the way, I called to see if they got my message...turned out my phone number was cut off and Chris (owner) was delighted I called back and gave me excellent directions to the restaurant where I made it in before a big party arrived!

The above illustrates an endearing aspect of this place: friendly, outgoing service; very popular place/filled up quickly by the time I left...always good to see repeat patrons being welcomed like family.

What about the food?  Excellent calamari steaks and delicate rockfish served with wonderful aioli (calamari) and yogurt reduction (rockfish).  Servings were generous with nice touches (peas served separately), distinctive vinaigrette salad dressing...desserts to die for (brought back a bread pudding to savor later!)

Wonderful to see a place live up to expectations and not disappoint...I'll have to come back next time I'm in town.
Great food! Great people! I've enjoyed everything I've tried on their buffet and menu!
Always fresh, fast, and friendly! Love the healthy and light options. Homemade soups, salads and sandwiches. The salted caramel creme Brule is amazing!

Had this place on my "bucket list" while we are in the Boise area.  We visited there tonight and our expectations were exceeded!  We both ordered the salmon crusted in shredded potatoes and it was off the charts good!  Service was great, atmosphere was great and the food was absolutely delicious!  I had the cheesy potato soup for my side and I would have been happy with just the soup.....it was that delicious!  I can tell that he knows what he is doing.  Nailed it!  Great job!

We love the bagel sandwiches here! Delicious flavors galore such as cheese and jalapeño, everything, cinnamon raisin and much more. Happy to drive here for best the breakfast bagel sandwich in the area. It truly can't be beat. The service is nice plus fast and very professional. Highly recommend eating here. Fresh ingredients for the lunch sandwiches as well. This place is one of our faves!!

Decided to make the switch from Verizon to Sprint because I was paying out the you-know-what for a single line of service. 
Sprint happened to have an amazing trade-in promotion going on, and with that and their already more affordable phone plans, I was able to cut my bill in half. 
Daniel, the store rep, was really helpful and had great customer service skills. He answered all my questions with patience. 
If I ever need assistance again, I wouldn't hesitate to swing by this store.

Amazing food! Absolutely delicious. Ambience was nice too. 

I told the our server Keri that this was our first time.  I asked her which did she recommended the smoked prime rib our the ribeye since I was having a difficult time deciding. She recommended the smoked prime rib. It turned out that it was an excellent choice . Excellent flavor not and not fatty . I chose the smashed potatoes instead of the baked potato to try something different . I wasn't particularly crazy about them The potatoes had a cream sauce like biscuits and gravy. I was hoping for mashed potatoes with butter and garlic instead . The cornmeal muffins were awesome too. They add jalapeno peppers in the muffins to give it a little kick.

My husband ordered the half rack of beef ribs since it is not easy finding beef ribs anywhere .  He was in bbq heaven smothered in sauce . He didn't bother adding extra sauce that was provided on the table because there was plenty on the ribs.
I can't say enough about how nice it is to watch a movie here, love love love it!!! The seats that move are like a massage at the cinema and they always have the best movies playing.

Okay so the food here is ALWAYS good. It's always good quality. It's always what I want but thats been it so far like I like it because it's good and it's consistant.
Not today. Today it was AMAZING. I had the spicy tuna gyoza and it blew my mind! Not just was it amazing but it was all these flavors that i never imagined I would like together just making a magical flavor combination in my mouth.
I would always fall back on Izumi because they deliver but guys. NOW I will choose it because they're recepies are so good and original!!
Also great prices! Affordable foodthat is totally fair for the quality they offer. Definately an option for all price ranges and tastes!
Our favorite place for Indian food! I could eat here everyday! They also have a lunch buffet that's a great deal, and you can try all different food.

Although I was put off by the fact that everything comes from a steam table, I was pleasantly surprised by the flavor and freshness of the food here. My wife and I stopped in for lunch at this Qdoba location, on Overland near Eagle Rd, and after scanning the fast food style menu, I chose the steak fajita burrito and my wife ordered the taco salad with grilled chicken. We both asked for guacamole (an extra $1.19) which was absolutely wonderful and very fresh. Everything is put together in front of you (like Subway) and served on paper lined baskets. My wife chose the hot salsa on her salad, and I chose the medium salsa verde for my burrito. We thoroughly enjoyed both of our items, the flavors were top notch and perfectly balanced. The atmosphere is casual, and the price was a little steep ($21.00 for the 2 of us), but the quality of the food justifies the price. We'll surely return when we're in the area again.

Lupe helped me in so many ways. Make sure you ask for her by name. This store is beautiful and has a huge selection of top quality furniture. I have bought all of my furniture from Ashley for the last 12 years. Pieces are contemporary and yet timeless. Lupe is so accommodating and helpful in picking just the right pieces to coordinate with my home and lifestyle. Kids and pets. She truly listens and won't do business with anyone but her.

A "Thank You" to Ashlee (table host/server) and Char (Bistro Chef) for excellent service and a delicious meal during our stay on Tues (10/16).
Ashlee was super friendly, attentive, professional and accommodating.  Char prepared two excellent entrees for myself and my husband.
The other fact that was quite impressive was that it was almost time for the Bistro to close, but we weren't rushed at all!
As always, one of the MANY reasons we like to stay at Marriott properties when traveling.
M & J
Phoenix, AZ
Beautiful location. Wonderful food. It was very filling and such a nice place to go. The vibe was excellent. The chef was funny and we had a wonderful time. I will definitely be going back.

Deeply disapointed that I was charged almost $8.00 for a tiny bean and cheese burrito. The managers response to my concern was "I am sorry about that, we ring it up as a Vegitarian burrito and that is the price. I will pass your concern on." I will not be back for a while!

BEST SUSHI in town.  My husband and I have tried many places and Izumi's has by far the most fresh, big yummy pieces and rolls around.  We go here once a month, its worth every penny!  Hibachi is always fun and entertaining for the whole family.  Beautiful atmosphere, excellent food and good service you won't be disappointed. Great place to celebrate your birthday. :)
The food is great here im huge fan of there baby backs and the spicy wings and i always get good service take out or dining in.

Burgers are delicious! But the atmosphere isn't great. Unbearably loud. The hostess was wearing leggings as pants and dirty slippers. The floor was dirty.... Sorry, even with the good food, I won't be going back.

Pizza by the slice.  Very responsible priced.  I don't seem to get very good service at pie hole. In fact my kids think it's kind of funny.  Tonight was no different.   My first question to the not so freindly pizza guy was.. What is a cheaper way to go by the slice or a whole pizza pie?  Answer  "I have no idea I don't do math".  My second question was.. Will there be more pizzas coming out to choose from tonight?   And the answer was...  " Nope this is it for the night that's how we do it".   So my 9 year old sons says dad just get us some cheese pizza  "you get what you get and you don't  throw a fit.  So we ate our pizza in the not so clean pizza place and as we are leaving all the kids say " Dad we really like this pizza we need to eat here more offen".   So there you go.  The kids really like the thin crust pizza and I will just go with the flow....

One star out of one for good cleanliness 
One star out of one for good service
One star out of three for food.
The food quality in terms of freshness is good. However not all the foodstuff was warm/hot.
The taste is kind of ordinary. It seems they are unable to decide whether they should go with the authentic south Asian taste or Americanize the taste by making things blander.

They can also change their music from Bollywood to a mix of other Indian music too.
Best Chinese food in South Meridian.  We had the veggie fried rice, sesame chicken and spring rolls.  The spring rolls were not great but the rest of the food was delicious and fresh!
This place is wonderful. The food came out in a timely manner, the staff is very accommodating and friendly. And it's very authentic and well balanced Indian food! I am very happy and impressed!

Efficient is the best word to describe my experience. I appreciate efficient, (most of the time) especially for my fingers. A pedicure needs a little more love I think, but I haven't gotten one there yet. 

The man who did my nails, Vu, I think was his name, was very meticulous and careful with my fingers. The paint job was flawless. 

The only reason I knocked down a star was because of my 30-40 min wait. I did walk in, but the time I was told was a little underestimated. Next time maybe I'll try for an appointment? 

Either way, great place to get a quick, clean, nail job done.

Frozen Custard like I had back East when I was a kid. Great Burgers too!!
I'm not a huge fan of the crinkle fries, but we love everything else.
Andi G. fixed the shape of my nails I had done at another salon. She killed it. Love them, and will be getting all future manicures from Glitz!

We went on a Friday night and it was packed.  We waited 45 minutes for a table, not unlikely for a Friday.  Once we were seated it took a good 10 minutes before we were asked our drink order though.  I know they were slammed, but I think they were not properly staffed for a Friday night crowd.   There were 4 people total working: host, bar, and two waiters.  

We placed our drink, appetizer, and dinner order all at once since we had waited long enough to order that we knew what we wanted.  My hubby got a beer and we got roasted brussel sprouts and mozzarella cheese sticks for an app. Unfortunately it was a good 25 minutes before these came out.   Long enough to have a refill on our drinks.   

The Moz cheese sticks were excellent.  The panko crumbs they were rolled in had a phenomenal crispness to them. The flavor was excellent.  The cheese was thoroughly melted.  It was perfect in every way you wanted your cheese stick to look and taste.  The marinara and ranch dipping sauce was also excellent.  They make their own house marinara and it is excellent warmed up.  Also, the ranch was excellent too.  Not just a salad dressing ranch, but a very tasty peppery ranch.  Overall, moz sticks a success!   

Brussel sprouts were ok.  The actual sprout was roasted and tasted ok, still slightly bitter though.  To counter that it was served in a bowl of yogurt.  It wasn't cohesive, it didn't seem like it fit well together, and seemed like an odd dish overall.  It was ok if you like your sprouts a little bitter.  

For pizza, I got the Margarita pizza and my hubby got the White Tiger.  
It took about an hour to get this after we ordered it.  That was the down side.  On the plus side, it was delicious!!!   I loved the fresh basil and mozzarella on mine.  The ratio was a little light for me, but the over taste was excellent.  The only thing I'd change is a bit more moz and basil.  I felt it was too spread out and not enough cheese to cover the pizza.  But taste was exactly what I had wanted.    My hubby loved his white tiger.  The sausage and caramelized onions were excellent.  The one change he suggested was for the garlic to be chopped up instead of whole garlic cloves on the pizza.  

Overall food was excellent, however wait time for food could really be improved.  Overall customer service was excellent too.

Needed flowers for a friend celebrating her birthday.  One call and they took care of everything, had the flowers to my friend right away and we beautiful!  The had excellent communication, sent me receipt and delivery confirmation by email, and I am extremely happy with Floral Creations.  I will use them again!
This is a great place to eat. Good prices, good bagels, great options, and plenty of snacks if you're on-the-go. We love coming here. We will continue to come back.

For the money, this has quickly become our family's favorite Thai restaurant in the Valley. Though there is nothing fancy about it, the service and food are consistently good. Ask for Roxy....she is our favorite server.

I've rented from this location twice in the last few months and overall it's a fine experience. Im a pretty dedicated Enterprise customer having rented only from them and several times in the last couple years.

One thing that I have noticed is that even if your experience doesn't go smoothly they do tend to rectify it overall.

My first rental from this location went pretty flawlessly, they gave me an excellent car and I was in and out with very friendly customer service.

The most recent time was a little different. The manager at this location is super friendly but one of the customer service girls that actually got me in the car, etc - super flat and just not terribly friendly at all. I noticed the next morning this car had definitely been smoked in and since that's not what I was paying for, I called and kindly asked to swap it out. She advised they were out of cars at that location but that returns would be coming back around 3.I told her no rush, I wouldn't need it until later in the day so later was fine. She said she would call me back. No call back and I had it for two more days...  I found her response to just be silly quite honestly. Im paying to drive around a car that stinks of smoke when it should be clean and you are a car rental company with several locations in the area. Not having a replacement for me was not meeting the deal we agreed on when I gave my cc for a clean rental car..

Long story longer, when I returned it and the manager took back the car, he asked about my experience and I explained all of the above. It was clear that he too found the response and lack of response to be inadequate. He ended up taking some money off of my bill and offering an upgrade for a rental down the road, these were both considerate offerings to make the situation better and I appreciated that he acknowledged the situation.

I will continue to go to Enterprise and hopefully to this location as it is very convenient to me.

This place is nicely tucked next to Lucky Fins and Varsity. First impressions is a nice restaurant, friendly staff, and kind of cold. They have a good selection of beers, menu is nic and simple. We ordered the pig destroyer and the margarita pizzas. The pig destroyer is pretty good, but our margarita pizza was kind of cold, I kind of expected bigger pieces of mozzarella and basils. It was mainly tomato sauce and no thin slices of tomatoes. The mozzarella really didn't melt was more cold than anything. We took our pizzas home in a to go box that you would normally put in regular food. I would rather have gotten a pizza box. When we took it home and baked it in the oven, the pizzas tasted better with the the crust not soggy and the pizza nice and hot. Give it a try but I would say for the price and taste, Blaze pizza is a better choice. "Give it a try and feel the hunger!"
What a blast!  Good food, good service, and laughs all around.  Our new favorite restaurant.
Place rocks. Super good tofu and noodles. The whole water gun thing is fun. Great place for a party. Fair pricing for everything. Owner is super nice.

We tried out this new place last night because of recommendations from people familiar with the chain.  All I can say is it's OK.  Not bad food, but nothing special.  Great place to take younger children.  Friendly and fast service and certainly affordable.

For the money The Habit does a much better burger.
2 different times now my co workers and i have gone here at lunch time, both times over a 40 minute wait, if you are white expect every Hispanic that pulls up after you to get their food first.

The next time you are in Boise, Idaho, you absolutely must visit Epi's Basque Restaurant.  Everything about this restaurant is cool, and especially the uber-fresh fish and traditional Basque choices on the menu.  I had fresh-caught Sable fish flown in from Alaska that morning.  It was amazing and so fresh it almost slapped me. LOL  The owner cooks and works the small dining room.  Check out this place!
I like most of the food, but the prime rib has been pretty tasteless the last two times I've ordered it. Best house salad in town.

We have been back and seems they have worked out some of bugs.  5 Stars. 

And the dollar movie on wed and thursdays  great deal.

I love the food and the service is outstanding!  Friendly staff, clean dining area and the food is so yummy, I keep wanting to go back! 
I work next door and told them I can't leave my store to wait in line to order. They suggested I join the VIP club to earn rewards and to order from the catering menus (same food) If you do this, you have to order by 11:00 am. I  love that I was able to quickly walk in and pick up my order. They kept the soup in a warmer so it was perfect!  I have my credit card on account so all I have to do is sign for it.  It's a timesaver!
Very nice salon. I saw Robyn and she is friendly, skilled and meticulous. And prices are very reasonable. Recommended!

Read reviews for Goodwood and Texas Roadhouse. We looked at the two menus online and found that Texas Roadhouse had  very limited options with turkey and chicken meals. For that reason we went to Goodwood. We went on a Tuesday evening right at prime dinner hour. The place is huge and we were seated almost immediately. Our waiter was Kody. He was attentive and very knowledgeable about the menu. Our meal was absolutely delicious. Service was top-notch. Kody was tremendous. Food was tremendous. Highly recommend.

Well, this is a head scratcher.  Stellar reviews but in my opinion, the pie was just ok...and I'm hesitant at giving this place a "3".  The pie literally looked like it was made with pre-made crust but I could be wrong.  The sauce, and although they advertise it using authentic San Marzano tomatoes...it literally tasted like they did just that - opened up the can and simply poured it all over the crust.  The fresh basil looked like it had been ridden hard and put away wet.  

The Wings - also just ok.  They serve their buffalo wings with ranch dressing - not blue cheese... :(. 

Next time I'd make the drive into town for a little bette quality pie - it'd be worth the drive.  

Sorry.
Amazing shrimp and their pork fried rice is awesome!  Friendly service and our food was prepared quickly.  I highly recommend this place!  Very clean dining environment.

Constant having issues with VIP - go on the website says it has it, go there to buy the VIP tickets says it doesn't exist. Or like tonight, checked to see VIP was there, went to go buy the tickets and said it doesn't even have it. Called to 3 different people, all 3 of them said "It's a glitch in our website," "It all just depends on if it's a popular movie," when the movie came out 2 days ago... nice logic for your dumbass workers for horrible service and no known of actual knowledge of what's going on with the actual movies playing.
Almost never disappoints. The bar upstairs, wow. Drinking whiskey in the theater without a flask? Awesome. The food was cool too.

The food here was wonderful! They have a lot of different sushi rolls to choose from. They also have hibachi and traditional dishes you would get at an Asian restaurant. We got the general Tso chicken, Godzilla roll, and Idaho roll. All of it was delicious! Atmosphere was nice and staff was very friendly. Our water never got less than half full. I would definitely recommend this place to anyone!

The smoked turkey was so good. Still so moist.The Aunt somebodys sweet potato casserole was heaven! Best thing I ate. BBQ sauce on tables OK. Dessert was delish! brownie ice cream something. It was good but obviously not super memorable a month later.

The decor & ambiance were very cool. Rustic & refined. I liked it.

Some friends from out of town we're coming for a special occasion, so I suggested Rick's. The friends were a little skeptical when they arrived, as the outside of the building and the interior hide what will be a  fantastic meal. Rick and his wife Julie went all out to make this a special night. We had a four course meal with a flaming dessert. Everyone was blown away, especially the potato encrusted salmon. They all want to eat there next time they are in town!
Went back more recently and noticed the quality had diminished a bit.  Same great wine and atmosphere, but the seasonings were tame on every plate.
Love love love this Indian restaurant!  Certainly one of the best in Boise!  Quality ingredients, great flavors, always delicious meals.  Very happy to have this great place nearby!

Never have I been to a 5 star (on yelp) restaurant, so I was dying to try this out on my last trip to the Boise area. It did NOT disappoint. From the ease of making my reservation (how sweet is Chris?!) to the warm welcome when we walked through the door, I knew it was going to be amazing. We had a cozy little table in the back corner which was perfect. The entire restaurant was full on the Tuesday evening at 7pm. 
Now on to the food... Seriously some of the best I have EVER tasted! Per previous reviews, I knew I wanted to try the croquettes, but since we were still slightly full from lunch we ordered a half order. That was perfect for the two of us! Not kidding... They literally melted in my mouth. YUM. 
For our starter, we each tried a different soup. I had the traditional bean and my dining partner had the soup of the day, which was cabbage. We both enjoyed them very much. For dinner we split the halibut with lobster cream sauce and garlic peas on the side. Oh!Em!Gee! SO delightful!! It's a must! 
As we were finished with our dinner, a gentleman came to our table and said that he noticed we were looking at the ink fish he was having for dinner. Turns out, it was Epi's grandson. He offered us a few bites along with some bread to try the sauce. Honestly, it's a bit off putting with the black color, but the taste was enjoyable. Not something I would order on my own, but I'm glad we were able to try it. 
We also had the house red wine which was a Tempernillo and an incredible value at $20 per bottle. 
I am so happy to have had the opportunity to experience Epi's. We will most definitely be back!

I travel a lot for work so I love to order delivery from here (through Cafe Courier) after I get home. They have never once gotten my order wrong and the food is always good. Great burgers and I recommend the pub chips!

The staff was so incredibly friendly and welcoming. I'm a visitor from out of state and have been going to the same Thai restaurant for about 10+ years, so I was hesitant to try someplace new...but I was not disappointed! I ordered larb chicken and Lao style papaya salad (both extra spicy). The flavors were bold, balanced, and extremely delicious. The spice level was just what I asked for, and I was delighted to get my order meticulously prepared in a timely manner. Job well done Thai Basil! 

P.S. Happy 4 year Anniversary! Hoping for many more successful years of business for you!

I absolutely love this place.  I think I may need to plan a trip back to Boise just to dine here again.

This is a small family owned restaurant the serves Basque food.  The restaurant appears to be a modified house and I can't imagine the dining room can accommodate more than 50 people so I would suggest making reservations.

The staff is very sweet and take pride in their establishment.  I hugged the owner when I left!!!

The food is amazing; half because the taste was wonderful and half because it is something different than the other chain restaurants.  Do not miss this place!!!

The facility is awesome!  The price is ridiculous.  Staff is nice and accommodating.  I paid over 30 dollars for an hour for two kids.  It's steep.  There is a lot of things for the kids to do but it's just expensive.

Food is good, the tikka masala tasted different than what I am used to. Maybe they added more than cardamon than what I prefer. Garlic naan is amazing. Service is good and friendly. Shame the wine list is rather sad. No dry white wine, only a Chardonnay.
Sushi is really good, their fried rice is okay, can have some improvement. We will come back

Ordered two pizzas and a meatball sub. The Potato & Bacon pizza was something new to try. And it turned out it is something worth having again. The meat ball sub was one if the best I have had in a long time. If I based the rating on the sub alone it would be five stars for sure. Oh, mine was to go but the wait time was shorter than I expected.
Great place! Super comfy seating, stadium of course. We even lost something in there and later had it returned to us from their lost and found. Awesome!
Visiting from Denver they have never heard of Pinot noir ! Server young holy who said 3 times it was late and to order only fried foods. Why give us menus ? Food horrible tortilla chips soggy skip it

I've been here twice (always give a second chance, right?) and both experiences were bad. All at checkout.  This week, I stood in line with two others (separate parties), while THREE cashiers were working.  Two were at one register - one was bagging and one was running the register.  BOTH were chirping away like birds, taking a lot of time for the chat part.  The third cashier studiously ignored us.  When one of my line mates got so frustrated (we had already all talked amongst us about the wait time and wasted time), she asked the third if she could ring or call for more cashiers.  Turns out #3 was in training and reading her manual.  Yoohoo?! Trainers?! Someone should train every staffer to watch for pissed off customers!  

Back to the two talkers -- one was Marsha, older, white-is hair. When she was asked if more cashiers could be called, she said, "Oh! I was so busy here I didn't see the line!...." and called another cashier.  Yoohoo....Trainers?!  We were standing about 10 feet from her station.

The other cashier -- the one who had been bagging? -- was immediately sent to a checkout counter -- on the other side of the store. Whaaaa? Someone else was dispatched to a checkout counter at our side of the store.  More wasted time.  (Also, the bagger could have moved to a checkout position much sooner....)

I was first in the line and had waited almost ten minutes -- doesn't SOUND like a lot, but try it waiting in a line, listening to two cashiers chat their way through those ten minutes...it was mind-bending.   There is no reason to go to Kohls above any other place -- and there is every reason not to with this level of customer care.

I would give this restaurant a solid 3.5.  The buffet has the basic offerings and everything tasted fine. The restaurant is spacious and clean. 
My only suggestion is to make sure that the food trays stay hot. About half the dishes on my plate were lukewarm or cold. 
All the dishes had great flavor and I really like their version of naan...it is very thin and crispy with fresh herbs sprinkled on top.
Amazing.  The owner is so friendly, the place feels like you're in someone's home, and the food is impeccable.  You're in for a treat!
The quality of their meat is just excellent and you can NOT go wrong with their Smoked Prime Rib. Get there early in the dinner service, because they have a limited amount every night.

This place is pretty great. Comfortable couches to lounge on while your kids play!!  

The crappy part is the food situation. They don't allow outside food but the food service they have is pretty minimal. They said it would be a 10 minute wait for the pizza. 25 minutes later the pizzas arrived. Still almost frozen in the middle. It wasn't even crowded. At all. 

They should allow outside food if they are going to be this bad with their own food! That said you could easily sneak in some of your own food. Not enough staff to monitor that.
The service is prompt, the steak was juicy and our cook Eric was amazing! We will definitely be back.

Went here when we found out it was new in town, especially since I love the building. 
This place was...strange. We were one of 3 tables in the place, and it just felt uncomfortable from the minute we walked in. It seemed that everyone could hear our conversation. The tables and chairs were not conducive to lounging around with pizza and beer. The waitress acted as if we intruded, no friendly greeting, lots of awkward staring. 
We left without eating.

We took our two boys for a special graduation late lunch, we got there at three or so and we were the only ones in the hibachi area. The waiter was very nice, and our cook was very fun, my boys loved the little show. The food was good, the service was good. Was it a bit pricy? Yes. Was it worth it for a special occasion? Absolutely! We had the sea, sea,sea-chicken and shrimp- and salmon and scallops, all of it was delicious.

HORRIBLE service! Our server did not know how to pronounce half the menus items, such as quinoa or Hefeweizen. By the time we placed our order, we were so confused! She had no idea what she was doing!! The bartender had NO CLUE how to make drinks!! The food was not horrible but not great. The restaurant was located within walking of our hotel, which was the only reason we went there again, the next night, for drinks. But again, the server was completely clueless and the bartender sucked! I would never go again!

Just stopped in for a couple quick meals to go. The cashier was friendly and courteous and the food was ready to go in less than 5 minutes. The buns were fresh and the hamburgers were still relatively hot when I got back to the motel. 

One thing that knocked a couple stars off was the amount of salt on the fries. The salt was so thick that I had to take a swig of water after every bite and eventually couldn't finish the fries. The salt also started to irritate the inside of my mouth and lips.

Please just a couple of shakes of the salt! Please!!!! If people need more salt they can add the salt from those little packets you keep at the condiments counter.

Definitely unhappy with my nails. I went in for a fill, I had a picture of what I wanted done and she said she needed to do a whole new set which was twice the money. My nails don't look how I wanted them. I recommend going elsewhere.
Solid food truck experience.  Very reasonably priced and consistent! I recommend the spicy pork taco, and the cardio Sada.  So delicious!  And a real Coke in a glass bottle of course!

I used to live in Meridian and I remember when Johnny's first opened up. They offered a large pizza for $4.99, and they're situated right down the street from Little Caesar's as it is. So when it came up as to "where should I stop for pizza?" the answer was Johnny's. Usually.

Time has passed and things have changed a little bit for both this little pizza place and myself. I'm a different person, now. I've had a lot of different pizza in my life. So how does it hold up?

PizzaKen and I arrived separately. I was accompanied by my girlfriend, Meg-arita (I forget all the nicknames we've come up with for people). The friendly cashier recommends the bbq chicken, so we get that on half with (you guessed it) pepperoni on the other. I throw in some cinnamon bites for extra fun.

The pizza comes out pretty quick. Like I mentioned, they're not far from Little C's, so you know they're good on applying the gas. There's a small alcove with some arcade machines next to the order and oven area. Obviously the experience is meant more for the get-it-to-go-er, but it's nice that we've got somewhere to sit.

-The Pepperoni-
Ah, yes. It's still pretty much how I remember it. It has a gooey texture overall, with nicely crisped peps. The dough feels big in your mouth but it goes down easy. It's a sweet, uninspired, but not unwelcome flavor. Solid.

-The BBQ Chicken-
Ken likes this one a lot. It makes me think, "This is how Chicago Connection should have done it." Nothing really stands out, again, but there's nothing about the joint that seems like it's aspiring to be "artisan." It's just good.

-The Cinnamon Bites-
I forget how these are actually labeled on the menu, but they're very good. Light, fluffy dough smothered in that rich cinnamon glaze and topped with that buttercream drizzle. If you're a fan of cinnamon rolls, you won't go wrong getting these.

-The Verdict-
Johnny's has got you covered. The best part of all this is it cost a pretty nominal amount. Without the cinnamon bites, I believe the X-Large pizza we received was only $18-ish. And it was a 50/50, 12-slice pie! They definitely offer highly competitive prices on their simpler pizzas, still working hard to out-do that Caesar's down the street, and in my opinion, they do that much very well. They definitely offer wider selection and more sides on top of that Go Local bonus. Don't plan to get blown away, but Johnny's is unlikely to disappoint.

3 slices out of 5

Ok we tried Popeye's again. So disappointed in the one in Nampa. So slow. Forgot half of our shrimp order, didn't include a biscuit that we paid extra for. Mine was cold. Waited over 20 minutes for our food. They didn't have any mild chicken which I would think for a Wednesday at 4pm they would have some nope had to wait. Then the person putting our food order together had no clue on how to put boxes in a bag ended up with a jumbled mess. Good thing I am smart enough to do it myself. They were out of the boneless wings so them putting up a sign helped them as people didn't order them. However, they should put up a sign saying they are out of mild after saying it's taking a bit longer to cook the mild. Pay good money for the food but each time we go they forget half our food or put gravy on the potatoes when they even have it on the receipt not to put any on ours.

SO GOOD!  I'm a newbie to Indian food and was scared it'd be too spicy but they ask you if what spice level you want (1-5).  We had our 9 year old with us so we stuck with 1 and our waitress offered to bring a side of hot sauce so we could make ours a little spicier.  The food was so flavorful and warming on a cold winter night.  We all enjoyed every dish we ordered and shared.  Will definitely be back .
