As a renter for almost 3 years under this property management company at their Murano Pl. properties, I can honestly say to ANYONE .. DO NOT RENT FROM THIS MANAGEMENT COMPANY! I pay my rent and have for the almost 3 years I've lived here ON TIME (with exception of 1 month, which is absolutely explainable). They claim to be so concerned about giving their renters a "wonderful experience" as quoted from one of their employees yet we are forced to live in situations that call for immediate action but fall very short in timelines. Since the very first snowfall of the winter, 2016 year, we have had our walkways shoveled twice in which snow melt was sprinkled. Several of us have gone out and purchased snow shovels and taken it upon ourselves. I am disabled but I refuse to allow a situation that could harm me more go unattended because of someone else's responsibility that they choose not to address. Maintenance requests are often called in a couple or few times over the course of several weeks before being handled. I will say that the ownership did change hands sometime in 2016 however, it didn't seem to change in the manner handled whatsoever. Everything seems to fall upon the renter because according Paradigm Property Solutions, it's really not their problem.

I didn't expect Izumi, a Japanese Steakhouse, to have great sushi. Boy was I wrong. I always order the same thing at different sushi restaurants I visit. My dish of choice is chirashi - a typical Japanese way of eating sushi. 

The presentation was over the top.  Spectacular. True art on a plate. And the taste was even better.  Thanks Izumi for a fantastic place to partake in my favorite food.
Very good, tasty Basque food. Waitresses are very nice. The combo cod is highly recommended. Went two days in roll...on a short biz trip.

Started with the crab dip and wings...delish! Had to go in on the salmon and loved it. Not big on chain restaurants and have been here 3 times now and have never been disappointed. Rick sent us a free flaming tiramisu to top our night off. I had no room left but had to try it and it just melted in my mouth. Signed my name on the wall and can't wait to come back!

I cannot remember how many knives I have purchased from Jeff, almost all of which were Spyderco ones. In all cases, shipping was prompt, and a tracking number was always provided. My latest order is expected to arrive in today's mail. Christmas in September.

The best thing about Cutlery Shoppe is that they offer exclusive versions of Spyderco knives, along with those from a select few other makers, with the "correct" handle color, which is, of course, orange. Because these are exclusive, and not regular production run knives, a limited number are made and will eventually sell out.

I am looking forward to buying more "sharp things" from Jeff in the future. Order with confidence!

Culver's is a great franchise that allows single family owners to own one or two restaurants making this concept a great locally owned business that serves up some real good quick service food.  I do believe they have one of the best fish sandwiches anywhere!  Also other great burgers and a awesome pork-tenderloin sandwich.  If you're not familiar with the brand you should give them a try...you will see the quality and family pride in every bite!  Great chain restaurant.  Nice addition to Meridian.
Good food, but portion sizes are small.  I got an $11 dinner and left hungry, not what I'd expect from a place that seems like it caters to guys.

First time here. The food tasted excellent. Fresh. High quality. Had the lunch menu  Shrimp and  Broccoli with fried rice and it was done to perfection. Also, absolutely LOVED their Thai Iced Tea! So delicious! Also, enjoyed the atmosphere and the the wait service was excellent. I will definitely go back!

This place is to die for! If you're looking for delicious food and good entertainment with friendly staff this is the place to go! All the food is amazing  amazing service and on top of everything! This is one of my favorite places in Boise!

I never hear much about Beef O'Brady's.  I think it is one of those hidden gems in the Treasure Valley.  I have been here several times and they always deliver!  Great food, great service and fun sports bar with TVs all around.  Another big reason I love this place is once you hit 9 or 10pm in the Meridian/SW Boise area your choice of restaurants significantly drops as most everything closes.  Not BOB's, they stay open till 11pm!  I love that about this place.  If you are up for the challenge, try their OMG Burger, it is one of the best burgers I have had in town.

Great fun for the Bday partay we had and this was a good spot to begin the celebrating with the girls... Food and Fun...always...
Bit light on the portions all around. Great selections. This time around I tried to keep it simple. That wasn't the best idea... Cuz simple is really simple. I will just stay with the all around good stuff. Yes, I usually get sushi. 
Again, great spot for starting the partay rounds.

I will never go there again.
Rewards card points are NOT honored,  & staff unwilling or unable to provide an explanation .

This was my first time at Cafe Zupas.  There was a slow line to order my food, which would be okay if it's worth the wait.  It was very noisy and I felt like I had to shout my order to those behind the counter.  Then I was unsure if they heard me correctly.  Fortunately, they did understand my special instructions.

The Chicken Tortilla soup was okay, but I've had better in many other places.  I had the turkey, bacon, and avocado sandwich without the avocado.  It was a small sandwich without much meat and the bacon had no flavor.  So overall, this was okay, but I would not go out of my way for the food.

Epi's is a wonderful little Basque restaurant in Meridian Idaho.  The owner Chris is an amazing woman who makes you feel welcomed the moment you walk in the door.  

The restaurant is pretty small so it is highly recommended that you make a reservation.  We like to have dinner on the patio, its one table that comfortably sits six to eight people. There is a curtain that you can close so you do not see the people coming and going.  

The food.. its amazing. I have been coming to Epi's for years and have never had a meal I did not like. Plan to spend a couple hours for the meal, you will be served appetizers if you order them, bread, soup, salad, the main course and finally dessert (if you have room). I like to try their specials,especially if they are fish.  My favorite appetizer is the calamari as it simply melts in your mouth.  The dessert we will order and take home because we are to stuffed to eat that night is their bread pudding.  It is simply wonderful.

Go check out this little gem.

I wish I could give 0 stars! I'm appalled at their lack of customer service. My furniture was supposed to be delivered during a 3 hour window which I gladly waited the three hours. After the 3 hours passed I hadn't heard anything. I gave them a call to find out the truck broke down and no one called to inform me. Apparently they don't have other trucks to continue their deliveries.. Now my delivery date is pushed back a few more days. I will gladly take my business elsewhere. Really disappointed.
Maybe we hit it on a bad night but the food was horrible, drinks we're alright! Won't go and eat there again.
An excellent little quaint restaurant in downtown Meridian. The service is exceptional and the food is to die for.

We were greeted by the owner and received like family. I had the butterfish special and ink fish appetizer. Everything was amazing. The rest of the party ordered the shrimp and Halibut. I could not suggest any improvements to our dining experience.

The chicken is pretty good and the service is ok from what I have see. But the French fries are not flavorful nor to they meet the standers of any fast food place. The overall cost is expensive compared to all the fast food places I have been too. But to end this off on a good note the biscuit is fluffy and flavorful.
I have never had such a great experience getting my nails done they are the sweetest girls and do an amazing job

On the way home and decided to stop at zuppa's tonight and get a bowl of soup being that it's cold and wet outside. I love the fact that they have so many options when it comes to soup (by the way offer samples if you can't decide) and everything is made fresh every day. I like the kitchen has see through glass so you can see how everything is prepared fresh every day. I decided today to get the chicken enchilada chili which is a great option if you're trying to watch your calories. The regular size at about six dollars is only 360 cal. I usually get a regular and then I'll have two meals out of it. Cool thing is they give you a little hunk of bread and a chocolate covered strawberry. I like any meal that comes with a chocolate covered strawberry to finish it off it off. The customer service is always super friendly; is nice that you can actually walk through the line and tell them what you want. I've actually been here other times for their salad options and they are very delicious. This is a great place either get soup or salad definitely would recommend it. This fall if you're looking for somewhere to grab a bowl of soup Zupas should be definitely one of your go to options they have several locations in the Boise area. One frustrating thing about them just like Chick-fil-A they are not open on Sundays. Like a said it's a great option to warm you up this winter!!

We are regulars and have never been let down. We are known here by name and this fits our bill of cozy unique places with good food. Rick has a simple menu and regularly has specials.

I happen to be a fan of his wings and always plan on getting them until I hear the specials. If you come visit us, Ricks is in our top five places we are going to take you too.

We've struggled to find really authentic ethnic food since moving here. We tried some Indian places in downtown Boise which didn't impress.  Then Spice moved into Meridian and with first order we were thrilled. Finally a place that cooks like the Indian places at home.  I like the online ordering too because then it is ready for me to pick it up on they way home from work.
The sandwich was good, but they should use gloves when making them. It's gross to ring me up on the iPad that the customers all touch then go make my sandwich with no gloves.

I had not visited an Ashley store until until a couple weeks ago when I was shopping for a sofa. I was assisted by Otto and he was most helpful in guiding me to my perfect option. He was honest and upfront with me, never tried to upsell me and clearly and thoroughly explained the process (selection, shipping, delivery, setup, etc.). It was such a positive experience that I returned last weekend to buy a dresser from him, as well!
Mike B in millwork was super friendly, helpful, knowledgeable. They have the nicest people working there.
My husband, son and I had waffle cones and our fave ice cream last night! Best ice cream cones ever!!!!!!

Tonight was a first. For the first time since moving to the Treasure Valley almost five years ago I experienced the worst customer service in a restaurant in my entire life. And I have lived in many states and enjoyed some of the best wines and food in the finest restaurants from California to New York.

My boyfriend and I visited Bodovino at the Village in Meridian earlier today (June 23, 2017) and encountered the rudest employee imaginable. I was trying a California Chardonnay when the apparatus they use to pour ran out of the wine that I was sampling. I alerted an employee who indicated he would look at it. After a considerable amount of time with no assistance I again requested some help. This time I talked to Thayne. 

I attempted to explain to him that I felt my Bodovino wine card was charged for a entire wine pour but Thayne abruptly cut me off. Rather than offer an explanation he chose to argue with me and refused to serve me. He then approached our table and accused me of disrespecting him. I guess the customer doesn't come first in his world. 

I have been going to Bodovino since they opened and my boyfriend was one of the first customers at the downtown Boise location. We even participated in their 2016 New Year's Eve party. He gave me $100 Bodovino card as a gift because he knew how much I enjoyed this place. The previous manager, Amy, and former employee Kayla as well as Channing have been the greatest. I consider them friends. I should also mention that a very good wine, Dunham Cellars, from Walla Walla, WA is being stored and served in an extremely warm environment. Such a shame. If I were a Dunham representative I would be very concerned. 

But tonight was our last visit and I encourage all my friends to do the same. There is absolutely no reason to visit an establishment that disrespects their customers and witnessed by other patrons in the restaurant. 

As a professional Pharmacist I have spent an entire career working with people. In fact, I would argue that my clients are the most vulnerable. Many times they are sick, depressed and just want to feel good. I always did my best to treat them with the upmost respect and dignity they deserve. I wanted nothing more than to make them feel better and give them the individual attention they so deserved. If I treated a client like I was treated tonight by Thayne, I would have been disciplined on the spot and maybe even fired.

When the the current manager, Dan, tried to diffuse the situation all I was asking for was an apology. Since it was clear that Thayne was not going to say he was sorry we closed out. As we were leaving he again chose to get into an escalated verbal exchange and threatened to call mall security. Unbelievable!

If you want a truly memorable wine tasting environment I recommend you spend your time and money at Telaya Winery, Coiled Wines, Tastings in southeast Boise or Capital Cellars in downtown Boise. There's also a great place called Divine Wine, Cork & Fork in downtown Meridian. Anywhere but Bodovino.

My experience with Ashley's Furniture (AF) was less than stellar. Excited with the first purchase of our house, we were seeking furniture. One of the local furniture store did not have what I was looking for in a dining room table or headboard for the master room. 

We ended up going to AF where we were greeted by three sales associates. Each one looming around us like we were fresh meat, waiting to strike and take the kill. Within the first 10 minutes, I saw the headboard and footboard I wanted. My husband had questions and spoke to a sales associate named Allen. WHAT A MISTAKE! My husband wanted our mattress to sit flesh with the footboard (to prevent the ever scooting mattress). Allen agreed that it would sit flesh. He showed us and ASSURED us the headboard and footboard would be snug. However, AF did not have King size available. The closest one was in Utah, which would be the end of May. Hesitant, I said," Maybe I should check out a few more stores before I decide". Allen then insisted that he check the Boise location to see if they had it. He happily returned and said there was a king size at the Boise location, but it would be two weeks to get it to us. The delivery date was set for May 20th. 

What happened next was just amazing.  Allen LIED to us. We waited all day on the 20th expecting for AF to deliver our Headboard. Nothing came. About 7PM I called AF to see what the hold up was. I spoke to a manager. He informed me he had no notes about a delivery for the 20th. I then explained him to him the conversation we had with Allen. The manager basically said we were lying. NICE, right?! We, the customers, were lying about a conversation we had with a sales associates. We just wanted our headboard to complete our room. I was stunned. I even told the manager I would prefer to have my money back at this point. He said "let me make it up to you by refunding the shipping cost." I said fine, but when is my bed coming. He said it would come to the 27th. Frustrated, I said okay. 

The day of delivery..... surprise surprise. The delivery individuals set up the bed. Nice People. I signed indicating I received the bed. I went into the room to put on the sheets. SURPRISE there is about 1 foot gap between the mattress and footboard. LIVID... we took pictures. We went to AF and the customer service rep was surprised. She said that is unusual and they probably got the box mixed up. She would send someone else over with the correct railings.

Okay. Great. Right? WRONG! Another individual from AF came out. She indicated that the side railing was for a CalKing. The side railing in the box is labeled as a King, but is indeed a CalKing. I informed her at this point, I would like my money back. She said she couldn't do it, but wanted to make it up to me. She didn't have any "queen" sized railing, hoping it would fit a king, in the shop. It would take two weeks to get in but would have her manager contact us. Nothing was resolved. I informed her again, I just wanted my money back. Nothing. She hurriedly left our house.

The manager called about 4 hours later, his name was Joe. He was AWFUL! He kept talking over me when I tried to explain to him what was going on. Angrily raised my voice. He said that we did infact received the correct side railings. I explained to him that our dog, a westie fell thru the gap and hurt himself. It is NOT the right railing. It measured as a CalKing, as done by his employee and ourself. I asked him to come to our house, so he can see for himself. He indicated the gap would be filled once blankets and comforter was added to the bed. My husband indicated the gap was indeed so large it wouldn't matter. 

I asked my money back, as I never wanted to shop at AF again. He told me I could NOT have my money back. I could do an exchange for something else but would not be able to give me my money back.

I ordered a product which was different from the showroom floor. I was unsatisfied with the product. I had the product for a good 4 hours. I want my money back. He told me no. What kind of business refuses to give our money back for a product that was NOT was discussed by a sales associate? The sales associate has lied on many different levels. There are no repercussions on his behalf. The sales associate indicated if the headboard or footboard did not fit, look, or match we could return it and get our money back. I specifically remember discussing this, because I was scared of how large it was and it wouldn't fit. I find this very alarming. I am an individual who does not write companies often, but having the experience I have, I will assure you I will inform all individuals who are looking at furniture of this story. I would NEVER want someone to go thru what we have gone thru. This is suppose to be a fun experience. Instead, it was an absolutely miserable one.
Great prices, great pizza - fresh sauce and dough made daily, always super friendly and appreciative.  $5 for a large pizza with whatever topping you want - much better than Little Caesar's/1

Had a blast here the other night when we decided to try it out with a friend visiting from out of state.  The food was amazing and well worth the wait (reservations recommended).  I'm going to have to start walking there just to work it all off.

Denizens of the Treasure Valley, we have no shortage of good spots for sushi.  I have sampled most of them in my 2+ years here and would recommend pretty much any of them depending on what you are looking for.  Izumi is a very worthwhile addition to the "sushi scene" here in the Boise area.  Is it the BEST sushi in town?  No, but they do a few things exceedingly well, better than any other sushi restaurant that I have been to.  That said, please note that this review is for sushi ONLY.  I have not done their hibachi so I cannot speak to that aspect of their offerings at all.  So... what does Izumi bring to the table?

More than anything else, Izumi brings a sense of atmosphere and presentation.  The interior looks very nice.  I wouldn't go so far as to call it "fancy," but it looks much nicer than pretty much any other sushi bar I've been to around here.  I almost felt a little under dressed just walking in there with my t-shirt and shorts on.  Along with this, the presentation of the sushi was fantastic.  The way things were arranged, decorated, etc. were a cut above the average presentation.  Going back to the old saying about eating first with your eyes, Izumi makes sure that your appetite is well satisfied before you put the first morsel in your mouth.  Very well done.

But all the fancy decor and presentation don't mean much if the food isn't any good.  Thankfully Izumi hits the mark here as well.  My wife and I ordered several appetizers and sushi rolls and were satisfied with all our choices.  The standout for my wife was the crab rangoon... which can seem like a very plain dish, if you think of it in terms of what you find on a typical Asian buffet line.  But Izumi's rangoons were excellent, a good balance of flavors and quality ingredients, not something just tossed out of a freezer bag.  The standout for me was also one of the apps, the spicy tartare tower.  This was a mix of three types of spicy fish with avocado and almonds, topped with crab meat.  Absolutely to die for... spicy, and creamy, and delicious.

There are a couple things about the sushi worth mentioning though, and they could be considered both positive and negative.  The first is that the rolls themselves are relatively small.  Each roll we ordered was between six and eight pieces, and the pieces themselves were rather small.  Now this is good because sushi is intended to be bite size, but with some of the pricier rolls (they go up as high as $15 each) you might feel a bit cheated.  Just something to be mindful of if you are someone who is always thinking in terms of "value."  Secondly the rolls are NOT packed with rice.  Some places really have a thick layer of rice on their sushi.  Izumi does not.  The rice is fairly thin, and I would say well proportioned.  To me this is almost purely positive, but I do note it as some people's tastes may vary.  

Bottom line folks, Izumi is a great addition to the Treasure Valley sushi scene.  I think it's above average atmosphere and presentation will make it a better "date night" location than other sushi bars in town if you are looking for something just a wee bit fancier.

This place is so good! One of my favorite bagel/ bagel sandwich places! Their boba drinks are good too! Also kudos to the guy always working behind the counter... he works his butt off! I always give him a tip!

The irony of this post is, I don't even like Basque food, but I love this restaurant, they made a believer out of me!  Atmosphere, food, and service this restaurant has it all.  Can be pricey, but a great place to take a date or friends/ family from out of town.  Very small restaurant, make sure to call ahead.

My husband and I have been to Spice multiple times already, and each time it was delicious! We were greeted promptly, seated promptly, and they made our dinners out with a 1-year old highly enjoyable.  We have tried chicken, lamb, and vegetarian dishes, as well as different naans.  The Boise hot spice level was perfect for me, while my husband was able to order the New York hot, which I couldn't handle but he loved.  Our servers were quite attentive to making sure our drinks were full and if we needed anything else.  For dessert, we have only tried the Gulab Jamun, which was different in a good way - I thought it tasted like a cotton-candy flavored donut hole, and my husband thought it more like a sweetened pancake - either way, it quickly disappeared! On a non-food related note, when our 1-year old was showing signs of being difficult (quite unusual for her) and we were giving each other the "do we leave or stay?" look, our server was empathetic and let us know that we were welcome - that is huge to me because we enjoy going out as a family. I am already thinking about what I am going to try on my next visit!

Was not impressed for what you get for the money. Way over priced curry dishes. I went to pick up dinner for my family and discovered that the plastic containers for the curry we ordered were half full. Very disappointing portions for the money. Not worth it at all. I even emailed management about this issue and attached the photo. The response I received stated that our curry dishes are not meant to fill the container. At the prices they charge they should. Poor quantities, poor customer service, and high cost. I will not be giving this place my business again. I would support them if they lowered the price of their entrees by $3.00 on average. It would justify the portions you receive. However you can't help but feel you are getting ripped off. I advise others to dine somewhere with more competitive prices.

I have always wanted to try authentic Basque food but in all of my travels I have never ran across an authentic restaurant.  That changed today in what I thought would be an unlikely place, Idaho. 

I showed up at Epi's Basque Restaurant in Meridian, Idaho without a reservation and while it is advertised as casual dining I was definitely underdressed in my hiking pants and black t-shirt. The strikingly beautiful silver haired hostess politely pointed out that all of the small tables were reserved and that the guests would be arriving soon. Naturally assuming that I would not be getting a table I started to thank her and turned to leave. Oh well, I thought, the winds of the universe don't always blow in your favor.....But wait!

Instead of turning me away she graciously offered me the head seat at a long table with place settings for ten. I jumped at the opportunity to have a huge table all to myself and was promptly seated. She pointed to the photo on the menu and proudly told me that the handsome couple were her grandparents. Turns out the hostess was the owner! 

 I ordered a glass of Eguren Rioja and lamb chops. The waiter offered me a choice of two soups, a traditional basque red bean, or a shrimp & rice soup which was one of the owner's recipes. I chose the shrimp and rice but much to my surprise the waiter also brought out a small bowl of the red bean soup to try as well. They were both excellent!

The three lamb chops arrived along with seasoned potatoes and a side bowl of peas. The food was nicely displayed along with an orange garnish. Now I normally try to use proper table manners when dining but after briefly scanning to see that no one was looking I grabbed those baby t-bones barehanded and savagely devoured that lamb like a ravenous wolf. Yes, it was that incredibly delicious! 

As I was eating a couple with two young children came in. One of the little girls ran over to the owner and hugged her. She told her it was her 9th birthday and this is where she wanted to come for dinner. That kid apparently has good taste. I overheard from one of the waitresses that the couple had been coming here since before their kids were born back when they were still dating. I could see why. I had never been here before but yet I was treated like royalty. The service was every bit as exceptional as the food.  

As I got up to leave the owner came over, clasped my hand, and sincerely thanked me for coming. I could tell from the look on her face that she was truly interested in my having had a great dining experience. Genuine sincerity is a rare commodity to find in the day and age in which we live in yet I found it......in the little house on the corner......in Meridian, Idaho.
Excellent service! The guys here are so nice and extremely helpful. The wait was a bit long, but they had a TV for my kid to watch.

This was my third time at Ricks' Press Room,  I highly recommend this place. Incredible service, Amazing Food,  and all fresh. The potato crusted salmon was delightful tonight,  the ribeye is spectacular!  I also recommend the tasting menu, different all the time. I'm a Jew and Rick has no problems working with my dietary restrictions. I am just in love with this place!
           K.C Jeanotte
My new favorite Thai food place! The lettuce wraps were awesome, the cashew chicken tasty. Only concern is they serve Pepsi products, not coke. Pepsi!!! Yuck.

This location seems to be the worst of the locations for service and quality. Today a trip 2 of the 4 pieces AND the replacement we got were dry.  Almost as if they had been overlooked and sat in the warmer longer than they should. The manager seemed put out when I asked for a replacement on the first one so I didn't even ask for the other to be replaced, just threw it away. 
I usually go to the Nampa or Broadway locations and avoid this one and the one on Fairview in Boise. 
Too bad because they are great locations.

Dr. Mills and his staff offer  an abundance of knowledge as well as compassion and tremendous customer service. Our pets were treated here for several years prior to our moving across the country. I so wish I could have them in my new location! That being said, I do somewhat have Dr. Mills' expertise as he will respond to e-mailed questions and let me know what to ask my current vet when I am having an issue.  Incredible people work here!

I ordered the udon noodle soup, but the flavor was just sub par and the add ins were not good. And then after a 2 tastes of the soup, I found a hair in it. This completely grossed me out.

I also had the charashi plate and the sushi tasted of very poor quality.

I was very disappointed in the quality since it was so highly rated. I personally love sushi and wouldn't recommend this place.
Fun, but Never saw an employee at all in jump time junior.  No kids under 48 inches were supposed to be jumping there, but many were, making it unsafe for my two year old.

I agree..  Good food for the price.  Cheese curds were a big hit with the kids, Burgers were OK,  and custard good as well.    

I will say the place is very clean and new!  ( really nice restrooms ) and well staffed.  Customer service was Great!  

I will go back at some point and see if I missed something that I didn't get the first time.. But won't go out of my way..
Pizza was terrible. I expected it to be much better but very disappointing! I truly believe if they want to stay in business they must make some changes.

Usually not a sprint customer. But eating near by and wanted a phone case for my phone. We were greater by " TARIQ" and let me tell you, sprint has a awesome employee. Wish I could steal this guy for my company. Great helpful service!

So good, the bagels are just amazing. Chewy and soft! The guy who runs the shop is incredible and so nice. We've gotten several sandwich bagels and they are all good but the California Dream is one of the best things I've ever eaten! Love it and cant wait to try more.

We were traveling through Idaho and HAD TO eat somewhere with amazing SPUDS. Reviews all suggested Goodwood for some of the best potato skins and potato salad. THEY DID NOT DISAPPOINT! The environment was clean. The staff was friendly and inviting. The FOOD! Was DELICIOUS!

The concept of this place was really outstanding. The model gives you accessibility to wines that are obscure and high quality, that otherwise may be out of our reach. That being said, food ok, service underwhelming.
Last week I went there with my family, the food and service was good.This week I took the same order but to go,the food was horrible and they put the food inside a milk box.Also the bread was burnt.
The hot and sour soup was not very hot nut extremely salty,  just Yuk. The rest of the order was also very salty

My friend ordered the calamari hibachi and I ordered 2 rolls of sushi; we both shared it. At first I believed they would charge me an extra $20 for sharing her hibachi, (since I got my own separate plate and got the same amount of rice and calamari) but they only charged me for the sushi which was great! I think it is okay to share one order of hibachi between two people, because even after we split it, we had leftovers. I'm a 15 year-Old who eats a lot, and I can say the serving size was quite large. I'll definitely be coming back with my family! (Oh, and our chef was super funny he made my friend and I's homecoming night super amusing)

First time there.  Ticket machines went down.  They had to reset ticket sale machines 2x.  Only one concession register open over thanksgiving break.  Guy running concession register seemed like it was his 1st day and had no training.   Lots of people behind counter doing nothing.  Line was over 30 people deep.   Ticket taker could not get reader to work and it took 10 minutes to through the ticket check line.  Took 35 min from ticket line to
Concession to seat.  Saw Thor.  Movie stopped playing 5 min in.  They reset it 3 times and it stopped at the same place.  No one came in to explain what was going on.  When I found a manager he did not know what was going on. They eventually cancelled the movie.   Had to stand in regular ticket lines to get reimbursement.   They need lots of help running a professional theater.   We eventually went to Majestic.  From ticket purchase to concession to seat took under 10 min.  That's how you run a theater.

This place used to be good, service was good and sandwiches were well made. Then they had some new people take over and now the service sucks. There are never any bagels in the morning, they're late most of the time and the sandwiches suck now. I got a sandwich the other day that had 1 single piece of meat on it.  I will not go there again because I'm tired of being disappointed.

You get a lot of feedback when you tell people you review pizza as a hobby. A lot of it comes off as "Isn't all pizza just...pizza? How can you really go wrong?" or something along that line. And it's true, you generally have to start to try to really mess up pizza, but on the same turn, you really have to do something to stand out among the rest. This week: does Santora's stand out? Or does it fade away into pizza oblivion?

Well, I will mention that first of all, this isn't just pizza. There's wings and subs, too. Perhaps they're not confident in any one aspect, so they suggest all three? Perhaps they're very confident in all three aspects, and recommend you go big? Hard to say. The pizza is what makes their logo, though, so let's look to that.

We pulled in to a strip mall built not far from the Majestic theater complex. Packed neatly between a Chinese restaurant, a bar-and-grill, and an army recruiting center is where you find Santora's. When we stepped in, we were affronted with the coziness (smallness) of the place. Space enough for you to bring your date after the romance movie. Not quite the place to bring your squad after the action movie.

The decorations were basic and the walls were white. You can see everything about their kitchen from the dining area. I'm not sure if that's comforting or not if you're germaphobic. Message us if you know the answer to that one.

We scroll down the menu and pick out a white, oil-based pie featuring garlic and tomatoes (literally titled: garlic pizza), and go with pepperoni on the other half. PizzaKen nabs a small bucket of wings.

It's not too long of a wait before we get our pie (the wings came out first, btw). We dig in.

-The Pepperoni-
Nice. Tastes rich, rewarding. Peps do not crunch, but the flavor lingers. Good cheese, solid crust. It does things right. There's not much else to say.

-The Garlic-
A lot of garlic. I believe I saw part of the making of this pizza, and it looked like they poured a decent amount of that kind of minced garlic you can buy in a massive jar from Costco. There was also tomato on here, somewhere, but really, what you taste is garlic. Neither Ken nor I were particularly huge fans of these slices, but, in fairness, this was called the Garlic Pizza. We should have heeded the namesake.

-The Verdict-
Santora's is quaint. It's got this nice, quiet, compact, friendly atmosphere. Its menu is straightforward, simple, and so is the pizza. You can't complain! The price on the pizza came out around $20-25 (again, this was for two pizza types combined into one, most prices list at about $13-15 for standard small pies). I haven't cultivated a strong desire to return, but, it's one of the first places I might suggest if I wanted to eat after catching a movie at The Majestic. Go here if you like fair pizza at a fair price. Also go here if you really like garlic: they have just the pizza for you.

P.S. The wings are aight.

3 slices out of 5

This is my new favorite theater in the Treasure Valley. I plan to go to this theater exclusively from now on.

The selling points: a VIP section with larger seats, waiters, a full bar,  separate bathroom, and great view of the screen. (They do need to work on the quality of their mixed drinks though--my husband's Manhattan was terrible.)

Very clean, and modern look.

Comfy places to sit.

A bar/restaurant where you can meet friends before or after the movie.

We are from out of town and wanted good pizza. So we came to the pie hole. It has original specialty pizzas, that are unique and delicious. We ordered two  pizzas both half and half. Potato bacon, pretty pretty princess, Canadian bacon and pineapple, and meat lovers. Yum! So good!

ORDER HERE!!  Was staying in town over night at a hotel.  Ordered a pizza and Stromboli.  Was great!!!  Hot, fresh,fast!!  The crust wasn't that crappy doughy mess like you get almost all the time, it was Perfect-firm yet soft, with a great taste.  I wish they were in Seattle near my home!!

The best bagels! I was a huge fan of their Nampa shop, but it wasn't very convenient for me to get to when I changed jobs. Customer service at both locations is A+! Always friendly and always fast. 
The shop is very clean with plenty of seating. In all of my trips to Sarah's there has never been a line. Except this last Sunday. Around 9:30am, and luckily after I got my order, the line filled in very quickly. I felt bad for the one employee working. It still seemed he got orders out quickly.
On to the food - my go to is simply a bagel with cream cheese. However, they have a delicious jalapeno and cheese bagel that is now my new favorite. This one is a little more expensive than most of the other bagels, but well worth it. Toasted with plain cream cheese and I'm a happy girl. The jalapenos are actual slices not just diced up. And they are melted in with the cheddar. Making not only a little spicy, but nice to look at too.
I just recently tried the New Yorker - their version of smoked salmon on a bagel. You pick your bagel, they toast it and then add cream cheese, sliced tomato, sliced red onions, sprouts, and smoked salmon. It's good. I've gotten it twice, one was better than the other mostly because of the salmon to tomato and onion ratio. The salmon does not have a strong smoked flavor and my last one had a rather small amount of salmon. As another reviewer said, capers on this would really be great!
I've heard their bagel sandwiches for lunch are really good, but I've not tried them yet. They do sell day-old bagels and one of my favorite snacks is their garlic bagel chips they sell at the counter. I like to keep a bag at work to add to lunchtime soups or as crunchy bits to salads!

I think I would give this place 2.5 stars if I could. Here for a 2 week business trip, went here with a couple of co-workers. We had Wings and Burgers. I wasn't a fan of either. 

PROS:

- Good selection of beers. 

-  Service was pretty good for being short staffed.

CONS:

- Wings were kinda dried out. I just didn't like the taste.

- I was here twice, both times the place was short staffed.

I wouldn't come back here on my own, but if a friend wanted to go here I would tag along. It wasn't horrible, it's kinda like a hole in the wall bar inside of a chain restaurant.

wow ! not good not even fair .terrible customer service and not once did they say "my pleaure" order was sent out twice wrong. manager was short . we receive excellant at other stores in idaho , very disappointing!

I can't believe I haven't already posted a review for Epi's.  It's my absolute favorite place in the Treasure Valley.  If there were more than 5 stars available, Epi's would receive them.

First of all - CALL for a reservation - Epi's is ALWAYS busy - which is a great thing and should tell you right there how good the food is.  Getting a table isn't always easy.

I love the steak with lots and lots of garlic, the salad is always cold and well-dressed, the fresh bread is light and flakey - just perfect.  The croquetas melt in my mouth - I could live on them alone, I think if they were my last meal I would die happy - I am so not kidding, they are that good!  The daily soup is red bean, and even my kids love it - every time we drive by they tell me how much they want Epi's red bean soup right now!  But my all-time favorite is their home-made, fresh, amazing and to die for Cream of Mushroom soup.  It's only available on certain nights, so call ahead if you love mushrooms.  You won't be disappointed.

The customer service may be the best I've ever received anywhere in my life.  Chris always remembers us, asking about the kids and our farm.  Before we leave she gives us a hug and thanks us.  Seriously, not living close to my mom or my grandma - sometimes I go in just because I need a hug.  

Oh - and don't forget the apple bread pudding for dessert.  With rich, fresh caramel sauce and whipped cream - it just tops off the dinner perfectly.

Jamie is amazing!!! This was my first spray tan experience ever, I was a little hesitant because I've never really been into spray tans, I had found out about Bronze Yourself from a friend, I gave it a try and my tan turned out amazing! I got so many compliments! I've even referred her for other women for her tanning services and I just love how she comes to you! She's sweet and makes the process comfortable and quick. My go to delivery tanning company (:

Earlier today as I was taking my daughter to a pediatrician appointment, I noticed Thai Basil. I am originally from Portland, Oregon, a city with amazing Thai food. I had yet to find anything in the Boise area that even compares. I had been craving Thai food, so when I saw the restaurant I thought, "why not? I'll try it." I am so glad I did! I had my toddler with me, so I opted for take out. When I called, the woman who took my order was very friendly. I had never been there, and she took the time to explain the dishes. I chose the tofu pad Thai, which I know isn't super original, but it sounded good and I didn't have time to look at a detailed menu. They had the food ready promptly in 15 minutes, and it was piping hot when I arrived. A younger gentleman greeted me at the door and walked me to the back of the counter where my order was waiting. There were two other employees back there who were friendly and exchanged small talk with me while I paid my bill. The price was very fair, under $8 for a generous portion. After I paid my bill, the young man walked me to the door and held it open for me. 
I was very pleasantly surprised by the food. Not at all greasy, packed with flavor, a generous amount of tofu, crushed peanuts on the side and a lime wedge. It could have been a little spicier. I ordered spicey, but I might try the Thai spicey next time! 
Very friendly people, delicious food! I cannot wait to come back.
Excellent amount of spice to flavor. Nice to find a great Indian place in the Boise area.

Our first time here to this new restaurant and very impressed! The food is what you would expect from a good Japanese Steakhouse, but the service and entertainment really stood out. The chefs are VERY well trained and really did a good job interacting with all the guests at the table. This is worth coming back for!!

Love the food but terrible service all 3 times I've been there. The bathroom has never been cleaned and is very grimy. Hope the kitchen gets cleaned. I had to get up and ask the server for an iced tea because she is always busy chatting with the other hostess. What happened to being polite to the people paying your paycheck ?

Pretty good sushi restaurant. We came here for a Saturday lunch.

Service: Great
Food: Good; the rolls are amazing.
Ambiance: Fabulous 

Typically I go to sushi places for the nigiri but was overwhelmingly surprised by the uniqueness of the sushi rolls.

I've been here many times and it's my go-to restaurant when I'm in the Treasure Valley.  I've tried most things on the menu and love them all.  Most memorable was a duck confit they had as a special.  Yummy.  Oh, and also a corn chowder (if I remember correctly) that I had on my first visit.  That said, I did have two meals that I really didn't think lived up to Rick's standards - a lobster special and a blackened marlin.  If it wasn't for those two meals, five stars all around.  Love the cozy environment and the tucked away location.

3 of the 4 times I have been here I have been forgotten about and waited it my car for at least 45 minutes to get my food. Each time the manager talks me into coming back. This last time was the last and I waited 54 minutes for 2 milk shakes and was forgotten about 3 times in 1
Visit and the excuse was I'm sorry we have never been this busy. I will not be going to this particular location. I have never had an issue with the Twin Falls location.

This is a great value for pizza.  Every time I am down in the valley with a larger group I dont hesitate to bring them here.  The service is quick and I have always had a positive interaction with the staff.  I feel the calzones are underrated and are worth a try.  The cinamon bites are a fantastic deal as well.

Open late, friendly people, boise staple! You can't go wrong with pie hole, I ve been going here since I was in high school and it's still the same amazing pizza today. Nice big pieces and fun specials of the day.

We have always enjoyed coming to the VIP. However, they've changed their menu and stoped making some of our favorite dishes, especially the Nachos! Also there is only one size of popcorn. I'm disappointed in the changes.

Had take out. They were quick (15 min). I had the summer roll combo. So good. A party in my mouth. I will be ordering the pork summer rolls from now on because it is that good. Cashew chicken also flavorful and enjoyable. Will go back.

We love this place! We eat here in the restaurant when we can- they have a small but decent sized main room. There is a huge fish tank the kids love, and the lighting and atmosphere are casual but on the upper end. Service is always friendly. Plan on a more leisurely pace for your meal, which does make it more challenging with the kids.

Our more usual way to enjoy their food is by pick up- this is our go to for a small "date night" at home after the kids go down! 

We love the Pad Kro Pao, and the red chicken curry is awesome. We never miss the Tom Yum soup (get the pot!) and the salad is super simple but we love the ginger dressing and ask for extra! We have had a number of the other dishes over time and enjoy most of them (we actually got fried rice for the first time last visit and enjoyed it) but we did it at all enjoy their "house duck". It was super stringy, full of inedible fat and a waste of time and money for us. We love duck, but even the sauce was overly sweet and we tossed most of the dish sadly. Other than that we have enjoyed everything. 

We order medium and mild flavors in one meal to
Mix it up (we ordered all medium one time- more power to you if you are good but for us it is... a bit much lol!).  Generally the soup we order mild and everything else we split between mild and medium, and they graciously give us extra chili oil to spice up things where we want! That is the way to do it!

They are fast, amazingly friendly and offer great, consistent food. I love eating there but our hectic lives mean we take our date nights where we can so take out is more normal! 

Side note- both our (young) kids love the Tom Yum soup, and the salad. They also love the curry and Pad Kra Poa as well as the noodle Dishes we've gotten. One loves medium heat and kills it, and the other prefers the more mild, but both love eating here and get excited to do so. 

It's pricey for a "normal" night out for a family of four but they get super excited to go for a special night!


Update: We have one of our sons who is now required to be dairy/soy/gluten free and also can't have a few others things. It's a major immune system issue so we have to be careful. We went here tonight, and I had packed food for him because I knew it would be tough to find food for him. They were awesome! Knowledgeable, plenty of options, could adjust almost anything, brought food out for the youngest right away, were patient and kind and just awesome food as always! I was so impressed by their willingness to accommodate our poor kiddo who doesn't often get a lot of choices!

Not impressed! We have been in to this store twice, and both times we made the mistake of going on days that they were doing giveaways. We were never greeted and had to seek out a salesperson to help us. So irritating when you are there to actually spend money and the only people that are getting customer service are the free loaders there to collect their $100 gift cards and buy the cheapest thing in the store with it. Each time we've been there the checkout process is ridiculous and extremely unorganized. They charge an arm and a leg for delivery, when we are used to paying a flat fee of $57 for the whole year at RC Willey. This morning I received a voicemail from one of the salesman accusing us of stealing the mattress cover that we purchased yesterday!! I was so angry that I called and spoke to the store manager. Apparently the guy who called us had mixed up some paperwork but the entire situation was very unprofessional. The store manager basically just said "sorry," but didn't offer anything to us to smooth it over. I expected something nice since we are actual paying customers, but apparently they only give stuff away to their non paying "customers." We will NOT be returning in the future. I'm curious to see how long these guys stay in business THIS time around...

Have been to Spice several times since they have opened.  I have been optimistically hopeful recognizing they have some serious competition in the valley.  My first several visits were good enough to bring me back.

Today wr stopped in for the lunch buffet and it was hands down stellar.  The Aloo Gobi, Chicken Makhani, and Tandoori Chicken were amaze balls.  I can honestly say they are better than their competition comparing these dishes.

The four stars?  They were out of Naan and it took them until my second pass through to get it out.  This is a travesty as Naan is to Indian food as jelly is to peanut butter.

Can't wait to come back,  keep up the great work

Worst customer service of any McDonalds I have ever been to.  Large drinks were less than 2/3's full, when I was handed the drinks I opened one and asked the employee if they would fill the cup.  I received a long blank stare, followed by the comment "are you serious".  Well, yes...yes I am serious.  Filled with large pieces of ice and less than 2/3's full - must have been around 6 oz of product in the cup if that.

Nuggets were cold, I asked for honey for them and received 1 packet of ketchup, and no napkins in the bag.   I'll stop across the street at their competitor from now on....

Despite this place being kind of run down and grubby, my four year old had a great time here and came home tired. 

Upon walking in, you're facing a net-encased trampoline area with a ton of older kids playing dodge ball. There are multiple tablets where you fill out your waiver with all the information they don't need like address and email (what happened to just signing your name?). Then you get in line to pay. 

The price wasn't bad - $7.50 for unlimited time. There is a concession area that sells a bunch of not-so-great snacks. Despite the signs declaring no outside food or drink, plenty of people were walking around with coffee and food that was clearly not bought at the snack bar. 

My kiddo is just under 48" so she could have played on either side; the facility has an entire area dedicated to children 48" and under. However, the employees didn't do a very good job of monitoring that - there were a lot of kids much taller there. 

That said, this place is pretty decent for the price. The employees are nice although not great at enforcing rules. As long as you're an assertive personality and don't mind watching your kid pretty closely, you're fine. We'll be coming back!

Pizza was very good only reason I'm giving this a 3 star is because customer service was horrible first I stood there for about 10 minutes before the dingy young blond stopped texting of her phone She then took my order then 40 minutes later i went and asked about my order they said it was accidental moved to the back.I asked to speak with the Manager and asked for a discount our a Pizza on the house which  a good Manager would have done, he said he didn't have the power to give me a free Pizza he said he could give me 2 pieces that is not much of a manager and customer service out the window.

Zupas has a good variety of soups, salads and sandwiches that are supposed to be a healthier alternative to your typical fast food fare.  

The salads and sandwiches are good.  They have fresh ingredients and the dessert that comes with combos are a nice touch. 

The soups are also good but usually too salty for my taste (at least at the Village location).  

The servings are decent and will fill you up.  The service is typically friendly.  

Bottom line: We will return for the salads & sandwiches but because of the saltiness of the soups it wouldn't be our first choice for soups.

Everyone at the spa is so warm and friendly.  I was given a tour and it's such an amazing place!!

My left should/neck was in agony after a long flight from New York and a previous poor night's sleep.  I walked in and had the best of luck to have Rose as my massage therapist.  She was so intuitive in applying the exact pressure I needed.  Afterwards my pain had subsided and I felt like I was floating on a cloud.  She is also a hair stylist, so she was able to trim my bangs so I looked fabulous and felt relaxed as I embarked on my evening.  The next day I had ZERO pain and feIt spectacular to get through my busy day. I will definitely be seeing her again!

Thanks again for making my experience so wonderful and having such a terrific team!

Came back to the village due to gift card graciously given by the manager to try Bodo Vino again.  It was great.  Love the concept, pour money in a card and taste your way to your favorite!  Foods was pretty good.  Be ready for ala cart. We love this concept!! Thanks for the GC ! We'll be back

Had the lunch special which was a Italian sausage turkey burger with the salad and balsamic dressing. It was literally the best burger I have ever had( any type of meat!) this place had a good mix of locals, regulars and out of towners. Service was good and the decor was pretty original. 

A must if you are in meridian!

I was so Happy to enter the dental office... I was greeted with smiles and Great People.  I waited less then 5 minutes before being taken to the back.  We started by getting to know me and then proceeded to get X-rays, and soon was greeted by the dentist.  I was given a full exam and cancer screening, we went over my X-rays and treatment.  The Dr. Was very friendly and had great bed side manner.  I was then greeted by the hygienist where we talked and got started on my cleaning...she was gentle but very detailed.  I walked out with a a bigger smile then walking in.  If you are looking for a dentist and a fun, friendly dental family check them out.

So here's the deal, I really quite like Qdoba as far as food goes, but the service is not so hot. It seems every time I go I walk away irritated that the hourly worker behind the counter just scrimped on my food like she was giving they were giving me food out of there personal paycheck.  As you walk through the line picking your items they seem pretty tight handed giving you a good portion. The last time I went there,  the manager took a spoonful of steak for my nachos dropped it it on top and half of it fell off the side, I asked the girl if she would add some more meat as it looked pretty light and I saw a charge for 2.99 extra on my receipt. Maybe its just this location I am not sure. I would have given them 5 stars had they not been super cheap on stuff over the past year and a half or so.  I wouldn't even mentions this irritation if it had been happening every time over the last while. I think I will make the drive to the Eagle rd. location next time to see if its any better. Probably same owner though.

Far better experience than Edwards. They have the most up to date setup including Dolby atmos and D-box. They have reserved seating and even an in theater bar & grill for the balcony seating. The Fandango app makes reserving the seat you want especially easy and the theater is conveniently located directly next to lots of good food. They have by far the nicest bathrooms I've ever seen in a movie theater too. Very clean and modern with music that is distinctly different than the outside. Little things that just make it better. This is also the first movie theater in boise I've noticed an entire coffee bar in. Pricing is average for a theater however beer and food for the balcony seats are typical of most of the surrounding restaurants. I rarely go anywhere else now.
$8 for a tiny taco salad with hardly anything in it. I felt ripped off.

Went for lunch today with my son asked for spring rolls she said no vegetable rolls are better and spring rolls weren't ready until later ? Ordered soup she forgot it my son got sweet n sour pork it was good I got house mai fun it was awful no taste and dry worst part it took 45 minutes to get food and we were the only people in there! Also their son was picking his nose while roaming around, we will never go back huge disappointment!

This Popeyes is the worst location I've been to. It's new so I gave them the benefit of the doubt the first few times I had been there. They charge for water, they don't offer the specials that are advertised and the front staff doesn't have the proper training. The food is usually fine but it takes forever to get your order in comparison to other franchises.

These are my go to guys for no-nonsense quality Japanese and Chinese food.  I come here once or twice a week.  I used to schlep all the way to the Overland and Vista location but they opened a much nicer place west of Overland and Eagle.

Service was spotty once or twice last winter but has improved to be near flawless.  Maybe they just know me.

I never get delivery so I cannot speak about that.

I like the Japanese stuff the best. They have great lunch specials.  Bento boxes are always a favorite and they have options for healthy eating and for watching carbs.

Comforting and unassuming.  I came in last Sunday night.  PeeWee's Big Adventure was playing over the sushi bar.  That's how I like my maki.

Horrible experience! Hired Cacicia's to cater and was charged twice the amount for food that was actually served! Guests also complained about the food. (Sticky over cooked pasta, dry meatballs, small portions, and skimpy on the toppings) To add insult to injury, they refused to even discuss the over charging situation with me! Stating I agreed to pay the amount, which is correct, but I didn't realize until later that I was given the wrong plate count...hmmm..... At first I thought it was an honest mistake and would be correct, but now it is my opinion it was an intentional act on the owners part to double their money from the very start. When refusing refunding the overcharged amount, they said they prided themselves on the quality of food and integrity. I found neither to be the case.***UPDATE***
I disputed charges with VISA and was refunded a significant amount.
Definitely the best Indian food in the valley and we've tried them all!!!  Excellent lunch buffet with great selection.   I highly recommend them.

The rooms are clean and nice, bed is comfy with lots of pillows, had a pull out sleeper in the king room which I wasn't expecting. Lobby is great. Looks like a fun place to have a drink and relax. Didn't have time to use the weight room or the pool and got up late so did not have time to go to the bistro for breakfast.  Will definitely come back to take advantage of these things.  Could hear traffic from the room which was the only drawback.

My boyfriend and I went for couples massages this morning. An hour and a half Swedish massage, the room was absolutely beautiful and so comfortable. All of the staff were so friendly, we even got a tour of the whole salon upon arriving. There are private rooms to dress down in, and warmed robes provided. I had the pleasure of working with massage therapist Amelia, and she was absolutely wonderful. I am pregnant, and she constantly checked to make sure I was still comfortable. She listened to my body better than any therapist I've ever worked with before, such an amazing therapist and I highly recommend both the salon and Amelia to any wanting a deeply relaxing experience.
We love Izumi! The three rolls for $12 are delicious, tons of fish, great service, great atmosphere. We always recommend this restaurant to all our friends with joy!

I dunno why this place has such bad reviews. It has some amazing food and flavors. The wait time can be bad, but they take call in orders and give you an estimate on how long your food will take. They are SUPER cheap, which is good because I can afford it on my student budget. I love them so much. Haven't found tripas tacos anywhere else in Boise area that's as good. And their al pastor torta is

Truly the best Indian food we have in the entire Boise area.  It is a family place and it is truly charming.  The food is outstanding. you have been warned about the Naan.  Yup you will get two orders for sure.  They are willing to deliver if they are not too busy and the order $ is appropriate.  As a vegetarian I can never pick one entree so I always order two and skip the rice but NOT the Naan.  Husband loves their lamb dishes and wish they were closer to where we live. Try it. don't let the strip center deter you.

Epi's is simply the best. Whether we're talking fine food or stellar service, the place is just magical. From the best calamari anywhere, to scrumptious cod, to succulent sea bass, to lovely lamb chops, to tender scallops, to any of their dungeness crab entrees, the great folks at Epi's work long and hard behind the scenes to deliver an unforgettable dining experience each time I've been there. Dessert? Flan and Gateau Basque are sweets you'll come back for. And if you play your cards right, you just may meet the love of your life at Epi's :)  Call ahead for a reservation; the secret is out!

Beautiful theater.  Obviously a ton of money to make it look that way.  Was thrilled about being able to order my tickets from Fandango early on and get awesome seats.  Didn't worry about being late.  

I couldn't figure out why the lines were so short yet moved so slowly.  Now I know it was because every customer was standing there picking out their seats.Butter on the popcorn had a very good taste and we snarfed it right down.

Screen was more square than rectangular.  (Theater 8)  But once the movie started I didn't really notice as the picture resolution was awesome.  Wish I had ordered seats in the very back row, as I felt like I was too close to the screen because there weren't very many seats in the theater.  I would have preferred a larger audience.

I didn't fit in the seat.  It was pretty, it looked like leather, there was lots of feet space, but I didn't fit.  I could barely bring the armrests down and felt like I was trapped.  The location on the armrest where the drink goes was way back, so it was a pain to have to keep turning sideways to take a sip.

The multiple thundering Dolby Atmos speakers were SO loud that I had to yell to talk to the person in the seat next to mine during the movie.  My son with sensitive ears would probably have to wear ear plugs.  It could have been the acoustics of the theater that made it seem louder than it should have been.  Plus one of the speakers on the right was making a weird sound that was very annoying.

We walked out of our theater and the acoustics again made the sound of everyone in the lobby talking sound louder than they were.  We couldn't wait to get out the front doors.

The good:  Good location, nice big room, comfortable bed, nice service. Like the free breakfast  buffet. Free wifi and parking.

The bad: not much, the pool is small, maybe good for kids.

I'll start by saying that I've been living in Texas for 20 plus years and not impressed with many BBQ places. Usually sit down bbq places do good sides and average BBQ or they do 1 or 2 items good and average every else. Well thus is what I noticed here. The sausage was really good, the chicken, I've had much better and the burnt ends, well just ok. Cornbread muffins very good. I'll go back and try the pulled pork and brisket and update my thoughts on this place. At the monument it's like what spring creek bbq is in Texas, nothing to write home about

Do not buy furniture here!!! It's going to be more than two months before my furniture is delivered to my house. I've been calling weekly and they aren't any help. Lots of lies to get you to go away. They really just take your money and run.

If you go anywhere for your dental needs, by all means please go here. Yes, indeed do your research, and if there's a place closer to you I understand; however, as there is nothing which can't be reached within twenty minutes in this town (and surrounding areas), you should most assuredly make this place at the top of your list.

If you're a fan of staff who are informed, courteous and are willing to listen to your dental needs and issues, then this is the place you want to attend. If you want doctors and hygienists who take the time to make you feel comfortable and demonstrate and expert level of their knowledge and of their equipment in a confident manner; then you have to make an appointment here, as you will want to build a relationship with this facility not only for yourself but also for your family.

In only one other place - which was out of state - have I received this high level of attention and care, and for me my visit on 25-July 2017 solidified my decision on who I want to care for my wife and my dental needs for as long as we live in the Boise area.
Good pizza fair price. I like to frequent locally owned places and this is one of them.

Was fairly pleased with the food, as my shrimp entree was well cooked. Our server however left us not feeling super great about this place. She was the bartender for the night, and we got to hear how busy she was at the bar quite often, while others seated in our section actually had what appeared to be actual servers wearing appropriate attire (not a mid rif top or a super short miniskirt). When she first appeared, I was almost worried that we had walked into the wrong type of establishment, but we did see other servers wearing professional uniforms. If the service had been better, I would definitely have given a higher rating.

What a surprise! This place is the real deal - great Sushi which is what we did - had a total Sushi binge and very reasonable.  The quality was awesome - best I have had in Idaho.  I'm bringing my brothers over from Seattle this fall - we go to Sushi restaurants together and eat till the proprietor is scared we can't pay the bill! Waiter was great and the Hostess that came by to see how we were doing was awesome - shared their philosophy and vision with us - Great night!

Sad experience tonite- had reservations, 15 minutes to get water (place was 3/4 full), food time ok, 45 minutes AFTER plates were cleared we gave up on dessert and asked for check. She just never came back, the older waitress. Won't be back. Wait staff shouldn't have to bus tables, set up bar and move furniture. 1 other person busing would have fixed this easily. It was Valentine's Day! :(  Food was good, had dessert at Dairy Queen down the street...

I really love this location.  It is always clean and friendly.  The store is well labeled so I don't look so dumb but when I have one of those moments, there is always a friendly employee directing me in the right direction.  Bathrooms are very clean as well.  I frequent this location and will continue coming back.

Amazing food some of the best.. hibachi chef "show" to be expected nothing sets it apart from others  not even the "gag" jokes they use. Sushi is super just don't expect the flame icons to be 100% accurate 

Weekends - have a reservation & come early door staff is a little off & not capable of honoring the time of a reservation or accurately estimating wait

What a solid chain restaurant! If your goal is to have a good beer menu, tons of tv's tuned to sports and a delicious entree then I suggest Mr. O' Brady's. The beer selection has new to me selections from breweries such as Payette and Salmon River and the most friendly service. The tv's had Kobe's last game, the Warriors going for the record, baseball, LPGA Golf and hockey. The food was outstanding!!!!! Ordered the Roast Beef Garlic Melt. As you may be able to see in my grainy photo it was served with a side of tater tots. In my book that instantly puts your food to a three star regardless of entree. Luckily I thought the entree was delicious. My sandwich was described as roast beef, red onion and provolone on pressed garlic Cuban bread. They sell the sandwich short in their description. The beef was nicely griddled and the onion was thick cut and devilish in flavor. The bread was a garlic symphony and the sandwich came with jus and creamy garlic sauce, both on the side. This was a great meal and I do not care that it came from a chain.

I was looking forward to trying out this theater.  I went with a friend to see a lesser known movie so we were in one of the smaller theaters.  I don't mind the reserved seating and we bought our tickets at the counter together so we could get adjoining seats.  When I bought my ticket, I also bought advanced tickets for the upcoming "Catching Fire" movie for myself and my son.

We went to the concession stands, and since we hadn't been able to get into one of the open restaurants (it was busy on a Friday night), we decided to get small cheese pizzas.  The pizzas were the frozen type you heat up, which didn't surprise me, but they didn't get all the way heated.  The cheese in the center wasn't melted, and although it was fully defrosted, it was cool in the center.

We went to sit down and found they didn't have any little seating area that was comfortable for eating.  They did have some benches with short drink tables.  This would be an easy improvement for them - if they added some "dining" style tables and chairs.

When we'd selected our seats we chose them near the end of a row to be near the aisle, but when we got into the theater, we found out there is only one aisle.  And we chose the wrong end.  We had to scootch past everyone in the aisle who were already seated to enter or leave the theater.  That was a bummer.

The seats are comfortable leather seats, but are about as wide as airline seats. I'm a larger person and had to basically fold my arms through the movie because there was no extra room.  The armrests were a little short, so getting your soda out of the cup holder was awkward.

The sound quality was great, the movie was great, the clarity was great.  No problem with the actual "movie" at all.  

By the time we left I realized that I would much rather go the Majestic, with more comfortable and wider seats, longer armrests, and hot food than come back here.  I stopped at the front desk and got a refund for the Catching Fire movie.  

That being said, it is a lovely theater.  If you are of smaller frame and want a Gelato (which I'm sure is awesome), this is probably a perfect theater for you.  But for anyone, you can have an equal or improved experience elsewhere.
Their bagels are great and their breakfast sandwiches are amazing-the best I've ever had!
Place is always full. Great place for family dinners.  Love their BBQ Ribs. - Yummy!!  And Server are super friendly.

Amazing experience... where do I start? I have been searching for great Basque food for several years and Epi's will forever be a stop on my way through the Boise Idaho area. The food was outstanding, but the people that welcome you i to the establishment, prepare and serve your food is amazing! The atmosphere is friendly with guests intermingling, sharing toasts, laughter and love all while sampling a wide array of family-favorite foods. This is a mus visit location!!! The food is rich, so choose wisely, but anything you order will be your favorite...

I was recently at a reputable furniture store in San Diego, Living Spaces, when I saw the couch exact same couch I had bought at Ashley Furniture in Meridian.  At first I was excited because I got to show my mom what I had bought (she lives in San Diego) but then I was literally shocked and so disappointed.  The price listed was $795!  I had bought the same exact couch at Ashley for $1,106 and that was on sale.  It would have been 1,349 otherwise.  So with my sale price I paid over 300 dollars more for the same couch.  And if you walked in on a non sale day at ashley you would be paying $550 more!  So with a stomach ache I texted my husband, boy were we bummed.  But I thought, hey, maybe they would honor a price guarantee that they claim to have.  And yes, I was outside of the 30 window, but I thought they might have some grace because this is such an extreme price difference.  They might realize why I feel like they literally ripped me off!  I understand slight price discrepancies but this just seemed wrong.  Well I went in and spoke with a manager.  He had nothing to say except that I was out of the "window" they provide.  While I know rules are rules, I have also worked in retail and always tried my best to see where the customer is coming from and do what I can to build back their trust.  Unfortunately today that did not happen.  I would stick with some of the other furniture stores in the valley, lest you go on vacation and find out you paid hundreds of dollars more than people are in a more expensive city at that.  I have yet to speak with the general manager of the store, JP, I am truly hoping that we can come to a better understanding.

Amazing. I do not think I have ever had an experience in any type of medical or dental office quite like this. The receptionists were all extremely kind every time I had contact with them and I even received a personal phone call from the dentist prior to the visit asking if I had any concerns. (Almost unheard of!) I am currently in a rigorous graduate school program that does not allow students to work and therefore do not have access to affordable dental insurance anymore (I am single and over 25 years of age). When I explained this upfront to the office, they took the time to explain my options and what they would cost me. Choosing to still see me as a patient knowing that they will not earn much for doing so demonstrates that this office is in the business for the patients and not insurance companies.

I should not have even sat down; wait time was so minimal.

Every member of this office treated each other with good humor, courtesy, and respect. Teamwork is huge in healthcare practice and given the amount of patients seen every day, this is crucial to avoid any mistakes being made. The dentist took his time with my exam and provided great patient education when I asked him several questions.

Never thought I would say this but I can't wait to pay another visit to this dental office

First time having Thai; loved it! The food was great, but the service was lacking although there were only a small handful of other customers their during dinner time. The food was very tasty though.  Will return.

Hands down our favorite restaurant in the Treasure Valley. The food is as amazing as the service! It feels and tastes authentic and their specials are usually to die for. It's our special place that we go to for birthdays, promotions, and any their celebratory occasions. We always make a reservation too. Chris is the nicest and warmest lady you'll ever encounter in the restaurant industry. It's also a great place to take visitors from out of town. Would give 10 stars if I could!

Spend the time to go down the street to Papa Murphy's at Cherry and Ten Mile, drive-thru or not. 

I have waited a while to actually present my feedback on this Papa Murphy's because in all fairness it has only been open a short time; the first few weeks/months can be a little bumpy. 

Well, those bumps seemed to never iron out here. The wait times are inexplicably longer than most other pizza places in the area, all while they constantly misquote their wait times. They have given our pizza away to someone else and made us wait until another was made. They have made my pizza wrong more times than one would tolerate. The lackluster customer service is borderline laughable. The only saving grace for this location is the drive-thru window. Without it, they would be in a tough spot.

This bagel cafe was such a great find! The inside was really clean and the man working was friendly. Our bagel sandwiches came out quickly and tasted absolutely delicious. The bagels were soft and flavorful. I had the cheese bagel and it was great. They had all the toppings even sprouts and avocado, yum!! We also ordered a latte and it was good too. They had a large offering of different drinks including boba, Thai tea, etc. The food was great in this little cafe and they had a good menu selection with something for everyone. We will definitely be back when we are in the area.

I really wanted to like this place. I even tried two different pizzas on two different occasions: but each time I'm just left with less money and dissatisfied. The pizzas aren't horrible here- they just aren't great. They are super bland- even the dough for some reason tastes bland with a slight bleach taste. I tried the Margherita pizza first: and while I know the sauce on a Margherita pizza is usually simple, I've had quite a bit of these types of pizzas and none have ever tasted so boring and bland. It was like they crushed the Marzano tomatoes but then didn't add any other spices to enhance the flavor. The next pizza I tried was a potato pizza with rosemary, bacon and Alfredo sauce. Honestly I couldn't even taste the Alfredo sauce. It was just ok. Nothing I would try again and wasn't good enough for me to even finish my small pizza. The price was almost $15 for a small pizza: at that price I want to be wowed or at least enjoy it enough to want to finish the entire meal. The inside of restaurant looks nice and clean, but the food wasn't up to par for me. I can't recommend it.
Amazing!!! Best burger in Idaho ! They have great service and prices ! We will be back every week
