Good food , good service! Front desk cashier sometimes not very helpful, it looks like they don't really know how to take people's order, once they even over charged me! Other than that,  the food and service is worth what you pay.

The atmosphere is dated and cheap looking. The service was friendly but slow. Worst of all the food was sub par. It was a huge disappointment after hearing so many good things from acquaintances...maybe we just went on an off night.
Nice atmosphere. Awesome service. A little pricy but I loved that they had a full bar and a good selection of wine. So delicious. I love sushi !

Should be 3.5 stars. Not an option. Sizzler usually so-so. This one is pretty good. Salad bar kept up consistently especially as busy as it was. All salad items fresh--except maybe chicken nuggets and wings too many out at a time. They get cold 
  Service excellent they quickly bring your Texas toast--I ask them to wait until I get back to table from salad bar. Tall thin blonde 'tami' I think is quite good and efficient. Could fit in at fancier place.  Kept drinks full and grabbed dirty plates immediately. Also brought extra napkins before we asked. 
   Burger dry/too well and lettuce at taco bar soaked otherwise 4+ stars. Caring people doing most things right.

I am currently sitting in a dark theater...and have been here for thirty minutes waiting for the movie to resume. Halfway through the biggest action sequence in the Hobbit, the picture cut off and we had to listen to a pivotal scene- with audio only. Way to ruin it, theater. It took three of us to get up and complain loudly to get anything done- but only after 10 more minutes of in-the-dark waiting did a manager come in and apologize. We are still waiting and we just overheard the managers saying that they can't fix it. Now we get to leave the theater without knowing how it ends. Still no official announcement. Way to go, loser theater of the world, I won't be back. DUMP!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

Oh. My. YUM. I took my husband here for his birthday in February. It is now April and I can still remember the meal clearly. We enjoyed ham croquetas, my husband had the halibut and I had the evening's special fish, and then we enjoyed his apple bread pudding for dessert. Absolutely amazing meal. We'll be back this summer!!

Ate here a few weeks ago and was pleasantly surprised. We won a gift card at a neighborhood party and decided to try it out. Unfortunately the gift card showed a zero balance. The owner assured us it was probably a glitch and put $10 on the card with no questions. The wife and I both had the brisket. It was tender, juicy, and the barbeque sauce was great. We had fries that were crispy and good, and the owner brought us a sample of barbeque beans that were very tasty. We usually eat at Famous Dave's but this place is closer, just as friendly, and so far the quailty was right there with FD. We will be eating there again soon.

We wanted to really like this restaurant, but it did not compare to the teppan grills we loved in California. We chose the hibachi grill. My husband's scallops were undercooked and chewy. The shrimp was just so so. My salmon was the worst I have ever had. Really fishy and inedible. I did enjoy the fried rice. I guess there is a reason they offer coupons every week. With our big group, our meal came to $165 which included beer and wine. Not money well spent in our opinion. Sorry, we won't be eating here again!

Friendly, delicious and a very welcome addition to the flavor profile of Meridian. Small and quaint. Food is fresh and energetic. After eating Indian cuisine all over the country, this rates in my top two. And I only had the buffet. Can't wait to go for dinner.

My family (mom, dad and I) were recommended to try this restaurant by another business in downtown Boise. After a long day of car shopping, we decided to treat ourselves to a nice dinner. This is definitely a restaurant appropriate for special occasions. The staff was extremely friendly and warm hearted. We were greeted by one of the owners who educated us about their history which I will leave for you to find out. The plates may seem a big expensive but it is worth the money. You get a three course meal - soup and bread, salad, and your entrée. We also ordered the croquetas, which are to die for if you've never tried them! The server was attentive and not overbearing so we were able to enjoy our meal. The courses seemed to be a bit spread out but after getting through my soup, which is only the second course since we got an appetizer first, I was happy that the courses were spread out a bit to allow for digestion to happen! I ordered the halibut with lobster cream sauce as my entrée and it was excellent. I'm from Alaska so ordering the halibut was risky, knowing what good halibut is. My dad ordered the meatballs which had a gravy type tomato sauce and he literally (okay not literally) licked the bowl clean. My mom ordered the scallops in some kind of garlic cream sauce and there were so many scallops in that dish. They definitely do not skimp on food here. Again it's well worth the money. My parents were discussing returning here for Father's Day this month with my mom's parents. The next time I am in town I will be returning as well! Well deserved 5 stars!!!!! They truly care about their guests and make you feel at home.

I liked this place. It was a little on the pricey side for the kid hibachi dishes but it does give a kid more than they could possibly eat. Service was awesome. Drinks were always full, yet we were the only ones there at the time. Food was good and sushi was amazing! They sing happy birthday with drums and a gong, which my son thought was the coolest thing in the world. Will definitely be returning for special occasions.

Went here bc of good old Guy And DDD. Ive been to about 20 DDD stops and I've only been disappointed once. This was not that one! Service was awesome. Atmosphere is great. People sign the wall and write recommendations which always helps. Food was incredible. Got the rock shrimp, pea soup, and potato encrusted salmon. Highlight for me was the salmon. The lemon butter sauce was knock your socks off good. I was practically licking my plate. The house made hash brown crust was great. You could taste the freshness of the local Idaho potato! If i am ever back in Boise I will def stop back here. The pork  chop is next on my list!

Been back now twice.  the service has improved greatly.  I really suggest the VIP over 21 section.  The food was great, we had Quesadillas, and my wife enjoyed a cocktail.  The prices were very reasonable.  The popcorn is the best in the Valley.  Worth going just fir it.
It's like dining with family!  Always good company. Always good food!  I would recommend dining here!  The staff was wonderful. And the food is amazing!

I've been coming here many times the past few years and this time around has been the worst experience by far. Typically the service is not the greatest, but the food made up for it. However, I believe management changed or something changed and the service is worse than before and the food is crap. We asked for spice (medium) and there was ZERO spice. Then, the waitress had the audacity to say maybe we don't know what spice is and they can make it hotter. Besides that, the food was flavorless and over cooked. The boba was extremely mushy and has no texture to it. I recommend finding another Thai place to go to or change the type of food you will get that evening. Avoid if at possible!

This place was really good. Excellent service and the best part was the coconut naan! The curry was good, but what blew my mind was the naaaannneeeyy! would definitely take friends and family there, for sure!

Very nice theater - definitely on the fancy side. Seats were pretty comfortable, sound on movies was good, food from the concession stand is decent though priced just as high as other theaters. I didn't try the food from the restaurant, so I can't comment on that. The one thing I don't like about this theater is that you have to purchase all of the tickets for your group at one time or you won't be able to get seats together since it is assigned seating. You almost can't ever just show up and buy tickets as any seats that might be together are usually already sold out. Frustrating to say the least, but overall a good experience at this theater.
Best mushroom Swiss burger, add lettuce and tomato for .25 worth it. Can't say enough about the great staff and the custard out of this world
Service is great!! Food was good as well. I'd come back. Nice and clean. But the service was great and that's what sets this place apart.

Amazing customer service!!! NIce nice people!!! My new fav place to get my toes done!
Nice people, clean, didn't try to upsell. Love it!
Thank you!!! 
They even have a punch card reward system!! Totally will be coming back and bring friends!
The bathrooms are absolutely disgusting! It's a Burger King... go somewhere local; they're better.

I took my St. Bernard, Katie to see Dr. Mills in the spring for a yearly check up.  I could tell right away that he had a lot of compassion for animals.  In November I decided I didn't know enough about breeding to have puppies and decided to have her spayed.  I had some questions and Dr. Mills took tme out of his busy schedule to call me to answer my questions. Katie came through her surgery and recovery just fine.  ( she didn't even have to wear collar, she never licked her incision) the staff at Settlers Park Veterinary Clinic are knowledgable and friendly and the clinic is very clean.  My daughter in law takes her dog here and recommended it to me, I am happy to find a great place to rely as n for my girls health care.

They forgot to make my salad, my soup was good but cold and I'm still waiting on my salad. Also a bit grossed out because the restroom is really dirty and no hot water. I have been to other locations that were super good but not this one. I think they work more on takeout and forget those of us eating in. Still waiting on salad.....
Love, love, love this spa!! A true hidden treasure. Massages were divine and pedicures were a real treat.
Very frustrating to join the waitlist on Yelp only to arrive at the restaurant and have them say they can't honor the online check-in because it's not fair to people in the restaurant.

I absolutely love this spa! When you walk in it's professional, clean and beautiful! I really like the online booking they have and the text message reminders. Every time I've walked in the front desk staff is super friendly and offer tea or water. They take you in a relaxing waiting room before your appointment which is nice after a long day at work! Courtney is the absolute best! You need to get a facial from her! I only trust her with my face! Her technique and knowledge is by far the best I've ever experienced and I've had many facials from different spas. Facials from this spa are seriously the best in town! You won't be disappointed!

For a short time only, Thai Basil is serving a seasonal Pumpkin Curry dish. It is truly the best curry and best pumpkin dish I've ever had. The curry also contains cubes of Thai pumpkin, which I'd never had before. It is similar to a firmer green zucchini with a slight sweetness.  I asked the waitress how long they would be serving it and she said most likely through the end of November.  You hazen't tried it yet?....go....go now!

My absolute favorite thing about moving to Boise is my dental hygienist Callin! I feel like I won the lottery. My teeth have never looked or felt better! She is professional, knowledgeable, and so personable. For the first time in my life I look forward to going to the dentist. She is gentle but very thorough. She has a great sense of humor. I look forward to my next teeth cleaning!

Beef Obradys has an incredible menu. I have yet to have a dish that wasn't simply amazing ! The waitstaff are professional and courteous.  My server Tonya must be management because she always goes above and beyond to give us the best dining experience. The prices are reasonable. The beer selection will cover any pallet and Tonya  ( as well as other servers we've had) are attentive and courteous.

This is the best place to ship packages through usps. I never have to wait in line. This is a one stop shop for all your post office needs. The prices are the same as well. Also, great customer service. All around great place to ship and buy supplies.

NO REASON TO GO TO THE POST OFFICE - You can do everything at Paper Cottage!

- Ship Packages
- Mail letters
- Buy stamps
- Buy shipping supplies
- etc.
This place is perfect if you like soup, salad, and sandwiches! They are efficient and customer service is great!

Wow just great food and service. First time here while visiting Idaho. Ordered the two meat plate with Mac and cheese and the loaded potato. Picked up a tasty sandwich with fries also. The ice tea was awesome and delicious as was all the food and don't forget to try the bbq sauces they have on the tables. Looking forward to visiting again in the future.

I've been to Village Cinema on a few occasions now and am definitely a fan.

I've purchased tickets in-house as well as online and I prefer purchasing them online beforehand. It saves on time standing in line and allows you to pick your seats without being rushed. For some reason, when I try to pick them there in person I always get things turned around and pick seats close to the front when I'm trying for closer to the back. I blame feeling rushed, but it's just as likely that I'm just completely directionally challenged and easily turned around.

The seats are plush and spacious and the screens in the theaters I've been in are ginormous. The seating is stadium style so there's never a worry that your view of Zac Efron's blue eyes will ever be, in the least bit, obstructed. 

I've always received great service and the concession line always seems to flow well. Ticket and concession prices are (as is usual for any newer theater) on the spendy side. But, if you go on Tuesdays, tickets are steeply discounted (there are Village wide discounts on Tuesday). Come early, though, Tuesday's a popular day at The Village!

Overall, a beautiful theater offering a delightfully comfortable viewing experience.

Get to it!

I used DoorDash for this place. Delivery was fine. When I placed my order for the Basil Shrimp it came with Jasmine Rice.  My food came cold and no rice. Called the restaurant and the fact they speak poor English it was hard to understand them. Told them I want my rice and a new meal since this one was cold. 
She said she had to call door dash customer service, they called me and the restaurant told them that they changed there menu and rice did not come with it, I told door dash that's not my problem that they changed there menu and didn't update door dash menu. I still want my frickin rice!
 I will never order from this place or use door dash again.

Good food and amazing service. Our waiter was extremely doting.  The only reason I didn't give them five stars is because their aisles are a little tight and my dad kept getting bumped by ladies purses walking by.

Surprisingly great bagels in Boise!  Prices are great compared to what we we used to, at 90 cents for plain, wheat, orange-cranberry, Hawaiian*, salt, blueberry, onion, garlic and others without cheese.  Cheese bagels, like Asiago, cheddar, garlic pesto, garlic spinach, and others were a little more, but worth it. [Hawaiian bagel was made with pineapple and coconut.]

We had egg, cheese and bagel sandwiches, then bought a baker's dozen for the road for $8.99!  Every flavor was delicious. 

Like Boise itself, which was more metropolitan that expected, Sarah's was a bagel oasis.  Also serves coffee, with lattes, espresso, and flavored coffees, and a full lunch menu.  Fresh made croissants for these who preferrer less bite in their lunch or breakfast sandwich.  Also, cinnamon twists that make a great dessert.

Worth the trip!

Terrible experience from the moment we walked in the door. We waited in line for concessions, when it was our turn the clerk just walked away and didn't say a word. We moved to a different line, I mentioned to the manager what happened and all she said is "Yea, we don't know where she went". One of our children waited at the Gelato counter for 10 minutes and the clerk making a coffee didn't say anything. I had to ask if we order at this counter. The clerk said yes, but I'm busy. We had arrived at the theater at 3:30 for a 4:10 meeting. When proceeded to the theaters we were actually sold tickets for the 3:10 movie. We had to go back to the ticket box to exchange the tickets. No apologies, no explanations. Horrible customer service!

Some of the slowest service over ever seen. Line of 9 people and you can see the employees Messing around in the back with one poor cook doing all the work. One cashier kaden was in the front and he was cranking out orders pretty well.

Joshua, I think the Meridian Speedway is a magnet for San Diegans. I, a native Dagoian, was invite to an afternoon at the Speedway by my good friend Andy. By "speedway" the Meridianese mean "1/4 mile high school track." Custom builts race at a neck-breaking 70 miles per hour. 

OK, now to the good part.
They have BEER in a PLASTIC BUCKET with a HOLE cut out of the LID 

In the heart of Uh-murrica/God's Country--where, in 2007, they still sell freedom fries at the concession stand-- the singer dude forgot the words to the National Anthem. 

I won a shirt with WWRBD (What would Ricky Bobby Do) and "Shake n Bake" printed on the back.

This one lady had three faces tattooed on her thigh. 

The End *passout*

HORRIBLE customer service.  Ordered chair over month ago still not in.  Was a Christmas gift ...promised absolutely no later than 23rd it's the 28th and no new eta.  Also waiting for return phone call from their "customer relationship manager" from 2 days ago.  I'll call you right back HA!  Spent 10 minutes on hold today no one picked up.  Buyer beware!

Best ever!  Curry, our waitress was quite the lady. She greeted us right away and answered all our questions. The chef shops twice daily and the salad and vegetables certainly reflect his attention to detail. The presentation was equally as good as the flavor. Overall customer service and quality of food was superb!

You need to train your people better.  I am a gluten-free vegetarian, not some pariah.  I do not need to be talked down to re:how hard it is to keep a gluten free atmosphere.   I choose to be gluten free and am not gluten intolerant, but your employees are obviously trained to be combative re: gluten and have not been educated re: why someone may have to avoid gluten.  This will end up biting you in the butt, I imagine.
And your vegetarian options?  The Quinoa Vegetable soup was all broth...really.  Two, maybe three spoonful of vegetables in the bottom of a Large Soup.  And the Kale Quinoa Salad?  Tasted good but, hey I know how much Quinoa and Kale cost...what a rip-off.
Oh and to illustrate the total lack of education regarding food allergies, there was the (2) rolls packaged with my soup and salad. 
This is a management issue and I would imagine it is franchise wide.  Needless to say, I will not be back and I will not recommend Café Zupas to any of my friends, no matter what there eating habits are.
I will recommend Chipotle next door, however.

I'm so full and there's still more to come! 
Saki shots, live beating fried rice heart, food flying everywhere. It's Japanese madness! 

This place is totally fun and delicious. 

Very authentic atmosphere and funny chefs. 

We didn't get very dangerous with the sushi but for what it's worth, the California rolls are great lol

This place rocks! My 1st night in Idaho was a truly multi-cultural experience thanks to Epi's (totally unexpected). We are huge fans of Spanish cuisine but had never tried the closely related Basque cuisine before.

Epi's provides a crash course in all things Basque - food, wine, culture, and the how/why Idaho came to have the largest Basque population outside of Europe.

Our waiter and the restaurant's hostess were wonderful; attentive, warm, friendly, and extremely informative. The staff at Epi's takes great pride in their food and culture (all staff members are Basque and most are related to the restaurant's founder, Grandma Epi).

The restaurant is clean, comfortable, and well decorated (warm, cozy, and homey...as if you're dining at a friend's/relative's house).

We sampled the Basque house red (drinkable, affordable, no frills), lamb stew (superb in every way - not even a touch gamey and perfectly seasoned), and the calamari in black squid ink (delicious and unique - a must try).

All of the above was served w/ multiple generous sides/salads/breads.

Even dessert and coffee was well worth the extra time and money spent (large portions, good qualitiy food).

We highly recommend Epi's for a unique dining experience at very, very reasonable prices!

Thank you for the yummy food and great service! Was offered water while I waited for my take-out and greeted promptly when I walked in. Food was ready in about 5 minutes. The red curry was amazing! I will definitely be back.

Great Ice cream., horrible customer service. Help was young and rude and made our large group feel rushed. Several in our group left and went to Fred Meyer for ice cream due to bad attitudes. We will not be back

This restaurant has THE BEST Thai food in the whole Boise, Meridian, Eagle, etc area. By far. No other place we have gone to has compared in any way to this place. 
Great portions, perfectly seasoned to your taste as they do ask your spice preference and are always spot on with it. You can taste the love and care that goes into every meal. 
I can't rave about this place enough. 

The service is fantastic! 
Staff are friendly, clean, quick, and courteous. 
You can even ask one of the fellas here to tell you a joke and he'll think one up for you!
They are very nice and accommodating every time we come here. The absolute best. 

The restaurant is always clean, beautifully decorated, and delightful ambiance. 

I highly recommend going here for the nest Thai food experience.

After a couple of negative interactions, I'm deciding to downgrade my review a bit. It sucks to give this two-star, because it comes down to some ridiculous individual stuff (not the organization as a whole); however, team members reflect the whole team.

The last few times we've gone, there has been utter confusion at the box office. Last night, three cash registers were being occupied by people who were counting money and trying to verify their numbers. Maybe they'd just been hit by a huge crowd? There was a lot of talk about refunding things and someone asking for very particular seats, which is why the only two seats "next to" each other in the VIP showing of the film we wanted to see were separated by an aisle. So my wife and I wouldn't be able to sit next to each other on our date night. We opted for regular seating, which sucked simply because other human beings are so goddamn awful (the guy behind me brutalized the chair I was sitting in; tons of folks on cell phones or talking... I know, not the theater's fault).

The issues came when the employees were totally confused (us wanting to sit next to each other), were doing things really quickly without talking to us or explaining what they were doing. There were 90 seconds of my wife and I staring at each other awkwardly while the employee flipped through screens rapid fire... we had no idea what she was doing until she explained that there were no seats next to each other in VIP for the rest of the night... well... that didn't matter. We were only able to see the 5:30 showing... so why all of the button pressing, awkward silence, etc.

During all of this, two "senior" employees (none of them claimed the title of manager, but were not wearing the standard uniforms) vented to each other about how hard the night was and about not having a manager around. To be helped by one person out of five or six was pretty frustrating, especially when TWO of those people supposedly had the power or credentials or whatever to do something other than openly, in front of customers, bitch about the situation.

Also, when my wife explained that she is a village employee and inquired about any discounts, the young lady laughed pretty rudely and point blank said, "No... sorry!" By the way, she was utterly wrong; we get free VIP upgrades on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays. That was about the fourth time an employee of this establishment both let us know that we didn't get a discount when we were entitled to one (not last night; it was Tuesday; she was still wrong and rude) and scoffed at us as if we were some money-grabbing assholes.

That's hard to swallow as a grown adult and coming from a 16-year-old.

We need to work on training, knowledge, and customer service. We've been misinformed on a variety of issues in the recent past (no happy hour drink or app prices in the theater, which we were later told was wrong... which meant they missed out on sales for the night from not only us, but whoever else wanted a beer and some fries). At some point, they will need to implement a training program and some kind of system for communication.

Recently traveled to Idaho on business.  An associate recommended I give this place a try for lunch... glad that I did.  Very fast, great flavors and good price.  The staff was friendly and the restaurant was clean.  Pretty casual atmosphere.  Overall, all I can say is that I hope Qdoba brings their concept down the Southern California soon.... cuz they hooked me on the first visit.

Recommendation:

-Chicken Queso Burrito (sooo delicious!)
-Chips w/ guac. (chips have a hint of salty, lime flavor and guac was perfect)
Everything tastes great . We don't live in Idaho but always find time when we are here.

My first time here and I felt very welcome! The staff was pleasant and friendly. The beer selection is awesome and the personal pizza I had hit the spot (I recommend getting a side of the buffalo sauce. The place is clean and overall, a great end to my day. 

A return trip on Taco Tuesday had me craving shrimp tacos. Hands down the best shrimps tacos I've ever had! Not enough salsa for the chips but they tasted good on their own. Definitely glad I came back!

I went into D&B Supply to look for a wrench to get my old license plates off my car. The woman at the counter went out of her way to find and let me borrow two screwdrivers and a wrench, and then another man who works at the store came out to help me with it! Super nice  friendly store.

I really wanted to like this place.  Great location, Italian food, and of course.....wine!  However, between the lack of knowledge from our server to the mismatching portions to two of the same dishes my dinner party and I ordered, I was underwhelmed.  The wine of course was good, but not $10 a glass good. I'd be interested in trying this place again in a few months since they just opened to see if they work out the kinks.

What more can you ask for????? Trendy, eclectic atmosphere! Owners were warm and welcoming. And the food....every bite was heaven. New England Clam Chowder was fabulous and the Salmon was even better! The southern fried chicken was crunchy on the outside and mouthwatering juicy and tender on the inside. 
A great find! Loved it.

Thai Basil is one of our favorite places. We go at least monthly. My wife loves the Pad Thai, but has started enjoying the curry. I love the seasonal pumpkin curry. The staff is always friendly and not intrusive.

It was supposed to be a quick visit to check out pricing for our son as he needed a new bed. Instead it turned into a two hour go back and forth with about 10-12 signed documents.  Don't get wrong, Ashley has beautiful furniture and offerings. They also have smiling and very polite salespeople. Paul was our salesperson and he is one of the nicest guys you will ever meet.  So, you may ask, what's the problem.  There are several issues. 

(1) They have specials but it is very nebulous as to what the final price is going to be. We had a budget of 700 or so and after two hours, the price had ballooned to 954 not including the finance and payments with the total amount to be north of 1200.00.  All of this for a Full size mattress and frame. 

(2) We must have signed our names at least twenty times on all sorts of paperwork. All the while we had really no clue what was the price until the last moment. 

(3) Delivery and setup is north of 120 dollars. 

(4) Delivery was a week out. 

We signed our names to the agreement just to get out since the process was way too long. We have negotiated for a new car in less time. 

Thankfully, they offer a 48 hour cancellation clause. We were told that we could not call in the cancellation, so after we saved ourselves roughly 700 dollars by visiting a competitor, we returned to Ashley and cancelled our order. 

While Ashley may be for other people, it simply was not for us. Again, this review is not about the quality of the merchandise or the friendliness of the employee, both of which is 5 stars but the overall process of getting customers through the sales process needs to be reviewed otherwise it may be simpler to purchase a car with zero money down.
High quality taco truck food. Friendly staff. Made to order. Not the biggest taco truck burrito I've ever had - but it was good! I'll go back.

The worst experience at a restaurant, period. Take out orders should be a breeze, not this occurrence. After getting my name wrong three times, it turned out that they had not made my order yet, forty minutes past the estimated time. They wouldn't refund me because it was an online order, a ridiculous excuse for a ridiculous experience. The refund is the money we'll be saving by not going there ever again.

I have been to Izumi twice now - once for my cousin's birthday in June on the Hibachi side and again last weekend just for family dinner.  It was so delicious both times!  The staff is all so friendly and everything everyone orders is always delicious.  The chicken tempura was the best I have ever had (including homemade).  My cousin ordered filet mignon and it came with two steaks!  I highly recommend Izumi to everyone!

Last night was my fifth trip to Goodwood's Meridian location and once again, Goodwood delivered. This time I took a business client from out of town. He travels extensively for work, is a huge barbecue fan and said that this place is equal in quality and price to many of the places he's visited in Texas, Kansas City, and Memphis. This coming from a man who refuses to eat at barbecue places in his home town - preferring to smoke his own meats in the backyard pit he constructed. 

A little of my own perspective and observation: Each time the service has been spot on and the food has been delicious. Don't let the veneer fool you, this is a real barbecue place meaning they actually smoke the meat as evidenced by the smoke rings in the meat. I had the brisket, babyback ribs and pulled pork. All were tender and served with Goodwoods' own barbecue sauces. The sides are excellent as well. I had the potato salad and coleslaw - both were creamy and refreshing while my client had the beans which he said were excellent. My wife, who accompanied us for the evening, almost always goes for the turkey or the pulled pork sandwich but this time opted for the chicken - which is half a chicken. It was also perfectly smoked.  

Overall, I would go so far as to say that I've never had better meals and better service for the price. To me that's value. A few words of caution: I've noticed that it can get pretty noisy so it's not recommended for a romantic-type dinner, it's definitely more a family friendly place as well.

Great office atmosphere, my dental hygienist was great, made everything painless and easy. Dr Smith was pleasant and friendly. One of the best experiences I've had when visiting a dentist and it will keep me going back for a long time. Highly recommended!
Excellent food! My favorite go to for Thai food. Had lettuce wraps and Tom Kha Gai soup take out tonight. YUM!!!!

So I thought I'd come here for lunch and have a sandwich. I was craving a sandwich. A really good sandwich. What I got was far from good :/

I ordered a turkey bacon avocado panini sandwich. No tomatoes, substitute sprouts.  

When my panini came out it was extremely thin...I opened it to find a pinch of sprouts only on one side, very small shriveled up half pieces of bacon, and a thin spread of avocado. Plus a chunk of something dark smashed into the bread. Not the business!!!

I brought my sandwich to the manager and asked him what the dark thing was...his response..."oh that's the avocado". 

Well that's some nasty over ripe avocado that has gone bad. 

I asked him if he thought that looked like a very appealing sandwich and if he would want to eat it... He quickly had a new sandwich remade for me.  That's the only reason I am giving this place a star. When my new sandwich came out, it was still hella thin with hardly anything on it. But I was hungry and needed to eat something. I probably should have just gotten my money back and went next door to Chipotle. 

Sooo the bottom line: Would I come here for another sandwich? Hell no!!! The quality of food and portions do not match up with their prices. 

I'm bummed out because I came here with great hopes after reading some of the other reviews....

I can get a much better sandwich for cheaper at the local grocery store deli. 

On that note....

Help raise awareness & end Human Sex Trafficking...

Visit : DontBePimped.com
Wrong checks, slow service, poor management, great chef. Watch your bill. For the price, should have better Customer service
Amazing!!! Wonderful flavors with service and atmosphere.  The staff makes the meal a "10"!!!   The food was fantastic!!

Not impressed at all. First, I'm completely over the "high school cafeteria lines." It's about how fast they can prod you through the line. Making the food as efficiently as possible. That is not relaxing, which is how I like my lunch. It's a break in the day where I get to exhale and take a breath.

Secondly, my soup was soooo salty, I could have stroked out there on the spot. The salad didn't take as fresh as it should have been. The portions were okay... not too large. They weren't worth the money.

Lastly, their phone directions say that they are south of Fairview. They are not. They are north of Fairview.

Nope. I won't be going back. It was chaotic. People walking around with trays, trying to find a table.
Had dinner. I felt the meal didn't have enough flavor so I won't be returning. But the staff was so very attentive. Wish them the best. High price range.

I was very excited to try this new theater. I went to the kiosk to get my tickets instead of waiting in the long lines. I got 2 VIP tickets. It said 21+ but admit I didn't pay much attention to that, until we found out we couldn't get in because my niece was 19. I assume because of alcohol. Or at least I hope that was the reason. Because of my mistake we had to go back down and get regular tickets. I thought I was getting good tickets but discovered they were right up front and our necks were bent back the whole time. I couldn't go exchange the tickets. This was a pain, literally and figuratively. The chairs are narrow and the can rock back and fourth. The people behind us kept kicking our chairs throughout the movie. At another theater we could just change seats. My niece waited for 20 minutes trying to get coffee. They took so long that by the time she got to the counter to order, they were taking so long making each coffee that she decided just to get water. I will not be going here again. My freedom of choice and ability to adjust my situation if needed is too stifled here.

First thing first. If you type the address into a gps make sure you pick the meridian address not eagle. Lol. Makes for a long drive. It's a nice establishment sports bar/restaurant we are on the hunt for the best wings in the area. (This place isn't it) they have good wings. The meat is good the skin a little crisp. We tried the medium and plan to go back to try the hot. I also had the bbq burger which was as good as any other restaurant. The staff is friendly and the service was quick and they were on the ball when it came to beverages. The restaurant is good definitely worth a try. But I am still on the look out for the best wings. (And don't say Buffalo Wild Wings cause that's not true (disgusting))

The only reason I go here is because it's the only place my grandparents like to go. It's okay, but it's not someplace I would choose to go to. 

Their salad bar is probably the best thing they've got, and it's a pretty decent salad bar. They've got lots of stuff for your salad, along with guacamole, avocados, chicken wings, soup. The have fresh slices of pineapple, watermelon, kiwis, and cantaloupe, along with grapes. They also have canned peaches and pineapples. For dessert they have an ice cream machine. Also, you can request a baked potato to accompany your salad bar if you want.

On this particular visit, the "fresh pineapple" had a bunch of really dried pieces. Also, the canned pineapple was sour. The place was busy so I find it ridiculous that they had sour food. Everything else, however, was really tasty.

When you order steak, they ask how you want your steak cooked. I honestly have no idea why they ask because I have never seen them get the meat cooked the way we asked. They have a little stick inserted in the steak to indicate how cooked it is.
One time my wife and I ended up swapping our steak because even though the labels said they were cooked the way we wanted it, they weren't. I don't understand why it's so difficult. I've gone to other steak places and they have no difficulty.

They do serve complimentary toast, which I love! But then again, bread is always good.

The service was decent and the establishment is clean. The place was a little noisy, but not as bad as other restaurants. My recommendation is to just stick with the salad bar, and you'll find that it's a decent value for the price.

Excellent BBQ.   Had the Beef brisket meal, pulled pork meal, set chicken meal.  

The Coleslaw & baked beans were also very good.  Defiantly the best BBQ in Idaho

Was excited when they first opened, but over time the quality & consistency has varied drastically. Sometimes the large salad portions are as they should be & sometimes they're the equivalent of a half order. 

Recently we ordered two salads to go, paid with our debit card, but got charged for three salads. When we brought this to their attention, before walking away from the counter, we were told they couldn't reverse or refund the transaction. We were told it was voided, but not given proof & then they immediately proceeded to charge our card for two more salads. When we questioned this we were told the charges weren't processed until the end of the night, so the first charge should not go through, but if it did bring the receipts back the next day to get it straightened out.

The first charge went through before we even got to our car. Went right back in & was told the same thing. Next day the second charge went through. We went back & at first they refused to do anything. Eventually they refunded the price of one salad because they didn't want a scene, but refused to do anymore. 

Not going back.
First time visit, won't go again.  The food was substandard considering the location next to the fountains in the Village, Meridian.

Al is a top notch individual. An honest, caring professional, and a kind, thoughtful person.  When my rental house had a hard-to-find and rather destructive water leak he was quick to make time to go look for it, and found the source of the leak before anyone else could.  He also did all the subsequent repairs quickly and for a fair price.  I whole heartedly recommend him!

I remember this location when it was a Kinko's back in the day.  Ah that brought a flood of college memories.  Whether it was copying papers or putting a presentation together or even yet using the internet since the internet was still too new and freaking slow.  

Times have changed but now, there's a FEDEX.  There's a lot of stuff, binders, books, and other misc office stuff. On this particular day I needed to ship some stuff to my brother in San Francisco and it had to go FEDEX special blah blah.  There was no time or means to deal with the USPS or another carrier or office.  Too bad, I had to do again, I probably would have gone elsewhere. Its not the fault of FEDEX, ( review is dated, as this transaction happened quite some time ago ), but the cashier was simply not ready for me that morning. She seemed to be handling a large binding copy project that burglarized her time and I waited at the scale for her to come to attend to me. There was no apology stated, but it would have been nice to hear. She weighed the items and quoted me a price.  It was super expensive. I don't remember the exact cost but I shrugged to comprehend why it was so much more.  There was no explanation given other than the, " It is what it is . "  I paid and left but I complained all the way to my vehicle and then was landslided by avalanche of regret by coming to FEDEX.   While the  service is handy when needed and there are probably more than 1000 more uses and services inside, I'll simply cling to my past memories and reflect kindly on them as a time gone era all the while waiting in line at the USPS to save some bucks.

Inspire is a beautiful salon & spa, owned by a really cool family. Their massage and nail care accommodations are very hard to beat. Great Place for a girls day, bridal party, or Mother's Day mani/pedi get together. They have an amazing couples massage room and they carry some of the best in hair care products. You can stop by anytime and they will stop everything to give you a tour of the space and meet their staff. I recommend a Pedicure with paraffin treatment - you won't be disappointed!

Not sure what has changed but we have experience many VIP movies here, mostly the earliest showing. When we went there November 7 to the 11:30 showing we were given menus and told to sit down and wait for the wait staff. No one showed up, so I went out to the snack bar and asked about placing our order. She told me they were not serving today. A manager came to our seats and she told us we could order popcorn or chips but not any thing from the menu. The whole reason we came to this theater was to have lunch prior to our movie. She told us a chef would no be on site until the evening. As of today the VIP seats with In theater dining is still being advertised. Nice theatre but poorly managed.

I have to agree with a lot of the reviews here, this feels as comfortable as visiting your friend's house and being served a fantastic meal. Best of all was the attentive staff, they exceeded our expectations for service.

I had the grilled lamb and it was outstanding. My wife, who is very picky about her seafood, had the seared scallops and she was blown away. The wine recommendation was spot-on.

This is going to be our go-to place for fine dining, hands down.

Locally owned and operated, this fast-food chain specializing in frozen custard and signature burgers made with Midwest beef and dairy according to the girl who talked to our table last night. 
We came to their grand opening day, it was crazy. The place was a zoo, but hey, it's their grand opening day so you kind of expected this kind of situation. but We didn't need to wait too long for our order to be deliver, 10 minutes top! At first you place your order and pay in the counter then they give you a table number then they will deliver your order to your table. 
They have everything! From burgers to soup to salad and cold treats. It was so hard to decide, too many choices!:)) Finally we order Wisconsin cheese curds, Onion rings and 6 different kind of concrete mixers. Every one of them was good! I can't wait to go back and try other things!

Could be a great place to live based on the amenities. Managment Lindy very negative and horrible with people. Just because of her I WOULDN'T  recommend anyone for living there. One person will complain about something then it becomes a rule. People complain all the time.

Surprise hit outside of Boise.  The food is wonderful, but I was taken by the overall hospitality of all of the employees.  I swear, I do not think there are any nicer and appreciative restaurateurs around.  Nice atmosphere and a well appointed menu.  Chorizo app, lamb stew and pudding cake - all very well prepared and tasty.  I'd recommend Epi's to anyone staying in the Boise area (or living) - try and frequent this place.

I LOVE coming here. Everyone is super friendly, the place is clean and they always remember me when I arrive.

If you like rich food, this is the place to visit in Meridian. I do not eat fish or seafood so, I have nothing to offer in that department.

My first time trying it! It was amazing! Their crab Rangoon's are creamy with a delicious orange sauce! Potstickers with a lot of flavor were perfectly cooked! The presentation was beautiful and the environment and professionalism was awesome! Definitely going back and already can't wait!  I had a Valentine Roll and it was absolutely lovely definitely recommend this to anyone!

This was my first time going to spice. I went for the lunch buffet at 1pm on a Tuesday. There was not a lot of people. It's a sit anywhere you'd like seating. I order a mango lassi which was yummy, I wish it was a smug thicker but was still hood either way. They had a decent selection of curries and sides. The naan was a touch disappointing so I will know for next time to special order the naan. Everything else was really good though. I will be going again.

Let me start off by saying, I love the decor and set up of this restaurant.  It is just beautiful.  I have been here a couple of times and really enjoyed both of my experiences.

Wait staff were very friendly, attentive and cordial.  We ordered several things including a lunch bento box, sushi, crispy peanut chicken, salad, soup and they were all terrific.  I would say the only thing that could have used some improvement was the fried rice.

I am really excited this restaurant has opened up.  I am looking forward to trying other items on the menu as well as their hibachi grill seating.  It seems like a great place to bring a bunch of friends and enjoy a wonderful evening of great food and drinks.  I am a fan!

Every person in the office is welcoming and friendly. I don't dread my cleanings and Dr. Smith is wonderful. I've been a patient for about four years after leaving another dental practice due to dissatisfaction. I drive from Star because I like them so much.

While we were at the outskirts of the village we decided to try out Zupas. We previously had seen the menu outside the front door which provided us with some idea as to what to expect.  This is a salad, soup, and sandwich place.  You can have a salad or soup and a sandwich as a combo.   They were busy this particular night with a lot of first time visitors.  The professional looking attendant by the front greeted us and provided us with a paper menu and some personal choices from the menu.  When we got to the beginning of the line. You inform the employee what it is you want. There is really no order taker or machine or ticket.  All the ordering is done verbally.  We ordered the Cuban sandwich without the dijon and added Chile lime. We also had a bowl of the Yucatan Chicken Tortilla soup and kid size of the Lobster bisque.   We were asked if we wanted salads and we declined since it was so cold outside.  The line moved along so the customers can see all their fresh ingredients.  The soup station was next.  Our soups were scooped and here is where the problem lies with Zupas.  With it being busy, the soups and sandwiches get lined up by an expeditor employee until that can be placed on tray.  There can be errors to be made since some customers may have the same time or slightly different items.  There is really no way to distinguish one's soup from another customer.  IF for whatever reason the one cashier is stalled or gets an older customer who suddenly wants to purchase multiple gift cards, your soup and sandwich will lose their heat.  The lone cashier apologized for the wait, but the damage was done, but both of our soups had lost their temperature while waiting to get to us.  This inherently is an issue that Zupas needs to fix. The bottleneck in this restaurant is clearly the cashier station as the rest of the line that is well staffed is moving right along. It 's really not the lone cashier's fault for the delay, they can only ring up one order at a time. There was a second register but it was not being used. I would recommend and suggest to Zupas that during peak times, they staff the second register or have team lead, management type person who can take special requests, gift cards so that the customer's hot food stays hot.  One more thing, it is not possible to 'save a table'  There are announcements on each tablet letting customers know that they have to get their table after going through the line.  This clearly would not be ideal if we had three small children who had to deal with going through the line with us. I would rather take our children to the table, and have my wife do the ordering.   Zupas does have a charging station for electronics and touchscreen gizmos which looks interesting and their beverage station is tucked away behind this station along with a variety of hot sauces and plastic cutlery.   If you are interested in going, go first to watch the operation and see if they have made the necessary improvements and if they have not, well then, enjoy your cold soup.

Melissa did an amazing job on my hair!  I am new to town and am glad I found this place.  They truly care about the health of your hair and don't try to just milk you for cash.  Melissa matched my previous red perfectly.  Highly recommend this salon and Melissa.

This restaurant totally deserves the five stars I've given it. I waited until my second visit before writing this review to see if they kept up the five stars and they did! Both times I've visited Epi's I've lived outside of the Boise/Meridian area. My first meal was so good it brought me back. However I'm going to talk about my second visit because I have photos to match. My husband and I shared each dish as we like to do. We began our meal with Ham Croquetas. So delicious. Our next course was soup, we enjoyed the bean soup and a cream soup. Both delicious. But then came the main course. It's what brought me back. This one I didn't share. I had the Ink Fish (Tximinoiak) and my husband enjoyed a combination of the Halibut and Cod. Usually they serve two filets of the same fish cooked the same way, but he asked if he could have one of each and they were very willing to do this. See the pictures. My Ink Fish was amazing. It is a true delicacy the way the chef prepares this meal. The service was fantastic, the atmosphere delightful, and Kudos to the Chef. There was truly no room for dessert. Our dinner conversation was about moving to Boise. We dined at Epi's for the second time in September, 2018, and moved to South, Boise in October, 2018.

Really cute little restaurant in an old house.  Great food and super friendly atmosphere.  They serve red and white wine and beer. Don't be in a hurry if you go,  appetizers, soup,  salad,  entrees and desserts.  One in our party had the bread pudding and  it was awesome! Served with home made Carmel and whip cream. It was light and fluffy not heavy at all.

I was visiting Boise from OOT for a wedding and stumbled upon this place! What a Deal! Bottomless mimosas with no real time frame. I went with a huge group and there was lots of seating to accomodate us. Seating is open concept right by the center water feature so its a pretty busy area but pretty seating. The staff came around pretty often and even dealt with the loudness our group brought. $10.99 for bottom less mimosas? Can't beat that! 
We also ate some apps during the happy hour. We had the mozzarella sticks and margarita pizza. Both were good. 

It is also in this really really cute shopping area with all the shops I like so it was nice to walk off all the alcohol.

False   Advertiseing      Theis  guys  suck     Told  me  all day yeserday  on ph they would have me a car   For a decent price   And  pic  me  up a few blicks away         When i was ready    They  neither  could pic me uo nor  had  any cars     Thanx fir nothin   Enterpbrise renta car   Meridian idaho

Inspire Salon and Day Spa is the perfect place to get pampered. The staff starting with the owners and management team are dialed into making you feel special. Inspire offers a wide range of services including pedicures to hair styling to even eyebrows,  body treatments, peels  and massages.  Recently my wife and my daughter needed a relaxing day with hair styling and make-up.  Addie, Starlet, and the staff treated them like royalty.  The girls were consulted about everything that they wanted to have done and in the end they looked amazing. Inspire Salon & day Spa is where you can dream to inspire what you want your look to be or how you inspire to feel    I would encourage any guy to have your special girl come here to get some pampering and let her inspire!

Why bother promoting somewhere that doesn't support it's fan base? This page and speedway runs false promotions to capture advertising and utilize intellectual property without ever providing or adhering to the rules. What a waste. Something that could be positive for the community is forever tainted by petty behavior. My sponsor dollars will never be used at this speedway.

Enterprise Meridian is a great place to get a car rental. The staff is friendly, helpful, and knowledgeable. They give multiple upgrades when they don't have the car you requested. No pressure on any options in the contract.
Highly recommend

Fantastic!  I had the Pra Ramlong which is broccoli,spinach, and chicken (my choice) smothered in peanut sauce and topped with fried onions. Presentation was great and flavor combination was amazing. 
I usually order pad Thai every time I go to a Thai restaurant. I will definitely need to continue to expand my horizons.

This is not a family welcome hotel. If you have kids, this is not the place. I have 2 girls; 4 and 1. After swimming they were hungry and their bistro was closed. What restaurant doesn't have room service. The lady at the front tells me "the market is open" I want to feed my girls food not snacks.. I'm beyond pissed.. We are from California and we will never stay here again. 
Wished we would've stayed at the Hyatt hotel in Boise..

The theatre is stunning.  We decided to catch dinner and movie. The ticket order process yesterday ( Friday ) was simple and easy, but are some things to note:  there's only one unisex bathroom in the lobby. There's a restroom upstairs and behind the bored ticket checker person. The coffee was cold from the counter.  Inside auditorium 12, the room is 2 small for the screen.  The seats are like Southwest airplane seats, leather and skinny.  When someone sits next to you, you hear their chewing and smell their breathe.  We heard several people belch during the movie. If all the auditoriums are like this. I'll drive to Edwards and pay more or less so I won't have to listen, hear or smell the body functions.

Food was really good but honestly the worst service I have ever experienced. We got the our food and ate in a pretty timely manner but it took the waiter 40 min to give us the check and another 15 to go cash us out. I would understand if the restaurant was busy but there were only 3 or 4 other tables around us and there was two waiters. If you want to sit around and wait forever for food I highly recommend.

This was my third trip to Epi's and every visit has been exceptional. This is what dining out should be. Chris (the owner) will greet you with a smile and a hug. She is passionate about people and fine food and that passion radiates throughout her establishment. We were well cared for from the moment we walked in the door to the moment we left. The food was excellent. I had the lamb chops and they were cooked to perfection. I could not have been happier! Then, I tried a bite of my wife's halibut with lobster cream sauce-amazing! All I can say is...we will be heading back soon!
Beautiful restaurant, wonderful service, and fantastic sushi at a great price. Can't beat that!

We are on vacation. I asked an employee of a fun center and was referred here. We're all about trying local favorites. The pizza was great  we also ordered the pinwheel and garlic knots and stromboli. The food was great people were great we would come again.

Stopped in here and indulged in their lunch buffet. Excellent food!!!  The atmosphere is nothing special and really lacks character. But it is clean and has plenty of seating. The staff is very welcoming and helpful. The prices are really good but the best part however is the food!!!  It is amazing!!!  An excellent way to try different dishes is to visit the buffet... stop by and enjoy it!

The food is PHENOMENAL!! I gave it 3 stars, however, due to the unfriendly nature of the staff. They were more concerned about keeping the line moving, and weren't short with me. Super great food, though!!!!

What can I say that hasn't been said already?!? This place is a true gem. We walked in at 8pm knowing they would be closing soon with no reservations, and they were so excited for us to be there, making room next to the kitchen for a table for two. You literally want to hug the owner when you walk in. It's almost like walking into your family's house (the restaurant is literally an old house) after a long road trip in which they greet you with hugs, smiles and offer you a heaping mound of comfort food. We had their special which was scallops in some amazing butter sauce) and their regular filet medallions in a peppercorn butter sauce with capers. Everything was amazing. You get a soup (of the day), salad, and fresh baked on premise bread with your entree. Definitely filling but we still had room for their green apple bread pudding with in house made carmel. Freaking amazing!!! We love this place, love how small and quaint it is, but love the staff and overall feeling of eating at Epi's.
This place set a new low bar for fast food. Every time I come they mess up an order or forget something. I spent 22 minutes waiting to get through the drive through.

Reliance arrived exactly on time and worked super efficiently. They were very fair with pricing, friendly, and careful with our things. We had to move up several flights of stairs and they handled it no problem. Highly recommended, best moving experience I've had yet!

Let me just start by saying I have an extreme fear of the dentist and get major anxiety when having to sit in that dentist chair.. I had just moved to Idaho and needed to find a dentist I had a tooth where half was missing and the nerve was exposed and I was in a lot of pain. I scoured Google to find a dentist that had the services available that I needed but also had great reviews and Millennium Family Dental had exactly that. They got me in same day and their office staff is just exceptional!! From the front office to the dental techs everyone (and I really do mean everyone, not one single person has been anything other than what I've described here) is so caring and kind and they really DO care about their patients and they understand that people like myself are terrified of the dentist and they do what they can to ease that fear. My appointment was with Dr. Pieper and he is absolutely THE BEST DENTIST I've ever had. From my first interaction with him I could tell he really cares for his patients and is VERY understanding about my anxiety and has not once made me feel stupid for it. I've actually had that problem in the past with other dentists. He has gained my trust and I no longer have an anxiety attack when I have to sit in that dentist chair. That IS HUGE for me. I've had some issues arise with some of the extractions I've had done, that had nothing to do with Dr. Pieper's dental work, just my unfortunate luck with dry socket and my sinus being exposed and every time I've had to go back for a follow-up the office staff has been nothing but kind and caring and compassionate. I've healed great due to the exceptional work from Dr. P! He is very knowledgeable and doesn't try to tell you that you need all this unnecessary work done just to get more money out of you. When the staff ask how I'm doing I don't feel like they're asking just to be polite, they really actually care and they see what they can do to make it better. Wonderful dentist and a great experience! I'm a new patient who came in for a routine cleaning. Scheduling the appointment was a breeze and the girls were so nice. Pros:
Sunday (when we were there) All day Happy Hour!
Staff was very nice.

Not sure if we seated ourselves or needed to wait, staff walked by us and didn't offer assistance.

Food was great, everything I had was delicious.  The staff was nice.  It's clearly a family operation and I mean that in a good way.  Food was fresh an most things appear to be made from scratch.  If you're a cheapskate, go over it and just do it.
Nice spot! Business travelers galore. Close to food joints within walking distance. It's a good one.

Things must have changed since the reviews from late 2016 -- hopefully they helped!  I've been there twice in the two months, and both times was met by Cody, at the register/order counter. He is AWESOME -- and a relatively new employee!  Conscientious, polite, knowledgable (helped me navigate the various coupon offers -- and the menu).   I do wish these Popeye's would put in some of the other menu items: onion rings, fish, giblets!
Absolutely fabulous experience. Food was delicious and our Hibachi chef was very entertaining; especially for our two year old! If you have kids, this is an ideal place to have a fantastic meal.

Danae & Victor, the owners and their staff are the best in the Treasure Valley.  I have been using them for about 3 years now and I won't go to anyone else.  I trust them completely.  They do an outstanding job.  Plus they have a very wide range of hours, sometimes in the early, early hours of the morning.  Very convenient.  If you are looking for a great salon give them a try.
I took my son here for the first time. Wow! He had so much fun! The prices were amazingly inexpensive. We are most definitely coming here again and possibly making this the new birthday hot spot.
Fantastic. The food was excellent, the service was great, and the atmosphere was homey. We'll be regulars.

If you haven't been here I'd suggest stopping in for some fresh custard. It's the best around Boise. 
Cheese curds are amazing and makes you know why Wisconsin is the cheese head state. The bacon cheeseburger is Sooooo good, they will make it anyway you want. Order the cheese fries, pretty darn good.

This is a tasty thin crust pizza!   They use great ingredients and you can tell from the grease that melts off the cheese and pepperoni.  Sauce is also perfectly matched.  This is a great local business with super atmosphere.

The atmosphere at V3 is inviting and friendly. I have absolutely loved how my hair turns out every single time. The staff are experienced and seem to love what they do. I recommend V3 to all my friends and family. You will not regret going there.

Pizza centric but offering much more in creative menu and good food plus a small but nifty wine and beer list in a casual "all people are welcome" space.  Open only a couple of weeks.  Like any new restaurant they are ironing out new place wrinkles so know before you go that this is so.  But after two visits for great food and friendly service, we're fans.  Details follow.  

BACKSTORY:   Soft opening mode now and will be until about November 1.  We were the only ones in the place for late lunch on our first visit so had a chance to talk with the nice guy owner, Dylan, about his background.  He owned a restaurant or two in the Portland metro area - and the chef's, Zach - from the Seattle area with experience in pizza centric kitchens - and plans for the restaurant as it evolves - use local, keep it fresh by changing up the menu now and then, create a place where all people like to eat. 

MENU & VALUE:   I posted photos of the four page menu.  Creative pizza,  small plate - shareable sized app options, a couple of pastas, a few salads and a couple of soups.  Prices are modest for the quality of the food for great value.

FOOD:  We have had our taste buds tickled by: 

*Fantabulous fried Brussels sprouts with lemon served on top of yogurt and bourbon-bacon jam with toasted nuts.  Only $9 in a serving size easily shareable by 2 or 3.  We polished it off and all but licked the bowl in which this was perfectly presented.

*Pizza with very good crust - made from dough proofed for 3 days and cooked in a blazing hot oven - in one of the of the creative combinations of the house - Jungle Pie -  that included house made arugula pesto, Mamma Lil's peppers, onions, artichoke hearts, ricotta and mozzarella  ($12).  Pizza is cut in 8 pieces - hooray!  Makes it easier to eat and also easy to be shared by four as part of a 'grazing' meal here.

*Caesar ($10.5) made with kale and what is listed on menu as Green Goddess dressing but which seemed like a very lemony (and delicious) vinaigrette to us.

*Fried calamari special ($9) was perfectly crispy, buttermilk batter and served with a disappointingly 'tame' kimchee mayo.  Kimchee kick and acid is great idea for fried food like this - maybe a kimchee confit would work better than mayo.

We see Baked Chevre ($8) or cup of tomato-pepper bisque ($4) or mushroom cannelloni ($12)  or maybe Sunnyslope Pizza ($12) - which includes CoOp-made Basque sausage and tart cherries - or a good ol' Margherite Pizza ($9) in our future here.  If you're beef eaters, we're not, you might try the housemade meatballs ($9) or meatball sub ($12)..

LIBATIONS:   Very small wine list features good local winemaker with options by bottle or glass . There is also a "house wine" red or white at only $6 a glass, a selection the  owner said he is changing it up from day to day to work through wines he 'inherited' when he took over this space from a previously failed restaurant located there.  On our first visit the house red pour ($6) was local Cinder Temperanillo, 2010 no less. (This is $10 / glass at a "foodie" Boise hot-spot.) On our second visit house red choice was a pedestrian mass market blend.  We chose instead the lovely Williamson Vineyards Sangiovese ($9).  Vino is served in good quality stemware and ample pours.  Beer on tap and by bottle / can.  Also soft beverages, including good brewed root beer and housemade strawberry lemonade.

VIBE:   Refreshing the already attractive space he inherited, new owner has made this welcoming.  All standard height seating (hooray) except for the bar counter. Interesting music mix low enough volume to know it is there but not compete with conversation on first visit and blaring Kurt Cobain and similar on need to shout over it "get me outta here" levels on second visit.

ACCESSIBILITY:   Level in the door.  All standard height seats but for the bar.  Accessible loo.  Parking lot is not ADA compliant, but that is the strip mall owner's shameful failure (the ADA has been law for 27 years) and not the restaurant's.

LOCATION / NEIGHBORS:   Surrounded by a sea of franchised food with Red Robin across the parking lot and Applebees across the street. Blue Tiger is in space that was briefly home to (the woeful) Barnyard.  But now new owner, new chef, new menu in a new restaurant.  Say Hallelulah! to being rescued from the gawdawful fast-casual-formula-food-franchised-food-chain joints which are the status quo in Meridian. 

HH / ETC:   Dylan is working on Happy Hour ideas.

No. Sorry. The decor reminded me of places I'd been to in china 25 years ago. The food was unimpressive. We went because they sent us a discount coupon so we gave it a try. If they send another coupon I'll pass.

Excellent experience with Millennium Dental. Everyone was so friendly and cleaned everything after each use. Very detailed in explaining the details about my teeth. Already have my next cleaning scheduled in 6 months.

There is no way it could get netter.  Done Rite is prompt, professional, courteous and thorough in all aspects of their business from quote to clean up.  If you need tree service, call them. You will be well satisfied.

I was in Boise for a business trip. It was lunch time and I am lucky this restaurant came out on my yelp suggestions. 

The Food: 
The menu features barbecue dishes, appetizers, cocktails, soft drinks (lemonade, soda, and shakes). 
I was in the mood for ribs so I ordered a half rack.  For my sides I got "Creamy Coleslaw," and sweet potato fries. 
My husband had the Brisket sandwich , with baked beans and potato salad. Both our meals were delicious! I used the Tejas blend, which is like their bbq sauce. 
We also got an order of corn bread, just because we are crazy about it. We couldn't finish it all so we took some for the road! 4 corn muffins with jalapeño and butter spread. 

They have three sauces in the table: Manny's mustard, Tejas Blend, and Sassy sauce. Listed from Mild to hot. 
 
The service: 
Great service! Our waitress was nice and friendly, she first brought our drinks and corn bread out, then the food. 
Then she came out with our food, and checked on us. She made sure we were pleased with our order. 

Overall: Great bbq experience! 4.3 Stars :-)
We love this place. We moved here from SLC where the Bombay House is king of Indian food. This place is the closest to the Bombay House thag we've found in the Boise area. We highly recommend.

This was the best decision I made after a lot of research and getting the nerve to do it.  Anna was fantastic!  She was referred to me by another cosmetologist, and was highly recommended. So my 3 year old boy made a wish in s fountain earlier in the day and the wish was for ice cream, for him, his grandma, myself and our friend. We just moved here and weren't sure where to go but ended up here and HOLY MOLY, it's the creamiest ice cream we've ever had. Sooooo good. Was very disappointed with the wrist corsage that I ordered. White roses were wilted and brown on the ends. Wrist band was put on backwards and I pointed it out and it was fixed. Flowers weren't as fresh as I would have liked.

Great! I have been looking for a good Pad Thai. Thai Basil does it! Great service. Reasonably priced.

I took my family here after moving back to the area and missing our favorite Hibachi steakhouse in Maryland. It is very clean, food was excellent, entertainment lived up to our expectations and the sushi was amazing...we will be coming back soon.
This place rocks!!! Food is gourmet and worth every penny!! I loved the service and I can't wait to go back. Best thing about Idaho--hands down!!

Horrible "BBQ". They cover everything in sauce, yet they have different sauces on the table. What's the point? I was looking forward to trying their sauces but all of our food came out smothered in sauce. But I know why, to hide the dry flavorless meats. We took visiting family here for a good dinner. Didn't happen though! All 12 of us were so disappointed. Beautiful place and great customer service. I wouldn't eat here again though!

Arrived to pick it up and it appeared they had not noticed our order come through.  They had it in the system but had not prepared it.  Once the order was completed they had my husband pay for it, although I had already paid on-line (not sure yet if I was double billed, will have to call).
