Mandarin chicken had the sauce on it already which made it a bit soggy.  Unidentifiable cup of dark sauce, think maybe it was a special soy sauce?  
Found it odd they made no offer to make up for their order mishap.
So all in all it makes me a bit sad, was hoping to be wowwed.  Guess we will keep searching for a good chinese takeout spot.
Reservation for 6:00, yet didn't get seated until 7:00.  Asked for medium rare and got medium well with an oops comment.  Horrible experience!

First time in Thai Basil, and I ordered Po Tak Soup, normally po tak has to come with lots of seafood as it even says on the menu but literally their soup came with barely any shrimp or mussels and veggies like plain water almost and the customer service was lack!
Dine in lunch was very good. Sushi was fresh, miso was hot, bento was plentiful! Wait staff was amazing!
Loved going to the movies here! Place is nice and clean and has good customer service! Didn't have to wait in line long for tickets or for snacks. Would recommend going.

The following is my opinion only.

Worst place ever. These people had me convinced I had like 10 cavities, and then I discovered (and they confirmed) that the X-Ray was simply showing overlapping angles of my teeth (which appear white)... but it was too late, because they already did 2 drillings / fillings, and now I have permanent pain.

Met some friends here recently.  Love the downtown location but the service at the village was aweful.  Asked to order by the glass after a dispensed wine at $10. Waitress never followed up. Just brought our bill
Won't be returning
The food is fairly simple, but delicious. We especially liked the mushroom appetizer. The halibut was amazing. The service was excellent.

My guess were having so much fun this is got to be the most fun I've ever had at a sushi restaurant. Besides the food being absolutely fabulous the curb have such an amazing sense of Eumar and extremely talented at juggling the spatula LOL lobster tails are definitely much larger than you'll find it any other restaurant.
Dr. Gerrard and the entire staff at Millennium Family Dental are top notch!!

Love this place. Good hot soups, great salads and I love the rolls. The sandwiches are awesome. Love the mushroom soup and the lobster bisque. Chocolate covered strawberries a treat. Have eaten here many times and loved it every time

First off this review is for the food truck and not the brick and mortar location, so take it with a grain of salt as they are selling the truck.  It is less a review of the food as it is a review of their service, which is every bit as important.
I've eaten food from the truck twice now and both times a bit underwhelmed by my experience.  The first dish was covered in olive oil and leaked through the box onto my hands as I was eating it, though I saw others with the same dish that wasnt that way, so at best they are inconsistent with their service.  The second time the pasta was a bit overcooked and mushy.  However, both of these experiences don't necessarily warrant a single star rating....
We hired two food trucks to cater our reception, each truck to service approximately 80 people as we were expecting 150 guests.  We provided each truck with 100 plates to serve on, so food/labor was the only expense on their end.  Through a counting mistake on their end, we were billed for an extra 100 plates (at $10 per plate! ) for their service.  The bill was paid without question because our wedding day is a busy day and we needed to get back to our guests.  When confronted with the overcharge, a refund was denied because they felt that their food and service was worth the extra money.  
Call me crazy, but this doesn't seem like a very professional or honest way to conduct business, and it definitely doesn't inspire me to recommend them to anyone.  

So if you are thinking about eating here, good luck as the food is hit and miss.
But if you are thinking about hiring their catering services, BUYER BEWARE!

Went in to the store to buy a new dinette set.  The salesman was very helpful and checked the online price which beat the current sale price by a large margin.  While doing the transaction the store manager was walking the store and thanks us for our purchase.  Wow great service and a killer price, what else can you ask for.

Ew. I'm mostly disappointed that my husband suggest we eat here without looking at the yelp reviews first. Had I known they only had 1.5 stars I would have never wasted my time.  I knew it was going to be bad when I first tasted the salsa... if the chips and salsa are bad, you're screwed. The food- I got the stuffed avocado and it was like they didn't even try, it would have been more appetizing to eat iceberg lettuce alone. No salsa. No lime. My husband got the enchiladas Vera Cruz- his mistake... it was like it was covered with Spicy Ketchup and ranch dressing. This is NOT Mexican food. Unfortunately the waitress didn't ask how my meal was, because I would have told her I hated it, but maybe she could tell by my entire plate being untouched.

Sounds like I'm not the only one who has had problems getting their furniture delivered. I purchased an entire living room set. They delivered everything but the couch and loveseat. After waiting two full months of them cancelling delivery date after delivery date, I finally made them take the rest back and give me a full refund. I even emailed corporate (the "contact us" tab) to complain but no one ever got back to me. My salesman was nice. The manager of the store was nice. But no one else in that company seemed to care... Will never go back.

"Fantastic care and service. Flowers were beautiful and incredibly tasteful, fresh and vibrant. No complaints whatsoever, in spite of some hassles with my own credit card and some renegotiating to our schedule. Teresa was incredibly thoughtful and supportive as we we're preparing for my mother's memorial service. I highly recommend them. Better and more personal than other Boise area florists. Do business with them.

This is a welcome new addition to the Japanese hibachi scene in Meridian/Boise. For me what makes a great habachi restaurant is it's all about the ambiance/scene. This restaurant gets it; right when you walk in it's very bright and festive. The ladies greet you and take you to a pretty much private area. I think one of the negatives I have seen in the Valley is that a lot of times your so close to the next party this place is laid out so well you end feeling like your getting a private party which is really cool. The gal that waited on was super awesome; she was friendly, attentive and just on top of things especially with a large group she did an excellent job. She always was smiling and even took a few pictures/video for the group. I loved how the hibachi cooks were just over the top; engaging funny and great chefs. They know how to get the audience involved and have some great jokes (yeah some were the standard "hibachi tricks/lines" yet there were plenty of new ones too). My crew was laughing and thoroughly enjoyed the show. For the drinks; I had a blue Hawaiian it was delicious perfect blend of pineapple and alcohol (not watered down or too much alcohol). The menu is actually quite simple (the menu they have on yelp shows a lot more entrees) I actually like their actual menu better keep it simple do what you do well/what your there for (hibachi). I chose the filet minion and had him cook it to medium (neat trick; you can swap out your veggies for double fried fried rice). The fried rice was great; just love the flavor fried rice gets on the grill (great portion sizes). Before the show your brought a small side salad and some soup; both were great. My meat was cooked perfectly; tender juicy flavorful with the sauces mixed in. The staff at the end even did saki/virgin saki deal where you yell and pound the table it falls in your drink. Like I said the whole point of going to Japanese steak house is the entertainment; these guys know how to entertain and how to cook great Japanese food with flavor and flair!!

Passing through town and saw the 5 star reviews and thought we needed to check it out. Food is delicious! If we lived here we would come all the time. Will definitely return when we visit our friends next time. Staff are really friendly and helpful. Thank you Epi's for a great dinner after our really long road trip!

Please send your delivery driver to a drivers course, they just cut off 3 different people, speeding, weaving in and out of traffic, ect.

Great theatre always clean and helpful staff. We love their $5 movies nights on Tuesdays. Their concessions are decent and parking is easy.  The village in general is a great place to go and walk around. Beautiful!

Perfect family hotel and business travelers  spot.  It has a number of typical courtyard features and some of its own beauty.    There is not a hot tub.  Well, not one we could find.   Also if you are not wanting to walk through the lobby in your bathing suit to the pool there is two elevators.  :)    Things I love:  cleanliness, friendliness and appearance.   Where they lost a star  was I was sweating!  It was so hot in our room.  I went to turn the heat down in the middle of the night and couldn't figure it out. You walk in to the wonderful sent of Gardenias.  The bistro off to the left is clean and well organized.  Friendliness. My mom was celebrating  her 70th and we had purchased her  flowers. Excellent place to relax and enjoy! Veronica Kyle and the entire staff make you feel welcome. Great food ( try the Erbazzone and the Idaho flat bread, delicious!) Great view of the fountain, huge and outstanding wine selection plus full bar. Bodovino in the Village at Meridian is the best.

Simply delicious!! I absolutely love The Pad Thai House and the food was identical! We asked our waitress about the association and she said that they were owned by the same family. 

We ordered the Cha Gio, Summer rolls, and Pad Thai. I really enjoyed everything.  The service was very friendly as well. Very happy to have great Thai food in Meridian!
It would have probably been a decent experience shopping for furniture had the salesman not literally followed us around the ENTIRE store today! SOOOO UNCOMFORTABLE!!

First time there and entrance wasn't easily found from south parking lot.Had to ask where to find it. A friendly sign would be helpful. Once in 45 min early with 3 grandkids was told it was sold out. Company needs to reevaluate seating procedures or lose money. Almost lost my $60.00 I ended spending there..that adds up if done on regular basis.Disgruntled employee?? Movie was great other than having to sit by everyone with babies and toddlers crying in one section .





.
Just got in from out of town and decided to stop to grab a beer and some appetizers. Best decision ever!! Food was amazing and blue moon was ice cold

The food: this is where by appearance the food takes a hit. The burger came out a bit wet on the bottom and a bit greasy looking. My heart skipped a beat looking at it, but in reality the food didn't taste too heavy and it has a good classic taste. Id most attribute it to Dairy Queen, but better.

Overall I think this place is pretty sweet for the price. The staff is well trained and courteous. The food isn't the best, but you could find much worse. 

I'll come again.
My go to spot for a solid Indian lunch buffet. Quick, simple, delicious, and very easy on the wallet.
Outrageous prices and all the hair is still there....waste of 5k. Won't be going back. Although the staff was very nice and friendly.

The food was pretty good. IMO there aren't any 5-star Indian food restaurants in this area so the food is on par with the others. Buffet had a good variety and service was decent. I knocked it from four to three stars simply because of the cleanliness (or lack thereof); I was the first customer in for the day and the restrooms were dirty and general housekeeping was subpar. Room for improvement.

My husband and I are very impressed with how wonderful LaShawnda was with our 9 month old son for his first haircut. She did an excellent job and was so patient with him. We will definitely be returning and requesting LaShawnda again! We received a nicely printed certificate with his picture and a baggie of his hair as a keepsake. Our son loved the car to sit in for his haircut and was in awe over the colorful atmosphere. Hours after his appointment he is still running around with his balloon! Thank you for taking such great care of our baby boy!

Great happy hour lunch we had today! Staff was very on top of things. We were one of the few people in here, so that's probably why we had great service. Sushi rolls were fresh and flavorful! Tempura was fantastic and the spring rolls were great! Can't wait to come back for hibachi!
This place is just Epic! Great food, great service, great ambiance.  I am from out of town but next time I'm back, Epi will be my first stop :)

I cannot fathom why the reviews are so low. Moving from CA and everybody, including Joel, Jerry, Michael and Dawna ( and every single customer service person) has been amazing! Delivery had been fantastic and even explained the nuances of the items I purchased. They took extra time to fit my large refrigerator in my small hole so it looks snd works perfectly.  Great attitudes and great service. I have had stellar service and deliveries have been great!!! This Lowe's is a great place and their prices are great also. Best price on blinds, appliances and great extended appliance warranties!!! Thanks Lowe's!!!

Good food. We've been twice; once for sushi and once for hibachi. The eating experience was superb. Our hibachi chef was a lot of fun. Sushi chefs are good too. Sitting at the bar was the quickest service for sushi. The service needs work overall. They are new and it's obvious the training hasn't been great. There's a major system breakdown for drinks. We were halfway through our meal before we got our beer. I'm hoping these issues are just about being a new establishment. We'll keep going for the food.

3rd time at Rick's. Started with the celery slaw and it was excellent!  Went light this time and got the apple pecan salad with chicken. Very tasty and full of flavor. Another great outing in Meridian.

Excellent food! All the dishes were full of flavor.... very layered. Unlike other Thai restaurants,  this place did not feel overpowered by the fish sauce smell. Service was quick. Will definitely visit again!
Waited very patiently and happily for 30 minutes and no one took our order.  Very strange.  We walked out.  Thumb's down.
Love the samosas! The lamb biryani was very good. I would definitely eat there again. It smelled WONDERFUL inside. I placed a to go order, so I didn't have the buffet, but I certainly plan to.
Jamie is always so gentle and thorough! She is so polite and accommodating! Every time I visit, I am greeted by warm smiles, making my trips to the dentist my favorite quarterly appointment!

Our favorite.  The food is amazing and they treat you like family.  We were introduced to Epi's a few years ago by our basque friends and it's been a favorite since then.  Everything we have ever ordered has been outstanding, so don't be shy!

So I can tell you is I came to the store and The employees were very friendly and the store was very well organized and I felt welcomed right away. If you are in the area and need to stop at a sprint store I would definitely recommend stopping here these fellas get the job done. Derrick was very helpful and very informative. Keep up the great work.

I've had the opportunity to meet the pastors, helpers, and the folks that make up Life Church, and I can say that they truly have a heart for God and for the Treasure Valley (and beyond!) 

I've seen healings: bad backs restored, food allergies disappear, perfume allergies disappear, depression gone, anxiety gone, ear loss recovered, lower back pain gone, asthma gone, car accident injuries disappear, war injuries healed, Vertigo gone, sicknesses I can't spell gone (LOL), vision cleared up, etc. The list would continue quite a ways, but my point is that God heals, and that this church believes that He can, too! :D

I love how even people I'm not close to care about me and know my name. I love the heart of Life Church.

What a great little place. Food was fabulous! We had a slice of pizza each, shared a piece of stromboli, and I had a side salad. The pizza crust was light and crisp, salad was crisp and cold, the stromboli was fantastic! Talking with the guys was just the perfect touch to make you feel welcome. So glad we found this new favorite!

I have to say that I normally have a strong dislike for dentists, dental hygenists, etc. I haven't had a horrible experience anywhere I just don't like the process of people sticking their hands in my mouth, scratching at my teeth, and then having to plan each breath and swallow...just no thank you!  HOWEVER Millennium Dental put me at ease the first time I sat in their chair. Everything they do is methodical and they explain everything. They look at your whole being, not just your mouth and teeth. I felt like a person and I was truly more relaxed then I think I ever have been at the dentist. I highly recommend the staff and their doctors. I'm actually not dreading my next cleaning and I don't think that's ever happened! Thank you, Millennium Dental!

Unfortunately, , we had a very bad experience at Ricks. After hearing great reviews about the food, we opted to go there for a celebration. Most of our meals were great, but one was not. Upon bringing it the the attention of the server and Rick, we were given the attitude that we were wrong and nothing could possibly be bad about the dish. It was inedible (3 members of our group tried it and spit it out. The meat was bad). Nothing was done about correcting the situation. No apology, nothing. Very poor customer service at Ricks. When everything is great, I am sure things go smoothly. But when there is a problem at Ricks, you are left to feel like you are the one to blame for the problem. This is not the way to run a customer based business. And they even tried to charge us for a meal we did not even eat. We will never eat at Ricks again. Neither will anyone in our group. There are too many other restaurants out there to be treated this way.

We've never had Basque food and we are people that enjoy sampling ethnic dishes from the entire world.  To start with, phone reservations are the only way you are going to get a table.  We called and left a message with Chris.  She called back and gave us a table on the porch, we're so grateful as we were leaving on Monday, the 15th.

Food:  We had bread, followed by soup, then salad.  Our entrees were ink fish (Tximinoiak), cod fish (Makailua), and sablefish.  All delicious and well worth the price.  

Service:  Extremely attentive.

This was an unforgettable experience and when we return next year, we will again dine at this exceptional restaurant.

Yummy! I am from New Jersey where we have a plethora of authentic delicious italian pizza and Finding that in Idaho has been a challenge, this isn't my favorite place to go but the pizza is very good, prices are decent and its close to home.

Excellent all around from the hostess to the decor to the servers and hands down best bartender Gracie she was very personable and very good at suggesting the perfect combination of drinks with my order. Will definitely come back.
Very quick service even for the 28 inch. Fairly cheep, even the specialty pizza isnt priced bad there 14inch 1 topping is only 5.99. Very friendly staff !

Our 3 Y/O is super high stress, and usually freaks when he gets his hair cuts.
We took him to cookie cutters, and he hardly flinched! He loved picking a car, loved checking out the environment, and thoroughly enjoyed watching Daniel Tiger while getting his hair cut. The girl who cut his hair was quick, and did a good job. 
My only complaint is that both my husband and I communicated to the girl who cut his hair that we wanted barely anything off the top of his hair, and she probably took off an inch and a half! I kind of freaked inside about that. But at the end of the day, his hair still looks good, and he was happy from start to finish, so I'll definitely be back and try to me extra clear about any specifics.
Would highly recommend to any of my friends.

This hotel is conveniently located just off the freeway and fairly close to lots of restaurants.  The rooms were beautiful and spacious.  I was impressed by how clean the rooms were. Our room had a king bed and a couch.  My sons room had two queen beds. They have an indoor pool that stays open until 10pm which was nice because we arrived a little later than we planned and specifically booked a hotel so the kids could swim.  The pool was stocked with lots of towels and tables/chairs for relaxing.  We will definitely stay at this hotel again when traveling.

I feel like a kid in a candy store whenever I go to Sportsman's. Tons of good fishing gear and the prices are fairly decent. I take in my reels to have bulk line put on. As long as you buy the line from them they put it on your reel for free. Makes it very convenient. Customer service is good and the staff is helpful.. willing to answer questions and offer tips. A+ in my book.

They recommend over $1,000 in dental work on me.  I brush every day sometimes two or three times, floss every other and see the dentist every 6 months. 
I got a second opinion. The second dentist and hygienist said this place was scamming me. 
Be very leary if they recommend a bunch of dental work.

Outstanding from the moment I called to get a reservation.  Last year my wife and I went to Paris for Thanksgiving.  We ate at great restaurants there.  None of them were as good as last night at Epi's.  Everything about this meal was 5+ stars.  The service was top notch from the moment we walked into the door -- Mark is that you? I am 1000 miles from home and never been to this place -- to the waiter who was a riot.  The food was amazing.  Mushroom soup, Halibut.. and then the best desert you can imagine.  Green Apple Bread Pudding.  The bottle of wine we had was awesome as well.  We have talked about dinner last night all day today.  Don't even think about missing this place.

I was in a desperate need for flowers for a funeral and pulled into Floral Creations at nearly the last minute. The time of my arrival was 3 PM and the Funeral Home viewing was at 5:30 PM that same day. The florist was eager to help me and showed me what she could do to satisfy my needs. They had the flowers at the showing and were absolutely beautiful. My thanks to them for helping me out so eagerly and with such beautiful results. PS: I know the floral business as I grew up with a Florist Mother who owned and operated her own business for many years. The folks at Floral Creations know very well how to satisfy their customers.

Meridian speedway. It's actually kind of fun!   We try to go to a few races every year.   We get a kick  out of the high school kids that race.  And it's even more fun watching the parents of the high school kids.  Tonight's races were  dominated by the girl drivers which we all thought was pretty cool.  They have some silly heat races that the kids really seem to enjoy.  And can't lie I think they are pretty entertaining as well. All and all its a good time to be had by everyone.   I will say it's a little redneck to drink beer out of a Tupperware pail...... But what the heck. :)

This is a great place to eat. Good prices, good bagels, great options, and plenty of snacks if you're on-the-go. We love coming here. We will continue to come back. 

However, I am concerned about the employee rights at this business. We have noticed the same staff member (who performs fantastic service and is an amazing employee) there at all times. We have been there early in the morning, in the late afternoon/evening, on the weekends both Saturday and Sunday, and he is always working. We've been visiting this business very regularly since it opened. We have never seen a different employee working there. I understand this may or may not be a family business, but it is not right to have an employee working 7 days a week at all hours of opening. I worry about the rights of the worker. I have conflicting feelings about continuing to support a business that treats its employees this way.
Huge portions of food.  We ordered brisket burned ends, pulled pork, salmon Caesar salad.  Everything was good.  Server ensured we were ok.

Don't go with a Paradigm Property!! Ugh-this management company is the WORST. First, they conveniently "lost" our rent twice, charged us late fees, and suddenly FOUND our rent check after we had anxiously paid the higher balance. Then we had toilet issues because the property is older, but not only did the maintenance tech NOT fix any problem, but WE got charged over $300 for the bill!! I have never been so disgusted with a landlord before. These people are scam artists!! Do more with your money by renting from a legitimate and professional company!

I was there on Saturday and when I got to the counter with an outdoor, clearance rug that  I had hauled around their store for an hour, matching up things and picking out the perfect items for my client, since I am a decorator.   A nice lady who was at the register said, " oh these aren't on clearance let me call my manager, Jim,"
Jim pranced his butt  up there and said "I will go look to see if these are on clearance". There's no way he could've looked so he called her on the radio and said "no those aren't on clearance " and they insinuated that I had switched  their tags so I went back to the 
Outdoor clearance  department only to find that he wasn't there, like he said he would meet me there, and every single rug in that department was marked down on clearance. I asked to go into his office to talk to him but he refused to do that so it became a yelling and screaming match- him yelling at me and me yelling at him. He even made a fist at me. I had a bad experience at Kohl's many months ago but I used to shop there only at Kohl's to the tune of over 50,000 a year. 
 I am a decorator and spend a large amount of money but I can tell you that I came home this time and cut my Kohls card and I will never ever step foot in their store again. Shame on you, Jim! Shame on Kohl's. Keep your rug ! . I've shared it all over social media. I'm still beyond upset!

Well, we waited a few months before giving them another shot. Sure enough, they let us down again.

The staff was rude to my husband who just wanted to watch to make sure they made our salads correctly, which of course they didn't. Accused him of holding up the line; it's an assembly line, so they couldn't make any other orders until they were done with ours anyway. When he explained why he was watching, they snarkily told him they were "properly trained" & he needed to quit holding up the line.

So disappointing. I doubt we'll be back to the Meridian location. At least they charged correctly this time. 

Oh & to whoever replied to my previous review, try reading & spell checking before you respond to your customers. I was already upset & not wanting to give you another chance before you replied with the wrong name.

Update: After I originally posted this review, someone from Zupa's went into their response to my first review to edit & correct the spelling of my name (thus making this review look like I was just overreacting or something). But no response to the current review. So much for caring about their customers.

I stopped by with the kids on a whim as I had seen Culver's a couple of times while driving in the area. The restaurant was clean for the most part. My interactions with the staff was lack luster. Definitely not service with a smile. We ordered the cod fish sandwich and a three piece cod fish meal. 

The food was delivered hot and appealing, however the meal was served with no utensils. I had to wait at the counter for assistance as there are no utensils available at the condiment kiosk. My kids said they enjoyed the sandwich, not the best but acceptable. My cod fish was flaky and moist. I really enjoyed. It comes with two sides and a roll. The sides were not so great. The slaw was drenched in mayonnaise and the quantity of fries was a small humorous portion. 

We took some chocolate custard on a cone to go and that was creamy and enjoyable on this warm afternoon. If I am in the area and craving fish or a cold snack I will definitely give them another try.
We all went home and puked our guts out. Their sides were good and the main dishes were ok but not great, especially for the price. By the time we all got home we got so sick. Never again!

This knock-off of the excellent Cineoplis Luxury Cinema concept is a big disappointment.  Mediocre seating, service, food and image quality.  It seems like they spent all their money on the lobby.  The loveseats are too close together and the side tables are tiny.  The waiter even forgot to bring us some of what we ordered.  The screen was fuzzy.  I have a better experience in my own home.  Save your money until someone builds a real premium cinema in the Treasure Valley.
Loved this salon! My 2 daughters and I went there for the first time & we will be back! Friendly clean loved their products! Had a pedi & can't wait to come back!

Use this florist at your own risk.

I spent a lot of time comparing the floral website offerings of several different florists and finally decided on Floral Creations Meridian.  I received an email that they could not provide the arrangement I had requested, and gave me a couple of options of what they could do - none of those options were refunding my money.  I hated one option and settled for the other, although disappointed.  I would never have purchased from this florist for the options provided.  The florist then sent the option I hated to the recipient, without contacting me first, and sent me an email excuse about why this was done only after the recipient sent me a picture of the arrangement she received which was NOT what I approved.  (The excuse was that the florist felt they were able to make the arrangement look nice without going with the more expensive flowers I had agreed to.)  I would never, ever, ever have knowingly purchased the arrangement that was sent.   That was almost a year ago, and since that time I have received numerous email solicitations from this florist.  Every time I "unsubscribe" and still I receive solicitations.  Seriously?  What does it take to get rid of this horrible florist?  This florist is high in arrogance and low in customer service.  Use at your own risk.

I ordered a centerpiece for Thanksgiving for my niece and family. I called and spoke with Marcia, she was super friendly and helped me choose a lovely arrangement that was the right size for my niece's table. 

I am always a little leery when ordering flowers online or over the phone. But talking to Marcia gave me a good feeling, and she did not disappoint - the flowers arrived on schedule, fresh and beautiful, as promised. And the price was very reasonable. 

Thank you Floral Creations for helping me send joy and love to the family I couldn't  be with in person on this special day.

The restaurant was full on a Wednesday night when we arrived at 8pm for (I believe) the last seating.  We had the croquetas, the baked cod, and the squid in ink.  

The salad and soup were nothing special/  I sort of agree with the reviewer who said the soup reminded him of canned beans, but again...no pretenses, I wouldn't even have minded if they were canned beans -- it's not the foo foo sort of place.

I'd say it is very good family style Basque food with no pretensions.  Even if I was just in town for a day and at the restaurant for the first time, I felt like I was having comfort food.  The croquetas were awesome, the fish soft and flaky in a really rich and creamy sauce, and the squid in ink was savory and not fishy (which is a worry when the ink is not fresh).

The owners were very warm and friendly,   I'd say it is a bit pricey, but the servings are huge.  We took the croquetas to our hotel because there was just too much for 2 people, and up to now we talk about how we should have flown them home to SF to eat, heh.
Great food and service. We definitely will be back. Great variety of options. Cannot wait to try something different next time

If I'm in the mood for hibachi steakhouse, I'm probably not coming here again. There chefs were great and talented, of course, but the food quality was pretty mediocre (sushi included). 

Also - the bathrooms were absolutely awful. The ladies room floor was as sticky as fly paper! No joke. And I thought maybe it felt sticky because of my shoes but as soon as I walked out of the restrooms, my shoes were not sticky. So it's legit just nasty inside there. 

A really random side note for parents... They don't have any milk option for kids. None. They'll squirt juice in your kid's face for laughs (adults get sake) but they can't offer any milk product after that. Not that it effected my star review, but it was... Odd. 

I don't know. It's a fine restaurant and it's a good addition to that side of town but man, I'm probably not likely to go back. :/

We got the managers special and ALL 5 of our buscuits had hair in them. We called to make sure they check all the other ones and they were very kind. Please check food if you order from this location.

Amazing margarita (the one named after the restaurant), great food, wonderful service, yummy chips, delicious Tamals. The kids loved the kids chicken burrito( chicken was tender) .. homemade tortillas. I truly love the margaritas. It is so hard to find a place that makes them not too sweet. 
The decor was bright and inviting. 
We went on Monday at 6 pm.

Yum, yum, yum!!! This place is amazing. Totally authentic and delicious. I live in downtown Boise, but I'll be a regular here. If I lived closer, I'd be here all the time. The cook really knows his stuff. His marinara sauce is just right. I don't know what spices he uses, but I love 'em. 

These folks just opened up in what was a different pizza place, and they are bringing their "A" game. Super nice folks who come around to your table to make sure you are enjoying your meal. I love it!

I see why this place gets bad ratings. Just moved here, took my dog in for allergy treatment. Got Dr. Reardon who didn't even introduce herself or ask why we where there. She was very condescending, rude, and lacked interpersonal skills. Will be seeking a better veterinarian elsewhere.

I had been here before several times over the years. This time was not a pleasant experience. I will NOT be going back nor will I refer anyone I know after the rude treatment I received. 

I was in the area and went in about noon on Friday and asked if they could take a walk in for a mani/pedi. There was only 1 customer finishing up with another tech, but my nail tech begrudgingly came out from the back to help. She acted annoyed with me from the beginning.  She was not friendly.

As she started my pedi she saw I had polish on my fingernails and asked if it was gel. I said no and she handed me a wad of acetone-soaked cotton and said "take it off." Seriously? I had to pay to take off my own regular polish myself? This was a treat for me and this attitude totally ruined it. But I took off my polish.

Then I looked at the swatches of gel polish and showed her the colors I wanted for my mani. After at least 20 minutes passed and finishing my toes she said "move over there" and didn't even look up or at me or provide direction as to which station she wanted me to move to. I went to grab the swatch to remind her of the colors I wanted and she snatched it from me and said "I know what colors you want" before I even said a word. And you know what? She painted the the wrong color and when I politely pointed it out I got even more attitude and mumbling how that's not the color I told her in the 1st place. 

At this point 2 regular clients had showed up and were with other techs. Their experience was entirely different than mine. They were greeted with a smile and politeness. When my nails were done the tech just got up without saying a word and greeted a client.  She then looked over her shoulder and told me my price to pay at the counter. 

This is by far the least enjoyable experience I've ever had. I will NOT be going back, and this had been my go to place for a few years whenever I wanted to treat myself. Save your money and go somewhere that will not only provide the service, but accompany it with an attitude that will contribute to the overall experience rather than ruin it.

We have traveled the world, and find that this restaurant is quite excellent in comparison with others for the price.  They offer a wonderful menu, and they listen carefully to their customer's requests.  The food is fresh and the price is super reasonable.  I highly recommend.

I'm not sure why this place has a 3 star review? The minute we walked in our waiter sat us down and got our drink order right away. Food was great , I got the steak quesadillas and a salad. I got to say the steak was awesome , great flavor !!!! I don't see why anyone would give it anything less than five stars!!
Some of the worst food that I've ever had. Your seafood is from a can. BOH needs to learn how to season food. The only redemption is a decent FOH person.

I would love to leave a review on the food but we sat in there for a good 15min. And never got served. Not even water! No one greated us. When you have to get up to ask for service and still no one comes by.. Wow! So out the door we went!

Stayed at the hotel beside here. I have eaten at beefs before since I am an east coaster so I know what to expect. 

They have on of the best grilled chicken salads I have ever eaten. I had their Italian dressing which is also very good.  3 stars for the food. 

0 stars for the service. Unfriendly staff, unorganized, and long wait to get my food. Even longer wait to get a refill on my drink and the check. I am convinced I was forgotten about. 

I are here 3 times this week because of convenience and after the first 2 experiences in house I took the last meal back to the room.

My favorite Thai restaurant in Boise/Meridian! We went on a Friday evening and the place was packed. I ordered the Drunken Noodles and my Husband ordered some sort of duck dish. Both were excellent! Would highly recommend. Great customer service and atmosphere!

This place is amazing!! We love every one that works here. They will also get you in for emergencies rather then turn you away. I have always been terrified of going to the dentist but this place makes me so comfortable from the moment I walk in the office. 

The billing part of the office is always on top of it. If you are looking for a new dental office I highly recommend this place!

We came to eat dinner here on a Wednesday night and it was about 5:15 PM. They were very busy seems that they had an unexpected group of young boys about 15 to 20 of them and that backed up the kitchen so everyone had to wait for their food. I had a ribeye steak was cooked good tasted good I also had a garden salad which was good one of us had baby back ribs that were tender another of us had a baby back rib plate that was tough. The smashed potatoes were not what we expected they were basically mashed potatoes that they served with white gravy. The servers took my empty soda class and never returned with the refill. Hit and miss at this place. Please could be kind of pricey

I ordered my Spyderco online at 1:30 on a Friday and I had received it in Chicagoland by 3:00 on Monday, all with free shipping and quick responses to all my questions in email. I had also looked up local Spyderco dealers, but I would've paid a lot more for the same knife locally. I'm glad I bought from this vendor. Oh, and the thing about the Tootsie Pops is real. I also got a Stay Sharp sticker.

By far, in my opinion, the best Indian restaurant in the valley.  This is not the first time I've been here and won't the be last.  The garlic naan is crispy on one side and tender on the other... buttery, garlic deliciousness!  How is that a bad thing?  Then the entrées, lamb Korma for me and  Lamb vindaloo for my husband.  The portions are plenty and we always have leftovers for my husbands lunch the next day.  The service is always welcoming and friendly.  If you like Indian food this is the place to go!

The food was typical & what you expect at Pizza Hut, & was prepared quickly enough. Our waitress was friendly & tried to do her job well, though it would have been nice not to sit next to the only other party in the whole restaurant. 
What was appalling was the filthiness of the dining room. Garbage & food crumbs were all over the floor. I won't describe the uncleanliness of the bathroom, but it's safe to say you wouldn't want to go in there. 
This was the second visit in 2 months, & the first experience wasn't much better.

6:00 on a Friday night... no line.  We left at 7:00, still no line.  I figure it's the location more than the food.

I'm not into BBQ so I ordered the bacon burger and steak fries.  The bacon was a little small and chewy, (I prefer crispy) but it had an excellent flavor!  Hubby had BBQ brisket and said it 'impressed' him.  I usually don't rave over restaurant fries, but these were just perfect with nice thick ketchup.

We had good servers, and had a party of 30 not been placed right next to us (very loud) we would have had an outstanding date night.  Goodwood realized how difficult it was for us to have a normal conversation, so nicely then gave us drinks and dessert free.  They didn't have to do that.  I told them it wasn't as bad as Texas Roadhouse as far as noise... but the boss lady insisted.

Had the chocolate sheet cake a la mode.  The ice cream was SO cold that I could barely put it in my mouth without my teeth aching.  The chocolate tasted very nice and I was happy it was fluffy and warm as opposed to cold and hard.  However the bottom layer was a bit too sticky so I just ate the top layer.

I asked that my burger not be pink inside and it was cooked just right.  No pink but not overcooked on the outside.

Sweet and spicy BBQ sauce was hot.  Sweet and sassy was OK, but didn't really have a true BBQ flavor.

The atmosphere was nice and clean, walls painted dark, booth was comfortable.  We will go here again.

This restaurant needs to narrow down the type of cuisine it specializes on. Their menu has a very wide variety of everything, so it's hard to decide. 
Portions are small compared to other Japanese/Sushi restaurants. 
The place is beautiful, but sometimes it seems unmanageable. 
I still haven't decided if I like it or not, I just know it's not one of my favorites in the area, especially considering the prices. 
I'd rather go to Kona Grill and eat better and more.

First time I have eaten here. I had the sashimi and miso soup. Both were very good. The sashimi was artfully prepared and presented. The atmosphere is very relaxed, you don't feel rushed at all. I had a chance to sit, talk, and have a drink with the owner, Ryan, which made my meal even more enjoyable. The green tea tiramisu for dessert was a perfect culmination to the meal. Highly recommended. An excellent addition to the Japanese cuisine in Boise.
Best Thai food in Boise. Better than Pad Thai. Consistency of food and service is amazing.

Ashley Furniture knowingly sells a fraudulent protection plan called "Montage Furniture Protection." We paid 280$ for this service because as its explained at time of purchase, "If you spill and can't clean it, they'll send someone out to clean it. If that person cannot get the stain out they'll replace it free of charge." Sounds great and totally worth it. In reality Montage will deny claims for nearly ANYTHING. My stain occurred when my 76 year old aunt was visiting and she spilled butter on the couch. She tried to clean it with upholstery cleaner. They denied the claim because "she tried to clean it!" I personally will never buy from them again because when I called them to tell them they clearly knew and didn't care. They get some kickback that makes scamming their clients worth it to them. I wouldn't give people like that my money voluntarily ever!!

Goodwood has always been a place that is consistent in service and in quality.  I took some clients here for lunch and we ordered 3 lunch specials with burnt ends and I upgraded to some ribs.  Their sides were terrific as we had the sweet potatoes and some fries.  The server was nice, helpful and friendly.  Everything came out as we expected and we all really enjoyed our lunch.

The restaurant itself is decorated nicely with beautiful wood ceilings.  Restrooms were clean. All in all, a really great place for a consistent lunch or dinner.  I have ordered their wings on a different occasion and really enjoy them.

I took my wife out for Birthday drinks we had great time love their card system so we can pick our sample or 1/2 glass or full glasses. You go up to different units and serve yourself no waiting. Didn't get any food but the people next to us said they foods good.

We ordered from Grub Hub and they got here in great time. Unfortunately, there were issues with the food. When we called to let them know that they left an entire side off of our order and forgot the sauce that the menu very clearly showed it included, they did not apologize or offer a solution to fix the problem. The manager I spoke with, Danielle, was impolite and unhelpful. After paying $20 to have grubhub deliver, my husband had to drive to the restaurant to pick up the missing items from our order. I had cold fish and chips. I would also stay away from the clam-chowder, unless you like sipping warm water with chunks.  I would never eat there or order from them again. The food is not worth the price and the service is terrible. Save your money and your nice evening, don't eat at Beef O Brady's.
Best atmosphere for sushi and hibachi in the Treasure Valley. Delicious, fresh sushi and very friendly staff. Never disappoints.

I am going to keep this short because Ophelia really summed up the entire experience in a way I cannot outdo, and throwing more fluffy language at this amazing restaurant isn't going to increase its rating from 5 to 6 stars. If I could give 6 stars, I would. This is the most amazing Basque dining experience and food that can be had short of traveling to Spain. The food is amazing, it is certainly worth the wait, it is worth the long dinner progression. Make a reservation, enjoy an authentic experience, and walk away with a giant smile on your face.
Delicious! Surpassed expectations! Ben was an excellent server! Food was amazing. Best Thai place!

The worst service food took an hour to get an then the food is cold the waiter was trying to take care of phones while the bartender visited with people and had a shot with them. I am very unhappy with this overall establishment.

I wanted to like this place. I'd heard good things about them. The nicest part was the location and the decor. The waiter was aloof and didn't seem really friendly. The food was fairly bland overall. 

Too bad.

Ordered a 5 piece combo, waited 10 minutes for it and when I get home it's a box full of just biscuits. This place is the worst when it comes to customer service and have fucked up my order multiple times. Don't usually leave reviews but this place sucks. Please hire people who give a fuck
Carne Asada meat quality is ehh but over all good for the price. Only thing that sucked was they forgot to put my onions and cilantro inside my burrito.

They spelt my name wrong and the cashier was very rude. I asked for no tomatoes and I kindly said of that's not possible it's ok. She rudely said I can do it. Not great customer service. I worked at Burger King I know how frustrating it can be but I still stayed humble

I honestly want to love this place the food taste yummy however it is so expensive for a bagel shop. A bagel sandwich with a chocolate milk and a side of cream cheese is $10. I can go to a restaurant and get a whole meal for that or go to a restaurant and get a bagel sandwich plus other food for that price. We used to come here every Sunday before church and it started out great and then each visit it just kept getting more expensive even though we were ordering the same thing so we stopped coming. Four months later we decided to go back and try it again and the food was very yummy however I cannot stand paying that much for a bagel sandwich. If the prices were better would probably either at least once a week.

Sprint is by far the worse cell phone service ever! 
If your ok with never having service then this service is for you. I don't think I've ever seen all the bars on my service bar before. At the most there's 3 bars.
Boise, meridian, Caldwell, Nampa. I've worked all around and I never have service, constantly dropping calls. Constantly going to 3g or just no service all together. 
I'm telling you people there cheap bill isn't worth it. You may as well not even have a phone if you get sprint.. paying for something that never works. 
And the best part is when you call to try and get it fixed and they tell me to go buy a cell phone booster. 
Like are you serious!! I have to go buy a booster to get more then 2 bars!
If you have ever read a review and thought hmm I'd like to find out for myself, then this review is for you, 
Don't do it!!
Run! 
Run to another company!!

Ps. The people at sprint are usually very nice and especially at this location. Unfortunately they work for a terrible company. 
(This review does not reflect on the people at this location) 

THE PHOTO I ATTACHED SHOWS WHAT SPRINT IS LIKE AS IM WRITING THIS REVIEW!! Look at the service bars in the picture, Hahaha wow ‍

Very cool theater! I used to live in California and all the movie theaters in that area had reclining seats. I was spoiled. When I moved here I was bummed that Boise's Edwards theaters did not have the luxury seats. But I knew I had to check out the Village Cinema! What was even cooler than the lounge seats was that they have a 21+ balcony where you can order drinks, and even food (salads, burgers, sandwiches, flatbreads, etc.) Dinner & a movie right in a comfortable lounge chair...can't wait to go back!

There are many places to buy a mattress, this should not be on your list.  They lied to me about the previous mattress I purchased and then I believed them when they said I had to upgrade or else.  So I did what the store manager required me to do.  I ended up with no refund, no exchange and a used dirty mattress.

Go to a nice local store that cares about your business.  You will be so happy if you have any problems. 

Good luck.
I love Thai food, I've even been to Thailand this by far has been my favorite chicken green curry I've had!

They are a small family-owned restaurant, which I like a lot. The prices are not bad at all. You get a lot for what you get. This is a nice friendly place to go if you need a quick bite that's also tasty. They aren't too busy yet, so you're spoiled as you have the waiters to yourself. It's a small place, hopefully one day they can get a bigger place. Their old location in Boise burned down, so they're still recovering from that. We love eating here. Take-out option is always good.

What a wonderful experience!  From the moment I contacted this office on the phone to leaving the office from my first appointment today, I am totally impressed, my jaw is on the floor and no I don't have an issue with my jaw, its just there because of the incredible experience I just had.  What I am most impressed with is the thorough job the staff and doctors do explaining things.  I now have a wealth of knowledge about my teeth and mouth.  They informed me and coached me, talked about what I can do to overcome some issues I have and detailed what I could expect.  They took the time with me that no one ever has.  I felt genuinely cared about and knew after this first visit that I really am in the best of care...anywhere...in any state...in the whole world for that matter. Yes, I am that impressed.  Kari at the front desk greeted me with a handshake and a smile, Lindsay was professional and so nice, not to mention very upbeat.  Dr Grant looked at the issues I was having and put me at ease.  Dr Porter looked at some receeding gums I have and we all came up with a plan.  I love a plan and now I have a team that cares so much, takes the time, is professional, kind and rolls out the red carpet.  I dare you not to have a jaw dropping experience!
One of the best meals I've had in Boise. I lived in Spain for a long time and I know good Spanish food. This is it. Period.  Plus the owner (Chris) treats you like family. It's pricy, but worth it.
This place is really good. Buffet is a great choice for people new to Indian cuisine.

So....another sandwich place on Eagle road. Ooooooooooooooo.... Like another Mexican restaurant in Caldwell.  

To the surprise of my wife and I. ..this place stands out. You pay a little more,  but you get more...fresh...delicious. ..."sit down" restaurant quality food.  It's fast food, but only in the sense of how long it takes to get it. 

If your idea of "eat fresh" is Subway....you probably will think this place is pricey. 

You can't make chicken soup from chicken sh*t.

Had a great first visit to Blue Tiger Pizza in Meridian, Idaho! The rose cider was delish and my dining companion and I enjoyed the Baked Goat Cheese appetizer. We followed up with a Margherita pizza that was crisp, hot, fresh and tasty with just the right balance of toppings. We enjoyed chatting with the owner, Dylan, and met his charming mother who was lending a hand that evening. Stylish, on-trend, cozy and clean, I look forward to many return visits and recommend Blue Tiger Pizza very highly!

We love this place! We eat here in the restaurant when we can- they have a small but decent sized main room. There is a huge fish tank the kids love, and the lighting and atmosphere are casual but on the upper end. Service is always friendly. Plan on a more leisurely pace for your meal, which does make it more challenging with the kids.

Our more usual way to enjoy their food is by pick up- this is our go to for a small "date night" at home after the kids go down! 

We love the Pad Kro Pao, and the red chicken curry is awesome. We never miss the Tom Yum soup (get the pot!) and the salad is super simple but we love the ginger dressing and ask for extra! We have had a number of the other dishes over time and enjoy most of them (we actually got fried rice for the first time last visit and enjoyed it) but we did it at all enjoy their "house duck". It was super stringy, full of inedible fat and a waste of time and money for us. We love duck, but even the sauce was overly sweet and we tossed most of the dish sadly. Other than that we have enjoyed everything. 

We order medium and mild flavors in one meal to
Mix it up (we ordered all medium one time- more power to you if you are good but for us it is... a bit much lol!).  Generally the soup we order mild and everything else we split between mild and medium, and they graciously give us extra chili oil to spice up things where we want! That is the way to do it!

They are fast, amazingly friendly and offer great, consistent food. I love eating there but our hectic lives mean we take our date nights where we can so take out is more normal! 

Side note- both our (young) kids love the Tom Yum soup, and the salad. They also love the curry and Pad Kra Poa as well as the noodle Dishes we've gotten. One loves medium heat and kills it, and the other prefers the more mild, but both love eating here and get excited to do so. 

It's pricey for a "normal" night out for a family of four but they get super excited to go for a special night out!

I ate here a few days ago in the noon hour. I thought it wasn't very busy when I first walked in...but then the rush walked in..huge line! 
I did the combo with half a salad and a sandwich. 
BBQ chicken salad - half size was quite large! My kind of salad, but nothing special above and beyond every other BBQ chicken salad I've had.
Ultimate grilled cheese - wonderful! I could live without the tomatoes in it but it was great. The pesto along with the three cheeses paired well. 
The salad came with a slice of baguette...it was nothing special, just plain blah bread.
Any entree comes with a chocolate covered strawberry - such a nice touch! It was small but yummy! They also have some gourmet brownies near the register that look to die for...I'll definitely be having one next time!
Excellent buffet selection for only $9.99 I feel like I was at an Indian persons home. Delicious home cook feel meal. Will be back!  Lots of choices for gluten free or dairy free & vegetarian.

We received a letter and check for only a portion of our deposit. No one responded to our phone calls or messages to complete a final walk-through of the house after we moved out and we paid to have it cleaned. Paradigm illegally charged for: cleaning (we hired and paid a cleaner), light bulbs (we specifically walked the property and made sure there were no bulbs out), wall patching (we used the existing nails, etc. to hang from; otherwise all wall damage was existing), smoke detector batteries (There were no smoke detectors beeping), and furnace filters (we had just replaced these). We have reported Paradigm to the Better Business Bureau and received an email back that they would look into it. That was 10 days ago and still no response. We truly cannot understand how Paradigm stays in business. We still have emails requesting repairs from when we first signed our lease and nothing got fixed the entire year we lived there. I would not rent a home if Paradigm is the property management company.

We've been looking for authentic, delicious, flavorful Mexican food for quite some time and we found it here.  The chili verde was the best I've ever had and the carnitas was equally delicious.  I sometimes judge a Mexican restaurant by the quality of the margarita and it did not disappoint.  It was definitely 5 star.  Service was wonderful!  I would highly recommend!

Huge mistake by asking Cacicia's Old World Sicilian food to help us cater our wedding (food truck). First, it was an embarrassment to me, as the bride, to have our guests complain that the food was cold, the meatballs were  were dry, and the portion sizes were small.  I tasted the food, and it was meh... ok at best. This was a terrible letdown, especially for the $10 per plate that they charged. Pretty disappointed - especially on such a big and great day that I will cherish forever! I will say that the company showed up on time and had food ready - the only two good points. 

The biggest frustration is the company's ETHICS. They overcharged us by over 100 plates (more than $1,000) - they did not count the individuals that they served, but took the lazy way out and guessed based on the number of plates in the box. Kicker is - we had both dinner and cake plates in the box so the actual number of plates in the box was half of what they thought. Cacicia's owners and staff just looked at the box and said that they served 160 people. We had 125 guests... either they stole our money or they served on used/dirty plates over 3 times per person. (We had another caterer on site as well.) We rightfully paid them not knowing about their mistake. They admit that the number was off BUT because of their "stellar" food and hard work, they will not refund our hard earned money. They also pointed the finger at another company from the Boise community - talk about a dirty move. 

To be honest, if their food was fantastic (hypothetical), but they endorsed and promoted fraudulent behavior... I would stay away no matter what. No good food is worth that. This could have been a great company and I urge them to be ethical and honest with their customers. We only want the highest of those qualities in our community. 

P.S. They are selling their food truck - wonder why?

This place had awesome food and the awesome service made it even better! My friends and I love the mixed rolls option and this may sound gross but the salmon skin salad was surprisingly good. Good proces for the fresh portions.

The pad Thai wasn't as good as some other Thai places and the service was slow. But the other dishes we ordered were amazing! I would highly recommend their Penang curry, drucken noodles and chicken lettuce wraps.

Well the seating was something to be desired. The bar area only had a few stools. The reception area was very small. It took 45 minutes to be seated. With no where to sit and wait really. Normal this isn't a problem I will seat at bar. But as I said before it was rather small and full. Now the staff was great. The waitressed was excellent answered all of our questions gave us ideas made suggestions. The food was rather good I wouldn't put it in a five star maybe a 3 1/2. The cook cooks my wife's steak well done when she requested medium rare I asked for rare and got a little bit better than medium rare. Our sides are excellent the salad I chose Tedd bacon on it and I was giving extra bacon without an extra charge which is always awesome. The alcohol prices were reasonable. Would I go back, maybe. There are other restaurants in the area that serve almost identical items especially steak and I found better prices and better steak nearby but as I said before the service was excellent I just think this restaurant would do a lot better if it had a larger bar area and a reasonable sized reception area.

Great place to put your feet up and watch a movie. The upper seat selections feature incliner chairs and pivoting tables to make you feel comfortable. The seats are all pre-selected by you when you purchase your ticket, so you can sit where you want.
This is one theater that knows how to keep the AC on during the summer. If you get cold easily, bring a blanket.

Went in couple of weeks ago(thought i did this review), and decided to try something I've never had I got the honey roasted duck. The first initial bite was good the flavor Asian wise seemed very mild could not describe what was used in the flavoring but it was nice. think I would like it on chicken as well. The duck itself as a very unusual texture similar to chicken thigh but not. It took me a little while of eating it to determine that flavor-wise it was very good, texture wise, don't like it. do not know if I will go try it anywhere else. The white steamed rice that came with it was cooked just right nice and sticky but not mushy. I also tried a glass of the plum wine they have. that was very good not sweet but crisp with slight tang. would like to buy that to keep at home. I will definitely go back again to try something else on the menu.

Are you looking for a great PCP/GP?  I recently had my first appointment with Dr. Partridge at Treasure Valley Family Medicine and he is a rare gem. There are actually 2 doctors there and they "offer you the missing ingredient to great health care - comprehensive primary care grounded in a personal relationship."
I  am here to tell you that it isn't a bunch of lip service. 
They block out an entire hour for your first appointment. Instead of filling out a bunch of forms they gather your history verbally and ask questions when appropriate. Not once was I cut off mid sentence, not once did I feel like I was a bother and just another patient, and not once was I condescended to. He listened and talked with me and got to know ME!  Not only that, but he is very knowledgable and did not brush off MY KNOWLEDGE about my condition.
I strongly recommend TVFM!

While visiting the Meridian area, Cafe Zupas was recommended as a place I would enjoy. After visiting, that is definitely true. For $8.95, the combo is ideal for lunch. You can choose two items (salad, sandwich, or soup) and you get a chocolate dipped strawberry for dessert. I had the Turkey, Bacon, Avocado Panini and Chicken Enchilada Chili. Everything was delicious! I also treated my family and they enjoyed their sandwiches and soups immensely. I will definitely visit again when I'm back in the area.

FYI...this location is SUPER busy at lunchtime, so I recommend coming before or after the lunch crowd (or have a friend scope out a table while you order).

The only issue I see at Cafe Zupas is that you order at the beginning and then you have to repeat your order at the end to the cashier. That is problematic if you are ordering for numerous people because you have to remember everything at the end. It would be better if they wrote down your order or typed it into an iPad and gave you a number. Other than that, everything is great!

We popped in at 7:15 on a Thursday. They were steady but we were greeted and seated with no waiting. The hostess was very friendly. Our server showed up promptly to greet  us and take our drink orders. Which were back within moments. My wife and I both had the 2 meat combos. She had the smoked Turkey and brisket with coleslaw and fries. I had pulled pork and smoked sausage with baked beans and fries. I wont go.into too much detail about the food because  you need to, experience It for yourself but everything was fantastic! While not the best barbeque we've ever had......it was pretty darn good. And the service was impeccable. Our server never let our sweet teas run dry. yes, that's right fo those of us southerners they do have sweet tea. If you're in the Boise/meridan area and are looking for good barbeque at reasonable prices with excellent service you have to try Goodwood!

This place is amazing!! We love every one that works here. They will also get you in for emergencies rather then turn you away. I have always been terrified of going to the dentist but this place makes me so comfortable from the moment I walk in the door.

This airport taxi company has been great for me! When I call them, they always answer no matter what time of day or night. It's so hard to know which taxi companies are legit nowadays. I've had some bad drivers before that smell like smoke and their car is dirty and the attitude is just plain rude. I've had pretty terrible experiences with taxi cabs being late or just not showing up. I think I finally found the perfect taxi company to take care of me. What I like especially is that it's always the same driver that I'm comfortable with now. He knows when to talk and when to leave me alone. His car is so clean inside and out as well as the driver himself and how he dresses. You don't see very many taxi drivers that take care of their appearance. Some even stay the night in their cars I've noticed from the strong odor they have. Anyways I won't bore you guys anymore but this should say enough on how much I liked this guy. He's the man!

The food itself is tasty and the restaurant has been clean every time I've been there. There is a really cute bar and the decor and general ambience is relaxed. The service can be a tad slow at times so don't come if you are in a rush or anything but the service is also very friendly and gracious.

Wow! In the years I've been going to the dentist, this was my the first place that was thorough! From the warm welcome when you walk in, meeting with Starla to talk about the office philosophy in how they approach dental treatments to the Dental Assistant, the Hygenist and Dr. Smith, the level of customer care is phenomenal! I'm bringing my entire family here and will tell friends. Their office is further than I thought prior to scheduling BUT so glad it didn't stop me from going. Oh by the way, I made the appointment yesterday for and an appointment today- last night I got a call from one of the Dentist introducing himself and is looking forward to my visit! REALLY? When was the last time you got a call from a Dentist to introduce themselves? Me, NEVER. 

If you're looking for a better dental experience, you owe it to yourself to try this office! You will not be disappointed.

All I can say is WOW!!!! Anna is AMAZING!! Needed a last minute appointment for my two daughters and myself. We just moved here and haven't had our brows touched for almost two months. She got us in and my brows look like the have been microbladed amazing. She has a customer for life.

Love Bodovino at The Village! The customer service is always top notch, the selection of wine is great, and the atmosphere is always satisfying. On my last visit, Larry went above and beyond to make sure we all had the perfect glass of wine and that we were well taken care of. Every visit has been great, but this one in particular was exceptional.

This place is fabulous. Be sure to call ahead and make a reservation. I had the mushroom cream soup which was the best mushroom soup I've had to date. Loved the garlicky flavor profile with a slightly spicy finish. My BF got the bean soup and it was a bit bland, which was surprising since literally all the other items we ordered were incredible. Not sure what happened to the bean soup. The croquets were SO good! Creamy and crunchy and well, the best. We also ordered the crusted halibut with lobster sauce and the lamb shank. All fabulous. Looking forward to returning.

We just moved here and were in desperate need of new furniture. I went in and was greeted right away. They guy was very nice and listened to my wants and needs. I made the mistake of showing him my approval amount for the credit card as I did not want to spend that much and sure enough my card is maxed out and then some! The sales guy was in no way pushy , I didn't feel pressured by him at all. My husband didn't like the cheaper set I originally chose because it was firm and the recliner was too small for our larger American physique! We are planning to buy a new home soon and didn't want to push our income to debt ratio. We love the new set the guys brought it quicker than expected and were in and out in no time! We would definitely be back again but next time I think the husband and I need to be on the same page 1st!

Love Epi's! It's so tough to get in but that's because they are THAT good! It's a family atmosphere with staff that truly care about the customer experience. The food is always so incredibly good! Prices are decent and the variety should fit most taste buds. I highly recommend trying Epi's! Call ahead and get reservations or check on the wait times!
If that girl behind the counter flips her stupid hair one more time I will call the health department myself. Waiting for pickup 30 minutes is unacceptable. I won't be back.

Don't understand why fast food employees want $15.00 an hr when they cant get your order correct. Went in today ordered 2 of the Mc Doubles with no onions well got back to work Yep they had onions and I am allergic to them no lunch for me today. Another thing how do you run out of soda there was a sign saying they only have Fanta orange Fruit Punch and tea well that wasn't true.

I get my nails done by Heather and she is always busy but fits me in her schedule even in a hurry. I love the way she does my nails fast and I always get so many compliments! The girls that work the front desk are sweethearts and I would recommend always having an appointment to ensure you can get in and out in a timely manner. No complaints!!

i wish yelp let me just leave the stars rating and be done with it. the idea of having to explain it is a little painful. oh well.

this place is solidly mediocre. the menu is all over the place (japanese, thai, indian, chinese). we ordered the eel sushi, and teriyaki, figuring that was the safest bet. it was passable. that's about the highest praise i can give. the salad was awash in mayonnaise-based dressing. there was a pool of it at the bottom of my bowl at the point i abandoned it.

the music is horrid pop, the decor is an attempt at 1980s upscale chinese hotel--with the fancy lit bar at the center of the restaurant, while the view out the window is of inadequate amounts of gravel covering tufts of landscape fabric, dead and live weeds, lots of ugly black irrigation tubing, and cracked and streaked stucco. nice.

for the record, what they call "hibachi" is actually "tepanyaki." that they confuse the two shouldn't surprise me, and doesn't.

Where do I start. I feel like we were just invited into a good friends home and served the most delicious home cooked meal. All of the food is made with love and is simply delicious. All I can say is, come hungry. 

We had to try the Croquettes which did not disappoint and the serving was generous, about a dozen. Entrees are served with soup, bread, salad and sides, the sides are predetermined for the night. Tonight's was a rice aide very similar to paella but without the seafood and oven fries which by the way were impressively addictive. My husband ordered the lamb chops and was very content with his order. I ordered the Special of the night which was scallops in a wine butter lemon sauce with mushrooms and sun-dried tomato. I couldn't stop soaking up the sauce with bread, it was so good. Prior to our mains we had the soup, the red bean soup was so comforting and satisfying. The mushroom soup was equally as good. The dressing on the salad was so good. If I could buy it by the bottle I would. 


We were so full and content that the idea of dessert seemed impossible...until our waiter kindly suggested we could take it home. Obviously I jumped at the opportunity and ordered the Gasteau Basque, a citrus pudding cake with fresh raspberry sauce. I haven't made enough room to dive in just yet but I won't be long and I can only assume it won't disappoint after the meal we just enjoyed. 

Can't wait to come back. The service is stellar and Chris is just the sweetest. Like a long lost dear friend welcoming you back.

Their lunch buffet is a deal at $9.99.  On a Friday around 12:15, there was ample seating.  Almost everything we had was delicious.  The vegetarian offerings are slim, but they do have a few options . Most of the entrees were chicken or lamb.  Furthermore, one of our coworkers, who is originally from India, commented that Spice has the tastiest and most authentic Indian food in the Boise area.  I don't doubt it.

Worst movie theater going experience because I can't get reception on my phone because My LTE coverage in Meridian is spotty. And the tickets are super overpriced. Edwards Boise stadium 22 and IMAX is the best theater that beats Village Cinema.

I moved here from California 4 years ago, so my standards for Mexican food is a little high. Today my husband and I tried El Gallo Giró and we fell in love. Their chili verde tastes homemade and their fajitas were delicious! If you are looking for amazing and authentic Mexican food you have to try them out.

This place was disgusting. The people that worked here were asses. Garbage on the floor and also there was a toddler throwing a fit and screaming its head off and no body said a damn word.  This carried on for 15 damn minutes. I am never coming back here again.
The people here gave me dirty looks. I asked for soup and it was cold. I told them i want the soup hot and they said that they don't have hot soup. So i asked for her to heat it up in the microwave and she said she couldn't and i asked why. She said no because the manager can only use it. So i asked for the manager and she said there was not one there today.

I had heard great things about Zupas, but am now gravely disappointed.  The soup and sandwich combo were tasty.  Unfortunately about an hour after eating here, I felt sick to my stomach.  That lasted for hours.  It took too long for my sandwich to be made while the rest of my party enjoyed their similar choices.  Grossly overpriced as well.  I guess that I should have asked for a refund when my sandwich arrived, and the lame excuse for the delay was, "OOPS, we burned the first one, so we thought we should make you another."  The other 3 in our party did not get bad food and poor service, so was I singled out for some reason?  I have no tolerance for incompetence, especially when on a tight lunch schedule.

I stop in here all the time for lunch - there aren't very many places around besides this one where you can get a couple quick (and totally delicious) slices of pizza and a coke and get back to work. The food has been great every time (excellent crust and sauce especially) and Joe and his staff are very friendly and mix in good conversation while doing their thing. I haven't had dinner here yet, but the Steak & Dandelions is definitely on my to-do list!

There were 5 dirty tables,  2 signature drinks were empty and there was maybe 8 people in the place.  All kids,  didn't see an adult.  Guess they can't keep up with cleaning and refilling.  Pathetic!!
Johnnys is delicious! Its our favorite spot in Meridian. One word CALZONE! You will not be disappointed I promise

Loved this place!  We were in Idaho for a few days went here each night.  The service the vibe the experience all top of the line.  Felt Five star.  Will be back again.  Thank you for the amazing food and drinks.  So good.

Worst place to get your nails done. Went in and waited for 30 plus minutes.  The lady was very rude and rushed through my manicure. Cut my cuticle and kept on going the gel polish looked like my 5 year old did  it and when I told her I wasn't happy with my nails she said oh well.... Horrible customer service...

As much as I love and will forever support PP. I will never return for any services thanks to Tony. Not even Dr. Tony. She's a very unprofessional nurse. Tony walked into the exam room without even knocking. She looked like she just got out of bed. Not even a lab coat on. Very unprofessional looking. She wasnt even in the room with me for five minutes. She gave me no warning of inserting the thing in my cervix. She didnt even apologize when I told her that it hurt. She said my problem was wrinkles "happens with age" in a very condescending way. Then she pretty much told me to leave cause there was nothing wrong. She made me feel stupid, embarrassed, unhappy, frustrated, needing a 2nd opinion cause I was even more confused than when I went in AND I was sore for HOURS afterwards!!!!! . Never again am i returning.

My wife and I travel the country enjoying sights, people, and food.  Our travels this summer brought us to Meridian UT and Epi's.  From the greeting by Chris the wonderfully gracious owner to the final sip of coffee after consuming every bite of my flana everything was superb!!  The Butterfish special paired perfectly with the Albariño.  The quality of ingredients paired perfectly with the chef's steady hands.  As we continue our journey we will seek reason to put Epi's on our "must return" list.

By far the best Vet I have ever used. I have a 13 year old German Shorthaired Pointer who has seen many vets in her day. I highly recommend this place! Dr. Ormond took his time and made us feel like valued clients. Clean friendly office staff who were full of smiles. Will be our permanent vet.

Love love love Goodwood!!!! The ribs, the onion rings, the pulled pork. ..oooohhh the pulled pork!!!! The staff are awesome and the atmosphere is very nice yet casual too. The worse part is waiting for the food while the smell odd meat surrounds you lol.

I don't know if I've mentioned it but I really love the old style theaters. I love these grand, ornate reminders of the past when people would dress up to go out.
