When dinner or a movie was an occasion. This theater is an achievement in itself by bringing back the past with all the modern-day conveniences.

They have restaurants and bars enough for every taste very close. They will bring you food and drink in your seat in the theater. They have many choices for screen sizes and seating. So there's something for everyone. And believe it or not their prices are reasonable. Enjoy your show!
I  Had lunch at goodwood barbecue today! Not only was the food amazing as usual but the service from Darian with spectacular!! Thank you so much for the goodwood experience. Be back soon!!!

I would avoid this place if at all possible.  The staff is rude and they don't have any information regarding alcohol and jumping.  My wife and I came here for our grandsons birthday party.  We arrived an hour early and ordered a glass of wine.  When the party started we went to pay for an hour of jump time.  They would not allow it because we purchased alcohol.  I can understand not allowing intoxicating patrons but two grown adults that had a glass of wine an hour before the party???   There are no signs referencing this issue.   We would not have purchase adult beverages had we known this was a policy.   I will be complaining to corporate in the morning!

Food was excellent but it couldn't make up for the terrible service.  25 minutes to get a beer, had to ask to refill water glasses, never cleared the dishes!  
When we discussed with manager, she was not customer oriented !  The coupons in the paper won't save this place !

We love this theatre. It's comfy and I like not having to get there super early to get a seat for popular shows. The coffee bar made me a delicious treat and I've been able to take in food from other Village restaurants no problem. We go once a week!
Excellent service and a amazing happy hour 3-6 half off of all alcohol & sushi rolls.

We were up for some adventure with food we don't typically eat. Spice Indian Cuisine was recommended to us by a coworker. It was delicious! I enjoyed the shrimp masala with a mango lassi drink. They serve the food to the table in fun silver bowls so you put the food on your own plate which is also perfect for sharing.

We have eaten here several times now.  I was wowed the first few times.  It is quaint and friendly but last time (and every time) our entrees were nothing to brag about.  I spent $32 on dry, awful Halibut.  Surely it was frozen.   My wife had scallops that were in a very unremarkable sauce.  Of course the salad is a small bowl of iceburg lettuce.  Bread is very good and wine selection small but very good.  To me it is not worth it.
I doubt we will visit there for a while but hardly think our opinion will impact the restaurant.  Clean place, great service, and overrated IMHO.
Its cool, but new seats suck! They barely recline and are not comfortable! Majestic is better!

I usually don't leave reviews but I want to share our amazing experience with Dr. Piper and his assistant and the hygienist. My husband has had very bad experiences that creates high anxiety at the dentist. Dr. Piper gave him an evaluation for a pain my husband was having in his tooth.  From the first day my husband felt comfortable with him. Dr. Piper and his staff are very understanding and did all they could to make him comfortable for his procedure. Today, my husband "slept" for his visit. He did the IV. He had a deep cleaning a crown put in and an extraction. It is the night of and he is doing great. No nausea. We are very thankful to have a good experience! Thank you so much!

Very disappointed in management. We have family visiting from out of town and wanted to take them somewhere different than a typical restaurant chain. First time we called, we were hung up on. Called back, to check if they take reservations and the girl stated that she could take a reservation but not before an hour's time. We said okay, and she stated she could put us down (we were a party of six) for 6:45. We said great, we'll take it. She put us on hold, then after about two minutes, the manager comes on the line and asked if he could help us. We replied that we were making a reservation, and he stated that he wasn't going to take the reservation, that's it's first come first serve. If management is reading this, I suggest next time they either honor what their staff says, or I suggest they train the staff answering the phones what the rules on reservations are before they answer these type of questions from customers. Or management can answer the phone from the start. We would still be dining there if we were told up front that they didn't take reservations, but because of the switch we will be dining somewhere else. Management's rudeness is just bad business.

Place was cool but the customer service was not. Website and price board reflected a Saturday social price but when I came with a group for my son's birthday expecting the price, it was not offered. After mentioning the listed discount, staff was rude and did not even follow up before charging me full price.

Yes, I'm giving 4 stars to this Sizzler. Yup. Sizzler. 4 stars. 

Has anyone NOT been to Sizzler?  I don't think there's anyone I know who doesn't know about their epic salad bar, which is easily a meal by itself.  In reality, there isn't a whole lot of salad to their salad bar.  Soups, pastas, breads, rolls, rice, tacos, several other things I'm forgetting about. It's more of a buffet. 

If you're not into their salad buffet bar, they have a menu full of offerings that I don't think has changed since the 80s. I'm a steak and shrimp junkie, so their 8oz sirloin (medium rare, please) and all you can eat breaded shrimp is in my wheelhouse.  It's hard to not get full on their magic cheese toast (AYCE is part of that problem) that they bring out before your meal arrives.  If you order off the menu, it gives you an all-access pass to their dessert bar where you can stuff your face full of soft serve ice cream with a few different toppings. 

They do have a selection of crappy beer if you want some, but I don't think serving Belgian monk brewed ale would fit the bill here. Although, a Blue Label Chimay wouldn't be turned down by me. 

I'm sure I could find a higher class place for my steak and shrimp that cost ten times the amount and would keep those reading this from questioning my Yelp Elite status for giving props to a Sizzler.  It could be partly a matter of nostalgia, too, as I'm a child of the 80s and we came here to eat often. Either way, I'm glad they're still around.

Food was very good, service was excellent and like any good place they were ensuring our food was excellent. This place is in a location that has had 2 prior restaurants that failed. This restaurant however is a keeper and serves a great need in the perfect location.  Highly recommend !!

Best basque food I have ever had! It's a very small restaurant with a tiny waiting area so be sure to have a reservation. Tender lamb, beef medallions, homemade soups. Everything is delicious! You feel like an honored guest in a home of someone who loves to cook and make their  guests feel special.

Our visit to Linder Pet was just plain AWESOME!  Dr. Bean was very complete in her exam and advised us in a very understanding way on what she recommended.  We did not feel rushed at all and she wanted us to ask as many questions as needed.  The value of service and the care we received was unlike another shop we had been at for years.  Dr, Bean really cared about our pet and us.  VERY REFRESHING...we would strongly recommend Linder Pet for all your Pet concerns or great plans for Wellness Visits!

By far my best experience with movers and they were the cheapest. I appreciate when people stick by their word. They were on time and quote didn't have any hidden cost, exactly what they quoted me. Next time im moving, I'm calling Reliance

We have been anticipating the opening and were glad to finally have the opportunity to go in for a meal.  We love Thai food and eat it any chance we get and also when we travel.

The first thing we noticed is on the front of the menu ~
they have MSG in their food and It is only stated on the front of their menu ~ they include it in their listing of "only the freshest ingredients." 
When we asked about it, only certain foods can be made w/out it, but you have to ask them to make it w/out. 
Actually, we were shocked that they use it. 

The food wasn't bad, but we were very disappointed that they use MSG ~ most restaurants today know the problems w/ this ingredient.  We won't be returning as long as they continue to use MSG

Felt cheated! is all I can say.
I ordered malai kofta, where kofta was so tuff that after leaving it soaked in that gravy for three days it remained inedible. The kofta (in malai kofta) is supposed to be made of cottage cheese which also makes it melt in the mouth soft, however the one provided by them was made from chickpea flour and may be some potato, which is not the case for an original recipe. I would have excused them for their flavors, but cheating the customer by replacing a malai kofta with potato-flour kofta is unforgivable!

Avoid them or buy frozen curry at an Indian store. That would taste much better than what they serve.

This place rivals Daves famous bbq in taste! Great brisquet. The ribs are smoked and delicious. Atmosphere was very cool and relaxed. Waitress was extremely nice and helpful. Cost was in line with great food and nice restaurant. 
WE WILL BE BACK

Can't say enough good about these guys.  Had my six year old dog's teeth cleaned by their mobile unit in June.  With that came free doctor's visits for a year.  Never expecting my dog to have any other problems I didn't think much about the free doctor visits until my dog got a pinched nerve in her neck and couldn't walk and was in so much pain.  These guys have done several chiropractic adjustments which cost only $48 by the mobile unit and the doctor's visit is free.  My dog is doing so much better and it has not cost an absolute fortune.  I love these guys.  Will stick with these guys forever.  They are so nice when my dog and I were at our worst.
Good friendly service. Good kids meals ~ offers fruit as an option. Excellent food for adults too. Decor is nice, comfortable. Will come back again.

Laticia is a one of a kind boss babe and esthetician. She made me feel so relaxed and at home during my facial as if I were hanging out with a friend, but maintained a professional demeanor and offered me loads of insight and knowledge into my skin's particular needs. I felt like a princess by the time it was done and literally did not want to leave  five stars from me!!

The food will curb your Indian food cravings, but the flavors are not as authentic as I would have hoped based on the yelp ratings. 
The buffet is not well stocked because they make things as needed. We found ourselves having to ask if they could make more. As a few things GRADUALLY came out, the consistency and flavor was lacking. The naan was it crisp and tasted doughy.
The positive: we did not leave with that heavy or sluggish feeling.

Today, I ACTUALLY got a full soon of fried onions for my soup. Problem is, mushroom busy was VERY WATERY. NOT MANY MUSHROOMS AND SEEMS LIKE IT'S CHANGED, too much water added. They also did not have my favorite drink the one with orange and berries. So sad...

Okay I don't usually go to "chains" but they're not national (yet?) and I wanted BBQ, was driving by and liked the 4 star rating. 

Was not disappointed.   Great service,  great food.  Had the baby backs, burnt ends and sausage with a salad.  

All was good enough for me to say " I will be back."

The new Boise location is great! It's so convenient now that there is a new location in SE Boise!  I know people are annoyed by the wait time for take out but it's worth it!!! It only goes to show that they are using fresh ingredients and cooking when you order.  The chicken is always all white meat with no gristle and veggies are fresh and crisp!

So I'm more frustrated with online ordering than this location. I made an online order that looked correct, I even read it back to my friends/family to make sure I didn't forget anything. We were in a great mood carving pumpkins for halloween and all was well, we even put a note saying "can you draw us a Halloween picture" pizza shows up in a timely manner, but there are way too many pizzas. I look at the receipt and somehow there was a glitch and it tripled one of our pizzas!! So here I am with $100 in pizza. The delivery guy told me I should call the restaurant. I called the restaurant and they told me to call the 1-800  number. I call the 1-800 number and The 1-800 number tells me to call the restaurant.... so here I am 4 days later with waaay to much pizza in the fridge and I'm out about $30. Forget these online deals, I'll stick to calling the place to order. On a plus side, they did draw me a sweet Halloween picture.

I've been coming to Beef 'O' Brady's for a few years  now. It's close to my office and offers a great variety of different dishes, so it works out great for me. The fact that they have a grill means that they can offer more than typical bar food, which is nice. They have steak and salmon and fajitas etc. The burgers are always excellent, as well as the fajitas and tacos. I am an iced tea purest and the tea here is excellent! They also have daily food specials as well as a lunch menu that has some great priced combos that include a side and your drink. The bar area is well stocked and there are a large amount of beers on tap. There are also large TV's all around the bar and restaurant, so if you have a sporting event you're interested in you can ask and they will usually put it on for you. When the weather is warm there is also a nice patio area. In my experience, the staff are always friendly and genuinely try to get to know you. The owners are great people too, and they are there quite often. Beef 'O' Brady's is also kid friendly, so it's a good place to take the whole family.

Such a cute place and everyone was so friendly!  I am from Detroit visiting family and found this day spa on Google to treat my mom, aunt and sister in law. They were very accommodating.  Bethany, Tru and Melissa did a wonderful job. If I lived here, this would be my place for sure. Plus they offer complimentary wine and champagne so you really feel pampered. Would definitely go back next time I'm in town.

The staff here is sooo nice that you hate to say anything unkind.  I think that may be a big part of why it's so highly reviewed.  But, we have been there a couple of times and the food was good, but nothing special.  

I will say that the green apple bread pudding is wonderful.  Other than that, all of our dishes have been average.  My one other tidbit of advice is that you should only go here if you are in the mood for meat.  Virtually all of their entrees are meat.
Brandon is an awesome server! Made my friends first sake bomb very fun. Nice environment too!!!!

Love spending 40 dollars on a to go order to have it missing one entire meal and another burger not only did I not get to eat but my wife gave hers to the kids to share so thanks for that. You have forever lost a customer as this isn't the first time. I'm sure it's also not the last.  From such an amazing company the employees don't really seem to care about reputation or quality. I called and tried to explain what was missing and it was dismissed by the rude horrible customer service.

Went for sushi and wasn't thrilled. Rice was al dente, they put sesame seeds on all the rolls we ordered, & our server wasn't knowledgeable about sushi at all. When asked if they had unagi server went to check with "sushi chef", when she came back she said he told her meant uni. Why doesn't the sushi chef know the difference between eel & urchin? On the plus side the fish itself was fresh and well presented.
The staff here is absolutely amazing!! I'm so happy with my treatments!! Laser hair removal is the best decision I ever made! The best customer service! They definitely know what they're doing!
Awesome laid back bar! Singing and free poker on certain days! Outdoor patio is a cool addition for live bands

Growing up in Southern California Santora's was a favorite place for pizza, wings, and sandwiches.  I heard that they had opened one in Meridian and couldn't wait to go. All the tastes are the same as I remember.  Outstanding sandwich and wings today. I'll be back without a doubt. Highly recommend trying it at least once, you don't know what you're missing.
This is a great place to meet friends. Great happy hour and appetizers. Yummy food! Service is friendly and available.

Great service. I coasted in today after running over road debris and getting a flat tire. Nice gash in my tire, they fixed it in 10 minutes and for very little cost. I appreciate that they didn't try to sell me a new tire right away

A nice, clean, modern movie theater with an option to get VIP 21+ balcony seating and in your chair food ordering/delivery for only $2 more, with reserved seats to boot?? Where do I sign? The theater is already beautiful on its own but the VIP experience takes movie going up about 5 notches. The seats are super comfortable, wider than normal seats and have a cup holder and a nice wide part on the arm to put your food (which can also hook into the cup holder and rest comfortably on your lap). They have a great full menu of just about any food and dessert options you could want, plus the staples like popcorn, candy and soda. I love that they had Wild Cherry Pepsi! 

The staff was also super friendly and this was probably the most pleasant movie experience I've ever had, especially for only $12. The theater is set back a little so street parking, if you can find it, is the closest. They have restrooms a' plenty too so you don't have to walk halfway across the theater to take care of business. If I lived in Boise I think I would go broke going to this theater all the time! Well done Village Cinema!

Great place to take kids to play. An hour is all I can afford ($10?!?!?).  I like keeping an eye on them as they jump but as they pass from Dodgeball to the pit to basketball and back again, I am running around on the perimeter. Makes it hard to actually work on anything. . . .Some type of upper level viewing area would let me stay in one place and keep an eye on them.

I've been to this location 2x while in Boise. We don't have a Qdoba in the Bay Area, and I've heard other people rave about Qdoba so I thought I'd give it a shot. 

1st time, I ordered a chipotle adobo burrito.. BLECK. It was smoky sweet and I hated it. 
2nd time, I was told to order the nachos because I was told the nacho cheese sauce was amazing. It tasted just like nacho cheese sauce.. nothing special. I sat there eating my nachos in disbelief that that was what I had ordered for dinner. 

The chips and guacamole were good, but all in all I'd say that if there's a Chipotle near by, go there.

Solid 4 star. Not a lot of tables. We were luck to get the last table in the house, so best to make reservations! 

Wait staff were pleasant. 

Menu has a lot of options, including the standard mango lassi that I thought I'd order for dessert but when that time came, I was stuffed! I really have to just order the thing at the start of the meal! 

Started with the aloo tikki, and the sauces that came with it were so delicious, too!

Then hubby and I shared the Mughal mukhani, Raita and Naan! Very yummy! Lamb was tender, and we asked for the Boise hot, that wasn't really hot at all. Next time, I'd order hotter.

Would love to come back and try some other dishes if theirs too!

It was okay. Great service. Food wasn't bad but not amazing.  The meat was very fatty. I had the smoked ends and BBQ chicken. Very little meat on the chicken. Neither tasted smoked. More covers with barbecue sauce.

Outstanding service last evening by Katherine at Goodwood BBQ Meridian, ID.  Food was excellent as well, with leftovers being taken home.  Katherine made our b-day celebration a fun event with a delicious dessert recommendation that we all enjoyed.  Thank you Katherine and Meridian Goodwood.  We'll be back again real soon!!

We had a reservation for 11 at 6 pm. We got there and the hostess said they had set another party of 12 at 4:30 and told them they had 90 minutes and then they would need to leave due to our reservation at 6pm.  I asked the hostess to tell them to the other party was here and that they are at their time limit.  I witnessed nothing being done and we were finally sat 35 minutes later.  

The food is always good here but the major reason for the 1 star review was the server JORDAN. When asked to pay for my sister's bill at the end of our meal he said, "I can't do that. She asked me to be on a check by herself."  I told him that I was her brother and wanted to pay for her and asked him again to "put her food on my bill" but he again said, "I can't do that and walked away."  

When he then came back with the bills, I then grabbed my sister's bill and then handed him my bill and my sister's bill with my credit card and said, "Now can you put her bill on my credit card?"  He said, "I will have to ask her." My sister and my stepmother, who also witnessed this were surprised by his lack of understanding and his rude attitude. My sister finally confirmed it was "OK" for JORDAN to do this and that is when he finally did it. 

Money is money Jordan and when people ASK YOU NICELY to do something, as you may not know my sister is going through a hard time right now and I simply want to be nice to her, take the stupid credit card, shut your mouth and do your job correctly without the attitude. You were lucky there was a built-in 20% tip or you would have got nothing.

We come here every week and love the food. By now they know us and always bring us a fresh order of naan. the lunch buffet is great! There is always something new to try. There hasn't been a single thing that I've tried that I'd didn't love, but the chicken Makhani is by far my favorite.  If you have a hankering for some real good food you should come here.

I had a work meeting here just the other day, and the coffee was delish! I had 2 cups! The bathrooms were clean, the staff was professional, the lobby smelled fragrant with flowers, the signs were easy to read & navigate through the hotel, and overall, it was a great experience. I saw the snack shops in the lobby, and I didn't have time to check them out. However, I'm sure the rooms & snack shop are just as great as the lobby and meeting halls. Thank you for a pleasant meeting!

I was a little worried about this place when we walked in, when there were no customers in the dining area. Every table was empty.  It was a lazy Sunday and at around 6:30 PM my husband asked me where I wanted to go for dinner. Mexican food sounded good, and I told my husband to surprise me.  We ended up at this little gem in a strip mall off of Main Street in Meridian.  It's kind of hard to find.  It's in the back behind the Kanack Attack.  We sat down at a booth and the waiter immediately gave us our menus and asked what we wanted to drink.  He then promptly gave us our drinks and chips, salsa and beans.  Chips were warm and tasty and the salsa had a good kick and  flavor. The bean dip had good flavor but was a bit runny for my taste. The menu is extensive and we needed just a little more time to decide when the waiter came to ask for our order.  Finally I ordered the enchilada suiza  and my husband ordered chimichanga manzanillo (something with fish it in).  Immediately after we ordered, the waiter came back and said they are out of chicken.  A little odd since the place was completely empty, but whatever.  I ordered the pork carnitas instead.  When I ordered the pork carnita's, in my mind I was thinking of casa verde' pork so when the carnita's arrived, I thought to myself, where's the green sauce?  Oh well, my mistake.  I dug in and was pleasantly surprised with the smokey flavor of the tender pork.  There were a lot of onions with this pork, but not a big deal for me because I like onions and they obviously go well with pork. Flour tortillas and rice and beans went with the meal.  I hope this place stays in business because I really want to try their enchilada suizas.

We have been longtime customers and do miss Chris. However the new owner Erik, is keeping the legacy of Epi's up to the high level it is always had. The entire team does a fantastic job and the food is absolutely wonderful. One cannot expect better service and leaving with a feeling that you are a treasured customer!  

Thank you for keeping a Treasure Valley icon going!

First, never have a felt so much like family in a restaurant as I did here.  From the moment we entered until we left, we received excellent service.  The special for the night - sea bass - was melt in your mouth delicious.  I am used to the "basque" style restaurants of Bakersfield so I missed the usual set up of soup, salad, spaghetti, tongue, french fries, etc. but Epi's does a wonderul set-up of just soup, salad, potatoes and beans which was wonderful and quite filling.  The desserts were fabulous.  I highly recommend Epi's for a wonderful dining experience where you will walk away with a smile on your face and count the days until you return to this wonderful restaurant.

I would give them 0 stars if I could. I got a full set done here three days ago and they are already lifting and falling off. I went in today because it says that walk-ins are welcome and the receptionist was inflexible and honestly just rude. She claimed that I had to have an appointment and that there were no appointments available for the rest of the night, she said that there no one available to fix the nails that I got done three days ago. To make it worse, there was a nail tech sitting at the first station doing her own nails. The receptionist basically told me that there was nothing she could do. Overpriced, with AWFUL customer service. Oh

I talked my husband into actually trying a Thai dish instead of Chinese. He had the Birds Nest with Pork. I nibbled a few of the noodles while I was waiting for my meal and it was fantastic. 
I can't remember the name of my meal. It was E5 with broccoli and spinach, chicken, peanut sauce, and fried onions. I got it with medium spice. It did not disappoint!  This is my 3 rd time here. I've eaten Pad Thai both of the other times, but I'm glad I decided to branch out. 
I've lived in many cities. There are probably other good Thai restaurants in the area, but I tend to stick to a good one when I find it. We'll be back.

So happy to have this place open.
Food great! 
Service is great!
The price is reasonable. Lots of traditional menu items. There something your looking for.

Went there for my daughters college graduation. There was 10 of us.  I have to say I was pleasantly surprised!  Our waiter did an amazing job!  I was buying so of course the drinks were flowing and this guy didn't miss a beat, even with this big group!  
The food was exceptional super tender steak, perfect lobster and I was told the Salmon was cooked to perfection.  
The cook was entertaining as most at this style place but he paid attention to the Grad which made me happy.   
We'll be back!

After reading previous reviews I will admit I was nervous for my first laser hair removal appointment. So I am pleased to say I had a much different experience than what I read about. I was greeted right away for my appointment and taken back within 5 minutes of my arrival. My nurse was fabulous and although it's not the most comfortable feeling in the world I couldn't believe how fast it went. She was thorough and a true professional. Looking forward to the results and future appointments!

I've been coming here at least once a week for the last 3 years or so. I always order sushi. This is the best place in the Treasure Valley to get authentic Japanese sushi. I'm not talking about Americanized, over sauced sushi. It's just fresh fish, fresh vegetables and other incredible ingredients to make the best sushi. Most places have too much rice and not enough fish. This place packs every roll with tons of fish and ingredients with rice that is perfectly cooked and spread thin on the nori. I won't go anywhere else for sushi.

Hailey was amazing! Came on St. Pattys day and even though she was super busy she answered all of our questions! The food is amazing and the customer service is amazing. Thank you girl for making our first time awesome

Very interesting menu choices. We started out with chili chicken wings and celery slaw and and order of potato pancakes.  I could have made a meal of the celery slaw!  Then came the smoked potato soup. It was so good. Dinner choices were meatloaf, smoked salmon with corn salsa and a rueben.  The meatloaf came with a jalapeño polenta.  All the meals were very good.  I felt a bit rushed in that we food was coming a bit fast. It would have been nice to finish our appetizers, then be able to finish or soup / salad course before being served our main course.  

I would recommend Ricks.  It really is a cute place with well prepared dishes.

My favorite bagel place in the Treasure valley! I'm originally from NY, so it's hard to compare bagels (or any other food to be honest), but this place is awesome! Not your average bagel, not sure how they're made, but they're delicious! Super nice staff, too! Their breakfast and lunch sandwiches are sooo good!! Huge variety of flavors and many more options as far as drinks, on the menu!
Good for kids to get their energy out. Do not eat the food here, it is overpriced and sub standard.

My fiancé and I love this place for a filling and healthy lunch or dinner. They have a great option under $10 of a pick two: sandwich, half salad, half soup. I almost always choose this option. My favorites are the honey bacon club, nuts about berries salad, and the mushroom bisque. All are absolutely delicious! My most recent visit I tried the chicken Cobb salad and it was delicious. Only complaint would be that a real Cobb salad comes with blue cheese... and no blue cheese? Maybe it's just me. The meals come with a roll and a chocolate covered strawberry, yum! The staff are always friendly, sometimes a little over the top, if that's even a thing. You can expect it to be very busy on the lunch and dinner rushes. The lines can be out the door.

Service is awesome!

The food was decent. I got a combo platter with brisket and pulled park on the server's recommendation, with fries and broccolini. The sides were perfect!! Wow! The brisket was good, the pulled pork a bit lacking. The BBQ sauce they put on is good however. Really good!

The music and TVs are a tad loud but the service was stellar from the moment I walked in. My spouse doesn't eat pork or beef which is why I decided to try this place on my own (I don't eat it when we are out together because we love to share!) and I will still recommend it to come back to as a family :)

I was in Boise area on business last week, and decided to get some Indian food.  I was perhaps feeling a bit homesick.  I came to Spice Indian Cuisine, and found it to be a small, but nice place.  It was quiet that day when I came.

I ordered one think for dinner.  I ordered the Lamb Palak.  This is basically lamb curry with spinach (greens).  It was served with white rice.  The food was quite good.  I actually found it to be a bit interesting, as it was served to me with a metal plate, rather then the standard ceramic.  Nothing bad, just a bit different (in India it is more common to see metal plates).  In any case, the lamb palak was good.  It tasted the way any good curry like that should taste.  The lamb was cooked well, and was definitely not chewy.  It had just the right amount of heat (spice).  

I wish this place well.  Perhaps, when I come through on business again in Boise area, I may come back here.  I travel through Boise enough on business.

Delicious. I have no other words to describe this place but sadly i have to write more for this to be a review. The cheese curds are the best thing on the menu  but they make me feel fat because there so good i eat a lot of them.

I was so excited for an Indian restaurant to open in Meridian. I love this place. I have been there at least 10 times. 
The staff is so friendly and will definitely remember what you order the last. I have eaten from the buffet and the menu, both are pretty good. 
They have a lot of great selection, also some vegan and dairy free options.

Super fun for the kids but the party's are expensive.  We had ordered two pizzas with our party and somehow the oven dropped black char on top of half of the pizza.  The host offered to hand pick it off which was impossible.  The manager wouldn't let her get us a new one but instead gave us half another pizza but by the time we got it the kids were done and playing again.  This place just isn't run very well!  It's there to make money and not keep customer happy

I highly recommended Bronze Yourself tanning! I got my first ever spray tan for my wedding, and I was pretty scared I would be orange or splotchy. Jamie was great to work with, made me feel comfortable, and I was so happy with the results. I was much more tan (looked great with wedding dress), but no one could tell that I got a "spray tan." Itwas very natural looking. I liked it so much that I went back and got another tan for a trip. I'll definitely be getting tan here again :)

Worst store for buying lumber.  Selection for what I was looking for, was pretty slim. Once I settled on plenty of warped redwood 2 by 4s, I get in a very long line, where lumber and large products checkout. I was about five people deep with one checker. The other one had an employee standing there, not taking customers, but shooting the breeze with the other checker. I turned around and the line was way down the aisle near the back of the store. Saturday mornings around 11 am, you would think it was all hands on deck!  Lowe's on Eagle was a way better experience yesterday.  I actually found someone to help me, without a poor attitude!

Wow!  All I've got to say is GO THERE!  Excellent flavors, and fresh fresh fresh!  We were traveling from Bandon, Oregon where we'd spent a week tent camping, boating, and crabbing on the coast.  We were headed home to Utah when we decided (through Yelp) to stop at Epi's.  We were raggedy and poorly dressed.  With no reservations we walked in and were fortunate enough to get a table on a Thursday evening.  I must say these were probably the friendliest, most unpretentious people we've encountered in fine dining!  SUPER impressed!  The owner, Erik McFarland, was an extremely gracious host, and we noticed that he waited every single table and spoke with every patron.  We could see the chefs from where we were seated, and both were enjoying their work, smiling, laughing occasionally, and just having a good time!  The wait staff were superb!  All were friendly and we felt like we were in the home of good friends!  The menu is unique, and every dish we had was excellent!  Food temperature, timing, texture, etc - PERFECT.  Get the calamari!  Get the chicken!  Get the Lengua (tongue), Get the soups!  Get the wine!  FINALLY!  An example for other restaurants to follow!

Came here for sushi and had a wallet stolen. Luckily, we got the wallet back, after being miraculously "found" in a menu. Every single person in our group of five had seen the wallet in the restaurant and the persons wallet who had been stolen never moved once from the table. After about ten or fifteen minutes of searching through camera footage-which we were not allowed to watch ourselves- the manager or owner, I'm not sure which, "found" the wallet in a menu. Every person in our group had seen that wallet after we had our menus taken. We were bagdered by one employee and were asked "So what did you think happened then?" when we stated our concerns for our friends missing wallet. The original waiter who was the only person to attend to our table, was nowhere to be found after we said we thought the wallet might have been stolen. During the searching of video footage, he left and wasn't seen again, even after getting the wallet back. He never apologized or came to at least explain what he knew about the wallet. I have NEVER gone to a restaurant and had this happen. It was extremely unprofessional and at one point I thought about contacting the cops. While the cops might not have been able to do much considering they had one of their cameras which was supposed to be directed towards us, was directed straight at the floor. It was ridiculous, unproffesional, and downright shady. I and my friends will never be attending there again and I hope you never do. Unless you want your wallet stolen.
It's ridiculous how the prices are going up and the size of the salad bar is going down! The food is getting worse every time we're here! We won't be back to this location ever!

Going to break this into two parts -

Quality: Fresh and flavorful

Cost: Ridiculous!  Three street tacos for $9.00 is ridiculous.  We got the kids a single cheese quesadilla which was $8.00 (are you kidding me)?

Way over priced and won't return.  They got two stars for the clean restaurant.

If you're looking for authentic Basque food, this is the place to go! It's located in a small house in downtown Meridian, super homey atmosphere. We came with a group of 6, and we all tried different dishes, everyone of them was delicious! Even the octopus ink dish, which my sister in law loved!!! The owner will personally welcome you herself, but I recommend reservations as it's always busy!!

Personally I look at the the price and the pizza is comparable but definitely better than little Caesar's. Highly recommend for people that don't want to spend 12 bucks for a pizza at one of the major chains. Fast, locally procured ingredients, and locally owned
Grab a burger and beer then watch any sporting event on one of the many tv monitors.   Good beer on tap selection.

I'm not sure where to begin with this one, so here goes.................

.......while rolling through the tail end of our Alaska-Canada motorcycle road trip, I had wanted to try this place for over a year.  In fact, we made it a point, 2 years in a row, to include Wyoming/Idaho for steak and Basque food, since as far as I'm concerned, it's some of the best food in the world.

Epi's certainly does NOT disappoint!!!

Our evening, from the moment we arrived, parked and walked in the door, was absolute PERFECTION in every way.

Beginning with a warm welcome, a perfectly located table, competent staff (many of whom are family members), delicious home made food and great wine to wash it all down.  Our entire evening was absolutely delightful.  

So looking forward to our return trip, sometime next year.

Stopped in this week and got great, fresh fried chicken, well flavored reddens and rice, and excellent service.  It was a tough-fish order, as I fumbled around with my new "app" for coupons.  Kendrick, manning the counter, was patient AND helpful, and his manager (didn't catch her name) helped him work through coupon issues quickly. We were in a bit of a rush, but between the two, the order was out before I finished paying. Good job guys!
They never get the whole order right...and refuse to make it better unless you pay extra...not very happy

Our server Madelyn was absolutely amazing tonight. I tried giving her a hard time, just because. She threw back an absolute amazing experience that will have us coming back for sure. I hope that her managers will review and share this with her. When you have a server who is knowledgeable, kind, and quick witted liker her you have a real gem. I would recommend the salad with dinner. Best in town. The sausage was on point tonight. If you come ask for Madelyn. She will make it worth the wait. So nice to see such excellent service. If I could email headquarters to tell them about her I would. Outstanding!

I went to Accure Dental a few years ago, when they first opened. I went thru many visits, and paid cash$1600 and they billed my insurance at about $1200) to get a full set of dentures. When it came down to the final fitting, the dentures, in no way fit.  The technician literally was cramming them in  my mouth.  I left and came back for another fitting. The exam chair wasnt secured to the floor.  When attempting to sit down, the unsecure chair slid and I went flying face first into the wall. I had bruises and a black eye. The dentures still didnt fit. I was so upset and after being told by the Dr. , that I was ok after fallinq, I never returned.  I was unable to use the product. My only regret is that I didnt sue them. DONT GO THERE!

This was my first stay at this hotel. I booked through Expedia, so I wasn't able to get my reward points, however I did save $10 per night and was able to get breakfast included for my wife, my grandson and I. 

Check in: Tristan was extremely polite. Great customer service and very helpful. 

Breakfast: the staff during breakfast was nothing less than amazing. Extremely attentive, very polite, and very personable. My grandson was sick the first morning and on the second morning the same employee asked me how he was doing and if she could get him anything special from the kitchen. 

I had a late dinner on the last night. The employee was amazing, very attentive and personable. 

The food was excellent. I didn't have a bad meal at all. 

The rooms were very clean, the hotel was very clean. The BSU team stayed there the night before their game against Portland State. The kids on the team were very polite as well. 

I will definitely visit this hotel again, specifically this location. The staff was amazing.

This is the worst restaurant that I have been in this year.  I've been traveling every week since January 1 across the country. Waited one hour for the pretzels and cheese appetizer to come out and when they finally arrived they were greasy, slimy and cold. Sent them back. I also  ordered a steak bowl and it came out cold, sent it back not about to get sick.  My wife ordered the shrimp it came out semi-warm. Also might suggest that the owners check out which employees are actually drinking alcohol on duty. Only good thing about this place was the waiter. Super nice guy and I feel sorry for him having to deal with what's going on in this restaurant tonight.

While on a business trip had the time to get my oil changed and more importantly wanted my other engine fluids checked. Chris and the entire treated me with the up most professionalsm and respect from explaining my current oil level to bring to my attention other services needed. I highly recommend this place for not only oil changes but for other engine checking serices.

We were pleasantly surprised with this place,  never been here.  Loved it.  Very pretty inside,  they have hibachi,  a sushi bar and a bar.  The food was amazing.  Pad thai and crispy peanut chicken. food was fabulous.  Happy hour amazing!! Thanks!!!

I read about this place opening up, and both my wife and I have been eager to try it.  Today, we were a bit punchy from being on the road all day, kind of hangry, but not wanting much to sit in a restaurant.  We decided to go ahead and give Spice a try, and get some take out.  Well, we were thoroughly satisfied by our dinner tonight.

I ordered the Shrimp Masala, and my wife ordered the Lamb Korma, and we ordered the both "New York Hot" (which is medium hot on their scale, between "Boise Hot" and "Bombay Hot").  Both dishes were delicious and the New York Hot level was perfect for us.  Spicy enough to get your attention, but not to inflict pain.  The spices that they use are so intricate and bring out so much flavor, it was just a really good dinner.

We will definitely be back, perhaps very soon, since we often crave Indian food.  Now we have a place close to home to satisfy that craving!

[ Orion's Belt is a huge waist of space. ]

We have stayed here before, it's a lovely faciity and a great hotel.  Had some issues with booking.com that couldn't get fixed and Scott T. went out of his way to call me and follow through with fixing the situation.  Don't hesistate to stay here and I personally thank him for the help!

Don't waste your time. This is barbecue for people who have never had good barbecue. Sides were mediocre at best. Ribs were dry with a terribly sticky sweet sauce. It did taste smoky, so if that's your thing...

Went here with my daughter for Mothers Day. The food, as always, was great. The service was a negative 1. The waiter assumed I was vegetarian, due to the fact I wasn't in the mood for meat. I just wanted the soup, salad, rice and veggies. The waiter brought everyone (7 out of 8, the one being myself) their soup and salad. I questioned the waiter where mine was. He replied, "I assumed all you wanted was the veggies". I had to reiterate again that I wanted everything else, but the meat entree. He huffed, turned and headed to the kitchen. He brought me the salad, but a egg flower soup instead of the beef broth. I ask him why was mine different? He stated, "I assumed you were vegetarian" again. I sent it back for the original soup. The remaining meal was great as well as the show. Then, the bill came. There were 3 separate groups at this table. One being my daughter and myself. The waiter added the gratuity to our bill. I've never had a waiter at Izumi's add the tip on the bill for just 2 on the ticket. This used to be my favorite place to eat. If I go again, I will request to NOT be in his section. I plan on calling and speaking to management about the worst service I've ever had and how he made sure to get a tip when he definitely didn't deserve one.

Very nice nail salon. The ladies were very nice and very gentle with me and my sister. A couple of my nails were cracked really bad and she took the time to mend them back together. When we were done they gave  us our buffer and nail file for a $1 charge to bring back next time. I really liked this because that meant they used fresh equipment on you. Will definitely recommend and will come back!
I travel to Boise to see Dr. Karlfield.  He is a consumate professional.  Completely passionate about his craft, but also a great guy.  I could not recommend him more highly!

Both of the other reviews slam Sizzler.  But they both knew the food quality prior to going there.  So why did they go?   I have not been to one in 15 years and I thought the food was excellent.  Ask my kids 8 & 6 where they want to and they say Sizzler....My only complaint is price$$$$. Price is just to high for family of four or we come more often...

I had a boudoir shoot earlier this year and had the privilege of having Laticia do my make up.  Not only did she take her time, she made sure that every stroke was perfect.  It was cute watching her react to my transformation right before her eyes.  She would get so excited.  It's obvious she loves her job.  I got so many compliments on my beautiful make up and my husband especially was speechless.  She was very personable and made me feel right at ease.  I would recommend her in a heartbeat.

Trent is an amazing bartender! We had a great Sunday lunch/brunch here and received amazing service and food/drink. We received prompt service, great service for refilling our miimosas and they had a great happy hour. We will definitely come back here for the food and great drink service. Trent was amazing, made awesome Bloody Mary's and continued to service our table for the several hours we were there.
A great little dive bar. Reasonable prices and pretty good food. Trevor makes some great gravy!

Moved to the Treasure Valley recently and was in search of a new dentist for my family of four. I searched Yelp and found that there were great reviews for this office so I set up an appointment, which I had today. My entire experience was great-from the friendly receptionists to the amazing dental hygienists to the dentist. The hygienist who took care of my 3 and 5 year old was outstanding! She made them feel so welcomed and excited to be there and my hygienist was just as friendly and knowledgeable. The dentist, Dr. Harker was amazing as well- he had a consult with me after my cleaning and exam to discuss cosmetic procedures that I asked about.  You really get the sense that they care about you and your comfort. 

There is a reason that this office is rated so highly by patients, I am truly impressed and would refer anyone to them.

I absolutely do not recommend this medical clinic. The way that they treated myself and my daughter was abhorrent. One of the receptionist or medical assistants Stephanie was extremely rude to us which we didn't say anything about but then when I met the physician it didn't make a difference because he was so great.... I thought. Over the course of about a year I came to rely on my physician for medical issues for my daughter and myself then possibly my husband. The first time ever in a year I brought my husband in All of a sudden my doctors demeanor changed and He almost acted like he had never met me or my daughter. It was very awkward. No eye contact etc. I have seen this guy at least five times in a year and have spoken with him, his staff and receptionist there at least 10 times. The visit itself was average it was a check in for medication refills which he provided. Then I went to make an appointment for my husband with maybe a different physician the following week and was told not only do they not have any appointments available for him but they were no longer able to treat me and my daughter they just simply didn't have room for us I suppose. When I inquired as to why the receptionist said I don't know let me transfer you to my manager and I never got a call back I have tried three Times and never received a callback. I don't know if it's because my husband is a site supervisor and is muddy after work or he open carries on his hip for safety purposes and for animals both on his job sites and on our land. After doing some research I found that this clinic summarily dismissed patients regularly when they Simply do not like you, your beliefs, family etc. ALLEGEDLY. Again this is other peoples reviews and messages I've exchanged back-and-forth of other peoples accounts. I then got set up with a new physician for me and my daughter and my husband got full check up blood tests etc. and found that I had been diagnosed improperly given treatments I actually didn't need and my daughter as well. I don't wanna go into too much detail because obviously we have filed a complaint with the medical board and are seeking legal options but I do feel a responsibility to let the public at large know to the best of my ability what they are getting into. 
I noticed when I was leaving a review that there is a YouTube video of the doctor saying how great his clinic is and how he owns it himself etc. and I commented on it he immediately responded to the comment professionally saying if you have an issue please call my office manager and when I went to actually click on the comment instead of just the notification he had blocked me altogether. I don't know if he just realized who I am or what but I still to this day have never received an honest answer as to why service was discontinued the only thing that I can think of is sheer discrimination and bias based on appearance and possible race I suppose?? Either way physicians these days have gotten out of control I am not at your behest in my opinion you are providing me a service just like any other company and to consistently treat people like they're doing you some big favor by cashing their huge paychecks is crazy then on top of that to find out about these treatments I had been paying for and getting that I didn't need when a clear and obvious MRI that any medical student could read  showed he was wrong was terrifying. This also must be why he was so reluctant to have me see a surgeon but I will not go any further I will just say there are hundreds of clinics in the area and I implore you for the sake of you and your family to slide right past this one and to another one.

I surprised my husband with a couples massage at Inspire the day after Valentine's Day. The staff are all super friendly. They offered us drinks before going in. The massage therapists made sure of any possible allergies and asked if there were any spots that needed extra attention. Everything was amazing and relaxing. Unfortunately my massage therapist didn't have enough time to get to my feet because my neck and back were so tight and tense she took extra care of that. I'm a little bummed but that it ok. My husband loved the surprise and said he feels so much better since he too had a lot of stress and tension going on too.

I don't know if I have ever been in a more welcoming restaurant.  We walked in the door to a place that was totally full. That is usually because of great food.  The owner and staff greeted us, and we got the last table in the place.  We were certainly not disappointed by the food.  It was delicious.  I'll eat here again in a heartbeat.

Folks, save your time and money.  Taco Bell is better Mexican food than this El Gallo Giro location.

The only similarity between this location and the original(?) in Kuna is the name.  We were disappointed from the moment we walked in until the moment we left (which couldn't come soon enough), both in terms of service and quality of food/beverage.

Things started off poorly when we first arrived as there was no host/hostess there to seat us, only a bartender who said we would be seated shortly.  Once we were seated, it was a couple minutes before chips and salsa arrived (the salsa consisting of mostly watery red sauce), and another several minutes until our drink order arrived (waters for the adults and chocolate milk for the kids).  Our food order was taken and then no further check ups until the food arrived, at which point I ordered a margarita.  The margarita didn't arrive until the meal was half gone, and it was made with very basic store bought mix and very cheap tequila.  No one at the table finished more than half their meal, as the food was simply not appealing.  

I typically let my tip speak for my satisfaction, but that was a little awkward since the server was standing there watching as I entered the payment information into the mobile payment device he offered me.  It's a shame, as this spot has been through so many different restaurants over the years, but I'm afraid this is another that won't last.

The most comfortable seat I've ever had in a movie theater!  Also I love that you get to pick your seats while purchasing your tickets.  We are getting to know just where we want to sit in any theater at village cinema.   The only ding they get in my opinion (the loss of one star).... the women's rest room is on one side and the men's on the other.  If the movie you want to see is on the other side, it's quite a hike to get to a rest room.  With as much space at the village, the architects could have done a much better job planting more restrooms about.

I was here for gel nail manicure, and it was done well. That's why the two stars. They charged me $40 and painted my nails. There was no massage, no treatment on hands at all. Just plain polish. It wasn't a manicure at all. One of the girls who work there went up to the pedicure chair, relaxed and started texting in her phone as if she was there for taking service. Did NOT seem professional at all. I'll not return. This is a place for dumb girls who like fake nails, fake lips, fake lashes, fake everything.

If only I can give a ZERO!!! I wouldn't be able to rate their move because Cameron never showed up! He was apparently having mechanical issues with his truck but didn't bother to let me know until after I called and text him after not showing up on time to our appt. I text him 30 mins before our appt giving him instructions about getting through the gate and parking but got no response. After a few minutes of waiting for him to show up at 8 am I called him but again, no answer. I text him AGAIN asking where he was and it wasn't until then that he responds. This guy doesn't answer my call or call me back. He instead texts back saying the battery is dead and to stop calling him! At this point I am freaking out because I put my trust in this guy to show up on time and he doesn't bother to let me know what is going on until AFTER our appt and AFTER I contact him multiple times. Car troubles I can understand but it was the lack of communication and apology that is INEXCUSABLE. At that time I was so infuriated that yes, i told him I would have everyone I know give him a bad review. But who wouldn't be pissed at someone for not showing up to a job as big as this? Cameron was rude and unapologetic about this whole situation. I was completely shocked and disappointed at how he treated me considering his reviews but that's what happened. Luckily, I was able to find a moving company last minute hat has multiple trucks and communicated with me when they were on their way and even stuck in traffic. I usually try to support small and local companies but DO NOT take your chance with this one. If you want a reliable moving company go with one that have their own trucks and multiple movers. DO NOT RISK IT!

Heard about this place many times and finally got a chance to check it out with some old friends. The wines were very tasty (I love the Moscato) and the food was perfectly cooked and seasoned. Was not disappointed and will be returning. I know we will be returning because my roommate is Basque and this is his favorite place lol.

We went on Friday for a late lunch and had amazing food and service. I did not know this is locally owned which is even cooler! Jerrolyn was our server and was super friendly and helpful. Homemade soup that was unbelievably delicious!!! I highly recommend their clam chowder! We had a great time and great food with amazing service! I highly recommend Goodwood!

I've been here a handful of times and each experience was exactly the same - perfect.  You walk into a home - transformed into a restaurant - and treated like you are at home. The owner and staff welcome you like you were their best, long- time customer, even if it's the first time you've come in. 

Entrees come with a soup and salad. You get a lot of food, so skip lunch and maybe breakfast. You won't want to go without trying one of their appetizers (the mushrooms are my fav) and some apple bread pudding for dessert. The menu, while on the small side, has something for everyone. And there has always been a special each time I've gone. 

Plan on around two hours or more for your meal. The service is impeccable and they don't bring your next dish out until you are finished with your current one. This has to be one of my top two or three favorite restaurants I've ever been to. It's a little on the spendy side, but worth ever penny. Call ahead and make a reservation as seating is limited and this place is popular!  You'll leave fat and happy and get a warm send-off from the owner.
Food was great, waitresses were cute and super friendly, the bartender was full of himself and rude

I called yesterday and shared with the woman who answered the phone that I was new to the area and have 1 dog and 1 cat and that I was looking for a family vet for them. I explained that before I left I had both pets fully vaccinated and groomed but I was in need of having my small poodle Charlie's nails trimmed, sometimes when he itches around his neck his nails get caught in his curls and luckily I have been home when this happens to free him. I shared that I would like to have it done ASAP, she quickly explained that her techs were very busy and why not go to PetSmart, I explained that I would much rather have a Vet do the trimming just in case. She explained that the Vet doesn't do the trimming it's the Tech's and again they are to busy. The earliest appointment would be in a week the 29th, just to get a nail clipping? I guess I was really spoiled back home with the Vet I have used for years, very busy office but they would welcome a nail clipping without an appointment, I may have had to wait but I knew they would take care of it with the Professionalism they showed each and every time. I have made other arrangements for his clipping today not 7 days away and they were happy to have my animals as new patients.
The price of the wings is pretty outrageous, I guess this place thrives on drunk people not worried a lot prices
Went there on a date and it was really good! Our chef was super engaging and entertaining. Food was prepared perfectly! The steak was melt in your mouth tender. Definitely going back.
OMG, what great customer service and amazing quality, to be honest I was shocked at the deal I got! Customer for life for sure!!!!
Overpriced and undercooked. Only positive was that it was warm from the holding oven. Won't be back.

This place was great. I read some pretty unsavory comments on here and was hesitant to go honestly. I am very glad to have given this place my business and would continue to do so in the future. They had a lot of options for the kids and even the smaller children too. The little kids and big kids areas were well separated and monitored by staff. The staff, although young, was very attentive to children safety. We came on a Saturday afternoon which was busy but we didn't have to wait for anything and when one area was crowded, there were plenty of other places for the kids to play. You still need to be attentive to your kids, but that should be expected anyways. This place definitely was above average and far exceeded my expectations for a kids trampoline house

This Wendy's is consistent on their customer service and their food quality. They recently wentthrough a remodel (Summer 2017) and it looks very good on the inside. 

Wendy's has good deals and value menu. I like the chili and baked potatoes. You can't find a good baked potato at other fast food chains, or chili for that matter.

Inside this location is one of the new Coke machines where you can make hundreds of combinations.

Friendly experience with the front desk. Quick to return my phone call to schedule an appointment. It was very clean, the esthetician was super friendly and answered all my annoying questions with no problem at all haha. She helped calm my nerves before she even started which I appreciated very much! Would recommend hands down

So, the hirachi experience is very fun for the whole family. The flipping food into your mouth, big flames, and cooking tool flips are fun and inclusive. Its really an interactive dining experience. The filet and chicken were very good. 
It gets knocked one star because the service at the cooktop tables is slow. Drinks and whatnot are hard to get due to the time it takes for someone to come back and check in on you. 
Nevertheless this is a fun and delicious dinner choice. We will be back.

I went here on a Tuesday night with a friend because it was open until 10 and the original place we wanted to go to closed at 9. The reviews were good so I figured why not. 
We arrive about 8 something or so and there were zero ppl. The place was super dead. Waitress was very sweet.
Ordered 3 rolls. All but one were very good (personal taste). 
The prices were quite steep tho.

It was good but didn't really match the price and the service was nice but it was missing something overall.

I really want to give this place a better review but.... the food is lacking flavor and wayyy overpriced. My husband said the sushi was bomb and the gyozas were good as well but the rice and chicken were both bland. Our waiter was very nice and attentive so I'd give them 3 's based on that and the sushi but our bill was 100$ and we left feeling unsatisfied which was a bummer.
Great theater, really really comfortable seats, offers assigned seating which is really nice.

I can't believe this was my first time at Izumi's.. I was invited to a friends bday dinner, table of 8 and the food was amazing. We shared food, Bday boy got a sushi boat for two that was a fun presentation and the sushi was SO fresh. I also tasted a peanut sauce served with a friends chicken and it was DELICIOUS. The service was incredible, the bartender was friendly and accommodating. I ordered fried cheesecakes for the table at the end and was surprised at how good it was. We'll definitely be retiring, this is a great place if you have kids or are wanting an adult night out. OH and they played a drum and sang tableside for the bday boy #bonus

These guys are incredibly fast and efficient. Unlike some other tree services I've observed, they have all of the equipment and manpower to get the job done quickly. They gave us a free quote, kept their appointment, and did the work for a price that I was happy to pay. We had a large, unhealthy elm tree close to the house with branches extending far over the roof. They brought in a lift and a crane, took out the elm, trimmed a few branches from other trees that were giving us problems, and removed two stumps. Our patio, driveway and yard were cleaner afterward than they had been before the work started. The crew seemed to enjoy their work, and our kids had a great time watching them. We couldn't be happier with this company.

This is the second time we have been here both times the food has been excellent, the service has been so so. The waitress tonight was very attentive, just didn't do a great job. She just missed a few things, utensils, napkins, plates for the sushi.
We decided to hit the happy hour, half priced drinks and reduced prices on appetizers and rolls. This time we tried the Crab Rangoon, Tiger, Dynamite, and Rainbow rolls and finished the evening up with one of the ice cream Bomba's.
We will definitely come back to Izumi, just wish they could get some of the bugs in the service part ironed out.
This is a wonderful place to have Tapas and wine! The menu is mainly gluten-free with a few exceptions and the food is delicious as well as the Wines & the varieties

Don't forget your "to go box" this place will trash it before you barely leave the parking lot...super bummer.  We called immediately after just leaving  and tried to return immediately, but Noooo,  in the trash it went. Boo!  way to piss off customers, goodwood needs to rethink this immediated dispose of your food box policy.  Ordered a $12 brisket sandwich had 4 small slices of meat on it.  Wow, skimpy expensive lunch, tiny bean side cup.  If you can even call it a cup, maybe a 1/2 cup.  Small portions. I Wont be back.

At dinner tonight with my mom and family friends, the waitress had a band-aid on her hand, flopping around as she poured more water.
* Friend to Waitress-  Looks like you're having a hard time keeping that band-aid on your hand.  
* Me- thinking: I hope no band-aid has been LOST while serving food to patrons...
* Waitress: Yeah, I'm having a hard time keeping it on because my hands are always wet at work. I bumped my hand into the oven rack, and got a burn.  It doesn't want to heal.  I can't seem to get it to scab over.
* Me, abruptly and loudly:  Excuse me.. We're EATING !!!
* Waitress-  Oh, sorry... 
So much for "fine dining" at Sizzler.  Ugh.

Best Japanese Hibatchi in town. Love the atmosphere, the chef was hilarious and knew his stuff.  It's a brand new restaurant and not run down. Inside way nicer than the outside.  Prices very reasonable. You should go. It will be fun.  Great servers. I got the chicken Hibatchi and my daughter had the shrimp. We also got the CA roll.  No complaints.  Loved the salad and miso too.

Nice, clean, good service, good burger. Better choice tha McD's or other similar burger places. They serve dinners and salads as wellI will come back and try the Cheese curds instead of the fries. Not too impressed with them. I hear the frozen custard is good

The online ordering and pickup options are smooth,  well-executed and much appreciated. The food is fantastic. But the real difference is the people. They hustle, get things done right and they all do it with a great attitude and a caring for their customers that really shows.

Never had a bad meal at Goodwood! The ribs and pulled pork are always great. The slaw and potato salad are good sides and always taste homemade. We all love the jalapeño corn muffins as well. Large booths and tables so you feel spread out.

The greatest marketing fumble in fast-food history...
NO CHICKEN SANDWICH! 
and even worse, NO CUSTOMER SERVICE! 

I was so excited to try the Chicken sandwich and share it with all of our clients and staff that I made a trip to Popeye's on August 12th to secure the much hyped delicacy. After waiting in line for 15 minutes, all the while looking at the chicken sandwich in all its glory on the HD digital menu board, I get to the front of the single line (why they have more than one register and no staff to man them during the lunch rush is a mystery) and I am promptly told without apology that the chicken sandwich will not be here at this location for a while longer.
"Why is it on the menu?"... 

Fast forward a week and we call, many times, before the phone is answered. YES! They have the chicken sandwich. I go and get them and yes it is great! (despite a 10 minute wait for the fries, just enough time for the sandwiches to lose some of the desired crunch)

Fast forward another week and I am very excited to get one for my wife on Sunday, so I can get her verdict on which is better, Popeye's or Chick-Fil-A? We skip lunch, as we are not in an area with a Popeye's, it will be worth it I say, trust me. We are finally able to get to the Popeye's in Meridian and enter the drive through at around 5:00pm, starving. "We will have 2 chicken sandwiches please"....
The load-speaker blares back..."We don't have the chicken sandwich". I said I had just eaten one last week, so yes, you do have the chicken sandwich. "No, it's released on September 2nd"... no, it was already released. "That was a limited release to the community to gain interest in the sandwich, we will not serve it until September 2nd"... 

No apology, nothing. We left. We will not be back. 

Popeye's may have the better chicken sandwich (debatable), but it lacks restaurant cleanliness, promptness of service, product knowledge, a membership program and most important of all CUSTOMER SERVICE. 

Before Popeye's rolled out one of the greatest marketing and menu entries of all time, the upper management and leadership at the helm should have ensured that the chicken sandwich would have been a hit and it's restaurant's service and image were second to none. It would have secured loyalty and driven repeat business. Instead, this experience for me and millions of others across America only reinforced that the competition does it better - the whole package. 

It's "My pleasure" to bring this to the management's attention and hopefully, a great marketing / customer service lesson can be learned for the future.

Yum..healthy and delicious !  For $10 I got a bbq chicken salad a cup of mushroom soup a bread roll and a choc covered strawberry!  It was not a huge portion but perfect for me and very fresh!  I would defiantly recommend !
Better than the kohl s at the Boise towne square mall much nicer employees, great selection. I wish some of the merchandise was priced clearer but price scanners clear most of that up
Great food and excellent service. One of the best hibachi experiences we've had in a long time.

Seriously the noisiest hotel I've ever stayed in. Unless you get the top floor do not stay at this hotel. This is the second time I have been here for work and both times it sounded like I had an elephant staying  above me. Late at night and early in the AM.   I travel for work on a regular basis and I have never had that issue at any other hotel. I did call the front desk and they moved me to a top floor  but I had to repack all my stuff etc.

I actually like Johnny's when you take price performance into consideration.  I like it a heck of a lot more than Little Caesars which is the only place in the same price range.  For a $5 pizza, its a good value.  My only complaint is sometimes they are a little heavy on the sauce, which is decent sauce but I would like a better sauce/cheese balance.  They do a good job overall and I like bring able to walk up, get a pizza, and be out the door in a couple of minutes.

Update: I moved my review from 3 to 4.  Jonny's has become our go-to place when we need a quick supper that everyone in my family likes.  I get a pizza, cinnamon sticks and garlic sticks and it's less than $13 and we always have left overs.  Hard to beat that price-performance.  Johnnys is the best budget pizza place in Meridian.

For those of you who know me, I'm a big foodie. I've traveled across several countries to dine in elegance, and to discover the smallest local gems that nobody speaks of. So it's with pleasure that I endorse Epi's Basque Restaurant. 

From the moment you cross the threshold into grandma Epi's house, you are greeted with a warm smile and a familiar hug. It feels like you're home right from the start. 

The environment is quaint and cozy, and a place where strangers instantly become friends. 

The food is unprecedented, the layers of flavor erupt on your tastebuds like a perfectly orchestrated symphony. I ended up overeating just to experience the next dish. I highly recommend the lamb stew. 

By some miracle I was seated without a reservation, something the patrons next to me exclaimed rarely ever happens, so you'd do well to get reservations in advance. 

Drop me a line and let me know what you think!

Happy dining

:-)
New to the area... such a great find. The lobster bisque is so good. Perfect for cold days

Maybe just maybe third time is the charm.  We have watched this location with promising restaurants come and quickly fold away.  We called it " the place where restaurants go to die "

The restaurant is cavernous and maybe that's whats been the issue in the past. The restaurant needs to make use of the space wisely and the service as well as the quality has to be there. I wanted to give them a chance but our chance came quicker than we planned. Our Yelp group was planning to meet there with the first round on our illustrious ambassador. Who in their right mind would turn that down.  Not us.  The restaurant is dark but its not too dark. It definitely kind of classy or dressy but if you are sporting your flip-flops and shorts don't be embarrassed as there any number of folks dressed that way. We were greeted and taken to our special table off to the right. Our server asked us for the drinks, and I ordered a Appletini and my wife ordered the Blue Hawaiian. Both drinks had modifications and they were executed correctly.  We were seated around two hibachi grills. I was not planning on having hibachi as I was very interested in having sushi. My wife wanted the hibachi and chose the chicken and the shrimp. I wanted to sets of sushi rolls but wasn't really sure which two. I finally decided on the lobster roll and sushi appetizer which I think is called the Salmon Tartare?  If you have never experienced a hibachi show, by all means go and enjoy.  I have been to many over the years and the last time as in Boise, ( I won't mention where )albeit it was a too tired performance that was not cool.  These chefs basically do the same shtick, " Volcano " and " Japanese Egg Roll " but there are drop dead hilarious.    Its like a Chris Rock and Louis CK show but hosted by two Japanese chefs.  Maybe its the tune or the vibe from our group of foodie crazed Yelpers, but it was really cool. After the cooking, and several Sake shots and I am not talking about shot glasses. I am talking about being squirted with Sake from about 50 - 100 feet away and that happened twice and the third time and I was doubled barreled blasted.  Sure, I smelled like a 3-day bender in Vegas, but it was worth every squirt. 

The portions are good and my sushi was delicious. In all honesty, it was an awesome experience. We are looking forward to going back. Little did we know, that we would return the next night. See below.


UPDATE: 

We had such an awesome experience the previous night and anything less than that was going to be a disappointment. It was, matter of fact, it was simply a disaster. I won't share where it was, other than the fact, I already did the review and it was 1 star.  So, we came back to Izumi, where the girls had mochi ice cream, our son had California rolls, and my wife and I shared some Philadelphia rolls. The experience was just as good as the night before.  Wow. If you don't believe me check out the picture with our daughters and the waiter.

Classic!! 

We're looking forward to having many more experiences at Izumi and bringing friends from out of town and out of country to experience this gem right in our neighborhood.

NOTE: MERIDIAN LOCATION PERMANENTLY CLOSED.   

Replaced by Pacific Fish poke bar.  It is a poke bowl place owned by the same people. Overland and Vista Panda Garden in Boise is still open.

Review below still applies for Boise location.

These are my go to guys for no-nonsense quality Japanese and Chinese food.  I come here once or twice a week.

Service was spotty once or twice last winter but has improved to be near flawless.  Maybe they just know me.

I never get delivery so I cannot speak about that.

I like the Japanese stuff the best. They have great lunch specials.  Bento boxes are always a favorite and they have options for healthy eating and for watching carbs.

Comforting and unassuming.

Beware get everything on paper and a complete understanding of what is going to be done. Verify who is going to be the lead person on the job and they understand the scope of the job. This is a one shot deal as the owner takes the position that correcting any mistakes or  misunderstandings does not make money and no sense to return if a profit can not be realized. In his mind a property owner has no say that its his way and that customer service is deducting for the non completed work and life goes on. That
discourtesy by an employee is ok if they are a long term employee. This type of attitude will catch up with an owner and when the business is good I guess you don't need customer service. Make sure you think about using this company if you have a problem your on your own.

I can attest that ordering from their online store is a great experience. 

Best prices, and no worries about fake knives like on Amazon. Fast order processing and shipping, and nice personal touch with the lollipops.

I don't often buy knives, but when I do, it's from Cutlery Shoppe. 
Stay sharp my friends.

Dr. Piper is s great dentist.  Very caring and as gentle as can be for a dentist. I also called to get my husband in for a broken crown, they saw him right away and took great care of him.   The staff are very friendly also .

Glitz is now Fina Beauty and Nails and has been under new ownership since last year! This is THE best nail salon in town. Clean and of Quality. I've been getting my nails done for over 20 yrs and I love this place. Most of the girls stay booked so plan ahead- make an appointment and keep it. I have no lifting and any design you can think of they can do it- and any nails shape. Pedicures are always great, high end products are used and they are extremely sanitary.
