This is my wife and I's Anniversary, Birthday, date place. I remember the first time we went in my son was like 4 months old but we needed a nice "date" even if we had to take the kid. Chris saw that baby and scooped him up. I figured she would bring him back after a few minutes but she trooped around with my son the whole dinner showing him to other frequent guests like it was her own. It felt like we went to Aunt Chris's for dinner. She treats you like she has known you forever. We LOVED it and have never had an experience like this place EVERY TIME. We always enjoy the home like atmosphere of Basque restaurants all over but this one is in a league of its own in every way.

Came here and order the salmon with baked potato.  Salmon was boring and baked potato was way over cooked.  They also charged me for a wine that was $6 more per glass than what I ordered.  It was late and I didn't find the waitress after I paid my bill without noticing the error.  Pretty bad $40 dinner.

Good atmosphere, nice staff.  Only giving two stars for mine and my wife's lasagna. They both came with no cheese and were cold in the middle.  Friends ordered the scollops and said they were very rubbery.

7th person to review this McDonalds located on Eagle and Magic View Dr. and inside a Jackson/Chevron convenient store. This is my 422nd review on Yelp. 

I've visited this location several times and each time I have, the service has been Meh-to-Okay and on the slow side.  It is clean though and the service is average to good. 

Be sure to allow yourself some time-- don't stop here if you are short on time.

So, this would be a better review except they have a very strange and difficult coupon policy. We were there with another couple and with 5 other "strangers" (if you have ever been to a hibatchi type place you know you are seated around a large cook top and typically share this with others). 

After the meal we presented a small coupon and were told it is only one per table. Because one of the "other" people, not in our group, used a coupon we couldn't use ours. "One per table" our waitress said. We tried to explain that they weren't apart of our party, but it didn't matter. 

Probably a big enough issue to not return. BEWARE.

I'm from Texas, so I know good barbecue! If you're in the Boise area, give this place a try. Their Mac n cheese is the best ever. If I could only have one kind of Mac and cheese forever, this would be it. It's clean, the staff is nice, and there are lots of good choices! My recommendations for sides would include sweet potato fries, too. The Cole slaw was good, but nothing special. Brisket was perfectly cooked and delicious. Big fan. Wish I lived locally so I could go back!

Buffet tasted below average, the gravies had overcooked chunks of chicken which were rubbery. Chicken wings in the buffet was a surprise and the best dish by far. The gravies and tandoori chicken had tons of food color. Not a place I'd want to visit again.

Do you enjoy eating in an older bungalow in downtown Meridian? Do you enjoy friendly and knowledgable servers? Do you crave croquetas? Then get to Epi's. 

I had the pleasure of checking out this local institution with some friends for the holidays. Our server informed us they are booked through the new year and I understand why! There are plenty of smiles and plenty of shared plates to go around the table at Epi's. 

We shared a giant bottle of Eguren wine. It was a smooth, delightful Basque wine. Ham croquetas were best I've ever had and the calamari was tender. Not a bit rubbery! 

If they have the mushroom soup on offer, get it. Firm mushrooms with a zippy white pepper finish. Delicious!!

My husband and I shared the grilled chicken and the special: sole wrapped in shrimp and baked in a lemon butter sauce. The chicken was tasty but not too memorable. The fish was delectable. Would order again. 

Such a pleasant experience. I'll be headed back to Epi's for another special occasion very soon. It's a pricier restaurant, so not fit for most people on just an average day. But well worth the price for a unique experience.

It's a pretty nice theater. 

The tickets are inexpensive and I always order them ahead of time on Fandango. This cinema does reserved seating so that's always nice. 

The decor and look of the theater is amazing. But the seats are less comfortable. I would just bring a jacket and use it to prop up my lower back or use my purse.

I had never heard of Basque and I'm not too comfortable trying new food, but OMG, they have the BEST food and the service is  great. We'll definitely be going back. Oh, and be sure to bring an appetite because you get a lot.
what a great setup with everything under the Sun from fertilizer lawn care needs barbequeer trailers accessories plants and stuff for the yard what a great store to shop in

Let's talk real barbeque and they have it: Brisket! All around my table people we're ordering ribs and other 2nd Bests... Have the Brisket! I had an order of sweet potato fries and coleslaw... In Elgin, Texas and Kansas City  both gamed for Barbeque ... Brisket reigns... Goodwood's stand up to that quality
Great food and great service. I would highly recommend this restaurant for date night, family dinner night, or a special meal with friends.

Always a tasty choice, love me some Goodwoods
Loved them before Coronavirus, but now even more.  Fabulous job with their curbside ordering and pickup

I cannot thank Valley Custom Moving enough for what they did for me. I spent weeks going back and forth with them on plans to come to California to get my load, take it to Idaho... and then my plans got changed. It was a lot of back and forth and Corey was so patient and understanding the entire time. I even referred them to my brother-in-laws business who needed someone to help them move. We ended up using them to help us unload our truck and they were efficient, friendly, fun, careful, and professional. I really enjoyed working with them and look forward to working with them in the future for any other moves!

I love this place.  Dr. Karlfeldt and Dr. Butterfield helped me overcome adrenal fatigue and thyroid issues - naturally!  No drugs, no long treatment plans, just resetting my body's natural system and supplementing my diet.  The chiropractors are also amazing - Dr. Knotts has helped me with years of chronic back pain in just a few adjustments!

We just moved here from California so we are used to Benihana but Izumi fulfilled our expectations. The food was really great filet mignon, fried rice, and vegetables in particular. We had Tommy as our chef and he was so awesome. He had some great tricks and fun things for the adults and kids. We will be back!

Pizza was ready within 15 minutes of my phone order.  No line at the counter.  Friendly  employee was creative in the use of my phone app coupon to save me money.  Pizza was good.  A perfect experience.
Prices are good, service is attentive, food is great.  Atmosphere is ok.

My wife and I dropped into Bodovino last night to get a bit to eat before our movie.  We had been in before to sample some wine, but this time we thought we would sample the food.  I'm so glad we did.  I ordered the fried calamari, seared sea scallops, and a bowl of soup.  Of course, we could not avoid sipping on a couple of light pours from the wine machines with our meal.  As far as the food goes, it all exceeded my expectations.  The scallops were amazing.  Crunchy seared on the top and bottom, but perfectly cooked in the middle.  Delicious.  The Calamari was delicious as well, and my wife stated that soup was very good.  The place was busy and pretty full, but we found a place to sit at the bar. The service was great, and we were able to make it to our movie with plenty of time.  Very enjoyable place!

Pull up at 4:57 , they say they are closed. B.S. 
They care more about getting home than serving food. Punk kid!!!!!

Great food! We have been pleasantly surprised so far with the quality and taste of their food and good prices

And my food
http://instagram.com/p/zGXHHkKdQ9/

This was by far the most outstanding dental visit I have ever had.  Every single person was amazingly kind and informative. I have every confidence in them at this time and actually look forward to my next visit.

I have eaten at QDOBA in Reno for years. My friends even know me for it. I would eat there 4 times a week. I've eaten at this location twice now, and have been super disappointed with portion sizes. I specifically ask for an extra scoop of rice and beans so when I leave I'm not hungry still. I want to be full. Both times I went they made sure to give me minimal amounts of both, even after asking. I won't be returning to this location. I'll go up eagle and hope that the other location is better. If I wanted skimped on food I could order a 1 dollar burrito from Taco Bell in the same parking lot

If I could give this restaurant ten stars I would.  Eric the host is amazing, he greats you as you come in and thanks you for coming as you leave.  Our waiter, Andrew, was amazing, he was attentive and more than met our needs.  The food was easily the BEST we have had anywhere.  Simply a great experience.
Tom Storm

We really enjoyed our recent dinner at Epi's.  Chris is super friendly when she greets you at the door, and the whole experience makes you feel like you are a long time friend of the family.  Epi's is a great place to go for a special date, or just a quiet dinner.  My wife had a rib eye steak, and I had a sea bass special.  Both meals were wonderful.  We really need to frequent Epi's more often.  The food is great, the atmosphere is wonderful, and the service is awesome.  We'll be back!

==========

Turning vegan would be a big missed steak.

This place is so yummy! So of the best thai I've had. Went today around 5:10pm and wasnt busy at all. Our server was a really adorable older lady that seemed like one of the managers/owners. She was super nice and got our food out promptly. 

The atmosphere was good, classy but no too fancy, just casual enough to feel comfortable. We got the fried tofu for appetizer and it was delicious, fresh and hot and with a delicious plum sauce.
I ordered the pad see ew with tofu on medium spice level and it was DELICIOUS! Highly recommend this place

Expensive, but great friendly service and yummy food! I liked trying out the Basque food, which is mostly seafood or lamb so if you like that kind of food and want a new experience you then try this place out! It's a cute small setting inside which feels very homey and great for an intimate fancy dinner.

The negative reviews speak for themselves. Although being tired and wanting to give this place a and chance, I was naive. The server acted as if she was doing me a favor taking my order. I asked her several times for my bill only to fibd her taking other people's orders. Stay away. Beyound horrible service and food.

I shop at Kohl's in Meridian all the time. The associates are always friendly and helpful. There is a cashier, her name is Sandy, that works on the ladies registers. She's amazing! She's polite, professional and her customer service skills are top notch! When I go to check out, and I'm waiting line, I'll let other customers go ahead of me so I can go to Sandy's registrar. I just enjoy her kindness and willingness to help out any way she can. You don't find excellent service like this very often. So to the Store Manager at Kohl's, thank you for having Sandy in the spotlight at Kohl's, she's definitely one of the reasons I love to shop at Kohl's! Thank you Sandy!!

I hate to be be the lone dissenting vote on this place because the staff is incredibly nice and friendly but I was very disappointed in my meal. We took a long detour to go to this place, rather than one of the downtown options based on the 5 star average here but I didn't like what I ordered. 

I had the meatballs because at $14.95, it was the cheapest entree on the menu. I would have had the sizzling shrimp but I didn't want to pay $22.95 because a lot of times shrimp portions are small and I wasn't sure it would fill me up. Anyhow, the meatballs and the sauce they were in tasted identical to what you get in a meatball sub at Subway- that is to say, not bad, but not anything special at all. The fries were good, that I will admit. 

I had the Basque red bean soup because they were out of the shrimp soup and, again, I felt it was very mediocre- filling but not very flavorful. I liked the dressing on the salad- but not the salad itself- iceberg lettuce is just not my thing. (How about some greens please?) My wife had the soup, salad and sides and also thought it was mediocre. I'm guessing that we just ordered the wrong thing but I don't think the meatballs should even be on the menu unless they make them better. Prices are high here, even if you do get soup, salad and sides. I'd rather see some entree options in the $10-$15 range without the soup and salad.

Love this place! We went on Friday night and it was busy. That's ok. We ordered sushi and Japanese food...no hibachi tonight. 

My only complaint was that the bartender was sent over to take our order and serve us. I felt like we were constantly waiting on her. She knew this and apologized. Someone else ended up coming over and helping. If you are tending bar on a Friday than that is what you should do UNLESS you are eating at the bar...which we were not. We were at a table. 

Food was good. Service was not on this visit.

The people are friendly, the financing is ok, but they need to work on their timing. Spending 2+ hours in a furniture store is torture.....

The first set we bought we saved on the delivery fee and picked up for the warehouse. With our next purchase we opted for the delivery to save our backs. Delivery was scheduled 3 weeks out, not a huge deal, but still a little annoying. Then the delivery times....a 3 hour window, and we both work. We requested multiple times to have the delivery team call one of us when they're on their way so we can meet them at the house - were told they'd put a note in but no guarantees and the drivers can only wait for 20 minutes before they have to leave. 

Day of delivery came, the online tracker doesn't work in Boise, so we hoped for the best. Got a call after the delivery team had sat and waited fur 10 minutes! Luckily the husband works semi-close and made it home....
Great food and service definitely recommend! Great family environment reasonable priced

My stay there was horrible and I only stayed there at night in order to sleep. They didn't have movies that would always help me go to sleep.         
I called the front desk and was informed they on longer offer movies that you have to have a Netflix account. It was clear that I was upset and the person didn't even care if I was. The towels were like sandpaper and not soft.

Son fell and split his head open on a broken clothing display. He was bleeding everywhere and while I was trying to hold him and keep compression on his wound employees were following me around asking me to fill out an accident report. No offer to help or see if he was ok. I was sobbing and repeatedly saying I needed to find my husband. No help in locating him. Again just followed around while an employee kept reporting to someone over her headset where I was so the manager could find me to fill out a report. Again no concern with my sons gushing wound. Still haven't heard from risk management to help with our ER bill. Shocked and disappointed in the employees at the Meridian location.

One of our favorite Friday night eateries.  Quality and care are the two main ingredients here.  Never a gamble.

Bigger than average menu.  Mostly burgers and fries but with fish and chips and pot roast dinner as added options.  Everything we've tried has been good, and nicely presented.  Nothing worse than spending the money to take your family out and having the food show up sloppily put together, that won't happen here.

The young staff seems very well managed, it's obvious that friendliness is high priority here.  Either they all really care or they're great at pretending.  

Culver's is counter service, but with a restaurant feel.  Tons of cozy seating, more like an IHOP than a fast food place.

Always look forward to being consistently pleased every time we eat here, keep it up!

This is a great spa! From the moment I walked in they were friendly and very accommodating. They offered me tea or water. I came in for the detox wrap and it was very relaxing. I loved the music...it was though I was next to the ocean or stream. Brooks was very friendly and made me feel welcome. I'm looking forward to my next appointment.

This is the best Indian food in the Boise area. There are some other great Indian restaurants around but this one instantly became my new favorite. The food is fresh and seems more fragrant and flavorful than anywhere else.  Some of my favorites are the chicken tikka kebab, the papadam with onion chutney,  the lamb korma, and the rice pudding. The atmosphere is warm and inviting, the service is great,  and the prices are good--the lunch buffet is an especially great deal,  but the dinner prices are not bad at all. Every time I come here I leave happy.

* Always loved their beans and rice, green beans, and fried shrimp. The chicken & bones itself did not hit any sweet spots with me.
* Today I noticed some tasty-looking combo meal deals, including chicken tenders, which seemed pretty good to a hungry boy with no particular place to go for lunch. I got the 5 mild tenders, with my 2 biscuits, green beans, and beans and rice.
* While waiting for my order, I noticed they had sturdy chairs and benches to sit on, and authentic New Orleans style jazz music playing at a comfortable volume, not distracting too much from the enjoyment of my food.
* The actual number of tenders... 5 is only a ballpark figure. I counted 4 small ones, 2 medium, and 3 large. No matter how many bites I took, this filled me right up. I also tried three dipping sauces: mustard horseradish, BBQ, and cayenne corn syrup (aka bayou buffalo sauce). They were better than the similar dips you find at the competitor from Kentucky, but still have room for improvement.
* Only one napkin dispenser in this place, really? For ten dollars worth of good good, I can visit the dispenser a few times. It seems I got more than my moneys worth today at Popeye's.

I decided to try this place out since it is so close to my work and there really are no good sushi places on Eagle road.  The atmosphere is very inviting with a hi-end feel.  There is a general dining area, a bar, a sushi bar and in another large room they have several hibachi tables where they cook the food in front of you.  It was pretty empty inside at about 1pm but I assume that is because they just opened this week.  It's odd that they have not really done much marketing to get the word out that they are open.  The menu is HUGE with tons of options.  They have a very affordable lunch menu on the back.  I ordered their 3 roll lunch special.  It came with a very tasty miso soup.  I had the spicy tuna, spicy salmon and the Idaho roll.  Holy cow!  Some of the best sushi I've had in the Boise area.  I was not expecting that at all.  The presentation was very well executed as well.  Our service was excellent and the food came out very quickly.  For a first visit on an opening week I give it 5 stars.

There are not enough positive adjectives to do this restaurant justice. It deserves ten stars. Not only is the food off the charts and the service amazing, but the atmosphere truly takes you away.  You feel like you are in Europe and surrounded by family and friends.  There is a warmth here that I cannot describe.  You must have a reservation, but wow, what a special experience!!

First let me say service was awesome 
Was suprized  what a 6oz sirloin was very small
Food was good . but a little overpriced  !

I'm only giving 4 stars because I wish they did gluten free soy sauce at least for my sushi . 
My 18 month old has a wheat and soy sensitivity so the waiter was very careful and courteous to have his grilled shrimp done in the back kitchen. 
The service was great. They were a bit behind this Saturday night but the waiter and cook at the Hibachi grill apologized countless times. The cook put on quite the show with fire and Sake shots while making some huge flames table side. I got a Mai Thai cocktail from the bar too and it was amazing. The bartender was super sweet and dressed super cute! She was very friendly and helpful. 
We'll be going back for sure and we'll recommend to others.

I haven't been to the dentist in 10+ years.  Having a terrible toothache, they were able to get me in within a day!  Dr. Pieper, his assistant, Roxie and the hygienist were nothing short of amazing.  I was a nervous wreck and they made me feel extremely comfortable.  They went over all my options and never once did I feel pressured into doing a procedure I didn't want/need or feel like my teeth were going to rot and fall out if I didn't listen to them.  I will definitely be returning and referring everyone I know to them!  Thank you for everything!!!

I've been wanting to try this place for a long time but given the crazy reservation schedule I was unable to secure one until last weekend. I made a reservation for 10 people and we were sat right on time.

Most of our party ordered appetizers and they were pretty good, but nothing to write home about or worthy of 5 stars. I shared 2 entrees with my girlfriend both the lamb chops and the 2 way cod. The lamb chops which I ordered medium rare came out more then well done. 2 others in our party ordered the lamb chops and they all had to be sent back. The butter cod was good but extremely heavy and rich, bring your best stomach. The grilled with pimentos was decent but pretty bland. So your choice, heavy or bland. 

Another thing is you need a good 1:30-2 hours to eat here as it takes a bit of time to eat appetizer, soup, salad and entree. 

The best part of the Epi experience was making the reservation as the owner is spunky and overly nice.

The biggest part of why I gave this experience 3 stars was because about half of us were sick after eating here and we spent most of our night in the you know where. The consistent 5 stars make me think either the Yelp community here has never eaten out of Boise or that it was a fluke night. 

Maybe I'll give it another try, but I've got to do some stomach training first.

Where to begin? I went in with my girlfriend intending to use a coupon that we had just gotten in the mail. I've never been to a Sizzler before, and I don't think I will be returning.

First off, the Sizzler business operation model is quite weird. Upon entering the doors, you order everything up front at the counter, and then sit down. This is similar to how a buffet works, but doesn't make sense for a restaurant. I like to be seated as I look through the menu, instead of standing by the front door in a line figuring out what I want on the spot.

This also sucks for those of us who like to have a couple alcoholic beverages. This means that you have to order them all upfront, which is a poor business model. The beers here are about $5 a pop for the basic selection, which is a bit insulting. Hint, you'll sell more beers if you serve them throughout the dining experience.

The second problem is that I was overcharged using the coupon. I ordered a small steak, a beer, a baked crab dish that included the salad bar, and my bill was $52. I went back up to the front and got it sorted out and it came to $42 instead. They had charged me for two salads instead of one. Still, that's a very high price to pay for mediocre food.

We both just weren't feeling it when it came to how we ordered food, the price that we paid, and the quality of the food.

My wife is of Basque decent and we were in the mood for a lamb dinner.  We were not disappointed!  The lamb loin was perfect.  While the restaurant is usually crowded, a reservation is recommended.  If you like Basque, this is the place to go in Boise.

I moved here from CA a year ago and found  Diane's Eyelashes through a Groupon offering.  I had talk to several eyelash professionals before but Diane was the first one that I felt was knowledgeable about the service she provided.  And I was right.  Since being a client of Diane's I have tried other services offered at Precision Laser, specifically facials by Christina and Dysport with Jackilyn.  I have never found a group of professional, caring and knowledgeable people in one place. The icing on the cake is that the pricing is very reasonable with ever changing monthly specials you can bank up.  I have referred family and friends without disappointment.   Thank you to everyone at Precision Laser!!

This was a birthday dinner for my wife. Definitely in the top five of our culinary experiences over the years.

We decided to go for the lamb. Previously, the only lamb I loved was the Lamb of God. But seriously, this lamb was delicious. If you like a delicious beef steak, you will really enjoy this lamb. Not gamey or mutton-tasting at all. Ours was the grilled lamb.

The service was tremendous. Our waiter (didn't catch his name) was great, very informative, accommodating, kind, friendly, but not at all intrusive. The perfect balance of attentiveness and respect for our privacy.

Chris, the owner, met us right as we walked through the door. So welcoming, so engaging. Very relational place. The room was a buzz with friendly chatter, greetings, and good cheer.

We concluded our meal with two of the dessert selections. We had the green apple bread putting with a caramel glaze and also the citrus cake with raspberry glaze. UNBELIEVABLE. 

We will definitely be going back to Epi's.

I cannot fathom why the reviews are so low. Moving from CA and everybody, including Joel, Jerry,Ike snd every single customer service person has been amazing! Delivery had been fantastic and even explained the nuances of the items I purchased. They took extra time to fit my large refrigerator in my small hole so it looks snd works perfectly.  Great attitudes and greT service!!!

Our new favorite place! Filet Mignon amazing. Noodles amazing. Sparkling sake Amazing. The Mongolian Mai Tai was amazing. Our server was excellent! Everything was superb and don't forget the fried banana dessert! We had a baby as well and kids it was fun for the whole family. Super nice atmosphere wasn't too loud and it was still private setting. The adults got to enjoy the food as well as the kids and we didn't even have to get a babysitter. Our new birthday spot as well!

.Went on Saturday night with SO for date night.  Seated immediately and offered drinks by waitress, but no indication that we'd be waiting for 45 minutes while they filled the rear of the table for Hibachi!  Some info on timeframes would have been helpful, but she admitted she was 'new' and was scrambling to keep her tables under control, OK I get it.  45 minutes later the chef starts the lack luster show, I've seen many others and he was not that interactive.  The food was Eatable but nothing special.  Everything's as covered in the same boring sweet teriyaki sauce.  Wait help continued to be horrible, at one point, bringing out her busboy crate to restock the sauce dishes at the table, right on the table where we were eating our dinner! Wow- really?!  After 2 hours and $90 dollars later we left, very disappointed.  Food was meh and he service was slow and horrible.  To top things off as we drove out of the parking lot we saw 5 employees back smoking, talking and taking a break!  We WILL not be back.
Salmon was dry and tasted cold.   Fried pickles no good.  I would t come here to eat.

DELISH.  wasnt sure i would love... but i so did. The sauce is great  i had chicken fried steak. It was huge. A lil too breaded. Gravy was so goid. Mac n chz was fair. However husbands babybacks were so good

A great place for lunch or dinner.  I take customers here once in a while and am never disappointed.  So far everything I've had off the menu has been very good.  Nothing so-so, nothing adequate but everything very good.  Can't ask for much more than that.

Love this place! Where else can you taste bottles of wine that are $100 or more a bottle but only paying for a few ounces so you can try them all. The downtown one has considerably more wine options but the one in meridian has better food in my option. The staff was amazingly nice, cracking jokes and making sure everyone had a good time. Trying to get my management to throw our Christmas party here :)

This is a decent public pool. Plenty of life guards. They change stations about every ten minutes so as to not become bored with their watch. Very smart! The baby pool (generally for ages 5 and under) is warm and shallow; but the really thoughtful feature is the large umbrellas shading the baby pool. Many babies skin just don't tolerate sunscreen; and these guys get that! 

They rent out noodle floats for .50 cents because other than wearable floats, floatation toys are not allowed, although you can bring your own water noodle. They also sell candy and quick energy snacks. There is an ice cream shack just outside of the entrance, but you must consume it outside of the pool premises. There is no food (other than the little candy they sell) allowed inside the pool area. I wish they would enforce this a bit more strictly. There are too many times I've stepped on chips, or sandwich crusts from ghetto slobs and their children who can't seem to go a couple hours without food. 

My real reason for the missing star is they are only open a couple hours at a time. Yes, the admission is very affordable, but the late afternoon hours make it difficult for those of us who like to swim early on the day or make a day thing of lounging by the pool.
Their lunch buffet is absurdly cheap at only $9.99/ person and DEFINITELY worth it! The butter chicken , coconut corn masala, and Navratan korma  were utterly DELIGHTFUL! So Yummy!

Had high hopes for this place but wasn't at all inspired and really just run of the mill stuff...salad was nothing special and lobster bisque was more of a chowder and way too rich at that. I just didn't think it was anything special and don't feel any need to go back. I will say that it was packed and probably will be for some time...really more of a statement of what we have in this area than anything else.
I watched the new Star Wars here. The movie went completely black 3 SEPARATE TIMES and I missed about a half hour of runtime in total. The audio still worked so everybody shouted and left the theater
Lupe LaFrenz was great.  She was knowledgeable, friendly and made my shopping experience memorable.

This place is great! I had Sydney for a gel polish manicure and she did a great job! It was her first day and she was easy to talk to and quick, and of course my nails look beautiful! I would recommend! And lots of colors to choose from!

Clean your restaurant!!! We were really excited to visit a new place! This is not new... Same decor, same owners I think? The tables were sticky, floors dirty, bathrooms disgusting and the area near the bathrooms was piled with everything from food storage, old furniture and cleaning supplies. The food was mediocre and now my whole family is at home with upset stomachs...

This place was great. My wife and I had an excellent meal. We had heard about Rick's and were excited to give it a try. 

We had the garlic wings and split the Salmon. Both were excellent. The wings weren't spicy (I love spicy but my wife doesn't), but they were very tasty. The blue cheese sauce was made with yogurt and mixed with diced celery in a type of celery salad. It was awesome I usually ignore the celery that comes with wings but I ate every bite. 
The salmon was great too.  They split it for us without complaint and it was excellent. 
We mentioned to Julie (our server) that this was our first time at Rick's. A few minutes later, a flaming slice of tiramisu shows up on our table. Totally cool!  It was excellent, the meal was excellent, and Julie was not only very nice, she was also a fantastic asset to Rick's. 
Thanks Julie and thank You Rick's for a great dining experience.

Contacted Handyman Connection, set up an appt. for the next business day. Work was quoted, did the work right then and there. Job was done in a very professional manner, would highly recommend them, as well as hire them again. VERY pleased!!

Wow!! Best food, best service and we had the best time!!  This will definitely be our "go to" place when we visit Meridian/Boise!  You definitely need a reservation, and you will definitely love it if you ask for the enclosed porch seating, where it is quiet and private!   We had amazing ham croquettes (it came with12 portions) for an appetizer that definitely melted in your mouth!  We had the scallop's, lamb stew, shrimp and halibut main course dishes, and each one was FANTASTIC!!  The dinner entry came with an amazing home made cream of shrimp soup, a salad with a light house dressing, and 2 vegie sides.  No one had room for dessert, but they sent us home with the Mousse Cake and it was very tasty!!  You will not be disappointed at Epi's!!  Thank you Epi's, for the best dining experience I can remember!
My favorite Thai place in Idaho.  Flavorful and consistently great food for dine in or take out.

Amazing place!!! 
As we were driving up, the owner, Chris was setting up outside. She asked if we had reservations. We said, "no." 
She said that was fine, as she thought, and said she had a table for two available until 7:15pm (it was 6pm when we arrived). 
She asked if we had been in before. We stated no, that we knew of basque food from Bakersfield, California. She started talking about Woolgrowers and such. She sat us and came over to visit numerous times, checking on us, our food and visit. 
Our waitress, Angie, was amazing as well. We had the lamb stew, sea scallops and of course, clam chowder. 

Thank you for seating us on such short notice!! Reminded us of home... we will be back!!!
Anna took so much time with me making it perfect! I'm so happy with my brows!! I will be back. Thanks Anna.

The staff was competent and extremely friendly. I walked in to get a to go order of two sandwiches and walked out in under 3 minutes. Ben (I believe was his name) was manning the front desk and was one of the nicest people I've met in food service. Very surprised to see such a low review, I will definitely be going back. Also, the food was hot and obviously fresh.

I love this place and I've only been a client/customer of theirs for one month. I have three small senior dogs and they all need their teeth cleaned about once a year. Linder Pet has memberships that come with a yearly teeth cleaning (which are expensive) and all other services are discounted if your pet has a membership. I paid $840 total for my three dogs ($25/month for the first 2 dogs, $20/month for the 3rd dog). You can either just do the monthly payment for pay in full, I paid in full so that I could get all 3 dogs teeth cleaned up front instead of waiting until the membership is paid in full. Well worth it. They've taken very good care of all three of my dogs. Also, the times I've made an appointment, I have been seen at my appointment time, I didn't have to wait past that.
Epi's does not need good reviews...food very good, excellent service, very clean and Super Nice staff make for a very pleasant experience...love to go there.  I loved the Portugese wine.too.

Even though this place is in the epicenter of "Meridifornia", I'll definitely be back.    I met a friend here for a Saturday lunch.   The atmosphere seemed elegant, the food was awesome, and the service was excellent.

I order Kra Pao Moo Sup (spelled KraPao Moo Sap at other places).   It's apparently traditional Thai "comfort food".   One web search result calls the dish, "The most common Thai dish many tourists never get to know."    Some Thai vocabulary for you, Pad = stir fried,  krapao = holy basil,  moo = pork,  sap = minced.

The dish was not on the regular menu, but was one of the Chef's specials.  I hadn't seen it served with a fried sunny-side up egg before, and since I don't care for yolk, asked whether the egg could be scrambled.   I found it comical that the answer was "no" (if you can cook a fried egg, can't you stir the egg up and cook it the same way?).   But, since I don't know the machinations of a Thai kitchen, and didn't want to annoy someone who was about to cook my food, I just declined the egg, rather than argue "you can TOO cook a scrambled egg !"  (And the idea of scrambled eggs mixed in with the minced pork seems like a good idea for when I attempt to recreate this dish at home sometime, or when I stretch the leftovers with more rice).

Anyway, the Krapao Moo Sap was very good.  I order it "Thai spicy" (described as the hotness the Thai cooks would make it for themselves).   It was definitely hot, and the quickly refilled, well-carbonated diet coke/pepsi (not sure which) cooled the heat.

My friend had some orange colored curry dish with duck meat.  It wasn't something I'd order, but he seemed to think it was good. 

Thanks for a great meal, Thai Basil.

Epi's is a super restaurant. You feel like you're in the living room of your best friends home. The food is so good, so rich and homey. We have been there several times And have never been disappointed. The calamari is off the charts yummy and so is there lamb stew. The waiters are attentive and so experienced

I'm not impressed with one of the Lowes truck drivers right now. He pulled a serious rookie or d!@& move at the gas station on Victory and Meridian roads. He stopped traffic just so he could cross the double yellow line and turn into the gas station. Gave me poo poo looks because I wouldn't move out of the way for his most precious highness. A work van backed up just for him, due to him pushing his way into the turn lane for west bound traffic only. I hope he appreciates how special he is,and next time choose not to advertise those bad driving choices with the company vehicle.

If you want quality top of the line blades for all use, you would have to be crazy not to buy from Cutlery Shoppe. This place has the "BEST" deals that you can find on the Internet. I have been buying knives from BladeHQ for a long time until I recently discovered Cutlery Shoppe. I will have to give them my business now. Thank you guys!!

Wow! This place has gone down the tubes. I will not be back....ever. They've gone from good prices with a large amount of great food to the same price, with only 1/3 the serving size and crappy food. I paid $5 per slice of duck that was tough and supposed to be served on a "bed" of kale; I had 4 small leaves. And...and...add insult to injury they serve cheap, crappy wine on average. Their "featured passport wines" are sour, dry and rotten. I've been a wine buyer for 20 years and this stuff is poor quality. I don't know how they choose their wines but maybe they should reconsider it. Not good anymore. Don't go!

If you are needing someone to help you move, these are the guys to call. We had a logistical nightmare on our hands in that the company called PODS did not deliver to the town where we were moving. We needed someone to travel to Everett, WA (PODS most northern delivery center) and take the items out of our three containers on separate dates and deliver those belongings to our house in Lynden, WA. I anticipated it to be expensive, a scheduling problem and a trust issue due to past experiences with other companies. Cameron was on top of it. He and Michael made a great team. They handled our belongings with care. They were efficient and very professional. They were on time and worked there tails off until the job was finished. They were easy to get along with and you could tell they not only enjoyed their work but also working with each other. We really struck gold with these guys and couldn't give them a higher recommendation. No broken items, no headaches and reasonably priced. What more could you want? Call them. You won't be sorry.
I loved it!  Wonderful, tender brisket and pulled pork.  Seasoned perfect!  Very friendly staff!

Went to Boise on a business trip and got a recommendation to stop by here for lunch. I figured any airport that posts "beef country" should be good at barbecue? I ordered the 3 meat platter (chicken, burnt ends, pulled pork), which comes with two sides, I chose Mac and cheese and also the coleslaw.

Everything was pretty tasty, the burnt ends was the best. The brisket ends were perfectly smoked and went well with the sweetness of the pulled pork and coleslaw.

The only thing was the Bbq chicken (1/2 of whole), was slightly dry.

Overall, good but not great.

The best Indian food in Idaho, hands down. Me and my husband have been coming here almost weekly for close to a year. We love the lunch buffet because it gives us the option to have a variety of the dishes. The vegetarian options pair well with the tandoori chicken, butter chicken, and lamb vindaloo ( just a few of my favorites). Then you can end your meal with the rice pudding and a wonderful cup of chai tea. Really a perfect meal every time. Just a perfect flavorful amount of space in every dish. If your interested but not ready to commit to a full dinner try the lunch buffet. But no matter what you get I'm sure you will be very happy. Well worth the drive Everytime!

I took my parents to Goodwood just the other day because I have had a great experience and good food there before. I was very disappointed this time. Three out of four of us ordered a rib eye steak and we all agreed that it was not a good piece of meat. It was very tough and grizzly. All our steaks were cooked to order (rare and medium rare). I have had a better steak and Texas Roadhouse! Our server , Hailey, did a great job. The price of the meal was overpriced for what we received.

Delicious!! Lots of people waiting but we only waited about 15 minutes on a Friday night. Food was great! Burnt ends were to die for. My hubby had ribs and they were flavorful and falling off the bone.
Service was quick and our waiter was so nice. We are visiting Boise and decided to give it a try. I wish they were in California where we live!

Cozy and quaint family operated restaurant. The first thing that will hit you as you walk in, is how much the operators of Epi's value each customer. After you begin your meal, you will taste the care taken in preparation. This is what all restaurants should be, but very few accomplish. An absolute treasure!!
Fun driver. Fast and good. Works hard for Express service here in the Treasure Valley.

Such a cute little quaint place for a quiet date night. ALL of the food is amazing. Absolutely love the cream of mushroom soup. It is so good! Also get the croquetas for appetizer. You can't go wrong with anything on the menu. Service is amazing! Chris is such a sweetheart, makes you feel at home. Definitely need a reservation, usually a couple weeks in advance.
Was in town for a few nights-stopped by because it was close. Waitress was Hailey- totally AWESOME!  Get her if you can. Food was great and I definitely will be back!
Went back this week and a completely different experience. Everyone was super friendly especially the hostess . The food was also amazing. So glad we went back to this place. We will be going back!

Great service, quality furniture. They make and distribute their own furniture, so the prices are decent for how well made  everything is. They also have the best mattress brands. And the best part about my shopping experience is in regards to the sales people, they aren't pushy at all and are very educated on their product.

Let's talk real barbeque and they have it: Brisket! All around my table people we're ordering ribs and other 2nd Bests... Have the Brisket! I had an order of sweet potato fries and coleslaw... In Elgin,Texas and Kansas City  both gamed for Barbeque ... Brisket reigns... Goodwood's stands up to that quality!

It's my go to Thai in the valley. Food is always great and service is too!  The waitress remembered my order from before and asked if I wanted the same thing?  What?  Who does that?  She did!  I love this place. Never disappointed.

It's always super crowded and the sticker price for 90 minutes hurts the wallet. Especially when you have to dodge Aiden, Jayden,Kayden,Bradeyn, McKenna, and McLou just to find a spot to sit or put your stuff away.

They sell wine so that helps.
Really good food. I recommend this for people that wants to try thai food and you're away from home.

We just popped in for a quick glass of wine after dinner in the Village.  What a fun place.  My wife and I had not experienced the "Wine Vending Machine" concept before, so this was a bit of an adventure for us.  The appeal here is that you can try several different wines during the course of an evening.  I love variety, so when purchasing a bottle of wine I like to try new and different tastes, often times without any reference or recommendation.  Sometimes this is successful, and a great new discovery is made.  However, sometimes I get a dud, which results in a wasted bottle of wine relegated to be cooked in the next batch of spaghetti.  Bodovino gives you the opportunity to do wine tasting at the comfort of a restaurant, which seems like a great concept for me.  The recommendations for food have me intrigued, even though we didn't have anything to eat while visiting here.  We will be back (since we have $$$ on a wine-machine-access-card), and maybe next time we will get something to eat as well!

I was so pleasantly surprised by this place - they advertise a $4.99 pizza and I figured it was a personal pizza.  Come to find out, it was larger than a little casears $5 and so so much better...fresh ingredients, sauce and dough made from scratch - I was able to feed our family of 6 for $20!  I will never go back to LIttle Caears!

Won't go too far into it but the short of it is this. My wife had a verbal agreement with Minerva at the meridian id store for a table. I went down to the store to purchase it and Lupe doubled the shipping cost. Cancelled it the next day with corporate cs (gabby) and waited 10 days for refund in my card. Called corporate back a few times trying to get info and I get a text saying they are delivering it. Called again and got Deena who actually cancelled it. 
Terrible customer service at Meridian ID store

My wife and I have been to this location about a dozen times over the past few years.  Reservations are recommended as quite often there is a disheveled line extending out passed the front doors. 

Our initial impressions of this restaurant lead us to believe it was a popular restaurant serving quality food.  On many of our visits over a year ago the meats (prime rib, rib eyes) seemed to be of a higher quality.  It was tender, juicy and cooked or smoked to perfection.  On other rating sites I had given them five stars.  However, lately something regarding the steaks seems to have changed.  During our last two visits the steaks were actually tough.  Both times we had ordered prime rib.  Maybe their method of preparing the meat has changed or possibly their meat supplier has changed?   On a high note the flavor of the meat was still good. 

We have nothing but praise for the servers at Goodwood BBQ.   All of their servers have been top notch and the last server was exceptional.  

We will give them another try in the near future.
They do a fantastic job for both myself and my toddler! Very thorough, very kind, and view oral health as vital to the health of the whole body. I would recommend them to anyone!

I'll keep it short and sweet- if you think Domino's is delicious then this is the place for you. It tastes just like Domino's: cheap tasting- down from the cheese to the sauce and bread. It was just plain awful to me.
Pizza is really good!  Staff is really friendly, highly recommended!  Ex-Girlfriend, Chicken Tenders, Mozzarella sticks are awesomd!

Awful, awful, awful. Before going we looked at the reviews and decided it was worth a try. It was just awful. The burger patty was paper thin, I kid you not! We got the much raved about cheese curds and they were disgusting. Fries were cold and the bun was hard. The only good part was the nice kid who took our order. Everything else was awful.

What a nice experience!   Not sure what more I could add that the legion of other 5-star reviewers haven't already said, so I'll be brief:

 - Gorgeous appointments inside
 - Giant Dolby screens available
 - Uber-comfortable seating with wide arm-rests and some reclining
 - Tastiest movie popcorn I've ever had!
 - Free drink refills on the large soda -- although you'd need six people to drink one

Our movie (trailers) started about 10 minutes after the stated start time of the movie.  I was a little bit glad because it was our first visit here and we drove all around the village trying to figure out how to get in and where to park.

Looking forward to next time when I'll try the gelato or maybe a cupcake.

My wife and I recently began going to Dr. Grant and would not go anywhere else! Dr. Grant and his staff are amazing and any apprehension of dental visits have been melted away. We are expecting a new member of our family and we cannot wait until they have teeth so we can introduce them to the superb team at Scott W Grant, DMD,
Another amazing time at this place...Andy thank you for taking care of me and my family. You were amazing and knowledgeable and we enjoyed our night at here as we always do! 5 stars to you girl!

Over-hyped, over-priced, and underwhelming. I'm not sure what the hype and fervor is about. I read about this place in the Statesman and wanted to try it because I loves me a good burger. Upon entering the restaurant on a Saturday night just after 8pm the place was completely empty except for one older couple sitting in the corner.

I went for the Nick Burger which has bacon and avocado on it. Honestly, the avocado was the best part of the burger. The hamburger patty was incredibly bland. C'mon, guys... A little dash of salt and pepper won't hurt anything. Biting into this thing was reminiscent of a Jack In The Box Bacon Cheeseburger. Only, this burger ALONE was $8 with tax. Just goes to show that higher pricing may give the impression of premium quality, but it doesn't always mean that you're getting it. There was absolutely no balance to this thing. A big bite of undercooked fatty bacon was the only thing that really had much flavor. But, it's bacon. Pretty hard to screw that up and yet they did.

The onion rings weren't bad, but they weren't great either. And, at $5 for an order, with tax,they are a terrible value for what you get. Furthermore, their registers have the "coerced tip" system where during checkout your practically are pressured into leaving a tip with the cashier staring at you during the checkout process. The lowest preset option is 18% and this is before you even see what you're getting. I try to not dine at places that use that pressure tactic to extract a tip from you. 

This place is definitely a "one and done" experience for me.

Being Indian I can honestly say this place has real authentic Indian cuisine! I took my client here for lunch one day. It was her first time trying Indian food & she loved it! We chose the buffet of course. It was coming out very fresh & they kept the bars clean. The butter chicken & chicken curry was so good. The lam just melts in your mouth! The chai was amazing, reminded me of morning with my amma.. I can't wait to come back for another lunch soon.

Loved this place! Hibachi was very good! Whole atmosphere was so fun- kids loved the onion volcano and the whole "show". Had really high expectations based on my experiences at other Japanese steakhouses and Izumi met all my expectations. Food portions were very good and prices were very reasonable. Servers were very friendly. Husband had sushi and said that it was very good and fresh. Will definitely be coming back here! If you tell them you are there celebrating a birthday they will give the birthday person a free ice cream sundae and will bring a big drum out and sing happy birthday to them!

We've been to Jump Time several times.  It's essentially a gigantic warehouse filled with trampolines, allowing you to jump, hop, and play to your heart's content.  They also have a swimming pool-sized pit filled with foam blocks to dive in, a dodge ball area, and a mini basketball court where the added boost of a trampoline makes shooting baskets a lot more interesting.

If I were to have written this review in the winter, it would merit four stars--not perfect, but very good.  So fun that even my straight-laced brother in law, an attorney, loved jumping.  But our most recent visit (in July) has changed that opinion because Jump Time is not air conditioned.  It was 100 degrees outside, and 90 degrees in the building.  I asked a worker if the air conditioning was broken, and he confirmed that they just don't have it.  They do have several large fans to at least keep the air circulating, but it's not enough.  I was uncomfortable just sitting there, and my children, who were running and jumping, were asking to leave after 20 minutes--an unfathomable thing coming from kids who begged to go in the first place. 

Jump Time is also pretty spendy ($10 per hour, per child) and they don't do a very good job policing the jumpers.  They assign each jumper a colored wrist band that corresponds with your "end time," and they announce over the loud speaker when your color's time has ended, but they don't enforce it.  That means that kids whose parents pay attention to them leave when they're supposed to, but rowdy, unsupervised kids with checked-out parents linger far past their paid time. 

I split the difference on my review--three stars (two in the Summer, four in the winter), but personally, we won't go back until after the hot weather ends.
Best dinner we have had in years!!! From Eric greating us at the door through dessert perfect!!!!  Will be back!!!!
I am a cookie fanatic. I had super high expectations going in and THEY WERE MET. So so good. The best cookie I've ever had. And I've had a lot!!!

New to the area last June, after extensive research, my husband, father-in-law & I chose Treasure Valley Family Medicine's superb practitioners, supported by an outstanding office staff, for our primary health care needs.  The bad news: those needs have been higher-than-usual in the ensuing months.  TVFM has consistently demonstrated that they are willing & able to go the extra mile in providing stellar health care.  Our hats are off to Dr. Crownover, Dee & their wonderful staff.  We are truly in awe of the level of your dedication, expertise, attention to detail, warmth & compassion!
We are fond of their curries: green, yellow or red. Good depth of flavor, fast service and always pleasant. It's our go to place for Thai food.

Annie is a great clerk and helped with w/ this issue at Kohls. If you have a cash gift card for Kohls...watch out! Kohls will NOT let you use it any way you want. I made a purchase to get my 30% discount and I always turn around and Pay in Full right there so I do NOT get a bill. Nope...Kohls will not let you do that. Ridiculous, right? Cash is cash?! So, I probably will not be shopping at Kohls in general. However, this store in Meridian has very nice people that truly want to help. Annie & Jim & Troy are great! Not their fault. They do their best! This is a Cooperate Issue w/Kohls. Hope they read this and change their ridiculous rule or they will lose more and more good customers!

I heard about Epi's from a friend, but when I called in for a reservation I was completely confused. The woman there talked to me like I was a long lost friend. When I came in with my family, the same thing happened. She must be confusing me with someone that she knows.

This continued all night as the waiter brought dish after dish of delicious food. By the end of the night I finally figured out that this is how everyone is treated at Epi's.

When my family comes to visit from out of town, they always ask if we can go out to eat at the nice little house with the super-friendly people.

That's Epi's...
They do a fantastic job for both myself and my toddler! Very thorough, very kind, and view oral health as vital to the health of the whole body. I would recommend them to ano

I was invited to meet a friend at this ubiquitous tiny restaurant close to St Luke's Hospital, where I was working.....I figured it would be the "nothing much" option in a mini-strip mall of food court type restaurants.  How wrong I was!  This restaurant had a buffet set up at lunch (and I despise buffets wherever I find them).  This buffet was so fresh, so constant in it's renewal and contained varieties of chutneys and yoghurts....I was flummoxed.   It also had a great waitstaff and a never ending spigot of actual Indian Chai, which was splendiferous.   Just eat here and be done with it.....

I ate here with my wife and my daughter for the 1st time today. We were weary from Black Friday shopping and this place was close and convenient, so we decided to give it a try.

My wife had the enchilada soup. the flavor was good, but I am not a fan of corn in my soup, so for me, it was a miss. If you like corn in your soup, you might like it. The set up here is similar to a sandwich shop like blimpies. You go into the line and order what you want on your salad. The people behind the counter build it for you.

I find this sort of thing ok, but I must prefer to build myself. I want to be able to pick and choose what I want, how much I want, and in what order I want instead of having to direct someone behind the counter to do it. 

Reminds me of Trouble Shooting training I have had where you have to tell someone how to build something just based on your words. They build it based on how to give them directions, but you cant look at what they are building and they cant look at you either. In the end, you hope that what the other person builds is what you wanted. 

This is how these places work. You tell the person behind the counter how to build your salad, how much you want and of what and you hope and pray that what they give you is what you had in mind.

I ordered the Avacado, Bacon and Turkey Panini. Here is what I had in my mind;

* Big pieces of ripe, but firm, Avacado that are creamy and added great texture and flavor to the sandwich
* Huge crisp pieces of thick bacon that was so large that it extruded from the edges of the bread and added crunch and a beautiful bacon flavor to the sandwich
* Big think juicy pieces of Turkey that had been smoked, or cooked with lots of flavor in an oven. When I bit into them, they were full of flavor and excitement.
* Fresh Bread that was toasted on a Panini press until it was crunchy and full of life. Something I could not wait to bit into

Here is what I received.

* A flavorless green paste. I assumed it was Avocado because it was green, but in reality, it could have been anything and just colored green. Maybe to save money, Zupas buys Avocados that are over ripe and mushy so they cant be used for anything except a mushy paste. It had no flavor at all and was gritty. 
* Very very small pieces of very flabby bacon that are paper thin. The only way I could tell they were even there was I opened up the sandwich and searched for them like an Easter Egg hunt. This is the sort of bacon you get at one of those chain sub shops. You have seen it before. 2 to 3 pieces of bacon that you can see through and have been cooked in such a way that the 2 to 3 strips have become 1. Its the sort of paper thin stuff that looks like bacon, but you are not really sure really what it is. It's like that mystery meat that McDonald's serves for Chicken and Hamburger. You hope and pray that its real, but in the deep recesses of your heart and mind, you know that it's not. It's some sort of bacon knock off that is probably a 1 cent bacon like substance that comes from the remains of the pig that no one wants to talk about. It had no flavor at all.
* Bread that was pressed in some sort of press, and had the marks of a Panani press, but im not really sure was a real Panani Press. Either that of it was done on a press at once time but has been sitting around way too long to be still considered bread. The bread was.....well it was bread. That's about the most positive I can say about it.

The worst part of this is that all around on the walls of this restaurant are the names of spices. This gives you the expectation that what you are getting is flavor and spice. Now I will say that the enchilada soup had flavor, but this sandwich that I had could have been anything.  

My impression of this place is that it's a fast casual place created by someone like Mr Wonderful on Shark Tank. Someone that cares way more about margins and the bottom line that actually putting out a good quality product. My advice is to find someplace else to go for your meal. A non-chain place where they still prepare sandwiches with love. Not just the cheapest ingredients prepared by the least qualified underpaid people the owners can find.

I hope and pray that I am wrong about this place. I did not try everything after all. Maybe just this one sandwich is awful. Or maybe sandwiches are not their thing but they excel at soups and salads. I might try coming here again, but I really prefer sandwiches to soup and salad, so for me, this experience was a real let down.

Went into new location.  They have a sausage sandwich.   I attempted to order and was told they didn't have some of the ingredients   

All this left was pizza which we ordered a couple of slices.  The pizza was not flavorful and very greasy

Why list something on the menu you can't or don't want to make?

I highly recommend Laticia for all your beauty needs. She is meticulous about making sure your makeup application is perfect and that your hair looks its very best. She will make sure you get the look you want and feel beautiful. I would suggest you use her for weddings, photo shoots, and just in general to feel gorgeous for any occasion you may have (even if you just want to treat yourself to a facial or need a brow wax). Call her today to set up an appointment! You will be so happy you did!

The first time we came here, our experience is not great at all. However, me and my fiancee decided to give them a 2nd chance and now We eat here once a week or twice a week, and i'll tell you, this place has great food and its not expensive at all. Order the egg drop soup, negi, and Philadelphia roll.  Give the place a shot and you wont be disappointed.
My first experience with Basque food. I'll be looking for the next opportunity. Excellent service and fantastic food. A thoroughly enjoyable evening.

I waited a month for an appointment. I described the style I was growing my hair into and went over the color swatches for base color and highlights. We agreed but when all was done my hair was almost bleached white and almost shaved in the back. All length was gone. I liked the stylists personality but that won't be enough to return. Trust needs to be involved.

I have tried several things on the menu and by far my favorite is the Crispy Sesame Beef.  I love consistency.  Every time I order something, it tastes exactly as I remembered it. 

It is conveniently located in a strip mall near Majestic Movie Theatre on Overland between Eagle and Locust Grove.  I am always in the area and like to stop for a quick lunch.  Service is always excellent.  I love their Hot and Sour soup that comes with their lunch special.  I haven't tried their sushi yet but I have tried more than a half a dozen items on their menu and I enjoyed them all.

I was in Boise on business and had some time to kill, so I stopped in at Inspire. They were the only place to have openings on a weekend on short notice, and how lucky was I! I couldn't have chosen a better place. I could tell that the receptionist was working me into the schedule, but he was able to accommodate all of the services I had asked for. Yay!

The front area is inviting and everyone is very friendly. I had a pedicure with Bethany that was perfect. It's been close to three weeks and my polish still looks great.

Rutger was my masseuse, he is amazing! He found tense areas that I hadn't realized were there and stretched/massaged them. He also explained to me what areas to maintain and self-treat as I'm training for my first marathon.

Courtney gave me the most incredible facial! Since I turned 35 last weekend, I felt obliged to opt for the anti-aging facial.I was so relaxed! She also recommended a chemical peel (I was nervous, as I've never done one before!) and I'm so happy she did. My skin felt instantly smoother and there was a noticeable difference in the fine lines and wrinkles that I was starting to spy....

The prices I felt were very reasonable for such a nice place. Yet I felt comfortable and completely at home.

Overall I really wish I could give better than 5 stars. I'll definitely be back when my travels take me that way again. Thanks for an amazing first impression of Idaho!
The best place to get your oil change. Very happy positive and informative. They don't try to sell you things you don't need. If you can choose a person choose Ramon; he's amazing!!!
Absolutely best hospitality and best sushi ever!!! We are from California and will be returning next year when we're in Boise.

I had seen the banner sign on Meridian Rd. advertising for this restaurant for a couple of weeks, so it had been in my mind to go there sometime.  When my wife said, "Surprise me" (in response to my question of "What do you want for dinner?"), this place jumped into my head.

Well, I'm happy to say that we had a really good dinner experience.  I found the chips to be fine, and the salsa was great!  There was a hint of spice in the salsa that sat on my tongue for a bit, urging me on to wanting another chip.  

The menu was pretty expansive, and I was happy to see that they had a large seafood selection.  I have long been a fan of Latin American seafood, so my tendency is often to seek out something in this realm.

For our meal, I ordered the Chimichanga Manzanillo, and I enjoyed really it.  The Chimi was covered with a sour cream sauce, with a hint of spice (perhaps cayenne pepper?).  The seafood mix was shredded meat, and there were tomatoes and a bit of onion in there too.  The flavor was really good.  The shell was fried perfectly, and not tough or chewy (like some poorly done Chimis), so overall, things were really good.  The rice was fine (perhaps could have been a bit more flavorful), and the refried beans were fine as well (although I typically don't eat beans at Mexican restaurants too much, because I suffer from dilatoventriphobia (fear of after dinner bloated stomach).

The restaurant is very clean, with happy music playing in the background.  The service was very good, and our waiter was very friendly.  When everything was said and done, this place was great.  I think we might be back sometime to try other things on the menu.

====================

For some reason, my wife started reading all the words in the dictionary starting with the letter 's'. She's up to Something.

I always stay at the hotel next to this place. I come here all the time since I can walk back after a few beers. Great selection of beers and specials are always perfect. Kyle is a stud and a very attentive bartender.

Had a really good lunch there the other day with a good friend. They were having a 2-4-$20 meals. We had the fish and chips and Blacked prawns. Nice amount of shrimp, rice, veggies and 4 pieces of cod with a generous amount of fries. You also get salads two. I will go back and try a couple of other things next time in town.

Went for happy hour was empty when we arrived bar 3/4 full in 45 min. At half price drinks still expensive. Food good but not great. Had sushi dragon roll I think looked great, crispy on top , ok underneath. Crab rangoons mediocre lots of cream cheese with a speck or 2 of crab(probably krab?). Not quite brown I think they yanked too soon out of fryer when they started leaking. 
   My salmon/avocado sushi not bad but salmon so thin had little flavor. Didn't taste bad but didn't taste real fresh either. And not enough ginger. Overall food was good for happy hour prices wouldn't pay full price. 
   Benihana style hibachi looked like fun but once you see the onion volcano a time or two is old hat. 
   I'll go back and try other happy hour fare but no rush.

This was a bad experience!  This place has cheapened out in favor of profit!!  This use to b good with decent wines and food. Now it seems the wine buyer looks for the nicest looking label on the bottles that guarantee the most sour, non-complex red wines. Seriously stupid wine, one bottle after another, seriously?

Staff was friendly and attentive, margarita was the worst I have ever had. All you could taste was the mix. They are not difficult to make so not sure the reason for using such a poor flavored mix. Fajitas were not bad. Did not have the tacos despite it being taco Tuesday.

Absolutely terrible! Very unprofessional at this location - three guys working, two of them sitting around, one of them talking about how he took the other's mom out the night before (mom jokes) in front of a customer. 
I visited the day after Thanksgiving for a phone upgrade. Very happy with the phone (Samsung Galaxy S10). However, I was told about a deal for Sprint Drive being free that day (a $250 value). And when asked if there was a monthly charge for it, I was told there wasn't. Two weeks later I received my bill with an $11 charge for Sprint Drive. I spent over two hours with Sprint Customer Service getting this resolved. They canceled the Sprint Drive, and credited me for the $11 on next month's bill. Then they billed me $115 for the Sprint Drive device which will apparently be credited once it's returned. I was also told by the rep. that I get free AAA - also not true!

I always want local businesses to survive, especially those that are surrounded by corporate businesses like Cacicias is currently in The Village. So I'm going to make this review less of a bash, and more of constructive feedback that the owners will hopefully consider. 

I would suggest that you hire someone - a chef, with restaurant experience - to come in and give your menu and staff a face lift. 

I personally have only eaten there once and didn't enjoy the food. The pasta was overcooked. The sauce, it tasted like a can of tomato sauce was just dumped on before any seasoning was added, or cooking had been done. It wasn't expensive, but even then the portions were small and it had no flavor. But that can all be fixed. Pasta restaurants are some of the most profitable out there. And some of the easiest, once you have your recipes and system down. That just hasn't happened yet. 

The staff must not be well trained on how to prepare the food. No attention is being paid on HOW it is being served as many complain about their food being cold. And overall there doesn't seem to be much passion behind this business. It can't only be about turning a dollar. It also has to be about the food. 

I want to support you. I really care about the local independent restaurants. But I only care about those who care about me as a customer. And the quality of your food says otherwise.   I am certain that you can revamp your recipes and food and restaurant, and recover from this lackluster start. And when you do, you should make an announcement to the community about your facelift. Only then will I be back.

Absolutely the worst experience at a nail salon in my life. If you want to be completely ignored and treated like a lesser person, this is your place. First off, I was scheduled for a mani/gel polish and only got a nail polish. Secondly I had a scheduled appointment and 20 minutes later after my nail tech/owner of business, Jordyn, was done chatting with another employee about what they were going to do this weekend, filling up her water and disappearing for a few minutes, she started on my nails. Throughout the whole appointment she chatted with her coworker and the coworkers client but had no manners to even converse with me. I even got referred to as 'her' stating "after I'm done with her..." I'm right fricken in front of you and treated as an inconvenience. Luckily I had a gift certificate so I did not have to pay for this experience but there was a remaining balance on the certificate that will never be used because I will never go back. Complete "Pretty Woman" experience about feeling like a lesser than, when I have the money to afford their outrageous over priced lack of good customer service. Nail job was mediocre at best. My dog has a grooming appointment today and I guarantee he will get better service than I did.

Staff is VERY friendly and the arrangements are just beautiful.  The drivers are absolutely awesome and very polite.  I highly highly recommend this shop to everyone I know.  
Linda Reiter
My favorite Thai place in the Boise metro.  Fresh, fast, and flavorful.  Always a good experience, whether it's take out or a dine in meal.

We are moving from Texas and I called at the last minute to check availability for our 3 year old and 10 month old. They were able to schedule is immediately. The salon was clean and not overcrowded at all. Great playscape indoors, plenty of seating options for kids, and they have individual TVs that provide a variety of distractions in case you have a little one opposed to getting his or her haircut. We saw Tasha and Kimber and they both did an excellent and quick job. We will be back soon!

I don't see why this place has such good reviews. The food is just ok, not great, not memorable, just ok. No one at my table loved their food, it was just average tasting BBQ but an above average price point. I've been twice & both times my dishes were just meh. 

On my last trip my brisket was really dry & the sauce was way too sweet. The sides were decent & service was average. I seriously doubt I'll ever be back. It's just a bit too much for the quality of food I was given.

You can't beat being able to pick out your own seats! We love this theater and there is nothing that we would change about it. Every time we come here it still looks brand new because it's very well taken care of.
Wonderful! Great technicians and awesome results : ) I can't wait to go back and get my legs done this fall. Easy to schedule and reschedule if needed.
Great Pizza, cold beer, and great music. Very relaxing atmosphere!!! Kudos. Well done!!!!
This place was great, from the atmosphere to the food and last but not least the staff.  My family and I had a terrific time, we can't wait to go back!

Over the years I have bern here many many times and never been disappointed. Although it doesn't look like much the food and service has been amazing. However, went on Friday night with my sisters   And left very disappointed.   SINCE WHEN DID IT BECOME INDUSTRY STANDARD TO CHARGE A 20 PERCENT TIP EITH A GROUP OF 6.  Over the years I have always felt like family going into this place and my last visit  I just felt like another customer. Any place that charges an automatic gratuity with a group of less than 8 is disappointing. Especially when it is not posted anywhere on their menus. Too many good restaurants to go to in the valley for me to go back to anytime soon.

60th person to review Beef O' Brady's in Meridian Idaho off Eagle and Overland. This is my 404th Yelp review. I like this place and am bummed that it has an average of only three stars. 

**Be sure to check in on Yelp before ordering to get 15% off! (excludes alcohol)** 

I've eaten here three times and have had Uber eats deliver it twice. Each time the food has been on point. They have a full menu, darts, some other games, and great food. They have an average-to-small happy hour (see my attached photo) and some really excellent food. 

On this trip, I ordered the shrimp lettuce wraps (amazing), tots and queso (just like it sounds), and since it was wing Wednesday ($.99 per wing, $.75 boneless and must order at least 6) we got 6 and a side of fries. There were three of us and we all just share food. Drinks are BOGO for wells. I ordered a vodka water with a splash of cranberry (don't drink your calories kids), and a vodka pineapple-- the drinks were okay, nothing special (meaning weak and not strong!)! 

One cool thing about this establishment is that they have handheld order takers that the waitress utilize. I haven't seen that before, in our area at least. This lessens the errors from the order taking and I would imagine helps with food cost. I've often been surprised by waitress/waiters that can take your order by memory and get it right (doesn't happen often). 

Now, Uber eats-- When you order from Uber, a driver goes to the location and picks up your food. My food has always been delivered quickly, warm and well put together. Last week, for lunch, we ordered a prime rib sandwich and it came with au jus sauce, which was piping hot! Order online today! inbox me for a code for $5 off. 

Again, I don't know why the three average stars. I've read them. I just think they've must have grown and I encourage you to give them a shot!

This is hands down the best Meridian taxi service Iv ever had. This man was on time and very friendly, his taxi is very clean.I highly recommend to go through this service it never disappoints it's always a fun warm ride!

Visiting Boise and wanted something I can't get at home.  Saw this sports bar that looked interesting, so I decided to try it.

Lots of TV's showing various sports.  Lots of different draft beers, some domestic, some imported.  Okay supply of liquor.

First things first.  My husband and I ordered from the 2 for $20 menu.  It includes either an appetizer or dessert, along with two select entrees.  We ordered the pretzels with queso, which were really good.  The pretzels were light, fluffy, had just the right amount of salt, were served warm.  The queso had decent flavor.  I ordered the boneless wings with medium heat (which I thought was mistakenly hot).  They came with a choice of blue cheese or ranch dip, and served with fries.  The fries were good.  My husband ordered the fish and chips, which he said was better than Red Lobster.

Our waiter, Caleb, was a good waiter, making sure we had everything we wanted, and that we were enjoying our food.

There was an issue or two, though.  The tables were all high tables, and they were too close together.  No one in a wheelchair would be able to navigate in there, let alone sit at a table.

Overall, pretty good.  Three stars.

Great value, yummy food !  
I love the serving sizes and the extra touch of a chocolate covered strawberry.

I have used this location for years, and always have received great service. They seem understaffed from time to time, but that is not the employees fault. 
They always jump on my project, and complete it quickly, and correctly. They can be a bit pricey, but you have to pay for immediate results.

Stopped in today for a bite.  Hubby had surf and turf with grilled shrimp (can have fried shrimp if you want.  It came with Cole slaw and French fries.  He liked it all.

I had a custom cheeseburger that came with fries and it was good

Service was great.
