Excellent service and more than excellent food. Everyone was helpful, and provided friendly and fast service. I ordered a patty melt, my standard order, and was not disappointed.  Hot, great flavor, and great value.

Absolutely the most perfect restaurant in the Treasure Valley. I always get something that involves salt cod. I'm sad that they no longer serve the pipperak, but I can look over that. Everything is incredible tasting, authentic, delicious and wonderful. 

A great place to celebrate love, the Valentines Day menu is nothing short of incredible. Wow. I love Epi's!

Just moved to Meridian and found Lotus Salon on Yelp. First impressions are important and the salon was above and beyond my expectations!
*Salon is beautifully decorated.
*Straight up pricing -prices are listed online and do not vary per stylist -which is awesome.
* The prices are very affordable I was happy to tip extra for such a quality cut.
*My stylist was the owner-Robyn. She is so sweet and professional. She was super friendly but (thankfully not a chatty Cathy). It was so nice to sit there and be able to relax and not feel like I have to tell my life story. 
  My haircut was a very detailed a-line style and Robyn did an AMAZING cut. I have already referred a few of my coworkers (and strangers too) to go to the Lotus Salon, after they complimented my cut.
*A few days later I received a personal post card thanking me for visiting the salon (nice touch).

I absolutely look forward to going back!
Just tried Thai Basil in Boise. Oh my gosh! Best Thai I have ever had.  I want to eat there every day! Their green curry and their peanut sauce chicken dish-to die for!

Great little local business.  Super friendly and helpful.  I wasn't sure what was wrong with my vacuum and it ended up just being a wire that had got caught in there and caused a clog to happen. They didn't charge me anything to evaluate it and fix it, which I thought was very cool, so it encouraged me to buy a couple products I needed while I was in there because I wanted to support this type of customer service.
Yuck!! Save your $ & time.. go buy a totino's pizza ,it might taste Better!!

The food is great, but when you are talking phone orders it's crucial. Don't put the new guy in the phone. Not only did I have to repeat it 4 times, but when I got there after 40min total it was still wrong. :(

The bagels are amazing, and so are the sandwiches. This family owned local business always has the best service. One of my fav places to pick up some lunch. They can have a bit of a wait during peak hours at this location.

Me and my husband went to Izumi Japanese and Steakhouse tonight to eat. It was very disappointing and unprofessional.  It was centered around squirting sake in peoples mouths and on the food when they were cooking.  Very low budget. We do not drink and luckily the first person who had it squirted in his mouth said it was sake.  My filet mignon tasted like a low grade steak. If you drink and like to party you will love this place. If you are not a drinker you might think twice before you go try it. We will not go back.

My wife and I decided to go to the Sizzler for a couple reasons. 1st, we had not been there is a long long time and thought maybe they had improved. Second, we needed to keep the eating out cost down and thought they would be a cheaper placed to eat.

Lets start with the good. The steak was not bad. Actually, for the price, it was pretty good. It was not fat or grisly. It was a bit tuff, which of course comes from not being a good cut of beef. But for the price, it was actually pretty good.

Then came the toast. They had taken some shredded cheddar cheese and added some to 1 side. Then toasted it. The result was a good cheesy crunch. Something simple, yet creative that I had not had even had fancier restaurants. It was unexpected to be sure and the highlight of my meal.

Now for the bad. I had the steak and Malibu Chicken. Now, I remember having this in years past, but I don't remember it being this bad. My 8 year old daughter order the Chicken strips. I looked at her plate, then to mine, then back again to hers. It was the exact same chicken strips that she had. She of course loved hers, but she is 8. I was not amused.

Did Sizzler take me for 8? The strips were straight out of a bag of frozen tasteless chicken strips. On top of the strip of Chicken was some ham. Not just any decent ham. It was the same disgusting thin sliced ham that you find in one of those bags of sandwich meat in the store, which sale for about 50 cents. The taste was terrible!!!

Then on top of this mess was a little cheese. The result was something so awful, that if it hadn't been for the fact that I was really hungry, I would have spit it out and not eaten another bite. Then probably washed down the bite I had spit out with water as fast as I could. Yes, it was that bad!!

The fries were also straight out of a frozen bag. The bland and totally tasteless kind that you have to drown in ketchup to get any flavor at all. The decoration was non existent. It reminded me of Denny's. Well, actually Denny's décor would have been an improvement to this place.

Steer clear of this place!!

I just watched The Jungle book at the 1 pm showing in #12. Nearly 5 minutes before the ending the trash can makes an appearance with a cleaner, it blocks the lower walk way and is very distracting.Then the other two helpers appear..How rude . I do not understand why my movie viewing had to be interrupted. Durning the movies a man with paperwork walked in front of  the screen twice(checking seats???) Talk about taking a person out of the moment.
Then I discover half way through the movie I am sitting in the middle of a family ,I bought my seat first?? I would have gladly let the daughter sit next to the mom. This just seems like a unnecessary policing of trash and people. Not classy.

Tried Culvers last night, average burgers and fries, prices seem reasonable for two people to eat under $15. Will go back again and try the ice cream or shakes along with the onion rings instead of the fries. Being it is a fairly new place it was really clean and staff were friendly.

Everyone leaving reviews about this place are literally going out of their way to bash on this restaurant. This is their 3rd location so obviously the majority of Boise enjoys their food, service and atmosphere because if not they'd be closed down by now but instead they keep growing.
I've lived in Chile and tried dishes from all over South America and Central America and I really do enjoy this place for some Mexican food! I appreciate the service of the waiters and the owner is always so kind to us when we come in. Great drinks, great food and a great time. They have a fun guacamole guy rolling around some nights and he'll make you some custom guacamole to your liking which is fun and good. Definitely recommend the fajitas, spicey salsa, grab a churro and ask Lucio what crazy drink he can make you behind the bar.
I had the baby back ribs and they were delish! Awesome service plus great atmosphere.

We've been going to Epi's for years, but hadn't been in a quite a while.  Mainly because we don't plan ahead, and a reservation is absolutely essential -- even on week nights.  We went this past Tuesday, and it was absolutely fabulous!  

The staff is so warm and friendly; they make you feel like invited guests that they're delighted to see.  The food isn't inexpensive, but it's a good value.  They cook with the freshest of ingredients, and all entrees come with soup AND salad, as well as fresh baguette.  They always have a red bean soup, plus a soup of the day.  If you can, plan to go when they have clam chowder -- it's the best clam chowder ever!  They'll even let you have seconds on soup, if you can find the room.  We love their salad as well.  Everything is very fresh, and it's dressed in a light vinaigrette.

I ordered a scallop dish from their specials menu, and it was delicious!  The sauce was so good, it was tempting to just drink it once the scallops were gone!  My husband had baked cod in a buttery cream sauce that was also wonderful.  Both dishes were accompanied by perfectly cooked red potatoes in a light butter sauce.  (You've probably figured out by now that this isn't diet food...)  For a side dish, we were offered Anaheim peppers that had been flash fried.  I tend to prefer my peppers stuffed with something, but these were still very good.  We had no room at all for dessert, which was unfortunate as they have some great options.

Because the interior is small and the tables are close together, it's a bit noisy.  If you plan far enough ahead, you may be able to reserve the table on the enclosed porch for your group.  It's nice and quiet out there, and very private.  Kind of like having dinner served to you at a private home!  

We'll definitely be returning soon -- it's worth the effort to plan ahead and book a reservation!

If you're after good barbecue in a pretty classy setting this is the place.  Traveling thru Boise on our way home to SoCal, we found this place via Yelp.  We think it was underrated.  Food was awesome, service was awesome, and the facility, while casual, was also awesome.  This will forever be a stop for us when we travel back and forth between Newport, OR and SoCal every year.

Felt like every time my family went in someone needed further dental work and it was never the same person/tooth, even though we didn't "take care" of the previous issue. Clearly, Millennium Dental was trying to up-sale us, rather than clean our teeth! And having x-rays every single time we went in for a simple cleaning was completely unnecessary and added radiation that no one needs! After almost 10 years of being patients of their office, it became less about patient care and more about the greed after all the good dentists retired! Hard to trust they were doing what was best for my family... We found a new dentist, who surprisingly doesn't want to drill out our teeth for nonexistent cavities after every visit!

We are here in the Nampa/Boise area visiting our son, and went here for Sunday lunch. It's a bit on the pricey side, but the food was excellent and the portions immense. We got a "small" order of onion rings. They brought a plate with 6 HUGE onion rings. I mean huge; each one was easily a ring of 1/2 an onion. We each are one and still have leftovers. Our steaks were quite good and cooked just right. I had asparagus but it was way over cooked and quite mushy. My husband got the fresh vegetables and he said they were cooked al dente which is how we like them. Our waiter was extremely busy (he had a table of 9 as well as 2 tables of 3) but he still managed to give us terrific service. I recommend it if you are looking for a good meal at a very nice place.

With a burger stand on every corner, I expected more! Not many people for a Friday night! Was told our chicken sandwich would add to our wait time. We asked for our fries as an appetizer. Food arrived about five mins later. Total of about 15 min total. Burger was just ok! Better than average fast food. But nothing to get really excited about. Was better than Five Guys! Not as good as Habit Grill! No where near In N Out. Very pricey for what I got. Undecided if I will ever try again.
Tyler and Louis were very helpful and kind! This was the new TMobile Location near Buffalo Wild Wings.

Recently had dinner with two friends. Two of us shared the butter baked cod and a sea bass special while our other meal friend had lamb stew. The lamb stew was reportedly outstanding and the cod was melt in your (my) mouth delicious! The shrimp and rice soup was also very tasty- especially with the fresh bread. An outstanding experience overall! Epi's never disappoints and we look forward to returning soon.

My wife and I went to Epi's for date night, and it was well worth it. Were were greeted by Eric as we walked in the door, with a huge smile and a firm handshake. We were seated quickly (slow night). We had the calamari appetizer, and the halibut fillet for dinner. The calamari was perfectly cooked, no rubbery, no mush. Very good. The sauce that comes with it had some kick. This was followed by a very petit salad, that was tasty. Then came the halibut which just amazing. Perfectly cooked, flavor was amazing. It was firm, but flakey, and very well seasoned. Dinner is served by courses, so plan a little extra time. Also if you don't want the soup, you will be waiting a while for your salad. Only possible call outs were slow on the water refills, and we didn't get any of the delicious smelling bread. The meal was very well balanced, and tasted amazing.

Stopped by to get 4 orders of the 4 pcs/$5 and a large french fries. Got home and opened the boxes and found out there were only 12 pcs of chicken and half a box of french fries. Called the store and let them knew what happened. The person on the phone apologized and told me that he's going to send me a coupon for what's missing from my order and said that I should receive it in 2 business days. Waited for almost 2 weeks and never received anything. This is the second time it's happened to me! So disappointed!!! 

Make sure you check your order before you leave!

Man, I'm not a big fan of Thai food. I just don't like it as much as some of the other world cuisines. Having said that, we recently hit up this Thai Basil in an attempt to expand my horizons and try new stuffs. Success on both fronts. 

I came in ordered the coconut soup as an appetizer, and it was pretty good. Completely different than anything I've ever had before, and pretty tasty. I think they overdo it with the mushrooms, but for all I know you're supposed to eat this food with mushrooms like that. I'm not Thai, so I'm gonna assume it's par for the course. I got a spicy chicken thing as an entrée, and man it was good. I don't recall what it was called, but it was like orange chicken but spicier. It was pretty good, but not awesome. It was good like I'd get it again, but not like I'd go back just for this. Also, I get the distinct impression it's a dish for non-Thai people like myself. 

The service was good, but not awesome. The place was nice and clean and generally looked pretty nice... I liked it. 

Overall, I like this place. I can see myself going back if I were super nearby, but I wouldn't want to go out of my way to go there.

Great location in Village.  Excellent selection of wine, available for paid tasting, but smaller selection than downtown Boise. This location is a full scale "Ristorante" with great service and and food, but food portions are small and overpriced for the size served. Everything is ala carte.

I went into the store to buy a hose for my kitchen faucet, the faucet doesn't have a make or model on it. I went to the store with the broken hose and asked one of the employees for help. He said they didn't carry that hose and my reply was it seems wierd that you sell the faucet but don't carry parts. He then asked me what faucet brand and I told him I didn't know. His reply was that I was dumb for not knowing the brand and then asked me if I knew the kind of car I drove. I said I knew what it was because it's name was on it and then he said it again, that I was dumb for knowing the kind of car I drove but not the brand of faucet in my kitchen. The store is in a great location, the variety of products is pretty good but customer service is horrible. I don't think I can go back there anymore.

Amy did my wedding nails... she blew me away with her creativity! The nail shape was perfect. The whole salon is very over the top glam, but the staff provides a very relaxed environment. Reasonable prices for the great work they do! Truly a must visit nail salon in Boise!!

My first trip to Goodwood here in Boise and I was impressed.   The food we ordered, turkey, Bbq chicken and pulled pork was all great...sassy sauce was also spectacular.   The only thing keeping this from a five star review was the service, especially the kitchen.   When we first sat down I ordered the onion ring appetizer but after what seemed like 30 minutes the server came over and apologized because the kitchen was changing out the oil in the fryer.    Soon my salad arrived but the server quickly realized it came with the wrong dressing, again he blamed the kitchen    Otherwise it was a great mid afternoon meal although I don't understand the delays in a near empty restaurant.

Could be a great place to live based on the amenities, location, and maintenance. Managment Lindy very negative and horrible with people. Just because of her I WOULDN'T  recommend anyone for living there. There were really only two people in the office. The other one was always nice and the reasonable one.

This review is for the Hibachi grill. Tonight was our first time at Izumi and we had a great experience from start to finish. 

The service was great, very attentive and focused on ensuring we were enjoying ourselves. The food from the hibachi grill was fantastic and exactly what we were craving. All of the vegetables were fresh, so was the edamame we ordered to start- certainly not the frozen type. Portions are generous and more than enough. We will certainly be back, we only wish it was closer to our side of town!

This place is as excellent as slow cooking and hospitality gets! Although they were already booked up for the evening when I called at noon, Chris told me she'd try to get us in, and even called me back while we were skiing to give me her cell phone number so I could check on the table status. She got us a table in the best corner of the house and even sat down to chat for a bit.

 The food and service was great. My husband never had to ask for water, and he drinks it like a worked horse! The red bean soup was excellent, as was the citrus halibut, and the flan was the best I've ever had-creamy with a slightly burned caramel sauce. Mmmmm!

Definitely make reservations, like a week before, or you risk losing out on this wonderful experience! The restaurant is closed on Sunday and Monday, and open from 5pm to 8:30pm all other nights.

In town for a quick business trip and staying next door at the Towneplace Suites by Marriott. After traveling all day and going for a pretty long bike ride before my flight I admittedly wanted to eat some greasy bar food to get back my calories that I lost this morning. Here are my notes:

PRO's:
- Location and proximity to my hotel.
- Staff and bartender were attentive and friendly.
- Craft beer selection on tap was stellar. If you have Deschutes Fresh Squeezed IPA on tap at your establishment your doing well.
-  Tons of tv's to get your sports fix in. 
-  Philly Cheese Steak. It was good! The hoagie was nice and moist and the grilled peppers and cheese was the greasiness I was after! I would order it again, but I'll say it's rather bland. Needs to be doctored up with some jalapeños or Tabasco. 
-  Fries were good. Nice and crispy and not over/under cooked. 
-  Check in here with Yelp and you get 15% off your first visit. 

CON's:
-  Also ordered the 6 wings and rings. 3 were garlic Parmesan and 3 were the Beef O' Brady buffalo sauce. Like other reviewers have mentioned the wings are kinda dried out. I don't mind that, but the thing that got me was the flavors. There was only a small hint of garlic Parmesan and the buffalo wings were super tangy. I only had one of each. My recommendation is to skip the wings and rings. 
-  I love onion rings! However, these were pretty average at best. I'm posting a pic because I don't think anyone has yet. The breading is kinda what you would expect from tempura. I like my rings a lil heartier with some crunch. 
-  The dipping ranch. You know the good ranch you get at salads bars? It's creamy and good, right amount of zing, and you know it's made from scratch. Oh lord this was not that ranch. Tasted like some Hidden Valley straight squeezed out of the bottle. 

All in all, cool chain restaurant spot that has a little bit of a divey feel. Place is clean and would be a great spot to catch a game or fight and have some average bar food. Most likely will just hit up my normal spot Grimaldi's down the road next time I'm in town for work.

I really liked it here as I'm new to Boise, and it's right by my house. The first time I went the owner was super nice, and friendly, even offered me a drink.... well at the end I paid by debit card and received a stamp card which he stamped and told me to bring it everytime I come in. Mind you I paid with my DEBIT.. and still was given a stamp. well I went in today with my boyfriends mother and was raving about the place on how great it was, etc. So I go to check out with a gift card my boyfriend got me for Valentines Day from the salon (which he paid for with CASH so I didn't see it on our bank statement) and asked the woman to stamp my card I was given. She claimed they couldn't cause I didn't pay cash.... so I said okay. Even if it was purchased with cash? She said no. I said okay and moved on. The gift certificate was for $40, I only used $25 on myself and decided to gift my boyfriends mom with the rest which is $15.... her total was $50... so she paid the remainder $35 with cash, than asked for the woman to stamp her card. The woman tried to make up the excuse saying oh well you paid with a gift certificate.. like what??? She paid mostly cash and I surprised her with paying only a quarter of her total price. The lady eventually said ok I'll do it this time but I don't understand why I was given a stamp the first time when I paid with debit and now I can't get one with a gift certificate? I brought her there for a good experience now I'm not sure I'll be back. No point to stamp cards if you aren't going to give stamps for paying customers!

Best Thai I've had in Boise! Thom Kau Kai soup is to die for! (I think that's the correct way to spell it) Also the green curry is by far the best I've ever had. A quick tip.... When you are asked if want it hot or Thai hot be prepared that Thai hot is crazy hot!!!!!! The only thing that has ever taken me down was a ghost chili and this trailed close behind. They also have a delicious dinner salad that has a lovely sesame dressing, which they sell.  Can't wait to go again this weekend. And I have not forgotten to mention the adorable Jessica who was our waitress.

We sat in the bistro section of the theater. It was great. The food was good and a decent price. The chairs are large and comfortable and there is lots of leg room. This is a great way to watch a movie.
Came for Sunday brunch, great service, great food & great mimosa bar. Have come here for quite awhile & never disappointed.

We live nearby and saw the pizza place there (before Santoras) and went to try it out one day and they had one piece of pizza in the window, the place looked dirty etc so we walked out. We eventually saw the name change and it said wings and subs so we decided to try again once the name changed. Yep, I was right. That's all that changed.. the name. They are advertising subs, wings and pizza.. sounds good right? They also advertise pizza by the slice. Upon arrival we quickly saw that nothing had changed but the name on the building. When we walked in, the place stunk like burned grease. There was one piece of old dried up cardboard-like pizza on the warming bar (not so appetizing). The menu is really high up on the wall where it's hard to see. It's not viewer friendly. I asked how the by-the-slice deal works and he pointed at that cardboard pizza. Umm.. no thanks. The guy taking our order was really messy, sitting in a chair, and had a hands free headset in his ear. We tried to go safe and ordered two slices of regular pepperoni and a basket of 10 hot wings (there's only one flavor available). After we ordered, we sat down to wait and about 3 minutes later, the guy with the earpiece yells out "Hey! are you the one who ordered the wings?"... um, there were only 2 other people in there and they already got their food. Yes, we got the wings. The wait was about 15 minutes. While we were waiting so me people came in, clearly ready to eat, looked at the cardboard pizza slice and walked out. (I bet they have that problem a lot) I should also mention this was on a Friday evening after work when you'd think they would be at their best. We got our order to-go since it smelled so bad in there. The guy handed us our to-go boxes and says "don't tip it or the sauce will spill out"... that right there was a red flag to me. I ordered two slices and a few wings. Why would sauce be dumping out? Yikes. Anyway, I cautiously opened the box when we got home and it was pretty much what I expected. The pizza was less than what I could have made at home, and the wings had ZERO flavor. It was like they took the wings out of the fryer and then added a couple spoon fulls of oil from the fryer on top. Yuck! We could barely eat the wings. I guess that's why it stunk so bad in there. The price seemed reasonable when I paid my bill, but after we were done I quickly realized that was way too much. I will never go back there and I imagine that they, same as the other pizza joint that was there, won't be there for long. If you're going to survive in the land of restaurants (Boise/Meridian)... especially as a pizza joint when there's one on every other corner, you better have something special going on. These guys do NOT.

This is the worst restaurant in Boise.Boise is a place where people are respected but if you want to be treated badly walk in here.Even if the place is empty you will have to wait for hours to be seated.The waitress there don't know what is courtesy or hospitality.
We waited for 40 min patiently to be seated still no one cared to give even a glass of water.All waitress were busy sitting and having a chat.

We've been coming here for awhile and love every visit. The food is packed with flavor and the staff is always friendly when we visit. For those of you who are lactose or have celiac, a majority of their entrees are dairy free and gluten free. My boyfriend who has celiac has never had a problem and we've been going here for a few years. If you like spicy, I recommend the lamb vindaloo. Also their tandoori entrees are amazing as well :) also they have a lunch buffet which is worth checking out.

Visited family in town. They suggested this restaurant. Great choice . Many different entrees to choose from. We had a combo platter for a family of 4-6,chicken, pulled pork, and ribs. Delicious. Even had to take some home. Only drawback being that they were out of prime rib other than well done on a Sunday night at 7.
Will definitely visit this place again when I return.

Always amazing.  Walking in the door you feel like family.   Chris goes the distance to make it a great experience.  

The food is great and the service friendly and efficient

I have the fortune of living in the town where Tia restaurant is located

Reservations are a must

Strongly recommended

We have been to several Veterinarians since moving here 9 yrs. ago.  All were "OK"' but we just couldn't find the perfect fit---until now.

When we came to Settlers Park Veterinary Hospital, on the recommendation of a friend, we were delighted to finally feel that this is were we would entrust the lives of our 2 dogs, who are like children to us.  Dr. Mills is such a kind and caring doctor to our "boys", Cody and Tucker.  He has done several surgical procedures, as well as teeth cleaning on both, all with no complications or post op problems.  And he has kept them healthy and up to date on their vaccines.

We highly recommend Dr. Mills and have been very pleased with him, and the facility.

Michael & Bonnie Tanner

Liked how I can reserve a seat in the theater.  Seats were a mixed review.. For some reason the seat cushions felt smaller than other theaters...But the arm rest were wider..  Cushions were a little on the hard side but still comfortable.  
Haven't tried their d box seats but they look like they may add to the experience.   Sound was very good.

What is with the new seating!!? The concept is great, but they are so uncomfortable. They are supposed to be the plush recliner chairs, almost like is what is in the "VIP" seating. But they failed miserably. The chairs recline, but don't stay reclined. So you will sit at a 90 degree angle
The whole time you are watching the movie. We left with our back hurting. Go back to the old seating or fix the recline.
The best place to get a new mattress. Customer service was excellent and they really helped me find the bed that was perfect for us. I'll see them again in 8 years!!
The new electric reclining seats are fantastic!  It was so relaxing. It was like being in your lazy boy!  And having your own tray was fantastic!  Great upgrade to the theater!

do not rent from these heartless assholes! they are only in it for the money. the only way you can get them to fix anything is telling them you are going to the news. they will find any and every way to charge you with something. the front desk girl is the WORST! they will screen your calls. before you even have time to sue them, they have already sent you to collections. at one point they were begging tenents to write a good review for them on google. dont even think about renting from these people. they should all be in jail.

Just like what the other reviewer said, this is "white people" Thai food. Food is dumb down here. Service is horrible too. We came here on a Monday. It was a slow day, there were only 3-4 tables. There were probably 12 customers max in the whole restaurant when we came in. We were promptly seated but I had to get up and go to the counter to ask someone to take our order after waiting for at least 10 mins, the servers are inattentive and we can see that they were just chatting in the back. The servers here are not friendly either. I definitely won't be coming back here.

It was delicious! We had the potato skins for a starter...crisp, loaded with bacon and cheese, buttermilk drizzle and served with sour cream.  Dinner was the baby back ribs with a side of hand cut fries and ranch beans.  Both, were delicious.  They had a wonderful selection of on tap beers, too. A server was amazing.  I'm sorry I didn't catch her name.  They were quick to clear plates, refill our waters, and ask if we needed anything else.  We will definitely be back.

I've been waiting two weeks for a master carpenter to come out, knock down our old shed and build a new one.  He came out, gave me an estimate and seemed very knowledgeable and skilled. I ordered a new shed, and it has been sitting in our garage for almost two weeks now. The day he was supposed to come out to knock down the old shed he was MIA. Nobody called to tell me why (as it turned out he had a death in the family), after we had moved all our stuff out of the old shed and covered with plastic to protect it from the rain and after I waited home all day for this guy.  I understand the nature of the emergency, but could no one from the office have called me? I did receive one email in my spam email, which contradicted what really happened. I have not heard from Handyman Connection or the contractor since (almost two weeks ago). I told them I was going to wait for the guy who came out, because he had good online reviews (only on their website though) who left me a card and who I've tried to call for four days now.  No answer, always goes to voice mail.  Now our irrigation water is in and all our stuff has been sitting outside for two weeks. I can't water the back yard until this gets done.  I've decided to go with bids from other companies.  HC really dropped the ball on this one, and we've had good experiences (4 times) with them in the past.  Not sure if it's because of new management or not.
Outstanding food and service.  You will not find a better group of people to provide  service and care when providing a meal.  The food is great and you will not leave unsatisfied.
Best Indian food in the valley.  Glad they opened up in Meridian amongst the sea of bad franchise restaurants.

Pleasantly surprised for a chain restaurant. Enough so that we came here twice as we stayed in a hotel waiting for our Boise apartment to become ready for move-in.

We enjoyed their "2 for $20" special and were impressed at the offerings as opposed to items that would chase you toward their regular menu.

The service was extremely quick and friendly, with conversation about our move and thoughts about what would help us become acquainted with Boise. Local beers were suggested and enjoyed.

Overall we felt very welcomed to our new community! Thanks to the servers of Beef O Bradys!

I am having the same problem as others who have purchased from the Meridian, ID store. I bought a reclining loveseat. It is too short and I want to return it and purchase the reclining sofa. When I tried to make the switch after having the loveseat for about 25 days I was told No because I have to ask for the switch within 14 days! I have disputed the purchase on my credit account and am waiting for them to respond.  I bought some furniture from Ashley's in Peoria, Az and did not experience the same poor customer service.  Ashley, if you read this, please don't give me a weak response! Just let me make the switch!

found a dark purple latex glove neatly folded under the greens in the take out container.  only discovered it after eating some of the salad off it.   hope it wasn't contaminated with something that could cause a health issue? ruined my dinner.  took it back to the meridian, id store.  manager said she would turn it over to the district manager.  posted the incident on their website with my name and contact information.  it's been over a week now and i've heard nothing from them.  my first and last experience with zupas!!

This location is pretty clean and well organized. I appreciate the sections designated for clearance -- as it allows the rest of the sales floor to be merchandised appropriately. Also, I went to the store earlier today. It was nice to find some items for competitive prices. Also, the Kohl's app manages my coupons and the rewards card gives money back in the form of coupons to be used for future purposes. One nice surprise is that Kohl's also offers gift cards to local restaurants. It makes gift shopping a lot easier!! :)
Always very helpful. Been coming here for years. Special thanks to Howard in doors for helping us special order on Easter Sunday. Great guy! -Sam and Christina

Dr Grant is above all else a great dentist and his office is wonderful.  He cares about his patients and his people do too. He is careful to take time with you and explains everything he does.  I would recommend him to anyone that is looking for a caring person that is wonderful with what he does.

Waited in line for over 20 min and they sloppily made my sandwich and got soup all over the sides of the cup. They ran out of rolls before we got to the check out to pay and so we didn't get the roll. How are you supposed to eat soup with out a roll? Definitely not coming to this busy, unorganized and sloppy location again. Also, it's suoer expensive for the price you pay.

Took the family out for dinner and were very impressed by the food and service! Cheese sticks were amazing and the pizzas had gobs of toppings. They are 12" pizzas so get a couple of them! Cole gives it two thumbs up!!
They staff are all very knowledgeable, patient and kind. Came in for a puppy wellness exam and vaccinations and they have a great health care plan that's really a great deal for a puppy's first year!

If you are looking for good service don't go to the sprint store in Meridian. Michael M (bold guy) was awful. From the second we walked up to be helped he was extremely rude. I can't tell you how many times he rolled his eyes and laughed at my problem. I have been in the customer service industry for 15+ years and I would never treat someone as poorly as he did.

Went fishing with my husband and kids.  We went to Sportsman's Warehouse to get our fishing supplies.  They had everything we needed.  Worms, hooks, weights and fishing poles also great customer service!

May be your only choice out here, but you're better off doing something else. Parents don't watch thier kids, butthole kids, staff not trained. There are obviously some nice parents and there was nice staff member. But you have teenagers in the kids area. Parents bringing thier kids that are physical violent. Anyways poorly ran managed, and place is falling apart. Besides the unavoidable stench and no socks there's things taped up and called good

Friday 630pm.  When we walked in there were 8 tables seated..the rest were empty (about half full). someone hollered from across the room they'd be right there to seat us.  8 minutes later and feeling sufficiently ignored, we were summoned from a woman at the bar who pointed to the table where we were going to sit.  So we walked over.  She said she would be right over with the menus.  My husband eventually got up to get the menu.  We looked around and no one working there paid us any attention.  no one came by....so we left.  Seriously.  I'm from New Orleans and just moved here.  I like good food and service.  This place has some serious work to do on service if they want to even get the food in front of anyone.

My family and I have been going to the local Goodwood for years. The staff has always been very nice and the food top quality. My favorite has always been the ribs and the honey stung chicken sandwich. Will continue to go in the future.

Ordered this with Mimi today for my office.  Waited until they ate not sure I am
Happy I waited or if I feel I should have dig in.  The smell BAM!  Amazing.  Having been to a ton of barbecue places this ranks #1 or maybe #2. Phenomenal taste. I didn't even use the sauce they sent and the meat was terrific. 

Had the west Texas beef was like eating joy. 

Chicken was great and had a lot of flavor and taste. Resonated on the tongue and in the mouth for a while. 

Pulled pork was flavorful and thick.  Felt like I was eating a memory. Made me shut up and savor it. 

Coleslaw was ok

Potato salad was a lot like the Munich style with a little less vinegar.  Still very good.  Loved it

The bean "dip" served with the chips is awful, and the salsa isn't much better. Their iced tea tastes like it's instant and the glass was filled to the brim with ice. The chicken fajitas we're worse than anything on Taco Bell's menu. The fajitas tasted as they'd grilled onion, bell pepper & mushrooms and used they either Kraft fajita mix (if there is such a thing,) or ketchup & chili powder.  My dining companion had Chile Relleno Veracruz and couldn't  eat it because there was enough salt in it for a five-gallon pot of Chili. It's not the worst Mexican joint in the Boise area I've eaten at (that would be Casa Mexico in Eagle) but it's not far from the worst. I don't see how this restaurant will be able to stay open, they should never have any return customers.

My nephew has been here for a week and I am very impressed with the facilities, the quality of the staff, the cleanliness of the hospital, and the overall care. We are from Payette and will drive here over any of the other local hospitals in the area. Glad we did too. After taking my nephew to St. Adolphus in Ontario and not getting proper care, St

Stayed several days in 2 separate rooms (we went out of town and returned to finish our Idaho stay) and really enjoyed it. We recommend staying upstairs - rooms are less used and in newer condition, and it's much quieter. There is no complementary breakfast, but there is a full Starbucks on the lobby that serves hot food. Food was delicious - restaurant quality, and price reflects that. The lobby is very nice with lots of little places to sit and relax with plenty of tv's. The rooms are really nice with great housekeeping staff (so friendly and attentive to our requests). Our family of 5 fit in one room with 2 queen beds and a lounge chair that converts into a hide-a-bed. There's a laundry room (requires quarters), small fitness center (cardio machines only), and a small indoor pool.
Sooooo slow in the drive through. It used to not be this way, but the last few months have been awful. And then you get stale cold fries by the time you get your food.

Kelsey Crawford is absolutely amazing with hair. I have been coming to her for about 3 years now. My hair is long and very thick, and until I found her I couldn't seem to find a stylist who wasn't overwhelmed by it all. She is great with color, too. She is always amazingly patient, even when the cut and color takes over 3 hours!! In addition to being great with hair, she is also an amazing person. My former last name is Winkler.
Fun, family friendly atmosphere. Great swim lessons with clean changing rooms and bathrooms. Can't beat it for the price!

I love Indian food, travel a lot on business and as a result get to sample a lot of restaurants across the country. This little place is newly opened, quite "bare bones" and thus still getting it's legs under it. Notwithstanding, my initial impression is that it will be a winner.

Being our first visit my wife and I had went "simple" and had the widely popular dishes Chicken Tikka Masala and Chicken Makhani. I had onion Kulcha and my better half had coconut Naan. 

Both chicken dishes were quite good but for those of you that like the light, creamy-smooth, buttery flavor of Tikka Masala I recommend the Chicken Makhani. Don't get me wrong, my Tikka Masala was tasty but their recipe uses a darker, tangy red sauce with large chunks of red pepper and onion - different from the standard Tikka Masala found in most Indian restaurants. BTW, The spice level will be what they say it will be. One of my complaints with typical Indian restaurants is that I definitely like it on the hot side but unfortunately I can never get it that way.

The Onion Kulcha was perfect but the Coconut Naan was a bit too sweet for us. On the other hand, If you're a fan of sweet baking coconut flakes you'll probably like it.

Because I'm an Indian food veteran of more than 30 years I ordered mixed pickle (I always do). It was excellent but as anyone who has eaten this pungent, salty side dish/condiment will tell you, it's not for everyone.

All-in-all our experience was a solid 'thumbs up' and, IMO, a cut above the other Boise-area Indian restaurants. We'll definitely go back!

Attentive customer service-clean-delicious food


First time at Izumi- just walked in on a Monday evening and sat right down at the Hibachi grill. Mai Thai ordered along with Salmon and Shrimp as entree- other people ordered filet mignon- super tasty and quality produce! We will be back again!

Yuuuuum. I'm a connoiseur of all duck dishes and the duck curry did not disappoint. It was a good sized portion and didn't break the bank (unlike duck dishes at another thai restaurant in town)

Especially wanted to give a shoutout for the service, especially to the waitress who patiently assisted my friends and I while we debated what level of spice we could tolerate. We got sweet fired wonton wrappers as a free starter, and everyone enjoyed their entrees and drinks. The bubble tea was especially pretty and I was tempted to get one myself.

My daughter and I stopped here on a Sunday around 1:30, because she saw the sign for Bobba drinks, and she loved bobba.  I really liked my Sarah's special omelette croissant, and I was glad I could get something other than a bagel.  My daughter had a bit on cheese bagel.  The chai bobba blended drink was really good, but I think any of the flavors would be good.  The prices are really good.  We will be back!

We come here for the Green Apple Bread Pudding!! The service is stellar, and the food is great too. But the bread pudding is what keeps my husband and I coming back to Epi's. We've had a variety of their entrees, from Lamb Shank, to fish, to the chicken - and all of it has been good. Portions are generous (bread, soup, salad comes with the entree, so come hungry). A few times my husband and I have split an entree so that we can each have our own bread pudding. However, it's definitely large enough to share and we usually wish that we had. You won't regret coming to dinner here, as long as you save some room for the BREAD PUDDING! Did I mention, it's all home made, including the Carmel sauce that's drizzled on top?! By far the best dessert we've ever had at any eating establishment.

Very charming restaurant with great food, run by very warm and friendly people.  And perhaps the best thing going for it was what it lacked:  popped collar assclowns fueled by hormones, trendy drinks and their parents credit cards that are all too common in other areas of downtown.  The family feel to Epi's is wards off any obnoxiousness and preserves a dignified, yet relaxed air.  

The mushrooms and bread could be a meal in itself, the red bean soup was hearty and flavorful (but not overwhelming) the salad had an excellent dressing (but even at opening was slightly wilted due to the fact that it must have been prepared an hour or two in advance), and my meal--flat iron steak--was exceptionally prepared.  The accompanying rice was a little too heavy on the saffron for my taste, but the roasted green peppers more than made up for any deficiencies.  

The only downside to this place is that they don't have a busboy.  The waitresses clear the tables, which means that if you're in a hurry, you're out of luck.  Seeing as though this place gets so crowded, having an extra staff member would get people in and out far quicker and would assist with getting overstuffed patrons back home before they pass out from eating too much!

I took my son there for lunch.  I don't normally go there since there are so many good lunch time places to visit in this area of town. The waitress seemed fine and was efficient in getting our order out to us.  I had the highlighted Carolina Pork sandwich. My son had the chicken crispers.  The food was great.

LOVE this Baskin-Robbins.
Great counter staff.  No matter who it is, they are always eager to please and offer samples if there is a flavor we would like to try.  

A new-to-me flavor that I wanted to try was America's Birthday Cake: Strawberry and cake-flavored ice cream mixed with candy confetti-topped cake pieces and blue whipped cream. Blueberry Cheesecake: Cheesecake flavored ice cream packed with cheesecake bits and swirled around with a blueberry ribbon.
- oh my was it GOOD!  That's probably my new favorite Baskin-Robbins ice cream flavor.

This location is in a shopping center with a Fred Meyer, a Great Clips, and a bunch of restaurants.  It makes sense to stop in for a treat after grocery shopping or a haircut. ;)
Best in Boise just outstanding, clean fresh and great atmosphere.  Sushi and steakhouse tables for special events.  Great cocktails too
I love that from the minute you walk in your traeted like family. Everyone is always so nice, the service is excellent and the food is always delicious.

Great church. Now that I'm in college, I realize more than ever how blessed I am to have grown up in this church. It was a solid foundation that established the Word in me and inspired me to seek God for myself. It led me to make my faith my own. God is definitely moving here. People are welcoming and loving, leaders are loving and Spirit led. Pastors are humble, loving, and friendly men of God with great hearts. both the lead pastor and youth pastor have had a huge influence on my life in many ways. They love God and love people, and they aim to live their lives in such a way that pleases their God and challenge and inspire everyone to do the same.

Have been here a few times and it was great. Went on a Friday night about 9pm. Where sat promptly and then sat there for 15 minutes with no service. Most of the waiters where standing around the check out area talking. Tried to get their attention a few times and where unable to. We ended up walking out. Will never go there again.

I've always been a lover of fried chicken; it's one of my guilty pleasures. I used to think the best fried chicken was KFC until I learned of the existence of 
Popeyes. The spicy chicken is amazing! I'm also a huge fan of their red beans and rice.
Needless to say I am very excited that there is a Meridian location. I have been to the Boise and Nampa locations and found each location satisfactory. This place was no exception. As expected from a new facility the establishment was clean and pleasant. There are a handful of booths along with bar table seating (minus the bar of course). 
The service was decent for a fast food establishment. In my particular case I had asked for dark meat. The employee called my number, read through my meal and realized my request had not been fulfilled. She was prompt to fix it and was courteous. Whenever I rate a place I keep in mind what the type of establishment could be in the best case scenario. So in the case of a fast food restaurant with minimum wage workers and high turn over rate, I find it impossible that mistakes won't be made. However, the service was prompt and the staff were courteous, which I consider reasonable expectations.
Great food and the portions are not small. The service staff is great as well. They are knowledgeable on the menu items. With allergies this is a must.

We just moved here from out of state and are very familiar with amazing Thai. We took a recommendation from a friend to try it out and what a disappointment. For starters I have worked in the restaurant industry and I know what was expected of me, it's not that hard to put a smile on your face and be friendly. 
Well the service here was below sub par, after 5-10 minutes she came up to us asked us what we wanted no 'hi' no 'welcome' no intro just a what do you want to eat. I had a few questions for her and she didn't know how to really answer them, except with I think it's this... she was very robotic with her services dropping off our appetizers with no smile, she never refilled my drink although she passed by it several times. Some guy came by eventually and asked if I wanted a refill on my water and I said no thanks, it was soda he just said 'oh.' And walked away. We kind of giggled and shrugged it off.
When our food arrived I was immediately put off by its appearance. I order pad thai and the noodles were a dark brown and really greasy. I couldn't break the noodles with my teeth because they were so rubbery, so it was an awkward meal to eat. It really wasn't that tasty, we asked each other what we thought and both gave a 'meh' but kept eating. Throwing some lime juice onto it made it a little better but I ate maybe a third and didn't want any more. The water guy came over again to collect some plates and asked if I wanted a box, I knew I wasn't going to eat it later but I said sure and he never came back with the dang box he offered! It got a little comical to us.
We paid, didn't complain and went on our way and will never be back. Bummer.

I've been a patient for about five years and I am happy with the customer service and individual attention I get here. I've never had an unpleasant dental hygienist and I've interacted with each dentist in the practise. Every person from the front desk to the hygenists to the dentists is personable and professional. 

One experience that stands out is when I had to have my wisdom teeth removed. It had been a loooong time since I had any major dental work and I was nervous to the point of tears. The assisting hygenist held my hand, the dentist calmed me down, and was truly supportive during the procedure, which was over so quickly and easily (thanks to the dentist's expertise) that I don't know why I waited so long. 

Recently I had a lump in my mouth that the hypochondriac in me was sure meant cancer. It turned out to be a hard food fragment stuck between my gums and teeth. The dentist listened to my multiple questions and concerns and didn't seemed rushed to leave the room. In fact, he sympathetically shared his own "food trauma" story (food trauma is a thing! I didn't even know it!). 

I appreciate that there is always good music playing and that there are TVs above the chairs so you can watch a show (and control the remote!) while you are getting your teeth cleaned. They also have a teeth whitening program (they custom fit you for bleaching trays) and will make recommendations for treatments or sealants based on your needs. Another thing I really appreciate is that they may recommend these things but they respect my decision to stay as natural as possible in my treatment so they never push me to buy anything just to make a sale but rather say, "It's an option if you change your mind or if you feel you need it." 

If you're looking for a dentist, give them a try!
Had a terrible time there. Many people are extremely rude there. Couldn't believe how rude they were until a mother tried kicking us out when we jumping.

Fantastic food!  My wife and I shared the beef ribs, the baby back ribs and the brisket salad.  All of them were excellent!!  Their BBQ sauces are well done and provide a great flavor without being overpowering.  We're both usually baby back rib lovers, but we loved their beef ribs even more.  Cooked perfectly!! The baby backs were excellent too, which states how good the beef ribs were.  The brisket salad was wonderful, with an excellent mix of flavors.  Finally, they had a special, limited-time mustard BBQ sauce.  My advice: make it a permanent part of your offerings.  It is perfect!!  Service was first rate as well.
I love this Popeyes Chicken!   I've had lunch here several times and the chicken is always hot and delicious.  The sides are good as well.  The place is clean and well ran.
Delicious Indian food! The lunch buffet is amazing and the price is awesome . Ill definitely be back

I travel for a living and frequent sushi restaurants across the country.  I would say the food is good and presentation was nice.  I would also say the food is tasty but lacks something. I think to make an excellent recommendation a person needs to visit twice a try different items.
Chris the owner is soooo nice and welcoming and really just amazing!!!  She made me feel like a regular and actually like family!!!  Food was so so good!!!

We've eaten at this restaurant in different occasions. The first time we loved it, the food was delicious, very tasty; but the next times it wasn't as good as our first time. 
It seems like it depends on who's cooking. 
Their deep fried ice cream is always sold out, so we never got a chance to try it. 
One thing to highlight is how nice our servers have been, they're customer oriented. 
Honestly for our last experiences, this isn't our first choice since the flavor and quality aren't constant. 
It's time to standardize the cooking process.

I can't even explain how disappointed I am in this business. I saw some older teens bullying a special needs boy and blasting him with dodge balls. I tried to tell them to stop and his mom was basically screaming and crying for the teens to stop. I went to the workers and told them the situation. They replied "boys will be boys" and looked at me as if I was stupid. NEVER will I support this business again. And I will definitely be telling everyone I know about this experience.

Not quite sure I'm "filing" this under the correct business, but oh well.  This review is intended for the ER at St. Luke's hospital on Eagle Road.  Suffice to say, the ER is not a place one wants to find themselves.  But when you do, there are two things you really want.  You want to be treated quickly, and you want to be treated with respect.  And on the night I needed them, the St. Luke's ER absolutely delivered on both points.  I was in a bed within five minutes of walking in the door, and I was out the door within three hours after a round of tests confirmed the initial suspected diagnosis.  The nursing staff were all extremely kind and patient.  I have nothing but the best to say about everyone I interacted with.

I know not every trip to every ER will be so smooth and comfortable.  But I am a firm believer in giving credit for a good experience, rather than just slamming a place when they do something wrong.  I am sure that if I had been there on a busier night, my experience could have been much different.  But it wasn't.  I can only review what I experienced, and on that night, St. Luke's really came through for me.  So thank you.

It's a pretty average Thai restaurant, the reason I'd say that is because nothing stands out, nor did anything really disappoint me. Amongst the many dishes we ordered, the black pepper shrimp is a must try !

Had a delicious dinner of chicken tikka masala, garlic naan and paneer. Spices (on a taste level) were very delicious, and we chose the medium spice/ heat level,which was enough to make my eyes start to water ( in a good way!). 

The service was good and the food came out quickly. Even though we came at the dinner hour, It looks like they have a good buffet going on for the lunch crowd. I would recommend this place!

I have two little boys my husband and I adopted. When we got them they were riddled with trauma and abuse. I spent the first three years of their lives in tears trying to find help for them. We were recommended Dr. Crownover by another trauma momma. Dr. Crownover literally changed my life. He is without a doubt the most knowledgeable Dr. He is carrying. He is actually concerned about his patients. There has never been a time we were turned away because they couldn't see one of my boys. Steph is also so kind and caring. They are always willing to accommodate us. I read a post about the cost, I would gladly pay a thousands times what he charges. My boys are healthy. They are a million times what they were when I walked through his door three years ago. 
So, if you are looking for a doctor who actually is what his job description says he is. I highly recommend Dr. Crownover.

Stopped by Thai Basil determined not to order our favorite dish...again. This time, I tried the Pad Thai. It was all that is great and good in the food universe: warmly tasty, sweet and salty, and ample in portion. Our waitress was charming and the atmosphere quaint and, somehow, de-stressifying (maybe it's the overhead, mood-ringesque Ikea lamps that change color). Anyway, I like it here and I'm coming back.
Good food. A little on the pricy side but it is good, fries and onion rings were nice and crispy, burgers nice and juicy. Solid A.

Great sushi!  They also have a great happy hour! 
The staff are friendly and always greets you with a smile.
The food is always delicious and fresh.  The presentation is awesome!

I've spent a great deal of money here and I'd do it all over again! I no longer have to shave, which is a beautiful thing worth every pricey penny. Yes, the treatments hurt, especially when you reach the end and the laser is more intense, but it is 100 percent worth the few minutes of minor pain! The staff is very professional, especially when you're having your bikini line done, which could be a very awkward situation, but it's not because the staff is so professional and make you feel comfortable. I always recommend this place for hair removal - it totally changed my life. I would have given a five star review, but treatments here are very expensive, though worth it!

Wow!  We have been steady customers for this place since they opened.  Last night I was short on cash and could not tip.  Today I was told that because I didn't tip we were not welcomed back. Also told that the manager did not like us. Perhaps the server had a bad day.  Have tipped him many, many dollars in the past. Leaves a bad taste in my mouth.  Lots of other wine bars in the vicinity.

Well so far bad service. So I'm starting with a three star. Table of 17 here and they r ordering....! No tea or water yet either!!!
    Ok we sat here for 5 min feeling lonely now gal apologized she didn't look over. We are sitting inside to the left and by our selves Inside the door. Then she started coming around.

If I could give no stars for our latest experience then I would. Ok so my boyfriend and his 2 kids tried to eat here this past Friday night at 5:30pm to be exact and there was a woman outside trying to get in because her elderly parents were in there eating. She couldn't get in and neither could we but luckily her father came out to open the door. Why was a door locked when there were customers inside? Puzzled. Once the door was opened we went in but a minute later were told that they were closing because their drive thru orders got way behind. What a fast food restaraunt closing at 5:30 pm on a Friday night because they were messing around to cause their drive thru to back up and couldn't get to their customers that were coming in so they decided to close the place for the night. WTH. I have never heard of this to close the entire restaraunt so their drive thru could catch up on orders when there looked to be enough food to handle the customers that were already seated eating but their drive thru was behind. I could see closing for an hour or so to get back on track but to close to the night just crazy. We usually don't have issues here other than being told to get things we don't want because they are on some quota to fulfill. Still the employees were just rude and unfriendly to the problem that they themselves caused. We will go to the one in Nampa or not at all before we head over to this one or do what we did and was give Applebee's our business for the night.

Well I forgot to take food photos... but trust me... the seasonal pumpkin risotto (gluten free!) the meat & cheese plate & the desserts were stellar... in addition to the fun my guest & I had trying many 1 oz pours of a variety of wines.  (You can sample from 1/4/6oz pours to whole bottles!). For a very light drinker like me... it's very fun to try whatever I want... without a huge amount of $ wasted.  Also service has always been good (although I admit it can be a bit hot or miss... I've been here multi times since it's opened.... but my tip there is u have to proactive ask for service... otherwise they assume most want to be left alone...)  I do suggest they carry more varietals... but they have a large selection... I just miss the -hard to find in ID-  Gewürztraminer wine

You know when you're craving something and you're really excited to finally satisfy your craving? Well, it's a huge disappointment when the food isn't anything like what you hoped it would be. I'm not sure what the other food is like at this restaurant but I wouldn't suggest ordering the Pad Thai. The sauce/spices were quite bland. However, there was the rather strong flavor of some sort of pickled red onion. I ordered chicken Pad Thai and so I was confused when I found tofu in addition to the chicken. I feel like I wasted my money and was let down by the quality. I hope those who run this restaurant aren't offended. I simply want all customers to know what they can expect from this dish.
Exceptional food and service. Loved it! Great date night with the hubs!

Based on all the great Yelp reviews we chose Epi's to celebrate a special occasion. Located in a renovated home on Main St., the interior is warm and cozy. Seating is limited but it didn't feel cramped...more intimate. The staff and owner are delightful and charming.
We started off our meal with the ham croquetas, puffy little clouds of silky potato/ham/cheese deliciousness. If you don't fall in love with these little poppers, you have no soul. 
All entrees came with soup, salad, bread, roasted peppers, and a pilaf style side dish. I ordered a single lamb chop from the "lighter fare" menu and my hub had the filet medallions.
Unfortunately both dishes were unremarkable. My lamb chop was small and dry and kinda of looked lost on the large dinner plate.(Lamb is one of my favorite dishes and the main reason I chose Epi's.) Hub's was a little better; his was accompanied by a tasty sauce. Also, neither dish was hot when it arrived at our table.
Service, although friendly, was sloooww. There is a big difference between slow and well-paced service. We had to flag down our server for water and to take our plates. All together it took us an hour and a half to finish our meal.
Not sure if I will be back. I was really hoping for a more satisfying dining experience.

Excellent BBQ.   I have had the Beef brisket meal, pulled pork meal, and chicken meal.  

The Coleslaw & baked beans were also very good.  Definitely the best BBQ in Idaho

Beautiful flowers and professionally arranged bouquets. The owner clearly cares about the satisfaction of her clients and her passion for flowers is evident in her arrangements, ensuring each arrangement is special. Great local business that adds a personal touch you won't get with big chains. And they can deliver! This owner and shop have my business for good!
Excellent food, great ambiance! We had the chicken marcella! Lick your plate clean good! Service was good. Prices were reasonable.

This place is great.  The salads are large and the ingredients are fresh.  The sandwiches are also great and the soups are wonderful.  The chocolate covered strawberries are sweet and such a nice bonus.  The creme brulee is AMAZING!  They offer complementary italian soda syrups, which are tasty and not overly sweet.  This place is a new favorite for my family.

Excellent BBQ.   Had the Beef brisket meal, pulled pork meal, set chicken meal.  

The Coleslaw & baked beans were also very good.  Defiantly the best BBQ in Idaho

Another sports bar atmosphere. We ate in the bar side. I wasn't too hungry so had the tacos. They were good! My date had a pulled pork sandwich. The thing that stood out to me about this place was the less than pleasant server. I don't know if she hates working...she seemed to have fun with the other servers...but she seemed put out to need to take our order, bring our food, or check on us. I have no desire to return due to the server.

I love their coconut naan, mango lassi and butter chicken(can be very mild to hot by request)! They have a great buffet at a great price, included drink and dessert. Everything on the buffet was exceptional. I've taken various friends and they all have loved it. Great food, service and atmosphere. Wish they had a bigger resturant, there could be a wait, but worth the wait

Went to frozen with my wife, and that's exactly the experience I had(i didn't wear a coat because i was going to be inside). The heating in the theater i went to had gone out. As in was not working while it was 10 degrees outside(might have been at most 50 in the theater i was in. When we left a little upset but not horribly we told the usher that the heating was out and that it was cold, the response i got was shocking "yeah we knew that the heating has been out all day." The fact that they not only sold us tickets knowing the theater was freezing but acted like it was no big deal, will not have me coming back anytime soon.

Otherwise this could easily be my new favorite theater in Idaho. The seats are nice, picking where you sit when you buy your tickets is helpful. The fact that if you pay for vip you can dine while watching the movie. all good things. But bad customer service will always ruin a good product. And they have bad customer service in spades.

Dr. Smith is always very kind, with all my kids. He makes them feel safe and let's them know exactly what they are doing well and what they need to work on. 
Their staff is always friendly and welcoming. 
All my kids enjoy going to the dentist. We have and will continue to recommend them for family's of all ages. 
You can tell they actually care about their patients and that is huge especially if you don't enjoy the dental visits... that can be scary for some people.

Best Indian food I've had in a very longtime! Stopped here while passing through town. Lunch buffet with take out option $12.95. Was able to eat and take away a huge togo box, what a deal! Now when I get home late I will ha e yummy leftovers to look forward to. Chai is fantastic too, staff super attentive. I highly recommend

Went in on a Saturday knowing I would probably have to wait, thankfully for me they had some no shows so Molly was able to assist us right away and thank goodness because she was awesome! She was very friendly and quick and she did a great job. Definitely coming back to see her!

Walked in and wasn't greeted, so the party I was with decided to snag a table and sit down. The Idaho flatbread was different than the downtown location, and wasn't as good in my opinion. The caprese salad was great though. As was the hummus. But the service was extremely slow unfortunately! Took 20-30 mins to be served our drinks. Didn't appear to be super busy, but they may have been understaffed
This place is great! The buffet had a big selection, there are a lot of vegan options and the service was excellent. Definitely will be back for more.

This was my second time here.  The first time was a year ago& I got a full set of gel nails, they turned out great. This time I brought my 5 year old daughter with me who is very well behaved. The man working there, I believe Tony was his name was very nice & helpful, he even brought us drinks and a bear cushion to put behind my daughter's back so she could fit her feet into the water. Tony was great, but he wasn't the one giving us pedicures. Those were done by two other women. Both were rude and didn't say anything the whole entire time. My daughter asked for a heart design on her toes and was completely ignored & got a flower design instead. My toenails came out messy, and the lady didn't even add a clear coat on top. After she was done with my toes she didn't say anything, just moved and sat at another table. Horrible customer service! Will not be coming back.

Had dinner here last night. Service and food was excellent. Best burnt ends and ribs ever. Our server Jamie was so attentive and Sean the manager came to apologize for running out of a signature dish. (Had a late dinner).  Drinks were good and prices reasonable. Can't wait to go back for great BBQ!

For no particular reason, my wife and I have been having a hankering for Taco-Truck-Tacos lately.  We've sampled a few around the valley over time, but the last few days have been hunting them down one-by-one, hoping to find that one good one.  Well, my friends, we may have found it.  On a random drive around town today, we noticed a Tacos El Ray truck just a stone's throw from our neighborhood, and decided to grab a quick taco snack in the middle of the afternoon.  

My wife and I each got a single pork taco.  They were cooked fresh, and were very hot (temperature) when the friendly server handed them to us.  He handed us two tubes of sauce, and of course we chose the red-spicy sauce.  After I smothered the two tacos with the sauce, they were also very hot (spicy).  Combine this with the fact that it is a hot afternoon and we were eating them in my hot car, we ended up enjoying our hot, hot, hot hot taco snack.  The pork was cooked in this delectable sauce, and was juicy and tender.  The tortillas were really good too, and could have been home made.  Simple, but delicious.  We will be walking here for lunches and dinners here in the future.



[  Remember, back in the day, when people used to reminisce about the old times?  ]

Awesome Thai Food great Cha Gio
Thai noodles awesome, Penang curry is fantastic. Good service awesome people you will love it!

Disappointed.. But but... there was no sugar in the dessert (rice pudding) like NADA.. I mean how does that qualify as a dessert? ( maybe, it's a healthy dessert with milk and rice and cinnamon.)  Being an Indian, guess I expect too much from Indian restaurants (disclaimer alert) But again, I have had better indian food in the states.

Coming to the good thing(s) - they had some gluten free options and vegan options. Malai  kofta and dahi vada was good. I went on a Saturday for brunch and I felt the place was little noisy. They had (read dried-out) chicken wings. Well atleast a new dish right! Excellent service. Hence the one star.

So anyways, coming out of the restaurant 

Husband ( to me) : I really hope u give up  your indian buffet brunch cravings coz I don't know what to eat.. Most of them are bland.
Me :  well, select one best dish in the buffet and eat till you are content. It's indian and it's buffet what more can you ask for.
Husband : so tell me, what was the best dish today?
Me : *silence*

And my search for good indian food in boise continues (blah blah)... *sigh*

Great service had a group of 30 and we came in unexpected. Server was amazing and we all thought the food was great. Great sports bar. Not sure why the others have negative feedback. We all had a great time Christy did awesome.

No not good!!! Just paid 70+ dollars for food I could of made at home!!! It was definitely American Asian. I Uber eat it to my house! Driver amazing food sucked!!!!  Regret ordering from there!! Should of ordered panda Garden! At least it taste good!!!! I would not recommend!

4-18-19
Visited with my aunt. It was the first time for her many times for me.
I ordered my usual, medium light spicy red curry with shrimp. Fantastic as usual.
My aunt ordered pad Thai. Horrible and disgusting.
Just like the pictures online the noodles were dark, overcooked, and way too spicy. They gave her Thai spicy instead of medium like she ordered.
I have to downgrade these guys now because if you can't make a good pad Thai then you really don't need to be in business.
Service the last two times has been very marginal. The first time was fantastic.
I will continue to look for my go to Thai place now.
If these guys want to learn about service, or most restaurants in Meridian area for that matter, they need to go to Pueblo Lindo Mexican restaurant. Fabulous service and great food.

One of the best places for a massage in the valley!! (Trust me, I have tried them all).  Very friendly and even stayed late to get my massage in on a Saturday evening.  Very nice facility,  looking foreward to trying other services as well!

We went to see the second Jack Reacher here. The movie was only mediocre but fortunately I don't have to review that. 

The experience starts as soon as you walk in to buy your tickets. We've only been here twice but the same guy was working there both times. I love that you get to pick your seat ahead of time so there is no worry as to whether or not you'll find seats together. Also, if the theater is too full for your liking at a particular showing you can always try another one. 

The lobby is opulent - vaulted ceilings and artwork in the floor. In addition to the traditional snack bar, there is a full coffee bar with traditional coffee house offerings - mostly baked goods that are OK but not really worth the price. The white mocha I ordered last time was pretty decent but they used real milk instead of soy like I asked. How do I know that, you ask? It brings me to the next portion of this review. 

The bathrooms are clean and well-lit. Everything is automated so you don't have to touch anything which I always like.  

Inside the actual theater, the chairs are cushy and rock back about 45 degrees - just enough to be more uncomfortable than sitting up straight, sort of akin to airplane seats. Better to just sit up. The seats are comfortable and clean and the floors are not sticky. 

To summarize: 

Lobby - Clean
Snack bar - clean, expensive, disinterested employees
Bathroom - Well kept
Theater - Clean, no bubble gum on the seats, no sticky floors

A+ for cleanliness, one star off for less than stellar snack bar employees. I'll come back for sure :)

We ordered over the phone for carry-out and specifically asked for gluten free as I am celiac and highly sensitive. The staff was very knowledgable and helpful. When we went to pick up the food, they told us they realized they mislead us regarding one of our dishes and that it did contain gluten. They were very apologetic and made us a fresh new dish. Their customer service was great, which was a cherry on top of the delicious food. We will absolutely be going back.
They messed up a simple two cheeseburger order and then they made me wait for 20 minutes before I got my correct order! The crazy thing is that there was only one other person in the restaurant!
We will go again but seems like there's room to grow and learn. We went on Valentines and only 1-2 other tables were occupied. You need a wine list!

I've now been to see three movies at Village Cinema, once with VIP seating, once in D-Box seats, and once in "general population". At the very least if you don't go with VIP, definitely do NOT choose any of the seats in the first four rows. I thought there must be a mistake with Fandango, the online order app/site for ticketing, so we went ahead and decided to buy tickets at the box office. Turns out the app was right and seating was truly that limited. We even adjusted to a later show and *still* got stuck in the Crick'a'Neck row 4 nearest the screen. The couple next to us actually left to change their tickets, it was so bad and I had a sore neck the rest of the evening from craning at such an odd angle to even try to see the screen. 

I do highly recommend ordering tix online if you're like me and like to take a minute to decide all the pros & cons of a particular seating spot & don't want to feel the 35 other folks lined up behind you waiting breathing down your neck (not really but still). The pressure!   There is also a self- serve kiosk for ticketing right next to the Box Office desk and the employee recommended to me not to bother with it. He said if you're right there you may as well get in line for all the trouble the kiosk seems to give others

VIP seating was nice, as mentioned by other reviews the seats are wide and comfortable and the food service if you arrive early enough is available beyond standard movie food. The husband and I each got a meal and dessert, and while I no longer remember what exactly we had, that's because it wasn't really memorable other than for cost, which was far too high for the quality. We decided in the future we would be more likely to take advantage of one of the many restaurants IN the Village and forego the theater eats. We actually went to Kona Grill right across the way from the theater the second time and had some amazing food for less than the Cinema charged. However, if you're wanting an awesome view, seats that you can comfortably relax in and to be absolutely assured that you won't have to be near the teens who insist on talking, laughing loudly and texting with their screens on maximum brightness around you, it's the way to go even at an up charge.  

The concessions sell the usuals plus an assortment of baked goods, smaller hot foods such as soft pretzels and pizza, and be advised if you're a hardcore Coke fan, they only serve Pepsi products for drinks. They do offer frou frou coffee but the machine wasn't in service the time I wanted some. 

The D-Box seats are just like they feel in the "Try It" spot in the lobby where you can see a trailer shownthat also uses the seats to show two viewers how they work. I saw Denzel's The Equalizer for that seating and it wasn't probably the best movie for the seats but fun nevertheless. I'd recommend a real action flick or maybe flying/military style movie for the best use of D-Box.
