All in all, for the movie theaters currently available in Boise, Village Cinema certainly offers the widest range of seating, food, and the best picture/sound quality - this is now our go to cinema.

My family and I came here to eat dinner after my daughter's track district championships last night.  We were kind of debating if we should give this place a try since we were super hungry. Knowing that this place just open a couple days ago. A lot of things can go wrong when a restaurant first opens. When you enter the building there is a bar in front of you, teppanyaki  grills to the left, and a sushi bar on the right. It was a pretty big building and had a bit more upscale elements in the decor than usual sushi restaurants. I'm so glad we went! We got seated right away, the food was good, they have good mixed drinks, friendly servers, a helpful sushi chef and a nice ambiance! We ordered Age Tofu, Gyoza and Fuji Mountain as an appetizer; everything was tasty! For the main dish we ordered Sushi Sashimi for two and Godzilla Roll! They both were good! The presentation of the Sushi Sashimi for two is the best in Boise! Hands down! We went home happy & satisfied! We'll be back!

Just...ew.

First, the employees didn't smile and it felt like I was inconveniencing them by being there and ordering food. 

Second, the portion was actually comical. I laughed when she put the spoonful of rice in the burrito bowl, thinking it was a joke. And then she looked at me stone cold serious, waiting for me to say what else I wanted. The ingredients were put in with what looked like a small (very small round) ice cream scoop. It scattered across the bowl and was no more than 2 bites of each thing. I wish I was exaggerating. It was mainly lettuce and liquidy salsa. 

Third, the guacamole was watery. 

Fourth, everything was bland and COLD! 

And last but not least, I'm convinced something was wrong with the food because shortly after eating it, (only because I'd been working all day and was crashing hard)  I got sick and puked it all up. Felt fine once it was all out of my stomach. 

It cost $14 for a laughable amount of food.

I'll stick with chipotle, thanks. For the same money, they fill that bowl up so full I have to eat it over two meals and they smother the whole top with delicious thick guacamole.
The food is fabulous.  There is a bartender named Grace who goes above and beyond kindness to take care of all your needs.

I got the upgraded special pedicure for 35 and loved it. The gentleman did a great job making my feet smooth. The special came with sugar scrub and cool mask on legs plus a leg and foot massage. He took his time and did a great job. They offer you a water and soda and were very nice. Very relaxing, only negative was the football on the tv, but I enjoyed the tropical aquarium.

Pass on this place.  The tables were dirty and the service was lacking.  The steak nachos don't look like the picture on the menu. It's more like steak less nachos. It could be a fun place but it needs some direction.

The BEST customer service around. I will definitely rent from this office again! The employees were extremely personable and accommodating and called me on be second day to ensure that the vehicle suited my needs. Highly recommend!!!
Really pleasantly surprised by this gem. Better than any Indian we could find in San Francisco located in a little strip mall in Boise! Super authentic, fresh. Great service.

This is by far the best Indian food in ADA county!
Traditional Indian cuisine in a quaint setting with modern twist!

Third time certainly is a charm. I've frequented El Gallo Giro's two other locations often and was excited to hear about the newest location in Meridian.

Polite-Delicious-Convenient-Timely

I came in on a very busy Saturday afternoon and immediately noticed laughter at almost every table, people seemed to be enjoying the atmosphere and the service.  You would think that because it was so busy that there may have been a long wait to get food or Margaritas that my party ordered (wasn't the case). I ordered a delicious "Gallorita" (Margarita) and had Pollo la Crema for my lunch. There were 4 of us and we were probably in and out of there in less than 45 minutes.

I'll definitely be returning, there is an interesting cocktail menu and some desserts that I want to try!
It's a Monday at 7pm, their sign says "now open" but they're closed and have no hours posted.... what a bummer, we love the other locations.

I arrived at 5:40 in time for happy hour (ends at 6). Waitress came over at 5:48 and asked it I was ready to order. I said yes, I ordered hot tea and she walked away?? Ok I thought...to get my tea. She walked by at 5:56 and dropped my tea off and kept walking, did not take my order and disappeared to the other side of the restaurant, taking orders. When she came back, I proceeded to order from the happy hour menu. She said "it's not happy hour" and pulled her cell phone out to check ....it said 6:00. Then she smiled and said "well it's 6" took my order. Sushi came out quick, it wasn't bad. ALOT of cucumbers!! So if you don't like cucumbers don't come here. 75% cucumber 25% fish and other. No refill on hot tea, finally had to wave her down and ask. My bill came and guess what...not happy hour prices  so again I had to flag her down, tell it's wrong. She said nope see it was past 6. The bill showed 6:03. Seriously  that's the time you rung it up after not taking my order for 20mins!

The main reason we went to Beef O'Bradys is because we received a coupon in the mail. If it had not been for that, I am not sure we would have risked it.

Why risk you say? Well, if you are a fan of Sports Grills, you might like it here.

As for me, I am not a fan of Sports Grills. I have been to several of them and everyone has let me down.

Sports Grills usually have food that is greasy and have little to no flavor. The reason for this is pretty simple. 

Sports Grills usually hire very young under trained people that make minimum wage or less. As a result, their cooking skills are very poor to non-existent.

The emphasis on sports grill, at least here in Boise, is on..........you guessed it, watching sports on their many TV's.

When I walked in Beef O-Bradys, I was met, not by a hostess, but by a music machine of some sort. I have never seen a music machine like this before. It was a modern day juke box.

Beef O'Bradys is what I call a Frankenstein Restaurant. It looked it may have once been alive, but has long since died.

The owners attempted to bring it back to life, but did a very poor job, and it looks like it might keel over at any moment. 

The restaurant is split right down the middle. Half of it is a bar, and the other half is the restaurant. Neither lives up to its potential. The bar areas is extremely noisy. Its not really because the patrons are that out of control. The excessive noise is caused by no carpet on the floor, or anything else that can absorb sound.

The other problem is a very short half wall that does absolutely nothing to block out the noise from the bar area. The restaurant area, like so many Sports Bars, suffers from an identity crises. It looks more like a bar area that was converted into a failed attempt at a restaurant.

In spite of all this, we set down to dinner. Our waitress seemed nice enough. We started with our drink order. I ordered a non-alcoholic Pina Colada. On a side note, I was very excited that they offered some non-alcoholic drink choices. In Dallas, there was once a restaurant called Noahs Ark. They had a huge selection of Mock-tails. I miss this a lot.

My wife ordered a Ginger Ale. Our waitress got not just 1 of our drinks wrong, she got them both wrong!

And that was with her writing the order down!

I was brought out a Margarita, which was horrible tasting. The best description of the taste that I can come up with is this. 

Go to your local grocery store and buy a dry in-the-envelope Margarita mix.Cut open the envelope and pour the contents directly into your mouth. 

My wife was brought out a root beer. The waitress apologized and went to get the correct drinks.

She soon appeared with my wifes Ginger ale. She told me that they had run out of Pina Colada mix. Huh....a mix???

It seemed that one here knew how to make a real Pina Colada that was not from a mix!!!

Well, this was a very bad sign, but we decided to grin and bear it. Beside, we were both very hungry.

My wife had a buffalo chicken wrap. I had the BBQ Bacon Cheeseburger. My daughter had her usual....Chicken tenders.

The chicken tenders were actually grease non-tenders. The wrap was...well...not good at all. I will leave it at that.

The bacon burger was actually not bad. It was one of the better burgers I have had of the Sports Bars that I have been to. But in comparison to an actual restaurant, I would give it a 4 out of 10 stars

The best part of it was the bacon. The bacon was crisp and smoky tasting. But the bacon was the only thing that gave the burger any flavor. The meat was dry and over-cooked.

After I left, I could feel the grease from the bacon coat my mouth. The bottom line for this place is that it is in desperate need for a make-over. Both the food, the decor, and Frankenstein itself.

We ordered vegetarian appetizers which was bland. No spices what so ever. Then we ordered dal makhani and malai kofta which was salty as hell. 
They didn't even apologize for anything. 
I will never go back here or recommend this place. 
I am very disappointed.

What an experience. We were there before two families and the woman server took other's order first. We didn't like it but didn't say anything. After about 50 mins and asked when will our food be ready, if not ready soon can we just pay for the drink. She said it's just one more table, food is already cooking 3-4 mins. After 10 minutes she served two other tables. But didn't you just say one more? Didn't you just say 3-4 mins? She stared to put plate on our table make us believe it's coming. We waited about 5-10 mins that's over an hour in the restaurant already. We wanted just pay the drink she said next time tell us if you have a lot of time and we will just throw the food away! Really? Over an hour is not long enough? Shouldn't be first come first service? We always had good experience with Indian restaurant, this is the first time we feel really disappointed. She didn't not apologize for anything and blame the customer for not taking orders in a sequence... We will never come back anymore...
Best cod around i love this place the shrimp is excellent and the frys are great i cant find anything bad about this plave

We went in Feb 23rd and purchased a sectional couch, super exciting right!! Well we bought it and the salesmen had us set our delivery day so we were told it will be here March 3rd from 12:30-3:30, so super excited took the day off got rid of our old furniture to get ready for this sectional, waiting around all day today March 3rd and it's 3pm getting worried that it might not be coming today,  so I call to make sure it was coming or to see what happened and th gentlemen told me it has been delayed,wtf, I'm super upset for taking the time off work, didn't receive any call or email letting me know it has been delayed to next week, so super aggravated now!! I have no furniture because I thought we were getting our new furniture!!  Excuse me I have one chair I kept , but they offered a refund for $100,at first it was $65 that was offered to me then they used it to $100, I bought my furniture full price $790 and he only offering me $100 back and still will make me wait?  so if I could deliver it myself will I get my sectional now or still have to wait? Super disappointed, will never do business here ever again, will shame u guys to everyone I know!

First time dining here, my usual choice in the area is closed Mondays, so decided to give Thai Basil a shot. They are located in a small strip mall on a busy street so I was not expecting a great visual experience, but the atmosphere and decor are great. Love the lighting and layout for a small place and was greeted immediately. 

I ordered for takeout to meet my wife for lunch, was directed to the small bar to order, and while everyone was busy, they were very attentive and engaging. Note they have different menus for takeout and in-store, there are some nice options and specials if you are dining in. 

Ordered Yellow Curry Chicken and Drunken Noodles, and unfortunately they were out of the Thai Egg Rolls, I decided on Lettuce Wraps for an appetizer. Wait was reasonable, about 10 minutes.

On opening our meal, saw they take great care to pack and present take out orders very well. Food stayed hot even though I had to wait 10 minutes for my wife to be ready to go to eat. The lettuce wraps were fantastic, generous portion and very fresh. Would like to see a lime wedge or some spice options like sending some chili oil. Fresh, fragrant, and great flavor.

My wife's curry was also superb, nice heat but mild enough for her. Unfortunately, my drunken noodles were very bland and dry. I returned with my dish after lunch, and was very happy with the response from the staff. The bartender took the dish back to the cooks for examination and they immediately fired the replacement, done in 3 minutes and much better.

Keep in mind (no criticism, you have to learn how any Thai restaurant spices and what to order) if you like Drunken Noodles, you may want to ask them to up the heat, the default is definitely on the mild side.

I will be back, and look forward to trying many other dishes. The Sauteed String Beans went past me on the way to a table and I was drooling!

This Kohl's went above and beyond for us when we were in a pinch.

My son was getting into his tux for homecoming and we could not get the pants adjusted/tightened to stay on him - and there were no belt loops on them.  And now we're going to be late.  He thought of using suspenders, but we didn't have any.  So, I looked at Kohl's online and it showed that they had them at this store.  Because we were already late and in a big hurry, I decided to call the store.  I called the store, asked for the men's department, and got Scott.  Scott was the most polite and helpful person ever with his "yes ma'ams."  I said "Scott, I need a huge favor" ... and I told him the story and asked him to get the suspenders and put them at the checkout for us because we were already late.  And he was on it.  We got to the store, kid ran in, suspenders were at the checkstand and he's set.

Now we're in the parking lot trying to put on the suspenders.  And we're late, and we just cannot get these things on, and they keep popping off him.  So, my son run's back in to the store to see if someone in there can help him.  And they did.  The lady paged for someone, couldn't get a response quick enough, so she did it herself.  (We didn't get her name.)  

We were super grateful for the extremely accommodating and eager-to-please/assist customer service that we received from this Kohl's.

Side note - the suspenders were on sale, and it showed a promo code online.  So, the kid showed the bar code at checkout to get the additional % off.  Kohl's has great sales too.

Kelby, Jessica and Natalie are rockstars. Great customer service w/ the bar, food and VIP experience.  Helped my wife and I get situated on our date night w/ great seats. A first class experience ... and great value Tuesday nights!

The first time we went it was amazing, idk what happened, ordered the same sandwich I always get and it was so gross and soggy I didn't take more than one bite. Couldn't stomach it.
Decided to give them another try today and ordered the wings....again couldn't finish one. The chicken was like biting into a chunk of fat, and they tasted like copper. I almost threw up. I'll never eat here again. Don't waste your money, there's better places in the are!

This is by far the best Indian food I have had in Boise! I want to marry the butter chicken, it is that amazing! I've eaten here several times and have not been disappointed with anything. If you haven't tried Indian food before, prepare to become addicted! Love, love, love!

The food was common but was shocked that they charge for sour cream and guacamole. An extra $3 for a small side off these common things at other restaurants... And there is nothing that states they are extra charge.....We're talking .99 for a tablespoon of sour cream, and 1.95 for a tablespoon of guacamole on 2 meals bringing the extra cost to $6.  Are you serious that's an extra meal. Just wrong....

We hired Reliance Moving to help us move the end of April 2019. They must have overbooked that day, but chose to do our move anyways. We requested 3 guys and they sent 2, neither of which knew what they were doing. They were slow, one of the guys took at least 5 breaks that totaled over an hour. The guy who took all of the breaks complained multiple times that things were "too heavy". The truck was only about 2/3 full when they told me it was a full load. Instead of using dolly's to move stacks of boxes into the truck they carried one at a time regardless of its size or weight. 
We have moved 7 times in the past ten years and have hired moving companies every time. In our previous move we moved from Boise to Meridian and hired a company that sent 2 guys who moved all our things in one load in under 3 hours. It took the guys from Reliance Moving 2 loads and almost 7 hours to move the fewer items to our new house that was less than a mile away from the old one. 
They also damaged our wood floors by dragging a piano across them instead of using dolly's. When my wife pointed our the damage the guy blamed her and said she should have "put plastic over the floor". I called and messaged the company about the damage and never received a response. 
At the end of the move they tried to charge me more than was agreed upon and couldn't provide me with and invoice. It was clear that these guys were not Reliance Moving's "A-team" and I'm guessing they weren't even employees, but guys they hired for the day to help out because they were overbooked. If you're going to portray yourself as a professional moving company you need to employ professional movers and deliver the service that you advertise on your website.

Always a good experience going here and worth the trip from Nampa, cant beat the pricing or the sales as well as the warranty! These guys work hard to keep the wait time down even for the rotations and they always spin balance all 4 tires doing the rotations! Had lots of problems elsewhere with that. Really trust them with my vehicles and they are very helpful, great service now 3 years for me!

Laticia is AWESOME and my eyebrows look amazing! She used brow powder to show me how she was going to shape them so I knew exactly what they were going to look like before she even touched the wax (I had been going to the same brow lady for almost 10 years before I moved, so I was nervous to have someone new do my brows). She makes sure that your eyebrows are the right shape for your face and features. Laticia made me feel super comfortable and she's as talented as she is sweet! I will definitely be a loyal repeat customer.

I have to add: I originally met Laticia when she was doing hair and makeup for a friend's save-the-date photo shoot. Her work is beautiful and flawless and she walks you through it step-by-step so you can be sure you're going to love the way you look. If you need hair/makeup/waxing, I definitely recommend going with HueLaLa Esthetics!
We stopped in with a soccer team and the parents, food was great and service was great considering we filled every table. Would definitely recommend.
I've been here three times over the last few months and every time it is excellent. Good service and the lamb khorma is excellent
I've had the burgers and I've had the fish and chips platter. Food is made fresh to order. Huge menu! There's alot to choose from. One of my favorite steak burger spots. They never disappoint.

So, the night staff was very friendly, morning not so much. I asked her about the Breakfast and she had no idea what I was talking about. I mentioned that there were hairs in my shower and it was disgustingly dirty and she acted like I was a martian.  The breakfast doesn't specify that you are paying $12 for one. The poor lady doing the Breakfast, Saturday, alone was running around like a mad woman, trying to do everything. The food is less than mediocre, save your money for a good food experience. Clean the rooms up. We ran the fan all night to keep the noise at a minimum, it's a very noisy place. You could do much better. Disappointed.
Awesome food with a true family feel.  Great service!  Felt like I was walking into my grandma's kitchen.

Great service. Their combo is one of the best I've eaten. Great to have a local pizza joint with such good food and service. It's takeout only. Wonderful for those busy evenings when out don't have the time or energy to cook.

Awful managers can kill the entire experience.  This salon changed its name to Fina, but they still remain substandard.

*** We were treated unprofessionally and very poorly. I booked a party of six people whom were in a wedding party two days later. The party was comprised of six pedicures, five full sets and a manicure. Because there are only four pedicure chairs, we knew we could have to have three people getting pedicures while three did their nails, and then the group would switch. When we arrived they asked for four of us to start with the pedicures. Because they did not follow their own scheduling, they ran out of time to do everyone's nails. Our appointments started at 11:45AM and we were supposed to be out of there around 2:00PM - 3:00PM. They "did us a favor", according to the manager as they called in another stylist to come in and do the last person's full set. We walked out of there after 5:30PM. When the manager was trying to bring in another employee to complete that last set of nails, she turned to me and said, "Do you want a 3:15PM appointment or NOT?" All the stylists were stressed, there was so much anger on the part of the manager...it was an all out awful experience. 

For a pedicure, which was done hastily and poorly, and a full set, we each paid over $140. And that was for nothing but gel polish and one accent finger decorated with a couple rhinestones. 

Truly, go elsewhere. The only compliment that I could fine would be Jade. He was very professional, made sure I was completely satisfied with my nails before he was done. I only wish he rented a chair at a salon that actually knew how to treat their customers in a responsible, professional manner. 

Post Owner Reply: I find it curious why the manager says it's our fault because we initiated the four pedicures be done at once. We knew that had to have three pedicures done at once, while three full-sets/manicures were done, then we'd switch. The owner then accused us as not bringing up the issue while we were there. I did bring it up. I was very dissatisfied and the reply from the owner was, "Do you want the 3:15PM appointment or NOT?" She did not approach the situation tactfully or professionally. So no, this wasn't our fault. We called over a month in advance to book our appointments at the very same time. We were aware that the group would have to be split in two, and I called the week prior to make sure everything was a go. Putting the substandard treatment wasn't our fault. Treating your customers poorly falls directly on the shoulders of you and the staff.
My only issue is I go in for dog food and spend 150.  Love this store!  Staff is always helpfull.

I order from here at least two times a week and have always had a good fresh meal ! The hibachi is tasty and the filet mignon is always perfect. I would suggest to anyone looking for some good Japanese hibachi.
Very good food and our waiter, a young kid from Virginia, was fantastic!  I highly recommend the Brady Burger.

Our party of four sat at the hibachi with another small party and we had a great time. The waiter was new and there was a little confusion with that and it being a busy night but not too distracting. Our chef did a great job entertaining the groups and made it especially fun for our kids. We don't drink but the other party got a LOT of free saki with their meal. The food was pretty good (steak and salmon were a little over cooked, but everything else was great.

First time here, I really liked this place. It was so clean and the decor was a combination of retro tiki and zen paradise with a minimalist hand. No clutter at the stations either. 

My stylist was friendly and skilled which was great! I always feel bad because I have a lot of hair, but it didn't seem to phase her which was cool! 

The $30 women's cut comes with a wash and blow dry/style. She did my cut dry which I actually prefer because my scalp is sensitive and wet hair cuts always tug on my head and put me in a stressed out mood. So the cut was dry and then she washed my hair afterward which was great so all the hair splinters got washed away! 

Best part of the hair wash is that they use a rubber piece on the lip of the basin so the blood isn't cut off from your brain. With heavy wet hair I always dread the hair wash because it kills the back of my head/neck. This was a really nice feature!

Also bang/fringe trims touch-ups are free!!

Seriously I can't believe I got a haircut in such a cute place for only $30 plus my tip. Was great, will be back!

As always, this little family run gem never disappoints. 
Last night I had the following:

Ham croquetas.  Little round balls (think Schwetty), of yummy, creamy porcine goodness. 

Red bean soup.  More creamy, yummy homemade goodness. 

House salad. Light, fresh and perfectly dressed. 

Baked cod in a creamy, velvety, party in your mouth garlic sauce with rice and roasted peppers. This was the best cod I've ever had in the USA. 

Washed it all down with a few glasses of riesling. 

Kris and Eric are obviously doing things right and this is my go to place when cruising in beautiful Idaho.

My first visit. I am hesitant about food in bars, expecting the worst. I was pleasantly surprised. I had The Cuban. The ingredients were all excellent, a very fair serving size with a fair price. Others in our group had a burger (very good), Philly cheese (very good), salad with Cod (the fish was very good). Our server was nice but perhaps very green. We had to ask for menus, tableware. The place was not full and our food was prepared and delivered very quickly. It is a nice bar, not very large and there are about 20 TV screens all around so if you want to watch your sport, it would be a good spot. I didn't drink a beer but they have a vast selection on tap.

What a fun place to drink wine! I was in Boise visiting my BFF who moved hear recently and we LOVE our wine, its kind of our thing haha. So of course one of the first places she had to introduce me to was this wine heave. 

I love that you have the autonomy to pick from so many different wines. I also really appreciated that you can choose to get 3oz poor, it makes tasting new wines great! I loved that I could try something and not commit to a full glass unless I really liked it. This is one of the things I absolutely hate when going out, taking chances on wines I have never had before and often at a 200-300% markup. 

It was a bit busy and seating was very scarce but we managed to find a place after a bit of a wait. We didn't get much service as we weren't eating but they could have checked on us at least once or twice after the initial "how many glasses" encounter, my only complaint. 

Overall, this was a fun visit and we there will for sure be many more future visits.

Went for lunch and ordered the tempura shrimp & vegetables. The veggies were good but the so called shrimp tempura was terrible. It seemed like it may have been dipped in tempura batter and then rolled with panko bread crumbs. Not a true tempura. It could have been good but after taking off all that breading, they were pencil thin pieces of shrimp, literally. You could not even taste shrimp. It came with 6 pieces and looked impressive but it was all breading. YUK!!!

Was looking forward to trying this place. My daughters and I stopped in around 4pm and it wasn't real busy. I hadn't ever been there before so I asked the guy at the register if we seat our selves or wait. He was very condescending in the way he answered me and repeated himself just in case I missed it the first time. So we found a table and waited and waited and waited. Not even an effort made by anyone like they were coming our way. We ended up leaving and eating somewhere else. Very disappointed.

This was our first time trying Culver's, and we really enjoyed it! As a family, we tried the bacon butterburger, fries, cheese curds, chicken strips, and frozen custard. The bacon butterburgers were very good. The best part was definitely the softness and juiciness of the meat. It really was like biting through butter--extremely soft. Not as flavorful as say Wendy's or Five Guys' meat... but unique and enjoyable. The crinkle fries were quite yummy. The cheese curds were delicious! Definitely give them a try. The chicken strips were just okay. The frozen custard was delicious; although the chocolate was maybe a bit too rich for my taste. I preferred the vanilla. All in all, it was a great experience. The employees were all awesome and very friendly, the restaurant was clean, and the food was yummy. Give it a try!

I got a pedicure with 2 family members at the same time to celebrate birthdays. Each of us had a wonderful experience. Melissa gave me a fantastic foot massage, which was included as well. The price was very reasonable. I will definitely return.

Had our Cobber dog put down today...
While I can, I just want to thank Dr. Doug Mills and his staff for all the best of care and expertise they have given me Cobber over the past couple of years we have been seeing him.
Always gives good advice without the fear that it is all about the money, not at all.

He went out of his way to schedule us in today on a busy Monday to help us do what we needed to do to make our Cob leave this world in a dignified and painless way, I will always be grateful for that...

I would recommend him and his staff wholeheartedly, without and hesitation whatsoever, they are all great.

Thank you so much Dr. Mills.
Now off for a good cry...

I recently moved to Meridian and needed help with a bad tooth. Dr. Porter was the first dentist I saw. He was great. Listened to what I had to say, and I felt his empathy. I went home with meds and over the weekend my tooth blew up and by Monday I was in agony. I then met Dr. Grant. He took a look and immediately called a colleague of his to help me. I needed an emergency root canal. He was so concerned and it showed. I got over to Dr. Eaton and he took care of me. I needed more work done and Dr. Grant was just awesome. I can tell you that everyone at the office is just fantastic. From the front office staff to the assistants to the doctors they are all top notch. Dr. Grant has taken great care of me and my wife too. She hates going to the dentist and after her 1st visit she was very comfortable with Dr. Grant. Having recently moved I can't tell you how nice it is to stumble on to such quality care. Maybe stumble is the wrong word. I looked up dentists and have never seen so many good reviews in my life. I trusted them and I am glad I did. The people at Dr. Grants office truly care about their patients and take pride in the work they do. I highly recommend coming here. You won't be sorry. Thanks doc you've been a life saver.
My wife and I went and had an incredible time! I highly recommend this for anyone that likes Thai food and, since I'm not a big-time fan also anyone who doesn't like Thai

Super disappointed! I loooove the Village and was excited about the prospect of a quiet, mellow upscale place to get a glass of wine or have a book club meeting but my first venture there did not go well. My mom made the reservation for 12 at about 3pm, a weird time when it shouldn't be busy and apparently the person taking the reservation asked if the party would be eating and drinking "because they couldn't sacrifice the space" if we weren't. Of course we were...maybe they have a problem with that, but I think it's really tacky to ask. 

We got there and the waitress seemed very flustered from the beginning. We were the only table in the place and drinks still took quite a while. We were not given silverware or menus until we asked and she was really confusing in her description of whether we could order from the lunch/dinner/happy hour menus. She took our orders, then came back to confirm the orders and "clarify how the checks would be split", then the food came out and the person delivering it was auctioning off the food ("who had the...?!") which is a pet peeve of mine in nicer restaurants. My step dad didn't get his food at all and when it finally came out they sent the wrong thing and he didn't get to eat until almost everyone else was done. 

I wasn't impressed by my sausage stuffed pastry from the happy hour menu (it came out two mildly burnt squares on a plate, not visually appealing), but almost everyone else said their food was good. Raves about the pumpkin bisque soup.  My happy hour moscato was only $5/glass and delicious. 

Bottom line, I will try it again because I want so much to like it, but I'll probably stick to happy hour and simple orders.

We had a wonderful experience here at this family owned business. We sat at the bar and received great service from everyone. Spoke to Coach and he was fun to chat with. We actually prefer to belly up at the bar in restaurants. Lighting could be a bit swankier with some softer pendulum lighting instead of the oversized, tin looking, white ones with the bulbs exposed. Just a little too in your face. If lighting was softer overall, the space would be more warm and inviting, but it was decorated very nicely. Good first impression. Food was delicious too! Got complimentary chips, salsa and bean dip, which was awesome! I got the Carne Borracha Molcajete and my hubby got the Chile Verde Molcajete, which he loved and said was one of the best he's had! While mine was super amazingly tasty and flavorful, the meat was a little tough, but I couldn't stop eating it. I never had a Molcajete and this dish came highly recommended by the staff. Soft warm tortillas did not disappointed either.

There's nothing like the Blue Tiger in Meridian. We started off with a nice house wine. Next we enjoyed the Brussel sprouts. Lastly, we had the pizza. The crust was super yummy. The toppings ranged from simple to more complex combinations. This is a must try for the valley!
Great salon!  Not too noisy, friendly, clean, and I got one-great-cut from Tanya!!  Highly recommend!

The best barbecue in the Treasure Valley in my opinion. 
They have a wide variety of delicious food with something for everyone. Some of my favorites include the two meat plate with brisket and smoked turkey, the wedge salad, and the chicken strips!

The restaurant is always clean and we have yet to get a bad waiter/waitress. 

We aren't able to go here very often as it is more on the pricey end, but the food is definitely worth it.

5 stars??? Yes!  So much fun!  I'm a kid at heart so this is my kind of place.  The service was awesome and everyone made sure we had a great time! Thank you!    Food and drinks were so good!  This will be our go to place for Birthdays going forward.. Highly recommend for a group of people or family outing. So yes 5 stars!

The staff here especially Taylor who has worked with me on laser hair removal has been awesome! They are always friendly and welcoming and I get in and out as planned. I recommend them if you need their services and they have some awesome Black Friday deals coming up!
Never disappoints.  Excellent food and service.  We always look forward to a fantastic meal at Goodwood.  Thanks for doing what you do so well.
Awesome customer service. Saved me lots of money! I went and purchased all my hunting gear for the year and a few AR15 accessories and the employees were very knowledgeable!
Great service, excellent food. Very happy with the entire experience. I had the Tricolor Enchiladas and they were the best I have had in a very long time. Would definitely recommend!

The location is great. It used to be Fusion restaurant. The decor is nice, darker than the sister's restaurant, Pad Thai House. The same owner and chef (and familiar faces of the staff) as Pad Thai House on Overland and Five Mile bring the same delicious taste on all the food. Tom Kah Gai soup is always our favorite. We also ordered fried tofu for appetizer, my boys loved them! Red curry chicken is also yumm! Pad Thai can't go wrong. It was great for Sunday brunch .

Driver was right on time and texted us when he was on the way. Also texted us confirming our reservation after we made it which I found reassuring that they would not forget.  Driver was friendly and made us comfortable on the way to the airport. He drove safely.

The Bomb. Puts Beni Hanna's to shame.  Much better menu selection, better drinks, better cook, better entertainment, better saki and way better prices!  Will need to go to the gym as I will be a regular!

Do not go here. I asked for an appointment with the owner after spending $6000.00 on 4 implants and dentures.  They have never fitted right and the owner would not even talk to me.  Go to Affordable Dental where they do a great job and the price is less than 1/3 of   Accura.

ARANCINI BALLS!!! That's what I want to start with. These are fried balls filled with risotto and served on delicious marinara. I can not express my love for these enough. It is the perfect flavor combo. They are only $7 and you get two decent sized balls.  The meatballs are also delicious. What I really love is that they fry their apps in a canola/cottonseed oil blend. I'm a foodie with a soy allergy. Most places use the soy vegetable oil because it's cheap and convenient. This makes it so hard for me to have anything. Bodovino is the one place I can go to and have delicious treats without having to worry about soy products. And the flavors here- oh the flavors. On top of delicious food- they have a great happy hour with wine selection.  You can get a tasting for a $1.00 and up at the happy hour prices. This place is a must visit!

Hint:  the $9.99 special  is not advertised at the restaurant but is a 6oz sirloin with Salad bar. Cheaper than a salad bar by itself for dinner.  And you can upgrade to an 8 oz for 1.70 more 
AND - never have the kitchen load the baked potato for you. Just get the toppings from the salad bar. 
Clean, good service, yummy food and great crispy cheese toast.

My kids love this place. We go almost every other week. Great staff clean fun place. The staff is very nice to the kids each time. They have drinks and other games to play. And a few sofas for the parents to seat and visit.  Keep up the good work.

I'm not normally impressed by a cinema but this place is fancy. From the main concession area all the way to the seats that have food trays its an experience. Had the joy of visiting well in town and i'm seriously jealous that we don't have anything like this near where I live.

We agree with John P's review from May 5. You'll need to click on "reviews we don't recommend" because apparently only reviewers with "friends" here are worth publishing. We hope John P's dog is doing well now, and cannot believe the level of incompetence from Mills not onlyk with our dogs with with John's, just a few months ago.

I have serious concerns with Doug Mills competency and level-headedness. Reading about John P's disaster with Mills completely missing an easy diagnosis is frightening, and if I wasn't already scared away by Mills I would be now. He is seriously hit and miss---mainly miss with us.

We brought in our dogs and thought we would try out this vet since he is close to our house. What a mistake. Mills was trying to get the attention of another customer (attractive female who pretty much wanted nothing to do with him) and treated us--who had an appt he was late for because of his socializing--like dirt or an irritation he wanted to get rid of as fast as possible. His lack of professionalism really was shocking to us. He did the exams and had to be reminded about the vaccinations. Distractions galore with this guy. 

If you care about your dogs, DON'T TAKE THEM TO DOUG MILLS. He's one of those vets you'll read about one day as making huge mistakes because of lack of skills, lack of attention or just being unprofessional.   There are so many good vets in Boise that we will continue to go there.

Used to love this place! Walked in tonight about 7:30pm literally no one said a word. I was surprised because no one was in line and 6 people working behind the counter, every other time we have come here no matter how busy they are they at least say hello. We approach the counter ready to order and stand there for a good 3-4 minutes, again not one word. Now if they were busy I would be ok with that, even tho it doesn't take a lot to say "hi, I'll be right with you", because that used to be one of the things I liked about coming to Zupas. Things changed tonight; one person was stocking bread, one was making a sandwich, one was making a salad complaining to their coworker about customers and the other was just chilling listening to the other one complain and then two cashiers were just hanging out. I finally walked up and asked the one gal if she was the manger, she said "yeah". I said I'm pretty disappointed, not one person has said a word to us and we've been standing there waiting with no one in line, is there someone who could possibly help us. She said "I was making a sandwich". And there ya have it folks! I was like oh ok well I guess we're done here. Needless to say we walked out and took our business to the Habit where they cheerfully greeted us as soon as we walked in. It's too bad we used to love this place. I really hope upper management pays attention to this review and addresses the lack of customer service.

The new "ice skating rink" is pretty cool and fun. My daughter loved it.

However, that is where the good stops. It is obvious there is no leadership present. The staff don't know how to properly operate the POS system. It took more than ten minutes to be charged improperly. It wasn't worth arguing to get the price to be properly charged - pathetic. In the end, I was over charged by $14 by someone that doesn't understand the prices nor math. One person couldn't operate the system while the other was too busy on her phone. 

What is the point of the rules if no one is going to enforce them? Wait, I know the answer. ALL of the staff is too damn busy on their damn phones. I was watching kids that were way too short to be on the large jumping bag while the "guard/staff" member was screwing off on her phone. What the hell? 

The "ninja time" has a minimum height restriction. Obviously it means nothing to parents or staff. Wait, they are on their phones again!

The clothing of the staff is poor. Ripped pants? What the hell is that besides unprofessional? They also seem to be so bored they are out jumping. Shouldn't they be paying attention to what is going on? We all know there is plenty of cleaning to do if they're that bored. 

For the ice rink, I would recommend covering the sharp edges all over, though. Otherwise, it is a good time. Also, please do what bowling alleys do with shared shoes. I don't need crabs of the feet. 

And, stay off your damn cell phones and pay attention! You're asking for a damn lawsuit. 

Did I mention that cell phones are a problem with the staff?

This place really is the best. Their swim lessons are very reasonable, and the instructors are very enthusiastic and wonderful with the children. The manager there listens to feedback, and reacts accordingly. There's a swimming area for all ages, including a kiddie pool that has huge umbrellas that cover the entire area. That's pretty cool.

I actually definitely give this establishment a 0 star (I had to give a star rating in order to post this) and would not recommend their services!  I took 2 sweaters with roll up cuffs in to be cleaned. I pointed out that the inside of all the cuffs were soiled. After picking them up later, I hung them up in my closet as it was the end of winter. I took one out in early spring to wear and when I rolled the cuff up it was just as soiled as when I took it in to be cleaned. I checked the other sweater and the cuffs were also still soiled.  I took them back to the cleaners to be re-cleaned pointing out the problem.  What happened  next was shocking....the lady claiming to be the manager said I had never brought my sweaters there. I have lived here 10 years and this is the only cleaners I have ever used and I go there approximately  once a month.  She then proceeded to claim my sweaters were dirty and even had popcorn on one.  Upon checking...sure enough at the bottom of one there was what looked like caramel corn....it was so embedded that I had to twist and pick at it to get it out....a sure sign that they hadn't cleaned my sweater properly in the first place.  When I pointed this out, the lady told me to get out and called me a white ho, followed by "get out white trash" 3 times.  Needless to say I was stunned and wanted out of there.  UNBELIEVABLE!

I just went to this restaurant for one of my best friend's birthday and I was actually really excited to try it out since my friend had mentioned the food was great. I left so upset and disappointed and I was not the only one. Our entire table of 12 was shocked at the TERRIBLE service we experienced. Now, I was a server for about 8 years at one point so I know what it's like to be super busy and I was trying to be understanding but the whole experience was very disappointing... Not only was the server impossible to find but she had a really bad attitude from the start. It wasn't even that busy and it not only took forever to get our food but after I received my pasta I had to go find the server and ask for some bread which she mentioned would be an additional charge. No problem, a little bit of bread with fettuccine is always nice. After I had finished my meal and everyone was done eating I again had to search for our server to let her know that I was done with my meal and that I no longer wanted the bread. She was VERY rude and walked away without saying a word. 15 minutes later she brings the bread over and says with a super rude attitude that the owner/cook said we had to pay for the bread because it was ordered. I explained we had all finished our meal ages ago but her attitude was so terrible I just told her to forget it. She added 18% gratuity to all our meals on top of everything else which was ridiculous since she had given us terrible service!!!!! I will never go back to that place again and I can't believe that even the owner acted that way. They OBVIOUSLY don't care about the repeat business and treat they customers like CRAP!

We had a great experience this evening!
For whatever reason, the host forgot to seat us. They recognized the error and apologized for it. While we were waiting for another seat to open up, they let us pre-order an appetizer on the house. 
The appetizer was great, the entrees were delicious and generous portions, and to top it all off we were given a key lime cheesecake!
I would highly recommend coming here for dinner and dessert!

The staff were friendly, gracious, and efficient; the restaurant outside and inside is charming; and most importantly, the food is delicious. 

A friend and I (both from out of state) attending a conference were able to get the last available reservation the evening we dined there, and not only was the food superb, but we were treated to a sampling of a Basque side dish that was excellent. 

I highly recommend this restaurant, and reservations are required, so plan ahead. It was a delightful introduction for us to local Basque cuisine.

DON'T EVER GO HERE! The service is rude and slow, it took 20 minutes for them to cook my order ( a 4 piece chicken tender meal and a plain quarter pounder with cheese ) and the fry's were almost cold, you would have expected they give you something free or at least a discount for waiting 20 MINUTES mind you but NO, Unacceptable service and no apologies, DON'T EVER COME HERE! GO TO ANOTHER MCDONALDS OR SOMEWHERE ELSE!

I don't mind paying for good barbeque. I was told this was a good place. I ordered a 1/2 slab of St. Louis style ribs. That is not what I got. I have never seen a St. Louis style rib presented with a 2 inch bone and unfortunately it was a portion smaller that a 1/2 slab. I should have returned and asked if they were trying to play a joke on me. I'm not motivated to give them another chance. I wonder what a 1/2 order of chicken looks like. Maybe it was an off night or maybe the person in the kitchen needs training??? I could say more but I will leave it at that. Seriously did not get my money's worth.
Fantastic! Now that opening bugs are worked out, everything is great. Bought tickets on-line-- you even get to choose your seats!
The food was very lack luster. It was incredibly cold in the bathroom. I don't recommend it.

Really good food but the prices are just way too high for what you get. It's just my humble opinion so it probably doesn't count for much but I really think that they would have a lot more business if they would bring their prices down just a little bit. That way everyone could afford to go.
Great buffet, very affordable, attentive and friendly staff.  Family owned and authentic.  We've tried a lot of Indian restaurants, and this is one of the best.

I came in on a Wednesday night. And the wait staff was very friendly and the food came out fast. I ordered the duo fajitas with shrimp and steak. And this steak and shrimp fajitas were delicious. I sat in a corner and videos  chatted with my husband. The wait staff seem to understand and not appear to be off put.  I'm glad I stopped in!

We have an old house in Boise that had a mysterious blockage. Al came and worked diligently to figure out and fix the problem, but telling us we probably needed to replace a line in the future. We then blocked it up about 6 months later. He helped us again, but let me know how to correct the issue ourselves until we decided to pony up the money to break concrete and permanently fix the plumbing. This was over a year ago. 

Recently, I bumped into him at a restaurant during his lunch break and he talked with my husband and I for 15 minutes DURING HIS LUNCH BREAK about our house issue (now that we're planning to truly fix it). He not only remembered the house and it's issues, but recommended the best way to go about figuring out how to get the repair done cheaper by doing some of the work ourselves. 

I do not know what the review from Calvin S. was about because Al has never been anything other than courteous and helpful. He's never been intimidating or nasty, perhaps because I understand plumbing can be expensive and I've been respectful and courteous. You reap what you sow. 

Al is great and I recommend him to anyone who wants an honest plumber that cares about excellent customer service.

My favorite Indian restaurant! My husband and I were craving Indian food and super excited to find this place.  We are also nervous about trying new places but you absolutely won't be disappointed in this restaurant.   Food was excellent and sauces delicious with spices.  I love Indian food but can't handle spicy food so they made all my dishes super mild but still so flavorful.   My husband likes spicy food and he enjoyed his dishes.

Outstanding customer service!
I was helping plan a surprise marriage proposal and needed a place for everyone to go after the proposal for a celebratory toast.
They really went out of their way to take care of us, confirmed everything we needed when I set up the event, called to reconfirm the morning of the event, communicated during event since it was hosted so that we didn't have any surprise charges.  Larry was great to work with and our server Mya(?) was outstanding. (They even reserved the outdoor patio for our group, which I dont think they usually do!)
Overall it was outstanding and we felt well taken care of!

Thank you!!!

Very simple process. I called in to see if it's something they could fix (the metal around my diamond was worn down).

I dropped it off and that was an in and out procedure, the employee was a bit unfriendly but nothing to really disway me.

I dropped it off during the holidays so it took a while to fix but I found that to be understandable given the time frame.

They charged me a very reasonable price comparatively to what a big jeweler quoted me.

Picked it up and it looked more gorgeous than ever.

Went here with friend on the Saturday after Thanksgiving, it looked very busy and we expected a long wait, but we were seated in about 5 minutes.  Waitress appeared and took our drink orders, which she quickly returned with and she was also very knowledgeable about the menu.  My friend asked about the smoked prime rib and she admitted that she had never had it , but many of her customers were well pleased with the dish.  I ordered the burnt ends brisket open-faced sandwich (my favorite and yes I've been here before).  Salads came quickly, with enough time for finishing before the entrees arrived.  My friend's 12 oz. prime rib was one of the largest hunks of meat that I have seen in quite awhile, it had a nice smoke ring and was quite tasty (he gave me a bite).  My burnt ends were excellent, just enough sauce and very tender for brisket.  Our drinks were kept filled and the waitress checked on us regularly (but not too intrusive).  All in all a great meal, with helpful, attentive staff, I will be back.

First visit to the dentist in six years. I was very anxious to go back. Luckily my teeth weren't awful esp for not ever having braces. The receptionists were very sweet and helpful. After I filled paperwork out one took me to a private room asking if I had any questions or concerns. They have stuff to make you relaxed like water, blankets, pillows, etc. I was then taken back to get my cleaning done, in which they relayed my concern about my anxiety and stuff to Shell who did my cleaning. She was wonderful, made me feel relaxed and I was not nervous or in pain once. After Abby and and Dr. Piper came in to chat and go over a few things. Ended up having four small cavities I need to just top off. Then leaving the receptionists were so helpful with pricing with my insurance coming to an end as well as answering my questions. They even gave me a huge cooler tote for being a first time customer. 

I highly recommend this place if you want peace and comfort and relaxation. Knowing you are being taken care of especially with your teeth, is so important. Five stars!!!

1st time visitor at Diamonds Fine Jewelry.
Lance was very helpful and super nice.
Fixed my jewelry that has been broken for awhile in no time. Will definitely be a returning customer.
Loved the selection of jewelry that was on display.
Love the prophetic and healing ministry at this church! The message of grace is refreshing. My family and I enjoy this church very much.
This is my second time here and Kendall is amazing! She is very personable, listens to what I am looking for and does just what I want.

I am so happy with the service at this location! My windshield wiper fluid wasn't coming out and spraying my windshield like it should. After trying on our own to troubleshoot the problem, I took the car to Einstein's to see if they might have an idea. Chris found that the tube was pinched under the air filter and that's why we weren't getting a spray. He fixed it in less than 5 minutes and sent me on my way. They didn't charge me anything and did it with a smile!

If I could do a 3.5 I would.  It wasn't as good as our last visit, which was a 5.  The service was definitely lacking in our waitress Dept.   Others stepped up to take our order, clear our plates even pick up our check. :(.  We ordered the potato skins :) a definite 5, but our combo plate of burnt ends (too fatty), brisket (dry and overcooked, and baby backs (good).  The fries were hot and fresh and the baked beans were delicious.  We'll still go back :)
Best nail experience I've had in Idaho. The lady was so sweet and so patient not to mention she did a fantastic job on my coffin nails they look so perfect! Would definitely recommend this place

I'm giving 2 stars as I can see this would be a fun place to sit around the hibachi tables and for the 2 eel I tried. That is where it ends. 

I want to preface by saying I worked in a sushi bar for 2 years, back in the day, at California Beach Rock N' Sushi in OC Cali. It was there that I was introduced to what good sushi tasted like, looked like, smelled like, and felt like on the tongue. The original CAL Beach had sushi chefs that had been trained by their grandparents, who were trained by theirs. Seriously. So I am slightly biased and have a high bar that has to be met before I throw out stars.

We had a gift cert, and was the real reason we ventured here. Our waiter was quiet and quick, the food was mediocre at best. The sushi... I made a big mistake in ordering something called a Spicy Trio. It was rolled haphazardly, it looked horrible on the plate, it all tasted the same, it had a mouth feel that I'm still getting over, eww. I also ordered Eel. The eel was good and those 2 stars above go to the eel.

I forked over $25 for hibachi for the kids, filet mignon and chicken. The filet was good, the chicken was over and dry. It was doused in sauce so the kids didn't notice. The salad which was mostly white lettuce in a mayo-like Japanese dressing. I have experienced fresh, delicious miso soup. Miso here was broth with one little mushroom floating in it. 

Our bill with the $20 off made this an "ok" meal. Had I paid full price, I just would not ever go back and pay full price for that food. It was like the Sizzler of Japanese food. Good for the cheap all-you-can-eat shrimp but not really GOOD food. Just "there".
Everyone was very friendly and helpful and took the time to give me all the information I needed.

Great atmosphere. Good food and friendly staff.
I would suggest this place over any other Thai restaurant in The Treasure Valley.
Prices are very good too.

DON'T EVEN ATTEMPT GOING WITHOUT RESERVATIONS!! Don't even know where to start here.  Took my husband and in laws. The servers are the nicest people ever!  It's very family too. Loved the bread with butter (yup filled up on that easily). I ordered the squid in ink, which was amazing, highly recommend. Husband had the lengua which was absolutely amazing and in laws had the Special Trout which they said was amazing. We had dessert and I fully recommend the Bread pudding, it was WOW!

I liked the people here but my results were not as good as I expected.

The ladies here are very friendly and accommodating. 

My sister, cousin and best friend have all done laser hair removal and none of them have to shave anymore. We all have the same skin and hair coloring. I bought an entire body package and still needed more so I bought a touch up package and still have to shave. I am not sure if it just doesn't work on me or if some places are better than others. 

If you want to do laser hair removal I'd suggest getting one area and seeing how it works for you before doing more. It is a big time and money commitment for it to not work as expected.

Quite possibly the worst Mexican food I have ever had! Everything was very bland and had no flavor to it, including the salsa which tasted like puréed tomatoes and onion but nothing else. I ordered the casa burrito and the enchilada sauce tasted like plain tomato sauce. Maybe that's how it's supposed to be, as authentic Mexican food, but we did not like it. There's a difference between something being mild (or hot) and actually having flavor. Nothing seemed to have any flavor. My husband ordered ground beef enchiladas and they brought him chicken ones. He ate them anyways and said even the chicken had no flavor as tasted of it had been boiled and shredded. We will definitely not be back! Very overpriced! I wish we would've read the reviews first!!!

Good food, friendly service in a cute setting. The portion size was small for me but no complains with its flavors. So far I have only tried Thai fried rice in my two visits. Based on the food served on the table, everybody enjoyed their order. So, overall, visit them for authentic Thai flavors in Boise.

PS - cautious with the spice level, mild or medium would be a way to go as you could be in tears while eating the hot version even if you can handle very spicy food.

Ordered via DoorDash at 8pm after a 10 hour drive. Food arrive packaged well, was fresh and delicious just what we needed after a long day on the road! Has the turkey avocado sandwich, tomato soup, mushroom bisque and the make your own salad. Everything was correct.
Good manicure terrible pedicures. Tried them twice and both times pedicure very poor

I recently lost a very close friend of mine and had no idea where to start on floral arrangements for his funeral. I had gone to one other floral shop and was treated very rudely so needless to say, I was feeling pretty defeated and fed up by the time I got there. My friends death was unexpected so money was definitely a concern for me. When I walked in, I was greeted very warmly and as I started to cry from pure frustration I was met with a very caring touch on my hand and told that it was going to be okay. I was walked through every option and she worked with my budget beautifully and even discounted the arrangements for me as I am military. I wasn't sure if I wanted them delivered or not because we didn't have the service completely planned, but I called her last minute and told her where it was and she offered to deliver them and get me taken care of. The day of the funeral, I walked in and the arrangements were absolutely stunning. Don't go anywhere else if you ever need flowers for a funeral. I was treated very well and everything was as perfect as it could have gone. Thank you so much. I will absolutely be a repeat customer.

We have been attending Life Church for over two years and are blessed to call this our home church.  Worship is incredible, Pastor Mark's teachings are truly led by the Holy Spirit and people genuinely care!  

There are two Sunday services, 9:30 and 11:30AM.  Services are approximately 1.5 hours and begin with worship and announcements after, followed by Pastor Mark's message.  There is also a weekly Wednesday night Believer's Meeting that begins at 7PM.  Every first Wednesday of the month is healing night.  I grew up in the church but never once attended a service outside of a Sunday one.  I attended my first Believer's Meeting last April and have been to almost every single one since.  I highly recommend attending a Wednesday night Believer's Meeting if you haven't already!

There are a good variety of Life Groups that are available to join.  There is also an awesome Kid's & Youth ministry with Vacation Bible School and Kid's camp over the summer, Youth camp in the Winter, Kingdom encounter nights, live worship and more! 

Even though, this is an amazing church, the most important factor in this is God and our relationship with Him.  Since attending Life Church, my life has been transformed, I have had more God encounters in these last two years than I have had my entire life and I know Him better than ever.  God is present, He is alive and He loves us!  God led my family to Life Church and I am so thankful.  He knew what I needed before I did.

HORRIBLE!!
First of all, you're paying for location.

This place is a scam. My bill was over $200 for an office visit! From now on CHECK FIRST. I recently had a procedure done (endoscopy) and THAT WAS CHEAPER!!

I was told the bill was so high because the "doctor" bills per subjects talked about. I was only there for 30 minutes and he covered a lot of subjects and when my wrist problem FINALLY came up - he referred my to a wrist doctor. (He does like to talk and wrack up that $$ invoice/bill)

Place seems kind of a scam. NEVER going back. Doctor spent less time with me than promised over the phone too.

Some of the food is pretty good, some not so much.  Their BBQ sauce is good. In fact, Id say its better than good. Their brisket is always lean, which is a huge plus. So many BBQ places, like famous Dave's, serve fatty brisket. 

The best thing about Good Wood is that it is always consistent. So many restaurants go up and down from visit to visit. This place is always good and always the same. I don't even have to ask for my brisket to be lean. Its always lean and never changes. 

Even though the brisket is lean and ok, its far from great. I make a far better one. I drown the brisket in sauce, which makes it good. But any meat that you have to drown in sauce to make good is not really good.

My wife always has the smoked turkey, which is also decent. But again, I make a far better one. 

They do have Sweat Tea here!!!!!! I am from texas, so having sweat tea is a must. But no Okra. This is a sin.

My wife and I go here often because we just can't find a BBQ place any better than this. 

The burger is not very good at all. The burn end sandwich was all fat. The corn bread has real corn in it. yuk. I have never had corn bread in Texas with actual corn in it.

The service is very good, which is another reason we keep coming here. In fact, on my last visit, my wife got the nachos. It looked like the person that made it got carried away with the cheese. The cheese on top was thick. So thick that when they went to heat ip up, the top got hot, but underneath, it was still cold.

We pointed this out and the waitress immedially took it back. She removed the nachos from our bill without us even have to ask. We had about 6 people, including the manager come by our table and tell us they were sorry. The service here is nothing short of amazing, which is why we will continue to eat here.

Yikes. I almost wish I could give this place a zero star rating. I lived in Italy for four years and this is NOT Italian food!! I took my mom on a date to The Village for a movie, some shopping, and lunch. Bodovino looked like such a cute little place to sit down and have lunch in front of the fountain in the outside air but boy was I WRONG! First off, the menu was confusing at best, in the "pasta" section it literally said "all pasta served on spaghetti" ... um spaghetti is a pasta ... That was my first red flag that these people have no idea what Italian food is. We ordered a caprese salad for a starter and was a little weirded out when it wasn't in slices like I'm used too but decided to roll with it until I realized it had bean sprouts instead of basal ... like what?? The bean sprouts were impossible to chew and gave the salad a very weird and off-putting taste. I ended up ordering the ravioli and my mom got the soup, salad, and bread. The ravioli came SUBMERGED in olive oil! It was like swimming in a Olympic sized pool of it. WHAT?! I had to shake off my ravioli and transfer it to another plate where it made its own pool of olive oil. Further disappointment, the pasta was over cooked and far from al dente. Not sure how the filling tasted because all I could tase was olive oil and garlic. My mom's minestrone soup had kale in it ... okay ... and she said she kept tasting something very very bitter that left her mouth dry. Her bread was so stale that even soaking it in the bathtub that was my ravioli couldn't save it. Needless to say we will never be going back there, so disappointed I took my mom here when there are so many fabulous restaurants in Boise!

The food at Rick's Press Room is phenomenal.  I've seen a few complaints about the speed of the service.  Feel free to hit the McDonald's drive through if you are looking for fast food.  This is a great place to take your loved one or family and have a nice relaxed dinner with food and beverages that will keep you coming back.

I came here with friends. The food inns delicious. We appreciate the sounding spice scale and people could palette spicy food so there had something for everybody. Not bad if you want roll try something different.

We love this place,  food is fabulous.  But when thou add for add ons for soup,  they fill up a spoon and then shake until it's flat,  so yippy get very,  very,  very little add on for 70+ cents.  RIP OFF!!!!
I usually don't leave reviews, but I was so impressed tonight that I felt I had to! AMAZING food, great service, and an overall awesome experience. I would absolutely recommend Izumi's to anyone

Since my reviews are becoming famous (more like infamous), I plan on elaborating as much as possible on this recent visit to Sizzler.

Before I get started...."Hey Shooter...Wanna go to Sizzler????????"  If that just made you LOL, awesome!  If not, stop reading my review.............now!

Of course the place is clean.  We started our visit around 11:05AM and they open at 11:00AM.  We actually drove by the front door to make sure they were still in business since there was NO ONE in the parking lot.  We were happy when we found the front doors unlocked and entered for some grindage.

Ordering was easy.  The person taking our order knew what she was doing but asked way too many questions!  Not the fault of the employee but Sizzler orders have too damn many options and asks too many questions.  Sizzler also serves Pepsi products so God Forbid you ask for a Coke.  Epic fail!

All four of us ordered the salad bar and at Sizzler, always a good idea......except this time.  As a caveat, we have visited the Boise Town Center Sizzler location multiple times so we are not new to the Sizzler experience.  We all found the salad bar lacking, small and the overall area claustrophobic.  I didn't say anything to anyone in our party about my epic fail feelings while at Sizzler.  It wasn't until many hours later we all agreed we've had better.

Personally, dessert is a big deal to me at salad bars/buffets.  I attempted to get some ice cream but when I pulled the chocolate ice cream lever, I received liquid, inedible chocolate.  HUH????  I know what ice cream looks and tastes like and today Sizzler....YOU FAILED!!!!

We visited this Sizzler location today because we spent the couple hours prior at Settlers Park.  Lesson learned.  I now realize why it's been 8+ years since my initial visit to this Sizzler.  Do yourself an epic favor if you're in the mood for Sizzler and make the drive to the Town Center Mall in Boise and get down on THAT Sizzler.

I read online that Culver's is known for their cheese curds and they are slap your mama good! We decided to finally try it since we were in the area. All of the staff was crazy friendly! The food was fast AND delicious! The double deluxe was so fresh and such a good burger all around! You MUST try the cheese curds with their cheese sauce, it's life changing! Plus, if you complete the survey you get a free custard. Flavor of the day is double strawberry and it did not disappoint!

I have never been so dissapointed. We got there and told them it was our first time they didn't have any special rules for my 3 year old son except that he should be supervised by an adult. After playing for more than an hour the manager said he had to stay in the kiddie area, when i asked about the other kids she didn't care. We went to the kiddie area and noticed about a dozen kids younger and smaller but nobody said anything. We realised he was he only dark skinned kid. We asked about that but they ignored us. Fuck these racist pieces of shit! Don't go there unless you have white skin.

Went in with high hopes but was let down slightly. We had a party of 15 people and called ahead 7hours prior to reserve a table and were still left standing for 15 minutes extra after our reservation, given it was a Friday, I'll cut them some slack. We had two servers keep attending us, one was rude and stern, didn't seem like he enjoyed his job at all. Nonetheless, the food was delicious and brought out in a timely matter. I must note that refills were never offered. Overall the experience was up to par and would maybe revisit with a smaller group or go to a restaurant that can handle our big group.

I'm so glad my experience with Ashley is finally over.  My financial stuff is through their smart sales so hopefully I will never have to deal with another Ashley person. 

These past 3 months have been hell.  It all started when I was sold a couch with the wrong measurements and wanted to cry when it was delivered. I went back to the store twice to sign a new deal with a new couch being told I was going to have to wait a whole month.  Longer than I would like to wait, however,  I thought,  people make mistakes,  move on.  
Soooo I get a text saying I'm having a deduction on my account for a couch I do not yet have in my possession.  Took all day to figure out and got in trouble at work for being on the phone for so long.  
Got another text a month later saying they were finally coming to pick up the new couch.  I called and they said they were not delivering the new couch that I would have to wait another month. 

Got another text saying they were coming over with my new couch 3 weeks later so I got off work early to find out that they weren't picking up my existing couch so I would end up with 2 couches in my living room. 

Ashley finally left after 3 months of hell.  I am very sorry I did business with these people.  In the end all they cared about was getting credit for the sale.  

Im being generous with the 2 stars because I really do love the new couch,  I just know I could have got the same thing without going through hell for it.

Interesting place. Oddly sterile. I couldn't say I liked it but I didn't not like it. The burger was just OK.  There was an odd flavor that dominated. I could not identify what it was. Onion rings were perfect. $25 for two burgers and one order of onion rings. I won't be back.

Great at what they do there is no questioning that. Worked for them for 1 day and can't even get paid for it and I worked very hard and got told I did an amazing job and yet I can't get paid for the amazing job I did!! Tried for 2 weeks but couldn't get anywhere with it, I understand it is only for a days work but I couldn't continue to ride my bicycle 14 miles to work and do the very hard manual labor the job calls for then ride my bike 14 miles home..

They would not assist in meeting my dietary restriction. Usually zupas food is pretty good, if you can't think of anything else. All I wanted was their cuban but I don't eat pork. So I asked them to take the ham and braised pork off and add braised turkey instead. You would think this would be totally fine considering all the sandwichs cost the same and I'm replacing 2 meats with one...But no. I don't care if you charge me extra, just make me the sandwich I drove here for.

If you've ever been to Goodwood, you would know that their staff there goes above and beyond to make sure every need is met.

The staff is very friendly and very customer service oriented. The restaurant is always very clean and the bathrooms are always very clean with a nice little station in the middle of the sinks with paper towels and mouth wash. 

Tonight I got the steak salad. It's really called the strawberry salad and I add steak to it. They are always willing to Tailor make anything you ask for.

My steak was cooked perfectly and placed last on top of my salad so nothing wilted. My drink was never empty. And I even went home with some leftovers because the portions are very generous.  I love going to Goodwood because they always have extra for lunch the next day!

Who can resist chips and queso?!

I'll stop in for a kids nachos or if I'm going to a potluck I may stop in and just grab chips and queso. I appreciate that the chips are hot and not stale and the queso is hot and ready to go.  Yum!

My other go to favorite are the street tacos.  I like that I can mix and match.  Those are super flavorful and made to order.  

Great place for a quick meal with my family!

This place is seriously AMAZINGGGGG! Yes the food is spending, but worth every penny. I've been here a couple times to do their hibachi and my goshhh it's so good! Also the people that work their are super nice!
Kim Brockner is fabulous!! She is knowledgeable and professional. I've had numerous services done by her. Facials, Dermaplane, Microneedling and Skin Sheek. I highly recommend her!
Teddy and Ryan were great! Very knowledgeable. We had a great time and always enjoy coming here when we are in town. Recommend to anyone.

Wow. Just wow. When your expectations are not only met, but shattered by a new standard of excellence, you have Done*Rite Tree Service! I knew my large, healthy, yet young trees (about 10 years old) needed trimming and shaping. I researched how to go about finding a tree service to do this properly, as well as safely and without heavy expense. The first two were my expectations, and the third was my hope. Yes, all three were met...very well I will say. They also cleared away all the limbs they had trimmed AND raked up the whole front yard from already fallen autumn leaves AND hauled it away! Oh. And FAST!! Extremely fast and efficient! This company came to my knowledge by very satisfied word of mouth...and now it's yours my yelper friend!

I placed an order online which was not even a pleasant experience. I should have taken that as a clue, but I proceeded anyways. The order said it would arrive in May 6th. I made arrangements to be home for the delivery, at 2 pm on the 6th I spent 45 minutes on hold and never got through, spent another 45 minutes with the online chat which takes 15 minutes for one reply.  I was assured it would arrive by end of day. Guess what, never showed up. The next day I get an email "confirming " a scheduled delivery of May 29th.  They had no intention of Delivering as agreed when purchased otherwise deliveries would not be 3 weeks later. No one wants to wait a month.  They have no respect for people, their work, or time. I would cancel but see people have a hard time getting refunds.  I can not wait to get my product and block their stupid emails that are sent multiple times a day. Each BS email makes me more mad.

We have dined at Izumi about a dozen times now. It's definitely one of our favorite restaurants in town. Their hibachi food is on point and their sushi is also excellent. My favorite food to order on the hibachi side is the filet and shrimp with fried rice. On the sushi bar side my wife and I like to order the sushi and sashimi plate for two. For the price, the portion is very good. The quality and freshness of the fish is top notch. The restaurant is kept clean, staff is very polite, and the atmosphere is very inviting. 2 thumbs up!
Chicken pad thai and some crab avacado roll...very yummy.  We decided to just dine instead of doing hibachi
Best sushi in Idaho hands down. The spicy girl roll and firecracker roll are a MUST. Start out with a yellowtail jalapeño appetizer and you won't be disappointed. 50% off drinks for happy hour!!
