The onion rings are great. Let's just say that was the best part of our meal. I had the ribeye and my husband had their Philly. My ribeye was way undercooked, his Philly was nasty and so we're their beans.. they sent my steak back to be "re-fired" somehow it still looked the same. Thankfully they took that meal off my bill. I was very disappointed with this place....

Reviewer #64

I'm a fan! Healthy eating, great tasting, wonderful people! 
The food here is smaller portion, but not smaller tastes. The salads they make are wonderfully blended. The soup (you can sample any) is warm and flavorful. You get a piece of bread and a chocolate dipped strawberry with each order. 

The desserts are nice sized and nicely priced, too. $3.99 for a large slice of cheesecake! 

The atmosphere is pretty relaxed as well-- the ONLY complaint, if you want to call it that, is the use of space of the lobby-- the tables are pretty close together and not much room. Try the pick 2 for under $10-- you chose two items from: soup, half salad (pretty big) or sandwich. Perfect for two people.

I can't really do spicy food, which would typically keep me away from a place that features spicy stuff.   But, spice-wimps, don't worry.  Their mild chicken is AH-MAY-ZING!  I love it, love it, love it.   I get it between 2pm and 4pm, when a 2-piece dark is 99 cents.  When it's hot and fresh, it can't be beat.

I had one odd thing happen at this location.  It was about 10 to 4 one afternoon, and when I went through the drive through to order the mild dark 2-piece special, they were out.  They quoted me a 15 minute wait and I agreed.  (I was desperate for their hot, fried goodness, okay? Don't judge.)  They pointed me to a spot in the hot sun and told me to wait there.  When I explained that we'd need to come up with something else, she had me give her my phone number and they'd call me when it was ready.  That worked out great... until the next day when a man called my phone thinking I was from Popeye's and "gave him my number".  Embarrassing!!  He got the receipt that had my phone number written on it.

Service has always been friendly.  I don't order drinks here because they're $2.50+.
Food was okay but kinda disappointed that the server was sharing with another server how hungover she was.  Awkward moment for me and my granddaughters.

We have used the village cinema to watch every movie premiere we buy tickets for. Unfortunately they wouldn't even refund us money or offer another ticket when we bought tickets on fandango and mistakenly came an hour late to the showing. When we asked for a solution they just brushed us off and said there was absolutely nothing they could do about it. The manager said the same thing. So not only did we miss the movie we were out 30 dollars as well. Horrible customer service and we will never be coming here again.
Got my carpet cleaner fixed--it had never worked since I bought it--and great curbside service.

Best sushi in Idaho, hands down. As someone who grew up in Los Angeles, where the standard for good sushi is extremely high, I can say that this place is up there with some of the best spots in LA. The presentation is outstanding, and the taste and texture of the fish is even better - flawless as good sushi should be! The Habachi is good too, but the sushi is clearly the standout.

Pretty nice atmosphere, I like the darker decor and spacious setting. Service has always been on point every time I've been here.

The worst experience I've ever had with a contractor. 0 stars is more appropriate. Not knowing a good contractor in town, we chose Handyman Connection because of positive experiences using this company in another city. What a mistake. The contractor did an absolutely horrible job. We hired Jarrett to expand our walk in closet which included cutting a hole in one wall and closing in another. The quality of his work was extremely poor, so bad that I probably could have done just as good and I'm not a "handy" guy. He left paint/plaster on the carpet, baseboards not painted to match, a small hole in one wall and the seam for the wall addition is ridiculous. After the job was complete (actually it was never fully complete) he told my wife it was going to be $250 more then the estimate. Now I realize unforeseen issues pop up during construction but I found it extremely unprofessional to not speak with us when the new costs arose instead of springing it on us at the end. So Jarrett, huge fail. The next day I called Handyman Connection to speak with them about my concerns. The lady on the phone was nice and listened to all my concerns and said it was above her level so she promised the owner would call me to discuss. She did proceed to charge my credit card including the extra amount. I thought this was unprofessional. I don't feel I should have been charged until speaking with the owner about the horrible job. 2 days later I got an email from the owner saying he wanted to make things "right" and I should talk to Jarrett. I explained to him I'd never let that guy back in my house and his response was again, "I want to make this right". Well it's been a week or so and have never heard from him again. Stay away from this place. Jarrett himself said you pay a premium for the backing of Handyman Connection but we proceeded anyways figuring a name behind the work would be worth the extra cost. It wasn't. Horrible customer service. Even after I complained about paying before being able to voice my concerns to the owner, some idiot in the office called my wife asking for payment and then a couple hours later called to ask how we liked the work and were we satisfied. Really?! Obviously they have no idea what they're doing.
An amazing experience with my wife. The basque food is over the top. Everything was perfect!

Ordered take out last night which had extra rice I didn't order, Nan bread was a soggy mess, food was watery and lacking flavor or what I would expect from an Indian restaurant.  The worst food quality I have had for Indian food.  And the restaurant was packed full with no one wearing masks apparently completely devoid of the pandemic we are trying to get rid of.
Only thing ive noticed is that the pizzas come out tasting/smelling fishy at times... But I like the deals, I'd rather spend an extra dollar for a fishy large pizza over little caesars any day.

Yellow Curry with sticky rice is on point! We ordered take out for a big group of friends, and medium spicy is perfect for my taste. The Pad Thai was delicious as well as the fresh spring rolls. The sauce that goes with the spring rolls is divine. Thank you 4 an awesome take out experience!

I love love LOVE Cafe Zupas food but the ordering process is VERY rushed and confusing. They need to put a better system in place so the next person on their food line knows what food they are making. Having to repeat myself 5 times before checking out is annoying. I also feel like the employees are moving so quickly that they do not stop to worry about any changes you might want to make. Slow down a bit and it will make the Zupas experience much more enjoyable.
The food is very mediocre.  It didn't have much taste.  The serive was good so thats why 3 instead of 2 stars.

I gave it four stars because I only ordered food to go. Order the chicken curry and it had great authentic tastetaste with a sense of fresh flavor. It definitely seems like they cook everything to order and not just have pot sitting around all day. A nice quaint place with nice decor. Everyone in their dining seemed like they were having a nice time and enjoying their food. I will definitely have to go back and dine in next time.

Actually 4.5. 
I will order the red curry and it did not disappoint. It's the perfect balance of sweet, savory, salty, rich.
I ordered it with shrimp and this is the first time a restaurant actually got it right. The shrimp is not over cooked and has a good fresh flavor. I will definitely be ordering this dish again.
Great service. 
Thai Iced Tea delish too. 
Great menu choice and very affordable.
Cozy interior. Great place to breakaway for lunch.
Steak cold, "chewy" potato not baked, last visit...

Nice place to grab a burger and beer or wine     Very pleasant and friendly waitress 

Would be a great place to watch sports. Lots of tv's. 

Burger was super good. Onion rings average. 

Within walking distance of Mariott suites. They also have tables outside.

If you just want wine, then go to this place, but please skip the food. My friend and I went for dinner a couple nights ago, and both of our meals were inedible. She got duck that was way undercooked and chewy and my fish was so over cooked and dry it was horrible. It was almost $60 for 2 glasses of wine and 2 horrible meals, it was a complete waste of money!

Wendy dental hygienists is always really friendly professional and gentle for my cleaning. The staff are always helpful and make a painful process seem simple.
Highly recommend all the great staff here at Millennium Dental

Employees are always happy to help and seem to give good advice when I'm not sure exactly what I need, like which type of oil to buy for my mowers, for example. 

They also were happy to help me with a return when I bought a spool of trimmer string which had been spooled wrong, which rendered it unusable. The exchange was quick and relatively easy, though they did ask for personal information with the return, such as phone number and home address, the latter of which I politely refused and they didn't mind.  I guess this helps them track who is making returns, but I still find it a little gross when stores ask for this kind of information. -1*

Will definitely buy my supplies here for my mowing company whenever I can.

I called yesterday and shared with the woman who answered the phone that I was new to the area and have 1 dog and 1 cat and that I was looking for a family vet for them. I explained that before I left I had both pets fully vaccinated but I was in need of having my small poodle Charlie's nails trimmed, sometimes when he itches around his neck his nails get caught in his curls and luckily I have been home when this happens because he cries, I shared that I would like to have it done ASAP, she quickly explained that her techs were very busy and why not go to PetSmart, I explained that I would much rather have a Vet do the trimming just in case. She explained that the Vet doesn't do the trimming it's the Tech's and again they are to busy. The earliest appointment would be in a week the 29th, just to get a nail clipping? I guess I was really spoiled back home with the Vet I have used for years, very busy office but they would welcome a nail clipping without an appointment, I may have had to wait but I knew they would take care of it with the Professionalism they showed each and every time. I have made other arrangements for his clipping today not 7 days away and they were happy to have my animals as new patients. We

This has become one of the most requested restaurants by my 12 year old. He loves the show at the grille even though he's seen it a few times now. It's a fun experience. Food is good, though beef entries at the grille tend to be slightly over cooked (so order rare if you want med-rare.)

I have since returned to GoodWood. The service is steller. The BBQ is pretty consistently good. I no longer order the full brisket platter. its just too expensive. No I get the Brisket sandwich every time. 

It is a bit less meat, but I dont miss it at all. Its served open faced, so for the price, I think its just about right. I still cant say anything good about the CFS (Chicken Fried Steak) here. I wil also warn you to stay away from the water. Its very nasty. All it would take is a filter to filter it in-house, but they refuse to do this.

Also, unless you like your meat pretty fatty, stay away from the Burnt Ends Brisket.

This Popeyes has gotten it's last dollar from me! They have messed up on my order so many times from giving me stale chicken, now today missing chicken. It was the last straw for me. 

Make sure you check your order before you leave!

If I could give -5 stars I would. I have been with sprint for 12 years. I sent my phone there to get fixe . Chris told me my phone wasn't covered n I would have to pay full price to get it fixed . The insurance company said I was covered and so did sprint. He said because I wanted to remove the insurance 10 days before I broke my phone I couldn't use it. He kept saying I got a credit for the insurance but the credit was for a referral I didn't get paid for. Both the insurance company and sprint called to talk to chris but he insisted he was righ . I have never been treated so poorly in my life. Chris told me i was committing insurance fraud. How is it fraud when you paid for the insurance from the day you bought the phone? They need to fire this person before they lose customers.
el gallo giro has a great staff and the taco's in boise. It's a need to go if your in boise area.

I just had the worst, most expensive drive thru sandwich ever!  I had an Arctic Cod Fillet with onion rings.  The fish was dry as was the bread.the lettuce seemed "slimy".  Honestly, if you can't do fish, don't have it on your menu!

First time visiting and purchased a pint of prepackaged Butter Brickle and it was solid vanilla custard with absolutely nothing in it! I would have returned it, had it not been that I tossed a receipt and brought it to the park to eat it was family. Very disappointing. Had I known this I never would have left the store, would have gotten my money back. Don't waste your time.
I wish this review would allow me to post pictures of it, it's amazing. Thanks Andrew, the individual posted on the bottom of this pint that packaged it.

Horrible food. Ordered wings, a small pizza and chips with bacon and sour cream and ranch on them. I asked for ranch on the side. Never got the ranch, pizza was cold and horrible and the chips had very little bacon and sour cream on the side. The bill was 40.00 and was not worth one tenth of that. Horrible food
Everything I've ever had at Epi's has been delicious, and this is coming from a fellow Basque. Nice and cozy atmosphere, wonderful staff and tasty food.

3rd person to Review Burger King, located in the Walmart in Meridian on Fairview Rd near Eagle. This is my 415th review. 

I generally chose to not review Fast food places because, well, I don't know why really, but when checking into this place today, I noticed their lack of reviews and the two they had weren't favorable. 

The service was quick, the food was presented well, served warm, delivered to me as opposed to calling my number, and the place was cleaned and had a good atmospheric feeling. 

I can't give them 5 stars though, because when I asked for sauce, and I asked for one of each, the manager on duty made it seem like it was the end of the world and I was some kind of weird-o, my perception of his "attitude" at least and you know what they say... perception is reality. Afterall, how else am I going to find the best tasting dip, if I don't try them all?!?
Good by and good luck . Not shopping there again . No my pillow . No more My Money . Buy local and American made products not cheap China made products.

Best hibachi in the valley, every time i got i get the filet and shrimp and it is amazing. The hibachi chefs have amazing personalities and really out on a show while making delicious food. I've never had a disappointing meal at the restaurant of the 10+ time i've been there.
I got my hair done by Alicia, so far from moving from California I have had 3 different women try to do what I like, and none of them did. Then I met Alicia, she's amazing! Young talented sweet girl!

Funny how they can remove your review. Went to the Nampa location to buy Ammo and was told I could only buy two boxes of Ammo I get it some places are limited but only two boxes for a place like sportsman's, at least Cabelas it a five box limit. Not only that the man behind the gun counter was just rude. I would give a zero if I could. Can't believe these bigger stores that I have shopped with for years are turning in Nazi police regulating Ammo. What's next Sportmans you going to require a hold on Ammo and a background check? Very disappointed.
In campground close by.  Good pizza, ready on time, friendly service.  We'd order again.

I'm going to be honest. This was hyped up to be one of the best locations locally to get sushi. What I received was the equivalent of grocery store sushi. 

The rolls were poorly wrapped and most of them were so soggy you couldn't pick it up without it falling apart completely. The pink lady roll is usually my go to at any sushi stop and it was the worst one I've ever had. Sadly I am disappointed and don't think I will order from them again.
Very knowledgeable staff with a lot of high end quality vacuums and accessories.   Knew what the issue was with my old vacuum right away.

This morning I needed help and a young guy helped me cut some wood. Got back and his cuts were all off by 1-2 inches. Really bummed because I was hoping to do this diy today. Live and learn I should've measured after him. I could tell he had no idea what he was doing. And stacking wood and then cutting isn't meticulous which ppl need. Wood prices are high, I wished he cared about that. The other day though we were helped by Juan and some other guy who cut the wood and they were great. Unfortunately today left a bad taste.

Horrible service.
Took over 20 minutes to get a value menu cheeseburger and fries.
When I told them they need to fix something because it was ridiculous. One of the employees proudly held up a middle finger at me and continued to hold it up as I left.
Whoever owns this location should really watch their camera footage.
I will be making contact with the Walmart.

We went to watch the fights last night. It's a great environment for sports but the service was terrible and the food even worse! This is in a great location but they need to get their service and quality up.

Without a doubt, this is the best Indian food I've ever had, and I've had quite a lot since I first discovered it in London, England back in 2000. Prior to COVID-19, I had to drive to the restaurant to get my Indian fix so I'm *extremely* happy they've extended their delivery radius to include Kuna, Idaho. Amazing food. I highly recommend it!

We just moved to Idaho and have not had a lot of "basque" cuisine apart from a Spain trip. We were so impressed by the amount of food and how delicious everything was! It felt like such a cute little local spot and very private. Everyone seemed to be really enjoying themselves and loving the food, the atmosphere was really nice. It was a wonderful date night restaurant but also would be great for groups!

From the moment I walked in I felt like I was at home. I honestly have never met a more caring personal. They literally have every single service you can possibly think of and their prices are 50% less than anyone else in the area. And the people there they don't just do a small percentage of your service they really go all out and that only the prices better but the machines are of a higher quality and they make such a big difference and you can see the difference the next day. I get the lipo laser by Lyndy and it absolutely works! I have a small pouch of my abdomen that's been bothering me and I'm telling you it actually works! I have been getting this laser treatment on my face and I bought the package the monthly package which is amazing deal by the way, and part of that package involves the Genesis Laser and it absolutely makes a huge difference in my skin! For a woman being 50 I am definitely looking younger! The one thing I'm extremely excited about, they have someone coming in that's going to be doing Hairpiece's, hair extensions and wigs. The custard is good. I drove across town one day to reward my kid with a loaded brownie dessert.  Not one brownie and a sad kid.  We were in the drive thru and there was nothing I could do since we noticed on the way home.
We went shortly there after for some chocolate cake  custard. Not one piece of chocolate cake. Again drive thru.
I've driven across town twice now to be disappointed. 
Are they forgetting?
Is it pre-mixed and we get unlucky scoops?

I had a brisket sandwich--it was awesome!

The service was friendly and fast.  The atmosphere is nice and the restaurant is clean and nicely decorated. This is great barbecue in Boise!

Not sure why everyone is giving this place 5 stars.  The customer service (well the owner) is 6 stars but the restaurant needs some updating, painting, and I'm not sure what else.  The food was good.  The appetizer was amazing.  My wife went straight home and puked her guts out. Weird.  Some kind of food poisoning.  She probably would never go there again.  Overall it was good but worth 3 to 3.5 stars.  Took a very very long time to get food and be out of there.
This was the best pedicure my husband and i have ever had!!!!!! Not rushed,great chairs,friendly staff!!! Cant wait for the next one already

Dr Jacob Smith is quite knowledgeable when stacked against others in the Valley. I have brought him some conundrums but he is always patient nonjudgmental and then comes up with whatever is needed to reach the best medical treatment. Maria his assistant is also amazing the front staff is super

The worst, thin, greasy, poor quality meat pattie ever!  Why people go here is beyond reasoning....unless they like all that  but it's high $$ for grease! BurgerKing's Whopper (and Whopper Jr) beats their burgers by leaps and bounds!

Our service was slow. The entrees were brought to us one by one. First, the Mongolian Beef and then the Pho Soup. We had to ask for silverware. (There were only 2 sets of customers) The Mongolian was cold and N6. Pho Soup was brought in a large bowl. I ordered beef pho and not sure what the pâté was so skirted it off to the side. After eating here will really research Yelp's ratings before venturing to another Thai restaurant.

I was here last night as part of the meet up group that I run. I had high hopes for it. Good Thai food, like good Mexican, as so far eluded me.

When possible, I also like to start off with the positive. But for some restaurants, I have written reviews on, this is just not possible.

When we arrived, we got our table very quickly. The next positive thing is the decor here. Now, its not top notch by any means, but when it comes to Asian type restaurants, they are up there in the decor rankings.

They have these lights hanging from the ceiling in very nice fixtures that change colors. I liked this a lot.

But Im afraid here is where the positivity stops.

After we were seated, we waited for at least 30 minutes before the waitress came to take our order. I was finally able to catch her eye as she was coming back from another table. 

Once she took our order, we again we are on wait list. After another 20 minutes or so, the waitress brought out our salads. None of us even knew we were getting salads. But to get them so late after placing our order was just weird.

The salad was just ok. Nothing of note here.

Next came our meals. I got the Pad Thai. I ordered this because the menu said it was the most popular item on the menu. I figured this meant it was their best dish, so thats what I got.

On a side note, how do places determine what is the most popular dish on a menu. Do they put all their dishes on a dartboard and throw darts to figure this out?

Do they poll their customers, or what? Im assuming its based on sales, but who knows. Maybe this was just the dish the cooks like cooking the most. 

Anway, when I got the Pad Thai, by mouth almost dropped open. It looked pretty disgusting. Now, we eat with our eyes and nose before we ever take a bite. I know sounds weird eating with your nose, right?

That just means that a lot of taste is based on smell. So when the waitress brought out my Pad Thai, the first thing I did was look at the dish and smell it. 

The pile of noodles looked.....well to be honest, it looked like a big pile of you know what. Not appetizing at all!

But I was very hungry by this time, so I wanted to eat it anyway. As for the smell, it smelled fishy. If I were to close by eyes, I would have thought it was a plate of seafood.

I had ordered Chicken with the Pad Thai, but I had to search and search for the chicken. It was like that old commercial; "Whers the Beef"? or Wheres Waldo. Waldo it seemed had left the building!

As for the taste, well, like I said, I was hungry. It tasted fishy and that was about it. Everyone at our table said that they were very disappointed in the heat level of their dish. We all had to add sauce for flavor and heat.

There were people in our party that said that the food here was good, so maybe they were just having an off day. It happens.

But for me, I probably will not be going back.

Chicken tikka masala was disappointing. Every other Indian restaurant I've been to prepares the tikka masala with all white meat chicken in a creamy sauce. This wasn't a creamy sauce and had both white and brown meat in a watery tomato sauce. I won't be going back.

This is the most normal meal I've gotten to eat in the last 5 months. 

They allowed us to have the all you can eat salad bar.  We were just requested to wear gloves at the salad bar with our masks,  they provided disposable gloves and brought us plates and bowls.  

We got to have a booth all to ourselves,  and the one behind and next to us were corded off so easy 6 feet between people.  

The staff was super friendly.  
They wore masks. 
And gloves. 

It was a completely delightful visit.  
I missed it so much.  
They made coming back so totally worth every penny.

I had been looking into getting extensions put into my head to add length and I decided to make a post on Facebook asking who knew how to do extensions. Sara Hoover was one of the girls who messaged me on messenger telling me she needed a model to do extensions on so she could improve her skills on hair extensions. In exact words she told me "if you have the hair I will do an install for free" so I say "yay okay I already have the hair and everything" and I come in for my appointment and she acts like she didn't tell me she'd do the install for free and before she even starts my hair tells me she's going to charge me $400. I told her there's an entire conversation in the comments of my post and on messenger saying she would do the install for free so I go into messenger and the whole conversation on her side is wiped clean gone.. so than I check the post and her comment is once again cleared. At this point I'm beyond livid because I know I'm not stupid and I'm not going to sit back and be taken advantage of. She denied it but might I add when I called her out she was tripping over her words. So I left the salon pretty ticked off. My sister happened to of just stopped working their because of maternity leave and when I told her the situation she also did this to one of her former employees the nail tech. So it clicked that she's shady. Super disappointed

So disappointed! What is going on !?!? The soda bar was so gross  filthy, and neglected. I honestly can not believe the sanitary standards this place is allowed to conduct business in! They can not blame it on the lack of employees, because there were 6 of them standing behind the counter conducting their conversations with plenty of time to get the maintenance done! Never mind COVID-19, I'm worried about food poisoning and Salmonella! If the visible areas look this horrific I can only imagine the kitchen...

My daughter and boyfriend have lived in a Johnson Property for almost two years.  There has never been an issue and they have been right out if and when a request was made for repair.   I have and would recommend this management company.

This has been a really good experience so far. My eye exam went well the doctor spent plenty of time with me and I'm comfortable with my choices. About a week later I went in to pick out frames. they spent time with me and even helped me with color suggestions and frame shape.

No high pressure sales here.

Every single person in this store was so very nice. Even though they are the same people who work in the Eagle store I think I like the vibe in the Meridian store just a little bit better.?.?

We have used handyman connection of Boise and would highly recommend them.  Hands down the best handyman service around!!  Chris & Gina run a very reputable company.  Ron was great when helping remodel our house last year and we couldn't have done it without there help.  When thinking of hiring a company for household repair big or small think "Handyman Connection"!!

This used to be our favorite place to go on a weekend morning for a breakfast bagel. The wonderful gentleman working was always friendly and the bagels were delicious. 

One day he told us that he was going to start working at the Sarah's Bagels in Boise. Sarah's in Meridian hasn't been the same since.  

Due to negative experiences after that we haven't been there in 6-7 months. This morning we tried again. Two young women were working. Our order was easy - a cheese bagel, toasted, with veggie cream cheese. I was told they don't have veggie cream cheese. "It's on your list of cream cheese flavors," I told her. She shrugged and said they don't have veggie cream cheese anymore. Oookay. So I asked for regular cream cheese and avocado on a cheddar cheese bagel. She tried to give me the wrong bagel - I pointed at it and repeated the order, but she seemed confused. Then she forgot the avocado. They weren't busy. It took about 20 minutes and was really frustrating.  We are trying to give our business to local establishments, but man, Sarah's Bagels in Meridian doesn't make it easy.

This is a great place! Everyone's really nice and my doctor is awesome. He listens to you and works with you to try to come up with the best plan. In my situation is antidepressant medication which can be tricky, I love that he talked WITH me through it. I recommend this place!

We were looking for some good BBQ and being from Texas we have had good BBQ. Based on other reviews on Yelp we selected Goodwood and we were glad we did. We ordered the three meat combo and selected The Baby Back ribs, pulled pork and Burnt ends. All three were excellent.

Our server Taylor May was also outstanding and really took the time to explain the choice of sides and her recommendations. She had a great sense of humor and was very attentive. We would highly recommend Goodwood. Based upon how busy it was when we left (Monday night) it appears others agree as well.

The wait was insane. They were out of rice, guacamole and French fries. They avoided telling us until we said something. Ended up just leaving all the food. The Boise location was so good. This location was so terrible. Wouldn't recommend.

Absolutely Amazing! The service was great, they were so friendly I almost forgot to take my food! I got the Chicken Tikka Masala level 3 for spice and it was the perfect amount of spice. Ultimate comfort food, I never wanted it to end. Will definitely be returning.
A fun dining experience.  The service here is excellent.  A great place to take out of town guests.

Michael was *awesome* dropping off my latest rental due to some guy totaling my van right before the COVID-19 stay at home orders. 

Dealing with the other guy's insurance has been an absolute nightmare (stay away from MAPFRE/AIC) - they've "extended" the rental after it expired (necessitating a new reservation), then "canceled" the new rental around close of business yesterday, 4 days before the rental expired. 

Now my insurance is taking over, and has issued a new reservation. Enterprise on Fairview (and in the admin office) has just been really accommodating and wonderful throughout it all. Great people, great service!

Not worth the risk.  The contractors doing the work likely do a great job but the owner is shady.  He was unwilling to pay the contractor for the minimal amount of work done on the job we hired HC to do so suddenly we are in the middle of a dispute where the contractor has threatened to put a lien on our house.  The dispute appears to be related to an employee who HC hired that was acting "unethically."  What the owner doesn't seem to realize is that you can't punish the customer for his bad decisions.  He implicated himself over and over again, but wasn't particularly interested in admitting his error or trying to correct the situation directly with us, so we have been forced to go other routes.

What a fantastic place to eat.  You feel like a member of the family, and the food is created like art.  The ink fish and lamb were amazing.  Highly recommend this restaurant is the the kind of business establishment that makes it fun to be a consumer.

Love lives here. Kind and generous spirits seem to reside within this building. You're always greeted with a smile and treated like they really appreciate your presence.

I love the decor and whole atmosphere here! It's gorgeous inside. It's a spacious restaurant so it's doubtful you'd have to wait to be seated.

The food is delicious. The menu is pretty much the exact same as their sister restaurant Pad Thai House with very little variation. Some of the names of the dishes are a little bit different, but the food is the same and I love consistency. Prices are good as well, so you can enjoy a delicious meal without breaking the bank.

What a unexpected fun evening. We went to the Smash o Rama event with our friends and teenage boys. We all had a blast and lots of laughs. Ticket prices are so reasonable. Hot dogs were inexpensive and good. The only negative is that it was crowded because it was a sold out event. Even with the crowded event we will definitely be back.

Bought Cinch brand Jean's, have several pair purchased over time.  Most recent pair fell apart in first wash, holes, shredded fabric, not normal.  D and b refused to take them back ($80 jeans) OR EXCHANGE but did offer a $25 dollar store gift card.  They made a point that the Jean's were purchased in March.....with stay at home order in place until now, it makes sense they are two months old... but never worn, washed once.

Tonight the hubs & I went to see a movie with dinner. This is our second time doing the VIP21 at the Village Cinema. Gotta say - it's nice to have dinner while watching a movie. Only down fall - hard to see what you're eating cause it's dark. Seating of course was comfy & roomy. Service this time was a little  disappointing...our server took order, brought food but never came back to see if we needed a refill or anything else. I really wanted to try their Creme Brûlée Popcorn...that will be on the next visit.
Great food. Order the bread pudding, trust the reviews, it is the best ever.
Loved the vibe, great food and service. Yummy bbq chicken and prime rib.  I'll be back.  Sorry no pictures I was hungry

The verde sauce is good. Anything with enchilada sauce just tastes like tomato paste, super bland, didn't even want to eat it. We were pretty disappointed. Salsa was mild which I like but again super bland.
Great time with a relaxed vibe, bartender Teddy had outstanding service with some history to go with it! Overall, A+ continuing to come here and have a great time.

Stopped by for some lunch looking for some authentic Mexican food. The restaurant is new and is still getting its feet under itself it seems. 
The one employee working in the front of the house was very nice and welcoming. She offered me chips, salsa, and beans upon sitting. The inside of the restaurant is very plain and the seating is all booths. Nothing to exciting.
I ordered the carnitas burrito for lunch which came with beans and rice. I like to try the carnitas and rice at mexican restaurants to test the authenticity of the chef. If you cook great carnitas and beans, we know the chef knows authentic food. Good news here...the rice was perfectly cooked and well seasoned. The carnitas had great flavor with a bit of crispness which is a great sign. 
Overall the food was very tasty. The beans were ok and salsa could use a bit more heat.
I would reccomend this place if you are in the neighborhood and looking for some good Mexican food. 
Cheers Always!

Kristine cut both my boys hair (twins) she was super friendly and engaging and patient with one of my twins who wouldn't sit still. They were also excited to get their haircut! This is our third time here and we love it every time.
Just had another contact with Al. Again, awesome service at a great price. If you're using another plumber you're missing out.

Bagels are good here, but the service sucks. The weekday morning woman works in slow motion. I've stopped going since COVID after seeing her prepare multiple orders and handle multiple credit cards without washing her hands or changing gloves.

The downtown Boise store has awesome, careful service.

I both eat and deliver for this place (with a third party delivery app) and I highly recommend it.

Timely: If a restaurant makes you wait more than 5 minutes as a Delivery driver then your hourly average drops a lot. At 10 minutes of waiting you end up around minimum wage (you need to complete a certain volume of orders per hour to make any real money). With that being said, they almost always have the order/s ready at least a few minutes early and they don't de-prioritize Delivery orders like most places do. Fastest pizza place in town. 

Management: The owners are a husband wife team who actually seem to care about what they do and they actually remember my face and make me feel like part of the family lollll

The food: really good, get the cinnamon bites they're SO GOOD. The pizza is significantly better than most of the chains I've tried, they are faster than the chains, and it's nice to support small business.

Price: competitive with local chains

I have a lot of respect for a restaurant that treats third party app Delivery people like human beings lol which is why I started eating here, and now I'm addicted. 

No restaurant is perfect, but in all the times I've been here for pickup, if someone has ever had a problem with an order the owners themselves have gone out of the way to accommodate people and make things right. 

Highly recommend!

Sorry B Finley that you had such a negative experience. People getting saved, a bible believing church that is growing and great people is hard to beat in this area.  SHOCKING that you didn't feel the Holy Spirit there.  Band sounds great to me and I am a former musician.  Only thing I can figure is that you know how many people this church is reaching and are of the enemy.  I'll be praying for you.  If you are of the family, you should come back.and talk to the car salesman yourself.

The food here is good but the language difficulties make​ ordering anything that isn't on the menu very hard.

If you have a specific eating style, think paleo, keto, or nutratarian, there are probably a lot of sauces they use that you may want a substitution for, getting that in my experience requires a lot of patience and even then it probably won't be right.

I wanted the chicken satays with no sauce, they didn't put the sauce on but they also didn't tell me they were soaked in a sugar marinade before they were grilled, even when I told them I wasn't eating sugar.

That aside, the food is exceptional, I had Hibachi scallops and they were perfectly cooked, tender, and there were a lot of them, plenty for two to share. The miso soup was exceptional as well and the hibachi vegetables were also cooked perfectly, they were hot, crunchy and flavorful.

The interior is very clean and modern and very well maintained. I find that often in these places they are aging and not well kept, that is definitely not the case here.

If you are going for a great experience and don't need changes for your food this place would be five stars.

My daughter and I went in. We don't have artificial nails - mainly I go in because I love the hand an foot massages and I can't get nail polish on myself worth a damn. The gals were very nice. Place seemed very clean. Foot massages were ok, there was NO hand massage, sadly. Charged full price for mani even though no polish
Probably won't return

Terry the manager is absolutely horrible.  I drove up to order and the representative was so nice but accidentally put a fish sandwich on the order instead of filets.   I didn't notice it till I got home and I called in and got the sweetest employee. She admitted there was a mistake and would correct it. Terry got on the phone and blamed me.  He was rude and nasty. I asked for his boss and he declined and said he is the boss.  I asked to talk to the nice employee that had said she would help and he denied me that.  I told him I wanted the owners info and he said no.  He argued and was rude and I will not go back to this place because he is such a horrible leader and person.   Nice work terry I have never had a bad experience at Culver's and I go all the time.  They made a mistake hiring u.

Been coming to Life Church since 2007! Building used to be at Maple Grove & Overland and since Life Church was growing even with 3 services that time, it seemed fitting to go on a bigger & better place! Hence the move in 2012 along Eagle. 

I think what makes Life Church one of the best churches in the valley is that Pastor Marks teaches with such power & authority & really brings life to our lives! That was Jesus came here for, to give us life abundantly! He really brings out the word & encourages you & challenges you to walk it out! Not just a hearer but a doer of the word!

Worship is one of the factor too, people really worship God here, sings, dances, lifts hand. Music is more in contemporary like Bethel, Gateway, Hillsong, Elevation, Planetshakers & so on but we do sing some classic old ones from time to time or even original music. Also we are very particular with the song content, always grounded on the finish work of the cross! There's power in words! 

I also love the praise reports & testimonies! It's so good to give God the glory with our testimonies & victories & it encourages others too! Every Sunday services, Ms Amy (Pastor Marks wife) share those testimonies which are sent via email or written. 

Every first Wednesday of the month, we have a Healing service. A lot of people come here to get healed & we saw some amazing healing that took place even so myself! Jesus received the stripes on His back for our healing, might as well access that, it's free! 

The rest of the Wednesdays are Believers meeting! It's like unplanned kinda service compared to the one on Sundays. It's like "Holy Spirit have Your way". Sometimes we worship the whole service, sometimes teaching takes place the whole service and sometimes mixed of both!

Aside from the amazing adult services happening both on Sundays & Wednesdays, Life Church also offers Youth & Kids services! I think it's great so that we adults can focus on our time with the Lord! Thats why we are so thankful we have so amazing people here that helps & volunteers in every area! Most giving & friendly people around! 

I know it's home when I first came here the first time & it's been my home in 9 years! Me & my husband serves here, my kids thrives here! We love our home! Grounded & settled! Loving Jesus, serving in the Kingdom, living life to the full! 

It's the place to be! Check it out!
Yummy pizza, friendly staff. Normally I go to the 8th street location. Happened to stop in to the meridian store today and the pie did not disappoint! Go for the potato bacon, it's outstanding.
It was a really enjoyable evening. All the food was fresh and and tasty. The drinks were great. We had a great time.

I used Reliance to move across town from the Barkley area to old Fairhaven Parkway about a month and a half ago, and I must say they were top notch! Cameron arrived right on time at 9am on March 15 and got right to work with his partner carrying all my heavy crap out of my apartment while my girlfriend and I did final cleaning and inspection Things. They were polite, professional, always asked how we wanted them to set things up when we were moving things into our destination and above all sought to make things easy for myself and my girlfriend. For the flat rate I paid, I got Cameron, his partner and a moving truck for four hours. They had everything moved well before then. Moving can be an ordeal... especially when you have to move in the middle of the week on a weekday, but Cameron made everything go smoothly. I would definitely recommend Reliance moving to anyone looking for a good mover in Bellingham or the surrounding area.
Had dinner here on a Wednesday evening with a group of eight people. The food was amazing and the hospitality was absolutely top notch. This place really stands out as something special!

It's really a shame to give only one star to this place as I really wanted to like it. They have a good atmosphere, lots of TVs for Sunday football, and decent menu. The positives end there though. 

The service was bad. Not just a little bad, but like bad bad. Having served a bit myself, and being with my wife who had served for many years, we have compassion for people getting rolled on a short staffed, busy Sunday. That being said, when you don't make an effort to acknowledge a potential long wait, or appear to give any craps whatsoever, I become less compassionate. Long story short, 15 mins to get a menu, 30 mins to get our drinks, 60 mins by the time my wings showed up (ordered right when I got the menu), and the side of fries my wife ordered at the same time as the wings never came. Additionally, wings were lukewarm. No thanks. Anyway, they were stunned I wanted to pay for our drinks and leave. Like shocked... really?? 

Save yourself the time and go to Rudys down the street or the Curb. 

Hopefully management sees this review and reacts to it, but the place has potential. Just poor management.

If you don't get the carne asada tacos from here at least once in your life, consider yourself an absolute failure. They use real ingredients and have staff ready to serve at any time. Happy to say I've been here at least half a dozen times and I've never been unsatisfied. The adobada is also amazing!

I have some major dental work that needs to be done. I was worried about finding a dentist that I can trust.
When I walked into his office I was happily greeted by the front desk employee.  The office was clean, relaxing, & welcoming. They have a cooler in the waiting area that has cold bottles of water  & a coffee pot & K-cups.  It's a nice touch. 
When I was called back, the assistant showed me around the office.  It was really nice.  The facility seems pretty big, so it was nice to have someone take the time to show me around.  The "tour" is really short, but informative.   The dentist came in fairly quickly and spoke with me & created a treatment plan.  I knew that there was a possibility of needing surgery. Dr. Grant looked at my X-rays & teeth and we discussed what my options are.  I made the decision to go to the hospital & have all of my work done at once under general anesthesia.  He said that if it were him in my situation, he would also do it through the hospital. 
I left his office feeling like he was a dentist who truly cares about his patients. I also left with a referral to another dentist  as well as a surgery date.  Yay!!! 
Amazing front & back office staff. I highly recommend him as your dentist. He is really amazing & talented.  You feel like family when are there.  I'm looking forward to having a new smile that I am proud of.

First off,  the intial server to seat us and get our drinks and order was amazing.  The establishment has a great setup and good energy. However, we were not thrilled with our food,  steak was poorly seasoned and over cooked when asked for med-rare,  the hamburger was also well done when asked for medium. The server whom took over halfway through our meal very energetic and smiley,  however she took our beer glass,  did not offer another nor any drink at all.  And persistently bugged us about how we were doing,  which is good when time is spaced out, not every couple minutes.  Then what unpset all 3 of us,  was how uncouth it was she held the check book in the front of her pants and proceeded to hand it to us like it was nothing but sanitary. Not exactly  happy with this place,  the other location in Nampa is a far better experience.

This place is the best. the owners/employees are friendly and awesome. the food is legit. They remember us and little things we prefer when we eat there. over all great indian food and love the staff.
My favorite place to get a bagel, easily one for the best places in town. They have a huge variety and super good prices!

The wait time has gotten a little better, I don't know whether that is from new management or employees but the past few times I've gone I barely had to wait at all. I've never had an issue with the quality of my food and overall am satisfied with my recent visits. They just gotta keep up with the wait times.
I won't go into it but I'll never go back. Last place I wanna take my fur babies. Should have a 0 star

I would not recommend this property management for anything whether you are renting or using them to rent out your place. Horrible customer service. I spoke with Angel and she practically harassed me on the policy to not call and wait for a call back (even tho if they approved someone else they would not call me back because they don't have the "time" to call every applicant back and let them know the status of approval or not) then told me if I called again about my application that she would instantly deny my application. I was interested in three properties and asked if I had to make an application for all three even tho they already had all my info. She was so rude and non compliant as far as answering my question and kept telling me to not call back and just look online.

This is one of our favorite restaurants in the whole valley. They have excellent service, excellent food, and we always have a good time. I appreciate restaurants like Izumi. They take customer service seriously and we will continue to frequent this establishment.

I love BanField Pet Hospitals. I visit them whenever I travel for my pets. This BanField however was not accommodating or advocating for my pets. I came in on Dec. 23 and was late due to traffic. I hurried in and stood at the front desk for 10 minutes where another man came up was helped before me, and then the vet tech went back to get the secretary. The secretary then came out said you are late and I said well I would haven't been so late but I stood out here for 10 minutes. She said well we can't get you in but you can leave your pets here. I asked when they'd be seen because I've left my pets before and they usually end up staying for 2-4 hours, which is fine if I'm planning on leaving them but being from out of town I didn't plan on that, and she said she doesn't know. So then who does know? My puppies were due for their 4 month booster shots. She was rude and mocking towards me. I don't know her name but she has short dirty blonde hair. I'll never go back to this BanField and I'll be sure to warn others to never visit this store either. The secretary's job is to be out front and greet the clients. She was not there and was not welcoming at all. Also being in the health field she should have advocating for my pets not herself and her schedule. I never was seen or told when I would be seen. I visited the BanField in Boise and highly recommend that location.

I'm starting with I'm really picky when it comes to Mexican food & in general because I'm Mexican myself having said that ate at this place twice so far so good! The cook be putting some magic in that Ceviche  service was great I think the only mess up was I asked for Corn tortillas got flour no big was so hungry devoured Ceviche & some chicken fajitas ate it all.
I don't even know what to say, except for AWESOME! It takes no time to order and be seated eating your meal! Fresh great food!

Great location for a Popeye's.  Easy in and out of this location, very wide drive through.  I have had fast and friendly service every time.  I enjoy the blackened tenders.  They always have to make them fresh so even though there is a little longer of a wait, totally worth having hot food.  A good low carb option when you are out and about and need a quick snack.

Super cute place! Amazing selection of wine and yummy food. Service was okay, our server seemed overwhelmed and not in the mood to be serving tables. Overall it was a good experience however, the service made us feel like a bit of a burden.
Been there several times. Always great customer service! Very friendly and willing to give samples.
Yummy authentic Mexican food! The staff is fantastic and you will be missing out if you don't try their most amazing queso dip! #supportlocal

I have taken several dogs to this practice, ranging from mixed rescues to purebred working dogs and I've always felt like my babies have received loving and competent care. I appreciate Dr Spotts & Dr Sanborn's thorough care for my dogs and their unique needs. Everyone from the front desk to the technicians to the doctors have been great to my family. Thank you

After a very bad experience in a Kuna pet clinic, we were very pleased with the Banfield Pet Hospital.  We had a very old male cat that had been with our family for 12 years.  It was clear that Mickie had finished his life.  The great people at Banfield were caring and compassionate.  I would highly recommend their services above everyone else in the Boise area.

Went here based on Nextdoor recommendation and what a great find.  I was lucky enough to get Tammy for my first visit.  She is extremely detail oriented and did a great mani/pedi.  She is also super sweet to chat with.  Highly recommend.  I'd also recommend and appointment as the place is pretty popular.... At least on weekends.

Don't bother going through the drive through. If you order food and ice cream they will immediately make the ice cream and then make you sit outside in your car for 20 minutes while they make the rest of your food. They will then hand your food and a soupy pile of whatever ice cream you ordered. I really hope they go out of business soon so a dairy queen or freddie's or any other fast food location can take the spot. I really hate this place but it's the closest place to my house so for some reason every couple of months I decide to go and get disappointed.

Wow! Great food, awesome staff, comfortable atmosphere, free easy parking. We love the white queso dip, and HIGHLY recommend this incredible restaurant. Come early as it gets busy and there is limited seating for COVID safe distancing.

Ordered some delivery from here and was sadly disappointed. The chimi was not crispy and actually very soggy, the burrito was a mess to say the very least. Extremely bland food the verde sauce was the only thing that had flavor and that was salt. The chicken was dry and bland and seemed like maybe it had been boiled. The chips were stale and inedible. Very disappointed in the price I paid for two lunches to be met with this sad presentation.
This is my go-to place for massage,  mani-pedi and facials.  Great staff.  Never had a bad experience.

This is our go-to restaurant in the area, and the one we insist all of our guests visiting from out of town try. We absolutely LOVE Thai basil and are so thankful to have such a delicious restaurant close to home!

My brother was visiting last week and he requested we have authentic Basque food while he was here. I was worried that we wouldn't be able to get any with everything closed right now but I found Epi's was open for take-out! And everything we ordered was absolutely delicious. We ordered an array of things, many items I would never think to order, but yum! It was all so unique and so flavorful. 
We started with Ham croquetas, and chorizos - both so good! I loved the pimentos with the chorizo. Then we had the lamb stew and ink fish - loved the lamb stew! The ink fish was different and it grew on me but not everyone was a fan. I think it's an acquired taste :) We also had the grilled lamb chops and beef filet. And paired with it all we had a delicious Basque wine. 
Highly recommend trying this out and I look forward to dining here when everything opens up again!

This is the only store probably in the world in my lifetime that I would gladly, willingly, even call-into-work seriously fucking boycott. They promise furniture to arrive to you at a certain time, then it is most likely weeks to MONTHS to get to you. In fact, the only time I ever ordered from this atrocious place was for a sofa that was promised on a specific date a month or so after purchase. BUT the day of promise I checked in with them and they said it just mysteriously "didn't show up on their truck order".  This happened EVERY WEEK for about 5 weeks. I ended up moving out of the valley for school but I still gave them a chance because I needed this sofa for my new place. They promised me a new date and I drove my ass the 3 hours back, rented a uhaul, showed up at their pick up... and alas. NO FUCKING COUCH. I had finally had enough and asked for a refund. They tried to talk me out of it saying they've already placed the order BLAH BLAH. Didn't care. Don't care. It took a month for the refund to show up back in my bank account. I will NEVER do business or refer anyone there. STAY AWAY.

This place is an absolute must if your looking for good bbq near Boise. After a long day of competing I was ready to eat and this place had exactly what I was looking for. I got the Idaho potato skins and I would definitely recommend them as they were loaded with toppings and the dipping sauce complimented it very nicely. I then got a half rack of St. Louis style ribs with sides of macaroni and cheese and loaded mashed potatoes. The half rack had a ton of bbq sauce and was tender off the bone. The macaroni and cheese had a creamy cheese flavor but was pretty standard. The loaded mashed potatoes were amazing as the bacon and sour cream all mixed up into mashed potatoes was a great combination of flavors. Finally let me address the service. The service is AMAZING. I forgot the waiters name but he was extremely attentive and was constantly refilling my cup. He was very prompt in taking our orders and checking up on the dishes. This was probably the best service I've ever had.

By far the best meal we've had in a long time. Great value for the price, large delicious portions, spot on customer service. Goodwood will be our new favorite place. I had the turkey club and it was to die for. All the ingredients were so fresh & tasted super delicious. Our server, Morgan was amazing. She was attentive & polite & very personable without being pushy or fake. We never had to wait for our drinks to be refilled, she anticipated all our needs before we did and even offered us some extra to-go garlic bread (c'mon, that never happens)! She really went above & Beyond. The service combined with the excellent food will have us coming back again and again.

I had my second appointment with Rachael and she gives great facials and my skin feels amazing !!! I have my 3rd facial scheduled next month- can't wait. Great products and front desk counter customer service is very informative and thorough! Jen

Loved this place! Great pedicurests! They are so fun and sweet! So glad I came! 

They have great color selection, good prices! Seriously FUN staff! 

Will be back!!

Takes appointments and walk ins

Good food, beer is cold, and atmosphere is what you would expect for a sports bar.  Service is just not on point.   I know during these times restaurants are understaffed but just SCREAMING  "sit anywhere you are comfortable" when guests come in is weird.  Put a sign up or properly great people.   Servers seemed confused too.   Honestly just seems like good systems are not in place to perfect the customer experience.

Seems like a solid sports bar. It's hard to judge because of covid bringing in less servers and stars but leaving your dining area in disarray leaves a lot to be desired, photo is of the bad table but nearly every table has been sat at and not wiped down...including the one we're sitting at

It's just weird to me that a bar with an irish name doesn't have any irish whiskey...
Handyman Connections was easy to work with. They were able to get us in quickly. Mike did an awesome job!

This is my third time where something in my order wasn't right. This is first time I have provided feedback. 

Today I initially ordered three piece meal with all dark. Upon questioning what pieces would be in that order I changed to 3-piece combo ( white and dark).  When I got home - guess what?  

I got 2 legs and a thigh which is what pieces should be in all dark. This was even after window person confirmed- 'here is your 3 piece combo.  

Usually my complaint is that the unsweetened ice tea barely has any flavor. It's mostly colored water but seemed a little
Better today

Chicken was tasty but I really would like to get what I ordered. 

Even my Reciept 662 says Combo. 

Sad.

Mixed review.  Paint department Is usually staffed and you get help fast.  Everything else... not so much

It was So bad I found myself wondering is I was invisible as employees walked right by me when I was wandering looking for help.  I ended up yelling down an isle after an employee walked right by me.

I still didn't get the help I needed and I have limited ability to walk so I had to leave before it got bad.

I found what I needed but it was large (not heavy) but I just could not get it off the shelf.... big sheet of rigid foam insulation 

Guess I'll be going to their competitor and see whether I'm invisible there or not

Culivers has good service and great food I popped in today for some lunch it was a bit busy (Middle day Lunch rush) as expected I placed an order and got to my table I when to my bathroom and by the time I was done my food was ready food was delicious and and the mixer was even better overall a great experience

I wish I could take my business elsewhere, but Lowes has more variety than anyone in Nampa. There is so much that I hate about Lowes that it sometimes makes me feel like I am at Walmart or Home Depot. 
I love that they have a variety of items to choose from. In most cases they may charge less than their competitor Home Depot. I will come here for bricks, pipes, and plants. I have even come to Lowes for appliances twice, but not anymore because that is where they lack options.
Two years ago I bought a washing machine. Much to my horror I discovered that I cannot have a HE washer and that was all that they had other than the Hot Point. The Hot Point was straight out of the box and was low quality; such a low quality that Lowes was discontinuing them. 
In addition to this I also discovered how hard it was to find someone to help me. I had to walk around the entire store and there was not anyone available. I had to go to customer service and ask them to call someone to help me with my purchase. I had to do that twice because nobody came to help me after the first time. 
Lowes is okay because they have a good variety of items to improve your home with. It is too bad they are not capable of improving their customer service.

(see original review below)  I am updating my review of Village Cinema based on my recent visit to see Mockingjay Part 2.  We had return guests from California that requested to visit this theater again.  With a group of 6 adults we reserved seating in the VIP 21+ balcony and it cost a pretty penny of $80+ dollars with a convenience fee of purchasing online.  We arrived to the theater 30 minutes before the movie started and they were training a new server.  We placed our order of 3 desserts and some adult beverages (another $76) and our food did not come out until the lights were off.  It's hard to eat a brownie sundae in the dark...especially when you haven't seen it in the light.  I will say that I'm usually boast about this sundae for only $6; However, I was disappointed with the taste and they didn't even put whipped cream on top.  I'm not sure if they changed the flavor of the gelato used on top or what but it did NOT taste like it normally does.  Another big downfall in my book is that they have changed to COKE products rather than my favorite (Pepsi).  Good think I quit drinking soda!  However, other people in our group were disappointed about the change as well.

************************************************************************************************************

I've been to a lot of movie theaters in several states and this is by far one of the nicest!  There's no other way I'd rather go to the movies than the VIP 21+ experience.

If you have no tried the adult section leave your kids at home and go for a date night.  The food is great and they come right to your seat and take your order.  It is well worth the additional $2.  Some foods are easier to eat than others (especially in the dark).  My favorite thing to order is the brownie dessert!  I believe it is only $6 which is less than most movie theaters charge for a popcorn.  They also serve adult beverages  I've only had one bad experience with this.  For the most part I'd rather sit next to a buzzed adult than a bunch of teenagers. 

Another nice feature at this theater is that you get to choose your seats in advance.  For picky people like myself this is a huge plus!  I don't have to stress over the fact that if my server doesn't hurry up I won't get there 30 min early to save a seat... It will just be there waiting for me.  They also have the special effects seating that we've tried but I still prefer to sit in the adult section.  

I also believe that this is the only theater serving Pepsi products (my fave) and AMAZING gelato as well as Dawson Taylor Coffee.

Greeted as soon as we walked In! We were a party of 7 and had a really great experience! The food is delicious! As a Hispanic myself, this food was NOT white washed. Real taste of tacos especially "Lengua". Will be coming back again!

I've never had more fun with my hair in all my life. The entire staff is engaged and fun to chat with and they all remember details that make it feel like coming to a best friend's house each visit.

I love their style and color techniques. I've had LONG natural blonde hair my whole life and as a comedian I wanted to explore unique colors to match my personality. Mission accomplished! I get more compliments on my hair now than I ever did wearing my natural color -- from COMPLETE STRANGERS -- stopping me on the street or commenting from the drive through windows I stop at. 

The owners are genuine and I've never been in when one or both of them are not here busting their tails and checking in on EVERY client. No wonder they are always busy and customers are always smiling. 

They work around my insane schedule - today I got in at 7am before a long busy day ahead. Highly recommend!
Yummmmmmm. Finger lickin good. Great food and great service.  We sat at the bar and enjoyed our meal and drinks
I love the brisket. I haven't tried much else on their menu. Left overs are made into brisket, potato, salsa tacos...Texas thing

Normally they do pretty good, but today I called and asked about pick up orders and then they said they were short staffed, which is understandable. But then I went to the store and they were closed, it's just kind of annoying they didn't tell me they were gonna be closed. But once again pretty good service most the time

I'm not one to post. But the severity of my experience at this salon with the owner Anna Williams, warrants me to do so. I put my trust in her because she's the professional. I informed her I was allergic to hair dye and also stated so on her form she had me fill out. She told me that the product she was going to use would be completely safe for me. She did not offer to do a patch test which later I found she should of. She then waxes first, which is also a big no-no and than applied the color. I had a major allergic reaction. I've learned my lesson, just because someone claims to be a professional doesn't mean they know what they are doing.

Unfortunately I can not recommend this company after receiving our stuff. I believe the big mistake is having them store our stuff. We had them come to our home in California and the movers were great.  They did good, were very nice and polite. Thought everything was going to be fine except for when we moved into our home and they delivered our belongings a couple weeks later. We started unpacking and we had several damaged furniture with chips, scratches, not just one but several. We had parts of our Dyson vacuum with missing parts that we ended up finding in the pile. We were unpacking our boxes and we had quite a bit of broken glass, plates, etc. and we wrapped them pretty good too with bubble wrap. Our sconces are now broken. The frame to our Thomas Kinkade paintings is chipped. We specifically asked if we should take those separately because we didn't want anything to happen to them and the gentleman said we could if we want but it's safe. He said he moves antiques and paintings worth a lot of money all the time just fine.  We haven't completely unpacked yet but I wanted to stop to write this review before I forgot.  Using them to move from your old home directly to your new home might be ok as you can see how they handle your belongings but I would never trust storing with them.  They obviously didn't take care of our stuff. I'm disappointed because I really liked the guys that pick up our belongings in Ca. And thought they were good. What happens and who handled it after that were completely different people.

In my opinion the best breakfast sandwich in surrounding Boise.  I'm shocked... right here in meridian.  First the bagel- thank god it isn't a dry rock, like so many others.  It is very soft, definitely non- traditional, but much better, and their elaborate baked on toppings are unique and traditional.    I opted for the bacon egg and cheese  on cheddar spinach bagel.    Oh my G.   Trust me it is killer.  Did I mention the Thai tea boba?   I can't.   You gotta try this place for the bagels.  If you are going to blow your carb allotment, this is the place.

They aren't great. I feel like they know they are one of a few places in town that do what they do, and simply take advantage. I had a bin from them for a remodel. They didn't pick it up when they said they would, came late, never called. Zero communication. It's a disappointing customer experience with them for sure.

Absolutely terrible.  Gave them 3 chances only because they are closest to my house.  Ruined a down comforter.  They can't get the easiest of stains out.  I swear they don't even try.  I don't recommend them whatsoever.

We live right by here and figured we would try it out. We went to watch a football game and it was great! They have ample tv's so anywhere you sit you will be able to see the game. The volume also wasn't terribly high, we could talk without having to yell. The food was good, service was good. This will be our new weekly spot for sure.

Walked in, place seemed nice, was wanting a rep to come up and ask me if I needed help finding anything or even say hi. But they were all starring at their computer screens starring at nothing. I had more conversation with other customers there then I did with any of the employees. Needless to say if you walk in they don't even notice. Service is not the greatest here for the price they charge. They had some nice peaces though.
This is the worst bagel shop I've ever been to. Very little selection of bagels and cheeses, super slow service and once I finally got my order it was junk. I won't be eating at Sarah's again.

After hearing great reviews of Valley Custom Moving we decided to book them for our long distance move from CA to Idaho. The reviews are right! Josh, Rob and Austin were absolutely amazing! They were in and out in just under 3 hours. I couldn't believe the care they took on our items,  even wrapped all the big stuff. Talk about 5 star treatment. They will be storing our things until our home is done then they'll be delivering to us. Im sure it'll be just as smooth as it was today..If you have any hesitation, no need for it. Book them now! Thanks again, Valley Custom Movers!!!
So weird , so many empty tables , and they made us wait outside almost 20 min . What is going on ? Last time .

Seriously people this is 10 stars!! I love love pizza and I've had good pizza, however this pizza is the bomb! I had a pepperoni slice,my hubby had Stromboli , and a Italian sub ( he was hungry) amazing pizza!! Subs & Stromboli!! Everything Waking in, it reminded me of waking into a NYC pizza Restaurant! The pizza was juicy and crunchy at the same time.. Please do yourself a favor and just stop by and try! 
I know now where we will be buying pizza and Italian food from now on! Joe & Joey are so friendly and honestly they are world class owners, like any awesome father and son team should be!! 
I've read the reviews before, and I can't seem to understand what this lady is talking about! The food speaks for itself, look at the pictures how many generations this goes back (the pictures are on the wall!!)
We will be back!! Very soon!!

Andrea

Great eye care! Very professional and friendly!! Recently had to get my reading glasses repaired and absolutely no problem, and it was under warranty. They even gave me a loaner pair with the original lenses while they processed a new replacement pair.  Great location for our family!  Would highly recommend VsionOne!
Love the pizza. Love the staff. Love the service. Locally owned. Great prices. Checks off every box on my list.

The vets are actually just fine, it's the service I'm not overwhelmed with. It's way too busy and getting in is quite difficult, be prepared to make appts months ahead, even though you've already prepaid for the procedure months and months ahead.  Also when I called to make an appt about getting my dog neutered they wouldn't answer their phone or return my message, instead they tried to schedule via text...I personally don't want to text back and forth with my vet trying to find a time that works for us both... just answer the phone.

We sat in the plain dining side and had great service and our meals were excellent. Loved my sashimi Octopus and my Poke Bowl was great, the perfect size. Hubs had Sashimi Spicy Tuna and General Tso Chicken both enjoyed, Generals he said could have been a bit spicier but was still tasty.

A well run race track, very exciting.  But I am totally turned off by the "Trump Won" flags all around the track.  Fringe politics do NOT belong at a public event.  I will boycott this track in the future.

I can think of no better rib eye than the one I just had at this restaurant. I've had equally good steaks, but there is no better than perfect.
The waitress was very friendly, attentive, and generally came across as a good quality person.
Try the Troublemaker wine; very good for the price.
Honest affordable service. Gave great suggestions on saving money down the line.  No service fee to come out.

This is a hard one to review. Mainly, because I feel like your experience is based off what you choose to order. 

I used the drive through and the line was super long. I stuck it out, because I knew they were new...so it was to be expected.  It was a slow but steady pace. 

I ordered 2 burgers, 1 cheese curd and 2 kids meals. I was disappointed with my burger, as I asked the attendant if the burger could be ordered with just lettuce and no bun. FYI...their lettuce is shredded,  so I got a small pile of lettuce under my burger patty. By the time I got home it was soggy lettuce.  I didn't taste anything remarkable about the actual burger.
Cheese curds were probably the best thing I ordered.  My kids stold most of them from me.
Kids meals were nothing special,  but who can screw up a corn dog?
I didn't try the custard and this seems to be what most rave about, so maybe I was on the wrong track with what to order here.
Overall...not my cup of tea. But maybe it will be for you!

This is absolutely the most horrible place I have ordered furniture from. I hate reviews but this one needs to be done. The way they lack communication, how they blame each other, and don't take ownership for their mistakes really baffles me. I am pissed I spent so much money for shit furniture. They way they treated me also was horrible. I'm sorry I'm young and don't know much about furniture. One guy told me It's common knowledge to get ropes. Well your sales person told me I didn't need anything. In fact she said you would come to my house and build the furniture. I denied, because I'm sure that's not allowed. Oh and I'm still missing a piece of furniture. Please please don't go here. From My personal experience, I'd rather buy furniture on Amazon than have to deal with them. Good riddance!

Great service terrible food. 

I ordered the pork fried rice and they gave a chicken with vegetables with a tortilla and red rice! And worst of all I did not receive my fortune cookie or chop sticks! WHAT KIND OF CHINESE RESTAURANT IS THIS!!
This place is new and super classy! They were all very quick and friendly. Tina, the shop owner was super sweet! This will definitely be my home salon in the Meridian area!!

Erin Ramirez was amazing! She has like 20 something years of design experience and helped us put together a really nice living and dining space. She also got us an amazing discount and some. All the staff was super friendly and not pushy. Thank you everyone for helping our family!!!

One of the best Thai restaurant in Boise/Meridian. 

Good pad Thai and great summer rolls (pork one is better than shrimp). I normally order two plate of summer rolls. Yes, that good !

The volcano is good and I like it spicy. 5 is good while 8 is too spicy. Good overall.

3 spice fish is really good... they cut in cube so make it easy to share.

Honey glazed duck is good, my son love it, but I found a little too sweet.

You should close with fried ice cream, really delicious. We shared for 3 folks.

First time at the steakhouse. I was looking for a sushi bar and this place had good reviews. The staff was really nice and pleasing to talk to. My waiter was Grace, she was really cool, easy on the eyes, I asked her what her fav sushi was and she said to get the Sweat Heart Roll, cooked but not deep fried. Also had the crab Rangoons for appetizer, oh man they're to die for. I thought they were called deep fried wontons, which wasn't on the menu, but Grace was confident that the Rangoons was what I was looking for. 10 out for 10 for great Customer Service and great food. I'm from WA state but I will definitely come back whenever I'm in town again.

We went to the firecracker event on the 4th of July. Good ticket price! The only thing I would say is, if you as a company don't like how people park then have someone direct the guests (no it wasn't us). Also can you find people who are a little less mop head personality to run your concession. One last thing, I realize that your company wants to make money, so no outside food or drinks, but water? Come on now!!!! It was 100 degrees! We will be back.
