We ordered a steak with corn and cream and vegetables. I would recommend this plate, the waiter told us that was the most popular. The steak was very delicious had a lot of flavor to it. I will come back again the service was good and friendly staff.

This restaurant really tries hard to please.  There were 6 in our party and everyone really liked their meal.  Their big seller is the salad bar - which is constantly being refreshed by the staff.  Our waitress was very busy!  I got my steak fries way late - but she tried hard to get them to me as soon as humanly possible.  

The front staff and register are friendly and greet you promptly.  

The service is consistent - and that's what we like about this restaurant.

Donavan was the young man that assisted me in choosing new eye glass frames.  He was willing to show me different styles until I found the one I liked.  He was also very informed as to the type of lenses i required and the prices for each addition I wanted.  I left very satisfied with the service I received.

STAY AWAY! Don't Bother! Avoid at all costs! Why? Because this is MY taco truck and I'm not willing to share. Meats are flavorful tortillas are made right there and often you'll see "grandma" working a big ball of masa in the tortilla maker. Meats are well prepared seasoned perfectly and their Lengua is succulent and juicy. My favorite is the Lengua Encheladas, but their tacos are alway ordered because life is not complete without at least a couple of their tacos. I moved to a home nearby in 2010 and discovered this place when I was gassing the truck during the move. It has been an addiction ever since. Addiction to the point of developing a taco fetish and an enchilada obsession. Family owned, and operated is shows in every bite. Just remember, this is MY taco truck so stay away. Mine all mine.

Tried to sell me protection plan garbage. Insist it has to be bought with the furniture.  
Bad business !

This is my favorite restaurant in the valley! Family owned and operated and you feel the love they have for their customers and their business. 
My husband called to make reservations and said he chatted with the sweet lady on the line for a good 30 minutes. She wanted to be sure she took good care of us. When we arrived a few days later for our anniversary she hugged him like an old friend when she seated us. She even recalled the chat! 
Our service was outstanding! We tried everything our server recommended and she led us to one of the best meals we have ever had. It was served family style at the table and was enough food for several more people. We managed to finish most of it because it was to delicious to stop eating! Thank you for an amazing anniversary dinner!

Elliott's Oyster House - Boise is so awesome. Sooooo good and well priced. They have a great menu as well. The team is very pleasant. I really liked that. Elliott's Oyster House - Boise is hands down the best.

Anna is the Queen! She is the only person I would ever trust to touch my eyebrows. Her talent and eye for shape, symmetry and color is perfection. Even better she has the kindest heart and is such and amazing, uplifting woman to be around. If you have the privilege of going to The Brow Club be sure to ask for Anna!

Not sure where to begin. If I could give zero stars I would...had reservations for an early dinner, showed up and they weren't ready for us, had to wait almost 10 minutes to be seated while they got the table ready. Even though they had our name on their books they seemed surprised to see us. They had 2 "hostesses", if you could even call them that. The way they were dressed they should have been working at Hooters. Wearing skin tight legging material type pants and short, almost bra like, shirts. If I wanted a show instead of an expensive dinner, I would go to Hooters and not bring my kids. Once seated it was so dark you could barely see who you were sitting with. The music was ridiculously loud and kept skipping and glitching then starting the same song over and over again, not to mention you had to yell over the music to talk to anyone. It was so loud that the waitress had to keep asking us to repeat ourselves. It took forever to get our drink order in and then again to place our food order. There were only 2 other hibachi tables that already had their food so not sure what the issue was. Our chef eventually came and started cooking but you could tell he was in a hurry. We had 2 young kids and 3 older kids who were looking forward to a show and we got nothing. A few spatula bangs on the grill, a small fireball once and that was it. When it came to when he is supposed to throw the food into your mouth he literally just launched it at our faces, he didn't even give you a chance to get ready, he just threw it at you, then didn't give you a chance to recover before he threw another one at you, hitting you in the face or the head and then moving on to the next person. He cooked as fast as the food would allow, to the point were the vegetables were raw, a tiny bit warm, but raw. The steak, chicken, shrimp, and rice was mediocre but definitely not worth the prices. I also ordered Tobiko, flying fish roe sushi. I know enough about sushi to know the difference between flying fish roe and smelt roe. When the menu says flying fish roe, I pay for and I expect to get flying fish roe, not smelt roe! Once we were done it took forever to get our bill, then even longer for them to come get our card and bring it back to us. We will never go back, it was very disappointing.

My mother and I made Dr. Crownover our primary this last year (2017) because he is thorough, personable, very knowledgeable, and easy to look at (smile). The Staff is all of the above as well, and it is always a pleasure to go to the office. Their portal is very very useful, what Dr can you send an email to asking your question, and get an answer within a few hours? This portal eliminates a lot of frustrating time that was waiting for a call back, and not knowing whether or not the Dr and or staff actually got your question. Actions are made quickly when possible (prescription refills, etc). I find this office a blessing to our family.
Jacqueline is always professional while keeping it personal. Been going here for 4+ years and never been disappointed.

Highly recommend!!! Cameron and his team were fantastic.. everything from customer service to packing, loading and unloading. They took care of all our personal items as if they were there own. We will absolutely use them in the future. Nice job guys!!

If I was given the opportunity I'd give this place a zero star. Firstly, their attitude towards new business was atrocious. I would never ever give them my business. The cow at the first station was the most hateful person this side of the freeway. If you value your money I'd go anywhere else. For a new business they should teach manners first.

The location is really good with restaurants not too far away.  The rooms are average.  My only constructive criticism is that they should have breakfast on weekends.  I was told that the hotel was fairly full which would indicate to me that there would be a need to serve breakfast on weekends.  Idaho doesn't follow much of a mask wearing so I don't think covid could be a good excuse.  Even a grab and go for a fee would be worth it.  The desk clerk at check in didn't have a great customer interaction.  Just checking in appeared to be a nuisance to her.  She peaked out the door while we were standing there waiting to check in.  She finally came out from the back room when she saw we weren't leaving.  Just not the most friendly, customer focused hotel.  We have been on the road for 5 weeks and this was probably our most negative experience.

THIS IS PICKUP & DELIVERY ONLY!!!!!! So frustrating, I have driven here twice to eat at a restaurant that looks good only to find it is CRAVE pick up or delivery only, I wish they would put that in the title.

I ordered a #7 combo and some other food as well. This gentleman asked if I wanted a receipt and I said no. I didn't figure I'd need it. I drove 2 minutes away and realized he didn't give me my side I ordered and PAID for. I walked in and nicely stated I didnt receive my side order and this was the same gentleman that gave me my order at the window. He knew who I was and I asked if I have a receipt. I told him no and that he was the one that asked me if I wanted it to begin with. He stated that he remembered that. He wasn't going to give me my side without the receipt. I WAS LITERALLY THERE TAKING MYY ORDER FROM HIM 4 MIN EARLIER! By the time he eventually gave me my side I ordered all of my other meals were cold. WORST MONEY IVE EVER SPENT. I recommend going to absolutely any other location. Not to mention as I was waiting to speak with someone, another gentleman who walked in an ordered food for there had told them they didn't give him the right amount of strips he ordered. Two mistakes within 5 minutes of each other.

This review is not on the food, but on the service. I have actually eaten here a few times in the past, and while the service has always Been spotty, I have always liked thier wings. Any other food items were forgettable.
This review is based on a visit recently where I and a friend came , were greeted by the hostess and were seated. So far..... No problem. 
Here's where the issue is. We waited for 10 minutes... No one came by to ask for a drink order, or even acknowledged us. The 2 girls waiting tables made every effort not to make eye contact with us. While this was going on, the hostess, who was stationed right next to our table cleaned menus, looking at us now and then. After waiting with no acknowledgement, we got up to leave, and the hostess wished a nice evening.
We went o the Ram, had drinks, and a meal and dropped $75.00.

Just so you know, I have a particular fondness for Indian food. It's my favorite, as I've mentioned previously. I think I may have found my new favorite Indian restaurant. Spice.

On the corner of Franklin and Eagle Road. Have wanted to try this place for a while. My brother is moving to China so this was the perfect opportunity. Going to miss him. We went for the buffet in order to try out a few different dishes. It is seriously so. damn. good.

I was able to sample quite a few chicken dishes I have never had, or even heard of, before. Karahi chicken, chicken tikka kabob, a few vegetarian dishes, and the one that was my favorite, chicken makhani. All on top of rice with some naan. YES PLEASE!

In my personal opinion, the spice blends in Indian dishes are simply amazing. If you have never had Indian food, or you have had "bad" Indian food, please PLEASE do yourself a favor and go try Spice's buffet. Hopefully you enjoy it as much as I do!
Always a great time at Elliott's!!! Bloody Mary's are divine and patio dining (with my pup) makes this a regular haunt for me.

Last night we got in a bind for dinner and didn't want to go far to grab something. Enter Johnny's! 

This was our first time trying Johnny's and we came out very pleased. The pizza was good, not like knock your socks off but absolutely something everyone will enjoy. The service was terrific,  they brought it right out to the car for my wife who was picking it up and the owner offered some discount pies. 

We got the 28" and it will easily Feed us for 2-3 days. .. it's huge and I loved that. The thing I loved about it most is they square cut their pies but give you the option for a slice cut. I lived in Buffalo for a time and they square cut their pies, I loved it and happy to see others doing it out here. 

Bottom line this joint is solid for game night pizza or a quick dinner and comes recommended by this reviewer for us meridian folks. Keep it up Johnny and we will keep supporting!
This was the most pleasant oil change experience. The staff was kind and explained everything so completely.

I used to love going to Beef O Brady's in college in Florida.  The wings and sports on TV with a cold beer was a perfect afternoon/evening for a college kid.  I took my family to the on here in Boise and wasn't disappointed.  It's solid bar food and cold beer. Period. And it was great.
It made my momma heart so happy that they took such good care of my baby for his first haircut!  Definitely the best place for children's hair cuts! They even had Blippi

I've been coming here on and off through the years, when I visit family and I've never been disappointed. The owners are ALWAYS welcoming, and you can't beat the quality for the price. It's definitely not like the other Sizzlers I've been to. Don't miss their steak deal.. my dads still raving about it ;)
It was a wonderful experience and the food was good, sushi was so fresh!, chef was very entertaining. Service was awesome. Definitely make. Reservation when going on the weekend.

Good place if you want a cheap mess up on a pizza and when you call to correct it you get an "oops, I didn't pay attention" I asked her to wait to start the pizza again since I would have to drive back from the opposite side of Boise, when I got there it was apparent that it was not waited on as it was old. All I got was a forced sorry and given the box and the girl walked to the back of the store leaving me alone. I usually love Johnny's but the customer service this time was not there at all.

Our daughter's first hair cut experience could not have gone any better! Even though the printer wasn't working, Cookie Cutters mailed the high quality certificate they promised! 
At Cookie Cutters the kiddos get to sit in a toy car while their hair is cut! They even have a tv to watch! Is there an adult version of this place?
Our stylist was great! Didn't care we were taking probably hundreds of pictures! She made sure our little cupcake got the royal treatment- hair sparkles, a braid, and a balloon!
It was a little pricey but worth it! When I checked in, Yelp gave us a coupon so I was thrilled! Other than that I'm excited to bring her back! One last thing, please build in Nampa!

This was my first time eating here, and it was just fantastic. I had the patty melt, and it was just delicious!  I normally don't care for steak fries, because they are never crispy enough, but these were just perfect!
I have to mention our server, Dean. Thank you SO much for your excellent service! It made the experience truly wonderful.  :)
Love this place!   No mask, great people, great service and fantastic food!  We ended up going 2 nights in a row! I would highly recommend this restaurant

The best Thai food in the Treasure Valley, best by far! Loved the fresh vegetables and mix of various flavors: everything was cooked perfectly. The ambience was distinctly Thai, very attentive waitstaff, and have I mentioned the food was fantastic?

I've had Thai a number of times, but the last place I went to gave me food poisoning and left a bad impression for the lack of hygiene. This place was clean and busy enough that it looked promising. I went with my girlfriend and her son, we each had different entrees and I tried the Boba "drink," which turned out to be an Icee type of drink rather than a juice or tea (not my favorite but it was good, I wanted the latte style boba tea); we were all very satisfied and had no complaints.

My daughter and I love Indian food and ended up here. I had read previous reviews about the food being good. The little restaurant resides in a strip mall. By the outside you wouldn't probably think about it being an Indian restaurant. Inside is tiny, the tiniest buffet lines one quarter of a wall and "L" shapes along the other. It begins with salad (which was sitting in dressing for awhile so We're really talking soup here) and traditional Indian condiments , cucumbers with tomatoes, etc. towards the end it had some kind of pudding and ice cream, albeit very melted and not appetizing in the least. The next part of the buffet was hot items. Naan bread( the tray was empty and we had to ask for more), many traditional tiki masala chicken , butter chicken ( was the best thing about this buffet!) and too many unlabeled unknown dishes! I don't eat lamb but knew they served it by reading the reviews but could not identify most of the dishes unless it said "chicken". The cauliflower dish was really good too. Also they make a pretty decent mango lassi. And the worst thing about this place was it felt dirty and there were flies all over. It's too bad because the food was decent but because I felt like the cleanliness level was subpar and the buffet wasn't refreshed the entire time we were there, I won't be back.

I'm new to Boise for the year and my husband and I regularly eat Indian food in Houston, TX so we thought we would try what Boise has to offer. This place had some five star reviews so we took the plunge. 

What we ordered:
Vegetable samosas
Chicken Curry (Boise Hot)
Chicken Jal Freezi (New York Hot)
Aloo Gobi (medium)

My ratings on a scale of 1-10 with 1(inedible) to 10(amazing, must get everytime):
Vegetable samosas- 2
Chicken Curry (Boise Hot)- 5-6
Chicken Jal Freezi (New York Hot)- 6
Aloo Gobi (medium)- 1

The vegetable samosas, though cooked, lacked flavor and seasoning and even when biting into it you can see just potatoes and peas. They use what seems to be tandoori chicken for the  chicken curry which wasn't bad but the flavor seemed to be missing something to put it at a higher rank. I usually eat this with rice and even their rice didn't seem like true Biryani rice but rather a cousin to it. However, if you're craving curry this will get the job done. For the Jal Freezi this was around the same for the chicken curry with not too much of a difference in flavors. Last is the Aloo Gobi.. honestly probably one of the strangest versions of this dish I've had (and coming from a well cultured area before I've had this alot as it's one of my go to dishes when trying any indian restaurant). The whole dish tasted more like saffron and potatoes. The cauliflower, to me, I couldn't even eat because it almost had a tartiness to it. The potatoes were fine if I mixed it with my curry sauce. The smell was more of a Cajun smell vs indian spices smell. Would not order that again for sure.

Since our food was takeout there's no way to comment on presentation and it's hard to distinguish them from each other. I did take a photo of what the samosa looked like inside though.

Three stars for wonderful service. Amazing and super friendly staff. The food?! For the price?! Too expensive and not that impressive. My husband and I laughed that this place is so highly rated due to its amazing costumer service. Most ppl probably leave feeling guilty not giving them all those stars and the review. Same here, prob made it 4 stars for a 3 star food value and price. See how much costumer service matters?!

What a perfect place to enjoy Tappan style dining!! Extremely satisfying with plenty of food to take home afterwards. The chef was super entertaining and funny to boot. Took the whole family there for a nice dinner out. I ordered the steak and scallops. Sooooo good!!

Lot of good things about Ada county but the recycling program here is not one of the them.  I've lived a lot of places and have rental properties in several more and I've never seen a recycling program that is as averse to recycling as this one.  Now, I know why most people here tell me they don't even bother.  I've never seen a recycling service that wouldn't pick up your cut and flattened boxes or glass and plastic recyclables.  You want me to cut and basically shred my cardboard so it fits in the container but you won't take shredded paper??  Do you know how many cut boxes fit in a container???  And somehow I'm supposed to put some boxes in a container and then find something to do with the rest of the recyclables for 2 wks until they pick up again.  They only come every 2 wks because people don't bother and just throw everything in the trash.  The guy in charge of this program should be fired.
Thai steak salad tasted fine. Ordered double meat, total less than 3 oz. added black beans, got 8. Added edamame, got 12 pcs. Very small especially for the price. I will never go back.

Don't bother with this store. I can't speak for the other locations but our experience at this one was awful. 

I called to ask about issues we had with a shelf that we purchased. I spoke with the woman who sold us our furniture, Nancy, and another woman named Christine, who told me she was a manager. Neither one followed through on their word to help us or put us in touch with someone who could. This store has awful customer service, you'll never be able to speak with someone who can help you and the associates don't know their own policies.

My family had an amazing experience with Valley Custom Moving! They moved us 900 miles. They are very professional, polite and know how to pack everything precisely. Using VCM took so much stress off the moving process and we will be calling them again for our final move. We highly recommend them. Thank you for such wonderful service.

Second stop on my trip took us to Goodwood BBQ in Meridian, ID.  It was only a couple miles from the hotel we were staying at and I had a hankering for a big piece of meat, so this one was a no-brainer.

Service:  4/5

The staff at Goodwood was very attentive from the moment we walked in the door.  The hostess held the door for my wife as she was carrying our young son and they gladly accommodated our request for a booth because that is how we prefer to eat out with a 4-month old.  He just sits in the booth with us as he's not quite old enough to sit in a high chair on his own just yet.

I do have to knock off one point for our waiter though.  He was a bit slow on taking our orders and keeping up with us after wards.  Soon after we arrived, a large party of twelve was also seated in our section.  I understand that large groups require more attention, but after they arrived, our service declined noticeably.  

Food:  5/5

Everything we ordered was excellent, including the signature BBQ that we were there for.  We began by splitting a house salad and an order of the spinach artichoke dip.  The dip was great and the salad was great.  The only thing I would say is ditch the chips for dipping and just give us more of the bread.  Maybe it's just my preference, but this wasn't a good dip for tortilla chips.  The slices of toasted bread worked great though.

For entrees my wife and I both ordered BBQ combination plates; pulled pork and beef brisket for my wife, pulled pork, BBQ chicken, and sausage for me.  My wife loved the pulled pork, and while I also enjoyed the pork, the best for me was the chicken.  It was so moist and flavorful.  It is so easy to overcook a chicken and turn it into a dry husk.  But this chicken was great.  The sides (baked beans, fried, potato salad) were solid, but not spectacular.  

For dessert we shared a berry cobbler.  It was served warm with a side of ice cream, and it was delicious.  The berries tasted fresh, the pastry was warm and flaky, and the cool ice cream was a good compliment.

Overall Impressions: 5/5

The decor and atmosphere in Goodwood is exactly what you would expect for a BBQ restaurant.  It is a modern rustic look with a lot of wood and wrought iron decor.  It wasn't too noisy inside and everything felt welcoming.  I know most people head to the central Boise location, but we found the Meridian Goodwood to be a great destination as well.  So if you're in the "suburbs," don't hesitate to check it out.
Girlfriend does the work of the lord with how skilled she is! I'm terrible at maintaining my eyebrows but she took them from Walmart to Chanel. Definitely going to continue seeing her.

Horrible customer service and system that doesn't work. Ordered ammo online for pickup the following day. Took my money right away then never completed the order. Tried to contact them was told store can't help at all must call online support. NEVER answer the phone and tell you to leave a number and they will get back in 24 to 72 hours. NEVER call back. NEVER SHOP THERE AGAIN!!!!!!!!

Had a wonderful dinner this past check in at Izumi. Our party of four had the hibachi dinner. So much fun and we had an entertaining cook. The food was really good and what we expected. They kept our drinks full and made sure we had everything we needed. Never felt rushed to leave either which is a bonus.

Tonight was the third time in the past 6 months that my husband, 12 year old son, and I have eaten dinner at Goodwood. I highly recommend this resturaunt for families or couples who want a nice menu selection, excellent service, and delicious food. It is nice to have a dinner spot that consistantly provides good food and good service.

This was bad. The cook in the back was extremely rude and kept aggressively interrupting the woman working the register to yell how long a wait time was or say they didn't have something. I'm not sure if all Good Burger locations are like this one, but I would steer clear of this one if you can help it

I will never go to this vendor again. ordered furniture in late August - sales person said delivery could be as early as mid-Sept, but more likely Oct 1st. Blamed Covid shutdowns in furniture manufacturing. Ok, i get that. As Oct 1st grew closer, received a call from a call center CSR - delivery delayed, More like Nov. 1 - still a Covid problem.  Got a call a week ago, partial delivery 1st week of November. Got a call today, no record of partial delivery call - delivery delayed until December 16. WTF? is this the worst furniture store ever or what? And the best part is, I paid for this furniture in August. They must be laughing all the way to the bank. Zero answers, zero furniture, zero concern. This place is a true pos when it comes to customer service.

I am very happy with the staff and services at Ideal Image! I absolutely love the fact that the girls performing my laser hair removal are licensed nurses and have years of nursing/medical experience. Other reviews mention that Ideal Image is expensive, this is true, but I would rather pay more knowing that the people using lasers on my skin know what they are doing! I love the professionalism and how genuinely nice the entire staff is. It can be very uncomfortable getting hair removal on certain areas of your body, and the staff at Ideal Image go above and beyond to make their clients feel comfortable and respected. I just had my third treatment and I can already see quite a reduction in hair growth and thickness, especially on my lower legs. They schedule your appointments every 8-10 weeks because your hair grows in cycles. This ensures that they are getting all of the new hair follicles in all of the stages of regrowth. Your hair isn't going to magically disappear after your first session. And your hair IS going to grow back in between treatments! It takes time to achieve the desired results! I would definitely recommend Ideal Image to anyone who is serious about investing in laser hair removal.

My friends and I went. We each had a different type of red wine, and all three reds had turned. They obviously had been left open too long and were very vinegary. I ordered the Firecracker roll, it wasn't spicy at all, the tempura on top was piled so high and made a mess all over me and the table. The sushi was lukewarm and mushy. 

My friends ordered the Crush and a basic salmon roll and the fish on their rolls was also warm and mushy. The price tag on my meal alone, the firecracker roll and 1 glass of wine, was $26.50, very pricy for such low quality. The saving grace was the service, our server was excellent!
Very friendly staff, knowledgeable, and efficient. Any oil change is very smooth and give you suggestions that you only need. Will be coming back for sure

I had a very unusual mailbox dilemma that no one had ever seen or even heard of before.  Lynn from Handyman Connection came out and resolved the problem to my satisfaction quickly and cost-effectively.  He knew exactly what to do and is also a very nice man which meant a lot.  I highly recommend Handyman Connection of Boise to anyone and plan on using them in the future as household needs arise.
The food was disgusting and terrible. Service was sooooo slow but the people were very nice. Me and my family have been near vomiting for the past three days. Will never go back.

I'm really bummed from my first time experience with this place.  Took my husband out to a movie for his birthday to see Gravity in 3D.  Unfortunately, the 3D didn't work!!  I've never gone to a movie and have it not work.  The screen was cut off during the previews and we ended up having to leave.  I asked if the next showing would be fixed and they said they didn't know.  While leaving, I spoke with a women who had this happen the previous week, so she was there to try to watch it again!  I know this theater is new, but really...there is no excuse for that.  They should have tested the movie before selling it to a bunch of people.

I found this place when I was out to lunch. I had some spare time and decided to try it out. I was new to the area and wanted to find a good place... this is it! Tammy was amazing and took her time. She was engaging in conversation, but not too much. My nails look fabulous and I will for sure be her new regular!

They advertise 50% off their laser hair removal package.  When I called I could not get them to give me any price over the phone and I asked more than once in the call.
When we show up they take us through their process not telling us the price until the very end.
**Over $10,000.00 for laser hair removal for a man's back.  With the 50% off it was around $5,200.00. They should give you prices on the phone when you call.
Hopefully this will save someone's time.
Also when I mentioned trying it just once to see if we were happy with what we saw in the first shot they dismissed us.  They wanted us to commit to the big ticket item.

We ordered hamburgers and French fries this past weekend. The French fries were advertised as hot and crisp-guaranteed. They were anything but hot and crispy. They tasted as if they had been sitting for a long time. The hamburgers tasted as though they had been cooked and out in a heating tray for awhile. The lettuce was soggy. We will never go there again. And we would not recommend it to anyone else.

If you need to move you need to call these guys! They probably have the best prices in town and they are very professional and courteous. Corey got everything set up for my move and kept in contact with me so that everything would go off without a hitch. Josh and KJ showed up on time and got to work immediately. They moved everything out of my house (including a piano) andand were on their way to our new place in 38 minutes! And they are very personable to boot! Very impressed! Hopefully I won't have to move again anytime soon but if I do I will definitely be calling these guys. Top rate company!

this was the absolute worst restaurant experience i've ever had. my girlfriend ordered food that she didn't like, we kindly asked if we could get something different. she wasn't being difficult by any means, we were polite and honest with them. we simply just wanted a different dish. we were told "No". the owner refused to replace her meal and find something she liked instead. being in the industry myself i was appalled at this. why was it so hard to replace her meal? we were more than willing to pay for one of the meals since she didn't touch the first one at all. they wanted us to pay for the one that was disgusting AND a whole new dish. i do not understand the logic in this. that is the LAST way to bring guests back into any establishment. izumis staff and management is the worst i've ever had. i do not recommend this place to anyone.

I had to wait forever and then they let a car cut my place in line although I had been waiting at least 5 minutes longer than this car when they were readjusting car order which was chaotic. Employee didn't care when I tried to explain my place in line and made me feel like a liar. Not happy with how long it took to service each car or the fact that my place had been stolen and my concern ignored. Had places to be and a very busy day. Will not be returning to this location, I appreciate honest businesses.

We were greeted by Kevin as soon as we walked through the door. We had a large group for hibachi. Kevin seated us and took our drink, appetizer and food orders. 
They came right away. Our hibachi chef was so much fun! 
The kids loved him. The food was wonderful. (The filet melted in our mouths!) we appreciated the great service that Kevin gave us from beginning to end. This was our first time there and will definitely will be going back soon!

I was pleasantly surprised to find this place. The flavors were good! Best aloo naan I've ever had. We tried the dal makhani with medium spice just to gauge the spice level and will definitely try hotter next time but it was very good, plenty of warmth from the spice and a very comforting dish. We also tried the samosas which I don't recommend. The pastry was very thick and once I got past all the breading there was no spice at all on the potatoes which was disappointing. But other than that this is a solid place and we will definitely be back!

We absolutely love coming to jump time as a family. For the past year it's our favorite cold weather activity. We have a very busy 2 year old and we were told today for the first time in over a year that it we were on the equipment playing with her that we as parents would need to pay $15 just to do so. They can't expect us to leave our 2 year old to her own devices can they?! The staff was pretty rude and I was very disappointed today.

well finally have my money back today after over a month and a half of fighting these snakes, so I can give my review.

if you are reading these reviews and thinking something bad won't happen to YOU, trust me- I did the same thing. I wish I had listened to others before we even walked in here.

the sales people circle like sharks the minute you walk in. they are nice enough, but it's all fake. they don't give a crap about you. they convince you to buy more and more for a discount, and when you do it and you're all excited they put a contract in front of your face you won't read and sign away.

ordered a sectional for our basement- excited enough about it. it was the only one in the store that we actually liked and was decently priced. it's insane how much they charge for sofas...especially since the quality is crap. signed away our life, and waited. 3 weeks later when it came, it didn't fit. literally- we couldn't get it in the room. the parts we could get in the room were cheap and sagged already. the quality was terrible. the delivery guys were really nice and told us we should just get a different configuration and when ashley called back and said it didn't come that way, we told them it wasn't going to work and to take the couch back.

this is where they get you- there are no returns. even if you have never sat on the couch- they will not take stuff back. you have to "re-select". well, they didn't have another couch that was going to fit, we had to change the entire game plan. we told them we wanted our money back- we were told that they don't do that.

after a LOT of hassle and a LOT of anger and a LOT of waiting and 2 weeks to come back and get the couch- 3 weeks to get our refund- so many calls to corporate I can't even see straight- we are still out the $120 in delivery fees. i'm just glad we got most of it back and glad I never have to deal with this crap company or these crap people ever again. and if the manager comments on this- which i'm sure he will- remember he's just trying to cover his own snake business.

we finally got the couch we needed at fred meyer and the people there were so nice- don't work on commission- helpful- and even told us if it didn't fit we could RETURN IT! how's that for service?!

i guarantee you the good reviews on here are just wives and family members of the desperate sales people that work on commission- i'm not buying it.

I wouldn't recommend ashley furniture homestore to my worst enemy.

This theater... This one cinematic venue... This is the reason I'm tempted to move away from Los Angeles and to the apartment complex next door to The Village. Five dollars for a movie ticket on Tuesday!!! Five!!!! My money is worth something here! And not only that; this is a quality movie theater. It's a clean, well staffed venue, and there are VIP seats where you can order food and drinks. This theater nailed it, NAILED it. There hasn't been a single technical issue. I don't have a single complaint about this place. The surrounding Village is beautiful at night, bring a date! Bring all your dates! Don't bring my date! I will fight you! We'll fight!!! Back off my girl!!!

Twice I've called for an order to go and there's so much background noise, they can't hear me on the phone, and I can barely hear them. That's a recipe for disaster, and in this instance, a hamburger without lettuce and tomato! Who does that anymore?  The food is not bad, but they really need to fix their phone orders.

Just ordered from Tokyo Hot Chicken!!! This was absolutely the BEST fried chicken I ever had!!! Its flavorful and oh so juicy! When it comes ordering fried crispy food for delivery, most of the time its disappointing but with this them it came hot & crispy! Also, I  would like to mention the sweet rolls!!! OMG! Its sweet, savory & spicy All MY FAVORITE THINGS!!! Great job!!! Im definitely spreading the word and letting all know how I love Tokyo Hot Chicken!

I called at the last minute and Jamie got me in. She was welcoming and made me feel very comfortable. My spray tan turned out great and I for sure will call her again when I can travel again!  Thanks Jamie!

The first time I ever had Tacos El Rey was during an event which they had catered. It was some time ago (pre-COVID, I say with tears) however I still remember thinking "Damn, I gotta find this place." You can imagine my joy when I discovered they were parked only 10 minutes from my house! 

During my last visit not too long ago I grabbed an Asada Super Burrito (filled with rice, beans, cilantro, salsa, lettuce, tomato, cheese and sour cream, $6.00). I mean, this burrito is the entire works. It's huge, filling, boasts flavor and carries value. Other taco trucks charge $10.00 for the same size burrito. Tacos El Rey not only makes me tummy happy but my wallet as well. 

Other yummy items are the Asada Tostada, Asada Quesadillas (notice a trend?), Cabeza and Pollo Tortas and the Barbacoa Burrito. All menu items are very reasonably priced. 

Note: I did not grow up eating much traditional Mexican food, so I do not feel qualified to gauge its authenticity. However, one of my great friends and frequent foodie buddy who did mentions that the food hits home pretty hard.
Finally tried Chip Co and am glad I did! We got one of each cookie flavor to try and both my husband and I LOVED the frosted sugar cookie! We will definitely be back for more of them!
Would definitely go back - sushi and hibachi were delicious - only downside was that we never received our salads with the Hibachi order :(

Driving from Denver to Portland not knowing how far I'd make it the first day so no hotel reservation. Made it to Boise where I pulled over and went on Booking.com.  Chose Courtyard be Marriott as it was the least expensive in the area I was checking.  Hotel was conveniently located, staff was helpful and friendly, room was perfect, and price was great. More than I could have hoped for on the fly.  Highly recommend.

Epi's was just a great place to enjoy great food and great hospitality.  My wife and I were late getting reservations, however the staff was gracious enough to allow us to come dine.  We had a wonderful dinner well prepared by Erik. I had the Halibut filet and my wife had the Garlic Shrimp.  The dessert, Gateau Basque, was so fantastic as well!  My wife will go back to Epi's the next time we're in Meridian to have dinner again.  
Thank you Erik and your wonderful staff for making our Idaho visit great by serving such delicious food.  Until next time...

My husband and I visited this McDonalds today for breakfast. There were two young kids behind the counter helping customers. There was also one gal, short heavyset with a large bun on her head, who we assumed was the manager. Every encounter these two kids had with her was met with complete annoyance. She would roll her eyes, groan with intolerance or give an impatient look when they came to her for assistance with anything. At first we didn't think much of it but as we watched this lady who was supposed to be in charge, it became infuriating. The young girl looked hesitant if she had to ask the manager for any type of help.  Someone  who is suppose to be in charge should be able to give guidance to these young employees who were obviously working their first job. Instead they seemed nervous to even ask her a simple question. Not sure how she became a manager but she may need some more training.  With so many choices of places to eat these days, it's annoying when your visit consists of watching management degrade thier staff.

Really great restaurant that I wish we'd found earlier, always knew it was there just never stopped in.  We had the chicken tikka masala and lamb korma.  Food came out promptly, was hot, fresh, and just the right amount of spice.

I hope this place can stay afloat, nice folks and great food are a pretty good combo.  

Try a Taj Mahal beer too, nice light lager!

So I haven't been to a dentist in forever so I knew that the initial consult wouldn't be all sunshine and rainbows but the staff was friendly and professional, they handled an insurance quibble very well and we got that all straightened out and they were able to map out a dental plan for me to fix my own mess. All in all, no complaints here.

Absolutely gross food.  Went for lunch today hoping to find a good Mexican place close to home.  They were not crowded but after ordering, our food took over 30 minutes to come out, and what they placed in front of us was lukewarm at best. I had a chili relleno, which I can tell you is the worst chili relleno I have ever had.  It was tiny, hardly any cheese, GREASY, and topped with what I'm sure was just tomato sauce.  My daughter had the carnitas, and while that was passable, it was cold.  Sad.

We always come to this place because its relaxing the food is fantastic and we always leave happier than when we first come in. Curry is our favorite comfort food. We will have to wait to dine in because we enjoy sitting down and eating in the restaurant than eating at home because the experience isn't the same

I came in with a group of girls to celebrate a birthday! First, we had made a reservation, but they didn't seem to have to. Luckily, there was room for our party of 6 on a Friday night. The decor is cute but there is not a lot options for privacy. The margaritas were pretty good, though the drink menu is a bit limited you can ask for custom margaritas and they'll happily oblige. The food was just OK, and after a table visit from the chef, it was delicious. Before he visited we found the carne to be dry, a bit cold and under seasoned- he came out and made a fresh batch that was so yummy. I give kudos to him for visiting tables & for caring about our experience! Our server was great- super friendly, well versed in the menu & timely with coursing & table touches. I REALLY wanted to give this place more than 3 stars- & I will be back- but there are some things in the kitchen they can work on to make the food consistently better for every patron. When they nail that, this will be an AWESOME restaurant for the area.

Nice little strip-mall shop, but EXTREMELY disappointed with food & serve!!  

I got a plain bagel with jalapeño cream cheese and a mocha coffee.  Only one other person being served, yet, the two staff members seem to be tripping over each other.  

Although she wrote down my order, a few minutes later she was asking me to repeat my order.  As I was walking out of the cafe I almost dropped my coffee bc it was EXTREMELY hot ... they didn't provide a sleeve and it was so over heated that they burnt the coffee.  The bagel was so bland that it seemed like a bulk buy from "C****o" (hmm?) and what made this all even more horrendous ... pretty sure the "jalapeño cream cheese" was either bad or it was mixed with mayonnaise (to stretch their inventory) bc it had a weird sweet & creamy texture of mayo. 

All n' all, the cream cheese is why I will never try another "Sarah's" again.

Kind of disappointed in their behavior especially because of the current global pandemic. We walked in, one kid was sitting on his phone next to the door with his mask down, didn't put it up as we walked in, the girl is standing at the register playing with her hair and yells across the restaurant to welcome us in. Continues to play with her hair and still doesn't put her mask up (at this point we are in front of her maybe 6 ft away). Finally as we walk closer, she puts her mask on, takes our order, finishes the transaction and goes directly to prep our food without washing her hands. Also I'm pretty sure in food service, you need your hair up AT LEAST!! Let alone a hair net and/or hat.

Used Goodwood for my wedding recently and was very pleased with their catering services. Mimi was a delight to work with; very friendly and professional. Yet staff was so helpful the day off. They showed up and went above and beyond all expectations.

I really like D&B Supply much more than the large box stores like Lowe's and Home Depot.  They seem to have things i cannot find at the larger stores.  For example I've been looking for a pair of small garden snips and have only found them here at D&B.  They have a really large selection of power tools also.  Plus you can always find someone willing to help find things here!

I purchased a refurbished vacuum cleaner in January.  I brought it in to the shop today for some help w the belt.  Not only was I given help with the belt, a part of the handle had broken off and it was replaced free of charge.   Great customer service and this is how you keep a customer for life!

I rarely write reviews.  Only if it is above and beyond or horrible beyond belief.  I don't expect much from my nail people, but this was the worst.  I was in a time crunch and asked for pedicure, he said he would do my nails while I waited for a pedicure.  No pedicure was ever done, he was rude and awkward, and ended up cutting my finger.  My nails did not even turn out that cute, definitely not $50 worth.  No thank you.

Great pizza for a great price. I have seen Johnny's Pizza numerous times and had never stopped... one night after work and knowing I had no desire to cook, I let Johnny's do the cooking for me and I was well fed. If you like hot/spice I highly suggest the Cajun bread sticks!!!

In town visiting from Pittsburgh and had to stop in as soon as we saw that there was a Zupas in town. We lived in Utah several years ago and always loved Zupas. My husband and I each did the try two combo. I got the mango berry salad and the Korean bbq sandwich. Both were fresh with great flavors! Restaurant was mostly clean, service was fast, and we left with full tummies and happy hearts.

I'm currently sitting at the meridian jump time. I am ashamed and more embarrassed than I have ever been in my entire life. 

My daughter raves about how much fun it is here so we came for some birthday fun after her party..... 7 unlimited wristbands. Everything started out fine until my kids got yelled at by a staff member for using the laser maze, which was not labeled "reserved." 

Then there was this giant inflatable bag that you could jump in to off of a trampoline. My kids begged me to do it. I am about 40 lbs over weight. Do I look it..... yes..... do I know it yes...... I jumped off and sunk up to my shoulders. I sat there for what seemed like 10 minutes trying to get out. People were snickering at me from around the safety gate, the staff member just smirked every time he walked by. When I finally got him to stop I asked if there was a trick to getting out and he said "not really." I had exhausted myself trying to climb out at this point.

Another staff member came to switch places with him and they went and stood in the corner and looked and me and were snickering. 

Finally two moms came and helped me get out. While I am not obese I am heavier from having a baby. I do not even want to jump with my kids at this point because I am so ashamed and embarrassed. I'm am sitting in the corner ,by the laser maze that my kids are not allowed to play in, crying. 

Thank you jump time for hiring the most unprofessional staff. They are letting bigger kids run all over small kids in the kiddie zone(including candy cane lane,)rude, and act like they are entitled. 

No one should be treated this way.

Worst property management company on the planet. My mom and her girlfriend rented from them and had nothing but problem after problem. Problems that repeatedly went unresolved. When they first moved in there were rips in the vinyl flooring in the laundry room, the refrigerator was broken and would not make ice, there were no coverings on the ceiling lights in the bedrooms etc. etc.. My mom told the landlord about all of these things that needed to be fixed.  All he did was give my mom a hard time and write her nasty emails. The floor never got fixed and the lights never got covers. He even tried to charge them for the ripped flooring and certain other things that were already damaged when they moved in. Luckily, she kept a record of all communications with this man. All of that aside, perhaps the worst thing about this Property Management is that they treated my mother and her girlfriend with complete disrespect, to the point of harassment. We definitely feel that they were discriminated against because of their sexual orientation.  I could probably write a ten page report on all of their awful experiences with this company but I will stop here. If you want a fair, understanding, communicative property management DO NOT RENT FROM JPM!!! They should be taken to court and SHUT DOWN!!!

Christian, Tia, and Ben take great care of my partner and I when we come in.  We make special trips after work, during the week just to banter and enjoy the fantastic cocktails they make!

Christian created the one in the photo, you should ask about it!

Thanks to you guys for always being friendly and amazing!
Bodo! Keep them around!
Mama always said if you got nothing nice to say, dont say anything at all........1 star does it for me

Where do I even begin with how despicable this property management company is? I lived in one of their  properties for just over a year, during that time my roommate and I both developed severe chronic health  problems that will likely effect us for the remainder of our lives. There was obviously a mold problem on the property and when we let them  know, they "solved" the problem by bringing over a bottle of bleach and not conducting any further investigations. This company is absolutely ruthless and has no regard for the well-being of their tenants. Someone please get this trash company shut down. Also, 10/10 don't recommend living on 310 w  thatcher unless  you want health problems and thousands on thousands of dollars worth of health bills.

it was finally time for my sons first haircut. this place was PERFECT- a jungle gym, lots of fun cars for the kids to sit in, a tv at every station with netflix, and balloons! 

my son was really not scared at all going in there and for the most part he enjoyed his time. he did cry when the clippers got taken out, but other than that he had lots of distractions in his face that made the whole experience enjoyable.

keely was so sweet and made him so comfortable. she did a great job and his hair turned out exactly like we wanted. at the end he got the cutest certificate and a lock of his hair for the baby book. so sweet!

I look forward to always bringing my son here for his hair cuts. they also had video games for the older kids, which was nice too!

Took hubs out for dinner on Fathers Day!  We've been here before and just love the hibachi dinners. But I must brag about their Beach Babe sushi roll. OMG!!! It was super yummy...it has strawberries, kiwi & bananas in it. Served with a mango creme dipping sauce. My hubs is not a sushi lover like my daughter or I, but he tried it and really liked it. The Beach Babe roll is amazing...try it on your next visit. You will not be disappointed!!

Simply put, "Spice" is the best Indian Cuisine I've ever had, ever... ever. 

This beautiful family started an amazing restaurant called Madhuban: it won awards, it was well established as the best Indian food in town for quite some time, and then some life events occurred and they left the original location; and then new owners took over and now that aforementioned location is a really great place to eat, but still no comparison to the original.

During my squeaky anxiety filled youth I was a waiter at the original Madhuban and developed somewhat of a family friendship with the owners. I literally was around the food on a daily basis and yet I always craved their amazing recipes at the end of my shift; specifically the korma sauce. Nothing... and I mean NOTHING ever compared to the specific way they made that ridiculously delicious sauce. 

Imagine basically every trailer for that game Assassin's Creed... or every movie trailer about a lone warrior who has to leave his home to save the world or something like that... ya know?

...he's hiking up snowy mountains, trudging through murky swamps, dying of thirst in the vast dunes of a desert... dude... that guy was ME while this family was away... I was looking for anything to compare to how the original Madhuban owners made that friggen sauce. I lived out my tender 20's stopping into one disappointing Indian restaurant after the other. And then...

Spice. Here they are kicking butt once again making absolutely stupendous Indian cuisine. On top of that, the waiters are awesome and experienced. The location is simple and cozy. And this family... if you ever have the pleasure of meeting these wonderful people you will understand the full meaning of the 'love' and effort added to every dish that cannot be replicated anywhere. 

Five star this place. Tell your friends. Tell your wife, tell your kids... and tip a lot. Dig deep into those pockets and give em' what you got. Gold pocket-watch? Put that, on the table, before you leave. 

And if I meet you and you've given these people anything below a five star rating... I will find you. And I will look at you soooo angrily... and then I'll do nothing because I'm too full from all that Lamb Korma and I don't like physical conflict. 

If this wasn't clear already... I HIGHLY recommend the Chicken Makhani (butter chicken) and the Lamb Korma with a side of coconut naan. Yum. Perfect. 

Spice (Original Madhuban), I love you. 

Person who is reading this review and is deciding whether to go or not. Go. You're welcome.

Went to Goodwood because we ran out of options for ribs. After a bad experience at big Daddys, and the closing of famous Dave's which was one of our favorites.  Ribs were surprisingly good here at Goodwood, not as dry as I remember, we split a full rack and had side Caesars prior to our meal. We both left very full and had a great experience, all though it is very loud through out the whole building and hard to talk and enjoy yourself. Sorry no pictures we drove in after having to wait quite a bit for a table.

My wife and I stopped in here last night for the first time; it was also the first time we've gone out together for Indian food.  Our young server was awesome.  We told her we hadn't eaten there before and told us what their most popular items were.  We ordered what was suggested and boy, were we happy with what we got.  I had the Mughlai Makhani and she tried the Mughlai Madrasi.  The shrimp were large, the lamp was soft and tender and the chicken was delicious.  We also selected the garlic and paneer naan to go with the meal.  We totally enjoyed our first venture into Indian food together at Spice in Meridian, ID.  Highly recommend this place.
What a nice place to eat. Delicious food clean restrooms and nice staff  We will definitely be back.

I decided to try a new bagel place.  My first impression of this place was that it must not be very popular or good because there was nobody there at 830 am when they should be busy.  I only wanted a bagel to go, but I asked about getting a baker's dozen bagels and the server's answer could not be understood at all because of such a difficult accent.  When I got home I cut my cinnamon raisin bagel in half to put it in the freezer for later.  Hmm .  .  . There were only 2 raisins in it.  So I don't think I will return to this place again.

We went to Goodwood barbecue over the weekend To celebrate My Husband's birthday. This was the first time we have been out to a restaurant since Covid started over a year ago. We felt very safe. They have put up plexiglass between the booths and and every staff member had a mask on. We are so glad to know that we can have a nice dinner out and still feel safe and comfortable in this difficult time. The food was delicious and we had a great time! Thanks, Goodwood!

Worst sushi ever!!!
We went here to get sushi and it's literally the worst sushi I've ever had. I got the Poseidon roll and there was so much tempura inside that's basically all it tasted like. I ended up sending it back and I NEVER send anything back. They still ended up charging me for it. I ordered a California roll after sending the other roll back because I was starving. It's pretty hard to make a bad Cali roll but they did. There was barely any rice around it. My husband got the sweetheart roll which was ok, not a lot of flavor. We also had gyoza which was actually really good. The other thing that was annoying was the service was terrible and we showed up at 3:45pm so they only had one other group. Will definitely not be going here again.
Had 12 piece nuggets. They were cold, dried out nasty little pieces of overcooked wads of batter! Worst nuggets I've ever had!

My wife and I needed an interstate moving company, and having heard horror stories about lost or delayed shipments, we were apprehensive to say the least. Friends referred us to Valley custom movers and we couldn't have been more pleased. Cory, Josh, and the crew went over and above in taking care of our items. Need a reliable moving company, go with Valley Custom Movers!

It might be great but I was so grossed out that the woman who took my order didn't change her gloves the whole time she was preparing food I won't know. She even checked me out using the same gloves and the card runner was all greasy from her doing it before.

Tonight we enjoyed meals with Los Mariachis. There were 4 of us and we all enjoyed a different item.  The food was fresh, well prepared and delicious.   I was a bit hesitant to go to the restaurant but I took into account the age of most of the reviews.  I'm happy to say that if there was a problem in the past they have addressed it. The portions were appropriate in size and a great presentation.  It is pretty standard Mexican food so if you're looking for a good meal that's normal fare I recommend this place.

Do not use banfield pet hospital in meridian. If you want your pet to stay alive go some where else.  They killed my 91/2 years old yorkie!! They don't care abt the well being of your pets. They all care about making money off your pets!! I took my dog there cuz she was having trouble breathing. They wanted to do X-ray and pay more for someone else to look at it. Ohh it's something simple and the meds will help. But no the meds made her worst and I called and begged for my dog to be seen ASAP but no they couldn't cuz they are tight schedule. She died suddenly and I called them to let them know. Now I'm slammed with $$$ they said I owed them when I already paid for the meds and X-ray etc. they told me you are all paid for and I left. But no I keep getting calls I owe way more $$ and they are refusing to tell me what it is for. They don't care if your dog died. Yes I blame them they killed my dog. Save your pets go some where else not banfield vet in meridian off eagle rd.

Since my last review, we have definitely been to this theater many more times and it's still our first pick.

Overall recommendation is to always go online and look up the movie you are wanting to see ahead of time. You will set yourself up for a much better experience, because you'll already know if the move is sold out and if not, what seating options are left. 

My absolute FAVORITE new update to this theater is the option of those with the reclining seats. So good! The seats are so comfortable and roomy, every seat is a good seat and each person gets a little table and drink holder.  I'm not ashamed to bring my blanket for a little added comfort.  Do note, these can sell out fast because there are far fewer seats in these theaters.
Out here from Idaho Falls and wanted some good Mexican food. Well we found this place and the food was so so good! And the service was excellent! Would come back here in a heart beat!!

Uber eats order wasn't completely fulfilled.  When I called to tell them they forgot my child's milk, they said well sorry but it's complimentary.  I asked to speak to the manager and the manager told the employee what to say to me.  I doubt it's complimentary, as the price is tallied into the kids meal.  The way this was handled was off putting.  The manager didn't care to pick up the phone or offer a free milk if I were to come in again.

We went to our favorite Qdoba yesterday evening and I ordered my usual grilled quesadilla.  I was surprised when it would not hold together and did not appear to have cheese.  Thinking they had forgotten the cheese, I brought it back to them. They made me a new one but it was just the same.  Then the employee explained that they had new quidelines as to how much cheese they could put in.  I had to take it home and recook it with added cheese to make it stay together.  I am not sure this change will be successful, if one can't pick up the quesadilla without all the ingredients falling out.

I have been patronizing Beef'O'Bradys for years, and I must say, I am very conflicted about this place lately. The food is great, no doubt.  The service during the week, especially at lunch is 5 star level - again no doubt!  But I must suggest sticking to the weekdays.  I'm not sure if it is strictly a staffing issue, or what, but this place has a definite Jekyll and Hyde feeling.  The level of service and quality of food rate a 1 star at best.  So that is why I give it 3 stars, but totally suggest eating there, just not on the weekends.

The good: pleasant decor and decent ambiance, milkshakes are nice, chicken tenders are fried very well.
This place has very busy Sunday afternoon business without the quality and service that correlates. Glad to have Sunday afternoon options in the area. Hope they improve.

The bad: poorly trained servers, poor food quality. Need local presence to check on tables and service.
More concerned about selling me pet insurance than my dog.  While waiting forever for the vet I called another vet and made an appointment.  The vet pitched me insurance too, so disappointing.

Called in today asking if they had life jackets. Held for a while. Then got transferred. Asked a lady if they had life jackets, then got transferred again. Asked a new lady if they had life jackets and she said "yeah we have all sorts!  What are you looking for?" I explained I had a ten year old boy and then a 15 year old boy who wore an adult large. "Oh yeah, we've got you covered. Come on down."
I show up less than 15 minutes later and they have one life jacket on the rack that is too big for either of my boys. I asked someone if they had more. The guy said "no that's all we have we've been out for a while. We should get some in soon though". 

Not going back.

Not a huge fan. Ordered the peanut butter today, which was very tall in the middle. Made me wonder how well the middle was cooked compared to the thinner outside of the cookie. Sure enough it was undercooked. They also coated it will sugar, kinda makes me think the cookie can't stand on its own. I will stick with Crumble cookies.

Horrible customer service. It's a cattle call with a rude person waiting for you at the end. These people could care less about the customer. Zero service. Awful place. My 4 year old could do a better job. Be nice people-smile-it goes a long way.

Our family recently dined at Epi's and the first word that comes to mind is WOW!!!
I can honestly say this is, by far, the very best meal any of us has had in a very long time. Every course was perfectly prepared and executed flawlessly.
Our service was spot on. 
The staff were genuinely friendly, and easy-going.
There were literally no weak links throughout the evening.
And then there was the food! Every course was perfectly seasoned. The calamari was fresh and melt in your mouth.
Our mushroom soup was lovely    the layered seasonings were beautifully balanced. My cod entrée was out of this world!
And the apple bread pudding? Divine 

Without a doubt our family will return very soon!
Don't miss out on this very special restaurant!
When I picked up the corsage we ordered, it wasn't quite what I had wanted. It was altered immediately to my satisfaction. I would order from this business again.

My husband and I are church roamers.  We've been in search of the perfect church home.  Which quite honestly is harder than you would think.  On a friend's suggestion we thought we would give Life Church a try a month ago.

As their website openly states, they are definitely not the right fit for everyone and I love that they are realistic and honest about this.  Our first visit was a bit of a shock, especially for my husband raised with very traditional Southern Baptist roots; but I think we can both say we had a great time.  I don't know that we have fully committed to making this our new church home yet, but we have attended 4 services now and have walked away energized from each and every one.

The service starts with what I can only describe as a high energy Christian concert.  Everyone is up singing along, dancing around and just having a good time praising the Lord.  The worship room is very simplistic in it's decor, which is a nice change of pace from other churches we have visited.

Pastor Mark is high energy, humorous and definitely has a talent for delivering the word of God in a way that is easily applied to daily life.  I truly look forward to hearing his sermon each week and think about his words throughout the week and how I can apply them.  

The church has a kids club, split up by age group and a computer system for checking them in.  They also offer different summer camps, study groups and even a bible college program for those wanting to explore their faith further.

All in all, I am impressed thus far.
Absolutely great Japanese steakhouse. Great food. Great sushi. Great hibachi. Great drink options. Great service. Love eating here.
This place is amazing! Great food, cozy atmosphere and friendly staff. We have yet to have a bad meal or experience here.

We continue to return. We absolutely love this place and once again Epi's never disappoints us. The food is amazing, rich in flavor, fresh, and authentic. The family service, well they make you feel right at home...okay actually better than home..we don't get service like that at home. ;)
Just really great people. They actually like what they do.

Trash. High pressure salesmen, who sign you up for a credit card upon any purchase. Go to RC Willey instead. I'm calling today to return the couch I purchased. This business is unethical and I will not buy from them
We had Yellow Curry and Mongolian Beef. Our taste buds were VERY Pleased. Sooooo much flavor my mouth watered. Will DEFINITELY be back.

I know, this isnt glitzy or glam, but if you are hankering for a salad bar plus something else, this is the place to stop!  I am not much for their steaks since that isn't my thing, but I love the salad bar and today they had a wonderful chili con carne soup that I added avocado to make it even more flavorful, and it was delicious!  Today they had kiwis, orange slices, and a yummy dessert.  You can be very healthy here and enjoy some additions to the salad bar-today was mexican fare.

Best Mexican in town hands down! Excellent food and service. Do yourself a favor and get yourself the beef taquitos! They're to die for! We've tried all 3 locations in the treasure valley and they're all good.

My boyfriend and I looked around everywhere for something we wanted, and it was specific. We came into Ashley and Aleena helped us find just the right thing. We had a good experience minus that it took forever for us to receive our furniture due to the shipping containers being help because of the pandemic. However, she helped us in situations where the 800 number told us incorrect information and gave us her personal cell number to get quicker answers. Also, we ended up picking up our furniture rather than having it delivered and she helped makes sure that charge was taken off our financing loan balance when it wouldn't reflect immediately. Aleena was super helpful on her days off and it was appreciated to have her help us along the way!

So... one more reason I wish I were Basque! Truly lovely service (I love watching peoples faces that have never been in before..I mean they make you feel like you're long lost friends and so excited to see you!). 

We have been in before and always enjoy appetizers to dessert.. but this time we were celebrating my mother-in-law's 90th birthday...and calling the day prior, there were no tables available. So we explained what she'd asked to be put on a cxlation list. 

Thankfully the next day there indeed was a table available early and we went on our merry way! My motherinlaw was treated like a queen- Bridgette (our server) even put a thick,  comfy pillow on her chair!  Chris & Bridget have been there since day 1...yep since 1999!!

And then the food... first there's deep fried green chilis... it's not what you think! Not greasy and it's mild taste is good! We ended up  taking what was left & chopping them up in eggs the next day!

Beef red bean stew, calamari, the side salad... all wonderful starters. 

Next the spicy shrimp special and husband said the beef tongue was wonderfully tender & prepared well. The scallops special with lemon cream was delightful & at first I thought it seemed like a pretty small portion ..but it was just right with it's richness and everything else!

The ONLY negative is it is such a small place & VERY loud with everyone enjoying delicious food & visiting ..but regardless, definitely recommend this place!
Went to go eat there with a friend and I ate the fajitas and got food poisoning. Was sick for days. The fajitas were old. Veggies were dark and old with no taste. Never going back!!

Ok, been here a few times and have no complaints. Granted, we come here to drink.  Tina first welcomed us on our first visit, super nice, then Eden and Cameron kept our drinks coming in the evening. Bar food has been decent. Not sure why the low reviews.

I've had 2 pedicures by Kristen at Inspire Salon and both times were wonderful.  Not only did she do the best at applying polish and cleaning up my feet, but she was as so personable and genuine.  The facility is also beautiful and immaculate.  I don't do pedicures often, but when I do, I'll look forward to seeing Kristen and will also probably try some other services.

I wasnt delivered my second trash can so I called in and spoke with Katie at the meridian office. Everyone I've talked to has been great except her. If her boss knew how she talked to customers he would probably have a major conversation with her...

Her customer service is Def sub par.

Edit: someone calls me back to tell me they delivered the second trash can with the bin number. I tell them I got the extra recycle but not the trash can. She implies that I'm lying saying "well they delivered it I'm not sure what to tell you". I ask if they can track it by the bin number she says no and tells me to see if one of my neighbors took it. I'm not going to go to my neighbors and peep around their homes looking at their trash bin numbers. Who does that and tells someone else to!
Yummiest yellow curry ever! My husband also got their roasted duck dish and he loved it. This is a great restaurant and ill be back again to try the rest of their curry dishes.

I made reservations for a group of 9. They were amazingly accommodating for a Friday evening, the atmosphere was cozy, and the service was great! Unfortunately, the food seemed to fall flat, and that was the consensus across the board. It wasn't bad per se, but I'd say mediocre at best. The price was as expected, but the food just didn't live up to what I'd hoped it would be. Based on the meal alone, I probably wouldn't return.
Not all members of staff were wearing gloves or masks. Cookies are good but there were no safety measures in place

I can't believe how despicable these people are!  They definitely shouldn't be in business if they don't know how to be respectful to ALL current and potential tenants.  Their customer service is terrible!!
We miss the buffet but still love the food. The flavors are great and the staff is nice.

This actually made a YouTube list of best fast food burgers.  I was really hungry.  It was there.  I decided to give it a try.

Best part of the experience was the service.  Well trained staff abs super perky.

Burger was fresh (as they advertise never frozen) and had great taste and texture but it was so thin the bun to meat ratio was off.  Definitely would get a double to correct this.

Fries were a total miss.  Pres study much the frozen crinkle fries we can all by at the grocery store.  Best thing I can say is at least they were hit!

The best thing was the fry sauce which had a nice Dijon flavor in addition to the normal as l ketchup snd mayo.  The got the internet frequents perfect for my taste buds.

I would give it a second chance just because it was a very pleasant experience

Very expensive. ..I do not recommend  this place  I had a coolsculping which I paid around  3 k ...and had no result s
I will never considered going back

Bethany is the QUEEN OF BALAYAGE!!
I've been working on this for almost a year now with two other stylists and spend over $1,000 to get this look and after all that time and money it still wasn't what I wanted. Bethany did this on her first try and at an unbeatable price! She really takes her time and I'm so obsessed!! Thank you Bethany, I will be back for all my hair needs!

Wonderful everything! Outstanding quality. Warm friendly service. There were 7 people in our party. Everyone had a wonderful meal. Great meal starting with the fresh bread then, soup, salad, main dishes, and awesome desserts! Only one negative. Tiny bit too noisy. We went on a Thursday evening. It was packed (because it is sooooo good!), so it was a bit noisy. Can't wait to go back!

So my wife and I ordered from crave tonight....because crave is flippin' amazing...and I finally decided to get me some Tokyo hot chicken. I have been craving some good fried chicken and thought what the heck, it looks good. 

I got a spread...like enough for two people and no matter how long and hard I was on that damn pelaton I still couldn't burn it all off. Any way, I tried the six piece chicken fingers in original spicy,  a chicken snacker, mac and cheese, and crispy yuzu potatoes for my sides. 

First the good news, i really enjoyed the chicken snacker. It's on a Hawaian style slider bun and the kewpie mayo is fantastic. It's probably what I would recommend to anyone ordering from here. The crispy yuzu potatoes were my favorite side and also really satisfying with a uniquely great flavor profile. 

Where it fell short for me was actually where I thought it's strength would be, the frikin chicken. The breading had very little flavor and the chicken was a bit dry. I did get the fingers so I would recommend going for the bone in pieces. 

All and all I didn't love it... and frankly I hardly liked it.  It was fast food fair (with less flavor) at crave level prices. I order from crave fairly often and expect top level cheat worthy menu items worth the premium price tag. The only thing that delivered was the snacker. I suggest you give it a shot but don't go in expecting Tony G level greatness. Get in there, order local fair and eat up Boise.

My husband and I were visiting our daughter and her family from out of state. Before visiting we searched online for a church to visit while in Meridian. I listened to Pastor Mark's message online from the previous week before visiting. We were led here by Holy Spirit to hear this truth filled, insightful and profound message on 3/18/18 about
FINDING FRANK, part 2 of series.  Acronym: F-friend, R-relatives, A-associates, N-neighbors, K-Kids. It was one of those moments when we knew in our hearts that this message on this day, at this exact time was what we needed. We have been Christians for a long time. God keeps feeding and growing us through His Word, prayer and listening to His still small voice, worship AND through Spirit filled pastors like Pastor Mark. Thank you for your service and for this Holy Spirit filled church! We are blessed. Praise the Lord!

Calazones at Johnny's are HUGE & super yummy. I was quite shocked at the size. You can customize your own. My daughter and I love the bacon, artichoke w/creamy garlic sauce. And my husband loves anything with meat. The prices are reasonable. Only thing is there are a lot of garlic crumble on outside ...maybe a little less and then perfecto!

Pick up for our neighborhood is on Tuesdays, our pick up day came and went and our trash bin was still full.  I called the next day to inform them our bin still needed service, I was told they would add me to the current days pick up.  Wednesday came and went and no pick up, I called again on Thursday and was now told that they could only request the drivers do a pick up but could not guarantee a pick up.  I don't understand how they believe its ok to charge me for services not rendered.   Bad customer service is bad enough, but non existent service is unacceptable!

What's up with Kohl's, on Eagle Rd., in Meridian....not doing anything about the appearance of the inside of the store?  All of the clerks were most helpful...but the clothes thrown in piles on the lower racks and hanging racks being totally empty, gave the appearance of the store going out of business.  Is this store closing?  I'm sure they are working with a short staff...due to the virus but I'm also sure more and more people will shop on-line, or shop other stores before shopping in that Kohl's store again.  That's just sad to see, especially with the amount of hours the store is closed and could be straightened and made ready for in-store shoppers.
