Great people serving home style foods, the converted house made you feel comfortable and the outside seating was nice, small so defiantly need to make reservations. Would recommend for adults as a bit pricey for family dining although they do offer a small menus for kids, nothing for seniors.
Our bartender Trent was the best bartender we've ever had.  He's hospitable, kind, engaging and funny.  Will definitely return to bodovino if Trent is working.  Thank you.
Never disappointed.  Nice buffet and good service. Nice choices. Restaurant is clean.

I purchased a washer and dryer in store. They only had the dryer in stock and let me know it was going to be 2-7 business days until the washer was available for pick up. I choose to wait to pick up the dryer when the other unit was there, and was told it would be marked appropriate and moved to the side for me. 

After not hearing from them for a week I called to check on the status of the washer to find out they couldn't find them. The lady then called back and said she has the washer but not the dryer and no other stores had it in stock. She never apologized or assumed responsibility for the fact that they lost an entire dryer I already paid for. The best she could do was to offer to refund me the money and make a special order with an estimate date of 2-3 weeks. 

I eventually talked with a manager and I had to ask for a floor model to try and resolve this issue. I just had wished there was an ounce of customer service and responsibility for losing a dryer, but a lesson was learned. If you paid for it and it's available just take it with you!!

The place I go to do all my printing needs. If it's fast simple photo prints, color prints for birthdays, schools banners and home framing needs. All I do here. Usually they have plenty of service people so you never wait too long. My only "complaint" will be that some of the staff can be not helpful let's say that. If I didn't have my graphic designer background and if I didn't knew paper comes in different thicknesses and the sizes I need to be specific in my requests for certain prints, it would have been very difficult for me to do that. Some of the staff is wonderfully helpful and knowledgeable and some aren't. Maybe they are just having a tough day who knows. I give them the benefit of the doubt but feel bad for those that don't get helped when they need to print certain items that need knowledge

I was so bummed the other night! I've really enjoyed this place and wanted to support them since the shutdown. We went in there the other night at 9:30 and the sign said they were closing at 11. I even asked if they were closing early and they said at 10. Trying to be mindful of their time we hurried and got our order to go. My roommate tipped them 25.00 for a 35.00 meal. We got home and our order was all messed up, burgers over done. Chicken was suppose to have cheese and bacon on it...nothing. We asked for grilled mushroom and onions on our burger.

This store is horrible. They will have items price tagged but they never go by that price. And they say that they won't honor it even though that's what I'm the freaking item. I tried to
Buy a hat it has a clearance tag on it and the lady told me "nope. No way. That's way to cheap for this hat." Uhhhhhh ok then why did you price tag it for that!! That's just an example of one time they did this. They have done it to me several Times. I will no longer shop here. Ever.

I've dined in and ordered a catered meal for several and both instances were phenomenal.  I do not usually like smoked poultry but their smoked turkey is something that I crave!  The beef selections and pork options are also tasty.  I plan to order ahead next time I have a large group of company over for dinner.

Well, this visit wasn't good at all. I ordered the Buffalo chicken salad and my wife ordered the Sante Fe chicken salad. We also ordered onion rings. I ordered an IPA as well. 
The beer that was brought to me was dark and not an IPA. I drank about a third of it and Lexie, our server, came back to the table with another beer, which was an IPA. That was fixed.
The salads were very small and there was actually only one decent piece of chicken in the salad. Everything else was hard crunchy breading pieces and I couldn't even stab most of it with my fork. So it was nothing but that and lettuce and a sprinkle of Parmesan. Th wife's salad was okay, but for $13 they were not big enough. 
We didn't get our onion rings until we asked Lexie about them. Those were good, but 6 of them for $7 was ridiculous. The sauce was nice and spicy. We weren't charged for the rings since they were late coming out.
I appreciate them having. $10 credit for Veterans.
Lexie did a fine job as a server.

I had the brisket salad. The brisket was very tender and tasty. I ordered the pulled pork to go for my daughter. I was very surprised   that they packaged the meat separate so that it would make the meat soggy. Very nice touch and the portions were big

Good Texas style BBQ.  Great service, great sides, fast to bring you food.  Don't miss the "chocolate sheet cake".  It was one of the best pieces of cake I have had.  Place is good looking as well.  Fair prices to boot!

I've been here twice and service is horrid. I went in around 12:00. Busiest time of day. Only two elderly woman working. The woman at the front counter was incredibly rude to the customers in front of me, when they asked for their drink before sitting down. When I finally got my food the burger was cold, onion rings cold and never got my drink. When I went to ask for my drink they wouldn't even acknowledge me, and were incredibly rude to the customer next to me when she said her drink tasted really bad, and she wanted another. Honestly, it wasn't worth the 6 dollars so I just finished quick and left. I get it. This is a Walmart restaurant. But I'm done. It's disgusting and they were rude.

Absolutely the worst service EVER!
Waited TWO MONTHS for our order and when delivery came it 
WASN'T ALL THERE ! ! Ashley needs to get it together too many other stores to buy from..We are DONE!

I was a boy last time I had Basque food. Epi's is homey, charming, friendly - and that's just the owner Chris, who is the daughter and 4th generation restaurateur here. I didn't notice much Basque food, but what they did, they executed perfectly!  We enjoyed a generous portion of halibut, perfectly cooked and with a rich lobster sauce (w/ chunks of lobster) to top it off. We also had the medallions of beef, tender as "butta" and sporting a silky brandy pepper sauce. Fluffy rice, crispy calamari app. And a nice bottle of Malbec made our meal complete w/no room for dessert. Service was first class, server was charming and informative and gregarious Chris was working the room like a mother hen tending to her brood. Crowded, buzzing and busy - everyone still had time to smile, chat and serve one of the best meals we've had in a long while!!

We've been going to Goodwood for the past five years. Never had a bad meal there. The smoked turkey breast is moist and flavorful. The pulled pork--moist! I've had the salmon which was incredible- moist and full of flavor. The burgers are cooked perfectly.. medium.  We've done take out and have had no issues with regards to the flavor, the heat of the food when we got it home. All good!  Their onion rings... TO DIE FOR.

Fast and friendly customer service. I needed to exchange a mop I bought online because it did not work. I was able to make the exchange easily. My only wish is that there were clear signs pointing in the right direction for returns and exchanges. I first waited in the line up front and then was told to go to the desk in the back. Then I waited at the desk in the back but was told to go to a different desk. So if you have a return or exchange just go straight to the very back left of the store to the desk marked service desk. I was not the only one who got confused because on the way out I heard the front cashier say to another woman to go to the back desk for returns after she had waited in a long line up front.

Had to cancel my membership after being on their wellness program for 2 years. Things got worse with every visit. I am not doubting their Veterinary knowledge, but their customer service is terrible. I understand the times we are in right now, but being in sales myself I am thankful to have been working every day. I am blessed to have my job and appreciate my customers I get to work with daily.  This has become more about their monthly fees than caring for their clients. Sad actually. Don't know if its just a reflection of all the people moving here or the frustration with all the issues we are dealing with currently.  I can literally walk to this clinic, but will be taking my 2 sons elsewhere in the future. 
Unfortunte how this place treats it's so called members.

Saw Star Wars in the 21+ lounge w/ wait service

So parking sucks, no matter where you park it's a walk to the theater.

The theater itself is very nice. You walk in and feel transported back to a time when people saw shows in beautiful theaters - like real shows! 

The waitstaff was very nice and efficient.

The food.... honestly I expected to pay more than value BUT this was just awful. We were expecting much, like I said, but we ordered the macaroni and the chicken tenders. My macaroni tasted like Kraft and the chicken tenders were a joke. The mozzarella stick things weren't cooked at all on the inside and it was like biting into crunchy string cheese... for almost $50 I can confidently saw I was disappointed! 

Our movie screen blacked out 3x during the movie - again we saw Star Wars - and missing scenes just isn't good. After the 3rd time my husband and I spoke with the theater manager, who was wonderful and definitely went out of his way to compensate us.

Yes, we will be back BUT can sure I'll let everyone know not to order in theater food...

We just moved here from Portland, where we regularly happily paid $50 to eat in a theater but the food was deserving. Step up your game Village Cinema.

Really, really good food and a nice variety in their offerings.

Immaculately clean place and very polite employees.  Right up their with Chick-Fil-A.  But I like Culvers a bit more as they have much more variety to their menu.

Double deluxe hamburger (opted with no cheese) was well cooked and the meat tasted very good.  Cheese tends to hide the meat flavor.  Potato/bacon soup was also excellent.

My wife had the fish sandwich and a cup of chili.  Thumbs up from her on those.

I traveled for years in the mid-west and enjoyed Culver's there.  Glad one is close-by in Meridian.  

Worth the drive from Middleton and an excellent excuse to drop in for an early lunch when going to the Boise Co-Op or Trader Joe's.

Nothing better than finding a local, one of a kind restaurant.  The food looked great and an excellent rating on Yelp so had to give it a shot.  Was expecting a fancy place based on the ratings but was a little quaint house. We were early for our reservation but the staff immediately took care of us and set up a table.  Started with mushrooms in a garlic and butter sauce and the ham croquetas. Both were amazing. Mushrooms cooked perfectly and so tender. That garlic butter sauce was just mild and tasty. The croquetas was also not a heavy ham taste. Crispy outside, moist inside. Great start. Next was a clam soup special. Also delicately flavored with a little spicy kick. Not a thick soup which I like. Again another great dish. For the main course I got the sizzling garlic shrimp. Had this once in Europe and thought it was a Portugal dish not Basque. Again this was great.  A little bread left from the mushrooms was so great to sip up some of the broth in the bottom.  We got the baby squid in ink sauce to share. The squid  legs were cut off and stuffed with some other goodness inside the body and then cooked in the ink sauce. This was the only dish that was so so for me. Way too much sauce and the ink sauce was a little sweet and needed something a little savory added for me. Hard to really taste the squid with so much sauce.  Would've been great with less sauce and maybe some type of pasta possibly.  All in all this was a great surprise find and the little house made it a fun place to check out.  Give it a shot if you're in Boise.

I am a sucker for anything new. New flavors of chips, new drink flavors, and new restaurants.

The exception is Dill Pickle flavored Chips. I cant bring myself to try that one. Culvers is the newest fast food place to darken the landscape in Meridian.

They seem to come on the heels of Freddie's offering Frozen Custard like Freddie's does.  If you have not yet had a chance to try frozen custard, you need to do this right now. 

Frozen custard is way better than regular ice cream. Frozen Custard is very creamy and does not seem to cause as much of an issue with my daughters lactose intolerance for some reason.

Today, I decided to give Culvers a shot and get a burger and fries from them.

I started with the fries because I love good fries. Culver's fries are crinkle cut which Im sorry to say is the best thing I can say about them. Crinkle cut fries are the best. Im not sure if its because the crinkles hold salt better, they get crispier or what, but they are my favorite fry.

Here is where the story though is over for their fries. They are tasteless. My guess is that they are straight out of a bag of frozen fries. On my scale of 1-10, I give them a -4.

Now on to the burger. It is a common and ordinary burger cooked on a flat top. My wife and daughter said its pretty similar to Arctic Circle. If you like their burgers, you will probably like these.

The burger has almost no flavor at all. The meat is greasy and...well there is just no much of anything good I can say here. The only flavor I got from eating it was the bacon. 

I would rank it right up there as one of the worst fast food burgers I have had. If you want something similar that has a decent flavor to it, go to Freddie's. Freddies are not great either, but way better than these.

On my 1-10 scale, Id give it a -2

Finally got a chance to try Izumi. I live nearby but had been hesitant to come and try what this place could offer. I am glad we came on a Friday night after a long day of work. Got seated right away, friendly staffs.  We got a table that could fit 6 people, there are 4 of us; in front of the sushi bar. Glad we got that big table because we ordered sushi-sashimi for 4 and it came on 2 boats. The main boat is huge! The design is really entertaining; bowl full of ice with some light inside, orchids, some other fake flowers/decor, bamboo and some of the sashimi hanging like on sail boat. The 2nd boat is smaller with some rolls. The fish were good size and amazingly fresh. They did not serve too much rice, which is great. Fish/rice ratio was perfect. We also ordered udon for my son who doesn't really enjoy sushi yet. Udon was ok, not a fan. I wish they had some Japanese ramen on the menu. Overall, the sushi was awesome! We will try the hibachi next time.

Loved going to this place. My son is super scared of getting his hair cut, and he is kind of hard to deal with. Debbie was very patient and did a great job for how fussy my son was. I would recommend this place to anyone with kids. The staff are friendly and awesome.

I've been eating Chip Cookies since they arrived in Boise in a little discreet location off of Chinden. It was amazing back then even as it is to this day! They are so good, their cookies are a little underbaked in the middle but not too doughy. Let's just say they are perfectly cooked. I love how you can get these to your door almost any time of day, for $10 plus delivery fee and if you'd like to tip the driver. I say do it, I've done it more than a handful of times. I LOVE how they finally made their biscoff a full time menu item because it is the bomb. I absolutely loved their fruity pebble one and their peppermint one they had in December. I will say though, I wish they had a way better rewards system because I could have probably gotten free boxes by now! Lol

Yea! A new restaurant.  But the fist night it was closed.  After 8:00.  So back the next night.   Tried the sampler.  I hope your on a diet.  The portions very very very small. The corn bread was about the size of a quarter and uncooked.  The order was missing coleslaw.  And the food was not so good. I guess I'll be waiting for the next restaurant to open as I won't return.

Came for lunch, ordered the drunken noodle lunch special and added the combo protein. I would rank this the best drunken noodles I've had at any Thai spot I've visited, and drunken noodles is a must order when I eat thai. Food came out quickly, service was superb.
Expectations vs reality....  Like come on next time won't be ordering while nannying from her the 2 stars is because I always order my favorite which is the vegetarian sandwich and it's always bomb.

Ordered food for pickup-2 chicken tender meals were supposed to have 4 tenders, fries and coleslaw-got 3 pieces of chicken in each and no coleslaw.  Chicken was good, fried pickles were way to salty.  Disappointed in not getting all the food when the order was over $50.

JUST BE HONEST!!! MOST CUSTOMERS WILL APPRECIATE IT!!!   I purchased a couch and coffee table 11/18/20 (pretty simple) I was told from the get go delivery would prob. be delayed until the end of Dec, maybe 1st wk of Jan. (no prob. I'm not in need just replacing) I didn't receive any calls/emails/text so I happened to be near the store & popped in to inquire (beginning of Jan 2021) I was told we are waiting for my couch to be shipped from the Tacoma warehouse & delivery should be around Feb. 2. Well again no contact so I called the store (on Feb 1 almost 11 weeks from purchase date) & was again told we are waiting for the couch to be shipped from the Tacoma warehouse & delivery should be around Feb. 19.  Well now I can't wrap my brain around why it's taking so long to ship a couch from Tacoma why is it just sitting there for so long!!!  So I called Ashley customer care instead, only to finally be informed the couch is actually on back order!! (Which I'm ok-ish with) I  don't know why the store feels its necessary to make up bs lies. Just tell me my couch is on b/o rather than lie to my face! The lies don't make me feel better, truth is much more appreciated! This Tacoma warehouse story was givin by 2 different associates so this may be their "go to" customer appeasement story!!

I'm a bit hesitant to give this place a full blown review simply because I just bought a bed and mattress last night and it hasn't been technically delivered to our house yet but I will review what has happened thus far in my experience. So this review is extremely subjective.

My wife and I were immediately greeted by Del, who was extremely helpful in helping us figure out what we were looking for. We had never put much thought into what I wanted in a bed (i.e. style, firmness, the coolness of the mattress, lumbar support, etc.) but Del was patient and even educated us on what exactly we were looking for to meet our needs.

At the same time, prices were extremely affordable. We came in with a budget, mentioned it to Del, and he helped us stay within those numbers. Del even included the box spring and sheets as part of the purchase package.

I highly recommend this as a location to purchase a bed. Since a bed/mattress purchase happens very rarely, it's great to have amazing customer service that looks to help you find what you need and at the same time, look out for you as you try to stay within a budget.

Refused to serve me and my friends in the drive through. They claimed that "scooters/unicycles do NOT count as vehicles". We did not see any signs about needing a vehicle in the drive through anyway. IK McDonalds doesnt care about missing out on $5 but come on. Honestly I think the workers there will take any excuse to be lazy.

Run as far away as you can from this place. I stopped here after a meeting in the area just to get my gel polish removed quickly. Big mistake! I was there for more than an hour and half, charged for a full manicure ($30!!!!???!!) and literally all the girl did was wrap my nails in foil and scrape my polish off. And, my nails are totally destroyed! At one point, my hands were soaked in a red dye and I left with red and purple hands. 

Beyond the ridiculous mark up and extremely slow service, the woman who did my nails said commented on my wedding ring and actually said "I used to have one like that but it was about twice as big as that." So rude. Terrible service from the moment I walked in (pushy receptionist, asking for my phone number multiple times despite me not being from there and stopping for a "quick" polish removal) to paying $30 for shredded nails and red-stained hands. It does not get worse.

Tried Sarah's out for the first time, as I usually go to the other local bagel place. I won't be back to Sarah's. 

I'm a huge fan of flavored cream cheese. The honey walnut and herb cc were terrible. The flavor was so overpowering but not in a good way (some herb they use ruined the whole thing). I couldn't even eat the bagels that got those on them. I think the Hawaiian bagel itself is prob pretty tasty, but not with the honey walnut on it. I also prefer a chewier bagel, and these were not. 

I went on a Sunday morning and there was only one person working. It took a while to get a few bagels with cream cheese as there were multiple people in front of me. The woman working hustled, but she could only make sandwiches so fast. Seems odd they wouldn't have at least two people on a weekend.
Ordered via Doordash and enjoyed it!  Great food, right prices, and fast delivery ..... recommend for anyone.

I ordered Cafe Zupas for lunch on Doordash and was really impressed! I ordered the "choose 2" and got the Thai Steak Salad and the Turkey Avacado Club sandwich. The salad was a mixed greens salad with veggies and yummy pieces of tender steak. The dressing was delicious and the salad was super fresh. I was left wishing I had ordered the whole salad instead of the half because it was so good! The sandwich was full sized and loaded with turkey and avacado. It also was super fresh, the bread was soft, and it was great quality.  I will definitely be ordering more Cafe Zupas for lunch!!

Soooo...: having moved during the pandemic. There haven't been very many chances to eat out and find a new local Mexican Restaurant.
But today we had a wonderful lunch here and it may very well become my "go to" place.

Unfortunately the wait staff hadn't arrived and the manager was waiting tables... but he did well and the food was excellent.

The carnitas is wasn't ready to serve so I got a Pollo & Creme burrito (1st one ever) and it was so good!  This maybe my new favorite burrito.

My spouse got the pollo mole, which was seasoned well but a touch too sweet. A little hot sauce helped with that!

I can't wait to go back!
Adorable, easy to schedule, cute little cars that they get to sit in. The rates are great, overall a very easy and great experience.

Where do I start. I bought a sofa bed from them in January when I recurved I noticed the mattress was short I called so a tech could come check and he agreed it was short and would have someone call to resolve the matter. Never got a call. So I called Ashley back and they said he had put in the notes that it wasn't short and the matter had been resolved. I was so upset because nothing had been fixed. You pay all this money and you want what you paid for. They sent him back out and he agreed again it was too short. A couple days later I get a call from Ashley saying the mattress will be replaced. Great news!! A month goes by and I never get a call saying it has arrived and it will be delivered or nothing. I call Ashley once again and they look into it. Come to find out it has been sitting in the warehouse no one called and told me and it's not being delivered I have to take other mattress to them and pick new one up. Long story short I get the new mattress and it is the exact same size as the other one!!!!!! I'm so over this store and their customer service!!!

Taco trucks...a taco lovers haven for those little succulent meat filled treasures. Quite possibly the most social food on the planet, arguably the most delicious, and you can get them damn near anywhere. But the best come from small venues such as this. Taco El Rey. A standard taco truck nestled in a back alley between a nursery and feed store. And it makes total sense. All the hard working landscapers flocking to this truck for lunch...it was a no brainer to give it a shot...and it delivered.

We were in the mood for tacos...like real tacos not the hipster trendy turds floating around. So I drove over, stepped up to the truck and ordered a slew of pastor, adobado, and carnitas. The craving was real at this point and just as fast it came it was filled. 14 tacos down the hatch...no regrets...no reservations...just satisfaction. The Pastor was the favorite closley followed by the carnitas. All were just as expected, jucy and delicious. I was pleased to see they give you the authentic condiments for Street tacos...red, Verde, and avocado salsas with onion and cilantro, and a slice of radish. All were good but the avocado took it for the win. They use correct sized #10 tacos doubled up as well which was great to see. Not made in house but forgivable. 

Tacos El Ray is a solid choice to fill your street taco craving. Is it the best? No, it's not. But does it need to be? It's here, and it's sufficient..and it IS delicious so give it a shot and eat those suckers standing up the way they were intended.
A very good place. It was a little crowded and the sushi bar backed up but the meal was excellent. Our waitress (Winnie) did a fantastic job.
I've been going here for years. I've had nothing but great experiences. Sometimes they get busy but I'm understanding and gracious. They genuinely care about about my pets.

I've been super blessed to have Danae do my hair for years.  She was the first professional to ever do my hair, and she would have been the only person if we hadn't of moved too far away for regular visits.  I have very fine, thin hair and she is awesome at giving it cute, trendy cuts that work well with my lifestyle.  And I have always loved and appreciated her ability to understand hair color--she is amazing! She is also great at keeping hair healthy and happy.  On top of all her skills, she has one of the largest, most loving hearts ever, and it shows in how happy everyone is at the hair studio and in how well everyone works together.  I love my time spent with her.

Phenomenal moving experience! Joshua and his team just relocated us to Boise from out of state and we could have been more pleased with the overall moving job. KJ, Jackio and Tyson were wonderful to work with, extremely polite, took great care of our household belongings and over communicated all throughout the process. if you need reliable movers for the West, we highly recommend VCM. This is our 6th move and by far the best ever! Thanks again Joshua and Team!
I've eaten there numerous times..!!!... Always GREAT Food ... Great service.!!! The prices are great for any meal you order ... Highly recommended.!!!
That wasn't great sushi, not even good. Bad rice, bad nori, low quality fish. The needed to have more creative rolls with good sauces. Not cheap.

4000.00 later I have dentures that ABSOLUTELY don't fit and they ruined one of the few real teeth I had left. Now I'm missing another tooth I couldn't afford to lose.  Really poor decision on my part to spend my money here. After they have your money the workmanship is awful and way below expectations. This place really is all about taking your money. Now I have no money to try to get my missing tooth repaired  and to try to get dentures that fit. In the consultation before I paid in full I told Ivy my expectations - she said oh sure no problem. Now they always blow me off and have an excuse why I can't have dentures that fit, I have had them in the past, and why they can't repair the tooth they ruined. I'M MISSING A FREAKING TOOTH NOW!

We had dinner here on 8/14/2020. Kayden was our waiter and he was excellent. This was among some of the best basque food we have ever experienced. The chef even brought out some of our courses and answered all our questions during our visit. We will definitely be back.

Rude manager and he gave me my mashed potatoes FINALLY after messing up my order four or five times through the drive thru and guess what? They put BEAN JUICE on them instead of GRAVY. That was obviously on purpose!
Solid job done! Very professional and speedy. Worth every cent. Helped us move all our furniture and nothing was scratched nor a doorway scuffed. This is the company you want moving your household.

I ordered a grilled chicken sandwich.  They must have been trying to prank me and used a piece of rubber colored to look like chicken.  I took one bite and tried to give the rest of the chicken to my dog. He didn't want it.  That says it all.

Update. It's been 15 mins since my one bite of that mystery chicken and my stomach is churning like a top load washing machine. Burping and just feel gross and not well.

Never Again! Norco ditched me forever when I need their help! They do not stand behind their product or their service. They will not lift a finger to help when I literally have no other options due to warranty restrictions. I'm very disappointed and would not make the same mistake twice! If I could do it again I would not choose them! STAY AWAY!!!
Absolutely have fantastic salads and soups! Great place to eat. Very friendly associates.

Omg, love love love. BEST cookies ever! My son asks for these every weekend. He eats his and always asks for mine. The cookies themselves are huge and taste great. Did I mention how big they are?! Amazing.

Another successful to go order from Goodwood! We first tried goodwood at their Boise location while house hunting, and now that we're here in meridian, we had a craving and placed a to go order! The food was great and lasted us 3 days! We got a full rack of baby back ribs, the 3 meat combo with burnt ends, a sausage and chicken, loaded mashed taters and beans, and fries. Everything was delicious. Loooove Goodwood! Will be a regular stop whenever we crave bbq!!

They over charge you and refuse coupons on meals. I have proof that the coupon works on our order and Matt tonight denied the coupon and we only got 1 side on the fish vs 2 like last night. My husband had to give up a side for a drink unlike last night. Not happy at all. I will be calling corporate over this in the morning. They also forgot the roll on my husbands dinner.
Was recommended this place by a friend. Great service! Their burgers were SO good. It was made with fresh ingredients and super tasty. The fries were amazing. We will definitely be back!
Excellent service. Got our food quickly after we ordered and not disappointed. Can't wait to come back to Meridian to come back and eat here. Below you will find some pictures of what we ordered.
Great tasting food I like spicy so I got the tai hot curry the flavors were outstanding

The bagels here are so delicious! They taste very fresh, and there are quite a lot of variety to choose from. Be prepared to wait a while in line, and you will not be greeted until they are ready to greet you.

Well, Yelp made me give a star to this store. I would've given it a zero star if I could. They are absolutely ridiculous! The customer service is nonexistent and I ordered something to be delivered for a week and it kept getting pushed back and back and back....endlessly. The are so rude and hung up your phone of you try to call them about the issue. Never shop here. PLEASE GO SOMEWHERE ELSE

Kinda pathetic. Ate here because it was close to Tru the hotel. Looks nice and menu has really nice pics but the actual food not so much. The salad greens were wilted, asked for no cheese, came with cheese. Entree was so boring and bland looking. While the pork was tender it was certainly salty. Baked potato was something you would get in a cafeteria. Small and wrinkled, not warm. Sat at the bar and while the server was pleasant the service was lacking. Just blah. This place is likely fine for a drink and app but not dinner.

Very underwhelming experience. Our "normal" football bar was closed so we decided to try other local places. Website said they opened at 9. Google and Facebook said they opened at 10. Door says they open at 11. Found out they opened at 10:30. COVID menu leaves a bit to be desired. A few beers were out but we couldn't get a beer list. At noon on football Sunday there were about 8 people in the place. We left after a few drinks and appetizer (that was nearly $40 tab). We both really wanted to like it but just felt "blah" with our experience. Wine glasses were very dirty. Know it was just water marks but shows lack of effort.
Best salad bar and steaks in the Treasure Valley. They also do a great job of takeaway for those who prefer that option.

Update: on the plus side I wasn't plagued with traffic noise in my room this stay.  The tub was not oversized by any stretch of the imagination but larger than some hotels and the overflow was not working so I was able to have the water a little deeper.  (Major challenge getting out of the tub without the rails but I lived)

Downgrade.  Second or third stay here and never have they gotten my reservations right .  Front desk person was very polite so that helped.

I specified accessible room facing parking lot.  I wake with a cane so don't need a roll in shower but do prefer bars at toilet and shower.

Front desk did nit have room location I requested so still traffic noise but nit as bad.  However they put me in a *hearing* accessible room.

I have a spine injury and two busted up knees.  My hearing is beyond excellent.  

Probably my last stay at this property.  The cafe is now open for breakfast but I need to check out before it opens in the morning so won't be able to finally try it. 

Oh yeah... the light is hitting the headboard and it has gif knows what on it.  I'm going to go with headprints Despite painful back and complaining knees I'm getting out the Clorox wipes!

It's a short stay.  I had to change rooms last time too otherwise would ask fir room change

If I biff it in the bathroom I will just scream like a banshee

Update:  this is for the person/people who designed the room layout: placing the TV in s location where you can't watch it from the bed and anchoring it there was a major oversight as was the 18" clearance on the side of the bed that you can see part of the TV from.  This is the kind of thing that makes the engineer in my cranky.

Went here to play some pool. Got a shot of whiskey neat. Got my drink and there was a giant fly in it. I tell the bartender and he acted annoyed, poured the whiskey out of the glass, refilled in the same glass and hands it back. The fly was still in the glass. Disgusting. 

Since I live close I decided to give them another shot and go play pool with a buddy. We order beer from bottles. The beer wasn't even in a fridge. Pulls it out of a case sitting on the ground. We play pool a bit and he has the gall to come over and say we need to order more drinks if we wanna stay playing pool. That was the last straw, never going back.  I'm all for a dive bar vibe but have a little pride in your establishment.

Usually go to the Popeyes in Boise and I will from now on. Went to this Popeyes on Fairview and Eagle on Wednesday night, it was quiet, not busy. Ordered our usual chicken tenders and they were slightly pink and slimy in the middle. IMO chicken should not have any pink. Took them up to the counter and they cooked us a new batch. Second batch was the same, probably needed three more minutes in the fryer. Expressed my concern about it being under cooked again and was dismissed. The girl at the register said that they cook to 160 (165 is what's actually safe for chicken) and since their oil is 300+ degrees there was no way it could be under cooked. Ate our sides and tossed twenty bucks worth of chicken in the trash. Won't be returning.

EPIs fabulous calamari with their sauce. I even got their recipe and try to reproduce it at home. Nothing like the original
Try the halibut with lobster sauce
Did someone say bread pudding

I usually love this place...the fresh choices and good customer service; however, I just stopped in there and it was so dirty and the service was not great even though there were a bunch of people working behind the counter. The juices were empty; I asked them to fill the one I wanted. It was approx 3:45 in the afternoon so not a busy meal time. Disappointed.

I purchased a sofa table and picked it up at the warehouse. Got it home and saw that the front corner is cracked. Called the store the next day and asked about exchanging it for another one. I was told that they couldn't do that, that they need to send a craftsman out to the house to look at it. Which means I will have to take time off from work, etc. NOT HAPPY. I've called again to question this and was again told they would contact me to schedule something. It's been over a week now and nobody has contacted me. I just want to exchange the table. It's a brand new table - I don't want it repaired, I want it replaced or just give me a refund.
It's a shame because I'm remodeling my house but I can guarantee you that I will not purchase a single thing from this company ever again.

Best hibachi grill I've been to in years, maybe the best ever. I took my 6-year-old son, who's been talking about it ever since (and says he wants to be a hibachi chef!) The food was very good, which isn't always the case when there's so much emphasis on showmanship.

Well I guess the kids would have fun no matter how long they got to play I was disappointed that we got there at 6 and we're told that they were changing the hours for the evening and closing at 7 instead of 8. Make sure that you call ahead of time if you're headed out for dinner and want to drop the kids off. Overall it looks clean and is reasonably priced.
Ordered one spicy chicken sandwich with no pickles. Got the sandwich with pickles. Chick fil a would never do this, I'll eat there instead :)

Their chicken fried steak keeps me coming back more than I would like to admit. The wait can be pretty long to dine in (at least before all this covid started up), so I'd recommend calling in ahead. Now, you can place your order ahead of time, pull up, text the number, and they will bring your food right to your car.

Valley Custom Moving is a great, locally owned company. The guys were so nice and personable. They made our move easy and stress free at a very reasonable, affordable price. They were honest and fair with their quote with no surprises at the end (I've heard horror stories with other companies). They took great care of our items and were even able to move our piano into tight quarters. We're extremely impressed with them, will definitely recommend VCM to family and friends.

My 90 year old grandmother wanted some corned beef and cabbage. I see Beef O'Brady's has it and I'm close so I get some to go. What she got was a clamshell full of fries 2 red potatoes 2 slices of what looks like breakfast ham (it was barely corned beef I tried it) griddled until it was shoe leather, and a sweet roll no cabbage what so ever. I call O'Brady's talk to the manager explain how unacceptable this food is and if I was sitting in their restaurant there's no way I would be paying for that meal. He takes my phone number and says he'll review it and get back to me and now here I am with no call back so paid 15 bucks for garbage food and I got blown off.

Tried this place on a whim and were not disappointed! They were very busy so we sat at the bar. The bartender was solo serving bar customers and preparing all drinks for the  whole restaurant and super slammed but he worked his butt off and still gave us great service. Drinks were generous and food (sushi) exceeded our expectations. The portions of sashimi were a lot bigger than many other places. We're on our way back there now! We will probably sit at the bar - we enjoyed the last experience. I'll have to get the bartender's name this time.

What once began as a personalized landing spot for dental care in early days, unfortunately today is operating more so as a volume shop with less personalized time for/with clients and more focused time for increasing the business' revenue stream.  The expansion of the physical office space has brought more than additional care rooms, money appears to be at the top of the care priority and less time is now dedicated to the relationship with patients.  The actually dental work has also suffered, seeing routine changes in chair sides and the speed of care appearing to be a measurement vs. a high quality end result.   Finished dental work all too often is not finished - just completed and made workable.

Questions to ask your dentist:
Do you have routine follow up in place at your end to confirm if the patient is doing well post dental procedures ?
Do you dedicate front end time to discuss options (pro & con) of solutions to existing dental pain/issues ?
Are there protocols in place to be proactive regarding patient history of medication needs  ?

"Bigger is not always better" or so the saying goes - in this particular instance it all so sadly true.
Great food!! If I'm stuck at home it's a great meal. Will to it again.  Food was hot and large amounts!!

Seriously the best facial I've ever had. Laticia was amazing! I've been having hormonal pregnancy breakouts and now a few weeks after my facial, my skin is doing soooo much better. It's actually pretty amazing! Don't waste money on a facial elsewhere. The included arm and leg massage is also great (especially when pregnant)!

The owner of this company truly cares about the quality delivered on behalf of her clients. She has beautiful arrangements at affordable rates.  They are super friendly and eager to help you with your creation.

Save yourself money and call her directly as apposed to a 3rd party site.
Great guys, very nice and prompt. Did a great job lifting our antique and very heavy piano.

I love Thai food. I was excited to try this place out, and I went for lunch with my coworker. The parking lot was full enough, I was rather excited to see how popular this place was. My expectation high! 

Well...when we got our food, my coworker and I both were rather unimpressed. I ordered Pad Prik King beef, and she ordered some sort of chicken dish, but the dishes were pretty blend compared to what we've experienced at a good Thai restaurant. The staff was friendly enough, but I'm not sure (and I'm sorry to say) if I would go back there again.

I have to say I was disappointed! I only had sushi, so I can't speak for the hibachi....but people were raving about this place, and I don't think it lived up to the hype. I will say it has a good atmosphere and fun drinks and the Firecracker Roll is a must try. But everything else was just so-so. There are DEFINATELY BETTER PLACES FOR SUSHI IN THE BOISE/MERIDIAN AREA, THAT'S FOR SURE!

Definitely one of the best Thai restaurants in Boise! 
Our server Benz recommended entrees based on my request and couldn't have been anymore happier! 
It's been a struggle to find pad thai in Boise (that's edible). 
Green Curry was so well flavored and had just the rt amount of spice!

Everyone there was super polite and helpful! We were even able to get our prescription there instead of going to another pharmacy. However, the wait was so long. It was longer than I have ever waited at any of the other locations.

Food was tasty and hot, but service was horrible. 
Went on Sunday 8/8/21 at 10am with a mobile order. I chose dine-in. Walked to the door and it was locked. I was confused because the posted hours said that they were open and there wasn't a closed sign on the door. 
I hopped back into my car and drove through the drive through. I was the second person in line. I mentioned my mobile order and they said to drive up, but still there was a car in front of me. I waited 9 minutes (yes, timed) before getting to the window. 
First thing that I asked for was the manager. I asked why the delay and she stated that the first customer was waiting on fresh biscuits. I said why not have them pull forward and take care of me? She said that actually my order was waiting on fresh biscuits too. 
1. I said how would I know that sitting in line for 9 minutes with no communication? 
2. I have placed my mobile order over 15 minutes ago and the biscuits couldn't have taken that long. 
I also mentioned that the door was locked even though the app allowed me to place a dine-in order. She made some excuse about lack of staff, but again, I asked, how would I know that from the outside? How difficult would it be to tape a sign on the door?
There wasn't a receipt in my bag, so how can I complete the survey? Mobile orders need receipts too. I asked her for the corporate number and she handed me a blank receipt with the number on the back. I called them but they were closed and no voicemail, so I let a message on their corporate website to contact me, but they never did. 
This manager may be on top of her staff and getting the food prepared, but if she isn't considering service from the customer's point-of-view, then she is failing as a manager. 
1. She could have placed a note on the door that the dining area was closed. 
2. She could have asked both the 1st driver and myself to move forward to wait on biscuits, as I was trapped in the lane with cars in front & back and no information provided as to the wait.
This was a horrible customer service experience and no ability to fill out the survey for the free sandwich?
FAIL.

UPDATE. The manager wrote me a nasty message on LinkedIn (stalker much?) where she made many false claims. When I review, I review honestly as you can see I have many more positive reviews than negative on Yelp.  I will proceed to call corporate and see is she can be removed or demoted for her personal attack. I've worked in the service industry for over 20 years and I know that the customer isn't always right, but also that she should have been more accommodating for her location's bad service.
I love this pizza place. It's so good and clean. The staff is so nice and helpful. The prices are fantastic I would go here over anywhere else any day
Excellent barbecue! Went twice this week and had the burnt ends, ribs and pulled pork. Nice bbq sauce selection and friendly staff. Great TV placement to enjoy and game while you eat.

Went here along (10 years ago). If you're into or interested in experiencing Basque cuisine and visiting the Treasure Valley this is the place for you. I'm ordinarily not a fan of lamb, but aside from the Dromoland Castle in Ireland, this is the best I've had.

Food was great. Server at our table was friendly. Place was clean and way nicer inside than any other Sizzler I had been in to in other states. 

The low stars is simply due to the fact that literally EVERY SINGLE dish, plate, bowl, silverware I picked up was filthy. Not one or two pieces, which lets be honest can happen in any restaurant, but literally everything given to us at our table and everything at the salad bar. I went through about ten plates at the salad bar before finding the "least" filthy one that was just spotted and didn't have old FOOD and muck all over it. And the silverware all had old crusty food on it. They gotta get the dish washers whether human or machine in check. 

I typically would not put a negative review about a couple of dirty plates or forks but it was so bad I had to do the two stars. Can't believe when they are putting it out for use that no one noticed or didn't feel like correcting. Gross.

For the high price we paid with the types of food we got, I was upset I paid so much to get disgusting utensils and plates with other peoples old food on them.

Tina and staff are amazing! I was struggling to find a place I really liked close to my home and this place fit the bill! From the first day I went with my mom they were so friendly, clean, had a great amount of color and type options (I.e. gel, polish, dip, extras). As with everywhere, they are short staffed often so making an appointment is a must! Although you should make an appt they have quick turnarounds and are very accommodating! 

Now that I've been a few times and had Tina each time, she's the owner, and she is so friendly and warm. She loves to chat and find out about you and your family! She remembers you after one visit and really takes the time and precision to make your nails and experience great!
This is by far our favorite place to eat everything here is good we haven't eaten one bad thing and the service is always great!

When my wife and I think of quality Mexican food we think los mariachis! Hands down the best! We highly recommend their fajitas, jalapeño poppers,
Enchiladas, guacamole and of course a cold Modelo! If you have not been here you are missing out!

While we only lived here for 10 months it was a great apartment - especially if you have a crapload of kitchen stuff. The leasing process was easy and surprisingly so was move out. We picked red tail because they had the 2 story options instead of 3, had garages available and had the best layout of all the apartments we looked at. They also didn't force entertainment packages like many others do. They do have trash valet which at first I thought was unnecessary but soon loved that feature especially for $10 a month. We very seldom had issues with parking and enjoyed using the pool and bbqs throughout the summer. For the most part we had quiet neighbors which made our stay even better. Our apartment was facing the parking lot and it was pretty quiet overall. There is a dog park and great walking paths right behind the complex. While it isn't the cheapest option around it was totally worth it for us.

We were really excited to see this place in The Village, so we popped in for a fresh cookie. First impression was that it was odd to see a whole store front dedicated to a place that serves two flavors of cookies. They had a rolling cart holding tubs filled with dough in the middle of the store behind the counter...not being refrigerated. That should've been a red flag, but somehow it wasn't at the time. We grabbed our overpriced cookies and went to sit on a bench. My husband finished his first and said "Not great and not fully cooked in the center. Too doughy." I agreed. Well, here we are a couple hours later, extremely nauseous and both in and out of the bathroom. Bloating, diarrhea, and nausea- not worth it! AVOID AVOID AVOID!

Loved working with this company. They were on time picking up and even delivered a day earlier than expected. The guys were professional and kind. I would highly recommend them. They moved us from SoCal to North Idaho in just 2 days.
Spend a lot of time hanging out and people watching with my husband and friends! We love Christian and Brit and the gluten free options are to die for!!!!
Really good food and nice atmosphere.  The server forgot our appetizer but when we mentioned it they brought it out to us on the house.  Absolutely recommend!
Very thorough and genuinely care about your health.  They offered great advice, great conversation, and best of all a painless cleaning.

If you've read even one of my reviews before, you know that sweets don't tempt me. I am a savory gal all the way. But HOT DAMN I love Chip Cookies!

Maybe it's because they're affordable? Maybe because I don't have to get myself in a car and drive to pick them up. Maybe it's the delicious cookies. I don't know. But I fully recommend. 

You can get 4 giant cookies for $10. Add $3 bucks more and you can have it delivered to your house until 2:00 am! Have I had it delivered to my house at 11:00 pm while my kids slept...maaaybeee...

The OG chocolate chip is so good. The inside is slightly undercooked, but in the very best way. And it always comes to you warm from the oven. I always get their Chip of the Month, because life is short. The Samoa in September was perfect. The right amount of coconut and caramel. Like a grown up girl scout. I don't love Reese's Pieces, so I didn't love October's Chip of the Month, but if felt festive. Do yourself a favor and get these delivered to your door at least once in your life.

I love Sarah's bagels. When I worked close by, I went in at least once a week. It's such a great value for how many awesome toppings you get, the quality of the bagel, and the sweet customer service. I really like subway, but I would chose this place over almost any sandwich shop. I've brought many people in with me and they love it too!
Back again! Same wonderful experience as the first time. I think I have found my new pedicure place.  Super friendly staff, clean and a wonderful pedicure.

My husband and I were craving Indian food so we decided to try Spice. The name is misleading. Most of it was very bland. We had the palak paneer, chicken vindaloo, and the veggies samosas. The chicken vindaloo was the only thing that wasn't bland but there was hardly any chicken, it was mostly potato. Very disappointing. We won't be back.

The fries were really good. However for the price the burgers and shakes ain't worth it. I was pretty disappointed. Both the burger and shake I got were very bland tasting. It would be worth more of your time to go to McDonald's or Burger King and get a cheaper combo than the outrageous price I paid for this mediocre food.

I have had two tans now from Bronze Yourself and they have both been amazing! They lasted over a week on me. Jamie is great- she is so knowledgeable about spray tanning and advises you how to make the most out of your tan. I was so comfortable with her. Looking forward to my next tan!
LOVE EATING HERE! You are able to live like it's 2019! All you Karen's and Dave's stay away this is an awesome place where we don't need your negativity

Food and service is fabulous! We went for Father's Day weekend and enjoyed our dinner but unfortunately they don't tend to the restrooms as the toilets are filthy with bacteria growing inside the bowl, no soap for washing my hands and the sink had not been scrubbed for who knows how long. I would not let my children use the restroom after I was done. Whoever is charge of cleaning needs to be put on notice. Hopefully their bathroom is not a reflection of what the back kitchen looks like.
A fun pla e to go on a date with your person. Dinner and a show! Not bad rolls and food as well.

The theater is very, very nice and the seats are quite comfortable.  We took advantage of the VIP 21+ seating and this is where our experience went south.

We had purchased the tickets online and when we got to the theater, there were people in our seats.  We talked to the manager and apparently something happened with Fandango and screwed up not only our tickets, but several other people's tickets as well.

I coined this as "we got Fandango'd"

The manager was very polite and got us taken care of.  We thought things would get better, but they didn't.

The movie started and the servers kept walking in front of us handing out food orders and taking orders..  This went on for at least 25 minutes into the movie.  At one point, one of the waiters carried on a very loud conversation at the entry point into the VIP section.  I finally asked them to take it outside.

Based on this experience, I can't justify the extra $$ to sit in the VIP seating.  Maybe someday they will tell their servers to stop serving food after the movie starts..

A very nice, clean, new theater.  We loved the idea that tickets can be prepurchased online with assigned seating.  We figured this would save us from having to arrive early to get a good seat.  

Not so.

We entered the theatre looking for a kiosk or something to print out our tickets, but they were all out of order.  So we waited in the very long line to get our tickets anyway.  Then we discovered they'd put us in VIP seating, which is for 21 and up, and doesn't work for my 10 year old.  So we waited in the very long line...again...to have our seats changed.

By the time we got to the front of the line, the only tickets they had available were for the front row.  Grrrr.  Okay, fine.  We took the front row seats.  We entered the theatre to find our seats (the movie having already started by this time), only to discover someone else sitting in our seats.  We had to ask them to move and the whole process disturbed everyone in our vicinity.

IF they can get it to work, the pre-purchased, pre-assigned seating is a great idea.  But it didn't work for us on that day, and I think we'll stick with the Edward's theater down the road.

Let's start off by saying I hate having to spend the time to type this out but honestly they deserve it. Jump time is mediocre for this type of place, but kids will have fun there. The problem is the horrible management. We reserved an area there for a birthday years ago and it went great! But this time we booked an area for my sons 6 year birthday. We booked it about a month in advance expecting to pay $150. TWO DAYS before the party we receive a long email about how they will be charging us more because HES SIX! Umm hello.. he's turning 6 years old. We called and spoke to Liz who is supposedly the reservation manager (hard to believe) and she was completely unhelpful and insisted on increasing what we have to pay due to his age. She would not budge on this and refused to allow us to speak to someone higher up, because supposedly there is no else. After paying the deposit (goodbye deposit), sending out invitations, preparing decorations, cake, etc they waited until we are pretty much stuck with their company and then increase the cost. UNREAL! This company is taking advantage of their customer base. You are better off going elsewhere for your children's birthday. There are plenty of places similar to Jump Time locally. This place is fine, so long as they cant hold your child's birthday as leverage over you.

I brought my 8 year old here to get tested for strep. We were seen quickly, and everyone we encountered was really nice and explained everything well. The place is new and clean, and they even have bottled waters and coffee to drink while you wait.

Started off waiting at the front door for a few minutes without even seeing a staff member. I understand this may be due to Covid staffing so I will give them that.

Staff members were incredibly nice. Upon asking a couple of wine specific questions they didn't seem very dialed in though. While I have to admit I don't remember specifically what they said, the spirit of their answers were very much in the, "I don't know, I think that one is really dry", level of wine talk.

The feeling inside this glass walled building is actually pretty cool. I was there at Christmas so to see Christmas shoppers walking around outside added to the atmosphere.

Then came the food. I had asked for a pasta dish but with a different pasta from another dish on the menu. I was told the chef doesn't like doing that. With that I thought two things: I know for a fact switching up pasta is no big deal, but maybe this is a chef with integrity. OK, I'll order something to see what this chef is about. I decided against pasta and went with their meatballs as I was having a good, meaty red. Also I am purpose order something basic first time into a menu. If the chef handles basics well the rest of the menu is usually very good. Well, I'll eat my hat if those meatballs weren't pre-bought/pre-formed. I have honest to God had better ones out of a bag from Safeway. I was asked if I'd like bread with that to dip into the sauce. Sure! Turned out it's bread they charge for. Wasn't informed. I only had one dish here, sure, but the BS about chef integrity over a pasta coupled with the eventual big fail of the meatballs left me not wanting to dip any further into their menu.

I have to say the Dunham Bordeaux blend I had was decent. Not $15 glass in my opinion, but decent. Also a heads up for anyone going here for the first time - these are wines served from a dispenser. I don't care how "fresh" it keeps the wines, it's pretty damn un-sexy. 

My opinion? Go across the street to the giant Albertson's supermarket, get the fixings for meatballs, make them yourself, and spend the money buying a nice bottle from their downright fantastic wine collection. Money much better spent.

Would have been two stars if it wasn't for how pleasant my server was.

My husband and I went here after we've been driving past it for what seems like forever! We were pretty impressed with the food! I ordered the chicken and shrimp and it comes with rice, and vegetables. The meal also comes with a clear broth as it states and a salad. We loved the broth it was so yummy! The hibachi show was pretty funny too! We will definitely be going back with some friends!

"Woohoo! As good as it gets" is a great description for this movie theatre. Not every movie theatre offers an experience that elicits that sort of response, but this one absolutely does. Pay in advance, select your seat(s) so you're not left with one of those front row seats that leaves you with a massive kink in your neck - brilliant! (I know a lot of theaters offer this, but Village Cinema was the first place that I saw this system in place). 

Aside from being able to pick your seats ahead of time, this movie theater is a bit swankier than your average cinema. It's interior possesses the same sort of class that the entire Village shopping center houses, the seats in here are cushiony and extra comfy, and every time I have been here it has been exceptionally clean. 

Tip: go on a Tuesday, it's only $5!
Very good food for relatively low prices. Bathrooms and dining area were clean and the staff was very welcoming and helpful. Gluten free options and dairy free options abound.

Where is the SPICE  in Spice Indian Cafe??

What a disappointment! The food is really bland on the lunch buffet. I don't understand why ethnic restaurants try to tone down their food to make it "suitable for the Western palette."  They should be proud of their food! Why do they think we are coming to them? If we wanted "American Food" (whatever that is) We would go someplace like Golden Coral. Went here for lunch today.  Ordered then waited patiently for 30 minutes while watching everyone else that came in after me get their food.  Turns out they lost my order.  They weren't even busy, how do you not realize hey this guy has been sitting here waiting for 30 minutes with no food. Very disappointed in this place. My boyfriend and I were helped with buying a Tempurpedic mattress and we were very excited. They quoted us a price that we could pay off in 60 months 0% interest. NEVER AGAIN WILL WE EVER GIVE OUR BUSINESS TO ASHLEY

I have not gotten an order correctly filled.  Every time something is wrong. I want to leave 0 stars but can't . I brought my 11 month old son to this salon, he has beautiful gorgeous blond locks. These locks were such a part him. If you are wanting authentic Mexican food this is not the place. Food was not good at all. The only thing I have good to say was our waitress was very nice. Other then that not worth going back.
I had a burger and cheese curds.  Both were good but not over the top  I recommend it if you are in the area but I wouldn't go out of my way to go there.

I came here to return some Amazon orders. I was greeted as soon as I walked in, and an employee helped me get a cart to put my boxes in (I had 3 I was trying to juggle). Meridian Sizzler has great curbside take out and their excellent steaks, burgers and seafood is wonderful anywhere.  There is a reason that Sizzler has been a part of our community for over 50 years!  It's the great food and the amazing prices!  I'm a big steak and Malibu chicken fan.
