Jessica and Zach made every effort to make our home furnishing needs met. They provided outstanding service and were friendly, professional and attentive without being overbearing at all. They helped us to look at different options and were super patient with our daughter being with us as well. I'm so excited for our new furniture and happy we chose this store to purchase from. Jessica and Zach also went out of their way to help us get a sofa at a fantastic discount to use while we wait for our big sofa! Highly recommend you looking for Jessica to help you and Zach the manager!

Awesome customer services! Don't know why people keep leaving bad reviews. I love it that they are protecting all their employees and other guest with great COVID-19 guidelines. Always great service from Ever in Firearm and Kaden in Camping! Great price with ethics and integrity! Common sensed people with great services! Just don't ask stupid questions or demand services as if You were a King.

I'd been to Zupas locations in Utah over the last few years and noticed that they've cut down on portions, particularly with their sandwiches, but they are tasty and of decent quality so, I let that slide.  I will add that while I'm not much of a salad eater, I do like their salads.  Staff is friendly.

They have no online way to file complaints...so, I'll do it here.

It's a bit too cafeteria-style for my liking, however.  Try having a conversation with someone while you pass the gauntlet of 40+ feet of counter folk trying to either sell you more food or ask you the same question you've already answered about what you'll be ordering.  In other words, be ready to help them "manage" the order making process all the way down the line which  most places are able to do behind the scenes.

What really kills me is the way they can't figure out what you've ordered.  At least three different people ask you what you ordered each time you go in.  I ordered a honey bacon club (HBC) and a BBQ chicken salad with no onions.  Somewhere between where I ordered my HBC sandwich and salad, they lost my salad.  The girl by the dessert case asked me about a pork sandwich and the cashier asked me if I had a pulled pork sandwich for some reason too.  I said that I just had a salad to go with my HBC sandwich.  The girl took my sandwich out of the to-go box and put it in someone else's box, then went to "find" my sandwich and salad.  Huh??  Meanwhile, another girl shows up and asks me what I had so I tell her too.  A salad shows up with onions on it which goes in the box with another sandwich.

I noticed that this girl in the middle was placing all the items that came her way on top of the dessert case/counter in such a random order that it was no wonder she couldn't find what she needed.

I tell the cashier that this kind of thing happens to me all the time.  The last time this happened to me I told the GM that they needed to fix this "cluster" and he tells me with enough arrogance to piss me off that they've "been in business for 10 years and this is quite a refined process".  Really?!?  How hard is it to get a Sharpie and write this stuff down and pass it along with the order so you don't separate the items and ask the customer a half-dozen times what they ordered?  ...and, then, FIND it!  It's exhausting and aggravating that they can't process a simple order with minimal input.  

Since I've been to this location on Eagle Road (7 or 8 times) with business associates, family and even by myself, they have NEVER gotten it right.  I can't be the only one to experience this circus.

Family owned Indian food restaurant is an option for good eats in the vast wasteland of marginal chain restaurants in this part of Meridian.  Welcoming space, friendly service, full menu of Indian food options and a lunch time buffet that is bargain priced at $9.99. There was enough to like here that we'll be happy to come back for dinner sometime to order off the menu and recommend it to others for lunch - noting for this meal it seems buffet is the thing and buffet eating is not our thing. 

LOCATION & VIBE:  In the awkward strip mall that also has chain Buffalo Wild Wings and family-owned (and very good) Mi Casa Mexican eatery.  Modest sized space with booths lining the walls and a few tables and chairs down the center of the room.  Light and clean.  A round of applause for them leaving ample space in the aisles for wait staff and customers to travel to and fro. The high ceilinged, quasi-industrial room has been warmed up with Indian art and artifacts on the walls.  Be sure to look up to see the beautiful, bright colored umbrellas.  I loved the traditional music on the sound system.

LUNCH BUFFET:  I am not a fan of buffets.  In particular at Indian food restaurants where offerings are often "dumbed down" to appeal to the largest number of people who want to eat a lot and spend little.  Walking into Spice, my husband's and my intention was to order off the menu for lamb biryani, vegetable korma and garlic naan, our 'go to' options when trying any Indian restaurant for the first time.  But the nice young woman who met us at the door encouraged us to try the buffet by saying it contained many of her favorite things.   Since it seemed she was reluctant to have us order off the dinner menu at lunch, I imagine the kitchen is overwhelmed trying to keep the buffet containers filled, we did try the buffet and were pleasantly surprised.  

There were at least two dozen options (more if you count the chutneys, fresh fruit and green salad), ranging from goat curry to at least half a dozen chicken dishes to that many or more vegetarian dishes and a couple of kinds of rice, pappadam and naan.  Also two desserts; a traditional rice pudding and mint-chip ice cream served semi-melted.

For $9.99 it is difficult to fathom how Spice owners make a profit to keep their quality up as they do.  I'd surmise there weren't more than 10 other diners in the place for lunch, all of them eating buffet, mostly men and the four surrounding us made four trips each to the buffet table to return with plates heaping.  That gluttonous behavior seems typical in use Indian food buffets and it has to cost the restaurant a lot.  It makes me wonder if containing cost might mean buying lower price / quality ingredients.

FOOD:  Leaning to vegetarian eating most of the time, an Indian restaurant is often a good choice for us.  We enjoyed all six of the vegetarian options and also trying the goat curry and a couple of the chicken dishes.   Both the plain and garlic naan were good with just enough toasty char on the bottom and side.  We like the mint chutney, which had more cilantro flavor to our palate and spicy-hot, and the tamarind sauce, labeled chutney but really sauce like consistency, but the house onion chutney fell short for us.  We've been known to make meals of chutneys and naan at other places, but we wouldn't find ourselves doing that here.

FULL MENU & PRICES:  Spice offers a menu for lunch and dinner including appetizers (@ $3-7), rice specialties (@$7-16 ), vegetarian, lamb and chicken entrees (@$11-15), seafood entrees (@$16), tandoori & kebab dishes (@$13-16), Mughlai (in the style of North India and Kurachi) specialties (@$16) and a variety of naan (@$2-$4).  As is so in traditional Indian restaurants you will not find beef or pork on menu here.  Limited beer and wine options.  Soft beverages include Lassi.  

THIS N THAT:

1) PARKING:  The mall lot is a mess of layout and always seems jammed even when the businesses in the mall are not.

2) ACCESSIBILITY:   Spice is level in the door from the sidewalk, all on one floor and all seating is standard height.  Aisles seem to be ample width for users of wheelchairs.  Loos are accessible too.  Problem is accessible parking. Given the number of parking spaces in the total lot, this mall should have at least 6 ADA spots and distributed near entries.  They have only 2 and at the far end of the strip.  This is the strip mall owners' failure to comply with Federal law and Idaho code in effect since 1990 and not the Spice restaurant's.

I've been to the new Eagle Road location 3 times. Two of those times I was very disappointed with the service and by the time I got my food it wasn't hot. 
The first time I went was with a group of about 20 people, even though we asked at the very beginning to get separate checks, they didn't and at the end of the meal they brought out the bill and a calculator so we could figure it out. That was a mess and took 30+ minutes just to figure out the bill and pay.
The second time I went there was with a friend for lunch, and the service was great and the food was good.
The last time was yesterday afternoon, it was not very busy, maybe 5 other tables with diners. It took about 30 minutes to get our food order taken and another 20 minutes to get the food. The waiter treated us like an inconvenience. When someone in our group (5 people) ordered a dish with ground beef, the waiter said only people who like bland, flavorless food order ground beef (although, no where on the menu does it list other meat options). By the time the food came I had filled up on chips and salsa because it took an hour to get our food. The food was luke warm. 
Then when we got our bills, my drink was on someone else's bill, and there was a 25% gratuity added to the total due.
25%! For poor service, long wait, and luke warm food.
When we asked about it he said it is automatically added for groups. But we only had 5 people. It wasn't until one of our group mentioned the owner is a friend of theirs, that the server removed the automatic gratuity from our bills.
I will not be coming here again.

We paid $38 for one hour of jumping with three kids. $10 extra for "ice skating". $48 total.  This is standard and I can see why they would charge extra for the new ice skating feature to recoup that cost.  However, I also purchased a 20oz Powerade for $3 dollars.  After I purchased it I asked for a plastic water cup so that I could share it with my 3 year old and not give him the entire bottle. The 6oz plastic water cup is 25 cents extra (this is the 1 star part).  We have had many birthday parties and events here and never had to pay 25 cents for a plastic cup. This is gouging the customer for any extra nickel and I disagree with the practice of charging for a water cup in general. That is all.  

Ps. I went ahead and bought the cup with my CC for 25 cents. I'm sure it was worth it for JumpTime to pay their merchant service fees on that transaction for their 25 cent plastic cup from the dollar store.
Happy hour is AMAZING! The staff is always friendly, the restaurant is always clean and the food is always terrific!

This review is for the N. Eagle, ID, location.  The food was ok.  BBQ was a bit dry and their specialty, the smoked prime rib was a bit underwhelming.  It had the smokey flavor but that was about it.  The food deserves a 3 star but their service for me should be a 1 star or zero.  At the end of the meal, I calculated a fair tip (more than 15%).  A day later I noticed my bank statement was charged a dollar more.  I remember the exact amount because I wrote it in.  So someone, either the manager or waiter decided their service was worth an extra dollar.  To me the amount isn't the issue.  I understand we're living in a pandemic but altering a customer's tip is just plain stealing and unethical.  Overall, very disappointing.  I recommend to keep your receipts and always check your statements.
Not very good. Sushi tasted old, very old. Prices are very high for the quality of fish. Also be aware that they serve jasmine rice and not sushi rice.

the reviews are fake.  
the "restaurant" (sic) is part of a crave delivery service which may, or may not, be great.... but posting fake reviews is bullshit and hurts honest and genuinely great restaurants.   
Jess "joyful" M is obviously a paid reviewer, moreover, this review of Elliott's Oyster House is for the "Boise location" which even Crave says doesn't exist.  

John J.,  you need to just apologize and delete your account.

My husband and I had a great experience with JPM. We were called back quickly when we wanted to see the townhouse and the man showing us the place was very helpful. The initial process was quick, easy, and helpful. We were in the place before we knew it and everyone was so helpful along the way. Nothing ever broke during our year-long stay, but whenever we needed something, they were quick to respond. The guys in the office were always so nice and we felt like they were trustworthy. This was great because in our last experience, we felt like our property management was trying to nickel and dime us, especially upon move-out. When we moved out of the JPM townhouse, we got most of our deposit back. We cleaned really well, so really the only thing listed on the receipt was standard carpet cleaning. If it weren't for us needing to move to Boise and being added onto a lease with another PM, we would stayed with Johnson. Highly recommend!

My wife and I have made this one of our very favorite restaurants in the Boise Meridian area. The food is very good and always served fresh and hot. The service is exceptional and the facility is always clean and they go out of their way to get you seated quickly.

Young instructors and lifeguards were not paying attention to my 3 year old while attending lessons this past summer. While in the kiddie pool, my daughter went into the deep end and she walked out too far and could not reach the bottom. She went under for a few seconds while I watched from afar. This all happened while a lifeguard was standing by and her 2 instructors were in the water next to her talking to each other. I had to yell at them to get their attention and then they slowly came over like it wasn't a big deal. I would never recommend this place to anyone. Totally unacceptable! Do your job!

After ordering delivery through GrubHub, we waited over an hour for the food to arrive (for a sandwich and salad) and when it arrived, the order was wrong. Trying not to get frustrated, I called in and was bounced from one girl to another and finally they figured out they accidentally switched my order with someone else and they said "omg that's awkward we can remake it if you order through grubhub again". I wasn't frustrated until i actually talked to someone and got that response. Wow.

Came here to use a voucher my son won. The manager checking us in was so nice and friendly, super great and kind to all my kids. She let my son keep his voucher and jump for free since we had never been. The whole facility was very clean and had something fun for all of my kids to do. Will definitely be back!

I came for a vist to Boise and a friend of mine said that I needed to check this place out. I have eated a lot of pizza from many different places but hands down the best I have ever eaten. The owner Joey puts up an up lifting vibe that makes you enjoy eating pizza. I don't rate any place but I had to for this place I will give this place a 10/10 will recommend.

74th review of Spice Indian Cuisine in Meridian, Idaho off Eagle Road near St. Lukes hospital. This is my 398th Yelp review. 

Today George and I met for lunch. I've been wanting to try Indian food, and I knew they did a buffet, which allows me to try multiple things since I don't really know what I like/dislike. All of the food was pretty good-- the bread was delicious and they had, what appeared to be, a good selection of foods-- that being said, I am not well versed in Indian food so, if you are, you may disagree with me. 

To my Yelpie (that's yelp bestie!) Yulia's review,  I too was concerned with the food temperatures. The hot food seemed to be on the "warm side" and the cold food wasn't really sitting on ice to make it cold-- however, all in all, it was overall pretty good. 

The inside had soft music playing, several booths and a few tables, and a friendly waiter. Again, I don't know about Indian food so I don't feel comfortable recommending this place for those who are Indian experts, but if you're new to Indian food, I do suggest that you check out the $9.99 lunch buffet.

I have to say this isn't a very objective review because I only had an appetizer and some wine, but we had a great time. The caprese salad was delicious, and we shared a bottle of Malbec. The atmosphere is great with the fountain in the background. I will be back to try the food.

This place had big shoes to fill for anyone familiar with Benihana. In terms of the teppanyaki fare, it does an admirable job of replicating the flavors (yum yum sauce, meats and fried rice). The cooks with their "choo-choos" and insistence on serving sake from a ketchup bottle can be a bit cringe-y, sure... but it's legit good. 

TBH, if I were grading this on the teppanyaki, it'd be a 4 star review. What makes this a solid 5 however surprisingly, is the sushi! I thought I had my fave sushi joint down: Island... hands down, right? Nope. 

The specialty maki (rolls) here smacks Island's upside the head.  It's also a cut above yoitomo, maru or shogun's ... IMHO. 

Pro tip, if you don't need to have the clang-clangs and don't mind not having your eyebrows burned off from the onion volcano, their teppanyaki hibachi food is just as good at a regular table. Cooked roll lovers, try the cowboy roll, BFG roll lovers, try the Bronco.

I just stopped by here since I had some time to kill. I was craving an Asiago breakfast sandwich (bacon, egg amd cheese) so I ordered one and it was amazing. Great bagel and really hot food. Friendly workers and I can't wait to try this place for lunch.

We've tried to call for a trash pick up that hasn't been done in 5 days. The lady was very angry by the 3rd call and said someone was picking it up today. It's past closing time and still trash. All services are current and not past due.

OK my friends I came in today and got what is called the pad see ew noodle it's a flat noodle with beans routs Chinese brocolli and onions with your choice of protein. I chose beef but since I love my vegetables I chose to add american brocolli and snow peas (which I don't regret doing at all) the mix between the flavoring and plenty of meat and vegetables was perfect. I also prefer my food a little spicy so I ordered medium which also added the final touch. Everything about it was delicious beyond belief. The restruant is in spectacular shape, decor is amazing I love their little lamps. Reading the past reviews I'd have to say my experience was the complete opposite. Tables where clean as a whistle literally they could slide my plate across the table to me without it even sticking:)... This is definitely one of my new favorite places and I can't wait to try the variety of food each time I come back. Service was amazing as well my drink never went completely to an end and my server kept coming back to check if the food and spice was GOOD for me. They genuinely care here and treat you like family. I hope business stays good for them because they more than deserve it.

Ordered over $400 in knives and never received anything. Buyer beware do not buy from them. Only customer service suggestion was call the post office. Now he has my money and I have nothing and that's just fine with Jeff

I don't usually have a hard time articulating my feelings on a place, but JumpTime has me waffling. There is a LOT to do, my kids love it, and the new facility is an improvement over the old. But there are just enough obnoxious elements to make JumpTime my least favorite indoor kid's space. 

The Moderately Ok: There are a few bounce inflatables, kiddy rides, tons of trampoline varieties, a dodgeball court, a really cool Ninja course, and a high jump into a giant inflated pillow. Plenty to do for all ages. I imagine this place is particularly good for the 7 - 12 age range. 

There are weekday times where you are not paying by the hour and that is pretty affordable for a younger kid. Though you are not allowed to bring in your own food, they do have a cafe to purchase food. Coffee is available (though preeeetty gross in my book). 

You can book parties and a semi-private party space. I have only been an attendee, but the parties seem ok. A sullen teenageer will be your "party host" and bring you Papa Murphy's pizza and start cleaning the space 15 minutes before your party actually ends, because another party begins at the exact time yours ends. But at least you don't have to do the clean up. 

The Not So Good: This is a huge space. However if your kids are under the age of 5, that's not really a good thing. It means you are chasing them all over, constantly trying to keep track of where they are and ensure that they aren't leaping to their death off some ledge. My 1 year old, "Hurricane" is particularly hell bent on self-mutilation. I leave JumpTime utterly exhausted. They do have dedicated space for kids under the age of 5, but it not sectioned off and the only deterrent for older kids is a sign that says "Five and under". And it certainly doesn't corral your little beast. 

I have never, not once, seen someone over the age of 18 working at Jump Time. I love teenagers. I used to teach them. I have met many WONDERFUL teenage workers at businesses all over the valley. Unfortunately, none of them work at JumpTime. The customer service is not great. I think a staff training on smiling could be beneficial. 

Lastly, a funny (maybe?) anecdote. The last time  I was there, the person running the music was playing a hip hop playlist. Most of it was ok, though not terribly conducive to kid's play. But then an incredibly inappropriate song came on. I'm talking F bombs every other word blaring from the speaker under our trampoline. It was only about 30 seconds before someone thought to change the song, so no real harm done. But I'm thinking they might want to review their music selection policies. :)

Tracy did an amazing job on my nails and feet. By far and away the best full set I've ever received. Thanks Diem!

Worst Customer service of any Popeyes that I've been to throughout this country. After a nightmare order that consisted of not getting an order correct, failing to have a coupon applied that the cashier insisted he had( did not actually apply the valid coupon), the Assistant manager Chris did nothing to remedy the situation and seemed absolutely clueless. Got the old elliptical moved to the garage and new one was picked up, delivered, and packed upstairs without breaking a sweat or anything!

Thank You!

Highly recommend this place - regardless of budget! Todd and Matt are a pleasure to work with. I also love that they are local.
They created custom designs at affordable prices. I have purchased a chain, a yellow diamond engagement ring, and a custom M pendant for my mother-in-law. All which turned out beautiful!
They are professional and punctual. Their prices can beat most of the competition, even big box stores like Costco/ Sam's.
Great food. Awesome job with catering! We order there for big events once a year and they always knock it out of the park. Pulled pork and potato salad are to die for!
What a lousy sandwich. Looks nothing like the photo, the bread was of poor quality. Getting two stars because the curbside service was efficient and polite.

Great customer service and knowledgable staff. I brought a vac here that i bought from somewhere else and they took care of the warranty repair and showed me how to maintain it to prevent future problems. Next time i will buy my vac from them.

Was such a breath of fresh air (literally and figuratively) not having to wear a mask walking in and getting your wine.  Always a fun place to go and the food is great.  We had the meatballs (wonderful) and the Idaho flatbread is fantastic.  The staff is always friendly and served us quickly (even though it was really busy).
Such a great atmosphere here! All staff are friendly and helpful. Dance is an expert colorist and advises hairstyle according to your wants, skin tone and facial shape! Love them!

What can I say?  This place was amazing.  From the receptionist to the massage therapist (Janette), I can't say enough about my first experience at the salon.  I am new to Boise and was used to a salon in California.  I felt that I got more than my monies worth!  The atmosphere, the layout, the services they offer are super.  The prices are very reasonable.  I already scheduled my next appointment.  I look forward to trying out the hair salon and nail salon as well.  When I arrived I was offered water, or champagne, which surprised me, but delightful.  The relaxation room was calm and inviting.  At the end of my stay, I was given a tour of the salon.  I'm telling you, from a California girl where things are expensive and quick, the service was terrific.

Super horrible service. First they put all the toppings on the two burgers which is fine most restaurants do that even when I ask for certain toppings. The worst was I ordered two double bacon cheese burgers they charged me for it but gave me a SINGLE party. And also they forgot to give us our custards so we had to go BACK and get them.
Brought my daughter in law for massages and mani/pedis. Very accommodating, great service and the best massage I have ever had.

From our phone reservation to our goodbye; dinner was amazing! Brigitte has an infectious personality that welcomes you & captivates you. The homemade soup was rice & shrimp (amazing). Salad was beautifully dressed and the scallops were the best I've ever eaten! Hubs had the chicken; delish & dessert - rice pudding was fantastic. Like Mom made. Chris & Brigitte are wonderful

I used Floral Creations last week to send a dear friend some flowers for her birthday...I was so very disappointed with what was sent for the $.
There were only six flowers in the vase...mostly green fillers. I sent a request after I was sent a pic  of the arrangement and asked if they could add one more rose to make it a total of three...and the girl texted me back and said they were out if pink roses.
The arrangement was really weak and I will not be using Floral Creations again.

Excellent Mexican food! I had the combination with an asada taco, chicken enchilada and chili relleno, and the hubby had the 5 pack of tacos (asada, pastor and carnitas) everything was so delicious and the service was quick and friendly. Will definitely be back!

My #1 suggestion if you're going to Epi's - come with an empty stomach! There is so much food and it's all delicious, so you'll want to try it all. This place is small and quaint and has real old school vibes - it's a complete gem. Some of my favorites: the ham and cheese roquettes (like pillows in your mouth), chorizo (who doesn't love meat?) for starters; the traditional bean soup was out of this world; for main course, the lamb strew (rich and flavorful) and the shrimp stuffed halibut special (I mean, fish stuffed with shellfish - yes please). And we topped it all off with some local Idaho red wine! I'd never had basque food before and now I'm on a mission to try and find somewhere back home that serves this delicious cuisine.
They cancelled our order places over an hour ago and their phone number rings 6 times then gets a FAX tone, so I dont know how to reach them.

First time visiting Chip cookies (normally eat crumbl cookies ),but noticed chip cookies had other flavors other than chocolate chip , not a fan of chocolate chip, but pretty ticked off I had to pay credit card and  not able  pay cash . The cookie was amazing but I'm going to stick with crumbl cookies from now on.

I was so excited to try this chicken! But was honestly disappointed. I feel like the chicken could have been cooked longer. It wasn't as crispy as it looked in photos. I got the potatoes for the side and they were also not as appetizing. These stars are mostly for the Crave service because delivery was good and so was the app, but don't think I would try Tokyo Hot Chicken again and wish I ordered something else..,

Yummmmmm. I want to eat here every day!! You gotta try their vegetarian sandwich. It's incredible!! And the mango salad with the mango yogurt dressing. And the million dollar bar omg one of the best deserts I've ever had! When I doordash for work they are also so quick with getting out the orders which rocks! Thank you to the staff for hustling so much!

Yuck, don't waste your time or money. Salsa verde on the enchiladas was bland, the rice had no flavor & the beans tasted canned. My husband's meal was almost uneatable. His chili rellano was crap, taco blah, & the red enchilada sauce again tasted canned. Thankfully we filled up on chips before our meal or we would have left hungry.

I ordered the fish expecting something wonderful. In stead a got a brick of Luke warm dry fish. Told waiter and all he said it was refreshed fish patted on my back and walked away. At the prices I paid it should be of quality. If not take it off the menu. I think Long John Silvers would have been better.
If only everyone got treated the same way I did. This is the worst business I have ever dealt with. I never wish Ill on anyone but I hope karma kicks your @$$!

First, I must thank Bill at Meridian Watch Repair for recommending this place.  (Go see him for all your time piece needs.)

All staff were wearing masks and they also provide hand sanitizer.  Parking is super easy, right out front and they're nestled behind the Red Robin and Krispy Kreme.  

I've been wanting for some time, to size a ring that belonged to my mom but never got around to it.  After stopping by to get a quote and speaking with their super friendly staff, I decided to get it done.  I also asked the cost to polish my wedding ring and they said no charge!  Yay!!  I posted my photos because everything turned out beautifully!!  

While waiting for the polishing, another really nice girl asked if I wanted to try any rings, just for fun.  They carry many modern designs and have a good selection of different gems to please anyone.  

They also can redesign your existing jewelry to make something new out of something old.  They create these mold-like templates to give you an idea of what the finished product will look like.  Pretty neat!  I'll be sure to bring my pieces here when I'm ready to do that. 

Thank you Diamonds Fine Jewelry!

Rude workers, open at 7 and have no bagels ready. She just stood silent, no apologies. Called Nampa store and he just says "Well... it happens" saying I should call ahead if I want bagels, again no apology. That just cost them a customer and my referrals.

Pros: A competent dental office, with few to none of the "you have a mouth full of cavities and need fillings and crowns and dentures" pressure selling. Everyone is polite, considerate, and sensible. The offices are calmly luxurious.

Cons: Be wary of any dental office that has special desks where you sit to discuss treatment plans and make payments, with attractive young ladies to consult with you. And not to mention being pumped for positive reviews.

I came in for an initial visit following development of a toothache and, feeling under pressure because of the current near-emergency of my tooth, I scheduled a cleaning without thinking to ask how much it would cost me. Now, typically a routine prophylaxis ought to be under $100 - I last paid $85 in a far higher cost of living area - to $120 including x-ray. The consultation, which ought to have led to a crown costing $1,000+ or an implant costing $3,000+, came to $150, and the cleaning was $360. To be fair, the cleaning included a panoramic x-ray, so I guess without it would have been $250.

I left with my wallet hurting more than my tooth. 

They're a fine dental office; just make sure you know what you're getting into.

A five star review means that all the major areas were nailed: service, cleanliness, yumminess factor, authenticity, and would I go back? I'm happy to say that Spice exceeded expectations in all areas. We ordered off the menu on a Saturday night. The flavors were warm and comforting, just what I was craving. The rice and nan were perfect companions to the delicious Indian flavors I was craving. And, the service and restaurant itself were lovely. I will definitely be back simply to explore more of the menu and because it was so good.
Saturday night. Super crowded. Everyone is in an ice cream mood! No complaints here! All is well in my world!

I have been a customer of Bodovino Ristorante at the Village in Meridian since they opened many years ago and I admit I should have written a review long ago about the amazing hospitality and service this place has given me.  
I typically go to either study, meet friends. It is also a great place to meet a date.  The wine choices are amazing and they have a great happy hour with half priced selections of wine and specialty drinks with food as well.
I want to highlight the team leader Larry who is always there to greet me and provide me with the best service possible.  His staff is also a great reflection of him as well as they are in my opinion the best service there is.  I will remain a faithful customer of Bodovino Ristorante at The Village.
I used to love this cookies, but the last time I bought from them, their cookies are so hard and dry. I wonder what happened. It's not the same anymore. So disappointed!

This restaurant has it all great authentic food very nice professional wait staff who is so how makes you feel at home even if this is your first visit the food is unbelievable it's a definite must have experience. Make reservations advance this places well-known and well loved

This is the only place that has good authentic Mexican food and at a great price in Idaho. 
Wish I could buy their salsa by the quart.

Good food and great service (shout out Lily!!!) Despite the heat, Lily had a smile on her face and was very helpful when something was missing from our order. This was our first time at Culver's and it we will definitely return

i'm really surprised I have never left a review of this place. I have been many times and had so many things on the menu over the last few years.

this restaurant is HUGE. they have an entire side dedicated to teppan (like benihana) and they have the big tables with the chefs who put on a show for you. it's very fun and very delicious. 

then they have a bar area when you first walk in with this big beautiful bar with TVs and a full bar and fun cocktails. 

they also have a sushi bar area which is tables for the sushi. they have the sushi guys back there making some really fresh and amazing rolls. you can sit right up front or have a table in that general area.

lastly, they have a regular dining room back behind the bar that overlooks eagle road that has lots of tables to just sit and have dinner. you can order teppan over there or sushi, do you don't need to sit in the other areas if you don't want to.

I really enjoy the food here. the sushi rolls are big and totally worth the price and the teppan is so delicious. my favorite combo is the teriyaki chicken and shrimp- it also comes with soup, salad, fried rice, and veggies. 

if you're into asian food, I recommend trying this place! and even better if it's your birthday- they make you hit a giant gong. it's totally fun and embarrassing.

Might as well rename this place shit burger because nothing about my burger was good. Paid 13$ for a McDonald's quality burger that left me with dick breath and a sense of violation. Thanks for ruining my already shitty day with your shit burgers.
Favorite tacos and burritos in the area l. Quick taco truck and their food is delicious. Don't necessarily like the hours due to COViD but I understand. & the food makes up for it.

Love this place!  Our dog has ALWAYS received exceptional care and attention to any issue that needed attention. 
The employees could not be more attentive and helpful.
To the person living on $400/per month...this is still a business that they must maintain.  If you are unable to adequately care (pay for care) for your pet, maybe putting it up for adoption would be in the better interest of your pet.  Blaming the veterinary service for not bending to your budget is not fair!

Wow! I found my new eye brow home! I previously had a brow lamination and henna done a few days ago. The tech and I were definitely on different pages. When I left the other place I just thought that I would be able to get used to the brows... but I just couldn't. I started researching places that could help me fix my brows before my maternity pictures this weekend! 

That's when I found the brow club. I spoke with Emily yesterday and she advised me to send in pictures so they can see how they could help me. :) I followed up this morning and Anna had looked at what I sent over and said she could definitely help me. She got me in without an appointment AND on her day off. Talk about first class service. She was so sweet, knowledgeable, and totally put me at ease. I will definitely be recommending everyone I know that needs their brows taken care of to go see Anna and the rest of her crew.

Thank you for saving my maternity pictures :) I'm so grateful!

Eat here all the time both in the hibachi dining room and take out. Food is amazing and the chefs do a great job beeping my 4 year old entertained. Always a fun experience and I would highly recommend them. Best sushi anywhere I've been. Love this place.

Can a review about a church be of any spiritual advice? No. What I can tell you is only of authenticity, sincerity,  and hell, a car salesman on stage!

This is the worst church I have personally been to.  There is nothing negative about the environment or staff, everything seems to be a big box non denominational Christian church to the core. But then it's showtime!

The band was awful,  and pretty awkward, but not a deal breaker. Let's move on to the service! Not without some strange sinister laughter from the male singer.  

Then comes a woman with a huge mint in her mouth to read some testimonials about lazy people praying for their house maintenance to take care of itself.  And the crowd goes crazy!  Oddly enough, people were tuned in to her, but what comes next was just exciting!

The pastor walks out on stage, and is fumbling about with the plexiglass stand, and continues to remind me of a bad Tim Robbins lookalike auditioning for a role as a presidential candidate.  Politician, car salesman style pastor, that manages to say nothing heartfelt for 10 minutes before 'warming the crowd up' with a line of scripture as the ushers hand out plastic buckets for tithing. Pretty sure the card to go with your cash said "I gave" on it, including a place for your name? Financial accountability?  

This was about the time where I proceeded towards the exit. 45 minutes in, no sermon, but a bad taste in my mouth for all of these members being misled from righteousness.  

Life Church, a DVD is not going to tell me what you're church is all about, your actions spoke volumes.

I sent the following e-mail to the Cutlery Shoppe:
Dear Sir,
I just wanted to thank you for the excellent service. I purchased 3 Gerber fastballs... one for
me and one for each of my boys. I was impressed with your selection and prices. I felt reassured buying from a business that has been in business for thirty years. Thanks for kindly upgrading my delivery from free standard to 2 day priority mail. Kind regards, James W.

I had an experience with the movers from hell about a year ago.  What a delight it was to find this reputable company for my latest move.  The movers were efficient, hard-working and really cared about my belongings.  They took extra care wrapping items for me and unwrapping them later in the day.  The price was a bargain.  I would not hesitate to use them again.  Moving is stressful but these guys brought the zen!

They have less than half of the tables open to maintain social distancing and yet employees were taking up the very few tables that were open. My baby and I had to sit outside in the 95 degree heat just so I could eat my hot overpriced soup. No employee seemed to care that we had no place to sit and didn't offer my food to go. Better off going to Panera. Won't be returning.
Nice clean place. Food is consistent with other Qdobas. Needs to have a Tasty Tuesday with half off burritos like the Billings MT location.

Went here for boyfriends birthday. Was a last minute. He got a burger difnt from ed out as requested did their best to ft ic the issue by the time he got it was full from fries only ate a third of it. Instead of knocking off some money off the bill gave us as 10 dollar off next visit. May go for my birthday lol. The service was great.

I would give this place zero stars if I could. I'm constantly looking for good deals, so when I talked to a gentleman who told me about all these good deals I'd get if I bought my mattress with him, I thought hey this is great. I still looked around (mor and rc willey ) of course the deal that the guy promised me was the best one . So as I pick out my mattress and box spring he tells me I can get a yeti, a twin matress , and some other items for free. ( a promotion they were running) Well as he runs my credit ( he told me at the beginning no credit check) but that's not a deal breaker for me. He tells me I got approved for so much. This guy was all over the place, and obviously had no idea what he was doing. He also told me I'd get a bed frame, well when it came down to it , I got nothing but a completely different bed ( still nice) and false hopes. Me being tired , I chose to go with the new bed. Long story short, I didn't get anything free like promised. ( it was just a plan to get me in the door) Well on delivery day, nothing I ordered was delivered, and only received one thing. Never got refunded like the guy told me I would either. This place is just a complete joke. I'd recommend not going there. Over $2,000 down the drain, and all I got was a pissed off wife.

Terrible service, watching the miss make my guacamole to-go with absolutely no sense of urgency when the order was already late- didn't necessarily make me happy...


Edit: unprofessional in how they handle complaints. As a manager of a restaurant myself I would never speak to produce delivery man, customer, or ANYONE who took the time to check out the business I work for this way over a simple complaint. 

I walked in through the same door as every other customer and dasher did. You propped the door open.

Thanks to one of our local news stations that featured this pizza business we decided to try it out. Glad we did! Great prices! The pizza was really good too. I like the little bit of spicy in the sauce. Will be back for sure! Support your Local Businesses!

One of the best establishments I've been to! I have a love for good fried chicken, so that's why I choose Popeyes instead of KFC. My visit here was nothing short of amazing and I owe that to their team member Noor. His customer service was impeccable. I was missing one of the sides that came with the 12 piece family meal and he fixed everything up with an amazing attitude. I could tell he was very kind while he held a smile with his service, and I didn't even feel to double check things after everything was handled by him. I really appreciate good and kind service, as I've been treated poorly from those who I gave my business to in the past. But after this amazing experience, I'm glad to say that I will be visiting more often. Amazing food and amazing service.

I do not recommend Grant Dental.

My first visit (Boise office) was for tooth pain in a back molar.  The Dentist quickly insisted I needed a crown and that he could complete it that morning.  I thought, okay great, I am already here!  About a month later I went back in because I continued to have pain from that tooth.  The same dentist just said it needed the crown needed 'adjusted' and to come back again if the pain continued because I would need a root canal and a new crown.  Why in the world would I be responsible for a new $600 crown when I just paid for a new $600 crown? Seems like a scam to me.

After another month went by, and the pain continued, I scheduled an appointment at the Meridian office because it is closer to my home and had an opening that was convenient for me.  I then received call after call from the Boise office and then exchanged 3 or 4 texts with their receptionist scolding me for scheduling at the wrong office and that now she would need to transfer my records.  She was completely out of line.

When I went to the Meridian office, the Boise office had failed to transfer my patient file as promised.  This made my appointment very frustrating as I felt I needed to repeat 100 times the reason for my visit.  The dentist I saw there said the NEW crown might be bad and need replaced, again, the crown is less than 2 months old at the time! He, too, 'adjusted' the crown and told me to come back if the pain continued. I am still continuing to have pain, but I will not be returning to Grant Dental.

After a few days of receiving my actual paper statement I started to receive calls, emails and texts notifying me of my 'outstanding' balance but the actual paper bill indicated my bill was due 05/22/21... why was this place in such a hurry to receive payment on a bill that hadn't even reached its due date?  On Monday the 24th, 3 days after my payment had been made in full, I received ANOTHER paper bill stating my payment was late, meaning they had mailed me a late notice before the due date on my paper bill had passed. I called their billing office twice, I did not hear back.

I would rather try DIY/Youtube videos for at home for dental procedures before visiting either of the Grant Dental offices, and wasting $600 on a crown only to be told it was bad by a dentist at their other office, again.

BEWARE !
We spent over three hours last week purchasing furniture at this store. The items we purchased were selected SPECIFICALLY because the salesman told us the items were in stock and available for immediate delivery. The process took forever because they said they were having issues with the in store computers. We returned after having dinner and they still took another 45 minutes to process the order. When we failed to hear from them for our scheduled delivery date, we went to the store. We were advised then that our furniture was not in stock and would not be available until sometime in December. I cancelled our order and then it took another 45 minutes for the manager to process a refund.

The same thing happened last spring when we attempted to purchase an outdoor dinning set from Ashley. After placing the order for an "in stock" item, we were advised that the item was not in stock and was no longer available.

AVOID THE HEADACHE AND LIES AND SHOP ELSEWARE!

I absolutely love this church. The people are so friendly and the pastors messages are always on point. This is a non denominational church that is spirit lead. The worship is amazing! If you are looking for a great church, you have found it here.

Overpriced wine .. I ordered a glass of red from the bar the other day and was asked if I wanted another , I said sure I'll try a Cabernet instead, tho they asked if I liked it fruit forward and I don't know what that means so the lady says " it means being punched in the face by fruit " I said  that seems interesting ,  I'll try it . She said I know just the kind and handed me a somewhat small pour (but the last one was actually on the smaller side too ) asked if I like it and I did . 
When I finished and they handed me the bill and that glass alone was $14 so I definitely got played by the waitress because she didn't mention how much it was , and I didn't ask because I didn't assume it would be that much either . Not a fan of being mislead , especially when I'm at the Village of all places because it's just weird enough there as it is . I also got the vibe that it's a pick up joint for old timers . From what I witnessed older People apparently do blind dates here. So all in all , it's a weird place . Wouldn't recommend . I would probably go anywhere else .

Goodwood did an outstanding job in providing a delivery order for a small rehearsal dinner.  The staff had outstanding communication with us as we were trying project the numbers for our event.  The food was OUTSTANDING.  They provided us guidance on how to keep it warm until we served the meal.  
The meat (ribs, brisket, pulled pork)  sides and potato rolls were delicious.  The berry cobbler was WONDERFUL.  Our guests raved about the food.
Would highly recommend them!

Disgusting food.  Disgusting management. Great waitress.  I'd write more but afraid if I criticize "the owner's son" or the corned beef and cabbage like my boyfriend then he will call the police.  Off his rocker.

I'm sorry to say my husband and I had a less than stellar experience. We came in store to buy a shed, but we're sent back outdoors (in over 95 degree weather) to the parking lot to wait for someone to help us. I don't know why (there were three people available at the customer service desk and I literally had a photo with the product number from the shed in thier lot). We waited for 20 minutes for someone to help us, and quite frankly were unimpressed with the attitude from all staff. We will be purchasing the shed elsewhere.

Extremely disappointing service. If you are a doordasher, have fun having them treat you like a piece of s*** simply because you are... helping them keep their business open during COVID-19 and they can't comprehend that you are all working and serving the same customer. The inside is dirty, awkward, cramped, and the manager is a complete narcissist who can't put a customer service attitude on o save his life. Wouldn't care if this business went down, and I don't say that about ANY business!

Absolutely the worst experience I could imagine. I do not recommend buying from Ashley under any circumstances. I placed my order in September ~ they said all the items on my order would be delivered on November 14; however, that was a lie to make the sale. Some items arrived in November; such as 1/2 my couch with legs that do not match. I ordered three bedroom sets and only one bed was put together because bed rails were missing on the other two beds. A couch and chair arrived damaged. The sofa table we ordered is the same height as the bar stools (thanks to the salesman), so no room for your legs.  I went into the local store and they would not help me. They said Ashley policy is that once an item is left at your house, you are stuck with it. We spent over $10,000 and we are getting the worst customer service possible. I called and talked to the local store manager and he could care less....he was not even listening to me on the phone. I am so disappointed.

Three and a half starts for the pizza -1 star for the service. Ordered from here three times. First time is flawless... pleasant service, reasonable price, above average  pizza. Second time we asked them to do a 3 x two-topping pizza deal and just make one of them cheese. They litterally could not accommodate that. They actually want to charge us more money for taking the toppings off the pizza then for leaving them on. Asked for a manager and was told i was talking to one. Unreal. Third time just picked up today. $44 between 2 pizzas. I said hey can I get some Ranch. Guy behind the counter says sure no problem how many you want. 3? 4?Manager screams over her shoulder you have to charge him for that. Poor kid looks at me sheepishly, doesn't know what to do charged me $2.50 for ranch. I said to the manager $2.50 for ranch you got to be out of your mind anywhere else this is free. Just looks at me.  I said and on top of it you yelled it rude over your shoulder. Told her I was never coming back she said sorry about that. Avoid these people like the plague they have it you don't care about your business.
Some of the best ribs I've ever had! My wife had spinach strawberry salad and it was delicious as well.  The sides were great as well. Clean well kept restaurant.

THIS IS A LONG, SLIGHTLY ANGRY REVIEW/POST..I AM SO MAD I EVEN HAVE TO RATE THEM A SINGLE STAR! I never, EVER do this..but I am HUGE ON CUSTOMER SERVICE, and this has hands down been the worst customer service I've ever, EVER received. So, if you think its tacky of me, or in poor taste, keep it moving‍ At this point I feel I absolutely MUST. I want to warn every single person I know about my experience with Ashley Furniture. I had purchased an item online, and it was delivered on the 17th of December, decided I did not want this item, called the very next day which was within their 72 hour window of returns. Was on hold for an hour, told someone would contact me within 48 hours, no one did. I called back the next day, was on hold for 45 minutes, told a pickup was never arranged, and that she would have someone contact me within 48 hours to arrange pickup, and that she would personally follow up with me to make sure that this actually happened. NEITHER of those things happened. I have had constant emailing back and forth up until today, with each person I talked to telling me they would arrange pickup, and NONE of them ever arranged this. That the online store, the physical local stores, the company that arranges pickup, as well as the company that actually picks up returns, are all independent, and not affiliated with one another so all of their hands are tied..Also, I might add that the local store here off of Fairview and Eagle Road DOESNT EVEN HAVE A PHONE NUMBER!! YOU CANT EVEN CALL THEM... Its just the basic 1-800 number for all stores. SHADY. I finally get connected to a 5th person, a supervisor, only to then be told that I am past the 72 hours window and they will not be accepting my item back for a return. At this point, im so incredibly frustrated, I actually have NO WORDS. After hanging up the phone, and looking into this, I found tons of online reviews with the same issues, and well as several law suits, and scathing YouTube reviews of the very same issue. SO, if this can save even just one person this incredible amount of frustration, then COOL, THATS SUUUUUUUUUPER DUPER. This is my first and only time dealing with Ashley Furniture and I will NEVER again. Now if you'll excuse me, I have to go have a stiff drink, possibly some yoga, and may even contemplate taking these 2 foundations out to the shooting range.. TOODLES‍

This vet & grooming facility has really surprised me with their lack of direct communication. I had a regular grooming appointment scheduled with Alicia & due to a new job, I needed my 2 dogs to be finished 30 minutes earlier than normal. Normally, I had dropped them off at 9am & they were usually done by 11:30am or noon at the latest. I called and ask if they could absolutely be done by 11:30am at the latest, and they said they could not comply. I then asked if only 1 could be groomed by that time the day before. I didn't receive an answer before the appointment, so because of that, they no longer want to accommodate my dogs as I did not show 4 their appointment; I would have been late 2 the new job. To my knowledge, it doesn't take ANY groomer 3 hours to groom an animal. I called several times, left messages, emails & txt, and no one would ever call me back. I guess they prefer email and txt, instead of a good old fashioned phone call. Call me crazy LOL but phone etiquette & F2F communication is a must when it comes to fur babies & children. If you want solid customer service and good follow up, don't go here. That is my recommendation. To date, no one has called me to remedy the situation. I simply got a txt LOL #EPICFAIL

Update: After a month, nothing has been sent or emailed to me about this, which is surprising, but we all have a choice as to where our fur babies go. I choose not to oblige this business anymore.

I Like the the theatre.  I Like that It is Super Cheap on Tuesdays.  Plenty of food options and offers Dolby which is a MUST.  The VIP has a cool concept but those seats are NOT comfortable.   Recliners MUST be part of the VIP experience, not just dining n stuff... 

I also wish ALL screenings had Reclining chairs, especially the Giant Screen or Dolby showings which would be amazing.  Other than that, i love coming here.

I will keep this review short and sweet. I'm giving 2 stars because I like their selection. But, this review is regarding my latest and last visit here due to the prick who was condisending to me when I had a simple question. As someone who works in a customer service role I was astonished by this individuals tone and comment.

Me and my girlfriend are big fans of sushi, and we figured we'd try out Izumi's. The bar was pretty cool, and the hibachis were fun, but down to the freshness of the sushi was awful. The beginning experience was great until that first and following bites. The avocado tasted warm in all the rolls, the seaweed was tough and hard to chew, and the meats tasted frozen! I mentioned it to them and had them remake two of them but different rolls and when they came back the same problems. The vegetables were warm and tasted old and the fish tasted like iced froze fish. It's one thing to have cold fish, but once you can taste ice and heat a crunch from just the shrimp, keep in mind it's fresh shrimp not fried. All and all would not suggest the sushi part of this sushi and steakhouse restaurant.

OPEN for Dine In, another survivor!! The salad bar has the best, varied selection that I recall including more fresh fruit choices. Sanitizer, spacing, masks - all efforts to stay safe and stay open. We look forward to coming back regularly! The servers were prompt, accurate and kind. The cleanest salad bar, cold food Cold. Looking for Keana next time too

I am having the same problem as others who have purchased from the Meridian, ID store. I bought a reclining loveseat. It is too short and I want to return it and purchase the reclining sofa. When I tried to make the switch after having the loveseat for about 25 days I was told No because I have to ask for the switch within 14 days! Ashley, if you read this, please don't give me a weak response! Just let me make the switch.


Ashley, I answered your request and sent you my email address and phone number. Are you going to solve my issue?

So Ashley called me and and repeated the same thing the store "Manager" said: "They cannot help me because it is over 14 days. " This company truly does not care about their customer. Takeout review:

Daal- Slightly runnier than I prefer but great flavor and spice. I got a 4/5 spice level and it was actually fairly spicy and full of flavor. It is under the entree category. 8/10

Tried one gravy and it was the chicken tikka masala- Same spice level and full of flavor. 8/10

Butter and garlic naan were good. 9/10
Love grabbing the ready-to-go Stromboli and pizza on my way home from work. While they heat the Stromboli, Joe makes an incredible fresh Cannoli. Price is great, too.

My husband and I got their drunkin noodles. I can't say anything else besides it's very good. We ordered it to go, only took 15minutes. The meat was very tender! Which is nice...considering I've had the same meal at other places and I couldn't chew the meat. 
Our portions were not the same.. which was frustrating. 
I would definitely recommend it tho.

The staff was very welcoming and sat us immediately. We ordered the baby back ribs. I had the baked beans which were delicious. The Manager came over to make sure everything was ok and was also very friendly. Very few minor things could have been better but nothing worth mentioning. Overall a great experience.

You won't find better people in the Boise jewelry business than Diamonds!  Honest, reasonably priced and the service is stellar.  Just great people and so willing to sincerely meet your needs. 5 Stars is not quite enough!

Alright..... I've almost written a review for this location multiple times. It's right by my house and the only "fast food" I'll eat.

I always find out when I get home or at the checkout.
I don't change my order 
I get a strawberry harvest with no chicken and a veggie sandwich.

Rolls and the chocolate covered strawberries off the pick two....
Tonight they were off out stuff.... Yet again

They are the best! From management to receptionist, they are attentive and always professional. I've had a couple of massages and a couple of facials and I've always been pleased. In fact I just booked my next facial lol
Dale

What a great spot! The menu has something for everyone...delicious appetizers...flat bread pizzas are terrific...enjoyed the Pinot
Grigio..better yet...Tia is fantastic and makes everyone feel comfortable! We will come back and hope that Tia takes care of us!

I giving this a stong 4 stars.  First time in and had the Chicken Mole. It was great! A little on the sweet side. I plan on trying out more from the menu soon. I hope to up this to five stars after I've eatten there a few more time.

The sandwiches are yummy! Not sure why my lunch sandwich had a slab of warm microwaved scrambled egg in it.  Also, the Ham sandwich picture is deceiving because there wasn't an alfalfa sprout to be found on the entire sandwich. It was one of the main reasons i had ordered that sandwich to begin with. Beware of the huge cuts of raw red onion in each sandwich also. 
I'd probably give 5 stars if it wasn't for the line of microwave action there. It tasted good but buyer beware of all I listed.

If you're looking a company who cares only about money, and nothing about you, and you like to get screwed - this is YOUR PLACE!  We asked them for details about what we needed to do to get our house ready to list... she only mentioned concern about the carpet and generically cleaning up the yard, but it turns out there was a LOT more.  We asked them to call us, and to set up appointments with us to discuss what we were supposed to be doing... they didn't call back and never made an appointment with us. Almost all correspondence we had with them after the check crossed their desk, was because I physically had to walk into the office and speak to someone. I gave them pictures of the house to use for their listing and they said they couldn't use most of them. I asked why, repeatedly, hoping to take more suitable pictures for them, but they never told me. They did list the house with a few of the pictures, not enough to really do the house justice, but had a very unflattering description of it - they were not trying very hard to sell all the features of our home. I asked on a couple occasions to improve the description and they did not. They did not even reply or explain their bland, generic approach to our listing. They took all our utilities out of our name, without our knowledge (we continued to get bills in our name and make payments all summer) so that, after we broke our contract off with them, they shut off our utilities while we still owned the house, were working on getting it ready to rent, and was still in our possession and not under contract with them anymore. They didn't even bother to simply call us and tell us we needed to switch utilities back into our name or inform us they were shutting them off. One phone call is all they had to do, but no, they called ALL the utilities and had them ordered to shut off. They looked aghast when I asked them to pay the $14 fee to have the gas turned back on in our house - and refused, naturally. And they NEVER apologize. EVER! Even when they are dead-out wrong they won't admit it, they will blame you. They never apologize for misunderstadings, short-fallings, confusion, or outright errors - - it is ALWAYS the customers fault. After all this: they didn't cash our original contract fee check, so they want to bill us for that, bill us for the utilities that never should have been in their name, bill us for 'electronic transfer fees' that THEY made (hey, they could have put a stamp on it like the rest of us, I shouldn't have to pay for their choice of bill payment), and charge us a 'breach of contract' fee (the contract does not say that there is a specific way to break free of these crooks, so we didn't breach anything.)  When I called to tell them we wanted out, instead of asking 'what can we do to make your experience better, she simply said 'let me see what the charge will be for that'. That comment alone sums up their attitude: they don't care about customer service, only about money.  They don't want to keep your business if they can make a buck off cutting you loose. Avoid this place at all costs. We have a new property management company and we are QUITE happy with them (and they charge a LOT less than Humphry's, for a TON more service!!)
PS This is Danielle, so you can't claim you don't know us.

Culver's is legit! Food is always great. I've been through the drive through several times and pulling out tonight we realized they have never messed up our order. The staff is polite, professional and well kept. We have gone inside on occasion and it's super clean and homey, I feel like I'm back in the Midwest:)

Just tried to get food through the drive thru, butter burger and fries. I had number 132, pulled up behind 3 cars in front of me. Those 3 cars got their food and then so did the next 7 cars that had pulled up behind me. The food runners saw me sitting there, no one asked me if I needed help or was I waiting for something but they walked right past me. I had to call explain the issue of my missing order to the manager Taylor, he didn't try to explain, no offer to make it right, no apology, just said wow that shouldn't of happened. Gee you think it shouldn't of happened, that's very astute of you. Now that you have shown you are a real life Sherlock Holmes, how about you learn about customer service. I completely understand that mistakes happen but teach what is proper when they do.
I love this place !!! It's very clean Only nurses do procedures. And I like the lifetime guarantees on laser hair removal.

I have been a loyal REI and very occasionally a Cabala's customer. Impulse shopped at this store in this location. Masks are newly optional. The store was packed, and it was the Friday before Father's Day. (and 100 degrees out). Seems like a recipe for "not fabulous." We worked with Chase looking for  woman's light hiking shoe. He was informed, had a great sense of humor, never made us feel rushed. He handled his part with casual professionalism (surprising for his youthful age). I'd give 5 stars because of Chase, however, one cashier open and 11 people in line seemed weak. All things considered, I will return again in the future. Well done Chase!

The food from the hibachi grill was good ,and plenty of it. Drinks were weil-made. Pricing was reasonable. All good news. The tables and grill were not clean when we sat, the waitress was inattentive and not well-trained in their offerings. Our cook was only so-so on the show stuff and not particularly friendly to the diners.

Would we go back? Yes, probably, sometime, but Izumi isn't at the top of our lists

Wasn't expecting this place to be as good as it was. The service was good, and the food was very good. 

They have the largest onion rings I have ever seen in my life. And they were very tasty.

I had the Carolina pulled pork sandwich, it was good even without adding sauce. My father had the brisket and said it was also exceptionally good. 

Would recommend.

Danielle was sooo amazing. She made our purchase so painless and smooth and helped us out with all the details and we wanted the store to know that we think she's fantastic!  With the baby due in a couple weeks and so much to take care of this was just a really nice experience for my husband and I. Thanks Danielle!!! 
All the other staff we spoke with were super accommodating as well and extremely friendly. We recommend this place  %

This was such a fun vacation find! Our kids had a blast and it tired them out for going back to the hotel! Perfect size place to be able to keep an eye on your kids, and you can also grab some food and drinks.

We have been eating at this restaurant for 3 years . We placed a take out order like we have done in the past and we both were quite disappointed in the portion sizes and the quality of the food. 
We have never had an issue before but even the staff was rude when I picked up the order . 
I don't know if this has to do with the times we are going threw right now but I expected better then what we got !

Warning: if you choose an apt facing victory greens your house will always be dusty and dirty. It's also super loud, you can't relax on your patio or sleep with your patio open (if you do, you'll wake up feeling awful from breathing in the dust all night)The walls are thin, they keep up the place well but I wish they'd clean our railing and our windows!
