Staff is nice, the handy men are great, all in all I just wish I knew about how dusty it was when I choose this apt, I thought it was a quote calm street and I was completely wrong.

Went through the drive up and ordered two burgers. 
Watched the runner drop them on the way to my car.  He apologized as he handed it into the window.  I looked to see if it was a mess from dropping it and saw only one burger.  He again said he was sorry and ran back in.  Brought the burger he dropped back out to us and said the other will be out soon. REALLY!!! Can I get the together and hot???? 
Answer to that is no. Nedlxt one came out cold and unseasoned.  Cheese was so cold it never melted.  Burger tasted like nothing.  No flavor. No seasoning. Cold. 
Just awful! We will not be going back there.
Home cooked food and great service every time. ! Epi's is my favorite restaurant in the area

No customer service. Very indifferent about working with the commercial customers schedule. Only trash service town so customer service is not a priority. Very disappointed that there is no other option for trash removal.

We contacted Handyman Connection for help getting our basement ceiling removed and then reinstalled so our electricians could access some work that they needed to do. Sean was sent for the job, and he really impressed me! He had great communication and was really humble and friendly, professional and respectful. I went in kind of skeptical (just because of stories you hear about contractors in general) and I was thoroughly impressed. Our ceiling looks amazing.

Found the waitstaff very helpful.  Greeted us at the door and were told to sit where we wanted.  We were able to order quickly and the food came fast.  I had the fish and chips, very tasty.  The prices were reasonable.

Great food but needs new management. Every single time we go through the drive thru our order is messed up. How hard is it not to put cheese on a burger when asked. The only reason I have written this review is because I'm frustrated. It's unfortunate that they just don't care about getting correct orders out. I think I've just visited them for the last time. They aren't that busy, maybe people are just fed up with their lack of doing things right.

We had the best time. Great service from Christina (daughter of original owner). The food was wonderful...even when we were one of the last seatings at 8:30p, they never rushed us and we had a great time. Servings are ample and true to the Basque traditions. Bravo! Great job!

This company is deplorable to say the least. They like to curse at potential tenants, refuse to move you if your neighbor dies and is rotting next door, they like to threaten elderly men....so if you love being disrespected, and treated like garbage this is the property management company for you.

2 Stars due to the atmosphere.    The place looked very nice inside.  My wife and I both decided to get teriyaki plates and both came with the wrong ingredients  (missing beef).  The tables on both sides of us had incorrect orders too and we all had different waitresses.    The food was bland and the chicken breast did not have its fat trimmed off.  The salad had one baby tomato and one slice of cucumber on top of iceberg lettuce that was not cut small and included the thick stem.  The staff claimed they had no sauces other than soy sauce and seracha  (looked and tasted more like catsup). 

I really wanted to like the place but I don't believe it will survive with its mediocrity.
One of my all time favorite restaurants.  The cod baked in a butter cream sauce is to die for.  So is the mushroom soup and green apple bread pudding. Heaven!

Goodwood Barbecue Company is a small chain of four restaurants, equally divided between Utah and Idaho, which specilizes on barbecue, hence the name.  While visiting my friend of 50+ years, Cindy, in the Boise, Idaho area, we decided to enjoy a dinner at the Meridian location of Goodwood, as we're fans of great barbecue.

As you enter the restaurant, a sign will remind you that we're still dealing with COVID-19, and "social distancing" is in effect.  The staff wear masks, but guest aren't required to.  I've never figured out how to enjoy dinner while donning a face mask.  The dining room is large, spacious, and the furniture is booths.  The dining room is separated into three sections, divided by partitions, and if you're in the mood to watch news or sports, there are many active television monitors.

Call me "old school," but I like barbecue cooked in a smokehouse, a pit in the ground, or one of those smokers that looks like a old-time steam locomotive.  I will "guess" since it's 2020, state laws must regulate how barbecue is cooked, but to me, the essence of barbecue is lost when it's prepared in an industrial, stainless steel "smoker," inside the restaurant.

My friend Cindy ordered the "Barbecue Chicken," dinner, from the "Barbecue Platters" section of the menu.  The menu describes the chicken as, "A half chicken, slow-smoked to perfection - our unique smoking process renders a perfect pink color."  So true!  She ordered "Steak Fries," and "Fresh Seasonal Vegetables" as a side.  My friend Cindy is a lover of steak fries just as much as I am!  After we were finished, she took nearly half of her dinner home in a box to enjoy at a later date.

From the "Homemade Salads and Soups" section of the dinner menu, Katie went with "Strawberry/Apple/Pecan/Spinach" salad, along with a "side" of a grilled chicken breast, as she's mostly "green" when it comes to eating.  The menu describes the salad as, "Fresh spinach, fresh and candied nuts, with raspberry-walnut with vinaigrette dressing.  Topped with bleu cheese crumbles."  She loved her salad, and like her mom, she took much of it home in a box to enjoy at a later date.

From the "Barbecue Platters" section of the dinner menu, on Cindy's recommendation, I went with the "Combination Platter," and ordered "Two Meats," as I couldn't enjoy a "third meat," thanks to the amazing breakfast I enjoyed earlier today at Coffee Mug Restaurant, located in Elko, NV.  My sides of choice were "Steak Fries," along with "Potato Salad," I truly believe that I chose the best sides from the menu!

As for the "two meats," which were the "star" of my dinner, after pondering the menu, I went with sausage and pulled pork.  All the meat choices seemed amazing, but that is where I ended up, which seemed to put me in a great place. 

The sausage was juicy and tender, with just a hint of smoke, and almost... well... almost reminded me of Texas "hill country sausage," but then I had to look around and realize that I was dining in an upscale dining room.  The pulled pork was tender, juicy, full of flavor, and topped with house-made, tangy barbecue sauce..  The barbecue was very good, almost "delicious," but lacked the "edge" that you get from a smokehouse, and I would simply describe the barbecue as "chain-restaurant-commercial" barbecue."  Not a bad description!

The meat was very good, but the sides were exceptional.  The "Steak Fries" were thick cut, just the way I love them, and fried to a light, golden brown.  As you bit into them, you'd note the outside was on the crunchy side, and the inside was juicy and tender.  These steak fries are as good as steak fries can get, and will put a smile on the face of anybody who loves steak fries.

"Mom's Potato Salad..."  Goodwood Barbecue Company's "mom" has "bragging rights," as she knows how to make potato salad!  When it comes to potato salad, I love it all, and "mom's" potato salad is excellent!  It arrived COLD... the way potato salad should be served, and had the right combination of potato, mayonnaise, pickle, onion and whatever else makes a delicious potato salad.  This potato salad was simply amazing!

A cup of in-house-made barbecue sauce rounded out this great barbecue dinner.

The barbecue served at Goodwood Barbecue Company is certainly delicious, but, like other "chain" barbecue restaurants, Goodwood produces "commercial" barbecue, and lacks the "down-home" atmosphere of a Texas, roadhouse barbecue restaurant.  It's a "sit-down," "full service" restaurant, which, to me, takes away from the informal, "grass roots" essence of barbecue.  I was less than impressed with the "industrial," non-personal service that Goodwood offers, as our server seemed in a hurry to "get the job done," with a minimum amount of personality..  The barbecue is very good... may I say delicious? ...but I imagine there are other barbecue restaurants more to my liking in the greater Boise area...

Love this place! My favorite is their spicy shrimp mango roll! They are also allergy friendly which is a huge plus with me. I am celiac and they are able to make their fried rice gluten free for me!! Everything is reasonably priced too.

The BEST frozen custard, love the Flavor of the Day!! Raspberry Cheesecake today, Dark chocolate Decadence another day. Chicken tenders are consistently most and flavorful. Butter Burgers are incredible too.
K J and his entire team were fantastic, even when it was raining.  I wouldn't hesitate to hire them again!

Man am I bummed! I'd been drooling and dreaming over Culver's famous Butterburgers and ice cream for months now and finally decided to brave the Eagle Road Rage plus lunch-hour traffic to satisfy my growling belly. Unfortunately, the experience was quite the opposite of superb.

My disappointment has nothing to do with the long time I waited. I totally understand this was to be expected considering the time of day. What is frustrating is waiting 25 minutes for tasteless, bland food. I thought Culver's was better than that! I was by myself and hate wasting food so I passed on ice cream this time figuring this would be the first of many visits. But now I'm not so sure if I'll return. 

I ordered the ButterBurger Cheese with Crinkle Fries ($7.79 for a combo meal). The burger features two never-frozen beef patties, american cheese, pickles, onions, lettuce, tomato and some kind of mayo-based sauce. While the ingredients did taste fresh, there was zero flavor. My taste buds were confused! Even drenched in their just-okay fry sauce hardly added any kind of pizzazz. The same went for the fries. Hardly salted, and didn't provide any kind of taste. At least they were crispy. Sadly, I only ate about half the burger before setting it aside, and maybe about 7 fries. My high-metabolism blesses me to be able to eat virtually whatever and not feel guilty, but I couldn't even do it with this meal. My conscious felt bad even with just how little I ate. A waste of calories, time and money. And did I mention - I absolutely HATE throwing food away. Thank God it was only $8.00.

Will I go back to try the ice cream? Was that my greatest mistake to omit it this trip? I don't know. I don't want to wait 30 minutes during rush hour for ice cream I may/may not enjoy. Sigh. Oh well. You win some, you lose some I guess. :(

This was fun. Exchange I had with the tall, young kid this morning on 12/10 at around 5:10am, when I pulled up to the window and saw him preparing my coffee with no mask, and no gloves, during another pandemic surge, and a new variant we know little about:
Me: aren't you guys supposed to be wearing masks?
Kid: yeah, we do.
Me: but, you're not.
Kid: oh, well, I just got here.
Me: well, can you put one on while you finish my order?
Kid: why, you're not wearing one.
Me: let me talk to your manager.
All the manager did was bob his head up and down, agreeing with me that I shouldn't have to deal with this sh*t at 5am when I'm just trying to get my coffee and blueberry muffin. 
Just remember, if you go to this location, there's a kid back there, who is probably not even vaccinated, who not only doesn't THINK he should be wearing a mask while handling and breathing and talking all over your food, but actually DOESN'T wear one, and a manager who seems pretty complacent about it. Coffee with a side of Omicron? No, thanks. I'll go out of my way to patronize a different location where employees follow safety protocols.

Good service and great BBQ!  The pulled pork, brisket, and turkey are my favorites!  It's a small 'chain restaurant' and that made us a little hesitant to dine here at first but after eating at Goodwood we will definitely be back for more.

We made sure to order furniture two months in advance so its arrival would coincide with our move in date. Our original date from our online order was Jan 16, we called to choose a day after our closing date, Jan 27th, our closing date was moved to January 29th so we called a few days after to arrange the drop off for the 29th, and then they said bc of their delivery schedule they wouldn't have movers available till 5 weeks later on March 2nd. I called to see what could be done to have it delivered earlier, like keeping the original date and changing the drop off address. After calling and messaging them, basically they said that they can't locate our furniture in the warehouse, so even thought they blamed the delay on the delivery service, its actually because they no longer have out furniture available for us to have. Most likely they sold it to a different customer after they switched our delivery date, without our confirmation I might add. This company is shady and doesn't actually care about honesty or good customer service. If you decide to purchase from them, order 4 months in advance of when you actually need it because otherwise you'll be waiting much longer than what they tell you. Very disappointed in our experience with this company.

Very professional and kind. A thorough gentle cleaning from hygienist, Nice clean office and easy access to location

I also had teeth whitening done in a separate appointment. Very good at explaining all aspects of the process. If you're looking for a dentist I would highly recommend them.

Goodwood bbq is awesome. Friendly, efficient service, quick delivery of food and drinks kept full. Best part...the food. Beef ribs are huge, delicious prime ribbie ribs and the sauce, crazy good. Salad is great, Mac and cheese is solid, and multi meat platters are moist and really tasty. Prices are fair. Goes to show what good management and great food can accomplish. Bravo!!!
Great Bible-based church for the whole family!
I love their soup! My uber eats order was perfect:) i know there stuff is made of quality ingredients. Thank u zupas for exceeding my expectations. U guys rock:)

Yeah, I'm liking this place. Great service and food make it appealing plus the wine varieties make it a solid choice. The location is a plus and you can shop, go to the movies and stop by for some dinner and serious wine tasting.  The plus for me, is that they offer a full bar so if you're in the mood for spirits then try their specialty drinks-they make mean Old Fashion  and a to-die-for Cosmo!

This was our first time in this restaurant. We have been to all others at the Village in Meridian and wanted to try this place. Admittedly, we had high expectations as we do with every time we decide to spend money going out to eat. We arrived late afternoon on Sunday. We found a table when we arrived and sat down. Service was quick. However, we were immediately approached with items they were out of. She told us in the first seconds that they were out of 2 items. I was put off as this is simply poor management to allow a restaurant to run out of product. This could be a precursor to other poor management with this restaurant. We soon picked out items to order when the server then informed us they were out of mozzarella sticks. So now this is 3 items on their menu that they do not have. With a total of maybe 20 menu items, this is 15 percent that they do not have! We came extremely close to leaving at that point but we decided to stay as we had wine. The server could care less. She was so used to being out of items, she went through the spiel like she knew exactly what to say. There was no excuse given for being out of these items. As a side note, being out of product reduces sales. We wanted one item as an appetizer and we ended up not ordering anything as they were out of what we wanted. 

The food arrived and were extremely small portions. Barely 2 ounces of chicken with the pasta. The food was good overall, just very small. That also makes them overpriced. I think the pasta with chicken was about $15. Generally not bad, but with small portions, it is a little expensive. 

Also, important to note that the menu online for this location is completely different from the menu in the restaurant. This is important to us as we use online menus to determine if we want to eat at a particular restaurant. There are many choices to dine out. This place does not do a great job overall. I have noticed with other reviews that there is a manager that will respond to great comments but does not provide any response to poor reviews. Another sign of poor management. Improvement to your operation is the ONLY way you will survive.

When driving near a taco truck, roadside taco stand or Mexican meat market, a mysterious Star Trek Tractor Beam latches to my car and draws me in.  Such was the case with Tacos El Rey at the NE corner of Cloverdale and Ustick in Meridian.  The last time I stopped (on a Monday) it was closed.  There wasn't any sign as to their times of operation, but in these days of unknowns, no surprise.   Tacos El Rey does have other locations in Garden City, Caldwell, Nampa and Meridian.  I don't know if they are all affiliated.  

The three tacos in the sampler were Cabeza (beef cheeks), Barbacoa (BBQ beef) and Carnitas (pork).  The amount of meat was excellent on two, fresh street taco tortillas.  The toppings were the appropriate onion and cilantro.  The cabeza was delicious as was the barbacoa.  The carnitas was a huge disappointment.  It wasn't the tender, juicy deep fat fried pork that showcases THE OTHER WHITE MEAT.  It was browned and tasteless - it is the taco on the right in the photo.  Confused by its appearance, I ate it first to confirm what it may be.  Ugh.

After having that taco, I asked the young lady in the truck for their choices of salsa.  She said green (tomatillo), red, something I forgot and habanero.  Whoa! Habanero salsa on a somewhat rainy day.  Things were looking up.

It was an orange colored thick salsa (likely habanero and crema) and a very gingerly put 5-6 DROPS on the next taco.  With other salsas, I normally just slop it on until it drips out the tortilla.  Habanero adds pure heat and little flavor to the taco.  The meat and toppings came through AND THEN the heat came later.  WOW.  My taste buds exploded with glee and my scalp was instantly electric (or at least sweating).  I repeated the process with the 3rd taco and the effect doubled.  This would definitely kill off a hipster.

30 minutes later, my scalp was still tingling, so I know there is new hair growth as a result.  I am alerting the CDC and FDA so they can begin trials on this salsa in their next round of Pandemic treatments.  I am convinced that no virus could survive this salsa. The remaining salsa in the small plastic cup is in my fridge, if they need a sample.  I will return to this truck, likely for a barbacoa burrito, of course with a request for the recipe for their habanero salsa.

I visited the store two days in a row! Seeing two different sales men! I was very happy with my choice of mattress even though the information about it was different from both sales reps! I believe I got an amazing deal on the mattress I got! Thank you mattress firm

Decided to try sizzler for the all you can eat salad bar. I must admit it's been quite sometime since we've been here, not great memories of mediocre food and being shuffled in and out. But this time things were different it seems the quality is way up, everything was very fresh, my steak which was a special combine with the salad bar was cooked perfectly medium rare, our waiter was amazing and very attentive, loved our experience here and we will definitely make it a regular spot.

Offerings of traditional basque food the evening we were there were very few. Asked the server about 2-3 selections and they were not available and she was sorry she had not updated the menu. Completely over priced for the food served. After the owner came outside and made you feel great full her accepting you to dine at her establishment. The service was very good to end on a high note.

From one New Yorker to another: I like these bagels. These bagels aren't from NY and so you need to get over it- you're in Idaho now. I told myself this after I went to pull a bagel from the bin at Walmart. That bagel was no bagel! So I said fine I'll go to that Bagel shop tomorrow, the one off 12th Ave. I was glad I finally did, only took me 2 years! 2 years without a decent Bagel until now! These bagels have a slight sweetness to it. The cream cheese is great too! Hubby was upset bc cream cheese didn't automatically come on his sandwich?!? He's from Idaho so I didn't question it, but maybe that's helpful to some others-make sure you order cream cheese on your sandwich!

I was very disappointed in the service last night.. we ordered a few drinks to have while we waited for a to go order well waiter forgot to put in half of our order took over hour and half to finally get things done I know places are short handed but this was not because of that this was just pure bad service

I heard some changes might be coming to this restaurant, so I hurried up and made a reservation for 2.  It was a late dinner for us on Thursday night.  The restaurant closed at 8pm, and our reservations were for 7:45.  But considering the last minute reservation, I was glad to get in.

Facility: The restaurant is a cute little house convert. It is very cozy and loud.  The bathroom is clean and has one bathroom for men and one for women.  They do have a private room for small parties towards the front.

Service: The service was amazing. We were greated quickly and seated shortly after.  The staff is super friendly and makes you feel like family.  Water was always refilled before it got empty, and the flow of service was perfect. Not too slow, not too fast.

Food: AMAZING!  I had heard ahead of time to try the halibut and Green Apple Bread pudding. So of course, that's what I got.  The dinner came with bread, soup, salad and an extra side.  We had 2 options for soup, so I opted for the classic Basque red bean soup.  Delicious.  For the salad, it was just a normal green salad, but what set it apart from others was their delicious homemade dressing. 

My Halibut came with a citrus crust, again so amazing, delicious and perfectly seasoned mashed potatoes.  The shared side was a healthy portion of peas.

My wife chose the filet mignon medallions and mashed potatoes.  I managed to steal a couple from her plate.  Well, maybe I gave her some of my Halibut too.  The medallions were cooked perfectly to the requested temperature, seasoned and had nice flavor.

Even though we normally don't get dessert and we were already pretty full, I had to try the bread pudding.  I am not a huge fan of bread pudding to begin with so was a little hesitant.  This one changed my mind.  It was a good size, easily shared by 4 people so we ate half and took the rest to our kids.

As we were leaving the owner greated us again and thanked us for coming.  It was not like the typical, thank you as you were walking away as most places do.  She was genuinely appreciative of us coming.  I have found my new favorite restaurant in the area.  I can't wait to return and be the creature of habit and hope the Halibut is still on the menu.

Thank you Epi's for giving us a great evening out and, though we didn't say anything, we were celebrating our 19 Anniversary.

We went there the other day because my youngest wanted to try it out (we are new to the valley). When we went in our feet were sticking to the floor (should've left right then). We ordered 4 burgers with 2 onion rings and 2 fries and all with large drinks. It took over 20 minutes to get our order completed as the cook had to keep looking at the order to remind himself to get it right. When we got the order they gave us 2 small cups per drink order because that was all they had in disposable cups. My wife was so freaked out that she tossed her order and went to Del Taco for her and my middle child. I felt bad for my youngest so I bit the bullet and ate my order with her. I immediately regreted the decision as the burgers just aren't good (the onion rings aren't bad and that's why I gave it 2 stars) and the service is horrible. Needless to say that will be my one and only adventure to Good Burger

It's been six years since my last review, so time to refresh. We've been to Epi's quite a few times in the last six years, although not in 2020, of course.

It has always been fantastic, albeit a treat due to the cost. Once the restaurant reopened after the sale and then the extended closure, we had gotten out of the habit of going, but renewed our relationship with them on our anniversary this summer 2021.

We got our favorites of course, ham croquettes, ink fish, and so on. It was a great meal and nice service. We love basque food and Epi's always delivers. On this evening, we did discuss how the meal didn't have the same panache that it always has had in the past - there didn't seem as much care put into the preparation. The croquettes were "nice", but didn't have the same ham to potato blend as before. The inkfish was "nice", but didn't have quite the same spicing.

Maybe we were comparing the meal with good memories, and we both discussed that, but given we felt the same, we went with "not as much care" as before. Still it was wonderful, though I decided our need for this conversation cost them a star in my mind.

Still highly recommended for Basque food.

There is a reason why Ashley gets one star. The delivery service people are rude and keep you on hold forever provided you get through in the first place.  The in-store people are very nice, especially Toni and Brian.

Having been to Epi's 4 times over our visits and residence in the area, I decided to add my thoughts to these reviews. IMO, Epi's probably counts for one of the few "landmark" restaurants in Boise. Eventually, almost everyone has heard about it and it has been around for a long time.

First, let's get a couple of things out front. It can be relatively spendy to eat here. I don't think that it would be excessive to spend over $35-$40 a head with wine and appetizer. 

Second, it is difficult to count on getting a table without a reservation. Weekends and Friday are an absolute necessity.

Third, the food is quite good and all dishes are authentically Basque or done in the Basque style (e.g. rib steak). Look for the Basque name behind the English name to help decide which it is. Dishes like squid with ink, braised tongue, Basque peppers, or croquettas are authentic without much analysis. For lighter eaters, look at the light fare portion of the menu. Examples, the light fare pork chop dinner has one chop rather than two. Ditto for the cod fish dinner. Save a few bucks. But the full dinners are certainly enough for two people and the kitchen will do the split in the back and each half will be nicely plated. 

And lastly, the service is cordial and almost family like. They will remember your name and treat you like family the next time. One thing we found that amazed us was that even though we lately are less likely to eat big meals in the evenings, we enjoyed the full meal at Epi's.

Now for the food. All meals come with a crusty bread, light in texture but flavorful. Soup is included and I favor the Basque bean soup. A small salad is next. Then the entree. Making up your mind may take some time as so many things sound good.Add in an appetizer and a good bottle of Spanish Basque wine and you can easily spend 2-3 hours in conversation and great companionship. And Epi's won't rush you even though they may want to turn your table for the crowd waiting outside. It is a treat to go, even if it is only once in awhile.

This place was absolutely fantastic. We stumbled upon it after a very long day of running errands in the cold and the food was beyond comforting.  Classic flavor to perfection with a very warm family feel and a staff that was very hospitable.

I have been going here for years now and have learned who to trust here and who not to. Dr. David is rude, unprofessional and does not treat my animals nicely at all. He just seems like he doesn't care. I love his son Dr. Robert. He is super nice and great with my animals. David never shows up on time and doesn't even call to let us know that he was going to be late. If Robert ends up being late he calls and gives us an ETA. He was also too scared to check out my dog's teeth (when that was the reason to the appointment) because he was worried she was going to bite him.... she a chihuahua! She had never been anyone and showed no sign of aggression! I have told the office to never have David come to my place anymore. I still love my vet I am just so fed up with Sr.

Whatever you do don't buy a card. If you loose it they won't honor it. They just made $70 off me and I will not be back.

Update: this happened in the salon and no one offered a managers help. She stated multiple times without the card I was out of luck. It showed I purchased it and that was it.
Every person I interact with at V-3 is friendly and gracious. And of course, Danae is an artist with haircuts. I always am glad to go and look forward to my next visit. Scheduling is easy.
Tv stations not working, no one at the front desk when we came in. Room is clean though

Goodwood- so good!! 

Hungry for a late lunch after a day of running errands, my husband and I stopped by Goodwood barbecue. They had a good sized lunch menu and went with onion rings to share and country fried steak to share. Also got a side of macaroni and cheese. First impressions... Wow!

Onion rings- HUGE onion rings- the small appetizer came 5 on a plate but they are each the size of a man's fist. After my husband and I each ate one onion ring, (with delicious ranch!) we couldn't believe we had each only eaten one! Seriously big. Lightly breaded and crispy, a unique style of breading that was very tasty. 5/5

Country fried steak- HUGE again- definitely enough to split. Came with two scoops of skin-on smashed potatoes and a side of toast. Breading was good, perfectly cooked, loved it! 5/5

Macaroni and cheese- definitely a cheddar-y Mac and cheese, nothing fancy but still hits the spot. 4/5

Wonderful, attentive service. Our iced teas were never less than half full. Our waitress checked in on us just enough and we had a great meal. We will definitely be coming back to try more! Maybe the brisket next time?

This is by far the best I have ever been treated by an apartment complex.
They delivered on everything without lying to me how refreshing! Soraya and her boss did everything professionally and then some. I am so happy and feel so confident in this management team and maintenance crew I strongly recommend you check this out!!

My daughter and I went there last Friday to celebrate our birthdays.  She heard from her friends that it was expensive, but since we were celebrating birthdays we decided to go here anyway.  

She ordered the Poke Bowl, and I had the hibachi steak and chicken combo.  We also had the spicy tuna sushi roll.  All our food was great.  The steak and chicken combo was huge.  Fresh vegetables, rice, steak and chicken was excellent.  The food was fresh and my meats were cooked to perfection.  The vegetables were fresh as well.  I would strongly recommend this place to anyone.  The staff were very nice.  Our waiter was Kun, and he was terrific.  

We went on a Friday night, so if you are going on the weekend I would recommend reservations.  The staff were so nice nice and accommodating.  If you want fresh, healthy Japanese food, this is the place.

A for effort. A+ for service and pleasantness. C- on food. To begin with hostess, waitress, shoot even the waterboy were friendly and kind and just so doggone glad to be there that it was infectious. The wine suggestion was excellent and quickly delivered but with the exception of the mushroom soup every single thing we ordered was one note and lacking. The salad was iceberg lettuce with a couple of shredded carrots and two baby tomatoes... that's it. The fries's didn't have salt... seasoning or garnish.. The bread was something out of the frozen food section. The entrees were just single note and sparse. There was no Pizzazz... no wow... no I got to have more of this.. no yum  factor... it was just like wedding food. It was there and it was unremarkable. Which is a shame because we wanted to love this place so bad. 

Prices were high and it's definitely an attraction for the area but not somewhere we would ever probably return to for the food. There was nothing wrong with the food per se there just wasn't anything right with it.

Boise has many better places to eat.

This would be zero stars if possible!  I lived in my triplex 11 1/2 years.  They were rude, they hung up on me when 
I had a question or maintenance request.  When the property failed housing inspections, they wouldn't repair until the Housing Authority abated their rent.  Yard care was included,  but they said that only meant mowing the grass when I complained about weeds and tree limbs coming down.  Bushes, trees, etc.  were never cared for!  The people who mowed the yard for several years warned me they were slum lords, I should have believed them!  When I moved in Don Johnson said they tell the Housing Authority the place is newer than it really is because they do not have to deal with lead issues that way.  He told me the owner was putting in sprinkler system and would be doing  upgrades - lies!  The final straw was when they started threatening me about not working with the Housing Authority any longer!  I gave my notice when I got a new apartment.  It ended up that I had to have an attorney to get more of my deposit back!  They relented and I received a bit more of my deposit back.  DO NOT RENT FROM JOHNSON PROPERTY MANAGEMENT, you will in all likelihood  regret it!

We have eaten at Goodwood for several years. Over that time the ribs are either delicious or absolutely horrible! Last night was a " horrible" experience. We got takeout at the Eagle location and the baby back ribs were so fatty they were gross! We were unable to eat 3/4 of them. What a huge disappointment when you are craving a good meal of ribs! We are vowing to never eat there again and waste our money, (they are expensive) and get a horrible piece of meat!! Don't risk it! Very inconsistent!

Linder Pet Medical Care has been great for our family. We have lived in the Treasure Valley for nearly two decades and have found Linder Pet Medical to be the best.  There is virtually no waiting if you've scheduled an appointment. Their prepayment program is outstanding; we're getting so many services for our dog and cat at a fraction of the cost we'd pay elsewhere. The staff is friendly and helpful. They've gone out of their way to help me get my pets in and out of my vehicle, but they also offer house calls if that's more convenient! We are customers for life!
This place is great.  Took a large party last minute and handled us like pros.   The food is amazing.  This our new go to for Thai.  The duck curry is excellent.

I've been here about 5 times now and every time has been great! Fantastic food and amazing service. I have to mention our server today, Kevin - he was so attentive and friendly! Keep up the good work, Izumi.

I can't give it less then 1 star or I would. Per the offices request I faxed my application over to them, anxiously waited 2 days and then called the office to see if I was approved for the apartment. The man that answered claimed to never have received my application. Although I faxed it to them from my job where a fax confirmation is always received after successfully faxing.  I proceeded to ask him questions regarding my application and the rental unit.  Apparently simply asking questions of him is to much for him to handle.  His ignorant reply was "with the way this conversation is going we wouldn't want to rent to you any way".  I should have heeded the warnings about Johnson Property Management but I really like the location of the apartment even though the unit below the one I wanted wreaked of cat urine and the front window was busted out and covered with cardboard.
