I will be returning over and over again for my kiddos fresh cut. Y'all did an amazing job!

I came in looking for some furniture for my house and not only did literally every single employee avoid me and my husband intentionally they also stared at us while doing so. Chill out people nearly everyone is wearing cloth face coverings doesn't mean we don't want to be treated like normal customers. We walked the whole store without one employee asking can I help you find something or is there something you're looking for? Instead we were met with glares and avoidance. Wow.

Going through other lower star reviews, I am glad others have had the same poor experience with the food and management. The food here is sub par and over priced. My friend and I got their charcuterie board and it was genuinely terrible, and like $25 I believe. The only cool part is the wine card, and being able to taste different wine selections. However, considering the absolutely awful costumer service here, I will be spending my money at local wineries instead if I want to go out with friends and go wine tasting. I recommend going to Yardhouse (they have a great happy hour) over this place if you're looking for something at the village.

Wow! My wife, who happens to be Hispanic, and I moved to Idaho from Arizona, so are very familiar with Sonoran, Chihuahuan, and Mexico City styles of food. Unlike too many other places that do Mexican food toned down for anglo tastebuds, Los Mariachis does not disappoint and is the real deal. 

We have been here at least once a month and we have had Carnitas, Sopa de Siete Mars, Chili Relleno, Chicken Flautas, and other items, all of which were very good.

I always try a place's rice and beans first because if you can't get these super simple things correct, there is little hope that the main courses will satisfy you, and Los Mariachis rice and beans satisfy. 

Fridays had become our family pizza night, but for me, even good pizza once a week is too often, so I suggested we alternate, one week we do pizza, the other here, she agreed!

The owner and staff are super friendly and always make us feel welcomed.

I took my three toddlers in for their first haircuts. I made sure to make an appointment. We were seen right around our appointment time. The little playground is perfect to keep my wild kiddos busy. The place was clean and our stylists were great. Overall, we had an excellent experience and will definitely return!

When you hire someone to deliver your food you better make sure the food is delivered.  Since Johnny's Pizza uses a 3 Party to deliver food and not their own drivers they delivered my pizza to somebody else!  I confirmed this with the Grubb Hub help line. To add insult they offered me a lousy  $7 discount in my next order. Now why would I do that. They already screwed my order up!  What makes them think they will get it right a second time!   Don't bother ordering food from Johnny's Pizza. You will probably not get it!
I've been craving curry and this place hit the spot with their duck curry #4 spicy, chicken cashew and pad Thai entrees

Last night the hubby & I wanted to try somewhere new to eat. We were on the hunt for a local spot that wasn't too expensive, wasn't a chain, & offered food that wasn't too fancy. We settled on Beef O' Brady's. 

We arrived at BOB right around 7:45. It was dead. We were told by the hostess that we could sit anywhere we would like. They offer both dining room and bar area seating.  We selected the dining room. There are a lot of TV's showing different sports & games.  The hostess gave us our menu which included 3 additional inserts offering new items & specials.  The menu was HUGE. I was really surprised. It was almost as big as the menu at Cheesecake Factory! They do have some specials that are a great deal: a 2 for $17, a 2 for $20, a daily special, & a build your own burger. It took about 20 minutes for us to go over the menu options & decide. We ordered:

OMG Burger with fries
6oz sirloin steak with baked potato & side salad with bleu cheese

The server brought out the side salad within minutes of our order. The salad included an iceberg mix, shredded cheese, chopped tomato, cucumber, onion, & croutons. The dressing is served in a cup on the side & it is the perfect amount of dressing.  The bleu cheese dressing was great! It was thick and had the perfect amount of bite to it. The only thing that would have made it better would have been more chunks of bleu cheese. 

The server arrived with my husbands food (the OMG) about 5 minutes after we were done eating the salad. She didn't have my food with her. It said that it would be right out. 8 minutes later she came out with my food. When she gave me my food her only words were that the cook didn't read how I wanted my steak cooked so he had to cook it longer. I hate it when the entire table isn't given their food at the same time.  We want to eat together, not in shifts!! Ugh. 

My husband's OMG Burger was great!! They make it with angus beef, 4 slices of bacon, 4 slices of American cheese....you can't go wrong! The fries were also cooked very well! My steak and potato were disappointing. The steak was over cooked & dry while the potato was undercooked and kinda mealy. It was strange. 

While we were in the middle of eating, our server dropped off our bill. My husband told her that we planned on ordering the funnel fries dessert once we were done eating. She said, "oh" and then took the check and put in the order for the funnel fries. 

The best part of the meal was the FUNNEL FRIES! Oh my word!! They are funnel cake fries with powdered sugar and warm caramel & chocolate dipping sauce on the side. They are so good. I will go back to BOB just for them! It tastes just like funnel cake at the fair!! 

We will give BOB another try for lunch or dinner, but next time I will order a burger instead of a steak.  It even if the food isn't good next time, I will be back for those funnel fries.

First time to Goodwood Barbecue and ordered their bacon and cheddar burger with steak fries. Almost didn't go because I typically don't like steak fries because they're normally mushy/ don't seem cooked, but these were nice and crispy just how I like it. And the burger was amazing. Very glad we ended up going!

3rd time's a charm catching the new Gallo Giró open for service. Overall our experience was consistent with the other locations in the valley - ok with a few food and service misses. 

Service was polite and friendly.  Asked for plain street tacos for the kids - received tomatillo and onion salsa. Asked our sever and she said "it's tomatillo salsa, it's not hot". Would have really liked to have had a replacement. 

Red salsa and kids hamburger was on point!  The kids enjoyed the hot fries. 

The plate didn't seem to fit the skinny enchilada entree. Too much white space surrounding some verrry skinny enchiladas, about the size of an expo marker. Rice and beans would have been a nice touch on a 12" plate. 

The carne asada meal filled the plate and the flavor was excellent. The only drawback was the toughness and the doneness was well when asked for medium rare. 

There's promise in this new location.  Having senior staff from the existing Gallo Giró locations may help front and back of house execute cleaner.  Might try it again 6-12mo to see improvement.

This is the fanciest dental office I have ever visited lol. I guess my previous experiences have always been super small practices with 1 dentist. But I made an appt here for a cleaning and ended up needing a deep cleaning. Was able to make all the appts up front. All the staff are nice. My hygienist is Janeal and she's great. Would recommend checking out this dental office if you are in search of a new dentist!

Food is pretty good, nothing to write home about- but good enough. (That's why 4 stars). If I could leave a review on service alone, they'd get 5 stars. Every employee is so incredibly helpful and goes out of their way to answer questions. I'd highly recommend checking them out- both the Meridian and Boise location have great service. They're doing something right with their training/hiring process- keep it up Café Zupas!

Had that chicken bacon cranberry blue cheese salad recently.  Nice big bowl of salad... but wait!  The bowl is domed in the center so it just looks like a nice big bowl of salad.  No complaints about the greens or the 2 plum tomatoes and the 2 slices of cucumber, but that chicken... oh my.  How do they manage to get gristle in EVERY SINGLE BITE!

It would also be nice if they'd wear masks... you know .. protect your customers so you'll still have customers.  The hospitals in Idaho are full, folks!

The food was terrible.  Worst buffalo wings I have ever had.  The pickle chips were over salted and just as bad as the wings. To make matters worse the service was just as bad.  I had to finally get up to find the server to get my bill and get off of here.  Total disappointment.

I found most of the reviews spot on (If you don't want to reserve your seat, there's tons on other theaters) but thought I'd chime in. No one has mentioned the food here. I've eaten there twice, once in the restaurant and once in the VIP seating. 
What a shame! After the planning and execution that went into building such a beautiful place, why is the food so mediocre. And that's being nice. 
The meal at the restaurant was poor. How do you screw up Italian? I had the gnocchi and it was dry and flavorless, and loaded with sea salt to try to hide it. Yes, the sandwich I had in the theater had on it what the menu said it would, but not much of it. Someone seemed to just have just gone through the motions of making a sandwich, without any thought to how appealing it may be, or how it would taste. My daughter had nothing nice to say about her order either.
They built a nice venue, charge healthy prices, now make an effort on the food! When the novelty wears off, people will still be apt to show up.
On a positive note, the coffee was good!

I just moved here and needed to be seen for a sinus infection. I brought a book expecting to wait. I walked in on a Saturday to an extremely clean and friendly place and was seen immediately. I got what I needed and was in and out before I could even open my book. Fantastic!

If you just want to go to dinner --hum drum, go somewhere else. BUT if you want excellent food and a place to make memories with your friends or family --go to this family run, unique, wonderful place! I recommend getting a reservation and if you can a get the porch--it's quiet and secluded (for 6-8+) The lamb is where it's at but everything is top notch. All the soups are so good and the geuto basque dessert is my favorite.

What an awesome place! The staff is super friendly and the food is too good to consider this place fast food! Love their vegan burger, too!

Hope the self-serve beer wall will be back up and running soon!

This is my go to place for waxing. I never leave disappointed because Courtney does such an amazing job. She has also given me a pregnancy massage which was also phenomenal. She is very professional and what I like most about her is she does not give off that phony dumb hair stylist vibe that seems too common in most Salons today. She is very knowledgable and dedicated to giving her client the best service.
Best Popeyes in town.  Big juicy pieces of chicken on my sandwich. Fast drive thru service.  Smiling customer service it was perfect!

So this is the second time we have come here and ordered something on the menu that actually wasn't on the menu. The first time the item on the menu was no longer available at that price, it was twice as much and the second time, they were out of the item we came for. We love other Popeye locations but we won't waste our time at this one anymore.

Service was lacking. Took quite a while for water and then a good 45 minutes for lunch to be served.  They were not busy. It was so cold in there as well. Food was not good and we love Thai but will not be back. So many better restaurants in the area to spend our money. 

Chicken and vegetables-  more Chinese than Thai. Really thick sweet brown sauce. Had to rinse the dish in our remaining soup broth and still couldn't eat it. Took the meat home to my dog, and he wouldn't even eat it. Hmmm...  Won't be back.

Four of us went there last week. Parking in the winter is a deterrent. Prices too high and food quality mediocre. Service was only fair. Perhaps our server was new and uninformed. Our DD drank only coke and was charged for each one. When we got the bill and asked the server about it, she said oh, it's a mistake and she adjusted the bill. I wonder how many times this "mistake" has been made and no one noticed? Bottom line is why pay a premium for a blah experience? Add it all up and with all the great restaurant options in the area, we won't be back.

Excellent! We travel around the country quite a bit and this one of the best sushi restaurants we've visited. Then fish is very fresh and they give you quite a bit of fish.  We will be coming back when we visit Boise again.
Spice has delicious Indian food! They also have great service. While I was waiting for my takeout order, they gave me water and some crackers. If you like Indian food, I definitely recommend Spice!

This place is cozy: dim lighting with a warm feel to it for the ambience.  I could tell their ingredients are fresh.  The staff are knowledgeable and friendly. They get in a great selection of seafood here.  I had croquettas, clam chowder, a butter fish for dinner, and green apple bread pudding.  The croquettas had a delicious flavor; however, I'm a meat eater and it was mostly filling with less than a tiny tiny bite of meat. If they could add more meat to this, it would be perfect for me.  The clam chowder was delicious- I would definitely order it again.  The butter fish was super delicate fish and buttery. The green apple pudding- this is something that can not be skipped. It's sooo delicious. Perfect flavors.  You have to call at least a week in advance for reservations- no last minute dining here. But when you do get in, you will find it a special treat!

If 10 stars were available that's what they would receive. This company is the best! Super responsive, extremely efficient, and very fair w pricing. I drove Ian crazy w my telephone calls, but he remained so professional and always available to answer my questions. I originally spoke to Corey w my first inquiry about using their company, again, very professional, friendly, and respectful. Ron and Seth moved my stuff from CA to Boise, both really nice, HARD WORKING guys! They were so respectful of my belongings, and took the extra care to ensure it was packed properly into the truck and to ensure things (legs on antique furniture) arrived in tact and not broken; THAT I really appreciated! The communication is the BEST!
You guys knocked it out of the park and would use you again ( and I will when my stuff needs to be moved from my storage unit) and recommend anyone to put their trust in these guys! They arrived on time as promised, and communicated all along the way enroute from CA to ID.

Thanks again, you all ROCK!
Robert in San Carlos

There are times when a review would be redundant and thus, unnecessary - this one of those times. When a dining establishment has 99.9% positive reviews and there are numerous of them, then why bother - just say "I concur"!

But I guess I should say something about Epi's - the food was excellent (I had the lamb chops, my wife had the steak medallions both cooked to perfection) yet as wonderful as the food was, it was outstripped by the service!!!!! The waitstaff at Epi's could be serving water in leaking cardboard cups and would give them 5 stars. Everyone we came in contact was well informed, extremely friendly and over the top helpful in making our dining experience something to remember.

That's it folks - don't miss this place in downtown Meridian.

Ordered a lot of food tonight and they forgot a couple of things from the order. At first it was kind of frustrating, but I had not realized that it was close to their closing hours. I brought up the mistake to the manager and he fixed the order quickly and kept a level-head during that last hectic hour. The food was great and I really appreciated how the staff and management handled the rush. 10/10 would go back

This is my second time review this place and honestly I'm not sure why we even came back after our last experiences. But my husband is from Florida and swears it's good food, which it might be but the staff is horrible, rude and not even wearing masks (regardless of how you feel about masks it is a mandate here). We ordered food to go, went to pick it up and halfway in between the restaurant and the car my husband noticed sauce from the wings was leaking out the side of the bag. He brought it into the car and noticed that half of his wings weren't even in the box, they were at the bottom of the bag. So we took the bag back inside and instantly the guy behind the counter said that it must have happened after we left the restaurant and called my husband a liar. He had no intention on fixing the issue and I finally just said I'd like my money back and they can keep the food. They did refund us and "cleaned" up the bag but they just put the wings from the bottom of the bag into a box. We won't be eating the food and we won't be coming back.
Some of the best food in the Treasure Valley with unparalleled service! The lamb stew is my personal favorite but you can't go wrong with anything on the menu.

The facility was clean and the staff were friendly. The massage therapists take the time to sit with you and discuss what type of massage and areas of focus you are interested in. I'm giving only Three Stars for two reasons: 1st - Before and after the back massage the therapist lays a hot towel on your back. While this feels nice at first, they leave it on your back far too long. It was a very unpleasant feeling having a cold, wet towel on your back - twice! When speaking to other clients, they experience the cold, wet towel on their back as well. 2nd - When it came to the scalp massage, my therapist Jan spent about two minutes just scratching my scalp. That was a big let down. Otherwise, the overall experience was decent and the pressure was good. I might be willing to visit again, but I will try a different therapist and I will speak up about the cold, wet towel.

Worst service ever.  Ordered a sectional and a dining set.  Took 2  months for the couch.  Then 3 days prior to the scheduled delivery for the dining set, they tell me they don't have it and it will be delayed another 2 weeks.  Glad I had the day off to be home for the delivery for them to cancel.  
So FINALLY they arrive with the dining set, one of the delivery guys smacks the table on the side of the truck on the way out.  Also there was paint missing/scratches on the chairs.  Had a tech come out a few days later to repair with touch up paint.  
A few days later, I notice there is paint overspray on one of the chairs.  So far I have left 4 messages, spoken to 2 managers, 1 store employee and countless emails.  After a week and a half I am told I need to wait up to 48 hours for the escalation team to contact me back.  I'm seriously about to dump these items on their doorstep and sue them after filing a claim with BBB.  
Do yourself a favor and steer far away from this place.  2 1/2 months to get 2 pieces of furniture and paying $3,000; they obviously don't give a sh** after they have your money.

I'll be Updating as the move rolls on... 

Earlier this week I reached out via Yelp message to Reliance Movers, Cameron was quick to respond (called me within 2 hours of my message being sent) he quoted me a price for what I was looking for and it was all inclusive (truck, blankets, tools, tear down/set up and labor) I felt the price was dead on accurate and fair (if not a bit underpriced) 

We set a date/time and I paid my $100 security deposit. Cameron made it very easy for me to handle this. The evening before the move date, Cameron text me to confirm the time he will be arriving. The next morning he arrived 15 mins early and introduced himself and his partner and got started right away. 

We're about 40 mins in to the move and they we are nearly done loading everything. Just a couple TV, Bed, and couch left.

The move started at 8am this morning and by 1030am everything was moved in to the new house and set up. Nothing scratched or dented. Cameron and Aaron handled business never once scoffed at the two staircases they had to go up n down and handled everything that was quoted without a hitch. Would most definitely recommend these guys and this company.

Our visits to CC is always amazing but this visit customer service wise (like I stated was amazing) but I'm giving 2 starts cuz I'm not happy with my little dudes cut.... Last time we had Erica and this time we had Jessie and I'm not happy. She was SUPER SWEET but we wanted the same cut Erica gave us but it was so different (same picture) and almost uneven and nothing like I showed her ;( I'm super bummed cuz we come here every month so when spending $25 ish bucks for a 18 month old haircut you want it perfect. I'll make sure on my own end to only book with Erica. Apart from this visit tho COOKIE CUTTERS IS AMAZING AND SO IS THERE STAFF just not happy with the outcome of my sons hair.

Horrible experience with them and Spyderco on a exclusive knife nether Jeff or Spyderco solved the problem and now I have a blade that can't be resharpen in a kme system that works on all my other blades so never again

Izumi is my favorite! My youngest daughter and I have been going there for years. Not only do they make the most flavorful sushi I've ever had, but the people who work there are top notch. From the chefs, to the wait staff, to the managers, they always make us feel special. A+++

I place an order to go and was really disappointed in the portion sizes. My curry was only half the container, if that. The rice was a little to go container that had rice all over the outside and the rice on the inside looked like it had been burnt. Parts were discolored and brown and dry. I did a summer rolls too. Thy were ok but there wasn't much filling in them to make the worth $9 for a combo roll. That's $3 per roll. I was told that it would be 15 minuets when I placed the order. Then after I arrived I was told that it would be another 10-15. I would have preferred if they did car side delivery seeing as multiple people I saw walk into the restaurant were not wearing mask at all. Include one worker that had to return to their vehicle for their mask.
We had an old Dyson that needed a new roller bar, belt and filter.  Within a few days the vacuum was returned to us as good as new.  Great place and up front on repair costs.

First time at Inspire and I was thoroughly impressed. I had a Swedish massage with Joy and she was nothing short of amazing. This is a full service salon and spa and while I didn't see the whole salon, what I saw was great. High quality products, lots of organic skin care which I love. The pedicure area is cool, I've never seen a set up like that. The spa area is quiet, comfortable, and clean. I also love that the salon is open concept when you walk in, I hate when I am having my hair done and the salon and reception area are kind of one big space. Inspire seems to be broken up so each type of service must have its own area. The spa is decorated nicely, modern clean style and I think the prices are very reasonable. The other awesome thing is they are open on Sunday, where I live you would never find a salon/spa open on a Sunday so this was awesome. I do not live in Meridian or even Idaho, which is probably a good thing or I would be here every week. I highly recommend!

I want to love this place.  I've given it 3 chances and can't say that I'll ever go back.  What my friend and I experienced yesterday was downright embarrassing and inexcusable for Bodovino.  Sadly, it was my friend's 1st time, and I don't think she'll ever try it again, or recommend it to others. 

We arrived around 5:45 (Happy Hour), upon walking in there was LITERALLY no employees (this is not an exaggeration); the entire restaurant was full except one corner table, and not an employee in sight. We, while looking around unsure of what to do, sat ourselves.  A few minutes later a very overwhelmed bearded older gentleman appeared from what I assume is the kitchen, and it was VERY clear right away he was doing the work of what should have been 5-6 employees.   We sat at the table, unsure if we were even "supposed" to seat ourselves, the single employee looked my way a few times but never acknowledged us.  I walked up to the counter and he, in an annoyed way, said he'd be that way.  Eventually he made it over to us to bring water, but no mention of taking our order was made and he never came back to take our order. 

Eventually, after watching him help and take orders of 4 groups that walked in after us (they ordered from the counter....is that what we were "supposed" to do?   Who knows) we went to the counter to order. 

I re-filled my Bodovino Wine Card (had a few cents on it from a prior visit and was still charged the $3 activation fee....is this even right?), I also ordered an Idaho flat bread and a house salad, however, the single employee was so overwhelmed, side tracked, distracted and incapable of doing it all that he ignored me twice, repeated back the wrong order, and overcharged me.  I don't think he could focus on ONE customer if he tried because he was doing it ALL.  

My friend, standing behind me, purchased her first wine card, and also 2 happy hour food items.   When the food arrived he ONLY brought mine and brought her a "plate to share".  She reminded him she had ordered and paid for her own items; annoyed, he said he forgot and said he would go put her order in.  So, we waited for her food while mine got cold. 

By this time we are beyond upset and thought it couldn't get worse, but it did. 

I get up to make my 1st wine selection, however, the wine bottle runs out half pour, when I tell the employee he LITERALLY ignored me, so when he saw I didn't walk away from the counter, I repeated myself and he said "I'll refill it when I have time" and I said "I paid for it", then his exact words were "It's a smart machine, it didn't charge you".  So, thinking it didn't charge me I put my card back in for another selection and YES, it had charged me.  It wasn't worth dealing with the overwhelmed, rude, overly busy single employee so I just dealt with it and took the loss.  Clearly the machines aren't as "smart" as he thinks they are. 

A while into eating the same employee walked over to our table and asked if we were "ready for the check?"   We looked at him confused because we both ordered from him, at the counter, and already paid.  So, not only did this show he's not waiter material, how overwhelmed he was, it also left us SO confused because is it a counter service or table service restaurant?  Does anyone even know? Does it change nightly?  Does it just depend on how upset you get at your table after not getting service so you get service at the counter?  I still don't know.  

Side note: 3 bottles of "half price" happy hours wines were empty. 

Anyhow, we left and laughed; it was THAT bad.  We are simple gals, not hard to please us, but this was just bad, bad. 
 
How does a restaurant at the Village, especially during happy hour only have ONE employee working?   And, let's, for a second pretend every other employee called in sick or took a break at the same time........at least ensure the single employee running the entire joint has customer service skills. He didn't.
Verry fresh seafood with great presentations. Staff excellent with superb service.

Ordered a pizza and dessert pizza online, had a friend pick it up and they forget to give her the dessert pizza.  I call and speak with a guy named Brody and he says, "Ohhh you forgot it."  My reply, "no, you forgot it.."  Brodie, "ya, send her back over."  I inform him that we are watching the NFC championship.  "Well I don't know what to tell ya.."  My response, "how about you start with how you are going to refund that amount!?!?"  He puts another guy on and neither know how to do a refund.
What an amazing experience, the service and food are absolutely amazing! The story of this little place will tug on your heart! Must go check it out!!!

DO NOT I repeat DO NOT take your pets here if you care about their well being! I came here with the hopes they could figure out what the rash was on my dogs stomach. They told me it was just a little "skin irritation". They prescribed me two different medications that didn't seem to do anything. He seemed to be getting worse & I kept taking him in. They kept telling me he was fine, well it got so bad one morning I had to rush him to All Valley in the early am for an emergency! Fast forward one month LPM pretty much gave up and pawned us off to another vet. West Vet did all they could regardless off being one month behind on my dogs injury. We had to put our sweet boy down & couldn't even get an "I'm sorry for your loss" from Linder Pet Medical ( and we know they were aware of our dog since WestVet told them what happened). I'm sure they will comment on this review trying to "defend themselves" but they know what they did & I couldn't even get an simple apology.

chris made our celebration for our grandson graduation from bosie state a stellar donning experience 
our baked cod was food for kings as was the braised pork 
the best bread red bean soup and delish salad  are all helped by marvelous basque red wine 
perfect hospitality and best basque food 
we fly in from pasadena ca and always make a res ahead it is imperative !! 
we also went to cottonwood restaurant and gino's 
epi's was the best of the weekend

We did door dash twice and it was great! Chile verde burrito is awesome! Also had the taco's. Delicious! The beans and rice are also very good. Our daughters favorite is the El mayor combo and wife loves the enchilada trio.
I have been calling for 2 days to make a reservation for next week & no one answers the phone. It's very irritating. Please have someone answering your phones.

Husband and I stopped by while we were out doing errands one Sunday. Some friends recommended this place and I would say it was good and portions were good.  More of an upscale place, great bar & drinks and the workers were very nice.  My only complaint is that everything was a little over sauced for my liking.  I prefer to sauce it myself and sometimes just eat  my ribs and brisket with no sauce.  Next time I know to make that request!  We tried the brisket, pulled pork, sausage, chicken and ribs all were very tender and tasty.  If you like sauce on the side just make sure you tell them!

I chose Floral Creations based on reviews and location for our son's wedding. I was so lucky! The bouquets were elegant and creative. The flowers were fragrant, unique, colorful, and super fresh. It all beautifully complemented the wedding attire from the flower choices to the ribbons. I received personalized service from the owner, Marci, and her staff which put me at ease. With only 2 days notice, the team made wonderful suggestions and created the entire floral spray - bridal and 4 bridesmaids bouquets, 5 boutonnieres, 3 corsages. Hours before the wedding, Marci put together a boutonniere we forgot and waited 2 hours past closing so we could retrieve it. We couldn't have been happier. I highly recommend this lovely shop!
Excellent service. Bought a handgun and they were super helpful in guiding me to the best decision. Everyone is wearing a face mask so it's pretty COVID friendly, as well.

We have been here twice ; the first time we had just sushi and the second time we tried habachi. We have two kids as well and we did not feel uncomfortable at all. The atmosphere is great and the appearance is very elegant. Recently at our last visit we had habachi and the kids loved it. The cook put on a fun show and took time to make the kids laugh. We were so pleased with our experience we are still talking about it. We had a mix of lobster, filet mingon, shrimp and chicken and I was very impressed with the lobster is was so flavorful. The lychee martini was spectacular as well! It was neither too sweet or bitter. We had Jackie as our server both times and she was on top of it the entire time. This is a new family favorite.
Have enjoyed Zupas but the soup apparently has MSG. I'm on day 3 of Migraine set off by their soup. They advertise as House Made so you expect natural ingredients.

I tried to buy a table. The salesman basically refused to let me buy it unless I paid an extra $100 for their extended warranty. After telling him over and over again that I did not want the warranty, he continued to just respond by telling me how great their extended warranty was and I shouldn't pass it up. I finally had to just leave the store without even buying the table. The salesman was very angry towards me. It was very awkward and creepy. I later called and spoke with the store manager, who's response was to let me know how great their extended warranty was... Seems like if they push so hard for an extended warranty, they clearly have no faith in their product.

Prompt, polite, professional and careful!!! They completed their work quickly and put everything exactly where requested!!! Thank you Valley Custom Moving for reasonable pricing, great customer service and s painless move!!! I will highly recommend you!!!

Our tile in our bathroom was unfinished so we gave handyman connections a call. They were fast in giving us a call back and recommending Todd. Todd made sure to take the necessary time and work into making our bathroom look exceptional. Thank you for going above and beyond. Also the price for 5 hrs of work wasn't bad at all! Would recommend giving them a call.

We ordered today's internet special...2 burgers and steak fries for $10. Our food was brought to the car in a timely fashion. It was still hot. The burgers were seasoned well and cooked perfectly. The buns were fresh as were all the toppings, fresh tomato, onion, pickles and shredded lettuce. The steak fries were crisp. Tucked in the take away bag was a couple of brownies that were small but tasty. We thought about eating in a park but decided not to as there was only one napkin included in the order. All in all it was an above average experience and a very good value for the price.

My husband and I have been here a few times, spaced out longer than we'd like, and never got around to writing a review. We are new fans of this place and will continue to visit. The service has always been quick, friendly, and our food has always arrived as ordered and delicious. Pricing is great too, they don't skimp on portions.

The first couple of visits we enjoyed the drunken noodles, green curry, summer rolls, and lettuce wraps. I remember the lettuce wraps being especially good, and they brought us out more lettuce leafs to take leftovers home.

We didn't have dinner planned on Thursday, May 30th and decided to visit Thai Basil again. We got there right at opening, there was another car already waiting. Their happy hour included B2G1 on beer or Sake which we of course participated in. 

We had a few beers, a bowl of Tom Yum Koong, Cha Gio, and summer rolls. They give you some complimentary fried wontons that have a sugar coating on them. The wontons are a nice treat while you wait for your food. 

Our soup came first and we were amazed!! It is hands down in the top 3 soups I have ever tasted. There are massive shrimp cooked perfectly, I believe our bowl had four or six. Mushroom mix is bomb and the broth is to die for. I've been craving this soup since.

We were also surprised at how many Cha Gio we were given. They were nice and crispy and about what you'd expect.

The summer rolls were delicious, too. They satisfied the craving and seemed super fresh.

Delicious and a very personable dining experience.  Family run and you can feel it.  Definitely a restaurant to support, they post on Facebook so you can follow along for seasonal dishes and chef surprises!  Do go, you won't forget your experience there and you will very much enjoy the food.  I have no idea where my photos went?  Sorry.  Had a beautiful piece of halibut in lobster sauce, impossibly tender veal shank, calamari & French fries.  All excellent.

I wouldn't go any where else! I take both my home and business vacuums to their establishment for both general service or a complete overhaul. They are the reason why my vacuums have been working for longer than they should. The best!! Bar none!!!

It would have probably been a decent experience shopping for furniture had the salesman not literally followed us around the ENTIRE store today! SOOOO UNCOMFORTABLE.

Update: I do not want to be bothered by this store. Several messages in less than one week is as uncomfortable as the stalking salesman.

We are new to the area and I'm so happy we found Cookie Cutters in Meridian!

I have 5 year old triplets...2 boys and 1 girl. All
3 had severe grown out quarantine hair!! 

I was able to make the appointments online which was a total time saver.

On the day of our appointment which was August 3, 2020 we walked into the salon with our masks on and we were greeted by a welcoming staff, who were also wearing masks.

Our stylist was LaShawnda.... she started with my son James, she asked me what I wanted her to do and I told her a short gentleman's cut and she cut his hair perfectly! I also liked the fact that she called me over after she was done with his haircut and made sure that it was what I asked for.   She then cut my other son, Coopers hair...again perfectly. 

Another stylist...I don't remember her name...cut my daughter Sophia's hair but never called me over to check the haircut and went ahead and styled it. The style was super cute but I was a little bummed that I couldn't see the actual haircut.  Next time I will have LaShawnda cut all 3 of my kids hair.

The kids loved picking out their own lollipop and balloon after their haircuts were done! We will definitely be back!

Love
Catered my wedding, the food is that good. That doesn't even touch on the glowing friendly caring environment of dining in.

Thai Basil is quickly becoming a new favorite/takeout staple in our house. The yellow curry is sooooooooo flavorful and delicious. I had never seen pineapple in yellow curry before moving to Boise, but it works! 

The cream cheese puffs & egg rolls are so dang tasty with the slightly spicy plum dipping sauce. I'm obsessed.

Last time visiting. I'd resigned myself to occasionally dealing with the lackluster food because they're usually very fats. But today I drove through and no one was masked. I get its the tail end of this pandemic but still...not going back, ever. 

Leave out the fact that the burgers generally look like the attached pic. Also, I ordered no onions. Thats just enough for me, no thanks.

I just went into Chip at Meridian Village to buy some cookies. Not a single employee was wearing a mask. Handling food, no masks. I will never go back. If they don't care enough about their customers' health and safety to wear protective masks, they don't deserve my business. Would obviously give zero stars if that were an option.

If you live in Boise, chances are you know all about the majestic 'Village' with beautiful water features, gorgeous plants and flowers, restaurants and shops. One of the biggest perks in my opinion of the 'Village' is the movie theater. You can enjoy shopping, dining, and relaxing all in one amazing area. 

My favorite thing about the theater are the reclining seats. For someone like me who is in chronic pain and nausea, being able to stretch my legs out and lay back is essential. We only go to this theater now for this specific reason. The theater is always clean including bathrooms, floors, and chairs. 

My one complaint is the fact that the automatic ticket machines are ALWAYS broken. Also, if you buy your ticket in advance it gives you a barcode that you can show on your phone. However, this theater is not with the technology of today which means the ticket person has to literally write the barcode number down on a piece of paper. One evening, which was particularly busy, the 8.5/11 sheet of paper was filled top to bottom, in the margins, on the back, not one white space left. These poor employees! Get them a scanner!! Their website also feels very outdated. This cinema really needs to step it up in that department. 

Otherwise, we have not had any bad experiences and it is by far our favorite theater. Can't beat $5 Tuesday night specials!

Bad salespeople taken to the extreme. The person we had basically held our hand from the moment we got into the store to the moment we ran out of there. I've heard similar experiences from family.

The management either needs to adjust their compensation policies, or they should tell their staff to give their customer's some breathing room.

The furniture (couches and tables) were very uncomfortable, and VERY expensive. As an example: they are selling fake plants for $800. And they didn't even look particularly nice. Absolutely insane.

Look for furniture elsewhere.
Bought a gun here. I shot that gun. It worked. Came back a few times and bought bullets to go into the gun I bought from here. The bullets worked. That's all I need.

Incredible value and service.  They cut down a huge poplar tree and removed numerous stumps for a jaw dropping price.  Professional and safe crew onsite with all the right equipment, and they left no mess whatsoever.  Highly recommend this team.

Ashley Furniture is A Joke. I purchased a lift chair about 6 months or less. I purchased the warranty as well. The chair support is broken down. They had a guy who came and over stuffed it. With myself having my right hip replacement in May 2020, my left in July 2020, and emergency back surgery in Sept 2020. When the guy added the stuffing in the chair, I had no idea it would be the worse thing ever for my back. My back Spazzed out from the overstuffed chair. I've had to go to the doctors twice due to the extreme pain from back spasms, with this chair being over stuffed.  
This chair is my life line. 
Support is Key!!
So I thought for sure Ashley would back up their product and since I spent extra for the Warranty. Nope. They said Sorry, you over used your chair. Wow. Your kidding me. Don't Buy from Ashley's. It took me over ten calls and four days to get anyone to respond and call me back. Plus to hear them say I'm sorry were unable to help you for people don't sit in a chair often. I'm not a heavy person or even a big person. What the heck. 
I should of ordered from Wayfair. Their warranty is much better than, an oh well ... to bad from Ashley. Advoid this place at all cost.

DO NOT GO HERE.  Ordered something had it backordered then they failed to deliver it multiple times after it was in store.  The customer service made me want to jump off twin falls and I would rather get trench foot than ever order from here again
They didn't honor the prices on the drink menu. Said they were in the process of updating their menus and charged us more than what was on the menu. Horrible business practice.

The girl working on our food had really long stringy hair hanging down into the food she was preparing. The soda machine was not working. She knew this before selling us a drink because when I went back to let her know, her response was "yeah, we know. It needs to be fixed."  Then went back to doing whatever it was she was doing. Never fixed it. But it seems like if you have no intention of fixing it, at least tell people it doesn't work before selling them a soda cup. But going back to the hair issue, I watched her make the food and drag her hair across multiple things. I feel like that should maybe be a health code violation.

The guys who actually do the work for Republic Services here in Nampa are great.  They are usually very helpful and polite.

However the same can NOT be said for the women who answer their phone.   I've only called Republic Services twice in the last three years and both times the females who answered the phone were "curt" and frankly just plain rude BOTH times.   There is no need for someone like that to represent your business IMO.

I missed a payment and the called me. I authorized them to pay the balance off and thought it was done. Two months later they tell me I missed my last two payments because instead of paying the entire balance they only charged me 230 of the 250 I owed. Then said I owed two late payments and when I asked for a copy of the first recorded call that I authorized the entire payment on they said they couldn't give it to me. Kohls is a horrible place to do credit. They are shady as f*.

This place is perfect for the village.  Had a couple glasses of wine and some appetizers before a movie.  Perfect.  Can sit inside or outside.  The appetizers were excellent.  The wine selection was pretty good.  A little expensive but like the taster option.   Definitely will be going there again.  Service was good place was very clean.  The sample pours are to expensive for what you get.  Same with full glass: hence only 4 out of 5 stars.

My wife and I bought the Sealy Memory Foam Mattress at this store. We also bought the adjustable base so out bill came to 10 grand.

Even though it was high, we decided that our sleep was worth it, so we were more than happy to drop this much. The sales guy seemed like he was looking out for us and not just the commission from the sale.

The bed was delivered and we slept on it the 1st night. My wife had such a poor nights sleep that she refused to sleep on it again. 

For me, I was determined to give the mattress more time. Surely it would get better, right?

Wrong. For the next 5 nights, I was in Mattress Hell. I finally gave up and called our sales person. I told him that the mattress slept really hot and was the worst nights sleep I had ever had. I was probably getting 4 hours sleep, or less a night. 

I told him that I just could not do it anymore. I had given up and was now sleeping on the couch. I also told him my wife's back and neck were hurting and she refused to sleep on this brick even 1 more night.

The sales guy asked me how hot I kept our room. Yeah, you caught me Mr sales guy. I deliberately turned the heat in my room up so I could say the mattress was hot and have an excuse to return it. I am of course kidding but I could not understand why he would ask such a ding dong question.

Now, if he had said something like; "Thats terrible Mr Dacus. Do not spend 1 more night on that bed. We want you to have the best nights sleep, not the worst. We will get a truck out there tomorrow to pick that thing up. Just come into our store and we will set you up with something else".

If he had said that, or something like it, I would have thought to myself that to Mattress Firm and him, I was a person and not just a sale. I would have done everything I could to find a different mattress at their store. 

But the sales guy did not say this or anything like it. He gave us a song and dance. At 1st, he said we had to sleep on the mattress for 30 days. When I told him this was not going to happen, and would he please see what he could do, he told us that the problem was because we had financed it and the place that was financing it had not processed the sale yet. So it was not possible for them to do a refund.

I had a feeling that the sales guy was blowing smoke up my you know where. So I called the finance company and they said that it had nothing to do with them. It was Mattress Firm that was holding things up. So I called my sales guy back up and called his bluff. He then said to go into the store and they would schedule the pick up and do the refund.

We went into the store, but things got worse. One of the reasons we went with Mattress Firm was because they told us if we did not like the mattress and had to get a refund, it would only cost us $70. 

Well, the guy at the store (He said he was the assistant manager) told us that the Mattress Cover was $200 charge. We had no clue on this. We had never been told that the Mattress cover was something we had to buy, or would be charged to us if we had to return the bed. 

I am not positive what all he deducted from our refund, because he never gave us any sort of receipt for these charges. He just told us that Mattress Firm was charging us $300 for the return!

Uh $300! What happened to the $70 return charge we were promised? We were told that the $70 was just for the Mattress. He did not cover non-returnable items. 

Can you say Bait and Switch Mattress Firm?

My advice is that if you are considering buying a mattress from here, to be careful. Ask lots of questions and be sure to check all the fine print.

This is absolutely the worst trash collection service and transfer station I have ever dealt with in my entire life.  It starts off with their trucks that come around once a week and while they are attempting to pick up my garbage, there is always trash left in my street that hangs on the truck. 

I actually make a trip in to the office and ask them may I please have additional cans, and they tell me that the larger cans are not available at the moment. So I tell them OK I will wait until they are available don't bring me the little ones. And within 24 hours I have two little ones sitting in front of my curb.
And god for bid you actually bring anything to their transfer station, you will wait in line, and talk to a smart mouth clerk, that is they're charging you $22 for some random household trash. We're not talking appliances lawnmowers water heaters barbecues tires, none of that trash. 50% of it had to be cardboard.
Today I decided to take some cardboard down there and get it recycled, about 15 flattened boxes the sign says free, but the clerk said nope it's going to be $11 for you sir. 
So now, I think I will put a call into corporate, because it is blatantly obvious that management in this location is of piss poor quality
Excellent service & amazing pedicure! Very clean inside and out wonderful massage chairs!

This place was great, place was clean, waitresses are super friendly and the food was delicious. Our waitress McKenzie came around many times to make sure we we were good and drinks filled. Super happy with service! Will definitely come again.
Worst food!  Fries were under cooked and greasy.   There was nothing even good about any of the food.  Had nachos, chips were stale.  I could go on and on.  Total waste of money, would never go back.

This is the best place for kids haircuts!  My daughter doesn't like anyone to touch her and our stylist Keely was AMAZING!!! this was our daughters first time getting a professional haircut and it couldn't have gone better.  The entire staff was wondering and they were all working very hard.  The place was clean and they sanitized the chairs in between clients.  Highly recommend and will definitely see Keely again!
Always great service and great food.  Very very friendly staff, only drawback is that they are always busy but honestly they are really that good
I normally don't gravitate to BBQ places, but I'd return here in a heartbeat. Excellent atmosphere, excellent service, and excellent food.

I have been eating here since 2008 and I have to say they are one of the most consistent restaurants in the entire valley.  The food is always great, service excellent, and the beer is cold.  This is an extremely well managed restaurant.  Alway great...every time!

Where to begin? We ordered a bed frame (Headboard, Footboard, Rails) in early July. The estimated delivery was already three weeks out, which is insane, but we waited. Two weeks passed, and we got a call from Customer Service that not all parts were available, and it would be delayed to an undetermined date. We told them we wanted to cancel, so we were transferred to the store. Side note: Why does Ashley Furniture pass the buck constantly? So... told the store we wanted to cancel, and magically they had the parts and it would be delivered the next week. Fast forward to Wednesday when the bed was dragged in to the house in all of it's cardboard and broken styrofoam glory. Opening it up, we immediately saw the corner of the headboard was chipped so we would have to file a warranty claim. After setting everything out, we learned the side rails were incorrect, and not at all what went with the other pieces. They matched, but they were not the correct parts and there was no way to attach. Calling customer service we finally reached a gentleman in Arizona who confirmed what we already knew - it was wrong, and - THE PIECES WE NEEDED ARE UNAVAILABLE AND LIKELY TO NEVER BE AVAILABLE. We were told we had to call the store to initiate the return. The store manager was utterly useless, telling us to call Customer Service. Finally, we went in to the store with customer service on the phone to get one of the two to actually do their job and help. Multiple calls after we now have a pick up scheduled one week out of this giant piece of crap that cannot be put together. So we get to store the giant boxes for a week, and we will not be refunded - for their mistake - until after they receive the pieces back. When we wanted to leave this review on the Ashley website, we read all of the posting rules, which essentially state that you cannot post a negative review. If this store manager and the salesperson who (we think) knowingly ordered the wrong piece are still employed there by the end of the Summer, I will assume that Ashley Furniture encourages this type of service and behavior. I am writing this review because I would advise everyone to go somewhere - anywhere else. We purchased a similar product from a competitor, cheaper, and will have it installed before these useless bags of skin pick up their pile of junk. Have I mentioned I despise this store and their "manager"? Go elsewhere, and encourage others to do the same.

We love the doctors (Dr. Anderson & Dr. Ormand) and technicians and staff at Linder Pet Medical
Our 3 Schnauzers receive excellent care at reasonable prices. First we brought 8 year old Brandy here for a dental cleaning. They did a great job with no complications or concerns. We joined the $300/yr program that includes her dental cleaning, immunizations, office visits, and more! 
So we brought our 12 year old Martini in. Again excellent care. Dr Anderson discovered high liver enzymes and urinary crystals. He's now on a different diet and medication...recheck of his condition is in 2 weeks so we hope for good results. 
Now Holly our 15 yr old is drinking a lot of water and lost her appetite. We brought her in today and Dr Ormand gave her a physical check and ordered blood work. Because she's on the wellness plan, todays visit was completely covered. 
My dogs were previously with River City where they received great care and the vets are excellent...but their costs and up selling of extra services was excessive. 
I highly recommend Linder Pet

This place is nice, but the rooms are very small, even the ones with kitchenettes. Our family of two adults and a baby could barely fit all of our luggage inside for a weekend! Also, the advertisement said breakfast was included with our booking, but there was no breakfast to be found. There was very little staff around at any hour, so it was hard to ask questions or get any help. Fo the price, I wouldn't stay here again. It felt like motel service at a hotel price.

I was recommended this place and initially it said it was closed but when I looked on the restaurant website it said it was open so I decided to drive and take a chance. And I am so glad I did!
Amazing margarita!!!!  
Amazing food, had a combo with carne asada, carnitas and chili relleno. The carnitas was amazing! Also had a taste of the guacamole which is awesome. 
Had an amazing waiter (tony I think) who had a fun personality and made sure to talk with everyone. He kept on top of everyone's order and likes. Just super fun. 
I will be returning. Again and again.

Dr Jacob Smith is the MOST PROFESSIONAL AND PRO ACATIVE doctor I have had the pleasure to work with in ages. We have searched the valley looking for a family physician for a great while before finding him . Thank goodness

I am new to the area and miss my sushi.  I tried out the sashimi entree and was pleasantly surprised.  The pieces of fish were very large and flavorful.  The price was well worth every penny.  I can't wait to go back and try something else.

Best Thai. The food is so fresh, made to order, the service is amazing. Great atmosphere, clean, and perfect. I'm so happy to have found this little gem visiting from Denver. I will be back! Denver is a foodie city but this restaurant definitely belongs out there and is even better than most Thai places in Colorado.

Ordered a simple pizza tonight.  Order was to be ready at a little after 7pm.  I pulled up to the drive thru and the clerk said they were a little behind and to just pull forward to wait.  As I was waiting, I watched 3 cars pull through the drive thru and get their orders and 2 ppl walk up and grab their orders (about 5-10 mins after I'd been waiting).  After waiting 20 mins past when it was supposed to be ready, I go into the store.  I see a stack of pizzas ready as one kid is cleaning the prep station.  The shift manager and another worker were in the back doing whatever but they clearly weren't working.  I asked where my order was since I'd been waiting 20 mins already after their 30 min preparation time.  His excuse was that they got busy and they got confused with the orders.  Wow, a shift manager got confused with orders and his team is completely disorganized while they have customers waiting on them to figure it out.  Not impressive at all, and since apparently there are no adults working maybe the store manager/owner should have some adult supervision because these kids apparently can't handle the responsibility.
Wonderful and amazing team! Professional and friendly and efficient from start to finish. If you're moving, you need these guys. Reasonably priced, on time, fast and so nice to work with!
This place is so wonderful! I love taking my 6 and 4 year old to get their wiggles out. The facilities are always clean and the staff is always friendly.

This place is great ! Ana is amazing. I love my brows thanks to Ana. She was professional and personable. Great pricing too. She is patient and really took her time to do a great job. Explained everything as she went.  Facility is clean and cute ' can't wait to go back.

Do not use this company. I am heartbroken at the damage done by Done Rite Tree Company. The first visit, they didn't do as promised in the quote and trimmed the wrong tree. Then, when they returned, they butchered the tree that was supposed to be trimmed, cutting off major branches that provided shade and privacy in our backyard. They broke a trellis that had a 12-year old clematis growing on it. There is no way to repair the damage that they did.

Amazing! Called yesterday after a groomer put rubber band bows on my dogs ears (around the actual ear - tightly) they got me in quickly - fixed our pup (she lost some ear lobe ) They were loving and sympathetic most importantly to my dog but to me as well!! Thank you for top notch service

Awful!!! Horrible customer service and no help at all!!! The man who helped me was rude and didn't even try to fix my problem. He told me to call customer service. (The reason I am in the store is because my phone doesn't work.) I will be going to another location to cancel service soon.

WOW, what a professional and high-tech office.  In one visit, Dr. Harker was able to create a crown AND resurface my two front teeth.  The resurfacing was scheduled on-the-fly and it looks completely natural, matching the surrounding teeth perfectly.  I've also had a teeth cleaning done at this office, which was painless and gentle.  All of the staff is professional and courteous. 
I highly recommend the service at this dental practice.  They really deserve 10 stars!

I've been going to the village cinema since its launch. I've been very happy with the theater and it's business model. Village Cinema offers seat selection so you'll know exactly where you'll be seated before even getting into the room. This removes stress from ordering concessions and if you pre purchase online it gives a great sense of comfort. 

Several times I've had customers in my purchased seats. I won't mark off the cinema for the complete lack of respect these people have, but that can be a downside. It creates an awkward situation and I personally don't give up my seats. 

I now also only sit Vip. The larger seats. Better viewing angle and drink selection is unbeatable. I have had issues with people thinking this is their living room and holding conversations. Just because it's a smaller section doesn't give you the right to talk! 

They also offer $5 Tuesday movies. Can't beat that price. Hopefully I'll see you at the cinema.

My moving crew (KJ, Jackio, etc.) were amazing! These guys were insanely efficient, reliable, and just all around KIND people to work with.

VCM is the only company I've heard of with a ~2 Day turnaround from pickup/delivery from CA to ID. Moving across the country is challenging, stressful, and exhausting but VCM truly made this a very pleasant experience.

Thank you for not only a wonderful experience but for also being an honest, caring, and professional moving company.

The women and men here are so professional and they really care. I am so great full that places like this are open I would have had no where to go and no one to turn to. Thank you and your staff for being so kind and understanding during this hard time for me! I left with the knowledge and information I need to continue to live a healthy happy life! Bless you!
Good food! Fun atmosphere, great service and authentic Mexican food. We will be back.

I have an older commercial walk-behind mower that got difficult to start and rough running. I took it first to a local factory service center. They charged me $$ for a diagnosis and told me it was old and had low compression. I needed a new engine. I took it to D&B and they said it would be three weeks before they could get to it because they had many customers ahead of me. It was winter so I left it. When I picked it up they had done a tune-up, blade sharpening (two-blades) and said it was just a dirty carb. They also replaced the filters and spark plug. The cost was very reasonable. This weekend was the reveal to see how it would run. It started on the third pull and ran better than it has in years. I will be back for regular end of season servicing. The quality and value of the work was terrific!

Amazing atmosphere, all tables had a great view of the water fountain outside the village. I've never tried wine before and wanted to have an introduction to wines I would enjoy. Larry took the time to show us each section they had, and the best wine for us to start out with. Not only that but educated us on what each wine was best to pair with, where it was from, and why it tasted the way it did. Truly a great experience, will definitely be returning.

My dad does construction work and often dumps wood refuse at the location off Franklin in Meridian. His trailer doesn't change in size but the amount he pays (even though he loads the trailer close to same every time) does. On 5/24 in the morning, this older, skinny man approached my dad and said $60. My dad said "I was here yesterday and it was $45." The man answered simply: "$75". My dad said: "Can you at least measure it?" The man answered: "$90". My dad asked to speak to a supervisor. Skinny man got on walkie talkie and another man cam to speak to him. After they spoke for a length of time, he came to my dad and said he would measure the trailer. He measured the refuse from highest point on trailer and did not count the "holes" (where refuse simply dips since it is not all square and even"). My dad asked him "Do you think that is right?" The man said "You are right, 4 cubic yards." My dad agreed simply to get going even though it was still going to be $60. Once he got to pay, he got his card out and in return was given a receipt for 4 cubic yards AND 1 yard of M&S for another $13, total of $73 (Weighmaster Alan P.). My dad used a different entrance to the same yard, with similar load and no issues $45 (Weighmaster Linda N.). The day before similar load and no issues $45 (Weighmaster Honor D.). I will say that my dad has a heavy accent and cannot help but think that this was an absolute discrimination because I know he would not dare talk to me (his son with no accent) OR any other American without accent. I am disgusted. I have no words to describe my anger. All of the above is factual with pictures of loads and receipts in hand.

Definitely recommend calling to make a reservation ahead of time. There is very limited seating so if you just show up you were not likely to get a table. In addition if you make a reservation don't show up early because they will ask you to wait until your reservation time.

Restaurant is very cozy and seating is not 6 feet apart.  However they do sanitizing between guests and change table cloth linens.  

Staff is very friendly and accommodating.  I think they do an amazing job considering the small space that they're working in. 

Tonight we ordered Croquettes and  the mushrooms for an appetizer.  For dinner my husband ordered the meatballs and I ordered the fillet medallions. Each entrée comes with a soup and a salad and a side of rice.  Be sure to specify if you have a shellfish allergy so your rice can come with veggies instead of shrimp.  For dessert my husband got the flan and I tried to Gateau. 

My most favorite part of our meal where the croquettes.  The legend is true, there is good as what everybody says they are!  I really could have made a meal just on those! They really were the highlight and the star of the night.

The mushrooms we're good flavorful and had a good sauce. 

Our salad-  it had an amazing vinaigrette house dressing on it that was light and citrusy and very tasty.  The proportion was perfect in the amount of salad dressing was perfect.  

My red bean soup was delicious! The portion size was very generous for a cup of soup.  I really enjoyed that.   My husband had the clam chowder and he said it was pretty good.

The fillet medallions were covered in a flavorful white sauce and this side of rice and vegetables was generous and tasted pretty good.  My hubby said the meatballs were excellent. 

Dessert was pretty good as well the flan had a very nice caramel sauce over it which gave it a very tasty sweet flavor.  The Gateau Was pretty dense, almost hard to eat but the raspberry sauce on the plate was excellent. 

This was our first time here and it was really nice.  I would definitely recommend going.  

However as a sidenote I don't think I would recommend taking small children since there is not a lot of room and it is such a small seating area.

I recently went in with my 4 year old to pick out some flowers to make into barrettes for her hair. I have purchased many other flower here over the course of her life and love their variety. 

We spent time looking thought the piles and baskets full of flowers, when my daughter began dancing around as if she had to use the restroom. I went to the counter with my kid visibly doing the pee dance and asked if she could use the bathroom, to my dismay the employee said we don't have a public bathroom. My response was shock, I have taken scrapbook classes at the store in the past and there is a bathroom available. I understand no public restrooms for adults but to deny a small child who obviously is about to have an emergency, is beyond my comprehension. Needless to say I left the mess of flowers on the counter and exited the store. I will not make another purchase here again.

Good customer service goes along way and this was completely unexceptable.

It is not the best one we have been, but I think it may be considered alright in the area.  It is small, but clean.  Staff members were friendly and helpful.
We like the big comfy couches to sit on while waiting.

Although it is small, I would still recommend staff members to be around each jumping area as to monitor and for precaution

At the end, my boys had fun, I guess that's all it matters.

This is one of the newer establishments that is near my house and I cannot express how convenient it was! 

The staff was incredibly friendly and completed my oil change in a quick manner. I have honestly never had a bad experience with any of the Einstein's that I have been too. This company trains their staff very well. 

The service technicians made their suggestions and placed notes in my chart for further visits. They were not pushy or trying to over sell anything. I typically hate doing anything vehicle related because I never know what I'm talking about and feel I get taken advantage of sometimes. That's not the case here. I appreciate the suggestions they recommend and they leave it up to me to decide without the additional pressure.

Epi's Basque Restaurant 
Located in Meridian, Epi's is the best Basque Restaurant in Idaho, and quite possibly North America. There are only 10 to 12 tables, so reservations are recommended. But once you arrive, you will be treated like family. The food is meat/fish centric, simply prepared, perfectly seasoned and delicious. The owner Chris, whose treasured grandmother's recipes the menu is based on, is retiring at the end of this month. But I have it on good authority that the restaurant will remain open with all of the current chefs in place. I really can't say enough good things about Epi's, one of my favorite restaurants of all time. Places like this are what makes Idaho so special. Highly Recommended!!!
Really impressed. Took time to ask questions and to make sure the pup was moving along and kept expectations in line.

Very rude employees. They should be fired. I sometimes take packages there on Saturday since Star doesn't have pickups on the weekends. I drive to this location and the employees always have to comment on my shipping. I ship everyday with my company, and have been shipping for years. My shipping is pre labeled and ready to go as is. I have special pricing and shipping with a contract with FedEx and not the store or it's employees. The weights and packages I use follow what I have with FedEx and not the store. I just use the store as a drop off for the driver to pickup my packages on the weekends. I'll have to see if there is a drop box there so I don't have to deal with their rude employees.

Pizza was pretty good, not really good.  Service was great and the people that work there are really nice.  Also ordered a Caesar Salad.  Wouldn't get the salad again, lettuce thrown in with sad shredded chicken on top.

Definitely should no longer be in business! In no way shape or form should anyone treat customers/ potential customers with such disrespect!! As I have seen in this circulating video. I should not be so shocked to see such ignorance... but I am. Such a "turd" company! 100% a total garbage company!

Renters and others beware of this company. This year in 2020 they changed their late rent policy from the industry-standard fixed fee to charging 18% of your rent for being a single day late. Consider that on a $1500 a month rent you will pay a $270 late fee for being a single day late. 

We have rented from this company for over 3.5 years and only been a couple of days late once or twice and they refused to waive the fee even though it is a brand new policy.

Consider for a moment what type of company and management/owners you would have to be to 

1) think an 18% late fee is fair, ethical, or reasonable
2) refuse to give a long time excellent tenants a one-time waiver to continue a good relationship

You can make your own conclusions but ask yourself if you really want to do business with this company. There are lots of property management companies out there, consider your options.
Excellent food, great customer service and the staff are wonderful and so polite.  I highly recommend pizza from Papa Murphy's and cooking at home.  Sweet Friday night dinner
The food was great and I loved the complementary chocolate covered strawberry. The Korean BBQ brisket sandwich should not be seasonal. I want to eat it year long!
My Friend got food poisoning lastnight there ! She threw up all night ! I went to another restaurant with another friend! Poor thing! Do not recommend this place

Bad service.
No one greeted us when we first walked in and we felt like a burden the entire time

I really liked it here! $8 for a Cod Filet sandwich with Krinkle Kut fries and a drink. Didnt walk away feeling hungry which was good. It has a homey feel with photos on the wall and they bring your food out. I noticed they've got custard, their own Root Beer, Cheese Curds and a feeling I dont usually get when I go to a place like this. Way better than Chick-Fil-A down the road which I dont have much good to say about.
Wanna come back and try the Reuben which isnt easy to find one that's good

Had a great experience the first time. Second time, I came back grabbed a Long Island and it's really not a hard drink to make. Watched the guy make it, barely put any alcohol in it, filled it mostly with water. I asked him to put more rum or something because after I tasted it, it was basically lemon water. Instead of having normal people skills, the guy became rude. He was arrogant (even though he can't understand how to make a simple drink), rude, and dismissive. I don't understand how the hell he landed the job, must be his dads place. 


Moral of the story is, if you want a Long Island expect lemonade. If you want to be treated with respect go somewhere else.
Best sushi in the valley! Fresh, fresh fresh, beautiful presentation & lots of flavor. If you opt for take out, they take the time to pack your hot & cold foods with care.
I have to say that I have never been quite so impressed by a dentist or staff members. They got me in quick, saw me back to back days and were truly awesome. I would highly recommend them to anyone!!
Great Thai food! I have been here 3 times and the food is delicious. I particularly loved the Drunken Noodles.

Wife and I are customers for nearly 2 years. Went to get a pair of relatively new expensive glasses repaired yesterday. This pair replaced the same brand eye wear I had to have repaired twice before. They said the original warranty (first pair) had expired, new pair was not under a new warranty, and would have to be completely replaced for $185. When I questioned this policy and other possible options, the reply was 'we can't give away glasses'. Was not a friendly visit! Definitely not the same friendly, experienced, professional crew from our previous visits! They certainly don't back up their expensive product, or care about customer satisfaction!! Too bad, the eye doctor that examines us is AWESOME!!! Will try other Insurance covered options in the future.

I would hire Valley Custom Moving again and would recommend them to anyone who needs a great moving company.  Austin, Wayne and Trent were great.  We moved 3 family members from 1 rental into 2 homes.  The price was fair, especially for the extra effort it took.  All movers were very friendly, cooperative and willing to work hard.  I was so impressed that I will be hiring this company for all my furniture and equipment moves in the future.

Only one mistake was made.  I have a pottery kiln.  One of the movers draped the power cord inside the kiln and closed the lid.  Once moved they opened the kiln to remove the power cord and discovered that doing so broke one of the walls inside the kiln.  So my tip is, do not put the power cord inside a kiln when moving.  It's an expensive lesson so please pass it on to anyone moving a kiln.  The mover was extremely apologetic.

The staff were so friendly and helpful. The doctor who removed my implant was so nice and talked to me during the whole process. She made the process go so fast I didn't even notice when she removed my implant. Great communication as well. They give you so much helpful information and the nurse was kind enough to print out a paper with different doctors I could go too.

The gentleman I did business with was very professional. Packed and moved my belongings for a reasonably low price. None of the fragile items were damaged, so that was appreciated. Hopefully I don't have to move for a while, but if I do, these guys will be the movers I call!

BEWARE!

I am not someone who loves going in for an eye appointment. I had successfully avoided it for about 3 years. Until I realized I should probably bring my kids in. I thought I may as well set a good example for them and do it myself also. 
I went in first on a Tuesday and can't say enough good things about my experience. The office was beautiful and welcoming and the staff was all so kind and patient with me.
I had so many good things to say about my appointment that when it was time for my kids to go a couple days later, they were actually excited. My kids are 5 and 8 and had never been to an eye doctor. The staff was soooo great with them and made them feel so comfortable and at ease. What a great first experience for all of us!
