We decided to stop in the local Cinema to see a Quiet Place II. We did order the tickets online, but the machines are not in service. You have to get in the regular line, and then they print them out for you.

I decided to grab some popcorn and a drink. A trick I use in my state is pay for a large popcorn, and ask for three TRAYS. These are the brown carry trays. Pour the popcorn into two trays. Ask for a refill. Then pour half of that one into the other tray. Not you have enough popcorn for 4 people. If you onky have three people you can get 2 trays instead. We had tons of popcorn. It was the perfect amount and super cheap. If you get a large drink there is one refill. 

I really love the recliner seats in the theatre. I also loved how there was a wall separating you from other rows, which helps with distractions. They even had trays to hold the food which was super cool.
Wow, I called for my Grandson and they don't take wait lists names. As a owner of rental property that would be a concern for me if I was looking for a property manager.. .

First time using them and absolutely terrible. It took over two months from eye exam to finished glasses. They ordered in my frames which apparently only took 4 days to receive however nobody called to tell me so they sat for weeks until I called. Then I was promised the lab is onsite and they would be completed within days....sigh once again It took me calling to find out, surprise, they were finished long ago and yes again nobody called me. Finally when I went to pick up my glasses I was handed a bag with my glasses and the receptionist said thanks. And walked away. No fitting, no adjustments (yes they needed them thanks lens crafters for adjusting them) totally dissapointed. They were happy to take my money then not deliver anything correctly. I will never used them again.

Excellent place to grab a few drinks while waiting on a table elsewhere! Loved the clever couch seating, the bigger-than-life lamps and wine glass on the patio, and the nice view of the water/light show in the center of the plaza. Fair prices and fast check-out!

WORST EXPERIENCE I have ever witnessed. Couldn't even get a drink order right. Had to ask for refills on soda/water. 2 tables being sat, including my party. Ordered the soba noodles. I took one bite, I did not like it. (My own taste preference) politely asked if I could switch out my meal or get it taken off the bill. I was told I STILL had to pay for it, and didn't let me get another entree option. What kind of business doesn't offer another food option, or get that entree off my bill. 10/10 would not recommend Izumi. Will not be back. What happened to this place?! First, lousy service; now, terrible, tough, dry bagels that fall apart like a stale dinner roll. The grocery store now has better bagels.

Most favorite theatre in the Treasure Valley! 

Love that I can order my tickets online, select my seat, and have the option to upgrade to VIP seating upstairs where one can dine while watching a movie. Last movie I watched, I had a cheesecake, a gelato, and a beer with my popcorn! Where else can a place make that happen?! 

Seats are super comfortable, screen is wide & clear, and the sound system is pure quality. Let's not forget that on Tuesdays, one can watch a movie for a discounted price (but it may be a little busy since this isn't a secret anymore). 

So go ahead, plan on going to the Village Cinema for your next anticipated movie, grab some popcorn, sit back, relax, and enjoy your show!

THE BEST! Food is perfection. Service is even more perfection. Atmosphere is like going home to celebrate the best times with family. Citrus encrusted halibut or the Filet medallions are both amazing. Simply dining perfection. If you haven't been there. GO! If you have - well you will definitely go again and again. Hands down our favorite dinner out place. You will feel valued like you have never felt in a restaurant. Chris and her staff are awesome!

I ordered a 3 pcs chicken through DoorDash and he he food cane hot and chicken he delivery was fast but the chicken was TINY! It was a wing, small thigh and small drumstick!! NOT WORTH THE MONEY! I paid $13 for 3 small pieces of chicken and a large mashed potatoes and gravy! I used to go to this Popeyes a lot since I know they're all locally owned but I won't be coming back to this one!!

I LOVE this location. Everyone is so nice. I felt comforted and not judged at all. 10/10 recommend supporting pp always and forever. They offer so many resources and they give so much knowledge on things I had no clue about.
We LOVE Thai Basil! From the lettuce wraps to the pad Thai noodles to the red curry, everything is always delicious at this family-ran business.

Mike and Ronnie were very helpful!! We came in asking a lot of questions about Kokanee and they were able to set us up with the perfect set up! Really appreciate their candid, honest, and knowledgeable advice! We will definitely come here again!

came in for lunch this week and I have to say I was so impressed by their prices and the variety of food they have on their menu. when you think BBQ, you usually assume it will cost a lot, but that wasn't the case. of course they had BBQ combo plates and such, but the sandwiches and salads and burgers were really well priced!

I ordered the honey chicken sandwich. it was chicken strips covered in a sweet sauce on a bun with all the fixings. it was good, but I think next time I will get a burger or something with their smoked meat on it. it was just simple. I got fries, because steak fries are life.

mom got the grilled chicken wrap and it was DELICIOUS! very flavorful and only $10! she got the potato salad and didn't like it, she just said it was boring. it's just simple.

I also got a margarita which was delightful. 

I really look forward to coming back. i'm going back on keto this week but so many things on the menu can be adjusted easily.
The fact that all ingredients are microwaved is weird, and taste was disappointing. Not much else to say.

Cheers!

Thai Basil was a last resort restaurant stop for us one night. My husband and I were so pleased we kept going back. Not much to say about staff or customer service but the food is very delicious. We've tried a couple different plates such as fried rice, pad Thai, chicken and veggie egg rolls, summer rolls and the yellow curry. They were all really tasty dishes. Best appetizer is their summer rolls! So yummy. My personal favorite of course is the Pad Thai which you can get with no spice, medium spice or really spicy. It seems to depend on the night but one time we had to wait a few for our dishes and then another night we had it out pretty quick. I will say it is definitely a place you have to try though!!

Please, please find a better popcorn bag!!! They are so loud and distracting!!!! We love the seats, love them. We now only come to the village when we were dedicated to majestic theatres because we love the recliners. But change the popcorn bags!!!!! So very loud

GO GO GO! You will thank me later! 

The FOOD: Outstanding! Husband and I ordered the Steak and all you can eat shrimp ( I added the salad bar) and it was cooked to perfection! Juicy steak, large crispy shrimp (all you can eat! Sooo good) and a huge baked potato with all the fixings...can't be beat, trust me I've eaten at all the steakhouses around Boise and Meridian. The salad bar was so fresh, I thought I was at the one inside Whole Foods....seriously that good! 

The Service: Michelle! Michelle was our server, and I have never received better hospitality, attention, all with a smile and eagerness rarely seen. I observed her deliver this to all of her guests in amazement. Not surprising was how her customers received her, with the same warmth. She even brought a second helping of that delicious shrimp BEFORE my husband had to ask! ( Don't get me stared on that famous cheese toast, or how many slices I had lol) I've never experienced that in any other "all you can eat" dining experiences of past. 

The Meridian Sizzler is the best kept secret in the state, I am sure of it... You won't be disappointed!

 Again some one came to our home, took pictures.   The last visit to the store, after a clerk, saying she was the manager and tell us that clothes can cause this.  WHAT!  Ended up talking to the temporary manager.  Said he would talk to corporate office.  Nothing, nothing, nothing has been resolved.   DO NOT BUY ANYTHIN FROM ASHLEY HOME FURNITURING.... Very poor quality and terrible service if you are not happy.  PLEASE DON'T BUY FROM ASHLEY HOME FURNISHING!!!  I click on 5 stars.  My mistake.  No stars for the store...

This is my 2nd visit and review of El Gallo Giro. I hate saying negative things about places. It keeps me up at night. I would love to walk into a restaurant and come out with; "I love it, I love it, I loved it" and not have a single negative to say.

But then again, if we never hear the bad, how can we improve? I used to manage "The Movie Gallery" in Nampa before movie rental places went the way of the DoDo bird.

I loved to get negative reviews. Most managers and owners tend to take these personally and get defensive. My philosophy was always more constructive.

If I only heard the good, and never any bad, how could I get better? There are always going to be bad reviews and bad experiences. Every business gets these. Instead of looking at them as negatives, how about looking at them as opportunities?

By my talking to a customer that had a bad experience, I could fix the problem and improve my business. At the very least, I could go to that customer, apologize for the poor experience, and offer them something to win them back.

I came into El Gallo Giro around 11am on purpose to find out what their service was like at non peak times. I was met at the door by a very friendly guy. It was an awesome greeting. This gets an A+ to be sure.

I was made to feel welcome and special. But now on to my 1st opportunity. My daughter and I set in the first booth by the door. I sat down and something felt weird.

Have you ever watched the news about sink holes? Places under the earth where water had undercut the top soil and the earth just collapsed into a large hole.

Well this happened to my butt. It had fallen into a large indentation in the seat cushion and my butt was not to be found again. 

Our server was great in his greeting and through the order process and bringing us our food. But then he was.... peace out.

He walked over to the bar where golf was on and watched it the whole time. I kept my eye on him to see what, if anything, he was going to do. He stood there and watched TV until we had finished and then brought us our check. 

The old saying in restaurants and business is, if your people have time to lean, they have time to clean. Having an employee doing nothing but watching TV right in front of your customers is a VERY BAD NO NO!

It gives off the impression of a lazy employee. If they are too lazy to take care of their customers, then chances are that the kitchen is not being kept clean either.

The other problem with this is that this person was not attending to us, his customers. TV was more important. We ended up leaving a $2 tip, and even that was being generous.

I had the fajitas. On my 1 to 10 scale, I give them a 3. The chicken is in very small bits instead of nice meaty chunks so this makes it hard to taste. One of the pieces was grizzly. 

I asked for corn tortillas and, as normal in any Mexican restaurant, I was given 3. Where this tradition of serving only 3 came from, I have no idea. I always imagined that whoever came up with it was a baseball fan and thought 3 was a good number, since its how many strikes you get in an inning. 

Though Im guessing more likely it has to do with the number of Fajitas it is thought the average person can eat. Either that or 3 is the magic number thought to stay warm. Then when you are done with the 3, you ask your wait person for more.

If our waiter had returned to check on us, I would have asked for more, but as it is, he did not, so I ran out and had to use chips.

The tortillas tasted and looked like they had been sitting under a heat lamp too long.

On a positive note, they improved their salsa since my last visit. It had flavor and a bite now. We even tried the hotter salsa. It was not too hot for me, and had good flavor. I liked this a lot.

The only real reason I am sticking with 2 stars here is because of he wonderful decor inside and the improvement of the salsa.

So as much as I am trying to like this place, I just dont. I might return here in a month or 2 to see if they have improved
I'd never had Basque food until I came here but their's was delicious!

Check this out!!! I just moved to Boise at the beginning  of the year. I lived in California for years, in fact, I have had Kaiser Permanente for almost my whole life. See once you have the system down Kaiser was convenient. I really didn't  think about my medical care until after we bought our house here in Boise. My husband and I are both retired so figured it would be no problem! 
WRONG!
I went to Treasure Valley Family Medicine and met amazing people. The front desk ladies are so nice and helpful! They shared recommendations and I felt like I had known them for years. 
But....my new medical number through Blue Cross had not caught up to me. But NO problem, I met a female doctor, Kerry. She is so sweet, nice, understanding, nonjudgmental and listened to me. The best thing is, she is my new lifetime physician.

You're about to read the 200th review of this place, and up to this point the average rating is 5 stars, something that's VERY impressive. I was torn when thinking of how I was going to provide feedback on this place, especially since I felt GUILTY of giving this place anything lower than a 5. The owner made me feel so welcomed that I felt like I'd be insulting her if I didn't give this place a 5. However, my overall objective for doing reviews all together is to be honest, provide real reviews, and keep it moving.

Prior to coming, I read reviews & checked out EVERY single photo posted. I usually only skim through a couple of reviews prior to coming to a restaurant but since this is an expensive restaurant I wanted to be ready & educated on what they offered to try & get the most out of the whole experience. With so many positive to near perfect reviews, my expectations were extremely high as I was thinking this would be meal I'd remember for quite some time.

The service here is remarkable & felt very personal and family like, which I don't think I've yet experienced from any restaurant. This is the biggest perk of this place. From the outside, the place looks small but the exterior is well kept and clean. There is parking behind the place as well as on the street upfront. I parked at the post office across the street.

- We ordered 2 appetizers (Calamari & Mushrooms) as well as a bottle of house wine (Merlot). Both were very tasty, the sauce that came with the Calamari was a little spicy but delicious. The mushrooms were fantastic, the sauce that they were served with was great. If I had to pick 1, I'd recommend the mushrooms. I enjoyed dipping the included bread into the mushroom sauce.
- For entrees, we ordered the Grilled Lamb Loin Chops & the 12oz Rib-Eye Steak. Prior to receiving the entrees, you're served a small bowl of soup (mushroom or red bean), as well as a small side salad. I'd recommend the mushroom soup over the red bean. For the Lamb Chops, you're given 3 piece of lamb, however, each piece had a pretty big bone, and a good portion was fat, so out of each of the 3 pieces, you'd have maybe 3-4 bites of real lamb meat per piece which wasn't what I was expecting. The sides were rice & fries. The rice was good, but for the price you're paying for these entrees, you should get garlic mashed potatoes or seasoned red potatoes, not fries, regardless what day of the week it is.
- For dessert we ordered Gateau Basque & Triple Layer Chocolate Mousse. The Gateau Basque was served with this raspberry jam, which tasted good & fresh. The chocolate mousse cake was good as well, but I think the real winner would be if Epi's served the chocolate mousse cake WITH the raspberry jam from the Gateau Basque cake. That combination would be my top choice.

There are a couple of negatives that when added up resulted in me giving this place a 3. The dining area is small, cramped, & loud, a byproduct when turning a house into a restaurant. I feel like Epi's is trying to cram as many tables as they can into a very limited floor plan. Trying to sneak in food pictures was very embarrassing since it's so small and personal, especially when you use an actual camera to take them, but I go hard for my yelp fam. I don't agree at all with the categorization of Epi's as "intimate" and the noise level as "average". I had a hard time speaking to my party in a regular voice and had to always lean across the table and repeat myself when speaking. There's no way I'd bring a date here for a romantic dinner, unless we plan on texting each other across the table all night.

The food was good, however I didn't taste anything special. I'm not a food snob, so maybe I just don't understand what the real Basque taste should be like & how Epi's compares, but from an average Joe's perspective, I didn't come away thinking how different or unique the food was. I thought that after eating here I'd know exactly what Basque food is and how it differentiates from the rest.

The final negative is the price. This place is very expensive, and while the food was good, I didn't feel like the asking price was fair. For example the mushroom appetizer was around $15, something that I'd feel comfortable paying $8 for. For the amount of lamb you get from the lamb loin chops, I'd feel comfortable paying around $22-24. Same goes for the Cali bottled house wine, which for a 750ml bottle came in at $20. Don't be surprised if you hit over $100 for a dinner for 2.

In conclusion, there are several factors that reflect the number of stars a place receives: atmosphere, service, pricing, food, and overall vibe. Epi's hits on some, but not all. If this place renovated / expanded their dining area as well as remodeled their pricing, I think it'd be a step in the right direction. I do not regret coming here and I'm glad I was able to experience what top tier service and hospitality feels like. Overall, it hurts to say it, but as a total package, this is a medium 3.

What a great experience!  We went for the full hibachi esque experience and ordered the steak and lobster,  lobster and scallops,  a shrimp and vegetable tempura plate and a sushi roll.  The orders came with delicious soup and even though the salmon was a little dry,  the presentation was fantastic and our waiter, Cody, was really fantastic. Uniquely attentive and very kind throughout our meal.  He managed to always be there when we needed him and without being over bearing. Really everything a server should exemplify.

I love everything about this place.  The service and the friendly atmosphere are unparalleled around here.  The food is magnificent - so tasteful and plentiful.  Even when I've taken some bad risks (tongue - just not for me), I never left disappointed.  But for those going in, here's a few recommendations: The calamari is outstanding.  Out of the regular soup choices, go for the mushroom - it's amazing.  For entrees, even though it's probably not a true Basque dish, the halibut is straight-up out-of-this-world.  It might seem like an obvious thing, but the best thing about the entrees here is that they don't overcook them.  The fish is juicy and flaky.  The meat is cooked according to how you order it.  Also - don't forget the green apple bread pudding.  I don't typically like fruity desserts, but this is probably the best dessert I've ever had in any restaurant anywhere.  

But, beyond the food - this place is about the experience.  They treat you like family.   They don't rush you.  And prices are extremely reasonable for the quality of the food and service.  This is the best restaurant around.

Went here with my boss the first time and loved it. Went a second time with my boyfriend and was SO disappointed, the serving sizes were insanely SMALL!! Like not even one cup of rice in the bowl, maybe a pinch of brisket, and almost no beans. Super bummed. Thought it was going to be my new favorite place.

My son does not have a standard boy haircut that most anyone can fake their way through. It requires scissors, layers and some legitimate understanding of technique.  I've learned this over the past four years for several reasons.... 
#1 I attempted to learn how to cut his hair myself and tried multiple times. Result...much photographic evidence that I'm sure I'll get heck for when he's older and the realization that no matter how hard I try; practice will not make perfect.
#2 After multiple different trials at other salons, all salons are not created equal. 

So imagine my surprise when I gave this salon a go and left pleased with the outcome. I have returned 3 times now, and have had an equally good experience each time.

Hairstylist is always friendly and personable to the child.  They do a great job keeping little's entertained while they cut away and are so good at anticipating a child's ability to make sudden, unannounced movements.

My only critique is that I have yet to have the same stylist.  I really liked the haircut before last and I requested the same gal again; for consistency.  But learned she no longer works there. The latest haircut turned out just fine, it's just totally different from the last one. But I figure,  who cares, he's four and will just appreciate I didn't do it when he reflects on those school photos later in life. ;)

And P.S. who doesn't want to get their haircut in a Spiderman car?!? I mean, come on!

Recently moved and found that the Meridian Lowes was an easier drive. Two separate times my, "active duty" husband came home from the store and shared his unfortunate experiences.

All of this Covid crap is no excuse to give such HORRIBLE customer service and be outright rude! Shame on you Lowes in Meridian! 

We still shop at Lowes, we go there more than the grocery store, but now we will take the long way, through the traffic and shop the Nampa store.

My husband just reminded me that there was 1 guy in electrical that was extremely helpful.
Terrible. Booked an appointment received email confirmation of appointment. Month and a half later show up to find out my appointment had been cancelled. Front office seems to not have a clue.

I wish I could give no stars. The showing agent was nice and seemed to want to help me find the right fit but the man working in the office treated me horribly. I will never rent from this company because if they treat their prospective tenants like that, I can only imagine how they treat their actual tenants.

I wish I would of read the reviews before I purchased my chair there at Ashley. I also purchased a warranty with it. Had the chair for less than six months. They stated that I've sat in the chair to many times and that the chair cannot be covered. I'm not a big person and aren't you supposed to sit in a chair. 
Please do your self a favor, and don't go to the Meridian Store or the Boise Store. The company it's self doesn't back up their products and you wound be happy.

If you haven't been here in a while then I suggest you try it again. The owners have gone away from the pie hole franchise and now it's called SLICES. The place it's self didn't really change much but but I feel the pizza is a little better quality then piehole. The atmosphere is definitely nicer and cleaner and they have a roof top seating also which is nice.. for the price and quality it is definitely one of my top choices for pizza in meridian.. will be going back again and again for sure...

I didn't take pictures but should have. We ordered curb side and the service / food was excellent! 
My boyfriend ordered the 12 ounce prime rib with loaded baked potato. I ordered the wedge salad plus carved turkey. We live 20 minutes away. When we unpacked the food we were pleasantly surprised to see how they packaged our meals. Everything was in containers and we essentially built our plates the way we wanted. This kept our food warm and fresh. Also when we arrived we followed the instructions and the service was fast! From the time we announced our arrival to driving away was less then 5 minutes. Brian brought us our take out, he was nice and friendly asked us how our evening was so far and we got to share a quick story about what were we're up to. Fantastic job good wood! I hadn't been since last November, we will be back sooner then later

So we were hungry and in a hurry so stopped at this place.  When we saw the whiskey barrel near the door full of garbage we should have left, but went inside anyway.  We were wearing masks, as is the county wide mandate.  We stood just inside the door waiting to be seated, as there is no sign saying to wait or to seat yourself.  Finally a woman said we could seat ourselves.  There were no blocked off areas to signify safe social distancing.  We chose a booth.  There were no other people seated in that side of the room.  Our server was wearing a mask, but the other server was wearing a mask hooked over only one ear.  What purpose that serves is a mystery.  Shortly after taking our order, a large group of children and adults came in, none of them wearing masks, and seated themselves at the adjacent booth, far less than the 6 ft. guideline.  Our drinks came with unwrapped straws.  Menus were not sanitized after use.  Food was okay, but we were not offered refills or even checked on once.  Check never came, so we left cash on the table and left.  Clearly, this place doesn't feel the responsibility to follow mandated health guidelines, and that coupled with crap customer service tells me that there is really no concern for the customer experience.

New small Mexican restaurant!  Should be an easy win, but ended up disappointed. 

Ordered my standard for comparison- chicken taco, cheese enchilada.   Taco was unremarkable,  enchilada sauce was bland.... bland enchilada sauce really gets my goat for some reason.   It's like.... I take it personally.... like they're out to get me with bad sauce...

Service was nice...

The booth seats... had some kind of design in the fabric... and it was painted over.... paint on fabric.... is it just me?

Can't say I'll be back.

I've been going to Café Zupas for two or three years now. My last visit was beyond disappointing. We got our food and went out to find a table. There were about 10 tables available but all dirty. I asked the cashier to help us get some tables cleaned and she said she would but no one ever came. We found the girl stocking lids and asked her if she would clean a table and she told us she would have to finish stocking the lids and that they've been really busy. I told her there are no tables at all for us to sit as we stood there with our trays. She was very rude and grabbed a wash cloth, found the dirtiest table she could find, the one that obviously had kids at it, and proceeded to wipe off the table but not the benches and not the floor. She expected us to sit there! There was food down in the crack of the bench, and not just crumbs. Full blown food! We ended up going to a different table and just wiping it off ourselves with water and napkins. About a minute after we rejected that table, two very elderly ladies sat there and I'm sure they didn't see all of the food on the benches because they slid right in. I felt very sorry for them. This was the worst experience ever!

Love, love, love this place! Wonderful food, good pricing, and really nice people working there. I particularly enjoy going for the buffet because I really like the variety. There is so much to try and they keep it fresh and hot. They have it arranged so that one section is condiments, salads and cold foods. The other two sections are side-by-side with just vegetarian on one side and food for carnivores on the other. 


Oh and another thing that's really cool about spice is that if you know that there is a particular dish that you really enjoy, you can call ahead the day before and let them know and they will put it on the buffet the next day for you. It is small place however and there was not a lot of room, so we couldn't get a booth, but it was so worth it for the food.

A NIGHTMARE OF A COMPANY. I wish I could give Ashley HomeStore 0 stars. I have had nothing but issue after issue with every piece of furniture I ordered. First was quoted 2-3 weeks for my couch, never received any delivery information so I then called the store and was told that my couch wouldn't be delivered for 3 months. I understand there are delays sometimes but there was 0 communication.
Then after waiting for my other furniture to be delivered, I was told that it has been in the warehouse for three days, again with no communication that I could come get it.
After finally receiving my $700 dresser and putting it together, I noticed the drawer slides are completely off, the drawers will not close/open all the way, the quality is comparable to big lots or walmart.
I contacted the customer service phone line and was told there is nothing they could do for me. Even though I purchased the "protection plan" and that because we picked it up from the warehouse, we should have inspected it ourselves before taking it home. Even though it was packaged in a large box and needed some assembly. There was also no communication that we should check the quality before we take it home.
Then, I went in store to talk to someone who then gave customer service like she was not interested in helping us. Told me that a tech would call me to set up an appointment for them to come fix the dresser. After a week with no communication(once again) I was told that I already have a scheduled date.
After all of these problems, all I would like is some compensation. After sitting on hold for over 30 minutes, I was then told by another corporate person that they will not do anything for me because we picked up the furniture ourselves. DO NOT BUY ANYTHING FROM THIS COMPANY
First time customer ... I ordered Tres Amigos. The chile relleno was cooked to perfection! The Colorado sauce with beef & chile verde -- delicious! I'll be back!!

Cameron & Michael are THE BEST movers EVER! They helped us with a complicated move from Everett. Due to circumstances, we had to divide our move into 3 parts. They were always in time, carefully transferred our belongings from a PODS container to their truck and drive it all the way up to Lynden. They were always professional; communicated with us every step of the way; trustworthy and personable. I would highly recommend Reliance Moving!
The food was fresh and very generous portions. Split it into 2 meals. Very helpful friendly staff. Clean restaurant. My only complaint was the temperature of the food, it was luke warm.
Very friendly staff. You are treated like family. You're needs are always met, the option to email your doctor is a huge plus.

Horrible customer service in the plumbing department. I needed some help with some fittings and the women who helped me out was was super annoyed with very little patience. I will be going to home depot for all my home improvement needs.

Thank you for exceeding expectations and restoring our faith in takeout. During COVID-19 we've only ventured out of the house a couple of times for takeout and every experience at other restaurants has been awful. After weeks of cooking at home we decided to try the takeout thing again and we chose Goodwood on Eagle road. The gal who answered the phone- super happy, super efficient, and got everything correct. What a different experience than what we'd gotten from other restaurants. My husband picked up the food on his way home from work. The packaging was clean, they didn't forget silverware, sauces, not even a little butter for the role. They remembered everything! And the little extra touches like wrapping the meat separately than the bun to prevent it from getting soggy, genius idea! I was full off my salad so thanks to how my sandwich was packaged, I get to look forward to leftovers tomorrow! And the brownie, coming from a pregnant lady that's been working from home and isolating, thank you!!! You guys are the best!

Great place to store extra house guests.  Clean, efficient. Nice staff.  Good location.  Reasonably priced.  Each room has ample space for kids in sleeping bags.  We had our family reunion in Nampa this year and our relatives were just fine with the amenities.

Stopped thru the drive thru today to grab some lunch on the way to watch game. They didn't seem to busy was only in couple cars in drive thru. Wish they had a menu before u get up to speaker to order so u can make up your mind before hand. We looked up menu on phones so had a pretty good idea. Ordering process was easy and fast and pricing is about the same as any other fast food place. Once u pay at window I get your drinks and then a number to pull forward to wait.. seems like a not so efficient way to do business but whatever works for them I guess.. as far as food goes it was a little above average. The butter buns are nice and soft, meat was about average but cheese was very good.  We also got a chicken sandwhich which was above average. We got both fries and onion rings both on the above average side of things.. all and all incould rate this above normal for fast food. I would like to go in and sit down and try some of there ice cream and other fun stuff.. I don't think I would go out of my way to go there but since I am in the area alot I am sure I will frequent it from time to time..

In town from Chicago, and boy were we lucky to stop by this place! Food is top notch and service is kind and welcoming. The homemade bbq sauce is going to make you want to buy a bottle to take home. Would recommend to friends and family and for larger get togethers. A wonderful experience!
I enjoyed the food this evening, fresh, flavorful and lots of smiles.

Morning of september 11, 2020 at mariott courtyard boise/west meridian 

Today I noticed three people in the lobby without masks- 

I was disturbed, as there is a sign that clearly states that masks must be worn inside, and covid is still taking its toll without a vaccine.

I let it go. Later on, I found myself needing some hot water to drink and no one was at the cafe- i heard a ruckus in the back so i wandered over and called in.. no answer, so i went in a ways to call again. I did not notice any sign barring my entry but was hesitant to go in, as it did seem like a place where I probably shouldn't be.. 

Surprisingly, as I looked around to get the nearest persons attention, a saw a man with his head leaning over a large salad bowl. He was tossing some food together, with his unmasked mouth right above the food he was preparing- enough to serve at least ten people in a very large dish.

Now, very disturbed about the lazy and disrespectful approach that people seem to be taking to covid protocols, I decided it was my duty to report this to the general manager by calling the operator and beginning a conversation with him just after 11am on september 11, 2020.

I told him what happened  and the knee jerk reaction was to minimize what's going on and to excuse the guests.

I was told that:

.they are not allowed to force people to wear a mask if they have a medical issue

.people in the lobby dont have to wear a mask as long as they are sitting down(which is not explained anywhere and violated the notice which is posted on every entry/exit door)

~and then this very disturbing quote from the general manager~

."you know, you are not allowed to be back there in the kitchen area"

I asked 

"So if one of your employees is breaking the law and I happen to walk in where I'm not supposed to be, you would tell me that im not supposed to be there?!"

I was extremely disturbed by this. This persons job is to manage his crew and try TO PREVENT THE SPREAD OF COVID, especially for someone who's breathing directly into a huge bowl of food that will be served to multiple people!

I was left feeling like he just wanted to excuse and minimize what happened, with little concern for public safety or the fact that his crew is not following or enforcing covid protocols.

I asked to speak to his boss- he refused! He said he "would take my info and maybe his boss will get back to me."

What a cop out. 

For being OK with putting peoples life at risk, you all have earned the lowest rating I can give.

To the general manager- you have shown very poor leadership and customer service- all you had to do is ensure me that you will correct those who are under your control and breaking protocol. 

Please take this matter seriously.

Great service by a very considerate driver! I live in South Meridian, ID and had forgotten to put my trash and recycling out last night. I remembered this morning when I heard one of the trucks. I was hurriedly getting things ready and had just opened my garage door when the recycling truck was passing by my house. I thought "oh well - will just have to wait until next time".  But, he saw me, stopped, backed up and got out of his truck so he could get my recycling! I didn't expect that and he certainly did not need to do that. Wish I would've gotten his name so I could mention him specifically. Kudos to Republic and to this specific gentleman!

This review is only based on the service. The cookies are pretty OK. Today I walked in to grab a cookie to snack on.  The gal that helped me was very nice and quick and is the reason for the 2 stars instead of 1.  But the big off-putting thing was watching the 4 other employees huddled around a small table portioning out dough.  3 out of the 4 were not wearing masks while handling the dough.  I get it the masks are uncomfortable and totally suck, but it was bothersome to see just the carelessness of those workers while handling food.  If masks are required for customers, you'd think they would be for those handling our food.

I can say that the service is good with the people there, they are very nice and friendly but the communication between the front and back is a little hectic and can get your food mixed up as I watched them do that a few times. It's funny listening to them go "And so it begins" "Here we go" sounds like they get busy and everyone is just trying to make it through the day. They did get my order right I think. The only thing that was weird for me was that the fries looked like a small size. The bacon burger was delicious better than Freddie's. The one thing that surprised me was the cheese curds and I am not a fan but they were  really good. The grilled chicken was bland but the burgers are great. Check this place out if your around for a burger!
Hands down the best! Staff is amazing. They are friendly, kind and knowledgeable. They take the time to listen. They are great with my kids. I am so thankful to have found them.

I am a frequent traveler and I always try to visit a BBQ restaurant in every city I work in.  Goodwood Barbecue Restaurant, by far, is the best I have visited.  

Starting with the greeting at the front door, I was welcomed by not one a few waitresses including the manager who stopped by a few time to check on my comfort.   I ordered the Baby Back Rib dish with a baked potato and a Caesar salad side.  The salad arrived fresh and with the correct amount of dressing, not too much, not too little.  It came with a warm corn muffin and dollup of butter.  The ribs arrived warm and a large perfectly loaded potato.  The meat was tender and the sauce was the outstanding.  While I was eating, my beverage never got below half.  The atmosphere was pleasant, the seats and tables were clean  as was the restroom.

Goodwood Barbeque Restaurant is a place I look forward to visiting again.

Wonderful night out with my gram. Exactly what was expected too. Awesome fried rice, Chicken, steak, scallops, and shrimp. Chef put on quiet the show as well and very entertaining. Great choice and I'd definitely go back.

please note, this review is based primarily on service. 

I have ordered Chip cookies for delivery and have always been pleased with arrival time and the cookies themselves. (Cookies are really nothing spectacular, just a good, basic chocolate chip cookie that's hits the spot when you don't feel like making a batch at home). 

Unfortunately, the last two times I've visited the store front at the Village, I have been pretty disappointed. Both times, there have been upwards of 6-8 people working behind the counter (some are prepping dough, some are baking cookies) but there are usually at least 3-4 just standing behind the counter. Never have they so much as looked up or spoken a greeting as I (or any other customer) comes through the door. I literally stood at the counter for a couple minutes while two of the girls just talked to each other, seemingly annoyed to finally have to  help me. 

While I was waiting for my order, another couple (there before me) asked to speak with a manager. The manager came forward and the couple voiced their frustration. The manager never spoke a word to the couple (who were just as frustrated with the service). Didn't apologize, didn't offer to make it right...it was astonishing the lack of customer service. 

I reached out to Chip via an Instagram message (since that's where I see they primarily promote) after my first equally bad visit, with no response. 

Moral of the story: 
-if you want a basic (not horrible, not great cookie - order Chip via delivery. 
-If you want to be treated like a nuisance, ignored for a solid 2-3 minutes and watch employees talk to each other, visit Chip's store front at the Village.

This is such a great place - the best thing I can write for a review is that it's my kids favorite go to place for a nice night out. The chefs are entertaining, it's great food, and we've never been disappointed. Definitely recommend checking it out!

Do not buy from this company!! Your fastest delivery date is a month away and when it should deliver they will set it back yet another month and tell you there is nothing they can do about it. Worst delivery service i have ever experienced. I will never buy from this company again please listen to the people who had bad experiences and make a smart choice!

So this is our very first time at a Popeye's and boy oh boy it was surprisingly good. 

Po'Boy with popcorn shrimp with the full lettuce pickles and mayonnaise (came in packets on the side). I did add the hot mustard which gave it an extra spicy kick. Seriously, this was so close to an original in Louisiana! I will come back for this alone!!

Boneless wings were super crispy, crunchy. 

Red beans & rice = good. 

Ambiance is a typical fast food restaurant but had the added entertainment of some southern cajun music. Adds a little charm. 

Overall, this is really a place we will come back to a quick bite to eat.
Excellent food and service. Ribeye steak was big and juicy. Service was prompt and attentive. Really convenient to have parking so close. Two thumbs up!

My mother-in-law and I made pedicure appointments a day in advance and were able to get in at the time we wanted. The customer service from the time we entered Smiley Nails was great and we loved our experience.  $30 for a pedicure. Definitely recommend this business for a pedicure.

My first visit here was favorable for a routine cleaning.  Office was very tech savvy, which sort of gave me mixed emotions. Thought it was kind of cool at first, but then began to think I was paying extra for a routine cleaning because of all the fancy technology they had.  Thought it was kind of weird that the dentist was almost trying to sell me on other services I could come back for.....

Six months later, I called on the day of my appointment to cancel as I was pregnant and having contractions. The receptionist had the nerve to tell me that normally I would incur a fee for canceling less than 48 hours before my appointment, but she thought she would do me a favor and make an exception. Really???? No congrats! Thanks for calling, best of luck, call us when you are ready to reschedule?  If I could have I would have punched her through the phone.

I realize it wasn't the hygienist or dentist fault, but I just couldn't bring myself to go back. There are far too many choices in the area, to be unhappy for any reason with your dentist.

My family and I stumbled across this barbecue restaurant and it just blew us away the service was fantastic from the moment we walked in. The food was amazing the kids menu was full of great choices for the kids and the prime rib was outstanding and though they didn't have to they gave us the military discount for my serving in the military and gave the kids a free dessert .

Food & atmosphere is great! However, I'm told  the owners won't give the secret key to the staff to adjust the temp. Went in & A/c is on & was colder than a well diggers ass & I froze my ass off in there. Won't be back anytime soon

Not worth all the hype.... the staff is super friendly and welcoming but the food itself kinda fell flat for me. I got a ribeye and my mom got the medallions neither had a lot of flavor. The mushroom soup was very good however. Overall don't think I will go back.

Simply an amazing dinner experience.  The fried rice was the best I've ever had.  Filet minon was excellent and cooked perfectly. The shrimp appetizers were nice large clump shrimp fresh and cooked to perfection.  The chef was simply amazing funny creative entertaining just awesome.  If I could give them six stars I would.  The best dinner experience I've had in Boise by far.  Restaurant was very clean Decour was new and looked very very nice.  Dinner service was excellent.

Great tasting food and people working there are fantastic. I only wish they would return their lunch buffet. It was the only place you could eat healthy in 15 minutes if you had a 30 minute lunch. Being next to the hospital and near 1000 businesses that need lunch food. If you follow the science covid is airborne not a surface germ. Everyone could put on a plastic glove if terrified by utensil handles or  just go at night when no buffet is available.
Gun department just rude, don't want to help customers at all.   Taking my business to Cabela's.   Would have probably spent upwards of $1,000.    Too bad.

They did a fabulous job of taking care of me every time I go in. The facility is clean with great nurses who are passionate about their work (they check your temperature and sign a COVID survey before services). I got to know a few of them over time and they're all great people. I signed up 8 cycles of CoolSculpting to be used throughout the year. I certainly gained 10-12lbs easily in 2020 so it's about time I get them off me. I was never blessed with flat abs no matter how fit I am and after my 2nd session, I'm starting to see results (takes 3-4 months to see effects) and did my 3rd session on my abs and 1 session on my inner thighs yesterday. Some discomfort, but it's expected. I'd say definitely check it out and stick to recommended number of cycles. It's like going to the gym, you don't expect immediate results after hitting the gym once and call it good. This is a happy medium for me not to get plastic surgery or having to workout 1.5 hours a day like I used to. 

For those who are mostly fit, but want to have that amazing tones abs. Check out CoolTone. It's like doing 10,000 situps in half an hour. You'll feel the muscles tightness and some soreness, nothing like if you had a hardcore workout soreness though. Plus, I think it strengthened my ab muscles that helped with my back pain. It feels like "holy cow, this is how people blessed with amazing abs feel like."

Do you like being able to contact your landlords in the event of an emergency,  or having a property management company who you can work with? Well, this isn't it. We had a rental for a year and a half before being absorbed into JPM. We asked about a potential rate rase and how much it might be, so we can be prepared.  Nothing. Then, two month before the lease was up, they were going to raise the rate over $400 from our previous contract. (The unit that was attached to ours had new appliances, attached backyard,  while ours had appliances from the 1980s, a deattateched backyard, and they wanted us to pay more). We had pipes in the basement blow twice, on the second time it happened on the weekend we couldn't get a hold of anyone. After we moved into our house the saga didn't end. We were contacted by JPM regarding our security deposit. I will admit,  we did miss a few things. However,  what was stated in the receipt said more things had to be done, which we know we did, and only saw a fraction of the deposit back. Some of the items listed were already there from the previous tentative, and were put on us. No benefit of the doubt. I was contacted by JPM to see where they could send a check and we had a discussion about the items. We were sent certian pictures of things. But, like was stated above certian items they didn't send photos of was on the receipt on what they needed to do. It seemed their minds were made up before they contacted me and didn't intend to hear my argument. The JPM team didn't make an effort to inspect the unit after they acquired the property either. I know this rental market is nuts, but I would try to find another management company to go with. They don't care about you, only your money and they're going to try and suck as much as they can out of you.
My go to place to get bbq!! You can never go wrong with the 2 meat plates. The burnt ends are a MUST!!!

My husbands primary doctor is here and we are very unhappy with their services. My husband had an ekg that showed he possibly suffered a heart attack and Dr George Thomas has not been very helpful. My husband has had to pressure him to get any tests done and now getting his staff to send referrals to the correct offices has been almost impossible. The one referral that has gone through was to an out of network office. They didn't even check his insurance to make sure they were sending the referral to someone in our network. They have been awful!!!!!
Love this place!  Great atmosphere, wine, service, and food.  Was pleasantly surprised the menu had allot of gluten free options.

I ordered the North Pacific Cod Sandwich from this location. Just some background, I've had this sandwich before from another Wendy's location and it was quite good. The meal was ready before I had even finished getting my drink; a red flag. Fish is supposed to be opaque and flaky, this fish was transparent and chewy, indicating it was severely over cooked. I couldn't even finish the sandwich. It was painfully obvious this was sitting in a warmer before I had gotten it.

My wife ordered the home style chicken sandwich. It was so overloaded with mayo that it was dropping off the sandwich in large clumps.

That was our first (and our last) visit to this Wendy's location.

Disgusting.

Love Love LOVE Elliot's here in Boise! The Wedge Salad is my absolute favorite thing to get... which sounds weird because I have never been this partial to a salad before, but it is just THAT GOOD! The crab cakes are also incredible and all of the fish and sea food is so dang fresh, it's hard to remember we're in Boise and not on the pier in Seattle.

I love that Elliot's is part of Crave Delivery because I can get all of this food straight to my door without having to even put pants on! Can't complain.

We first ate at Goodwood when some friends took us out for dinner. We thought it was really, really good. Had a great time. Service was spot on.

Hubby & I went a few months later for lunch. The meat was a little dry that day but it was still good. The sides are mediocre in my opinion and I've tried most of them.

The problem was with the beer my husband ordered. He asked for Coors Light on tap. When he tasted the beer, it was clearly NOT Coors Light. I tried it too and could taste it was Bud or Bud Light maybe. We told the waitress and she took the beer and brought back which seemed to be the same one but topped off. It still was not Coors Light. We brought it to her attention and she said she was going to ask the bartender. She never came back to the table except to bring our bill. They lost a star because of this. The meats are really good here and we will come back, but hopefully that kind of thing doesn't happen again. My hubby didn't even finish the beer which is not like him.

This is one of the most conscientious establishments in the valley relating to COVID restrictions and courtesies to customers.  I have no fear of entering this place.  The food is excellent, as always, spotless, sanitized, masked, etc.  No effort has been spared to protect their customers as opposed to many places.

Cutest little hair cut place to take your little to. The stylist are absolutely amazing, i made a reservation on a Saturday (which I would recommend doing if you don't want to wait). Eva our hair stylist was so great with my 2-year old. It's a little outing for them, a perfect afternoon. Not only is the hair cutting experience great but so is when they leave. A complementary ballon for all the kiddos. This will become a regular spot for us.
My husband and I ordered sushi for take out using DoorDash and I can safely say this was some of the most mediocre and ill formed sushi we've ever had. Would not recommend.
This place is addicting. I think we went through 3-4 months where we would buy cookies every week. We still buy cookies. The Oreo chip cookies are the bomb
Wow, I am really surprised how good our lunch was.  I wasn't expecting too much from a fast food restaurant.  I had the steak quesadilla and chips and queso and it was delish and reasonable.
Made reservations for habachi and service was great, the food was delicious. Will definitely come back for the sushi and drinks.

We are in town for a week and we we're looking up places to eat, we found blue tiger pizza. It had over 4 stars so we figured we would give it a shot. We now know why they have good reviews. This place is delicious. We got the pig destroyer, yes it's as good as it sounds., Just wish it was spicy.  The customer service was wonderful as well. Our pizza was $24 for a 16inch pizza.

The trash can was absolutely stuffed. They forgot to come here so obviously there's going to be double the trash. This was a case of "not my job" for this guy at the creek side apartments. I wouldn't recommend this company.

We unfortunately had a not so great stay here. 
First thing, we haven't had rain in quite some time but the entire stairwell was leaking with water running down the walls & buckets were out throughout the hotel to catch dripping water. 
I went to the bistro in the morning to get coffee, after waiting several minutes for an employee to show up, she didn't greet or thank me. And made my coffee with regular milk even though the menu item was supposed to be made with coconut milk. 
We used the pull out couch for a bed, no bedding in the room for it. The front desk didn't offer it at check in even though we asked them about the feature & they knew we'd be using it. 
Lastly there is no hot tub, which was a bummer. Guess you can't assume if there is a pool, there is a hot tub. The pool area was definitely not cleaned and the workout room had no wipes available, the equipment was old, it just wasn't at the level of what we've come to expect from a Marriott property. 
The good news was we called headquarters and they were extremely nice about the whole thing. Great customer service there, only reason this property is getting 2 stars instead of 1.

They have the best salmon I have ever had. 
I always love to go to Goodwood anytime I want salmon. The capers added to the top makes the whole meal.

The staff was friendly and professional. My only gripe was my glasses took longer than I was told. I don't think it's their fault and most likely COVID related. My glasses didn't fit well when I got home and tried them on and I had to make adjustments myself and bent the frame. I am used to getting them fitted when I get new glasses, but it may have been a COVID issue as well. 

That being said I would use them again.

New'ish offshoot (opened 2019) of mothership Eagle Vision One in Eagle,  this optometry and opticial services business is located in a strip mall with convenient parking in Meridian and has equally customer friendly layout and helpful optical staff as the Eagle location.  My husband and I, both long time wearers of eyeglasses and multi year clients of the Eagle location, toodled into the Meridian store for the first time last Saturday morning right after they opened (8a to Noon Saturdays) to see if there were eyeglass styles for him he liked better than the two pair on the 'finals list' at the Eagle location before he made his purchase there.  Friendly staff greeted us and let us look about as we told them the reason for our visit but were readily available when my hubby had a question.

INVENTORY:  Good variety of frames here for men and women, although for our shopping profiles maybe more at the Eagle store in the brands we purchase.  If you're looking for children's frames, there seemed to be a really great variety and assortment here.  Frame prices across price points here from those marked "special value" (or something like that) to designer brands.  

COVID19 SAFETY PRACTICES:  Here as in the Eagle location, all staff and customers must wear masks.  After you have handled a frame off the display you leave it on one of the stations and the staff cleans it before it is put back on display.  (This process is a little better organized at the Eagle store where they have a "deposit basket" for the handled frames and an auto-clave looking piece of equipment below it that the staff puts he frames in to clean them.)  New construction, high ceilings, good venilation, a comfortable place to shop.

THE PRACTICAL MATTER:  When one is going to invest several hundred dollars between frames and lenses in spectacles, one needs to be able to see oneself without mask.  One of the reasons we went in early when there were no other customers in the store was to be able to stand at one of the far back mirrors so that my hubby could lower his mask to assess how a frame looked on him, something we would not do were there others in proximity. 

LOO:  Is in the lobby.

ACCESSIBILITY:  From parking lot in and throughout this seems among one of he few truly ADA compliant facilities in Meridian, including having perhaps the only correct for parking scope and placement in the area.  Level in the door, ample clear floor spaces, seating for fittings is at standard height tables.  Lobby loo accessible too.

GOOD DEAL PS:  Once a year they have a "back to school" special that applies to all customers not just students.  It is buy two pair and get 50% off the price of the second.  My hubby took advantage of that great deal which expires today (August 31).
Yelp says you close at 10pm. Your restaurant door says 11 pm but at 8:52pm your doors were locked with 2 tables full inside.

Friendly helpful efficient 
Dylan Morgan and Randy are awesome!! 
Didn't have to wait, knowledgeable about what is needed. Cant recommend enough!
Could be a cool hang out spot but has terrible customer service. The manager and multiple servers are extremely rude and on power trips. Don't waste your time on mediocre food/wine and bad service.

It's pretty rare for me to give a single star review. I try to look for the positives in a business rather than focus on the negative, but unfortunately my visit to Sizzler lacked in positive attributes. 

My bff's daughter decided that she wanted to go to Sizzler for her birthday dinner (I would bet that she chose Sizzler for the dessert bar! Lol) anyway, we were a party of 8. We arrived at 6:30pm on a Tuesday evening.  We ordered our meals at the counter and were then seated. 

4 All You Can Eat Salad Bar's
1 steak & salad bar special 

We were at a large table with our friends & the waitress brought out several baskets of the coveted cheese toast.  The toast is probably my favorite thing that Sizzler has. The majority of the slices of toast were perfectly cooked and some were just soggy.  It was strange. We asked for more toast several times, but it never arrived.  

The Salad Bar
The salad bar was so bad that it deserved its own section! Lol.  The lettuces were all soaking wet.  They had 3 different types and each one was wet.  I ended up putting my lettuce on my plate, took it back to my table, and dried it with several napkins.  It was crazy.  I have never had to do this before.  The utensils at the salad bar were a mess! My son found a pair of tongs sitting fully submerged in the nacho cheese.  He fished it out with another pair of tongs and made an employee aware of where the tongs were found.  She simply said, "Oh, that's where those went" and then walked away.  She never replaced the nacho cheese.  At that point, my son refused to eat anything else.  He was disgusted by the idea of how many people touched those tongs before they were lost in a sea of nacho cheese.  

The steak & baked potato
It was poorly cooked.  The steak was under seasoned and very fatty.  There were probably only about 5 bites of the steak that were edible.  The baked potato was a hot mess! It was so overcooked that as I put my fork into the potato, the inside turned to a consistently similar to sand! It was disgusting.  

Service
We would have made our server aware of our issues, but she didn't show up very often.  We didn't get refills on our drinks and she never checked in on us once our food came out.  She did however, inform us that they were closing early because the staff earned a pizza and movie night.  They were very motivated to get everyone out of the restaurant so they could have their party. 

I won't be giving Sizzler another try. I spent over $70 to feed my family of 4 and we all ended up having a bowl of cereal once we got home!

As brand new residents of Idaho, we have no idea where the best places are to eat yet.  My husband and I have noticed that there are a lot of different BBQ places around.  We ended up here by chance.  I am so grateful that we did though!

We arrived on tonight (Friday) just before 8pm. The parking lot seemed a bit full, so we expected a wait. When we opened the first set of doors, we were greeted by a smiling hostess welcoming us and holding open the 2nd set of doors for us.  We were then welcomed again by another smiling hostess who happily told us that she could immediately seat my party of 4 if we didn't mind a table. A table was fine with us, so we followed her. Once seated, we were greeted by Jordan. He was really friendly & patient with us. He asked us if we had any questions about the menu & checked back in with us regularly to see if we had decided what we wanted.  Our order consisted of:

(2) Chicken Fried Steak with smashed potatoes & gravy. Side salad with Bleu Cheese dressing without onion 
1/2 lb Old Fashioned burger with fries
1/3 slab of baby back ribs with mac & cheese and a baked potato with sour cream & butter

The salads were promptly brought out with 2 cornbread muffins & butter. The salad was impressive! It included bacon, diced tomatoes, diced egg, mixture of iceberg & romaine lettuce, cabbage, and croutons. It usually includes onion, but we think onions are the work of Satan, so we don't eat them.  

When the food arrived at the table, we were awestruck by what was placed before us.  The food on our plates were steaming hot.  I can't remember the last time that I had food delivered to be with it steaming! Everything smelled delicious.  I helped my son cut up his chicken fried steak and was impressed with the batter that was used for the steak.  It was clearly hand dipped & not frozen.  The gravy atop the steak was delicious! It was perfect. My husband and son both ordered the chicken fried steak & my husband commented that this was the best chicken fried steak that he has ever had.  I had the baby back ribs and Mac & cheese and a baked potato. The ribs were really good.  There was a nice smoke on them & the red smoke coloring was perfect! The Mac & cheese was just insane! The flavor was rich, creamy, & cheesy. The macaroni was still firm and held its shape. The Mac & cheese was also got all the way through.  It didn't taste like it had been just heated up under the salamander then brought out to me. I didn't eat my baked potato because I was too full, so I brought it home to eat later.  My daughter ordered the Old Fashioned burger & fries and she ate the entire thing. She commented on how fresh the meat tasted & how crisp the veggies were. The burger was huge! 

Jordan regularly checked in with us throughout our meal. We chatted with him about the food & the restaurant and he told us that everything on the menu, aside from the Caesar dressing, was scratch made in the restaurant. We also found out that the owners live locally & still come in several times a week. It was obvious to see that they take pride in the restaurant.  

I highly recommend this establishment. The prices were great. Our bill for the 4 of us was just under $60. Thank you Goodwood BBQ Company for such a great dinner & dining experience.

This place is over priced, unsafe, and my 12 year old daughter had the worst experience ever here!  She was bullied and physically hit by another girl whom she had never met before here. My daughter did the right thing and tried to go to the staff members for help on 2 different occasions while she was here and the only thing helpful they told her was that "the other girl was a regular customer known for doing this." It really bothered her.  The next day I contacted Joe the owner and he was beyond rude.  He told me he wasn't running a daycare and this wasn't his problem.  If you read other reviews about Jump Time on other sites you will find there is a common thread with kids getting hurt not because of jumping but because Jump Time turns a blind eye to certain behaviors that go on.  If you want customer service, a fun safe place for your kids to play that is inexpensive this is NOT the place to go!

Culver's 

I went to Culver's in Meridian today to try their walleye. Normally, they have it through the end of April, but they ran out early. So I tried their North Atlantic Cod Filet sandwich ($5.59). For three dollars extra I got it combo style, which includes a generous portion of french fries and a medium drink. 

This is the best fast food fish sandwich I have had to date. It's a generous portion of high-quality fish that has been perfectly cooked. The cod was nice and flakey. The batter is light but crispy. Everything about the sandwich including the bun, shredded lettuce and cheese was very fresh.I like that you can get extra tartar sauce on the side for no charge. The crinkle cut french fries were excellent.I like that both the fries and sandwich were made to order, as is all of their food. That alone is pretty much a rarity for fast food restaurants these days.

As I was getting ready to leave, one of the employees came up and told me they had made an extra caramel milkshake by mistake. They asked if I would like it. I don't normally eat caramel but because I've heard such great things about their frozen custard, I said I would be happy to. The milkshake was excellent! I like that they took the extra step of lining part of the inside of the cup with caramel.

I haven't tried very many items at Culver's, as I don't normally eat a lot of fast food but this was definitely a five-star experience. If you're in Meridian and thinking about getting fast food, you should definitely consider giving Culver's a try.

Had the worst experience ever with Chip Cookie tonight. We ordered cookies at 9 to be delivered at 9:30-10. We received no texts to update the order status (usually you get these). 10 o clock came and there were no cookies nor a text about the order. Finally at 10:20 I called Chip, getting the answering machine as they were "closed"? I called the Boise location and learned that Meridian had sent home their drivers before 10 and therefore did not send out the last few orders of the night? This gentleman was nice enough to refund the order, but it was extremely frustrating to wait an hour and a half with NO communication from Chip about this. I would recommend Crumbl cookies for anyone debating between the two.

Been here a dozen times or so. Always consistent. Really enjoy the southwest protein bowl. Soup is great too - have had the potato soup and tortilla chili soup. Long wait tonight, attributed to the lack of workforce right now but the employees were great, working really hard, and the food tasted great.

Dr. Mills and his team are friendly, knowledgeable, and a pleasure to work with. My dog is always thrilled to come visit as he gets all kinds of loves and treats during his visit and I feel confident that we are getting everything we need to keep our pup happy and healthy. I very much appreciate Dr. Mills' ability to deliver important information in a clear and positive manner, as well as ease of conversation in which we discuss current status and goals for our pets. 
His prices are very reasonable (I feel like I'm always double checking that they actually charged me for everything because it seems like it's less than I expect! They've never had it wrong!)
I've never had an issue scheduling an appt and they even personally call the day before to remind you, which is appreciated. Love the staff, love the hospital, would highly recommend Settler's Park Vet to anyone in search of a new doc for your furry loved ones.

Well thank you Matthew - supposed manager.. your standoffish negative attitude will make me absolutely a Home Depot shopper! Your unwillingness to help a customer and keep business at Lowes is amazing. Along with your trying to make excuses trying to make a college educated customer fell incompetent about geography is unfathomable.
Love cookie cutters haircuts for kids salon!! Every time we have gone their all the technicians have been great with our son and daughter! It's kept very clean and organized.

A family-run operation.  Ryan is the son of the owner and really does a great job hosting the customer.  We accepted his recommendations for our lunch and it was delicious.

The fresh cod was unbelievable.  Loved every bite.  The three taco special was very tasty.  The burger special before 3 pm got our attention.  Got the Make your own burger with Provolone and bacon and it was a solid choice.  

We were there for happy hour and the drinks were flowing at our table.  

Excellent staff attention.  We loved our discussion about things with Ryan.  He is committed to serving the best meal possible.  Keep up the good work, young man.

We will be going back very soon and often.  We recommend the same for you.

Had a meat craving, after trying two food trucks that were closed today, I decided to try Culver's. Not too bad, not overly greasy because the patties looked a little dry. The flavors were fulfilling my meat craving. Their crinkle fries were okay, but nothing to write home about. However, I was able to order a Burger with mushrooms and fried onions for the wife! it put a smile on her face so you get an extra star!
One of my favorite places in the Valley. The staff is great, the hibachi is amazing and the atmosphere is super fun.

Absolutely the worst we have ever had!!! We come here for every kids birthday and tonight was awful!!! The show was so terrible! Why do they even ask how we want our steak if they don't listen? The guy we ended up getting was a horrible entertainer! Ugh everything was over cooked and it was boring!! Had to ask 2 times for then to sing happy birthday! We will never go back! If you want a hibachi show go to Kyoto's in Boise!

Goodwood is a good resturant but it's not that resturant you ever plan on becoming a regular guest at. Maybe with Famous Dave's gone it will draw in more of a bbq loving crowd. However I personally feel it lacks a well organized team and enviroment.

When we arrived the host/hostess were arguing amongst them selves where to seat us. That initial interaction you meet with a host or hostess has a way of sticking with you the whole meal. Our waitress was super friendly and efficent but she appeared very busy which lacked in service in those respects. 

Food was great and came out quick so that was a bonus. I loved the Baby back ribs and the Ruth's Pecans. I love the flavors and the tenderness of the meat. The food alone deserves five stars however i think naturally service, enviroment and food shpuld be equally working together to get that five star dinninh experience. Definately room for improvement but highly recommend if you need a bbq fix.

If you have one of the properties they manage in your HOA, expect a lot of frustration in getting them to pay their association fees. They will admit they received your notice but just haven't got around to paying it for weeks. They don't care about the neighborhoods in which their properties are located. If you need a property manager, look elsewhere!
Tammy did  an amazing job!! Super nice and did a great job on my pedicure! So happy to have found Tammy.

First, they sold me a plan that did not work with my phone.
So I changed both the plan and the phone. 
Second, they fried my old phone doing data transfer. The tech guy didn't even apologize !! I lost all data/photos/contacts/etc.
Third : though they assured me the first line got transferred and therefore didn't need to be canceled, they charged me for all lines..
Conclusion : find another option !!

When it comes to family-friendly locations, there's just something special about the Meridian Speedway. The excitement of the races, kids having fun in the bleachers, the cheap food (and sometimes free 16 oz beers for adults), and having the opportunity to meet the racers after the event....it's just good, clean fun. 

We arrived at 6:30, which was 15 minutes before the event began, and there was plenty of free parking, no line to get past security, and plenty of bleacher seating. Guests of all ages were having fun and I think it's awesome that there were even some designated areas where there's no drinking and smoking allowed in the family bleacher section. 

All staff members were incredibly nice, the announcers kept the jokes, trivia and giveaways going throughout the event, and the races themselves were exciting. We attended a race Halloween weekend, so they had the racers run over pumpkins, side over water, and even go backwards at one point. There were a few crashes which the kids loved (everyone was safe), and it was a great mix of both teenage girls, boys and adults racing so the little girls had some awesome female racers to look up to. 

Overall, the price is hard to beat and there's hours of fun to be had. If you're looking to enjoy a night out on the town, this place is worth a visit!

My background - A Pacific Northwest Yankee that lived in the South (and Texas) for a number of years and has developed a kin for good BBQ, especially brisket.  That said, I can give Goodwood a fairly strong thumbs up for the brisket that we had.  It was quite tender and flavorful, and the BBQ sauce was good.  It lacked smoke and the high tenderness combined with the fact that I saw no ovens for 14+ hour bakes makes me wonder if it was chemically-tenderized or not, but  it was good.  That's the good part.  The bad was the sausage ...goodness, what a big limp embarrassment of a sausage!  I won't bother on sausage again!  And the 'burnt ends' really weren't ...it was just cut-up brisket from what I could see, not the 'burnt ends' of the South from the tip of the brisket, full of flavor and smoke, and drier than the  rest of the brisket.  Overall, I'd give Goodwood a 3.5 if it were in the South, but grudgingly move it to a 4 since we're a long way from Dixie.  I'll just order the brisket alone next time...

I've used this salon multiple times for massages and pedicures and I have never come away feeling unhappy with my experience. Every massage therapist I've had has been phenomenal and the pedicures are to die for. It's a beautiful, relaxing space, and the front desk service has always been great. I'd highly recommend this spa! Best I've been to in Boise!

Today 3 friend and I tried this place for the first time. I have to say we were all honestly disappointed. Each and everyone of us TRIED to order something that we out of. The man that took our order although friendly was actually laughing like it was completely acceptable to be out of foodproduts. He never even apologized. I ordered my food last of the four of us but got it first. It was cold by the time the others food came. The food was ok but overpriced.  (fries were real good) I Was glad the Dinning room was clean. Chairs are very uncomfortable. We all much prefer smash burgers and Red Robin for the price. Might give it one more try but probably not!

A nice hotel with a great location convenient for road trips, close to the freeway, yet quite. The property has a modern feel, everything seems to be new. The rooms were spacey and comfortable, with a separate living area, work station, and a minibar station equipped with a refrigerator, microwave and coffee maker. The only negative experience was at the lobby coffeeshop when we were charged more than $5 for a Pellegrino water! Even the employee seemed to realize it was a ripoff; she apologized as she was announcing the price, as if she was saying "Yeah I know!".

I really have come to love this place as a quick,  healthy option to fast food. Every soup I've tried, including their seasonal options have been fabulous. Seriously, that word - fabulous - works for their soups, salads & sandwiches. Well I haven't tried every single one there are at least sex that I've tried in all so far. The pick 2 option for less than $10 gives you a smaller version of each and allows you to try new things each time. Highly recommend.

Sushi was ok at best and expensive for the quality, waiter forgot the other meal and then brought it ice cold when we asked and it was clear they forgot it. $70 dollars and the best thing was a store bought sauce.

Honestly? It sucked.  The sides were awful.  Like I had to make a box of Cracker Barrel Mac n cheese to replace them.  My chicken "fingers" were really chicken nuggets, and the spicy wasn't. AT ALL. 

Even the sriracha Mayo wasn't spicy. 

Maybe I'm looking at this because I've had some of the best chicken karaage and know what it should be- but this wasn't it.  This wasn't even close.  I wanted to like this. I really did. It smelled great.  But it just wasn't.  

And again- terrible sides.  Crave and it's pop ups are a great concept but terrible execution so far.  

I expect better from Michael Mina.  Much better.


ETA- customer service at CRAVE is great.  I added stars back because they are willing to make it right.

I'm still looking for a Authentic Thai Restaurant. The fact that this place has the word Authentic on it made me choose to dine in. They lack some real ingredients. It seems that a lot of Thai restaurants here in Idaho go cheap on their ingredients and I think it's sad that people who eat there actually think this is how Thai dishes are really prepared.
