They serve sweet chili sauce (from a bottle) for their fresh spring rolls.. typically it's supposed to be a peanut sauce which I had requested. Also the larb had cabbage on the side instead of lettuce or lime leaves. Cabbage would really throw off the taste of the chicken larb when eaten together. The fresh spring rolls really lacked the correct ingredients. It was pretty much stuffed with iceberg lettuce. These aren't true Thai ingredients for making this. They skimp the real
Authenticity by using cheaper products.

Oh the December cookie of the month!! *drools* 

I don't generally love sweets, but my girls + husband do. I decided to bring home a box to split. 

They had the OG (chocolate chip), biscoff chip, and the seasonal - candy cane sugar chip. I ordered 2 seasonals + one of each of the others. I had wished there was a fourth option for all different, but after sampling the candy cane sugar chip I changed my mind.  

That frosting is divine! Cream cheese and peppermint?! I truly can't imagine a better pair. 

I got each of my girls a gift card for a stocking stuffer (the smallest denomination they'll load is $10). So, we will be back!!

The Best in the Boise Valley!  Our HOA has been using Done-Rite for numerous years, and again this year, they did an excellent job!  Each and every man on their crews were professional, experienced, courteous and very well trained, along with giving us a fair price.  They cleaned up after each section in our neighborhood as it was a large project with numerous tall pine trees, and when the project was completed, we are very pleased, as always.  They know trees like no other!  You can trust whatever Gary or Cory say as they are straight forward guys, who know their business.  I've personally worked with their company over 25 years ago, when I was with another HOA.  He knew trees way back then!  There is no other company in the valley who has their expertise!

Time to be seated was about 10-15 minutes, we're ok with it. 
Menu wasn't interesting at all, it was average. Then we ordered and it took a while to be served. 
Mashed potatoes were dry and cold. I'd like them smooth and warm. 
Then my 6 oz. sirloin was dry, I know I asked for a well-done sirloin, but it didn't mean dry. I was expecting a well-done and juicy sirloin. I asked to top it off with mushrooms, well they were teeny tiny mushrooms lol 
My husband ordered a sweeeet chicken with Pilaf rice, it was flavorless.
The check was almost $60 for 3 meals and the quality and service weren't what we expected. 
Our server was a little bit too much with the next customers, he forgot he had to take care of other tables. 
We're sticking with Texas Roadhouse in this area and The Outback by Overland. 
This was our first and last time at this restaurant, we got a poor first impression.
I love bagels and this place is so yummy. When I went there was only 1 worker so it did take a little while for my food to be ready but I didn't mind the wait.

I attempted to return a box of Daisy CO2 cartridges this evening that I had purchased there just a few hours earlier. When I got home and opened the box I discovered them to be the wrong style. They had no threads to attach them to my device. When I bought them an associate told me "these here are what you need" so I bought them. I was unable to return immediately but did so as soon as I could. I was told I could not exchange or return them because they don't know if I used them them brought them back. Basically accusing me of being a thief. Also you can indeed tell if they have been used or not. To use one, one must puncture the metal cap covering the outlet. This is a fairly thick metal, not tin foil as the contents are under a lot of pressure and it would be very easy to tell if it was punctured or doctored to look like it hadn't been.   I've been a long time customer and have spent a couple grand in the last year on knives, gun parts, ammunition and gear. I've purchased several firearms from them in the past, I shudder to think how much I've spent in that store since it opened, hell, I got Ted Nugents autograph on a copy of Kill it and Grill it there 14-15 years ago but will no longer give them my business. I'll go out of my way to a store that treats customers with respect. All over a $10.59 purchase. Poor business if you ask me, thank you Mr. Hunting manager. On the bright side the young lady that cashiered me was also working the return/license desk when I came back to return them and she was very nice, polite and a pleasure to deal with.

We needed a large (1ft x 5 ft) concrete patch poured and a heavy mirror installed.  Ken was on time and handled both projects like a pro!  He is obviously knowledgeable and skilled.  I would definitely call Handyman Connection should I ever need services again.

I ordered an arrangement for my dearest friend after loosing her son. I talked to the designer and thought she understood what I wanted. For the money I spent I could have bought fresh flowers myself and put a bouquet together had been more pleased. So disappointed

Definitely an experience to remember! This place was packed on a Saturday night and we got a table outside. What a treat to try some unique flavors and great quality food. We started with the Ham Croquettes and they are cheesy delicious fried balls of yumminess. The mushroom soup was my favorite thing we ate- a little spicy but so creamy and flavorful. The salad was a little underwhelming, just a light vinaigrette on some lettuce with shredded carrots and one cherry tomato. I chose the meatball and my mom got the sizzling garlic shrimp. The meatballs are... unique. Definitely house made- did not expect the flavor. Very finely ground meat but flavorful. The shrimp was tasty- no leftovers there!

A unique must-try restaurant when in Meridian!

Cameron maintained excellent communication with me throughout my moving experience, he and worker arrived on time, never missed a beat, hard workers, very respectful of my furnishings, made my move easy and effortless on my part.  I highly recommend Reliance Moving.  Very professional and courteous, and they had the best prices of all companies I researched.  Can't say enough about this company!

My wife and I came in to try Spice Indian Cuisine, as it is close to our house. Unfortunately my wife didn't care for her curry and was disappointed in its flavor. The basmati rice seemed a bit off, old.  On the other had I thoroughly enjoyed my meal. Although the garlic Naan was also a bit off, and soggy. It appeared they don't clean all that often. Food particles could be seen on the floor, in several places. We won't be back. We'll stick to our favorite downtown Boise.

Normally I love going to Sarah's bagels. But lately I have been annoyed. Orders have been wrong, switched around and now some of the workers are neglecting to wear masks or gloves on one hand but using both hands. Doesn't make sense to me. Love the food. Sad to say I won't be back.

We hired this company to move us from Roseville Ca to Hayden Idaho.  They did a fantastic job!  They were on schedule and actually had us unloaded a day early!  They were so nice and pleasant to work with!  All of our belongings arrived safe and in perfect condition!  If you need a moving company this is the one to call!

We booked our first couples massage today and what an incredible experience! 80 mins of bliss and relaxation. It was comfortable and clean, the estheticians were friendly but not overly chatty. Support this small business- you won't regret it.
The only thing I wish would have happened was to have it explained what the products were so I could purchase them after for at home maintenance and maybe more pressure during my foot/hand massage. We will definitely be booking again soon!

If I could give this zero stars I would the Nampa location rocks but the Meridian location not even close the man that works there seems like the most incompetent fellow I've ever met and the fact that he can barely speak English that's discernible is also very discouraging and the first time I went the gal making the sandwiches messed them up very badly the guy in front of me ordered a tuna sandwich and he got a tuna sandwich with no tuna and then the next time I went at 11 o'clock on a Sunday Now bear in mind they don't close till 3 o'clock and yet they were basically already all out of bagels I asked him if they had anymore and he said no this is it. Also as a sidenote I love the cinnamon sugar bagels at the Nampa location but for some reason the Meridian location seems to want to put sesame seeds all over the bottom and in my opinion that does not go well with cinnamon sugar like not just a couple an accident they were coated with them

My husband and I ate here for the first time this weekend. We were very pleased. The food, staff and atmosphere were amazing. We had such a wonderful time. I just enjoyed watching The staff connect with people, many of which they new by name. Very impressive.

We were visiting the area for the first time. Our friends suggested coming here for a chocolate chip cookie. That is all we bought - one chocolate chip cookie and my husband and I shared it. It is pretty big and heavy! It was one of the best cookies we have ever tasted. We will definitely come back for another cookie when visiting again. The employees were also very nice.
Slowest McDonald's ever. 1 car in front of us and it took 10 minutes to move anywhere!

A great guy who does great work. He's on time and doesn't try to sell you anything. He does what's right at a good price. He's trustworthy, clean and honest. He's been at my home twice and I'm about to call him for another. 9/30/19. Al came out to check out my disgruntled garbage disposal. Recently out of surgery I was unable to fix it myself. Al could have easily told me I needed a new one and charged me a lot more money but he made the simple and effective fix. Thanks Al

Asked for ham bacon egg cheese sandwich and noticed when they made it, bacon was on the counter next to them the whole time. Got home, no bacon and realized it was mine that they charged me for. Not going back again.

I have never ordered from here and decided to go through the drive through because my husband wanted to try them out. Apparently I took to long ordering because the manager got on and started rushing us to pick something. It was less then 5 mins and no one was behind us. I honestly wanted my husband to drive somewhere else. She was very rude. I would recommend checking the menu before going apparently they are not use to new comers.

If I could give negative stars I would! This was the worst service I have ever had at a Popeye's EVER! The menu board price was $13.00 less that what it rang up. They would not give me the menu board price and didn't even have enough chicken ready, unless we wanted over half our chicken in wings! No thank you!! The cook complained about having to make more chicken and it was 3:15 in the afternoon not closing time! The kid that took our order would not lower the price and went and got the girl from drive thru who also said she couldn't lower the price. So I asked for the manager and as she stomped to the back to get the manager, she yelled out to her co-workers how she needed the manager because I couldn't afford to pay for my chicken.
the manager did nothing about it either and supposedly called the GM who also would not honor the price on the menu board. 
This whole time the gentlemen behind us was saying how it is illegal to charge more than what is posted. The boy that helped us tells him to back off and be quiet as our issue is being dealt with. I told him to be quiet as the gentleman heard everything that had happened. 
Appalled at the crappy service we all left. 
We went to Meridian where their menu board was updated and I paid the higher price, because I can afford it! They all had on name tags, unlike the employees in Nampa! Drive to Meridian for better service and they also had chicken cooked and ready to go!
We love the teppanyaki style meal experience and food - it's delicious. We have also been there for sushi and have enjoyed the rolls. Would recommend.

AMAZING!!!! I have rented from 2 other local property management companies in the past and I will say hands down Humphry Property Management gave me the best customer service. communication was fabulous I always got a response within 10 minutes in emails during normal business hours or first thing the next morning. They are a smaller property management company so it feels like your working with people who care and are there for you. If I had property that needed to be managed, I would be working with them! I'm looking forward to our  renter to management relationship with them.

Ordered a coffee table and end tables during Covid. The box was delivered with holes in it. After opening it the coffee table had a hole straight through the wood. I tried calling quite a few times and could only leave a message. It said they would call me back in 24-48 hours. They never call me. I tried emailing and that wouldn't go through either. Automatic message saying they wouldn't be using email during Covid. After several months of frustration I just called my credit card and filed a dispute. I got my money back and figured Ashley would call after that. They did not.

Really disappointing. The service was fast and friendly, but the food...ugh. Thankfully I had a coupon, but wow. I remember why it's been almost 20 years since I've eaten there now. I had the original chicken sandwich. It came with wilted, shredded lettuce in the center of the sandwich, and a blob of mayonnaise.

I can't recall a time when I was in a store where NO ONE wanted to help me‍ I guess that the part of the store that takes Amazon returns must keep them in business. I asked 2 employees simple questions and, I'm not embellishing, got blank stares from both of them. If you work in the bedding department, first, you should know if you have heated throws and second, the general area they are in. Gave up and went to household looking for a slow cooker.... No prices on anything. I'll not waste my time going here again and cut up my Kohl's credit card when I got home.
Consistently poor customer service and arrogant staff in the two stores I've been in in Boise and Albany, Oregon. Will not enter these stores again.

Hidden gem!!
Loved the nachos 
Sat on the patio and the service was excellent! Went at 6:30pm and it wasn't busy at all. I'm surprised there wasn't a line to get in.

I was in Meridian looking at property and was in the mood for India food. Unlike So Cal there are not a ton of Indian restaurant's in Meridian but this one looked good. I have tried at least 30 restaurants and this one is in the top 5. I wasn't sure what to expect but it far exceeded my expectations. There was a ton of great flavors. On top of that, the portions were pretty large and there was a lot of chicken in both dishes. Also the naan was exceptional.
I would highly recommend this place and look forward to coming back once I move there next month.

Dr. Robert Ormond was recommend to me by our breeder for our new puppy. I called Linder Pet and specifically asked for him when we made our first puppy "wellness appointment." However, instead of sending Dr. Robert, they sent his father, Dr. David. Do not let this man anywhere near your pets!! Dr. David decided to administer vaccines during this visit, despite the fact that I had records that her last vaccine was given only 11 days prior. I even pointed it out to him and showed him her medical records, but he gave her the vaccine anyways. Everything I have read and heard from other vets is that vaccines should NOT be given less than 2 weeks apart I'm very concerned by Dr. David's careless attitude. He also charged me $70 for an "exam" but all he did was listen to her heartbeat. He did not examine her ears, take her temperature, etc. He spent about 2 minutes with my puppy and the rest of his time was spent talking to me about their "puppy plan" and trying to sell me on it. While it does seem like a good deal compared to other vets in the area, I wish he had spent more time actually giving my puppy a check-up. I've heard great things about Dr. Robert but stay far away from Dr. David if you choose to use Linder Pet!

My wife and I love Wendy's! We've already been here twice this week since moving to the area. It's pretty standard  quality to any other Wendy's restaurant you might have been to. They have a great two for $5 sale for a Dave Single and Chicken Sandwich as of February 2020. Went through the drive thru both times and it was a smooth and easy process. They will know our names by the end of this year lol Will come back again!

I have been going to Epi's for years and always look forward to the dinning experience, from the wonderful food to the excellent service. Our recent experience was disappointing. But not because of the food or the service, instead we noticed none of the staff were wearing masks. We were quite surprised and disappointed.
Took a lot of my hard earned and scarce money for a couple of years and didn't help me one bit.  Just interested in selling his line of supplements.

This was a very pleasant experience! The staff was every friendly from the greeting at the front desk until I walked out the door. Dr. Grant and his dental assistant were amazing too and actually got to know me a little before diving into my mouth. The goody bag was a great touch as well

Another great local business where the customer service is superior to the shopping experience at Home Depot (good luck finding an available employee) or Amazon (good luck figuring it all out yourself).  They clearly were knowledgeable about and had pride in the brands they carry.   In this day and age, any time I need to buy anything there are seemingly hundreds of products to sort through.  I really don't have the patience for that, so I rely on sales people.  Also, I felt very safe with their covid protocols, which I appreciated very much.  I would have turned around and gone home had there been anyone not wearing a mask properly, but that wasn't the case for me today.

The one star is a generous star. Our experience started out as good, and quickly  became bad. 

Getting the lenses was a superb experience. My husband had frames ( RayBans) he wanted. He did NOT buy the frames at Eagle Vision One; so, off he sent the prescription and lenses. 

The young gentleman said it would take two weeks to get the lenses and glasses back. Two days after the two week Mark, I contacted the center. Riley ( Railey?), the receptionist, told me the frames had broken and we'd need to replace it by either purchasing frames from there or bringing in our own. I questioned her how they broke, and why are we responsible for someone's careless actions? She indicated it was our problem, not the centers. Taken back by the response, I asked her how come we weren't notified sooner. She said she was sorry, she was unsure.

I asked to speak to a manager, the manager was at lunch. 

1st, why is it that I have to call a business after they said it would be in within Two weeks? How come accountability isn't being met on their end? Shouldn't the right thing to do is call a customer to let them know a. They are running behind , and b. They were irresponsible and broke our frames? Why do I have to take time out of my schedule
To call?
Secondly, someone should train the receptionist business etiquette.
The receptionist attitude was horrid. 

Third-Being held accountable for someone's actions, into regarding breaking the frames, is not what I would except from a business. We also weren't told this information. I'm now out of 200 dollars because they "aren't responsible". What kind of response is that?? Appalling. 


We will not be going there in the future, nor will we refer others. 

Once the manager calls back, I will update this with a response.

I had high hopes for this place. The food is honestly the only reason I rated this restaurant 3 stars. The service was amazing. Kind and friendly staff and the atmosphere was fine as well. But the food was just very bland and lackluster. Always willing to try again but just disappointing.

Food was good, but not anything special based on the price point. Service was good. The most concerning thing was the lack of any safety measures. None of the servers wore masks and the tables were tightly spaced. The room was filled to capacity which made it impossible to socially distance from the adjacent tables. I would not recommend this restaurant until COVID is completely under control. We are just hoping that we were not exposed at dinner tonight.

I ordered a jalapeno burger while Kristy ordered the bonsai. We shared an order of onion rings. The burgers were fine and the onion rings were also good.

Service was friendly and although we didn't order any beer, they had a large selection of self-service taps. 

This is the fourth restaurant in the Treasure Valley for the Boise-based chain.They have an interesting backstory, with CEO Nicholas Jones starting the chain while teaching entrepreneur classes as Northwest Nazarene University in Nampa.

We applaud Good Burger for their commitment to helping others. Once a month, employees take sack lunches to homeless folks near Boise's Rhodes skatepark. Jones also donates money to local nonprofit groups.

This place is an absolute joke. They claim to have a price match guarantee, until you come in with a price match that is way cheaper than what their floor price is. 

We wanted a headboard and two end tables that we saw on a few different websites. Walmart, Target, and multiple places on Amazon. Now I get you can't really price match against Amazon stores, but both Walmart and Target were significantly cheaper. When we came in to show them that Walmart and Target were about $350 dollars cheaper, they said they weren't sure if the could price match because it could be a "knock off" version, even though both sites said it was the same Ashley furniture sitting on their floor. After speaking with a manager, the best the could do was knock off $100 dollars. Some price match right? 

We ended up just buying all of it through Walmart and saved almost $400 dollars. 

Avoid this place if you are planning on price matching. They obviously don't honor what it clearly says on their website.

Update: We just went to another vet and found out our puppy has infections in both of her ears and they were clogged up with a ton of gunk. When I told Dr. David she had been scratching at her ears, he still did not look at them. Had Dr. David done his job, we probably could have caught it much sooner. Very disappointed!
I purchased some barstools and didn't like them.  Buyer beware.  They have a NO RETURNS POLICY.
Burgers and fries were super good. There isn't a place to sit and eat, but Covid has caused that for many restaurants.
I drove by the address. No signage to identify a sit down restaurant. Just Crave food delivery. Does not look like any activity in the front.

After trial and error from several salons in the area between Nampa and Boise, I have finally found my forever nail salon! Ashley B is the only one who does my nails now. I never have complains or issues with my nails and they are such amazing quality. She is always a delight to talk to and the salon has such a welcoming environment with everyone laughing, talking, singing. It's amazing!
Amazing service!! Car is great, super on time, he even had water and candies for us!! Totally recommend.

I cannot say enough good things about Mattress Firm and the gentleman who helped me, Justin Hatfield.  I hate mattress shopping.  It is confusing and exhausting.  Justin was knowledgeable, patient and kind.  He in no way pressured me  and encouraged me to take the time I needed to make a decision.  Thank you Justin and Mattress Firm.

I will not be shopping here again I am disabled and can not wear a mask I was confronted by two employees (Alex/JR or JD, I don't remember) who approached me not politely and said you need to wear a mask or leave I explained my multiple disabilities as to why I can not wear a mask and pointed out I was abiding by 6ft distancing and that the store was practically empty when they came to tell me standing well within MY 6ft safety zone they don't care that I'm disabled it's company policy and I can put a mask on or leave). It was a horrible experience and I'm only posting my experience In hopes know one else has to deal with being treated so badly!! Needless to say I left with an anxiety attack and apparently because I'm disabled NOT ALLOWED to shop here per corporate!
Danae and her team are wonderful. Friendly and experienced with cut and color, I am very happy with the result. Highly recommend and look forward to going back!

We had friends over and I checked Yelp for the pizza recommend.  We typically get Chicago Connection however I was in the mood to try something new.  This place is just up the road from us.  It's new and there was only one guy manning the place but boy oh boy ... It hit the spot!  I am please to say that out of three pizza's there was only 1 piece left.  It was great!  We will be back.  Thank You!!!

Ah!  I forgot to mention we scored some hot wings and they were incredible as well.

Do yourself a favor and make reservations to check this place out!  Located in a house that gives a cozy vibe with service that treats you like family.  Basque food at it's best!

PROS:  Where to start?  Service, atmosphere, food...all outstanding and compared to none in the Treasure Valley.  The calamari is the best I've ever had..and I don't even like Calamari.  Sauteed mushrooms?  Just say yes and enjoy the garlicky goodness as it swarms your taste buds. Entrees?  Pick any and you won't be disappointed.  My fav is the cod!  If they have a special entree available, usually it's amazing so don't hesitate to order it.  Dessert?  Green Apple Bread Pudding that will sooth your soul and belly in ways you didn't know it needed soothing.

The service and staff is always friendly and professional, treating you like family.  Snappy on the refills and clean up but not obnoxiously hovering or glaring.  They also have really good stories if they feel so inclined to share.  

I won't even both listing a "CONS" section because there are none.

A Few Notes: Make reservations.  The prices are on the higher side but you do receive high quality food and service and charging less would be an insult to the establishment.  Also expect to have your meal served at a slower place than most restaurants. It's an experience to be here, so don't expect everything out in 10 minutes or less.  Enjoy the wine and savor the flavors as you dine here and don't rush it.

Overall, Epi's is outstandingly delicious place to dine for a unique basque experience!
Holy cow.. the pedicure was amazing. They took very good care of me! The lady who did my pedicure was very attentive and made sure I was comfortable. I Will definitely be back!

Not impressed at all. I got a basic pedicure and the girl who did my pedicure only said about 5 words to me the entire time. So it was very awkward. And one of the other girls working there who was working on another clients fingernails kept texting and taking phone calls and even reading things on her phone. All the while her client was sitting there waiting on her. Very unprofessional. The music was way too loud. And in less than 5 days my polish was coming off of my nails. Some came off in a whole single piece which is weird for regular polish and other toes were chipping. I'll never go back and I'd never recommend this place to anybody!!

Tried this place because it was next to my hotel. Cool place with a lot of tv's. Sports on most with music on the rest. Friendly waitress (Tanya) was busy but attentive. I had garlic buffalo wings. They were delicious as were the crispy shoe string fries. Overall a good place. This was on a Sunday evening so it wasn't that busy.

Worst service ever! Waited 20 minutes for our order to be taken. Took forever to get our drinks refilled. Then when we got our bill we were charged for things we didn't order. Never once did our waiter apologize for anything.
The morning breakfast taste like its microwaved and from a late night gas station. Says hot and fresh but don't let that fool you.

I wanted to love this place because I read all the raving reviews online. But I have to say- I was expecting so much more... The food tasted really bland, nothing special to it. I felt like I could have made a pizza and not missed out on anything. I'm sure others will continue to love it but sadly it wasn't for me.
Best sweet & sour chicken And the sticky rice with mango is a must!! Service was great. Went back within a few days after our first visit bc I was craving it!
The meal was fantastic. We had Halibut with a lobster cream sauce and hubby had lamb chops. Shrimp and rice soup bread and salad. Great service. This is a must go to restaurant.

This is the slowest restaurant of ALL TIME. I had to wait 30 min at the restaurant for a to go order that was already called in earlier. None of the staff is helpful. Terrible experience. Probably worse than watching NASCAR on TV. Definitely worse than the Sonic movie.

I'm loving this new (for us) vet so far. With 5 very spoiled dogs (3 Yorkies and 2 English Labradors), finding good quality and reasonably priced care is essential! So far, zero complaints. I've seen two of the doctors, had one pet surgery, one teeth cleaning with extractions, ear infection treatment, and shots and exams for all five. My dogs typically hate going to the vet, but almost all of them warmed right up (I had one hold out - but he's just special). The gals in reception and the vet tech were also very friendly and helpful.
We love Sizzler! Food is always fresh, restaurant is clean, value is awesome. Love it!
This is our favorite mom and pop pizza place! The price is just right and it tastes delicious!

I placed my order for a double cheeseburger meal with a tropical sprite, a quarter pounder meal with a coke, two mcchiken sandwiches and medium fry and another medium coke, and a strawberry milkshake. 

I was charged for two crispy buttermilk sandwiches instead - a $7 price difference. After realizing the mistake, I told the boy at the drive through, and he offered to get the manager. I waited a few minutes and they asked me to pull forward to wait at the numbered sign. I asked about my refund and I was told the manager was busy.... Nice. The kid at the drive through went and got my refund and I pulled forward. After another 5 minutes or so, they brought my order out. 

When I got home, I realized all my fries were half full at best, my food was cold, my quarter pounder was dry, and I was still given the crispy buttermilk chicken sandwiches - granted I was given a refund, but it's still not what I ordered. Also my sprite was pretty much half coke.

All in all, it was a terrible experience. Charged wrong, given the wrong items, poor quality, and apparently the manager was too busy to talk to customers. If I could give zero stars, I would.

This Sizzler Restaurant was fantastic! It's cozy and warm decor, large, very clean. A beautiful salad bar presentation with cut fresh fruit beautifully displayed. Tons of options at the salad bar.  Our wait staff was fast, caring and efficient. Our food was prepared and brought to the table in a very timely manner. I ordered the Fish and Chips with my "chips" being Sweet Potato Fries. Everything was hot and delicious and I gotta say the BEST fish I've ever had in a Fish and Chips platter. Usually restaurants serve the fish with more batter coating than fish meat but here, the fish was like at least an inch thick! It was crazy good and delicious! Loved it!  And!!! You get ice cream with a fun choice of toppings or brownies or Rice Krispie treats for dessert at the salad bar! The bathrooms were clean and well stocked. 
5 stars for this visit! We'll definitely be back!
I've been to all there locations and the consistency never fails! This will forever be my go to taco place except through December and January:(

If u can't do something, SAY YOU CAN'T before it's too late!!! Made appointment for multiple services. Was told "We will make it work and let you know if we can't. Otherwise you are all set." 2 weeks later I call to confirm appointments made. Was then told that it couldn't happen.....2 days before the appointments and 4 days before the wedding!!!  Now everywhere is filled and the brides hair can't get done. Beyond frustrating and extremely unprofessional!!!

We just used Valley Custom to move from Irvine to Boise.  They were straight forward with there quoting process.   They did what they said they would. Communicated during there trip out to Irvine, showed up on time.  Austin and Tony were professional and they were very good movers.  Took good care of our stuff, and were careful when they were moving into the new place.  We were very comfortable with them and would ask for them specifically if we needed a moving company in the future
These people will disrespect you the moment they don't like something about you. They dont care about their tenants or human decency in general. I would not recommend coming here. PERIOD.

I had to drive nearly 7 hours away to help a cousin recover from surgery. The day before I was to leave, my dash popped up with a warning that the tire pressure was too low.  A little overwhelmed and slightly panicky, I called the local Big O Tires.  Explaining the situation the very nice man told me to bring it right down.   What a relief!  He checks all my tires at it seems my two front ones are low on tread.  Its obvious once he points it out.  I wish I'd caught it sooner.  It turns out they had the tires I needed and swapped them out for me.  It was a very busy shop, but I was in and out in less than 2 hours.  Now I can drive off and feel completely safe.  How great is that!!!  I'm going back for all my tire needs from now on.  AND they told me they do a lot more than tires!  Awesome!

Absolutely disgusted. I went in today and ordered for my family and it was going to be our nice meal and I paid $34 for something that I could've gotten at taco Del Mar for five dollars. My husband got brisket tacos and the manager was so rude to actually take the meat off of the tacos throw the taco shells away because the young gentleman helping me had put way too much well I can tell you that too much means some meat rather than no meat. We will not be back ever and I hope that they see this one star in their corporate fires the manager for her horrible customer service

Made an appointment and went in at my designated time for a pedi and mani. The menu was quick and good, the pedicure took AN HOUR AND A HALF, and I left without ever even getting my polish done. The girl didn't know what she was doing, the water was cold and she kept filing the skin around my nails. So unhappy with my service.

Not bad, but also not outstanding. The outside and interior are well appointed and give a nice atmosphere. We decided to have the hibachi menu at the teppanyaki grill. Our server, Ryan was pleasant and did a good job but also seem to be rushing around and overworked. Perhaps they were understaffed? The server at the grill next to us, I did not catch his name, but he wore his face mask under his chin the entire time. I realize that some employees wear their mask and others do not perhaps depending on whether they have received their vaccination. I don't have a problem with either scenario but I do have a problem if you're constantly wearing your mask under your chin. Either wear it correctly or take it off. 
The chef we had seemed to have very good knife skills but the show at this location was less of a thrill than I have experienced at other teppanyaki restaurants. Usually you will get a shrimp thrown at you to catch like a seal. LOL. This is actually a fun part of the experience but for some reason at this location they threw broccoli instead. Really? This seemed odd to us. Of course we still got the shrimp appetizer but it was unceremoniously placed on our plates.
The rice was very flavorful but just fried with egg and soy sauce. That was served first. The show with the flaming smiley face, spinning egg, the knife skills and the flaming volcano were standard. The chef did a great job at keeping us entertained, but as mentioned previously this restaurant does not give them too many tricks to perform. Our biggest disappointment was the temperature of the proteins cooked. Everything was far overcooked, especially giving the fact that the chef asked us what temperatures we would like on the meat. One lady at our table requested her meat to be "bloody rare" and yet received it medium to medium-well. Our salmon was overcooked and actually dry and only edible when dredged in the yum-yum sauce. The vegetables were well cooked and plentiful. I should state that we started with a few appetizers which were excellent. The seafood soup had a wonderful flavor and thick body. The rock shrimp came with a delicious spicy dressing and mixed greens.
This restaurant is okay and we may return but we will probably try other teppanyaki restaurants before we decide to come back here.

We had a wonderful experience using these guys!  We would highly recommend.  Pretty amazing to have your home packed up on Tuesday and they have it to you by the end of the week.  I loved that they were local and I wasn't dealing with a national company.  Hire them, you won't be disappointed! Thank you for making our move from to CA to ID so smooth!

We stopped in for the all you can eat shrimp with steak special and despite the low rating, we found the restaurant very clean. The service was excellent due to Crystal, our waitress. Steak was cooked right on the money and the buffet was fresh and had a great variety.  We will stop by here again!
Our first time there and the food & service was excellent. Had fish & chips was one of the best I've ever had. Tried the custard for dessert and  wasn't disappointed at all we'll return  !

What happened to this place? Last time there were beer taps on the wall; now, no beer whatsoever. Bragged about all the beer choices, brought our friends to a place with no beer, sticky floors and not enough staff. Still decent burgers, but there are lots of choices for burgers.

On the search for solid Asian not American style, pure Asian cuisine. And wow we found it at Thai Basil, great food and nice people.  A must if you want a great Pho or Curry. Definitely our new favorite restaurant!!!

Love the atmosphere, literally, you're in someone living and dining room. Generous service, but was a bit underwhelmed by the food. No doubt it's good, may have built it up in my head; I've just found a couple places downtown I'd go back to first.

Handyman Connection was very responsive and was able to schedule me very quickly. Andrew showed up and was extremely knowledgeable about what was needed to fix everything on my list and even came back on a Saturday to complete the last item. I highly recommend this service and Andrew!

I must tell you how amazing Dr. Jacob Smith has been for me.  I am a 66 yr. old woman who moved to Meridian in December, 2018.  Two days before I moved, I was diagnosed with kidney cancer.  I was terrified!  I was going to a new place with NO doctors.  Dr.  Smith totally understood and got to work immediately.  He listened to my needs and then did what I needed.  Most doctors don't act as quickly as he did for me.  I can definitely recommend Dr. Smith to anyone who needs a family Dr. or a PCP.  He is fabulous!

Horrible attitude with employees. Recently got attitude from Justin at the returns counter. I bought the wrong size part and was going to exchange for the correct one. Instead I got my money back (very rudely from Justin) and went to Home Depot and had a very positive experience opposite from what I saw at Lowes.

-10 rating

I went to the vet to see if my dog was having maybe tooth problem vet say teeth fine need blood work which I was never explained why I live on 400.00 a month on medicare then came back hands me a cup tells me I have to get a sample of her pee then says that she is in kidney failure and tells me to come back in a week go up front to pay was told 280.00 dollars I was in there 5 minuets.  Now I go on vacation the next day and about 3 days into vacation my dog my baby is now peeing blood not emergency vet so not I am driving as fast as I can I am 6 hours a away get home go to the emergency hospital on overland and guess what my baby not in kidney failure she has a uti with ecoli and maybe if linder vet would of taken more time with her she would of know this they want money and do not care about any of the animals they treat this is the worst treatment I have ever had in my life and then told me I had to buy a 65.00 dollar bag of dog food that they sell because she cant eat regular food now we are at 350.00 and nothing from them.  We are now patients of the emergency hospital and they are awesome and I spent 209.00 this is a shame the way linder vet treats people this is a -10 rating I would not go there.
If you feel like getting half the portion as you would at Chipotle, for the same price, this spot is for you my friend!

Epi's has been on my to do list for a very long time and I finally made it. The reviews are very good by our fellow Yelpers so my hopes were high. I have friends that rave about this place. 
The restaurant is located in an old house with a built on enclosed patio. When you enter the restaurant, you pass the singular table in the patio and enter the main restaurant where all the tables are located which was the houses original living room it seems. Just fyi...the restaurant does pack as many tables as they can in the room... I thought this brought a unique homey feel. The employees were all very nice and friendly. 
We started our dinner with Ham Croquettes along with Button Mushrooms. The mushrooms were cooked in a light sauce that did not mask the mushrooms. If you love button mushrooms, you will love these. The croquettes were cooked to a golden brown with a great exterior crunch. The insides of the Croquettes were very creamy but lacked the ham taste I was expecting. I am no Croquettes expert, but these were great.
For dinner I ordered the Meatballs. The dinner was accompanied with bread, soup, salad, mashed potatoes, and peas. The accompanied food is for all dishes. No substitutes here. The bread was fresh and yummy. The red bean soup was my favorite dish of the night. It had great flavor and was not too heavy. The salad was very boring (see photo). The peas were overcooked and chalky in my opinion. The meatballs were nothing special. They did not have any wow factor or flavor and the garlic tomato sauce was bland.
I went in with high hopes and left 'meh. The food appearance is sub par and very boring. The flavors of the food were a bit disappointing (I expected a lot more given the reviews). The portions of the food are just fine.
If you are looking for a basque restaurant and want a friendly and comfortable spot, Epi's is your spot.
Cheers Always!

Thank you 4 taking care of us this morning. My two sons and I all got haircuts this morning, and it was very quick and painless. The boys got balloons, lollipops and lots of fun playtime at the slide afterwards. Dawson even got blue Sonic hair gel for his new fade. He loves it!!! Thanks again for another round of great haircuts.
This is some of the best Hispanic food I've had in Boise. Tacos were delicious and great options. Happy hour till 6. Will definitely be back!

I wish I could give zero stars. This is the worst rental company and half of what they do should be illegal.  We rented from them in a home that only had one neighbor who they also rented out.  When looking at the home they boasted at how great the one neighbor was.  What a lie.  The guy was a convicted felon (he and his gf told us), who tormented me and my family the whole time we lived there. We had the police there more times to count and when bringing this up to Johnson Property Management, they couldn't care less.  To top everything off, they charged us pet cleaning fees when we moved out, even though we had no pets.  These people are TERRIBLE. They prey on people who don't have much money or poor credit. Their prices seem good to be true because they are, you get what you pay for.

I made a simple order.  Two meals, the same thing.  They couldn't be bothered to actually get this simple order correct.

I might return in a year after everybody there has been fired

These days it's really hard to find good customer service. My husband has been working on various projects around the house, so that means many trips to the hardware stores. Compared to HomeDepot, Lowe's had by far the best customer service. I understand that there is a shortage of workers, but you wouldn't even know it by their outstanding customer service. Every time we need assistance the workers are extremely helpful, kind and most importantly knowledgeable. They spend as much time as it takes to help us with our needs. I am always impressed when I come here. 5 stars from me!

I don't typically give reviews, but my experience this morning driving through was too good to not give a virtual high-five.
Matt (a lead/shift lead, according to his name tag) took our order and helped us through the whole process, and his customer service was impeccable. My friend was in town visiting, and having never eaten at a Culver's before - it took us a little longer to order. Matt was courteous during the entire process. Any questions/requests we had, Matt came through each and every answer/response with flying colors. He was very kind and professional in his order taking, he said "My pleasure" with honesty, and a genuine attitude. He was the perfect representation of what customer service should me. Someone give that man a raise!

Admittedly, I've never eaten at a Sizzler..  but our family, on the 12 hour drive home, decided to stop and grab dinner.  Could not be happier!  First thing I see upon walking in is a happy hostess who was extremely nice and at the salad bar an employee very nicely asking a patron to wear a mask...  not judgmentally nor rudely, but in a way where everyone was smiling and went about their way.  We opted to sit outside (they have outside seating) and our waitress was very nice and helpful and the food was delicious and a great value...  I had the trio, kids had steak bites, and my wife had hibachi combo...  all was wonderful.  Great experience.

Let's run down the list of why you want to try other wine spots.  1) EXTREMELY overpriced wines.  If you want to pay 3x-4x times the cost, this is the place for you.  2) A restaurant run by millennials for a crowd of 30/40/50 somethings.  And older.  If you want to listen to 20 something rappers while you sip wine with your friends who are in their 40's/50s'/60's or more... THIS is the place for you.  3) the staff (younger staff) are EXTREMELY rude.  The bar manager at this location forgets who pays the bills.  To be honest, I'd avoid this place and if you happen to be in the Village.... try Kona or one of the other places.  They honestly do not care about the customer here.  Like I said, when the "mgmt" is gone, the younger staff take over.  See above as to why that's a bad thing.

Normally I do not leave low ratings, and just let things go.  However, this past sanitation pick up cycle, Thursday May 2nd, it has gone too far.   Not only did the sanitation worker not pick up the garbage (broken plastic lattice), he threw it across the sidewalk away from the bin.  Then, proceeded to break our  2nd trash can handle by throwing it against the truck (yes, its an approved container).  Basically, now we are left with a bin full of plastic lattice and our personal second trash bin thats now broken, and no pick up for another week.  I will not assume this is normal for other neighborhoods.  I can state this has been ongoing for this route and it is obvious there is no supervisor or manager willing to step up and correct this issue for the customers.  The bad part is the snide looks we will get by having to stack full trash bags bags next to our bins due to the bins already being full of the trash they decided to pick up this week.   Guess Republic should have thought of that today. 
Next step, contact Ada County and Boise City to file a more formal complaint.

Let me start by saying our server Brandon was great and gets five stars for his service. On to the restaurant, if Gordon Ramsey walked in here he would shut the place down. The food at this place is absolutely hideous! The manager on duty during the day is totally rude and cheap. We were charged extra for even the lamest things to be charged for. All the rolls we ate were disgusting. And they were cheap on everything. Their specialty rolls were like a mix of bland and gross flavors mixed into one gross bite. When we left the manager was at the door and wouldn't even acknowledge us. Hopefully Brandon will quite and go somewhere where is great customer service experience is appreciated. Won't be back

I have been exploring the menu...love the lamb curry, so good. I have ordered 3 x now. It has been consistently wonderful. Still haven't been for the buffet, which I would recommend for any new food to explore options, but have enjoyed several other items from the menu. I would love to take visiting friends and/or family to Spice Indian Cuisine for a meal.
This amazing restaurant never disappoints!  The food is fantastic and the service even better!!!  And the portions are huge!  There's nowhere I'd rather go for a special event dinner.

Went there for St  Patrick's day knowing it would be busy. However, there were about 4 groups waiting at the front door and none of the hosts or hostesses acknowledged them or us. Multiple hosts, hostesses, and other staff walked by, looked at us, grabbed something from the host stand and walked away. We stood there for roughly 10 minutes before giving up and going somewhere else. 

Always acknowledge the customers with a greeting, at least, and never a glare.
My family has been here twice. Both times the food was hot, fresh and delicious. Their butter burgers are the best fast food burger around.
Amazing food and service. The fried rice is amazing. The shrimp was way better than the scallops but both were great

Don't bother ordering these for anyone! They didn't deliver (or call) then when we called them several hours later we were told Eagle is outside their delivery area. Fix your website so it doesn't take money, then have the curtesy to call people and refund money if you refuse to deliver to them After accepting an order!!!

Love the theater! It is clean, and the theaters we have been in so far are not very large, but the screens are decent size and the seating arrangements are amazing! Spacious, large area for your legs to have tons of room, there are separating walls in between every row so no one is kicking the back of your seat at all! Large leather recliners with trays in front of you for food and deep drink holders. Nice selection of snacks at the food bar. Can't believe how inexpensive tickets are for how nice it is.

They delivered quickly. They are thick and doughy, under cooked and when cold are not fit to eat. I wouldn't except that they are so expensive. Must not have eggs or they would be dangerous to keep in a couple days. Buyers are better off going to a bakery, any bakery.

I just came in with my husband and daughter and we waited an exceptional lol ng time for our meals however the management and server were extremely wonderful.  They bought our food and in return I decided to give a tip anyway.  Everyone makes mistakes but unfortunately you can't really help when ticket machines go down. Food was still great! ....just forgot the peppers on my philly. ;)

Oh wow! Bodovino is awesome but the drinks are even better... Christian makes the best drinks ever, I recommend the dirty martini, hands down the best!! Not only are the drinks tasty but Christian is delicious to look at and so fun to chat with!

I was working overseas and wanted to rent out my place. So I hired Paradigm in 2014 to manage one of my properties in meridian because they were referred to me. At first everything was great. I would touch base every once in a while to see how the renters were treating the property and every answer I got was "they are treating the house with care". So I didn't really worry. So one tenant left and I specifically asked how the house was left and they said it was in great shape and ready for another tenant to move in. So I took them at their word since I had no way of knowing any difference. So it was finally rented again by a very nice couple with four kids. Around a month into the house they were emailing the property team asking for things to be replaced or fixed. So I replaced or fixed all of the issues that was actually forwarded to me from the property team. I now know that a lot of stuff was not being dealt with or forwarded to me. So I finally got the numbers of the tenants and asked them if they wanted to get rid of the property team and just go to me. They were so happy. I actually found out the house was not in renting conditions when the tenants rented. They needed to get into a house fast so they accepted it. 

All in all... I do not recommend Paradigm for anything. They over charged for things like landscaping but nothing was ever done. Just cannot trust them.

Oh... my... gosh!!!! I just ordered takeout here for the first time and this is hands down the BEST sushi I have found in the Boise area! I am so beyond thrilled with our order. It was expensive, but SO worth it! 

Dishes we would highly recommend: 

Dragon Roll
Sunshine Roll
Dinosaur Eggs
Edamame (fantastic portion for the price)

A loa ally owned restaurant and its DELICIOUS!!! I was given a gift card for Christmas and that was my first time trying it. I've been back 3 times now because it's soooo yummy! Definitely worth the splurge. We took it as take each time and it was packaged nicely.

I ordered a 12 piece spicy tenders yesterday evening. When I got them home to eat, I couldn't believe it!!!
Instead of Chicken Tenders, I received Boot Leather Strips!!! Absolutely inedible!!!
    I Love Popeyes!!! But to receive and purchase such incredibly awful & inedible eats has me so disparaged! Questioning whether ir not to patron this establishment ever again. So very disappointed!!! Not to mention that I tried to order popcorn shrimp and they said they had been out if shrimp for 3 months!!!
       Seriously Not Haappy!!!!!!!

What a gem!! This place my not look like much but I will definitely be going back to try more of what they are serving. I ordered the prime rib french dip and let me tell you, this may be one of the best prime rib sandwich I have ever had. The rub was absolutely amazing!!!!!!!! It crusted the edges of the not so thinly sliced meat but not so thick that you can't sink your teeth through it and had an amazing flavor! It is smoked right there for god knows for how long but it is good. They give you your choice of fries, totts, onion rings or salad for a side. I stayed traditional with fries and was very happy. The portion was plenty, the fries were well cooked, not greasy and soft, but lightly crispy and fluffy. They serve them with there version of fry sauce that has a little horseradish in it to add a little kick. Not only did it taste amazing but it paired well with the prime rib sandwich. I also ordered an ice tea for a refreshing beverage and was caught a little off guard when it came out in a small beer style pitcher for a glass. The up side was I never had to have a refill as there was plenty to quince my thirst.

Now I do have to give a little disclaimer on the building and atmosphere as it is not your average sit-down eatery. When you drive up it will most likely look closed, but don't worry someone will be in there. You have to park in a dirt lot in the back of the building and enter through the back door, just pretend you are a delivery guy and you will be fine. For a second you will feel as if you are totally in the wrong place. When you get inside you will find yourself in a bar surrounded by pool tables, bar style round tables, bar stools and an L shaped full-on bar. The menu is one page that covers breakfast, lunch, dinner and appetizers but finding something that sound good is not difficult. 

I am looking forward to going back and trying there philly chees stake, also prime rib, and some onion rings. I highly sugest giving this place a try and if you can get over the atmosphere I would be shocked if you didn't love the food.

Had a great first visit! Stopped in for a light brunch and really loved it. We took advantage of the Sunday $3 mimosas and ordered two side Caesars with a flatbread to share. We added chicken to the salad and that was quite yummy! They were pretty busy and prob could have used one more staffer but the service was reasonable and the team was very friendly and welcoming.  Nothing to be intimidated about here. Love the wine is all visible and in beautiful displays and pour lines. Really neat to see! Reduced a star due to staffing needs and visibly seeing them remove masks etc while talking to customers (covid is not gone) and the flatbread could have been a bit more tasty. Will be back for sure!

Stopped in recently and glad we did! It's been several years since I've been back to the Mountain West and I wanted to try some of my old haunts again. 
Ordering food is fairly simple process and with a few exceptions it is made in front of you and ready by the time you get to the cash register. Sandwiches can take a bit longer due to grill time. 
The restaurant wasn't terribly busy the evening my wife, in-laws and I went and so we were seated in a matter of minutes with our food. 
I got a Cuban sandwich and then a BBQ chicken salad and both were excellent! 
Reason for the 4-stars was that the restaurant itself wasn't particularly clean and the children's high chairs were filthy. Glad we always bring wipes.

Our first trip here was disappointing. The baked ziti was barely warm and certainly not baked. The bolognese sauce was flavorful but was not cooked long enough to soften the carrots. Table service was marginal. We noticed the table next to us retained their dirty dishes for over 25 minutes. The attire of the employees and the acid rock background music was in opposition to our expectations. They have work to do.

Every once-in-a-while during my travels across the U.S. I wander into something truly special and unique.  Lucky for me, this happened last evening at Epi's.

In town for a trade show, I offered to buy some customers dinner and they recommended this restaurant and I feel very thankful that they did.  To sum things up, this place is special on every level... food, customer service, attention to detail, friendliness, warmth, you name it!

If you're Gluten Free, don't judge a book by it's cover.  This is a family owned restaurant and just looking at their menu might drive you away.  One of the guests who joined me is Gluten Free and called the restaurant before they opened.  The Chef answered the phone and described what he could cook for him.  When we arrived, the same chef came out and went through the menu with our Gluten Free guest and they designed his dinner.  He was so happy that he decided to join us and thankful for the special attention from the chef.  He's in town a lot on business and will be visiting Epi's many more times in the future!

 I won't try to bother describing the food.  I don't have the words to do it justice. Suffice it to say it's absolutely wonderful.  I am particular fond of the red bean soup with the bread they serve.  I honestly could have just eaten this all evening.  However, the salad, Rock Fish special, and everything they served was simply outstanding.  Order the bread pudding dessert with their awesome caramel and share it with the group.  You'll end up ordering another one.  It's heavenly! 

The chef and our server came out to say goodbye as we left.  Nice touch!  And a hug from the server was also nice.

We Will Be Back!!!

First impressions are every thing. I have not rented from this company and never will because they treated me poorly over a simple phone call. I dont appreciate businesses that think they are "too good" to be polite or professional with you. I sure would never treat someone that way in my place of business. I expect better especially if I plan to rent a home from them.

We were "here" about a year ago, and it's a totally experience today!

It has built a new facility in a new location with many more equipments.  It is definitely new and much cleaner.  My boys love their Ninja course and dart (Nerf gun) time which adults can have lots of fun and challenges as well (or tiring...). Big parking lot to accommodate guests.  They have more guards to monitor the play areas to ensure safety of players.

Note: there are some age and height restrictions on the Ninja course.  If the kids is younger or shorter but wants to try it.  S/he musts be accompanied by an adult who will pay a 50% off ticket.  I had to go in and do a bit "stunt" with my 7 year old short boy.   Be prepared if you have a younger kid who wants to try it. 

We didn't try the food so I can't rate the quality of food.  I would say this is a great party place to have a kids birthday parties and many hours of fun just on any day.

Only hope they would have a few lockers and the check in area a bit bigger.  It is too close to the entrance so lots of people were crowded over there when we walked in.  Some hand sanitizers dispensers around the play area will be a big plus, too.
Great tasting pizza at a great price!  Real ingredients,  great pizza sauce, it's always fresh. You get a punch card to earn free pizza. Our favorite place to grab lunch during the work day.

Went there didn't have a mask it fell on the ground outside and I didn't want to wear it. So when I walked in I immediately asked for a mask and Antonio at the counter told me I needed to leave immediately and that they would not serve me. When I asked again if they had a mask they could provide he said no go buy one yourself, I get the mask regulations but I have never in my life got such attitude and disrespect from an employee before. I won't ever go to this place. Went to habit burger down the road they gave us masks and let us eat there. Way better anyway. For businesses doing so bad if I were the owner I would be firing employees that make me lose out on business. To be honest my wife and my friends that went will never even try it because of this one situation. So disrespectful.

When I moved into my first home I needed a vacuum. My Mom suggested I go to Classic Vacs, saying that the owner "knows his products" and has great customer service. She was right on both counts! He took time to really listen to my needs and then recommend a product that would meet them in my price range. He is kind and knowledgeable and I HIGHLY recommend his store and expertise!
Great atmosphere with even better food and drinks! Make sure to see Christian while you're there for a good drink

The worst vet practice I have ever encountered. They sent my dog to WestVet for treatment and when I tried to renew meds that she was placed on they said I had to wait until the vet who saw her was in. I said it was a refill and was willing to bring her in but was told the other vets would not see her   they said that they never received records from westvet which were faxed twice and they have never prescribed the med she is on for a dog. They must hire the bottom of barrel. If you don't know something, Look It Up! They also make you leave you're dog for appointments. It was over 3years of these kinds of appointments before I found out that my vet was no longer there and before I set eyes on anyone else. They spayed my girl and somehow it caused her breathing problems that sent her to WestVet. If you care about your animal, take them elsewhere!

Lauren was great with my son's first haircut! He's a one year old typical squirmy little boy and she did great with keeping him distracted and giving him a cute little boy haircut. I would definitely recommend this place to anyone who has a little one. Just call ahead to make an appointment first!

Ashley Has some pretty nice furniture lines and while their staff is friendly their management is seriously dysfunctional. I attempted to make a purchase in the store over the phone and verified item numbers with the associate only to have the manager change my order to another piece of furniture he felt was similar because I had actually been quoted incorrectly the price over the phone. It is a good thing the sales associate was smart enough to catch the mistake and call me before the furniture got delivered. I'm not sure what the manager was thinking that I would not have somehow noticed he changed my order? On what planet does a manager just change Items in a furniture order without speaking with the customer first? Stay tune for how long it takes for me to get my refund...
Pretty good bbq, but when you've eaten bbq from south central L.A. which is from people from the south it's hard to compare. But I'd say very good with great portions.

Amazing sushi. Raw sashimi ... real sushi!! Excellent cocktails great staff! Great big location with room for social distancing. I cannot wait to go back! Lots of stuff on the menu to choose from. Everything we picked was amazing! Not one complaint

IZUMI never disappoints, Grace and Kun are FANTASTIC!!!  They are always friendly and anticipate our needs before we ask.  In these times (Covid, post Covid, etc. whatever you call it...) it is difficult to find service workers that are so dedicated and make you feel not just welcome--but truly appreciated as a customer.   We dine out easily 5 days a week, and while we often times seek out new experiences, IZUMI is a weekly visit.  Food is excellent, drink prices are good, presentation is true art--though, the real reason we come back is the service.  Grace is most likely one of the most amazing humans we have met, so kind and caring.  Kun is extremely detailed and doesn't miss anything!   These two are so complimentary in their roles that everything flows seamlessly.  Seriously, don't pass by this place without stopping in--and most importantly, make sure you see Grace and Kun at the bar! Not only are they amazing at their job, and incredible people -- they both are always dressed in the latest styles. (NO ONE rocks a vest like Kun!!)   If you like amazing service, good food/drinks with meticulous presentation, do not miss this place!

We have been going to Culver's in Meridian consistently for about 3 years. The food has always been great. Big, customizable menu. Good portions. Everything always prepared well. However, the service was excellent up until the last few months. Now, incorrect orders, frequent communication issues with individuals taking the orders, long wait times without being busy, and just generally poor customer service. 

Most recent example is, I ordered a meal for myself, wife, and small child. The individual taking the order multiple times replied with "what!?". Not "I'm sorry, I didn't catch that", not "would you mind repeating that", not "I'm having difficulty hearing you" or even just politely saying "what was that". It was as if I was inconveniencing this individual by the simple act of trying to place my order. Then, after waiting an exceptionally long time to receive our food, an individual wearing a manager name badge repeats the order to me and it is incorrect. I state as much and he just looks at me and says "oh, its correct" without actually looking. This isnt the most egregious example, but the most recent. That said, in the last few months it seems they have a lot of new people working at and running this location that just dont give a rip about the job they accepted and are paid to do. I'm not asking for free stuff or a 5 star experience from a fast food joint, but standard common courtesy and a dash of customer service can go a long way.

Dr. Mills and the staff go above and beyond. My cat had been excessively sneezing and had eye discharge. They were extremely gentle and friendly with him. It turned out my little guy had a respiratory infection and needed antibiotics. They were happy to answer any questions or concerns I had. I will be back for any other issues that may arise. Thank you for being amazing and having excellent customer service.

Linder Pet Care had been providing all of our veterinary needs for our dog Georgie when he became immobile and couldn't make visits to the veterinary office. When we recently had to say goodbye to Georgie,  Dr. Ormond and his staff were extremely kind and caring. They made a very difficult time better by treating our dog, and our family, with the highest respect. They will always have our gratitude for the excellent mobile services and the gentle care they provide.

2 stars because it was a good burger but establishment and employees not so much
 Wont be eating there again. So first none of the employees wearing masks soo dont think youre following covid regulations. Then we get our food notice employee touched his face multiple times no hand washing. Husband asked for ranch one employee goes to get it and the other says "you want to suck my d*** while down there" yep... so the ranch was gross not ranch. Then as were eating the employees are talking about very inappropriate things loudly. It's one thing one was proudly voicing his political views I dont think is good for business but leave the sexual talk where customers cant hear? The drink fountain looks like it hasn't been cleaned in a while. So here's my suggestion... good food. Get new employees because joe dirt and the trailer park boys dont know how to behave for a business.

The bowls that we ordered were really dried out. Dried out beans (didn't know that was possible), dry chicken. Everything was very bland. Smaller portions by a long shot. I guess smaller portions work out when the food isn't enjoyable anyway.

This is not a reflection on Dr . Karlfeldt himself as I've never seen him, this review is based on his staff and office personnel . This office is run so unprofessionally it lacks enforcing any Hippa laws. I say this as a healthcare professional myself. Please do your homework and look for a clinic who knows how to treat you not only as a patient but a human being. The front office and nurses are so rude and incompetent. Truly there are too many reasons to list as to why not to come here.. consider this a friendly for-warning. Look somewhere else, you'll be happy you did.
Waited 30 minutes in an empty restaurant for sub-par, but grossly overpriced food. Don't get all the hype behind Culver's since this happens every single I've visited. Never again lol

Really disappointed in the experience today. Normally zupas is money but not today. Crazy long wait time and rude service. I get that the stress of a busy lunch rush can get to you but customers are also feeling the stress of having to wait in line for half an hour just to get a salad. Not to mention other workers were barely moving. Feels as though this is the new trend. Understaffed restaurants, stressed employees, poor quality service and the kicker is you pay more for it.

These guys were on time, accommodating, and professional. Ron and John drove down to LA to pick up our things. Both were professional and personable. In less than 5 days we had our stuff all loaded into our nampa apartment.

Thier estimate was perfect, I recommend them and would use them again in a heartbeat.

Thanks VCM

No ammo in stock when I went, except a few boxes of 45-70, 3 25 packs of .357, and 2 boxes of 9mm. All of the shelves are empty. They also allow only 2 boxes TOTAL to be purchased. On top of that, the long haired sales associate at the gun counter had ATTITUDE dripping off of his body posture and facial expression. I got the feeling he hated me....?

WTH happened to this place? I shopped here last year and people were nice and they had ammo in stock. No this is a shell of a store, and the workers are just plain mean. 

Avoid this place like the plague.

I was vacuuming today, cleaning up after my son's usual antics, and my vacuum cleaner almost caught on fire or smelled like it was going to. I looked up the local vacuum repair shop, and I found this gem. But it looks like I forgot to replace a filter that I have never even known about LOL It was an easy $15 repair, and it was totally worth the cost, time and trip to the shop. Thank you!!!

Excellent 20 years ago--- excellent today!
Delivery is awesome- but let's be real- how could delivery beat from kitchen to table in 10 footsteps?
Grateful for delivery to keep this amazing place here for when we're out of this!
We had Valley Custom Moving move some furniture to idaho Falls. They were reliable and did a good job. Very nice guys.

I am giving two stars because the servers are good, but the food tonight was, omg, sub par and like my 10 year old made it ....the Aglio Olio was just so amateur and zero flavor....I had the "Bolognese" pasta , but was nothing "Bolognese" about it. It was suspossed to be on linguine but is was spaghetti noodles with pasta sauce with some ground beef and zero spices ..Apparantly they have zero clue what Bolognese is.....lol.  NO KIDDING.....the pizza was very little pepperoni and too much cheese....and my friend had a salad and had most left so she wanted to take home but they were out of to go boxes at 7:30... Nice wine selection, but small pours....would not go back for the food ever unless you have no taste buds of think bolognese is bland pasta sauce with no spices ground beef.

This is a medical supply store. It's always very busy with people picking up specialized formula or diapers for their kids, medical scooters, crutches, c-pap machines, oxygen and much more. The wait times are very long at times-- the people do a good job and are friendly. I don't have much experience with other medical supply stores, but this one seems to be clean and top of the line. The reason for the 3 stars is the wait time. I've been waiting 3 days for a call back for an appointment to pick something up, and they've yet to call me back to schedule the appointment. Everyday I call and they will have "someone call me back", just schedule me already.

We really enjoyed our dinner. We came on a Friday night at 7 pm, it was busy but they took us to a table immediately. The service was quick and our server, Kun, did an excellent job. Dinner was delicious and the food came quickly. Will be back!

I'm very upset, for the first time in 20 years I got food poisoning.  It was clearly from this place. 

Either the spicy tuna roll, pink lady roll, edemame, or hot and sour soup were tainted.

I'm really pissed off at this place.  I traveled from out of town for work, so now not only am I away from home, but I'm stuck in my hotel room on a toilet.

Gross.
Reliance Movers came through for me! Showed up on time, worked hard, great attitude. 5 stars all the way!

Give your taste buds a treat.  Excellent tasty cuisine.   We chose the dining room at 4PM and ordered from the multi-choice menu.  Don't miss the 'starters '.....crispy calamari is outstanding.  As is the house made Mai Tai.  We tried several menu items...all very good.  The group seating with an onsite chef had begun before we finished.  That will be fun next time with a group of friends.
Highly recommend.

A great guy who does great work. He's on time and doesn't try to sell you anything. He does what's right at a good price. He's trustworthy, clean and honest. He's been at my home twice and I'm about to call him for another project.

The staff was very nice, the breakfast was good, and the location was ideal. Problem is, no amount of good coffee makes up for letting kids run and stomp in the room above all night long. Its hard to enjoy a good hotel when you are kept awake by rude patrons. 10:30pm Monday night and the stomping continues, really puts a damper on the good vibe.

Good very good the few times I've been there this most recent time on Monday afternoon for lunch, had a lunch menu and children's menu. All nice proportions, able and o enjoy indoor dining! 
The restaurant had kept patrons placed in tables spacing adequately for guidelines for the virus.
So thankful able to enjoy their great food and service indoor!

Santoras was recommended to me by a friend, and I was not disappointed. Each time I have the Stromboli it is the best I've ever had. It's like it just gets better and better!!! The meatball and Italian subs are incredible and I plan to try everything on the menu at some point. I lived back East and this is the real deal. Bonus!: the service is fabulous. These guys treat their customers like family and always make sure the food is of the highest quality. Do yourself a favor and check it out!

Super meal.  Favorite app of all five was the tuna tartar tower.  Least favorite app was the overcooked calamari.  Enjoyed many excellent rolls, though I appreciate when they are smaller slices so they're easier to eat with grace.  All four mixed drinks at the table, including the Grey Goose martini, were very weak.  That's unusual for a straight vodka martini without a mixer.  We'll stick to wine next time.  Great dinner, nice space, adequate service.

I took my Son Nathanael in for a haircut yesterday and was completely satisfied with the service and friendliness that was given. My wife and I first visited the Cookie Cutters location in Boise and it was such a bad and unprofessional experience that we never returned. The Meridian location however is a complete 180 experience. The shop is clean, the staff is very friendly and they made Nathanael feel comfortable and happy. His haircut came out great and he left with a free balloon, a lollipop and a big smile. Im happy we found where he will be getting all of his haircuts now!

Excellent clinic! Super friendly staff, sparkling clean, plenty of parking (including Handicap spaces actually near the entrance! As a high risk person for Covid-19, I can say I felt very safe. I've been here a couple times during this pandemic & it's been a positive experience every time! I'm SO thankful they are NOT seeing COVID-19 patients/likely patients. Big thank you to all the kind staff!

Amazing and authentic Indian food.  Southwest Boise has a gem of a restaurant in Spice India.  They can adjust the heat from 1-5 in the dishes.  Everything was fresh and hot when it came to the table.  The staff is friendly and efficient.  Be sure to try the Chicken Mikhani and order fresh naan on the side.  Can't believe we have this amazing food on our end of town.  It's right by St. Luke's in Meridian.  Give yourself a treat!

Amazing salon. I went in for blonde color correction and they did an incredible job! 
I also recently went back in for a deep conditioning and my hair feels so soft. Highly recommend :)
