For decades we have been excellent customers of D&B supply and have poured a lot of money into this local business.I returned a shirt at the Meridian D&B supply that I had purchased this year for my husband but it was the wrong size and wanted to exchange it.they did not have this particular shirt in their System and after about 20 minutes they determined they would give me a meager $10 back for a shirt I paid much more for.I know I bought it on sale but I did not get a Roper western shirt for such a cheap price. It was very frustrating and a demonstration of poor customer service , especially for a loyal long time customer.I'll take my business down the road. The irony is that this young man would have made up for the little bit of extra cash he should have given me for the shirt since I was going to buy a case of dog food , a brand new shirts that would've cost much more and a breast strap for my horse.someone else will get that business.
A friend and I went to this place for pedicures. The polish was off 1-2 toes for each of us after two days. A complete waste of money!

If you want to try authentic basque food Eli's is your place. I was in town for a wedding and wanted to try this delicious food since I've never seen a Basque restaurant in any state other than Idaho. Who would have thought?

The food here was not spicy and full of flavor. We tried the beef meatballs in a delicious orange tomato based sauce. These delectable meatballs tasted differently than your typical Italian fare with different spices and were so tender they almost melt in your mouth. 

Another winning dish is the cod in lemon-cream sauce. It was baked to perfection with citrus and creamy sauce swimming with super tender pieces of fish. 

All of Epi's dishes come with soup, salad, and bread. It's like a three course meal for a one course entree price! Go here with your adventurous food loving family and enjoy all the many flavors of Basque food.

This place was recommended to me for BBQ so I decided to try it out. 

Walked into the bar area and a waitress named Dawn was wonderful through the experience giving suggestions and was super attentive. 

I tried a combo plate with baby back ribs, pulled pork, BBQ beans and mac and cheese. The best part was the pulled pork and all of the items had a smoky flavor to it which was great! I'd rate the food 7 out of 10. 

The customer service is stellar and with great food ...it's hard to skip! The service was 10 of 10 for sure.

Spoke to Mark on the phone regarding my Dyson vacuum issues. He was extremely nice and very knowledgeable in! He helped troubleshoot the problem which ended up being a simple fix! The shop is amazing! I recommend it for any and every vacuum repair!

Best hair cutting place for kids hands down. Theirs a play area w a slide once you go in or video games for the kiddos to play w while they are waiting. They get to pick what car they want to go in, they put my sons favorite show on, gave him a lollipop and this was the first easy haircut he's had. This place is incredible and definitely worth taking your kiddos too.

I wanted to support a local business and decided to order pizza from Johnny's. I picked up my pizzas, went to my car, and decided to open one of the boxes just to double check it and it was the wrong pizza. I checked the other one and it too, was wrong. They apologized and quickly made me the correct pizzas. When they were ready they apologized once again and even gave me a card for a free pizza. I wouldn't say the pizza was the best in the valley, but their customer service was great and they were eager to make the situation right. That's very important to me when it comes to customer service. I would definitely recommend them!
I love their wedge and 'toss and turn' salads.  The burnt ends and pulled pork meats are fabulous too.
2 thumbs up. Had a friend who hired this guy and he actually did a great job. He was quick and reasonable.

Came for the first time and have to say this was the best Indian Food dinner I've ever had. We went a little overboard on the order but I'm not mad at the left overs nor were any of the dishes anything but exceptional. I've not been to India but I've been to many in the US (mostly LA area) and some internationally... this is the new gold standard for me, and great prices, ambiance,  etc. If you like real family-owned Indian Restaurants check this place out ASAP.

These large cookies are amazing and worth it. It is the first place I stop when I leave the airport. Usually get a box of 4 fresh cookies (traditional chocolate chip and then other seasonal flavors); the cookies will last a few days and I have rewarmed in the oven. I have had hit and miss with the frozen cookie (even following the instructions.) BTW, the staff is good and really patient as my group has always had trouble making decisions.

Reviewing Izumi brings to mind the parable of the three blind men describing an elephant.  Each with unique perspective having been assigned different parts of the pachyderm to examine. So it is at Izumi depending on whether you go for "Steakhouse", Teppanyaki entertainment, enormous cocktail bar or traditional Japanese food including sushi.

It also will depend on expectations.  Are you looking for suburban American setting with entertainment of Teppanyaki chefs lighting onion 'volcanos', huge menu and a cavernous bar with exotic cocktails (Scorpion Bowl, anyone?).  This is it.  Do you want understated, serene spaces, clean favors and gracious hospitality typical of family owned Japanese restaurants in Asian neighborhoods in some cities?  Izumi will not be for you.

Good enough for sushi that  we wouldn't refuse to  return for that if someone suggested it.   But overall I draw this analogy; if you think Matador Mexican restaurant chain owned Casa de Matador at the Village in Meridian is real Mexican food and a cool space, then you'll probably enjoy Izumi as parallel for Japanese food.  If you're not into the concepts of 'flash means flavor' and  'bigger is better' then Izumi may not be as good a fit for you.  

The best values are at lunch.  Save room for the ice cream bombe desserts.

A PUZZLE
Why do they call the Teppanyaki flat tops "hibachi" here?  Hibachi are open grills, typically gas.  Teppanyanki are metal flat tops from which chefs put on shows of flipping food and turning onions into volcanoes or shooting flames from their hats.  Some enjoy the entertainment schtick. Teppanyaki chefs are showmen.  On entering one is asked "Hibachi or Dining" (without explanation of what that means) and those answering "Hibachi" are escorted to room with several Teppanyaki top tables.  This is NOT hibachi grill. 

VIBE
Owners, who are Chinese investors not Japanese heritage, have done a respectable job of revamping the dark, cavernous interior  they inherited from a previous chain-restaurant tenant.  But the high ceilings, multiple Spanish style chandeliers and four televisions (two tuned to soccer, two to a cooking show) visible from the dramatic cocktail bar that is center of the space seemed odd.  Music on the sound system during lunch was as if for cocktail time in some other venue.  Like a songstress I didn't recognize singing "Straighten Up and Fly Right".  Music I like.  But it didn't fit the time of day or venue. 

The dark, big cocktail bar dominates the center of the space, the sushi bar to right,  another dining room to left and directly in front of the lounge is the Teppanyaki room.

MENU
The multi laminated pages menu is so large they present it in a small binder.  Offerings are largely Japanese with some Chinese and Thai food thrown in and with even a nod to the fact that India is part of the Asian continent with at least one Indian selection.  (I wish Asian food restaurants would choose a lane and stay in it.  It is hard enough to get one specialty right, let alone dabble in others.)  It would be impossible to describe the breadth of offerings.  Look at the menu link on their web site and it still just scratches the surface. 

FOOD / VALUE
As crust is to pizza, rice is to sushi and the sushi rice here was good. The vegetable and fish ingredients were fresh with bright flavors.  The rolls were artfully filled and shaped then sliced in sizes just right to be one bite.  The gari (pickled ginger) tasted as if house made.

Tempura was expertly panko coated, perfectly crispy and served hot.  But disappointing in that every tempura item tasted like every other item in the selection and all tasted bland.

Desserts are a series of ice cream bombes, not made in house, or fried bananas or fried ice cream.  A coconut ice cream bombe covered with dark chocolate fed two and was worth every calorie. 

Lunch for two with dessert and no beverages = $24 before tax.

HOSPITALITY / SERVICE
The young man who greeted us was pleasant but aloof.  A hostess / manager ignored us but had an extended discussion in Chinese with the folks at the table beside us.  The young woman who waited on us was very sweet but reserved.  Language barriers may play a role in the latter.

ACCESSIBILITY
Accessible parking in lot.  Level in the door.  All on one level.  No standard height tables in bar or Teppanyaki room thereby segreating out wheelchair users.  Yes, that is illegal under the 1990 passed civil rights law  ADA.  Standard height seating in and at sushi bar and dining room.  Loo is accessible.

I really wanted to like this place, but after two attempts and two misses I'm giving up. 

Their online ordering system is pretty flawed. I got out of a long day at work one evening and placed an online order for pickup. I drove all the way there to find the restaurant closed. My card was charged and the order was processed. I was annoyed, but I guess I could have double checked their hours so I let it slide. They refunded me the next day but there were no further attempts to rectify the situation (i.e discount off next order, etc). Again, it was partially my fault for not checking the hours, but their website really shouldn't let you place orders if they aren't open...just one woman's opinion. 


We tried it again last week and placed an online order (after confirming they were indeed, open). I ordered two pork Pad Thais, some egg rolls, and a cup of daily soup for my husband. He wanted hot and sour soup but their menu only showed large bowls as a serving size for that, so he was willing to take a chance on whatever the daily special was. An employee called after I placed the order to say I couldn't order the soup for dinner. I couldn't really understand him but it sounds like maybe that was only an option for lunch? I explained my husband really just wanted a cup of hot and sour soup and the employee said they don't offer cups of soup. Weird, but fine. 

But then we tried the food. And it was the worst pad Thai I've ever tried. Tasteless, nearly sauceless. Just some clumps of noodles with a few pieces of pork thrown on top. Strike three. 

Needless to say, our search for good Thai food in the Valley is ongoing.

Went here today, our 1st time. I got the Mushroom Swiss with added bacon. The wife got the bacon cheeseburger. We also shared a large order of French fries. We both enjoyed our burgers and fries. We will definitely be back!

Where do I even begin with the review? This complex used to be wonderful. I am sad to say that I no longer feel this way. The staff only cares about jacking up tenants costs and getting people moved out if they have concerns. A recent quote in an email from the Assistant Manager said "We are looking for two bedrooms, they are in high demand if you are interested in moving." When she was emailed about concerns regarding the lack of maintenance being done to the facility and lack of consideration for people's vehicles, that was her only response. It is clear that they have a lack on tenants due to the increase and inconsistency of their pricing. Not only do they want you to move out, they also want to DNA test your animals due to some tenants not picking up after their pets. While I do feel you need to pick up after your animal, I believe it is highly intrusive to want to go to the extent to DNA test an animal and its excrement in order to fine you if you haven't picked it up. If they can perform tests on feces around the complex, they are more than capable of picking it up as well. What are the staff getting paid for anyway? This is particularly bothersome to me because the neighborhood next door has access to the complex and the amenities in the complex, so it could be easily be people from the neighborhood. My last disappointment is the cheap apartment itself. "Luxury" apartments should be insulated enough where you cannot hear another tenant turning on their water or having a conversation. I consistently heard the neighbors in the surrounding apartments. The cabinets are cheap and so is the carpet inside. Just because you throw some granite countertops in, doesn't make it "luxury" by any means. I would not recommend this complex to anyone moving into the area. Your concerns will not be listened to, you will instead be urged to move out.
Had an awesome experience with a kiddo who took it upon herself to take some chunks out of her hair! Our hairdresser fixed it perfectly and was so patient and sweet with my daughter!

Stopped in for dinner on Taco Tuesday. What a quaint and colorful restaurant. Our server  Alvaro, was personable and friendly. Loved the thin chips served with flavorful salsa and bean dip...yummm. we enjoyed dinner and my margarita was really good as well. Def going back.
I have been here several times in the past but couldn't give a better review this time. My hamburger came out cold but the appetizer was very good

Awesome Hibachi Restaurant for all occasions. Great Food+Funny Entertainment=Awesome time. One of the best parts of going to a hibachi restaurant like this is you also know that all the food is fresh.
Great option to please multiple appetites. Soups, salads and sandwiches offer great variety. Multiple choices of Agra Fresca and the rice crispy treat sealed the deal.

Life Church is a non denominational Christian church located in Meridian right off Eagle Rd..  I started attending Life Church in August 2007 when it was located in Boise.  This review incorporates 10 years of getting to know the Pastor's vision and heart and seeing it unfold as well as the changes in my life from where I was to where I am.  How to sum it up in a few paragraphs will be challenging but let's give it a shot.

Overview:
I am super thankful for this church.  I am thankful to have a Pastoral staff that seek God daily.  I know the Pastors are called to be Pastors as it shows in their dedication, wisdom and vision for the church.  They truly have a heart to see people prosper in every area of their life.  Our Pastors hear from God and with all their heart desire to pursue the will of God and make that a priority.  There have been dozens of times where I needed a specific word and it was exactly what I needed to hear. The Holy Spirit is alive and present in the church services with manifestations of amazing miracles and healings frequently.  Lives are touched and people are changed.  God has touched many lives since I have attended there and radically transformed their lives as I have witnessed this not only in my life but others that I have relationship with.

Worship and Services:
Our services on Sunday start at 9:30am, 11:30am and 1:30pm.  They start off with amazing worship.  The worship has a variety of contemporary music such as Bethel and Hillsong but also a wide variety of other songs.  The worship invites you to engage in a time of devotion and adoration for all Jesus has done.  Everyone on the worship team has a unique gift and ability and when the come together it is truly beautiful.

Our Pastor delivers powerful and relevant sermons as to what the Spirit leads him.  Our Pastor is very organized but is sensitive to change directions if led to do so.  I am super thankful for a Pastor who is committed to preaching the truth no matter the cost.  Our Pastor is super gifted in teaching and is one of the best teachers I have heard.  He relates truth in a way that is understandable and relatable.  The very few times that he is not there to teach, he allows others to speak on his behalf and they have always delivered wonderful teachings as well.

Youth:
Like other churches, Life Church has youth services available on Wednesday evenings.  The Youth Pastor is extremely gifted in teaching and connecting with the youth with a heart for God.  He is relatable and understands the pressures of youth living in today's world.  

Children's services:
I don't have any kids that attend the children's services but I have heard numerous stories from several families that the kids love the service and can't wait to come back the following week.  Every time I look into the services I see kids enjoying themselves.  From what I have been told the curriculum in teaching kid's services are top notch.

Life Groups:
The church is large and is divided up into three services.  One of the benefits of church is having another family to come together and share life with.  With a church this size, the church really encourages everyone to join a Life Group.  A Life Group is a small groups from 6-12 people that gather together weekly or bi weekly to discuss a variety of topics from book studies, finance groups, marriage groups, singles groups, etc.  You can join a Life Group anytime but they typically go for 10-12 weeks and then take a small break.  You can continue going to the same group or change groups depending on what you would like to discuss.  It is a great way to meet people and take a specific topic to a deeper level.  

I know no church is perfect for everyone but if you are looking for a church to plug into and get connected to some great teaching, good friendships and to experience God, give this place a try.  I am just grateful for all the Pastors and staff, they have been so kind to me and have helped encourage me through some tough times.  I have also met my beautiful wife here so this place has been a blessing to me.

Best Bread pudding in town, state, country, hemisphere, world... you get the picture. Chris made me feel like a guest in her home. Everything was beautiful and delicious. I've eaten the world over and Epi's is as good as it gets.

I just came in for a take out and the food was phenomenal! I had a jalapeño wrapped with bacon along with a pork carnitas burrito and lemme say my mouth is burning but the flavor was great... i noticed there is a wait on food due to the shortage on staff like everyone else. But if you are patient definitely try this place
Great tasting food I like spicy so I got the tai hot curry the flavors were outstanding. The entire group I went with were happy..... and by the way the service is great
Great little Sports Bar & Grill.....great food and excellent service.  Staff is very friendly and the portions are good.  Definitely going back

My husband and I went down to Sarah's bagels to give it a try... 
The woman working was extremely nice and seemed to be working alone (so she seemed slightly overwhelmed). 

We ordered a bagel sandwich, and we watched as the woman microwaved the eggs and sausage and put them on our bagel. This didn't bother us too much, until we tasted it. 

The food was decent, 5/10 I would say. The bagel seemed undercooked but what do you expect from a $4.99 bagel sandwich? 

It was after eating the bagel that my husband started feeling ill.. and let me tell you, he has a stomach of steel. 
Shortly after I started not feeling well. 

Needless to say, we will not be going back to Sarah's :(

Dr. Smith is the nicest guy you'll ever meet. His bedside manner is second to none. I wish every doctor was like this guy. Maria my nurse way very friendly and really sweet. I love this place. The front desk all the way to the nurses are so sweet. I've been here several times and always had a positive experience.   If your thinking of going to a hospital, come here first. I'm so happy to have found this place. Really good people work here.

Beware! Read the reviews. At least try to call their 866 customer service line. They will never ever answer no matter how long you wait. They don't respond to emails. If you do buy something don't expect to get it delivered when promised. Horrible customer service and they obvious don't care as everywhere you look, online or any social media has tons of horror stories and bad reviews.

We recently bought an used Kirby vacuum that needed bags.  We researched different places and came upon this little gem. It's tucked away in a strip mall near a Pizza Hut and the Blind Gallery.  The gentleman was super friendly and knew his stuff.  They stock many brands of vacuums, hoses, belts, bags, attachments, cleaning supplies, and even dusters!  We were happy to find a local business and it's so convenient that we will definitely return when we need any other supplies.
The best Indian food I've literally ever had. I'm here way too much! I'm vegetarian/vegan and love how many meatless options Spice has. They blend the best flavors I've ever had.

Terrible, slow, surly service. Absentee management? If you expect all your customers to use the wine dispensers, then don't put wine by the glass on the menu and only come to the table (with attitude) when hailed. Won't return.

The burgers are good but they seem awfully proud of them based on the price.  I would not go back since there are places with similar burgers and a better atmosphere for lower prices.  The onion rings were also way overpriced.  They are quite proud of their "beer wall" and perhaps that is what the inflated prices are going towards.  

Pretty cold service and the checkout process with the preset tip at 18% just makes you feel like you're getting taken advantage of.
Love this place! They have amazing dishes and the flavors are exquisite! They even taste better the next day and we don't really like leftovers. That's saying something!

Since I got my hair cut in a pixie style earlier this year, I have one thought when I get my hair done: 

One bad hair cut. I am one bad haircut away from having a mullet. 

So as you can imagine, I'm terrified to get my hair done. I've been in Treasure Valley for two months. I only have two friends so I couldn't really depend on them to make a solid recommendation. Shaving my head is not an option, so I took a chance. 

I found this place (as I often do with these little spots) by accident. I was at the kids' resale shop next door (Kidz Again) and noticed Lotus Hair Spa. Desperate for a cut, I checked yelp and crossed my fingers. 

When I called to make the appointment, the girl who answered the phone couldn't have been less enthusiastic. However, my appointment was not to be with her (I checked) so I felt it was OK to move forward. They were able to get me in two days later with Tanya. 

I walked in and was sort-of greeted by a girl sitting in a chair while talking to her client. She didn't bother to get up. I fervently hoped this was not my hairdresser. 

Nope, a slight woman approached me and asked if I was Shawna. As it happens, I *have* been Shawna since I was born. I answered in the affirmative and we were off! 

We discussed what I wanted - that I was growing out my hair from this pixie cut but didn't want a mullet. Mostly I just needed my bangs cut and my hair trimmed. She did exactly what I asked, then washed my hair. As she worked we talked about organic foods, cost of living, moving from place to place. She was very easy to talk to and I was super comfortable with her. I'm happy with my cut and will definitely be going back. 

In summary: 

*They need a front desk receptionist
*The atmosphere wasn't super friendly but not offputting enough for me to skip going again
*The music was awesome - they said it was Pandora's 70's, 80's and 90's station
*The hairdresser was cool, knowledgeable and adept (THIS was paramount for me)
*The place is definitely clean, also a pretty important point considering the nature of the business

The cut cost me a cool $30 plus tip - a pretty amazing deal for a salon. I guess I can forgive the cool reception for that price. I'll definitely be back!

I wish I could give zero stars for the combination of customer service and inedible food. Our server was awful, he was very inattentive and forgetful. 

I took my 1st (and only) bite of pad Thai and honestly couldn't even get it down. It was disgusting. It tasted like wet dog. I sat there for awhile when he finally came to check on the food. (He had disappeared for so long that we were actually ready to go at this point.) I said it wasn't good and it had a funny taste, he chuckled and offered me a box. I said no and he still made us pay full price for the food we didn't eat. My friend ordered the same thing and ate a few more bites than I did but she said she immediately felt sick. 

The photo I've attached it how much I ate, you can't even tell I took a bite. 

I've never been disappointed by pad Thai before but first for everything I guess. I actually surprised they are selling this to people and even more surprised that people are buying it. Our experience was so bad it was almost comical.

Love this place! Not the cheapest, but you get what you pay for. It's easily the most beautiful apartment community in the Treasure Valley and the staff does an amazing job keeping it up. Always very friendly and helpful.

Dr. Rowley was incredible. I've never been particular about my eye doctor but after having her I don't want to see anyone else! She was very professional yet I felt like I could trust her like my best friend. She was so kind and personable

This is a great store.  Open late with a very large selection of scrapbooking materials.  They also have a U.S. Post office, which has so much more convenient hours than any traditional post office.  Love this store!

Pizza is pretty standard in all locations.  Chose this one due to convenience.  They have a drive up window which for some reason you can make your order there.  The drive up window should be used for call in orders only like the location on Overland Rd.  When I called I told them 10-15 mins and I actually got there 20 mins after I called.  I was informed that because it was soo busy that my second pizza (half pineapple and half pepperoni) wasn't done yet and it would be another 15 mins.  Had I been told of the wait times on the phone when I called I would've waited longer at home.  I was not the only one waiting longer than expected for their pizza and it seemed like a young new crew working.  A good tip for managers of this location would be to visit the other nearby locations and see how they run.  This location did recently just open but unless improvements are made it won't last.
Eva was amazing! She had such a warm personality and was so gentle with my daughter. My daughter's hair cut was just what I wanted.  She walked out of that place looking cute as a button!

I realize that this is not a gourmet restaurant.  I went in there today for a short break because that is all I had.

I made my order, got my drink, and sat down.  I had waited 20 minutes and didn't get my food.  Several other customers had come in after me to get food and had been served.  I went to the counter and told the clerk.  She assured me that it would be take n care of.  

I waited an additional 10 minutes and nothing.  I had to leave so I went to the register and told them I would like my money back.  

The person at the register got the manager.  She refunded my money, minus the drink, which is fine.  The clerk apologized and the manager told her there was no need to do this.

Sorry, but the manager should have apologized.  I don't go to a McDonalds for gourmet food, but for quickness of service.  I won't go to this one again.

I have dealt with many realtor professionals. It is my opinion these guys are the rudest most unprofessional realtor and should not be in the business. When I called he never gave me his name nor the name of his company. When I asked him about the property that he had bannered from the interstate 184 he told me that he had no idea what I was talking about. He told me to check the website then rattled of something which could not be understood. When I finally found the property there were no signs indicating the units that were for sale. I then called the company back he was very belligerent and hung up on me yet again. I know that I would Not like to be represented in this manner. I wish I could give them a negative 5 Stars. I can hope to purchase and lease out a property with out allowing this rude company to receive any of my money.

Indigo was fighting her nap and winning, so we went out for coffee. We got there and she was asleep, so I found a drive through. That drive through was at Culvers. 

I ordered a the original butter burger with all the fixings and the custard of the day, butter pecan. The butter burger was fabulous, no grisly unpleasantness, and I ate the burger so fast I don't really remember any other details. 

The custard, the custard, the custard. I think you should try it without any preconceived ideas. 

Now the customer service was great! The gal working the drive through was helpful, polite and quick. The girl bringing the food to the car in front of me was funny and we briefly discussed the mini thunderstorm that was occurring. The young man who brought me my food was friendly and smiley. 

Indigo has no comment, she was napping. 

I recommend this place for the customer service and custard. 

Oh, FYI, they ask you to drive forward and give you a number so the carhops can bring you your order.

Everything with Linder Pet was pretty fine for my golden retriever up until today. We had got a puppy package with Linder pet where he could get al of his shots and be fixed and microchipped. We did all of the shots with no issues, and the people were generally okay during these appointments. Not too friendly but not rude or anything either. Well today my boyfriend and I took our golden retriever in to get fixed and he got out of surgery and I was waiting by the car to help him get in and when we were loading him in we noticed some stuff in his fur. I just wanted to get him home because he was very uncomfortable and I made the wrong assumption that Linder pet would take care of my dog completely. We got to our apartment which is around 3 minutes away and we had also forgotten to grab his pills which we noticed at the time we got to our apartment. When we got our dog out of the car there was poop all over the seats of the car and we then checked him out and there was also poop on his paws, and his underside and backside, right by the area that was JUST stitched up and is easily vulnerable to infection. My boyfriend left to go grab the pills and I told him to ask them if our dog had an accident in their care. When he got there he said it was busy and he didn't have the opportunity, I would've went ahead and talked to them if I was there personally but I was with the dog at home. We started calling Linder pet to try and get to the bottom of what happened, no answer but they texted back quickly when we sent a text asking for a CALL. My boyfriend and I started cleaning up the dog and the car with wipes and finally Linder pet gave me a call. The lady on the phone said our dog did have an accident in his kennel. She said there were no signs or smells and she didn't see anything while they were walking out, which is fair. However the mess was all underneath him and on his paws so of course you aren't going to be able to see it on the top of his back. The issue come in when she told me several times "it's not a big deal" and to just clean him off. Yes, obviously I'm going to get him cleaned up. My problem is that he had poop right by fresh stitches and that is a recipe for infection. I'm really not sure how the kennels are or why they wouldn't be able to see through them and see if there was poop in it because the typical kennels are just wire crates. Whatever the case may be, it was an absolute mess and the women on the phone passed it off like it wasn't a big deal, someone who once sounded nice and friendly, to arrogant and rude about the situation all together. She reiterated loudly and multiple times that she would've cleaned him if she saw what had happened, but that's kinda the point. Nobody even checked let alone double or tripled checked to make sure everything was good to go, which is personally what I thought was a standard. It's unacceptable to send a pet home from surgery with poop all over him. On the phone we were told to go ahead and take some photos and we could talk to a manager later in the week. All in all it was not a fun or easy experience for a day that's already hard on a dog and their owners. I would recommend coming here for your pets shots, but nothing more. Hopefully after getting him all cleaned up he won't get an infection.

TEN STARS  the most honest and professional moving  company we've ever had the pleasure of working with! They were on-time, friendly, professional, and when we got to the end, the bill was exactly what was quoted.  Love these guys!

Our dinner at Goodwood BBQ in Boise on Spectrum) was amazing. Everything was better than most BBQ we have ever had (baby back ribs, pulled pork, potato salad, creamy corn and peach cobbler!) Additionally, every staff member was so courteous and accommodating, above and beyond most any place we've experienced! It seemed as though this was just a normal way of treating people! We wish we could have this restaurant and it's staff near our home ( in CURTIS BAY, MD)

Wow. Shame on me! I walked in, hoping to see a doctor for a lingering cough that I've been battling for several weeks. I was hoping for some medical direction, an evaluation (do I have pneumonia???) and to hopefully have my medical needs addressed or further medical steps directed.  Instead, I was immediately reminded that I shouldn't be there. Literally. I was not welcome. I was, however, immediately interrogated as to the nature, then validity of my visit. My somewhat vague responses to the interrogation (I wasn't really interested in giving doctor level privilege of my health concern, to the front desk, nor defending my reason for the visit) was questioned and professional advice was delivered, (for free!) as I was bluntly questioned as to why I don't just see my regular physician since I'd been there a few times already and what do I expect them to help me with "if they couldn't help me before"? Well, there are several reasons why I am not at my regular doctor, chief among them is I don't really have one. And I'm back, because, well, I'm still sick! But I digress. Thank you Primary Health Care for reminding me that, 1) My memory is poor. Our family has had poor customer relations experiences here in the past and I'd forgiven and forgotten. 2) For sharing the excellent advice to go somewhere else.

So, shame on me! But here's a single star for the lesson I've learned--this time I will be taking your advice! I will never return to your establishment again, and anyone I know  friend or foe will be given your advice -- to never visit either.

Wow. This place is going to be the best new addition to the Village!! The outside patio and ambiance are striking. The fountain, people watching, and if course! the wine are second to none!
Now, for my wine people-- much smaller selection. Only four of wine banks, compared to the dozen or so downtown.
We always use this location. Customer service is top notch. Today Nicole was extremely helpful and accommodating, She went above and beyond to make sure the car would be ready for our trip.

We weren't sure what to expect with Goodwood. We had tried Big Daddy's and just thought it was okay, but Goodwood is our absolute favorite BBQ place in the area! The meat quality is always great (I'm super picky about meat), the sides are to die for - mac & cheese, mashed potatoes and gravy, cornbread, coleslaw, baked beans, we get ALL the sides ALL the time! We love the smoked turkey and the chicken! Oh and I can't forget the chicken crispers - an absolute must!! Love love Goodwood!

I'm very conflicted by this place. First off, yes the food is fresh which is great! However, the kids meal options are pathetic. For a company that strides itself on healthy options, they should consider adding more to the kids menus besides chicken strips, grilled cheese, and soup. To top it off, the kids menu offers a fresh fruit cup. If you look at the pictures you will find what we were given. They would normally give you thin apple slices but we asked for more blueberries instead. Would you call this a fruit cup?? Next we were given the kids chicken strips. Look at how thin they are? My daughter hadn't eaten anything when I took those photos. I just cut up her chicken. I paid $5 for the kids meal and my one year old daughter was still hungry (she's 23lbs). The manager was the one who served me so I'm not sure if this is normal or if she's stingy?

I should have checked Yelp rather than Google reviews. I was not happy with our experience at El Gallo Giro. I was hoping to find some authentic street tacos and found this place locally. The pics look good, so we decided to give it a try. 

We were greeted when we walked in. Right when we sat down, our waitress asked if we wanted a side of guac with our chips and salsa that come with the table. We said sure, and she asked if we wanted it made at our table. We hadn't had a chance to look at the menu yet, so we agreed. She failed to tell us it would be a $10 charge, and we really didn't even want it. 

The kid who made it rolled up with a cart that had a huge "TIP" jar on it, but I didn't want to partake since I felt swindled from the start.

The strawberry margarita I ordered was waaaay too sweet and probably didn't have any alcohol in it. It was $10. The price is not listed on the menu.  

Not trusting the establishment and having a huge bowl of guac to eat, I could only stomach a few street tacos. I ordered asada, fish and pollo. They were all lackluster, lacking in flavor and looked pitiful on the plate. The one hope for flavor/zest was dashed when I realized the limes on the plate had no juice. 

The menu prices are all different than what they charged us. They aren't huge differences, but it made me not trust them or want to come back. The three street tacos I ordered were supposed to be $5.95 total, but if you do the math off the receipt, they were $6.50 total.

The menu also says the guac made at the table is supposed to be $9.95 (which is already ridiculous), but they charged me $10. And this was not including tax. 

My friend was satisfied with her taquitos, but she doesn't really eat out much. I think she was just trying to be nice. 

Like I said, I would not return. There are plenty other Mexican cuisine spots around here that I can give a try.

The only reason I go to this bar is the Bartender. My girlfriend and I absolutely love the drinks Christian makes. Neither of us have any clue it was a full bar.My girlfriend also said Christian is extremely fun to have a conversation with, normally this might be upsetting LOL, but honestly I have to agree! The young guy is just an absolute breath of fresh air in a world that's kind of out of control right now. Christian is a happy go lucky guy, and I think the world needs more of them right now!  

PS. Keep up the good work Christian, and keep making those amazing drinks.

I normally love this place, but the last few times I've ordered I've been extremely disappointed. 

Today I got miso soup and a tuna poke bowl... ended up paying $20 and regretting the entire order. It wasn't nearly worth the money.

The miso was so watery, bland, and, quite frankly, gross... I couldn't even eat it! Then, the poke bowl.... was not a poke bowl. For abt $13 I got tuna, a few pieces of avocado, and seriously just a couple of shavings of cucumber.... that was it. No rice. Nothing else. The portions were shockingly stingy and the quality was really lacking. 

I'm honestly really considering switching back to Sakana Sushi... this is really disappointing and completely not worth the money.... McDonalds would've even been a better choice for the quality I received today. I might even seek a refund if I can :/

Cookies used to be good. Have had horrible service with orders arriving over an hour late and tonight not only were they late, they were raw. It was like taking a bite of a cookie that had only been in the over for a few minutes. 
Don't waste your money. Get Crumbl instead!
New to the area. Found this gem. The atmosphere was great. Christian and Travis were amazing bartenders and very friendly. They treated me like a frequent patron. Will be back for food next time :)

Went here on a date and it was really good sushi! The fish seemed to be very fresh and the service was fairly quick. It wasn't but a couple minutes and we were seated with a drink in our hands. Really no negative about the restaurant other than it took awhile to get our check. I'd try it out if you're looking for good sushi!

This was our first time here and it won't be our last! We heard about this place from a friend and decided to try it out for my birthday. EVERYTHING was so good, the staff was amazing and our cook was so entertaining! I had lobster and scallops, for appetizer I had spicy octopus with seaweed salad, and a roll with spicy tuna, avocado and salmon topped with tobiko and green onion. Probably ordered too much, but I was ok with that. I also enjoyed some Nigori Sake. Overall I would recommend this place in a heartbeat!

We ordered almost  $10,000 worth of furniture in September and still have not received all our furniture! We have had partial deliveries, such as one piece of a 6 piece sectional! Stay away from place! Customer service is worthless and condescending when you try to ask for a refund. Never again!
The food is delicious and the portions are generous--I always have leftovers for another meal. Sometimes the third party delivery service causes a delay in delivery, but Izumi is always on point!

We love Cafe Zupas, their prices are great, their soups are fantastic.  They are always friendly, professional and you really can't beat the food.  Definitely a great alternative to fast food.  It's fresh and taste awesome!!!!

Tonight was the second time in a row that we had either a delivery or takeout that was not as ordered. The service was indifferent and not friendly at all. We've had great experiences before, not really sure what is going on currently but it's super hit miss and not worth the gamble. Unfortunately, we'll be taking our business elsewhere. Sayonara Izumi...

Tons of salad choices,  very happy with their herb vinaigrette dressing. .yum! Tried the pick two combo and since I'm super picky about soup,  I opted for the crab & avocado sandwich and protein salad..both delish,  I'll be back and might even try the soup next time!
Floor is dirty.  Booths are dirty.   Only two total employees with one smoking in the parking lot not wearing shoes.  Slow service as a result.
Dr. Crawford is phenomenal! Thank you to all the staff and provider for making my visit comfortable and quick!

My first experience at Cafe Zupas was great!  I did a build your own salad that was really good.  I felt like I had lots of choices and I was running out of options so I got to double up on the cheese.  It came with a roll and a chocolate covered strawberry for less than $6.   Next time I'm going for the grilled cheese... I've heard good things about it ;)

Recommendation... I ordered the small salad and my friend ordered the bigger one... They looked the same in size to me.

Don't come here hungry, took 35 minutes to get two sushi rolls and sashimi. Sunday evening, place was not busy, so not sure why the long wait for a basic California roll. Lots of reviews mentioned slow service, and they are correct. Drove out here from Boise but I won't be back unless I have time to waste. Spicy girl was good but nothing spectacular, it didn't satisfy my craving for sushi for some reason
Place is perfect...all employees are awesome and on point. Ryan is a worker and always busy...good beer and good wings- sweet family owned spot...we going back tonight for round 2!!

This place is a joke. They have extremely HIGH prices and do packages. My package was 2k and they told me I could get up to 10 treatments. Every other laser place does 4-6 weeks between treatments but this place had me at 8 weeks! So my hair kept on growing back... 

After my package was up - you have to pay per session, 10% of what your package originally cost. So every time I go now, it'll cost $200. Rip off! 

Now I go to other places, they use the same exact machines for 80% less! Check groupon! :)

The people at this place are always nice - it's just the company as a whole is my issue.

Great customer service!  Had the pleasure of getting a wonderful gal named Erin on the phone who took the time to listen and take down a LOT of information and then provided helpful information that we would need as well. Patient and although called with many questions and lots of info to go over, she did not seem bothered at all. Thank you!  I am sure it helped that I informed her initially that it would take a while as I had a lot of info to go over and asked if it was a good time for her to help me .. being a good customer is as  important as being a good customer service rep, people!  Let them know what they are getting in to and be clear in your communication! With that said, Erin was attentive and helpful and accurate and I am happy I got the luck of the draw with her being our Ashley rep!

This is a solid clothing and accessories shop. They have a good assortment, it's easy to get around, the staff is friendly. Here in Idaho Kohl's has always been my go to shop for my new threads. Prices range from real cheap to "no way I'm getting that," but they have great sales and an awesome way of letting you know about them. I'll include a picture. They have jewelry, sunglasses; you can get bed sheets here... A pack of hot sauce. There's a lot here!!!

I cannot recommend this place more highly. Wow.

FIRST - GET RESERVATIONS. We didn't, but were lucky - we arrived on a Boise State home game evening and were presented a cancellation table. In the corner. It was perfect. But the absolutely friendly hostess would have kindly turned us away (bummer) had it been another night.

Our dishes were marvelous. Basque food? Lamb, squid, beef tongue and other delectables. It was truly amazing. If some of these food items make you wonder, you haven't tried the spectacular way they've been prepared. I'm not from Boise, but I want to go back, because I can't try all the entrees in one evening.

A wonderful dinner.

This is the first of two reviews today for the same Handyman Connection repairman, Lynn K.  This review is for excellent work done by Lynn late last year, 2020, probably sometime in the month of December.  Lynn was here to fix a leaky sink drain and took care of matters in the most efficient and cost effective way possible.  No new hardware was needed and the drain hasn't leaked since.  Thanks Lynn for a job well done and sorry for the late review.

The second review for work done by Lynn K. is for repairs today, 8/31/21, on our difficult to open, close, lock and unlock double doors leading out to our back yard.  The doors have been used infrequently and now our operating like normal doors should be thanks to Lynn who is as personable as he is talented.  Thanks again Lynn for doing such great work for us on the latest in a wide variety of household issues.
I've been taking my furbabies here for over 10 years. They are caring compassionate and will take care of you furbabies. Thank You Dr. MILLS FOR EVERYTHING
Always a welcoming environment, amazing food and top notch service in the cutest old house!  You MUST have reservations!!

I was really excited when I read that Michael Mina, who has a Michelin-starred restaurant in San Francisco, was opening a Meridian ghost kitchen operation through Crave. 

I may have been the first person to order on the day Tokyo Hot Chicken opened, Nov. 16. I ordered four pieces of chicken and the crunchy Yuzu potatoes. 

I was greatly disappointed with the chicken. Mina told the Los Angeles Times that his chicken would rate a 6 or 7 out of 10 for heat. My pieces were barely a 2. And there was no seasoning, so the chicken was juicy but bland. The potatoes, on the other hand, were really good.

Fast forward nearly a month and I tried them again. This time they offered an "inferno" heat setting, so of course I dialed that in.

And boy, did it pack the heat. It was much more satisfying. But it still could have used some salt or other seasoning to perk up the flavor. Again, the potatoes were wonderful.

So it appears that in the month they've been operating Tokyo Hot Chicken has tweaked their operation. One thing that I am still disappointed in was that after my first experience, I wrote to Tokyo Hot Chicken in San Diego through a private Facebook message (there was no contact information for the company on its website.) I also sent an email to Chef Mina's restaurant group. I didn't get a response back from either contact. They're apparently not very good at customer service.

The Crave delivery drivers have been pleasant and professional.

So far, I have been really pleased with the staff at Ideal Image. I worked with Amy Almaraz and she was really patient as I had her work up multiple quotes for me and explain what I could expect depending on the area treated. The price is pretty expensive so she helped to find a package that was in my budget.

Came in to town late.  Needed something to eat.  Found BoB's open.  Ordered a grilled chicken wrap (pretty good) and a Mediterranean Salad (Not so good).  Service was super fast, for a call in order.  Nice, there was no up charge for a to-go order.  

For the food, the Med Salad had some kind of mystery meat in it.  We think it was chicken, very dry, over cooked.  

Filled the void for the most part.
First time and the service was great day shift was amazing grace show we had an amazing time. The food was delicious that rolls were to die for everything look appetizing and well-presented.

I have been here a few times and every time I order I am not disappointed. Their pizzas are fairly priced compared to Little Caesars but what makes it better is it is a locally owned business. I think we have only had pepperoni and olive pizzas as well as their cheesy garlic bread it always is good. They also have good ranch if you are a ranch snob. Not all ranches are created equally.
Just plain bad from the moment she answered the phone. Do not want to waste my time on writing something.

I saw a billboard advertising custard at Culver's on Fairview so Sherry and I decided to give this a try to cool our pallets after some Thai food.  The menu was confusing (how do I order *just* a custard without toppings, extras, etc.) and the cashier seemed to be just as confused because she couldn't explain it either.  Sherry finally got it figured out (look at the bottom of the menu for the version without all the extras).

The custard was served in scoops in a cup, different from the softer custard served at Freddy's.  Our initial impression was the same: when we first tasted the custard at Freddy's we both though "Wow, this is really good!".  Here, it was just good.  Couple that with the confusing menu and the unhelpful help, and you get a 'Meh'.

My husband took me to Izumi for my birthday dinner. We had hibachi, the fried rice was so good. I would go back just to have it again! We went on on Wednesday night, I was very surprised at how busy it was for a Wednesday. My husband did try to get reservations, but no one would pick up the phone. Thankfully, we got there before the restaurant filled up.

There are only two scooter/ wheelchair repair stores in Meridian/Boise. They both have terrible customer service, and are booked weeks in advance because theres no where else to go. We have been ripped off, paid for repairs that were not actually done, and purchased batteries that were not needed. Norco's M.O. is to sell a battery first. They always initially say thats the problem, w/ out  checking. They are crooks. If you complain they simply refuse to service you again, they can do that because they are the only game in town. Beware!

I visited Santoras today for my first time with my mom and husband. We ordered a large pepperoni pizza and an order of manicotti to share. Everything tasted fresh and delicious. The pizza crust and sauce are out of this world, & to me the manicotti tasted how authentic Italian food should. The sauces are all made from scratch and you can literally watch them throwing the pizza dough up in the air to spin it! That was something I'd actually never seen before in real life so it was pretty cool. The restaurant is clean and smells heavenly, and the staff is very friendly and attentive. I highly recommend it to anyone as it is probably the best pizza I have ever eaten!! Yum.

Dropped in for lunch on the way to the airport after being in town for work. All in all, a solid BBQ joint. I had the two meat combo to fill me up before an evening of flights and to hopefully help me about old eating crappy airport food. Brisket + sausage with baked beans and pecan sweet potatoes. The sauce that came on the brisket was not my favorite, and I likely would have preferred it on the side instead of scraping it off had I know it came already sauced. However, the spicier, bold sauce at the table was phenomenal! The brisket was average to a bit above average- could have used a bit more flavor. The sausage was delicious! Great flavor, perfect texture, and even more delicious when dipped in the bold sauce! I think my favorite part of my meal was the pecan sweet potato side, though. Perfect combo of subtle sweetness and a bit of crunch! Definite winner for your side options!

This has Become my wife and my regular date night locations for authentic Mexican food. 

My wife does the Chicken Chimmi every time, I like to try new things. I've had campechana, a shrimp and octopus soup, the chili relleno, the carne asada and mas with spicy shrimp, the carnitas, and several other items, none disappointed. Great flavor and just the right amount of heat.

Service is always friendly and makes you feel like family. We've become regulars!

Much better than I expected. Knowing this was a chain, I was expecting chain quality... NOPE. This place rocks. 
This was our go-to lunch spot for a couple weeks. 
Everything on the menu is great. 
Can't point to one item that disappointed.
Salads were massive. Variety of greens (I like spinach and arugula) and great combo of proteins and accoutrements.
Smoked meat was great. Best BBQ I had in Idaho, truly. 
Place is CLEAN. Really clean. That's a big deal. 
Staff is on it, knew the menu and are very polite/helpful.
HIGHLY RECOMMENDED.

We are almost directly across the street from this location, so this is a regular "go-to" for when we have a Thai craving. The wait staff are always nice and speedy. We have only taking it to-go, never ate in the restaurant.

My favorite and always prime test of a good Thai place is their Pad Thai. That Basil absolutely passes my bench test, and delivers a delicious Pad Thai. If you like spicy then ask for Thai hot and it's not disappointing. If you are not a big spice person your face might literally melt.

I tried chip cookies for the first time last year in Boise. It was love at first bite! This location in meridian is no exception. The cookies were warm gooey on the inside and perfectly crisp on the outside. Generously sized, perfectly priced. Super friendly staff and the most convenient location! I will be back for sure. 

Also, the cookie butter COTM was unreal!!!

We went here for my husbands birthday. We both decided to try their steaks, which probably wasn't the brightest idea seeing how they are a "barbecue" restaurant. Any-who my sirloin was definitely not cooked to medium well but rather medium and didn't taste very good. My husbands Rib eye wasn't the greatest either. I will say that their loaded smashed potatoes were pretty yummy! Their garden and Caesar salad weren't all that either. Their Potato salad was meh, and their Mac and cheese was good but nothing like wow! So the 3 stars is basically for the smashed potatoes and the service. The staff were all really nice along with our waiter! Also they were quick to get us a seat seeing how we went around 2-3 pm on a Monday and food was cooked rather quick. We probably won't be choosing this place again and if we do we'd probably try their barbecue.

Nice theater. Great location right in the middle of The Village. Easy to have a nice dinner at any of the great places The Village has to offer and then walk over for a movie following. The Cinema has a coffee bar and the latte was actually well priced and decent. They offer reserved seating which is awesome and the chairs have high backs and are comfortable. Not recliners.
August 2021 - Pretty good Thai food overall although we have only been one time and it was "to go". Will elaborate further when we return and dine in.

I love this place!!  My favorite dishes are the summer rolls and yellow curry dish with chicken. 

My husband was indecisive as to which dish is his favorite -  The yellow curry dish with chicken or the Yellow curry dish with beef.  A  true toss up in his opinion.  His favorite appetizer is the deep fried tofu. Killer! 
His new favorite drink is now the Thai coffee.  

This place is consistent with great service, food and dependability.  Tyler was our waiter and constantly checked on us.  He couldn't do enough.  The food menu is reasonable priced.

For me finding a place that offers a wide array of gluten free options is a must!  This place fits the bill.   

Trust me when I say you will leave this place pleasantly satisfied and full.  
This restaurant is a Thai food haven.  I'm sold!

Only got 4 stars because of the extremely long wait we had. 2.5 hours to eat there, but I think it was because of a huge, unannounced party (not sure?). The food was great. Definitely best in the area. Portions are not very big but the taste was on point! Coming from CA to ID, I did not expect to find great Indian food, but look no further than here!!! The lamb korma, veggie korma, chicken tikka, plain naan, and endless basmati rice was amazing! The server was very attentive. I'd give it 5 stars if it weren't for the long wait we had.

This has quickly become our favorite place. We've had Chris as our server a few times and we appreciate how he gets eye level with each table so he can treat each guest on a personal level.
And the food is excellent!

Great food. Let me repeat that, great food.

I had the crab as an appetizer and the catfish for the entrée. Both were delicious. 

Getting seated was a bit of a challenge but you can't fault them for me showing up on Friday evening during dinner time.

Prices were great, as was the quality/quantity of food. I will go back every time I'm in town.

NOT ONE employee was wearing a mask or exercising social distancing. All the anti-maskers in the valley must've gotten the memo because literally no one else is wearing a mask, either. Get your act together, Jump Time. There is still a pandemic, whether you want to believe it or not.

I feel like it's weird for me to be reviewing a Lowe's, but I guess it's pretty normal. Sorry...thinking out loud. Anyway, I love this Lowe's. Is it weird to love a specific Lowe's? Whatever...continuing on, there are three things I love about this Lowe's. First, they are typically always pretty organized. They keep everything tidy and well-stocked and I can usually always find what I'm looking for. There have been a few times when I've seen a great deal on something random online and when I go in and ask someone where I can find it, they will check the item, see it's in stock, but then can't find it at all. That's frustrating,  but like most places, there are always stock issues. 

Now that brings me to the second thing I love, which is arguably the most important. The people who work there. For the most part, the employees are awesome and incredibly helpful. I'll call out one specific worker named Juan. Juan is the best. He has helped me a few times when I have questions or am looking for something and has gone super out of his way to help. Just the other day, I was looking for an item that showed was in stock, and he literally walked across the entire store with me to look for it, couldn't find it, went to the back to search for it, and unfortunately still couldn't find it, but was very apologetic about it and just such a nice dude. Also, I wish I could remember her name, but a woman working at the customer service/returns desk is awesome. Just a great staff. 

Third, they occasionally have really good deals on things. I'm sure this is the same for most Lowe's and all stores in general, but they randomly have super good clearance deals on things and I love it! I called about a miter saw that was 50% off and they said they had 2 in stock and then held one for me at the desk. I now have a miter saw. Awesome. A great Lowe's with great people!

Looking for a quick delicious lunch? This is the place to try.

Had never been here before, and I saw the menu on the wall outside while I was walking to my vehicle. Since I needed to get something to eat, I figured I'd go ahead and try this place.

I ordered the Lunch special: whole sandwich + half bowl soup or salad.
I had the pesto chicken sandwich with clam chowder. It also came with a small roll and a chocolate covered strawberry.

The chowder was flavorful without rubbery pieces of clam in in. The pesto sandwich was tasteful as well, but I forgot to order without tomato like I usually do. It just made the sandwich a little watery.

I DO recommend this place to eat. It's on par with Panera.

Take one thing away from this review, order the Mopped Delmonico Steak. For the price, you really can't touch this steak anywhere else in the Treasure Valley. Need another option, wife normally gets the pulled pork sandwich which they pile high with very tender and juicy pork. It's probably the only thing that can get me away from the Delmonico.

This place is always really busy, tends to be loud which is awesome if you have kids because they can be rowdy without bothering others. There is always tons of families and kids dining here as well.

Awesome BBQ option, we will be back often!

ZERO COVID PRECAUTIONS. Nobody was wearing masks (not even the staff), and the one hand sanitizer machine near the little kids area was empty. We hadn't been out anywhere indoors since the pandemic started, but we decided to try JT based on their website and the precautions they listed. Sadly it was business as usual and we will not be back until this changes. Very disappointing.

I always sort of hate places that have ....and more to their name. If they are indecisive on who they are, makes me a bit nervous. but in the case of Blue Tiger Pizza, maybe the owner should add those few words.

While their pizzas are great, some of the best we have tasted, and innovative too, the menu has much more that is different and very good. For example, people who know me know green things don't rank high in my like list. But we had the Fried Brussel Sprouts and cleaned them up. Me too. The pizza was the special of the day and the crust and toppings were all excellent.

Lots more to try there, so we will be back again. Meatball sandwich looks great. Ice cream sandwiches too.

For the best details on layout and other details, see Michele R's great review. No use me regurgitating her, as usual, composition.

Scheduled a pick up order and they were on time to have it ready, polite, and most importantly the food was amazing! It is a little pricey, but not overly. I'll pay it again since the taste is awesome! The drunken noodle needs more spice, so buyers, if you like spice ask for more on that! The panang curry is the best! Coming from CA to ID, I didn't expect much from the cuisine, but this place doesn't disappoint one bit!

Very much enjoy every trip I've had here. Food is delicious and always cooked just right. 

The entertainment, while usually unique between each chef, is similar enough that after my 3rd visit in 6 months I'm a little over it. Would like this to be more than a special occasion restaurant, but I can see that easily happening with our family. 

The discounts we receive in the mail is currently the driving force for reach of our returns.

UPDATE: I found out some "terrible" news today...on a long walk from my house, I knew I'd be passing by Johnny's at some point, so I ordered their BBQ Chicken Combo pizza as I've only had their amazing regular pizza with red sauce and Bomb.com calzones. I'm a HUGE fan of bbq chicken pizzas so my expectations were pretty high as I have loved everything else I've had here. Picked it up with a few sides of their freakin incredible ranch, went home, ABSOLUTELY DEVOURED! It's honestly one of the best, if not THE best BBQ Chicken pie I've ever had. Not sure if their sauce is homemade, but hot damn is it good. A little sweet, plenty of tanginess, and super bold but not overpowering...it's just delicious. And the toppings were just thick enough to get so much flavor out of without also being overpowering. The ratios! They're all perfect. With all their pizzas! I mentioned it's "horrible" news because, again, I live close enough to walk here and I FREAKIN LOVE THIS PLACE!!!

Haven't gone for food so I don't know how it relates, but as a standalone dive bar it's pretty fun. I've gone on several occasions and I've never felt out of place or unwanted. The karaoke is on point and I love that everyone does it. 

I definitely recommend swinging by with a few friends, getting drinks and singing a few songs.
Al Pastor tacos habanero salsa is very spicy and tasty, salsa verde is my favorite as well.

The food tasted good what Little bit they're was. I ordered a three piece chicken dinner and did not get one piece of white meat. The leg I got was literally one bite. The short leg I got was literally a Bite a half. I get bigger pieces of chicken from a wing joint. This place was a total rip off. They will never get the chance to rip me off again. For the price it was ridiculous how small the pieces of chicken were. I would strongly suggest you find somewhere else to go!

I use them because they are the best equipped and supplied vendor. But their service generally sucks for the wait time and the method they use to sequence customers. You can wait for just an answer to a question as long as a piece of equipment. 

Yesterday I wanted to return a piece of equipment and there was no one at their front desk. No one came to see what I needed. So after 15 minutes, l just left it on the front desk. 

Techs know what they are advising on, but to see one in some reasonable time is poor.

Good wood has a great atmosphere and solid food. It's extremely close to Texas Roadhouse and you'll find that it's a bit slower than Roadhouse because it's bit more expensive. 

The quality selection of ribs is very appreciative and the non barabaque options are also very delicious. The price point is a bit more expensive than I'd like, but not enough to not visit on occasion. My personal favorite is the Pit Boss Burger. Really good!

Have been to beef o Brady's a couple of times, their food is pretty good and their pickle chips are the best we've had in Boise. 

The reason I gave them three stars is because we went there on Sunday afternoon specifically to watch the nfl games and figured they would have all of the games since they call themselves a sports bar. When we got there they only had one of the five or six games playing and did not get any of the other channels. Although their food is good they do not provide their customers with the experience that they advertise.

This place is amazing! And our meal got even better because we got served with so much awesomeness from Michelle the server. She connected with us on a professional and personal level and did her job very well!! She was running around taking care of everyone and making sure everyone were satisfied. Again, the food is affordable and taste like a million!! We will definitely come back to this place!

Stopped in here on a Friday afternoon, nice clean place.  I would recommend this place for lunch.  My only complaint is when I order lox and bagels please put capers on the sandwich, it's just not the same flavor, it seems like you cant taste the salmon, no smokiness. Fair prices and the sandwich was definitely big enough.

If you haven't been to a Culver's before you must grab a concrete shake at least! When I come here I usually fill up on a bunch of snacks! I always get an order of cheese curds and depending on my mood an order of chicken fingers. I don't recommend getting the cheese sauce with the cheese curds only because I was expecting better tasting cheese sauce. I know you probably think I have my pinky in the air however there's a real difference! I have noticed a change in the cheese curds, I can't put my finger on it, maybe the batter, maybe the cheese? Not sure but my chicken strips were on point! I really do love this place and also love to bring my friends that have never been. My best advice, don't order too many snacks because you need to save room for the ice cream!!

THIS PLACE SUCKS!!!!!!! Worst serves every and the worst food. The nachos were the poorest excuse I've ever seen!!! $14 for dry chips and bare to no other topping. Oh... there was the avocado that I paid extra for but when the crappy server brought it out it was an ounce of guacamole.... 
My friend ordered a drink and never got a refill even though she asked for one two times!!!!! Water was only filled once after we asked several times. This place deserves a big after 0 for serve and food.

I had heard from some Indian customers I met at work that this was the best place for Indian food in the valley.  When we researched it and found it was run by the owners of the original Madhuban, Cybil and I had high hopes for it, but alas the lunch buffet was just average and not as good as Madhuban on State Street primarily because the limited space allows for less of a selection.  I'll have to come back and try ordering from their regular menu.

Favorite family Mexican comfort food! Come early for a quiet booth, love the TriColor Enchiladas (one each beef, cheese, chicken) and the skinny Avocado chicken, and the skinny margarita. We will be back, and you should too!

The ONLY reason I'm even giving this review one star is because Yelp makes you... 

The customer service at this place is pretty much non-existent... by far the worst customer service I have ever experienced. When we expressed our frustration about our first experience in 2020 all they did was point fingers at other people, first the sales guy who helped us the first time around (who was pleasant enough) and then on their delivery guys (who informed us that angry customers and delivery delays are a common thing that the delivery people have to deal with). If you care to read our experience in a nutshell (YES, this is in a nutshell), continue reading below.

My husband and I ordered furniture from this store in 2019 and had an awful experience and said we would never come back. Fast forward to December 2020... We purchased an adjustable base for our mattress but, unfortunately, the footboard to our bed that we previously purchased wasn't compatible with the adjustable base. Back to Ashley we went to purchase the footboard that goes with our bed and is compatible with the adjustable base.  The original delivery date for the footboard was towards the end of January... the end of January rolls around and we hadn't heard anything so my husband reaches out to check the status and they inform us that the delivery got pushed to February 7th.  February 6th rolls around and I call to confirm delivery and they tell me that the delivery date got pushed back to February 28th.  Today (February 19, 2021) my husband gets an email saying "Good News! Your order can be delivered earlier than expected!", so he clicks the link to schedule the delivery and it tells him that there are no deliveries available in our area. Immediately he picked up the phone and called. The gal who answered the phone told him that the scheduled delivery date is pushed out another month to March 28th. All we did was order a footboard, it's not like they're waiting on multiple pieces to deliver, there's no reason it should take this long to deliver and to not even bother to call us to let us know that our delivery date keeps getting pushed out is idiotic. We are highly considering cancelling our order, selling our bedroom furniture and purchasing something else from RC Wiley.

The food was pretty good. IMO there aren't any 5-star Indian food restaurants in this area so the food is on par with the others. Buffet had a good variety and service was decent. I knocked it from four to three stars simply because of the cleanliness (or lack thereof); I was the first customer in for the day and the restrooms were dirty and general housekeeping was subpar. Room for improvement.

I realized it has been awhile since my first review and that a fair amount of time as passed, in which an updated review is warranted. 

My family has faithfully been attending Life Church since June of last year, and I have to say I truly enjoy it more and more as time passes.

The church members and church body are such friendly, welcoming people. With a membership of I am sure over 1,000 it is impressive that I don't feel like a little fish in a giant fishbowl. 

I love that there are always new events popping up on the church calendar to provide opportunities for fellowship and personal growth. I truly do feel blessed to have found my church home. 

(please refer to my previous review for a more descriptive breakdown of what to expect if you are a first time guest)

The food here is absolutely amazing. The pho is some of the best I have ever had and would definitely recommend to any fans of pho. The fried rice is amazing as well, always cooked just right. The place is a little over crowded and the service is never fantastic. Luckily the food more then makes up for it.  I would definitely recommend, I would not recommend for a romantic date, but if your just wanting delicious food this place is perfect for that.
Michael in the fishing department loves and knows his SHIT!!  So happy he helped me. I'm going to tell everyone to ask for him.

I called 2 buy a mattress, and I spoke with an associate. He didn't have the answers, so he said his manager would call me back upon his arrival at 2pm that day. The manager or the associate never called back. During the conversation, the associate told me that he would not recommend that I order from the Ashley store online because of the virus. He said that it would not be delivered for up to two months, so I went ahead and checked out the website since I didn't get a call back. I received my mattress and all of its accessories within one week. My suggestion to you, the consumer, is to go to the website online before going here because you will probably receive much better customer service and an overall better experience.

This theater rocks!  I don't get the opportunity to go to the movies often, let alone to see a grown up movie without kids; so when doing so I really do hope to have a really great experience.  I was not disappointed.

It is very clean and nicely decorated.  The employees are all very friendly. Seats are comfortable and roomy.

I have visited this theater twice now, in the last couple of months.  The first time around was with my husband and our two boys.  So it was definitely more of the traditional general admission, popcorn and drink gig.  Which was fine, except I didn't realize we could reserve our seats ahead of time and got neck breaking seats.  Not the theater's fault.  So that's a tip to you, you pick the seats you are going to sit in ahead of time.  So either arrive early, pick them and go walk around the village for awhile and come back.  OR as I experimented with on the second go around, go online ahead of time (Fandango) and ordered them.

On the second go around, I splurged on the VIP seating above.  21 and over only, which is really nice when you are on an official date night with the hubby.  You get this nice little love seats and if you arrive at least 30 minutes early, there is a wait staff that will bring you food, drinks (real 21 and over drinks) and dessert.  The menu is based off of the restaurant in the theater, so it does extend beyond the general move fair.  We ate dinner beforehand, but did get a piece of the chocolate torte.  Which was delicious!

I did order my tickets online, the morning of the day we went.  Which was a good call, because it was the opening weekend for the movie and the place was packed!  

The sound was great, move screen was HUGE and I had a very clear, unobstructed view.

Unbeknownst to me, VIP level seating is current on special at general admission pricing.  So that was a nice bonus!  So $10 instead of $13, which honestly I don't really think $13 is outrageous for a date night.  But maybe for a regular occurrence.

As we left, the employees waived and told us to have a great night.  Almost like when you depart an airplane and the flight attendants are telling goodbye.  Loved it!

We love this place for take out or pick up (we have young kids and haven't dined in yet)! My only complaint is that it's not open earlier for my lunch cravings!! The food is all delicious and we always order extra to make sure we have leftovers.

The design of the Auditoriums are barbaric.  Everything feels so squeezed in and the only good seats in my opinion or the ones in the clear back (not VIP seating).  Other seats you literally have to crank your neck to see the movie.  

This cinema does not compare to Edwards theater across town.  Even though this cinema is closer, I'd rather not frequent it.

I was just at the CHIP at The Village.  Several sanitation issues.  3 employees were rolling cookie dough and were laughing hard bending over with mouths in their plastic gloves then back to rolling. One grabbed her phone with gloves and plugged it in by the front desk and back to rolling dough.  The one at the front desk with gloves was touching credit cards then off to get cookies touching them to go into the bags.  No one had a mask.  No one changed gloves after leaving the area and coming back or laughing into glove   or touching their phone.  Quite a scene and disturbing.  

First and last time in their door for me!

Booking a haircut was easy by calling and then getting a text back to communicate.  I received a text response immediately and after a brief exchange, was booked.  

Being new, I didn't have a preferred request for a hairdresser and was booked with Melissa.  She gave me a cute haircut similar but not exactly to what I was expecting.  It is very complementary for my face shape though so I'm happy.   She was very easy to talk with and we had a nice conversation.  The ambiance of the salon was pleasant, relaxing, chic but casual with a nice salon vibe.
