My kiddos came back for their own appointments and she did a superb job on their hair.  The fair pricing for both adult and kids cuts was a huge bonus!
One of my favorites! Happy hour is a great choice for a quick date before the evening picks up with kid activities!
Clean, quick service, large, comfy chairs, cheap Saturday afternoon ticket. Not a bad seat in Theatre  15.

My hubby and I stopped in for lunch and were amazed at how friendly our waiter was (forgot to get his name, but he was soooo friendly and his service was impeccable).  We both had the Memphis Love Me Tender hamburger which was AWESOME!  The best burger up here and it even comes with a large chicken tender on top...OMG! So good, it felt like I was having a party in my mouth.

We also had their cheese/bacon Idaho potato crisps which were THE best ever! Never had a chip like that before anywhere and will definitely come back for more.  The 23 oz, yes 23 oz Sangria was oh so yummy too.

Love the decor/atmosphere, great place for two or a whole group.  All-in-all this is one of our new "favorites" to go. Definitely recommend this place to all!!!

Tried out this newish Thai Restaurant in Meridian for the first time. We were very pleased with the decor, cleanliness, service and food. I am holding off at 4 stars, since there may be a better place in the area, but being  somewhat of a newb on Thai places here, I haven't tried many. 

This is the former Asian Fusion place. So I would bet they didn't have to do much redecorating to make it into a Thai place. The menu seemed to have a mix of Thai and Chinese dishes.

We partook of a late lunch about 45 minutes before they closed for their 3-5 PM hiatus. So they were not really busy, but we were not the only diners. Our server was a very nice young woman who answered the few questions we had. My wife had the Tom Yum Soup. It was seasoned nicely and was very well stocked with chicken and mushrooms. We split a Cha Yor, Vietnamese egg roll. Deep fried, cut into bite sized slices and served with lettuce wraps and a delightful peanut sauce. Large enough for 2 diners with some to go home as a later snack. A chicken drunken noodles made a good dish to also split and enjoy. I had it spiced up to their top spice level. It definitely cleared my head. The sweetness of a Thai tea was a just right accompaniment to cool down the fiery spice effects.

All three dishes were well done and enjoyable. We would go back and enjoy other dishes.

Love the Village Cinemas but if you are disabled and in a wheelchair then you are seated near the front and are basically looking up the whole time and end up with a neck ache! But... The VIP section is perfect if you don't have little ones with you! Disabled seating is on the back row which is perfect for me.

These guys are so helpful! I came here to print out a few things, and they got me in and out super fast. I usually use their self-serve stations (you send an email to printandgo@fedex.com, enter your confirmation code, and pay), but this time I had a bit more complex of a print job. I thought I might have to wait a while to get it done, but I was in and out within 5 minutes. The gentleman who helped me did not seem fazed at all by my questions and made this an easy peasy errand. Printing can be a frustrating endeavor that requires loads of patience, so when someone can yield their expertise to me, I am always so thankful.

Five stars for super-speedy-top-notch customer service and prints that came out exactly how they were supposed to!

Steak is perfect every time,  staff very friendly and courteous. 
Easy comfortable place to relax and salad bar is excellent as well

Expect your delivery order to arrive at least an hour late AND expect to get charged an additional $5 for local "shipping" plus however much you tip. They've been using doordash because they don't have enough employees and part of whatever you tip the dasher is TAKEN OUT. Your entire tip amount DOES NOT go to the dasher. They gave my dasher a $1.50 tip when I tipped $3. No wonder the orders are late. Dashers don't want to pick them up bc they get ripped off on their tips. I'm worried my cookies will get spit on or worse. Bummer bc the cookies are good but this has been a constant issue and I'm paying $8 extra for delivery (including tip) but the delivery person only gets $1.50. Pretty LAME, Chip.

I have alternately loved and hated this place. When they are on, it's a five star restaurant. Great food, fun grill "show", and great service. When it's bad, it's one star bad. Hostess in a bikini top that's nasty and seats you 30 minutes after your reservation for an overcooked meal with a barely fun "show". I won't rush back.

I've been coming to Idaho to visit my boyfriend and friends and they wanted to bring me to this place because they've told me many good things about it. We got a reservation at 6:30 and were seated. It was pretty crowded at this time and the layout of the restaurant is a bit cramped. Everything is going fine, he's took our drink orders and our appetizers. An hour rolls by, 7:30, no drink at all, no one has really checked in on us, but the table that sat next to us was seated not too long ago but already getting appetizers. Finally after about 15 minutes, we finally get the drinks. Then another 15 rolls by and we get our appetizers. My boyfriend and I got a sushi roll, Kiss on Fire. It looked pretty decent and didn't taste that bad, the only issue was there were so much panko on the sushi and really all I could taste was just that for the entirety of it, it just had the potential to be good but it wasn't that great. 
Finally after waiting for so long, it's around 8:20pm. Our hibachi chef rolls by and checks who gets what and then gets started on the show. He's flipping a lot of stuff and tossing things into everyone's mouth. Then he starts cooking, my boyfriend and I share the hibachi combo, Salmon and Lobster with fried rice. 
He puts it on our plate when they're ready, cleans up and leaves. 
I was hoping they did something different or special with the stuff they were gonna cook. Like something special where I can only get this at this specific place. But no, it was just seafood I literally could've done the same thing but better at home. 
It was so over sauced and the fried rice was literally just soy sauce with a little bit of carrots and peas. There is more to fried rice than literally just that. We cook it at home a lot. So when I saw this I could just already see my money not getting it's worth. 
I ate a tiny bit of the rice then started to eat the seafood. I tried it with the sides of sauce they gave us and the light colored one reminded me of a salad and the dark one was a bit like tangy like vinegar. They were alright, not really complimenting to go together since the seafood was already doused in sauce. 
After the guy was done with the show and left while we were trying out the food. It was now 9. My boyfriend and I got up to leave, we had a lot of food left so had 2 to go boxes for both of us, tho we didn't really eat the left overs and just gave the rest of the seafood to whoever in the house wanted to try or his cat. 
The service wasn't fast nor great. The food was mediocre. This place isn't necessarily worth it really. It doesn't hurt to go for one time but I'll never want to come back here. I'd rather eat McDonalds than this place really.
I will say the only good thing about this place was just their house soup, it was definitely better than the seafood I got and I finished that quite quickly.

I've eaten here a few times now... & each time it's felt like eating with extended family. I love the concept of soup & salad before the main entree, & their wines are all superb. And $7 for a glass of quality wine is an extra bonus. Whether planning a romantic dinner or have a group dinner u r planning- this restaurant can meet your expectations. Note: no gluten free options are available without pre arrangement with the chef.

I absolutely love it when I read good reviews on Yelp.  Again, I was so pleased when I found Classic Vacs and met Paul the owner.  He has a great understanding of Dyson and mine was in dire straits and I wasn't ready to spend $400+ on a new one. 

Paul just happened to have the Dyson part in stock so he could fix my vacuum quickly.   He also called me later on to let me know he also found some other issues with it.  The vacuum was ready to pick up the next day.  I was quite pleased as the repairs were only $140 which was way better than buying a new one.  Plus now my vacuum looks like it's brand new too. 

Thank you Paul, for your prompt service.

If I could give zero stars, I would.  DO NOT BUY FROM THIS STORE! Save yourself the trouble and don't do it!  I get that stuff is taking longer to get delivered, however I purchased bedroom furniture for our 3 kids and patio furniture back in April and I still haven't received the dressers and half the patio furniture!  I bought furniture from 3 different stores back in April and May and received my items from the other two stores with little delays all the way back in August.  If you go in the store, the employees don't give a $h!%!!  They tell you they will look into it and then never call you!  We paid Ashley a total of about $10k for the bedroom sets and patio furniture and have only received half of what we paid for and we've been waiting 9 months now!  I was just told by Ashley corp that the rest of the furniture won't be here till February, however that it was they say every two months.  They push it out another two months.  So I'm not holding my breath! Even more unfortunate is I'm stuck waiting for this stupid furniture cause my kids have half the bedroom sets and we have half the patio furniture.  I'd really like some chairs to go with the patio dining table I have sitting in my backyard since September!  And my kids would love a dresser to put their clothes in!!!!  Go anywhere else!!!  Even if you have to pay a little more, it's worth it!!!  Unless your jonesing to get ripped off, don't even bother with this store or the employees!  Especially the employees and the managers.  They are full of crap, every single one of them!

My husband and I just moved here and decided to take our awesome new friends here as our thank you to them for helping us to become new Idahoans.  WOW! We were made to feel like truly welcomed guests and the atmosphere was so warm and inviting, that I knew it had to be good.  The place was packed and we had the leg of lamb, which was the best I have ever had and the mushroom appetizer was out of this world tasty.  We were never rushed and this will definitely one for our "Best places to eat" list.  Everyone was so friendly and accommodating and pair that with the wonderful food and all i can say is you REALLY need to try this place, you will not be disappointed.  Make reservations early, I waited until 2 days before our dinner date and they only had a 5pm or 7:45pm time, but since we wanted a true European dining experience, the 7:45 p.m. time worked out great.  .

My husband and I decided to have one last date night before the arrival of our son and we become a family of 3. We have been wanting to try this establishment since we moved here... and the stars finally aligned. 

We started our meal with the croquettas. We were really intrigued by all of the appetizers... but knew our stomachs could only hold so much. We absolutely made a phenomenal choice! The croquettas were perfectly crisp, creamy and light! They were heavenly. 

As this was our first time, we really wanted to share and experience everything that we could during our dining experience. The soups were very good (this is coming from a person who really doesn't care for soup) and the salad was the perfect serving portion. 

Now on to the main event! My husband had the lamb leg and it was very good... but let me tell you... TRY THE HALIBUT! Words cannot even begin to explain how perfect this piece of fish was. The lobster sauce that was paired with it was incredible as well. We very much enjoyed our side dishes (the rice and sautéed peppers) as well. 

Finally, because at this point we had to fight through the food pain... we had dessert. We shared the citrus cake with raspberry sauce. It was a perfectly dense and refreshing (yes, dense and refreshing... odd right?!?). If you like citrus, this is a dessert "must try"! This was such a beautiful date night out for us. We are looking forward to future nights to visit again.

They refuse to take cash, lame.  Since Yelp wants more words, here are some more words: it makes me feel as though Chip doesn't value me as a customer because I prefer to pay cash. "Oh look at the stupid old fool trying to buy his kids some cookies and doesn't want to borrow $15 from a bank or use a debit card which, if compromised could have his bank account cleaned out, what an idiot" they seem to be saying.

We visited at the recommendation of a friend who bought a Green Mountain pellet grill here.  A friendly salesman named Kevin immediately approached us and asked how he could help, answered my questions about the grill, and pointed out that it was on sale at a price comparable to Internet outlets with a 30 day return policy.  Kevin loaded up the grill on a cart along with some bags of pellets that were also on sale, took us to checkout where he waited while a friendly cashier rung us out and got me signed up for their rewards program, then wheeled the cart out to my rig where he loaded the grill and pellets for us.

Fast, friendly and knowledgeable service, great prices, a liberal return policy and someone to get it all loaded up for you -- what more can you ask for?

We all have an "eating lane".  The one in which I drive to prefer sustainably grown and raised, locally sourced products used in dishes created by Chef driven kitchens for independent "mom n pop" eateries runs nowhere near the parking lot of a Sizzler.  Yet, here I was for curbside take-away.  Before I tell you about the experience for order, service and food, I will share how I came to be here in this odd year that has been 2020.  Because when the pieces are added together, I think you may want to support this Sizzler too.

LONG & WINDING ROAD TO SIZZLER:  Introduced, in virtual sense, to the woman who owns this Sizzler franchise via a  neighborhood bulletin board where the topic was Eagle and Meridian eateries ignoring Central District Health pandemic times mask rules and distancing recommendations.  My view, in metaphorical terms, is the owners of those businesses are standing with middle finger raised to issues of public health during a pandemic.  A disturbing number of my neighbors think these are OK to be ignored, as a "liberty" issue.  Then joined in the owner of this Sizzler proposing restaurant owners chose to be part of the problem or part of the solution and that she and her co-owner husband had from the 'get' decided to follow Central District Health and CDC guidelines and be part of the solution, even though it has a financial cost to an eatery to do those right things.

Not only did I say "Exactly" to this owner's responsible approach, but learning she and her husband owned this franchise - and the one in Nampa - checked the "mom n pop" owner box on my list.  I also appreciated learning they employ 100 local people and use many local suppliers.

I thought her business deserved my support but I am in the main "allergic" to chains in the way Maynard G. Krebs was to work.   For due diligence, I read Yelp reviews  - sorted by Newest - and found all written in 2019 - 2020 were 4 and 5 stars! (To make it easy to see two of the 5 star reviews that informed me, I'll insert excerpts below.)

My husband and I are not eating in for now, so we placed an order to take away.   We would do it again at this location based on our good experience.  

ORDER & SERVICE:  Top notch service starting with staff follow up on the order which I placed using web site at about 8:30a.m. and scheduled for early evening pick up curbside.  For a true test, I ordered two small entrees, each with a choice of side, and two salads. I  used my husband's cell number as contact (I do my best to ignore my phone) and about 10:30a.m. his phone rang.  It was a nice man from this Sizzler who told me he noticed my evening order came in with rice as side for one dish and he wanted to be certain I noticed menu description that this dish came with rice.  Good catch by him.  I had not read the description correctly.  I changed my side to pan seared green beans.  I did not expect a chain restaurant to reach out like that on a to-go order.  Perfect.

Another thing done just right by them was this; in order comments I asked for cold items in separate bag from hot ones.  (It has been my experience even up-end places often put them together.)   When order was delivered  to our car- right on time btw - they had separate bags.  And on arrival home we found everything well packed to assemble into meal.  

EATS:  Every item was better than expected, given our chain skepticism, and nicely seasoned.  Our happiest surprise was the salads - each $3.99 so we expected they would be small - were bountiful.  One of my guilty pleasures is a wedge salad and assembled at home from carefully packed ingredients this one was tasty!

OTHER YELPERS SAY 5 STARS:

*Craig A from Portland in August 2020: "Admittedly, I've never eaten at a Sizzler.. but our family, on the 12 hour drive home, decided to stop and grab dinner.  Could not be happier! ...a happy hostess who was extremely nice and at the salad bar an employee very nicely asking a patron to wear a mask... not judgmentally nor rudely, but in a way where everyone was smiling and went about their way...our waitress was very nice and helpful and the food was delicious and a great value...I had the trio, kids had steak bites, and my wife had hibachi combo...all was wonderful.  Great experience.

Monique H in the 'before pandemic days' in 2019: "GO GO GO! You will thank me later! FOOD: Outstanding! Husband and I ordered the Steak and all you can eat shrimp (I added salad bar) and it was cooked to perfection! Juicy steak, large crispy shrimp (all you can eat! Sooo good) and a huge baked potato with all the fixings...can't be beat, trust me I've eaten at all the steakhouses around Boise and Meridian. The salad bar was so fresh...Service: Michelle was our server, and I have never received better hospitality, attention, all with a smile and eagerness rarely seen. I observed her deliver this to all of her guests...The Meridian Sizzler is the best kept secret in the state, I am sure of it. You won't be disappointed!"

We switched over to Medicap medical sullied and pharmacy.
Couldn't be more thrilled with their service!!

Awful. Just...so awful. I lived in an apartment managed by these guys for three years. The first year was alright. We had an issue where they claimed my rent hadn't been received, asked me to send them a check, and then cashed the original check they previously said was not received. I had put a stop payment on the first check so, when they cashed both, the first check bounced. They went on to blame me for it, refused to accept any other checks from me, and even tried to charge me for the bounced check, which we eventually cleared up. They never refunded me for the unneeded stop payment fee. Okay, fine, your payment department is incompetent but the property was in a nice location, people make mistakes, and I didn't want to move; I really should have. Oops.

About two years later, I had an issue with the living room gas fireplace. It shared a common flue with the upstairs neighbors who had blocked it shut for some reason. I found this out the hard way when my girlfriend and I suffered a fun bout of carbon monoxide poisoning one cold winter night. JPM's solution? None at all! They just suggested I not use it ever again. When asked for compensation since part of the property I was renting no longer functioned and was not going to be fixed, they laughed at me and told me I would not be compensated. They actually laughed at me on the phone. Way to be professional, guys.

Later that same month came the water heater. The water heater was spitting up large chunks of white and brown mineral gunk, so much so that our faucets kept clogging and taking a bath was disgusting. I checked into cleaning it and it had been so long since it had been flushed that the water heater flush valve was clogged. We cleaned it out, flushed it numerous times, and found it was still dumping massive chunks of gunk. JPM's response? Too bad. Apparently this is normal and the many decades I've had water heaters that didn't constantly clog the pipes was a fluke. They refused to fix and/or replace it, and suggested I remove the aerators on my faucets. I explained that it was big chunks in the pipes causing the blocks and Don Johnson, the owner, just told me he didn't know what to tell me: I was going to have to learn to live with it. I put in my notice shortly thereafter and never looked back.

They, of course, docked my rent for various normal maintenance and painting related charges, even though there was no damage and regular wear and tear (including painting) is the landlord's responsibility. All in all, your typical scumbag slumlord. 

In a nutshell, avoid these guys. It's a property management group run by a bunch of incompetents at best, and crooks at worst. The best part? They had SO many negative reviews on their google places page they removed it. I love it!

I come to this location all the time and the service has always been outstanding! Recently I decided to go when I got off work and realized I had forgotten my wallet after I had already placed my order... but the manager Matt went above and beyond and took care of my order on the house! I was so so appreciative that I didn't have to go away empty handed or drive 20 mins back home to grab my card! Thank you Matt and thank you Culver's!

Never had such bad customer service anywhere!
They said the person we needed wasn't in & come back tomorrow; when Doc's office called to check to see what was going on, they got the correct person on that same day. 
Hmmmm... seems management believes that they have a monopoly & don't have to answer questions, phone messages, or make an effort to fill prescriptions on time, either.
We will be looking elsewhere for services.
SAD!! Smallest portions from any of the wonderful Qdoba's we have visited. Asked for double meat on both bowl and burrito. We will never spend our money at this location ever again.

One of our favorite new bagel places! 

There are a few reasons why I am so excited that I found this place... 
1. They have croissants. I know this seems like a silly excitement, but there are some mornings where this little lady just needs a ham and cheese croissant for breakfast and not a bagel. 
2. They have some great varieties of bagels. One interesting flavor I found was their Hawaiian bagel. It's coconut and pineapple. Pair that with their honey walnut cream cheese.. and you've got a winner! Sadly others feel the same as I do, so they sell out kinda quickly. 
3. They have a great espresso bar. Their vanilla chai is to die for! Most coffee shops offer chai from a liquid state. Sarah's bagel has chai that is powder base. Caution: this particular drink is NOT diet friendly. But it's oh soooo goood!
Ordered take out today and the food was delicious!  Sizzler is always so good, there's a reason they've been in business so long!  Will patronize more!

Carne Borracha Molcajete

Really one of the best Mexican places in Boise! Food is amazing and unusual. Service was perfect! Great drinks :)

Upon calling to ask about a reservation we got told not need we drove straight there and had a 45min wait. The food is precooked frozen and reheated at least all of ours was. We had requested the grill area and got seated at a table. The rice is at best minute rice. Go to Panda Express its about the same quality. My food was also wrong.

Came here to kill some time. Did the bottle of champagne and clams. I was so excited to try this place out since I love the one downtown but it was underwhelming. The waiter/bartender brought our champagne and juices walked away and we had no glasses. It was busy and he was running around so had to wait a bit to get the glasses. Neither my friend or I were fans of the clams. We ended up not eating most of it. There was just something very unappealing of the sauce. I did enjoy the glass box atmosphere and people watching at Christmas time.

Pretty good. I can't believe how busy this place always is. Had the pesto chicken sandwich and seasonal asparagus cream soup. It was good and a change from the norm. I tend to crane more a good old fashioned deli style sandwich which this is not. All in All everything was tasty.

My 4 year old loves coming here. He tells us all the time that he wants to go Jump!
Great way to get the silly out when the weather is bad. My husband takes him for an hour and he's begging for a nap by the time they leave!

I gave 3 stars for suggestions on improvements to make it all the better. I agree with another helper that the toddler zone is not monitored at all. When we first started coming here, our son was just a little guy and he would get trampled by these big kids who should not have been in the room to begin with.  

The pricing was great for kids under 3. But I feel like it starts getting a little steep for 3 and older.

One nice thing, is now that our son is old enough to jump on the larger equipment my husband can join in with him. He says it is quite the workout.

I have only been to Goodwood once but I doubt that I would ever go back. The quality of meat that I got was very disappointing. I was excited to order a rack of ribs only to find out that I could barely get the meat off the bone. The ribs were very chewy and tough, not what would be expected of the "fall off the bone" aspect of ribs at any good restaurant. The sides were ok but nothing that I would rave about. If you want some good barbecue I would suggest looking somewhere else.

Love this cinema , the only one we visit for the past 3 years. But may I make a request. The snack bar needs to offer some low carb choices. With as many people with diabetes and others making the choice to live a low carb life (Keto). I really the fact that have to sneak my own snacks into the movie. All you need to is offer pork rinds, meat sticks and maybe almonds. All these items you would be able To make your profit.

As a continual customer of Epi's, and a lover of their food, I was surprised on our last visit that none of the employees were wearing masks nor were the tables distanced. This county does have those mandates in place but the owner is choosing to operate differently stating that he would be out of business if he had to follow them. As much as I want this restaurant to continue I also want to keep us all safe. Also, if you don't like the cold in winter ask to not be seated on the front porch (we were cold). Just want people to be aware and not caught off guard like we were.

I ordered a steak dinner last night for delivery. This review will be about the food only.

The steak was large (14oz.) and I had ordered it medium well, and it was cooked to perfection. It was tasty after I added my own steak sauce, but it probably could have used a little more seasoning. I had ordered cooked onions to top my steak with, and there were plenty! It was also a nice touch that the steak was partially wrapped in foil so any juices didn't get onto the fries and make them soggy. I only wish the steak was completely wrapped in foil so it was kept warm during the delivery.

My meal came with a nice piece of toast that was seasoned well, and steak fries. The fries were also cooked perfectly, not too crispy and not too soft. The meal didn't come with any catsup but luckily I had my own.

I also ordered a side of New England Clam Chowder, and it was warm and tasty as well. 

I appreciated that the owners sent a complimentary brownie with my meal to finish it off, nice touch!

The only piece of advice I would add is (I already shared this with the restaurant) to tape the delivery container or bag closed so that the customer is confident the food wasn't tampered with by the delivery driver.

Aside from that, having a container that was more sealed may have retained more of the heat from the food, as it was I had to re-heat it once it arrived (except the soup) as it had gotten cold. This is more likely a disadvantage of ordering delivery versus dining at the location in person, but in these Covid times I prefer eating at home.

Thank you Sizzler for a wonderful steak dinner delivered!

Over 200 reviews, and a 5 star composite, not 4 1/2 stars. That's impressive. This is tough. I waited too long to do the review. I've forgotten too many details. The place was packed. Fortunately we had  reservations. After a couple minutes we were seated, and treated like family. The service was flawless over the evening. The wine was well priced. The food excellent, but I'm not going to be able to give details. I'm not quite sure what local Basque food actually is, but this was good. There is a whole region South of I-84 and North of I-80 across Nevada and Idaho where Basque's have done sheep herding going back to the old West. This is the best of the Basque places I've been to. The only thing missing is the classic drink of the American Basque. A Picon Punch.

One thing's for sure. when you see a Basque place, make an effort to go. Especially for Epi's. It's the best thing near Boise.

I have been exploring the menu...love the lamb curry, so good. I have ordered 3 x now. It has been consistently wonderful. However, today I went for the buffet, which I would not recommend. The only meat option was chicken, which was DRY, and I think overall lacked variety. Additionally, most of the dishes looked like they'd been there an extended amount of time. No naan, no mint chutney, only cucumbers in the "salad" section. Although I love the lamb curry, I was so disappointed today, not only with the food selection and quality, but with the waitress. She couldn't be more disinterested. We had to leave our table to track her down multiple times. I had previously given this restaurant a 5 star review, today I struggle with giving it a 3.

We went in Saturday afternoon and we got a living room set that we were under the impression that financing was zero interest for 12 months they run my fiancé's credit and we are waiting there while they're doing all the paperwork and right as he's about to sign it says The total of the furniture set was double because it had interest on it so we were going to pay $2300 for a furniture said that it was 999. 
He was about to sign the paperwork until he saw that the price doubled employees didn't know what they were talking about ran our credit anyways. 

We were going to pay cash but got talked into financing because we were told there was no interest for the first 12 months. We ended up paying cash anyways because they were charging us double with interest so ran our credit for no reason and docked us points. 

Waste of time no one knew what they were talking about the manger didn't do anything to make it better.

Took my dog here for the first time this week.  Since moving to the area 5 years ago, I had yet to find a vet that I was comfortable with.  I called first thing in the morning to schedule an appointment for a little mishap that had happened camping over the weekend, and was fit into the schedule the same day.  (Let me side note and tell you the first place I called told me they were too busy and I could drop my dog off and they would get to her when they had time.)

Located in the business complex across from Settler's Park on the corner of Ustick and Meridian.  The reception area, is small but comfortable.  Clean and tidy, and not overly stocked with  add on purchases like some vets I have been too.

Sheryl met with us first and got us settled in the exam room.  She was gentle and kind to my dog, patient and very soft handed.

Dr. Mills came in soon after, and the same as Sheryl was also very gentle and through.  Even though I was a last minute appointment, he treated our visit as if he had all the time in the world.  He gave her a full health exam, asked if I had any general questions about her health, and then examined the fish hook in her ear.  Yes, my dog pierced her own ear!

We talked about options for removal, and he assured me no matter the steps needed it was not a big deal.  She would need to be sedated, and he was sharp enough to suggest she get caught up on shots while she was feeling relaxed.  Dr. Mills personally called me later that day, to give me a report on how things went and explain any further care I needed to give.

When I got home that evening, my dog was running around happy and excited like she was trying to show me something.  That is when I realized she appeared to have gotten a bath, brushing and nail trim while she was there!  I can't say with certainty that they for sure did this, but she smelled good and her summer shedding was gone!  It was like I dropped her off for a day at the spa!  :)

Lastly, I was very pleasantly surprised with the reasonable charge for my visit.  I had no idea what I was getting myself into when I dropped her off.  I have definitely felt taken advantage of in the past at other places, and was so pleased to see a break down of charges that actually made sense and prices that seemed fair.

Added bonus, they sent the fish hook home in a baggie!  Love it!  It's like a momento to add to the scrap book along side my child's first lost tooth!  :)

Not the best nor the worst dessert experience.   
We had two "concretes" - their thick shake like dessert.   One made with vanilla was very runny/thin.  Neither one was mixed to the bottom.  
Staff was friendly.

I realized it's been quite a few years since my initial review so time for an update! Since my initial visit, we have continued to use Settlers Vet for our doggie doctor needs and are always satisfied with our care.

The fur baby I spoke about in my initial review, as since passed away. It was a very difficult decision for me and Dr Mills and his staff where very empathetic and compassionate during the whole experience.

Since that time, we have brought a new fur baby into our household and Dr Mills is who we called right away. We purchased the new dog from a breeder and so we wanted to have a check-up done right away to make sure there was nothing out of the ordinary discovered. All went well,  he answered questions we had specific about the breed and has been our go-to for annual check-ups ever since. 

Still the great quality of care and friendly staff from 6 years prior.

I took my mom out for a ladies night to BodoVino and loved the atmosphere and food. We sat at the bar where we were attended to by Christian. My mom wasn't sure what all the fancy drinks were but she wanted something festive, and Christian took the time to walk her through the menu and made many helpful suggestions. She wound up ordering some fancy drink with really beautiful garnish. Holy wow! We also ordered clams which were delightful. Thank you so much! We'll be back to see the new vending machines!

We got a mailer advertising their Steak and Lobster dinner which my wife immediately took notice of. She said we had to go try it! 
For variety, I got the Steak & Malibu Chicken dinner and we both got the Salad Bar. As always, the salad bar was plentiful and well stocked. The dinners were served in good order and the food was very good. Both the server and cashier were efficient and friendly.

I recently purchased new chairs from this location. The chairs were delivered assembled. All of them are really wobbly. One of them looks like it was used. The seat is faded and there's a stain on the arm rest. To add to this, I didn't appreciate the sales tactics used in the store. Our salesperson insisted that we buy the white glove delivery instead of assembling the chairs ourselves. I did not want this m, but was told that I could only buy them in increments of 2 if I did not want the delivery.  Since we were buying 3 chairs, this was basically a requirement. So we paid $100 for this delivery which makes the fact that they are not in good condition even more frustrating. A tech is coming to fix or replace them. I will update this review based on the outcome of that visit.

Update:
I've changed my review from 1 to 3 stars. Ashley Furniture gave me a full refund for the three chairs. I didn't go higher for a couple reasons. First, I had to deliver the chairs myself to their warehouse which was pretty far away. I think they should have picked them up. I also still don't like the sales tactic of requiring the added cost of their assembly and delivery. I could have assembled them myself, but wasn't able to do that unless I ordered in increments of two. At least that's what the salesman said.

The room was fine, bed was very comfy. However I was surprised that there was no complimentary breakfast, when I stayed at the Hampton Inn previously just a short distance away, they had a great complimentary breakfast with omelets and waffles, etc. In fact every other hotel that I can think of provides a free breakfast....just sayin'.

Yum!  Fast food with a big ice cream menu.   Stopped in for lunch and ordered the crispy chicken spinach artichoke burger.  It was delish!   Also loved the vanilla peanut butter cup, salted caramel shake.  Fries were satisfying dipped in ranch.  Fry sauce was meh.  Kiddo ordered a grilled cheese that was done to perfection.  She gobbled it up!

Never again. We decided to try a new sushi spot and saw this place had 4 stars so why not? We began with a couple of Mai Tai's and they were disgusting. I immediately felt like I drank something that was mixed with antiseptic and band-aids. Blaaahh!! No, not an alcohol flavor but more like an medical flavor...so gross. I ended up ordering another drink that couldn't be messed up.

We ordered the Japanese calamari for our appetizer and got these skinny overcooked little rings...about 10 of them. Then we ordered our sushi and just wasn't happy with them. Mine came with a variety of "caviar" and as I tried each of them, they tasted like they had a chemical plastic flavor. My husband thought it had a gasoline flavor to them. Not the best dinner for a date night. 

The only positives was how fast the food arrived at the table, the food presentation, and the beer I ordered to replace the cocktail.

We don't mind paying for great food but this was extremely overpriced for the quality we were given.

I really enjoyed the atmosphere and the great selection of wines at Bodovino. I enjoyed one of the Chardonnay's, while watching the fountains dance outside, through the gigantic windows boasted around the building. However, I was not overly impressed with any of the food (meatballs, bread, any of the spreads). The option to go up to the wine dispensers (not sure the official name of it) and pay for them yourself was a really neat feature.

Pickup is quick and easy with their drive-through window. The cashier was friendly and efficient. My Chicken Bacon Garlic stuffed pizza was ready when I had requested it. I followed the baking instructions and it turned out perfectly.

Was surprised to see how filthy the place is considering it's moderately high prices. The plates are greasy and have nice decorations ranging from crusty stuck on onion to little pieces of fried rice. They can't even wash a plate or wipe down a table so unless you wanna pay 80$ for a food poisoning roulette don't go.
Great service today. Had an issue with an online order which was not the fault of the store but of the website. The manager quickly made the situation right and I left with the pizza I was expecting.

If I could give 0 stars I would.

First off, they do not take cash, which last I checked was legal tender for all debts, public and private.  Next the kid taking orders at the makeshift "Drive Thru" wanted me to read him my credit card information so he could type it into his tablet.  Are you kidding me?  I asked if I could pay using a credit card or ApplePay, he said only inside, they only take credit card numbers at the drive thru.

I went inside and spoke with a manager and asked if it was true they did not take cash, she said they hadn't been taking cash for a couple of months now.  I told her if that was true, this would be my last time as a customer.  Her response?   A cheery (and phony) I'm sorry to hear that, I'll let my manager know.

Finally it took 35 minutes to get served, with no warning given when I placed my order what the wait would be.

So just in case she forgets, I'll let the managers and the rest of the public know, right here.

Zuppa's, your competition has got this figured out (visit Panda Express for a lesson in how it's done).  And you'd better figure it out too if you want to survive.

If you know my reviews, you know that I really enjoy keeping everything on a positive note. Unfortunately for this particular McDonald's location, I do not have great things to say. 

The 3-4 times my husband and I have tried this location, we have always had a minimum of a 25-40 minute wait (drive-thru). Although the staff is typically friendly, it makes zero sense on why anyone would ever have to wait that long for food from there. In all reality I guess it in my inner chubby self saying "you don't need to eat bad food for you". Nonetheless, it's incredibly frustrating. 

If this only happened once, then this review would be nonexistent. However, because this has happened on multiple visits. This has to be noted to anyone considering to visit this location.

Good burger joint. Have been twice now and pleasant experience so far. Reminds me a lot of Freddy's and priced similarly. Love the crinkle cut fries and the double bacon cheeseburger was good. Also like that they have diet root beer!!

Worst customer service I have ever experienced. My order was to be delivered within an hour, I waited an hour and 20 minutes before calling. The manager told me my order had been sitting in his warmer for a while and was now probably bad, because he didn't know where his delivery driver was. He did NOT apologize, he had no offers to help make right, his response was... "Well it has been a very rough day here for me and I don't know what to tell you about your order. " Terrible Terrible Customer Service. No dinner for me

This is my second Grandson we brought for their "first" haircut. After 6 months ago when his brother took a couple chunks of hair off his head with a razor we decided to bring him in for an official hair cut. They are so friendly as soon as you walk in the door. Very patient with children and really listen to what you would like done with your child's hair. Would definitely recommend taking your child for their haircuts here. Plus they get to sit in their favorite race cars!!

Highly disappointed in my experience, especially since we were so excited to try this place. I'll start with the only positive, the food was delicious. Now to the negatives... for starters, the waiting area was packed with 30+ people (not all wearing masks). During a pandemic there needs to be more structure and rules enforced to keep everyone safe. That environment is exactly how the virus spreads. I had made a reservation more than a week in advance. When I arrived 2 minutes early and checked in I was told it would be a 30 minute wait past my reservation time. I immediately asked to speak with the manager (just call me Karen) as I didn't understand why they would make a reservation that they wouldn't be able to seat for 30 minutes past the original reservation time. After speaking with the manager there was still no clarity. She did assure me it wouldn't be a 30 minute wait and she was right, it was a 24 minute wait before we were seated. Once seated it took almost 15 minutes before we were greeted by anyone and drink orders were taken. The waiter was extremely rude and abrasive and from the very beginning you could tell he was rushing us to get in and out. Once drink and dinner orders were placed it still took another 25 minutes before our drinks made it to the table. Oh, did I mention the hibachi chef came to start cooking our meal during this time and discovered no one had ever turned on the grill to pre heating so we had to wait even longer. This had to have been the worst dining experience I've had in over a year if not longer. My husband and I eat out 2-3 times a week to help support local businesses during this pandemic. We will not be eating here again.

In my opinion this place needs a serious customer service overhaul and training.  Here's a detailed account of my experience. 

My husband and I went to go see Baywatch on 5/25/17 at the 9pm showing. It was our anniversary so we decided to upgrade to the VIP section (even though we don't drink) because of the food service & comfy love seats. We arrived at about 8:40 & headed to theatre #10 to take our seats.  We stopped and got some popcorn & a sofa at the upstairs concession area.  The upstairs concession does not have a popcorn machine. Instead they have bags of every size sitting in a case. We bought a medium popcorn and a large coke & spent just under $13. The woman working there was very nice. She was super friendly & enthusiastic. I would say that she was absolutely the best employee we met. 
We arrived to our seats right around 8:50pm.  Once we were situated in our seats we tried the popcorn.  It was awful.  It was not hot (or even lukewarm) or fresh.  It tasted like it had been sitting for hours.  I decided to just go downstairs to the main concession stand and ask for fresh popcorn to replace the one I bought upstairs.  Side note: One thing I noticed about this theatre is that it didn't smell like popcorn. I have never gone into any movie theatre & not smelled popcorn.  It's all part of the experience, isn't it? Anyway, the popcorn machines were full of popcorn & I asked if I could have mine replaced with fresh popcorn.  The worker said that he believed that it was pretty fresh & replaced it. I headed back upstairs with the new popcorn. 
When I got back to my seat the previews were starting. I asked my husband if the waiter came by to take our food order & he said no.  We never were approached by a server, even though a group of single girls were helped. That sucked. While watching previews we tried the popcorn. YUCK!!! Again, stale, cold, & nasty. I set it aside and didn't touch it again. 
Over the course of the movie there was a couple who seriously would not shut up.  Like they were having full on conversations.  To make matters worse, they were sloppy drunk.  At one point they had an argument because the girl dropped her drink.  I left the theatre several times in search of an usher or employee who could perhaps ask them to be quiet.  The majority of the people in VIP asked them to be quiet to no avail, so we needed an usher.  But, I could not find one anywhere.  It was beyond annoying.  
After the movie was over I went to find a manager to make him aware of everything that happened. 
I had the pleasure (lol) of dealing with Xander. When I spoke to him about my experience & asked him to refund my popcorn he was completely unprofessional & told me there was nothing he could do for me.  He said that because the popcorn was EDIBLE I had no right to complain.  He said that they simply do not refund concessions....EVER.  I was floored. I asked him how it was right for me to pay for food that wasn't good. He then grabbed popcorn out of my bag, popped it in his mouth & said, " See, its perfectly fine". OMG!! Really?? He just ate my popcorn!?!? He doesn't know me or know what I may have done to it. At this point, another patron was involved.  He looked at Xander & asked him if he was serious. At this point, Xander walked off without saying a word to me & went into an office. 
After about 7-9 minutes, a female manager came out & asked what was going on.  I knew that she was aware of the situation because 1. Xander just spent nearly 10 minutes in the office with her & 2. I heard her confirm to another employee over the handheld radio that she was aware of the situation.  I told her that I didn't want to go over the entire story while she already knew it. I told her that I find it frustrating that I can spend nearly $50 to see a movie & the entire experience is crap and when I talk to a "manager" about possibly getting a refund on my $7 for popcorn I get yelled at. She (Eleanor) then tells my husband that she wants to give us a couple of passes to come back. She returns with 2 passes & a coupon for 10% off food at Backstreet Bistro. I appreciated the gesture. Then when I got into my car I looked at the movie passes.  They are restricted to movies that are more than 2 weeks old.  What!?!? Seriously???? I'm at a movie on opening night & I get some pass for an old movie.  Wow...thanks...I guess.  
I will definitely be sticking to movies at the Majestic. The theatre may be a bit older, but at least the popcorn is fresh & the employees are friendly. The Village Cinema isn't worth the headache.

First timer to this place... well actually to Indian food in general. My in laws were in town visiting. We were trying to find somewhere new for dinner, and we strolled by this place. 

In all honesty, my father in law did all of the ordering. We ordered 3 different entrees and they were served with rice. We also ordered garlic naan (which was delicious). I do remember a type of butter chicken sauce that also had lamb and shrimp. This was my favorite out of everything we ordered. The sauce was creamy and the proteins were very good. 

I am really looking forward to returning and trying new things! The staff was very helpful with suggestions as well

Johnny's Pizza is the perfect example of why you should never judge a book by its cover...or judge a hole-in-the-wall joint by it's smattering of posters all over the windows. If you happen to be in this little strip mall off Meridian and Fairview and saw this little joint, you'd probably think "oh there's a cheap little pizza place where the food is probably crap but would be nice to throw down during a hangover." Here's the thing...your predetermined notion thinking is WRONG and you should be ashamed cause this place is FANTASTIC!

I was on a long walk and was passing by this little easy-to-miss spot in an easy-to-drive-by strip mall. I'm a sucker for a good deal and saw they were offering a 1-topping pizza for like eight bucks and 3-topping calzones for seven I think? Deal! Got me a large with chicken, a calzone with pep, sausage, and bell peppers, and an order of cheesy jalapeño bread. Total cost was around 23 bucks, which is fantastic for the amount you get. With that being said, my mind fully switched to lowered expectations, thinking that this would be your standard mediocre-tasting pizza that you either get when you can't think of anything else to do for lunch or dinner, are having a ton of people over for a sporting event or something similar, or are just 100% inebriated AND WANT PIZZA RIGHT EFFING NOW! Well, as you may have guessed from the amount of stars given, I was so so wrong and I LOVE that I was wrong. This place is GOOD! Like...really really good. I'm not typically a huge red sauce fan and love me some white pizza, but the house-made sauce here is just freakin fantastic. A lot of flavor. The large pizza was a great size for 8 bucks, not thin and not too thick, and just so tasty. The chicken on it wasn't the big chunks like I'd expect but smaller and had a little crispiness. It was good. It all was just really good. 

Now the REAL star may have been the calzone. Holy wow it was great...good meats in their pepperoni and sausage and the peppers had a nice little tasty crunch to them. The calzone was big and thick and baked to perfection with plenty of cheese and their super tasty red sauce, then sprinkled with some kind of garlic madness on the outside crust. Just so freakin good. I'll come back just to order like three of these on a massive cheat day then happily perish via heart disease but well worth it. 

All in all, this place is a gem, and yes, I overuse that word now that I live in Idaho, but I just call it as I see it. Really really good food here for a great price. SUPER dangerous as I live close to it, but good to know that if I decide that I need to try to reach that obese level with a smile on my face, I'm going to Johnny's!

If we order take out, we usually order athai from Thai Basil.

Hubby is OBSESSED with their boneless honey roasted duck. Yes, it is a little fatty but the flavor... WORTH IT. Just feed the fat to your dog  (if you have one).

The Vietnamese egg rolls, DELISH. 

We also really enjoy their curries. Super flavorful.

Yum. This is gonna be short and sweet. 

The naan bread is amazing. Get all the flavors. Do not plan on sharing. You need your own portion. Not because the portions are small but because it's so delicious and you will fight your quarantine roommates for every last bite. 

There is no bad choice. I love the butter chicken. It is sweet, creamy, spicy and tender. They included two yummy sauces. A minty one and a....peppery one? I honestly don't know. That's one of my favorite things about Indian food. I'm never quite sure how to describe the flavor except amazing.
This was the worst ever one star is very generous, The wings should have been thrown away two hours ago they had been fresh for probably five or six hours not a bargain at $.50 each.

Came to this spa a few days ago with my mom and it was great. They have a eucalyptus steam room and mineral pool you can soak in before your services. I got a spray tan and my mom got a eyebrow wax with the services we purchased. Everyone was very sweet and the facility was clean and well decorated.

Friendly staff, great service, and great food! I had French toast cover with pecan top with bacon caramel sauce. It was moist and just amazing. Popular breakfast place from the looks of how many people were in there. I would come again for sure.

Amazing!  Had the panini, soup, and chips combo.  Absolutely delicious!  Full of flavor, good quantity for the price, excellent service and a clean restaurant.  They have a bunch of baked goods available and a variety of brewed hot coffee too.  Definitely will be returning here often!

The Griddle comes out to be an average breakfast joint that could have been as good as Joe Mamma's if it aspired to, but it keeps tripping over its own feet with easily fixable problems.

They serve Dawson Taylor coffee, and make it just strong enough for coffee connoisseurs like me to enjoy. Sometimes, they make you wait a little bit on refills, but thankfully this doesn't happen too often.

The reason I eat at The Griddle once in awhile is because it's a nice and easy two mile bike ride from my house. The atmosphere inside is nice with a classic diner touch and modernized refinements. Their Savory Crepe is phenomenal and is the best thing on the list after eat nearly everything. Their fruit crepes are also very damn good, but you'll usually spend a lot adding these to your main meal.

So what's the bad? Well, for one thing, they have very high prices. For most selections, you will spend at least $10-12 and you won't be stuffed, either. Unless you order a few select things (clue: Savory Crepe), then you will likely walk away not being "stuffed," but usually being just "barely full." For lazy, fat Americans like the most of us, we want to feel like taking a power nap spending near $20 on breakfast. Now you understand why I choose to bike to the Griddle: It's because I never feel stuffed or lazy afterwords. This is the only way I can phrase being shorthanded positively...sort of...

The service is ok-- nothing special. The food has always came out on time, so no complaints there. The Griddle is worth trying once, but if The Griddle is all you eat at, then you are really missing what else Boise has to offer.

My wife and I had dinner during a movie here last week. The dinner was average (as expected at a movie theater) but the service was great and it was definitely a more upscale movie theater. I probably wouldn't order food here again, but the drinks (beer and cider) tasted delicious.

This restaurant is one that I will continue to return to whenever I am in town.  I come in early and was seated immediately by Haylee.  Her service was excellent, friendly and accurate. The food was delicious. The restaurant was clean and neat.
Rude server named Amy. My first time here and every question was met by an annoyed look. And no, there was no one waiting behind me to order. Food was ok. Bread overly buttered and eggs very salty.

I am a fan of the chain, but my experience at this location was very pleasant. The service was quick and the dining room clean. I wouldnt usually write up on Denny's but HAVE YOU TRIED THE MAPLE BACON MILKSHAKE? Omg

If you love beer, all sorts of beer, this is an excellent place to shop, get a Growler filled, or have a meal and a brew.  They have an amazing bottle shop and an excellent rotating tap list. 

The food selection is minimal and changes often, so try not to be too heartbroken if your favorite southern style sando is no longer offered *sob*, but it's also excellent.  The current food offering is an array of appetizers (we always get the Bavarian Soft Pretzel, it is a must have), Cuban style pressed sandwiches, and wonderful totally unique pizzas (ham, caramelized onion, green apple, and blue cheese pizza?  Weird?  No.  Awesome!).  

The staff is always very helpful and friendly and extremely knowledgeable when it comes to beer.  Have a beer question? Ask.  Even when busy they've always been more than willing to try and answer any questions you may have about style, food pairing, and what's available. 
This is however first and foremost a bottle shop.  In all the times I've been there I've never seen more than three people working at once (that includes the cook) so if it's busy do not expect any kind of table service.  You order at the counter & they bring you your food, when you want something else, head back to the counter to order it.  This might throw some people off but to me it offers another chance to peruse the wall o-beer. 

Also, don't be surprised to see a scruffy pooch napping under the feet of the people at the bar...he/she belongs there and basically ignores everyone he/she don't know.

My husband and I absolutely love Terri's Cafe. The food portion size is bigger than most breakfast and lunch spots for the same amount of money that others charge.Terri's is also consistent with the way there food tastes and is cooked.I love a GOOD cup of coffee hince not the cheap stuff, they also give you the choice of flavored creamers not to mention a big coffee cup. I get tired of asking for coffee warm ups every 2 seconds because most restaurants have such small cups.Terri's Cafe is consistently good food, good coffee,for a good price$$

We bought a rhino sewer hose and it broke when we tried to put it on our RV. I took it to the CW in Meridian to exchange it. I waited in line for 10 minutes only to have the cashier tell me I couldn't exchange it. When I questioned this she told me I would have to talk to the manager. I then waited another 10 minutes in line to talk to the manager. He said no problem -- so I went and got the replacement and went back to the cashier to do the exchange. She acted my miffed that I was there. HORRIBLE CUSTOMER SERVICE.

We visited their new storefront, excited to try it out. The staff was incredibly nice and helpful, and the food was ok. The price seems high for the size of the cone. My husband and kids complained about being hungry when we left. There was not much seating in this location.

I'm so happy we tried Simmons Jewelry. We were approached by Shannon Opfer, she is professional, warm hearted and had our best interest in mind at all times. We are currently having a new custom engagement ring be made by Simmons now. If you're looking for a jeweler you can trust, give Simmons Jeweler, and Shannon a try.

Green Leaf seems to be a franchise. I've used them in different cities and the results have always been superior. I mostly use them for starched shirts and men's clothes. 

When I moved to Boise I tried a couple of different local chains in downtown that had high reviews. Choice was based on location honestly. Those cleaners were nice enough, but failed to starch my shirts (I gave each shop three tries). I even asked for heavy starch and the shirts still came back like I just pulled them out of the dryer. 

Green Leaf is a little out of my way, but worth it! My shirts are clean and starched. The store is immaculate by the way. Very nice location. 

I'll continue to use them.

I really wanted to not like the whole pizza cone idea. But after trying one (can't knock it till you try it!) I've been hooked. I was so excited when the truck became a restaurant as well. The only reason I don't give 5 stars is that the price seems a little up there. That being said it has hardly ever kept me away. This is absolutely something I recommend trying!

I had the Southwest Chicken wrap and asked for no tomatoes, and what they brought was some finely chopped super dry chicken with lettuce wrapped in a tortilla.  
And my son said his chicken strips tasted like pickles.
Food is mediocre at best. Shakes and slushes are good. I'm underwhelmed by the whole experience.

Great place to get a car wash and detail.  Service people were wonderful.  They were efficient, courteous and made my car look fantastic.  There is a stir that sells drinks and snacks along with tons of other things that I didn't even know I needed.  They also gave my dog a biscuit.  PET FRIENDLY. I will be back.

Always the best prices and products. I always shop around but end up buying from Home Depot.

They have reviews and recommendations on their website too. 

The store in Meridian has free classes too. 

If you are a veteran ask for the 10% discount.

This is another nice addition to the Meridian Village.  We tried Backstage this past weekend on a Sunday.  Not too many people dining that evening, but just as well as it was our first visit and we needed a bit of orienting.  We first were led to a booth, but opted out after we noticed a small table with circular seats---there were four of us.  We finally were seated at a table for four.  

On to the food:  My husband and I shared an arugula salad--ample and very good with a light vinaigrette.   The main course was horseradish encrusted salmon with red flannel hash, a mix of diced beets and potatoes.  Delicious!   One in our party had the lemon chicken with some shoestring potatoes and enjoyed that.  Dessert was profiteroles(cream puffs) filled with vanilla ice cream and chocolate sauce.  Excellent!  The other couple shared a rich chocolate cake and pronounced that to be yummy!  They cleaned the plate!

My only complaint and it's a minor one because I do love movies, is that there are previews shown on a screen on the wall near the staircase.  There is no avoiding it.  There's no sound but it is a distraction if you're trying to have a conversation.   On the other hand it was fun to see what upcoming movies are being shown here at the cinema!
Great neighborhood pub atmosphere. Patrons we're friendly and the bartender, Anna, was PERFECT. Great drinks and good food. We'll be back.
So, I was pushed to pay for my coffee by the Cashier before I was able to order food and then the line was 20 people long. While I loved my coffee it seems like she could have switched registers?

Lol well I should have went with my co workers suggestion and went to L's.  I go to Home Depot normally for everything, because I watch YouTube and consider myself a house renovator, DIYer.  I needed new flooring, the house I live in was built in 1992.  I wanted carpet in the bed rooms, tile in the bathroom, and vinyl in the main living area.  I picked out "Seasoned Wood" for vinyl, "Home Decorators Collection (San Rafael II)" for carpet.  The employees in the store are always very friendly.  The flooring desk gal was way patient with me and helpful, and finally we got a time set for the installers to come out.

The measurement, "Home Depot" employee, was off setting from the get go.  I asked if he knew the actual installers and if they were good at installing.  He laughed and said "that depends", not very reassuring.  He said I can't guarantee their work, or who will install the product.

7 hours later an Austin, Tx number called confirming that our measurements went through.  I worked with the confirmation measurement lady for 53 min, making sure everything was perfect.  She sent one confirmation email, and I realized we would take out all the old flooring ourselves (the pic attached was the first confirmation before the final changes) so, again we needed to change a few things.  The last hallway I was trying to correct took the gal over her shift hours she was scheduled to work..... Bc she hung up on me lol before the 2nd finalization.  I waited 3 min for her to call back and then I called her.  The automated system said that their "call center is currently closed".  I'll be going somewhere else to get flooring.

Food was bland after I ate the crab Rangoon and the butterfly shrimp I felt very sick. The ice cream was refrigerated instead of freezed. The waiter was very disrespectful she seemed very rude and edgy with children. Overall I hated the experience. And will definetly won't be coming back.

Look this place is amazing, and it's the best Ramen in Boise. If you're expecting everything to be 100% perfect you might be disappointed, but if you like Ramen and are looking for a cool spot downtown to eat at, this place rocks. 

If you have unrealistic standards and like to complain about tiny things, maybe you wont enjoy it.

I was there in the Spring with a friend for breakfast and they were fast, food was fresh and well prepared. It was very good. They have many healthy options for the health conscious but have the sweet stuff too. I really appreciate a reassurance that has good fresh fruit that isn't oils chopped cantaloupe and a strawberry. They had fresh blueberries and strawberries that were very good! Not frozen out of a bag. The place was very clean and cute. They top Kneaders in the cleanliness department by 4.5 stars!

Not impressed with the customer service. Guy was a jerk! I just wanted what everyone was having and he was difficult and wouldn't help me. Looked like he was trying to impress my girl with his knowledge but instead he offended both of us with his comments. I actually walked out and will maybe try this in Boise but as for the Meridian  one. NEVER!!!! Good luck! This guy needs a class on the customer is always right....just go with it.
This place is now closed, but was one of the absolute best places to eat in the entire states. Momo's- we will miss you!
Amazing food! Asian husband very satisfied. Takoyaki! Going to be a must stop every time we come up to Boise area.

This review is solely based on the delivery service. I have ordered food to be delivered on several occasions and I have always found it to be hot, fresh, and delicious. They are so flexible with custom orders and the drivers have all been very courteous.

Brand new location and my brand new favorite spot to quickly caffienate.  As my tastes in coffee have changed somewhat, I have found my old favorite Dutch Bros to be just way too sweet.  On the other end of the spectrum, I find most Starbucks varieties to be either too bitter, or more like milk shakes.  Human Bean really hits that balance for me.  Heh, I almost said "sweet spot" but that would have been somewhat misleading.  Not only that but they make a very good Mexican Mocha, which has become my "go to" drink when I do go out for coffee.

I also have to say I really like the vibe at Human Bean.  They are every bit as friendly (if not more so) than the very peppy baristas at your typical Dutch Bros, but you don't get the loud, pounding music that can sometimes be more distracting than anything.  All the folks I've encountered at Human Bean locations have been very friendly and helpful, and I haven't had to shout to get my order across.

Bottom line folks, if you haven't already, give these guys a try.  I think you will be pleasantly surprised.

Great place. Servers were super nice in that laid back way that makes you wish they'd sit down and have a beer with you. They even remembered my name after telling them just once. Very cool.

I told them I liked Shocktop and was immediately offered a taste of a beer on tap that was similar and that I loved. I drank two of them.

In keeping with the theme of quality, the menu was fantastic. I debated between about 10 things before I finally chose the Zeke's pizza which was quite possibly the best pizza I've ever had...and I just got back from Italy, so that's saying something! The sauce was spicy and it was covered in a lush blanket of basil that I haven't seen on a pizza since I made one myself. To top it off, the pizza was so hot and fresh I had to let it cool before I dug in. No heat lamps here. 

Sitting outside listening to good music and enjoying the surroundings I knew I'd found a new spot in Boise. Can't wait for the next business trip!

I get the same drink all the time and it tastes absolutely different every time I go there. Rather go out of my way to Dutch Bros. The staff is super sweet and though and there's usually little to no line

Great food, fun atmosphere, and ecellent service. A place where, when you finish your meal, you're happy you ate there. I had the ham steak, hashbrown casserole, and carrots and it was excellent. The rest in my party loved their meals as well, will return again.
This breakfast place is amazing! Very much worth the wait. I don't think there is a bad hing on the menu!

I'm more and disappointed in the quality of food.  My salad today looked like they didn't have enough ingredients and just threw it together and poorly I might add.  If not for the bakery I problem might not come back.

Love this place. Always friendly service. I go in during the day, and manager is always friendly.  He always jumps in where needed whether it's cooking,serving or clearing tables.
Great food. Great severs. Great atmosphere.

We pulled into the Meridian KOA to find that our weight distribution system had Broken at the chassis.  For some reason and in spite of driving right by it on freeway, Camping World was not top of mind for a fix.  After more than half a dozen attempts on Sunday and Memorial Day morning I called and spoke to Jeremy who was professional and quick on his feet.   Said come on over and we will take a look.  He and service mgr Scott quickly assessed that it was fixable but would take a custom solution.  Both were positive, confidant and kind.   In less than two hours we were back on the road to Yellowstone and our vacation was saved.  Thank you Jeremy, Scott and the whole service team at Camping World!     You will be top of mind going forward.
Great job detailing my SUV with months of use from three little ones and many road trips. Wasn't busy so I was in and out on a hot summer afternoon.

I personally love this place. Being that I exercise a lot, this place is perfect for the lazy takeout of your dreams. They also drive around in a food truck sometimes

The food is the essence of copious, and not to the point of where the tastiness subsides. You have a choice of 1-10 on spiciness. I usually go 8, and the taste isn't compromised. If you're masochistic, go for 10.

And this place is super duper cheap. The double whammy of my stomach says: bring this place closer to Boise (rather than Eagle...)

I get the same drink all the time and it tastes absolutely different every time I go there. Rather go out of my way to Dutch Bros. The staff is super sweet and though and there's usually little to no line.

I think they do good work but they are short staffed and the wait times are ridiculous!  Please don't tell me 15 minutes and then make me wait 45. I've tried making a reservation and still had the same experience.

Overall pretty tasty. Each item was well-seasoned and not overpowering. The momos are pretty small and have maybe only 1/2 to 3/4 of a tablespoon of meat each (i.e., just enough to taste). 
I do not agree with the hidden charge for the yak "momos" (they charged us a hidden 80 cents extra just for selecting yak for ONE of the 5 momos on each of the two plates I ordered).  Fine, charge more for exotic meat. I get it. But the above circumstances came across as unfair. I might come back, but not for a while.

Just happened to wander by on a trip back to Oregon and decided to give it a try. Very tasty! And quite healthy as well. Rare to see a brown rice option at most restaurants. They turkey MO MO was very good, as we're the other meat options. The black Eyed Peas were scrumptious as well. Not greasy and very satisfying. I will come here again if I am in town. Makes me curious to try other Himalayan cooking.

Corner Bakery Cafe is a great place to get yummy soups or a fresh salad. They have great lemonades. And without hardly mentioning it, they brought over a free chocolate-drizzled mini bundt brownie for my mom's birthday.

This place is great! I had previously gone to another nail salon two weeks prior and they did a terrible job. I decided to grow them out, get them off and then new ones put back on. This place is literally right down the street from me so the convenience part is definitely there. I had Billy take my nails off and he is by far the BEST person for doing this! I am a huge baby about getting acrylics off because I feel like some salons just rip them off and it hurts. Well Billy was very gentle and it didn't hurt at all. My nails look so much better- the length, the shape, the color. He took his time and I appreciate it. Thank you so much! I will definitely be back.

CupBop is a Chipotle/Qdoba style "Korean" food.  You have a few different meats to choose from (spicy pork is the most flavorful in my opinion), served in a bowl with rice, noodles, and your choice of cabbage or spinach.  You can choose a spice level by number which correlates what sauces are drizzled on top.  

If you are looking for authentic korean BBQ then this is NOT it.  I enjoy truly authentic ethnic foods including Korean BBQ and Korean tacos so obviously this Americanized version of "Korean BBQ" was very disappointing.  I was excited to try it as it came recommended from friends but I won't be returning.

This is a new restaurant but somehow they managed to make it feel like a dive. The outside is shiny and clean, but the inside is dim and feels cheap. They have several TVs throughout the restaurant that play advertisements non-stop. The price was ridiculous! We paid around $12 per person for the buffet which didn't even include a drink. The food selection was abysmal. To top it all off, both my wife and I became ill that evening. The staff weren't friendly. There's not a single redeeming quality about this place.

I've given this location several opportunities to change my mind. But every time i come they disappoint me. I'm a pretty basic coffee drinker, just a basic java chip trap is what I get each time and every time they have made it has been terrible. From a compete mess covering my hands in chocolate to completely watery, or flat no chocolate. The only reason I even placed two stars is because of a funny gentleman running the drive threw admitting his faults and making it laughable. The rest of the staff I've dealt with im lucky if they even make eye contact with me and I'm a pretty friendly person so I'm surprised.

This was a great experience, very relaxing and the staff were super polite. A bit of a language barrier but that didn't affect my experience.  My companion and I chose a sea-salt foot soak before the massage; this took about 10 min. The other 30 minutes were spent getting the most thorough foot massage of my life! I definitely felt relaxed and pampered. They were able to accommodate my same day appointment. We were given full size water bottles when we left, very nice!

Went to order to go about 20 min ago. Never had eaten there before so I decided to try it out. Ended up ordering the kids burgers for my boys, and ordered the Kobe beef sliders and came back burnt. If you know how to cook, you don't burn Kobe beef, or any burger. Needless to say I will never eat there again one of the worst places and waste of money.
Caramel Macchiato? Not even close, just tasted like white chocolate milk. 16oz for $4.03 - drank it within 10 minutes and it's barely the size of my hand..

First time having their burgers and we were very impressed. You can tell that the meat doesn't have fillers and that the fries have not been frozen. 
Staff is very friendly, but not obnoxiously so. They were quick to greet us and offer help and samples. 
So many frozen yogurt choices that it is hard to choose. The topping choices are plentiful and the bar area was kept very clean. 
Overall, very good and we will be back.
We had the best car buying experience ever at Carmax.  No pressure, cheerful staff, quality cars, and our salesman George was timely, honest, and knowledgeable.  The best

I loved this place! The customer service was great and so was the mechanic! I had went to another place for an oil change and for some reason they couldn't reach the spot to get my power steering fluid filled. So they sent me to Bobbys to get the job done. I was very irritated about the whole situation but am so grateful that I went here and they took care of me in about 5 minutes. The mechanic had an out of the box solution to reach my power steering fluid and it worked magically. I highly recommend Bobbys Transmission!

Very disappointed in this location's quality. I usually go to the Boise location but moved to meridian so figured quality would be the same. Was I wrong. They didn't vacuum the inside, there is dirt still all over the car, the rims didn't even get wiped down. For $25 plus tip I guess I was expecting a little better service. Safe to say will not be returning here to this location.
Had a great foot massage at this location. Very nice staff and clean establishment. Definitely worth $30 for 60 minutes. I will return.

Normally we have great service but today we had reservations for 1 pm for Mothers Day and they had 4 other booked for 1 pm. We had to wait about and hour. They didn't even acknowledge that we had reservations. I am not sure they even scheduled any of us. We could of gladly done another time when we called for reservations! Pedicures are suppose to be relaxing my pedicure wasn't gentle more painful.
Best coffee in the world and the owner is thee best and super polite and generous and hilarious. Great price highly recommend it

Overall my experience was okay. Not bad, not great, just okay. I ordered a London fog and surprisingly there wasn't any vanilla in it like a traditional London fog, so when I got home I had to sweeten it myself. I also ordered a cinnamon roll which was very average for the price (again I was surprised by this because a lot of the reviews on here say the food is great). I am new to the area and haven't tried any other local coffee shops but I just don't see myself going back to this one.
