We frequent the Rudys on the south side of town and always have an amazing time. We just stumbled across the N Meridian location this evening on our date night. Food was ok, lettuce wraps were awful. But the service was the worst. If you need anything after your food comes, you'd better be ready to walk and ask for it. Love you Rudy's don't love these waitresses....

I took my iPhone in to have the screen replaced. A few days later I went back to let them know I was having intermittent issues. The young gentleman told me unless the phone was acting up so he could see it there was nothing he could do. I stressed to him that I was a on call pilot and the importance of my phone. He told me he was getting off in a hour and once again there was nothing he could do. Meanwhile he had a friend in the back room with a baby that he wanted to get back to visiting and that I clearly was holding him up. A few days later when my iPhone was acting up I took it in to the store manager (Tyler) he took it in the back and replaced the screen. Tyler had another employee bring my phone out to me with no apology or explanation. I got into my car and realized my screen had a low color tone to it :( also when I make a call people say I sound like I'm in the restroom. I've emailed the company with my explanation and still have not heard back. I'm completely disappointed in not only the repair but the customer service!!!!!!!!
I love tcby. Best frozen yogurt around, we go year round if it's 80 or 8 degrees outside! Great flavors to pick from and they even have sugar free flavors.

I had high hopes for CenturyLink, after being told they were good internet provider. First of all, we contracted them at one rate and were billed at another with additional fees not mentioned during signing. They guys who signed us up actually told us that the wireless router sucks and we should probably buy a better one. Then we had to wait two weeks for a "technician to come out and hook it up." TWO WEEKS?!?! Without internet? Gimme a break! Then when the time came and went (and several calls and promises that "Someone would be there") for our hook up, someone FINALLY tells us, "Oh, you should have service now. No one has to come hook it up, we turn it on from here." WHAT?!?! WHY DID I HAVE TO WAIT TWO WEEKS FOR SOMEONE TO FLIP A SWITCH?!?!? Several issues occurred during our service, such as added fees, the requirement to sign up for two things online to get the promised price, all of this at the disruption of normal life, which is hectic enough. In the event of a move, we were told that no fees or secrets awaited us to move the service. Until it came time to move and we were THEN told we needed to renew our contract?!? Then we got the runaround at the call center, were passed between several people who were "looking up our info" and were kept on hold for over 90 minutes. Eventually my phone died and I haven't talked myself down enough to have a reason able conversation with their reps. Plus I don't want to be on hold for another hour. The one positive mention is that the service provided wasn't bad, which is the only reason I have refrained from using bad words in this review. I have worked in customer service for several years and if I treated people the way we have been treated, I'd have been FIRED. Pick it up, CenturyLink.
Their staff is always really nice and helpful. Great place for drinks! But the quality of food does not even come close to matching their high prices

When we went in, there wasn't an employee in sight, despite the fact that there was only one other occupied table in the entire place. We stood and waited for seven minutes until someone finally emerged from the kitchen to seat us. 

My husband ordered the fried chicken, and it was hands-down the worst fried chicken ever. The consistency of the breading was nice, but it clearly hadn't been seasoned, not even lightly. 

The drinks from the bar were alright, but I wasn't impressed by the server and the bartender leaning on the bar, chatting with each other, and looking at their cell phones. If they have time to socialize and text, they should have time to wait on customers.
來到Boise 一個禮拜終於吃到比較好吃的亞洲食物啦 如果不想一直吃美式喝濃湯Raman Sho 是你的好選擇 miso raman湯頭味道適中不會太鹹，如果喜歡重口味一點的可以再加點辣椒，風味更佳
The food here was delish and generous. We had the ribs and the combo platter.  The ribs were perfectly cooked and seasoned with tasty fries.  The combo platter was tender and flavorful.
Great options, staff and selection! There's just MORE of what they have in the downtown location. Happy to be a member with healthy choices, community involvement and local variety.

We ordered the Tonkatsu and the Curry Tonkatsu.  Both were very good, the broth is rich and delicious, which is the best part about a good ramen.  We also ordered the pan fried gyoza, which had a nice fresh ginger flavor.  All was very good.

Delicious food--our orders were the blue plate special and turkey biscuits--and friendly service. Portions were generous. Spiced watermelon, cole slaw, grits, and fries as sides were at least as tasty as the fried chicken and little biscuit and turkey sandwiches. We will be back for more!

When my wife Darla and I want to spend a relaxed evening and share a great meal with friends we are pretty picky.
Needless to say we had a marvelous time at the Backstage Bistro.   The food was excellent and the service couldn't have been better.  
Thanks Backstage Bistro.   We will see you again soon.

Worst customer service ever. Ordered online, got a two year old that we didn't want to wrestle and ruin other peoples dinner. Somehow if you order online you are second class and won't be helped. They kept telling me my dinner was cooking never even asking my name. Long story short it was ready the whole time. No one would even talk to me for more than a second once they found out I was waiting on a to go order.

They changed their menu! :(

I recently visited Brewforia and they've taken a bunch if items off their menu. It's mainly salads and a few craft breads. I ordered the Zeke's craftbread and it was just mediocre. I don't think I'll be back.
Buffet was bland. Cream cheese Rangoon's didn't seem to even have cream cheese in it. My sons cheese cake was frozen. Will never be back.

Waste of money and time. They think a car wash and spray sticky shinny crap all over is a deal. They didn't even bother vacuum around the back seat. When I brought it back he said "looks good enough ".

Went here this morning for breakfast. 
Was not impressed at all. The food was upscale Denney's is what my friend called it. 
Not one person on the waitstaff smiled or asked how the meal was.
Bursting with taste, Coned is quick, delicious and delectable. Great for families too.

The place is very nice.  However, the service was very lack luster, there seemed to be no organization, the food was over priced and the food was...average.  When we arrived the hostess was gossiping with some girls and had her back to us for a lengthy amount of time before one of the girls told her we were there.  She sat us at a table right by an open door (it was not warm tonight) and so we sat there shivering and nobody seemed to notice.  

Then a young man came to our table and filled our glasses...not saying  anything for quite some time.  He asked us if we wanted anything and we had decided what we wanted and told him.  He took off.  We had no idea if he was our waiter or not.  Then a lady came to our table to double check our order and it was incorrect, so luckily that was resolved.  

While we waited for our food, we noticed the hostess darted to the kitchen for some reason and seconds later, a family came to the podium, stood there for about 5 minutes waiting for someone to notice them and turned around and left.

I ordered the panko salmon.  It had so much dill and parsley, I couldn't taste the salmon or the panko crust.  My husband had chicken strips, it was the smallest appetizer I've ever seen.

I am all about second chances. So, I'm hoping that if I come back, its better.

The daycare itself is decent but the staff is awful.  Constant turnover.  The teachers aren't friendly.  My daughter has gone there for almost two years and I think her teacher has said maybe five words to me in that time.  The office staff is incredibly rude (when there's actually someone there) and not helpful at all.

I really hate to write bad reviews, but very now and then. There is a need to say that the food was just bad. My chicken was so rubbery it tasted microwaved and perhaps cooked in old grease. The rice was flavorless. The Rangoon (1 piece) was good. The service was pleasant but after "hello" we had no further interaction. Won't be back.
Kids and I love CupBop as a quick and easy take home dinner. It's always the B-Bop for me and my son. Tip and they tip you back ;)
One of our Favorites! Great Philly Cheese steak! Ice cold Draft Coors Light and ACE Pear Cider! Very refreshing!

We've had Meridian great wall of China delivery before and love it!  This time I called it in for a to go order. Apparently they have the same number for both restaurants on their main website, so it took me to The restaurant that is not close to me. I put in my order,  they told me 30 minute wait and it would be ready. I showed up at the one close to me and of course they didn't have my order because I was at the wrong one. They were very polite and called the other restaurant to cancel my order but the other restaurant said that they did not even have an order under my name! I'm so glad the Meridian Great Wall of China took care of me and they rushed my to go order! Great customer service!

At the end of the day these guys have the typical gym rat mafia mentality you find everywhere you go. They tout themselves as a unique, neighborhood gym but only want the CONTRACT and AUTO PAY - just like all the other gyms. Here's my take: if you're going to get locked into a contract and be subject to dealing with meat head service regardless of where you go, then why not spend your dollars at a name brand gym where you can get the same exact thing but at least have legitimate equipment and classes in a room bigger than a broom closet? Just saying.

These rascals set me up on a "month to month" contract. I notified them that I had moved out of the area and would not be renewing the next month. Apparently, verbal notification wasn't good enough. Even after notification in writing they still keep trying to auto draft the monthly dues and have now resorted to collections. Nice.

I'm not disgruntled. I get it. Times are tough and your small time gym needs my $19 to keep the lights on, but collections?? Comical. Body Renew is Junior Varsity 'B' Team, at best.

My wife and I ended up going here because the two Thai restaurants we tried to go to in the late afternoon were both closed until dinner. Having said that, I'm glad that we did. The employees were friendly and welcoming, the service was reasonably fast, and the food was good. I had their chicken teriyaki bowl and an order of gyoza, and my wife had the tofu teriyaki bowl.

The gyoza were pretty good for a prepackaged and heated product, as was the sauce for them. The teriyaki sauce was delicious, and the chicken was cooked well and of good quality -- I didn't have any difficult-to-chew pieces. The veggies, on the other hand, were limp and didn't really appeal a lot.

My wife also noticed that the cost per gyoza was actually higher for the 6-piece order (at $6.29, ~$1.05/gyoza) than the 4-piece order ($3.99, ~$.99/gyoza). 

Overall we enjoyed our visit and will likely go back again, but the quality of the veggies in our bowls is what kept me from giving this a 5-star review.

I'm happy to see a local coffee shop break into the scene in suburban Boise so that I can continue to avoid Starbucks. I believe they have 3 locations in the area so they are locally owned, but they don't quite have all of the character and charm as a single independent coffee shop that you will find downtown.  What they do provide is an excellent space for me to come in and work, which I do often. Previous reviewer said their coffee is watered down but I have not had that experience. They offer both almond and  coconut milk (bonus for you Paleo addicts), and while limited, there are a few food options if you need a caloric fix.  When I am in town I generally have at least one work day a week from this spot so they must be doing something right. :)

Today was my first visit to Denny's since they updated the interior. I was impressed by the look but the feel does not make the grade. I am 6'2 and 220 lbs and the new booths have the seats so close to the table that it was nearly impossible for me to squeeze in and out and legroom was close to zero. The booth tables are very small and I would hate to even attempt to seat more than 2 people per booth.  Overall, it was so uncomfortable that it overshadowed both the above average food and the fantastic service from Danielle T. and it's unlikely I will return soon.
Bought a new camper from them, had to have it worked on 4 times before even using it once. When you pay 40,000$ for a new camper it should not have to be worked on.

Ouch. Glad I'm not the only one to have experienced this place on the bad side. We ordered from them based on the fact that they deliver. I'm just going to focus on the Mongolian Beef. There was...no beef. I literally counted like 5 pieces in the carton. And then it was the same grade as you'd get at a Mongolian BBQ. The bamboo shoots were tough, like recycled asphalt shingles marinated in MSG. The fried rice and chow mein were passable, barely. Order from them if you must, but buyer beware, the food is just not very good.

I don't know how the Idaho Statesman named this place the best food at the village?  Maybe the reviewer just smoked a big dubbie. Tried a couple of times and the food is just not that good.  Cold fries, tasteless and dry burger and my wife's entree was uninspired.
The bistro was not busy while other restaurants were packed.  The theory of if a restaurant is not busy...the odds are that the food is not good.
I will give credit to very good service.
I suggest Twigs or Kona Grill over the Bistro at the village in Meridian.

This was my first time here before going to a movie. The service was good and the menu looked interesting.  

We had the mozzarella spring rolls which would have been great except the cheese was still solid on the inside and the marinara sauce was a bit runny and bland.

My wife had the French dip sandwich which was underwhelming it was edible but I've had better at subway. I had the fish and chips which were thin and over cooked with a bland tarter sauce closer to sour cream than tarter. 

I will probably give them another chance next time around but with so many option within 50 ft, it will probably be my last choice in the village square.
The Pecan Crusted French Toast with Bacon Caramel Sauce was to die for!! The service was great and it was the perfect place for two busy moms to grab a few quiet moments.
My fav specialty grocer in Treasure Valley! If they could stock Sierra Nevada Cheese Co., my praises will be off the charts!

Love Brewforia for their extensive selection of gluten free beers and ciders. Not very often when I can go into a bar and order multiple types of beers! Wish they had some gluten free food options to go with the gf beers though. Otherwise this place is great.

Backstage Bistro has one strong point - outside seating. The last couple of visits, we also had good service and appetizers... and the drinks are OK. Sat inside only once and everything I had on smelled of popcorn so strong that it came off in the laundry room. Have to take a star off for that.
Worst buffet in town from the selection, quality, and decor. Same price as others in the area and not even close in comparison.

Love this place. Fresh food that is a change from the norm. I never leave hungry, but don't feel like I need a nap after either. Great restaurant! If you like different types of food and haven't tried this one yet.

Rudy's is one of our Favorites! Great service, Ice Cold Beer and the best Philly Cheese steak sandwich! Love the deep fried Tater tots and Fry sauce! Love this place! Love Sade too! Great waitress! Thanks Guys!
Love this place, decently priced, delicious pizza and nice people! When I'm in a pinch and I don't want to spend a bunch of money I just come here and get a delicious classic pepperoni cone

The food is quite good. The burger was definitely fresh and yummy. The fried chicken was also quite good. I love that the meat is local. We will be back to try more things. The only suggestion is to offer more local beers on tap.

We were on a little weekend fun session for the kids before school starts back home in Bend, Oregon. So I go out for some supplies and and a sixer of the beloved fermented nectar. Coming from the microbrew capital of the world, I settle for the usual fair found at the grocery store. Satisfied with my goods I drove back to the hotel and entered through an alternate ingress only to find "Brewforia" right in the same patch of macadam as the hotel NO WAY!! Huge selection of brew, pub grub and lovely staff to help you if you don't know what's up! Brewforia is a literal oasis of brew in an otherwise desert of real breweries. 90 different beers all expertly displayed in wood  cases or the wonderful wall of refrigerated cold cases. The genius of Brewforia however is that the business is set up as a "beer market" so you can stay and play or load and go! Drink & eat there or take you beer out in a sack back to the hotel (or home) BRILLIANT!

Will never use again and would not recommend. Had them come out to quote moving kitchen plumbing from south side of kitchen to east side of kitchen and to move bathroom plumbing approximately 1 foot over in a remodel, i felt the price was reasonable ($2000) and the plumber was friendly and seemed knowledgeable. After he was finished the plumbing was not in the correct places, things done that we didnt ask for, a brand new vanity was ruined, there was water under the house, insulation pulled down and not put back up (failed on inspection by potential home buyer), all the old piping was left under the house, and trash thrown in our recycle can. I was angry but my spouse was more angry, after a few days of calming down i contacted them and asked for a manager to come see the issues and the lady on the phone tried to tell me that they didnt know if their guy had ruined the vanity (brand new out of the box the night before plumbing was moved and in a vacant home) i told her i did. The owner came out and spoke with my spouse, he agreed to replace the vanity and to have someone fix the other issues. Sent the same guy out, then a few days later when he came out to do the finishing touches he tried to tell me that we damaged the rings that go around the pipe that he had installed originally and then had to remove to fix what was wrong and that he wasnt planning to replace them and then replaced them with incorrect pieces, he left the water running in my yard when he left. When i sent the receipt for reimbursement for having to buy another new vanity i asked for the owner to contact me back and he never did, after a few weeks i called to inquire about whether or not they were going to reimburse me and i was told by the owner in an extremely unprofessional manner that the check was already mailed and when i inquired where they sent the check it was to the remodel address where no one lives and where mail doeant get delivered and the owner tried to imply it was my fault they sent the check to that address. My spouse thought the owner was pleasant, however i do not feel the same, i was not treated with courtesy or respect even though i allowed them to try to correct the issues. Beware.
Great place for good coffee and conversation. The staff are very friendly and make great java!

The best part....it is Interesting and different and the staff is friendly and helpful. Now to the food, the meat has been over cooked all 3 times I've gone. I like the novelty of everything being in a cup but with that said, everything piled on top of each other makes quite a mess of food with no individual flavors.  I would give it 3.5 stars.
Nice ramen!  I wish it was closer than Boise but the team is professional and the ramen is good.  If you are in Boise go buy and order some ramen!

DON'T do it please, Panda express has better food and service. Every bite of chicken was horrible. who knows what was really deep fried in their shrimp. Went in and didn't even finish our first plate, was asked how everything was and we told them horrible. The food was awful, the reply "Oh I'm sorry here is your bill". Went to McDoonalds afterwards to wash that taste away

There are Tuesday specials you can combine with a $5 movie at the Village. They have happy hour from 4-6 and a varied menu, from hamburgers to shrimp scsmpi and salmon, to a roast beef dip. The. Appetizers included meat and cheese,platter, a hummus and flat bread tray and great fries.   They also have a full bar.  Be prepared to stay awhile, as the service csn be a bit slow.

The food was good, but they were short handed and the manager yelled at our waitress where everyone in the restaurant could hear them. She also told a complaining customer that she was in the back cooking, but she had her hair down below her shoulders

After having lived in Japan for two months, I can't handle bad ramen. This place is amazing. Authentic, flavorful, delicious ramen. Also, the karaage (Japanese fried chicken) is to die for.  When I want to revisit memories of Japanese flavors, I come here. It's the most authentic Japanese place in town. So delicious!!
These guys are laser focused on giving the customer a great tasting experience. The best part is when you get to the bottom. It a mozzarella stick!

Thank you, thank you, thank you for having gluten free options! I have a child with celiac disease and that makes eating out extremely hard. Bonus points that she loved the food! My bowl (BBQ Beef) was delicious and the employees were super helpful in explaining everything for us first timers.

We popped into Backstage Bistro before a Saturday night flick (about 5:30pm) and found it surprisingly empty. Also, surprisingly classy. I felt a little under dressed! 

I was with a small group of gals who opted to sit on the balcony -- not the best decision, in my opinion, due to the 90 degree weather. However, the view is awesome. There are a few couches outside, one of which surrounds (what I'm assuming is) a glass fire pit and some very cool string lights. It would be such a neat spot to hang out for the night. When we sat down, they turned on the misters that wrapped around the railing, something I greatly appreciated! One of my girlfriends, however, didn't appreciated getting a face full of water (understandable, seeing as she was all dolled up) and asked they be turned off (we were the only crazy ones sitting outside). For some reason, it took 10 minutes of them turning them off and on before they finally died down completely. 

The prices are a little steep, but I suppose they fit the Village's vibe and the restaurant's atmosphere. The food though? O-M-G! So good!!!! Great, even!! I had the Chicken Club and it was to-die for. Everyone at the table was extremely satisfied. One of the girls got a caprese salad and the smell of the pesto overwhelmed the table, in a 100% good way!

I probably would have give 5 stars if it weren't for the lacking customer service. The mister incident combined with lackluster service left for some sort of docking.
Love this place! Great happy hour specials on both food and drinks with happy hour starting a little earlier in the evenings than average.

Super frustrated today!  Paid $15 for my car wash and vacuum - they took me out to my car and there was still crumbs, bits of grass and dirt on the carpet on the drivers side.  I pointed this out to the girl and she took my car to be re-vacuumed.  Came back with the majority of the stuff still there!  I have black carpet, so it's pretty easy to see where you've missed.  Didn't have time to stay for a 3rd round , and doubted it would have helped.  I'll do it myself next time!

Okay service. Ya have to watch the kids doing the work. I paid for a full service car wash, the interior of my car wasn't wiped down and there were drips all over the paint. Fast service, though. Not the best, not the worst.
Fried chicken with waffles and spiced watermelon was very delicious!! Nice stuff and nice interiour! Will be back here many times!

Our experience with the service here was so extensively terrible, it's hard to get it all down.  Suffice to say, between the service taking so much longer than they quoted us that it delayed our camping trip, and finding out AFTER our blow out on the freeway that all of our new tires had been mis-installed, and THEN finding out that they had OUTSOURCED our RV work to ANOTHER tire shop in Boise and charged us retail Camping World prices... we will not be returning.  Dishonest, shoddy, expensive work.  Not impressed, Camping World.  NOT.  IMPRESSED.
Cute 50's style diner, delicious fresh squeezed mimosas, and AMAZING Eggs Benedict! 5 varieties available. The 4 of us tried four different ones and they were all yummy!

We came here for lunch, the food was great! Got the black bean burger and the sweet bbq chicken sandwich, both with the house cut fries (which were awesome and of a generous portion). Costs about $20 for two to eat, with each person getting fries and a drink with their burger.  I would definitely recommend at least trying this place out, the staff was very friendly and the food was delicious.

Poor customer service and overall an unorganized store in meridian. Be aware that if you do purchase anything the sales guy will tell you that there is no refunds and if they do give you a refund be prepared to pay 20% restocking fee. What got me irate was how I was treated as a customer, I felt as if they would rather make a sell of any kind rather than fixing the overall issue. Potentially I may have had a bad experience but if I wanted to return an item I wish they had disclosed information about all sales being final rather than having a sneaky sign behind the counter stating their policies. I appreciate good customer service and unfortunately they failed to deliver.
Most of the hair stylists know what they are doing, especially the guy (good for male haircuts). Very friendly group, never have to wait too long. Ask for Kieanna if you want a color. She's a pro.

This used to be our favorite go to breakfast spot... over the years we've spent hundreds if not thousands of dollars here. Brought all of our family here while in town and have two separate loyalty/reward cards. 
Today we were turned away for being 3mins late for modified hours relating to Labor Day. We have a 1 year old and it takes a little longer to get out of a vehicle and walk through a parking lot. 

So we walked across the parking lot and were gladly welcomed into the new sunrise cafe by majestic. 

Not another dollar from myself or any family members will go to The Griddle in Meridian.

Meh. It's decent, but not amazing.  The food was fairly good, but again, not the most amazing I've ever had.  The potatoes were nicely seasoned and not as dry as they looked, but the eggs were definitely dry. 

The customer service was not good.  It wasn't horrendous either though.  The staff were more indifferent than anything.  

I do give them kudos for using Mighty Leaf teas.  Mighty Leaf is an awesome brand of whole leaf tea in these cute woven silk-like tea bags.  I really do enjoy the tea.  

Overall, not the most amazing place, but a decent place to go for a mediocre breakfast on a Sunday morning. :)
Best food in Meridian!!! Everyone needs to try it!!!!! So happy to finally find good southern food in Idaho!!!

It's never easy to leave your child in the care of others but my son, with special needs thrived in this environment. Mrs Fatima is amazing with the kiddos and the owner, Mrs Susan is warm and caring paying close attention to every detail. Not to mention the playground and yard is ENORMOUS! Oh, and it helps when the children think they're walking in to a castle.
We love cupbob! The staff is really friendly and helpful, and the food is amazing! The pork is especially tasty!

While traveling through Idaho with our fifth wheel, the brakes failed and we were forced to stop for repairs. At first the rep here told us they were a week out on repairs and no one else in town could help. I managed to grab someone else who was very helpful and nice...Claudio. for 200 dollars they would move us to the front of the line, 800 dollars later, we paid for clips and magnets which cost 20 dollars apiece to purchase ourselves.  We did not have that option, and paid instead 80 dollars apiece, plus labor,plus the 200 to start the work. Claudio was helpful, but we feel we had no choice and they knew it.

I'm super torn between 3 or 4 stars. My average experience with Corner Bakery in California was always 4-5 stars, but my last visit at this location was lacking. 

When I came with my husband and son it was practically empty inside (maybe one other couple dining). I always have the chicken carbonara pasta so my husband ordered as I got settled with our one year old and started feeding him baby food. 

Our food came out fast, which we appreciated. I was so hungry I started eating quickly. Half way through, while juggling baby food and my iPhone for a Thomas the train video, I realized there was no chicken in my pasta!  None. Not even one piece. It's never happened before and it was very disappointing. I was almost done with the meal and we had to go. I don't like complaining, and the meal was still tasty.  In hindsight I should have brought it up for the staff as a learning experience. I'll be back someday I'm sure, but I'll check my food next time.

The food was not bad, and the service was nice. Came here for lunch with 2 friends and left slightly hungry. I ordered the pulled pork biscuits, my friends ordered the beef brisket biscuits and the pancakes. I gave three stars overall for the taste of the food and the friendly service.

Pros:
1. The pancakes and eggs were actually a large portion and my friend enjoyed them and had leftovers to spare.
2. Service was quick and friendly.
3. They have fry sauce and particularly good fries.
4. The coleslaw is fresh and not overly dressed.

Cons:
1. The "biscuits" plates are slider style and only come with two very small sized sandwiches (the rest of the plate is filled with fries to compensate). Three would have made more sense for an average appetite and for the price charged. This could also be remedied with a larger sized biscuit.
2. The chairs are very small for anyone with even slightly larger hips. I'm fairly small and they were tight on my hips. My friends had to sit on the bench side of the table to avoid discomfort.
3. I was told they only have one kind of barbecue sauce (sweet/tangy) when I requested a spicy barbecue sauce.

Overall I prefer other barbecue places for their portions, price point, and variety of barbecue sauces.
Unsanitary when taking gel nails off. Used his fingers to pry them off. When I commented about it he became rude and tough on my nails. Never again will I go here.
Every time I come through meridian I stop here for lunch.  they are consistently delicious and friendly!  Clean, quality ethnic food.
Horrible service for mobile orders. They have no concept of what to do. Yeah I actually want my drink in under 15 min.

Beer selection is great like always, but the food has gone down hill since they have started working on their new ventures.  We were even told by current staff that the menu had to change to easier items since the chef's focus is on their new burger joint in downtown Boise.

Really good breakfast options. I went with my family and everyone loved it. The huckleberry pancakes are amazing! The huckleberry "syrup" isn't like regular syrup. It's homemade and tastes amazing! I had their biscuits and gravy and Oh. My. Gosh they were amazing!! The gravy is made with the sausage oils (like they are supposed to) and it made you just want to keep eating. Overall everything is homemade and you just want more. Service was great as well for being so busy.
Chicken and pork are good here. I love sauses and meat here. Also, I ordered bubble tea and it tasted different to those I tasted before. Tea here must be nice!

Great Bacon

Cinnamon. Rolls lack flavor

Dads Pancake is salty

Hot chocolate  is bland
I liked it alot, the prices were good, service was good, food was pretty good, Cole slaw was very salty, Irish cowboy was pretty bland

I just had the best massage this morning. I am definitely going to go again!  They offer a lot of great services and and their prices seem very reasonable. They have thought of everything to make you comfortable. I think our next thing to try is their mineral water soak. It looks amazing!
Love this place. Bbop and mandoo are great. The staff is great and very knowledgeable about the sauces and spices.
Really good food! And fun and enthusiastic service! Also? The ambiance is just perfect for a country home style breakfast/lunch!

Sorry to say this is the worst Chinese buffet I've ever been to.  They didn't even do the stir fry right...I mean come on all you have to do is fry the meat and veggies and put some sauce right?  Not one item was good except the store bought pumpkin pie that I had for dessert.   I won't be back ever!
Clean, friendly, and the massage was decent.  Great prices - $35 for an hour foot/body massage.  I would go back again.
Server Denna was very nice and helped rush our order before running off to work and school. Good food, friendly people, great diner :)

My fiancé and I had a wonderful experience. We went in to have our engagement ring redesigned so that we could pair a band with it.  Our sales lady Shannon helped us find the band of our choice first and then with assistance from Jay Simmons we were able to design a new ring.  They met our needs and the ring was completed as they had promised.  We will be returning for future jewelry needs.

Food is good but service is shitty! I've called in before and they told me rudely that they are not delivering today and hung up on me. Another time I called and never brought all the stuff I bought then when I called in they argued with me that I got everything. I would suggest ordering from a different place.

I didn't realize the store had already closed when I walked in, as it was unlocked, but Sarah was super friendly, and helped me with my purchase, even though technically they were closed. I don't recommend going there intentionally at that time, but I was in a jewelry anticipation haze, and lost track of time. I'm happy to have found a new jewelry store here, with beautiful items at different price points, and fabulous service.
Ramen was delicious and so was the takoyaki and gyoza. Waiter was friendly food was prompt. A pleasant experience.

Seems like they have mixed reviews so we decide to go and try it ourselves. We had a great time, food was so deleicious and great prices too. I highly recommend testing our your "ramen" tastebuds at this awesome local joint.

I probably spent 20 minutes sipping my caramel macchiato while chit chatting with the owner on a slow, snowy Monday morning. He's a really nice, laid back, down to earth guy. 
The coffee was fantastic! The best caramel macchiato I've had to date. There was a perfect blend of rich, quality espresso and sweetness. The coffee wasn't lost in the sugar. The sugar enhanced the coffee. I can't wait to go back.

Ramen is ok, not worth the wait though. If need to wait for more than 15 mins I think better go somewhere.
For Ramen speciality restaurant, consider ok only compared to others that I have tried at other cities.

Menu is very limited. Services is not impressive and inconsiderate. Place does not feel clean. Still struggling I think due to newly open and does not seem ready.

Much room for improvement in my opinion.

Decent lunch for $8.50. EXTREMELY  noisy inside. Would be nice to have a little more meat and veggies in the bowl but like I said, decent. Maybe a little more selection for meat and toppings. Staff was friendly and efficient. Decor was lacking and not really anything inviting. Much like most new walk-thru restaurants, eat and get out.

Beer, I love beer, I enjoy a nice farmhouse ale any time of the year, hefeweizen in the summer and a rich stout in the fall. I don't know if it is abnormal for a girl like me to enjoy it as much as I do but I could really care less. My knee's on the other hand hate me for it and all of the running I have to do work off those 'empty calories' but for beer wonderful beer, surely it's worth it. 

So what can I say that hasn't already been said about Brewforia other than every city, town, village and hamlet needs to have a Brewforia type of establishment. They have an amazing selection of beers and for someone that had just moved to town from Kansas City they helped to alleviate some of my sadness of missing my home with a nice selection of Boulevard Beer products. Along with my own favorite home town beer, they also have organic, gluten free and a huge selection of other beers that I haven't even heard of. It really can be quite intimidating and I would almost suggest taking a peak at the website before you go in. So at least you don't stand at the counter or drooling at the glass coolers like a zombie in need of brains.

Oh, they also have food and good food too! A great flatbread salad, which is really just pizza salad, I recommend the Sicily and order it every time. I can't speak to anything else on the menu, because I literally order the Sicily every time. I personally don't enjoy chicken wings, but guys seem to and they have an interesting selection of options to choose from, BBQ Rub to Chicken and Waffles flavor. 

So get your self to Brewforia, pick up a growler, a mini growler, (what ever those are called) or a pint and enjoy beer!

We have visited the griddle many times since it opened. It's consistently busy on the weekends with hit and miss service The hits come from Abe, taking the helm over the Griddle. The staff is hustling and service is the best! Stay and enjoy!! However, after this mornings visit it was easy to see where the misses come from, the owners, Dave and Ashley need to stay home and or out of the restaurant during operating hours.  From walking in to put our names on the list Ashley is extremely unfriendly and abrasive in her barking orders.  Watching the staff, they are all grim faced and scrambling with a sense of panic!!! Which was definitely quarter backed by Dave. Assumingely quiet it is evident of his undermining negative nature, affecting all staff.  Our table overheard two staffers deciding to quit after their shifts due to how "horrible" the owners are. The Griddle's food is usually good, today there was a mess up with my food, which I was ok with. The attempt to fix my order was,try and pull a fast one and I hope I didn't notice. Fortunately, I watched them, so I called it to their attention.  Resulting in blame shifting, instead of accountability....Had we not been meeting our friends for what we were hoping to be an enjoyable breakfast I would have left at first abrasive "greeting!"   For the wait and the price to have an uninviting finger pointing experience I would recommend walking across the street to their competition.

We just had Brian from Meridian Plumbing respond to a service call placed this morning for a leaking pipe and/or toilet.  Not only did he arrive early, he was exceptionally knowledgeable, identified the problem immediately, fixed it, and along the way was extremely personable.  Great job Brian and Meridian Plumbing!!
This time the server was disrespectful and utterly rude to my wife.  The manager defend his actions.
Ordered a simple, Family Size pepperoni and as you will see by the picture, looks like they are getting cheap with the cheese

We really hoped for great things from this place but it was underwhelming. We ordered the Shoyu and Tonkatsu ramen. We also had the japanese fried chicken appetizer. Overall, the food was decent, but not great. The restaurant was hot and only had a few tables inside, although that didn't matter because they opened it up to the patio so there was zero ac on a 100 degree day. The wait staff was fantastic. That's the only big plus going for this place. We won't be back.

This place is an alternative to the over priced biker wear at name brand stores.  The staff is very helpful.  I was looking to pay a reasonable price for an item I could get on-line and the owner worked with me on it and got it for me.  What great people.  For other biker clothing stuff, I always check the prices at other stores & come here to make my final purchase because a) I know they'll tell me what equipment / clothing I'll need, why I'll need it, when I should use it, what I should be thinking about getting in the future, etc....  So there's no comparison to service, you simply won't find better service.

The other good thing is that there almost always seems to be a few bikers hanging out.  If I have questions about a ride or a piece of equipment, they're always willing to give me their experienced advice.

We had a reservation next door but it was a long wait and packed house. We went here and it was a great meal. Smaller menu but what they do they do good. The ramen dishes were spot on with fall off your fork slightly fatty bites of pork and hard to find real deal ramen noodles. The pork bento bowl was fabulous with spot on flavor profile of ginger and garlic sauce with perfect blend of sauce to meat to rice portion for like 7 bucks. The gyoza were perfectly cooked and a tasty app. We fed four for a Friday night meal and with tip and even a beer for under $50.  Just went into the new location closer to Meridian. We really like the food here. I would have given it 5 stars but we ordered our appetizer first with drinks and app came after our ramen. The pork rice dish is cheap and flavorful. The sampler appetizer was like 5 bucks and was well worth it. You could even sub in a kids meal with the chicken bites. Next time we're in town we'll be back.

I have no idea why people think this place is so great. Service is ok, cleanliness is ok and the food is not very tasty. Greasy. Not impressed. Where is the good chinese food in this area. Best I know of is P.F. Changs in downtown Boise. If you want cheap, quick eats, this is the place.

We came here for dinner and it was by far the worst service that I have ever had at Denny's. The server we had clearly didn't know what she was doing the fact that she took an order on her arm and stood there watching after the table had spilled a drink. If you ever think it's a good idea to stop here just keep driving.

Stopped in to try for lunch. Great surprise! Sandwiches are just like homemade. Big serving so can split or get full. Nice decor and patio is next to downtown fountain. This has been a number of Resturants over the years and so hope they make it.  We will return.

Don't get a membership here! DON'T! They charge you "fees" that you don't expect or deserve to get charged- and they won't reverse the charges if they do. They don't keep the "gym" clean. Dusty, dirty, no fans to circulate the gross air, regularly NO soap or TP in the restrooms. The temps are always too hot for a gym. The machines are cheapest of the cheap machines and there is always one or so that is broken. They have over 10 weight machines for upper body strength but only 3 for lower body. They use dollar store bath mats in the shower which don't get washed or disinfected, so wear your shower shoes in the dirty restroom.
Did not enjoy the food here very much. Noodles don't seem authentic and the people working there were not very kind. Would strongly recommend no going here.

I'm one of those breakfast-for-dinner (or any meal for that matter) kind of people, so I LOVE Corner Bakery Cafe. The portions are huge, food is delicious, and the choices are vast! 

Food: I have gotten several items on the menu and from the baked goods case and have been impressed each time. My favorite is the steel cut oatmeal with warm apple cranberry topping. The Ahaheim Scrambler is giant and so flavorful. The pancakes are more than enough and have an excellent, fluffy consistency. And the cinnamon roll is sugary and sweet and super sticky. Yum! I love that you can also grab-and-go from the baked goods if you're in a hurry and want a yummy treat and coffee while on the run.

Drinks: Self-serve coffee bar... TWO THUMBS UP! 

Atmosphere: As it has limited seating, it tends to fill up quickly so it can seem like people are table-sharking while they wait to sit down. That's probably one of the only things I don't like. But the decor is simple, the menu has photos that go along with it, and the baked goods display case is total eye candy. 

Service: When they first opened, the ladies behind the counter didn't seem to know much of what was going on, but it's since gotten better. I've spoken with the manager several times (to compliment their service) and she's always been super friendly and helpful. They're very quick to get your food out to you!

Happy Hour Offerings: n/a

Healthy Hack: The oatmeal, while super healthy, is still a huge portion! Ask for half to go!

Tips: n/a

We have been eating here for close to 4 years.  We are always seated quickly and given our drinks.  The containers of food are usually full.  The staff is polite.  We only eat certain things, and those are things that we like and they taste wonderful.  This is one of our favorite places to go for date night.

My only complaint surrounds one time that we went and we did not leave a tip.  The waitress asked us outright if they had done anything wrong.  I felt very awkward explaining that the service had been great and that we rarely leave tips.  I felt that she was rude I guess...

You have to definitely try a glass of orange juice - the best ever. We had tried the special of the day, The Loco Moco. It was delicious other than I was hoping it was on calrose white rather than Jasmine but regardless, it was good!! The pancakes are also the best ever! Customer Service was on point and we enjoyed this place.

Just okay. I have had the spicy miso twice, but it's not very spicy, and they are skimpy with the meat. The wait is usually long, with only 1 or 2 staff members to get service. There is not much room for parties over 2 and if there is a large party, that party more or less takes up the whole space. The eggs used in the ramen are good, but everything else is just okay.
Great beer selection but food equal to airline food. Customer service lacking. I don't think the male bartender there likes women as he was hitting on my date. Not cool!
Go here for beer! Nuff said. Don't waste ur time at sports bars or places with girls in tight shirts. Come here and drink amazng beer

Great beers, they have a very good variety of beers and rotating taps. They recently revised their food menu, the pizzas are smaller and more personal sized. Definitely big enough for a 180lb dude as long as there is an appetizer and a beer to go with it. Have had their Santa Fe goat cheese fundido as well and it was very very tasty.

We are extremely happy with the job that Meridian Plumbing did for our home!  We recently had a basement dug out from our 11 year old home.  Almost every bit of plumbing that existed had to be changed and moved up into the joists, New plumbing needed to be installed in the new bathroom, laundry, and bar, our water main had to be moved, and every drain pipe had to be rerouted.  This was a MAJOR undertaking, and  puzzle to figure out.  These guys did it all, including correcting some work that was done previously, moving our water softener system and plumbing our ejector/sump pump.  

When they came out to give us the estimate, they spent a couple of hours here figuring out exactly what we would need,how they would do it, and explained it all to us.  I think that is pretty nice considering they were giving us a free estimate of job that was way beyond a simple remodel.   They spent close to a week working on this mess and when it was all said and done, we could not be happier.  They were right on with their estimate, and didn't even reach the high end of the estimate, which in most cases like this, I would have thought they would have to max it out.  Their price was fair, better than another estimate we had gotten, and they took care of EVERYTHING.  The two plumbers who came to work here were absolutely wonderful, very professional, kind and considerate.  Brian and Zack worked their butts off, communicated any issues or questions to us immediately and were very organized and respectful of our home, cleaned up beautifully  and wrapped up every neat as a pin.  I could not be happier with everything that they did for us, and would highly reccommend them to anyone looking for a plumber.   This was NOT an easy job, this was highly complicated tangled mess that had to be thoughtfully worked out.  These guys obviously can do ANYTHING having to do with plumbing, and then some.  I doubt you could stump them with any problem.  So, regardless of what you might need done in the plumbing department, I can assure you that you can count on Meridian Plumbing to provide you with a fair price, accurate estimation and high quality work.  We are very pleased to have such a wonderful resource now, and would not hesitate to call them again.

This is my favorite place to go for breakfast. The atmosphere is amazing, the service is great and the freshly squeezed orange juice is great. Just watching the orange juicer contraption is fun ;) I try to branch out whenever I go to the griddle but my favorites are the crepes or the Caribbean french toast (coconut battered- yum)! The food is high quality and decent priced. some may say over priced but I say you get what you pay for.

My first visit to MoMo was a very pleasant surprise. I have never eaten Himalayan food, so I was unsure what to expect. The MoMo is a meat or veggie filled dumpling that comes with a sauce for dipping. I got the spicy sauce, which has a hint of sweet to it as well. It was very delicious. 

The combo plate comes with 3 MoMos as well as rice, beans, and 1 topping. I got the Curry Chicken as my topping. There is a side of veggies that has a light vinaigrette sauce that perfectly compliments the rice and meat. 

Overall, the food was excellent and a welcome change from the typical sandwich for lunch. It is a very filling lunch as well. Price was very reasonable at about $10 for the lunch and drink. I highly recommend a visit.

This was hands down the best experience I've had at a local business. Great customer service from Shane. They were also extremely quick and affordable. Would highly recommend to everyone. Also they're deals are crazy good I'd you're looking for a phone case.

I have to have a better experience here. We used to come here fairly often. I know people get excited about the bottles, but they're on the expensive side. Terrific selection, but for whatever reason, I prefer bier: thirty (for buying bottles).

Their taps are usually great and they almost always have a $2.00 pint, which sounds terrible but tastes amazing. Case in point: a lemon-ginger wheat. To me, sounded terrible but I wound up drinking three of them. Can't beat the price.

The real negative experience is the food. The last time we went here, the kitchen was extremely limited (maybe being remodeled?). We ordered the Santa Fe Queso Fundido Dip and the Pork Carnitas Tacos. Shame on us for not reading the menu better, but shame on the waiter for not telling us THEY INVOLVE THE EXACT SAME INGREDIENTS! One was seriously eaten out of a bowl with stale chips, the other was put onto stale, panani-grilled tortillas. Seriously disappointing, as neither one was any good.

I want to come back and try their variety of wings. They look great. I'm assuming their food just isn't amazing, but will certainly treat you just fine with some beer.

The best chicken teriyaki bowl with brown rice and fresh veggies. You could split one bowl with your significant other, or save half for later. This is one of our favorite places to grab a healthy meal. We tried to grab a bowl at the Boise location and the girl at the front informed us they had run out if brown rice. What? We drove to Meridian and got the goods. You won't be disappointed.

I had the chicken pomodori which is "All-natural roasted chicken, fresh basil and spinach, oven-roasted tomatoes and provolone cheese with pesto mayo." Which is on sourdough bread, although gluten free options are available. I found the bread to have good crunch, and the taste was exceptional.
I had a side of Mac and cheese, which I found bland.
My wife had the uptown turkey on harvest toast which is "Smoked turkey breast, applewood smoked bacon, avocado, lettuce, tomatoes and mayo on whole grain harvest toast." It was also very good.
She had a side dish of broccoli cheese soup which I found to be incredibly good.

Overall the service was fast and the staff were polite. It has a nice feel and a lot of drink options.

My husband picked up a bucket of chicken and some sides. He requested no biscuits because we don't like them. When he got it all home, there it was- a box of biscuits. Had to throw them away. I hate to waste food! Then we started to eat the chicken. So over cooked and dry there was hardly any flavor. So disappointing! It will be a while before we get food there again.

I just had a killer hamburger and it was dirt cheap. Our waiter Kevin was awesome. The menu is so interesting and you don't have to go to a movie to eat there. However if you want a place to go before a movie this is the place.
My favorite breakfast in Idaho. I prefer the Boise location but Meridian is good too. I have never had a bad experience. Don't let the long wait discourage you there's a wait for a reason! Enjoy!!!

We love Korean Food - the more traditional, the better. The new Cupbob restaurant in Eagle has figured out how to do traditional Korean food combined with a modern Korean edge.  It's delicious!

I have a weakness for jjapchae (Korean Sweet Potato Noodles), which usually come as a banchan (small side dish) or ordered as a side.  When I saw on the menu that the jjapchae was offered as a vegan option I was excited.   But, I really wanted to try the meat dishes and didn't want to pay $8 for the vegan noodles only plus a meat dish.  No worries though!  All cups come with both rice AND noodles!  Happy face for sure!

The S.O. Got the combo with Korean Beef (aka Bulgogi) and Spicy Pork.  Both the kid and I got the Ugly Bop (rice, jjapchae, cabbage (you can choose lettuce instead), and sauces).  

The crew asks how spicy you'd like it and adds sauces on top to suit your request.  I don't like overly sauced food, so next time I'll be sure to ask for less, but the taste of everything was amazing.   So good we made plans to drive the 30 min each way from our place in Boise again the next day to order again. 

Plus, the $8 student meal (a CupBop and drink) is available all day, every day.   The price is affordable, the food is fresh and plentiful, the decor is fun and spot on to modern Korean esthetic.  

Great addition to the Treasure Valley!  Can't wait for them to open one nearer to us in downtown Boise (one can hope).

UPDATE:  2nd time trekking to CupBop.  Mandoo!   You must get Mandoo!  $2 for a 3 piece.  We ordered 2 orders but got the third for free because our chicken took a few min to cook. 
Fresh food and awesome cust service!

What is this sauce I want to lap up??? What are these perfectly textured noodles at the bottom of the sauce that's perfect? Hello!! I love when I find a food I actually crave! Holy heck..had this downtown once on NYE... Then drove to Meridian to see if the restaurant made the same epic flavors..yep. I got a kko. Chicken on top of perfect noodles and I added cabbage for crunch. The truth is..I ordered another to go for the next day for lunch with the beef..I can't tell you enough how the#4 sauce with that creamy crack lime mayo stuff made my taste buds happy. Together..I'm in love. YAY!
This is a delicious choice for Ramen! The Gyoza is amazing! Their food truck on broadway will be a new favorite as this location moves to meridian!

On paper, Barnyard has potential; the decor gives the right vibe, the thoughtfully crafted menu builds anticipation, and the drinks strike the right balance  between trendy and timeless. That said, from the deviled eggs to the fried chicken, Barnyard's well-conceived dishes suffered from a lack of seasoning. There were some high points--the sautéed carrots and banana pudding were delicious--but the biscuits were inferior to Chik-Fil-A and the corn pudding was nothing to write home about.

For the price, a good value, but if you're looking for the true soul of the South, St. Lawrence Gridiron or Grit are better bets.

Green Leaf Cleaners is the best place to get clothes done. They always over deliver. My clothes seem to get ruined everywhere but Green Leaf. I will go there for as long as I can and support them as much as possible.

We came in looking for a specific trailer that we found on the site but yet the trailer color and trailer were in a different state!  The salesperson assisting was great!  He listened to what our wants and needs were.  We did go in and crunch numbers on one trailer.  When all was said and done it didn't come with electric stabalizers nor did it come with batteries.  Those 2 items there raised the trailers sales price to well over 32,000.00.  In the end do NOT be afraid to walk away if it isn't what you really want.   We have been researching endlessly online through all the travel trailers, we have even built a few online and gotten quotes.  Through it all it will in the end be cheaper to drive to the Midwest over 1000 miles aways to save well over $10,000.00.

I just received excellent service and great food to boot.  I inadvertently ordered from the wrong location and rather than traveling across town, they transferred the order and took care of us even though it was my error.  Thank you!! 

Shelly

I'm glad to see the Co-Op, long a fixture in Boise's North End, has expanded to Meridian. 

They have much more space than the Boise store and its location in The Village will bring a lot more traffic past the store, which could be a great advantage in building their business here.

Fantastic....Exactly what every review has said. We ate there just over a month ago, and we have been craving it since. Today we went back and it was just as awesome as the first time....we've found food love. The momo's are just scrumptious, and the samosas....well those are just heaven wrapped up and deep fried. The dipping sauce for them is totally drinkable too. We will need to go there more often to satisfy my newly found samosa addiction.

So this was kind of a new one for me. At first I was a little leary of the food.  But I like to step out of the box some and try new things so what the heck. Initally was was still thinking "hmm not too sure about this stuff" but I will now admit it has grown on me and I have been there several times. This is a small mom and pop shop. Food is fresh and your can tell who the owners are as they take special care in how things are done and made. Overall I would have to say I like it, and I continue to go back.
Great service and always friendly employees, especially Al Pal! I really wish they had chocolate whipped cream for my American is though...

Momo's Meridian, Idaho  great one of a kind small restaurant. Food is made on the spot. Fast. Clean. Sooo tasty. Friendly staff. Very reasonable prices. Wish I lived close by because it would be on my "favorite" list. Can't wait to go back. Samosas are divine!!!

"My girls" at the Salon never let me down.  I trust Lori to do manage my hair challenges and she does an exceptional job, it is so nice to have a secure and trusting relationship with my hair dresser. I trust Jamie to take care of skin challenges and she's exceptional at her suggestions while consulting,  and also takes my budget into consideration.  I so appreciate to have found confident, capable and friendly professionals to assist me.  E-Salon and Med Spa Rocks!

I've come back here a few times recently. They've increased the amount of broth in the ramen to a more appropriate amount.

I've also tried their gyoza, takoyaki, karaage, and rice bowls and enjoyed all of them.

so excited to find a restaurant that has fresh delicious food.. made from scratch with such care and pride..  they change the menu every week and use a lot of local ingredients...  every dish is made too order.. not sitting around under a heat lamp... sauces.... salad dressings....  at our table we had an awesome steak salad... a pork cutlet dish that was melt in your mouth ...  they had a cream of sweet potato soup that we passed around the table because everyone wanted a taste and then wanted more... it was incredible... and for dessert we ordered a candied walnut chocolate chip cookie topped with (housemade) salted carmel ice cream...  we shared this and it was so out of this world good i had to go back and order my own the next night because, as i said earlier they change the menu every week, so i wasn't sure that they would have this again soon... so good...  we will definitely go back!

Excellent Buffet ,I really enjoyed the stir-fry bar. All the food was nice and fresh and there was a great selection. All the food was full of flavor and was good. I loved the variety it wasnt one of those chinese buffets that put the same dishes put with just a different meat.Every thing was different and had its own Flavor .Dessert was also excellent. They only thing that could use improvement would be the dining room staff .Thats why im only giving them a 4 stars or else they would have gotton 5.

Ramen sho is the most authentic Japanese ramen I've found in Idaho. After spending 4 years in japan it was really refreshing to have a nice hot bowl of ramen. They also feature a variety of authentic and unique Japanese flavors of ramen including curry ramen (one of my personal favorites). The only downside was that the pork they serve didn't fall apart in my mouth. It was a little bit too chewy for my taste and slightly below my expectation but it was still delicious.

I have given these guys two chances but NOT a third! My first experience, I purchased one of the wash packages which the gal told me came with a wipe down of the inside of the vehicle. Well upon completion I noticed the middle console, dash and none of the leather had even been touched. The poor girl working there quickly addressed it once I pointed it out to her but her "boss" some white dude statnding out there with his whip was not too happy that I was holding up the "slave labor" I guess. My second experience was last week when I brought one of my other vehicles there, only btw because it's the only full service car wash in town that I know of. Anyway, I paid $80 to have the inside carpet shampooed and the engine cleaned. It literally took the guy a grand total of maybe 30 min. max to do both! The quality of the job showed just that. I got home and looked under the hood and several spots were not even touched. The carpet was not any cleaner than before and the truth is when I have washed the floor mats in my washing machine they came out alot cleaner than the job this guy did in the detail shop who happened to be the manager. I DO NOT recommend this place to anyone! to add insult to injury too, there gas is always at least 20 cents more a gallon than the leading companies like Chevron & Shell which are not too far away from there. I'm not sure why anyone fills up there. I guess they like throwing there money away. If you want a good car wash, minus the full service go to Mister Hot Shine or whatever it's called on Eagle Road. Great price and your car will deafenently be clean!

We were very disappointed. The atmosphere is nice but the service was horrible. Our waitress was nowhere to be found. Our appetizer came 40 minutes after we ordered and our food came about an hour after we ordered. When we asked our waitress, she apologized and told us that at one point the kitchen was backed up by about 40 minutes (wish that she had mentioned that when we sat down).
We could hear several waitstaff around us also apologizing to their tables throughout our time there.  

Once our food finally came, my burger was dry. My husband ordered a pasta dish that had baked chicken, when it came it was fried. By that time we were too hungry to say anything. We definitely won't return unless it's just for drinks.
Amazing service bartenders are awesome! Especially Cody, food and drinks are really good! And they have the best happy hour prices in Meridian!
A two because delivery was fast and food hot. The food was extremely greasy and not very tasty. Will pass on their delivery in the future.

Stupidly took a chance on this place despite poor reviews. Saw lots of cars in parking lot, but it turns out these were not the cars of patrons because the place was deservedly empty. Their "chow mein" is actually lo mein (soft noodles). Chow mein was what I wanted and couldn't find anything else on the menu that sounded good except vegetable tempura. That's hard to mess up, but they did. Even the miso soup was awful. Do not go here.

Fun decorated vibe with great employees. The service was a 10. I like the idea of where this restaurant is trying to go with adding a little twist in the norm for valley. However, I found the ingredients felt heavy despite the attempt to keep the healthy flare going.  Definitely a place you have to go and judge for yourself!

It is fun now that the Boise Co-Op is here closer to Meridian.  We've been members for years, but would only occasionally get into the Co-Op when it was only at the north end.  Now that it is closer to home, in the Village area, we have been in quite a few times.  Tonight, it was to get a take out dinner from the deli.  All I can say is Yum!  
I got the Patagonia Bowl, and my wife got some Chimichurri Pork and Macaroni & Cheese.  We also selected a bottle of wine for dinner, and a lemon bar and a lemon tart for desert.  The Patagonia Bowl was great!  There was this huge variety of flavors combined together that was really unique.  The lemon tart was excellent!  I love it when lemon deserts make you pucker up!  The whole thing cost less than a typical evening dinner out, and we got to take it home to eat while watching a movie.  What a fun night!

The Co-Op deli has a great selection of prepared food (including sushi, meat loaf, soups, and lots of others), and they have a nice menu for dishes they can cook for you too.  We love visiting Co-Op-deli-like places when we are on vacation, because we can get a variety of foods, and enjoy them in our hotel rooms, but now with the Co-Op so close to home, we can enjoy vacation-like evenings when we are at home for the weekend too!

The staff there is super friendly too, and the place is always clean and organized.  Yes, the prices are high, compared to Wall Mart or other supermarkets, but the experience, variety, and quality of the items available at the Co-Op make it worth while for me! 

[ This week, I was diagnosed as being color blind.  It was a shock.  It hit me out of the purple.  ]

First off, I'm just glad we finally have a ramen shop in Idaho that's why I'm giving them 4 stars. Secondly, I went during their soft opening. We waited 2 hrs. People were taking their time eating ramen & I honestly think they could have added more seating. Anyway, the owner was nice enough to provide us with complimentary beer for waiting until closing. Now on to the ramen. They're all delicious! But I wish they added more meat. For $10 it only comes with one piece of meat on every order. I don't think that's too much to ask. So hopefully when they are fully open and ready that they will take into account the reviews here on yelp. I really want this shop to be successful and for it to stay open forever!

Update: They have added more meat to their ramen and more items in their menu. Yay! I'd like to point out some reviews on here about the noodles. To anyone who compared the noodles to packaged ramen, I'd like to know where they got it because that's some fine ass packaged ramen. I'd personally say the noodles do not taste or feel like cheap packaged noodles. My fave has to be the tonkatsu! Also, I'd like to agree on the temperature of the broth. It would be nice if it was hot. Not scorching hot, but nice and warm hot. So when they are served and being mixed they don't become cold so quickly. Otherwise, most of my concerns have been improved and I hope they continue to serve us their ramen!

Our favorite place to catch a bite to eat when we go to the village. The food is very tasty....mozzarella spring rolls, salmon, and bread pudding absolutely delicious. Service was fantastic.  Easy 4 star.

As of May 2016, this place is incredible! Full detail on a car with 10 years of borderline abuse with 2 kids for only $150 with a $20 coupon on their website. Crumbs and stains everywhere, in all grooves and crevices... Everything is clean and spotless, interior and exterior, including all compartments. Can't beat the deal or the service! 5 stars.

Paid 180 to have my wife's X5 detailed.  It came back worse than it went in PLUS if was obvious they had "fun" in there.

These guys are smegma's smegma.  Avoid them or you'll regret it.
Kids just loved this fresh noodles and fresh chicken or beef and can season how you would like with whatever flavor combo! Will definitely be back!

Customer service is where they are missing. One of the girls was a bit rude and the other was awesome. I wish I had her name so she could get some credit. She seemed like she really liked being there and made the atmosphere better. Balanced out the negativity. Aside from that the smoothies were ok.
Visiting from California. Amazing menu and fabulous food. Our waitress was a kick. Super upbeat and friendly. Great place! Check out the candy store next door too!

I did not know what to order so I asked for advice I got a five piece Momo combo.
I had the turkey pork and a vegetarian Momo plus beans and a curry vegetable it was awesome. don't forget to order the Taj Mahal beer
Food was delicious and service was super fast! Ordered an appetizer and it was on our table within 5 minutes then the main dish was within 10. Would defiantly recommend to anybody!

These guys are great!  They all know me, my kids AND my dogs by name every time we come in.  Any time I have a question on my account, they are more than willing to take the time to explain things to me. I don't ever feel like they are trying to get money out of me, I don't feel like I'm just a number.
Stop here today great place very nice young lady assisted us on our yogurt order lots and lots of great flavors and great topping bar... will go again but will try the burgers too
Really good breakfast.. Only knock was the service was a bit slow, but they were friendly. The Rosie French Toast was awesome!

Wonderful food, great atmosphere, and amazing customer service. I always love our trips here. If you need a great location for a girls brunch or a quiete meal with a friend, try the corner bakery. 

-ps- the Bacon Mac & Three Chees is delightful.

We decided that for our first night in Boise, Idaho we wanted to have something warm and flavorful to enjoy for our first night here! So glad we decided to stop in, the ambiance was very simple and inviting. Billy, our waiter was super sweet to accommodate for our pup Cowboy! Billy also made us smile and shared his Japanese ethnicity with us! The service was quick and delicious! Must try the Tan Tan and Tonkotsu if you are a meat eater! The dishes were super rich with flavor. We are normally vegan but decided to venture out and expose ourselves to well rated and hole-in-the-wall places to enhance our experience! Not to mention the Beatles playing (one of my favorites) made this place super memorable!

This has to be the worst Kentucky fried chicken on the planet. We've had trouble in the past, and just thought it was a fluke. We went the other day and they had no white meat chicken at all, and their fryers didn't have oil in them. It seems odd for a fried chicken place. The worst part of it was, the employee wasn't sorry at all. It's not that she had a bad attitude, she just had zero empathy. I will never go here again.

Have I reviewed them before?  Ehh, who cares, it's still terrific.  2nd time at this Meridian location and it's still A+.  It's hard to compare it to anything else around because their menu is so diverse and original.  It has basic items, chicken fried steak, etc, but they also have treats that you won't get other places.  

Today I had, I believe, Caribbean French Toast(?).  Strawberry, light coconut, cream cheese, and a strawberry-rhubarb jelly that was (insert expletive here) amazing!  It was one of the three specials, and I'll be honest, I almost ordered two of them because they all sounded incredible.  I went with the sweeter option and wasn't disappointed.  Wife loved it, too.  

The ambiance in this outfit is completely what we look for in a breakfast diner.  The tables aren't all jammed together like other smaller places.  You can walk around without knocking people's coats off their chairs.  Everyone seems to be hustling and getting things done.  The wait staff has been excellent each time.  The coffee/mochas are great.  They have a beer license so you can have mimosas or beermosa, like my wife had.  Guess it was decent, but the diversity is excellent.

We've decided this is our breakfast home, so if you see us, come say hi!
Always pleasant employees, excellant service, smiles and great food. This is our first choice.

My fiance and I were in the area for the VIP debut of The Village at Meridian but we  had absolutely no interest in attempting to actually find dinner there.  The crowds were expected, but we would have spent several hours waiting for a table at any of the restaurants.

So we drove off and wound up going only a short way before spying Denny's.

Our server was great, she was friendly, funny, and on top of all the late night customers she seemed to be solely taking care of.

I had a chocolate milkshake and ate some of my fiance's fries.  He ordered a big old burger and was pretty pleased with it.

No complaints here.
The bacon is amazing. I took my employees here for breakfast and the rest of the food was just ok. So if you come in just order bacon with a side of bacon and you will give it five stars.
Get the online coupon. $10 off Ultrawash. That makes it $15.95 which is well worth a full service car wash...even if they miss a spot sometimes...
Worst customer ever!!! Save your time and go ANYWHERE else but here. Employees who would rather socialize and waste your time than do their jobs and help you out.

Great little coffee shop/ eatery located in quaint downtown meridian.  Impeccable coffee.  I get the shot in the dark as I do at all coffee shops and theirs is delectable.  Ordered the protein power and my wife got a breakfast burrito, both of which are highly satisfying.  We very much recommend trying out this little gem.

Delicious food, great service. A little crowded, but they did their best to take care of everyone. My only complaint is that I was unable to finish the whole thing. I had to abandon the last bits of my delicious meal. Next time, maybe. Next time.

I had the biscuits and gravy with a side of toast. The biscuits were very dense but crumbly like a good biscuit should be. The sausage gravy was very good I only wished there was more slathered on my biscuits! I also had a side of toast with the homemade peach jam. The jam was very good and I would definitely take some home. The atmosphere was nice inside and well decorated. There were quite a few employees and all were helpful to the tables. I liked how they all helped each other wait their tables and refill coffees. I would definitely come back!!

Boise has needed this place for a long time. Healthy, fresh, incredibly tasty and flavorful. The dumplings are light and tasty but packed full of delicious flavor. The rice with curry and fresh crunchy vegetables are outstanding. There are tons of different flavor variations you can have by combining things differently. This would be a great place to bring people who only go to Applebee's to introduce them to something different - it is immaculately clean, and the flavors are not so intense as to be intimidating, and everything is delicious. We will definitely be back.
Quite possibly the longest I've ever waited for ONE DRINK. More than 20 mins and there aren't even very many customers. Absolutely ridiculous.
Absolutely love the California Benny. It is the best I have found. The fresh orange juice is not cheap but it is definitely worth it. This is probably my favorite breakfast place in town.

I was bringing some home smoked ham to work but was in need for some bread. I stopped by ate Corner Bakery cafe and ordered some rye and ciabatta bread to go.
After 5min I was asking...a bit sarcastic... if they bake the bread fresh or why it was taking so long, Indeed they were making the ciabatta fresh and boy was that good with the ham.
Totally worth the wait!

Had dinner with the hubs tonight at The Great Wall...our hostess and waitress we're very nice and attentive, which increased the number of stars from 2 to 3. There was plenty of selections in the buffet, but the majority weren't hot, or even warm, and there were some that hadn't been refilled. We didn't get sick, or anything crazy, and the restaurant was clean, just would have been so much better to have hot food.
Great cut for my springer spaniel! Very affordable, friendly and do a great job!

I had a pipe bust in my crawl space last winter. I could hear water running but didn't know where it was coming from. I checked the crawl and saw the water gushing to the ground. I immediately shut the main valve off (which happened to be what actually busted.) I wasn't sure if i was going to need their services but I called them anyway and they had a crew out with in 30 minutes. The crew went into the crawl and checked the building materials for water damage. Fortunately for me the water sprayed straight down to the ground and didn't get the structure wet. Some of the insulation got a little bit of water from the splashing, they  recommended I take it out and replace it with new insulation. It was something I could do myself. The crew was great and honest.  I was not charged because there was no work to be done. I HIGHLY recommend Servpro of Boise.

Oh my gosh! What a hidden gym! This place is huge! They have everything from a-z! I had a facial today with Jasmine and she was phenomenal! She was so informative, helpful and did amazing! My skin feels great and I can't wait to go back for my Botox, massage and to soak in their huge mineral pool!!

My girlfriend and I are financially challenged, yet unrepentant, foodies. We both agree this is one of the very best eateries, at any price, in the Treasure Valley. The prices might seem high to folks who can't tell Applebee's or Sizzler from fine dining, but you truly get what you pay for.
