Their menu is typically very limited, but quite eclectic and it changes every week! Many better restaurants claim to have a seasonal menu, but this place actually does, and it really does seem to update weekly. The staff is very kind, I know this is Idaho and we tend to like things rugged and informal, but don't be put off by the reserved european vibe. The staff like to chat, and sometimes the restaurant gets a good buzz of conversation and merry-making going. They also have live flamenco music; the guy is maybe not the best guitarist, but he ain't bad, (also, I'm hypercritical on that subject) and he has an absolutely angelic singing voice. I can't say enough about the food, I've never had anything short of amazing, dishes ranging from fresh crab caprese, to Osso Bucco, espresso-rubbed flatiron steak, butternut squash ravioli, various duck dishes, you really can't go wrong.
Overall score, 100% because percents don't go any higher than that, you silly geese.

First time I went - Nasty!  Food was overly salted, overly cooked and DOUBLE Deep Fried items made everything seem very cheap.  Even the chicken items didn't taste like chicken which is hard to do. My kid was sick all night and I was not feeling to well myself till a day later.  

I give restaurants a 2nd chance so we went again recently and SAME horrible experience.  100% sure they won't get a 3rd try to get my business. It really doesn't make sense why parking lot is so full. SHUT this place down!

You can purchase a mouth-watering, tasty meal for less than $9.00. The meals for one feeds three easily. The crab rangoon add-on is delicious and China Wok cooks it to perfection. We enjoy choice #2 for $8.25 with crab add-on, which makes it a few dollars more.

My husband and I feast on a meal for one for two nights.

Val Lee of "val lee weblog"

I've passed this restaurant for months and finally decided to stop and see what it is all about. 

Menu is similar to Panda Express ( Mongolian Beef, Orange Chicken, Broccoli Beef, Teriyaki Chicken, etc.) but without the cafeteria-like serving line or fast food atmosphere. It's a family restaurant with friendly service. The person who took my order was very helpful answering my questions about the menu. 

I had the Mongolian beef and it was pretty good. Not as spicy as I expected but I'm sure I could have asked them to spice it up if I really wanted them to. My wife had the orange chicken and it seemed to be similar to that of Panda.

The steamed rice was really good and I'm picky about rice.

Lunch price including entree, rice or noodles, and spring roll or cream rangoon is $6.99. Dinner is a buck more. Lots of choices of appetizers too. And options for large groups too.

This place is amazing! The numerous options and combinations are sure to satisfy any customer while the staff is friendly and informative. The combination plate is my personal favorite as it showcases both the momo dumplings as well as the rice bowl with different curry toppings. It is ideal for both vegans and vegetarians! While it may take a few minutes to heat up momos it is well worth the wait, the meal is always filling and delicious (especially the spicy and regular curry sauce). Overall a fantastic restaurant that offers a taste of the intersection of cultures through food.

What a pleasant surprise this was. We were just shopping nearby and I used my yelp app to find something out of the ordinary. While it is an ordinary location, a quick glance at the menu should tell you that they have extraordinary variety. Good service... Great food.

Had the best experience I've had in a long time at Denny's tonight. Our server was extremely attentive and so friendly. Misty made us feel like we were the only guests in the restaurant and made some great suggestions. Our group ordered the strawberry pancakes, Gouda Burger and Honey Jalepeno Burger. Everything was amazing and the timing was perfect. We will go to this location from now on just for the great service and awesome food :)
Thanks for wetting down the bugs and bird shit on my car before returning it to me. This car wash makes vehicles look good from afar, but far from good. YOU'RE FUCKIN' GARBAGE!

Had a wonderful totally relaxing experience today.
Katrina definitely made me feel pampered while doing my hair. I was greeted the minute I entered the  salon, and the entire time she made me feel relaxed and comfortable. The salon is absolutely upscale and I can't imagine not finding something to treat myself too.
Already made plans to go back! Thank you!

I came in with my mom expecting an experience I had had at a Chicago location a few years back. Remembering the delicious coffee cake, I got the same with a small soy vanilla latte. Coffee cake was good, not as wonderful as I remember but the coffee was horrible! I can't exactly describe its watery-like taste. Nowhere near a latte? My mom got a blueberry pastry that was very doughy and the same awful coffee. 

Service was mediocre. Nice but not attentive. We had to go on a search for the silverware which I then had to go to the front to get as they forgot to bring it? A lot of unnecessary problems.

Ok we ordered two Miso soups and chick Teri and short ribs. Then As always I checked in and saw a Free  Miso with check in. Asked the gal about it and she said they are not affiliated with that... huh??? Need to check with the owner or something. Cause those just dont just pop up under a business.   Maybe someone didn't get the memo???? Anyway u get nothing so dont try!! Let's hope the food is decent. Noticed that Geoffrey the owner writes back on things.. let's see if he sees this bougus check in soup offer.
    Sooo our food came and btw IT was fabulous. My teri chicken was spot on flavor and so were the short ribs!! I think as closer we r to the NW the more authentic food gets. Sooo ok when the Miso came it was in huge containers! It was a bit salty but was ok. We did have r soup after food cause she brought it like that. I just kept the lid on till ready to eat. So I don't see them giving away that big of a size. ( but smaller Free would have been nice oh well). So that's why the 4 star instead of 5.

Heard about this place from a friend that contracts with them. What a joke. I needed some brick to build a retaining wall and some sod. I ordered the brick they charged me 2 deliveries at $80, plus another $70 for who knows what. When they delivered the brick they ran over my front yard without permission and destroyed my front yard. Then when I called to ask what has happened they got extremely rude and said they would call back and failed to do so 3 times. Every person that works here including the manager could care less about their customers . Once they have your money , you will mean nothing to them. Highly advise to go elsewhere!

Great place.  A really good selection of beers, though I would love to see more east coast brews.  The staff was very friendly and helpful.  We sat to drink a new beer while we thought about what new treasures we'd bring home.

This is the best place for breakfast! Home made everything and it all tastes great. I have been here many times and love to take visitors here because the atmosphere is fun and it always has the best food.
I'm a member so maybe my review is a little biased, but I love this place! Great people, organic food selection, and their beer and wine selection is on point. In house coffee is pretty good too!

Food handlers are not required to wear gloves, to the contrary Health Depts. require food handlers to wash hands frequently. Gloves are required if a handler has a cut or open sore. Gloves can get just as dirty as hands and can cause cross contamination.

We have visited the griddle many times since it opened. It's consistently busy on the weekends with hit and miss service The hits come from Abe, taking the helm over the Griddle. The staff is hustling and service is the best! Stay and enjoy!! However, after this mornings visit it was easy to see where the misses come from, the owners, Dave and Ashley need to stay home and or out of the restaurant during operating hours.  From walking in to put our names on the list Ashley is extremely unfriendly and abrasive in her barking orders.  Watching the staff, they are all grim faced and scrambling with a sense of panic!!! Which was definitely quarter backed by Dave. Assumingely quiet it is evident of his undermining negative nature, affecting all staff.  Our table overheard two staffers deciding to quit after their shifts due to how "horrible" the owners are. The Griddle's food is usually good, today there was a mess up with my food, which I was ok with. The attempt to fix my order was,try and pull a fast one and I hope I didn't notice. Fortunately, I watched them, so I called it to their attention.  Resulting in blame shifting, instead of accountability....Had we not been meeting our friends for what we were hoping to be an enjoyable breakfast I would have left at first abrasive "greeting!"   For the wait and the price to have an uninviting finger pointing experience I would recommend walking across the street to their competition.

I'm a late night eater. So it a place is open, I'll more then likely go in no matter the star rating to see for myself. I don't trust people because any little thing can set someone off on here and falsely give a bad review. So now, here is my review.

I walked in to find a family sitting and waiting for 11'oclock to hit. Tired from a long day of work. The mother, her daughters and son sitting around staring at clock. I walk in and instantly the youngest boy tries to take my order, then the sister comes to me and tells him to sit and let her handle it. She gives me the run down of the menu. After deciding, I patiently sit and wait for my food. Almost forgetting I was here, I see a happy family talking about her daughters going on dates and other family discussions. The youngest laughing when the mom tells the daughter she is too young and she should lock her in the house forever. I start to laugh, they laugh. Almost reminding me of my family. It was great, because the food will take a while to cook. Everything is freshly made and HOT!! Nothing is siting underneath lights. The food..... Delicious! Nice and spicy (asked for it extra spicy), the white rice sticky, and they remembered no peanuts! Always a plus! If you don't mind a basic room to sit in and looking for real family time and not working employees, you should come late at night before 930 or so. Other then that. I will be back and hungry again. Do bring your appetite. These plates. Not on the small side.

Stopped in on my move from Seattle to Denver when my gears started slipping on the freeway. Friendly and helpful from the minute I walked in. No waiting and they helped fix the problem even though it ended up being unrelated to the transmission. Called around to other shops for help and found me the best and fastest deal for the fix. Didn't even charge me on the way out.

1. There wasn't wireless in the rooms. I use an iPad.
2. 4 lights didn't work as well as the outlet on the desk.
3. The toilet clogged.
4. I looked for the hot food breakfast but found only bacon, biscuits and gravy. An employee said that's all there is for hot food. (She later offered to make me egg patties). I didn't see the waffle maker on another counter.
We LOVE The Griddle! We enjoy breakfast there every weekend. The staff is great and food is always yummy. We really enjoy the special offerings each week.
Favoite place for breakfast in Meridian. The fresh squeezed orange is a huge hit. Pecan waffle with banana made to order and fresh tasting. Also a 10%.discount available. Thanks Griddle.

We had high hopes for this place, especially since in the lobby they had some baked goods that looked awesome!

I had an omelet and it was ok, my only issue was that the cheese was kraft American cheese slices and I would have preferred real cheddar.

My husband had biscuits and gravy, and the gravy had a pink mystery meat in it that was unappetizing and the gravy was like paste.  It definitely didn't seem homemade at all.

I would give this place another shot just because of the cute interior and friendly staff.

Went tonight for dinner and drinks, my wife and two of our good friends. Loved how big the place was and how prompt the waitress was! She checked in on us and was great. The food was delicious and hot when it came out. I would highly recommend this restaurant! Worth the money for sure and is a great environment

Big disappointment broth had no depth of flavor, the half egg was cold, pork belly was slimy, just chewy fat in my mouth. Fried rice was just rice, egg, corn. Poor excuse for vegetable fried rice. No flavor. You need to taste the food you serve. It really didn't seem like you even tried. Won't be back! Read Ivan Ramens book and steal some of his techniques

horrible experience from the start. my salesman was suppose to set an appointment to finalize everything with finance, and he never did. i had to call to schedule a time. i even called and left messages with the salesman to get help but not a response back.  i told c.w. about it hoping the finance portion would be smooth but it wasnt. i did a walk through on a supposedly brand new rv but the stove buttons were missing. sliding door to master bed area was missing, the plastic cover to the screeen door was broke, the shades were also broke. i spent 5 hours waiting for them to fix everything (the rv plant is in namps).  when i was about to leave i noticed they forgot to install the brake controller.  and that took anothe 1.5 hours. sales associate apologized and assured me things would get better and they would fix everything. 3 weeks later im still waiting on pieces for stove and screen door.  ive called, emailed, etc.  not a response back.  do not buy from c.w.  worst customer service. definately have buyers remorse.  should have went to bish's.
I come to the Griddle often. The food is great and not run of the mill. The quiche is the best and the fresh OJ always good. Always bring people here who visit from out of town.

This review is not based on the food!!! Please tell the servers to stop wearing their aprons into the restroom...I've gone in to eat there and used the restroom prior to ordering and found two of the ramen sho servers coming out of the stall with their aprons on. It made me feel uncomfortable about what other sanitary issues could be taking place so I left. This is an easy fix though. I'll be back.
Most amazing foot and all over body massage. Use of deep pressure makes this a real gem. The low price and service received is unequivocal!
Very good service came here for lunch!! Good for two friends grabbing lunch,  get the tonkotsu ramen with extra egg
Best ice cream in town. Must try the Huckleberry! The kids working there have excellent Guest Service!  Good family treat.

I haven't ate here.  I am visiting and was looking up late night delivery.  (10:30 pm) online said they were open until 11:00 pm. I called and my call was greeted with a, hello!!!???? (Why the hell are you calling-is what I heard) I simply asked if they were open,  she replied, "we closed a long time ago, at 10 and hung up on me".
Wasn't expecting them to be open even when it said they were open online.  But I want expected to be treated like an idiot and hung up on either.  Hence the 1 star rating.  ;-)
Always and forever the baristas here are so good to me and my husband. I love my perk way and the breakfast burrito is the best.  They're always speedy and super awesome.  Yep!

New to town, wanted a quick bite and my husband wanted pork and we like Japanese so we stopped by for teriyaki. It wasn't sensational, but that's not what we were expecting. We expected something fast, tasty enough, and edible. Delivered on all counts. Reminded me of the teriyaki places where I'm from (chain restaurants) that cooked the chicken on a large skillet, poured sauce on, and served it on a bed of rice. Fast food, basically (though where I'm from the chicken was much lower quality, so the uptick in quality here is nice). We also ordered egg rolls and they were tasty... crunchy outside with a softer inside, haven't had them like that before. Didn't taste quite as from-the-freezer as what I'm used to from a take away place.

I gave this restaurant 4 stars because it's decent fast food. Not mind blowing, but expected. Nothing to write home about, but a good go-to for take away when I want teriyaki, I suppose.

My favorite froyo place in the valley hands down. Great selection of yogurts and sorbets, abundance of toppings, and great prices.

The only drawback is the incredibly young staff. If something runs out, and it's too close to closing (within 3 hours), good luck sweet talking them into getting more of something.

The addition of the grill was confusing. Kind of an afterthought/bad business decision. I've never seen anyone order food. The primary reason for coming here will always be froyo and I never have a bowl of froyo and say to myself "gosh, I'd really like a burger now."
Excellent ramen and gyoza. Perfect comfort food for a cold evening. I like the Tonkatsu, wife likes the Miso. Will definitely be a regular.
They have the best burgers in town. One of the few places that when you order the five alarm burger, it is actually burn-your-mouth hot, with habenero peppers. Awesome fries too!

We waited 90 minutes to be served the Ramen. So don't go if you're in a hurry or on your lunch break. I got the Miso Ramen, it was bland and I was not impressed. The egg was overcooked as well as the pork. Honestly, I make better Ramen at home. Our waitress was very kind and apologetic about how long our wait was. I was excited for a Ramen restaurant in Boise but I won't be going back.

I come here every time I visit Boise. The location couldn't be better. There's a ton of parking and it's easy to get to. 

I usually get the iced coffee here. The roast used for the iced coffee is so good. It's one of the best iced coffees I've ever had. I also like how you can add a syrup to the iced coffee.

There's a lot of seating inside. It's nice and warm on a cold day too.

A very average restaurant. Nothing exceptional about the ramen at all, it was just " meh"... Overly salty which destroys all the other obviously good ingredients that are in the brith. We wanted to try the rice and ramen combo but were informed that they were out of the plum sauce for the rice so we just got the ramen which wasnt anything to rave about. Service was quick and the server was friendly and attentive, but the food wasnt so good.

I strongly recommend that no one ever steps foot in Camping World of Meridian. My problem with them dates back to last winter when I looking to buy a camper.  I started my search there because it is close to where I work.  I walked in, looked at their selection for 2 hours and was not helped or even greeted by a single employee, let alone a salesperson.  I wound up purchasing from a private party instead. In June when my refridgerater unit failed I made them mistake of giving them a second chance in hopes that their service department would be better. So, I called and made an appointment for July 5 and dropped it off at which time they told me they would not be able to work on it until Monday, which was 4 days later.  When I called monday after work to follow up imagine my surprise when they stated "we have no record  of you in our system, Sir.  Do you know who you might of talked to you?"  I immediately went to their shop, met they person who filled paperwork out and we figured out that the receptionist had transferred me to the Idaho Falls store . I was also told that I needed a new refridgerater unit, but it would take 2 weeks to ship and cost $837. 2 weeks later I get an email saying its here and they will install it the next day.  When I stop in on Wednesday to see how the progress was going I was informed that it was done they would like to test it for 24 hours and would call me on Thursday. I did not get a call so I called them Friday after work to see if I can pick it up.  I asked for the service writer but he was not there so they took my name and number.  The person on the phone was unable to tell me anything about my camper but promised a phone call in 20 minutes.  2 hours later I had not heard back.  I called them again and was told that the service department is closed.  Over the last 3 weeks I have had nothing  but bad experiences and even worse communication.  Never again!

We had the daily lunch special and chicken with mushroom sauce. Mine was midly disgusting with overcooked fried rice, barely edible noodles and sweet chicken. It was about $6 so I guess I couldn't complain.  My husband had basically breaded chicken with gelatinous mushroom sauce. He's usually an easy eater and was still unhappy with the meal. His turned out to be $9. Save your money and appetite for somewhere else.
Love the decor inside of this place! Quiet or perfect for a small meeting. Check out their bathroom. Service is friendly, I'd much rather support a local biz than a major chain like Starbucks.

WOW. This place is AMAZING. A road trip from Washington to Colorado with a strict vegetarian is hard to pull off, so when I saw Boise had Nepali food we HAD to stop. The place was busy, but the set up is efficient and fast. The food is unbelievably fresh, and the momo (dumplings) were tender and fabulous, the saffron rice and black eyed peas were tasty and not over-powered by ham or vinegar flavor like you get in Southern cooking. I ended up buying 2 bottles of the sauce to take back to Washington with me. I have been craving this food ever since, and it kills me there isn't a momo place here.

Side note: the staff are all incredibly sweet and friendly, they really love the food they are making and it shows.

I would seriously plan any future road trips to include a stop in Boise just for the momo.
Always great service. My boyfriend and I always grab a drink or something to eat before watching a movie. Staff is super nice and they always recommend the best drinks.

Reed's is just what North Meridian needed (or what I needed within walking distance of my house, anyway). 

Food: The ice cream is super dense, creamy, and heavenly. I love that you can create hand-packed pints for a cheaper cost than a double scoop. With over 20 flavors to indulge in, you can't go wrong. Cookies & cream, grasshopper and salted caramel cashew are our favorites. 

Drinks: they have chocolate & regular milk for purchase! 

Atmosphere: clean and open, very limited seating. If there's a line it feels pretty packed. 

Service: super friendly kiddos always working. 

Happy Hour Offerings: n/a

Healthy Hack: um... just go for it. Nothing healthy about this place 

Tips: a double scoop is $6. Get a hand-packed pint with WAY more ice cream for $5.

Had the mandarin chicken today. It was super fresh but it was extremely chewy and awkward to eat. Couldn't figure out if the chicken was old, uncooked or just poor choice of meat. Flavor was good and service was nice but I'd go to panda express before I'd come back.

Egg-salad sandwich and fries.  Service was excellent!  Couldn't have asked for a better server.  Attentive, personable and prompt.  Food - ok.  

Egg salad was a traditional mustard, mayo, chopped hardboiled egg and spices spread on white bread (wasn't offered options on the bread).  Garnish included a leaf of lettuce and a wedge of dill pickle.  Came with fries with normal options/substitutions.  I elected for fries (health food and this IS Idaho).

Fries - were cut thin like shoestring potatoes -- maybe slightly larger.  Should have been easy to make golden & crisp.  They were golden, but limp and oily.

Kitchen was amazingly slow.  Server said better to have good food than fast.  Good answer.  I don't think that was it.  They appeared disorganized.  The store was only 25% full.  Three line cooks in back and a 25 min wait time for the cold sandwich and under-cooked fries.

Tried for the first time at their food truck and I thought it was delicious!! The reason I didn't give 5 stars is the cheese wasn't melted all the way in the middle. Don't know if that is a common thing or not, but I'll definitely be back to try again. Wish it was a tad cheaper!! Can get a whole pizza at Blaze for the same price.

I would give 2.5 stars if I could. I didn't find this much better than say, Dennys. Service was excellent and timing good, but food just so so. Maybe if I'd ordered something different  (I had the corned beef hash, which was a bit cold and greasy). The food at other tables looked good, especially pancakes and waffles. I'll try again and order something different next time.
The karaage rice bowl was delicious! A bit pricey but good food and good service. Try the green tea mochi.

I really enjoyed the food but with a family of carnivores and vegetarians it was hard to satisfy everyone. I wish they had more vegetables. 
Yummy sauce and noodles though. 
I'll go back.

I stumbled upon this restaurant during a business trip to Boise.  I tried the tonkotsu ramen and rice bowl combo.  The ramen noodle was ok, but not hot enough.   A bowl of ramen noodle is supposed to be steaming hot.   The rice bowl was cha-shu pork with teriyaki sauce served over rice.   The teriyaki sauce was much too sweet for my taste and I couldn't eat it.   But I can understand they are experimenting with their menu during their 'soft opening'.   3 stars for their food.   

The service on the other hand doesn't deserve any stars.   The waitress was busy chatting with her friends or dancing to the background music most of the time.  Not even once did she come by to see if I needed anything or filled my glass of water.   After my meal was done and waited for a long time for my bill, she finally came so I asked for the bill and a water refill.  She disappeared again for a long time, and when she finally came back with a water pitcher, my table was already bused and the glass was gone.   I told her not to worry but she insisted she would bring me a glass of water.  Well, she came back with a glass filled only 1/3 way with warm water and no ice, which was very peculiar.   When I smelled the water, It had a very strong chlorine/chemical smell, like it came from a cleaning bucket.   I told her the water smelled funny and paid the bill and left...   Not sure if she did this to me intentionally or just an accident, but something like this shouldn't be excusable even if this is their 'soft opening'.

I mean well this food was phenomenal the one thing I'm starting to learn about this city is that y'all really know how to do breakfast around here then or not so much but if you want a good breakfast geez go here I had this lamb egg concoction I Love lamb I love eggs I love this breakfast the family and I will definitely be coming back to this place my kids had a chocolate pancake it was tasty I've had the biscuits and gravy and when you do homemade biscuits you've automatically one our vote they do homemade biscuits did I mention the fresh squeezed orange juice I didn't well they got a machine... They squeezed orange is right there right into a pitcher and straight from that pitcher they poured into your glass oh good....

I have driven by this place for years. After our favorite Chinese buffet that was located on Fairview Avenue closed, we had to look for a new place. This is about as good as it gets in Meridian. The place was very clean, very accommodating and had a HUGE spread for their buffet. There was sushi, much to my wife's delight. There was one part of the buffet dedicated to a Mongolian style grill. A fresh salad bar. And of course two steam tables full of yummy Chinese style food. The prices were moderate, the server was on top of everything, including refilling our drinks and clearing plates. I would recommend this place, and we will definitely be going back soon.

Some of the best crepes I've ever come across, you would be doing yourself an injustice by not getting an order of crepes here, perfect crepe outside with an awesome cream cheese filling I keep going back for more! 5/5 good eats

What a wonderful dinner last night.  Generous portions, great service.  Fabulous latte.  Small-ish menu, but that is so they can concentrate of those dishes!  However, what just pissed me off is that it was Thursday night, and the place was pretty much EMPTY!  Of course the Red Robin chain restaurant was hoping across the parking lot.  Seriously, folks, support the small local guy who makes every dish with love and care.  I love Red Robin, and it is probably a local  who owns it, but these small restaurants CANNOT SURVIVE if people don't patronize them!  They don't have the advertising budget of the big chains! So do your patriotic duty and get out there and eat out a local restaurant that cooks with heart!

I went to MoMos for lunch and it was better then expected. I had the turkey and yak dumplings and the yak doesn't taste bad at all. I also had the chai tea and it was too strong for my taste and was way too hot to sip on during my meal. The veggie salad is highly preferred and the chicken curry sauce is a must. I would try Momo's at least once if you haven't already!

We picked a new place in Meridian /Boise  area and headed for Barnyard  Kitchen and Bar on a week night. Great food with a southern comfort flavor. You will enjoy it! The sockeye salmon was delicious. And serving water- melon with their meals was nice for summer!

This place bloody sucks! Maybe it's just what I ordered - the New York Strips were overdone but the inside was raw RAW! There was a rubbery tendon inside (the waitress told me that the chef said it was intentional to enhance the taste?!?). Yes - tendon can taste good if it's been cooking over a long period of time, but this was meal was defn. rushed. Come to think of it - there was no reason for that even: the place was empty on a FRIDAY EVENING! Everyone else was at the bar across the street. My brother's pork chops were bland and dry. The only DECENT dish was the appetizer pork belly, but even that was overcooked. Do avoid
The spicy ramen was good. We will definitely come back again.  The pork belly could be a little more tender but the broth was good and very satisfying.

We gave Camping World 2 chances to service our 5th wheel. Both times we were epically disappointed. The first time we dropped our RV off at their service center, they did none of the work they were supposed to do, and instead gave us a list of excuses as to why they didn't do any of the work. We gave them another chance a couple months later. Again, we dropped our RV to be serviced, and again we were extremely disappointed. This time, they put the wrong color decal on the exterior of our RV, they replaced our king size bed set with a queen size set (we have a king size bed), they did not install the cabinet door they were supoosed to install but rather lost the hardware for the door that we had paid for out of pocket, and they broke our closet door hinge. We then took our RV to Dennis Dillon, and they fixed everything in a professional timely manner. Save yourself a world of headache and frustration and only take your RVs to Dennis Dillon.
This place was amazing! So sad it is closing in Boise! Go to it in Meridian!!!! You don't want to miss out.
Catering is great for business lunches. Right on time and sandwiches disappeared quick. :) Will definitely order again.

We had a yummy dinner with helpful service. My husband ordered the beef stroganoff, and I got the sirloin. Both were good dishes for the price and portions...we'd both order them again. Our waitress was training another server, both of them were attentive, helpful, and professional. Overall a very good experience.

I realize this is a 'soft opening.' but honestly, I don't feel they are ready to be open. Period. The first time I went, their day 3 of being open, things were definitely disjointed... but the food was pretty good... at least what was available... two choices.  I did not think the meat was high quality and did not eat it, but the noodles, broth, and 1/2 egg were good.  The appetizer (the only one offered) came well into our meal, but was very good.  

We happened to be downtown today at almost 1 pm, and went back. We were told there would be a 30 minute wait.  AFTER waiting 25 minutes, we were told we would be waiting ANOTHER 30 minutes.  Had I known the wait was going to be an hour, I would have eaten elsewhere, without wasting 25 minutes standing in a line. We left.  Hungry. And annoyed. 

I saw the same black tape blocking out the unavailable items in the menu... maybe temporary paper menus or something else?  Anything but Black tape?  There were tables, and space for additional tables, unused on the veranda, and come to find out, a whole section of the restaurant looks like a big/dirty break room for employees... long tables, open bags of chips... fine.  But maybe clean it up and add eating bars or tables... communal even. Communal would be perfect, really. 

I think I will be back... but this soft opening is too soft, and not off to a good start.  The ramen itself is decent, but needs mix ins (chili oil, etc), more topping options, more toppings period, more variety period. 

The restaurant needs management, proper staffing, trained staff, and additional seating... for which ample space appears available.  Bring trays of appetizers out and 'sample' them to those in your long line.  Play some music.  Make it exciting, and fun!  Welcome people like you want their business.  Smile.  Be efficient.  Communicate effectively. 

I want this place to work.  Please, someone who can make the changes, read this and other reviews.  Work the bugs out and open when you are ready to be open and bring your A game.  Boise deserves that, after waiting so long for a dedicated ramen spot.  We will support you... we're serious about our local food scene!  Give us something to rave about, and delicious noodles to show off to our friends, family, and out of town guests.
My wife and I both love CupBop! She really enjoys the gluten-free bowl, it's nice to have an option like that. We will be repeat customers for sure!

I am writing this review because I really want people to know how nice this store is but...  When it first opened the staff was very nice and helpful, that's changed a bit.  I like the selection and the price is a bit high but I don't shop here all the time.  Between Fred Meyer, Natural Grocers and the Co-op, I am able to get what I am looking for.  Back to the staff.  I have asked for 2 things on two different occasions that they did not have.  Both people I spoke to were very nice and said someone would be calling me to let me know if they could bring the items in or what the results were of their search.  No one has gotten back to me and its been a few months.  This last weekend I went in and shopped and got my usual cashier who is usually very nice and she was not this time.  I asked for my 10% monthly discount on my bill and did not get it.  When I called in to see if it could be credited the gentleman on the phone was in a hurry and I felt like I was putting him out by his tone and fast words.  He said to come in this weekend and I could pick up a gift card for the amount that was not credited and his hurry to get off the phone was very noticable.  Overall in the last week the service seems to be going down hill.  I felt like I was putting these people out.  This makes me bummed because I really like this place.  There is a guy who bags my groceries and a gal in the cheese department that are amazing.  I am wondering if something is going on with employee satisfaction or if maybe some of the crew just needs a little training boost in customer service.  If things get better I will increase my rating but I probably won't be going shopping at the Co-Op as often as I have been, for now anyway.

Great place for a nice cup of coffee. Not as sugary as Dutch Bros Coffee which I like. Great balance of flavors. Nice drive through and great interior. Lots of nice flavors to choose from and great customer service. I rate this place 10 out of 10

Hands down the friendliest, most detail-oriented, most legit place I've been for an oil change....ever. And the biggest pro....even my hubby trusts and likes them, and he's a tough one to please when it comes to automotive care. 

You sit in your car during the oil change, with monitors you can watch to see what they're doing. They check literally everything. Lights, tires and tire pressure, the list goes on and on. Highly recommended!

My wife had the Pulled Pork Po' Boy. Pretty good. My personal preference would have been to add a BBQ sauce and not Sriracha Mayo. To give the dish five stars, I would pre-fry the French fries during prep. Then finish them at 350 degrees in the fryer. You will get a more crisp, crunchy fry. Believe me!
I had the fried chicken. Cooked to order. Very crunchy, crispy outside. Piping hot inside. Absolutely delicious. The spicy watermelon was perfect. Just a little heat. Although I believe the cole slaw portion was a little skimpy. Cool presentation.
We will be back. We are going to try out breakfast next.

Stopped by for lunch today, ordered the combo with hotbop and uglybop. The place was clean, and attitude of the workers was pleasant, and rather quirky. The food itself is what brought me to the three star rating. It was better than I expected, but not something I'd go out of my way to eat. The uglybop fried chicken was the highlight, and saved the bowl from complete failure. I tried four of the sauces. Not sure what they were all called. The yellow orange sauce, had a yellow mustard taste, that clashed with the style of food I was eating. The "#10 heat" hot sauce looked like schriracha, but lacked the depth in flavor. It was surprisingly hot, and had an underlying Gochujang flavor. Was only able to sample one mandoo dumpling. Great taste with ginger, and a hint of slight smoke flavor. Will definitely order more next time I'm there. I will also go with noodles only. The combo of noodles and rice just didn't hit the spot.

Stopped in while visiting a friend who lives in Boise. Tap list was great. Selection of Northwest beers to buy by the bottle was awesome. Enjoyed a chipotle BBQ chicken craft bread that went perfect with the beer on tap. Will be a return customer anytime I'm back in the area.
Excellent and soooooo delicious. When are we going to see CupBop in southeast Boise????

The food is so good!!! You get white rice, clear noodles, cabbage or lettuce and your choice of meat or tofu! It's healthy and yummy! You get to pick how spicy you want it ! 
KOREAN BBQ is the best!!!!

Visiting the area and stopped here based on Yelp reviews. We just wanted to grab some pastries to go. But they closed 30 minutes earlier than the hours listed on the door. Employees just stared at us through the door. Okay. Went to Kneader's instead.

Love the store and the employees.  They're great; but I'll never have another Home Depot contractor work for me again. I expect upfront costs, so I know my budget, and their counter people (Precision Counters) did a poor estimate job and came back with several  hundred more in hidden costs related to their mistakes. They basically held our deposit over our heads. I wanted to give the business to their competitor, but they had our money and Home Depot wouldn't back us up. 

Their installers were great, but the counters marginal quality. By going through Home Depot, it feel like we lost all ability to ensure we were treated fairly.
There isn't a better place in Idaho to get a beer. Lots of choices from all over the country and the world.

So different and absolutely delicious! Highly recommend! They have a very warm and welcoming staff who seems very happy to walk you through your first time so do not be intimidated! The bowls are enough for two meals and make great leftovers!
Only ate here for breakfast but its great every time. Love a good ole dinner that have amazing food and great staff.
Two words: "Chorizo Benedict".  It's just another piece of proof that someone up there loves us and wants us to be happy.

Absolutely the best coffee in town. I always order a flat white and it's always perfect. The staff and new owner (Kolby) are friendly and welcoming, and the food is AMAZING! They have a ton of options for those with special preferences, and their coffee is the best! Great place to hold a meeting, do homework, or hang out with friends!

Hubby asked me what I would like for lunch, and of course I said CupBop.  He had Ugly Pop Bop with butter garlic sauce, and I had Doochi Bop with sweet chili sauce.  My tofu was perfect, crunchy on the outside and creamy on the inside. Both were good, but next time I'm going to ask for no rice and extra cabbage in place of the rice.  I love that they have a physical address besides the food truck.

This used to be my favorite place but have recently switched out their entire staff.  The new staff is rude.  They ridiculed and shamed me for removing the acrylic nails they had put on 3 weeks prior.  When I explained that I couldn't come in prior to the 3 weeks, he shook his head repeatedly.   One by one, he held each finger up and shook his head.
The following week I went in to get a pedicure.   Different man but same rhetoric.   Obsessed with who had removed the gel nail polish from my toes.  When I told him I did, he said that wasn't possible.  Then continued to ask me over and over.  Finally, I told him that I had made a mistake in coming to CoCos and apologized for coming in without both my nails and toes in the perfect state that they expect.  Never going back!
Took almost a hour to get our dinner and it wasn't even busy. But your waitress was very nice and working hard. They gave us a discount for having to wait so long.

Husband and I had the best experience last night for dinner. Service was great. Everyone went out of their way to accommodate requests we had made regarding our food. Asian pork sandwich was fantastic and the Santa Fe salad was wonderful as well. Portions were large enough for the two of us overweight seniors to split our meals and leave very full indeed. Just can't say enough about friendly service and a business that really seems to care for its customers.

I've been wanting to try CupBop for a while now. We finally got the chance and it wasn't disappointing. It's far from authentic Korean cuisine, if that's what you're looking for, but it has its own unique flavor. I wasn't sure how to feel about it at the time, but I would definitely try it again.

I ordered the kids bop, as I wasn't all that hungry, and it seemed to be the perfect amount for me. I got chicken as my meat, with the cabbage, lettuce, rice, and sweet potato noodles that are in everything. 

They have a nice way of customizing your meal- you choose your spice level on a scale from 1-10. I can't handle spice too well, but I chose 6 on the scale, and it ended up being the perfect balance of spice and flavor for me. It wasn't overwhelming, but I definitely needed a drink every now and then. The sauces they put on top are spicy mayo, and a spicy red sauce that resembles Sriracha. We were also able to try the potstickers, which were good but nothing special. 

All in all, the food wasn't the best thing I had ever had, but it definitely was a unique flavor that I'll crave again some time.

My cousins and I stayed at the Country Inn & Suites by Carlton in Meridian ID for 4 days in June of 2016. We had separate rooms. My cousins got very poor room cleanings. The cleaning staff SKIPPED CLEANING MY ROOM one day during the stay.  I called the front desk to alert them to this. They said, "It's been a very busy day, but I'll make sure the cleaning staff knows you want it cleaned."  That call took place at 2:11pm. I left the room and returned at 6:30pm. THE ROOM WAS STILL NOT CLEANED...NOT TOUCHED. I called the front desk again and was informed that the cleaning staff had left for the day. The girl at the front desk said she was the only person on duty at the hotel until the next morning. She did offer me the option of switching rooms. At that point, I was tired and didn't want to move all my things. This has never happened to me at a HOTEL... not even when I have stayed at MOTELS. It was disappointing and I would not stay at a hotel in this chain again.
The biscuits were really dry but the fresh squeeze orange juice was amazingly refreshing. Our food could've had more flavor to it, too bland for a restaurant. The service was really good though.
Clayton is very attentive and accommodating. I enjoyed my facial very much, especially the uv light and arm massage. My skin looks great and rejuvenated. I will definitely be back.

Wow....what a pleasant surprise. Great food, great flavors that enhance the natural flavor of the quality ingredients. All the staff was very friendly and helpful. We will be back for sure!!! The breakfast menu looks amazing. We really enjoyed the atmosphere..... country and modern.

Dreamland has everything we wanted in a daycare. We did several walk thru's before finding this one & Dreamland won hands down. It's a very clean & tidy center. All rooms are large and give children plenty of space. They teach manners & have fun educational activities. The staff is kind and treat my children with love & respect. It gives me peace of mind knowing my most precious pieces of my heart are being well cared for.

This is an excellent example of where an excellent breakfast can be obtained. I've never had any menu items at this particular restaurant that weren't perfect. The Philly Cheesesteak omelet is absolutely to die for! Also the staff has always been very helpful and friendly. The entire Dennys chain should use this as the standard bearer!!!

I have had several people tell me that Reed's Dairy had opened and that it should be a tradition to have their ice cream after working in the new Meridian LDS Temple that is just a few blocks away. Tonight I had been driving from Salt Lake City up to McCall and I wanted a shake to enjoy and keep me awake for the last 2 hours of my drive back to McCall. I stopped and the store was clean and bright with 2 young employees working. I was greeted quickly. After trying a few different flavors of ice cream, I asked about the shakes. They put any flavor ice cream and then blend in either their dairy's regular milk or chocolate milk. I noticed the lemon ice cream with raspberry ribbon and thought that would not be a good combination with chocolate milk. Instead I chose Big Daddy (chocolate ice cream with almonds, chocolate chips, and Caramel ribbon) blended in with chocolate milk. It was delicious. One very nice touch was they gave me a mammoth thick straw which was awesome for drinking the shake.

This will be a regular stop after volunteer working in the temple.

We purchased our 2018 Keystone Cougar Travel Trailer 2 weeks ago and just love it!  Being one that is somewhat suspicious and hesitant with large purchases, I was pleasantly surprised on how smooth and stress-free the entire experience was.  Beginning with our salesperson Megan, who was fun and made us feel completely at ease while we shopped and answered all of the questions we asked or the finance manager Efrem who we felt completely comfortable with in closing our deal.  I feel we got the best possible outcome we could have received.  We also want to thank Rick, our service tech who conducted our final inspection and walk-thru prior to us pulling the trailer off the lot.  He was awesome.  We did not feel rushed and he took his time explaining everything that we asked.  We did have one small issue with the trailer while on our maiden 3 day campout.  The A/C was not working properly.  We called Camping World from our campground and spoke with Ron.  To our surprise he in turn sent Jeff (Service Tech) to our campground to inspect and repair the problem.  Jeff replaced the thermostat in the trailer and we were quickly back enjoying our "cool" Travel Trailer.  Great Service!  You can't ask for any better then this.  Our sincere appreciation to all of you at Camping World!  You're the bomb!
  Sincerely,

Carl & Judy Pierce
 (Star, Id)

I thought this little place was pretty neat; although I didn't try any of their food, I did order some ice cream. I had the cookies 'n cream and it was delicious. I would love to go back the next time I'm in town for a meal.
We love this place. Excellent food at great prices and pretty much any beer your heart desires. Yum yum for your tum tum! :)

We went tonight and we were able to get A table that we wanted right away. We got amazing service and she always checked in on us but it was not too much. The food was absolutely amazing. We had chips and salsa, some wings, the steak salad, fish and chips, and the Gorgonzola chicken pasta. Would highly recommend these selections. Amazing time!

* Kinda crazy idea: pizza cones. Why not? Four basic cones for the simple minded: pepperoni, cheese, sausage, and veggie. I had the sausage, which was pretty good, but not as filling as two slices of normal pizza. So I ordered a veggie cone afterward. Yes this is rather abnormal; seems more like holding a calzone in your hand.
* I don't dislike the food here at all, but there is room for improvement. For example the crust or cone is a little bland. Maybe spice it up with some garlic butter, some anise seeds, some crushed red pepper.
* There are no waffle-style ice cream cones here, which is a shame. Because I just don't care for ice cream on pizza crust.
* There are only four tables here, and even though they are long tables, none of the steel chairs felt comfortable. The two aluminum top tables remind me of mechanic's workbenches.

Worst customer service I've ever had. My ice cream came to a total of 4$ and some change and the poor girl who clearly didn't know how to do her job handed me back 10$ from a 20$. After that we ordered our food and got drinks and then another poorly trained girl removed the soda spout so we were unable to get drinks and had to wait for 2 different employees to try and fix it. And to top it off what looked to the be the manager was kicking out some old man for asking questions and shut the door so we couldn't hear the dibocal. We will never be back untill they can get a fully equipped staff.

HORRIBLE! 
My wife bought me a $400 jacket. The first time I tried to zip in the liner it broke. They charged me $45 to fix it. They were rude and acted like they were doing me a favor. 
When I complained about the charge they told me it was excessive wear. 2 month old, overpriced garbage that they sold me and it's already wearing out?
Their stock is poor quality that they over price to make you think you are getting quality, and zero customer service. You're better off buying gear at Walmart.

We love the griddle, it is our go to place for brunch. They have amazing crepes and omelettes. The orange juice is as fresh as you can get! Must go to place. 
If you go on Saturday or Sunday make sure you get there early or be willing to wait 40 minutes to an hour. I would say unless you are totally starving it is worth the wait.

My bar is high, I've eaten at every ramen joint in NYC & LA, obsessively. I spend two days cooking for one night of ramen at home. Critiques aside. Thank god my favorite bowl of soul is in Boise. Thank you. The Tonkatsu broth was delicious, noodles perfectly chewy; Ramen Sho is on the right track. Chashu could use a touch of work and their additions are growing but all in all a damn fine bowl of noodles that we needed desperately. Welcome Ramen Sho! See you soon.

I don't often go to Denny's for anything but breakfast and today I learned again that there are reasons to go to other places for lunch.

 The good:  We were seated promptly and drinks were brought quickly. My mom enjoyed the grilled tilapia, saying that though she expected it to be dry, it was not dry and was done well. She also liked the chicken noodle soup. My wife liked the chicken caesar salad but said it was not nearly as good a dressing as it could be. My grilled cheese sandwich was almost as good as homemade.

The rest: Drink refills were slow to come and the food took a lot longer to come out than I expected even for a moderately busy lunch  "rush". My only real complaint was that  the primary seasoning of the greasy beef veg soup was obviously salt. 

Pretty average diner food in a pretty average diner but I still LOVE the fluffy pancakes!

Absolutely love CupBop! Pick your meat, your bowl, and flavor with whatever sauces you choose. I find myself craving their food all the time. The staff is so friendly and helpful if it's your first time there. Definitely a place to try! The only thing they need now is a drive thru so I don't have to haul my kids in every time I'm craving it! Ha

This place is wonderful and better than the competition whom I will not name. With such a great menu to select from I had a difficult time choosing from such a great menu. Also fast and friendly service. I had the Spicy Asian Pork which is too die for with lots of flavor. Visiting from Tacoma, Wa

Wish there was Corner Bakery near my location.

My husband and I went 'browsing' for a new travel trailer at Bish's and Camping World in July 2018. We did not like the vibe at Bish's: it was more like pushy sales tactics. Ryan at CW spent a lot of time showing us all the trailers we wanted without making us feel rushed. He gave us his honest opinion about the different units until we settled on a Keystone Cougar and committed to try to make a deal. Ryan was able to find us the color scheme we preferred and had it brought over from another state. The 'deal' process was fairly painless and did include some back-and-forth with Ryan to management, but they came up to the deal we wanted and were true to their word. When we came back to sign papers and pick up the trailer, they do this whole production where you get a nametag/lanyard and they announce your names over the PA, and you meet with different representatives including the manager of the service department who took us through our trailer and showed us everything we needed to know. I'll admit I was wary of buying from CW after reading some negative reviews, but I am pleased with my experience and felt we were treated with value.  They also let me ring the gong!
French Roast Coffee tasted like water. Don't waste your money here. I love supporting small businesses but getting a $2.50 cup of brown water is not how I like to start my day.

Went here last night for dinner and a drink before a movie. Makayla took us to our table and was also our waitress. So friendly, upbeat and efficient, she was a super-star server. We were lucky enough to arrive during happy hour and it certainly made us happy! Started with a fabulous Village Collins made with huckleberry vodka. Refreshing and delicious, the perfect drink on a hot summer night. Our app was a chicken quesadilla with guacamole. Nice sized with good chicken and guac and a nice amount of sour cream.  My only gripe was the tortilla was not crisp and not easy to cut. Also had the Short Film burger with cheddar and fries. Skin on shoestring fries accompanied a yummy, well seasoned, juicy burger that was properly cooked. Unfortunately a star falls from my rating when my dessert order did not arrive promptly and had to be cancelled so I could get to my movie. Overall, I really enjoyed the food, drinks and especially Makayla's exceptional service. I shall return!
Great knowledgeable staff! Always pleasant and easy to talk to. The first Amendment black IPA is amazing!

I don't normally spend $49 for a car wash but our car was so dirty from traveling that I decided to go for it.  I was very impressed by the outcome. They spent a lot of time on the interior and it showed.  I could not find anything that had not been cleaned from the front area to the trunk.  If your vehicle is real dirty, I definitely recommend this level of cleaning.
I love this coffee shop! Jordan is my barista and he is always friendly and strives to remember each customers' name. And, on top of that, the Mexican mocha tastes legit.

Worst customer service ever. Bought a brand new class c motor home and had some quality issues. Toilet seat hinge broke on our first trip. 5 weeks to get a new toilet seat from manufacturer. Outrageous. Went to take a shower but no one told us we did not have electronic start for water heater. Trip with no shower, cause we thought it was broken?! Probably would have used propane if we knew, we had a 50 minute walk thru that they told us to plan on 2 hours minimum, when we purchased. Had to pick up unit for a trip and will have to bring back end of September when our toilet seat arrives from Timbuktu I guess( 5 weeks).

Awesome customer service. I've never been to a place like this before! The fact that you wait in the comfort of your own vehicle while it is being serviced is definitely worth that 5th star! They walk you through everything they're doing, they don't try and recommend unnecessary work to try and make bigger sales. They are polite and professional with some fun thrown in. 
We will be going through these guys from now on!

The Boise area isn't known for an abundance of fine Asian cuisine - or an abundance at all. Was in the mood and felt like delivery, so gave them a try after looking at "all" the others one more time. 

Was very pleasantly surprised that ordering process was so simple I did not have to slowly repeat everything 20 times. The biggest complaint I had was that food arrived nearly an hour prior to scheduled time - a very forgivable thing for hot and edible food.

Overall the food was very average - nothing stellar, but have attempted to eat much worse The chicken chow mein was a bright spot and the fried rice and battered chicken not far behind. The egg rolls were ok, but soft with a slightly off flavor. 

The meal arrived well packaged and without mistake. The young man delivering was very pleasant and eager to address any potential issue.  All in all worth a second shot. I've never been in the restaurant but rate it a three based on both on food and on pleasantry of entire transaction.

My opinion ; Same ingredients in ramen bowl the differences is the sauce that added to the broth. Nothing special. The ramen noodles is a bit thick should cook a bit more. We love the way they cooked gyoza though even though they didn't make it them self fresh.

What goes with an evening at home, movie's and beer?  Pizza! Papa Murphys Take and Bake has never let me down when I want a fresh pizza where the crust is not saturated in grease.  They have a variety of pizza options for the different taste buds in your family. You can choose your fresh dough: pan, thin, original, stuffed and gluten free.

Tonight we had The Cowboy- pepperoni,  sausage, sliced mushrooms,  and black olives on traditional red sauce with herb and cheese. It was on special tonight so we got a family size for $13 which happens to be a family favorite. Friday nights also come with an added bonus for an additional $5 you can get two sides when you order a pizza.  I didn't go the side route this time, but there will always be another Friday night where I might want sides with my pizza.

The service was great and the waiting area was clean.

My wife and I stopped for dinner.  She had the Mac n Cheese.  I got the Open Face Turkey sandwich and we split a side of corn bread.  I asked my wife how she liked her meal and she replied, "eh".  I tried her mac n cheese and it was bland.  I'd much prefer Kraft.  The turkey was OK, a little dry but the gravy made up for it.  The corn bread was also OK.  All in all I'd prefer Marie Callender's.  It was....eh.
Great service no pressure. Made good on an issue regarding tear in front seat. Would recommend to anyone.

This is on my top 3 FAVORITE places to have breakfast. The customer service is great most of the time and even while busy, my max wait was 30 minutes when the place was packed full which isn't too bad. I always go for their eggs benedict. The eggs are never overcooked and their hollandaise sauce is AMAZING. It also comes with a side hasbrowns and they're always cooked perfectly and little crispy. They also have really yummy specails that are generally covered in cheese  I've never had anything from this place I didn't like! My knack is defiantly the Benedict though.

This place is definitely worth a try! For me the experience is the real reason I'd come back. The price is kind of high considering one cone is two slices of pizza. You pay $6 for a basic cone and $7 for the premium cones. You could easily eat two & thats roughly $15 after taxes when you can get a whole pizza for that. Also the dough isn't what I thought it would be. It could've had some more flavor or be more crispier. The service was amazing though & it's interesting watching the process!

I had a 'secondary exhaust' issue previously and Meineke Meridian did the work and I was very satisfied with the cost and the workmanship. This latest repair was for a cracked front exhaust manifold on my 2005 Nissan Murano. I shopped around and could have had the repair done a bit cheeper, but would have had to wait 2-3 days for the part. Meineke got the part right away, and even provided me a loaner vehicle for the afternoon. The additional cost was well worth the excellent service and quality repair. I will consider this shop for future repairs and would highly recommend them.

I cannot even begin to say how much my daughter LOVES Dreamland!! She is greeted every day by the sweetest teachers. Every day she cannot wait to go to school!! Which is a far cry from how she used to be when I used to take her to a different daycare. 
The ladies here are so loving and kind. I have not toured another daycare that I felt the same way about. It instantly felt like home away from home And when I do come to pick her up, she is having so much fun she doesn't want to leave!! Knowing that she is in such a safe and happy place makes me more productive at my own job, because I know she's cared for so well. I would recommend Dreamland to anyone considering a daycare!!!! And I didn't even mention how many things shes learned... she comes home and tells her brother some of the stuff she was taught that day and they're amazed  give them a call today, you will not be disappointed

Horrible bank for mortgages. We were working with Bank of the West and were told we qualified for a refinance. We provided endless amounts of information and even paid for an appraisal (FYI: our credit card refunded the appraisal fee as we were able to prove Bank of the West ordered the appraisal under false pretense) and then given the run around for 5 months. I finally realized they were not going to perform. I contacted Wells Fargo. Wells Fargo was amazing and completed our refinance within 45 days.

We own several properties and I use to be a real estate broker, thus I have been involved in countless real estate purchases and refinances.  Bank of the West is the worst brokerage experience I have ever had; a waste of time, money and ones precious sanity!
I've never gone wrong with anything on the menu but I keep coming back to the Caribbean French Toast! It's amazing.

Visited this little local gem tonight for some brews and dinner. Pizza was delicious, beer was cold and refreshing, and the bar keeper (Tatiana) was inviting, friendly, HOT, and gave some suggestions for my lunch here in Boise tomorrow. When I was done eating and drinking I built my own six pack of beers from the largest of selections in the Northwest and continued my fun conversation with Tatiana. I can't wait until my next trip to southwest Idaho so that I can come here again after a day of work! If you are thirsty/hungry/like good looking girls, I highly recommend that you visit Brewforia Beer Market!
Shakes & ice cream are AWESOME. Inventive, creative & delicious. Hamburgers are so-so. Onion rings very good.

YAY on the 148,000 combinations of drinks you can offer...minus one star for the mouth-burning breakfast burrito that kept leaping all over my pants instead of my mouth. The tater tots hash browns were a bit too salty, but also burning hot. Just cause I lost my taste buds back over my Southwest flight over here, doesn't mean I don't treasure the few I still have left these days...hehe...

So now I'm not a Sonic virgin anymore, and now those ads back in SF makes sense now. Why not advertise for Dairy Queen for us poor San Fran'ers who don't have the convenience of hunting down said eateries (grin).

If your tastebuds are open to different ethnic food, you'll enjoy Ramen Sho. I'm fortunate to have a mom who prepares this Japanese comfort food (even though she's not Japanese). Not your standard ramen you get at the store when you're in need of cheap dorm food. The broth was so good, and when you add some spice - it's a little slice of heaven. They also have vegetarian options. It's a must if you're here in Boise.

I was so excited to try this new bakery, and being in the mood for something sweet my daughter and I decided to drop in while out shopping.
The ambiance was nice, and the cafe looked clean. That, however, is where the positives stop.  

We weren't in the mood to sit down and eat, so instead opted for two desserts to go. I chose the chocolate moon pie and my daughter chose the mini chocolate bundt cake.

Let's start with the least disappointing one first. The bundt was a great size, and it looked appetizing. It was moist enough, and the texture was good,but the chocolate flavor was missing. It looked like it would be decadent with rich chocolate flavor, and it fell far short. It was merely ok. It's nothing to try again by any means.

My moon pie looked amazing - 2 chocolate brownie looking cookies filled with cream cheese frosting. Though it looked great, it was anything but. The wrapper it came In was soaked with grease from the cookies. When I took a bite the grease was the first and last thing I noticed YUCK!  The filling was ok, but the cookie portion , along with being disgustingly greasy was also lacking in any rich chocolate flavor. I took 2 bites and tossed it.

We will not be returning to the Corner Bakery Cafe. I would recommend going Dow the road a mile and getting treats at Kneaders instead!

Himalayan food?  What is it? I can't even pronounce most of the things on the menu.   So I've walked by this place many times because it just doesn't look like it's for me.  Not a big curry fan.  

Well Today I decided to try something new and got some tips from a follow yelper on what to try. And let me tell you I'm so glad I did. SO GOOD!  The dumplings are awesome and the chicken curry was so delicious. Yes I said curry. It's a bit different than other places.  You just need to try it and see for yourself.   The rice and beans were also very fresh and very good.   They also give you  a side of some sauce either spicy or not.  Which both are very good but the spicy is the way to go. 

The staff is so freindly and they understand that not everyone gets the menu. They will explain everything to you and give you lots of samples.  They are super proud of what they are serving and are excited to show first timers like me the Himalayan way.   I really like this locally owned and operated restaurant.   Just give this place a try you'll be happy you did!  I sure am!

We were looking at SUVs online and had heard great things about Carmax, Boise. (Which is actually in Meridian.) My Husband made a call and spoke with Ryan H. After giving him all of the details of the buying/selling situation he said, "Why don't we start with getting your current car appraised and we can go from there." Smart move because that was all that really needed to be accomplished. We knew what we wanted in our next vehicle, but we were not set on model. We went diwn a few hours later and met with Ryan H. He was knowledgeable about the various models. When I asked about a certain SUV he asked me what the price range was and then stated that it may be more than I wanted to spend. I found the fact that he did not want to push us out of the range we wanted to spend refreshing. In the end we got the price we wanted for our trade in and we are in awe of our fabulous new ride. Ryan H.'s sales style seems that he just wants to do a great job for you. Next we worked with Trudy to sign all the paperwork. She was so friendly and fast. Finally, the icing on the cake...they put a bow on the new ride. A HUGE bow. Made me smile. We managed to sell, test drive and buy a new vehicle in just over 90 minutes with a 14 month old baby in tow. We just went to get an appraisal!!! Great work Carmax, Boise!!

Don't ever open a Home Depot credit card. They will lie to you about promotions and say anything to get you to open the card. Then when you are charged fees that you were promised you wouldn't be charged, they won't fix it. They'll just apologize and say "There's nothing we can do about it." Beware - this store will say anything to get you to sign up!
Love the service. Sheradan was spectacular. I could tell the food has high quality ingredients by the taste and flavor. Ramen Sho is a new regular spot.

We went in here to check out some used trailers and were very pleased with the customer service from all the workers but our salesman Todd Taylor was a straight shooter and very sincere! We appreciated him greatly!!! Thank you!
Amazing employees making a disaster a little less traumatic.  I appreciated the professionalism, timeliness and quality of work.

We really like this place. Came hear twice for breakfast. They serve the best omelette we've ever had in our travels. All food is fresh.  Also, my wife came here twice for lunch. The salad with goat cheese and beets was tremendous.

Awesome! Perfect thick cut crispy bacon, delicious hash browns, eggs cooked perfectly, absolutely amazing out of this world Raspberry Crepes!! Fast good service. Food came out fast. Great place to eat!
Thanks but no thanks. Waited 20 minutes for a repeat beer. Owner came over and defended her waitress. SMH I'm done...

Ok, I have to admit...  For years I was NOT a fan of Starbucks.  Yeah, I had been drinking Starbucks for years, and thought they weren't bad but not that great. I am definitely a coffee lover, and in the past, I had my favorite local coffee houses and roasters that I loved.  Well, time passes, and things change, and now the places I once loved (along with their delicious coffee) are gone, and nothing more than a memory.  :-(  At some point in time, my wife told me that there was something about this particular Starbucks in Meridian.  The coffee was simply really, really good.  Well, I tried it, and she was right.  We have drank Starbucks coffee all over North America, from Seattle, to New York City, to Orlando, to Anaheim, and this Starbucks here in little ol' Meridian Idaho has them all beat.  I don't know what it is.  Is it the water?  Do they throw a little extra coffee in there?  Is it just the love they put into it?  I don't know, but this place consistently brews a really really good cup of coffee.  I also love their Chai Tea drinks.


[ My Dad is in hospital, texted me this: "My Dr only gave me 6 months to live - so I chose October to April 2056." ]

Corner bakery is consistently a great place for lunch or bakery items.  Have eaten  at many locations and I have found the food to be good and the prices are very reasonable.   Also ordered mini sweets for a Christmas party and they were a huge hit.  I think they are a step above  Panara...which I love,

Sadly, today was our last visit to The Griddle. Overpriced food, very bitter coffee, portions are getting smaller and smaller and it's very hit and miss on getting your food to your table hot, or even warm. When we first moved here we loved this place. Not so much anymore. The quality of the food isn't consistent and service can be very hit or miss. There are better, more reasonably priced breakfast places in Meridian and Boise which we will be going to from now on.
The atmosphere is nice and it does get really busy on the weekends. If they continue on the path we've experienced this may not be a problem in the future.

So glad this place is becoming popular! I have been here twice and would continue going back. Food is very flavorful and I love the option to make your meal as spicy (or not) as you would like. 
The atmosphere is very fun. Bright colors and upbeat music make this restaurant a very upbeat spot. The staff was very friendly, fast, and helpful to any newcomers. Can't wait to go back and try more options!
Wonderful, friendly staff!  Sam groomed my Havanese and did a great job.  I highly recommend this establishment to anyone who wants their dog treated the best!
I really love this place! My family doesn't like it as much so I can only when I'm alone. So I sneak off alone a lot to go. My fav is the fried chicken with cabbage and medium sauce.

We went tonight and spent $30 and tipped the employees, then I handed them my punch card and they refused to punch it because I had already paid. I will never go there again! I have lots of grandkids who love frozen yogurt and there are lots of yogurt places with good customer service.

I can't understand the poor reviews.  The job was well done and very thorough, going well beyond any previous experience.  In the past, companies I've hired have come only with a portable vacuum and hand drill with a pipe snake attached.  Boise Air Duct Cleaning came in with a truck that put a vacuum to the entire system, then scraped, wiped and blew everything out.  The before and after pictures are dramatic.  In addition, a gap left between the main supply duct and furnace was pointed out, and poor seals around HVAC access doors were fixed.  Arrived and completed the job on schedule.
Awesome place for coffee, visits, and breakfast/lunch!!! Lisa is amazing and the staff is attentive. Delicious soup!

Had a tree die 2 months after planting. All the other trees and other plants in my yard are doing great. I took a picture of the tree (per their instruction) and the copy of the receipt that they gave me to effect a replacement. What I got was a run around, they will not honor the exchange unless I produce the yellow copy of the receipt, not withstanding their admission that the copy is a bona fide copy that they gave me. Their return policy SUCKS!! Nice trees, crappy service. 

Not at all accommodating or polite. BTW, my gardener of 20 years duration told me the tree was improperly planted in a hole which was too small for it. I even showed them recommendations for the planting of the tree which reflected my gardener's opinion. They poo pooed that without examining it and accused me of watering it improperly. 

My opinion is to find another source and/or hardscape. I checked with another gardener and his opinion of their service was less than favorable as well. Caveat emptor.

Pretty clean store besides the restroom (disgusting).

Getting some one to help you is pretty tough.

Once you do they badger you to purchase "protection plan", they do not understand that no means no.

Went in recently to buy a six pack to go. The inventory isn't as large as it was a year ago. Also, no more 10% discounts for six packs-BOO.  New owners are pinching pennies I guess. Hope the inventory improves. They also cut out lunch service during the week because they don't open until 2pm. Did not eat on this visit.

I've had CupBop a couple of times and have enjoyed it. My favorite part is their sweet potato noodles, they are so yummy! So essentially with this type of restaurant you choose what protein you'd want and then also go from their menu as well. My favorite is their fried chicken! After choosing your protein you can choose whether you'd like lettuce or cabbage, and then what sauces. The reason I docked a star is because their food isn't as warm or hot as you would like your food to be, another thing is since it's in a cup it can be hard to get a bite of everything at once. Other than those reasons they are pretty good.
Disgusting is as about as accurate as I can get. Couldn't eat it. I just threw it away and went to costa Vida.

Got there at 4:00 to sit outside on balcony and was told all tables at the outside we're were reserved so we sat inside.  We had drinks,  dinner and upon leaving at  5:30 Noone was in the  "reserved seats".  It is now 5:45 and all those perimeter seats are STILL  empty.  So why we're they reserved for the entire evening? We could have had dinner and left.  Who knows when the people who reserves the tables will show up.  Poor reservation system I think!  Maybe not allow outside seats to be reserved First come first served!!  And the menu had gone down too.  Used to have a fabulous chicken dish on lettuce with potatoes strings.  It was fabulous!  No more.  Too bad.  We have promoted this place a great deal.

New in town and starting my quest to visit all the local, indy cafes.  I was very impressed with everything about Groove Coffee.  Owner Kolby puts his heart and soul into the establishment.  He is attentive to every detail, makes delicious coffee drinks, and creates an environment that welcomes all.  Love the sense of community that Groove provides.  My family and I will definitely be back to hang out and enjoy the food, drink, and atmosphere.
When I ordered a coffee they only filled the cup 2/3 of the way. I am disappointed. This is not what I payed for.

If they say the wait time for food is 25-30 minutes, expect to be waiting at least twice as long.  Our server was very nice and apologetic but not helpful. Table next to us that came in after us was served food first because they had kids. We finally left after 60 minutes of just water refills and no food. I will not be back to this location.

Great friendly service.  Had a massive cinnamon roll with cream cheese on top.   To die for.   Servers that are not serving me actually talked to me.  Certainly not a restaurant norm

Server was Jeffrey.  Great server

I must say this is a wonderful place! This was my first time here and I will be back. The menu is a little tricky to figure out but once you get through it it's not that bad. The food is great- the best way I can describe it is a dim sum Himalayan style. And also kindof a tikka masala flavor-ish....

Their food is great!! They give you a huge portion and they're really friendly. The only advice I'd give for this location is to avoid the lunch rush. The high schoolers tend to come and pack up the place at 11. The girl was so nice though, she even gave me double the portion of mandoo for free. Tasted great and is a great idea for a restaurant.

Went in looking to do a trade in on our FJ, they made us wait 45 min. for a quote and came back with a low ball offer. The sales guy said he makes the same no matter the price car we buy, but kept showing high end cars. We ended up selling our car on Craigslist for way more money and bought a car somewhere else. I get they want to make a profit, but don't waste your time, these guys are just like every other sleezy used car dealer. My advice sell it yourself and find a place who will give you best deal on new/used car!
Steamed clams on potato, leek soup. OMG the best!  Dry martini and a salad is where it is at! The chef here rocks thanks  Tal for an amazing meal!! !!

I strongly recommend that NO ONE ever steps foot in Camping World of Meridian. BUYER BEWARE, the Service Department has extremely poor customer service.
