After buying air bags for our vehicle, we were informed that it would be a 3hr job. Made an appointment for installation, 10am, the Service Advisor, William, then told us they would need additional labor time, that brought it up to 5.5hrs. After 3hrs into it, called to see how things were going, I was told that the wrong parts were ordered and they were waiting on parts to arrive. Once the parts arrived the technician Tony, would start working on it again. I called back after 6hrs of waiting, was told then the truck was ready for pick up. We got half way there and I received a call back stating that our truck wasn't ready after all. When we stop at the Parts counter, I mentioned to the gentleman who did the ordering, told him what we were told, and he said that wasn't true, he ordered the correct part, and he had done some research and found out that the installation is different and informed the service department of the correct position where those bags needed to go and what they needed to do.  We then went to the Service department and was told that the technician was working as fast as he could and our truck wouldn't be ready until 8pm. Wow....9hrs, instead of the original 3hrs that was quoted!  I told him, I refused to be charged any more labor time.  William was going into how much work it was, everything the technician was going through, yada..yada..yada. I informed him I wanted our truck tonight and that we should be compensated for them having our truck all day, our time and us being told one thing and then being told something else. The Service Advisor, has no customer service skills, smug acting, and rude. He would not give us any compensation what so ever for our frustration, time or lies we were told. 

We will NEVER go back to them. I wished we had read these reviews before dropping our vehicle off to them. We are concerned about the quality of the installation of these air bags now. Only time will tell.
After going back again the service seems to have improved. Better than the first time. I hope to try it again sometime soon.
Delicious, lots of options including non-dairy, and tons of toppings!
Great shot. Fix the problem with my phone very quickly and efficiently. They need more help because the one person is not adequate to help all people in there

Under construction to become an even better location. It's small, so I probably would not spend much time here working or anything like that. But it's a nice spot to eat lunch at or chat with a friend. For me it's three blocks from work so it's a no-brainier. Friendly but quiet staff. I like my Starbucks baristas loud and obnoxious. But I won't knock them for that. :)

I am so glad that we now have a brick and mortar place to go to if and when we get the craving for some good Nepalese dumplings or 'momo's (which is about twice a week at our house :) instead of having to wait for Saturday mornings and then fighting for parking in BoDo. Despite the parking issues, we were regulars at momo stand at the Boise Saturday markets. The guys who never hesitated to give people a sample and always had a smile for you. The restaurant menu includes some other additional items besides momos, namely the rice bowl and chicken salad as well as samosas as a side. The combo bowl is a medley of about 5 (or 6?) dumplings plus a good helping of rice with a choice of ground turkey ("Everest") or meatballs. They offer two choices of sauces - the 'spicy' one is real so be aware. Rice bowl ($6.99) includes a generous helping of fragrant saffron rice, black eyed peas (yum!) with a serving of choice of meat and a salad which is the perfect fresh, crunchy touch. Good portion size - I generally have left overs if I get the rice bowl. The combo is the best of both worlds (app. $7.49). A side order of samosas include two pieces with a soy-sesame oil sauce that is slightly on the sweet side with a hint of orange juice. Unexpected but goes well together. 
Now, for the momos. You have a choice of ground pork, turkey or vegetarian filling. You can choose to have the sauce on the side. They also offer fried momos but I haven't tried. There is something about fresh steamed Asian style dumplings - these deceptively simple packets of deliciousness - that is so utterly satisfying. The more you have them, the more you want. That is precisely what happens when you try a momo from Momo. :) 
Wonderful people, nice place, reasonable price point, great food. Now for a branch in Boise someday. Hey, one can hope!

I just got my car washed here under the full service wash.  They caused damage to my car and when I complained and asked for the manager, he mocked me, he seriously laughed in my face as if he was trying to get me mad.  Then one of his friends right by the cash register told me to "shut up and leave", so the assistant manager shook the guys hand and they laughed about it as well.  So here I am my nice luxury car has lost value and It's as if they don't even care.  I called the owner and he said he would handle it, but the manager is still there.  Ironically I was warned before I went, but stupid me I thought it would be different.  Whatever you do, if you enjoy you car at all, do not go here, they don't care about you or your car.

It was our first time here. The food was great and good portions. The staff was really friendly and the place was nice and clean. We ordered the burgers this time and they were fresh and delicious. We will be coming back to try the yogurt next time..

The only reason you would think this is good ramen is because the only ramen you've had came out of a package.  I was excited to try this place with hopes this would be delicious! Sooooo disappointed.

I went in this evening and placed an order to go while I was waiting I watch the man cooking the Mongolian BBQ without wearing gloves which I think is kind of required for food handlers he touched and handled with his bare hands every bit of food that the man had handed to him to cook he wiped his hands on his apron and touch the food again heater round white his hands on a towel and touch the food again when I complained to her about this they just laughed at me and then pretended they did not know what I was saying I doubt that when my food was ready and I left I got home I had ordered sweet and sour pork I had the sauce for the sweet and sour pork but no sweet and sour pork when I called to complain they asked me to bring everything back so they could look at what I got to verify that it was missing which I think is one of the dumbest things I've ever heard if you actually think about it for a minute then they finally went and looked and realized that they had packed it it was in the box but it never been put in to make my box to go so they said that they would bring it they asked for my address I live on a street called Cedar Grove Cedar like the tree I spell this to them several times and I said Cedar like the tree the young man a high school student you should be able to spell and read in English when I called back 45 minutes later wondering where it was said they couldn't find a Cedar Grove spelled seder I explain to them that's why I spelled it for him twice before then they offered to bring it I said it's been too long forget it I want my money back I will come in and pay and get my money back I have the receipt. They called me back saying that they could adjust it if I wanted to give them my credit card number I said I am not giving you my credit card number over the phone I will come in they said are you coming in tonight we need to be able to settle the books I said that is not really my problem this is your mess up I'm not leaving home so that I can drive back to get credit for a mess that you made I will bring my receipt in and have it fixed tomorrow thank you all and all this is been one of the worst restaurant experiences of my life
The place was nice and fully stocked with beer. It was a nice place to just sit and have a beer. The option to sample beers before you try them was nice as well.

Probably the worst service ever in the world. Fries tasted like they were microwaved after sitting on the counter overnight. When we asked for new fries, we never got them. They instead ignored us and we waited for over 15 minutes and had to leave without them. The chicken tenders were overcooked and lack luster. Don't waste your time or money on this place because I won't anymore.

They don't know how to vacuum a car! Or clean the windows. Spent $33 today and had to completely redo the inside by myself. I will never go back. Overland one is perfect and they detail the inside. Fairview did a piss poor job in my opinion. Giving them one star because the outside was "somewhat" clean.

Nice casual atmosphere. Thousands of bottles and cans on shelves to brouse. A couple big screen TV's with sports on but no audio to be a nuisance. Good wait staff and very good food selection and preparation. I had 2 different NW drafts and Mantana Pizza. Very well prepared and tasty. Nice wait staff.

Oh my goodness, this place for breakfast was amazing.  I took a colleague to breakfast here while he was in town for a conference.  As long as you don't go on a Sat/Sun during peak time you won't have a long wait. We were seated right away and our drink order was taken pretty quick.  I had orange juice which was freshly squeezed in the juicer across the room.  My colleague got a hot drink that came out in a huge mug.  We ordered the biscuits and gravy and the crepes.  Both our meals came with bacon.  Plates came out quick with large portions.  Food was sooooooooooo very good.  

Overall, Staff is attentive to needs, very friendly, customer serivce oriented. 
Food is hot, fresh, made to order, and tasted delicious!

Will for sure be returning with my family!!!

This place has so much potential...too bad their offerings don't live up to the menu descriptions! 

Wanted to try someplace new to try on a Saturday afternoon, saw this place pop up as nearby on my Yelp search, so we decided to try it out. The menu looked fantastic, can't go wrong with a 'farm to table' concept! 

The food was just okay. It's obvious that they rely on a lot of shortcut ingredients (premade burgers, packaged smoked turkey), which is unfortunate - both could be made in-house easily (hubby does it at his restaurant!). And I know this is nitpicking, but for crissake, if you claim to use heirloom tomatoes, then use heirloom tomatoes! 

Service was awesome, though! Then again...the place was pretty empty.
Enjoyed the prompt service, friendly staff and fresh food. Would have been 5 stars but they didn't take 10% off when I showed the staff my Yelp checkin coupon and I didn't ask twice. I will be back!

I love the atmosphere here. It has a very hipster vibe to it without trying to be cool. 

The service was great! Our barista was very friendly and attentive. Overall I thought it was a great place to just hang and I will definitely go back again.

This is the best food in the treasure valley. Its so healthy and so delicious! The people are friendly and we have been here several times. The yak momo is so good! Everything is fresh and tasty! 
Go here! Don't be afraid because bits different. I'm so plain and was nervous that I wouldnt like the flavors. Thanks to my boyfriend for making me try it!!! Its my favorite food now!!

I came in here thinking it was going to have great beer and average food.  I was half-right - the beer was fantastic.  But what I didn't expect was the high-quality of the food.  I came in just in time for lunch, and ordered the Old World and Carib pizzas (small pizzas, $5 each).  Wow.  I'm blown away by this restaurant's creativity and taste. So fresh, so delicious.  I actually made pleasure noises out loud while eating, an honor I usually only reserve for fantastic sushi restaurants.  5 stars.

Oh, and the atmosphere was great, too!  A very communal environment with welcoming, but cool staff.  Definitely recommend Brewforia Beer Market.

Came in for a drink and appetizer and service was S-L-O-W. People that came in after we did had some attentive service before we did. Would have had an appetizer but they were too slow. Told them we had dinner reservations elsewhere and it still didn't seem to make much difference. Nine bucks for a cocktail.

I've been a customer of Simmons for around 20 years and it is the best jewelry store in the Treasure Valley.  I would give them 5 stars, but I am going to be fair and deduct one because there are times that different sales people don't always have a complete understanding of what to do.  That being said, I understand there are new people that are in training and  I know it takes time to figure out how everything works when you are dealing with custom design, fit, etc.  Not many stores in this area are good with custom jewelry but Simmons can do about anything!  I prefer nice quality jewelry, therefore I do not shop at bargain stores (mall shops, pawn shops, etc.) that typically have low quality items.  If you are shopping for quality jewelry that will last and be beautiful then this is the place to be.  They have the biggest and nicest selection of good jewelry as well as having goldsmiths on hand.  Over the years I have sent many people in and they have been able to get what they are looking for.  I read the other 2 reviews and I'm sorry about their bad experience, but my friends, family, and I have never had an issue.  I would recommend going in to see the beautiful store and the variety of jewelry they have!

We went into Ramen Sho on a Saturday afternoon, excited that Boise finally got a ramen restaurant, and left feeling mostly positive about the experience. 

Between my fiance and I, we had the tonkatsu, and the spicy miso with medium spice. The flavor on the spicy miso was considerably better- it was spiced perfectly. The tonkatsu was good, the flavor was well balanced. The portion size was almost perfect, and the price was fair. The toppings were good, but we would've liked more. I'm also unsure how the pork belly was cooked, but it had an undesirable texture. We both ended up picking it out. 

The service was adequate, it could be better. We were also informed that they are still in their "soft opening," despite having been open for 2-ish months, and for that reason they were out of several things. 

I would give this place another chance. Hopefully some of the kinks are worked out in the near future, it would be a bummer to see it fail.

Was passing through town while moving and stopped here for lunch. We split the Frito Pie Quesadilla and the Pulled Pork Poy Boy. Both were delicious. The restaurant was dead by the time we arrived at 1:30 in the afternoon. Staff could've been a little more attentive as we were the only table, but overall great find!

Came here on Christmas Day and all I heard was the bartender complain. In fact he used the F word. I understand when people have bad days but please don't show it on the job. Everyone else was very jolly and was making the best of working on Christmas day.

I am not a vegetarian, but I love the vegetarian dishes. The only thing that would make this place better is if the food was just a tad bit spicier. The prices are cheap and the customer service is excellent, I highly recommend eating here!

I was excited to see that a panera styled restaurant had made its way to the village. Their casual dining experience was fast paced but the line left me with enough time to find out what I wanted to eat. 

When my fiancé and I got to our table, our food was followed shortly thereafter. But after a few bites into her panini, she saw a giant hair on her plate that did not belong to one of us. I went to the manager at the front who promptly refunded out food, but I don't think he had intended on me hearing him tell the kitchen staff that I had been the second complaint about hair they had received that day. 

All in all the food and service would have been great, but with it being a new restaurant they should take a few steps back to ensure the basics of cleanliness are addressed.

So far this restaurant has done nothing but disappoint me in their customer service. The wait staff is slow and aren't attentive to their tables. 

The food however is good.
Meh. Ok food, nothing special. Had the double bacon cheeseburger and was told they only have american cheese in the restaurant.

Love Papa Murphy's take and bake pizza.  Call ahead, order online or just drop in. They have all sorts of pizza and combos you can choose from. They can make almost any pizza on the super thin crust they call deLights or a gluten free option.  You can get salads, sodas and cookie dough to make a full meal.
They are always running some sort special so ask if they don't offer to tell you what they are. 

This is a take and bake place so seating is for waiting not for eating.

I hardly post reviews unless I feel they will be useful. Whether they are negative or positive. This one happens to be a positive one. I have been trying to get my family's travel trailer de-winterized for the past couple weeks and have been unsuccessful due to the fact I work out of town during the week. This makes my time at home on the weekend compact with chores, family, and errands. I called multiple locations and was given quotes ranging from $69.99 to $199.99 (way to try and rob people Bish's). I called Camping World and talked to Charlie Organista in the service department. He was extremely polite, professional, and courteous. He informed me he could get me in the very next day, would only need the trailer for roughly 45 min and it would be $50 bucks. So I said done! I arrived 30 min late due to the kids and trying to get out the door. When I arrived, Charlie was not bothered by it at all. He asked if I could wait while I had the service done. I replied that it would be hard since I am a father of 16 month old twins and they were both sleeping in the truck at the time. Charlie said "no worries, I'll send a couple guys out right now and we'll have it done shortly." Well the twins woke up anyways, so I took them inside and pushed them around the store. While inside Charlie told me "once the service is done, just take off, use the $50 for your twins and have a good day." He had no reason to offer this. I called the day prior, I was late showing up, and I couldn't really wait the 45min. They were done in about 20 min and the twins and I were out of there! I really appreciated the patience and service I was given. I know not every experience is like mine and if it was they wouldn't be in business but I would at least give Camping World the chance to earn your business. Give Charlie a call!
Very good, great alternative to fast food. I was impressed that they had brown rice. Friendly, the girl at the counter played peek a boo with my 2 year old.

Loved it! Happened to be there while they were celebrating Teej and it was a really neat experience. The food was extremely fresh and delicious. Next time I come to Boise I will make sure to come again.

Do yourself a favor and choose another provider. First of all, our wifi is pretty terrible. We've been told we'll have to buy a new router (from a third party) to have acceptable wifi. If that weren't bad enough, I have been trying to chat with Century Link for over 65 minutes now and just keep getting the runaround. I am merely trying to move service to my new home, less than 4 miles away. Ultimately, I've told them to just cancel the service because I am just disgusted with how I've been treated, including condescending behavior from the chat agents.

I recently moved to Boise from LA, California and I've been searching for foot massage places for the past 3 months because I love them. I finally tried this place and it was AMAZING!!!! I would definitely recommend sunshine massage it has great prices, clean, and very friendly. I've found a few places in Boise but they were very over priced.... I don't mind driving 20 min for a massage because it was definitely worth it!!!!

I have been craving Japanese ramen for a long time and I am glad this place opened. I had the spicy miso ramen which was delicious. The only thing is seating gets a little crowded since there is limited space. Other than that, highly recommend.

We have been here a few times and will typically get some of each of the four types of momos (pork, turkey, vegetable, and yak). They are similar to pot stickers, with the rest of the meal being like a mix between Indian, afghani, and Chinese food. If you like those types of food, you'll like Momo.

I didn't realize this was a chain restaurant, because it's not in the state I used to live in. Anyway, the food was lukewarm and not too flavorful. Rather pricey for what I got. I don't knock chain restaurants, it's just that this particular dining experience wasn't up to par.
Fast and friendly service. I had the combination of chicken and pork and it was awesome!!

Tried this shop since it is fairly close to our house and it wasn't bad. The girls were super nice and the drinks were good. Not our favorite, but it wasn't horrible either. There weren't very many people inside, so it's definitely not a hopping place.  If you are looking for a mellow place to have a meeting with a friend or business meeting it would be a good go to for that reason. I still would rather drive 20+ minutes to Hyde Perk in Boise though...no one has topped them yet.

First time in, pasta was hot and delicious. Server Angelica served our food to us and made sure we had enough silverware. Also, they catered to a work function and the bagels were rocking awesome and I thoroughly enjoyed their other pastries. Kneaders has some serious competition.

Epic food that goes against convention.  I don't even like Indian food, but I try to eat here once a week it's so delicious.  Also, its insanely healthy.  I don't like healthy food either, but I could eat here daily.  Very complex, surprisingly delicious flavor combinations.  Most delicious vegetables I've ever had.  A must try.  Also, super friendly staff.

Food was made to order, fast, & inexpensive. They have an appetizer (spring roll or rangoon), side (steamed rice, fried rice, or veg. chow mein), and your choice of entree for $6.99 at lunch. Got the lunch order of beef & broccoli (ridiculously easy dish that's ridiculously easy to get wrong) and it was pretty good. Steamed rice and spring roll were really good though the spring roll was very small. Excited to go back and try their bulgogi or curry next time.

Good food, good service. In my visit it was for a holiday party, perhaps a group of 70-80 people and the place is not set up to have everyone centered. Not the place's fault at all, just noting that smaller groups would be better. Bar in the center and I understand they have a thing with the movie theater so that you can have "dinner and a movie" but in style. Have yet to do that but sounds like a great date night.
Hannah is amazing and I wait to go on Sunday just to see her :) I've been to many places since moving to Idaho three years ago and this is the best place by far!

I absolutely LOVE The Bean! Fast and accurate service, they go that extra mile to remember you and your common drink orders. The ladies working there are beyond amazing!! I'll always be loyal to The Human Bean no other coffee spot can compare! But this particular location is my favorite. They know my drink and get so creative with the flavors! I appreciate the time and personal touch they put in everyday to make our day better with just the few moments they have with us. Seeing those familiar smiling faces every morning and through out the day definitely makes my day better! They give the place such a great atmosphere and you that desire to come back again! Definitely stop by any location (especially this one!). The Human Bean has amazing drink choices, yummy treats, and great company! I know they'll take care of you! Thanks again ladies for being the best!

I had an amazing experience at the Meridian location. Broken iPhone 6 screen. They were super friendly and actually fixed my screen in under 20 minutes. I was shocked at how easy and fast this process was. I highly recommend this company.
Really nice breakfast option! Good food good selection and wait staff ROCKS. The kind of breakfast to look forward to driving over there.
This place is amazing!!!!  They have a breakfast and a lunch menu. There food is so good and the staff are super friendly. I will definitely be back again!!

What a fancy-dancy place. Yup, my jaw dropped when I walked in and I spent extra time walking all the isle to see it all. It is similar to museum just with pretty food!

I just came into the Co-Op to buy my favorite hot sauce that I haven't seen in 10 years! I bought two just because I could! 

I will be back to test drive the food!

Meridian Co-Op is bigger than the one in the North End but the friendliness wasn't lost with the expansion and growth of the store. Often times my personal opinion is the larger a place gets and each time it is replicated, service and personalization slip a little. Glad to know that personal Co-Op touch is still there.

We have eaten here a handful of times now.  We really like the food and the friendly, upbeat staff, who never seem to rush us and are always willing to give suggestions.  The parking can be tricky so just be careful when backing out.  We look forward to our next visit.

A different kind of food but very delicious. Service was friendly and engaging, the eclectic options you have to put with your curry rice is excellent and I love the fact the momos are steamed. Definitely recommend.
So disappointed. Dry tough meat.  I threw most of it away.  Maybe just an off night?  I'll likely try again later after they get their feet under them.

This place is my absolute FAVORITE breakfast place in all of Boise. The atmosphere here is very bright and friendly. All the servers and staff are so nice and patient and customer service here is just truly perfect. I have been here a million times and I have never had anything I didn't like. I love that they get their food locally and it all is so fresh tasting. I personally recommend their eggs Benedict. I usually get traditional and it's outstanding but really all of their Benedict's are. The meat is a perfect amount and their English muffins are fluffy but a little crispy on the outside for a nice texture in this dish. The eggs are cooked just right and are never over cooked in the middle and the hollandaise sauce it really what bring a this whole meal together.  I always ask for an additional side of the hollandaise because it so freaking amazing. It will not disappoint!!

We just bought our 2016 coleman lantern travel trailer this week and had a great experience with Camping World. Their sale price on the style camper we wanted was the best price in town.  We have not had any transactions with the service department  yet... hopefully that will go just as smoothly as the rest when we do!  Yes, we read the other reviews before shopping there and I always try to keep in mind that when someone likes something they are likely to tell a few people about it however, when people don't like something they will tell everyone they can.

Nice clean place with really nice people. The food I had was good but not what I was expecting. I was hoping for exceptional food based on b past reviews but I would have to say it looked and tasted a little bland.
Love it here. Food was great tasting and the restaurant is clean and the staff was on top of it.  The portions were perfect size any bigger and would have needed a nap.

As a customer I've eaten at Rudy's twice and had drinks a few times at the bar top. Both settings we're great. This is such a great neighborhood bar and grill! Servers and bartenders have great personalities and warm welcomes every time we come thru the door! I've never felt more welcome at a neighborhood restaurant than this one! If you live in meridian, eagle, Star or even Nampa, come enjoy the friendly atmosphere, mouth watering steaks and burgers and one of a kind, delicious desserts!  P.s. did I mention the staff is phenomenal?!
Love this place!  It's like home cooked meals and I don't have make it!  Prices very reasonable and staff is so friendly...we had Beverly and she was so sweet.  Try it ... I'm sure you will love it

My wife and I were traveling back to Seattle from Boise. We noticed the wheel started shaking in our vehicle. It was the day after Christmas and everywhere else was closed. We had a car full of luggage and our dogs were with us. Meineke was so wonderful they let our dogs inside while they check our car. It ended up being too much snow packed in the wheels,  a simple fix which they did free of charge.  Meineke went above and beyond to help us and we highly recommend their service.

Pizza Cones are a super interesting concept and I really enjoyed the one I got. They have a pretty good selection and they are relatively quick. This place is right down the road from my work and now I feel like I have a place to run to on my short lunches that will make me feel satisfied for as much, if not less, than I'll wind up paying at work. 

I definitively would recommend this place to anyone who wants pizza, as they put a new spin on it.  

P.s. The Bavarian Cream Cone is a win for dessert.

Ordered delivery tonight. Received email confirmation saying delivery due by 5:41. Called restaurant at 6:00 wondering where order is since we live 2.98 miles away. They told me it left the restaurant 20 minutes ago. It arrived 6:16 (estimated 35 minutes late), rice was uncovered and meal of $41 was cold.  Driver didn't care when I questioned him! So I removed the tip and will not order again!

We just enjoyed a late lunch at The Barnyard and we both came away happy and satisfied. We both had the Blue Plate special which was two pieces of fried chicken, a biscuit, watermelon and coleslaw. You are allowed to pick white, or dark meat. I was happy about that because I am not fond of white meat. Normally, fried chicken choices consist of a boneless, skinless chicken breast, so it was nice to be able to order a thigh and a leg. And the chicken breast my husband had was a real piece of chicken, with bones! I thought the breading on the chicken was very good. It was light and flavorful. Admittedly, if I were cooking it at home, I would have added a generous helping of garlic salt, but I understand not everyone likes garlic on their chicken. 

The biscuit was light and fluffy, the watermelon was plentiful, unfortunately it's not quite the season for watermelon, so the flavor wasn't the best. The coleslaw has a little kick to it, and a pleasing flavor. The lunch Blue Plate Special sells for $8.99 which I felt was reasonable. 

We're looking forward to our next visit!

This is my second time here and I decided to try the burger and fries! Absolutely one of the best I've had! The service here is fantastic everybody is so friendly and personable! I had the Bacon Blue Bronco Burger and it was mouthwateringly delicious! I will definitely be back with friends!

Hmmm.  Kept hearing about "All Day Breakfast" at this "Jack-in-the-Box" owned/related "upscale" eatery.  
* Me- I'll have Oatmeal.  
* CBCafe- Sorry, we stop serving that at 11:00.  
* Me- I guess oatmeal isn't a breakfast item ?

Food was meh. pancakes tasted very "malt-y", which made me wonder if they were sourdough.  Nope- menu says "buttermilk".

I'll pass on this place next time.  Denny's is just down the street, and is more to my liking.
Came here with four on Mother's Day and the place was an efficient machine of delicious.  Four people give five stars- unanimous!
This is a Panera Bread wannabe that will have to do until we get the real thing here. Pretty good lineup of sandwich, soup, & salad options and we did like it a bit better than Kneaders.

Came here for a mid morning breakfast on Thursday.  Long wait to get our order long wait to get our food. Had to ask for refills of coffee and condiments and jelly.  Hmmmm...so why was the food not even hot when we finally got it. The food itself was ok but there are definitely better places to spend time and money for breakfast in Meridian.  Sorry to say that as we had heard good things about the Griddle in the past.

What this place lacks in quality, it makes up in quantity.  I've been here twice (wanted to give them a second chance) and the food was bad both times.  Food was not fresh and tasted/looked like it was sitting for days.

This review is for the store location:

We visited the new store location in Meridian on 11/30/17 located by the Sports Clips and ATT store. This store is a Korean fast food type of place. We ordered two kids cups (rice, sweet potato noodles, chicken, a dumpling and sauce) and a two meat cup (pork and beef) with rice, sweet potato noodles, cabbage, a dumpling, combo of sauce mix (level 3/10) with kimchi. We liked the different flavors and uniqueness of the bowls. My kids favorite part was actually the sweet potato noodles which are transparent in color. They are somewhat picky, so I was surprised that they both liked an item I thought they would pick out. The kids were encouraged to use a few to turn into shapes while eating by one of the workers which kept them busy while we ate. I really enjoyed the noodles and the flavor of them. I highly recommend grabbing some kimchi to mix in with the meal. The store itself has great seating areas (and a lot of them), many big and bright windows, vibrant colors, loud music and a very loud and inviting staff. They walked us through their options and sauces since it was our first time, and when I tipped them at the end, they all yelled a company phrase and then added an extra dumpling to my bowl. I liked the location as it is right off of Chinden and Linder in the Fred Meyer shopping block, and allows something different than the standard McDonald hamburger or Subway sandwich. I was really happy the kids finished their bowls and wanted more of the noodles. It's a very simple menu so the flow of traffic is fast, and yet there are 10 different levels of sweet/spicy sauces that allow customization. It is reasonably priced and the servings will easily fill you up. I would definitely recommend trying this new type of fast food and support a new local business in our neighborhood.

Had lunch today at Ramens Sho it was ok I had the fried dumpling they were not hot at all and I order the spice miso ramens an it was not hot either but it did have good flavor too it. The miso was not spicy at all they did send a side dish of chili paste but I really didn't  think it was spicy. I sent out on the patio for lunch the chairs they have at the tables are not very comfortable the back lean way too far back. The waitress I had just didn't seem too interested in seeing what I needed I was almost done with my meal before she came around and asked me if she could fill up my water glass again. When the waitress asked me how the meal was and I told her that I thought the soup could have been warmer and that the dumplings could have been warmer too in the center she just kind of smiled and said yeah and walked off. I may go back in a month to see if there has been any improvements to the serving staff or the food I think for right now they need to work the bugs out and get things done better.
great. best cut my dog had in her two years of life. Kind and quick and reasonably priced

A great bar to get warmed up for a movie! Good beer selection, good happy hour which we love on Tuesdays. Great date night bar. Big shout out to our favorite bartenders, Cody and Jim! They remember us and go out of their way to make sure we have things correct, Thanx!

Exelent service and great food!
Food was awesome I could not believe the servers to customer ratio. Counted at least 13 servers
The food was fresh and fast and good
I will be back

I have been to Rudy's a few times and have never had bad food. I usually get their street tacos which are great, but branch out to their other food as well.

The service is always great and always very friendly. It is a great place to watch a game, have a beer, and eat some food.

I started with nails, now I enjoy a variety of services. Danielle is an excellent nail tech, she's very creative and fun. Jami does Botox and having two prior Botox professionals wrk on me, she's the best. She's incredibly gentle and knows exactly what she's doing. She'll be conservative and adjust accordingly, so she's cautious not to overdo anything. She's a card and she'll entertain you while she turns back the clock! Laci's face treatments and product recommendations have been super rejuvenating and beneficial to me. Jacee does a great job on hair, she also recommends good products based on your hair type. Keep up the great work, ladies! Much appreciated!!

Noms..... I came here twice while I was visiting family in Idaho. When you walked in, the smell of fresh waffle cones is like a slap in the face. The ice cream was very rich and flavorful. I also tried the grilled cheese and tomato soup, to which I totally recommend if you're up for it. Workers were super nice and I was able to try a bunch of flavors (samples) before I decided one one. A single scoop = 2 scoops, a kiddie = 1 scoop; I was overwhelmed with the single scoop. I am a fan, and I look forward to coming back to this place to get my dairy on.

I also noticed a lot of people coming in jus to purchase their chocolate milk, something I will have to try in the future.

With a heavy heart I must write this review.  I started going to Brewforia two years ago.  Then it was a quiet little beer market where you could get amazingly great tap beer selections for a outstanding value.  But alas, no more.  I went in about a month ago and the tap prices were so high that I left. $5.50 for a draft draw?  I might as well be in BoDo.  Progress I suppose.

Went in because I was having problems with my phone. They guy in there was awesome. He could have sold me on fixing my phone because it wasn't charging, but instead he let me know how to clean the charging port and didn't charge me any money. I wouldn't have known if it was even broken, he could have got away with charging me, but he didn't. I would recommend this establishment to anyone that needs help with any situation. Thank you 360 wireless thank you for being honest and helping me out.

I come through Boise every 3 to 6 weeks on business, usually for a week at a time.  I always make a point to stop in here for breakfast at least once while I am in town.  Fantastically friendly staff, excellent home style food.  Very affordable pricing.  I've been stopping here for awhile now, and have never left disappointed.
Not like getting ramen in Vancouver ... but it is filling and tasty and i will be back.
Delicious, healthy, quick, reasonably priced.  Food was fresh and flavorful, the kind of stuff that makes your body feel amazing after you eat it.  Service was great.  Definitely going back.

What a fantastic treat! Some friends have been telling us we have to check the place out. So for a great Sunday lunch we stopped in and had lunch. Good job! The Hightower chicken sandwich I had was great, the burgers my wife and kids had we fantastic. Hand cut fries are awesome! And a big thumbs up to the two teenage kids working. Real work ethic there. They were both helpful, courteous and constantly doing something. After many years in the restaurant business I know how tough it is to find good help and this place has done it. All in all a great experience and fantastic meal. We'll be making the drive from Caldwell again for lunch or dinner here. That is unless there is plans to open a Canyon County location soon...wink wink.

My girlfriend and I both ate here recently. Not being familiar with the food we got a sampler of momos. 30 minutes later both of us were too sick to leave bed. We called the restaurant to warn them and help prevent others from getting sick, the lady argued with us. She never apologized, or showed any concern. She stated it couldn't have been their food because she had been eating it and she felt fine. The lack of care, professionalism, and the bad food will keep me from ever returning.

Went for breakfast  waited 15
Minutes for a seat over hour for our food it was warm at best and they forgot  some of our food when we got it, it was cold the Mgr ask me what was wrong  told her she said sorry what do you want me  to do about it then she ask if I would like to leave a  tip hell no

I know a lot of people like to rag on Starbucks for one reason or another but I'm a relatively picky coffee drinker and I still find them to make a decent cup. I've been to a lot of Starbucks, I think we all have, they are on almost every street corner and they always serve the exact same thing. But there is one difference and that's the employees. I know that locally I avoid a couple different Starbucks because the baristas there are terrible. They are rude to customers and they don't like to help you. But that isn't the case at this one. Everyone is always friendly and nice, they try and help you out if you're not sure what you want to order, and they always seem really excited to see me. I do love this location.

The iced drinks aren't bad but not the best. What I'm frustrated by is that I asked for a 16 ounce fruit smoothie to be split in 3 separate small cups for my little children and at first she said no because we would have to pay extra for the cups but didn't offer that. So I told her I'm fine with paying the extra 30 cents for the cup, she left and returned to say that we actually can't order the split smoothie like that and we had to pay for 2 8 ounce smoothies instead. What's the point of offering a large size like that if you'll require for us to pay for 2 smaller sizes to make the same amount of drink? 
My suggestion is to be a bit more flexible and kid friendly. I didn't order the smoothie at all so which decision actually saved the company money?
The ice cream is great but the efficiency and knowledge of the staff is still underdeveloped.  Still a great cone and awesome grilled cheeses at lunch

My wife and I went to breakfast there on Monday morning, we found the waiters and hostesses very friendly and very helpful. We found the food;  I had the chicken fried steak and my wife had fruit crepes to be very tasty.  The decor was okay and the hot chocolate drinks were excellent.  My only complaint is that the chicken fried steak I had was over cooked.  I would recommend this breakfast restaurant.

First off. The employees I dealt with were nice and helpful. Maybe this bad review stems from being short handed. I had to make all the calls, 6 of them. Only did I get a call back when I made that call saying I am concerned about the service I am not being provided. My concerns were, do you have the parts? How much? How long will it take? This is what ended up happening. Call, tell them we need to pick up. 12 days later they are just starting the work. Still don't know labor price. We know parts are in stock and price for them. At checkout they added $100 for shipping. Shipping what? I ask. Mistake, so they remove it.  I pay and sign off. I ask for a walk thru because I just signed that all is good. They thought this odd. During walk thru 2 items I asked for not completed. Frustrating. Will try another place next time. My 22 ft travel trailer is a 2015 and in excellent condition. Thought when reading this review you should know that it wasn't a 1978 with problems.

I truly believe Tim Huddleston is a very honest sales person and I would do business with him again. We purchased a Winnebago Fuse in April 2018 and Tim was most helpful. He did research for us, without a commitment that we would purchase - Tim was just helping us figure it all out. We went on two test drives, two separate motor homes, and it took us a month to commit to purchase. Tim was very patient with us - no pressure. Our overall experience with Camping World of Meridian ID has been great, but the 5 stars goes to Tim Huddleston!
Most amazing foot and all over body massage. Use of deep pressure makes this a real gem. The low price and service received is unequivocal!
We were so thrilled to see this place open recently and it does not disappoint!  Wow! The food was great and service was awesome. I just hope that they can keep it!
Thank you David H for everthing. What are knowledgeable intelligent guy, again thank you for your help

I spent roughly 3 weeks searching for the "right" wedding present for my bride to be.  All of the jewelers I spoke to had something that "might work," but I was left feeling like I was buying something "close" instead of the piece she deserved and I wanted.  It wasn't that way when I came to Simmons Jewelry, their selection was fantastic.  More importantly the staff were exceptionally patient and willing to share their knowledge with me.  They provided options, listened to my comments and explained why one piece was more expensive than another.  I also appreciated that the respected that my budget was a lot for me and made sure that my dollar went as far as it could.  Thank you to the staff for all your help and taking a large weight off my shoulders.

Very pleased to find Groove Coffee while travelling through from San Francisco. This is the sort of quality and authenticity I appreciate when looking for a cafe. The new owner is the real deal! They offer locally sourced everything and it is tasty! I recommend locals and out-of-towners alike to check out this superb shop. I ordered a tea over ice and my wife had the iced mocha (92F outside) and we both enjoyed them immensely!

Worst Chinese I've had in many years, unfortunately.  The meat was an impossible combination of both too greasy and too dry and desiccated.  Made me sick to my stomach upon leaving and left me disquieted the rest of the night.  I had some general Tso's chicken and some crab rangoons from the buffet.

If I could give them less than one star I would. The first time I had a issue at this Denny's I chalked it up as just a bad experience, but I brought my kids here today for lunch and saw that it wasn't just a bad experience but bad customer service. They completely forgot my sons hamburger. I'm a pretty patient person, so I overlooked the sticky tables. The manager offered to remake his burger, and take it off the bill. I was fine with that. However when his burger came, the meat was not cooked all the way through and he couldn't even eat a single bite of the burger. My other son had a soggy bananas, they forgot my daughters dinner bread, they forgot the cheese for my fries. I would not recommend this place to anyone at all.

If you are buying a car buy it here. That it. Honestly they were super helpful they didn't pressure us into anything. They repeatedly checked that we were good with the purchasing price and financing. They showed us so many options.
We went in with a car in mind and when we couldn't afford it they showed us a dozen options really really close that we could afford. We left with a car we love and a price we weren't stressed about. 
If you have ever bought a car in Idaho you know how rare this is but one amazing thing about Carmax is their 5 day return. You can change your mind for any reason for 5 days. In Idaho, on used cars, that's unheard of!!

I would recommend thing location to all of my family and friends. I will personally be back to buy a car myself!
Food good. Except salad was wilted and un imaginative. Great service. Decor is homey and fun. Had lunch. Will come back and try bfast.

Been there now 3 times.
The first time was excellent ordering the habenero burger.
The second time ordered the same thing.  Not as good as the first.  Wasn't spicy at all.
The third time decided to order the chicken habenero.
Took way too long.  Had to go back to work and had to cancel the order after waiting over 30 minutes.
Each time the service and food has gotten worse.
I will not be going back.
Service horrible, consisted of two apathetic teens staring into their electronic devices 99 percent of the time. I never saw an adult. Food was very unimpressive.

The Griddle is a breakfast joint with that home and old school feel.  I was not sure what to expect but when I ordered the Coconut battered French Toast, I was amazed.  I was in Idaho and not in Hawaii.  How was this possible?  I did not really get a chance to try the other foods.  I did take a bite of the chicken fried steak, it was ok, kind of a let down given it was in cattle country!

I'm visiting the Boise area and paid about $44 to feed my family a takeout that amounted to undercooked slop. The food was truly awful! I should have checked the other reviews first and avoided this place!
I'm not sure if this is fair to compare but I've only had ramen in Phoenix.  It wasn't even close to the experience  in AZ, it was pretty bland.  Not sure I would go back.

Absolutely some of the best service my family and I have had in Boise. Audrey was our waitress and she was so wonderful, very attentive (and it was Sunday morning so she was running), and efficient. Our coffee cups were never empty and we were in and out in under an hour. Every individual that came by our table was extremely polite and friendly. Not to mention, the food was wonderful. I would highly recommend The Griddle on Overland Road. I definitely will be returning and bringing others with me!!!
Just tried to order coffee. Asked for a tall latte. Was rudely told 'we don't speak Starbucks here'. Large or small? Done. Will spread word . Just wanted a cup of coffee not a judgement of character.

Great to have Mo Mo here in town. We tried Mo Mo in Lincoln City and loved it! Mo Mo is an excellent place to try Mo Mo or get your fix if you've had it before.
 
The staff is incredibly helpful and friendly. They will take the time to explain the different dishes and guide you depending on your tastes.
I had a direct deposit payroll snafu and Senada and Melodi called their systems administrators and straightened everything out quickly and efficiently. Excellent customer service!

I love the atmosphere. The Decor  is really fun and it's always clean. I have been here a few times for lunch with friends and family and we always have to go around the table and taste each other's food because it's always so good! 
The Thanksgiving dinner sandwich that they made during the holiday was heavenly. I think it was called the gobbler. Oh and the lattes are always hot and delicious and you can't go wrong ordering a pastry to go with it.

Mixed bag a Rudy's on McMillian.  Unlike some other reviewers we actually get quite good service here.  Some nights I'll go 4 stars but I had a strange and telling experience last night.  I ordered beef stroganoff that came with "garlic bread" and instead came with two tiny little thin bread'letts not much larger than crackers.  Not a huge deal.  But I asked the server about it and she was nice and said it is a common complaint.  She mentioned it to the manager who said the owner would not change it in hopes that people would "order" more bread.  WTF?  It's bread for an $11 pasta dish.  Give me some garlic bread for goodness sake.  Particularly if you are receiving "multiple" complaints.  Anyway, I'll be taking my business to homestead now.  Better food and beer.

We went here at 10 pm and the bar tenders were drinking, one female bartender had three friends at the bar and would go to the other side and drink with them.  Another guy in a blue shirt came and grabbed a handful of cards and told thr other bartender lets use these.  Anyway they were drunk dropped charge cards in the trash and then after pulling them out kept doing their thing.

The ramen is decent but it is so freaking cold in the restaurant that it is almost painful to sit and wait for your meal.  I asked for coffee to keep me warm while I waited but they don't have cream.  My whole table had to wear our winter coats the entire time we were there.  I wish there were more meat options for the ramen.  There are really one two.  Pork or veggie.

After a few more visits to MoMo (most of them, ordering just the dumplings), I decided to give the chicken curry another try.

So glad that I did.

It was tender and moist. The vegetables were lightly steamed just enough to bring out the bright colors and still maintain firmness. Perfect. 

Service is very polite. Always a good experience.

And that sauce! Heavenly.

Their very own brand of signature curry sauce is rich and creamy with a nice, yet not overbearing, spicy kick. Today, I'll be walking out with a bottle, which they sell in the restaurant.

On a side note: I recently had the distinct pleasure of speaking with Bijaya, the owner. Even though I expressed some concerns about her restaurant in my previous review, it's all water under the bridge. Her willingness to listen made a huge impact on this updated review.

Recommendation: If you haven't yet been to MoMo (next to Saint Luke's, just off of Eagle road, near the freeway), get there. First-timers should order straight down the left side of the menu. You can't go wrong.

And don't forget to pick up a bottle (or two) of their signature sauce. Sold in "medium" and "spicy."
Great breakfast,  chorizo was spicy but not over the top,  eggs over medium just right.  Server was super friendly and attentive.

Went back this week, & it was great again. They offered me a free rice bowl for my daughter, (smart move :)) with the rice on the bottom, it was great... All the flavors melded together very nicely. Love this place, & my siblings that have gone from my persistence loved it too.

First of all their add says they have a sushi  bar. This is an out and right lie. Serving sushi and having it in the buffet is not that same thing. SECOND they have gotten lazy and no longer provide the same quality the did. They actually serve their customers poop. I mean this literally.  They no longer clean their shrimp. If you see a shrimp with a black line down the back it has not been cleaned. That black line is its poop shoot and the black is poop. And they are knowingly feeding it to you. So next time you go to Great Wall know you will be eating shrimp poop.

Basically, the biggest struggle of this place is knowing what to order. Everything is good!!! 

I'm obsessed with the pecan crusted French toast with bacon caramel sauce by their quiche Lorraine and scrambled are also completely amazing. 

The service is also unmatched. From the moment you walk in to the second you leave, you are treated like family--family that never lets your coffee cup run dry!

I highly recommend this spot for breakfast any time of the week. Just make sure you get here early because spots are slim after about 9:30 on the weekend.

Had a great experience today with Jay Simmons and Neal Hunt, who helped me get beautiful rings at a great price. We were referred to them by a close friend who gave glowing reviews and the word of mouth I've heard about Simmons is excellent. My experiences backed this up and I'd refer all my friends to them.They were very patient as we looked at different styles of settings and various cuts of diamonds last night and today and then helped explain what would work in our price range. They didn't try to push to make bigger sales, but focused on getting us the best possible rings and we felt totally heard and respected. Like finding a good car mechanic, it's so important to find someone you trust and I felt 100 percent confident in them and would recommend Simmons to anyone looking for quality jewelry.
I've always enjoyed this restaurant. If you like deep fried Chinese you'll like it. Never once was I upset after eating here . I think it's yummy

This is an adorable cafe!  Love the atmosphere and the customer service is top notch!  My husband had a breakfast panini, which I would order next time.  Super yummy!  I got the breakfast croissant which was good as well.  Their cinnamon rolls were delightful.  Can't wait to go back! (Their lunches looked very good as well).

My wife had a coupon for this place and it was amazing!  Menu changes daily and the chef makes everything including dessert on site!  Small and very intimate, definitely a place to get away and have great food with someone you want to talk to.

On vacation from California and alternator failed. They were able to take me right away and fixed the problem. Lifetime nationwide warranty on the alternator is a great plus.  They even gave me a loaner while my car was being repaired. 

Thanks Jim and Bill!

My husband and I bought a used camper two months ago now from camping world Boise, loved the guy that serviced our camper very knowledgeable man can't remember his name but from Sheridan, Wyoming! They sales department on the other hand.. I found the camper on there online site so I knew what I wanted! Didn't need to be sold on anything! The sales man (Nurija Kajdic) couldn't have given less crap, I was just another picture on his wall! I had to wait 20 minutes for the manager to come out and put me in the phone with there insurance. I ended up hanging up the phone. As I packed two huge boxes for the camper out to leave with two small children in a very busy parking lot in tow, he went out the opposite door not holding it open while on the phone and followed us out never offering to help with a box just to reach the pickup and ask for a picture. Then the next day as I'm trying to register it in another state the wrong information is on the paper work! I call and they say I don't know how it got in there and to rip it up! Couple weeks later the manager that I tried 20 times to call finally calls me back saying the computer mixed stuff up... And they need to over night me paper work. Long story short it was a miserable experience! And they we'll never see my business again!

What I really liked about this place was the uniqueness of Huckleberry! I grew up loving huckleberry jam and honey at my grandmothers and this place hit that nostalgia right on the nose. We ordered huckleberry waffles and a stuffed huckleberry French toast. The waffles were some of the best I have ever tasted and also came with a huckleberry syrup. Crunchy on the outside, soft in the middle. Their (I believe) homemade butter on top was quite delicious. The French toast was more like a dessert which was a little too sweet for me but was still yummy. The sausage was probably some of the best sausage I have ever had. They are quite big! We wanna go back, bc we realized when paying that their special menu had pineapple coconut pancakes and peach hot chocolate! Two of my favorite fruits! The decor was old farm home style, and the staff were nice, but seemed rushed and flustered. Food took 20 min to get to us which was fine since we weren't too hungry, but would have felt like a lifetime if we had been hungry. Also a little over priced for a college student.

My girlfriend turned me on to this little gym...  It's got everything, even though it's small, and even has tanning beds which are included in your membership, unlimited.  It's open 24 hours, 7 days a week, and has really friendly staff.  The equipment is clean and maintained, and the place isn't a meat market.  I can't think of a single thing wrong with this gym.  Has childcare.
Been coming here for a while...the yogurt is good...but they decided to take down the only two non-dairy flavors at 6:30...kind of lame...we will try again but very disappointed.
Had the best server EVER in Norma today just before Star Wars The Last Jedi. So funny, authentic and awesome. She's a credit to the Backstage Bistro staff!
Food is great, but rather expensive for the portions, in my opinion. We still come back a lot as my kids are in love with the mac and cheese.

This is our Sunday Yumday! We love the food we love the service! Even if you walk to the door and they are a packed house give them 15 quick minutes and you will be seated and treated to a great breakfast with a smile.

Why didn't I buy the bottle of sauce to take home with me?!??!  Stupid, stupid, stupid!!  I love the spicy mahkani sauce drizzled over the steamed dumplings/momos.  I keep meaning to try other things on the menu but I just can't seem to get away from my go-to order.  

Does anybody want to buy me a bottle of the spicy mahkani sauce for my birthday?  Pretty please??
Ice cream, chocolate milk, and cheese curds are amazing. They are from my home town, and it is the same in both cities. We love it and glad it came to meridian.

Although we live in Nevada and have been patrons of The Griddle in Winnemucca for many years, we were beyond thrilled when the owners expanded into Idaho and improved their menu.
We spend a lot of time in the Caldwell area and cannot wait for The Griddle to open their latest addition in Nampa but for the time being, we continue to make the short trip to Meridian for the food when we're in town...it's that good.
Since my husband prefers breakfast (served til closing) and I prefer lunch (served after 10am), we usually hit The Griddle around 1pm; it's quieter and this meal becomes our only one of the day...the servings are that big.
Unfortunately, we are also creatures of habit...when we like something, we stick with it. He usually orders the Pulled Pork & Green Chile omelet (very "smokey" tasting) while I enjoy the Apple Wedgie Salad with Chicken (I'm not a fan of iceberg lettuce but this salad is worth looking past it...it's just plain yummy). But there are great looking items on the menu...we've seen them, just haven't tasted them...yet!!!
So, don't delay...bring your appetite because the portions are good sized, the place is spotless and the staff is incredibly friendly and efficient.
Just keep in mind that The Griddle is always packed on weekends...so we stay away.
Very unhappy of your staff and Service your staff treated my fiancé like a child very unhappy and unprofessional not going there again

Arrived in Boise for a 4 night stay at midnight, tired, and just needing to get to the hotel and get some sleep. The "shuttle service" was a city cab, that was not marked as theirs, and not found with the other cabs. We weren't given directions about how to find our ride (the cab) from the airport prior to our arrival and had to figure that out on our own. I will say, the front desk staff was very courteous and polite. 

We had not been  informed of the ongoing renovations to the first floor lobby, hallways, and breakfast room. There was no furniture at all in the lobby for us to meet our other family members when gathering for the day. On the first day I needed a ride to the airport for my rental car, and called for the "shuttle". 10 minutes later I got to the lobby and no cab. I waited outside, since again, the lobby had no furniture at all, and waited on the sidewalk out front. 15 minutes later I came back in and asked them to call to check on the taxi. The girl called, and apparently, the call was not sent or dispatched correctly, or something, but she said the cab would be right there. 45 minutes after my initial call for a shuttle, the cab got there. If I had a flight to catch, I wouldn't have made it. The cab driver was very surly, and offered no apology at all, shifting the blame to the hotel. He explained in detail why these hotel runs are a pain in the neck and financially inferior to other fares for him. 

The second day, my cousin's room wasn't cleaned at all, no bed made, not even towels. It was skipped entirely. When she called to let the front desk know, she was told the cleaning staff had gone for the day. And nothing was done. I had to go get clean towels for her. That day, my room had minimal service. The bathroom mirror wasn't cleaned, and beds were very poorly made. The next day her room was cleaned and she was in the room. The housekeeping staff went on and on about others who don't do their job and "goof off" instead of cleaning. The third day was about the same for our rooms. Bed linens were pulled up, but not straight on the bed and the little foot coverlet was not touched so it was all crooked and lumpy. When leaving, I checked the floor by our bed for anything that might had dropped, and found a toy car and a pretzel that were not ours, and had been there all 4 days of our stay.

Breakfast was very poor. The first day our hash browns hadn't been cooked. They had been dumped straight from the frozen bag into the warming tray. There was no fresh fruit at all, just the empty container, and we were there an hour before the end of breakfast. 2nd day breakfast was a bit better, but not much. I had to ask about the biscuits, and the staff brought some out. After that, we ate breakfast elsewhere. 

I do plan to return to the Boise area, but sorry to say, will be sure not to stay at this hotel again.

The best sales and service we have dealt with at any dealership! We were treated like we were their only customer even though it was packed!! Well stocked store, amazing selection of RVs. Sales people all the way to maintenance went above the call! Best experience ever!!
Drove all the way to meridian because I missed this place. Delicious! They even have vegetarian ramen!

Tried the combo plate today for dinner and had the Hot Bop (crunchy chicken with S&S sauce)/ Korean style BBQ beef. 

My honest opinion: although I'm really excited that there are more options for food  in the area...  I am not sure I'd go out of my way to eat there. Sauces and food was a little different than I am used to for being Korean food.
Ramen sho was exactly what I expected. Noodles were great and service was exceptional! Definitely going back again

Always drive by this place....today we stopped in....of course I ordered the 5 alarm.   Well after two cups of lemonade  and a trip to the restroom it was indeed on fire..... Pretty daggone good too. Well time to wipe off the sweat and go get some ice cream.... We'll be coming back

Delish! I took my dad here for lunch. We got some great brewskis and fantastic food. My dad ordered the Old South sandwich. I got the Old World pizza. Both meals were fantastic. The atmosphere inside Brewforia is welcoming and open. It's definitely a great place to go out if you're in the mood for some craft beer. 

Is it worth the stop? ABSOLUTELY.

Super yummy and the staff are really nice. The spice level is crazy hot. So be careful. My husband likes ghost pepper hot and he got an 8 and it was to hot. Our picky eater 7 year old loved it. I had the butter garlic sauce and it was delish. Will go back again!

Such delicious coffee! My favorite place for a Mexican mocha. Not too sweet and not heavy handed with the cinnamon. The best part are the "beans" with your drink - chocolate covered espresso beans! So glad they are expanding throughout the Treasure Valley.

If you like Micro Brews and Craft Beers you'll love this place. They've got the popular stuff as well as the hard to find. The service is great and friendly and IMHO their knowledge of beer is the best in the area. The food is great and at a very fair price. These guys are the best in my book. Keep it up.

The staff was very congenial and obliging. The guy working by the cheese was confidently educated and helped me with my selections. 

I always come here for the yummy seasonal desserts. I find the prices pretty fair.
Thanks Dave + Ricco on the hell on the Sig MPX, look forward to future transactions soon! Cheers!

I have found my new favorite dish at ramen sho. The curry tonkatsu is the perfect mix of everything ever and if you don't get it you have never lived. Sorry the downtown location is closing soon but glad to hear they have the food truck and the Meridian location. Come visit this place before 5/31 and you won't be disappointed, or visit them in meridian where I am sure the quality is just as amazing.

Yum yum yum! So many delicious flavors, it's like crack for my tastebuds. The food is healthy, the owners are great, and I have liked about 95% of what I've tried (which is pretty much everything on the menu). Highly recommend. Only complaint is that they don't have one downtown :)
Ordered the "Deluxe Club" sandwich. It was the best freakin' club sandwich I've ever had. If you go here, try it. It's my new go to!
Great concept, great food.  Want to go back to try again.  Very basic so shouldn't scare anyone away that is afraid to try new foods.

I was shopping for a camper for over a week , going to all the RV places here in Boise, my last place was to check out the RV show in Nampa , i walked in and was greeted my a female , than as i wss walking around looking and about to walk out , i was approached by a guy named William who asked if i been helped, and i said no. He asked me all the right questions and was willing to go back to camp world to show me some trailers, i was very inpressed with his customer service and he made me feel important by listening to what i was looking for. Im excited to say, we bought a trailer from him. So excited. Cecilia Hope

Ordered double sweet and sour chicken and szechuan beef at 5. Was told 45 min to delivery and was right on time. Hot and delicious. Well seasoned as I asked for extra spicy and it packed a good punch. Great portion size and definitely worth the price. We will be ordering again!

We had a delicious dinner outside on their patio .... menu changes every Tues 

Appetizer: egg washed panko very tender calamari with a delicious aioli dipping sauce... 

My wife's entree: caramelized chicken breast with sautéed prosciutto, crimini mushrooms & fresh sage leaves, garlic mash potatoes and olive oil sautéed string beans....

My entree: secret delicious spice rubbed (2) Idaho Trout filets topped sliced almonds sautéed in butter-olive oil, DITTO re: starch & veggie ..... accompanied with delicious garlic - rosemary French bread ...... 

wine: bottle of Cline "cold climate" Sonoma Coast Syrah
Never really had a good experience with Food trucks until CupBop! SOOO good!

Great to finally have Ramen in Boise.   We always try Ramen in Vegas, Seattle, Portland ....   Ramen Sho has Miso broth that is good (probably 3.5 compared to other cities).  Menu should provide options to add additional items.  Try this restaurant.
Ugh! Who delivers food to a hotel without bringing utensils?  The food was ok, nothing great. I asked for extra, EXTRA soy sauce and got two packages. Greasy shrimp.

I wasn't a fan of this place. I felt like the meat had been overly cooked (for like days) and it was dry and shredded. In my opinion the meat in Korean bbq is the highlight and I've had good Korean bbq and bad. This was bad. Their noodles, veggies and sauces were good (sauces were not homemade and tasted very processed) band had a good flavor. Ultimately not very good and will not return.

Service and food was excellent today. I have been here several times with poor service,  but today was top notch. we had a large table of 7 people.  All of our food was hot and delicious  and our coffee cups were filled continuously. Good job guys.

My friend and I love The Griddle. We were excited to hear there was one closer to us, but unsure after reading the Yelp reviews. We decided to try it anyways and are glad to say that it did not disappoint!

We showed up about an hour from closing, so it was a little dead. Our waiter, despite being tired from a long and understaffed day, was a hoot. He was friendly, helpful, and funny. Definitely made the experience better. He also made one of, if not THE best latte I've ever had!

The food was delicious! I had the California Benedict which was a little better than expected because the bacon and even hashbrowns had the perfect amount of crisp. My friend had the Caribbean French Toast, which was enjoyed so much I almost didn't get to try it.

All in all, it was a great experience and I can't wait to go back again!
Best. Ice. Cream. Nothing else is needed. Simple, normal and unique flavors with fair amount for the price. I will be back and you should check it out.

Ramen Sho is an oasis of quality here in the Treasure Valley. Dang if downtown Boise didn't lose this gem; thankfully it resurrected itself in Meridian --of all places. Very incongruous.
Ramen Sho is a small and unadorned presence, but its product is mighty. Some of the best Ramen I've had. 
This is owed to Miki in the kitchen, a *powerhouse* of an Okinawan woman whose kitchen chops are unimpeachable. She knows what she's doing. I've been eating what she serves up for, oh, two years now? I have never had 'ought but the best tonkatsu imaginable. It is delicious, and it is reliable. I have never had a so-so bowl, it has *always* been top-notch, and well presented. The pork is always tender, the egg and presentation consistently appetizing.
Honestly, I've never had anything but the tonkatsu, so I can't speak to the rest of their fare. The wife had the yakisoba special today, and THAT was delicious, with rich, delicate noodles with some kind of wondermous fried chicken. I did have a few bites, it was good.
Running the front of the house is Yoko, who is just such a joy. Warm and funny, she imbues the sparse digs with life. Ramen Sho is such a gift. I can't recommend it highly enough.

Great food for the price.
I love Yokozuna for their chicken and veggie bowl. 
My wife gets the beef sukiyaki and also the brown rice and veggies.
I usually call ahead and its ready when I show up and I always take it home. When i get there I pick up a container of the chili paste that adds a great amount of spice to the teriyaki sauce that they provide

Usually like Dennys but went there for dinner and everything was cold. I like the $4. Biscuits and Gravy. Cold biscuits topped with Luke warm gravy, cold hash browns, and two cold over easy eggs. Those of you who know,  nothing grosser than cold fried eggs.  My wifes burger was so cold the cheese didnt melt. This is not the norm but Thur. Night it was bad.

One of the first stops I make when visiting Boise.  Great place to sample the micro brews from the Pacific Northwest, especially the Idaho beers which don't make it to where I live.  Staff always ready with suggestions based on your preferences.

Beautiful place, love the balcony environment. Food was "eh". Made even worse by the slowest service I've ever experienced. & we're talking about a slow day. 4 or 5 servers on duty, and maybe like 4 tables of customers total. & it took them 30 minutes each trip to come back to us. Younger brother had to actually go, ask for the check, bring it to us, and then take it back to them so we could leave. Not impressed. Especially since you can see the servers inside through the glass, chatting and doing nothing. Customer service makes or breaks an establishment, & I can 100% say we'll never be coming back.

What a delightful surprise!  We thought we'd lost our Ramen Sho forever when the downtown location closed, only to discover they had reopened in Meridian in a strip mall location.  We were thrilled!  Stopped in yesterday for lunch and my husband had the tonkatsu (he can't get off the tonkatsu!) while I chose the summer-special yakisoba dish (beautiful flavors--ginger, garlic, shredded veggies) topped with a few pieces of fried chicken.  Both were excellent, and the service from Yoko was attentive without being pushy.  Everyone else dining with us were making the same happy and appreciative noises.  Love this little place!
Good food and atmosphere. Large restaurant , with friendly staff. Real fresh squeezed orange juice.

I love love love this place!!! Angie and Amy are my go to ladies for hair , eyebrows and spray tan.  Rebecca is the nail tech that enjoys drawing things on a tiny canvas such as nails! She was great! I get compliments often because of these Wonderful woman!!!  Highly recommend!!!

Oh my!! I cannot say enough GREAT things about this salon/spa. Went for a spa day today and they went above and beyond! Everyone was lovely and extremely helpful with such a huge smile and passion for what they do! Alisa did my facial and she was hands down the best. Very knowledgeable and helped answer all my questions plus gave me a fantastic facial. Gina did my mani and pedi and I adored her! She pampered me!! And she is really a people person and fully enjoys getting to know you. Just a bunch of kind women! The "taking the waters," was so relaxing, with the mineral bath and eucalyptus sauna! I was in heaven. I look forward to going back, again and again! Thank you everyone who helped my spa day the best I have ever had, you all are so wonderful!

It's Denny's, which you can file under "what do you expect?" This one actually has decent cooks in the back, they get a thumbs up for that. However, the wait staff is really inconsistent. One minute they are there, the next minute you are in a ghost town and considering the self-service option as you watch the coffee the waitress left brewing smolder down to char from neglect. I don't know if the poor waitresses have just been abused so long by passing truckers that they have developed some sort of built-in flight reflex. Maybe if they sense anyone is going to complain about something, they scatter. They seem to be surprised when someone acts polite to them, but respond favorably, like you've just made a new friend. Anyway, besides service that leaves you scratching your head, it's a decent Denny's.

Who would have thunk that there was an even more expensive grocery than Whole Paycheck (Sorry, I meant Whole Foods), well I found it: Boise Co-op: $65 to become a member!!!!

Ouch, that being said, most of what they carry is organic and local. But still, I think that if I decide to join, then my household will have to make a conscious effort to only eat out once a week, or take on another mortgage!,

What a great find! The MOMOS are amazing!  I & my two teenagers tried all three available: the turkey, pork, & vegetarian.  We all agreed the pork was the winner. The samosas are outstanding also, and the spicy red sauce served with them had just the right amount of heat...very addicting! We ordered two combos, but the rice was not ready so they brought it out on the side. We all agreed that the beans were very bland, and the combo itself was a little disappointing. We also tried the fried dumplings, and they were delicious also. 
We didn't care for everything,  but I'm still giving a 5 star rating because the MOMOSand samosas are worth it. 
Very friendly and helpful staff, who took the time to explain the menu, and come around to the tables and ask how we liked the food. The atmosphere was bright and inviting, and the restaurant was very clean. 
This is a must-try restaurant, and I will be back, guaranteed!

We shared a modified Vic's omelet this morning, which turned out great along with wonderfully crispy (at our request) hash browns. Got some of their famous hotcakes on the side to which my husband commented that they were the best he has had in a long time: super fresh, fluffy and delicious. Service was very friendly but as a tea drinker, it's never easy to get refills, it seems. All in all it was quite tasty and we would certainly come back.

Can't say enough about the service here! As out of state travelers, we were beyond nervous when our car started to unexpectedly overheat. Proximity and other Yelp recommendations helped seal our decision to go to this Meineke. As it turns out, it was only a faulty radiator cap...and we were not gouged with excessive and unnecessary costs. We were out the door after 90 minutes for under $23!! Yes!! Go here for any of your car difficulties!! So grateful.
