Hands down; the best meal I've had all year. Anyone local to or visiting Boise has to put Muse on their MUST list. Absolutely brilliant!

This is the first time I have written a review, and I felt that I had to to save everyone's life from eating here. The Meat Was Awful And Rubbery and greasy with no flavor.  The meat was stringy and disgusting. My daughter loves Chinese but now she doesn't want anyone to mention it anymore. It is filthy and the plates were dirty. My family didn't even touch the food. Some of the meat had a slight fishy taste when it shouldn't have tasted like that. When we went to the salad bar they had the lettuce sitting in a pan of water! The lettuce was floating in it! They poured water into the chicken and all of there food tasted greasy. All I can say eat at your own risk.

Staff is always helpful when trying to find the right product.  Thank you!!!!  Any item I've purchased in the store, has been greater than my expectation of "organic" or natural!!! I shop here regularly because of the consistency.

Extreamly clean and organized, however I will not be going there again bc of a comment made by one of the female cashier's that I have personally delt with on numerous occasions. On his day off my thoughtful boyfriend had picked up my prenatal vitamins for me and was waiting in line and the cashier was being pleasant to the people in front of him and a first very pleasant to him as well. And well I think that he had mistaken her up first kindness for flirting; she proceeded to check him out with the one item look down at what it was and proceeded to talk to the person after him like he suddenly doesn't exist. Which that in everyone's eyes is pretty rude but he got very baffled at the fact that she snarled at the end "good luck", and keep in mind that we have both been checked out together by this woman. So although I like the environment it and how its setup and everything I'll be going to the one further away for me so I don't have to have a conversation with this woman.

This place has become a great "regular" place for my family and I on Sunday mornings. The food is all around good to great and the wait staff has always been very friendly. I'd love to give it 5 stars, but the huge open dining area makes for a pretty loud environment and lacks that "cozy" feel that is often a hallmark of an exceptional breakfast spot for me. The coffee is so-so, but they never leave your mug empty!

I go here during the week as the weekends can be crowded. They listen when you order and the food is prepared accordingly. One of the few places in town that can make an egg over easy and not come out medium. HINT: Once in awhile the crispy hash browns come out pasty white - I have since learned to ordered them crispy on both sides. Perfection!

I hope Terri's will follow Steve's lead and offer the PORKIE. Hasn't happened yet. It's the only time I go there on weekend and then I go both Saturday AND Sunday. Yes, it is that good.

Keeping my fingers crossed!

ps: I think they use Dawson Creek coffee - good stuff. Let's hope it doesn't change.
Great food from a quick casual restaurant.  If you like Indian food, you will love this place.

Nice studying atmosphere, but only 2 outlets. Get your fix of caffine or relax with a glass of wine. There are books and magazines for anyone who needs a study break. Pretty good pina colada smoothie,  green tea frappe was creamy and full of flavor. They didn't skip on matcha powder.  

A little pricey (some drinks start at 3.50 for a small, 12 oz).

Seems like a friendly neighborhood joint. Owner was here for an hour or so, but didn't talk to me, so I can't confirm what previous yelpers said. Barista was really friendly though.

Bonus: Wireless printing for 10 cents / page
Bought a beautiful hot pink hydroflask this morning at 7am. It's noon and my coffee is still as hat as when it was made and I won't be contributing to the landfill anymore! Glorious!
Great customer service, clean store and phones prices are great. The person helping me was very Knowledgeable one there products and phones. Amazing deals

I've loved Cupbop for awhile since I used to live in Salt Lake and was so happy to discover that they had opened a location up here. They're bowls are filling. I especially love the sweet potato noodles and the sauces are great. I typically order the Ugly Bop Pop (Korean Fried Chicken) but you can't go wrong with anything from the menu. The Mandoo is great too. I always order some extra. The people there are always warm and inviting. It's a great atmosphere. Highly recommend.

We pulled up here late at night a couple days ago, after having called to make sure they wouldn't give our room away. They reassured us that someone would be there and they'd hold our room. 
Once we got in, the lady at the desk got us all set up, and was so kind. She was very laid back and let us know the pool and hot tub would be open a little longer, and helped me find an herbal tea to wind down after an 8+ hour drive. 
I was surprised and impressed that both the pool and the hot tub had chairs to be accessible for people with disabilities. 
The room was spacious enough for the two of us, clean, comfortable beds, water pressure in the bathroom was fine, nothing at ALL to complain about.  Breakfast was included, and it was a little nicer than what I expected. 

We only stayed one night, and got up early the next day and went on our way, but I'd stay here again.

The store and parts department here are nice. That's about it. Do not ever take your RV for service to this place. We took our RV in to have them do their silver service plus generator service. They came back and told us that there were two leaks in the propane system, one in the range and one in the fridge. The part for the fridge was no longer available. So their solution was to buy a new fridge. Within five minutes of me looking online I found an alternative part number that the manufacturer had issued. They said that they could perform the generator service because there was no gas in the generator, but my rig has an under rig generator that pulls fuel from the gas tank. Kind of scary that I knew more than their techs and I just bought the RV, which is my first one, less than a month before I took it in. 
They also left my black water valve open with the cover on the drain pipe. I spotted it before we left for a trip but when I went to the dump to make sure everything was drained, it spilled waste all over my clothes and shoes and all over the dump site. To say I was upset is a huge understatement. 
So not trusting what they had told me, I got a second opinion on the leaks. Surprise, surprise the person that I had do a second test found NO leaks anywhere in the LP system. They tried to scare me into buying new appliances and I refused to fall into their web of lies! 
There were other little things that they said were broken or didn't work, like the LP detector. They said it needed to be replaced because the old one didn't work at all. Granted it did need to be replaced due to age, but it wasn't working because there was no fuse installed in the breaker box for it. I had to figure that one out. 
At this point I'm not 100% sure what we paid $450 for. I would highly recommend taking your RV to anywhere but here! If I could give it zero stars I would.
I ordered from uber eats and received my food in a decent amount of time. The broth was tasteless, the pork belly was tough and chewy; overall it was a huge disappointment.

is this location closed? it shows open online & i have tried to go here twice (on Sundays) & both time it has closed sign up. i wanted a boba tea & to try the steak & shrimp bowl. i'll still go to the one on Vista, but this one is closer for my son to try. online shouldn't show open if they aren't.
Love the aesthetic, owner is super friendly! Some of the best coffee in Boise, honestly.

Kevin was amazing!!! When helping us out he didn't just take our order but made suggestions of what he liked and seemed truly pleased to make sure we were happy. GET THE ARTISANAL CHEESE! The Whitewater brew ain't bad to wash it down with either! Great food, exponentially better service!
Love this place! The atmosphere is super fun and the owner really tries to get to know all of his customers. My recommendation is a blended groove!

The only thing they care about is SELLING RVs. Their parts and accessories department are so small it could FIT in an RV. There was a counter with ONE man behind it and 8 people waiting for service. We were looking for a tripod for stabilizing the front of our 5th wheel when we are stopped for overnight. They had ONE and the box was broken and open. When we asked a woman who worked there if there were others in the back she went and looked and said no that was the only one. When I wanted to open the box and make sure everything was there and unbroken she said she couldn't do that but I could go to the counter (which now had the same 8 people and one more for a total of 9 people waiting!) and he could do it. I went to the front counter that had two women "working" (actually just chatting) and asked if there was someone else who could help us and was told no. So, we left without the tripod and are getting it from someplace else (Country Corners RV park -- which I will give a positive review elsewhere) where they are MUCH nicer and it is nearly 1/3 less! Camping World was a dreadful disappointment-- they were rude, ill equipped, poorly supplied, poorly staffed, and way overpriced. Won't be back!

First time trying this place. Waited 30+ minutes for our food, they were out of condiments, there was flies everywhere. I was hoping for something slightly better than what I could get at a McDonalds and was severely disappointed, the food was cold, our waitress barely spoke and when they did it sounded like they were there against their will. I will not be coming back to this place ever.
Ramen Sho is a great new restaurant. I found the quality of food to be a great focus of the restuarant. As this place grows I wouldn't be surprised if it become another classic Boise resturant.

We went for lunch because at night this place is always packed, would suggest lunch time or be prepared to wait at night.  

Awesome beer selection, great pizza and wings. Couldn't ask for anything more!  Will definitely come back to visit whenever we are in Boise.  

Only giving 4 stars due to the small size of the location.

This place is amazing ... I've only gone twice but each time was worth driving along Eagle Road.  Their momos are really good and they have different choices.  I've tried all but their yak. The curry chicken is sweet and tender.  The owner is very nice and down to earth.  He actually gave us a free extra momo because he thought his pork momos came out a little too small.  My boyfriend and I split the 5 momo + 1 side dish and there were even leftovers.  It isn't greasy at all and the flavors are wonderful.  I highly recommend getting their specialty drink the mango lassi.

Momo is a Himalayan dumpling shop that is new to the Boise area. Knowing my love for Asian, especially dim sum and dumplings, I knew I would be one of the first people through the door of the place. Having eaten a full order of their pork momo with the spicy sauce and a little cilantro, I am confident my first visit will not be my last. 

The menu at Momo is fairly simple. You can choose from turkey or pork dumplings which are similar to steamed potstickers and then one of two accompanying sauces. I sampled both sauces and preferred the spicy one. They also serve some rice bowls and a chicken salad that I did not try. My dumplings were perfectly steamed and had a great texture. The pork flavor was a little more robust than the turkey dumpling which has a milder taste. 

My overall impression of my initial visit was a positive one. 

My minor gripes would be the price and amount of sauce they give you. A full dumpling order with 8 dumplings was $7.00. Not a bad price but not a great one. While I enjoy the sauce Momo serves with the dumplings, they drown the tasty morsels in it. For my next visit, I think I am going to ask for the sauce to be on the side or have them put about half as much on. The pork dumplings can stand on their own, there is no reason to overpower their flavor with the sauce like they did during my visit.

Well let us begin....really noisy.   Place wasn't full when we arrived and the waitress was pleasant and efficient.   But we waited an extremely long time before our food arrived.  Not sure I'd want to go back.  Too many great places to eat around here.

The service here is something you don't ever find anymore. Simply incredible! I was floored with the friendliness. The food choices were perfect (had a hard time choosing), and priced just right. I had the corned beef and hash and it was yummy! After our first time there, we will definitely be back! 5+stars!

Yokozuna was a frequent stop when they opened for me, but their customer service has gone downhill. I have had many visits where you sit and wait to be greeted with nobody in sight. Their front case is mostly empty and they frequently are out of boba or have not made it yet. They serve boba, but only if you don't show up when they open for lunch.

Cleanliness is also an issue and they do not keep up with general cleaning.

The teriyaki itself is good, although smaller portions than other teriyaki places in town for the same price. Other menu items have been mediocre at best.
Great coffee and nice employees! I come here several times a week and have never been disappointed! Text club is nice perk!

I just ate at Great Wall, first time as we are newer residents to Boise.   Food was fresh, and well prepared.

Chicken wings, yes the chicken wings are really good.    Not as massive on the selections of other area Chinese fusion type buffets, but each item was good.

Went on a Saturday around 11am for some breakfast because I heard that "Steve's Cafe" has amazing breakfast.   I was soon informed by a server that Steve had left the cafe and now Terri owns it and that it was the first opening weekend for Terri's Cafe instead of Steve's.  Congrats Terri!  

Simply put, this place is AMAZING.  Although it was busy due to the Saturday crowd, we were seated immediately at the breakfast bar area.  Here's the breakdown:

PROS:  Too many! First of all, when you order a drip coffee, they give you a BIG mug...none of those tiny 10 ounce cups you see at other places that leave you hoping that the waitress notices you need a refill every 5 minutes.  Secondly, if you're not into coffee, DO order a hot chocolate or a peppermint hot chocolate...you will not regret it!  

This place has the absolute BEST corned beef breakfast plate I've ever had in Boise! Quality meat that is perfectly flavored and doesn't have the fatty parts seen on other plates around Boise.  The server informed me they slow cook it overnight.  My wife scored the huckleberry stuffed french toast which was also delicious and quality.  The woman next to me ordered the biscuits and gravy which she highly praised as well.  

CONS:  None!  Everything from the food to atmosphere and service were top notch.  There were plenty of servers staffed and everyone was very friendly and helpful.

Side Note:  If you go during a busy time, the parking can be somewhat limited since the parking lot is shared with several other businesses (it's located in a strip mall).  Also, expect to wait a little bit if you if you have 4 or more people.  Although, the wait is definitely worth it!


Overall, if you are craving a quality breakfast be sure to check out Terri's!

The food was good and there were a lot of healthy options I wasn't expecting. For example the side dishes had whole grain rice, broccoli, and steamed squash. I could tell they had worked on improving the menu.
The place was clean and the staff were polite. All in all it's a good diner.

I always meet interesting people, the service is awesome, and the beer selection... Oh, and try to beat a $5 growler fill!

This is one of the establishments that makes me happy I live in Boise.

Good Cook'n Griddle is Idaho's version of Breakfast at Tiffany's.  The food is always fresh and the special offer up unique tastes that leave you wanting to come back again. 
Must try the Caribbean French Toast and the Crab cakes Benedict.  Fresh squeezed Orange JuiceJuice is the a great compliment to any meal. 
If you sleep in and feel like catching lunch they offer up some fantastic lunch items. Or you can grab a late breakfast. Hope you enjoy as much as we do.

Wow, sure wish we had Frankie's near us. We were on vacation in Idaho and decided to give Frankie's a try. 
Not only was the food fresh and made with love, but the service was outstanding. 
My husband had the huevos rancheros which, he said were the best he'd ever had. 
Everything was fresh, nothing from a can or frozen pouch like you find in the mainstream chain restaurants. I wasn't real hungry so I asked if they'd mind just making  a couple scrambled eggs with some avocado and they were more than happy to make whatever we wanted. When we left we couldn't resist taking one if their delicious looking cinnamon rolls with us which was outstanding. Oh great coffee and latte as well. Would be a comfortable place to meet friend or co workers for a meeting. Lots of well thought out seating options. Owner is super friendly and passionate about her restaurant!

When I first walked in, no one even acknowledged me... two employees just avoided all contact. They got some condescending kid to take my order..  The kid at the counter kept arguing with me about what I wanted to order... he was trying to up sell me even though twice I told them what I wanted. This is not how you run a business is not how you get return business I will never use this restaurant again. This was my first, and now my last visit to any Papa Murphy's location.

I was not expecting the food to be as good as it was.  My wife ordered a sweet and sour combo and I had the buffet.  Almost everything I tried was excellent.  It was late in the evening so a few of the items looked like they were there awhile.  The crab egg rolls were good so was the "build your own" mongolian type grill.  They charge by age for the buffet, like 65 cents per year of age,  so my 4 year old ate for like $2.50 and I found out that if you have gone through bariatric surgery they charge you for a 5 year old so you can eat for like $3 bucks.

Big error on gift cards $735 and they can't figure out how to fix it. Told me they would have to submit a form and I would have to wait for an answer. Not the responsibility se you want when they just took $735 of my money. Sue, operations manager, was very rude and unresponsive. Although Lillie is very nice and trying to help me out.

Delicious! I looooove curry! I prefer spicy curry but the curry here was great. The guys working were super friendly and recommended great stuff for my platter. I tried the yak, it did not disappoint. I definitely plan to return. 

Great service and delicious food!
What a great place.  We came here because its close to our hotel, and glad we did!  Yummy breakfast, awesome service.  Super clean, great decor.  We will definitely be back!

I had been wanting to try this place ever since I heard about it. I ended up with the Hawaiian cone, but added black olives. This does not disappoint. I will for sure be back. I should have taken a picture, but I ate it first. The cone had pretty good flavor as well. 
Can't wait to come back and bring my wife.

Where are the Chinese in Eagle?  One might think with the amount of cars in the parking lot that this place would be good. If you want tater tots they have them.  If you want Chinese keep looking.   

Is this place related to place on Overland. At least in rating!

I ordered food from the bistro when we saw a movie on the VIP balcony. They had some kinks to work out regarding the system, but my burger and fries were surprisingly tasty and not greasy.  The prices are comparable to similar establishments, and considering the expense of popcorn and prepackaged concessions, it's a good value. 

We also stopped by the bar after my birthday dinner last weekend. Even though we were just there for post-dinner drinks, we still received friendly service. I didn't find it to be any louder than any other dining options at the Village. Quite the contrary. 

It's a unique idea and well-executed.  I can see us coming for a meal when Twigs isn't in the budget, or taking advantage of VIP dining again. 

Update: we've indulged in VIP dining several times now. There's still the occasional slip-up, but the burgers and fries are consistently fantastic. My second fave burger after the signature burger at Twigs. The cocktails aren't as enjoyable served in plastic, but I can guess why they avoid glassware in the theater itself. My advice?

Unless you're drinking beer, sip a cocktail on the balcony before or after your movie instead, and enjoy the view.

We stayed for three nights while my husband was interviewing with a local company and we took an extra day to tour the area.  

The hotel is older but exceptionally clean and well maintained and has some very nice upgrades.  It is centrally located to the cities of Meridian, Eagle and Boise and is next to one of the main arterials in the area so it was convenient to get to all the local conveniences and the freeway.

They had a complementary continental breakfast with great coffee (coming from Seattle we were excited to have bold java), the only recommendation I'd make it to add in more protein and less carbs for the buffet.  Lots of danishes, waffles, French toast, cereals and breads, biscuits & gravy but only one day of scrambled eggs and no hardboiled or cottage cheese or some other protein substitute to round out the carb load.  They did offer yogurt and cut up fruit, which was a little past its time, but overall it was edible if you were in a hurry and looking for a quick bite.  The mini waffles were a big hit with the husband.

It would be great to see the owner implement a recycle program and have a bin in every room and the lobby area.  I felt bad about dumping all the plastic containers, newspapers and magazines in the trash.

The staff overall was very friendly and helpful, but the front desk person was doing laundry every time we went to the lobby to ask for assistance. They had a sign out front indicating they were doing the laundry and instructions to ring a bell, but the dryer's were loud and they would not hear the bell every time so we'd be waiting around for 5-10 minutes at a time.  What we found is the front desk manager does ALL the laundry for the hotel.  I would recommend having someone from the housekeeping staff help with this task or hire someone to handle it exclusively so the front desk person can focus on customers.

Otherwise, it was a very nice stay, in a very clean hotel with friendly and helpful staff in a great location.   

Recommend!

Kolby and crew are the best!. I meet at the Groove with customers and friends offer. Turkey sandwich is out of this world. Great people great coffee Great FOOD. Atmosphere and friendliness is unbeatable. They also have a drive thru window. Love small businesses. .

I was desperately looking for a place that could take a last minute same day appointment since I was experiencing a horrible headache and left work early. My usual massage therapist was not open on Monday so I found this place. This place far exceeded my expectations! Don't let the outside fool you! When you walk in it's clean and professional! They were very busy but still managed to see me! They guy that did my massage was very nice and was a master at Chinese massage! How do I know this? I've received several massages all throughout Idaho and California from high end spas and his massage technique was impressive! So this place is more of the pressure point deep massages not the soft Swedish massage. He was very skilled in hitting all the right pressure points all along my entire body. He basically got rid of all of the knots in my upper back!! Don't let the stigma of 'Asian massage' places deter you from trying this place out. Everyone there both the men and women were professional and friendly. Might be some language barrier but so what.

They were able to get me in same day which was lovely since I never know my schedule in advance. Very clean place, professional stylists, no heavy sales stuff (which I appreciate). I got an all-over color and my stylist (I'm sorry! I can't remember your name!) was very helpful and encouraging. Definitely going back. Took me a long time to find a place I like!

Only thing I'm not crazy about... the back of my white shirt is now purple because the dye wasn't rinsed from the hair back there.

Really good ramen.  Just would like a different protein option than pork belly.  With that said, the pork belly is scrumptious. Be sure to order an extra soft boiled egg or two if you are in to the egg thing.

Very great friendly service. Good employees, good food, good times. Every time I eat at The Great Wall, I have a good time. I tip well every single time and I enjoy the friendly service. The entry is a bit confusing, but otherwise it's great!
The ramen was good - a bit different toppings than what was advertised on the menu, but still good.  The atmosphere of the restaurant was very quite and chill.

Exceptional restaurant. Seated quickly and attentive waiter. Order came within 8 minutes. All hot foods served steaming hot. Waiter gave us a short lesson on differences of hot cakes, flap jacks and pancakes. Teen said they were best he's ever had. The bacon was incredible. Spouse had biscuits and gravy and it was amazing. The flavor of the gravy was very savory. Will definitely come back.

Prices are great, quality is fantastic and the staff was supremely helpful.

Really my only complaint is that I have to go down Eagle road and then fight with more hospital traffic once I turn into the parking lot. Probably won't be back as I don't enjoy sitting in traffic or encouraging over development of already strained areas and that is a real shame because this place is divine.
I had no idea what to expect but I love trying new things. Tried the pork chicken even the yak. Loved the extra spicy sauce. Give it a try.

This is the place for Craft Beer drinkers.  Far and away the best selection and value in the Treasure Valley.  Not a sport bar, not a meat market, not a pub.  An unique experience.  Rotating beer menu of Craft Beers on tap.  Plus a huge selection in their "beer library."  Draws for Craft Beers are on average $1 to $3 cheaper than anywhere in the Boise area!  The food menu is somewhat specialized and the portion not very big, but the selection of delectable unusual treats goes very well with the beer menu  Friendly staff.  Relaxing atmosphere.  An all around great experience.

Stopped by recently for a quick lunch. Service was ok. Foods were ok. We ordered pull-pork sandwich and BBQ two meats plate. French fries were ok, a bit on the soggy side. Ambience is like in a warehouse setting. Not too bad to grab a bite but nothing else.

I highly recommend TERRI'S CAFE. The food is always delicious. I have to eat gluten free and they have a very nice selection of breakfast and lunch items. TERRI the owner has made nice improvements to what was once Steves Restaurant. The waitresses are always pleasant and friendly. Don't hesitate to have your next breakfast or lunch here. You won't be disappointed.

This breakfast joint was the best breakfast I have had in a long time. The French toast was fluffy and filling, the hash browns were crispy and delightful. I had a mimosa with breakfast and my fiancé had coffee which never got cold because the service was phenomenal. They asked frequently how we were doing and kept the table neat and clean. Even after they got busy, the service remained good. This has to be my new favorite breakfast place and we will be coming back!

I really enjoyed the food. It is light, fresh and feels like it came from the Himalayas. The dumplings are perfect. I love the meatballs, ground turkey, spicy chicken. The addition of fresh, raw veggies with yogurt and celantro on top really Is a nice finish.

I give it 2 stars only because theres no 1/2. Anyways, i grabbed lunch there yesterday and got 3 sandwiches, 2 salads, and 1 soup. Needless to say it sucked! The salad leaves were wilted, and the sandwiches were way to plain jane. The bread was dry as well as the turkey. I was expecting a little more. I wont be going back.

Absolutely awful! Worst food I have had in awhile! Took 3 bites out of my spicy skillet and now I feel sick. All the meat was chewy. Server saw it at the edge of the table, clearly we were unhappy and still paid 11 for junk. Will not be coming back anytime soon.  Management didn't even ask how our food was.

If I could I would put a negative star for this site. We bought an RV at this place one year ago. There was an RV advertised on the internet that looked real good and was just what we were looking for in a class A. It came with a toad (a Smart car)! When we got there we were told they sold the toad separately and it was gone. Although the internet still showed the toad in the ad. We got to Meridian after traveling from Montana to see the advertised RV. We waited way too long for the salesman to help us even though we made an appointment to see him. We should have just got up and left. The salesman could not find the RV we asked to see and he was confused as to which one we wanted to see. Strike 2!. Now he found it but begins to talk about how the previous owner put it on consignment and such. All talk from this salesman is negative about the previous owner and the RV. It still looked good to us. Salesman then wants to show us another similar RV. We look at it. He begins to talk this one up real hard!! All positive now!
We should have left at this point as this was the CLASSIC BAIT AND SWITCH coming on. This RV was not as nice, dirty inside and out. Cheaper yes, but we liked the first one better. 
We asked to drive the first RV. We were told to go to the waiting area and the salesman would get it out to where we could drive it. Time marches on.....(we should have left)...now we are told the RV will not start and there is techs working on it. Time marches on.....finally told it will not start and would we be interested in trying the other RV? OK sure....(we should have refused and left) 
The test drive went ok. We checked out the RV and found the coach batteries were missing and in their place was one small 12v battery that would not power much for very long. Previous owner had taken the other batteries as well as a few other things we noticed. Solar panel, satellite receiver antenna, and who knows what else. The salesman could not identify what I guessed was an DC to AC inverter. Salesman had previously told us how he had been selling RV's for many years yet he could not confirm that what I guessed was an inverter. 
After going through the finance person who claimed at one point she had not made a mistake in 3 years and yet she just made a mistake on our contract..how weird is that?
The RV was ready the next day for us to pick up. We inspected it and were told it was in excellent shape. Turns out later in the day we are leaving the lot and it starts raining....Wipers are not working. Oh yeah it is in excellent shape. I had to rustle up the service manager to get this fixed as we are on the road to Carson City NV without wipers. The manager and a service tech put in a USED part and promise to send a new one to us. That ends up taking 2 weeks and several phone calls. The keys to the RV do not include the deadbolt lock key and only one set of keys. More phone calls and more waiting to get the new lockset from Winnebago via the CW service manager. On the road now and stopping in Winnemucca NV for the night. We lost coach battery power and cannot pull in the slides or start the engine. The new coach batteries they put in are dead. Many phone calls later we get a service person to spend 4 hours rewiring the so-called aux battery with new cables and relocating same to the battery box under the steps. We have road service and a service contract but we had to eat the 4 hour service person charge because nothing was replaced. I could go on with this but I will finish by saying...BEWARE OF BUYING FROM THIS PLACE!!! THE SALES PEOPLE ARE NOT HONEST!

I've been here a few times and to be honest it is one of the better. On my last visit me and my friend had ordered two $5 fill ups. They were perfectly cooked. Moist and juicy with no pink. We had also ordered a $20 family fill up bucket with a request that it be delayed so that it was nice and hot during my ride home for my family. Once we had finished our 5 dollar fill ups we conversed for a a few minutes and just as we got ready to get up and go they had finished making the family fill up. They even offered me a cake for my wait even though I had told them I didn't mind waiting while we ate. I thought it was generous and quite fantastic. As long as they keep up the fantastic customer service I will continue to come here. Being from the southern state of Mississippi I always crave good soul food as most would refer it. KFC is the perfect place to sate my craving for a taste of home. Great work!

The staff handled a surprise (meaning unannounced) birthday party so well tonight. They were friendly, kept their cool, and truly hustled to get food to a bunch of loud, squirmy kids. And as vegetarians, we were delightfully surprised at how delicious the black bean veggie burger is!! Will definitely come back. Kudos to the staff for such great customer service tonight!

I am so happy to have the privilege of writing a positive review for a repair place that not only cares about its customers, but takes pride in their work. This Meineke location takes pride in a job well done. Their prices are fair and service is great. I will return here for future needs. Oh, and they obviously respect our men and women of the military as I watched them offer a discount to a disabled veteran who was in line in front of me. Thanks so much, Meineke!

Highly recommend this business, we were  traveling to Montana from Nevada and had a stop in Meridian, one of our air conditioners went out and needed replacement, Kenny, our service writer,  completely handled the logistics and coordination of all repairs and services,  I cannot say enough about the staff and professionalism of this business,  not only will I post here but write the company and higher supervision to give thanks for the great work,  if you have ever dealt with warranty issues and politics, please know that Kenny and this staff will ease your mind, kudos again for Kenny and this business

At last! I have been looking for a good old-fashioned ice cream shop since moving to the Treasure Valley a year and a half ago. I got a single scoop of this one flavor that has Thin Mints and caramel. It was delicious and the service was fast and friendly. My husband got a shake (thick and drinkable) and a grilled cheese. I wouldn't say the grilled cheese is the best ever, but for $2.50 it's worth it. I can't wait to come back.

Excellent addition to the Treasure Valley food scene.
I first experienced the Momo craze several years back during a trip to the local farmer's market and am very excited that they have since open their own restaurant.
Besides the great tasting and unique food the owners and staff are incredibly friendly.

Close to our hotel so we decided to try it out before we left town. Fast service, super cute, clean, busy cafe. Big cups of coffee and our food was really good. Thanks Tricia for the to-go coffee too!

Really excellent experience.  We had just returned from a trip to Vegas where we ate at a southern comfort restaurant (Yardbird), which was fantastic, but really expensive.  We thought Barnyard was very comparable, but more reasonably priced.  Highly recommend the Fried Green Tomato Stack - delicious!  All of the biscuits would be delicious - we went with the Classic and ended up ordering a second helping.  The skillet fried smoke chicken and ribs were outstanding.  Definitely recommend!!

So, I didn't actually go in to this store. I called Customer Service responding to an email regarding an "internet for life" offer. Deanna, from Springfield MO helped set me up and was delightful to work with. At the end of our interaction I asked if there were any other loyalty perks I might be eligible for. She sent me to the Retention Department where a gentleman answered the call. Unfortunately I have forgotten his name but he did mention that he had recently moved to Boise! He was also quite charming and, indeed had a decent offer for me! I am quite pleased at lowering my monthly bill by $19 and locking that price in for life! (As long as I remain a "customer in good standing".) 
I rarely have a rewarding experience with most customer service departments but, in spite of having marginal speed on my internet, I'm pleased with the outcome this time and am content to remain a loyal customer!
Just okay ramen. The service was quick and the server was very polite. The ambience is just okay. The ramen was good but not amazing.
Two stars is a gift. Meat was stringy and cheap.  Chicken was bland. Frozen mc nuggets would be tastier.

Great little BBQ spot in Meridian. Excellent service and southern style BBQ in the heart of Idaho. Had the blue plate, which had delicious, moist fried chicken and spiced chilled watermelon. Others had the po boy, burger, chicken salad sammich, all of which received rave reviews.
In a comparison between Dennys, Sharis, and IHOP. Dennys has the best food between the three, Sharis is a close second, while IHOP is absolutely the worst. Will definitely come back to Dennys.

I'd suggest Momo, if only looking for something different. The food was very good and the folks working there were some of the nicest people in the Valley. However, the menu was very limited, seating limited and the ambient temp of the place (on a cool day) seemed like it was in the mid 80's, which made the place stuffy and uncomfortable. I had the combo platter with turkey dumplings. The portions were very reasonable compared to cost and taste/texture varied. However, unless the several items available are your thing, I wouldn't imagine it keeping you coming back.

Was looking forward to trying out this restaurant based on the description. I personally had never heard of it, my wife had and suggested to give it a try...unfortunately this was chose as where we'd have her birthday dinner. I'm going to have to make this up to her somehow. 
Wasn't impressed, I had the BBQ Duo. The brisket seemed as if it had been sliced earlier in the day and then placed on the flattop to reheat it. The BBQ sauce that covered it and the pulled pork was okay, it definitely helped to give the meat some flavor. Without the sauce you get nothing... literally no flavor whatsoever. My wife had the chicken & waffles   & watermelon. They use the same BBQ sauce as they use on the brisket for the chicken, it doesn't really work with the dish. If you are expecting fried chicken, think again. The Belgian waffles aren't bad, a light maple syrup and a chutney top these, again BBQ doesn't work here. The watermelon was good, this was all that she finished, my wife only ate half a waffle and one of the pieces of chicken. I will say, the fresh cut fries are pretty good, maybe the best part of my meal. 
The staff were not super helpful. I was also a little surprised that at 6:30 pm to 7:30 while we were there, the place was empty. 
I highly doubt I would go back. It wa nothing like what's described on their website. I'd their going to market the experience as such, you need to deliver.
Just a typical Sonic drive in.  I have noticed that this particular location is a little slow, don't know why? Love the Limeades. Visiting from Tacoma, Wa

Tried to have breakfast however we could not get seated. Hostess came out and called our name then was rude when we started to go in stating she was not ready for us. We continued to watch several parties be seated before us after 30 minutes of waiting we left. Working in restaurants I understand it was busy and we had 4 adults and 2 kids but there was a lack of communication and professionalism you could clearly hear them talking about how they couldnt seat us so it didnt matter.

So tried after. Long days drive from Jackson Hole.
Walked over to find no one in the place!
She said most everyone calls for take out!!
Food was typical American/Chinese.
Filling yes, good just OK.
Too tired to finish so take out worked ...only we took it out!

Please don't go here if you expect them to add your order up correctly. We were charged $35 for two ice cream cones and a shake. When we questioned the order our money was refunded and re-run. However we were charged for a large even though we got a small. When I questioned them a second time about the cost they kept telling me I was wrong. When I showed the girls we got a small they apologized but could not re-run our card a third time!

Was passing through Boise on my way up to Seattle this past weekend. Asked a local at a gas station where a good place to grab some lunch was and they recommended Barn Yard Kitchen and bar, said they smoke their meats right at the restaurant. I took the suggestion and headed over. Sure enough, as I was pulling in to the parking lot, there was their yoder smoker sitting on a trailer and the pit master was pulling a fresh batch smoked turkey out. I went inside and was given a menu and told I could sit wherever I liked. I grabbed a table and was promptly greeted by a server; I asked for a water and few minutes to look over the menu. By the time she came back with the water, I knew I wanted the smoked turkey sandwich with the fresh turkey that I had just watched the pit master pull from the smoker. 

The sandwich was served fairly quickly, and it was amazing. The turkey was savory and moist, and still slightly warm. Couldn't be more impressed with the sandwich. I also had a Blackberry Bourbon Lemonade to drink, and it was the perfect beverage. 

If I'm ever in Boise again, I will definitely be coming back here. The location is saved in my GPS. Great food, great drink, great service, and great prices.

Tried several times over the last few years and it gets worse every time.   The cleanliness of this restaurant is gross.  The floors are dirty and the carpet is heavily soiled.  The service was good but the food was below standard.  The ratio meat to bun is like subway.   They must have a good happy hour as the bar was busy.   I used to like this concept years ago at the Overland location.  It seems like they have lost their enthusiasm for running a good to great restaurant.  It won't be long before they call Chef Ramsey to save their business.
In the mood for Chinese and International Express hit the spot.  Really friendly owner making some delicious food.  Priced right will definitely be back.

First of all let me say that this is the first time I've ever been to a Sonic's so I came here an optimistic. Rollerskating servers and the "car dining" experience. Long story short, My lunch was ruined and i don't plan on ever coming back to a Sonic's ever again. Now for the whole story, I ordered a Bacon Double Cheddar Croissant Dog because it looked so freaking good in the picture and I just wanted to indulge myself in it, waited the usual time it would take to prepare the meal. Then the waiter came walking out and I jokingly asked what happened to the roller skates since I was expecting them and just wanted to see that for the "Sonic's dining experience" He simply said he didn't have time to put them on.... ok then? Got my food and immediately was put off by the look of it. The bun was not a croissant bun and the cheese didn't look like the shredded cheddar cheese in the picture, they just squirted some cheap liquidy nacho cheese on the hotdog. I said something about it to him & He asked me what was it that I ordered, I  told him what it was and he looked at the hotdog and was like,"Is that not it?" No it is not! Look at the bun, looks like a regular hotdog bun. He then proceeded to say with a snarky attitude  "sorry I don't know what it looks like" At that point I was just like whatever I'll eat it since I have somewhere to be and I was done talking to this guy who obviously didn't care that I wasn't satisfied with the food he brought me. On top of the bun being wrong, it was stale also. Never going to a Sonic's again

I made a reservation for this hotel for the eclipse.  It was a room with 2 queen beds.  The room was very clean, bedding smelled slightly of bleach (a very positive sign), and the shower had good water pressure, even on the top floor.  Mattresses were a little hard for my liking, but of good quality.  They provided toiletries and a coffee maker as well.  My only complaint about this place was the attitude of the evening front desk person (7:30 pm).  She was on her phone and I stood a full 30 seconds in front of her before she bothered to say hello.   She was not very polite to a guest on the phone who called for assistance while I checked in either.  The morning staff were very pleasant.  The breakfast spread was great and well managed.  The nice lady cleaning the breakfast room was friendly and hardworking.  I would recommend this place.  I just hope that they get better evening staff.

My husband and my son and I were at Denny's today for lunch.  I ordered the apple cranberry salad.  The salad it self was wilted and I mean wilted.  This was the last straw I will never step foot into Denny's again.  My husband and I travel frequently and have to say we used to stop at the local Denny's but lately no matter what state we are in Denny's have gone down hill fast!!

Momo is a fast-casual restaurant of a different kind... the good kind of different. And it's all about the food and service.

Here's what you should expect: My immediate impression is that it's a fusion of Indian, Chinese, and a little bit of Thai cuisines. Now go find Nepal on a map, and sure enough, you'll know what I'm talking about.

Don't come here expecting an elegant, chic atmosphere. It's almost like they started to go for the clean, minimalist look and then ditched the idea halfway through decorating. They have bright orange and green furniture colors combined with some wall panels that appear hastily slung together and then they ran out of the hideous brown paint. "Oh, no!" But they put the panels up anyway, slapped some pictures up there, too, and then scattered numerous Himalayan dolls around as a distraction.

Okay, so decorating isn't their strong point. Just forget about that.

If you're a new-comer, simply order from the left side of the menu, top-to-bottom. The process is pretty self-explanatory. But even if you do have questions (about how to order or the food, itself), ask freely. The staff LOVES to help. You can tell that they're really excited about introducing people to the momo way of life. Very informative and not at all condescending.

The combination plates come with 3 or 5 dumplings and you can mix or match if you want to try several kinds. I highly recommend the pork momo with the spicy dipping sauce. They even have momo with yak meat, and it's worth the up-charge -- if nothing more than to check-off "eat yak" from your bucket list.

The only true downfall in my personal experience (though I'm sure that this isn't a regular problem, or hope it's not the beginning of a slip in food quality) is that my rice and beans were dry. This was probably due to the product sitting on the steam table for too long. And (ignoring the decor) it's the only reason I'm giving Momo 3 stars.

There's great potential here to bring it back to where it needs to be, so I'll surely make a return trip. By the way, momo means, "Himalayan dumpling." But I say that it's short for, "I want some mo'!"

We went here for the first time today and it was delicious! You get a ton of food for a good price. Most combos(includes burger/wrap/sandwich fries and a drink) were under $10. We were using a Groupon so the cashier, who seemed new, had the owner come help. The owner was a super nice guy and genuinely thanked us for our business a couple times. I'm more than happy to continue taking my business to such a friendly establishment.

First time here today and it was a great find! My boyfriend had the Waikiki pizza and the tavern turkey salad. The pizza was hand made, fresh ingredients, and smelled sooo good! I chowed it down. The salad was nice and not just blaaa. The tavern buttermilk dressing was a nice change from my regular ranch. So many beers on display to easily view and select and the employees offer to help and describe as many as you need. Clean,relaxed atmosphere and we will be back to get our growlers filled.

What a fun breakfast spot! Takes you back some decades in the best way possible. The menu is huge, you'll definitely find something you like! I had the blueberry pancakes (only available on Sundays) with bacon and hash browns. My friend got one peach crepe and one raspberry crepe. It was all delicious! We sat at the counter and our server was very friendly. Definitely returning here when I'm back in town!
The wait was a little long but the employees are very nice and helpful. The food had great flavor and came out nice and hot! Me and my husband are very happy a Ramen shop has opened in Boise!

The Isaacson brothers and their crew came down to work here in Redding, CA after we went through the Carr Fire in late July. They serviced a number of homes on our cul-de-sac. We were impressed with the way they ran their business. They were very personable and explained everything well. They showed up when they said they would and their crew did a GREAT job cleaning. Thanks, SERVPRO of Boise for helping us with smoke damage cleanup.

The Griddle is my FAVE place to eat in the valley, especially this one on Overland. We were there last Sunday and had the BEST server, Eddie. He was polite, professional, and very friendly and educated about The Griddle's background! Eddie is a prime example of how all servers should operate. Also, Christina, the manager at this location, is such a delight to talk with! Christina is always professional and upbeat, even when they are extremely busy (which is like always because they ROCK!) I always feel taken care of and important when I come here and the food is amazing!!! Thank you guys

Worst atmosphere I've ever experienced! Three men, talking extremely loud in their native language, soccer on the TV.  Come on!!! Not what women are looking for in a nail salon, not to mention the pedicure I got was OK at best. Not relaxing, not professional, and not a good experience!!

Went in today with my daughter pulling into one of the bullets order to Route 44 frozen lemonades after ordering it took 10 minutes for two drinks granted they were relatively busy but when the drinks were finally delivered no apology for the long wait no thank you.I Won't be going  back

Went in with my girlfriend for breakfast. We received GREAT customer service never waited for refills or didn't wait very long for our food. We had Rene as our server. Way to keep the work place with a positive attitude.
Good service reasonable price the Jamaican jerk burger and the golden gate are delicious

We were driving down the main drag through Boise and outlying areas when I did a nearby search for restaurants.  Once again, the app did not let me down right near the Red Robin in a small strip mall was Muse.  

As soon as I saw Bistro and Wine Bar, i knew we had to try this because most of the other places in the area were fast food and/or chain restaurants.

We walked in and it was nicely done up with cloth tablecloths and beautifully decorated.

We were quickly seated and ordered an appetizer and a bottle of wine.  The wine we order was out so our waitress recommended a local wine a Zhoo Zhoo Syrah Rose which is made by Hells Canyon Winery in Caldwell.  It was very tasty and we liked it so much that we are thinking about stopping by the winery before we head out of town.

We ordered the cheese plate as an appetizer, 4 types of cheese, fresh fruit, crackers and candied nuts with honey.

The menu is changed weekly and they have a nice select array of offerings.  On this evening I selected the Chicken Marsala.  It was quite tasty and well worth the $20 a plate.  It came with cooked spinach and wild rice.  

I picked out a mixed green salad to come out prior to the meal and it was good as well.  There was so much of it that I shared it with the YS.

He picked out the pork chop stuffed with crayfish.  I tried it and it was quite good as well.

We asked about dessert and they had a tiramisu and a chocolate cake with expresso.  I elected to skip both as I don't like the taste of coffee and both of them would most certainly taste like that.  The YS also decided to skip dessert.

It was ok to do that because the portions were a decent size and there was more than enough food to go around.

I noticed outdoor seating for when the weather gets a bit warmer.  This is a small place the maximum occupancy of 37 according to the sign put up by the fire marshal.  

They have a small bar as you enter for some seating for a drink or two.

The decor, music and general ambiance would make this a great date night place.  They take reservations but on this Thursday night as we were in early we didn't need them.  This place did fill up quite a bit as we were getting ready to depart.  

I would definitely recommend this to others and come back when in the area again.

THE BEST. This is our favorite local ice cream shops. All house made with excellent and unique flavors. 

The milkshakes are TO DIE FOR! 

We have had it all - grilled cheese, tomato soup, cheese, curds, milk....you name. Everything is excellent. 

This is another must try for locals and tourists.

Wow. Read reviews here and decided to try it out. Fantastic service and delightful food. During the weekday it was slow. I'm sure this place is packed on the weekends. I can't say enough positive things about the service. Seriously stellar. Will definitely be trying again.

Took my motorhome to Camping World in Meridian ID to be summarized and couldn't be happier with the service.  Service tech Charlie was awesome and got me in and out quickly and professionally. Great job Charlie!!

The food is good, portions are a little in the small side.  Excellent beer selection.
Overall, this is my favorite neighborhood pub.  Great place to watch a game.

Great menu selection for breakfast.  I had the quiche...delicious with both Canadian Bacon and regular.  Asked for hash browns extra crispy and that is exactly what I received!  Hubby ordered the bacon, tomato, bruschetta omelet and it was excellent.  Eddie was attentive and helpful but not overbearing.  We will definitely be back again soon.
I have ordered to go's so many times I can't even count. Always steaming hot fast and delicious!! Good job Great Wall!!
Took my family in for grilled cheese, grilled ham and cheese and Ice cream. Everyone loved it. My boys said the chocolate milk was the best thing they have ever drank.

We bought a brand new RV elsewhere because the salesman at Camping World pestered us to death when we went to 'just look' there.  Did call CW to get an estimate on installing a tow package on our car.  Gave all the details, no call back.  Went in person, gave all the details, no call back.  Complained to Marcus Limone who owns CW.  Went elsewhere for tow package but now told we can have warranty work done at CW by Forest River & rather skeptical about using their services.

The food is Sonic but the service gives new meaning to the word slow. Be prepared to wait 30 or more minutes for any order. Make sure you have enough gas in your car as well if you choose to go through the drive through. I hope management fixes this... But as this has been my experience over a number of months they may not know there is a problem.

Have to say this is a great concept that is well executed by the owners.
I would recommend this place to any micro brew lover.
Never had any food there.  But had a few beers and it was awesome!

Diarrhea. This is what you'll inevitably experience after you're done eating. Went fur lunch, food was extremely old, dried out. I'd doubt they even had a high enough temp on the steam table ad it was just warm, sorta. Decided to try the grill and do something fresh, bad idea, gross as well.  My soda was good though. Went after it first opened and don't remember it being this bad. This will be my last no doubt. Like most reviews are asking how is this place still open, how the heck do they pass fda inspections?
Plain and simple best beer store in the treasure valley

I have personally never ate at this location only stop in reply quick to grab a bubble tea. There selection of flavors isnalways good and this location is never super busy so usually can get in and out pretty quick. 90% of the time the bubble tea is perfect but sometimes they can be a little off I think it just depends on who is making it that day. But I love me some bubble tea for sure..
Ok it's fast food but tasty, inexpensive and served with a smile. When I'm hungry and have no time to cook it's just up the road. It is healthy too!

Wow, this was a disappointment. 

I read The Statesman review from last year and I was really looking forward to trying The Backstage Bistro.  I'm sorry I did.

We were grabbing dinner before the movie and sat at the bar.  The bartender seemed nice enough.  However I had ask three times before we could get two glasses of water, that seemed odd.

We ordered Ham Croquettes as a starter, my better half ordered a SIDE salad with Blue Cheese dressing on the side and a Club Sandwich with Onion straws.  I ordered the Chicken & Dumplings, then the bartender explained it was not a typical Chicken & Dumpling dinner.  I'm glad she did because other than having chicken, it's not anything like Chicken & Dumplings.  However it sounded interesting so I took the plunge.

The Ham Croquettes were ok, but not great.  I was a little disappointed, but no big deal.

We waited about 20-30 minutes and then they brought out the sandwich, my plate and a STEAK salad.  I explain that we ordered a side salad to be brought out before the meal.  The server apologized and said that she simply brought out the salad to the wrong table but she would bring the correct salad that she had already made.  

She brought out the correct salad, with the wrong dressing.  I wanted to know why they didn't bring out the salad first, but my girl was already irritated and didn't want me to make a scene so I relented.

The Chicken & Dumpling dinner was ok, a new take on a classic dish.  Not great, but good enough I guess.  The Club Sandwich on the other hand was inedible.  The bread was stale and dry and the whole thing just looked unappealing.  

We really like the decor and general ambiance, but it will be a long time before I go to The Backstage Bistro for anything other than a drink.  They do make a good Martini!

Great atmosphere and deck.  Incredible and creative bartenders.  Beer selection is limited but good.  Chef has wonderful meals going and changes up the menu from time to time. We go here at least weekly.

With a busy scheduled day ahead of us, we made a 930am appointment for two pedicures- BUT NO ONE WAS THERE. Waited until 945am until finally a guy showed up. What poor work ethic... decided to go somewhere else. Don't understand what happened usually love this place for good service and a close location. Sooo disappointing

Yeah yeah yeah... beer!!
But really... WINGS! Their wings & Greek salad is where the AWESOME is at! If you thought the beer was good, try the wingies (cuz "Tommy want wingy!")... Dopplepok in particular is amazing, but I've tried them all and they are all great!

They were packed at 1am on...looked as though a wedding party had invaded the place. The entire experience was memorable....not because of the food, but because of local clientele conversations surrounding us. Bible study groups, enemas and world of warcraft are only some of the gossip we overheard. 
Typical Denny's food but our server was our savior.....

While traveling through Boise, we exited the freeway to look for a quick but healthy lunch. This place fit the bill nicely with packaged deli foods and a small restaurant counter with many healthy options, including vegetarian. Pleasant eating area at the front of the store made it easy to eat and then be on our way.
Horrible...$18 for a car wash and I will have to go home and touch up!  Haven't been here for a while, thought I would try again.  Same crappy job.  Don't waste your money.

Friendly casual place and at times..very busy.  Staff is very friendly...very efficient and service is quick.

Food is okay...portions are very generous.  Love that they squeeze their own oranges for the juice. My food was warm..not very hot.  They have a wide variety of breakfast items...the French toast was very good, egg batter very light and tasty...

I would go back again simply because the staff is very nice and for the price...you get a lot of food.

The restaurant sits above the concession area (no.walls)of the movie theater and is overwhelmed by popcorn smell and loud people below. The seating area looks like a restaurant at an airport.  

Had dinner with several friends.  Service was good..   You can tell people were still learning the set up, but everyone was trying and doing a good job.

We all ordered entrées and the food was served at staggered times. 5-7 minute window.   I hate this as it makes people wait to eat or feel uncomfortable eating before others.  The kitchen needs to work on the food timing.

Most people were disappointed in their food.  Some comments.. Mushroom Risotto was too al dente basically undercooked. Flavor was ok, quality ok... Way over priced for the portion and quality.  Salmon dry and the salad was wilted .  Steak(don't remember the dish name) had okay flavor, but portion size was small.  Portions size is European.  I don't see the food quality as making up the differance.  If your a big eater this is not the place to eat.

I say most as the person who ate the burger was very happy( one of the least expensive entrees I think 13.00) He said one of the better hamburger and fries he has had.

I have been waiting for Cupbop make their way to Boise for years and when they finally arrived, the did not disappoint. Very tasty rice and noodle bowls with sauces that are to die for. If you need a quick and tasty meal, this is the place.

What a terrible job. I guess they no longer use a pressure washer, for the lower door panels. I still have mud & snow slush on the bottom of the doors, and the windshield is dirty. I have been using this place for over 15 years. I now need to find a place that actually cares about the work they turn out.

This place has great food but the service is horrible.  They started cleaning over 30 minutes prior to closing in the summer and we're extremely rude.  Too many unsupervised teenagers.  This place is in desperate need of management and secret "shoppers"

I've read the other reviews, but this place has new owners now. I wanted a pedicure, because I was going to have to wear a medical boot that shows my toes after foot surgery. They were very gentle while doing that foot and my toes look great. Couldn't be happier r
Love the staff!!!! Codie,  Sam,  james and sean at the bar!!  Visit them for a new menu coming soon

Best breakfast on our 7 day road trip! 

I had the Caribbean French Toast and hubby had the Almond Crusted French Toast, which was topped with mixed fresh berries. Both were amazing! We each made them a combo (added eggs over medium and bacon). The eggs were cooked perfectly and the bacon was delicious!

Caribbean French toast would be better with some sort of tropical topping or syrup (like the orange juice based syrup at Original Pancake House, but the sweet coconut was still delicious.

Service was friendly and professional. 

Note: they are not honoring the 10% off deal on Yelp. Per the waiter "we have contacted Yelp to ask them to take it down". I sent the owner a Yelp message to let her know she needed to remove it.

Food is average, highly over priced, service is inconsistent. For example when I come here for breakfast during the week and am allowed to substitute fruit for my toast and hashbrowns which I don't eat. Today after buying a $9.75 omelette I was informed that not onlywould there be a $2.50 upcharge but that it has never been allowed. After eating here several times a week for two years I'm done eating here. Not just because of this event but because of the service and the price too, everything combined makes this a no go for me from now on.

Have only been once and will go again.  Menu was a bit spotty in my estimation.  I thought there would be more.  There is plenty to purchase other than food off the menu, perhaps too much.  It is hard to tell where the drinks come from so you have to ask often for assistance but maybe that's just me.  Like I said, will be back, maybe with a coupon.
The food is okay . They need to stop the yelling every time you order something . It's very annoying .

It's a shame...the service is THE WORST but the food concept is interesting and unique for the area.  Inexcusably inattentive wait staff made for a frustrating meal.  We were seated right away, given water, and ignored for 20 minutes. I was ready to walk out but my wife said "one more minute" and was able to wave someone down to take our order. After another 20 minute wait for food, the Waitress didn't bother to refill drinks or even swing by the table until we asked for the ticket.

Had the Salisbury steak which was pretty good, but my order was wrong and when they corrected the issue with reheated (over heated, microwaved?) and super dry plain mashed potatoes. Tried a couple bites and left them on the plate.  (And no gravy on the potatoes? WTF?)

Don't waste your time, just go to Red Robin in the same parking lot. SAD.

What a pleasant  surprise to find  this delightful restaurant. The staff were super friendly, the atmosphere is cozy, the guitar player  was an unexpected bonus. The wine selection was better than most and offered in reasonable  price ranges. Now for the food: We started with the pan fried oysters...the freshest I've had in Boise ever! We opted for the prime rib...the wife had her medium rare, mine was medium, both cooked to perfection, very generous portions and the best I've had in the past 10 years...fork tender. The creamed spinach ...with their house chèvre was delicious. Unfortunately, by the time we finished our meal we were too full to order desert so I can only imagine how that would have tasted. We WILL be going back!!

Ordered a pizza w out tomatoes and walked in to them picking the ingredients off a pizza and then throwing them back in the ingredients to be used later! So gross! And when I asked to have a new one made they got snotty! And when I asked what their manager would think they didn't even answer me. I will not be coming to this location ever again. Be warned- if you have good allergies they could kill you!
Craving Ramen and this place delivers!! The broth was delicious. Will definitely come back!!
food is great i love the miso ramen and the pork belly bowl... its the best ramen i've had in idaho ever

Just very average or a little below average. Servers were nice. Place small and hot without a great atmosphere. Few drink options. Tiny menu with few choices and no vegetarian or vegan options for Ramen. They were also out of a lot of menu items on the already small menu. I would not go back.

This place blows dead dogs. And probably cooks and serves them. Buffett is terrible, the staff is nice but not very efficient, the food is crap. Was recomnended by a friend because of the low prices, 10$ a head. I want my friggen money back! And a new friend! Just because something is cheap does not make it good to eat. Screw this place, go to Quick Wok and enjoy a decent meal for a comparable price. Fags.

I've heard this was a great place and finally after a long day we came here. I am so impressed and excited to have found this place. Fast and courteous service, amazing food. The curry is the best I've had and the noodles are perfection.

First time here & I LOVE it!!!  Wonderful staff, clean rooms, fresh breakfast, do friendly, & yummy cookies in the afternoon. Large hot tub & handicap accessible pool (both indoors). Wouldn't hesitate coming here again.
Yummy. First time here today. Best food in Boise by far!

Food cart style food, fast food looking store front, delicious authentic food. Friendly and prompt service, inexpensive, easy access off the interstate in which we originally chose to stop for. Vegan options, delicious fluffy piping hot samosas. Next time I'm driving thru, I will be back.

Let's be honest here, it's a little different.  But trust me on this one. Get the yak!!  If you have to lie to yourself and say it's just beef then do so, you will thank me.  And personally I thought the brown rice is better than the jasmine  because I like a softer rice
Very good service and friendly wait staff. Very over priced for what you get! Tiny portion sizes and bland food. Total bummer because it was a really cool space.

I went in on a slow day and everything was nice and clean. The staff was not as talkative as I am used too, so I found myself in awkward silence for the most part of my stay. He did ask me some questions about myself, but his reply was very fast. Like he rehearsed what to say beforehand. My haircut however was very much to my liking! I am very picky about who cuts my hair and Fantastic Sams Hair Salon has never let me down. I tipped the man $7. Two whole dollars more than what I am used too. Great job, people!

Love this place for frozen yogurt and was surprised how much I liked the food. Very friendly owner came and chatted with us while we ate! Super family friendly. My husband and I shared the Godzilla burger with regular fries and both left over full!
Lived in Korea for 8 years. This definitely addressed a homesick feeling. It's a Korean food Qdoba for lack of a better comparison. Yummy, simple flavors. Great service. Definitely give it a try!

Love Love Love Backstage Bistro!!! 9 of my friends and family and I just had a Birthday lunch at the Bistro before a move at the vip theater up stairs at Village Cinema.   First off the lunch At Backstage Bistro was wonderful the staff has very nice, the meals all ten of them were as nice for the eye's as for the tummy. After the lunch we all went to see the new Disney Movie Cinderella the manager asked if I wanted them to put or Birthday gifts in the office while we watched our Movie how great is that!! I would recommend this to everyone I know! Thank you so much for making my Birthday a wonderful time to remember....Jasmine

Just to preface: I've eaten a lot of ramen. I've been to a number of ramen shops across the country and made my own at home. I love my ramen but don't consider myself a snob. It needn't be fancy, just quality. 

Ramen sho could be good but needs some improvement. Looking at the few pictures others have posted, I suspect my wife and I may gave been shorted as they may have been running low on food (we showed up around 6 pm and they ran out about an hour later). The first thing I noticed is they don't have shichimi togarashi, a spice mix, which is odd as it's a ramen shop staple. That's like ramen 101, folks. We checked out the menu but about half of it was taped over, presumably due to them being out. I'm accustomed to being able to choose my own ramen adventure, selecting a broth base with noodles and then add-ons, but there was no such option. Part of the fun for me is customizing my ramen (corn, pork, seaweed, naruto, even butter!) so that was a bummer. I ordered tonkotsu ramen, my wife miso. 

Both came with one razor thin slice of pork, half of a soft-boiled egg, and various condiments (corn, mushroom slices, seaweed, ginger, et cetera). Both bowls were seriously lacking in broth which is majorly disappointing as ramen is very broth-centric, not to mention our egg halves were cold. There wasn't enough broth to submerge the egg halves so cold they remained. It was basically a pile of noodles with some broth around the bottom. The noodles were mediocre, I'm sure they weren't fresh, probably dried but maybe fried. Given that you can purchase frozen fresh noodles locally, this was a letdown. My tonkotsu broth was good but I found my wife's miso broth to be too heavy on the miso, making it a bit too salty and flavor too strong.

Service was what I've grown to expect from Shige: ranging between mediocre to bad. We worked with three different individuals: one woman who seated us, another who was our waitress, and a third who took our payment. We were seated quickly if impersonally. Our waitress was friendly but inattentive, not checking on us once and only returning very early in the meal to drop off the bill. The woman who eventually took our payment did so without responding to us and avoided eye contact. We watched my debit card being passed from person to person, disappearing for awhile, then presumably being run, then being carried around by one waitress with the signing slips for awhile until it was passed to the woman who took it who just as quietly dropped it off with us. We thanked and wished her a good evening, and she just walked away. My card was on its adventure for about fifteen minutes and while nothing bad happened, it was odd and unprofessional.

Bear in mind this was the first day so I expect (hope) they will get better; as it stands, though, the experience was disappointing. I hope the food will improve but am not holding my breath for the service; Shige's service has been consistently spotty as long as I've gone there. I'll give them another try in a couple of weeks and update my review accordingly!

Nobody seating guests. They ignore you if you ask them how long the wait is. Not just one person on staff, but all three of them. Nobody serving guests. Nobody giving checks to guests. Empty tables for two while a line is forming. They won't be able to survive with incompetent management. They will be out of business soon.

We're thrilled with the great service we got from Mindy when we asked Camping World to sell our fifth wheel trailer on consignment. We wanted it sold quickly and they sold it in less than three weeks! Mindy couldn't have been more helpful and thorough. She went out of her way to answer all our questions. And if she's not in her office, she gets right back to you. This is great customer service. If you want to sell your recreation vehicle or trailer, you'll get a lot more money selling it on consignment than you will with a trade in, and Camping World will do all the work of showing it and selling it. We couldn't be happier with Mindy and Camping World of Meridian.

I love the Co-op.  All of the employees there enjoy their jobs so much they make me want to work there. The pizza man knows our pizza and recognizes us before we say anything.  The gal in the shower gel, oil and vitamins knows eveything, literally. Everyone has a smile always. They have rare fruit and veggies and great chocolate, teas and meats.
The waitress was very overbearing, food was cold, and 25.00 for a small breakfast. I am not a happy camper. Will not be back. Never!!!

Fantastic breakfast place. You know it's good when the line is out the door and they are serving free coffee outside. I had the chicken fried steak and lemme tell you I will be back! Keep up the good work!
Love their drinks and staff is amazing! Service is slow, though, or I would have given 5 stars.

I am not going to lie to you and say the food is spectacular. Nor will I say that the decor is exquisite and impeccable. But that's not why you go to a Chinese buffet. You go because you're hungry, maybe a little stoned, and want to go to town on some salty, fatty, greasy food.

Well, my friends, this is a place to feed your dirty desires for such cuisine. I have never had a bad experience here. The food is always relatively fresh, the service is about what you'd expect (slightly more pleasant than average buffet service), and there's a pretty good variety of dishes.

I can tell you with 100% confidence that this is not the best Chinese food you will ever have. However, it is far from the worst Chinese food you'll ever have. I have been here more times than I'd like to admit, but it keeps me coming back. They have a soft serve machine and a 'build-your-own' stir-fry bar. I have yet to try that, but everything looks good.

You know what you're getting yourself into when you go to a Chinese buffet. Don't kid yourself and you'll find that you are actually having a pretty good meal here. The price is right, and the food is good. I haven't been to other Chinese buffets in the area, but I can't imagine they'd far surpass Great Wall for what you'd be paying.

My husband and I went for the first time today, and it was a great experience.  Everything was bright and clean, and it smelled fantastic! We were asked if it was our first time, and everything was explained to us. My husband was a little confused (he's more of a burger kind of guy), and he was given a momo to sample.  We both ordered combos, as it offered a little bit of everything.  I also got an order of samosas that was heavenly.  Everything was very fresh and flavorful -- you could tell they weren't just opening up packages of frozen stuff.  They also had chai tea, which I thought I wouldn't like, but it was so good!  Not sure if it's that good everywhere, but I plan to get it next time I'm back.  And I'll definitely be back!

Also, prices were very reasonable.  Two combo meals, an order of samosas, and two drinks -- and the total was still under $20!

The fat part of pork belly needs improvement.
Dining environment needs serious improvement.
Noodle is really good. Soup is good.  
For spicy noodle, it's better not using the pepper source you bought, that one adds too much sour into the noodle.

This place has gluten-free teriyaki! Yes, I was skeptical at first. Apparently it's made in house, and it is absolutely amazing. It cost an extra buck to add it to their teriyaki bowls (which means everything else on their menu is off limits for me, which doesn't bug me because the teriyaki is delicious). I could eat there every day. I recommend the teriyaki with chicken, it also comes with big chunks of stir fry vegetables (think carrots, zucchini, snap peas). Mmmhmmm. You can also add a fried egg on top as well. 

Note: I have gluten sensitivity, but I'm not full blown celiac. I'm sure there's a degree of cross contamination - I haven't asked how celiac friendly their kitchen is. But I've eaten here multiple times with no indication that I've been glutened (and I can tell when I've been glutened within a matter of minutes). 

The Meridian location has quite a bit of indoor seating, also a covered patio for when the days are nice! I've never once had poor service, although I have had to wait a minute for my order to be taken. From what I can observe, the small amount of persons on staff means that sometimes the people running the register have to make food as well.
