No big deal for me, the food never takes long to make - max I've had to wait to eat (from walking in to getting my food) is ten minutes. PLUS they have delivery!
Delicious!  Great, flavorful choice for vegetarians.  After getting over the different look, it's my 5 year old's new favorite food.  Fantastic service.
Very nice market but lacks on Italian ingredients. This may be ideal for the local hipster.

Food is decent enough but service is horrible! Three times we have ordered delivery from them. Not once has the food ever arrived on time, and once it was even cold. They never try to make it right or offer any compensation for the service, let alone an apology for the service. I even tried ordering online once and they sent an email confirming my order and delivery time. 45 minutes after the delivery time came and went I called and asked about my food. I was put on hold for 7 minutes and then hung up on. I had to call back only to be told my food had not yet even left the store! When I asked if I could speak to a manager I was told "no, thats our delivery boy, you can always come and get your food" I asked again if she was saying their manager was a delivery boy and and she said yes and then put me back on hold again. Needless to say - never order from here if you want your food within 2 hours or hot!
I love this place and the people who are employed there! It's a drive for us but it's well worth it. I so enjoy the baked goods and enjoy just walking around looking!! Really nice people. Thank you!
Travel for work and eat out often. Just had the tastiest breakfast and best service than I've had in a long time. Thank you Christine for brightening my morning.

I had my baby-shower held at Backstage Bistro and it was amazing! Becky, their bakery chef, did an incredible job on my cake and cupcakes. Lori, the event planner, was absolutely friendly and helpful. The manager was very helpful during my event, and the server did a wonderful job! I was very pleased with the food, drinks, service and atmosphere during my event. They did a great job! I highly recommend this restaurant to anyone! I couldn't have asked for a better time!

We trusted our Yelp community for this breakfast spot on our first trip to Boise.  It did not disappoint in any way.  Beverly, our server was fantastic.  She recommended the huckleberry pancakes and their in house made corn beef hash!  Both were excellent!   My wife got the house made chicken apple sausage and banana walnut pancake and both were top notch.  This place has a great feeling and a true cafe feel. If you don't take the opportunity to eat at Terri's Cafe you will miss out big time.  Be sure to ask for Beverly, she is a great server with a dynamite smile!!!!

All hungry road warriors just passing through, stop here! It's right off the 84. Leave the gut bomb road food behind and get some good food. It's not vegan or GF friendly but there are some healthier options available. 

The wait staff is super friendly and high energy. There's a 10% off coupon for first time Yelp check-in's. Our service was great so we paid it forward to our server. 

To drink I had a breve and fresh squeezed orange juice. For breakfast, I ordered poached eggs, extra crispy hash browns, and bacon with a biscuit. Everything was made exactly how I wanted. My better half ordered the cream cheese strawberry rhubarb stuffed French toast with a side of crispy bacon. Too sweet for my taste but then again, that's why he ordered it and not me. :) The French toast wasn't stuffed, exactly. It was layered, more like a "breakfast grilled cheese sandwich" in the words of my partner. 

I recommend this place if you don't have the time to go into downtown Boise.

Awesome ramen and amazing in-house-made dumplings at an awesome price.  So far, I was only there for the opening night with a limited menu.  Even so, it was really wonderful.  I can't wait to see what else they add.

Small (seats less than 40), very intimate, wonderful decor.  Everything from the carpets, ceiling tiles, "art deco" stools at the  bar (all facing the same way, I might add for effect), expensive silver and stemware is pretty near perfect.

The food for lunch was absolutely amazing and all but one dish $10 or less.  Service was great and there were even Lindor chocolates instead of mints on the way out!

I will definitely be taking my best clients to lunch here often.  The large booths are a perfect place to "close the deal" in an intensely elegant atmosphere and will definitely impress.  Even the background music was perfect.

Do NOT miss this restaurant.  I will definitely be going back for dinner.

I come here often since it's close to my work. They have a lot of places to sit, but despite that sometimes when they are busy they're all taken!  Good coffee, good pastries, good baristas, and a clean store. I'll be back!

The main reason why my husband and I will be downtown more often! This is the second visit, first visit was last Saturday 11/11/17, both times the ramen was perfect! I had the spicy tonkotsu and my husband had the non-spicy version both visits. I got "medium" spice both times, and I wouldn't be able to handle any hotter!be sure to add an extra egg, worth it! First visit we had the fried egg rolls (no picture) which you can't go wrong with. This time we had the fried gyoza (5 piece). Both would get again. Can't wait to go back!! Yay for Ramen Sho!

Well, let's start this on a high note...

THE BROTH WAS GREAT.

But as my fiancé said, " It's called Ramen Sho cause it's just for show..."

The broth was tasty, full flavored, and honestly the only impressing part of the dish. Now the cons: the pot stickers we got were obviously frozen prior to being brought out which made them watery and mushy. Also it came with the remnants of the fried oil left over from the frying pan.

Down to the ramie ramen part: the noodles tasted and had the texture like they went to the near by gas station, bought 3 pallets of top ramen, and took out the noodles. They were tough, felt half cooked, and tasted like nothing. 

The meat was fatty and minuscule. It tasted like smoked horse hoof.

Now the shiitake mushrooms were squeaky, undercooked, and tasted like literal mold. 

To wrap it all up, the wait staff was underaged, inexperienced, and uninterested in taking our order and serving us. It took 10 minutes to seat us after being stared at from the back by the hostess. A waitress had to seat us and I had to walk back up and grab a menu. 

Not gonna say it was the worst. But I lived in Japan and this shouldn't be labeled the first ramen shop in Boise. It should be labeled a first attempt... and not quite a win

While quiet the service was efficient and pleasant enough. The ice creams were delicious if not amazing. We had Brown Cows which is chocolate milk over your choice of ice cream which was a surprise and delight for my inner child. The retail space if sparse and boring is clean and spacious enough for a few families to be in at the same time. And while being located in Meridian doesn't guarantee my business again anytime soon. They were worth the first visit. I felt their pricing was on par with any other local ice cream shop.

Don't know about the sales side but stay away from their service department.  They will charge 4-5 times what anyone else will. They "find" all sorts of non existent problems, canning seem to ever get things done in the time they quote you and find all sorts of ways to add more to your bill.  Do yourself a favor, just stay away.

Not comfortable. Beds are hard as rock and pillows are flat. No amenities available. Breakfast substandard. Disappointing experience.  We changed hotels to a Marriott after a few sleepless nights here.
Great place for breakfast! Folks will not leave hungry. Good portions and very fast service. The staff is always very friendly and welcoming. Be sure to check out the daily specials too.

Often before trying a new restaurant, my wife and I consult yelp to get an idea of what the restaurant is like, and whether it is even worth going to in the first place. This evening, however, we were out running errands and just wanted something to take home that would be quick and easy, and didn't take the time to look up reviews first. Our mistake. 

At first, we were pleased to see that they had a drive through, thinking we could get it fairly quickly and take it home. I wondered if it was just for picking up phone in orders, but then noticed the large menu posted next to the window, so decided to take advantage of it. The lady stuck her head out, and looked annoyed as we tried to decide what to order. We decided on a family meal, which included pork fried rice, general tso's chicken, moo goo gai pan, fried shrimp, sesame pork, and side salad and/or egg drop soup.

Then we sat and waited... and waited... and waited for 20 minutes. Finally the lady passed our food out to us. My wife made a comment about it taking so long, and the lady rudely remarked that next time we should call ahead first. Well thanks, we'd figured that out by that point, but it would have been nice to know when we ordered that it would be a 20 minute wait. Even a simple apology would have been nice. 

At this point, I was still willing to give them the benefit of the doubt. Maybe I should be thankful that they didn't give us food that has been sitting under a lamp 30 seconds after ordering. Maybe the food was all made fresh and from scratch. Upon arriving home, however, we saw that this was not the case. 

The salad was wet and droopy, the moo goo gai pan was utterly bland, the fried shrimp was overly breaded yet still somehow tasteless, the sesame pork literally looked like pieces of dry ham with sesame seeds on the side, the egg drop soup was bland, and the pork fried rice was tolerable. The only thing that bumps this up to two stars rather than one was that the general tso's chicken was actually quite good. However, I don't think I'll be going back just for that.
These folks are great and the drinks are awesome.  The blended mochas are really something to crow about (vs. Dutch Brothers).  Always happy with a trip to the HB.

Henry and his team are amazing!  Our clothes are always ready ahead of schedule, the prices are great and so is the location!  I especially love that they email me when the clothes are ready for pick-up!

I am so thankful we found Green Leaf Cleaners!  We will be moving soon and are hopeful for an East Boise location!

Fantastic food and excellent service. Great place for vegans and vegetarians. We went once when they first opened and again last week. Definitely one of our favorite places to eat in the area. Wish they had a restaurant in downtown Boise.
Best mortgage experience ever. The staff is helpful and professional. They closed my purchase in less than 30-days.

We didn't read any reviews and should have. The manager was suppose to contact us and it's been a month. 

So this place is a 3star and we paid over $500 for our stay and couldn't get the cable stations to come in.  Upon calling the front desk was told by staff that it wasnt their fault and they cant do anything about it. I call liar bc normal hotel staff can call the cable company to see what's up. The front desk staff here just blames each other for everything. We didn't have, or i should say had a gew squares on both rolls of toilet paper in our room when we got there so I went down to get more and the woman was nice but made excuses. The WiFi wasnt working right. ..more excuses. Asked for the manager's help...nope another excuse. Upon leaving was told the manager would contact us....left info and is waiting to hear back.

I got sick from their breakfast sausage. The breakfast at the hampton inn suites is better than here which I s where we will be at next time we are in town. Here they serve  have under ripe melon, cheap waffle and cheap bread..cereal is cheapo and 2hot cheap items that are pretty gross so expect to eat elsewhere. I cracked up laughing at their advertised easter brunch....so hilarious!  My Marriott stay in Boise was cheaper and had better amenities?!?!?

The tv's are super outdated.... 2002 called and want their analog back... beds are hard linen wrinkled. They have really bad water that completely dries you out. 

The manager is super incompetent and the front desk staff is horribly untrained to do anything (managers fault) the cleaning staff was good except the elevator floor was dirty nearly the whole time we were here, but it's highly used because the fancy stairs only go to the 2nd floor and there were no signs indicating stairs to use anywhere else. It was really disappointing and we will book elsewhere.
Love this place!!! Service and food are fantastic!!! TUESDAY is wing night! Get the crunchy wings w Buffalo sauce and blue cheese! You won't regret it!
This place is awesome! We drive across town for some good ice cream. Today we had bubble gum bear, cookie dough, and chocolate.

Love this Denny's. The manager Nassa checked in on us while we were dining and our waitress, Donna (Moosie), was fantastic! The food was excellent and came out quickly. My niece loved her how to build a snowman shake and pancakes. Moosie checked in on us often and made sure our dining experience was very pleasant. We will definitely be back to this Denny's!

I haven't actually eaten in the restaraunt, but I've eaten their food at the Sunday market in Bound Crossing. The dumplings are to die for! The sauce they put on them is amazing. When I'm back in Boise I will definitely be stopping by to gobble up some dumplings.

Corner Bakery has been one of my favorite places starting when we lived in SoCal. When this one opened in Meridian, we were so excited. Until this recent visit, we enjoyed spending our money here. However, someone at Corporate decided to change the menu - they removed the one item I always ordered because it was the bomb. The Sante Fe Salad is no longer available.....bummer! Also, when we arrived it was about 11:15 am on a Monday......not too busy, but there must have been 6 tables that had not been cleared of the previous customers' dishes. My daughter and I had to bus our own table so we could sit at a booth. Disappointing to say the least. Normally I would say I would give them a second chance, but since the menu has changed I guess I will change restaurants too.

Middle of last week around 11:00 am, they easily and quickly accommodated a party of 7 that grew to 9.  Friendly and very competent service, made the whole brunch/lunch special. They gave us breakfast menus at first, but brought lunch menus when we asked for them -- maybe because we took so long deciding among the many options that it was already time for lunch? (I joke.)

I enjoyed the meatloaf sandwich.  The half salad had a few wilted greens but the rest was fine and dressing was good.  I tasted some of the Red Flannel Hash, which is a mixture of regular potatoes, sweet potatoes, and beets (yes, beets), mixed with onions and the best bacon ever -- that was really good. I also swiped a bit of my Dad's extra toast so I could taste the homemade preserves, also excellent. 

Large portions, good food, all of us out-of-towners were impressed, and the local Idahoans were justifiably proud of their suggestion to come here.

My brakes were squeaking when I was backing out my driveway.  I thought that maybe I needed a brake job since I had 75000 on the vehicle.  I expected them to come back with a big fix, but they said the brakes were fine and that cold weather tends to make them squeak.  
I would trust them with any repairs.
Service by Don Palmer was excellent he helped me solve a parking break problem in a few seconds  his knowledge and courtesy was outstanding  hope all my future  contacts are as great!

Went here on a date with my husband. I agree with the other reviewer who compared the inside area to an airport, I wasn't impressed. However, we sat outside and the view overlooking the village and fountain was beautiful. The service was ok but the food was disgusting, my husband had pork, which was better than the fish that I could only take a few bites of, but still was not very good. I was disappointed as I saw the good reviews and expected more. I'm still hoping to find a place I'm willing to eat at more than once in the village...

I tried the house ramen and the spicy miso both were flavorful. The only let down was the portion sizes. The protein and noodles were meager and left us still hungry. 3 thin slices of pork belly... For the price you can go down the street for a large bowl of pho and a beer.

Came here on a busy lunch shift when they were new. Unfortunately my cone and my buddies cone was cold, but they fixed it immediately and gave us free ones for the next visit. Really unique and delicious food here. Be warned, one cone by themselves is not very filling so you might want two. Have been back twice since and plan to return again.
Pretty decent food here. I enjoy a good bowl of ramen and I feel they do a good job here. Only bad part was the wait.

UPDATE--- the team at window wizard have resolved all of my issues, above what I originally ever expected.  Once the right people were involved this was rectified quickly.  I understand this was a case of miscommunications and a 'fluke' issue so I will likely use them again in the future.

It's a buffet with Mongolian stir fry. I like this place, so many bad reviews I don't see why? What were you expecting from a all you can eat buffet? Food is good and service is really good for a buffet.
I came here last week and all but one of my six very basic drink orders were made wrong. So today I just got a straight drip and water. What did they even hand me?
Good place to meet friends and have a light breakfast and a cuppa. Prices are a little steep bit over all nice place. We live the patio and the employees and nice!

The beer selection is awesome! I love that you can make your own six pack. The prices seem fair and the variety is almost overwhelming. We ate lunch there and our food was also delicious. My only setback was the seating, it is so small in there that when we were seated we were overcrowded by people trying to mix and match their six packs. Maybe it would be better if the tables were higher? Then at least you don't have butts pushing against the back of your neck!

The flavors were off. We were excited to try their food, but were very much let down. The sweet potato noodles are too thick and taste/look like a sticky hand (cheap toy you get from the dentist). The rice was undercooked and weirdly sweet. The meat was dry. We couldn't finish it. Very sad because I don't like wasting food. The girls who worked there were very friendly though!

3 stars would probably be generous. At best the appetizers are good. Drinks are good but very expensive. Main courses? Marginal at best. "Steak salad" was literally roast beef on lettuce. "Shrimp" salad was fried shrimp on lettuce. Go somewhere else for the money.

I have been to many different coffee Cafes through my travels but I have never seen a coffee shop that looks so pretty, actually it looks more like a really cool restaurant which it is, the owner was very sweet and friendly, the coffee was excellent as was my Bacon & Egg on a delicious roll, can't wait to return the owner is adorable

We had a wonderful lunch as our first experience dining at Muse Bistro so we made reservations for Valentines Day and are so happy we did.  One of the best meals since moving to Idaho 8 years ago.  We usually skip the Valentines restaurant scene as food is usually mediocre and service is rushed.  Not at Muse.  Excellent  and attentive service from all staff.  Our server, Bobbie, was very knowledgable of the menu and amazing wine list. All food is chef prepared homemade which made choosing difficult.  Bobbie took the time to go over the menu and help us pair with the perfect wine.  The asparagus artichoke Brie soup was delicious.  My husband choice of the 20 oz. bone in ribeye steak with chefs potatoes and a baked cheese topped tomato Did not  disappoint.  I had the crusted pork tenderloin with a brandy apple sauce that was delicious.  The homemade bread with just a touch of Rosemary is impossible to stop eating which unfortunately left us too full for dessert.  I highly recommend this restaurant.  We will definitely be back often.

I am SO EXCITED!   THRILLED is another word that can be used.  Pretty much ECSTATIC.  Much like Chris Matthews when he saw our ex POTUS,  there is a THRILL running down my leg.   Why might you ask?  It's simple: On Saturday a [competitor] (it appears they flag certain words here and that competitors name appears to be one) will be here to install phone and internet and I will FOREVER be rid of having to deal with the most amateur hour telecommunications company I have ever had the displeasure of dealing with... CenturyLink.  Leaving an 11 year customer (multiple services mind you!), who does his business out of his home office exclusively, high and dry with NO PHONE and NO INTERNET SERVICE what so ever for 6 full days... all the while LYING to about when the tech would be out on three separate occasions... has demonstrated the fact that CenturyLink does not care about it's customers,  and with amazing clarity.  That is 11 years down the drain.  I hope it was worth it... but somehow,  I don't think anyone there gives a damn.

The first time I tried Backstage Bistro was during a movie at the Village Cinema with the VIP 21+ seating they have. All of the food was delicious, although I had cold mac and cheese (as another reviewer experienced) and our server was not the best. However, I did not let that one experience tarnish my opinion and decided to give Bistro more chances. One time was with a friend during happy hour - good nachos, good discounts on the drinks, and more attentive staff (this was when actually dining in the restaurant portion). Flash forward to another VIP movie experience, and wow, talk about improvement! Our waitress was beyond friendly and accommodating. The food we received was not only hot, but delicious too. Mind you, these visits all took place after Bistro was not-as-new and more established, leading me to believe they listen to feedback and work hard to improve, which is a huge deal.

My last visit was the highlight of my experiences at Bistro and what seals the deal such a high review. After some less than stellar service at two other restaurants in The Village (I'll omit names), my friend and I ended up settling at Bistro for the night and we are so glad we did. We were seated quickly in a booth, as per our request. Waters were brought out first thing and our waitress was happy to give us time to browse the food and drink menus. She was back in a timely manner to take our orders and proceeded to fulfill our drink orders in no time flat! When she saw we had not yet received the dessert we ordered when stopping by a short while later, she went back to the kitchen to see what the status was and a minute after that, VOILA, sugary goodness delivered! Note - our waitress was taking our orders AND working as one of the bartenders and she still managed to give us the full attention we would expect. The other staff are also extremely friendly and helpful, as they walk by and are not afraid to make eye contact (which is surprising, since at some places, you can be flailing your arms and knocking stuff over trying to get a servers attention and not a single employee will bat their eyes or acknowledge you).

I was also fortunate enough to meet the manager and general manager. Both gentleman were very friendly and professional. I can see why Bistro has improved so much - they clearly care about the business and want to not only see it succeed, but also see people enjoy the time spent there, which includes excellent service and food.

I personally enjoy the atmosphere, which has high ceilings (with a super cool chandelier made of glass film) and beautiful balcony seating for nice days. The bar is in the center of the restaurant, so if you enjoy having drinks, this leads to speedier service than other establishments. Sometimes there are also special events they do to promote movies (most recently, The Avengers 2) which really livens the place up!

So long story short - if you are looking for (what I have found to be) the friendliest staff in The Village, tasty food (make sure to get the profiteroles...hard to pronounce, easy to enjoy), and a pleasant ambiance, go here! Just please don't take my booth :)

We have eaten here twice now and have had a wonderful experience.  The food is outstanding and the service excellent.  The ambiance is great for date night and the environment is subdued.  If this s your kind of venue, please give them a try.  We need to keep these non-chain restaurants in our area.
A great option for tasty grub with an International flair.

Exactly what we needed after a long 8hr drive. The service was prompt and friendly, they were nice to our children and the food was great. The wings were the best I've had in years (buffalo) and the beer was spot on with plenty on draft to chose from.

My young son and I have been coming here after school 2-3 times a week after school for several months. The women behind the counter are always happy and respectful. They also remember our orders and provide excellent customer service. It's been a great place for us to spend an hour or so 2-3 times a week. As the weather continues to improve, they may see less of us as he wants to play more at the park, but we will certainly be back when we need our coffee, milk, and cookie. 

With so many coffee places around town, excellent customer service is key and these women nail it!

Horrible service. So called manger McKenna was bad mouthing customers right in from of us and very disrespectful to her coworkers and us. We were not impressed at all. What a way to end a fun weekend. #uswirl

I almost feel like this place should have two different ratings. One for RV sales and service which most of the negative reviews seem to take aim at, and one for parts. 

I have not purchased nor received service on my RV at this location.  My review and rating is strictly based on my experience​ at thier retail parts store. 

This is a typical Camping world location, nobody stocks as much RV parts and accessories as Camping World. They have an excellent selection, and helpful staff. I wouldn't hesitate to come here for parts again.

Good food but service is a bit slow. We waited about 30 mins for our food.
Also, the ramen soup would be better if it is a bit more hot.

Amazing food and great service! This was our first visit but will definitely not be our last! The salad was huge and the burger was amazing. I would recommend this restaurant to anyone looking for great food on a budget.

I took my car to Bobby's after the driver's-side window stopped working. They loaned me a vehicle for the day, fixed my window within a few hours, saved me literally hundreds of dollars based on what the Honda service center quoted me, and gave friendly service. Thanks guys! 100% satisfied & will be back!

12/16/2017: Another great experience with Lance & his team at Bobby's this week! In the middle of a busy day, my car started acting up & I worried it might break down at any minute. I took it to Bobby's & they squeezed me in. The spark plugs & wires needed to be replaced. They had me back on the road a couple hours later for a very reasonable price, which is especially appreciated during the holiday season. Out of curiosity I later called the Honda service center for a quote, which was $235 higher. Happy Holidays to everyone at Bobby's Transmission!

One of the best iced chai teas I've ever had.

My only complaint is that sometimes they don't listen to you when you order..  

For example, at least 2 or 3 times I've specifically ordered ICED chai with SOY milk..  and have gotten a variety of different outcomes..

One was hot.

One was iced..............with moo milk.


Muffins are delicious..  all baked goods look fresh and scrumptious.

Wonderful atmosphere and location.


And good memories.  : )

Please please -- don't ever go here. To say the service department is terrible would be too kind. We plan to never return. I hope someone from corporate reads these reviews so they can see the extreme dissatisfaction associated with this location.

Nice atmosphere. There is an enclosed patio as well as inside seating. Decent view of the street, as it is on the second floor. Ramen was delicious-I had the curry flavor and my husband had the spicy miso (which waa quite spicy!). I would definitely recommend this pace.
Very yummy ice cream! Went with my mom and there was a little line and I am sure glad I waited! Great location and very friendly!

Just ok, sounded tasty and stopped to try. Cute establishment. Liked the appearance of cone pizza. Started out good but as you eat it, becomes messy and the cheese and sauce were cold in middle. Not sure I would return again.
Great place to grab a cold drink and some good food. Lots of tvs and a friendly wait staff! We love the sliders!!

I haven't been in Denny's for quite a while but I figured I'd give it a try. The food was great I loved my pancakes, they have a good variety of choices and most will fill any person. The reason I give this place 2 stars is because the service was awful. The lady was nice but it took forever for our food to arrive, the place wasn't even full! So a quick breakfast turned into an hour+ and that I can't forgive.
I had the Irish one and it was great! They have all different sizes, not just typical small medium and large. I wanna go back before I leave

Very efficient and painless used car buying experience.  I found a vehicle I was interested in on-line and called the dealership to have it placed on hold until I could go by that afternoon to have a look at the car.  Eli (the salesman) was courteous, knowledgeable, efficient and helpful.  He was patient and forthcoming with any and all information I wanted to know about the vehicle.  Kudos.  I returned the next day during my lunch hour and Mike and Kate had me out with the vehicle and paperwork completed in about 30 minutes.  Again, well done!  Overall the experience was very good.  The only recommendation I could make to improve the service would be for the dealership to make certain the interior of the vehicle being sold is cleaned before sale.  I didn't mention this because I was in a hurry but it didn't appear that much time was spent cleaning and making the interior of the vehicle presentable for sale.  The exterior was in cleaned condition, having been washed the afternoon before.  I would have rated this experience 5 stars had the car's interior been cleaned properly.

Update 02/09/2017

I contacted Louis the CarMax manager and provided feedback on my purchase experience.  I mentioned that the car was not clean enough.  He asked me to bring the vehicle in to the service department to give him an opportunity to improve things at no cost to me.  I did this and in about 2-1/2 hours the vehicle looked immaculate.  Additionally,  his team provided a keyfob that would operate the remote start system on the vehicle (the original keyfob would not).  Louis and the service rep (Brianna) were gracious.  It was obvious they cared about my business and made sure I was satisfied before I left.  Brianna urged me to contact her if there was anything else she and CarMax could do to improve my experience.  Truly outstanding service and customer care.  I highly recommend this business to anyone looking to purchase a used vehicle.  Top notch people with a caring attitude.  Thank you CarMax.

Hard to give a review on this place. We left after sitting at our table for 15 to 20 minutes with nobody ever coming to take our drink order. It was only when we were half way out the door when they thought we were skipping out on the check. I then told them we don't owe anything because we never got to order anything. Won't go back
We sold our travel trailer through Camping World. Dealt with Mindie. She was very professional, would recommend.

They're pretty busy with the high school crowd during their lunch roughly 10:58 to 11:32 am.  This is why I went at about 2:30pm.  There were only 3 people there when I showed up.  Service was fast and friendly, and I even got to talk to the owner a bit.  The pizza transported me back to my college days in the 90's.  Thin crust with yummy sauce and excellent cheese.  It reminded me of hot lips pizza in Portland, Or.  really the only reason I took one star off was that it was more expensive than I thought it would be.  To be fair though, I 'm remembering slice prices from 20+ years ago, so it's bound to have gone up in price.

This is a great place to start before you go into your movie. The drinks are good and the food is as well. I love the steak salad. Loads of steak and the Vignette dressing is awesome. Nice that the server knows us and even knew which dressing We like.

We wandered into this place on a Tuesday evening at the recommendation of a friend, and I'm so glad we did. We both ordered margaritas, which were delicious and not overly sweet. The alcohol and flavor were well balanced. 

Then, we ordered tacos of every flavor, and an order of the jalapeño egg rolls. The tacos were amazing- incredible flavor and the perfect size, and for $1 each! The egg rolls were good in flavor, but so spicy that my fiancé and I, who are spice lovers, could only eat 1 each. But, jalapeños are unpredictable that way. 

The service was the best thing about our visit. Our drinks never ran dry, and our food was quick and hot. And the price was unbelievable! 7 tacos, an order of egg rolls, and 6 margaritas for under $30. We will absolutely be back!
Wow! I finally have a great place to get Ramen close to home. Some of the better Ramen I've had outside of Tokyo. I'll be back.

One of our favorite places to grab a quick bite to eat before a movie at the village. The bruschetta is our favorite appetizer & their drinks are yummy too. My husband loves the French dip & I love their chicken club. Overall good quality food for the price. One less star for the quality on their Tuesday night deals because some of it actually comes from the theater (movie theater cheese isn't so tasty for a restaurant like this).

The ice cream I had here was delicious! Friendly people and quick! Hate to be that guy was ice cream was a perfect "creamy" and I'd gladly go get some more. It's a good thing this place is far away or else it would be frequently tempting. Prices seem a bit high but at the same time, it's worth it and they didn't make me get a double scoop.
The spicy Asian pork sandwich is amazing!  Everything I have tried so far I have loved!  Great selections on the menu. Good service and reasonable price. A solid choice for breakfast or lunch.

Ordered the red white and blue pancakes, hash browns, over easy eggs and bacon. Bacon was small and overcooked. Eggs were not over easy, they were not even sunny side up. They were raw. I cut into them and the whites in the middle spilled out. My girlfriend ordered over medium eggs, she got over easy. She sent them back. Told them to make over medium again. Specified firmer yolks. The waitress tried to make an excuse that the eggs were over medium. Needless to say they were not. Got over easy again after reorder. She ordered sausage. She got bacon. My hash browns were cold and soggy. Service was poor. Dishes weren't even uniform. I got two small pancakes. She got one huge one and one small one. Not worth the time or money.

Absolutely awful company. We ordered a TV & Internet package over the phone to be installed on our move in day. 2 days before I called up to check as I had heard nothing and they told me I was scheduled for 3 weeks later! After going back and forward I got to speak with a supervisor who informed me point blank the original agent I spoke with had outright lied to me and I was not going to get Internet or they service on the day promised, on top of that the guy had misquoted me by $15 a month. The supervisor said he was going to call me back within 24 hours. 8 days later I'm still waiting. Please avoid these useless scam artists!!

The negative reviews of this place are exaggerated. I got the ultra supreme wash (it was on sale) and although there are still a few small spots, I am otherwise satisfied. The carpets were thoroughly vacuumed and the dash cleaned. I'm not sure I'd say it's a $25 quality job (again, I didn't actually pay that much), but hey, the kids doing it are obviously high school or undergraduates. everyone was very friendly and professional. If you're looking to get the interior done, there's nothing wrong with ultra touch, but your money's probably better spent elsewhere if you're just looking at the exterior.

Absolutely disgusting, came here by mistake, thought it was one that got better reviews.  Dirty, selection very poor, very slow to replenish items.  Raw meats sitting out for the stir-fry.  Didn't even dare try it.  My wife's never gonna' let me live this one down.

Great pizza, nice people.

Papa Murphys has really improved their pizza, not that it was bad at all, but its taken on a whole new flavor and look.

I'm very impressed!

I ordered a combo to be delivered - Caprese grilled flat and side salad with bleu cheese. They gave me Italian dressing instead. 

The Caprese sandwich had no basil on it, so by definition was not a Caprese anything. It was also very dry, the tomatoes were unripe and the whole thing tasted sort of sour - either the cheese was bad, or it was goat cheese instead of fresh mozzarella. I added balsamic dressing that happened to be on hand from someone else's lunch from Kneaders and that made it edible.

Overall a total disappointment and I won't be ordering again any time soon.

The Griddle is one of our favorite brunch spots in the West Boise, East Meridian area. The French Toast is one of the best I've ever had and the service is always exceptional. They move fast and the food quality doesn't suffer from it. Great job to the Griddle staff!

This is your typical camping world. There's a million sales guys running around a one guy at the parts counter. They have the typical things that you will find at every other camping world. Overall I wish there was another store to go to but I do not know of one.

They have a great atmosphere. Linen and China. Flowers on the table. Live guitar playing. There's a wine bar. The ceiling looks like stamped metal. Delicious Rosemary bread. Caesar dressing was definitely home made. Steak was delicious.

The service was terrific and they know that you are likely trying to catch a movie (since it is located inside the theater building itself), which is helpful to not have to remind someone that you are trying to get on to something else.  

I saw the comment left by Dan S. that the seating area looks like an airport restaurant.  If you buy into the concept that you are at a high-end theater and grabbing a 'quick-but-quality' bite to eat, you can get past that idea.  It didn't bother me one bit.

My wife commented that "it was nice to feel like I was somewhere else other than a few miles from home".  I ordered the salmon "burger" which was only like a burger because it was on a slightly sweet and toasted bun.  It was perfectly cooked, tender and delicious.  Accompanied by tempura asparagus, it was balanced with complimentary tastes.  Nice.

I'd go again for sure whether or not I'm about to catch a movie.
Excellent!!  Friendly staff, vintage diner decor, freshly squeezed orange juice, fabulous crepes.  Great menu selection.  You won't be disappointed.

I've been here (including the original location on overland) at least a hundred times over the years.... I'm still obsessed!!! So good. You aren't coming here for the service- you're coming for the delicious food for an awesome price. Every time I visit or move to a different city, I still have never found a place that compares to Great Wall!!!
My favorite ramen place in Boise! Best one in the menu is the tonkotsu ramen! The sides (Japanese fried chicken and takoyaki) are also really good! Almost comparable to the ramen shops in Tokyo!!

My wife and I tried Muse recently and I have to admit that I personally was not impressed.  I ordered the prime rib special and it was probably the most bland piece of prime rib I have ever had.  There was just no flavor.  My wife had the scallops and I do have to admit they were pretty good.  I am not sure I would go back.

When I placed my order, the snarky girl on the other end asked if there was anything else. When I said yes and ordered drinks, she obviously wasnt listening and never placed the order for the drinks. I had to place another order for drinks.  When I got home, my daughters Dr. pepper had a nasty brown grainy substance on the bottom of the cup.  I ordered a diet green tea and it had a sandy substance at the bottom too...just a couple drinks in and the drinks went in the trash!. Tried calling the store several times and no one ever answered the phone.  I have left feedback with corporate, I dont know what was in the drinks, but I'm not about to put my family or myself in danger with whatever the snarky chick decided to do to our drinks!!

Clayton was awesome! I needed to get in on the same day and he was able to work me into his busy schedule. He took time to explain the different service options and even followed up after to make sure I was happy with my results. I will definitely be a return customer!
Friendly staff! Very clean. Huge portion sizes and in house made products. I had the house made sausages, love it!
Cozy happening corner spot. The wait didnt seem that long. Coffee available outside while you wait. Impressed with their homemade salsa and jam. Great food. Great service. What else do you need?

It is terrible! Barely any choices and anything is old and looks disgusting. I love dumplings and potstickers and would never turn down any one, but this time I had to throw it away after one bite. What's on top of all these is that you have to pay $11.93 for it. I bet what all they are serving would not worth $300. Terrible service too!

Ended up here on a whim... Giving this two stars only because our waitress was lovely. The food on the other had was awful. Weird flavor on almost all the entrees, soggy croutons that were painfully spicy. Fries were heavily soaked in oil and tasted just like the frying oil. Chicken was dry and bland.

Not the friendliest staff, not bad, just not great. Busy for a Tuesday at 7.  Smells great. Motif is confusing. A beer pub with kids games on the fireplace that looks more like a wine bar. 

Long wait for an appetizer and salad... Over 50 minutes and I finally left. When I told the girl that I ordered from that I was leaving, she said sorry but my order got stuck in the computer. 

Super lame.  I hate reviewing local places poorly. But this was a terrible experience.

Excellent food. Been there 2x. Both times we ordered alcoholic drinks that we did not enjoy. Not only did they replace them, they offered up alternatives that we may enjoy more. I am from the South and very much enjoy the food. They make great efforts to pack in flavor without making the meal too greasy. Go Enjoy!
Very different food but tasty and nutritious. Variety of sauces available. Some customization is possible as well. Reduced prices on Monday evenings.
International Express is so awesome!! The food is always hot and delicious! The staff is friendly and always makes sure you're well taken care of. I highly recommend eating here.

Last night I ordered food from this restaurant. I will never eat there again. I ordered combo Lo Mein and what I got was a box with noodles and nothing on it, and then a container with a gravy with veggies and meat. Now this is not Lo Mein. I moved here from So CAL, and have eaten Lo Mein for 40 years from many Chinese restaurants. I even just googled it. NONE of the pictures had it smothered in this brown gravy. Just Meridian alone has 1,000 people moving here a month. I suggest owners of all the Chinese restaurants travel to Irvine, which is about 90% Asian, and eat at Sam Woo's if they want good Chinese food. With all the people moving here, they need to step up their game. This is the 4th Chinese restaurant I've been disappointed with. I also ordered combo fried rice which was barely fried and was supposed to have beef and pork in it. You would need a microscope to find the beef, and I think they used tiny bits of bacon for the pork. In a good Chinese restaurant, the rice would be fried, there would have been slices of beef and chunks of pork if it had been what I ordered. Don't bother with this restaurant if you are used to good Chinese food.

First impression was quaint little family bistro with a live guitar player.   Grest start as the guitar playing was classic and true.   Then we noticed a lady (ended up being an employee) sitting at a table with her friend eating and drinking.   That is fine until she got up mid chew and greeted people at the door. Very tacky.   After clearing her mouth and getting the guests seated,  she quickly sat back down with her friend and started eating, drinking and laughing again.   I do not feel employees should be doing such in front of guests.
Now to the food. 
Soup and salad were very tasty and seemed very fresh.   The table bread was yummy.   Entrees.. the fish was a little overcooked unfortunately.   The chicken dinner was perfect. We did not try any desert.
I must say the wine list is very affordable and our waiter was great.
Recommend!  
The only reason I did not give more stars was solely due to the lady employee eating, drinking,  laughing and greeting.

Ummmm. JUST. YUM!!

Man you can taste the from scratch in every dish! 

Their homemade jam/jelly/spread- ahhhhhhmazing! 

This will be our go-to spot on this side of town, where before we would go to Moe-Joe's.... This. Is. Better, with better service and a larger seating atmosphere.

And they have mimosas!

Best beer selection, best wings and best flatbreads in Idaho... It's not just a beer store... Stay a while and try the food. I personally love the DoplePak wings, Old world flatbread and the IPA selection.
Incredible people,  incredible service, great decor, great location!!! Will return ofton!!!

Great food and service.  Always fun to find well prepared, fresh, unique dishes ( food that is not burger, fries, chicken or pizza).  Prices just a tad on the high side for this type of atmosphere/lunch as it is a la carte, and by the time you put together what you want it seems a bit high.  But it is healthy and good.

Slow service ask for boxes took like 5-10 just to get box sat there another 20 before asking for check when clearly were done. Unprofessional person in front of me tipped to dollar for the poor service. Then the guy running cash register openly says are you fucking kidding me and shows me what she tipped. Not that I say its right to not tip especially if busy, but it was slow and the service sucked!

We kept heading rave reviews about noodle bowls, of all things, and I couldn't figure out what all the fuss was about...and then I ate here. They're so delicious! The sauces are all tasty, and I liked being able to choose my level of heat. I loved having a few options re: rice, noodles, proteins. I'm picky about carbs, and being able to customize exactly what goes into my bowl makes this perfect for me. And everything was so flavorful! After having tried Flame Broiler, across the street, and not being very impressed, I was thrilled. I could eat here weekly.
I was really excited to try this place after reading the reviews, but was rather disappointed. The food was not great and the service was so-so. The ambiance is nice, but probably won't be back.

The Meridian location of the Boise Co-Op opened this morning for members, a day ahead of the grand opening.  FANTABULOUS store!   Bigger and brighter than the beloved Boise location.  Some of the same great assets like very friendly people and a splendid selection of local and organic produce.  Deli  with a broad selection of specialty meats options like house made Cuban ham that can be cut for you.  Some prepared in house and ready to take or eat there options, like rice bowls and pizzas from a pizza oven on site that can be purchased by slice or whole.

If you, like me, thought a drawback for this Co-Op location was going to be that it doesn't have the Wine Co-Op as does the Boise location, the Co-Op folks read our minds and added in an expanded wine selection at this store.  A good amount of square footage with a thoughtful assortment and anything you want brought in from the Wine Co-Op they will happily arrange. 

There is also a classroom in store that will be used for cooking classes and special events, but it isn't quite finished.  Looks like they are also going to offer some of the same wine tasting events at this location, in that event room, as are offered at the Wine Co-Op on a one week later schedule. 
 
My heart belonged to the Boise location.  But  I am smitten with this new one.  And given it is likely I am one of only sixteen people in the entire Treasure Valley who dislike The Village at Meridian (mall), here's a tip for you other fifteen.  Although the address of the Co-Op is "2350 N. Eagle Road in The Village", it is really in the area there, right next to Michael's where parking and navigation are easier to come by than the "haute shops meets Vegas" area of The Village mall.

I found this place on Groupon and was surprised with the quality of the beef which is very good.  We Love all the burgers. The beef is fresh and delicious. I don't do soft serve yogurt but there are always people there with their kids so that counter always busy too.
My college son's love the fresh cut fries and order them regularly over the frozen. Be sure to specify the ones that are cut and fried there.

I LOVE Brewforia! You must try the Sicily salad - the combination of flavors is amazing and it's served on something similar to a cheese pizza. It's delish! Their pulled pork and hot wings are also very good! They have a large assortment of beer, the atmosphere is very laid back, and the service is good. Seriously, go check it out! I have no complaints! Today we ordered the Sicily salad, the hot wings, the pulled pork and two beers. The total came to $28 and we went home with leftovers. Great deal in my opinion.
Looks new ~ your typical co-op of what one would expect. I wish they offered GF in their deli but other than that nice store, clean, organized and friendly knowledgeable staff.

This is beyond a doubt the worse Subway I have ever been to. They have a drive through but while you sit in the drive through everyone who walks in the front door gets waited on first. I ordered the same sandwiches I usually order and they were so awful! I've never had someone ruin a subway sandwich! They didn't even put the cheese on. I suggest, if you really want a sub, go somewhere else!

Awesome food, humungous servings...who would have thought to look for Himalayan food in of all places, Meridian?  Very tasty momo (steamed dumplings, their only fault is that they disappear in a couple of bites), excellent chicken curry, saffron or brown rice, veggies and blackeyed peas topped off with cilantro and your choice of curries.  Full plate plus drink for $10...excellent value!  It can get crowded quickly but the service is good and well worth the wait...I'll be back!

Vegans / Vegetarians: 
Pros - They have two vegan broths - Skip the miso flavor, go for the Soy Sauce flavor, ask for no egg. The Soy Sauce flavor one is actually excellent. The miso one is tasteless. 
Cons - Unacceptable service, incredibly slow, our neighbors (a couple) got their meals 30min apart. Server first told us the spring rolls were vegetarian, then I asked he clarify and he came back to say they actually have meat in them. Glad I asked! After 20min, had to ask for our check. The curry fried rice without egg was tasteless. 
Summary: It's the only Ramen in town with a vegan / vegetarian broth (that I know it) and the Soy flavored one is actually delicious! If you're in a rush, don't come here. It's worth a try, but a giant bowl of savory vegan pho and a side of fresh spring rolls will continue to win me over every time.

This review is for the bubble tea/boba tea. It's delicious! I've missed boba and I finally found a great place that offers it at a great price. 

I got a coconut taro blend and it was delicious

I've had 2 experiences with this location.  The first was with a 2011 Ford F-350 Diesel that had a warning light on, they checked everything out fixed a minor issue and said there was no charge.  This week I took my 67 Mustang in for an oil change and asked them to look at a leak which ended up being a slow transmission leak but they also spotted a slow leak of gas from the fuel pump.  They repaired both quickly at reasonable rates and adjusted my carburetor. 

Great team, great service and they're honest... A rare combination in the industry!
Crapshoot service. Internet works only when it wants to, customer service is an absolute joke. You constantly conned in to having to do a modem "upgrade" which is more of a down grade.
Horrendously slow and not stocked up on ingredients. There were only two customers ahead of us and it took 30 minutes to get our order. Ridiculous!!!
The service was slow because there was only waiter serving the restaurant but the food was good. We loved the variety of ramen dishes and add ons. Definitely would go back.

Alright...not really worth the money in my opinion. We had grilled cheese, soup, and ice cream. I expected an exceptional grilled cheese (given that it was essentially the only staple food option) I found it to be bland. I also tried the chocolate ice cream, and found basically the same thing as the sandwich...bland.

My family and I checked this out after buying the Groupon and overall the food was tasty, frozen yogurt was yummy and the staff was awesome! The only reason why I rated 3 stars is due to the fact that this place needs a thorough cleaning and upkeep throughout the day. The booths and chairs need a complete scrub down and tables,floors, bathrooms should be kept up throughout the day. The staff and food was really good so I hope to see the restaurant look cleaner the next time we visit!

My wife and I have ate here twice. Each time has been great and we are finally figuring out what the best spicy scale is for us.

Staff is friendly and upbeat
Nice that they have some gluten-free options as well
$30 for gel manicure. Not very sanitary. No attention to detail. Nice staff but I don't think I will be coming back again.
The food is good, the coffee is great (Dawson Taylor is served) and the service was good each time we went. I would get there early, before 9am . The price point is a bit high.

We went in on Sunday, December 17th at 2pm to use the coupon I got sent in an email. Needless to say we left after standing there for about 5 minutes without being helped on.  The girl kept saying we will be with you shortly but never got to place our order. This place better get their customer service figured out before we go back.

My friend and I met for breakfast decided to try out meridian's newest breakfast spot. I had to say I was a little hesitant the reviews/star rating is a little rough so I had initial trepidations. The waitress was super friendly and helpful with the menu. I love the decor of this space; the sliding barn door for the busser space is really cool/great artwork on the walls too).The breakfast menu is quite extensive lots of traditional southern favorites. I love how brisket plays a prominent part in their breakfast menu. I ended up ordering the brisket breakfast burrito which comes with their skillet apples. My buddy ordered the biscuits and gravy. He ordered the hot chocolate; it was a really good size actually come to the table to refill it. Breakfast burrito was delicious; a perfect of smoked brisket, eggs, cheese, and peppers all wrapped in a grilled tortilla. The skillets apples were definitely fresh; sliced and immersed in a sweet buttery sauce. My biggest disappointment was the salsa; everything up this point was flavorful and fresh except for the salsa. They brought out a cup of pace picante; a big pet peeve of mine not even salsa yuck :(  after all that emphasis on fresh and southern flavor to just go with pace picante was very disappointing; I'd think you'd be able to come up with fresh salsa for your breakfast burritos or at least source it out to one of our local salsa makers/distributors.  My buddy got biscuits and gravy; said it was some of the best he's had in Boise. Overall it was a flavorful breakfast visit; a delightful spin on southern favorites a welcome addition to the meridian breakfast scene. I will definitely be back..
Yoga with Don, Zumba with Michelle and Theresa. Best classes and lots of variety
Disapointing..   I ordered the noodles with beef. The flavor was mediocre, and the beef was inedible. About half of the beef pieces were full of gristle. I doubt I'll return.

Adorable place and a great location. The service was super friendly and welcoming. I didn't love what I ordered for breakfast, the eggs were just too cheesy for me (if there is such a thing as too cheesy!) but the ego boost I ordered with it was delicious! The pastries looked great and I will definitely be back to try something different on the menu.

MAKE SURE YOU CHECK EVERYTHING WHEN BUYING FROM CAMPING WORLD

They provided me with 2 larger propane tanks, they claimed were filled, but upon using the propane for heat, both were empty. 
Then when going back after they said the would refill the tanks, they stated that the tanks were EXPIRED, and they I needed to drive 15 miles to get the tank "certified".
AND upon going to the location CW advised, they said the tanks were not expired after all.

I'm pissed at the quality and reliability of this location

Absolutely delicious food! Well worth the wait on a Sunday morning! Our server Jeffrey was also amazing!!!! We got the chorizo eggs Benedict and the egg and bacon focaccia breakfast sandwich....both were to die for! We will definitely come back!
I'm not a huge fan of Asian food, but this was pretty good. The appetizers were great especially the Japanese Fried Chicken. Would recommend.

Hands down, best Camping World in the USA. Great prices, service and models. They had everything I needed and were extremely knowledgeable, I mean they really know what they are doing. I have been to other Camping Worlds and have yet to meet a group that knows as much as the Camping World of Caldwell does. Frank was my salesman and to this day he helps me whenever I call. If you need a new model I highly recommend working with him. Such a great experience, this has definitely become my Camping World of choice.
My daily regular! love this place and their breakfast burritos are the best in town!

My new place to go to get massage! This place is relaxing & clean! They don't have a very big room, the most they can fit in there is 4 people in their biggest room but they have 3 other rooms. I paid $30 for one hour foot massage; it's includes head, neck, shoulder, arm hands, foot, back, lower back back massage & a foot scrub! What a bargain! I feel like a new person afterwards! I will be back for sure!

My husband and I are frequent movie goers...we have seen about 7 movies at the Village in Meridian and have eaten both at the Backstage Bistro and in the VIP in theater dining a few times...the food is delicious...so far we have tried short ribs, steak frites, tuna tartar, calamari, pear gallette, creme brule, mac and cheese, burgers (My husband's burger was undercooked during a matinee show one time, but other than that the food is really great!), crouque monsuer, pumpkin raspberry upside down cake, paninis, and some of there signature cocktails...the Chef really knows what he is doing...I am impressed with the Backstage Bistro...we only see movies in the VIP now...Thanks Village Cinema and  Backstage Bistro! The staff upstairs are super friendly and really know the menu.  Thanks to Terrance for the great dining experience in the Bistro! The kids in the box office were very polite and knowledgeable about were the best spot in VIP would be.  We just found out last time we were there that they are now offering $5 all day movie tickets on Tuesdays and they have cool appetizers and drink deals in VIP....we are so there....new Tuesday date night!!!
Everything about cupbop is 5 stars! EVERYTHING...BBQ chicken is my fave and always get extra mondoo!!!

In addition to other work performed by Meridian Plumbing at my rental property in Eagle, I retained them to install a water heater in February of 2014.

I was recently notified by my property manager that there was evidence of a leak between the pipe nipple on the water heater and the flex connector which connects the water heater to the house.

I spoke with the technician and asked him why there was a leak after only four years which is atypical of most installations (I still have my original water heater at my residence which is 33 years old. No leaks).

He told me that the company (Meridian Plumbing) was using substandard nipples at the time and have since changed to another brand.

I remarked that now I have to pay for his company's purchasing practices.

He told me that he would have to drain the water heater (which he didn't do), and install a new pipe nipple and flex connector for a charge of $131.00.

I decided in view of safety and reliability to make the repair.

My property manager relayed my concern about getting no relief for the substandard material used and I was subsequently sent an email by Chris Field, Director of Finance, informing me that the owner "Jeff" stated that he was well within his rights to bill me as the installation is only guaranteed for one year.

Although "Jeff" is legally "within his rights", this is not good business practice and people considering using this firm should be forewarned that they don't stand behind their work for a period of time consistent with what most people would consider reasonable for such an installation. 

Furthermore, I was merely asking for some relief or consideration and was not expecting to pay nothing.

I will certainly never use Meridian Plumbing again have suggested to my property manager who recommended them to me to do likewise.

We have never had a bad meal here...They are under new management and the service was excellent, which was something we hadn't experienced at the Eagle location.  They have the best French Toast ever and their omelets are amazing as well!  This is our go-to place fore breakfast and lunch...and we will go to this location from now on...friendly staff, amazing food!

Rodeo burger. The best fast food burger I've had. Bacon, cheese, bbq sauce, and a huge onion ring (I don't really enjoy onions, but it is so good and totally makes the burger). Fries here are also super delicious - just the right amount of crunchiness, fluffiness, and saltiness. Never been disappointed here. Service is generally very friendly and I LOVE the oldies music they play inside. 

The only thing I think they could change is the size of their shakes. If you're looking for a ginormous shake and have two or three people to feed, get the "Mini" shake, and you'll be set. It'd be nice if they could serve a shake that's much smaller since it's impossible for me to eat an entire mini shake along with my meal. 

I used to live in California and would frequently visit In-N-Out- But I have to say, I'd definitely choose the Rodeo burger and Iceberg french fries over the In-N-Out burgers, even though they are very tasty. 

*My sister and her husband still live in CA and come to visit every couple of months - they will go to Iceberg 2 or 3 times while they're here because there are no Iceberg's where they live.

Never miss out when in the Boise area! Full espresso bar, fresh specialties & killer jams!
Omelettes, eggs, benedicts, cakes, crepes - everything is yumm!

The owners are new to the restaurant gig and Barnyard has only been open a couple of weeks.  For those reasons, I would be inclined to charitable view for just how bad was our first, and likely last, visit there.  But for the fact of glowing reviews that drew us in.  And but for the owners' marketing rhetoric that had us waxing enthusiastic and which the reality of our experience matched not at all.

The food was inedible.  Truly.  There have not been many times my hubby and I left an entire meal uneaten.  As here.  And while our server was very nice it seems servers had not been trained on the menu.  At all.  For those reasons, we'd be hard pressed to go back here again and if someone suggested it we'd say 'no go'.  That's our 2 star standard.  They are not ready for prime-time.

Here is the MARKETING RHETORIC:  "... farm fresh right to your table...Fresh cheeses, milks, yogurts made daily by hand in an age old artisevan fashion...We bake our breads fresh and serve it with our house made butters...consciously sourced meats are cooked low and slow in a revival of rural American cooking...comfort foods...casual, inexpensive yet elevated...focus on local quality ingredients starting with our own farm...a timeless journey back to what wholesome food used to be..."

Here is the REALITY OF OUR VISIT:

VIBE: Starting with the best thing, the interior was light and bright farm-style meets strip mall; comfortable with standard height seating (hooray) at wood tables arranged in a way that felt as if there was breathing room.  In the era of "sardine can" seating, good for them!  Although there was only one other couple in the place when we arrived and only two others when we left, I imagine if there were lots of people it would still have felt good. 

A bar at the entry had a few high counter stools.

Music was country western cranked up a few decibels too high, but it fit the space otherwise.

MENU:  Serving lunch and supper (yes, supper in the old farm style word, I love it) from about 11am through 9pm, there is a different menu for each meal.  Other reviewers left photos of menus or find them at Barnyard's web site. Some items are supper only, like pot roast, and some make it on both menus, like fried green tomatoes or Mama's Biscuits.  And that is where the rub started.

SERVICE & FOOD:  We were there for lunch but asked if we could order sides, called "Fixin's" off the supper menu.  Specifically cornbread.  If not, we said, we'd order biscuits.  Our server checked with the kitchen and returned to report "Fixins" were supper only so no cornbread at lunch.  Or biscuits, she said, the kitchen says biscuits are supper only. 

But, we said, there are Mama's Biscuits (4 to the order with house made butter and jam) listed as a lunch menu item.   And biscuits appear on the lunch menu as "comes with..." several items.  How does that work if the kitchen tells you biscuits aren't served at lunch?

The server agreed this didn't make sense.  She said she would check with the manager.

The server returned.  The manager, she said,  offered to get us a side of biscuits. Special help. OK then. We took the manager up on it.  But this was perilously close to the "I'll have toast" scene from Five Easy Pieces.  I mean, biscuits are listed several times on the regular lunch menu.

Here's the run down on food items we ordered.  Note I didn't say ate.

Mamas Biscuits - We received 2 not 4 (per menu) hockey puck sized biscuits.  "Oops", said the server when she picked up our plates," the kitchen should have put 4 on the plate but I didn't know the menu says that."  Biscuits were too dense.  The house butter with them was over churned.  But they were the best part of the meal and the only thing we finished.

Fried Green Tomatoes - encased in a heavy, bland, completely under seasoned batter and fried to be greasy.  The half slice of chewy bacon on top of each was good though.  Ate the bacon and after sampling the tomatoes, left them.  I love fried green tomatoes and have had yummy ones many times.  This was not one of those times. 

Shrimp and Grits - this entree arrived to be the worst version of this dish we have been served.  Anywhere. Ever.  Bland, under seasoned grits and tasteless shrimp although the cubes of pork (is that you, country ham?) were OK.  Two bites was too much and we set the dish aside.

Wedge Salad - half portion came with grits entree, although our server was unaware this was printed on the menu.  She had to go double check when we asked where it was.  Tomatoes were good, dressing was good if scant, but the kind of iceberg that ought not be put on a plate. (To see Wedge done right, visit Bodacious Pig.)

VALUE
Had manager not comped $18 of our bill (very nice of her, we didn't expect it), the total would have been $28 for lunch for two with no beverages.

NOTE
HH 3p - 6p daily.
Located next to Lucky Fin, across from Red Robin.

We've dined at Muse Wine Bar twice and both were "home runs!"  This is a wonderful small restaurant with excellent food, presentation and service.  They are committed to "doing it right" by keeping the restaurant small and intimate.  Just nine tables!  The menu is nicely balanced with meat and seafood, and changes weekly.  Deserts are homemade and spectacular.  Very reasonable prices for high quality food and upscale presentation by a very creative chef.  You will not be disappointed at Muse. We went with friends for New Years Eve and they were very impressed--a superior new addition to the Boise restaurant scene and we hope we'll still be able to get a reservation one the word gets out!!

walked through the door no one in store but employees in the back, which made eye contact.  Still took several minutes for them to come to the front and assist me.  After making change I hold my hand up to get the bills and coin, cashier looks and puts money on counter.
This is the neighborhood pizza place but I won't be back.   I don't expect much, I do expect common courtesy though.

I'm a huge fan of Indian cuisine and this was probably the closest I could get to Indian in Meridian. Plus, I never had Himalayan/Nepalese food, so the foodie in me couldn't resist checking this one off the list! Surprisingly, the star here aren't the momos, as it was just a basic steamed dumpling...it's the samosas with their fresh red sauce! Delicious! Totally satisfied my craving and on top of that a medium combo (3 momos, meatball makhani, chicken salad, black eyed peas) was only like $6! Raj (owner? manager?) is super friendly. Thanks, Yelp!

This is funny for coffee ppl ...so i ordered a simple black coffee from the barista. First time at this groovey spot. The chick  kept my change in the till when she rang me up. I thought oh well was gonna toss it in the jar so whatevs. I took a sip of coffee and noticed it was old and cold. I had told barista coffee was cold so she poured it into a steaming pitcher and proceeded to warm it that way instead of brewing fresh coffee. Who does that lol I just got my money back and left. I think she was new or.something??

Yet another one star rating for Camping World in Meridian.  I browsed parts for my recently purchased trailer.  Found the part I wanted and inquired about where to purchase propane.  The pleasant sales clerk told me where to go to get the propane and to bring my slip back and she'd ring them up together.  She would call to have someone come fill my tanks.  The distance to the tank filling area is not short.  So I drive my RV over, took off the tanks and waited.....and waited.  15 minutes and nothing.  I walked up to reception to ask for help and they rudely referred me back to the retail area.  That same, formerly friendly sales clerk snapped at me that she had already told her manager.  I walked back out and waited again.  Same result.  I'm can't figure out why there isn't a call box, accept of course that they want you to spend time in the retail area.  Again I tromped back in.  Now there is a long line at the retail desk.  Waited in line, by then I was so angry I walked out, put the tanks back in my RV and left.  I will not return.

Nice teriyaki place. I love their option of brown rice. The first few times we ate there the teriyaki chicken bowl came with fresh veggies- carrots, broccoli and zucchini. I went back a few days ago and sadly they have switched to bagged frozen veggies. The sugar snap peas and broccoli were mushy, the carrots were flavorless and there were hardly any in the first place. Their sauce is very flavorful and the chicken is always cooked well. Good sized portions and very nice service will keep me going back. But now I know what to expect in their rice bowls going forward.
Great tasting food at an affordable price. I had the platter so I could try a variety of options. Don't forget to add a side of samosas and chai! Will definitely eat at MoMo again.

Came in for the red white and blue slam: blueberry pancakes topped with strawberries and cream cheese syrup with two eggs, two slices of bacon and a side of hash browns. Sounds delicious, right? It sure looked delicious in their ad, I otherwise would not be interested in dining here. 

So I asked for my eggs to be cooked over medium and to substitute sausage for the bacon. Instead of writing down sausage though, our waitress wrote down bacon. ??? Ok... So my food comes out and I immediately know this isn't going to be good. The pancakes were slightly overcooked, the amount of blueberries overwhelming, and far too little of that delicious cream cheese syrup on top. Had to send back my bacon so I could get what I asked for. 

The worst part...my eggs looked underdone. Cut into them...they were a perfect over easy. Which would have been great if that's what I ordered. But I can't eat over easy eggs. I find them unbearable. So I sent them back and specified what I meant by over medium.  Second try...over easy, again. So I left them on the plate and we left disgruntled and frustrated. If you're hiring cooks for a diner, they sure better know how to cook and egg 10 ways.  And one of those should be over medium.

This is one of the best breakfast places I have ever been in. The staff were very warm and helpful. The food was excellent. I went with my daughter and my sister, who is on this special diet. The server was suggesting things to her and was in no hurry to get our order. The place was 3/4 full and they had more than enough wait staff. Very excellent breakfast. We return 
Give it a try and you would leave hungry!!

I had an amazing experience with CarMax.  I had been looking at and researching different SUVs for about 6 months before I decided on a Jeep Grand Cherokee.  I looked at my local dealerships as well as online at several dealerships.  I kept going back to the CarMax website as they were roughly $3000 lower on the same model, similar mileage, and exact options.  My local dealership refused to lower their price on the same vehicle to match CarMax so I finally decided to make the move on my purchase.  I called CarMax and was answered by Rasheed who was very helpful and friendly.  He walked me through all the steps of putting in a transfer and what would happen each step of the way.  My transfer came in approximately 3 weeks, made an appointment to go to Boise for the test drive.  Absolutely loved the Grand Cherokee, it looked BRAND NEW and was spotless.  Paperwork was so quick, easy and painless (I'm sure it helped to get pre-approved).  They sent the Grand Cherokee to get detailed while I signed papers which kind of surprised me because it was already spotless but I appreciated their attention to detail.  I also received $800 more on my trade than my local dealership was willing to give me and it was $500 over what high list was on KBB.  I had an amazing experience and will definitely be a return customer.  The other guy who complained about them not matching the price on an identical truck with less miles.....then just buy the identical truck with less miles for $1K less?!!! Hahaha!  I also highly recommend Rasheed as a sale consultant....he definitely knows his stuff and answered every question I had about the Grand Cherokee and showed me all the bells and whistles.

RAMEN SNOB ALERT

After reading the other reviews, I went into my two meals here thinking I was going to be very let down. But in an area where there's only one option available to get legit non-fusiony ramen (and I'm not including some of the sushi places that offer ramen because that broth flavoring is just coming straight from a soup packet), it's not too bad. It's in no way a standout for me either, and there are issues beyond the food quality that could use some ironing out. But it's serviceable and would be a regular option for me if I still lived in Boise.

There appears to be no specialty dish here, so I went with my usual mainstays of tonkotsu and shoyu ramen. Based on what the owner told me, there's a connection between here and a ramen legend in L.A. called Daikokuya, which specializes in a fairly hearty tonkotsu ramen. Here the broth isn't as intense. It's not a light broth in of itself because it's pork bone broth after all, but it's lighter than I've come to expect, like a tonkotsu made in Tokyo to appease the masses as opposed to one being served in the Kyushu area where it originated. I'd imagine it would be toned down on purpose for the Boise area, so this doesn't surprise me. It was still flavorful, and it's a safe entryway into the tonkotsu realm. But I prefer the broth to have a bit more punch. The shoyu broth was alright. It didn't have the depth of flavor like at some of my favorite places to eat it. Despite being fairly rudimentary, it wasn't offensive to my palate at all. Somewhere between meh and OK. The amount of slices of chashu you get seems to vary on whether the place is busy or not (one during a chaotic dinner, two during a mellow lunch). No matter the amount, I thought the taste was a little above average with a decent meat-to-fat quotient. Like others, I do agree that we're not getting enough broth. This reeks of cutting corners. The egg was average. The gyoza was meh. Daikokuya has (or at least used to have) some of the best and most unique gyoza I've ever had, so the owner should be cognizant of what makes stellar gyoza. This wasn't it.

When I went for dinner, I thought the initial wait-time issues soon after it had opened would have been cleared up. No they weren't. Coming at around 7:00 on a weekday night with three adults and one child yielded about a 40-minute wait time after our order had been placed. That's far and away the longest time I've ever had to wait for ramen after the order had been placed. Our bill got a minor deduction because of it, but there was no way I was going to make a second trip at dinnertime. I went back for lunch before the lunch crowd started filing in and got served promptly. Actual service was friendly and hospitable if ragged on the edges (dishes getting confused, lack of knowledge of the product), and the owner seemed nice.

Like Horix's review, I'll also offer some suggestions (including what he suggested). 

--More broth in the bowl. Once again, this reeks of cutting corners to make sure the broth doesn't run out. 
--More condiments. Horix mentioned togarashi, rayu, and white pepper. I would add sesame seed dispensers at the very least. If you want to make an even better impression, offer takana (mustard greens).
