--Offer the ability to add more noodles or more soup upon finishing most of one's bowl, as well as the ability to customize toppings. I'm hopeful this will happen in time as the kinks get worked out.
--Offer more than one kind of noodle. If you're trying to do legit Hakata-style tonkotsu, you have the wrong style of noodle for it and probably know that already. Will you be using the same style of noodle when tsukemen starts to be served? I hope not.
--Offer the ability to have tonkotsu done "kotteri" style where fat is added to the broth to give it a richer flavor.
--Get higher seats for the bar. Sitting at the bar and trying to eat is a weird experience. If you're there just to drink, it's fine. But you have to assume that people are going to be eating there as well, and it's an awkward experience (even with me at 6' 2") to try to be eating out of a deep bowl with chopsticks at a high bar with a seat level that's not conducive to easy eating. If I was any shorter and had no other option where to eat, I would've just kicked my seat to the side and stood at the bar while eating.
--In general, please try to offer as authentic a meal as possible and only play it safe if you provide another option that doesn't play it safe (like with the tonkotsu broth). It took so long for Boise to get a ramen-ya. So many options for pho, but ramen lovers were always being given the shaft until you came around. This had been a long time in the waiting. Don't get complacent just because you're the only game in town, as that will change eventually.

Overall it's more of a 2.5 star review. There's potential here despite the shortcomings, which is why I'm going to round up to a 3. But it needs some fine-tuning like any other startup restaurant.

The coffee here is just fine. I am not a fan of super-sugary drinks but if you are, you can get 'em here. Of all the diabetes-inducing beverages, go for the Milky Way. My girlfriend gets 'em and, admittedly, they're pretty tasty; I just can't commit to a whole cup of that.

I've had their breakfast burritos a couple times. They're pretty tasty and relatively filling. The burritos are filled with egg, potato, and your choice of sausage or bacon (I think they've got one without the meats, too). There might even be a little cheese in those burritos. I am not sure about their other munchable selections, but I am sure they're all pretty alright.

I have seen people on laptops here, so I imagine they've got wifi. There are quite a few tables inside and it is pretty cozy. The baristas are always friendly seem very highly caffeinated. That's alright with me though, because they always get stuff out quickly.
Love this place! Great food...relaxing, community-friendly environment, pleasant staff, and of course, lots of beer choices!! If you want to meet people in a casual environment, this is the place.

I was extremely impressed with Andrew at Meridian plumbing.  Fast efficient and friendly he did a great job!  He explained everything helped make decisions on other plumbing needs and really overall went out of his way to get my new stove installed and converted!  Definitely recommend this company!

I have been going to this Home Depot for years and it's customer service has slowly declined to an all time low. Today we went to go purchase a screen door or storm door, however, we were not sure which type to purchase. Made our way to the door customer service area where 2 older and heavy set men were sitting alone. I asked for some help explaining I dont know which one to purchase. The employee said, "Those doors are down and to the right."  They had no intention of helping us.

We were so took back by the laziness we left and went 1 mile to Lowe's and got great service.

Slowest sonic in town, consistently. If they were just slow once, fine. But every time I go I wait over 10 min at the drive through. I'm currently sitting in it actually. It's been 15 minutes and still 2 cars in front of me.
Very disappointed. Expensive for no work... windows still bad. Nothing wiped down on the inside, vacuum job not good. I understand hiring youth, and I support that, but teach them to do a better job

Great service from Rey, super friendly, kid savvy and great food recommendations. I had the Caribbean French toast in the combo, with bacon and eggs was the perfect amount of food. My boyfriend had the California Benedict with avocado, bacon and tomato. Also delicious. 
Very attentive and friendly staff, made us feel very welcome and at home. Menu is eclectic, something for everyone. Can't wait to come back and try something else!!
This was my 1st time here I just moved to the area and Betty and angel were great. My gel  manicure and regular pedicure looked awesome and they are all very nice their. Will definitely go back

The food and drinks are excellent.  However, they need to work on their happy hour.  $1 off of drinks does not a happy hour make when you can go next door for half the price and have food included in the package:  hopefully they make it!!

We had a reservation next door but it was a long wait and packed house. We went here and it was a great meal. Smaller menu but what they do they do good. The ramen dishes were spot on with fall off your fork slightly fatty bites of pork and hard to find real deal ramen noodles. The pork bento bowl was fabulous with spot on flavor profile of ginger and garlic sauce with perfect blend of sauce to meat to rice portion for like 7 bucks. The gyoza were perfectly cooked and a tasty app. We fed four for a Friday night meal and with tip and even a beer for under $50.

My daughter had two nails that needed tips, and wanted a gel polish change, and our regular girl doesn't work Fri-Sun. We had an appt. and they were so blasé. They switched people on her twice, the workers were practically non-verbal, or even communicative at all. She said her nail hurts, and the tip is too heavy, and feels loose, but she wants nothing more to do with them. She looked so perturbed on the bench when I came to get her, not at all pampered, or even treated in a friendly way. Never again.
Grew up on reeds dairy and they're still the best, so glad there here in Meridian! Love their cheese curds, ice cream and chocolate milk

Many healthy and flavorful options. Great prices, too - for less than $10, I had a combination with saffron rice, several steamed dumplings, two types of vegetarian curry, a samosa and two sauces. Server explained all of the menu items and although the shop is in a strip mall, it was very clean and smelled good.

I absolutely do not understand the people that give this place bad ratings. My wife and I go here all the time and it is always good. I don't expect this to be some Chinatown kind of experience. It is in Meridian Idaho and for where it is, the food is great. Note: My mom used to manage a really good Chinese buffet restaurant so I know what time to go..nuff said. The service was top notch. Kacey and others took really good care of us. I want to mention that I took a huge bag of Starburst candy in with me and offered some to everyone that was working out front. This gesture was well received, but in no way influences my rating. I spent many years working in restaurants and appreciate the people that do this for a living. Perhaps those people that haven't slaved in kitchens of big restaurants don't understand how much work goes into their food and leave stupid ratings. This restaurant does a good job. Show them some love. Take the people that serve your food some candy, or say something nice. They deserve it. Trust me. Thanks Great Wall. You've never let us down.
Love BREAKFASTQUEST at this place! It's always a great choice! I was just there this morning enjoying pancakes!

They charge 37 cents/oz.  They have lots of flavors, I think like 15 or something.  You get a free waffle cone/bowl with your ice cream if you want it.  The staff is very nice as well.  My favorite part is they have a huge candy, cookie and topping bar.  You can rent out the space for free for partys.  There's really nothing bad about this place. Its a fun place to go!

I had never eaten Himalayan food, but I was staying nearby and they awesome reviews, so I trusted yelp on this one. The woman was very helpful with ordering, and I got the combination with 5 momos, a mix of them, with chicken curry on basmati rice, spicy sauce (not too spicy), beans, mixed chopped peppers and cabbage. It was outstanding. For sure will be coming back for more.

My husband ordered the chorizo tostada, I ordered the feta basil omelette and the Caribbean French toast. All of it was amazing! The servers Nick and host John were super-amazing and pleasant. Loved the service!!!The prices we're great. Oh and the homemade Jams...raspberries and blueberries we're all so amazing! We love this place. If we lived in Boise we would make this place our Sunday breakfast tradition.

I have to admit when I saw the redesign of the old video store building I didn't like it....still don't, no offense Mr. owner sir (it's the circus colors outside). However if looks were everything where would we be? Inside this place was great! Lots of flavors of yogurt, should have counted but it seemed more than the other local joints. They had a ton of toppings which was really nice, lots and lots of options. Place was clean, really nice inside, and staff guy was nice as well. I was skeptical at first but you won me over, we will be back!!

Loved the tonkatsu ramen and gyoza!! Both were delicious! Wished there were more options (add pork, etc.) Will be back to try all remaining flavors of ramen in the near future! So stoked there's a ramen shop in Boise!!!!
I love this place!! Food is amazing and the service, especially by Amy, was wonderful!!! So glad we finally have a Corner Bakery in Idaho!!!

The tonkatsu ramen is absolutely delicious with the pork belly and broth. The staff is pleasant and friendly. We've had the cream cheese wontons which are slightly spicy and super delicious. Finish your meal with some mochi ice cream (I recommend the mango) and you'll have had a great meal and a fun dining experience. This has become one of my favorite places to grab a great dinner in downtown Boise.

Just never satisfied when we dine here. Always hear that it's a great place, beginning to wonder if we hit it when the worst staff is on duty.  I'm a big fan of biscuits and gravy. They totally mess it up. Might give it another try after I've forgotten how bad it was.

I'm fairly disappointed with this one. I saw the good reviews here, and it seemed like Iceberg, while being a mini-chain, had a higher level of credibility to its name.

The first thing I noticed about the menu was that the burgers are relatively cheap. I went to the counter and tried to order a burger with a little bit of pink inside, only to be told by the girl behind the counter that their burgers are the frozen and pre-cooked kind. Ahhhh, so that's why they can sell them cheap. If you're a burger joint and you're not offering fresh beef, you're not exactly starting off from a position of strength (and any comparisons to In-n-Out should end right there). But I wanted to try one out anyway. The condiments I got were of higher quality than you'd get out of a regular chain. But you can polish up a turd as much as you like, yet unfortunately I'm still being served a turd. Same goes for the fries. The way they were cooked was done well, as the fries were crispy on the outside and light and airy on the inside. But I was being served utterly generic steak fries that I can get at any random market on the cheap. The onion rings are better. They're enormous though. You get an order of four giant rings. And while it was kinda cool at first to see my order right in front of me, I realized that handling, breaking down, and consuming them was going to make eating these an utter mess. I couldn't tell you how many napkins I went through to consume them. Good luck picking them apart and then trying to dunk them in the fry sauce without a layer of grease creeping up further on your hand (I found it best to just spread the fry sauce out on the tray). If I ever had these again, I'd only eat them with a knife and fork.

The shakes here seem to be their claim to fame. It warns you right on the cup that they're thick, and these are extremely thick. So thick that they don't even bother giving you a straw. Instead you get a spoon. Personal preference certainly comes into play here, but for me this is not a shake. This is soft-serve ice cream. Which was fine for what it was, but I hadn't planned on being served soft-serve ice cream, and I would prefer I get my soft-serve ice cream through Fanci Freeze because what I get at Fanci Freeze is better than what I got at Iceberg. They offer two sizes, and even the mini size may be too big for the average person to consume on their own. You'll need a really big appetite to polish off the regular size. I gave myself a facepalm when I saw the pricing structure. You get a regular for $3.99, and the mini size? $3.59. Well HELL, why even bother getting a mini when they're only going to cut the cost of it by 40 cents? If they're going to offer a mini size, wouldn't you figure it would be in the realm of say $2 or so? The comparison between sizes is substantial enough that you may as well get the regular for the extra value and keep passing that cup around until it's gone. It's so stupid. The people running Iceberg got "upselling" down to a science with that one.

As I said, not what I was expecting given the praise here. Iceberg turned out to be complete fools gold for me.

Staaaahhhhp it!  This was my cheat meal every single week when I was slimming down for my wedding. There might be a touch of cocaine in the filling they use for the crêpes and stuffed french toast, because that stuff leaves you fiending for more.  Disney has nicknamed their oreo filling "the grey stuff", well I argue that this filling is on par and is now dubbed "the white stuff".

Do yourself a favor and just order some to go as well, to save yourself a trip later that afternoon.

Pleasantly surprised!  I love Momo's modern approach to Nepalese cuisine.  Lots of options made with fresh ingredients, friendly staff, and very affordable.  I got a 5 momo plate with rice and chicken curry plus a mango lassi for $12.  This is a good spot to grab a quick bite.

I am so excited for this shop! The coffee drinks are better than what other cafes offer and the pastries are flipping amazing. The shop is decorated really well, had a great atmosphere, and the employees are friendly and cheerful.

I called recently to talk with the manager about the menu change. I was told that the Santa Fe Salad would not be back so I guess I won't either. Now with Panera opening up nearby, there's no need to even consider going back to CB. Wake up CB, you're losing customers. Truly a shame as CB was a great choice for a good meal in a clean, well managed environment. Moving on!
Aiyaya..The branding appeals fresh & homemade to me but actually it's a very fast food orientated restaurant. White bread sandwich. Sugar cookies. Sweet coffee. Sorry. It's not my cup of coffee.

UPDATE: After nearly 2 months in service - we were told we could pick up our trailer, so we showed up and guess what -- NO PAPERWORK AND OUR KEYS ARE LOST!!!! we left without our trailer and management has yet to pick up the phone.

To say the service department is terrible would be too kind. Unless we absolutely have to - we plan to never return.
I was really hoping for a great ramen restaurant in Boise. This one is not great. Pretty average.

For not knowing the movie theater had a good restaurant located inside it,  our experience was great.   The service was very attentive.   The chef even arrived at our table to inquire about the food.  The chef was very nice and informative.   We gave our opinions and he appreciated our feedback.   Not to often does the chef make personal visits to the guests.
The food was creative, upscale and tasty. The menu is not what one would expect inside a movie theater. 
The Short Ribs were cooked perfectly along with the house made pasta.  We also ordered the house made gnocchi in butter sauce.     
The decor is nice and the patio is amazing. 
Highly recommend and we look forward to many drinks this summer on the patio watching the sunset.

Really like this place. Definitely on the spendy side, but I have my favorites I only get there. Their burritos are awesome! Especially if you get one of the ladies to make it, they do a great job! Guys that work there will usually make it super small or you will get all the beans on one side and everything else on the other. The ladies should teach them how it's done! The salad bar is good too! And their bakery goodies are always delicious!

I would like to start by saying by far best food and people. We had a tough time deciding what we wanted, thanks to the great staff they helped us decide a great breakfast . Management came to every table to make sure everyone was happy. Food was fresh and delicious , the ice tea was amazing. We will make this our new breakfast spot. Keep up the great work, I hope your cafe stays for a very long time.

I was very happy with the parts sales and advice that I received.  If you're spending a couple hundred bucks it will be worth buying a membership.  Don't worry, they'll let you know.  You can buy discounted propane a couple days a week with it.  Yelpers are kinda mean in general, so here is 5 stars.

We come here about once a month, not as good today, I know it's not about the toast but it helps if they use a better grade instead of the really cheap stuff. Came back every where else was to busy. It has not improved any since the last time. The hash browns were very greasy, I dropped A little on my shirt and left a big grease mark I should be more careful. Probably will pass next time.

Has a drive thru whick is nice. Lady and man are very nice. Food is great. We love to be able to bring the food home. Just call ahead and order and go pick it up. Been going there for a while. Have went in. I have a wild child so they appeased him. I really like the people that work there. Hard to understand a touch but great people. Willing to work with you on your order. Tasty.

I think for those who have never actually had authentic Korean food but have only had "Food Truck" Korean or "Fusion" Korean, this place is probably amazing, but I didn't find the food very evocative of Korean flavors. The pulkogi was fine but not great, the chapchae was not flavorful, and the mandu was DEEPLY deep fried. I have to say that the kimchi was very good and very fresh. But beside the kimchi, the only real flavor came from the stuff they squirted on top, which wasn't really Korean at all. So don't get me wrong, if you like food truck food, if you like fusion Korean Food, this place is probably right up your alley, but if you're looking for authentic Korean fare, you may want to keep looking. Again, the food wasn't bad at all, but I was looking for authentic Korean.

I was pleasantly surprised at the quality and portion of the bowls. I ordered the chicken teriyaki for my wife and u gad the steak teriyaki, I am very picky about teriyaki sauce so I didn't have high hopes, again pleasantly surprised.  The sauce is not over powering, nor to weak, enough to feed two adults and the veggies were steamed to perfection. 
I give this place for stars, only reason it's not five stars, the tables were dirty, and some cheesy hand drawn signage promoting super bowl party platters were ugly. Ya I'm picky!
I was excited to try this place based on the reviews! The ice cream was okay. Not the best that I have had. And the prices were rather high! But, the inside of the store is cute!

My husband and I would like to say that we had a great experience at Camping World in Meridian.  From Todd, the salesman, to Donna, in finance, to Rob, who did our walk through.  We feel the entire transaction was handled with professionalism and the motorhome is exactly what we were looking for.

Nice place to catch a couple beers and a bite.  They have a 7 or so beers on tap and usually there is one or two that I haven't tried.  Wait staff is nice and friendly.  Food is actually very good.  Get a pizza and the Asian flavored wings (forgot the name on the menu).... The food here is good.   Note.. I was not a big fan of the jerked chicken.

Staff was very knowledgable with the beer selections   Food was sub par especially when compared to prior visits.  As noted in another post the menu has changed, but even the legacy items such as the wings were worse.  I think most of the issue was that they were room temperature.   something about this place had changed. I will have to try it one more time as it may have been just a bad day

I previously wrote up a bad review for 360 wireless. After being contacted by Tyler the manager I am now changing my review. Tyler personally has assured me that he is going to take care of my Iphone issue. Tyler also has apologized for my previous issues and the customer service.

I love this restaurant. Most everyone goes there for the buffet that is served all day, in fact, I am pretty sure that is what 90% of the customers get. The buffet is great. It has a wide variety of food, and for dinner they add crab legs and smoked pork and seeds. I think they have the best egg foo young in town. The prices are pretty darn good as well.

The bonus with this one is that it is still very new, so the restaurant itself is clean and nice, not like the typical worn out chinese restaurants you will find in the valley.

If you like chinese food, and want a good variety, give it a try. Especially if you have kids, as the buffet prices are great for kids.
Fast! Thanks! God bless! Made my quick trip way smoother! Literally 10 min away! Nice guy
My boyfriend and I absolutely love this place! Everything on the menu is amazing and I love that it's so healthy!

We have a men's group every Tuesday morning. Our waiter Rene is the best. The food is satisfactory a d priced well and they offer military discounts. The problem is that trying to pay a d leave sometimes takes 15 minutes. It is an extremely slow process. Why can't they let the waiters take our payment
Let's make this short and sweet. Awful customer and SUPER slow. Wouldn't recommend it to anyone.
Excellent service and the food was over the top delicious.  Kids meals are not so small which my lil guy likes.  We will be back!

From out of town. Went there on the advice from someone. Wished i would have checked out yelp. We eat at Chinese buffet where ever we go so we are pretty much experts in Chinese buffets. Food was decent but on the cold side. Plenty of selections. They do have a stir-fry grill and this is the first time ever they want you to separate the food for them to cook. No problem for whatever reason. Few different selections from the normal ones. Not sure if we would come back because we would try others in the area. Staff was very good and helpful. Kept my ice tea full without asking.
So yummy, so friendly, so unique. I love the CupBop staff and the warm atmosphere. Make sure to try the mandoo and tip them- they'll give you a lil extra!

After staying the night in Idaho, for breakfast my grandkids wanted to have some eggs "over easy."  We located this restaurant close by.  When we entered, we were warmly greeted and seated immediately.  The waiter came by, took our drink order, and was back before we knew it.  We placed our food order, which included lots of special requests.  We were pleasantly surprised.  Everything looked delicious and was cooked to order.  The portions were nice sized.  It has been years since I've been to a Denny's but this location turned out to be a good choice.  As we were leaving, the place was packed with lots of people waiting for tables.  We lucked out and went at a good time.

Cute shop, nice service, and it's so good. A new place for my daughter to beg me to do a drive by at on the way home from work. I'll have to try the stores one, on a day where I've only consumed 10 or so calories ;).

Well if you can get over all the rules and order without hesitation I am sure the food will be fine. We were met with two signs of instant complaints to customers from management.  Then upon ordering we were told to hurry.  My name was taken but when my smoothy was ready I was notified by someone calling out smoothy. Since I was the most recent customer I decided that was me.. 
Management may need to look at hiring young help that are jazzed to work. Decor may be reason prices are high and service is low.
The cook was very friendly and turned around the atmosphere but the only reason we saw her was because we ordered our food togo. Cashier handles cash and then handles food or makes coffee or bagels. 
Not impressed with high class attitude for low class service. And make sure if company has a meeting there to bring cash cause your not allowed to have water you must order a drink to stay. Fyi.

I always get takeout because it doesn't really seem like a dine in kind of place. The food is the best if you're looking for cheap and tasty Chinese takeout. Perfect for those Chinese cravings or a night watching movies with your friends. Best take out I've had in Boise.

Love, love, love this place! Friendly and helpful service, intimate atmosphere with a live instrumental band, yummy wines and absolutely delicious food! A bit on the spendy side so my Love and I go here on special occasions only and have dubbed it "our place".

Wonderful and authentic Ramen. The broth is delicious and don't be afraid to order the pork belly ramen. It's tender and so flavorful. We ordered the Tonkotsu Ramen and two different flavors of the the Veggie Ramen. All were delicious and filling. We will definitely be back!

We didn't want to drive very far as the weather was bad so we decided to try our new neighborhood restaurant International Express. The young man behind the counter was very nice and told us that his mother was the cook. When we heard that we had very high hopes that this would be an amazing meal. We waited about 10 minutes so that "mom" could make our meal from scratch. We ordered the mongolian beef on the recommendation  of the young man. When we got home and opened the boxes the chow main looked like spaghetti noodles and the meat was swimming in brown sauce. We still tried to stay hopeful but after about two bites we closed the boxes and didn't end up eating the rest. The rice was dry and the meat was bland and swimming in a gel type sauce. I really wanted to like this local place and but unfortunately we just won't be back.

What an amazing coffee shop. Great staff and amazing coffee and food. Coffee shop has free Wi Fi and has more than a couple outlets. Alot of their desserts and treats are made fresh. I am not a big salad fan but their salads are amazing. If you are in Meridian try it out you won't be dissatisfied.  The best part about this place is that it's locally owned and operated. We need to start supporting our locals and buying USA. Drive through is an added bonus.

This place is great!  Amazing food really nice staff.  The price is great. You get a lot of food for the price. To top it all off the food is actually healthy for you. I have gone back here a few time since my first visit.

This was my first time visiting and I heard good things so I was pretty excited to eat here. We got seated and had drinks served right away. Our waiter was fantastic. Where it went down hill is we waited 50 minutes for our food with little kids. By the time our food came out it was lukewarm and the crab Benedict was super fishy. Definitely will not be visiting this place anytime soon.

Yum! Clean, fast, friendly staff and delicious food! I'll be back! 
The turkey meatballs and chicken curry on basmati rice with all the toppings including black eyed peas and spicy sauce was delicious! And gluten free! I'm in!

Came here Sunday night. Seems like a slow night since only a four booths were filled. We ordered a two item sampler and one of their skillet special... we were patiently waiting for our order and we noticed that the servers would chat with each other any chance they get or strike up long conversations with other guests when other guests are still waiting to be served or waiting for a take out box just like the table next to us, one server was running around like a lost chicken, acting like she's busy. Long story short after 45 minutes I finally went up to check on my order and they "were just preparing it"... Anyway, we're not going back here. The people on the next table also acknowledge how long our order took and how the server seems to not have a system. I realize that this is a just another Denny's diner but unlike other Denny's diner this is the only one were I had a bad experience. Come here if you like waiting for 45mins for a simple order.

Absolutely love this place! The environment is different and sophisticated and the food is terrific. The staff is upbeat and friendly. We used to come for their calamari but they don't make it anymore! So sad!!!

I have never in my life received such atrocious service as I did last night when I went to the backstage bistro. For as dead as it was there is not excuse as to why  I had to give my order to the hostess,  not once did our server come ask what we had wanted, never once was my water refilled, never once was I asked how my meal was, which for the price I might add was mediocre. I had to track down the hostess again for my check because after sitting there twenty minutes after we were done with dinner it was beyond time to go. Unless management can find some better servers getting rid of Kristen would be there best option than I will not be returning to the backstage bistro EVER!!!!!!

Don't come here if you're in a hurry. I stop by sometimes on my lunch hour because they carry certain foods that fit into my restricted diet and Whole Foods is too far from my office. 

Every time I'm here I get so frustrated because there are no quick checkout lanes and there are too few checkout lines open, and cashiers seem to be required to spend 20 minutes chit-chatting with everyone who comes through their line. 

It would be really appreciated if some effort was made to accommodate people who don't have all day to spend leisurely shooting the breeze in the checkout line.

Boise finally has a dedicated ramen shop. When I went there on their opening day the place was packed and there was a line at the entrance. Obviously there's a desire for this type of place downtown.

I ordered the tonkatsu ramen which included a few strips of pork and half an egg in it.

I really liked the pork, the egg, and the broth. However, I didn't love the noodles themselves. I'll need to go to a ramen shop somewhere else to compare and be sure, but I almost felt like noodles were instant noodles and not fresh. I also thought the ratio of noodles to broth was a bit high. Next time I go in I'll probably ask for only half the amount of noodles.

There's still some growing pains and kinks to work out, but I'm excited to finally have a ramen shop downtown.

Took my family here prior to a movie since we had been here before. I asked how much time to be seated, response 15min. I say no problem and was put on the list, they were busy at 10am. I had my kids and wife  think about what they wanted to eat. The crowds start coming in and a lot of people waiting as well. We get inside and we sit down near the door still waiting to be seated. I understand if there is a party of two and they are filling spot. That is not the issue. 
There was a table seating next to the door and where the list was placed, it starts to open up. I check the list we are next. I waited for them to finish cleaning up knowing that we are next for us a party of 4. They proceed to ask for Mitch (this individual had a party of six) and was on the list under my name. They also brought 2 more chairs to fill that table. 
If you are going to use a list for seating at least adhere to the list and not some Weekend shifter letting his buddy's he knows skip the list. I saw him look at the list and then proceed to seat the party of 6. Not once did he or another call my name.
We left and will not be back, if service fails there at the door, food is not worth it. Unless you want the fresh squeezed OJ. Waffles, pancakes, eggs can be had anywhere else. I got better service at Carls Jr. down the road.
Great customer service! Everyone was very friendly and helpful. I will definitely be going back. It's a little far from where I live but I think the drive is worth it.

Great breakfast/lunch place. Always nice servers with fast, hot food. My only suggestion would be to add a sugar free creamer to your restaurant. These days many people can't have sugar or try to avoid it. Would like to be able to enjoy a coffee with my breakfast.

Not a good experience at all. This place needs acoustical panels in the ceiling because could not even hear the people at my table. The food was terrible. We had to wait almost a half hour to get it and all three of ours was very cold. Sent it back and had to wait another 20 min. Asked for a side of Hollandaise sauce. Again waited another 20 min. This was absolutely the worst hollandaise sauce I have ever eaten. I couldn't eat it. If you choose to eat at the Griddle only go to Eagle or Park Center. We were embarrassed because we took a guest here.
B2

This is a great place for Lunch.  I discovered this place from Yelp.  The waitresses were friendly, food was hot and yummy and I like the fact that I didn't need to hunt down my waitress for more coffee.   It looks like a lot of locals frequent this place as it was packed.  

I had the Chicken club with fries - Gluten free.  I can't wait to have breakfast there.  We'll be back for sure!

I purchased a trailer from the Camping World in Kaysville Utah and have had all of my service work performed by the store here. PJ who runs the store is very knowledgable and they have EVERYTHING you could ever want or need for your RV. Jason has always taken very good care of me in Service. I highly recommend these guys and will continue to use them and shop here.

Lunched with Dad here again today.  We ate here once before and couldn't figure out why there were so many cars in the parking lot.  A coupon got us to try it again.

We found that:
 - the fried shrimp were overly greasy
 - the egg foo young patties were extremely thin and flavorless
 - the peel & eat shrimp were small and overcooked

When we have all-you-can-eat Chinese on the mind, we'd much rather eat at City Buffet or China Grand.

Amazing that there are 3 reviews and then silence.  Well I am here to tell you that it's a great place to stop during your road trip wherever it's taking you. We were on a mission from St. Louis to Portland and this was our final stop before heading into my wonderful city.  

Pros:
Windows that open!!!!
Air control
Free breakfast (though it's not anything to wake up to unless you make one of those waffles!)
Quiet
Clean
Comfy bed/pillows
Free wifi and it was fast
Good shower (hate some of those save the water shower heads, you know the ones that feel like you are being sprayed with an air gun, not here)
Good customer service. Guess Erin wasn't there. Not like I'd give a 1 star for only that when my room was awesome.(See 1 of the 3 reviews here for more details) She even put us on the top floor. I mean that's only the 7th floor but more quiet that way.
Price was not cheap like a cheap hotel BUT, it was not overpriced either

Cons:
You are sitting in Mall land.. everywhere for miles around there are malls. Not the fault of the hotel so no foul no harm.

Called for a take out order we've done before with no problems. Nothing difficult. Said it would be 45 minutes to an hour? For take out? Guess they don't want my business anymore. Would it take that long in the restaurant?
This place is the place for a casual lunch or for to go. I try something new each time and have enjoyed it all! Very healthy and affordable. My kids love it and want to go all the time

My go to Froyo place. The most froyo flavors than any other place I've been to.  Couple that with their wide selection of toppings and free waffle cone/bowls, you've got a great spot to satisfy your froyo craving.
It's the only place I've found that has all of my ingredients.  Tarte froyo. Fresh kiwis and strawberries.  Granola without any sunflower seeds (it's happened before), and cheesecake bites. Yum!! I need some now. 

The only reason I didn't give 5 stars is because it's always super warm in there.

Breakfast was delicious, mimosas were strong, and the atmosphere was amazing. A little bit of a wait for a seat but the service was friendly and fast, we were visiting from out of state and will make it a point to come in again.

My favorite place to eat in Boise (or is it Meridian this far out?), hands down. I have tried each Momo variety, and all of them are delicious, though I usually go for veggie because I'm a wimpy hippie. I honestly can't think of anything on the menu that has been disappointing. The price is good for what you get, I usually pay somewhere between $17-$20 for both me and my boyfriend, depending on if we both get drinks. I'll be back again! And probably again... and again...

Delicious Korean-American bowls that are packed with tons of flavors and textures. I wouldn't call this food authentic, but it is delicious and a wonderful break from the basic food options in the Boise area. The vibe is a little weird/trendy, but the service is great and all the employees are super nice and helpful. 

*TIP- If you give them a tip at checkout then they will sometimes reward you with a side of potstickers for free. Free stuff is the best!

Clam atmosphere with groove jams loud enough to camouflage the slurps but quiet enough to still have conversation, family friendly- we will definitely come back- ordered spicy classic tonkotsu Ramen and veggie fried rice- DELICIOUS RAMEN GETS 5 out of 5!! The broth is full of flavor
Good ramen all the essential parts were there we had fast service  it was 1:30 on a wendsday. Good spicy tonkansu. And the fried chicken appitiser.id return for the miso based bowl next time

Are you a mom and/or housewife recently transplanted from California? 

Do you yearn for the company of other bored, disinteresting people such as yourself? 

Do you dream of consuming food so decadent, so astronomically high in calories that you'll look in the mirror each night wondering why your Juicy track pants don't fit the way they used to? 

If so, there's a seat with your name on it here at Corner Bakery. 
Welcome home to the rest of your life.
I was really impressed with their flavors and toppings - tasted delicious and fresh and there was a ton of variety.  The store itself was very clean as well

I have been there twice and don't get why people like it.  The burgers are soggy and the french fries are from Costco.  The milk shakes are not very good as well.   The signage in eagle road looks like an auto parts store.  Main Street Burgers are so much better,
I miss Ramen Sho too much! I would go there everyday if I lived in Boise. It's just too far away from Los Angeles... Great atmosphere, great food, great service. I'll be back!!!

When I first heard the name Yogurt and Grill didn't seem to go together.  I love Frozen Yogurt and so I gave them a try.
The Yogurt is great with tons of flavors and toppings.
But the HAMBURGERS are AMAZING!!
I will never go to a chain restraint to hamburgers again because this is my very favorite place for Hamburgers!  BRONCO BLUE BURGER is delicious...

Our experience with Muse was subpar at best. Let's start with the atmosphere, which is going to be the nicest part of my review. The restaurant is small and quaint and charming. Ok, now to the part that people actually care about. Our server was weird, and not quirky fun weird, but weird like "Go away and do something else" weird. He was constantly at our table interjecting our conversation and making us feel uncomfortable. I was with a friend I hadn't seen in a long time and his constant chatter and interruptions were rude and unwelcome. We were the only table in the restaurant at the time, so maybe he was bored, however as a server once myself I couldn't help but think, "don't you have side work to do?" or "can't you control yourself to not come over here every 5 minutes?" Ok, so get past the weird service and on to the menu. The menu was small and varied wildly; as our server pointed out, the menu selections are rotated every week. He compared Muse to another local restaurant, Le Coq Rouge, however in his comparisons he also spent several minutes bad mouthing Le Coq Rouge for their lack of a wine menu, prices etc, which I found in bad taste for a local restaurant to slander another local restaurant (on a side note I found the service, food and total experience at Le Coug Rouge to be 100% better than at Muse.) After his tactless ranting we decided on an appetizer, it was shrimp on skewers. I would say they were delicious and expensive and the portions very small, luckily they give you a free helping of bread at the table. Then we ordered entrees, I had the blue cheese raviolis and my friend had the monk fish. When the food came I was shocked, for a price tag of $15 I got four, yes four, small raviolis, oh and no side to speak of. Now I understand us Americans may dabble into portions that are too large, however four raviolis and no side is insulting to the customer and a waste of money. My entrée looked more like a small appetizer then a dinner. I do have to admit that they were very tasty, however defiantly not worth $15. The monk fish my friend ordered was also very small in portion and came with a side of three asparagus spears and some sort of potatoes. The potatoes was good, the fish seemed tough and flavorless. Our server compared the monk fish to lobster, only less expensive, I would like to say that the bite of the fish I had was nothing like lobster. So either the fish wasn't any good, or the description our server gave us was way off base. Lastly, we ordered desert. We had the Guinness cake. The cake was so terrible tasting that we ended up sending it back, even though, after our very limited portions, we were still quite hungry. Our server was very surprised that we didn't like the desert, but he did the right thing and took it off of our bill. Long story short;  atmosphere was good, service was annoying, food was expensive inappropriately proportioned and too expensive - and in the area of desert it was terrible.

On a positive the homemade jam is excellent. We were very disappointed with the service we received from Ash. Her bad day really ruined our experience with the Restaurant. Thinks got off on the wrong foot from the start even with a service of our drinks then when we showed her our coupon for the from Yelp she took our check and was very upset about it. Far as the food I would say this is the best in town but I think because of the service it really ruined our expectation of what we 8. The tree sale and the corn beef were really good outside of that everything else was average.

My wife and I walked in at around 9:30 on a Friday night.  We are from out of town and happened to see an ad in the local paper.  We were seated immediately in their elegantly intimate dining room.  The server explained the chef's specials of the night and recommended the scallops.  We ordered salads and entrees, including the scallop dish.  While waiting, we were served a home made bread which was lightly flavored with rosemary......delicious.  We ordered wine by the glass from a well thought out list.   The scallops were spectacular!  We asked to see the chef to offer our thanks.  We topped the evening off with a shared portion of a house made ice cream.  

All in all, we could not have asked for more.  Everthing was delicious and well presented and served.  Prices are very very reasonable given the quality of the food and surroundings.

This is a great date or special occasion restaurant but reasonable enough to enjoy anytime you want to eat well!  We will visit whenever we are in town.

The food was good overall, the pork had great texture and flavor and the rice wasn't to dry or mushy. It's exactly what I'd expect from a moderately priced Korean restaurant.
  Most of the tables and floors were dirty. We had to wait about 6 to 7 minutes before we were noticed by the staff, but the woman who served me apologized profusely and gave my party of two free drinks as well as free dumplings upon our departure.
  If you're in the area and craving some big portions of Korean BBQ in a cup for a great price, then I'd recommend Cupbop!

  Child size, Vegan, Kosher, and Gluten Free options are available.
Nice location in downtown Boise on the second floor. Gyoza was delicious, so was the ramen. Restaurant is moving location to Meridian. They have a food truck On Broadway

Great place love the food!  My only complaint is when I pay 8 dollars for a Reuben it better have some meat on it.  If you wanna sell a premium product it better have the value in it and I feel it just doesn't.  Where's the beef?

I love their Pizza By The Slice. It has a crispy crust that you fold to eat. That's an absolute MUST. A perfect blend on the sauce. 

If you can plan around the high school lunch times, take the drive thru and you will have a piping hot pizza slice in minutes.

So why not five stars? Their sausage sub is amazing in flavor...except the outer casing is so tough you can't chew it and if you try to swallow it, you can choke on it. I brought it to the staff's attention, but I was met with a shrug. I demonstrated how tough it was by stretching it in and out without breaking -like trying to eat a rubber band. But what do you expect from a 19 year old who could care less?

Hey, owner - how hard would it be to pull off the the outer casing before slicing up the sausage for your sub?

I will go here when I have a "little slice of heaven" craving but at $9 for a tough as rubber sub, I will pass.
Tasty fast food option that is rarely seen, with reasonable prices. Very helpful staff. Perfect if you're looking for something other than burgers or bad tacos, especially while on the road.

Fantastic groomer! Love that each grooming appointment is scheduled for one on one time with the pups. Also appreciated that Sam called me to discuss some options with my older cavalier due to some uneven spots in her hair. Great prices, great communication, and beautiful grooming job!
Outstanding location to have a pint, grab a growler or six-pack, and enjoy a pizza. The selection of beers is ever-changing and has something for any beer drinker

***three star casual dining***
Other than food taking a long time to arrive just above cold, it was pretty nice. Our server was very personable, but her helpers kept trying to rush us off by pre-bussing our plates that still had quite a bit of food on them. It took 30min for 5 appetizers to appear (which weren't creative genius) after ordering. Since they took their sweet time getting the food there- aren't we allowed at least as much time to consume them? Sure it was busy- but that's what the biz looks like properly running! I wonder if they just don't have enough dishes to serve food on? Anyway, the wine was very good. :-)

I'm not sure why there are two business entries for TCBY with the same address.  But regardless, this is the place that my family loves to go to for an evening snack in the summer.  We have been going here for years.  TCBY is indeed the Country's Best, and they always have super friendly folks there providing service.  We just love it!


[  Mom: "I need a starch, or else I won't stop eating"
Dad: "When I eat, I always like to have a starch, and then I have a finich" ]

Came with a party of 13 plus an infant. Once seated the service for drinks and taking orders was fast and courteous. Considering the size of the order the food came out really fast. I ordered the biscuits and gravy. The sausage gravy tastes like a powdered mix and was really bland. Also the food prices seem to reflect the popularity, where the more popular dishes cost more, but would appear that is where the company cuts corners on quality. I think the price was decent considering and would like to come back to try some of the not so popular items.

Absolutely a scam! I cannot believe I thought the smooth talking salesman knew what he was talking about! Pre made hard inserts! A piece of plastic worth about a buck!  Assured they would get more comfortable if I wore a bit longer each day. Terrible pain that got worse by the minute. Exchanged 3 times and finally gave up! The "nice" salesman refused to return my money. In store credit where one can buy tennis shoes there most likely worth $20 for $135.00!!!  Go to a reputable store this one is not! Please stay away there are many stores that treat foot pain that are knowledgeable. This one is not!!

Javier helped me out and had my phone done within an hour and a half. Great service and I'm really impressed with the work he did on my phone. It looks brand new and it was only $95. I highly recommend this place if you need your phone repaired for an affordable price! They have a bunch of accessories for phones too for reasonable prices. Good experience! Thanks again!
Really bad buffet. Everything was either out or tasted like it had been sitting there for 8 hours. Holy mother Mary what a bad bad day to have been in the mood for Chinese

I stopped in for a couple slices from the walk up window and was impressed with the quick service despite the drive-through line being busy. 
One bite, it's a pretty decent crisp crust without much dough flavor. Really tasty pepperoni with nice spice to it. Buffalo chicken wasn't my favorite-I would've liked more hot sauce and some blue cheese crumble or a drizzle of blue cheese dressing. I didn't care for the ranch-it tasted just like hidden Valley from the grocery store. All in all, anice slice of New York style pizza and I'll definitely be back when I'm in the neighborhood. 7.1

Subpar food, TERRIBLE service. We ordered food to go for the first time tonight.  We are new to the area. I paid $60 for this food and I only got half of what I ordered.  I guess I ordered 2 things they do not carry so instead of telling me that they just didn't put one order and the other they gave me something totally different. For the ribbs they gave me different ribbs. When we called to fix it I was first  told they would not help me at all. After waiting forever a "manager" got on and said I would have to pay for it to he changed even if I brought back the wrong food. Then I was told I was a liar and that it was the food I ordered. And that she wouldn't help me at all and hung up on me. What type of restaurant talks to customers like that?  I guess I should not be surprised,  when I asked if there were sauces in the box she said she had put ketchup packets in it. I will never eat there again and neither should you!

Lunch was great!  New favorite sandwich is the golden gate.  It is served warm on a grilled sourdough bread with a grated Asiago cheese and lightly dashed with dried jalapeño.  It turns this TurkeyBacon avocado club into a mouth watering masterpiece!  Treat yourself to the freshly squeezed OJ.
I had a really dirty muddy truck and they made it sparkle!  Thanks so much. I will tell my friends this is the place to come.

I have taken my Mac and my son's Alienware here. Great service and great people to work with. Always fair and willing to take the time to make sure I understand what could be done to address the issues and how I could do things differently to avoid future problems.

Stopped here first when I had missed lunch about 3pm and had fried green tomatoes and they were to die for ( to much for an appetizer) but took the rest to hotel and they even reheated wonderful. Came  back the next night for dinner. I ordered the rib steak with corn pudding, mashed potatoes, and a wedge salad.Their timing is really off. Had one bite of my salad and my steak came out. Steak was average a little tough for a rib steak. May come back for lunch but not for dinner. I told the server to let chef know. They don't seem to care a out repeat busines. Didn't even ask if I wanted desert. Oh well many more restaurants in Boise.

I am not a big fan of Indian food but the MOMO may have changed my mind!   This place is very good and you can see why all of the reviews are so positive. 
The food has great flavor and you can't beat the price!
Good coffee. My favorite would have to absolutely be their blended Java Chip. All the chocolate chunks give it texture, and the three shots of espresso gives you a little kick for the day.(:

It's great to see team work, however our service from Avery ?? was horrible. Other patrons received information on specials we were just asked what we wanted. Very disappointing that I had to ask about them. 
Guess it will be our last visit there.
Just OK and not nearly as good nor as filling as Zupas or Panera. I won't go here again.

Sorry, what can I say, this place is nasty.  The food is not delicious at all.  The only thing that is okay is the noodles that they make for you on the spot.  Otherwise, this is overpriced and nasty.
Clean, tasty, polite. Visiting from Tacoma, Wa

They're pretty busy with the high school crowd during their lunch roughly 10:58 to 11:32 am.  This is why I went at about 2:30pm.  There were only 3 people there when I showed up.  Service was fast and friendly, and I even got to talk to the owner a bit.  The pizza transported me back to my college days in the 90's.  Thin crust with yummy sauce and excellent cheese.  It reminded me of hot lips pizza in Portland, Or.

This place is awesome great food and great staff, especially peanut she always makes the place shine with her upbeat attitude. I never can pick what I want to eat and this is the only place I have that problem!!

Victory Greens has a lot of eye candy to look at. The staff have always been helpful...especially Vickie who is a hoot. She gave us lots of good ideas.
However, I think that their items are way overpriced. Most little trees we looked at cost $350. Add to that planting fee: 1/2 the price of the tree, and delivery $75 and your tree now costs $600. My thumb is too brown to take a chance on a $600 tree.

The staff are what made this stay so welcoming and warm. Thank you for being so accommodating, prompt and professional. It's hard when I have to be away from my family, but Sami made me feel at home. The housekeeping staff( Paul) among others were meticulous and made sure that my room was beautifully  kept every single day. I wish all of my stays while out of town were more like this, they did a great job to make me feel at home.
Dine in serves half the portions of take out. Good fried rice, generals chicken, chow mein.  Pork and seeds are inedible.

Stopped in at 6 am this morning for their very reasonably priced Value Slam - one of my fav's!  Must have been a new or beginning cook.  Grill obviously too hot and the breakfast showed it. I'm surprised that they served it.
Really good ice cream! Very creamy and unique flavors you won't find at other places.

Tim from Victory Greens was amazing! After a bit of confusion on my stone order, he did what he promised and delivered. Without a doubt this nursery and stone yard is top notch and puts customers first.

Okay when they first came to Boise they were at 5th and Jefferson beside the Health and Welfare building. The first time I ate there I met the owners they were super super nice and made sure that the bowl was made correctly with plenty of meat and done right. Unfortunately they have gone downhill quickly. When the opener brick-and-mortar building is when things really started to go bad. They have a manager there name Sophia or Sophie or some weird name and she's probably 18 20 years old very opinionated and has no idea how to handle customers. She does not have life experience managed correctly. I went into their brick-and-mortar place the other day Not only was it filthy inside but there was no one there except a couple of people in back, and took them forever to come out. The guy might have been knew I don't know but he was confused and didn't know how to react when I asked him to only put rice and then all three meats on top. I've been going to cupbop since they opened in Boise have never been charged over $9 and some change for my bowl. This time they wanted me to pay 12 bucks and said that it's always been that way they charged me for extra meat which was only one extra scooping of one meat I had three. Will I asked to speak to the manager she came out with an attitude immediately already increasing the tension of a situation. So instead of arguing with her I asked her for the owner's phone number. She gave me a number and I repeat that number to her twice and she said that's the right number. Well it was not the right number, when I called her back she immediately had a attitude and said she gave me the right number for a fact!! that she could not have made a mistake. When I ask her for the number this time she gave me a different number so I called it. I've left three messages and have not received a call back or even an acknowledgement. So long story I know made short.. I will not be going back to Cupbop they are the true epitome of bait and switch. They start out all fluffy and nice and give you everything you ask for at a certain price and then change the price up on you and the value and quality of the food goes down price goes up. There's an old saying in business, do a job they well till three of their friends, but if you screw them they're going to tell everyone . Anyway the food was pretty good but has gone downhill quite a bit. But the service is absolutely terrible and the owners don't care if you have a good meal or have a bad service or not

Really easy drive up for some great tasting coffee. I would say for Meridian it's some of the best. I ordered a FLAT WHITE and it was made hot and tastey.  The barista didnt ask me what I'm doing today or what my plans are like some drive ups.  It looks like a clean large new workspace so im sure the staff is loving it. Oh, and the music wasnt blaring like some drive ups...The only  reason I can't give five stars is because if I drive to Boise I can get third wave coffee that is phenomenal. Good job Human Bean, I will return often!

I love the custard concretes at Freddys on Eagle. So when I saw that Sonic decided to put them on the menu, I had to try it. 

Frozen Custard is soooo good. It is way better than regular ice cream. If you have not tried it you need it. But I would not waste my time with Sonics version of it. 

I dont think Sonic is using real frozen custard. It taste nothing like Freddy's. I would be willing to bet that Sonic is using Ice Cream and not Custard. Or if they are using custard, its probably a mix of ice Cream and Custard, or something else like that.  And not even a good quality Ice Cream.

If you want to try some good Frozen Custard, dont waste your money at Sonic. Go to Freddy's!
Love it here! I always get the Caribbean French Toast and it's always fantastic! How do they do it?

Ordered breakfast on our first visit. Scrambled eggs and bacon were ok but the potatoes were dry and tasteless and the toast was just stale bread heated up. The coffee was a huge disappointment - watery and tasted nasty. Service was about a C minus. Won't be returning.

Oh my gosh SO GOOD! The pizza is huge and a great price. I called ahead and picked it up through the drive through and the girls working were very friendly. I can't wait to skip making dinner and order delicious pizza again!

Best Ramen in town, you have to try them all, I had the Miso Ramen and loved it
My best experience In Idaho

Ordered combo bowl from their food truck at BSU, which is a double protein rice bowl. Total cost was almost $10. Most of the bowl consisted of cheap starch fillers, white rice and sweet potato glass noodles. The latter are just sweet potato starch and water noodles, don't be swayed into thinking it's some fancy ingredient. This day they were out of cabbage, so it was a thin layer of cheap iceberg lettuce. The protein was decent, but expected marinated, charred/grilled traditional Korean chicken bbq and this is not that. Overall, for almost $10, it is not worth it at all. It only would be if they added more premium veggies like bok choy, shredded carrots, etc. or had a hardier portion of protein. Pass on this one!

After seeing many neighbor recommendations, we tried it today. Very disappointed.  While the decor and ambience were lovely, unfortunately the food did not meet expectations. My coffee was lukewarm and apparently was the end of the pot, all burnt and stale. Also, no refills. I realize they are a Java shop but no refill on a $2.00 cup of joe is a bit much, especially since it was cold. They were out of croissants for the sandwich I ordered, so they said they would substitute an everything bagel which I said was fine, but ended up receiving an onion bagel instead. Not a huge deal, but didn't expect this. My husbands order was messed up in that they did not include cheese in the eggs as per the recipe on the board. Guess it may have been an off day for them, but not impressed and won't be back.

The main reason why my husband and I will be downtown more often! This is the second visit, both times the ramen was perfect! I had the spicy tonkotsu and my husband had the non-spicy version both visits. I got "medium" spice both times, and I wouldn't be able to handle any hotter!be sure to add an extra egg, worth it! First visit we had the fried egg rolls (no picture) which you can't go wrong with. This time we had the fried gyoza (5 piece). Both would get again. Can't wait to go back!! Yay for Ramen Sho! 

Adding pictures, have been here six times now. We're obsessed! Every time has been amazing. 

12/16/17 Tried the Karaage, fried chicken. The sauce that it is served with is so good! Chicken was cooked perfectly, too. 

My new favorite is the Tan Tan Ramen which includes a spicy ground pork as the meat. Delicious!!! Also had the Tako Yaki, battered/fried diced octopus. Amazing!!
Awesome friendly service, warm inviting atmosphere, and pancakes OVER 1 INCH THICK!!! What's not to love?
Messier than most Dennys I've been to and the order was messed up and the food was super salty. I mean you know what you get but still...wasn't a good experience.
They have the  best waiters and best service. And the food is great and Terry is the greatest waiter and they have the best crew ever

This is come-to place for yogurt. We love the flavors and the abundance of toppings! I recently visited there with my daughter now that it's a grill. I ordered the grilled chicken avocado wrap, and to my surprise, it was really delicious! You get it a choice of three different flavors of tortilla and they press it on a panini type grill so that the tortilla is crispy, but the vegetables inside are cool and crisp. Next time we come we will try the Angus burgers and I will write a separate review on that, but so far so good!

This was our first time here and it was fantastic. Great service great southern fusion food. Must try the fried green tomatoes, they are amazing. The staff was very friendly. Come on down to the Barnyard.

Pretty good. I was born and raised in Hawaii, so when I pulled up and DID NOT see "Hawaiian Pizza" (which by the way, we do not eat pizza with pineapples on them) I was already a fan. So thank you Johnny Bronx! Their pizza taste like a pizza place in Hawaii Called "Boston's" and I LOVE IT. Will be back here soon.
Very basic 'starbucks'. They have a couple tables but they only sit 2/3 people. They do have a couple big chairs that you can hang in (where im at lol) all the baristas were real nice!

Brought my trailer in for repairs. I asked how much each item would cost, the salesman told the price. When I went to pick up my trailer the price was way higher than expected, so I asked why they said labor. So I guess when you ask how much something is to repair they don't understand basic English.
I have never had Himalaya food before but decided to give it a try. Great service, food was really fresh. The dumplings were great and the spicey potatoes were fantastic.

Had lunch everything we had was very good. My wife had the Butcher Block fries and she really like them, Their version of poutine fries. I had the barnyard burger and fries it was excellent. Only complaint would be the smoked pork belly ingredient was bacon. I know bacon is smoked pork belly I was hoping for a hot smoked thicker slice but it was bacon so how can I complain. Daughter in law had brisket sandwich and son had BBQ combo. Both enjoyed and finished them off. We will return.

Amazing ice cream!!!! It's so creamy and delicious, only reason I don't give it five stars is the lack of toppings to add to the ice cream, maybe that's just how they want their business but I really enjoy some good chocolate sauce or caramel on such an amazing cup of ice cream.

Addicting - twice a week minimum. Hot bop or ugly bop are a must try. Get it to go and shake it to mix all the sauce up perfectly. Level 7 sauce is what I go with on both, sweet and spicy. Super fast for lunch too.

Went to Terry's for lunch because they have great coffee, I ordered a burger and hash browns, wife ordered eggs and hash browns. Something was wrong with my burger it just wasn't right not sure what is was, I told my wife somethings weird with my burger didn't taste right. I got half the burger down set it down and quit eating my hash browns too and went back to my coffee. I told my wife somethings wrong with my food, she said her eggs were OK but hash browns weren't crispy as she requested instead almost uncooked, we realized our food was half cooked, my burger patty was raw in the middle and hash browns were not cooked long enough. I don't complain about food or send it back and don't enjoy the company of people that do that either,  I'll go back because of the great coffee but will order foods usually not stored frozen like eggs, bacon, English muffins, its just hard to find a place that serves great coffee and Steve's now Terry's has great coffee now needs to work on serving great food.
 Update: Terry's doing better so I upgraded them to 4 stars, great food, GREAT COFFEE!

This could be the best Ramen on the planet. But I wouldn't know since after 15 minutes of sitting at our table without seeing a server, we left. We were never even given water. There were also several flies inside the restaurant and the glass on the table was dirty. Hard pass on this one.
Not my favorite place,  not a very friendly staff (Billy) no lotion, no oil, incomplete process for gel nails.

I enjoy spending time at this Lucky Perk, often I'll either do homework or waste time. The space feels nice and there is usually plenty of seating.
The reason I am giving three out of five stars is due to the inconsistency of service and drink quality. Depending on the barista, you will either get great service or, like one of the reviews mentioned, a watered down drink.
Still a great place to hangout, I just hope they can fix the consistency issue soon.

We sat and waited for a table for at least 15 minutes.  During our wait a table right on front of us was empty,  bused and set.  A larger group of 6 or so came in and got sat ahead of us. We were expecting to be next,  but the waiter seating people left and was working their tables.  We left.  We never expect good service here,  but that was the limit.
Absolute dumbest staff I have ever been helped by. Nobody knows what they are doing. This place needs to hire all new girls. Great food and yogurt but I will not be back by any means.

I have been going to Yokozuna Teriyaki for a couple of years now.  They have amazing rice bowls.  I typically call my order in and it is always ready and hot when I get there.  I have tried several different menu items and have enjoyed everything.  I love that it makes an easy take out dinner, but they also have a seating area for dinning in.  Great staff, amazing food!!!

I have been here for hair services and facials, and I have always had a great experience! Katrina does an amazing job with my hair! I love that she takes her time, is personable, and very friendly! I also like being greeted as soon as I walk in the door. I have nothing bad to say about this salon I will continue to come here

I've never been impressed with this nursery. By default of distance from my home has been the only reason I've gone here. After this morning, I won't even make an exception. The manager in the front is not pleasant to speak with. I stopped by at 730.  I drove in because the fence was open and I didn't know the hours. He was standing there looking through some papers.  He glanced at me and said they didn't open until 8 and didn't even care to speak with or help me.  Horrible customer service. Not the first time I've had an unpleasant experience from this nursery.

Loved this place! Had the Sockeye sweet wheat beer and Rome craft bread. All was delicious! Was trivia night and still fun even though my team came in last "/. They  have board games available for play as well. Two complaints; no wine and was a bit chilly from the AC. I'll definitely be back as the Sweet Wheat beer made up for no wine and next time I suppose I'll just have to wear pants.

We've eaten here on a number of occasions and have always felt like it's decent but not amazing. The daily special, which never changes, is a staple for us and is a really good value for the money. It's not fancy and the service can seem less than professional but hey the food is actually good. Not a date place but when I want to order something other than pizza for dinner this gets my vote.

Updated review: i appreciated the offer from Matt the manager though I didn't take him up on it. However my wife and I did go back and had a terrific meal. I still think there are better spots but you won't be disappointed if you eat there before a movie; it is super convenient.  Try the burgers, they are really tasty.

Food is tasty, but it takes too long to be served. 
Dinnerware needs to be updated, some bowls and cups are chipped, which may absorb bacteria. 
Definitely not my first choice in the downtown Meridian area.
My wife went in with a specific coupon for thighs and drumsticks only. When she got home it had 2 thighs, 4 wings, and 4 drumsticks. I tried calling and no one would speak with me. Very disappointed.

Wow! Ramen Sho is a must try. If you've ever or never had Ramen, you need to try it because it's the best we've had in the area. Great flavor, great service and super cool atmosphere. We will be back many times over!
Gabriel did a great job on our laundry room project! He took down old wallpaper, painted and installed wood floors. I would recommend him for any home project!
My boyfriend being from West LA is spoiled.  For him, this ramen is surprisingly good for Boise.  I thoroughly enjoyed it as well.  We will definitely be back.

Fun place! We love that downtown Meridian is growing its small businesses. Frankie's Java has good food and fun coffee; although the coffee snobs in us wish it was stronger. We will return often and love that we get to share the experience with our kids.

Being a native New Yorker (upstate fine but still on point pizza), I'm pretty skeptical of new entrants into the market but alas, these guys are ON POINT! I was out of the country while the drama of their opening was unfolding but my first day back had to include a stop to see what all the fuss was about. Me and the boy headed off to pick up a whole pie for dinner, but we couldn't resist a cheese slice at the counter to taste test. Yeah, it's legitimately on par with what you can get back east. Crust is airy but has that nice crunch to it. Sauce and cheese are perfectly balanced. Chatted with the owner a bit who was super excited and passionate about what they're doing...he told us they spent 2.5 years working on the concept! Bottom line...if you are a fan of New York pizza, this is a must!
Super service and great atmosphere. Free wifi. It's like a coffee shop except the coffee is beer and the pastries are personal gourmet pizzas.

Went to Terri's because its a nice place plus has fabulous coffee, its hard to find an eatery that has great coffee, we ordered coffee and lunch, for me a burger and hash browns, wife ordered eggs and hash browns. Something was wrong with my burger didn't taste good, I ate a few bites then went back to coffee. I asked my wife how her food was her eggs good but hash browns weren't crispy as requested not cooked long enough, we realized the food we ordered likely stocked frozen, my burger patty cooked around the edges but pink in the middle next time I'll emphasis 'well done'. You know most folk that come in this place aren't in a rush, Terri's a happy scene and l don't want to complain and send food back because of a dumb hamburger everybody's working hard I know. I'll go back because the coffee is fantastic but might order food not stored frozen like eggs, bacon, muffins, hot oatmeal. It's hard to find a restaurant that serves great coffee and I'll go back, and if the situation is for the guys in the back having to rush then getting the grill hotter might work since things they cook for breakfast and lunch could handle a really hot grill they promise good breakfast, sandwiches, salads, waffles, you know the basics its not French cuisine but if there is a decision needed between waiting longer for an order OR getting food out fast we'll nurse our great coffee and happily wait for it!

What a gorgeous new location!  (Old one's still there... but this one is spectacular!)  In addition to plenty of natural light and plenty of space to move around, this one even features a demo kitchen where they'll hold classes & such.

Prepared foods include salads, sandwiches, pizza, soups and a full salad bar.  {My favorite is the chicken salad sandwich on ciabatta.}  Great seafood and meat counter.  Lots of helpful staff, too.

Went in here recently to have my computer checked out. They were super friendly and gave honest advice after looking. I never go to Geek Squad ever since they completely botched up a few years ago with me. The Office Depot location I usually go to is no longer there so I was glad to find that these guys were just as nice and equally honest. They offered several ideas for how to fix my computer and most of which wouldn't cost anything. Didn't charge to take a look. I will go again if I have issues in the future.
Over cooked, dry and tuff BBQ chicken. Fried chicken did not have any spices , herbs, salt or pepper. Side dishes were good but not good enough to try this place again!

15 of us met here for brunch. I had the almond-crusted french toast and it was to die for! The kids loved the OJ machine, and everyone seemed to love what they ordered. Fun, casual atmosphere while feeling far nicer than a chain breakfast place. The only downside is that service was quite slow despite the restaurant being mostly empty.
First time taking our cat in. Great experience! They took there time! She looks amazing!

The challenge with a 4/5 star system is there's no 4.5 option, which Terry's solid rating should be. 
I'm dropping half a star because the decor needs to be... refreshed, let's say. But the place is clean, the staff is exceptional and the food is tasty. One of the best breakfast places in town, and there aren't many. 
Sunday's are pretty busy. But it's worth the way. Will be back!

We hard a large group today. The service was EXCELLENT, the food was hot and tasty and best of all my coffee cup never went dry. Who ever was in charge today should be commended. The staff worked well together and all seemed happy. I look forward to coming back to The Griddle real soon.

The BEST brisket sandwich and duck fat french fries and under $10!  That's lunch. Their dinners are great also. They bake their own bread and make all their own desserts including the salted caramel ice cream.

Will do business with these guys at the drop of a hat. They came through with flying colors. It didn't all start out smooth, I was at another store and had the LCD replaced on my SG Note3. When I got my phone back, the button to start the screen was loose and the guys didn't know how to repair it. They referred me over to the Meridian store where their specialist, Hung, looked it over and made some command decisions. The LCD screen was replaced again at their expense and the button I was concerned about  was working as it should. The story doesn't end there though. When I had brought it back the first time and Hung went to open it up, a part inside snagged and took out other pertinent parts (think motherboard) and things rapidly declined. The manager/ sales rep had to come and tell me that I was not going to get my phone back in another ten minutes (though he didn't say it like that). He was very apologetic and, having been in business for the past 25 years, I know that sometimes things happen. I left that day without my phone but assured that all would be taken care of and when I got it back it would be as brand new with Verizon parts and all. 

Hung placed a priority on the phone being fixed and after having to rush a motherboard or whatever the part was and to upload all of my files, by noon the next day my phone was once again, perfect.

Sometimes things don't always go well and people don't understand the complexities that come along with a process...such as the techie phones we all carry. I would say to the consumer who is at a huge loss because their phone is down, take it to the 360 Wireless store in Meridian and breathe...let them do their thing and don't get all flustered. Things don't always go perfect the first time and the truth of the matter is that instead of getting angry with them, take better care to not have to visit them in the first place. Since I got my phone back I have accidentally dropped it two more times...Luckily Hung and the manager/sales rep had given me a screen protector for the inconvenience of coming back and forth and thoughtfully suggested the Otter box. That alone has possibly saved me over $500.  Thanks Hung and manager/sales rep guy (sorry I didn't get your name). - Jeff

So rude! My daughter asked the male nail technician to fill her nails and polish the same. When he said he was done. We asked for the glitter that she had before to be applied bc that's what we asked for. He gave us an attitude and AGGRESSIVELY handled her nails and shook his head the whole time. Will never go back!
Everything was amazing! My husband had the tonkatsu ramen & I had the soy sauce ramen. We got a side of gyoza. It was perfect for a cold day!
Very disappointed yesterday. I order a 12 piece, get to the window and the gal says we won't have any chicken for 25 minutes...at 6pm??? Wow, talking about not ready for your busy time...
Really nice little ramen shop. Great atmosphere and service. Egg was a bit over cooked but overall great food. Must try.

Exceptional coffees and atmosphere. Locally owned with very friendly staff. My 4 year old daughter loves their hot chocolate. They also have free wi-fi which is great. Plenty of space for meeting or working while you enjoy coffee. One of my favorites is their breakfast sandwich and the Mango smoothies.
