They've also just started serving wine and have live music on the weekends. My favorite coffee shop in Meridian.
This place was phenomenal. Different from other restaurants in the are. Will definitely be coming back for the delicious food!

Historically I've been very pleased but man the last two visits have been a disaster! Last time resulted in several huge scratches on my nav screen...to their credit they owned up to it, offered to pay to replace it and gave me several gift certificates to compensate. It was fine. It happens. So today I go to redeem one of the certificates and everything looks fine but as I drive away I realize there's a part from my car sitting in the cup holder...wtf!? No one said anything so guess I'll try and figure out where the part belongs. Might need to find a new car wash place!

Prompt response, friendly, and professional. Also, not overpriced.  I had my guest bathroom's door locked, and the door handle was being unscrewed. The latch fell on other side of the bathroom. My husband & me were trying to open it by watching YouTube. It was a fail attempts, and we were concerned that we might have to replaced the door, due to possibility the lock area had to be drilled.  We called other locksmith & consult the situation, and the person on the other side was thinking about the same possibility, but only could come in a day after appointment. 
So, I searched for other Locksmith & James picked up the phone & was responding quickly, abled to come in and fixed the door in just few seconds without ruining my bathroom door.
We are super happy with the service.  
I highly recommended this Locksmith.

So I will preface this review with this: I cook a lot because I am allergic to a lot of things (leaky gut drama), and when I cook I value top quality produce and selection in organic items and pastured/grassfed meats (pay the farm or pay the pharm). Oh, and I need this place to be easy to get to because there can be fatigue in the healing process for real. Boise Co-Op Meridian has IT ALL!

Not only is the food selection great, but they have an amazing supplement section with extremely knowledgeable staff. Trust me, I know. 

Awesome bonus?? Notice they are missing your favorite brand of something? You can submit a request for them to stock that item!!

What they have: bone broth, pastured local eggs, grassfed beef, organic chicken, olives, BULK items like spices - they even have cool stuff in the bulk section like clay (for you all making toothpowder and whatnot), and bulk teas (even Essiac), lots of dark chocolate (tho I wish they had more super dark *submits request form*), fermented pickled EVERYTHING (if your gut can tolerate that) and plenty of asian selections including Mae Ploy curry paste (because come on, if we are gonna do Thai at home, you gotta have the real stuff). I'm not even mentioning the fact that they make smoothies and have a little cafe here. And I'm not even mentioning the wine selection. 

Anyway, this place is worth a stop whether you are a member or not.
The oil change and overall car care was amazing.  Courteous staff did excellent work from greeting to exit.  Absolutely blew me away.  Forget about doing it yourself or going to discount shops.

Really good Ramen, good service and they were great with my kid.  I got the standard ramen and my husband got the vegetarian.  1 star off because we also got pork buns and they were tough and chewy, obviously reheated.

I came in and placed an order to go. Service was fast and efficient. I ordered the curry tonkotsu and my wife ordered spicy miso ramen. Both were packed with flavor and were delicious! This was my first visit and I will definitely be back for many more to try all the varieties they offer.

Gabe's work on our barn was excellent. We couldn't be happier with the results. All the work was done efficiently and in a timely manner, impressive for such a big project. The job included: replacing walls, fixing supports, fixing the roof, new doors, painting and more.
Delicious pizza in a cone! I tried the meat lovers, and it was great. Absolutely love the dessert cone options  too! Great location and close to other places.
We love this place for dessert! But.... they are great for breakfast too!! We don't have anything but fast food near chinden and Linder for good sit down breakfast! Try this place! Delish

I went for lunch on opening day and got the soy sauce ramen. I enjoyed the noodles, but something about the broth didn't sit well. I tried my friend's Tonkotsu and liked the flavor of that one more, but I was expecting more broth and the ginger was a little too strong. Opening day was kind of crazy, but the servers were pretty cool about it and offered complimentary snacks and soda. I'm interested in coming back and trying out the Miso flavor.

Yokozuna is a great spot to grab a quick rice bowl, noodles or salad without dropping half your paycheck. With lots of options to choose from and fast service, this place will have your tummy happy and you'll be on your way in no time. 

Food: The rice bowls and yakisoba noodles are very good. I typically opt for a bowl with all veggies & no rice, and it's only a slight-upcharge for the extra veggies. The chicken is our favorite protein on the menu, though sometimes it's a little overcooked (hence the 3-stars)... but since the teriyaki flavor is spot-on, I try not to complain. My only wish for their menu is that they had more sauce options other than teriyaki. I'd love to see a peanut / ginger / other option to add to the dishes. 

Drinks: Serve yourself soda fountain.

Atmosphere: It's a small joint, so don't expect anything fancy (hence the 3-stars). We usually take our meals to go and enjoy them at home! 

Service: Fast! Very accommodating to special menu requests.

Happy Hour Offerings: n/a

Healthy Hack: Go for a chicken or salmon bowl with all veggies, no rice. I also get my sauce on the side! 

Tips: Sauce on the side! Mix the teriyaki with the chili paste & sriracha they have on their little side table. Such a good combo!
Not impressed with breakfast. The food and coffee was comparable to a fast food place. Not likely to return or recommend to others.

No matter what my most current dietary needs are, I can always find what I need at the Boise Co-OP.   I've been going to the one on Eagle Rd. in the last few years but still drop in at the smaller one in "the prettiest part of town" on occasion (tree lover that I've always been).   
I do not buy much in the way of takeaway entrees but DO have to admit I had a hard time opening the broccoli salad I bought today out of the deli case and had to use special "bubble pack" scissors to cut the package open to eat the salad.  Good thing I was home!  
I bought it to see if it was the same broccoli salad I've been making since 1991 and it was!! (minus raisins).  That salad stole the show at a lovely wedding reception I attended in the Oregon Wine Country and the new bride graced all of us who requested a copy of the family recipe when she returned from her honeymoon.  
BUT....The broccoli pieces in the salad I got today were way too big so I cut each of them into about 1/4th the size, so each bite would have some of the goodies (bacon, etc.).   Another "good thing I was home" moment!   (hint to the deli crew).   
People are so helpful at both stores (especially Meridian store).  I also love getting to choose which day of the month I want to apply my member's discount.   Shopping there is a very enjoyable experience!

Literally haven't had pizza this good since I was in Italy! They sell homemade ice cream sandwiches made with cookies that they fresh bake everyday. The staff is great! The girls who took our order were super fun and upbeat, and the owner went out of his way to make sure we enjoyed it. 11/10 would recommend!
Is it just me or does anyone else not like it when the fry cook blows cigarette smoke into the fryer. I know that that is a health code violation, not pleased! Thats what the windows are for.

I came into tonight not knowing what to expect and was welcomed by wonderful workers! This ice cream is delicious, I treated myself to the cotton candy flavor and it was sooo good! Very good family friendly service with big scoops! Special shoutout to the two very friendly and helpful workers that helped us tonight: Dylon and Allie. We will be back again, no matter the temperature!

First time my husband and I tried muse. We were highly impressed. Apparently their menu changes every Tuesday, which will keep us coming back for sure. Husband had the swordfish ($26) and I had rosemary pomegranate chicken ($22). His fish melted in your mouth like butter and my chicken was amazing. Never thought to put those ingredients together, but it was amazing. At a cozy 45 (or so) people max seating we loved the intimacy. Ordered salted caramel ice cream over a walnut brownie and a kahlua espresso flourless torte. Both absolutely delicious. Apparently they have the torte consistently because its popular. With entrees, starter salad, husbands beer, two desserts our tab was $74+tip, not bad at all. Can't wait to go back for different entrees. Or try it for lunch!

It seems that if it can go wrong it all goes wrong at once. We had to have our hot water heaters replaced. Meridian Plumbing gave us the best price and their technician was great! Within a few weeks the hose broke underneath my kitchen sink, again we called Meridian Plumbing. They sent out Brian.  He is great!!  And then we had to have our water softener replaced, we used Meridian Plumbing again and asking for Brian, since we fell in love with him.  He has great work ethic and is so easy to work with.  He goes above and beyond!  I have already recommended Meridian Plumbing to my friends and will continue to recommend them.

I am so delighted to have the Boise Co-op in a place close to where I live.  The new store is very open, modern, clean, and the big plus is more parking spaces!  There are also new staff who are enthusiastic and helpful.

The produce area is very inviting and is located right inside the door.  I like that items like baby turnips and golden beets are available from time to time.  The fruits and vegetables are very fresh and are reasonably priced.

I've also enjoyed the fish I've bought here and varieties that aren't always available in local supermarkets can be found at this Co-op.  I'm talking about Petrale Sole,  Ling Cod,  King Salmon, and others that are wild caught and U.S. sourced.    

I also like the deli area with a good selection of cheeses and meats. The  staff that work in this area are also very helpful and will let you taste before you buy.   


My husband and I have also enjoyed lunch here----a chicken salad sandwich made in the prepared food section.   And what made it even better is there is now a larger room with tables where one can sit down and eat lunch in a quiet space.  In this room there are also cooking classes offered.  

The only negative about this store is that many of the bulk items found in the downtown Boise Co-op are not available here.  I especially am referring to coffee as we have a favorite brand that we can only get at the downtown store.  A staff member explained that because wine is also part of the inventory that there simply isn't enough room for all of the food items.   Maybe with time this wonderful store may need to expand as the Meridian area continues to grow and the store becomes even more popular!

We were looking for a decent Chinese food place near our house. 
After reading the reviews we decided to try it out. 
First - like other reviews the Decor is just ok, but it is about what you would expect from a restaurant in a strip mall. 
Service - the service was outstanding, when picking a place to eat service is a big deal for our family. That set the tone for the rest of the meal. The owner was working the counter and she is fantastic and will help you with your decisions. 
Food - while I can see how in other reviews people
 compare the menu to Panda, the food does not even come close. This is considerably better. It is fresh and taste fresh and has good flavors. 
Overall this will be a new take out place.
Go.  Now.  Drink.  Eat.  Wonderful selection of brews from all over.  Loved the Basque pizza.  I will be stopping every time I drive through the Boise area for sure!

Had the 4 course valentines dinner and it was fantastic. We couldn't decide what was the best course or part from the salad to the rack of lamb to the house made desserts. Amazing food, service and wine's. They never disappoint!

I think they have an awesome selection of not only traditional breakfast items but quite a few specialties too. Always cooked to perfection. Beware of large waits as it is popular and not very big so call ahead.

Very helpful, and friendly I wish they would have coffee flavored yogurt. I really like the girl who is studying forensic science, she was very polite. 
Signed, Sam and his daughter Daisy.

I can recommend this store, but I did have a somewhat unsatisfactory experience, which led to a lesson learned for next time. So, if you take into account the lesson learned, this store will likely be a good resource for anyone in the community. Here's the lesson:

Do your own research before renting a paint sprayer.

With no previous experience with a paint sprayer, I rented a cordless sprayer to paint the walls and ceiling of a 15x20 room. The sprayer came with a charger and two batteries. I was able to paint only three of the walls before the first battery was depleted. With the second battery I was only able to paint the remaining wall and half the ceiling. With both batteries depleted I was unable to clean the sprayer. I removed the tip and tossed it into a bucket of water, put one battery in the charger, and went to eat lunch, hoping for the best.

After lunch (about an hour) I found the battery indicator showing fully charged. I put the second battery in the charger and resumed painting. I finished the ceiling and put a second coat on the walls,  and the sprayer stopped with a depleted battery. I had to stop at that point and clean the system with the second, partially-charged battery.

In addition to the inadequate battery power, I had to contend with refilling the small paint cup every five minutes!

I should have researched the performance of cordless sprayers.

The store associate should have asked about my experience, the project, and recommended the 110 -volt sprayer.

Lesson learned.

This place has outstanding burgers.  I had driven by several times and finally stopped.  Most would think it is a place for yogurt, and it is bu the burgers are outstanding.  They were fresh, juicy, large, and the extras were fresh.  The buns were fresh and the fries were crisp.

If you are in this area stop by for a burger, you won't be disappointed.

So I walked in today with my daughters cell phone & the screen isn't working. Employee discussed how he thought it was a broken LCD. When I return later, he tells me a plug had gotten loose inside, probably from the phone being dropped, & it's fixed. No charge. 
I would never have known the difference. I appreciated his honesty.

Excellent spot for billiards, darts and a mighty amazing jalapeño margarita!  Although I'm also partial to the dark n stormy. Last time we were here we met Neil as well as  Joe. This time Kelsey kept our drinks fresh. Every time we're in the Boise area we'll be coming back to this gem.
My least favorite fast food breakfast. If it weren't for their cold drinks on hot days, I could live without Sonic entirely.
First time here and have to say it was amazing !!! Had the spicy ramen miso and it was the perfect amount of spice but still good to eat ! Definitely will be coming back !!

Like many places I have to rate it for the goals the establishment is trying to achieve rather than what I would prefer. It would be like going to a greasy spoon and expecting it to be a five star restaurant; it's just not going to happen. 

What Home Depot attempts to accomplish is to provide home appliances, tools, and materials at low prices. It accomplishes this goal quite well.

Is the service great? That depends. Do they help you find items in the store? Yes. Are they courteous? Fairly. Do they ask you if you need help every time you see them? Yes (which is good and bad). Will they provide expert opinions about what works for your project? Not really. If you need that help you should probably go to a local store. 

The store itself is well maintained. They have an app that lets you quickly find what you are looking for and locate it in the store. It gives the aisle and bay number, so it's very quick. And it avoids the need for human interaction which I prefer at these stores.

One weak point is they don't have as nice of a selection of home decor items, such as lights, etc. Lowe's is a better option for those items.

The only reason for the second star was our server, Rene. His service was great, and in my opinion, he is wasting his skills and talents at this dive. 

Look, it's Denny's so I wasn't expecting a whole lot. However, this location completely failed to meet even the lowest of expectations. Food was cold, drinks were ordered that never showed, and when raw food was sent back to refire, it took so long that everybody else in our party was done eating before the dish showed back up. 

Overall, I'm completely underwhelmed and disappointed. You've been warned: Please!  Go ANYWHERE else!
SOOO SLOW!  And then they rang it up wrong and treated me as if it was my fault!  The cashier was beyond rude!  Don't go there!! I didn't even want to do one star.

I had the absolute best experience working with Sarah at Prestige Diamonds.  She was incredibly helpful and timely in getting all of my needs taken care of, and designed the most beautiful engagement ring for us.  We live in San Diego and she was still able to provide top level service making it seem as though she weren't hundreds of miles away in Idaho.  Definitely a WOW experience and highly recommend Sarah and Prestige Diamonds for all your jewelry needs!  Thanks so much Sarah, the ring is so perfect!

Last night made me never want to return. The service was HORRIBLE. We weren't allowed to sit in the quiet section when we asked plenty of other people were placed by us not remembering we asked for a fairly quiet corner. No problem. Maybe it's cuz we were sober And this is how jt usually goes. Idk. The only waitress on staff constantly complained about how "slammed they were right before we got there". It was a ghost town when we arrived. She said sit anywhere except table 41 and 39, as if we knew the table numbers haha. 
She had her own music playing on the phone in her apron and was literally singing the entire time she walked around the restaurant. I was giving my order and she just started singing Her song I'm the middle of it haha. I didn't know if I should wait for her to finish or not. She didn't cut off the overhead music so it was her competing with the radio. The music in the kitchen was so loud that every time food was brought in or out there was a blast of a 3rd music. I felt like I was at a Schizophrenic Rave lol. She listed off about half the menu as being out or unavailable. Luckily we weren't there for those things so we were good with it.  We couldn't decide what to order because we wanted a variety of things but decided the two of us could share 3 entrees from the value menu. We knew it was a lot of food but were in a YOLO mood. 
It continued to get weird when she let a dog in that clearly was NOT a service animal and kept petting the dog, bringing it food from the kitchen , etc. I know the difference between a service dog and a regular animal.  She touched the dog and went back to grab a small extra we ordered. She was in the back 10 seconds max. Definitely not enough time to wash up. I could hear her telling the cook about the cute dog and then the cook came out to pet the dog. Sure hope he washed his hands but I assumed he would. 
There was clearly an employees child hanging out and wandering around the dining room and the waitress was loud and inappropriate with the child.  
Every 30 seconds or so she would yell out some random thing like "I can't wait to go to home after this shift" "holy **** I hate how bad the other employees leave things looking when they go home, I never do this" or "omg I love this song" or "wow that car was going really fast!"  It was loud enough for the entire diner to hear and not relevant or desired. 
Like mentioned earlier I actually, generally love the food here. Good prices and the food is definitely good too. This was a horrible exception. We ordered chicken fried steak and gravy, biscuits and gravy, and a grand slam. Definitely a lot of food for two but YOLO. When the chicken fried steak and eggs came it was soggy and the gravy was milk with pepper at best. It was so runny and by far the worst gravy I've ever seen let alone tasted. I only like country gravy and their gravy is generally great.  Imagine pouring a cup of milk on your biscuits.....instantly soggy. The chicken fried steak was barely warm in the middle, and I wasn't sure if the gravy made it soggy or it just didn't get cooked long enough. The gravy however was almost non existent because of the runny consistency. Since it was a "skillet" meal, the gravy ran right off the fried steak and then burned on the bottom of the hot skillet. Made the potatoes and onions gross. The eggs were not cooked to order and I was instantly turned off. I asked for more gravy and she said no problem. Brought me more peppered milk. I asked if I could have a new batch and she said she'd ask the cook, came back and said it would be like 45 min but I could wait if I wanted(while my food got cold?). I make gravy a couple times a month. It does absolutely not take 45 min. She offered to discount the meal and I said sure, but the main course was already ruined. Biscuits were soggy before they came out due to the same gravy and there was literally a runny puddle on the bottom of the plate. As she brought out the third entree I mentioned that we were excited for the huge amount of food. She then mentioned that we better eat it all up because they were out of to go boxes also and she forgot to tell us when we were clearly over ordering. What?  She said she would get a plastic plate and tape and bags and we could try it ourselves. Already turned off I tried to dive into my eggs (not cooked to order) and two bites in found everyone's favorite surprise. Egg shell. Ugh. It happens I guess. A few bites later more shells. Did I order egg shell crumbles?
Went to pay to gtfo because I was fairly frustrated and she would stop talking about tips and how people don't like it when the waitress is watching them tip. Didn't discount as promised either. So what did she do?  She literally watched us fill out the tip line. Like hovering status. The entire thinf was a disaster and insanely embarrassing for Denny's.

I bought a brand new $30K RV from Camping World in August of 2015. This was a horrible experience that continued to get worse.  Had I not needed to immediately get an RV I would have went elsewhere.  Here is a review of my experience. The sales guy told me he would have no problem meeting my deadlines if I bought from him.  He did not.  When I found a trailer that I liked they asked for a copy of my drivers license.  He never gave it back to me. I remembered he did not give it back to me after I left the dealership to think over the offer and after I made the 100-mile drive back home. This was just a tactic to get me back in their store. I signed the deal with the agreement that they would get me delivered on the same day. They messed around with excuse after excuse and did not meet the deadline. After taking delivery of the RV I found 8 issues with the RV.  They basically told me to take it up with the manufacturer. Unhappy with this answer I called the sales guy that sold me the RV.  He disappeared. The manager I finally talked to to basically told me there was nothing he could do to help me. I think this is one of the worst buying experiences I have had in a long time.  Do not buy from these folks unless you are a very experienced RV buyer and watch them closely.  They are not good people. Here are the problems they told me they could not help me with: no key to outside shower door, speaker outside did not work, missing light fixture, the RV set-up remote control does not work, peeling counter-top.

love my girlfriends brunch on Saturday and Sundays. wish they closed at 3pm instead of 2pm. everything i tried was superb food wise. i enjoy this place a lot!
they need your love. show your support with your bellies. go now and keep them open for us all.

Excellent food! Excellent service. Was visiting out of town on business the entire staff was so warm and friendly. Cute 50s time decor. Wish there were more places like this around. Unique offerings too.
These guys are in shirts and ties, friendly and incredibly polite. They explain everything and do excellent work.

AMAZING!!!!!!!!!!!!! love love it's sooo good!!!! I've been wanting to try it for couple weeks and I finally had the chance to today!!! You can choose your spicy level (I chose 8 out of 10). We also tried the noodle bop and the hot bop. Both were delicious!! It's really east to grab for lunch :) love it definitely going back!!!!

Over the years, Home Depot has really declined from the days you could get help from real craftsmen.  However, I'm working on a large project and the millworks guy helping me informed me (after I asked him) that if we took the order to the bid desk, we'd get a 12% ~ 15% discount since Home Depot would "bid it out."  That process took several days & I went down to meet with the bid desk people.  They offered something more akin to 6%.  I expressed my concern & the bid desk person asked if I'd had anyone else bid it.  I said "no," and told her that if the discount I was told about came through, I didn't feel the need to bid it out.

I took the bid to Lowes and they came up with a 25% discount from Home Depot's offer.  I'm going to Lowes, of course.

I feel loyal to Home Depot, but I'm done with them, I think.  My loyalty lasted way too long anyway.

I've come to have Tonkotsu ramen for 3 times. The cooking wasn't very consistent. The pork belly was super hard and dry when I came for the first time so I wasn't impressed.  Then the second time the belly was super soft and tender. Then the third time belly went south again... I would just wish they could make the cooking more consistent. The place was very busy at noon or dinner time so maybe they don't always have time to boil the meat excessively. The broth was pretty creamy and delicious though.

As for noodles, yes, they taste no different from ones you buy from the grocery so I don't think they're authentic ramen made in the authentic way. But once again, this is Idaho we're talking about, not Kyoto or San Francisco. Not so much specialty food options in treasure valley overall. You  come around few Japanese ramen chiefs in Idaho, if any... I'd give the place a 4 star given that this is what Idaho can offer at best. For those hardcore Asian foodies out there, yeah the noodles won't be the ones you'd get in Japan or bay area.

We love Reed's and are so glad they are in the neighborhood. If you are looking for some delicious ice cream, you won't be disappointed. I love that they change out the flavors for variety, but they keep the tried and true such as Rocky Road (my favorite).  The portions are huge. And here's a tip, order a single scoop but do a split. You'll get two yummy flavors for the price of one. Don't forget to buy some chocolate milk to go. We recently bought some and OMG--it is the best I've ever had.

Okay everyone, sorry for the novel below but I love Japanese-style ramen. It's by far what I eat most when I'm in Asia for work or over there on vacation. Japan obviously has the highest quality and varieties of ramen; when I'm there it's pure heaven. Even when I'm in a bigger US city I always try to seek out the best ramen joints; I'm a connoisseur of sorts. If you love ramen like me or newly into it hopefully you appreciate my thorough review below:

My fiancee and I made sure to try this place on the first day it opened since we are both ramen-loving freaks. It was pure chaos and our bill got confused with another order but I'm not going to hold that against this place. This was their first day open and rolling out a new restaurant isn't easy, especially one like this that is so desperately needed in Boise. I think it's a good thing it was chaotic because it shows how much Boise is craving ramen! It was exciting to see so many hungry people swarming this place; in Tokyo the best ramen joints have hour long lines of people around the block waiting to sit at a 10 seat hole-in-the-wall.

Anyways, onto the review: when we walked up there were 3 groups ahead of us and they said the wait would be between 15-20 minutes but we were seated in under 10 minutes. I ordered the Miso Ramen and my fiance ordered the Tonkatsu. I had a few bites (slurps?) of hers so I could write up this review for both dishes. There was one other ramen style available called the Shōyu (soy sauce) ramen which I'll definitely be back to try soon. Lastly, there were 2 or 3 other ramen dishes on the menu covered with tape at the moment and I heard one of them is a tsukemen (dipping noodle) option which I can't wait to try as that's one of my favorite styles and it's typically hard to find in the states.

Miso Ramen: Delicious! I'm being serious this was very good ramen, there could be some small improvements but overall it was very hearty and full flavored which is what I prefer in my ramen. The broth was rich, the noodles weren't too soft, the pork chashu melted and fell apart in my mouth, and the soft boiled egg was that perfect medium level where it's gooey but not runny. We both love our ramen spicy so the waitress brought out some dried pepper flakes and I put two heaping spoons of it into my ramen and stirred it in. I highly recommend adding this to the ramen if you love spicy ramen like me: it kicks it up a notch and most importantly it DOESN'T change the flavor of the broth. I hate when I go to ramen place in the U.S. and I ask for it spicy and they bring me sriracha or chili bean paste which will completely ruin the flavor of the broth and throw off the balance of flavors. What I'd really prefer though: a finely ground chili power that can almost dissolve into the broth (Ichiran, a very popular ramen chain from japan does this) or the option to have the chef add Japanese chili oil (La-Yu). Next time I'll probably bring some of my own finely ground chili powder because I'm weird.

Tonkotsu ramen: Also delicious and had a very authentic milky/creamy broth. However, the broth was surprisingly mild and light to my taste compared to what I expect from tonkotsu ramen. I think it may have more chicken and/or vegetable broth added to lighten it up a bit. This isn't a bad thing; it's just a preference thing. If you like a lighter broth this one is for you! I also noticed the strong ginger flavor which again is very authentic: they use "beni shoga" (pickled ginger) as a topping (red stuff in the pictures) and it was great for my fiancee who had an upset stomach that day. If you aren't big on ginger have them hold off the beni shoga/pickled ginger topping.

Overall I'd like to give 4 stars because there's a few tips/suggestions I have:
1. Add more broth to the bowl. The noodle portion is perfect but as you can see from my pictures the broth level is a bit low compared to what I'm used to. In Japan often times you finish your noodles and have the option to order a second helping of freshly cooked noodles to add back into the remaining broth. It would be great if this place had that option but right now both of us didn't have much broth left over to savor after finishing our noodles.
2. Already mentioned it before but spicy options: it would be great to have a more finely ground chili powder (Togarashi) to dissolve into the broth OR have the option to add some japanese chili oil (La-Yu). Also I think adding to the table some white pepper instead of just black pepper would be the way to go.

TL;DR: great quality authentic Japanese-style ramen in Boise, finally!
This is a great classic 50's dinner, updated to 2018. Everything you expect but updated to the 20teens. Service above and beyond with prices from the 70's. Try the waffles... Best I have ever had.

OK, so this is in response to my 3rd visit to the CupBop in Meridian. I would have given my first visit 4 stars, my 2nd visit 3 stars, and my visit yesterday only 2 stars.

I really want CupBop to succeed so I thought I would throw this out there just in case others are having similar experiences and help the management dial in to better experiences for their patrons.

The first negative is the customer service. While the service isn't awful, it's rather random and a bit too careless.  Every time we've visited there has been varying degrees of chaos. People cleaning tables yelling at the servers, servers yelling at the kitchen, the kitchen yelling at the servers, and irritated employees venting their frustrations over the heads of the patrons standing in line.  It just feels poorly managed.  In fact, on our second visit, we were done eating and exiting but a manager/owner (not sure which) was standing in the doorway blocking our exit while yelling instructions across the restaurant over our heads.  We eventually slipped by with nervous smiles the person blocking the doorway didn't even notice we were there.  It was a bit rude and perhaps the employees are simply behaving like their supervisors?

To be honest, our first visit was fairly chaotic but since it was fairly soon after opening, I just chalked it up to working out some kinks. On that first visit the food was surprisingly good and the sauces were liberally applied and yummy...and getting some bonus Mandoo after we left a tip was a nice suprize!  "You tip us, we tip you". AWESOME!

Our second visit was equally chaotic but the food was decent and we intentionally left a tip wondering if we would get a couple bonus Mandoo tipped back.  We didn't.  So, I guess we were a bit bummed. We thought the 'tip back' thing was a 'thing. There was a lot of noise and the help was arguing but the food was pretty good.  The worst part was when the owner/manager (not sure which but she was dressed fancy) treated us as if we were invisible...it turned into a rather negative experience.

On our last visit, which was a 'to go' order, the staff seemed distracted. Items in the protein section were low or missing.  The sauces were applied WAY too sparingly and once again adding a tip didn't produce any extra Mandoo. Maybe they don't do the 'tip back Mandoo' thing any more but it did make you feel kind of special when they did. The person cleaning the dining room was yelling something to the people in the kitchen when we were in line.  After our orders were ready and paid for (yes with a tip) the person behind the counter didn't hand us the bag with our food but left it sitting on the counter behind the register. He then went down to add sauces to another order. We were less than 4 feet away and we couldn't get his attention. Granted, the customers behind us were a couple of cute young ladies but we were forced to endure a few minutes of flirtatious saucing before the counter person finally noticed that he had failed to give us our food. It was out of our reach behind the counter.  He apologized, and it might have even been a bit funny but when we got home we discovered that our food was sooo dry that we could only eat the dry meat off of the top with the help of some of our own soy sauce.  The rest had to go in the garbage.  A waste of 20 bucks and a tip (which I wish I could have taken back).

So, that's my review.  I might give CupBop another try but my wife definitely is tapping out. I averaged all 3 visits and left that as my review but I sure hope CupBop can get a bit better in the customer service department.  Thanks!

This place is ok if you're looking to have a drink and socialize or watch the game but the food quality is wanting.  We've tried most of the things on their menu at one point or another and I can't honestly recommend anything except the wings,  a burger, or some onion rings.  We keep hoping that the food quality will improve (since we live nearby) but unfortunately it hasn't happened yet.
Every time in our choices of ice cream is excellent.  I love the richness of the ice cream and the friendly staff
Excellent beers coupled with very knowledgable staff. Recently recommended "Sea Legs" by Crooked Line = Nailed it! One of my new favorites by far!
Such a cool idea we orders tons for our lacrosse boys team and they loved them!! So tasty and good priced thanks again!!

Visiting from out east and had a jonesing for some real ramen.  Ordered the spicy tonkotsu.  While not as spicy as I'd like the bone broth was up there with the best I've had and the pork was tender and tasty.  The noodles were perfectly chewy and absorbed the broth well.  Like most ramen restaurants the egg was a little overcooked but the center was still a little creamy.  Overall a very satisfying meal and I will visit again.

We started at Dreamland in 2016. We visited about 5 daycare centers in Meridian and decided we liked Dreamland the best. All 3 of my kids attended. I am always greeted by the teachers and assistants that see me come through the door, whether or not I have a child in their class or not. Sarah, at the front desk is super friendly and always a pleasure to talk to. Ms. Esther is an amazing teacher in the 4s class, my son has learned so much this year and I think its because of her. My daughter is in the 2s class and she has a hard time warming up to anyone, however, Ms. Angela & Ms. Nicole have earned her trust and she loves them. Fatima, the Director, is always around and available if I ever have questions.  I have read a few reviews about sicknesses, but any time something is going around, I am notified and really, when you have 100 kids under the same roof with siblings at all different schools, you're bound to run into some illness.
Took my family there the other night to get ice cream! OMG - deliciousness! Friendly staff, great prices. They are very very generous on their scoops of ice cream. 1 scoop = is HUGE!
If you're looking for a great selection of crafted beers this is the place for you. They also have minimal food items as well.

My husband and I tried this place for the first time on Friday night. The shocking discrepancy between all of the reviews had us in tears laughing so hard on the way there, so we really had no idea what to expect. But we had never tried real Ramen before and were committed to at least giving it a try.

So first of all, the location is weird. It's hard to tell if it is still in the process of taking over the location of a different Japanese restaurant, or if it is just sharing space with it? The decor of the area that appeared to be designated to Ramen Sho seemed to be perhaps loosely based on Urban Japanese culture? There is a giant almost mural of an anime style character on the outer wall. We were seated immediately in the outdoor area which is on the landing near the escalators that lead to several other restaurants. There seemed to be kind of a weird smell there, almost like the smell of an aquarium? I couldn't quite put my finger on it but the smell bothered me the whole time we were sitting there. 

Our waitress was young, very sweet and welcoming. She answered our questions warmly and thoroughly. My husband ordered the Tonkatsu ramen soup, I chose the Miso and we shared an order of Gyoza and Tako Yaki. Our soups arrived very quickly, to our surprise, and as previous reviewers have said, the temperature of the soup was only warm but not hot. Perhaps the temperature of the cold toppings cools it down? The broths were both rich and luscious. I couldn't decide which I liked best! As I mentioned, neither of have ever tried real Ramen before, but neither of us were extremely gung-ho about the texture and flavor of the noodles. The toppings were ok, though the sprouts were not crisp. I personally couldn't handle the texture of the pork belly--soft, pale and fatty-- which came with both of our soups, but my husband ate both of them and said they were delicious. 

The Gyoza were epic!! Absolutely delicious. I wanted more! Next we tried the Tako Yaki. I was eager and bit into one and burned my mouth!! I watched another customer do the same thing! It was a bit odd to have this difference in temperature between each menu item. I found that I couldn't handle the texture of these either. The outside is crispy and thin while the entire middle is creamy like mashed potatoes with the chewy piece of octopus in the very middle. I think maybe if they were smaller, I would find them a little more palatable. But I admit, I am no connoisseur of Japanese food.

Our waitress brought us the bill before we were finished eating, which is unfortunately one of my pet peeves, especially when the place is not extremely busy. We hadn't decided yet if we were going to have dessert, and ended up deciding to which made us feel awkward because she had already brought the bill. Meanwhile my glass was drained halfway through the meal, despite making eye contact with her with my glass held up, after which she took the water pitcher and went to water the plants!!!  I drained my husband's glass, and no one offered to refill it either. She refilled glasses of water at the table directly beside us, too, which was also odd.

We ordered Mochi for dessert, which was also a first for us. We hesitated in choosing between green tea and mango flavor and our waitress offered us one of each which we gladly accepted. We were surprised when she came out with two plates of two of each, which she apologized for and said she would just charge us for one. We were already very full at this point so we're bummed that we wouldn't be able to finish all of them before they melted. I personally loved the mango mochi!! 

It was definitely a mixed experience. I am excited that Boise now has a ramen restaurant, and I hope that they continue to improve their service and consistency.

The Griddle never fails to disappoint. Hubs and I went there for a Mother's Day breakfast and it was (of course) packed!  We order Caribbean French Toast and BACON French Toast, yes, BACON!  Both items were delicious and the perfect portion size. Our waiter was fantastic and checked back on us multiple times. Love the atmosphere, love the staff, and LOVE their food!

I got eyelash extensions for the first time, and am now wondering why I waited so long. Clayton is amazing. He made my lashes look long, full and natural. His salon is peaceful, relaxing and clean. I've already booked an eyelash fill!

We love trying new places on the off chance that something wonderful is out there.   This is one place we wish we tried sooner. 

Being first-timers, we were patiently led through the options by the servers at the counter.   Everyone was friendly and helpful -- we got a very genuine feeling from them.   Dining room was very clean and bright.

I'm a serious spice wimp (extra-mild is sometimes too much for me), so I was worried that the food here would be too spicy.  It was flavorful, yes, but not spicy.   There was a spicy sauce option, but I skipped it.

Dad & I each had a combo with 5 MoMo dumplings (we had 3 pork and 2 turkey each) with the beans & saffron rice, then he had 2 turkey meatballs & sauce while I had the ground turkey.   Those were accompanied by a veggie salad mixture and the milder of the two sauces for dipping.  Delicious!

Definitely coming back.  Often.

Fair prices and good work. Our plumber that visited was professional, courteous, and friendly. Fixed our problem and gave us some tips to avoid the issue in the future. Highly reccomend and will use in the future!

Visited Ramen Sho on a Wednesday right at 5pm even drove from central Boise just to try it. It was super quiet but quickly picked up. We order shortly after arriving and got our food SO fast. I got the spicy miso ramen with pork belly. It was delicious but not spicy will add some next time. We were there for an hour but felt so much longer because we got our food so fast. Will definitely return!

I had a horrible experience here with my hair.. i wont go back.. i have photos to prove how bad it went.. along with 3 other salons who tell me they could have done what i wanted vs telling me the look/colors i wanted were based off a wig photo when thats totally not the case... cindi on the 1st night treated me and my son so bad i left crying. Should have been my 1st clue not to go back.. but i thought id give the owners lisa and lori a chance to fix the issue but instead i got ruined hair and a partial refund.. they do not know how to do fashion colors..  I DO NOT RECOMMEND YOU GO TO THEM FOR YOUR HAIR NEEDS...
NEVER WASHED MY HAIR CHECK OUT THE PHOTOS..

Great yogurt!  Friendly staff!  I like that even the toppings were self serve, unlike the other frozen yogurt shops.  We were there for a birthday party, which they let you rent out the corner room for free!!

I wanted to add my two cents since we went for lunch, and most other reviewers reviewed coffee and breakfast. You can have breakfast menu options at lunch (which are great) but there are also many great salads and sandwiches on the menu. I had a super yummy Waldorf salad with curried chicken, and my daughter had an enormous quesadilla. I also happen to be there on a Monday and they are currently running a promotion for "Free Muffin Monday" which you get when you order just about anything. Don't know how long it will last, but their delish lemon almond muffin became my dessert! The restaurant has lots of charm and is large and open with lots of seating in and outdoors. They are also situated right in front of a pretty play fountain. Great option when you want quick, fresh, healthy and yummy meal!
Such great service, fantastic customer service and delicious food! Our waitress was sweet to our children and extremely good at her job.

The Griddle brings a retro feel to breakfast and is slowly becoming one of my favorite spots to have some OJ and munch on an omelet. 

I was somewhat wary of The Griddle on first glance. Here you have a place that is kind of out in the middle of nowhere in terms of location and proximity to anything and it is very crowded. I can't stand waiting in lines to eat and I am also not a fan of driving off the beaten path just to grab some breakfast but I was mildly surprised by the excursion. 

Seeing that seating was in short supply my girlfriend and I opted to saddle up the bar and began perusing the menu. The Griddle sports a good selection of breakfast items and we were eager to dig into them. I had an omelet and she had corned beef hash. Both were very good. My omelet was fluffy and full of meat and cheese and her corned beef hash was flavorful and not too dry like some other eateries. 

I was also happy to be drinking orange juice that was freshly squeezed on location. Juice seems to always be better when it gets made just minutes before you drink it. 

Since we were at the counter, we got to see everyone milling around in the kitchen and got to talk to a waiter while we were waiting for our food. The service here was prompt and constant and this was despite a very full house of hungry breakfast seekers. 

The only downside to The Griddle is it was a tad spendy but no more so than places like Goldy's or Jerry's State Court Cafe. Overall, we were very satisfied with our experience and will be returning soon.

...I have used Avery Law twice in my life, the staff are highly knowledgeable in all aspects of Bankruptcy Law and complex issues you may have and their easily accessible for any questions you may have. They have several payment plans to make it easier for you at a good price. I highly recommend Avery Law.

Cool retro decor & very delicious food! The staff is very attentive & personable. We are new to the area & will for sure be back again & again!!! The also have some awesome coffee! Do not pass up on a chance to have a meal here!!

Went in here and waited about 20 minutes to be acknowledged.  We read a little about the program here which is a 3 step program.  I read reviews on yelp and they were too expensive.  We went down the road to NBalance and they took care of our needs immediately.  Very good customer service.   
Stop here first.

The Rudy's Pub and Grill on 10 Mile is one of our favorite restaurants. Always great food and awesome service. We saw this other Meridian location after leaving the movies tonight and were excited to check it out. Sadly, we left without eating.....or even getting a single word from any of the staff. 

We walked in just before 9:30pm. It said to seat yourself so we found an open booth and sat down. The restaurant was still around 75% full perhaps due to the BSU game that was on. We saw a couple of waitresses walking around and they seemed to be taking care of cashing out a few tables. A blond waitress made eye contact with me several times but never came over and acknowledged us at all. I figured, no problem, maybe she is trying to finish up some tables so those customers could be on their way. She even ended up going over to one table and sitting down to talk with the people at the table. 

We sat there waiting for 20 minutes without a single word or acknowledgement from anybody. I'm a patient person but this is unacceptable. I ended up grabbing my phone to see what other restaurants were near us and noticed Rudy's closed at 10pm. I'm not sure if that is why we were totally ignored but the common curtesy of saying "hey, just so you know we close in about 1/2 hour" would have been nice. I know several servers saw us, we were literally in the middle of the restraint and they made eye contact with me several times. 

What a waste, we won't be back to this location.

For those of you that don't know, Cupbop is a new food truck. I had been seeing it pop up around town. The other day, around lunch time, I saw they were on the corner of 5th and State Street along with a couple other food trucks, and decided it was time I give them a try.

This is a description of Cupbop straight from Facebook:

"Cupbop is Korean BBQ in a bowl! We offer sweet, savory and spicy food that will have fireworks bursting with flavor in your mouth! Your bowl will have fluffy white rice, a layer of crisp lettuce, delicate sweet potato noodles, and your choice of beef, pork, chicken, or our tofu kimchi medley! Shhh... Just eat! When you eat Cupbop, you will poop gold!"

To be honest, the description is pretty spot on. All except maybe 'pooping gold'. This was a delicious bowl of Korean food. I believe the name is a play on the Korean dish bibimbap, but don't quote me. Bibimbap, sometimes anglicized as bi bim bap or bi bim bop, is a Korean dish that literally means "mixed rice". Bibimbap is served as a bowl of warm, white rice topped with seasoned vegetables and sauces.

I chose their Kko Kko Bop (the chicken bowl) with a couple mandoo (Korean potstickers). Everything was very good. Loved the noodles. I do wish there was less rice and more of everything else, but that's just me being greedy. You also get to choose the spice level of your sauce on a scale of 1-10. I went with a 5. Should have gone 6 or 7, but I like my food with a little bit of a kick to it.

Overall, this is one of the best meals from a food truck I have ever had. Follow them on Facebook or Instagram to find out where they will be next. I will definitely be having some more of their delicious food in the not so distant future!
Brian was our guy. Professional, knowledgeable and dependable. Very happy with the installation of our new water softener and filtration system.

The day before Thanksgiving I dropped my Yukon off right before close to get my flat tire repaired. They fixed it that evening and left it for me to pick up that night. They were closed so I couldn't pay them. When I called them to pay, they said it was free. That was really cool of them- especially given it was 6:00 pm the day before Thanksgiving. They could've said "forget it" and gone home.

The bar staff is awesome, especially Cody and Sam, the waiters are great. The Happy Hour specials on drinks are worth the quick visit prior to a movie.

The only reason for a 4 over a 5 is that they need to fix the big screen, the one tv is out and makes it very hard to watch anything!

Decent place for breakfast, its always crowded so go on off hours if possible. Retro feel to the dining room. I had the chorizo, eggs and potatoes with pico/salsa and sour cream, good combo. Prices may be a bit steep for breakfast in Meridian.

Service department is horrible. Forgot to order parts. Takes forever to get warranty claims fixed. When items fixed not done properly. Sorry I bought camper from them never again. I now only go back for warranty repairs only. Seems like they are short handed in service dept.

My truck had a nail or screw stuck in the tire. It had a slow leak that I ignored forever. I just kept putting air in it. I finally dropped it off at the Commercial Tire on Chinden/Linder  and walked to the store to kill time while they fixed it. I came back in about 45 minutes and went in to pay. I told them I needed to pay for my truck, the man asked the truck with the tire?  I nodded and he said, no charge, have a nice day. It was so cool. I wasn't expecting it and it surprised me. Totally made my day!  I told him thanks and left. Now I'm letting you all know. I need tires this fall and I'll be going to them. 

Thank you Commercial Tire!

I can't say the food was bad (it was okay) or the service was terrible (it was fine). All I can say is that when I walk into a restaurant with floors and tables as filthy as this, I should know to walk back out. My hamburger was ok. Fries were good. Service was quick. "Gross" is the best way to describe the overall experience. Clean your floors. Wipe your tables. Tell your busboy to quit wiping down tables with the worlds dirtiest dishrag. This is my third (and last) attempt to eat at this restaurant.

Clean, homie place. Went to try the hucleberry stuffed french toast, I ended up not being a fan of that but had a breakfast burrito that was fantastic. I subbed the ham in it for sausage and it was big tasty pieces. Service was good and prices were decent as well. Eager to try other things on the menu. Will definitely be back.

My daughter went today to use the credit that they offered me because she lives locally she did not attempt to order anything with salt LOL she said that the drinks that she did get were made perfectly and she would definitely return. It is good when businesses take note of the reviews posted here and use them to improve their business and make customers  happy . I would definitely give them another chance when I return to visit the area because as you know we have a ton of options as far as coffee shops go!
So thank thank your luckyperk for making good on your word!

If a new video game doesn't come in 3D, VR, or 4K, I won't watch it. If my pizza doesn't come to me in an irregular shape...I'll probably still eat it, who are we kidding? But hey -- pizza in a cone? That's exciting.

The hype surrounding the recently opened Coned! and their irregularly-shaped pizzas was real, albeit a tad subdued. We couldn't get very far in life without hearing about it, so we tried it out as soon as we could! And then I procrastinated for almost a month before writing this. Woops!

We tried three different cones between the two of us; we each got a pepperoni, I got the bbq chicken, and Ken got the chicken alfredo. We also learned, halfway through eating these, that they have ice cream cones (it's just ice cream, but the cone is still pizza dough). We each got one of those, too. I ended up feeling so full, I almost died.

Here's the thing: despite being a cone, it still tasted like pizza. This is good! However, it tasted like pizza with a *lot* of sauce. More than normal. So if you're big into pizza sauce: you'll love this. I don't know if it has to do with the physical dynamic of it being in a cone, or just the way they proportion their ingredients, but at times you are practically drinking the stuff.

- The Pepperoni -
With a red, marinara-style pizza, drinking the sauce isn't so bad. The peps were there, the cheese was the right amount of gooey, the crust was pretty solid, nothing special to really note about the taste. Good stuff: Kenny and I both agree.

- The BBQ Chicken -
The bbq sauce they use is very vinegary. Not something I might notice on more normal pizza, but remember, you really do end up *drinking* this sauce. If you like drinking vinegar, be my guest. Otherwise, the other ingredients were fine but it really got drowned out by the sauce. I can't say I'd recommend it.

- The Alfredo -
See "The BBQ Chicken" and replace "vinegar" with "alfredo."

- The Ice Cream -
Now this is worth it. Their ice cream is great (I have no idea who the source maker is), and the pizza-dough cone reminisces of a scone sundae like the kind at Merritt's. If you're stopping at Coned!, you'd be remiss to skip dessert.

- The Verdict -
Coned! is fine, acceptable pizza...if you stick to the marinara style. I don't know if they're going to read this, but the one thing they need to consider to really up their game is to cut back on the amount of sauce per cone. It noticeably drowns down the other texture and flavor you expect to get from pizza. The fact that it's in the shape of the cone can't hide this from the scrutinous taste buds of Boise's most prolific pizza pundits. Neat idea, though. It works really well for ice cream!

3 slices out of 5
Worst iced mocha I've ever tasted. Watery, gritty and about 5x sweeter than it needed to be. I'll never go back.

I'm giving them a two for this stay. I stayed one other time: June 2015 and things were fine.  This time:  September 2015 my family stayed for several days and experienced apathy from most of the staff.  They were understaffed for weekend breakfasts, so garbage was overflowing and several people went without the eggs and sausage.  One waffle maker left the waffle raw in the middle.  Mostly we were disappointed with housekeeping.  One evening we came back to unmade beds and full garbage.  We informed the desk and were given a new garbage liner by request.  That's it.  No one came to finish the room and no compensation was offered.  :(.  On another day the door was crashed into very loudly; not a bump.  It made us all jump and I saw a maid pulling away with her cart.  My husband saw a maid help herself to the breakfast.  We averaged $119/night for apathetic service, but comfortable beds, decent food when available and clean rooms if housekeeping finishes the job.  We moved to another hotel for the remainder if our trip.

My friend and I love this place! It's so amazing! Anything you order is amazing! I have never been disappointed! The tonkotsu Ramen is my favorite! So many happy flavors! If you love ramen, this is the place for you!! Staff is super friendly and kind!  Love this place.
Traveling through town.... Exactly what my kids and I needed! Great, friendly service, and food was good! Coffee was ok, but I am used to Portland area coffee.

If you are looking for the best bowl of soup in town then Frankie's Java is the place to go! Each batch is hand-crafted to match the season. But you want to get there early because they do sell out! The atmosphere, customer service and food are excellent!

I am so incredibly disappointed with this place. And will never ever be back. My mother took my three small children here today and realized, after they had gotten their yogurt, that she had forgotten her wallet in her other purse. The cashier called a manager and told my mom that she could come back after they ate and pay for the yogurt. She offered to give them what cash she had on her (only about five dollars). While they are eating their yogurt the same person who told them that they could eat it and pay later after talking to a manager then tells my mother that they spoke with another manager and that they actually actually eat their yogurt now!! My two three year olds and five year old had to stop eating their frozen yogurt and leave. Are you kidding me?!! I cannot wrap my mind around this. I will never in my life walk in to this place again and I will share this with everyone I know. This is disgusting. What kind of customer service is this? I could understand if they got to the check out and upon learning that my mom could only pay $5 until she could drive a half of a mile to her home and bring back the remaining money she was told that they couldn't eat it. Of course. That makes sense. But to come out after my kids had started eating the yogurt and pretty much take it away?????? The young man working is not to blame. Whichever manager told him that they had to stop eating their yogurt after another manager said it was ok...they are to blame. I hope this person reconsiders their career in the food industry. PLEASE do not eat here!!
I have no idea what the Seattle snob is talking about, go back to pellegrino land. I have been to the Muse many times and the staff and food are always amazing.

Got a medium almond milk sugar free white chocolate. It is terrible. I'm forcing it down after paying 4.66 for it. It tastes bitter...I'm not sure if it's the espresso or the sugar free white chocolate but I'm not into it. I've had there drinks from here and they are decent...not amazing but I can usually drink them.

2nd visit and glad to see improvements from the last time. The music/noise level is much more reasonable and   they've streamlined the counter process to make things move along quicker.

The kimche is great and the food, overall, is very good. I could do without some of the graphics as gas as decor as an unnecessary distraction. Overall, will continue to frequent and give them our business.

Love the vibe and being downtown Meridian.  Great place to drop in and grab a coffee, wonderful bite and socialize.

Recommend the Ego Boost with a Mister Man Burrito.

Fantastic place, came in on a Saturday morning, only about 20min wait and the staff and service was excellent!
Had the Ham Steak and Eggs!  Wow! Great!
Overall a great place and nice family environment!

Keep up the good work Griddle Team of Meridian, ID!

A great alternative for a quick meal.  Got the combo mean which is dumplings and rice.  Dumplings had great flavor... recommend the pork..I added the saffron rice with vegetables which tasted fresh and had a good flavor ... Service was also great.. People are friendly and put out a great vibe.  My new favorite place for a quick and healthy meal.

S

This place is awesome! We love the different choices, especially considering that there's a vegan one, which tastes delicious!
Prices are affordable even for students. 
Customer service is outstanding. 
Highly recommended!!
Great place to grab a bite and linger a bit over a beer with friends. Specializing in unique flat breads (pizzas) and sandwiches for food offering, remember that the beers are the focus here.

Bomb! Had the sausage with pepperoni and mushroom, white sauce, and the special slice. Simple menu but it's all delicious. Pizza has a great crust with a perfect balance of cheese to sauce ratio. Go try them. The owner is super friendly.

Had something stolen off the passenger seat which was then "found in the trash". I would never go back, since they don't let you stay in the car during the wash, and I can't trust the employees. The wash itself was fine, but I cannot recommend.

The Griddle is one of my favorite breakfast places! The Staff is always welcoming, warm and accommodating. When I'm not doing carbs they'll always cater to exactly what I'm in the mood for. My eggs are always cooked perfectly (I can't do runny eggs) I've been here with a date as well as a friend and by myself during the work week. Expect a wait on the weekends as it's a packed house- coffee and heaters are out in front while you wait! HIGHLY recommend the almond crusted French Toast.

Great food, friendly service and although it's always pretty busy they move the line very efficiently.  Their specials are always a must try.  Last time we were in they had a Mexican Eggs Benedict that was off the chart.
More expensive than other, better places. Service is spotty.  The food is fine but the price and service will send us elsewhere.

After meeting the owner I thought this would be the place I would go in the future, very nice guy. But he left soon after my van was being looked at and maybe that's where it went wrong. I took my van to get everything checked out. I knew my alignment was off and asked for them to look at that as well. He said yes it's on the rack now and they'll check it. I was told I needed various things one of them being two new tires on the front (I'm assuming because I went so long needing an alignment) they told me it would be about and hour and a half, $450 and 3 hours later I pick up my van and as I'm driving home my alignment is still off!!! So I call and tell them it's still pulling to the left and he tells me yeah there's a car there now and they were unable to get to mine. I was so frustrated especially because before I left for 3 hours, I was told it was getting looked at right then. I don't care about the time it took and would of paid more to get my alignment fixed, but specific things I asked for and was told would happen didn't. So I had bought brand new tires for my vehicle that still had an alignment issue, had I known the alignment wouldn't of been fixed I wouldn't of bought new tires, seeing as the alignment as it is now will ruin my new tires.
Delivery was early and the food was great had the pork chow mien and egg flower soups and the crab rangoon that was super-good!

The service was very prompt and friendly! I didn't really think you could make a waffle really stand out from the rest I have had in my life, but I was wrong! Waffle had great texture and was tasty.  The cinnamon topping hit the spot.

Dirty place. Saw employee with finger halfway up his nose by the kitchen. When I saw that I canceled my order. Disgusting. Wouldn't surprise me if there were cockroaches running around in the kitchen. Don't know how the food is here and I don't care to know. Much better Chinese food elsewhere I'm sure and made in a clean environment.
We tried Tako-yaki appetizer today, taste very yummy, the Raman are as good as always
Food was burnt and charcoal all the way through. Don't go here if you want properly cooked food.

I love the food here, but the wait staff is seriously bad. Half of them look miserable like they don't want to be there. Every time I go, they forget the Mob Sauce (even though you have to pay for it). And the last couple of times I've gone my order was wrong. They're whole concept is Drive Thru pizza, however most of the time they make you pull into a parking spot then call your name to come grab your order - the opposite of a drive thru. Maybe they need to look next door at sonic and take a page out of their book by walking the order to your vehicle.

3rd time was NOT the charm. More like 3 stikes and we are done! 1st visit our food was good, wait was long, yet service was pretty good despite the big crowd. We were excited to share with friends...2nd visit service was rude and short, food was cold and even though 3 out of 4 of our party had arrived Terri would not seat us remarking she had been burned before... this weekend we gave it a 3rd visit. Arrived at 1:45. Rush hour over hoping to get the food we had enjoyed on our 1st visit. We were seated & given waters. Terri took her belongings and left the building... our waitress ATE at the counter while 2 other waitresses bussed and restocked their empty stations. We waited 14 minutes were never acknowledged so as our waitress enjoyed her brunch we WALKED OUT!  and will never return...what a shame.

Great little waffle spot! Meridian definitely needed one of these so I am very excited for the new addition. Superb customer service and even better food! Can't wait to keep coming back and trying the rest of the menu. The only thing that could make this place 6 stars is an experienced barista and latte art! ;)

Unfortunately this will be the only time I will be entering this establishment. Service was absent. We waited to be seated as the only waitress carried on a conversation for several minutes. Once seated two of the three of us had our beverage orders taken. It took 10 minutes to get the third. Apps were probably the best and worst. Perfect croquet but raw Japanese fried chicken. Strike two. Ordered miso ramen and tonkatsu for the three of us. After doing around Japan and Tokyo this was a pale excuse for ramen. Noodles were nothing special and stock was one dimensional. Then the waitress tried to say the chef studied the number one chef in Tokyo for a whole month for ramen. Calling BS on that. I have had that ramen and it is much better and he would never serve the dishwater. Sorry this is the only ramen show in town but I doubt this one is going to last.

I wasn't impressed. The drinks were ok. Not a great wine selection but nice standard bar drinks. Definitely frozen beef patties. Biscuits were good but what was inside was barely ok. Coleslaw was slimy. Service was inconsistent.

We had yet ANOTHER great time today at Frankie's Java.  I enjoyed my favorite...the Eggs Benedict.  It was truly perfect!  The patio was so nice to enjoy with the town center water fountain in view.  It was a nice morning with the ladies.  Thanks for providing the perfect place for us.  See you in 2 weeks!

Terri's Café (Meridian, Idaho)

I found Terri's Café on Yelp and was not disappointed.  In fact, I was happy with my food and wowed by the service.  I can't deny it.  My wife's name is Terri and the name of this restaurant made me curious.  With a name like Terri's Café, this place must be good.  Just like Mel's Diner, right? 

Meridian doesn't have a lot of places with a significant amount of Yelp reviews.  When I found Terri's Café on Yelp, the first thing I looked at was the review count and average stars.  With less than 50 reviews, I figured that it's probably equivalent to an establishment in Vegas with over 200 reviews.  

I dined on a weekday and was told that this place is busy during the weekends.  I was seated immediately, and my server gave me a few suggestions.  I didn't go with any of her suggestions and decided on the potato crusted trout, couple stacks of pancakes, cottage cheese, of course eggs, and an elk patty just in case.  If you're not familiar with elk, it tastes like beef, just a bit sweeter.  Elk is high in protein and low in fat.  Even better, elk isn't as gamey as the rest of the exotic meats out there. My overall meal was delicious, and I didn't leave a single crumb on my plate.  But if I had to recommend one item here, get the potato crusted trout.  It's very good, lightly breaded, and potato anything in Idaho just seems to taste a lot better.  

As for service, it's as good as it gets. I didn't get the opportunity to meet Terri the owner. I did converse with 3 of her employees.  All were very nice and made my visit an awesome one.  I can't wait to come back for some more trout and eggs.
Always ask for Danny! She's the best and great personality! Also foods a hit n miss but most the time it's good!

Super delicious, unique food and equally amazing service. Recommend the saffron rice and turkey meatballs, yummy! Will be back soon Momo! We had our first visit and are definitely going back. So great to eat soothing well made and unique! Thank you Momo!

Went there for lunch for the first time today. I was concerned as there wasn't anyone in there, but I decided to try it anyway. Well now I know why it was empty.
Paid $18 for my food which was their special plus potstickers. A little expensive for a lunch. The potstickers were okay, but my meal was absolutely inedible. Honestly threw it away. The meat was disgusting and a ton of fat....  
I really hate writing a bad review, but I just had too with this. Also, the restaurant was dirty which in hindsight should have been another clue. Definitely won't go back.
Love the raspberry pomegranate! They let you taste before you buy and the have lots of flavors and toppings. Yummy!

Excellent customer service! Employees went above and beyond and I am now a huge fan. Yesterday 10/8/19 was my first trip for an oil change at Einstein's. As the service was wrapping up, they mentioned they can check engine light codes, top off fluids, tire pressure, etc. I had actually popped a check engine light just over a week ago and was surprised to hear they offer a check. 5 minutes later the employee had given me a description of the codes and explained what the typical issue is pertaining to the codes present. 
Then . . . I started up my car (it recently developed a little rattle sound) the employee heard it, asked the tech below the car if he heard it. Then they investigated - a little 3" x 5" sized metal bracket that holds wiring had come loose and was dangling against another piece of metal. He showed me pictures, handed it to me, and told me what I would need to do to get it squared away. 
I have never had customer service make such an impact while getting an oil change, really got my day going in a great way. Thank you
Pizza was awesome reminded me of New York.   The price was reasonable it was a very busy night but the employees did a great job to have order ready for pick up.

What a great place to bring your family.  There is not a better place for frozen yogurt than found here.  The selections were amazing, the place was clean and they even serve food.  We ordered a large fry and we were brought out a tray full of fries...unbelievable.  If you have not been here yet, I would encourage you to give it a try.
Wow Waffle Love! Your Nutella waffle with raspberries is to die for! Can I give 10 stars?

It was our first visit to Brewforia and it was great. We were greeted when we entered and they walked us through the unique methodology without being made to feel like "noobs". 

Great variety on tap (many places have tons of dark beer, stouts, IPAs or as I call them "Hipster Beer", and one or two mainstream beers - this place has at least one tap of each type).

I would guess they have 500 bottles and cans to choose from. BrewHaven (?) on Vista has far more, and the real downside here for Brewforia is they are not chilled... This lead to the 4/5 stars, but clearly is not what Brewforia is about, so most would probably not fault them for this. 

Have a few, decide on a favorite and take a growler home for a fair price, unlike most restaurants that charge more than the quickstop growler stations we are seeing pop up everywhere. 

As far as a place to grab a quick beer and light snack (pizza, pretzels, salad, wings) with a friend, there is no better place to go in Meridian.

Ordered over an hour before our movie start time, waiter asked if we were going to a movie and said no problem. Never got our food. I'm sure he forgot to place the order. The movie in the VIP was equally disappointing. Order a specific beer which is carried at the bar but my waitress told me the bar was too busy and she didn't want to wait that long. Customer service at its finest. There was no hurry the movie is 2 hrs long.

We visited Terri's cafe for the very first time today and it was outstanding!  Our server, Karisa was fantastic!  She was outgoing, friendly and so cheerful!!  What a delight!  She took the time to tell us some of the favorites and told us to take our time looking over the menu.  She said she would be back when we closed our menus.  She was right there when we were ready.  My husband had the corned beef hash and eggs. They were the BEST he has ever had!!  I had my usual eggs, bacon, hash browns and pancakes.  Eggs were done perfect, bacon tasty, hash browns crisp and the fluffiest pancakes ever!!  Love the large cup of coffee served which manages to stay hot even when I added cream!  All the staff was very friendly and efficient! We will definitely be back!!

A solid four stars! We have been for breakfast/brunch on a weekend and a late lunch during the week. During both visits the staff was prompt and helpful. The breakfast was very good, although the portions (especially the kids menu) left most of us still hungry. The lunch was more filling and the sandwiches were great. We look forward to coming back. Plan on a LONG wait on the weekend (were waited 45 min) and to order a bit extra. Also, it is a bit pricey but not crazy expensive compared to other spots.

I'm sorry. The server and I didn't mesh. I didn't understand why he was being difficult. Am sure I was to him. Didn't want the rice and noodles do mix. Regardless, the food was disappointing. I really wanted it to be good since I love Korean food. But it wasn't. Clear glass noodles were ok. They are usually my fav anywhere. Got the marinated beef. Not ok. And kimchi was so not amazing. Sorry again, I don't like to give two stars. But this was a bust. I would have tried again if the food was more the ah.
I love Meridian Plumbing. They have come out to our house in Kuna multiple times to help us out and they are ALWAYS reasonably priced and very fair. I highly recommend them.

Before we get into the real problem I'd like to make it clear that I too work in the service industry. Upon arrvial this morning I was ready to eat an omelet and excited because the customer service at the Dennys is usually on point. As I got to the door the line was ridiculous which is OK because this is a sign your a good place to eat. After waiting a solid 15 minutes me and the people in front of me were never greeted. Which I know you are suppose to be greeted within the first 30 seconds of arriving. That was whatever until I noticed that you had two managers not doing a single thing standing on your expo line in the back. In my experience if the servers are busy it is the managers job to seat people and get their drinks. Which should of happened considering there were at least 9 open tables. So I left and upon leaving I circled around back. As I did I saw what seemed to be another manager not doing a damn thing and smoking a cigarette. This was the most disappointing experience I've ever had. Figure your shit out!!!!

I'm unimpressed with my first visit so far. I'm an Uber driver and came 20-some minutes to pick up, then deliver an order. This means the order was placed before that. When I arrived, nothing was ready and there were no staff visible in the dining area. A couple of minutes later a dude came out and asked if I was with Uber. I said yes, then he transmitted something to back with his headset. 
While I stood there within the next two minutes, two other parties came to check on their orders. One lady said she had to get back to work and asked to make her order to go. The other customer was told to check back in five minutes. 
Eventually I was told to have a seat as it would be a few minutes (and it has ALREADY been a few). 
Eventually I saw the one party get its dine-in order delivered in bags for take out. Not sure if the other lady got her stuff or not.
