There were about 12 people in the dining area that looks like it could handle closer to 100, yet the one staffer I've seen so far told me an another the kitchen "got slammed."
Maybe it's good food, but it seems understaffed. 
The young man in the dining area seems to be doing his best, but I feel bad for him having to field all these inquiries for food. 
I've been waiting 15 minutes and counting...

My wife and I were really looking forward to trying this place. Unfortunately, it was quite disappointing. Service is exceptionally poor. The staff asked us 4 times what we ordered and then still got the order wrong. Food quality is average, I probably won't return here anytime soon.

The salon was able to get me in last minute and they were very friendly, last Friday. However, 15 min after leaving my left nail chipped, I asked for gel on my natural nail. Today is Monday, just 3 days later and my right thumb polish came completely off. This is very upsetting considering I paid $70 for a manicure and pedicure. I would not recommend this salon to anyone because of my experience!

Clayton did an awesome job! I got a facial and he clearly explained everything that he was doing and made it a relaxing experience. Clayton is also so positive and I left feeling not only happier as a person but my face felt AMAZING! And after a week, my face and pores still feel clean and fresh!

Have signs up trees 75% off
I asked what trees was told the ones on the white barcode picked out a tree with a white barcode  right next to the sign they wanted regular price. The cashier called for help got told to call... Then call... Then was told they don't have any trees on sale 

Even though the signs are plastered everywhere they wouldn't do anything

Lowes honors posted signs

I really do like Frankie's, the atmosphere is fantastic with wonderful outdoor seating.  Plenty of room inside as well.  The decor is great and you feel welcomed.  All of the staff were super nice and we received our order very fast.  The coffee was nice and strong and the cinnamon roll was so good.  It's not your typical yeast-raised fluffy cinnamon roll though.  It seems to be made with a flakier pastry dough so it is different, but good different.  I would definitely get another one.  The prices are quite reasonable.  So why the 3 rating?  Because I cannot return due to the lack of items on the menu.  I would love to come back but Frankie's does not cater very well to vegetarians and non-dairy and low-carb eaters.  The menu just doesn't have enough variety.  Even this visit I had to order items a la carte.  It didn't seem like they had a button for this on the cash register so I ended up paying for meat because it comes with the dish (bacon) even though we're vegetarian.  Given the size of Frankie's, I really think they should expand their business a bit and get a bigger menu with more kitchen/chef staff.  Build your own omelets would be perfect.  Why not get some tofu or other fake vegan meat products?  There are plenty out there.  So if you don't mind the typical wrap or salad or egg-bacon-toast plate, you will really like Frankie's.  If you like a little excitement in your food or lots of options, Frankie's will disappoint.

IF I COULD GIVE ZERO STARS I WOULD!!! I literally only have one thing to say about Century Link....its a bait and switch company that promises one thing, locks you into a contract and then charges an obscene amount! ABSOLUTELY DONT USE THIS COMPANY....EVER!!!!!!!!!!

Whit table cloths, great wine selection, awesome food with attention to detail.  Very intimate setting.  I had pork Osso Bucco  and my husband had the chicken.  This restaurant is at Eagle and Fairview where all the chains are.  It is a neighborhood gem.  You no longer need to go downtown to find fresh ingredients, well prepared in a quiet, upscale environment.

We are so happy we called Gabriel for our project. He's professional, courteous, personable, trustworthy. His work is meticulous, and I appreciate that he keeps our budget in mind and still does stellar work. It's been a pleasure doing business with Gabriel and his colleague, Vincent. Together they knocked out our project quicker than expected. He will be my first call for future projects.

I was going to carmax to look at a 2013 Volkswagen Jetta. While the car was valued on the high end of the price spectrum, I still decided to go and look at it. I met the salesman and we went to do a test drive on the car, while an appraisal was being done on my trade. He did give me some information on the car, but for the most part, he was just talking about the carmax guarantees and how the car was reconditioned. The test drive did reveal to me that something was not quite right about the car mechanically. So after getting back, I decided to look at the other Jetta on the lot and it had a strong odor and as the salesman indicated, an accident history. Didn't drive it mostly because of the odor.

I did feel that the salesman really was trying to push the car on me. During the test drive, he only talked about himself, nothing about the car and how great the prices were and so good that you didn't need to negotiate the price. Secondly, when he told me that the cars they sold didn't have accident histories, which wasn't true. 

Then he indicated that to me when he wanted to start the deal before the appraisal was done, but I told him no. Then when the appraisal was done, they listed things they said were wrong with my car, that weren't. I finally decided that I should leave and go somewhere else where I got a much better deal, price and no pressure.

The only reason I gave it two stars is because while the experience was not that great, the facility was easy to find, clean, comfortable and the staff was friendly to me when I first walked in the door.

Their cars were not accessible for my special needs son to see. They have a large lot of cars and no way to get around to see them. I ask about a golf cart and the sales man laughed at me. He told me I was welcome to return Without my son .... I would hope that you would boycott this business until they charge their attitude about the handicapped individuals.
So yummy! Loved this pizza! Only down side was how slow the line moved. But if you have time to spare definitely check them out!

The coffee is jank. Its hit or miss, sometimes the iced coffee is good and sometimes its watered down. It is not consistent, and not to mention the food is way overpriced. The employees there are pretty good, although the manager or front end lead sucks and seems like she spends most of the time in the back room instead of being a team player and helping out.

This is the best groomer's I have had the privilege of using EVER!  Both Sarah and Sam have done grooms for my pomeranian.  They have always done a fabulous job and I have always been very pleased.  I am particularly fond of the unique and fun dye work that they do!  For them, grooming is not just a job, it's an art form and you can see the care that they put into their work.  They contribute their services to both rescue dogs and cats and service dogs which I love!  They are priced competitively and worth every penny.

My husband and I were visiting a total of 4 RV dealerships.  This one was the first stop.  The sales guy we were seated with told us several times that he was on commission.  I found it very distasteful.  We were looking for a specific trailer size, not sure if we wanted new or used, but he was pushy and mentioned he was paid commission at least 5 times in the 20 minutes we spent with him.  He was just not a great salesman.  I would not waste my time going here.  We ended up with an amazing 2018 RV anyways!  I just wouldn't give them my business due to this mans performance.

Was really looking forward to another great hamburger here. This time it was cool and raw inside, which to me is rare. To our server, which he made a point of "educating" us, it was cooked how I asked for it - medium rare. I sent it back.  I also sat there with a rare hamburger for at least 15 minutes while my friend enjoyed her dish. So by the time my hamburger came back she was done. This could have been avoided if the server would have checked with us a few minutes after our meal was served. Kind of bummed.

First time in, owner recommended a speciality Iced Coffee with a hint of Lavender. The owner was super friendly. One of the most smoothest coffees I've tasted. One of the best coffees I've tasted here in Meridian.

It would be cheaper and quicker to drive to Salt Lake City or Portland to get service done on your motor home! Not kidding!

I needed an oil change on my motor home, and Camping World was the only RV service center in Boise that would do the engine and generator. All the other RV centers would only do the generator.

After five days of waiting ('promised' in two days) they finally got our oil changed on the engine (Ford V10), and the generator. I had asked for an estimate on repairs for a very small crack in the sidewall also. 

After 5 days of no contact, I had my wife drop me off determined to leave with the motor home whether it was done or not... I had to wait over an hour. I sat outside with a guy who was absolutely fuming over them losing his camper... I finally just went in and told them I'm leaving! I had my spare keys and could see my motor home! 

This is when they rushed out the bill and my keys: over $200 for the oil change!!

They also said I had two broken exhaust manifold bolts and I needed to get that fixed right away. They were of course happy to do it for a cost of over $300!

I asked about the body estimate, and they had no idea what I was talking about, of course...

I paid, told them I'd never return, and left...

Took it to Speed-O-Motive in Fruitland Idaho for the exhaust manifold repair- they found two loose bolts and a loose heat shield. Charged me $25!

Funny follow-up: about a week later, I got a call from the body shop at Camping World. The guy was very rude, saying he had blocked out a spot in his very important schedule to look at my RV, but I had come and picked it up early! I told him that it sat there for 5 days waiting for him to look at it, three days longer than was scheduled. He basically accused me of wasting his time, and I hung up.

Two days later, I got an official written estimate for repairs in the mail. It said they were ready to begin work, all they needed was my approval (they thought the motor home was still there). The estimate was for over $7000!!!

For those potential customers who are smart enough to read Yelp reviews 'before' you go to Camping World in Meridian: DON'T DO IT!!! If you need toilet treatment or a new lawn chair, and are a 'member' of their special club, then go for it... If you need parts or service, 'BE AFRAID'!! 

P.S. I've since changed to oil on both the engine and generator myself: total cost with full synthetic was lass the $50. 

Hope this is helpful to someone...

First time here and I arrived about 10 minutes after the place opened for lunch.  We had the curry ramen, the tonkotsu ramen and gyoza and it was very good.   Just don't eat here if you're in a rush but otherwise I'll definitely be back!

My husband surprised me today with ramen for lunch.  It was wonderful.  I wanted to eat it all, but alas there was too much good stuff.  The broth was excellent, the pork tasty, and the noodles slurping good.

We have been to this place for breakfast many times, but recently have decided there are better options for the price. The food is so-so, but for the price I expect much more for a breakfast place if I am spending $9.50 for an omelet.

There are a lack of great breakfast places in this area and I would put this one in the middle of the pack and there are better alternatives.
Wow, a great place. The food was excellent and the service was better. Thanks Karissa, you are the best waitress I have had in many years.

Just bought an immaculate 2015 Audi Q3 at Carmax! This is my 2nd experience at this location and cannot imagine going back to the old way of buying car - dealing with high pressure salespeople, haggling on price, wasting the whole day on the lot. I love the Carmax model of best price displayed up front, the staff is helpful and knowledgable, financing rate was very good....the whole experience is low stress and positive. And in the end, they bring your detailed, fueled up car out with a big bow! #instaworthy!

I've known Tim for several years now and he's one of the most stand up, caring, salt of the earth kinda guys I've ever met. Victory Greens is on point with their staff, selection, knowledge, prices, and just overall great vibes. It's inspiring to walk around and get tons of landscaping ideas. I'm always treated well at Victory Greens. Would recommend them to anyone. :)

Disappointed. Been there previously, & always had a good Happy Hour. The service took a very long time, even though our waitress stated she was new, & was very friendly. I ordered the chicken dippers & my husband ordered the $5.55 turkey burger with fries. The place was empty with quite a few workers. After 25 minutes of ordering, we finally got our food. I was shocked to see the chicken looking like a few thin sticks  with tiny sauce dipping spoons. I'm glad we didn't share..The chicken's breading was soggy, and the chicken itself looked and tasted 'mechanically processed.' They were small and thin, and 5 pieces. I compared them to frozen fish sticks..you get the point. I asked for another sauce, but by the time I received it, my few bites of the chicken were gone, except the small amount of soggy breading that fell off. These were the worst chicken fingers/dippers I've ever had. The husband's burger was delicious, thick and juicy. Yet, accompanied by a small pile of sad, mushy shoestring fries. No Idaho, you know better. Anyway..I will pass and visit Twigs or Kona next movie day.

It was delicious! I went for their soft opening. I like that it is Japanese owned and not appropriating Japanese food. I had the miso Ramen which was delicious! The goyoza were also very delicious. The broth is a dynamic flavor! Will go there monthly if not weekly! Reasonably priced as well.
Don't lock twice! If A#A gives you a 3 hour response time for a lockout. James will be there in 30 minutes. Thanks for the prompt and professional service.

The food was good, but not outstanding. I would probably go back occasionally, but the hard metal chairs are incredibly uncomfortable. Between the average food, the chairs, and a sense that it wasn't as clean as it might have been, I think I'll pass.

I had it DoorDashed to my work, and I'm disappointed. I got a combo of beef and chicken, and all together I had maybe 2-3 bites of meat. Spending the amount of money I did to be disappointed with the amount of meat given is frustrating.

Who would have thought that a frozen yogurt place would have such an extensive food menu?  One of the best burger and fries I've had in a while.  Don't let the name fool you.  This is a legit place to eat some great food.

Delivery is the only way to go!! It's delivered hot and fresh!! Made to order and brought to you. Don't let the buffet turn you off. Try ordering from the menu and carry out or deliver. They don't make till you order and it really is some of the best authentic Chinese we have ever had. Their noodles are our favorite and the fried rice is delicious!! Patricia made a special house call at no charge because I ordered something wrong. They go out of their way to make things right. This is the only Chinese my husband will get now after this experience. Try delivery, you won't be disappointed.

GREAT new restaurant - I am from Caldwell and met a friend in Meridian.  My friend had been the night before and liked it so much, she took me for lunch the next day.  She and her husband went back again for dinner the same night!  Was thrilled I could sit outside in the shade with my dog.  They brought him a bowl of water right away as it was hot.  Our waitress was great (sorry, can't remember her name) - the food was good and not over priced.  Will be back!  If you live in Meridian get there quick before it becomes super popular  - which it should.

Gabe did a great job on our deck.  Two weeks before a wedding our deck collapsed, and Gabe stepped up, worked through the 4th of July holiday, worked through 100 degree heat, and produced an excellent finished product with time to spare.  I've hired him for some other projects as well, and he has always gone the extra mile to make sure I'm happy with his work.  I highly recommend him.
Don't underestimate the spice levels lol! Really good Korean bbq, great portions for the value, really filling and yummy. Worth a try for sure
Fantastic customer service, got my blinds repaired by a couple gentlemen. Very happy with the experience and my blinds look great!
Love the brand new store!! Finally I don't need to drive all the way to down town to go to shop! Thank You!!!

It was a pleasure to work with CarMax.  I'll never buy another car any other way.  The people are so nice, not pushy and very helpful.  Even the service department employees are great.  I can highly recommend them for your used car purchases.

Had an appointment with them for today. They were a no show. After giving some extra time called them and they claimed we cancelled. Told them no way and they should come over immediately. No show. 
This company does not deserve your or my business! WARNING!

Not the best experience. Not a lot of choices of flavors. The hard scooped yogurt looked old. The white chocolate mouse had an off flavor to it. We were charged extra on our yogurts. Won't be returning.
If you like little girls running about, and your pedicure and manicure looking like the sawtooths, then use them. The worst experience my wife and I have ever had!

We stopped here for brunch on father's day. The kids had pancakes, mom had corned beef Benedict, and dad had the sausage sampler. All of the food was delicious, and the service was quick and helpful despite the rush of customers. The bathrooms were clean and kid friendly as well. Overall it was a wonderful family dining experience and we look forward to visiting again next time we are in the area.

A bit small inside and often too busy to sit and work, especially with limited outlets. Staff has been inconsistent but the drinks have been fairly consistent. They have a tendency to short cut (mopping with two hours left and right where you are working, creamers away, no dark roast by lunch time) but are pretty nice. Standard Starbucks so a safe bet :)
The food is ok. It's what you would expect from a Chinese food buffet. Always crowded and the idea of been rushed is not good.

If your on this side of town, it's worth trying. The pizzas are nice thin slices with a good crunch. The combo prices are good and the service is great. Nice, friendly, and easy to order whether on foot or driving through. I got the pepperoni and that was delicious. I got the special and if you like elote corn, you will like it more than I did. I really like that think crispy slice and it holds up well. Give it a try and I'm sure you will be happy leaving!

ramen sho is such a cute little shop!! i love the simple menu. the waitstaff was just so nice to us and not overbearing. i'll definitely come back. they even have a vegetarian bowl! gonna have to try more of their ramen options. the big anime style sign outside is hard to miss.  the culture.
I love this place! Great people and food....keep it going! Tuesday's are the best. Half price wings.

I truly love The Human Bean and it is a favorite of the rest of my family and even out of town family.

I have only gone to 3 human beans - this one, one in CDA and the one out in Caldwell - good experiences at all!

It is primarily all young folks working at these shops and they are always very pleasant and provide a simple transaction which is especially helpful first thing in the morning.

I haven't strayed much outside of my typical iced latte but the couple things I have tried or family members have tried, have been quite tasty. They offer all kinds of options like low carb, sugar free, soy milk, skim milk, etc.

I like this establishment for it's courteous, professional staff, it's great coffee and the easy process in which to obtain it.

The Human Bean will always be my first choice in this and surrounding regions.

Service deserves 5 stars, food 2.  

Muse has been on my radar since we relocated from Seattle and we finally decided to give it a shot this week.  Based on the glowing reviews we were expecting something good.  That isn't what we received.  

Muse is located in a strip mall in Meridian but once you walk through the door the glow of Red Robin's lights are muted and you feel like you could almost be in a wine bar anywhere but a strip mall.  Almost.  

The front of the house and our server were excellent but the wheels fell off the bus when it came to the food.  We didn't have reservations for a Tuesday night but we had looked at OpenTable and all of the times we were considering were open so we thought doing a walk-in would be fine.  As other reviewers have mentioned this is a small, intimate restaurant and most of the tables were reserved so we were given the choice of a sub-par table near the door or seats at the bar.  We went with the bar.  

We were promptly given menus, explained that the menus change every Tuesday and that everything is made in house.  Waters and bread and butter soon followed while JP and I decided on some wine.  Their wine list is thoughtful and well-priced.  We ordered the Barbera which was great.  My husband commented it was one of the best wines he had had in awhile and we just did a long weekend of wine tasting in Walla Walla.  I was also stoked that they serve Pellegrino.  I thought it was pretty much a given for a restaurant to have it until I moved to ID.  

The menu itself is on the small side which I can appreciate since it's a small establishment.  I would rather see a place doing a few things really well but unfortunately that is not the experience we had.  JP ordered the soup du jour which was Creamy Broccoli.  The soup was okay-tended to be on the thinner side but I can appreciate that because creamy soups can tend to be too thick  Flavor was decent..  For entrees I ordered the prawn risotto while JP ordered the Pork Tenderloin.  It took FOREVER for our entrees to come out.  JP even saw a table seated after ours receive their food before us.  When our dinner was finally delivered we were told the plates were extremely hot.  I was cautious since a well done risotto is usually warm so imagine my surprise when I took my first bite only to find it barely room temperature.  Next I cut into one of my prawns only to find it rubbery and chewy.  Seriously it is one of the worst dishes I have had in a long time and I only took 2 bites.  JP's pork had potential...the flavors were all there but the meat itself was overcooked, to the point that it didn't cut easily with a knife.  

Our server came over to ask how things were and I am a horrible liar so I just fessed up.  She said she would be happy to have the risotto remade or replace it with something else.  We had already waited such a long time for what we did receive JP asked what she recommended and what could come out quickly.  She recommended the petite fillet.  When asking how I wanted it cooked I said medium rare since I was concerned if I ordered it medium it would come out overcooked.  

To the kitchen's credit the fillet came out quickly and was tasty, although a bit salty.  Since it was our first visit I asked our server what the kitchen's process was since it did appear our original entrees sat for awhile before being delivered.  She said that the chef cooks everything himself and that a bunch of tables were seated at the same time as us since they ran a Groupon or Living Social deal and it was expiring so people were coming in to use them (note...we were not using a coupon).  Let's back up folks...that is Marketing 101....whenever you run a promotion you know that the start and end of the deal will be the busy times.  Plan accordingly.  Quality and timing shouldn't have to suffer because you choose to offer a deal.

Our server was extremely gracious and took one of our entrees off (although we said we would gladly pay for everything).  She wanted us to have a good experience and come back.  I do give every place two tries so I will try Muse again but can't say I will be rushing back soon.

On a side note...if you are serving $20+ entrees perhaps you should forgo the foil wrapped butter packets.  They just scream diner or something to me.

I absolutely LOVE this pizza!!!  Great concept and an amazing slice of pizza at a great price!  The crust is always crispy yet a little floppy and the sauce is soooo good!  Wait times can be a little longer than expected at a drive thru but the pizza is definitely worth the wait!

Expect to wait 15-20 minutes for your food. We just waited 25 minutes total... 

Our food was thrown into the bag and almost all the fries were spilled out.
Terrible commercial degrading our latino population with the "Ramon" inference!  I will never do business with you, sir!
Very happy with the work they did replacing the clutch on my '95 Ford PS pickup. Very prompt and the price was very competitive.

Had them over to fix a couple things around the house. Easy to get along with and a nice guy. They took care of everything beautifully and quickly. I would use and recommend GM Construction to anyone who needs some work done around the house. Thanks Gabriel

I am not sure if all locations are good but I have to say that I have been really impressed with the food quality of this location.  I've been here a few times now and every time I order something, I taste it and think, this is really good.  I really enjoyed different kinds of burgers here and last night, I had the wild, yes wild salmon and doubled up on broccoli.  Oh my gosh! The flavor of the salmon and seasoned broccoli were amazing.  Service has been hit and miss on the different times I have been there but all in all, I will definitely be revisiting this location.

I needed my engine steam cleaned for my mechanic (I had an oil leak and they couldn't see where it was coming from), and called ahead of time to see if they offered the service. A friendly employee told me yes, and the price was $39.95 which included a basic exterior wash. 

The next morning I took the car in. It was raining, so there were signs saying they were closed due to weather. I went in and asked if they could still clean under the hood, which they happily accommodated. They unlocked the side door to bring my car in, and started up their otherwise-off hoses. They finished quickly and a very nice gentleman brought me my keys and a detailed description of what he had just done. He offered me a voucher for a free car wash when it stopped raining. 

In all, I interacted with 5 employees at this location. Every one of them was friendly and attentive. 

I'm surprised by all of the negative reviews of this location, as my service was stellar. However it should be noted that I got an uncommon service, not the standard wash everyone is commenting on. I will happily return to claim my free wash when the sun comes out.

Extra points for the cozy waiting area, and for the eclectic display of gifts which includes an abundance of garden and football paraphernalia.

So far we've been here 2xs... And have had great customer service (educated us on the trees we picked out- answered all of our questions) they will install/plant the trees in a few weeks... So we'll see how that goes

This is probably the most disgusting place I've ever eaten. My 3 year old couldn't even eat the food it was so hard and stale. Asked to talk to manager because we didn't eat and we wanted to leave but they wanted to charge us full price! We ate one plate so I was fine with paying for one adult buffet but he wouldn't even compromise. Instead he started speaking very loudly and rude. Very disrespectful and I will NEVER go back or recommend it to anybody. My whole family is disgusted with this place. Horrible service from the manager but waiter was nice. Do not waste your time or money! It sucks because we used to come here all the time now we will never be back!

Tonight for dinner I went decided I would try this restaurant. I had about ten bites then threw it away. I ordered the B Bop bowl which is korean bbq with vegetables (I chose cabbage) and rice. My bowl however came with the sweet potatoes noodles, without me being prompted and with all the pictures of the item coming with rice and the online menu saying it came with rice. I was not asked if I wanted rice or the sweet potato noodles, I just received rice. I thought whatever i'll see if it's any good, it wasn't. The "bbq" beef was terrible. It was not cooked over a flame or over coals. It seemed to have been cooked on a flat top or pan that had too much beef in close proximity and the beef ending up boiling in its own juices, that may sound good but it's not. The beef also didn't seem to be seasoned, was from a poor cut of beef, and seemed old. On being asked what level of spiciness from 1-10 that I wanted I answered 4 and received am orange earthish color sauce. In the entire restaurant there was no list of what sauces they served and what spiciness level they corresponded with. The sauce barely had any flavor and had absolutely no kick, it also was equally as bad as everything else. I didn't get far enough into the bowl to try the cabbage. When it came time to pay the cashier didn't give me my change and I had to ask for it. I will never come back to this restaurant or eat at any of the other franchises. Anytime somebody I know or somebody around me expresses a desire to go to CupBop Boise I will advise them to save their money and go somewhere else.

I bumped into this store on a ride. I live in the southwest, and we have no riding apparel store of this caliber in my city of 2 mil. Your city is lucky to have a gem like this. On a side note for the sniveler who left a bad review, This is a store not a manufacturer. Did you leave a bad review on the MFG's Yelp? Or are you trying to take your life out on the people who actually remedied your situation... Diva much?  I am geared up now  thanks to Cruisin.

Loved it!  Not a place to take your prom date, but immaculately clean, and what a great, friendly group.  Checked every table when we were there to make sure things were right.. Try it for something different (and more healthy).

This would be one of those times you should pay attention to the bad reviews.

This place is pretty bad, very greasy food.
Even the stir fry was greasy steer clear for your own good

This is my all time favorite nail place!! Everyone is so polite and cheerful!! Clean and fair prices!!  Most of all consistent, I always know what I'm going to get! The owner is absolutely the sweetest lady! You will not be disappointed!

The Griddle is one of our favorite breakfast spots. With a full breakfast AND lunch menu (and healthy options to boot!), it's one of our go-to spots when we're trying to look for something for everyone. 

Food: I've tried many Griddle items, and my favorites include their oatmeal (which comes plain or with a variety of toppings) and their egg white omelets. The oats are great because it's not a HUGE portion, so you can eat the entire bowl along with a side of protein like eggs and not feel like you've just stuffed yourself silly. The omelets are made with 3 eggs, and they don't upcharge for egg white only omelets. My favorite is the "make your own" so you can add in any 3 ingredients you want! If you like hashbrowns, specify if you'd like them crispy. They can sometimes come out a little soft. Also, the crepes (amazing cream cheese filling) and hotcakes (light and fluffy) are to die for TRY THEIR HOUSEMADE JAMS! Amazing!! 

Drinks: House-squeezed orange juice, full espresso bar, endless coffee refills and yummy chocolate milk. No complaints! 

Atmosphere: The Overland location seems to have more seating than the Eagle one, so we go to that spot if we're looking to get in and out, but you sure can't beat the Eagle one for the brightness and airy atmosphere. The Overland spot has bar-top seating and tables that can accommodate big or small parties.

Service: So fast and friendly! They are always coming around to refill your coffee and don't question when you make wacky meal requests (as I often do!). 

Happy Hour Offerings: n/a

Healthy Hack: Order the oats and/or egg white omelet. Both are completely customizeable to meet any macronutrient/dietary needs! 

Tips: TRY THE HOUSE-MADE JAM!
2 adults 2 kids $40 later everyone is still hungry.  Not a good value.        ...........

These ladies are fabulous!  And so is their work!  Need an emergency repair on a string of pearls and Sarah got it done in just a couple of hours.  Re-strung and cleaned beautifully and at a very reasonable price.  I wish I lived nearby so I could do more business with them.  A great store with a good variety and knowledgeable staff.  Tank you Sarah and Erin!

We went there on Wednesday, August 17, for dinner. What a mistake! Our service was ridiculously slow. The restaurant was not busy and we waited almost 30 minutes for our food to come out of the kitchen. Nooooo, we didn't order anything crazy. Actually, one of us ordered something based on the server's recommendation. People who sat after us and ordered after us got their food before us. 

The food was not good. His potatoes were so cold, they didn't even begin to melt the minute amount of cheese on them. The carrots were cold to the touch. I don't eat shrimp but, it looked like it could have used some more of whatever sauce/seasoning was to have been on it. All I had was a wedge salad. To their credit, the portion size was good. However, there were about 20 bacon bits on it and very little dressing. The dressing was mediocre at best. 

I almost forgot when the server brought our food she told us that she had to go back and help in the kitchen. Really? Why? I can guess because the "chef" doesn't know what he is doing. And, you REALLY shouldn't tell your patrons that.

The server was kind and took the meals off of our bill. Honestly, with the "Now Open" banner waving above you would think that they've been open for just two to four weeks. Nope. Like eight months!!! Eight months and you still haven't gotten it together!!?? 

I would not recommend this place at all. The emptiness of the restaurant speaks volumes.
Great food and excellent service! First time in today and will definitely return soon! Amy did great! Good job crew!
Great food!!! Second time eating from Yogurts and I got the 5 alarm burger and it had my nose running. More hot than any other place I've tried in Idaho.  It was awesome...

We ordered this for delivery and the guy brought the wrong order. After we chased him down and swapped for the right box it went downhill from there. They sent several wrong items and one giant bucket of sauce for both the sweet and sour chicken and the mandarin chicken. The portions were large but we didn't even bother to save the leftovers. They were very helpful when we called to complain and refunded half the purchase to our card. Even at 50% off I don't think it was worth it.

My wife and I are staying at a hotel in Boise. We read about MoMo's on Yelp! and are very happy that we gave it a try.  Absolutely delicious food, in large quantities and at reasonable prices. A clean restaurant with very helpful staff. We're looking forward to returning to Boise, so we can enjoy MoMo's again.

This place is amazing.  They're really good at what they do. Went here for the 1st last week after reading reviews and was very pleased.  So much better then the Supercuts are usually go to by the Home Depot on meridian. Scalp massage, shampoo, and they even so a neck shave. 5 's

Went through drive through with my mom.  She's disabled and has a really hard time getting out of the car.  She wanted an ice cream with three different flavors.  I didn't see any ice cream flavors listed so asked the drive through clerk.  She said they rotated them too much to have them listed.  I asked if she could tell us the flavors.  She proceeded to list them all, "chocolate, cake batter, peanut butter yoyo, cookie dough" on and on.  So many and said so fast we could barely remember them.  I told her we were trying to pick which ones and remember what she had listed.  She replied, "you could always get out and come inside and see the flavors." My disabled mom looked at me like WOW.  I had originally planned on getting an ice cream too, but was not interested at that point. 
We finally picked our flavors for her. 
Very painful process.  Definitely won't be back...

Four times my wife and I have stopped at the Bistro going to or after a movie. The service is horrible. Last night we gave it one more try. There may have been 20 customers and after waiting 25 minutes for our drink order, we left.

We loved our second vehicle purchase, as also the first at CarMax. We loved working with the honest, kind, helpful and conscientious sales associates, named Dave and Holden. The cars and trucks are competitively priced and popular makes and models. We would highly recommend doing business with the professional staff and receive excellent service at CarMax!

Gabriel built an addition of a master bedroom and bath and a deck.  The quality and attention to detail are outstanding.  He kept us informed, and saved us money whenever he could.  He's very honest and patient when we changed our minds. We plan to have him remodel our kitchen next

I haven't considered Denny's since I was a young-20-something... but my elderly mother wanted to go yesterday, so we went. We were the only customers there a lot of the time, and it was clean. The food was okay. 

The waitress was attentive, and did fine. Some advice for her, though: if you're going to tell an offensive (not to mention completely ignorant) joke about an entire group of people, maybe do it quietly instead of yelling it back to the kitchen staff. Just because I can't see you doesn't mean I can't hear you. Also, maybe don't tell a joke about a group that will make up a lot of your customer base. Also, maybe just don't tell bigoted jokes. 

I considered talking to a manager, but I didn't want to ruin my mom's meal.
Stupid I walk up and they say they will not serve a nerd. I scoff at them there deserve nothing it is 2.50 for a slice of pizza what an outrage!

It was amazing! Sydney was very nice and helpful while I was getting my trim and highlights. She was very patient even though this cut and highlight took over an hour. She is probably the best hair dresser I have ever had give me a haircut and highlights. I would totally recommend you to go here!

Sheesh....been here twice in the last year on a Saturday and it's frigging chaos. One server, which I felt sooo bad for, was running around helpless. Had been in the service industry this is really a turn off. Food is great, but the panic and long wait experience makes eating in atmosphere very uncomfortable. I will most likely come back but jesus, get two servers in there for the 11 tables!

Visited the 10 mile Rudy's tonight. Was very very happy with the service and the way they did the wedge salad  Emily was the bartender and she was extremely nice the whole atmosphere was great. We really enjoyed being there and our salad was amazing. We recommend this place to anyone and everyone.  We had a to go order and Brian was extremely helpful In making sure that everything was right, he went above and beyond.  We were there at around 8 PM and they were busy but very attentive to every one.

What an awesome little place. I was driving by and noticed they were open for sit down and I'm so glad that I did. The food, meat lovers omelet, was awesome, hash browns rocked and they have great OJ. The service was above and beyond and the prices were reasonable.
A+++ in my book.

Very accommodating staff. The entire area was booked. We booked online at the same time as someone else and it double booked the last room. The other party arrived before we did so we missed out on the last room in town. They had someone check-out just before we arrived so they quickly cleaned the room and upgraded us. Very friendly and helpful. Room was clean and nice. We thought the price was a little higher than average but it was nice place.
Service was great, food and drinks decent.  Very clean, spacious place great for everyone.  Prices were very reasonable!

Had really high hopes for this small locally owned restaurant. Ambiance is quite nice as is their wine selection. After having been there several times I can only say the food is hit or miss. The service definately needs to be stepped up. At our last visit our wine was poured without the opportunity to taste it. Not good style if you are spending upwards of $40 a bottle. Our meat was tough, advised the staff and no offer to replace it or credit our check was made. Please -- if you are trying to be an upscale restaurant give your staff some training. Probably will not try you again. Third strike, you're out.

I don't mind the occasional commute, it brings me back to the days when I lived in the Bay Area or in the San Diego area.  Clearly, our traffic or commute is nothing like that regardless of what the locals think.  I have made trips to the local Boise Co-Op in the north end area of Boise.  The funky old style grocery store was cool in many ways that brought the best and freshest to Boise. When it was announced that the Co-Op would have a store in Meridian, I remember all the furor and uproar.  " Why not Nampa? " " Gosh, Imagine the traffic! "  Anyways, the Co-Op opened to some nice crowds and a little fanfare.  The new store is bright, beautiful and very shiny but it does not remind me of the other location. It looks like a Whole Foods. I can't say if that's a good thing or not, but I was expecting a little more " little town Boise" instead of Corporate Meridian.  I am not offended by any means, but those who were looking for an extension of the store in Boise are out of luck. The offerings at the new store are completely upgraded. Looking for a grab go for any meal of the day? They have it. A hot Breakfast bar? Yep, How about a Cheese, bread, Meat section?  Yes Yes Yes.  Looking for homemade soaps and chemical free lotions for men.  Absolutely.  The Staff are just as friendly as the Boise store, and that's the only connection to it's older brother in Boise.  Will I continue to shop at the Co-Op in Meridian, Sure. I love the fact that I can find ACME or Gaston's bread plus the cucumber and Lemon men's lotion is a steal at $5.99.  If you are not a member, you should join. $65 bucks for a lifetime membership is worth it.  Before I go, There are classes that will rival Sur la Table but not Rosauers since Rosauers is $10 bucks but all-in-all, I'm glad the Co-Op is here.  Catch me with my Gaston's and my rice for making Paella.

This is a drive thru coffee shop. They have no seating; you can only drive in. The service has been quick and polite.

Every time to order a cup it comes with a complimentary chocolate covered espresso bean. I can't actually tell you if the coffee is good, because I hate coffee. My wife prefers this coffee compared to Starbucks because it's not bitter in her opinion.  

I like their milk steamers. They also have  a significantly large selection of sugar free syrups, which I prefer. 

Also, their cups are sized like they should be; small, medium, large. Rather than picking arbitrary pretentious names that I can't remember like other overrated coffee shops I won't name (cough, Starbucks)  they use conventional sizes and have reasonable prices. It has a simple menu with good options.

This place has been our go to breakfast brunch place for many years. It continues to have great food at reasonable prices. I especially like their omelettes. They have some unusual sandwiches that are always great to.

So I am not the type of person to post bad things, but this one tops the list. Sunday we were dying for chinese food, so we ordered from great wall, delivery. Yes I was aware of a THREE DOLLAR delivery charge, kinda spendy but I didn't have to leave. After an hour and a half our food showed up. Now please understand this might be a "pet peeve" but the driver parked in my driveway. He handed me the delivery and it didn't seem right, too much food, he insisted it was correct. I opened box number one, WRONG, box two, WRONG, egg rolls ?! didn't order those. So I called the store and explained my displeasure, the lady was less than interested. About ten minutes later the driver showed up again, again parking in the driveway. Guess what, our food was wrong AGAIN !!! So frustrated at this time we ate what we had vowing never to return. Oh by the way, the drivers car left OIL SPOTS as well.

We just had Gabe redo our master bathroom and in less then 2 weeks it's done.  He does great work and his prices are better then anyone we talked to.  We are very happy with our new bathroom and will be using him again for our next big project.  Gabe really cares about the work he's doing and always asks if we like it or want to change something.   We will be recommending him to all our friends for their future projects.  He will go the extra mile to make sure everything is just right! Thanks Gabe!

This is the best ramen in all of Idaho. The staff is great and the food is fabulous. The Tan Tan ramen is authentic and my favorite. I consistently come here for both lunch and dinner and have always enjoyed the food and atmosphere.

Terrible terrible and TERRIBLE! Never will come back some bigger blonde doesn't know how to serve ! I have food allergies and she has the balls to tell me I'm wasting there food because I'm allergic! Do not come here unless you want to drink I guess..

I love the food here! So yummy! However, tonight I had to walk out before ordering because the woman who was serving the food did not have her hair pulled back and it was long and hanging just over the food. I'd be happy to change my review if I receive confirmation that this food handlers violation is addressed.

I came in early in the morning and got my order taken (it was to go) and waited 40 mins to get my food yes 40 mins !! All the people that came in after me got their food, I would understand if the restaurant was full but it was half full !! Don't recommend
Great coffee from a local establishment.  Super friendly staff. Went in for a free coffee (from a punch card ) and the staff suggested I male it large instead of medium.  Nice touch.. Love this place
Nice place. Our food was great. The service was nice and friendly. We had salads. And shared a Prime Rib dip and the Mac and cheese with added bacon. Yum. We will be back.

Good small place for a good filling lunch or light dinner! The place is fun and welcoming and so are the servers who make the bowls right in front of you. You also get the option for spiciness levels or just sweet if that's how you like it.

This was my first time going to Einstein's and I was beyond impressed with the service, professionalism, and being able to sit in my car while my oil was being changed. I will continue going here and highly recommend their services!!
We had a GREAT exterior wash today for only $10!  They removed all the bugs from a long road trip the day before, blacked the tires, hand scrubbed and wiped down the exterior.  We were very pleased!

This review is for their burgers and fries. I had a Groupon and it was my first time visiting them. They advertise they have 100 percent pure angus beef no added fillers. I decided hey if your coming here you better order a burger. I ordered your standard cheeseburger with bacon and medium order of their hand cut fries with a side of cheese sauce. The burger was great full of flavor, bun was excellent, and the bacon slices were huge no itty bacon slices here. The fries were great as well the cheese sauce well only a small container didn't really cover all the fries. The customer service was great; both were friendly and outgoing. Service time was about 10-15 minutes which one would expect for a fresh burger. I'd go again for the burger it was excellent. My only compliant which might be prohibitive in the future is the cost. My total was $14 for a burger and fries that's a little steep in my book even though it's 100 percent angus beef. If your looking for a fun date night spot complete with yummy frozen yogurt don't mind paying a little bit for a great tasting burger this is the spot for you!!

OMG we had the ceasar salad. The NEW pork risotto!  And the pumpkin cheese cake.  All I can say is OMG it was so, so good!  We love the new items on the menu! Tart cherries  gnocchi too! And the cranberry drift is amazing! Love this bar!  It's the best! We love Cody, Sam, Tracy and Olivia!  Thanks you guys!

Schuyler, Chris, and the crew do an amazing job at taking care of every client. They did an awesome job on my wrangler upgrading and making it exactly what I was looking for. New wheels tires and a lift made my Jeep just what I wanted. I will be back and highly recommend them.
Yummy! I asked for light sauce and it was just right.  Excellent customer service.  A little pricey, but good pizza usually is!

Fantastic integrity in ownership!  The best customer service I've ever experienced in dry cleaning. The owner Henry really cares about making sure his customers are satisfied. Happy to support a local business who appreciates his clients!!!
I've been wanting to have some great Japanese ramen in Boise and Ramen Sho was delicious!!!

Met Clayton for the first time today. My daughter had her brows waxed. He takes the time to make sure they are symmetrical, not over waxed and trimmed them up perfectly. She loves how they turned out and even had him wax her upper lip. His prices are inexpensive and he really cares about the work he does. Clayton has a wonderful personality and we left with big smiles on our faces. We will definitely be returning and are no longer searching for the perfect aesthetician!

The food was delicious! My husband and I shared a savory (avocado chicken)and a sweet (red wonder something). They were both really good. Service was great, very friendly and very helpful. The reason only 4 stars is the price was a little high and location wasn't great, not much parking.

Very first time at Terri's, my suggestion GET THERE EARLY, or try to arrive before you are really hungry, there was a definite wait, even at noon on a Sunday. Once seated, the waitress was prompt, attentive and polite and the food was good, except for the fries, which were sadly stale, oil soaked and over cooked. I will say one thing, if you are looking for Eggs Benedict look no further, the hollandaise was so smooth, creamy and delicate, absolutely delicious. Overall, Terri's has a familiar and cozy feel and is a good place to sit and enjoy a "home-cooked" meal with friends and family. Will be back to try something new off the menu, which has an extensive selection of breakfast and lunch items. 


Oh! Don't forget the sparkling lemonades, they are yummy and refreshing, definitely a must try if you're feeling parched.

I went here once when I was owned by someone else and didn't care for it. I started going to another one close by, it was just ok. I kept telling myself "why am I paying for something and not feeling completely satisfied when I leave." I noticed this one has new owners so I decided to call and make an appointment. It is redone inside and the staff is amazing! I like how they have respect for people's time. If a walk in came in they let them know how long the wait would be, not just yes and leave them to sit and wonder. I highly recommend :)
Their heavy cream is perfect for cooking and their ice cream is delectable and creamy unlike any store bought ice cream around! Fun to check out with the family.

I brought a computer into Meridian Computer that is only used for photo-editing. It was top notch 5 years ago but needed a refresh to take advantage of the changes at Adobe and On1. The guys took a look at what I had, what I wanted as to improvements, and recommended a SSD drive, a large storage drive, to salvage one of the old drivers for a total of three and a new video card. I was not oversold, talked down to, nor did the shop try to impress me with their brilliance like a couple other shops I looked into did. The components were all fairly priced, the labor was very reasonable and the work was done in 24 hours. Time, quality and price, Meridian Computer hit them all.

Pros - What they serve tastes great. Tried several options and they were all good. 

Cons- their prices are INSANE. I definitely don't mind paying for good food, but for even the worlds best waffles (which these are not) their prices are outrageous in comparison to their portion sizes. My kids waffles were maybe 5 bites. So I paid over a dollar per bite basically. The adult portions were really small for the price as well, I was expecting a lot more. You are better off going to Joe Mamma's for waffles that are with their price and also just as delicious.

Service was very slow despite the fact that we were the only people there.

I would not go back unless they lowered their prices or increased their portion sizes.
Fantastic food! I loved the saffron rice, turkey momos and chicken curry! My husband took his dad yesterday and brought me today! We've all loved it!

They were very professional, kind and efficient.  I highly recommend them.  I was stressed out before calling them but they made me feel so at ease and led me through each step to get the paperwork completed and filed so I could get a fresh start.

Hats off to Rick Boyd for not only being passionate enough about beer to open a craft beer store locally but helping coordinate Boise's annual beer festival that has already proved quite popular after only a few years in existence.

There's really not much else to say about this place that hasn't been said. Part bar/part beer store, this is a place to come if you're looking for high-quality beer from around the world, be it to take home or enjoy there. They mostly dabble in single-bottle offerings but have multi-packs in the frig in the back. Plus there's a rotating set of beers on tap. It's a bit like Meridian's version of The Front Door bar in downtown Boise. They also host occasional events with beer tasting.

I guess the knock on them for me would be that between them, the Co-Op, and Brewer's Haven, I think they generally have the highest prices of the three. But it's not insanely higher, generally $.50 to $1 for the stuff I regularly get. If Brewforia is the closest of the three to you, it's not really worth the extra driving to get the savings. Plus it's a place to actually hang out at and enjoy your beer in a comfortable and relaxed setting. As it's the furthest of the three for me now after they moved out of their old digs on Milwaukee (and even after they open up a new location in Bown Crossing soon), I don't get there all that often. But I sure appreciate them being here.

Great to finally have Ramen in Boise.   We always try Ramen in Vegas, Seattle, Portland ....   Ramen Sho has Miso broth that is good (probably 3.5 compared to other cities).  Menu should provide options to add additional items.  Try this restaurant.

I really appreciate the nail techs at this salon, I've seen three of them and they are all perfectionist with nails.  I had my original set done at a salon in Eagle and they were horrible, so I decided to try 2Q for a fill and repair of my ugly nails.  They looked fabulous afterwards!
All 3 techs that I have used listen to my concerns and address them appropriately.  I have 'problem' cuticles and they are best taken care of before the fill.  I have a hard time with this request at prior shops over the years, but these guys at Q2 did exactly what I asked and my nails look amazing!  Their prices are fair and not overpriced, the techs are kind and talk to you, & I have always been able to get in without an appointment although they highly recommended that you make one.   Jason is my favorite tech.

I wanted to love this place so much. Originally being from the south, I was totally looking forward to trying it out. Menu definitely has southern intrigue. Interior is great, it's clean, farmhouse and a little industrial - very nice space! The service was good/friendly but kind of awkward - not necessarily bad but just felt like maybe this was her first go at this. The food was not bad in terms of edibility or quality but flavor was nowhere in sight. Everything was totally bland where it could have been big bursts of flavor. Perhaps owners/chef's should take a trip down to Nashville or Atlanta :] I am going to chalk the experience up to the fact that it is brand new and give them another try down the road, way down the road.

I've been wanting to write a review especially since I've been coming here for a while! I get my eye brows done and go NO WHERE ELSE. Clayton does an AMAZING job! I've gone to many other places here in the valley because of my move from the Bay Area. Clayton has such precession and it amazes me every time! He makes me feel like I'm his only client when he's working because of his extreme focus! I've also had my lashes done through him and LOVED them! I stopped only because I had my baby and couldn't continue coming regularly. I do plan to get them again in the next month or two and can't wait! Clayton makes me feel beautiful after every secession no matter what the service. Professional, clean and precise! Clayton 100%!!!
Good food great help. I ordered make your own. I ordered sausage, onion, peppers, mushrooms and olives. I will be back
Delicious burgers! We will be back! And the shakes! We did not get one but they looked amazing.

The buying process was a little long and not my favorite. I didn't like the preselected test drive route that didn't allow me to test the horsepower out on the freeway. I ended up finding a bunch of little and one important thing wrong with the car after purchase. So I went back and was rescued by the service department and their wonderful 30 day warranty. Danny Pinkston gets an A+++ for impeccable customer service. Made sure all of my concerns were addressed, even little cosmetic things, and it was totally free. Nice save!

I purchased a travel trailer several months ago from Camping World, the process was great and our Salesman (Jared) was outstanding! On to service....

I recently took my trailer in for its winterazation, I was greeted by Charlie Organista who went out of his way to explain everything and communicated findings/solutions in a expedited manner. Charlie is rock solid!

Charlie and Dave (product specialist) went above and beyond and I am very pleased with CW.

Thanks!

Nothing short of an explosion of flavor in your mouth!!! My family of 4 spent 15 minutes going over the menu - we couldn't decide. We ended up purchasing 5 meals for the 4 of us. The 8 am burger (stunning), Pecan French toast with caramel bacon sauce ( yes you read right - unfairly delicious) Breakfast quesadilla, Biscuits and gravy ( oh my) and the most amazing Bruschetta omelette with pesto sauce (nothing should taste this good) We crossed forks left and right as we reached for each other's plate followed by a moan with each new bite! Ummmmmmm!!!!

We were also entertained by Ray the waiter!! He made our visit a delight! It fun to go to an establishment where people actually enjoy their job!! He was hilarious!

You would regret it if you passed thru Boise and didn't stop to enjoy the food and environment!! I neglected to say, the place was cheerfully designed! I enjoyed looking around as we waited for our seat. The place is open, clean and delightful!! 

I wish we had one in Utah!! Well....maybe not....I'd be 50 lbs heavier, remember I was the one who ordered two plates because I just couldn't choose!

I could die over this food, it was absolutely amazing. I love that they do salty and sweet because when I went in I was feeling salty whereas my family was definitely leaning more towards the sweets. I had their grilled cheese waffle and it was absolutely amazing. Only issue is that is pretty expensive so this is more of a cheat day kind of treat.
pizza is very affordable for big slices and their garlic bread is to die for. 10/10 returning soon
Coffee is perfect and the staff is so sweet and fast! I have never had an order messed up or come out wrong here. No matter who makes my iced coffee it always tastes the same which is great! :)

There's BOBA in Boise?!! We got one order of lychee bubble tea which came in a sealed plastic up and fatty straws for the boba / tapioca balls. 

The drink was really milky instead of the syrupy ones that many Taiwanese cafes often have in LA (which are similar to snow-cones). They call it a smoothie here although our drink was more like coconut milk (but lychee flavored). It's hard to explain, but essentially it's more milky and smoother than most smoothies.   

While the tapioca balls aren't anything special (pretty flavorless) but the drink was good and had a subtle taste. I'd prefer it sweeter, but I'm not decreasing stars based on my personal preferences.

Didn't try the food, but there are many appetizing pictures on the walls to help you decide. 

The grand champion of teriyaki has a newly opened business in Meridian (there is already one on Vista in Boise).

Fun venue. Awesome wait and bar staff.  Lively atmosphere.  If you want to watch sports, you will love this place.  TV's are all over.  Tasty bar foods, huge nachos, full bar, and good selection of beer taps.  Karaoke on weekends. Pool tables.  Outdoor patio.  It might not look like much in this tiny strip mall, but get inside and you will love the employees and atmosphere!   Cheers!

Fast 
Friendly 
Price 
Fourth of July 2019, best service I've ever had at a sonic anywhere! Guy even checked back with me after a few minutes to make sure I was all set with condiments. Nice work!

My Experience 40 foot Monaco Executive Diesel 500 HP Cummins.
I as told that the coach would be ready to pick up on at 4:00 pm I received a call saying that they had the coach running and moved it around to detail it and couldn't get it started. They said that they ran the batteries down trying to start it and didn't have a working battery charger. They said it wasn't getting fuel.
The next morning I went to Camper's World to see what was going on. I was told that the engine wasn't getting fuel and they thought it was the lift pump that wasn't working. My son is a Diesel Mechanic and I called my son at work and had him talk to your Mechanic and told him to start by replacing the fuel filters.
I was told that she could pick up the motorhome later that day after they got it running. Later that afternoon I received a call saying that the starter wasn't working now and so needed permission to replace the starter. They still hadn't replaced the fuel filter so your mechanic didn't follow the instructions he was given. So as a result it is the mechanic's mistake that he took it upon himself to continue using the starter and ignoring instructions given by son. The starter was probably already damaged from the day before at this point anyway. I personally believe that he did not follow standard operating procedure of not running the starter for more than a maximum of 30 seconds and then waiting 2 minutes for the starter to cool before trying again as stated by Pearson Education Careers Item 1. Footnotes and Monaco Executive Manuel Item 2. Footnotes
THE BOTTOM LINE IS: The mechanic or staff at Camper's World should pay for the Starter.
The next problem I will address now is that Camper's World did not maintain the minimum charge to the house batteries as required to not damage the batteries.
 The batteries were so low that the panel to turn on the inverter was inoperative. I spoke to Monaco Technical Support and they told me that he was surprised that the batteries would even take a charge at all if the batteries are run down that much. The coach can charge all batteries but I was told by Ken that in the process of painting in your shop they had to turn off all power in the coach. There are 2 shut off switches in this motorhome as described in the operating manual. The first one and the one that causes the least amount of trouble is located at the door but it doesn't shut off all power from the house batteries in the coach. The second one or if the house batteries were disconnected then when power is restored the clock has to be reset so the generator will come on automatically when the charge in the house batteries are below the set point to protect the batteries. This was not done by your technicians. The other problem the inverter turns off when the power is shut off and needs to be reprogramed to charge and to run electrical in the coach.
Note: The inverter requires at least 8.5 Volts DC to operate the internal "brain."
I had checked with Cummins in Boise about getting a starter and they quoted at the time of $370.00 for a remanufactured starter model 3675293RX. Ken told me the price for a starter he could supply would be over $500.00, but when Linda told them the price from cummins was $370.00 he said he could match that price, so your mechanic installed the starter you were supplying but your place wanted another $300.00 to $400.00 to install the fuel filters so Linda from what had happened she had no confidence in your mechanic and decided to have her son install the fuel filters. Campers World then pushed the motorhome out on your lot with dead house batteries as explained above. Ken came to the rescue and hooked up a battery charger so we could get the generator started. I left when the generator started. The inverter was turned off so I had to program the inverter to charge the batteries. The generator ran from that night till the next afternoon (charging batteries) when James arrived to install the fuel filter which he did, and it was the primary fuel filter that was the problem. with the new primary fuel filter replaced the motorhome started and was driven away to his place to replace the secondary filter the next day. A wire had been left dangling from the rear of the coach which your mechanic had left hanging. This shop has no idea how to handle a large motorhome. Only bring them small gas motorhomes if you dare. They will do nothing about this so the message that they will respond with is only to make you think they will help. They will not Do anything about this. They should pay for the starter and replace the house batteries at no charge.

It's Dennys. Same corporate restaurant everywhere you go. Busy but fast. Always dependable to get you seated quickly and pump your food out ASAP. 

I still don't understand why they haven't started offering flavored coffee creamer like every other restaurant but that's just a pet peeve of mine. No matter where you go, Dennys takes care of you and that is comforting especially when you are traveling.

Went through the drive-thru of this Human Bean on Saturday afternoon.  Pretty decent cup of coffee, and just the right thing as a pick-me-up that I needed at the time.  Oh, the barista's were perky and fun, and offered the chocolate covered bean with the cup, which I love!  Thanks folks!
Pizza was okay but not "mixed" within cone so some bites were just sauce. Also - very speedy for amount of pizza you get. Cool idea though

My daughter and I finally had a chance to visit the Corner Bakery Cafe yesterday.  I had great expectations based on my experiences with the team and the owners and I was quite conflicted as to whether or not I should write to a review.  The deciding factor was that I would feel biased if I did not write a review.  The Caesar salad that came with the chicken dish was mostly all croutons and not enough dressing and Parmesan.  The chicken dinner was a chicken breast with tomatoes. My chicken was not hot  and it was a shame since it had so much potential if it was hot.  There were two pasta dishes of which one resembled 'shells and cheese' and the other was not recognizable. Again, both pasta dishes were not hot. Warm would have been acceptable but temperature was closer to chilled than warm. The price for these dishes was close to $26.00.  Our group of five left shaking our heads as to what we were missing or did we order incorrectly. When we checked the other reviews on yelp, it became apparent that this location suffers from inconsistencies in quality and temperatures. I would encourage the team at Corners Bakery cafe to review the feedback from the yelpers so that the business can learn from the issues and make Corner Bakery Cafe a destination for all of Meridian on a consistent basis.

I'm giving 2 stars because our waitress was great but wow, slow service and lackluster, at best, food. 
Cold soggy food wasn't worth the 1/2 hour wait. 
Yuck. 
Avoid!
So bad and terrible service,  2 kids 1 adult $35.   We will not be back.........save your money

Wanted to try something new while we were in town. Service was fast and friendly! Food was tasty, but not much like any Korean I've ever had before. Maybe it's not supposed to be?! We felt the sauce was a little heavy handed, but my kiddos loved the tofu and everyone enjoyed their meals. Four stars instead of five because most of us couldn't finish our meals, as the last few bites of rice were swimming in sauce.

What a fantastic place! I first walked into this Meineke location in 2005 and have been going there for work on all of my cars ever since. Jim (the owner) and his staff (Bill is his manager) are super conscientious people who provide great service at a great price. I don't want to sound like a salesman, but I honestly wouldn't take my cars anywhere else for service. The most important thing you need in finding a good mechanic (besides skill) is honesty. I cannot speak for anyone else, but I'll tell you that these folks at this Meineke location have treated my family and me with total honesty and respect with zero exceptions. All told, with oil changes, engine work, problem shooting, and many other types of service tasks performed on at least five different vehicles I've had, I believe they have worked on my cars at least thirty different times. I'm just as happy after those thirty times as I was after the first... just say'n!

The food here is pretty good but nothing mind blowing other than the prices and wait time for your food.  Went in on a Friday and waited 30 minutes for eggs that costed me around 15.00 bucks.  So if your time isn't worth money and you like over spending this is a great place to dine at.  Another thing that really annoyed me was if you wanna feel horrible while you eat they've also got pop up marketing for sick children at the table so you'll donate money to a good cause.  Don't get me wrong I'm all about charity, but don't throw that in my face first thing in the morning while I try and eat that's horrible!!
Came here for the first time, and had the fish and chips. We decided they are New Zealand worthy. Hands-down the best fish and chips in Idaho.  And I love getting a carafe of iced tea at my table!

We stopped by and ordered a large cheese pie.  Wait time was only 15 minutes.  Cheese and sauce ratio is good overall, not great.  What I'm looking for in the sauce is not too sweet but with a more tomato taste which this achieves.  My suggestion is more sauce and cheese near the edges and perhaps slightly more crispy on the bottom as it's a little under cooked otherwise, good pizza and the staff is quite friendly.  We'll try again and hopefully provide a better rating but for now, prefer Guido's in the battle of NY style around here.

I never knew how much fun it would be to rock shop, never knew rocks were cool.  Until I went to Victory Greens.  Toured their place this early spring, during a massive rain storm (yep had it in 4WD to avoid getting stuck in the mud!) and looked at all kinds of rocks.  Very pretty selection, especially wet. Drove around the place 3 times and visited the slab stones as well.  Found exactly what my mind had been dreaming about for 10+ years.  I was so excited for when the rains would stop and I could create the backyard of my dreams.  I just finished a few days ago, with beautiful Snake River rock and pebbles, shredded cedar mulch and lots of beautiful flowers and trees.  I really like this place for hardscapes.  I haven't ventured into the nursery, but plan on it this summer.

I was really craving Korean bbq and when I passed by this place I felt like trying it. So I decided to have it for din with my bf and I was really disappointed:( I am from San Diego , Ca and I have tried multiple Korean bbq places and most of them were the type where they give you the raw, marinated meat and you cook it yourself. This place the meat is already cooked and there are a handful of options and yes it did taste okay , BUT it did not taste anything like Korean bbq. I got the bulgolgi and it seriously tasted like cooked meat that was flavored with soy sauce and honestly this place is seriously Americanized food. The staff are super friendly and helpful, however I wouldn't go here again. I wish Boise had a Korean Bbq place that tasted authentic.

I love this place! It's clean, the food is fresh, the staff is friendly! But I have an issue spending too much money here because their hot food and beer selection is amazing! The mushroom bahn mi sandwich and roasted veggie burrito are delicious. If you like spicy foods, make sure to add their red chili sauce to either of those!

Love the good vibes. Always feels like home when we visit!

This place gets Busy! I mean cranking it out early in the morning!  If you think you can stroll in here between 7am and 830 am and walk out in less than 2 minutes good luck with that.  The reason?  They make great and varied drinks.  They also offer hot food items.  There is a full seating area and usually it is at least 75% full.  Drive through always has cars in it and there is a line inside.  How do I know?  I make large orders here several times a month (about 20+) drinks each time.  I send over the order via fax with an arrival time.  So while they finish off the drinks I am standing and people watching.  Drinks are made to order and they get it right every time.  I see regulars nearly every other visit.  The staff is friendly and they always have at least 4-6 staff members working.  If you want a place to sit drink coffee and get some work done this is your place.  If you are dashing and have about 5 minutes this is your place.
Delicious breakfasts with fresh squeezed Orange juice. Great service with a smile and a good family spot.

This is a huge shout out to Clayton!  I've been going to him for lashes since I moved here. Like all his clients mention in their reviews, he is Da Bomb!  He is meticulous, understands all about the services he provides and is an all around amazing person.  Besides lashes, I've also had two facials.  So relaxing and my skin is so thankful afterward.  Hands down, no competition, if you want a great aesthetician and lash technician, Clayton is your guy!

Seemed pretty low staff for the business level, the whole time we were there. We waited a few minutes to be acknowledged and then seated. The server was decent, but seemed annoyed to be there and complained to a number of guests and co-workers (we could hear) about various complaints, from management to customers. She was a fine server mostly, just seemed annoyed with everyone and everything (including us). There was a young gentleman there on the other side of restaurant and I wish we had been seated there- he seems genuinely nice and friendly and less agitated.

The food seemed to take a bit but wasn't horrible. The salad was fresh and the food was decent. Chicken nice and moist, burger was fine. Nothing out of this world but solid, especially for a Dennys. I felt the cooks cared about it at least, better than can be said at some places!

Not our best visit there but could have been worse.
Great service, so friendly, accommodating for my weird orders!!! The order taker and Anna, the cashier were awesome!

Great people, Friendly atmosphere,  only one problem.  I asked for extra crispy hash browns and they couldn't have been more raw if they took them right out of the freezer and slapped them on the plate.  The other items were perfect..so I will try again.

Pretty legit. The crust was crispy with a bit of New York flop, and a really nice chew. The sauce had a tang to it, which I liked a lot. Having lived in New Jersey and eaten a ton of pizza, in both New Jersey and Brooklyn/Manhattan, it was a good representation of a New York slice. 

As far as service, i called ahead and ordered a whole pie, and it was ready in about 30 minutes. I waited about 5 minutes at the window and was on my way. No complaints.

Needed some water damage repaired in 3 rooms so we called SERVPRO. Very friendly and quick to respond. An employee inspected the attic with almost no attic access, it was a very tight fit because we have a low pitched roof. From that information they provided a bid for services to be performed that I agreed to.  After the ceilings were removed it became clear that much of the damaged wood needed to be replaced and not worth cleaning up or repairing.  Called SERVPRO back out and an employee agreed that it would be better to wait until the roof was repaired by the roofing company before cleaning up mold damage. Problem is their company had already ordered the dry ice for the repair. They charged me for the dry ice even though their own employee recommended waiting. I trusted their initial recommendation to repair and then a different employee agreed that I should wait. That, plus a very vague invoice is why I wouldn't consider using this company in the future.
I didn't even get the 500lbs of dry ice they charged me for...

My stylist Sydney was amazing!!!  She lifted my mud brown hair to platinum & gave me a cut that makes me feel 10 years younger.  It took HOURS & she was meticulous, patient, funny, & kind.  I can't recommend enough.  My only criticism is they don't have WiFi... when you're sitting in a chair for so long it would be nice to have some online entertainment to pass the time.  Otherwise

This place has good food but it is WAY too expensive. The specialty cone is $7 and salads start at $6. The upside to the "make your own" is that you can have unlimited toppings but the size doesn't merit the price. They say it is the size of 2 regular slices of pizza but they must have measured a small pizza because it was not filling, but I wasn't going to spend another $7 for a second cone. 

They have ice cream cones for $5 a cone which still feels really expensive for the novelty of ice cream in a pizza cone. 

If the price was a couple dollars cheaper...this place would get 5 stars. It was good, just not nearly enough food for the price.

If the place was in a more diverse city it would be full every day. I've eaten Ramen in many cities around the world and this was very comparable. Tonkatsu was rich and hot and the Chicken Karaage was perfect. Highly recommended. don't let the older reviews sway you. Service was excellent as well.
