Love this place! The espresso has fantastic flavor, and the chocolate covered coffee bean... Yum! I tend to stop at the Maple Grove & Emerald location on the way to work and try to go on double punch day!

CupBop is a great idea and has a really cool atmosphere, however there food fell way short. I'm not a fan of all of the sauces and the JapChae noodles (I think that's what they're supposed to be) tasted like they were heated in a plastic bag. Meat was ok, but very very little was added. They load up a ton of rice and noodles, with a tiny bit of meat and smother it in your choice of creamy type of sauce. 

Some people may really like it, but I wasn't a fan. Two stars for the concept and cool atmosphere. Improve flavor, add more meat and you've got a solid idea.

My wife and I ate here by accident. The resturant we were going too had a long wait. We are not originally from here but arrived and live in Meridian from Nee York. Dakota our server was very friendly and careful not to ask me if I am from NY, very professional for one so young.
 I had the Alaskian cod which were large portions cooked perfectly. The fries were not great. My wife had french dip roast beef, she ate the whole thing which is unusual. I had tomato soup to try it. It was thick with fried basil leaf. Peppery good.

There were no salt or pepper shakers on any table. I am use to using salt and pepper on my food. There was no non alcohol auto refills or at least they didn't fill mine.
All and all it was a good experience in the historic area of Meridian Idaho. Good fun for a New Yorker.
worst subway ever. Skimpy portions, poorly made sandwiches. Second time with poor service and substandard sandwiches. Won't be back
My daughter and I live this place and are never disappointed! Always good food and good people!
this place has amazing amazing pizza and there meatball subs are the BOM DOT COM!! it's local and fresh and so so soooo good! always get meatball subs bad there's so good and taste amazing reheated!

Pretty chill place to eat. Came with some buddies from high school! It was a nice place to catch up and get some good food! Service was fast and helpful! I got a brisket sandwich on focaccia which was better than expected! Nice portion size meals! Will be coming back!
Been coming here since they have opened.  Henry and his team are always pleasant and our cleaning is ready when promised.  We have tried many but finally found a cleaners worth our business.

We have bought over 10 trees from victory and have enjoyed the experience every time. We had three trees that failed just after the one-year warranty Mark. I caught up with Tim the manager and shared with him the situation.

He volunteered to honor the warranty anyway which was really great and we appreciated that so much.

My four-year-old daughter was really interested in looking at some of the rocks that were there and we asked if she could take a few rocks home. Tim went above and beyond and gave my daughter a rock tour. My four-year-old daughter was absolutely delighted and got to go home bragging about all the rocks she had collected.  She still has them on display.

The selection here is great, the people are great and the prices are very competitive.   Always been impressed by the knowledge of the staff.

I would suggest a product called tree gator. This is a water bag that helps the watering process of a new tree. They don't sell it at victory but you can get it on Amazon.

This is, without a doubt, the best breakfast we have had in recent memory. And amazing gluten free options to boot! The GF pancakes were perfectly buttery and crispy (and I am picky about my pancakes). The huckleberry syrup was delicious and super fresh. Eggs and hashbrowns cooked to perfection and Kate, our server was attentive and lovely. My husband and I are BIG fans of breakfast and this place made our dreams come true.  If you are anywhere in the area GO HERE, you will not be sorry.

We found a decent deal on hotwire, we stayed here while driving through and when we checked in at 1130 pm the lady was so sweet & took care of us right away! Then next morning trying to check out the manager Erin, was the rudest lady I have ever met! I would not ever recommend this place to anybody because of this womans attitude, I thought customers were always right? Well I have never been treated so horribly! DO NOT STAY HERE!!

This place was very mediocre, not sure what the Decor theme is either. The food was decent. I asked for my eggs scrambled and they came out in one piece which was unsatisfying to eat and had absolutely no flavor. The country fried steak was over cooked as well. My waiter personally was not great, saw him 3 times. Once to take my order, once to deliver my food where I was able to get a coffee refill, and one last time for the bill. Normally I wouldn't complain about the wait staff except they were very slow and I would have thought I'd get more attention. Gave 3 star because in my opinion it's not different than a Denny's or ihop. I would try it again in hopes that it was just a one time deal.
Great food. Even better customer service. The burger was cooked perfectly and so juicy. Candied bacon was a great touch.

Sheesh....been here twice in the last year on a Saturday and it's frigging chaos. One server, which I felt sooo bad for, was running around helpless. Had been in the service industry this is really a turn off. Food is great, but the panic and long wait experience makes eating in atmosphere very uncomfortable. I will most likely come back but jesus, get two servers in there for the 11 tables!

Absolutely a scam! I cannot believe I thought the smooth talking salesman knew what he was talking about! Pre made hard inserts! A piece of plastic worth about a buck!  Assured they would get more comfortable if I wore a bit longer each day. Terrible pain that got worse by the minute. Exchanged 3 times and finally gave up! The "nice" salesman refused to return my money. In store credit andone can buy tennis shoes there most likely worth $20 for $135.00!!!  Go to a reputable store this one is not! Please stay away there are many stores that treat foot pain that are knowledgeable. This one is not!! 

After reading my post Good Feet decided to return my money. I do appreciate this but one shouldn't have to post a negative review to have their money returned.  Thank you for the refund. Diane Evans

We tried Terri's Cafe based on the Yelp reviews and can say the reviews are right on. We were seated promptly upon entering the restaurant and were offered coffee right after being seated. Our server was very friendly and attentive. The breakfast was delicious and cooked just right... props to the cook! I will definitely go back on my next trip to the Boise area.

I always wanted to try this. I was told about form a colleague of mine in Lansing Michigan. I ordered a plane cheese coned. It was big. I had mixed feeling for it. Not sure if I would go out of my way to get one. I probably should try a vegetarian one next time or something with chicken.

Of all the places this food truck could open up a storefront, they do it in the town where I live - Eagle, Idaho. Yeah!

Tucked away in the northeast corner of Chinden and Linder, where the Fred Meyer is. Take your pick of several bowls built with different ingredients. The gig is rice, veggies, meat (or not), and sauces to top it off that you pick your heat level from 1 to 10. I haven't ventured past level 2. My favs so far are the Korean beef bowl and the Doochi, which is kimchi and tofu on top of the veggies and rice. 

Grab a fountain drink and have a seat while watching K-pop on the TV. Make sure and leave them a tip and there's a very good chance they'll hook you up with some free Mandoo (potstickers).

Took my wife and family here today for brunch.
Doughnuts were hard n cold,not worth the money..
We all ordered Benedict's.
The muffins are fantastic.
We all had poached eggs that were hard?? All of us.
The bacon is fantastic and the meats are great.
Good place , atmosphere....someone needs to show them how to cook poached eggs!
Love this place, I never leave feeling disappointed. Consistently great food and service. One of Boise's best breakfast spots!

Ooh my word !! I have waited so long to try Johnny Bronx Pizza & I absolutely loved my pizza, meatballs & red sauce are awesome,customer service was great! It totally hit the spot, oh yes & ice cream sandwich was perfect for dessert! Looking forward to trying a new flavor! Thanks again Johnny Bronx ! Kristi

First time guest and I'll be back often. Thanks Dalton for the amazingly special hand-crafted rum tiki cocktails!! They made my dinner that much better. You should get a day raise because I can see how much love you put into each drink you made. I miss this kind of service. I have to admit, we love Chandler's and now this place tops our list now as well! Food came fast. Presentation was spot on. Everything on the plate was perfect. All around friendly people working here. Welcome to the neighborhood and looking forward to visiting on Tiki Tuesday. 
Kathi S.
Great food and selection of organic grub. And they now have GURU donuts. We love the selection of fresh baked breads and the hot foods. They have raw milk as well which is so good.

READ THE FINE PRINT!  Ad for the motorhome said it came with 32 inch plasma tv, gas bbq, coffee pot and the hot water heater was gas/electic.  None of this was in the motorhome when we arrived.  Sales manager said he didn't want to hide behind legal fine print but the ad did say that the options listed were not necessarily accurate.  Then he hid behind the fine print; he was not willig to make good on any of this.  We traveled from Olympia WA to Idaho on the word of this dealership in order to buy this motorhome.

CAMPING WORLD SUCKS!

Okay so this place has really grown on me. It took me a few times going in on social media coupons but quite frankly I got to where I actually quite like it and want to go there more often. It's different than most traditional places around town and I like that. Owners are super nice! Thanks guys!

This is the Lucky Perk I visit most! Lucky Perk is my absolute favorite of all our local coffee shops, and consistent across the board, no matter which location I'm going to. Why are they different? They feature a rotating "dessert" brew each day. No cals, lots of flavor, great aroma. I love love LOVE their dessert drips! Plus, customer service is ON POINT across the board. They are MY spot!

Food: The oatmeal is very good! It comes in a coffee cup with your choice of mix-ins (almonds, brown sugar & cranberries--you pick 2). It's not fancy but I really like that it's house-made, not a HUGE portion and not pre-packaged. I love that they also offer a wide variety of meals (oatmeal, burritos, salads) and pastries. The breakfast burritos are very good... they're heavy and very filling. They offer different flavors (the bacon, egg & cheese is yummy!) and serve with hot sauce if requested. The cinnamon rolls are homemade by a local gal and are SO GOOD! She does a really nice job! The frosted sugar cookies are the icing on the cake. You won't be disappointed.

Drinks: The dessert brew! They do a good job with their lattes, hot chocolates and tea variety as well, but I love the dessert brew. It's a new flavor each day. They also serve a decaf gingerbread tea that is so great... make it a "London Fog" by adding a splash of milk!

Atmosphere: They are always very nice and cozy for a casual catch-up date or just a solo study session. I like the tables (high and low options) and the comfy couches. There's always a variety and the fireside seating is also a bonus. Plus, they're so close to many other stores/shopping at this location that you can be pleased no matter what your mission involves!

Service: The service (and dessert brew, of course!) is what keeps me coming back. The staff is always friendly, upbeat and smiling. 

Happy Hour Offerings: n/a though they do have punch cards & text club

Healthy Hack: The dessert brew is a flavored coffee with no cals. Bonus! If you're looking for a light but satisfying meal, ask for the oatmeal. It's an appropriate serving and won't tip you over the edge on calories, sugar or cost!

Tips: Ask for the dessert drip! It's a rotating flavor ranging from vanilla to almond, etc. No cals, lots of flavor, amazing aroma. Join the text club for deals and discount alerts!

I was disappointed my daughter & I went and the nice hostess informed us "we also have fresh squeezed lemonade" we were excited. When we got our lemonade it was sprite with a squeeze of lemon with a slice of lemon as a garnish. Fresh squeezed lemonade is lemon, water & sugar NOT sprite. When I told hostess her response was "oh." Plus they charged me $2.99 per glass. The price would be fine if it was actually FRESH SQUEEZED LEMONADE. 

My daughter ramen noodles weren't cooked completely. 

I so want this ramen restaurant to work out in Boise but don't advertise something and give customers something else.

Very helpful, and friendly I wish they would have coffee flavored yogurt. I really like the girl who is studying forensic science, she was very polite. 
Signed, Sam and his daughter Daisy. 

Ouch. This last stop in my lip was cut by their sharp plastic spoons! Ow.
Not good, wired my slideout wrong, and now I have a short circuit...Very unresponsive and slow.  I can not get a call back.
Fun different way to eat Pizza! We all had the BBQ chicken, it was tasty and the crust was done to perfection.

Initially found the Gridlle when I travelled through Winnemucca. I was impressed. I have been disappointed by this location. The portions size verses the price don't add up. Service is friendly and place is clean. Food is tasty but value is the downfall.

It's not the nearest lube station to my house, but they really well and we're efficient in servicing my vehicle. I've tried other places and this location did very well by me! Since I came in on a Wednesday I received free windshield wipers! Better than Einstein's!

Ordered sandwiches , pulled pork sandwich great .
Store very clean and everyone very nice and helpful

This place is a rip off and not only that if you notify them that you want to cancel the only way you can cancel is showing up in person and begging them to cancel.

I had to move and forgot to come in and cancel so I let them know I moved out I can't come in.  

There was no way to cancel this place.  If you do not follow the strict rules in the "contract" you will be auto billed, if you cancel that, they will turn you over to collections and not only that they will threaten to take you to small claims court.  

My suggestion is stay away from this place they will rip you off one way or another.

The service department at this dealership gives the worst customer service I have ever experienced. The service techs and managers do not return phone calls, it takes forever to schedule service and they do not complete the work properly on the work scheduled with the department. Do yourself a favor and schedule your service at Camping World Caldwell (with an excellent customer service department).

If I could, I would give Ramen Sho 3.5 stars. It is a very tasty ramen shop but it suffers from the growing pains of many newly opened restaurants. Odd staffing, a limited menu, and a vibe that signals it just hasn't quite found its stride. 

On its own, the ramen is quite good. Ramen snobs will most likely complain about the thickness of the noodle, the inability to order more noodles for your broth, and mediocre ajitsuke tamago (the soft boiled and marinated egg you find in ramen). The chashu pork is also not quite up to par when compared to more established ramen shops. 

The tonkotsu broth is quite flavorful though and the gyoza are also pretty good. 

Right now, Ramen Sho only serves tonkotsu, Miso, and Shoyu broth. Hopefully, they will add shio and curry ramen at a later point. Gyoza is also the only appetizer available and hopefully that will change at some point. Karaage would be a welcome addition. I would also like the menu to allow for the ability to add extra or varying ingredients to a bowl as desired. 

But I say all of this knowing that Ramen Sho has only been officially open for two days and there is a lot that will most likely change as the shop comes into its own. I for one will go back again in a week or two and probably a few more times after that. Boise sorely needs a good ramen shop and I wish Ramen Sho the best!

My husband and I shared the Dulce.  While tasty, it wasn't anything special.  There just wasn't anything about that you couldn't get someplace else.  There is just other food that tastes better for better price. We probably will not go back.

On the way to Meridian, just out side Boise since the mid 1970's we stopped at the dairy to get cheese, and the largest bowl of ice cream I every saw!!! And it was delicious...
Always busy,always fun...very clean and friendly. Our family memories always bring up cheese and ice cream from Reeds. And they also had a gift shop. As time passed, we were part of their evolution by observation. Fun stop for being hours on a road trip.
It was a great experience! The window girl Natacia was very nice and friendly. She have great options for a warm hot drink. Will be going back.
We tried Tako-yaki appetizer today, taste very yummy, the Raman are as good as always!

I went there for Memorial Day to celebrate my friends birthday. We had a long wait but we didn't mind. When we finally got seated, the waitress was friendly. Took our order and then we waited. Four cups of coffee later (at least an hour) Not kidding. Now it was ridiculous. When we asked, we were told that they were short handed. "They didn't expect so many people that day". When we got our food, the toast was burned, the portions were mashed together. The whole plated meal was a mess. I was so disappointed that I had chosen this place to celebrate my dearest friend.

This cafe is now one of my favorite breakfast spots. It's not too fancy but the food is excellent and staff are very friendly. Make sure to try their marion berry or huckleberry pancakes, they are fabulous! Also love the extra large coffee mugs!
Service very friendly. Very good taco omelette. We go on Sundays and the wait is not that bad 10-20 min. You can have coffee while you wait.
Awful! Very disappointed. We were the only ones in the place and don't feel that we were given fresh waffles. The chocolate wasn't even completely warmed in one of our waffles.

This has to be the worst Denny's I've ever been in. I went here on my Birthday so my grand Slam was free, I ended up letting my wife order it because I always get the chicken wraps with fries. Besides taking forever to get our meal, my wife upgraded the regular pancakes for the cinnamon roll pancakes which looked nothing like the picture in the menu and the whole breakfast was cold. I ordered the grilled buffalo chicken wraps which came with no buffalo sauce and the fries were under cooked. In the end the bill was $6 and some change. I still left a tip based on what the meal would have normally cost because our waitress Edwina was a hoot, was very attentive and gave us great service.

The meal was worth $6.00 though cuz the grand slam was free, that's why I didn't complain to the manager.
Love the work they put in here, but way too over priced these days.  They used to have a good rate, but those days are gone.

We made reservations for a Valentine's dinner. When we arrived the hostess turned her back on us and when she finally walked us to "our" table, it ended up being a communal 8 foot long bar table with other groups at each end of the table. So, apparently we were to spend our Valentine's with complete strangers. We asked if we could have a private table and she rudely announced that those tables were reserved. I reminded her that we had reservations, but she simply put the menus at the spots she had deemed were good enough for us and walked away without acknowledging it. (Note that there were 4-6 tables that were empty before we arrived and were still empty when we left)  It was interesting to have the couple seated closest to us tell us "If it makes you feel any better, she just did the same thing to us". I currently have a broken back and am in a back brace. The bar high chairs were excruciating for me. Normally, I would have tried one more time to be moved, but she had made it clear that she refused to help us. 

We ordered from both the regular menu and the Valentines menu. For appetizers, we tried both the Popcorn Calamari ($10.50) and the Bistro Meat and Cheese ($14.00). The calamari were soft, perfectly fried and the sauce was great. The meat and cheese "tray" would be a joke if they hadn't charged $14 for it, making it not at all funny. There were 2 pieces of cured pork (could have been a beef, it wasn't identified) 3 thin slices of salami, 6 pieces of baguette and 4 tiny cheese wedges that, if combined, would not have totaled a 1"x 1 1/2" square. 

My husband ordered the Beef Tournados, which was fine, but there was a very small amount of beef on one thin potato cake. He did compliment the potato cake, but there was supposed to be beets and there were just about 5 - 1/4"x1/2" pieces. How does someone justify charging $19 for that?

But the worst dish of all was my Shellfish scampi. I looked up "scampi" in the dictionary and it didn't mention hard, overcooked, rubbery shrimp. The linguini was so overcooked that it was a mush with peppery wine sauce. That's all it was. I felt like I had wasted an opportunity for a special Valentine with my hubby of 40 years and was beyond disappointed. When the waiter asked how it was I said "alright" and he asked if it was "just" alright. I said yes, he left, brought the bill and didn't say another word to us. In any fine establishment with good front of house training and service, the manager or chef would have come out and spoken to us, but no one showed up. It was amazing to think about even giving the waiter 15% at that point, because he could have been honest with us about any of these dishes and we would have taken him seriously. Instead, out of 4 items, we had one decent item. 

Please keep in mind the options around this place. Kona Grill, Twigs Martini Bar and Bistro, YardHouse, Goodwood, and dozens of others. This would never be an option for us again. One star is the lowest they allow you to rate, or this would be NO STAR.

It was UNANIMOUS!  All of us enthusiastically agreed that's the best Chinese food we've ever had.  The special (combo) fried rice had just the right level of moistness.  All vegetables were beautifully bright, tasty and tender-crisp.  The bok choy was served as full, very young stalks.  Who'd have thought that after living in New York, Houston & D.C. that the best Chinese restaurant is The Great Wall in LANDLOCKED IDAHO!  
We loved the ease of ordering online, using the EAT24 app to track the order and delivery, and having the food arrive hot with super-friendly service!  Our new favorite!  BEST Monday Night Football food ever!
Jordan in the drive thru was amazing and the drinks were awesome! Coming back again for sure! Great customer service!

Omg the caramel rocky road is the best ice cream I have ever had in my life! And that's saying something! What a cool little spot! The young kids working in there are so warm and friendly which is refreshing :)

If I could leave zero stars I would. The worst possible experience you can have with purchasing an rv. Please whoever sees this review, turn around and go to Bish's rv right next door or anywhere else. We are getting a lawyer involved with our situation. They sell half assed built campers and expect you to bring it back to get fixed. Then you'll wait 8 months to get the damn thing fixed and in turn you waste all that warranty time. Please save yourself a headache and a half, go somewhere else to get a camper!!

go get some delicious pizza from Johnny Bronx in Merdian by Rocky Mountain HS. This place is a drive by, grab and go by the slice place and the pizza can't beat. 

I had the pepperoni with sausage and olives, white pizza, and the Mac n' cheese pizza. The special sauce (mob sauce) is out of this world.

We go to Reed's for our milk every week - frequently walking away with a quart of hand-packed ice cream as well.  It is my firm opinion that they have the best ice cream in the area (we moved here from Vermont and are hard to please), and the grilled cheese & tomato soup combo are also a favorite. The staff are always very friendly and happy to help and I'm pretty sure they all know our faces by now.
This was the best experience I have ever had with an oil change. Upon arrival I felt I had gone back in time to an old full service Texaco station. It was awesome

I come to Meridian every 3 years and this time I want to make sure I hit the non chain restaurants.  After looking at the reviews for this place I had to make stop in and try the Caribbean French Toast.

Since it was a weekday, there was no lines and you seat yourself.  The staff greets you once you step through the 2nd door and the next thing I notice is how clean the place is.  The decor is bright and welcoming.

The servers let you settle in for a moment and ask you what you'd like to drink.  In a few moments they return with your drink and let you know the special for the day.  I knew what i wanted...Caribbean French Toast with side bacon.

Within minutes your plate arrives and it looks deelish.  Then I notice the side order of bacon, 4 meaty pieces.  Immediately I start cutting up my french toast and poured the syrup over it.  I try not to drown it because I want to taste more of the french toast.  OH - EMMM - GEE, I was in heaven, the first bite was so tasty and fluffy and cooked all the way through.  (some places you still see the yoke-ness still in the middle).  And the bacon, did I mention how meaty it was - cooked too perfection not burnt nor flimsy.  

This was so good I returned the next day since it was my last morning in Meridian.  Once again, it was cooked perfect and tasting the same as the day before.

Nice local chain coffeehouse. This was my first time stopping by this location. I've been to the location off Cherry. 

They have a pretty good drink selection and some decent pastries (cookies, scones, and a couple items from Zeppole bakery). I got an iced americano and a blueberry scone. Americano was good and strong with four shots. The scone was pretty good warmed up. Crunchy outer edge and soft in the middle.

The baristas were all really friendly. It would be nice if they opened a location closer to Boise.

I've been here twice now and both times I found the food and service lacking in a significant way.

First, I understand they exist to serve the theatre however, they also set up as a restaurant so the expectation I have is no different than any other restaurant. 

Both times I've visited they've been out of several items on the menu. I'm sorry, unless something is a special and not a staple, restaurants shouldn't run out of core items. Especially during the holiday season when they can reasonably assume they will be busier than usual.

Each time the food I ordered was served warm not hot. The amount of time it took to get my order left me imagining that it had been cooling under a mediocre heat lamp while the servers were doing ... I'm not sure what exactly.

The service is slow and sparse, you'll wait forever to have a refill on your water and forget about needing to order quickly, you'll be seated and it will take five to ten minutes for someone to come talk to you and take your order. But be prepared, they probably won't have what you order so then they'll walk away while you look at the menu and amble back over in another five to ten minutes.

The food quality is average and the prices are what you'd expect at Twigs or Kona Grill for a much high quality food and experience.

I think next time I'll opt for a hot dog from the cinema snack bar.

If you go there for the first time make sure and tell them and they go overboard and make your experience that much better, great energy great food dad is super unique and fun to eat. Very impressed I don't live anywhere near the one location they have very excited for them to expand in the valley

In some ways, this is your typical self-serve fro-yo situation.  Cups stand at the entrance to a line of several flavors of frozen yogurt that you may mix and match to your hearts content. This is followed by an array of the usual toppings for you to top your mix-matched delight.

There are a few things that, to me, make Yogurtz a cut above the rest:

1.  All the self-serve toppings are in containers with a scoop for you to top with your desired amount.  This may not seem terribly unusual, but some of the other places in town have these canisters on the wall where you twist a nob and your chosen topping is dropped into your cup.  You have little control over the amount and I've had a ridiculous mountain of mini-m&m's descend on my poor unsuspecting swirl of fro-yo.  This is annoying in 2 ways:  
                                  a)  The mini-m&m to fro-yo ratio is rendered totally unacceptable.
                                  b)  Topping are heavy and now my fro-yo is stupid expensive.
But, the point here is:  Yogurtz doesn't have that system, so my fro-yo is always topped exactly how I like it.

2.  The atmosphere is upbeat.  It's large and there are always people enjoying their fro-yo in good cheer.  There is even a party room and very often a party underway.  

3.  There is plenty of seating.

Their yogurt is not as tart as some of the other places in town (which some will enjoy and some will not).  It always seems to me to be a bit on the sweeter side--though not overly so.  

It's always clean and the workers are pleasant and efficient. 

I should mention (though I may be the only one who cares about this):  They don't have mini-m&m's but rather the regular sized m&m's, which I don't like as well as a fro-yo topping (I don't know why this makes a difference--but, really, it does!).

Other than that small snafu, a fabulous frozen yogurt experience.

Get to it!

I am a big fan of John Hardy silver jewelry and Simmons has the best and biggest selection of any store in the Treasure Valley.  Both Jay Simmons and his son Blake are very knowledgeable about their trade. They are very courteous and welcoming when you enter the store.  They will also clean up any silver jewelry you bring in and make it shiny again!  The space itself is very bright and the display cases are attractive and well arranged.  

I would highly recommend this jeweler to anyone looking for a  gift or a pair of earrings, bracelets, rings, necklaces that will make any occasion special!

I went with my son to buy a new trailer and my son told the financial manager that he likes camping because he is a disabled veteran and he can stay for free in Oregon camp sites. I was shocked when the manager said you don't look disabled to me and then told us a story about some college football players that lied and got disabled parking permits. My son went through a lot of things in 2003-2004 when he was in Iraq. And I was stunned that he said those things. But that was not all by a long shot. He kept pressuring him to buy this damn insurance. I finally had to say to this clown how many times do we have to say no. But there was more to come they raised the price $2000 from the agreed upon price for the trailer $13999. And oddly enough the $13999 is on the website. So we had to spend 30 min to straighten this out . I would stay away from this place they are rude slippery liars.

I have had the worst experiences there at every level. I had my 76 airstream winterized. We were charged and told they couldn't do it. I attempted to purchase a new RV there, they didn't even bother to call me back after visiting. I tried to purchase a grill that could hook up to my camper (that I purchased from a place that did return my call). I couldn't get anyone to help me. I decided to give them another chance. Today I called to ask if they could do warranty work. The lady, who was initially nice, got really short with me when I told her it was under warranty at another place. She immediately stopped and very rudely stated no, and if they could I can't get an appointment for three to four months. I called Bretz and the man who answered was very nice and offered to have someone call me on Monday. I am done with Camping World.
Great waffles. Nice friendly staff flavors are great. Wish they had a larger menu. Nice clean environment with plenty of seating.
Service was good. Food was WAY over salted & overdressed. Probably won't return. I'm missing Flat Bread Pizzeria right now.

It's great to see the addition of Ramen Sho. I especially enjoyed the Tan Tan ramen. Spicy and delicious, and hard to find outside of Japan or California. 

Service is also prompt and very friendly. 

Shige's is a wonderful unique combination of authentic Japanese eats and Boise flavors, and so is Ramen Sho. 

Highly recommended.

When we came here to eat dinner, they had been open for 2 weeks. They have nice decor and atmosphere. It's a seat-yourself kind of restaurant. We were greeted and given the menu which was pretty simple, and we liked that. There were 2 tables filled when we arrived at 7:30. It took them forever to make our food and they were not busy! One of my girls ordered the sliders off of the kid's menu. The slider has mini biscuits instead of a burger bun and it comes with fries. My other daughter ordered, in my opinion, a very expensive meal. This is because it's the same size as the kids, but costs more. They also forgot to give her the side that comes with the meal. We ordered Fried Green Tomatoes for appetizers and they were decent. All of their food was a OK.

Brought my coach in for some extended warranty work. When dropping it off I was assured it could be done with my 3 week timeline.  I called in weekly to the service dept but could actually NEVER get them to pick up or call back.  Ended up driving in to check on the progress.  Nothing was done in 3 weeks except getting charged for diag.  Asked if simple slide service was done - Was assured it was and heard a long winded explanation on why it was more money than originally quoted. Warranty work could not get done on other items because "parts are at least 8 weeks out".  Paid for slide service and diagnosis rip off and went to leave.  Checked slide and nothing seemed done.  Went back in and grabbed my service rep and a tech to check it out.  The tech said - we never serviced this slide? 
Rep acted shocked and said I could come back in for a 1 day turn around on the slide.  Caught them in a total lie and was charged for service that didn't actually get done!.  BTW called the local freightliner guys and they had the needed parts and could give me a one day turn around for the other items I wanted done.  Bottom line my opinion is that the Boise Camping world service dept reps are at best completely inept and have NO CLUE on how to run their business.  PLEASE go ANYWHERE else if you need service. Don't let them rip you off.

Wife and I had the Pork Momo and Meat Balls Makhani.  The MoMo's (dumplings) were flavorful, especially with the available sauces.  The Makhani were well seasoned.  Overall a texture and flavor balance - however, given the very limited menu, just not certain if Momo - Food of the Himalayas will bring me back time and time again.  

Overall would recommend giving MoMo's a try, if nothing more than to sample favors from the Himalayas.

First time in, and have to say that it's the best espresso I've had in Boise. I ordered a breve and a BLT, then camped out for a few hours to get some work done.  The espresso was 5 stars without question.  The BLT was fine - nothing to write home about (go to 10 Barrel if you want a life-changing BLT...fried egg...Mmm...), but then again, it was only $7 and this isn't a full restaurant.

Atmosphere was great for studying or working (I was on a couple conference calls, no issues even though there was a normal amount of noise in the cafe).  Easy parking, really chill owner running the place, and last but not least - a really funky bathroom.  Sounds strange, but I like a place that puts some thought into the water closet.  I don't want to simply tinkle...I want to be ENTERTAINED! 

The owner is young, and clearly a lot of friends / peers come in to say hi.  I like that atmosphere, and I also like that it didn't slow down the service or seem like it was his own exclusive super special tree house.  

Menu is pretty small - bagels, sammies, eggs and bacon, and some baked goods.  Come here for the amazing espresso and the atmosphere.  Looks like there are several outlets spread out for laptops (I think other reviews dinged them on this), so you're good to go for a place to do your laptop commando shenanigans.

Not the best frozen yogurt I've had, but ok. Lots of flavors and toppings. They don't let you get your own sample. The person working has to do it for you :( I get it, but it takes forever and is just stupid. Where the yogurt is, felt really cramped. It was busy and I wanted to get out of there, so I didn't get the samples a wanted. Don't think I'll go back. U-swirl is much better.

I have tried the shoyu and tonkatsu so far and they were both delicious. The pork belly portion is on the small side, but they are still only in a soft opening so they may just have underestimated the amount of food they would sell. So far they have been open 2 days and have had to close sale due to selling out. I will be coming here regularly.

Although my wife and I have eaten and prepare a large variety of Asian dishes, I do not claim to be an expert on ramen, but if what we received on Wednesday night is indicative of ramen restaurants, I may need to pass.
My wife and I ordered a bowl of the Tonkotsa ramen to share, when it arrived, there were a few things that stood out. First it was only lukewarm, certainly not what we wanted or expected in a bowl of soup (or noodles.) The broth had a white look to it, not close to the clear broth we were expecting. The initial taste of the broth was quite good, but after several bites both my wife and  I soon grew tired of the taste, as it seemed to pick some unusual after tastes. And we would have better served had we fished out most of the pickled ginger before stirring the broth, we use a lot of ginger, but this was way too overpowering.
We had also ordered the Karaage, Japanese Fried Chicken. Our waitress explained it was pieces of breast meat- deep fried. It certainly was not breast meat, but thigh and very dark thigh meat at that. My wife did not mind it, but I did not care for the taste at all. 
Will I try a ramen place again? Certainly not this one, maybe somewhere else.

They are not ASE certified mechanics and give false quotes for unnecessary work. Our oldest son just turned 18 and brought his car here for just tire rotation. He came out with $800 quote saying struts all lose and car wont make it far, should be fixed right away. Thankfully he called while still at Commercial Tires and we talked our son out of paying for the repairs right then. Within a week we had vehicle into ASC Certified mechanic, Bronco Motors and they physically showed the car while on the lift not a thing was wrong with it. Commercial Tires was just out to make money off of a young child ... Terrible service and dishonest.

I've been to CupBob a couple of times and have been fully satisfied every single time. The prices are a little high, however the amount of food they give you almost guarantees leftovers.They have plenty of options to find the perfect Korean dish for each person. The customizable level of spiciness allowed me to have the perfect meal without it being bland or overly hot. The atmosphere of the restaurant may not be for all, but I found it hip and easy to dine and spend time in. I'm already looking forward to my next meal there.

It felt like buying from a private owner but with the relief of knowing you aren't getting a lemon!  Joe didn't pressure me at all and they are very thorough with reviewing your paperwork at the time of purchase.  Thanks CarMax!
Awful... got a gel manicure and felt totally rushed worst manicure I've ever gotten in my life. I hate looking at them  don't come here

I went here looking for a new car and got the run around not for a day, not for two days but for THREE DAYS! I reserved the car the day before and while he was taking my application another salesman was showing the car to another couple!!! They don't have a large inventory  I was actually surprised at how tiny the lot was. I provided all the required documentation they requested and had several items that showed my physical address because I receive mail at a PO Box and they still wanted more. I gathered up all the items I gave them and drove straight to Tom Scott Toyota in Nampa and left with a new car and a better deal and with all the same docs the clowns at CarMax couldn't figure out! Tom Scott Toyota rocks!!!

I had a terrible experience at Meridian Carmax. I had a 7 pm appointment and showed up on time. My "salesperson" was just starting with a new customer. Why'd they even bother to give me appointment. I let my displeasure known about my lack of an appointment and there was eye rolling throughout. 
So eventually I got another salesperson and they appraised my Jetta. They were selling very similar Jettas on their website for $10,000 and only offered $3000 for mine. What a waste of time. If you think Carmax is different from the dealers they are. They're worse!

This is an interesting idea and food was good to. Faster than I thought it would be. Try them on a Thursday fur double punch day.  Was great in combo with nearby theatre. Dinner and a movie. Made for a great night out.
We will be back!

Second time coming to this place...Friday night is always busy. When we first came here, we were the only ones dining in. There seems to be 1 lady who is working in the front. She was busy taking orders, deliver foods and drinks, checking out, and cleaning tables. She was sweating. The wait was not too long for us. The kitchen staffs did a good job because the noodles came out perfectly. They did take quality over quantity despite many orders for so many customers. For Boise-Meridian area, I think this is still the only option for good ramen.
So far this is the best pizza I've had in Boise. If you are looking for a New York style pizza this is the best I've had here. Would highly recommend!
Honestly I love this place! They are so good about getting you in last minute and they always deliver on relaxing me by the end of the hour!
AWESOME. desert is even better when it is with nutella. service was great and friendly. you can even visit them at the BSU game.

I'm a coffee foodie so I have to put snobbery aside for a sec. 

I have to say that Frankie's is a really nice place with pretty good coffee.  It's a meeting place offering food, fun, and yes good coffee. 

I'm picky about music and don't care for the louder than normal music... it shouldn't be at Frankie's. 

I had an Americano it was hot enough and very tasty.

This is the kind of place that will be great for meeting clients, family, friends. I especially like the outdoor seating. Floors are the buffed concrete look, great lighting, a breakfast bar that you can sit at to watch the cooking. 

I personally would have a girl flying a sign on main street to let drivers by know they exist and put more info out on social media. I'd also have a punch card to reward frequent patrons. Oh, another idea, go after the brunch crowd of the church across the street. 

I'm rating five stars generously because I'm glad they're here and I will be back!

Great food.. great service.. just a reall well run restaurant!
Oh and u gotta try the Ruben!

Downtown Meridian has a great restaurant in its hands. 830 has a great menu and a very comfortable vibe. The restaurant has a great selection of seating options for inside, outside,  and bar side. 
The staff were all super friendly and helpful throughout the meal. 
I ordered the Burger with Fries for lunch.... and damn that burger is big. Be ready with two hands and plenty of napkins. The beef seems very fresh as it was very juicy and messy. The beef was well seasoned and the bun held up nicely to the burger. The flavor of the entire burger was amazing and one of the best that I have ever had!! The fries were fresh, warm, crisp, and salty. Being in Idaho, you better get the fries right and they did. 
If you are in downtown Meridian looking for a cool joint with great food and drinks, I would highly reccomend 830 for sure!! I am looking forward to trying something new and tasty the next time I stop in. 
Cheers Always!

We used to love this place but a few months ago I got food poisoning and assumed it was from either here or albertsons so i went with albies being the culprit and moved on. Then 2 days ago my kids wanted froyo and this was their fave. We went we ate yogurt we left. No issue. Projectile vomiting then ensued and I am just now getting a little better. The health dept needs to stop in and figure out the source.

Our first week there I found MOLD in my child's day care sippy cup. Furthermore, I had to bathe my child the moment we got home because she always smelled strongly of bleach from the spray they use on the changing tables. The center was lacking educationally in both age groups my children attended. As others have posted, the staff never spoke to me either, regardless of the amount of time I tried.

I visited Terri's with my mom last Saturday.   We experienced excellent service and delicious food!!! I can't wait to take my husband there!  The sausage gravy was the best I ever had and the pumpkin pancakes were amazing too.  Mom had the sausage sampler and after tasting their house made sausages we both left with several pounds for home.   

My new favorite breakfast spot!!!

If you like Indian food but are looking for a new twist, Mo Mo is the place to go.  They serve Nepalese food and it's fantastic.  Mo Mos are steamed dumplings with meat or vegetables and they are served with a wonderful sauce (chutney).  My favorite is to get the Combo Confession with Everest.  This includes 5 MoMos, rice, a delicious ground turkey with spices, black eyed peas, and vegetable salad.  The combination of flavor, textures, and temperatures is fantastic.  Don't forget the spicy sauce.  It's not for the faint of heart, but it's delicious.

The staff at MoMo are excellent and they always strive to make sure your dining experience is as good as it can be. This is a family run restaurant and everything about the place shows that they care about the food they serve.

Go try it right now.  You'll be glad you did.

Stay away of Camper's world in Meridian especially if you have a large coach. They have no clue how to reset the Inverter or the auto start on the generator after the turning off all battery power. They don't know about starting a diesel motorhome because they burned up the starter and charged us for it. The starter on a diesel should not be run for more than 30 seconds and then needs to cool down for 2 minutes before trying again. They did not reset the inverter or the generator and as a result they ran the house batteries down to the point that the screen for setting the inverter and generator did not show settings. If the inverter is set and the generator is on autostart as soon as the batteries are to a set minimum charge before damage occurs the generator will start and recharge all the batteries, house and chassis batteries. The motorhome was in for paint and body work and was promised it would take 12 to 14 days and took 30 days. Good luck to you.
We had some repairs completed for us at Rev RV which services monaco and other brands and they had 50 amp service for customers coming in the day before and they gave me a quote before starting the work and that is the price you pay no matter how long it takes to complete the work. It took them 2 hour longer but that did not affect the price I paid. 1-541-681-8086 Coburn Oregon.
what a great space!!! Very pretty,  a bar and southern cooking.  Street tacos were pretty good,  pulled pork sandwich was good,  very big,  fries were fabulous. Enjoyed the visit.
Einstein's Oilery has reinvented the oil change. Clean, knowledgeable, and friendly employees. Amazing customer service!! Very unique. I will be back for sure!

I had the most horrific experience here. It's a beautiful place, but the rental price is beyond greedy!  I was considering a space that was like 800 square feet and then rental price surged upwards after Krista saw my savings account amount. Besides the price gouging, the insincere affect of the management team adds a level of distrust that deterred me from moving into this place. Be advised -- stay away!

Calm atmosphere with groove jams loud enough to camouflage the slurps but quiet enough to still have conversation, family friendly- we will definitely come back- ordered spicy classic tonkotsu Ramen and veggie fried rice- DELICIOUS RAMEN GETS 5 out of 5!! The broth is full of flavor
Nice big bar and grill restaurant with dozens of TVs with all different sports channels. Service was quick and friendly. Food was good.

This was the first massage for both my husband and I, and even though they don't advertise a couples massage they had a room set up for two people already. We both got the full body deep tissue with oil, it was the most relaxing experience ever. I think the receptionist is new because she thought I couldn't get the full body since I'm 26 weeks pregnant, but the masseuse seemed very well practiced in the prenatal version. I was jealous that my husband got hot stones, but I couldn't since I was not on my stomach. The best experience I could have ever asked for. 10/10
Oh how I love this place!! I could (and usually do) spend hours and hours browsing through every aisle, rummaging through every nook and cranny.

We love ramen sho!   We usually start off with a hot sake and the pan fried gyoza.   The gyoza are so flavorful!   I've tried every type of ramen.  It's very hard to pick a favorite but I continue going back to the spicy miso.  It is always the perfect mix and spice and flavor!   If you are in the mood for some truly amazing authentic ramen I would definitely recommend Ramen Sho!

James was at our house on a Sunday within an hour of our call. He was friendly, professional, and handled a difficult deadbolt lock which needed cutting to be removed. We highly recommend his services.

Great pizza! Had it at their food truck and the location fun way to eat pizza I get the original pepperoni but my husband likes the buffalo chicken bacon. They have a vegetarian option and you can substitute vegan cheese if that's your thing!

Along with Moe Joe's  and Black Bear Diner down Overland a bit, this is one of my favorite places to eat Breakfast in the Boise area. Like the others, it is well worth the wait to get a table during peak times.

Ok, if you are looking for a fast food feel and taste then this is your spot. The food isn't bad, but it is definitely nothing special. They serve everything in to-go containers regardless if you order it to stay or not. You have to eat with plastic and drink from  paper cups. They don't seem to care about being sustainable at all. The food is in warming tubs and is spooned out in front of you like in a cafeteria. Pretty Americanized, mild flavors and very subawayesque atmosphere.
This place has gone down hill. They've eliminated a lot of their menu! So bummed I really liked eating here

I'm from out of town and had dinner with my family here. Worst service and food I've ever had. The waitress was a total idiot. She walked around talking to everyone in the place and forgot to take our order. She had to be told by the owner that she forgot. When the food came it was cold and had no flavor at all. We waited for an hour.

I am the QUEEN of waffles and have them all over town and on any out of town adventure (just say no to pancakes). I've had the chicken and waffles here 3x (I cant make myself order anything different -yet) and my date has had the waffle with ice-cream and the one with berries and whipped cream- allll of them are amazing. Waffles are cooked to order, the chicken is delicious and I'm always amazed at how large the pieces of chicken are. It's served with warm syrup and a spicy aioli/mayo sauce that MAKES the meal.  You will not be disappointed
Great pizza. Fast and easy. The specials are usually really good. Last time I got the Scarface. It was awesome. The spicy honey sauce is great.
This was a good NY style pie.  Large slices and thin crust, just the way I like it.  Nice and tasty and not overbearing.  We ordered takeout.
Had a take and bake pizza and the bread tasted stale. Skimpy toppings as well. Not very good at all.

We love coming here. Their yogurt is delicious and their toppings are great. So many choices that include fresh fruit and whip cream if you choose. The people at the register are always so kind and helpful.

I am so happy I found this place. It's a cute, fast-casual shop with friendly, attentive service and really, really good ramen. We ordered the tonkatsu ramen with extra noodles and extra chashyu. The broth was deep and flavorful and fresh so I was very happy. We also ordered the Tan Tan rice bowl, some springs rolls, and a pork bun. Good, good, and good. I recommend this place fo' sho!

Can not say enough about Meridian Plumbing.  We had just gotten off the plane on New Years and had 10 messages that we had a broken water main.  We googled plumbing companies in Meridian and called the first one that came up.  Couldn't have been luckier to call them.  By the time we had our luggage and got home, Jeff was already there and under the house.  Long story short he called the leak detection company and got an apt for us.  Gave as all the different scenarios and pricing.  Felt very comfortable with what he was telling us and trusted that he had our best interest in mind.  He communicated with us what was happening and got the job done as promised 
Made a bad situation less stressful.  Highly recommend Jeff and his staff.   If I ever need a plumber again, Meridian Plumbing are the only people I will call.  
Thanks Jeff

Visited the griddle today and was looking forward to having breakfast there for my first time. We had a group of 10, two being kids... So we ordered mimosas and waited awhile for our food. We ordered another one but never received it. The manager Christina came up to us and said "I cannot serve you anymore alcohol" and then walked away and we were all thinking what?! Why?! And she came back, says to us "Do you wanna know why?!" While she's clapping her hands together and saying it so rudely with SO much attitude in it. She then tells us "We are highly intoxicated and we are throwing quarters" Only TWO people were drinking mimosas, NOT the whole table and they were not being loud at all. ALSO My friends son was playing with a quarter and it rolled on the ground. NONE of us were throwing quarters and I don't even know why we would in the first place! The way she said it and handled it was rude. If she would've told us nicely we would've been fine. THEN one friends sausages were uncooked, and another friend had a ROTTEN steak. Thankfully, they took it off the bill and the chef agreed it was bad. We were still all astonished with how we were treated and almost got up to leave because we felt so disrespected. Our server was AMAZING though, so thank you to our server! She also told us that the manager called the owner herself and that the owner was going to come in to talk? So we waited and no sign of the owner. Besides the manager treating us paying customers super crappy and unprofessional like, our server was amazing!!!!!!!!! But I can definitely say none of us plan to go back.

So...first things first...we will definitely go back. There were highs and lows but overall I expected more from veteran restaurant operators even though it's a new concept. The queso and brussels were great starters...the queso could have had a bit more quantity wise but it was yummy. Drinks and beers both good. So 2 of our 4 entrees were delivered...steak and enchiladas...one steak more tender than the other oddly enough. The other 2 entrees were a good 10 minutes later with an apology from the server but no offer to make it right with a drink or something. The fish and chips were good but some of the fries were pretty soggy. Friends salmon was way over cooked and the quinoa mushy with undercooked carrots. The server was fine but didn't really seem empowered to do anything to make things right. Oddly enough the owner (or Gm maybe...not sure) was walking around checking in with many tables but never stopped at our table...not sure if he didn't want to hear about some problems or just happen to skip past us. Like I said, we will go back but the first impression could have easily been a lot better.
I was greeted quickly with a smile. They offered me several services with no pressure. They took care of my car and got it back on the road quickly.

I had thee best slice of pizza tonight, in.my.life. It was called Honey Please...I don't know what all it had on it, I think it was chicken, bacon, honey, green onions, I don't know, it was dark, and I scarfed it in the car, and it was AMAZING! I want to go back as soon as they open tomorrow and have another slice! Sooooo dang good!
This Denny's is good.  Food was good and just what you expect from a Denny's - consistency.   The server did a great job and was friendly.

I have mixed feelings about this place. We came for a friends birthday and I got the grown up grilled cheese which was delicious! My husband ordered the  salmon. His salmon was tiny and overcooked. On top of that it was very fishy like it was not fresh. We sent it back for the fried chicken. The chicken came out burned.  Our server asked how it was to which we answered truthfully that it was burned. We just got a sorry. My husband couldn't eat it and he left hungry. Still got billed $18 for chicken that was too burned to eat. I'm giving this 3 stars because my food was really excellent.

It was okay. We thought it was too loud, but the service was friendly and attentive. We ordered a breakfast burrito and chilaquiles. They were okay, and generously portioned. The chilaquiles were more of an interpretation, not authentic chilaquiles, more like breakfast styled nachos really. We had gone in for lunch, but lunch wasn't being served because of Father's Day. We were a little disappointed about that, but already had our drinks, and felt a little guilted about leaving. I don't think we'll go back.
Second time I've been over charged. I won't ever tip because they can't even ring up their menu correctly. Super annoying.

2nd time to this place and it has been awesome both times!

Got the spicy tonkotsu this time and it was amazing! The medium spice was absolutely the right amount.

The waitress was really nice and personable about everything. She brought up new ideas and ways to have us come back!

Can't wait to come back and try it again

Great food choices and very unique appetizers.  The bar is well stocked and serves a number of one-of-a-kind drinks.  We loved the atmosphere and background music.  What also impressed me was not having to yell to my friends over a loud noisy restaurant.  Every entree was prepared to perfection.  Highly recommended.

Great food, especially the crepes. I got the ham steak on my second visit and corned beef hash on my first. Corned beef could have been chopped a bit finer but ok flavor. Ham steak was quality and generous. 
Coffee was fresh and delish, regular and decaf. 
My only complaints are the price and the wait. It's a great place but there are a few others around now equally delish.

I have been searching for a primary doc for years! For those of you who are looking, look no further. Sue is amazing! Her and her staff take time with you, and truly listen to you. It is hard for me to find a doctor who really cares. Sue has made me feel welcome, and always listens to me and even follows up with me as well.

This has to be the last RV Dealer in the world to do business with, they never tell you the truth, and the upper Management never follows up on problems, and only looks for the next unaware RV newbie, the coo Marcus Lemonis must not care about the customers eather just get the money, we had to fight to get our money back and they need to get rid of that Jason I was a salesman for 35 years never did we treat a customer like we were treated he could never stand next to a real salesperson  and no one ever called us back,not even the sales manager,  All I can tell you buyer beware, check around.and save yourself a lot of headaches.

If I could leave them no stars I would. For the past three times I've gone here I've had horrible customer service. The girls who work here are rude and dumb. Not only that but all three times they've messed up my order.

We love this store. All of the employees are very accommodating and helpful. 

I was in there Christmas Eve, last minute shopping for my husband and was able to find exactly what I wanted.

My husband however, didn't agree Christmas morning- but we were able to do a quick exchange after the Holidays and go on our way.

Good management and friendly employees. Win/win.

I recently bought a used 2014 Nissan Leaf from Carmax.  It was a great experience from beginning to end.  I started out looking on the lot. They were all quality cars and were categorized.  I did not find exactly what I was looking for so I went home and looked on the Carmax website. I found the car I wanted at another Carmax dealership. I called the Meridian dealer and talked to a sales person who told me if I had any questions about the car he would call the dealer where the car was located and get the answers . After my questions were answered I decided to order the car.  There are fees associated with transferring cars that change with different criteria.  My car luckily enough had no transfer fees.  My salesman kept me informed throughout the whole transfer.  When my car arrived I was called and made an appointment to pick it up.  When I went to get the car unfortunately one of the features on it had been misrepresented. I thought to myself "oh boy here comes trouble".  I couldn't have been more wrong.  The sales manager apologized and told me she would discount the price AND fix the misrepresentation or I could keep looking and walk away from deal.  I chose to have them fix it and take the discount.  Their service department took care of it in a prompt and very professional manner. They kept me in the loop with a phone call everyday throughout the whole process.  This was by far the greatest car buying experience I've ever had. By the way I'm over 60 and have bought quite a few cars.  Brian G
CupBop is a go-to for me. Always super fresh and perfectly cooked with gluten free options for my daughter. I love cup bop and I drive out of my way to get it!

This place is absolutely amazing!  The Golden Gate sandwich is hands down the best ive ever had. Service, food quality, and cleanliness is always on point. I have to mention that our server Ty was awesome.  I will recommend The Griddle to everyone.

Ordered a strawberry açaí refresher and received a cup of ice with a splash of refresher. Three swigs and it was gone. Normally I go out of my way to go to this location But I don't know that I will anymore.

I have eaten in two of the location in the valley and both places were awful. The 2 star rating for this place was kind it should be a one star. The food looks old and and tastes like it has been reheated many times.

BEWARE.....DO NOT BUY APPLIANCES FROM HOME DEPOT (ESPECIALLY SAMSUNG).  Make sure to read the small print in their return policy for appliances!  Basically, you are stuck with it unless you report ONLY a damaged or defective item within 48 hours.  Make sure to wash and dry everything you have from very small to very large within the first 48 hours to make sure that everything works.  Now, if you are just unsatisfied with it you are completely out of luck.  Home Depot will not exchange or refund it period!  We bought this washer and matching dryer a few weeks ago.  We had high hopes for it but were quickly very unsatisfied with it.  The washer does not wash at all.  My wife quickly noticed this, so she experimented with it.  She put 3 layers of clothes that were different colors in the washer.  She then ran a complete cycle and when it was done the clothes were still in the same order.  They never moved!  She then washed a full/queen comforter (it's not real big) and once the washer was done the comforter was puffed up in the washer and at least 50% of the comforter was still dry (see picture)!
She then called Home Depot and asked if she could get an exchange or refund since it had only been 3 weeks.  They refused to help out in any way.  She then worked her way up with a variety of Home Depot Managers and they all told her the same thing that she is out of luck.  One Home Depot Manager told her basically to stop calling and she is stuck with the washer and dryer!  Spectacular customer service HD!  The only thing that the Home Depot Managers could provide was a phone number to call Samsung direct.   
She then called Samsung and talked to a couple of techs.  They did some sort of facetime with her to see if our washer is defective and after 30-40 minutes they determined that it is not defective.  They told her that when she washes comforters that she will have to take them out and wash them a second time.  This is supposed to be an energy efficient washer....how is that efficient to have to wash it twice each time.  The Samsung techs told her, "that is just how it washes."   
My wife then called Home Depot back again and explained to them that this washer does not work like described on their website and she was once again told that she is out of luck!
Do yourself a favor and don't settle for, "that is just how it washes!"  And stay away from Home Depot....we sure are!

We were super excited for this opening- love this location! Flatbread is great so we knew the owners would likely deliver a fun new concept. The food that we had was good and we will definitely return because some of the items we wanted weren't available. No big deal. 
The reason for the 3 stars- pretty easy fixes, really. Our server showed ZERO excitement! No mention of recently opening, no name/introduction , no recommendations or even the offer to answer questions- first thing she said 'do you want anything other than water?' So boring. I mean, you JUST opened! Show your excitement to be there and your guests will feel it. 
Another thing that bothered all of us at our table... the fact that staff utilizes the garage roll up door to go between the patio and inside. There is a small wall that everyone has to literally step over and it looks so unprofessional and lazy. Maybe if the small wall at the bottom wasn't there, it wouldn't have been so obvious, but they even used this access while the tables in front of the door were seated with guests. It was so bad. All 4 of us noticed it right away and couldn't believe it. It's really the little details that make restaurants stand out. I think there are a lot of great things about this restaurant but I just feel they need fine tune the details. Especially staff!

I had a good body massage there & will probably return.

Price is reasonable, low lighting conditions, quiet environment good quality massage.

The therapist enquired about the pressure level when we first started and kept it consistent throughout the session.

I was satisfied with the service.

I have been coming here for over two years twice a week. It's where I get my best work done. Love the staff, service and most importantly their drinks. In my opinion there coffee, chai tea, teas, Italian sodas are the best in town. The place could use some sprucing up, new paint, tiles missing under register, new decor pieces/ signs. It's clean and a great place to meet up with friends or to get some work done.
Norma was a terrific server! I was not disappointed with the service and she was so kind to me! I will definitely be back soon!
I really want to love you, Yogurtz! You make it so hard with your lack of good customer service. The food has always been spot on. Train up the people and you'll have a gem!

I had the stuffed huckleberry French toast with bacon and eggs. It was amazing. Bacon and eggs were done to perfection. My wife had the chicken fried angus steak with hash browns and eggs. It too was excellent. Great place for breakfast or lunch.

I was searching for a new place and person that I could trust waxing my eyebrows, cause every girl knows, you have to trust the person who does your brows with your life! About a month ago I got a butchered eyebrow wax from a different place that lead me to growing them out. I needed a new place to get waxed and heard about Meraki and decided to try it out, and I'm so glad I did! Clayton is amazing and you can tell he really cares about his clients. Not only that but he is extremely knowledgeable about all and everything about skin care, ect. He definitely knows what he is doing! I told him about my bad experiences with previous eyebrow waxes and explained exactly how I wanted them done; he listened and now I am a very happy customer with a great brow wax!

Great service and great pancakes. Recommend the pumpkin pecan. Fresh squeeze Orange juice is a must as well. Best time to arrive is before 10 am on Sundays otherwise you will have you wait for a table. Arrive before  9 am and you have your choice of where to sit. We prefer the spacious booths towards the back.

Nice selection of bottled beer. Small selection of beer on draft. Nice decor, atmosphere, and customer service. Decent food menu.

Being from Portland we have a far better beer store (John's Market on Multnomah) and pubs with much larger draft selections (Green Dragon) but this is a nice place in Boise to enjoy a cool draft with friends.

The menu includes pizza, salad, sandwiches, 6 varieties of chicken wings, and mussels.  Outdoor seating on sunny days is another plus!

Ramen sho was a 3 1/2 - 4 star place during its run at its original downtown location. With its relocation to Meridian, I have to wonder if there was a change to the kitchen staff. The tonkotsu ramen broth has been super salty consistently for the last 3 times I've visited. The karaage is decent but oily and the tako yaki lacks tako. The gyozas are okay. 

On the positive side of things, the noodles are consistently al dente, the chashu is super tender and good. The potato croquette is perfect. 

Overall the service was good and the Japanese pop culture media serves to remind you that it is a Japanese restaurant. The saltiness of its main dish however is very un-Japanese.

I was a walkin, no appt. they sat me at the first station on the left. The guy that did my gel mani was a little rough on my nails when removing the old gel and shaping the nails with a file. He did not place a towel under my hands to catch the gel debris as he filed the old polish off.  He also did not offer the arm cushion for my forearms. I finally spoke up and asked for one as my arms were hurting from leaning on the hard edge of the table. He got polish on my fingers around the nail. He then tried to use an emery board to remove the polish. 
No!  I would not go again and I would not suggest anyone else go there either.

My wife and I went in for drinks and an appetizer. The food was great and the desert was even better! Our waiter (name escapes me at the moment) went above and beyond in his service. I highly recommend this place!

We have a men's group every Tuesday morning. Our waiter Rene is the best. The food is satisfactory a d priced well and they offer military discounts. The problem is that trying to pay a d leave sometimes takes 15 minutes. It is an extremely slow process. Why can't they let the waiters take our payment?
DONT GET CENTURYLINK! Waste of money. They said I would not have a contract, so I call to cancel and guess who has a sudden contract! Ugh!!!
Great drinks and food.! This is one of my favorite bars to hangout at. Brooke is so friendly and inviting along with the rest of the staff. I highly recommend Rudys Bar and Grill to everyone.
Taylor is a very nice and polite barista. He is always in a good mood and looks you in the eye. Besides that, it is a normal Starbucks with everything you would expect.

Amazing! The #1 gave me a nice cheap meal with a reasonable ice cream size that was soooo good! I have tried many flavors but Grasshopper is my favorite ( Grasshopper is: mint, chocolate chips, Oreos, and Carmel) soooooo good! The chocolate milk is also very good and they make all their things! Very local to Idaho!
Mediocre gluten free pancakes but excellent allergy awareness and courteous staff. Great atmosphere and prompt seating despite the business.

I like keeping my reviews short and to the point so let me start of by saying my wife and i dismissed all the negative reviews this place has because lets face it, its the 1st and maybe only ramen house Boise has so how much do people really know. For starters the broth was tasty. Portion size was plenty, the server was  friendly and attentive. Cheap beer always good. The atmosphere is lacking a bit but the music was excellent. They were playing the Fugees second studio album "the score". We were overall very satisfied. 
A couple of things they can work on: more sides so people can create their own bowl. Less fat on the pork.
More selection on non alcoholic beverages, the wife is pregnant:).
The place is new and needs some minor improvements. We will defenitely be back again.
The food was delicious and the service was great. I had the shrimp and avocado Benedict with the short stack huxko
Ordered pancakes and was brought French toast. Strawberries and whipped cream made the whole thing a soggy mess.

Late night, 11p ish all I've received is bad service, my order is usually wrong and I get irritated looks by employees. I come through here a couple times a week "late night" and the experience hasn't been good yet. I don't recommend this sonic at all
This is a great place for kids and adults. $11 for a shampoo and haircut for my 8 year old. They give the kids tokens to get a bouncy ball after...cute idea!

CupBop became one of my favorite places for a quick meal about six months ago.  As a vegetarian, I really enjoy that I can get a filling meal without having to ask them to remove ingredients.  When Cupbop is done right, it's GREAT and I love it. I think about it a lot and try to convince my husband that it's time for another order.  But, there are major issues with the consistency of what you get. I typically order the Doochi Bop and usually have it delivered. This bowl consists of rice, cabbage, noodles, fried tofu, kimchi, and the spicy mayo sauce.  But every time I order for delivery, it's a Russian roulette of what I will get. Sometimes they make it vegan, even though I don't ask for them to make it vegan. About 50% of the time they leave out the kimchi.  A couple of times I've gotten it without tofu.  My husband usually gets the combo bowl and it's almost always done right.  But, the last time I ordered, both mine and my husbands bowls were about 50% of the size they normally are. Literally half a bowl instead of a full bowl.  I don't know if this was because the person making it made that decision, or if they are cutting portion sizes to save money.  But, all of these issues have definitely made me reconsider my orders here and I will probably be taking a break for a while.

This is probably the worst experience I've had. Our waitress was inattentive, didn't give us utensils or napkins until we requested it. Our coffee was practically brown water, we couldn't mix sugar or creamer as we didn't have utensils. When we did get our food, my wife's Moons Over my Hammy didn't have any Ham and my pancakes were burnt. The waitress Kasie had enough time to chitchat with her friends, but providing adequate service must have been too much for her. Awful experience, needless to say we will not be visiting this Denny's again.
Great place for mulch, compost, and soil.  I've also bought sod at reasonable prices here.  Not great for flowers/ fertilizer.  Rock is also their specialty.

I really like the idea of the co op but I want to love the place more.

I just went into the new co op and it is great and very corporate. It lost the homey feeling of the downtown store. And really, that's ok because it makes up for it in a bright, cheery atmosphere and the same happy staff I've become used to downtown.

I can't fall in love the the place for several reasons, not the least of which is price.

I regularly shop a mile down the street at Rosaurers and virtually everything I regularly buy is much less expensive. Dawson Taylor coffee? $2 less a pound a half mile away. Dave's Bread? Less expensive by a lot. My favorite pretzels? You get the idea. And the reason this bothers me is that I pay for a membership and it is a co op for group buying advantage but there is no savings to be seen.

The prepared food at the deli is very average here. I got a burrito and frankly it was the worst I've had in Boise but the Pizza was great and the soups are delicious. And that pretty well sums up why the three star rating. They do some things really well but fail in big ways on other things.

I'll keep going from time to time in hope it changes, I really want to support the co op and to buy from a local small business but until they get their pricing in line and have some consistency I won't be consistently going to the co op.

These guys are great! My van broke down in the bay while getting my oil changed. They were so great trying to fix my van so I could at least get it to the mechanic. They ended up pushing me out and then one of the workers Remington stayed and worked on my van for quit a while! Got it started and to the mechanic. It ended up being a bad starter which is what they suspected. Great service!!

Stay away from this business especially if you have a diesel pusher. They burned up the starter and then charged for supplying another starter. These starters are good for 10,000 starts but must not have starter on for more than 30 seconds each time and then rest for 2 minutes before trying again. They burned it up. They ran the house batteries down to zero. They had turned off the autostart on the generator which would protect the batteries from being damaged. 
Take big rigs to monaco rv in coburg, OR
They give you a quote before they start the work and that is the price you pay. If the eork takes longer they don't charge more. They have 50 amp plug ins so you can park overnight on their lot. 1-541-686-8011

As a southern girl I had to try out Barnyard. First the good. It's interior is adorable. Very quaint and down home feel. Drinks in Mason jars. Sweet tea is great. The waitress was attentive and introduced the menu to us. The food overall was good. The main entrees are massive. Be prepared to get a box. 
Now the bad. It's new and they have some kinks to work out. Granted we got there an hour and a half before closing. There was nobody in there which made me a bit nervous.
