We ordered the brick fries for an appetizers, which are huge. But we never got to eat them because the food came 2 minutes later. So we had to box up the app and barely got a chance to eat it before it cooled off. I ordered the open face turkey sandwich. The flavor of the turkey was great. But the gravy was incredibly peppery so that it took away from the turkey. The mashed potatoes were also a little cold. My fiancé has the bbq po boy and loved it. He loved it. 
It's got potential!

OK, this is an updated review. I recently gave CupBop another try and have to say the experience was VERY different.  The food was awesome and juicy, the help was respectful and attentive.

After my last review I was a little apprehensive about swinging in for a late lunch but I am glad I did.  I'm glad to have this place on my list for lunch options!

It's the Christmas mailing season!!! My daughter & I went to this UPS yesterday to mail some Xmas presents and the line was LONG but it moved very very quickly.  The UPS clerk (Zachary) was personable yet efficient and professional.  I worked for the Postal Service for 32 years up in Montana and this UPS store had the USPS beat with efficiency and professionalism hands-down.  Great experience.  This UPS will definitely be our go-to store for mailing packages in the future.
Prompt. Professional. Knowledgeable. Great experience! James was able to adjust a very old lock set and bring it back into working order.
A nice place to stop by for some ramen. The spicy tonkotsu ramen was very tasty and filling. I'd come back when I'm in the area again
Excellent thin crust pizza. By the slice is always hot and delicious. Also they have a special of the week that is usually super creative and almost always great.
Excellent staff, awesome coffee and it comes with a chocolate covered coffee bean! Definately give it a try!

Hmmmmm....where do I start? We were very excited to try this restaurant located on Main Street in downtown Meridian. This restaurant came on the recommendation from friends and the Yelp ratings.  We were quickly seated at a high top table.  We waited awhile before any one came over with menus (not busy only 3 tables were full)  It was happy hour and we asked about three beers on their draft beer list including the beer of the day, our server, Jocelyn couldn't tell us about the taste profile on any of the three.  I ended ordering my standard bottled beer.  When she brought the bottled beer over with a glass, the glass was very warm and wet :( not the best to put a cold beer in. I ordered the happy hour carnitas nachos they were okay, nothing special.  I also ordered two street tacos. The carnitas one was ok.  The spicy shrimp taco was rubbery and flavorless. The most flavor came from the raw onions that were on the taco. My husband ordered the fish and chips.  We waited and waited for the order to come.  I was almost done with mine when the waitress reappeared to ask how our dinner was.  We asked where the fish and chips were and she said she would go to the kitchen and check.  We waited at least fifteen minutes, no waitress and still no dinner.  She was no where to be found.  Finally a gentleman brought out the order and asked if we needed anything else.  She finally came over to say the kitchen had lost the order.  We found it hard to believe.  We think she forgot to turn it in.  She never wrote down our order.  The $16 fish and chips only came with two pieces of fish and lukewarm soggy fries.  Definitely not worth the price.  When our bill came she had added another tables beer to our tab.  She fixed the mistake.  Needless to say the service is lacking &  value for food is not good.  We probably won't be returning.  Too bad because it's a great location and gas so much potential.

2 reasons I didn't give 5 stars. Not open Sunday (almost all the places nearby are closed.  Could this have anything to do with the Temple around the corner?) and the other is the price. Very high.  Prohibitively high. 
   Great ice creams and dairy items. I haven't tried any food yet only went for dessert. Standard flavors plus some special ones. Strawberry cheesecake was great as is butter pecan. I'll go back but can't afford to go often. Lots of big families ahead of me last time took forever!

I took my fifth wheel to Camping World to be consigned. I called first and went through the process with Mindy. She is the consignment specialist. She was absolutely wonderful! From the time we dropped it off until the time we picked up the check she did all the work and made the process so easy. I would highly recommend working with Mindy and Camping World. They got me a fair price and I wouldn't hesitate to go through it again. Thank you again Mindy!

Something has changed and that is obvious by the amount of empty seats at 7:00 p.m. on a Saturday night.  The calamari was good, but the entrees we could have skipped.  Fajitas came out on a cast iron skillet but lacked the obvious "sizzle"  and just didn't look good, the taste, ok.  I ordered the patty melt, expecting something substantial, I received 2 slices of bread with some meat larger than a slider patty but smaller than a burger patty.  I visited with the manager however, overall, we were disappointed, if you look at the 2 year yelp trend they are not improving and I am sorry to see this.  For the price point, I expect more.

Teriyaki chicken bowl substituted noodles. 1.89 more $10 Bowl$ reasonable small drink
Taste good fresh hot a bit expensive but it was good I think I'll stick to the Teriyaki and rice and maybe get a option with the noodles that already there but it wasn't a big portion maybe not even average! But fresh

Ramen snob checking in.  I would like to give Ramen Sho 3.5 stars, but that's not possible.  So, 3 stars it is.

Dish: Tonkotsu with no bean sprouts
Broth: Ramen Sho used garlic in a very clever way in this broth.  While the broth wasn't the creamiest, the garlic flavor complimented the rest of the ingredients, making a very good overall base.
Chashu: Fatty and flavorful. Excellent.
Egg: Soft boiled correctly, but flavorless. Did not appear to be marinated at all.
Noodles: Here is where Ramen Sho really faltered for me.  Their noodles tasted like some I have gotten from the refrigerated "Asian" section at the grocery store.  Thick, flavorless, and rubbery.  Entirely the wrong type of noodle for this particular dish.  The noodles were so thick, I had trouble getting them from the bowl to my mouth, which is a big negative.

Overall, I think if Ramen Sho improved their noodles, I would increase their rating to 4 stars.  They are probably the best option in Boise, but I'll probably pass the next time in town.

UPDATE 10/24.  Now reopened after closing on about 10/18, just a week-ish after original opening on about 10/10.  No kidding.  Customer demand for their pizza (by slice or whole pie), pasta bowls, sub sandwiches and meatball eats was so high in the first week of business that the two local nice guys who came up with the Johnny Bronx concept found themselves being bought out of food every day well before the end of the day.  They closed for a few days to consider how to produce more of their eats to meet customer demand and are back at it now, having added an additional pizza oven and hired more staff.

My recent visit suggests they still have process kinks to iron out.  Like training the new staff and fixing the systems to make it possible for them to take more than one order at a time.  (Example, the computer was in use for staff member on phone taking a call in order, so another person was unable to take ours for plain cheese slice until that long order call was completed.)  They'll get there.  These are good guys working hard to get it right.  Expect some order speed-bumps and be patient and you'll be happier, I think.

THE DRILL:  Walk up to the window in front or drive around to the drive through at side to order or pick up an order you have called in.  Whole pies must be picked up at the walk up window at front.  There is no indoor seating.  They may add a couple of outdoor tables near the order window in the future. For now, there is a long bench near the order window to sit and nosh.  They do not deliver.

TIMING CAN BE EVERYTHING: Proximity to a local high school has high student turn out at lunch  - you may want to plan around that.  As school adjourns in mid afternoon seems the Dutch Brothers down the street and neither Johnny Bronx nor next door neighbor Sonic get the student crowds at that time of day.

KISS MENU:  Keeping the menu simple and sticking to the Italian NY concept lane is really smart.  As the early customer demand for their product shows.
  
*Five kinds of pizza in slices / $2.85 - $3.75
*Five kinds of whole (20") pies / $16.50 - $22.50
*Slices also offered "1 with drink" $4.75 or "2 with drink" $7.50) 
*Option to choose your own toppings to "customize" a pie
*One special pizza of the day offered whole or in slices too
*Genius of "mix it up" for slices of your choice to create a whole pie
*Sub sandwiches - meatballs or (so-called) Italian sausage 
*Penne pasta bowl with red sauce (can add meatballs or sausage)
*Mac n Cheese
*Garlic Bread
*Homemade ice cream sandwiches as dessert

THE EATS:  I took my Brooklyn native, Sicilian heritage and Italian neighborhood raised husband for a 'test drive' for eats.  The pizza dough is hand made and the crust comes out of the pizza ovens in thin style with crispy bottom cooked just right but for my hubby it lacked the 'chew' of NY pizza.  He gave thumbs up for a slice being flexible to fold to eat - essential he says - and folding a plain cheese slice delivered the little drips of grease he says should go with NY pizza.  (For me that's not-so-much an advantage.)   Demerits from Brooklyner husband for Johnny Bronx offering Ranch dressing-sauce as a side order with pizza and calling spicy Ranch "mob sauce" doesn't get them off the hook.  (They'd be floating face down in Sheepshead Bay if they tried to peddle that with pizza in Brooklyn, he says.)  And yet, in Idaho it seems Ranch dressing with pizza is a thing so if it is your thing they have it here.  (I don't judge.)  He awards extra points to them for avoiding pineapple and ham as topping options.  And big applause for not a chicken wing or cinnamon knot in sight.

WHATT-ARE-YOUSE-KIDDIN'-ME?:  He literally said this to find their "Italian" sausage is a mixed beef and pork product and not all pork as the 'real thing" should be.  

GENIUS IN NAME & MARKETING:  Inserting Bronx in the name to make folks wonder if the owners have NY origins (they don't) is a great idea.  They even tout, as part of well crafted marketing plan, that they use NY-style filtered water in the dough.  Brilliant.  I mean that in a good way.  (Grimaldi's does the same, but they take it even further and say Brooklyn style water.) All of their marketing materials, including the printed take-away menus, pivot off of a fresh and fun nod to the New York food thing. 

PARKING:  Several angle in parking spots in paved lot surrounding the take out / drive through building.

ACCESSIBILITY:  One van accessible stall with access to sidewalk leading to order window.  Loo is accessible too. 

LOO:  They have gender neutral loo at side of building.

PS NAME: There is a Johnny's Pizza in Meridian too.  Don't confuse it with this Johnny Bronx Pizza.

By far this is the best place to eat burgers I order the one that has habanero, sorry I forgot the name, it's delicious. The place looks clean they also have a good costumer service. Can't wait to go again.

I had an issue last year with wait times. We tried it a year later and I suspect they remembered me cause my food came out in about 7 min. Server very on top of it and the food was amazing as usual. Glad they made it right cause my family really enjoyed going there. Glad to be back. - Ben

I recently moved from Phoenix back to Boise and was so happy to see Waffle Love was in my new neighborhood!!  This location is super clean, new, and had a great menu. My mom was a first timer and Sabrina went out of her way to give us the low down on everything they do. She was super friendly and made us feel welcome.  I had The Works with their Biscoff butter, strawberries, and homemade whip. Mom had the Boise Blue with blueberry lime jam and fresh whip.  The waffles were perfect and we finished every bite.  Will definitely be back again!!

Let me begin by saying the food was outstanding! I ordered the beet salad and although thats not much to review, it was the prettiest and tastiest I've ever had. 

On the other hand, the service sucked! The restaurant was not busy at all yet it took beyond several minutes before anyone approached my table. When someone did finally come over, I asked "are you my server?", and she replied "apparently I am".  

I ordered the house white wine which I got from the Happy Hour menu. She said "we don't have any house wine". When I pointed it out to her, she said that it's only available during happy hour. Which is fine,  I didn't mind paying more because it wasn't Happy Hour. So without asking me, she brought a Le Crema Chardonnay and charged me $10.50, which is fine if the service justifies the price. What I don't like is being ignored and then being overcharged for what I'm getting. 

I'm sure she provided better service during other times like when she wasn't taking pictures of frothy coffee drinks so she could post them on Instagram. Still not sure why I had 3 different people coming to my table because not one of them saw my empty glass and asked if I'd like another.

Expensive for the experience and service, I won't be back.

Firstly, the food was not to my liking. They went extremely heavy-handed with the sauces (couldn't see the food underneath) and that was all the flavor I could taste. Rice seemed undercooked but the noodles were an okay texture. Dumplings weren't bad and rather the best part. I ate about half the bowl and had to trash the rest. Ended up with stomach problems after so good thing I stopped.

An important thing to note also is if you have food allergies (like my husband does), please be aware that there is the possibility of the employee serving you will have no idea what is in the food (and seemed unwilling to check) nor the proper procedure to handle a situation like that. My husband did have an allergic reaction, and yes, that's on us for risking it, but they should also be trained properly.
Great choices and stock. Always find what I need. The staff are all very helpful and friendly.
This is a good place to come for breakfast. I have not been as impressed with lunch but whenever you come it is good service with a smile.
The concept is new and fun, however I'm neutral. The pizza cones taste "okay!" Nothing spectacular. After asking my kids what they thought, one mentioned, "well, they're different."
The food was absolutely wonderful and the service was prompt, polite and on top of our dishes and our drinks all evening.

Just OK. Not too much to choose from on the menu, and it was more expensive than I thought it would be. $33 for me and 3 kids. The waffles are small, but filling. The girls working there were very nice. They were working hard to clean while we were there, but soaked the floor with their mop and my son fell. Then the store smelled like dirty dishrags.
Mike Twite and his crew gave us great advice and didn't oversell. My sons car is now safe for winter to include a full fluid change. Fair price and great service.
Great market. Friendly service & good selection of organic products and produce. The wine shop & pet store are also great.

This has to be one of the worst dining experiences I've had in awhile.  I should have steered clear when I was all but hung up on earlier in the afternoon when I called to check on call ahead seating for 7 that evening. The girl was short and rude. We chose this place since it was close to home and we were pressed for time and didn't want to make the trip to the Village area for other dining. From sit down at 5:10 to meal served at 6:20! 3 tables around us were seated, served and finished before we got our food. And when we dared to ask how much longer it might be the waitress got snooty. It should be out soon and walked off. It SHOULD have probably been out 20 minutes ago! Our salad should have been out 30 minutes ago not with our very well-done "medium well" steak and cold potatoes. The salad comes first before the meal not with it but at least I know what took so long. They needed time to over cook or under warm everything. I sent my steak and potatoes back and asked for it to be removed from the bill and just ate the salad. 2 different people came over, a manager and the OWNER asking if "we were good" and "what do you want us to do"?  Umm no not good, I did not have dinner! And what do you want us to do? If you have to ask the customer you have no business being in customer service. I came here for a meal not to tell you how to do your job. Don't offer me dessert to appease me, take something off the bill that I WAS ABLE TO CONSUME! I don't know, the drinks or one of the appetizers maybe? Give me a reason to come back not a reason to turn to Yelp!! Isn't that what one usually does when their customer's experience was terrible!?

We have a pretty busy flooring store in San Marocs. I showed up to our shop a little early this morning to help my guys organize and load some early morning deliveries in the company van. After looking in all the usual spots in the store for the keys I decided to check the van. The keys were sitting in plain sight inside the van and the doors locked. I called O'Bryant locksmith because he was local and I needed to get into the van quickly to get these deliveries on the road. James showed up and had the job done in less than 20 min. Very happy with his quick and efficient service. The pricing was reasonable and he was very professional. I would definatly use his service again although I hope I wont need to.
This is the best bar is the Meridian area. Great service, good drinks, good food, clean space and a great vibe. Kareoke is always on point. The locals are amazing and I have always had a good time.
Great customer service...piping hot coffee in a really BIG mug...will definitely be back.

If you are looking for quality internet century link is not what you are looking for. We have had it for a year now and we have had nothing but problems. We have been through 3 different routers and still have the same problem of the internet going out several times a day. Look elsewhere if you don't want the headache.

I sent a request to Camping World-Meridian looking for a particular travel trailer. They didn't have this trailer in stock but the salesman told me he would try to find it and have it shipped to Meridian. Great! 
I told him I wanted a weight distribution hitch included in the price and I intended to pay cash for the trailer. After several text messages between the two of us (and the price changing several times)he told me he had found a trailer and could sell it for a price but had to get approval from his manager because it was a cash transaction and Camping World wouldn't be making the profit from me financing it. Apparently the price (without finance charges)was not approved and the new price went up thousands of dollars. Each time I got a new price the salesman added the weight distribution hitch and BATTERIES. DON'T ALL TRAILERS HAVE BATTERIES? I got a call later from the sales manager who said he would try to help me. Next he offered to send me info on lower cost trailers. I wasn't interested in lower cost trailers and Never heard a word from the sales manager as promised.
My point in posting this is to tell Camping World sales
People that buyers don't appreciate "sales games" from the salesman who will "check with the manager" and then having the sales manager come into the scene playing "good cop/bad cop".
I bought a nice travel trailer from camping World in another location a few years ago and they were very professional.
I'll never go to or contact Camping World again.
***There is way too much competition in this area to be treated like this! TRY ANY OTHER DEALERSHIP!
Awesome New York style pizza! A little on the greasy side and the tomato had a sweet taste to it but overall, it is pretty good!

I wish I could give this local business a positive review, but my experience was not a positive one. I stopped in due to a flat tire. While "working" on my vehicle the technician broke a lug stud. I was told about the damaged stud and informed that a replacement was on its way. An hour later, the car was ready to go. I asked what I owed for the flat repair and was told that the repair to the tire was complimentary.
However, I was then told that they would, and I quote, "get to charge me" for the repair of the broken stud.  I then received an invoice for 37$ (parts & labor) for replacement of the 3$ lug stud that they broke!  A 37$ charge for replacing a lug stud may be the deal of the century, but is this really your business practice to charge your customer when your technician damages or breaks your vehicle?  This customer quietly paid the bill and will quietly take all of his vehicles elsewhere for service.

You know when a friend tells you "I don't like (thing)" and you're like "Oh well you haven't had GOOD (thing)!" If that thing is corned beef hash, bring them here. Literally melts in your mouth with tenderness and flavor, but still has a pleasant chew to it. Biscuits weren't as flakey as I like, but decent gravy. Not a huge concern for me; the corned beef hash was enough to make me love this place. 

The huckleberry pancakes were awesome and fluffy too!! The homemade syrup is YUM. If you're not terribly sensitive to flavors like my husband, you might not sense a huge difference between it and a blueberry pancake.

Getting your lashes done is like going to the gym. You hate the process but love the results. Well Clayton made the process enjoyable for me in a friendly and welcoming environment and beautiful lashes.  You will not be disappointed with the results or his professionalism.

Very thankful to have an office supply store in the middle of Meridian.  I believe every time I have come here, I have experienced helpful employees that go out of their way to help or point me in the right direction.  This store is very big and overwhelming so I am grateful for the help at the store.  Came here recently to purchase a cartridge for my labeler.  As I chose the one I was looking for, I happened to check Amazon to make sure they value was in line and the price at OD was more than 200% of Amazon's price.  As I stepped up to the register, I asked the cashier if they price matched and she said yes.  I showed her the price of Amazon on my phone and she gladly discounted $13 off an item that was marked $22.99.  I know it is super hard to keep up with everyone's prices, I am just super thankful that OD price matches.  Sometimes you just have to ask.  I would rather buy locally from a friendly place than have to wait for shipping online and for that reason, I am really happy to shop here and will continue.

How well a company deals with problems should be your deciding factor when making purchases. Their associates are rude and act like it is an inconvenience to be helpful. When making large purchases you want to feel good that you are going to get good service when something is defective. Lowes has better prices and service and I will be shopping there from now on.

Been here once and that was it.  Tried it since it was the new place.  The wife and I still surprised that they are still around and the parking lot is full.  Can't see why. There's nothing special and it's racked with disorganization throughout.  Skip it. Cook your own.

Hit or miss? Reviews of Camping World of Boise are very poor, or very good. For me, I hope never to have to deal with Camping World of Boise again.

I bought a new 2014 Dutchmen 16' ultra-light trailer from Camping World of Boise, and the sales staff was friendly and persuasive. Perhaps it helped that we had a substantial down payment. But that was the last pleasant experience I've had at Camping World of Boise.

I've been to Camping World of Boise twice now, the first time for help in replacing the propane line to the cylinder and lighting the refrigerator. During our first camping trip I'd detected a strong smell of propane, and a soapy water spray showed a leak at the coupling. We made an appointment, left the trailer and returned a week later to be told there was no problem with the refrigerator and no leak at the propane coupling. I had to repeatedly ask for a service tech to walk out to the trailer with me and attempt to light the refrigerator. He tried for 15 minutes, finally getting it to light, telling me that it would get better over time. I did not detect any propane odor so I called it good and left. My second experience was worse.

After a year and several more camping trips, the propane odor returned. Again, a soapy water spray showed a leak at the coupling. This time I removed the hose myself and took it to Camping World of Boise for a replacement, hoping it would take only 15-minutes to buy, install and get on our way.

It was nearly an hour. An hour of frustration. An hour of poor, poor customer service.

I walked into the front door, expecting to be greeted by the receptionist. No greeting and no eye contact, despite no customers at the front desk.

I went to the parts department. Two men behind the counter, one flipping pages of a catalog, one with a customer, and another customer waiting for service. And me. No eye contact, no "Be right with you!".

I wandered the aisles, looking for LP parts. No staff came to ask if I needed help. With customers still at the front counter I went to the other side of the store, the sales side of Camping World of Boise.

Again, no staff greeted me, no staff asked if they could help. I wandered the aisles until landing at a small LP parts display. None of the replacement hoses matched my old one. They were either too short or had a different style of coupling.

I waited in line at the cash register and asked the clerk for help, and she immediately closed her register and walked back with me to the LP parts display to help. She was the ONLY bright spot that day at Camping World. Together we again looked for a match for my hose, but found nothing. She then went to the "back room" to see if there were any on the overstock shelf, but came back to say there were none.

I asked if there were couplings that would convert the older style of hose to the newer style. While she went to the parts department I looked closer at the LP display. Sure enough, I found a coupling that appeared to be made to fit my style of older hose, converting it to the newer style coupling. When the clerk returned I asked it it would work for me. She did not know, but she invited me to talk with the parts staff.

At the parts department, I again received no greeting, no eye-contact, no offer to help. I waited until the customer line had dwindled, leaving one parts tech flipping through a catalog, again! I waited in front of him. No greeting, no eye-contact, no mention of "be right with you". Finally, he looked up with raised eyebrows, "Yes?" 

I explained my problem and showed him my old hose, the newer style replacement hose, and the coupling. He looked at them all, paused, looked again, and said, "Nope." I had to ask him why the coupling wouldn't work. He said, implying in his tone that I was on the stupid side of smart, that I was trying to fit a male coupling to a male coupling. Wouldn't work.

I pointed to the label on the coupling package: "FEMALE". He frowned, grabbed the package, studied it carefully, looked at my hose, looked at the coupling, looked at the new hose, looked at the coupling and then looked at me. "Well, let's find out!"

He ripped open the package, screwed the coupling onto the hose, studied it carefully, and then said, "It's worth a try."

Biting my tongue to prevent further argument and accusation, I asked simply for a roll of teflon pipe tape. He told me that I don't want to use teflon tape on LP fittings, that no one should ever use teflon tape on LP fittings

I told him that the original hose, which I had in my hand, had been installed using teflon tape, on my propane trailer which I bought new the previous year from Camping World of Boise. He shrugged, telling me it was installed wrong.

I paid my money, installed my new hose and new style coupling, soapy water tested and left town to go camping.

This place is amazing! I was looking for somthing fun and different in town and found 830 common . Had family and friends in town for the 4th we came in with a group and it was pretty hoppin , we were greeted right away and accommodated quickly! The food was hard to find just one we loved service was super friendly and the atmosphere was fun and upbeat! I highly recommend this place . Found our new hangout.

I've never been so disappointed in a car wash. The young man who introduced us to our options was awesome; I decided to go with the ultra wash with an upholstery deal to clean the seats. He was extremely nice and he made a great effort to make us feel welcome... And that's the end of anything positive.

Thirty minutes later I got my car back. They managed to get one stain out. My car still had dirt on it, there were additional stains on the seats (they added) it was still dusty, they made no attempt to get anything significant off of the car. I scratched some of the grime off of my car with my thumb. 

They wrapped the driver's seat in plastic because the cloth was still wet. They didn't do the same on the passenger side, so my mom sat down into a soaked seat. 

They didn't put in the scent for the vents that was listed with the upholstery deal. 

Here's the ultimate one star review: I went up to the desk with my mom to tell them I couldn't find my receipt, they acted very upset until finally another woman came up and said, "Justin?" She didn't make eye contact with me. "Yes," I said. Talking to the other woman at the desk she said, "he couldn't find it because he left it in the car and he HASN'T paid." She said this then turned away. I know some of that may seem harmless, but the subtext there was that I wasn't going to pay... Standing there with my wallet in my hand. 

So other then my car getting a horrible wash, no attention to detail, no warning about the wet seats, I was treated like a potential criminal.

I will never be returning here and will strongly advise anyone against it.

Beds were uncomfortable, breakfast was something I would only eat if I knew I wasn't going to eat for 15 hours, and the housekeeping was so so (didn't empty my trash for a few days).

The place was also really noisy.  Think walls allowed me to hear the kids running, jumping and screaming in the room above.

We were traveling through from Arizona and fell in love with this place.  We had a chance to try pepperoni pizza, a specialty pizza, bread sticks, and the meatball sub.  WOW, can't wait to try again.  We live in AZ and look forward to a day when they open in AZ.  Until then, we would travel many miles out of our way to eat at this place!  The people are friendly and customer service is outstanding!  Love the fact that you can drive thru and get just a slice of pizza.  Oh, and their specialty sauces are amazing.  One in AZ can't come too soon for us!!  Go Johnny Bronx Pizza!!
Great service and food . The team was friendly and informative it was my time in and I was very impressed by the service.

Nest by the slice pizza joint around.  I literary crave it at this point.  The subs are delicious as well and the breadsticks are hands down the best you're going to find.  Whatever you do, don't leave without one of their icecream sandwiches.  Amazing!!+

What a fun new way to eat pizza. We bought three  kid sized cones and they were cooked perfectly. I had the chicken buffalo and it was okay. A lot of sauce for sure but I think next time I'll try something else. Friendly staff and not too long for food to come out.

Being new to the area, I was unsure where to go. I received a local magazine with an advertisement and coupons for the salon. I decided to give it a try. I'm so glad that I did. They are absolutely wonderful. From the moment you walk in until you leave, they are attentive to you. Jacee was my stylist and she was awesome. She took the time to make sure I received exactly what I wanted. I will definitely be going back.

$39 for our food and we didnt get any condiments. I ordered a chicken sandwich bundles and I literally just got the meat smh.. never again are we going to sonic. Thank goodness we were able to get condiments at the hotel.
We did a pick up and got a couple of containers for home.  The chocolate ice cream was by far the best ice cream that I have ever eaten!  I want to stop by every time I drive by!
At most, a 4 inch top and bottom partial waffle with ice cream and a drizzle of caramel sauce. $5 for this? Who are they kidding?

As Denny's go, this is a good one.  We have had breakfast and lunch here over the last week.  The original Grand Slam is still a good deal.  

The double cheeseburger is a monster.

Both visits, we had Nicole as our server.  She is a great asset for this location.  Attentive, friendly and accurate.

Absolutely the worst! I bought a LivingSocial that was the featured deal and when I got there they wouldn't honor it it said over 1000 bought  on the living social website and the manager and the person at the counter told me it was a scam! Then they got all smarty pants and rude! Needless to stay I did not buy the hamburgers there was no one even in the place so I would imagine the hamburgers were horrible. Don't go here!!!!!

I've been to other Jiffy Lube locations and had decent service. When we arrived here both bays had vehicles being serviced. They must have been both getting more than oil changes because we waited around 35 minutes. Another customer arrived and pulled in behind our vehicle (so bay 1 had no line and bay 2 now had two cars in line). The vehicle in bay 1 finished and a new customer pulled in. They were directed straight into bay 1. So me and the guy who got there after me had to waIt while employees had this new car cut in front of us. After about 5 minutes I went looking for an employee because we had been waiting about 40 minutes now. They were all in the bays. I collected my family and got in our vehicle. An employee came over to say they were almost done working on the car in front of us. I was too incensed at them having a customer cut in front of us after waiting long enough for two oil changes to have been  done. We left with them looking at me like I was some a$$hole (I was polite, but direct...definitely not being an a$$hole). I later went to Einstein's where I received prompt, courteous service. No more Jiffy Lube for me, just Einsteins.

Stopped in to try this place. First it's not in the best spot and the parking lot is small and can get full when busy. Luckly I went after the lunch rush. The employees are nice and friendly and will answer any questions. The menu is pretty simple and there isn't a tone of selections. It's 6 bucks for a basic come which is same as 1 topping slice of pizza and 7 bucks for a premium which gives u more toppings or u can build your own. They have a simple soda machine and chips for extra. I got a meat cone which had pepperoni and sausage and a small drink was 9 bucks which isn't bad but the cone isn't huge and I could have easily ate another one. They say it's equivalent to 2 slices of pizza. Overall for the price and food it was good. The restraunt it's self was weird  very industrial which means uncomfortable seating but it only takes 5 mins to eat one so you don't sit that long. Overall a good grab for a good price will probably hit it up again when I am around.

One couple in front of us ordered 2 coffees. We ordered 3 bagels...took almost 15 minutes to receive 2 of the 3 bagels and had to leave for a soccer game without the last bagel which was already paid for. Super slow service...disappointed!  Late for warm up and an empty stomach and a loss of $$$.  Use to be a customer WILL NEVER BE BACK

I was so happy that we had a tire dealer real close that could do my tires and oil changes, and pack my trailer bearings.  Until recently I would have given them a 4 or more, however my recent experience soured me on them.  Last summer they put a new tire on my boat trailer, but I got a couple of comments that the trailer did not look like it was tracking properly.  I did not think Much of it since the tire they put on was new and the other tire still had 80% tread.  I recently took the boat out of storage .Boat dealer to prepare it for spring fishing, it had been in storage for about 6 months.  I noticed The boat weaving a little and I remember comments I got last summer so while I had it out I took over to commercial tire to see what was wrong.  The attendant found out that a bias ply 
Tire was put on at commercial when the other tire is a radial.  Of course this is a no no even
Though the attendant didn't seem like it was a big deal.  Anyway, he quoted a retail price to 
Replace the tire and offered no concession even though they screwed up.  His excuse was

Service and seating was very prompt. We sat outside and got everything ( utensils and such) as well as water immediately. Then ordered when we were ready and food was out quickly. 10 or 15 minutes I would say. Their I am your huckleberry alcoholic drink was well made. Food was 12/10. Very good and made perfectly. I got the bleu bugers ordered medium rare ( some pink) and it was spot on. The lady got the shrimp poboy and it was delicious as well. Portions for the price were great. I never really leave reviews but this establishment made me! Haha try it, you won't be disappointed. I cannot speak for rush hour service as we were there at lunch.
Love the food, wait staff are improving.  Like the variety of unique meals.

Dave was knowledgeable, friendly and helpful. I had some out-of-state residency issues and I needed to ensure I was in compliance will all laws. He did the research, called me back and helped me make a purchase. I highly recommend this business and will be back soon. Don't take my word for it, go check it out!

I've gone to see Jason for over 20 years. Him and his staff are extremely professionally and always so helpful with all my computer needs. Always willing to take time and answer any questions. They will even tell u to bring  your computer even if it's a quick fix. I highly recommend them  to everyone i know. And very reasonably priced. Jason always goes above and beyond to make his customers happy.

This place deserves 5 stars all the way.  

For the price you pay...:
DO NOT COMPLAIN!!

It's real Chinese food, made the way it was originally during the gold rush!

Awkward method to order food. I was there to have dinner with two others that arrived after I did. I wanted a beer before they came but had to buy it separately from the meal because they don't offer table service. 
You go in, grab a menu and sit down. Then get up and stand in line to order your beer and food. Then stand there some more to wait for your beer.  They do bring your food to the table for you. 
Truffle frys were very good and the burgers are cooked to order.

It's a very loud place, typically they have the TV and music playing very loudly. With the chatter of the clients and nail technicians, this is not a place to relax and enjoy a pedicure. They do a good job cleaning up ingrown nails. Massage on pedicures are average.
Best New York style pizza I have had since moving here. Staff always nice and friendly and my children's favorite pizza.

I went to see Clayton for a PCA peel with a Retinol boost and I am very happy with my results after just 1 peel my skin is brighter and tighter my active acne is significantly reduced wow amazing. I was a little nervous at first being that I have ethic skin and couldn't find any pics on yelp of a darker skin client before and after pics but Clayton knew exactly how to care for my skin. I can't wait to start my microneedling sessions. The  pca peel with retinol boost was a great introduction to getting my skin back on track oh and the prices for services here are amazing thanks Clayton I will  be seeing you soon ;)

What can I say about Clayton???  He is the best!!!!  He is friendly, knowledgeable and very detailed. I was so scared and worried about having my eyebrows mIcrobladed. He made me feel so comfortable and he didn't even hurt at all!!!  He was just amazing. My eyebrows look amazing. He  will be the only ONLY one that I will  be going back to for any of my skincare needs and I will recommend him to all my family and friends. I just love him to death.

Our first visit to this new restaurant. We had to try out the savory and the sweet. I had the chicken avocado tartine. It was delicious! The creaminess of the avocado and overeasy egg went perfectly with the sauce, spicy chicken and cheese. My wife had the chicken bacon ranch sandwich. She says it was good but the bacon was undercooked to her preference but just fine by mine. So if you want crispy bacon, you'll want to ask for it. For the sweet we had the Red Wonder. You can't go wrong with delicious biscoff cookie butter, whipped cream, and berries on a very nice waffle. The staff was very friendly and courteous and brought our food to us. The booths are hard and very upright so not super comfy. Overall a good experience.

Brewforia is the best beer store I've ever been to, plain and simple.  I just got back from Seattle & I visited the best specialty beer stores in that area and none of them were even close to Brewforia.  Rick Boyd, the owner, spends a lot of time researching beers, going to festivals, visiting breweries, and arranging to get the beers locally.  It's not always possible, but if at all possible, he'll get it for you.  You can mix and match beers and they only cost the same as if you bought the entire 6 pack.

The prices are very reasonable!

You can also drink the beer on-site as he has both on-site & off-site consumption permits.  And recently, they even got a pizza oven, so you can have something to eat as well.

I just don't know how you can be disappointed with this specialty beer store.  Great beers and great service.

I'm sad to say that our experience with this company was not what we expected.  We contacted them via a personal reference that gave this company high marks.  Alas, they didn't live up to their word.

When we first contacted the company, we spoke with Rachel.  She was friendly and explained their process, making sure to point out the benefits of their service that set them apart from their competition.  Top of the line equipment, cameras to show before & after shots, etc...  Sounds great...your hired!  Well...that didn't work out. :(

First off, Ryan was not very personable or friendly upon arriving.  As a previous business owner, I feel it's important that the company be represented in a positive light to encourage loyalty and growth.  He didn't acknowledge me, and only spoke to me when I spoke first...and barely then;  based on this alone, I would not recommend them.  Why give my money to someone who is unappreciative when there are others who value their customers?

Secondly, he didn't communicate what he was doing as he went along; he didn't explain he'd have to almost disassemble the whole furnace; he put holes in the ducting and covered 'most' of them back up with duct tape; he didn't clean up after he was done, and he started to leave without letting us know he was done and offer to answer any questions or show us what he'd done.

How do you provide a service that you're being paid for, be unfriendly, barely communicate with the homeowner, and then try to leave without cleaning up or saying anything, not even a Thank You?  Not good business in my book.  And...we're still having issues after the service, and wonder about his thoroughness.  It might also be a good idea to make sure all of your wonderful equipment is in full working order when you arrive at the job site; at least give a heads-up if it's not.

There is nothing I like more than singing the praises of a company I've done business with...especially a local, independent company.  Let's hope this serves as an opportunity for Boise Air Duct Cleaning to do better by their customers.

Delivery BOBA! I love that this place delivers, so nice to mix it up with something over than Jimmy Johns and Dominos. Great fresh rice bowls, the steak and salmon are both surprisingly good for a quick meal type place. If you've never had Thai tea its amazing, and even better in boba form, must try!

Holy Cow.  Delicious breakfast.  Great service. Very fast and friendly. I ordered the sausage sampler.  Every sausage (chicken apple, Mexican and Italian) was flavorful.  My husband ordered the Alaskan salmon eggs Benedict.  He was wowed as well.
I love me some waffle love. I had Nutella and raspberries with a side of lemon curd. Mmmmmmm....

OMG YUM 
So so so so so so good.
It is new like never heard of before so it being really good and being new way to eat pizza, ya... I'm in!!
We come here about once a month, not as good today, I know it's not about the toast but it helps if they use a better grade instead of the really cheap stuff.
This is basically the best Ramen place in town. The tonkutsu is so good and hearty. I did not have such good pork belly in Boise. Thanks Ramen Sho for making such great broth and noodles!

Worst service I have EVER experienced. Came in with a party of 5, separate checks, and the food came out with a 20 minute gap between according to the checks. First one took about 30 minutes, and they had finished their food by the time the next order arrived. After that was about 10 minutes for us to finally get our food, and when it finally got the table both dishes were lukewarm. Server didn't check in once to get us more water or ask how the food was (once it finally arrived) and spent the whole time chatting at the bar (less than 10 feet away from our table). Absolutely no communication about why our food came out so late except for a "oh, they're getting it started now" once the first people were nearly done. Food was decent, would have been good hot, but service was such a bad experience that it overshadowed the food quality.

I will be the first to admit I'm a little bit of an ethnic food snob. While I can totally dig me some Boise Fry Company, I really love authentic ethnic food. I've seen this food truck around here and there and was interested to try it out. They're tucked into a corner of Eagle Island shopping center, near Dekalash and Cookie Cutters. Parking was easy because the other couple businesses in that little nook haven't really taken off yet. 

When I walked in my eyes were assaulted with a bright yellow motif. I supposed it's considered modern but my eyes were bleeding so...I don't know. Also, there was no one else there when I was so the music was blaring. A cashier looked up disinterestedly when I came in. While I looked over the menu (tiny, but hey - sometimes you have a few items and you do those items really, really well), a guy finally wandered up to the food line. Yay. He didn't even say hi until I did. 

I ordered KKO KKO bop. The sweet potato noodles were good. I asked for two of the sauces they listed and they had neither. The guy smirked and said they hadn't "gone to the store" to pick it up yet. Uh...wut? 

The veggies were...well, veggies. Nothing to write home about. The meat was fatty and may have been better with a sauce to complement but I'll never know. The fatty part is authentic, at least :D 

Overall, the best part here was the noodles. The customer service was pretty much nil. The ambience was...nonexistent. Food quality is not great; it's mediocre at best. If I were to try this place again, I might try the ugly bop just because it's a cute name and it's basically fried chicken on rice and noodles, right? Can't go wrong with that. Probably. 

Final opinion: CupBop is to Korean food what Taco Bell is to Mexican food.

I was in town from NYC this weekend to see my parents and wanted to do a last minute belated Father's Day/Birthday surprise for my Dad with a tree for his back yard. What can I say? We found the perfect tree and Tim (who helped us) could not have been more knowledgable, fabulous, and swift in getting us our tree! Picked out, delivered, and planted -- BAM!
I plan on planting trees each year with my parents and will always return to Victory Greens!

It's a love/hate relationship. Every time I walk in there I'm not sure what experience I'm going to get. Either great service or bad service. Fresh food or stale chicken. Tonight was lack of product, so unfortunately my 35 minute drive there was in vein. I wish it was consistent, because when it's fresh and they have all products needed to make a bowl it's great!

i would give zero stars if i could, i have been growing my hair out for 16 years and had asked for just a trim, my hair was past my lower back, after getting it washed and cut the lady had cut off my hair to above my middle back and did such a terrible job. The left side of my hair is way longer then my right side of my hair and missed multiple hairs. This is the worst hair cut i have ever gotten! i would definitely not recommend this company. The check in staff was also rude. DON'T get your hair cut here.

I haven't had the food but they definitely have the best frozen yogurt in Meridian. It's a cool spot, the atmosphere is pretty nice. It's never crowded here, it's always me and my boyfriend and a few others.

I just left. Food was either dry or over cooked. Tasteless. I had a difficult time eating. I just had to stop. The Crab Rangoon was tough, and dry, hard to cut with a fork. Fried rice...yuck. Crab/cheese eggroll, was tough, and the fried mushrooms...well...lots of coating, and when I bit into it was greeted by LOTS of oil,  frying oil?, and small mushroom. Everything was tough, and no flavor.
Waitresses were very lack. I stood waiting to be seated. One gal kept looking at me, then went back to whatever she was doing. 8 minutes later I was seated. It seemed like I was a chore for her, I guess that was my interpretation of the towel in her right hand. Must have been a dinner rush. 5 people in there not including me. So, 6.  My server  instead of finding items to do was playing with her tablet. She wanted me to pay my bill before I left, as her shift was ending, so that she could get her tip.
Best thing...Steve Harvey, Family Feud.
Interesting question.
Is most of this food frozen? The food at several places has been the same. This however was the worst. SERIOUSLY its all the same, From Sweet and Sour, to Rangoons, etc.
Is there any fresh made Chinese food?

I am so happy to recommend James (and Frankie) for all your locksmith needs. I had an emergency lockout (2 different doors) at 12midnight. I called three other '24 hr' locksmiths, each website claimed they would respond within 15 minutes....never happened. Two hours later, James picked up my midnight call, and was here in a flash...literally!!  He was the nicest person, very courteous and polite. My only regret:  I didn't get to meet Frankie in person.   Please do not hesitate to call OBryant Locksmith with all your locksmith needs. I am so glad I did

The crispy crust - I love it! The sausage pizza is my favorite. It would rate 5 stars, but I alway have to ask for extra napkins so I can dab up some of the oil that sits atop the slice. Is that how New York style pizza is? After I soak up the oil, it's fabulous!

I made sure I took my Coleman trailer in before it froze this year as not to be charged $400 to thaw out the lines and winterize. The tech came back and said the bypass valve to the water heater was leaking and said they need to fix it if they had the part. They brought out the new plastic valve and told me I would have to pay for the part and an hour of time. When asked how much for the hour it was going to cost, the price was $129.  Funny thing is, this "leaking" valve is secured with a clamp to a floor joist and covered with foam insulation. Basically no way it should leak after two years or rattle loose. I told them I didn't touch it, their tech was the only one who did. Some how I'm still liable. I made them plug the hoses to bypass and paid the regular $130 for winterizing I should've just done myself. If you want BS service and BS reasons to breaking parts, this is the place. Save your money. 

09/15/18
Went to camping world (don't know why) to get an attachment to go into my pump under the sink. Stopped at their service desk where the always unfriendly men work. When asked if they had said piece the man said, "No those are specific to the brand of pump you have."  I then asked if stores such as Lowe's, Home Depot, or a plumbing store would have the attachment. Again he said, "No. those are specific to the pump you have."  No help, just straight "get the F out of my face" attitude. I left the store and went to Bish RV next door to see if what Captain Helpful at Camping World said was true. I asked the service guy at Bish for the attachment to the pump and he said, "Do you want a straight one or one with an elbow?  One or two?"  Apparently they aren't that difficult to find when you actually care. I should've never gone back to Camping World. Now.  I won't.
Great Pizza, amazing Mac and cheese, bread sticks are unbelievable.   So far everything has been top of the line.  Love this place.

The staff at the the Co-op absolutely knocked it out of the park! I am the lifestyle ambassador at the new apartment community for seniors right behind the Co-op, and we've been planning fun events and activities right out of the gate.  Austin, the wine and cheese manager, presented a fun, engaging wine tasting class for the residents. As an unexpected bonus, Chef Michael, their kitchen manager, treated us to a plate of delectable bites. For our Friendsgiving feast, Mark, the store manager, made sure we had plenty of delicious, perfectly-roasted turkey...and Shawn, the assistant kitchen manager, even delivered it to our kitchen. On top of that, they provided an abundance of goodies for our welcome bags that new residents receive when they move in. Everything they've done has been top-notch and has far exceeded all expectations. They're making fast friends over here for sure!

I came here for buffet with my husband and two small children. It was our first time. Food was okay but service was inadequate. We had a lot to take care of already with the kids but nobody really took care of us. Although the servers were not outright disrespectful, they appeared highly unprofessional, paid very little attention to our needs, and failed to communicate. 
I think the manager needs to reconsider the dress code. None of the workers dressed the part so it was hard to know who to ask for help. The hostess was wearing jeans and a hoodie. I thought she was a customer in a cute relaxed outfit until I was surprised to hear her ask how many were being seated. All the other workers were wearing athletic type clothing or jeans. I forgot to mention that we came on Christmas Day, so maybe they were just dressing relaxed for the holiday. Regardless, it felt like they were dressing undercover or something, pretending to be customers so they wouldn't have to speak to us. 
We felt like nobody saw our table. The girl at the front seated us without silverware and took our drink order. We grabbed a plate or two while there were still no drinks on our table. My husband went over to the same girl in the front to ask about our drinks and she didn't seem to remember him. She brought our drinks but didn't even bother to take our plates away. Whether or not she was actually our server, there were two other servers that were near our table, but never even made eye contact with us. 
Something about the service was very inefficient in terms of communication. When we went up to pay, the host asked who our server was. I'm assuming he asked so he could know who to give our tip to. Shouldn't he know that? Maybe if the server brought us their ticket instead of us having to go up front to get it, then they would know. Or maybe if he asked where we were seated, he would know the server's section. Do the servers even have sections? Who knows. 
And one bonus suggestion, coming from a former server at a Chinese buffet (myself), is to ask the customers if they would like hot mustard, ketchup, and seeds as you order their drinks. And then bring them a nice plate of it if they wish. All I found was a table at the buffet with condiments but no little cups to put them in. Who wants to sprinkle seeds and squirt hot mustard on their plate? Anyway, that's just kind of a little thing, but I think it would make the server's job more useful if they offered something like that. 
Like I said, food was okay. We might come back for that but it's unlikely because of our first experience. Then again, it was Christmas Day. We only went there because our choices were limited. Maybe it was just an off day because nobody wants to work holidays and it was too busy for them. I hope the manager reads their reviews so they can take this one to heart.

This review is for the store and not the quality of the clothes. When I walked in I was not greeted, the people I'm front of me and behind me were though. No one asked me if I need help, if I was finding everything ok, etc. I realize this place was filled with white people and I'm not their usual customer but geeze.
I've experienced this at their food truck at many events and the pizza is amazing!!!  Happy to see a brick and mortar version. Will he stopping by to check it out soon.

I'm not really sure what you're looking for in a review about a co-op. Maybe you're so hopelessly at a loss about your culinary preparations you need an application to assure you're about to make a safe assumption towards the inventory of a cooperative market. Or maybe you just want to know what the f$&! a co-op is... in which case I implore you to take a gander down a google search; as the curation of a professional website will obviously result in better results than what some idiot like me thinks on Yelp. But I'll save you the finger tapping... the co-op is like a group effort towards a local market... where there's a standard for members' economic participation-blah blah blah-the goods are more expensive here. You'll buy a box of macaroni and some ice-cream but leave as though you tackled an entire rack of olive-oil at Albertsons into your shopping cart. There's a wider variety of items here though. Quality coffee. Delicious pizza ready to eat. So if you ask me (and you are asking me) the price is worth what you're getting. 

If you're anyone worth talking to you're probably worried about the intelligence of a guy who walks into the Boise Co-op, becomes a member, pays more than usual for his groceries and doesn't really understand why... and then proceeds to try and educate you via Yelp... well here's what I think about that:

You SHOULD be worried about the truck drivers here in Boise. I was sitting in traffic and two trucks blasted past me in some sort of race or contest. Myself and the other cars around me were drenched in their filthy exhaust fumes and dust. A bit of harmless fun? Wrong. Why were they doing that? To show off their engines? Okay. The engines that someone else built? So they're showing off... what they can buy? And how hard they can push something with their foot? Oh they built the engines? Did they? Okay so they're showing off their mechanical prowess? Okay then why didn't this conversation occur instead of a contest...

"Jeff I really admire your craft. You're one heck of an engineer and mechanic."

"Thank you, that means a lot coming from you. You've taught me a lot over the years about automobile maintenance."

"Aw thanks Jeff. How's Susan?"

"My god Dave... don't you remember... the crash?"

Dave laughs. "Oh you. Stop it."

"You're really worrying me man... I think you should get help." 

"All the help I need is in this Ford F-150."

".........You know I can't argue with that."

Whoof.

Sorry I drank a Guayakí Organic Brand Yerba Mate before I started writing this co-op review. It's surprisingly caffeinated.

I was very disappointed this morning at The Griddle. The employees did NOT wear any face masks or gloves...not even the cooks. It was very inconsiderate. Even with to-go orders, people trying to be safe, wouldn't be safe. Very irresponsible and inconsiderate of vulnerable people.

Staff is very nice and helpful. I have been back a few times to switch out my orthodoxe to make sure I get the right ones for running and every time I've been in the staff has been friendly and helpful. Thanks to Traci, Kelly, Suzann, Bryan, and Greg! I highly recommend this store

Food is always good here. French toasts...any kinds...never disappoints. Fresh squeezed orange juice is awesome...if you don't mind spending $3.25 for a small glass. They have the machine at the back of the restaurant. I had their coffee and this is their weakest item in the menu. It is VERY watery, and not much of a wake up coffee. Plus there is only unflavored creamer. It was so busy that I did not want to ask for flavored creamer like french vanilla, hazelnut, etc. I spent almost $40 for breakfast with my son...yes, just the 2 of us. For the amount of money we spent, we did not bring a to-go box; which I really like. I don't like the super big portion myself. However, compared to other breakfast restaurants around, this place is too expensive. I don't think I could go out every weekend with my family of 4. The wait was also too long. However, the people are nice.

Very mediocre Korean food, but maybe they are trying for some kind of fusion approach, in which case, it's mediocre fusion food.  I got the B Bop cup, which is beef and noodles, and it was edible.  The heat level at 8 was pretty spicy, but the flavor just wasn't there. I've had the real thing in Seoul, and Korean food can be awesome.  It's very fast in Meridian, especially since there was no one ordering ahead of me. The choices were limited, but if it had been good that would have been ok.  Not planning a return visit.

Four stars because of great food and nice selection of vegan products. Staff are always friendly, but the deli was pretty ridiculous. Ordered food, was the only person in line and it literally took them over 10 minutes to make my burrito. It was the slowest moving crew I'd ever seen.

I have tried the shoyu and tonkatsu so far and they were both delicious. The pork belly portion is on the small side, but they are still only in a soft opening so they may just have underestimated the amount of food they would sell. So far they have been open 2 days and have had to close sale due to selling out. I will be coming here regularly.

Update: still in soft opening but ramen has been very good and they are slowly adding more items to the menu. The reviews that have stated that the noodles were undercooked or possibly dried are way off, these people have most likely never had fresh ramen which is supposed to be a little in the chewy side. The owner informed me the noodles are fresh and get shipped in from Seattle. Beware the bad reviews, they are wrong. Service is still a work in progress, but steadily getting better as well.
Great store. Good selection of everything I wish I could buy. Helpful employees. We'll be back for more of this spectacular brand

I had gone to this establishment when it was flat bread, and I must say I love the upgrade. The atmosphere is cozy, and clean, with a friendly environment. Needless to say the menu has changed, but for the better in my personal opinion. They have left some subtle reminders linking the taste between flat bread, and eight thirty common together. Such as the roasted tomato soup, that always is a go to dish for my group. We ventured out trying some different dishes on this menu starting with The crispy brussels sprouts that were fantastic! This dish had a beautiful blend of sweet maple and tangy balsamic with the bitterness of the Brussels sprouts. From there we also tried the " you're my boy blue" burger, the " peanut lime chicken salad" and both of these were amazing! The meat was cooked to perfection with excellent toppings that complemented the overall robust flavor of the blue cheese. The chicken salad was crisp and tangy with a refreshing crunch with every bite. However their beehive hatch chili mac & cheese left a lot to be desired... I was expecting a delectable creamy mac & cheese with a fantastic crumble topping, but I was met with a over all plain noodle with a light cheese crumble... I do not recommend this dish. I would also like to add the truffle cheesy tots to the do not recommend list. Upon reading the menu these sounded fantastic! However after tasting them I was completely taken back by their overall bad flavor... I don't know if it was too much Parmesan cheese, or too much parsley... But these are overall quite disgusting... but with all that in mind this restaurant gotten quite a beautiful face lift and I can't wait to go back! Our server Kalyee(sp) was very sweet and attentive, and took very good care of us!
We greatly appreciate the Office Depot printing department. We have a recurring, large, and fairly complex project that I only trust Office Depot with. Prices and turn around time are reasonable.

Pizza was good. Nothing unique but also nothing terrible either. The ice cream sandwich I was let down by. The ice cream to cookie ratio had me suspicious from the looks and upon the first bite, I was positive. Too much cookie, not enough ice cream.

Excellent Gel Pedicures! Pedicures that last forever!!! Only had one time a tech dug a bit too deep in my nail beds, but the Gel Pedicure still lasted forever. Awesome selection of colors. They always try hard to fit you in, too - even with no appointment and up to 5 of us showing up at a time! I believe they have 6 massage chairs (maybe 8)? So larger groups can reserve and go together at once, too!
Super nice, efficient, etc! I have gone over 10 times there, and my sister, daughter, and Neice all go there now, too! Owners remember us and ask about updates in life, etc. very personable!

Warning! 
I was unlucky enough to have an appointment with Lin. She was so rude to me I will never go back to this salon. She insulted me the entire time because my nails are short and that is how I like them. She filed them on the corners so hard they hurt today beside the fact they look horrible. There was another customer seated next to me and heard the whole thing. Lin is a nasty, unhappy person and she should be fired!

Momo is not a place you go for the ambiance (the decor is 'cafeteria') but for the great food and friendly faces. The food is delicious - I love the veggie momos (sort of like a HImalayan version of a ravioli) and the turkey meatballs (in a mildly-spiced curry sauce.) The fresh veggies and other topping option (I love fresh cilantro and yogurt on the rice bowl portion) make for a delicious meal. And the staff is always so friendly and welcoming that we've been back several times already!
Seriously some really good pizza! Wish there was a location closer to me in boise, but i have driven out to their current location a few times just to get their pizza!
We made reservations since we were a party of 14, no problem getting the time we wanted. The service was fantastic & the food was delicious.

My wife and I just moved here from CA and we are avid fans of pizza. We are constantly looking for places to get our favorite food, and we love being able to take it home, relax and enjoy. This Papa Murphy's location has treated us very well. Every time we go in, we are greeted promptly and by the kids with smiles on their faces. I have witnessed a couple of disgruntled customers treating the employees...not so nicely, and when it came time for me to get my food, they shook it off and helped me with getting my dinner. They have always had a clean store and were always professional. After spending multiple years in the food/service industry, I can say with certainty that this store location is run very well and I greatly appreciate the friendly and prompt service that I receive each time I go it.

Thank you Papa Murphy's Meridian, keep up the good work.

Never buy a gym membership here and give them your card number. They will just over charge you, give you the worst customer service and take almost a month to figure out how to refund!  Worst customer service i have ever had!

Great customer service, great ice cream at a great price. Visited this place a few times when I was on vacation. Chocolate Milk was awesome and the cheese cuts are tasty. I would have give it 5 stars, but they didn't have Chocolate Chip Ice Cream. Who doesn't serve Chocolate Chip?
Reasonable prices on good food and great service!  Very impressed with their new location and CLEAN!

What!!?? Cat Days  now at Paw Spa on Meridian Road. Attention cats of Treasure Valley, want to finally ditch those pesky dogs for the day? Have your own relaxing, quiet time at a spa? Call and make your appointment. They fill up fast, but you can get on the monthly schedule! My kittens signed up and love it! Soft claws , fur brushed out, smelling nice, relaxed and even pics if you're good (even if you're a little bratty she'll love ya anyway! Ask my Bumbi who was a talker!!). I now have two baby doll face Persians I take to get soft claws and their massive fur coat brushed out. They took to Sam well. Sam is a cat lover (a few cats in her zoo at home too!) so kind to all my cats I've brought over the last 7yrs. The appointment begins on time, it is done right, she is honest, it isn't ever messy (you do not want soft claw glue on their paw fur ), it is done when she says it will be, and she'll text you and let you know because she knows it is stressful for you too! I haven't had any issues. My cat looks great. Just remember all the art on the wall is Sam's own artistry! Best animal photos I've ever seen. Such movement and how does she pic up such personality in such detail I'll never understand. Cats can be in color too! White cat? Wish you have a tiger? Bam!  she can do that and it is all natural. Tell Sam that Kathi, Raton, and Birken sent you!  Hope you enjoy pics below of my Persian cats groomed only at The Paw Spa in Meridian, Idaho. Love you Sam!!

This company doesn't even deserve a star not even a 0.25 of a star! I cancelled my membership two and a half years ago. My husband and I went to the gym in Star Idaho and turned in our key fobs to the manager. We then asked him if we needed to do anything else, he said that there were no further actions required and that we were good to go. Two and a half years later I received a letter from the collection agency stating that I owe them $393. I called the billing department regarding this issue. Here are the following things transpired in our conversation

1. The woman was extremely rude

2. I asked her why was I not contacted for the past last two and a half years regarding this issue.

3. She said that they called my old phone number.

4. I told them that I no longer have that phone number and asked why they did not mail or email me about this issue if they could not contact me via phone.

5. The woman in the billing department did not answer that question and told me to call the collection agency. She said "Have a nice day and call CBI." CBI is the collection agency. 

DO NOT JOIN this gym because they do not and I mean DO NOT have integrity! The billing system is messed up; as you can see from the previews reviews. It may be cheap but the head aches of their billing department is not worth it. They say that your account is cancelled, but it really isn't. I have reported them to the Better Business Bureau.

We love Korean food and eat it often, so we were excited to try Cupbop. It was pretty disappointing. The bulgogi was nothing like bulgogi. The meat didn't seem marinated at all, and it was grainy and tough. The marinated chicken and pork also lacked good flavor. Not sure the "fresh meat" slogan applies. They were sold out of the fried chicken unfortunately, which looked promising. Also the quantity of meat was tiny, not that it mattered since we didn't like how it tasted and pushed it to the side. The concept has so much potential, if they just used better quality products and marinades. Not sure we'll try it again :(

Decided to order from here via DoorDash, not only was my order inaccurate (I decided to push past it, it happens) but there was an actual little hair in my food. It's never happened to me before so I was shocked and disgusted. The food itself before finding it, wasn't the best. Happy Teriyaki would have been a better choice and I'm upset I chose to be curious of a new place for my lunch.

Reed's is fantastic!  We enjoy the atmosphere and great selection of ice cream.  Can't believe how inexpensive it is and the place is always clean.  It can get crowded and noisy but that is what happens when you mix kids with ice cream.

This is a fun way to eat pizza. Ingredients are fresh and the cheese is good quality. Price seems a bit much for what you get but the novelty of it all makes it worth it. Good fun. Great staff. We really enjoyed it.

We hadn't had our windows done for quite a while and even longer for our blinds to be cleaned. Myra, Al, and Anthony did a terrific job inside and out! They were professional, thorough and respectful of our home. We were so impressed we decided to have them schedule us for regular cleanings. Reasonably priced and professionally done. We highly recommend them for your window and blind cleaning. I worst scheduled because they had a coupon. Was impressed with the help Ernie provided on the phone when I scheduled. He was helpful again when I called to say it was a great job and ask about being on a regular schedule. Great team all around.

I used to always go to Jiffy Lube. I tried Einstein's because it was close to home. They had great service....and the business as well as employees were clean and appeared to take pride in what they did. I recently went to a Jiffy Lube because of a coupon I had. Very bad experience. I left before my vehicle was even serviced. I came back to Einstein's and, as always, was very pleased. I will keep returning to them for my oil changes.

I was visiting friends and we opted for pizza. I scoffed at the name until I tasted the pizza. This is real New York pizza. In Idaho. I know, right? I mean I once took an entire N.Y. Suprema pizza (413 8th Avenue) on the subway to JFK and carried it on the plane for my flight home. This pizza was New York good and anyone who's eaten New York pizza will know what I mean. Think crust that has the right cross of crunch and chewy, perfect sauce/cheese/meat ratio. Give it a try.

Great ice cream and HUGE portions. We were told a single is about a baseball in size but I'd say closer to between that and a softball. Price was very reasonable for even a regular sized scoop, so the huge one you get is definitely a great deal.
Ghosted on me. No call no show. Called on Tuesday, set up an appointment for 9:30 on Friday 4/12/19. Called several times starting at 11:00. Even called on Saturday...nothing.

.I was hooked on TCBY the same day I went into a Baskin-Robbins looking for a soft-serve treat to relieve me of Mid-South heat stroke. Only chocolate & vanilla? Really? Maybe that TCBY place could do better. Yeah buddy, unique flavors besides chocolate and vanilla. It was just what my soul needed to chill out, and it became a habit. What exactly was behind that acronym? The Country's Best Yogurt.
.This place is off the traffic lane, so to speak. You can see it easily from Eagle Road, but getting there in a car takes a little jig. It's actually in the same building as the coffee place. Same employees. So when I walk into this TCBY, it smells like coffee. If there's nobody there to take my order, I just wait a minute until someone walks over from the coffee business. More customers are in the coffee side, almost any time of day, so that's where most of the employees hang out.
.It's a cozy place, and I have seen a parent with one or two kids sitting at a table, but I would not hang out inside. The coffee smell annoys me. There are other places beating TCBY for sheer variety of frozen yogurt, but once in a while, I still like to come here for the White Chocolate Mousse.

Not all Starbucks are equal!  This one by far, in my opinion, is the best in the valley and all Starbucks that I have gone to in my travels with my husband.  The Pike Place market coffee is rich with flavor and just the right strength.  The people that work here are nice and what can I say... I love this place.
I love these guys! I always appreciate their honesty and efforts to help me save money. As a single mom who knows nothing about cars I always feel they have my best interest in mind. Thank you!

What a great place!!

My mothers visiting the Treasure Valley for the first time, and as we're also new, I wanted a place that had great food in a good family friendly environment and that is just this!! 

Came here on a Thursday mid-morning. It was surprisingly busy, but in a good way! The place was full of families and what appeared to be regulars.

Mom ordered a special, had Bronco in the name lol. Basically hashbrowns with cheese, eggs, meat & veggies topped with gravy... Basically the thing breakfast dreams of! She said it was spectacular!

I had the B&Gs. I've had better, but they were by far super yummy! The gravy has excellent flavor, the biscuit is soft, eggs (over medium) cooked perfectly, hashbrowns cooked perfect & the sausage was amazing! 

We ordered the eggs & meat kids plate for my 3yo, great portion sizes and he ate most of it (he is 3 after all..)

Waitstaff very friendly, patient & knowledgable on the menu.

Atmosphere is really great too! It's an open room but isn't too loud, but at the same time some how seems to lesson the loudness that is a three year olds normal inside voice. The decor is simple but cute, chairs are comfortable and overall vibe is very comfortable and relaxed.

For three breakfasts, two coffees & two milks we spent less than $40 with tip, and we're not skimpy tippers! 

Definitely check this place out!

Nicest folks in the valley, and a great selection. More geared towards bikers than the Euro style Cycle Gear stuff. They have a fantastic seamstress that comes in, too, that handles all of my group's patch sewing.
Great service, food was delicious. Made reservations online and we were seated as soon as we showed up. Heading there tomorrow to try brunch.
Yum! I was definitely not expecting much but our pizza cones we delicious. The cone was crunchy with just the right amount of toppings on the inside.
Such great ice cream, my sister bought some and brought it over. Delicious! Keep up the good work!
Locked the keys in the car and OBryant locksmith to the rescue! In 15 minutes it was all done - fast and professional - many thanks for you help! Reasonably priced too!

I was very happy with my overall experience at Victory Greens.  I came looking for a blue spruce tree and the staff was extremely helpful in finding the perfect tree to fit the space in my  backyard.
