The tree was delivered to my house on time - DeAndre and Judah were very friendly and accommodating to my requests on where to plant the tree. They did a tremendous job!  Thank you!

Hands down the best oil change experience I have had. The employees were professional, friendly and informative. I typically get my oil changed at Toyota but today I realized this was a better overall experience. The manager Tony took the time to come out to my car to explain how the settings for my tire pressure, oil change and overall maintenance work (something I was oblivious to when I was getting my oil changed at Toyota). The employee Sam was friendly and only suggested things I might need in the future but never pushed me to buy anything I didn't need. When I pulled up another employee started washing my windshield (it was very dirty after a 13 hour drive). I told him that he didn't need to wash it but he instead it was spotless. Overall, it was a wonderful experience. I highly recommend! Thank you all for the great service!!!!

OUCH!!!   Do check around on prices before you use this company.   I needed a sink disposer replaced and it cost over 300.00   Come to find out the same item could be bought at Walmart for 89.00.  I understand mark up and the cost to install but that seems a bit on the high side.

Check your prices.

What can I say , it's Denny's!! A big chain with alright breakfast , they need to educated their waitresses to attend their customers in a timely manner and not be so rude. It doesn't take 15 minutes from sitting down to get a cup of coffee. Waitress should ask you what you want to drink as soon as they sit you down . Well that's not the case here. Good luck even getting your food at a  reasonable time. If you are in a rush to get to work or anywhere , don't go here !!!!

We have been in several times since my last review. The last couple times, the tacos were unbelievably greasy, but still good aside from that. 

Tonight, every single one of our tacos arrived at our table broken in half. We had to ask the waitress for silverware just to eat them. They were also dry, and the queso wasn't near warm enough. 

They've also doubled the price from $1 to $2, although their signage has remained the same and the quality has gone way downhill. 

After this visit, we won't be back.

August 3, 2012


Disappointing lunch experience

Went there for lunch today - arrived at 12:45. There were two people in the restaurant when my friend and I arrived. One of us ordered an appetizer and soup of the day - the other soup and house salad. It took 45 minutes to get our food, which was mediocre at best. Soup was so so, appetizer very disappointing, and house salad very good. Waiter was slow, not very helpful, and not friendly. Another couple came in later, and took forever for them to get their food, and they were also not happy. We went to scout the place out as a potential location for our 12 person lunch group - it is a definite no.
Wine was very good.

My wife and I tried this renewed establishment for the first time tonight. We were big fans of the prior Flatbread Pizza at this location. After reading the reviews I was a little nervous...not sure my nerves were completely calmed after our experience, but maybe some of you are correct that they are working through some growing pains?

We ordered a couple of dishes from the Happy Hour menu, the Brussel Sprouts and a couple of tacos. I enjoyed the tacos...especially the corn tortillas. Homemade?

The sprouts were just ok. Too much vinegar for my taste. 

We also had the (un)common burger with fries. Not bad. Wasn't amazing or anything brilliant. Just a burger. 

I laughed when I read several other reviews that mentioned an unenthusiastic waitress. Yes, we agree. 

I like the addition of some TVs. We arrived really early, so it was super quiet. I hope they can work out a few kinks...we will try it again in a few weeks. 

Oh...3 1/2 stars! My wife gave it 3 and I leaned toward 4.

Great people and product from their place to mine. Saw the ad on tv for free planting and decided to check it out. From the time I got on the golf cart to go pick a tree knew I had come to the right place.

With the tree picked out delivery and planting was scheduled. When the crew showed up they were courteous and ready to work. Quickly they found that previous landscapers had not removed stump that I had paid for, just cut below dirt. Instead of explaining to my wife why they couldn't they just did what was needed to make it a successful plant. Planting and staking done as promised and it was like the tree had been there for years.

Would recommend to anyone looking for a new tree.
We tried Tako-yaki appetizer today, taste very yummy, the Raman are as good as always

I only come here because they are close to my house. They carry certain a foods not available at normal groceries  chains.

If Whole Foods was closer would go there instead. 

I find the cashiers to be rude. They can improve on their customer service skills.

Clayton did a fantastic job on my eyelash extensions. His studio has a fantastic, calm feel and very relaxing. Clayton himself is very personable and fun to talk to. I highly recommend Clayton and Meraki.
Service was decent but the drinks were pretty disappointing. Biggest complaint is having Fox news on the TV. Better off to go next door.

Horrible customer service in the parts department! My review is not based on calling in just once or twice. I have tried buying parts from them several times over the last few years and they are always very short and cranky over the phone and in person!! They act like they could care less about me as a customer. I will never stop in there again for a part and will definitely never buy an RV from them! Rediculous!! I'll just order online from now on.

I've always looked forward to getting my oil change at Einstein's oilery. Today I went to get an oil change and it took so much longer then normal and the crew was mostly just standing around. Normally I only wait 5-10 min, this time I waited almost 30 min before I even pulled in to get service and it wasn't any busier than normal. 

But the thing that was the most different was the customer service wasn't good. No energy, the employees don't seem like they want to be there, no greetings. Normally the employees come running to the car with a news paper and a drink. This time nothing of the sort. 

I then found out that they were bought out by valvoline and it made a lot more sense. 

Then after being home for a couple of hours I begin to smell oil in my garage. After looking underneath my vehicle I see that my car is leaking oil everywhere. Also again I ended up back in line waiting (forever) to get it fixed. After they looked at it they said the they didn't fasten something down well enough. They offered me a discount on my next service I asked for a discount on today's service and they said they can't do that, "because they can't take money from corporate".

I'm super sad the Einstein's sold. They were truly great.

Everything was not even edible and had clearly been under the heat lamp all day. Literally the only thing to eat was the fruit...or jello. And you're paying top buffet prices- Couldn't pay me to go back.

The best computer shop in the Treasure Valley!!! I've gone to Jason and his team for over 15 years...very reliable, hardworking, very fast....and very friendly staff. Very reasonable priced and excellent customer service. Even if its a simple question I know I can always call or go in and they are always happy to help u out. I wouldn't  trust anyone else with my computer or buy any computer anywhere else. 
Jason and his staff always goes above and beyond to make sure his customers are always happy!!!! I will never go anywhere else!!!!
We came as a group of 7 for kids eat free last Saturday at dinner time. The food was good, service prompt, and we had a great time! Just a regular, familiar Denny's experience.
Their Sunday brunch is delicious!! A must for anyone looking for delicious breakfast and even gluten free biscuits and gravy!!

CupBop... ok the name had me totally intrigued! I am super happy the hubby pulled over to eat here. First I walking in, the restaurant is easy on the eyes and very clean. Our server was super friendly and informative. Since we have never been here before he explained the menu real quick without confusing us. Everything, literally everything on the menu is freaking AMAZING! First bite was a pot sticker. Best freakin pot sticker I have ever had. The combination of the meat, rice, and noodles (which are sweet potato noodles, but you would have no clue because it just tastes  like a regular noodle to me!) was perfect! And when you think it can't get any better, you're wrong! You have ten different sauce options to choose from. I got a level 5 which is the same as the sracha and mayo sauce from sushi joints. The Korean bbq sauce is so amazing too. Then you have the option to add some sesame seeds on top! Sooooo delicious! My husband and I are excited that we found a new go to spot. Something affordable, delicious, and filling! Can't wait to go back!!!

I needed to rekey my front door and called him on a Sunday night at 730pm. He showed up 20 minutes later and rekeyed the door. 

He was very nice and efficient and he had the cutest dobie in the backseat of his car!! 

He accepts all forms of payment. I wish I had cash at the time to tip him. His pricing was fair! 

I would highly recommend!!

IF YOU WANT WHITE MEAT CHICKEN HERE, YOU CAN ONLY CHOOSE FROM 2 DISHES.

Before I decided to write my review, I looked through the others. There is a very mixed bag of reviews. It seems that either people loved this place or hated it. it is very very hard for me to imagine anyone liking it here. Please read on to find out why.

I have been here once before back when it 1st opened. I remember it well. My wife and I came in and sat down. Our experience with Chinese places has taught us to always ask if they serve white meat chicken.

White meat is not traditional in China. Dark meat is cheaper, and can be more flavorful than white meat unless a cook knows what they are doing.

After I wrote my review, the owner, or manager, emailed me and promised that they did indeed have white meat chicken. I trusted him and took down my review.

I have meant to return, but just could not bring myself to do it. The outside looks bad. I dont recall what was here before, but it looks like an A & W, or something else like this.

They have attempted to turn it into Chinese, but wanted to keep an American feel to it as well. This way, they can also appeal to Americans. 

They failed on both counts.

Today, I decided to return to give them one last chance to redeem themselves. We asked the server if they had white meat chicken. She said yes, but then after I ordered, this changed.

She said that there was only 2 dishes that came with white meat chicken. I wanted the Generals, but this was not one of them. I told her that the manager promised they had white meat chicken. She went to ask and came back and said no. 

I read through the menu and found an item that said right in the menu that it was chicken breast. It was not one of the 2 that she said was white meat chicken.

I thought to myself, doesn't Chicken Breast = white meat chicken?

I pointed it out to the waitress. She seemed surprised. I dont think she knew her menu at all. In fact, after eating here, my guess is that none of these people know the 1st thing about Chinese cooking. 

Whoever started this place probably just thought that starting a restaurant sounded like a good easy way to make a buck. I can just see Robert Irvine shaking his heard is disbelief at The Great Wall.

This place seems to survive by offering a buffet. So Im guessing they dont get a lot of people that actually order off the menu.

When my order came out, it was the oddest looking Chinese dish I have ever seen. What I got was about 20 small pieces of chicken that had tales on them. They looked like Hush Puppies or a really odd version of popcorn chicken.

The chicken had a tempura batter, which had been dropped in the fryer wet. This is why they seemed to have tales. The chicken and batter had no flavor.

The pile of Chicken was served with a large bowl of some sort of sauce with cut jalapenos floating in them. Something else I have never seen before. Uh, excuse me Mr owner, arent jalapenos Mexican?

So we have a Chinese/American/Mexican restaurant. Thats an interesting mix indeed.

The sauce...well, I cant describe the flavor because it had very little of it. it was temperature hot. In fact it was very hot (Temperature) like all the other food. But the heat was the only positive thing I can say about any of it. 

The thing that really floored me was this pile of White meat chicken could be combined with any sauce and veggies to make up any dish. 

Do you want to hear the reason the waitress gave me that none of the other chicken dishes come as White Meat? Wait for it.........

She said its because all the rest of the Chicken dishes are pre-made with dark meat. I was afraid to ask any more questions, but I can only imagine all these items on the menu in plastic bags because they have been made way ahead of time. 

When you order them, they pour the ingredients from the bag, warm them up in the microwave, or on the flattop and serve them.

I ordered hot tea. It had very little flavor to it. My 11 year old, that loves hot tea, commented that it tasted like hot water. My sentiments exactly! It tested the same at the end of the meal, so it had plenty of time to steep.

I kept looking at the inside of my chicken, The light was odd, so it was hard to say for sure, but Im pretty sure that the Chicken was undercooked. Not raw, but still pink.

One last thing I just have to point out. My wife had Egg Fu Young. When it came out, I thought I had been transported to a breakfast place. The Egg Fu Young here looks like pancakes. The flavor was ok.

Due to all the bad things here, I will just give this place an overall rating. On a scale of 1 to 10, I would give it a -3.

I would be very surprised in they are in business in another 6 months. 

Dont waste your time here. Of all restaurants I have reviewed, this is one of the worst.

Go to PF Changs, Ling and Lois down the street, or even Panda Express.

Probably one of the best new hidden gems in the Treasure Valley. The menu sounds loaded with basic comfort food, but I can assure you that it is anything but basic. My wife and I were lured in by the half price appetizers, and we regret nothing. We chose to split the Frito Pie Quesadilla. It was fantastic! We went on to split a few selected side items and were not disappointed. Corn Pudding, Mac & Cheese, Pulled Pork Belly Baked Beans. All was amazing. We will certainly be going back!

Only downside was very few customers. We do not want to see this place struggle when they have so much to offer. Please give them a try! You will be glad you did.

They were so efficient and accommodating. Gave me way more than I thought my car was even worth and found me exactly what I was looking for and had it shipped to me in a week. 
My salesperson was Holden, he was wonderful and so sweet. He even put my dog covers on my back seats for me. Holden, you rock! Thank you!

Finally got to Johnny Bronx pizza. Grew up in Chicago and that's great pizza on the Southside. This pizza didn't disappoint and was very delicious. I give Johnny Bronx pizza an A+ for the tasty sauce and crust. Great service. I'll be back with my friends that fly in from Chicago in June. Good job!

We miss flatbread pizza! Tried this for appetizers and desserts and were sadly disappointed. We ordered some queso... and it had no flavor. Zero. How is that even possible?? It's cheese for heaven's sake! It was the weirdest thing. Unfortunately, nothing else we got was much better. Sad. Wish they'd bring Flatbread back.
Loved this place, the drinks were great the food was good but the service was on point. Ask for  Montana she is Amazing.

Worst experience we ever had.  We paid top dollar for the best detail job and our car came back worse than it went in.  When we complained the owner called the police!  Avoid at all costs.  We still are trying to get the marajuana smell out of our car.

This is what $180.00 gets you.  These pics were taken 10 minutes after the detail:

https://ultratouchboiseid.shutterfly.com/

You be the judge.,

What a treat!!!  The ice cream is phenomenal and there are SO MANY flavors. My kids keep recommending they make a bacon flavored ice cream so maybe one day we will see that there.  
Reed's Dairy is a clean atmosphere and a great location with lots of parking. 
Stop in and enjoy some ice cream and pick up some milk and/or cheese on your way out!

Had the most horrible experience! It was a Sunday night around 11 pm my family and I had just got in town from a long 10 hour drive. We have 5 children, as my 12 year old boy stood outside or our suburban. He was wearing a MAGA. hat. There was a young female who was talking about my sons hat. It was pretty clear she was not a fan of it. She then called the manager (Colleen) to make fun of my son. Where we could see very clearly Colleen wording "what the F$&@". Then Colleen walked away then came back to stare more with discussing looks. (Don't think they could see us in the front seat so to tinted windows) they called multiple employees over to see .... this went on for about 3 mins. As the young man with long hair brought my food out to my car. I asked immediately what seems to be the problem with my sons hat? I can see you guys all have an issue and something is going on in there that is not right. No denial he just said let me get my manager. Colleen came out and I asked the same thing? Baffled looks on their face, they never denied it and agreed it was wrong but could not say why or what was being said as I continued to asked what is the issue. I stated you think I am an idiot, the young man with long hair was quick to inform me no one called me an idiot. I know no one called me an idiot but to do the things you are doing you must think I am an idiot! Colleen was stunned and really did not say anything after I asked what was said. I was telling Colleen I was not sure if wanted to take my food, worried of what may or may not of been done to my food l. Because the horrible reaction to a simple hat on a 12 year old boy. The young boy with long hair upset cause I called them out storms away before I could even finish "fine you don't want your food " slamming the door to the kitchen hard while walking in. I explain to Colleen you gave me no option to keep my food and was trying to communicate our worry and disapproval of her and her staff. Trying to gain some common ground is my food ok ..... quickly I realized she was panic mode after knowing she was in extreme trouble and was very wrong. My wife explain to her with all the hate in the world people claim a certain type does sure seems very hateful what was going on. Colleen asked what she could do to stop from this going to upper management, in fear of her own response but no concern with our food or clearing it up. In the morning after on 8/24/202 I contacted the store manager who called me back. He was very clear on Sonic policy of not being partial to any political view and was extremely applaud by what had occurred the night before. He then gave me his district manager David number and asked if would call him. I explained I want to go up the chain very clearly to give opportunity to hear why this happened. As I believe if you write a review or go over people head it is gossip... you must tell the source first so you know what exactly is the intention of the person. A few hours later Dave's called and explain that this was not what Sonic stood for and that Colleen had contacted him Sunday evening the night it occurred. I explained in detail what happened in detail and how disheartening this was. My expectations of what was next I wanted to know what disciplinary action would be taken????? David told me there might be write ups and a talking to that was it. I did as well contact the corporate office. I was very clear to Colleen , store manager and district manager David..... that all this was a lack of management! I feel like someone who would do such things as Colleen and her staff that Sunday felt it was acceptable to do. Clearly to me that there was not control over this location. POOR MANAGEMENT IS WHY EMPLOYEES ACT HOW THEY DO IT COME FROMT HE TOP! I am on vacation and very clearly will be contacting you attorney over being denied service do to my sons hat. Hope everyone enjoys my review I was completely honest and fair to the staff at Sonic. We did not yell or cuss at them but talked sternly and very pin point to facts. Truly blown away at how this was handled. If I was the owner of this franchise I would most definitely be trying to reach out!

So I wanted to bribe my kids with ice cream or shakes and we were passing Sonic...so in we go.  Pulled into the parking spots with the order windows and ordered a bunch of shakes and one sundae plus a kids meal, and French fries.  The ordering was a bit hairy, the girl on the other end of the mic was not super friendly since we changed the order once or twice while trying to decide.  The bill was for $19 and change.  We waited and prepared $20 cash with the change.  When the guy arrived with the order, he was nice.  Were we supposed to tip?  Not sure, but my hubby didn't think so at a fast food place and he gave the money to the guy.  But then...crickets for a moment, and the guy stood there with a pause.  Hubby asked for the dollar change but we then both felt weird afterwards and wondered if it is customary to tip at Sonic.  If anyone out there knows, please let me know....

All in all, we didn't like the cheesecake shakes but the other shakes and ice cream was good.  Our mission was accomplished, kids were happy and we bought a few more minutes to do our errands.  Thank you Sonic!

This was a super stop on our road trip from Pocatello to Eugene. Husband had the steak salad and literally swooned! I ordered the carnitas hash, OMG it was amazing. I can't wait to make the trip again so we stop there again!

We came here for breakfast today and it was amazing. This is your local diner where the owner knows everyone coming in by first name. We only had to wait 10 mins for a table on a Sunday morning which is great for a breakfast spot. Our server was fast and attentive with drinks and food. We ordered the veggie omelet with toast and hashbrowns, the fried trout breakfast and a full stack of pancakes. The veggie omelet was amazing and I love the cheddar in it and the hashbrowns were crispy and delish. The trout breakfast was very interesting but loved the crust on the trout. The pancakes were HUGE, fluffy and most important cooked all the way through. This is a great local breakfast spot with a warm home cooking feel to it. I will be back soon to try their Benedict's and eggs and bacon or homemade sausages.

Ramen Sho is nostalgic to me; it reminds me of visiting my favorite ramen shops when I lived in LA. It is authentic and so delicious! The service is very friendly as soon as entering the restaurant, and some evenings it is very busy, but worth the wait. I order a hot sake while I wait. They have a veggie ramen, which I order, with a spicy miso base. I also get a side of their super tasty spicy fried rice to mix in, to add an extra spicy kick. My husband's favorite is the curry tonkatsu ramen, which is deliciously spicy. I also recommend their gyoza and spring rolls. We always leave Ramen Sho full and happy!

Every time we go in to this Camping World, we are always treated with the best customer service.  All of the staff are very welcoming, helpful and friendly.  Jodie has helped us on a few trips we made in and is extremely helpful and knowledgeable.  

Most recently, we came in to look at the Class C's on the lot and Dave was so pleasant to work with.  He took his time to drive us out to the RVs, walk us through the ones we liked and even took the time to note things that we are looking for and like in an RV.  He was so friendly and not pushy at all.  Even though we told him we are just looking, he didn't treat us as anything but good customers and has the best customer service attitude we've experienced.  We love all of our experiences at this store and will definitely be coming back once we are ready to purchase our RV.

Keep up the great customer service!
What a great breakfast place!! Love eating here! The service is quick and never fails!

Food was decently good. But I feel this particular location is understaffed. I would not recommend coming here if you have places to be. Coming in I had to wait some time to be seated and even longer to be checked out. The wait for being cashed out was uncanny. The guy who finally did help me was super nice though. And the service overall was good and friendly. Idk if it's just me and my paranoia, but I did feel uncomfortable after I heard some of the coworkers laugh when I came in.

Tried the location in Nampa. The staff were unprofessional, the counters behind them had their person staff drinks on them, trash and old noodles they had wiped off of dirty tables with a dirty rag sitting on the serving station.  The "one" trash can was overflowing. And the food, Gross! Pot stickers were cold... weird odd food.

I don't know why they wanted to switch to an entirely different menu & name -- don't mess with something that working!! Anyway, the restaurant itself has great atmosphere and the patio is beautiful. The food was meh. I got the tres amigos tacos. The chicken and pork were ok, but the shrimp was inedible. It was so spicy and gritty. All the toppings on the tacos were cut WAY too big for the delicate tacos. With each bite I had either way too much meat, onion, sauce, etc etc. My friends got a salad and the French dip. Everything just seemed meh. Probably won't be back. Bummer

After a disappointing experience with Goldy's, we ate here the next morning. The service was exemplary. Well lit, clean...nice energy.
The menu offered a good variety. The meals were delicious. I will return and bring friends. Only 4 stars...I'm not a fan of the prices (Still returning). This is a MUST place for anyone who likes flavorful breakfasts and pleasant/charming service staff.
Nice, clean business. Tasty ice cream. Not too spendy. Staff was extremely young and seemed inexperienced. Service was good but a little slow.

A real treat for breakfast!  Corned beef hash (home made) and eggs were excellent!  Service was very good and I like the "old timey" atmosphere and decor.   Good value vs pricey hotel food on the road.

Won't go again. Shitty job. Vacuum I guess doesn't include  seats. Wipe down I guess doesn't include the full dash just half and nothing else. Found window cleaner on inside of doors which they won't wipe unless you pay them another 39.95.  I am demanding a refund

It's always a pleasant experience when I come here to get my car serviced. I'm always out in 20 minutes or less, and they do a great job. They always have a coupon for $10 off a Signature Service and 15% off additional services. They do free Trip Checks if you're headed out of town and just want to make sure everything is running smoothly. They will also do a free top-off of your oil if you're running low but it's not time for your oil change yet. And best of all, the staff is super friendly. They always chat me up about my ancient car and how they think I take such good care of it. They probably say that to everyone but I don't care. It makes me feel like a valued customer, and that's important in a world full of crappy customer service (I'm looking at you, cable TV companies!)

Ok this was my first time here and my last service was all that. The young lad was new and not sure if him self. Food took longer than normal. Coffee nope the lady kept walking by and didn't ask if I would like more. Hmmmm and for the shakes?? Out of every supply imaginable. My lady friend asked for muffin dry and server brought us a gluten free whatever it was?? Then drenched the muffin in so much butter when all she wanted was dry muffin. Never came to check up on us ...... my last time I ever come here. The grade is F-

I highly recommend Window Wizard. They have an excellent understanding of customer service, and the service they provided for me (exterior window cleaning) was completed well and on-time. They even made a follow-up call to check on the quality of service I received, and followed THAT up with a letter thanking me for my time on the phone and for my business. A+!

Terri's Cafe is ok, nothing special by any means. The food was good and the coffee is good, you get larger cups here then you would at a Denny's or ihop. My only gripe is my pancakes were kind of chewy. But overall was a good experience. Staff was very friendly!!!
Corned beef hash was on point! I only dropped a star cause I think the potatoes could have been more flavorful and cut differently, but also that's just my own preference. Great spot!

Always a quick breakfast favorite for mid valley Boise. I love sitting at the counter. Wait staff is usually quick at the counter not so much at the tables. I like omelettes the best. I usually order a side of avocado but the last couple of times my avocado has not been ripe.
Nope they were not descriptive with there fees change the price of my phone without my permission see what happens when you get greedy.
The Ramen and Tako Yaki here are really good! I tried the Curry ramen and my wife tried their most popular ramen, both of them are good!

Avery law has been great, they are usually pretty busy though but are quick to respond. I don't know what that last reviewer was so upset about, maybe they had a difficult case that required updates. So far so good for me.
Delish!!!! Hands down, best Eggs Benedict ever! Can't wait to try other items on the menu!

So absolutely disappointing for a discounted almost $20 carwash. Got in line and they took 3 cars that came in after me, because I got the slow worker. Wise up....too many new car washes in town!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

The tuna melt was of great value and tasted good. The service was very prompt with service which is a huge plus, so one doesn't go waiting long periods of time for a refill on a tasty beverage. The Pub also has a wide selection of brews to choose from.

Okay, I don't get why this place gets so much hate. Service can be inconsistent. But, the chicken here is pretty fresh for KFC. Definitely, better than most KFC I've attended. If you go to KFCs in different locations, the food and care they put in their food has definitely gone down over the years. This location is usually super-busy, so, the turn-over on chicken is much faster making it more fresh. If this place is so bad, why is this place so busy? (People can say location, but there's a subway next door and it's rarely busy.)

Great local restaurant! The menu is a little small, but that just means they can do what they do well! The portions aren't very big and my husband left hungry even after eating half of my food!  The parking was a little crazy. There's not a lot of room in the parking lot so we had to circle a couple times before a spot became available. So you might need to plan a few extra minutes if it's a busy weekend.

First time at this Rudy's and we were not disappointed!

The food was delicious and quite plentiful!

The service of Dayton was fantastic!  Knows the menu thoroughly and was quite the comedian as well!

We'll be back!

Boise Co-Op in Meridian is my new FAVORITE shop for groceries. You can shop if you are a member of the co-op or not. :) 

Every time I stop in, the organic produce looks amazing. They have a huge selection of specialty, health food, and LOCAL goods. I've been able to find all kinds of great items to meet my familly's dietary needs.

This is a new store so it is fabulous and very clean. The carts are great, ranging from the easy push mini carts, to the kid friendly car carts.

This place is a taste of Italy right here in Idaho. I was blown away by their hospitality - The owners go out of their way to make you feel welcomed. I was so pleased with my whole experience... the food is so delicious, my whole family enjoyed it. Thank you for such a great experience, Coned!

We have found our new spot in Meridian! The food is delicious, the drinks are strong & tasty, best of all, it's kid friendly! Service is fantastic and everyone  is so friendly. We will be visiting regularly.
Since moving to Meridian, Rudy's has become our go to for late night burgers and craft beer. We've yet to be disappointed and would have to recommend without a doubt.

Absolutely DELICIOUS spicy miso ramen. Was in the area for work and this place had good prices and great reviews so thought I would stop in. Did not regret it! Adding it to my collection so I can stop in next time IMDb town!

This was our second visit. We used to frequent Flatbread at this location because it's down the street from us. Unfortunately we are still unimpressed. Last time we had the Chopped salad and a Dip, it was ok just not really exciting, and for the price point of the menu you'd expect more flavor. Today was wings, side salad and a burger and fries. 
The good: the server was sweet and attentive.
The burger patty and bacon were delicious. 
The not so good:
The onion straws on the burger tasted a week old, the bun was too soft to hold the burger, and didn't taste fresh, the wings were honestly slimy, the fresh cut fries (which were good last time) were undercooked by quite a bit and a side salad should consist of more than spring mix, cucumber and tomato. 

I was really hoping this place would be spectacular because we definitely need it in downtown Meridian! I really hope they up their game!

Just had a chicken sandwich and shake at SIDS!! My husband had a burger yesterday and another one today and said this is the best quality burger and you get so much for your money. In California this is a $20 burger.
Can't wait to visit again and try more stuff!! Very friendly staff also
Lost the keys to our snowboard rack right before a trip! He came within 15 minutes and got it unlocked for us in what seemed like less than a minute. Can't get much better than that!

Went to Reed's the last couple of day's. The ice cream was great as usual but what happened to the quantity??  The single cup use to be baseball size but now it half the size.  If I'm going to pay almost $4.00 for a the size they're scooping up now, it time to find a new ice parlor.
The food was fantastic, our server was great and the environment was really awesome. Love the location. Really great place to go grab a bite. Delicious food options.

I travel to Boise quite a bit, and everytine I'm in town Coned is always on my list to stop by. 
I love their Buffalo chicken and veggie cones. But you can't go wrong any of the choices. Ingredients are always fresh and satisfying. Desert cones are delicious. Staff is friendly and service is fast.  I will highly recommend coned to anyone.

Called OBryant this morning to rekey two doors for us, they gave us a fair quote, showed up two hours later, and voila job done within 45 minutes. Great service, nice guy who showed up, would recommend again.
Very good buffet, my girlfriend and i enjoy coming here! Loooooooove it, always fresh and friendly staff

What can I say about home depot it's an OK place it's always always always hard to find someone to ask questions about something and you know the prices are OK I guess just be nice if things were a little more and I know people say this 100 times a little more price friendly and more helped
Just a quick stop for a mimosa. bartender made them with fresh squeezed orange juice! Very tasty!

This is the best brunch spot I have tried in a long time! The eggs benedict is seriously to die for. Their hollandaise sauce is heavenly. Also try the pistachio latte!! Brilliant. I will be back for sure!

Just had another amazing bowl of ramen from Ramen Sho! They often are parked at Clairvoyant Brewery on Thursdays and serve up the best Ramen Bowl I've had in Boise! The service is fast and the ramen is hot! I love the miso bowl. So flavorful and delicious!! Eating ramen always leaves me so full & satisfied!

UPDATED REVIEW for duplex job.
They came thru in the end and finished the job, with a few hiccups.  Be sure to demand a licensed plumber for any job, no matter how small.

This Subway has a drive thru and it's really quick. My sandwich ingredients were really fresh, which sometimes other subways have wilted lettuce or too thin tomatos, etc, you get it. Good quick service.
Just tried them for the first time today and will for sure be going back. The flavors are insane! Pure quality meal right here!!

Great business and friendly service! New owners were great!!! I was seated right away and I had a very great pedicure, best I've had. I live far away from this place, but will definitely go out of my way to come back for the service.

I forgot to include my salesman name.... Dave Luling.... best Car salesman I have ever encountered. Made me feel so comfortable, he was very informative and detailed.  Answered every question I had. Very friendly and made our experience  Fun.... We had a good time.

We went here tonight for dinner and it was fantastic. We order the ramen tonkatsu, tantan, pork bun and spring rolls. The pork bun was perfectly steamed and had a lot of pork. The tantan was great and had just the right spice to it. The star of the show was the pork ramen because the broth was rich and delicious. Also, the noodles, egg and pork slices were all amazing with the awesome broth. Overall, so far the best ramen I have had in Boise. I definitely reccomend Ramen Sho if you are wanting a delicious bowl of ramen.

This was my first visit and I chose to bring my family and meet some relatives here. About eight people in our party. We were seated at a very large booth and the servers seemed very pleasant.
The servers appearance seemed to be as if they came right out of cleaning out the garage or some other task. Not very hygienic and all sorts of grunge. Definitely helpful, and definitely pleasant though.
The menu was pretty comprehensive. Whether you were in the mood for a burger, some fish and chips, tacos, or other pub food, it was a very wide variety to meet just about any desire. I ordered The onion rings as an appetizer, and while they were good they seemed to be the kind that were frozen that you just toss into a deep fat fryer. They were breaded so there was nothing really fancy about them. They are served with some standard fry sauce, which is a local delicacy for some reason (catsup and mayonnaise), or with ranch. 
My aunt ordered the skewered shrimp and it looked OK, people at the table did not finish it however so it may have been dry.
I ordered the buffalo wings and they were very good. I also ordered the spicy sweet wings and they were just so-so. We had ordered various meals at the table. My wife ordered tacos which she liked, my mom ordered fish and chips which looked pretty good, I know that the tater tot's were excellent, and the  corn dog bites are also pretty good.
Overall it's a good pub stop I would not give it four stars but I would definitely give it 3.5+. The staff had great attitudes and were very helpful.
As far as cleanliness, they could use a vacuum and some polishing of the surfaces. It looked pretty grungy. But after all, it is a pub/sports bar.

This has to be one of the worst dining experiences I've had in awhile.  I should have steered clear when I was all but hung up on earlier in the afternoon when I called to check on call ahead seating for 7 that evening. The girl was short and rude. We chose this place since it was close to home and we were pressed for time and didn't want to make the trip to the Village area for other dining. From sit down at 5:10 to meal served at 6:20! 3 tables around us were seated, served and finished before we got our food. And when we dared to ask how much longer it might be the waitress got snooty. It should be out soon and walked off. It SHOULD have probably been out 20 minutes ago! Our salad should have been out 30 minutes ago not with our very well-done "medium well" steak and cold potatoes. The salad comes first before the meal not with it but at least I know what took so long. They needed time to over cook or under warm everything. I sent my steak and potatoes back and asked for it to be removed from the bill and just ate the salad. 2 different people came over, a manager and the OWNER asking if "we were good" and "what do you want us to do"?  Umm no not good, I did not have dinner! And what do you want us to do? If you have to ask the customer you have no business being in customer service. I came here for a meal not to tell you how to do your job. Don't offer me dessert to appease me, take something off the bill that I WAS ABLE TO CONSUME! I don't know, the drinks or one of the appetizers maybe? Give me a reason to come back not a reason to turn to Yelp with a bad review!
Service not great. But this place really isn't bad for drive thru pizza! Kind of reminds me of Piehole but with crispy crust. I'd go there again

I mean for what it's worth I would say the food is decently good. Of course I've not tried all the menu items so maybe I have yet to discover something better. It's still good enough though that I like to pop in every now and again. Although I'm sorry but it would be nice if for once I can get my whole order the first time and not need to remind them. Idk how many times I've had people from a bunch of businesses forget my drink. Not that it matters but it's a bit ironic.

Clayton did a fantastic job on my lashes! I had some old flimsy ones that havent fallen off from a different place, but he assured me it would be fine and beautiful once he worked on them.  He did lash magic and I am very happy with the results.

He was professional in every way; from friendly reminder of my appointment to making sure everything was sanitized and safe between every client service.

Thank you , Clayton, for making me look my best!!!

We loved our waffles, but it seems like this location is understaffed. It took a while to get our order. 
Parking lot is tight and there aren't enough parking spots for two fast food restaurants and a drive thru. 
There's room for improvement and we hope you improve your lead time. 
We will give it another try to see if it was just a bad day. You should've been prepared, especially when you had a Father's Day special going on. 
A checker shouldn't be making waffles, money and food manipulation aren't compatible! 
Hope to see better practices in the near future.
They came out and actually troubleshoot the problem rather than just throwing parts in. Fixed the problem straight away. Great job.

I am very picky about my coffee. Was in the area and stopped by the coffee shop. Asked for a smoothie coffee a scone and turkey sandwich. Everything was so good coffee made just right smoothie was amazing and refreshing. Scone was perfect and warm and the sandwich tasted good. Seriously they got my business no more Starbucks. Girls where all super nice and sweet. Very professional team did I mention they are locally owned!!!!!! - best part!!!! Ty guys.

I have been here twice and like the flavor, crunchiness of the pizza, but especially that is served to you very hot not room temperature. The staff has been awesome, nice and very friendly. Definitely recommend it and will come again.

I would highly recommend this restaurant! We were seated quickly and greeted in a timely manner by our waitress who gave the best service I've had in a while. Her menu knowledge was exponential and she was patient with any questions we had regarding the menu and from what I could hear around me, with everyone else in the restaurant. My SO and I had hot tea (worth the wait for the steeping process) our tea glasses and water glasses were never empty. We each had the Tonkatsu Ramen (their most popular item) and it did not disappoint. The broth was full of flavor, the pork belly was delicious and fatty like it is supposed to be. I loved the way the mushrooms were sliced and the fresh spinach was a really nice addition. My SO loved the pickled ginger, I don't like ginger but I liked their vibrant red! Overall we had a lovely experience and we will definitely be back to try other items!

-the waitress asked kids to get sodas instead, so she didn't have to spend the time to make milkshakes.

-the waitress took so long, that another waitress took our order after realizing we hadn't had our order taken

-the food took 30+ mins to get to us (the place was pretty dead)

-asked for a sunny side up egg, received a very over-hard egg

-when asking if there was chocolate chips in our pancakes, the waitress's reply was "flip it over and look"

-waited about 15 mins for the check, after plates had been taken up
________________________________________________________
From one server-to-another-server; very poor service and food!

I rented a sod cutter from this Home Depot location yesterday. The rental office closes at 6 so I had to rent the machine earlier in the day and complete the job after work. The machine didn't work so I had to call some friends to help me rip up the sod by hand. It took us 5 hours. When I went to return the machine I explained it didn't work. The employee didn't believe me. He basically insinuated that I used the machine and just didn't want to pay. I even showed him how the blade wouldn't stay in the down position. I did end up getting a full refund but his attitude was ridiculous. I will never rent a tool from Home Depot again. Completely unprofessional.

I really like this store. The prices and selection are fantastic, and everyone is friendly enough.  The parking lot is always super busy, but  guess that means that they are busy right?

 Bought my last trailer  (a Cougar by Keystone ) and got the best price I've ever seen....and I shopped alot.

It's camping season! Woot!

Great internet & service via phone every time I call in! I haven't had any issues. We have high speed internet for only $45/month & there were no problems when we transferred our service. Highly recommend Century Link!

My group visited from out of state and were quickly impressed with the hospitality. All the employees are super friendly and fun. The atmosphere is amazing. Then came the food. UNREAL!!!! Everything was amazing, so good we came back two days later!! Would highly recommend.

I am updating this review to 3 stars from 1 because they replaced the burnt mandoos and were very polite and nice about it. While driving all the way back there to fix the order was annoying, they owned up to their mistake and took care of the problem. Well done cupbop.
On our way home to Portland, we needed a real breakfast, not a hotel breakfast. This restaurant was a delightful surprise. Wonderful staff, hot perfectly prepared food and friendly, homey atmosphere.

We got a to go order the day after they opened and we were so excited to go try it inside when we had the chance. I ordered the fish and chips it was really good and my husband ordered the French dip sandwich with provolone. The server brought out the food and he brought the sandwich out with cheddar! As he handed it to my husband he said,  "I figured you wouldn't mind because they were out of provolone." My husband actually minded he doesn't like cheddar! If he had been told there was no provolone he would have gotten something else! We couldn't believe they just assumed he'd be okay with something he didn't order! It just wasn't a good experience at all! I don't think we will be back for a while!!!
I love stopping and here and getting a slice for lunch, it's always hot fresh and delicious. Everyone is extremely friendly, I wish I could eat there more often.
Awesome!! Walked in and they went right to putting in a full set. Very friendly and lots of laughing techs. Very warm and inviting atmosphere. Will definitely make this my Goto place
Absolutely love this place. Great food and awesome service. Large menu selection and lots of seating. Everybody is very friendly and great beer selection.

Ok food and nice staff but won't go back. For a single hamburger it was $12 with no sides. The staff sat us and then made us get up and go back to the counter and order,go and get our own drinks. The music was too loud to hear each other. Just wanted to put this review out there for others. Way too expensive and loud.

Bryeanna was awesome helping us pick the perfect plate for brunch.  And she was super patient with all of our questions.  We thought we'd try this place out.  This is our first visit and we aren't disappointed. 

We tried the Anaheim scramble and a latte. Oh, and a cookie!  It was all really good. 

The staff is friendly.  The environment is clean and pleasant.
Excellent service from these guys first thing in the morning.  Not more expensive than other places. Andre was super friendly. Treats for the dogs and coffee for me.  Thank you!
We love Johnny Bronx SO MUCH!! Best pizza in the Valley! Meatball subs are so good you might cry. Love JB!!

Great place to pick up a quick slice of pizza. They are pretty big and thin slices. I wish there was more sauce and cheese on the pizza. The crust is delicious! I ordered the special, cheese and pepperoni pizza and garlic bread. The garlic bread was my favorite. The huge downside, it's slow! If there are more then 2 cars in the drive, its a wait. I wish they had a speaker box at the beginning of the drive to take orders. They do have people pull around to wait, which does help the line. Staff is always friendly and a pleasure to order from.
Super Cool Shop. Great Coffee and the People are always so sweet!!! Love the White Chocolate Peppermint Mocha! YUMMO!

Whaaat?! Why is this not something I can have access to in the Bay Area? This is like getting some bomb.com fair food or Disneyland food but for half the price. $6-$7 dollars for a molten pizza crust cone of cheese and toppings? YES. PLEASE. Go try this- right now. If you like pizza like any sane person this will give you a whole new experience. They stuff your bread cone full of cheese, sauce, and meat and/veggies, put it in a spinning oven that looks pretty neat, and out comes a piping hot cone of deliciousness. If you like hot pockets get some class and have a pizza cone instead. One thousand percent better. Awesome idea executed well. 


I'm a fan! I will be back. Thank you coned. Thank you.

You get what you pay for. We quit going there for breakfast because they can never seem to get all the food cooked right. Either it's over cooked, or cold, or just not good. Lunches are OK if you order something simple.

I absolutely love this grocery store. When moving to Eagle I was so nervous about their grocery stores. I'm used to great organic food so I was happy to find this local gem. I love their local products. The store is clean and nicely organized. The meat selection is great and the employees here have been so friendly. I use their curbside pick up on a weekly basis. Tom is always so nice. There have been a few issues since using this service but they have always fixed any problems. Try their house made salsa in the cute jars. Only complaint is they don't have a store in Eagle.

I love the Starbucks on meridian road. They always provide great service and make yummy coffee. I really like the new remodel and the feeling of the environment. I have never had a problem with this location! Thanks for everything!

The $15 unlimited mimosas here are a great deal! However, I was a little disappointed in the food. We waited about an hour and 10 minutes for the food to come out after ordering and it was cold. The side of potatoes with our meals came with about four little dices of potatoes.. about equivalent to a fourth of a potato even though photos/other reviews showed much larger portions.
We had a delightful dinner. Jasmine was our server and she was awesome. My burger was delicious and my husband had the cast iron Mac and cheese. Loved it!  We will be back

Lost 2 Birch Trees this year due to borers.  My realtor, KC Robinson of Windemere Realty, highly recommended Victory Greens because of their wonderful selection of large 2 1/4" caliper trees.  I chose 2 Cleveland Pears and they were expertly delivered and planted by Lonny and Christian.  The team was friendly and very professional, a real asset to Victory Greens!  They followed my location instructions and knew exactly what they were doing.  They left my property perfectly clean and provided watering instructions with their 1 year warranty before leaving.  I am 100% pleased with Victory Greens and will use them for all my future landscape needs.

Hands down the best representation of NY pizza in our area! The wait was a bit long, but ohhh so worth it! It's only a walk up (pick up) and drive through, so we phoned our order in ahead of time. No limp pizza here!! The crust was amazing!! If you're looking for true NY style pizza, look no further!
I love this ramen! It's the best in the Treasury Valley and the only place that specializes in ramen!

Pizza toppings in a crust cone? Yes, please! Five stars for deliciousness, service, and fun factor; 3.5 for value (kinda pricey for size; usually by-the-slice pizza is closer to $3). But we still come, because YUM.
Great service & food. They make their own sausages and serve huckleberry pancakes! Delicious.
Alisa was just wonderful! I was so relaxed while getting a facial- I fell asleep! The ladies at the front desk were jovial and professional.

My husband and I had a great experience here this past weekend! We worked with Joe, and he wasn't pushy or aggressive. Very nice, and knowledgeable. We knew what we wanted for the most part, and test drove a couple models. So we ended up trading in both of our cars (which CarMax gave us a great deal on), for a slightly used car. I was hesitant at first to get a used car, as I've only ever purchased new, but it has been great so far. CarMax has a great selection, and you can tell that they purchase nice used cars. Not junky, old ones. The process was smooth as well! I'd come here again in the future!

Do you want to know what food in the south taste like?  Well I can't speak to too many dishes yet because I have only been here once. But what I can tell you is that the this place has the crispiest, non greasy, crunchy, yummy fried chicken in Boise.  I look forward to trying the rest of the dishes here. 

The other thing you will enjoy is the specialty drinks they serve.  The southern them master pieces will intrigue you and the marrying of the flavors do not disappoint.  This is a restaurant that should be supported.  It's new. They are learning and developing but wow what a great start.

This was my first time here before going to a movie. The service was good and the menu looked interesting.  

We had the mozzarella spring rolls which would have been great except the cheese was still solid on the inside and the marinara sauce was a bit runny and bland.

My wife had the French dip sandwich which was underwhelming it was edible but I've had better at subway. I had the fish and chips which were thin and over cooked with a bland tarter sauce closer to sour cream than tarter. 

I will probably give them another chance next time around but with so many option within 50 ft, it will probably be my last choice in the village square.

Seriously, the worst renting experience I have ever had. First they did not tell me my apartment was a handicap apartment and then when I found out, they said "oh, we thought you had seen it" when they knew I was moving from out of state. Then the heater is so loud it sounds like a blow dryer. I had to call 3 times over 3 weeks before someone finally came to look at it, Which did nothing by the way. The maintenance guy told me they used really cheap material and that there was nothing he could do. It blows right into my bedroom so it is super annoying and wakes me up most nights. Then, I was locked out of my portal to pay rent so had to call the office to have them send me a new link. I paid on the 4th and was charged a $100 late fee!! That is ridiculous!! I am so happy I only signed through August and can not wait to move out. Do yourself a huge favor and look elsewhere. With all of the new apartment buildings popping up, this should be the last place you want to live.

Waited 40 min to seat 4 people took their sweet ass time and food was sub par. What can I say not worth ur time or energy to go here. Keep making mistakes took us an hour to get our food and even longer to print our charges Messed up three times

Service needs work.  Waited first in line at the counter while two young girls ignored us for 10 minutes.  Food was excellent after about 25 minutes of waiting.  I hate seeing a restaurant that is new at high risk of losing customers over lack of staff.  Overstaff, and be prepared to take a labor cost hit while building a reputation for excellent service and food quality.  If you don't, you wont make it a year. Hopefully this was an exception, we will be back to try again because the food was good.

From our experience if you go to places like The Griddle who also serves lunch the better time to go is after the big breakfast rush! Past 11:00 you should do better and we push our 3 kids to go later  to avoid long wait times... With that said The Griddle should post a sign once you sit down it can be up to an hour to maybe get your food, and when you waive at the manager and make eye contact goodbye and say we can't wait any longer as it's passing 12:20 don't expect her to come over and explain or apologize as her job title suggests she do, it compounds the problem. Then server says "let me get your check for the coffee and drinks" it made it even more special as that's what I come for... The Coffee..This was in a partially filled restaurant while 3 groups of people who came in after are already eating or looking for their checks. Good food bad service and disappointed as we did like the food when we got it. X2 we waited a long time.  This time it was just too long

Typical sonic, had a coupon got a free foot-long Coney with the purchase of another. Sonics are pretty inconsistent depending on which minimum-wage person made your food. Hotdog was dry hardly any cheese very little chilly, edible but certainly not anything to brag about.

Great store!  I'm a flight attendant and have been having trouble with my feet and stopped in The Good Feet Store on Eagle Rd in Meridian.  Greg and Suzann helped me out with their 3 Step Arch Support System.  I've only been using them for 2 weeks and my feet already feel better.  
I also purchased 2 BackJoy seats for my car.   I've had one for 7-8 years and it needed replacing.  I also bought one for my office chair at home.  
Thank You!
Celeste

The Meridian Press did a short story on the International Express which piqued the interest of our daughter who is quite the Asian cooking aficionado. She is typically qualified in the area of Korean and Vietnamese foods.  So, with her in toe, we entered International Express. I am very apprehensively entering a place at 5:00pm and not seeing anyone inside and this is typically not a good sign. The restaurant has all sorts of things that would drive Robert Irvine to get his sledgehammer. The crane game, bubble gum candy stands, mood ring display on the counter and all other assorted items for sale or play.  For me, these things distract from the restaurant and should not be out there for the customers or kids.  Once past all the sideshows, the menu is on the back wall.  It's laid out like Panda Express but not exactly.  You choose your side dish, course and and either a crab rangoon or a spring roll. Do yourself a favor and skip all of that and go to the Bul Go Gee option.  Its a separate meal but worth it.  It's not for the faint of hearts, as it comes with Kimchi.  If you're okay with that. you are in for a treat. The meat is perfectly marinated, seasoned, and cooked.  It had great favor and is the star of the menu.  Alll the other items from Chow Mein, to Shrimp with vegetables are freshly made but they are lacking seasoning, whether that's garlic, soy sauce, or MSG. There's a blandness that is hard not to overlook. The owner/ chef is very personable and friendly. She speaks several languages and has another operation in Caldwell.  International Express is a nice addition to West Meridian but order the BulGoGee and have it for takeout.

Yum! Homemade sausage and fantastic gluten-free waffles. Definitely one of the better casual breakfast spots in Meridian. I highly recommend! I haven't tried any other gluten-free options besides the waffle.

I have not had a single plate that wasn't delicious! From fresh-squeezed orange juice to mimosas, starting it off right is the way they do it. I love the bacon-pecan crusted French toast, but they do everything well. Go midweek for quick and friendly service as they are packed with a waiting list every weekend. But if you're willing to wait, it is well worth it!

Really liked it! I'm from Philly and this pizza tastes like home. Crust was right, slice was perfectly floppy and foldable, and the sauce was great -- not too sweet, not too acidic. It's kind of a haul from where I live for a takeout-only place (had a hot slice in the car but the rest was pretty cold by the time we got home) so I hope they open another shop deeper into Boise.

Staff is great.  New menu and they jacked the happy hour drink prices up.  Was our go to happy hour but $3.00 more a drink now during happy hour?  No thanks.  If I want to spend $8 for a drink on happy hour it isn't at a movie theater bar. Fun while it lasted.

I have come here twice in the past 2 weeks.  Both times I have found some great things.

The first time I found a pair of brand new sunglasses.  The price tag said $16.99.  I got them for $2.99!  I also found 2 Hawaii coffee mugs to add to my collection for $.50 each.

The second time I went I found pajamas, a skirt, a sweater & a jacket for my husband.  I got so much I needed to buy a tote bag to put them all in to take on the plane home.  Clothing items are $3.75 unless marked otherwise & there are different color tags for 50% off each day.  

It's a big clean store with a varitey of items for everyone.

I placed an order on November 15th, they charged my credit card and I've never received my beer and have not received a refund.  I've emailed them several times and no response.  I have called over and over.  They always say they will call me back, I need to call them back, and the best one was the computer system had problems but all the refunds had been taken care of.  Well, not mine and I'm tired of the lies and horrible service!

I'm sitting in here typing this because the service was whatever's and the wait was wayyyy too long.

We arrived around 9:50-10:00am and no one came to offer us any drinks for 10-15 mins. We didn't get our drinks til 10:30ish. When we ordered our drinks we ordered appetizers for our wait as well.

The appetizers can out around 10:40 ish not too long after the drinks. But the whole point of appetizers was to eat it while we wait for the main course. We ordered the build your own appetizer that gives us 4 choices and we got Chicken, Bbq wings, mozzarella sticks and onion rings. When they came out it didn't have onion rings. They told us "oh sorry we're out of onion rings did you want something else" AFTER bringing out the appetizers. Which would have been another wait. so we said no thank you. 

While still waiting for the main course the waitress came out and said "we don't have anymore seasoned fries do you want regular fries" there was 6 of us and half of us ordered seasoned fries. A couple mins later she comes out and says they're out of hash browns and if I wanted red potatos and I said no and got regular fries, then she comes back to say Just Kidding we're not on the same page back there.

My sister ordered a Philly cheesesteak omelet that had little to no cheese and they used roast beef and thought she wasn't gnna notice. Sounding annoyed the waitress asked her if she wanted something else.

Getting our receipt we were charged for lemonade we didn't order, & for 4 appetizers instead of 3.


All in all we waited 30mins for drinks (we watched ppl come in and get treated kindly and drinks ordered right away), 45 for appetizers & an hr for our food that came out burnt and cold.

I don't come often as this location is out of my way from work & home, this was perhaps my 2nd visit. I love the potato bowls and have not had one in over a year, and then I had this craving! I made the trip and I was NOT disappointed.  Look at all that chicken!!! I sent the photo to my mom in TX and a friend in Boise and it got their mouths watering.  They both took off shortly after to get their own and sent me photos of theirs too, and we compared notes. Hint: mine was the best! 
Okay I am craving it again. I'll leave my review at that, and pick up again should I get anything different!
Chicken was great....but you could resole your shoes with the waffle. Tough and rubbery! Very pricey.......

I discovered Driven Automotive several years ago and have always received honest opinions, reasonable prices, solid work, and terrific communication. They consistently back their work and deliver as promised. The best part is they bend backwards to do what they can within your budget and will tell what really needs to be done vs what can wait, or even if something doesn't need repair at all. I can't recommend these guys enough! They've worked on my Lexus GS400 and Honda Odyssey numerous times. They might specialize in Toyota brands but their work is great no matter what they turn a wrench on.

I was excited to see a ramen place in Boise but this place was a big let down. I think it was the worst ramen I've ever had (and I've eaten ramen from mall food courts) 

I had the tonkatsu which was not very flavorful and the flavor it did have just wasn't very good. It definitely didn't have that rich pork taste. The noodles seemed more like Top Ramen noodles than fresh and delicious ramen noodles.

My husband had the spicy miso ramen and it wasn't much better. 

The pork belly in each bowl was just one giant blob of fat. And not the slow cooked, melt in your mouth kind. I didn't even touch mine.

The service was ok. It was pretty empty when we were there and there was a lot of staff.

Flavorful, quick, cheap, and won't make you feel like crap. This place is awesome! 

I've been there a couple of times now and it's been very good both times. I got the spicy pork bowl with cabbage. I think my favorite part might be the glass noodles they put on top! 

I wasn't sure what to expect with their spice level so I got a level 4 the first time (not spicy at all) and a level 6 the second time (perfect amount of spice for me). My husband got the level 9 and he really enjoyed it. I think he'll go for the 10 next time. 
We'll definitely be back often!
If you could see the kitchen you would have that place closed. I work there for about 3 days and had to quit because it was so filthy. -10 stars

We came here during the weekend and it was a little odd  .
The drinks are good and strong but it takes a while to get them even if it's not quite busy and there are multiple servers around (as well as trying to pay the tab at the end ) . The bartender was friendly enough but talked too much and she did seem ... drunk ? Totally worth going for a drink on the rooftop to watch the fire and take in the sunset . Pretty view . It's a weird vibe here but it you can get passed it it's worth going though .

This place was great! We were super excited to eat at a local restaurant in the village, instead of a chain restaurant. We had the wings and a couple burgers, all of which was awesome. Our only complaints were likely due to the fact that this is a brand new restaurant. The burgers didn't come with fries, which we found surprising. I think most people expect their burgers to come with fries and wouldn't mind paying an extra dollar or so to have them. Like some other reviewers, the beer didn't seem like it was a full pint, although it was priced like it was. They have a great beer list though. I think these guys are still trying to figure out some kinks, which I'm sure will be figured out in no time. Overall, the ambiance was comfortable and relaxed and the staff was super nice. We'll be back soon!

Was so looking forward to coming here on Father's Day. Not that this is the restaurants fault but as we walked in through the patio a dog that was there tried biting our 2 year old daughter. It was pretty terrifying. Nothing was done about it. 

Our server was super friendly, attentive, and did very well with our daughter too. She was great. 

My husband ordered 2 different cocktails and could barely drink them both. The first one said it was served on a rock but then came with crushed ice which was too bad. The 2nd one tasted like soap. Unfortunately while their cocktail menu sounded delicious the drinks were a disappointment. 

My daughter loved her kids meal of a grilled cheese, milk, apple sauce, and fries. It was a VERY generous serving. My friend chicken and waffle was huge. The waffle was very good and the chicken didn't seem too greasy but it was just SO big. My husband had a chicken sandwich and liked his too. We ordered the corn dog bites as an appetizer and we all liked those. 

Overall, we were pretty indifferent about the place. It wasn't as good as we had hoped and we both agreed we probably wouldn't come back. When we go out we want somewhere with good cocktails or at least a good beer list and this didn't have either.

I've had this place on my radar for awhile now. So glad I was able to try it today. 

Monte Cristo and Huckleberry stuffed French toast. MUAH!! So good. The Cristo was grilled and not deep fried. It was tasty regardless. Served with syrup but they will give you jam if you'd like. My friend got the French toast which was amazing. Cream cheese stuffed of course. Served with the huckleberry sauce. Side of crisp bacon. I'd have to say the French toast was my favorite of the two but you can't go wrong with either. Waitstaff was friendly and kept our drinks full. 

Can I also be excited because they serve Pepsi products. It's the little things...

Totally unusual way to eat a classic!  The flavors are good!  I had the buffalo chicken one.  I really like the hard crusty pizza dough and the buffalo chicken didn't disappoint.  I have a feeling my kids would love this place if there was one near home base!

Terrific new place for quick food at a very reasonable price.  Unique flavors and just a cool vibe.  My vegetarian wife loved it and so did my little 5 yr old.  Portions were just right.  Actually a bit large for wife.  3 of us ate for $22 and left full.  Love having a new food type in town.  Nothing like it

Very poor experience. Initially came in for an oil change. Went it with 4 working TPMS sensors. When I received my car back, it was initially reported that 3 TPMS sensors were broken. I asked the tech to look again and he shared that it was only one TPMS sensor that was broken and that he had made a mistake. Location claimed that it was broken when the car arrived (another mistake). Had several conversations with the manager and she said there was nothing they could do outside of giving me a discount to fix what they broke. I wanted this location to be my "go to car" place, but because of this recent situation, I will be going someplace else. Buyer beware.

Quiet honestly, the greatest service I have had in a very long time. Extremely friendly, generous and assuming of our needs. They went so far as to remake one of our friends food because he had to step out for a phone call and they didn't want his meal to be cold. Jeff should have his own podcast with how entertaining he is and Allie and Alexis should have their own spinoff in the style of Disney Channel's Ally & AJ.
Food was good and they were able to make me a vegetarian eggs Benedict which was great! Mostly would be back for the great conversation and sweet demeanor.

Came here last night (Thursday). Wonderful live music. They have expanded and are under new management since I was here last. It's the perfect little corner bar. Kind of reminded me of Cheers since I knew many people from the neighborhood. Surprisingly lots of seating but they were filling up nicely as night went on. The usual bar fare which was good. We just had chicken strips and tots. They could have used another waitress but the one they had was doing an amazing job so kudos to her. We'll definitely be back!

Victory Greens is my absolute favorite place to purchase landscaping bricks. I have been buying from them for years. Customer Service is always fantastic. At my visit this last weekend, Thomas provided guidance on how many bricks would be needed for my size of yard. Then Tim had me loaded up and ready to go. They were extremely helpful and friendly. Note this was also during a cold raining day. I would highly recommend them to friends and family.

Do you want authentic Japanese ramen?  Then come to this amazing hidden gem.  Japanese chef and server.   

My wife and I are Japanese...   and it's hard to find authentic food like this.  

You won't be disappointed!

what Boise Foodie A said, and

Some great choices for the closet vegetarian that include rice, beans, vegetables. A few items also marked gluten free for those yahoos. Meat options of turkey or pork, I'd like to see some alternative protein source beyond the black-eyed peas, but I am a turkey fan and really enjoyed the food.

A different set of spices than I'm used to, and very pleasant combinations. Hubs got the spicy sauce, put it all over his 'Everest'/pork dumpling combo bowl and was sweating bullets. I had the makhani (rice with a tomato-cream sauce over turkey dumplings, chopped raw veg on top) alone, not in a combo (no dumplings), not at all too spicy but rather well flavored. Fountain drinks or a few bottled juices, yogurt available.

To be found in the strip mall just north of Elk's Rehab/St Luke's Meridian. From Eagle road northbound enter lot on east side before Franklin road.
They have incredible ice cream. Huckleberry is a great Idaho flavor to experience. Their chocolate milk is the best you'll ever have.

In my ideal world, this is what fast food would look like. Not all healthy or all evil, fast, fresh, delicious, portable, and highly addictive. All they're missing is a drive-through window. If you haven't heard of them, you need to go check them out. If you have heard of them but haven't checked them out, you need to go check them out. If you've checked them out but it's been a while, you need to go back. I'm serious, people. This isn't a game. I want them to be so overwhelmed with customers that they have no choice but to open more locations. More info at my website if you want.

P.S. Get an order of mandoo and toss them into the bowl with everything else. Trust me.
The food is really tasty. The chicken cup is my favorite.  The baby spice sauce has a little kick to it but not too much.

I took my son to CupBop today. He got the ugly pop bop and I got rice and noodles. They charge me $7.50 for a scoop of hard old rice and I barely got any noodles. I won't be coming back. What happened to this place?????
Very easy to work with for our landscaping project, got 8 cubic yards of river rock with delivery for a very fair price.
Amazing chicken and waffles. Waitstaff are very friendly. Drinks are delish. You can't go wrong here!

I found another one, just like the other ones!! And surprise!...it rocks too!

One rainy Sunday I embarked on a journey to the land of Meridian. And magically as I drove, an Idaho Youth Ranch appeared on my left. Poof! "Well," I told my self, " I can't drive by a thrift store without stopping!"

So I floated in! I ooooed and awwwwed. I got lost in the magical castle looking book nook! I shuffled through the packed clothing racks and ooogled over the excellent and diverse styles of clothes they offered. 

I zoomed over to the packed racks of purses (I found a Coach purse for $30.00 bucks... pretty new) ... I skipped through the long runway style glass and dishware section like I was walking the catwalk! "Excuse me sir, do you have a cart big enough to take this all home?" I always think. Glassware is my obsession. How many glasses can I drink out of at once, I always ask myself while grabbing another retro awesome mug/cup.

After I walked the catwalk there is a round sharp u-turn through the magical forest of homeware, misc. and stuff. (The only way I know how describe this section and what my brain screams it is break out in song!) As Ariel from TL Mermaid would say, Whoozits and Whatzits galore! And I say, "thing-a-mcbobs, I've got 20. But who cares... No big deal... I want morrrrrrrrreeeeeee. "

After I bobbed and weaved through the magical forrest of thing-a-mcbobs, I snuck through the furniture graveyard. Hmmm, pretty good furniture for the furniture graveyard...

Upon exploring the cave of extra misc. and sports equipment, I whisped through the registrar and bought all of my whoozits and then escaped this magical place only to say, I should probably come back next week. 

Moral of the story. Don't try this place, you will get lost in its magical wonder and probably buy something I want. ;)

ate here for the first time at brunch,  food okay,  service not much.  The young man who seated us was dismissive.   They need to offer more options fir breakfast potatoes like grits or hash browns instead of 2 large plain chunks of potatoes.  They also charged 8.50 for a not so great cinnamon roll.  Might give it a try for lunch to see if it's better,

I had the avocado benedict and my husband had a carnitas hash .  It was okay,  but when my husband ordered the cinnamon roll he was dissatisfied especially at the price .   Really 8.50 for a cinnamon rolls?
My family and I went there today and had a great experience ! The "coned pizza" was delicious and the staff was very friendly! We will be going back very soon!

We went to The Griddle for breakfast. I was hesitant as we have had soo many not do good experiences with breakfast. O sure, they are all ok, but that is usually the highlight.

I grave a great experience with great staff that know how to treat people and serve you well. 

I grave something different. Not the same old eggs, bacon, and hash browns that any 10 year old could make.

Well, I wont say that this place is great just yet, I will have to come back here a few more times before I can say that. 

But what I will say is that my 1st time was a good one. Our waiter was a tall guy that said he had been there just a few months. 

If there are any more like this one around, they better snatch em up. This guy was great. He was nice, friendly and entertaining. Unfortunately, I did not get his name. 

My daughter said that if we had had a mystery shop at this place, this guy would be aces and get raving marks.

I had the Caribbean French Toast. Anything dipped in a Coconut batter has to be good! 

If Green Beans were dipped in Coconut batter, I think I would even eat those.  I love Coconut so much that I dream of Coconuts dipped in Coconut batter.
