Anyway, this is what I ordered. They tasted a bit like doughnuts, except not near as sweet. I had them leave off the powdered sugar just for that reason. I did not want them to be too sweet.

Not sure I thought I was in the Caribbean as I was eating them, but they did taste of coconut and goodness.

This place is not much to look at and has a huge menu. So I will have to come back and try it again before I can decide if its really a great breakfast experience, but so far so good.

2 hours wait while they told us to wait for 1 hour. A
mess .... 

They gave our table to 3 party coming later after us. When my wife asked (5 times), they said it's because they are 2 people party while we are 2 plus kid. We could just squeeze my son with our table.

My 9 year old was so hungry only had his dinner at 10:15 pm, because we need to wait even after we get seated.

Also after waiting for 2 hours, the appetizer runs out. 

Bad service....

I can't say enough wonderful things about Esalon and Med-Spa!! I started as a client 2 years ago. I'm still a client but actually now, I'm more of a friend as well a client. That's how amazing this place is. 
I visit once a week and I can attest to the professional staff and atmosphere.  The spa is not only beautiful but it is also classy and welcoming. 
Aside from seeing the staff, my favorite part of each visit is relaxing in the sauna and taking the waters. The "waters" is a huge whirlpool/spa with amazing minerals that help relax and renew my tired body and muscles. 
I've had many different services here and I've never been disappointed.
Spray tan, hair, facials,Botox, lip injections, pedicures, nails, I've done them all. 
Occasionally there's a hiccup and any time there is, someone is there right away to rectify things efficiently, professionally and kindly. 
Everyone here is warm, inclusive and genuine which adds to their professional manner. 
I highly recommend this spa. They have a fantastic rewards program for friends too.

Wife:  "I feel like having a snack.  How about a yogurt?"
Me:  "That sounds more like a treat, rather than a snack." (Inside Joke, thanks to Isabelle)
Wife: "Yeah, I'd like a treat!"

So off we go to TCBY.  We love this place, and have been going here since it first opened.  There have been lots of new "self-serve" frozen yogurt places open, but TCBY remains our favorite.  They always have nice people working there, and the service is really great.  And, seriously, this has got to be the country's best yogurt!

Today's treat consisted of two waffle cones, with chocolate yogurt.  Delicious Simplicity.

Yum


[  Why can't you ever borrow money from a leprechaun?... ... ...Because they are always a little short.  ]

Arlene is a very kind, thoughtful individual who is greatly motivated to help others reach their full potential, I cannot say enough good things about her! I started seeing Arlene in January to help break old bad habits and reinforce positive habits and her sessions have really helped! I have noticed that I unconciously do not want to fall back into my bad habits on a stressful day and my outlook is so much more positive. I was actually so impressed I referred my colleaue to her! I fully recommend calling Arlene for a free consultation to see if she can help you with any life changes you want to make, no matter how big or small.

I really like this restaurant. Normally I would give them a 4 at least. But this morning when I ordered my eggs over easy the whites came very runny and ran all over my plate. I did not eat them. I simply asked them to take them off of my bill. Someone (presumably a manager) came over to argue with me that I didn't know how to order my eggs! They did give me a dollar off: I wanted to show them a cookbook.
Five stars simply for the boba tea! It is blended instead of iced which is awesome, and the Thai tea is the best I've had in the area. They have become a weekly stop for me.

I wanted a oil change and tire rotation. Only one car ahead of us, came back an hour later since they said 30 mins, the had two other cars processed and mine was still in the bay. 

This is typical service and I should have learned from the last time here.
This place is pretty dope and the food is delightful. I just wouldn't recommend ordering on GrubHub because they almost always get our order wrong!

My sister actually wanted to try this place out during her visit and I'm glad she found this place. I've heard great things about this place and I see why everyone talks highly about it. Great service here. I love the theme and homey feel of the restaurant. The ingredients in the California Benedict tasted fresh. It was the perfect light breakfast with a side of toast and jam. 

The stuffed French toast is perfect for anyone who has a sweet tooth. It's f

I will say that I expected a larger portion for the meat lovers omelette. It seemed pretty small compared to other restaurants. It did come with more hash browns than I would prefer. Otherwise, it was good omelette.

It's a place you have to try it out.

Food was fresh and good as we ordered off the menu. It was perfectly seasoned chow menu, Orange chicken, and broccoli beef that needed no extra soy sauce at all. Service was great and server was very friendly.

I sold my BMW here and was amazed at how fast and easy it was to get an appraisal and offer. The price was very fair which made it an easy decision to sell direct versus privately because they also take care of all the paperwork. The atmosphere was relaxing, no pressure, nice people - all added to my trust in the transaction. Next time I'm looking to buy a car, I'll start at CarMax first.

I took my car to Bobby's after the driver's-side window stopped working. They loaned me a vehicle for the day, fixed my window within a few hours, saved me literally hundreds of dollars based on what the Honda service center quoted me, and gave friendly service. Thanks guys! 100% satisfied & will be back!

Another great experience with Lance & his team at Bobby's this week! In the middle of a busy day, my car started acting up & I worried it might break down at any minute. I took it to Bobby's & they squeezed me in. The spark plugs & wires needed to be replaced. They had me back on the road a couple hours later for a very reasonable price, which is especially appreciated during the holiday season. Out of curiosity I later called the Honda service center for a quote, which was $235 higher. Happy Holidays to everyone at Bobby's Transmission!

I saw Arlene to help me prepare for my vbac homebirth. I was very excited to experience a natural birth but also felt a great deal of fear and anxiety "What if I can't handle the pain? What if I panic?". Through our sessions and recordings Arlene was able to retrain my subconscious and replace my uneasiness with confidence and sense of peace. She taught me how to use a number of tools during my labor which later proved to be  invaluable. The best part was that I didn't need to actively think "hmm what tool should I use", it just happened naturally as a result of her training and my commitment to practicing. Arlene's hypnotherapy was vital to the success and ease of my daughter's birth. I never felt afraid or even tired, I honestly felt calm and strong. I went from 2cm and 85% effaced at 12am to holding my baby in my arms at 5am, and this was my first time going into labor or even feeling a contraction. If you are pregnant and would like to replace any anxieties you may feel with positive feelings I highly recommend you see Arlene. I relaxed mind means a relaxed body and a relaxed body knows how to birth!
Love this place! Food is amazing! I love the chicken! I love that when I want some Korean food, I just come here and it's fast service too.
This is fast becoming our favorite place in town. Great food. Casual and relaxed environment. Try the Apple Walnut Chicken Salad and the Bianco Magnifico!

Wow what am amazing expirience! This feels like my millionth visit to this restuarant and i love it more and more every time i come! the service is always supurb and the food is the perfect getaway from Boise. I will always and have recommended this place to friends and family! 11/10!

We just feel kind of eh about this place. I love liege waffles and have a great affinity for the little storefront in downtown Boise, so I was excited to stop in. The menu is HUGE, so it may be that we just happened to choose ok options. My husband got a croissant breakfast waffle with eggs and sausage; he was really disappointed that the croissant didn't crisp up at all in the waffle iron, and that everything was so drowned in syrup. I tasted his and had to agree that it was definitely not a savory mouthful, so if that's what you're hoping for, it's kind of a bummer. 

I got a churro waffle with "fried" ice cream (their quotes not mine), strawberries and cream. I had no complaints. 

Service was slow, but pleasant enough. No hate for these guys, but I don't know if there was enough to love to make us go back.

The hamburgers are great.  Even the less expensive hamburgers are good.  The meat is a higher quality.  I like the lettuce and tomato that are on the burgers.  I did order a cheese burger and said no onions.  Guess what---there were onions on it.  I didn't have time to complain and get another burger because we were on our way to see a movie.  Other than the onions on the burger,  they were good.

Excellent, polite service. Very knowledgeable, and happy to give recommendations regarding light, medium and heavy starches for my dress shirts. I dropped off two sleeping bags and 10 or 12 shirts, all of which was ready just a few short days later. I received an email letting me know my items were ready, which was very helpful. Green Leaf Cleaners is now my go to dry cleaning shop.

THE BEST LOCAL COFFEE SHOP!!! Great coffee, yummy food especially the breakfast wraps and always awesome customer service! Hot perk way is my year round coffee drink! When I want something on the cold side, the mocha freeze is the way to go!
Love this store! Great selection and friendly staff. They have all the carhartt items you could ever want! I could spend a fortune here

Finally made it to Sid's last night. Great place! The staff are awesome, and the food and atmosphere are fun and casual. We had a large group, and all the food ordered was excellent. I had to have to Southern Bell shake (which is a play on my favorite donut of Donut and Dog) and it was . It was my 9yr old nephew's birthday and his shake was served with a sparkler/flare in it, which he thought was super cool. 
The burgers are SO good. They blend their own, and their beef and most ingredients are local. And I love that the owner is there to chat with and welcome customers, just like he was with Donut and Dog, which I was so sad to see close, but when I realized Sid's was the same owner I was super stoked! Even better news...they are opening Donut and Dog again in another location, and I can't freaking wait! 

Definitely recommend going! Unless you're not into fun, casual, awesome music, with delicious -you-will-be-stuffed eats.

I started seeing Arlene a few months ago in order to quit smoking, and I am extremely impressed with the results.  I have not had a cigarette in 60 days, and have not had any urges or cravings since the 2nd session.  Most importantly, my family still likes me: In past attempts to quit smoking, I have typically turned into a jerk after 3 days w/o smoking.  Not this time. 

Additionally, Arlene has helped me achieve a couple other goals.  I had a history of over analyzing, and over thinking, work assignments - constantly tinkering and word smithing in an effort to produce something perfect. With Arelene's help, I am now much more productive while still maintaining a high level of quality. 

Arelene and I have also done some work on improving my confidence and communications style, and I'm seeing positive results in my presentation skills at work.

Lastly, Arlene provides audio recordings of every session. These recordings have been great in helping me find  20 - 30 minutes to unplug from the rest of the world and relax; and, listening to them has really brought my stress levels down. 

I would definitely recommend working w/ Arlene.
It was good. It just wasn't something that I'd crave on a regular basis. My kids loved it.

We loved the pizza cones! Have had them from the food truck and was happy to see they have a Meridian location. Kids size was perfect for a 7 year old. Employees are really nice. We can't wait to try the desert cone!!!

Best kept secret in Asian food in Boise. Super friendly staff, great food and the freshest quality. Had a small wait offshoot 10 minutes the flavor and quality far exceeded the wait. Give them a try the chow main is awesome.
If you want to find great Korean food this is the place! The food is delicious and the service is quick.

this place is SO good. ugh. I just am so happy that something like this even exists, and they actually do it right which is the best part. it's like $10 and you get a huge bowl of meat of your choice (their chicken is the BEST), noodles, rice, cabbage, and spicy sweet sauce all over. they even have a mayo sauce. it's just my favorite kind of food....it hits every happy spot.

if you haven't tried cup bop yet you are really missing out, it's korean food and you will not leave disappointed. a food has actually left me with little words...that's a good sign! I will be a loyal customer for life. 

here's what I suggest-
chicken bowl, sweet sauce, and medium spicy sauce (that's the mayo one). 
report back and let me know what you think!

Amazing! We have gone here here quiet a bit. The waffles are yum. My favorite is then chicken and waffles. The chicken is some of the best fried chicken around here, I was so surprised! My kids love the waffle with cookie butter and cream as well as the grilled cheese waffle and tomato soup. Truly a little gem here in meridian. The staff is always kind and more then accommodating.

This place serves the freshest food you can ever imagine. The food was also very flavorful and delicious. Some might compare the food to Indian, but although there are some similarities, Nepali food is different. Personally I prefer Nepali over Indian as some Indian cuisine can be overpowering. The owners also make it a point to ask for feedback and I like that they are constantly trying to improve and offer a great culinary/cultural experience. An added benefit is the price! Where can you find fresh, fast food for under $10.

These guys did a really bad job . I had to have them vacuum it twice because when I lifted up the rugs there was stuff under there that they had not vacuumed. Nor of the windows were clean. They were cleaned in the middle and still had dirty and grime around all for edges. And the dashboard had spray splashes all over where they had not wiped it down. It was a half@ss job. I would definitely think twice before I paid $40 for this detail again. It honestly looked almost exactly the same when they were done as before they started. Just do it yourself... If you took ten minutes to clean it, you'd do a better job than these people.

I've come here twice while passing through town. The body massages are good, very professional and unlike some other places, they speak enough English that there's no confusion in what you're asking for, what you're paying for and what directions they're trying to give during the massage.
My only reason for not giving all 5 stars, I've had well over 100 foot massages and this one fell short in comparison to other places. Generally (not always) your feet soak and you receive a facial/scalp massage while they soak - even if you get a combination massage where time is split between body and feet. This combination massage was done completely on the table, no soaking, no facial massage, and very little pressure applied to the feet during the massage. This may just be the way they do combo massages. The foot only may be done in a more typical manor, I've never had one done here.
Ramen Sho had very quick service and the food was warm and yummy! Large portions made the cost worth while and tako yaki was very good. Would recommend!
French  dip! Ribs! Friendly staff, kids like too. Reasonable pricing.

I had been wanting to try Cupbop for a long time and finally did a month or so ago. I like less meat so i got noodle bop and tried one of my friends potstickers from there. I have a higher spice tolerance than all my friends and got 7.5 and it was plenty spicy and flavorful.
Next time I will probably get mandoo bop without rice. I love rice but it was sad to get to the bottom of my cup and have rice without any sauce. Maybe if i could get some sauce on the side it would solve my problem

They really don't give a shit about selling crap!!! Had issues with some long socks. They did return 2 of them for an exchange awhile back. But after wearing them 4 times each the heel started to get holes again. 
I have probably 25-30 pairs of carhartt socks. Never had this issue. 
The female manager didn't give a shit!!! We looked up at what we spent the last year at the Meridian store. It came close to $22,000 between 42 employees. Online/other carhartt stores was close to $56,000 the previous 2 1/2 yrs. 
we comp our crews 50% on work items. Due to how the manager treated us we pulled our discount @ that store. If you're going to offer a warranty and don't honor that, well bad business!!!

Being a brick and mortar store I understand that if products don't get moved , you close down. I sent a memo to all our employees that we WILL NO LONGER BE DOING BUSINESS with that location and no longer offer a 50% discount there. Online is fine.

As far as car buying and selling goes Carmax makes it as smooth as possible. This is a new location (2016) and extremely clean and nice inside. There is free guest WiFi in the lobby and a small play area for kids. 

I sold a vehicle this time around and even with the vehicle inspection it only took an hour from when I arrived until when I signed over the title and got the bank draft. I was offered a fair price for the vehicle. I wasn't pressure by the associate (James) or the business office manager (Trudy) which makes it less stressful. In fact, they were very helpful and nice to me. 

There is no negotiating on the price which makes the process quicker overall. I know they will make a little money when they put it on their lot and sell it, but that is their job. And I'm confident the next buyer will be happy with the low mileage Toyota I sold them today.

I am a regular customer here however I probably wont be anymore!!! I just called the location on vista because I am at work and wanted to have some food delivered. They have a 3 mile limit for delivery, my work is 3.1 miles away. I even offered to pay more for delivery and the manager refused to do it. Talk about terrible customer service! I could see if i was several miles over but its .1 of a mile. They lost a loyal customer and all my friends will no longer support them either. Shame on the manager for such poor customer service!!!!
I called with a leak in my home today, during the current COVID-19 outbreak. In under an hour, Andy arrived to help. He was cautious, quick, and even disinfected everything he touched on his way out.
These guys are amazing. They were half the price of their competitors and twice as fast. They helped us when we were bind and I'll forever be grateful. Great customer service, too!

If there was a way to give zero stars, I would. Sat out on the balcony with my wine group. Definite lack of shade so if you sit there, bring a hat, umbrella, cabana boy with a large fan, go nude! All I could smell was the popcorn from the cinema below. Staff seemed apathetic, low energy. Almost had to do cartwheels to get my order taken. I could've easily walked out without paying. Extreme disappointment. I'll never return.

We were greeted right away. The customer service is ON POINT.  The burgers are priced perfectly! Also.... hands down one of the best burgers we've had in a while. We will be back in the future for some more. Get ready to get your hands dirty haha.
The beers seem to be a little overpriced for the size of them but that's just our opinion.  
Loved every minute though. Thanks a bunch!

Lovely spot for any meal of the day. I've come here now  for both weekend brunch and dinner - loved each experiences. Staff couldn't be more friendly and accommodating. The food is fresh, creative and delicious. Lots of outdoor seating too! Can't wait to come back!
Friendly and enjoyable environment.  I went for breakfast, and it didn't disappoint.  The food was tasty, and there was plenty of it!  Terri's is a good place to grab a bite!

I can't say enough great things about this place. I've been 3 times in the last month or so. For dinner, lunch, and brunch. Everything has been so good. The tots are a must! Staff and service has been great and their outdoor seating area is super nice.
Love this place. Never any wait, friendly staff, and great prices. April amazing.I will be back.
We LOVE The Griddle! We enjoy breakfast there every weekend. The staff is great and food is always yummy. We really enjoy the special offerings each week!
There is nothing better than a fresh hot waffle!  The ladies here make the very best waffles!  We tried the Boise Blue with Huckleberries and fresh whip; & Cinnalove!

This is not your normal walk in salon.   The stylists here are exceptional.  Though the prices are competitive, the work is far above the norm.  Tate was my stylist.  I have been a client for a couple years and even followed him from another salon.  His ability to understand what I want and add in his creativity has always left me with a great cut, color and style.  I have some physical challenges and he creates an up to date style that I can also do myself. Amazing!  Amazing!  Amazing!  Also.... he does the best eyebrow wax ever!

My wife and I have started up our date nights again after a long absence.  Part of the reason we stopped doing them is because our daughter was always around. We always love it when our daughter is with us, but is just not the same as a real date with the wife.

Well, the daughter now has a boyfriend. Those dreaded words that every dad hates but inevitably happens anyway. Luckily, the guy that our daughter chose is pretty nice. In fact, I told our daughter that he is a lot like me. 

One upside of the daughter going on dates with her bo is that it gives us the opportunity to go on a dates too. A date with the wife! God love that daughter of mine. 

We try to find a new place to eat at when we go out on these dates. Today, we chose a new place called Waffle Love. I have driven by and seen this place several times. I resisted trying it because I have not been a fan of the waffle craze. 

I had heard of Chicken and Waffles before but I just could not figure out what the hubub was all about. Well, Im happy to admit when I was wrong. 

I did not try the chicken and waffles here, but I might next time. The other thing that my wife and I do now is split dishes. It just sounds more romantic and we have found sure enough that it is. 

Its a bit like that old Disney movie, the lady and the tramp where the dogs are in that restaurant eating spaghetti and wind up eating on the same noodle and it draws them to almost kiss.

We had the Grilled cheese with Tomato Bisque from the savory side of the menu and The Dulce from the sweet side. Trying to make a decision which side of the menu to order from is a bit like that commercial, "sometimes you feel like a nut, sometimes you dont.."

I was skeptical and wary, but that all faded when it came. The Grilled Cheese is a Belgium Waffle. If you have not had one of these, do so as soon as you can. Belgium waffles are light and fluffy, crispy and chewy all at the same time. 

They are completely different from normal waffles and barely even a comparison. The waffle was stuffed with cheese just like a grilled cheese sandwich. It was delightful and very flavorful. It was one of the best grilled cheese that I have ever had.

I did not try the Tomato Bisque because I just don't like tomato soup, but my wife said it was good. On my 1 to 10 scale, I would give this a solid 8. I felt that the sandwich lacked something, but I could not put my finger on what it needed. 

The Dulche is a Belgium Waffle, Fried Ice Cream with Corn Flakes on the outside, cinnamon and a carmel sauce with strawberries. This is very good. The waffle keeps its crispness. The fried ice cream is very creamy and the cork flakes added a nice texture difference to it. I think it would have been ever better if the corn flakes were mixed into the ice cream itself. A choice of different flavors of ice cream would be a nice addition.

The carmel was for me, a little lacking in flavor and I would have liked way more of it. I would have also liked more cinnamon, but then again, im a cinaholic. (Ps, this does mean, I like to sin. :)) 

The strawberries were very light and fresh and made the dish brighter. Overall I would give this dish a 7. It was really good, but needed more carmel, cinnamon and strawberries to balance it out and match the picture they show on the menu at the counter.

I applaud them having waffles to fit both a meal and a dessert. That was very smart on someones part. My only concern would be that coming here a lot, one might get waffle overload, but for me, it was a fun thing to try and I will come back again to try more of the menu.

I'm an out of towner from SoCal visiting friends. They picked us use some lunch. 

The Pulled Pork sandwich was amazing. Very, very yummy. 

I also had the sweet potato and apple slaw. I wasn't a big fan. I think if the apples were skinned and it had a little more salt and pepper, it would have been decent. 

Overall it was decent!

Food is good, they've put upscale spins on traditional bar food & overall prices are EXPENSIVE. Just paid $32 for 2 simple bloody Mary's (2 olives, nothing else) and a small appetizer. Last time we were here it was in the evening and we felt the same - very expensive for the area. You could go downtown and get the same quality food and cocktails for less.
Food portion is terrible. Especially for a first time experience. I will not be back.

I'm a frequent shopper here. While the prices are a little high, the range of goods are unmatched (especially for those following vegan or vegetarian diets). This is true of food prepared in-store as well. Occasionally I will get a burrito and a vegan peanut butter fudge bar for lunch - excellent food.

Ordered a 20 oz Americano and asked if they could put in a "tiny, itty bitty amount of heavy cream". The gal taking my order assured they would. Well, I just got home and opened up my cup and my coffee is practically white. It's going down the drain.
Excellent food and great atmosphere. The patio was inviting and had enough seating for our whole family.  We had a great time dining here.

By far the best window washing company in all of Idaho, my wife recently had our windows clean. Let me tell you, AMAZING my wife was confronted by Gilbert and Jesse. Two fine young men who have a lot coming for them in the future did an amazing job. I walked right into the slider door ! Job well done window wizard

We checked out this restaurant with two kids in tow, not realizing that apparently that would be a problem for our waiter. He promptly stared us down as if we were homeless people. He directed us to our table and we asked for a high chair and he acted put out. He was the most unfriendly waiter I have ever encountered. He acted very snobby and wouldn't give us the time of the day, meanwhile chatting up every table around us. The food was sub par, not worth the expense or terrible service. We may have enjoyed the food more if we didn't feel like we were in such a hostile environment! I will NEVER EVER go back or recommend this to anyone!

Honestly I have so many great things to say about this location and the current employees. I've been going to Einstein's since we moved to Eagle but this location is now right by my house. What I love most is they are so kid/family friendly. They genuinely take the time to look in the car see if me or my kids need anything from water to coffee to newspapers or tablets. They walk you through everything they do and you are in an out in 15 min max. And you just can sit and relax for a minute.
Thank you for your incredible customer service.

So being from Portland I consider myself a coffee lover and feel I have a taste for not only good tasting coffee but also appreciation for good coffee people. This place has both!

Stopped here after church last Sunday. Husband ordered an iced coffee, boooooring, haha but said it was good. I was feeling more adventurous and ordered a Java Chip Granita.... ohhhhhhh emmmmmm geeeeeee! Best part was the price, I felt like we were stealing our coffee!

Service is outstanding.

Ohh and you get a chocolate covered espresso bean. Sold.

I initially went here 4 a Yelp Elite event, and I'm glad I did. I can't wait to bring my husband here 4 a sweet breaky this weekend maybe 4 a belated Father's Day meal since we were camping in the great outdoors. The waffles are light, fluffy and full of sweet treats, like fresh fruit, chocolate, caramel drizzle, whipped cream, etc. It really depends on your preference, but if you LOVE Nutella and bananas, there is a specific waffle just 4 you. For me, I added strawberries because I couldn't decide on strawberries or bananas, and of course, they were able to accommodate. Give them a try. You won't regret it!
Boss hog! Best burger I have ever had. Tons of fries. Coming back to Boise just to eat here!
The food is great and the yogurt choice and toppings are plentiful. The burgers are always juicy and the sweet potato fries are great! Love this place!

I used to love going to the old downtown Boise location. The store had a great vib. Tried the Meridian location today, and was not impressed. Ridiculously high prices (yeah, I know its not Winco), poor selection in comparison to the original, or Whole Foods.
I'll stick with WF, or the original. Too bad, was close to my home.

My boyfriend and I found this cute little joint and the service was very friendly and made us feel very welcome and comfortable. The food was absolutely amazing! It also doesn't take very long to get your cones. They definitely turned us into to weekly regulars.
Great place. Music is a little loud but awesome. Food was great and done perfect. Small beer selection but what they have was great. Can't wait until lunch

Good slices of pizza. If you like thin slices that you can fold, this is your place. I like how they have some seating outside and a drive-thru. I will definitely be back when I am on that side of town.

New in town from the Copper state. 1st night here and tried the dairy ice cream pretty darn good. A pint is only $4.77.. First time ever trying black licorice ice cream.... Trey was great as cashier and all around happy face. They are still giving samples so go try a few flavors and say howdy to TREY.

had a full detail on my truck today, worst ever. It would have looked better if I'd taken it to J's Hand Wash in Garden City. The ONE thing, ONE I asked to be taken care of was a blemish that I'm quite sure could have been buffed out and it was still there in all it's glory-magnified only because it was clean AROUND it. For a full detail I'd expect the windows to be clean, it doesn't appear that they even cleaned the back window, it rolls down completely and it's water spotted at the bottom, the driver's side mirror is completely smeared obviously wiped down with a dirty rag and spotted, smudgy finger prints on 2 of 4 doors, wax or something on the driver's side flooring/carpet. This was especially noticeable since the floor mats were not replaced but rather thrown in and left in the bed of my truck. The inside was decent, I suppose you have to aspire to something, decent is all they can handle. It was at least wiped down, seats looked clean. That's about the only good thing I can say. Spend $15 and go to J's. Never again!

I finally bit the bullet and got my eyebrows microbladed by Clayton - I've been getting my lashes done by him for a while now and seriously, if you're looking for someone who is AMAZING at lashes & microblading, Clayton is your guy.  

Clayton exceeded ALL of my expectations and my brows look better than I could have ever dreamed!  He is SO talented, not to mention that he is HILARIOUS and SWEET as hell.  

He won't charge you half of your tiny paycheck (great pricing), is easy to get in touch with and scheduling is super convenient.  My lashes have survived the crazy winds of Iceland, the sweltering saunas & smells of hot yoga and the gooey hands of triplet toddlers. They feel weightless and look incredible EVERY time. I would definitely recommend Meraki Spa/Clayton to everyone and anyone!!!

Looking for a nice lunch spot and found 830 Common. Sat outside. Covid - safe. Ordered burgers and corn dog bites. All very good and the wait staff was super attentive and nice. Ask for tastings of beers if you are undecided. GREAT place! Want to go for brunch next time we are in town!
Fantastic food and great prices, fast service and they are consistent. I wish they offered more food because it's delicious!

The menu over promises and under delivers. I ordered the You're My Boy Bleu burger and it was disappointing...the only saving grace for the meal was the "house" punched fries. The bun was straight out of the package - not toasted or seasoned in any way. The patty was over cooked (ordered medium and received it well done), dry, and without flavor. The onion straws were old and stale - no crunch or flavor. For a $14.00 burger I expect more and a patty from Carl's Jr. sadly has more flavor.

On a positive note, my wife ordered the tacos and said they were good. My recommendation is to stay away from the burgers.

P.S. Owners, you might want to incorporate some of the Flatbread menu (at least the French Onion soup)

Been here about 4 or 5 times. And its been a blast every time. The staff is friendly and welcoming. The truffle fries are a must if you like fries, my fab fries in boise for sure. Definitely need like 4 people to eat 1 order. I've had the steakhouse burger before and the fried chicken sandwich both great.

We went and got an oil change from this place on Saturday. My husband drives this car to work and he had been home since Saturday and we have not driven it since Saturday. This morning my husband went to drive to work and the car started smoking and draining oil!! We called a tow company to come get the car and take it to the dealership. They came and once they looked at the car they found they had not put the right filter in( all though they had to go to an auto store to get my filter since they did not have mine in stock and charged me for it!!)  I went back today after I got my car back after the dealership had to put new filters in and 8 quarts of oil...  They asked if I wanted a free oil change... Ya right!!! I asked for my money back and they gave me.. But I would stay clear of this place if I were you!

All our family likes this place, including the kids that usually picky.
Tasty and friendly.
Just happen to check this place out for lunch when I had a coupon. I love the Turkey sandwich with red peppers. Excellent and not easy to find around here. I'll be back!

Most authentic fish and chips I have had since visiting England years ago. Batter was light and crisp with a moist flaky thick filet. If there was mayonnaise on the fries I would have believed I was transported back in time to Cambridge. Definitely recommend this meal.

Tate is AWESOME!!!  I had been very apprehensive about getting my hair cut into an a-line because so many people had messed it up previously.  When I walked in and explained what I wanted and what my fears were, he confidently assured me that he could give me what I wanted. He ended up spending 2 hours making sure that everything was just right and for the first time in a very long time, I LOVE MY HAIRCUT!!!  I will be rocking my new do with confidence, thanks to Tate, and he has just made a VERY enthusiastic return client!!!!

Formally known as Steve's, this place is a little gem! Sandwiched in the middle of a strip mall on Fairview, is Terri's. I looked to yelp to give me advice on what to order. I'm a huge fan of corned beef hash, and Terri's did not let me down! With chunks of corned beef with pieces of browned potatoes, I was in corned beef heaven! This place also has huckleberry everything! Hot cocoa, cupcakes, lemonade, tea, pancakes, waffles and stuffed French toast! The bf got their huckleberry waffle with homemade syrup. The syrup was just the perfect amount of sweet. The waffle had hidden perfect huckleberry morsels in every bite! If you are considering this place, do it! You will not regret your decision! Happy eating!

Gabriel has done a few projects for us. He gives an accurate time and price estimate, works hard, is friendly, courteous and professional. Does a great job and cleans everything up. He really cares about the quality of his work. I will use him again and recommend him to anyone.

After a bad year health wise the IRS and the bill collectors all came at once. I call and schedule an appointment with Avery Law Ryan Farnsworth. For no charge at all I was given the best advice in years. 
Note they could have directed me into costly and long drawn out process but they put their reputation and my needs above their profit. Thank You Avery Law.

This place used to be great when we moved out to our new subdivision in 2016.  Great service, great food and great atmosphere.  In the past two years it's gone complete down hill.  Stopped in yesterday after a bad experience 6 months prior with food.  Last nights visit involved short pouring of drinks, a hair in our food and 45 minutes of watching the bartenders drink do more shots behind the bar then I think they served.  I hope the owners are making enough money on that place to cover the theft of their own staff.  

Won't go back.  There are way to many new establishments coming in to waste my cash on poor service, poor hygiene in the kitchen and a drunk at 4:00 pm staff.

This was honestly the best grilled cheese sandwich I've ever had in my life. The Young man that was helping us was awesome! The ice cream is yummy as well! If you are in the mood for a grilled cheese sandwich and or ice cream, this is the place!!! Definitely will be returning!

The place is cute inside and not over dressed. But the owners / staff need more training. They were not staffed properly for the flow of people coming in and out

Now, for the food   All I can say is bland. We started with the chive and dill deviled eggs. Those were the best thing we had!  After that it got disappointing. 

We had the fried chicken with cole slaw and  watermelon slices. The chicken was juicy but the crispy coating was bland and lacked seasoning. It tasted of flour. The waitress had to ask the kitchen what was sprinkled on the watermelon as she didn't know. Careful here as it did have cayenne and may be a bit too spicy for some. We all agreed the cole slaw was also bland. 

The smoked turkey with a cranberry sauce on biscuits was dry. We had to ask for more sauce  

The salmon was obviously not fresh as it had the telltale white "mush" on it. The best thing was the fries that came with it. 

I highly doubt we will return as I would rather get some of the same things from Shanaz and enjoy complimentary corn bread as well. That was one thing that was missing with our supper here: table bread!

Excellent food and extremely friendly staff, but a bit pricey. My husband and I ordered a burger each and two sides, drank 2 beers (so, 4 total) and with tax and tip we paid nearly $90. I have no problem visiting again and likely will, we were just shocked at the total.

This was DISGUSTING! My father and I couldn't even finish one plate of food. It was dry, cold, and tasted nasty. We were here 4 months ago and it was okay. Not today. I will never go back. For the first time in my life I asked if I had to pay. They were going to make me until I told the people coming in the door (the only other guests) to look before deciding to stay. I was then told to leave and the other people left also. 

Save yourself time and find a different place to eat.

I was super excited when I found CupBop parked at one of the food truck events in Meridian. I thought, "Korean BBQ food truck, no freaking way! This is going to be so damn good." Sadly, I was lead astray...

CupBop is not original Korean BBQ food. I'm not sure if you can even call it Korean. More accurate would be Korean-American because the food is American AF. I've been to South Korea a few times, so I know what authentic bap tastes like. Granted that this place is in the US, run by Americans, I understand I'm not going to get something that tastes fresh out of a Korean hawker center. But come on guys. My bop didn't even right for American food. The strips of beef were tasteless. The noodles were slimy but not the good kind of slimy. It was like there was coagulated water on each strand. Should have just hot rice. They also ask how hot you want your sauce. I don't remember what the scale was but I do recall asking for the hottest option. It was not spicy, no where near. It tasted sweet. It didn't taste bad, it was actually rather good sauce however it was not what I had asked for. The whole bowl was a waste of $8.

I probably won't try this place again when I see it parked out and about. The only reason for the extra star is because I really do enjoy the concept! I think CupBop could thrive if it improved their product's look and taste. Great idea, poor execution. Maybe time will tell...

I made sure I took my Coleman trailer in before it froze this year as not to be charged $400 to thaw out the lines and winterize. The tech came back and said the bypass valve to the water heater was leaking and said they need to fix it if they had the part. They brought out the new plastic valve and told me I would have to pay for the part and an hour of time. When asked how much for the hour it was going to cost, the price was $129.  Funny thing is, this "leaking" valve is secured with a clamp to a floor joist and covered with foam insulation. Basically no way it should leak after two years or rattle loose. I told them I didn't touch it, their tech was the only one who did. Some how I'm still liable. I made them plug the hoses to bypass and paid the regular $130 for winterizing I should've just done myself. If you want BS service and BS reasons to breaking parts, this is the place. Save your money.

I love the ranch. No, I'm not talking about buttermilk or Blue Cheese's stepbrother but rather the Idaho Youth Ranch.  Why? Here's why. (1) Goodwill maybe good for popping tags but they rake in the $$$$$, (2) Savers is good but the donating part is not always easy at my location.  (3) The Salvation Army is most 2nd choice due to the fact that they help the most and there no $$$ that go to top or the execs.  The IYR helps Idaho kids plain and simple. They have an awesome drive thru donation system that I have been using for the past 12 years.  Receipts are actually receipts that you can use for your taxes besides the "coupons" that the Goodwill gives you.  Very happy to be supporting a legitimate charity locally.

Very friendly new owners. Over the top, great food. During these tough times, they are delivering free waffles to home bound seniors on Sundays. I'd come here anyway, but that makes me want to give them even more business. We had the chicken and waffles and grilled cheese and tomato soup tonight. Everyone in the house says Waffle Love gets a repeat this week--we're doing take out a few times a week, hoping to help small, local businesses. We'll be working our way through the menu! Eat local, eat here. Reasonable prices for high quality, delicious food. And nice people.

Both my husband and I bought their product.  My husband is doing well with his.  I developed heel spurs after I started using them.
If you have arthritis, especially in your feet this may not be the best $1200 you can spend on your feet.  I have more pain now than I ever had before.

I was looking forward to trying this place, as I live very close to here. I was very disappointed in the food. When asked about rice, I prefer brown rice, but they unfortunately don't serve brown rice. I got the one with the beef and the beef was so dry and bland. I would not recommend. As far as the sauces, I hate Mayonnaise-based sauce. I wanted it hot, but I did not realize that was their hot sauce. I had a hard time getting passed that sauce and the taste. I wish their were better options for the sauces on top. Overall, it was not good and a little too funky for me to like it. For the money, you get a great serving and the staff was very friendly.

My husband went there the other day and can't stop talking about their service. So, I figured I should probably write a review for them. He says that the employees are professional and knowledgeable. He stayed in the car while they worked on the car. They constantly offered him water and made sure he was comfortable the whole time.  We will for sure be back for our other cars. Thank you again for great service!!

Unfortunately, I made a huge mistake trusting what I read on their website about being a nonsmoking/nonvaping community.  I also confirmed this with their leasing agent, Ally.   As it turns out, nothing could be further from the truth.  There is smoking allowed on patios and throughout the community (parking lots, sidewalks, etc)   Since I have heart issues and allergies, this is a serious issue for me.  Also, my father and brother died from lung cancer at young ages.  I lived in a truly nonsmoking apartment community here in Meridian before, so I had no reason not to believe what I read and what I was told.  Management simply stated that Idaho is a little behind in what they called the "nonsmoking movement'' and mentioned people being allowed to smoke in bars in Boise.  Personally, I don't consider my home equivalent to a bar.  Until I moved here, I didn't realize there were so many smokers in the Treasure Valley. My dog and I frequently go to all the Meridian Parks and even they are truly nonsmoking, as is all of Boise State University.   Now I'm stuck in a one-year lease and have to try to avoid many, many smokers and the second-hand smoke.  Moving would be quite a hardship and costly, but I would love to be let out of the lease without a $2000 break-lease fee.    

There were many, many other issues that came up from day one, but they pale in comparison.  Risking my health and not being able to enjoy my own balcony, front porch, or walking in the community is very stressful.  This entire situation could have been avoided completely had management been honest.  I would not have even filled out an application and paid the fee for that and the administrative fee of $150.

Not bad at all. I came here with my brother and girlfriend. Compared to where we are from, California, this place was pretty on point. I will forsure be coming back here when I'm visiting family back in Idaho.
Had dinner delivered! Driver was great and on time. Food was delicious we will definitely order from The Great Wall Restaurant again.

We were lucky enough to have La Crepe visit our subdivision tonight.  They were quite the hit.  We tried the "classic" and the "happy."  Both were desert style and both were delicious.  Can't wait to try more!

Locked my myself out of my room right before having to meet friends for my birthday dinner ‍
A friend tried to pick the lock but we were unsuccessful.  Finally buckled and decided to call a locksmith.  First one I called sounded sketchy and said they charge a $29 service fee off the bar but had to call me back to even tell me how much just to open the room door.  Decided to call another, Obryant was next one I found.  He was upfront and honest right away.  Quoted me a reasonable fee right on the phone.  Was there super quick and got the job done super fast. I think it took him longer to find parking in my complex lol .  I made it to dinner on time thanks to him.  Then the "other" company called me back.  When I said we already had it resolved they had the nerve to try and say I owe them for the service fee just for calling back...hah what a joke
If I stupidly lock myself out (hopefully not again) I know who to call

Kim (receptionist) and Jason (technician) were absolutely outstanding! Coming into a garage filled with water wasn't what I had planned for the start of the week, but they made the entire process smooth and seamless. Their professionalism and pricing is unmatched and we will definitely be keeping them for our plumbing needs! Thank you for making a stressful situation, enjoyable.

What a cool concept! One cone is equal to 2 slices so it's a  perfect size! Toppings are great quality and the crust holds up so well, no spilling or dripping out which is a huge plus. Prices are great for what you get too. All around great experience!

Purchased a few items from this store. 
Dealt mostly with Brennen in person and Shawna over the phone (hope I spelled their names correctly!!). 
Excellent customer service from both. 
Great store and I'll be shopping here for a very long time. 
Many thanks
Such a great place with great food and service. Can't get good ramen anywhere else in Idaho to be honest. Reminds me of home in Washington.

I called at 8:15 at night on a Saturday night and asked to place an order to go. I was answered with "Will you be here before 8:30". Closing time, I get it. I ordered teriyaki chicken, chicken yakisoba and gyoza. The chicken in their teriyaki was burned and had a overwhelming taste of salt. The yakisoba was also salty and had a taste of liquid smoke. The Gyoza had a filling of what looked to be hamburger was also salty and very greasy. The sauce it came with did not enhance anything in the meal. I was very disappointed in the meal and the experience.
We tried to get the coach ready for summer after it had been winterized by Camping World and discovered that the washer was damaged, water flows into the washer while washer is turned off.
Food is good and the people are great. Keep an eye out for their cooking classes, they're a lot of fun.

So...  Some of the technicians looked like characters from the movie Anchorman as they all had the big 70's style mustaches...  lol

That being said, their service was AWESOME!  These guys took their job seriously, went through their checklists verbally, and communicated with me the whole time.  The used both whitten and digital checklists to get through the different tasks, and did it with enthusiasm.  Which is such a rare thing these days.

I have sent my wife here and taken all 3 of our vehicles here.  We will continue to drive past another few locations that provide the same service to come see these guys.  Thanks!

Went here for the first time, after reading great reviews. It did not disappoint! We got the pepperoni cone and it was delicious! Packed full of cheese, sauce, and pepperoni, layered throughout! Sauce is very tasty. The pizza cone is delicious as well! Will definitely be back to try others!

So very, very disappointed. We ordered what sounded like a lovely breakfast. Unfortunately it was on the serving bar at 10:15 but our waitress Anna did not bother to serve us until 10:27. While our food sat there getting cold she took new orders, served others coffee and took care of other customers bills. Meantime our food sat and sat. She reheated my French toast allegedly on the griddle but that just dried it out. Lukewarm stale texture bread instead of a lovely breakfast.

Browsing the Boys & Girls Club online auction and noticed this place donated several gift certificates. I never heard of it but wanted to give it a try AND support a local business that supports the community. It was delicious. Had the huckleberry pancakes and their homemade sausage. The sausage was so flavorful. Servers were super nice. We'll definitely be back because there are so many items on their menu that sound good.

Service was great. Someone was at our table before we could even think to ask for anything. Everyone seemed to be working together. The view is cool, the place was a lot smaller than I thought it would be. The patio looks like the spot to sit, but alas it was raining so we were inside. I took my mom and my girls on $5 movie/burger night- the food was a mix of restaurant and concession stand stuff. We caught a movie afterwards...definitly a plus being a short walk from work and home.

Make sure you don't tell him anything in confidence.  He harmed 5 people by repeating what was told to him in confidence.  Eyelashes were good....just don't share anything with him.  I believe he got even with me for requesting (for the third time at the third visit) to NOT pull anymore of my eyelashes out.  :(

I really love when the truck comes on the BSU campus. The food is great but recently the proportions and service hasn't been the best with the new people I've seen on the truck. I usually have them Substitute the rice with noodles and recently it seems as though I've gotten half the amount I usually get with Rhonda or the other girls that would previously work the truck. It's just a little disappointing considering I pay $10-13 a bowl and come every Wednesday. Probably won't be coming again.

Our last visit was better than this time. 

The good...let's begin by breaking down the term pancake...pan-cake...yep, that describes 'em, like a small cake made in a pan, the thickest I've ever seen!

The not so good...neither my wife or son loved their meals, he said his pancakes seemed underdone, sort of doughy in the middle like they needed another thirty seconds on the grill, my wife agreed. My wife also expected link sausage and got what would have been a really respectable patty if it had been a burger, impressively large, but the sausage lacked any spice, no apparent salt, pepper or chili flakes, so was ultimately a little boring and only half eaten even between the two of us. 

The almost good...I had the eggs benedict. There was nothing blatantly wrong, they just needed more hollandaise sauce, it was like they were running out and didn't want to make more, it left them, under-satisfying. This said, the eggs were exactly spot on what you expect with poached eggs, noticeably so, so props for them. 

Back to good, dare I say awesome...the OJ is killer, made from scratch but if you're a wimpy "pulp is icky", never ate a real orange before type, steer clear because like I said, it'd made on the spot from oranges and de-li-cious. 

I don't think my wife or son will be willing to try here again, so maybe next time I'll go alone and let the IHOP fans get their pancakes elsewhere. Uh, can I get a sode of hollendase here?
This is the worst Chinese place I ever been to, food was old,flavor was gone, worst buffet choice, don't waste you're money food was terrible!

Clayton is a genius. Immediately he put me at ease with his warm personality. He took his time and gave me a thorough and relaxing facial. The massage technique he uses is absolutely paralyzing and melted away all of the stress and tension I've carried around for the last year. I was pleased to see he practices covid safety protocols and donned a mask before my service. In addition to being a very warm person, he is an excellent aesthetician who very much understands skin care. I appreciate that he worked me into his schedule on a Saturday. Without hesitation, I look forward to having another appointment.

Took my kiddos & their father to eat here. I wanted all of us to experience it for the first time because their milkshakes seemed so delicious.

Tables are first come, first serve, but they also have a line outside waiting to be seated so contradicts the signs. Some dude & his family decided to cut in front of us & seat themselves which I let one of the waitress know & she was quick to find us a table, which I greatly appreciated.

Quality in food was amazing, no complaints. I think the pricing was pretty accurate. Their milkshakes did indeed meet my expectations & definitely my kiddos expectations as well.

The waitress was super friendly & was quick to explain their process as it was our first time.

What upset me about this place was how long it took for my youngest to receive his chicken tenders, as well as his father to receive his burger. The dude at the cash register (not sure if he's the owner) came about 15mins after my oldest & I had received our burger & explained the "egg" had burst on my kiddos fathers Hangover burger & they had to redo. Totally fine with that. About another 15mins went by & nothing. My youngest finally received his tenders five mins or so after that. I stepped outside to take a phone call, came back in 5mins later & my kiddos father tells me the waitress told him I placed his order separately which is why it was taking so long (I did no such thing)...That made things super awkward...They finally brought his burger out & apologized for the wait, said it was on them & idk what else. Anyway, I asked the cashier for two cups for water & he was apologizing for the long wait for the burger & at this point I was kinda over the whole experience. Paid my bill a bit after & left. Not sure where the discount was when paying cash when I was charged the same as when the waitress was charging me with my card (my card wouldn't work because it's too worn out) so had to pay cash.

I don't like to judge a restaurant by one experience, unless its a horrible experience. This was one of the top 5 worst experiences I've had at a restaurant. I do believe they're still figuring out how to make it all work, so maybe I'll visit months from now.

This was my first visit to this salon. My regular nail tech is out of the country for three weeks. And my nails really needed to be done -- after I broke two nails over the last three days. Since I couldn't wait, I called the closest salon to my house... and I ended up here. Michelle worked on my nails -- she was polite, quick, and efficient. The salon was clean. The atmosphere was pleasant... and it didn't have an overwhelming acetone smell -- which was great! When my nails were done, they looked great. The price was good as well; I paid $30 for a fill, cutdown, and 2 replaced nails. Wow!! I'd highly recommend this salon!

Called and placed and order over the phone for pick up. Gave us a time. Arrived at restaurant prior to time given and waited in line. I was in line so long that by the time I got to the window and gave my name, they told me they tossed my pizzas in the trash because I was late. This was 100% not my issue. They told me I'd have to wait another 15 minutes for my pizza to be remade and then proceeded to charge me full price. They lost our business from now on. Too many good options in town to be rude with customers. Taste like west coast pizza tonight.

Looking for a good old fashion breakfast, for something a little different, like orange stuffed french toast, this is the place to go.
Portions are generous so you won't leave hungry.
The pancakes are about 10 inches across, so a s short stack with some bacon and eggs may more than fill you up.
Great service and a friendly staff will get your day off to a great start!

What a horrible place. It started bad and has stayed that way since. I showed up looking for a trailer and the "salesman" decided that it was far more important to play on his phone. Then he had no idea how much the trailer I liked cost and was truly offended that I wanted him to find out the price. I left there and let the corporate office know about the issues and now they are passing my contact information around the office like it's a joint. Just know that there is a far better place right next door and they do not treat customers like crap.

This spot is great! Love the ambiance and the food is fantastic with perfect proportions. The service was top notch! I came in with 3 teenagers and they even commented how their drink was never empty. That's a big deal for teens!! Definite must try, you wont be disappointed.

Is there a good Chinese restaurant in Meridian or West Boise? This was yet another crappy buffet with less than mediocre food. Eggroll had an off taste, noodles were greasy, there we no other entrees that looked tempting. Hot and sour soup was good but only warm. The ribs were great, the best thing I tried. I love pot stickers and these were terrible. Place didn't look clean but the wait staff was very friendly.

Oh my the deli here is awesome! Great salads! Pasta dishes are excellent too. The groceries are typical for highly over priced but that's the norm for the Co-op. I'd recommend this place for a healthy fast lunch...but don't forget to grab a cookie from the bakery. The salted chocolate chip cookies are amazing.
Just okay. Glad we tried it, but probably wouldn't run & recommend to all my friends.

Nice place for something different...better for lunch than dinner. The chicken curry is flavorful without any heat at all, and the marinated veggies are light, but not as flavorful as expected. During my visit the service was poor. There was a dazed and confused young man who didn't offer explaining the food after I mentioned it was my first visit there so I was a bit clueless. We ordered every kind of momo but they only had the turkey and yak ones ready at the time so we said we'd wait for the others to be brought out....and we waited...and waited...Mr. Dazed and Confused had to keep asking us which ones we were waiting for and if we'd received them yet. Meanwhile he brought a Samosa out to another table (who had already received their samosa) and in his confusion a light bulb came on and he gave it to us while we continued to wait for our momos. More time passed and we still did not get all of our momos. We had someplace to be, so we got up and left. Mr. Dazed and Confused did holler out to us when we were at the door asking if we wanted our momos. I replied no, we had the Samosa and had to go. I hope the owners hire more competent help in the future.

Update: The manager reached out to us directly and was incredibly kind and accommodating. She completely explained our concerns and made the experience up to us. Customer service is incredible and we will definitely be giving them another chance!

Worst service I have EVER experienced. Came in with a party of 5, separate checks, and the food came out with a 20 minute gap between according to the checks. First one took about 30 minutes, and they had finished their food by the time the next order arrived. After that was about 10 minutes for us to finally get our food, and when it finally got the table both dishes were lukewarm. Server didn't check in once to get us more water or ask how the food was (once it finally arrived) and spent the whole time chatting at the bar (less than 10 feet away from our table). Absolutely no communication about why our food came out so late except for a "oh, they're getting it started now" once the first people were nearly done. Food was decent, would have been good hot, but service was such a bad experience that it overshadowed the food quality.

Mr. O'bryant communicated quickly and efficiently. I mistakenly locked my keys In my house, he made this stressful process easier than I thought. He quoted me 20 minutes and was indeed punctual, he arrived with his partner in crime, she was so beautiful and friendly- Frankie (a Doberman), he's pretty hot himself. 
He had everything he needed and opened my door fast, with enough time to make it to my appointment. I would highly recommend him . Thanks for all your help.

This place had recently just opened and I couldn't wait to get in there and try it. Customer service was excellent and staff was super friendly. They were able to take a large group as well as many small groups. We had 10 in our group and we called ahead for a reservation in which they were able to accommodate.

Our group got two of appetizers: The Idaho fries and the dips and chips. The Idaho fries were an excellent choice for the kiddos. I really like that you can choose how big of a portion or how small of a portion you want. We also got the dips and chips which were a really great option for the adults. The pimento cheese and guacamole were flavorful and tasty.

For dinner I got the steak salad which doesn't sound interesting but I had heard it was really good and it did not disappoint.  Their chef gets your steak done to exactly how you want it so my medium steak was absolutely perfect over my salad. And the salad itself was also pretty interesting with butter lettuce and a champagne vinaigrette salad dressing with cheese crumbles.  When you say steak salad and it doesn't sound good you have yet to try it here because it was amazing and I actually finished the whole thing. Which was a huge portion! 

My husband got the fish and chips, my grandparents got The trace amigos tacos in the adult grown-up grilled cheese and tomato soup. Both look very good!!!   Of all 10 of us at the table everybody said they would come back again. It really was so good!!!  

I really hope they keep the chef! Haha

Rice bowl is great, but the ramen needs help. Noodles were not completely cooked and you have to hook up the broth to eat. Service will need to be stepped up as well before they formally open. Great potential though.

Friendly baristas, clean interior, cozy and has lots of tables, chairs. They serve breakfast, lunch, and snacks. The wall and entire interior colors are calming. Perfect for winding down after stressful day from work.

Positive: Professionalism, Quality, Responsiveness, Value
I called about my iPhone speaker/earpiece. They stated it would be $20 to clean and $60-$80 to replace. When I got there they looked, said just dirty, cleaned and wouldn't let me pay! They also assisted me on making great choices on older model iPhones. So so grateful for HONEST good iPhone repair people

I witnessed first hand the positive influence that Arlene can have on another person. I was amazed at the emotional and mental transformation that took place in a short period of time.  I am extremely grateful for all that she has done.

Arlene was extremely professional and after two sessions we mutually agreed that our goals had been achieved.

Top soil - I ordered up 2 yds of what was called Top Soil at Victory Greens.  When it arrived it appeared to be fairly dusty with some ground up hay visible in it.  Once I loaded it into newly built raised beds, then mixed with 30% compost the finished product once watered unfortunately turned to hardened crusty mud, bummer.  Definitely disappointed in the makeup of the product, my first with VG unfortunately.  So, if you are a gardener and looking for some nice soil for the coming summer planting - suggest you look elsewhere.

The Franklin has been a good experience for me and my dog. Since I moved from Virginia last April, I've watched the grounds, staff, and surrounding area develop around me. 

The apartment: the living space is a good fit for me, my dog, and my roommate. Generally adequate storage, quality materials, and proper appliances have all made me feel at home. The design and layout is sensible for the space available. On the second floor, I have never had issues with noise from our neighbors. The sound dampening in these adjoining walls is impressive. 

Parking: For my outlying unit, the parking situation can be a bit frustrating at times, as the availability of guest spots can be inconvenient/far away. There aren't really many paths that take you directly from overflow parking to the units. This means that, often, my guests have had to walk through the wet grass, snow, lawn clippings, etc. in order to get to and from my unit. With that said, there is space in the community to create additional paved and maintained paths in the future if they see it fit. 

Management: Every time I've been in the clubhouse, the staff is friendly and at least shoots me a kind greeting if I'm just stopping by to drop off mail. When the management staff is available, they are happy to help me with whatever I need. The team appears to put plenty of  effort towards maintenance, repairs, and grounds issues (i.e. "poop and run" issues with pet owners.) While not incredibly personable, the maintenance/groundskeeping staff is attentive and gets the job done. Community-wide maintenance and other major events are always presented via notes left on doors from the management team, giving tenants several days to a few weeks to prepare. 

Overall, it has been easy and comfortable to live here this year, especially since it is my first lease residence. It is important to note that I was the first tenant to live in my unit, which shows just how new this community is. In my opinion, it seems the management team has learned a lot just in the year I've been here, and they appear to be eager to improve the experiences of current and future tenants. I look forward to seeing more growth from management and the surrounding areas in the months to come!

I will never do business again with Century Link. About a year ago I called to cancel my internet services and they offered me a discounted rate to keep me as a customer. A year goes by and I notice that my rate had jumped back to the normal price. I called the billings department and told them that I wanted my agreed upon pricing back on my account and they refused. They stated that I should have noticed the disclaimer on my bill that stated it was only going to last for 12 months. They kept telling me that it was my responsibility to understand the disclaimers and that they wouldn't take responsibility for what their rep sold me. Coned is the best New idea in pizza and Coned does it best. Get Coned today!!! Wish they had T-shirts that say Get Coned Today!!!

We should've read the reviews before we ordered. We placed a delivery order at 6:09PM. It was supposed to be delivered by 7:28PM. The order didn't arrive until 8PM!We called the restaurant a few times, when we were finally able to get through, they assured us the order was on it's way.  Not only did it take 2 hours to get it delivered, the chow mein wasn't what we expected. We thought chow mein was a noodle dish with veggies. Make sure to read the menu. If you want noodles on your chow mein, you need to order the "Special" Chow Mein. What we received were a bunch of sauteed onions, celery, cabbage, bean sprouts in a goopy gravy sauce with (get this) fried chow mein noodles (they kinda looked like a soup topping, like croutons in tomato soup).

Super friendly staff, you order at the counter and then look for a seat .  burgers sound a bit weird on the menu (which is a kinda limited) but are amazing!  Super juicy & great flavors I would highly recommend it. Only drawback is limited seating.

One of our favorite go to breakfast places. We have checked out a few "The Griddle" locations and this location did not disappoint. 

If you're going on a weekend, I would recommend going before 8:30am. It tends to get pretty busy on the weekends (especially between the hours of 9-10:30am). Don't worry though, hot coffee is available for everyone while you wait. They also have propane heaters out during winter to help keep you warm. 

One item that is new for my husband and I is their house made granola. I've had it with the yogurt or topping a crepe. Either way, it is delicious!!! Another item I enjoy ordering is their chilequiles. It has just the right amount of spice and is very filling. 

Mimosas are available if that is part of your brunch fun. The hot cocoa is also very yummy!

I wish I had taken a picture of the slices of pizza but I had finished the two slices before the though even crossed my mind. It was just too good to stop to take a picture! 

My coworkers and I were doing our traditional pizza lunch for our office and they all agreed that they should order delivery with Johnny Bronx because it's delicious NY style pizza. I haven't had Johnny Bronx's Pizza before but having had good pizza from NY, I wanted to get my hopes up with this one. When the pizzas came in the office I was not disappointed! The Pizzas are true , thin crust, NY style pizza that you fold in the in the middle to eat.

I got a slice of pepperoni and ham and one chicken Alfredo pizza slice. That first bite of the pepperoni and ham had going for more! It was super delicious and I knew I was going to visit Johnny Bronx's sometime again. Don't even get me started about the Chicken Alfredo Pizza! The taste was something I never knew I needed in a pizza but here I am wanting to buy a chicken Alfredo pizza pie all for myself. 

Go try this place out! You'll probably find me in line waiting to order the Chicken Alfredo Pizza.

Meridian Plumbing is a fantastic company to work with.  I called Friday morning due to an expansion tank leak and 16-17 year old hot water heater on its last legs.  This time of year, all plumbers are very busy.  Michael (one of their plumbers) came out when he said he would and talked with me about all the different options available to me.  I took him up on a full package with extended warranty -- which by the way was about the same price as Lowes,  but I didn't have to pick it up and bring it home for installation.   He was very professional and polite to talk with.   He dismantled my old one, let me know that he needed to go back to the shop to get the water heater I wanted, and that Chris (another plumber) would finish up the install.   Chris arrived a short while later and was also very professional and polite.   He answered all the questions that I had to my satisfaction.   What a great job with the install.   Everything looks and more importantly works great.  I would recommend Meridian Plumbing and these two plumbers to my family and friends.   They did a great job.   Thank you for everything you all did Meridian Plumbing!   I really appreciate it.   Rated 5+ stars out of 5.

I would have taken a picture of my food but it all looked so yummy I couldn't wait! I highly recommend the Oh Boy, Blue burger. The food I would have to give it an 8/10 was expecting better but the food was over all good I got the Fish and Chips and my bf got the Bleu Burger cow boy burger  but it took forever to come out on a slow night. Solid 4 star breakfast. Enjoyed the stuffed French toast with strawberry rhubarb sauce...wish it was a bit more stuffed though! But over all was really yummy, I liked the bread they used to make it. The bacon I ordered was overcooked, or like, dried out from sitting in a heated bin probably. It looked like a dog treat but still tasted pretty good. I will return to try more food as I know this place can do well!

Excellent food!  They were busy when we were there and the music is a little loud, so it was hard to have a conversation.  The waitress recommended the fried deviled eggs and they were awesome!  Burger was one of the best I've had in awhile.  Fries were crispy and hot.

They need a no star category!  This was probably the most unfriendly experience at a home depot, I have ever experienced.  I went to the tool rental and found the person indifferent to my needs, did not explain the process for renting equipment, did not explain the operation of the equipment rented, I had to ask.
