I really appreciate his professionalism and honesty. He showed up prompt and was quick! I would absolutely recommend OBryant locksmith. He made the inconvenience of my day easy. Thanks again

Have been here several times in the last couple weeks and have to say there selections is amazing they always have alot of different options for rock and landscaping needs. The employees are nice and courteous and all the ball when you need your vehicle loaded. Are there prices the best in town I would say noo but you pay a little extra for that convience factor which I am ok.. I have a feeling I will be going here alot more over the next year.. keep up the good work

This place is such a guilty pleasure that I am going to happily come back to and brings guests to when visitors are in town. It's pizza in cones- I mean where else can you get something so awesome? So the cone is made out of pizza dough and the inside is whatever fillings you would like. They have many different filling and cone options, along with children's sized cones for your small humans to enjoy. My personal favorite is the pepperoni because it creates the most well balanced and delicious pizza cone. We have also always had great service here and there is a fun backdrop wall for you to take pictures with your pizza cone for social media if that is your vibe. On top of all of this Coned! is extremely affordable and you won't be breaking the bank if you want to indulge a bit. As mentioned, pizza cones can be difficult to eat, my preferred method of eating is by a fork, and I begin by biting around the crust and work my way down with a fork until more crust is available, however, I understand that some people find any pizza with a fork a crime, but a girls gotta do what a girls gotta do to enjoy pizza (especially a pizza cone!).

Visiting from out of state.  Very good coffee and friendly staff.  As a Californian (I know, I know), this coffee is better than Dutch bro's, Starbucks and any other coffee place I could find in the Eagle, ID area

I love the BBop, I am not big on heat so I stick to level 2. I absolutely love the sauces. I'm sad to see the negative reviews. It's a new favorite in my family. Hope you enjoy their food the way we do!
Best wings in town!! the service needs a little work but the food is killer.

Worth the wait and the price. You order, then seat your self. It was pretty busy on a Saturday night, but that's to be expected, especially at the Village, and especially since the place is pretty small with limited seating. We ordered drinks, which we got right away, stood around for awhile until a table was open, then sat with no issues. We ordered the parmesan fries, steakhouse burgers and the kick starter. Everything was delicious. The service was also very good. Our waitress was awesome and the owner, who took our order, was great as well. We had no issues and will definitely be back.

Amazing spot! All of our servers were super attentive. One of our friends had to take a phone call and they remade his food because it was sitting for a while. Our main server Jeff was so fun. He told us stories about his cooking adventures during Covid learning recipes from Tik Tok and how his family thinks he should open a tri tip food truck. Everyone at our table thought he should start a podcast, we could listen to him talk all day, with all those fun voices and sound effects he makes. I had their eggs Benedict and fresh squeezed orange juice, super super good! Definitely would recommend this spot to anyone in the Meridian/Boise area.

I spent some time teaching English in Japan about 10 years ago, where I became addicted to ramen, and the spicy tonkatsu with a karaage appetizer at Ramen Sho can compete with the stuff back in Japanland. I'm definitely coming back for more!

Okay, it's official. Breakfast is probably one of my most favorite meals! Maybe it's the fact that I'm from Idaho and have a love affair with hash browns, or maybe it's because breakfast food is just really that amazing!  

While visiting my best friend in Idaho this past weekend, we woke up with our tummy's grumbling and headed to The Griddle to get our brunch fix.

Both of us opted for the California Eggs Benedict, because bacon, avocado and hollandaise sauce served on a croissant just sounded amazing! And oh it was! While I opted for eggs over hard instead of poached, it was seriously delicious. Served with a side of hash-browns that were cooked perfectly brown on the outside, we devoured our entire meal! 

Our server was probably one of the friendliest people, making sure we had everything we needed. 

The space itself reminds me of an old diner, and feels comfortable and cozy. The perfect place to catch up with a good friend over breakfast!

Probably one of the better burgers in the Treasure Valley.  It's not Hodad's- but it's got a similar vibe (cleaner and definitely more Idahoish).  Hodad's is the gold standard that we hold highest out of all burgers.  

The side dishes are huge.  Just get the fries and share them if you aren't starving or training to be a competitive eater.  Burgers have great quality meat- and fresh buns.  Good variety of "fancy" flavors but not so fancy you feel out of place.  

And the shakes- we didn't even attempt that- cause we were beyond full.  But they looked crazy, and over the top.  

Would we come back- absolutely.  It's a great edition to the village.
Extremely friendly staff. Good customer service.  Waffles are real good too. I recommend the waffles that have berries because the others can tend to be a bit too sweet.
I've always had good experiences here.  Food and service is good and consistent.

We LOVE Rudy's on McMillian in Meridian. We are always greeted with warmth & enthusiasm. Our favorite servers, Hana & Crena, make every visit special & fun. They have taken the time to get to know us and make sure our every need is met! Rudy's is our go to for watching sports, great food & beyond great service!

They're amazing! I was calling around to price compare and they gave me an honest upfront price that was better than every other place I checked. They're also very professional and efficient. When I called back they arrived within 10min and finished the job within minutes with no issues.

Come for the Food. Stay for the hospitality. This place is on point ! To begin with, as soon as you walk through the door they greet you with open arms.  Everyone is wicked nice ! The food came out quickly, served fresh and hot and the portions are huge. So glad to have a new joint like this in Meridian!!
Unbelievable waffles if you're craving waffles this is your place cool little local spot great customer service and good food

Pretty dang delicious!!! The menu is nice and small, but boy does it pack a punch! They have sweet potato noodles, who would have thought sweet potato noodles are transparent? Just so you know, they are!  Cupbop creates parfaits of heavenly goodness! All of their bowls come with rice, cabbage or lettuce and noodles. You pick your meat to go with this yummy bowl. Now, you pick your sauce. They have all sorts of sauces to please your pallet. You pick the spice level, they will whip up the perfect match your flavor. Don't forget the mandoo... deep fried tasty dumplings! I threw a tip in the tip jar because the server was so helpful to my cupbop virgin self and BAM... I got free mandoo!  What a pleasant surprise! They also have a food truck that roams around all the local events. If you haven't been, you are missing out my friend!!!

Always do a great job and at a great price. I love the Reflexology Massage..oh and the tea at the end! Love this place !!

Yesterday I was in desperate need of a deep tissue massage. I called right at 9:00 am and was able to schedule an appointment for 3:30. The best part about E Salon is you can show up early and relax in the mineral spa as well as the saunas. It was quiet, I was able to hydrate, mediate a bit and relax. It only got better from there. I was fortunate enough to have Liyan as my massage therapist. She was amazing. I have already schedule another appointment! I highly recommend both Liyan and the E Salon to anyone looking for a nice relaxing spa.
They have traded local for generic. No longer the specialty store they used to be. Far too high priced. Experienced discrimination!
So good, I tried the Boss Hog, the pork belly was perfect. I'll be going back many many times!

To start, the food was delicious! The service was fantastic. Cleanliness is perfect. I went to breakfast with my son who is in his inevitable terrible two's... not once did my server, Audrey or the other (blonde) woman who helped us, act irritated or annoyed with his crazy self. They were very helpful, understanding, and caring. 10/10 recommend in all aspects!

My daughter in law and I went the other night for dinner.  I had read the reviews earlier in the day and had some hesitation but this is where she had suggested we go.  I did see some growing pains with it being new (appetizer arrived just after the dinner was brought out) but we both loved the food and drinks.  Probably the best French dip sandwich I have ever had and it is kind of my go to dish.  Service was slow, but I prefer slow dining like in Europe instead of the rushed feeling you get in many American restaurants.  We were both very pleased with everything and will definitely be back.

I'm on a whole 30 kick so I didn't get to fully enjoy the whole spectrum of the menu but this place is fantastic. Highly recommend this relatively new spot. 
Definitely pricey but worth it.
Awesome place that has purple Japanese potatoes! Plenty of vitamins with great deals!

This was my first visit and it was beyond all of my expectations. I got the Smokehouse burger and it was done to perfection. The real treat are the shakes. We saw a number of incredible shakes, I was so jealous. They looked Amazing! I will be going back as often as possible.

I love this place.
Spent New Year's Eve with my boyfriend here for a great Gatsby theme party and we had a blast.
Kind of an amazing view and all around fun place.

In Meridian decided to stop here for dinner.  Haven't been here since they opened, place was pretty vibrant and we got the last table without any weight fortunately. Really like the menu everything is well thought out, ordered the mushroom Swiss burger with you is a blend of Kobe beef, taste was good kind of small portion though in my opinion if they were going to be known for good burgers. The burgers are topped with a cheese stuffed tater tot which are offered on the appetizer selection. What a great idea, they are amazing, I liked it better than the burger. We ordered a salad to share and this is my biggest complaint, absolutely tiny tiny portion, with the cost of lettuce there's no reason to be the skimpy. We will come back as there are many items I would like to try.

I've been wanting to catch these guys to try their Korean BBQ in a bowl for a few months now. Finally they came close enough, I was able to grab it for lunch with my coworker today. So here is my first experience...

I was a little surprised to see two white guys running the truck. I don't know why...I assumed I was going see at least one Korean?! At any rate...they were super friendly with super "LOUD" voice! It'a like they are smiling yet yelling at each other! But it wasn't nothing but a really fun vibe!!

The food was great, and the service was super fast. I got the combo with spicy pork and bbq beef. It came with chap-chae (clear sweet potato noodles), rice, and mhan-doo (complimentary). I asked for some kimchi, which made the bowl extra spicy! They put some spicy sauce and another mayonnaise-like sauce, which I'm not familiar with. But it was still great! My coworker also got a combo with chicken and spicy pork. We both were super happy with our food and will definitely try it again!

So many great vegan choices!! There are rice bowls, several vegetables, vegan beans, vegan sauces, tofu, mushrooms, vegetable sandwiches, vegetable pizza with or with out vegan cheese. Also a huge selection of beer. #boisevegan #vegan

We were in Meridian for a tennis tournament and decided to try this place. Menu was simple but adequate.  We ordered two Korean beef cups and one chicken.($8 each) The cups are built with steam rice on the bottom, clear noodle, meat, then the sauces. You have a choice of how spicy you want. I had baby spicy and was just right for me. The boys had a 3 and a 5 level spicy.  We got a complimentary gyoza dumplings for leaving tips and they were yummy.  We ate all of our food. I did think I had Too much sauce.  I'd ask for easy on the sauce next time. The boys received a high schooler meal deal which came with free drinks. Overall, it was yummy and I'd recommend it. Service was friendly and speedy too.

Pretty da*n good! We finally made it in for an early lunch (11:20) and the place was empty but by the time we left 12 it was filling up quickly! Yes, it's a little spendy but you get quality food and great portions which make it worth it. 

We got the fried eggs and OMG they were amazing!!! The jalapeño mustard sauce that comes on the side is to die for and I even added it onto my burger. The truffle fries came as a huge portion (enough for 2-3 adults) and they were so good. I ate so many of them, I just couldn't stop lol. They were nice as crispy too. 

We had them surprise us with the burger and so we got the Maui burger. It was really good. The one thing I would say is I think the flavors of the Maui portion kind of conflicted with the burger meat itself. It was kind of 2 different flavors in a burger. Still really yummy though. And as I said above, I added the jalapeño mustard sauce to the burger as well lol. 

We met the owner and he was so kind and easy to talk to and seemed to truly care about how we felt. 

Hubby and I shared the eggs, fries and burger and we are stuffed! Can't wait to go back and try more.

I had been hankering for fried chicken for some time, but just never was near KFC or Popeyes, but finally was close to the KFC in Meridian. Completely disappointed. The line was ridiculously long in the drive thru, and the dining room is currently closed due to COVID, so that was understandable. When it was my turn to order, I asked for extra crispy, but was encouraged to get original because the extra crispy would be at least a 20 minute wait. I'd already waited about 20 minutes to place my order, and was a little annoyed that they hadn't thought with a line around the building they should be dropping both original and extra crispy to serve. Anyway, I agreed to the original. It was cold, and soggy, and slid off the chicken. Ugh. Everything I ordered was cold, and old. Won't be going back. I wouldn't have been so annoyed about the wait if it had at least been fresh.

We love going on secret squirrel missions and in this case we have crazy dreams about replacing the carpet upstairs with hardwood floors and totally redoing the bathroom. We scope out two Lowes locations earlier in the week and were expecting the same hide and seek routine from the employees. That was not the case with THD. We were greeted by at least five different employees and when the sixth found us we were enchanted with his knowledge of Pergo, Porcelain tiles and everything in between. His name for your reference is Seth. Go find him as he is the Indiana Jones to your  remodel crusade. Seriously, Seth should have his own DIY home show on HGTV. Ok you get the service.  The products and offerings are equal to the other guys and if you are looking to do any sort of home remodel make sure you scope out all the pricing. THD and Lowes do offer specials but make sure you read the signs for the exclusions so that you don't get hit with a surprise. Case in point. If you want THD to do the install of the hardwood floor, it's on special right now of .89 cents a sq. ft but the hardwood needs to be priced more than 1.99 a sq ft.  We ordered the measurement so we'll update the review as the process moves along.  Thanks Seth.

Had a great brunch here! The staff was very friendly and the food was amazing. I highly recommend the pecan roll, and the California Benedict (croissant, bacon, avocado, tomato, and hollandaise). But you can't go wrong with anything on the menu!

This will be my new go-to spot! The drinks are outstanding as is the service and food. I had the seared steak salad and a friend had the peanut lime chicken salad. Both were exceptional. Service was super friendly. Can't wait to come back.

I recently bought a car from CarMax, and when it didn't work out, I returned it as simply as they advertise.  I then transferred in another car and bought that one.  The team at CarMax went out of their way to insure that the new car met my expectations.  While I'm not a huge fan of the fixed price model, CarMax makes the buying process as smooth as possible.  I would buy from them again.
Delicious concept. The staff was completely willing to try something not on the menu and it was delicious. We'll be back for sure!
Mac and cheese was soupy, burger was ok, overpriced. The shakes were too too much. Too much to eat, pricey. My kids didn't enjoy them...

A friend told us about Rudy's, and while exploring the area we stumbled across it and had to stop in. The place is pretty big considering the center it is in. We were pleasantly surprised. Super clean, including restrooms. Very friendly and welcoming staff. We sat at the bar midday, and had the pleasure of chatting with Mel, bartender/manager. We asked her a bunch of questions about the area, and she was super helpful and just so down to earth. She also made really good mixed drinks! Beer was super cold too. Being out of town visitors, Mel made us feel like friends. We had a very enjoyable experience and will definitely be back! Thanks Mel, you ROCK!
The ramen is SO good! The place doesn't look like much, but the food is amazing! The service was excellent - very fast, friendly, and knowledgeable. We'll be back!
The best pizza I've ever had! All employees wear gloves and masks and do everything they can to help with Covid!

I wish i could double the stars because this jeweler deserves a 10!  This would be my 6th purchase and/or experience with Jay and his staff but this time it was more sentimental and personal as i was looking for my wedding band after recently becoming engaged. Immediately Crista showed me some examples of what i had explained to her that i liked and wanted.  It was so refreshing having someone that LISTENED to us and what we were looking for.  In the course of our conversation I mentioned having a different stone instead of a diamond. There was no pushback or pish poshing of what i wanted. She was open to showing me everything. Ensuring i could see all my options. The end result besides my new wedding ring is HAPPINESS and you can't put a price on that.  Thank you Crista and Jay for taking your time with us. 
Matthew and Raquel

Worked with Andrew at Meridian Plumbing to solve the puzzle of my newly purchased, but "antique" 1946 house in Star! He was extremely knowledgable, communicative, and thorough in his evaluation of the need to replace a water pressure valve and pipe to the city water, and gained my confidence immediately. The job was done on time, took fewer actual hours than anticipated, and so cost me less than the original bid! Yea! I would highly recommend Meridian Plumbing, especially for any complicated or serious plumbing needs. Great job!

Purchased gravel from them last week. We were told that they would call 30 minutes before delivery. You also don't get your receipt until they deliver the stone. The person who sold it to use wrote down the wrong stone. We weren't home when they delivered since they didn't call. If we had the receipt we would have seen they wrote down the wrong thing or if we were home we could have told them it was the wrong product. Called and was told it is already on the driveway so not their problem.

Now we have try to sell this and we are out the $75.00 delivery fee.

Loved the waffle! Had it just plain and it was perfect! We also had the breakfast sandwich Which was delicious, and the chicken avocado tartine which was equally delicious. Will definitely go back often.
Yum. Brussel Sprouts! What? Yep, and fries and burgers to die for. But don't blink  you might miss it.

My husband and I had a great late lunch and cocktail hour afternoon here! Food was good and drinks were even better! I'm not sure I would recommend the queso appetizer but the tacos, sliders and pretzel we got were wonderful. Service was lovely and our pup enjoyed the dog-friendly patio too!

I thought my transmission was out in my truck.  Took it to Bobby's and come to find out, it was only a fuse...thank God!  
Very honest company, great customer service!  
They have gained a customer for life!
Great food, love the atmosphere! The service was very good.  I have tried many items, the fried chicken is definitely a favorite!

Probably one of the worst Sonics I've ever been to. The serving staff is always nice, but man the food is always bad. I mean, I'm not expecting much when I go to a Sonic, so that says something. Hot dogs and tots are always cold / room temperature. They always get something wrong with each order.

When visiting Idaho this is my favorite place to eat. The service is exceptional. 
My family changes up what they order every time we come. They all rave about how good their food is. 
I am stuck on the Aunt Mo's Potatoes. They are hash browns grilled with bacon, onions, and green peppers. Get my eggs scrambled and an English muffin. Oh yeah, add a slice of French toast.
Yeah. It's a lot of food but the coffee washes it down nicely.

Where do I start? I came here after a recent social media post I saw on this place. This restaurant reserved a large table, with 13 seats and 13 beers, to honor the fallen heroes in Afghanistan. For this reason alone, my veteran fiancé and I wanted to support them. We walked in and was promptly welcomed by the friendliest worker. Our waitress was friendly as well and had great recommendations such as the candied jalepeños bacon which wasn't spicy and the best bacon I've ever had. Our burgers were fun and delicious and just everything about the staff and the food was exceptional. We will definitely come again and again and again. Lastly, thank you for supporting our military!! We love this place!!!!

Our experience from start to finish was AMAZING!  Our sales person Mike was very helpful and answered all questions and showed us everything we asked to see.  We traded in our truck camper and got a very fair price for it and the trade in process was effortless.  The finance process with Efren was entertaining to say the least and he did everything possible to get us all we needed as far as rate and any extras available.  We also had a great experience with Jeremy and Jackie on the parts side to top of our great experience at Camping World.

Visited here twice last week while visiting the area. Food was very good. Waitress on first visit was awesome. Waiter on second visit was just okay. - Wish they enforced the COVID mandate for patrons to wear masks at least when they enter the place. Would have given it 4 stars but they seem very relaxed about mask wearing in some cases, mostly with customers. I get that you can't wear a mask while eating or drinking but the management should enforce mask wearing upon entering the establishment and invest in a portable air purifier or two for the room.

Last minute emergency repair on my move from Seattle to Denver. My catalytic converter went out. They took me in immediately and they stayed late to finish the job when it took longer than expected due to a fair bit of Seattle rust. And even though it took 3 hours and another part after all, they only charged the original one hour labor estimate I was given at the beginning. Thanks guys!

Don't be put off by the strip mall location. This place is for real. The food was amazing! All from scratch, healthy too. The momos and sauce is to die for. I had the combo meal, turkey momos, rice and black eyed peas, with a mutter panner style sauce. All amazing, all of this in Bosie? Wow!  You would be more than successful in Portland... Please come!

5 stars for previous menu! We came in a couple of times before and the dinner menu was spot on! Salads, entrees and appetizers were AMAZING! Alas, they moved to a watered down pseudo menu that leaves much to be desired. Fortunately the chef spices it up with evening specials that rival any fine dining in town. The rib-eye special with some sort of truffle goodness in mashed potato form was enough to make me want to lick the plate. Our waiter, Terrance, was of the highest standard. He bent over backwards to make sure our dining experience was top notch. 
Hopefully they bring back the REAL FINE DINING menu and save the "pub fare" for the sports bars!
This is the worst Chinese food I've ever had. I got the house lomain. It was soupy and they used spaghetti noodles. No taste what so ever. So disappointing.

Good place to come for lunch, nice simple atmosphere. Ordered the spicy tonkatsu. Was delicious, the broth was tasty and noodles were good. Decent size portions. Needed to add sriracha to get it spicier enough. One complaint would be there was too much fat in the pork.
Great neighborhood place for dinner and drinks.  Good service and yummy food!  My husband and I go often and we have yet to be disappointed.

Hands down the best representation of NY pizza in our area! The wait was a bit long, but ohhh so worth it! It's only a walk up (pick up) and drive through, so we phoned our order in ahead of time. No limp pizza here!! The crust was amazing!! If you're looking for true NY style pizza, look no further!

So first of all Clayton is just the best person around. And his skills are top notch! I did a TON of research before I decided to bite the bullet and get eyelash extensions. He made this first timer feel at ease. His spa room was clean and smelled amazing. He was warm and welcoming, and worked around my super water-y eyes and fidgets. He explained everything, And  helped me decide what would look most natural and I LOVE LOVE them. Definitely recommending him to every person who will listen. I will update this review when I've had them a few weeks. So far, amazing!

When visiting Boise our daughter and son In Law recommended this wonderful restaurant. We enjoyed the chicken and waffles, salmon and chicken sandwhich plates.Since I'm staying away from meat I opted for the bbq chicken salad but traded out the chicken for the portobello mushroom. Everything was delicious but my salad was drowning in the chipotle ranch dressing. When I mentioned this to our (FANTASTIC) server Morgan she promptly mentioned it to her manager. I wasn't looking for my meal to be comped but it was so sweet of her to take care of us in this way. Totally will be returning. Love Idaho

My second and last time to ever visit this place. First time it was 8:57 pm and they didn't want to sell me a slice. The second time is today. I ordered the 3 meatballs w pasta. I got home and there was only 2. I called and was told 1) the container only holds 2. 2) I was only charged for 2.  I know when I have had the old bait and switch done to me. Very obnoxious and flippant servers. I must have interrupted their grab ass time. Please, stay in your car and drive past this place. There are many fine privately owned places to eat that appreciate your hard earned dollars. This in my opinion is not one of them.

One of Treasure Valley's most beautiful salons. I wish I had found this place sooner. My hair stylist, Jacee moved to this salon and I'm so glad she introduced me to this place. It's a little hard to find but what a great hidden treasure. Jacee does an excellent job on my hair but all the staff there seem equally wonderful!
It took over 25 minutes to just to get two drinks, popcorn chicken, and a pretzel stick. I will not go back!

I'm going to preface this by saying that we normally LOVE CupBop! However, a couple weeks ago my husband and I decided to grab it for dinner. We haven't been inside the door of any restaurant or grocery store since March due to Covid, but *nervously* we decided to make an exception. I called in the pickup order and waited the 20 minutes before going in and grabbing it. One family in line and they had not started the order. A huge bummer given how nervous I was to be in there. We ordered two of the two meat cups and when I got home neither entree had the chicken on it. I called a couple times and the phone rang and rang with no answering machine. Really sad because I felt like it made the reward not worth the risk!

We have been coming to Yogurtz for a long time and the food is almost always spot on. This truly is a little hidden gem for amazing burgers and great froyo. That said, you are going to start losing your business if you don't improve your customer service. We usually "put up" with poor service just to have a great burger.  It has been steadily declining over the past several months.  Also, why did you change your buns on the burgers recently to those awful sesame seed buns??  If it's not broke, don't fix it!

Once again, Meridian Plumbing did a great job!

#1 was a new natural gas line to the kitchen range, to the laundry room for the dryer, and to the patio for the bbq'er.

#2 was a broken water faucet that the home inspector did not find.


Jake the first time was great!  And he shared his local fishing spots with us.

Joe time #2 fixed the water pipe and showed me how for the next time.

They gave me 5% off for the Angie's List membership!


These guys are prompt, courteous, and just great to have come work on my house!

Now don't get me wrong the presentation of these waffles along with the nice hearty scoop of whipped topping is appealing. I love the idea of incorporating biscoff in and I'm a huge fan so it's great. However the taste of the waffles itself is nothing grand. The price for one of these (verging on rock hard, pretty tasteless waffles) is insane. The bacon however I thought was very tasty. My first time here it wasn't even busy but I had to wait forever to even get any service. The girl though was friendly and the service is fast. So that's a plus. But it's really the next time I went that made me give this rating. The guy serving me shocked me. I literally thought he must be playing mind games with me or was he really that stupid? I had thought. I told him a simple order. Didn't even ask for any complicated changes but yet he acted clueless as to what I was ordering even though it was right there on the board. He made it seem like I was crazy and made me second guess myself. I felt humiliated and wanted to cry. I'm not usually a confrontational person so I just let it slide. But I wonder if anyone else had similar situations with this person acted rude and it would be nice to see that person fired. Oh and they cooked my eggs totally wrong from what I asked plus they should probably include the WHOLE menu on the main board. But other then that the waffles taste ok.

This place is a hidden gem. So much going on in this spa. I've had several pedicures, a facial, a massage, and a manicure. This is a truly luxurious spa. The staff is wonderful, the decor makes you feel you are in a big city spa and everyone working there is the best at what they do.
I always leave feeling completely relaxed and pampered. And figuring out when I can go again.
Treat yourself to any of their services. And make sure to use the waters room. There are days I seriously consider just going for that.
Today I went with two friends for pedicures. We did the waters room first and all three of us were able to get our toes done together. The pedi room fits a party of four and is the perfect set up for gabbing and catching up. 
Fruit infused water is offered throughout the spa. I was also offered a glass of wine, which was wonderful.
Very clean, lots of products to purchase and again the staff is amazing!

What a hidden gem! It's a cool burger place that supports local breweries and farmers.
We went for the first time and had a great waitress!
Apps, burgers, sides, and shakes did not disappoint.
Their online menu doesn't show a kids menu, but they do serve kid chicken tenders, grilled cheese, burger or Mac n cheese!   
The presentation of the shakes is memorable.

My new burger spot in the Treasure Valley!! Quality meat you can taste not just seasoning! Fresh ingredients! Candied bacon is amazing! Solid tots! Service was on point and super friendly! Check this place out!

My husband and I were celebrating our 19th year anniversary and decided to try this sweet little place out. Atmosphere was great, staff nice and friendly. Cute place for a date night or group of friends. Prices are very fair and affordable.

Great service, very helpful and willing to go the extra mile with packaging etc.  always pleasant and friendly. I always come and need to print my amazon label and packages need taping etc and I never get a feeling of frustration or being put out. They are ready and more than willing to help. I do all my business here because their service is so great.

What can I say, this place is everything I love about a burger joint - and more! After visiting a handful of times, I can tell you that the food quality and friendliness of the staff is consistent every time. The burgers are filling and delicious, the Loco fries are crispy and plentiful (make sure you try the fry sauce!!), and as a former Nashville resident of 17 years, I can tell you that the Nashville hot chicken sandwich is on-point! I also love the atmosphere - great vibe and tunes! I look forward to continually coming back and trying more things on the menu.

It tastes like they completely ran out of salt. Breadsticks? BLAND, marinara? BLAND, the pizza? BLAND. I think the idea is very cool but the execution was not well thought out. Read a bunch of reviews on here beforehand and decided to give this place a try, was very disappointed. Staff was very nice and welcoming but the food here is just... not good.

My daugter & son in law went to the Great Wall Restaurant this evening. I have never had such a raunchy meal as this one . This place will kill someone . If I could give it no stars I would have. Thats the first time and the last time I ever go into this establishment again. The waitresses were very un-friendly . We had to ask for orders to come out. They acted as if we were a pain. Sorry, but this place is not my cup of tea. i will never go to this place again.

Used to be noisy and fun counter help. Now a bit subdued with tofu always having to be cooked to order then brought to table way too hot. Was on the line before for their popular tofu type bowls.

Still a four for the food!
This is the best pizza in meridian for sure! Very good turn around times after ordering, and a very friendly staff!
One of my favorite places to go.  So happy to have you in Meridian for a quick a yummy meal :)

My husband & I have eaten here many times. At first we thought it was great! The last few times not so good sorry to say. The last time we went in we waited about 10 minutes for anyone to even come to our table. There were about 4 tables occupied so it wasn't because it was busy. Then it took awhile just to get our drinks. Once the girl finally took our food order it was ok. The food was prompt. I guess she didn't feel like working that day. There's plenty of other places to go. Not sure if we will be back.

As a newcomer to the area, this was one of the places that a local recommended to eat at. I have been there 2 times since then. We will always recommend this place to anyone looking for an awesome burger and fries with an awesome atmosphere. The employee's are beyond awesome. They make you feel very welcome.
Out of bacon. No ice tea for weeks. Who is running this place? Been going downhill for months. Time for a new breakfast place.

I'm disappointed in this location. The place was empty on a Saturday morning. I just thought it was my lucky day! Then I quickly figured out why. I went in and waited for 15 mins as 3 employees passed me and said "someone will be with you shortly." We eventually left as well and the three groups waiting behind me. So is the food good?! Who knows? Is the service good? That's a hard no.

Such good ice cream!! I ordered moms recipe and it might be my new favorite ice cream!! I'll definitely have to go back. There was a nice selection. They have seating inside but none outside. They also sell raw milk, milk, eggs, cheese curds, cream and ice cream by the pints.

I had broken my key into my front door  and called him to help me.  He answered promptly and came within twenty minutes of calling him and fixed my lock and everything quickly.  I would recommend and use him again
We have been here twice now and we really like it!!   Lots of vegetarian options and good burgers for meat eaters!  The service is top notch too

I don't give out a lot of five stars, maybe that's because we travel a lot and our expectations are high. I've been wanting to try this new burger joint in the village for a while .  Tonight was the night, we met a couple friends and although we ate fairly early because we were going to see a movie, there was no wait. Small place and a bit loud and cold for my normal taste but I will be back! Other reviews were very accurate, this place is amazing!  Their burgers are a Wagyu mix and are the best I've had in a long time and that says a lot. The owner himself came over and personally explained the menu thoroughly.  The simplest burger on their menu (the Not So Whimpie) will knock your socks off flavor wise. Wife got the Steakhouse burger, OMG!   Friends split the Hangover burger and loved it too.  We also got the pork belly tater tot's and a side of their season fries, outstanding and huge portion.  This is all a cart so you order the burger and your side separately, worth every dime and can't wait to go back and work our way through the menu.

Gluten free pancakes are a win!! Super good flavor, consistency, generous portion, and overall appeal! Been a big fan of Terri's cafe (formerly Steve's). I wish they had gluten free toast too. Overall my meal was hot, out quick, and cooked perfectly!

Left a lot to be desired... no reason to go back

I rarely leave bad reviews. But this place was kind of disappointing honestly. The employees recommended the meat lovers and said it was their most popular, but the taste was comparable to a Little Caesars $5 pizza. The pizza sauce was also too sweet. 

Tried the seasonal pumpkin pie cheesecake cone and was completely underwhelmed. I also had to go up and remind the employee that we had ordered dessert too. 

Not a great value, not very much pizza for the price.

I can't in good conscience recommend this place to anyone I actually like.

Love Cup Bop you can pick you level of "hot". The sauces are amazing and very friendly staff. Always greeted with a cheerful hello when we visit. They have a punch card system, so our next visit will be free. Combo Bowl

Yummy pizza. Good quick service. I feel quite stupid, however, because I didn't realize how GARGANTUAN the pizza really is. I am not familiar with New York Style pizza. I have been a regular with Papa Murphy's so when I called in 2 whole pizzas for my 6 person family, I didn't see how silly that was. I wish that the person I was talking with would have informed me. I even said that I had never tried their pizza before. The least they could have done was said, "Oh! Are you planning on feeding the neighborhood as well?" But, again, I admit it's my own fault. I just hope to inform others before they repeat my mistake. ‍ I now I have pizza til next Thursday.
I shopped around I found that victory green the best Price they were fun to work with and my rocks arrived on time I would recommend working with these guys

Sooo good! Loved my experience and excited to come back. When I heard the Flatbread in Meridian was closing but was being reopened by the same owners I was excited to see what was to come. It lived up to my expectations abd looking forward to coming back.

I took a break from eyelash extensions for personal reasons... nothing to do with Clayton or his work. I came back yesterday and he did my lashes again. I love them! He is very meticulous, and asks questions to get to know what kind of look you want. I have already received compliments on my lashes. I recommend him to all my friends. Clayton is very approachable, kind, and a good listener.

Update regarding first review: Josh, Operations Manager, called me to discuss my issues. Josh was very professional. Receiving a call shows that Window Wizard does care about their customers and the service they provide. Thank you Josh!

Highly recommend using another company instead of Window Wizard. They misquoted me and I received a bill for a higher amount. I also had to remind them I had a coupon. Account receivable department accepted my quoted price and then turned around and said they had a missing payment from me. In the end, I just went ahead and paid them the additional costs. Also, the techs had to return because they forgot a window and blind in my house. The inside window cleaning was sloppy and the girl did not clean my window tracks very well.

Sid's Garage just recently opened up shop inside the village. They are in the spot that used to belong to what they claimed was an upscale Donut shop. I cant recall the name.

The Donut shop and Sids is owned by the same guy. Sid says the donuts are moving somewhere downtown. An upscale donut was a cool concept, but for me, it was a failure, so I am happy to see they have changed gears.

The only thing different I noticed in the way of change of decor from the donut shop was the new name on the wall. They are a counter culture hamburger place. The idea is interesting, and I applaud their creativity, but I think they missed the mark on a few things.

On the wall, is a picture of Homer Simpson. I could picture in my mind Homer taking a bite out of their burger and saying "Doh! For me, the Doh means the burger could be better.

The atmosphere
I can describe the atmosphere in one word, LOUD! The music is played loud and its hard rock. They cater here to a 20 and 30 something crowd. If you dont fall into this age range, or you have young kids, or a baby, you might not have good experience dining inside Sids. 

For me, I like my music less loud and less gritty. If you dont like their dining concept, Id recommend getting your food to go. 

The other thing I noticed was a young women server that had shirt on that was hiked up to her belly button showing her mid section. My daughter tries to get away with doing this as well, so I know the style, but for me, it does not belong in a place that has shakes that seem to be trying to entice kids to come into. 

Kids dont need to be seeing this.

The Food
I had the JEKYLL & HYDE Burger. For me, it lacked flavor. After several bites, the bun disintegrated. The peaches did not taste very peachy probably from being grilled which tends to remove their juice and flavor. The beef blend for me failed and had very little flavor. 

My wife had the Nashville Hot Chicken. This sandwich was very good. It is a crispy chicken battered with a corn meal batter. It has heat to it, so be careful with this one. I loved the spice, but for my wife, it was way too hot. For me, it was perfect!

Fries
A big miss here. They are frozen Shoestring fries and lacked flavor. The Truffle and Parmesan fries were especially disappointing.  I could not taste any truffle oil at all. I am not sure what sort of parm they are using, but the only way I could get any parm flavor was to find a big handful of the it and eat that by itself. 

Since there were 2 of us, we got 2 orders of fries. The portion size of an order of fries is huge. 1 order of fries will easily feed 3-4 people.

Shakes
We had the 420 which is an Oreo shake. Love love love! The ice cream is more like a soft serve, which for me was great. It was not overly sweet, which was also for me a huge plus. There was also a huge ice cream sandwich hanging off the side of the glass. Even the rim was covered in crushed Oreos.

Wagu Blend beef
Wagu is supposed to be a hot and trendy beef and is touted as the best. If you have not had Wagu, its hard to say if you will like it. Wagu has a weird taste and texture way different than regular beef. 

For me, its waxy, and soft. The best description I can think of it this. Take some regular beef. Put it in the Food Processor and process it along with some oil. Then form it into a patty and cook it. For me, I did not like it at all. I much prefer regular beef. 

Areas to consider for improvement
* Lower the volume on the music and consider less gritty music that has more mass appeal. 
* Hamburger - Consider adding a regular beef hamburger to the menu to either replace the Wagu or in addition to it.
* Menus - Clean your menus.
* Barrell Tables - The barrels are too small to have enough room on them to make a table. 
The metal chairs that are beside the barrel tables are small and very uncomfortable. Do away with these and put up regular tables or booths
* Shakes - These are what shakes should be. Expand this part of the menu with even more creative options and will you be a winner, especially for kids. BUT you will need to address the issues with not being family friendly. 
* Fries - recommend hand cutting your fries, using a better quality parm with more flavor and draining the grease.

Since the ratings on this one is going to range a lot, I decided to break them down by category. The ratings are on my 1-10 scale with 1 meaning I hated it and 10 being the best

Ratings 
Hamburger - 3
Fries - 2
Shakes - 9
Chicken - 9
Atmosphere - 2
Creativity - 9
Family Friendly - 1

I had to take away 2 stars in yelps rating system due to the issues  with Sids that I found.

Wife and I had dinner here tonight for the first time. I made a reservation not knowing for sure how busy they get, and glad I did as the place looked fairly full.  
The place has a nice warm feel to it, good background music and a few large TVs around showing a basketball game with close captions on. 
We sat on the street side by the window and even though we were on a high table and chairs it was comfortable, not too loud and we could carry on a conversation easily. 
Our waitress Rainie was very nice,promptly greeted us and took our drink/appetizer order(wings,corona and Ice Tea).  Ranie described the flavor of the week for the wings and we were fine with it.  
She returned with our drinks and took our dinner order (Fish n Chips for Wife and Bacon Burger and Fries for me) 
We enjoyed our conversations and time went by quickly so when Ranie walked up to our table with our dinner meals we were surprised because we hadn't even gotten our wings yet.....ooops! 
She apologized for the mistake, owned it and asked if we still wanted the wings.  We replied yes and she left to take care of it.  Mid meal Ranie returned with freshly made wings.  A few minutes later a manager stopped by to see if everything was okay and said they comped our wings.  Thank you. 
This is a perfect example of how to take care of your customer.  Own a mistake and make up for it anyway you can.  We will definitely be coming back. 
My wife thoroughly enjoyed her Fish and Chips. The fish good flavor had a nice crispy batter, the fries had a nice whole skin cut to them and could have been a little crispier, but there was none to be found on our plates so there good!  My Bacon Burger was excellent and everything paired up well.  Nice bun and my medium cook preference was spot on.  We both enjoyed the wings (nice spicy flavor) and overall a very enjoyable experience at Eight Thirty Common.  
Keep up the good work.  
And Ranie you did a great job!  $h_t happens.  It's how people and management handles it that makes a difference. INTEGRITY COUNTS!  
If we don't learn something everyday life gets boring.

Love the ambiance of this restaurant. It has an old Hollywood glam style, but the menu .  .  .  . well- it USED to make this restaurant a fine dining experience. Now- it's a glorified bar menu. PLEASE bring back the full menu!
Got a coupon and tried it.  What a small romantic place and the food was  incredible.  Looking forward to going back soon.

Stopped in on a Friday evening. Lots of customers which is always a good sign! We ordered 2 single cones, one strawberry cheesecake and one (can't remember name) chocolate with mini peanut butter cups. While the size of the scoops were massive, there was very little flavor. There was just a tiny sliver of pink in the strawberry cheesecake and no sign of cheesecake whatsoever and 2 tiny peanut butter cup pieces in the other. Service was great though.

I feel very lucky to have this place within a 10 minute drive. I have been here twice now, both with last minute notice, and both times the experience has been wonderful. I have only got the 30 min massage both times, so I can't speak for their foot massage or reflexology. They make great use of their time and really focus on the entire back, even using hot stones. I appreciate that they also use a warm towel at the end so you don't leave still lathered in oil. By the end of my appointment today I was practically cross-eyed and so relaxed I had to take a breather in my car before driving, and I mean that in the best way possible.
Thank you for another wonderful experience getting a gel manicure!  I have come by every 2 weeks for the past 5 months and am never disappointed
The food was very good but it was very, very noisy, we won't go there again.If you do go,you better wear some ear plugs.

We drove from Portland to meridian Idaho to purchase our 2018 outback 325bh. Worst new purchase we have ever experienced. The salesman lied to us. Certain option we asked him if our rv had. He lied to us and said it had the options we asked about. Our unit was held at a remote location. He sent us pictures of a unit they had on their lot And told us they had the same exact options. We drove 460 miles to find out it didn't have the options we asked about.
When we arrived after waking up at 3:00 in the morning for the seven hour drive, we did the walk through. Only to find the left side of our rv was completely covered in dried white hard water spots all over the windows and siding. It looked like a 5 year old unit that had never been taken care of. Hard water spots are extremely difficult to remove. They spent over 2 hours trying to get them removed only to find only about 1/3 of them were gone. By this time it was after their closing time so we were stuck taking the rv as is. Not exactly how you want to drive off the lot with a brand new purchase.
On top of this, the auto level control unit on top of the power jack is supposed to have a cover to protect it from the elements, it is completely broken off and missing. They say the will shop is a new unit. 
Their was mud all under the unit that they didn't even care to wash off. One of the tires was almost flat.
It had no water pressure from any faucets 
Their parts prices are a joke. The weight distribution I wanted I got on amazon for 450, they wanted $600 for the same unit. I get paying a little more at brick and mortar business but I'm not going to throw away an xtra $150 for a little bit of convenience. 
They charged us $65 for a water hose and sewer hose that all the dealers in Oregon we looked at rv's including with buying a new rv.
Do yourself a favor and don't buy from this dealer.

Do not buy trees from this place. They guarantee their trees but do not honor their warranty's. asked several times about a failing  tree immediately after planting it and deep watering as instructed.  Multiple other trees on the property are doing fine.  The people that work there are very nice but the owners are con artists. Buyer beware.

It is okay. Not great, not cruddy. I do wish their young servers would be more aware of their personal cleanliness and demeanorvwhen handling,food. The food is not anything to write home about and the restaurant is kinda noisy.
Graet pizza, pasta, sandwiches and great service!  In my opinion, best pizza in Treasure Valley.
The overall experience was amazing. The food and shakes were incredible! The staff was kind and attentive. I can't recommend this place enough. Our new favorite spot in town!

Licorice!  Among my fav of ice cream flavors, hard to find and they had it here.  It was luscious.  My husband said the same of the huckleberry flavor he chose, which he described as loaded with huckleberries and just a tad chewy in texture which is among the highest of compliments he will pay a good ice cream.  Add in friendly service, "Welcome to Reed's" greeting by the two young women behind the counter, good deal prices, 23 flavors from which to choose and local-'ish' owners (Idaho Falls) - what's not to like?

THE VIBE:
With the lovely warm sugar aroma of freshly made waffle cones perfuming the space, today at high noon there were roughly three moms with seven children between them sitting at the tables to enjoy the eats along with a guy waiting on his milkshake and us.  There is seating for maybe 20 folks at tables and chairs inside the Spartan, as in cement floors, but sparking clean space.  No outside seats.

I appreciate  that there is no music in the store.  If you want to sit and savor your ice cream and have a conversation there is nothing to need to shout over.

THE DRILL:
Order at the counter.  They are happy to offer tastes on little spoons if you want to try before you guy.  Each cone and the ice cream for shakes and floats gets hand scooped so be patient if it takes some time.  It is worth it and then some.  Especially at these prices.  Kiddie sizes (which one does not have to be a kiddie to order) as little as $2 and ample and the standard single scoop servings are uber generous at $3.50. 

They have pre-packed pints ($4.50), quarts and half gallons at the back of the store along with milk products (including chocolate) in glass containers, butter and yellow cheddar.  I have my fingers crossed for eggnog at Christmas!

FEBRUARY 2018 UPDATE:  Back to Reeds for a mocha fudge milkshake.  The BEST.  My hubby doesn't even like milkshakes as a rule but he nearly wrestled me to get his share of this one!  Too thick for a straw and that is perfect!

ACCESSIBILITY: 
Level in and all on one floor.  Standard height seating.  Accessible parking in lot is not to code and this is a brand new strip mall.  That is not the ice cream store owner's problem, but a violation of Federal law and State codes by the strip mall owner. How this passed City of Meridian plan review with State Building Access Code / ADA violations in the location of the accessible parking and the dimension of the walkway that forced the ADA parking across the lot to the corner instead of right outside the doors of the stores is beyond comprehension.  The ADA Law and State Accessible Building Code which mirrors it have been in effect for 27 years.
We had the best time and such wonderful service, food and drinks here. Also, loved how seriously you've taken distancing and masks here, it's appreciated. Cheers! We look forward to our next visit.

After two major leaks in crawl space due to faulty manufacturing of polybutylene pipe, decided re-pipe of entire system was needed.
Meridian Plumbing (Brian Smith, plumber), did an excellent job. Due to great planning, all was finished in less time than projected. He and the apprentice plumber were cautious about placing protection on floors and kept disruption to my household at a minimum. They took time to carefully answer all questions and explain reason for each process.  They display pride in the work they do and it is reflected in the finished product. Meridian Plumbing has taken care of issues at a my home for over 12 years and will continue to be who I call.  Thanks to everyone there.

I really wanted to love this place because it has a nice atmosphere and it is conveniently located.

I ordered the omelette with caramelized onions and goat cheese. It was a soggy mess and didn't have a good flavor at all. When I pointed it out to the server she sympathized but didn't discount it or anything.

My husband ordered biscuits and gravy with two eggs and hash browns and a side of ham. The biscuit was dry and flavorless and the gravy was bland. The eggs and ham were perfect. The hash browns were a little undercooked.

The kids' menu left much to be desired. The "hot cake," for example, is literally one hot cake with no side. Both my kids ordered two flavored hot cakes off the regular menu. I will say the hot cakes looked amazing and fluffy and wonderful. My son didn't touch his but I just don't think he was hungry. My picky daughter ate about half (so I guess the kids' order would have been fine!) but she really liked it.

Improve your customer service and some of your food and maybe we'll be back. Meanwhile we'll stick with Shari's for family meals.

While visiting Idaho a couple of weekends ago, we decided to give The Griddle a try, and it was a hit! Other than homemade hollandaise sauce, The Griddle has so far been the best hollandaise I have found that wasn't at a "high end" place. It was delicious, and I enjoyed the california benedict very much. 

The kids pancakes came back a little raw at first, but they were very quick and prompt about getting new pancakes out, and the kids loved them. My husbands only complaint was that he ate too much ;)

If you're in Meridian and in need of a quick inexpensive breakfast, I'd definitely recommend The Griddle.

I had the grilled cheese and tomato soup for lunch and it was fabulous.  We dined during Covid and it was easy to get in and out while all protocols were being met.  The waitress was great and friendly.  I will definitely be back.
Worst Chinese smelling food. Waste of money. Straight went to trash. Manager is  lier.

We went the Eight Thirty Common after following them on IG for a couple weeks. I ordered the chicken and waffle (my go to on ANY menu) and he had the prime rib dip. We ordered the wagyu corn dogs as an app.
I don't eat hot dogs and ordered the wagyu corn dogs bcuz I thought they were more like finger steaks but turns out it's a hot dog inside.. lol.. I tasted them but left them for my husband. The waitress said it's a spicy mustard served with them- it's actually a sweet mustard and really good. My honey latte was amazing, really liked it. The spinach/bacon waffle was super crispy and light, definitely savory and so good. The brined fried chicken was good too even tho the meat slid right out of the breading I ate it separately. The syrup was kind of... bland? It wasn't sweet.. or spicy.. just kind of.. ok. Would have preferred a sweet and/or spicy syrup as a compliment to the meal. My husband took two bites of his sandwich, bread was soft but the reason for the 4 stars- all our food was served cold. Even the fried chicken was room temp and it really brought down the experience. The ginger vinaigrette wasn't to our taste. Waitress was nice and very attentive. We'll try them again another time.

Authentic, bone broth based Ramen in Boise!
Tonkotsu and Spicy Tonkotsu are our all-time favorites. But there is another little food gem on their menu: The pork belly rice bowl is to die for.
We eat here frequently and had times when the chashu pork was a bit on the firm side, not so in recent weeks when it was perfect melt-in-your-mouth and flavorful. Noodles are consistently great and taste home made. But for us the broth is where it is at and Ramen Sho delivers on that like none of the other places we have in town.

My wife found this restaurant on Yelp.  We went last Sunday after church for brunch.  It is only open for breakfast and lunch.  

We went there around 1:00 PM, and it was pretty full.  We were able to sit down pretty quickly.  I ordered the Big Bird with a fruit cup.

The sandwich was great.  The bread was fresh and crisp, the meat was fresh and juicy, and the service was great.  

My wife ordered the ultimate club wrap.  She enjoyed it and said it was great.  The meat was fresh, the cole slaw was delicious.  The service was great, and our waitress was very attentive to us.  If you are on Fairview Avenue in the morning or early afternoon and are hungry it is worth going here to eat.

Greg was great from start to finish. I called in asking about appointments, and he said they didn't have availability until the following week. I then arranged a time today to bring my vehicle in and have it diagnosed for transmission services, etc. Greg informed me of my options and was awesome about letting me know exactly how the repair would go. Thank you 4 a lovely experience, despite my car troubles. I will highly recommend this business in the future.
Amazing food, awesome staff overall the best Korean bbq ever! Definitely going again!

I don't usually give bad reviews however my wife says other should know. Spent over $220 to get a detail and still had to spend my own time scrubbing half of the vehicle. When I showed them what wasn't done they said we went through it already didn't even look or want to do anything about it. I don't even think they hand waxed the van and likely just ran it through the car wash and hand dried it. They definitely don't pay attention to the details which is not good when you're a detailed shop. Hopefully this was a one-off thing.  Good luck if you choose them.

Really good food and service! Cheese enchiladas are great! Chips and salsa are really good a d they serve beans with it also. 
Overall, really good! I'll be back!

I don't enjoy writing bad reviews, especially of a place like this.  I really want to see these locally owned non-chain restaurants have success.  In three years though, we haven't had a single smooth experience here, yet we keep coming back....because in the end, the food is (usually) pretty good, and it's never too busy.  In fact, it's a Saturday night and the place is virtually empty, starting to think that's no accident.  40 minutes passed between the arrival of our first and final orders.  Every order was wrong in some way.  The veggie burger was (for the fourth time) frozen in the middle, the grilled cheese was a burnt cheese, and all the food was in general cold and limp.  Amazing too because as the plates were being distributed, the girl warned that the kid's plates were "piping hot" due to the heat lamp they'd been sitting under for the last half hour.  Not ok.  

I get that this isn't fine dining, it's fro-yo and burgers.  None the less, consider that some people can only afford to take their family out to eat for special occasions, a few times a month at most, and they chose to spend their limited time and money at your place.  If you can't figure out how to consistently provide people with a vaguely positive experience, you won't be around for long.  It's not rocket science, a little care and some training would go a long way.
They have a great variety of ice cream flavors and dairy goods. Soo yummy! Great stop with the family!
Not a fan of food. Resteraunt is so loud hard to socialize. My kids won't eat anything. My husband through his in the garbage, the first time.
Great place and good knowledgeable service!!  My son and grandson were both taken great care of.

Extremely  disappointed  with  them.......84 year  old  customer called  them  several  times for  help and a  home  visit...she  has  gone through you  several  times.......  she needed   help.......I  even  called them  from  her house and explained.......they  again  said  she would  get  a phone call from  Jason........it never  happened.......I  finally  called another  computer company  that  called her  that  day and  made  the house  call to her  the next  day.......they  appreciated  her business,  evidently  Jason  and  Meridian   Computer  didn't want or need  her business......shame  on you.
Very friendly staff and they're open till 10 o'clock. I'm on the lookout for the perfect mocha frappaccino. Gotta get my husband to try a latte...he's pretty specific though on what he likes too.

Glad we stopped by on our travels. Great food and atmosphere! The service was spot on, along with the excellent choice in music. Brought me back to my baggy jnco jeans and side-tilted hat days. Loved it. We will be stopping by again next time we are in town.

Meridian downtowns newest gastro pub.  I'm assuming it's Flat Breads latest restaurant changing it up from pizza.  Clean and modern, with dining on the patio.  Service and food both good, food was at a fair price.  Read some of the bad reviews we didn't experience any of this, I've been here twice.
They didn't do a good job on my nails. They began to chip and break almost from the beginning. I will never go back!!!! They are terrible.and dont waste your money.

We had a flywheel from an old Ford pickup we brought into Bobby's,  they did an excellent job, it looked brand new.  We know where we can go for our work in the future, and you should too.  They take care of their customers.  And they treat you right, thanks, Greg!

I needed to get the locks changed for a front door last minute and contacted James about getting it done ASAP. He replied immediately and we scheduled an appointment for only an hour later! He arrived early and began work right away. Great service, price, and turnaround time!
So good!! If you like ramen ....definitely come give this place a try!! Happy customer!!

I have had many dealings with Simmons over the years.  I know that jewelry is a very personal thing and it can also be intimidating. I have loved and enjoyed every piece I have gotten from them.  I have looked at other jewelry store and find the quality, workmanship, attention to detail to be very different at Simmons.  Meaning,  the quality is very high.  They guarantee the piece.  Every time I walk in, someone asks me for my jewelry and it looks brand new and clean when I get back a few minutes later and it has also been checked for loose diamonds or prongs wearing down.  

They actually observe you, listen to your story, pay close attention to what draws your eye and make recommendations on what they see suiting you.. My very own personal Jewelry shopper!  That is cool.  

They all dress professionally vs just got out of bed. Very classy store.  Personally, I have been treated well by everyone.  I will buy more jewelry from them.  The quality is always superior to what I have found in other stores.  You have many sales people and there is a personality to fit anyone.

I would recommend Simmons.

Sid's garage is a great concept that surpasses expectations at first impression and gradually falls to a disappointing experience. The staff are very friendly and helpful but not attentive at the right times. The appetizers were pretty good with the sweet potato fries undercooked and not at all crispy while the bacon was fantastic, especially with the sauce. The burger was meant to be medium rare and was very well done with pork belly that was sub-par. The milk shake we got was good but not as special as it looked and sounded. Overall, this spot is worth a visit but it was the most expensive restaurant I've been to in months and was not even worth $50, let alone the $75 it costed.

LOve this place!!! Talk about the Fastest and Best place to buy a car. The staff are ALL so great at what they do..... They make it so easy...Friendly and the Lobby is roomy and so clean...
It has been a long time since I had a Car this Nice and New.... I searched and searched and found a really great price on a Car I totally LOVE! I did the approval on-line, got a call not long after that I was approved and  that I could go in and GET MY CAR!!! I really could not believe it till they handed me the keys...
The car is Perfect, Beautiful and just what I wanted... They even held it for me till I could get in to sign the papers...  They washed the car and put a Big Bow on it... 
My payments are Low and so are the miles on the car.
The Whole experience was the best I have ever had at Buying a NEw CAr..... I now send everyone I know who is looking for a car to CarMax...
Thank You All so Much....  Tawnia......

Delicious pizza and huge slices! Really good cheese bread too. The only downside is that they never have any cheese bread ready. We always have to wait, and we always wait a lot longer than the time they give us.
Great coffee, atmosphere, fast WiFi, and friendly baristas.

Came in for lunch after wanting to eat here FOREVER! Let's start with the fact that the staff is super rad and helpful to newbies! They gave us recommendations which I always appreciate and we ended up with the buffalo chicken ranch cone and the classic pepperoni cone!
 
The Verdict? ABSURDLY GOOD! I may wind up on my 700 lb from this place alone and I'm okay with it. If you're in the neighborhood or live in friggin Maryland, either way, you NEED to try this place. This is last meal quality food here. 5 stars because there isn't an 'OH LAWD' button.
Great place and contrary to belief some standard products are cheeped then I can find at Fred Meyers!   Always fresh and great selection of cheese!

Ridiculously overpriced!! A basic chicken sandwich is $11 and it doesn't even come with fries. Beers are $7 and super small. You have to go to the counter to place your order and when you pay, it prompts you to leave a tip. Why would I leave a tip if I'm doing everything a waitress would do?? This place is overrated. I wouldn't go back.

Our order was 1.5 hours EARLY, and it didn't even include the right items! We called to try to fix it and they said we could either have our missing items delivered (like we paid to have done the first time??) OR a 30% discount on a future order. No thanks. The employees were nice but the managers had no desire to assist and deliver valuable customer service.
Don't waste your time or your money.
I love pizza, and pizza shaped as an ice cream cone? It's a must for me. Love coming here, lots of options for all pizza lover types.
Great Costco: plenty of parking, friendly staff, great store layout, many selections, not too crowded, and safe.
Loved the selection and set up of the store! The only downside was I felt like the used books were a little overpriced. Great atmosphere though!
Stopped here on our drive through idaho, super cute!  The servers were friendly and attentive but not invasive, and the ramen was yums.  Will definitely stop by again if we are in the area!

I have to say that the staff at the Franklin exceeded my expectations. Each an everyone of them are, friendly, courteous, and above all sincerely invested in doing what is right for the tenant. Anything I need is addressed in a timely fashion no matter how large or small, moreover; I am never treated as a bother

My favorite place to shop when I am in Boise; reminds of a cooler Whole Foods. Not only do I stock up on my groceries, but they have amazing hot food meals prepared for you. I love the shredded Beef burritos with spicy sauce. Great variety in kombuchas, healthy snack foods, and coffee.

The food wasn't bad. It was good. The problem was that, they were out of almost everything. We ordered a tater tot nacho app. They were out of tater tots. My wife ordered the meatloaf, they were out of that. A friend who was with us tried to order some broccoli as a side, guess what, no broccoli. The waitress, who was a loud and annoying woman was absolutely snotty to three different tables 2 of them being Hispanic people, and another an Asian couple. As soon as she heard any accent she loudly said "Here we go! It's going take forever to get this order in!"  Then she complained about them in an outdoor voice, like if they didn't speak perfect English they wouldn't know she was talking about them to another table! She loudly told us that the reason that they were out of stuff was because sales were down and corporate was limiting the amount they could order! If true I would say that wrong headedness is running rampant in the Denny's organization from the top to the bottom!

This post is long overdo from when we visited around the holidays BUT Oh my goodness - this place is a TREAT. My husband got fried chicken and waffles (DELICIOUS!) and I got a waffle with biscoff, raspberries and fresh whipped cream (Heaven on earth!). I love waffles and make a pretty exceptional one myself but this style waffle was unlike any I've ever tasted before... it was a bit more dense in texture but the flavor profile they created was on the money. Deliciously decadent. It's definitely a cheat meal but one well worth it.... if you're on the fence - TRY IT!! It really is worth experiencing and you'll thank me for the nudge... on another positive note, the staff/ service was lovely across the board. Look forward to having  a repeat visit!

I ordered the steak... it was delivered and I waited 4 min for a fork. The worse part it was my medium steak was wayy under cooked. 


1 star cool vide 
1 star Nice owner 
1 star cool greeted quickly

3 star review that's why.
Great food and service. We eat here a couple times a week because our 2 year old eats mandoo and rice like a champ! I love the kko kko bop!
I'm so glad I discovered this place! It's a new favorite. Delicious and great service and a fun, casual atmosphere. My kids love it too!

Elite Perk: Today finally tried a coned pizza. Wow...yummy. Love that it's easy to hold if your driving or walking. Store is way cute. My daughter and got to watch how the cones are made and then how toppings are added. Definitely going back. Thank you Coned for my yummy treat today!
This is my new favorite place ! I lived in japan for a while and this is as close to the motherland as it gets !

We tried Sid's Garage yesterday.  The food and service were amazing.  All prices are ala carte so it was a little pricey.  They are known for their milkshakes which are very yummy, but also a little expensive at $12.  I will definitely be a return customer.

Thank you for absolutely nothing and if this review can be 0 zeros I'd set it to that! ALSO please teach your employees not to throw gang signs at people. This is Idaho, where it's suppose to be a safe and welcoming state. We have kids, we are not interested in gangs or gang banging! SO UNPROFESSIONAL.

This is probably my favorite restaurant so far. I'm new to the area and have been here 3 times. Every time the food was delicious, service was great, and so was the music. I recently had the rosé slush (yum!) and the poke bowl (so fresh!). Our dinner and brunch experience was equally as phenomenal. Parking is plentiful, as well as the outdoor seating.
Super cute place! Yummy drinks & French Dip was great! We will be back

The food was ehh. Good concept but the waffles weren't that great. The portions aren't that big either. I can understand why people would like this place since there aren't many places that sell waffles besides the obvious IHOP and Denny's. You can definitely just make your own waffles at home. Save you the trip and money
Eight Thirty Common is our go to date night or brunch spot in Meridian! Food, drinks, and service always exceed expectations.

I finally got the opportunity to visit Reed's Dairy this weekend and I'm hoping they open more locations in the Boise are.  Ice Cream would be my main course for every meal in an ideal world so maybe it's a good thing for my waist line that it's not exactly convenient for me.  

The best thing about Reed's is that they keep things simple and delicious (similar to In-N-Out).  Considering that I have waited several months to visit I needed to try ALL THE THINGS!  We started with grilled ham and cheese (made with their cheese and butter) it paired perfectly with the tomato soup.  I will say that the grilled cheese has a sweeter taste to it but it was delicious and the soup was creamy and not too acidic.  I personally had a sugar cone with a single scoop of mint cookie ice cream.  Other people in our group ordered a root beer float and rocky road ice cream and then went back to order sandwiches after tasting ours.  The customer service was quick and the employees were friendly.

I'm a huge fan of their cooler full of ice creams packed to go, cheese curds, butter, eggs, and various milks.  Does anyone miss milk in the glass?  This is your place!  I took home a half gallon of chocolate milk and it is by far the BEST chocolate milk I've purchased.  My sandwich, soup, 2 ice cream cones and chocolate milk only cost around $13 which is very affordable in comparison to Cold Stone or Baskin Robbins... SUPPORT LOCAL!  

On a side note you can order their products online for home delivery :)

Stopped in for my first visit on the recommendation of my sister. Brandon was behind the counter and couldn't have been more welcoming. After trying the Jamaoca Fudge I was hooked.
I'll definitely be back again.

Stopped in today for the first time wow great place. I felt comfortable the lady working was extremely helpful and nice and the prices were great. I highly recommend stopping in and checking them out.

One and done! Ordered the buffet at 5PM on a Tuesday evening.
One chicken wing left under heat lamp, egg roll was not appealing to our taste buds, hot and sour  soup was bitter, and they serve a lot of fried foods.
My husband  liked the salad bar.
Two ice cream bins were empty.
$11.99 a piece for the buffet and very disappointing. 
We felt sorry for the servers they were so sweet and kind ladies!

Our first time there since the remodel & name change. We didn't eat, only had a few beers and had already ate.
The beer selection is much better than before. There were a few items on the menu I would like to try another time. We sat at the outside bar, had great service (thank you Kenedi), she also took care of other customers while being attentive to is.
We'll be back!

James did a great job on the door knob and lock at my home.  He was one of the first to reply on my service request, and was over in around 20 minutes.  He looked at what the issue was and went over Home Depot and took pictures to give me choices.  He finished the work with no issues.  I will not hesitate to use his services again.

Pizza is great.  Really good quality. Only knock is their service when they get busy. Seems like they are always "backed up" and I consistently end up waiting more than what they gave me.  Especially frustrating when I order ahead for a later time (as that should be easy to start the order in time to meet a pickup time beyond the expected wait).  The staff hasn't demonstrated a very customer appeasing attitude/stance in such instances.
I love Bella! All the staff is friendly and so helpful! Sue took her time and listened to everything I have going on. I love everything about this place!

Wow - what a place! Waffles every which way you can think of and lots more you probably never dreamed of. Truly they prove waffles are not just for breakfast anymore. No mater what the time of day, if you are close by you should stop in and get some waffles at Waffle Love.

Delicious and not expensive very mom and pop place to go for breakfast.
Everything was great including the service.

I was suffering from crippling panic attacks out of nowhere and decided I'd rather try hypnotherapy before trying medication and I'm so glad I did! Arlene is so sweet and genuine and after one visit, my panic attacks decreased dramatically.
