She gave me the recording of the hypnosis portion to listen to at home and it has been a great help in minimizing the panic attacks and making me feel more confident every day. I had really lost myself and the ability to enjoy and experience life and Arlene helped me be myself again. I highly recommend her for anyone feeling lost, depressed, or anxious. She can help retrain your subconscious instead of experimenting with a drug cocktail. It's safe, natural, and spiritual and I couldn't be a more satisfied customer!

The pizza is pretty good the problem is the wait time. I've been here three times and each time I've had to wait in the parking lot for 7 to 10 minutes for them to bring the food out. I get wanting a hot and fresh product but if you're going through a drive-through you expect to take your food and go. Especially when the menu is very small, and it during a busy time like lunch hour. They should be having pepperoni pizzas ready to go....

My mom visited from out of town. She read about the store closing right after it opened due to high demand and she insisted we visit. She's born and raised NJ (doesn't admit this often), now a world traveler having tried many places that claim to be "east coast style" and has always been let down. She said this place gets her approval! 
I have never been to the east coast, but I love me some pizza. I'm a fan as well!
Pretty good pizza for a fare price. Ordered 3 slices and wasn't disappointed. Wait time for a whole pizza was like 2hrs so I settled

Very fast and professional.  Thorough inspection of the car and regular communication with you while you wait in your car.  There system tells them what each car model needs in terms of lubricants and they'll provide you with reminders of the manufacturer's guidelines for radiator and transmission flushes, etc.  

Check the website before going in to see what additional services/upgrades they offer so you're prepared to purchase (or not).  They don't pressure you, but they do ask. 

I will definitely be back.

This is a nice occasional visit.  They have a good selection of waffle related options and the food is good.  I'll mention the parking is not great and they can get busy.  Try to shoot for an off time.  

It's important to note that the portions are not big and the price is pretty high.  Which is why I would say this is good for the occasional visit.  It's definitely not meant to be your usual breakfast haunt.  If you are looking to get a single waffle and a drink, you'll be looking at around 10 dollars.  So multiply that per person.  

Especially in the area, there aren't a lot of breakfast options.  I would recommend visiting it every now and then for something different.  Otherwise, traveling a little further for more general breakfast fare (and cheaper options) are probably a better bet.

Reviewer # 13
I really like Sonic. I don't really eat the food there, but the drinks and Ice Cream are awesome. 
There is no reason that I don't eat the food that often. When I think of Sonic I think of Ice Cream, Shakes and drinks. 

First off-- real fruit in your drinks! MMMM. My favorite is unsweetened tea with real pineapple and watermelon. The have thousands of combinations between flavors and fruits. 

The Ice Cream and shakes have many combinations, too. Visit happy hour 2-4 for 1/2 price drinks. 

This particular Sonic is friendly and fast. Take the survey on the receipt and get a free 44 oz drink!

My family and I were visiting from California and looking for some decent pizza....and OMG how lucky were we to find Tony G's?!?! This has to be the best pizza I have EVER eaten! We got the family special which I believe came with 2-3 pizzas and a side of 12 meatballs. Everything was out of this world. Even heating the pizza up the next day was delicious (which IMO is usually gross). We will be having Tony G's whenever we visit!! 5+ stars!!!

This spot is the worse! We were visiting from Washington and this makes me not want to go to any Denny's in Idaho!! We didn't get asked for water until we said something then they took over 30 minutes to serve our food! Very disappointed and we had kids with us as well never going here again!!  If I could this place doesn't get any stars from me!!!

Watch out they have nothing . Lol most of the stuff is not available. Like ice cream , most bread , chicken . Last time was here they didn't had straws . If you for pancakes, you are probably fine , anyways breakfast I think most of the stuff available but lunch and dinner- forget it .

We received a coupon for a free first time oil change. Indeed it was free with the exception of Idaho State tax. The guys were professional and the process was simple. I was informed of upcoming maintenance base on manufacturers suggested guidelines, and then given the final bill for payment. 

They offer a good size waiting room with water, coffee, and TV. It was clean and perfect for the short wait. I will definitely give them another go.

I have known Arlene for over 2 years.  I have not had the pleasure of experiencing her work, but I can vouch for her comittment to life and her work.  

She is a person of  high integity, she cares deeply and is willing to go the extra mile to get her clients what they need.  R.K.  (LCSW)

As far as car buying and selling goes Carmax makes it as smooth as possible. This is a new location (2016) and extremely clean and nice insidI sold a vehicle this time around and even with the vehicle inspection it only took an hour from when I arrived until when I signed over the title and got the bank draft. I was offered a fair price for the vehicle. I wasn't pressure by the associate (James) or the business office manager (Trudy) which makes it less stressful. In fact, they were very helpful and nice to me. 

There is no negotiating on the price which makes the process quicker overall. I know they will make a little money when they put it on their lot and sell it, but that is their job. And I'm confident the next buyer will be happy with the low mileage Toyota I sold them today. 

03/26/2018: came back and sold my new/barely used Honda Civic Si. Someone will soon be buying a great vehicle and CarMax paid me a fair price too which makes me happy. 

Again, a very easy "car selling" process and I worked with Michelle this time in the business office. She was very professional and knew the car selling process well. In addition, she was very personable while we waited for payoff information. I highly recommend her if she is working that day.

We came here for lunch, and the Caesar wrap was delicious! The kids meals were all a bit dry/over done, but they did OK with lots of ketchup. I think it would be nice if they included a small yogurt in the kids meal package, since that's their main thing. We paid about $40 for our family of 5. And that was without any dessert.

This is one of the best ramen places in the area, if not the best. Give it a try, you won't be disappointed! The bowl is super authentic. Waiters are friendly and to add to the ambiance they play authentic Asian music videos. If you forget about your surroundings you'd think you were in a Japanese ramen house.

This restaurant genuinely surprised me! I've had some good burgers, so I didn't have high expectations, but Sids delivered! 
We ordered the truffle parmesan fries and the mac and cheese as an appetizer. The fries could definitely use more truffle flavor (it was sadly very faint) and I just moved here from the south, so the mac and cheese had a lot to live up to...it didn't rock my world, but was still good.
But the burgers were AMAZING!!! I got the 'Not so Whimpie' and my husband got the 'The Hangover'. I literally wouldn't change anything on the burger that I got...the flavors were fantastic and the textures were perfectly complimentary! I would eat it again and again. My husband finished his so fast that I didn't get a taste, but he said its one of the best burgers he's ever had and we've eaten burgers all over the country!
Great job, Sids...keep it up!

Fantastic! Our burgers were cooked to perfection and were some of the best that we have ever had. Truly. Juicy, delicious sauce, jalapeño bacon, perfect bun. We also had an amazing shake! On top of the great food was amazing service! The owner was there and was friendly, helpful, and enthusiastic about great service! Go here and get an awesome meal while supporting a fantastic small business!

They were so rude and so unclean!!

I was super excited to get some fun summer nails done. The lady treated me like production line. She didnt even trim my nails. 
She kept asking me to cross my hands over one another to dry the gel. It made no sense and I was super uncomfortable. She kept having conversations with her fellow worker in their foreign language and laughing. I asked her what was so funny, in conversation, and she laughed at me. She didn't have me dry the gel long enough so it all peeled right away. And she left at least a two week grow to start with. She told me to make sure not pick because they would peel up. WT?   I have never had such poor costumer service.  The nails were cute for a day but I will never return here. Not to mention I think they should get a visit from the health inspector. She didn't clean anything inbtwn people.

They over-sell their service. Sure, the windows end up clean but they try to tell senior citizens that they ought to have their windows cleaned once a month. It would be better if they did the job and asked if they can call you in a few months to see if you want the windows cleaned again.

Excellent ice cream , milk and eggs. We love their idsho honey as well. We are return customers every week snd really love this gem. The young adults tat serve you are usually good, but occasional we encounter one that is less professional than the others, horsing around.

We saw this place and thought we'd give it a shot. We thought, "Drive thru pizza has got to be inventive and fun, right?" To be honest, now, I'm not sure why the drive thru is an option. They took our order at the window, told us it would be over an hour. So we cancelled that order and just got slices. We tried to order a Sausage slice, which was a menu option and came with mushroom and pepperoni. The cashier seemed confused and asked if we just wanted cheese and sausage, so we said whatever. We're hungry, that's fine. After paying, too much might I add, for the slices they told us there was a wait on the cheese? Not sure what that meant but we waited. Finally the food came and it was so greasy we had to pat it down, and not as large as they said they would be. Flavors were anything special, either. They could definitely improve on their signage for drive through and waiting areas, menu clarity (maybe don't name the slices the same as multi-topping pizzas?), and over all guidance. We were very confused going in and were more confused leaving. Do we need to call ahead for a whole pizza? If so why put it on the drive thru menu? I think there's room for improvement for sure here. Not our first choice to get pizza.

Always friendly and does an amazing job on manicures, pedicures and gel nails. I look forward to going to get my nail fill because it is such a warm environment.  I highly suggest if you are looking for a great nail salon!

Beautiful place and everyone was very nice and friendly. Went in for a pedicure. My technician was actually a stylist. So that being said, it seemed there was a lack of skill. Unfortunately My last color shows through because it was not removed correctly or completely. I would give it another try but with a nail technician.

Wow I spent $35.00 for a hand wash of my truck. What a joke, they don't even clean the windshield. Did not clean the wheels, windows and failed to wash the center section of the hood. It's a rip off at this location, the guy was more worried about getting his paperwork. He didn't give a shit about doing a good job. They don't deserve the one star. We have a fleet of trucks and will cancel future business.

Trying to be socially responsible, I set about looking for a jeweler that had Canadian diamonds. All of the associates at Simmons were helpful. They answered all of my questions and were very understanding of what I was after. And now, confession time: I did not want any diamonds from the big diamond monopoly that shall remain nameless but you all know who I'm referring to. I was not about to support their horrible treatment of the diamond minors. Man, did I get an education. I was given all kinds of information on how the diamond industry has changed their ways. How they're giving back to the communities that are affected by what they do. And how they support women and education around the world. I still didn't buy from the biggest company, I chose an American mom and pop company instead. I love the end result of my purchase. The associates were fabulous and knowledgeable! Not that I buy a lot of jewelry but this will be my place from now on. And I'll tell all my friends not only about how great Simmons is but everything I learned about diamonds!

Needed my exhaust system diagnosed and fixed so I could get my 1991 Toyota pickup emission tested.  Meineke got me in right away (same day) found a hole in my pipe, welded on a patch and I was good to go.  Total bill was $58.  Friendly, fast and fair...fantastic!
Insane local wagyu / black angus blend! Juiciest burger with toppings to rival the best restaurants! Just go you won't be disappointed... unless your looking for boring chain food.

We recently went to tcby Silverstone and ordered a quart of yogurt.  The person taking the order said they were out of quart containers and they would give it to us in three containers equal to a quart.   Instead of charging 6.49 for a quart we were charged $9.  What crummy service.

This pizza establishment has some of the best pizza I've ever had and top notch customer service.

On National Pizza Day we ordered by phone and were quoted about an hour wait. We showed up to pick up our pizza and ended up waiting an additional 45 minutes.

Despite waiting an extensive amount of time, several of the team members were very apologetic and made the situation right.

Highly recommended and will definitely keep coming back!

I had the most horrific experience here. It's a beautiful place, but the rental price is beyond greedy!  I was considering a space that was like 800 square feet and then rental price surged upwards after Krista saw my savings account amount. Besides the price gouging, the insincere affect of the management team adds a level of distrust that deterred me from moving into this place. Be advised -- stay away!


@FranklinManagementTeam: thanks for the generic comment, but when more than half of your reviews are 1-star, then maybe you should spend time undergoing customer service workshops and enhance your true transparency instead of cloaking "how wonderful you are."

Took my brother and his friend over for some ramen and man were we in for a treat! The eggs were done right and it was down right delicious along with the pork belly. Great flavor all-round. The people there were nice and polite with us. I will definitely come back to this place for more ramen!

Best breakfast I've found locally, chicken fried steak cooked perfectly, best hashbrowns ever! Substituted a pancake for the biscuit and gravy perfect meal could not finish it. As you can see the over easy eggs are cooked to perfection. They definitely care about quality here, I've heard the rumors and I now believe it! Clean restaurant and very friendly staffed, if there's a weight it's well worth it.

Just moved to Meridian and was craving beef. Ordered the Seared Beef Salad and Cast Iron Berry Cobbler to go. The place was pretty crowded and it was the first time I was in a restaurant since COVID hit. The salad was really good - good size serving of steak. The balsamic onion jam gives the salad a great flavor, but the bleu cheese was skimpy. Got two small containers of bleu cheese dressing - one was watery 'I don't know what'. The cobbler was so sour, just couldn't eat it, even though it came with a scoop of ice cream. I'd definitely go back for the salad.

Traci did a great job.  Very professional.  I felt an immediate difference walking around the store in the trial orthotics.  Still not over the sticker shock.  Time will tell whether $1200 for six pieces of plastic is justified.  If I understand correctly, I purchased 3 sets of orthotics, but I'm supposed to arrive at the point where I'm wearing only one of the three sets 100% of the time.  Hoping they'll let me trade in the others for another pair or two of the full time orthotics so I'm not having to transfer them from shoe to shoe.

Visit the Breakaway for happy hour.  You can't beat hh prices for beer and cocktails.  And you really can't beat taco Tuesday's.  $1.00 tacos, fish, pork, beef.  All delicious.  For a buck each.  You'll be happy.

Took my son and daughter here today. Horrible service. You wouldn't have lost us if you'd have just made sure my coffee was full. The guy was filling all the coffee cups around us, just not mine. Also, the same server called my 15 year old daughter "Mom" assuming my two year old son was hers... (6ft male, brown hair, glasses) Dude, you're a complete imbecile. Too bad because this place came recommended by friends who live here locally... Go down the street to MoJos if you want great service and food

The pizza is pretty good the problem is the wait time. I've been here three times and each time I've had to wait in the parking lot for 7 to 10 minutes for them to bring the food out. I get wanting a hot and fresh product but if you're going through a drive-through you expect to take your food and go. Especially when the menu is very small, enit during a busy time like lunch hour. They should be having pepperoni pizzas ready to go....update: I went again to order a whole pie. 1 hour wait....nothing has changed

The fact that this is inside of the village cinema makes it easy to have dinner and a movie. The Bistro is nice and a change to regular dining experiences. It is spendy though for what you get but they also serve you in the 21 up area of the theater its attached to. 

I do recomend this place if you are running short on time to eat before a movie, or if you are at the theater and want to order their food to be delivered to your seat.
The place is small so if you go at busy times, you will probably wait. BUT, it is worth the wait. I had the Tonkoysu and it was spectacular!  You will love this place.

Prefer trader joe's or the downtown boise co-op. Couple cool employees here that have me adding on a star. Having been said, assistant  manager "Ruth" can't keep her mask above her nose or even her mouth. Heard her talk about how masks are "stupid."

These are not your run of the mill waffle. These things will expand your definition of what a waffle can be from every aspect. Yeast in the waffle? Check. Blueberry lime sauce with whipped cream? Check. Take-out waffles that stay amazing even as they cool? Check. 

The waffles will look small to your American-portion-size eyes. They did to mine anyway. But these things are dense, and I'm stuffed. Give this place a try as soon as you can.

Cebtury link is a terrible ISP. They throttle speeds, have massive problems with user security (leek user info for $$) they have constant drops and outages that have lasted as long as several days. From what I hear they treat their workers awful as well. Century link is hot garbage literally the worst ever but it's the only ISP that provides unlimited data where I live. So I'm stuck until I move. Total trash company only reason they have customers is because they run a monopoly.
Nadia in appliances is fantastic!!!  She needs a raise!!!!  Helped us save $300 on appliances, & got us set up & out of there in no time.  Went the extra mile to help us find just what we needed.
Thank you for another wonderful experience getting a gel manicure!  I have come by every 2 weeks for the past 5 months and am never disappointed!

We come here often after sports practices. I ordered the feast that comes with lemonade and cookies. Once I got my food I asked the lady at the window of the gravy was in there twice and she said yes. I got home and no gravy. I called and Chris told me to come down and he would make it right. My husband gets there and a bunch of employees are in the back doing a training and eating around food being prepared for customers (huge osha violation). He gives my husband the gravy and says he threw in cookies for inconvenience. When he gets home I let him know that we never even received the cookies that came with the meal. We drove 15 miles back just to get the gravy. 

Trainings should be done when you are closed! We won't be returning. I always give a place 2 times of mistakes and it's not worth it when there are many places out there that take very good care of you and appreciate your business.

Love the Co-Op! "Everyone" is always kind and friendly, I ask how they are doing , check in on them... This is an awesome establishment that works with - and helps local growers, I LOVE the community atmosphere, the small town feel as our cities keep growing bigger and bigger; This place is a gem !

I will say , what I see more of is the negativity from patrons, no appreciation for the hard work or true value of humanity  for our Co-op family.. This is disturbing, I was not like this a couple of years ago ,.. Work on positive resolutions to any disturbance or possible offence, we are all just trying to get through these past couple of strange and difficult years... SPREAD SOME GOOD CHEER AND LEARN THE MEANING OF THE IDAHO WAVE !
Just had an amazing experience first time trying and just blown away. A sandwich that is actually matches the name (hot chicken sandwich)  I would highly recommend it. Definitely coming back!

I paid for interior super clean which includes the  ultra supreme wash, $49.95, (irst extra for a mini van). They didn't wash my interior rubber mats or even vacuum thoroughly. When I asked why the mats weren't cleaned, they took them out and washed them but they still didn't look very clean. Feels like a lot of money for not a great clean

Horrible management. Whenever we have gone to management with a problem they act like we are bothering them. Or laugh at us. I have tried to call them in the office when I know they are there and they don't answer the phone. I have gone in after several unanswered calls and found two office staff and the two maintenance people sitting around talking. When I walked in they visibly appeared annoyed. I also had to go in to get a package that was about 10 minutes before closing and they were locking up and hustling out and pretended not to see me. I would think an apartment complex that claims to be "upscale" living would hire more professional staff. I wouldn't recommend this place to anyone!

Went back to Sids on this 100+ day more for the shake.  We had the Fat Elvis shake with strawberry ice cream, peanut butter on the outside and captain crunch with an entire strawberry crunch ice cream bar on top.  Now, I am an ice cream junky..and this hit my sweet spot.  We followed it up with the Truffle & parmesan fries that had great flavor and more then enough for a party of 4.  Next, the El Jeffe burger with sweet corn, cojita cheese and  lime wedge. Burger was super tender & seasoning was super spicy; corn was dry and wish it had a slaw or tomato to cool my mouth...oh wait I still had some milk shake left.  Too loud for conversation but a great experience for an endulging meal but you have to try a shake!

It's a new place and clean. Food is okay not grate as fare as Korean BBQ goes I have no idea. Spicey is good but for the most part it's just rice and garbage and some meat. Don't think it will keep me form coming back.

Good show Ramen Sho! I'll be coming back fo sho! 

Menu- simple is best, the fewer items, the easier it is to perfect the dishes and these menus are quite simple, one page front and back with mains (ramen, because you know..... it's a ramen house), and a few sides. My wife and kiddos were excited to eat here so we ended up ordering quite a few sides. 

Food- Absolutely delicious! Like everything was really good. The dishes were simple but very tasty and filling. Ramen bowls were generously portioned, I'm a fairly big eater and I barely made it through mine. In the end, we came home with a small box of chicken and rice left over from the kids. 

Service- prompt and friendly. No complaints there. 

Restaurant- sparse, but comfortable. 

Overall- No complaints from my family! We look forward to coming back!

I had Meridian Plumbing come out and give me an estimate on my dripping roman tub faucet. I live in a single wide manufactured home and the guy wanted to break apart my tub tile and rebuild it since there was no access panel.  He quoted me $6,000, which was ridiculous. I went to Veterans Plumbing and they did the job for $780 without having to break out the tile and rebuild the wall; instead they accessed it under the house to get the job done, and I now have a beautiful new faucet. They didn't gouge me the way Meridian Plumbing tried to.
Great food and extremely hospitable. I don't believe we saw a single person walk in or out without being greeted or appreciated. Would highly recommend.

No masks when they're inside your car.
There was one kid doing an awesome job wiping down the car (skinny, 5 foot, shaggy hair) , the rest were more interested in chatting about dating life with lazy work and it showed.. 
There are hard water stains on the outside of my windshield that annoys the hell out me in certain driving situations. 
I had to ask them to wipe my dash and re-wipe my windshield because of the waxy streaks left. 
I was there for AN HOUR on a tuesday afternoon. 
They no longer offer a scent for your car.

Great service, friendly and fast response. He was super fast and professional. Best prices I could find, lots of places charge fee's once they are there or take a long time to get to you. Will definitely recommend them and they are 24/7. Saved the day

So I have been in pain from poor support with my feet. I have tried so many different insoles and nothing has worked. Everyone has told me about the Good Feet Store. I have put it off for a long time, thinking my pain would be corrected on its own. But it has not and is affecting my work. 

So today, I took time to go into the store and see what all the praise was about. I went inside and was greeted by an employee. He asked what brought me into the store. I told him my issues and he had me sit and wait for Tracie who came about 2 minutes later. She offered me water and told me to explain what brings me in. So I told her about my pain and I want it gone. 

So after about 30 mins of her talking, showing me the products and having me field test them in the store, she told me that for all of this ( three different insoles and a life time warranty) that it would be $1200 dollars......

I do not know about you, but I don't have $1200 dollars just laying around. I was speechless and she knew it. I told her that I cannot afford that. She asked how my credit was... again.. my credit is not the best. Then she asked what price range I was expecting. I told her that I just wanted some insoles so I could put into my boots for work to lower my pain. I told her that I was expecting to pay around $50-60 for good reliable insoles. 

Tracie told me they have two different types of insoles they sell for $149 and $199. I still was pretty hesitant on paying that much for insoles but worth a shot. I tried out the $149 pair and they were much better then what I was using before. 

So she goes over to ring everything up and calls me over. She tells me the total is $191 and change. I look at the receipt and see that there was a charge for $32 for a Odor free insole that goes through the shoe. The $149 just goes past the arch. But what pissed me off is that she didn't explain it was $32 dollars or anything. She just added it in. It just bothered me she didn't explain the charges. 

I will update this review in a week to let you know if these $149 insoles worked for me.
not what I asked for, crooked nails, each nail is a different shape, all slightly slanted. it's bad and I'm angry. 10 out of 10 would NOT recommend. waste of money.
Great pizza the other night. The calzone was ok not great. The pizza was the best that we have had in Idaho son d we got here.

I went here yesterday at about 1 pm to enjoy some frozen yogurt I've been craving. This was my first time in this store.  when I walked in there was no employee in sight.  I ran the bell on the counter n waited ..... no response.  I ran the bell again and waited. Again no response. The store was completely silent so it wasn't like employee was in back area. There was only three flavors of soft serve available and I would have no idea how it tasted because I never saw an employee and finally just left.
Oh man this pizza is awesome. We got the mango habanero and it is amazing. For being a new restaurant they are getting all the bugs work out and they're doing a great job.

Our family was disappointed. We ate Sonic cheeseburgers, which are usually good. They tasted like they were reheated and not fresh. Very dry (with only mustard). We ate because we were hungry and in a rush. As we were leaving, I made a comment through the speaker to one of the servers who was inside. I let her know our burgers were dry, and not good. We asked her to tell the cooks. Her response was, "Okay, thanks for telling me."

Chaney is a great server!!
Loved the place!
Hands down the best milkshakes and their truffle fries were bomb! I definitely need to try their burgers next time, but the chicken sandwich was delicious!!

Omg this burger was sooo good! My husband and I split the Boss Hog burger because they are half pound burgers but I think with the toppings they probably weigh a pound! The patties are top grade local meat and very flavorful! If you like a high quality burger then this is where you will find the best tasting flavor filled burgers. The fries are really good too even though Shoestring fries are not my favorite! Overall excellent
First time here!  It was awesome!  Very unique and fun idea to eat your pizza in a cone!  It did not disappoint! Emily was awesome, friendly and fast!

Small place with very good ramen soups. Good broth and very good pork belly, tender and rich in flavor. If you want it spicy they've  got options. I loved the Curry ramen, yummy! A surprise was Takoyaki appetizer which is hard to find. Basically octopus dumplings, a Japanese specialty that's really delicious. They're worth trying. Good cold sake too!

I died and went to heaven. My husband and I had their "not so whimpie" burger tonight and it was probably one of the best burgers of my life. So flavorful and they were very accommodating with making my burger lettuce wrapped and gluten-free because I have celiac. My husband also got the loco fries along with his burger and they "taste like crack" they are so good. Highly recommend and we will be back

Just love jiffy lube!  These guys noticed that I had changed my oils 1500 miles ago, so being honest they told me I didn't need it now.  I'm just a spaz about clean oil and I drive all over the country so I was getting ready for another trip and wanted it changed.  I just really appreciate the great job they do and the honesty!

I'll always be loyal to them.
Thanks Jiffy!
Jan Welch

This dry cleaner is pretty savvy when it comes to uniforms. I am grateful that their experience here is outstanding, and you get A+ service right away. Being in the service I like my uniforms cared for and after using the service here I am not complaining one bit.

Loved it! The huckleberry pancakes and stuffed French toast are certainly favorites jere, and for good reason. I had the huckleberry French toast and was very pleased. It sure didn't last long! Delicious cream cheese filling on the inside, amazing huckleberry sauce and berries on top. Coupled with eggs and a side of gravy, and I was ready to go for the day!
These guys are the best! Got my iPhone battery replaced and fixed for the best price in town.

This place was great. I was little sceptic, but trusted the reviews that people left on Yelp. I ordered the spicy something, not the spicy miso, and it was perfect. The broth, noodles, toppings, and service were spot on. Will defiantly go back.

I got my arch training inserts 4 years ago, when I almost couldn't walk because of heel pain. They not only are the reason I can walk, they also reduced my back pain (fractured spine) significantly. Returns are so easy! They really take care of you. They are worth every penny.

Had been following them in IG for a while, and finally made it for brunch... and I'm glad I did! 
The grilled cheese and tomato bisque was a great combo. Separately, they were both really good, but I'm a big kid at heart, so I use my soup as a dipping sauce for the sammy, and damn was it fantastic! 
And since I'm a big boy with a big boy appetite, I also tried the Sunshine, with raspberries & lemon curd & creme... oh my gawd it was amazing. this is such a delicious combination. 
The lobby is clean, and inviting. If I remember right, they had some really good tunes playing (sorry, I'm stuck thinking about the waffles as I type this). The staff was super friendly, and they all seemed to be busy and working hard. 
In short, this place is pretty dope. Great food. Great customer service. Totally going back.

I've submitted an order for a six pack of brews, two types, three 12 oz bottles of each type [Deschutes], to be shipped to me.  Small order, easy to fill right?  Nope.  So Brewforia did take my money, and an email was generated to let me know a shipping label has been produced however, no shipping event has occurred. Recount of events:
1.  Jul 17, 2013 - Order placed, brewforia took my money and issued a receipt.
2. Jul 17, 2013 - brewforia sent notification of having created a shipping label with UPS.
3. As of Jul 26, 2013 the shipment has not been dropped off to UPS.
4. July 22 to 26 2013, have called brewforia customer service multiple times, no one answers the phone, there is no voicemail.
5. July 22 to 26 2013, have emailed Brewforia customer service and an individual email I happened to have from my receipt, no one has responded.
6. July 22 to 26 2013, submitted a communication to Brewforia over their official form on their website.  Have not heard a word from Brewforia.

Was really looking forward to these brews as I can't get them here.  Becoming disappointed and frustrated with Brewforia.  Brewforia certainly should not charge my credit card until they have shipped my order.  

Also, a little frustrated with Deschutes Brewery as they recommend on their website to use brewforia for ordering their beer online [to be shipped].

Great place to stop in for a craft beer on tap or to go.  Their food menu changes a few times a year and their tap selections change throughout the day as one keg blows and they try a different one.  Hint, if you like it - drink it - as it may not be there tomorrow.

I'm a regular there, in fact I'm there every morning and gotta say that most of the time when I pull up to the front my drink is all ready made and waiting for me as soon as I walk in. The employees there are great, never had a problem.

Nice people and fun atmosphere, but the music was so loud the waitress had to shout the menu options to us. Then again, the cashier called me "dear", so maybe I'm just old. 

The loco elote dog was super spicy. The elote was good - the grilled bun was tasty, but the chorizo was dry and too spicy for my taste. One of my friends had the hangover burger. He called it the "oil change burger" due to the pool of grease on the tray. The loco fries were good - nice and crispy!

Great experience buying an RV. Brian Vetter was my salesman and I would recommend him to anyone not looking for a pushy order taker (if you are shopping for an RV locally, you know the clowns I'm talking about).  Brian was patient, spent a lot of time helping evaluate our needs, and recommended the perfect rig. He is an RV expert. 
The shop reviewed the rig pre delivery and found a couple of items that needed repair, taken care of. The purchase process was a good experience and Efram in finance was also really good to work with. 
I highly recommend Brian and the crew at Camping World Meridian for your next RV/camper purchase.

We love the idea behind a Waffle only place & the food was amazing!! We would definitely go back again! 
Only down side is we would have loved a mimosa or Bloody Mary with our breakfast.

Always great customer service and ice cream. 
They carry milk, eggs, cheese, butter on top of ice cream.

I went here for my 1st oil change in Meridian. Customer Service was wonderful and quick. Everyone was very helpful and friendly. They don't heavy up sell you.  You are given options and it's your choice on what you select after everything is explained.  This is now our family's now "go to" spot for oil changes!
Top notch service and great prices! And they stock loads of 10mm ammo that I can't find anywhere!
Clayton is the absolute best. I have had my lashes done for years and I LOVE his work. He is also such a nice guy. Try him I know you will be so happy!

" that wasn't just a meal... That was an experience!" -out from out of town! Katie Emily and Norma are incredible! This is my sixth time here and every single time I'm absolutely amazed! I can't seem to get away from the Maui Wowie burger! However this time I tried Jekyll and hide! But everyone who We be in here always shares with me so I've had a bite of just about everything! Also been served by Veronica-so awesome! Their hospitality impressed my very picky mother to the point of her thinking she could move to Idaho! She loves it here!

Was really excited to try this place however when we walked in at 7:45 pm we were told we could not order anything even if it was to go because they close at 8:00pm. I'll make sure none of my friends or family go here. Don't waste your time.

Update after owner reply. 

There were two tables eating inside when we walked in at 7:45. The waiter came to the door and told us to leave because they close at 8:00.

I posted the first review on Facebook after leaving at 7:50 and being seated at another nearby restaurant. If you view the time stamp on the Facebook review you will see it was even posted before 8:00PM.

Last and final update, after emailing the business owner as requested, they did nothing but try to blame me for what happened. How is it my fault that your staff told me they could not serve my family before they even closed? 

Absolutely unprofessional! 

Take your business elsewhere. This is not a business we want to keep in the treasure valley.
Excellent food and libations. New to the area, found this place and had a great experience. Staff was friendly, accommodating, & professional. Will definitely return.

Has good reviews based on completed projects, yet very unprofessional with time/estimates. That's why he is getting 1 star, we had a schedule meeting for 3pm texted him 30 min prior to confirm. Later called him no answer, I finally get a text saying he can meet in a couple of hours or tomorrow. Again he responded 1 hr and 30 min later to be exact. Everyone's time is important and valuable and that needs to be respected. Don't waist my time.

I'll admit it: I'm a pizza snob. Friends I grew up with still rave about Keystone Pizza, which had several outlets in the Treasure Valley in the 1970s. Their only redeeming factor was they were cheap: They rotated $5 large pepperoni   and Canadian bacon and pineapple pizzas every month. They were great for a 20-year-old's budget but not much else.

So I was skeptical when I heard a California company had opened a pizza joint at the Crave ghost kitchen. But as I researched the company and owner Tony Gemignani, I learned he was the real deal.

We learned that his San Francisco restaurant, in the heart of the city's Italian neighborhood, North Beach, features gas, electric and coal-fired ovens, with different menus for each. Coal is old-school East Coast. 

I ordered the 13-inch Wiseguy NY pizza, with pepperoni and calabrese sausage. It was the best pizza I've had in the Treasure Valley, though still behind Apizza Scholls in Portland. But still top of the line.
Typical sonic. Great service at this location. Great happy hour specials on strawberry lemonade (my favorite) as well as countless other drink refreshments.
Had this at their food truck and it was sooo delicious!! Very salty but that is what make it good, right? I can't wait to bring my family back!
Delicious, unique pizza experience! Food was great and the staff was friendly. Will definitely be back!

We had planned to go to Yogurtz for my daughter's birthday only to arrive to their kitchen being closed. The cook said he had to shut down the kitchen because they didn't have  enough people to work as someone had called out. What?! Who owns this place?? How disappointing.

Not a bad place at all, but not the best in town. Only reason I came here was because Moe Joe's down the street had a 40 minute wait, while this place had no wait. Atmosphere / interior vibe inside is alright, can get a little loud at times, definitely not as cozy as Moe Joe's (IMO).

Although there was no wait time, the service was slow, specifically when waiting for the food. The waitress and the younger guy we had serving us drinks & food were very nice and friendly. 

The food was alright, portions were kind of small for the price, and I wish they served country style potatoes rather than shredded hash browns, since the hashbrowns felt a little too greasy / rich after you ate them. One specialty item I ordered was the Blueberry pancakes (specialty because they only serve them on Sundays), and they were pretty good, although I wish they were served with some kind of blueberry or mixed berry type of syrup rather than maple (or maybe I had to request that?) and with built in walnuts or some other kind of nuts. 

I think the part I enjoyed most here was their cappuccino and latte (ordered both to compare). Still doesn't compare to the Konditorei Restaurant in Sun Valley OR Flying M Coffee Garage in Nampa, but the cappuccino here was kinda up there IMO. Also, the friendliness of the people here was one of the bigger pros for me.

An area of improvement that would be nice to see is the reduced wait time for the food. Made me question if the no wait time for seating but the long wait time for food was even faster than just sitting it out in Moe Joes.

Overall, can't give this place a 3 since in reality this place wasn't bad at all and I don't think that's fair, but can't give this place a 5 either, since I'm kind of stingy when giving out 5s. However, adding up the friendly service, the really good cappuccino, the pretty good blueberry pancakes, and the no wait time to sit, it's a 4. Just isn't a place that stood out to me, which kind of resulted in this semi uninspired review. Will I come back here, probably, but Moe Joe's is still the go to place in town (IMO), although the wait time recently on weekends is kinda getting annoying.

I don't usually post a negative review but I felt this was much needed. So it was a Tuesday evening about 8:30pm. We were seated and the first thing we noticed was the crappy music. It was hip hoppy and was too loud. Our server was new to the job.  Her second day so I will extend grace.  She did better than I will have. We asked later if something could be done about the music.  We were told no.  The second thing that drove me crazy was when we could hear the staff loudly talking about hair and make up. This was not a good dining experience.  I won't be back.

This is the best massage in town, it also happens to be quite a deal.  Get the stone massage if you have no issues with being naked (covered with towel) otherwise go with the foot massage.  

I've never been able to do a walk in appointment here, so plan accordingly.  The only downside for me at least is the massage chair is too high when I'm getting a foot massage.  I'm 5'4" and recommend asking for a stool under the soaking tub to avoid lower back strain.

Parker (assistant Manager) is a top notch employee at this Home Depot. We ordered an artificial Christmas tree online for pick up in store. It was literally the only tree we could agree on, so fast forward to showing up at the store...........and you guessed it, no one can find our tree/order. After 2 employees try to find it, in comes Parker (the peace keeper). Parker was set on finding our tree for us, as his search went on and the potential of finding our tree started to diminish, it was obvious how bad he felt. When there were no other local stores carrying the tree and no shipping options available, it started to look dire. But Parker made one last attempt to find our tree and a miracle occurred- he found it! Probably in some dark and dingy room, way far in the back. But none the less, he found it. Even at 8pm on a Wednesday, Parker never lost sight of providing amazing customer service and I have no doubt that even if he wasn't able to find it, he would have done everything he could to make it right. It's nice to come across a gem of an employee like Parker who understands and appreciates good customer service. 

Parker saved our Christmas!

Exceptional 5 star service! I stopped by Einstein's Oilery on 11/27/18 to get the "noble" oil change service.  I arrived around 4:45. As I pulled up I was immediately greeted by Austin, my service writer.  Austin asked if I had ever been in before and since I had not, he explained the process to me. 
He then had me pull into the service bay and offered mr today's newspaper, a Kindle, & something to drink.  As Austin went to grab my drink, I met Chris. He asked if I wanted regular or synthetic oil and then they went to work.  It was pretty cool. They checked everything! My lights, tire pressure, fluid levels, etc. They cheerfully communicated necessary information to one another in a very fun way. Think Chick Fil A and Dutch Bros had a baby! Lol. That's what they were like.  
I was done before 5:15! I was so impressed by these guys! Top notch service and work! I will never go back to the old way of getting my oil changed!

I find everyone to be very helpful, especially in paint center. I was there yesterday and a woman and older gentleman were so knowledgeable. The women went over and above to help me out. I will always get my paint there now because of them.
Really annoying when they don't honor their own coupons that don't have an expiration date. Topping were stale.. fruit was nasty. Watermelon fro yo tasted like mold. I won't be back that's for sure!

Go thru the drive thru today to order a strawberry açaí. Place my order and get to the window To get told we can't make it with light ice and light water, the Açaí cost too much is what the employee said to us. Well I'm not paying you for water!! Every other location has made it the way I've ask for it. Will never return to this location. Plus the Employee got all pissy when I canceled the order after they told me that. Absolutely horrible customer service

So the dog in the pic seemed like this was a promising lock smith and it totally was. Not only he was local, he was fast, efficient and reasonable in his pricing compare to other places which was too overpriced. 11 out of 10 would recommend! Thank you again
The chicken i got tasted great and the man at the window, Jay was the nicest man I had ever met, he was so kind and asked if I was from out of town and I felt welcome, he was pretty cute too

My wife and I went to Camping World In Meridian, Idaho again today (8/1/2017).
We have been there several times for items for our 5th Wheel which we purchased elsewhere after reading all the negative reviews from people who have purchased RV's from Camping World.  Now I understand completely why the reviews are so negative!!!
Again today, like EVERY other time we have visited the store, there were at least three people sitting at the front counter and not one of them said "hello", "welcome" or "can we help you".  We went to the parts counter and asked for a small part we needed for our RV and were treated as though we were an imposition rather than a paying customer.
I cannot believe the lack of customer service at this location.  The only place in the store where we were even acknowledged was at the the check out, where the young lady was VERY eager to "UP SELL" us on our Good Sam Membership.
Another thing we noticed when we were browsing the retail store is the transformation from an RV parts store to a pet supply store!  At least one third of the retail floor is now covered with pet supplies and dog food.  When we asked about it, the girl at the check out laughed and said "ya...the CEO just purchased a pet supply company".  Sounds like the company CEO Marcus Lemonis is using Camping World to introduce his new pet supply business rather than building a more reputable and customer oriented RV supply store.  How about a better selection of RV supplies?  Who wants to buy dog food at the RV store????
On our way out the door, it happened again (or should I say, didn't happen again) not one person said goodbye, thank you, come again....NOTHING!!!  Two of them were talking among themselves and the other was texting on her phone.
The sad part of all this, is the place we most often frequented for our RV supplies (Nelson's RV's) has just been purchased by Camping World.  Guess we will have to find another place to take our RV business!!

There is not one bad thing I can say about this restaurant. I had a French dip and it was perfect. My son had a grilled cheese sandwich and it was made with fresh cut cheese and homemade bread. They have the best hot chocolate and are very kid friendly.
Great place. I had the bacon burger with the peanut butter and jelly . It was AMAZING! The deviled eggs and bacon rack were delicious as well

I went in with my husband looking for a ring setting for our anniversary. The owner made a couple of insulting comments that made me feel uncomfortable. I don't normally wear a band with my ring, and he said by doing so it will look like I have three kids and am still engaged. Then he showed us $60K ring we didn't ask to see and told us we couldn't afford it. I left with a bad taste in my mouth. It's a nice store, but apparently not for average folks like us.
Super impressed, wasn't expecting to find such a good ramen place so close to where we moved to.  I had the spicy and my husband had the curry and they were both perfect.  We will definitely be back!

It's common enough to find a good burger joint with tasty sides and good shakes. Even easy enough to get decent service. That is not this place! This is locally sourced high quality beef from SRV, battered and 'eyes roll back in your head' fries, Deep. Fried. Deviled. Eggs., beer cheese smothered tots with  pork belly, and WAY TOO Large milkshakes sinfully decorated. The service here is beyond outstanding! Everyone here clearly loves their jobs and love to treat guests right! I will be back over and over this place is fantastic!

Food is good, but eating there could be risky as the staff is unaware they need to wear face masks.  Asked the waitress but she just shrugged and didn't seem to know anything about mask wearing.  Also the busboy was re-using a cleaning cloth to wipe down tables, (no disinfectant spray that I could see).

Love this place, wouldn't go anywhere else! I was hesitant to take my daughter to a "traditional daycare." The in home daycare provider refused to help potty train my daughter despite my daughters readiness at 18 months, so I made the leap! My daughter is 9 years old now and my son is 6--love, love, love Fatima, Sarah, Angela, Whitney and owner Suzanne!

My first time ever being to The Human Bean. It was pretty good, but would not be my go to coffee shop. I ordered a 12 oz chai smoothie, it didn't have as much chai as I was expecting. It seemed to be watered down and I couldn't really taste the chai. I don't think i would go there again, I would rather choose Starbucks or Dutch Bros.

Decided to give it a second chance.... kind of sorry we did. The $16 burger was yummy. Haven't seen our waitress since we got here other than to take our order. The cook brought our food out.... after dropping the people next to us order on the floor! Hello!! Need our check!!!! Where are you???? Anybody here???

Slow Service!
Ordered the Lemonberry Slush using the Sonic app.  The Slush was great -- a variety of flavors in one cup!
However, service was extremely slow.  The Slush was the only item that I ordered; nevertheless, it took 14 minutes from time of check-in to when I pushed the button again to ask how much longer.  The server said, "Oh, it's right here in front of me.  I'll bring it out."  Why does a single drink order take 14 minutes???

I would pass this place next time. I ordered the caprese. A pretty tiny sandwich, hard to eat. Everything falls off! Net extremely friendly service either. I got the lemon bar too. It tastes old and it was hard. Great Harvest has a much better lemon bar, so does kneaders. Disappointed

Visiting from Oregon. My mom and brother, both separately, HIGHLY recommended this place. So im in Boise and gave it a shot. 

Im very happy i did. It was DELICIOUS! My fiance ordered the curry tonkotsu, i got spicy tonkotsu. I liked mine better but they were both quite enjoyable. Great service , VERY reasonable prices. Highly recommended!

I stayed her one night, got here at 4 in the morning... After driving 13 hrs! Wasn't looking forward to check inn as its usually a long tedious process! Nope... Young boy working grave yard was so pleasant and observant by knowing I was tired so when I needed my car rental license number and such I was like aw man, do I have to go out there to get it?! No problem.. Just tell me what it looks like and if you know the model or make will be just fine. Asked questions about breakfast like time it ended and started. He says we don't open for another hr or so but I'd be happy to set it up for you and allow you to eat before its time!! So I skipped breakfast as I just wanted to go to bed. From the moment I walked in until the time I left the major observance I had was how impeccably clean the entire hotel was and how unnecessarily accommodating and upbeat a well as kind all the staff were that I came into contact with! Never once have I stayed in a hotel where the housekeeping made it a point to look you in the eye and say hello or good morning to you!! And not just one or two.... Every single one acknowledged my existence and was extremely welcoming!! Bed super comfy as it was just the right amount of soft and firm for my taste along with some pillows firm an some super fluffy! Breakfast was superb to me especially for free! Hot items included biscuits and gravy with scrambled eggs kep warm! I don't particular like biscuits and gravy but I even had seconds!! Many selections of teas to meet specific needs- sleepy time, calming, relaxing, etc! Chamomile to name one. Coffee was great with only a few hrs of sleep turned me into wide awake and energized to continue my drive! Even came with brand name French vanilla or hazelnut creamer! Tv is good size and quality that turns on the dresser for convenient viewing and comes with a brochure of all the channels! Great for child with nickelodeon and Disney channels just to name two of the kids channels! Hbo and other movie channels included! The best experience I had was wen I realized that I was 4 min until check out.. Still wanted to take a shower so I expressed my disappointment to lady behind counter, whom offered me 1/2 hr extra time without charge! Amazing. Toiletries came with brand name (Pantene pro-v) shampoo & conditioner, face soap as well as a nice and thick bar of body soap which was moisturizing so skin didn't feel dried out and icky! Makeup remover, lotion as well as mouth wash!! Never got mouth wash from hotel before!!! Shower was wonderful and water was just the right amount of pressure and high up because I hate when I am face to face with my shower head! Then I had to do laundry because stupid me packed dirty clothes cause was to lazy to wash before leaving!! Figured Id deal with it later! But I was worried as I was already checked out! No problem, gave me a card to get into laundry and no time limit to kick me out of here! In fact its 3pm and I'm still here! Daughter allowed to swim while attending to laundry! They even have rolls of quarters if you don't have them for the machines! I can go on and on about my new all time favorite hotel but you have to come and check it out yourself! They go above and beyond the price and for a 3 star hotel!!! Come here for your next stay and I'm confident you'll be more than happy that you did!

If I could give less stars I would. Worst then cafeteria food and for the price was gosh awful. Will never eat there again. Terrible service as well they forgot our drinks and didn't give us even the sauce that came with the order. Not a good first impression at all never again.  Also the hash browns for undercooked and the drinks weren't even cold what a joke.

What a refreshing atmosphere!!!
Fantastic service and wait staff. Very inviting. Love the multiple tv's and variety of programs. Also VERY CLEAN AND ORGANIZED! A Fantastic experience overall. Would recommend to anyone and to those if my friends that don't know about this hidden treasure!
No hand soap or paper towels in bathrooms.  Which means employees weren't  washing their hands effectively either.

Way too expensive. I'm all for co-ops and conscious shopping but I can't afford to be in there. Everyone there was super nice and friendly. They had a great selection. They had a couple fruit samples out, and a woman giving wine samples. I probably won't be going again because of the prices.

Our friends and I wanted some comfort food after a long day of hiking in the cold and we had heard about Sid's garage so thought it would be a perfect night to try it out! Everything was great. The staff were welcoming and cool and the food and drinks did not disappoint. We started off with the deviled eggs and loco fries - yum. Deviled eggs were deep fried and so bomb. And the fries were delicious and plenty for 4 people. We all got burgers and they were all so unique and full of flavor! Also, some of us got the sangria and it looked like an adult Capri sun. 
Loved the vibe! Will definitely be back.

Horrible service, they don't even ask how you are like in every other restaurant and they struggled to even bring out hot chocolate. Waitress gives us a dirty look when she walks by. Been waiting for 45 minutes for food for two people. Place is ridiculous!

Ordered through door dash. No sauces for fries or cheesy tots included in my order even the Bleu Cheese listed on my receipt was missing. Called asking about this and was told I should of listed my sauces I wanted in the notes of door dash and that was it. Please add a section to add sauces to your order or a list of sauces available as all your images show the items with them.

Love coming here for a sweet treat. My favorite so far is the red wonder. It consists of biscoff spread with whipped topping along with strawberries and raspberries. I have also had the banana cream pie which has chocolate sticks inside of the waffle. Personally not our favorite because the chocolate sticks overpowered the whole thing. My husband loves the plain liege waffle with whipped cream. He's a simple dude! But he also really loved their chicken and waffles which was really yummy because the chicken was fresh and had the perfect amount of crunch to it. It comes with two sauces which are realllly good. I would get that for lunch! I have almost tried them all besides the savory ones. Others I have tried are the sunshine, cinnalove, grilled cheese and the dulce. The sunshine is good but really tart because of the lemon curd (duh, of course! Lemon!). The cinnalove was good but realllly sweet because of the cinnamon glaze they top if off with. I felt like it needed whipped cream to help with the sweetness lol and then the dulce was really good because of the ice cream. I liked that one a lot. So all in all I guess what I'm trying to say is that I have been here quite a bit. Wear your stretchy pants because you can't have just one!

I have had some pretty good chicken and waffles before and this place is up there as one of the best. Long way from the south so I was skeptical but I was wrong. Can't wait to go back. Sat on the patio during a nice fall day. Perfect date night spot.

This place is absolutely amazing! Great music, friendly staff, terrific food and even when it's busy, there's almost no wait time! The candied jalapeño bacon is the best I've ever had and it comes with their amazing bourbon-sriracha dipping sauce that is to die for. One of the best things about this place is the unique sauces and pairings of meat and fruit (don't knock it until you try it). If you're questioning where you should go, this is the place!

Yummy. But incredibly, absurdly expensive. The burgers don't come with fries or veggies or sauce (???). I love rock music, and I love loud music, but the music was loud to the point of being unpleasant. We couldn't even hear each other at our small table or understand our waitress. The whole "music too loud? we'll turn it up!" thing is stupid and gimmicky. We probably won't be back... it's just wayyy too expensive for a burger joint. Try the Garage Cafe in Notus, or Westside Drive-In, or even Five Guys... the food is just as good, and you get a big portion with fries & a drink!

Losing your long time nail tech can be so traumatic!  That was confirmed when I chose someone and my gel nails peeled off within one week!  I then went to see Michelle at Tip Top nails and left there with a smile on my face. She was efficient, pleasant and personal (called me by my name) and my nails were beautiful. (Thanks for the referral Pam Grove!). See you in a couple of weeks Michelle!
Hot Bar continues to feed my soul and nutritional profile! Milk in the raw! I'll be back again and again.

(UPDATE: I've been contacted by Servpro and they are now trying to address the issues, so I have increased my star rating accordingly.)
Mine was a smallish job, a bathtub flood in a 2 bedroom duplex. While the mitigation and tear down phases went very well, when the job was handed off to the restoration crew it all fell apart. 
First of all, the way they have compartmentalized their functional arms seems disjointed and led to some communication snafus.
Secondly, the estimator and lead for their restoration effort was completely disinterested and incompetant. After 2 weeks of no start, I was told the hang up was tile: no longer available at Lowes. So I picked a reasonable substitute via email that would take a week to come in. In the meanwhile, I presumed carpet, wall board and subfloor could start. Alas, not so. The estimator could not locate any contractors and could not start for another 3 weeks out. 
My tenant at this point had been out of her home for nearly a month.
I went to Lowes and found the exact tile in stock and bought it. Fired Servpro and hired another company who said they could do the job within a week. 
Frankly, I don't think Servpro cared. I was lied to again and again until the relationship became dysfunctional. End of story.
Excellent frozen yogurt! Would highly recommend Golden Vanilla! Very friendly employees and clean store. I'm stoked that TCBY's are still in the Boise area!
Mom's recipe is our favorite ice cream flavor! And we always get a gallon of milk to take home. Try their old fashioned vanilla milk, tastes just like homemade vanilla ice cream.

As one of the first tenants to Jasper I'm not happy with the management staff. For those moving from out of state waiting on a house be very careful with negotiations on your lease. I was told I could get out of my lease early and now that I am getting ready to move into my new home they are making it impossible and charging outrageous fees. This review isn't about my issues with my lease I will handle that with my Attorney. This review is from the heart and my experience. If you are ok with a cheaply made apartment, very cold, cheap appliances that break down easily, bathroom fans that automatically turn on throughout the day doesn't matter what time you can be sleeping and fans turn on very annoying, trash constantly full it's disgusting everywhere on the ground, loud neighbors, they must not care about background checks and it shows. Dog poop everywhere in grassy areas and tenants with very aggressive pets where you are hoping the leash doesn't break and you don't get mauled up by someone's pet then you can call Jasper home. Now if this bothers you then please from my experience RUN!!
Just because they are new and they are advertised as luxury apartments doesn't mean crap.  Please take this review into consideration and hope someone doesn't make the biggest mistake of their lives just because they are willing to take any tenant to fill their empty apartments. 
Lesson learned!!! If I could give zero stars

Our office had CupBop's food truck come for lunch this week. I was severely impressed because it was just one person working the food and she managed to take care of all of us!
I had the B_Bop, spice level 4, kimchee on top. It was very delicious but I could have used a little more spicy heat. The kimchee was more on the sweet side than what I'm used to. Next time I'll know to dial up the spicy heat factor with the kimchee, and there will be a next time.

Not trustworthy . Jay Simmons. Shame on you. You know what  you did.
Stay clear of this Place and NEVER LEAVE YOUR JEWELRY TO BE APPRAISED. Go. Anywhere. Else. But. Simmons!!!
Food is decent but the wait staff is terrible. They are inattentive and rude. Want to like it but they treat you like you're inconveniencing them.

Come on, Century Link, you guys are better than this!!!!!
I understand right now you guys are the only service in town, or in Eagle ID, but there's going to come to a point when someone's going to come in and offer better-trained staff, a much better onboarding process for new customers, and a system of automation that actually works.  
Unfortunately, the automated system was a complete waste of time; I will say your customer service agents were kind, and we're sincerely apologetic about that whole process but were unable to help me as a new customer get my service established, which is a little bewildering.
My move to Boise's been absolutely amazing, The people in the community are great but I can say working with century link was just a disaster:/.

So, I went to pick up a cargo van the other day, you know, the one they advertise as "$19 for 75 minutes"? Well, good luck staying under the 75 minutes as your time starts when you're still in the building, prior to walking to the back of the parking lot, having the attendant start the car, check the gas level, show you where to fill it up with gas, etc. So, after wasting my first 10 minutes with all of that, I get back to Home Depot with 10 minutes to spare. Awesome! Until I got back into the rental drop off area and there was a line. I politely told the worker that I wanted to make sure my time didn't go over since the vehicle was parked, not being used, etc. His response? "Your time ends when I check you back in". What a sweetheart!  The van did end up getting the job done, just factor in 20-30 extra minutes of messing with the Home Depot associates into the 75. Nice little scam they have going on over there...
The staff out front could use some training.  As well as the cook....disappointing experience

I ordered the fish which was beautifully cooked except they forgot to season it. I was so disappointed and was unable to eat it. I will def go again and try another dish but avoid the potato coated trout. It's no bueno.

First walking in, seeings its packed is a good sign! Love the anime manga decor on the walls. Our waiter is very attentive and looking to please our order. Everyone around us seem to be enjoying themselves and their food.  I got the ramen and bowl combo, karaage chicken and spicy tonkatsu ramen.

We were super excited for this opening- love this location! Flatbread is great so we knew the owners would likely deliver a fun new concept. The food that we had was good and we will definitely return because some of the items we wanted weren't available. No big deal. 
The reason for the 3 stars- pretty easy fixes, really. Our server showed ZERO excitement! No mention of recently opening, no name/introduction , no recommendations or even the offer to answer questions- first thing she said 'do you want anything other than water?' So boring. I mean, you JUST opened! Show your excitement to be there and your guests will feel it. 
Another thing that bothered all of us at our table... the fact that staff utilizes the garage roll up door to go between the patio and inside. There is a small wall that everyone has to liters step over and it looks so unprofessional and lazy. Maybe if the small wall at the bottom wasn't there, it wouldn't have been so obvious, but they even used this access while the tables in front of the door were seated with guests. It was so bad. All 4 of us noticed it right away and couldn't believe it. It's really the little details that make restaurants stand out. I think there are a lot of great things about this restaurant but I just feel they need fine tune the details. Especially staff! 


* I tried to email that address but it didn't work. I'm happy to try a different one, if you have one. Thanks!
Loved that he showed up in a mask and he was lightening fast.    I couldn't be more pleased with the service I got getting back in my car after locking the keys in!

If your hungry don't go here! After traveling from Alabama to Atlanta and flying home to Idaho I decided to take my twin friends to a late breakfast. First we ordered the grand slam breakfast. I ordered basted eggs because I wanted the yolk runny and white cooked. When the order arrived at our table the white and yolk were both very runny so I ordered eggs over easy. After reading the correct cooking method I was assured that the white would be cooked and the yoke would be runny. It returned the table and the yoke and the white we're still both still very runny. The honey jalapeño bacon was burnt and quite foul tasting. The biscuits and gravy were served and the gravy was cold. The third time I sent the eggs back I decided I better ask for over medium. When they arrived at the table the yoke was runny and the whites were still runny. By this time my appetite was totally gone. After sending so many things back and getting them back worse than they were in the beginning I no longer was hungry.  We waited for over 30 minutes just to get our check and a togo box for pancakes that were not eaten. They were not busy so I do not understand the problem with the cook or waiter but our entire meal was very undesirable. The staff was friendly but after asking to be served the right kind of food they were ignoring us. I am sorry to say Denny's will no longer be a choice even if they give you a free birthday meal they could not pay me to eat there again.
Love this neighborhood sports bar. Karaoke on Thursday, Fri, Sat til 2am. Cheese curds and whiskey, need I say more.

I was looking for advice on filing Bankruptcy. Avery Law was very honest and was able to explain all my options. I did file Bankruptcy. Payments are very doable. And also if you need to postpone a payment for a week as long as you call them in advance they a very helpful and willing to work with you. Staff very friendly. Would definitely recommend them.

Oh. We love their pizza. If you get thin crust and extra toppings, for their price. Its the best pizza. Their Cowboy pizza id the best.  I always make up my own with pepperoni olives mushrooms and X cheese  pineapple. Yum. Its always at a good price. Heard Tuesdays they have a special

I was locked out of a house that I was taking care of for a nice family. The business owner came fast, treated me kindly, and last but certainly not least, for the door open with no damage so the homeowners wouldn't worry in the future! Highly recommend this man and his dog for any future issues involving locks.

Tom is Great, Gary is Awful. I have been going to this store since it opened several years ago.  I have seen good years for personnel and bad years.  Tom has been there for a number of years and has always been helpful, friendly and efficient. The older gentleman, I believe his name is Gary, is cantankerous, grumpy and non-approachable. I believe he's been there now for about 2 years.  My teenage kids say they don't want to go into the store because of this guy.  I still go into the store, because I like to support my local business, but it does take some internal convincing that I should go because I'm always afraid I'm going to get the grump.

If you are looking for a unique dinner experience this is the place to go. From the moment you walk in the door you are greeted with a loud welcome from the staff. The service was great and relatively quick. All of their dishes are served in such fun ways. My burger was served in a lunch pail. Their shakes are huge and over the top, in the best way. Mine came with a huge piece of chocolate cake on top. The one downside is that all of the entrees are sold separately from the sides and shakes, so it can be pretty pricey to eat here. If you are looking for a quiet intimate restaurant this isn't the best place as it is a fun, loud, lively atmosphere.

No more Panda Express for us... CupBop is our new jam!  Every time we drove past we laughed at the name until we finally got to check it out.  We stopped in for lunch a couple of weeks ago and I was impressed with how clean it is and how friendly the staff was.  Not knowing what we were doing and never having experienced Korean BBQ we were all confused.  The staff was very informative and patient while we all made our way through the line picking and choosing what went in our bowl.  

You start with white rice, choose from cabbage or lettuce, they add the noodles (made from sweet potatoes), you choose your meat(s) and then there are a variety of sauces.  I chose fried chicken and bbq chicken the first time and went with their suggestion on sauce.  The next time I went back I got all bbq chicken and extra garlic sauce.  It is very filling and we each usually get 2 meals out of each bowl.  Now we just need a CupBop on the south side of the interstate!

Stopped in the other day for a quick bite to eat. Pretty good I must say. I had a spicy chicken bowl with rice and noodles. They stirred it up with a 8/10 hot sauce, I normally would have done a 10 but figured I needed to tame it down considering I needed to go back to work afterwards. See you again soon!
Tony G's would have received 5-stars for the Crave service and the Grandma Spicy Sicilian but the NY pepperoni was so salty it was inedible!

I brought in a Microsoft SurfaceBook computer with a stuck power button.    Microsoft wouldn't repair and offered me a standard exchange of $599 since the device was out of warranty.  Al Loose helped me workaround the problem by pointing out where the frame was slightly bent and how to workaround it.  And he didn't charge me anything!  Great solution and really friendly service.  I'm so grateful!!!   I wouldn't hesitate to recommend them for any computer repair.

I was talking to some friends the other night and they suggested I try Rudy's.  I had said I had been to Gino's next door, and they pointed to Rudy's for next time.  So, last night my son and I went over to try it for dinner.  We sat ourselves, like one does in a bar, and we were quickly greeted, menu'd, and asked if we wanted a drink.  Perfect!  We ordered drinks, and since the Olympics were on, we asked to have the big monitor over the bar changed from Euro soccer to Woman's beach Volleyball (US vs China).  Lots of TVs! 
 The bartender didn't know what channel it was on, but it was on some tiny TV in the "family" section with low tables, and she went of there and then came back and changed it for us.  Cool!  Plus it was a great match btw, but I digress.  So, let's talk the wine list.  Meh, nothing on there to write home about, so did the house red to be cheap.  Beer and mixed drinks are the order of the day here, which is fine.  The bar seemed quite efficient even with less staff working.  The place was clean.  All the tables, as we looked around, were kept very clean which was nice.  Nobody likes to have to pick their table because it was the only clean one around.  Not the case here.  All the open tables were very clean.  Onto the menu...  It's pretty extensive.  I'm not a huge fan of extensive menu's, I don't think too many places do 500 dishes wonderfully, but I'm used to going to places that have too many things rather than focus only on what they do best.   So, a wide array of choices.  It is Pub fair.  So, don't be looking for some fancy dishes.  This place is like Homestead without all the noise, or Busters in Eagle.  Mostly simple food as seen on many American menus.  They did have something my friend mentioned, the 'Wedge Salad with Chicken'.  I thought, that's kinda bizarre, but I do like a good wedge, and the chicken does add protein so you're not hungry 10 minutes later.   My son ordered a Pub burger.  Pretty standard, but that's his fault because they had some good sounding burgers, but he likes them plain.  He enjoyed his, I enjoyed mine, the place was clean, the people were nice, not too noisy, good TV viewing, outdoor dining when weather permits.  This is a good place to come.  Shorts and flip flops dinner.  I'd say try it out for unpretentious evening paired with the standard American bar dishes.  Think Chili's if you will.  Anyway, I'll come back...

Excellent Mexican Food! We ate at there Hailey restaurant and we were so excited when they came to Meridian. Very friendly staff.  Definitely need another location as well.  Suggestion... out at Chinden and Linder.
The waffles for the breakfast sandwich are light and work very well as a dish. I added sausage to mine and covered it in hot sauce. Not a huge fan of the house sauce however.
The staff was extremely rude, disrespectful, and unhelpful. Although this is the nearest UPS store, I will never use it again. I will drive out of my way to take my business elsewhere.

The Buffalo chicken flatbread is great. We also love their burgers and tots. It has a hometown burger joint feel! We keep coming back again and again! I just wish they had milkshakes or some kind of dessert options.

I know there are restaurants with way more Idaho history behind them, but I say Terri's Cafe does a perfect job demonstrating what makes this State beautiful. It's family environment with hot coffee and good conversions. The food is cozy and comforting, the menu is detailed but not bogged down by too many options. The waitresses are delightful, friendly and so nice to talk to. No one is on their phone, but I am because I'm a disgusting millennial who uses yelp. There are big open windows; right now you can see October at its best with colorful leaves and half naked trees.
