At this hour it's quiet... just 20 or so people here and the gentle sound of laugher and the clatter of busy workers in the kitchen. 

Sure I haven't said much about the food. But it's great, and the portions are generous. I love it here and I highly recommend taking someone you care about to this diner and enjoying their company while you enjoy the warm meal. They have weekly specials for lunch and breakfast, and be careful on holidays because this place can start to get packed. Especially on Mother's day. 

Be kind to each other.

I went the first time because I got a free wash & cut in the mail. The girl did a nice job on my hair. So I went again and paid (same girl) and the cut was terrible. My hair is way too short and my bangs are all chopped and up and way too short. My husband said it looks like someone put a bowl on my head and cut around it. 

Don't think I'll be back. Very disappointed.

They were all very friendly and professional, I took my little girl and they put her in the cute pink chair for pedicures. They listened to my concerns about a previous dip manicure I had done else where and did an amazing job. It's not clunky and thick like some places I've had, very happy with the service and result.

From the outside Ramen Sho doesn't look like much but as soon as you taste their food you know you have found a gem. Their customer service is great and their food is even better. I will definitely be coming back with some friends.

We arrived at opening (5pm) and were the first ones there. I went to the bathroom before ordering and it was... not clean. Urine all over the toilet and messy. Should have left, but decided not to make a big deal about it. Server was very friendly. Food was ok, but definitely not amazing as some people have stated.  Price seemed great until food arrived and I realized how small the portions were. I don't know how anyone can think this place is anything above a three star restaurant.

Quick and detailed response by James to my quote request. Next-day appointment for my non-emergency service. (I never even got a call back from another locksmith I had been referred to prior). Thorough and fast job for very reasonable rate. Highly recommend!!
Delish. Quick service. Great fresh o.j. I get the Benedict. I wish they'd offer a half order option because it's so yummy and I hate to waste food, so I leave a bit over stuffed.

My first visit and I am hooked! Not only is the food good, it is filling. I ordered 5 momos and a plate of rice and chicken with curry and I was stuffed. Who would have thought? Not I! The momos are packed with meat. The food is healthy but doesn't taste like you just ate some grass. It has substance and flavor. Then there was the staff! They were friendly and welcoming. They asked if it was our first time in there, which it was, and then proceeded to walk us through what was what. Oh, and they cater and deliver! I think I am in love :)

Called Meridian Plumbing for a diagnosis on my water heater and had the privilege to meet Brian Peltzman from their team. Brian was very professional, clean, and organized upon arrival.  Brian put his shoe covers on before entering the house and verified why he was here. Brian was successful with his diagnosis and offered information about the situation freely to make sure I understood the situation.
Brian also went out of his way to inform me about a few other things going with the house. A water hardness test was also conducted to determine if we should invest in a water softener.
I would highly recommend Brian from Meridian Plumbing to anybody. Brian was very professional, polite, informed (20 years exp), and helpfu.

I never write on Yelp and usually just kinda suck it up but I have to say how disappointed I was with the food in this restaurant! My son and I went there at about 7:45 ish  and I was going to eat off the buffet, however the food looked cold and sparse. I realize that it was later than most people probably eat so I ordered off the menu. When I got my food it was barely warm and to top it off there was a hair on my plate ( not mine) so I just can't imagine what was in my food! The waiter we had was wonderful and it wasn't his fault that the food was cold as he was very attentive. He did compensate us for my meal however I suggest that ya'll save your time and money and go elsewhere if you want good Asian cuisine!

Love this little family breakfast place! I came here years ago when it was still Steve's and not much has changed. I am from out of town so I love the huckleberry pancakes! Service was quick, food was hot, portions were large! Very impressed with my second time here!
Ordered a full pie for delivery no problem but we wanted add slice of cheese pizza for our kid nope tuff shit call Uber eats if you want that well tuff shit we went somewhere else

*UPDATE*
"Management" has responded asking me to reach out yet I've called at least 6 times, and emailed about 3 times with no response. Like I said, they don't care to solve actual issues and that's that. ‍

We ordered takeout while passing through and staying in a hotel across the street for a night, the food was good, we had pizza cones and salads and all were yummy. It was nice to have something by that our kids would enjoy but that we enjoyed as well. Will definitely visit again if we are in town.

This place is amazing. The staff are very nice and helped us right away. We had to wait a little bit for a table but it wasn't that bad seeing that they were very busy. The burgers were cooked perfectly and the smoked bacon bits were awesome . I would definitely recommend this place to anyone who wants a great burger and friendly environment.

I just deleted the RAVING review that I gave this place one year ago. Today was my third visit. My daughter was with me. We asked for two pedicures. We were not offered additional services or asked which level of pedicure we wanted. My $25 pedicure lasted 15 MINUTES.  My daughter soaked for five minutes before someone got to her and she was done in 10 MINUTES. I expressed my frustration with the owner and told him I was willing to pay $15 for each of our pedicures. I will give him a nod for allowing us to leave without paying anything  -  but I will not return to this salon. Too many choices in Meridian. This is a very lovely salon, but the service is below average.

Love Terri's for breakfast.  Everything is delicious.  The waffles.  The eggs.  The sausage.  I don't know why their scrambled eggs are so good.  Never much of a wait if any.  Great staff.  Your neighborhood family restaurant.  I only wish it was carpeted but it's not a big deal.

This review is for their installation service.  The in-store help was amazing.  The trick is--they are super helpful to get you to purchase items, but then awful at following up to ensure the items are delivered and installed properly.  It was a very frustrating experience trying to communicate with the store about the installation workers never showing up, and then they tried to give us the run-around when we said we would just like to return the item.
If you need something delivered and installed--go to Lowe's!

Had the fiber wifi installed and its not even strong enough to get into bedrooms on the same floor in a small house, 20 yards from the modem! Just spent 40 minutes on Chat Help getting transferred FIVE Times, with each transfer again asking for account number, email, phone number, etc. and then asking what the problem is again.

There only response was for us to purchase a wifi extender!  PURCHASE???  So the service you advertised, and the service the technician promised us, and the service we are paying for isn't working as agreed upon...so you want us to pay more????

How about sending a tech to fix the issue!!
Feeling frustrated and pissed off.

The best vape shop in the valley. Very knowledgable and helpful employees. They're always patient when I need help with builds or have 100 questions or want to try several flavors. They're also supportive of our Military!

I've been here twice now with two different sets of people and the overall consensus has been similar both times.   Waffles are yummy, dessert waffles are yummier, but not sure these particular waffles are worth coming back for time and time again. 

Teenage staff working here has always been very friendly and helpful. I appreciate that as much of the youth today seems to feel they are beyond a typical high school job. So props there. 

There is a good selection of offerings, both sweet and savory, so I think most everyone can find something to meet their taste buds. I personally find for the serving size the $7-$8 price point to be a bit steep to make it a regular stop for most. I think most would not be willing to share one.

I am familiar with a traditional liege waffle and have had many in the past, so I find these particular waffles to be very different than what I'm accustomed too.  Those that I have had prior are more crunchy on the outside with a pretty significant sugary caramel coating and soft on the inside. The waffles here are fluffy like a belgian waffle but sweet with the pearl sugar, no crunchy sugary outside.  For someone who doesn't have something to compare too, you'd probably be less judgemental about this aspect.  I personally just find them to miss the mark, based on what I'm expecting.  

I also prefer my whipped cream to be more light and airy. I'm not suggesting they use store bought whipped cream, love that they make it fresh in-house daily but . . . I've had and made homemade whipped cream before and it wasn't as dense as theirs is.  It's almost like the consistency of a giant scoop of butter. I also think the ratio of whip to waffle is not right. 

Fruit toppings have always been fresh, flavorful and a decent amount. 

Parking is a bit tricky so be sure to pull into the lot prior to pulling up in front of the actual building. There is not parking in front of the actual store front and the side of building parking is tricky and hard to navigate if the neighboring business has a full drive through. 

Overall my kids think the place is great. The adults I've been with seem to have more discerning palates and have similar feelings to what I've said above. So I guess weigh your audience and give it a go.

P.S.  This is not in BOISE, but in Meridian . . . so don't get confused by the name!

We bought our C class motor home in June, after getting it home we found several things that required serious attention. we called several times to the service department, they wanted pictures of which we sent to them. We took the motor home in for them to check it out, after two weeks nothing was done including checking the bedroom slide out that I had told them it wouldn't go in all the way. since then it is September we only took it out once on a short trip because we are not sure the bedroom slide out will become stuck in the out position. Bare in mind this is a brand new motor home that they were glad to sell us, it has full warranty coverage. I'm sorry I didn't read these pages before I bought this motor home. My wife and I are retired me from the military and social security we had planed on taking the motorhome and travel a bit, but instead we spent most of our life savings for something we can't use because of poor follow up from this company and a worse service department. they called me today and told me the parts they needed would be in October 10, and they need more pictures of the slide out, if they had checked it  when I took in and they kept it for two weeks to order parts and check the problems that I pointed out.

Used to be a regular every week for almost 2 years, but now sadly I need to find a new ramen spot. Soup tastes so bland and watered down, used to be savory and filling. Now it just tastes like dish water with a splash of chicken soup. Service went down the hole,  profanities being shouted from the kitchen. (while kids are in the dining room). Nobody looks like they know what's going on. Floors are CAKED in grease(have been ever since i stated coming) Bathrooms never have any soap. In a pandemic??? Not professional service like it once had. One waitress girl i've seen cry on multiple occasions that i've come, like is something wrong? does she need a hug? the cook walks out back and forth and i can smell the pack of cigarettes he smoked moments before, unappetizing in my opinion. i don't understand why the environment is so uncomfortable and hostile in a small ramen joint. Miss the authentic Japanese hospitality. A shame. Owners should be embarrassed if they even care to.

Holy Moly this was such a stellar find! I had plans to meet friends for happy hour, but the place we chose was a no go. 830 Commons was close, so we thought, why not. It was fabulous!! From the service to the food, everything was top notch. After having appetizers, I HAD to order a BBQ chicken salad to go for dinner. It was huge and packaged in such a way that the greens didn't wilt and the avocado was still looking as fresh as could be. I am so excited to go back and try EVERYTHING on the menu. If you like great food come here!!

Clean establishment, friendly cashier's, fast and easy. Fun idea to have your pizza rolled into a cone. Easier for eating on the go or in the car. I wish the location was easier to get to. It's off overland and the eagle exit. Perhaps if it was a drive through! I got a sausage cone and my husband got a pepperoni cone. Both were good.

I love that these came to Idaho! I am always craving waffles and this is the perfect place. They have such a great menu and such a cute little place to go eat out or even order from. I love their nutella waffles and also their fried chicken waffles! Can't wait to try more from their menu but super happy with them and what they do!!

We love having a camping place close to our home and I'm not sure why the reviews are so low here on Yelp! because we were just here two day's ago and everyone was very welcoming, knowledgeable and helpful on every level, so we are giving them a five stars review due to their above and beyond excellent treatment towards their customers from the moment we walked in their door to leaving, everyone constantly asking if we had been helped yet!  They also offer Good Sam and Veteran discounts here.
Yummy Coffee! This is my 1st time trying their coffee! I love their Butterfinger! I'll be back!

12th reviewer of Meridians CarMax. 
This is my 361st review. 

Wow... seriously! EASY!!

I started looking online at cars, looking at safety ratings, fuel mileage and so on. I needed a second car, just something small. I stumbled upon the car that I was interested in through Carmax website at a very good price, low mileage, and a great condition for being a 2-year-old car. 

I applied online, and within 30 minutes I was called with a "pre-approval". After discussing the car in more detail, I applied for it. Was approved in minutes with a fair monthly payment and nothing down. I made an appointment for later that afternoon and went down. 

When I got there, I noticed many people buying or selling their cars. I was immediately shown "my car" and suggested to test drive and inspect the vehicle before making any decisions (yes of course). I went for a ride with the salesman George, who made a good conversion with "dad talk" about our kids and the good they're doing in the world. 

I was sold on the vehicle. We went inside and the car was taken to be filled with fuel, washed, and cleaned. I told George that it was clean enough, but he said that's the Carmax way... so, I just smiled. 

Within minutes I was at the finance person's desk. The paperwork was already printed, no need for those long forms that take forever to print on and you feel as though you're back in the 80's. As we signed he placed the papers, a different George this time (spelled Jorje), into a scanner/printer which printed my copes as we went-- so much time savings. I literally bought a car in less than 30 minutes. It's taken hours in the past-- literally hours... 

Once the paperwork was signed we walked over to the televison waiting room. I then noticed my new car, all shiny, with a big bow on the hood. What a good experience. I, seriously, will never buy a car at another place. Thanks Carmax. WOW. Stress free and proud to be!

I found Plumbing solutions through NextDoor. They were able to schedule me the same day and that was a great relief since I am worried about water damage to my house. They sent Gary, he did a great job. I have a new hose bib and no leaks.

OH. MY. PIZZA.

11/10 this is still so good. If you're considering coming here stop what you're doing and go get yourself a pizza cone. The best pizza-ish thing I've ever had please do yourself a favor and get this NOW.

Those last few bites of cone are filled with cheese basically like a little mini stuffed crust pizza- or the "cheese butt" as they call it.

We met the owner Tyler and he told us all about the business. Unfortunately with Covid much of their food truck business at festivals, fairs and sporting events has been impacted. Please support this local business and buy all the pizza cones. 

Whaaat?! This is like getting some bomb.com fair food or Disneyland food but for half the price. $6-$7 dollars for a molten cone of cheese and toppings? YES. PLEASE. Go try this- right now. If you like pizza like any sane person this will give you a whole new experience. They stuff your bread cone full of cheese, sauce, and meat and/veggies, put it in a spinning oven that looks pretty neat, and out comes a piping hot cone of deliciousness. If you like hot pockets get some class and have a pizza cone instead. One thousand percent better. Awesome idea executed well. 


I'm a fan! I WILL be back. Thank you coned. Thank you.
Awesome!!!  Love this place.  Delicious pizza cones and very fast.  Friendly staff and we love coming here after going to the movies.

Hypnosis therapy with Arlene is very positive, customized and effective!
She gets to know you and together you work out a realistic path to gaining more control and happiness in your life.
Amazing food, great bar, fantastic service.  It is comfortable going there by yourself as well as with a group.  Yummy burgers, salmon and salads.  I could eat there everyday!

I was vacationing in Eagle and was overjoyed to find the Boise Co-Op. They have a great selection of specialty, organic, vegan, gluten-free, and other healthy items. (Hint: try the in-house-packaged tamari sunflower seeds!) They have good prices on fruit. I just wish my companion hadn't rushed me out before I could try the deli. Very nice cashier, too!  : )

Arlene is a real gift to the world! Within the first few minutes of meeting her you feel as if you've known her your entire life, almost as if talking to a close friend/family member who understands you inside and out and truly cares. She is so enthusiastic about what she does and it made me feel excited and confident in the change I wanted to bring to my life. Going into my first session I felt like I was at rock bottom, I wasn't even sure on who I really was anymore. She taught me specific tools to break old patterns and become the best me I can be. Between my first and second session (1 week apart) my life completely 180'd. I feel like a better me, on the way to becoming the best me! I got a promotion, an internship, and found a new apartment and mended relationships. At 20 years old these are all things I wished to accomplish in a couple months time, but with the tools Arlene had taught me it allowed for me to not waist my energy on negativity anymore but focus it on what I wanted out of life which allowed me to accomplish so much in 1 week. Only 7 days later and I feel like a brand new me! The best part is I'm eager to keep growing due to Arlene's optimistic approach! I would recommend Arlene to everyone! She truly cares about the people she works with and can show you how to break bad habits, accomplish what you want and how to show yourself just how wonderful you are and what you have to offer to the world.( and much more of course!)  I'm so glad I decided to go to Arlene! What a saint!!

Amazing. We're in from out of town and needed something quite simple. Our plan was to leave in 2 days and they squeezed us in and fixed the issue. .... And we were on our way. 
The work was for a window washer pump replacement. It was completed quickly, accurately and within a reasonable price. The staff is beyond helpful and friendly. Just excellent to deal with. The facility is clean, spacious and probably the nicest automotive repair shop we've seen.  We would gladly return if the need should arise. 
Thank You

If I could give Driven 10 stars I would! These guys have worked on all the cars we own, and we are NEVER disappointed with their work. We had to move from Idaho to Virginia, and while I was back visiting I took my Nissan Cube in for a shimmy when breaking. They fixed it right up, checked my fluid levels, and the air pressure in my tires, and I am ready for the drive back to Virginia. The people working at this business are ALWAYS honest, and as a woman that is absolutely invaluable in an auto repair shop. I would recommend them to anyone.

Tip Top?  Not so much!  Rudest salon I have ever been to.  We made an appointment two days in advance for pedicures for my niece's birthday.  We were finally given chairs 15 minutes after the appointment time.  Two of us got boiling hot water in the bowls, and two of us got no water at all.  When we asked about adding a bit of cooler water, or giving the other two water in the bowls, the woman waved her hand at us and simply dismissed our questions.  She started to sweep the floor and completely ignored us.  15 minutes later (30 minutes after our scheduled appointment time) we walked out.  

Save yourself the pain of this place ruining a girls day for a special occasion.  Go ANYWHERE else but here.

I have had nothing but problems with Centurylink right from the start.
From setting me up on an account I didn't ask for, to over charge if me half the time. They say they are going to do one thing and then the next time you call the person you talk to has no record or any idea what you're talking about.
The service is slow and unreliable. When I finally got fed up and decided to cancel they charged me an early cancellation fee. I didn't like it but I understood and paid it; or at least I tried to pay it. The company didn't take the payment and then didn't send out a bill. 7 months later I get a bill from a collection agency say I owe them money for a bill from Centurylink. I hadn't received a bill or a phone call from Centurylink in 7 months. This came at a complete surprise because I thought that I had already paid my bill and was finally done with Centurylink. But they have a way of screwing you even when you don't have service with them.
I'll never go back, never.

I was skeptical at first.  However, after the first session, I never felt so good and positive about myself!  I saw her to help me with my self esteem.  I used to feel anxious  meeting new people and be in unfamiliar places. I've seen several psychologist for ages and felt worse after each session.  Her approach is excellent.  She goes right into your very core and correct your false beliefs.  You'll leave her office feeling confident, with totally different outlook of yourself!

Camping World is the most unethical organization I have ever associated with.  My husband and I purchased a 2017 new RV from them on July 31st.  We we got the RV home we noticed a multitude of issues and defects.  We contacted Camping World immediately and we told we needed to bring the RV in for warranty work since we now owned the unit.  The earliest they could get us in was the following Monday - a week following our purchase.  Camping World has had our RV ever since.  They have never called my husband or me to let us know the status or when we will get our NEW RV back.  We have reached to them on several occasions and receive the same response from Dave - Service Director "Your RV is not ready and I am not sure what is going on and will need to call you back."  As you can guess we have NEVER received a call back.  Out side of hiring an attorney - we are at complete loss as to what to do.

Probably my worst Denny's experience ever, and I grew up with Denny's...

The service was poor, no refills, all of the orders ended up with the wrong items, one of the appetizers was  severely burnt, my burger patty was also severely burnt and the has browns with onions extra suddenly became gravy hash browns.

I witnessed an elderly gentleman ask if they could get refills  and that their waiter had abandoned them and the waitress started berating the other employee right there in front of the customers telling them that she would yell at her again.

I felt physically ill upon learning that I had eaten food prepared by the sick cook... 

This is beyond bad:  This is shut this place down and start over with new staff type-bad.

Three day's in a row so far without any internet at all or sufficient consistency so as to be able to accomplish much of anything.  The issue was initially an "equipment malfunction" of some sort.  Each day we have been told the issue would be resolved by a certain time only to have them fail to deliver or push the resolution time back further.  

This has made it impossible to work from home (kind of a big deal during COVID).  I stupidly believed their latest promise for restoring service and purchased a UFC event, which I ended up having to stream via cellular on an iPad. CenturyLink, we pay you in full, on time and rely on your service.  You are an internet provider.  How about PROVIDING THE INTERNET?!? 

So aggravating.  We're going to be forced to shop for an alternative.  My first call Monday morning will be to a competitor. I will pay more to put an end to this bad joke of a service.
Stopped in for a small bite to eat and coffee. My kids and I loved it. Friendly staff, delicious food, good coffee. Nice to have a local town coffee shop to hang out

The food at Rudy's is excellent and well priced, but tonight isn't the first time we have had horrible service.  Not once were we asked if we needed drink refills, we sat 25 minutes before drink orders were even taken.  My grandson accidentally spilled his drink.  We asked the waitress for help and she literally walked over, threw down a small towel and walked away.  We had to go up to the bar and ask for more towels because she didn't even come back to check on the situation- a young man stepped in and brought our food.

you just lost me as a customer. And over $10! I went in to buy a Christmas tree that I found online. It was $10 more in store so I simply asked for a price match and was told NO! What? They said they cannot price match online. Like seriously? What store these days does not price match online especially their own store?!? We have had other issues at Home Depot the past couple of years and this just took the cake. Absolutely ridiculous. Get it together Home Depot; your making Lowe's richer.

Went with my grandsons a couple of weeks ago, didn't even know it existed on Idaho, knew they were in Utah.  Food was excellent, both sweet and savory.  Went twice while they were visiting...will go again.  Fun place to go!!

To those other reviewers complaining about pricing...thanks to Covid and the logistics nightmare in this country,  prices everywhere have gone up like crazy, have you bought groceries lately, or filled your car with gas?  Nothing  worth having is cheap anymore.  Found it reasonably priced compared to other options out there.

Food that is fun! I always like that! I got the Make Your Own so could pick the items I wanted in my cone. It was yummy. We took them home and they were nice and warm. Excited to bring the grandkids here! They even have cone desserts!

Return customer here! Tom is my guy, he always provides excellent service and is upfront about the devices and deals. The guy seriously knows his stuff, and has earned the trust that I give. Would not let anyone else handle my phone! Props 360!

Was in the area, so decided to try this for the first time.

The place is sort of cold and all hard services. So the Korean TV program sounded like automatic weapons fire inside of a concrete bunker. You can't even hear the servers' questions. I could do without it.

The food choices are tasty. We had the Tofu and Kimchi Bowl and the Fried Chicken Bowl. Both have a bed of white rice, a little lettuce or cabbage, and sweet potato noodles. Put on the protein choice and the sauce of choice. All bowls run from about $7.50 and $8.50. They were quite filling and different than the Flame broiler which I have heard this compared with.

But, I would only go back if in the area and needed a quick meal. To be honest, for the same price, I would rather have a lunch special plate at Wok Fusion. More choice, tastier food, and quieter.

My main suggestions would be:
1) quiet the background noise,
2) Serve brown rice as an option,
3) Have Tea as a drink option,
4) Find a Gochujang Hot Pepper Paste. This is supposed to be Korean, for God's sake.
This place always has awesome pizza cones and the staff are always friendly!! I definitely recommend this place if you love pizza!

Love Love Love Clayton and my eyelashes!  I always feel pampered when I am there, love his room, super relaxing!  He is quick and efficient, which is super important to me as well, I can't spend ALL day at the spa.  I had been shopping around for an eye-lash guru and location that I loved and stopped shopping after finding him!

YUM! This place hits the spot in all the good ways. It's really flavorful and definitely worth your money. I think I paid like $12 total for everything: the Bbop + mandoo!

I got the Bbop, which is the Korean style BBQ beef served w/ rice & lettuce & mixed cabbage. EVERYTHING WAS ON POINT. Even the lettuce and mixed cabbage was bursting with flavor- like come on, lemme tell ya, I'm guilty of skipping veggies in general, but it was delicious! I also got the mandoo, but it was ok, nothing special. Their sauce was also delicious too. I like my spice, so I chose a level 7. It went soooo well with the beef.  I recommend getting the sauce separately! 

Yum yum yum, though. Thinking about it right now! Big flavor bombs everywhere. Highly recommend, will def get this again and try their korean fried chicken & pork :)
Very professional-guys showed up on time, explained themselves each step of the way, were clean and neat. Thanks Ryan, Kirby, and Antonio

Unfortunately, I have only been twice. Johnny Bronx is over of the best fast pizza places in the area.  There is only other pizza place that is as good, but much slower and more expensive.  

Johnny Bronx is a small drive-in pizza place.  They have minimal outdoor seating if you want to relax there.  I would highly recommend eating either there in your car, or eating at over if their tables.  To often hot pizza sitting in boxes add steam and makes the crust flimsy.  By eating it right away, the crust is crunchy as it should be.

They have their common slices already premade so when you order, they throw the slide in the oven to reheat. This process can make the drive-thru slow, so just be patient-your reward is coming. As I mentioned above, this is over of the best spots.

There are other items on the menu, which I plan on trying soon.  Some of these items are, meatballs, pasta and cheese bread.

On August 5, we celebrated our 21st Anniversary by taking our 2 kids, MIL, SIL, and niece to the Backstage Bistro.  We thought it would be great to sit out on patio and watch the Elton John Tribute.  I had called in a reservation, and I was told that I could not reserve the patio tables.  As such, I made a reservation for inside, but when I got there tables were available on the patio.  I asked if I could sit right out front, and I was told, "No.  That table is reserved."  Interesting to say the least.  At any rate, the wait staff was really nice and accommodating, so we just went with the flow, but it was annoying.
I ordered the 12oz. Ribeye, and it was very good.  My wife had the halibut, and it was very good also.  Overall, the meals were all good.  The service was a little slow, but we had a very nice time.
We did have an issue with the Creme Brulee.  We ordered 4 of them to share, and they took 40 minutes to be served!! (I know its hard to believe, but we would have normally left, if not for the band and the cocktails.)  My thoughts on the Creme Brulee was that the carmelization was perfect, but the custard was REALLY runny.  I have a feeling that they forgot about us, and then when I said something, they rushed it together.

Overall, good experience, but definitely some work to be done.  We will try it again...

Every time we come here which has been around for or five times we leave so unhappy. The food is nothing special and over priced. And don't even think about doing any substitutions or changes to your food because they nickel and dime you for every thing.

I have used this UPS store with success in the past. However their have been personnel changes recently. I have tried to contact the ownership without success to complain about their employees. 
If you are unlucky to get the old guy that rests his head on his arm while he reads the screen be prepared to spend 30 minutes there. His demeanor is surly at best. He is glacially slow, will ask you the same questions over again, complain that you have sent too a lot of locations. What a jerk. Going to use other locations to get away from this grouch.
Some of the worst food I have ever had in my life. Awful Idunno how anyone likes this place. Moe joes is wayyyy bettter and cheaper and service is excellent at moe joes. Will never come here again.
They got us through a difficult time as painlessly as possible. The payment plan is very generous.

My mom and I saw this place while driving to another restaurant, and it looked so interesting we decided to drop in! It's a wonderful place! 

With how cheerful and welcoming the staff was, it was hard not to get super jazzed about the bowls of Korean BBQ we were getting. Good job staff! Go ahead and take the day off tomorrow! Tell your boss I said it was okay and that you read it in a yelp review... I'm sure that'll hold up. 

My mom and I really enjoyed the food! I'd say it was just the perfect amount of food for the right price. I really enjoyed the large selection of sauces they had. They have a spice scale of 1 to 10. I had them mix in multiple sauces just for fun... and it was fun... it was. Fun. I got the spiced pork and that was delicious; thank goodness it was delicious because I swore to never eat pork again after watching that one film about the alien genetically modified pigs, with that one actress who is amazing and creepy and beautiful all at the same time. Tilda Swinton? Is she a pixie?

I digress. I think this is a great food joint. My mother's one complaint was they didn't have tea. And they don't, so, you know, she's right about that. About them not having tea. Cuz, you should have tea, ya know? Cuz if you don't have tea, you've got other stuff. You see my point.

I came for those excellent tasting Slingers, but they no longer sell them. I decided to get a double cheeseburger meal. I ordered a large size, with a diet coke, tots, with fry sauce. What I received is a small meal, no fry sauce, and a cherry coke. How could they get this simple meal so wrong? I will no longer eat here. Idaho has so many burger joints you don't need to settle for less. This Sonic location is way under my radar for a meal.
Great ice cream!  This little place is great place to run in and grab ice cream.  They have to go quart sizes also.  I like to be able to grab fresh milk and other dairy items while I am there too.
An amazing experience with friendly, welcoming staff, mind-blowing food, and epic taste in music. Highly recommend.

I have use this location many times over the years. It is awesome to have somebody so close that can do so much. I am fortunate enough to get to deal with one of the employees in there named Jacob who is always very pleasant and very efficient. In a time where customer service is unfortunately very rare it is amazing to see somebody like Jacob with such a good hustle and such a positive demeanor make and experience very pleasant. I would literally go a few miles out of my way to select the store even if it wasn't the closest

Came in today to try the famous "coned" pizza. Megan greeted us with such amazing customer service and explains the origins of the coned pizza. Very pleased on the service and pizza was exceptionally good. Cant wait to come back and try the other flavors as well as pick up some breadsticks!
Burgers have great flavor! The homemade ranch dressing is delicious. We had excellent service.

My husband and I just purchased a new trailer here today. The experience was great at first, but turned sour when there were some "warranty problems" with the exterior. Just when I was about to leave a 1 star review, Camping World fixed the entire situation and made sure we left their store happy. The general manager really stepped up to make sure we were WELL taken care of and we are absolutely satisfied with the overall experience. They reconized, took ownership, and made amends with the mistake they made, and because of this, we are satisfied with the overall experience.

Oh, HECK YEAH! This place is so rad. To be honest, we've only orderd it from DoorDash for lunch but it NEVER disappoints. Seriously the second time was even better than the first.

You get a MASSIVE bowl of food. The BBQ PORK IS THE BESSSTTTTTT. the noodles are amazing, the rice is great and the SUACE! oh my gosh. The price is great also! 

I'm excited to be in down town and actually walk in to experience the atmosphere of this restaurant! These guys are doing it right!!! We will be ordering again, soon!!!

I've been wanting to try the burgers here but didn't have any major expectations- it was amazing!! I had the boss hog, loved it. Onion rings were crispy and the bbq sauce had a slight kick. Pork belly wasn't too fatty, really well done. We also had the hangover and the steakhouse. Loved the arugula on steakhouse and the pretzel bun on hangover. Tots and loco fries came out first - also great. Wish we had room for a shake but we'll definitely be back again soon! I want to try their champagne flight and sangria - both looked really good.

I waited seven days before writing this, just to make sure of what I thought was my best lash experience ever...It was!  I have NEVER had so much "retention" of my lashes as with Clayton's.  I have had exactly one lash come off.  In a full seven days.  Previously, I'd have at least two or three fall off within the first 48 hours, and then progressively more (yes, I took very good care of them, following lash protocol exactly as recommended).  His choice of product, and more important, his careful and exacting application, are simply amazing.  

Before Clayton, I'd had lash extensions from three other practitioners (as they'd move on and be replaced), at a nice day spa. But when the last one left, I had decided take a break.  I'm quite picky, and really looked around. Clayton has provided the VERY BEST experience and quality yet!!  Where to begin??  I loved that his website gives so much information. I was also able to make an appointment online.  Then, he reached out, and sent me information about the extension process, maintenance, etc., well BEFORE the appointment.  His space is very comfortable, roomy and professional. And it is so clean! (important, when someone is working around your eyes, nose, mouth, face!)  He is warm and welcoming, but also very professional....and SO knowledgeable!  He told me about the various lashes that were available to me, and gave me his opinion on what would work well for my challenged-lashes (OBVIOUSLY, he was spot on in his selection!).   

On top of all that, I learned more from him about skin and aging  (and this was ONLY a lash appointment!) in one hour than I had in years.   He clearly has a passion for AND dedication to his craft, and seems to seek out more knowledge, information, technique and whatever he can to enrich his ability to serve his clients. His website is a fantastic source of information too -- educational videos, etc.  The depth of his website is just another indication of how much he puts into his practice, 

I've already made an appointment for another service, and like others on here, won't go anywhere else for my lashes either.

We recently purchased a home in Boise. We had 13 window blinds that really needed to be cleaned.   They are white, faux wood.   We called Window Wizards. Oh My Goodness, what a great decision.   Al and Chip came to our home and in less than 90 minutes had removed, cleaned, repaired and replaced all 13 blinds.   After repairing some and cleaning all of them , they look like new, work like new.  Look it's not just the blinds that look great, al of the strings that operate them look great and work great too.   We are so happy with the results.   Thank you WW and Al and Chip.   Great job.
Great, tasty breakfast!  The biscuits and gravy were really good.  Wife loved the corned beef benedict.  The coffee was great too!

Not good. We paid to get sick. When I called to get a refund on the check, I was only given a partial refund since I mentioned that the vegetables were ice cold and we had been sick to our stomachs for about a week my daughter and I. The manager told me that the vegetables were fully cooked and kept in an ice bath so that made them safe to eat cold & scolded me for not telling someone immediately  and made an excuse that the only thing that made us sick was the chicken terriyaki so that was all that was refunded. I basically paid them to make me sick from food poisoning for a week and they would only refund the food items eaten. Not great customer service, food safety questionable and we will never partake or recommend this establishment again. Be warned they do not take food safety seriously.
Good location, the staff is very nice, the coffee is okay, just terribly slow service. If you're in a hurry avoid.

Made a reservation because reviews said they get busy. We showed up a few min before our reservation and saw the place wasn't busy and half the tables were open. The hostess told us they couldn't honor our reservation but could put us on a waiting list. I said but there's many tables open? Her reply was yea but that's what my manager told me to say. Our kitchen is slow and you can't sit down. Even the bar was open and we couldn't sit to order a drink and wait. That's just terrible business. Instead we walked across the street and spent $125 at Heritage Hop Haus. I suggest don't accept reservations you can't honor.

WTF happened to this place??!! Food was AWFUL. only thing served to me that was fresh were the pancakes. Eggs seemed like powdered. Sausage links were cold. Reheated hard and more like beef jerky!! Hash brown was so soggy and seemed raw in the middle it was disgusting. And WORST of all remember how the ham was one big thick piece? I got served a stack of thinly slices you make sandwiches with!!! Wow!! What the hell?? So gross I almost gagged when I got to my car!! 
I cannot believe what just happened!! An American Icon gone!! I'm heartbroken.
Awesome owners that work hard to make customers a top priority. Super helpful and the waffles will blow your socks off!

Tried this ramen place after seeing some great reviews on Yelp and have been searching for a ramen place in Boise. I do feel like the reviews were a bit inflated and I rounded up my review to four instead of 3.5 since I can't give a 3.5. I checked out the website and was pretty excited to try out their ramen as it looked like it would be authentic. 

My order was for pickup and the service was great, with the employee being very friendly and kind so I imagine that service would be good. I tried your standard tonkatsu ramen and added extra char su. The menu says that it comes with a half boiled egg, char su, and bean sprouts then you have a pretty limited selection of what else you can add. I was surprised to see that there was no option to add nori (I've always seen this as a standard option to add). When I tried my ramen I would say it was better than other places in Boise I've tried but definitely not the best. I did get an extra serving of char su that I ordered. The charsu had a strange odor to it almost like vinegar and I wasn't quite sure how long it had been precooked before giving it to me before serving. It definitely lacked a fresh taste. The ramen bowl came with pink ginger and a lot of it so be careful when adding this as it definitely overpowered the entire ramen. The egg was a bit overcooked with the yolk cooked nearly all the way and I couldn't taste any seasoning in it. Overall it seemed to miss the robust, seasoned flavor ramen will have. The noodles itself tasted and looked like spaghetti noodles (they weren't) with some oil and garlic but I definitely kept staring at it to double check it wasn't. The broth was good, not very oily but definitely didn't go with the amount of ginger that came with it. 

I did order the pan fried potstickers as an appetizer and those were great! I would recommend that.

I'd say if I'm craving ramen this place would suffice but in my experience of ramen-eating it would fall lower on my list.

Great vibe and service! The chorizo dog I had was bangin'! The bacon and eggs is a great starter, with the deep fried deviled eggs being an interesting and delicious twist. The bacon doneness should have been more consistent. The shakes are outrageous with things like a slice of cake on top. Will go again next time in area.

If you appreciate being treated with respect by office staff when renting an apartment, DO NOT move here. Yeah the apartment was nice but god forbid you have any questions or issues and have to talk to the staff, you'll regret it. They never failed to ruin my mood and make me feel like an inconvenience any time that myself or my boyfriend called, texted or walked in specifically the women working in the office. 
We lived here for almost a year and on paper the apartment is great. Hardwood floors, vaulted ceilings, in unit washer and dryer wow! Loved that. Like stated in a previous review there was a mold issue in every single window sill. When we talking to maintenance - "omg wow we had no idea this was an issue!"  the maintenance staff otherwise were the only paid apartment complex employees who gave you the time of day and treated you with respect. The office staff nearly laughed in our faces when a lightbulb in the 8 ft ceiling went out and I asked for it to be replaced, so make sure if you're moving in you bring an 8ft ladder with you!!
READ YOUR LEASE OVER AND OVER AGAIN. This apartment love love loooooves to find any and every way to fine you! There were so many ridiculous things they catch renters on that I've never even heard of in my years of renting. Every email about something exciting like the pool opening included less about the pool but a huge lengthy warning about all of the ways they would fine you if you misused it. Every letter posted to your door about fire extinguisher testing or sprinkler inspections was always quick to note exactly how they planned to fine you if you didn't cooperate. Late on your rent by 1 single day because of a medical emergency?? They don't give two you-know-what's. Really makes for a friendly community feeling right?? 
The dog park - wow it's so awesome to have one in the complex, this was a huge selling point when we moved in! But beware: it's reactive dog central. There were NEVER any dogs in the dog park unless they were the ones snarling and losing their mind so much that the owners had to grab them away and quickly leave as soon as others walked past. My 3 yr old dog has never been attacked before and was for the first time in that dog park last fall. 
The gym is another great amenity, I used it a lot! But for goodness sake it has not been cleaned it what looks like a year. I witnessed janitors wiping down equipment and vacuuming the floor but the amount of dust piling up on window sills, equipment and floor boards is so disgusting. And this was in the height of Covid.
Moral of the story: if you come from a customer service background or don't but have a pulse, you will be blown away by how awful and disrespectful their office staff is.
Good food, fast service.  Had the camarones al mojo which was spicy but great butterflied prawns and not overly cooked mushrooms.  Spicy salsa and bean dip upon being seated. Will go again!

Quick, solid service. Went late and they still happily served us. Excellent food. Could be a little bit cheaper to match the portion size (which is still good, but probably the one thing I'd love changed). Flavors are awesome. Highly recommend it.
Burgers were "thick" with very few seasonings.  Left a bad taste in my mouth. Buns were hard. So we just ate the green beans which were delicious . Won't be back

Good fast food for pizza. Went quick. One thing is a when they ask for a tip it is irritating. It puts you on the spot and honestly they are not doing work of a waitress so I feel these places that ask for a tip is ridiculous.
Egregious violation of capacity limiting and social distancing measures. People packed in like sardines, staff not wearing masks properly. Didn't stay long enough to order food, totally disgusted.

This place is amazing! First of all the staff & customer service is the best I've seen in a very long time. Norma (Host) & Alli (Waitress) were so helpful in recommendations for a killer first experience followed by great service! Erik the GM makes the best Bloody Mary's just throwing that out there! Will the owner was kind greeting every table & making sure everyone is well taken care of. 

I tried the Maui Wowie burger & it was amazing! I def recommend this burger if you like pineapple. Their salads are also very tasty!

For drinks I had the Mimosa in a bag, & a Bloody Mary. 

For dessert I had the Kick Starter & let's just say I've been living life all wrong when it comes to milkshakes until I tried a milkshake here. Hands down best milkshake I have ever had. My goal is to go in and try every flavor! 

All in all this place is locally owned, amazing service, and everything from the drinks to the food is delicious! If your looking for a fun stop or to take anyone in your family out this is the place to go you will not be disappointed! 

Thank you again SIDS Garage for making my experience amazing from start to finish!

This is the most frustrating drive-thru place on the planet. Every time you go you have no idea if what you want will be available. About 50% of the time they are out of basic things like cheese or pepperoni slices. If they do have it available it's a very long wait. The actual product once you get it is pretty good but the experience is an absolute disaster.

I guess the "Fresh" part was not in this concept.
I went to the Nampa location at 8 p.m. tonight. 

Music was blasting, the gentleman at the register was very polite, friendly and good at describing the menu/experience.

But what I saw...The noodles I could see were cooked this morning or at least looked like it . 

Dried dark brown noodle stuck on the side of the pan. Most of the lids covering the food inserts were covered with old food particles-GROSS!

Fast casual Asian is not all cooked to order, but at least not sitting there for God knows how long like this place???

Korean food is awesome usually but not like this...:(

This is always a nice place to meet and have a drink and food. You can sit inside or outside, the outside seating along the edge is nice for people watching.  There are happy hour specials from four to six and all day Tuesday,  their martinis are especially yummy.  Service is always friendly and prompt.

Love, love, love this place!!! I was staying at the Tru hotel near here and HAD to check it out. The girl who was working was so nice and helpful that day! We ordered a meat cone and a bbq chicken cone. What a funny and great idea! They were so good!

Awesome  
Very professional! Excellent service AND customer service. I had ALL the locks  in my house rekeyed. I wasn't charged extra for Saturday service either. Thank you kindly for the prompt response, service and the peace of mind that I can now enjoy!

They close way too early, and the manager called me and idiot for not know what time they close. Horrible service and I'm never coming back. Also I  I saw a family of rats crawling around the ac unit outside. Disgusting..

This place was HORRIBLE!! We went for mother's day with an appointment, my friends appointment started on time mine started 30mim after sitting in cold water.  The person doing my friends was taking personal calls on her cell phone, scrolling through Facebook ordering food and texting!  My pedicure was done before hers were even close to being painted.  My manicure started and I was pretty much done by the time she sat down for her manicure.  I finished paid and went to the store and came back to see she finally told them to stop paid them and left with no nail polish.  It was sooo unbelievable hat they would even charge for that! She was there for over 2 1/2hrs and to leave not even completed is absurd. My nails all chipped two days later.  Talk about a waste of $80 for me and $50 for my friend!  STAY AWAY!!!!

Me and my family went in recently for some frozen yogurt.  I asked for a medium cup and my wife and daughter got smalls.  We get back to our vehicle to start eating and it turns out you get more yogurt with a small than with a medium.  This is what happens when you hire teenagers with no adults to supervise.  

The coffee place (Lucky Perk) is just as bad.  You want something sweeter, you have to pay extra.  Only place in the valley that does that.  They lost my daily business too about 6 months ago.

Exactly what I expected for a NY style pizza. Ordered online and picked up through the drive thru. Ordered a cheese with red and a cheese with white sauce pizza. The family was torn on which they liked best. Will be ordering again in the future.

My husband I decided to pop in for a quick lunch on a Sunday at noon. We've eaten there before and thought the food was amazing. Sadly, we left feeling very disappointed. It took about 45 min. to get our food. Granted it was on a Sunday and seats are limited due to covid. The longer than anticipated wait wasn't really the disappointing part. Our food was just not good. I ordered a shrimp po boy. The bread was completely sliced in two pieces so the insides were falling out everywhere. The sauce was very strong with horseradish almost overpowering. I've typically had po boys with the sauce consisting of mayonnaise, dill pickle relish, fresh lemon juice, hot sauce, capers, paprika, Creole or Dijon mustard, Worcestershire sauce and garlic. This tasted like 3 tbs. of horseradish mixed into mayo. Both my husband and I had ice cold fries. He ordered the fried chicken sandwich which he said just lacked flavor. The produce on both looked old. Very inconsistent with our first visit.
Had an emergency and couldn't come home.  Made a call and Meridian plumbing was over in 20 minutes. Fixed problem and charged a more than fair price.
This place does not disappoint. The amazing food and service especially from Hannah, made our night! Thank you for giving my wife and I a new date night location with gluten free option.

Where to start... This shop is very clean and smells nice. The people that work there are SO kind, spoke very good English compared to my lack of knowledge of Vietnamese. Angel was my tech and did such a nice job on my nails. The hand massage wasn't bad either. :)  So pleased with the people and the experience I will definitely return.  A little hint, if you pay cash you get a discount.
Great,efficient and friendly service and reasonably priced. Would definitely refer them!
Rick was prompt, helpful and didn't try to upsell us beyond what was necessary. He explained the problem and was easy to communicate with. He got the job done at a reasonable rate. Thank you!

Soooo good!!! We love to get their crispy chicken sando, fries (the best fries), and a waffle to split for dessert!!! Everything is always so fresh and tastes delicious!! Our favorite little brunch spot!

Worse food and service..Even my dogs would NOT eat it...NEVER AGAIN.!!!!!!!
What happened to the REAL DELICIOUS KFC....!!!!!!!!!!!!

I took my newer pickup into victory greens for a load of perms rock. I had a tarp but when I went to grab it, the ignorant front end loader motioned to leave it.. they were too busy. 
He dumped the load down my pickup and rock chipped the entire side of it. 

The owner didn't respond until today, 3 weeks later. 

They refused the claim and said it's what happens. Owner is Tom and he is incredibly rude. 

I've loaded at Diamond recycling and NEVER had an issue. Zambia's either. Plus... their crappy rock is full of dirt. 

Avoid at all costs.

Amazing food! I got the "Not So Whimpie" burger and it was incredible. Very good flavor and the fries were so good. My friend ordered the "Hangover" burger and they loved it. We ordered a bucket of fries and they tasted amazing. The fry bucket is pretty big (about enough for 3-4 people) and we're bringing half the bucket home. Incredible meal and we love it!

Disclaimer:
Waiters, waitresses, and cooks don't wear face masks and seats are pretty close together. When we got to the restaurant, it was pretty packed. If you are strict about social distancing and masks, I suggest you choose another restaurant. My group (3) is pretty strict about masks, but we got a table in a corner not next to many people, therefore it didn't bother us much. We did use masks when getting up from the table.

Love the atmosphere, I don't know if they always play the same music, but you can't go wrong with Blink, Social D, The Offspring, etc... It was like my own playlist was on and I loved that! This spot is now in my top 3 for best burger in Boise, they are more on the expensive side but when you consider that it's also just a fun environment to hang out in, it's an easy exception to make. (However if they were a little less expensive this would be a very close #1 burger in town )  The milkshakes are also insane and delicious, very photogenic for your Instagram if you're into that sort of thing  Check this place out!!

Had some issues with my car so I took my car back in after getting an oil change because the light was on. They told me it was a sensor I paid 178 and left thinking my issue was solved, to find out as I was driving off my engine blew. After taking it to another mechanic I was told commercial tire should have done a oil pressure test and they did not which caused me to blow my engine! Avoid at all costs if you don't wanna lose your money and car! I now have to spend 3000 on a new engine because of this place. They refused to give me a refund as well!
 After speaking with corporate I was told they will not give a refund because they "Did the correct diagnostics". They said they spoke with some different mechanics and they confirmed "That one does not need to hook a gauge to verify that pressure was actually bad, and that simply just replacing the sensor was correct and if that did not fix it continue billing and diagnosing " After hearing this I decided to call 3 more mechanics asking if this was actually true. Everyone said - "We would verify the pressure before replacing the sensor, and tell you you would need to have an oil pressure reading done." That now puts a total of 6 licensed mechanics saying that an oil pressure reading would have confirmed the issue and that would have been where they started. That any shop that fixes without verifying the the part will actually fix the issue is simply out to get money by fixing every issue that could cause it allowing for the company to make money on unnecessary repairs. So not sure what mechanic you guy's talked to but may want to have them go back to school! .


I have now spoken with 10 licensed mechanics across the Treasure Valley and none of which have said the proper way to diagnose is to just keep replacing parts until it works. Going to the chevy dealership tomorrow to get this in writing from a licensed master mechanic!

Pros: as a member you get 10% off once a month on the grocery trip of your choosing + they carry great local and organic produce, dairy, meat, wine, etc. + their in-house made foods are made from scratch and are delicious + if you go regularly at a regular time, you get to know the employees and most are very kind.

Cons: it is expensive to shop here. Even items they have that are carried at mainstream stores are more expensive at the co-op. 

Tips: plan out your shopping trips. Know what you want to buy at the co-op and stock up to make your 10% once a month discount really count. Buy other non-local items at other stores. As for the membership, they seem to offer a discount on it twice a year, so wait to join during their membership drive. If you don't like your membership, they say they'll refund your money. Plus it's a one time fee and then it's good for life.
We have been here twice now. In two weeks! Very impressed and everyone is so friendly! Kids of course LOVED the shakes  we will be back again
Had everything we wanted and the hot food was great.  They must hire well as everyone was nice and went above and beyond to help with questions.  Great place.

This place is warm, and pretty friendly. "Steve" the bartender made an outstanding Michelada, and other delicious libations. Cool atmosphere for sure for a smaller little pub. Food is tasty too. The pretzel is very warm and on point. I highly recommend this place for sure. I'll be coming back.
Great little pizza spot. NY style pizza with a lot of flop. A bit oily, but solid taste. Good crust. Usually I enjoy pepperoni pizza, but the cheese here is better. Solid 7.3 pizza.
They have a wide variety of plants, trees, rocks, bricks etc.  The staff is always so helpful!
We just had the most amazing meal! The environment, food, staff were exceptional! We were a large group on a Friday night and it couldn't have been better!

If only the food and beverage matched the service. From the hostess to the wait staff and then the super nice manager=Service 5*. The atmosphere is lively and the vibe is good. But, alas, the eats. Dry big pretzel app with chalky texture/beer sauce? Sorry I love my pretzels and creamy sauces. Greasy portobello sando. Bread was drenched. Shroom sat center and was crazy small. Fries were advertised freshly cut. Appeared and tasted not. The beef dip was great tho! 
Gosh now I feel bad, but...we sat across from the bar. Watched the fellow make drink after drink with less than a shot each. We each had "one". Shortest drinks this side of Utah lol. Order the wine! It's a fair pour. I wish I didn't love food like I do so I likely won't go back. Darn cuz DT Meridian is growing and happening.

This is the 2nd time I've been to this car wash.  The first time they did an OK job, not worth the money but it wasn't too bad.  I decided to try again today and was VERY disappointed this time.  My wheels were still filthy.  They did not bother to wipe the wheels down at all.  My side mirrors were still dirty and weren't wiped down.  The front end was still dirty, the windows were not wiped down...
My back hatch closes automatically by a button, but the bottom tailgate has to be semi slammed shut.  It wasn't closing when the guy tried to close it and he was trying desperately to force it closed by pushing on it instead of coming and letting me know it wouldn't close.  Luckily I seen him trying to close it forcefully and ran out and showed him how to close it.
I just think I will not go to this car wash again.  I feel some of those workers are lazy.  I really wish I would have waited to leave a tip in the mailbox!
Great coffee.  Great breakfast. Great menu. Great atmosphere. SUPER DUPER waitress (Lexi)!!

I've been here multiple times for meetings and just casual drinks on the patio. Nothing but good things to share about. The brunch menu is fantastic with so much delicious items to choose from. The menu is just as good if you choose to eat at dinner time. Bartenders and staff are all very knowledgeable and friendly. Highly recommend.
Wonderful food, great patio and Ivonne was a prompt, attentive and friendly server, kudos to her!

If your hungry don't go here! After traveling from Alabama to Atlanta and flying home to Idaho I decided to take my twin friends to a late breakfast. 

First we ordered the grand slam breakfast. I ordered basted eggs because I wanted the yolk runny and white cooked. When the order arrived at our table the white and yolk were both very runny so I ordered eggs over easy. 

After reading the correct cooking method I was assured that the white would be cooked and the yoke would be runny. It returned the table and the yoke and the white we're still both still very runny. 

The honey jalapeño bacon was burnt and quite foul tasting. The biscuits and gravy were served and the gravy was cold. 

The third time I sent the eggs back I decided I better ask for over medium. When they arrived at the table the yoke was runny and the whites were still runny. 

By this time my appetite was totally gone. After sending so many things back and getting them back worse than they were in the beginning I no longer had any appetite to remain at that location. 

We waited for over 30 minutes just to get our check and a togo box for pancakes that were not eaten. 

They were not busy so I do not understand the problem with the cook or waiter but our entire meal was very undesirable. 

The staff was friendly but after asking to be served the right kind of food they were ignoring us.

I am sorry to say Denny's will no longer be a choice even if they give you a free birthday meal they could not pay me to eat there again.
Terrible Company. Thankfully someone with a brain got on the phone and was able to assist me. I appreciate her

Called 2Q yesterday morning to set up an appt at 6:15. Showed up to my appt and asked to get the set attached. However it looks nothing like the picture I showed them, color, length, shape or design. They are very bulky and no where near the shape I wanted. No attention to detail was paid.

I recently had a session with Arlene for  anxiety and sleep issues. These seemed to develop with the onset of the  Pandemic/Quarantine. I felt like I was stuck in a vicious, repeating  cycle and was exhausted.
She helped me identify what was happening and  reconnect with my Inner Child. She also provided me with helpful coping  tools. I am feeling and sleeping better and feel a profound sense of  relief.
She is kind, empathetic and an excellent hypnotherapist and I would highly recommend her."
Janis Carrion

We stayed here for a couple of nights while in town to see family.  I really don't have anything negative to say.

The rooms were clean.  The breakfast was good (especially for free) with numerous options.  Our finicky kids found something to eat both mornings.  The beds were comfortable.  Good on all accounts!

We stopped in after hearing they supported military families. We got burgers kids meals fries and shakes. Wow. Delicious. Get the shakes to go they are huge! Friendly and fast service. Great place. Burgers are pricey and don't come with a side. But they're good. The chorizo dog was also yummy with a brioche bun. The truffle fries are really good.

I wanted to thank Roscoe that helped me at the S. Progress store in Meridian. I needed to pick out a different grout color for our kitchen project and Roscoe was very generous with his time in narrowing down the right color. He gave me good advice and answered all my questions. The project turned out looking exactly how I had hoped!
It is very hard to find great customer service these days, so thanks again Roscoe for going above and beyond!!

Here helping a friend with a trade in. 
Place is swamped and even with a reservation there's a 45 min wait. 
Honest clean business and the staff could not be friendlier. 

Second time I've used them and so far so food.

Negligent at best, willful disregard of my instructions at worst.  I filed bankruptcy using Avery Law in Meridian.  I asked to sign a re-affirmation of debt for my car because I wanted to keep it.  The lawyer advised me against it but I insisted and finally got the paperwork signed even though I had to pester them to get me the paperwork.  Still have a signed copy of it.  Found out several months later as my car was being reposessed that the attorney never even filed the paperwork with the bankruptcy court.  To add insult to injury I get a letter in the mail from Avery Law on April 16 (dated April 1) that I had till the 15th of April to pay off the car or get it refinanced if I wanted to get the car back.  No phone call from them even though it was extremely time sensitive.  Considering filing charges against them.

Kiddie Cones are $2 .... the same size, and a dollar less than the single scoops at local Baskin Robbins locations.  And, you can really taste the dairy as their ice cream is very milky and creamy.  

We had a scoop of bubble gum: 
Bubble gum flavored with bubble gum pieces
.... on a cone and it had a milky bubble gum taste with small pieces of bubble gum throughout.  Traditional bubble gum ice cream has gumballs in it, these were small square pieces and bits.  

We also had a scoop of heavenly hash: 
Chocolate with Girl Scout Thin Mint cookies and a caramel ribbon
.... you could taste all the ingredients and in the correct proportions and was quite tasty.

The place is clean, with a lot of young staff on hand to take your order and make your cones.

Great company to work with. We have had them out several times to unclog toilets, sinks, install dishwasher and troubleshoot other problems. We have a basement bathroom and have had a few issues. They just came out to look at it and did not charge us anything at all! wow
They are reliable (show up when they say) and charges are very reasonable.
Highly recommend this company!
Fantastic service!! Everyone was very friendly and professional. I will be coming back here for years to come. Thank you so much for the fast oil change!!!!!!
Don't look twice! If A#A gives you a 3 hour response time for a lockout. James will be there in 30 minutes. Thanks for the prompt and professional service!

Worst experience ever!    Pretty sure it wasn't completely our servers fault, so I'll start with that.  We sat outside, waited 15 minutes to finally ask for a server.  After waiting nearly an hour for food, we finally got 2 of 3 of our meals.   One meal was cold.  After 10 mins of waiting for that third meal, we asked for the manager.  This "general manager" dropped the meal - the MOST condescending and rude manager.  Actually rolled her eyes at us a few times.  

One positive - and wish we would have got her name, but a neighboring server dropped out to-go food and apologized for the service.   Kudos to you, thank you for going the extra mile. 

Will never go back here again.  Horrible service.  Rude manager.  Not worth it!!

Found this little spot while exploring the Boise area. Glad we stopped in. The staff was friendly and attentive. The food was also very good. One of the things that makes or breaks a breakfast spot for us is the coffee and theirs was very good.

I had the worst service experience of my long adult life with the Meridian Camping World dealership. Took my newly purchased camper to them May 25,2019, for warranty repair. Got the run around for eight weeks for a repair that should have taken 10 days. Told three times that parts were being ordered but somehow never received until June 10th after many complaints to my service representative. Finally told it would be completed by the end of day June 20. Guess what? Not done. Job needed two techs but they assigned one. I had to cancel three reservations planned for late May and June. Maybe I'll get it back in time for July 4.

Sales person and finance person where great which is why I gave one .

What a great neighborhood spot! So many options to choose from for food and drink. My husband got a steak wrap, and I got a grilled chicken western burger. You get tots or fries. Both of our meals were delicious! Kida meals are available, and come with fries/tots, drink & lollipop. The employees working there were nice, and they'll bring the food to your table after you place your order.

I really wanted to like this place, like a lot. The location is convenient, the store is beautifully appointed and the staff is friendly. So what's the problem? The food. This place is all about the cone, heck, it's the name. But you want to know the worst thing about this place? The cones. There's nothing special about the cones. It's not quite pizza crust...it's just unflavored dough. Beyond that, all three cones by friend and I ordered all had holes in them which made them impractical. The pizza was nothing to write home about and the process takes forever. We were the only two in line and it still took about 7 minutes for our two dinner cones to be ready. Then, for dessert I was super excited to try their partnership with the STIL for an ice cream cone. However the cone ruined the dessert. It's the same unflavored dough as the pizza, still had holes in it, and it was served warm which melted the ice cream instantly. I feel bad saying this, but everything here would be better coneless. Excellent idea, and it CAN be executed properly (here's looking at you Cozy Cone inside California Adventures) however this place, as is, is not worth the money or calories.

This Denny's has the best customer service ever! This dining experience was fun and enjoyable thanks to the manager and our waitress. I called in to complain about the experience I had on my birthday yesterday at the Denny's near the airport, and the manager, Nassa, apologized even tho it wasn't her restaurant. She offered to give me the free grand slam for my birthday even tho it was yesterday. Our waitress, Donna (Moosie), had excellent customer service as well. She had already been told by the manager to expect us before we even went into the restaurant. It was a wonderful experience altogether.

Ordered a pepperoni pizza Wednesday night and was surprised to find it's the closest thing to pizza from the Bronx we've found. My wife was born in the Bronx so that say's a lot about the authenticity of their product. If you like foldable, juicy NY-style pizza this is as good as it gets without going to Arthur Avenue!
This place so rocks!!! People are super nice and really attentive to your order and genuinely wants to know about your day. Alex, Cortney, and everyone keep up the good work!!

Wagyu corn dog bites were disappointing. The batter was uncooked inside and the dog itself was barely luke warm. The quality of the dog was clearly good. Setting aside any execution errors, the dish is very awkward. The size of the bites are way too big so you really can't eat them on the stick as it seems the chef intends. 

Got the mojito, which had excellent flavors, but suffered from a couple problems. The biggest problem was the thin gauge paper straw with a crushed ice drink. The straw instantly clogs and falls apart before you can finish the drink. You're left struggling to drink something with crushed ice so you either risk a face full of ice or you leave behind some of your $10 drink. 

At least they finally have pretzels.

Delicious local ice cream. Root beer, licorice, mint chocolate chip, and many more. Their cheese curds are the closest we can find to Tillamook cheese curds. Plus they have grilled cheese sandwiches that are quite tasty when it gets cold out.

WE LOVE JOHNNY BRONX!!!! 

They saved the day after a terrible experience with Jersey Mike's off of McMillan. 

They literally bent over backwards to accomodate a birthday party and they were so freaking nice and kind. Talk about wonderful customer service! 

You could tell they were slammed when I called. The young lady, Skye, took my order with ease and was so nice! Someone give this angel a raise! 

My husbands family owns a local business and we appreciate this so much! 

There is a reason that they are the best pizza place in town! 

Thank you, you guys!  You have no idea how happy you made 20+ kids and parents!

We've been there a couple of times ...  so we've tried several things - Spendy....Very. 
But the burgers are great.  Green beans are good, and spicy candied bacon is yum.  Fried Deviled eggs, not my favorite - they've got pretzel bites with beer cheese - tater tot appetizer "with bang sauce" and pork belly is good but everything is kindof a gut bomb.  

GREAT bread and butter pickles on their chicken sandwich- i will try that next time. 

My son got a 12.50 milkshake and it was over the top - with a piece of chocolate Nutella cake shoved in the top. 3 of us didn't finish it, with more food coming behind it lol

not sure if you're on a diet this is the place for you but it has a cool vibe and fairly good service. 

Like the bloody Mary's !

You just have to try this place. It's across the street from Sephora, inside the Village. I will say, parking is very limited but it's worth the walk. Service was OUTSTANDING. The restaurant decor is an entire vibe. 
Kids options are very limited (chicken fingers or burger with no sides included). Also, your meal does not come with a side. You order everything individually so it does add up. You must definitely try the candied bacon and regular fries. Both 10/10. Here are some pictures of what we got this time around.

I've been here twice, once under previous restaurant name and once with Terri, both were good experiences! Nice breakfast and lunch place, plenty of seating, good food, and friendly staff. I had the corn beef hash and it was very good! Meat was lean, hash browns were solid, and eggs go well with with both items. Didn't get a pic of the toast but it was also very tasty! Had a good jam selection. Very good breakfast place and would recommend.
Such an awesome idea! The pizza was amazing and so was the customer service, very kind! Would give them so much more than 5 stars if I could!

The last couple of visits were very disappointing. I bought the $25 wash and it was more like a $10 wash without interior service. There were suction cup marks on the inside of the windshield from radar and GPS, and those marks were still there - in fact none of the glass, inside or out, was cleaned. I specifically cleaned most of the bugs off the front before I went down and there were still bugs on the headlights, etc. None of the interior was wiped down at all. They were busy so it took 35 minutes to get my car back. Apparently the kids there were just trying to get through the line as fast as they could. So I am now looking for a new place to get my car washed. $25 isn't a lot of money but when I pay a business for a service I kind of expect them to give me close to my money's worth - I'm really funny that way since I have run my own business for years and am a stickler for taking the best care of my customers that I possibly can.

Been here twice now- the first was during lunch.  I wasn't all that thrilled- BUT- it was good enough to come back and give them a second shot.
