And I'm glad I did.  Dinner was much better than lunch.  I got fish & chips cause that's what I was craving (some of the best fry sauce in the TV) and husband got the "'Cuz I'm a cowboy baby" burger.  We shared the Wagyu corn dog bites. 

It was all great.  Server was on top of it, and it was just a very nice night on the patio.  Very glad I came back, and I plan to do so again- great local spot!

Always hear bad things about Camping World and Good Sam. But I am here to say it is still the best place to find RV accessories on the road, and then with the Good Sam discount to boot its awesome!  Then there was Jackie she is the BEST, knew where everything was and everything we needed to go with it. Then found a tool we could borrow so we could put the rack on our Jeep so we could get everything back to the rv since we have a small Wrangler. Jackie also helped us add more time to our Good Sam membership with freeee months and also explained that we could use our GS card in conjunction with our Gas Buddy Card at Pilots to double the discount!Highly recommend!

This little coffee shop is incredible. Lucky Perk is full of character and charm. The baristas are really nice with smiles to share. This place reminds you that you can have great coffee without the sterile almost hospital feel of Starbucks. 
If you haven't been yet, come check them out and fall in love with coffee all over again.
Yummy coffee drive thru that's kind of hidden! The drinks were yummy and the employees were so sweet. They also have a punch card!
Great burgers and tasty milkshakes. Loud rock n roll, quick service..... I thought it was great. Only reason I didn't give it five stars was that it's a wee bit pricy.  But otherwise it was a treat.

We stumbled upon this place quite by accident, using Yelp to find ourselves  another good breakfast after seeing the very crowded seating in Joe Mama's. The staff at Terri's was friendly and welcoming, the tables were spaced so that my husband and I felt very comfortable with dining indoors, and we observed good cleaning protocols used between diners.  Oh, and the food we ordered was absolutely delicious! Fresh, hot, served within a short wait time.  We will definitely be returning to Terri's.
We found this place with Yelp reviews late on a Friday. Highly recommend making reservation. We waited 45 minutes for a table. Food was good, service friendly.

I've been to this pub several times.   The last two times I've asked for a beer list,  the response is "what do you like?".  I like lots of different types of beer depending on what I'm going to eat.  When pushed further about a beer list, I was told there are only 6 lists for the whole bar and they are outdated anyways.  What?  THIS IS A PUB!!!  I asked what types of lager they have...Kona and Blue Moon?  WHAT?  Blue Moon isn't a lager.  I ordered a Kona. I told him a beer list would be helpful and thought a list might show up.  No list ever appeared.  My second drink was water.

The atmosphere and food is good.

I suggest Rudy's get a beer list on each table.

Fun appetizers and magnificently huge milkshakes! Wow! 

Restaurant: Located in The Village in Meridian, which I consider a death sentence for most restaurants. This place has has enough going for it that it will likely flourish and hopefully get the property owners to allow fun places like this to replace the usually bland and unimaginative selection commonly found here. Inside you'll find a retro decorated eatery with classic and hard rock blasting. 

Menu: Great selection! Every offering tempts you with interesting combinations and remixes of old classics. Loaded tots? Yes please! Spicy candied bacon??? Hells yes! 

Food: The burgers are no slouch, likely the best burgers I've had in Boise, or Idaho for that matter (big boast, I know with Boise Fry and Big Judd's but a few minutes away. But the stars of the show are the wacky appetizers. You could feed a family with a few of their apps and some shakes. Which brings us to the shakes. Think super Bloody Mary except with ice cream and sweets. They're amazing and have extras skewered to the top for added enjoyment. 

Overall: will come back and will enjoy again and will bring friends.
We love this place!!!  So yummy!  Loud. But yummy!!  The bacon is a must followed by any burger!  I did mine open faced this time.

Utter disappointment. You know those days when you just NEED something to go right? This was that thing. This was the first time in a while that my husband and I were able to go out following a major injury. It was supposed to be a belated anniversary and birthday dinner, and much-needed evening out of the house after difficult workdays. We arrived, met with the host and we're seated on the patio at a table that the host apologized had not been cleaned. Not ones to fuss, we told the host not to worry about the dirty table; it was a large table and was just the two of us, so we instead opted to sit at the patio bar in case a larger group came in and needed a large table. For 25-minutes, we received no acknowledgement as other tables were seated on the same patio, orders taken, dishes and drinks brought by 3 different coworkers. More than understanding, at the 20-minute mark, we agreed we'd wait until the 30-minute mark to leave if not helped. Between the 20 and 25-minute mark, 2 coworkers assisted tables next to us, made eye-contact as we held-up the menu to signal we needed assistance, and went back inside without approaching our table, we gave up. A $10 cocktail and $14 burger is not worth our begging for. We went into this evening and this experience with high expectations of taking a break from our recent challenges and celebrating special occasions, and we're sorely disappointed. Bummer. We won't attempt this restaurant again.

I had a 4 pm oil change appointment and was helped immediately. The friendly associate said, "Give us about an hour". Even though they also replaced my air filter (reasonable part cost, no additional charge for labor) and rotated my tires, it was ready in 1/2 hour. I commented about it and the associate said he was able to put 2 guys working on my car which sped up the process.

Really good ice cream!

I'm not sure if it's because I haven't had ice cream in a while but all of the flavors I sampled were absolutely delicious!
The pralines n cream and huckleberry were especially tasty.

I can see this being a must have anytime I am in the area

The 3 stars is because the service was great, the food was phenomenal and I liked the atmosphere. I would have given them a full 5 stars if their cooks wore masks, their one heavily-bearded cook wore a beard net, there were sanitizer options available, or they simply put any effort into keeping their customers safe during a pandemic. Their plasticware and napkins were all at your table jammed together in close proximity so it was impossible to grab a fork without touching another. And how many people have touched those forks before you grabbed yours? Their tables were not spaced out at all, the servers wore masks but they were below their noses and one of the servers got within three inches of my face when she was trying to tell me about the menu - clearly not picking up on my discomfort from when I was intentionally leaning away from her. I will definitely be coming back again but will wait until after the pandemic. Working in healthcare and specifically radiology, it really is a slap in the face seeing people and especially restaurants being careless about the safety recommendations and mandates that are being implemented. You can still go out and have a good time, but please be don't be a dingus about it. Don't come in if you are hoping for any sort of CDC recommendations being followed. But, I do recommend takeout or delivery from this place. We ordered a variety of options and had no complaints. Their food was absolutely delicious and what I believe to be the owner (and the servers) were very kind and friendly.

Didn't have a good start here:  Spilled my beer @ the counter, couldn't see the "water" label at the drink fountain. The "number" stand is so flimsy it won't stand, and the bathroom, while clean, the paper-towel dispenser was jammed. 

But the beer (left hand stout on nitro) was so good I ordered another, and the Ultimate Mac? It tasted as good as it looks!  I'll be back for sure!

I think this place is awesome. I've been wanting to stop in for a long time and haven't. The place is super clean with lots of yogurt flavors. In fact there is a whole wall of flavors just look at my photos! Oh and toppings galore! 

But... the food! They make great food with excellent presentation and quality products. The young lady at the counter gave me an order number but ended up serving the food to us which I was very nice. The only downfall, for me, was that I asked for onion rings and what came was a lightly breaded pile of onions which aren't the same thing as onion rings. Good for a burger but not a side, I tossed em. I tried my kids fries and they were on point! 

Great Job Yogurtz!

I'm a team OTR driver and finding decent food accessible while on my route is challenging to near impossible at times. 
Soooo, Johnny Bronx pizza is now my go to spot when I drive through Boise area.  I was able to park my tractor trailer alongside the drive through lane, throw on my 4 ways, walk to the pickup window and grab my slices!  I can't begin to tell you how terrific it is to pickup decent food let alone amazing delicious food!!

Now to the important part, the PIZZA: 
I saw Thai pizza... I was intrigued.  Im Asian, love most Asian cuisine but on a pizza?? Had my doubts but I'm adventurous and not judgy about food. 

First thing, I don't eat the crust of pizza. I don't like all that doughyness, I believe it makes me fat just looking at it. It also fills me up too fast thus inhibiting the amount of the delicious toppings I can eat, which is what I care about. Johnny Bronx Pizza has the first crust I've actually eaten and enjoyed. It's super thin, so I won't get fat right?? It's super crispy, yet foldable like NY pizza is supposed to  be, at least all the mob movies show it that way. I ate the whole crust, then licked my fingers. 

The Thai was a special of the day pizza, toppings were red sauce with sweet chili sauce, mozz, chicken, bacon, onion, red bell pepper, jalapeño with teriyaki drizzle over the top . I was worried it would be too sweet, I'm not a fan of teriyaki sauce but I wanted to try it as it was prepared before judging it and removing  toppings.  It was PERFECT.  The heat from the chili sauce was balanced nicely by the sweet in the teriyaki. Jalapeños added that extra bite. Unless I'm getting an all cheese pizza, I don't want to be overwhelmed by cheese, I want the toppings to shine, and they did. bacon mozzarella jalapeño and teriyaki are not even close to traditional Thai ingredients but I didn't care cuz it was flat out delicious yummy satisfying!!

If I lived in the area I'd be checking this place out weekly just to sample the special of the days pizza.  Quick in and out, never get out of your car convenience for a palate delight pizza is a winner for me.
Great Costco!  Plenty of parking and very helpful staff. Love having a Costco close by.

My husband and I had a great experience here this past weekend! We worked with Joe, and he wasn't pushy or aggressive. Very nice, and knowledgeable. We knew what we wanted for the most part, and test drove a couple models. So we ended up trading in both of our cars (which CarMax gave us a great deal on), for a slightly used car. I was hesitant at first to get a used car, as I've only ever purchased new, but it has been great so far. CarMax has a great selection, and you can tell that they purchase nice used cars. Not junky, old onesThe process was smooth as well! I'd come here again in the future! 

*update that I wanted to add: we were told it could take 15 business days for them to pay off our old cars. Which could result in us paying our car payments (since we still owed) on our old cars, but then get reimbursed. However, it's only been a few days since we traded our old cars in, and they've already been paid off! So we don't need to worry about the hassle of being reimbursed. Very efficient!

I've been on the hunt for many years and I am pretty sure I found the best burger in town! Real 1/2 pound hand pressed burger with Angus/Wagyu mix, it was fantastic! My wife got the Nashville hot chicken sandwich which was also great. We got there first thing when they opened, the staff was extremely friendly and accommodating. I was also impressed that even though we were the first ones in and nobody else was in yet, the staff was constantly cleaning and straightening menus, basically keeping busy making sure everything was looking perfect. I have been places where you are the only one in the place and staff is hard to find or just standing around. It was our first time in this restaurant and I can't wait to go back. 5 star burger spot for sure!

Really disappointed in seeing this location slowly spiral downwards. I am a regular who used to come every morning for the past couple of years. All of the beautiful faces I used to see every morning are gone. The quality of the drinks and the service with all the new baristas are poor. Not sure what has happened within the last year or so but my family and I have noticed a significant difference in quality. So sad, it used to be our favorite place.

Was seen here just recently. Didn't have to wait like most offices. Great staff and Sue Jardine is professional and knowledgeable. She answered all my questions and helped get me on my path to an overall better health and lifestyle.

Very disappointing.
This is our first RV purchase and after looking at several tow-behind trailers at other dealers in the area we decided on the 21ft. Forest River Rockwell at Camping World of Meridian. We love the trailer and the salesman was knowledgeable and friendly. The only downside I have to say for sales and finance experience it that it was very rushed. Anyway, after taking delivery at the dealership I thought there would training as we are first time owners and had zero experience with RV's. The person showing us the operations and features seemed very rushed and kept asking "do you have any more questions?". I didn't know what questions to ask!! The whole experience was very frustrating so I sent an email directly to the Camping World CEO letting him know. His office responded (the CEO did not respond of course) and I was able to take the trailer in a 2nd time for more training. Once again, the person showing us the trailer operations seemed to just rush through it and kept asking me "do you have any more questions?". Once again! I didn't know what questions to ask! After owning the trailer for a month, I was able to figure a lot on my own. My advice is if you are a first time RV owner and decide to purchase a RV from Camping World KNOW WHAT QUESTIONS TO ASK!!!

The only reason I gave this One (1) star is that I didn't think I'd get any further with my review unless I did so.  This place is a huge Rip-Off!  I came in with NO PAIN in my feet but because I had a job standing all day, I wanted to be proactive and keep it that way.  I wore the inserts for 4 days and returned them.  My feet were now hurting so bad that I had to quit my high-paying job at the end of the month because I could hardly walk. I ended up buying a different paid of shoes and then because I had a credit on my account, they finally gave me what little I had left.  These people are NOT trained to diagnose your pain although they have some interesting gimmicks to make you believe so.  Go to a podiatrist instead.  Stay away from this place.

Made an appointment to test drive a vehicle. They preceded to be more then twenty minutes late. I can understand if they were busy, but while we were sitting there four employees were discussing a clicking pen for ten minutes. Do not take your vehicle as a trade in with winter tires!! They will tell you that the tires need to be replaced. Will never return and I will discourage anyone to waste your time. Because this business doesn't care about your time.
Great pizza. Everything I've had here is excellent. It's HUGE, so you should only need one or two slices per person. The ranch is also so good for dipping. Well-priced and fast! Totally recommend.

I've been to the Corner Bakery a couple times and I actually find it to be a decent place to eat. I ordered the chopped salad and I found it pretty tasty! I think I really liked it because I ordered it twice already lol so that must mean something. I also have tried the turkey avocado and bacon sandwich which is pretty good as well. I wouldn't say this is the cheapest place to eat though, it is almost as comparable (price wise) to panera bread if you've been there. I have been here the two times and each time I went with a coupon in hand. One last thing I really loved is their hibiscus tea and the toffee cookie!!
We have always loved the food here, it's a cut above.  This time we had a new server named Ivana and she was super nice and very good at her job.  She made it a great experience!

Tried today for the first time and we will definitely be back!!  All our food looked and tasted awesome and authentic.    Hubby had steak fajitas  I had the daily special 3 crispy chicken tacos for $6.  Friendly service.   Clean restaurant. And clean bathrooms too!!  This is the first Mexican restaurant in the area that we've tried and will return to.  It's hard to find really good Mexican food around here!  Give them a try!

This is an honest and genuine review. Not out to spite anyone's name or credentials but just sharing my personal experience. The overall demeanor of Arlene Thompson wasn't very warm or welcoming. I felt quite unwanted and didn't feel understood. When I would come up with suggestions on things I wanted to change she would give me a confused look and frown about what I was saying, although it wasn't very hard to understand. This is what I found off-putting and frustrating. She seemed shocked when I was telling her things I wanted to change like she's never heard of these things before...I thought it was really unprofessional how I felt uncomfortable sharing my personal journey and traumatic events. I see the concept of trying to change the mindset and how I think about my experiences and outlook on life. I felt I could've gotten the same experience from listening to a YouTube video online for free. Wouldn't spend money or time going again to do this. Maybe if there was a more open and judgement free feel I would give more stars. Also I couldn't download or open the recording she sent me so that's a downfall as well.

I am still slowly trying to find good Chinese restaurants around here.  Somehow a bit disappointed with their buffet.

We went there Sat. evening around 8 p.m. after Thanksgiving.  I can understand they are probably not busy because of the Thanksgiving holidays.  They had quite a few almost empty trays of dishes but no intent to refill it.  They also had a few sushi dishes on the side but pretty much gone, selections were not that great.  Lots of the dishes are fried but with bad greasy oil that will leave you greasy taste in your mouth.  I do have to say some of their dishes are not too bad but very few (Thus 2 stars).  Desserts are very limited and not very appealing.

Staff were friendly and great, we have no complaint of.

Fun place to eat! Concept is interesting, and executed well. You get a bit of all the toppings in every bite and it's crispy all the way down to the bottom. Fun spot for a quick, tasty meal. Who thought pizza could be eaten on the go?!?

The restaurant is definitely an experience. Their food was a bit overpriced for what it was and I did not find the food (we got the hangover burger, Nashville chicken salad, sweet potato fries) to be anything special although the shake was great. The service was excellent!

One of our favorite breakfast places. Great food, not overly greasy and wonderful flavors. My only complaint is the owner making people feel rushed on busy days. We were waiting on a friend & she said that we needed to hurry up and order because there was a line out the door. I understand wanting to have the place packed but don't make customers feel rushed and that quantity is better than quality food, service & time with friends..

Very happy with Dan at Meridian Plumbing. He took care of a very leaky hose bib, at a very fair price. No gouging with these straight shooters! I won't hesitate to call them with any plumbing related work in the future!

I am over the moon with my powder brows!  Clayton does a masterful job, and no question, has innate talent.  As important, his skills are honed from so much experience. You can't just do this stuff watching videos!  

I continue to be impressed with Clayton's abilities--and his dedication to constantly getting better.  I always seem to learn something during my treatments--because he is always learning himself.  My brow experience was fantastic.  No pain (and I am a huge pain wimp), very efficient (but not rushed at all), and they look and feel GREAT. Even on Day One (no pain!). 

Clayton also listens well, takes time to find out what YOU want...but also gives his opinion when you want it--and you should. After all, he IS a trained and very experienced professional!  His opinion/advice are part of what I am happy to pay for.

This is about the sixth different (facial, lashes, etc.) service I've received from Clayton over the years, and perhaps the 20th overall with Clayton.  His facility is clean, bright, comfortable, clean, relaxing, clean....did I mention that it's clean?  One thing I noticed from my very first appointment with him years ago, is his attention to the safety and hygienic conditions of his place, tools and services.  He was wearing gloves and a surgical mask LONG before they were cool. ;-D 

I also like getting my skin treatments and products from him -- he puts a lot of thought into selecting what will really work for you. As for the product I purchase, he is very patient about making sure I know what I'm doing with the stuff!

Clayton makes the whole experience a pleasure.  And let's face it--usually  getting lashes or brows done is not "fun."  But because of Clayton's personality and caring, I really look forward to my time at Meraki Skin Spa.  I relax, knowing I am in really good hands, with someone who has my best interests at heart.  Clayton genuinely derives joy from helping his clients feel as good as they can....and that's his special magic.

Wow. Wowwwwwwww. This KFC is really bad.. I came here craving hot wings only to be told they have discontinued them. How in heavens name does KFC discontinued hot wings? As another reviewer put it "even my dogs wouldn't eat it" but I think this is an understatement, even my goats wouldn't eat it! RIP KFC 1952-2021

Extremely responsive, especially for a Saturday.  Responded to quote request within minutes and after agreeing on the work was out within 20 minutes allowing us to get on with our day. 

Very professional and reasonably priced. Would recommend and will use again.

Was not impressed to say the least with their hamburgers or their chicken wrap. I had the 1/4 lb hamburger, that didn't even fit the bun and was tasteless. Would you like a hamburger with that bun? It could have used some seasoning or at least salt. My husband had the chicken wrap, the chicken was super dry that it could have also used some extra aioli sauce. I think three stars is fair enough because their fries made up for the dishes mentioned above.
Be prepared to get taking advantage of and have to fight for any service work to be done. I'd look elsewhere and will when it's time for another rv/5th wheel
Got me in right awAy, did a great job, got me out in about 90 minutes and smiled and were courteous! I have always had great service there!

I'll start this review by saying that I will probably come back here again, but I'm not proud of that fact. Going anywhere your first time is always a learning experience, and I learned a ton from my first trip the other day. STORY...GO!

I had to kill about an hour and was redonk hungry and in Meridian, so the inner-fat guy in me said "LOOK FOR A BUFFET, YOU COW!" I obliged...found Great Wall Meridian on Yelp, read the reviews, ignored the reviews, and went in. Sat down, ordered a water (Baller!), and got up for my first of three trips to their nicely-sized buffet. In my three trips, many of the items I had were pretty good, such as a variety of chicken...things. I don't remember any of the names cause there were a bunch, but I now know that when and if I go back, I will mostly ONLY get chicken things and fried rice, both of which were decent. Also, the fried things were ok like sweet and sour pork and chicken and shrimp. Everything else? Bleh...major disappointment with their crab rangoons and egg rolls and some kind of gross beef madness that literally had me spitting it out of my mouth. Oh, and the "sushi?" NO! Just...no. Awful. 

Bottom line, I went in during lunch time and paid 9 bucks (before tip) for all you can eat Chinese buffet. It's like ordering things off a dollar menu at a drive-thru...you're getting what you pay for. It wasn't bad, and it CERTAINLY wasn't gourmet, or what many in the culinary industry would call "good," however I went in with the expectation that I am going to be getting what I paid for, and that's exactly what I got. For that reason, I might try it again some time and up the star rating, but for now, there were too many dishes that were just UGGGHHH for me to justify 5 or even 4 stars. But again, I wouldn't discourage anyone not to try it and find the things you like and stick with them. I will be back at some point now that I have learned. I'll say this...if and when Idaho finally legalizes marijuana, this will be the most popular place in all the land. College-me would have been here every week HAHAHAHAHA jk...kinda. Now if you'll excuse me, I need to go continue to drink gallons upon gallons of water to try and flush some of the massive amounts of salt running through my veins from eating here.

We happened upon Sid's Garage when we were walking around The Villages at Meridian - and what a great find! The decor, the food, the staff, the music - everything was fantastic, right down to the naugahyde booth seat and the gas pump door handle. I had the seared ahi salad and my husband had the hangover burger. The salad was perfectly portioned, I rarely finish a salad but it was exactly the right amount. The egg on the burger was overeasy, which was pretty runny (yes, I know that's the way it's supposed to be) - the only criticism of that would be if the server had asked how he wanted his egg, since he forgot to mention it.  The only other slight criticisms I would have are the lack of variety on the menu and the prices are pretty high, but the quality is excellent and it IS a burger place, so...still five stars.  Be sure you get the candied jalapeno bacon - not too spicy, excellent flavor. Well done, folks! We're glad we ate local!

I have no idea how this place isn't all 5 stars. I didn't get a picture because we ate everything. The tots are fantastic. We saw the bacon appetizer & that looked amazing. Burgers - my husband said too 3 burger of his life. We truly loved it.

So much goodness in this place!! Started with the happy greetings at the door "very welcoming" same greetings you get when you haven't seen friends for a long time at their house. Make sure you're ready to eat some of that great tasting Snake River Wagu  Beef yumm! I got the Hangover Burger  and it was all cooked perfectly  Bucket of fries on the side hoooweee! and the Kicker Starter Shake oh good lawd  we definitely  recommend this place this was the place to go for sure. Sids Garage for your moneys worth is a must go. The goodbyes were just like leaving your friends house again, happy well wishes when you leave. Great work, food and staff. Great recommendations from their friendly staff. Sids Garage with their great food, friendly attitude and atmosphere are ready for more locations. Thank you Sids Garage, keep it going........

I used DoorDash to get my food and I understand that restaurants can be busy, but when it comes to waiting for an hour and half to get your food you're annoyed. The DoorDash person got to Denny's and said they haven't even started cooking for my order and let alone forgot what my order was and couldn't get it it right. You're better off just going there then getting it delivered.

1st: visited their website and the menu included veggie burgers. 2nd: called to verify and was told yes they do have veggie burgers. 3rd: upon arrival was told they do not have veggie burgers. During our conversation the manager stated, "we haven't had any calls today, maybe you called another store." I told her the # I called and she admitted it was theirs. We stayed and ate, minus the veggie burgers for the vegetarians in our group.  Our burgers were dry, the fries and onion rings greasy, and one of the yogurt flavors tasted like sour milk. Horrible management/PR and nasty food!  #NEVER AGAIN!
Quiche Lorraine! Generous, creamy, warm delicious and served with a smile. Jade is a great server, and consistent American food is a gem on Overland.

Terri has got better since the 1st time I was here, when it was under a different owner. Now, I would rank them among the best Breakfast spots on town. 

Let me give you a tour of it. From the outside, it does not look like much at all. Most breakfast places seem to pay little to no attention to the outside of their business. Why I have no idea, because its the outside of the building, more than anything else, that draws you inside to eat, unless you just happen to have read about, or know of the business.

The only distinctive thing on the outside is a coffee place called BR, which stands for Black Rock. BR did a great job on their stand alone Coffee Drive through building. The parking lot needs help. Some of the spots have to be parked on sideways, but they are not marked as such, so Ive seen people parking straight in, which causes issues. If the ownership is reading this, the parking lot needs to be re-marked strategically and maybe added to to allow for additional parking. A good strategic parking plan could probably add around 10 extra spaces. 

If someone is new in town and driving down Fairview looking for a place to eat, they might well drive right past this place, having no idea that there is good breakfast inside. There are also people that live here, but are driving around searching for a place to eat but will blink and not see Terri's. The inside is also pretty non descript.

Ok, lets move onto the food.

The CFS, or chicken fried steak, is good. Its a Texas style CFS, unlike most every place in town, that makes more of a Northern style CFS. A good Texas style CFS has a heavy crust that is crunchy, with fork tender round steak, and a white country gravy. The steak is seasoned,  floured, put in an egg wash, then coated in something crispy like panko, and then laid gently in oil to cook. 

Contrary to what some cooks and wait staff will tell you, If the person cooking this knows anything at all about frying, the CFS will not be greasy at all!

The only improvement I would make to this steak is that it needs seasoning. A little onion and garlic powder and maybe just a little salt would elevate this steak to CFS nirvana.

Next up are the eggs. This is a pet pieve of mine. No one in town seems to know how to make good fluffy scrambled eggs. Eggs are looked at as an after thought, which is very weird since they are the main staple of most dishes.

Scrambled eggs need to be made with care, and not just left on the flattop and cut up and the last minute. You start off with the mixture. Scrambled eggs should be about half eggs and half heavy cream. Then you beat the crap out of them with a whisk which whips in air, hence the fluffy.

Next you pour them into a pan, not a flattop, and keep stirring them until they are nice light fluffy scrambled eggs. 

Jam. This seem like a small thing, but if you like toast and jam like me, its huge. Pre-packaged Smuckers is no bueno! 

Good Jam has to be home-made. 

If you like sausage, you have to try it here. Its homemade and very good. No tough skin to chew. Just flavor and spice and everything nice. I have not found any better anywhere!

The bottom line here is that Terri's is very good. They rank right up there among the best Breakfast places in town. With just a few improvements though, they would be THE BEST Breakfast spot in town by a mile!

Went here for lunch with coworkers to check out there buffet. 

If you're expecting gourmet Asian cuisine, then you're definitely going to be disappointed! But, if you're expecting quick and easy Chinese food (and a lot of it), then this place is great!

The food is kept hot and plentiful. When the trays get low, out comes a new one to replenish the stock. I honestly thought the food was decent and took care of the "Chinese" food fix that was scratching my stomach for months.

It's not authentic or gourmet, but it's great for the price!

This is the worst company I have ever delt with.  We made an appointment to take our motorhome in. Got there and they had no record of our appointment. We had written a list of what we needed done and gave it to them. 2 weeks later the only thing they had done was change the oil. We bought insurance when we bought it for an extra $10500. The big problem was over heating. After 3 weeks when we tracked someone down. They said well it does get warm when it's hot out. Duh! So we explained the problem after another week they said they weren't able to recreate the problem. Did they take it up a climb. NO. They finally got around to ordering the parts for the piddley stuff. Those would be there in a few weeks they said. Then they said they couldn't fix t kmhe overheating problem it would have to go to a diesel mechanic. We asked well why can't it go there while you are waiting for parts. Oh gee I guess so they said. They finally got it to their preferred mechanic. He couldn't get a hold of anyone at camping world either to get the insurance approval so they weren't happy because it was taking up a bay. Wait another week. called the insurance company and they hadn't heard anything from camping world about the overheating.  They always tell us they will call us on Friday and they haven't done so yet. We were trying to be patient so we would wait until Tuesday and call them ourselves. And imagine that no one was available.  My husband has gone over there 4 times.  We get a lot of lip service. It's been 6 weeks. I could go on and on. They didn't do the things they were supposed to when we bought it either. Save a lot of frustration and don't patronize this company.

I enjoyed my short lunch experience at Eight Thirty Common on 07/15/2021! Located right smack in the middle of downtown Meridian, it's fairly easy to find a parking spot despite the heavy traffic. It wasn't very busy for a Thursday afternoon so we were seated quickly, choosing to sit indoors to escape this God-awful heat. 

They have an awesome menu. Seriously, every single thing listed sounded tasty. I ordered the Crispy Chicken Sandwich (24-hour buttermilk brined & fried, Boar's Head baby Swiss, sweet spicy slaw, tomato, mayo, baby swiss, Bigwood Bread challah bun, $14.75) and requested it Nashville Hot (+$1.00).  It was tasty! The chicken was fresh and the bread is grilled adding a very satisfying extra crunch. Sadly, it was anything but spicy. Like, zero. Save your $1.00 or request they make it extra hot because obviously their meaning of Nashville hot is poorly defined. The fries were fantastic. They are sprinkled with large salt crystals. Also the fry sauce was a huge plus! I'm sure it's house made, it didn't taste like the cheap stuff found at Walmart. 

All in all, I liked my lunch. It was honestly delicious, even without it being all I'd hoped for. I would definitely recommend stopping in. I'll be back to try more menu items and for that 5 star experience!

In town with some family and they recommended we visit. Did not disappoint. Service was amazing. From the time you enter and they all greet a big "Welcome In." to the manager, Jake, coming by and introducing himself to see how things were, to the time we left and they all said "Thanks for Coming In." Multiple people checking up on us and everyone was friendly and full of energy. Last year or so it seems like so many places have steered away from great customer service, this place knows how to do it!
Busy Friday night and the place was loud and full of energy. Music is loud, but great playlist. Food was fantastic. Recommend the 208 burger and the Bacon. Best Bacon Ever! Tried their Red Velvet Milkshake and it came with a whole piece of cake on it! 
Will definitely be back when we come into town next time.

If I could give this place 0 stars I absolutely would. I understand there is a staff shortage but there is just no excuse for a lack of trying. 

We were in town for my son's birthday. We were seated pretty much right away, no menus. After waiting well over 20 minutes for menus to be brought, we went to the front and asked for them ourselves. After about another 15 minutes of reviewing the menu, the manager came over and basically said she had forgotten about us. "How long have you been waiting?" Is what was said. We ordered eventually, leading to another 25ish minutes for our food. They ended up getting one of the plates completely wrong. Not to mention no silverware was brought. I had to go up front to get some. 

The biscuits and gravy bowl was disgusting. It was basically cold peppered water over cold and dry biscuits and over cooked chicken. The Santa Fe skillet was burnt (picture). The burger buns on both burgers on the order were just completely soggy. The pancakes for my son's meal were just plain disgusting and overcooked that not even he wanted to eat them. No one came to see if we needed refills. The only plus was the younger lady who, after I brought it up, said she would comp the Santa Fe skillet because it was "inedible." 

Avoid this place like the plague.

Spent $30 on two milk shakes to go. We waited a good amount of time for our to go order, once we finally got it we walked it across to Big Al's, so maybe a minute walk, when we took the lids off the milkshake just over flowed with a melted mess! The ice cream sandwich that was suppose to go in the milk shake also completely melted as well! Huge disappointment and ridiculous waist of money, as they were such a mess and warm my kids managed like three sips before tossing them.
Really enjoy the food here.  Certainly something different and delicious.  Seems like the numbered spice levels can vary quite a bit based on who is making your bow but have never been disappointed.
This place was great terrific. Burgers and milkshakes out of this world big bucket of fries great environment right in the middle of the village in Meridian couldn't ask for more staff was super fun!

I think Terri made a HUGE mistake firing Amy! I'm sure that it will have a negative impact on her bottom line. Amy was a super efficient waitress and was always pleasant.

I'm sure that the food at Terri's will continue to be excellent and that the other current servers will be just fine.

I still think it was a poor move getting rid of Amy ... just my opinion.

Regards,
Mike and Kathy

Finally found you guys!! Your broth is really REALLY REALLY delicious! It's been a while since I've had as good. However your noodles are sort of a let down.. they aren't homemade are they? They were super soft, almost mushy and that's a total bummer. 
The egg was way over cooked but I can forgive that as it was still delicious with the soup but the mushrooms are just weird and that's coming from someone that loves weird mushrooms. 
The pork though.... wow... it was beyond perfection, freaking flawless and delicious. I think I dreamed about the pork that night. 
I cannot wait to come back in and get another bowl... spicy miso all the way!!

A larger beer selection wouldn't be the worst idea either... just saying... I like beer with my ramen.
The food here was so good! The hotdogs and burgers were amazing and the sweet potato fries were the best I've ever had. The cakes on display were super neat. Will be going back again!

I'm leaving one star and that's generous.  In early May, I visited VG to purchase a yard of perma rock. When I pulled in, nobody said ANYTHING about not using the tarp I had brought to protect my pickup.  They were very busy the day I went.  I motioned to the front end loader that I have my own tarp, he wanted to see my receipt and upon seeing I held it, just motioned me to move out of the way.  He was in such a hurry, he did not allow me to put my tarp on the bed to overhang the sides.  Long story short, he dumped rock all over the side of my new pickup.  It's chipped and has small dings and dents.  I went back in and spoke to a manager.  They neglected to call me back for 3 weeks and I kept calling and kindly asking what they wanted to do.
Today, Tim called.  What a rude person.  He lied and told me that KEY insurance denied the claim.  I called Key insurance and he told me they didn't want to pay for some body work because their deductible was too high.  I called Tim back to discuss and he continually let me know what I jerk I am that they now have a special form and I'm the " flagship" to that form.  He can explain that to my lawyer.  Avoid at all costs.  Diamond street recyling and Zamzows don't damage your vehicle and their managers aren't completely rude jerks.

I can't speak for all the food but my GF and I stopped in here during brunch on a busy holiday Saturday afternoon and we were happy to find space at the bar. Neither of us were super hungry so we talked to the bartender about the food and the chorizo fondito was sold out so we opted for the Brussels sprouts and bloody Marys. My friend got the bacon Bloody Mary while I chose the one with Clamato juice. Both were delicious. But those Brussels sprouts I mean WOW!  We both enjoyed them a lot and I'm not even a huge fan of Brussels sprouts. So although I can't speak to everything based on my first experience I will be back!

Groovy little coffeeshop with plenty of seating, nice furniture, laid back atmosphere, and classy decor not to mention, the coffee really hit the spot. 

A little confused why people aren't coming in to check out this gem! Came in for the first time and was impressed with the atmosphere and decor. Ordered my typical drink, found a great spot to study, and felt comfortable hanging out doing homework (Free WiFi). The owner is very attentive and seems to know/care for his customers. 

Whatever playlist they had playing in the background was just right and fit the setting of the coffee shop. I also noticed that they have quite a bit of food options which I intend to try during my next visit (review update coming soon). 

Overall, great experience, positive vibes, and highly recommend people to visit this great local business.

I went in because I thought my iPhone speaker was broken. I was expecting an expensive repair. The employee said he thought it was just clogged and we tested it out and then he fixed it FOR FREE! I really appreciated the quick service, and more importantly, that even though he was in a position to take advantage and charge me for an expensive and unnecessary speaker "repair" or replacement- he did not! I really appreciated his honesty, accuracy, and service!

We have patronized these guys for years. Purchased gift certificates for friends, and family.  Now, they are not honoring gift certificates from over 6 months ago.  We have about $360 worth of certificates that they wont honor.  Bad business decision. We wont go back ever. There are many other credible massage businesses in Meridian to patronize.

If I could give a 0 star review of these apartments/management, I would! Management cannot keep track of anything! I had put in a notice of vacate at the time I needed to (30 days prior) and when I came to verify a week before we moved, they "lost" or couldn't find anything related to notice of vacate. They also didn't fix our dish washer that had been broken for over 3 months! They kept saying they would have someone fix it but they never did. 

Management is only out to get your money and will NOT look out for you. They are also gauging and raising rent prices ridiculously! They will lose your lease and have you renew at a higher price, do not trust this management/apartments. Highly do not recommend.

On 7/31/21, I visited Eight Thirty Common in Meridian for the second time. Even though we had reservations for 5:30 PM, the place is already packed. For starters, we shared two appetizers:

Queso Fundido ($9.95) - Hatch chili cheese / chorizo / roasted mushrooms / Sonora corn tortillas

Crispy Brussel Sprouts ($9.95) - maple bacon glaze

Both appetizers were excellent, but overpriced. The amount of queso was deceptively little because of the way it was served. It was at best half an inch thick. It was confusing that the corn tortillas were served both deep-fried and uncooked. In the future, I would ask for them all to be deep-fried. Easier to scoop up the Queso with.

For my entrée, I ordered the sliders, which are one of the appetizers. For $11.95, you get a Classic Cheeseburger, Nashville Hot Chicken and Philly Cheesesteak slider. The sliders looked good but I wasn't impressed with the flavor/execution. The best of the three was the classic cheeseburger but it was just so-so. I was led to believe that the cheeseburger sliders was a mini version of the regular sized burger made with American Kobe blend. Based on my slider, I would say there is very little Kobe beef involved. It's also the first time I've seen Kobe beef noted as a blend on any menu, which is suspicious. There was too much batter and too little chicken on the Nashville hot chicken and the batter was overly salty. The Philly cheesesteak had no cheese. When I shared this with my server, he said many had complained about this to no avail.  That lack of responsiveness by business owners is appalling. Don't put an item on the menu called a Philly Cheesesteak if you have no intention of meeting it's most basic requirements. Needless to say, I do not recommend the sliders.

My friends ordered: 

Tres Amigos Tacos ($13.50) - grilled fish / chicken tinga / house braised Al Pastor. I wasn't able to get a picture before my friend started eating but I found a photo from the restaurant's FB page. The tacos are small and overpriced.

Market Chop Chop ($11.95) - Campari tomatoes / avocado / marcona almonds / fresh corn / chopped dates / goat cheese / champagne vinaigrette. I think this is a fairly small salad for close to $12. Also if you look at the photo you will note that it looks like they forgot to add the tomatoes and avocado.

On my first visit, I ordered the Brilliant French Dip ($15.95). It was good, but most like most things on the menu, overpriced.

Eight Thirty Common has a creative menu. The food is good, but not great, and overpriced.

They have a wider variety of books than the local Barns and Noble. The have a far better selection of movies than Best Buy. They have magazines, games, gifts, and collectibles. And the prices are hard to beat. Not only have I had some great finds, but I grew up near two used bookstores so it brings back some memories. The staff is always friendly and attentive and I'm treated like a valued customer when I walk in even if I'm just browsing. I'll also give this place kudos for enforcing masks during these trying times.

I also just wanted to mention the first time I walked in there were like three or four movies on my list and they just happen to be in stock - two of them were still new and sealed but at a bargain price. You never know what you'll find here. :)

One of the best things we could've gotten here in meridian. I hope they last!

So good!  I ordered a comb with a cheese enchilada and beef tamal and it was awesome. We also ordered nachos. They put enough cheese to make this Texan Tex-mex lover happy. Everything was good and I loved their salsa. We also had a margarita and it was strong and good. I'm a lightweight and almost couldn't finish my one margarita.  I will be back here for my cheat meals going forward!

This place was AMAZING ! My Wife A Friend and I stopped by for an early dinner because we flew in from California for a short trip out here to Idaho and we found this place on Yelp and I'm so happy we decided to stop here! When you first Walk in your greeted by everyone which is amazing and the customer service was so on point ! We got the tater tots the truffle parmesan fries the loco fries and the Mac and cheese was amazing !! We also got the cheeseburgers but we were so hungry I didn't get a picture of those but the patties were such a big portion and so juicy ! I will definitely miss this place when we fly back but if you aren't sure where to get amazing food and awesome customer service please stop here you won't regret it !

Previous miscommunication reconciled with Rusty of Plumbing Solutions of Idaho. I'm changing my review to five stars. He was great to work with. I would 100% use and recommend this company in the future. Thank you!

A lesson in inefficiency- 6 people directing traffic and taking donations and I waited for what I expected to be a few minutes behind several cars to drop donations off. Ending up waiting nearly half an hour before they actually took my donations. Pretty ridiculous for the amount of people that were working- I will say on a positive note many place were turning away donations this close to the end of the year. But BOY they could certainly use someone to move along the productivity.

ate here for the first time at brunch,  food okay,  service not much.  The young man who seated us was dismissive.   They need to offer more options fir breakfast potatoes like grits or hash browns instead of 2 large plain chunks of potatoes.  They also charged 8.50 for a not so great cinnamon roll.  Might give it a try for lunch to see if it's better!
Just stopped in when we didn't know what to eat. This place is amazing. Excellent food, the most polite, cheerful staff. What a pleasant surprise.

I called and got an appt for the next morning like I was wanting and when I arrived they were ready for me. They did the nail length and shape the way I asked, the polish the way I asked, and the thickness of my set is great! I went to a different place last month and they were weird shapes and thick - tip top did great!! I love my nails! And then I got a delux pedi and it was so relaxing. I had a great experience. I will be going back for sure!

Best burger in the Treasure Valley, and it's not particularly close. The beef was perfect - tender, juicy, perfect crust and perfectly cooked. The bun was on-point and the toppings were absolute perfection. Our group tried several burgers and the hot chicken sandwich and they were all top-notch. I'll say it again- this was the best burger in Boise and probably the best I've ever had. We ordered three apps:  fried deviled eggs, bacon-wrapped dates with goat cheese, and candied jalapeño bacon. Each was fantastic. 
This is now a must-eat place in Boise. When you have people in from out of town and they want a "BOISE" place to eat - this is it. They won't be disappointed.

Terrible fucking company with even worse managers. No one but one person knows how to do their job there. They are always understaffed and the managers always conveniently seem to be in the back "working" while they have maybe 2 regular associates in the front. I literally saw a manager walk out, see it was busy, and walked right to the back. If I could give negative stars I would. Fucking ridiculous. Worst management. 
Avoid: Shane/Mark

We love to support local business and this place makes it easy to do so! The atmosphere is great, the staff could not be friendlier, met the owner who asked several times how everything was and gave us the run down on the menu, great guy. The food was AMAZING! Highly recommend the fried pickles, the Mac n cheese was the best I've ever had! Burgers are high quality and delicious!!

Oh sids garage, you continue to impress me! We went to the meridian location last time where you order at the counter then find a seat. 
This time, we visited the Boise location. The servers take your order at your table so that's nice. The servers were all super friendly and attentive. We got their tots, because that is a must have at this place! Their candied bacon was too delicious for words! We ordered their boss hog and the 420 shake. First of all, the 420 comes with a chocolate ice cream sandwich with ribbons of fudge sandwiched in between the ice cream. There's chunks of Oreos althroughout the shake. The burger is cooked to perfection and the bbq sauce has a nice kick to it! Our entire table was so impressed with this place and will definitely be back!!!!

Dang. Holy Toledo. Great Waffle House and speedy, friendly service. My fiancée and I first ordered the Breakfast Sammy and the Sausage Sammy "for here", which was ready in about 5-10 minutes with about 75 percent store capacity. After that, we ordered a couple waffles from the "sweet" menu, was ridiculously scrumptious. They could have better coffee, though, but then I'd need to rate it 6/5. 

I don't know why some crazy people say they're not safe during the China Virus, they were safe.

Great food and our server was very sweet. The staff weren't wearing a mask but the hostess was? It was busy when we first got there but then it slowed after a little bit. The mimosas were fantastic, just the right amount of oj and champagne. Our order was all right just didn't all come out at the same time, the server mentioned that a cook walked out of the kitchen during the morning rush which I understood. Just having the servers wearing masks would make me more comfortable.

Absolutely amazing! From the ambiance (loads of fun) to the service (shout out to Erik who was the best) to the absolutely delicious food! This place has it all. Yes it's a bit spendy for a burger spot, but everything is top quality and you definitely get what you pay for. 
Make this your choice for your next meal out. You won't be disappointed!
Truly love this place! Have really enjoyed the takeout during covid but they are still providing covid precautions for indoor dining! The quality of food is truly amazing! Will definitely be back!

8/01/2021. Steak burger, Chicken sandwich, and fries were so good! Very unique, a lot of flavor. Definitely recommend Sid's Garage. Staff was very outgoing, welcoming, and friendly. It a bit too loud, and feels compact, however that does tie in with the theme/ vibe. Great experience!

Food is amazing but the service is incredibly slow! No matter who my waiter is they are slow. Not sure if it's the food that's slow or the waiter. As soon as you sit down expect to wait 20-30 minutes before someone comes to take your drink and food order. And the hostess likes to get angry when you ask to sit outside.

This is a cute shop. They offer you a soda or water when you come in. I got a pedicure, which was really nice sitting in a great massage chair. I thought the massage was ok...it was a good length of time though. Prices are a little high starting at $30. I took an extra star off because the lady could not speak any English, and I was not able to communicate anything to her.

This place is great! The ice cream is delicious, it's super creamy and has wonderful flavors. We tried German chocolate and monster cookie, both were excellent. We also got the sandwich meal and the grilled cheese was good and soup tasty, those were 4 stars. The price is perfect for the meal- quite affordable. 
We also appreciated that the store required masks. We felt very safe and comfortable picking up our order. I work at the hospital and it means a lot when businesses are trying to help prevent the spread of this virus! 
Perfect place to stop by to pick up a quick and delicious meal!

Just wanted to share.
We purchased 3 trees during the "buy a tree we will plant it for free" promotion.
DeAndre and Judah came yesterday as scheduled to plant them 
What a great team! They were professional, worked well together and got the job done beautifully!
Thanks guy!

Reed's Dairy is my favorite ice cream of all time. Hands down. Which says a lot since I am well known for my love of ice cream. 

I grew up in Idaho Falls which is where the original local dairy is located. Every time I went home to visit my parents I made sure we made a stop at Reed's. So I was ecstatic when they opened up a branch in the Treasure Valley. 

Their ice cream is incredibly creamy and flavorful. Plus the scoops are huge! You get a lot for your money. They have crazy cool flavors that are always changing.

But their chocolate milk is a MUST!!!!! It is made with potato flakes (Idaho, Idaho!) which sounds disgusting, but I'm telling you, anyone that try's it is hooked for life. You'll never taste anything more creamy and chocolatey. It's expensive, but totally worth it. 

My favorite thing in the menu is cookies and cream ice cream and a brown cow which is a float with chocolate milk instead of soda. 

And of course, don't forget to grab a grilled cheese and tomato soup for lunch! Great value!!!

Locked myself out of my apartment on my way to get ice cream... called our apartment & it was going to be a long wait. Did a quick google search and he came up. I called and he answered very quick. Quoted me a great price over the phone and was at my door with his dog in 15 minutes! Quick and easy! Thank you, again!

Ever come back to a restaurant that you absolutely adored the first time only to be let down horribly the next time? I have unfortunately plenty of times. BUT NOT THIS TIME! I fricken loved this place the first time, and now after coming back I'm ready to commit to a long term relationship! Oh my God they have the best burgers period! Their fries tie the list of my all time favorite from Hugo's Deli, and the shakes!!! The monthly special  shake is described on the website as "Bourbon barrel aged chocolate syrup, chocolate ice cream, bacon, nitro stout whip, toasted marshmallow" I call it Manna from Heaven! They got this recipe from God in a vision I'm sure! Thanks gang for making my Fathers Day a great one!
Perfect for our late lunch. Definitely get the Brussel sprouts! Perfect little green space for kid play after eating. Service was wonderful, margarita was delicious!!!!!
Yummy ice cream. Amazing milkshakes. You can have them mix the milkshake with chocolate milk instead of regular milk and it's SO GOOD. Highly recommend.

Set an appointment to go over the sever adverse reaction to new heart medication. I received no less than  4 reminders for my appointment on 10/29/20 at 3 pm. I show up to find a note in the door that they decided to close until 11/4/20 so they could update their computers.  Now here I sit having issues with my heart that my only option is to go the the emergency room. Your disregard for my healthcare is astounding.  How about a phone call to say are you ok with rescheduling.

I came last night but there were lines(Sat night), so I tried next door(Mex).
Then I came back tonight and fortunately we were able to get table right away!

We got Tonkotsu Ramen and Tan Tan Men and both came perfect.
It has been long time since I finished whole soup!
For sure this is best Ramen place in Idaho.

Customer is only half right here. I asked my Waitress Kristina if they had gluten free pancakes, and my waitress said Yes and went on to tell me that I could add a choice of fruit in my batter, I asked if it was extra, and she said No it was not extra and I was charged 3.75 extra on my receipt. Mentioned to my waitress that I was unaware that the gluten pancakes were extra.. she went to see if she could make it right with the owner. And the owner came back with a new receipt and said, "I went ahead and took 2 dollars off(not the whole 3.75) and completely ignored the fact that I was unaware that it was extra when  I made mention to her (the owner) . all she said was, "yea well, she was supposed to go over that with you". I had to literally argue with the lady to take that extra 1.75 off my receipt. Pretty ridiculous if you ask me. It's more about the principal than the amount. If she had gone over with me that it was extra, I would have just got the regular pancakes. I'm not on a diet that restricts me from eating gluten, Just that it was a healthier alternative. I won't be coming back to say the lease. Make sure to go over your receipt with this place. They will get you on the extra charges if your not paying attention.

When I called to schedule my work, I was quoted a very acceptable $95 to have a sink removed. They were on time and courteous, then the bill showed up today and much to my surprise it was only $45. The only disappointment was that they don't work on weekends, so I didn't have the pleasure of working with them again when I had the sink put back in. Of course one does not hope for future plumbing problems, but should anything arise, I'll be glad to invite this company to my home again.

My husband and I have been here 2 times With friends and both times loved our experience and food. The customer service has always been very friendly and superb. Our favorite menu items are the chicken sandwich, Mac n cheese topped with Dorito dust and the steak salad. We also love their beer and cocktails. I do recommend making reservations they are always busy!

Called to ask if a certain shrub was currently in stock. Gary from the garden department was too lazy and sarcastic to bother checking for me, stating that they do not keep inventory on shrubs. When I pressed him to physically check, his exact words were, "Sure, I'll put you on hold while I go check every single shrub here". Gary is reason enough for me to never shop the garden department at Home Depot again. Thanks, Gary.

I'd like to start this by saying that the review is really a 2.5 or 2.75.. not quite a 3* though. 
This "gastropub" is in the same spot that the Flatbread restaurant was in downtown Meridian. From what I've read and heard it's owned by the same people. After this last visit I can assure everyone that a lot of what is wrong is just growing pains and poor hiring decisions, so a lot of what's wrong here should work itself out.

Service: I made a reservation. I was asked if I wanted a tall table or a regular table... I said a regular table... we were seated at a tall table. 
We ordered a app and a salad....they both came out at the same time... no where near as big a deal as when the 2 entrees then came out 5 minutes later. We told our waitress to take the entrees back to the kitchen so that we could enjoy our two starters. 
The waitress never asked about our food, only if we wanted another drink... when we had next to full drinks... meanwhile our waters were next to empty the entire meal.

Food: Aside from the server/kitchen blunder with coursing... it was better than ok. The Brussels sprouts were REALLY charred. I like a roasted sprout but these were over. The dish was SOOOO sweet that I had no idea there was bacon in it... how do you overpower bacon!?!
The beet salad was awesome! The beets were very well cooked and I loved the amount of goat cheese. I'd like more arugula though and a bit less dressed. 
My wife had the Salmon entree and it was so over cooked that all I could see in my minds-eye was Gordon Ramsey smashing it and throwing it against a wall. The asparagus on the plate were also so over cooked that they went untouched. The mashed potatoes were delicious. 
I had the 16oz ribeye, med-rare. I ended up with a mostly medium steak.. not the end of the world but just not what I ordered. The blue cheese compound butter was amazing as were the roasted garlic chips. However my dish also suffered from horribly over cooked asparagus that went untouched.

Overall: I think there is a lot of promise but as of now it still feels like a soft open. The servers feel more like cocktail servers than food servers.. as ours wasn't very familiar with the menu. 
I really cannot believe that they took out the pizza oven... my steak would have been SO MUCH BETTER if it was finished in a wood oven. (EVERYTHING is better finished in a wood oven haha!). The lighting is super bright. We had a early reservation, I kept expecting the lights to be turned down... they never were... felt sorta cafeteria like. 
I think after looking at the menu I was expecting more of a bistro/gastropub but whatever I was expecting this wasn't really it.

As an out-of-stater I don't get over here very often, but when I'm in town I come for the chocolate milk with potato flakes! It's the stuff of legends and I always buy extra to freeze and bring with me on my flights home! I've done it 6-7 times and don't planning on letting up any time soon!

The burger was excellent. Be careful of the fries as one order can feed three or four people. The truffle Parmesan fries were good but not one I would get again. The water or the ice was not filtered and tasted terrible. The place was packed and noisy.

We got our 40' Class A washed at Blue Beacon in Fernly, NV and almost as soon as we left, headed for Boise, the refrigerator started beeping.  We tried several fixes, pushing various buttons, opening the vent cover,etc to no avail.  When we got to Winnemucca,  we phoned Camping World, in Meridian, ID and spoke to Lee in Service.  He was very apologetic, saying he probably wouldn't have a spot for us for several weeks.  I explained I thought it might be a simple thing related to maybe the RV wash water blasting into the compartment.  He offered to have me in his "wait line" which I accepted and drove from Winnemucca. We arrived and almost immediately were talking with Lee.  Within 15 minutes a technician (Darryl Frar) accompanied Lee and I to my RV.  Darryl tinkered with some wires, then acquired the fridge tech book and tried a simple fix with a magnet. It did not work.  He then called the manufacturer and was placed on hold.  He offered to wait on hold while he conducted some other work.  I accepted and related we would wait until closing time in hopes someone from the mfg. would answer. While setting up an appointment with Lee,  Darryl came up and related the mfg. admitted the spec book was wrong.  We went back out to the RV and attached a magnet to the fridge sensor for 2+ minutes (instead of 30 seconds).  VIOLLA, the fridge started.  Yea.  BEN in Parts was also very helpful in looking for parts for the fridge.  Lee and Darryl and Ben went above and beyond in working me into their tight schedule and out of this problem and in conversing with them were professional and personable.  I must say my wife and I were extremely pleased with the excellent customer service we received.
My husband and I love this restaurant. Our favorite breakfast. Great awesome food and wonderful service.
What's that crispy crunch in my waffle? Sugar, of course! Best waffles, ever. The bacon is good too. You gotta try this place.

I always love to come to cupbop both food trucks or stores when I was in Utah. So, I tried the store in Boise and it does not disappoint. The taste is the same (delicious) as in what we used to try in Utah. We tried the beef bulgogi, spicy pork and, of course, the delicious mandoo...

In fact, the Boise server is more generous in giving the rice, noodles, vegetables and meat... which reminds me of the first time CupBop started in Utah with its food truck and a number of yelp events. 

Anyway, the service is great and they are very willing to compensate the rice with noodles or vegetables if you don't need to much of anyone of them. Truly, the feeling is like when CupBop started in Utah on Day 1.

Good job guys... pls keep the service, the food quality and the "family ambience" continued in Boise...

Arlene is awesome. I'd never even come close to seeing a hypnotherapist before, so it was a rather daunting step. If you're in the same boat, Arlene is a very good introduction into hypnotherapy; I was at ease with her, which is saying a lot. The home office environment is professional feeling and welcoming. Her rates are reasonable, too. But what's important is that she really seemed to invest a good deal of thought and effort into our sessions. She actually went above and beyond to help me with my issues, which is more than I can say for any other therapist or psych I've seen. Which probably explains why I had more 'results' here than with previous therapists. The customized recorded sessions were especially helpful, as I prefer to listen to the mp3's afterward. While seeing her and listening to our recordings, I felt notably better. Again, which is saying a lot.
Super nice and helpful. I came out to a flat after getting my nails done across the parking lot. I drove over here and they gave me a free used tire.

This place is outstanding. I first got to try them at the Ford Center during a Primus concert. They're not far from where I currently live and I never dropped in. But after enjoying their pizza cone at the concert I was hooked. We went in again tonight and were able to order what we wanted to eat in our pizza cones and once again it was amazing. My only thing would be that they come up with the Philly cheesesteak cone because that would be amazing. I highly recommend this place.

I live in a different state (Montana) and found a used trailer on their website.  I was fortunate to work with David.  He sent multiple pictures of the trailer and answered all my questions over the phone (and there were many).  I never felt pressured to complete the sale and I felt he had a great deal of integrity.  We decided to make the purchase.  Once we got there, our vehicle needed to be wired correctly.  The service team was able to move mountains to complete the wiring timely.  All in all, it was a wonderful experience.  I would certainly recommend this fine group of individuals.

Tried Ramen Sho for the first time.   Reminded me of the small cafes that would serve as my food stops in Roppongi and Shinjuku.  This is the real deal.  

I had Tonkotsu Ramen (spicy) and Taki Yaki (deep fried Octopus balls).  Delicious and plenty to eat for lunch.

Strongly recommend.

WOW!   Everything was A+!   The food, the staff, the environment!
I had such a wonderful experience.   The service was second to none (Bailey), I met the Owner, Ashley, and honestly from the moment you walk in the door and receive such a smile and welcoming, from the staff and from the chef's..... WOW....the food....Delicious!!!!
Totally the ultimate dining experience.  
The Blood Mary was delicious with a huge strip of bacon!   YUM!

Greeted at the door by the owner, Will. Being our 1st time at this establishment, he explained the menu, seating options, and ordering. We found a seat, picked our food options and wifey ordered for us. The waitress brought our tray of "community seasoned fries" and fried green beans. Both were fantastic. Only small criticism on the seasoned fries, which I expressed to the owner was the seasoning was a teeny bit much, but I still ate almost the whole plate. Wifey ordered the veggie burger and I had the steakhouse burger. Wifey said the veggie burger was "the best veggie burger I've ever had". The steakhouse burger was exactly as I ordered and cooked correctly! Both wifey and I couldn't finish our burgers. We did have a doggie bag of leftovers! As we were leaving we stopped and expressed our Thanks for the great food and had a pleasant chat with Will and the Operations Manager, Daniel. We highly recommend this establishment to others!! Great food and great service!!

Are plumber Kyle was great! Showed up on time. Called beforehand to let us know he was coming. Was kind and courteous answered all questions that we had. Went above and beyond trying to unclog our drain. We highly recommend plumbing solutions.

Really good ice cream!! My favorite flavors are mint chocolate chip, grasshopper, huckleberry and their raspberry cheesecake! I still need to try others of course. They have so many flavors to choose from and I love how they mix them up. When you walk into this cute little location it smells heavenly! Honestly it's a mix between their grilled cheese and fresh waffle cones! Their portions are huge!!! If I want to try more than one flavor I ask for a single-split and that's about two big scoops, when I want just one scoop I get the kiddie scoop. I understand why people say it's pretty expensive but you get what you pay for. Yummy ice cream and great portions. Their chocolate milk is just that, chocolate milk. My husband and I didn't understand the rave on that but it was good just not the best.

I tried Johnny's pizza today. Got the two slices and soda for $7.50. The slices are are huge. It was the best tasting pizza I've had since I've been in Idaho. Flavorful sauce, nice NY style crust, had a slice of PSM & the Special. Both were delicious.
Convenient drive through too;)
I recommend you try it, you won't be disappointed!
I'll be back...

We went in this last weekend to look at a trailer. Told the salesman exactly what we wanted. They ended up not showing us the one we wanted but instead showed us the 2022 instead of the 2021 which was 12k more in price. We couldn't come to agreeable terms on the financing and instead of saying we'll come back if you change your mind or shaking our hand or even a goodbye he simply walked out like a grown toddler, over $100 a month difference. We went to next door to Bish's today and ended up buying the trailer we wanted and we're treated with respect. Camping world was going to give more for our trade but still didn't account for where $2000 of the trade value was going. Their math skills are seriously lacking. Customer service is sub par. Save yourself the headache and go to Bush's where they are up front and fully disclose everything.

This used to be my favorite chinese restaurant in the Meridian area.  I say, "used to be" because of a recent service issue.  I placed an order today for over $50 worth of food at their Eagle store location.  I am usually happy with their tasty food, fast service and reasonable prices and I must say I am sad to write this of such a good place to eat but here is what happened.  I placed 4 entree orders; each order receives a box of rice with the entree.  I waited only 22 minutes to receive the order at my doorstep where I accepted it and gave the driver a tip.  Upon looking over my order I noticed that 3 of the rice orders were missing.  I went back to the website where I placed the order and verified that I had ordered 4 rices for my 4 entrees.  Yes, I had, so I searched for their phone number and upon finding it, gave the company a call.   I was greeted by a young lady who I explained the problem to.  She asked me what I wanted to do about the problem.  I suggested that they run the 3 boxes of rice over to my home (I live 2.93 miles away according to their site).  I mentioned that I had paid a $3 delivery charge plus a $3 tip and on top of that had provided the driver with another tip.  I also mentioned how often I order and what I normally pay (once per month, $50-$75 each order).  She told me she had to check with her boss and put me on hold.  After a long 6 minutes of dead air, she picked up the phone apologizing for the long wait and told me her boss told her that he had placed all the rice orders in the box my order was contained in.  So, I guess I am calling up to a good restaurant to complain about something that isn't true...?  Hmmm.  I hung up from there and decided to write this review.  Long story short, good food, good value but terrible customer service.  I will not be returning.
Still the same overpriced food. Help is not really concerned. Go to Steve's or Express Cafe for good food and at a fair price.

The ramen house offers very, very small menu, and the dishes I ordered were very very good.  The prices are also very price friendly.  If you don't put high expectation on menu selection and environment, it is a good place to have a simple meal.

** WARNING** 
I understand we are all going through an extremely tough time during all this mess, but that still doesn't excuse bad behavior.. My S/O and I went to this Subway about 2 days ago, and ordered one sandwhich. The total was $6 something and when we got all cashed out the girl didn't give me my receipt. When I asked for it, she seemed hesitant, but finally handed it over. I then read the tip line and noticed what she'd done. My only issue is, if she would have asked, it would have been okay. Who knows if this is a regular thing for her and if so, that is terrible. She could overdraw someones card and really mess someone up. Management absolutley needs to deal with this. It was a younger girl with black hair.
This place is awesome, good food, good drinks, sick music and awesome service. Enough said.

Walked in the door and was greeted by a couple people. Once we came in our server, Josh, he took our daughters order, because she needed to eat, then came back with our drinks. He came back in a timely manner to take my wife and I's order. Food came out fast and was amazing. I had the BBQ Brisket sandwich and it was one of the best I have EVER had. Meat was tender, sauce was amazing, and the portion sizes make sure you leave satisfied. My wife had the BBQ Bacon Burger and it was just as amazing. My daughters over the chicken fries and the service was some of the best I have had in quite sometime. 

My family will absolutely be back to eat there again. Staff was very friendly, Manager Melissa was great to chat with and let her know about my positive experience and all around 10/10 from me. I will be back again and if Josh is working, I think I'll ask for him by name

My husband and I just stayed two nights at this property this past weekend and we enjoyed our stay. Love the fireplace in the lobby and the overall "home" look of the lobby. Jason took great care of us during our whole stay. I liked that he was always there when we came in and out of the hotel instead of other properties where it's a different face each time. 
We had no issues with our room. It was very spacious. The bed was very comfortable. After traveling all day we fell asleep easily. This property doesn't have any USB outlets like most new properties so keep that in mind, (not the end of the world). 
I like that the location is SO close to restaurants and shopping. Downtown Boise is just the road which is nice. I would stay at this property again.

Updated Review: 
We've been coming here since they first opened and I've noticed some changes to the food and pricing over the years. I'm kind of thinking when they got new owners in 2020 that's when the pricing changed and went up. 

There are a couple trips where we've had some inconsistencies in their food. 1. The waffle being as hard as a rock, probably because the cooked sugar in the waffle. It was so so hard to cut, even with a steak knife. 2. The whipped cream not having enough sugar or something to give it that sweetness factor. It was still good nonetheless. 

Now I'm just not sure the food justifies the price anymore. We paid $28 for 3 waffles. 2 grilled cheese with a cup of soup each and 1 red wonder.
