The grilled cheese was pretty small which definitely makes it more of an appetizer sizing rather than a lunch portion. Their cup of soup on mine was delicious and plenty but my husbands was FULL of their cherry tomatoes they never blended so he only got about 3 spoonfuls of it. 

I think in the end this is why we don't come or crave their waffles as much as we used to.

Husband and I go here often. Love it every time and always great service! 

Tonight was just a little extra! I went in not too long before close and they were out of some things (understandable) and Sofia/Sophia did not hesitate to quickly make me some fresh veggies. She was so professional, had great customer service, she calmed her coworkers who were getting a little rowdy (also understandable. I get excited when a work day is ending too), told me about coupons on Facebook, etc. I'm raving now, but she deserves it. Hard workers are hard to come by and I hope Sofia (and Cupbop) knows her value! I saw it in a very short time!

Love me some Griddle! I have a review on the park Blvd location so go check that out but it's gunna be more of the same here. 

The griddle is great. It's solid, like a solid bedrock of  breakfast foundation. Everything we have had here had been fantastic. The meridian location has plenty of seating as well. 

The French toast...especially the Caribbean French toast is off the flippin charts good. The best French toast I have had in recent memory. The eggs Benedict was very good as well, really my two favorite dishes here. 

Go get you some Griddle and eat up Boise!

Our server was EXCEPTIONAL! Aundrey greeted us with a smile and asked what we were up to today and if we were enjoying the sunshine that was just the start! The next hour her personable service will definitely bring us back! We had bloody Mary's, they were loaded with bacon celery and dilly beans,  chicken fried steak which was hot and super fresh! Huevos rancheros with TASTY Spanish sauce and perfect medium eggs. I would recommend all of the above. I ate at the griddle a year or two ago and had eggs and meat my way and found my dish was meh. My guy has eaten at the griddle numerous times and talked me into trying it again. I'm hooked will definitely be back sooner then later. They are also adhering to Covid safety recommendations with a check in station outside. We did have an issue with check in. I gave my name and asked if I should wait the gal said I could stay in my vehicle just check in at 10 minutes. We checked in at 9 min and after 15 minutes noticed we weren't getting seated. People I didn't recognize were. Checking the sheet 4 parties were seated before us. She apologized and seated us right away. The check in process could improve. I would suggest not leaving the waiting area. Finally we sat at the counter and got to watch the team work together they were awesome! Making sure each other were taken care of keeping everything moving stocked and ready. Check em out! I hope you get Audrey!

New owners so previous negative remarks reflect different owners. Decor has changed. Nice new pedicure chairs. Lucy did a beautiful job on my nails and also had a great pedi. Give the new owners a chance and form your own opinion.

Great Mexican food.
Good service and always clean. 
Lunch specials are filling and at the right price.
I highly recommend eating here.
Reminds me of Whole Foods.  Lots of healthy options, alternative brands, organic, fresh made, all expensive.   If that's your type of thing, this is a great grocery option.

I recently worked with the Meridian CarMax to bring in an SUV from a CA CarMax location for a test drive.  I also had them give me a trade in value on my SUV.  

Everyone I interacted with was helpful and low pressure.  Parts of the process were done via their website and via text, which was convenient.  The quote they gave me in my vehicle was also about $5K higher than the other offers I received from similar car buying companies.  

I didn't end up purchasing the SUV I test drove.  However, I would do business with this CarMax in the future given this positive experience.

No complaints about the atmosphere, service, or cocktails. Presentation of food is excellent but I had higher expectations based on the menu. I was most excited for the chorizo eggs Benedict but it was a disappointment. My egg wasn't runny at all and the amount of chorizo was probably around a tablespoon. Carnitas hash came with one egg and again with very little carnitas. Would come back for the drinks, not so much for the breakfast items.

We did breakfast to go and I LOVED IT! Like, I wish I could have it daily. 

I ordered the Caribbean French Toast and it was amazing. I don't normally do sweet breakfast, but when I spotted this on the menu I had to give it a go! Glad I did. 

The staff was so friendly when we ordered and when we picked up. They had a lot of orders ahead of ours, but a 50 minute wait was totally worth it!

Formerly Gelato Cafe, Breakaway is providing a similar menu and experience. What is noticeably missing is the Sushi. The Sushi counter has been replaced by draft beers.l but the rest of the menu is fundamentally the same. And yes, they still have gelato!

They've opened up the space next to the original cafe and created more space for watching games on a projection television system. The space and especially the furniture needs a little updating. They do have a pool table though which is a cool addition.

Breakaway maintained the liquor license so you can still get your favorite (if basic) cocktails here. The patio is still available in good weather which makes this a great place for lunch or an evening cocktail spring through fall.

The food remains very good and the staff is very friendly. I hope that this restaurant has as long a run as the former Gelato Cafe.

I was there for lunch on opening day so the chaos was unsurprising. They covered up with tape the menu options that were not yet available but there were other items that weren't covered up and STILL weren't available. No booze because no liquor license yet but it was also on the menu uncovered. Waitress knew very little about the food. I've eaten ramen at good and middle of the road restaurants (menchanko-tei and ippudo in NYC, samurai and muto in Seattle) and the flavor of my shoyu was good, as was the tonkotsu my wife ordered. Noodles were consistent with what I've come to expect from every ramen restaurant I've been to.

Aside from the menu mistakes and service foibles, my biggest critique of Ramen Sho is what Horix has written: the noodle to broth ratio. That's a real but solvable problem, and it shouldn't be happening. I shouldn't have to press my spoon down into the noodles to get into the broth for heaven's sake.

Other things: the low quality of pork belly. It looked like a few half slices of bacon were slid in there. My egg (which initially wasn't there, the waitress noticed and gave me a whole egg, nice touch!) was a little over cooked with the yolk starting to get chalky around the edges. Also these are fixable. I hear this place is super crowded now so they don't have an incentive to fix their problems... yet. Let's see if they fix them, or if they concentrate on raking in the dollars.

And could they please please please put some tsukemono on the menu!

On second thought I have to go with 2 stars. My wife just reminded me my gyoza were lukewarm. This is the worst ramen restaurant I've ever been to, although even the worst ramen restaurant is still pretty darn good.
Good selection, I wanted to browse more but the store smelled so strongly of cigarette smoke

This place is awesome. The pedicure chairs are beautiful and luxurious. The spa itself is large and has an open feel. It is clean and doesn't have that generic nail salon smell (you know acetone). Linh is awesome and her nail work is fantastic. I had an awesome experience and can't wait to be back.

Today was not one of The Griddle's better days. 

We arrived at about 7:45 AM, before the morning rush, for two orders of bacon and scrambled eggs and one Belgian waffle. We were able to watch the staff, four additional servers, and the morning customers arrive while we waited for our order to do the same.

When the food came the waffle was past its prime, soft and described (by a picky eater) as soggy. The scrambled eggs were good, the bacon was undercooked and paper thin, the hasbrowns raw under their superficial tanned pieces.

The price was full. We won't be back.

We bought a 2018 Keystone Cougar in May 2018 from salesman Tim Huddleston & went back August 17, 2019 & traded it in for a 2020 Cougar from salesman Brian Vetter. Brian offered to take us to Walmart if we needed to go and he fed us a free lunch.
We've had great experiences with Camping World in Meridian.  Joe in the shop was a tremendous help learning all the new features of our new 5th wheel and Efrem Ball in financing was great as usual! 
We would recommend this place to anyone looking to buy a trailer.

Very disappointed in this stay. There was a sign stating that due to low staffing they will not be coming in to clean up daily like you typically would see at a hotel. They have not taken out our trash in the four days we have been here and you have to walk down to the front desk in order to get more towels. The breakfast was also very disappointing. We were under the impression it was supposed to be a nice hot breakfast while there was some hot sausage, potatoes, and eggs other than that there was mostly pre packaged foods. There was a place and toppings for oatmeal but there was no oatmeal in the four days we were there. The breakfast attendants had to be told every time something ran out as they were not paying attention and refilling things as needed. Overall I would not stay at this location again and would not recommend it to others.

I tried to call them to purchase a gift card for my wife for Mothers Day and a recording came on and said that the number I called DOES NOT ACCEPT INCOMING CALLS , I have never heard of any business NOT accepting incoming calls, the phone is a business live line. On to the next Massage place to spend my money!

Soooo good! I honestly really wasn't expecting much when we came here. Thought it was a cool different foodie experience to take our niece and nephew to. Boy was I wrong! The cone crust was perfectly crispy with the perfect softness on the interior. Each cone was filled to the brim with toppings, sauce, and ooey gooey cheese goodness. We got the Hawaiian no ham sub pepperoni, pepperoni, bbq chicken, and create your own with mushrooms, pineapples, and sausage. The pepperoni cone was made to look like a little rose and it was the cutest little esthetic touch. Overall, great lil spot for a spin on a personal pizza.

thanks to Marcos, Jackson, and Nate for their help during our move out.  They were very conscientious and careful with all of our belongings.  We appreciate they're taking care of our belongings during this stressful time.

I can't express how amazing this entire staff was these guys are rock stars!! Filing bankruptcy was so stressful but they help ease our minds  and walk us through everything. I couldn't have pick a better place to file. Thank you so much for everything

Great apartment, brand new, can't really hear your neighbors next door. HOWEVER, if you decide to live here, beware of the new construction of a very large building behind the apartments toward the back of the complex. Construction, noise and extremely bright lights during all hours of the day AND night. Apparently multiple complaints, but nothing has been done. Makes it extremely difficult to sleep. I wish that I would have known of this construction prior to signing my lease agreement because I would have not chose this location (we moved from out of state, and leased without seeing the location, our fault, but should have been advised) it's an ongoing, daily and nightly noise nuisance. Also, have witnessed construction workers using the construction site instead of the portable restrooms.

Love this place on McMillian and 10 Mile in Meridian.. We go there often for lunch.  The food is great and the staff excellent!  We especially like the wait gal Emma.  She always remembers us, what we like to eat and drink...Great experience. Will be back again very soon...like tomorrow.
Cute little spot if you're in the mood for nice comfort food! Chicken avocado tartine! Yum! Nutella love

September 2020 we purchased a 2013 Ford Flex.  They said they cleaned it but it was filthy and we had to spend hours cleaning it.  Within two weeks there were major issues.  They referred us to a 3rd party shop to fix the issues.  We were without the car for a week during the first month we owned it.  As soon as we got it back, it had the same issues.  Back to the 3rd party shop to re-fix the issue and another week without the car.  Shortly after getting it back another major issue.  Back to CarMax Service to diagnose and then referred to the Ford dealership.  We spoke with CarMax customer service and the woman assured us that they would take care of us.  Told us they would handle getting a loaner car and all we would have to do is exchange cars at CarMax.  The Ford dealership called us to schedule the appointment which confused us since we were supposed to make the exchange at CarMax.  We made several calls to CarMax and no one would help us over the phone.  I had to go to CarMax to get answers.  The answer I received was that we had to figure out dropping the car off at the dealership and then go through the process of renting a car and then submit a reimbursement to CarMax.  How is this taking care of us?  Two major issues, a bunch of run around and now we have to take care of everything ourselves?  Do yourself a favor and do not purchase a vehicle from CarMax.  CarMax "Certified" is a joke and their customer service is even worse.  They don't answer the phone, you call their out of state customer service, they try calling the dealership and they also can't get anyone to answer.  They transfer you to someone's extension and it rings and rings with no VM.  So now we are faced with dropping off the car at the dealership, being without a car for 1-2 weeks or renting a car and hoping their reimbursement process is smoother than all the other processes we've experienced so far.  Their response to voicing this concern on another site was for us to contact the same customer service number that has not helped us up to this point.  Do yourself a favor and choose a different company to do business with.  I'm sure some people have had a good experience but after personal experience and research, you are looking at 50% chance of a positive outcome.  Not the kind of rate you want when spending thousands of dollars on something you need to rely and depend on.

Terrible customer service.  1) this is one of the few restaurants that still only serving drive thru and the inability to have at least a couple of tables open for dining/pick up inside is deserving of zero stars.  2) because they are only drive thru some people might have trouble reading the menu outside and apparently staff also have trouble listening to customers because I ordered fried chicken strips but they gave me 5 full pieces of chicken.  There is no excuse for this mistake or it is possible that they are just dishonest and wanted to charge more for the order.

Since zero stars isn't an option.  Arrived at 1 on Saturday.  Hostess ignored us for five minutes and then asked if we had a reservation for the half full restaurant.  Told there was a wait ( even with many open tables).  Customer I. Front of was told 20 minutes because the kitchen was behind.

Blame covid all you want.  If you open your doors you should be open.  Own your service experience- no matter how awful it is.

Walked next door and was seated and served almost immediately.

We were so excited to come here for brunch! The food was great, some of the best pancakes I've ever had. But the service was terrible. We ordered bottomless mimosas and was maybe only refilled once. Our waitress ended up being cut and we were never informed. After 30 minutes of waiting, we asked another server for a refill. He informed us our server had left quite some time ago but he would help us out. After that he walked past our table 3x without giving us any help or explanation. We ended up just leaving, there was also no manager on sight. I do not recommend coming here unless you wanna pay for terrible service.

questionable service. I have been here before many times for lunch but this is my first time coming for their breakfast. The food was good and as always I love the environment but the entire staff was scrambling to get things done even though it wasn't as busy as I've seen before. Our server was unknowledgeable of the menu and proceeded to tell us twice that they were out of things that we had previously asked for that she said they had. Almost all of the staff seemed new to the establishment except for the bartender and this man with a red flannel and mustache that i'm assuming was the manager. hostesses were very passive aggressive. We had asked one of the hosts that was walking by if we could have napkins and she said in a snarky way that our server can bring us the napkins. We didn't get napkins until 20 minutes in. We had ordered an iced latte, it came out hot. Won't be returning for breakfast again......

I went to eat at Rudy's for the first time today.
Everything about it was fantastic!!!!
They have given me faith that great food and service in restaurants still exist
       THANK YOU!!!!

We loved our experience at 830 Common!  All of our meals were absolutely DELICIOUS, and our server Ivana was outstanding!  She was personable, professional, & attentive to the needs/wants of our 4-year old daughter.  We will be back again!  The atmosphere is a tad louder than some other establishments, but manageable.  GREAT JOB 830 Common!!

This awesome nail salon opened about 9 months ago and is next door to the Panda Express on Ten Mile in the Walmart shopping center.  
The salon is super clean and the staff are very nice and accommodating.  They have TONS of colors to choose from in both regular polish & gel polish.  They have complimentary soda & bottled waters available which is a nice touch. 
This place has THE BEST pedicures hands down! There are 3 different pedicures offered. They always take their time & give an amazing foot massage. My favorite part of getting a pedicure is the massage & this place does not disappoint. They even do hot stone massage with the pedicure. I always leave with beautiful, smooth feet.
I have gotten several manicures here as well & was very happy with the service.  The last time I did a standard polish manicure my polish did not chip at all for over a week. 
I highly recommend Coco Nail Spa!

I recently had a bathroom remodel that I needed to have done. I had four estimates for other contractors and none of them just felt right to me, and the prices that I was receiving were incredible high. I called Gabriel from GM Constuction because he was referred to me by a friend and he was able to come by the same day I called. Gabriel was fantastic! He took the time to walk through everything and explained to me how the whole process of a bathroom remodel works. He also took the time to listen to what I was saying and to what I wanted done in the bathroom. Gabriel summited his estimate to me in a very timely fashion, not only was he more then affordable the work that he did and the time he spent was really incredible. Gabriel was so meticulous and took such pride in his work, it was really enjoyable to what him work and to see the project all come together. I will never call another contractor for my home improvement needs. 

I love my bathroom! Thank you so much Gabriel!

This one is rapidly becoming my favorite breakfast spot.  Everything about it is great.  The staff is friendly and efficient, you can seat yourself "anywhere where's there's silverware " and the food is fresh and tasty.  I've tried several things and I'm never disappointed.   Also it's super clean and recently renovated, with additional space currently being added. Which is a good thing as they are busy!  That's a sign of a great restaurant

I was really excited to give this place a try, as it is a definite treat to pay someone to not only wash the outside of my car, but give the inside a bit of love too.  Sadly, I was disappointed with the outcome.  And definitely felt $25 was not worth it.

Before I begin my review, let me mention that I took the time to completely empty my SUV of personal belongings to ensure I would get a good wash!

As I waited in line for my turn, I watched the cars in front of me get vacuumed.  I notated that they cleaned the trunk area and was excited, as we had just came back from camping and there was a lot of debris in my trunk.  However, when I opened my trunk later that evening to put back a few things I found to my surprise the trunk didn't even get touched.  Bummer!!!

I also noticed that there were several spots on the exterior that still had dirt spots, which seems odd to me since they first hand wash, then send through their machine wash and then hand dry.

I also think it is ridiculous for the price you pay, that they can't take the extra step of wiping down your front dash board.  

I would caution the use of their scents.  I choose the pina colada, which smelled good initially.  But I think I am already tired of it.

All in all, not worth the $25 in my opinion.

Please try Sids Garage. Not only because of the incredible food, but for its staff. I'm not sure I've had a better experience. 

As soon as we entered, we were greeted by a woman on staff (I think maybe the owner). She walked us through the menu, how to order, and the seating. We got in line to order but had to wait a couple minutes as the waitress was taking a lengthy to-go order. I didn't mind waiting at all but the staff made sure to apologize to me many times. I found it very professional and kind. 

Once we ordered, we received our fried deviled eggs (unique and delicious) within a couple of minutes and the 'loco fries' just a few short minutes after that. While chowing down on our apps the waitress came over and asked if we were missing an item. We told her we had also ordered a burger (Honestly we hadn't missed it yet as we were still busy eating the addicting french fries) and she immediately apologized. She explained that it got lost in the shuffle during the large to-go order she was taking before us. She said she would put the order right in and apologized again. It was evident that she thought it was all her fault, but who can keep up with to-go orders during a pandemic?! I feel like you need a masters to get everyone's food right. Anyway...We told her it was no big deal and we were happy to wait. 

While passing our table, one of the owners noticed we didn't have our burger as well. She stopped and asked us about it and was immediately off to see if she could help rectify the situation. About 30 seconds later we had our juicy cheeseburger and promptly devoured it. 

While finishing, the other owner came over and asked what he could do to make it right. We turned him down, saying it wasn't a big deal, and mistakes happen. He still insisted and kept offering us more fries or a beer. He clearly cared and wanted to make up for the situation. But what's funny is that it was barely a situation. Our burger was maybe a few minutes late and we still felt like we were the only customers in the store. 

What an incredible beginning to what I hope is a long and plentiful life of Sids Garage. We'll be back. Not only to try new burgers (PB&J burger anyone?!) but to get waited on by such impressive staff.

One of the few places that has actually lived up to the hype! I heard a bunch of CrossFit/marathoners at my chiropractor's office talking about it and decided to check it out. SO THANKFUL I DID! The parm truffle fries are truly the best I have ever eaten. 

Yum. You won't regret it. High quality ingredients. Be warned that the music is loud but it goes with the ambiance. :)

Loved the lunch combo! The broth was so delicious! Noodles perfectly cooked and I love that they have shaved ginger in it. They also had ginger on the rice with the most delicious sauce. I'll be back for sure!

Only leaving a star because you have to. Got our order wrong, and my food was completely cold, forgot one of our shakes. Sent the wrong order back along with the cold food, brought out the right order but forgot to bring back the food we sent back that was cold. Worst sonic I have ever been to, will not be back here.

I don't even have words for how awful this place is.  It seems like management is either non-existent or utterly incompetent.  Long wait times to be seated, long wait times to bring the food out (by the way, when you finally do get it, it's ice cold), they don't warm the syrup for your pancakes, and you'll have to wait a long time to pay for your meal at the cashier as well.  Corporate should really send someone to help get this place in order; it's an absolute nightmare.  I'll never go back.
This ramen place is the best in Boise/Meridian!! Very authentic and so delicious. Would highly recommend supporting them.

We're talkin' pizza here. But setting the stage for what this is and is not, Tony G's Boise (as named) is not in Boise.  In fact, it is run out of one of roughly 16 ghost kitchens in a production complex in Meridian.  It is not a local pizzeria restaurant.  In fact, it is a virtual appearance of a San Francisco based chain.  It has no storefront from which to order.  In fact, you can only order Tony G's pizza if you download the Crave (ghost kitchen delivery) app (which is clunky in interface design).   My experience with ordering other things from other vendors who operate their virtual chains out of the ghost kitchens at Crave has been underwhelming in the main and lousy for some.  But for what it is I have to say both my husband, a 100% Italian heritage guy who grew up in an Italian neighborhood in Brooklyn and considers himself to 'know' good pizza, and I really enjoyed the Tony G's pizza we ordered.  We would do it again.  But be aware this can be budget buster for cost when all factors of working through Crave are considered.

VARIETIES, SIZES, COST:  There are 3 kinds of pizza available.  Detroit.  Grandma's Sicilian.  Regular.  We chose the latter and it was just right chewy thin crust and the cook on it was just right for us too.  My hubby appreciated that it met his 'fold test'...that is one ought to be able to fold a slice to eat it.  (This I do not 'get' but then I grew up in Portland and Seattle not Brooklyn.) The Regular pizzas are offered in 2 sizes - 13" and 20".  Given we wanted leftovers from our meal, and given delivery fee and driver tip added up to about $13, we decided to go for the larger pizza.  Mamma Mia!  That 20" pie is a biggie of 12 slices that would easily feed four people.  (13" has 6 slices.)  And this is not a bargain priced endeavor.  The 20" pizza was $30.  Add tax, delivery fee and tip and you're coming up on $45 for a pie delivered to your door.

YA GETS WHAT YA GETS: Because this is a ghost kitchen created chain menu one does not get to order the pie their way.  The choices are the choices and you cannot add or subtract.  So, for example, the Pigman pizza we ordered last night - the pig being very good crispy bacon in nearly lardon cuts - that came with cilantro could not be ordered without herb for people who think cilantro tastes like soap - as is true for several of my friends.  Or with extra for we who love it.  But for the audience of cilantro haters I would say 'no worries' because the cilantro was so minimal it was nearly impossible to distinguish its' flavor.  That being our minor criticism because it was also true that we said 'thumbs up' for the just right amount of cheese and sauce toppings on this pizza and that the kitchen didn't fall prey to the piling on too much.  After all in pizza, the crust quality is 'the thing' and the toppings should just accentuate it.  As here.  Good for Tony G himself who likely sets the formula for ghost kitchen preparations because there really is a Tony Gemignani living in SF who oversees this chain.

TAKE THEM WITH A GRAIN OF SALT:  Noting some past reviewers - with 0 friends and few reviews - who say they are from out of town and call this the best 'restaurant' in Boise or that they 'love the vibe' of the space (Yelp now moved that probably fake review behind the filter and good they did since Tony G's has no physical space to 'vibe') one might consider them planted reviews to consume for veracity accordingly.  But to  my Yelp friend John S I say "grazie" because it was only his high praise review for Tony G's that led me to try it myself.  I'm happy I did.

While crepes are often associated with a tiny region in the northwest of France called Brittany, their consumption is widespread in many parts of the world. It is said that in France, crepes are traditionally served on Candlemas, a Christian Holy Day commemorating the presentation of Jesus at the Temple. It falls on February 2nd.

But you know what, good thing is we can eat crepes everyday! I'm a sucker for high-quality crepes. And La Crepe Boise always satisfies my taste buds. 

Oh, how I love this mobile creperie! They are stationed in my neck of the woods every other week, and I make sure to drop by and order my favorite crepes not only because I like to support local businesses but also because their crepes are tasty and hearty. You can tell that the crepes are created with lots of love and attention to detail. 

My favorites are the chicken delight ($8.50) and the classic crepe ($7). Yes, I always order two crepes (don't judge! lol). The chicken delight is composed of roasted chicken breast, mushrooms, spinach, parmesan cheese, and pepper jack cheese. It has the right amount of spice to it. The classic crepe is composed of Nutella, powdered sugar, and a choice of banana or strawberry.

Cammy, the owner, has such a pleasing personality. She's friendly. She's passionate about her job. And she loves her customers. I enjoy talking to her while she's making my crepes!

Check them out! Their crepes don't disappoint. I believe they also do catering.

Called back a few minutes later (8:45) and asked when they closed: "another hour was the answer".  Then placed our order, including mac & cheese.  We were told, "We don't have any m&c. My husband and I choose a new Friday date night dinner place on Yelp every week (find it on Yelp, read reviews while eating because they are entertaining, then review our experience) and Johnny Bronx is where we landed tonight!

What we bought and what it cost: We were excited to order by the slice, as we love variety. In total, we ordered 4 individual slices, 1 order garlic bread, 1 order meatballs, and 1 large rootbeer. Our total came to about $27, plus a $5 tip. At first, I was shocked at the price but when we received our order, it all made sense. 

The Eats: the slices are HUGE. Thin and crunchy crust, tasty sauce and toppings, and a perfect cheese/crust/topping ratio. Great pizza overall. The garlic bread is made to order and ours was a little underdone, but honestly I really enjoyed it like that. Buttery and flavorful with tomato sauce on the side. Wonderful. The meatballs were good and so flavorful with cheese and sauce, but at this point, there's no room! LOL We ordered a ton of food. 

Customer Service: Polite and to the point, which I appreciate. Answered the two questions I had, pleasant attitude, and all of our food was out in five or six minutes after ordering and paying.

Overall: swing by and grab a slice and the garlic bread! We are new fans!

Who would've thought that a hipster place known in the community for offering super healthy, organic & local products would be the best place to buy ALCOHOL (specifically beer)? For the handful of years I've been an Idahoan, this has been (and will be) the #1 "beer run" location (Meridian location over the downtown Boise one).

Beer selection here is FANTASTIC. The "over the counter", popular OG beers are still here (from the local breweries and from around the country), but the main attraction are all the specialty beers that you won't find in Walmart, Winco, Albertsons, Fred Meyer. The enormous Albertsons "World Market" that's close by might have a bigger selection (in terms of floor space in the store), but you won't find a lot of the beers at this Co-Op over there.

The #1 perk of buying beer here (and the primary factor of the 5 star review), is that you can buy beer BY THE CAN. No need to waste money on the full 6 pack when you don't know if you're going to even like the beer or not. The pricing of beer, by the can, is extremely competitive, and is only $1-3 more than buying the full 6 pack (or 4 pints). This has encouraged me to try so many new beers that I'd never try before. This "feature" is killer, and easily differentiates this place from the rest of the stores.

As for the food, I'm sure it's extremely healthy, ethically raised, etc, but the price is just too high for me (and I'm sure for a lot of others). If money isn't an issue, I'd love to be able to buy all my produce here, but that's not reality (at least for me). Some of my favorite items here are the chili at the soup bar, the "Acme" branded rosemary bread (UNREAL), Wildflower bakery scones, and the amazing selection of cheeses (smoked gouda baby). Favorite non-food item (and a great gift) is the Idaho shaped bamboo cutting board that's sold here (I don't actually use for cutting stuff, just decoration).

This Meridian location is superior to the Boise location. This seems newer, bigger, more interior lighting, layout isn't crammed, and the EASY parking (parking at the Boise location just isn't worth the hassle). Only perk at the Boise location is the better / bigger olive bar.

Friendly people working at this location. I'm not a member, and don't plan on spending money to be one, so as long as they don't require you to be a member, I'll be coming back. 

If you're looking for LOCAL IPAs (hazy, double, etc), "Mother Earth Brewing" from Nampa cannot be beat. I tried most of the other local, Idaho breweries, and IMO they don't even come close. My all time favorite IPA has to go to "Revision Brewing". 4 Pints for around $16.50 (used to be $12.50!) is pricey, but they hit it out of the park in terms of high octane alcohol %, low IBUs, and that distinct "dank" smell and flavor I crave.

P.S. Shout out to this place for sending out free $10 off for $25+ order vouchers years ago when I lived in an apartment nearby. This was the only reason I started coming here (since you could even use that on beer lol)

They stated that I needed to have my alignment checked and the bolts checked within 2 to 3 weeks after installation. It is now over six weeks and multiple visits back there and still have not had my alignment readjusted, which is now off, or the bolts retightened. Every time I go they tell me they are too busy. I have attempted to make an appointment, they will not allow me to make appointment stating that I just need to drop in. I have called before coming in, I have dropped in.  However they are never free to perform the work they told me I needed. I am now driving with an alignment that is pulling and don't know about the tightness of the bolts.  I recommend you go elsewhere.

Reed's Dairy is my favorite ice cream of all time. Hands down. Which says a lot since I am well known for my love of ice cream. 

I grew up in Idaho Falls which is where the original local dairy is located. Every time I went home to visit my parents I made sure we made a stop at Reed's. So I was ecstatic when they opened up a branch in the Treasure Valley. 

Their ice cream is incredibly creamy and flavorful. Plus the scoops are huge! You get a lot for your money. They have crazy cool flavors that are always changing. An

But their chocolate milk is a MUST!!!!! It is made with potato flakes (Idaho, Idaho!) which sounds disgusting, but I'm telling you, anyone that try's it is hooked for life. You'll never taste anything more creamy and chocolatey. It's expensive, but totally worth it. 

My favorite thing in the menu is cookies and cream ice cream and a brown cow which is a float with chocolate milk instead of soda. 

And of course, don't forget to grab a grilled cheese and tomato soup for lunch! Great value!!!

Well educated, energetic, and an expert in her field,  Arlene can help you make positive changes in your life.   With her excellent communication skills, Arlene makes the process very comfortable by guiding you to change behaviors so you can accomplish your goals.

Arlene is amazing!!  I immediately felt at ease and comfortable talking with her.  She is kind, totally engaged and truly cares about the well being of her clients.  I am so fortunate to have found her.  She is really helping me make positive changes in my life.  I highly recommend her.  She is a wonderful person who is truly expert in her field.  Thank You Arlene!

I am very happy with Meridian Plumbing. I called in the morning when they opened and expressed interest of wanting a water softener installed. The technician Pete came out the same day in the afternoon and had it installed and working. Pete was very professional and awesome to work with. He completed the installation in a very timely manner and was more than happy to answer any questions you had. Pete you are amazing! Thanks for your service guys! Their pricing is fair especially with the amazing service they provide.
Such good food, the waffles are to die for and the salad is TOP TIER. Highly recommend!

I am sorry but this is not what I thought it was . The food was very COLD no Flavor at all. The meat taste fake. The Cup was mostly full of Noodles and Rice . Very little meat and veggies. I would not recommend this place to anyone at all.

We live in East Boise and normally go to the Griddle on Parkcenter, however, on Saturday, August 24, the road was closed for the Color Run, and since it was my birthday and I was looking forward to the eating at the Griddle, we decided to venture out of our "East Boise Bubble" and head to Meridian to check out that Griddle location, and I'm so glad we did!  The staff was friendly, our waitress, Megan was wonderful, and the food was the best I've ever had at any Griddle location.  In fact, I was so impressed with the food and service, I told our waitress about it, and lo and behold she is the manager at this location!  I told her the food was outstanding, and that's when she told me she recently hired a new kitchen manager.  We will definitely be back, and I suggest you head back too if you haven't been there in a while, it's well worth it.

So the front office was okay. Sometimes they were nice but sometimes they were rude. We got a lot of mail that wasn't ours, they told us we could bring it in or throw it away. I thought I'd bring it in the office so maybe they could get it to the right person, NOPE they have a huge pile of mail sitting in a corner. And I mean huge, there's a box so full it's overflowing onto the floor. It's ridiculous. The apartment itself was pretty nice. It was modern and cute, living room was small and the dining are is small and right at the front door which makes it awkward. There was black mold growing on the window seal after a few weeks of living there. I was pregnant and was worried. They definitely treated me as an inconvenience, I had to call multiple times and they just kept saying it wasn't mold before even coming to look. Once they finally came, the maintenance guy just said "really? That's it? Keep the fan on in the bathroom and you won't have that problem. That's hardly anything and it's not even harmful. When you see it just scrape it off." I thought it was super rude, also the window was on the opposite side of the bathroom and the mold was happening because it was getting wet in only the one room everytime it rained or snowed.

Tried Sid's Garage for the first time today and was very impressed. Every employee was extremely friendly and helpful. The food portions are large and the food was delicious. The staff went above and beyond to make sure we had a good experience. 
They are grateful for local support and we definitely plan on making Sid's a regular stop!

Our family of five started with a slice each, ate it out front and ordered a second round. 
My two girls loved the pepperoni. My personal favorite was the white sauce pizza with added balsamic and tuff drizzle. This pizza was amazing! 
We also made sure to try their Bronx Boys homemade ice cream sandwiches. They told us the cookie is made fresh and not frozen again.

DO NOT EAT HERE. WAY TOO EXPENSIVE !!!! It is SO overpriced for what it is. The restaurant is so loud, I couldn't even carry on a conversation. The waiter of the restaurant was extremely pushy towards us and the food was very mediocre. I DO NOT recommend at all.

This place used to be great.  I went in today and had to point out smudges on the windows on the inside that were not cleaned.  They don't even wipe down the dust on the doors in the cab.  I paid for the ultra? wash, did not get the tire treatment that is supposed to come with it.  This is the second time in a row that they have done a poor job.  Maybe I can find something better on Yelp.

Terrible service!  We literally sat at the speaker to order in the drive through for over ten minutes. Every time I said some I was told to wait because they were too busy to take my order. No apology, no regret, just the worst drive through service in the world. Wouldn't be sad to see this place shut down!

Johnny Bronx is our new favorite pizza place! Great pizza, prices and friendly service. Also love that it's a drive through so we can quickly grab a pizza. Can't wait to try some of their other items on the menu.
Decided to order my breakfast from the griddle for the first time today and i couldn't have been any more pleased! delicious food, a great chai, and the sweetest server!

This place was amazing! We came Sunday and were prepared to wait because they had just opened, but there was no wait at the time we came! You grab a menu, order, then seat yourself! Super cute set up and everyone was so friendly. We got the tots without the cheese and the boss hog burger! the bang sauce on the tots was delicious i wish i had more! they were all out of the loco fries but we will defiantly be back because there is so much more i want to try!

Under new management, this place really knows how to make a woman & her 2 kids welcome. I went here to get my wedding ring repaired, and it took a few days, in which I didn't mind. However, they do have same day services as well 4 repair & resizing, if you arrive early enough. One employee let my 4 year old son choose a rock or gem from a bag of others, so he choose a jade, which was a nice gesture & learning experience 4 him as he had never been to a jewelry store. In addition, I've had a broken heirloom jewelry box 4 years, and they fixed it perfectly. Thank you 4 the lovely experience!

I stopped to grab a quick bite only to find myself trapped in the drive threw for 30 min!! Even after calling from the drive threw and giving some suggestions on how to deal with the broken speaker they made zero effort to change their trajectory!!!!! 
It was horrible!! I had places to be!! I was trapped! No way threw or out!!! Never ever go here or you may find yourself in a similar situation!
Absolutely no concern for their customers!!

Wanted to like this place but it is a bit small and more suited for take out. I ordered a cheeseburger, fries and huckleberry lemonade.  Burger was OK not a medium rare kobe beef kind of burger but definitely better then average fast food.  Fries were crispy with lots of flavor but too salty for me. Lemonade was a tad too sweet as well.  Staff was wonderful and it was busy. Menu has a wide selection of items so may return in future to try new items.

Wish I could give zero stars! Worst internet service I have ever had!!! Customer service is rude and incompetent! They unfortunately are the only option in my area! One of the worst companies I've ever had the displeasure of dealing with!!!

We have been here twice on short notice and they were wonderful! They are so sweet to our dog. She hates getting her nails cut and they go above and beyond to make sure she's comfortable. Their prices are amazing and they have fun colors for your pet too! We drive from downtown Boise just to use them.

I grew up in the Northeast so I'm always on the lookout for good NY style pizza. The pizza at Johnny Bronx is great! The crust is thin and crispy, good ratio of cheese to sauce - overall just delicious pizza. I don't have any comments on the quality of service or the condition of the restaurant since I wasn't the one who picked up our takeout order, but I'd say it's definitely worth checking out Johnny Bronx if you're a fan of NY style pizza.
Such good waffles, I've had the Nutella ones and the savory sausage one! Always Great service! The girls are nice and helpful!

My husband and I stopped in here bevause IHOP was too busy and I'm glad we did. It was quiet and delicious. The food came fast and the place is very clean. My husband got the chicken and waffles which was also amazing. Good little place for Sunday brunch.

Well this was our first time at this restaurant and I had high hopes, but as I do this review I am torn. Everything started out fine our waitress was really friendly and we placed our order and my children received their drinks quickly and figured ours weren't far behind until 15 minutes passed and our drinks were still sitting at the bar waiting to be picked up and our waitress was no where to be seen. We asked the bar tender and she told us we would have to wait for our waitress and she was zero help to the problem. Finally got the attention if another waitress and she brought them over. Then the kids food came out and I expressed to them our waitress how I was
Not happy with never receiving our drinks. She said she was busy in the back and thought one of the other waiters would bring us our drinks. Umm ok? I felt a little better about the situation cause I understand if she really was busy in the back, and she also took the drinks off the bill. Well our food didn't come out until about five minutes after the kids food did and it was another waitress who brought it out. She kindly asked if we needed Anything else and we did because we never got silverware or napkins either. The food was decent not to bad but nothing I would crave to go back to after the whole experience. I ordered the chicken sandwich which I swear the menu said had spicy slaw but I never received that ‍.  So needless to say the experience was not great.

We bought a refrigerator on November 22 to be delivered December 9th. I decided to call (1-877-946-9843) the day before since we didn't get a call that day as promised. I talked to an individual and was on hold for almost an hour when I was disconnected. Next, I called the local Meridian store to explain the situation and was promised I would be called back, this never happened. At that point I called the other number again where I was eventually transferred to another individual where I called (1-833-452-2893) which is Appliance Delivery, there I finally was told the fridge would be delivered December 15th, 6 days after the initial delivery date. 
The fridge was delivered, it looked good, no visible damage and everything seemed to work, (Water, Ice maker, lights etc) The next morning there was a very loud rattling noise which I eventually found to from under the fridge. While checking this out I discovered the front wheels that support the fridge where loose, not supporting it. Then I called Whirlpool where I was again told I need to talk to Home Depot delivery which I did only to find out I have to wait until January 13th to have someone come out to look at the problem. Researching this I've discovered the fridge should lean to the back slightly which is the opposite of what it does.
Overall a VERY disappointing experience with the whole purchase, next time I will be looking elsewhere for any appliance we may need.

Paid for ultra supreme what a horrible job. Mats were still dirty had to ask for a rag to finish wiping inside that was not done. Won't waste my money again. Had to give a star because Yelp requires it
OMG why have an I found this place earlier? The brunch is amazing and the brussels sprouts I am still thinking about. Definitely a great place to go solo and with friends.

Best pizza around! Extremely happy we found a little bit of NorCal here in Idaho.  We had the Wise guy, Cal Italia and the Pigman. Fresh ingredients and all three were amazing in their own unique way. Everyone loved it! 

One reviewer said it was bland, not sure what they are talking about. The pizza is delicious! Maybe it's not for everyone but we are huge fans Tony G's!!!
Thank you! You all were super helpful riding me around and helping me pick out a tree! You delivered it two weeks earlier than you said and the delivery/planters guys were super nice.

LITERALLY THE WORST DINING EXPERIENCE IN IDAHO!! How is this place even a restaurant and how does it have any good reviews???? I feel like the reviews must be family members cause the food and service were the worst experience I've ever had. Go to MoeJoes down the street for a real breakfast at the same cost.

Two stars because at first I thought they did a decent job, I didn't have high expectations. As they were painting my nails the man kept adding something to thin the polish. I didn't really think anything of it at the time. It took a really long time for my nails to "dry" then 8 hours later I put a sock on and it stuck to the polish. 24 hours later the polish is still sticky. I think they are being so cheap that they aren't replacing the polish when they need to and results are a messed up $40 pedicure.

This place is fantastic! I met a friend here, and I was impressed with the decor and with the intimacy of the small dining room. The tables had nice linens on them, and the bar was cozy and romantic. We had lunch, and could not decide because there were so many tasty options! We ordered the sliders and the brisket and then shared. Both dishes were awesome but my favorite if I had to choose were the sliders. Our server, Kyle, suggested an amazing wine (out of 30 choices) that went really well with the meal. I could not believe what a gem that we stumbled upon! We both unanimously agreed that we will be coming back every week for lunch! You must go here, you will not be sorry.
The best ramen around! Tonkatsu ramen is my favorite. Helpful, attentive staff. Perfect place for lunch on a cold winter day!

We had coned from the truck at the Ford Idaho center purely because, well, there weren't any other options. 

Talk about a pleasant surprise!  I'm no stranger to pizza, and know what I like, what I don't and quality vs crap.

This wasn't just "event food".  The crust has flavor, they make really good sauce, use great toppings and that cheesy part at the very bottom is better than the chocolate hunk at the bottom of a drumstick.  

It wasn't "fair food" it was real, fresh made pizza, and a really pretty great one at that.  

I will definitely look for them again when at an event- and I get why everyone else does too!

Be ready to wait 50+ minutes for your food to come out. I really don't know why we keep giving this place a chance. Never stepping a foot in this Denny's ever again. Customer service and waiting time is ridiculous.
Amazing food, great customer service! Made a reservation and table was ready upon arrival. Would definitely recommend this restaurant to anyone!

I don't think this is good me. Not sure what I was expecting, but definitely not close to any authentic Korean food. It's good if you need a quick fix for the flavor.  The yam noodles are a better choice for me than with rice on the bottom of the cup because you're suppoded to mix everything and I hate when my rice is all mixed into my food.  The workers there were nice and there seems to be a following so good for you if you live these guys, but honestly, no hate here, I'd rather have real bi bim bop or regular Korean.  But it's a cute concept and fun to try.

The closest thing to CA Mexican food I've found in Idaho after a six year search!  TRY IT! And don't be afraid if it is empty (they are new to this location) - just walk in and either belly up to the bar or have a seat...you won't regret it!

Their margarita needs some work and one of the servers is very "green" (but isn't that everywhere right now); I trust in time this will improve.  But the RED SAUCE...will nearly take you back! I love it!

In town for business, and wandered by this place.   Had the miso ramen, enjoyed it very much.   Came back to the hotel to write the review, and read the previous reviews.   Seems like they've settled down since opening last year, and my experience was terrific.   I grew up in Tokyo, so I'm super picky about my ramen.   The broth was very rich and unctuous without being overly fatty.  The egg was cooked perfectly, not marinated, but nowadays many places don't marinated the eggs so that was cool.  And with the rich broth of miso ramen, I prefer a plain egg.  I loved the pork belly...nice and fatty, very tender meat...I prefer this sort of pork in my ramen rather than the dry tenderloin some places use.  The rest of the toppings were good.   

I judge a ramen joint on the broth and noodles...toppings will be different everywhere you go.   My only quibble is that there wasn't a choice of noodle type, or offering of a second helping of noodle to go with the leftover broth (kaedama.)  They used a slightly thicker noodle for the miso ramen, which worked well, I would have liked a bit more "bite" or snap to the noodle, but that's splitting hairs.  You can see they care about their bowls when they arrive at the table, and I'm glad to give them 5 stars for that effort!

Alright Idaho, enough. Enough with the "New York" pizza. If you're not FROM NYC, if you've never even BEEN to NYC and had a slice of real New York pizza, don't in any way, shape, or form, call your pizza "New York" pizza. Brooklyn, my a$$. Not even close. This pizza is thin and big. That's about it. No drips of grease landing on my plate after I folded a slice. Flavor was absolutely standard, nothing especially flavorful or special about it. And the worst part, the crust had an odd, unpleasant taste to it, and a weird texture. It was slightly chewy, but not in the right way. I don't know how they managed that. SO disappointed. I've been yearning for a real slice of New York pizza for so long, Guido's isn't even cutting it for me lately. But this place claiming "Brooklyn" pizza, that should be illegal. How dare they.
We liked it! Friendly service and unique food! Tangy chicken is super good and service is fast.

Frankie's Java, a new coffeehouse and restaurant, is open in downtown Meridian, founded by the former co-owner of Java.The new cafe and restaurant has plenty of indoor seating and a patio overlooking Generations Plaza. Frankie's Java will be open daily from 7 a.m. to 6 p.m. and offers a full food menu. Breakfast is served all day, however.

While living in Sun Valley, Lisa Squires co-owned and operated Java, including the two Boise locations, for 16 years. Frankie's Java, named after her 12-year-old daughter, is not associated with the Sun Valley-based Java.

They serve very good, full bodied, local custom roasted coffee from Grace Organics of Sun Valley. Refills with breakfast were appreciated. Try the "The Ego Boost" a Mexican mocha with home made whip cream for an extra lift in the morning.

Breakfast is served all day as well as a full menu with non breakfast meals. The poached eggs with toast and jam were my treat for the day. A side of bacon and I was set. My wife had a bagel with cream cheese and avocado. Our suggestion to the owner was she consider using bagels from Blue Sky. They bake their own pastries and an apple muffin was excellent with their fine coffee.

Seating ranges from lounge chairs, regular seating height tables, and high counter-style chairs. The outdoor seating is especially pleasant as it is not on the street, has shade and lots of room. In fact seating is not crowded, so access is easy for any mobility challenged customers. Parking is on the street and plentiful.

Pleasant servers were open to answering questions and suggesting what to have. As they are newly opened, they want to know their customers opinions and preferences. Plenty of room, so they will not be rushing customers who want to linger over tea or coffee and converse or use the WiFi.

As this was their soft opening, there is always room for improvement. so we are sure a 5 star review is in the offing. We will come back.

Eight Thirty Common was such a pleasant surprise. I went in with friends to grab a round of drinks and left with a full stomach! Their adult grilled cheese is to die for, with pimento cheese, bacon, and tomato dipped in tomato soup. The atmosphere is nice, quiet, and intimate. A great spot for meeting up with friends for dinner or drinks!

Did a birthday brunch here for a friend. Food was delicious, I had the California Benedict and shared some pancakes. My friend who had the chilaquiles said his was pretty good but not the best. We shared mimosas and the service was great. Definitely coming back.

My new favorite place in Meridian. Great atmosphere, service and vibe! I love their food so much. Brunch, lunch, dinner, happy hour! Everytime I have been there I leave super satisfied. Also great patio!
Excellent breakfast. Huckleberry stuffed French toast is well worth the calories. My wife enjoyed the Denver omelet especially the ham. Also even the toast was great.

Dangerously HOT coffee!!! Like, shockingly scalding!!!!!! That is NOT ok. I am constantly going through coffee shop drive-thru's and have never experienced this issue. Employees need to be trained properly!
Very good atmosphere was amazing , are server was very responsive. One of the things I hate is waiting on drink refills and this place was amazing about refills.

My first cat grooming experience was great!  Quick and friendly service and my boy came home looking and feeling so handsome!  Unfortunately my second experience was the opposite.  Apparently prices have increased while quality has declined.  My boy came home nervous and rattled and immediately started peeing in the house. (He's 3 years old and had NEVER previously pottied in the house!)  He also still had mats under his front legs, which was the primary reason making the appointment.

I was in need of shoes because my feet are swollen they had a pair but one of the shoes was chewed up and you couldn't Buckle it and they wanted to charge me 15 bucks.. the lady said because of the name of that  brand that's why it was that that price.. so what product is torn or chewed up they want full price because of the name of the brand and I don't think that's right even if I wanted to wear them I could even wear one shoe because I could have been lakshit.. and then the lady was rude to me on top of it acting like it was disgusting that I would ask for a lower price.. I thought the thrift stores over there to help us out for low income families? It's sad I went to Walmart after this and found a pair for 1.00. And got good customer service and brand new shoes.

Amazing shakes and burgers!  Very busy on a Saturday but they had great service.  We will definitely be back. Try the hangover burger, tots, and a 420 milkshake... it's definitely enough for two people to share.

Tried out BLG for the first time, and we were not disappointed! The menu is extensive, we ended up getting burgers. My hubby got the belly buster, 3 patties on it so be prepared! He couldn't finish it, it was HUGE! I got the BCMG. Both were delish! I got the tots, he got fries. In the future I will be getting the fries, they were so good!

Oh, and the lemonade...TO. DIE. FOR.! You can't come to Burnt Lemon Grill and not get a lemonade. They have at least 10 flavors you can add to it, I got the huckleberry and hubby got regular. Both were amazing! 

Can't wait to come back, we literally want to try everything on the menu!

Wife ordered veggie omelet (no onions) of course plenty of onions in it, hash browns well done, they were not. I ordered  eggs, and well done sausage   and hash browns, neither was as I ordered. Plus, waitress very friendly.

Loved the food! The only bad thing was the seating. We got sat at the table right in front of the door. It was packed but our server was fast and attentive. We got a blue cheese burger and fried chicken sandwich. Both were amazing. Cooked perfectly and great flavor. The drinks were also good. Our favorite was the bloody Mary. They used an infused vodka which was amazing. I want to try the bloody Mary flights. We will be back for brunch sometime!

I have been to this salon 3 times now. The first time I hated it and was soooo disappointed I complained and they told me I didn't know what I was talking about. The second time, I decided to give them another shot, and the second time I was equally upset. They argue with you about what you want, they try to just hurry up and get your manicure/pedicure over with so they can get more money with more customers. They don't care how well they are doing your nails. I finally went in today, because I had gel polish put on from a different salon a couple of weeks ago, and only needed it taken off (so I thought how hard is that), so they took it off. They didn't smooth the nail out after removing the gel so when they re-painted my nails, the nail is completely bumpy and un-even. Its awful. He did such a horrible job painting that the color looks uneven in places, and thick and heavy in other places. They stuck 3 of us at the "drying table" when really it only fits 2 people, and 5 minutes later they tried to tell me that my nails were dry, when they weren't even close, because they wanted my spot for another person. I will NEVER go here again. They are sooo unfriendly, rude, and awful at their job I wont give them even $5 of my money. I rather pay more money for a job that is done right.

I was able to get an oil change appointment for the following day and they got me right in when I arrived. The service manager was knowledgeable as well as friendly. The waiting area was clean and comfortable. 
My car recommends using full synthetic oil and Meineke was offering a $20 off special -- always nice to get a discount! The full service oil change includes checking several other items such as the air and cabin filters. The manager showed me the filters (which were a bit dirty, but not too bad) and he wasn't at all pushy when I elected not to replace them this time. Total wait time was less than 1 hour -- overall, it was a pleasant experience.

Update: same O, same O. Poor service, slow and waffle was near awful. Only went back because friend wanted to meet there for breakfast.

Go to Moe Joe's or Steve's. You'll be happy that you did.

I ate here right after it opened.  I was so excited, it has been a long time since I've had bulgogi from a Korean restaurant, and I dream of the day when I can eat like I ate in Korea.  What I got really underwhelmed me.  Maybe I have to go back, perhaps they were still figuring out how much to give, because the other reviews say that the helpings were good.  Mine had almost no meat.  Like maybe 6-7 little meat strips at the most.  It was 90% rice.  Bulgogi is a meat dish.  This was a rice dish.

I've been looking for a nail salon to do a good job in gel type nails. I specifically asked if they had "shellac" brand and they told me "yes". When I got there they gave me a card with all of their colors and told me to pick one. None of the gels were the brand I was looking for. 

The finish is very wavy and doesn't look very professional. I asked for a very natural light pink and the color I got is a very solid light pink color. Not at all the color I requested. I asked them to match the one they were removing from my nails. Not even close. 

Billy, who seemed to be in charge was NOT very friendly. I will be looking for another salon for my future needs. Here is a picture of the wavy finish.

1 week later - they have peeled off

Sue and her team are great. I have moved my entire family to her practice including my two teenage boys. She has addressed all my questions and concerns. She has helped address issues that their previous pediatrician had ignored. My boys always comment how easy to talk to and how nice she is. Thanks Sue!

We were very impressed by the People and place. 

These folks were so nice and friendly.

Not a chain. 

Family owned and operated. At least three of the family are there every day.

So busy they have broken down the wall next door for expansion.

All the items are homemade.

All flavors were unique and delicious.

We hope to visit again.

I promise you won't be sorry.

This review is only for the fact that people are walking in and around not wearing masks. We were the only people who went in wearing them. There were people literally tailgating us to the elevator that were also not wearing them. The hotel is not enforcing guests wearing masks.
Excellent place to eat a little something, watch ANY sports show as they have all of them on Direct TV, do karaoke, play virtual golf, darts or pool.  - Enjoy!

Awesome place. Super laid back. Great atmosphere. The owners are top notch. And the food is absolutely . Burgers are the #bestofboise. The wife and I are going to make this our weekly afterwork meeting place. Get the beer in a bag. It is worth it.

Carmax is absolutely the best. If you are in need of a car make sure you consider Carmax first because when I tell you they have everything you need as far as options and will make sure you are well taken care of. I bought all my cars from Carmax over the years and I am truly a satisfied customer. My last visit was at the Boise Idaho Carmax and I worked with Rebecca. She is amazing and hard-working. You got it appreciate that. Mike goes above and beyond when it comes to his team. That man is THE MAN! lol he gets the job done. The staff here offer top of the line customer service and they don't go home until you are completely taken care of. I love Carmax and everyone keep up the great work. Todd Jenn Rebecca Mike and Dylan keep up the great excellent work!

I'm not even embarrassed to admit that I stopped in here twice during the quick trip I took to Meridian this month. If I'd gone one more time maybe they would've known my name by the end of the week! 
The spice fried chicken is so good and the bulgogi beef isn't half bad either! 
Prices are very reasonable and the portions are a good size.

Looking for a classic Ramen house feel, but well out of  the weather? Well, this is the place! My visit was pleasant, the staff and service excellent, and the cost reasonable enough. I had a pleasant time. Food was great and arrived in a reasonable time.
I liked this place. The food was good. I got the steak salad. I liked the atmosphere, too, but the service was pretty slow this particular night. I got the chocolate torte, too, and I liked that.

Finally able to try out the new store location. Was greeted by 3 very happy employees who were eager to help me through the process of ordering. I went with the combo beef/pork bowl and cabbage instead of lettuce. Sauce I did medium heat and the flavor was excellent. The mando didn't impress me much as it reminded me of any pre frozen asian dumpling you can buy in the freezer section of your local market. One big surprise was the actual size of the bowls. Don't be fooled by the photos as they seem to make it look "cup" size when in fact it's a very good portion. Next time I will for sure try the fried chicken option.  Thanks for bringing variety to Boise!

We were riding around Saturday afternoon and needed some lunch.  But we didn't want typical "fast food" lunch, so I remembered this place was open over near Rocky Mountain High School.

We went through the drive-thru; the menu is a little farther up in the lane than you would imagine, and then you order at the window where you would also pick up your food.

We opted for the 2 slices and a drink deal for $7.50.  
We got a slice of cheese and a slice of sausage (which was sausage, pepperoni and mushroom).  And it. was. delicious.  It was a really large piece, that New York style where it's got a thinner base crust.  And it was cheesy and the toppings were fabulous.  There was a little bit of spice/heat coming from something - the sausage or the pepperoni or the sauce, not sure? - but not a lot, just a tad.  

The drink we got was gigantic - she said they had run out of medium cups, so she gave us the large. 

The service, the timing, and the food were fantastic.  
Totally going back here.

I'll start by saying this...I'm glad the reviews from idiot anti-maskers were taken down for whatever reason, because this place was getting a bad rap for ACTUALLY ENFORCING the Ada County mask mandate. While this stupid ass pandemic continues on, I try to do absolutely nothing, but when I NEED to go somewhere, I always appreciate businesses that do what they can to keep customers safe. This Costco, somewhat unlike the Nampa location, seems to be doing that and doing it well. 

Ok now that the safety madness is over, let's get to the meat. MEAT! I don't think I've ever been to a Costco that I didn't like. Actually, that's not true. Go to the one in Salinas, CA on a weekend and you'll hate your life and everyone on Earth. But this new one I'm Meridian? Beautiful! I began my adventure by GETTING GAS!!! Oooooh exotic! Started out dumb though as my Costco member card is old and beat up and the pump couldn't read it. NOT TO WORRY! A super nice attendant came by and looked at the card and saw that it sucked, so he just used his and said I could go get a new one inside. Got gas and went inside to the membership area. Now this is common for most Costco membership staff, but these gals were SWEETHEARTS! I initially was being helped by one lovely lady and ended up having three lovely ladies help me for some reason, which was great. I got a new card and they hooked up my digital membership, and took a new stupid picture of me. FUN. 

Once that was done, on to the actual store. It looked like....well, it looked like a big Costco. But a nice, clean Costco! They had everything I needed and, as always, way more that I ended up with. Not much to say here other than it was well-stocked and clean and nice. 

Now the ONLY downsides consisted of two things. The first thing I can't even be mad at but was inconvenient. Today is Dec 18th, so yes I'm cutting it close, but I was hoping to find ANY gift baskets to pick up and give to friends. They literally had NADA! That means none...duh. So that sucked, but again, I can't dock any points for that because it's so close to Christmas and it should be expected...I guess...

But the thing I DID dock a star off for was for currently being understaffed. Or so it seemed anyway. Upon checkout, I ended up with a nice older gentleman who was scanning all my loot, but unlike a majority of Costcos, no one was helping box up everything. Only when he was almost done ringing me up did a lovely young lady come over and start tossing everything in my cart. Like I always do at every Costco, I asked to fill a few boxes as heavy as possible so I can make fewer trips from my car to the door. She said no problem, but it didn't turn out that way. I ended up with one big box and one small box and several loose individual items just placed in the cart. Needless to say, I had to make several trips from my car to the front door when I got home. Cmon now...I'm not gonna be buff forever. Fill up those big boxes!!!

Now that last fact certainly won't stop me from going back to this Costco! This will probably be my new Costco from here on out, and hopefully they just get better as this is a very new location! HOORAY COSTCO! Weeee! 

Ps. Excuse these lame pictures but I only remembered to take any when I was in line to check out. Hey, at least I remembered to take them for once.

I attempted to eat here but they were out of everything I ordered, instead of making any attempt to fix anything it was just, sorry, have a better night. Obviously they are a new restaurant but there was no indication that they were out of these things and it was 8pm on a Friday night when they were supposed to be open until 11. My boyfriend got his food to go and we left, not a very enjoyable experience. Maybe I'll try again when they figure out how to keep some food options on the menu, but I doubt it.

Absolutely horrible customer service! My husband is a floor installer and uses this store daily. We went in for the black Friday four pack appliances. It took 22 minutes to get someone to help us. When a manager asked an associate to help us she rolled her eyes and acted completely irritated to help us. We showed her the add and she tried to talk us out of the style because it scratches .  She then got irritated with me for not knowing the measurement of my current refrigerator. I had to go find my husband to please her. She then quit helping me to go help another customer while she was in the middle of typing my orders in the computer. When she decided to finish my order she went over how I need to check each and every appliances before I signed for it. She then asked if I need to have all the old appliances removed.  Now today after waiting almost a week for my appliances they tell me I only ordered a refrigerator.  To get the black Friday deal I have to refuse the refrigerator cancel the order go in and make the order again then wait for the delivery up to a week. My kitchen has been completely emptied and waiting for my new appliances. I babysit out of my home and have a household of seven in addition. To have to go without a stove and refrigerator is extremely hard. My husband and I have both tried to figure something out with Home Depot. They refuse to try and help remedy the problem this week. They only offer a refund and order again they will come sometime next week. No discount, no tomorrow delivery, no take the fridge now and well get you the rest tomorrow. 
Nothing.  Completely discussed.

Do not go here. There's a IHOP on the other side of the intersection save yourself the heart ache of this place and just go to IHOP. Was here and maybe 7 other tables where people were seated I ordered coffee to drink it was room temp, ordered my food and waited 45mins before getting served only for it to be cold and the amount of grease on my plate when done eating made me wonder the last time the grill had been cleaned. Not to mention there were bugs crawling on the floor where another customer kept stepping on them to kill them. This place doesn't even deserve one star. Don't know how this place is even open.

First Time Here !!!

The wait wasn't long and our server was very nice.

We got regular TonKatsu and the spicy one and both were flavorful.

My son (10yo) got the Japanese Fried Chicken and loved it.


Will definitely be back
Rude staff, unhelpful sales people, and overall just a bad place to buy a car. Many other options out there and all are better. Overpriced cars and unhelpful staff

OK, the food took a little while to come but these days during the Covid crazy times, it is really difficult to get people to work at service jobs. I had a couple of issues but the manager Brie was very prompt in responding to me and I was satisfied with how she handled my questions.  5 stars because of the manager's handling of my issues. Service times...Today you get a "Get out of jail free" card! Thanks Brie
Very rude and unprofessional. I felt as if they were annoyed they had to help me. Tried to talk to the manager but she was worse than her employee!
Their Detroit style pie is glorified cheesy bread. SO much bread and so little flavor. I'm a huge fan of Detroit style pizza but unfortunately this is not it. Disappointing...

This place has some really good food and the milkshakes are amazing as well! And it's so good to see normal people working there and treating you like normal human beings. My family and I ate there this weekend and were completely taken back by actual customer service and smiling faces! We will be back again.

I went to see Arlene when I was facing major surgery, where pain control was going to be an issue. We had several sessions and I loaded my sessions onto my iPod to listen to over and over. We worked on changing the nature of pain. I still felt things but the hurt was taken out of of the things I felt. It is hard to describe, and Arlene could probably explain it better. What I can say is the surgery was successful and I did not have a problem with pain. Thanks Arlene.

I had an emergency hospitalization years after the planned surgery, and I used the same sessions until I could have new sessions recorded that were specific to the new problem.

I would go back to Arlene if needed. I sent my sister to her, and I have suggested her to friends. Great person, effective and reasonable fees, that is a hard to beat combo!

Due to the excellent ratings, we chose this hotel, tho expensive.  Cost us over $500.00 for 2 nights.  Upon entering room carpet was filthy and stained.  The bathroom had not been cleaned.  Bathtub was dirty and brown scum around the toilet paper holder.  Only 2 towels for a double queen room.  Thermostat in room didn't work properly, couldn't use continuous fan for white noise.  Took time for the refrigerator to cool since it was turned off. Mirrors dirty. Upon checkout, made a list of problems, which they could have cared less. Would never use this hotel again.

From the moment you first see the door you know it's going to be an amazing restaurant! The servers were all amazing! Everyone is super friendly and welcoming really loud upon entering which I loved!! The drinks are awesome!!! Highly recommend the blonde bombshell and adult Capri suns!! Loco fries are to die for and the big hoss burger is literally the best burger I've had in my entire life. My wife got the Nashville hot chicken sandwhich and it was perfect!! I absolutely will be a regular here. The environment is PERFECT! If you want amazing food, drinks, environment and service you have to come here!!!!

This used to be Coco Nail Spa, but it has new owners and a new name! I have been here several times since the new owner took over and I am definitely impressed with them.  They made some necessary changes and they have kept some of the things that I liked. The manicure and pedicure menu has not changed.  They still offer the same services. They even still have the rewards card where you get $15 off after you pay for 10 visits with cash. It's awesome that a business is willing to pass along savings to the customer when they aren't having to pay credit card processing fees! The shop is very clean and smells wonderful!! There is no "nail shop" smell here.  It has a couple of Scentsy burners going, so it's very nice. The employees are all very nice and do a great job.  
I suggest calling ahead and making an appointment because they get pretty busy.  This shop remains my #1 pick for a pedicure.
