Wow, I should have read these reviews before calling this company because I had the exact same experience the other reviewers did.  I called to get an quote, couldn't get them on the phone, so I sent them a message on Facebook (this was probably my first mistake).  I got a quote, and they were the lowest, so I set up an appointment (on Facebook.  Again, my mistake).  My appointment was at 10 on the day we had determined, and at 9:00 that day, I got a call that said he had sick kids and needed to make arrangements for them.  I have kids, and I totally understand.  But he was a no show.  Long story short, lots of going back and forth on facebook (NEVER another phone call, just Facebook messaging), me calling what he said was his personal cell phone AND the phone listed on the website several times with no call back, excuses of "sorry, been a bad week," and my favorite, "took cold medicine and fell asleep."  Again, I have kids, I understand if there was a family emergency or something, and if we would have explained, I would be more than sympathetic. But we rescheduled and that was when "something came up."  Just be warned before making an appointment with this company.

I can't wait to go back! I think I have a new favorite pizza place. I have really nothing to complain about other than I wish there were more pictures on the walls. Here are some FYI's: They have more than just pizza cones. They have salads. If you are crunching those calorie numbers make sure you note that one cone is the evaluate to 2 slices of pizza. They have dessert. In fact fellow Yelpers, if you rate Coned you are eligible for a free dessert-just not ice cream. And if you like saving money like me then make sure you grab a punch card. Since I'm on the topic of money, I like the price of these cones at $6 or $7. Seriously, everything was tasty! The crust, the sauce, the cheese, even my pepperoni! Now I did check out the kids menu and I'm not sure I'd try the PBJ cone but I'll definitely try the hot pretzels! One last thing, the bathroom was clean-thank you Coned! I really can't wait to come back even if you won't give me free ice cream for this review!

I'm conflicted.   I'm from out of town, and love NY Pizza, so when I saw this place I had to give it a try.  Unlike other reviews, the wait was not long at all.  I ordered two slices, one pepperoni and one 'special' which was a mustard based pizza with sausage and onion.   The pepperoni pizza was... awful.   An inch of grease on top, like it had been sitting around for hours and then thrown in an oven for too long. The special, to my surprise, was really good however.  I can't imagine anyone looked at the pepperoni pizza slice and decided it was good enough to serve, though.  I really don't know what happened.   Unfortunately, if push came to shove, I wouldn't come back.  Bummer.

I went to school in Eastern Idaho and I got Reeds dairy chocolate milk as often as my meager college budget would allow. Growing up in Meridian, I was elated to discover that my beloved chocolate milk could be purchased in my home town. I now live in Pittsburgh, but every time I visit my parents I get a half gallon and savor every sip during my stay. I have gone as far as freezing the smaller bottles, double bagging them, and checking my bag back to Pittsburgh to enjoy for a little while longer. I've been able to get home after a long day of travel with little ice chunks still in my milk, even in the middle of summer. I'll be honest, I've never tried anything else here, but I'm sure it's good! It's really the best chocolate milk I've ever had. There are a couple dairies here in Pittsburgh that have fun flavors every once in awhile, but nothing ever compares. I promise you won't regret trying the chocolate milk. You'll be hooked for sure!

I was once a fan of lucky perk but sadly to say that has changed. Went through the drive-through last week and ordered a couple of breakfast sandwiches, nothing special there and super overpriced. When it comes to coffee it's not that difficult right you're roasting means you have hot water that you are well apparently if you don't know how to make a salted caramel mocha you shouldn't offer that's all I'm saying! 
About three or four steps into my drink I started tasting what I thought was an excess of salt, come to find out most of my drink was a salty mess, common table salt not sprinkled on top but dumped into my cup I felt like I was a drunken sailor recovering from a bad night on the ocean and looking for a A place to throw up or jumped overboard! 
Needless to say I will not be back anytime soon, lucky perk your ship has sailed and it's beyond the horizon. 
My advice to you is teach you're young barista's how to make drinks.

Sid's Garage is BANGIN'! What a damn concept. Remember Donut & Dog? These are the same guys. But better. They've revamped the building and created a place where there are no rules when it come to good food and I'm here for it.  Huge burgers, innovative appetizers and oh my God the shakes are out of this world. 

My better half and I began with a Hazy IPA ($7.00) from Western Collective and a Setting Sun Sangria (white wine, champagne float, fresh fruit and seasonal purée, $10.00), respectively. Mine was such a dope drink. Think adult Capri sun. And it's delicious, I could definitely see myself enjoying one again on a hot summer day. Or any day, really. 

For food, we shared the Not So Whimpie (candied jalapeño bacon, aged cheddar cheese, lettuce, tomato, onions, pickles and burger sauce, on a brioche bun, $10.50). Damn, it really is different from your typical burger. The pattie is moist, almost feels like it melts in your mouth. I should have ordered my own but I wanted to save room for what brought me in in the first place...

Every month Sid's creates a new crazy milkshake with a whole freaking piece of cake of the top, offered alongside their other crazy af shakes. Their February shake is a vanilla red velvet shake topped with a red velvet cake slice with buttercream frosting, dark chocolate swirl, pastry lemon cream rim with red sugar coating, Sweetheart candies topped with a ring pop ($12.00). I am IN LOVE! Fan-freaking-tastic. It's a sugar-lover's absolute dream. I'm not sure how I'm going to try all their other shakes if I keep going back for their seasonal ones...I just may have to double back very soon!

This is by far my favorite breakfast spot in Idaho. I frequent the meridian location usually at least once a week. The pancakes are delicious. I've also tried almost everything else on the breakfast menu but the thing that stands out the most is the way the servers treat you. They always are so excited to see you and all a genuinely kind people. I've never had a bad experience her. They even write kind messages on my to go boxes. I love it here and will always come back!

Sabroso!!!  We have been looking for good Mexican restaurant.  Doesn't have all the bells and whistles decor but the food is great!  Great chili verde British and the salsa is wonderful!!  We will be back.  No pictures, I ate it too fast .
Walked in for the 1st time and was impressed with the decor, service and delicious food along with the extensive menu. I highly recommend this establishment.

I have always liked Camping World, at least the one out of state, but this one takes the cake! I went there on Monday to get (2) 5 gallon propane bbq tanks filled, and I went inside, spoke to nice lady at front desk, she directed me to a gentleman at the left desk who handles propane. He was on the phone, he acknowledged me (sort of) and she said I could wait out in my car for him.  I expected a few min wait due to his phone call, but then began to see many customers walking in, and being helped by HIM no less.  After shy of 30 min/8 songs on the radio, I went back in and asked if he was ever going to stop helping new customers and help me?  The guy at the front desk said he was the only 1 who did propane and I'd have to continue to wait.  I thought that was sort of rude as I was there before these other customers.  I finally walked out and left and went over to Bish's RV directly next store, and had my propane filled and took off in about 10 min of arrival.  All just too easy, not so easy at Camping World.  Sadly this wasn't even a BUSY day for them. I must say, there was a worker in the back area who noticed I hadn't been helped, he asked me, I told him what was up, and sadly he couldn't do the propane to help me, otherwise I would have only waited for about 15 min.  So unless your buying an RV/Trailer or something for it, they don't care about you.  Last time I go there for any trailer accessories or especially propane!

Burgers, wraps, sandwiches, salads sides and almost no options that are not animal protein centric unless you look at sides like onion rings and 'tots'.  Not that there's anything wrong with that as Seinfeld and George Costanza would say.  Opened roughly May 11, 2021 when owners closed the Caldwelll location, this Meridian outpost is at Linder and Chinden near Reed's Dairy and Black Rock Coffee so it is a good fit for the kind of 'family fast' in that strip mall.

This location is one of maybe three, others in Nampa and Twin Falls perhaps, local owned.

The format is order at the counter and carry your eats to your seat or out the door to go. 

Prices are lowish.  Examples:  Finger Steaks or Philly Steak Sandwich $8.29 / Western Chicken Sandwich $8.59 / Kickin' Western Burger $8.29...all comes with fries or tots (no surprise) / Pulled Pork Roll Up $8.76 / Buffalo Chicken Flatbread $7.99 / Cashew Chicken Salad $7.99 / Street Taco (with choice of protein) $2.99 and so it goes with lots of options in those kinds of options.  A Kidz (that is not a typo) menu of the usual suspects like chicken nuggets and mac n cheese in about half a dozen choices for $5.29.  None of those are things I eat so the draw for me was multiple kinds of lemonade but 'sourpuss' that I am theirs is too sweet for my sour loving taste buds.

A number of my neighbors love Burnt Lemon because it is in their wheelhouse of big sizes and low prices and old fashioned feel.   If that is also your thing, this place is worth the try.  

The parking lot in this newish strip mall is lousy.  So you know.

I'm sorry but the coffee here is just not good. The service is very kind and quick and they have an okay environment depending on what you're looking for in a coffee shop -- it could be a nice place to work or talk. I ordered an iced latte with almond milk the first time I came and it was just so bitter and not enjoyable, I couldn't drink it at all. The next time I ordered a latte with regular milk and I did end up drinking it but it was just okay. I don't know if it's their roast or they need to pull their shots earlier but I just the coffee was very bitter and not smooth at all.
Food was fantastic. Vibe was great. Cute outside seating near a little park with a water feature. Definitely go check them out!!

My clothes are so clean, they look brand new!!!! The staff is friendly and knowledgable.  I even took my favorite placemats and table runner.  They looked fabulous.  I live near downtown and I won't go anywhere else!!! They are the bomb

I feel bad writing this, but in my defense, I gave this place more than one shot. The first time my friend and I walked in without an appointment, which took about 3 hours total for us to get in and out. The dip powder I got done wasn't bad but my pedicure was chipping 3 days after having it done. What's worse is I didn't realize that the person that did it didn't cut my toenails at all. I should've noticed but you'd think that it would've been done...?

The second time I went I made an appointment and it took 3 1/2 hours for me to get in and out. The pedicure was great, but after that was finished I went and sat in a chair waiting to get my nails done for 30 mins at least. They used the excuse that my nails had to soak to get the dip powder off. Although it does take a while, I know that isn't true. Especially considering the fact that I have a cosmetology license. 

On top of all that, they asked someone working at the front to file off my top coat. Based on her lack of experience and how many times she asked me if she hurt me, I'm fairly confident that she isn't licensed at all. 

Once again, after 3 days, I had an issue. The dipping powder started chipping. Next thing I know, all of my nails were lifting and getting caught on my hair. I finally had enough and took 10 minutes to just chip them off on my own. 

After being asked to wait, with an appointment, having walk ins taken long before me, and having the quality of my nails be less than great, I'm done trying with this place. I paid $169 that day for a gel pedicure (I got the highest price one, which is $70 w/ gel) and the dipping powder on my nails. So beware, they may overcharge you too...

I went through the drive-thru here. Just kidding! I know all they have is a drive-through LOL I ordered a green tea smoothie, and it was divine. I will definitely be coming back for another very soon.

Outstanding! My son and I tried this place this morning and were very pleased. We got one sweet (Cinnalove) and one savory (Chicken and waffles)) and we shared. Chicken was very juicy and crispy, just like it should be. Flavors were incredible. Definitely coming back to try everything on the menu. Only thing I would change is for the coffee to be a bit more hot. Other than that, yumm-o!!

Not a true 24/7 gym/tanning place like I signed up for.  They've gone to a "spa model" for the tanning and it hasn't been really available to me for over a year.  I'm out.  Also, they have a special maintenance fee of $20 every July.  At the Vista place, the manager told me the 2K people were happy with it.  I don't see $40K worth of improvements in the last 5 months.  In fact, I haven't seen a single new piece of equipment in that time.  They cardio equipment is also low end stuff.  The heart rate monitors don't work on most of the treadmills, for example.  Pretty crappy attitudes on  the workers too.  I'd rather work out in prison.

Gastropub is a term I'm not familiar with, so I can't say how this restaurant tanks in category. Their menu is loaded with food I ate as a kid but reimagined for adults. I had beef stroganoff, and my wife ate grown up grilled cheese and tomato soup. 

The food was hot, full of flavor, and served in a cool "pub" type atmosphere. Our server was excellent. It was a quiet dinner for two in the late afternoon on a Monday.

Idaho arms and ammo is a top notch store.  I was looking for some parts for my AR-15 build.  The store was not your typical dark gun store.  It was modern, well lit and best of all very well stocked with top shelf products.  The staff was very experienced and kind.  They took the time to find the parts that best fit my needs.  Definitely recommend this store, I will be back!

We finally found this place after friends sugested we try it. It was Sauturday and raining so the place was packed. Seating was quick and service was prompt. Food was good, but, the size of the portions were VERY disappoinintg! The price for the "Bronco Scramble" was $9.95, and the amount of food was very small. Would not make a decent omelette and the hashbrown portions were equally disappoinintg.  My wife's "bowl" of oatmeal was not even a CUP. If the very pleasant waitress had not broought her a second "bowl" she would hav eleft very unfilled. Good food, High prices and small quantities. They better either lower thier prices or increase the quantity. We wont return for quite a while and then if nothing has changed we will find a nother place!

We took our RV in for a new Lift kit for a failed rear jack motor issue.  We were quoted $6802.00.  Everything was fine - until it wasn't.  We received a call from the service dept. stating that they needed another 3 additional hours to install the lift kit.  Plus there was another $600.00 required for parts in order to finish the job.   The explanation was poor - but what I was able to understand was that our bill was growing and going up.  The price was a moving target.  The customer service was for the most part  hit and miss depending  who was helping you.  We left a message with the manager the next working day which was a Monday.  We called again and left a message but after no response we just decided to drive down there to get this resolved.   After a couple of hours of going back and forth and with many quotes and revisions - not to mention  frustration......we got it resolved.  We also had them check the seals around the motor home for leaks.  At that point our confidence was shot down and we opted out of not having them do the repairs.

Now - onto the positive side.  There were 2 people that we were  impressed with.  They tried hard to make things right.  Not sure of the spelling but one young man was named  Andrea.  Andrea worked in service and there was Eddie who is the manager of the parts department on the other side of the store. Eddie was able to bring the price down to the original quote- shaving off of about $800.00 from the original quote. 

The work appears to have been done properly.  When we picked up the RV - they did come out and show us the repaired fix.  Hopefully this dealer can get their customer service and prices down packed,  so they can turn this place around.
Love them! Nows the best time to support local. Incredible coffee and really sweet staff.

James showed up on time was quick reliable and reasonably priced. I would use him again anytime. Very professional and knew what he was doing. Very friendly. Great service. He drilled and installed a deadbolt for me

5 minutes before they even began to take my order then 20 minutes to fill it. a SINGLE item that normally is served in under 3 minutes.

The cashier was nasty while trying to say there was only two people there.  Even if that's not a lie that's no excuse for such a display of gross and willful incompetence.

I love love love this place, as native a Los Angelina I am used to having a melting pot of restaurants nearby and my standards are a little high. Since moving here I was dying for good ramen and every place I tried just didn't make the cut. Then I had a friend recommend this place to me and I've been hooked ever since. It's a tiny little place in Meridian with a hip vibe, good food, and phenomenal customer service. And it's always super clean, even the bathroom! 

I have a mushroom allergy and they have never given me trouble about it or made me feel like it was an inconvenience to them. One time a little mushroom accidentally got into my soup (I suspect that it had fallen in to the prep container of another veggie) and I found it half way through my meal. I told the waitress not to worry as I had already eaten half of the soup and I didn't ingest it so I should be okay, but the cook (possibly owner?) insisted on remaking my soup AND came out to make sure it was okay.

As for the food itself, everything has amazing texture and deep, rich flavors.  I usually get Tonkatsu Ramen and a rice curry bowl and it is just as good as back home. I have literally never had a bad experience here. My ONLY criticism is that it closes between the lunch and dinner service, which is normal, but I usually get hungry for lunch right at 2 or 3 pm and I often miss the lunch service. I cannot recommend this place enough, just save me a table!

We had never heard of this before and what an interesting experience! So cool - pizza in a cone!

Dad: the sauce is unique. I don't absolutely love it, but i like it. I thought it was great though. 

Mom: we usually order light sauce on our pizza, so we should have said light sauce for you. I love the sauce. I would definitely eat here again. I want to try the salad ;)

Daughter; i don't like the sauce. It tastes like spaghetti sauce, not pizza sauce. I liked it and I'd eat here again.

Son: 100% i love it. I would eat here morning, noon & night. (He is 15!)

Overall review: we're coming back!

Fabulous pancakes and coffee!   Try the sausage varieties too.  
The staff is so friendly--Amy is our favorite server.  

It's a great place for breakfast and lunch.

Most of the peeps that follow me on here know by now how obsessed I am with pizza ESPECIALLY good pizza! We should all only be obsessed with good pizza! Papa Johns and Domino's...NOT good pizza! 
Always look for mom and pop places or ya know...places that ARE NOT NATIONAL CHAINS! Domino's literally tastes like ass. They haven't been good since 1992 lol. I'm that old. Papa Johns was good years and years ago when AND ONLY WHEN 1) you were broke and starving or 2) you were in a rush to get something for you and your low rent friends hahaha! 

Johnny Bronx! (My dad was born and raised in the Bronx. The real NYC lol) I saw a story about this mook (lol) on the news after all the pandemic nonsense started. I have been DYING to try this place! Being from New York, i am forever on a quest for AMAZING pizza in BOISE. IDAHO. 
I've come across a few good places. 
First great place was the NY Giant Pizza (but their slices only! Regular pizzas have a totally different vibe to them)
Second place, Guidos on the Boise/Meridian border. Amazing pizza, but like I said in my review for them, there was something about that pizza that couldn't be mentioned in a review haha! Trust me on that. 
And now! Third! Johnny Bronx!!! 
Johnny's easily gets bumped to number 1! NY giant is second and Guidos is third.
To be honest too, I am not sure Johnny's will be bumped from the top spot. 
The news thing I saw about them almost a year ago stated that the owner recently had moved here from NYC. That right there had my eyes open up wide haha! 
Peeps from the city KNOW good pizza and KNOW how to make it! They also know how fn sacred pizza is to some of us! This guy also knew "Im moving to Idaho! I KNOW there ain't no good pizzas out there!" (That's literally what every NYer thinks when coming here lol
Actually, any NYer who leaves NY just knows they'll never have another pizza as great as ACTUAL NY pizza lol. They try places like Idaho Pizza or whatever that's called or Pie Hole and then they.....leave crying and cry harder when Idahoans ate like PIE HOLE IS THE BEST EVER!!! Get tf outta here with that nonsense hahahaha! 
I'd almost say dominos is better but ugh I can't say that. Just can't. 

Anyway, when I heard he moved here from the city I was so fn stoked to try this shit. Then I looked it up ... 25 mins from my house. A single tear rolled down my cheek knowing it would be awhile before I get to try it. 

MONTHS LATER that tear dried up! Why? Because on rare occasion I was in that area. I rarely go to Meridian. Boise has everything I need EXCEPT JOHNNY BRONX!!! Dude, people live in Boise. In fact, the population in Boise is indeed greater than that of Meridians population! I get it, the rent is probably cheaper there. Lemme tell you tho, opening one in Boise would be genius! You'd make a killing! Why? Because you're pizza is FN AMAZING!!!! 
So I was over in Meridian to pick up a Mr. Potato Head lol True story. Thanks cancel culture folks lol
So roommate was like...want a pizza? I'm like HELL YEAH! Lemme look at Yelp first Yelp one to pop up...Johnny Bronx. 

I was BEYOND EXCITED TO FINALLY be getting this pizza I've waited almost a year to get. Sure I could have driven over before now, but I'm being 10000% honest here when I say this, I HATE HATE HATE the traffic in this city. Like it legit gives me a panic attack. I don't like to drive outside my bubble unless I have to. 
Yes, NYC traffic is horrific, but this is Boise! It's not supposed to be bad.

Ok, before I run out of room. I rambled extra extra today lol.
The drive is absolutely worth it. This pizza is GREAT and then some! It says it's authentic NY pizza and even tho they don't use NY water (yeah apparently that's a biggie lol) it's still HANDS DOWN the BEST pizza Boise/Meridian has to offer us. If you've been, you know. However if you've never had NY pizza, then you just know Johnny's is great and trust me when I say this, it's the closest you'll ever get to NYC pizza especially for y'all who live in a bubble and refuse to travel lol 

The pizza, cheese was $16 plus tax. Little higher than I thought but it's worth it. 
The staff is SUPER friendly. All Idahoans lol. You can tell. I would have loved to meet the actual owner, but nah didn't happen. Maybe in the future because I'll definitely return but again ... BOISE NEEDS A JOHNNY BRONX!

Seriously you will NOT be disappointed! Cheese is amazing, sauce .. perfect and of course the one thing most care about ..: how's the crust? I sent a pic to my brother in NY of the pizza and right away "the crust looks good af!" Haha! And it is! So damn good! 

Go to Johnny Bronx! Let's make sure they get the service the deserve and then some! We need them to always be here and hopefully one in Boise one day! 

Thanks Yelpereeetites! I'm sure I'm out of room! Thanks for reading and ENJOY TF out of Johnny Bronx! I know you will! Thanks for bringing great pizza to the Treasure Valley!

Cheers!!!

I did run out of room and had to cut out a lot lol

Excellent service and food! Had a great breakfast here this morning with such a friendly and attentive waiter. 

The food was classic diner breakfast food, but a tad elevated. 

It was a little bit noisy, due to construction in the restaurant (they are expanding! ), but it wasn't too bad.

I am a big fan of Driven Automotive. I have been having my Toyota Camry serviced there for the past two years and find that the workmanship is great and the customer service is consistently beyond expectations.

These folks are honest and will do whatever it takes to please. There prices are very reasonable.

For whatever reason this Costco doesn't carry the same items or is always out of certain items. If I go to the Costco in Nampa or Boise they'll have what I'm looking for? Not sure what's up with that.

This UPS store is great! Just went in to mail some Xmas gifts... The line was out the door! Although it was crazy busy they were fast, efficient, and super positive vibes! The person who helped me was very friendly and helpful even with having to go go go nonstop. I needed help with packaging my gifts, which I felt bad about because it was so busy. She didn't bat an eye and just got right to it. I was immediately reminded why I choose UPS over the USPS any day!

DO YOURSELF A FAVOR and find another place to service your RV.  There are a lot of other places in the Boise area who provide RV Service and Repair.  Camping World of Boise in Meridian has the poorest customer service imaginable.  Charlie, in the service department, was rude, insulting and inconsiderate from beginning to end.  He did his level best to intimidate us and during a phone conversation when we asked to speak to his manager he hung up on us.  We are older and retired and have never been treated so poorly.  Unbelievably, it took over 2 months (not kidding) to complete warranty work on a new fifth wheel we bought from them less than 4 months prior.  We happened upon an executive of Camping World from Illinois and asked him to help us get our fifth wheel repaired and returned back to us.  June 20, 2017 to September 1, 2017 without our new fifth wheel.  Inexcusable.
Another great experience at Eight Thirty Common. This restaurant has been very consistent with delicious food and great service. They have a great menu.

Starting the sessions with Arlene is one of the best decisions I've made in my life.  I came to her for the anger issue.  It was at my low point of my life and felt very hard to control emotions.  The relaxation tools she gave me on the first session had an immediately positive impact on me.  

We then had several sessions on inner child to investigate deeper on the reason.  She helped me to reconcile with the past and correct the false belief, which empowered me to face the issue,  and finally solved it successfully.  I especially liked the personal notes she gave at the end of the session.  It tells me that she listens, cares, and always well prepared for the session.  

I'm now in the third session of the weight loss program.  I've already noticed the changes on my food choice.  I can't believe I can transform to a veggie lover in such a short time.  The amazing part is that I don't need to try hard to avoid unhealthy food and drink as before since the change is made to the subconscious mind.   Arlene totally deserves a 5 star review, and I hope anyone who is seeking for the cure of their problems /issues will get the help from her!

At last,  thank you Arlene for bringing the joy and peace back to my life!
One of my top favorites in Meridian.  The food is top notch.  Today I had a grilled cheese and tomato soup.  Excellent along with the service.

We were super excited for this opening- love this location! Flatbread is great so we knew the owners would likely deliver a fun new concept. The food that we had was good and we will definitely return because some of the items we wanted weren't available. No big deal. 
The reason for the 3 stars- pretty easy fixes, really. Our server showed ZERO excitement! No mention of recently opening, no name/introduction , no recommendations or even the offer to answer questions- first thing she said 'do you want anything other than water?' So boring. I mean, you JUST opened! Show your excitement to be there and your guests will feel it. 
Another thing that bothered all of us at our table... the fact that staff utilizes the garage roll up door to go between the patio and inside. There is a small wall that everyone has to liters step over and it looks so unprofessional and lazy. Maybe if the small wall at the bottom wasn't there, it wouldn't have been so obvious, but they even used this access while the tables in front of the door were seated with guests. It was so bad. All 4 of us noticed it right away and couldn't believe it. It's really the little details that make restaurants stand out. I think there are a lot of great things about this restaurant but I just feel they need fine tune the details. Especially staff! 


* I tried to email that address but it didn't work. I'm happy to try a different one, if you have one. 


I am SO happy to be adding to my review. As I originally mentioned, we like this place and so when some friends were recently in town, we went back for lunch. Everything was great!! The food was delicious, we sat inside with our 2 little kids we had with us  and it was a wonderful lunch. We loved all of the food, the happy hour beers, and on top of it, Alex was our server and he was incredible! Great knowledge of the menu with a fun personality- much different than our first experience. We did see our previous server taking care of the table next to us and we were so happy that Alex was our guy. After we ate, we ventured onto the patio and the kids enjoyed the grassy area while we sat and chatted. 

So happy to know some great changes have been made! See you again soon and thank you Alex!

Ramen Sho is awesome! It's definitely become one of my favorite food trucks. I grew up eating ramen all the time, and many of Ramen Sho's dishes bring me back to my childhood. Although I've tried much of their menu I always go back to the Tonkotsu ramen. For only $8 you get a ginormous bowl of this insanely good dish. I would recommend adding the chashu and an egg!
Great place that does excellent work Henry will take good care of your clothes or whatever for a better price than most in the valley

Cute little hole in the wall. Since I am under the weather, I knew ramen would be just the cure. I ordered hot tea, which they do not give you the entire tea pot. They give you a fairly big tea cup and just pour to your hearts desire. They have combos, ramen and beer, ramen and pork buns, ramen and rice bowls. We ordered the ramen and rice bowl and their ramen bowls were massive! Hearty bowls of noodles and veggies. Before I came here, I read the reviews that said their pork belly was not tender enough. This was not the case when I stopped by today. The pork belly was tender and practically melted in my mouth. Was very impressed today.
Tasty! Not the greatest pizza I've ever had and the dough is frozen into a cone shape and then "made to order" so there's that. Other than that, it's really tasty and not good for you at all lol.

The food here is amazing. Perhaps some
Of the best food in town, and very unique way of doing things. The atmosphere could use a little pick-me-up, but the atmosphere is nice, clean and modern still. Still blown away by how good their house made tater tots were!!! You must get them!

First time doing business at this location this morning. I went in because I understand they support the Rocky Mountain High School Football team (I appreciate that). The staff and service was spectacular! The were fast, friendly and efficient. Made a fan of me. I will be back for tire service and oil changes.
The food today, & every visit, was (is) exceptional   Montana is a great server, very attentive & pleasant. Love the atmosphere, community & company. Look forward to our next meal
Great NY style pizza! Thin and bendy crust. A simple sausage and cheese pie is hard to make and they do not disappoint! Their mac and cheese is pretty solid as well.
We love the recommendations here. Our favorite is Corey. He had sold us many recommended mods and disposables. We don't shop anywhere else even though there are 2 locations closer to us.

We picked up food and we had Yokozuna deliver dinner in the past month. We like the peanut noodles, teriyaki chicken, yakisoba noodles and the miso soup is the best around.  I really enjoyed how fresh their salads are too- Teriyaki salad is very good!  They have bubble teas which are also tasty, and they have a ton of different flavors.  Staff was very friendly and gave great service both visits.  We will be back again.

This company doesn't even rate one star, but I had to give them one to write a review.  I placed an order and the person taking the order said they could do sauce on the side for our chow mein.  Because every time they have delivered it in the past, the sauce has ended up spilling all over the delivery box and leaving none on the food. Employee said no problem. When the order showed up without the sauce, I called.  He said the boss told him it didn't work that way.  I asked to talk to the boss, and asked him to refund my money for that one item, because it wasn't what I ordered. He told me he did not make a mistake, his employee made a mistake, so he wouldn't refund the money. When I tried to explain why he should do so, he wouldn't shut up and listen to me, just kept ranting on and on that he was right.  Never had such lousy customer service in my entire life.  Certainly the rudest restaurant owner in Idaho. DON"T DO BUSINESS WITH THESE PEOPLE!
Good experience, our order was completed quickly and accurately, friendly staff! Consistent food quality, we'll definitely be back.

The WORST place ever!!!
I would not recommend it. Prices are way to high for the quality of food, let alone the service. I ordered the bacon appetizer, burnt like no other. Asked for a replacement,  gm came to our table and said he would replace a half piece of bacon...are you kidding me? 
It gets better...
I ordered a salad with chicken pieces on it, very dry as far as dressing. I asked 2 servers if I could get more no one  showed up with more dressing ...dress..
I finally gave up asking for anything at this point. Paid 97.65 for our meals.
Called them after I left since I couldn't get any servers to do anything. 8 phone calls later after I kept getting disconnected and spoke with Eric the Gm. He said he would credit me for the bacon and salad. Asked exactly how much that credit was going to be, said he would send me a $25 gift card. I never got it. Called back, said he would send it within an hour. Again, never got it. I realize we are in the middle of a pandemic but come on....we are paying a high price for their food and service and they were sub par at best on both fronts....
We had to call back 3 more times because my husbands credit card got charged twice. Heard back from the owner Will today. Said he sent us an email Sunday evening and issued us a credit. He also told us we were harassing his staff and to never come back. 
Not a problem, he was very aggressive with us, I won't support a business like that.
 Now we have to dispute both charges with our bank
Really good food, really good service and reasonable prices. Awesome job folks!! Breakfast is the best

Would not recommend Camping World - Meridian.  Take a look at the Better Business Bureau site.  They have nearly 800 complaints.  We did have a good experience with the Sales Department, however, the Service Department is frustrating at best.  When a unit is scheduled for a service appointment, it doesn't mean that they have any parts required for service or even will have the time to look at it.  After drop off, they will eventually look at it, and then, order parts or get warranty approval.  In our experience, on three separate occasions during the past year, our unit has sat on the CW lot for over a month.  Two times, our unit has been damaged by CW while sitting on the lot.  The Service Manager is impossible to deal with and is unwilling to help facilitate repairs.  We are always told that they can't give us a estimate of completion date, and we are welcome to pick it up whenever we want.  There is always an excuse -- ordered the wrong metal, part, etc.  We will not be doing business with Camping World in the future.

Merp!  Was excited to try this place out but was sorely disappointed.  We left hungry our W done burgers were Med/rare and super greasy. The "candied jalapeño bacon" they offer on the burger which is why i ordered it was literally just a slice of reg. Bacon and pickled jalapeños on top. The ice machine was out the entire time we were there. Really just not worth the hype and a waste of 47$ for 2 burgers, 1 fry and soft drinks. Also if your a covid conscious person don't go here!

I needed the clutch replaced on my VW Jetta. Bobby's replaced it quickly and at a great price. And most importantly my car is running great! The mechanics were all very nice, helpful and knowledgeable. I will definitely use them again.

Went to the Bank of the West after moving to Meridian ID on Wells.  They required an appointment, so I made one.  I went to the bank and waited 20 minutes with no assistance from the personal.  Ending up leaving and went down the street the Idaho Central Credit Union to establish a checking account.  They provided superior customer service and assisted me with no issues.
Went to Bank of the West again three days later for a deposit.  Waited 20 minutes in line to get waited on.  I talked to Stacey VP regarding my visit and the lack of service.  She gave me a poor excuse about my experience.  If you want good customer service and a sense of urgency when you go in to do a transaction, then this is not the place to go.  This is coming from a customer of Bank of the West that has been with them for 50 years.

The guys here were amazing. They got me in at the last minute and stayed passed their store hours to complete my install of four new tires plus an balance and alignment. I will be coming back to them.

Karaoke on Saturday  night was the 1st and last time I will be coming out to this show. She needs to learn a few things about a fair rotation. I did enjoy the singers and the chicken fingers.  Go Cubs

I went to get a anti-aging facial + derma-planing service done today and I was displeased and in pain throughout the 90 mins. The derma-plaining experience was painful and I don't believe it should be based on my research. In addition, the type of blade Clayton used for the derma-planing was disappointing. The blade / tools utilized through the facial did not appear as advanced/professional tools. The whole facial was just painful. I won't be returning. I will say Clayton had good conversation. However, I am
extremely disappointed that Clayton did not offer a discount on today's service considering the fact that he dropped a light fixture on my face by accident before we started the facial. I will be conducting further research on esthetician's / services moving forward.

I'm so glad I didn't read the reviews before choosing this apartment complex . Wow, this was not our experience here.  The staff was friendly and the overall upkeep of the grounds was nice.  The apartment was exactly what we needed for a 10 month lease.

We just sold our home and was in the process of building a new home.  My husband and I needed an apartment right away and the one we originally were going to rent was rented from under us (annoying and not worth going into). Anyway, we needed a place to live ASAP to transition from our old  home to an apartment before closing on our old home.  The Franklin had an apartment available but it was a day or two before it would be ready for the dates we needed. Timing was everything for us,
and I asked the manager if we could get in earlier.
Thankfully the management worked with us and got the place ready for us on the date we needed. 

As for the  apartment, it was clean and honestly the nicest apartment we have ever lived in.  We hadn't lived an apartment since the 1980s and they weren't as nice as this place. However, apartment living, for me, is what it is, LOUD!  Walls are thin and the biggest complaint here is the heating and air, inside and out.  The heating unit inside is extremely loud and the outdoor AC units from other apartments were loud and annoying to the point where why bother sitting on the back deck.  I tried, I honestly tried, but every time one unit in particular would go off, and this thing had a rattle to it, I had to come inside.  Another pet peeve I had is that the toilets, after a day or two after cleaning, would get this moldy ring.  Pretty gross and I assume it was because the toilets are cheap.  Basically everything in the apartment is cheap material, but it's new so it's not broken down...yet. 

The water does not get hot enough to sanitize your dishes.  I would turn the water to just hot and could easily put my hands under it without burning myself.  You can't turn up the hot water heater either because it is locked. I suppose I could of called maintenance, but I didn't bother to.  I just got used to it. 

Also another thing to be aware of is that the $300 deposit is more like a fee.  You will not see much money after moving out.  They charge $180 for carpet and light cleaning.  And then you get charged for the last part garbage, water and sewer.  We vacated our place a month before our lease was up so not sure what water would of been used. Anyway, I was annoyed at the carpet and cleaning fee since my apartment was very clean and there's not much carpet, however I guess I did agree to those fees and didn't question them until I got the bill.  Oh well.  I think this is probably pretty standard with apartment complexes, but be aware that the $300 is not a deposit that will be returned after you move out.

On another positive note is that this place being a dog friendly complex,  there was never any issues with the dogs as far as dog poop not being picked up or excessive barking. My husband and I are not pet owners. There were a lot of dog owners that lived at the Franklin  but either the management was diligent in making sure the tenants were responsible for picking up after their animals or the tenants were awesome in picking up poop and making sure their pets didn't make a lot of noise.  

Overall I think you will run into the type of annoyances I mentioned living in most apartment complexes.  And as far as rent, it's competitive to other places.  The cleanliness and upkeep  and location was pretty nice and so I think three stars in a fair rating for my experience here.

If you read the other reviews you'll definitely get the gist of why you should NEVER rent from this complex. Especially considering hundreds of people all have the same issue which is 100% management. The OWNERS should truly take a hard look at who they are employing and how horribly they are "managing" their business. 

I could go into detail about every single issue I've unfortunately had to deal with here, but that would take at least a year to type. 

I'd also like to add I still have seven months on my lease, but the disrespect that comes from the staff of this complex is so bad, I had to warn others before they decided to rent from here. 

Long story short, the management, specifically Kayla, is ONE THOUSAND percent the most unprofessional, rude, condescending, power tripped manager I have ever had the un-pleasure of interacting with. Any issue I've had to bring to her attention, wether it be with my unit or the residents, it is ALWAYS met with a rude and uninterested attitude from Kayla, who usually has no solution to the issues at hand besides a "Sorry about that!"  

They will also throw around lease violations without ever actually trying to solve the "issues" that they're "violating" you for. 

Again, I would stay as far from this complex as possible considering you pay over $1000 a month for a box with a dog park, a dirty hot tub, and a HORRIBLE manager.

I love their food! The Ribs, sweet onion chicken and teriyaki chicken has a good amount of flavor and it makes my taste buds go crazy every single time I go there. It's one of my favorite places in Boise and I visit it pretty often. The guys at the counter are friendly and amazing! 
I would go over and over again!
They have a number that goes to fax...what help is that? How is any body supposed to get ahold of anybody?
If only I could do 6 stat.  Unique Korean food and friendly fast service.   They are slowly adding items and mixing it up.   No complaints

My mother in law was desperate for a Chinese restaurant that could deliver lunch to our office.  She called a few places and finally found Great Wall.  I cringed a little when I looked at the lunch menu option... It seemed rather cheap and there weren't many options.  

While placing the order of 5 lunch specials plus eggs rolls my MIL had to repeat herself several times and the woman taking her order was very rude!  It took a good hour before our food finally arrived and they didn't even get it right.  We didn't receive one of the sweet and sour pork with fried rice that we ordered but instead we got some kind of shrimp fish.  All of the chicken was dark meat and the "fried rice" was like steamed rice with a little egg and green onion. Nobody at the table had much good to say about their order.

I was NOT surprised when I looked them up on Yelp and saw other reviews while I picked over my mandarin chicken.  I am giving them 2 stars because the food did arrive HOT and I did not get food poisoning.  We will not be ordering Chinese take out from here again!

I went to buy my favorite Koia Keto Carmel Creme plant-base keto shake! Thank Heavens there was one left just for me! Mackenzie (the cashier at checkout) was really polite. She offered the membership and had informed me that curbside pickup is now available. Awesome service.

Very disappointing experience tonight. First, the staff were nonexistent. We wanted to try a sample. We got tired of waiting and went back to just pick something. Finally they appeared from the back with phones in hand. They couldn't have cared less to see us. We got what we wanted and went to the front. Two other people came in. The staff asked if they were there for the grill, which they were. The girls told them the grill was closed as the cook had quit. After they walked out, the girls proceeded to mock the customers about not being able to read the sign on the door. Keep that to yourselves. Finally, when it was time to pay, one of the girls was very busy on her cell phone. The other couldn't figure out how to charge my card. She annoyingly interrupted the other that was on her phone.

What a pathetic display of service. No wonder the cook for the grill quit.

had ServPro come back inpart for the unpack. Our crew was Kirby Antonio Mike Marcos Jackson Lenard and Jerry. Nice friendly hard working guys who did their best to make everything right. Whatever wasn't just as we wanted it, Jerry stepped in to make it good.  I'm told by others our time frame from move out to move in was very fast compared to other services.  Great customer service.

I have been meaning to match locks on all the doors in my home as well as the deadbolts for a long time and finally got around to it. I requested a quote late on a Friday night and received a quote back within minutes.After a couple of messages back/forth, we arranged to have them come out the very next morning. He showed up on time and quickly took care of my job while taking the time to explain what and why he was doing everything. I am highly impressed and would definitely recommend them to anyone looking for similar services.

What a selection of hardscape materials!  We were in search of paver options for our backyard walkway as well as some materials for a waterfall fountain.  This place did not disappoint.  We went on a Saturday late morning and this place was super busy.  We were able to walk around and look at a bunch of different options.  We were offered help, but weren't ready to make a final decision as there were just too many good choices.  We also noticed a good selection of healthy Japanese Maples at great prices.  I guess that will be another project we can add to the list.  If you are in need of hardscape materials and/or trees, you need to check out their selection.
First time eating here. I wasn't sure about the sweet potato noodles because I'm am not a fan of sweet potatoes, but I couldn't even tell. Customer service was great and the food hada great taste!!!

Took the iPad in here after the kiddos dropped it. They ordered the part for me and then when it arrived, they replaced it! Unfortunately the screen started to lift a tiny bit, so I took it back. Without hesitation they immediately dialed me in and reminded me about their warranty for the service performed on it. Would recommend this place to anyone that has an issue with their iPad or iPhone. I believe they fix just about anything phone or device related!

Want the best burger, come here! Super awesome service, the staff is over the top friendly and inviting. You walk in and the atmosphere is amazing! We needed a lot of food to buy lunch for our office staff. The food was done on time and all of our requests were made!Everyone at our office ate every bite of what we got and now are all planning to go visit! Even when you dine in the food is fast, big, and always going to put a smile on your face! Came here with some girl friends and we had a blast trying each others burgers and seeing the cool flavors all come together! Everyone in idaho needs to try this place! It's awesome! I personally love the Boss Hog and the Nashville Hot Chicken Sandwich!

I've just had my third LED facial treatment, and love it. Even though I'm not suppose to see any changes yet, I am quite sure there is an improvement in texture of my skin, as well as an evening of color.  The process is completely non-invasive -- the LED emitting panel is positioned above your face and does not make contact.  Clayton prepares the skin first, then applies a mask, and then places the LED panel.  I think it takes about 40 minutes, but I'm not sure because.....in addition (!!!!!!), Clayton gives a wonderful arm and hand massage while your LED facial takes place! THAT certainly makes the time fly!  I've signed on for an eight-treatment package.  Also, when I asked a friend - who used to run a high-end chain of day spas in SoCal - what treatments she partakes in, this was her first mention!! That got me to try it -- the results (and Clayton's massage -- heehee) convinced me.
this is first time i came here with my boyfriend . ramen is very good，we also ordered fried chicken and takoyaki, everything good here. the waitress so nice! love u

My husband and I went to Terri's on the 23rd to get our butts up and going for a long and stressful day.... and because I wanted a local joint with good breakfast food. I got the Eggs Benedict. I have NEVER had one before. I have made the dish for others but I have never eaten it myself. I'm not entirely sure why. I now realize that I was missing out this whole time. The eggs were poached perfectly and the hollandaise sauce was also made right (can be a pain to make from scratch, trust me.) I was so full when finished but it was a happy full. It was also served with hashbrowns and those were really good too. 

 My husband get the bacon cheeseburger. He really liked the buns they use but the meat was a little more rare than what he likes but he said it was still really good.  Their fries were pretty darn tasty too.  I tried their sparkling Strawberry basil lemonade. It was lacking the sparkling and not a whole lot of sweetness but still refreshing. 

Our waitress, Lisa,  was a sweetheart of a lady and made sure that we were well taken care of. Thanks Terri's!!

Worst customer service ever. This is the third and last time I will ever go here. Staff acts like you're privileged to walk in their store, staff at the food prep counter acts exasperated when you ask them to make something fresh. Flagship Albertsons is ten times better. Far better service, wider selection, and better prices. Don't waste your time.
These were so damn good we went back and bought two more for my mother in law.  Mother In Law...  Not sure about the rest but the Apple Pie and Bavarian Cream we de-lish!  5 stars!!

If you go, don't go during the lunch rush. We were just there and told it would be 15 minutes before we could be seated. We asked if we could sit on the bench in the outside foyer and were told we could. I checked after 15 minutes, and after others had been seated who came after us and was told they hadn't forgotten us. After yet another group was seated, 30 minutes later, I went inside to find out why they hadn't seated us. A different employee was at the desk and said we could be seated, but it would be 20 minutes before our order would be taken. I guess nobody is consulting the list of names the first person wrote. Consult your name list! Use the same employee up front during busy times! 

The food is good. If you go between normal meal/busy times, the service is better. That's the only reason I gave any stars. We left and don't plan to return. It made me angry, and I don't get angry easily.

I don't do breakfast places in boise. They all lack taste in my eyes. Goldy's with its long lines... still don't get why?!? This place however, is a place that will become our families breakfast spot am sure. I approve of the food. It's actually delicious. And it's still a gem that is not so busy that lines are at the door. Which means, I'm telling you a secret in this review. It's wonderful. Only breakfast place I will consider to go in boise. Try it out. You won't be disappointed.
A solid breakfast restaurant. A little pricy in my personal opinion but the food is great and atmosphere fits for a modern breakfast eatery.
Average. I have gone there a few times, the food can be described as average. The prices seem just above average but they claim several things (meats) are local.
Absolutely zero safety protocols. Staff without masks. Zero crowd control. Food was solid. But seriously. All of their neighbors at The Village were acting much more responsibly. Step it up Sids.

Two stars for being inventive, but our cones and salad were disappointing.  For the pizza, this conical format doesn't allow for browning of the toppings or release of oils in the pepperoni, leaving it warm but unfinished in the center while the crust is very hard and challenging to chew.  One bite and grease and sauce were spilling out.  It was awkward and not enjoyable.

As for the salad, the iceberg lettuce was brown, as if it wasn't rotated or was simply not fresh.

Your kids may think it's fun and unique treat, but beware of trying to eat it in the car!  Ask for EXTRA, EXTRA napkins!

Kudos to them for trying something new.  It might be a hit at the county fair.
Terrible coffee. Bitter. Yikes. Looked like a Starbucks clone. Disappointed. At least it was cheap.

I recently enjoy some take out here. I thought the idea of cooking your own pizza was idiotic at first, but the smell of bread baking in your home is decadent. If you like the smell of fresh bread baking, then you'll love this place. We ordered the Cowboy pizza, and it was quite tasty, plus a cheese bread for our son. He loved it and had pizza for breakfast for once (8

I order online for pick up at this location 2-3x a week for my lunch break during work or for dinner on the way home. 

Today the service was terrible. I placed an online order for the beef short ribs with extra beef and fried egg, and chicken teriyaki with extra chicken and fried egg, plus I ordered a lemon boba and a peach boba. Usually I dont like to add tips to online/pickup orders, but today I decided to tip. That was a mistake on my part.

I arrived there to pick up my order, but they had not even started cooking my order despite being 15min late to pick it up. My wife was waiting with our two crying toddlers in the car. This is why I order ahead of time so I can reduce the wait time for the kids!!

Also instead of ordering one lemon boba tea and one peach boba, I mistakenly filled out the online form where it was sent as a peach/lemon mix  boba tea. One of the two girls pointed out my mistake and seem unwilling to fix my mistake. I informed her I would like to have two bobas (1 peach and 1 lemon) as I had intended. Well, the other girl churned out some shitty drinks devoid of any crushed ice. It was basically flat sugar water with boba settling at the bottom (see pics). I threw that crap in the trash. 

Thanks for wasting my money!!

Love this place! I used to shop at HPB in California and was so happy to see they expanded to Idaho! Staff are friendly and helpful. They were happy to make suggestions and have conversation about books as well. There's an amazing selection of books here, and yes, they're super discounted! I got an almost perfect condition book that was originally $20 for $9. They've also got a pretty nice selection of vinyls and CDs too. I'm glad they required mask wearing. Overall a great place, keep it up!
Service was good.  However food arrived cold to our table.  For the price, the portions were small.

Went to the Griddle today for the last time.  20 minute wait for table for party of three which they gave away to line jumper with four people.  Seated shortly there after.  The line jumper and people seated after us were all served by the time someone took our order.  Forty tables and 15 servers....  People seated after w ordered were served before our food came.  At least the silverware was dirty.  One hour and thirty minutes after starting this adventure was able to pay the bill which was 59$ before tip for breakfast.....  why do consumers put up with this?  Over rated and over priced....

Amazing Breakfest food!! Their orange juice is to die for and everything else is so full of flavor and will have you leaving happy and full! I Go there whenever I can! Great place, you won't be disappointed!

I stopped by Tip Top Nails for a quick pedicure. I hadn't expected perfection, but this was awful! The worst part was that the owner broke a bottle of polish on me, ruining my pants, and didn't even apologize. When I asked what they planned to do about the pants his answer was "accidents happen". He's right, they do, but that doesn't absolve him of responsibility. His only offer was to put my 100% cotton pants in a bath of pure acetone- which would have eaten the pants. He finally told me not to pay for my nails, but to never come back... like I would have anyway! 
Don't bother, the man is a crook

Ok, So long story short. In general my food and drinks were fine, but my wife's burger was so greasy that it melted her bun, and she had to mop up all the grease with about five napkins. I'm not exaggerating. I never complain, but I asked our waiter who walked off with almost an entire uneaten burger to please remove that one burger off our tab because my wife couldn't eat it. He acted like it was an unusual request and that it was inconvenient to ask. Eventually the manager came over and said he would discount some of the burger since she ate half the burger. She only ate the edge of it because the bun melted off into a slimy pile of slop. Wouldn't show us an itemized receipt or how much he was discounting us. Wife in frustration handed him her card and I was like, "this is unacceptable". Now I'm pissed and say "I don't want to pay for any of this." I told him don't run that card and he did anyway. They were acting like because they are edgy and trendy that they just don't care if the service sucked and no-one apologized or anything. There is way more to this story but let's just say I walked out angry.

I really didn't want to write a review and waited a couple of days. This place is just below average. Did not get the tech's name just told me to pick a color and sit down while he walked off. Saw water running in chair so chose that one. The Tech sitting next did not even move his things out of the way even though I had to go around with my cane. They spoke their language to each other and laughed at things on the TV. Terrible trimming of my toenails and barely trimmed around and terrible loofah on my feet and terrible leg massage. Basically rubbed some lotion on and rubbed. All the tech's talk amongst themselves and never acknowledge you are there except to take the fee. Very disappointing really wanted this to be my place since I have recently moved here. I won't be going back. Duh.

What a great find! We came here for lunch on a Sunday and were seated right away. Kate was a great server and even recommended some good dishes. We got the monte cristo and the chicken sandwich with chili cheese fries. Everything came out warm and delish. Large portions and just overall really tasty. We will be back, thanks Kate!

My Experience at Camping World was EXCELLENT!! I'm from California and because of Chris Ozuna ,  and the Manager Kevin made my Purchase  quick and very Pleasurable!! Chris was one of the Best Sales representative I have ever met !! I could of bought in my hometown but the way he treated me was something I have NEVER  Experienced, he treated like I was family !! The reason I bought my travel trailer was because of him!! Keep it up Chris !! Very friendly staff  very attentive! Thanks so much for everyone at this store !! I definitely recommend buying here !!! Ask for Chris !!!

BEWARE - HIDDEN FEES. I can't in to get a basic gel pedicure and was told gel would cost a certain amount. I agreed and got in the chair feet in the water only to be handed an additional menu listing additional costs if I wanted to continue with the pedicure. Sneaky ! The pedicure was terrible. No work on on my feet. I paid almost as much as I would have at a spa. Waste of money !

I brought my truck in for a suspected transmission issue. They inspected and let me know it wasn't a transmission problem. When they had me pick up my truck, there was no charge for the diagnostic. I'll definitely bring my vehicles here if I ever have a transmission problem and I'll refer anyone else to do the same.

Sold our last camper over 10 years ago, and with our new pull behind we had many questions and needs. Without hesitation and without making us feel like the rookies we were again, the parts and service departments were AMAZING to us. Please feel free to let the kind folks at Camping World be a part of your RV family, you won't regret it.

Our online price was $62.00 per night for two queen room.  No issues with our reservations.

PROS:
Hotel staff are very friendly
Free breakfast. Bagels, donuts, fruit, cereal, eggs, potatoes, coffee, waffles.
Lots of parking and lit in good repair.
Close to freeway and Boise.
Pool is clean
Prices are good
Everything in our room worked well
Beds are medium firm and pretty comfy 
Free tea, coffee, bottled water in room
Heat, fan, air conditioning in rooms.
Handicap access to pool and hot tub 

CONS:
Hot tub is pretty cold and jets don't function properly
Exercise room is in disrepair with squeaky worn out machines
Carpet needs replaced

I would very much consider staying here in the future especially for the price I paid for my stay.

GM Construction helps to replace my deck in two days. Gabriel removed the old deck and repaired some damaged sidings. He installed a new deck with beautiful redwoods. I also have him added two new patio shapes and replacing all the exterior lighting fixtures. I absolutely love my new deck and looking forward to spend the summer outside. His price are reasonable and I really enjoy working with him!!
Yummy place! Great service! Clean establishment. Hit all the marks. Parking kind of sucks when it is busy. They are pretty quick. I look forward to trying more things on there menu.
Food is great, drinks are great, service sucks. Took 30 minutes to finally get our food and drinks ordered.  Who knows where the waitress was....Sadly I won't be coming back.

Came for the French toast special... unfortunately, they ran out but gave my family all free ice cream!! They did not give small portions- it was plenty and it was absolutely delicious!! The BEST ice cream!!
Very good food and excellent service. We couldn't have been happier with their laid back patio and delicious brunch.

This company is hands-down the best auto repair shop
in the Treasure Valley! Ten years ago, I decided I needed somewhere other than the dealership for repairs/routine maintenance. A close friend recommended Driven. My friend was right, I became a loyal customer after my first experience! I have never been disappointed or concerned about any of the work that has been done on either of my cars. Check them out - you won't be disappointed!  (Ask for April when you call. She's the best!)

My wife and I recently visited Bella Family Health.  We moved here last summer and have had some trouble finding a new primary care provider, either people don't want to answer or turned us away for my pain conditions.  We both were seen by Sue for our initial consultation.  She was extremely friendly, professional and understanding.  She took her time listening to our concerns and past medical history, we never felt rushed.  I have a current/continuing medical problem.  Spending the last few years dealing with experts, second & third opinion doctors, numerous trial and error, and being treated more like a number than a human being, it was a breadth of fresh air to have found Sue and her staff.  We are EXTREMELY grateful to be treated as people instead of broken toys.  The entire staff were  just as professional and welcoming....true Idaho spirit!  We highly recommend Bella Family Health if you are looking for current health care providers with old school service :)

Amazing pizza! I've never tasted anything like it before,like a cross between a pizza and a calzone! It was amazing!!

The staff was awesome too! Not only friendly but very helpful! They helped make my day!
This is legit thin crust ny style pizza and very tasty. The only thing I would recommend to people is don't bother ordering extra cheese as a topping bc they skimp on it.

Rude bar staff and management. Tried to stop in for a quick bite alone and see the bartender and manager standing across the restaurant, pointing at me and talking about me before I'm even greeted. I was not asked kindly to move, her approach was rude which is why I decided to leave, not worth spending my money.
I love Cupbop! Great customer service and the food never disappoints! My favorite is the Bpop

Tire center is the worst!! Been calling for a week straight, no one answers the phone. Finally got through to someone, he talked down to me so degrading and belittling when I inquired about the cost of winter spiked tires. I was just in their warehouse a week ago, and we ordered Our third set, which will be shipped in because they don't carry them in stock. I explained they should be in a few weeks into please look at our account, as I know we can still order them. The guy continually talk down me telling me they don't carry them and I simply don't understand tires. Rude staff and not worth the hassle. Costco is five stars in every category but their tire center. Worst customer service experience ever and I've been a member over 20 years!
Suggestion Costco, how about take the hundreds of employees walking around the store, and place a few in the tire center, educating them so they can actually man the phones and provide excellent customer service as they do on the floor.

If I could leave them a negative review I would! We got there and waited 20 minutes to be seated. Then after ordering and waiting 45minutes -1hr with one table ahead of us I got served a sandwich that had wrong ingredients  and  frozen tomatoes and ham( that should not have been there)  I 100% refuse to go back!

This is in regards to an attempt to purchase blinds. I must say that this ranks as one of the worst experiences I have ever had. None of the three associates we worked with seemed to have any clue what they were doing. Two of them appeared to be less than thrilled to have to assist us at all. They could not answer the most basic of questions.

We sat for a long period of time while one employee painfully (face contorting) attempted to put together a quote. There were long periods of silence with the occasional "I have no idea what I am doing" noise emanating out of her. In the end we ended up with a quote that seems to be overpriced and incorrect.

I attempted to call today. I asked specifically for someone who was very familiar with the blind department. Once again she could not answer questions and 10 minutes into the call I was hung up on. She did not want to take the time to help me work out whether we had the right pricing. 

Never again!
Read mixed reviews when it first opened. People are inpatient with new places opening up. Went and tried it. Good pizza. Friendly folks. Would definitely go again.
Best ice cream ever and friendly workers. You can tell it's good in the summer when the line is out the door!
Always fresh and I love that they have gluten free options. Lots of choices and staff is always friendly. I wish they were open on Sundays!

Absolutely delicious burgers! Great quality meat and perfectly cooked. I also got the candied bacon, which is a great combo of sweet and spicy, and happily would have gone to heaven after eating that! Will be coming back!

At first I was really impressed with this salon - everyone was so nice and the chairs were comfortable and very clean. It was my first pedi in several months, so I knew I was overdue and needed a little extra attention. I paid for an upgraded pedicure that was supposed to include callus removal and some other moisturizing goodies. The technician that did my pedicure was very fast and didn't really give my feet the TLC they needed for my first pedi after the winter. The callus removal was perfunctory at best.  I will say she did do a great job on the polish, so if I didn't need the extra TLC, maybe this place would be fine.  

One other note, I prefer OPI polish and they don't carry that line so if I ever go back I know I will need to bring my own polish.
I'm not sure how the cost of propane can be .20 more than Flying J with the GoodSam discount.  Also, Flying J gives me another discount from having GoodSam.  Odd.

I, for one am thrilled they opened this location.  Meridian is growing by leaps and bounds and having this store will help relieve the congestion at Boise or Nampa.  This Costco has it all; tire center, gas station, food court, pharmacy and offers eye exams and hearing aids.  The store is abiding to the latest COVID guidelines by enforcing face masks and social distancing by providing acrylic shields at check out and they've sectioned off the area where you would normally try on eyeglasses.  Just ask one of the friendly associates if you'd like to try on a pair.  They also sanitize after someone tries it on so there is no worrying.  I find it easy to navigate and there is ample parking.  I've heard that they'll be opening some other nearby mixed-use retail stores and a WinCo, so stay tuned.

What I disappointment. This used to be my fav. Yogurt place. Not any more. Showed up and they were out of like 4 flavors. When asked why the worker said oh we just haven't gotten around to making any. Seriously. Not interested in places that don't care to stay on top of making sure their advertised products are actually available. I understand running out once in a blue moon but laziness??

We recently found Crave Delivery app and on the first order we ordered our daughter a cheese pizza (cause you know that is all a 5yr old will eat) while my wife and I tried some other Crave options. When the pizza arrived we tried a bite and it was fantastic!

Fast forward to now, and after 5 orders from Crave we are now doing orders of all Tony G's Pizza for the entire family. We have tried several of the pizzas, and honestly we have yet to meet one that was not delicious. The most recent delivery included the Boise-Boy which had bacon, pesto, and purple potatoes. Wow, so good!! Their pizza dough is done very well, and they have just the right amount of crust for those crust lovers, but pizza is thin crust (aka NY style).

Only downside, you will look at the prices at say "wow they are expensive for a 13" pizza". This is true, but in my book not worth deducting a star. The pizzas and their ingredients are high quality and fresh, thus the price tag. Delivery through Crave is $5 or you can pickup for free. There is no dine-in option for Crave.

Terr's is awesome!!!!  Home cooked food with the best service staff ever!!!  They are accommodating and friendly.  Kate is the nicest person on the planet!  And if their extensive menu isn't enough, they also have another extensive gluten free menu!!!  Yahoo!!!!  We had the best breakfast experience we've ever had!  So easy so relaxing so yummy!!!!!!    The corned beef is the best Ive ever had and I make my own!!!!  If you're in Idaho,  do not miss Terr's!

Shut your mouth and the garage door! Absolutely delicious good, great beers and cider with any game you want to watch on the TVs. Attentive and friendly service to top it all off. We had the tempura green beans ( BETTER than PF CHANGS BY A MILE), truffle fires (delicious huge portion), deviled eggs (you've never had any this delicious), Kielbasa and Hot Chicken. People, get your butt to this casual restaurant with high class food. Family friendly and don't forget the shakes that will blow your mind and macros. Top Notch.
Tao is always so quick and thorough! Two things we want with nails haha! I love this fall look especially she did on me today!

Fabulous breakfast and lunch place.  Love their hot cakes and fruit syrup.  
The Italian focaccia sandwich is the bomb!!

It's been awhile since I've had real legitimate ice cream. We've been on the froyo train for awhile now,  as it meets the need of a child's desire to create a masterpiece and it's healthier; right?!? 
Anyways....my son noticed the store go up and asked consistently for weeks to go to the "cow ice cream store " and so alas we did!
Ummmmm.....SO Good!! It was so creamy and flavorful. I had the Rocky Road, one of my personal favorites. It had a really good balance of chocolate to goodies.  I sampled quite a few others and they were all very good. I'm told the honeycomb is one of their top picks and I can understand why. It had legitimate pieces of honeycomb in it! 
They really had a vast selection of options and several unique flavors.
Because they are a dairy, they also offer other milk products for sale. I didn't get any this time around, but I'll be back!
Last tid  bit. The scoops are ginormus! I could have easily settled for the kids scoop. 
Give it a go! Your taste buds will thank you!

I've been craving an In-n-Out burger since a colleague introduced me to them during a business trip to Mountain View last year. This did a pretty good job of satisfying that craving: great flavor, your choice of grilled or fresh onions, outstanding fries, and a reasonable price ($4.99 for a single, fries, and a drink).  The only disappointment was that they served sliced lettuce instead of the leaves of iceberg lettuce In-n-Out uses -- ironic given their name. But it's still very well worth a stop.

Holy Cow! Literally! Reed's Dairy just opened in Meridian, right down the road from us! They serve up some of the best ice cream I've ever eaten, sourced from their own dairy. I love ice cream that is so dense and creamy that it is downright chewy.
If you have a hard time deciding on a flavor, like I did, they allow you to sample....woo-hoo. I tried the coconut which was great but finally landed on the pralines and cream, hub had the rocky road caramel. Both were wonderful. I ordered a "single" cone and it was ginormous....so be aware of sizing when you order. Might get the "kiddie" next time. Even the sugar cone was delicious with a nice almond flavor.  I found the pricing very reasonable especially considering the quality....costs not much more than "soft-serve" at your local fast food joint!
There is a cooler/freezer along the back wall with ice cream, milk (in glass bottles, no less), butter, and chocolate milk. (my only wish is that they carry organic dairy items too!)  They also serve grilled cheese sandwiches and tomato soup for those of us with sweet/salty issues.  Reed's even offers milk delivery right to your door...how nostalgic!
With quality like this, I predict epic success for Reed's Dairy!
The outside doesn't look like much but the staff was super helpful and nice and the food was amazing... my wife and all the kids loved it. The trifecta was a highlight and my son loved the loco moco
Amazing foot massage. Quiet and relaxing !! I walk away feeling relaxed and yet refreshed

So I received a call from Camping World today and I'm a little confused. They asked me for the estimate for cleaning off the hard water spots. I told them we are having someone look at it Wednesday morning. He said great I will close this complaint and we will wait for the estimate. 

I was confused on why they would close the complaint when the work hasn't been done yet. What is the purpose of that? And what if it doesn't work and not all the hard water stains don't come out. I will be asking to replace the windows. If they close the complaint does that mean they are not going to make it right ?

Two of us went for lunch, seated quickly and waters brought out.  As we were ordering they were out of three of the things we ordered.  After we ordered about 5 minutes went by and our waitress told us our meals were almost ready.  Not sure what that meant as 35 minutes later our food was no where to be found.  We only ordered a light sandwich and a breakfast.  When our food was brought out our waitress told us she had to cook it and hoped it was good.... well long story short it wasnt.  The only reason we went to this Dennys was because we had some coupons, which at the time we paid we couldnt use them as their system wasnt updated and they didnt know how to ring them up.
