We explained they were  going to expire in a week or two and again we got no sympathy to them not knowing what was going on.  If I could give a worse review I would but I had to at leat give one star.  The food was undercooked and oversalted and just plain awful.

Awesome place
Great service 
I'd suggest checking them out for
Taco Tuesday or
Wing Wednesday 
Keep up the good work
Awesome burger.  Awesome choices!.   Food was great.   Nice to have a place nearby which is not a chain restaurant.
Outstanding burgers, shakes and fries. Don't miss the dogs or Nashville chicken. They're my personal favorites. Good beer selection and fun vibe.

Twice now, we have called Meridian Plumbing to come out to our home.  Both times our problems have resolved themselves either right before they get there, or while they're there.  Neither time, have they charged us for a service call or made us feel stupid for calling.  I would recommend Meridian Plumbing to anyone based on their care and concern for their customers and their understanding that problems can resolve.  Not only that, but they take the time to explain things so that we understand.  We will never use another plumber.

Hey morning crew, Lisa is back! She is working 8-12. She misses you as much as you missed her. YOU are the only reason she came back. 

Nothing much has changed but Lisa is back!

When you see her, tell her you saw this post.

Had to wait two hours for help they lost the car I was trying to purchase the left hand doesn't know what the right hand is doing worst car buying experience ever the people there are not helpful what so ever they  just keep putting you off several employees 5 to be exact just standing around circle jerking not doing shit talking about tomorrow's football playoffs pretty sad to be a paying customer in this establishment !!!!!
Used to go here all the time a couple years ago and the service was amazing, as was the food. This time was different. Poor service, the food was subpar, very disappointing.

If you want a tasty, greasy burger, this is your place.  The burger meat is very favorfull.  The sides were tasty treats too.  Loved the beans with the incredible sauce.  Remember to mix the sauce before mixing.
I will give these folks a 2 1/2 star rating. The staff was very friendly. The food was very average at best. Not a lot of variety for toppings. Not so sure I will be back
Unique and delicious. Very clever spin on traditional pizza. I'm not a crust lover, but this crust  was perfect.

Chicken sandwich was bland and dry. It was just two chicken tenders with fry sauce on them. Nothing Nashville about it. Burger felt drenched in grease. We asked for Buffalo but got some weird honey sauce instead. Disappointed. The staff weren't wearing masks but they were very friendly. The milkshakes looked good.

Just called Camping world in Meridian and I believe I talked to Amanda.  Asked her about putting a hitch on the back of my new Coleman TT which I bought from Camping World for a price.  She asked if I knew how wide the back of the trailer for the hitch because she needed it for the right fit of the hitch.  I told her I didn't know and then asked her if she had a parts book to look it up and her answer was I don't know what the widths of every trailer.  I said to her you should be able to look up the part in the book and since you carry the TT you should be able to find it.  No answer so I told her I would find someone else that could really help with the brand of trailer I have since she was worthless.,,,,, no wonder CW of Meridian gets crappy reviews, they need to have people who know to look parts up and be helpful.  Not impressed at all all with the so called parts department

I'm updating my rating of this Denny's from a 1-star to a 4-star and I'm writing off our previous visit and review as they just had a bad day.  It was a Saturday morning so they would be busy anyway and then they had several people call in leaving them short-staffed on the floor and in the kitchen - so there were issues.

We went back on another Saturday morning and by all appearances they looked to be fully staffed.  The restaurant was clean, and neatly decorated for Halloween which made it fun without being over-the-top.

Our server was Edwina - and she was great.  I think she's been there for a while.  When I think of the Denny's I used to go to in college (many years ago) Edwina is much like the server I had and loved back then.  A nice cute lady, funny without being annoying, the kind that calls you honey and baby in a sweet way, and someone who takes pride in their work and wants to make sure you are taken care of.

I started with coffee .... is there ever anything wrong with coffee?  Not much to say about it.  It was hot and good, and Edwina was timely with the refill.

And then I got a do-ver on my Birthday meal thanks to Brie who is the new GM here and is trying to make some positive changes at this location.  My meal was PERFECT.  Exactly as ordered and exactly how I wanted it to be.  The build-your-own-Grand Slam is the free birthday meal and you get to choose 4 items off a list of 12 things.  I chose sausage, bacon, eggs over hard, and hash browns.  My eggs were exactly over hard, the sausage and bacon were perfectly cooked, and the hash browns were the perfect color and with the crunch on the outside and softer potato shreds on the inside.

My husband ordered the biscuit and gravy breakfast and all things were perfect and to his liking; the eggs exactly as he ordered them.

I've seen other less-than-favorable reviews here on Yelp for this Denny's location and with some engagement from Brie the new GM.  I believe there is hope for this Denny's yet! --- and I look forward to returning again soon.

I'm consistently amazed by this place... This is really good pizza. The deal is fresh crispy but chewy light and thin But not too thin... The right amount of toppings paperwhite pizzas are out of this world... Read it immediately after your hand in the box don't let it sit in there and get soft. The sauce is delicate and it is a true nod to a simple New York slice. After a long night of playing music I love to grab happy hour for myself and kids... Even the soft drinks are legit!  
I'd take a picture but I ate it all...

Listen to the reviews , don't waste your money .
Exterior wash for $ 13 left water spots all over the car & bugs splat weren't taken off during the wash.
Paid 3$ extra for floor mats to be rinsed, they didn't bother to do the trunk ( the dirtiest one) 
I was in and out in less then 15 minutes. Waste of time and won't be back .

We had a couple of beers last night at Loose Screw, and Waffle Love was taking orders for food to be delivered there from their restaurant. 
Our order got completely botched, and 45 minutes later we were told, "Oops, we missed your order, and will get it as quick as we can."  We were not happy, to say the least. 

Well, about 20 minutiae later, the owner of Waffle Love, Stephanie (sp?) approached us with bags of fun waffle food (far more than we had ordered). She was very apologetic, indicated that she had refunded our meal costs, and thanked us for our patience. This kind of business behavior is so rare, and so appreciated. Her business is still coming up to speed, they stumbled, but recovered well. And the food is SO YUMMY!!!

We should all be supporting these kinds of quality small businesses. Even if you're not jonesing for waffles, give Waffle Love a try. You'll be glad you did!
I've been twice in one week. I might come a third time. We enjoyed the food and the wait staff were polite and friendly. Try the fish tacos. Best I've eaten.

Update
I have roasted the co-op in the past, see below. However, I still gave them a high rating of 4 stars because I am petty, not unreasonable. 
Recently I went to the co-op for lunch and there was a minor problem with it. I mentioned my concerns to a cashier and they offered me a refund immediately. I told them that receiving a refund wasn't why I was bringing the issue to their attention. They gave me a refund anyway despite the fact that I am not a member or frequent shopper. My advice for speaking to a manager or employee: be nice, be reasonable, and be unassuming. 

Tangent:  
Speaking calmly with a person about issues will almost always get you better results than writing a 1 star review on Yelp. Make sure the issue is a real issue and not just your disdain of county mask mandates which the business has absolutely no control over. Please give the county hell about the mask mandate. Stop misdirecting your anger at people who have no control over what you are mad at. That's my hot take. 

Progress over perfection
5 stars. Not because my experience was perfect. Not because all of my expectations were met. Not because I got a refund. Not because they have excellent tiramisu. 5 stars because they wanted to do better. And because I think they got rid of their house made spam. :)

I'm new to Meridian (moved in May) and have tried a ton of different spots throughout the region.  This place is legit AF!  Probably the best overall restaurant I've been to thus far (service/food/ambiance/attention to detail).  I'd rather go eat 3 of the bacon appetizers here for dinner than go to the majority of the nice steak houses in town TBH .  I'd put this place up against any burger joint in any other city

I Love teriyaki bowls, and this place does it right.  The rice is so important to the dish and theirs is skillfully made.  The chicken is the best in this category as are their gyoza      
Honestly, the meridian location is much better, possibly since they are the original restaurant.

I don't eat out for breakfast very often, but would totally make the effort to come back and eat here. Came here with my parents, who had eaten at their restaurant in Winnemuca and raved about how great they were.

They serve breakfast and lunch. We went at about 11am, and I had already eaten breakfast so I went for a sandwich. It was very good! The bread was dipped in a batter with red pepper flakes and parmesan cheese and then grilled. 

My parents both had breakfast, which looked delicious!  I read many things on their menu that sounded worth trying. Lots of very unique options, you would never see at somewhere like IHOP.

Most everything is made from scratch, I believe, so it takes a little longer to get your order; but I think it's worth the wait.

Has a diner feel, complete with a full counter/bar stool area reminiscent of a traditional diner.

Everything was priced a little higher than I expected, but I guess you get what you pay for! The only thing we ordered, that just seemed ridiculous was one sausage patty that cost $4!

Employees were friendly and attentive.

They also currently have a deal, where if you check in on yelp you get a 10% discount. Paid for the silly sausage patty! Lol!!

All in all, I would come back. Would love to try some of their breakfast items.

Throw all of your patronage to this place - they've earned it! Not only are they totally Socially Responsible, good neighbors, and just nice peeps, the food is like nothing else in Boise.  They like their neighbors so much that they only serve wagyu black Angus beef from Snake River Farms and Double R Ranch.  

Let's talk Milkshakes - for the lactose intolerant.  Yup, they make the most incredible works of dairy-free art that I've ever seen.  They are huge, so bring a friend. 

Get here early, before the line starts!

Worst apartments! You would expect new appliances, but even the guy that fixes them says every build has been worked in because they are old. Our dish washer had rotten motor which we never even used. Managment is the worst they make you feel stupid. They can't keep all there files in one place. They lie straight to your face and refuse to be wrong. Trash bins are the worst people can't seek to learn how to use them and put the trash where it belongs. Dogs poop everywhere and people don't pick them up. Managment also doesn't seem to car that people pay for parking and follow the rules while others park for free anywhere in random places. They also raise rent 400$ for everyone with only a month notice before renewal lease is up. Honestly this place is just horrible as nice as it seems not worth your money. Appliances are old, Managment is just as bad! Avoid if you you can but if you must then you better be ready to have nothing fix for almost 3 months. Make sure you also keep copies of everything because they are great and loosing things and make changes on their own when ever they like!

Worst Sonic experience I have ever had. We love Sonic, but will never come to this location again. There were 3 other cars in bays, but it took 20 minutes for some one to take our order, then another 30 to receive the food. Most of the order was wrong. Would give zero stars if possible.

What a nice surprise!  Found it on a whim on Yelp and it's some of the best Mexican food I've had in Meridian or Boise!!!!   
Great service , full bar, great food!

They were absolutely great here very professional and friendly they take there time to do quality work.
I love that there meticulous 
I would recommend them to anyone who just wants a relaxing time and a professional job well done 
Mary White

I had decided to buy a camper from CW in Meridian and was ready to sign paper work. Time was tight because my wife had to go back to work. We made the appointed time and waited a half hour. We couldn't wait any longer so we set another time. Another dealer called and told me that the camper we originally wanted to buy is coming out with a model that totally fits our needs. Told CW we needed time to think about the purchase. They told us because they had to ship the camper in they would not refund our deposit.Didn't want to even try to convince us that we should stick with the original camper we had brought in.Now that I have been reading about the terrible reports on their service department I am even less sure I should business with them.
I want to make it clear that our sales person was super. Upper management is the problem.

YUMMY!!!!!! We've never heard of this place and I just so happened to catch it out of the corner of my eye and decided to swing in to eat. The woman who took our order was very kind and informative.  The food tasted fresh and delicious! We'll be back
Love waffle love! Definitely recommend going there for delicious food!! Friendly polite workers!
We had a big group and they treated us so kindly. We had amazing, super nice servers. The food and drinks were prompt, and overall we had a great experience. Thanks Denny's!!!

Let me just start out by saying that THE FOOD WAS AMAZING. As an appetizer, we had the Queso Fundido and for dinner, we had the crispy chicken sandwich and the "Cuz I'm a Cowboy" Burger. The reason I'm giving this place 3 stars was the service. Perhaps it was a combination of being understaffed and having tables outside and inside (it was a beautiful day and people were seated outside), but our waitress only visited our table 3 times and all of the items we ordered took a very long time to get to our table. Our drinks and appetizer came out together, 30 minutes after we ordered. Our dinner came out 45-50 minutes after we ordered it. The restaurant was not at full capacity, but it did seem like the waitresses were spread thin. What did not help was that there didn't seem to be a set Bartender making drinks for everyone, It was more like the waitresses were making their own drinks as they went. Maybe there was also a hold up in the kitchen, causing our food to take longer. Whatever the case may be, we were disappointed. Our waitress was nice enough, but we didn't see or talk to her much, and she didn't address the time that we waited at all or apologize for the inconvenience. We hope to come back, but we're afraid that the service will disappoint again.

My family has tried this place and their feedback is that it's super good. Both ice cream and shakes are good.  They tried it then have gone back many times since and look forward to each time they go, so it must be good.

The General's Chicken is the best I have had anywhere!  Seriously I crave it all the time it is so good! If I was rating the restaurant just on this dish I would give them more than a five. They also have good Crab Rangoon. The other food I had was good but not fantastic. Service is always good and fast.
Surprisingly Amazing pizza (big New York Slices), tasty garlic sticks and the Ice Cream Sandwiches are the Bomb!
I love  this place! I love that they have online reservations and service is always good and friendly! Great atmosphere and good people! Pistachio latte is 100 percent worth it! So good!

I still love Terri's!!!  I can't go to Idaho without having breakfast there!!!  The staff is friendly and always get my order right!  Your food comes out hot and what was ordered!  They have an extensive gluten free menu which is hard to find.  So both normal people () and gluten free eaters can partake together.
There's other places for breakfast but the food won't be as good and the service won't be like Terri's!  And you'll wait in line on the weekends forever.  Go to Terri's and get into the restaurant fast for a delicious dining experience!  And it's family oriented so bring your gang with you!

So many great vegan choices!! There are rice bowls, several vegetables, vegan beans, vegan sauces, tofu, mushrooms, vegetable sandwiches, vegetable pizza with or with out vegan cheese. Also a huge selection of beer. #boisevegan #vegan
Corner Bakery is great!  I love the service Amy gives.  Thanks.

In town visiting from Pittsburgh and were so excited to see a Cupbop in town! We used to live in Utah and visited Cupbop on several occasions. We actually discovered it was in town through an ad on Facebook and we were able to get a couple free bowls. I got the ugly and it was so yummy and comforting to eat some food from years gone by. The service was great! Minutes before I pulled up my baby fell asleep in the car and the worker was gracious enough to take my order over the phone, come out to get my card for payment, and then bring me our food so I didn't have to get out of the car and wake my baby.
This place was awesome! Bomb burgers, tasty tots and crazy good monster milkshakes! I'll definitely be back because this place rocked!

I have been coming here for 2 years now. And I can't believe I have never wrote a review until now!! I just want to let everyone know that my nail guy is one of the best I've had here in the treasure valley, thanks for everything Billy!!!

We were welcomed right away and all the employees were so friendly and attentive. I ordered the Maui Woowee burger, Parmesan fries, and shared the Kicker shake. Everything tasted great and I would definitely come back again. Thank you for a great meal.

Yuck. This is NOT NY pizza. NY pizza has mozarella cheese on it which does not turn yellow when you heat it up. In addition if there is no much grease on a slice it is bleeding through to the packaging you know for certain it is not NY style pizza.  Boring disgusting so called pizza with no basil or anything. Our family has been traveling through America trying pizza places and this place doesnt even make the top 100 or even top 500. Just disgusting.  Yuck YUCK.  Pizz joint is a drive through which might explain something. Not a fan not returning. Did I say Yuck already.

What a joke....... I'm leaving for a hunting trip on Friday and going through the trailer on the Monday before and the pump on our toy hauler fuel station isn't working. We were super busy so we took the easy way out and took it to Camping World in Meridian to have them fix it. Andres was the service advisor and right off the bat he had an attitude, he was very rude and was more concerned in up selling us on $6,400 in sealing our 2013 trailer than trying to help us with what we needed before the hunt. He said he would call us by the end of the day and never did, the next day at 11am we called and we were told the tech was just finishing it up. No call again and when we called Wednesday at 11am Andres said "I thought we called you and you already picked it up" He told us that the motor was bad and needs to be replaced. When I got home I did what I should of in the first place and an hour later I had the pump working just fine. The pump had not been used much this year and just needed to have the cap taken off and the gears needed some grease. The pump works perfect now. Camping World in Meridian is an absolute joke and Andres should not in a position to deal with the public, he has the worst customer service ever.
This place is so yummy!!! Truffle fries are delicious!! Can say the hamburgers, shakes and Sangria are also very good!!

Worst practice I have ever been to.  My first appointment was with Cassie regarding my blood pressure.  She did not listen to my issues and instead wanted to push anti-depressants on me since she felt it was stress related.  (it was not).  She scheduled a follow up appt in 2 weeks with me but when I called to cancel the assistant told me that they'd hate to lose me as a patient and would I please try one of the other two practioners.  I said ok and she scheduled the appt.  Today I show up and I'm told I have no appointment.  I tell them everything and they say, ok, they can fit me in.  They took my copay and took me into the exam room.  The nurse says to me as she's putting a bp cuff on my arm "You don't have an appointment but we'll take your blood pressure since that is your concern and then we'll reschedule you."  I said, WHAT?  I'm not giving you $40 to take my blood pressure.  I demanded my copay back and told her she didn't need to take my pressure, that I'd be going elsewhere.  She said "Fine, BYE" very sarcastically as she ripped the bp cuff off my arm.  Needless to say, I won't be back.

Customer service is non existent!  I forgot to pick up an order placed online.  Instead of calling me and reminding me , they trashed the pizzas and my money is gone.  The manager said, they don't see the phone numbers placed online (which is hard to believe) and they don't call customers.  It's easier for them to trash the pizzas than to call the the customers who have been supporting them all these years.

Gab, was an absolutely fantastic. Fastest turn around time for a contractor and a perfectionist when it comes to his quality of work. We will be using him for the front of our house. I would give him 10 stars if I could.  Thanks Gab!

Definition of a scam is $523 for pre-made insoles and a 20 minute consultation.  At no time was price discussed until credit card was in hands of salesman. My time is more valuable than fighting them for a refund. In the event these magical plastic insoles actually work I will edit my post in 3 months. Until then do your own research. Wouldn't recommend them at this time and I have never posted negative review.

I used to love this place!! Would go at least twice a month for the last 6 years and they have gone down hill fast and charged $10 more. They refuse to start the reflexology massage with your head, no pressure points, ears, or rubbing your temples. Instead they start on your arms and Skip your head completely.  It's terrible and not the way to start off a good reflexology massage.  They used to have reflexology massage technicians that added their special touch to the normal routine that made it amazing, But not no more those people left. I am so sad and disappointed in this place now because it's 10 minutes from where I live. $40 for a reflexology massage plus a tip is very expensive for what you get. In more expensive states they are $25 an hour.

Arlene is really a special person. As long as you are open to letting her guide you, she will take you by the hand and lead you to clarity. I started seeing Arlene after getting random anxiety. Arlene showed me where it was coming from and gave me tools to deal with it. We also had incredibly beneficial inner-child sessions. Not knowing what these sessions were about prior to meeting Arlene, I was pleasantly surprised at how effective they are. 

Onwards to sunnier days!

Great service 
Enjoy taco Tuesday and
Wing Wednesday  
Keep up the great work

Nice to browse.  I have a list of things I'm hunting for in order if priority.  I found one item but it's at the bottom of the priority list so I left with nothing.

The store does have a large selection but I felt the prices were high relative to other consignment stores and buying new.

In terms of selection it was mostly dark wood finishes with only one off white item in the entire store. (The round table I was admiring). There were a few lighter wood pieces that looked like maple.

The artwork selection was good and there was one I was really interested in but it was really high up on a high wall with no price tag or sign anywhere with price.

They had one really cute little girls bedroom set painted in bright colors and sparkles that's going to make someone really happy.

Very good selection if sofas and sectionals but but I wasn't in the market for that.

Overall I think it's like most consignment stores... always drop by if you are in the area.

I stood in line service department 10 min while workers stocked shelf asked him you this department says yeah what do you want showed him told me to go to home depot
  Last time I will go to get parts

Rudy's is a decent place to eat. Atmosphere is good, plenty of TVs to watch. Average choice of beers on tap. I chose the Lagunitas IPA, never disappoints.

The wife unit and I split two meals, the Southwestern Chicken salad and fish and chips. 

Fish was good, crispy and a little oily. Fries weren't real hot like the fish. Three pieces of sea meat with plenty of fries and cole slaw.

The salad was good, the chicken pieces  were spicy, but small. Dressing tasted good. I probably wouldn't order it again. 

Service was great, very attentive staff.

I've been a customer of this local shop for almost 20 years. New computers, repairs, & upgrades, they've always been great to work with. When I had a PC down, Jason was great to get it back up In a jiffy! Buy local!

I am super disappointed in the buffet at Great Wall. We went to an early dinner at 4 pm on Sunday. The food tasted awful!! The food tasted like It was sitting out for hours! I am also disappointed in our waitress. She came to the table once to deliver our bill and never asked if we wanted a refill on our drinks. To top it off, we got the chocolate pie and cheesecake for dessert, and they were frozen. The cheesecake was yellow and it was not even lemon. I am sorry to say this, but it was absolutely disgusting!

We went on a Sunday around 1:30 (two of us). The hostess said it would be a 45 minute wait. I looked at the bar and there appeared to be some seats there and she said that there was only one seat available. I said that we'd be happy to sit at the bar if it meant a shorter wait. She said she would text us if that were the case. We went outside to wait and I ran back in to use the restroom. I noticed there were actually four seats at the bar that weren't being used and I asked the bartender if they were available and she said they were. So we immediately sat down with no wait at all. (?)
The bartender was not engaging and never smiled to anyone at the bar no matter how engaging the customers were. Kind of set the tone. Anyway, I was torn between two dishes and asked if she had an opinion on either one and she said both were very popular. So I chose one and it arrived completely cold. My husband's was not cold which was good. I didn't bother saying anything because they were very busy and at this point I was just ready to leave. Just not an overall great experience and highly doubtful we'll be back.

Stopped in for a quick coffee and I was met at the car while in line for an employee to take my order. I was glad to see everyone wearing masks! And those handling the coffee were in gloves too. Always happy to continue to support businesses taking precautions. The ladies working were all super friendly as well. They were very busy!

I ordered a lavender snowy (their white mocha) and YUM! It's a great calming drink - much needed in the week leading up to Christmas. It wasn't very sweet, so next time I may ask for a little more, but still delish!

We bought our trailer in 2017 brand new. Right away we had issues so we took it in and about only one issue had been resolved, putting in a screw. Then our hot water heater failed. They did fix that. Just recently I scheduled it for more repairs, some of those would have been easy and cheap to fix. We bought an extended warranty so we assumed the would have been covered. Nope, only two of the issues would be covered, the cheap ones but then we were told that we would be charged one shop hour for each issue just to be diagnosed(150.00 each hour) I took trailer and left. Don't do business with them and definitely don't buy the warranty, it's all a scam.
Service is as promised  wish it was little faster sometimes but it's reliable.  Customer service pretty dry but  not impolite.  Actually cleansing& press - superior

Meet a friend for lunch and I just loved it. I had the Short Rib bowl with white rice. OMG, it was to die for. Before I left, I ordered another one for my lunch the next day!!!  Place was clean and very friendly staff. I just love the teriyaki sauce...I will be back!!
Loved it, was my first time the staff were very friendly and answered questions with enthusiasm! I will be back also loved the yogo drink as well.

Diabetics beware! I was fully assured that these Orthotics were great for diabetic neuropathy and charcot foot... This was not correct, I actually got an ulcer wound on my foot and the providers I had to see for 2 months to help it heal are pretty sure that these caused or at least started the wound due to the deformity of my right foot. I was strongly reassured that the roll bar shoes that I paid $100 for would not allow my ankle to roll but due to it making my ankle roll three times as much as normal I had to buy a whole nother pair of shoes because my ankle was so sore from rolling In their shoes. Be ready to spend lots of money and time, remember none of the sale staff are medically licensed to give you any medical advice concerning your feet legs or back. Another interesting fact...  This business has a D minus  from the BBB for not  responding to complaints. I  really wish I would have seen the scores of their reviews before I spent my hard-earned money.

No, No and No. I have been wanting to try this place since they opened and we are so disappointed. I knew from the moment I walked in to pick up the order it was going to be gross. The place smells like cheap old cooking oil. The food was just awful. The flatbread was overly salty and almost inedible. The fish taco had a lime wedge inside the taco and the taco completely disintegrated into a huge mess as I picked it up. I think of the corn taco was missing. Nope, we will not be going there again.

Hard to put more superlatives in a review of this place.  We had an omelet and a Corned Beef Eggs Benedict.  Quick and attentive service with coffee refills.  Lots to eat for the price.  Everything was delicious.  

This could very well be the best Eggs Benedict I have ever eaten.  The Benedict sauce was just the right consistency.  I have eaten corned beef everywhere on the globe and this example really was spectacular.  

Come for the corned beef.

Looks like this will be our only meal for the day.  Wouldn't want to be disappointed by any other meal of lesser quality.

I really wanted to like this place. we looked up the menu the night before and everything just sounds so amazing. they really put some good thought into the items on the menu- specifically the brunch menu. we arrived on time on sunday to a busy restaurant. with full tables inside and out on the patio. 

the server promptly took our drink order and then was gone for a while, which ended up being his MO the entire meal. if you're busy it's fine, but staff accordingly. everything took forever. like I mean obnoxiously long waits for things.

the food sounds SO good on the menu- I was ready to have a good cheat meal (i'm on keto so we don't eat out as often as before). I ordered the huevos rancheros. ugh. premade cold tostadas, over cooked eggs, cold enchilada sauce on top. canned beans sprinkled. what a major disappointment. I ate it all because by the time it came out I was starving and would have eaten anything at that point.

EVERYONES eggs were overcooked. this is a brunch menu and the eggs benedict eggs had hard yokes. no one wanted to send anything back because we were starving from waiting so long. the server never checked on us. disaster. 

we also ordered these donuts that everyone was raving about- cold, hard, didn't taste fresh. disappointing.

lastly. we were a group of 7 that came in for my moms birthday. we mentioned multiple times it was her birthday and nothing was done and the server never acknowledged it. 

I have no intentions of giving them another chance. see ya.

One of my new favorite brunch spots! 
LOVE that they offer bottomless mimosas and they have a wonderful selection of fun coffees. I highly recommended trying the iced salted honey latte. I've had their amazing toast variety as well as an egg white scramble. My friend has their lemon blueberry pancakes that were so tasty and it was more than enough to share. There is a little something for everyone on this brunch menu. Depending on your breakfast favorites, their fresh house made biscuits are incredible! Especially when paired with their jam. I am looking forward to my next brunch adventure there. 

Also, I do recommend making a reservation. They are incredibly easy to do and can be completed online or on Yelp! They are working very hard to ensure safety for diners as well as staff members. A reservation just helps across all boards.
Family owned and operated, nice people. Removed my dip manicure by soaking then gave me a full acrylic set with a beautiful airbrushed ombré.

When I was there I was looking for a particular book and the man looked it up on the computer and found it and took me right to it
Also directed me to the children's section and told me about their buy back policy and said let him know if I needed any more help just let him know
I thought he was very friendly and will return
The prices seem very good
It's too bad some of the comments here are negative only because the people don't want to wear a mask inside
Well I'm glad they require the mask and I could care less about the anti mask people's comments 
They are risking my and their lives so they can just stay away and keep their COVID away!!!!

Dropped off donations today, and I wasn't quite sure if they were ready to take them or not since they seemed to be busy. So I waited in my car until someone gave me directions or came to speak to me. One employee was yelling that She didn't know where she was taking my donations from and upon my confusion (I was inside a car and she was shouting outside it so I wasn't even sure she was speaking to me) she screamed I needed to open my trunk. It's just a really baffling way to be treated when you're giving away stuff to an organization, and uncalled for since I wasn't being rude or demeaning like some other donators might be. Long story short I made a Yelp account just to leave this one review because that's how upset I am. And I'm truth, the staff there are pushy most of the time, but never have they been outright malicious. I get it's hot and the work is hard, but this sort of thing is really in poor taste.

Oh my goodness!!! We had the best experience and meal. Meridian location! From when we entered and they all yelled to greet us, to I think Katie the hostess who would not let us wait in the cold.  Our waitress Kayla was so fun and attentive! She made us feel so special! THIS place is an experience! She even recognized us from when we went to the Boise location! my young adult girls loves the music, ambianc, staff Ana food.  My 20 year old now wants to work there!! so fun!

I've been wanting to try this place for what seems like forever! Finally the right time came up and we decided to head there around 4:45 on a Friday and it was probably a good idea on our end. When walking in they do enforce you to wear a mask to walk the 5 feet to your table so just in case you walk in with no mask, be aware. I wouldn't say this place is toddler friendly so it's more so a date night kind of place. There are a ton of high top tables and hardly any regular but with our timing they luckily had a regular table to sit at with our two year old. I noticed while waiting for our appetizer that they had to turn a LOT of people away for lack of seating, which I thought was really disappointing, so make a reservation or arrive early! We ordered the queso fundido as a starter and it was really good! I was a bit skeptical about the mushrooms (I love mushrooms) but in the queso thought it was an odd choice, turned out to be yummy! My entree of choice was the beer battered fish and chips and it was delicious. The fish came out really hot and the tarter sauce was my absolute favorite! My husband ordered the French dip and he's had many to try and he said this one wasn't his favorite, the meat was bland. Personally I would say you have to try the fish and chips if you try this place.
Food is not fresh makes me sick, and doesn't use very much spices such as salt and pepper

Good food and drinks plus the extra bonus of taking absolutely no steps to keep their staff or customers safe from Covid-19. No masks on the waiters and bartenders, very few on the kitchen staff and no requirement that customers wear one. No social distancing, no disinfection of surfaces, nothing at all! It's like stepping through a time machine into 2019. Great place for your next super spreader event!!

Best car buying experience we've ever had!!! Two salespeople helped with our car buying were very knowledgeable!! If I ever have to buy another car in my lifetime, it will be from CarMax!! My only negative comment is regarding the finance dept. very inexperienced young people! Service department staff are all fabulous and quick to help!

The best ramen shop in the entire Treasure valley. I tried to frequent this place once a month since I only have one day off per week. The food was cooked correctly every time I order, customer service is on point so kudos to the staff given the short staff situation that they are in. The last couple times that I was there they had to close lunch service because of the short staff. 

Back to the food, the noodles was cooked perfectly, still a little crunch, not over cooked like some other ramen shops that I've been in. The menu is limited but I don't mind since I'm there strictly for the ramen. I'd rather have it that way since it's a ramen shop not a sushi bar that carries ramen and they are really excelled in that. I always get tonkatsu ramen with an extra side of noodles. The meat is cooked beautifully with a perfect ratio of meat and fat. 

Overall, this is a really nice little ramen shop. I can totally see how easy it is for the shop to get packed and overwhelmed but the staff still churns out top notch food and service. Please support this ramen shop, if things get hectic please be considerate and patience to the staff. Ramen Sho will continuously have my support.

Fantastic food choices to appease the many, tons of drinks especially for brunch time with bottomless mimosas. Everything we've had has been so good. Cute place too. Dogs allowed on patio which is a huge plus for me.
Pizza pepperoni sausauge and mushroom and breadsticks were on point. Really enjoyed the homemade marinara sauce that puts any other pizza place to shame. Will be going back

Coffee when it was finally safe to drink was excellent but they handed it to me at McDonalds lawsuit temperature hot. It was scalding hot. I decided to give them a try today instead of DB as I felt like a drink on the drive home from Hobby Lobby. I took a tiny sip immediately.... Because I was thirsty and my tongue was burnt. The staff were lovely but they need to be given an upper limit as to what temp to use on their hot drinks. I took the lid off to help it cool and it was still way to hot to drink when I got home 20 min later. I probably would hesitate to go there again. So 5 stars for the coffee and 1 star for the scalding temp.
Yummy!!!!  :0).  Who thought pizza could get better!!!  Fast & friendly service. Very clean & convenient location!  We'll be back!!!

This store is a total ripoff!!!  You cannot return the hard plastic insert because they don't allow it.  Also, this arch is so hard that it will never "melt" to the shape of your arch.  All they'll do is give you a store credit for future purchases.  Their selection is so minimal that I can't believe I fell for their "schtick."  I then went to a foot doctor who told me that they've heard so many negative things about this place.  The insert costs $400 and you're out that money.  Rosendahl's is very reputable and I was told that if I needed to return my new inserts, they would give me my money back.  The selection at The Good Feet Store is very minimal and you should just go directly to New Balance on the corner of Eagle and McMillan.  The insert I purchased felt like golf balls under my arches.  You need to avoid this place like the plague!!!

This was our first time visiting Sids. You would have thought we were regulars the way they greeted us. We had the burgers and fries. All was excellent. Burgers cooked right (medium) and super tasty. Fries were awesome. Definitely will be back!

Five stars is not enough. I was recently "stricken" with irregular heart beats and my cardiologist told me it was stress and anxiety. Medication is always a last resort for me. I figured I would try all forms of alternative medicine. Hypnotherapy, after one visit, was exactly what I needed. My session is tailored exactly to my needs and my take home sessions are extremely helpful. It has changed my life and everyone around me can tell. Arlene really is life changing!
I love breakfast! I love their Americanos! Great food and friendly staff! They were super nice! You should eat here if your visiting or want to change up your breakfast places!

Seriously, DO NOT WASTE your money here!!!!!! You WILL NOT get a clean car. This was the worst service I've ever received anywhere. They left my car dirty, the windows streaked and you couldn't tell they even vacuumed the inside. Wish I had not wasted my time and money here. You could pay a five year old a dollar and get a better car wash than this. It's only rated one star because ZERO stars wasn't an option!

Came in with my husband on a Saturday afternoon. The waitress seemed really stressed out and like she didn't have time for us. The table next to us came in about 7 min after we did but got their food and had half eaten it before we even got ours. The waitress did do a good job keeping my husband's soda refilled. I had the crispy chicken, my husband the uncommon burger. Both were just ok. I asked the waitress what the spicy topping on my sandwich was she acted annoyed that I asked. The chicken was pretty greasy and just overall ok.  The fries were pretty typical freezer fries. The fry sauce was good. Overall we won't be back because almost 60.00 for 1 drink and 2 sandwiches seemed pricey for the service and overall taste of the food. I was bummed based on reviews of others.

Eta, after I wrote my review I kept trying to figure out why it was so expensive. I looked at the reciept and they had charged us for an extra sandwich. I called and asked for a manager. The girl whom answered was rude and said he is busy. I then explained the issue. He all of a sudden got on the phone.  He was nice enough. He laughed and said there was an online order that got added to ours and he didn't know where it went? I would have thought the server would have realized the cost and checked it. So she ended up getting a way bigger tip than she deserved. He said they would credit it back. No real apology. Meh.

We took our 5th wheel in to Camping World for repairs on September 1, 2021 for repairs on a slide that wasn't working properly.  It was covered with an extended warranty .  It is now January 16, 2022 and there has been nothing done on our trailer (over 4 1/2 months).  We were told the work had been done.  We went in yesterday ...nothing done but they had damaged our trailer by running into it with another trailer.  Now they have to replace the whole back of our trailer.  This is a nightmare.... been told so many things only to find out it wasn't true....NOTHING HAS BEEN DONE, EXCEPT THEIR DAMAGE to our rig.  Now they tell us that we need a new roof!!!  Don't know why they were even on the roof to begin with.    I have been in contact with an attorney.  We usually go South in winter and North in summer..  not this year!!  I do not recommend taking anything to Camping World....terrible service!!!!  Terrible communication!!!  and now we have a damaged trailer..

Highly disappointed today.  Was very excited to try your burgers and shakes.  Came after my sons baseball game.  Waited outside 20 minutes for a seat and told the hostess my wife was joining us but she doesn't eat this food and was getting a protein shake accross the street.  We were seated, ordered drinks and when the waitress came to order food I told her my wife was not ordering because of her diet but would have a protein shake from accross the way.  Was told you didn't allow that.  I said ok and we'd be leaving.  Was asked to pay for the soft drinks before we left.  Mind you my son maybe had one drink of his sprite.  I paid the 4 dollars and left.  I'll never be back.  Was treated rudely and had the hostess told me that wasn't allowed we'd never have sat down.  The 4 dollars I paid for a soda we didn't even drink was ridiculous but the waitresses attitude was even worse.  We went to the Habit and had a burger and they could have cared less that
My wife had a drink with her.  Oddly enough, there were several people in SIDS with their own water bottles and some had Starbucks.  Never again.

Food is good, beer is tasty, staff is friendly, and decor is cool...only one complaint.  The music is way too loud, hard to have a conversation with the people at your table and difficult to even focus when eating.  We asked if I could turn it down a bit, even stating we didn't want to ruin the vibe, but just a little bit to reduce the obnoxious-ness.  We were told according to their manual it must remain at that volume.
Love the variety of crepes, both sweet and savory. Absolutely delicious. Filling and good price.

Just left this place. Unsure where to start. It took around 15 minutes for anyone to ask us if we wanted to have any drinks. We were also sat in the bar area and were not given happy hour menus. When we finally got someone to acknowledge us he had to go back to get us the HH menu and barcode scanner for drinks on tap which took him two separate trips to do so and he left after we could give him our order. Servers in general looked lost and confused with orders. 

When my fiancée finally got his drink the server had forgotten to put in my order so I had to wait even longer. Not once did anyone check in on us and I didn't appreciate getting slapped with the bill and having to pay as this gentleman impatiently stood holding the device. 

Let me be clear that the place wasn't packed; no wait at all and our server not once introduced himself or was courteous to us as we patiently sat around waiting. 

Food was pretty good. Carnitas nachos were great. Chicken sandwich was good as well but based off of this experience and what I paid, I will not be going back.

This place is great! I can't wait to come back. The hostesses and waitresses were all very nice and seemed very young. The ambiance is fun and trendy with a great bar area. They have TVs for sports and a flyer noting Trivia Tuesday's, which sounds like a lot of fun. The cocktails are so good I got a little jingled  and frisky with my man. All were good such as the blood orange boulevardiar, blister in the sun, honey boo boo and sweet Caroline. For food we stuck with sliders and suds where you get to pick 3 beers on tap with little variety of sliders, yum yum. The crispy Brussels sprouts which weren't very good, tasted burnt. Then the truffled cheesy tots which were a comfort food delight. I can't wait to come back and try some more cocktails and bigger meals. Maybe even try the Tuesday trivia!!
They got me right in the day after thanksgiving and Nhan aka "Lucy" was so sweet and amazing! I love my ombré nails and will definitely be back!

While the store has a great selection of books, they absolutely discriminate currently against people with medical exemptions and won't allow you to step foot in their store, shop, or even pay for books that are located on the outside of their store if you do not comply with the mask policy. Won't be visiting during COVID again. While mandating masks can be helpful, there ARE people with medical exemptions and it's nobody's right to ban people from shopping without the masks if they are medically cleared by a doctor to not wear one.

Really dug the food and ambiance.  The burgers are juicy, well dressed and big enough for a meal by themselves (or to split and add a side!)

Ordered the truffle fries and they were decadent, albeit large and very filling.    These could be shared with 2-3 people easily.  

I had the left coast which had a perfect blend of condiments, avocado and aioli really matched well flavor wise.

A bit pricey but well worth a "cheat day", hope they do well, excellent food and service is always a good mix.
Fries were not even half full. Burger was overcooked and dry. Chicken sandwiches were also overcooked and very dry. Not going back, I wouldn't bother.

Food is yummy but definitely leans on the spendy side. To echo what others have said, this place is beyond loud for how small it is. That mixed with the servers yelling over the music to communicate, made the experience too over the top. 

Husband is a drummer in a metal band, so we are no strangers to loud heavy music and the garage rocking lifestyle. Somehow, the experience this place is trying to capture just didn't work for us. From our perspective, it was a bit gimmicky.  

It seems like it is a good place for people/families who otherwise don't get to feel that type of lifestyle, get the opportunity to experience that feeling-which I totally support and encourage. I think we get enough of it on a regular basis that it's not what we look for when we go out to eat. 

Sids Garage in Meridian did nothing wrong on our visit, it was just not a good fit for us. We found the experience to be stressful for eating, but on observation of other tables, a lot of people seemed to be having a great time. I would probably would have enjoyed it if I was just out drinking and getting rowdy with some friends, not trying to sit down and have a meal. 

Overall, I think everyone should give Sids a shot, you may enjoy it, or you may not, but you'll never know if you don't experience for yourself!
He is terrific! Got locked out with the dog inside and he came right over. Even though we were 30 miles away and it was 10 at night. And we paid way less than I would have expected. Great service

Weekend appointment? Heck yes! Relaxing environment? You bet! Superb waxing skills? Oh yeah! Clayton's the best!! The room was super comfy, dark, cool yet warm, while beautiful fragrances whirl around the room & stimulate your senses, complete with a soft blanket to cuddle with. I've been waxing my legs for many years and Clayton has the most gentle leg waxing technique I've ever experienced, I didn't even feel the usual torture of the leg waxing process - yeah, he's that good!. He's ever so thorough while you relax & listen to the calming sounds of nature. His products are superb & the final oil & gel massage is the cherry on top! I will be going back & bringing my friends with me.

Who comes away from a plumbing job thinking "wow- I really liked my plumber?" That's not how that usually goes. 
We needed a hot water circulator and some work done on our water softener, and these guys were so great. Andrew was the most personable guy I've talked to lately and they did exactly what they were going to do for the price they said they would do it. I will use this company for any and all plumbing needs in my future.

Hands down my go to place for coffee every morning, afternoon and late evening. There's comfy chairs, board games, daily specials and son of a baptist preacher damn good coffee. There's no whippee do here. The coffee is great, the employees are down to earth and know their customers.  Sure Starbucks is at Fred Meyers and has multiple locations on Eagle Road, but when you want something else go to Lucky Perk.

Visiting the Boise area from Colorado, and wanted to find a local breakfast/brunch spot.  We were in Meridian and used Yelp to find a place with good reviews.  It was about 10:30 in the morning when we arrived and Terri's was busy.  Due to Covid, some tables were closed, and there were 5 parties ahead of us waiting for seats.  They took our name and phone number, told us it would be 25 minutes, and we waited in our car.

25 minutes later, they called, we were seated, and menus provided.  I ordered the Half California Benedict (bacon, tomato, avocado) with a side of home fries.  Those home fries were perfect!  The hollandaise sauce had a great flavor.

Husband had the 2 eggs with Mexican sausage, hash browns and a side of fruit.  Plus black coffee.  He said "it was average".

Daughter got eggs, Italian sausage links (they were pretty greasy) and avocado with white bread toast.  She ate almost all of it, and said she loved it!

Overall, A great experience.  Our server was friendly and attentive.  I would come back again.
I've had a lot of shitty experiences with National companies and this one probably takes the cake. John you deserve a bronze star

Very delicious food and options.  Fun environment and next time I will try a shake.  Love supporting local and waitress was beyond friendly.  Get the local fries and green beans..... delicious.  The adult Capri sun bag was fun and the sangria inside was tasty!
I know it's pricey for a burger joint but you will not be disappointed. Order the shake, so yummy. The fried green beans were great. Can't wait to go again.
Dude! Small location but big portions! So many flavors. We had a hard time picking so we did a mixed medley. The vibe is chill and fun. Would go again.

Had their $8.99 ribs tonight.... boiled baby back
Ribs then put on the grill to finish
Not worth it for me!
Service was good..
I'll try again a hamburger

Love Costco. Clothing kinda meh like their eyeglass selection but if you shop smart and use your food saver it's great.  One good tip;  do NOT be the first group who buys the rotisserie chicken.  I learned the hard way.  They were roasted hours before and were dry and tough.  Wait till you see them actually coming off the rotisserie.

Friendly neighborhood pub.
Good food reasonable prices.
Family friendly.
Yea we'll be back

Pretty hard to go here as it has been closed for at least 5 months. It is now the site for Big Daddy' BBQ. 

See individual review for the BBQ joint

I tried to find the owner's name so I could personally tell him what a really bad job Ultra Touch in Meridian did on my car today. But the ad they place doesn't give that info, just says the owner tries to be there every day and is referred to as "he" only. Paid for the Ultra Supreme. There was a long line of dirt at the bottom of the car I noticed walking up to it. I rubbed my finger on it and it came right off. There was most all of the same crumbs in my console, on my dash, dirt spots on the windows, little droplets of Pepsi in a couple places on the steering wheel, not hidden. And 2 large mud/water drippings down the back of the car.  I was completely disappointed. Went back in and told the cashier and showed her the dirt on my finger where I easily wiped the mud off the car. She said "You'll have to talk to them. I just take the money"....thanks for your help. Very supportive.  I don't think writing my review here will do much. I would much prefer to talk to the owner. If I write a letter and mail it, the same people who had no interest in fixing this today would just throw it away. I can't afford the Ultra Supreme. I was treating myself. I was highly disappointed in the shabby, lazy work they did there....inside and out....and the response I received when I reported it. If the owner sees this, I think it only right that you try to repair the damage that will be done by word of mouth advertising.

Family owed and operated. It was a pleasure talking to Natalia. She is very knowledgeable and very helpful. They are great in custom design and great prices. Beautiful selection of  jewelry and watches. Thank you! Will be back :)

The worst Denny's in the whole world
I ordered the mega philly cheese Melt and this is what they gave me
Lots of things on the menu weren't available
What they gave me vs what they show

I needed some sod this weekend because I'd killed some grass in my front yard as a new home owner.
I thought fertilizer was the way to go, but didn't water after as a plain ole, never had a lawn, rookie move.
I burned it to hell, and the HOA wasn't going to be pleased with my ignorance, much less my neighbors, who's lawn is perfectly maintained.
I made the decision, with the help of my dad, to go to Victory Greens, not just because it was near, but also because I'd read reviews to purchase anything from the company.
Mind you, I've made my own choice in this life to alter my appearance with tattoos and hair style - and I expect in any establishment to be met with a level of "whoa", but I'm also about being humble, and especially when I'm paying for a service a certain level of customer service, because I am, after all, a paying customer. 
My experience there was anything but.
Not really knowing what I'd be ordering was an anxiety I had to start, but I knew the square footage to a degree.
Instead of being helpful as I walked up to the sales counter, the guy proceeded to shout - "THIS GIRL NEED SOME SOD"
when I stammered before pulling out my measurements. 
He the yelled, "SHE NEEDS A LOT OF SOD" when I confusued at that point, and continued to stammer, now embarrassed.
He wrote it on the invoice. 
"some sod"
"alot (sic) sod"
The office had a good chuckle, and it was lame. 
The other dude just yelled, "GIVE HER THIRTY ROLLS, that's what she's asking for!"
At the end of the day, the product they produced was epic, and my yard looks great after my family and I spent the day installing it - but my experience there  was lame. 
Get better with your delivery of your amazing product, is what I say.
Comedy and judgement is what it is, and my HOA is super good with it all - but the human experience is just as important as the return customer. 
10/10. The sod is brilliant. 
1/10. The experience was shit.

OK...this place was awesome! I love the atmosphere, the staff, the drinks and the food!!!  I had the Hangover Burger, my husband had a regular burger with cheese and Applewood bacon.  We also ordered the tots which had pork belly and cheese and they were so good.  I also got a champagne flight and later found out that they had a sangria in a cool little pouch and got that also.  Everything was great.  The staff were friendly and fun.  It is a very loud place but I was totally fine with that since it was a fun place to be.  I can't wait to go back!  I spoke to one of the managers there and he mentioned that a second location will be opening up in about 3 weeks in downtown Boise.  Looking forward to it!

The long-haired large dark Ender here kicks ass! We waited more than an hour to get in here but we finally were able to order our food. Bartender was very attentive. But the cook's need some help! As you can see in the pictures that was a medium and a medium rare Burger. Does it look like that to you? This place has been open way too long the send out subpar food. My first time here and probably my last!
This is a small, quaint restaurant in a great location. The selection is somewhat small, but everything we tried was good. Would visit again!

Waffles were so rubbery I could not cut them with a knife. Super friendly but won't go back. I ordered the sausage, cheese, egg sandwich on a waffle. The flavor was great,however not the waffle. My husband ordered the chicken and waffle and the same problem,on top of the batter not sticking to the chicken. I will give it a two star because of the friendly attitude in this world of customer no service.
Creamy ice cream and fun flavors. One need say no more except they have extra stuff like milk and cheeses too.
Hands down the best Mexican food in our area without leaving the state. I've searched a long time and finally found what I was looking for.

Troy, Austin, & Matt, and the rest of the team at Camping World provided EXCELLENT Service! My wife and I could not be more happy with our experience, and we will definitely return for our future needs! 

Since this was our first dip into the RV world, we had a lot to learn, and Troy's team walked us through it all. After our first trip, we still had questions, and Austin set up a meeting when he could personally answer questions & demonstrate how to utilize our trailer to the best of its abilities.

We are grateful for their service, and we will be back!
Best Mushroom Bisque in Pacific Northwest! Fast friendly service, great TV monitors for sports coverage. We will back!

I absolutely adore this place.  My friends and I chose it as a 'special treat' location for a birthday dinner and were blown away!  The service is friendly and intimate, it felt like the server was working with our table only, even though I knew they had other tables.  I hadn't really done 'gastropub' before but they have set the standard for me; excellent reimagined classics with just enough pub to be hearty but just enough presentation to be classy!

The atmosphere does have a slight 'up-class' feel but it doesn't come across as pretentious, and I don't feel out of place showing up in something more casual and I would wager they'd prefer a graphic tee to a three-piece (haha!)

They also ruined mules for me: the mule I had there was so delicious that no other place has compared.  I highly recommend this spot for a quick hangout without breaking the bank.  It's not the cheapest spot but you definitely get what you pay for and it's worth every penny.
Nice very nice service fast and friendly!! Great beer!!! Music is loud but fun!!! Awsome service !!! Great beer! Great smoothies !!!! Love this place wish I had this place in California! Idaho !

When it was announced that Reed's Dairy was opening a location in Meridian several of my friends were beyond ecstatic about it. So, when they opened their doors I knew we had to try it! 
Walking into Reed's is pretty underwhelming. The space is a traditional strip mall retail space.  There isn't a lot of decor in the store. To your right is the ice cream counter adorned with freshly baked waffle cones, behind the counter you will find the grilled cheese press, & there are 2 refrigerator/freezers stocked with to go ice cream and fresh milk, cheeses, etc. 
The selection of ice cream flavors is pretty good. They definitely have something for everyone. The portions are big, but fair considering the prices. In addition to the ice cream, they have grilled cheese & tomato soup. I tried the grilled cheese and didn't like it.  They use cheddar cheese & I prefer American on my grilled cheese, so it's just my preference. The sandwich tastes kinda sweet.  I don't know where the sweet taste was coming from.  
I ordered rocky road ice cream and my husband and kids had shakes. They really enjoyed the shakes and said that they were the perfect consistency of thick, but still able to drink. 
Reed's is a great spot to get really good ice cream & milk.  Next time I go I think I will be getting the kids come!  They can get really busy, especially in the evenings after high school sports games finish and from people leaving the LDS temple. If there is a line, don't worry, it moves quickly and is worth the wait!!
Everyone is super friendly and nice! Food is BOMMMMB we pretty much tried a little bit of everything and it was all fire so you can't go wrong

If you cant groom a poodle then maybe you should stick to boarding and pet sitting.
Poor girl got butchered!! very unprofessional. You should atleast have that experience. A poodle will be traditional grooming experience.YIKES!!

No flavor!  I was so disappointed.  I had been wanting to come here for so long and when I got there It felt to me more like a Run through experience.  You go in and order at a counter, no one explains the menu and you sit with a number on your table. But that wasn't a big deal or deal breaker, what was disappointing was the hangover burger had no flavor. It needed salt and pepper. It was bland on bland - for me. Plus the music was so loud that I could hardly think. Left quickly and doctored up the burger when I got home.

Since Terri took over the cafe, the place has gotten even better. The servers are friendly and helpful and seem genuinely happy to help. It is definitely a favorite place for bringing a group for a delicious weekend breakfast. 
And the food? It's hard to make up my mind usually----the Stuffed Huckleberry French Toast is bursting with flavor, with fresh huckleberries making the sauce something truly local and something you can't find anywhere else. Their sausage patties are excellent with great flavor that only comes from them making the sausage themselves. The omelettes are fluffy, light and chock full out of all sorts of good ingredients to your choice. The pancakes are fluffy too, big and definitely a kid favorite. A highlight is the sausage combo of their fresh made sausages. And they of course do eggs your way! Some days it's even fun to just do sides. My suggestion---get a side of ham with an order of biscuits and gravy. Down home dining at it's best!
Lunchwise, they have lots of good choices.  An excellent Italian Sausage sandwich, with the delicious sausage and oozing with other things. The Reuben is really good too. My favorite however is the Idaho Chili bowl. I'm particular about my chili, having even won a chili cookoff in years past. And I have to say, of all the places i've been, their is the best. Get the bowl, it's a meal in itself. 
Terri is usually there to greet you and check up on things. She makes sure you're happy. This place is wonderful and just the kind of place that you envision when you thing of a comfort, homey type restaurant.

By far the best ice cream in town!  So rich and creamy it makes me want more just thinking about it lol. 

They always have a great selection of flavors and the staff are always so nice.  I highly recommend Reed's Dairy if you're an ice cream fan :)

I'd been wanting to try this place since hearing about their truck in Utah.  So glad they came to Meridian (why you called Boise though? - LOL).

They have a weekly special for $5.  
This week's was CINNALOVE: house made cream cheese frosting & cinnamon butter.  It was delicious.

We also had the RED WONDER: crunchy biscoff, strawberries, raspberries, fresh whipped cream.  The whipped cream was a giant scoop and just the perfect delicious not-so-sweet addition to this dish.  
So so good.

3 nice teenagers working Friday night.  Keeping the place clean, and cranking out good waffles pretty quickly.

Nothing but love Waffle Love.

Very clean and efficient but I had higher expectations. The bowl I got was over sauced and not much substance. Noodles were a bit mushy. Maybe I have to try something different but it was a bit of a sodium bomb.

First, don't fall for the Beer in a Bag trick. When waiting in line they come up and you can buy a mystery beer in a bag. If you guess what the beer is, they will pay for the next one.  I can only drink IPAs and certain dark beers so when she asked me if I prefer light or dark, I thought at least I can tell her dark and get something close to what I want. 

Turns out the beer they charged me $6.00 for was a Bud Light disguised as a "Boise Light".  I asked the host why she even bothered to ask me if I prefer light or dark when they gave me the cheap light stuff and she just said it's all up to them what beer they want to give.  I'm not a customer service expert but it's probably not a good practice to bamboozle your patrons. 

As for the food, the burgers were just okay.  They were so overloaded with sauces and seasoning that they fell apart when trying to eat them and I wasn't sure what I was tasting exactly, not to mention the belly ache later that night. 

Our waitress was nice, but overall I think this place is highly overrated and I probably would have been more satisfied eating at Five Guys.

Alvaro and Bobby performed our water restoration after a failed water fitting on our washing machine flooded our downstairs.  I couldn't have asked for a more professional, knowledgeable, detail-oriented, and responsive team to address our problem.  They arrived on time, when they said they would be here, and put us in a situation where the reconstruction process should be quick and easy.  If you need any restoration services, I highly recommend ServPro of Boise, and request Alvaro and Bobby for your job!!

Bomb!! Carne asada is so good- juicy, flavorful and not super fatty. I've been every day this week for these! Beans and rice are good too. All around very good and I'm a huge Mexican food critic. I haven't tried anything else but if you like carne asada street tacos you will love these.

Gabriel Myers and his crew rebuilt my deck. The deck had many angles, wrapped around 2 large oak trees, and had 2 access points, so it was a challenging project. Gabe worked closely with us to redesign the deck railings and steps. They also poured a concrete pad for us to support an emergency water tank, going the extra mile to pick up the tank and put it in place.  I would highly recommend GM Construction to anyone. Gabriel is a great guy that you can trust.

We went to this Denny's on my birthday for my free Grand Slam.  Again, I hate writing bad reviews - especially when I get free food - but when there is nothing good to say about the food, what can you do?  
Generally speaking, Denny's has declined over the years.  We used to go to Denny's a lot when I was a kid and then when I was in college and they were nice, and clean, and updated.  It's hard to find that anymore.

Our waitress - Kaylynn (sp?) was good ... and I felt sorry for her because there were issues in the kitchen that as the waitress out on the floor, she was taking the heat for.  One lady was complaining about her runny eggs not even being over-easy, they were just raw and something about idiots in the kitchen.  It seems she goes there often, because another couple came in and she hollered at them "JUST TO WARN YOU xxxx IS NOT HERE TODAY."  They ended up having a couple of issues with their food too - ordered bacon, but it came with sausage, for one.

I like my eggs over-hard and ordered as such.  When K set them on the table, she knew ... and she said "are those okay....?"  And I felt bad and just said meekly "nooo :( "  She took them back and then brought me what looked like an omelet - they had broken the yolks and kind of mixed the eggs together.  So they were cooked, but they weren't over-hard eggs.  I didn't say anything.  The pancakes were way overcooked - on the verge of being burnt.  I heard someone in the kitchen saying the cook had called in.  The thing is - if the cook calls in, the customers shouldn't be able to tell.  The manager should be able to jump in and cook things how they are supposed to be cooked.  My sausage was way overcooked - took that home for my dog.  The hashbrowns were dry and too crunchy (overcooked).  The Hi-C fruit punch had floaties in it - looked like chunks of dust or something.  Even for a free meal, I can't say anything good about it.

My daughter ordered over easy eggs ... they were raw.  Truly.  She didn't say anything because she felt bad for K the waitress too. 

All I can say is the server was good, and was in a tough spot.  I gave her a big tip because she deserved it.  But the food ... I can't even say it wasn't good ... it was bad.  That is all.

Our family loves Terri's! We have been going here for years. The staff is always awesome and we love how Terri is always greeting everyone at the door.

We've never had a bad meal here. Everything is so fresh and tasty! Definitely our favorite brunch spot in Meridian! 

I always order the eggs benedict and they are cooked perfectly! I love me a perfect poached egg that I can dip my toast in!

Yum!

Sooooo creamy. I love Reed's Dairy ice cream and had them cater dessert at my wedding! Ice cream is my and my husband's favorite dessert and we did a "first scoop" instead of a cake cutting. Prices were fantastic and they brought their own cups and spoons though we ended up using our own cups. Almost everyone had dessert and commented on the unique flavors and creaminess of the dessert. Our guests with allergies or dietary restrictions loved that they had an Italian Ice option too! I'd highly recommend checking out their catering option. I'll add more pictures when I get them back, these are just phone photos from our coordinator. 

Also DONT SLEEP ON HUCKLEBERRY AND GRASSHOPPER such amazing flavors though you really can't go wrong.
Everything we tried was so delicious! My favorite is the White Sauce pizza. My family will be giving them much more business.

This place was so great!!! First time but won't be the last. Great selection in lots of styles, prices, new and used! Like the best part of a great-priced thrift store all the way to dream rooms. Their artwork and decor was as good as the furnishings. I bought a coffee table and bench seating for our ministry center and they even took me to a donate pile in the storeroom when they found out we were a nonprofit Christian Healthcare & Counseling center in Caldwell.  Water was provided, open restrooms (some are closing them due to this Covid mess! How are so to wash our hands?!) and even hand sanitizer was provided with a sign saying "optional"! Nice touch Idaho peeps! Freedom reigns in this local business and I would definitely recommend and come back with friends and a bigger budget next time!
I order the Steele special. They know me by name.  Best NY slice in Idaho by far.  Plus BOGO slices last hour they are open.

Took my car in because it was shifting hard, they told me it would be around 800$ for what they thought the problem was. It ended up being over 2000$ and when I got my car back it literally died two miles away from the shop. I promptly called them and they did not answer. We ended up having to get it towed back and they were closed for the weekend, apparently one of the wires was loose and they did not charge us for them to re connect it. At the same time I got all of this done I got my oil changed and now a few weeks later my car beeps every time I get into it and tells me that I need an oil change. I shouldn't need one until January! The work I had done was: a full transmission rebuild, oil change, and replacement of the front motor mount.

A lipstick covered coffee cup and 20 minute wait to be asked to order left me hangry!!! Really!!! dirty cups ...when we are trying to recover from a pandemic then when we brought to attention of Manager we were told I'll have to see??? I'm out .. still hungry

Not sure how haven't written about this place! Always delicious!  There's always a crowd so go early or late in the middle of the week if wanting a quiet meal!

Do not come here! It's the worst nail place in meridian! Congratulations for being top worst place, owners are horrible!

Absolutely love this store! Switched from Whole Foods and Trader Joes to just this one. Amazing selection of produce, hot bar is delicious, friendly staff, very clean and organized. This is a great breakfast spot. It does get busy though so timing is everything.  The breakfast selection is fantastic and they are all delicious. Their sweet pancake isn't too sweet and sugary which made this momma very happy. The omelets are delicious.  Great prices and the service is amazing. Had a bad burger experience the night before so tried Sids based on menu and positive reviews. The interior has a very cool vibe..hubby loved the rock soundtrack. We were attended to quickly and our server was friendly and helpful.  We both got burgers and split a "bucket" of loco fries. The fries were coated in a unique blend of seasoning with a bit of kick to it. Then the burgers..hubby got the not so whimpie burger and I got the new elote burger with corn. Cooked to a perfect medium rare on a buttery brioche bun. The burger, local waygu/angus beef was like butter and not heavy tasting. My only regrets are we didn't try their extensive beer and alcohol menu or the wonderful milkshakes that are a shareable work of art...we will be back, maybe tomorrow. I have to say I was very disappointed in this place.  After reading the 5-stars I was prepared to be overwhelmed with WOW, but not so.

Now on to the food, I had always wanted to try stuffed french toast and was excited to see they had it on the menu, but what I got was a slice of french toast (nothing to yelp home about either) with a slab of cream cheese and then another piece of french toast topped with the same table-top raspberry jam they had on the tables. So I really dint know anything about this place except that in the past it was a pizza place and that the owners had changed the menu and renamed themselves.   I dont know if this is true but regardless, I was looking for a place to eat on a Sunday and found this place and the pictures of food told me it was worth a try.

Short and sweet, we were seated immediately after the table was sterilized and the waitress was very helpful.  People that follow me would know i often stick to some staples but the menu here gave me at least four choices.    Ugh the frustration.   The waitress was of no help saying my final two were her favorites.   I went with the eggs beni with meat.  It did take a while but was beautiful when it arrived.   My only advice would be to use some spices!  You're menu screamed flavor to me but the dishes lacked the POW I was expecting.   With your menu choices and drinks I would suggest Cajon spices.  The meal also came with what looked like a small baked potato that had been ripped apart and I believe fried.  The piece weren't cut, they were pulled apart which meant they were very different in size and not all cooked the same.  They also had zero spice on them but still pretty good.

Overall the waitress was excellent and ensured my glass was full.  The food was very good and I will be returning (more often if spices are added).  Outdoor seating is great.  I am glad I found this place in Meridian.

Boy did I find a Gem when I found Clayton!  I (of course) got his name from Yelp.  I read all the reviews before I had decided to make the appointment.  I was made to feel very comfortable right from the start.  Clayton definitely knows what he's doing!  I've received many compliments on my eyelashes and have recommended him several times.
