I have tried to get an appt on Thur‐Sat but they are usually busy. On this holiday Mon. I was able to make an appt. The salon is on Ten Mile (walmart center) and behind the SBucks.  The salon has 10 spa chairs and 8 stations for nails. Lots of staff on this day and all were kind and friendly.  2Q was so much cleaner than some of the places i have been to.    I got a basic mani and pedi and polish on toes only. The specialist who took care or me was gentle and gave long  arm/)leg massages. For my manicure I like a short cut which is better for cooking and she shaped them beautifully with no jagged edges and my cuticle beds look so nice.  My Pedi was great i always bring my own polish (I always recommend this).  I will definitely be back and recommend always plan ahead and call them ahead to make an appt.

Was invited to lunch here as a guest. Had pretty much given up on this place, but today's experience was OK. 

The food was good and cooked to order. Coffee was better than average, but not Illy. They do have an espresso machine though. 

The place is clean and tables aren't piled one on another.  Service was good, but sometimes they could refill drinks a bit quicker.

So I upped them to three stars. I may not pick them as a first choice for breakfast, but I am not afraid to return.

Great ice cream. That is about it here, along with floats, shakes, sundaes. Lots of flavors and ability to taste as many as you would like to try. If you need further directions, look for Reed's next to the Flame Broiler.

Clean and tidy store. Table and chairs seating for maybe 15-20 peeps max. Servers are very courteous and attentive. 

We thought the pricing was quite fair. $3.50 for a single scoop in a cup and a very generous scoop. The milkshakes looked so inviting. There is not much else served here, but they did have a grilled cheese sandwich (with ham, if desired) made with Reed's Own cheese. It looked scrumptious. They also have cream of tomato soup to go with it. Brings back memories of many childhood day lunches. I am going to go back for that one day. But that's it for protein here.

Unfortunately, they do not serve coffee. Coffee with ice cream is a nice combination. But, the Black Rock Coffee outlet is two doors way, so we plan to grab a cup at the drive thru and take it over to indulge in some ice cream. Best of both worlds.
Delicious waffles. Sometimes more sweet than I prefer but will definitely be back. Staff is nice.

The food here bears only the slightest resemblance to Korean cuisine. It's also over-priced. Do yourself a favor and find a real Korean BBQ restaurant. Ideally, one that's owned and operated by Koreans.

Went today to try this place for the first time. We sat at the bar and ordered two cocktails off of their menu. The drinks were so syrupy sweet that we couldn't drink them. On top of this, the drink that my wife ordered was made with a lesser quality vodka than what was advertised on the menu. She ordered a drink that was suppose to have Effen Raspberry vodka (they even name the drink after Effen as well) and we watched the female bartender use Absolut Raspberry.  This is not the same quality of vodka. 

This was enough for us as we figured the food was probably as bad as the drinks. Additionally, we figured they probably make a habit of using lesser quality ingredients just like they did at the bar. We will never go back.

I really want to like CupBop as there are so many cool things about its location in Meridian off of Chinden and Linder. 

The overall design and colors really make it stand out. The Black and Yellow on the walls and the ceiling are very distinctive. 

The menu is very straightforward and simple which I like and believe all restaurants should adopt. 

My dinner companion ordered the Tofu and Kimchi Bowl. 

All the CupBop bowls come with rice and then you choose what you want. The sweet potato glass noodles are a great edition as well as cooking the Tofu fresh. 

There's quite a bit sauces but before I go any forward, let's take a couple of steps back. 

You'll walk in and directly to your right is a picture board with Polaroids with no mention or explanation as to why there are pictures there. 

Moving towards the 'Order Here' is a TV playing sports.  CupBop is not a sports pub or sports grill. There's really no need for the TV unless it was playing KPOP videos or Korean dramas. 

The Menu board - TV monitor is on the wall to your right when your order.  That's fine but there's two tables directly to your left. Granted no one was sitting there when we were there but I highly doubt anyone wants to sit there anyways. Those tables shouldn't be there. 

Ordering in front of the rice cooker, guests can see the shelves of drinks and see beyond into the operations. This may be or ok or not ok depending on what the owners what their customers to see 

The steam table of items are all lidded and it's kinda of a hide and seek situation. It's not like a Chipotle or Costa Vida where all the items are clearly visible. 

The children drawings on the back wall are cute but drawings typically don't survive well in a BOH setting. I would kindly suggest for those to be moved where the TV that was playing sports is located so that customers who walk in see those drawing up close and personal rather from behind a glass partition and up on a kitchen wall. 

Now, let's get back to the progression of the order,  

Rice from the rice cooker, then lettuce or cabbage, then the your items from the covered steam table and then the sauce station. 

The sauce station is odd because there's a parade of squeeze bottles but it's not clear which one is which.  There's the Goji  and the Orange mayo sauce but none of them are within reach of the customers and the sauces are manned by the cashier because it's the next step. After saucing is paying. 

The service is ok. The word I would use is inconsistent. 

Some hats worn correctly and others backwards. 

Some shirts tucked in and others untucked. 

Some employees have phones in the back pocket or by their stations and others don't. 

This is an issue as well as mopping the floor at dinner time.  I can understand mopping if the floor had a spill but it makes no sense to mop the floor moments before your busiest hours.  Why make your parade of customers tip toe through the dining room during peak hours. 

Remember those Polaroids on the wall. On our way out, we checked to see what it was all about.  It's a survivor board. These are pictures of customers who ate their CupBop with level 10 sauce.  

Ok.  Now I get it. Why not promote the board the right way?  That's something that should be highlighted or accentuated not to be a piece of Pictionary or charades. 

It was clear to me that there's a lack of leadership and management. All of the critiques mentioned above are fixable. I am more than willing to help the owners and/or the management because I want CupBop to succeed. My companion's Bowl was on point. 10 out of 10 and she cooks her own Korean food as well as Ramen. 

So, CupBop my offer stands.  If you need a Robert Irvine or Gordon Ramsey, I can tell you that they aren't available but I am.   Looking forward to returning and seeing the improvements.

Went here for dinner. Very nice vibe and great location in old Meridian. Was seated right away. Both inside and outdoor dining available. Ordered fish and chips ( a standard of mine). Very good. Full bar for you to partake in. Try it and enjoy it

Okay. Firstly I don't even know how she didn't get it when I clearly said it . We pull up for our food at the drive in, we were paying with 9 bucks in cash and the rest on card, I handed it to her, she counted, then asked me "what's the 9 dollars for?" (My thinking: I guess it's understandable to ask to be sure) so I told her "we would like to pay 9 dollars in cash and the rest on the card" and she nodded her head and said "okay" so we were waiting for our food , and when we get home to eat it we read the receipt and it said she billed full 20.18 to my boyfriends card. WHERE DID MY NINE DOLLARS GO?!  On the bright side they put four pickles on my boyfriends burger.

Raspberry crepe, shredded hash, and chimichangas 

The Griddle has it all. A cool retro feeling diner that has everything. And if you want anything tweaked or a little different they are more than willing to make anything to your liking.  Definitely worth stopping when in Boise!

We ordered through Uber Eats and there was a little mix-up at first.  We have the Eats Pass and receive Uber Cash with a credit card we have.  This is what the mixup was about, not with the restaurant. Our food arrived hot, in spite of having to switch drivers and tasted good.  The beef yakisoba had a lot of meat and I was surprised at the generous portions.  My husband is the repeat customer and always had good things to say about this place, and I must agree.  So stop by and maybe you'll be happily surprised too!

Im very upset to learn that Suzanne is no longer there and they wont tell me where she went. Ive been getting reflexology foot massage for 8 years at over a dozen places in a couple different states and she was by far the best. 
I would love tp know where sge works now

Not only were they preparing food without masks on and no gloves, but they served an entire 8 person+ table before me and my mom (who both order the plain waffle with whip and strawberries). We arrived at 6:22 and didn't get out to go order until 6:44. I am extremely displeased with the amount of effort put into serving the customers and will not be going back.

Today we split the chef salad and a cup of the soup of the day, sausage tortillini.  Soup was seasoned perfect, told the start it a few days prior.  Salad was its usual amazing size, full of fresh deli meat etc.  2 of us couldn't finish it, well done Terri's again.  Sorry no pic of the soup, we ate it too fast...

I purchased the Good Feet arch supports and wore them for six months until I started having knee problems. Spent a bundle for them too. I am an active person who plays tennis, does cardio classes and walks my dog three miles every day. I was skeptical because my podiatrist had also provided "hard plastic" supports that were uncomfortable to wear and that I finally quit wearing. These "hard plastic" supports were the same, except I spent hundreds of dollars, not covered by insurance.  I went back to Dr. Scholl's ($14.99) inserts for plantar fasciitis, and the pain in my knees went away immediately. You can buy a lot of Dr. Scholl's inserts for over $300.00. I'm still just as active as before. My caution is that these inserts may help for a while, but long-term, they are not a good solution. I think they break down tissue and joints over time. P.S. The knee pain has not returned almost a year later.

Don't go to this establishment....
unless you enjoy a super friendly staff exceptional food and a over the top atmosphere. Katie welcomed me in and I sat at the bar. She made me feel so welcome (I was having a really tough day) I was made to feel like I was visiting an old friends house. The conversations and fun were flowing easyly like floating the Boise river on a triple digit day. Whether you're new to the Treasure Valley or a long time resident this is a must visit restaurant when you are at the Village in Meridian.

I have a love hate relationship with this Boise Co op. There is no middle ground. If I could describe this place in 5 words it would be:  Meridians most unnecessarily fancy grocery. 

Love
Environmentally aware skincare. So, I love that I can find reef safe sunscreen for my face. It's hard to find reef safe sunscreen in general and damn near impossible to find any for your face. They have an amazing skincare selection. 

JellyCat. It is a brand of stuffed animal toys for children. The creatures are whimsical, fun, and just a little sassy. They're a little pricy, just like everything else here. 

Figs. Boise co op is one of the only places that carries fresh figs and during the short season that they are available, I basically pick up a basket every couple of days. 

Everyday stuff, but fabulous. I can walk in here, grab 5 ordinary items and have a gift basket in less than 5 minutes. Why? Because anything from jerky to beer to cocktail napkins are extraordinary here. Every time I assemble a basket, I am pleasantly satisfied with the results and gifting is a breeze. 

Hate
We need to talk. Ok, my health obsessed friends. Not Everything Needs to be Healthy. With all due respect, stop it. Let me have my sugar and calories in peace. I don't tell you how to live your life, do me a favor. Do not mess with me. 

Kill joy. It isn't necessary to RUIN my mocha and take out a whopping 25% of its sugar. I know the co op isn't directly responsible for this but they are responsible for stocking them. I hate the co op for stocking something that used to taste like hope but now tastes like despair. 

Yuck. I feel the need to mention the Tiki Bowl. It is only available at this location and it should not exist at all. I may talk to a manager next time I go. I would not give the house made spam to my dog. Its texture is that of a sponge. I can say with 100% confidence that it tastes, like a dirty kitchen sponge would taste. Don't complicate things. If it's unhealthy and tastes good don't attempt to make it from scratch. For the love of gawd. Life is short. 

Other than that, this place is great, 4 stars!

We've been to Terri's quite a few times now. We try to go once a week... and for a good reason. Their breakfast is not only delicious, but you get such a good portion of food. I usually get the scrambled (2) eggs with the ham steak, that you don't even need teeth to eat . So moist and tender. The pancakes are incredible--not to mention... huge. Service is outstanding and the ladies that take care of you are friendly and outstanding at what they do!!!!'

The waffles weren't anything I'd ever had before. They were flaky and delicious probably because they were made from a yeast dough rather than a batter. 

My son wanted the chicken and waffles. I was so surprised at how good the chicken was!  It was made from scratch, chicken breast with a wonderful juicy crunch. So delicious. 

I had the breakfast Sammy.  Perfectly cooked bacon and eggs. It had a sauce on it, which was a little heavier than I would have used, but it was good none the less. 

The only thing that disappointed me was there wasn't a mask in the place. I was expecting masks at least on the staff.  So where is the "love" for the customers in that regard?  Especially in a spiking pandemic!
We have only had good experiences when ordering from here! Love the portion sizes, and the menu items we have tried (Krab Rangoon, chicken/shrimp teriyaki, edamame, yakisoba) were all tasty!

Atmosphere: Family friendly. Loud (but decent), older diner decor which I love, personally.

Staff: Very friendly and helpful. Interacted with our table very well and very attentive to our needs.

Food: Amazing! I love a crispy bacon (if you don't this place won't be it for you). I think you can request lightly cooked bacon if you're into that, but I love the crispy bacon. Crepes were OK. Kind of plain in my opinion. I got the stuffed French toast and it's my favorite! (Strawberry and Rhubarb).

Mimosa: FAVORITE! FRESH (literally made in-front of you) orange juice!! 

Kind of pricey but it's good to treat you or your family every now and then.

Tucked away on overland, just past eagle road is this breakfast spot. it was really busy when we got there on a Saturday morning, but we only had to wait for like 20 minutes so it wasn't terrible.

I guess people really love this place, because it was very crowded inside. Again, as you all know, breakfast just doesn't do it for me. I don't really like going out for breakfast. They had no lunch options on the menu, but they did have a Mexican food type section of the menu so I got the chilaquiles.

I should have known when the server didn't ask me how I wanted my eggs. for $14 I got some barely wet chips with scrambled egg mixed in. ok. the pulled pork was really good, I will say. it was $2 more to add but they gave me a ton. That made the dish. Without the pork, don't bother.

Their hash browns were good and crispy, the bacon looked ok, but my mom said the gravy is delicious. I didn't try it.

I thought the service was fast for how busy they were, and our server was attentive. My only complaint is I ordered a side of fruit for my toddler. she told me the adult fruit cup was a little bigger, so I said ok. When I got the bill it was $7! for a ramekin of fruit. it was ridiculous. I was pretty mad about it, i'm not gonna lie. it was not listed on the menu. 

Overall, ok place. Order the kitchen sink breakfast. Don't get fruit!

Dave R. you are spot on!  I rated this business a one star only because I have to give it some type of rating.  However, I would have preferred the option of half or no star.  My family and I had a similar experience with Simmons Jewelry. I recommended Simmons because I was apparently under the impression that it was the best jewelry business in the valley.  Boy was that a mistake.  My daughter was getting married and I presented her with my mother's wedding band.  It needed to be sized down.  The first point of contact was with a young man, who apparently didn't know what he was doing.  We told him what we would like to do and he gave us a look of "why would you want to wear this...."  He too rolled his eyes and looked at the ring as if it came from a candy machine.  Then Jay Simmons appeared, he too was just as rude, condescending, and made the remark to my future son-in-law "why would you give her this, she clearly likes bling, look at her watch..." We should have left at that point, but we didn't.  Mistake.  They fudged around with the sizing, which I find very odd today, but nonetheless, they took the ring.  The ring was to be sized to a 6 1/2, with any metal that was cut out to be given back to us.  When we picked up the ring, it appeared to fit, but was snug.  My daughter thought it was just that her fingers were swollen. No help from the salesperson, he couldn't get us out fast enough. We paid and went on our way.  Later that day my daughter said she thinks the ring is too small.  I cried.  We went to another jewelry store and explained our situation and they sized the ring....it was cut down to  5!!!!!  Really Simmons, fine jewelry? I think not.  My husband wouldn't let me go back to Simmons because, I was so upset over what they had done to my mother's wedding ring.  The other jewelry fixed the ring, at no charge.  I will not recommend going to Simmons Jewelry.  NEVER.

In addition, my son-in-law was looking at a Tungsten ring for his band.  Jay Simmons, said, "why would you want to buy that, it will just break..."  Well, my son-in-law purchased a Tungsten from another jewelry and he works with his hands all day.  Happy to say, it is still in tack and going strong.  

It appears Simmons Jewelry (I leave out the "fine" on purpose) focus is to sell only over-priced jewelry for which they feel is what the customer wants or need.  Dismissing family heirlooms as trash. Very sad.
Undoubtedly the best lemonade ever!  Happy hour 2-5pm....drinks are half price.  Try to be nachos or a chicken roll.

Working with Arlene has been some of the best money I have ever spent.  The positive effect her sessions and tapes have had on my life is astonishing. It's like all of the internal, negative chatter has been cleared away, and I've been freed to take actions that support my real objectives.

We were very disappointed with this facility. The only wonderful thing about this facility is Ms.  Ester, the 4's teacher. I understand that children have colds and get sick and being together all day they will transfer all germs, but my son caught extremes here. For 6 weeks solid he had pink eye and got pneumonia 3 times. After taking him to the doctor the second time he explained it is another child in the class who is coughing on my son transferring the virus. I explained to Ms. Esther as well as Fatima the director and asked her to write a note to all the parents to keep everyone informed and stop this. Fatima said she talked to all of the parents, no note. The third time my doctor requested we remove him for his health. Where was the communication to the other parents? Why did I have to remove my child because other parents were uninformed? Issue number 2... My child fell off the slide and fell on his head. They waited 2 hours to call me and in a panic I rushed over to find him laying down at nap time! I was told they checked him over and concluded he wasn't hurt. As a parent I would have appreciated a phone call when it happened so I would have to choice to check over my child before laying him down for a nap. Fatima told me when I showed up that it was a courtesy call and that they didn't have to call me at all. My parenting style is very different from the way the run their facility and they were not accommodating to make me feel comfortable leaving him in their care.

When I review businesses I try to stay as fair and accurate to my personal experiences as possible. I dislike using poor situations as a barometer to rate a business because those are not consistent to the everyday order of business. 

Unfortunately every visit I've had at this meridian location has been filled with dissatisfaction. As a consumer I love Corner Bakery, and raved about its new location here. As a regular to other locations in California I had a good idea what to expect. 

Food wise; it's exactly how I remembered it back in Cali. Great soups and Sandwhichs. Deserts are delicious and quite varied. I still do recommend people to at least try this location for the food. 

If I could do one thing though, it would be to tell the upper management to wake up. Every visit has been marred with lost food, forgotten orders, incorrect orders, or food left on the expo line too long. This is an issue that comes from the management level up. Offering meal coupons can only go so far when it's a consistent issue. I truly hope that they realize their issue before the location earns a negative reputation.

I recently purchased a motor home from this dealer coming from Idaho Falls to finalize the purchase.   The salesman I contacted offered to film a video of the motor home I was interested in and did a fantastic job of showing me top to bottom and side to side of the motor home.  When I arrived to final the sale, the salesman and finance person were absolutely on top of things and did everything to help us get on our way.   I was so skeptical about the "walk through" which was listed as part of the final step in the purchase process but was truly amazed at all I learned - such a great tool for someone buying for the first time or just an aid in getting to know the vehicle you purchased.  The people up front greeting us and helping us find our way were so friendly and professional.  Thank you for making this a truly memorable and smooth finish.

Love, love, love this restaurant! If you are looking for a spot to have some great morning food, look no further than The Griddle. Be warned, this place is no longer a secret in the valley which means that there will be a bit of a wait but it is so worth it. 

Personally, I recommend trying their Breakfast Croissant which is an egg, ham, and cheese croissant-style sandwich. This will give you enough room to try one of their dessert style breakfast which includes their Peach Crepes. Highly recommend this yummy goodness. 

Guaranteed great customer service, your coffee cup will not be empty longer than two minutes (it's almost like they know when you need a refill). Great place to bring friends and family from out of town to show off one of the valley's finest breakfast restaurants. Cheers!
Juiciest thickest burgers, their buns are so good, best truffle parm fries ever!!!! And that shake+fun music! Our server Greyson was super friendly & gave us great recommendations!
Best southern style meal in the valley. The deviled eggs, yes deviled eggs, are incredible. The fried chicken is great as well. They serve breakfast that is outstanding.

The best Mexican food in Idaho, by far, and the only restaurant that compares to the many great hole in the wall Mexican restaurants in Southern California (one of the few redeeming qualities of that place).  After 14 years of being disgusted by Idaho's Mexican food dining options we finally have a keeper.  What's good? Literally everything, but my favorite is the carnitas.  

One very nice touch for you vegetarians out there, when you order from their vegetarian section on the menu they serve vegetarian rice and beans that have all the flavor of the regular items without the animal base.  

The food, employees, service, and the clean dining room make this restaurant the gold standard of Mexican food in the state.
This place is great! Delicious pizza, great specialty pizza options. Highly recommend!

This is a quaint place in Meridian.  Gastropub describes the choices perfectly.  Lots of cocktails, 12 rotating Taps, and food choices from Appetizers to full entrees. 

     We sat outside and it was beautiful.  I started with the Blood Orange Boulevardier and wasn't disappointed.   Ordered appetizers of brussles sprouts, pretzel and the cheesy tots.  All VERY tasty....only complaint is they are a tad small portion wise.  

     Ordered a second cocktail and a cider along with my Blue Cheese burger and fries.  The burger was big and looked great.  First bite told me it was the best Blue Cheese burger I've had (and I order them everywhere).  Candied bacon and onion jam gabe sweetness....the fresh Blue cheese rounded out the burger perfectly.  Fries were crisp and delicious.  Man what a great meal.  

     Service was friendly and attentive.  All in all this is a great little place to eat....or drink.  Will definitely be coming back.  Looking forward to trying the Cowboy burger

$140 (tip included) for a small bowl of Mac n cheese, 3 burgers, 3 orders of fries, 3 shakes, and a beer. We were 3 adults and 3 kids and we decided to split some burgers to save money. My kid loves mac n cheese but didn't enjoy this one as the cheese was hardened and chewy. I thought the burgers would be bigger and that they would come with fries, but alas, they don't. With that said the fries were quite good! We tried the Parmesan fries and the loco fries and the burgers were very creative and tasty. I love my music loud but functionally to hear our server and others at our table it was excessive. What I love about this place and what else makes it unique is that the staff are jovial, the kitchen even greets you as you come in and says good bye when you leave.
Rudy's use to be one of my favorite places but they've back slid a lot and that was before the pandemic. I hope they do better because I miss having a place to go.

Went here based on the good reviews we saw.  Employees were really friendly and when I asked if the Pastrami had mustard (I don't like mustard) she said no, but would make the sandwich like a traditional Pastrami if I wanted.  I didn't, but she was willing to change things up with-out me even asking.  The whole family enjoyed their food, wife loved the Buffalo Cauliflower.  Environment was great.  The only complaint I can come up with was they were outta the beer I wanted, but next time...

This should rename this to Chicken Love! I always get the chicken and waffles...never to be disappointed! They have the best fried chicken I have ever had. No comparison. Juicy inside, crispy outside, and very generous portions! I wanted to go a few times before I left a review. They have excelled every time. I will say the only downfall I've seen is the longer wait times for food. But when it's good - I don't mind waiting a few extra minutes!
Getting very frustrated with Costco.  I know they count in the impulse buy fir revenue but fir the live if all things holy just offer pick up service for groceries!

Bought a travel trailer from them.

 Problem 1 over weight, was told it was 4500 and it came in at 5800. We could tow 6000 total.  Called in and talked to the manager about it and was told "you should have done more research before buying."

Problem 2. Looking at a Class A motorhome. Had a salesman tell me he had the "Perfect" one for us in "mint" condition. I guess that having cracks running from the top of the coach to the bottom of the coach that were 1 inch wide is "mint". Plus there was a long vertical split in the bedroom closet. These were supposed to be "cosmetic" and "nothing to worry about." 

Needless to say we bought a class a somewhere else. 

So now onto problem 3. We asked for a refund on some of the add on's that we paid for but did not use. As it was written in the contract we came in in person, filled out the paperwork and waited. It is 9 weeks now and still no refund.

Must do a lot of one time business because I can see no reason for them to prosper based on integrity of the sales staff or the promptness of the refunds/claim re-imbursement nor the Managerial Staff's courtesy training.

My advice....RUN don't walk FAR FAR AWAY

The burgers and pork belly toys here are to die for! I prefer a place that actually let's you get your burger cooked to order temp your way ( I like them bloody!) And Sids does. The shakes are a meal unto themselves fair warning. Have been here multiple times now and never disappointed.

Ugly bop. Sauce #4. Sloppy. Trust me, this is one of the best meals I've had in the treasure valley. Make sure they put the white sauce on there. Sad to be leaving the treasure valley and leaving this gem behind, but that is why I am leaving this review. With door dash it is a toss up, weather the order will be correct, but I've had no issues ordering in person. Give it a shot it won't disappoint as long as you're accustomed to mild spicyness!

WOW...it's been 2 years now since my life changed from walking into the Good Feet Store in Meridian, Idaho.  Two years ago, I was suffering  arthritis in both feet, my knees, hips, and back. Once I was fitted in the proper arches for my feet and I walked around the store, I was all smiles!  And two years later, I am still smiling as I have significant relief of pain in my feet, knees, hips, and back.  I can go on hikes and long walks again.

I booked a room after being assured it had a kitchenette. Called 2 days before arriving to verify the room had a kitchenette and was told it did. It didn't - in fact none of the rooms had kitchenettes. The breakfast they serve is horrible. When asked for a late checkout was told they would only extend it 1/2 hour - far shorter than any hotel I've ever stayed. The shower head was barely functional. Anything positive? Nic size room. 

Not recommended.

I came in today. It was my first and last visit there. The 2 employees  working seemed like they didn't want to be there-not friendly at all. When my group got their order, they forgot my waffle and, instead of apologizing and making it, she rushed through it and it was not cooked at all. I spent $5 on a waffle I took one bite of. Horrible customer service and food! Never going back there!

We went here tonight and got a 20 inch cheese pizza to go. The pizza was very good and I love the sauce on the pizza. If you like thin crust NY style pizza then give this place a try you will not be disappointed. Also, I love that they have a drive thru window to pick up your pizza. It's nice for the Idaho winters. Overall I really liked the pizza and will be back to try other toppings and sides that they offer.

I had the B Bop cup. I couldn't finish it. The beef was chewy, and the sauce was almost pure mayonnaise (is that a Korean thing).

The staff gets points for asking us how our meal was and being genuinely interested in our feedback.

James answered our call and arrived quickly. I was already frustrated (by my own fault) but regardless he was kind and professional. I highly recommend his service. His copilot, Frankie (the Doberman) is also a plus. What a great duo!!

I'm into Organic Foods and this store has them in abundance. Totally enjoy shopping here. Their range of items exceeds any I've ever found in other stores. Just the selection of different organic rice is amazing, not to mention the flours, raw local honey, a huge variety of organic vegetables and fruits. I was so impressed I joined during my first visit. Their facility also has a cafe and I enjoyed a lovely ruben sandwich made a little differently than most.
Loved that no one was wearing masks! Seriously like a breath of fresh air. It felt so normal and everyone was so nice! Loved that I could actually see faces. More businesses should be like this!

I used to enjoy the oil change experience at Einstein's, and knowing it was helping an Idaho based company made it that much better.  After reading about the recent sale to Valvoline and the way the Einstein employees have been treated following the sale I won't be back.  I get that companies can pay employees what they want (above minimum wage), but to force employees to sign a non-compete agreement is completely unreasonable.  

My family and I won't be back and I look forward to driving by these locations and seeing them empty.  Hopefully Valvoline will be forced to close up shop and leave Idaho.

The work here has always been good.  I've spent thousands here over the past couple years.  Prices have gone up considerably and now are much higher than other places with licensed therapists.  What really got me was I left a 10.00 tip and was informed I needed to leave more that it wasn't going to be enough.  I work in the service industry so I know how it is a very few tip well, some tip a little and unfortunately a lot tip NOTHING!  That's how it goes you don't have to leave anything for a tip and sadly most these businesses are taking advantage of employees who deserve more, but never have I told one of my customers they HAVE to tip me or even be so BRAZEN as to say you must tip me more so I WONT BE GOING BACK.

This Ramen shop is one of the best I've ever been too. And they have rice noodles if you're gluten free! Definitely would recommend highly to anyone. They are not nearly as busy because of Covid.  Best and most authentic Ramen in Idaho
First time here. Great place! Super atmosphere,  afternoon cocktails, great food and Nicky the bartender ROCKS!!!!

Always love the Costco employed but becoming frustrated with Costco.

The new store was nit fully stocked on my first visit.  Not a big deal that the veggie section was really sparse.  Came back a week later and it was fully stocked 

I don't know why Costco stores always seem to have stupid parking lots and dumb exits and entrances.  The parking lot is huge including with mire dirt spaces.

As the case is more often than nit... how you get in and out just sucks.  I would say avoid at holidays cuz it's going to be a nightmare but since I'm not allowed in due to the new mask/shield mandate I can't comply with that's pointless.

They need to at least have pick-up if they are going to ban shippers with health issues from the store.

Four negative Covid tests and counting but still #icantbreath

10/10 would recommend. Their teriyaki is amazing too I never leave without it. Food tasted amazing and everything was fresh. They oddly have an amazing sense of communication because when something ran out another one immediately popped up. Little pricey but manageable work a try if you haven't been here!

When we travel we always stop at Costco. This time in the deli for premade Dinners. Tired of eating out, it's nice to buy food that we can put in the oven at BNB and treat our guests.  Also, it's nice to see the different clothing items at each store.  We always seem to find something to pickup along the way.  Self check was a plus as this store is quite busy, but all in all I enjoyed shopping here.

Stay away from this place. These people have no integrity and no concern for the tenants who live here. They will say whatever is needed to get you in but will not lift a finger to correct anything after you are. My husband and I moved here in February 2019.  We are both working professionals and were needing a place to rent for a short time while we looked for a home to buy.  We wanted a nice apartment home that would allow us to have our 2 small dogs.  We thought this would be the best place.  We pay as much as a mortgage to live here and the amenities are awful. The hot tub is constantly yellow and I've rarely seen anyone cleaning it.  We had our small granddaughter over for a weekend and had one of the tenant here (special needs) disrobe and jump up and down naked in the hot tub.  My husband yelled at him and his caregiver (who was laughing) to get out of the hot tub.  It was terrible for a little girl to experience.  The following Monday I called the office and told them of the situation. Nothing happened.  The man and his caregiver were still frequenting the hot tub putting children at risk.  

The dog park was flooded for over a month and no matter how many times I went to the office to complain nothing happened.  It took several tenants telling the office that they needed to fix the swamp and mud park or we would stop paying doggie rent because no one could use it.  Mud was literally everywhere .... covering our dogs each time we took them their to go potty.   After about 6 weeks of hell, they finally got someone to fix the sprinklers so the park would not be flooded. 
Next they did not water the grass and everything died off.  Our dogs were now in dried dirt and dead grass.  They seriously took about 2 months to fix the sprinkler issue.  

After being here almost 6 months, we are soooooo ready to be out of here.  Ownership has changed but they kept the same management personnel.  Big big mistake.  These people ignore problems, refuse to speak to you face to face and never return calls.  The manager is awful and very unprofessional.  The staff is the same way.  Condescending and rude. 

Our newest fiscal was their online payment system.  Starting July 1st, 4 days ago, anyone on autopay had to stop autopay and sign up with their new system (that did not work).  Then tenants were told to bring in a  cashiers check or personal check to pay their rent until they could get the problem solved.  My husband and I were on that autopay and we do everything electronically.  I don't even own checks and had to go to the bank to pay for them to print me some.  We both work 8-6PM so it's very hard to get to the bank before it closes.  The 4th was a holiday and I had been working out of town prior to this.  The first day back (3rd) I went to the bank, got a paper check and walked it into the office today the (5th).  Mind you, I have always paid my rent on time, always paid on-line and I had to go out of my way to get them a paper check because their on-line system was not working.  I was shocked when they told me I was being fined and owed them another $100 because it was late. That is ($1750 total) because I didn't get them a paper check by the first because their system was not working.  Unbelievable.  No ownership for their inability to take our payment online, no forgiveness for the few days it took to go to the bank and get them a check, it was just a flat out..."we warned you 2 weeks ago that we were changing systems".... how about warning us the system wouldn't work either.  I so upset I asked to speak with the manager, Erica Andrews.  I was smuggly told that she was in a meeting.  I came back a few hours later to see if she was out of her meeting and was then told she was on vacation and could not be reached until Monday.  I asked for her phone number in which they said we don't give out that information and to check my email for her response.  

I checked my email after that only to find, the same old crap.  They still want to stick it to me.  They will not own anything.  They could care less that I had to go out of my way because their system was not working and want to fine me for it.

I'm warning you.... don't rent here if you want to be respected and treated with dignity.  You will only be a number to them and all they care about is bringing in more money and doing the least as possible to manage the property correctly.  

I've only shared a few incidents that have happened while living here but trust me ....there are more than I have patience to write about.  Read what others have written and do yourself a favor... walk away from this place.
Most authentic ramen in Boise (so far)! I'm from Hawaii and we moved from Korea and Japan this past year. Get the Tan Tan Ramen, you won't be disappointed.

I kind of mulled over this review for the better part of the day because a lot of my experience today was still a 4* review but I ultimately decided to take back a star.
The good: 
Seated promptly.  Cold frosty beverage delivered quickly.  Server was extremely helpful and friendly.

The Meh:
Ramen was good but nowhere near as good as the last visit. I ordered the Spicy Miso Ramen extra spicy... it came out rather bland and not spicy at all.
The server brought me a thing of chili oil which wasn't spicy at all but tasted good.  In the end the chili oil just made the broth gross and I couldn't drain my bowl like I did last time.

The Bad:
First step in the door and all I could hear was my boots sticking to the floor. Which tells me that they were mopped with dirty water and that's just gross.
All of the door and window fixtures were covered in dust and cobwebs, again just means that they don't clean. If the establishment doesn't clean the areas that the customer sees...  god only knows what the back of the house (where they cook and prep the food that you eat) looks like. Eww.

I would also like to add that the pork I was served was not cooked enough. It was cooked to a safe to eat temp but not enough so that it was that tender texture you expect with pork belly. Instead I was served a whole lot of hard white fat and meat with too much bite. Wasn't appetizing in the slightest and wasn't eaten.... was really gross but it happens. 

So yeah I took back a star but look forward to going back again someday. Hopefully to some new cleaning regiments and better cooked pork.

We bought a new Toy Hauler from Camping World Meridian a couple months ago. I will say from sales to purchase to some changes needing to be made, this has been the most enjoyable buying experience I have had in a long time. I would really like to say a big "thank you" to our salesman David who did an incredible job, even after the purchase, and Jeremy for working with us on our trade-in and sales price. After the purchase we had a change that needed to be made right away and the service manager JT, came to the rescue. Thank you all so much for your continued service and help with our trailer. I would highly recommend Camping World of Meridian for any of your RV purchases. You will be in great hands!

The Place is nice, Great Food  and a lot of it we came home with leftovers. 
Our Waitress Karisa Tho she was busy she still smiled  and provided us with on going Coffee without us needing to ask.
We had breakfast and now we must return and try out their yummy lunch menu .
We also meet Terri the owner who was very pleasant.
This will be our breakfast place from now on, Saying bye to the chain restaurant we were going to .

American food cafe in downtown meridian. Brick oven restaurant used to be in this location. Outdoor seating available in warmer weather. Bar seating and table seating inside. Lots of interesting drinks available. No vegan options but there are vegetarian options that can be made vegan. I ordered the portobello mushroom sandwich with no cheese, and mustard instead of pesto. It comes with fries. The bread is brushed with either butter or oil but I didn't ask which one. Limited kids menu. My kid got the green chili Mac n cheese which is not on the kid menu but he liked it.

Really good ice cream!! It has somewhat of a chewyness to it which is something you don't get very often from ice cream shops. My favorite flavors are mint chocolate chip, grasshopper, huckleberry and their raspberry cheesecake! I still need to try others of course. They have so many flavors to choose from and I love how they mix them up. When you walk into this cute little location it smells heavenly! Honestly it's a mix between their grilled cheese and fresh waffle cones! Their portions are huge!!! If I want to try more than one flavor I ask for a single-split and that's about two big scoops, when I want just one scoop I get the kiddie scoop. I understand why people say it's pretty expensive but you get what you pay for. Yummy ice cream and great portions. Their chocolate milk is just that, chocolate milk. My husband and I didn't understand the rave on that but it was good just not the best.

Driven Automotive is more of dedicated Toyota facility.   Brian, Bryce and crew does an amazing job. 

One of the best attributes is they are honest.    They do not do anything that is not needed and always call before they work on the vehicle.   

The prices are extremely reasonable and the work is done quickly and efficiently.   Give them a try if you are looking for a breath of fresh air in the auto repair industry.

The only thing positive I can say is it has a full bar. Walked in around 1, not real busy but there were several tables full. Our waitress was more interested in flirting,  playing with her hair and rubbing her nose with the same hands that are going to be on the plates food is served on. And no she was not a twenty something person, had to be in late thirties.  25 minutes after seating ourselves she decided to come over and say hi. Food was ok, nothing worth coming back for.

This place is A- Maze- ing. We got Into town late and we called ahead. They stayed open late for us.   Who does that?  Nobody does that anymore. Service was great. 

Let's talk food. Can you say Chicken and Waffles. This is Idaho people. Do they know how to do make new things in Idaho?

I ordered the chicken and waffles and it was great. Son in law had "The best burger he has ever had". He's been everywhere and that is saying something. 

Friend and daughter each had the salad and the loved it. I can't recommend this place more. 

Did they keep the kitchen open for us?  Yes

Was the service good?  Yes. Exceptional

Was the menu complete?  Yep

Was the food good?  Amazing. 

GO HERE!!!

Great service. Great location. Portions are generous. Recommend the Bloody Mary flight. The Hatch Chili hollandaise sauce on the eggs Benedict was awesome. I wish I remembered our servers name, but she was fantastic. She was tending bar and holding down her area with ease. Even remembered an Alcohol I mentioned the last time she encountered us. It's the little things that make it memorable. I'm holding that 5 star rating just because of flavor. The food has great potential, but ours was a little lacking. Definitely trying it again.
Food- **** of 5
Service-*****+ of 5
Price-$$ of 5

This is now my favorite place to go to in Idaho now! The customer service was outstanding; It was probably one of the best experience I've had at a restaurant. 

We ordered 4 different appetizers which were all fantastic and their sangria in a bag which you can walk around with in the village!

We got the jalapeño bacon which was my favorite and comes out on a cool hanging rack. The truffle fries were huge, Mac & Cheese was awesome, and the flash fried deviled eggs were amazing! There's nothing bad about this place. Can't wait to go back the next time I visit!

Needed an Inspection and Gabe did a fantastic job.  Incredibly thorough and actually did some repairs along the way which I did not even ask for.  Strong recommendation and will hire him again for a kitchen project and some larger deck and structural projects down the road.  Before you make a final decision on a contractor just give Gabe a quick call and you won't regret it.

In the last year, I can't say things have NOT gotten much better at the Meridian branch of the Coop. We find we don't go in more than once a month. The sorriest department is the meat and fish counter. No one seems to know much about their items or how to cook them. The help seems to have no pride or sense of ownership in their department. They seem to be more clock-watchers than purveyors.

The sorry treatment of their fish still persists as I observed from over a year ago. Wild King is wasted at this store. We have resorted to paying a fortune to have really fresh seafood shipped in by Pike's Fish Market in Seattle. Ever had Copper River King Salmon, really fresh? King Salmon, not Sockeye, and you'll think you just tasted the best salmon in the world. No one even carries Copper River King in Boise, at least that we have found.

The help can be also hit or miss. Surly more often than not.

Tried Sid's Garage for the first time today, and we are so glad we did! We've been searching for the BEST burger in Idaho and we found it at Sid's! High quality, local beef... fresh buns, and cooked to perfection! 

The tempura green beans and fries are delicious too. Had no room left for the incredible-looking shakes but we will save room next time! 

The staff is super warm and friendly, and we love seeing their smiling faces :). The service is fantastic! This place is an all-around A+ winner!
Great service and good food. My order was correct and came out quick. Staff was very kind and kept my drink full. Not much more to say other than that, breakfast was tasty.

Egg rolls and egg flower soup is good. Be sure to check your pickup order. We ordered sweet and sour pork and unfortunately did not receive the sweet and sour sauce.  I called to inform them of the mistake and asked if they could deliver the sauce and they said they could but it would require a delivery fee.  I asked if they could take the delivery fee out of the tip I left. They said they would 'ask' and call me back. 3.5 hrs later no call back. I contacted the restaurant again and was told they unfortunately cannot deliver sweet and sour sauce. We have ordered 4 times and we have never received a complete order. This was our last. If you do order make sure you triple check their work. Way too much room for error on take out and delivery services for this business.  It's the last $3 mistake that costs $??s in future business from us.

Wow!  Best burgers I've ever had.  Staff is super friendly you order when you come in at the counter and go find your seat. I ordered the steakhouse burger and pork belly tots.  Everything is alacart so you can customize your meal. Totally would recommend this place.  Just note it's usually pretty busy and not a lot of seating but so worth it.

Interesting little place, a fast-casual hole in the wall that's essentially a slightly upscale Idaho version of that southern staple place Waffle House. Unlike your average Waffle House, this place is very clean. It's good, the portions aren't super generous, but tasty. The place is kind of a one-note "let's do one thing well" sort of place; that basically means that the menu is endless variations of how to dress up a waffle, plus chicken or a fried egg, and avocado toast. For me, it's more of a place to snack than get a meal, maybe ideal for a post-drinking binge destination. I kind of wish they had a bigger meal option for the bigger eater, but not my restaurant. You could always go back and order something else if it doesn't fill you up, but there is a bit of a lag between ordering and getting your food, so that doesn't seem practical to me.
Best burgers in town. Best milkshake in town. If you are local you know this, if you are from out of town...GO! Might be a line but worth it.
Fun place to eat and a terrific burger.  We go here on a pretty regular basis and have loved it every time!

Upscale burger joint. They have innovative recipes and very friendly staff. What I really liked was that there were no silly mask rules. I'm so done with the faked pandimic. By the way if you haven't figured it out yet, the jabs are causing more deaths than the covid-19, just sayin'

I came for my birthday with a group of 14. I spoke to Brian, one of the owners, over the phone to hash out all of the details. They don't normally take reservations, as it's a small establishment, but accommodated us because we pre-ordered our food. Everything started amazing. The server was wonderful and the food was served very promptly as promised. Everyone raved how efficient everything was! That was all until it was time to pay the checks..now, we discussed that each couple would be able to pay separate checks with the server via their tablet. I offered to pay in full and I know Brian specifically said it would be ok to pay separate checks so I didn't think it was going to be an issue. The server told us the easiest way to split everything was to stand in line at the front and tell the server at the POS station what each of us had. We had no issue doing this, but apparently Will, the other owner, did. He wasn't afraid to get very loud and vocal with my entire party and yell in front of all the staff and guests about how you don't take reservations and it's ridiculous that we were doing separate checks, as that's not aloud. He even went as far as threatening to throw one of my friends out while saying he can't wait to hear our raving review! I tried to explain that Brian and I had discussed everything and he started yelling even more saying he was in on the conversation and that I was lying. You have no idea how embarrassed and mortified I was. My guests were disgusted as well. I've NEVER been treated so Unprofessionally anywhere! Especially by an owner of a company. The staff was apologetic, which they shouldn't have had to been. Brian was so helpful and friendly and Will was a complete hothead! We completely felt unwanted. It's unfortunate because it was such a smooth dinner. We were in and out in 45 min (not including the wait to check out), which is amazing for 14 people!! 
Unfortunately, I for one will never return. I know my guests will never return. That may not affect your establishment in the least but friends tell friends. It could've all been avoided had Will not stepped in to ruin our experience.

Dropped off my husband at work in the morning and decided to get a foot massage nearby his office.  

Not a big place, small and it is OK.  I walked in without an appt. around 10:15 a.m. and was led to a semi private room.  There are only about 4 chairs out there, like I mentioned, not big.

The lady was very nice and did a good job.  Not the best I have tried but it was good enough to relax my muscles (if I have any...Ha).  After the massage, they offered me a bottle of water, which is awesome to me.  I believe that one needs to drink warm water after reflexiology massage, it helps to cleanse out the detox, so I appreciated the drink a lot.  They also offer a reward card, by having 10 massages, you will receive 30 min free on your 11th massage.

They have 2 different kinds of foot massage, I picked the one with back massage.  They also have 30 min. Foot massage only for $20, which I think is great for people in the office for a quick break.

Will I go back?  Most likely if I am in the neighborhood.

So at the time I write this, they've been open about a month, and I just found out about this place a couple days ago.  Gotta say- they've got something good going on!

The salsa they serve with their chips was great, and actually has a bit of bite, which makes me happy.  The chips were served as huge circular fried tortillas which you break apart, rather than the normal, restaurant-style tortilla chips, which was cool.

Tried the al pastor tacos, and they were am-freaking-azing!  Street taco style, with juicy meat, some green salsa, and a few lime wedges.  Simple.  Yummy.

Not too many beers on tap.  Modelo and Pacifico is what I saw.  Can't go wrong with Modelo at a Mexican joint.

Super friendly staff, simple, clean deco... yeah... cool place.

I was a big fan of Flatbread and was sad to hear they were closed. But the new restaurant apparently is owned by the same people.
Checked it out with a friend for Sunday brunch. I love that you can make reservations here on Yelp. I would recommend doing that for brunch. At 11am it was busy! Parking is a pain too. There are at least three restaurants at that intersection that do breakfast or brunch on Sundays, along with several churches on the block. Be prepared to walk a bit.
The brunch menu looked good, but we ordered off the lunch menu. With the exception of the bottomless mimosa.
For starters, we got the crispy brussel sprouts. Amazing!! They had bacon and whole grain mustard, were roasted perfectly. Almost like chips. I will go back just for those.
For lunch I went with the grownup grilled cheese and tomato soup, my friend ordered the fish and chips. My sandwich was made with pimento cheese, tomato slices and bacon. Really good and a little spicy. The tomato soup was good with a bit of spice. The fish on my friends dish were two large pieces of cod. They, along with the fries looked good, and it was a big plate of food.
Service was pretty good. Since I made a reservation we had no wait and they had our table ready a few minutes early. Our waitress was very friendly and made sure to let me know my grilled cheese and soup both had a bit of spice. Fine by me, but she said she likes to make people aware. We did have to ask for refill on our drinks twice. And once the bill was paid no one checked on us again even though we sat and chatted for a bit. So much for "bottomless" mimosas. Also, our lunches came out less than a minute after our appetizers. We made it clear we wanted them first even though we ordered all at the same time. It was busy so the kitchen just seemed to be cranking out the food. I guess I'd rather have it all at the same time and hot than separately and our lunches be cold.
I'm already planning on going back, both with my friend and my hubby. There are a lot of things on the menu that look delicious. Looks like they have a good happy hour selection too. Spring and summer on there patio will be a must to check out in the coming months!

One word: WOW.
I am truly impressed. 

Sometimes, there is nothing more comforting than a warm bowl of ramen. & The ramen at Ramen Sho hits the spot. It is Mouthwateringly delicious- Bursting with flavour and spices! The service staff is kind, knowledgeable, and welcoming. The atmosphere is nice and casual. 

I would definitely recommend this restaurant to all friends and family! 

Sincere thanks to everyone at the restaurant for making our dinner so memorable and pleasant with top service and tasty food!

To those reading this: If you're looking for delicious Japanese food, give Ramen Sho a try. You will not regret it.

Late to the job.  Didn't write the estimate for what we asked.  Had outrageously high prices. Partially completed the agreed work & would not come back to finish unless we would give them additional money (we finished their work).  I am a general contractor and I personally do this kind of work myself with my own hands so I know what it takes. I try to be fair with everyone. I don't want anybody to get burned and taken advantage of. So I'm posting this review

WOW!! This was fantastic! I had the ugly bop with no cabbage it was awesome. The chicken was so good and I loved the sweet sauce!! The noodles were also so great. This is the first time I have had Korean food and I don't know how authentic this is but based on this I would love to try more.
Recently visited the salon and felt like I was an inconvenience to the employee working. He rushed through my nails and left me paint on my cuticles and bumps/bubbles on my nails. Just dissatisfied!

I have been going to this location for multiple years now, due to the unfortunate circumstance that they have a large supply store. Their customer service is poor at best. No one seems to genuinely want to help you, but rather that you are inconveniencing them with your presence. It would be nice to go in the store just once with and feel welcome and appreciated, in 5 years it has yet to happen.

We had a great experience at Sid's! The flash fried deviled eggs were delicious as were the truffle fries but the standouts were the burger (hangover) and shake (Kickstarter). Both were to die for! I enjoyed the atmosphere as well .. the wall art and music selection put out a great vibe. I look forward to many returns !

We've been here four times now and each visit has been consistently enjoyable. Good service, prompt ticket times, drinks that don't leave you wishing they were a bit stronger, everything is well executed. The burgers are legit, the shrimp po boy had more shrimp that I was expecting by far - which is always a pleasant surprise. Last time we went I had fish and chips and the fish was GOOD. Fried perfectly. They have our business for sure - every time we're out in old Town Meridian its our go-to place.

I must have horrible luck with nail salons. I came here for my birthday a while back, and asked for dip nails with SHORT extensions. The man who did my nails ignored my request and proceeded to put long acrylics on my fingers. The colors aren't what I asked for either. When I got home I felt like crying. They charged 70 dollars and made us pay to get them redone. I then got gel polish in the colors I originally wanted, done by a woman who was rushing to get me out. Frustrated and will not be returning

This Home Depot location is really awesome. Their customer service is always on point and they go the extra mile.  For example, this past week we have had temps over 100 here in Meridian. It's been miserable.  When my husband mentioned that we needed to stop by Home Depot to get some blackout blinds I was less than enthusiastic. But his promise of dinner out was just enough persuasion to get me into the car! As we walked into Home Depot we were greeted by an employee standing next to a large chest freezer offering free cold bottles of water. It was such a great gesture & I was really impressed.

I made an appointment and walked in 10 min. early. No acknowledgment. Finally, 5 min after my appt. time, "take a chair." 10 min. later still no technician. When I asked a near by tech if they honor appt. she said, "We're not leaving our customers in the chair," and walked away.  They were no busier than any other salon I've been to.  Rude.
Updating my review & still just as pleased as the first visit! The service is amazing, the food is amazing, and the atmosphere is as well. Such a great place!

this used to be our favorite buffet  we havent been in a while everything just tasted old and bland also the mongolian meat had a film, like an actual clear crispy film we just spent 40 bucks for 3 people for ten minutes and then another 20 at mcdonalds to feed everyone. also when asked how everything was we told her it wasnt very good she just said sorry that'll be 40 bucks no why or how come just "whatever" this is only my second review ever on yelp not a big reviewer but man people need to be warned.

Overpriced in my opinion, but it was all great food and we had a good experience! I loved the atmosphere of the place and it was fun. My kids ate their entire plates, which is rare for them! They went crazy over the fruity pebble milkshake for dessert, the server split it for them which was very sweet and thoughtful.

What can I say? Sometimes I just feel like going to Dennys.   They have a good burger selections as well as many other choices.  I will admit that I am a gravy addict and think that it's goodness is seriously under valued in restaurants.  I am not prejudice to what color of gravy I get.  I dream of a place where a place will offer me any of the gravy colors whether it is white, yellow,  or brown gravy.  In short, Dennys has dishes with good gravy.

I ordered the pot roast and potatoes and gravy.   A little light on the veggies but it was warm and good and lots of gravy.  Meat was a little well done but that's ok.  I ordered a strawberry milkshake that was completely liquid.  It had no thickness at all.

Sometimes this place just hits the spot.

The lady handling everyone's money then puts the straw in peoples drink. KEEP STRAWS IN PACKAGES! Not safe at all for covid. As a high risk person I would not recommend this place. You should not be handling people's money and then touching everyone's straw.
Stopped in for dinner on a Saturday night! Quick service, and great food! Had the karage, and curry tomkatsu bowl., with a pork bun. Very very tasty!Will be coming back to try more.

Well, this is a first.  Bought two items and VG.  Paid cash. Saved the receipt (since we knew we may not need both items.)  Returned one item, unopened with receipt. Instead of getting cash back, we were given a slip of paper and told that we'd be "mailed a check." 
If a customer pays cash, they should receive cash back on the spot. Waiting for a check or having to share personal information, inconveniences the customer and seems way too old school.
A quick and easy lunch or dinner fix. Everyone working there is always on top of the ball and give great service.
Happy hour everyday 11-7 pm. $1 tacos on Tuesday. This place is so cool. Friendly neighborhood bar.

My first try at The Griddle was fabulous.  The only issue they had was time of service.  

We went in there as a huge group of people (23) and needed to be served with several different tickets.  The waitstaff didn't even balk at this and quickly helped us by re-arranging tables to accommodate our very large party on a very busy Saturday breakfast rush!  

That was nice.  Then came the menu which is plenty diverse for a breakfast and lunch joint, and gave us enough options to satisfy the pickiest of people.  

I had a typical breakfast with eggs, sausage and pancakes.  Every item was delicious and settled well, even in a friend's sensitive stomach.  The treat that had us all thrilled was the fresh squeezed orange juice.  We are so used to having pre processed OJ that we have all forgotten how good the fresh version is.  This was amazing and allowed one of my daughter's switch from an OJ hater to specifically wanting to return to the restaurant to order OJ!  

The prices were better than average and the food was phenomenal.  The only down we could see was time of service, but I will say we were a huge party in an already heavily attended restaurant!

I will definitely go back!
Delicious burgers and tots! The shakes are out of control. Wonderful service, fun atmosphere, kid friendly. Just simply delicious. Can't wait to come back!

Huge fan of the Korean Japchae. The ugly bop is my fav, a mix of sweet potato noodles & rice, with the crunchy cabbage & fried chicken with the perfect tuned sauce to your liking. It's  winning lunch combo & that white sauce is magic - always ask for extra!

Nice looking place. But once you get inside the hosts seem like they could care less to be there and was not keeping up with the waitlist. We went straight to the bar after getting on the wait list and didn't get helped for at least 15 minutes (we were the only ones at the bar) once we got helped it took another 30 minutes for the bartender (Nicole J.) to acknowledge us to get our actual order. The "bottomless mimosas" was basically orange juice with a splash of champagne. Eggs Benedict was completely flavorless. Needless to say DO NOT waste your time or money at this place. Shit service
Great service. Great food. The lemonade with ice cream is the bomb. I highly recommend going here. Menu is big as well. A lot of options.

I forgot to take pictures of what we order, but our server was super nice. The coffee was so good and my cup was never empty. I order the biscuits and gravy and it had so much flavor.  My boyfriend order the Chilaquiles w carnitas and they look good and tastes excellent and for me being Mexican I am picky on my Chilaquiles so I enjoy them. The orange juice wow! It was so refreshing.  I am definitely coming back.
Very bad experience high pressure sales tactics, worse I've ever seen. Wouldn't take no for an answer. I lost $1000.
Great atmosphere! Great host and staff! Wonderful food and sake! Can't wait to come back!

So I posted a review on 2/29/20, see there was a response on 3/13/20.  What a joke that response is.  I contacted the email address the rep listed and NOTHING happened and no one contacted me from the dealership.  As a matter of fact they blamed me for the damaged they caused.  So ask yourself this why would the rep from send me to a corporate email address rather than contacting me directly.  They have my contact information cus I tried to work this out with them.  Or better yet, why not ask me to call so they can fix it?  Well because they are not trustworthy and they are not honest.  Every one of their responses to a negative review says the same thing; contact the corporate email they give you.  It's called the run around because the people who can do something are at the dealership not in some room with a 1,000 others typing out responses to something they know nothing about.  The response I got is the typical response to ALL negative reviews.  Probably a cut and paste that is from a script.  Look for yourself as it relates to the negative reviews.  I am being truthful when I tell you to RUN, RUN, RUN from this place.  They do not honor anything except making money no matter the cost to the consumer and that is a FACT.  I have all the proof.
Great experience all around! The menu is fantastic. The milkshakes are stunning. Love the decor. Service, friendliness, presentation, taste all 5 stars.

I am glad that so many people like this place, and that it gets a lot of love.  Unfortunately, for me the food was not very good. The pancakes were rubbery, the fried potatoes had no seasoning, and the shredded pork omelette special which had the potential to be really great also fell flat due to lack of seasoning/flavor.  There was only a tiny amount of Chile verde on top. I had to add a bunch of Tapatio to give it any flavor.  Maybe I just caught them on an off day.

I sat at CarMax for 4 hours frustrated trying to purchase a car. It was my first time buying a car and I needed a little extra reassurance and assistance. I was very frustrated by my experience because there was not one person that went out of there way to help me try to solve the problems I was facing, including the employee I was working directly with. Once she left, everyone just sat around and watched me struggle. It was both embarrassing and frustrating. However what changed my experience was an employee named Kiel, if you are purchasing a car at this Carmax I can not recommend Kiel enough. He is the only one who offered to help me,  even though he was with another customer! He offered me empathy and assistance. Later when I returned with what I needed, he had me in and out of the dealership in 30-45 minutes! He was very professional and so helpful, without him I would not have been able to purchase the car. I honestly would not shop for a car here unless I was working directly with him.

We enjoyed the food here but felt let down when a dish we had ordered (carne asada) was immediately served to the manager's friend, who walked in ~15 min after us. So we waited more than half an hour while everyone around us was served, and by the time our food arrived, I regretted ordering it because it made us late to an appointment that day. I can understand wanting to take care of friends who visit the restaurant, but as new customers, we were really bummed.

Bummed...website says Monday 11:30am-9pm, no sign on door and not answering the phone.  I know staff is tough right now, but it takes one person to stick a sign on the door.  I always say "if they don't care I guess I shouldn't either" so won't make plans there again :-(

Friend recommended Coned for dinner tonight. It was amazing. One cone filled me up. It was a mix of cheesy, saucy, meaty goodness stuffed in a perfectly cooked bread cone. I got the meat lovers, and my son got the classic pepperoni. We will defiantly be returning to try other cones at Coned.

Our first time to this restaurant with 2-5 year old kids and 2 adults.   Everything was fantastic.   We ordered.  Everything came out as ordered except my wife. - they mixed the order up.   But they fixed it quickly and it was not a big deal to us.    They said they would comp her dinner.  I said no  way.  Kids got desert but they split it for us.   Great place great service and food is as advertised.   Could not ask for better service and food.

I really wanted to love this dry cleaner. More eco friendly dry cleaning is what I prefer for my husband's suits. I was even willing to drive half an hour for drop-off/pick-up. 

The first time I went the owner was at the front counter. While I had researched them before going, I wanted to know if there was anything more about their processes before I dropping off. His manner was gruff and rude. He raised his voice and spoke at a hurried pace, like my questions were a waste of his time, and he suggested I look at the website for more info. He also said it would be about five days to get items back. I didn't know him well, so thought he might be having an off day and decided to give it a go and leave the clothes. They did an ok job with the clothes. 

The next time I went the the owner was there again. Still somewhat gruff, but not as much. I was dropping off a dress of my own as well as my husbands clothes. I also wanted the dress hemmed. He told me he would have to charge me the cleaning price of a gown, and quoted around $30! For a dress, not a gown! His logic was that there were two layers of fabric in the skirt, a liner, and a sheer fabric. So it would "take hours to press". Seriously? Because the dress came in an envelope, squished, and it took twenty minutes to steam at home. Oh, and they no longer offer alterations. Forever the dress then, I just wanted to be lazy. I will clean it myself. 

Upon returning for my husbands clothes a different woman was at the front counter. She was informing all clients that it would be a week or so before they would get clothes back now. Final strike for me. I've researched and found another dry cleaner who has better customer service.

WHERE HAVE YOU BEEN ALL MY LIFE??? This place is a must try!!! We stopped by based on the reviews in Yelp and it didn't disappoint one bit.  We had the most knowledgeable server Lori and everything she recommended, we ordered without hesitation...and so glad we did!!  The service, the food and the atmosphere (including music) was off the charts!  Even the apparel was cool (totally bought a shirt!).
This is how the restaurant corked our bottle of wine.  The bartender was awful and completely nasty. Luckily the waitress was decent . I hope she didn't have to share her tip with him.

One star is too generous. Went into the nearly empty restaurant and ordered two sides of hash browns.  We noticed the table next to us ordering breakfast for several men after we placed our order.  Their complete breakfasts came out so we reminded the waitress that our food still hadn't been served despite them ordering after us.  Finally our food was served 40 minutes after we ordered! Mind you, it was hash browns. In a crappy breakfast joint. At breakfast.  How hard can that be?  Obviously too hard for this place.   We paid for the coffee and left, never to return.

A book store!! And a discount one at that! I was so excited to see this store when I came to shop at Ross tonight. I went inside to browse, and they have some really great finds. They have new books available for a great deal. For example, they had the popular kid books out (like Diary of a Wimpy Kid & Dogman) for about half the price of other stores. They have the books (new & used) organized very well, and there were some fun titles I found. They also have games, CDs, DVDs, puzzles, toys & more!
Do not go here. only sells dud disposables and will scam you. save your money. Horrible customer service as well.

My friend and I tried this restaurant today for lunch based on the many glowing reviews.  I ordered the steak salad and she ordered the grilled cheese and tomato basil soup.  Sadly her soup was barely lukewarm and my steak was well done (I ordered it medium rare) but the flavors in both meals were spot on, so, despite the shortcomings, we really enjoyed it.  The service was slow but very pleasant however our server automatically added a 20% tip, which I found offensive and quite presumptuous (I am usually a very good tipper, unless it is an awful experience) so that was not a good ending to a yummy meal.  I plan to eat there again but hope they bring me hot and correctly prepared food.  Oh, one other thing, I think it must have been the manager, but our server reported to him that my steak was well done and he came to our table within minutes and couldn't do enough to make it right - he wanted to grill me another steak (I said thank you, but no), he said he would take care of my check and I again said thank you, but that was not necessary because the flavors were so good, so he then offered to bring us dessert and I told him let's wait and see if we have enough room for dessert.  We did order the apple crisp and it was sooooooooooo good, but HUGE!!!  It is definitely a dessert to be shared and worth endulging in.  And one more thing:  I'm looking forward to having a meal and drinks on their patio when the warmer weather (finally) arrives!

What a fun place! If you want an experience when you dine out Sids Garage is a great place to go for the whole family. The milkshakes are incredible.  We had a seasonal inspiration, it was a "Death by chocolate" shake. Whipped ice cream, chocolate chips, buttercream and chocolate cookie crumb rimmed glass with a large slice of luscious fudgy chocolate cake on top! Sooo good. I also saw a fruity pebbles one with a giant rainbow lollipop. They serve "The Boss Hog" in a old 70s style lunchpail and for the truly dramatic, a "Smoke" filled glass box brought to our table filled with a serving of Bourbon glazed goat cheese stuffed bacon wrapped dates, heavenly! Deep fried deviled eggs-great! Pork belly beer sauce tots-great! I am definitely going back to try those Truffle Parmesan fries, they looked amazing. Great service! Only down side, the seats were a little uncomfortable(all metal) and crowded. Sids you need a larger place?! Loved it!

This Denys (on Eagle and Fairview in Meridian ID) is the worst one I have ever been to. The staff takes forever to seat you, forever to get your drink order and the person taking your drink order forgets to tell your waitress, not only that, but forgets to tell her your sitting in her area. Don't order an appetizer because the same thing happens, just like your drinks. Asking for napkins it's like pulling teeth,  you only get one per person.  Couldn't get to go boxes either, NO ONE WAS EVER AROUND!!
Great place to look for gently used books. Many topics to choose from. Everything is organized and staff is always willing to help. Love the records section also.
Atmosphere was great and the food was very authentic.  We had Pollo Al la creama and chicken enchiladas.  Highly recommend!  Salsa is the best I have had since we were in Mexico.  We will be back!
Our favorite breakfast spot. Quiche is the best ever and of course they always treat their customers like regulars! Big menu, great portions...can never go wrong eating here!
