I feel so mixed!!! It's loud in here it was busy. Like we could not have a conversation at our table. Also, once we got seated the tables didn't have enough chairs? So I had to stand for a while and wait for a chair to become available. Once we got over those little bits - our experience got better. 

Eric was working the whole restaurant and he was awesome! Kudos to that guy - please give him a high five. 

You go to the far counter to order, and then sit back down and wait for food. The bacon appetizer was good! Someone at our table ordered a burger that came in an old metal lunchbox. that was kind of cool. :) 

The milkshake list looked phenomenal but we were WAY too full. We might try it again - but it sounds like they are opening up downtown which I would be excited to try!

I have had my fair share of burgers in the world but nothing beats this meat!! From apps to brews wow wow! First time here and we had the Maui Wowie burger+the ultimate mac & cheese and the chimay red dark ale! (Hubby and I spilt it all) we need to be rolled out of here! Haha soooo BOMB! Highly recommend! Wow!
Nashville hot chicken was BUSSIN!!! Loved the fries and deviled eggs as well. Need to try a burger next time.

Not only is the selection great, so is the pricing. 
I have to brag about the eyes center in Costco, called
Meridian Eyes. 
Usually I pay 85.00 for an exam. Same here at Costco.
But at Meridian Eyes inside Costco, I got a thorough exam
with images of my eyes showing things I thought I would only
see or find in my doctor's office. They even communicate images
to my doctor. The eyes tell more about health than I ever imagined.
I have been going to eye doctors for years and why wasn't I shown
this technology before? I was told it is not new technology. 
Usually I pay 300.00 for a pair of glasses from one of the chain
exam places. A little more at the local eye doctor buildings. 
For a pair of prescription polarized sunglasses, and two pair of
name brand prescription glasses, I paid 319.00 out the door. I don't mind waiting 10 days at those prices. 
Friendly staff and doctors here. Highly recommend!

Tried this for the first time, but wasn't impressed. Choices were typical for this kind of place, but the food wasn't outstanding. The veggies are steamed from frozen packages. The meats were ok, but I've had better. Their curry is unremarkable. 

The help was uninspiring and when he brought our food, he had his thumb over the rim of the bowl. Not very sanitary. 

Prices aren't cheap after they add on all the extras for brown rice, curry sauce, etc. I can get a hot, very fresh don-buri bowl at a Japanese restaurant for the final price. 

Won't be returning

While house sitting in Kuna I needed a grocery run.  So on my way home from work in Boise, I hit the Winco at the Meridian offramp and decided coffee was in order!  Starbucks rarely disappoints, and this location DID NOT either :)  Quick zip through the drive though and a venti iced caramel macchiato was making my evening MUCH BETTER.  Viva las Starbucks!

I recently had a bathroom remodel that I needed to have done. I had four estimates for other contractors and none of them just felt right to me, and the prices that I was receiving were incredible high. I called Gabriel from GM Constuction because he was referred to me by a friend and he was able to come by the same day I called. Gabriel was fantastic! He took the time to walk through everything and explained to me how the whole process of a bathroom remodel works. He also took the time to listen to what I was saying and to what I wanted done in the bathroom. Gabriel summited his estimate to me in a very timely fashion, not only was he more then affordable the work that he did and the time he spent was really incredible. Gabriel was so meticulous and took such pride in his work it was really enjoyable to what him work and to see the project all come together. I will never call another contractor for my home improvement needs. 

I love my bathroom! Thank you so much Gabriel!!

The staff is so friendly and always makes sure they get your order right and the restaurant is very clean and a family environment. And the food is just amazing, I especially love the vegan option! The portions are pretty big too. One of my favorite places to eat.

this was my second time back, and during this visit I had a pedicure in cold water, not even warm. They said all the stations were like that but another worker had told her client she will get her a chair with hot water. Only certain chairs had cold... they did not wait for my toes to dry which caused my toe nail polish to scrape off when he put my sandals on and did not fix. A month ago a pedicure was $31, now a regular pedicure is $35.

Really good pizza & great Bronx boys ice cream sandwiches. If they ever have their elote pizza again as a special, I highly recommend it. For the month they had it on special I got it a good 5 times. And one time they had lemon cookie Bronx boys... dang. So good.
I have now purchased several cars from CarMax and am still amazed at how hassle free the car buying experience is. Thank you for another great experience guys!!!!!

Okay guys, ready for it? Tony G's is legit. If you are looking for an authentic pie thats savory and absolutely  nails the texture right then tony g's is the place to be. I have had many pies from west coast to east coast and these hold up to many that top my list. Ingredients are on point and its always cooked perfect. Give it a shot you won't be let down, and hey I think you might even ltearn a thing or two eating THIS pie. Nice job Tony... keep it going and eat up boise!

Go to Bish's next door for better service and prices. 
Service is so so if you're buying a new RV, but horrible otherwise. 
They put a hold on funds when I ordered online, then charged me again when the item was shipped. I was told the hold would be released in "a few days". What if I didn't have enough money in my account for twice the amount of my order? They could have easily over drafted my account but no one seems to care. This is a horrible policy, I wonder how many people it has screwed over. 
The service department is a joke. I had an 8 AM appt on Monday. When I dropped our trailer off they informed me it would get put in line and looked at sometime in the next 10 days. WHAT? Why do I have an appt?
I decided to give them another chance and they raped me for $4 a gallon for propane. I can get it down the street for 1/3 that price  
NEVER AGAIN YOU LYING THEIVES!

We were just driving through town from Bend, OR on our way to Colorado.  Super creative to serve pizza in a cone.  My 13 yr old was so enamored, put away a 2nd meat lovers and still had room for a s'mores!
Amazing burgers and sides, great customer service, and excellent prices for the quality you receive! I will continue to support this local business.
Great burgers, awesome location, great service, shakes are out of this world, be prepared for a food coma.  We will be back for another cheat day soon.  Kids loved it too.

The staff was friendly enough. We sat down and ordered drinks. We got margaritas. The house margarita tasted like pure salt. Salt slushee.. yuck. The mango margarita had a funny taste. No tequila in it and it was awful as well. We decided if the drinks were that bad should we risk eating there. Our answer was NO!!! I hope they make some drastic changes for the better. It's a shame because we don't have an awesome Mexican restaurant in Idaho. You know it's sad when Taco Bell, Costa Vita, and Cafe Rio are way better than a nice sit down restaurant.

Friendly and helpful management.  Nice and new apartments in just about the most convenient location possible ! Close to world class shopping and dining.  Alway responsive to my questions and safe neighborhood for families.

Couldn't tell if the jewelry was great or not, because we only spent a couple of minutes in the shop before leaving. We pulled up in a Jeep and had street clothes on, so I guess we are street bums. The service was insulting from the minute we walked in, don't try to explain what you want without the correct jargon or the staff will roll eyes with some attitude for trying to explain what you wanted. We even stayed longer to see the collection, but it only got worse! We already had other engagement rings picked out, so their loss. Service was so horrible I had to write this. I went to every shop in Boise, ID. And this is the only shop I don't recommend.

I think this is the best coffee around! It's not bitter, but smooth & delicious. They can make almost any drink sugar free & dairy free! There are a lot of snack options, and non coffee options for the kiddos. This location has a great group of people working there!

My wife had the veggie omelette and I had the Italian scramble. Both were excellent. The service was friendly and efficient and they got us a place to sit as quickly as was reasonable considering how busy they were. The food came out very quickly, hot and delicious. I wouldn't hesitate to recommend this place.

Excellent breakfast spot, never disappoints! 

Honestly, this isn't your most fancy restaurant but everything about it makes you feel right at home. Staff is very friendly and accommodating, super efficient and pay close attention to detail. Example, our 10 month old is just learning how to eat "adult food" but he makes quite the mess. We told the staff that we had a baby when we came inside, they found a great spot and even put white paper under the high chair to catch any mess. It's this attention that makes me appreciate them and want to come back. Where most restaurants see children as an inconvenience or burden, the staff here are accommodating and prepared.  

Ordered food and food came out in less than 8 minutes. I was super impressed by this and also amazed by how yummy the food was. Those red house potatoes were something else, highly recommend! All in all a great experience and very welcoming environment! Two thumbs up!

Updated review to add a little more deets. Nothing major. 

Love coming here for a sweet treat. 
-My favorite so far is the red wonder. It consists of biscoff spread with whipped topping along with strawberries and raspberries. 

-I have also had the banana cream pie which has chocolate sticks inside of the waffle. Personally not our favorite because the chocolate sticks overpowered the whole thing. Besides who has had chocolate on their banana cream pie? I have never. 

-My husband loves the plain liege waffle with whipped cream. He's a simple dude! But he also really loved their chicken and waffles which was really yummy because the chicken was fresh and had the perfect amount of crunch to it. It comes with two sauces (one savory, one sweet) which are realllly tasty. I would get that for lunch! I have almost tried them all besides some savory ones. The only other savory I've had is the grilled cheese which is appetizing. It has some good seasoning in the grilled cheese, to me it reminds me of rosemary but I could be wrong and then when you dunk it in their heavenly tomato bisque! Mmmm. 

-Others I have tried are the sunshine, cinnalove and then the dulce. The sunshine is good but really tart because of the lemon curd (duh, of course! Lemon!). The cinnalove was good but realllly sweet because of the cinnamon glaze they too if off with. I felt like it needed whipped cream to help combat all the sweetness goin on. Last but not least the dulce is yummy because they roll their ice cream in these crunchy sweet flakes, it's just a lot though so be aware you may have to share (oh that rhymed lol). So all in all I guess what I'm trying to say is that I have been here quite a bit. Wear your stretchy pants because you can't have just one!
Light ice means less than half. Since it was a mobile order, I couldn't have it remade.

What a great local ice cream shop.  The bonus is the waffle cones.  The brilliant thing they offer is bags of waffle cone pieces that you can grab to take home with whatever ice cream flavor you choose.... There are so many great flavors it's hard to have a favorite.  If you're craving ice cream, this is a must to try at least once.
We love Cupbop! The combo of rice, noodles, sauce, proteins and veggies are wonderful! Thanks Cupbop!

This is our go to spot when we need some ice cream!! Good selection of flavors and the portion size is better than most creamery spots we have been too. They are great about letting you sample their flavors. They have a fun selection of waffle cones dipped in chocolate with nuts and candies. 

I don't understand the reviews on here where people are complaining about the price of Reed's ice cream. Clearly some patrons don't go to many ice cream shoppes. Check out Baskin Robbins price, portion size, and flavor of their product, then compare it to Reed's. Then you can go back and update your comment!

This salon came recommended by a friend who goes there for pedicures.  Making an appointment was easy enough and the experience itself was fine, but poor nail prep & low quality products have resulted in me losing 3 nails in 10 days. The first nail was lost 3 days post mani, the entire nail just popped off. After that repair, it was losing a nail every two days.  Not worth my time to go back for a shoddy fix. The repair job on the first nail is uneven and bubbled.   Maybe they're decent at pedicures but I won't be trying them again.  Waste of $60 and an even bigger waste of my time.  I've been getting acrylic nails for over ten years and this is the worst experience I've had.

Clayton is the best in the business! I first started going to him for eyelash extensions and now he takes care of all my beauty facial stuff. Thank you for making me feel 10 years younger and for always taking care of my beauty needs! You are the absolute best!!

Although this is a good place to find items at a reasonable (not GREAT)price, their policy stinks when it comes to having them consign your furniture.

First, they take 50% which is ridiculously high. Then we had 3 items to sell and agreed to 3months to have them sell all pieces so they could cut us one check. Sounded good.....until they sold all of our items only to tell us we now have to wait 2 more months before they send us a check...WHAT? ARE THEY KIDDING?

What a racket. They now have made 50% off the sell and now get to sit on MY 50% and make interest for THEM

I will never use this "convenience" again. I do better on Offer Up or Craigslist.

They lost two stars today.... They cook scrambled eggs like most folks like... creamy and soft.  Ugh... I cannot.  I asked for the breakfast burrito which I normally really enjoy, however today was not that day.  I asked the eggs be scrambled hard and I got soft and gooey.  It was horrible.  I will never order that again.  I'll only order things that I can actually verify are cooked thoroughly from now on.  The staff here are wonderful!  I'm hoping they can regain their 5 star review next time by honoring a customer's request.  They are absolutely worth coming here tho... son and dad both loved their soft eggs.  Apparently it's just me....

Live rather close and have been a fan of this location and others around the area. I went in late one night, cutting close to running into locked doors but I did order ahead and was aware of my late order so I had tipped 8 dollars in cash. I had asked for a dairy free veggie pizza on the regular crust family size.. they insisted on it being on thin crust because it was cheaper I replied I liked the regular crust better. And wanted to make sure it wasn't going to be on thin. I had orders extra toppings, got another pizza, and a two liter of Pepsi. When I got home after shopping around at the Albertsons near by, I nearly cried realizing my whole pizza adventure had been for nothing realizing it was made with their white sauce. I saved my pizza in the fridge after work the next day. I arrived with pizza intact and in hand and told the front of house. They seemed unimpressed and unfazed about my issue. They said all they could do was give me a half off pizza. Since that was the best they could do I agreed, so I could finally get my pizza needs taken care of. I wasn't paying attention when they handed me my pizza and when I went to through it in the oven. It was only a large and it was made on thin crust.

One of the best car buying experience I've had.  We were there from 9:30-4:00 only because I couldn't  decide on what car to purchase.  There was no pressure and they really made the entire process amazing!!!  My son went with me and he bought a car from them too.  This was his second purchase from CarMax and they have two customers for life.  I would recommend CarMax to anyone who his thinking about purchasing a vehicle!!

We'd been to Sid's a couple times before and were excited to share it with our son who is visiting from out of town. Initially things went as predicted, but fell off the rails when I noticed other diners who had been seated after us receiving food. When I ask the waitress  if our food was coming she rather snarkily said that "we're really busy and the food comes out as it's ordered" then walked off without offering to check on the order's status. I started a stopwatch on my phone and set it on the table. Nearly seven minutes later, after the 40 we'd been waiting at the table, a guy comes by to say, "we've had an issue and would you tell me what you ordered to make sure we have the right food?" Which really means that the food order had been entirely lost and no one was willing to acknowledge that fact.  All that and our table was next to the expediter's station where nearly every employee walked past without noticing, or seemingly caring, that we'd not been served. A frustrating experience tonight with no sincere attempt by anyone to turn our experience around.

Update: In an offline discussion the owner offered a gift card, which I declined.

A really great pizza .... In a cone shape. I was really impressed with the flavor and topping selection.  This a must try when visiting Idaho. I highly recommend and hope they will bring this great idea to Southern California.

I brought my 2011 Ford Fusion to Bobby's for transmission diagnostic and repairs. My fusion was acting so goofy one day when driving down to Kuna that I was sure the transmission was going to transmission heaven. However, Bobby's reassured me that it could be something on a much smaller scale that could be very easy to repair. Well, a phone call later from Greg and I was told that the transmission needed to be flushed (horrible old transmission fluid) and I needed a new top and bottom mount. I gave them the green light for the bottom torque mount and the flush. The service was GREAT! I got my car back the very next day and my car runs like new. Greg was great to work with. If I have any transmission (I pray I don't) I will bring my car back to them again and again. Thank you for all you did Bobbys!

I had my first meal at their village location. I'm an outside sales rep and go to a lot of restaurants and found out they opened about 5 min from my house and was looking forward to trying it out. I was really disappointed. First The waitress was extremely rushed and gave me the rundown and then wanted my order ASAP. My side (fried deviled eggs. Tasted good) came out a good bit before my burger so I had the choice to eat my side alone or let it get cold before my burger. The burger came out and was good as well. However scarcely had a finished my side the waitress had taken my side plate and asked me if I needed anything else.(I'd only been in the restaurant for like 10min at this point). Then about 5min later( I was partially through my burger she came by to take payment.) Her handhelds were acting up so she had to take 3 trips to get another and then told me if it didn't work this time I'd have to use a different card. After about 3 min of trying to get my card to go thru with a partially eaten burger on my plate she had me get up and go to the counter where the card reader finally worked. 

After about 16min in the restaurant I've paid $26 for a burger and side. Then I get my receipt and realize I've been charged 2.5% for using a credit card? 

Food was decent but unfortunately after this I won't be back.
Good food, but a word of advice: don't go here when they're busy.  Their staff is obviously undertrained and it was obvious that the entire staff was overwhelmed even though they weren't that busy.

HUGE shoutout to Consign Furniture for getting me moved into my apartment with all the furniture I bought today! I furnished my entire living room for such an awesome price  The service was great, I didn't feel pressured to buy, and I left with some really cool pieces! Thanks again everyone! I will be referring you to everyone I know :) 

I'm also not sure why the last two reviews were negative? My uncle is constantly selling furniture through this store (how I was referred here) and he raves about their service. Maybe make sure you know what selling through a consignment store is like first? ...It's actually pretty common to receive only a percentage of the sale, and for good reason -- it's being showcased in a furniture store ‍

This place has a really good atmosphere. You walk in the door and hear everyone yell "welcome". The people are friendly. And the fries are hands down the best fries I have ever had. The burger was perfect. It was so full of flavor and the right amount of heat. Our lunch here was so good it had me dancing in my seat.

I hired Ryan Boudreau of Boise Air Duct Cleaning to clean my air ducts in May of 2016.  He cut a hole in the side of my Heating, Ventilation and Air Conditioning (HVAC) unit to inspect the evaporator coil and adjacent ductwork.  Upon installing the sheet metal patch to cover the hole, used for inspection, Ryan pierced my evaporator coil with a sheet metal screw releasing the refrigerant.  At the time, I was not aware that the damage occurred.  When I turned my air conditioning on for the first time the following month, there was no cooling.  I called an HVAC company to diagnose the problem, which was quickly determined to be the sheet metal screw that pierced my evaporator coil.  When I explained the situation to Ryan, initially he said his insurance company would not cover the cost and that he would see what he could do to come up with the $1361 to cover the repair.  Days later, Ryan told me that he would only give me $466.67 as this was what his insurance company said was appropriate.  This amount does not even take into account labor costs.  I had to take Ryan to small claims court (January 20, 2017) where the judge ruled a default judgment in my favor because Ryan did not show up for the hearing.  As of this date, I am waiting for Ryan to pay me the money he owes me.

Think twice and very hard if you opt to let CF sell your furniture.  My couch sold the end of March and when I went in the store on Apr. 1st to "renew" my contract, it was only then that I was informed my couch sold.  They told me I would get a check for my 50% of the sale by the end of the month.  I'm still waiting for my check after being told it was mailed out on the 20th of Apr.  Several phone calls to inquire as to where my check is I get a condescending attitude and the runaround and believe they've lied to me about it coming from accounting in Reno!  Called Reno...nope, that's not where it's coming from...the same place they sold it...what do ya know, right here in Boise.  Con artists; don't do business with this shady company.
We love Rudy's. Great meals every time. Great kids meals, friendly staff. We have frequented often since finding it a few months ago. We might even go tonight!

So I have been an avid Einstein oilery user for a long time always loved their service and speed. You couldn't hardly get down the drive before they were knocking at the window asking if you wanted a drink or a paper. I hardly got a half assed greeting and waited longer then I have ever waited ever for a simple oil change. I waited for over 40 mins to just get in. This place is an absolute joke now not impressed. Won't be coming back very sad seeing a great business gone.

Got to come here for a rare date night on the dime of a gift-card and we were so pleased!

We arrived during happy hour and got to enjoy some local beer from Bear Island. I ordered the chicken and waffles and my husband ordered the center cut filet. 

I have never ordered chicken and waffles before. But something about this called to me... I think it was the promise of a savory waffle. And ETC delivered! It was filled with hatch chiles and had a light, fluffy inside and a crunchy, exterior. I love how deep their waffle holes are. More space for me to smear butter into. :) The chicken was FANTASTIC! It is brined and so tender. The crunchy batter has a nice spice to it that will leave your lips slightly on fire, only to be quenched by the sweet syrup. My only regret was that there was not a vegetable in sight. Should have ordered a side salad to make me feel a little better about my choices. 

My husband liked his steak. It was accompanied by a pile of crispy fried onions, mashed potatoes and tender asparagus. I didn't bother trying it because I couldn't take my eyes off my chicken and waffle. 

The tables were well spaced, staff was in masks and the service was great! So happy to have a cool, local eatery in Meridian downtown.

Crispy chicken sandwich is great however their side salad (two cucumber slices and lettuce) was extremely disappointing. Where's the cheese, onion and croutons?! Hangover bloody Mary's are good with a little mini snack size grilled cheese on top. Bottomless mimosas are all orange juice.

I don't usually leave negative feedback, especially since I realize many restaurants are struggling right now. I was with Josh when four of us were turned away before closing. I understand how it's difficult to find employees who want to work, especially near closing time, and I never want to be the one holding employees after hours. When they told us they were already closed, and then said they closed at 8:00, I was kind of shocked. After reading the response from the owners, I can now see where the employee's attitude comes from. We were definitely there before closing. In fact, Josh posted his review as we were sitting at our table at another restaurant. According to the time stamp, Sid's should've still been opened. 

We go out to eat frequently, but we won't be spending any of our money there. It makes sense why they went out of business with their first restaurant, my guess is they are working on strike two. 

Note to owners: Even if you don't agree with a review, posting a comment about how you can prove it's wrong (when there are multiple witnesses that can prove it's not) won't help your cause.


Edit: "...our team was serving people all the way up through close per receipts."  - response from owners when Josh claimed they refused service prior to closing. Sure sounds to me like making excuses and proving the customer wrong. The good news is, there are a dozen restaurants within walking distance and another one was more than happy to take our money, and seat us in time for Josh to write a review prior to the actual closing time of your restaurant. 

As a business owner, I would rather learn from the mistake, and train my employees (or perhaps myself) on the fine art of customer service. Excuses NEVER fix anything. Hopefully you figure it out before more people have the same negative experience we had.  

For the record, I was willing to just walk away and not come back. The negative review came after your arrogance in responding to Josh. Coupled with the way we were treated by your employees, I felt it merited me wasting my time to write a review.

Final Update: If anyone wants to read the owners actual initial response, it's in their reply to Josh's post, and was the main reason I decided to rate them as well. I gave them an honest review from my perspective. I quoted word-for-word above (hopefully they don't edit it). I'm not into bullying anyone, I was actually excited to try out this new place (it was my idea to go there).

WOW!! This place was absolutely amazing. This is the best ramen I have ever had, and I am a ramen connoisseur. My two friends and I ate here two nights ago and we exceptionally pleased with service and quality. Loved this place, best ramen in Boise, best ramen I have ever had ever in my life.

Oh my this place is amazing! We tried Banana Cream Pie which consists chocolate stuffed inside the waffle then sliced of bananas & whipped cream on top! We also tried Red Wonder; which consists of biscoff crumbles, slices of strawberries, whipped cream & raspberries! Both of the waffles are delicious!
Yes their price is a little bit higher for a waffles, but it's so worth it! 
The next time when we come back I want to try their savory waffles!

I went to Sid's for the first time with a friend this afternoon for lunch.  

When we entered, I thought to myself "this is going to be cool", as I pulled  the door handle which was actually an old gas nozzle.  The inside was supposed to resemble a car garage which they somewhat pulled off.  The staff was as friendly as one would expect from a fairly new establishment. 

One of the servers came over to give us the rundown on how things work there.  Basically, you check out the menu then go up to the counter and order your food.  While she was giving her spiel, I could barely make out what she was saying over the blaringly loud grunge music.  I politely said to her "I'm sorry, I'm really having a tough time hearing you.  Is it possible to have the music turned down just a bit?"  She curtly, but somewhat politely said "no" that that is part of the whole ambiance.  So I asked her if she would speak up.  She continued, but made little effort to accommodate.  

After deciding  that we would stick it out and try to make the best of it, I ordered the Maui Wowie hamburger and shared the Stuffed Bacon Wrapped Dates and a beer from their average range of selection.  

The food was very good and cooked exactly as ordered.  The dates were delicious.  The service was fast and friendly.  

I'm giving this joint  2 stars because when I go to a place like Sid's, I go for the overall experience which includes the food, the decor, service and yes... the music. 

Look, I'm a music guy and grew up playing electric guitar and listening to heavy metal and 90's grunge.  I also happen to be a car guy and watch the Motor Trends channel whenever I can.   That said, I have never once walked into a "garage" where the music was so loud that you can barely hear the mechanic tell you what they found wrong with your car.  So I don't really get what Sid's is trying to accomplish with that.  

I thought "perhaps they're trying to attract a younger crowd?".  But at those prices, I seriously doubt today's "younger crowd" can afford this kind eatery.

Again, the food is good, but if I'm going to pay that kind of money, I want the full experience and dine there...but I'm not willing to wear earplugs during my visit.  What about take-out?  Look, there are a multitude of take-out options out there that are equally as good without the steep pricing (for example, Homestead Bar and Grill on Linder and Chinden), so I doubt I will ever order take-out from Sid's.  

Sorry, guys.  Let me know if you ever change your music-volume policy as I would love to give you guys a second chance.  

Wishing you much success.

PS - It was refreshing to see that this establishment has opted to not require it's employees to wear masks as allowed by the recently lifting of the county-wide mandate.  Perhaps a sign that we are finally heading in the direction of normalcy!

UPDATED:  Received a response from owner who elaborated on key points concerning the food quality and quantity of the sides.  Both, excellent points. I would consider the curb-side pick up.  I further revised the review from 2 to 3 stars in the spirit of fairness and the fact that I appreciate when ANY business owner or team member takes the time to write a lengthy, on-point response to a customer's review/concerns.
Brian helped us out with some root intrusions was great. I'd definitely recommend their services.

Frankie's has only been open for two months and we just found it today. I feel like I've been ripped off!! I lost two months of a quiet morning cup of coffee with a fountain and birdsong as my backdrop. 

I tried the house coffee today, and the Huevos Rancheros. Great flavor describes both, add ascetic appeal to the breakfast plate! 

The staff are very friendly and eager to get the word out about this new place. And they should be. They have a charming place and should be thrilled with the opportunity before them. 

Good luck, Frankie!
Service was horrible and took 2 weeks to get into my car. And the customer service rep was very unprofessional and rude.

These apartments are very nice, however, the management's frequent emails and rules were frustrating and annoying. Moving into an apartment community with pets is challenging, and we moved from a house into an apartment until our next home was being renovated.  We stayed less than three months, and today I received the final "bill".  Rather than receive a refund of my deposits, I have to pay to have carpet replaced.  This carpet began to smell 3 days after I moved into the apartment.  That cost alone is astronomical, but there's more.  We received frequent complaints from management about our pets barking, despite having bark collars on.  The neighbors upstairs would stomp on the floor if the dogs barked, and they'd bark more, so more stomping would ensue.  Then I'd get an email from the management about a bark complaint.  BUT I never complained about the dog across the street that barked all day long and no one stopped that.  There was poop everywhere, all over the grounds, despite the fact that supposedly everyone had to pick up after their dog.  We got emails about storage containers on our deck not being in compliance, but I counted about 5 residents that had storage containers on their deck, as well as trash, shelving units with paper towels, etc.  Today I called to discuss an additional rent fee, even though I paid the the rent as per written move out calculation paperwork.  I was told to call back later, as they managers were busy.  I asked if she could take my phone numbers and have them call me.  She said, "No" as they were in meetings and she wouldn't want them to miss me when they called back. I tell you, this place seems like a nice, attractive place to live, but beware of the Pet friendly connotation and staff who are appear nice on the surface but won't help resolve issues.  This apartment complex has been nothing but a frustrating experience for me and my family.  I wouldn't recommend at all as they are nice and accommodating when moving in but become very unwilling to assist afterwards.  The fact that Marissa couldn't / wouldn't answer my question regarding a rent charge leads me to believe this is a common shady practice with apartment agencies.  They don't even deserve a one star review.

All of the staff were very friendly.  To the gentlemen out there their barber Jess is outstanding. Whether it's a haircut, straight razor shave, or a beard shave. Jess has cut my hair and trimmed my beard twice now both times were excellent.
Burger was unreal!! Got the Jekyll and Hyde, candied bacon, Mac n cheese, and tots. All of it was soo good. And they have Shiner Bock on tap.
Had high hopes for this place ..... but was left disappointed.  The saltiness food I have ever had, from the wings to the burgers.

I have been going to them for 7 YEARS .
Not only have I bought dozens of gift cards for friends and family, but I have personally invested hundreds of dollars into this establishment. 
I bought my mother a  $100 gift card this Christmas... 
They will not honor gift her card even though the reason my mother could not go until now was because of Covid.  And they were CLOSED for months because of COVID and she couldn't go. 
We will not be going back and I will not refer my friends and family. 
Furthermore, today they answered the phone multiple times while giving me a massage. 
The amount of unprofessionalism at this place is sad. It didn't use to be this way.

Usually awesome food. This Sunday the 13th took my family there to have breakfast. There was a large gathering of 8 people, hugging, greeting each other, not a mask on one of them. We asked to be moved and asked the manager to politely asked the people to please sit down and wear masks while standing, yelling etc. The apparent manager, a lady with blonde hair, blue eyes and 40ish informed us she was not enforcing mask mandate and suggested we leave.  We will be calling the health dept on Monday. We have been supportive patrons since the day the griddle opened. We will never return and be telling everyone we know to stay away from the COVID Griddle in Meridian. And to the condescending manager I hope she does not end up with covid.

A true artist! Clayton is the epitome of accommodating! I was at ease the moment I walked into the the salon where Clayton does his magic, especially his work space. I am elated by my microblading and plan to start microneedling and peels on a continuous basis. His pricing is beyond competitive in relation to the quality of his work, I can understand why he is booked as heavy as he is, and it's definitely worth the wait! So happy to be in his care!

My wife and I were just at this Sonic and the complete Order was wrong. We basically paid $11 for a regular and large cup of vanilla ice cream. We ordered the cookie dough blast and again got nothing but vanilla ice cream. We go here about once a week but not any longer!!!!!

Everyone was super nice and it was a loud busy afternoon. Although the food had a great taste our burgers were very greasy and I feel like you didn't quite get the bang for your buck here. Probably won't visit very often

The old standby... gotta love this place. The fusion bowls of Korean(ish) food are really amazing. I love the combinations and my dinner date  (my daughter) had a lot of fun exploring this food for the first time. 

The fact that you dont have to mull over food choices all day is actually quite nice.  

The enthusiasm that I once enjoyed as I walked in when it was first open has come down a notch,  but all in all, still good food, still a unique experience. Have been a lot of times, I dont expect that to change.
First visit and definitely my last.  The waffles were cold and very tough.  Nothing like any waffle I have had before.  You couldn't cut them with the plastic cutlery!  Yuck.

Staff is super friendly and service is great here. You will always get help, only thing was I noticed staff had a hard time figuring where to drop off food at. The fries were ok to me, my wife liked the Cajun fries better than the parmesan truffle fries. The Nashville hot chicken isn't as hot but has good flavor, crispy and tender. The not so wimpy burger was good, I would recommend you try another burger from the menu. There's a good variety of beers there. Atmosphere is nice and like the open floor plan. Definitely a good place to check if your in the area.

Arlene has been able to help restore my sleep pattern, which prior to our sessions I was struggling. I feel like a new person.
Arlene has also help me with my extreme anxiety and stress. I'm able to have little or no symptoms at all. Thank you!!!

Stopped in to kill an hour before meeting some friends for lunch while visiting the Boise area. Asked to see the same model of class c we were looking at in Reno. Discovered the price was $5000 less and they would give us $2400 more for our trade! They sent Juan 470 miles to Northern Nevada for our trailer. Had a wonderful evening. The next day I rode back up with Juan and it couldn't have been a nicer trip. He took me to my hotel, picked me up the next morning to go to the bank and then to get my new RV. I have to say that Juan was more than helpful and made the whole experience great.
They're amazing! Super friendly and always made sure me and my friend liked our nails throughout the process. I live in AZ but I will definitely will be coming back every chance I get. SO GOOD
They make Gluten Free waffles which are delicious! The service is great. We went on a Thursday around 10am, ordering was quick, and it took about 15 minutes to receive our food.

They have hardly worn masks throughout the pandemic. I commented on an Instagram post a while back during the height of Idaho's outbreak questioning their commitment to keep the community safe. They not only deleted the comment, but they also blocked me on Instagram. Their childish response as a business is telling of the type of people who own and run the company. Last time I went in I figured they'd be wearing masks because they began wearing them toward the end of summer, they were not. One of the cooks was sniffling non-stop with a runny nose. Hate to see it. We won't be back. Their priorities are clear. Waffle love? More like Waffle Against Public Safety!

This is our favorite breakfast place. 
Great coffee, and you can't go wrong with their huckleberry pancakes or homemade sausages!
Sam is an attentive server, and Terri will always greet you with a smile!

We had a fantastic experience at Eight Thirty Common! We were there with a large group of 9 and they were very accommodating. The service was great, I loved the atmosphere and the food was exceptional.
Best Mexican food around! I love the fajitas! Really good salsa. People are great and family owned.

This is my 2nd trip to Sids. The 1st time I had one of their burgers. if you are a fan of Wagu, you might like them. For me, I am not a fan.

This time, I had the Nashville Hot Chicken sandwich. Its not a true chicken patty. it was just 2 pieces of chicken strips stuffed between 2 buns and called a sandwich. Not real flavor at all.

Next up are the fries. I tried both the parm fries and the Loco Fries. The parm fries did have some parm cheese on them, which was good, but that was it. The loco fries were...well, lets say I left all of them in the pale they came in. Very greasy and no flavor at all.

Their tag line here at Sids is that we dont do boring. Well, I hate to tell you Sid, but your fries are very boring.

The only bright spot here are the shakes. If you like a good shake, you have to come try these shakes, but I dont recommend any of the food.

O, and before I forget, there is the noise. The music plays very loud here and the place is not that big. So my advice is that if you have young kids, a baby or babies, or you dont like loud music, you will want to re-think a trip to Sids. its very loud!

Ramen was decent but the place was filthy. The tables and chairs were covered in lint and the window sills were covered in cob webs, dust, and dead flies. The server was nice but dressed in a short, revealing dress and sandals, not what you would expect for wait staff. Overall, we won't be back.

No social distancing in place and employees were maskless as well but don't worry..."they'll put one on if you ask"...because that really makes a difference once they've already spread the virus at the table 3 ft from them. Food was good, but wouldn't feel safe eating here.
Fast, Friendly Service, and Fantastic Food & Fare, Priced Right, Quiet atmosphere, Large Portions. Try it, You'll Love this Cafe too... Easy Parking.
Forget it. An hour and a half for a whole pie order? They won't be getting my business today. Maybe never.
Good food, excellent service, friendly staff. It's the next thing in pizza. I recommend to any pizza lover.

One of the very best restaurants in Meridian! AWESOME customer service , delicious food, cool environment. They were busy and we were offered the bar. We took it and honestly so happy we did. We spoke with pretty much every waiter and the owner. I personally watched the owner thank all of his employees when he asked them to do anything and they even had 13 chairs set aside in honor of the heroic military that lost their lives this week. I will now be visiting way more often to experience the service at SIDS!

The dude there was so sweet and helpful!!! Badass fixed my husbands phone charger in under 10 minutes when I was sure it had to be replaced. Was super humble saying he didn't need a tip when I offered but he was deserved one! Glad so had cash on me. Quick and sweet. 

Thankyou!!! We will be back!!

Just got finished with lunch here! First time here and the location was recommended to me. When I checked out the Yelp review and photos and IG page I knew I had to come here. I was not disappointed. Had the bacon and eggs from the Nosh menu and it went fast. That jalapeño candied bacon was amazing. I would definitely order that again. Kids had a kids burger and chose their toppings. We also ordered the Hangover burger and El Jefe. The El Jefe was the best burger I've ever had. Liao fries and taco seasonings....I don't know why I've never tried that before. For dessert we ordered Midnight Munchies. So goooood. The milkshake went so fast we should have ordered two and tried a different flavor. All in all, IM COMING HERE AGAIN!
Haven't been in a bit, won't be going back.piss poor service with only 3 people there and still waited 20min. and for what half burnt pizza !!
Didn't know what to order so my boyfriend ordered for me, totally awesome!! Great food!! Will do this again!

Great burger.  Great fries.  Great service.  But won't go back.  The music is WAY TOO LOUD!!  Couldn't hear myself think let alone hear the people at my table.  They even have a wall that says, "Music too loud?  We'll, turn it up!"  Really? You lost my business and I'm posting a rare review to let others know this might not be the right place due to the blasting 2000's punk/alt music.
Wear a mask! There is a global pandemic and our county has a mask mandate when social distancing is not possible. You are irresponsible and dirty.

The KFCs in Boise are terrible.  They get the order wrong more than half the time.  They almost never have enough extra crispy chicken made to fill up a 12 piece bucket.  Often I have to wait 20 minutes or more to get some.  Tonight it was over 1 1/2 hours till closing and the manager told me they weren't planning to make any more chicken tonight, so I couldn't even wait for extra crispy.  She said that she could give me half extra and half the other, when I got home 4 out of 12 pieces were extra crispy, so her definition of half is suspect.  I'd already given up on the other locations in the area and now it's clear that this is a management problem with the company that owns all the KFCs in the area.  Never again.
Quick service at a very reasonable price.  He rekeyed all of our locks when we bought our house, and has very professional. Would recommend and use again anytime we need locksmith  services.

Arlene is wonderful.
She is professional, prompt, polite and has helped me make huge strides in improving my life in numerous ways.

We stopped in Coned for a quick bite to eat on Saturday.  All 3 of us ordered different cones (Buffalo Chicken, Alfredo Chicken and Chicken Parmesan).  This is definitely a novelty item at $7/cone because I wouldn't pay $7/slice of pizza unless it was REALLY good.  The cone was probably the best part; however, it is very messy to eat once the toppings inside start spilling out.  My daughter's cone did not have the cheese melted all the way through (was still in large chunks and cold in the middle) so they sent it back through the oven for us.  Overall the place is cute and simple.  The staff was just "ok" one of the gentleman working provided better customer service than the other girls.  For as simple as it is and as slow as it was when we stopped in I was surprised to see employees standing around and not cleaning up wiping down tables, there was trash on the floor and the bathroom needed to be cleaned.

Ehhh what can I say.. I tried. I went in for the first time to check it out. I went in for a pedicure nothing crazy. I literally just wanted the pedicure for the soaking, massage, and nail trim. No color for me. Basic right? I went in right when they opened knowing I might not get seen right away without an appointment. The gal at the front rushed me through, yelled at me to go wash my hands. I walked to the back to wash my hands and wow.. the smell.. someone used the bathroom and needed to courtesy flush. Whatever not their fault, but just kinda weird. 
After washing my hands in the poopy bathroom, I stood near the pedicure chairs because no one was telling me where to go next. Someone ordered me to sit at one chair, then told me to move. A technician started working on me, no hello, got up and left. Then someone else came over and said "he needed to go to another person for their appointment". Totally understandable. Then this new guy starts working on me. He was totally rude, really hurt while clipping my cuticles and was all around incredibly rough throughout the whole thing. He actually became more angry that I didn't want polish. He seemed very frustrated and kept bringing it up. I simply replied, "I'm trying to let me nails breathe, it's been a while since I've had a pedicure so I just want to let them breathe." He then made an extremely offensive remark referencing Covid/breathing/to my toes. Off color remark... but yeah I'm not at the point where I really want to joke about this plandemic. As I went to pay he again was rude and rushed. My total came out to $33 dollars... don't know where that number came from. Their prices were listed for other services but I didn't see anything printed or listed on their paper at the front. Hmmm... interesting.

Anyway I won't be returning.

I want to start out by saying atmosphere and service is amazing. No issues there. 

I may be the odd man out but there is literally nothing here besides the steak salad that I actually enjoy. The food is either underwhelming in flavor or doing the absolute most that it is strange. 

I've tried this place multiple times hoping I would find literally anything that I would love and came up empty handed each time.

Moved in January and it started out ok, but they jacked up the price out of nowhere with little/very confusingly worded notice. Terrible communication. We moved out because we found an apartment that was nicer AND cheaper. They made the vacating process way more difficult than it had to be and then after leaving the apartment spotless, they took a huge chunk of our security deposit, likely out of spite. The apartments are new but there are enough annoying little problems from poor/rushed construction to really put you off. Don't waste your time.
First time here and it looks, smells, and tastes great. Try it. Got the Rock Boo, Combo Bop, and KKO KKO Bop

I sought out a hypnotherapist in efforts to quit smoking because a friend of mine had great success doing the same.  I went on Yelp to find one close by, and saw Arlene's page.  She had great reviews, and was very responsive to my phone call.  When she called back she was very friendly and professional and quickly gained my trust.  After the initial paperwork was done, she dove right into a VERY personalized program that consisted of 3 sessions that we're about 1.25 hrs in length.  I'll be honest, I didn't completely quit smoking right away ( it doesn't work that way), but I have significantly cut back, and have tools to improve every day.  When I first met with Arlene, I was smoking about a pack and a half a day.  Now I'm down to about 10 and smoking less every day.  Thanks Arlene

Jay Simmons obviously enjoys making his would be customers feel like they aren't good enough to be in his store! Rude, condescending and unprofessional in so many ways. Personally I will never recommend this jewelry store and will be sure to tell all my family, friends and acquaintances not to waste their time or money shopping here! There are so many jewelers in this valley that appreciate their customers, don't waste your time at Simmons, it should be re-named "Snotty's"

They are on Door Dash, so if you want to be safe, use it!

COVID ops- I can't remember whether or not customers are required to wear masks, but you do have access to hand sanitizer, and they're making excellent use of their outdoor area, as there isn't a lot of square footage to allow for a ton of well-spaced seating.  They appear to take our and their safety and health seriously.

For the record, when there isn't a pandemic, the floor-plan is cool, with kind of a garage door that opens to the outside, weather permitting, and they have a cool little bar area, which is too cramped to keep open right now.

Full bar, limited beer on tap, but I've never had a time where they didn't have something good.

Their burgers are juicy and tasty as can be but... but... TOAST.  THE.  BUN.  It limits the sog factor :-P

I recently good hooked on their BBQ chicken salad, which uses delicious fried chicken.  No really, I saw someone else get it, and you know how sometimes dishes will look so good you just kinda know it's gonna taste awesome?  That's what happened with me and that salad.

I can also speak for them having the best tomato soup I've ever had.  I mean... just look at it!  LOOK!  And it tastes better!

Anyway, cool little place, food that hasn't missed yet, nice staff.

The food is decent, nothing to write home about. The drinks, however, are awesome! Whatever your taste they have something to fit it. I was devastated when they changed the Espresso martini and I couldn't get the "real" one with real espresso. But Sam saved the day!!! He's the best bartender ever! We come just to see him. His drinks are always consistent, and he tastes them with a straw to make sure! That's the mark of a good bartender. He's also great company, he's very personable and remembers his regulars. Sam would be an asset to any form of service! So excited I can still get my espresso martini! Don't ever let Samuel go!
Not only was the food not good, someone left a shit smeared toilet seat in the bathroom. Merry shitmas.

OK I'll admit it. This place .. WOW. Korean food is awesome but cupbop brings a whole new level to the experience. Be warned though getting your dish above a 7 rating in heat, you better have an iron gut.. for certain.

The customer service is excellent, and the employees here really care about their customers a great deal. Dont hesitate to try these guys out and follow their food truck too.. you wont be disappointed. But you will be satisfied.

The pizza was cold, had no flavor crust had no flavor I was very surprised with all the raves that this man has gotten from the website that he's selling pizza from all the accolades that he has from all over the world of this pizza would've been fantastic took an hour and a half to get to us I don't recommend you try this pizza I've had so many better pizzas that were not from a gentleman that had all these accolades ,Not a great pizza I recommend you pass on this, just my two cents!
Unable to correctly format a .png to a piece of paper. Inept. On my way to an interview and have to scramble. Go elsewhere

Love Yogurtz! Surprisingly great burgers, fries and salads. Only drawback is high turnover in employees so best to go on slow days or it may take some time to get your meal. Cooks vary, but one is a trained chef and you can tell when you get your food, how delicious and beautiful it is when he makes it! When the better chef makes your burgers, they are the best burgers in town!

I LOVE NY style pizza, even if I've never been to NY. Big, floppy, greasy slices...just love it. So, I was happy to see this place relatively close to me and excited to try it. It's a small place with a drive thru window, and a nice little staff in the window. I ordered a 2-slice combo and a side of garlic bread. Decent price for what you get. Also pretty decent-sized slices. First thing I tried was the sausage pizza. Really good. With both slices, I loved the NY feel of the pizza...floppy and greasy and just good. Great red sauce they put on there with good toppings. Kind of wish there were more toppings on the sausage slice, but it was super good so I can't complain much. Now as for the special of the day, the "Blue Lady" I believe it was called...holy freakin wow. What amazing flavor. Jalapeño, blue cheese crumbles, some type of sweet sauce, and a bunch of other things that I can't remember, but wow...honestly, and no I don't take this lightly, this was one of the best slices of pizza I've ever had in my life. It was roughly perfect. So much flavor on a perfectly textured slice. I mean, good lord...it was so good, I can't even take it thinking about it. And again, I don't say this lightly. I don't know their schedule in terms of how often they switch up their specials of the day, but I hope they have the Blue Lady on a regular basis because this is something that I need in my life ALL THE TIME NOW!!! ::has heart attack::

And I haven't even talked about the garlic bread yet! WOW! They give you a good amount of the little rectangular pieces of delicious bread, and not only are they good by themselves, but they give you a little container of their red sauce, and it's just phenomenal. I'm not even a big red sauce kind of guy, but there's just so much flavor in it, it's the perfect combo. As dangerous as it is, I'm very happy I found this place. BEST PIZZA AROUND!

Very cute place for starters!  Everyone was so friendly and welcoming.  We came before 5 so we took advantage a little bit at least of the happy hour.  We had the nachos.  The nachos were good but a bit too salty.  The margaritas were made fresh and were to die for.  My hubby had 2. (Hiccup)
Hubby had the French dip - to which he really enjoyed.  He especially liked the bread it was served on.  I had the chop-chop salad.  It too was very good although I would not order the chicken as a topping.  I wasn't a fan of the chicken.  All in all - I thought this place was really good.  We really loved the bartender Cody!

Customer service is fine until you have a problem, I brought back two atomizers one I had used and it was clearly defective. It made my mod got to the touch and killed my battery within an hour. I wanted to exchange them and they tried to blame my mod and sell me a new one. They refused to do the exchange. They are not the only vale store in town and I will not be back.

Sorry to say that after several repeat trips back for breakfast, I can't update at a higher star rating. In fact if there was a 3.5 star I would go that high, but there isn't no such animal.

Now remember that this is my taste, so keep that in mind. But I don't find their breakfasts satisfying because there is not enough there in a dish. For example, the poached eggs with toast don't have any potatoes or meat. And yet it cost, almost 8 bucks. Add some bacon and you are up to the $10 area, plus tax. And their is no choice of ham or sausage. So for a guy, I'd say the appeal for breakfast isn't there. I'd be going to Express Cafe, Mo Joes or Le Peep for that amount and getting eggs, ham, potatoes and toast.

Now my wife says it is satisfying for her, if she has a muffin and coffee. Or, an order of avocado toast and coffee. 

In summary, IMO their menu is better suited for women or very light eater men. Otherwise I like the ambience, people and coffee.

Shops like this that help keep guns OUT of law abiding American Patriots.

Went into the shop about two weeks ago a routine basic transfer pick up. Gave my name to the Joe Biden looking dude he goes to the back comes back out {avoids eye contact} and says he's not going to do the transfer.
When asked why not? he smirkingly says "to shady" no further explanation. Not sure if this shop understands basic FFL laws or if they just blatantly prejudicially decided they did not like what they saw in their customer. They just refused service to a Veteran and Active first responder.

Good job guys. This experience cost me restocking fees of {-700} for the property that I was denied I also will not be recommending this shop to anyone of my peers. Worse business experience in a long time. This shop belongs in California.

Wow!  This was our first time to eat at Sids Garage  in the Village and we will definitely be going back!  Impeccable wait service, delicious but not intimidating food, unique and unusual lunch.  Flavors and presentation were beyond anything I've seen in a while.  

So happy to have discovered Sid's!!!

Extensive menu and great prices.  They didn't skimp on the fries or tots.
The lemonade was delicious. We would come again just for the lemonade.  And It's half off during happy hour 2-5!
It's a great way to eat a tasty pizza. The cone seemed gimmicky, but after you eat your first, you'll wonder why the heck there aren't more around the states! Delicioso!

Cool store with a healthy feel to it. Lots of fresh and hard to find produce. Many vegan and gluten free products. Food counter where you can order food to go. Wine section. Bulk section. Spice section. Fridge and frozen food. Employees are friendly and helpful. I was looking for a few different wines and the wine employee looked them all up in the computer and checked the boise location in the computer as well. Prices are not cheap though so if you live closer to the grocery outlet in Boise I would recommend going there for specialty vegan items.

This is a little breakfast/brunch place in a strip mall and has all the things you would expect from a little Idaho breakfast place: stick to your ribs food and service big on warmth and charm. What's surprising about the place is that the menu has a number of items you wouldn't expect on an average breakfast place's menu, like stuffed french toast. We were pretty impressed this place is a delightful little discovery and the service is very much closer to the neighborhood places we remember in Idaho from years past.

Love me or hate me, either way you're thinking about me--Unknown

23rd person to review Coned! The pizza company located on the corner of Eagle and overland near the Pita Pit and Big Juds. This is my 464th review. 

As the quote above suggests, Coned! has been one of those ideals that you either love or hate. Reading the mixed reviews and the discussions in "Talk" there are a lot of mixed reviews. I, personally, am neutral. 

Coned! is pizza spite the fact that it sounds like an ice cream shop. They are a food truck turned brick and mortar location. They have a specialized cone pressing machine and a custom oven that cooks said cone in under 4 minutes. 

I am one of those fellas that like to bite the bottom of the waffle cone and suck out the ice cream--yea, don't do that to this... you'll burn your mouth! It's basically two pieces of pizza into one, all rolled into a cone shape. It doesn't fall apart and is surprisingly easy to eat. 

They have some dessert cones, too, such as peanut butter and jelly. The place itself is rather small. They do have a private bathroom. Most of the seating is high stool chairs which would be hard for some, especially those with mobility issues and sitting on stools-- beware of that. 

The staff is sweet for the most part, mostly teenagers. They aren't the most consistent bunch. When I was in there I noticed a drawing and when you order you're to be given a certain amount of tickets per order. The gal gave some people some and not others. It was free drink day and she offered some customer some and not others (including me) with any purchase. This seemed a little bias to me. I had to ask for the drawing enteries.

Not pleased with my window washing. I had to follow them around because they forgot to do the window tracks, they missed entire window. So they came back out, did the outside with the screens still in the windows, plus it was a rain day. I told them to come at 10 a.m. they came at 
8:30 a.m.  The inside was just mediocre, they didn't clean along the frame of the window just squeegee were the tool would go not using a rag to get close to the frame and clean.
Very disappointed.

Can understand the poor rating and mostly poor reviews

In summary ,the manager outright lied about not having upgrades for Radisson Rewards members and then charged when he gave us one. 
Felt like I was trying to buy a used car.  This problem was resolved through the rewards program so that is not why I gave the place a one rating but more than enough reason to give it a one rating

First, bed was not comfortable.  Breakfast in the morning was only from 6 to 8 a.m.   Room was old and needs a redo.

Finally, because of my poor experience we moved up the street to the Hampton Inn and found a nicer room and amenities, breakfast and most importantly, customer service.  Made this Country Inn & Suites place look like a Motel 6.

Seated promptly. Order taken in a reasonable amount of time. Server was friendly, kept our coffee filled. Downhill from there... the salted caramel banana pancakes were wonderful. My husbands regular pancakes were inedible as was the rest of our food. Almost cold,  not even lukewarm. I can't stomach cold over easy eggs(ordered over medium) or hash browns. Forgot the toast..We were comped $5. Waitress said both cooks were new but that doesn't keep the food from getting to the table hot. Then the machine only gave options to tip by percentage and hubby had to override for a zero. He never leaves zero but over 50% of our food was left behind. (Took some home for the dogs) Won't return. Used to love Denneys and I've actually been very patient eating out this last year but this was bad. Poor waitress will go somewhere else I'm sure.

Tasty burger (the hangover) but everything is over-priced.  What would be $15 on the high end anywhere else was $30 (burger, fries and a beer)

The french fries only come in one size and without flavor, not even potato. Just crunchy fried stuff. Mine were the Loco fries.

Re: Owner commentary - Limiting every menu entry to what you consider to be gourmet only limits your base. Volume pays overhead. Red Robin, yuuuuuummmmmmm. And their fries are potato-y
Coned pizza is not only a fun idea but very delicious!! Friendly staff and a cool place to stop in and change up the typical lunch stops.

We've been dropping off items for the youth ranch about twice a month for three years. 
Yesterday we were there at the drive in to drop off some items, there were two young women working ignoring us and the gentleman waiting ahead of us. We were late for an appointment so my wife set our items by one of the racks telling one of the women she was in a hurry.  Both women started yelling she couldn't do that and one grabbed the items and threw them in a box.  I suggested she calm down a little which she didn't and we were told not to come back. She even went to the trouble of running out of the driveway to write down our license number as we drove down the street. Very strange business practice for a business that relies on donations. 
Many other organizations I can and will give to. 
So needless to say I won't be back.

This place is beginning to grow on me.

The first couple of times I came here, I wasn't too sure. The bartenders and servers were actually intoxicated from drinking with customers. I'm all for enjoying work so it doesn't feel like "work", but when you begin forgetting things customers have asked for or why you went to the back of the house, then that's an issue.

With that said: the food is decent, the beer selection is not bad, and the drink pours are heavy. How this place has stayed open for so long is amazing.

I do enjoy their weeknight specials on apps, wings, and ribs.

All in all, the staff is friendly, and the drinks and food are decent. I just don't recommend going later in the evening after everyone's had a few rounds.

I called in to order the special of the day pizza ranch with bacon and chicken. They said it will take them 30 minutes to be picked up. We came less than 5 minutes since this place is just down the road from us. I decided to order a slice of pepperoni and a cheese pizza to try with my daughter. We love the pizzas,...the crust was so good. 
Yes, nothing like a slice of pizza in NY but hey to be fair I don't think there is bad place for pizza in NY! Lol! We will be back!
Ordering online & curbside pick up is awesome, esp 4 a mom with sleeping kids in the car! Thanks 4 making home improvement easy, convenient & offering the best prices in town. I'll be back!

This was my first time here and will not be my last. In all this craziness of stupid COVID a lot of restaurants We normally patron the quality of food as gone down and thats a shame. I love to try new  places but again have been apprehensive lately. The Griddle DID NOT disappoint it was so so good. I had the eggs Benedict (amazing) and my 12yr son ordered the 5 meat omelet also on point. The mimosas, fresh squeezed OJ, chai latte also excellent. 
Try The Griddle out you won't be disappointed.

The food was excellent. Big juicy burgers,  great tasting sides at an extra cost. Everything was a la carte. They have some very interesting and tasty spins on classics like tater tots. If you have a sweet tooth, their milkshakes are over the top. The service is where things are a bit different. It is a quasi self serve with wait staff sorta. We walked in and were greeted and were asked to seat ourselves. We grabbed menus off of a table by the entrance. A waitress asked if we would like anything to drink and grabbed some beers for us. You have to go to a cashier by the cooks to order your food. You can pay then or leave a tab open. Our food was brought to us by the wait staff. After finishing our meals the empty trays were taken away by the staff. We wanted water and I went to the cashier and he handed me glasses and pointed me to the self serve fountain. When it was time to pay I went to the cashier and he said that he could have come to our table. I thought to myself "but you didn't". Long story short is good food at sit down restaurant prices with semi fast food service.

Rudy's is a great restaurant most of the time. It's been hit and miss lately. Some of the meals are spot on like the Fish Tacos and Sliders, super tasty! The Nachos and Lettuce Wraps not so much. And the staff was not very concerned in correcting any of the short comings. We still visit frequently but try to just stick with what we know is going to be consistent. The staff is attentive and friendly and the place has a great energy. Worth giving them a try if you're in the area.

Where to start. First time in and was greeted with a loud welcome in and it was awesome. The manager took me to my seat and explained how the menu goes and what the top favorite are. I decided to get the steakhouse burger with truffle fries. The burger was so juicy and warm when I took that first bite. You know it wasn't sitting in front of a heat lamp. The truffle fries are a lot. I will definitely be coming here again with a lot more people. Thanks for have a kick ass restaurant.

We heard good things and decided to have a late breakfast at Waffle Love. We ordered one breakfast sandwich (sammy) with a side piece of chicken, and a chicken/waffle order.  There was one order ahead of us (4 ladies and their toddlers).   Thirty minutes after we ordered, the ladies ahead us got their order.  Fifty minutes after we ordered, we finally got our food.   It seems they are understaffed (only 2 employees) and I only saw one grill, so maybe they need to resolve that.  

The breakfast sandwich was extremely disappointing...plain tasting egg with a small amount of soggy bacon between two rubbery waffles.   I ended up giving it to my wife who then found a hair/eyelash in it.  The chicken was decent though.  

Based on our experience, we will not return and would not recommend this place.  Long wait for below average food.
Service was great, food was okay. The ham get patties were flat and not much flavor. The grilled chicken was similar. After I finished the first thought that came to mind was "meh."

Went with a Friend for Sundaes. Was disappointed in Service. My friend ordered 2 scoops of Praline with Cream, drizzled with Caramel Syrup. She didn't get any Syrup. I ordered a scoop of Grasshopper, and a scoop of Southern Black Cherry drizzled with Hot Fudge. I received BOTH Syrups on my Sundae. We were pressed for time, and couldn't afford to wait around to get this Rectified Wasn't Happy.
However the flavors were A1, and decent size scoops is Why I'll recommend them.

Mallory was outstanding in her care as a server. I came by my self on Veterans Day and she made me feel like it was MY restaurant and I was the only patron! Very personable and on top of every facet! The corn-beef hash was excellent! 
 Thank you Griddle!

I tried and tried to get another appointment for my havanese to be groomed.  The owner told me that she would have one of her groomers call me.  Nothing even after I called again.  If this owner wants to keep and hold onto loyal, paying customers, than she needs to make sure that calling back is a priority.

Food was fresh and service was good.they asked twice if everything was okay.
With covid a concern..the only thing was lacking was the salt and pepper..

Very friendly staff..

Everything was amazing! Came in for a dinner date with my wife at 4:30 PM Friday. Seated immediately and took in the vibe. Music is a bit loud but it fits with the mood of the restaurant, a rockin' garage with throwbacks I used to listen to in high school and college. The servers were very attentive and friendly.

The food here is delicious! Everything tasted amazing and was worth the price. Started with the tempura green beans and it's a nice size to share with two. My wife and I each got a burger, the hangover for me and the steakhouse for my wife. The burgers were both delicious, the best we've had in the valley or probably ever. Of favorite of the two was the hangover. Came with pretzel bun, bacon, cheddar, and a nice sunny side up egg with the yolk bringing it all together. Last but not least we have the 420 shake to split and trust me, you want to split this with someone because it can be a meal on its own. It was picture worthy and it was the only thing we could take a picture of because before we knew it we had already eaten our burgers - they were so good. 

Overall and amazing experience. I will be coming back with friends and family when I'm feeling a delicious burger.

Went in for a simple oil change and had an amazing experience!! Dustin walked me through everything that needed to be done and cut me an amazing deal for the oil and the additional fluids and services done. Will define rly be coming back for any other services needed.

What a shining example of how a Starbucks should be ran. 2 days in a row, the drive through was quick and the people friendly. One girl started up a quick friendly conversation while we waited for our coffee at the window. Super sweet girl (I didn't catch her name, but she has a couple tattoos on her lower arms). I truly wish ALL Starbucks operates this efficiently and this friendly. Thanks!

Good food definitely worth the pay. Good price my friends & I always come
Here on weekends

They charged me 60$ for artificial nails. The design pealed off not even 24 hours later, they also put so much room between my cuticle and where they started the artificial nail. This is forcing me to go get my nails redone not even a week later. DO NOT GO HERE! Worst nails i have ever seen! I supplied a photo for them as well of what i wanted and it looked nothing like them when they where done.

Went to the location after a few years. My daughter and I both had chicken terriyaki bowls and my vegetables were ice cold. Within a short time we were both very sick to our stomachs and it took about a week to feel completely better. I called the location which does not have a voicemail and was not open on Sundays to let them know that we both got very sick and were still feeling poorly and that I wanted a full refund. The manager told me that she would get a refund, but when I noticed bank statement only partial refund was granted the amount of the bowls. I called back and spoke to same manager she stated that because the bowls are what got us sick that was all that they were going to refund, she scolded me for not coming forward at the time we were dining and stated that she would tell the owner to see if he would give me the other refund. She also stated that the vegetables are cooked and kept in an ice bath so they couldn't possibly have gotten us sick and that nobody else has complained. I told her that most of the time they wont complain they just wont come back. I called back today to leave a message with the owner to get my full refund, after all I did not pay to get sick and none of the meal would have been enjoyable. It became an oppositional time with the same female manager that has been handling this issue since I have been calling. I let her know that I would be filing a complaint with the health department and want to have a call back from the owner asap. She also decided to let me know she thought I stated that I was starting to feel better. I just want to clarify me and my daughter have been having stomach issues since we ate there and gradually everyday it is getting better, but I have not felt completely better since before I ate there last week, so one week still having issues!!!
https://www.tripadvisor.com/ShowUserReviews-g35531-d5045326-r800923612-Yokozuna_Teriyaki-Meridian_Idaho.html#

Well, I'm sad that their broth had no flavor. I moved here two months ago and I was looking for a Ramen place to find in place of my favorite one in California. I guess I'll keep looking. On a good note, Naomi made up in her service and personality. She apologized for the lack of flavor. I really had to doctor it up with chile.

We (Josh/Barbie) have been going to waffle love for some time now. The staff is always so nice and we always see the owner jumping in and helping the staff when it's busy. If you haven't made a trip in to try out the menu, you HAVE to do so! Waffle Love is for sure one of the gems of Meridian.

Three weeks ago, as my wife and I were preparing for a two-week trip to Yellowstone, we discovered a problem with our travel trailer. We made the discovery at 9pm on Saturday night before a Monday morning departure. Since Camping World Meridian had winterized the trailer and then prepped it for summer I went to them on Monday morning for help. Their service department told me they could not look at the trailer until July 12 - seven days in the future. I had RV park reservations in 5 different places in the next 14 days and had to be on the road THAT DAY, but alas Camping World was entirely inflexible and would not offer ANY help until the following Monday. I had no choice but to leave and be on my way. We did manage to figure out what the problem was and get it fixed along our way - no thanks to Camping World.
Lessons learned:
1) DO NOT ==EVER== accept your RV for return to service without PERSONALLY checking out EVERY system BEFORE you sign the service documents
2) DO NOT ==EVER== expect help from Camping World in an emergency. Any emergency you may have is YOUR emergency, not theirs.
3) Seek out a place that will help you in event of an emergency and GO THERE for service

This is such a cute restaurant in downtown meridian. The staff are so friendly. It will be our Friday night date night restaurant. Great cocktails/beers but the food is the best.
