Search is over, I have found my fish and chips place!  Fish is fresh and batter is crispy not greasy.  The apps are great and can't wait to order the ahi tuna nachos-so fresh and innovative. The burgers and fries are excellent and cooked a perfect medium rare. Catch you there on a Friday night.

This is by far the worst "car wash" I have ever been to.  I was there 2 weeks ago for a wash and wax. I think first someone should tell them you can't wax anything that is black and plastic.  They didn't even try to keep the wax off my side mirrors, door handles and  the liner of the truck bed.  It won't wash or wipe off, and the only solution the manager had was for me to sit there and watch him try to wipe it off.  It looked good for about 2 minutes until it dried and turned white again.  The manager had a very bad attitude and many excuses.  Please learn from my experience.

Good food, but I felt pressured to get something from every page in their menu.  "We start with shakes" and "sides are all extra" ended up costing me $40 for a party of one.  Note that all of the things that I ordered tasted great and were well thought out by the menu planner.  I'd just really like to be able to get out of there for $15-$20 after a burger, drink, and side.  After all...it is a burger joint.
Cute little spot. We unfortunately were put in the veryyy back corner which was a bummer. But yummy food & good drinks! Service was great!

Great food,Incredible service
 Courteous & professional waitstaff!!
Julie Grass 

They are always friendly and know us by name .   Just that small hometown feeling that most places in this valley anymore are lacking!   
Truly a treat to go there .  
Karla

Losing your long time nail tech can be so traumatic!  That was confirmed when I chose someone and my gel nails peeled off within one week!  I then went to see Michelle at Tip Top nails and left there with a smile on my face. She was efficient, pleasant and personal (called me by my name) and my nails were beautiful. (Thanks for the referral Pam Grove!). See you in a couple of weeks Michelle!

This place was really good! We live nearby and were excited to try it and it didn't disappoint, we had the Carnitas, corn dogs, and rib eye and it was fantastic! Great friendly service also! Definitely be back

I'm not gonna lie....THIS IS A GREAT BREAKFAST PLACE!! Everything is made from scratch....EVERYTHING!!! I have literally never tried anything on the menu I didn't like! Eggs Benny...good! Waffles and crepes...good! Omelets...good! Mimosas...GOOD!

This is no longer the best kept secret in the Valley though....the word is out and they ARE busy! So anticipate a wait...but trust, it is worth it.

We were a group of four that were in town for the weekend. We ate here on a Saturday afternoon.  We got sat and greeted right away. Burgers came out quick, hot and tasted fresh.  We also had two milkshakes that were awesome. We will definitely be back when we are in area again.

Food's fantastic. But we've gotten takeout here half a dozen times and 5/6 times they've forgotten something from our order. Such as tortillas for fajitas or a side of rice. Should be better than that.

Stopped in with some friends for Rudy's Tuesday half-priced wings. A dozen meaty wings served with a tasty selection of sauces, blue cheese dressing, carrots and celery for 6 bucks.  Friendly, attentive service and an environment conducive to conversation.  What's not to love?

I have to say that Coop needs to rethink their marketing of their fish. Why would you keep a fish that you planned to market at $20 a pound (wild caught King Salmon) on ice for 5 days before you fillet it and put it in the case? Well that is what they do.

We asked when the King Salmon came in and said it didn't look that fresh. They gave us the date of delivery and then using the date we were in there, it showed a fish that had been kept for 5 days before it was put out. Sorry, but we are not paying $20 a pound for fish treated like that. It is certainly a shame to see this happening because I am willing to bet they wasted most of that fish thru no sales.

This is an indication of poor marketing management and we know that this happens to other fish in their counter. If we were Coop, we would take names of customers who want fresh fish and then email out the arrival date a day or two in advance of the fish's arrival. People would know what is coming in and could drop down and get fresh fish.Bet their utilization rate goes up, wastage goes down, and they could even lower prices a bit based on the increased sales. But, I know, that takes too much ingenuity. Sorry to have suggested it.

The fajitas were great, the beans and rice flavorful on this...my second trip to Las Cabanitas. Unfortunately, I kept back a star because of service, or rather the lack there of. When we got there, there was a good amount of customers but not overwhelming. We got seated quickly but the staff took a long time to bring menus andtake our order and a long time to check on us and a longer time after we finished our food to bring our bill and then I asked for a to-go box and I had to get up to ask for my box and to cash us out. We waited and finally were able to  leave.

A great addition for those of us on this side of the metro area. It was always somewhat a pain to go to the original Coop, but this is going to make a big difference in our shopping habits. 

The grand opening was a bit of a zoo, but fun. Lots of free tastings. The store is well laid out and squeaky new. Michele R. Has already done the heavy lifting in describing the layout, so I won't duplicate. 

We really liked their takeout and ready to eat food sections. The rice bowls are tasty and well done. The pizzas by the slice also looked yummy. With nice,new, long food display cases, the takeout foods are multitudinous and attractively displayed. I can see having lunch there and plenty of opportunities to pick up takeout for home meals. One small criticism, the sign boards for the burritos, bowls and sandwiches are angled such that you can't really read them from at the counter. You need to back up almost to the cold drink coolers to view them all, before you can make a decision.

In summary, it is nice to have a one stop close by to get a choice of local breads, meats and unusual foods, prepared and fresh.
Ramen is delicious the food there is to die for it doesn't upset my stomach it me feel full like that good full not that ahh man I ate to much it's delicious.

Extremely unprofessional work crew tonight. Not attentive to the customers, didn't follow instructions and just plain didn't care about anything. Laughing and joking around with each other the whole time. It was like a frat house. Worst restaurant experience I've ever had. Will not be going back to the Eagle/Chinden location or maybe any location.

Definitely was a No for me! I was so excited to hear that they brought Korean BBQ in the valley. My husband surprised me for my birthday and brought me here. Expectations were just pushed out the doors! In a bad way!! It was nothing I expected , it was not Korean what so ever. I was so disappointed & sad!! 
It was not my cup of tea, I did see a lot of others review and said it was so good. It wasn't great at all for me. My husband didn't like it either, said it was just a bunch of random stuff put together. 
On a better note, they do give you a good portion for the price, but we ended up throwing it all away anyways....

This business is doing so many good things! Their customer service is dynamite and the food is delicious. These are the same owners as the Donut and Dog so expect great food. You should also expect to pay a slightly higher price to enjoy that food. 

The fries are my favorite. Crispy on the outside and creamy on the inside. They also have a delicious, mild seasoning. You can get them with Parmesan cheese too. I also enjoyed the Maui Wowi burger. So good and so messy! The El Jefe milkshake wasn't my favorite. The flavor was good but because it's made with oat milk ice cream, it came out a bit icy. They take a lot of care to make each presentation amazing. 

I do want to point out that the second time I was there, their COVID precautions weren't as strong as I'd like to see. At least 3 of their waitstaff was wearing masks under their noses and one just had his around his chin the whole time. Also they have communal condiments and plastic utensils out on every table, plus social distancing doesn't really exist there. In normal times, I wouldn't have thought about any of my these things but I do want to point it out for people who are high risk.

Cool. Trendy. Hipster vibes everywhere. Loved it!

It was Sunday after church, we were starving! Yelp came through once again. Yay!

We were lucky enough to get a table inside since it was still a bit chilly outside. It was in the 50's and being from Cali- that's basically freezing to us. 

I started with the hot Sage Latte. What a great play of flavors in this sweet hot cup of perfection. I will be craving this one in Cali for sure! 

For lunch hubby ordered the Huevos Rancheros and I ordered the fried Chicken Sandwich with Fries. First, the Huevos Rancheros- not my husband's favorite. The tortillas were the hardshell ones you buy for tostadas so that was disappointing. He ate around the hard shell. 
My Chicken Sandwich was AMAZING! The kale was dressed with a horseradish vinaigrette that was to die for!! The french fries were also delicious. I asked for a trio of dipping sauces;) 

Even though hubby didn't enjoy his lunch as much as I did, they still get 5 stars because I'm the one who matters! I love this place:)

We are done here. Slow service, over-priced and in some cases very small portions for a high price. After 4 times, we have decided that they aren't worth the trip.

Try Jo Mammas across Eagle Road, good portions, tasty and large menu and prices are  a few dollars cheaper for every comparable entry. Can be pretty crowded on weekends, but other times, not a problem.

I went in wanting to buy a car I already new what my price range was and I was going through iccu I had a check ready to pay for a vehicle. I couldn't drive it the first day because I lost my license so that was my fault my friend drove it for me on our way back to the store one of the lights came on saying something was wrong and I asked what that meant and Adam Main our sales consultant said he didn't know to almost everything we asked or always seemed unsure and said I will ask my manager. During our test drives he would just sit in the back and not say a word and was just looking out the window enjoying the ride I guess.  So that made me feel unsure. I was still considering the car because I liked it and I was set on buying it the next day because he said I needed my drivers license to buy it. So I told him okay put it on hold I'm going to come first thing in the morning after I leave the DMV and come back with the check and all. Well I was anxious so I went home read reviews about the car a lot of people liked it but it wasn't a hundred percent awesome so I looked into maybe changing my mind it was a Mazda but you guys also had a c250 Mercedes Benz that I fell in love with when I first walked in so throughout the night I was set and changed my mind for the Benz. I kept researching things because I couldn't sleep so I looked up more info through carmax because it looked like a good place to buy a car. I've never seen so many terrible reviews about a car dealership and what was worse is they were all alike too some people got sold lemons or they had issues with the 5 day return policy or their car broke down In a week or a month this lady said the car salesman told her the reason why her car was rattling was because all small cars do that......it was nuts out of 73 reviews I read only 13 of them were 4 to 5 star and they said nothing about the cars they just said their sales consultant was amazing and had a great experience. So I was a bit worried but I really wanted that Benz so next day I went back to the store Adam Main was waiting for me right at the door I told him I think I want to test drive both so I can make up my mind. So I did drive the Mazda first the light thing came on again and the Benz you could tell needed an alignment because when I hit the freeway I let go of the wheel and immediately went the other direction and the speakers were broken I'm not knowledgeable about cars so I thought if I can notice this I wonder what else could be wrong. The car was a little dirty on the inside and in the back there was an ash tray with ash still in it too.  I asked Adam if I could take it to a mechanic or someone to look at it to make sure it's okay he said I had to buy it first and then I had 5 days to return it immediately I thought of all those reviews I asked Paul Otanez the manager and he said the same thing that I had to buy it and I had 5 days to bring it back. I had a terrible feeling so I said I would think about it right then and there Adam looked so mad and irritated after that he didn't even look or talk to us we said goodbye to Paul the manager and left. Thankfully enough I trusted my gut late that day I ended up at Volkwagon Audi they had the exact same color but in red and fell in love I asked if I could take it to get looked at and they said I could take it wherever i wanted immediately I felt like crying and told them about my horrible day and bought an amazing car there. So now I'm writing a review because I feel bad for all the other people that had a bad experience so DO NOT BUY FROM HERE CARMAX IS A SHADY PLACE TO BUY A CAR look at all the reviews about this place before you go in there.

oatmeal and coffee and chai tea all bomb once i tried soup and pannini i remember is being pretty good as well but service is meh and all the yummy fattening pastries I normally like looked kinda bland that disappointed me big time

We purchased a brand new travel trailer from Camping World. It has had several issues, and has now been in the service department for 3 weeks (not its first trip back to the service department). There has been no communication regarding when it will be done. After calling and asking for an update several times, I received a call today letting me know the repair had not been approved by warranty yet because it was just submitted on June 10th. We dropped the camper off around May 24th. They could not tell me when it will be done. I do not recommend purchasing a new camper through Camping World.

After the super crowded opening days, we thought we would review our review when the traffic is more normal.

With time and room to more slowly cruise the aisles, we are still pleased. We have noticed more things we liked. The bread selection is tops. Besides the local Zeppole, Gaston and Acme, they also have Ketchum's Bigwood. We have come to love Bigwood's Epis, Challah, and sourdough big loaves.

Lots  of great diary products. We love Nancy's products and their cottage cheese is tops. Discovered Kefir and now can drink my yogurt, Never thought I'd like it, but I remembered I liked buttermilk as a kid and Kefir is better. Almost as good as a milkshake with only a small calorie hit.They also carry a wide range of Califia diary and citrus products. They make great lemonades, not too sweet, but tops in flavor. I like to cut mine with some Pellegrino to make it more refreshing.

Their take out food is great. The pizza, bowls and prepared soups have been very good. My wife, who is an A-1 soup maker, said she would take quarts of soup home and not be ashamed to serve them to company. 

The only thing we found a bit short was the salad bar. How about some sliced hard boiled eggs, pickled beets, bacon bits to add to the mix? OK, I admit, salads with lots of green stuff isn't my forte.

Their cookies and muffins are as good as we had from Boise. But there are no guru donuts that we have seen.

Store is clean and well stocked. Prices may seem high to some,  but one gets what they pay for.

Visit if you haven't yet.
The address is not correct on Yelp . It's take you to some greenhouse. La Crap de la Boise. We went home and made our crepes.

I heard rave reviews forever from friends at school about Momo dumplings, but it was so out of my way, that it took me forever to test them myself. One day, I was cat sitting on that side of town and decided, "what the hey, let's try it!" 

That day changed my life. Amazing dumplings, perfectly cooked crisp veggies, a bouquet of flavors and textures. Everyone has to try the yak dumplings and delicious samosas! My husband and I are always stuffed after leaving, but the food is light on the tummy, and I always feel energetic and refreshed after eating. 

The atmosphere is unprecedented in its hospitality-- I feel like family here, and service is always fast. Momo Dumplings is on my list to take any and all out-of-town visitors.

I've been looking forward to going to this place all week and I was SO disappointed. I don't know if I came on a bad night or what but the meat was super dry and bland. I love the idea but the end result wasn't great. I lived in LA for 6 years, the mecca for KBBQ and maybe my expectations were just a little too high.
Very interesting place. Yummy food and cool atmosphere. I will definitely be coming back to Sid's.

Pretty dang good pizza! My husband is obsessed with their mushroom truffle sauce! Dave Portnoy from Barstool has made me obsessed with New York style pizza and I have zero regrets. Perfect amount of cheese, flavor and that crunch! Yum! So delicious!

Nice store out in Eagle! Happy that they have healthier options for this side of town. The check out lady I had was not very friendly though! Man I was ready to get to my car....my advice as a person who has worked in customer service is just to be kind! Even if you are having a crap day. You can really effect others whether you know it or not...

Having gone back again, I find I need to upgrade them to a 4 Star. They have come a long way from my initial low rating.

The new management is much more personal and the new menu (to me, at least) has some good things on it, like a lamb burger. Still have really fresh squeezed OJ. You can watch it being squeezed.

Coffee is still good, roomy dining area and clean. The Eagle  restaurant is our choice for breakfast when in Eagle.
Great place only one bathroom.  Employees use the same bathroom.  I was behind multiple employees and each one of them averages 10 minutes.   There should be a separate bathroom

Lovely location in Meridian. 

I ate outside on the patio overlooking a common green grass area. Kids were playing, people were happy, no masks were needed on this outside area during Covid in June of 2021.

It was a good day.

The fish and chips were well prepared. The beer was dark and cold as I like it.

Only one thing kept me from giving them five stars. When my bill arrived the server had already included my tip putting 30% in the tip area. 

Now, I had formed a policy of tipping heavy because of the stress of Covid and how it hurt so many individuals in the restaurant business. But I like to be the one to choose what I will put as a tip and not have it placed there before me. And as it was only me, it was not a fixed gratuity.

So instead of choosing to give this person 30% which I would have probably done, I only included a 10% tip. I let it speak for itself and hopefully the server got the message. But if not, she's angry and so be it.

A tip is just that...extra money for quality of service, chosen by the patron.

I have not returned to this restaurant.

Not a single sales person was wearing a mask although many of the customers were. A salesman approached me and I asked him why he was not wearing a mask. He said, "Well, my boss doesn't require that we wear them so I don't bother." Absolutely disgusting. I thought,  Really? I'm wearing one to protect you, the employee, but your boss and you don't feel any obligation to protect me, the client? The place felt absolutely dirty. I walked in with $5000 in my pocket to furnish my new house and even though I skimmed through and saw some pieces I liked at decent prices I walked out with nothing. Would never give these people a dime of my money. We're in the middle of a pandemic and their boss does require them to wear masks to protect their customers? No wonder Boise has such a terrible Covid problem with management  like that.

LOTS of furniture to choose from. Staff was really great and easy to work with. We purchased some unique pieces that we were fortunate to find as a set. John & Dwayne were helpful with our small budget and knowledgeable of their inventory. Victor was a great delivery guy who made sure the pieces fit with no damage to the ceilings or the walls. Overall a great experience and we would definitely come back!

Let's start with the wonderful, Great tasting burgers and wonderful flavor packed fries. for those of you who order to go, They always pack everything needed in the takeout. Very organized and as requested. Our favorite is the hangover with the pretzel bun. Loco fries and Parmesan fries. Hubby likes the spicy Nashville chicken burger. regarding actually seating in the location... well, its not my favorite. super loud, not the best vibes, very close tables to keep safe distance and lets not get started with the wait line standing outside under the blazing sun on summer days. super tiny location. if you want better experience, order to go and enjoy all the positives they can offer
Consistently good food and friendly staff. They were out of mandoo today and there was a bit of trash that missed the trash can (napkins, a fork, and cup lid). Otherwise good atmosphere.

Love it here!  The most toppings and yogurt flavors but more importantly,  clean and pretty friendly service!  It's bright and cheery with plenty of seating so don't feel bad if want to sit and visit.  Love that you yourself can control exactly how much topping you want.  Even the owner is great!

My wife and I have been to Momo's many times now.  Their food is always fresh and is so good.  It is refreshing to have a healthy option in town that not a burger place or another chain.  My 7 year old and 5 year old love their dumplings and meatballs.  What really brings the meal together is their sauce (we love their spicy) which they make themselves and you can now buy locally.  We can eat a full meal their and not feel like we overate.  For first timers, just go in and order the combo and their staff will help you put together a wonderful meal.

Thank you to these two wonderful women, Sam and Katie!  I took my sweet Ragdoll cat Diamonds into them this morning for her first bath and grooming.  I've normally taken her to the Vet for her yearly combout.  She had some mats on her hind-end along with needing a bath.  They were very kind, knowledgeable and most of all took wonderful care of my sweet 12 year old cat.  It's obvious they both love cats.  Diamonds came home smelling clean and they combed SO much hair out of her, along with taking the mats out.  She isn't even mad at me, and I will go back to Paw Spa from now on, along with telling everyone with a dog or cat to call them.  When she was ready to be picked up, I got a cute picture of her saying "I'm done!"  OH, and by the way, they have one day they only do cats so our little sweet babies won't have to listen to dogs barking ...
smart, huh?!  Trust these two gals!  Thanks, again.

I stopped in this little store to get lunch. 

I was  surprised I spent $10 on vegetables and rice. But I have to say it was the most generous portion, and the best healthiest meal I've ordered in a long time. 

So my apologies for making a comment about the price to the staff, and I will be back! 

Good job!

Great staff, great food, great music and atmosphere! Worth the wait...appreciated the outdoor heater!  Play the beer in a bag game...great fun and great beer!! Can't wait to go back and bring our friends!!

Camping World is absolutely inexcusably awful!!! My husband and I went there last night in search of a travel trailer. Geoff seemed to be a very nice and honest salesman at first. But as we were looking at thier inventory, I mentioned that I wanted to look at one other place before we made a decision. His demeanor suddenly changed and he started questioning me as to where else I wanted to look and why. I gave him the name of the other dealership and he his response was "well we own them". He then proceeded to express the fact that what we are looking for sells fast so we needed to make a decision
The pressure was on. I asked if we could all look at the inventory on line together and he was happy to help. Come to find out, my husband noticed that the search he did was customized to above our budget. Long story short we ended up giving them a HOLDING deposit of $500 and told that we needed to contact him when the financing got approved prior to them prepping it for sale.
We found a better trailer that would meet our family needs much better for a similar price at another dealership. When we called Geoff at Camping World to inform him of our new find, we were absolutely appalled at his response. He not only was absolutely disrespectful, he threatened to send us a bill for the work that had been done to the trailer, send our information to "management" prior to hanging up on us. Please keep in mind, we didn't request any work be done, we never signed any paperwork promising to buy the trailer. 
If that isn't bad enough, we stopped in to get our holding deposit check back and they refused to give it to back to us.
I'm not usually a person that complains about companies or customer service because I know we all have our bad days. But this is absolutely inexcusably wrong!!! Not to mention illegal!!! BBB will be getting a phone call about this.

Impressive. I recently moved here from California ( Please don't judge me ) and have so far been pretty disappointed in the food when eating out in meridian/Boise area. And then I came here for brunch and was blown away. Who is your cook? I want to kiss him. The blueberry ricotta pancakes were fluffy AF and no syrup needed. And the truffle tots?!! Jesus Christ. One of the best things I ever put in my mouth. The house Bloody Mary had me saying Hail Marys after every sip it was soooo good. And the service was exceptional. Our waiter was quick, not hovering and friendly. And the table next to us was a group of fabulous wig wearing dolls out for a bachelorette. Their waitress didn't skip a beat. I don't think I ever saw their mimosa glasses empty. I will be coming back here for many brunch's.

I have been eager to try this place out ever since I started seeing the IG pics pop up on my feed. I was initially drawn in by the massive burgers, snake river farms beef and crazy looking shakes. 

I got the boss hog cooked medium rare and had them add an egg to it. On the side I got sweet potato fries and the 420 shake. The burger was unbelievable from presentation to consumption. Meat was cooked perfect, bun was soft and the size was just right. Massive onion rings, pork belly and a sunny side up egg al blended perfectly with the bbq sauce on there. The fries were great. I normally go for hand cut fries but that was not an option and I was surprisingly not disappointed with the sweet waffle fries. 

I wasn't crazy about the shake. It looked good but wasn't as thick as I wished it would have been. It was a lot of whipped cream and not so much ice cream. 

All in all, I can't wait to go back and try it all!

I came back about a month later so the next paragraph is my update.

I arrived before opening so no crowd issue.  The menu has been updated with less options but I think that's fine as long as they actually have the items advertised. They were out of Sapporo so I had to get a lager on tap. Less of a big deal. They had karaage and it was fresh out of the fryer. Excellent although I found myself wishing for more of the sauce that came with it. As for the ramen I hate to say this but they still aren't firing on all cylinders yet. Ramen to broth ratio is improved but I want half a cup more broth in the bowl. Also there was more, uh, oil in this bowl and I'm not usually accustomed to quite so much. The egg made into the bowl but still is just barely turning into a hard boiled egg. Pork was more hefty so I have less of a complaint about that. Waitress tried hard to please, I think the negative reviews have had an effect.  Again, even the worst ramen restaurant is still pretty good and I'll stick by that assessment but bump it up to 3 stars. Hopefully they have fixed the problem with the gyoza which is quite truthfully unacceptable.

I was there for lunch on opening day so the chaos was unsurprising. They covered up with tape the menu options that were not yet available but there were other items that weren't covered up and STILL weren't available. No booze because no liquor license yet but it was also on the menu uncovered. Waitress knew very little about the food. I've eaten ramen at good and middle of the road restaurants (menchanko-tei and ippudo in NYC, samurai and muto in Seattle) and the flavor of my shoyu was good, as was the tonkotsu my wife ordered. Noodles were consistent with what I've come to expect from every ramen restaurant I've been to.

Aside from the menu mistakes and service foibles, my biggest critique of Ramen Sho is what Horix has written: the noodle to broth ratio. That's a real but solvable problem, and it shouldn't be happening. I shouldn't have to press my spoon down into the noodles to get into the broth for heaven's sake.

Other things: the low quality of pork belly. It looked like a few half slices of bacon were slid in there. My egg (which initially wasn't there, the waitress noticed and gave me a whole egg, nice touch!) was a little over cooked with the yolk starting to get chalky around the edges. Also these are fixable. I hear this place is super crowded now so they don't have an incentive to fix their problems... yet. Let's see if they fix them, or if they concentrate on raking in the dollars.

And could they please please please put some tsukemono on the menu!

For personal reasons I'm giving this establishment 1 star... but mostly it's because a very tall young man was incredibly rude a very sweet young couple.  I'm disappointed in how some folks are behaving during this time.  It's sad.  I won't be back.

I would give them a negative star rating, if I could. Hands down the WORST experience. We drove 5 hours to pick up an RV that we put $ on so they would hold it. When we got there, they asked us to come back so they could fix it. No, we can't, we just drove 5 hours to get here. It took hours for them to "fix" most things, but the toilet was still broken. They were going to ship us the part so we could get back on the road. On our walk through I asked why there was only one battery when there was a spot for two. They said they are only required to give us one battery. On our first trip, I'm driving down the road and the RV is SMOKING! We pull over and the guys in the shop had zip tied the positive and negative connectors to the FRAME because they were too cheap to give me a second battery. What did Camping world do after 15 calls and speaking to two managers?? NOTHING! They wanted me to take the RV back (another 10 hour round trip drive) to prove they did it, and I didn't. Why the hell would I zip tie the battery connectors to the frame? On top of them dodging my calls, we finally got the bathroom cassette 3 months later... and it doesn't fit!  I'm sure they will be super helpful in exchanging that!

If a restaurant can't keep the dining area clean, even bus the dishes and tables, then it gets a one star in my book. Plus there was a 12 noon lunch crowd lined up to order. Now where were they going to sit? Sort of reminds me of Kneaders, same problems in organization and managerial effort. We, of course, left and won't be back.

DO YOU LIKE ARTISTS? SPECIFICALLY SCAM ARTISTS? THEN THIS IS THE PLACE FOR YOU!

I bought a cute little Honda Fit here once when I was going through the worst spiral downfall of my life. I needed lower payments, something that would fit all 4 of my big dogs, and something reliable. 

First of all don't go with their loan options, the interest percentages are atrocious. I would recommend going with a credit union and finding the loan yourself. BUT if the car starts having issues immediately and you want to return it there is something you should know. 

My Fit suddenly started having problems that arose just about 48 hours after purchase. Also I can't stress enough CHECK THE CAR FROM TOP TO BOTTOM FRONT TO BACK INSIDE AND OUT. The side of the bumper was coming apart, the trunk would get jammed etc. Things you really wouldn't think about whole test driving.

I returned the car about 2 weeks later as they have a 30 day return policy. They weren't happy and were super rude. They were supposed to send the check that I brought in back to the credit union where I got the loan.
Fast forward one month I get a notification saying I'm past due for a payment on this car that is no longer mine. They never sent the check and they wouldn't tell me what was happening. They even hung up on me when I called in. They would no longer communicate with me.

I ended up calling corporate and complaining. They had it handled in 3 days.

You're better off buying a brand new car tbh. I got a brand new car elsewhere for CHEAPER than this god forbidden Honda Fit.

Although the portions were decent our whole order was wrong. Even down to the drinks which were warm with no ice,and the soda was flat. The karaage chicken was over cooked and the tonkatsu was just pork belly. No difference from their chashyu. The definition of tonkatsu is "fried in Panko". Server was nice but so busy we did not want to bother her, so we ate what we received. We will never return. Do they use MSG?? I was up way past my bedtime!!

I was in town and needed a place to meet a friend. This place fit the bill the food was tasty and if I just ranked this based on food it would be 4 or 5 stars. 

Walking in, the employees get in your face and yell a greeting. Even pre-pandemic that would have been weird, but now it was too much. People here are complaining about the level of music but it seemed to fit the ambiance for dinner. We were there at lunch and it was still fine (though I was surprised). We were able to get a table by the window because we were the only ones wearing a mask, including the servers. 

Prices are steep but expected. The candied bacon cost more than a dollar a strip. The truffle fries are $$ but have truffle oil so they were amazing, and worth 5 stars alone. I took my leftovers home and ate them for breakfast with a fried egg on top.  

Our server didn't ask how we wanted our burgers cooked and they arrived medium. I hate seeing pink in ground meat, so I was able to eat everything except the center, which I would have liked to have eaten. Not because it was extra delicious but because I was hungry. I should have just finished the fries and ordered a milkshake instead of a burger. 

This place has potential but since I'm only in Boise once every two years, I won't be back.

Edited to 2 from 3 stars after reading the terrible responses negative reviews have been getting from owner/management. Horrible customer service, folks.

I'm tempted to not leave a review for fear that this place will get too popular, but they deserve an A+ review. Food and beer selection is legit! Had the Carnitas last week, which was excellent and affordable. Ordered the Ground Beef Burrito Special tonight. Salsas are great, service is incredible--my new go to spot! Easily the best spot I've been to in Ada County.

I really enjoyed the Togo experience at SIDS.  Ordered Nashville Hot Chicken and Steak House Burger with side of fries.  The food was outstanding, with great flavors, large portions,  quality and nice presentation.  The staff was friendly, interactive and efficient.  The owner was present and running the business with high standards.   The place was super busy and well ran.  Not hard to see why they have such a high rating.  Nice concept that was raised from the ashes of previous concept that was hard to understand.   This owner has vision, courage and a winning concept!

Packed and loaded with people which was a good sign but got skipped in line by another party and sat in a pretty bad spot where everyone was kind of walking by. Food was good. None of the burgers come with a side so a little spendy for a burger and fries.

Went there for the first time yesterday. The food and staff were great, but the music is so loud that you can't hear yourself think or easily carry on a conversation with your party. It's too bad that they think it needs to be that loud because it really made our visit somewhat unpleasant. There are a lot of great burger places in the TV that we can go to and not be bombarded by loud music so that we can enjoy our meal. Don't think I'll be coming back, sorry.

Two things to know before you visit this place:
1. You order everything at the counter, then they bring it to your table
2. This place gets busy. They do not take reservations. They do not have a wait list. It is a free for all and as soon as a table opens, you have to be quicker than the guy/gal next to you and grab it!
Their burgers are big! It's nice that everything is ala carte, that makes it easy. The sangria in a bag is a MUST HAVE! Their tots were delicious! The restaurant was cute and fun! Will be back!

My wife and I love this place! Whenever we're in Meridian, you can just about bet we'll be stopping at MoMo's. We love everything about this place - the food is delicious AND healthy, you get a lot of food for a really good price, and the staff is awesome and incredibly friendly. We both usually get the Combo Confession, with either pork or turkey meatballs and the Makhani meatballs. I should try something else at some point, but the Momos and meatballs are just so good, I can't give them up! Plus, yesterday we found out they added a smaller version of the combo to the menu, which is nice if you're not quite hungry enough to polish off the full. Rajah also offered to let us try some incredibly delicious mango tea that it sounds like they're thinking of adding to the menu - definitely hope they do, it was so good!

Stop by this place, you won't be disappointed!!

My wife and I decided to take a breakfast date to a new location. We Stumbled upon the Griddle that was fairly close to our home.

The location is large with a ton of seating, with that though, there was a several minute wait at the front as it was full. 

The menu is large and features a lot of different"home cooked" special items. There is a note on the menu that says each speciality item has a story behind it and to ask the server for them. I declined to do this, but it's a cute idea. 

We opted for a build your own omlete and you know the rules we had to swap our toast for a pancake. I might be spoiled from other locations up charge so I was taken back by the 2.50 price. It's not unreasonable  for that price, but other locations have a cheaper up charge.

Pancake was fluffy and large, a bit doughy, and the syrup tasted great. The pancake was so heavy that it sits in your stomach. Definitely enjoyed eating the pancake, but afterwards you question your life decisions. The omelette was fine. Nothing special. Get 3 items for the cost, each item after that is 1.00. too expensive for me to get the omelette I wanted.

Overall it's not bad. Your grandparents will love it. Kids will enjoy it. Pocketbook will hate you for it.

Underwhelming. My friend is a big fan of Flatbread so he wanted to try this place. First thing we noticed was a glass milk jar on the table filled with water and capped with a plastic top. We didn't know if it was there to refill our water or if they were going to put flowers in it and hadn't gotten around to it.  
For our entrees, we ordered the $15 French Dip and the $12 Crispy Chicken Sandwich. The French Dip was described "prime rib slow roasted nightly - thinly sliced to order". The meat was overcooked, curled up, and didn't look like it was "sliced to order. The Crispy Chicken Sandwich was hardly that. The "crunch" had fallen off the chicken, leaving a soggy breading on my bun, revealing a cooked chicken breast. Also, there were no condiments served with the sandwich, just cole slaw and a tomato. There was no salt and pepper on the table and we had to ask our waitress twice for them. "Oops I forgot", she said with a smile (basic table items). Also, we asked for ranch dressing to dip our fries in and they came back with a watery dressing. 
The table was supplied with only two forks and napkins. No knives were provided upon delivery of our entrees, leaving us up to shaking the horseradish spread onto the French Dip (we did ask for knives and finally got two). 
Summary: 
Cons: Overpriced, average food, no better than Shari's. Poorly set dining table, unprepared for diners. Inattentive servers. 
Pros: The fries were good, and the "buspersons" were prompt when asked for something.

Can you call this pizza? Yes! One trend I have done most of my life is folding a slice of pizza in half to eat it. Coned takes it one step further and makes an elevated pizza. 

The cone itself is easy to grip and delicious to the last, cheesy bite. One thing I love about it is the consistency of the crust, it's crispy from the beginning to the end. The mix of toppings is great as every bite is cheesy and has a good collection of tasty treats in it. I like the fact that you can choose your own toppings if you don't want a pre-set option. 

Overall, this place is top notch and one of the best pizza's I've had in the Treasure Valley. Definitely a place that is worth stopping by for a delectable meal!

Finally found a good Mexican food place near me! Not only is the food great, the staff is awesome and it is very clean. If you lived in So Cal and you like Super Mex and Mi Burrito, you will love this place. They all know each other

Great customer service and such a beautiful assortment of jewelry.  They offer fair pricing for repairs and in a timely fashion.  I enjoy coming here just to browse, always something new and they have unique estate pieces that are fun to look at.

First time in today which happened to be on Mother's Day at around 10AM! Whoops big mistake! Didn't check the TIPS where someone wrote a tip that they're ALWAYS busy on Sunday's and to get there before 9AM! I can't imagine how much crazier it was today because it was Sunday + Mother's Day. We were seated at the bar after about 30 minutes (with parties of 6, 8 & 10 before us) and I thought they tried to be as accommodating as possible because it seemed like there was a LOT of large groups. 

As for the food I thought it was great! My boyfriend and I both got the specials for the day. I had a "Mimosa French Toast", champagne battered Texas toast stuffed with orange zest and a strawberry coulis on top. They were very generous with the coulis so bonus points for that! I felt like it could have used some whipped cream + I'm not super fond of the Texas French toast version. 

I thought it was good, loved the decor and ambiance. Service was as quick as can be for being swamped. Overall I would definitely return!

Where do i begin. Overall the food was fine. I think this place and management needs to invest on their workers and get them trained a little more. 

Came in and got seated. Our waitress comes and asks for drinks and we ask for orange juice and water. Water comes but no orange juice. I ask them to substitute one the sausage and upgrade it to the large sausage and didnt get it. They eventually bring it and end up charging me extra FULL price not the upgrade price. Orange juice eventually comes after asking them for a second time and our waitress was super overwhelmed. She was not very professional in a sense she would talk with an attitude and yell across the diner. 

Honestly, if management just spent a little more time training and working on the employees' communication and other skills for this service I think this place would do fine. Until then, I will try another place.
